text:
Friendly service and flexible appointments if you schedule ahead of time! They have a pretty big store with many frames for you to choose from including kids. Is right next to a few food places so you can grab a bite after your appointment. 

They have a number of variety of lenses for your glasses and contacts.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
This place is nothing special. I've eaten here enough times to know!  Each time, I end up saying,"Should have gone to Carabba's!"  Or Olive Garden for that matter. The food is mediocre.

The only good thing about this place is its prime location for sidewalk dining.

I LOVE the zumba classes - however the group exercise room is always TOO HOT for those zumba classes that start right after yoga.  There is no air circulation (no fans, no windows open) so even in the winter, it was too hot for a heavy cardio class.  They just need to install ceiling fans!  This is a major issue
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This is a Mid West style thin cracker crust pizza cut into squares. If you know this type of pizza this is a great place. Some other highlights, the make their own sausage, Friendly service, and salads. This is a small hole place that has been lost in time from the 70's. The beer selection is not great.

Dr. Toscani and her assistants downstairs have taken excellent care of my eyes for almost 8 years. I've purchased a couple pairs of glasses from the upstairs folks, and Rocky helped me choose a cute pair last time- I get a lot of compliments on the frames, but it wasn't something I would have picked for myself!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This was a very pleasant experience. The room was big and clean, nice kitchen too. The hotel has an indoor pool, fitness room, tennis court and free laundry for guests. Everyone was friendly and even the breakfast was good. I would definitely stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: this is located right off the turnpike and next to the red robin. I deposited money here for a friend who lives in California. Staff was fair and helpful. Most of the tellers were multi-ligual. drive through was pretty busy, but inside we were the only people there.

Tried to do a walk in during a recent trip to the area but it is a small restaurant with limited seating so we had to leave with our party of four. We returned the next day to get a quick takeout for beef udon noodles which was fine. Recommend to call ahead to find out seating availability.

If you're on the West side of town and need to rent a car, I recommend Enterprise. The staff is friendly, professional, eager to please, and happy to pick you up and drop you off. The fleet is brand new and full of fun new, German and Japanese cars that are great on gas.

This place is totally old school., The Supermarket that was left in the 70s. They have some kooky brands from New Hampshire called Best Yet. Id never seen that before. Some of your normal standard chain grocery things also. Nothing special and crazy. I guess if you live in the area it's as convenient as it gets.

I love tea, especially if it is of excellent quality.  The tea here is overpriced for the quality.  The dragon well longjin is quite mediocre, in particular.  The other teas are pretty creative and worth a try but only that.  I mean, it's over $20 for a half pound!

Got a multi-grain bagel and coffee here this morning, and, to be honest, I am not a big fan of the "improved" artisan bagels.  They are a bit too doughy for my taste and the multi-grain didn't have that great nutty taste.  At least the coffee was decent.  Service was very meh.

They have a lot of vegetarian options, which is nice, but it's pretty typical takeout.  The portions are good, and the chicken in the stir-fried dishes is not heavily coated in starch.  The brown sauce is decent but nothing special.  It's a good takeout option if you manage expectations.

Love this little hole in the wall place!  My shrimp over rice plate was delish, huge, and only $6. Plus they are super fast and I had my takeout in less than 5 min. I saw them cooking the dish in the kitchen. It's a no frills cafe but the food is fantastic and very authentic Cantonese home style.

I love the thin mint ice cream. It's like a cold creamy girl scout cookie. Give me two scoops in a waffle cone and I will be a very happy camper.  It can be very busy in the evenings but is worth the wait. They also ave healthier options like fro yo but I'm going for my favorite heart attack in a cone.

It was a little pricey as others have said. The food was decent, nothing to rave about. I had the Titanic Boat special and spinach dumplings. Dumplings were different and quite good, even with no meat inside. Took a little bit of time for the food to come, but that's because everything was made fresh (obviously since it was sushi).

The drinks here are standard fare but the jazz/funk band that played here was freaking amazing.  We came here twice because of them.  This was on Friday and Saturday between 2-4pm.  All of them rocked it out of the house, especially the saxophone man, his runs were ridiculous.  

4 stars.

I don't think that Peach Wave was necessarily better as an experience (I gave it 4 stars).  I think I might be starting to get over this craze as a separate "cool" experience.  Still enjoyable, great yogurt, and fun toppings.  Just not a 4-star thing anymore.

YUM YUM YUM

I love this place!

Favorites to order:

-California Burrito
- Enchiladas
- Veggie Burrito

Their service is great, dining room is always clean, they have never screwed up my order, and my husband and I can eat here and still spend less than 20$ total!

Love it!

How stupid is this bank? They have 2 entrance doors one for the "outside" atms and then one into the main bank branch. How about when the main bank was closed the other day, around 6 pm, some dumbass locked the doors restraining access to the atms. Some location. psh, take my money elsewhere.

Pretty good so far, does need some upgrading though and not as clean as I am used to.  It seems one other toilets are always clogged.  By biggest pet peeve is the young man who works nights parking in the handicapped space by the front door (silver VW) - doesn't seem to have a handicapped placard or plate....
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Great barber shop experience. I was greeted with a cold beer. Had a great cut from Sherie. The environment is relaxed and friendly. They have off-street parking which makes it easy to get in and out. The price was average for a good haircut in NOLA: $35. I will defiantly be back. Sorry "other guy".

Same shit, new shop... details of the quality service provided below:

https://www.yelp.com/biz/daves-wissahickon-barber-shop-philadelphia?hrid=U3dWh-l1iUIBmCwzxVx7Vg&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)

Dave or Carlos no matter... go get your head right.

Off the beaten path sushi spot, great for locals who want a bite to eat on a cute patio without a wait. I've been going here at least once a month for the past couple years. Fish is fresh, they have good rolls if someone is looking for "American" sushi and their house cabbage salad is delicious.

The "original" loses its lackluster when there are so many other "franchises" along the block.  Yes, liquid pixie stick is the best way to describe it.  So long as you follow the one-and-done philosophy, you'll make it alive out of Bourbon Street without gagging - too much.  [Last Visit: November 11, 2011]

The trainers and vibe are super friendly and helpful. The trainers have great tips and work to find a tip that works for you. The variety of versa climber, weights, running and rowing keep you engaged the entire class. The facilities are clean and new too! Not to mention, you'll get a whole body workout you won't regret.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Drive-through at about 4 a.m. today. My daughter wanted a meal. I wanted a diet DP.

Drive-through attendant on the squawk-box confirmed dinner was served, so Miss C. got her meal.

I got my diet DP. Deliverer of food was incredibly gracious and nice. Miss C. wanted extra ketchup, which was delivered appropriately.

Great service.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Came here while in town for work. Ordered the Baked Gnocchi as an appetizer and it was very good. Also ordered a pasta dish that I can't seem to recall but I remember it being very solid as well. Prices were reasonable and the service was friendly. Will definitely come back here.

Stayed here while in town for work. The hotel itself is very very nice but like others have mentioned, the ongoing construction around the area makes it a hassle. Hotel was very clean and grand. Service was friendly and the wifi was fast. Rates were pretty expensive but you certainly do get what you pay for.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Smaller size but great service! 

There is a bar right by the front window and maybe 1 table and two chairs.
The parking is not the most convenient, it should be open in the back to park but you just have the front and side options.

Not the best bucks to work from but an easy stop when hitting up spots up and down the pike!

From the moment I stepped into the restaurant, I was greeted with a smile. Right off the bat, I knew that this was going to be great place. The restaurant is very clean and presentable.

It is typical Chinese food you can get other places, but the staff and the cleanliness of he restaurant made it much better.

We had a fantastic time here one Tuesday night, thanks for the most part to the terrific service.

Each cocktail was carefully prepared and well-balanced. Music selection caused us to forego our other plans and stay at the Bends.

If I'm ever back in St. Pete, you'll find me here.

The pizza here is phenomenal. The chefs are from Italy and are award winning. The dough and all ingredient are simple. The cheeses are imported. The breads are fresh made. 

This place is a great choice for a date or group dinner.  The outside patio is very nice with great music.

I haven't been here in a couple years -- but they used to have one of the best selections of Grateful Palate wines in the country -- a most visit for those in search of top end Aussies. Give them a call. They always treated me like I was a VIP -- really great experience.

Best wine in the bayou.

AC/DC: Blows on my face, I hate that....
Cleanliness: Good
Decor: Really Cool
Price: Good
Shower: Great, plenty of hot water
Location: In the heart of it all

Great place to stay near everything, junior suite with separate living room, very cool, very comfortable. Huge Flat Screen TV 50 inches......
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Room: Semi-clean
TV: Old Style
Bathroom: Dirty
Bed: Comfortable
Hotel: Old
AC/DC: Yes it blew on my face

Front Desk was great and very helpful. Not as good as the last 2 Marriott's I stayed at but I'm still a fan. The location is great for an early flight to Detroit, MI. I'm an elevator ride to my gate, very cool!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
3:00 on a Sunday afternoon. Walked in to order an iced coffee. Was told they're "too backed up" and aren't taking any more orders. What!? You're a coffee shop! I asked if that was even for iced coffee and was told yes. 

Mind. Blown. 

Never had that happen in my life at any Starbucks.

I LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS PLACE!!! 

Some of the most fun rolls and its BYO! :) I like to sit at the bar and watch the guys rolling.  

MY favorite rolls are the Sixers, NE Viking, Spicy Capt'n Crunch oh the list goes on... dynamite roll is a winner too.. 

You MUST get the rock shrimp tempura - nice and spicy! :) yum!!!

I love this place. If you don't want to go through the trouble of doing your own car at a DIY car wash like Bubbles nearby, this place is nice, thorough, and it leaves your car very clean. In addition the staff is knowledgeable and quite friendly.  This has become one of my standby carwashes in the area.

Fun restaraunt for families. The owners have twin little boys that happened to be there when my kids were eating. We had a great time & now each time I come back, with or without children, they always ask. Its nice to have good food & unbelievable service. Good service is hard to find.

After reading the reviews here, I was super excited for some delicious Mexican food. What we got was minimal service, bland food, and long waits. My Enchiladas Supremas were very bland and watery. The salsa didn't have much flavor either. It was a cute environment, but I don't really plan on returning due to subpar food.

A solid neighborhood brunch spot with a number of breakfast options.  I sampled the Creole Omelet, which was strongly flavored with andouille sausage, roasted peppers, perfectly melted Jack cheese, peppers and a delicious Chipotle sauce with a little kick - a great choice!

This might be Jay's Favorite, but it's certainly not mine.  The fish is reasonably fresh and it's reasonably priced (3 for $10.25), but you get what you pay for in terms for fish quantity.  If you're desperate for cheap sushi with free delivery, it's an option, but I'd look for a quality sushi experience elsewhere.

The typical kind of bar like atmosphere (like an "Ale House")  Nothing too exciting.  I tried their Clam Chowder and was of course disappointed, it was salty and too thick.  We did try the burger and the fish sandwich which were pretty decent.  Might be a good place to watch a game and have a beer....

I have been to Koi three times, once for take out and the other two to dine in.  

The atmosphere is cool, and the service is pretty good.

The sushi is a bit overpriced, but they do have some different things on the menu, which makes the prices a bit easier to deal with.

I

I've been to Ooka a bunch of times.  

This place is pretty good.  I've gotten a wide variety of their rolls and sashimi-all of which is pretty damn good.

Great seats at the sushi bar-amazing to watch.

The servers are always polite, and the price is right on for what you get.

Good sake to boot!

This bar is a no frills bar located in Northern Libs.  It is filled with mostly locals who don't want to fight with a bunch of people for seats and shit like that. 

This bar is exactly what it appears to be.  This is a place where you can walk in, get service with a smile, and leave without spending 485983 dollars on drinks.

Came here with family while on vacation. Very disappointed. The crust was horrible, the sauce was bland, the toppings sucked, and it was grossly overpriced. It's essentially expensive fast food pizza. I would have rather ordered a chain pizza place and saved the money. Do yourself a favor and don't eat here.

This is a quiet neighborhood BYOB, cozy interior. The fare is basic American-Italian, nothing super authentic nor experimental. It's cheap and pretty good for the spectacular pricing. Our waiter was very friendly on the one visit we've made. I'd go again if I were in the neighborhood.

when I want wings, and I'm in the mall, I come here. they're pretty good. no flavor explosions. but good for what you pay for. I was especially disappointed with the gumbo. I know, you don't come here for the gumbo, i you do expect it to be pretty tasty... it wasn't.

Great wine shop right around the corner from e, and next-door to Publix. The staff is always extremely helpful and inviting. They have a huge selection of different wines. I have even seen wine tastings in there on the weekends. Overall one of the best choices in the area.

I have now been here twice, huge selection of toppings, and I mean HUGE selection!!! One thing that sealed the deal with me coming back was that they have a good selection of non-dairy ice cream. Sorbet to be honest. 

It's always busy cause it's yummy :)))

The music can be quite good here. Drink prices were in line for Bourbon street. It is the typical Bourbon street bar, a bit run down as far as appointments. So nothing very impressive about the facility. But the bands are good, and the folks here are having fun.

I have stayed here quite a few times over the years. it has a convenient location, but  the rooms can be small, and you do get quite a bit of noise from the riverboats. I still like it, the courtyard is charming and the staff are helpful. You can often find great online discount prices for rooms here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Best Pizza in Carp! Not my all time favorite, but this is my local go-to spot. Granted I like to actually go there, cuz the place is usually filthy and if there's a crowd it gets noisy. They do a trivia night on Mondays which is fun. And karaoke on Wednesdays which sounds awful...

I only ever come here because this market is two blocks from my place. If I were feeling not-so-lazy, I would make the hike to Trader Joe's. The staff are nice and they offer a wide variety of produce and groceries, but you pay a hefty premium for its location.

Fast, friendly and HONEST.  Amazingly, when I brought my car to Crown Honda - read my review about them :-( they wanted $150 for what this place did for $50.  I was in and out in less than 30 minutes and paid what I was quoted.  So simple, yet a challenge to find in this day and age.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Joe's Pizza provides late night food when you need it most.  Located on N Dale Mabry, they cater to the crowd partaking in the strip clubs, but with drive though pizza it definitely beats the usual fast food late night options.

Joe's pizza is NY style, so expect a slice you can pick up and fold, with a nice crunch to the crust.

I have been here twice since they have changed hands.  I am a big fan of their beer selection!  Their burgers are A-ok and the service was good.
I think it should do good considering that the parking lot is usually full and there are only two choices for dinner and beer in Harleysville.

I love salon bass.  I found it for my wedding -- Garrett was one of the stylists and he is fantastic -- and have since been back to get bangs and trims.  It is a comfortable, clean, friendly environment.  I got my husband to go also and they give him great haircuts too.  For the quality, I think the price is completely reasonable.

Again, we've all been to Dunkin so I'll leave impressions of the food to you and let's talk service and selection. As this is a smaller shop, the selection isn't as good as at some of the larger places, with limited offerings that quickly run out through the day. Service is pleasant but can sometimes be inattentive.

I just recently attended a conference there,  The hotel itself was very nice.  Rooms very clean, new and very large. I would give the hotel itself a high rating.  The food was terrible.  Awful They need to up their game. If you are attending a conference there I would suggest you not plan on eating.  Food was less than 1 star.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place is the worst McDonalds in the world. I know that sounds hard but this place is run by total morons, it is disgustingly dirty, the wait times are atrocious and the food (which should be exactly the same as any other McDonalds) is untasty and tossed in the bag like it was made by mentally deranged criminals.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
We buy liquor here on occaision because it is convenient.
I think the PA liquor laws are really strange and generally nonsensical.
They did have some chilled prosecco, though and that was great as I was on my way to a BYO.

Not a GREAT store - but OK in a pinch.

OMG - so overpriced for what it is.
I just had the $14 triple - an open-faced grilled cheese, French onion soup and a small salad, plus an iced tea.

My friend had an $18 burger and a beer.

Lunch was $52 after tax & tip.

Very nice food - but not THAT nice.
Sheesh.

I am seriously not kidding when I tell you that I came here with my (now) husband when we were dating and could absolutely not get any privacy.  

We stayed for one night only - maybe 6 hours really - and found the room to be clean and comfortable.

Don't ask, don't tell.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
OMG Romano's is just AWFUL.  Yes, it's a chain.  Yes they serve sub-par bitter (often rancid) carafes of inedible olive oil on every table.  Yes, the food is loaded with salt.

No, this is not what Italian-American food should be.  No, I do NOT want to ever come back here.

This is pretty much as "good as it gets" for a Fourbucks.
There is a drive through - but the walk-in service is even better with a spacious dining area - and super clean (brand new) facilities.

Excellent service and a full staff during the AM rush.

Plenty of parking.  Yay!!!

I like the Neuvo-Latino-Americano grub here.  The place has moved locations and is now a bit larger.  Chips & Salsa are always fresh 7 tasty, too.

I wish I could give a more substanital review but I ate here so long ago - and at the old location - so I'd better just keep my mouth shut.

Brand new - huge and much needed in this part of town.
A big improvement over the dinky "State Store" they closed on Chestnut.

So happy to be able to get a few bottled of bubbly for the holidays or a bottle or liquer or vodka when I need them.  (And an easy walk from 20th Street Station).

I love TD Bank - and go to this one primarily to use one of the 2 ATMs.

One big complaint though - when the changed their ATMs so that only a few are "full service" (Only a few ATMs take deposits, sell stamps, etc. - the rest only dispense cash)

I feel that all the machines should take deposits.

The Doylestown BK has been around for a long, long time - at least 32 years.  (The McDonald's up the road came first, though.)

As BKs go - and I am not a fan - this one is decent.  often tables and restrooms need more cleaning, though.

It's a reliable fast food option - though I loathe the stuff.

Between OK and Iovine's the RTM has your produce needs more than adequately met.
I usually check Iovine's first and then head to Ok's for whatever did not appeal over there.

They also have good prices on bananas.
Some of the discounted bagged produce you must use it right away (use it or lose it).

Large Starbucks right near 476 - so fairly convenient but the trafic at rush hour is bad.  Drive thru is available but we opted to order inside (and use the restrooms).

No issues.

Got in and out fairly quickly.  Parking lot was PACKED.

Alex (cashier/barista) was very good.
Seating area was clean and comfy.

Surprisingly OK.  Very nice front desk person (one guy - works=ed at least a double shift) and housekeepers.  Breakfast is included and is semi-decent including a 1 minute pancake (not waffle) machine.

Rooms are small but clean and comfortable. Strange lighting - bathroom area is super bright.
No complaints.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This bar has not changed in the last 25 years.
Mostly biker-type regulars from Q-town or Souderton and a few D-town long-timers.
Nice people in a dark and smoky bar (Hooray - you actually still smoke here).

Cheap drinks and easy access to the rest of town.

Not my thing - but OK in a pinch. 
The bartender Susie is a doll.

My husband ran in here today for an EMERGENCY pie to take to his brother who is stuck at HUP and craving Pizza.  He ordered a calzone and a Quattro (pick 4 toppings - one per 1/4 of the pie).

He said everything was fine.  Thin crust, decent toppings and since the pie was made fresh to order it was tasty and good. (Not stale).

Wow - such awful reviews for this place.  Sure it's sky-high prices - but you are paying for the convenience factor.  Decent produce, frozen foods, dairy, meat and prepared foods.

I go here for emergency purchases, certainly not to do my everyday shopping.

GLad they exist.  Grocery stores are few & far between in Center City.

Don't get the pizza (odds are you won't). The crust was very obviously a cheap frozen brand from the supermarket. The guys I went with got all you can eat grab for $30, though they said they've had better elsewhere. $1 PBRs on Wednesdays is a great deal, and quizzo night was fun.

The vegetarian pizza left something to be desired and for the price! Oh man, I was expecting gold on my pizza after I saw the bill.

Good service and delicious beers - perhaps happy hour would be a better fit!

The opposite of a comfy atmosphere - very clean and metal (if you're into that, you'll love it).

Came for a business dinner during devour downtown. The waitstaff was great - laid back in attitude but professional in service. 

The food itself was fine - not blown away for $30/person though. The portion was a bit small. My petite filet mignon was really thin but everyone's steaks were cooked to order.

For Chinese takeout, there is nothing better than Golden China. 

They have fast, friendly service that accompanies an equally great price.  And the best is that you get a free 2 liter of soda with every order of $20.00 or more.  

The only downside is that they do not have a seating area so it really is take out!!

Felicias is the best on the Main Line and even Philly for that matter. 

Nice wholesome ingredients with a delicious brick oven flavor. The staff is friendly and accommodating. Their pizzas are simply awesome. And their staff is super charming. 

This is by far the best pizza on the Main Line! The brick oven flavor is fabulous!

Your run of the mill Chinese takeout place. It's been here forever so they must be doing something right. Decent, cheap and fast. Get a combo which includes egg roll and rice. They also don't deliver their food in styrofoam which is always a plus in my book.

I've been to Japan a few times now, and I went here to get my Japanese kick. Sushi is good. I got the Don-buri last time I went and it was pretty solid. No issues. The place was quiet as could be. Everything tasted good. Nothing extraordinary about this place, but better than some Japanese steakhouse.

I asked my wife's family about a killer burger place here in town, and they said this is one of the best. They were right.

Spot on burger, fresh and not all greasy-nasty-drippy-in-a-bad-way. Yeah, that really is as eloquent as I can put it right now. 

Tasty stuff. Go git' it.

Its sad that if you want to charge your phone in between convention sessions, you must sit on the floor. Parking is weird, so much so that so many people have tried to avoid it that neighbors have added no parking signs to all the nearby streets. Yet they still charge. (At least its cheaper then downtown.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Nice Dunky .... Bright, clean, friendly staff. But the last 3 times I've been there the coffee is not very hot and has a bitter, non-Dunky taste. I grew up in Dunky country and am addicted so this was very disappointment. This just doesn't taste like Dunkin Donuts coffee.

Really awesome restaurant. We came all the way from Willow Grove to try a new restaurant. The food was amazing and the atmosphere even better. My wife loved their gnocchi (Nioki) and the branzino was delicious. We will definetly come back in the near future. You must take the Napoleon cake at the end. Thanks for great food.

Zama definitely prepares fresh and delicious seafood. While their Makis are pretty standard, I gave them a 4 because of the freshness of their fish and service. I ordered the House Tofu, and while the dish is interesting in preparation, I wish there was more flavor to it.

YUM! My friend and I split the spicy tuna crunch, eel roll, some other crunchy type roll and a california roll, and everything was delicious. I had a groupon, so that's why I chose to go here, and I would like to go again, but the prices are a tad bit too much for me, but probably about as cheap as you're going to find in the city.

WHOLY EXPENSIVE BATMAN!

$14 for a bottle of pine nuts. No joke. 

The store has an OK selection, although they often dont have what I want.  The seafood always looks bad...very bad. 

It is very expensive. I'd rather go to whole foods and spend that kind of money.

My first visit was for take out. The decor is nice and the restaurant is large.  

There is a large bar and TVs to grab some cocktails. 
I got chicken yakisoba. The portion and price was good but the flavor wasn't great. Something taste off. Almost burnt. 

I wouldn't order it again. I'll be back to try their sushi!

Don't mistake this fast casual chain for fast food. Everything is cooked to order, which is great! And the food is tasty, and fairly quick.

The problem when I was here was the woman taking orders. She didn't know how to move on between customers, which was adding tons of unnecessary wait time

I used to eat here all the time when I lived in St. Louis years ago. I went back for the first time a few weeks ago and I was underwhelmed...I would probably rather go to Chevys in Crestwood. But there was nothing BAD about the food, either.

Their fried icecream is great, so that's a reason to go here.

Great prices, decent food. It's about what I expect from fast food, and it beats the Panda Express by a long way. But that's not really saying much. If you want cheap food, and enough of it to get your belly full, then give this place a try. If you're having a craving for really good Chinese....find a real restaurant.

Love that this place has side booths and back rooms where you can sit at low-lying tables in a more traditional Japanese fashion. Makes an outing that much more fun!

The prices are decent and the sushi's very good. It's alwasy very fresh and there are many kinds of specialty rolls to choose from!

I stayed here for a weekend to attend a nearby concert. The prices were very reasonable and I really appreciated the food and drink coupons! We took advantage of the hotel restaurant. All staff, from check-in to housekeeping to restaurant staff, were friendly and professional.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Very convenient to all shopping areas.  The highway I 95 is right around the corner.  The staff has been very accommodating. The manager is always willing to help no matter what the circumstances may be. The rooms gets cleaned everyday.   Food?  Very homely. Staff serve everyone with a big smile.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This is a neat little neighborhood bar. The staff was friendly and the patrons seemed cool, too. I really like that this place allows dogs. I always find dog friendly places extra welcoming. It's worth stopping in if you are in the area and you want a drink.

I've been to this grocery store a few times, when I have been in the area. I have always found items here well priced and I like how they actually have a bunch of lines open at once, in order to get people in and out. I have never had to wait in a super long line here, which is awesome when you are in a rush.

Review is for happy hour only..

Great spot to watch a game, there are lots of tv's and they also play the volume for the big game of the day too.
Cheap appetizers and cheap drinks..Appetizers and drinks are 50%...
The servers are very friendly too.. 

Will definitely come back for happy hour next time I'm in town..

Dinner reservation for 5 long-time friends on the Friday after Thanksgiving.  We had a great time and a delicious meal. We shared 3 appetizers and each got an entree.  I thought the portions were perfect in size, although some might say too big?  I thought it was great.

Its been 4 years since my last review and It deserves an update. It tastes better. 

After recently eating more sushi, I went back to Samurai. It's good. The fish tastes good. The service not at peak times is fast. I like that the place is small. 

I still went with Spicy Tuna Roll and Vandy Roll. Both still delicious!

The flockworty Peacock Room is the newest Elevated Cocktail bar on the scene. The cocktails are very catchy and they have an amazing taste. I have to try the food. Careful with parking because it is in the heart of the city. I would suggest taking an uber/lift/taxi here. Robin Barnes performs on Thursday nights. Must see!

This is the first spot that you should stumble into on Frenchmen Street.

One of the only spots on Frenchmen with Hip Hop & R&B  DJ...

Like my celebrity twin RHonda W said " Great crowd mixture and large size aquarium to add to the rustic scenery"

Wednesday Night is Poetry. Happy Hour on Friday night with Brass band. 

@Vaso_Nola

The fanciest restaurant in St. Louis.  It's mostly memorable for the experience.  One of those jacket-only places--of course, you can't start comparing this to real foodie city restaurants...For most St. Louis people, it's one of those special occasion places.

Not really impressed. 

Pros - Our waiter was excellent, Fried mozzarella, was good, Italian beer ice cold, and cheap at happy hour, my pizza was OK. 

Cons - They got my wife's order wrong, Her meat was tough and dry. 

For the price, and the wait I expected better.

Doctor was grand, staff and the eyeglass side well... they're  a little lacking. Little expensive, and more than just a little misleading. I am satisfied with Dad's glasses, and my own. But, I felt much the same way I do after buying a new car. Most likely will not use them again for glasses.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Pricing is higher than a regular McDonald's.  Do not have dollar menu.

Smaller than normal McD's.  Has outdoor seating.  Right across from the beach on Beach Walk.

Staff talks among themselves too much, could provide more attention to customer, but were not rude.

Charge extra for sauces.

ATM machine inside.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I come here often since it is near where I lived. The servers are very pleasant, makes you feel at home the moment you enter. The food, let's just say it is fair enough to satisfy my craving for Japanese food. They put too much sauce on their teriyaki chicken. Rolls and sushi are just okay.

Sushi rice wasn't that tasty.  We ordered 7 rolls... each were just "meh" in flavor. The presentation of sushi arriving on their boats and bridges is cute though. I wouldn't necessarily come back to this place though. It wasn't as tasty as the other reviews made it to be.

We came here deciding to order some pizzas to go while in Bryn Mawr. It had the best reviews near the hospital so we tried it out. Their specialty pizzas interested us. 
The dough was hard as a rock. Not what we expected from the "best pizza." 
Don't bother If you want a real pizza with good dough and fresh ingredients.

Went here for a birthday lunch.


I had the squid salad, spicy rainbow roll and tuna nigiri.  The rolls were really big and the tuna nigiri pieces were also large.  

Overall, everything was just okay.  It was good quality fish and everything tasted good.  But nothing special.  Just okay.  I would go again if I was in the area.

A hip looking (but CLEAN) coffee shop in the Marigny.  I'm not a coffee drinker but their tea selection was good and tasty.  Plus I got to try mochi (ice cream w/ rice something around it).  Very delicious

If it was in my 'hood I would be here at least once a week.

OK.  I have to admit, I was not a fan of the Save-a-Center and only went under duress or great need.  But Rouse's has definitely improved the space and the selection of fresh produce and Louisiana products.  They are slowly working to improve this store and it is appreciated.

I usually pop in here when heading over to Elmwood for a movie or shopping.  For a sushi joint in a strip mall, they are really good.  They have items on their menu that the Magazine St. location has dropped (like their delicious inari).  Service can be sketchy because I think they hire local HS students, but it's OK.

Finally I get a chance to try here... its the best sushi I have since I moved to Tucson and thats all I can say!

Service was great even they were very busy the night when I was there. staffs were very attentive and friendly.  Spice tuna can be better but that just my opinion. 

If you like RA...don't come here...:)

Given the number of so-so food trucks with long lines of scrub-wearing dental hygienist and nursing assistant students, $8 for lunch isn't a bad option for this part of town.  The food's not terrible here and it's pretty clean.  They don't take credit cards, so bring cash.

This is no authentic Mexican dive, but it's predictable franchise Mexican.  They kind of skimp on the complimentary chips, but I imagine you can ask for some more if you feel like you can eat some more.  Nothing fancy, but they keep this site clean and the salsa/jalapeno bar is always well-stocked.

Very good dry cleaning, and a great place to get your jeans hemmed or a hole fixed.  They mended a hole in a very nice pair of my bf's jeans for $7.  Not the fastest, though, I think they send the cleaning out so it takes a few days.  Service is beyond helpful, the same woman is always there and she takes her job seriously.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: This place has a great mix and match section that seems to offer something for everyone. A color system tells you the cost for that particular beer and you can get as many as you'd like. It's a distributor as well if you're looking for a case, and they had a free tasting on the Friday that I stopped in.

I have only been here for happy hour, but it was a nice place with friendly service. Generous pours of wine for $5, a bourbon cocktail for $5, and I think a beer special or two also. They even gave us free bread since our friend raved about how good it was. I'd definitely like to find my way back here soon.

I honestly try to be upbeat and positive on my reviews but sometimes there is just not much nice to say.  We have been in twice and both times have not been greeted we just get that blank stare where you finally just have to assume they are ready and spout off your order.

Not the first place (or fourth) you think of when brunch in Rittenhouse comes to mind, although the lemon ricotta pancakes with raspberries are worth a special trip. Same can't be said for the bloody mary's, but maybe that's why it's not the first place you think of when you want brunch in Rittenhouse...

I'd give it a 3.5 if I could.

Stopped by here by myself the first time and had a quick and cheap lunch. A good, solid Plate of food.

Took The Girly there the second time. Still solid. Sweet lady who waits the tables seems to be the only wait staff member.

Guess it's time I updated this.

Went back and tried their poboys. Not bad. Won't blow Yangs or Parkway out of the water, but they are large, inexpensive and cooked quickly.
The owners are always friendly and have never felt like they were anything but open and honestly just nice people.

The place is in a good turn around location to grab something before heading to 270.

Onion rings descent from here and horseradish mustard taste great.  Forget the weird sauce they offer and stick to the horseradish mustard.

Culver's or many bars have better onion rings, but these are convenient and cheap.

I don't know what people are thinking. This place is really awful. 

Everything tasted like it came out of a can. All of the sauce was glossy, thick, pectin-like and did not taste like it contained any real food. So gross. You're better off either heating up some Mexican food from the frozen foods aisle or going hungry.

A very nice hotel. Located just 1 block off of Bourbon ST and convienient to all of the French Quarter. The rooms are HUGE, the beds very comfy, the staff are friendly, helpful and accomodating. We had a great stay and will make our plans to stay here again on our next trip to N.O.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Excellent food and concept. They really did a great job with the space as well - modernizing it but keeping many of the unique features from Duffs in tact. I love the open kitchen and the bar space. The service was not great, but it was only their third night and I am sure it will improve. Great addition to the neighborhood!

Tommy the guy that works here gave me a really good deal on my brakes. An affordable rate that went well with my wallet. It also only cost me 20 bucks for an oil change. I just went in for a routine oil change, and tire rotation, and found out I needed new break pads, Anyway I'm glad I went there.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Been here a few times - mainly for happy hour in the bar.  Decent drink and food specials during happy hour.  Food is decent but I don't think I'd come and pay regular menu prices.  The atmosphere in the bar is very nice.  Good place to grab a drink and a snack after work!

Food is authentic! Located in the same plaza as pho quyen and is right before the Taco Bell. I would choose this place over Taco Bell. The women working there was very nice. I ordered the tostadas and could only finish one as the portions are generous.  My fiance ordered the empanadas/quesadilla combination and loved it.

this is my favorite sushi place, ever. Always really good, good service (well, as good as any you get at a sushi place). Great value. The hawaiian roll and the miso glazed eggplant appetizer are my absolute favorite things. I wish it was a little closer to me.

Updating my review because I've been having a Wasabi summer this year.. While perhaps not the most exciting food you'll ever try, Wasabi has been overall consistent and good over the past few months. No weird odors anymore. It's a solid bet when in the area.

I had dinner here with a group of 9 people. The service was fantastic and the food was very good. I loved the chili and my friends loved the soup. We also enjoyed mozzarella squares and the Bruschetta. Overall, the meal was a success and I look forward to visiting again!

Authentic Mexican food at great prices.  Super clean place and very friendly staff.  Even if it's out-of-your-way, it's worth the trip if you're not interested in eating the same terrible Mexican food NE Philly and the general surrounding area normally serves up.

Its nice, its got a great location, its pretty expensive and then you pay nearly $30 for parking on top of that. I hate hotels that charge for parking regardless of location. You already pay a pretty penny for the hotel to have to pay for parking is such a slap in the face
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Good atmosphere out on the deck on a lovely evening. The server was very personable and attended the right amount. The hummus & whipped feta shmears were both very good. The pizza-ettes were a joke no need to get those. The small plates were good to share at our table of 8.

I went there for lunch, sat outside and this place was great!  I think I sent back the waiter twice because I couldn't decide what I wanted.  I wanted to order everything off that friggin' menu!  When I finally did get my food it was much more than I expected.  Why don't we have places like this in center city... sigh..

Like they said - you call them, they pick up your laundry, wash it, dry it, fold it and drop it back off. In our case, we were at a hotel, so they picked it up at the front desk, and dropped it off there, so we didn't need to rush back or anything. They did a great job!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I really like this dive because they have taco tuesdays, cheap drinks and one of the only dart boards in Boise (it's one of those plastic ones which disappointed me but it actually works alright).  Unfortunately I can't really go back because of a failed relationship with one of the regulars, c'est la vie.

I have only been to Asiago's twice but both times I had a really good experience.  This may be due to the fact that I am in love with asiago cheese and they freshly grate it for you.  The menu is a little pricey but the quiet dining room, polite service, and amazing food make it a great place for a romantic date.

I ate the crab scrapple for lunch and it was just ehhh - a very average dish. As for the desserts, the smith island cake was dry but the peach buckle was good.

Although the food was just okay here, I did like the open/modern space. The service was great.

Maybe I'll go back at some point to give it another shot.

I just took my bi-annual load of dry cleaning here this week, and was impressed with the very friendly service.  Clothes seem adequately clean and pressed...I dunno, what else do you look for in dry cleaning?  Not as cheap as Star Cleaners down the road, but much better customer service.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: This place is freakin Awesome! We've been there three times now, and have never been disappointed. Sure, they are making sushi that are catered to "Tennessee " people, (not all of it on the menu), but I love it. It's always fresh and at a great price. You should give it a shot!

I've only ordered the peking duck roll and it is pretty delicious. That being said, it's premade and microwaved which gives the roll/crepe wrap a weird mushy soggy texture. It would be better if it were thrown over a pan rq to heat and fresh made, but I guess for the cost they dont care enough to sacrifice speed for sogginess.

Old Point is great because it is open late.  The large selection of late night eats is fantastic.  When all the other bars on Mass Ave are closing, this place it just started to warm up.  I love the building and the outdoor seating.  Great views of the city.

This Subway is packed with medical professionals on a daily basis.  I feel like if anything happened to me while I chowed down on a sub, I would be in good hands.  I go to the Subway the most often, it's walking distant to work and I'm always happy with the service.

Their food is pretty good (I especially love the beets/soft cheese side dish), but their prices are too high for casual food. Also, when I take out, after 15 or 20 mins, someone at the counter will ask me if/what I ordered. They always seem overwhelmed and confused.

Delicious pizza with exactly what I wanted on it. Price is not bad either! $3 cheaper for a gluten-free pie here than at nearby competitor &Pizza. Lines can be long and the restaurant is tiny with limited seating, but the line goes fast and the yummy pizza is worth the crowds!

Went to Stella Sera with some friends this past week.  The restaurant is very nice, it's clean, the servers are very attentive and good at what they do.  In my opinion the menu is limited for an Italian restaurant.  The pappardelle pasta was good and cooked just right.

Food was pretty good. Drinks were good.
Staff was arguing in front of us constantly. 
Restaurant was way over packed (seemingly above capacity), hot as hell and the chairs/seats were so worn down that our tailbones were resting against the wood of the chair frame (and we are not heavy people)

Kazoku is slightly different!  It's not "the best" anymore!  It's still great, don't get me wrong.  But I can't fairly say it's the best.  The edamame tasted kinda grassy today; a lot of their warm foods tasted like a generic teriyaki sauce.  It's still extremely generous with all the side items and dessert though!

The food is average. The Margarita was weird tasting, like it was not fresh. 

There were more waiters than customers and we still had slow service, which was strange. The service was nice but again it was very slow.

TLDR: Average or below. Too many great Mexican places around to drive out of your way for this one.

There's a list why this fine wine & good spirits is my second favorite place to get hard liquor and wine (the first being on 20th and Market). Top two reason: it's clean and pretty big and a lot nicer than the ones in my neighborhood-- they even have tastings. Two-they have a huge parking lot so it's convenient! 
Sad face: no ice!

I've been to Red Elephant twice and have enjoyed my meals both times. The first time I had the Key West salad. The other night I ordered the Pasta Ya Ya with the alfredo on the side. It made it much healthier, and the chicken and veggies were seasoned so well that I didn't even use much of the sauce at all.

Went for lunch today. All the under construction stuff was gone. Actually for an inner city establishment it was very nice and tastefully decorated. Every worker i met was nice to me. 

My chicken nugget meal was popping hot and fresh.  No complaints about this visit.   I don't give chain restaurants 5 stars out of principal
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
PIER 39 in San Francisco had an  In-N-Out , no wonder, PIER 39 is for tourist & morons.

The food is awful, it has no taste.  Everything on the menu has a "fake" taste quality.

It is better than CrapDonalds though.

Tucson got one, so what, The food is awful, it has no taste.

Newly remodeled. 
Stop by the bar and if Mark is working tell him Ron and Angie from Cicero Il sent you. Mark makes you feel very welcome. Mark recommended an Irish restaurant in Franklin and it was great!

Love the new LG televisions, and the staff is excellent. Wifi is very reliable. Temperature was perfect.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
You can hear the Broad Street Line trains go by when you're down in the bathroom.  Srsly. 
This place has got really carby gnocchi--basically my favorite thing ever, fore a reasonable price.    Besides that I'm basically nonplussed with regards to this place.

Very cool.  I like this place   It's not the biggest or the cleanest but you can find some harder to find things here (not just goya foods).

They also have more flavors of Jarritos than I've seen anywhere else.  

The icecream case was all melted though, that's knocking down a star.

Ok I grew up on Pizza Shack Pizza and most importantly their FANTASTIC STROMBOLIS.  The pizza is not the best in town but their strombolis are out of this world.

Today I went to visit my grandmother and I got a chicken cheesesteak.  It was DISGUSTING--dry and blah.  Enough to knock 2 stars off.

This place is SO WHATEVER.  I wish I saw AJ Feeley when I was here because he is a babe.  

Anyway, I went here for an afterwork Happy Hour and it was just so lame.  The waitress misquoted us prices on drinks it took forever to get served and when we were we were given the wrong drinks.

It's expensive and fratty.

Decent Coffee on Whyte

When I stay in Edmonton I love to stay at the Varscona, so this Second Cup is a bit like my second home. I wouldn't say the ambience is anything amazing, but like most places on Whyte an interesting crowd and decent coffee. All with friendly and fun staff.

I had stopped eating here for a long time but restarted recently.  The regular "Single" burgers are better than I remember.  The buns are very good, very fresh, so is the lettuce.  I've come back a few times now. 

And of course we can't forget about the Frosty.  A chocolate Frosty is always a nice finish.

This place wasn't too bad. I'm from the SW so I've had my fair share of Mexican food. I had some carne asada tacos with rice and beans and they were pretty good. This place is nothing to rave about, but I'd come back here if I was in town again and needed a fix.

Not a huge fan of Starbucks in general, overpriced and sometimes bitter coffee. With that said, I do drop by for a coffee fix and lemon loaf from time to time. This location is close to me and the people are always very nice. Parking is good and traffic getting in and out it smooth.

Cheap Chinese food that is hit-or-miss.  Broccoli and Chicken is good, Cashew Chicken is not.  Veggie fried rice is so-so. But it's close and it's quick so I go.

The fortune cookies, however, are SPOT ON.  Seriously.  Like the most perfect fortunes ever.  Be prepared to be amazed.

Ummm, I went here last fall and haven't been back.  There wasn't anything particularly memorable about the place, except there weren't many customers, and still service was very slow.  Maybe they've gotten their act together since then.  I don't know if I'll go back to find out unless there's a really stellar review of it on here.

nola, you tried to kill me the one long weekend i spent in your fabulous city and you almost succeeded. what is a lush to do when the cocktails deliciously crafted?the music just right , the weather and breeze just perfect? find this gem across from acme, find a seat, a cocktail list and stay a while, you won't regret it

As an Italian from Brooklyn this place is sacrilegious for me to check in here.  But at 12am on a Sunday night and your craving pizza in Florida, you have limited options. If you can get it fresh out of the oven you have a fighting chance it might just be OK to consume it and not feel guilty in the morning.

I have been a DD fan for over 40 years and location quality varies immensely unfortunately, this location so far has been good so far in the times I have patronized it.My only gripe would be that,depending on time of the day, some employees are not as friendly and can be rude when you change or modify your order.

Grabbed a Hot and Sour soup here recently on the go and It was probably the worst I ever had. Overly salted and overly spiced , Tofu tasted stale and veggies looked like they seen better days. I had to throw it out , it was that bad. Plus place is dirty and unorganized not good signs.  Much better options in the area.

I stop here on occasion and the service is spotty , the drive thru people can be for a lack of better word, rude at times. Just about every time I have ordered my usual Iced coffee light ice, sweet n low and 1/2 n 1/2 , they give me full ice, milk and sugar.
,So to be very generous I can only give them 2 stars at best.

This is your average expensive laundry center, but it is open 24 hours, so you can wash whenever you feel like it, though I would not feel to safe in there that late. There are no workers that you can see, it is pretty much do it yourself, though there are a couple insects in there which can bother some.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: You will go insane trying to decide which wine to purchase....huge selection. Love reading the reviews. Many Napa and Sonoma vineyards that we have visited are represented at Plaza. The beer selection is mind boggling!  This is the only place in town that carries my beloved Poire William..

I would give this place an "Eek! Methinks not" and half a "Meh".  If it weren't for their salad bar (the only highlight), I would not have enjoyed this place at all.  Their soup was overly salty and whatever my husband ordered wasn't memorable.  I won't be going back again.

Best apple turnover I've ever had.  You can tell this place takes every detail into consideration.  The sandwiches looked beautiful thru the glass, although a bit expensive.  We only stopped in the bakery coffee shop so i can't say anything for the restaurant except that it was hopping late the night before when we walked by.

Very nice people running the hotel. Front desk staff and everyone else is friendly. The hotel room was comfortable and the bed was good.  Free parking across the street.  The price was reasonable and they were convenient to the casinos.  I'll definitely stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Yo My Goodness is exactly right! It is Yo my goodness good!

Self serve fro-yo and toppings that is priced per weight. What a genius concept! I recommend the brownie and yellow cake batter flavors! Mmmmm! The place is just so darn cute and trendy inside. I will be back.

This place makes me forget I live in the prohibition era ( I mean PA). It is clean, well organized and has a great selection. Plus there is easy parking right out front. 

Hopefully this is a trend that they are trying to start with state stores. Unfortunately it probably isn't.

Stopped here on the way back to philly, they have a nice 10% discount for Sundays on 6 bottles that my girlfriend and I split. While I wasn't overly impressed with the selection they did have many wines I am familiar with and miss while shopping in PA. I would defintiely come back if I were driving by.

I don't know why people in the Northeast love this place. They card at the door, but you can clearly see that all of them are underage! The women that go here think they are high class when they really aren't and they want to get hit on by these guys that you can clearly see will never do anything with their lives.

They were good, today. Had my reservation ready to go, she was polite and friendly throughout the process, the car was right where it was supposed to be, and haven't had a problem with it. 

Definitely worth the taxi ride from the airport - It would've been $350 more to get the car from PHL.

If you're drunk, and  you are, and it's hot, and it is, this place will hit the spot. I mean, there's really not a whole lot more to say about that. You grab one on the fly and keep on walking down the street on a 95 degree evening. Careful now, they're sweet and taste light but they pack a punch. As they should.

Yum yum.  The ice cream was a bit on the expensive side but the flavors were absolutely delicious.  They have the best Salted Caramel (better than places in CA) and I loved the Creole Cream Cheese.

There's a big section of different variations of chocolate flavors as well so if you're a chocolate fan, this place is for you.

Just to be clear:
I'm writing this about the LOUNGE experience only.  (I've been for their food and it's very good)
But don't let their good food trick you into hanging at the bar.
It's probably just me, but being hit on by drunk law students just isn't my idea of a good time.

I recently ate at Ajia before a concert I attended at World Cafe Live, and my experience there was much better than it was the first time I had eaten there 3 years ago.  The sushi was yummy and the place wasn't crowded either so I was in and out of there in about a half an hour (or less!).  Good service too :)

This place has potential BUT their portion sizes are on the smaller side. Another issue I have with this place is that I ordered a hot fudge sundae in which they placed the ice cream on top of the hot fudge therefore receiving cold fudge. So disappointing considering what you're paying.

I wish their service was a bit quicker! Sometimes I need a rush clean and they seem to not provide this service. Other than that, they do a pretty good job on the items I have dropped off thus far.  Oh and the lady that works there needs to smile more often. She seems quite miserable at times!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Good menu, service and fresh seafood are the reasons I frequent this establishment.  Great for lunch or dinner, the food always has been served quickly and on point.  Having other selections than raw fish are great, but definitly secondary for me.  Place has good value and the interior is clean and intimate, most of the time.

Love this Burger King!  

Every time I go here, the food is hot, fresh, and tasty.  The lady who helps me, Bobbi, provides outstanding service every time I go!  Great customer service, friendly, quick, and super nice.

(Don't be fooled by the guy on the internet doing bad stuff with the food. He doesn't work at this one.)

This is THE worst Starbucks in south Tampa. They are always out of coffee..Really? This is a coffee shop. They should never be out of coffee. The service is terrible. Whoever manages this one should be fired. It's been terrible here for a very long time. Avoid.

This is a great Starbucks to go to if you are looking for a spacious area to set up work shop.  The WIFI is pretty good here, I had no issues signing in while I was there.  I really like the big patio too!  

The service here is friendly and fast, plus the drinks are consistent with all other Starbucks.

This is an A-Ok spot in Nippers Corner to get stocked up on some liquor or wine.  It is pretty small in size, but is somewhat competitive with pricing.  I do like the selection of refridgerated white wines.  It is great for grab and go options.  

Also, it is pretty easy to get in and out of.  Not to bad!

On a busy sunday evening, service is kind of slow.  Wait for seating takes 5 or so minutes even with reservation. All hosts in the front desk are trying to help set up a table for someone walk-in.  Waiting in the room for another 10 min without service.

Food in general is OK, nothing to brag about.

This is a typical example of this chain.  Small tough parking lot.  Food and drinks are just what you expect but you may run into a language barrier ordering it.  They have extended hours so I sometimes go here at odd times.  Most of the time I'm 1 minute up the street at Starbucks.

This is one branch of a big chain. The good news is-
* Clean and neat
* Competitive pricing
* Decent hours
* In and out relatively quickly with no appointment

The bad news is it can be difficult to get the same person each time.  If that's important to you another alternative may be your best choice.

I've been in here a couple of times but only at the bar.  In each case my drink has been fairly priced but the bartenders have been not even OK.  They were different each time and acted bored and uninterested.  

I need some better reviews from my fellow yelpers to give me an incentive to return.  Otherwise I'll just drive on by.

I love this place.  I have been here on several occasions and always found something inventive to eat.  Recently, I had the beef three ways and all three were done perfectly.  However, I would not be honest if I didn't say that one of my favorite reasons for going is the brownie and mint ice cream dessert.

This place is pretty cool. I came here to grab a beer and have some pizza while watching sports with friends. The Santa Barbara whether is usually really nice so you can enjoy eating and drinking outside on the rot iron chairs. I will probably be back. Thanks Gina's!

-Tej

Incredibly slow and only one person running the front counter, despite many people standing around in the back, and all I ordered was a salad that was pre-made. The salad that I received contained about half as much as I usually get. 

What's the deal, Mickey D's?
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I stopped by during happy hour. $1.50 off of all drafts, and their prices are already pretty low  so it ends up being a cheap drink. The bartender was friendly and attentive, and I love that they have additional bar-style seating against the wall. I'll definitely return!

The food wasn't mind blowing, but it was good.

What I liked most was the horchata. I'd never had it until dining here and it set me on this big quest to find the best in St. Louis. Gardunos' is definitely my favorite.

If you've never tried it (or have never heard of it), this is a great place to give it a try.

Love this Hampton Inn.
Staff is so friendly and sweet.  Everyone making sure you are alright and finding everything ok.  Felt very safe and the room was nice and clean/comfy.

They do have complementary breakfast in the morning and coffee all day. I didn't have breakfast but their coffee was decent.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Tip:
-metered parking is enforced on the weekends 
-come on wednesdays for 99c double meat

Service was friendly. I like how the guac and hummus are at your disposal at no extra cost. I added banana peppers with my gyro and that didn't pair well. It masked the flavor of the gyro meat. Don't think I'll be back for a while.

They car wash is good but not great.  Old style wash isn't as thorough nor as gentle as the touchless and their wheel cleaning wasn't 100% either.  Nobody wipes down your car after it comes through either.  That said it is quick, pretty good and for $8 not too expensive.

It's a little small place in a small plaza that is pretty much family operated. One main person who does the cutting. She did a great job doing what I asked her to do, which was simple bc all I wanted was a trim. She made my hair look fresh again. =)

Cheap and fast. Definitely check it out if you are in the area.

I've come here on a few occasions.... The food is good. The service is good. Actually the service is great. They are always prompt and the head sushi chef always, always, always throws in a lil lagniappe. (Complete surprise every time).

The rolls are too big for my taste. It makes it hard to eawt them.

I have got to say....I really like this place! 

I have been coming here recently to stock up for this juice craze I have been on. Top of the line fresh veggies and fruits! 

The meat market is on point, as is the prepared food section.

It is a bit pricey,, but totally worth it as far as quality and customer service go.

4/5 you take so much of my money.

so fre$h. let's not lie. this place is like my bank account, only i don't own any of the money i hand over the register. oops.

great selections though, all are really fresh and great. love the specials on tuesdays, staff are friendly. pick up the fruit chips! nomzzzz!

2.5/5 on ATM only

i've never actually walked in, but will stop by to pull cash every once in a while. for some reason, when i visit in the evenings i don't fully feel safe  on more than one occasion i've noticed there's been a car just chillin in the drive-through, but not actually conducting any business.

I'm torn.  The food is sooooo good but the service is sooooooooooooo bad.  They have very unique and delicious dishes but they need professional servers - these guys had no idea what was going on.  Two of us finished an entire bottle of wine before an appetizer came out and we were drinking VERY slowly.

The delivery is fast, prices aren't bad and the combo platters have good value. When I called the person on the phone wasn't that friendly, but the reason for a 3 star is that the meat in the sweet and sour chicken always seems so little. They are pretty decent overall.

Yum yum yum yum yum

I wouldn't give Miyabi a 5 star fancy dining rating but I work nearby and love the bento boxes while dining in or delivery to the office. Right now I'm on a small kick of addiction here since it is conveniently located near a nail salon and other shops.

I was happy with the $17 car wash and while I wasn't amazed or highly impressed, I do think it was better than the other car washes I had been in the past. The inside waiting area is very basic and has air freshener, snacks and standard stuff for sale like most places have. The staff were also nice.

Great place for a spicy bloody mary!  The Burgers are HUGE! and I left feeling really stuffed!  Molly served us today, and she was very helpful and nice!  

I would recommend this place to anyone who is hungry or wants to have a few cocktails with friends before dinner.

This location is great!  The night we went I had ordered an Ice Carmel Frapo, I wanted a tall, but they accidentally made me a Venti!  I wasn't' going to deny it!

The staff is very friendly I noticed that they new their regular customers by name, and I Love place like that!

I haven't been since the opened, and it was a good dinning experience.  The food is pretty much the same now that I have eaten at all 3 of thier resturants.  Staff was great and the table side lady who makes the Salsa even made some for my kids, and they loved it.  The place is great for big parties and families with kids.

Every time I come into this branch the staff is incredibly friendly. It's clean, well staffed and taken care of. I just do basic business banking here, and have never had an issue. I never have to wait in line, and get any questions answered easily and politely. 

It's a great Chase branch.

Awful...
The menu sets you up for such high expectations and then everything comes out all messed up. Wrong food. Slow service. Burger wasn't cooked well. (after specifically saying that). It took almost 2 hours to eat here and it wasn't real busy. I won't be back.

Decent room, but hot water was dangerously hot (I reported it to the front desk.) Outdoor pool is a nice touch, but sucks when you want a pool during the winter or late fall. Staff is cool and will do things like call you a cab late night. I'd stay here again and the price is right, but still prefer being in downtown Indy itself.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Slow service... everyone will probably find something they like.  Half of the food is good.  The ice cream was below grocery store quality.  Entrees around $17.  Slow service and weird atmosphere.  I'm guessing it's a place for the "regulars" - the 55+ community on the same property.  Parking was tight.

I'm new to the all you can eat option in sushi restaurants.  So the waitress gave us her pitch and after everyone took off their shoes to figure out the math we decided to go for it.  Save yourself the math and go for the all you can eat.  Even if you are not a big eater the variety is worth it.

I will admit that I am a sushi snob.  I can't help it... I'm asian.

Expensive for what you get. Small portions.

I got take out here because it was convenient when I was having a big sushi crave. 

Specialty Rolls are lackluster.  Miso soup is watery and salty at best.

Wow they deliver and it's really cool looking... It'sPizza's worst nightmare. This is pan fried greek style pizza. Which essentially to me is nonsense. Their pizzas are super expensive and small-small. It's just a cut above pizza hut. I feel like the greek style pan pizza chains are in a league of fake pizzas of their own. WEAK!

Once you find a reliable, honest, and qualified mechanic, you might also want to buy a lottery ticket.  I'm not sure which odds are greater.  I've been using Don's Muffler for oil changes and brakes for 2 years now.  I've sent all my family and friends and no one ever has had a complaint.  They're fast efficient, inexpensive.

basic mexican...
good because they are cheap and nice at the same time!

although they say the outside is heated if you sit next to the plastic outer limits you are left with cold feet ... on the only cold day out of this year!

Like I said its not fancy mexican but its cheap and the liquor is cheap/ with the beer!

I live nearby and figured I'd give China King a chance - especially since they deliver - but, I was disappointed by my meal.  The veggie dumplings were a shade of green I've never seen in nature, much less in something I was supposed to eat.  The chicken & shrimp in garlic sauce was OK - but not something I'd order again.

Good cafe-type food cooked fresh and served quickly. Seating can get a little tight during the lunch rush, but they have a takeout counter as well.

I'm particularly a fan of the (pieces of) fish sandwich or the corned beef, but I've not had anything I didn't like.

It's a McDonald's... so you already know what you're in for.

I was excited when I drove by to find out this one had a 24 hour drive-thru, thinking it was the closest to Downtown, but I just learned the one on Lindell near Sarah is *also* 24 hours. Fast-food nation, indeed.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Had a very tasty lunch here with some clients here recently.  GREAT lunch specials..$13 for six pieces of sushi, and six sashimi salmon with a small salad and miso soup to start.  Spicy wasabi and a beautiful presentation.  

Lots of other items on the menu I'd love to come back and check out as well..

Sushi Heaven is here. Casual, yet delicious and without the pretension that makes it impossible to get a table at some of the other sushi spots in town. Understated, yet elegant surroundings make this a choice spot for a first date or a business dinner, and the sushi is divine .

Went there a few days after opening, and the lines were pretty long but of course the food is always great, I love the caramelo's. Through in a couple roasted Jalapenos and its on!! Seating is a bit of a pain, hopefully when the eastiders get their fill and the hype dies a bit it wont be that busy.

To me, the food here is standard, marginal cafeteria fare.  It's okay.  I had the chicken fried steak for breakfast and it was good when you're in the mood for that kind of full breakfast.  I wouldn't avoid the place by any means, but it's not on my top 10 list either.

I stayed her with my wife over Labor Day weekend.  The room was nice, the bed was comfortable, and everything was clean.  The people at the front desk were friendly and helpful.  This isn't the Ritz Carlton, but if you are looking for a good place to stay that is clean, has good amenities, and won't break the bank, this is it!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Had a chicken parm dinner while the wife got 2 slices of veggie pie. The chicken parm  was ok...the ziti accompanying it were aldenti as I prefer. The tomato sauce tasted just ok. Portion was average. My wife said the pizza was just ok. Good , friendly service .

Had lunch here with 2  guys that work with me. The free bruschetta was among the best I've ever had. The other 2 guys both got a panini, which they both said was very good. I got ravioli which was quite good, in a very tasty tomato sauce. Service was very good.  A tasty bread was served as well. I will be back!

I only stay here if everything else is booked. The service here is horrific. The rooms are shabby. Room service trays stay in the halls for hours. My ice machine was broken for five days! 

Go on hotwire DO NOT BOOK 3.5 stars in center city west!!!! you will always most likely get this joint!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is a very good fast service restaurant. they have flame grilled and griddle cooked hamburgers. it is cheap and usually good for a fast food restaurant. one of the best in town. the food is usually hot and fresh. the onion rings are awesome. i love the BLT.

most of the time when i am in belleville, my sis and i end up here. good food, ok prices. i like the double dipped fries. fries that are fried, then covered in buffalo sauce then fried again. the wings are good. they have sweet potato fries and an awesome ranch dressing.

i'm not gonna lie. this store is old, but it serves it's purpose. It is clean. the people are kinda hit and miss on friendly. if you are wanting a salad bar or gourmet section. this is not your store. This store has most of the things you need for your grocery shopping needs.

i went here today for lunch. i got the new Orleans eggs Benedict. very good and came with fries. added bonus. i wish they would sell the beingets all day, but what can ya do. i have yet to try one. the cheese sauce could have been a bit better, it was more butter than cheese. but still pretty good.

this is one of the better shop and saves on the east side. it is always clean and the people are mostly friendly. the size of the store is bigger than the one i have here in town.  i wish i would have thought about going in first before i got gas. depending on how much you spend you get so much off your gas per gallon.

This may have been the smallest hotel room I've ever seen. There is nothing 'luxury' about it which is strange because it is affliated with Davios, an expensive and upscale steakhouse.  I think the room service comes from there.  The rates are reasonable for the area but don't expect any frills.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The correct name for this establishment is now called, "Mr. Jack's"

I have been to see Mr. Jack before.

They do a decent job and are reasonably priced.

Nothing fancy, so if you like the hot towels, cold towels, head massage etc...  you may want to keep poking around.

The room was decent, although small.
The rest of the hotel has seen better days, but is still "a-ok."
The location is awesome - we walked to at least 20 bars over the 3 days, no exaggeration.
The prices are the best you will find in the area.
It has a decent bar in the lobby (Elephant & Castle).
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Below-average mainstream sushi restaurant.  Decent seared fish appetizers on special when we went, and the seafood salad was hearty and refreshing.  Other than that everything was mediocre and nothing to write home about.  Good for a quick-fix take-out sushi but definitely not destination worthy.

I got a small dark chocolate.  It had two large scoops of ice cream, which I came nowhere close to finishing, but it was really tasty!  Next time I need an ice cream fix, I'm coming here!  And I'm probably going to try the strawberry ice cream since I can imagine MaggiMoo's being really good.

gosh. you can easily get yourself in trouble in this store.  I had no idea tea could be so costly.  I was still happy with my experience because the tea smells and tastes really good but these ladies are hustlers. no joke.  I even saw two girls high five each other after they sold $500 worth of tea to some guy.  what a schmuck.

There are already so many reviews that I will keep this very brief.
1) Do not eat in. It's compact, to say the least. 
2) Great, cheap selection, but the rolls are pretty small.
3) Very friendly staff.
4) On a Tuesday night they were still open at 10pm... that's great in my book.

We finally tried this place that is right around the corner from our house. We ordered the St. Louis style combo pizza. It was underwhelming - a bit soggy and greasy. I think the pizza is expensive for the quality so next time I would opt for my other closeby favorites - Pi or Dewey's.

We've been to Blackfish many times and we decided to try Mica for our anniversary dinner. The blue crab tortellini is to die for and our main courses were cooked to perfection. I do wish there was more options on the menu and updates on the tasting menu too.

As far as Wendy's goes, the food is solid, the service is friendly and the location is clean. I really only need that to make me happy. It is also conviently located amongst the millions of plazas on Street Rd, so if you are out spending all your money on other stuff, this is a filling and cheap option.

I was sold when I read Cinnamon bun ice cream. I did really enjoy my cone, but it did take an eternity to scoop to balls into a waffle. I wish the service was faster and the prices were cheaper.

Overall it is decent ice cream, there's parking and some benches in the back to sit. The staff was also pretty friendly.

You know, there's actually limited peking duck here. It's actually better fo roasted duck in the window, and they do a better job at their big restaurant over on Vine with the peking duck.

Noodle & rice dishes Hong Kong style. Much like Big Wong's.

Cheap prices, though. Cash only.
