I saw this Dairy Queen in Philadelphia and did a double-take, as normally this is not around the area! They had all the old favorites of blizzards, mint sticks, and more.

As the store is right off South Street, it can get quite dirty... watch out later in the night as kids overflow the area.

I am new to the area and I chose this place because of the great reviews on yelp.  I was able to walk in on a friday afternoon and we were seen within 20 minutes.  The vet was friendly and helpful and I think my pup will be fine.  The facility is clean and the staff were friendly.  I will go here again!

I really liked the blacken tuna nigiri and starstruck roll.  The place didn't offer appetizers or dessert with the all you can eat menu.  Very disappointing.  I had to try the place from the recommendation is a friend of mine.  

I know next time I'm going to head over to Sushi Pier  2 and Hiroba.

Nice selection of name brand frames and they always carry the season's newest. But too overpriced for eye exams. I'd normally do cough out $$$ for a pair of fashionable Chanels or Gucci frames. But get your exam elsewhere. Also catch their annual trunk show sale, plenty of great deals.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: We tried several items on the menu and found three things that are very good:  Egg Foo Yung, Chicken with Chinese Vegetables and Crab Rangoon.  We don't like their fried rice, Hot and Sour soup or Kung Pao Chicken, which is pretty disappointing for a place like this.

I choose Holiday Inn so I can get United miles... not such a good reason huh. Well, overall the place was okay, nothing special. I would recommend the best western over the holiday inn though since the bw has complementary breakfast, friendlier staff, and nicer rooms. Oh well, lesson learned.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: After my fiancee and I went to the aquarium, we decided to get some fish for lunch. We both got the 3 roll lunch special which is a great deal. The sushi though is a bit below par, the rice was way too cold (like last nights) and the flavoring is eh. Overall ok, nothing special, won't be coming back.

I didn't actually stay at this hotel, though I did go to a conference that was being held here. The hotel from the lobby to the ballrooms appear to be outdated and falling a part. Its rather dark and the ceilings look like they have seen better days. 

On the positive it is not a far walk to restaurants, the library, and museums.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I come here once every week or two for withdrawals and deposits.  The lines (both inside for the teller and the drive-up ATMs) can get surprisingly long during certain peak periods.  Surprisingly, the interior ATM machine is almost never busy.  Staff is friendly, but seem a bit overworked/understaffed.

Reasonably central location (about a 15-minute walk up Canal from the French Quarter), this location didn't seem as well-organized as the Baronne street location and I ended up waiting ~20 minutes to get helped during both pickup and return.  Staff was pretty friendly, but next time I'll probably rent from Baronne street.

The margherita pizza here is to die for! 

THey offer both mozzarella or goat cheese for a nice change of pace. It might seem a little pricey at $19.50 but it's worth it.

Skip the slices they can't compare to a nice large pie fresh out of the oven with the crust perfectly done.

Definitely "a slice of Brooklyn" here in Tampa

Picked up a large veggie pizza & it was delicious! Fresh crust, sauce, cheese, & veggies. 

Heads up: I swapped mushrooms for banana peppers but still found a few mushrooms on my pizza so if you have any allergies then speak up when ordering so this doesn't happen to you.

I'll definitely grab a pizza from here again!

In the market for a nice pair of eye glasses? They got you. Or a nice pair of Sun glasses? They got you for that too! Fashion Eye center has a pretty good selection to choose from. I've also had eye exams here in the past. The staff are nice...although sometimes a bit slow, but overall good experience.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Tortillas! It's all about the these delicious orbs of flour. These are legit. I highly recommend you check this spot out at for to pick tortillas, because that's all I can really speak to at the moment. I have yet to dine in. There'a no reason to buy big box store tortillas when we have so many options in Tucson.

Covid take out seems to be a lot of misses. You can count on vivace for consistency, that's for sure! We called in for a 6pm. pick up.- three entrees- the eggplant, stuffed pork chop and shrimp. Everything was as good as it would have been for dine in. The staff brought out food out curbside which was highly appreciated.

Nail Experts is conveniently located at Loughborough and 55 in South City.  In the past, the service wasn't that great, but ownership has changed since my initial review. My recent experience was much better.  The place is a little outdated, but the Nail Technicians do a good job.  Not my first choice, but great option in a pinch.

I was very happy to see Negra Modelo on the beer list, and the sweet plantains were fried to perfection.  I had the cuban sandwich~it totally put to shame all other cuban sandwiches, especially since it was layered with pork, ham, melty cheese, annnnnd roast beef.  Lovely.

The Down Under is alright. There really isn't anything special about it. The food menu has cute names that sound Australian, but the food is exactly what you'd get at any other one-off, family-owned restaurant: burgers, chicken sandwiches, salads, etc.

Nothing truly Australian about this place besides the photos on the walls!!

-Looks like a house and is rather small. 
-A chain Mexican resturant that can be found all around STL, other parts of MO and IL. 
-With that said you will have the bland generic salsa and dishes. 
-The service was great and quick.
-I love the fajita nachos. AHHmazing.

So I stopped in at Colombos on a random Thursday night.  Despite the smoke, which wasn't all that bad, it was a great time.  Ill keep this review short and SWEET:  $2beers in tap.  'Nuff said.

This place always holds a special place in my heart, so I am a little bias.  Not gonna lie.

Old Philly atmosphere and service. A total classic in the best way. Enjoy a carafe of sweet red wine, spaghetti and meat balls with garlic bread. The wait staff calls you "hon" and you don't mind at all. Linger in the bar on a busy night for prime people watching.

Gingham's is a good place to go for breakfast; they serve it all day long and the prices are amazing. (I think what I like is called the Rancher or something like that.) The rest of the food here is so-so and they attract an older crowd. Stay away from this place on Sundays as the after church crowd is insane!

Okay, so you get a ton of food for your buck at El Maguey's. Uh, but that doesn't matter if this "ton of food" is served in a dark, dirty dining room. I still maintain that my food didn't taste very good of its own accord, but I also maintain that nothing could taste good in this place because of the look of it. Gross.

Late in the evening munchies, not much open on 34th but the fast food places..drove through and got their 'Angry Whopper' which is a new item.
It had a bite to it surprisingly.
So far, I've made to 'angry' trips to the bathroom this morning.
Well done Burger King! A product which lives up to its name!

This store is a mainstay in the area - I cannot imagine how much money I have spent in this place over the last 30 years or so....

Prices are usually reasonable, and sometimes they have great promos. This store is above average in size and selection for an ABC.

So - just joined - one day in, I have to say it's what fits my life best. Helpful staff, lots of cardio options.

I like the 24 hr access and the location is ideal for me. Pricing put them in the middle of the various options I considered, and the crowd is there to get healthy, not preen and pose. Me likey.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Settled in the unlikely stretch of Elmwood Shopping Center, Sake is relying on those seeking a more exotic fare from surrounding burger, fried chicken, and other up-scaled fast food joints.

As a sushi restaurant, they are about average to meh, though a far bit better than other local eateries.

I had a 6:45 train back to NYC one morning after a night of debauchery in Philly, and was happy to see this place was open.  They were really on top of taking orders and getting the coffee into the hands of a drowsy public.

My order was fast and accurate (also not that complicated) so I have to say this place is decent.

Let's be honest here - it's a $4 - $8 (depending on what service you get), automated car wash.  If you have high expectations from that, then I don't know what to tell you, but if you're looking for a quick wash to get all the salt/muck off during the winter, this place is great.  I'll definitely be back!

Tip: skip the walk-up window for Hand Grenades, and head deep into the bar. Service is quicker, plus you'll be entertained by some good musicians. Give 'em a buck, they're working hard!

I like the frozen Hand Grenades better than on the rocks. Fun, at least once while you're in New Orleans.

Hand Grenades are A-Okay! $8 to start, $7 refills, so Grip it and Sip it!

This "Little" Tropical Isle is good for a pop-in but kind of depressing. A piano/guitar duo were so sedate, I figured they were on ludes. Pop-in the door on the left and grab your Hand Grenades, Horny Gators, etc. to go!

Service is consistently slow. It's not the wait staff, its the kitchen. We often watch wistfully at the window waiting for our food to appear. The food is ok. The chef salad is good as is the cheesesteak. The Italian Food isn't Grandma's but this is a place you can comfortably go and know that you'll get an ok meal.

Disclaimer - I hardly ever go out to bars. Having said that, I loved the moonrise rooftop bar (and downstairs bar). The place has great modern decorations, good music, great drinks, and is a wonderful place to spend a nice evening overlooking... Delmar. Besides the lack of a skyline or a nice view, this place is rockin.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The room was clean and fairly modern.  But, the bathroom was miniscule!  Not to mention, the place is being remodeled and the lobby is in a complete mess.  Further, the construction began at 7 a.m. on a SATURDAY!!   I prefer the Marriott which is in the same area...and the price difference is not that great!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
About 6 years ago they missed a fatal disease (Pyometra) with my older dog on her first visit.. I switched doctors but stayed at the clinic due to the proximity to my home.

About six months ago they missed yet another fatal disease (Parvovirus) on my new pup. 

I felt it was time to move on to a new clinic.

Great market here. Tons and tons of selections, as well as cafe inside the store. Their natural/organic section is great! I only shop there for sale items because their regular priced items are quite expensive. All in all a good market with a big selection.

Yogurt cup is your average yogurt shop. There's nothing outstanding that makes this place stand out. The yogurt is ok; there are definitely better yogurt shops around, however, there aren't many shops like this in Levittown.
All in all, an ok place with some good flavors. I do thoroughly enjoy the seasonal flavors, though.

I would never have known that there was a public element to the Fed until I visited for work.  There's a free exhibit about the Fed and its history that's pretty informative. I've returned with friends, and they're always glad I brought them there. It's worth stopping in.

great place to listen to live music. the bartenders know their drinks & make them well. plus, in new orleans you can always take your drinks to go if you are bar hopping. laid back feel. the bathrooms are tiny & were probably an afterthought when this bar was first in place.

If you are unsure how you feel about Vic Sushi, order the Naruto roll, and then make your verdict. Salmon, yellowtail, and tuna (no rice!) wrapped in cucumber. Super refreshing on a hot summer day. If you don't like it you might accidentally be eating something else.

This place is convenient if you happen to be out at Creve Coeur Lake.  The outdoor seating is spacious and looks out over the lake.

The food itself is just ok.  It's good, but not great.  The service isn't bad either.  I'll come back, but I'm riding my bike around here all the time.

Besides my reservation missing from the gold lot, waiting over an hour and being stuck in a line from hell, this wasn't bad.  Would I ever go back?  Never....  Enterprise's home office is in St Louis, I should have listened and rented from them.  I'd rather be shot at and walk to my hotel than ever endure this again.

The location isn't great. Somewhat difficult to return the car to unless you've done it enough to remember how to get there. The staff is very friendly. Be sure to get there in plenty of time for your flight. Nice selection of vehicles. The site itself looks like a used car lot.

Still a regular here and I must say the service has improved. Drive through lines go by in a jiffy and everything is made the right way. Pumpkin spice lattes are made perfect here. Everyone should try their pumpkin scones as well if you're into sweets. Yum.

Ordered a really generic chicken burrito with a white flour tortilla and white rice that I guess was supposed to be Spanish rice -- very plain. Not worth $10 and I'm pretty sure they forgot to give me the beans and rice on the side but I forgot to ask. The staff were nice though.

Food is REALLY good here & the Pizzas are great. The wait service is just average. We felt that if we were not a "local" then we were put more or less to the back of the bus. The Busboys are great. They spoke & dealt with us more then anyone. Service is why 3 - ***

This place was much nicer inside than I was expecting. I have a fear of strip mall sushi, but this is the closest sushi place to my house. 

To my surprise...the sushi, the service and the food selection are actually quite good. Although they could benefit from a lunch menu and possibly more parking, but Ill be back.

This has gotten to be my favorite restaurant in Cherry Hill. For special occasions, the Farm and Fisherman can accommodate large parties or small. The unique and fresh combination of entrees and dessert trays cannot be found anywhere else. This restaurant is perfect and hits the spot consistently every time.

We went here thinking Shabu Shabu was still there. Shabu Shabu was closed but we stayed and ate here anyway. It was so memorable that my wife has to keep reminding me that we ate here so it couldn't have been that good or bad. Meh. I've experienced better.

Meh. I  have eaten there a few times and cannot recall anything about the place other than I felt rushed and I left not liking what I ordered and that it was a lot more money than I thought I was going to pay. Overall I'd say splurge the little bit more you would have to spend and go to a better higher end place.

Fresh. Very fresh ingredients. I have done take out and have dined in and in both cases I have enjoyed their food and to me it is the freshest Chinese food in Tucson. I know I said Tucson so that might be a huge compliment but it is a good one. Pretty interior. Very nice owners. A great addition to the Rita Ranch area.

Wow kinda feels like piling on at this point...

Tokyo is at least as good as Drunken Fish and better than Wasabi...and price point is much much more "appetizing" as it were...

Drink selection is a miss but have some saki and enjoy some fresh flavorful fish..yum!

A Chrsitmas eve tradition with good pub food.  Had a straightforward cheese burger and fries with a couple beverages and had no complaints.

Staff was not cuper friendly but they were prompt and attentive.  So try it out if you are nearby and want some simple pub food.

I'm really OK with Dunkin' Donuts as a chain.  I'm a big fan of chocolate Glazed donuts and their hash browns but for the love of all that is holy they should just take the hash browns off their menu at this location because they constantly don't have them available and this is unacceptable.

Better than your typical strip mall Chinese restaurant but still heavily Americanized. The wonton soup had fresh, crispy vegetables and tasty wontons. The vegetables in the shrimp with mixed vegetables were also good, although the broccoli overwhelmed the dish. Less broccoli and more bok Choy please.  Lots of plump shrimp as well.

Man, did I feel old here! We walked in here on a whim and were immediately confronted with the youth! We battled through the crowd to grab a drink and I was impressed with the stiffness of my jack and coke. It's easy to find a quiet corner here if that's what you're looking for or a loud crowd.

On a recent visit I sat in the back dining room for the first time.  Recommend sitting in here as to opposed to the casual bar area.  It is much nicer.  Portions are really generous.  My chicken francaise was delicious and could have served two.  Good service too.

I'm underwhelmed although I do like the casual outdoor and back alley seating. The menu offers decent homemade pasta in an unadorned BYOB. My suggestion is that you stick to the pasta and avoid the entrees. The prices are reasonable. The service leaves a bit to be desired. A nice neighborhood spot.

Made a last minute trip to Santa barbara and stopped in at Roy around 1145pm.

Place has a neat vibe and atmosphere and the prices aren't too bad.

Meal
Appetizer bread- awesome
Potato leek soup- pretty good
Entrée- grilled lambloin and ratatoulle -excellent!

Wouldn't mind eating here again on my next stop in SB

The only reason why this corner store (in the middle of the block) is worth writing about is that they have a decent selection of beer at a good price. Not the selection of the foodery, but cheaper. And it's my stop for soda water after visiting the PLCB on Chestnut.

$5 minimum for debit, $10 minimum for credit.

Staff are very nice and helpful- the doctor herself is a bit...what's the word....pretentious and slightly condescending. My dog didn't really like her too much upon meeting her, especially as compared with our old vet. Facility is extremely clean and neat. Parking is fabulous.

My family would come here after browsing in New Hope.  Then the waiter tacked some extra $ to the tip/bill.  Then this happened not one more time but twice more.  It's practically standard practice for the Spotted Hog.  When you tip 20% +, it is totally unacceptable to be treated this way.

Meh, strawberry ice cream tasted a watered down.  No sampling allowed.  Scoops are pretty generous. Go for your supermarket, get haagen daz ice cream instead, and save money.  But for social things, ice cream flight might be fun (thus 2 stars instead of one).

After enjoying a nice chimay and excellent service, my boyfriend was presented with a bill for $40. For 1 beer. This place is absurd. We will not be returning. You are better off going next door to the ritz Carlton for a nice cocktail menu at reasonable prices.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Ben's prices can't be beat!
I live in San Francisco and always stop at Ben's whenever I'm in Reno to pick up whatever good tequila is on sale. The sale prices are better than anything that BevMo could offer. 

Best thing is that they open at 7am! Who's in need of booze at 7am besides me?

3 dollar express car wash, free do it yourself vacuuming stations. What's not to like?

Arizona auto spa, offers a well priced drive through car wash that gets the job done. It  may not get your car as clean as hand washing it would but for 3 dollars and 3 minutes you can't be upset with the results.

I ordered the Reuben, which was decent, but nothing over the top. Anita loved her tenderloin sandwich, and said it was the best she'd had (better than CR Heroes???? How can that be?). Service was really good and attentive. I'll have to try something else off the menu before deciding if I love this place or not.

Could not be cuter inside. 

Wild Mushroom arancini should not be missed. 

Loves the meatballs, though the pasta could have used a touch more salt. 
Fusilli was also very good.

Prices are really reasonable if you aren't a huge eater and if you don't tap in to the booze.

Tria is missed. The service here was a little awkward. None of the appetizers are particularly exciting. My seafood dish was fresh but a bit bland and too easily replicated at home for being over $30. The cutlets are dope though. I will likely return, but only for that pounded, breaded, fried jawn.

It's a bank. You put money in, you take money out. However. Their recent change to the account fee policies where you either have to either use direct deposit (screw you, entrepreneurs!) or have a minimum balance throughout their company are BS.

ATM machine worked, at least.

This McDonalds is attached to a Pilot Travel Center (gas station/truck stop). The service was friendly. My husband's fries were cold and didn't taste salted- my fries were hot and salted- I guess I'm the lucky one. They have nice big booths. This is located just off I-65S.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I used to like this rental station at Lambert Airport. However, they now have a new deal where the bus driver drops you off in the middle of the parking lot and you have to schlug all your stuff over to your car, no matter where it's parked. And I'm talking, we're "Preferred Presidential" or whatever it's called! NO LIKEY!

Honestly, I was only in here looking for alligator sausage and was inside for about 10 minutes. If I lived in New Orleans and needed a general grocery store, I'd probably make it Rouse's. The seafood selection looked awesome; the shrimps looked like they were the size of my hand. 

But you sell alligator sausage, so I'm sold. :)

What can you say about another Starbucks? This one is a popular joint for the Lakeview crowd even though NOLA Beans is just a few doors down.  The locals seem to like this place for its coffee and outdoor seating. If it gets too crowded, just try NOLA Beans... or just go ahead and try NOLA Beans first.

burritos are big, but bland in my opinion.  beans are runny, rice is like whatever, chips were pretty good.  overall, this is not exactly my kind of burrito place - maybe they're from texas or something cause la bamba doesn't meet my socal burrito standards.

In the hierarchy of college bars, T J Quills is second to the worst college bar, only to be beaten by the much esteemed: The Boot. Quills seems to do a better job of IDing which is the only reason it can be given a star at all.
  Perhaps you should stay away unless you are an angsty 16 year old.

Solid sushi and reasonable prices, the specialty rolls seem very expensive but are very large. The crawfish roll is a nice twist on the traditional California roll. The salmon is top quality, however the ikura (salmon roe) and tuna tasted a little bit off. This is a nice stop on the way to the airport from the city.

Nothing to get excited about (much like the rest of this airport).  Airport bar that's open to the rest of the terminal so it's loud.  The draft beer selection sucks (Miller Lite, Bud Light, Heineken, and Sam Adams), but they do a decent bloody mary that will set you back $9.25.  Nice lady behind the bar.

Wow sooo bland!! I wouldn't recommend this place for good sushi. Everything tasted like nothing!! I taste more lemon because I wasn't happy and kept asking for more so I could put with my soy sauce to dip my sushi!!! if you want REAL sushi go to miyagi's or naked chopstix in north side.

I ordered a tequila sour.. and it had a bug in it.. need I say more?? the bartender gladly replaced my drink ( with one that came in it's OWN bottle with a TOP) and had no problem giving me back the difference..the ONLY reason this place is getting 2 stars is because it's got character.. and the workers were really nice..

Terrible breakfast, great friendly service. We had to wait 2 hours fur check in although the place was dead and I know a room was available. Fortunately the price is great and the people are very sweet. Mini fridge and microwave included in all rooms so  take out isn't mandatory for every meal. 

Pool closes after Labor Day!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Free coffee for the week in posting this (across McDonald's Canada) and happy staff with interesting takells to tell gives me a happy moment.

Three-star quality food, hyper-consistent but soulless, is what it is.

At least there's the free coffee, while it lasts, and the happy staff and their tales.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Jason, thank you for all your help with picking out a good selection of on-sale beverages; the case of champagne-ish Confidence & Integrity was a win! Several bottles have been gifted already. Again, thanks!

Convenient location, small number of sale items -- perfect if you find what you need, helpful staff.

The proximity to the convention center, French Quarter, and streetcar -- and the spacious workout room -- don't make up for the fact that there's no wifi in the guest rooms, and the shower water temperature goes from scaldingly hot to shockingly freezing (invariably when my face was all sudsed up!)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The people who work here are fairly nice; I believe it's a family owned place.

I only stop in on occasion to grab my uncle some beer, and everything seems easy enough to navigate.

If I get him more than one case, they always ask if they can help me take it to the car, so they get 2 thumbs up from me.

just scarfed down Al Pastor tacos (tastier than the steak, imo). sooooo good. i'm going to come back and try a burrito. the tortillas and chips were made to order, they were still hot when they came out! only a few tables but easy to sit on a friday night.

3 stars for their chocolate martini. 

This bar looks very nice, during the day.
but the douches and yuppies come out at night.

If you're allergic to guys with gel compacted hair, who wear their sunglasses at night OR
chicks wearing dresses the size of shirts with fresh bright orange tans,
stay away.

This place overuses crab salad to the extreme, so don't order anything with crab.  Everything is pretty much average.  I think the gooey noodles are disguisting, but others seem to think they're great.  Oh yea, and unlike many other sushi restaurants in the area they card pretty hard.

They are friendly, they are quick, they are affordable, they have never lost any of my clothes.  In all, these are the things I look for in a cleaners.  

It is easy to get in and out of here quickly and get back on the road.  I hope they do well at this location.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Very 90's grunge era coffee shop.

Good cup of coffee, had the requisite sofas and comfy chairs.  There were also the requisite people just sitting around hogging up all the good spots while using a laptop all day and paying for 1 coffee.  The food looked good, but I was just on a caffine jones.

Good spot to start your day.

You get what you pay for; but hey sometimes a price like this is just what you need. Use the money you save by crashing here on great food at nearby Reading Terminal Market or partake of the numerous "massage parlors" in the streets surrounding the convention center where this hotel hides.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Food was pretty good but it wasn't the absolute best I've had.  I had the ramen soup while hubby ordered various sushi.   The tables in the restaurant are little too close together.  We overheard two tables with absolutely bizarro conversations that were hard to tune out.

Dunkin Donuts near Concourse C at MSY. It's convenient and the donuts are good. I'll come here for coffee and a chocolate glazed before heading in. Thank god I have TSA Pre so I can enjoy my donuts on the comfy couches outside before heading to the gate. Service is always spotty but it's an airport vendor what do you expect.

Grossest place Ive even eaten in a long time. Fries and onion rings were cooked in the same vat of crap. They were tough and tasted like greased card board. They guy never let me speak to the manager, but he did admit the oil was a bad color. Duh!! Avoid, Run!!

Many reasons NOT to come here.
1. Filthy outside. Trash everywhere.
2. They cram crap in areas that only allow one cart through at a time. Very annoying! Reminds of Walmart.
3. Cashier's are unprofessional. 

AVOID AT ALL COSTS if you aren't from this side of town.

This place is fine. Coffee fine. People were alright. I'd go again if I had to. Wouldn't complain about it. If trapped, I'd have plenty to read because it's half a used bookstore . Not sure if I'd have to pay for those books I'd read though. Signs unclear.

I ordered a mocha.  It was very disappointing.  In fact, the drink was so bad, I threw it away.  I thought this place would be a cut above Starbucks.  Not!  I must say, I also dislike Starbucks.   I am not sure what they used in my drink, it was very acidic and the chocolate tasted gross.

the self serve wash is really great now that it's been updated.  reliably takes credit cards now and also will take cash.  $5/$7/$9 tier washes with an extra $2 to do tires.  it used to be $1 for tires.  the dryer lasts for 60 seconds which is plenty to blow most of the water off the car.  I use this one often!

Glad to hear that Sunset has declared "uncle" in an ever expanding food scene. While this restaurant may have may have offered a break from the norm 5 or 10 years ago, Nashville has become a very complex culinary city and can not tolerate such spotty service. Either keep up with the times, or respectably bow out.

had family gathering in the wine room. the waiter was attentive and gave us enough privacy at the same time. the reservation was made through open table with my requests about high chair for my nephew.  

food is solid and it's always packed. will be back soon

solid sushi joint.  it is BYOB so make sure you bring your own drinks. 

my gf isn't a big sushi fan but I had the tuna which were described as fresh that night which cost little bit more but it was very fresh. great family/friendly environment and cute.

had the udon which was solid.

I'm so sad to hear this place has closed.  I liked the menu and my hotdog very much.  I remember chatting with the owner late one night as I waited for my group to take care of the birthday boy after a night of drinking, and it seemed like things were going well.

Just had a bento box here the california roll had a bit too much mayonnaise and the teriyaki chicken could use a better sauce and work on how they cook the chicken not the best.  It's okay this is a sushi place not a teriyaki house but they should work on it.

Ah, definitely wasn't feeling this place.

I came here for the half-off sushi but was disappointed by the quality. There was way too much rice on the rolls (a good fish-rice ratio is key) and even the rice seemed off.

There are other sushi places in Bensalem (see my other reviews) that I would definitely recommend over this place.

I love this gym!!  No long lines to use the equipment, not too much spandex and few preening body-builders.   Been a happy member for 3+ years, and I am as excited to cross its threshold today as I was on my first day.  A big fan of the personal TV screens on some of the aerobic equipment. And the price is right at $20/month.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
They serve pancakes the size of Malcom Glaser's ego. 

I was subjected to my neighboring table's conversation about bowel movements and intestinal issues, which is tough enough to hear during a meal, but it was coming from a table full of older women....ugh. 

Haven't been back since.

I agree with Scott F. This is our neighborhood Chinese spot and I have to say, the food is decent, CHEAP, and the service is great. We can order our food and have it delivered in 20 minutes. Plus, it's enough to feed the two of us for more than one meal. It's Chinese food. I have no complaints!

We came by around 10pm on a Friday after dinner and were surprised to find the place basically deserted. They had live music (cover band) which was pretty loud. Decent draft list - I had a Walt Wit. We left after about an hour. I can't speak to the food, but I don't think I'd return for the bar.

The weather was overcast, but gets a star for having tables where you could hear the ocean while you ate.   Loved the picnic tables.  There was a sand pit for kids to play in.  The salad was good.  And again, I had the Firestone Sauvignon Blanc (told you that I like it).  Beautiful location.

I took the boys for dinner. One server was continually on her cell phone. The server brought chips & salsa right away. Then food came up for another table, the bits wanted water but the other server was setting in a booth texting. I said out loud
Evan as soon as our server drops off the rest of the food you will get your water!

Passing through the drive through of this Arby's because it was convenient, but they were out of turnovers! How does that happen? Other than the slow service, at least my roast beef sandwich was fresh and they did get the order right. Still, I've experienced better.

Very small location that's located inside of a Cumberland Farms (convenience store). They still have all the usual sandwiches and coffee options as a full size DD.

It's a very busy location on a super busy corner. But when you need a donut (or a dozen), here's the spot.

Clean, quiet, friendly. Get your bowl, fill it with froyo, top it with wet and dry toppings (not enough nuts for my taste, but that's me) and then pay for it by weight. Not great, not bad. It's A-OK.

Reasonable seating area, but I took mine to go and ate while I drove.

Good stuff, I'd recommend.

Pretty good sushi.  We went during happy hour before a Cardinals game.

The rolls are a bit small, not sure I would've liked to pay full price for them.  The flavor was decent, but nothing that knocked my socks off.

Not as good as many people think it is, but not that bad either!

I come here every Friday.  They are always helpful.  It is a great place to work on your computer.

Their handmade teas are fantastic.  If you stay in store, they'll serve you a small teapot.

I love the Zebra mocha and the white chocolate macademia nut cookies

Stopped in for lunch on recommendation from several coworkers.  Ordered a cheesesteak with whiz and fried onions.  The roll was fresh.  The steak was chopped finely, yet juicy.  It tasted great.  Better than a lot of Philly joints.  Definitely hope I can stop in for lunch again!

Why can't all the local diner owners take a class here? They all badly need to be taught the Asian way to run something! If it ain't fresh don't serve it! If you don't make it, don't serve it! If you wouldn't eat it, don't serve it! This place will not disappoint ever! It is beyond wonderful!

Meh. Not bad, not good. Very hot inside restaurant. Dough was ok. Sauce was very garlicky. I got mushrooms, there were eight slices. Eight measly slices of mushrooms. That's one to two small mushrooms sliced on my pizza. All the toppings are stingy. 
Not worth the $$.
There's much better pizza in Conshy.

This review is for the bar/restaurant. The customer service is excellent. The bar is nice. The food is good. The only issue is the number of fruit flies in the bar area. Annoying. They need to find a remedy to that. Other than that, everything was excellent
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This was the first place we ever ordered from after moving from NY to PA. We got 3 pies total for the movers and for us. The pizza was not very good. Two of the pies were vastly under done and the cheese was barely melted. Even the movers were bitching that it was crap. I guess that says it all.

This is a pretty decent chain Italian restaurant.   The interior is actually quite upscale so it's completely appropriate for a night out on the town.   But it's not so upscale that you would feel out of place in shorts and a t-shirt.

The food is typical American-Italian stuff so no surprises (good or bad).

The hand grenade is bad news. Just a warning. The live music is alright. But this is Bourbon street. If you want good music, find any other street in the FQ.

That said, I can't really say this place is much better or worse than other places on Bourbon St.

Oh Blergh.

I'm sure I'm in the minority, but I did not like the hand grenade going down or coming back up. It's base is disgustingly sweet and then it's loaded with tartness to try and make it palatable. It's a Bourbon Street institution that I wish had never been created.

I was a volunteer at a great wine festival in NJ. UCP was one of the food vendors. They supplied the workers with some eats.

Not only were they friendly, but their pizza was pretty good too (even for NJ)!
I loved the long sausage and balls of meat.
The sauce was the final finishing touch!

I will give a 5th star once I come again.

Love the shaded patio but not the fish.

Sashimi dinner was small portion of 3 fish. I've seen much better on average. Yellow tail was slightly better than room temp. It should be cold.
Rainbow roll was as expected and of average size. 

This was my first visit and with other, better sushi joints in town, I doubt I'll be back.

I mean, it's exactly what you would expect: pizza in a crowded shopping center. My Mom, sister and I ate lunch here on Saturday. Started with the tossed salad and split a small pizza. It was fine, the pizza was not as greasy at Grotto's and the salad was satisfying. I do not like that the sodas come in bottles! FOUNTAIN SODAS RULE!

Delicious food!  The owner was greeting customers while we ordered last night.  I love that!  So great to meet the owner and hear the story. Chicken tacos are bomb and so is the salsa.  There is seating available should you need.  Great food!  I will definitely be back!

Whoever said this bar is only $ is crazy! This is the most expensive bar in the quarter. It's great that they have great music. That saves them from one star. I have met the owners and they are all behind selling $.90 nasty alcohol in a stupid glass. I think it's a solid place, just being super expensive.

OMG the ribs.  That's all I have to say about this place.  It's the bar that's attached to a beach resort and it was so convenient to go in and grab something quick or to just hang out and enjoy the view of the beach.  But the ribs were so darn good, I went back for them two times.

Got delivery via grubhub. Delivery was on target and the rolls appeared fresh. I had the Alaskan roll and the sweet potato tempura roll. Might've been better if the Alaskan wasn't so warm. But maybe the fc that they were both in the same container is to blame.

Straight razor shave, haircut & shampoo fot $85. He opened early and was very generous with his time. I was in the chair at least an hour. This is a full service old school barber shop. This shop is on the fifth floor of the Whitney Bank Building so it is not easy to find.

Attempted to eat here today at 2pm. Cars were in drivethru and people were inside.
Doors were locked. The people coming out said the staff is closing down because they could not keep up with the orders. Since when do places get to shut down because of being under staffed????

Never going here again
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This coffee shop is in the lobby of the building I work in, and it's a pretty awesome little shop!  Chris - the best barista in all of Philly - runs the shop during the week.  They have daily latte specials - I recommend Thursday's C-3PO latte!  They also have a good assortment of muffins, cookies, and pretzels.

What a great place to go after work and unwind!  Especially in the summer!  There's a nice patio outside for al fresco dining / drinking, with a beautiful grape arbor that canopies the patio.  The wait staff is really friendly and they serve well poured drinks and amazing pizza!  If you're in UCITY check them out!

Love the new location. The fried calamari was some of thest i've ever had. 

You can't go wring with the Saltimboca. 

Can't remember the name of the dish but the owner presents it tableside and flambes it with vodka, inside of a giant cheesewheel. It turns out like mac and cheese on steroids but sooooo delish!

While their dinner menu is less than impressive, the have one of the best breakfast's in town. Creme Brule French Toast, Crab Cake Benedict, Smoked Salmon and bagels with all of the trimmings. It's excellent. 
Word to the wise, if you get the O'Gratin potatoes instead of home fries, order them "hot" if you don't, they won't be.

Bliss offers a good menu for a leisure lunch or business lunch. We often came by when we tired of the typical Italian fare/ Palm Restaurant (next door)'s offerings. We especially loved the al fresco dining area which was a great way to relax over a lovely meal.

Prices are reasonable, food is good, and service is great. You can get the first 2 at other Mexican restaurants in the area but the good service makes this place stand out. This is now on our list for local lunch options. I have been here about 5 times now and haven't had a bad experience.
Keep up the good work guys!

You know what I love about Sobeys?  You don't need a stupid card for sale prices.  Yes, you need a card to collect points but not for sales.

Also, they have super cute little shopping carts for your toddler to push!  Just beware of your ankles a d those around you as the cart is metal ;-)

Brand new location, clean, bright... As good as it gets for  McD minus that they don't have a play place for kidlets which could be a pro if you're not wanting to hear children ;-)

P.S.  You've got to try the New Chicken Italian McTaster for only $2.99 - It's quite good for an mid day bite.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
This location is quite hit and miss.  I don't recommend the drive thru here plus it's an inconvenient parking lot if you're trying to grab a quick cup of joe.

That being said, if you're meeting a friend for a leisurely coffee date, this location might be the right one for you!  Slower paced and not very busy.

I had previously questioned the level of diligence and dedication to craft in the employees at this establishment.  I feel it only fair to note that the offending parties seem no longer to work here, and that the new people are great.  The complainer in me feels it necessary to add that their chai really sucks, though.

Great selection of beer at great prices.  They always have great beer specials and they have the lowest prices on liquor in town.  The only drawback is that they only accept cash but they have an ATM in the store.  Even if I didn't live a few blocks from A-1 it would still be worth the drive.

This is one of the best hotels I have ever stayed at. The best service, no really, the best. The rooms are outstanding and the location is great if your in town for a convention. If you have the ability to stay here then do it. I think that there are only 4 or 5 Conrad's in the USA.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The hotel rooms don't have a work/writing desk or chair as a standard feature. Just an uncomfortable couch or a bed. If you're a working professional stay away from this hotel as you won't have a chance of being productive. What a disappointment for a Hyatt. I've stayed in Hampton Inns that are nicer.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Great place with a great selection.  I lived near here for years and this was my spot.  Also, if you have a kegerator and need parts or air, this is the place, the old guy working in the shop is a little "codgery" but knows his stuff, and the other guy who may own it is very knowledgeable.   Great place.

This Starbucks, like most, is uber busy between the hours of 7AM and 8AM. But the staff is cheery, the facility is clean and the chairs are comfy. Safe yourself sometime and go in, rather than waiting for the drive up; the line insides seems to be speedier than the line outside.

Salon Bass has changed the way that I see my hair, & myself. Joe , the owner, does a much better job on my hair then my last stylist - and the environment is welcoming too . He does great on both cut and color, and I always come out feeling like a million dollars . Thanks for keeping an older lady feeling and looking her best !

A very small grocery store. Not a lot of fresh produce choices. Also does not have a "healthfood" or organic isle or even those brands like Annies. Not any cheaper either but it does have a good location for us Garden Districters.
Mostly filled with boxed products in the middle isles and alcohol.

Super convenient, tiny little grocery store in Mid-City. My only complaint is that it tends to be kind of expensive, as in Whole Foods kind of expensive, but they've got everything I need and it just makes me happy to go there. Plus I'm too lazy to go to the real grocery store.

When Chick-fil-A is out on Sunday.  Wendy is the backup.  The service is very fast and they got all my order correctly w/o any issues.  The guy that handed over the food with great personality because he said more than just hello, but asking us how we did for that day.  It was a nice experience.

It was a random day to pick something for dinner. There wasn't anyone in the front, no bell or anything to ring anyone.  We asked for menu, and the Asian lady told us to order online, and shut the window.  We got mask and maintain social distancing.  It appears she doesn't want us to order at their order.  The service is very bad.

It's not great but it's not supposed to be great. It's a diner....... in a casino. But the food is decent, the prices are great and the service is acceptable. Order any breakfast item and get a bloody mary for $1.99. Yeah yeah yeah you can get a free one at the tables, but you might lose your nut before it gets there!

Beautiful hotel lobby complete with palm trees and marble floors.  Our room seemed a little cramped after staying at the new Hyatt in Clearwater.  The front desk was nice enough to get us a water channel view, which was nice.  Right across the street from the TECO Line Streetcar System.  Plus, they have a Starbucks in the lobby.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We started our holiday party at Jillians (not my choice), then after we OD'd on electronics, 

The Red Key Tavern was a welcome relief, hung out in the back, great jute box, lots of regulars, felt like you are in a neighbor's living room.  Just what a neighboorhood bar should be!

Downstairs cafe in a renovated temple on the canal.  

Sat by the window over looking the canal, pleasant enough.  Couldn't eat the soup, tasted like flavored water, I would stick with bar food on the menu next time.  Would be great in the spring or summer to sit outside, either downstairs or upstairs at Eurphoria.

First assigned to 627 and had to be moved because the room was smokey and bedazzled w glitter!  Hannah at the Front Desk was kind enough to move us to an upgraded room for our inconvenience.  The hotel is otherwise clean and well maintained.  We used the valet parking lot that the hotel uses and saved about 15$ doing so ourselves.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I came here with pals when I was visiting NOLA.  I got malted chocolate chip.  The flavor was good and the chips were crunchy and abundant.  The servings were huge and a pretty decent price.  I can imagine that I'd come here a lot in the summer if I lived in New Orleans.

We came here for a company hh-decent drinks. They had some quick bites for us...deviled eggs, chicken tenders....not bad at all. There was a decent amount of people at the bar for a Wednesday. 

There's no sign outside so it's hard to tell that it's a bar. Located on 9th and Orange.

We went here for lunch on a Sat. I got the steak (medium rare) and fabulous eggs (sunny side up). The fries were soggy and the steak was small - nothing special. This place is average. 

We had a party of ten and one of the drinks had a fly in it....they replaced it but I felt like they should have comped that drink.

Looks ghetto outside but don't be fooled!!! It is pretty spacious and clean inside with friendly staff. They have a decent selection...reminds me of Wine and Spirit Stores in PA. They have tons of craft beers which is why I went. My friend wanted to get Delirium tremens beer. 

Pros
Tax Free
Cheap prices

Cons
Shady outside

Is it an inn?  No idea.  But is it a bar with cheap drinks, fast service, juke box, and good people watching- absolutely!  It's what you'd expect for an Irish-ish place- a little dive-ish, dirty, with some local flair.  Good for a break of the bazillion chain restaurants in the area.

I'm happy to report: Still excellent. It's worth the drive across town, even through that stupid 80/395 construction to get over here. I'm tempted to tell everyone about cockroaches, old fish, and hairy rolls just so I can have this all to myself. Fortunately, my review remains: Highly Recommended.

Solid coffee on the run. If you are in this part of town and need a caffeine fix, this is the place to go. Don't blink or you'll miss it. It is a coffee shack that dispenses good coffee of all types from "straight up" to the most "fru-fru" concoction you can think up.

A remodeled location and they did a good job. The new menu is actually pretty good. I like coming here because it has a deceptively big play area for my daughter. Judging among Burger Kings, this place is better than most Burger Kings and is why I am giving it 4 stars.

I'd put this sushi restaurant against the best sushi places in the country.  The owner Nao is also the head chef.  Sakana prefers quality over quantity but even so, this place is cheap compared to LA or NYC sushi restaurants.

I hate to even recommend this place - it's already getting too hard to get in.

meh. it was ok. i wasnt wowed by food or service. the decor is 70's rec room. my friends food came out first and mine came about 5 mins later. nothing special. i did see that they do a hell of business. burn and turn. the wait staff was pretty colorful. maybe better with large groups

Was looking for an affordable sushi place not in center city and happened to find this place on yelp. So glad I decided to go here! Definitely affordable and it's BYOB :D Loved the tuna tartare and the fried green tea ice cream! Service was great too. The staff is really friendly.

Hana is the type of place to bring your friends who like sushi, but can't admit to eating raw fish. 

Tiny, and closes early. Expansive menu, with lots of big, saucy rolls, and traditional Japanese specialties like natto.

The service is extremely attentive, and I have no doubt wins over many fans.

I loved my pizza here!!  I had pepperoni with roasted garlic.  Yum!!  The crust was super thin and they must have painted it with olive oil, because it tasted super light.  
The staff is alot cooler than me, too.  So , maybe I should go more often and have the coolness rub off on me.  They're friendly too!!

Decent but a little disappointed  in the size of the room. We stayed at a Springhill suites in Arizona and the room was huge! I expected the same since the online description was the same. I stay at Marriotts ALL the time and had a good idea of what to expect. They surprised me though! Everything was fine and decent though.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The coffee is limited to about 4 kinds and the space is a bit small but they do have outside seating and are right by Lazy Acres and a CVS, which make it a really convenient stop.

Down side:  their creamer selection is limited, in fact, it's just a box of half and half on the counter, ewww.

Great location to the airport. The rooms are spacious and clean. You have one large wide screen TV that shares on a swivel for both rooms. Get food somewhere else if you can...... it was not that great and selection was light. They did not have wine glasses that was a bummer. But all in all it is exactly a 3 star.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The broccoli cheddar mac & cheese vegan style was excellent!  I've had many good and bad vegan mac & cheese's in my lifetime and can say that Cheese-ology pulled it off quite well; the overall flavoring was perfect.  You can get most of their dishes vegan, as they just replace the cheese with Daiya.

It's OK.  I mean, is there another delivery option to Fishtown that I don't know about?  If so, please enlighten me.   The tacos, burritos and quesadillas are average.  The taco salad is good.  They have a nice salsa Verde.  Don't ever get any steak dishes, it's inedible meat.  Why doesn't Taco Riendo deliver????

This is not a traditional sushi restaurant, but the combinations on their menu give your mouth an explosion of flavor.  A really nice atmosphere.  Usually on the quieter side, so conversation is easy.  Definitely do the "all you can eat."  It is the best value.  Enjoy!

Just OK. I would expect more from a Westin even if it's just in Indianapolis. The accommodations were fine, but the level of service was not always up to par. Irregular help opening doors, getting taxis, assistance with forgotten toiletries, etc. Most other Westins I've stayed at have super fresh air, but it seemed stale here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Service was EXCELLENT.  I had the Vitello Piccata (veal cutlet in a white wine, lemon and butter sauce) (see picture).  Absolutely out of this world good!  This came with broccoli with unlimited bread and butter.  I cannot wait to go back!

The food and service were so good on this visit, I'm upgrading from 3 to 4 stars!

I'm just not a big fan but I agree with other reviewers if you are going make sure you get the "hot donuts" sign when its glowing.  I personally prefer a cake donut (aka Tastee/McKenzie Buttermilk drops) but If I go I get the cinnamon apple filled donut with cinnamon powdered sugar

I've been here about 10 times. The buffalo chicken wrap is BANGIN! LOVE IT! As far as pizzeria places go I'd say this is run of the mill, except for the wraps that are a 10 in my book!

Bottom line; Get the buffalo chicken wrap and call for pick up. Your standard pizza shop.

Both my husband and I are from Sparks and this is hands down our favorite place for Mexican food. We went to Reed High and would pop into Las Trojes during lunch break and have been fans ever since. Every time we visit our families we must eat here.

Delicious chips and salsa, chile rellenos, cheese enchiladas, and beans and rice.

Another work regular, and a reasonably solid performer.  Go for the lobster ravioli, which doesn't fall into the trap of being too sweet.

I haven't been overly excited about the Italian places I've been here in Philly, so saying La Viola is probably the winner may not mean much.  But it's the winner among the ones I've been to.

Unlike most of the previous reviewers I have never received bad service at Pizza Rustica.  I stop in probably once a week for a slice of pizza and the staff is fine and I think the pizza is great!  I have never ordered anything else off of the menu so I cant comment but the pizza is good, the crust is thin and the slices are large!

Had a Greek Salad which was just so-so.  Usually a Greek Salad comes with anchovies, red onions and a stuffed grape leaf and some good oregano.  This was pretty generic.  I can get better, cheaper in other places.  Nice place.  Clean and all.  So far, not a good start in my book.

Haven't had a pizza from here I didn't like. I prefer the Cheese, Roma Tomato, and Bananna Pepper Pizza. My wife loves the cheesy bread.

The customer service is good. We tend to order online so we never really talk to anyone until we pick up the pizza.

They are always quick and on time!

It is a food court restaurant, but the quality is there.  The team that prepares the sushi is well above mall grade, but the fact that it is a mall takes away from the quality of fish.  Had they been in a sit down restaurant, I think the that aspect would improve, but the prices do not dictate the product that you receive.

Yogurt is fine, typical you'd find at this type of place, but prices are insane. $40 for 4 treats, most less than 1/4 full .. I've never spent more than $20 for similar. We won't be back. 

Suggestion - get Frostys across the street at Wendy's for 1/8 the price.

I've been here a handful of times... Great place to socialize. They have a nice pool table and comfy couches to chat on. I love the ambiance of this place. Don't come here if you want to dance or get wild. Come here if you're tired of trying to have a conversation with someone Since the music isn't blaring in your ears.

Went here for breakfast on a busy Sunday morning during COVID. They have a great back patio to enjoy your food. We had croissant  breakfasts, pancakes and a single croissant. The food was very good and so were the to the to order coffee drinks. Nice experience and a very good price.

Pretty standard Mexican fare. Menu resembles what you find at most local Mexican restaurants with the usual fajitas, enchiladas, burritos, etc. Everything is fresh and tasty. I recommend the Cancun Fajitas which are chicken and steak served in half a pineapple.

So there was nothing that was super amazing here, but everything was decent or good.  It was $16 for all you can eat.  Great for quantity and/or curing a hangover.  The only thing I wasn't really keen on was the pad thai.  The donuts and chocolate ice cream were clutch :)

Good neighbourhood to escape the French Quarter tourist crap. Decent coffee and espresso (nothing close to Intelligentsia as some reviewers claim--though I don't think Intelligentsia is that great anyway!!), good snacks, super cute decor (I'm a sucker for mid-century furniture). Next time I'm in NO, I'll stick to the Orange Couch.

This place is closed now.  The building isn't even there anymore. There's just a sign left but the building is gone.  When they were open I would've given them a 4.  Freshly made and typically fast. Sometimes the wait would be long which is why the rating wasn't higher.

I tried the new smoked sausage egg sandwich. Tasty but too greasy for me and I don't think they would have appreciated me posting a picture of the mess they threw together.  I guess I should just stick to my usual coffee and ice coffee but I am fan of this DD....  they are pretty consistent with friendly, fast and accurate service.

I have to knock a couple of stars off because weekends here are not great.  Coffee tastes watered down, orders are screwed up, workers seem to be too busy talking to each other to engage with the customers, not great...        4 stars for weekday mornings, 2 stars for weekends.

If you are in the area and need to stop in for some beer or a bottle of wine, this is a small store with a decent selection. The strip mall it is located in is somewhat sketchy, but like I said, if you're already there and don't feel like going out of your way, this is a handy spot. The clerks also seemed friendly.

Yum! So happy something good finally opened in this location. I live pretty close and it's been a sub par Mexican place prior to this. I love sushi and love their spicy tuna salad and the other small plates like that. Very friendly wait staff and good food and choices. I will be back.

Food was pretty good, but I did not enjoy the experience. With so many pizza places available, I don't think that I will be returning. The atmosphere was dull, wait staff seemed either bored or inexperienced, and I'm not sure if they have management around.

I've been to Cancun Mexican Restaurant several times because it is convenient.  Their food is good and predictable and their prices are moderate.  The best part about Cancun is that you can almost always find a coupon or discount somewhere.  My favorite dish is their carne asada tacos.

Such a great hotel !  Location was ideal and the cute roof top pool was fun ! It's close to the pier and to great breakfast .  

It's a little walk to the restaurants but we wanted to be a little away from the noise .

It's expensive but the rooms were wonderful with fireplace , huge bathroom and comfortable beds !
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I didn't spend much time in here but only to grab a road Hand Grenade. You can get it with or without ice.. I opted for ice because it was hotter than my body could handle, and was happy. You have to try one of these since they're advertised all over Bourbon.

My advice? Get 2.. but not 4 :)

Great liquor store.  It's a Wine & Spirits, so prices are regulated to PA standard, but this place is clean and nice and spread out.  Always a good selection in stock, and much safer feeling compared to their old location a block away.  Staff is friendly and helpful, and service is quick.

Great location, OK decor from about 15 yrs ago, but the food was better than average, but nothing to write home about. The service was abysmal and the dude at the table next to us looked like he had just gotten out of prison.
I'll come back when I see an "Under new management " sign in the window.

Bad haircuts
overpriced
I can't beleive I paid $35 (which was a fair price in my hometown, but a fortune in economically depressed Tucson) and got such a lackluster haircut. Furthermore, the old lady actually missed several locks behind my ears. I will never set foot there again. Instead, try Dapper, downtown.

My hotel was connected to this bar and we got a free drink form here just because were staying at the hotel. It was a nice little nook in the corner of a building. Definitely not a huge tourist spot which makes it a good place to chill for a little before exploring the monster which is Bourbon St.

The staff here is nice and they're pretty efficient.  The only problem was that they don't have a scanner for my Starbucks iPhone app, so I'd have to read off the number every time.  The line gets pretty long in the mornings, but usually moves pretty quickly.

These are donuts I grew up on and they are delish no matter where I go. I got the regular glazed, but I know from past experiences that the creme filled are also awesome :) 

The staff here were pretty laid back- I'd imagine it's hit or miss, but this time was a hit!

We were pretty disappointed that their frozen coffee machine was out of service when we went there specifically for a frozen coffee.  Instead, we both got something from their Baskin Robbins menu and were pretty satisfied.  But for the $10 price tag for 2 drinks????  No thanks.

Definitely needs a makeover. Happy hour 5:30 - 7:30 cocktails on the house up to 5. 

Had dinner in the restaurant, they were  out of 6 main menu items. Had the burger it was very good. 

My room has no place to use as a work space. There is a desk but no outlets to plug anything into. 

Very courteous staff.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
A-OK is what best describes this restaurant,

Nothing really to boast about, limited menu food is mediocre, didn't care for the soup at all! Service was good, we were greeted by a nice lady who showed us our seats and gave us our menus. 

Not in a rush to return.....

Well this was my first time trying White Castle and i must say the chicken sandwich was rather good! No complaints here, my fries were hot my drink was good..hell it was all good! I was surprised being i heard so much negative talks about this joint...don't always believe what what you hear!

So we did Wednesday Bucka shock and I have to say it was outstanding. We also had the fried oysters which were extremely good. And a bottle of rose which was competitively priced. So all in all a great experience. If you're looking for a good buck a shuck  place they absolutely hit the spot!

My last trip here the service was terrible! I cannot believe how rude the woman taking our order and greeting us at the window was. I have never experienced anyone that works here with that kind of attitude. Our food took forever to get, and add that with our not so friendly staff makes me question going back.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I often pop in to this great tea room after the gym for a Detox Tea. I usually don't have enough will or self discipline to pass up having a gluten free brownie or delish cookie. 
If you haven't been to Cups and Chairs DO stop by and treat yourself to lovely cup of tea. Cheers.

Convenient hotel just east of St. Louis. Rooms are not as updated as some Hampton Inn locations, but overall the location is clean and well-kept. Customer service was outstanding upon arrival - very friendly and welcoming. Price was a bit steep for an older Hampton. Otherwise, my rating would be in the 4-star range.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Good food, though I felt like the portions were smaller than I was expecting for the price. I'm surprised that other Yelper's rated this two dollar signs. I also wish they'd had gluten free soy sauce. Other than that, there is really nothing to complain about and I still was able to enjoy my meal.

Best auto shop in Philly. No one tries to big boy or upsell you here. They are also incredibly nice :)

I came in to get a bent antenna and windshield wiper replaced - he bent both back into place with his bare hands and charged me nothing. 

Don is a saint

Great little place but the pizza is strange. Its really thin, almost cardboard like, and very bland. I haven't had a chance to try any of the specialty pizzas but they look delicious. They also charge more than they should ($2.75). The place is nice & clean though.

But I'd liek to give this place another shot sometime.

I want this place to be so good, so badly. I'm giving it a decent rating because of the decor and rooftop patio. Drinks and appetizers were decent to "meh." Service is hit or miss. I'll definitely be back to try other items on the menu; I want to love this place!

What a fine Margherita Pizza. I watched it being baked, carefully turned with a peel, like I'd use tongs to flip my steaks on a grill.  Best crust I've had in a while, toasted in an oak-fired oven to golden-brown, even black, but no annoyingly large char-bubbles. I could taste the basil on every slice. Great ending to a long day.

The iron leaked water all over my clothes, but they replaced the iron. At 435AM the alarm clock went off. I finally went back to sleep after 30 mins, and I got a wakeup call from the front desk at 5AM. What the fuck? Pretty sure I'm not going back to sleep now. It's awesome being up till 2AM working and having this happen.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
How are onions always out of stock in this enormous Kroger? 

While the downtown location and garage parking are convenient, this Kroger's produce section could definitely double in size. 

Legitimate selection of wine and craft beers, however. Check-out lines move pretty efficiently.

Always a line, but the service is great.  I'm there every morning for a to-go coffee and bagel.  How come they never remember my name or order yet they remember all of the other regular customers?  Am I that forgettable?  Regardless, I still stop by hoping that they'll remember my name.  Oh well.

I have dined here a couple times for lunch.  It has never been crowded either time I was here but the sushi has taken a very long time to come out.  Now I eat a lot of sushi so I know that it does take some time if you order a variety of items.  For me there are other place in town that do a better job.

Best sushi in SB! Moved down from Northern California and was very frustrated with the poor quality sushi down here. I described to a co-worker the kind of sushi I like and they recommended Sakana. Great tasting rolls. A little pricy but worth every bite. I think we found our new sushi spot!

Best gym in Carp thats for sure! Coming from managing prestegious health clubs for the past 8 years I had higher hopes. The gym has everythign you need from cardio, machines, free weights, classes and trainers, The gym is small and hot inside. Overall it's the best you will find in Carp unfortunately.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: this place was ok. wasnt exactly great but at the same time it didnt completely suck. the food was ok and they get their bread from sarcones which is basically some of the best bread ever. service was pretty lame. and the restaurant itself is so small it appears very old fashion-esque.

This is your typical strip mall nail salon but I came here on a referral and it's right off of 55 in the Schnucks/Lowes center...so it's VERY convenient for me.
My friend told me to ask for Tom, so I did and he let me make a reservation.  Tom did a great job on my nails...I got white tips w/ pink...but no glaze....just buffed.

UPDATE as of 2/28/11: CLOSED permanently! 

Yum! Definitely try this place and you will not be disappointed!!!! It's also super fun to sit outside on their large patio and listen to the waves crash as you sip on a nice pitcher of cold beer and bite into your delicious pizza!!

Heard their was a new coffee place in the area. Had to go and try Luck Goat out. The coffee is good. The pastries were good. I went when they first open. The smoothie was good too. The ambience of this place is  very cozy and zen. Beautiful space. Can't wait till all the menu items are up. Great addition to Fairmount.

I'm not a huge fan of this particular Acme. I come here only if I happen to be in the area and need to grab something. When compared to the Acme in Folsom, this Acme has very little. There is really no organic section. All of the other items you would normally find in a grocery store are here though. Nothing more to it.

I've been here three times. I've ordered iced Americanos each time. Every single time they have added sweetener to them without being asked to. I've never had this problem at any other Starbucks in the WORLD. Please just make the drinks according to Starbucks rules.

/whitewhine

Wasn't blown away, especially having read these glowing reviews of Vincent's.  Food was average, service was slightly below average.  I'm willing to bet our table was given second rate service because of our age bracket (18-24).  And nothing upsets me more than not being treated equally because of my age.

I really don't understand why this place has 5 stars.

The 3 roll special is decent and the rest of the prices were okay, but the rolls themselves are nothing to write home about. The hand roll is tiny, the spicy tuna isn't spicy at all, and there is too much tempura flake on everything.

No thanks.

Great service in the Emerald Aisle! 

After years at a competitor I was hesitant when my company switched contracts to National but I was pleasantly surprised during this trip.

Greeter was exceptionally friendly and no issues whatsoever with reservation.

I'm a happy customer.

We went back with my mom to try out their pizzas. The Parma was awesome! The Double Pepperoni was also good and very flavorful. My mom just wanted a plain cheese pizza so we went with the Margarita pizza. She loved it. We were all very happy with our choices.

Dinner Sep 24
  I love that you can order this on line.  Very user friendly site to place order.  Really liked the sweet & sour sauce.
  I am glad people like this place, but I am not a fan.  Ordered 3 dinners and 2 apps and eggrolls and none were anywhere near what I expected taste wise.  That is all I will say.

This is a great spot for lunch. I have been there twice and also ordered take out before here.  The Salmon Panini and the Arugula Salad are two of my favorite things on the menu.  They usually have amazaing seasonal salads as well as a special.  The next time I go I plan to try their pizza because they looked good also!

Fried green tomato eggs benedict.  Service was a little slow and my food was only warm, but not hot.  They were not busy, so I don't know what's up with that.  
Food was tasty and the atmosphere was relaxed, but nice.  I would give it another try.  Maybe it was just an off morning.

OK, OK it's Starbucks! But on that note, this location very efficient, clean & fast!! It was extremely Brick outside, so running into the city Sunday I stopped to get a skinny macchiatio-& it delivered. Yummmmm. The employees were quick, sits on corner, & like this one.

Look , for the amount of Ala Carte sushi..its not bad!! Its not A buffet, is its astounding??! no..But At least its made to order & they are decent.
Especially when I go with bunch friends from the gym., guys eat like 8-10 rolls..LOL.

Return factor:
For the price -Yes!!

2nd Chance, still no good:

Totally losing points in the book of coolness. 

I opened a disputeabout a charge & 25 days later, no resolution. Called the 800# thinking could get an update... Ehhhhh I'm routed back to the Canal St branch. 

I had such high hopes for this Bank, but daily I'm being let down.

Nicely designed. Great selection. They tend to be a bit pricey nonetheless.  The traffic in the parking lot is always horrendous, finding a spot is like a game of 'hide & go seek'. 

The area is lively and thereby the store seems to always be hopping do to speak. 

Paper or plastic, they don't ask, but it's available.

As a disclaimer, I only came here for drinks, so I can't really talk about the food. 

The second I came in I knew this was my type of bar. Small intimate tables, dark lighting, a bit fancy but doesn't overdo it. Great. 

Too bad they only have beer and wine. Get a real liquor license!

Love this little gym. It may be small but it doesn't get too crowed, is always clean and the staff is very friendly and helpful. The membership cost is very reasonable, especially since it allows you to go to any other anytime fitness for no extra charge. Just the right amount of gym for me.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
sooo I've now been here at least 5x and it is growing on me. I still don't like how icy/watery it is but it does hit the spot on a hot day. 

my biggest beef with the staff here is that they are so f**** s-l-o-w. I feel like my yummy yogurt is half melted by the time i check out and am allowed to start eating.  Speed it up bitches!

Fantastic omelettes. Food is good and service is good too. Been coming to the Three Coins Restaurant for many years. What's good about its open 24/7. 

Its a good local restaurant located on Nebraska Ave in Seminole Heights.

I recommend this place to everyone.

So glad to have an affordable dry cleaner service with friendly workers who return my clothes nicely pressed and smelling nice and clean, unlike Broad Street Cleaners (for the last part). You do have to pay in advance for the discount price, but it's worth it!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Really good pizza. I've only ordered from them once but I think if my next order is just as good, I'll give them 5 stars for consistency. They aren't located too far from me but it still took about 45 minutes after I ordered. Not a complaint as I don't know how long it takes to make a pizza. It was hot on arrival.

Some of the best breakfast I've tried in a while I had there eggs Benedict and they were fantastic! The country style potatoes were also very good. If you havent tried this place for breakfast I would recomend you do so you wont leave with an empty stomach thats for sure since the portions are huge.

Awesome little sushi joint tucked away in a shopping plaza which offers great sushi, fast service, and decent prices. Monkey Ball was very good if your looking for an appetizer, the salmon lover roll was also really good.  No beer or sake which was pretty disappointing but overall pretty good dining experience.

Found it on Yelp (because you do NOT eat sushi in a new city without reading anything), and have to agree: this is solidly four stars.  The sushi is slightly overpriced (compared to the West Coast anyway) but fresher than I expected, and the presentation is really superb.

I stopped in for a breakfast sandwich (one of the flatbread ones) and a coffee, and it was pretty good. I was pleasantly surprised by the bits of veggie in the egg portion of the sandwich, and the cheddar cheese was not terrible. I also enjoyed the flax seed in the "bun". Service was nice, the place was pretty clean.

When you feel like you are too cool for TJ Quills because you are now 19 (and thus don't want to hang out with those lame 18 year olds) this is where you head. standard mixed drinks and crappy beer at high prices in a room too loud to hear any thing and too packed to breathe.

Inevitably, if you ask any New Orleanian which is his favorite snowball stand, the answer is going to be the one closest to his house. As this is the closest to ma hood, its without a doubt the winner. They make sure the give me enough syrup on my nectar snowball to put an elephant into a diabetic coma. mmmm.

Lots of TVs ! Video poker. This place is 24hours now! Nice. Even though they were out of Stoli Raz, il forgive them. They serve pizza too! Pizza was mediocre and 3.50 per slice here (u can get it a couple blocks over on Bourbon for like.. $1!)  nice crowd. Better during games! Who dat!?

Well I don't know why their yelp page spelled cocktail "Coctail" but that's none of my business. I love hole in the wall bars and this one is no exception. I have no complaints about this place (so far, as I've just discovered it)! Desiree was one of the nicest and most attentive Metairie bartenders I've come across.

Stereotypical Wendy's you find in any major city.  The service was normal/average and the food was normal/average.  We ate inside and the place was clean which was definitely a bonus.  Maybe I ought to bump this review up to 3 stars...(ok, I did).  Cleanliness in a fast food joint is definitely worth an extra star these days.

Went here for dinner and had such a great meal! I had the green enchiladas and they were soooo good. The waitress couldn't have been nicer and put up with my "what's your favorite thing on the menu" questions. It makes me a little sad that the place was nearly empty - COME HERE!! It's really good and authentic food!

as i used to work right around the corner, i didn't have too many opportunities to hang out here and enjoy my latte, but i do recall that there was seating upstairs as well
