consistently good coffee and friendly baristas
cozy interior
i was happy when they opened on the hill as starbucks was really the only other option for coffee

I was glad to have a vet that is within walking distance of my house. I take vets very serious and am very picky. I have been here twice. Once with my dog and once with my cat....both times were great. They also have done a great job of reminding me of medications and appointments. I have no complaints!

Agh. Meh. Mmmph. And other shoulder shrugging sounds. 

A.) it's your standard Starbucks as far as menu, decor, etc. go
B.) The free wifi is less than weak. Double "meh"
C.) I get that the suburbanites have few other coffee shop options, but holy shiza this place is jiggity jammed. 
D.) friendly service
E.) It gets "the job" done

9 chairs so even when it's busy you can get a haircut pretty quick.  All the barbers are good, I don't have one that I consistently go to.   These guys are all really good.  I go out of my way to go there but its the only place I go.  And for $13, you can't beat it.

I have never had a bad experience here. I have only dined in once, but the food speaks for itself! I almost always get the Maki Combination. The fish is always fresh and delicious! Service is always great & I look forward to checking out their new location in Warminster I just wish they delivered!

Sakana is a favorite of mine and the hubby. Great ambiance - very cozy and warm. The rolls are eclectic and original...and delish! I highly recommend the following rolls: lobster habanero melt, bakes scallop, green snake, crunchy veggie, and the kobe beef sushi.

This place came recommend from my trolly guide.
The atmosphere is really nice and the staff was great.
I ordered the chicken parm which was super dry and lacked flavor.  The side salad that came with my meal was drenched in dressing.
If it wasnt for their $3.00 martini special I would have been really disappointed.

This is your run of the mill Dunkin Donuts - the staff has always been friendly and helpful whenever I stop in, the facilities are clean, and they've always done a nice job with my coffee. My only complaint would be the short hours and lack of Wi-Fi.

Convenience will definitely have me coming back!

I would consider this a typical Starbucks, except for the size. It is TINY! If there are more than 2 people waiting, there is barely a place to stand to wait for your drink without stepping on someone else's toes! Despite the size issue, the employees have always been very friendly and my drinks have always been correct.

Not my favorite car wash in St. Pete but definitely never busy either.

My first choice is always Pasadena Car wash, but the wait is always forever (for a good reason-they are that good and meticulous with their work), but when you need a quick job, this place does the trick.

Not sure if I just had an ok experience, but I will stick to my regular girl at K Nails. 

Everything was clean and laid out well, but I thought the prices were a few dollars higher than I'm use to spending for no additional frills. 

I will say that their massage chairs were new and nice.

Very friendly staff and a convenient location make this salon a must go to for your mani pedi needs.  

They are located near Pizza Fusion and Burger 21.

Every time I've gone there, they are cleaning the tools and to me, that's important.

I like Mae....very much attention to detail and a perfectionist

So I love Zoe's Yougurt Village.  I love that they have interesting flavor combinations.   I love the fact that when you ask to taste a flavor  they give you a lot.  They have a large selection of toppings.   This is an excellent way to end an afternoon walk in Broad Ripple.

This is my second time visiting here. The atmosphere is calm and pleasant. Everyone is friendly and professional. The last visit my hair lasted 3 weeks. I am 100% natural hair and seldom get my hair straightened. I used my own hair products and once again the results were amazing.

After reading great reviews, we were very much looking forward to dining here when business took us to this side of town.

We were quite disappointed.  The service was lacking, the food was average, and the price was....a little startling.

Many better options for Mexican fare in Indy.

We've been to George's several times.  The bottom line is, we like it....but not enough to make a special trip there.  the food is always good, but, with the exception of the tenderloin, not great.  The service is always adequate, but not outstanding.  It's a good, solid restaurant that with just a little work could be a standout.

Located on the 5th floor in suite 500 of the bank building.  Very non-descript.  Received haircut, style, and razor shave from Susan.  She was very careful and did a decent job.  But $60?  Was expecting somewhere in $25-$40 range (with style) after reading other posts.  Not sure why I was charged so much compared to others.

Nothing special here, just an average shop. I go here for lunch sometimes and Im able to get back to work within an hour which is good. The parking is limited. Nothing really jumped out at me here, usually I go to a sushi house and theres something I am excited about. Not here though. Its average even if that.

Went through the dive-thru on a Saturday night. They only had five flavors of ice cream. I ordered a banana royale and they didn't put any sauce on it, just ice cream, banana slices and whipped cream. I asked for a sweet tea and gave me an unsweet one. Not coming back, there's other options in the area.

Psst. Closed ages ago.

New owners of the space are the folks that run Holdren's, and the space is planned to split out into two restaurants. One will be steaks Holdren's style, the other as another Italian/pasta joint. It's far from being open anytime soon, though.

I still can't say from experience whether Super Cuca's is a right good fix after a crazy night of drinking, but I can say it's a right good fix after three days of evacuation from the Jesusita Fire, and living on office snacks.

Regular size carnitas burrito, enough for two meals. Ah, hot prepared food.

I had salmon roe sushi and Tempura udon. The udon was surprisingly nice (4 stars), but the tempura was weird; 2 shirmp, 2 broccoli, 2 cauliflower. Those vegetable are not acceptable for me (-1). Salmon roe was not very fresh, and they didn't have uni.

Sushi master was Chinese. He has the speed. Service is quite slow.

If you're looking for cheap, near downtown and clean, this is your place. The cost was around $40. There is a mini fridge and microwave, and flat screen TV. There is no coffee pot, but there is a gas station around the corner. 
Can fare to downtown is about $5.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Luca Pizza is Luca Pizza- Big and greasy. 

The guy that worked here was by himself and totally swamped. I can't believe how nice he was- completely genuine. Even though he was really busy, he managed to get my slice and breadsticks pretty quickly for me. I think he could tell I was in a hurry. 

Thanks, dude!

I came here between yet two more doctor's appointments. It was a day full of appointments, and I  hadn't eaten much of anything. I had an hour to kill. There were no pre-made sandwiches available. When I asked for a breakfast sandwiches- nothing- they were hit hard at breakfast. There wasn't even a fruit plate.

This place serves below average Chinese food.  For the same quality food at a better price, I prefer Chinese Express which is a block away (next to Schnucks).  

They have an option to order your food online which is handy when ordering for an office group.

Cheap, good, greasy Chinese food with very good service.  I stopped in during my lunch break.  My food was brought out piping hot only a few minutes after I ordered.  And the value is good.  They bring you a heaping portion with soup and an egg roll for ~$7.

They're ok.  I continue to go to them because they are the closest to my home.  However, when paying $20+ for a wash, I expect it to be immaculate.  They always miss spots.

They do have discounts some times.  Look for the sign on the road that advertises the specials.

They had a special offering $9.99 for a cut so I went in.  The stylist, John, was friendly, and took his time.  It seemed like he was new to the craft.  The cut was mediocre, not great.  But the price was right, the store is new, and it's in a convenient location (next to Schnuck's).  I may try them again before moving on.

One of the diveyest of dive bars I've ever been to.  Bars on the front door, the smell of ash trays as you enter, and a female bartender that I bet could bet you at arm wrestling.  

They had a nice Golden Tee machine and drinks were super cheap.  $4 for two bourbon & diets.  We might have been there during some kind of special.

I will never order from here again.  I ordered a vegetable pizza and a caesar salad which arrived after waiting 90 minutes.  The pizza was delivered cold and the salad was literally just lettuce, croutons, and a cup of dressing.  Definitely not worth your time or money.

What a great surprise. Thanks to "Things-to-do" app and Yelp, we found this place. Upscale restaurant with the slightly higher prices. But the value is there. You pay more and get more and better of everything. The solo Italian soprano after dinner (for late eaters, during) was a real treat.

THE best Subway I've ever been to.  The service is NOT slow.  The people know my order every time I walk through the door.  They are friendly and always ask for my husband if he is not with me and vice-versa.  The food is excellent and it is spotless.  The toppings are a very good amount - my sandwiches are always overflowing.

Starbucks isn't usually at the top of my coffee shop list, but this location is pretty nice. It's easy to find and has a lot of parking, so it makes a good meeting point.

The staff are always very friendly, and it's usually busy, but I've never seen it busy enough that there are no free seats.

I've only used the wand wash here, so I can't comment on their more extensive services. 

This is the car wash right across the street from my apartment, and ... well, it's a car wash. Coin operated, there's a change machine in the front. 

My goal in life is to be fast enough to wash my car for $2 instead of $3. Someday....

Love the atmosphere here! Lots of different beers to try. Great service. Brandon mall is pretty central location. Prices are a bit steep but there is something for everyone.
I enjoy sitting on the patio and listening to live music. I will return but on a night that is cool out.

Large Pie?  Medium in nature. Sauce and dough too sweet!  If I want sweet there are donuts available at Dunkin Donuts down the street.  Their menu might be extensive but when you can not make a decent pie?  Too many better pizza joints in the neighborhood.  Live and Learn!

Don't bother with a kiddie cone.  Get the regular size  or get a large and share with your little one since it's more for your money.  

I'm addicted to this place.  With flavors like "Happy Bunny" and "Hi Jinx", you don't need the extra toppings.  

Ok finishing this review and heading over there now.

My husband and I like to eat here since it's within walking distance of our home.  Always the nicest people working with extremely fast service.  Decent food, but that's just it - not fantastic, just run of the mill Chinese...and I really hate that they close at 8:30! Waaay too early!

I frequent this salon because it is closer to my house than most and it is slightly more upscale. Overall I have no major complaints. I think the manicures are exactly as expected, but I do wish they did a better job on my pedicure. Their prices are higher than many other salons in the area, but the pedicure seems to be comparable.

Besides the drunken-dancing with my buddy's girlfriend's friends, this place reminded me of everything that i hated about college. It was everything that I hoped it wasn't: vomit-stricken floors, cheap, disgusting beer, under-21 coed's wasting away, with their lack of inhibition, and a mechanical bull. 'Nuff said. Place is whack.

Pros: quick service; the General Tso's Chicken was nice and crispy; brown rice is an option for combination platters

Cons: the General Tso's Chicken didn't come with broccoli! That's outrageous! That's preposterous! That's just weird!!! But the chicken was still very good.

Bottom line: I would definitely order from here again.

Quality cheap Chinese food.  That says it all.

It was at China Wok Express that I finally tried a St. Paul sandwich - and fell in love.

The upside to its location in the massive, vacant and blighted ghost town that is St. Louis Marketplace?  Soooooooooo much parking.

I give 3.5 stars for John Jay.  From what I hear, you are much less likely to get a mullet here than, say, supercuts on carrolton.  Although to be honest, I probably would have risked a mullet if John Jay wasn't offering 1/2 off cuts for students!  With that discount it was ~$16 before tip for my cut.

Really fresh fish. The oyster and uni shooter look pretty amazing although we didn't try. Right now they are having their anniversary sale. You can get a boat special about 10-12 pieces of sashimi/suhi for $12.95. That's plenty for 2 people. I haven't tried their entrees yet but they all look really good. Will go back.

Well, it was one of the best caesar salads I've ever had in my life.  I certainly remember that much.   After that, the memory gets a little foggy. 

No, I didn't drink too much Chianti.  I just ate way too much Italian food...it's what I've come to expect from a great Italian restaurant.  See for yourself what I'm talking about.

I love this place! I love Starbucks in general. There really isn't much to say about it. My order is always right, the staff is very nice and quick. Even in the mornings, they are spot on and always smiling. The Store itself is very clean and well kept. It is a great spot to get a cup, and chill.

This Wendy's is always clean, the service is always slow however. The drive thru is always faster than going inside. So if you are in a hurry you can just get it in the window. You will be there for a while if not. Other than that the food is always hot and fresh. The restrooms are just alright. There never spotless, but not gross.

I love this place. Tonight we had the Lobster Salad, Oregon Roll, Tempura with banana, what? SO GOOD! Fabulous! Its causal and full with couples, families, singles at the sushi bar. Service was very good. They always have different and unique items on the menu.

Comfortable beds, free WiFi, a decent free breakfast, and friendly service. It's what you expect out of a midprice hotel. There is also a workout room and a small pool. The rooms are recently redone and you don't have to search for an outlet to charge your stuff. The microwave and fridge are a nice touch. I would stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: oh you chocolate amaretto! so delicious! we walked here after lunch for a delicious ice cream treat. my mom actually ended up stealing the rest of my chocolate amaretto because it was that good. I love that they have little sample dishes you can get and will be back one day with my husband to get one :)

came here 20 minutes before closing and there was a huge line! but it moved fast. very good ice cream though I wish I tried the dark chocolate which I would have liked better. besides that though very delicious ice cream and a cute place :) we enjoyed it. definitely a stop to make after dinner when in Nashville!

I sent my husband here for his birthday and he came back mutilated.  I was angry that he paid for his shave.  His face was literally bleeding in 7 places and more razorburn than I've ever seen.  The owner gave his service as well.  

It was absolutely unacceptable and they should have been profusely apologetic.

I have a soft spot in my heart for this place, probably because I have been going  for 15 years.
Great neighborhood spot, a little on the pricey side.

I love their hamachi and masago with green onions and they have some interesting rolls - box sushi is awesome, ginger is too. The spicy edamame isn't too spicy and is really good.

The best sushi I have had in the Cresent City.  The quantity, quality, and cost make it the best value here or comparing to Dallas!  Very casual atmosphere yet fine Asian dining.  The sushi bar is well designed.  WIll haver to go back and sit at the bar and watch istead of the table.

This cute coffee shop was super close to where I was staying while visiting new Orleans. The barista was very friendly, helpful, and interesting to talk to. The cold brew was quite good. The pastries were so so. The prices were very reasonable. I'd recommend for coffee and good company.

If you need some alcohol last minute and can't drive far this place isn't bad. RW and The Wine Cellar were closed so I had to stop in for my Xmas wine. The wine selection needs some work. My redlaser app informed me their prices we're on the high side compared to other places. Customer service was nice.

It's like Ted Drewes kinda sloppy little brother - Skeets makes some wicked custard, and they've got gourmet cones (choco-pretzel!), but it's just not as pretty.... You'll see the difference when you drive up and notice everyone is leanin' wit it on the uneven landing and tables out front.

Not the best Courtyard I've stayed at. Courtyards are usually my preference when I'm out traveling. The bathtub was starting to peel. The beds were comfy and the rooms were clean. Biggest pro = this place is 5 mins to the airport and has free shuttle service.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Small sushi place with outside seating, weather permitting.  Bi Bim Bop was good especially when served in the stone bowl and the rice is just a little crunchy. Unagi maki was simple, yet good and fresh.  Seaweed salad was very good (not dry or overly saturated with dressing).

If you live within 65 miles of this airport you need to bring in a paper copy of your current car insurance policy.  Where is this stated?  In the "terms and conditions"" which nobody ever reads and unhelpfully on the counter once you've already arrived to pick up your rental.

Just when I was going to say this was one of the cleanest McDonalds...

It LOOKS clean. Ignorance is bliss I suppose...
I saw the guy who was sweeping the floor, clean the benches and chairs by sweeping them with that same broom that he used near the bathrooms and trashcan.
Yuck! :P

Coffee was good tho. :)
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The service was good, the atmosphere was pleasant, but the food was only so-so, especially considering the price.  I ordered the chef's special for the day and only ate about half.  I want to go back and try the happy hour sushi, but Mochi isn't high on my priority list.

It's no secret that I value good beer, good food, and good service.  Throw a big patio into the mix and you've made a repeat customer out of me.  This is Harry's.  I spent some of my final hours in St. Louis here, but the group and I were eventually chased off the premises by a bold band of mosquitoes.

True-to-form Imo's pizza is served here, so you're likely to love it or hate it already.  It has a much bigger dining area than some of the other Imos' locations, but if you want delivery, make sure no other branch is closer.  They wouldn't deliver to my apartment which, according to Google Maps, is an 8 minute drive.

Awesome for staying open late but pizza quality isn't what you want.

I'm fairly sure their crust is premade - when you order a pie to go you see them grab it, throw sauce on it and whatever you want.  Seriously!?!?!?! This is acceptable in Philadelphia? I'm confused - we're Philadelphia.  This shouldn't be allowed.

This is a great spot for your go-to Italian meal.  

It's exactly what I want when I'm looking for the true Italian meal we've all grown up with. 
No bells no whistles no menu items that are a paragraph long to read with words you mumble when ordering because you're not sure how to pronounce. 

Clean, friendly, priced accordingly.

We only went here for the location, because it was convenient. 

There is not much to say other than the service, food, and atmosphere were just A-OK.  

It would have been nice to see some sort of happy hour special/menu.  At 5:15 on a week night, they had nothing of the sort going on.

Great location and meeting the standard hampton Inn standard.

It's a few minutes from shopping mall including Macy's and etc and there is an Asian buffet restaurant just a few blocks away.  

Room was spacious and free breakfast comes with real fruits including seasonal (now it's blueberries).  

No complain from me
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Asparagus chicken was decent. Arnold Palmer came with a handy cup of sugar water. However, 3 of 4 of us thought the fish dishes were sad. Fish tacos were perfectly tasteless. A disgrace to Mexican food. Despite living only a couple miles away, will probably not go back.

Meh. Been here twice in the last couple of years with family. Great place for a beer but the food is at or below average. My husband had their turkey sandwich that he declared was mediocre. I had their veggie burger...decent but the side salad was pretty sad. Time to try another Peddlers Village establishment

A very good local donut shop featuring a lot of exotic items to meet any taste. I cam in hungry for my favorite chocolate covered cake and settled for a plain cake and it was good. I don't get into exotic donuts much outside of District but if thats your thing than this is your place for the many choices you have.

One of the few air conditioned coffee shops in the Marigny/Bywater featuring not only coffee but frozen ice cream treats. Its a little small and not much room to do work in but there is seating outside on a good day. All I order in the summer is iced coffee which I found to be good. Great stop to cool off if your on your bike.

All I can say is Pizza D is back. Not only are the pies great, the pasta specials are also superb as well as the salads and garlic knots. My friends had two of the specials and they were superb and so were the pies. The only draw back is that they didn't bring back the pepperoni rolls. PD is back as the No. 1 pizza in the city.

This is an update. We ordered from Linda jeans and were pleasantly surprised with the improvement. We got the chicken florentine chicken cheese steak,a crispy chicken salad, the potato soup, and a chicken parm sandwich for the kids to split. I was quite pleased with all the food we ordered.

I wish I would have read these review before going. 
I have absolutely no idea what I paid for.  Had a coupon for a $29 dollar advanced oil change and I get the basic 14.50 oil change with another $25 dollars of who knows what fees.  Grand total $36.
RIP OFF SO MANY HIDDEN FEES.
Avoid.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Ehh...I would say the food here is mediocre...I didn't like the dimly lit dining room atmosphere and how the seating was soo tightly packed... had a party of 10 so we had a pretty large sampling of their menu...all I can say is.. I do not have the urge to want to go back

This is the worst DD I have ever been in. My order is never correct. They rush you and are rude. They push everyone down the end of the counter to wait and if 10 people are getting sandwiches, you are all on top of each other. Ugh, it's a nightmare. Will not return here anytime soon. I have reached my patience level with th place.

A girl got to have some wine once in a while.  After a long day of work, I wanted just that.  I stopped here to grab some.  The shop has a decent selection.  However finding anything here is nearly impossible.  I mean there are sections like french wine, italian wine, etc. but the way the store is organized is horrible.

Finn McCool's is a dive bar in Ambler, adjust your expectations accordingly.  

It tends to not be crowded, even on the weekends.  If you're in Ambler and looking for a place to hang out with friends and drink a couple beers, this would be an A-OK place to go.

On the plus side, it's a really cool old building.

What's not to like about this place? Its a friggin Pinkberry, same goodness coming out of this location as the ones on the west coast. Wait can be a pain as I saw quite a line when walking past it a day or so after we got some, but the workers are friendly and prompt. Great yogurt.

Awesome local bar with good peeps.  We were there for a Krewe party at Christmas.  Owners and bartenders kind and helpful, and the regular crowd was hospitable.  If in the area and in need of a neighborhood bar with cold beer, I'd hit up the Homedale Inn again for sure.  No question.

Not a fan.  The room had a strange layout.  It felt dated.  The A/C didn't work.  Weird shower handle that felt like it was going to break every time I took a shower.  Food trays that sat in the hall for 24 hours.

An extra star for good service.  I also liked the breakfast.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Was looking for a refi. Here I found a typical cold, impersonal, big bank. I'm going to work with Metairie Bank & Trust. Locally owned and they will keep my mortgage in house, locally, not sell it to another big bank. My best advice: eliminate credit card debts, and move your money to credit unions or local banks.

Found this place by accident one day because Google Maps still thinks there is a Tully's here. But I'm glad to say this local coffee shop is a better find. Not only are the staff super friendly, but the coffee is very good too. If you like weak watered down stuff, don't come here.

I disagree with Kara.  This is not the worst Starbucks in the area and actually has one of the nicest coffee lounge spaces in town.  Tall lofted ceilings look out to Mt Rose and the surrounding Summit Sierra Mall.  It's actually a very scenic location.  The coffee is like every other Starbucks, good but not great.

They can be a bit rude at times and sometimes they get annoyed with you when you don't pick up your item the day it's ready. They do a good job but the prices are way overpriced, whether it's a normal dry cleaning job or getting pants hemmed, I feel like I get ripped off.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: not too bad for the price $18.95 for all you can eat sushi which was really good for the lunch price.  It does get really busy though.  I love some of the rolls. The miso soup was okay as well.  Service can be really busy though and the chefs too.  But the prices were really good and amazing :P

This Arby's is off Kirkwood Highway westbound. First impression of the interior of this Arby's is it seemed up-to-date and fairly comfortable. I had a 'shroom and swiss with curly fries and the food was good enough, about what I would expect from this fast food chain. Service was okay.

Brought my friend's LV scarf to clean and remove the red wine stain ... yea not looking good already, cost a FORTUNE! I figured it's the closest dry cleaning place to work and convenient, but the lady was rude like everyone said and the stains were still there. Faint, but there ....
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Great place to have lunch. Super quick and the portions are huge. They do deliver as well so you don't have to leave the desk. They have so many options to choose from. You can order a salad or order that salad as a quesadilla. Great food and fast service.

Not bad if you have a rewards card. The sales are decent and the staff has always been courteous and kind to us. Produce is better than walmart although not as good as some other places.

We stop here at twice a week so I think the staff knows us by now ;)

Truly some of the best sushi I've ever had. The freshest fish imaginable! And the family owners are so nice and friendly. Not a single item we have disliked...their spicy tuna is awesome because it's not mayo-based. My favorite specialty roll is the TMNT, but they are all good!!!

Ugh I can't stand this place. It's always super packed, and the only way they get people in is through their free happy hours and free drinks. They intentionally make people wait in line outside, even when there is plenty of space in there (they do it to appear in-demand). Overall, not my cup 'o tea.

Overall I've had very good experiences with this Starbucks. My only complaint is that they only have small tables and a window bar with stools. I wish they had some comfy chairs, and bigger tables that barely fit 2 laptops. But I realize that it's a small Starbucks and I assume they're doing the best with what they have!

This is a great take out place!  The food is clean and not gooey, crab rangoons are awesome and they are pretty fast and I've never had a screw up on my order.

A few weeks ago they even delivered after they were closed, which shows how important customer service is to them.

Yay! I'm a fan.

I agree with the majority of the reviews.  Total lack of variety of flavors.  They have one thingy of sorbet (if memory serves me right).  Kinda expensive.  Yes, they sell bottled water.  The toppings are kinda lame.  Typical sprinkles, nuts, strawberries, crushed oreos, etc..  Nothing new.

It's official.  My bf got me hooked on this place after nearly a year of not coming here.  There is a lack of variety in terms of flavors, but the toppings are great.  I just wish they would have more non-dairy stuff. Maybe it's the hormones inside of me that changed my colors about this place.

Came here for lunch, food was decent, the service was pretty good too.  I got a few different rolls, nothing really extraordinary.  The miso soup hit the spot.  I have a suspicion their drinks are a little watered down, though.  They take Discover, and don't seem to mind splitting checks and stuff.  Lots of seating options.

To put it simply: good sushi, prices could be a lot better.  There are a bunch of sushi places in the area that are just as good if not better, with lower prices.  Other places may not look as cool on the inside, but that's okay with me.  The service was good, friendly people, good hours.  If you need a TV, they've got one too!

I wasn't expecting much considering it's in the mall, but this place is good! They have really great guacamole that they prepare at your table, and the serving size is huge (it's 2 whole avocados!). The actual meals are delicious and, again, huge portions.

Ok, I don't consider myself a pizza connoisseur, but I'm close. This pizza is NOT as good as everyone else says. Every time I've had it the crust is burnt, hard, and gross. Beside the bad crust situation, the actual pizza is rather tasteless. Go to Newtown Pizza--it's way better!

What I most enjoyed here are the gyoza's and the broccoli tempura. The sushi itself it was A ok. At least we tried it for ourselves. The red bean ice cream- i've tasted better than this one. When we got there it seemed that there's only 2 ppl worked in front of the house, no one greeted us when we got there.

This is a decent delivery Chinese restaurant in the city to order from. The General Tso Chicken was good as was the lo mein and egg roll. I've had better wonton soup, but it still got the job done. The boneless ribs were also good. Safe bet for late night Chinese cravings.

One of the nest of Tampa's chinese places... a small place that probably would have gone unnoticed but given word of mouth an yelp has grown to be packed most days... and yes you can actually find asians who eat here.... salt and pepper calamari gets my vote too

I think it's the last bennigans in tampa - ok that may be a stretch. It does have a great view ad the service was nice. Plus it kinda reminds me of high school going to bennigans with the friends. that being said the food does seem to have taken a bit of a decline even for a chain restaurant

the 24/7 hours make it so much easier to work out given the non-stop and random schedule that I have. Plus with you membership you have access to all Anytime locations as well. It's a good gym. No Planet Fitness mushiness but no pool, basketball area like LA fitness. You go here to work out on your own and when you want.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Predictable high-volume dirty Mexican restaurant.  Food is cheap and agreeable.  Drinks are large and, again, cheap.  This one gets 3 stars because of the festive atmosphere... it is a favorite of younger natives and college students who are out on the town.

I have to back up Claire B. on the price thing: a bottle of wine here is consistently about $2.00 more than the same bottle elsewhere in town.  Frugal MacDougal's and Midtown have better selection, great lay-outs, and consistently competitive prices by comparison.

Above-average, creative sushi in a cozy, hip space in a great location.  Perfect for grabbing a bite before a concert at The End or Exit/Inn.  Try the signature Choo Choo Roll, the Crazy Roll or the Samurai Roll.  For sushi snobs too good for rolls, the real stuff is also very good.

Are you serious?? Based on the reviews from YELP I went here on a first date totally hyped. The place was cute but tight, a nice date spot. I got sushi 1 and my date got fish curry. As soon as I saw my plate I knew it wouldn't be good, and my date barely ate his dish. I'm asian, I know my asian food, this place was terrible.

I was surprised for my birthday and it felt like I was in someone's house, which was cute but quiet snug. Being that I was born and raised in an Italian home, I was a little underwhelmed in terms of food selection on the menu. However, I still enjoyed the tiramisu! I think that may have been the highlight.

While the take out service was fine, I didn't think the food was very good. I simply didn't enjoy my dish of pork lo mein. The noodles were over cooked and the flavor was off. Perhaps there are other items on the menu that are better.  Let me know. 

Life is still good with Chinese takeout but it could be better.

Awful. I'm not a big fan of most of the Friday's style chain restaurants anyway but this is the bottom of the barrel. The food was just terrible and I really can't think of anything redeeming about the place. There are plenty of  other great restaurants in the area (P.F. Chang's, Ted's Montana Grill, WAWA!) so skip this one.

Harry's Corner is a great little corner bar in the French Quarter. It is a favorite place to stop in, get a drink, and 'use the facilities' while stomping around the quarter. They are reasonably priced. I love the big windows which are perfect for people watching while enjoying an adult beverage.

Had dinner here. Very good but given that the prices exceed the fine dining factor can't go for the 4th star. For example, the whole fish I ordered was deboned tableside. The process left me with a plate of fish chunks, not 2 whole fillets as it should have been.

only had a few slices here.  they were a little dry... not the best.  could've used more flavor.  
they could be in contention as a neighborhood joint, but i don't know the other contestants yet.  either way, this place doesn't compete with hotshots like gianfranco or rustica or soho.

Went here once towards the end of summer 07 with some friends for dinner out on the patio.  If I recall correctly I either had pork chops or chicken but either way the food was really subpar.  Absolutely without any flavor and it cost more than it should have.

I'd go back and try the pizza if I were in the neighborhood though.

I've been hearing awesome things about this place, but I'm not a huge Italian fan.  Let me tell ya, it was some of the best FOOD I've had in a while.  I got a shrimp pasta special and my boyfriend got blackened redfish.  Everything was so amazing and flavorful, not salty.  The caprese salad was extremely fresh.  Awesome mmmm...

A friend from out of town came in with a groupon. I wasn't sure about the place but we gave it a go. It was during Mardi Gras season and they had a limited menu... and were out of most everything on that! But we all ordered and got great hot bar food... no complaints, but no raves! Irish pub with burgers...

Delicious, nice atmosphere, great service! I had the Fantasy (loved the crust and burrata) and the boyfriend had the Thriller. Both were quite good! I also tried the Peach Sangria, it was good but I was a tad disappointed by the lack of fruit in the glass. The pizza is on the pricier side, so it's a great treat!

We ordered take out the first week they were open and it was excellent. I called prior to their opening and spoke with the manager who let me put the order in and pick-up still before the restaurant opened. Food was excellent and the staff could not have been more accommodating. Looking forward to dining in house.

Ok, upon a few other trials of the dry cleaning, they are officially hopeless. Just terrible. Takes forever, the attendant is an unpleasant woman. The prices unjustifiable for the shoddy service. They cant even get a regular laundering of a collared shirt right. Just terrible.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Welcome to Florida, land of state ran overpriced liquor stores. A 1.75 liter of Jack goes for app. 14.00 more than here . Who cares about state tax? On my last visit, stoped by Costco at home and saved well over 100.00 on restocking my bar. Well , now I know ... and so do you !!

This has got to be one of the biggest safeways Ive ever been to and yet they dont have the one thing i need most a probiotic kambucha drink. They got everything else from soda to energy drinks. They also dont carry any good gallon bottled waters like AZ's own RimRock or another good one like geyser at least.

This is my favorite Publix in South Tampa.  The staff is super friendly and always greets me by my first name. Everyone in the bakery has gotten to know my kids and they are always excited to get their Publix cookie. Parking is easy and the check-out lines move very fast.

The service here is always wonderful and the baristas are very friendly. Great location, however sometimes the drive-through can be a bit slow. I really like their breakfast sandwiches, especially the egg-white, spinach and feta wrap.  The Cinnamon Dolci Latte is my fave drink.

I am so happy to finally have a local coffee spot open within walking distance of my house. I've only been twice but love the atmosphere and the staff. This is a great place to meet a friend or to just work on the computer. The feature local pastries from We Vegan Eats as well as incredible smoothies from Raw Smoothie Co.

Haven't been here in a while, but picked up a non-fat mocha to keep me warm and energized in this dreary winter weather. Friendly service with a smile. 

Have any of you ever seen their riddles? It's on a chalkboard near the cream and sugar. For once I finally figured out the answer to their riddle and it made my day.

Ok this is now become my favorite sushi place in town.  The efficiency of the staff to get you seated, the sushi chef's creating amazing, flavorful, tasty food.  This place is in a strip mall by Winco and you know what?  Who cares.  It is super fresh, great plating, and worth every penny.

Got lucky after having breakfast at Truckee Bagel.  I was able to walk in and be seated immediately for my haircut.  Janet Urbina was the woman who took care of me.  I was in and out with an excellent haircut in under 15 minutes.  I'll be returning in four weeks for another.  Thanks Janet!

Very new, clean comfortable,  excellent location.  My room is quiet with amenities. It's not cheesy 80's decor but beautifully modern. Breakfast is top notch. Service is responsive. Small negative is the ac has one fan setting and its sounds like its always on high located next to the bed.  My room had no tub
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
okay, im giving one star just out of respect for st. louis...cause i love you.  but i don't love your pizza.  so so wrong.  i seriously won't even eat it.  and im not a pickey gal.  

the other star is for the toasted ravs. and salad, which are at least edible.

Living in East Nashville, this has become our "go to" place when we want something to eat that's not really expensive but filling.  There's nothing about Las Maracas that will place it above your typical Mexican restaurant however, it's consistently fast and filling.

This is short and simple. Stopped here for dinner after shopping (yes dinner) and the service was fast, friendly, and efficient. The McDonalds was up to date and had a nice feel of modern and christmas;). The food was hot and it did me justice. Ill be back for sure. Until next time yelpers adios.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Sun King beers were good. Offshore restaurant chips were good, chowder was amazing.  But what we really came for, the Lobstah Roll, was disappointingly tiny and way overpriced.  Would rather go to Caplinger's to satisfy the craving.  Would come back for the beers but probably not to eat.

Highest quality Japanese Omakase.  A complete journey with interesting appetizers, fish, sushi, meat, soup, and dessert tastings.  Simple preparation  allowed the ingredients to shine.  A small sake tasting complemented the meal.  Sitting by the chef allowed us to talk food and ingredients during the meal.

This is my local go to for chinese food when I'm stuck at home with no food around. Food is cheap, and reliable. I can't say its the best chinese food ever but it meets your basic expectation of chinese food.

I wish they would add brown rice options though.

I've been coming to this place for years. They are straight-shooters. The neighborhood is problematic so be careful. They are very fast getting your car repaired. You rarely have to wait more than a few hours, which is a rarity in the auto repair business. And they are cheap.

Ramen was pretty boring...didn't like the fact that you had to add meat, sprouts, onions, etc and pay additional charges for each-absurd! I did like the complimentary edamame, the salad, and 4 piece cali roll that comes with the boring ginormous bowl of ramen.
Tucson, help me find the best ramen spot in you!

I am very picky with Chinese restaurant and Wei Asian café is a great neighborhood restaurant, I always buy to to go and the food is great everytime a must try there are the curry mussels if you like spicy and he Hong Kong beef soup an awesome service and very happy that we should 5 minutes away

Nothing exciting about running cars really but this place makes it as painless as possible.  Another great location and friendly, quick service here.  Again, the biggest and best benefit to me is being able to literally walk to my car and jump in prior to paperwork.  Love that.

This place has decent sushi.  I have been coming here for a while.  Wookie and his brother own the place and will provide you with great service.  When you order I would just ask Wookie to make you a plate of whatever is fresh.  I have never gone wrong that way.

Great hotel for the price. Location is perfect. I got really good deal through tripadvisor. Parking was $25 bucks and you can come and go with your car as you please. Hotel was clean. No complaints really. Not the most glamorous hotel in Philly but for one night it did the trick.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Villa di Roma I don't know what happened but it seems that the quality of your food, and especially the service, have dropped noticibly but prices have climbed.  Spaghetti and meatballs for $14 really?  For better food at similar prices I now go to Criniti on Broad near Oregon.

I usually don't dine out on Saturday nights as I prefer to go out when restaurants are slower but I did.  Maybe this attributed to the excruciatingly slow service but I am not likely to go back.  I also did not care of the designer rolls that we purchased as they were too fragile to eat with chop sticks.

I was just reading Bill McThrill's review and wanted to toss in my two cents.  Pine Street makes the best white anchovy pizza in my book.  The more garlic the better and the crust is tasty.  I don't order there as much as I used to but I swear they see my number pop up on their caller ID and know my order right away.

My friend was visiting and wanted to try this place out because it was on national tv for their Sonoran dogs.

I wasn't impressed. It was just a-ok, wasn't bad but wasn't memorable to make me come back.  I had Carne Asada tacos while my friends had their Sonoran dogs...  typical salsa bar.

FINALLY found a place to get my weekly fix of Japanese food (Hot Udon, Soba, Tempura, Donburi, Nabe, Sushi, Tofu, Chirashi, etc)

 AND GOOOOOOD SPICY TUNA!  They also make Poke (yay for Hawaii!!) :)  and salad with the traditional daikon, citrus, soy dressing NOT something you can get in a bottle.

Ah, the disappointment.  ... the ahi was pulverized and it wasn't even spicy.

the hamachi was so very fishy.

Thank god the green tea was good, washed everything down.  

The chef looked cute tho.  Nobu.  He's very friendly and looks like a Japanese Mario bros.  Too bad I don't think I'll ever go back here for sushi.

Solid espresso with a simple swanky urban cafe vibe. It's hard to find solid espresso in a town dominated by old time coffee producers like Community and CDM. The service can be somewhat curt. Maybe they need to drink more of their own espresso in the mornings...

Had lunch here yesterday. Had the fried chicken. Pretty good, it came with a salad (basic iceberg lettuce, carrots, cheese) mashed potatoes and green beans. My friend had the burger and liked it, no problems.
Staff was friendly and they were not busy at all. I'd go back, chicken was very good.

Stopped in the other day "cuz I was over that way. Not bad,  but not as wonderful as I remember. There really was nothing wrong. The coffee was great, the doughnuts were fresh, the service was friendly. But I have grown so fondly of this one little shop near me, that DD didn't really measure up this time.

Our favorite Korean store-small but has everything we need. I love their Kimchee because it's not as sour as other stores. And they're so friendly here! Their snacks bring a bit of nostalgia of childhood. I'm not Korean but hubbs is and he likes coming here. We don't get produce or meat here because it's a bit pricey.

I've only been here once for lunch, but Chopstix didn't leave much of an impression on me. It's not particularly authentic Chinese food, but I don't think they pretend to be either. Lunch entrees are around $8 and include basics like General Tso Chicken and Mongolian Beef.

Good food, good service, good atmosphere. You won't be disappointed here. My food was good, but my boyfriend's pork shoulder was amazing. Also, we started with the mac and cheese appetizer which was wonderful- the best mac and cheese I've ever had (sorry, mom.) They had a good selection of wines and a very romantic atmosphere :)

I've had good experiences at Eye encounters over e past 3 years- my exams have been thorough, where each step is explained to me. It's not a fancy place, but it's clean, the people are nice, they get the job done and it's in walking distance to my job. Who needs fancy?
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
LOVE this nail salon. Got a pedi today and the service was spectacular. I recommend making an appointment, they were a little busy when I went, but fit me in in about 15 minutes.

The staff are nice and sociable. Which is always a huge plus. I'll definitely be going back again soon!

3.5 stars.

cute!  not amazing and not life-changing but it is good. I came here for my birthday last year and the service was really great! I really can't remember much about the food, which is why I can't round up to 4 stars.  I do remember that the seafood pasta was pretty good.

About average for a Marriott ap property. 

Restaurants here were decent, nice bar area. Omelete was a little undercooked but the buffet overall was good.  I would stay here again as the rooms are comfortable and reasonably well appointed.  Good value for the money.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Caffee Maida is located right on Butler Ave.  When the weather is nice I love to sit out front and people watch.  They have a very limited selection of deserts.  I wish they had more options to choose from.  Their cannoli's are filled to order and I do enjoy them.

Dettera illustrates the huge transformation Ambler has made over the past 10 years.  The decor is reminicant of a center city restaurant and so are the prices.  The food and beverage selections are diverse but I still feel they are charging too much.  Even though Dettera has the feel of the city its still in Ambler.

A local hole in the wall dive bar that I love!  Cisco's is a small bar located right on Bethlehem Pike across from the Sunoco. The bar's walls are lined with old photos of Jim Cisco.  They are known for their cheesesteak hoagie.  Its an actual Italian hoagie with steak meat on top.  Its a small sandwich but a tasty one.

Called to book here and the room was more than available.  Played phone tag for 24 hours and finally emailed instead to avoid delaying signing a contract and all of a sudden the room was being booked by Pepin for the exact date and time we were looking for.  Totally unprofessional and wasted our time.

I love this place. In this day and age it's tough to find an old fashioned barber shop. So I gladly, every 6 weeks make the trip out and get a great hair cut.

The conversation between the barbers and clientele,especially when it comes to sports, moves along from chair to chair and it adds to the experience.

I agree this place has gone down hill.. it's in need of a major refresh and is just dark and feels dirty.  Service is still super fast though, even during the packed lunch rush hour. 

Good news is, they're getting a refresh!!  Moving across the street to the old KFC, coming soon!

I've only ever gone through the Drive Thru at this location and I've never had any problems.  They're super fast, even with a long line.  The McD's on Olive does it better though with the dual ordering windows.  I've never had problems with them getting the order right or overcharging me.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Pretty good Resturaunt next to the airport greeted almost immediately.
Waiter came to get our order fast.  After dropping off our food he returned within a few min to ask how our meal was and if we needed anything.  Good kid!!!! The food was pretty good but not spectacular but still right for the price

Airport bar/food. Always busy because of travelers . Food mediocre at best. Staff hit and miss. Not much to say. If it wasn't in the airport they would seriously have to step there game up but since your trapped with no other place to go it works. The potato chips are good. Don't get the sliders. Not good. Burnt frozen patty's.

Stopped in for lunch a few weeks ago.  We ordered the 2-roll lunch special, but ended up getting brought the wrong rolls... twice.  When we finally got our correct order, the rolls were small and pretty sub-par. They get a second star because they let us keep the rolls that they served us by mistake, but I won't be back.

A friend of mine was guest bartending one evening, so I decided to give PH a shot. All drinks were half price (hell yes)! I think the appetizers were cheaper also, but I vaguely remember eating the hummus since I was pretty drunk. The atmosphere wasn't my usual, but it was cool mingling with Philly's 9-5er's.

Refer to Sarah B.'s review. 

P.S. This was my request on open table, and confirmed over the phone: "I would like to request the most baller view in the restaurant. Thank you for your accommodation." 

The view was not close to being baller, or semi-baller. We were seated in a tucked in section of the empty restaurant.

I never dined in or tried anything off the menu here. Just dropped by to pick up a bag of their Red Velvet coffee beans!! Simply Amazing!!!

Brew a pot in the morning. And you'll see why the coffee alone brings this joint to a 4 star in my book!  AND DONT BE CHEAP On the coffee when brewing to give a nice bold pot!

The place is tucked in a corner of a small convenient store. But don't let the appearance fool you...their pineapple & pork tacos (earlier I said burritos, but i meant tacos) are so delicious. Prepared the way it should be...double corn tortilla, chopped onions, and cilantro.

Really nice service.  I was feeding a crowd so ordered about 6 pizzas.  Delivery was fast.  Ingredients seemed good quality but for some reason the crust, to sauce, to toppings ratios were off and the sauce needed a bit more flavor/oomph.  I'd try again though as I don't think one time is a fair shake if it was at least decent.

Pastabilities was recommended to me and my friend.
We went.  We ate.
As my mother used to say, 'If you have nothing nice to say, then say nothing at all'.
I prefer Attilio's Ristorante & Mrs. Rubino's when in Wilmington, DE area.
My friend was adamant about me putting only 1 star, but I couldn't .
The End.

Delicious!  They had a few different flavors than the last time I was in.  I love being able to sample before I serve.  I tried the banana and it was like Whoa! Holy imitation flavoring.  So instead, I went with red velvet cake.  It was so good, even my pup liked it.

Disappointed. Loved it other times but this time, if you move the seat move it back. I still can't get it adjusted the way I had it!! Having sneezing fits from all the towels fibers left in my not so clean car... maybe it's why everyone just sitting around.

I phone ordered the large Fried Chicken Salad for carryout. The person on the phone was efficient and polite. The food was ready for me when I arrived in 10 minutes during the lunch hour. 

The chicken was excellent and I really liked their chunky bleu cheese dressing. The salad was huge. Great value!

i find it terribly lame that folks are losing it so much about the rising rates...are we not in a bit of a shit economy right now? yeah..thought so.

for those going with zipcar--remember this--they will raise the rates once they push out the little guy (PCS).

Clean, decent service and the parking it's more them adequate. 

In my experiences the food has been hot. My order has so far been correct. 

Get the new fries, which are much better then the old ones. Onion rings are always a good option especially since not to many places actually have onion rings on the menu.

We only went here because my husband had a gift card.  The burgers were decent and the fries were good.  A step-up from McDonalds but not as good as SmashBurger.  And $15 for two burger meals.  I don't think I would have spent that much for some so-so burgers if I didn't have the gift card.

This is an upscale grocery near Butler University area. The pricing is moderate and seems comparable to Whole Foods.  Distinctive features are the homey decor, and a fresh peanut and almond butter maker that the son in particular likes to use.   Parking lot seemed tiny to me for a grocery store!

the decor and food here was pretty good. the absolute best was the stuffed veal and their "famous" calamari, which could easily be a meal in itself. also comes with 3 different sauces. it's a pricy meal but it's Half price only btwn 4-7pm, $2 vodka drinks and that made it taste so much better

Not my favorite Courtyard.  The wifi is painnnnnnnnnfully slow and the gym is very small.  The treadmills are practically on top of each other and the equipment is out of date.  For business travellers, the food options nearby are scarce.  There is a Wegmens right down the street but that's about it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Came for a late and light lunch on a sunny Friday afternoon and was seated indoors but with a wonderful river view at this laid back establishment.  A couple of nice salads along with a couple of pinot grigio hit the spot.  Service was very friendly and efficient.

Bottom line - we will return.

Not bad. Not great. Just OK. I didn't think their rolls were very inventive (they have most of the standard ones: california, philly, rainbow, dragon, veggie, etc.). The prices are pretty decent and reflect the quality of the food. I would go other places before coming here.

In an area where good pizza is hard to come by, Salerno's is probably the best bet in Lawndale/Lawncrest.  Their regular pies are serviceable, yet they dont even approach transcendency.  

The Sicilian Tomato pie is the way to go.  This is the only thing that I order from there and it never disappoints.  I love it.  GET IT!

Hikari is a cute sushi establishment in No Libs.  I have been here twice.  Service is efficient and the atmosphere is nice.  Both times that I have gone I have stuck to their rolls.  Nothing has been "bad," but none of the rolls have blown me away either.  It's not my first choice for sushi, but it does the trick.

Slow. Prepared to wait up to 5 hours for an oil change.  They get backed up.  I got stuck waiting because I had to have them adjust my belt.  They apparently forgot to tighten it when they replaced my old one.  6 hours later, I was on my way.  Prices are average.  Service people are fairly nice, but there are better options.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This place used to be great for cheap, strong drinks, but not when the asshole (owner?) is bartending. Any mix drink is measured as a half a shot. When everyone in my party complained, he got all pissed off at us. I mean, its seriously laughable how little alcohol was in these drinks.

I'm giving this Starbucks a two star only because the set up and slower staff make the line consistently long. They make decent Starbucks drinks, but if there's a line, it will take you a bit longer to get your drink. If you're rushing to get on a flight, do NOT go here unless there's no line.

A nice local coffee shop that's often got a steady stream of regulars. Despite this, they are always quick, attentive, and friendly.  It's always clean and inviting inside, but they've got seating outside, too, which is a bonus on beautiful days when you'd like to take your time enjoying your coffee and the day.

A great addition to the Oldsmar resaturant scene. I always liked Sushi Alive, and the owners/menu are one and the same. Lots of great specialty rolls, friendly service. Yoshi Roll and Pink Lady Roll are two of my favorites. They also have sushi happy hour and specials after 9pm for those late-night sushi cravings.

I enjoyed dinner last night at Mazara. The service was friendly and fairly quick, though the restaurant was only about 1/3 full. I tried the beer & cheese sound and Tutto Mara, both were wonderful. The bar area looks fairly nice too, but beer selection is limited. This is a restaurant I would try again.

Sandy at Rapunzel's Beauty Salon is wonderful with my 2.5 year old son. We come in monthly to get his hair cut and she does a great job, while making the cut as least traumatic for him as possible. It takes her about 10-15 minutes and we are off! I'm glad she is close by when our lil guy needs a clean up!

$20 oil change is as good as it gets.  i'll be going back here for that service.

they installed my muffler as well and it was fair.

they were pleasant and professional.  the only gripe i had was that i made a follow up call to see how the vehicle was progressing.  wish they had taken that initiative.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Our friendly neighborhood Starbucks... good place to meet friends OK for business associates ... She's been there FOREVER and survived the downsizing from a few years ago (thank God)... but her age is showing, could use some new furniture or even a remodel, but we LOVE her

Had lunch here a few weekends ago.  Love the decor.  The deep violets, black trimming, chandeliers - so chic.

Great sushi, great service, great price. Best Udon Soup I've had in town I think. 

Nothing much to say except it had a great selection of sushi and soups on the menu. Go try it.  You'll love it!

No thanks on the food - pizza is somehow doughy & gummy at the same time... oh and if you go pick up you will likely lose your appetite - it's filthy, the guy behind the counter was dripping sweat and soft core porn was on the TV (I wish I were kidding)...

Not bad. The service was decent and the food was okay. But that's the problem. Because of all of the positive reviews, our family was expecting much more. The kids didn't even finish their pizza (1 slice respectively). It's worth a try but it's no Dewey's--one of our family's favorite pizza places.

Stopped in for a drink/nightcap after an earlier dinner. Donal (sp?), the owner remembered me from an earlier visit and I give him props for that. Friendly bartender and a good selection of beers guarantees a return visit. One of our party didn't like their Yuengling draft and I have to agree that it was a little offputting.

I came here as part of a wedding party rehearsal dinner, and it was a very nice venue for that person. I had the gnocchi, which was very good. The only drawback that I noticed was for a party of 50 some odd people, they only had three servers for the event, which made the service a little slow and confused.

I think Japanese food is the type of thing where once you've had the good stuff you're ruined for the lower quality version.  This place is popular and people seem to love it, but to me the sushi is not that great.  The nice thing is the price isn't outrageous, as Japanese food often is.

Excellent!!! Great spot for lunch! We were able to be in and out under an hour which is great for a business lunch and the food was so good. You didn't feel like you have to compromise food for time. Very good Valeria's salad. The grilled chipotle shrimp was excellent. Definitely want to come back to try more menu items.

It's an OK place - upsides: it is close to Broadway, good restaurants  and Grand Ole Opry. Downsides: The "restaurant" has a very limited menu selection, the windows in the rooms USED to open, but no more....screwed shut. Makes things kind of claustrophobic.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've only been here twice but it's quickly becoming my favorite sushi in the city. Fish is very fresh, rice is above average, presentation is top notch, and the speed of service is very quick. They have great lunch specials too. Keep a lookout, they do groupons every now and then.

Great atmosphere, best professional men's haircutters in town & relaxing hot shaves.  If you've been going to the place down the street (or on Fulton), do yourself a favor and book a cut and/or shave with Mike, Nathan or Sarah at Bearded Lady!  You'll thank me later!!

The quality is good but the prices are expensive. I guess if you are into all you can eat, the value is there.

I was not psyched about the cutesy movie themed names for their rolls. This was distracting.

The service was a little distracted and scattered. 

I will probably go back and give them another chance.

I stayed here for NYE '08 with about 5 others. They had a NYE party package deal where there was bands, food, karaoke, and so on. It was actually a lot of fun! The rooms are nice here and room service is good-and goes pretty late too. I would reccommend this place to someone visiting downtown STL.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Double Shots Espresso Bar is a very nice cozy place. The coffee is way better than star bucks, and they have a descent selection of bagels, scones, and pastries.

I did see an internet sign, but I'm not sure if it's free or pay. If you are waiting to get your passport done across the street, this a nice place to go.

This is your typical local pizza shop.  Don't come here for exceptional pastas, but you can definitely expect HUGE portions.  

personally, i enjoy getting their cheesesteaks. 

my main gripe is the limited seating available.  if you want a more family oriented place, see my review on Bravo's 5 minutes away.

Its a pizza parlor. Simple slice pizza, and bottled drinks available make for a 5 dollar lunch and a comfortable eating experience when you just want a slice. Not the best pizza in the world but not the worst. They also have sandwiches and salads, neither of which I have tried yet.

What makes this Dunkin Donuts worth stopping in, is not the coffee donuts or sandwiches but the great service by the people behind the counter. Become a regular and by the time you negotiate the long lines in the morning, and your order will be ready for you before you even order it.

Delicious breakfast!  Stopped in before our sons baseball game and we were pleasantly surprised by our yummy breakfast. We enjoyed the breakfast sandwich, a breakfast burrito and a bagel sandwich. All were served hot and quickly. All were great!  Cappuccino was great too!

It's not my favourite pizza place in town. But in a pinch, and especially when it's getting late and other places are closed, Boston Pizza is fine.  I like the Zorba the Greek pizza - tomatoes, olives, onions, bell peppers, feta and mozzarella.  Very satisfying when you're very hungry.

One of the best hotels in the St. Louis Area by far. A bit pricier than most, but it was new, nice and clean. They had Philosophy bath products when I was there not L'Occitane, but I love Philosophy. The beds were Tempurpedic or that style. The room had character and I certain would stay there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Awesome sushi, sashimi, hibachi etc. In a super convenient location (if you are staying near the Doubletree). Staff was very friendly and selection was huge. Spicy Tuna for me with a special Geisha Roll. Just the ticket after a night in the Quarter or at the Casino.

I wish every hotel was at least this nice. Newer hotel with big rooms. Separate work, sleeping, and lounge are in each room. Wet bar with microwave, refrigerator etc. Nice touch is including paper plates and plastic utensils for those eat-in nights. Super clean and very nice staff.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Update- Haven't been inside since my review in '08 but do use the drive thru.   It's always a pleasure because the staff is super friendly.     I don't know if there has been new management or better training since '08 when I gave it a poor review.   But no complaints about the drive thru service.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Very warm staff and awesome food. Great new addition to the Central West End and have already been a few times since this place has opened.  Papardelle is incredible. Make sure to save room for dessert!!! All of their desserts are to die for. Can't wait to try them for brunch :o)

See, this yelp is hard to write because I had so much fun the first night I went.  Met some fun people and had a blast.  I've been there a ton of times since and it's just okay.  Some nights are better than others.  The bartenders all have been wonderful, especially John on Mondays.  Definitely a place to go, however.

It's a really silly reason as to why I hate this place but they NEVER stir your coffee. I get an iced coffee with mocha syrup, cream, and sugar.  All of that shit stays on the bottom and I'm pretty much drinking milk. Only Dunkin donuts I've ever been to that doesn't freaking stir their drinks.  Weird, I know, but I hate it!

I dont like when bars do not accept credit cards.. that's just me.  It is a clean place and a fun neighborhood bar but the location is bad. It is RIGHT on the Roosevelt boulevard.  I picked up many a drunk wandering into the street.  Now, obviously this is not Rhawn Pub's fault.. but it is unsettling.  It is honestly just okay.

I had the chicken parm from the lunch menu. Perfect crunch and the right amount of cheese while still maintaining a juicy chicken breast. Excellent.

And the side of pasta with marinara sauce was also very tasty.

i have also tried the chcken milanese and the gnocchi; 
Great italian food.

Chaya is to Pittsburgh as Sakura is to Indianapolis. Both are equally great sushi restaurants in their respective cities, and the fish is always great! Cons would be the price, but if you're going to have sushi, you should pay a higher price for the quality.

I have been trying to like this place for years and I think I just gave up. The atmosphere is really nice though, always seating available and I love the floor booths along the wall by the sushi bar. The staff is always friendly but the sushi just doesn't hit the spot for me. Pretty mediocre.

This place is AMAZING.  I actually started a Yelp account to say how great this salon is.

I like to cut my hair short, and have had a few epic disasters doing so.  Now, I won't go anywhere but Aspara (and Mo) because every cut has been perfect.  She has a vision, and I look all the better for it.

This is our neighborhood Mickey D's and we love it.  The one time we had a big issue, the Manager got in touch with me personally and worked very hard to correct the problem.   We use the drive through and the folks there are polite and the service is usually pretty quick.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Great places to go and get your nails done in the city.  Fair prices and easy to find parking.  I would definitely make a reservation if you plan on going in the evening.  If you go early in the morning, you can usually be taken right away.  They do an excellent job!

This is the only decent restaurant I've been able to find on this somewhat sad stretch of fast-food-infested Dickerson.

I had a great Polish sausage with peppers and sauerkraut, for a great price. Everyone was super friendly, and they have outdoor seating that's dog-friendly! Great place!

A beautiful location seems to have them resting on their laurels, while skipping all the way to the bank from the OVER priced, just ok food. Was really looking forward to liking this place, and am a little heart broken over feeling I had been extorted from. 

Their going to have to have a MAJOR event to get me back in the doors.

I didn't expect to hear Michael Jackson and 80s music inside this country western themed place, but we had a fun time on a Saturday night.  The place was packed, the bartenders are pretty to look at and it's fun watching people get tossed off the mechanical bull.

We only came here because everywhere else in the hotel is closed. Our whole group was too tired to get a taxi and go somewhere else.

But the food here was not bad at all. I loved the fillet Mignon. It was tender and juicy!

The sauce was a rendered down Cabernet sauce which was so good and rich.

It's pretty icky---the buffet is terrible.  However, I must admit that I like the mongolian four dish-its quite good.
This is not the chinese buffet to go to.  I was quite disappointed on the search for good chinese still and if anyone tells me they love Panda Express I may have to hit you because that to me is just as icky.

The hotel looks a little old; but I would have to say newer GM Daniel V. really has the place looking good.  The staff at the front desk was nice and the pool area is great.  Santa Barbara is a great city to visit and this is a reasonable hotel in a good location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
It's a train wreck of a meal that you just can't keep yourself from hankering from time to time. Give in, get that Triple Whopper, and remind yourself why you don't go there. 

It gets three stars because the only thing sadder than eating at Burger King is complaining about eating at Burger King.

Worst bank ever. Was getting charged overdraft fees on purchases structured so I went overlimit because of their shady practices. By the way, there is a class action law suit vs B of A because of this; they did it to thousands.  I'll never bank with them again.

There is a lot of hype about this place, and sadly, it doesn't quite live up to it. All of the pieces are close but fall just a little short. Crust is pretty good, but the sauce fails to deliver any type of flavor. Overall it was a little disappointing as "great pizza" but if you expect an average pie, it will do the trick.

This place has ALMOND MILK, which may not mean a lot to some, but it's a huge deal to non-dairy snob such as myself. We came here twice; helped once by a very nice gentleman and again by a still-nice-but-less-nice lady. Both times the coffee was very good, even by my ridiculous Bay Area "third wave coffee" standards.

PROS: Good sushi, spacious, decent/fast service
CONS: Expensive!

The sushi here is solid. It's not blow-my-mind amazing, but the prices are a bit higher than I expected for the quality and portion size. I'd say Zama is your typical better-than-average-albeit-pricey sushi spot.

Cash only and sorta divey. We stopped by before a movie for a quick drink, ordered a Kenzinger which tasted bitter and not quite fizzy enough, my date had a golden monkey that was also on the tap which did not taste the same way it usually does.

Cash only, go to the Irish Pol instead.

Went there with my wife for dinner, her salad came and gone before my food came, basically we both had the chance to watch the other eat. Although the service was lacking, the food was good. If this is how they normally serve, I would avoid this place for a first date.

I didn't think this place was particularly great. It was decent. I just got a sushi roll. I did ask for extra ginger, and they gave me a very generous portion. Service was good. The waiters are friendly. I liked the kale juice they give you after you're done eating. That was something that sets this place apart from the others.

This place looks familiar... like from some TV show or something. Hmm.

Anyway, decently priced drinks, interesting variety of music, also pool & darts, but as others have mentioned, oh so smokey. It was nice to go outside and get some fresh air after this bar on our Metry bar crawl.

Always my go to place for eye exams.  Located inside LensCrafters at Tyrone Mall, Dr. Fisher is the best optometrist I've ever been to.  Personal, friendly, and accurate.  Always willing to do what's right.  

Adrianna at the front office is exemplary, sweet, attractive, and super nice.  See my tip for her quote of the day.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Ohhh, where to start? Staff was okay, not friendly, but not hostile either. Miso was waaaay too salty, with not enough tofu or seaweed and no green onions. Ginger salad was okay. Edemame was the best thing we had. Sushi was the blandest I've ever had. 

At least it's cheap, but you get what you pay for.

The coffee is always good at DD, but this site has the worst service. The donuts are always stale and if your in the drive through make sure you get your change. I think they tip themselves with your jingles.
     I gave them 2 stars because of the coffee. Nothing else. Oh and the ice-cream , although the ice-cream is expensive.

Super friendly baristas (which is becoming a rarity on the SBucks front)! The turkey bacon, egg white, cheddar sandwich was surprisingly delish! And the orange cranberry scones and dark roast were actually fresh here! All around solid SBucks on the Northside!

I love it! I can't make as many excellent points as some of the other reviewers, but I absolutely love 12th Street. The classes are especially great, and they have a ton of equipment within their labyrinth-like walls. Definitely a great price, good hours, and generally friendly people
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Love love love. Ok, so this place is where you go to get a drink and walk through Bourbon. It is your run of the mill bar. Kind of a young crowd but for $8 you can get a well poured long island. What else do you need?  

Friendly bartenders, fruity drinks and good prices. Check it out!

Wow, fast food is supposed to be a little faster than sitting in a restaurant and ordering right?  I've been in the drive thru for 10 minutes so far and I an still in front of the ordering box.  I just left the drive-through Lane, Burger King lost my business.

Sitting here right now and waiting. Service staff is too busy flirting to do their jobs. Place is mostly empty yet I had to listen to them chit chat for 10 minutes before I even got a menu. Sushi didn't taste super fresh but maybe I am just used to the west coast sushi.

Such a great place! The people there are extremely helpful and do a wonderful job. 
You won't get scammed into fixing something that isn't broken, or talked into unnecessary expensive maintenance.  My whole family has been going to Sooter's for 20 years, and no complaint yet!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Not sure what all the hatings about...

You stay here because they offer clean, consistent rooms, at reasonable (for the area) prices, in a GREAT location.

If you're expecting the Hilton or Hyatt...stay at the Hilton or Hyatt.

This is a mid-tier full service hotel that performs to expectations.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
love this place. our vamp tour guide took us up to the upper bar. a place you have to commit to to get to.

cherry bombs are lethal. midnight potion has everclear.

2 doubles 2 j&c = $18 not bad at all. hard core metal. on request. lovely lovely lovely atmosphere. well lovely if you are into that kind of thing.

(In the voice of the most interesting man...)
I dont always go to Starbucks..but when I do, I go here!

Great staff, Drinks always done correctly, friendly.
They have hipped me to a few different drinks.
Big fan of the Red Eye (bold coffee/shot of espresso)

As the mid-west weather drops, Bob Evans starts to creep into my conciosness more and more.
Ive recently been a big fan of their $20 family meals.
Roast turkey, gravy, (excellent) stuffing and bread (pumpkin for me please!)
Feeds four (or 2 hungry Stefans!)

Great for takeout, packed nicely.

I wish there were two entrances to the drive thru banking area and I feel like the drive thru and parking is ackward. Most people don't seem to mind judging by the numbers of cars frequenting this place everyday. I need to download that app so I can deposit checks with my cell phone. Think I'll do that right now.

Secret's out. 

M Bistro is offering a 2-course lunch for $10 M-F with complimentary valet. 

Went with some ladies last week, and the service was TOP NOTCH. I felt like royalty. I am convinced that New Orleans restaurants have the best service in the country. 

Treat yourself to lunch and eat like a queen for $10!
