Go to drink, not to eat. Everything we had was mediocre at best and the menu was not even creative. Typical burgers and sandwiches. If you are going to make a club sandwich, don't use thick packaged turkey. They need to make this good if it is this simple. 

Bar area was good and drinks were reasonably priced.

I would liken this place to a McDonald's of Mexican food, or more accurately, it's a really awful attempt at a Mexican version of Panera. Everything I ate here was just so-so. But hey, it was Mexican food, so I wasn't too upset. I would recommend something larger scale, cheaper or more authentic then this place.

Sometimes they are open and sometimes they have cars. Seriously- if you can rent anywhere else, go for it. This is just a convenient location, but the ups and downs in service here are just too one sided (in their favor) to ever make it a four star business or better.

Service doesn't come with a smile at this location.

Location is ok, not great. Having Bahama Breeze next door you would think is a good thing. We dined there and it stunk. So it's not a bonus.

This location has tons of hotels so I guess they feel they have trapped business.

Next time I'm in the area I'll try the Dunedin HIE
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This is the only Chinese restaurant I've found that simply will not accommodate someone with a shellfish allergy. They just say "Everything we make is cooked in the same oil; we can't use fresh oil; the oil has shrimp in it."

Other than that, I can't comment on the restaurant, because I can't eat there.

I didn't want double sided shears with teeth to be used on my hair. I feel like it makes it look thinner. The hairstylist insisted to "blend the ends out."
...you would only need to blend the ends out if you didn't cut properly. 
Can't complain too much. $20 and at least my dead ends are gone!

1 1/2 Stars.  Yeah, this is pretty much a modified version of the Olive Garden.  Definitely nothing authentic or quality about it.  But then, it's cheap-ish and convenient.  Not terrible.  At least it's not run-down and crusty looking inside or super BLAH-looking inside either like the OG.  Staff is nice and friendly.

The place is very nice with. Lots of kid-friendly things to distract them from the actual hair cut. We arrived on time (appointment only) and were seen promptly. 

The place is clean and the staff is very friendly. The haircut came out pretty well!

The place accepts cash or check only.

A nice little market.  It offers lots of things that the Acme across the street does not, like quality lunch meats, good South Philly Italian bread, real soft pretzels, and short lines.  The butcher counter here is surprisingly good.  I don't recommend the produce, however.

ad a great experience at Uptown. The eye exam was through and the fitting was was the same. The staff is super friendly and the doctor was as well. By the time I left, I think I had met everyone. Was told my glasses should be ready around 7 to 8 business days...Thanks Uptown Eyecare.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This salon has been one of the only salons for black men and women for over 15 years . Still in business and still running strong.If your looking for a salon that is completely familiar with ethnic hair this is the salon for you. Its the only one i go to!!!

I actually eat here at least once a month . The food is good and the service compliments it. You will fall in love with there zucchini muffins. I always leave with some stashed in my purse, you know for later. The prices are cheap and they have a fantastic frozen yogurt bar . with unlimited toppings. Have fun !! yum yum

As reliable and friendly a dry cleaner as I've ever used. The prices are good, the hours good as well, and the proprietor is always welcoming and helpful.

We've been getting our cleaning and tailoring done here for three years and all work has been excellent. So happy that we have them in our neighborhood.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
One word Tortas.  Went there on the Cinco de mayo celebration on Cherokee street.  Good service despite the huge crowds.  Andria was our server very good service.  

My date had the fajitas more than she could eat, they were very tasty.  

The margaritas got the job done.

Left a bad taste in my mouth.  One clerk was bad mouthing my road insurance for a significant delay, while I am hearing a listing of actions from my insurance listing who they talked to and when!?!  

They got it done in 1.5 hours.  But I could do without the drama and difficulty.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: They took along time to fill my Viagra (errr prescription) from New Orleans (errrr the bible belt southern state). Did I really type that!?!  Oh dear.  Seriously they have taken forever to fill this Rx.  They have had it since 5pm.  It is now730pm.  Really I can count by 3's or 5's faster than that!

Tapas 2 for 9... got meatballs n prochuito n cheese... pointless.. tasted microwaved...also ordered yheir polomoriano soup... said it had mozerella croutons...so it caught my eye... lies! It was tomato soup... waitress brandy was nice n friendly... and attentive... n place clean... food is half of ok.

The playplace smells like it hasn't been cleaned since it opened, I walked in there and started gagging. And it seem liked a junior high group was in there and taking up all the play space from the younger kids. But not a lot of room in the actual eating area so maybe blame that.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Good chinese, low prices. Works for me. Just wish they could figure out seasoning on the Mongolion beef. Regular for me is too hot, and then I asked for not spicy, and it was too bland, so then I said mild and it is still pretty hot. So gotta figure something out but overall the flavor is really good.

As with any car wash, the question is..  Does it clean my car?  Cool Springs Car Wash offers both Touchless Automatic or Manual Wash. I would say that my car was left LESS DIRTY, but by no means clean.  One advantage is it Accepts Credit Cards for Touchless

Delivers an "As Expected" make your own Burrito Chain. The bonus here is the Pineapple Salsa, which is really good and they also sell Las Paletas Gourmet Popsicles.

Overall my experiences here have been just fine. It's nothing to write home about, but you get what you come in for.

What? Maggie Moo's.. Me? There must be some mistake. I didn't go to Maggie Moo's!

Okay. I did.

Great place, though I'm sad they don't have 'Nilla Wafers.  Those are like Crack for me.  My secret recipe is called The King:

'Nilla Wafers
Cream Ice Cream
Peanut Butter
Banana

Outstanding place

Most Consistent Sushi.

I've been to many of the Sushi places in the Nashville area and I have to say this is my overall favorite. It might not have the flashy atmosphere of Ru'san, but you can always expect consistently good Sushi and a decent price.  Also one of the few places you can get Umeshiso.

I've been to Pie in the Sky with the girlfriend quite a few times. Service can be a bit slow sometimes, but the service is very friendly and the Pizza is delicious! 

We get the Shrimp Pizza, but have them remove the lemons and its incredible. If you are looking for a delicious specialty pizza this is the place to go.

I'm used to being able to write down my choices and hand it to the sushi chef or waiter. Fujiyama doesn't seem to be set up to allow for this and  It makes ordering more awkward trying to remember all the different numbers.  The sushi itself was good and the service was fine. I'm happy to have another good sushi place to visit.

I was actually surprised at how much I liked Pinkberry.  It's a very different taste than I was used to, but I found myself actually enjoying it.

I had the Original with Peanut Butter and the sour/sweet combination was delicious.

Beware, its not your usual Frozen Yogurt, but give it a try and you might be surprised like I was.

American Vision is the only place I could find rimless glasses that fit my wide face.  Although the prices are high, they are not outrageous for the products' quality. The service is friendly and efficient. I've gotten exactly what I want and, since it's my vision is the core of it, I'm satisfied.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
This is a brunch review only. Maybe this place is different for dinner.

But as far as brunch goes...

Lackluster food matched by indifferent service. A generic Restoration Hardware-style "space" of the kind that seems designed to part young professionals from their money.

The restaurant is in the middle of the Italian Market on ninth st. The restaurant is old school, red sauce place.  If that's the type of place your looking for it's ok.  But if your looking for something more lighter, clean flavored Italian this is not your place.  It's busy and on the smaller side.

Beer + grouper sandwich

That's all I can say

Beer + grouper sandwich

I mean, let's be honest... is there anywhere even REMOTELY good to eat on that strip of beach?  This place came close.  The beer was imported, good, and made me see pirates out on the outlet/bay...

Oh wait... that was a tourist pirate ship.  Snap.

I really like this Wells Fargo. I always find their service fast, polite and very efficient. 

I don't think that I've ever waited more than a few moments for service. 

I do with they had a larger safe deposit box area. Seems like those are always in under supply.

This felt like a KFC branch. Coincidentally the items that I ordered ALL turned out to be deeply fried- what are the chances?  I did not expect the mushroom ravioli to be deep fried, and the calamari, though expected to be fried, was so dry that I thought I was chewing rubber band. My teeth hurt from the experience.

Poor service AND poor food... for some reason I was excited for this place because they have a plethora of grilled and fried skewers.

They all sucked.

Not only that, the flounder and octopus they served us was rancid.

Gah, thinking about this place makes me angry.

The place is pretty decent but the best thing about this Silky's location is that it's right next to a Jimmy Johns.  Like Chad, I come here mainly because it's close by... and next to Jimmy Johns.

I"m a fan of the Elvis Pretzely... banana with chunks of pretzels for that sweet/salty dynamic.

This place got renovated with that "open air" feeling with only ONE counter section to keep you from wondering when WOULD they open that 2nd or 3rd tier (I still think we need a Yelp event big enough to warrant that...).

Friendly fast service and because of said open air layout, it's a heck of a lot cleaner too.

I've had lunch here a couple times now that I work nearby and they handle the crowd pretty well.  I haven't had any issues with my Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger with Everything order and I'm also going to say that this is one of the better Wendy's in the area.  I'd even skip over the one at 170 and Page to get to this one.

We found this place through yelp actually, after looking for the nearest place to Audubon park to get something to eat after our run. Amazing ice cream! There is a huge variety of interesting flavors - like the kind you'd normally see in a gelato place. So delicious and refreshing.

I've been going here for 5+ years and have never had a bad experience. The staff is really friendly and they always help me pick out frames that honestly look good on my face. I feel like they don't try to oversell me and I genuinely like going here. The optometrist is great and as long as I'm living here I'll go to Glasses Galore.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I tried the soft-shell-crab poboy here and it was good and way too big to finish. The service was a little slow, but the food was good and the group of people I was here with (6 total) all seemed to have a good time. This place is conveniently located within the Westin.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Always 2 barbers cutting.  great guys and good service.  Joe the owner is an aspiring health nut and he is always easy to strike up a conversation with.  signature service includes a wet/straight-razor shave on the neck and a scalp/ shoulder massage for $12!  nice!

I have been coming here for years. It is great if you want to see all the rich and famous of Santa Barbara, however the food isn't that good. The coffee is great now that they brought back Kona coffee and it is great for people watching. The rest of the food is blah although the salad bar is fresh.

I very much enjoy this place. Smoking is a blah point but everything else is great. We often go here as a family bc the Nachos will feed at least 3. I have heard great things about their other foods. Great location for ppl watching when sitting outside. 
Highly recommend :)

Great local place! I saw an article about places in Tampa that use local ingredients, and Refinery was at the top of the list. I came on a Sunday night, and they had live music on the deck. I had the burger, which was delicious, with fries, which were even better. Highly recommend!

I was in Nashville and wanted to try something different than prior visits. A friend recommended Sunset Grill, I read some Yelp reviews and chose the Coca-Cola short ribs. Let me just say that I wasn't disappointed and will be back in the future. We also ordered chicken quesadillas and my friend raved about the salmon.

I just can't say enough about this place. Awesome homemade tortilla chips, guacamole and salsa. The burrito's are always good and the prices are reasonable. They have a great drink menu including margarita's and mojito's. I crave Cafe America only a weekly basis - sooo good!

I've been going here since moving to Dtown over 5 years ago and have no regrets. The guys are great...they take the time to explain things and provide options. With their coupons, you can get good deals too. The only thing is they are very busy so you almost always have to make an appointment in advance.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Hands down the best sushi restaurant in Doylestown and the surrounding burbs. Ooka has a fun atmosphere and  inventive rolls that will blow you away. They also have habachi which seems to be great fun based on the loud laughs and oooo's and ahhh's coming from that section. The service is always spot on too!

This is more than a grocery store, the deli and dessert area have a great variety of items hot and cold. This is perfect for a pick up and go meals.

The store has a variety of deals from weekly to daily specials which change each month. It can be a little pricey otherwise so take advantage of shopping the deals.

great place. good location on Magazine, about 4 blocks from the Quarter. Free breakfast, which since Mothers is around the corner we didnt really partake in, but it looked good. friendly staff who were very helpful. our room on the 4th floor was quiet . i would give this 5 stars if it were in the quarter.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: For the price, it's hard to beat if you are craving a wide-variety of sushi that's made to order. The staff needs training on customer service though. Most of the time they look angry and/or just toss your order on the table. I'd recommend to spend the extra money and travel to Minado.

Great to see the old Arcelia's space back to life.  I guess it's been open about two weeks, I wasn't sure since there's no sign that I noticed.  Mostly Tex-Mex items done well - food was fresh and staff friendly.  Since I live in the neighborhood, I'll be back!

Food: 4 Stars
Service: 3 Stars

Love having Starbucks in any mall as it's an easy way for me to get a little kick while I shop. What can kill an experience is the speed of service and getting your order correct. Not sure how "Chai Tea Latte" translates to "Green Tea Latte", but whatever. :|

Great place for a quick bite.  Reasonable on pricing, great specials and the staff is great. I had never tried their buffalo wings and asked if I could try a sample and to my surprise was given one! Even though I was cheated an order of fries the last time I was there...I will return.

I am eating their $14, Poke Salad as I write this.  That's right, $14.  This is not the freshest or best I've had, but I don't really expect it to be.  Lakeview isn't really known for their restaurants.  

Consisting mostly of cucumber and a little seaweed, tuna, eel.  The sauce is a little spicy, which I like.

Went here for my sons birthday and the food was just OK.  Not like it use to be.  The server was friendly and got to us fast but didn't even know what we were talking about when we asked for mustard for my sons chicken strips.  When she did manage to find some it was a very old bottle and he said it tasted funny.

The parking is a little sparse, but food and service were great!  They have some interesting menu items -- things I wouldn't typically make at home -- and what we had was delicious.  It's a little noisy and a little pricey, but a good restaurant choice for a special occasion.

Came back three months later, and pretty much the same experience -- great food, very fresh. The upside was that we went on a Thursday evening and for some reason it was not very busy.  So, the food came out FAST.  Will definitely be back over and over again!

91/100 health score! Now that this is a Yelp feature, this is the first thing I'm checking, in particular with fast food. Service was quick and friendly, the food was fresh and tasty. 

Being in a high traffic area, I was worried about the restroom, but it was clean.

Fresh stuff, frozen, on a stick, for $3.  What's not to like?  The flavors are good and exotic.  I've had strawberry lemongrass , pineapple basil, mango ginger, and blueberry buttermilk.  All tasty, sweet, but not overly syrupy.  They are frozen rock hard, so no drips on a hot day.

Asaka has a sushi happy hour early evenings.  The rolls were fresh and came out FAST (it may have helped that we sat at the sushi bar).  The rolls were not very creative though.  I would like to see some more outrageous rolls there -- they were pretty basic.  The quality was fantastic though.

Basic Mexican food, quick, cheap, tasty.  There is nothing particularly stand out about this place, but the food is consistently good and the service is always prompt and attentive.  It's one of the few decent Mexican restaurants in Decatur Township, so if you are out that way, it is a definite winner.

I have been to other El Meson locations, and this one seems the worst in terms of food quality.  Service was good, food came out fast, but it just wasn't tasty.  Also, in a nearly deserted restaurant, they seated us right next to a table of ten, so we had to shout over them to be heard during our meal.  Skip it.

The language barrier is a communication issue here. We experienced a difficult time trying to communicate what we desired on our sandwich.
We ended up giving up out of frustration and accepted the fact it was not worth the hassle or stress.

We will go to another restaurant where our dollars are appreciated.

meh. for me the exciting ingredients didn't add up to amazing pizza--I could taste that it was in there but somehow for me it just wasn't greater the sum of the parts. Nice menu, good wine list, and wonderful outdoor seating area. Maybe it was an off night for the kitchen? nevertheless, not on my top return to list.

The waiting here is interminible. There is no getting in and getting out quickly, no matter why you are here. They do have good prices on frames and the BOGO deal (especially for kids) is good. But dang, the service is SLOW. The people are friendly, once you wait 45 minutes (in a near empty store) to talk to someone.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
A small restaurant, but well decorated.  Sushi offerings are pretty extensive- I think my favorite that I had this night was the sweet potato and cream cheese roll!  

Ahi tuna appetizer was good as well- super thin slices which I really liked.  

Prices are reasonable for the specialty rolls.  Service is good.

Typical Chinese fast food.  Not too pricey, and the dumplings and stir fry are good.  Wonton soup is sometimes ok, sometimes way too salty.

They have tables and chairs, but nobody actually uses them except to wait for their take-out.  Most of the time I go for delivery, which is good and generally arrives on time.

Like many tourist/museum food courts, this place was no different - in one word, expensive. With that said, they seemed to have some sort of concern for a nice variety AND healthy eating. It wasn't all just burgers, fries, and hotdogs - lots of salads, grilled fish, etc.

This Hampton Inn appears to be pretty new.  It was nice enough for a one night stay, room was clean, didn't hear a bunch of noise throughout the night and the staff was friendly.  Restaurants are about 3-4 miles away, so fairly convenient, but nothing within walking distance.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Pretty decent hotel breakfast here. My only complaint is that they didn't tell me that ordering a specially-made omelet would change my charge from $0 to $15. Nonetheless I needed breakfast before work, so I probably would have paid it anyway. I just think they should tell you these things.

Call me crazy. I like it. There is never a wait. Service is fast. It is not by any means gourmet or fresh. It's that guilty mexican food that is full of creams and sauces but I come here a lot with friends that live nearby and everyone leaves happy. Their Shrimp Chimichanga is good.

I have been here a few times and never had a bad experience. I like their large deck. The avocado and white cheese quesadilla is very good and unique and i get it everytime. Their margaritas are the usual. I would suggest getting  beer instead. Dos Equis. Because like most margaritas they are just so syrupy.

The staff at this Bank of America are friendly and efficient. The lines are never long inside and the ATMs at this location are well lit and both offer check deposit without the use of deposit slips or envelopes. It's not a stand out but it is a good location.

Papa Murphy's Oro Valley location is always speedy and efficient. The pizzas are freshly prepared and always taste great.They have a huge selection of different styles of pizzas from gourmet to thin crust to stuffed pizzas! I highly recommend their take and bakes over any of the Dominos or Pizza Huts out there.

This is a very fun bar!  Cheap drinks!  They serve food but we did not get any.
The bathrooms are very clean.  The staff is very nice.  
Karaoke every Thursday, Friday and Saturday 8pm-midnight with Chuck!  Such a fun time!
They have pool tables, table shuffle board, lots of TVs for sports.
It is an indoor smoking bar...

I had my wedding here in 2008.  Everyone was great and the wedding was wonderful!  On Fridays they have all you can eat prime rib and pasta bar.  The prime rib can be hit or miss, but the pasta is made right in the dining room with whatever ingredients you want.  We make reservations, but the dining room isn't usually full.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Small coffee shop with a casual and chill air.  There was room for us to sit, but I think others have stated, and I agree, this is a cozy place.

The Honey Latte was coffee with a thick froth and undercurrent of honey flavor that was perfect. A great find and thanks to our CM for his recent review that led me to HQ!

This was the largest Starbucks I've seen in Nashville.  It has a barstool area, table area, small conference room and an outside porch.  Service was on par with other Starbucks, meaning it was efficient and friendly.  It was cool but not cold and felt great after being outside in the sweltering summer heat.  Go Starbucks!!

With moderate customer service, and a constant high-pitched beeping in the kitchen, I tend to avoid McDonald's. It seems that every couple orders or so, they give you the wrong thing. Don't get me wrong - if greasy fast food is your thing, you will love their food. But you might not be so satisfied with their customer service.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: A neighborhood gem! If you're looking for a family-owned, authentic Italian food, this is it! Food is very delicious. Service is attentive. Remember to make a reservation by calling. They do not have online reservations via Yelp or Opentable. Also, this is a Cash Only restaurant. The portions are average in size and could improve.

Same product as the original location, but with a much roomier building and more parking space. I love it. If I can choose, I go with Master Street first. I love the coffee, but sometimes it is a little too bright for my soft palate. Gotta grow up, I know.

A decent enough selection to be the store I visit the most; but for the best deals and a more diverse selection, the one at 2nd and Girard is the best in town. The staff is hit-or-miss, but generally helpful. I don't often fine a wine expert at the store, though.

This place is where you need to get your post-warranty car fixed. Why? It's really simple: great prices, honest mechanics, and excellent craftsmanship. Not easy to find in town. Worth the drive if you live closer to Central Philadelphia. There's a reason they've been in business this long.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I only had the Pizza here but that was enough. I had the special which was 2 slices of plain piizza and a 20 ounce bottle of soda for $3.75 and it was sooooo good!!!!! The price could not be beat!!!!! I understand this little pizza place has been here 10 years. I am glad I found it!!!!!

I came this time to have a good meal and I wasn't disappointed!! Had a burger with chips and a salad and a side of fries. They really do have the best French Fries!! Burger was perfect as well. The salad was ten times better than the one I had at Nellie's down the street. Great service and the folks in the bar are friendly too.

Good chili and a cold beer, what's not to like! Nice place inside, spots on lots of TVs. Friendly staff to feed and liquor you up. Nice neighborhood vibe.

 I had to laugh that someone was offended by the no guns sign. Fear not son, this is Ashland City, not Afghanistan.

Okay I was told to try a Hand Grenade and it was my first stop. It is a freakin' strong ass drink, I will give it that. However, it was way too syrupy and overpowering. It also leaves a funky aftertaste in your mouth. The bartender was super nice here so that was one bonus.

My husband and I stopped here a few times for a couple of drinks. They have an upstairs and a downstairs. Upstairs you can chill on the balcony or be inside waiting people ride the bull. 

I'm a not a fan of the music as it is country. My husband on the other hand was loving it.

I just stopped in today for the first time. I got an iced tea and they brew each individual cup fresh. I had peppermint green tea but there were so many other teas thatit was hard to chioose. Delicious. The owner was really nice and I found out she bakes the muffins and cupcakes on the premises. I will be back to try the food soon!

I used to be a regular at this very same El Maguey, it is always hopping!  The last few times the food has not been that great and last time, service was horrible.

I'm a little sad to have to take this place off of our regular rotation, but it just doesn't seem worth it anymore.

Hell yes, Tony!
In the last few months the place has really stepped up with it with keeping the place tidy and the equipment in good shape.

They've added a now squat rack with a pull up bar that I will be using the hell out of. So, thanks to CHFC and their commitment to their members.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Eh, not one of my favorite type of restaurants. The steak and shrimp were overlooked but the rice was good. 

The food was filling and cooks were friendly to everyone and entertaining. The soda machine was down so drink options were limited. 

I wouldn't rush back here.

I've heard mixed reviews but always want to decide for myself. So glad I did. Loved just about everything about this place and can't wait to get back for brunch. Favorites were the Fried Green Tomatoes, fried chicken and bread pudding. The cocktails were amazing as well and server was extremely helpful and knowledgeable.

Close enough to home for us to try., so why not? Plus, I give the manager a plus for actually leaving responses to other Yelpers.. 

Sushi here is not bad, but it's not great.. Got the Sushi Deluxe, everything seemed good except for the salmon that left a very fishy after taste. 

Service was quick which I love.

Had the lambchops here, it was tender and juicy! Excellent. 

Do not recall any bad experiences here with wait staff or anyone. Take the streetcar for a nice ride if not, drive and find parking along the side streets, but be careful and do not park anywhere too dark. 

Tables have breadsticks, but try to not fill up on this.

I tried to go to The Handle Bar on a Saturday night.  While most bars in Philadelphia have banned smoking, The Handle Bar still allows it.  The bar was so full of smoke that I could hardly see or breathe.  I had to leave immediately.

So, if you are a non-smoker, this is not the bar for you.

Went with a groupon, no problem. The groupon was for a 7 course meal. The courses were good but wouldn't say great. The service was friendly (close your eyes and you'd swear Al Pacino was your server) and efficient. Dinner included a carafe of Italian red. All in all a pretty good meal and we left stuffed and satisfied.

Enthusiastic service punctuates the varied and quite frankly delicious menu offerings. Unique cheeses, ahi tuna roll, granny smith apple celery soup and the dessert crisp with the vanilla gelato atop was a wonderful way to wrap up my meal. Than you chef. I will be back soon. Best meal Ive had in Philly.

Thank you, for having everything I ever need. From new bike tubes, to beer. 
Thank you, for always being friendly, having crappy poboys, and keeping the place relatively clean. 
Thank you, for taking the time and trouble and kicking out the drunk guy who harrasses everyone. 
Please, open on Sunday.

I decided to try this place based on the Yelp reviews and was disappointed.  I ordered a plain pie and it was extremely doughy/chewy but not in a good way.  It was a bit difficult to eat and it was extremely oily.  It also did not reheat well the next day.   I'll pass on this pizza joint in the future.

I tried the vanilla frosted w/sprinkles and while the donut was a bit better than what DD would serve, it was by no means life changing.  My favorite local donut shop is Yum Yum in Colmar and this donut just didn't taste as fresh as the ones Yum Yum serves.  The donut should have been softer and I wish the icing tasted more unique.

I'm little disappointed with the sushi roll selections (really sticking with the basics) but the fish has been consistently fresh. The service is great, my hot green tea runneth over...and the prices are very reasonable. Very cute and fun little place in the Mesa.

Actual phone conversation...

"Jack's"
"Hi!  Do you have any appointments available for today?"
"No!" Hangs up.

End of conversation.  That's it.  I guess Jack's got more work than he can handle.  Or maybe he just has a problem with phone etiquette.  Either way, adios.

It's an old school building but the same old Arby's food.  The staff is really trying, but its still only three and a half stars due to location, condition of the building, and the friendliness of the staff.

Drive thru is not usually busy, so that's a good thing, and the Roast Beef is also a good thing.

I'm sorry, but there's absolutely no way that your shake machine has "just gone down" or "locked" EVERY SINGLE EVENING I've come by over a period of months. Seriously, months. 

Just be honest & tell me you don't want to clean the machine so I can just plan to go to Steak & Shake.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Tucked away in middle of industrial park in southside. But cozy atmosphere and they do a fantastic medium roast.  I'm a coffee snob so look for roasting expertise as primary thing, and they're right up there with Cartel and Savaya in my opinion, and they have their own roast profile distinct from the others.  Give them a try.

Eh. The food isn't bad, but I feel they try too hard to be 'different' than the other AYCE sushi joints in town. Cilantro? Mango? Macadamia nuts? Umm, alright... I guess so.  

The service was pretty good and the sushi was fresh, but overall, a rather uneventful lunch.

OK, I should have read reviews here before eating here. The "chef spitting on the grill" thing is just way over the top.

I found the food to be "just OK". Nothing to write home about. 

Most Chinese food on the east coast pretty much sucks. So it's par for the course.

This place is take out ONLY.

OK, I should have read reviews here before eating here. The "chef spitting on the grill" thing is just way over the top.

I found the food to be "just OK". Nothing to write home about. Menu is mostly "Americanized Chinese", nothing truly authentic.

The food was ok at best. The salads were probably the best part of the meal. However, the service was really slow, it took about an hour to get our meals and then they brought us cold coffee after the meal. Would not recommend thus place due to it's high prices and average food.

Convenient, friendly staff (which is HUGE for this city), very approachable prices (I only looked through wine). Primary bummer is the lack of selection (again, in wine) and variety. This store is well-stocked, but solely with easy to find labels.

I can imagine it does a steady business with the BYOB places nearby.

This is the cheapest hotel in the SB / Carpinteria / Goleta area.  The staff was nice and accommodating. So much so, that when I asked to change rooms because the room we were originally given reeked of cigarette smoke they ended up giving us a less stinky room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This place is pretty decent considering there isn't much around this area.    

Their floor set up is sort of strange.  I enjoy coming here once a year (during Christmas) visiting family!  One of my favorite item on the menu is their Fried Chicken!  Yummy!!!.

After undergoing renovations, this location is simply not the same.

The new staff seem to be more engaged in their own conversations instead of helping patrons... 

Also, the availability of stock isn't the best. The salmon spread is almost always out of stock whenever I'm around, even at 8 in the morning. How can this be?

Back in Vancouver, I would typically go out for sushi three times a week. So when I moved to Edmonton, I started to go through withdrawal. I decided to check this place out. While it wasn't horrible, the sashimi didn't taste very fresh.  This is probably a great place if you plan on sticking to maki or cooked rolls.

Let's start with the guy behind the counter being sour. Then sprinkle the fact that this is the ONLY Subway I have EVER been to that didn't serve fresh avocado as a choice for your sandwich. He proceeded to explain to me "Yeah, this subway is weird like that!".

very knowledgeable chap that looked like a cross between a lost sailor and a roadie rocker from the 70's led me to some amazing wines i had never tasted on the west coast that led me to buy more on my trip.

what is v raving about:
2012 alexandria nicole pinot gris
2012 lone birch pinot gris

I became a fan of Ruby Tuesday again over just recently. I thought their service had went down but THEY ARE BACK and with a vengenance. I love their Peach Tea with the fruit it in it is delicious. I got their grilled chicken sandwich but was very plentiful.

Came here for a quick bottle of wine and was too lazy to go downtown to Crown or Kahn's. So...finally went here after living in the Square for two years. I agree with Ben. I got booze. They got money. That's it. The lady was kind and we had a small conversation. I would come back for that quick booze pick-up.

So dirty inside. We tried to find a place to sit before ordering the kids some food. And there wasnt one clean seat or table. Not only is there trash everywhere but the table have dried up food stains and it smells like a dumpster inside. We had to leave to take the kids somewhere else. Disgusting.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We always stop by Club Decatur when in New O.  Several flat screens to watch sports, nice outdoor patio, about 20 beers on tap, bartenders are friendly - gave us tastes of several beers, $5 call drinks, great pizza by the slice.  I think they recently replaced the bar top and furniture.

I really wanted to like it, but the burger just wasn't tasty. The meat didn't have much flavor, and was tough and dry, which is remarkable given how greasy the burger was. The sauteed mushrooms were great, but not enough to balance out the burger. Maybe the kobe beef burger's better?

Had the all you can Eat sashimi. Sushi was fresh but the lady behind the counter was a one woman show. She was the only attending everyone at the bar. So she only took orders one at a time. selection was ok but I just felt we did not have the attention and we had to wait each time to order.

First off this is Supercuts, so I wasn't expecting a luxury salon experience.

That being said, the $18 haircut (long layered trim lasting about thirty minutes) administered by Arlene was perfectly fine. 

She chatted in a friendly and genuinely interested manner and gave me a more than adequate cut. 

I would definitely return.

Now this is New York style Pizza. You always hear down here in the south "There's no good pizza here" well that's bullish?t. Go here and eat and you'll be happy you did. The owners are really nice and the waitress's are there for your every need. I'd highly recommend.

Estela's is solid Mexican food. The burritos and tacos are good as well as the refried beans. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is for the simple fact that I ordered a Margarita in here and they brought me  Pina Colada...really???? Isn't the margarita your go to drink? Other than that all is good.

Clean self-service car wash station. The wash bay I used seemed to be in excellent working order. My only complaint is that the water pressure could be turned up on the power washers. I'm not 100%, but it seems like other self-service car wash stations I've used give you more time for your money.

Very cute little restaurant in Chestnut Hill, servers were very courteous, attentive and knowledgeable. We had the 7 course tasting and weren't so impressed and did not feel it was worth the price. There were a few shining dishes like the Wagyu beef, but overall we left wanting more. We will have to try the regular menu next time.

I dig this Starbucks. They have huge tables and some are communal tables that you share with others so if you are anti social, don't sit. Baristas are quick and super friendly. I think I saw on the door that they are open until midnight each wk--unheard of!

Went back to this place after about a three month absence, to find that the ownership had changed. Now it was all lit up like a nightclub, playing weird rave music. The menu didn't change, but the flavor definitely has. Don't know that I'll go back, as I was a bit heartbroken.

When a grilled cheese is the last thing to come out to the table, you know something is up in the kitchen!  At the very least we had an attentive waitress, who checked in regularly, but hardly refilled water glasses.  Nothing special about this place at all.

Been going to La Locanda ever since it was first called Laceno. Every time we are there we are treated like family and served like kings. Every dish has something special. I have not found a bad dish nor had a bad experience there. I recommend it to everyone.

Excellent, fast and friendly service every single time. They get my mocha light frap right every time I go. I only go on my pay day, otherwise I would have gone bankrupt by now. BUT it is a nice treat, and the price tag is easier to swallow when my frap is delivered with a smile :)

Yum yum yum. This place is TINY which is why the line ends up out the door in the thick of summer. BRING CASH! They won't take your plastic.
If you need fro-yo try Jilly B's.
If you need more options try Masso's.
But this place is a wonderful neighborhood gem. Plus they top your gelati with an animal cracker :)

Rocco's gets three stars solely because I have to rate it above the Raven. While it's not the worst bar on that corner, it doesn't hold an alcoholic candle to either Bruno's or the Door's. Rocco's is usually too crowded, with too many youth, and too many people no one likes. Please, don't go here.

Parking is a headache but the interior of this Starbucks is large, with an array of tables, workstations, bar seating, and couches. You'll find lots of college students studying here, so it's a good place to be productive. One of the better Starbucks locations I've been to!

Fantastic!  Truely a great place to have lunch or bring a dinner date.  Outdoor tables in summer are hard to get but really deliver the urban neighborhood feel.  I work on the block so I have eaten at so many times it is hard to count, maybe 60, 70 times over the last few years.  It always delivers.  Enjoy!

Pro's and con's of gay pizza:

pro's-delicious when intoxicated, open far later then any other pizza place in center city, delivers late as well

con's-the pizza is really not that good, sober, and it's crawling after 1, which sometimes is interesting

my conclusion is, only come here when drunk

I was overall satisfied with them!  Each time I went they were helpful and friendly and it didn't take too long (between 5-30 mins) for them to get me a ride or a car. Toyota paid for my rental so I can't speak to prices or ease of payment, but with Toyota footing the bill I was in and out in seconds.

Food was really good and I love the El Niño drink. But don't come here if you like chips! If you want guacamole, salsa, and queso you have to pay separately for each sauce-- We spent upwards of 16 dollars on chips and dip! I think most places give you complementary salsa or at least have combo deals...

GREAT GREAT GREAT !!!!

Im very picky about starbucks i used to be a starbucks barista 
and this location rocks always friendly always the correct drink ( or fixed right away ) they really show what most starbucks used to be and now this kind of quality is few and far between.

I can find no fault with this place.  The hair dressers are friendly and skilled and the salon is clean.  The only reason I probably won't go back is I ended up with more of a "style" than I was looking for.  It was a perfectly nice cut just seemed a little edgy circa 2007.

This is favorite Wine & Spirits Shoppe in the city. The wines are well stocked and nicely organized. And I've also had good luck of stopping by when they're having a wine tasting.

The staff is very helpful in answering an questions you may have. And Max is a sommelier that has always suggested the right wine to bring to a BYOB.

I go here every Sunday with my family, not by choice really. I have a different opinion and think the prices are a little high, for the rather average quality of food. This is obviously a South County staple. I can't say I would choose it on my own, without my family. I'd say C+ at best. Try IHOP.

Probably much better when you order a whole pizza. They are definitely making
pizza by the slice ahead of time and then reheating. Mine was very dry and overcooked. They seem to use quality ingredients and I might try it again with friends when I can order a whole fresh pizza.

The $8 Lunch menu was great. We had the pleasure to try it free however, because we had certificates for that lunch. The waitress was quick and attentive yet not in your face about the food. A very nice leisurely lunch spot. I believe there are certificates to be used there that yields great discounts.

I usually stay here when i come in for Spring Training games for the Yankees.  I love the place.  Close to the mall(awesome bars), they provide a ride to where you need to go.  The beds are super comfy, rates are reasonable.  And best for me, only about a 5min drive away from the ball fields.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Hotel is newer and modern. HUGE & meant for large conferences. The rooms are spacious and beds comfortable. Not a 5 star hotel but clean and modern-4 stars at the most. Staff is ok-nice but not too helpful or informative. Overall, good value for what you get.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Since moving to Reno, we've learned that there is a great selection of bars in the midtown area. We are usually visiting during non peak hours so service has been quick and the drinks made well. I tried a gin based drink (not my normal) to be adventurous and it tasted great. I only regret we didn't check out the deck on the roof!

My husband had dinner there last night for the first time.  We are not sushi people so we tried the teriyaki shrimp and steak.  Everything tasted great and there was plenty of food with the salad and soup the dinners come with.  The service was prompt and curtious, we will be back!

I like the fact that their burgers are freshly made. Sometimes they seem to be understaffed and can be slow. And when they are understaffed, the priority seems to be taking care of the drive-thru customers over the people dining inside. But it's usually worth the wait. And where else can you get chili to dip your fries in?

I eat here for the lunch special and its an awesome value. The food is good, and as a vegetarian, its nice they have tofu hibachi and vegetarian rolls that dont suck. For 10 bucks you cant beat it. Also, the service is really good and Gina does an awesome job everytime im there.

They actually had what I was looking for.  And that's always a good sign for a proper liquor store.  They had a huge selection inside.  Only downside was maybe the guy at the counter could've been friendlier, since we were the only females inside.  

Liked that the receipt said, "Thanks for having good taste."

Really good potato soup!  Lunch is reasonably priced.   I had the Asian Salmon Wrap, which is the most unique wrap I've seen on a menu.  Essentially, it was a lightly battered salmon fillet glazed in Teriyaki sauce wrapped with cabbage, cheese, and wild rice.  It was so filling, I could only eat half of it in one sitting.

Great lunch deal! Three rolls for about $10, but they weren't very memorable.  Next time I wanna hit up their all-you-can eat deal so I can try their different kinds of rolls with some friends.  

The decor could use a little work, and maybe it was because they just opened.  But the last lunch I had there, it was freezing!!

The garlic knots are fantastic! We also really enjoyed the cheesesteak egg rolls. I wanted to give them 5 stars but unfortunately they got our pizza order all wrong. We ordered a pepperoni pizza with extra pepperoni but when we got home it had zero pepperoni one it. It was still a good pizza but we were very disappointed.

After driving my Wrangler from PA to FL there was work to be done. The attendant really took extra effort to address the bug-covered grill and front window.
I always appreciate the free vacuums after the wash, although I think the suction could be better.
Flippers and I go back to my Valrico days. Always been a fan.

Yogorino is more of a gelateria than a place to get frozen yogurt. The staff said they are known for the one frozen yogurt flavor they offer, a relatively bland tart-less yogurt that tasted more like whip cream than anything else. Pinkberry and Red Mango are far superior.

Finally a decent challenger to Nomad with respect to Naples-style pizza, meaning thin crust, fresh ingredients, San Marzano tomatoes, and wood fired oven. We had the buffalo mozzarella and the cauliflower pizzas. Both were terrific. The interior is very welcoming as well.

The waitress kept skipping over people when taking their orders. Some people got their entrees before others had their order taken. My dad has his order taken after the second group of people got their entrees. Just weird. The food was underwhelming also. Had the rubber chicken pad Thai. Bad food, bad service. Not coming back.

This is now a Kinecta.  They're in the middle of nowhere as far as goleta is concerned and unless you are stuck with Kinecta or you live in the elwood area, you'll never see this place.  People here are pretty apathetic and the service is slow.....  and they're schedule is random and has short hours.

I've been to Lolita several times in the last year, and each meal was great. It's now my go-to for Mexican in Washington Square West (though I've only been to El Vez once). Highlights: grilled street corn, fried chicken tacos, and the Mezcalito (smoky, spicy, creative).

This place is pretty darn good for a very reasonable price! What is lacking in deliciousness is made up for in convenience and cost. Although one should note that the Chicken Picatta and Chicken Parmesan deserve five stars. The setting is not a date spot but it isn't exactly a hole in the wall either.

Subway menu.
Extremely slow service. One lady working with a line of people.
She announces "out of coffee" so you don't want to wait of you want coffee. 
It's 9am... How about make some coffee. 5 people walked out. 
She was still super slow... It took us greater than 30 minutes to get out 2 sandwiches

They were quick, thorough, and cheap. I got in on the same day (with an appointment) and was given my prescription to order contacts online with no fuss. Exactly what I was looking for. I also was tempted by the large selection of frames for cheap. Maybe next time.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
I had high hopes for this place.  From the moment we walked in the service was soft...the hostess was overwhelmed with not wait, the server gave no description of the food from the servers, no personality from anyone who works there.

The food was ok, but nothing blown us away.  overall you can spend your money elsewhere.

I'm on the fence between 3 and 4 stars. My haircut only took like 5 minutes, and for $25 bucks it's better than most cuts I've gotten in the city. I still have to grow into before I decide. I might search for an Italian barber in the suburbs who can take care of my thick hair for less than $20

Great new updated Courtyard. Same large rooms,  nice beds, clean and has a pool. 

Easy access off I65 just north of Nashville.  The lobby is very large with good size eating area and sitting area for hanging out if you come with other business people.  Can't go wrong here and I would certainly repeat.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: There are only 3 Chinese Restaurants in Willingboro that I will go to an this is one of them simply because they offer a lot of healthy options and even if you order it the regular way it tastes great and non greasy like some of the other Chinese places are. Definitely a great Chinese choice!

It was not expensive (booking.com) even though just 4-5 days before Fat Tuesday. The staff are very nice, the rooms are clean, adequate and the bed comfortable. Very close to airport. Wouldn't want to stay again (so isolated from restaurants unless you have a car) unless I had a crazy early flight like I do this time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I've eaten breakfast/lunch here three times and I'm not impressed. It was the only option without walking downtown in the sweltering humidity. It's pricey, and while the food is decent, I'd go elsewhere. The staff is friendly but I found myself waiting for service too often. Next time I'll cab it downtown.

Everyone at Don's is super nice. They do good work for great prices- and when I've needed help in a hurry they have rearranged things to help me out! I used to go to a different place nearby but the people weren't as nice or friendly, and they charged almost double for an inspection! I will never go anywhere but Don's again.

From start. To finush...worst dining experience I've ever had...horrible waitress...warm salad....ridiculous pour of wine...expensive..food barely edible.....my dining partners felt the same...how..why this place has 3 .5 stars...I'll never know...pass on this place....

One of the better Dunkin Donuts experiences. The store has been very clean every time I've come in, service is fast and courteous enough. Biggest downside here is the parking lot - it's always full, and can be a bit hard to navigate when people are parking in non-spots because of it.

I have only recently tried Dunkin Donuts for the first time earlier this year.  I loved the location because it was super clean and the staff is very friendly.  

The only bad thing about this Dunkin Donuts is the entrance.  It is difficult to get to, but totally worth it the visit.

Always clean and friendly.  The staff is always more than willing to go out of there way to do anything.

The only reason I am giving it a 4 star out of 5 is because the entrance -- it is the most strange entrance and the parking is limited.  

Overall, one of the better Starbucks in town.

This is one of the cleanest and friendliest McDonald's I've ever been to.  They are always fast and friendly.  Although, McDonalds food is subpar and a guilty habit I like to indulge in occasionally this is one of the best restaurants to go to for it.   

Friendly, clean, and prompt....I really like this one!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I freakin' love it.

The only serious coffee game in (Fish)town.

Nice minimalist decor compliments their back to basics coffee aesthetic.

In presenting "coffee directly to you" I'd like to take this opportunity, ReAnimator, to present this song directly to you:

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CKVMl2Ft_gU

I have had better in Reno but it is a great place if your downtown already.  They have a sushi chef named Godzilla.  She is about 5' tall and she is very good.  If you can sit in her area you'll have a great time.  The wait is way longer than it shoud be and that's pretty much why I stay away from this place.

This is a very friendly neighborhood type Italian restaurant in an old bank building in Eagle.  It's very casual and the food is good.  I especially like the Chicken Parmigiana and the Fettucine Alfredo.  It's just a nice place to come on a spur of the moment dining out experience.  Very small and intimate space!

Wow! Fantastic addition to the neighborhood! Great value, fresh, delicious flavors, generous portions, friendly service. We got a yummy, just-right-sweet bubble tea, seaweed salad, and a dinner combo w three rolls and miso soup. Everything was ready early, packaged perfectly, and really delicious! I'll be back for sure. Big Ya!

I own a classic car, and Chris at Expert Auto is one of the few mechanics who will work on it. His hourly rate is high, but this is offset by the fact that he's very good at keeping his time down (I suspect he cuts it to make sure the final bill is reasonable).

I used to go to the Uptown WOW Wingery every now and then while I worked nearby. The service was generally ok but the food just wasn't that good. It was the type of place that I just wouldn't have gone to if it weren't within walking distance. 

I'm divided between two and three stars on this place. It's just not memorable.

The sushi was OK. My only complaint is that they get stingy when you're really there for all-you-can-eat. When they noticed that we were ordering large quantities of sushi, they reminded us of their policy and then took over 30 minutes to get our order. It wasn't even busy that day.

You can't beat an $8 hair cut anywhere else in town. I got my hair done here today and am very satisfied. I don't have one bad thing to say about this place. In addition to the great prices, the people there are awesome. I'll definitely recommend this place to my friends and will return for my next hair cut.

Usually pretty good wax, gel, and pedicure. Gel can be tough you never know when it will peel, but it's pretty rare. Wait time can be tough on a weekend. Shares the lot with shop rite and a few other stores on the corner of free tree and egg harbor. Parking is plentiful. Come in from the greentree side, it's easier.

Used to shop at ABC stores whenever I was liquor shopping but after today will not. I stopped in to pick up boxes for moving and the gentleman was rude after receiving permission from the nice girl at the register. He told me he needed them for customers. Well I'm no longer an ABC customer.

Pros:  Really fast and friendly service and tasty burgers.

Cons:  A little pricey for what you get ($10 for a burger, fries and soda) and your clothes will smell of burgers for the rest of the day.

The spreadable cheddar is loved by many but I would scrape of 2/3 of the amount they give you.

Great solid place to stay near RNO.

Clean, terrific service , fitness facility, breakfast and free wifi! Also has a little bar. Room has a small fridge.

Very good value for business travel. Air conditioner is a little loud bit after a couple of days I got used to it!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The Linguine alla pugliese with mussels, calamari, shrimp is still great.  I just love that zucchini pesto.  Generous serving of mussels.

Also tried an olive-crusted catfish special, in a tomato-caper-zucchini caponata, which was tasty.

But whenever I think of this BYOB, it's the zucchini pesto linguine I yearn for.

I'm not sure on the low stars for this chase location but they are nothing but sweet to me. 

I'm here pretty much every day and never have problems. 

Occasionally there is a line however. 

Go see sandy and ryan they are the best!!

I find getting there at 9 or after 10 is best.

It's convenience is what keeps bringing me back, definitely not the fish or service...   Every time I come in I have service issues, whether it be extremely slow, order wrong, billing issues, or issues using groupon/living social deals.  I will not go back.

Decided to eat here because everything in downtown Kenner was closed! I had a salad which was good. The ladies working here were super warm and nice. The black coffee was very watery and I asked them if I can have another cup. The second one was still watery yet it wasn't as bad as the first.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Great white pizza - The cheese on the pizza had a little tartness which made it "magnificent"! The bruschetta was also yummy with lots of tomato topping. 

Sat outside on the sidewalk which was so nice, and there is plenty of outdoor seating here. The wine list is ok...they had a sangria pitcher for like $26.

Seriously - the BEST water ice I have ever had. I have been a pretty solid Rita's fan (ohhh I know) and just got done eating a Cabana Water Ice. It was simply amazing, real fruit chunks and at like HALF the price of Rita's.....WOW. 

And they have Peach for like a month, if you go, for the love - get the Peach!

........ did not impress at all :-/

- Small portions - like really small
- Don't know what's Gluten Free, the server had no idea what I was talking about - scared
- Expensive - WHOA
- Food was so/so - came out luke warm - meh

So all in all, if you want to be over charged for small so/so food and drinks - this is your place.

Came here for dinner a couple weeks ago.  Food was good, nothing special, just your standard buffet choices.  The one thing that would make me come back here is the price...holy cow...$7.00 for dinner?  I couldn't believe it!  They normally charge about double back home!

Close, quick, accommodating & friendly!!! What more can you ask for.

Dr. White is awesome and called to check up on my baby after our visit.  She also took the initiative to research other avenues that would assist in making my Pug feel better after being diagnosed with an eye ulcer.

What's the purpose of reserving a specific vehicle size of you'll have to wait an hour or more to get it?! Clearly this pissed me off and I requested an upgrade (which of course I was told wasn't an available option either)

Overall terrible customer service, no more Thrifty for me. I guess you simply get what you pay for.

They were very helpful with obtaining a car when I was getting repairs done. Decent car. Great service. Also, I left my sunglasses in the rental. They contacted the next rental driver immediately and he was kind enough to return them. Enterprise held onto them for me until I could come by and pick them up.

Good drinks, good rock music. We wandered in here when we hear Sweet Emotion by Aerosmith . They don't serve the Hurricane here but instead have their house specialty , the Hand Grenade.  The bar staff is great and friendly and the music is great. We also got the fries to soak up all the alcohol which were fantastic.

Pretty efficient place right outside the hospital! I wish more restaurant places learn from this and put restaurants in walking distances.  We walked in and the line was long but within 5 mins, I was able to order my food! They personalize your order with your name.

I have been back twice since then! Love my frosty!!

every time i've been here so far i have found a vegan option that is fruit based and no palm oil.  this is HUGE. im aware the flavors rotate but so far so good!  the vegan topping options are varied - they have nuts and coconut. 

pro tip: they charge by weight so fill up on how little or (in my case) how much you want!

I'd stay here if I wasn't married to the Hilton program, but I come here all the time when I am in St. Louis...Ruth Chris, Starbucks, a store and their restaurant is good too. 
It is safe, convenient and I like it.

Tip: there is a little known restroom under the stairs by the Ruth Chris.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I wish I could rate these folks higher! A great, professional place to get your hair cut! Also try the great line of shampoos and conditioners. Jenni is the ONLY person I trust to cut my hair and trim my beard. She really is a GREAT stylist and AWESOME person!

Much better than the Sparks location across from Sierra Sid's. These people are courteous and friendly, unlike nasty-as-hell Tina in Sparks. Not sure why BK keeps lousy employees when there are obviously people who are professional and know how to treat customers.

This is a DECENT Chinese fast-food joint. The food is quite good, and they give you a lot. That being said, the people who work behind the counter are rude as hell. Very unfriendly. Dude with thick black glasses is almost hateful. I also don't like that they want to charge you for a soda refill. WTF??!!

If you want quality McD's, avoid this place at all cost. I went in at night. Four male employees YELLING F-BOMBS all over the place! Was gonna mention something, but I figured one of the punks would flick a booger in my burger. I've never seen such a poorly managed place. I'd fire every single one of them!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: One of the worst McDonald's I've been to. Employees more interesting in childish effing around than handling orders. Saw one kid walk up and get a bag full of FREE food because his friend was working. Had to wait for the employees to pull their heads out before they started making my order. McDonald's hires idiots!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I love Ike's, but the airport locations aren't that great. The servers aren't very friendly, the drinks are subpar and the pastries are dry.

If you want a good coffee in TIA, this is your only choice. Otherwise, definitely hit one of the brick and mortar locations instead.

Very good. Fresh fish and made to perfection. Very good quality. Small inside so it's best for 2-3 people; not so much groups. I have been afraid to eat sushi since I started living here but I found this joint is better than some of the Sushi places in California.

Its not a 5 star hotel chain, but its great for what it is. The rate was cheap, service was friendly and accommodating, the room was clean, the bed was comfortable. To get downtown, I took the free shuttle to the airport and then the Gray Line shuttle service.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Went here for Sips last wednesday and the drinks and the happy hour food were incredibly disappointing. If they were trying to entice anyone to stay for dinner, this preview did not cut it. 

The sliders and the burgers were incredibly tasteless and dry. The hush puppies were probably the best thing but nothing to write home about.

i came here on recommendation from a friend who knows how much i love nigiri sushi and sashimi. i was super impressed with the fish i ordered. everything was incredibly fresh, and despite being pretty busy when i came to dine, the food came out quickly. this will be my go-to spot for reasonably priced sushi in philly.

I visit the Seminole location on Park to wash my car (and my daughter's) weekly, at least.  The staff is very friendly and the car wash itself is great, including the different tools to clean the interior.  The monthly deal can't be beat.  Highly recommend.

Solid service and wait staff. All smiles and very friendly. Wonton chips and soup app with the lunch special but the food was only ok. No real other complaints or praise but a very middle of the road American-Chinese food restaurant. Probably would not return for a while, just not my thing.

A cute boutique hotel with a french quarter flair! Location was ideal for our FWNOLA guest and the complimentary (extensive selection) breakfast is a huge plus! Don't be fooled by the Best Western! We would highly recommend it when looking for a place for guest to stay!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Good spicy crawfish roll and spicy octopus roll. Small portions of fish in the sashimi plate and it didn't seem that fresh. Asparagus wrapped with beef was delicious! Being from California I'm used to amazing sushi, however it was nice to have a meal that wasn't deep-fried!

This is a GREAT place, small with a cool atmosphere. I loved the chicken curry press box, will be back for more SOON.

Heads up, they do take-out but some reason don't have a take-out menu... No idea why, management if you're reading this, post a take-out menu for hungry Yelpers like myself!

This is one of those places that you always pass and you never know if its open because there isn't much traffic that you see.  We decided to stop in and try it and enjoyed it very much.  Ordered cheese bread, salads, drinks and a pizza.  It is not cheap but it is worth a stop by a few times.

So you will charge $15-20 to do the nails of my 3yr old but you can't get one of these teenyboppers that work there to dust the vents in the bathroom?  Nasty af.  When you call "pull off the dust like it's monkey bread", you haven't cleaned it in far too long...

(We take credit cards) on the window

"I'd like a slice of Sicilian"
"$3.02"
"Hands credit card"
"$10 minimum, but you can use our ATM"
"What is the ATM fee?"
"$2"
"Goes to use ATM, smallest amount you can take out is $20"

So to get a $3 slice of pizza I'll have to have taken $22 from my account"

If this isn't a Ponzi scheme...

No atmosphere, non-pretentious, not bad. Great prices, good sushi, good sake. You can order "non-americanized" sushi as well. Ahem, that means no mayo and no cream cheese and no crab with a K. And you don't have to break out a brand new outfit as you would for ARIGATO on State. I love to go here with my man...good times.

Wasn't a fan at first but now it's become a regular spot for me.  I eat lunch here about once a week.  The cheeseburger is excellent, as are the breakfast dishes I've tried: blueberry pancakes and a standard eggs, sausage, breakfast potatoes plate.  Good, simple food, friendly staff.

Best beer distributor in the area.  The website is up to date with recent beers they add to their stock.  See something you want?  Email them and they can get it, or put it aside for you.  They get a good variety of hard to find beers.  Check it out on a Friday after 5 for some free snacks and beer tastings.

Things have greatly changed at this gym -  if you can ignore the unbelievable rudeness of the administration, then you won't have any problems working out at this great gym with the best hours in Philadelphia - I, however, would rather spend my money elsewhere.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: What a cute bar!!!!  They have different bands every night.  It is LOUD but heck,  you're in the French Quarters, it's whats to be expected!  Try their Frenchy!!!  It's AMAZING!  I love a good French 75 and this is their take on it.  Addicting to say the least.  We loved this place so much we came back every night we were in town.

This is Starbucks is in a great location right next to Rittenhouse Park.  Its a pretty new store with lots of seating, including plenty of outdoor tables which are great in the summer.  Like most starbucks in the city, the coffee is generally good and the baristas friendly and helpful.

I'm not a big fan of Sushi Bros. Their rice is really plump and too sticky for my liking. Have you ever been to someones house and had dinner, just to have their dinner taste like the smell of their house? That's how I feel about this place. Every roll pretty much tastes the same to me.

I don't come here at night and I don't come here alone.  The location is absolutely hideous.

Other than that, it's right by my house and is CHEAP!  My favorite bottle of vino is $5 more up the street about a mile or so. 

Risking my life one bottle of wine at a time!

One of my FAVORITE places to go for fro-yo. Fun flavours to try and I really like the toppings. I would give them a five if they would bring back mochi!

The staff is always warm and inviting. They will ask if you'd like to try a sample and check you out promptly. Pile it high or fill your cup halfway, it is up to you here.

Very good sandwiches,and the service was casual, friendly, and efficient. 

The Kobe burger was excellent, and the leather bottle chicken sandwich was also great.    The fries were fine,and the size of the serving of fries was adequate.

I was surprised that they were out of white wine and craft beer, but it wasn't a big deal.

Had the buffet.  Food was good, not great.  It was excellent value for the cost, so I will give them that, but I personally prefer quality over quantity, and I felt it fell short of that.  I would go back, but with lower expectations.  I have to say, I have a pretty high expectation, so maybe it's not as bad for others.

Went to get the ultimate carwash. Left with a slightly cleaner car and 50 green papers lighter.

Workers clearly didn't want to work there and it showed in their workmanship. Therefore, overpriced and a waste of time.

Parking: It's a car wash
Price: Overpriced at any level
Wait: Almost none

Yes. Perfect.

Be sure to visit the bar and experience amazing mixologists. All the service staff take large pride in their work. They are amazing friendly and you get to be a part of their family during your time there.

The food is simply amazing. Each dish is unique and perfect. You cannot go wrong with anything you order.

Came here for Clayton restaurant week. The other reviews that detail the lengthy process of sitting down, receiving drink menu, and finally food menu were accurate. The drinks were really good. The food was good but not great, it was too rich for me. Service was excellent.

I love this place, and I can't really figure out why. The selection was never great. The prices are fair. I guess I just like the old school feel inside, no bells and whistles.

Equally, I like the fact that they keep cases of swill on ice in the back for your party-to-go.

If I were to visit the Philly area (even though it's about 30 minutes away) again I'd stay here.

It was clean, bright, and very well maintained. My bill was around $133 for a suite on a Friday night. 

I left early in the morning so I skipped the complimentary breakfast.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Very nice place on the inside. Staff was pleasant and helpful. I wasn't sure what to expect with the food, but the pizza was definitely WAY better than I expected. Certainly tasted authentic. The prices were a little more on the expensive side, but you really get what you pay for. Great place.

Stayed here for 1 night with my husband. Room was fine. Bathroom was set up awkwardly. You could hear the toilet flush in the room next to us. Parking was easy. We did receive a coupon for a free appetizer at a local restaurant, so that was nice. Overall, would probably stay here again if it was cheaper then some other options.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This is my number 1 go-to liquor store. The staff has always been friendly and provides great service. They have even made sure to stock my favorite beer. they offer a wide variety of liquor and beers. 
It is a one stop shop for all of your drinking needs.

This is a great location to have sushi. The service was quick and the food was tasty. My favorite was the tuna tataki, super yum!
The sushi overall is decent. The atmosphere was pretty quiet when I went. The happy hour here is great!  Decent prices and great sushi!

Came back for dinner. Food is fresh, tasty, ordered a pitcher of margarita --that was a bit sour, but we really enjoyed their fish tacos. The one star was for the service - it was exceptionally slow and the restaurant wasn't as crowded for the service to be that slow.

OK, not the classiest joint in the world, but I like it.  It's a cheap place to get lunch, when all you want is a burger and fries or pizza and you're not looking to "dine" in any sense of the word.  I end up getting lunch here a lot when I'm at work because, well, it's just so easy.

Great spot to eat gamble and drink. The menu has it all. The food is tasty and well put together. 
Prices here are great as well. You can have a lot for little price. 
Service is fast and friendly, thanks Lacey. Eat at the bar so you can gamble and eat and yes I know too many ands,drink too.

I make a huge detour to go there for my car. A top list cleaning looks like the car has been details. And it is so good I will have it details before winter... 
Just great! Take something to read while waiting because it takes a little longer than a traditional car wash, but it is worth every minute and $$$

I wasn't blown away by this restaurant.  Although they didn't really have anything that was vegetarian friendly, the chef and owner, Paul, altered some items to help me out, which was very nice.  It was good, but not good enough to really make me want to go back.  The decoration is horrible.

Ventured over from Jersey for a cup of tea and a light bite on a much-cherished day off.  The service was excellent.  The ambiance was quaint and comfy.  The caramel tea was awesome as was the breakfast sandwich I had.  

I will be returning soon to try one of their many other teas.

It's my local Starbucks. The staff is always very friendly and has more to say than what do you want :-) Has a drive through. 
If it wasnt out of my way I'd visit more often. Man I wish there was another one closer to my house. Can we get a Starbucks at the Beach?

I love this place. If you aren't paying attention you could walk right by it. Good coffee and friendly people. The atmosphere is eclectic and the space really radiates positive energy. Great place to kick back and get some work accomplished. I've never tried the food but it it looks great too.

Go here!

Rolls are interesting and not the usual fare. The ambiece is nice for dates or small groups, though if there is an obnoxious table in the restaurant everyone is bothered. Nice fish, nice apps. BYOB policy.

Pros: Rolls, rolls, rolls

Cons: Can get loud

I really liked their chicken karaage and tuna nachos on wonton chips.  Sushi rolls were pretty good too.
The uni pasta didn't have as much uni as I would have liked but can't complain for $16. They were out of the grilled fish collars the evening I went.  Good service and food! I'll be back!

This is a buffet. The dishes seem to stay mostly the same, which can be good because you know what you're going to get when you go there. They never seem to be very busy, which I like. The girl who seats you appears to be about 10; who knows what kind of child labor laws they're breaking, but the food is good. :D

This is a starbucks inside of a Target. The locations Perfect! It's got great service and of course, they make ALL the drinks just like you like them. 

I always get a Medium hot chai latte, made with skim, with extra chai, which is always no cost. I LOVE it.

Dual drive thrus make it easy to get a Half/half tea when the person in the other lane is apparently ordering 1 of everything off the menu. Mine was a quick in and out trip and It took less than 3 minutes to order and get my tea. 

I am sad though. Large Iced teas no longer are $1.00. Le sigh.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I visited a friend here today, and was quite happy with the set up.  Their 2 bedroom apartment is fairly large, with 2 bathrooms and a large living area and kitchen. I understand that the rent is ok too. 

Me? I'm not a hive person, so I won't live in one,but I'll be honest, they're pretty nice.

The Garden District of NOLA is difficult enough to drive around in, but this Chase bank made it even more difficult with it's convoluted enterance for the drive through. We literally had someone else do the same thing we did, which is go in the wrong enterance , have to pull out and go in the right one. Oy!

Drive through, we aren't sure why, but we were asked to wait on an order for 2 large diet cokes. I suppose it could be that they were changing the Co2 but that wasn't communicated. We were told to wait. We waited 12 minutes.  We had asked that one be without ice, and one to have lemons. They both had no ice, and neither had lemons.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Amazing sushi and rolls, all you can eat, fresh, great portions $20 weekday and $22 weekends (more choices).

Shrimp.tempura  = 9
Crab Ragoon = 10 plus ( best ever had)
Salmon = 10
Spicy girl roll = 10
Winter roll =8.5
Tuna  = 10
Red snapper = 9.5
Yellowtail  = 10
Dragon roll = 7.5
