Least favorite yogurt in Tucson.  Stay on speedway and go to BTO.  The worker actually left me and my friends in there alone for about 3 minutes, in that time we just sat and complained about the yogurt.  You know its not good, when given to chance to get some free yogurt, you pass.

My daughter loves their McGriddle with just eggs and cheese. 

That the only thing she will eat out of there short of my having to always buy a toy for $2.00

Their lines for the drive way is usually crazy on Saturdays you better off swinging towards the end of the drive thru park your car and go inside to order.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Love sushi? Don't want to pay RAW or Morimoti prices? Eat here.  It's wonderful.  I prefer getting takeout though. The restaurant is teensy small so it may be best to go here on a summer or spring day and then head out to Rittenhouse Square and dine amongst the passersby.

This gym is kept clean and Not super busy late at night like after 9pm.  They could do some building improvements for example the sauna is falling apart.  most of the equipment is older and often lots of out of service signs on the treadmills and ellipticals up stairs.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Our server was very attentive and friendly. The overall feel of the place is really peaceful and calm. The food, however, isn't so great. The prices aren't too bad, but I honestly would rather go to state street and pay the same price for better food. The tiramisu was appetizing though.

Very unassuming. Tucked away in a generic grocery store stripmall. I've tried a number of places around Indy and Sushi House is a very solid option. I usually order some salmon nigiri/sashimi and it is always very fresh and tasty. Their regular rolls are less impressive but still good. This is my go to sushi place!

A resounding, emphatic 'meh.'

It's pasta! How can it go wrong? Well, it's not that it was 'wrong,' but nothing was particularly 'right' either. If I'm going to pay for pasta, it better be noticeably of higher quality than something I can make from a single jar and box from any grocery store.

Pros:  Clean, helpful staff, lots of TVs (AND Movie nights!), mostly professional clients who frequent the place, great fitness classes included in price of membership

Cons:  A little pricer than other neighborhood gyms but you get what you pay for right?
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
The automatic car wash is the same price as the Shell on Euclid at Dale Mabry, but at least the Shell car wash had a dryer.

It's a better deal self washing.  Although the machines can take credit card/debit, there's a $5 minimum, so if you just want to rinse off the love bugs, bring quarters or single dollar bills.

At $18 it's twice as costly to get a car wash here than at one of the car washes at your local gas station but the wash here does a heck of a lot better job at getting the salt off your car. While you're paying a little more, your four wheeled baby is worth it, right?

I agree with Travis A. I neither was impressed with this place. I actually never heard of it until the night I decided to try it. The soup, drinks, nachos were not that great. Basically, everything i ordered I kept sending it back. I typically don't do that but I just didn't like the food. 

Sorry.

This place stays packed so some people do like it! It has a great atmosphere though but its small like most sushi bars.  

 Don't expect a fast checkout especially during lunch hour. Their sushi presentation wasn't that attractive nor was the taste fresh but not stale. It was just ok.  All I can say is I've had better.

We go here all the time since we live right around the corner from it. At first the they didn't have their prices together but eventually it all worked itself out. I like the fact they have local flavors. The only thing is they charge you more if you order the flavor of the month. Would recommend this place.

My national ice cream tour continues ... 

YUM. Lots of original flavors, including one called a chockwork orange -- a rich chocolate with an unexpected, but nice, orange flair at the end. My waffle cone was fresh and tasty. Happiness. 

They only accept cash, but there is a Chase bank next door.

$4.95 for mediocre flavors. There are so many good flavor options for FroYo that offering just the basics (cake batter, chocolate, vanilla, tart, etc.) makes no sense to me. Toppings are standard, setting is pleasant, prices seem a bit high. If I'm driving by, I may stop, but I wont go out of my way for it.

Four of us had a lovely dinner here on a Sunday evening. Our salads, pastas, entrees, and desserts were all terrific. We were even given a limoncello gratis to finish off a great meal. Our waiter was fabulous, funny, engaging, and he made excellent suggestions.

Hi, I'm goth, what are you?  As good as any of the twenty bars in a two block radius.  Maybe a bit better because now that i think about it i've had more good times here than mediocre ones.  Worth stopping at while touring if you're under thirty or wear black.

pastas, many of which are good and a few of which are dumb, and a few other entrees that can sometimes impress.  The petit filets and porkchops (obviously not pastas) are succulent.  as far as pastas go, the baked macaroni, bbq chicken, and muffaletta pastas rock.

Tropical Isle is tacky, but they have a signature and requisite blow-your-brains-out specialty drink, the Hand Grenade (complete with stupid cup), which is the stupidness-delivery weapon of chice for the polo shirt wearing-beads set.  Two for one during daylight hours, most days.

Yuppified but nicely-adorned bar that is home to hotting and hollering frat-types and the ladies who dote on them.  Drinks are overpriced, which is a shame because this neighborhood is awesome.  If you have to go here, don't park in the Perlis lot and don't urinate outside.  You will be caught on tape.

Madigan's is the place to go for underaged girls (even though a sign on the door says they want 2 forms of ID), decent drink specials, and fairly good burgers (at GB's in the back).  Now that i have said that and laughed at my shame for saying it, i will tell you that if you love TJ Quills or Friar Tucks, then this bar is for you!

What a great branch. I opened my first bank account here back when it was a Commerce. My girlfriend and I have alot of fun with the penny arcade. We take bets all the time. Sometimes we even win the cheap prize. Hey they make banking fun. I miss the Big C banks though.

Customer Service: The customer service here is terrible. 

Presentation: Dirty. Long Lines. 

Price: Not worth it! Why spend the $5-10 on junk! 

Food: Well some it may taste good going in but I can't say the same for going out.  

Me: Do your best to avoid the homeless guy outside the door.

Wow. Waited for over 10 mins and of course they still managed to get the order incorrect. Trying to just grab a quick "good job meal" for my kid turned into a full 30 minute trip. The one star is for the friendly lady who took my money, she's about the only good thing at this place.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The new layout really sucks. Two ATMs in the lobby which are supposed to speed the process along do the opposite. People that still prefer speaking to a human for things the atm can do. Less tellers available. The teller line is a rat trap with no escape in case of emergency. Not a fan.

Previously a Burger King, then a random eatery, now a Dunkin Donuts. It's a convenient location for anyone in Lindenwold or Laurel Springs. The inside is pretty clean, they have a drive-thru, and thus far, have not mussed up my order. Kudos to these folks.

Really good for a a reasonable price. Definitely a place where you would want to bring your friends or family and order a nice bottle of red to compliment your food. The service was also good. Ambiance was nice, and the lights were set low to make it seem very personal. Will return!

Pistachio Grille is very nice little place in Maple Glen on Limekiln Pike. The decor and ambiance is very good and the food is tasty to say the least. Also, make sure to check out their daily specials ranging from savory pork sanwiches to pistachio encrusted salmon. Definitely a must try.

Food is better than Olive Garden, but that is not saying much. Management is not very kind if you try to pay for your meal with any sort of gift card, or restaurant.com certificate. Kind of depressing. But overall, better than the run-of-the-mill italian eatery. Don't really see myself every revisiting this place.

Basic chain fare.  Nothing to write home about.  The waiter asked if I wanted my mahi mahi sandwich grilled or blackened.  I opted for blackened.  There wasn't a trace of blackened seasoning.  The sandwich was a basic grilled sandwich.  It wasn't bad , just wasn't blackened.

I don't know what the fuck happened to this place since my good experience earlier in the year. Food quality went downhill and our server didn't know how to smile.

The only thing I enjoyed was the free foccacia appetizer and my free cup of grated parmesan. SMH.

If I could give this place 10 stars I would. The food was amazing and plentiful. The options were healthy and delicious. The service was prompt and friendly, and the bill? Incredibly reasonable. We can't wait to return.

As a tip, try one of their omelets with andouille sausage and some fresh veggies. It was fantastic.

Great selection of beer and wine.  The Manager is so cool, he always helps you with your selection and is very knowledgeable about the product.  He will offer better selections and is helpful with food pairing selections too.  They have tastings on Friday and Saturday evenings as well.

Love subway. I often go around 7, 7:30pm. Sometimes there are out of half of their breads which can be frustrating. But good, quick, cheap. My husband is the most expensive person to buy for out to eat because he's such a glutton and eats so much but at least he can eat here for $6-$8!

So Roosevelts has awful food. I ordered some nachos and quickly regretted my decision after seeing the bartender get food delivered to the bar. 

That said, you can get a yards philly pale ale for only $3 without any special happy hours or anything. That itself is a reason to go back to Roosevelts.

They have the most delicious homemade bread here!!

We went for Valentine's Day. Even with the crowd, the service and the food were great. 

It's on an unimpressive corner of Frankford Ave (we almost missed it!). It doesn't look like much from the outside, but inside, it's delicious!

So glad this place opened in my neighborhood. I love having a dedicated wine shop with knowledgeable and friendly owners on hand. There's nothing better than being guided to your new favorite wine!  They have a great space that will be amazing for tastings or events. I can't wait to enjoy it when times change.

Yum! I think out of the dozen or so times I've come to Peddler's, I've been to Hart's at least half of them. I highly recommend the potato/corn soup and basically anything else on the menu is great. I like the lighting inside and the overall atmosphere, very pub.

Chocolate snowball is insanely good! Between that and mega mango, definitely two of the best snowballs in the entire metro area! Any of the "mega" flavors are great! Haven't had a disappointing visit yet. Snowballs are consistently delicious and the staff is always friendly.

I don't want to like Bici, I want to love it!  We live three blocks aways.  The place is charming.  The outdoor seating is wonderful.  But the food always disappoints.  Granted, it's never awful or nasty.  But it's never inspired either.  It's consistently meh.  If the kitchen improved, we'd be there all the time...

Looks as though they are remodeling, because there was no menu on the wall and lots of stuff around. It was clean, however, and the staff were nice and professional. It's a little cramped and small inside, but overall it was a good location and good ice cream.

Hmm...maybe my standards for really good Chinese food are too high. This place is merely ok, in my opinion. Things are fried. The sauce is brown. Not that different from a million other Chinese places in the naked city.

On the other hand--delivery, which is always a plus.

Went here for lunch with my kids. They both had the grilled cheese with tomato soup--my son loved it, my daughter not so much. I had the portabella sandwich, which was kind of eh. 

Worried that this place won't survive, as it's always barely half-full--and the prices are not that reasonable, for the neighborhood.

I have a problem with Creole Creamery.  And that problem is, whenever I drive down Prytania, I feel compelled to stop for ice cream.  Am I late for something?  Am I on the way to dinner?  Am I stuffed?  IT DOESN'T MATTER.

Crazy flavors, perfect portions, and friendly service.  It's all good.  Too good.

Just passing through town, naturally, and had a decent stay at Springhill Suites. We stayed here because it was close to Watkins College, which I was familiar with, and it was close enough to walk to Neely's Barbeque. We left about 10 minutes prior to the continental breakfast. We would be pleased to stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We have been coming to cortaro farms since we moved here in 2011. Dr. Lueth and the entire staff treat you with kindness and they have all been empathetic during the difficult times with older pets. They have Saturday appointments which is super convenient. I would highly recommend Cortaro Fsrms.

Man, I love this place. It's small, but people get elbow-to-elbow and get along.

The iRoll and the Dragon Roll are two of my favorites. We go with 4 people at lunch and enjoy the whole vibe. We get really fresh sushi and get to be up close and personal with the sushi chefs. To me, this is the top sushi place in Philly.

Solid byob, great lunch and dinner menu and specials good is always very hood especially forte price.  Service and staff is very friendly, sometimes a little forgetful but good none the less.  For the price a great value, hidden little gem on consh.  Only problem is it is extremely small

Had a chicken cheesesteak here.  Nothing great, nothing bad.  Not enough chicken to fill the nice crusty roll.  I'd suggest getting some sauce on the side (I had ketchup but my partner had sauce which was much better).

Quick and easy; nothing stellar or special about this place.

I ordered a blueberry cobbler Croissant. It costs $2.79 and it was stale. I can understand a gas station donut being stale but when you only have one to do and you charge $2.79 for a regular size donut, I kind of expect a great donut or at least a good one. First time there and probably the last.

Initially got attracted to the 50% sushi sign. 

Walked in and the place was relatively empty. The service was good and the sushi was exactly what you paid for. It wasn't the best, but it wasn't the worst; it was average. 

Would I come back? Maybe if I was really craving sushi without breaking the bank.

Perfectly fine McDonald's this beautiful morning. Pulled up to the drive through with no wait (5:15 on a Saturday morning) and was greeted pleasantly. Ordered, paid, and out in less than three minutes I think. 

Egg McMuffins were fine, service with a smile, and close to our hotel.  All good.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: One of my favorite dives in New Orleans. Dirty, dark, weird, always something a little shady going on. Great jukebox, good location on lower decatur close to other places I like to frequent. The bartenders have always been great, and it's open 24 hours. Love it.

If i had known there was a pool i'd of brought my swimsuit! It's no "W" but on a budget you can have a nice romantic stay smack in the middle of the city. There is a cool view out front of some rose garden as an added bonus. I'd say do it, unless money isn't an issue.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Couldnt have asked for anything more on this stay. Comfortable beds, which are a just, and convenient to anything you want to do. The staff was amazing! $30 per night for parking was a little steep but there are options nearby if you want to explore other parking facilities.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Came here for restaurant week, so may not have had the most adventurous items on the menu, but was quickly disappointed.  Sushi was boring, small, and not very flavorful.  I'd honestly prefer Mizu over this any time, and Mizu is like 1/2 the price.

Also - clean your bathrooms!

The wonderfulness of the house cucumber roll is seared into my memory.  Every rool we roders was fresh and light.  Plus pleasant and airy decor.

Just what the doctor ordered for two tourist who were getting tired of cajun and creole cooking in New Orleans.

Maybe they should change the name to Joey's Cheesesteaks and Pizza.  Leading solely with pizza highlights (to be honest) their worst offering.  The crust is way overdone and tasteless.  Everything on top is good but just like a sandwich, the bread is everything.

Palm tree has quality grocery selections, reasonably priced. Lots of pre-made Vegetarian to-go stuff, and a killer veggie cheesesteak. (full deli for carnivores too). Gracious and friendly staff. I stop in almost daily. If they offered beer, they would be perfect.

This location is OK. It has a drive thru which is nice but parking is extremely limited and it is no longer 24 hours.

This would have been a 5 star location in its 24 hour heyday but I myself have almost forgotten that it is there since it seems like it is closed all the time now.

A great selection of beer and spirits merchandised well so you can easily locate what your looking for. The store is bright, spacious and clean with a great staff.  We haven't explored the wine selection yet, but their cold beer and bourbon selection is great.  This has become our first stop for adult juice.

Good location but I agree with Shawn P. that they seem a little skimpy with the toppings. My husband picked up my sandwich for me and I had to open it all the way up to find the cheese. I think I had one slice. There weren't even a lot of veggies. Disappointing.

Very busy location -- service is always polite but tends to be slow. I don't frequent this location -- if I'm jonesing for a Coke Zero or a sausage mcmuffin, I will usually just wait until I get to the Binford location. But, as long as you're patient, it's not as bad as the other reviews would have you think.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I'm not sure what people see in this place. Parking is a nightmare, and due to the lack of decent restaurants in the Horsham- willow grove area, this one gets packed at lunch. Food is decent, but over-priced. Decor is nice, but beyond this, nothing special.

Prices are high here and the food is just average. The environment is nice, but not fancy. They are always busy, and offer takeout.  But nothing about this place is remarkable. The bread is good, but I don't think they make their pasta fresh and the risotto was mealy and bland. I don't get the appeal.

Tasty! Tasty! Tasty! Take your kid to the Chuck E Cheese next to the mall in Cherry Hill and then come here for some tasty icecream. Our family of 3 shared a small flurry -a blended ice cream with TONS of Reeses Peanut Butter cups-$3.50. Just plan to eat in your car (which is kind of a pain with a toddler, but we managed).

We hadn't been to a hibachi type restaurant in years, and didn't know what to expect. Our two-year old was with us, along with my mom and brother. Karley was a friendly, and attentive server. Dinner was great, but for some reason, their lunch isn't as good. We will def be back for dinner, but will skip this place during lunch.

UPDATE: We did try Giovanni's Pizza. The pizza was actually very good. I would go here again. It's a shame they don't deliver to our area.

ORIGINAL: They deliver, but only if you're real close. I'm a mile away, and they won't cross the street to deliver. Unreal!

Ordered chicken cheesesteaks with extra cheese. One with fried onion. The sandwiches were tasty, but the one with fried onions had onions, not fried. 
Also ordered curly fries and sweet potato fries which were very good. Delivery took about 40 minutes. 

Ok, but not fantastic.

Ordered a chicken sandwich, received a burger in a chicken sandwich box. Front of house is friendly and attentive. Back of house can't tell the difference between a burger or piece of chicken. Or maybe it was just the dudes working the that night. Most times they get the order 99% accurate.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I've had breakfast here that wasn't bad. But any time I've been here with co-workers for a pre-flight cocktail, the place is always a mess. Sticky, un-wiped tables and bar, un-swept floors. And btw, there is now such a thing as flatscreen TVs. Get with the program.

Not the best sushi or Japanese food. Plus it's expensive for what you get. 

I like that it's BYOB. It probably seems better than it is since there is no sushi competition in Manayunk. Still would rather travel to the 'burbs or Center City when I'm feeling sushi.

I tend to frequent this market because of its convenient location and the fact that it accepts credit/debit cards. You certainly won't find any deals here, but I wouldn't necessarily say the food is overpriced either. Great if you need to pick up a few things here or there. Wouldn't recommend for a full food shopping.

Not overly impressed. I got a med soft serve dipped cone  it was much smaller then expected and the chocolate coating was a little lacking. My hubby got the med hand-dipped strawberry cone of which I finagled a taste and was surprised at how really good it was. The experience was MEH... I would rather go to DQ or cold stone.

Like Carrie, I really like this Starbucks and the staff is extremely fun & friendly. For me it's an easy stop on the way to work. I occasionally have trouble parking during peak hours in the morning, but around lunchtime it's always easy to find a spot right near the front.

It's Dunkin Donuts, you know what to expect and this store does not disappoint. The fact it is right around the corner from my house means I can walk there to satisfy my daily caffeine and carb cravings (and to walk off the calories from their damn tasty donuts).

It's Dunkin Donuts so you know what to expect (typical South Asian owner/operators, nice folks), except this Dunkin Donuts is also part of a ridiculously overpriced gas station. Coffee and donut prices are what they are but when it comes to their gas they are price gougers (2 star ding for ripping off people). I go elsewhere..

This is a very clean nail salon with very thorough service. I love the deluxe pedicure as they really take the time to massage your feet :)  The service is prompt and professional. Costs a little more than some of the other nail salons but it is definitely worth it!

this place was pretty good. Coming here i was really skeptical being that i come from an area notible for italian food, but i was suprised
by the food. I order the cantaloni and i was very impressed the filling was delicious, i think it was veal and pork. also the corn and crab bisque is worth trying.

Would definatly come again

This place hardly ever seems busy, and for good reason the service here is average and pales in comparision to the location in the city. The food here does not live up to the quality at the other location. If you want good Italian skip Hollywood, and head to The Hill.

This is your standard Wendy's, however compared to some newer locations this place already feels dated. Also the staff here isnt the friendliest nor do they offer exceptionally fast service. I will say that the Pretzel Bacon Cheeseburger is amazing, yet slightly expensive.

I don't know why everyone is hating so much!  I think the frozen yogurt is very tasty.  They have a decent number of flavors and the signs are  very cute.  Yes, it's expensive; however, I feel like it's similar to market price.  I definitely prefer Sweet Ending to Red Mango, Pinkberry, etc.  This place is yummy :)

Great service, delicious. But, I would've appreciated more of sweet flavors. They had soy yogurt, reduced sugar and no sugar added flavors, and fruit based/sherbert types of flavors. But, the chocolate wasn't quite sweet enough. Honestly, it's probably healthier that way, but I felt like something sugary.

I keep going back to this place. The people are friendly and the food is rich and tasty. I recommend the taco salad. The best part is the juices at the bottom with the re-fried beans and crunchy bowl. Somehow the food is better here than the one in Newark. I think the are both Tonaltecas despite the name on this post.

Staff was hustling, you could tell they were little behind and they were having some equipment issues. A few of the patrons were a little rude but the staff still kept it together. Good job guys. I don't come to McDonald's often, but you get three stars which in a chain is good for me.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Took them several minutes to check if I had a designation of beneficiary form at the branch in the IN Gov't Center. Then they announced the form was invalid as they don't allow secondary beneficiaries. Their rates on money market are inferior to TCU. In short, there are better credit unions.

Very disappointed. They said I needed a new pump. I had 2 other mechanics check it out. Not only did I not need one (their estimate-5hours labor,$800+), but it could be done for half that if I needed one whch I did not. They also said I needed new struts which I did not (another $1000 savings). Wont be back.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: My insurance company let me redo an eye exam here after another Carmel optometrisst refused to give me a 2 year lens prescription as required by government regulations. Although the doctor I saw last time had left, the new doctor was very thorough and professional and gave me the required 2 year script. Recommended.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
I'm sure running a sushi restaurant must be hard.  

But I think the most important thing would be to have fresh fish .

I ate here for lunch on a Saturday and this place had the oldest fish I can ever remember eating.  Very disappointing!!

At least the service was friendly .

It's Starbucks so I can't say much. I enjoy a latte now and again, but of course, it's pricey. This particular location can get really congested. Staff is okay; they don't quite have the friendliness of most Starbucks baristas I've encountered. I wouldn't recommend coming during peak times, or if you're in a hurry.

I went for the first time today September 27. The wash didn't get my car clean at all. The two kids working the beginning of the wash were really rude.  I was pretty surprised the wash left so much dirt on my car. The 3 stars are for the vacuum which worked exceptionally well.

Impressive launch.  The service was fantastic!  The food was good.  It seemed those around me had picked the better meal.  I ordered the Shrimp Taco and enjoyed it.  I was hoping for more.

I've decided to give this 4 stars because we had such a great time.  I will definitly be back.

More laid back than the Montgomeryville Ooka, but I enjoy coming here for good sashimi. They have a lot of cooked rolls on the menu which I'm not a fan of.. but can't go wrong with my usual spicy tuna rolls. Parking lot is a bit small but I haven't had a problem when I came here on two occasions. Will return!

This Hampton inn Rocks, the staff was super friendly and made my team feel at home and the room was clean. The only issue I had was that HH failed to upload my invoice to the app and my points failed to transfer over but Brandy Dixon step up to the plate and emailed me my invoice in a matter of seconds.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Someone said it's an expensive Olive Garden.  I would actually go so far as to call it a Domino's with no taste.  Service is horrible.  Also if you are thinking chi-chi because of the location, remember kids love pizza and aren't picky about what it tastes like.

It was ok.  after reading the reviews here I expected it to be phenomenal.  the sushi was average and inside it almost looked like a fast food restaurant.  definitely didn't meet my expectations.   If I'm going to spend $50 on dinner I'd rather just go to cha yoon.

My daughter and I stopped in as we made our in to the St. Clair Square mall . Pretty much in the same leauge as TGIF or Applebee's but not as much flair. I got the chick-chick chickee pot pie and she got the fried cheese cubes. Both  were good and so was the service . Nothing mind blowing but I would go back .

My dad and I stopped here for a quick cheesesteak -- I did not try the pizza.  The cheesesteak was good, a little more bland than some other places and less dripping with grease, which arguably makes it better but sometimes when you order a cheesesteak you WANT the salt and grease.  :)

Came here for lunch today. Clean place. Basic pizza joint. Not a lot of pizza selections - basics and some speciality pies. I got a turkey hoagie after tax came to $7.30 - which I think is expensive for a hoagie. Good though. Thick sliced oven roasted turkey. nice fresh roll. Fast service.

You gotta thank Yelp for the reviews. I wouldn't have found this place otherwise. Their rolls are amazing!! We had the St Louis, Catepillar, Crazy, and I don't remember the last one, but my favorite was the Crazy Roll (lots of fish). I suppose the near 10% in tax is worth it. I definitely would come back here.

I came here back in October and we weren't blown away by this hotel. The staff were very nice and the room was clean, but the bed was very uncomfortable and sleep was poor overall. The hotel is very conveniently located (right near the football stadium and various restaurants), but I doubt I would stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Moved here from Orange County, CA and been struggling to find a good barber for a consistent fade cut. Got a recommendation to see Randy at Big Bend. He owns a cool shop and provided a GREAT haircut. It's exactly the fade and part I'm looking for. I'll be coming to see him every two weeks. Highly recommended!

Early bird specials are very reasonably priced and the staff was friendly enough but the food was average at best. We had a party of 6 and had enough different entrees to judge the food and it was was just ok. Do your self a favor and drive a couple of miles to Da Sesto, you won't be sorry.

Taki is such an unassuming place because it's in a strip with Subway and a tan place, but Taki has never disappointed me any time I've been. I always order rolls here and they're great every time. The staff is pleasant and the prices are quite decent for sushi!

Not my favorite Midas, but I lived just down the street from them and they got the job done every time. The shop is on such a busy road so getting in and out can be a hassle, but they do have free wi-fi while you wait and you can always walk across the street to Publix if you're hungry!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I lived just down the road from Dolce Vita, and I always ordered from this place whenever I wanted to take a pizza home. I can't recall the exact price of their carry-out special, but it's a good deal and I recommend calling first and asking them what it is. Overall great pizza for a great price!

Well... It's hard to review these kinds of Mexican restaurants. All of your dining experiences there start to blend in, you know? Not a bad thing, obviously, since I'm giving Las Maracas three times. I've eaten here twice, neither of which were bad meals, but nothing worth writing home about. It's just your basic Mexican fare.

4 stars for value (3 - 8 piece maki rolls for $10.95), probably 3.5 stars for quality. Not legit sushi, but good enough for a quick fix.

There really are only 6 seats at the bar, so we got take out and dined al fresco at Rittenhouse Square. Got to take advantage of these warm summer nights!

Great coffee as usual but this has to be the dirtiest LaColombe I've ever been in. Smeary Windows and the trash cans are overflowing. Outside, the tables all need wiping down and there is litter all over the terrace. Trash cans overflowing outside too. Very surprised at this lack of attention to detail.

My husband and I went here once so far. We were the only ones there that day that weren't "usuals." But everyone was friendly with us. Drinks were good. They seem to have lots of games to play besides just the video poker machines. I will be coming here again when I visit Sparks!

Aisles of wine with a large selection of premium wines in the back of the store. Nothing too exciting, especially if you're like me. I don't know much about wine, I just know what I don't like. What I don't like, is any bottle of wine over $10. I was able to make it out tonight with a hefty bottle for less than $8. Bottoms up!

Rooms are just okay. Good prices though. Even though the rooms are not wonderful they were clean and fairly comfortable. It surely was nice to be able to book at the last minute, but if you have the option to plan ahead I wouldn't recommend this hotel. It is in a great location, walking distance to lots of things.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: For years, the roast beef has been sliced way too thick. It's gross. The Arby's at Curlew and 19 knows that the roast beef should be sliced thinly. It may be farther away. I need to start going there. Theirs tastes much better. I even asked for it to be sliced thinly, but it wasn't. The drive-thru guy always has good jokes though.

Poor quality of food for the price. Had the sweet chili wings and the gluten free steak and onion flatbread. Both were very cheaply made and tasted very bad. Atmosphere and location were good and would probably stop for a slice of $3 cheese pizza  if I was walking home drunk. Otherwise would not go back for dinner.

Great people, great beer selections, and a bumper pool table. They also have food pop ups (cheese curds anyone?) and had crawfish during the season. They've also had beer tastings from local breweries.

I love learning about the variety of beers out there and having the opportunity to try a bunch of them.

I haven't eaten here in ages, but it was our old stand-by at my parents' house. They have the best pizza in the immediate area, their sandwiches aren't half-bad either, and the owner and staff are incredibly nice. We rarely ate in the restaurant, but for reasonably priced take-out, Mama's can't be beat.

I came here with my girlfriends for a girls dinner, and we all had a nice time. There were a few small complaints among our group, but that's bound to happen with a party of 8. 

The food was good, but not great, and I think everyone in our party enjoyed their meal.

For the love god made little green apples, make sure you have an interior room and not one that looks out over one of the streets surrounding the hotel. The loud club music runs all night at volumes that defy simple explanation, and even earplugs won't help you.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: First time at a Winn-Dixie, was not too impressed. Store was kind of dreary looking in some aisles, not enough lighting. They seem to have some good deals if you have a membership card, but not as many as some other large supermarket chains. Self checkout had 2 out of order machines when I went, something to stay more on top of

Decent donuts.. usually stale though by the time I get to them. I prefer other local donut shops in town, but if I'm not up for driving there.. Can't go wrong with a Dunkin'..  Their coffee is decent, but i'd stay away from the 'special coffee' like their mochas.. blah!

This is your standard dry cleaner. I've only used them once, but they did a fine job. The person at the shop was friendly and helpful and pointed out I'd given him 5 instead of 4 shirts. There's not really much in the way of a cleaners around the far south city area.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: the food was abysmal. everything was drenched in cheese, as if huge amounts of fat mask the poor quality and execution of what is supposed to be authentic mexican. honestly, i would rather go to chipotle. the ambiance was as underwhelming as the food. the only good things were the free nachos and the booze we brought.

I want to like this place very badly. Local owners: Mom and daughter-in-law. The issues I have found span all 6 of my trips: cold espresso (low volume business, and I wonder if they keep the machine primed properly - that is over-roasted and bitter. The cupcakes are good, and the decor is nice.

Ordered a plain pizza and a gourmet pizza along with mega fries. There was nothing special about the food. Crust was thick and had no crisp. Not much flavor to sauce, and cheese was not good quality either. Does the job, but won't impress. If you're paying for food, don't you want it to impress more than DiGiorno's?

This store used to be better. The staff isn't as friendly anymore and it's food prepared better. The cleanliness of the store is in question to me since on this visit a roach came from under the kitchen door into the dining area. I alerted the manager on duty and promptly left.

We have always loved this place.  They people are very friendly here.  The vegetable tempura is a nice size portion and very good.  The california rolls are also good.  We also enjoy getting chicken and beef teriyaki hibachi.  Great dinner date and a nice place to go with a group of friends.

As a Huge mexican food fan I've been to a million places and I've had the best and the worst.  I've even had Mexican on the streets of Tijuana. 
This place almost tries too hard to be authentic Mexican.
The beef was chewy as hell.  Overall not a good experience.
Salsas were bland.

Fresh ingredients, great service, clean facility.  Had the Chicago style deep dish, it was delicious!  I am from Chicago so i can say with authority this is some good stuff.  We also had the vegetarian antipasto salad and the Rachar wraps...definitely recommend them.

Excellent service - food was very good. I wouldn't go as far as to say it deserved no. 1 restaurant from Philadelphia Magazine, but still very good. The beignets were delicious and you should definitely order the striped bass - if you like sweeter fishes, you will not be disappointed.

This is closer to 3.5 stars but not quite 4.  We'll definitely go back for the outdoor seating and dog friendly atmosphere outside.  However, it was a bit overpriced.  While we all loved our dishes,  after a drink each, two apps for 4 people and 4 entrees, the bill came to right around $150.  Just felt steep.

I priceline-ed a room in this hotel for $50 per night.  That was the best thing about our stay. 

Parking is very expensive for St. Louis.  If you don't have a car to park, this would be a good place to stay.  If you're traveling on a budget, stay elsewhere.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Fast. Super fast. You'll be in and out in less than an hour. (not a good thing). meaballs are good, but not as good as Barbuzza's up the street. Overall food is very good and reasonably priced. it's just that you'll be in and out in 60 minutes as opposed to an evening meal.

What more to ask for on a 1 night stay?  A good firm mattress, quiet room, free internet, free full breakfast the next morning - I chose very good sausage, crisp bacon, a fresh orange, good strong coffee, and an omeltte made to my specs served by the chef.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Not bad, not good. The staff have been pretty nice each of the few times I've been in. The coffee (now requested made fresh after receiving a cold cup previously) was a little better than OK. The donuts tasted day old, but still edible. *shrug* pretty much on par with all other D&D's outside of Boston.

Best Italian around! If you haven't checked it out you're missing out. The menu is simple so ASK the waiter or the owner to explain it more as its more than meets the eye. From the wine, to the soup, entree, espresso and finally dessert it is the best experience in South Tampa.

A dollar more than all of the other self car washes. But the big reason why I'm only giving them one star is because the bug remover scrub actually scratched up my windshield really badly. Couldn't believe the scratches I saw when I got out of the car wash. Never again.

My least favorite branch. Tellers are always borderline rude, and the wait is always ridiculous for simple transactions. I usually go for deposits or to withdraw money. Have had to wait in the drive thru for 15 mins. when other branches I'm in and out.  Not sure what happens at this location....

I'd heard about this place as a good late-night place to eat. We were generally underwhelmed by our food. My date, who will normally eat about anything without complaining, mentioned his food was "bland". For the price we paid, I definitely wished we had gone to Hungry Cat or Romanti-Ezer instead.

BADDD customer service. I like the bathrooms but, like some else said, the showers don't get cleaned daily. Gross. Pizza and tootsie rolls at the gym? That basically means they want you to keep coming back because they're feeding you food that counteracts the workout you just did. This is the worst 10$ gym I've been to in town
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Free chips & salsa for starters.  One friendly waitress who also was the only bus person too.

Good rock / modern folk Mexican music played over sound system.

Excellent tangy verde sauce over the stuffed white chicken burrito - delicioso.

Mole wasn't flavorful.

Pricing is more like $1/2 - $$.  BYOB.  Good for groups.

Damn good sushi for a neighborhood joint.  I've eaten here twice in the last week and was impressed both times with the freshness of the fish. Sashimi pieces are huge and reasonably priced.  'Special' roles are essentially the standards (dragon, spider, variations on the themes), but very tasty.  My current sushi go-to.

Look, your goal was to drink beer. I found that for this purpose, Emily will treat you alright. Don't sweat the many layers of security glass and cigarette advertising between you and the cold stuff. The beer is moist enough to sog the ass of a freshly changed babe. And plenty cold. Thanks Emily.

I absolutely love this place. I live around the corner and come here all the time. The only complaint i have is that my burritos never come with guac, whether I order guac in them or I get the surf and turf burrito... This has happened about a dozen times.

I eat here because it's probably the best pizza in town. But let's be honest, the bar is a little low for pizza in New Orleans. I'm not sure how I feel about the recent "portland airport vibe" interior remodeling job but I feel less ambiguous about their margarita pie, which is like a slice of heaven, pun intended

Great sushi, fair prices,  very nice staff. I'm not a huge fan of the location and parking can be very sparse. Prepare to parallel park. Closed on Sundays which is my usual sushi day so I don't make it over here too much anymore but its worth checking out!

Not bad, not great. The atmosphere was very cute and the service was wonderful. The "healthy" options menu was a welcome addition, but the dish I ordered was pretty ho-hum. Bland and not presented very well. I would like to go again just so I could try something from the regular menu.

Fun to go so you can say that you have been there.  However, be wary of the interactive bar tenders, they try to promote this and that, games, etc. and next thing you know there is shots that you didn't even take, but unknowingly purchased for others, on your tab because you lost a contest, game, etc.

I personally have had a good experience so far. Although there were a few problems scheduling my appointment with a personal trainer, my sister and I got a sweet deal on our membership; we got to split the cost since we live in the same household. It can be a bit busy around 5pm but that's a normal occurrence at any gym.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: It just dawned on me after doing this review, Pascucci and Palazzio I realized that Santa Barbara is in some SERIOUS need of a good Italian restaurant.  We need to get Mario Batali to open something up. No one in SB can hold a candle to Del Posto or Babbo.

Really happy to have another pizza joint to add to the rotation!  Slim's was really good.  The sauce is amazing and it was a nice thin crust pizza.  I had green peppers, oven roasted tomatoes (!!!), and black olives...great combo.  Stromboli was the best I've had in awhile!

Amazing staff, they were very friendly and professional. The Hyatt Regency St. Louis at The Arch is an excellent place to host or attend a conference. The hotel has a contemporary decor and offers a lot of perks from a 24-hour fitness center, large suites, and great restaurants.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
So disappointing. Gummy rice in the roll, like it was yesterday's. Really mediocre. So sorry it turned out this way after the pandemic. The hours are always off by an hour, either in the window (2 different sets if hours, there) and Yelp is way off, too.
Have to look further west now for a sushi place.

This place used to be a standout in chain restaurant food with outstanding service. The last two times there service was abysmal, the food was mediocre and the prices had gone way up. They have priced themselves way out of their league ($13 appetizers in a chain?). Will not be back.

Each course was a 5 star- drinks - appetizers-lamb meatball- "now that IS a meatball"!  Had read about the black spaghetti and it was truly delish- a nice portion but not so huge where you leave feeling as if you will explode. Excellent service- attentive but not obnoxious. Will return

There aren't too many places you can get away from the chaos in the Quarter and feel like you're at a local joint but this is the one I like.  Extremely friendly staff and good patrons as well.  You know, I might stop in there this weekend now I think of it.  :)

This place is a giant ripoff - there, I've said it. They have a large selection of beer and that's really awesome, but it's priced outrageously high. We're talking $10-15 over the normal case price. 

Go to Total Wine in Cherry Hill, NJ (next to the Cherry Hill Mall) if you want as good of a selection at much, much better prices.

We went for lunch to experience the half-price sushi rolls and were not disappointed!  I had the Spicy Tuna and the Crazy Roll.  Both were very tasty and the fish was very fresh.  I would recommend this if you're looking for a quick sushi lunch for a great price.  

Our server was attentive and kept my water glass filled!

Raspberry limoncello martini was YUMMY!  Mushroom fondue things were really tasty but not really what I was expecting.  The bread is good and love the free bruschetta.  Unfortunately my short rib ravioli was just so so.  I would probably go back if I'm in the area again though so that's a positive review.

I just discovered that McDonald's adds cream to their iced coffee by default. I usually get my iced coffee elsewhere. Fail. 

Otherwise very McDonald's-like in all other aspects. 

Oh, an obnoxiously loud pre-recorded message plays at the drive-thru speaker prior to you being connected to the employee.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Typical Americanized Chinese Food.

Everything you'd expect to find at a take-out Chinese hole in the wall except for the bullet-proof plexi glass.  

Do yourself a favor and take the trip down to Sang Kee or Charles Plaza in Chinatown, it'll be worth the extra 3 minute drive.

I've got no major issues with this National location.  The people are generally friendly and the cars are new.  However, I'm not a fan of having to go through the check in process - very annoying.  As an Emerald member, I'm accustomed to just walking out and getting in a car, they don't have that process at the Boise location.

I can't wait to go back. We had a wonderful dinner. You have to get the truffle butter gnocchi and pork ragu pasta. Best of my life. We had the soft shell crab special which was good, but the pasta is the star of this BYOB. Chocolate torta dessert was out of this world.  Service was cool and calm with great suggestions.

This review is for the slice of pizza I had. The crust was the best part; thin, chewy and a bit crunchy.The sauce & cheese were extremely bland; not much flavor at all. Can't comprehend how this place got such good reviews. I'm sticking to La Rosa a block away; no contest.

This location is great if you just need to jump on the interstate and go.  There isn't a whole lot of places to eat around the hotel, but it serves its purpose.  The room was typical marriott, decently clean but you could tell it had served many.  
The staff was friendly and took care of anything needed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This place sucks so much. I'm at this restaurant right now, yelping from my phone. It is that bad.

I waited an hour for my food and it's not that busy. Oh and when I finally got my food it was terrible. The worst sushi and udon ever in the history of the world. Don't go here. 

Don't ever ever ever ever go here!!!!!!!!!!!

Awesome food.  I had the Santa Fe Quesadilla and chips with queso.  Took half of the food home for a second meal.  Extremely quick service and a good selection of quesadillas, wraps, and nachos.  Plus, anyone that serves Gus' pretzels with queso is alright in my book.  I would highly recommend The Global Quesadilla.

I went here with my friend who lives nearby, and really enjoyed it.  The fish is really fresh, and they have some special rolls that are creative and delicious.

Their prices are fair; you'll probably still end up spending about 25-30 per person, and the portions are plenty generous.

I'd highly recommend it.

Cheesesteaks are my favorite in town. They're huge and delicious. Overall, the sandwiches are better than the pizza. This wouldn't be my choice place for pizza in town. 

They get points for delivering fries with wholes in the container so they don't get soft. So important! Who wants soggy fries?!

I like the concept of pay/weight fro-yo, especially because I load up on the fruit toppings which other fro-yo shops charge at a premium.  The guy behind the counter was nice and forewarned us about their fast-serving machines (beware: the fro-yo comes out at high speeds!).

3+ for local ingredients, super-friendly (bubbly, even) service, and delicious food.  I ordered the scallop entree and was very pleased.  Btw, the farro that comes with the scallops is a hearty grain.  My husband had the beef tenderloin which I really liked though he thought it was a tad too salty.  We'll probably be back.

I love this place and haven't been there for awhile. Some people complain because there's not a menu. But really there is you have several choices of whatever fresh food that Joe decides to cook for the weekend. It is a bit crowded but courtesy and service makes up for that. The food is excellent. BYOB.

There's no real reason to spend a lot of time on this.  Run of the mill, serviceable BYO Italian.  Straightforward stuff.

You can equate this to La Viola.  Probably best for groups as the dining room can be moved around easily, prices aren't bad, and anyone can find something they can stomach on the standard Italian menu.

I honestly don't know how people rave about this place, it's mediocre at best. Pasta dishes were bland. Atmosphere is pathetic ,tables with cheap plastic checkered tablecloths , Place is just loud at all times . Service was lacking .Place need to be updated desperately

It's a starbucks, but unlike some others the baristas here always have a frown. In the city that has housed amazing cafes since the really 19th century it's hard to jump on the Seattle-coffee train, we have our own style of cafe and it rocks. Anyone remember Kaldi's?

Breakfast, lunch and dinner place in the heart of Narberth serves solid unpretentious food in a friendly neighborhood atmosphere with breakfasts especially good.  The few outdoor tables in summer a pleasant way to spend the early part of a balmy evening.  Salmon dinner specials very good.  Reasonably priced.

With all of the rave reviews for Vic's will mine really make a difference?  Probably not.  But let me just say I agree with almost all of the 4-5 star reviews and can say that this has been, and continues to be, my favorite Rittenhouse sushi bar.  And...that's pretty much what it is, just a bar!  Go here and enjoy.

hungry and tired from driving south of the OC, I just wanted a beer and check the college game scores. Meh, I've had better, but the games were on and the beer was cold so yay for that!! Places like this have a purpose and this one served mine. I'll pay for that.

The rooms are the smallest I have ever stayed in. I had 1 window overlooking the hallway. 2 stars are for location and they are actually upgrading. Don't try to sleep in the construction crew will start at 9am.
The front desk likes to keep that a little secret
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Two stars, for the location and one that it is upgraded (new). 

Wow the rooms are small....very small. I was in room 402 and the only window looks out to the hallway. Not going to leave that curtain open. For the location and price I get it and if I have to stay in New Orleans again I think I would pass on this place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Positives: Clean hotel. Close to airport. Good rates. Huge fitness center. 

Negatives: You can hear the airplanes even though the hotel is a couple miles away. Awkward parking situation. They never picked up my breakfast order from my door so I had to make a last minute Starbucks run before work, which was annoying.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Maybe I came on a bad day, but this Starbucks was a bit of a train wreck. everyone seemed to be on their first day of work. Cashier messed up everyone's order. Simple things like water was overlooked. People with online orders were waiting behind people who waited in line.

It was general chaos.

Took my dirty winter car in for a BASIC car wash.  Polite guys cleaned and vacuumed my car inside and out.  Vacuuming and detailed cleaning of the cracks and crevices is my number one issue.  This visit did not require a "take another look" which I found gratifying.  Worth the price.

We really enjoyed Lucha. Great food, tried tacos, stew, soup and a burrito. Had to have a quick dinner before show at Powell Hall, really appreciated what the staff did to help the 6 of us get to the show on time! Every new restaurant has to work through its bugs but these guys have the right heart and great food.

Average Pita type place, but I'm glad to have one around.  

It gives you a health(ier) option for a quick lunch or dinner that offers hot fresh food.  Looking at their menu I've only seen a couple of things that appealed to me and I don't see myself branching out and eating a lot of different things at this place.

Wasabi is now our favorite all-around sushi place in St. Louis.  I actually think Miso has better sushi, but it's more of a bar or lounge than a restaurant.  Not really an ideal setting to go out for dinner.

Wasabi has great food, good atmosphere, and (usually) good service.  Highly recommended.

This place gets 3 1/2.  It's great for if you're craving Japanese and you happen to work downtown.  I also like it better than Koto, which seems to be the other downtown Japanese restaurant staple.  The food at Ichiban is a bit more authentic than Koto, and the portions are huge!

I'm not sure how I've forgotten to review this place but I really love it. As long as you can get past the crappy parking situation, you'll be good! 
Sushi is fresh, lots of choices, and service is solid. They're always friendly and make suggestions when you need them.

Grabbed some take out from here as a last minute change of plans. We ordered chicken and green beans and chicken and vegetables. We also had the crab wontons. 
The food was pretty average. Nothing stood out, but everything was good. I'd def go back and try some other things!

We came here around 430 on Friday afternoon and it was very busy but we didn't have to wait. 
We opted for couple rolls and some nigiri. Everything was tasty. We were served soup prior to the meal and it was a bit odd. 
Saki and beer were cold (as requested) and service was good. Will definitely come back!

We live within walking distance of this place and I have grown to really love it. The food is always good; they have a great full bar and the service is wondeful. The salads and handmade pasta are my favorites.
I would recommed this place to anyone looking for a great deal and a nice drink. Cheers!

Yet another reason to venture over to The Fletcher Place/Fountain Square neighborhood. A really cute gem of a place-and welcome addition to the neighborhood! All organic yogurts and topping such as Nutella-how can you go wrong?  Sit on a swing and enjoy your delicious yogurt!!

Pretty dang terrible. Food was not good and of shockingly poor quality. Particles floating in my cup of water, was not able to get a new cup of water without the same problem. Server recognized that we weren't happy with our meal and offered a discount coupon for next time. Never going again.

Nice people equals four stars.  I had a crappy stay and management apologized, they bought me the beverage Platinum members get.  I think it's the duty of a reviewer to comment as such correcting the review.  Give the parking garage people hell for me regarding no elevator!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place was so clean and friendly. They offered me bottled water. They have a special of a free manicure with a deluxe pedicure for $35. Best deal. I loved the technicians. It's so refreshing to find such a great nail place. I don't give 5 stars often so trust me when I say this place is a gem.

Had to bump up to four stars after just ordering delivery - the poor guy was dripping yet but was still pleasant and had put a black trash bag around the normal pizza case to make sure my pizza was a) hot and b) dry.  Full pies beat the slices, which is what I had when I wrote my 3-star review.

Not going to lie...there was nothing impressive about this place. I have been to other establishments in town that offer a way better experience for the same price. Plus, I found them to be kind of pushy when it came to upgrades in the packages they offer. My experience here wasn't bad, but I prefer other places over Luxury Nails.

The rooms are OK, although you feel like the furniture is all from Ikea.  The bathrooms are tiny, and feel like afterthoughts.  You check in electronically, and there are no bellmen or valet parking.

Overall, there are a lot of better options in the Rittenhouse Square area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This was about as average as it gets. I had the first floor room and they switched it for me. The room was clean, but the curtains were torn and the paper was peeling in the bath. It was very standard. I'd stay again for business, but would go elsewhere if I were bringing my wife.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Acceptable sushi. Shared the: salmon, yellow fin tuna, striped bass sushi, California roll, miso, and shumai dumplings. The shumai came cool, which was a bit disappointing. Nothing extraordinary with the sushi, but not bad either. Worth a trip and remember it's a BYOB

I been here a couple times. I've had the gelato and yogurt. Their gelato comes in behind Capogiro's but their yogurt is very good and worth a trip. Not the Dairy Queen type, clean light tasting. Also the toppings are very good. Had the mixed berry sauce with some dark chocolate sauce and hazelnuts. Yum

Eh, the sushi was ok at best.  I had the Tulane greenwave and it actually had sliced lime on it.  Tasted different, but halfway through I picked them off.  My husband didnt like his at all not sure what he ordered, but it was sweet with a brown sauce.  the service was ok and the seating was not comfortable.

I first came here a couple of years ago and it was decent.  But it seems like it's gone downhill, they had a total of three people to seat, serve, and prepare.  As you can guess, the wait at the table took forever and the sushi/desserts were sloppily made.

I visited this coffee shop twice in one day and had a hot latté and an iced latté, and loved both beverages. Each beverage had the perfect balance of milk and espresso. The staff were very friendly, and the shop had a warm and cozy vibe. I'll definitely be back for my future java fixes.

I have to admit that 

a)I still shop at Supreme at least twice a month and 
b)Not EVERYTHING smells like death anymore. They have fairly recently closed down the fish/seafood part of the supermarket. I'm not sure if the slightly improved scent has anything to do with that but I'll take it

Not a huge frozen yogurt fan, and it was cool out, but this made a nice dessert after a big meal.

Very friendly staff, who helped and made suggestions.  A huge variety of toppings, with fresh berries, all sorts of less-healthy options, and good sauces.  Can't wait to find one during the summer.

Went there with my staff during teachers' convention. They were a bit strict with the rules (only one bill for the whole group and must pay cash) but the food arrived fast and was really good. As a vegetarian I had two options for lunch, which, on that size of a menu, was all right, but not great. Still, a nice lunch!

Unagi is a solid choice for sushi in the Old Metairie area. I stopped in here with my wife the other night and even though we were the only patrons in the place, we very much enjoyed the sushi. I grabbed a to-go menu and plan on ordering lots of takeout from here in the future! 

BOTTOM LINE: Good sushi.

I stopped in for a McRib, assuming they were at all McDonalds by this point in November... much to my extreme disappointment; this was not the case at this location. I substituted with the new CBO burger, and although it's no McRib, it was still pretty darn good. 

BOTTOM LINE: As of 11/15/2012, no McRibs at this location.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Stopped by here for lunch with friends. The place is pretty run down and Defiantly dirty. We decided to try it since we had driven there. Average food and poor selection of overpriced soda given out of a can . Saw many health code violations including workers directly handling cooked food with bear hands. Wont be back.

This used to be a super goth/heavy metal type freaky place with secret doors and upstairs human torture cages with hidden nooks and crannies all over the place.  Now they have split the place up and ruined the whole thing.  Yet another place that just ain't there no more...

A nice little neighborhood grocery market that also has a decent deli with meat and three plates.  They actually have parking which makes it easy to do some quick shopping for needed items.  Martin's BBQ is also has one of their locations right next door so you can combine a grocery shop and BBQ stop all in one.

A nice little neighborhood grocery market that also has a decent deli with meat and three plates.  They actually have parking which makes it easy to do some quick shopping for needed items.  Martin's BBQ also has one of their locations right next door so you can combine making groceries  and a BBQ stop all in one.

Cute little spot for brunch. Parking can be a pain on busy mornings/afternoons, but nothing a few [dozen] circles around NoLibs can't solve. I can't comment on the interior layout, as I've only eaten at the outside cafe tables, but I enjoyed it nonetheless.

Not my favorite AYCE sushi, but it hits the spot! Sashimi is oddly cut, but they have a wide range from salmon, tuna, clam, etc. They don't over-stuff your rolls with rice to make you full faster, but their spicy tuna and salmon are over-filled with tempura flakes as fillers. Red bean and green tea ice cream for dessert is a plus!

It's all been said before, so I'll just summarize:  excellent sushi, fantastic prices.  I'm very picky about my Japanese food and while Vic isn't Morimoto or Zento, it's probably the best "budget" sushi in the city.  I just wish this place were closer to my neighborhood.

First try for delivery. Waited an hour and a half. But was told so upon ordering. Worth the wait. Tofu with spicy salts was awesome. Good egg rolls (and being a new Yorker I'm fussy about my egg rolls). Solid pork lo mien. Garlic pork was a little light on meat so that was the weak point of the meal. Otherwise great food!

So, I order takeout from here pretty often.  It's fast, cheap, average Chinese food.  I've tried a variety of things from here and its all been very average.  I've never had anything to rave about.  It's pretty much what you would expect from a place like this and for the price.

My order is a month old, the order status says shipped however FedEx says you have simply filled in the label, it has not shipped. I have written 3 separate inquiries to your support and nobody responds. Please address this within 24 hours or I will file a claim with Visa. Order # 3726657

Fish were fresh and the sushi were great.  
Had a few rolls shared between two friends and was pretty satisfied with things we have tried.  Will definitely stop by again.

The place was small and very popular!  Thank god we got there early.  There was a huge wait after we got done eating.

BYOB :)

For under $20 you can get a nice wash, inside and out. My stops usually take between 20 and 30 minutes. The staff is nice, they do a nice job drying the car when it's over. Pick up a Cardinal card and get it punched each visit. I think 10 washes gets you one free.

Screwed me over.  Won't rent from enterprise ever again.  Overcharged for a repair that was their fault in the first place.  

Didn't get the car I was offered.  The car smelled of dog (although I think that was the air freshener they use.  )

Enterprise has lost my business.  I'd rather pay more and go elsewhere.

At least there was Cajun music and the band actually could sing. My vote for best on Bourbon St.! Now don't get me wrong, it is disgustingly dirty and don't even think about going to the bathroom here - you may end up in an ER. BUT, this was GREAT music and so happy for the EXCELLENT BAND!

One of the nicer La Quinta's I've stayed out, it's on the newer side. Close to the freeway but far enough away so it's peaceful. Breakfast was included and nice, everything was quiet. No amenities except a gas station mini mart in walking distance, though Westport is a short drive away.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Decent Courtyard, but nothing special. Close to airport and I-95 which is convenient. Pay for parking. The only thing in walking distance is a Ruby Tuesdays, otherwise you have to eat at hotel or drive. Also, if you're returning a rental car, no gas station in close proximity so plan ahead.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Service friendliness was awesome, 5 stars. Price- $25 for a car wash- way too high. Quality- Had streaks on the front windshield which is what everyone sees when they drive out so 3 stars max. Hard sell on membership upgrade. Overall, decent but for the price and the dropped balls not in a hurry to go back.

Wasn't expecting too much from sushi in Nashville, but the place was surprinsingly good. I started with edamame (good) and Beef Negi Maki (subpar), and then switched to sushi which was all good- Alaska roll (excellent) sashimi sampler (decent) and unagi nigiri (good). Service was friendly and the bill was reasonable.

Standard McDonalds, though the airport location leads to a smaller service area so the food delivery is a little bit of a cluster. But they have a full menu I think and the staff was reasonably friendly by McDonalds standards. As for the food offering, unless you grew up under a rock you probably know what it is...........
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Good option if you want to stay close to STL airport. The shuttle service is relatively convenient and they will take you to the nearby rental car outlets instead if you want. The rooms are nice and pretty soundproof, so you can't hear the planes taking off. 

Not a leisure destination, but when on business, why not.......
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: 4 stars because breakfast is the best thing to get here no matter what time of day. Friendly staff. This is your basic diner/greasy spoon. Great for hangovers or when you don't brush your hair! Loved both times I've been so far. Can't wait to cure another hangover here!

My wife was raised in Brooklyn. This is NOT Brooklyn pizza!
The crust was a little dry but otherwise the pizza is fine, the prices are fine, everything was exactly what you'd expect from the average cheap neighborhood pizza joint. Nothing special here but they're okay.

I had panzarotti's here for the first time. However, they were way to oily. They do not compare to the consistently good panzarotti's I have gotten from Sal's Pizzeria in Marlton, NJ. The place is spartan, with security windows. However the service was friendly. Not much room to eat here.

we had an overall solid experience. service was great and the vibe within the place was definitely friendly. but the food just didn't live up to expectations. but we've heard so many good things about umai that we're going to give it another shot one day soon.

My tire BLEW OUT on Donner Pass and I was able to make it back to town and see Wes for help.  He ordered my tire, did my oil change and even fixed the corner where the bad tire had ripped a screw off of the body of my Lexus CT. Great service and very reasonable pricing. Thank you, Big O!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Well it is Starbucks.  How interesting can this review actually be?  This is your standard Starbucks.  They are friendly and fast.  They run out of stuff sometimes though and it pisses me off.  Other than that I guess you could say they are pretty comparable to all of the other 5 gazillion 'bucks out there.

I don't think you can go wrong here. It is an extraordinary dining experience, with culinary surprises around every corner and impeccable service on top of it. 

Dessert and drinks don't disappoint, either. Fabulous Pimm's Cup - crisp & refreshing. 

I'll be back and tell everyone I know how excellent this place is.

Been going here for years.  I love the staff and they do things right.
One time they lost a suit of mine.  Not great, but this happens everywhere from time to time.
The owner negotiated a fair rate with me, and offered store credit that lasted a few months.  Great guy.  Very honest businessman.
I would recommend.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Had dinner here with my colleagues from work to wish our summer intern well. The food was delicious! I had the Rigatoni with crab meat, scallops and peas in an Alfredo sauce. The portions were very generous. The service was excellent.  . . . and leftovers made for the perfect lunch the next day. 

What a great time had by all!

Need a break from all the country? Try Throwdown. Always a mix of people. Just remember that everyone is looking to have a good time, and then make it happen! Drinks are a little more expensive here then the other bars nearby, but it will give you some variety too.

Dining at the new Cafe on the Square was a pleasant experience.  Good location, nice atmosphere, great service and the food was fantastic.  Breakfast had a great menu.  I tried the homemade granola and yogurt.....AWESOME!!!!   If you are in the CBD, you should definitely try the place.  Well worth the visit.

Great selection. Good service. All you can eat. The holy trinity of restaurants. The reason it's not getting 5 stars is because I wanted twister to be part of the all you can eat menu. Hope they get this review and shoot for the for 5th star next time I'm there ;)

I have rented a van to haul some visiting friends and family around, and the van wasn't cleaned at all - smells literally like livestock, or horse poop. I was also told btw Abra that the deposit was 50, but it was 200. Not a big deal, just not was was told to me.  I will NEVER use enterprise again.

This is some of the best American-Chinese delivery in Nashville.  They have a huge delivery area...and will deliver out to Donelson, if not farther.  The food is cheap, tasty, and plentiful.  Try the General Tso chicken and be sure to ask for white meat chicken only.

Wait staff was attentive. Had a chorizo, alambre and Al pastor taco. Honestly couldn't tell which was what. Flavors didn't stand out. Chimichanga was served with cheese that was similar to nacho cheese consistency. Nacho chips were a lite on the stale side. Will come back to give the place another shot.

This was my first time visiting Vics and I will definitely will be going back. A small location, however their food makes up for it. I tried the shrimp tempura, philly, and spicy tuna rolls. All were very good, however I could have done with a little less cream cheese in the Philly roll. Prices are reasonable and service is great!

This is probably the last place that comes to mind when ordering pizza. However, it's the first place that comes to mind for pizza at the end of a night out.  They are open late and perfect for drunk food. Can order by the slice or whole pie. I haven't tried anything but the pizza so the rating does not reflect their other options.

I really did not like the place the people that worked there was not very helpfull pizza was not that good. I have been to New York a few times and had pizza there this does not do it justice. I have no problem with the size of the place some of the  best things come in small packages but this is not one of them.

Consistently good, reliable and tasty Chinese delivery. My go to!

Try these first: 
* Mongolian Beef
* Sweet & Sour Chicken
* Steamed Pork Dumplings
* Cream Cheese Wontons (I don't give a shit, judge me.)

Ask for chopsticks and tell 'em Diana on Pen Ambler sent you.

I only went to the adjoining liquor store, but the whole place including the restaurant was dimly lit. I just got my bottle of Reisling and kept it moving. This area reminds me of Detroit, kinda run down. The remnants of a once occupied shopping complex. A lil depressing.

With the sad closing of Calta's, we needed to find a gym close to home. We came to Youfit and the price was right. They don't have all the equipment that we were used to at Calta's, but it'll do. From 4:30-7:30pm during the week it gets pretty jammed, so be prepared.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This is the carry out shop for the Toscana restaurant. Food quality is high and the staff helpful, but the dishes have been getting significantly blander over the years. The lasagna is typically good, but almost very thing else in the case or on the menu is normally a bland disappointment.

Imagine the lounge on a Carnival cruise ship, stepped up a couple of notches. It's a great space with funky lighting and a firepit surrounded by water. My Mai Tai was delicious and high octane. But this is a smoky place. Lots of cigars, which I wish they would prohibit it.

I like any automatic car wash that doesn't scratch my paint. So far so good here. I do however, bring my own towel for the drying. They provide a small micro fiber towel that actually does a good wipe down, but my F-150 has too many places for water to hide, so I need a little extra. They never complain if I ask for two towels.

I don't ask for a lot from Burger King, and this location is always happy to oblige.  Breakfast or lunch, my orders here have always been received hot and correct.  Of course, they're a little slower than some spots, but if that due to quality assurance, I'm down with the wait.

I've had ice cream at Bo's several times during my life, mostly when I was younger, but a few times in my adult years, and I've got to say that there ain't nothing special about their treats.  Haven't been back in years, and probably won't.  I'd have to be pretty hard up for some soft serve!

Always fast, always correct and always fresh.  As far as Subways go, this one is my favorite.  There is one at the opposite end of Country Way in the Winn Dixie plaza,  but it tends to be over crowed and at times difficult to get in and out of.  Too much hustle and bustle for my sandwich liking.

I only got my eyebrows waxed but wow! Core took great care of me. She spent a lot of time, waxing, trimming and making sure everything was perfect. 

When I found out it was just $8 I was shocked. I also saw a gentleman getting his beard trimmed and the detail there was the same. Hope to go back for a haircut while I'm in town.

I went  to Cafe at the Square 4 years ago. Someone was recently asking me about the wet food in New Orleans and I had to let them know to visit this place!!! They have the BEST fried green tomatoes!! Years later I'm still thinking about how amazing their food was xoxo

Asked for 2 personal pan pizza with 2 toppings on each. 

The person on duty told me it was cheaper to order 2 medium pizzas. I should of objected right then and there.

According to there menu the cost would of been 19.90 instead I was charged $36.00.

They didn't care or offer to make adjustments.

Good pizza but terrible service

The food was good and the price was fair for a shrimp Po Boy bake potato and drink was $12.80.  The place needs updating and needs to keep it tables cleaned.  The lack of table service will be a reason for me not to come back that often but if I want a PoBoy on the run this would be a good place.

Not the biggest grocery store, but it does its job for me.  I come here for my chinese veggies, and it's always fresh and the prices are cheap.

Get yu choy, broccoli, baby bok choy, garlic (5 bulbs for a dollar or so), couple boxes of tofu, soy sauce and sesame oil and you have yourself a tasty healthy meal for under $2/meal.
