What can you say? The Habit is definitely a good choice if you're craving a burger. It takes about 10 minutes for your food to be ready but quality always takes time. I would definitely choose to eat here over any other fast food chain. Their chicken club is one of my favorites and salads are always good. Fries are ok.

This bar opened up and we were thrilled! It has a great decor and wonderful beer selection. They finally added $5 burgers and $3 fries to the menu full-time; it's a GREAT deal. Great bartenders, great folks - GREAT place. It's our neighborhood bar and we love it. You can buy 6-packs to-go, which is a nice feature as well.

Nothing elaborate, but I'd stay here again.

A friendly and professional staff.
There is a swimming pool.
Wi-fi for $3 a night.
The rooms are accessed from an indoor hallway.

This place is WAY BETTER than the Motel 6 in Willcox, Arizona. Just a suggestion if you're driving through.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Apparently I'm a sushi snob.  I'm starting to think that there is not a good sushi place in New Orleans.  Sake Cafe is entry level sushi to me.  I would recommend it in as far as it probably won't make you sick.  I don't like the zen wannabe atmosphere, the service is hit or miss and the sushi rice is always too warm for my taste.

Possibly the LOUDEST place I've ever stayed. Right on a major highway. No sound dampening on the doors or windows. You can hear the traffic and people waking by your room talking in a normal voice as if it was all in the room with you. Never again.  Shame on you Mariot.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place has the WORST calzones I have ever had. Undercooked and under flavored! The dough almost seemed raw inside and the broccoli inside was obviously frozen. Not good at all... Maybe ok for college kids but defiantly not some place for professionals to eat.

Had one of the best dinners here! We went with the four course prixe fixed dinner with wine pairing. I had the tuna nicoise, octopus, lamb rigatoni and dirt pudding. I was so impressed with the robust flavors of the food. I ate and drank every last bit of my meal and cannot wait to return.

I had a blue burger, which was just like home.  My wife had the ribeye sandwich.  It was good, if a little tough.

It's a divey, bar kind of place.  We say outside, and the view was fantastic.  Service was swift and kind.  Overall, a good experience from which we will look forward to another visit.

Needs a little work, we had mediocre service, sushi that was not fresh (albeit on a Sunday but that's no excuse) and there were fruit flies that were buzzing around constantly.    The server was not  "Modern Japanese", more like lower-end Chinese restaurant performance.     I hope they read this and improve.

Good service, but for some reason the past two times I've been there my drinks have been kind of "meh."  My husband's coffee was also filled to dangerous levels, which facilitated the making of a huge mess as coffee leaked from the cup.  With that said, the store is modern, clean and new and it's in a great location.

great flavor ... good tortillas,  and Pico was great. yeah El Pollo Loco is good but very commercial. I do miss their green salsa.  but this place was good, and the chicken was cooked just right.  not too dry, as El Pollo Loco can be.  Ill Def be back soon.  next time a whole side of Pico. need to have beer, and I'd eat in.

I love this place! I have lived around the corner for over a year and never ventured in. I love the pool tables and games. However, I ordered an Aperol Spritz and let's just say... I found mold in my drink. I ended up drink Ming wine - but I will probably not order another mixed beverage when I go back.

decent mexican food that won't blow you away but also won't leave you disappointed.  it's simple, mexican food.  fresh chips are a nice bonus.  Does Las Maracas compare to the mexican you'll find in Texas or California..no way.  But for Nashville, it serves it's purpose.

stuck in Nashville and needing a Pinkberry or Red Mango fix?  Krave is your spot.  nice selection of flavored yogurt (mango, red guava, green tea) including the tart style served @ PB/RM.  I prefer Red Mango's tart flavor but Krave satisfies when you're jonesin'.

Blows away Yogurt Oasis.

one of the best Japanese restaurants in Nashville.  Solid sushi, great atmosphere, 2 for 1 sake happy hr 5-7.  I was really surprised to see Tonkatsu ramen on the menu...so nice to have in Nashville!  

beware of the chicken teriyaki...it isn't traditional japanese style...more americanized execution.

definitely worth a visit.

Best authentic street tacos in town.  Simple - meat, onions and cilantro (option).  Not expensive. Not fancy. Just great flavor.  You can go typical with carnitas or shredded beef or go wild with tripe or cabeza.  

Dining room is loud, but bright and fresh (after complete remodeling post-fire).

I have become a regular here. The staff are very nice and get me my drink and bagel quickly. They don't cringe when I bring in DD coupons all the time. The coffee is average as DD coffee is, but they don't put too much cream and sugar in my drink when I ask for it "light," so I appreciate that.

I won't be coming back to Sushi-Ten. The sushi did not taste fresh. One of the rolls was so mushy I had to force myself to eat it. My husband was dousing his in Sriracha to be able to eat it. At first the service was good, but once our food got to the table we had to flag them down (a couple times) to get the bill.

I work in University City, so I frequent the lunch trucks quite often. But every once in a while I get a hankering for a couple slices of their veggie pizza. Fricking good. Their tomato carpaccio salad is tasty, as is their mozzarella panini. 
My only complaint is that the kids they put at the registers are kind of idiots.

A great sushi surprise a few blocks away from the liberty bell in Philly. Original plates, the salmon was excellent, they have a nice looking bar, always crowded. A gem when you arrive to Philly. Ambience is very casual. Reasonable prices. A great place to go.

If there ever was a home of sushi, Sukura would be the Indianapolis sushi home. Its the freshest (isn't that what sushi is about), with the warmest service and the buzz of locals that keeps us going back. Tried the others in indy, but this is the very best there is our city has to offer.

Not the most amazing pizza but definitely better than frozen pizza. The slices are huge but extremely thin so it actually isn't as much as it looks like. It's a great spot when you have drunk munchies. Is that even a word?  Anyway, you get what I meant. They sorta close whenever they feel like depending how busy it is.

Quite disappointed.  I called to check the hours (it was a Sunday afternoon) at about 4:45 and was told that the place closes at 5:45.  I asked if I could come for a wash and interior cleanout and was told no problem.  When I got there at 5:15, I was told that there was no more vacuuming available.  Nice.  I left.

I ordered a "BLT sub."  I found it odd that each of those ingredients was confirmed with me as he was making it: Bacon? Yes. Lettuce? Yes. Tomato? Yes.  I wanted to explain that if any of those ingredients are omitted, it's not a BLT but I didn't think he's understand... (and I would hardly call this Rittenhouse Square.)

Definitely NOT a brewhouse by any means.  Only a few draft choices and were out of the one we wanted.  Service was terrible.  The kitchen was so far away our waitress forgot what she was going for every time she left.  Food was average.   Would not recommend by any means.

I was stop by last week for a pedicure and dipping nails done. What's a disappointment my toes cuticles was cut and still bleeding when I got home, the dipping were so uneven and thick like acrylic and my cuticles also all around I dares not come back to visit and not recommend unless you want to get injured.

As far as Airport food goes, this place is pretty good.   The service sucked, but the food made up for it (as far as airport food goes).

I shouldn't even review this.    It's not like you run across terminals to find something Zagat rated.       

Carry on!

The pizza is great! Wings are good.  Burger is... meh.

I've only had take out/delivery, but the place seemed clean inside.  Employees are friendly.  Price is competitive with other pizza restaurants with delivery. 

I had a baked pasta once, and it was also really good.

Staff was eager to push the most expensive things on the menu.  But the service was good and food was decent.  Disappointed because my steak was cooked medium-well when I asked for medium to medium-rare.  Great happy hour place though.  Build your own martinis... no need to say more, I'm there!

Cozy coffee shop that has good coffee, friendly baristas and good lighting. Only downside is there's not much space for seating so know that before going in.
It also gets pretty loud if you're trying to have a conversation so don't come to spill secrets :)

I'd definitely make this my go to spot if I lived in the area.

Food was great. Definitely recommend the German Sausage Plate! Consistent quality.

Restaurant isn't a looker, but can be easily fixed with a good sanding and coating of polyurethane.  

Nice owner. Very chatty, in a good way. Should try and play some music in the background. Owner said he likes Bob Dylan, so play some Bob Dylan!

Do people really have high expectations of Chinese food?  I tend to set the bar not too high, so for me, the food didn't disappoint.  However, I do wish there were a couple more bean curd dishes on the menu.  I felt limited with my options as a vegetarian.

This is a first for me: I liked the waffle cone better than the frozen custard.  The flavors were underwhelming in comparison to the other frozen custard establishments I've tried...but the waffle cone sure was tasty!  

Knowing the other options in the area, I'll drive farther south next time.

It's Mc Donald's enough said.  We don't come here for the high quality healthy food we come because the kids like to play.  It's not the cleanest but on a hot, rainy, or snowy day this is a place the kids can unleash their pent-up energy and give us parents a few moments to ourselves.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
What a great haircut. For $13 you get the full treatment with high attention to detail. I felt like I got plenty of time and consideration even though there was a line of customers waiting. Total time walking in to walking out was about 30min.

I loved the haircut, and I'll go back for my next cut!

I was disappointed in this place.  Don't get me wrong - it's clean and cheerful, and the people are nice enough.  But I was hoping for better haircuts.  My children have wavy hair and it really needs layers.  The stylists here seemed to be more of the typical "kids cuts" stripe.  I guess you get what you pay for.

Dismal and depressing.  Location was perfect for the convention, but the rooms are dismal. Bathrooms are unattractive and tiny. No minibar.  Mattress soft as a marshmallow. Front desk people are indifferent. The valet lost my key and took a long time to find it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Old building & carpet, definitely needs to remodel. Small rooms. Smelly hallways. No breakfast/coffee/cookies like any other hotel charging $140/night. Wi-fi is extremely slow. When my room was cleaned I didn't get any amenities re-stocked.

Received 2 stars because they have a great gym and the staff is friendly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Very good West County choice.  Had a good crowd on Friday night but we easily got in.  I had the chicken stir fry and enjoyed it.  The burger looked really solid too.  Of course the smoked shrimp is always a winner, a copy of Annie Gunn's unfortunately.  only complaint is the menu doesn't change very much

Awesome car rental location in South Tampa! Service is super friendly and they have a great selection of cars. We've rented the Camaro convertible a few times just for a fun weekend trip and we've always gotten a great deal. Highly recommend if you are in need of a rental car in S. Tampa!

We moved to Mt. Juliet recently from Los Angeles and my husband is Mexican, so of course we have made the rounds to try all the Mexican food in our new town. This place is the best so far. Our kids loved it. Excellent salsa, beans, enchiladas...The staff was really friendly. All in all, I give it an A+.  (Great homemade flan too!)

Fun little market tucked away on Pima and Columbus has pretty much what you might be looking for in a pinch for Oriental foods and drinks. They have Saki and beer and some kitchen stuff as well and frozen goods. If you're seeking fresh Tofu and things I would try Leelee Market.

My first visit here was fine, and the truck was washed well- seems like a couple of spots were missed. You hang out while they take the car, and it took about 10 minutes, and they vacuumed the interior. My second visit through, there was a 45 minute wait just to do the $10 wash. I declined to wait and drove on for somewhere else.

This is a neighborhood staple and favorite BYO that offers very solid, classic Italian dishes at a very reasonable price in a relaxed environment. Service is always fast and friendly. Never had a bad meal there. It's definitely a go to when it comes to a casual weeknight dinner when we don't feel like cooking. Great place!

On a recent cross country trip we stopped in her for a cone and really enjoyed their interesting flavors. We got the sampler dish so we could try multiple flavors since we could never decide with so many that sounded so good. It was very good and we ended up getting a second one to try some more of their great flavors.

The staff were fantastic, quick, friendly and attentive throughout the meal.  The chicken quesadillas are good, but the beef enchilada is not that great.  The ground beef poor quality, tortilla is too thin, way too much cheese.  I could only eat half of it.  Margarita was OK, not much tequila and served in a plastic wine glass?

A nice retro feel to the bar makes for friendly faces.  Juke Box has a wide variety of music ranging from Indie/Alternative Rock to Motown/Johnny Cash.  Bar is spacious and has seating that fits all type. (Bar stool, couches, booths and tall tables)  Great for a date/nightcap or for a group festivity.

The only way to really describe this place: MAD DECENT. 

The flavors are awesome. The toppings are abundant, though some a tad stale.

I don't see why anyone would travel up here outside the Temple student body, but for students, this is a really, really good froyo establishment.

Will come back!

BF and I have been here at least 3 times.  The crab and avocado salad appetizer draws us back every time.  Everything else is pretty good as well, with large servings and addictive bread with olive oil.  +points for atmosphere and decor - tables are spaced apart so it doesn't feel crowded, decor is warm and nice but not formal.

Nobody expects quick speed of light service in the big easy, but waiting 35 minutes after signing contract for a car is insane.  At the end of my rental they did drive me to terminal in my car, and the entire experience was much nicer at end than at start,

I went there a couple times with my friend who lives in NOLA.  They are inexpensive and have a very big variety for what I expected.  There were always enough checkout lanes open, and we were usually checked out quickly.  The staff isn't overly friendly, but they are efficient.

They do a great job with the car wash itself and vacuuming. We didn't get the full service detail but the detailing that comes with the country club best wash was OK. Still had some spots that we had to ask they touch up. The customer service however, was excellent!

The cocktails and food were really delicious. We went twice in our 5 day stay in St. Louis. We loved the pizza and the appetizers. It was very pricey for pizzas but they had great happy hour specials. Service was excellent.
I would go again in a heartbeat.

i came here for a classmates's birthday. it was a neat concept when i heard about a piano bar, but it got old with me quick. they played a lot of music that i don't listen to. however the band is pretty talented and everyone else seemed to have a good time. this wasn't really my cup of chai.

I go here often. really good if you are tired of 'fast food' run of the mill. always get great service, good prices. clean small resturant to sit and eat, has a TV always full or semi full. Alot of take out fans but I like to sit at the table and eat to unwind here.

got my glasses. They are bi-focals so I had to be told how to use them. They work. I would have liked to been shown more updated frames but next time I need frames I will know to look on my own. I am guessing because I used my insurance they assumed I wanted to pay as least as possible.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I can't speak to the sushi bar, but totally love the beef yakiniku. Nice variety of goodies on the side... Good miso soup, tempura shrimp and veggies, salad, etc. Add a Sapporo and some hot saki, and you have a satisfying outing! Good service and atmosphere.

Had to update this review because the last couple of times I've been here, I got the regular pizza (pepperoni) and it was very good. A lot better than some of the other pizza places around here that charge $12-$15 for a pizza. And the staff is so friendly too. And $5 for a large pizza?  How can you beat that?

More like 3.5 stars. Good ice cream and shakes. However, the shakes are around $6 a piece (even though the board said $5 and my total for two shakes as $12 something) and not worth the price. I'd say maybe $4 would be right. 

And nobody uses Nestle Quik mix in their shakes, or even give you that option!  What's up with that??

It is great that this place is open to allow people to satisfy their drunk food cravings. The problem is that the pizza is terrible. It tastes like frozen pizza, and in fact I have had frozen pizza that is better. Would expect more from a place in New Orleans.

I live close by so I go there every so often. I've only eaten there once and had a burger. It was decent. The service is disappointing. Most of the time I go to the bar for my drinks and I don't find the staff very friendly. If it wasn't in a convenient location I would go back.

Make reservations if you're going for dinner- especially on a weekend.

Our party ordered filet mignon, pork chops and roasted Chicken with the crab cakes for an app. Everyone was very happy with their food. The service was good and worth the prices (which jump $10-20) from lunch.

Thought the service was GREAT - everyone was extremely friendly.  The negative aspects ... 1. We sat closer to the people at the table nest to us than each other and 2.  The entrees were not so great; the turf, of the surf and turf, was close to terrible.  Don't think we'll be going back any time soon.

This place has always been a Tampa gem. Open 24/7, this diner has a large menu, from breakfast all the way to full dinners. And everything in between. The staff is very friendly and swift. I never have to send anything back. I'm here mostly late at night with my friends. Try this place. You will not be disappointed.

The fact the most Mexican food as we know it tacos , burritos come from Mexican farm workers and Californios (Castillian Californias) the east coast will just never get Mexican food ride. Also the agriculture has a huge part to play. I mean the place is ok, but it's not the real real!

Best hibachi in the area, especially for the price!!

Japanese soup, salad, rice our noodles and two shrimp come with dinner.

The fillet is delicious and makes sake sushi my favorite steak house.  Everything is consistently delicious!

I am more or less addicted to this place!

A hidden gem in an unusual part of town. Delightful creativity with many homemade ingredients. We loved the lamb and peanut butter appetizer with mint pickled blueberries. The burger was rock solid. Less loved were the Frickadella meatballs, good but not special. Menu changes everyday, we will be back!

A great place to grab quick lunch when I'm in Pinellas Park. Fortunatos downtown is now closed, but you can still get their pizza in Pinellas Park. Sandwiches good too, as they've got a bunch of lunch specials (til 4pm) which adds nice variety. Tough to pass up those desserts up in the front case!

I like their yogurt, especially the taro yogurt which is hard to find. It's not self serve but they have plenty of different flavors. They also have seasonal flavors that changes.

I haven't been here in awhile because I live on the other side but it's a place that is easily visited when going to the Theaters.

I had Mac Grill for my homecoming back in the days and I really liked it. The servers were nice and I was able to draw all over the tables (white paper) without getting in trouble. The food was really good for a decent price and the interior was really classy.

I had no problem with my experience with Mac Grill and would go back :)

The "x-hole" and I sometimes meet up here when he stays with the kids for some of his weekends.  

Very nice hotel - thankfully it seems safe.  It's also clean and the staff is friendly when I went in a few times.  

Nice décor too.  

My kids used to like their pool when they were younger.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I don't think Ive been here since cutting hs w my friends! Its improved but what a crowd!  Strangers talking to us spooked my daughter!   

Im ready to eat my hand - skipped lunch and apparently breakfast all day is popular!   Waiting and waiting ....

Only thing Id order here - the rest goes through me like a freight train!!!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Very cool space. Love the outside patio portion and the games out front. They had live music going the day I went and he was playing at a perfect volume which can be tricky. Food is a slightly elevated bar food. They have a really large menu and great drinks! Will def be back!

With the gem show it was very crowded- the  margarita happy hour is great prior to your long wait. I love salt around the rim. For dinner I had pollo con mole - wish a third enchilada was included - only two enchiladas yet it was very delicious! I will go back when it isn't so crowded.

So McDonald's is McDonald's and sometimes you are drawn to fast food, like a McDonald's chicken wrap with fries!!  But this place is anything but fast, and it's hell to get in and out of.  The lettuce on the wrap did not taste particularly fresh.  I think I'll skip this one from now on.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Came back here a few times for lunch and the rolls aren't consistent. One week it's too much rice then the next week it's drowned in too much soy sauce. This place has lost a star from me due to not making my favorite roll (white dragon roll) as good as it once was.

Wonderful food!  Friendly service!  But portions are on the small side, which for a $20 plate of Lobster Ravioli - you would like to get more than 3 pieces.  It's divine, but it would be nice to get 4 or so, I think.  But I love these kind folk and when there's more than a few nickels in my pocket, I'll be back...

I love DD, but coffee just doesn't tasting right at this location. I've mentioned it to a few employees, one said its the same as everywhere else, and the other told me to ask for fresh coffee cause I'm probably being served the old stuff. I need to ask for fresh coffee at a Dunkin Donuts?!?!?

We lived just down the street from this store for years, and didn't come close to sampling their entire beer, wine, or hard liquor selection. 

The staff are awesome, and their recommendations have always been spot on.

Finally, they organize periodic tasting events which should not be missed.

Finally Brandon has a great Italian restaurant that is inviting yet affordable! The atmosphere and service are great. Lighting is romantic, cozy and staff is knowledgable and attentive. The food is amazing. First visit ordered the veal parm - best I've had! We will be back.

I have tried most of the sushi restaurants in New Orleans and Sushi Brothers is still my favorite.  No frills, great prices, and delicious rolls.  The Black and Gold Roll and FEMA rolls are must trys!  The service staff works as a team, and I have received excellent service every time I have visited.

I'm not really a country-girl, but I had fun here. There was lots of dancing, and most of the people were really good dancers. The floor was a little sticky and the people a little pushy, but over all I had a good night. I don't think I would come back here on my own, it would have to be for an event of some sort!

These places are like cockroaches - they be everywhere.  And, for the most part, they're all the same.  They have friendly staff, they serve decent coffee, and the ambiance is comforting.  This location certainly doesn't divert from the norm - they have friendly staff, they serve decent coffee, and I feel comfortable there.

Had a delicious dinner. Reservations here on a Saturday night are a must. Luckily we had one and our table was ready when expected. Service was a bit slow but the food was worth it. We started with the Tuna Tartare  then I had the Veal Saltimboca and my wife had the Zuppa de Pesce. All of it was top notch.

Alwways good, never exceptional.  Friday night is all you can eat sushi night and it makes sense if you are going to get any specialty rolls.  Free soup and salad comes with.  The kids love the "show" and enjoy the food as well.  Not a bad night.  Service in the bar area can be very slow.

We ordered a coffee here and sat outside at their patio. The coffee was brewed fresh and the patio was nice and refreshing over the small indoor seating area. 
Staff here are decent but not coordinated well. They actually seem understaffed as it took a while for everyone to receive their order.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I come to Patel market all the time!! The quality of the veggies is high and they have the full spectrum of spices to fill your cabinet. Definitely grab some homemade samosas at the register, trust me, they're the real deal and extremely tasty.  The parking lot is small and this place is super busy all day long too.

Nice people. But just had some bad experiences there. When I try and use the Starbucks app... it frequently says that they're out of items. It hasn't just been today. But pretty much every time I use the Starbucks app. Hopefully they will get more items in stock. Again, nice people. Nice location.

Worst service I have ever received in Philadelphia. Took 25 minutes to get menus, rude host, couldn't even get check to pay. Did not get enough silverware nor napkins, our wine was never opened. I am just flabbergasted by their audacity and outright rudeness.

Meh.  Pass on this spot.  Yes, it's inside of Reading Terminal Market.  But on the other hand, chinatown is only a couple blocks away.  Speaking of a couple blocks away... Dim Sum Garden is only a short walk from here.  You'd do yourself much better to go there instead.

This is bland food for a mostly transient client base.

Thank you Yelp for directing us to Bugambilias as it is a great find. Their food is definitely authentic and delicious as everything is prepared with fresh ingredients. No cookie cutter meals served here. Love the Charo beans which are full of great flavor. Cannot wait to return so we can try another auth

Not a fan. Way overpriced compared to other sushi places in the area. I have been here twice. Eel is my favorite type of fish, but here it is not cut or cleaned properly. My rolls had giant bones in them. I guess if you know what to order, it's ok. I've tried a few things there and I wasn't a fan of their assortments.

Although I have to come back to try some more of their food. The place already sold me on the pillow seatings and scallops. LOL. I know. I just love the pan seared scallops, which were super delicious, juicy, melt in your mouth. Overall, a nice place to go eat. I would definitely come back.

It's okay as a go to place when options are limited around the area.  I've ordered many things here when craving for some takeout Chinese food. It was alright, just like any other ones. Price is standard. Certain items I was really hoping for it to be better like shrimp in lobster sauce, cheese wonton and hot and sour soup.

We gave this place 2 chances....each time was the same.  We spread our visits out over a 4 month periods to be fair.  The service was the worst I have ever experiences at a restaraunt.  The shrimp is frozen...and I mean frozen so much you taste the burn from the freezer.  The sushi is sub-standard....don't do it.

We had not been to Greeks in a long time. If I cant find a parking place close by I give up and go further south on College. Still great pizza and bread sticks. Service tonight was just ok. Great windows for people watching while eating. On a warmer day eating outside would be nice.

Oh Micky D's ....get rid of the self serve kiosk. Leading people to use them this morning instead of getting personal face to face service is tacky. They have the ability to replace 6 employees with these things. I won't use self checkout in the grocery. I won't use these. Just another way to cut jobs.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This Kroger is one of the dirtiest stores I have ever been in. Trash all over the the front of the store outside. Trash all over inside the vestibule. Aisles littered with boxes. The company really needs to look into how this location is ran. Even with a lack of employees there is no reason to look like a dump.

Beautiful hotel. Courteous, helpful staff. We booked this at the last minute because of flight delays and were so pleasantly surprised. This will be our "go to" Tucson hotel from now on. The breakfast buffet is great and in a comfortable setting ... not the crowded "cattle call" like most places.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I guess I'll give this place 3 stars due to its location and level of competition.  But if they were to move this place near SF, CA, it would be a solid 2 stars (tops).

I guess if you're here, you may as well order the sushi and nothing else.  The bento boxes, noodles, and fried rice were all pretty bad.

What a delightful place. Service, food, music, ambiance, all of it-wonderful and delicious. We will be back. Paradise roll and Mt Fuji rolls were delicious, and Gyoza app was unbelievable, so fresh and flavorful. Great deals too: buy one roll get one half off.

Well, I said I hope they continue to serve good sushi ... and they let me down tonight: spicy tuna roll with not much spicy nor much tuna-y flavor and a sweet potato tempura roll with mostly raw sweet potato.  First Vic's goes down hill (post sale) and now Jay's is sliding???  Sigh...

I was interested to check out the new place down the street, but when I tried their three-roll combo, that was the end of that.  The rolls were smaller than most I've had lately and they had very little flavor -- three different rolls and they were all pretty bland and all tasted roughly the same.  Disappointing.

Very hit or miss in service quality & wait time. More often than not your drive thru time is at least 10 minutes (order to receipt of food time). Food itself is standard or sub standard for the chain.
One star for the ladies who take your payment. That window always has someone friendly
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Would love to review the food...but we've been waiting in line for wayyy too long. Three people have left the line it's taking that long. If we were not the next car in line (past 15+ minutes) we would have left by now. Just take my money and give me food!

Wow, so careless in preparation, quality, and portion. Shredded beef tacos had less than one tablespoon of meat per taco, and the beans tasted like Rosarita's canned beans. Skimpy on the lettuce and cheese too. They used to be one of the  best fast Mexican food places - not any more.

They have legendary Sonoran dogs and their beef caramelos are the stuff dreams are made of. Even better is they have three locations now, so it's easy to get your fix. Always consistent quality, preparation, and friendly service. If you're lucky, Guero Canelo may even be there and ask you how your meal was and chat for a bit.

Very nice family owned business. I was referred by family friends who have taken their Mercedes here for years, as the Mercedes dealership was not yet in town. He did an oil change and other check ups for $135 (after he quoted me $150) Mercedes wanted $250. Glad to support the local team. Thank you Bob, my car is happy!

Meh, I thought the sushi here was just ok.  Came with friends and was a bit disappointed.  My co-worker had the pad thai and it was terrible, but another co-worker comes here all the time and loves it.  It's a cute spot and the service and decor were nice, but I wasn't impressed by the sushi, so I can only give it 2 stars.

The staff was VERY helpful!  I was searching for bourbons and whiskey and they had a nice selection across multiple price points.  The staff was knowledgeable and helped me find some new ones to surprise my friends with.  I did not spend much time in the wine department - but the spirits were great.

Are you going to get all star gourmet food here? No. Are you going to get fast service, good takeout, and reasonable prices? Absolutely.  I am a frequent patron of Panda Garden and have never been disappointed. Food always comes quickly and is always tasty.

Great ice cream! Friendly staff! Unusual flavors, that are all delicious!

I had the Drunken Brownies (two scoops in a wonderful waffle cone) and I  loved it. The group I was with tried a bunch of different flavors, and everyone was happy! 

Sampled the Goat Cheese Habanero... and it was yummy!

You have to try this place!

This Publix is frequently busy. There are times when it isn't as crazy, but I'm not stupid enough to ruin my shopping times ;)  The wine section has a pretty good selection.  Last weekend, they were sampling a few wines.  The cashiers and bagpeople are friendly and efficient.

I like a hotel that has the conveniences of home.  Stove. Larger refrigerator and full size coffee maker.  Couch and basically all the things I need on the road with 180+ days a year on the road.  Still haven't had the breakfast as I bring my own.  Overall a great staff, quiet hotel and works for me.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Very friendly staff and clean hotel that was set off a bit from the road so it was extremely quiet as well.  They don't have a pantry to buy various items which is a bit odd as most do so bring change for vending.  I would stay here again if in the area and 2 restaurants are nearby so easy to grab a meal.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I do not understand how this place has so many positive reviews. My husband and I went because we had a Groupon and we lived nearby. The food was really bland- just not good. The service also left something to be desired. There are so many better places in Clayton!

Staff is very friendly. Last week they had no creamers to go. Today they had no sugar packets.
Long story short, I had to throw out both coffees because I like it the way I like it. Not with the equivalent of 9 scoops of sugar and a half cup of creamer. Sucks.

Been here a few times because it is close. Lunch ayce is 14.95.  No appetizers like Rick shaws, but the quality is better. Will be back but with so much selection in Reno, it might be a little while.  One thing where this place stands out from the masses is that tehy have a blackened cajun tuna sushi that was quite good.

I had never been to their previous location, but I can say from my first experience here recently, I will be going back to Sushi 7 for sushi again. I liked every single roll we tried and it was fresh and delicious. The rolls came to our table in a timely manner and the service was very friendly as well. Loved it!

Cool bar! I think we would've missed it if it hadn't been on the cocktail tour app we had, and it ended up being one of our new favorites. I'm sure it didn't hurt that there was an awesome jazz band when we were there. The decor was interesting and bartender friendly. We just had beer; will come back to try a cocktail.

WOW!!!!  We went here on a no carb day!  Their amazing selection of sashimi was out of this world.  There was a bit of a wait but they were able to seat everyone very quickly.  And the food was out of this world.  Hands down will visit again when I'm in the area.

Stopped by when I was in town on business. This was the worst sushi restaurant I have been to in my life - and I've probably been to more than 50. They charged me the wrong amount when I check out, did not have WiFi for customers and the sushi just tasted awful - lots of rice and the fish wasn't fresh.

Omg!  I love this place! The food is great and the drinks too. The staff is fantastic and I love how a place can recreate itself elsewhere better or as good as that the original. The spirits are top shelf and the food was delicious and savory. Thanks to whoever had the vision to create this place here in Edwardsville.

China King has a distinct advantage over my go-to Chinese food spot in U-City...the fact that they're open Sunday. The rice is about the same, Hon's wins on General Tso's chicken & their egg foo yung gravy, China King gets higher marks for customer service and cleanliness of the waiting area.

I want this place to succeed so bad, but so far I've only encountered one competent member of the wait staff.  The rest are too busy smoking.

Good beer selection but drinks are a bit on the pricey side.

The specials really are specials: when they're gone, they're gone.

Come on guys.  We're rooting for you.

Avoid this place if you can. The service is very poor and unfriendly.  The attitudes of the employees made me worry about the quality and preparation of my food. I like Wendy's restaurants overall, although I've definitely observed a disregard toward customers the past few years...I'll drive past this one.

Pizza was as expected, I did a pick up it was ready, that was great, the wings were disgusting. They were rubbery, no breading no char no nothing, and it was like somebody just dumped Frank's red hot over nasty wings. Couldn't even eat the six I ordered because the texture and taste were horrible

I brought my dog in for an urgent appointment and they were able to get us in the same day. An urgent care visit is $54 (not including lab tests or meds) which is about average from our experience. Front desk staff was friendly and the Vet was great as well. 
They due offer annual pet plans as well as boarding and grooming.

Small and cozy. Great for meeting your clients or work related meet ups. Not crowded which is great for me.
drinks are Starbucks drinks. nothing special there. just ah.
in summer bring a jacket if you get to stay longer. the staff cranks up the a/c to a freezing cold.

The service here is absolutely horrendous! 

It's always extremely dirty here also.

The donuts are always hard and never fresh, no matter what time of day I go! 

I go here every couple months to give it another chance. I always leave with regret, very annoyed, and unsatisfied with what I bought.

*Barf*

Bourbon urine is green because of these foul sweet azz drinks.  The "strongest on Bourbon St." is a joke.

I drank 2 of these in an hour and didn't get a buzz on.

The only cool thing about this is the souvenir cup.  Oh, except that they won't let you bring it in to any other bars....so actually, not cool.

Ehhh. I've been here a few times, always out of necessity (waiting for bike repairs at Trophy Bikes or waiting for friends who are hours late to show up) and it's been decent. It's a little slow, the food is alright bordering on good. It's the price that kills me. $12.00 for jambalaya and $7.00 for collard greens? Yikes....

Rancho Grande recently spent a lot of money investing in this lively-looking bar area. Friday night's feature their mega-margarita for $10.99. A wide assortment of traditional Mexican food pales in comparison to the family atmosphere. Make sure to stop by and tell them you found out about them on The317Live.com.

Bartenders are slow to ask for your drink and to refill those lonely ice cubes. Food was tasty, lots of variety, and ambiance is spot on. I wouldn't race back here so quickly if my wife didn't like it so much.

I would recommend going at least once for a bite to eat and cocktail, but don't go to expect a full meal.

Meh. Although fried rice was tasty it also had a rubbery texture. Crab Rangoon was blandish in raster, maybe a 3 on a 1 to 5 scale. Water was excellent.

Staff is very friendly and when not taking or serving orders they are cleaning tables and restocking condiment area. Service bumped West End Wok to a 3. It was close.

Good selection of food with Korean twists ;)
Food is fresh and tasty but it seems that Tucson has it's own style of Japanese restaurant, carpeted, bright dining rooms with plethora of Japanese fusion meals in the menu to satisfy the most "demanding customers".

This is a nice Starbucks location.  It is large and has plenty of comfortable places to sit.  The service was fast and very friendly.  They also have plenty of merchandise for sale, in case you need any of that.  It isn't your old style neighborhood coffee shop, but it gets the job done.

I love the Creation Cafe.  The food is beyond excellent...and in ample portions!  The fish sandwich is the best I've ever had.  The beer selection is awesome.  The only reason I did not given them 5 stars is because the service is not as prompt as it could be, and they stopped giving out the croutons before the meal.

Don't be fooled...this place is only a McDonald's.  The decor may be nicer than the usual that is found at the Golden Arches, but the food is the same.  The service is what you would expect from a busy, fast-food restaurant.

Of course, I only go to this McDonald's later in the evening for vanilla soft serve and coffee.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place is down right cool. There's tons of stuff to look at, and everyone there was super interesting. (Yes, I'm a big people watcher.) Tori was my stylist and did a great job. Because I was a new customer, I also got a coupon to use next time. Score! For once, I am really looking forward to going back to a salon.

Great place. Good food. Kid friendly. Menu changes often.
I especially loved the apps. The curried cauliflower, pretzel, and a corn pudding special. 
My lamb entree was good - but not as good as the others people ordered - especially the goat tacos. And I'm not even a goat person.

its all good sitting at the bar (sushi or booze). 
i'm a regular (bimonthly) and have never been disappointed.  
its not the largest selection or the cheapest prices, but it wins points because it is close enough to bike to, the servers are friendly, and the food is tasty.

Their pizza was pretty damn good, but the place is a little too well-lit & pretentious. I'll still probably go back if I'm craving a thin crust pizza and I'm in the neighborhood. It was super packed... I'll probably go back on a weeknight. 3.5 stars for being reasonably priced.

Every time I shop here I regret it.  Selection and price are not great - it seems like they are always out of something I need.

However, my biggest beef is service which is just terrible. Employees vary from inattentive to just plain rude. 

I have started going to the new Giant in Springfield - a million times better.

As I am not a huge Sushi fan, I really enjoyed the selection that O'Sake had.  I do not eat raw meat, but felt the that vegetable options were wonderful and even tasted better!  The group of 6 I was with were the only customers in the establishment from 11am - 12pm which was a little awkward, but nice all at the same time.

It's a totally normal McDonald's, but the only annoying this is that there's no lights out of the parking lot, and it's on a busy road, so you're gonna have to wait a while for your left hand turn. Other then that, it's as clean as McDonald's gets! Friendly employees and cheap!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
My son would give this place five stars.  He would live there.  He would name his first child FroYo.  But, since I'm not four years old, I'm not as enamored.  

Nothing is wrong with the place.  The toppings always seem fresh.  They keep it clean.  Good way to cool down.

I don't understand the bad reviews.  I consider myself a food snob and I really enjoy it here.  The GADP has always been clean, food good, service decent.  I like their burgers and baked potato soup.  I'm gonna have to try breakfast here soon and see how they do.

Been here quite a few times b/c the little one likes to sit outside and eat her pizza.  The pizza and Caesar salad are good.  But that's about it.  Their pasta dishes are loaded with sauce and lack flavor, crab cakes were very bland, desserts are so so.  Skip it unless you want pizza and salad.

I haven't had the sushi here, but the hibatchi was sub-par. We had a party of 8, and it was the SLOWEST hibatchi I've ever experience. The chef served us ONE dish at a time - we were there forever! And we didn't even get to all eat at the same time. Try somewhere else.

Quality has gone down a bit, not as good as Sushi Palace, but the service here is much better than Sushi Palace, Sushi Palace I believe has the worst  service I've ever seen...

I'll take decent food and goodt service, over great food and crappy service ANYDAY!!

The price has gone up a little recently, but they are still one of my favorite spots in philly!
You have to try their Gyros, Burgers, Pizzas, and Wings!! Unbelievable!!
The cheesesteaks are ok, but the above mentioned are outstanding!
I always visit them if I'm in the vicinity! Like today!

Nice little local market for korean & japanese grocery items: oils, vinegars, seasonings, cooking wines, frozen grocery/meats, and kimchi & kimchi ramen!! 

Friendly service, though the woman did keep asking my 1yr old if he wanted us to leave him there?  (not a chance!)

I generally like Sheraton hotels.  This one is just o.k.  It is showing its age, and is in need of some rennovation.

On the plus side, I had a room service lunch that was pretty good.  Also, the staff was friendly and helpful.

The location of this hotel is good, and the prices are reasonable for downtown Philly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I work downtown and have eaten here a number of times.  It is just o.k.

The food is good, but not great.  The portions are not huge, by any means.  The prices is o.k. for a hotel restaurant.

The best thing about this place is the nice view of the Hillsborough River.  For good food, you can do better in downtown Tampa.

This review is just for the conference facilities -- I did not stay here.

I attended a 50 person meeting.  The meeting facilities were quite good, and the public spaces of the hotel very attractive.

Based on the meeting experience, I was impressed with the facility and would give it a try if I needed a hotel in this area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Organic Dry Cleaners !!!  I LOVE these guys!  Don't you hate putting on a sweater that smells like chemicals?  Me too, but the wonderful folks at Cardinal use an organic cleaning process that eliminates that nasty smell.  They also do alterations and repairs.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Good creamy treats on a hot and humid night at the Pass-a-Grill beach. Nice to have the option of sitting inside with the AC or out on the patio with others when you have your dog with you. Prices were on par, not ridiculous and the ice cream was excellent.

This location is pretty bad. I just went there this morning and tried to use a starbucks free reward. You know what the cashier said to me.."we don't redeem rewards for free drinks anymore" i'm like who/what/when/where/why and she just ignored me. Pathetic.

pretty bad exterior.. bad location for a bank.. this branch has some issues with customer info breaches, other than that, they have the top sales people in tampa b/c their clientele is 85% spanish but still.. wouldnt even think of retirement with this bunch either..

Great variety and super rich! 

Cool flavors - Blueberry Pie was my last tasting and it was great - and they keep rotating! 

My recommendation, walk there and walk back home - you'll need to burn off those calories! 

CASH ONLY.

867 (Food, Service, Ambiance)

4/2011: Closed and became something else.  Rats!
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Very good food and service.  Romantic atmosphere.

Entrees are very tasty and well prepared.  Worth going out of your way for.

I hate to say it, but the quality of this place has gone downhill. The last few times we have gone, the food was less than mediocre and the service was just bad. It's a shame because they used to have some really great things (except the bad Salad bar and weird dressings)....disappointed!!!

The previous ratings are pretty accurate.  The food was ok...portions small, everything is ala carte, so don't expect a vegetable one potato with en entre.  Service was below average...very hurried, not real friendly...seemed like everyone had a bit of an attitude.  Expensive for what you get unless you like a lot of attitude!

Wanted to update that after the latest incident of not opening on time I finally got in touch with a manager who gave me a free month off my membership. Regardless, it is super inconvenient to never know if the gym will actually be open when I get there at 5am or not.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
This is a great nail salon. I went here when i was in college and the years after when i worked in west chester. Each year they have improved the look and feel of the salon. 

They are friendly and have great colors to choice from. I have sent everyone i know who is looking for a salon to these guys. 

They are worth a try.

Update again.  There are two very good Asian markets in Tucson, Lee Lee and this. I like them both. Lee Lee is more international and this is an old fashioned Chinese market, jumbled with lots and lots of stuff.  Better prices than Lee Lee.  It's been here for a long time. The owner is a nice guy.

Casual & inexpensive with great food.  Did I mention the huge portions?  Love the market too - it's a favorite place to stock up  with all of the ingredients for making carne asada tacos at home. Try the marinated (preparada) beef with grilled veggies and you'll be hooked.

My friends and I eat here a lot after dinner. We're huge fans of Yogorino.The wall decor was interesting. The gelato selection was good even though none of us got it. My friend and I did get froyo with dark chocolate and blackberries.

This is the perfect after dinner dessert place.

Yup, this is a place where you can rent cars.  Is there much more to say?  They treat their preferred members (free to join) well, with car-side drop-off.  The lady who minds the gate is very friendly and sweet - it took her only 2 weeks to start recognizing me as a regular.  Otherwise... um... it's a car rental agency.  Yay?

never again,pedicure and tips $85.00,pedi was okay but the owner Victoria did my nails and was so rough,swear she was trying to file my skin!then she wanted to wax my eyebrows,had them done 2 days earlier,money grubbing,hard skin rubbing,non-friendly lady!

Aside from the fishy fishy fish smell, it was pretty good!  I think the smell would subside with more people in the restaurant.... I ate at an odd hour of lunch with close to no one there.  

The sushi was good for Philadelphia standards, which kind of means nothing.  It satiates, I guess.  The prices are good for lunch.

This is a great location if you are in town to enjoy the French Quarter. Walk across Canal and you are there. It is noisy due to the trolley and energetic revelers, but that comes with the territory. Rooms and lobby are nice, I was glad to have stayed here. Pay for valet parking ($26/day) and walk everywhere.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I go hear for Lunch once in a while, and I think the food hits the spot. Although its not the highest quality, the dishes are yummy enough were I crave the fajitas. Their lunch special is pretty reasonable. I would go back for the cheap eats, but would be hesitant to return for dates or any special occasions.

The new incarnation of Pair is so cozy and inviting.  We didn't even know it existed, but stopped in on the walk by to check it out.  Quiet, good drinks, comfy seating, the atmosphere reminds me of the dark little row bars in San Francisco that I miss so much.  I'm a fan.

Pretty bad, went in for a quick lunch got the Speedy Gonzalez lunch special.  I've never had a taco with such little flavor in my life.  It was litterally browned ground beef with close to no seasoning at all.  Good service good atmosphere food was some of the worst Mexican I've had to date

My wife ordered pizza from this place and gave her credit card number over the phone. The next day, we got a call from PNC saying someone tried to spend over $1000 with the card. There is no such thing as coincidences.

So, if you want to eat food prepared by thugs, cheats and scammers, EAT AT LEBEL PIZZA!

Good place to take your car to get inspected. The waiting room is nice and clean, with a TV, computers for internet use (costs $1), vending machines, and free coffee. Quick and friendly service. I was in and out in less than an hour. Inspection was $54 with tax and everything.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I've been to Tsuki three more times since my first review, twice for the Sushi entree  and once for the Sashimi entree. Every time it was a very good experience with super fresh fish and nice miso soup or ginger dressing salad. I would love to see more variety in the fish, but like I said before it's good basic sushi.

Went here for an early dinner today. Service was nice. Food DISGUSTING. chicken cesar salad was dry and I paid 8.95 for just chopped up lettuce a table spoon of cheese stale bread and 5 peices of crutons...only the fries was best. Waste of money. Gave 2 stars for the fries.

If you need a quick over night while flying this is the place to stay! It is newly renovated and feels very clean and very nice! 
I have stayed here about a dozen times and I don't even look to stay anywhere else!

Great airport shuttle, nice breakfast in the morning.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Went there for just a couple drinks and ended up staying till Midnight.  $5 buckets of beer!  Can't beat that.  Iggy's has specials every night.  I did forget it was Mexican and got a pizza because I was not in the mood for Mexican for late night snak.  Was glad they had the TJ's Bacon Pizza!

Overpriced and horrible, The slices are small. They burned the living heck out of mine and my husband's (I also observed the table next to us picking most of the crust off for the same reason). VERY greasy and the inside was under cooked and mushy. Never again. What a waste of $.

Everything was so covered in olive oil.  Both pasta dishes (I got the pesto with ricotta, my boyfriend the spinach & sundried tomatoes), the side of broccoli rabe, the garlic bread, even the house salad.  It's stomach turning.  Wait staff was good.  I don't think I'd go back though, to be honest.

Nice spot on corner of 18th and Samson. Ate outside on a nice night which was a plus. The waitress, Ary, was very good.  The food was good, but much better Italian in the city.  I had a grilled shrimp and bean appetizer and grilled calamari for my entree.  Good, just not memorable.

We lucked out and went here for a last minute lunch and got a table. Love the feel of this place and the food and service were both great.
We shared a bunch of stuff and everything was delicious.
Arancini, meatballs and a salad were great starters and my fish for my entree was perfect.
A great spot.

Does the job. Inexpensive and quick take-out. Beef and broccoli was a little oilier than I'd like, but definitely tasty. And the portion was huge. The staff is friendly and attentive enough that you could probably ask them to cook with less oil and they'd do it.

Decent enough pizza. As others have commented: it's definitely a soft-crust kind of place. Cheesesteaks are adequate. Not my first choice for pizza in the area, but they'll get you through in a pinch. Definitely better than Domino's if it comes to that! Grab the slice and soda special if you're driving by.

Friendly neighbourhood bar in the French Quarter somewhat away from the madness. Good beer selection and friendly bar people. Every day there is a different special dish of the day - usually something creole or cajun. When crawfish are in season and the weather cooperates there is a big boil going on once a week.

Hands down the BEST ice cream I've ever had, and I love good homemade ice cream. They have really different and fun flavors and encourage you to try some to determine what you like. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable and seemingly equally excited as you are for you to try the ice cream.

This is my favorite bar. It has the mixture of 50's honky-tonk and new world vibes all together under one roof. The mixture of people is about as eclectic as the bar itself. Great Art, great bartenders, great events and live music. S. Beach has Club Deuce...we have The Emerald.

I haven't tried the pizza yet, but we ordered cheesesteaks to be delivered last night, and I was very disappointed. The roll was soft, and even a bit soggy. The meat was overcooked and dry. The french fries were crispy, though, and actually above average for a local pizza/steak shop.

I absolutely love this place the food is great and the staff are always friendly and if you start coming in on a regular basis they remember not only your name but the food you like! I will continue to get the Singapore noodle and the cashew chicken they are done well and the spicey tofu is awesome!

Fortels was great when Bob was alive (the owner died a few years back) and we would go there all the time but now they are huge and seem to care less about the pizza and more about bringing in the dough.  
Don't get me wrong, it's still good... just not great like it was

Sadly, we recently had to put our old dog to sleep. The staff at Boulevard Animal Hospital made the process as comforting as such a thing can be. I know their prices can run a little higher then other surrounding vets but I believe the quality of care justifies it.

Not to pour salt on the wounds but I'm with the others. This DD sucks.

How old is this DD ? Felt like I traveled back in time to the 1977. 

The prostitute with leather jacket and boots was pretty hot though - not gonna lie. I always had a thing for blue eye liner.

Coffee was lukewarm water with a hint of sugar. 

horrible.

Well, it's not disgusting, but the price is on the accurate to high side. Hasn't been kept up at all. This place hasn't seen a coat of paint since the early 90's. Attention owners: put a little money into this place. Staff is courteous, but I want to dip my body in alcohol and I ain't the squeamish type.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place has become one of our favorite Mexican joints in the St Louis metro area.  The food is excellent, the service is above average and is close to or house!  The salsa is really good even if the chips are a bit too thick for my tastes.  Still, if it's Mexican food you want, you won't be disappointed!

If you are looking for a quick place for a lunch sized pizza for under $6.00, drink included, then this is a great place.  The pizza is not the best pizza in the world but it's certainly good and given the price, it's a heckuva deal!  The staff is outstanding and caters graciously to any special orders we have.

Well they did it again. I recently purchased several cases here for a party. To my dismay upon arriving home I realized I was sold a case of victory with a past due best by date of 2 weeks prior to my purchase. I was charged full price. These guys are truly the worst!

I like their coffee. Sometimes it does take a while to get your orders here.  So I know not to come here if I have limited time or am running late. It's convenient and inexpensive.  So it serves it's purpose. I actually like the taste of their coffee compared to Starbucks..  yeah I know weird.

This place was just okay.  The food was okay, while the staff and atmosphere were nice, loud and hospitable.  It was kind of expensive though for the portion sizes they give you and not really worth it for the taste.  I could see why this is a local fav though with all the sports and ease access in Continental Ranch.

It really bugs me that they can't spray off both sides of my car before I go through the wash even though I asked them to each time. This seems to be a reoccurring problem and I hope it will be addressed.  The air dryers at this location are worse than other locations... And it always leaves me drying to do by hand

Solid, has a tv, and is one of the only places to catch a game in this part of the airport.  Bartenders aren't bad, but didn't like me ordering a soda.  Can't blame him.  Again, solid but nothing great about it either.  Actually I take that back, it has very nice golf decorations.

You don't have to drive to St. Louis to find great sushi.  This is a great, convenient place to go when I have a hankering for sushi...which is frequently.  Very nice waitress.  Sometimes they get busy and are a bit slow, but other than that, no complaints.

I've eaten here twice over the last year, and both times I felt the service and ambiance was superb, especially for a suburban fine dining establishment. The food, though fresh, was light on the seasoning side. I've eaten at some of the restaurant groups other places, and those (Ela in particular) did not have this issue.

Womp. The mat cleaning machines are broken, and I'm not surprised that they wait til you've already paid to unapologetically declare this. 

Considering I can get better customer service and working machines for $3 at other washes, this place deserves a big "meh."

The dr. Doses are amazing! Their prices for dental were very reasonable and they were very friendly and thorough with the whole process.  You can tell they really care about the animals and love what they do. I was very comfortable leaving my dog with them for dental work. They have my business for all my pets needs!

The service was very good as was the atmosphere. Unfortunately, the entrees were hit or miss. I love spicy food, but the chorizo flatbread was too hot for my wife and I to enjoy. The lamb lollipops were great, the scallops were just so-so. Really wanted to like it, will give another try.

I definitely am not a fan of this coffee place I was excited to try something new but the coffee tasted strange and dirty to me. And I also felt like it was all vegan and natural ish and I couldn't order cream or sugar or anything seemed like that wasn't an option. Coffee went into the trash I couldn't drink it.

Horrible experience! Staff was rude and unwilling to cooperate with us and our promotional coupon. Too many restrictions to the promotional coupon that were not listed in the rules. Will not be visiting again.  The food was OK, but the service from the manager, waiters and bartender was horrible.

I went here on a Friday, arguably a busy day for a bank. The employees were nice and professional, but I am baffled by the lack of foresight. On a Friday they had one person working the window. One. On a Friday. Seems like bad planning. I stood in line for a pretty long time.

3 1/2 stars. Good quality pizza, decent prices. It's just a pizza place, so it doesn't pull any surprises, but it's consistently tasty and for locals it's conveniently placed on a busy street. Great for all ages, especially youngsters just passing through for a slice.

Great ambience, fresh sushi, fairly priced. Stopped by for lunch.  I'd recommend the salmon sushi bento. Salmon was seared well on the outside, tender and moist on the inside. It was not overlooked at all.  The ginger salad dressing on the salad was fresh, light, and slightly tangy.

Humid weather calls for delicious ice cream creations! My boyfriend and I took a street car from our hotel and we stumbled upon this amazing ice cream shop. With amazing ice flavors such as lavender honey to peanut butter fudge pie....who can resist? 

Bring cash and 6 mini scoops for $6.

Much improved service and food quality over the prior Mexican place that was here. No frills, just fresh ingredients and friendly service.  It's obviously made to order, which in my opinion is the way to go, I don't mind waiting a little extra for amazing tacos.  This is me and my husbands favorite taco joint in the area.

Rexy's is probably most famous for being the hang out of the 1970's Flyers teams. The carpets, wood panel on the walls and the booths haven't been replaced since Bill Barber ordered a Bud and a Turkey Club. Things look old and beat up. The food is average at best. Rexy's had seen better days.

Not that bad but not overly great either. I don't think that I can really say that I have ever had "bad" pizza in my time but I have had some pretyt decent stuff.

This is a decent lunch spot for something quick. Not sure I would go here for dinner though.

I love this place. Prices are decent, food is amazing. Calamari is fantastic, and their buffalo wings are surprisingly good. 

Desserts are okay- my parents had the tiramisu and loved it, my husband and I had a type of custard and it wasn't great. 

Last time we went, service was very slow.

Cozy with decent coffee, a bit too bitter but it's OK.  The staff is always nice and attentive. They even bring you your order at times if it's slow enough. I have fallen asleep after reading some magazines in the back. It's very peaceful and chill.

They have some moderately/cheaply priced sandwiches. Overall, it's a great place.

I've been here once.  I ordered coffee and quiche, both of which were delicious and neither of which were the problem.  The problem was the snarky little bullfrog with a bad attitude that worked behind the food counter.  That fool needs to mop the floor with that attitude.  What a dishrag.

Their corn and crab chowder sounded so good on the menu, but what a disappointment! Imitation crab in a pasty tasting chowder. The corn was fine - fire grilled and from Indiana- but it was seriously the worst chowder I have ever had in my life. The service was fine, but what good is service when the food is awful?

Another local establishment that we can count on for a good meal just around the corner.  In addition to their normal service, we have also been here for large group events and their Sunday brunch, and found their handling of both of these types of events to be fantastic.

Best sushi in town, in a strange strip mall, but really classy on the inside.  Ken, Sherri, and April are super personable behind the bar, the tall lady, I think owner they call "mom" is really sweet and nice.

The hibachi is fun and great, I wouldn't do anything differently if I owned the place myself.

Yummy bison burgers!
I've been here several times, and never been disappointed. The burgers are great - I try to get bison whenever I can - I especially love the S.O.B and the Cadillac combos....
Service is quick and friendly, noise level is a little high which makes it good for kids and groups.

I had Mediterranean salmon and Greek salad. The fish was awesome! I'm gluten free and I do worry about finding good healthy and tasty food. This place was comfortable, service excellent. Servings are large so I felt ok spending a few extra dollars. Highly recommended!

This place was part of the Lopez chain of 6.  It now seems to be owned by someone else and has changed its name.  The food was not a patch on Lopez on the murfreesboro road, much more greasy and flavorless.  Not much to say, disappointing but of course cheap.

We only see Dr. Sara.  He is a wonderful doctor to our pets and has handled everything from vaccinations to a final farewell to our beloved first dog with compassion, gentleness, and kindness.  I wouldn't say he's a people person, but he definitely is an animal person.  We wouldn't go anywhere else.

I ordered delivery; the employee over the phone was very helpful. I ordered edamame, vegetable spring roll, avocado cucumber roll. The food came an hour after ordering. The sushi was so fresh and delicious. The spring roll got crushed during delivery but it was still very good. I would definitely order from here again.

SO PLEASED!  Made appointment for teenage son who can't quite figure out what to do with his hair.  Ashley made him very comfortable and went to town.  Cowlicks are now under control, styling is super easy & it looks fantastic.  The boys new go-to place.  FINALLY!

Extremely fresh ice cream. Flavors are not all that inventive. And the mix-ins are too skimpy. Like for example, if you get cookies and cream ice cream here, the Oreos are few and far between. They skimp on ingredients.
Another disappointing Florida ice cream joint.

This is a great little oasis hidden in a very ugly Florida strip mall. Food was fresh, sushi was fresh, prices are not cheap. If you have the Japanese craving, give this place a try. As long as you are not a Japanese food snob from San Francisco or LA, I think you will be satisfied.

The Starbucks locations in Tampa Bay are below average. Usually they are mobbed and have below average staff in terms of drink-making skills. This location is no exception. If you want a large Starbucks to hang out in, check out the one on MLK Jr. Blvd. in Tampa. It's never mobbed and staff are nice.

great variety!  
I don't live in the city, so this is a nice treat on a pretty day to take a drive out to creole.  
A few times the service has been a little "attitutdinal" but honeslty think they were a little annoyed at people at the counter who can't decide what to order.
Remember- cash only people!

Airport bar with a decent beer selection, full bar, wine list.  Foods are mostly "east coast" style sandwiches, like cheesesteaks.  I had a goose island IPA and parmesan tater tots.  The tots were kinda greasy.  The overall price was airport extreme, almost $20.00 for the two things.  The service was a little slow but nice.

We ordered delivery it was gonna take like 45 mins it was really fast we ordered hot n sour soup yum broth was spicy n fresh yes had the eggroll good veggies not crisp but good flavor mongolian beef was very tasty enjoyed our meal sweet n sour chicken good too I will go here again

Excellent service by the staff and really fun cool rooms.  It's by the airport, so if you're just in for night flight it works great.  If you want to use aloft for weekender and journey into the city, you'll pay $33 each way for a cab.  The bar downstairs is fun and the pool is alright.  Parking is $7 a day.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This location is the Original Habit...I love any place with a history and an interesting story. The char burger combo is a yummy deal and the fries are always on point. The outdoor seating with soft drink machine is accommodating and clean. The staff is nice also.

I've been holding back, been a member for 3 years. My biggest complaint is the wifi. If there is no one in the gym it is average, more than 10 people what is wifi. Nothing in the free weight area. This is after they upgrade the equipment. I use an iPhone 6s, so this should offer more insight.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
The monster roll is delicious. The selection is great and I also like the seaweek salad. 
I will certainly come back. It was a wednesday night and we were the only people in the restaurant, for the whole 2 hours we were there. I felt bad for them, but at the same time I liked the intimacy and the vip service.

I have been here a couple of times now for carry-out, and have been very pleased with the menu, food, and staff.  It is Americanized Chinese food, so don't go expecting authenticity, but if you want hot fast Chinese-American comfort food to go then it's perfect.  I'll definitely be back.

Why does this place not get in touch with you when your payment doesn't go through or when you switch banks? Why do they wait so long? Every other place I deal with and all my bills let me know ASAP when the payment doesn't do through! Am I missing something?
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This place and GREAT WALL in pilgrim gardens are the ONLY chinese places you should go to in the entire general area. Dragon always has super fast accurate delivery. Not expensive either. I have never actually been to the store- but have ordered delivery time -n- time again. Very fresh. Try it and you will see!

I was surprised that Oro Valley even has sports bars.  The atmosphere is not bad, and the individual TVs at each booth are pretty cool.  The food was not bad - wings were decent, salad was reasonable, and corn chowder was pretty good.  All in all, OK, but not anything out of the ordinary.

REALLY good sandwiches here.. The salads are top notch too. Soups good and hot and the service is excellent. Ravioli is delish. A step above your normal pizza place.. Clean inside and the decor is darn nice,. Not any thing bad to say about this restaurant..

Been going here off and on for years and never had a bad meal. It is our favorite NE Philly Italian restaurants. All the food is prepared to perfection and its never too spicy. The gravy is excellent. The white clams and linguini and the manacatti are our favs.

Still one of our favorite local Pizza and pasta restaurants. Ya gotta try the chicken parm! It is top notch restaurant worthy! Nick is a great guy who has owned his shop for decades.He cars about everything his restaurant makes and it shows. Keep up the good work and we will be lifetime customers!

Overpriced food.   Would not accept a restaurant.com coupon because we told him we had seen a show upstairs earlier that we paid for.   The place was completely empty.   The bartender (owner) was rude.  Made a point of trashing other restaurants that we said we frequented.

This is the best place for matcha ice cream, friendly staff, and they give you a generous portion for the amount of money I paid. Their ice cream is so smooth, seriously better than any other places I've tried, including places in Hong Kong, California, etc. Definitely recommended!

I saw four stars and thought this place would be exceptional. I can only rate it 3 stars. I had the Cody Roll and Fried Rice. It was good. But I can't say it is some of the best sushi I have had. There were only a few people in there during the lunch hour.

The presentation and unique dishes were amazing! The raw oysters had an amazing flavor with just a dollop of purée that was ten times better then the usual accompaniments. The dishes are small plates so you do have to order several to fill you up. The atmosphere was also unique--rustic farm decor dressed up.

I have been coming to this market since I was in college.  Interesting selection of items and great housewares for the person who loves tea/rice/Asian inspired dishes.  I do not live that close anymore but if I find myself in the neighborhood... I always stop in to look around.  

Prices are reasonable, items are unique!

I would work on the lighting in the space. It was a little loud for my liking but may have been the crowd this night. The Risotto with shrimp and crab is outstanding. Also had a bite of the pork chop and it was out of this world. 

This feels like a family run restaurant. The staff was warm and welcoming. 

Definitely coming back.

First visit was okay. Not great, but okay. The food was tasty, well-prepared and the service was friendly.

The second time, everything we ordered was dry, dry, dry, dry, dry.

I had hopes this would be a nice neighborhood place with outdoor seating for me and my dog, but I don't see a future for us eating here.

Bad. It wasn't this bad before. The special chicken sausage and asparagus torta was cold and the steak knife it came with was too dull to cut through it. The chocolate hazelnut crostata was burnt. Service was fine. I'm adding a star for the embarrassment of having to sing Happy birthday to my daughter.

Great drinks and outdoor bar atmosphere. I almost always get a burger at Knight House and I'm never disappointed. The french fries are likewise tasty. The last time I was at Knight House I got the prosciutto flatbread. Like the burgers, the flatbread was delicious and perfect alongside a cocktail.

excellent customer service and management is accomodating...there are some unasked concerns involving accessing a gym like this which is manned partially during the day and so on...15 dollars a day for a guest pass...thats not that bad...BUT you know GOLDS and other spots aren't this expensive.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: mmmhm, so getting back into Santa Barbara and using the gym was great, like there is a cheaper alternative, East Beach, but with the shower room and 99cent store so close going all the way to East Beach out by Milpas, actually pretty past Milpas wouldn't be fun, though the trolley isn't That expensive and shit.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Delivery took 40 minutes and this place is 0.4 miles away...

Hot and sour soup is actually one of the better ones I've had

Broccoli with shrimp and garlic sauce was just OK. 

Also had quite the trip in the bathroom later that day... can't point fingers but I'm assuming...

I agree with most other posters, in that this place is really nothing special.  I do think their salads are pretty good, however way too big for a person with a smaller appetite.

I would not recommend to someone asking me about where to go for a good lunch.

What an eclectic place, the menu, the servers, the people who dine...it is a place for everybody and every "taste".  There are vegetarian dishes as well as meats, their hanger steak is always on the menu but prepared differently, I always order and I am never let down! Can't wait to see what inspires the menu next!

Meh. Weird setup - the bar goes straight down the building from front to back and is pretty narrow so not a whole lot of room for movement if it's busy or if you wanna get your twerk on.
