A good location for people that live in that area, but not worth the drive to Lakeview for everyone else as it's ordinary at best.

Ardmore has a much better selection.  This is a smaller W&S with limited selection.  Staff is nice enough but not all that informed.  This must be what it was like in Russia before the wall fell.  If you have time go to Ardmore.  It's bigger with a better selection.

Great selection of craft beers and pounders. Very clean and organized. They do tastings apparently in this cute room to the side but the cashier working didn't know when it was which was a little disappointing. I took one star off for the price, although it is very convenient for me from my apartment it's a bit overpriced.

Visited: Thursday - February 26, 2015 - 11:30 AM

This is an overall review from my roughly 20 year membership. 

The tellers and loan officers are professional but, pleasant.

The on-line teller is user friendly

The offices are clean, bright, and welcoming.

There is plenty of parking.

Brief but, to the point

This is your bullet-proof glass box-type liquor store. They don't have a wine selection, or much in the way of craft beer. This is the type of place where you already know what you're getting before you set foot in the store. The service, however, was super friendly!

I don't see what the big problem is, honestly. I come to this Subway quite frequently and usually get my sandwich quickly and at the quality I expect from the Subway chain. 

They lock their doors at 7, but their drive-thru stays open beyond that. Don't expect anything special, just a sandwich on the go.

Orange you glad they have sorbets at Sweet Cece's. As with the other varied flavors the Outrageous Sorbet and the Orange Burst Sorbet appear and disappear. Selections vary week to week. The sorbets and yogurts are topped by buyers favorite sweet toppings. Malt balls & petite mints are best.

I only had beer before a Ray's game.  They had a limited food menu that day and nothing jumped out at me or sounded too great.  They do have a nice selection of beers.  I think they might have wine too, but no liquor.  They have TV's, but otherwise it is sparse.  They have pool tables too.  Enjoy!

LOVED the flavors - delicious taste, creamy and smooth.  Toppings were not as extensive as other places.  

Why 2 stars??  Well, I ended up with lethargy and indigestion for the 24 hours following our trip.  No problems at other self-serve yogurt places nor a sensitivity to dairy so what gives . . . . :(

I would rate the food a 3.5 star, but the service and the noise are a distraction. Between the waitress spilling a glass of water, forgetting part of our drink order, and the food arriving after about 40 minutes it was a long night. Luckily the company was good.

The Montecito Inn is a sneaky little hotel... located so close to Santa Barbara without paying the rediculously high "beach" fees. It is within walking distance of the absolutely fabulous Sakana Restaurant!! Loved our stay... friendly staff, clean, organized hotel. Rooms a little small, but overall a great time had here!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We went to Sugo's on a Monday night for the $10 pizza and salad.  It was our first visit and I loved the looks of the place.  Our service was very good and the salads were great.  The pizzas came and they were huge and very tasty.  There were leftovers galore.  I like it here.

I just had Krystal's for lunch.  It's almost like a southern White Castle. I had 2 cheeseburgers and 2 hamburgers with fries and 2 pup dogs. They are mini chili dogs. Krystal's puts mustard on their burgers instead of ketchup. It was good but I love The Castle more

$15 and you get the privilege of scrubbing your car down before going through the wash and then cleaning off everything it missed including the soap afterwards. First time, I thought it was a fluke. Second? Maybe I was doing something wrong.  Third? Yea, I'm a sucker.

A pretty decent place right on the beach.  The outdoor bar area has friendly bartenders who are quick to serve patrons.  The hot tub and outdoor fire pit are also a great feature that most of the bars in this area don't have.  A great place to spend a relaxing evening if you are staying at the beach in this area.

this place is a lost jewel. it's hidden away in the Marigny, but it's one of the best places to go for cofee, tea, treats and mochi. everything about this place is soothing and chill: the decor, the employees, food and drinks. I love this place and go once a week. and the prices are awesome

About the only affordable place to eat a quick breakfast, even on Sat and Sun mornings. The maangers and workers hustle hard, and they are quick.

I'm disappointed b/c they don't have combo's with their meals, so it was alot more than what you'd normally pay elsewhere

Great pasta!  Huge menu, all freshly prepared in the restaurant.  I had the veal saltimbocca, which was excellent.  My wife and our friend ordered pasta dishes, which they raved about.  Service was excellent, and we didn't have obnoxious dinner guests nearby!!

Good. Not Great. Not Bad. 

The fish is fairly fresh, but not the amazingly high quality fresh fish you'd find at a top end sushi place. The service is fast and our server was very friendly. 

The prices were fair. The sushi platter I got was $22, and left me very full.

Given the price, I was underwhelmed. The food is fine, but not great. Rather, everything seems a bit gimmicky. The three salt edamame amused me but did little for my taste buds. The roles were elaborately presented but simple in their taste. On the plus side, we had some really good unfiltered saki.

I've always had a good experience here with Enterprise. If they don't have the car I need they do their best to get me into a similar car and in a timely manner. Also, you can get an incredible deal by using your Costco membership. This rental is costing a whopping $10 a day!

Use your Costco rental car service!! It's so cheap!

Anyone else feel like a member of a herd of cattle when you eat here?

Service: 0
Atmosphere: 1
Food: 3
Value: 4
Overall experience: 2

I only go here when dragged by others. If you appreciate sushi (particularly fresh sushi), I recommend another selection.

Tasty - but expensive. $18 for vegetable sushi?  Please.  Not a place for vegetarians; even the seaweed salad has dashi in it.  Of course, that's the authentic style, so I'm not complaining. The tempura was dreamy; the sea salt on our edamame received no perceptible enhancement from green tea.

Courtyard Marriott

Pros:
Conveniently located two blocks from the convention center. 
Free wireless.
Incredibly kind and helpful staff. 
Comfortable walking distance from the French Quarter.
Six blocks from the St. Charles street car.
$20 shuttle ride to the airport.

Cons:
Super, teeny, tiny bathroom
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have to say I was skeptical when we saw that yet another pizza place was going into this failed BBQ joint but I was pleasantly surprised! We had plain and white veggie pizza slices and they were HUGE and very delicious. We will be back soon to try their other menu items.

Everyone should be aware that their menu prices have recently increased pretty significantly. It's not just 25 to 50 cents here and there, I'm talking several dollar increases per item. I'm sorry but we have taken Gio's off the go-to list and thrown their menu out over these insane price increases.

You have to try a hand grenade, or two, if it's your first time visiting New Orleans...

...you just have to!

Ask for an extra shot and see where the night takes you. That is all.

I didn't give it a 5 star because of feeling like I've been hit by a train the next day just about every single time.

You have to try a hand grenade, or two, if it's your first time visiting New Orleans...

...you just have to!

Ask for an extra shot and see where the night takes you. That is all.

I didn't give it a 5 star because of feeling like I've been hit by a train the next day just about every single time.

Great food, good service. Took a large party here after a meeting. Was a bit hesitant about the family style service but it was perfectly executed. The most remarkable  were the soup and hamachi appetizers. Skate fish and port chop were good too. I highly recommend you try this restaurant.

A lot of beers on tap, service is OK, but weird beer selection. They don't have Yuengling, Guinness or other beers on tap, but they do have some others. Fair amount of bar space, but a little narrow. Prices are what you expect at an airport. Didn't try the food.

Came here for girls' night a few weeks ago. BYOB and AYCE?! It was $24 PP and you have a lot of options. I think the app portions are perfect and you're not stuffing your face for the first few dishes you get. The sushi is fresh. Service was great.

I'd definitely come back.

THE BEST ITALIAN FOOD in the area!!! Now, after going to Italy - this is definitely where you can get your taste of authentic, Italian food without going to Italy.

I absolutely love it here. Everything is delicious. I've had their garlic bread, mussels in red sauce, spaghetti and meatballs, everything.

YUMMY!

The drive thru here can be packed specially in the morning. So you may want to just go out and take your food to go. However, be warned to double check your items. They messed up on my order twice. They forgot some items, napkins, utensils and straws for the drinks.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Worst drive thru ever! One we paid from the first window, the lady from the second window asked for our receipt and still screwed our order. They also didn't give us sauce for our nuggets even if it was listed in the receipt. Then they forgot to give our drinks. What's worse, the people working have attitudes.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place is great! $23 for inside and out!! They hand dry car, wipe tires with the shiny stuff, clean inside windows, etc. every time I go, they find things in my car that have been missing for months. Service is fast! Love this place. A best kept secret.

Fry's belongs to the Kroger chain of grocery stores and in my opinion, Kroger is the Walmart of grocery stores. Nonetheless, this Fry's is always clean, comfortable, and the staff have been friendly. I enjoy the large selection of produce, sushi, and alcohol. It makes it convenient when attending bbq's in Rancho.

Not a bad spot in which to sit in the huge, comfortable bar chairs over a few drinks and some small plates.  The brussel sprouts were amazing, and I was extremely excited that they were able to make my favorite drink:  a lychee martini with real lychee juice!

The service was a little spotty, but atmosphere was classy chill.

Nice room, comfy bed.  It would have been 4 stars, but they put us in a room next to the elevator on the 5th floor..  So all night long we could hear the elevator running- which made it impossible to sleep the first night- even with our white noise machine on. :( free breakfast was nice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The ambience is decent, though I would wish for a few less TV.s.  

The food is excellent. I had both catered lunch food from here as well as a chicken sandwich at the restaurant the following night. Both were very very good food.

My server, at dinner time, was very friendly and efficient. I felt well cared for.

Nothing special here.  The salmon was flavorless and the rolls skimped on fish (it's disappointing when your eel cucumber roll is almost exclusively cucumber).  Though the fish was missing, my husband was surprised to find an unexpected treat in his roll--a long dark hair.  Yuck!

Chicken fingers "I'm gonna run a train on those..."
Great atmosphere and depending on if you like crowds or not the weekends are always packed so get there early if you wanna get a spot at the bar...music is always good with different DJs throughout the week

Ok, I went there today after visiting with a client, it was a long appt. and I was hungry!  

I got the falafel wrap which was very good, but I also got a piece of the carrot cake which was dry and actually, quite gross.  Stay away from the carrot cake.  Aside from that, our lunch was good.

Peculiar place, at best.

The "sushi" we ordered was mostly cream cheese.  

Nothing we tried was worth going back for.

Your money will get you better almost anywhere else.

The folks at the Japan Consulate Office told me to give-up on finding real tempura in New Orleans.

Your choice!

Rick

Ichiban is a pretty decent sushi resturant. They have a pretty good selection of speciality sushi rolls. All the rolls and sashimi we ate were really fresh. The service was great and we loved the small hip atmostpher. This is one of the best sushi resturants in the area.

This is a great Chinese takeout restaurant. Just moved from Land O'Lakes to WC and really glad to have found a Chinese restaurant we like. Great food, always consistent. Reasonably priced. Very fresh, and always hot. Standard menu, nothing spectacular but done well and as ordered every time.

Umm..not a place I would recommend. The party I was with ordered different pasta dishes. I had the caesar salad and pizza. Salad had too much dressing. Pizza had no favor. The only good dish was this pasta place with their signature sauce. Staff was friendly. It was a simple Italian eatery.

I've quite enjoyed it the past couple times I've been.  Good value, and especially good fish.  The sushi chefs were lively and helpful when we talked to them.  I also really enjoy the presentation of the oranges at the end of the meal.  A nice touch to top a wonderful meal off.

I've eaten here twice. The first time I had red pizza...awful sauce! Good topping though. The second time I went because I was told to try the white pizza...yum! So that's my recommendation..stick to white! Another reason for only 3 stars is the service. It's strange and disorderly!

That lobster bisque and bam bam shrimp is that stuff. I mean good lord it was tasty. I liked the location and the staff as well. 

What I liked the most was how inexpensive their lunch menu was. I am a very cheap person and would probably never eat dinner here, but their lunch menu was crazy affordable.

this place is delicious- price value is excellent and the best fish tacos I have ever had- and I have tried many.  The only way they could improve is if you're eating there, the ambiance is pretty lame- very plain, no decor.  But it's a fairly new place so maybe there are plans for that.

First time here and probably won't be back.   I still have polish on my nails from my old color and the new color is chipping off already....just a short few days later.  My gel nails at my old salon used to last me three weeks....I'd still be going there if it was closer to the new home.

Probably the worst service I had here yet.   I have been here a half an hour and still have not gotten my sushi.  Not has the waitress come around to see if I need a refill on my tea.  The majority of the time I have been here, the chef wasn't even at the counter.  Disappointing.  At least the sushi is good.

Can be a hassle to get to if coming from the south, and it's connected to the gas station, so that's odd. No play-place, no "McCafe" area, but a solid McD's to have lunch at.

Staff is nice and friendly, and the food's fine during he rush...nice and fresh.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I've been coming here for years. Everyone knows about the great 3 rolls for $10.95 deal, but now they're not the only ones in the city to offer that. They may have been one of the firsts and they sure do it well. But why can't they expand for the love of God!? Under 10 seats? Come on.

Love the gourmet options they have at Slice, although they are on the pricey side. They really earned the 4th star by delivering quickly during the awful, snowy mix Halloween weather. Although I wouldn't recommend delivery from here - it tastes waaaaay better right out of their oven. Noticeably better. Make the trip.

Decent hotel but after leaving at 10 AM working then touring and getting back to hotel  at 2 AM (16 hours later) it is  clear that no one has bothered to clean the room- No fresh  towels, bed not made nothing close to holiday inn standards, much less Hilton , vastly disappointing
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I'm not sure what is up at the GS but I had one of the worst meals of my life here tonight.  The chicken was so effing hard I thought I chipped tooth.  And it was a if they poured a gallon of sugar in the sauce.  It was inedible.  I hope to get their shit together....

This little strip mall experience was neither great nor bad.   It was all good.

The problem with "good" sushi is the price. Bad, good and great sushi typically carries the same price tag.  So, with better options available why eat just good sushi?

The staff seemed friendly, the beer was cold and the place seemed clean.

Came here because of the Axxess card and was very happy with the food and service. I would go around lunch time because the dinner menu is more expensive but the portions arent that much bigger.

The Japanese Pumpkin Ravioli w/ reduced balsamic sauce is the best!

Best katsu curry in town. Their ramen is pretty good as well. I'm a regular here and I live very far away. The sushi I don't get often but my friend swears by it. I go here for the pork katsu curry. The service is really nice. I like ordering the melon cream soda with no ice. Don't spill it though.

This place was good, not great. (3 stars) Then again, not too big of a fan of Italian food. I ordered their salad of the day, which was a good blend of greens, smoked salmon, avocado, some vinaigrette (too much, IMO), and capers. I don't remember much about this place, but everyone else seemed to enjoy his or her dish.

My favorite location ever. The staff is fast and friendly even on busy days. The drinks come quick, and correct everytime. If you're unsure on what you want they'll make recommendations based in your likes, not on something they may be pushing. Overall great location.

Yep. I was a tourist, yep I drank a couple Hand Grenades... On an empty stomach... Left my blood and skin about the French Quarter crawling back to my hotel... Locals tell me you will be marked as a tourist if you drink one, because the locals "neaux" betta...

Nice patio, really bad food. Sticky gross salt shakers...such a pet peeve. When I pick up a shaker, I expect to be able to set it back down with ease. Menu is odd mix of burgers and Mexican. The Mexican is pretty awful. How do you screw up guacamole? Night Porter is here to show you.

I hope this place reopens soon - two stories of goodness! The space is airy and very well lit with tons of natural light. Came for brunch and we were seated immediately and service was quick. My daughter loved her pancakes and I had a really delicious tomato soup. Super convenient location close to museums and sights.

One of my go-to places for fresh sashimi. I have had quite a few things here and they have consistently been good. I usually get a sashimi deluxe but have tried their fusion rolls (the naruto, spider, caterpillar and rainbow rolls) and shared a 66piece sushi boat with 5 other people, which was enough for everyone.

What an awful Frat Bar. The bar will steal your $$$$ for drinks; they "include" your tip for them and don't itemize. Do NOT give them your CC & ID, bring cash of you must go - and there's a $5 cover charge. Who does that in NOLA? Lots of eye candy to be seen, none to be had. Skip it. Seriously, skip it.

Went for: Breakfast

Best: The Scrapple!! A nice thick piece with crisp edges.

Worst: Country Fried Steak - YUCK! Greasy, Smelly, Mostly Breading. Def a pre-frozen "piece of meat" with pre-made gravy. Told them they should take it off the menu.

Everything else was standard diner experience.

Nice area. Lots of places to eat and shop. Shoe and clothing stores galore ! Now to find what I want to eat . Not crazy about the parking situation. You only get part off and it's not at the hotel. The rooms and bathroom is smaller than I'm used to. My room was short hand towels and wash clothes. Got a great deal through Hot Wire .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place sure is divisive. I for one love the tacky interior, I love anything that looks like it was created with love. The food is fine and certainly the best Mexican anyone's getting in Collinsville. It's not perfect but just writing this review has made me want enchiladas famosas...

I recently bought frames on a trip to Spain and needed prescription lenses put in them -- I just walked in, handed them my prescription, and they were able to put in the lenses in about in hour.  The staff are very friendly and helpful, and I'll definitely go back for new glasses.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Hate to say but it's the type of place you go to in order to check off your "I've been there list". Food wasn't too filling. Fish tacos were fishy.  We got some appetizer that was 10.00 and it was pretty much a cup of cocktail sauce with a few ratty shrimp

So BAD!  We got a Groupon for 4 and we were forced to pay 18% tip on the Retail price.  The tip was 37.00  The groupon itself was 65.00  So how does that make sense.  The service was horrible, the food was worse, and the milk in the coffee was bad.  The meat was tough.  I will NEVER go back.  I feel I was tricked by Groupon too.

The owner sent me an email for my review and called me a liar. Said there gnocchi is ALWAYS served as cavatelli, so the waiter couldnt have said that. So they flat out lie on their menu, because they know a monkey could make cavatelli and only a seasoned chef can make gnocchi. Low grade dog food.

Everything was dated and dirty! They stated "newly renovated" but was not sure what was renovated because banged up, and the arm rests on the sofa were filthy. Luckily, we only stayed one night. 2 stars (added 1star for friendly staff) but better hotel in the area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place was pretty average. Lunch crowd was nonexistent. The house salad was basic (not terribly unusual). The chicken piccata was fair in taste, but underwhelming overall - not a significant portion. I've had much better. The service was pretty good though.

Nonplussed with the bar service.  Perhaps I set my expectations too high. Been here a couple of time but usually with a large group. Not terribly impressed with any aspect of the place but it is not too bad to hang out in when it is not full.  At least they have free wifi to use while you are waiting for your beer.

I would echo what the other customers have said about this place. The food was above average, but then again so is the food at a number of other Japanese and sushi places nearby that aren't this absurdly overpriced. The staff, however, is so rude that there is no level of food quality that could get me to go back.

Customer Service was excellent, but our final product cake looked terrible. $30 for a cake that feeds 4-6 people. The writing was terrible and looks like they had to remove the first try. Luckily this was for a 4 yr old, if it was for an adult I would be embarrassed. Please see my photo I posted.

Pretty much your typical Dunkin' Donuts. Stopped in here on a Sat morning and walked in to grab some donuts and coffee. Clearly the person helping behind the counter was new as he struggled to operate the register a bit, but not a big deal. Store inside was clean. Donuts are just OK. I prefer the coffee and latte's here.

Went here 3 times while in town for a convention, and it was delish! They have a great happy hour with 1/2 price wine, beer and apps from 5-7pm which was great. The quality of the sushi and sashimi was fantastic and the prices were right on too. Definitely stop in and try it! Mizu is way better than Wasabi just FYI.

I wanted to stay in my first night in philly so I ordered delivery from china house. They were fast and the food was delicious! They did get my drink order wrong though, but I wasnt too worried. I also got an unidentifiable mystery item that seemed a little eird, but overall I was pretty happy.

I love the Reuben sandwich.  The burgers are great as well.  Great place to go later in the evening have an appetizer and adult beverage.  The staff is always pleasant and efficient.  Big Smiles everywhere!!!  We try to stop there at least 2 times a month.

"Meh" really sums it up here.  I always regret eating the food, and it's somehow even more expensive than the nearby options for breakfast sandwiches.  But you do get consistent mediocrity, so that's something I guess.

2 star quality also applies to dingy interior and lacking customer service at this location.

Very good, I hold pizza to a different standard now because of this pizza. Expect to pay extra for this pizza, but its worth it.
One pizza is good for an EXTRA hungry person, or you can share between two and a salad.
They have snazzy toppings for a pizza too.

Will NOT return - 

My friend and I went for all-you-can sushi for dinner. Sashimi was not fresh. Edamame was old and cold. food was incredibly sloooww. Misu soup was very salty. one of the waitress has a bitchy attitude. total comes to $30 which is way too overpriced for that kind of quality of food.

Eaten here several times and have received awful service each time.  The food's acceptable, though not for the price.  Stretch your legs and check out what other eateries in the area have to offer.  This place is for people who don't know or don't care for other places to eat.

We had dinner here last week.

One of the cheapest place in Nashville for a piece of veal.

We had the veal parmesan and the veal marsala for $13.99 each.

Both came with a mixed green salad and spaghetti with sauce.

Also 2 pieces of garlic sticks.

Not the greatest but it is filling.

Most of the people were there for pizza.

One word: GRENADES.

Our group of ladies opted for the smallest to-go cups possible, with ice and this drink still kicked my butt in record time! Neon green and lethally sweet - the alcohol WILL creep up on you. It took hours (no lie) for this lightweight to finish, but I conquered it! Won't drink this again though ;)

So I'm from California and Sushi is one of my favorite foods and I've had sushi in 1 million places in California. No places in Reno come close to anything you've ever had in California. And the worst part is everything is all you can eat so they kind of just slap together all the rules. This place is no exception.

So I'm from California and Sushi is one of my favorite foods and I've had sushi in 1 million places in California. No places in Reno come close to anything you've ever had in California. And the worst part is everything is all you can eat so they kind of just slap together all the rolls. This place is no exception.

Sushi in general is not good in Reno. I tried to not hold that against this place but it is the same except here the sushi chef is rude, makes your rolls in about 3 seconds and whisper the entire time you're communicating to her even after you say you cannot hear her. I am sorry to say that I wouldn't recommend this place.

Ok, so as far as getting the basics done for your standard dry cleaning (dress pants, dresses, shirts) this place rocks! Can't beat the price, and your items get in & out pretty quickly. Drop by 9am, pick up after 5. Plus, they're open from 7a to 7p, Monday- Saturday.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Less than mediocre in cuisine, minus the one lunch I had here about a year ago.  I had the overpriced steak this time around and would have been much happier with an Arby's sandwich or a steak from Outback. Subpar, inordinately horrific service with a near empty restaurant on a Friday night. 
Shudder.

Redeeming point: $5 martinis!

The sausage dish was wonderful. Kids had pizza and gnocchi and they finished them all. Spinach salad was tasty over Parmesan cheese dish. Special fish for the day was yummy. It's really noisy since they have a lot of big groups but the staffs are attentive and on top of stuff.

Uhhhmmm...this place is legit!  I grew up loving homemade ice cream and the Gelati i just consumed was flipping amazing--better than anything growing up!  We just moved into the area and I can see that Diane's will be a weekly happening for our house!
Definitely check it out!

What a fantastic addition to the Nashville beer scene!

Here's how it works - pick up a growler, hand it over to an employee & tell them what you want inside. Easy as that! I think I remember seeing a few options in bottles as well.

My favorite part -- they have Goose Island! Be still, my heart.

I love breakfast and I am particular about my eggs. Maritsa's hit the spot. Great coffee service with a smile make this Maple Shade spot a winner. The price for breakfast 21 for two with a side of bacon and fresh fruit eggs and pancakes two coffees. Need to try back for lunch and dinner.

We popped in here because it was the first coffee shop we spotted while exploring Santa Barbara. The barista wasn't particularly friendly or welcoming. My decaf Americano was passable; my husband's latte tasted like there wasn't espresso in it.

Skip this. You can do much better in Santa Barbara for coffee.

Generally good food in the main dinning room which is fairly romantic.   Management is solid and very friendly.  They always make you feel at home.  There is a bar in the middle room and a smaller lighter fare restaurant on the left, which also hosts local bands on the weekend.  We always enjoy our evenings there.

I've been taking my dry cleaning here for about 6 years now.  They do a great job, the staff is very efficient and courteous, and they even offer home pickup and delivery.   Their store has a drop-off lockbox for off-hours, so I can drop my laundry off late at night if necessary.  Very convenient.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Absolutely wonderful service and staff! The pool is perfect. Great for a quick relaxing night after the beach! Equipped with a great grill for bqq'ing pool side.  Social hours M,T, W includes yummy themed snacks and beverages! Close to a few beaches and a short uber ride to clearwater beach!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This is a family owned shop with honest, friendly, and reliable mechanics and employees.  Their prices are very slightly higher than the local chain auto repair shops, but based on some truly questionable experiences elsewhere, the cost is well worth it.   Great for work on both foreign and domestic cars.

I tried them again over a year later.

Their most expensive wash... car comes back with crumbs in cup holder, dust on dashboard.

This time I vow never to return here again. No matter if they are offering a deal or not.

They shouldn't be in business offering such abysmal service.

The place is kinda...eh to me. It did not help that when I got to the bar that all the bartenders were chilling outside, so I had to wait. The tap list was okay with a few decent beers, and the chicken parm sandwich was really good. I might stop back here only if spots like Tattooed Moms and Wooly Mammoth are crowded.

Top notch Italian!

The food here is very good, and this is an area with plenty of Italian cuisine to choose from. Service was above average, and the dining room is pleasant, if a bit small. Prices here do match the quality, though: I think they're reasonable, but be aware that this is not low-rent pizzeria.

Inexpensive, tasty (Americanized) Chinese food served by friendly staff.  Menu is typical for small restaurants of this type.  I recommend the steamed dumplings.  Seating is limited.

Note that if you are driving north on Route 202, you will need to pass the restaurant, and turn around to come back to the restaurant.

Best pizza in NOLA hands down. Pizza in New Orleans is generally pretty meh. Nothing comes close to this.  I could eat a million of their broccoli and cauliflower rolls.  Make sure to ask for extra sauce on the side to dip rolls and garlic knots in. Vegan cheese option on pizzas.

Good Happy Hour. Pretty standard American Mexican fare. Nothing to write home about. I do enjoy going for a drink here with friends when I want something quick. They have a great patio area. You are allowed to smoke on the patio so don't go out if smoke bothers you. The servers are always nice and they are quick and efficient.

I had a good experience here, the food was good I had a filet and the drinks were good as well. I will say what they have in food, they lack in service. Our waitress just totally disappeared for long stretches of time and it was not crowded at all. I'd go again for the location.

I went to Niche last New Years Eve.  The decor and ambiance is great.  The service is great.  And I'm still talking about the non-traditional vegetarian lasagna (truffled bechamel, wild mushrooms, fontina, farm egg, sage brown butter).  You must visit Niche just to try this entree!

After all the reviews, I was worried about having dinner but I was so pleasantly surprised by my experience.  Service was good.  I ordered the Super Deluxe Nigiri which came with 7 pieces of sushi and one eel roll.  All tasted fresh, good, and not fishy.  Its a bit out of the way, but I'd go back if I'm in the area.

I came here for Sunday brunch and it was my first time. I ordered a ham and cheddar cheese omelette with mushrooms. My omelette was so good! The presentation was so pretty too. Food was so yummy! I would definitely come back to this restaurant. The waitresses were very nice also.

The room was clean, had a king size bed and a wonderful jacuzzi tub.  The walls are on the thin side, every time the neighbors turned on the shower, flushed the toilet or turned on the sink, we could hear it all.  Still, that is my only complaint.  The breakfast was good for it's size.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Being in the Emerald club makes it super easy to get in and out. The car was ready, clean and ready to go when we arrived. Could not have asked for a better car rental experience. I can tell you from using Avis and Budget in the past, that National does a much better job getting you in your car and on your way in a hurry.

It's hard to go wrong with cheap pizza. But it's cheap pizza. It'll fill you up, but it's nothing to write home about.

The guys there are friendly, but I'd rather hike the 5 blocks to Mama Angelina's and pay an extra dollar. 

There's usually a movie going when you come in late at night. Crowded seating as well

Trendy and expensive.  It's not necessarily bad, but nothing stood out that impressed me.  The fish was okay, the rice was off.  Nothing quality really stood out to me.  Honestly, I've forgotten mostly about this place because nothing interesting was had there.

This is a 24 hour location (the only kind I ever seem to make it to) 

I have only been inside once, meh. 

The late night staff is good, and fairly friendly for Micky-Ds

Im not going to review the kind of food mcdonalds has... I think everyone knows what they serve, but this location serves the standard quality you expect.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Worst place I've ever been too. Im not a big complainer,  so when my nails weren't equal in size and shape, nail polish was streaky and covered more than my nailbed, I was just disappointed. But charging extra for credit card (without warning in advance) and extra for removing gel polish, I was furious.

Slowest Starbucks drive thru in history. I could have driven back home, brewed a pot of coffee, and packed a travel mug in the time it takes to get through their drive thru. Parking your car and heading inside is not any better either. It's unfortunate, but it's the only Starbucks with a drive thru in the Riverview area.

we found this fantastic place when leaving reno last week. we are donut snobs and were hoping to find a great donut. Not only was the apple fritter and filled donut the best we have had in the area it was the best we have had anywhere! service was great we will be returning when we are in the area again

I'm not too crazy about this place compared to other Anytime Fitnesses and gym facilities, however it serves it's purpose. The equipment here is a little older than other locations and not as user-friendly. It's also not too large for the crowd it gets during the peak hours- right after work.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The customer service and effortless hive mind expertise in this store are absolutely amazing. This place is a study in how brick & mortar stores can survive and even surpass internet buying. Kudos to the owner for encouraging the fun friendly and relaxed atmosphere and hiring people who totally dig what they do.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: After 10 on a Saturday night in Santa Barbara - where to get a meal? We had some ideas and were heading in the direction of one of them when we walked past Roy and decided to give it a shot. My wife had a cheese plate a chocolate martini, and I had three-cheese ravioli and a Scotch. Not bad at all.

For my second visit to Corteo's I tried the Eggplant Parmesan sub, and it  was huge and awesome! The bread is fantastic!

My buddy from out of town got the Lasagna al Fiorno, and he loved it. The stuffed eggplant appetizer is incredible too. This place is my go-to Italian restaurant from here on out.

I went to this little Italian restaurant on a Friday night.  I was not impressed with the food at all, and found it in the expensive side and the portions were small.  I had the lasagna and it was not that great.  It was served at room temperature, it lacked meat sauce as well, and the flavor just wasn't there.

Awesome pizza! We ordered the garlic bread and a large pizza, both were amazing! The crust on their pizza is the most wonderful part, i highly recommend this pizza place, for dine in or carry out. We sat inside, it was cute and the service was excellent, the place was non stop busy so I know people love this place!

I love the staff at Creature Comforts. They are always very accommodating and nice when I bring in my little guy Pepe. Although he can turn into a little Kujo when his nails are being clipped, they are always very sweet and patient with him. Their prices are very reasonable as well.

Another successful rental from this location.
Any other Hertz would dump me into a POS Camry or Altima. this Hertz stepped it up a notch and gave me a Volvo s60. I am one of the many people who love Volvo. I appreciate the fact that Herts actually gave me a decent car for a change.

Go early. 
I had to drive back a major pocket was still filthy. Overall it was moderate ..... for the $$. I got the $ 60 package. I honestly expected better. The windshield and other areas still showed dirt. It was mid afternoon on a bright sunny day so they should have caught the dirt.... oh well...

Although I enjoyed several of the flavors of yogurt they had to offer, and the MOUNTAIN of toppings to choose from, I wasn't not overly impressed with this place.  I didn't even finish my yogurt!  They do have variety, so if you are looking for that, this is your place.  The staff was readily available and friendly.

I must say that The owner did make efforts to contact me and that is admirable.  He was not the problem but an employee and we can't always be on hand to make sure things happen properly.  I will give them a second chance but just not for a bit.

I hope others have better expereinces due to the sharing of this last visit.  :)

Nice hotel, not fabulous by any means. But the room service is pretty good, beds are comfortable and the wi-fi is free. Works for me.

And if you have a flight to catch, this place couldn't be any more convenient; it is directly attached to the airport by a walkway.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went with a friend for dinner on a Saturday night. Neither of us liked our dishes. My fish was over cooked an salty. Additionally, we were asked to leave because the next party had arrived. Mind you, we were on time for our reservation and had been there for less than an hour.

Pretty good americanized Italian. The food is ok, but $12 for a plate of spagetti with meat sauce? Considering I can go across the street and eat better Italian for comparable money? Oh and the beef ribs are terrible. Pork ribs are excellent. Strange. The salad bar was ok but way more expensive than I'd consider reasonable.

This is a newer McDonald's. The staff is nice, but, the service is slow and I don't think every crew member knows exactly what they're doing. It took me a while  to just get a fairly uncomplicated order for me and my co-worker. It is convenient to my new job in East Falls, though.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I took off another star because this place has no dollar menu.  But, the service is usually consistent along with the food. They are also open until 4 AM Friday & Saturday. Fair warning, though, you might be waiting an 45 minutes-hour for your order after the bars close. It becomes a mad house.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
This was one of the others I've been to in when I was in the neighborhood often. My friend's ex and his family weren't students with disposable income so they did most of their shopping here. 

Good sales, relatively clean and safe store, and never an issue with the staff. They are overall a solid, plain-old-supermarket.

Not the worst sushi in the world but certainly not the best. With all the other excellent sushi restaurants in the area (Mikado, Megu, Sagami, Akira) I don't plan on rushing back. The ambiance is also a bit blah. Its cheap and edible though. I just happen to think there are far better sushi offerings in the area.

This was one of my most enjoyable meals of the past year.  This is one of those places when I wanted to lick the plates and try absolutely everything on the menu.  The gnocchi, pork chop, and cherry crumble were particularly memorable.  Service was excellent.  The dining room was very small so reservations are a must.

Unimpressed.  Ended up having 3 waiters, one of which gave us the wrong happy hour special, which caused confusion, and a waitress that had a very snobby attitude.  We both tried the Kobe burger, which was extremely salty, and both burgers had incorrect temperatures.Don't think we will bother coming back.

Food was excellent, service was friendly. The crust was nice and crisp underneath.  It could have used another thirty seconds in the oven, I had a doughy bite or two.   Overall , they bring a high quality pizza to an area that needed it.  Looking forward to mixing them in to my regular lunch rotation.

Stopped in here for one last drink before Ubering home.  It was recommended by a bartender up the street.   I think he said it was a dive bar but it didn't seem too bad to us.   Just was a one and done while waiting for our ride. Would probably stop in again if in town.

Cheap tasty Mexican food. They deliver. They deliver to the bar. I'm always happy when I eat here. It's the perfect way to soak up a bunch of beer. 
The guac is yummy, the shredded beef tacos were really good and the cake was awesome. Oh, and it's pretty cheap. I really appreciate it.

Mediocre Mexican food.  There are many places that serve better starting with Guadalajara Grill.  The bar area is the only reason I've gone back.  It's cozy and dark, nice to just sit and have beers.  Plus their margaritas are actually pretty good.  But if you're hungry - look elsewhere.

Simply say that if you are looking for authentic Japanese restaurant, this is not the place you should be at. Kampai serves Korean type Japanese good. It is very easy to tell by the way the way they handle sashimi. If you are looking to enjoy authentic Japanese food, stay away Kampai.

No go.
This is my least favorite Cancun in Indy. The food never tastes the same for some reason. I went once and the queso looked like someone had dumbed a cup of hot spicy peppers in it, and another time I went and there were no peppers at all. I have stale chips on several occasions and the service is hit or miss.

Food took forever on a Tuesday night... Edamame was cold and unsalted but not too bad. The rolls all fell apart so it was impossible to eat! The vegetables tasted slightly plasticky and there was lettuce in the sushi...??? The place is small and the staff nice. Pricey for the quality...

This cute little byob is a really nice addition for Medford restaurants. I came here for a nice lunch and got the plantain burrito with side salad. It was really delish. Service was awesome. It's a lil dark inside I think for lunch but think that ambiance would fit more for dinner time.

Went to the bar downstairs. By far the BEST cocktails I've ever had. Even the execution was a treat to watch. Try Panda at the Disco. It was my fave! Go see James the bartender, he was amazing making us drinks. This place is a more intimate environment. Definitely best cocktails in Philly. Yum. Can't wait to return.

I was happy to see Debbie open this! Great location and interior is lovely. But Debbie is the jewel here. Totally professional, gave me a beautiful cut. I was nervous because switching stylists is kinda' risky. But she listened carefully to what I wanted, and took a lot of care with me. Thank you, Debbie!

Came here with a group (I didn't choose the restaurant) and was pleasantly surprised that it wasn't terrible! Food took a bit long to come out, but we weren't in a hurry, and they didn't rush us. That said, it is so close to the Walnut Street Bridge and the prices are expensive for how good the food is.

As close to Lombardi's in New York as you can get in flavor and in price.

Great coal fired crust and sauce, but not using fresh sliced mozzarella was a sin.

Not a huge deal, but I found it odd all the sodas were in bottles when we went.  I like fountain sodas.  I guess it discourages refills.  LOL

It's a bit pricey but it's not your standard ice cream. I crave the frozen custard here. The ice cream cakes are pretty amazing too. During the summer they have "Dog's Night Out" where once a month you can bring your four-legged pal with you and for every item you purchase they give your dog(s) a dish of vanilla custard.

Amazing service, atmosphere and food!  We came here for Mother's Day and we were not disappointed.  

We had the calamari, Limoncello pasta, stuffed salmon, and pizza, all of which were amazing.  Delicious cocktails.  Fresh food.  Great service.  Yum, yum, yum!

We will be returning!

Coming from Reno which is the King of ayce, I know what I like and I don't. The sushi here is pretty fresh and delicious. The reason why this place only getting 2 stars is because of CUSTOMER SERVICE. We ordered only two rolls and they forgot one. No one took our orders or acknowledged us.

This another one of those places you ride past and don't know exist. I've been dinning in and taking out on a regular basis for years. Very nice menu and service is exceptional. The steamed dumplings are the best I've ever tried. Next time your in Spring House stop in and check it out for yourself, you won't be disappointed.

Been here several times. Menu is always changing with the local ingredient options. Three of us had very different things - fish, chicken, beef. All excellent. My wife and I took her mother and she really enjoyed it. A great place for either a slightly upscale casual or even a more romantic event.

Tried it for the first time ever... Ordered I thought two enchiladas and one tamale... I got one tiny enchilada and one tiny tamale. Tamale was over cooked. And did I mention portions were TINY! I heard the Betos over on Wells is better - maybe I'll try there!

I love this sushi place. Both chefs ive had were so good at making sushi. The mussels here are delicious as well. Everyone who works here is very friendly.

The raw fish is really fresh for Reno and I love sushi here!

The Mochi mango flavored is so good! (;

My favorite staff in any sushi joint (:

Tokyo Bistro, is a winner in my book.
My Tuna, Avocado rolls were superb.
Tuna and avocado in my book are a match made in heaven.
Tuna melts in your mouth, and the avocado is so beautiful as a taste accompaniment.
As good as some, better than most.
This place is on my list as a go-to for Sushi..

I would probably give this 3.5 stars if I could.  Food was good but not great.  The place is pretty small but very nice.  I liked the location.  It was in a neighborhood in east Nashville and parking was easy.  We had the clam pizza, Shrimp, and sourdough bread.   Everything was good but nothing blew my doors off.

I remember this being good Chinese food years ago but was super disappointed by the fishy shrimp pad thai and the wonton soup that had no meat in it at all. It is affordably priced and was delivered quickly, but I guess this is a case of getting what you pay for.

I like this place and think the quality of the food is good but the three time so have been here the service has been horrible. Last night it took them 15 minutes to get us three diet cokes. I like the fact that it is BYOB and they have an extensive menu. Love the fruit punch roll and the kabuki roll.

Great dive bar with a huge drink selection.  Pool tables, tons of drafts,nice feel to the place to go and relax after work or to start your night out. Staff was very friendly, helped to narrow down your selection based on your likes. I would be a regular here if I lived in Nashville for sure.

They have a decent brunch on Sundays, a quality eggs benedict.  Pretty much burgers, sandwhiches and salads.  It's a local hang out that I hear used to have a full moon party though I have never been. The rueben is decent and so is the french dip. Local greasy spoon with lots of locals.

Ordered a chimirito with shredded beef dinner enchilada style w green from the back of the menu. Was pretty tasty. Their chips and salsa were subpar. Lime margarita straight up was excellent. Waitress Arlene was bright and cheerful we really enjoyed her service.

Nothing fancy although it seems they are going for that "better than Arby's" vibe. Other than being sort of slow in the drive thru, I wasn't really impressed enough that I needed to come out of my way to try it again. Also, they don't serve lion do in not sure about the name choice.

This Arby's is a great location. They have the bell to ring as you leave, they have the friendly staff there to great you, and they have the meats! Even had a good conversation at the drive thru once when I was curious about a new menu item and what they liked as far as a sauce to add.

Went there tonight for dinner. The cheeseburger was that SO delicious!  However, their vanilla milkshake was the WORSE I ever had. It DID NOT taste right and it was like FAKED. I would come back for their cheeseburger!  It was much better than the Mc Donald's cheeseburgers.

I just received a meal I ordered from Italian Bistro via diningin.com.  In addition to the lack of salad dressing for the salad, the calamari had cartilage/shells (like shrimp shells) and the pasta was undercooked with barely any chicken.  I would not recommend this restaurant if you are craving GOOD italian food.

Get a new manager, this one does not work very hard.  She is not friendly to the public.  The setting is lovely. Upscale.  I think adding good local bands will help the place pull people in.  We only came to see Baker Street so no food on this visit.  In the past, the appetizers were just fine.

First time in this restaurant. We are trying 2014 Devour Downtown Indianapolis, IN. Honestly I was not expecting to pay $30 (that's the promotion of Devour) for salad and chicken soup. The hostess and waiter sold it as a big portion. I think they missed the main course.

GREAT FOR KIDS!!!

I had Kim cut my son's hair for his first cut. She provided me with a certificate for me to choose from and I got to take as many pictures that I wanted. I got an envelope with some of his hair for his baby book. 
Her prices are unbeatable. She charges $5 and I gave her $10 with tip. 

Love her patience!

Fair at best, go if hungry and see no other options to eat. Have had a couple burritos from here. Nothing mind blowing but it cures hunger. Definitely are better Mexican options out there. Since my last visit I rarely ever see anyone in there, honestly I'm surprised it's still open.

Update 1/2/2016: food still great. However, after third time will not likely come back. Made reservations for a specific table, but seated elsewhere and after 20 minute wait. Empty water glass never refilled. Waiter disappeared altogether after 9:30. You guys are not gonna last here on good food alone.

So happy to find this restaurant in Manayunk where the sushi is so fresh and the decoration simple, yet refine. Everything down to the green tea was excellent. We even had the mochi ice cream that was delicious. 

The price was also very reasonable. We will definitely be back.

We just returned from a party of six at Blackfish. We had the tasting menu and the food was good as usual except the filet which was a little chewy. We were charged a 20% gratuity and a $2 per bottle corkage fee. I don't agree with the corkage fee at a BYOB and I thought the 20% gratuity was over the top.

I have been getting my haircut here for over two years. Casey does an amazing job. They are very flexible fitting you in with the walk-in or you can schedule an appointment either way it's convenient. I have never been disappointed and now I take my son here as well.

Slow, unfriendly, and inefficient. Not sure how the experience here could be worse... Perhaps if they screwed up the order...

Totally underwhelmed and not at all up to the standard of a usual Starbucks.

I would walk next door and get coffee from Bread Co. next time.

Gruyere Popovers w/ Truffle Butter.
Foie Gras Soup.

Capicola Mousse.
Beef Tartare.
(Both on Toast)

Spaghetti w/ King Crab.
Saffron Risotto.

Octopus.

Carrot Cake w/ Chai Ice Cream.
Chocolate Mousse w/ Pumpkin Ice Cream.

Everything was Superb.
Delicious Food.
Very Enjoyable Dining Experience.

Sh*t Hole, plain and simple; with no-class patrons.
This is a place for drunks with something to hide.
it is dirty and smells like puke.
At the end of the night, a parade of fools stumble up the streets of Doylestown vandalizing, peeing, and passing out.
You are all a bunch of winners.

I want to love this place, I really do...especially since its convenient.  But I can't.  I've only had concretes.  Each time, they blend the custard so long that it's like a milkshake.  That's not a good custard experience.  It doesn't rival Culver's (which by the way is not the king of custard by a long shot).

Really should be 3.5 but 3 currently. may get kicked up 1/2 a star after repeat visits. I ordered the teriyaki chicken and wasn't supremely impressed. The entree was brought out on a 'fajita' style plate still sizzling. Wife got the chicken bento box, it was quite good.

Just had takeout from here for the first time. Thoroughly enjoyed it and nothing was left off our big order. Used to dine at Sapporo 2 but have officially switched to Wasabi. There were some rolls in the chef's plate that had too much of an American fusion to it, but still tasty.

I like going to Dunkin Donuts, sit, sip coffee and read my magazine. However most recently, they removed the chairs from the area. Let's me know I'm not welcome but my money is. Sorry, if I'm not welcome to sit, neither is my money. I'll take my coffee and magazines elsewhere.

A-OK. Literally no complaints with this visit. In and out the drive thru line in under 5 min. Ordered 1 Double Beef Sandwich Meal.  Ample meat on the sandwich, so much so that I was shocked! Good flavor, good heat, fries were hot. Good ole Arby Sauce for the compliment.

They got it right! Sometimes you simply crave the classics, no fluff. Yep, Big Mac and Hot Fries. The fries were right out the grease and lightly salted the way you need them. The Mac was as close to the commercial as it could get. Now, in no way is McDs the best burger in town...but it's what we know.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Taco Del Mar is the Subway of Tex-Mex. Having said that, I love it for what it is! 

The employees are super duper friendly & the prices are great. I usually get vegetarian tacos or a burrito - the pico de gallo is fresh & flavorful, the guacamole is definitely passable, and the black beans are really well seasoned.

A nice restaurant. Had the chimichanga nacional. Basically it a lot of yellow rice and some chicken wrapped in a tortilla.  If you like yellow rice this is the place for you. You get a large side of yellow rice on top of all the yellow rice they stuffed in the food.

Just revisted Oishi last week and reminded myself - I gotta get in here more often! Love their rolls. Always taste fresh and are well prepared. We usually get a selection of favorites - Oishi, Zen, Dynamite, and St Louis. Oishi Sushi - yeah, that's how we roll!

I'm in from Detroit and staying at Ameristar for a few days. I love sushi! I fFound this local sushi place in a strip plaza. Reasonable attempt at sushi. But unfortunately they do not use rice wine vinegar in the rice for the sushi plus the soy sauce tasted spoiled.  Limited menu choices.

Another great meal at Sunset Grill.  This was our first visit to Sunset grill on a busy Saturday.  With the efficiency of the wait staff and kitchen you would have thought it was a slow Monday.  Everything was outstanding.  You must try the Habanero bread pudding.

The late night happy hour here is pretty good but you can only get the happy hour prices in the bar area - not pleasant when you have a bigger group. The food is okay and the drinks are good. There is kareoke during happy hour so there is some funny entertainment.

Just plain awful.  I paid $16 for the worst manicure ever with polish that's chipped on the first day. This place is dirty, dirty, dirty and overpriced for the "quality" (or lack thereof). I'm actually embarrassed that I stayed and paid. You've been warned.

Ninja has easily become our go-to sushi spot. The menu is diverse and appeases to all types of preferences. I personally don't eat seafood, let alone raw seafood. The menu has many vegetarian and non-seafood options and the staff is very accommodating on special requests.

I do like the food but I think the worst thing is the cleaner that they use permeates whole entire restaurant and sometimes it makes the food taste of it too! 

So I havent gone there in a long time because my stomach hurts when I think of it! 

Maybe one day I can go back!

This was a great place but I think they've closed.  I'm holding out hope that they're renovating or something but I'm not optimistic. I drive by it a lot so I'll keep an eye out.  It's really a shame if they're closed they were great.
Update: they're moving WHOOO HOOOO http://www.cdromas.com/index.html

This was a comfortable place with OK music and a pretty decent upstairs area with knock hockey and a balcony. Also, Jimmy Buffet's hat and flip flop, if you could give two $hits about that.

Folks I was with said the hand grenades were gross; I wasn't going anywhere near one. Still, this was a fun place to stop in.

should have been a 5-star, but they canceled ladies night. i'm a single dude who like locals-only bars (like this one), so they basically just cut off 50% of their business. 

also i've been ripped off by their food selections too many times so a long awaited revenge is in order; minus another star.

This Starbucks is located inside a hotel, the Embassy Suites. Though it looks like a Starbucks inside with the decor, the drinks do not taste the same. The value here is convenience if you are staying in the hotel or nearby on the Riverwalk.

IMPORTANT NOTE: NO FREE STARBUCKS WI-FI HERE!

No service, no real seating. The sushi quality is just ok, but I don't think it really qualifies as a sushi restaurant, but the sushi price is there. The salad comes in a to go box with to go pack of dressing. If you want a drink you have to get it yourself. I won't be back.

The best I've had in South Philly! Cash only, must pick up, but it's worth it. All Lomein dishes are great, as is the triple delight, wings, beef & broccoli and the spring rolls. That's all I usually order and I've been here about 25-30 times over the years. They are consistent good!

Dinner was a disappointment. I ordered the crawfish etouffee. Small portion. It was more like a appetizer size. I had to order a shrimp Po-Boy for dessert to cure the crave. It was alittle expensive to have such small portions. Oh and the cook set the kitchen on fire and shut the place down for twenty minutes.

this place is awesome.  it is cheap, fresh, and fast.  if you go in expecting high end mexican food, you're in the wrong place.  yes, it is comparable to a chipotle, but there are more options (especially for vegetarians) and i find that the line usually isn't as long.

So...after giving this place a few more tries (I really do want to like it), I've added a star. The food is very good--not great, but the real problem is the service. The staff seems inexperienced and inept. It's never been very crowded when I've been there so I just can't understand why there is such a problem with the service.

I LOVE the salad options here.  It's my go to for order ahead to go or eat in.

BUT the ladies room is nasty, nasty, nasty.  Find a manager who cares not only about food quality but also the all around appearance, including the rest rooms!!

Next time I'll include a photo

I've only been to Vincenzo's once and I definitely enjoyed it!  When we went it wasn't very crowded so we had very attentive service.  The bread and olive oil was very good.  I got for my main meal chicken parmesan which was good just it was pretty small compared to Antonio's Pasta Grille.  I would go back.

Been here many times. Sat in the bar area this time. Service was slow. Portions are usually large and totally worth the price so I ordered a side if spinach.... 7.95$!!! For no more than a 1/4 cup. Between service and spinach we'll be back one day, when theres no place else to go...

Great sushi hidden in Moorestown. I've only ever ordered takeout, but the sushi is always freshly made (I've even had to wait for my order on occasion) and you can't beat the 30% off on Sunday and Monday. If they're trying to get rid of "old" fish, I wouldn't know, the quality is always top notch.

Home made ice cream...can it get any better than this??? Had a scoop of  Blueberry and a scoop of Cheese Cake! Yum! Smooth and satisfying...unlike the other reviewer. Service was great and the owner was there running the place. Will be bringing the family back next time.

Use to be good. Last few times though has been a waste of 15 bucks. You would think that there was something wrong with their vacuum cleaner. Half a dozen people working on it only to be a halfazz job. Floor boards not vacuumed good, dirt, hair left on console... Pretty sorry job. The last 3 times it's been like this.

I have been here before with a large group. I came back with 10 people tonight and we have been here for 2 hours ad still have not been served. They dropped off some edamame but didn't update us on our order. Still no word on the food and the place is empty now. The food is good here, if you can get it.

Pro- comfy bed, quiet room, clean sheets and towels, hot water

Cons- New Year's Eve 55 minute check in with line wrapped around lobby, and no free WiFi even though it was advertised when we booked. 12.95 per computer per day. 

I hope this place gets their act together. Soon.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I'd honestly rate this a 3 1/2 stars.. everything was just the way it should be.  I don't think there were any stand out dishes- nothing made me say 'wow'.  This was a quintessential Italian restaurant, you'll leave happy and full, but note that they aren't reinventing the wheel here...  Also the place  looks adorable.

Grillsmith is the place to be on Wednesday evenings!  Live music (in the patio), $5 appetizers, and half off wines and cocktails.  You can't go wrong!  My husband and I shared the Spicy Thai Shrimp, Calamari, and Sticky Thai Wings (all appetizers).  We also probably liked each of those dishes in that order.

While the sushi was good enough for me to return, the service wasn't.  From the waitress to the sushi chef, I was very disappointed by the neglect.  At times, the sushi chef would leave the bar - I have never witnessed that before...  They have a variety of rolls to try, but watch out for the ones with mayo - there's a lot of it.

Decent little car wash with do it yourself wash bays and two automatic wash bays as well. Also vacuum areas to clean out your vehicle from dirt, trash and what not. This place gets busy on the weekend and not so much during the week. Also soda machine, coin machine.

This is my "neighborhood" Starbucks as its the closest to my house. As i'm not a huge fan of Starbucks in general, i do seek them out sometimes because of the convenience. This location has a drive thru which can be nice.. avoid this place on saturday morning. SO BUSY!

I don't usually venture to the south-side, but if there is 1/2 off sushi I will!!!

Great atmosphere, delicious food, great service, drink specials. It doesn't get better. I will definitely be visiting here again!! 

Tip: If you want to get seated on Monday, get there at 5:00 or 5:30. This place is VERY popular.

"Burritos as big as your head" -- that sounds like a great idea! It's not such a great idea if it's gonna come back up later. 

I am not a fan. these burritos were not good. It was pretty much a big glob of shady beef. Almost no lettuce tomato or anything. I felt strong indigestion and sick after eating here.

I don't recommend.

I have been a member for many years. There are better more upscale facilities but FRS can't be beat for the price. Crowded during prime time but not impossible to get an exercise machine. Convenient location on the corner of Vets and Cleary Ave. They keep up with equipment technology too.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This is very average Mexican food.   Got the Grande Sampler and it was not very good.  Enchilada was greasy.   I mean, GREASY.   Wow.  Nothing on the 2 plates was above average.   Complimentary chips and salsa were good and the service was fine.  I really wanted to like this place.  Sadly, I did not.

This National location is very efficient with a good choice of vehicles.  The checkin procedure was quick with plenty of people working so there was no wait.  Though there was an issue of a scrape on the bumper and when it happened it was handled quickly without delaying my travel.

Pretty solid sushi for a strip mall location....Was really glad to find a japanese place in the area that delivers to langhorne/holland area
The special rolls we ordered were very tasty including the godzilla roll, jumbo dynamic, jumbo crazy and black dragon

Waited over 45 minutes for the Habachi to start. $42.00 for a TWO piece lobster. $120.00 for two people. My boyfriend and I always eat out and never have we ever experienced an expensive yet mediocre dinner before. Save yourself and go to Fuji Hana Habachi instead...

Great staff. They tend to change doctors often. However, the doctors that come through are very well trained and great, very personable. The only downside is there is always a wait. Be prepared to take out an hour out of your day. The wait time will be 30-45 mins and the exam is about 15 minutes!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Doctor Thomas and her staff are wonderful. She is passionate about vision therapy. Before any surgical operation for your eyes please be sure to get a second opinion from doctor Thomas. All the therapists are knowledgable and well trained! They are great with children and have loads of patience with each individual patient.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Kinda slow service.... and I'm just talking about getting water at the start. I had to stop my waitress to get her to bring water. Having worked in bars I could see her section wasn't busy enough for the delay. After that the food came out quick and it tasted ok.

I purchased a LivingSocial deal here (3 supreme washes for $25 -- normally about $22 each). Consistent with previous reviews, they are SLOW, however, I will take slow any day as long as they are thorough about cleaning my car (which they were). No complaints here.

Waiter was super impatient. Fish is not very fresh. Cover everything in sauce. No alcohol. Then in the middle of our meal every person in the restaurant stopped working and took over 3 tables and were slurping down food. Unprofessional. Would never go back.

I've been looking for a great place to get sushi in Hendersonville, without going to Nashville. So I decided to try Hana Sushi based on other yelpper reviews. I got the clear soup (not very flavorful), spring roll (these were good), and the Hana Sushi (delicious). For take-out this was very good, I will do this again sometime.

Pizza was decent, but cold when we got it. The customer service and time management by the staff was very poor. Wings are not good compare to the many I've had from other places. 
I probably won't go back, there are several other businesses in the area I will choose over this place.

Went here on a Sunday night (not the best night for sushi, I know) and had a really great experience. I live in San Francisco so I didn't have high hopes for Tennessee sushi, but O'Sake served fresh fish, we were served quickly, and the food was very well prepared. We all agreed that we'd definitely eat here again.

This place took a huge dive in quality since their remodel.  Instead of a nice cafe atmosphere, they changed it to an express 'get you out as quick as possible' type place.  I am very disappointed in JSB, this used to be my favorite place to eat, but not anymore.

Great take out!!!

Finally found a Chinese takeout place that does not make my wife sick. 

We have ordered twice from this place and each time they where great.  The Mu-Shi was excellent, and my wife loved the Mongolian Chicken.

My only compliant is that they dont have brown rice.

Horrible. Chicken and broccoli tasted like pickled hamster hair. The guy behind the counter also overcharged me and I didn't realize it until I was eating. Will never eat here again. Ever. Cash Only.

Food Quality/Taste = 1 Stars
Portion Size Given Price = 3 Stars
Price = 3 Stars
Service = N/A
Experience with Staff = 2 Stars

Eh, was okay. Had the large clams casino pizza - $24 with tax. It tasted fine but there was no wow moment as it was lacking clams and was overpowered by the green peppers. It is thin crust, but the whole pizza fed 2 comfortably. Was told to come in 25 minutes after ordering by phone but it looked like it was ready 10 minutes early.

Deplorable!  I walked in a couple of days ago and asked how much for a mani-pedi and after being looked at up and down, she told me they could not help me "that day."  No apology nor a price given.  If there was a "no star" rating, that's what I would give them.

I've been to a couple of the locations of this place in the Tampa area. It's okay, but nothing special. The decor is bright & colorful, which makes for a fun atmosphere. The food is extremely reasonably priced and Tuesday is Taco Night w/ super cheap tacos. Service is fine, but overall it's just so-so.

The nachos were enormous and very good except the jalapeños were out of a can which kind of ruined it. It's really nice during summer because the patio is open and it's nice and big. I would definitely go again, maybe for some nachos without jalapeños and to hang out on the porch.

My mom and I stopped in for a quick bite. The food was okay, I wouldn't go as far saying it was great. It is takeout Chinese food that has been Americanized, don't expect a gourmet meal. I got the pu pu platter, it was alright. My mom got the beef and broccoli, it was good.

Very nice hotel for the area. Had a great night sleep on the first floor in a 2 queen bedroom room. The gym is also top notch for a hotel like this. Service is great. The rooms are cozy and beds are firmness adjustable which is very satisfying. The rooms are also spacious with high ceilings.  Well worth the cost.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Royersford continues to renovate itself with the addition of Handel's Ice Cream. On the site of the former Nelson's Ice Cream Shop, a new ice cream store has risen. The staff is courteous and the ice cream delicious. I'm glad to see another place occupy this location. I hope they keep it open through the winter.

The closest location to me that offers several burgers and sandwiches for $1.  While the food is your typical McDonalds fare, the service tends to be on the poor side at times.  Too often the cashiers are in the drive-thru window area yacking with each other while lines form waiting for service.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Delicious Mexican food! 

Fast service. My pickup order was ready and waiting as promised. 

Friendly service. The lady on the phone when I ordered explained the menu options. 

Very good food. Homemade chips and salsas came w the order. Probably the best tostadas over ever had, very filling!

I like the lunch I like the chili verde Chimichanga's really good The Taste is excellent they are skimping on the pork in the Chimichanga's. I know because I go to the Midtown one and they have lots of pork cubes in the chimi.
I'm looking forward to going to happy hour getting a big giant margarita

My favourite Boston Pizza, with the regular good menu (one of the best of the "plastic menu" places) and a high level of service and cleanliness.  Unlike some of their locations, this one is not excessively noisy, and the staff are attentive and freindly.  A well run establishment.

It is the restaurant in the Crowne Plaza West Philly hotel.   The buffet breakfast was decent and the servers were nice.   The buffet breakfast price was actually reasonable comparing to some of the other hotels would charge - but still expensive if you just walk or drive to some of the restaurant around the area.

A quaint little place that offers a trendy atmosphere. It's a no frill place where the portions are a good size. If you use Yelp, you can get 10% off or your order. I ordered Chirasi with salad and it was filling and delicious. Also, if you pay with cash, you will receive 10% off.

The best part of this hotel is that it has a shuttle to the airport where you can catch the train into town. Some shuttle drivers were friendly, some were not. The hotel bar was expensive and the food they served there was mediocre. Would I book here again? Sure
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Hands down one of the best burgers around. Was going to go get In-and-Out and was recommended to this place instead because it was close and SOO glad I went. Have the burger Santa Barbara style with Avocado and cheese on sourdough. Ugh it was fantastic. And the fries, fantastic. This place can't be beat!

This location is the benchmark for all other Los Betos around town except for the Valencia location " that one is a lost cause" .
The food is pretty good for the genre, no frills and portions are good sized. 
If you want a yummy chorizio breakfast burrito this place will fill the bill.

they shouldn't be open 24/7.. it's a waste of electricity! once it hits midnight, you'll start hearing excuses like "we don't have that", "we don't have food right now because we're getting ready for breakfast"... what the hell?! boooooo, what a waste of time.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: No Kerrygold butter? But the Marsh on NJ street has it? Big store but doesn't stock as much as its smaller sister. The parking garage is okay but boy was it a hassle to get out of there during rush hour. Won't be going back. Go to the store at 320 N New Jersey street.

Interesting delicious food and drink menu, with great options for your vegetarian friends. Chef Chris has transformed this space into a neighborhood gem. All of the staff are very attentive and kind, without being overbearing.  We love the fact that the kitchen is open a little later than most other Mid-City restaurants.

Stopped here for some pizza while in the neighborhood. We don't live close by, just happened to be in the area. It was decent but not outstanding. Cash only- they acted like we should have known that when we pulled our card out. There is an ATM
In the restaurant.  I wouldn't make a special trip back.

This place is just not good. The quality is about the same as something you could pick up at your local grocery store or pizzeria for about half the price! The only things they have going for them are their ability to accommodate large groups & that they are BYOB.

Old.  Old carpet.  Old bathrooms.  Low water pressure.  Barely warm enough water.  Very friendly staff.  Marginally comfortable beds.  On the plus side they do have a microwave and a small refrigerator.  Ac in outside hall is very loud and probably on its last legs.  Extremely long check in time.  Very inefficient software system.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Great place to lounge and chat - not too loud and plenty of places to sit. 

The drinks are often prepared inconsistently, though. Sometimes my campari would come with an orange and other times it would not. Even their 'signature' cocktails would have a different garnish than what was specified on the menu at times.

I love DD coffee & donuts. But this location has the worst service. It's frustrating when the counter person talks to other customers and employees about nothing instead of taking orders. Their sloppy looking and most of them have the personality of a wet rag. To the owner....get involved or get out!!!!

Employees try to avoid eye contact in order to pretend you're not there. I waited 5 minutes at the counter only to have no one approach me to take my order. I departed letting them know that I would put in a complaint. No surprise, no one got back to me on my complaint.

Giving it  4 stars, I have celiac and their gluten-free pizza is good! very thin crust but they cook it separately on a tin so it doesn't touch the bottom of the pizza oven. I eat here about once a month and never gotten sick! Thank you for offering a gluten free alternative!
