I've gone here three times now and won't be back. My nails are never filed straight across when i leave and so they grow out slanted which is super annoying. Ive gotten 2 pedicures and they barely scrape the bottom of your feet. I leave with gross dry skin still. Prices are great but it reflects the work they're doing.

Yummy bread that rivals Boudin in SF!  Great service, consistently good food with a great variety.  Pretty good wine list and my husband is happy with the beer selection!  Did I mention that their bread is the bomb!?!  Great Herbed Halibut, Prawns Milano, Polenta soup and Margherite pizza!  :o)

I took a customer here today, and ordered the lunch fajita mix. The portion was HUGE! I ate, and have enough for two more meals. Larger portions than the one in Manchester. Ask for the hot salsa, and be ready for the after burn...it kicks in if you stop eating it. I will definitely return to this location.

Excellent new beer place! They have quite the selection of beers from nearly everywhere and the staff is friendly and enthusiastic (read: beer nerds) about their beers without being snotty. 

Definitely worth walking into if you are into beer and even if you aren't, you'll enjoy the attention to detail.

Not the best daiquiri shop in the city. They don't have a lobby area, Its all drive thru. Mondays and wednesdays are the best time to go. This daiquiri shop had a very limited selection, the customer service wasn't that stellar either. This one is in the ghetto so can't expect too much.

Have stopped in on this location many times over the years. Just recently stopped in to grab a couple tea lattes where I was greeted & quickly had my order taken. I was in & out in less than 10 minutes. Very efficient & the lattes were delicious as always!

Updated Note (6/16/12): this location has been sold off and will soon become a part Jersey Mike's Subs and part Wendy's.

RIP McDonalds, many a Big Mac was served in this location, and you will not be forgotten by the tens of thousands of Amtrak Keystone passengers who rushed into your lobby during their 18-minute layover.

I liked this place okay, but there was only one tart flavor (strawberry). My friend was sad the only mochi topping they had was strawberry-flavored. Noticed one soy flavor (peanut butter) that after tasting made me really grateful for being able to consume dairy.

I've been to this McDonald's about a dozen times, mostly drive-thru but sometimes eat-in. It's a nice interior and the employees are friendly. Other than that one experience when they didn't include my Egg McMuffin Sandwich in my breakfast meal and maybe one other occasion, I've gotten the correct order and the food has been good.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Italian place owned by some guy name Tony. About a block from the beach. Nice quiet atmosphere. The ribs are decent. My angel hair with clams not bad, but not super angelic. Overall a decent place. The Pizza here is supposed to be great but not in a pizza mood today.

Cocky much?? Don't let the name fool you. This is a far cry from the best in town.  The only way this place would classify as best in town is if it was the only one in town. The pizza had a brick oven taste but it didn't differentiate itself enough from fair, grease-laden Northeast Philly pizza to call itself best in town.

I'm a HUGE fan of their creamy fun fantastic flavors!  It's hard for me to view their menu w/out having an anxiety attack!!!  There are so may variations that are constantly changing!  It's GREAT!  The only downside is the fat content and the super high prices.  :)

This restaurant refused to charge me for four burgers and put all of them between one bun.  It's ridiculous to think that you've got one job to do -put burgers between buns - and you can't even get that right.

Congratulations on winning first place in the race to the bottom!

They don't seem to get my car as clean as they used to.  I still go because they recycle the water, which is better than doing it yourself where you wast the water and the soap can be harmful to the environment.  the prices aren't too bad especially if you get a book.

This hotel is gorgeous, with a price tag to match. There were a lot of out of towners, which gave it a Vegas feel poolside. The gym is on the top floor, and can mess with your head a bit if you have height issues. Expect to pay top prices for anything extra here. The room was excellent.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My tire was hissing and I needed a quick replacement. I came in stressed and shaking, and the team at NTB completely took care of me and calmed me down. They even stayed late to get my tires replaced. Very positive experience and I would highly recommend this location for any tire issues, emergency or not!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Employees are not the happy campers you would normally see at this chain. I have been in here several times, always the same grumpy uninterested all business young faces. They have never been thrilled to accommodate my special requests. Not my choice of place to eat in this complex.

I came her on a Tuesday at noon for lunch. There were 3 men playing pool, and a man and women sitting at the bar. I can't see how they stay in business. As for the food my chicken sandwich was very good but the fries tasted like they were deep fried in old oil. I will come back to try other food.

Located next door to the Holiday Inn - French Quarter. I had lunch. Like most places here in New Orleans, good selection of alcohol. I had the red beans and rice with grilled sausage. Nothing to write home about. It was good, but not great. Good bartender service.

I was just wanting a snack and a beverage. It was attached to my hotel. so why not. I had a crown and coke. Normal small bar glass. 9 DOLLARS????????????. Ordered the chips and cheese. Cheese dip was good. first serving of chips was stale and very greasy. second batch was good. I wont be going there for another beverage.

absolutely the best sushi around!!! we used to live in the city and after having sushi here, we honestly think the fish and flavors are much better at umai! Entire staff here is wonderful and really become your friends! Make sure to get the blue fin tuna for an extra $1 when they have it, totally worth it!

Filthy cars (interior)... I had to pick up baby wipes to clean up the greasy interior.

The car needed an alignment badly ablbd the steering wheel would stick at center.

This is the second time that I had a bad experience here with poorly maintained vehicles.  The last time the car I rented had bald tires on it.

Very nice hotel with an excellent pool. More geared towards the family and business conference crowd.

Spent a week here at the end of April, the weather was absolutely perfect and spent most of the day poolside. I highly recommend getting a brown top pina colada and relaxing in the FL sun!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Used to come here literally at least once a week because we can walk here. Their prices have randomly gone up astronomically. 12 wings went to $16? How is this even justified? Also just called to get the pasta dinners. They no longer even do them. Won't be back anymore.

I took my dog for an emergency visit (he was bleeding) and the office declined to see him because I don't have an appointment. Since when did an emergency require an appointment? It's so disheartening that the employee at the check-in exercised zero common sense.

Super challenging, fun and effective workouts paired with an awesome staff. I've done their classes and I've done their personal training and highly recommend both! I worked with Mada and she whipped me into tip top shape right before my wedding and I couldn't be happier!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The food is fine but way over priced.  $100 tab for 2 adults and 3 kids with not much in the way of extras and no alcohol.  The decor is nice but not fancy.  They service is slow with the meal taking far too long not were the entrees bright at the same time.  I suggest skipping it for other sushi options.

I only came in for a coffee, so my review doesn't encompass the food which looked great. The espresso wasn't pulled properly, so it came bitter and watery.
That being said, the ambiance was great, and I've got a bag of good beans. Worth a shot, but not for a coffee snob like me.

We are always on the hunt of really good food,  we just found a place we will come back to again, and again.  The service is wonderful, and to start the salsa doesn't taste or look like everyone elses.  Our food came out and sorry no pictures because it was that good.  I had a tamale and it was fluffy and full of flavor.

More convenient for us than the one in the Commons, this was a good location for them.

Pretty standard corporate food -- consistent with the next place.

Our dogs love to get patties only as very special treats... and Five Guys is awesome to pack them up for us.

This is a must stop while in New Orleans. That being said, it is a touristy place but you gotta have a Hand Grenade! It'll knock you out.

Our group started our second line here. Perfect place to grab a drink and march down Bourbon St with a police escort and live brass band, just saying.

Food is fine, sort of a small menu (and tables). I was a little disappointed with the glass size my sangria came in since it cost $5 and had a lot of ice. Otherwise the environment for the restaurant is good, definitely a good local place feel to get some halfway decent food.

Horrible, run down, decrepit junk hotel. Everything about this place is an embarrassment. What is this world coming to? The staff, the food, and the prices are like a perfect conglomeration and example of what NOT to do. They should call this place the ghetto circus hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: About a year ago I got my eyebrows done and they were messed up. showed the owners but they didn't seem to care. I shouldn't of had to pay for it especially since I walked out upset with my eyebrows screwed up. was told to color of them inwith pencil so they looked like they matched! Were they on crack?

My car went in dirty and came out 1/2 as dirty, which sucks for 15 bucks. Tire shine is bleach, which will dry out your tires and make them look like garbage. Stop being cheap and use the good stuff. Towels used to dry your cars are dingy and dirty. Swirl marks anyone?

Not fantastic, but not bad either. I was there on opening week and it was packed out the door. But the more i come back the less I see. Staff is ok. Prices are what they are. And the amazing glazed donut gets old after a while. I'm not a donut lover and KK hasn't changed my mind.

yummy local pizza.  

i like the silly provel thing they do.  thin crust and imos are just not the most delicious or most cost effective way to fill my stomach.

it is funny how the two imos on hampton always make sure you can tell them apart.  don't call the wrong one.  =P

This place is nice~however it is almost double the price of any other vet in SB. Have very very deep pockets if you want to go here. They charged me $30 to clip my dogs nails and other prices are almost twice as much as other vets! I now go to San Roque Pet Hospital and they are very friendly and very reasonable!

The restaurant is mostly clean.  The food is edible.  If you are visiting  New Orleans don't bother.  This is no more than greasy bar food.  The portions are big,  the price is big,  the service is slow, and they can't get the order right.  At least the tea is good.

Went last night, very quiet in the place. Had the Pea/Curry soup (which was very good), with the Bison meatloaf (also very good). Small simple menu with fresh ingredients, despite this there was something for every one, exactly what I was looking for. Attentive wait staff and good service. I would definitely come back.

Personally, this is one of my favorite places for a quick semi-authentic Mexican meal. Make sure to order the spicy salsa if you're into the heat! Also, the tacos de carnitas is off the charts, along with tacos de carne asada. This may be the fastest restaurant in Nashville.

The owner is super cool. The local beer selection is stellar! I would highly recommend coming and supporting this place any day. It's not just a filling station anymore. You can hang out and listen to great tunes. Monday through Friday happy hour is 3-6 with $1 off all pints!

Came in to see a friend's band play. The crowd was ehh-clectic, Melt itself is possibly even more eclectic. The staff as well. We've been wanting to come for breakfast and now that we see what it has to offer I think it's still on our radar. Will update once we've eaten waffles and tasted coffees!

I wanted to like this place but they seem to compensate for the lack of freshness and flavor in some of the dishes by giving you 5 POUNDS of it.

Take a note from some of the greats in town (Harvest, Eleven Eleven). QUALITY not quantity. I know Italians "love to eat" but seriously, it was enough food for 4.

3.5....rounded up for now. The chaos of picking up and order is a definite -1. The restaurant is like one hallway with nonstop traffic.

Some of the sushi was excellent though, and it's a closer and less expensive choice than Wasabi or Kampai so we may patronize them again.

Parking can be SUPER annoying in this area.

Starting to worry too much about food cost.  Chicken breast sandwich we had was really small.  Like they took a regular one and split it in half.  Menu is getting old.  Last time I had the chicken wings, they were super small too

Dude.  We only go for drinks now.

I like Subway but one they can't understand and I don't mind that it be a fast service but to be rushed out of the way is not ok. Plus if you ask for any extras it's with a grunt and eye rolling. No thank you for me. I drive  2 miles and go to the other subway.

Tokyo Express thank you for existing in West Edmonton Mall because I don't have to eat a lousy burger or soggy fries from one of the many burgers and fries establishment in the food court.

I would take a Maki roll or a bento box any day of the week over the golden arches.

Went for brunch here today and it was excellent! Great service and attentive waitress. Delicious Bloody Mary! I had the omelet and added mushrooms and bacon and would have liked to have it cooked in the omelette but it was on the side - still delicious though! Overall excellent experience!

Matteo's is right down the street from my apartment in Cool Springs, and I'm so glad it is. Not that I order pizza often, but when I do... I want good pizza. This is GOOD pizza. 

So many options of toppings, friendly service, and decent pricing. Keep baking those pies, Matteo's.

It's Starbucks, one with somewhat nicer furnishings and an ample amount of space. I doubt there's is much variation between stores and customers come here knowing what to expect. Didn't get particularly bad or good service here. As usual, the coffee's just okay.

Competent.  Very nice and very accommodating folks.  Food failed to dazzle but wasn't in any way bad.

The decor indicates that the diners should dress up.  But they don't.  I think this is simply a function of the part of the country in which the restaurant is located.

This would be a great hotel to stay when traveling for business. Above average. Still, nothing to write home about. Feng shue/room design was a touch off. And there is nothing interesting or unique about it. 

You can see a McDonalds from here. And the McDonalds seems to have its own pier. That's about it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I don't even drink but I have been coming here since my college days. As liquor has gotten more more expensive somehow these guys are still they will sell it cheaper than everyone else. I just change the name recently so if you been going here this is the same place but just a different awning.

Very nice and large Spring Hill.  I love Spring Hill's so I am biased.  The breakfasts in the morning never disappoints.  Not giving it 5 stars because I feel they have shady characters staying here on weekends from out of town, not in their control.  They do have security that walks around to monitor it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This particular DD can't ever seem to get it together with their customer service and drive thru operations.   Having customers pull to the side for "efficiency" is completely inefficient.  The owner/manager could greatly benefit from speaking with a Six Sigma consultant.

Used to think they were the best but they really aren't friendly anymore. If you are burnt out go get another waiter job. When they first opened they were so pleasant and enthusiastic about their product and now they just act like jaded hipsters. Food is still but the vibe is just a bummer.

Brought in my uniform for cleaning.  Charged me $18 bucks for top and bottom and they forgot to give my uniform proper creases for the top.  I complained and they gave me a measly $2 off.  I never pay that much for my uniform - only around $5 bucks for top and bottom.  Never again.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I've gone twice for a gel manicure and spa pedicure. Each time the gel manicure (using OPI gel) have lasted at least two weeks. The pedicures have always been incredibly relaxing and rejuvenating. They offer a complimentary shoulder/neck massage while your nails are drying. It's reasonably priced, clean, and convenient.

Only been here once, just to grab a quick slice, but I LOVE the fact that "a slice" is literally a quarter of a pie. Its 2 slices. I found that out, because I asked for "two slices," and I was told that "thats half a pie." Slices were good. I'll definitely be back

Did I miss something? How is this place different in ANY way from Mikado? They even have the same staff as they did when they were Mikado. I have reviewed Mikado before, so if you want to know how Kampachi is, just read that because the two are LITERALLY the same thing.

went here for dinner recently and food was good. however, if I had known they were out of potatoes I would have ordered the lamb instead of the ribeye. it wasn't until my food arrived with a side of pasta did they tell me that they were out of potatoes.
 limited dessert selections this particular Sunday night!

This place is sooo slow. I am sitting at the drive through line as we speak and the line has not moved for 5 minutes. I often order chili and they sometimes pack a spoon. Ok now 6 minutes still haven't moved... I might die of old age in the drive through line.

I don't really know what's going but it looks as if they threw me pick order together just with no regard.  They are not busy so there is no excuse.  And when I mention they put al the sushi in one container they gave me a look of bewilderment. Didn't even give me wasbi or anything wow just ridiculous.

The hotel itself was fine.  The restaurant attached to the hotel was pretty weak sauce.  I spent $10 for breakfast and walked away hungry.  The exercise room was pretty small.  Free weights and some cardio machines.  That's it.   It wasn't a bad place, I guess I've just come to expect more.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
If I designed a hotel this would be how I would design it. If I ran a hotel this is how I would run it. 

Swimming pool on the 11th floor.
Great bar.
Sundries and beer for sale.
Comfortable beds and pillows.
Very friendly service

That being said... uncomfortable desk chair. TV can't tilt?! No comfy chair for TV?! Minor complaints.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This location must have a morning rush on the weekdays, but it's not crammed with students or tourists whenever I go in the evenings or weekend. And I am embarrassed for liking the draft latte as much as I do, but it's like a cafe sua da without the diabetic coma.

I came here for an updo for a wedding. I had a vague idea of what I wanted, but did not have a picture or any real guidance. The end result was beautiful. I wish I could get my hair done there every day. I have only gotten a few updos ever, but this was by far the best. For great hair in New Orleans, go to City Looks!

23.00 dollars for all you can eat and they sit you at the bar so you can watch your food being made.

Very clean and nice chiefs, TV is above the bar.  The only down fall now is that I stuffed myself so much to get in my 23.00 dollars that I don't want sushi FOR A LONG TIME.

The vegi wrap was tasty.   It didn't leak or fall apart and all the ingredients were fresh.   Due to timing there were no lines when I ordered.   Service was just fine.   Prices are airport prices so you do pay a lot for what you get.   At least this healthy option is available vs some junky fast food restaurant.

First time here and I got a concrete mixed with pecans.   It was good but had a subtle burnt egg yolk aftertaste.   I wasn't sure if it was the combination or just the custard but I was already commuting back so I couldn't exchange it.   The service was friendly and the place was clean.   I'll try them again for sure.

I have found Vic Sushi Bar to be one of the best and consistent sushi spots in Philadelphia. They have a good assortment of choices [the Sunshi and Sansom roll being two I am fond of] and while some of them combine a lot of ingredients, I think they pull them off well. And the price is very reasonable [for sushi].

Random points:

The food is very good. 

The service is also good.

It gets a bit loud and hard to hear your dining partner.

The tables are close together. If you don't like people, this is not the place for you.

Multiple misspellings on the menu.

Cash only.

I would eat here again.

As the name implies, they are tomato pies. Specifically, they are emulating De Lorenzo's tomato pies in Trenton. They succeed, although they do have rest rooms.

Don't expect the usual pizza.

The clam pie is also terrific.

Tony Luke was there eating a couple pies the that time we ate there.

I am definitely a fan of the yogurt here and the ambiance. I give it 4/5 because if you look at the nutrition facts that must be asked for you will see the yogurt is very high in sugar and calories. It's practically the same as eating ice cream. It is nice to indulge in yogurtland every once in a while but its not guilt-free

In general the move away from the train station was a very positive one. Allowing for a great space to sit and relax or work. Ample parking. They now have a drive through and still seem a little "challenged" with that new addition but all in all a great place.

Just an update on this bank. I still hate this bank. Nothing but issues EVERY TIME I come here. I can never deposit money using the ATM. This issue has been "corrected" 4 times. I do not get what needs to be corrected in order for me to deposit money into my own account.

Dont get the ramen. Squid salad and sushi were delicious. Gyoza pan-fried are awesome and you have to try it. The ramen was not really ramen. The soup didn't have any flavor and the noodles didn't taste like they were cooked all the way. We will be going back for  the gyoza and sushi for sure.

I guess this is what we have now...i agree,  i am almost always overcharged,  i bought leeks once and was charged for all three what the cost of the bundle should have been!    its way more expensive than sav a center was too!  and an occational Hello wouldnt hurt!  ohhh...don't get me started!

Good service but will try to up sell you! I came in because i blew my tire and Iwas down the street. Tire was on sale but after inspection it was suggested i get 4 new tires (which i probably need but not today) ball joint replacement on blown tire and rotation for $1600.

No thanks! Though I did get two new back tires.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Best appetizers and food. Was a big fan of thier cazuelas until they changed it up by trying to make it fancy and raised the price to $15. Now I just drink a beer! Anyhow the food is delicious, the waitresses are always friendly and great, and the music on Friday and Saturday nights is always fun.

Came here to pick up dinner for family. What I would expect from Five guys as far as quality and quality of service. The fries were a little underdone and the man calling my number said "30" but it sounded a lot like "40". They should really get a digital display of sorts up and running.

The place didn't blow me away by any stretch of the imagination. I also didn't have the highly touted sushi there. BUT they did have hot tea free of charge (a staple at any authentic asian restaurant) and decent vegetarian options. The soba was good, though clearly not 100% buckwheat soba. I'll probably pass next time.

This off airport facility includes all Rental Companies. Take the bus from the middle curb at arrival level. Expect a 10 minute ride. If you're not Hertz Gold expect to wait in line to get your car. Although the weekly rates are low, facility taxes and fees could add a $100 to your bill.

A taste of the city in the burbs. Absolutely delicious! Their crab fundido and mushroom huarache appetizers are out of this world. I love their chicken enchiladas and carnitas tacos, they're usually my go-to entrees. Churro ice cream dessert is worth every calorie!

Picked up an order for my team at work $15 for bakers dozen. Not bad. There was no line at 8:30 am which was a plus wide variety of donuts and the chocolate w/ choc frosting was tasty! Parked at meter right outside which gives 10 free minutes (i think) was in and out in no time

Pros: really nice atmosphere, great decor.

Cons: (IMO) a little pricey for what you get. The non-sushi menu options we got were sort of okay, but nothing to write home about. On return trips I'll certainly focus on the sushi. When dropping $40+ on a meal, I want to feel like I got something I couldn't make better at home!

New hotel, always a bonus. Staff was super friendly and awesome. I was a bit irked by Hilton's representation on their web site staying how it has all this stuff around the hotel when all the stuff is still being built and wasn't open. But when it's competed it will be an excellent place to stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Drink thru order almost $30.00 during lunch time. Took forever for order to be taken. Waited almost 20 minutes after paying for food. Fries were either raw or burnt.When i finally received the order I asked why it took so long, she said we're busy it's lunch.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place is not cute , hidden in a strip mall with a very stripped down dining area but the food is good and a good value. I had got ans sour soup and chicken lo mein both of which were excellent. My mother had black peppered chicken and enjoyed it. $5.95 lunch special Monday- Saturday!

They used to be my go to place, but the quality has declined. I only recognized one face among the staff. I suspect the place has been sold or something. It used to be in and out in under an hour, but today I sat there like a chump for more than an hour and they did not even look at my car. So I left.

This is the best ewing has to offer. Food is good and prices are reasonable. They need a larger appetizer selection.  Sals is our go to place when we are not sure where to go. Service is good but it is obvious that some of the girls smoke during their shift. That's a bit nasty. Over all a really good restaurant.

I was so disappointed.  The risotto I got tasted like glue and the scallops were cold and rubbery.  My husband enjoyed his steak,  however.  The service was OK.  But we spent a fortune on an AWFUL meal and felt rushed.  They sent us a 10.00 coupon....they can keep it.

Great place for Hibatchi! Lunch specials are worth it. But for the price at dinner, Umi Grill kicks the bottom out of it if you can spare the Hibatchi experience. Service is EQUAL with all of your guest whom you share the hibatchi grill with. Nice people too!

Sushi was well made and fresh. Maybe a bit to much rice in it? No big deal... The udon tasted great and well flavored shrimp in it. The egg rolls where not greasy. Playboy Roll has a great presentation. Fried ice Creme was addictive! Only down fall was the martinis! Super strong, almost unbearable! Great service though!

We only dined here once, but we thought it was decent.  As others have said - there are lots of Italian places inn South Jersey (many not that great).  But I really like Nunzio.  I would compare them to Sappori in Collingswood.  Still one of the better local Italian eateries.

If you expect this to be cheaper than going to your dealership you are ready for a rude awakening. I felt it was far more expensive and especially their labor rates are very steep. This place was recommended by a friend but I am just going to go back to the dealer.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
The food is ok~ 
It's honestly just a mediocre diner like everywhere else. I do enjoy the cheese sticks though. 
My server on the other hand was very sweet, polite and on top of her game. 
My order had originally came out cold and she was so sweet and patient about fixing it. I give it a 3 because of the food...

Pretty tasty! I like carry out here and the service is very warm. Enchiladas were pretty warm and extra jalapeños were spicy and extra green which equals fresh fresh fresh! Salsa is chunky and chips are warm and home made. I was glad they weren't too salty :)

Wow....and not in a good way. The food was typical airport. You get whatcha get. 

The service was another matter!! Look....if you don't like your job, find a new one. If you're going to try rudeness as being funny..... let's work on your delivery, because today, it certainly wasn't working!!

This is the worst Marriott I've ever been too - and I'm an Elite member. It's an embarrassment to the brand. The hotel is situated between 4 highways and busy roads - so every room is noisy. The entire hotel is pet friendly - so half the rooms smell like cat urine and the other half smell like deodorizer. I'll never return.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Service was good and food was tasty. We ordered two burritos and a taco combo, the chicken was a touch dry though. Overall it hit cravings and we were glad to try another local authentic taco shop.  We had Togo food, and the wait was just right. Thank you,

This place totally sucks!!! Conveniently located but believe I won't be back. God forbid you ask for something on the side, for one they don't put it in your order. For two the chinsy food they give isn't worth it anymore. And customer service is crappy also!!

My girlfriend (now wife) & I stopped in to Cisco's a few days after we moved into our house in Flourtown. Nice cold beer, but a couple of bland previously frozen fried hamburger patties left us really cold. Too bad we didn't know any of the locals at that point - maybe we would have ordered the cheese-steak hoagie.

I live 5 minutes from this Giant but will now travel the extra miles to the Flourtown store after shopping there for the first time today. The difference between these two stores is like night and day. The store (Flourtown) seems cheerier and cleaner and the employees are so much nicer. Very pleasant experience.

Ordered my usual. Sashimi platter with salmon, salmon roe, Tuna and uni. They were somewhat flavorless. Rolls seemed good with all the sauces etc but sashimi wasn't that good. And personally I am not fan of blue neon light with food presentation. Not so appetizing.

I love this local nail spot. Its so close to my home and I always am received by the most welcoming staff! They are so friendly! I had my nails done there a few weeks ago with the gel polish and it looked perfect for over a month! They provide a great massage with pedicures as well! I highly recommend.

Worst Burger King Ever! Slow service and completely got my order wrong while I listened to the employees bash the customers because they were still ordering breakfast at 10:30.... How it's still open is beyond me. I'll just go to the one in Greenwood from here on out.

Food is decent, prices were better than expected. Our server, Juan was horrible, he would disappear for long periods of time, at one point we had to ask the hostess to find him.... Twice. Atmosphere could use some changes, I get the decor, but it's too much... bull.

Won't be going back.

Below average quality of food, prices are "ok". They charge $2 per can of soda, so be warned. 

Very loud and crowded atmosphere.

The sushi seaweed is very chewy and thick, spicy tuna rolls tasted very "fishy" which is not good. The staff was pretty friendly though. 

Overall, we wouldn't go again.

Absolutely THE worst Dunkin I've ever been to. They get orders wrong continuously, they run out of stock on items constantly, and asking to correct the order is like watching paint dry. I think the combined intelligence of the entire staff is that of a box of rocks. Never again will I give them another shot.

I have been to Thario's four times now. Each time I got something different. I have yet to have a meal that disappoints. I just had the spaghetti and meat balls and it was fantastic! I have had two different pizzas with the family and everyone said they were very authentic. I personally love their lasagna. Go and enjoy!

Had lunch here today.  It was OK for lunch.  The sushi was fresh and good.  Not spectacular.  The service was prompt.  I had the cold tofu for an appetizer, and I highly recommend staying away.  I thought it might be quality tofu as they were offering it cold on its own, but it was more like grocery store quality.  Not yummy.

The original  and still the best when it comes to panzarrottis. Since I will be working in Camden, I will make my way to some famous spots to satisfy my palette. Started at this spot. Panzarrottis are the best you will ever find. They have a full array of choices to fill in their panzarrottis. This was all look good!

Although parking can be a problem, a good place to stop if you need a few cases of beer for a party. Staff is very helpful and if you can get your car near the store they'll help bring the cases to your car. If you want single bottles or a non-standard selection of beers you'll need to go somewhere else (e.g., Local 44).

Excellent service. Very attentive and friendly. Food was good. It's very hard to find authentic Italian food in Tampa. Pasta was homemade which is a HUGE plus. Personally, the temperature is my dish wasn't hot enough and the sauce was too thick. Again, personal preferences. 
Dessert and cappuccino were a great ending to the meal!

The prices are a bit higher than other nearby sushi places.  I was not a fan of the scallop roll and the chicken teriyaki was not that good.  The service was very attentive and the décor was better than most sushi places.  Maybe it was just an off day for the chefs since the other reviews are much higher.

Overpriced Mexican, with only hipster quality food (decent, but nowhere near as good as the 15 different Taquerias around the corner on 9th St). In a neighborhood full of Mexican immigrants, do yourself a favor and go to a Taqueria that is full of Mexican customers and not hipsters - you'll see why.

My dad and I had about 45 minutes to kill before our 4:45 movie and so we came here.  We were seated right away since they were dead. Our waiter came right over and took our orders and offered us the movie ticket deal.  He was very attentive. My dad had the clam chowder which he said was just okay. Burgers are pretty good.

Came here for happy hour but the up charge is ridiculous...they have $5.00 margaritas but if you want flavor it's an extra $3.50 for syrup...and please tell me where Cuervo is the same price as Patron??? I get patron being  $9.00 a shot but Cuervo 
...smh..oh well the nachos were good.

I followed Becky here from a previous salon. Becky is the shizz when it comes to cutting my hair. She asks questions and listens to my answers before telling me her plan. Cute place-trendy colors and design. Affordable prices and a talented stylist-what more can you ask for in Port Richmond?

You cannot beat OG Habit!

Burgers and fresh and top quality, fries are hot and addicting, and the feeling you get when your at the front window makes you feel like a kid again!

Keep it up Habit, I'm proud to say the best burger in the USA is from my hometown!

Not fast food 20 min and Diet Coke was not diet. Ugg. They are super slow yet employees are chowing down in the dining room yucking it up. All we wanted was a Diet Coke and hash browns . When I ran inside they looked at me like I was out of line, or worse...
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I go here only for really expensive items as I feel like they are a bit more professional than some other locations although their prices are really outrageous.  They charge so much for simple dry cleaning services and hemming the dress of a coton sundress.  They are not a regular vendor for me.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: It was a while back that we came here to eat and maybe its not fair to write a review after a couple of months have gone by. But if the food would have been great I know I would have remembered. Would I go back, Probably since I have no negative memories from the experience either.

The owner has been a great supporter of the local schools. The pizza is solid with good sauce. I'd like my crust a bit thicker but otherwise very good. The cheesesteak here was also very good for South Jersey. Finally their grilled cheese varieties are very tasty. Johnny's is definitely a solid go to neighborhood pizzeria.

i wanted to try this place for awhile and went yesterday before the basketball game. i will try to be brief and to the point i thought the crust was a little too thick and wasnt cooked enough; it was too soft. i had pepperoni and it was ok just nothing special and have had better in reno

This restaurant is a convenient choice for the Ritz movie theaters. Unfortunately, the fried chicken was only so-so.  Maybe,it was an off night. The pancake underneath was not terrible, but neither was it tasty.   The salad, however, was great. The Oreo pudding dessert was good as well.

We are back for the first time this year.
Lorenza ordered the Sashimi/Tempura lunch and I order the Sashimi lunch with grilled squid appetizer. 
We love the atmosphere. The Japanese waitresses have been here for decades and the booths have the feeling of old Japan. 

Oi Shi Ney.

No longer my favorite.  Went to celebrate my birthday and was beyond disappointed with the 3 Tempura Combinations and 4 Soft Shelled Crabs.  they were over breaded in a way I have never experienced.  Not sure if they have some one new in the kitchen, but Sakura now has my heart and stomach!

Refinery has some solid regional food in a fun hip atmosphere. The upstairs patio area is cool. This restaurant is part of the Seminole Heights renaissance and the owners, Greg and Michelle Baker, have a great deal to be proud of. The competition has increased and stepped up the game. Game on.

I keep trying to be impressed by Gia Nina's because of their reputation, but it just doesn't happen for me. Our last try was a carry-out pizza with everything. It was good, but not great. We'll probably go there again when we get bored with the limited offerings in the Woodbury area, but it's just not a first choice.

Sat at the bar, ordered a bloody Mary, Horrible!! The worst bloody Mary in the city. I watched the guy make it and just knew I was in trouble. Was shocked he actually charged me..after I said I had better. Miso soup was good. The box I had was just okay. Will stick with Sushi from now on...

Stopped in for a late lunch, the simplest salad was so refreshing. Cucumber and Soy Sauce. The Sushi was top notch. When a person orders water, please don't give them the look of death. Overall the hostess was very enjoyable and friendly. Only reason I gave four stars, Sushi Chef had his ear buds in... Totally incorrect...

I don't know what everybody's beef is about the wait time.  I cruised through the drive-through in no time.  The staff was very friendly.  As for the food?  Hey, they're sliders; what do you expect?  They taste yummy going down and you'll of course regret them later.  That's the deal.

Love the bourbon glazed salmon.  Had it with the grilled zucchini.  Very good! They need to have a written recipe for their side car.  I have had it 3 times & it was different every time:)
All in all, a pretty good place to eat.  Burgers are good, as well!

All Dunkin Doughnuts have the same menu.  What sets this one apart is speed. At rush hour they have 4 registers working and several extra staff to make sure that you are served in seconds.  For uncooked items, there is basically no waiting after you pay the cashier.

I was with a group of several people and ordered the carne asada. The beef was extremely dry and tough. The avocados were oxidized and brown. How could they sell such an inferior meal for $13?  I would have been better served by Taco Bell!  Don't waste your money at this place.

Very well managed and maintained. The staff is exceptional. The dinner and breakfast at Pellagia was excellent. The breakfast buffet was reasonable and offered a wide variety of selections.

Highly recommend any event and stay at this hotel. The food is great.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
It's been a few years since I've had a car wash here. Now I remember why I stopped. 

If u go to a car wash u should be able to pay , car washed and drive away. 

Here u work. For $4 u get to dry ur car urself. To much work. Not worth the time and effort. 

Go to mister shine, spend a little extra and be completely satisfied

Had enough space but still small compared to the other ones I've been to. I favor this one only because they have 2 stair masters. Cleanliness hasn't been a problem for me. The staff has been friendly, considering I only interact with they scan my pass and when they say bye to me.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I was a little hesitant because it is located in a weird strip mall but the food was amazing. It's a byob but the sandwiches taste great with the fancy sodas they sell. New American cuisine is the best way to describe it so if you are expecting "traditional" food be aware.

I think they recently changed chefs.  The three star rating is an average.  It would be 5 stars for the old food and 1 for the new food.  All of the rolls taste different and the tartar is awful now.  They have even changed their coupons.  This used to be my go-to sushi place but I may have to find a new one.

Um, not gourmet... but made from scratch pizza to order. Was good but sauce was way too sweet. Did love all the vegetarian options though. Far from worst pizza I've ever had but you won't mistake it for a wood fired Neapolitan pie. Nice addition to late night quick food options on Cherokee. And super friendly owners!

Do you like low employee turnover, working equipment,  cleanliness, water to drink and cool temperatures at your gym?  

Do you get amped to exercise and like the reliability of knowing you're going to a place that will support a good workout?

Don't go here.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I love Giant!  

They always have what I need.

The store is very clean.

The store is huge and has so many products. 

I love their bakery department, the cakes and breads are so yummy! 

The staff is always so helpful and friendly and can get customers quickly through the lines.

I have to say I was questioning this McDonalds from the looks on the outside, but due to the long drive-thru line we opted to brave it and head in for our sodas. The place was spotless and the service was excellent. Wow! They have Coke Zero now to my husbands delight! A quality McDonalds.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I take my cat here for vaccines and they are cheap so I will continue to get her vaccined here. However ask for Dr. Sara and as per the recommendation of a friend of mine that used to work there: if you need more than just vaccines, such as surgery, go somewhere else. If all you need is vaccines though this is the place to go.

My husband and I are such fans of this place. It's small, located on the corner of Lafayette Square. The food isn't anything gourmet, but what they do make is wonderful. The specials are where it's at. And you can't beat the price. Definitely a good spot to make it your regular breakfast place if you live in the area.

Ah, walking into the el Azteca I felt like I'd come home to Southern California and their wonderful family owned Mexican Restaurants.   The atmosphere is great.   The food is very good and very reasonable and the Margaritas delicious and reasonable.   I can't wait to go back.

2 stars for great service by the optometrist. Other than the optometrist care, this place is ridiculously expensive. $150 for a single vision -1/-0.75 lenses? Rip off! If you bought a Groupon, buying the glasses and lenses are absolutely not worth it. Not going back.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: After reading all the good reviews I had to give this place a try.  All the positive reviews are spot on!  The spicy mocha is really all that!  The barista was very friendly and the place has a great vibe.  This is not your chain store Starbucks!  I can't wait to return.

This place has very good pizza. I've had better in a very few places which is why the 4 stars instead of 5.

For those of you who keep posting negative reviews on pizza joints after ordering a salad... please stop. These are pizza joints, not neighborhood gardens.

So they've raised their prices to $3.25 (single), $3.75 (double) and $5 (triple), though dryers have stayed the same. I'm taking now giving them 3 stars though I'll probably continue to go there because it IS clean and IS convenient to where I live, but now I have to pay even more...
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Smooth creamy froyo and tasty gelato. The service is friendly and we tried a handful of flavors before settling on both froyo and gelato. Their single flavor of frozen yogurt is a bit different. Its more creamy and less icy. It is a little more sweet and a little less tart. The gelato is good as well.

This location is right in congested center city, which is notorious for no parking... and sure enough it was wall to wall packed. I'm not screwing with fkn parking around here... now I have to wait until I'm near another location later this week, thanks a lot.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: It was ok, except for the unavailability of the fitness room but at least they had the business center. But apparently these hotels are pretty much party joints now, I go to get away but I've got to deal with carfuls of gangstas with tinted out windows smoking up weed day and nite...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Apparently the benches and weights are thee most popular attraction at these places because there's always people using them. Forget about ellipticals etc at gyms... weights are where it's at; And can't escape the muscle heads rolling up in their cool cars, bikes etc. That's the deal.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Pros: Rural area, comp pass to local gym. Cons: Really high hold fee, while I do appreciate a computer being available it  freezes up after a couple minutes,howling screechy pop music being played in lobby,too many loud  cars and trucks  on roads outside and bikes at gas station across road. Aside from that it's ok;
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Very friendly staff who made the process of renting a car easy and quick while my car was in the shop. Good selection of vehicles too. Yes, most of my costs were covered through my insurance company, but if I'd need to rent a car for any other reason, I would definitely consider this Enterprise location.

very expensive sushi for very average to below average tasting sushi.   We had tried a special scallop roll- very bland taste at best-  the waitress asked for our feedback-  but it still remained on our bill.   The spicy crunch tuna roll was good, but not enough to have me spend that much money on blah food.

Fish n Chips had too much batter, tartar sauce was too much mayo, fries were too salty and not crisp enough for vinegar. Wife did enjoy STL steak sandwich and Caesar salad.  Lots of TV's to catch a game. Friendly service.  Will be back to sample some other menu items.

Hit or miss.  Sometimes the sushi is great and other times it is terrible.

More importantly, I would never sit down at this restaurant again - the service is terrible.

But, there is a $9 lunch special that includes three rolls and a salad.  That's a deal and it only takes 10-15 minutes.

I won't shop any other store unless I'm too far away.  Full line of all beverages, and the best prices around, if not lower, for sure they won't be higher.  Quick check out, and great customer service if you're looking for a specific bottle.   Always have a positive experience here.

Chiles rellenos: A
Queso Enchiladas: A
Nachos with cheese: D-
The chips themselves would have been decent. They were definitely made in the store. The yellow liquid cheese was even worse than Taco Bell. Don't waste your $8. Otherwise, the food was decent. We got takeout.

Continued 5-Star experience that I have experienced in OH. The entire team did an awesome job on their first "officially/unofficial" catering order today. Clients raved about the fresh salad, veggies and of course the Piada Sticks and Cannoli Chips!

I will certainly be back. I will refer you guys in a heartbeat!
-JP

I don't really like visiting chains, especially when I'm traveling, but I got over-ruled by my travel-mates. It was nice. Not thrilling, but nice. I had the lasagna ($13) which was a bit overpriced (quality) but at least the portion was decent. House wine at $5.50/glass was ok.

Good, strong drinks.

The cauliflower soup was divine as were the garlic mashed potatoes and creamed spinach (the steak those sides came with was pretty tasty, too).

Beware if they seat you at a high-top table; the stools are difficult to perch upon (we were happy there was a regular table available to switch to).

Simply put:  This is the best for miles around.  There are two, maybe three other good sushi places in S. Jersey,  but "Yoki" is the best in my estimation.  Can't speak about the hibachi side of the restaurant because I am drawn like a magnet to the sushi.  Great & Phenomenal are the adjectives that come to mind.

China Dragon is good for quick, simple Chinese. The food isn't bad and I'd recommend their hot and sour soup, sesame chicken and black bean shrimp. 

If you're in a hurry and don't want a buffet, it's the place I'd go.

They also have great smoothies and bubble tea.

Service was great. 

Food wasn't.  We both had salmon hibachi.  Soup was bland. Salad tasted like straight mayo and salmon had a sour taste. Wayyy too much lemon on that salmon.  I had seeds on my plate.

For $17.50, I'll go elsewhere. Definitely not worth what we paid and portions were small.

This is the kind of dive bar every neighborhood needs. It's just tacky and dirty enough to have some real personality. So if you're looking for a dirty martini and a medium rare filet, keep on looking. If you want to enjoy a couple of cheap PBR tall boys with a group of friends, Boyle's is the place to go.

I never new this place existed as long as it has! This is based on atmosphere and drinks as I didn't eat, but by everyone's comments I will be trying real soon.  The margarita as freshly made and very yummy.  Bartenders were very attentive, never let us sit long without a new one coming :) nice friendly staff!

You can't really go wrong with any El Limons they were my saviors during the lockdowns, best chorizo and al pastor in the area. Their sauces are a must try, red one is the best for spicy lovers. Rates are very reasonable and everything we have tried has been great, highly recommended!

Awful, The staff is not helpful no managers on during the weekends. We confirmed our room on a Friday for an overnight room and on Saturday turned out they gave our room away. Just stay clear a lot of better hotels close by. Also the lobby was not the cleanest.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Service has been very slow the last few times.  Get it together, guys
      One of the busiest Starbucks in New Orleans, getting in and out here can be a pain.  That being said, service is always very fast, my order is usually spot-on, and I have met some very friendly, helpful barristas.  Stop by if you're cruising on the Wank.

I ordered Homemade Butternut Squash Ravioli and Raspberry white chocolate bread pudding for dessert.  Both were good, but I didn't feel like I received a meal that matched the $30 price tag.  $30 for just Ravioli and dessert - no salad, no drinks, no appetizer.  Service was excellent and it's a nice place.

Speaking as someone who can eat ice cream as well as write reviews, I give Annie's 2 stars.  Yes, it is a local favorite for kids and families.  Yes, it's a good outdoor ice cream spot.  However, the ice cream itself is the same exact thing you can find at Bobby's (in Maryville) or Dairy Queen.

We stopped here for the gas bar recently as we were nearly out of gas. It was a really decent gas bar, but as I didn't go inside I have no way of reviewing the rest of this Safeway location. It's nice to find a gas bar right when we were almost out of fuel, however!

For fast food sushi, Sushi Ya is one of the better options downtown. I had a chirashi there and it filled me up well for the rest of my workday. I've definitely had better non-fast food sushi, but for the quick option in a food court or kiosk area of a mall, this really works well.

While I've yet to stay in rooms at this hotel, I really do find the function space here ample for the needs of the groups that I've been with, and I like how well lit and maintained the restrooms are along with the fact that this place is attached via skywalk to the convention centre.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: No complaints here. I've only been here to the lounge area for drinks with friends. And the variety seemed to suit our group. It was a bit loud with the hockey game on (we weren't there to watch) but otherwise it was pretty good. I enjoyed my hot chocolate with whipped cream which was a nice way to end my day.

I haven't been here super frequently, but as far as I can tell based on my recent visits, this place is a pretty standard Second Cup location. My beverages have tasted precisely as I've expected them. The last trip we took here, the scone was super dry which was disappointing, however. The staff are pretty friendly/helpful.

Stopped in at 6 pm on a Saturday to find a mostly empty restaurant. Good quiet place to grab above-board sushi. The special rolls seem a bit overpriced, but the standard rolls like spicy tuna, etc. were reasonable. Sake nirigi was great. Tempura was also good. Awesome paintings in the restroom.

I love their coffee,  but their staff leaves a lot to be desired. They are slow and one of the servers at the drive thru is constantly rude. They should also be warned that customers can actually hear them talking about other customers. Headsets don't block the other people around you from hearing what you're saying.

The menu is Pizza and that's about it. They have wings and gave us a couple to sample but they were pretty darn dry and like the Pizza coal tasting. The Pizza was okay if you like that burnt kind of taste/feel. Sodas are bottle and $2.60 each! They haven't heard of a fountain?

Mixed bag on this place. I have had delivery, take-out and eat-in. They shorted us wings on a delivery and didn't make good on a credit or additonal wings... therefore will never get a delivery from them again.

I have had good luck with eating in and take-out and the food is good.

This was one of the worst Mexican meals I have ever had. The salsa tasted HORRIBLE and the chips had a weird chemical aftertaste. The enchilada looked about as appetizing as wet dog food served up with red sauce.

Do yourself a favor- avoid this place at all costs.

Not a bad McDonalds. My food is usually simple and usually never gets messed up. But with all fast food, things are happening fast in the kitchen and things may get confused or forgotten. Check your bag and don't be a jerk about it if something isn't right. Enjoy!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I have been there twice while visiting my inlaws.They have great pizza and antipasto salad. My husband waited 3 years for Amici's and tonight's dinner was excellent as usual. His parents eat there all the time. We wish they had a place like this in California.

The care for my dog is good but the 9.50 PPE fee added to each visit is a bit insane. Curbside visits to mitigate risk, sure.  The cdc literally says that the risk of animals spreading COVID-19 to people is considered to be low. The 9.50 PPE fee is another money grabbing scheme.

Take advantage of the free vacuums! But beware, they're not the most powerful suckers around. The real suckers are those who opt for the much pricier $12 wash, instead of the $3 or $7 wash. Just because the sign says, "Best buy! Best buy!" doesn't mean it is.

This place is a throwback to a time when neighborhood's were a place where neighbors got together. The haircuts are top-notch, sure, but the real reason you'll love this place is because Joe is just a hell of a good guy who genuinely enjoys chatting everyone up.

I love La Colombe coffee, but this location's employees aren't the greatest. Maybe I was just there on an off day, but the indifference of the girls behind the counter really turned me off. 

But looking past that, the coffee is great and 100% worth the hype! Get yourself a draft latte!

I came by because the reviews looked good on Yelp. I drove several miles to try this little hole in the wall. They were closed. The sign says they are open Mon thru Fri 11:00 - 9:00. It is Tuesday at 7:00pm and they are closed. No sign on the door and no sign of life inside. They could have at least put a note up.

After reading reviews I had high expectations and our experience just didn't match up. Chips and salsa is a charge. The guacamole tasted like it was grocery store made. The margaritas were super tart and the street corn was literally just a pile of mayo on top. Very disallowing.

its a rental car place- at the philly airport. when your plane lands you need to catch one of thier big red buses outside baggage claim.  Sometimes they come in a timely manner, sometimes they dont.  (same can be said for Hertz)  I generally don't have too much else to say other than its just a-ok.

It is the golden arches... not to be confused with the golden M... Clean place. They have their slow periods but for the most part they get the food to you pretty quick. I must admit though I mainly come here to get my sweet tea fix... Liquid crack. Damn now I want a sweet tea...
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Not a bad place to get your fix for an ok roast beef sandwich. The service here is either hot or miss and they have the annoying ability of running out of key items that you want. Inside of the restaurant is kept pretty clean and the staff is quick to get you the extras that you are needing.

Small and older looking store which is pretty clean. They have a lot of deals laid out to try and help them out against their competitor which seems to have a store on every corner. Staff is helpful enough and gets you to what you are looking for and out the door. Good meat from the beef people.

Nice bar. They have good bands, an outside seating area, and the drink prices are not that outrageous. Nice place with a lot of drafts to choose from including multiple ciders. Nice eye candy without coming off as a total meat market.  Also you can sit outside and enjoy a cigar and no one messes with you.

If your looking for a simple lunch this is the spot 
They offer combos for 6.00 the staff are always nice they offer free wifi as well they resently started serving tea and lemonade together a different drink and if you purchase a 25.00 card you receive a 6 inch for free

While I loathe lines I cant get enough of their flavors!!! At the tomato fest they had a Green Tomato Yogurt that was so insanely good I went back for seconds. I am a fan of the new adventurous but even if you are more of a bland Andy this place has something for everyone

Only place I have ever seen taro frozen yogurt. Very similar to its northern neighbour froyo. I think it has a bit better toppings selection, but not as many flavors. Definitely much nicer spoons though. I'd tend to recommend going to whichever you are closest to.

Our goto pizza joint in south Reno! We have ordered pizza here (pick-up & delivery) about a dozen times and every time it has been excellent pizza & customer service. Delivery has always been on time and by a friendly employee. I highly suggest the Mt St Helens pizza....so good!

Decent selection of flavors that taste like what they purport to be--a little heavy on the fruit-based flavors, though.  Toppings were pretty standard, except for the cream-cheese frosting squeeze bottle, which I've never seen anywhere else and which made up for the fact that the blueberries were moldy.

From out of town and discovered this fabulous little restaurant.  Great ambiance, food and service.  The gluten free pizza was great, even if you don't require gluten free.  Can't recommend this place highly enough.  Only minor complaint would be that the music was a little loud.  Outdoor and indoor seating areas were very nice.

Just came here for the first time. It's a pretty nice place, typical Mexican restaurant. I went during lunch so service was no issue and food came out with 5-10 minutes. Establishment was clean, good was pretty good, definitely recommend and will go back next time I'm in the mood for some Mexican.

The owner stands behind the counter and makes the employees use skimpy amount of of toppings and i hate that that.... And he does it right in front of the customers. It is so disgusting and just makes me sick just thinkin about that lil piece of shit doin that! Fuck that guy

This place is a unique one and that's why I love it... When you walk in you notice all the decor that was manipulated make it fun and classic at the same time... Good is sooooooooooo good and the concoctions of these waffles is to die for. Staff is always great and rarely complaining. I suggest this place for everyone!

Totally awesome that u get a free bag when u spend over $10. Love it. So glad this store is downtown. I'm trying to eat better and their fresh fruit soothes my soul and makes my tummy happy. I have to force myself to leave cuz there are do many options. I have to remember I'm not grocery shopping.

Planet fitness is a great gym. This location is a little bigger than my former PF location in Donelson/Hermitage. The morning staff is friendly. The gym is not filthy but Donelson was cleaner. Machine-wise, the only diff between Donelson and Murfreesboro is that Murfreesboro has those stretch bars.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This McDonalds is hit or miss.  Sometimes it is fast and good and sometimes it is slow and cold.  Today was slow and cold.  Hash browns were barely cooked and cold.  Considering I only got a sausage mcmuffin, coffee, water and hash browns that is not good.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Good sushi, but nothing really stands out. The AYCE was reasonably priced and I liked the fact the rolls were smaller, so you could save room for other choices. I'm not a big stickler on service and rarely mention it, but our waitress would struggle serving water in a desert.

i wish i could give this place zero stars.
hey owners if youre going to offer online ordering maybe have your servers pay attention to the printer.  my father with stage 4 cancer who never eats wanted lasagna but now he will starve because of your "printer" completely unacceptable!!!

I can't believe it, but this location does not make the flagship breakfast sandwich, the Egg McMuffin! Only biscuits and mcgriddles... Must be a southern thing? Anyway, mcd's needs to start paying people better cuz these people here work like they are moving through molasses in the winter.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Location was nice in that we could walk to a lot of bars and restaurants if you're in average shape. Our floor had no ice machine and tons of grime on the floor and wall. Lobby was nice, but since it is the Sheraton you can expect that. I'd stay here again if the price was right but nothing special.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Got a new, nice and clean car! Had shuttle service from the airport to the rental place and back, free of charge and gave us free water bottles to relax. Best part was the cost- $11 a day! It was such a pleasure and convenience  to book with this company. Would do it again for sure!

Great diner style food in the mall. Very creative menu. The only downside is the service is slow. I think they need to add a few more servers to take care of the larger crowds around the holidays. The seating is a little crazy because it is open to the mall and it is self seating. They need a host during the holidays

Shawn was an exceptional server.  You start off here with chips and two flavors of salsa.  The green is nice and spicy and full of flavor.  The wet chicken burrito was really good.  The Spanish rice on the other hand was undercooked.  How do you mess up rice at a Mexican restaurant?

The portobello sandwich had the smallest portobello mushroom in the world with roasted red peppers that where right out of the jar and frozen egg plant. With asparagus that was more like compost. If I could go into the kitchen and throw the good at the chef I would. Never again!

I've been going here for quite a bit now. The owners are very friendly and they get my clothes done in a timely fashion. Whether I go for alteration or dry cleaning, I'm always satisfied. I'm hoping business will pick up for them! Support local businesses!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Just had lunch here with my family and the food was top notch. The wonton soup is AMAZING ...  The spring rolls were GREAT as always BUT the BEST was the Honey Walnut Shrimp recommended by the owner Angel.  I LOVE this place and will keep coming back for more ...

Gave this place another chance, this time with Buffalo Chicken Pizza. It's nice and spicy with just the right amount of buffalo sauce and ranch sauce. But just like the Meat Lover's pizza, there are TOO many toppings! It is incredibly heavy and did not go down well, to say the least. Last time I will order from here.

Awesome place run by genial, hard-working couple. We had a ton of food for two and it was like 14 bucks. Everything was super tasty, I enjoy the spinning grill. We agreed that the salsa selection was as good as it gets. Please come here and support your local hard-working businesses!

This place  is  reason  enough  to  visit  New  Orleans. I'm  an ice  cream  lover, and Creole  Creamery  is at the  top of my list. This  trip, I had the 6 mini-scoop sampler, and wish I had room for more. If they  had a location  closer to where we stay I would  be  there  every  day.

This is the worst TD bank location in the city. There is always a line because they only have 2 people working at any time of the day. The debt machine is always out of order, and the employees are SO SLOW. Go to the branch on 11th and chestnut for actual service if you have to.

So awesome. Did not want to leave AZ without some good Mexican food and this really hit the spot. Amazing carne asada tacos. Liked the "add your own toppings bar" love the cabbage and all the salsas were great. Also had our first Sonoran hot dog and loved it (that's saying a lot since we're from Chicago ;))

Good local neighborhood pizza place. No frills or add ons. Large and small pizza. Two large pizzas and a 2 liter came to $25. No menu to be found anywhere online - but like I said it's a very simple no frills type of place. Wish I had tried it a year ago when I moved in around the corner but always went to Roma's and Zesto's.

Great little place with excellent sushi and very helpful staff. It was so good I did not save any for later. Nice that it's open until 10:30 on a weekday. Don't miss the special where you can get 2 rolls from # 1-62 plus miso soup and salad for $15.99! I had # 43 and 38 and they were great.

Had a large party set to come in... Reserved the roof deck, it rained! They accommodated us with a nice reserved booth "cube" section. Staff was fantastic and atmosphere was great! We ordered Snacks since we were upstairs, what we ordered was all good. Korean bbq wings are outstanding! Overall great time was had by all!

Felicias is our favorite place for Pizza. I'd avoid the Margarita (No fresh Basil) , but other than that everything on the menu is fantastic. Remember to get a salad and bring a bottle of wine to the roofdeck. I can't believe I lived near Ardmore for three years before finding Felicias. 

Wonderful!

Sun Valley is hit or miss (and the address on Yelp is wrong, they moved)

Great salads and ok Pizza. We go for lunch at work quite a  bit because the Salads are pretty spiffy. Try the Grilled Chicken over Garden salad. Fresh greens and the chicken comes out hot. 

I'd recommend avoiding the pie by the slice.

i used to go here when it first opened. the owner was fantastic! the new crew...not so much. They seem indifferent. decent selection, but i recently called about sam adams boston "ale", and they never heard of it. ok, I HAVE! so they should have as well. you always get the feeling you are bothering them. probably wont go back.

The pizza was ok but after checking my receipt the next day, I noticed that the guy charged me $4.50/slice instead of $4.25 that's posted on the price board. It's not worth my time to go back and argue over 50  cents but its a grimey practice and best believe they lost my trust and business going forward.

Made a special trip to try out this newer Hub space today at 12:50pm (Saturday) and no one is here. Shop empty. Lights off. No sign up about being closed today and nothing found online about change in hours. Disappointing.  Hours posted show 9-3pm on Saturdays

The outside of this hotel is a bit dated but the rooms and lobby have been updated with the current Hyatt furnishings. The customer service was great and was given a room with a great view as well as a late checkout with no trouble at all. Everyone was friendly and accommodating.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Good food. Nice service. No WOW though ( no bad wow either). Aussie Dip sauce was good. Tuna Fillet was a tad dry. Very friendly and attentive service.  The restaurant leans more towards its bar roots with the dark colors and wood paneling.  Our dinner , with a glass of wine and a whiskey ran about $30.

Three stars for the food that was just ok.
Five stars for excellent and efficient service. Salsa was customized at the table.
One star for the value. The prices were high considering the quality of the food.

I think I need to stick with the more dive-y Mexican places, they usually have much better and authentic food.

Take a wheelbarrow full of money with you!  Dr. Ortiz will take it from you and smile. She made the wrong diagnosis and called for unnecessary tests. She has the $$$ planned before you arrive. I will not return. She chose the most expensive diagnosis then charged me for it!

It is what is. I thought it was a bit sketchy. And my drive through Tropical Storm cocktail, while a great value, tasted like a 7-11 slurpee with rum. Then again that's what it is supposed to be I guess. The girl at the window was not especially friendly or helpful. I will try a different drive thru next time.

Love this salon. I have been to a lot and this is the best. Great service and really nice. They use a Microplane grater for feet that really takes off callouses gently. My feet feel awesome. Even brought my super picky mother here and she loved it. If you want a great experience, you should come here.

WOW...two pizzas and a large salad for $50! It was all so fresh and delicious, and the service was excellent. It got super busy on a Tuesday night but that didn't hurt the experience one bit. Awesome food, old school atmosphere, attentive service and full bellies!!!! DELICIOUS!

You know when you read the  menu that the food will be great...and it doesn't disappoint.
Pork cheeks and ropa vieja to start.  Wild boar and rack of lamb for entrees and orange cheesecake and ginger funnel cake (with BACON ice cream).  Each dish was executed perfectly and the service was impeccable.  Can't wait for the next visit.

(3.75) ~ Good Neighborhood Market, that has ALL the essentials.  Located right off the Narberth Septa Train Stop with plenty of Street/Meter Parking too.

FOOD:
** Brioche Rolls = (4) very good
* Italian Sub = (3.75) Good
* Marinated Mozzarella Balls = (3.25) pretty good.

(3.5) ~ good overall food & service.  There are plenty of Tables & TV's at this location.

MENU:
** Provel Cheese Bites = (4) very good
* Toasted Ravioli(w. marinara sauce) = (3.5) good
* Egg-ceptional Pizza = (3.5) good
* Minute Maid Cherry Limeade = (3.5) good
* Cheese Pizza = (3.25) pretty good
* Deluxe Pizza = (3) ok

Place is pretty disappointing--went to get a complete detail, but I could have did a better job on my own. I had to tell the attendant to get the bugs off the front, and he left wax everywhere. Super half-ass job. Don't come here if you want perfection or if care about how your car looks.

I have been here a handful of times, usually with people form work. The service is always great, but I am never pleased with the food. My burger was dry, overdone on two occasions (I had given it a 2nd shot) and my fish from my fish & chips entree had the hardest coating ever. I will say their salads are pretty good.

Stuck between delivery truck and one car in front of us. Ridiculous wait time. Also need to put trained cashier on drive thru or give her help! It is not smart to place here at rush hour. 15 minute wait, removed half the order bc wrong, card reader not working for any cars.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I applaud the new menu and pricing. However, the food was a bit salty. The restaurant was clean and the staff were friendly. The Tuesday kids eat free special brought us in for a stop off of 465. For the price and portions not a bad rest stop choice. Dinner is large so can easily split with small ones.

Visited late in evening and found the staff friendly and great w offering tastings. I appreciated the suggestions and settled on the Bear Claw. It was delicious! But I found all the samples had a full, creamy texture and flavors tasted fresh not artificial. Price was good and seating well lighted and upbeat.

PROBLEM
Music was so loud I would characterize it as rude. The store is not clean. Not a very good Starbucks. 

SOLUTION
Hire, Train, and Mentor good people. It doesn't take the clientele to point out filth and loud music. It takes common sense and client centric leadership.

Seriously guys, what is with the over-priced oddly flavored food at this place.  We were one of three tables in the place and it was very hard to get service.  In fact, my miso soup never showed up.  There were four employees out in front and nobody could help?  Really?

I was here earlier this summer for lunch. Just a Subway knockoff when I was hoping it would be similar to Roti. 

Do NOT order the falafel! Just a dried out, over-processed attempt at it. With Planet Sub across the street and Sauce on the Side  around the corner I don't know how this place keeps getting foot traffic.

On a lunch visit the place seemed to be very empty.  I'm sure having so many more restaurants in the area have hurt business.  

Wait staff was efficient and professional.  Our food was delicious. 

If you're looking for a more intimate lunch with someone special, this might be the place for you.

Usually, I'm a fairly harsh grader, so my 3/5 rating is saying something about this restaurant.

I've been there three times and have never experienced anything horrible. My pizzas were delicious, the salad tasty, and my service was fine and friendly! 

Is it the greatest pizza in the world? No. But it's better than Osteria.

At night is the worst. I'll get se next time when I go to this McDonalds I will go inside next time because when you go late night they Jack your food up thank God I open my sandwich before I pulled off. and I didn't have sauteed onions and bacon on my sandwich.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Back because the doctor gave me the wrong prescription and we had to redo it and then they will send a return policy is 3 months but they windup putting a new prescription in for free but it don't make no sense so should have been a year from the last time it was in December but it is ok. I won't be back there.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Not bad for lunch or late night, any crowded time though OPT suffers.  Lunch is quick with seats usually open inside & out.  The food is pretty good, with the sandwiches & specials being the most consistent.  Great location for people watching & enjoying the weather.

Best haircut I've had in a long time.  I'm someone who never really goes back to the same place because I've never been in love with what they've done.  But, I will definitely be making a follow-up appointment at Snip.  Katherine was great - she listened to what I wanted, as well as gave some helpful suggestions.  Five stars!

They food here is ok. It's good for the price. My Pad Thai always smells bad and there's a lot of oil in the bottom. I like that I can watch them making it, and the staff is friendly. 

The restaurant and restrooms are always clean. The service is also fast.
