The food is consistently very good. Nothing fancy, basic red sauce Italian. Service can be spotty,  especially if there are any large groups. Prices are reasonable , plates are generous. Have been here a number of times,  never disappointed . We will return again, soon.

This is the only Starbucks (since day 1) that is consistent with incorrect orders. You must sip before leaving or have time to come back to have it corrected. Sometimes you think the coffee is wrong because it just doesn't taste right. 2 stars due to it being a drive thru and the location.

Horribly slow service every time I come here no matter what time it is! Drinks are inconsistent but still better than any other coffee around big bend, and they have a drive thru, unlike most other sb in Riverview. Been waiting over 5 min in drive thru with one car in front of me for a grande coffee.

I've been a couple of times and enjoyed the food. Both times I ordered the Enchiladas Mexicanos which are cheese enchiladas with chunks of pork in a ranchero sauce. Very good I thought. Service was attentive. The guitarist adds a nice touch and I always give him a couple of bucks when I leave.

Jason is the BEST Barber!!! I found him from your reviews. My sons hair looks amazing. I'm so relieved to have finally found a Barber so detailed. I'm a hairstylist and knew that I'd never get the haircut I wanted unless I used a real Barber. Jay is a REAL Barber!

Hit or miss.  Before Los Jalapeños was merged with tres jalapeños it was way way better.  It was our go to for take out and home delivery for 3 years.  Now I can't do it.  sometimes it is ok and sometimes I am almost angry at how bad it is.  They need to get it together over there.

The donuts were really good. The bluberry glazed was my favorite! Lots of blueberry taste and just the right amount of glaze. I also had a glazed chocolate twist donut and it was huge. It was really heavy on the glaze though, which made it kind of heavy on my stomach. My kids loved it, of course. I will definitely try it again.

No bad.  I stop in from time to time for lunch when I am at work.  They have a good lunch special, two slices and a can of soda for like $4.99, cheaper than most lunch options around here.  I've only ahd the pizza thus far so if I ever try anything else, I'll add an update.

I stopped here for breakfast. They have two tamales on their regular menu that are vegan (New Delhi curry and blue corn with squash). I tried both, topped with a variety of salsas from their well-stocked salsa bar. I enjoyed the tamales, and I would definitely come again for breakfast or a snack.

Dear chefs at Vincent's, 

You do not need to put ten cloves of garlic in every dish that emerges from your kitchen. A little garlic goes a long way. A lot goes too far! All of the elements of good Italian food are here. Just back off the garlic some, please!

It's a Subway, so why am I giving four stars? Well, they managed to get through a line four deep, where multiple people ordered multiple sandwiches, in a timely fashion while remaining friendly and helpful. Plus, the place was busy but still clean. This place seems to run well and I very much respect that. Good job, guys!

Delicious pizza!  Experience spoiled only by sub-par service.  I sat without a drink for 10 minutes as the waiter took my glass and did not return with a refill.  I had to remind him twice before finally getting another drink.  The pizza was wonderful though!

Please dont waste your time.  Meat sauce that you need a magnifying glass to see.   Margherita pizza without basil   The slowest service ive had all year.  Innacurate orders.  if you want a bad night out this is the place!!

Oh and they are cheap w the sauce so bring your own

I have been here several times with friends, but we go more for the drinks than the food. We like to get the beer tower and share with 5-6 people. The food is not bad, but I would say pretty average. It is a nice place to go to relax with friends and have a few drinks. I find it to be quieter than other bars in West Chester.

Edomasa never disappoints! Open late for those late night Edomasa cravings! Love the Baltimore roll (absolutely my favorite) but when I'm craving something on the lighter side, the spicy tuna roll is fantastic. Best Spicy Tuna roll I've had in town. California roll, no roe add asparagus, yum! Edomasa gets my vote!

I haven't been to this place in many,many years and remember it being just so-so when I was there... Wouldn't mind trying it again sometime because something has apparently been keeping them in business all these years!  The parking lot is usually packed when I drive by at night...

We don't get to the King of Prussia mall very often, but when we do, we always stop and got smoothies/chillers at Fruit Sensations.  My oldest daughter's favorite is the Belly Buster - she gets it every time.  Pretty high prices though (almost six bucks for a small) so it's probably a good thing we don't come often :)

Where do I start well the meatballs since reopening its a regular stop for me multiple times a month when I get back to town. Last week 6 balls to go to take to my daughter and shame on me I ate them all at 1am just go they are the best and ive been a lot of placed being a retired flight crew 1 more thing get the butter cake

When I was there the bartender starting complaining very loudly about the last customer not paying. When I first heard this I could not believe that a customer would do this but by the end of my meal I realized why the guy left without paying. Yes it was that bad.

Great self car wash. It's clean, it has everything you would need such as a high pressured hose, a foaming scrub brush and vacuums on site. Maybe it's been awhile since I've been to a car wash but I thought it was rather unique they had a blow dryer option as well. This is great for those car obsessed individuals.

I love National but this location is a mess. Not enough vans so the wait at baggage claim is way too long. All other agencies have at least two vans circling every few minutes. Once on the bus it's obvious the drivers are miserable. Time to try Hertz or Budget I guess.

The loaded pizza is great. I get it half and half of pineapple and ham. Delivery to my house is around $24 ( I live like 2miles away). The crust is very nice and flaky. The sauce is not over done and just enough tang. I also really like the calamari. I get deliveries from this location at least once a month. Try them out.

I agree with Ben K's review for the most part. The service is indeed very slow, and they barely speak English. Fish was fine when I went, but true it was not fresh. And, the gyoza was prepackaged, as is in most restaurants unfortunately. To me, it's just another bargain sushi joint.

I came here because I had Groupons... The service was mediocre, we had to ask for a drink menu multiple times and remind our server of things that we had ordered and not received yet.  The sushi rolls were falling apart, and it was definitely NOT my favorite, glad I tried it but will not be going back.

Called ahead and made an appointment for a state inspection.  I was told to come at 12:30pm.  I was there until 4:30pm.  I was not happy having to wait SUCH a long time, especially after calling ahead to make an appointment.  I highly recommend you avoid this place.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I was very pleased with my experience here!  Good, fast service--you can linger after your meal because you've paid up front. 

And, most importantly the food is fresh and tasty!  I loved my chicken taco salad and the plantains we got.  The drinks, especially the mojito, were good too. 

Will definitely be back to try more things.

Good place, but not my cup of tea for pizza. I like the thin crust, well-done version, with a fresh chunky sauce -& fresh ingredients
Toppings we're fresh, cheese - marinara was skimpy.
Crust was too thick & sauce was generic.
What's a girl to do? I have & continue to look for a great pizza in my area.

I used to go here all the time but recently they changed something. Maybe owners? The line took forever then they must have sprayed something on my car before in went in the tunnel that left awful marks. It was water marks or stains that took a re wash and wax to get out. Never again.  They definitely lost a long time customer.

I've been there twice, once for color and cut and other for cut and wash.  Both times I had Vicki.  She's good and quick. I like the products they use such as Bumble and Bumble and Moroccan Oil.  Price is very reasonable probably more so I've seen a newbie to the salon. I recommend it or at least try it once!

First time going here I went for a trim ended up with a haircut.  Not bad but could be better staffed.  Hair products are meh, not my type of product line.  Location is nice if you traveling downtown.  My stylist was cool but it dragged after like as if she lost interest in the blow dry portion which made me not want to come back.

Ordered the eggplant parmasean entree, which comes with two garlic knots and a side salad. One of the garlic knots was literally rock hard (not even a knife could cut through it). Also, the parmasean cheese on top of the eggplant felt overwhelmingly salty. Overall, satisfactory but probably won't be returning without incentive

I'm not sure if new people were hired but this place has gotten a little better. 

Got the haircut I asked for, quick and easy.
A few mistakes here and there but they don't question and they're glad to fix it!

If you want a inexpensive and quick haircut, go here.
But don't expect it to be perfect!

The sushi is great but, if you don't sit at the bar you have to order ala carte which can get very expensive. AYCE is the better value but, I ordered ala carte and felt extremely over charged for what I got. Now I know to go when I'm hungry enough to make AYCE worth it.

i absolutely love this place! not is the place very nicely decorated, but it has decent sushi with interesting "special rolls." I also went with a bunch of vegetarian friends, and they were able to find many delicious options.I like their combo of ingredients for sushi (very creative), and the price. service was also great.

I am usually a sucker for country places,I cant say i had no fun at all but i can say that i found the staff incredibly obnoxious and....whats the right word im looking for...arrogant, my suggestion is if its country youre looking for go to cook a way better crowd and super friendly staff

I like this location because of the setup - it's spacious and have sufficient workspace for folks who like to surf the Net, telework, or work in another place other than at home. This location is diagonal from the Westshore Mall. 

The parking lot is a little tight given the number of store fronts that are in that little plaza.

I'm gonna keep this review short & sweet.  Jen B is the BOMB!!!  She is a miracle worker and I would enthusiastically recommend her to anyone!  Amazing cuts and color everytime.  She also did my makeup for my wedding & once again she killed it!  Thanks Jen B!

Worse buffet I have ever been to.  Food is garbage, staff is rude, selection is pitiful and the place is filthy.  The place is always empty, I do not know how they stay in business.  There is a much nicer buffet a few miles down on Lindbergh, skip this place and drive down there you will be very glad you did.

They don't honor appointments.  Called day before, set an appointment.  Called morning of to confirm.  Showed up on time, 45 minute wait.  W.T.F.  Hello?  If you don't honor the appointment times you set, why would anyone go there?  Been a regular customer but I wouldn't go back if they paid me, I need someone reliable.

I think they went out of business.  I'm here now and they have a sign in the window saying OPEN but no one is here and they are closed.  Calls go unanswered.  That's a shame, I guess they closed because of the ferguson riots.  It's 5pm on a Monday so you would think they would be open right now their yelp page says they should be.

This is the second time we have tried this pizza place. The pizza was good and the price was right. We ordered the 18" pepperoni pizza. We like the New York style and they make it pretty well.  We have tried a lot of different places and this one ranks in the top of our list.

Food was amazing but had to wait 20min for it. Was asked if we wanted the complimentary miso soup & green beans 5 min before our plate came. We said no but they came out with the green beans anyway!  That was nice. This is a nice Eastside sushi location everyone must try it.

If you want sushi at lunch time, you are far better off getting the six dollar buffet and having a couple rolls with it than you are eating the all you can eat sushi for twenty dollars. It's very unreasonable and you do get penalized for not finishing all of the sushi they give you.

Great locals bar, 
Friendly cool people, great wine selection and plenty of tequila and  mescal options
Burgers are great, all the food is but this ain't a taco stand, go meaty! Or take a wine flight with local knowledge - PS... wintertime rates rival $225 a night, take a lyft home after mescaline tasting!

Went for a Friday night dinner to see if the ambiguous comments (mine and yours) were justified.

They were.

Comatose hostess; fabulous waiter.

Drafty table (it was a a very windy day); immediate response to a request for more heat.

Very good food; a bit expensive.

Charming host; charming host.

We'll be back.

The slices are normal size slices which gives a less guilty feeling after devouring my lunch special which seems to include a large drink.  The pizza is NOT I repeat NOT super greasy which is awesome! I will come again as long as I am in the area, but I will see what all this area has to offer before I settle here.

Had the lunch special, Pepperoni sandwich/drink/chips, $7.60 plus tip-you are served here.
Nice clean place, good location, staff was nice. I didn't leave hungry.
Sandwich was just pepperoni and cheese and pizza sauce--no veggies in the sandwich.  Just Ok.  

Hopefully the other sandwiches are more interesting/flavorful.

It took us 15 minutes to just get water and the menu seemed so limited and overpriced. I wasn't really impressed with the service and the food was "meh" at best. In my opinion, there are some amazing restaurants in town that are worth the price. This is not one of them.

I had one of the most phenomenal veggoe burgers of my life here.  Everything was cooked to perfection and absolutely delicious.  We got the loaded fries as a starter and they were wonderful too.  All of the service staff was attentive and friendly.  We will definitely be back again soon!

Meh! I have eaten here twice and that was two times too many.  Both times my sushi was mushy and falling apart. I had an avocado salad and the avocado was browning so bad and the ginger dressing was way too watered down. The prices here are way too high for the quality of the food.  I was not impressed.

The quality and creativity of the food served at Fond is excellent. The service is attentive, but not bothersome. The restaurant recently revamped its menu. Their are no printed menus. Today's selections are posted on the wall. List 1 are  small plates/apps. List 2 would be considered entree sizes.

Agree with other reviewers that this property is not super convenient to the airport. About a 10 minute ride away. Also very noisy in the morning due to traffic outside. In an industrial area so no restaurants around. Countertop in bathroom stained and carpet has burn spots in it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Friendly, professional staff. (rare in Tampa) Free darts! Nice big airy space but still cozy. divey; not dicey.  Jukebox is touch tunes so you can control it from your mobile device. Nicely located toward the end of 7th past all the places that attract the less desirable elements of the area.

Super "chill" ice cream spot in the historic Ybor district- this place is busy! I can see why, amazing flavors. 3 hardworking ladies working the counter- and beautiful!

I got the praline, girls got vanilla and their babysitter got Tampa banana- that has walnuts. 3 ice cream bowls- one scoop each- came to about $20

We went to Cancun for dinner with friends a couple of weekends ago. We ordered margaritas, and the waiter carded three of the four of us making a point that he did not need to see our fourth amigos card - rude. The food was mediocre. Save some time and money and check out El Rodeo or La Hacienda instead.

i came here expecting some mecca of latin ingredients. it was fine but i actually found none of the specialty ingredients i was looking for. it's pretty much a regular grocery store with a few extra goya items. certainly nothing to go out of my way for. the workers were friendly and helpful.

I'm more of a Maggianos or Amerigo kind of guy, but I went to MG for the first time a few months ago and was pleasantly surprised. The ambiance was good and the food was good.

It's not better than the other two places, but it was worth the nice dinner that I shared there with my wife.

Holy moly their delivery is slow as molasses!!!! I ordered at 12:35pm and it's 2:02pm and i still don't have my food. I called at 1:35pm and they said i'd have it in 10 minutes...?! AND, the delivery is always this slow. It never fails. Not sure why i thought it'd be different this time. GGAAAHHH.

Food is always very tasty and at a very reasonable price. The service on the other hand has something to be desired.  I have been there many times and the first two were my absolute best with both the food and the service. Since this time my service experiences have been less than stellar, but the food has remained good.

Not really sure what they're going for here.   Odd floorplan,  dining area is devoid of character and bar area was dead during our visit.  

Food was good.  Calimari had some kick.  Pizza was crisp.  Honest effort put into the beer list.  Everythings priced a buck or two more than it should be.

Ok.

Always very very busy.  I dont particularly care for the tacos, I think that's just me. I do love the pineapple and cilantro and the 1/2 chicken.  They are very friendly and have made the menu friendly for all types of dietary need. With indoor and outdoor seating it's an awesome spot to have a meal.

This is a good Starbucks, super clean and very bright. People are almost always friendly. The drive-through line tends to move along slowly, same as the internet. If there are more than 3 people inside using the internet, don't expect to get online. Otherwise, grab a comfy chair and read a book or meet a friend.

When I want some good comforting Italian food, I go to Cafe Fellini. Food is good, their pastas are nicely and consistently al dente like they are supposed to be, they sauce and marinara are good. A good, and solidly consistent neighborhood Italian restaurant. Watch out the portions are very generous. And byob, of course...

This location was nice and clean the team at the desk was friendly greeting you throughout the entire stay.  The room was nice but it had a problem over night with the heating unit as it would get loud at different times.  The team up front listened and noted they would have maintenance check it out.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I stumbled in here during the Mardi Gras blurriness and barely remember leaving (although I have pictures to prove I was actually there).  Those hand grenades fuck you up but beware the inevitable intense sugar hangover in the morning.  Have ibuprofen on hand!

I have been to this restaurant many times in the past and will continue to go in the future.  The sushi is always very good and they prepare it quickly.  The prices are not too terribly expensive either compared to a lot of other sushi places in town.  The service has always been great too.

I have been to this Cinco de Mayo location many times.  The food is always good and you get it quickly and while its hot.  My main complaint is the service is not as fast as the Cinco de Mayo in West Nashville which is my favorite.  Sometimes the service here has been just plain lackluster.  Other than that, I enjoy eating here.

So, I have a rewards card for this place that I've been using for years, but the benefits elude me. They didn't have what we were looking for, but they were friendly about it. It's hard to go to this place when there are so many kick ass options so nearby!

Aside from a couple who regularly fight in a foreign language here, this place is just like all it's other clones. In fact the food here is so similar to China Wok around the corner, that I can't even tell their egg drop soup apart, it's the same place as far as I'm concerned. Good in a pinch, and absolutely mediocre.

Great ice cream.  They have the staple flavors but always have some interesting concoctions of their own.  Samples are always available.  I don't think they took credit cards, which was a little annoying, but I'm finding that more and more common.

Love the store and how it's decorated.  

Staff was very friendly.

Clean. Good massages. Decent color selection. Very nice staff. They also have great loyalty card. This is definitely my go to place. 
There's also a parking lot!
Updated review to 5 stars as I am now a loyal client who has always been so so happy with my experiences here. Love Elisa & her work!

Favorite sushi spot. Parking sucks so we normally just order on a to go app. Favorites include gator roll, Hurricane roll, volcano roll, and geisha roll. I've had their udon or noodles before and it was just mediocre-i personally would stick to their rolls :)

This was a rather large hotel. We stayed one nigh and we were put in a room that was pretty filthy.  But they moved us right away and the new room was much better. 

The service was good. In the morning we only got a bag breakfast and it was pretty limited.   I'm not sure I'd stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We arrived late and the city is requiring masks but no one was wearing any.  No customers nor employees.  It's got to make you wonder if they won't enforce something like this, what else they don't do.

We were given a room and we got up the the 5th floor only to find it was SOMEONE elses room.  

Not going back again
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I went to Brakemasters and they wanted to fix a problem with my cooling system for 550 dollars. I took it to Jack Furriers and they diagnosed the problem and fixed it for only 125. Big difference! Remember, they don't just do tires! Very happy with service!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Great thin crust style pizza. Growing up in Chicago, many people don't realize that there is a thin crust pizza style as well. Charlie and Millies reminds me of the best ones I had there! Friendly neighborhood pizza place with a killer lunch special: $4.50 9inch pizza with toppings costing $.75. I go out of my way to stop here!

Based on reviews, we made a special trip to buy two packages of their medium tortillas. ($3.50 per bag). I've never really liked tortillas before, but I'm eating these as snacks, they are so good. And they're "just" tortillas!

Will have to go back and try their menu items.

I visit Arnold Animal Hospital at the least 3-4 times a year ( My wife is a hypochondriac with our dog) The staff and especially Dr Mayab always make the visit bearable for myself and my prima donna dog. Dr. Mayab is very knowledgeable with my dog's semi rare breed which is why I am willing to travel out of my way to go to AAH.

This place is AMAZING!!!!!.  Since I have been here I have been looking for NYC sushi.  FOUND IT!!!  When I am back in the area will definitely stop in.  The sushi is serious fresh and not loaded down with rice and sweet sauce as in other sushi places in Florida.  Please put this spot on your list if in the area.

Seems like the last two times we ordered pizza, it was disappointing. One time was not enough cheese. The next time ordered with pepperoni. 
Was not placed all around the pizza, and we couldn't find any sauce. Not sure if they are just rushed or don't care. We. May be ordering from some
other places from now on for pizza.

We have been eating at Ichiban Sushi on the east side of Tucson for years. The owner,Sookie, offers THE BEST Japanese and Korean dishes in town.  The staff is friendly and attentive.  There is a regular crowd most nights, but always can get a table or seat at the Sushi bar.  Sookie will make sure you have a memorable experience.

Hands down, the Habit burgers are as good as it gets for the price you get it for. In-n-who?? I don't even crave In-n-Out as I do for a thick and juicy, bbq charburger (w/avocados).  I'm not even hungry right now, but I could eat one right now... with onion rings too.

Slow...very slow. I went in and the place was empty, there were to "cooks". I watched in amazement at how slow they moved. It took them 15 minutes just to start my order...then another 20 minutes to make the sandwiches. 
It's a good thing they took my money up front or I would have been long gone.

It is a decent rolls place, but the servers and sushi chefs have a bit of an over inflated ego. if you have been to their other locations you know they are generally pretty good and fun. this place is ok, as long as you don't know a lot about sushi.

(we have eaten in more than 250+ sushi restaurants including 25+ in Japan & Asia)

Had the all-you-can-eat sushi with a few of my co-workers for 2-14-14 dinner. Food and price were great! food service was a bit slow but the server was really nice. One of the best all-you-can-eat sushi in Reno, NV. They had a good sushi menu and the ones we ordered were pretty good.

The location gets this hotel an extra star.  The attached restaurant/bar can be VERY noisy at night, so if you are a light sleeper, ask for a parking lot view so you are on the other side of the noise.  But then you miss the great bay view.  Hmmm...you can't really win at this hotel I guess.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Very calm and quiet. No awful smells of perfume or chemicals. The salon workers were pleasant and the pedicure was above average. The salon was clean and there was an attention to detail that I appreciate. I will definitely return with my friends. Fabulous!

When there's no line at the drive through, this place is great. Employees are friendly at the window. But when they have a line you can be there for 15+ minutes and they even forgot us one time when they told us to pull over because our order was taking extra time. I avoid this one when there's a line.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Awesome local place.  Honest work.  Main line Toyota gave me a quote of around $2000 for maintenance repairs and an inspection.  Took my car here all I needed was a serpentine belt and they fixed my light sensor on my door jam for free only costing me $100 ish total.

Omg, the worst Japanese restaurant I had in my life. One star for the grilled squid appetizer only. The rolls are okay but still bad. They show the walking dead on TV when we are having lunch, so gross! I don't know why people have such high reviews for this place and I will never return.

Anna was very helpful. This is a great option for a quick wash. We have the membership and thoroughly appreciate it with the ever changing seasons of dust, rain, and snow out here. Sometimes there can be a rather large line but you learn the busy times, great price for what
You get!

Car is clean, but the wash pulled the hitch cover off and they just handed it to me. What happened? Where are the clips? No answer because they don't speak English and don't even bother to look. What the heck? Won't ever come again even though the car looks nice. A shame.

Only paid $10 for a perfect manicure that lasted nearly 2 weeks!  

Sunny is clearly a perfectionist and took her time doing a simple manicure.  The salon is very clean and brightly decorated.  They also have a huge selection of OPIs and Essies to choose from. 

The next time I'm in the burbs I'll stop by for sure.

Waaaay to expensive.  They do a good job but not at all worth the price they charge.  $10 for a light jacket.  That added with a few shirts and a jersey and my bill was $40.  That's crazy!  I'm used to a flat rate of 2.50 per item.  I will not be back here.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I have been here twice now.  The service is friendly and fast.  The portions sizes are large.  The food has great flavor, the enchiladas mexicanes is flavorful variety of four enchiladas. It comes with a chicken, beef, cheese and bean enchilada.  Check it out.

Great food. Incredibly over priced. Definitely great toppings, decent service and delivery times, but the prices seemed ridiculously high for pizza and wings. One medium pizza and 12 wings plus tip for nearly $50? Yikes. I guess it makes a good but rare special treat.

Seems like worst car wash I ever got. Water spots all over, nowhere to pull over and dry car. Back and front of smaller SUV didn't really get cleaned. They only wash outside. There is vacuum area but you must do before getting in line and I had to fight my way in out of 3 lines told to alternate.

The service is good. The atmosphere has totally changed and the food is lacking something.

I was a regular at the previous establishment (Reynolds Roadhouse has since moved to St Charles off Elm)... 

I may give them a try again, and I'll adjust my review accordingly.

This place is by far the best sushi place in SB! The press boxes are all amazing. The Montecito and the mozzarella red wine eel melt boxes are great! The sauces are all original, colorful and makes the quality sushi just that much better. Highly recommended

They went above and beyond to donate food to our school. They aren't even in our zone! They care about building a community within the complex and supporting the community. If I were new to Reno, that is something I would look for when I was searching for a place.

The food is mediocre, but it was cheap. The people working there don't seem to care or just don't have a personality. Not the type of people that should be dealing with people. The crew can't really be blamed for that, but the management can be. It just doesn't seem like a well run restaurant.

The hotel was nice and the employees were very helpful. Rooms are clean and the beds are comfortable. My only problem was the traffic noise from the expressway. It was too noisy and kept me up a good portion of the night. I will not stay again unless I bring a noise machine of some sort. We were in room 304.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I got the banana bread with dairy free coconut base. The base had a strong coconut flavor with a bit of tang. I'm not sure where the tang is coming from if it's dairy free, but it makes it resemble a frozen yogurt. It came with pecans, bananas, wafer, and honey. It's a good combination that resembles the comfort food.

Quite a disappointing meal tonight. The service was poor and I almost never have an issue with service. It took 10-15 mins to see the server for the first time and I had no water for far too long. My entrée (tile fish) was not seasoned at all - completely bland - and the sauce that came with it was simply strange. Won't be back.

Not much to say. It was fast, fresh, and wow this is a delicious Mama Burger!
Usually when you go into a fast food place you are getting something that's been sitting in the grill or the warmer for a while. 
Not the case here. This burger tasted fresh! And so did the ingredients! Nice.

Well, it's a McDonald's so what can you say? This one is pretty decent. The staff are friendly and the service is pretty quick. Especially for fast food. 

It's a good place to come by to grab a coffee or something before watching a hockey game at Terwillegar or something. It's in a convenient location too :)
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: My husband and I both had the Vichyssoise which we thought was bland and disappointing. I had the cavetelli pasta with the 62 degree egg on top and that was very good. I would order that again. For my second course I had the salmon which was melt in your mouth delicious. I look forward to returning to try a tasting menu.

Authentic!
Clean, modern, spacious tables.
The attentive server who helped us navigate the assortment of options.
We opt for more authentic than Americanized Mexican food.
Shared a few soft flour tacos- steak and pork plus a large special cold salad with grilled shrimps and mango.  A good meal.

Nice to find a pizza restaurant doing pizza differently.  Very nice to have so many interesting choices to select from as opposed to just a whole individual pie.  I live variety so this is best fo me while my wife can select just one flavor combo for her individual pie.  Great helpful staff.  We'll be back again.

BYOB too.

An excellent experience from start to finish. Attentiveness of staff, selection of glasses and price were excellent.  Dr. Sabin has a great, warm personality and was happy to answer any question thoroughly and even help pick out the frames.
Highly recommend.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The food is delicious but the serving is too small for what you pay. The prices went up in the past couple of months so for those who have gone before expect to pay a little more. The staff are friendly, but are not responsive to extra request even though you will pay for them. I was a fan, but after the last visit, not so much.

This place is worth the trip, its byob which allows you to allocate more cash towards sushi. The food itself it not cheap but, certainly not too expensive when you consider its sushi. 

The wife and I love going here when we are in the need for raw fish and/or some sort of roll.

These auto car washes are all rip offs. Bought the "Deluxe" wash, bird shit, still all over the hood. Why not call it the half was washed comedy hour, since that is what these machine jokes washes are.  

A homless huybwpuld jave done it for less and done it better.. Never again.

Great location, nice rooms, still need some work on the housekeeping department.

Day 2:  Housekeeper never replaced my towels and toiletries, and when I called to have them deliver towels, shampoo and soap, they never arrived.

BONUS:  free WIFI in room and pool table in lobby!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Very authentic.  I had combination #13 very flavorful you must ask for the homemade hot sauce. It's like my great Aunt from Mexico use to make.  The music is a nice touch.  We visited on a Saturday around 3 and service was great.  I will definitely be back an we are glad your here.

I love this place. I'm no sushi connoisseur so I have no idea if this is "good" sushi, but to me it's delicious. The prices are reasonable, and I love the special rolls. Their spicy crawfish roll could be a little better, but that's my only complaint. Also-- the service is great. What more do you need?

Not gourmet, please don't be misled.
I would avoid going here unless it was absolutely necessary. The pizza is always so dry, no flavor and almost cardboard-tasting.

I get that it's a late night place that you only go to at the end of a long night but its never worth the long line outside of it. Like ever.

Best new restaurant downtown, in the Mercantile Exchange.  Good local beers on tap.  Pizza is really good.  My fiancee and I try to have their "pizza of the month" specials, which have been surprisingly good.

This place will only get better once other businesses open in the MX, like the movie theatre.

There was one special sushi roll (they cover with aluminum foil and set on fire at the table) that tasted good.  The rest was not that great, and the sashimi wasn't good.  Our waitress was nice, though.

We like Wasabi better, and it's only a few blocks away, if you're looking for sushi in the downtown area.

This is one of my favorite sushi restaurants in the country. The Choo Choo Roll is absolutely amazing. The sushi is always fresh and the chefs seem to have a good time making fun of the rockers from exit/in and scores of vandy kids. Samurai is a standout in nashville food.

They have a great price specials for Cheese steaks on Wednesday. You can get a cheese steak, fries, and a drink for about $8. 

The portion was super generous. The fries aren't my cup of tea and the cheese steak was satisfying, but short of great. It will fill you up and for $8, that's not a bad overall deal.

Tried it for lunch. No one else there on a Friday. Kind of strange but Maybe an Ardmore thing?  Seated right away . Menus took awhile to get there. Order took even longer but  the food was good. Especially the Lentil .soup. The place was very pretty inside and it had two bars. I'm going back

Parking is pretty bad here so unfortunately lose a star. And if you are on Germantown PK its really only accessible if you are heading EAST. And the place could use a good dusting and window cleaning.
Staff is professional and very nice. The coffee was hot and good and the cinnamon roll was light, airy and tasty.

Hands down one of the best places/BYOB ever!! Not only is the service amazing but the food is to die for! The cook is fantastic and super sweet! I had my rehearsal dinner there and they went out of there way to make it beyond special! I can't give enough stars to this place!

What a delight to have a restaurant of this quality so close to home. The food is exquisite, plated artistically, and served excellently. We dined there at lunchtime and for dinner and found the quality of cuisine, creative and tasty, and the service consistently good.

What a disappointment ! We used to dine here periodically, but tonight's dinner was dreadful. The Bloody Mary tasted like watered down tomato juice. The New England steamed clams were overcooked. The shrimp in the ciopinno were dried out. The prime rib was undercooked, fatty and full of synue.

I really hope this Irvington restaurant makes it. It's so good. A nice refreshing take on Mexican food - not the stereotypical American version you can get everywhere else! Quite a few vegetarian and vegan options. Wait staff was friendly and it appears live music is a possibility. I'll definitely be back.

Pleasantly surprised at the quality of this restaurant. Don't let its spot in a Publix plaza and the nondescript signage fool you--this place does Italian food right! Perfectly flavorful pizza, with a light, airy crust. And reasonably priced! Have also been told they have great calzones.

I can't say enough good things about the JW Marriott in downtown Indy. I suggest booking an executive suite because you get access to the VIP lounge that has snacks and drinks all day plus free wifi. The restaurants are great and it's an all around classy crowd in this place!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I came here to get gel manicure and it was not the greatest. It started chipping in the matter of one day, and also didn't look like gel. It was really chunky and just didn't look smooth. Luckily, I came back and they fixed it within the same day, but it was not a good price either.

Good, but not great Japanese.  Ideal location right off Rittenhouse.  

A creative menu but the dishes don't quite live up to the quality one would expect from the intricate descriptions and the price points.  Also the sake drink sizes are way too small for my liking.

I did enjoy most of the food and will likely return.

Yes, the service is amazing and the place looks cool. But I went there with this great expectation for some amazing pizza and found there deep dish to be very mediocre, it was not bad but certainly nothing to come back for. Maybe im just being a pessimist but its not all that.

Service here has really gone to hell. I hit this place around 4:15 am at least twice a week and order the same thing each time but since  the beginning of February it has been nothing but excuses of why nothing is ready. They are too busy hanging out in the parking lot talking to their friends then to do their jobs.

I've been there several times for both lunch and diner.  The food is fantastic, the service is friendly.  Even when it's packed the servicve is good.  If you're the leftover type, you'll probably take some home.  I will continue to go back.
note: this is at 9173 Newport Gap Pike, just at the DE/PA state line

This is the only ice cream place in downtown Phoenixville.  It looks like it should be perfect - everything is classic and I have to say the ice cream is not bad.  They don't take cards but they let people without cash who live in Phoenixville buy on credit (who does that?)

I always try to make it Jack Willie's when I'm in Tampa.  We go for lunch....Sit at the Tiki hut bar, doesn't get much better than this.  
Their fried grouper sandwich is a must!!!
Lori the bartender knows everyone who walks in.  Great service...thanks Lori!!
We'll be back again

Good frozen yogurt, but nothing special and definitely more expensive than other places I've been. Additionally, most (if not all) of their flavors are whole milk-based, which I wish they had more low-fat options. However, the worker was very nice, but I wish the tables were more attentively cleaned.

My go to salon on this side of town. I've never had any problems here. Everyone is nice and the quality is good. Great selection of colors. It's also very clean and comfortable. Prices are about the same as anywhere else. It's great for kids too -- several little girl pedicure chairs.

Origami has such good miso soup! If you are a fan of ginger dressing on your salad then this restaurant also has really yummy ginger dressing. I got the salmon nigiri here as well which was fantastic. My friend had gotten a New Orleans inspired roll with crawfish and he loved it as well.

Best nachos in Delaware.  If you've got the munchies, their nachos more than hit the spot, with crab, fresh jalapenos.  I'm salivating just thinking about their nachos.  And at times they've got great live music.  Fun, laid back place to drink, munch, and chill out.

The staff was really friendly and helpful without being pushy or overbearing.  You get a TON of food with the prix fixe menu.  They are very accommodating to vegetarians and I felt like I got a lot of food and didn't feel like I was missing out.  The best part of the meal were the desserts and the homemade limoncello.

The best place in the area to take your family for ice cream.  They have a ton of exotic flavors that you can mix and match.  My personal favorite is peanut butter curl and banana pudding in a waffle cone.  If you've never had Hershey's I've cream then your in for a real treat.

ten years ago my brother asked my why there were no subway sandwich shops in philadelphia. my answer was that since there are so many amazing authentic places to get a hoagie in philly, if a subway opened up, they would surely go out of business.

well i guess i was FUCKIN wrong.

Winner!! It's a bit hard to find and parking is limited. None of that matters. I haven't found anything that's as comparable in quality and price anywhere else in the area. Excellent selection, and very fresh. We are excited to make this our regular Wednesday night spot when they have their buy 2 get one special.

I went here with a friend who had a Groupon.  The sushi was horrible, full of filler breadcrums and very skimpy on fish.  They took a lot of time and care to decorate the plate with fresh orchids and I wish that they would have invested this extra money into giving us more fish in our rolls.

The food was okay, I have had better. The only vegetarian option was eggplant or alfredo. I will not be going back only because almost everything has meat. When I asked if they could leave the meat out of the vodka sauce I was told no. Well that was enough for me never to go back.

I drove by this place for years before I went to eat there (pre covid). I felt like we were the youngest folks there (which isn't a bad thing!).  It is super family friendly and feels cozy in there. The food was reasonably priced for what it was. 
It could be a bit updated on the inside. I'd go again!

The hotel is beautiful and the staff was extremely helpful and kind.  The room was clean and the service was friendly.  Comfortable beds, quiet, great towels, and nice bathrooms and showers.  Also...great price and great location with nearby restaurants and cab service.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: love this place! it's a great place for singles, couples, and groups. big tv all around the bar and a projector near the tables for games, draft menu is a little small, but they carry a lot of bottles. menu is reasonably priced. it's classy for the ladies and sporty for the men! :)

This store boasts selling single bottles but I didn't see single bottles for sale. Hmmm okay. No one asked me if I needed help so I just kinda wandered around aimlessly after not finding what I wanted. I wanted to try a couple beers out without committing to an entire case or 6 pack ..ah well

No frills liquor store. Wine prices are much cheaper than other stores. You can always find bottles for $3.99! Massive variety of nips(little liquor bottles) for a dollar or 2. Beer and liquor prices are much higher than other stores ive been to and about a $3-4 difference. 6 packs and cases available.

People SWEAR BY this pizza! I truly don't know how they do when the cheese is constantly falling off of the entire crust! Cheesesteaks are dry, unseasoned meat that tastes like it's been heating for hours. Ordered cheese fries, got no cheese. Our buffalo wings were overcooked and totally dried out. Yeah. Nope.

One word: BACON. Excellent service, food and drinks. Their brunch is to die for, especially the sweet breakfast item that changes each month and is usually some of cake / croissant inspired dish. It's getting popular, so a reservation is key on the weekends.

Three small raviolis cost you over $20. The portions here on most meals are very very small. You will leave hungry if you do not order an appetizer, salad and dessert. This place will quickly become a $75 meal per person.

The food is decent but the value for your money is very poor.

Both times I ordered delivery it took around 1.5 hours to get the order. Both times the French fries were barely cooked even when I asked for them extra crispy the second time. They did give me a discount off the fries the second time which was nice, but I'm not sure I'll give them a third shot.

Home of the hand grenade in two sizes.  There are so many of these along bourbon but this one was our favorite because the layout made it easier to move about inside.

Service was quick and friendly and we loved the air on a hot muggy day!!  

The crowd here is lively and fun and the music was awesome.

Made a reservation for a car, showed up and guess what?  No cars.  So much for the reservation, I ended up having to wait another 20 min or so to get my car.  The customer service guy inside the airport at the desk was not the greatest.  When I went outside and finally got the car the staff outside was much better though.

Not much to not like about this place. Friendly staff, reasonable prices, and amazing frozen yogurt with a nice selection of yogurt and toppings available. The inside is very modern and pleasant, but on a nice day you can walk on the main street and enjoy the night. Highly recommend this place.

Imagine having your mouth water for One of Dunkin' Donuts' deliciously warm Vanilla Chai Tea but instead you get a  feeling of disappointment that comes over you after your first sip of what taste like a watered down, imitation tasting vanilla chai with sour milk!

Really the forefront of convenience for Grad Hospital. They have a deli area and a full selection of beer. Pretty similar to Sprouts in terms of what they stock. Automated checking area. As with any store it can get pretty busy on Sunday and lines will be long.

Overall, very fast and seamless experience. I called earlier in the day and Don said that they were busy but would squeeze me in. Literally took 30 minutes to help with some strange sounds that were coming from a wheel and when braking. So far so good, fast and easy service.

Wow, delicious. The quality of the fish is superb. We got to try a couple classic rolls, sashimi, and udon. All of it was yummy and the fish tasted fresh and not frozen. Not that many special or heated rolls, but that's OK. Tight menu, clean restaurant, and the service is so nice and friendly.

Washing machines and dryers typically need service. If your card is overcharged or the machine does not work, the company will offer a refund or a credit on a laundry card when you contact them, but it has yet to be seen. I reached out to a customer service rep in January and have been back and forth with them on a refund.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Oh my I truly cannot go to this location ever again! I order a simple Iced coffee sweetened with cream and it sucks here every single time! How can you mess up an ice coffee! The coffee always tastes burnt. I have wasted a lot of money at this location not once has my iced coffee been good. So sad:(

Okay super cool kids Mikey that works here really made us feel special at the drive thru! Totally had interest in how our evening was and truly took care of our order! Hev exemplifies customer service!  love the roast beef sandwich with the Hawaiian roll--- mmmmm! And they are open late and accept digital coupons!

Well this is the only Starbucks so far where I receive my Ice Coffee with cream unstirred or shaken....boo! I truly pay a lot for an ice coffee that i have to stir - might as well make at home:( The baristas not too friendly and not too helpful either. Still a Starbucks and the coffee is delish. Just not my favorite location.

Had the taps steak skewers...amazing! I could bathe in the sauce! And $3 tall Stella or any kind of beer cant be beat! Stellaaaaaaaaaaa! Sat at the bar, bartender was a tool, and the guy across the bar actually made me uncomfortable, awkwardly sucking on some girls neck and face!

What a "stuffy" place. The staff wasn't overly welcoming most times. The rooms weren't very updated. The closet and bathroom were big (outdated) while the bedroom was small. They have way too many rules regarding what you can and cannot do in regards to your apparel. Would never stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The atmosphere is great, the service is nice, its very clean and relaxing. However, i have had better food at other Italian restaurants that have more of a custom feel rather than a chain. I feel like they can make it more unique with their menu and their presentation. It felt like olive garden when it came to the food.

This is a really chill bar right off of Passyunk. 

The crowd is similar to just about everywhere that is considered a dive bar (hipsters and drinkers).

The bartenders here always take good care of you. 

Downfall is their disgusting bathroom. Maybe time to invest in an upgrade.

This place is perfect for the small crowds that use the weights. I believe in a year or so they may have to expand, but for now it is good. I haven't taken any of their classes yet, but they seem fun and  intense. Could use another water fountain on the free weight side. All in all nice gym.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Not a horrible place - great location, friendly staff and nice pool.  However, the housekeeping staff was a cluster)*&$ and the food they served for breakfast and dinner was absolutely disgusting! Had they not charged only one $100 fee for our two dogs to stay with us, we would have checked-out LONG before our four month stay!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
It's just that... it's meh and I've had better.

The ambiance is a bit underwhelming and the food was just OK. 

They do have decent service and food came out relatively fast as a positive footnote.  

Don't see my self returning as this neighborhood has tons of great Mexican places to stop by.

I bring my two girls here for vet care. They are the best. I have seen Dr. Lent and Dr. Quick. They are two vets that really care about the animal and not just the money. They take the time to listen to you. The staff was very nice too. I would highly recommend them to anyone.

They mischarged me for wifi when this is always waived due to my corporate rate. The phone line was busy and I had to call 3 times, then I was routed to the accounting person, and they were not there. I had to leave a message, and I don't know when I will hear back.

This is pretty annoying!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place is great!  Only bad thing is that it's closed on Sundays.  I ate here yesterday and got chicken lo mein and sesame chicken mmmm was it good!  The portions are huge and the food is ready very fast!  I think this is the best Chinese in STL and for sure the best in CWE

I like it! I was apprehensive about trying a true St. Louis style pizza, but I really enjoyed it. Just got a small deluxe. Nice and crispy crust, and the Provel cheese was really good.

The staff at this location may have been a little rough, but they were at least courteous.

Highly recommended!

Two weekends in a row with poor car selection for emerald executive elite and the shuttle to and from the airport has been ridiculous for Friday night pickups and Sunday afternoon drop offs. The wait has surpassed 15 minutes for a shuttle. And both weekends there were 5:1 enterprise to Alamo/National shuttles.

Stopped and had lunch here and what a cool place. The atmosphere is great as well as the food. We had a burger and fried chicken sandwich which were both great but the star of the show was the artichoke bread. Best thing I've ever had and could have ate 30 of them. Also the strawberry beer is a winner

I spoke with with someone here about my account they did not have any business cards to give to me so i could emal them a copy of my insurance for a auto loan that i was approved for  the have a very long wait if you need to speak with some one about your account

So the place is nice but the staff is rude the place is crowed for a Sunday afternoon.  the senior citizens stand right in the middle of the aisle  So you can't get pass .the staff does the same thing the stand in the middle  well stocking the selfs the place is huge but to over crowded

i drive on the freeway every day  and i have a lot of bugs around the front of the car  so i came here to have the outside wash. i paid two dollars more  a little more then the places that cost  three dollars and they did a ok job i just hate paying ten dollars for a car wash and they don't get the bugs of the front of my car

This review is purely for their Restaurant Week prix fixe which was excellent!
Portions weren't teeny tiny like some other notorious Restaurant Week spots I've been to.  On the contrary, they were nicely sized and delicious!  
The coconut tres leches cake at the end was to die for!

Went to my cousins for a backyard party.  Second time she ordered from this place.  The chicken parm was absolutely delicious.  Everyone was saying how good it was.  Pasta dishes were on the money.  The owner delivered and set up the dishes.  Very good service and excellent food.  Recommended for party catering.

Damn good food! They frequently have deals on different sandwiches, like 2 for $5.I usually go for the good old roast beef and cheddar classic, but other sandwiches like their Rueben are good as well. I love my Arby's! It's a tasty occasional fast food treat.

It's great that there's so many toppings, but I'm here to tell you, YA DON´T NEED 'EM. This froyo is delicious all by itself. Now that the weather's warming up, grab some friends and sit out back on the patio. Or pack a pint or two to take home, it freezes really well.

The smoked salmon appetizer was amazing! The salads are very good. The 3 stars is due to poor service, and the appetizer sampler was not very good. I will give it another shot. Happy hour all appetizers half off! The drinks are only a dollar off, but the appetizers are a very good deal.

Went through the drive thru. The one time I really considered eating McDonalds, would be awful. My sons food was cold. I ordered the wrap. The veggies were soggy, not to mention it was dripping sauce all over me and of course they gave me no napkins. The only "good" thing about that place is the staff was friendly.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Fantastic salon, for only $20 you can get gel nails! One of the best prices ever! They also have little sweets and water available. It feels like a higher end salon for wonderful prices. Everyone who works there is also so sweet and really seem to care about their work, which is wonderful to see. Will defintely return!

Good service but the sushi rolls are not worth the money. They have too much rice. I ordered one with cucumber, smoked salmon and avocado and the cucumber tasted funky (I don't think it was ready to be cut!) and the smoked salmon was over cooked and hard. The bagel roll was mainly rice.

Being from California, I'm spoiled. Below average and all the fish was mushy. Like it was frozen and the temperature wasn't low enough, or just low quality fish. It all tasted the same, which is to say no flavor, but I guess you don't come to the desert for sushi...

Hole in the wall Italian joint. Authentic Wood burning pizza oven. Tried the chicken pesto Bianca pizza, it was surprisingly good. Finished it off with a slice of the limoncello cake, which was great. They had other homemade desserts that also looked amazing.

7:50P on a Thursday night and the place was closed. No sign. Waited behind a car in drive thru for several minutes. They left. I pulled to window and it was a ghost town. .Disappointed. Dissatisfied because  No hours posted. Not your typical Starbucks experience.

Somewhat costly for ice cream.  Decent selection of flavors and average tasting ice cream, parking can be tough and I'd like to see more cleanliness.  Not saying it is unsanitary, but lighting and paint would do a lot to give interior a better perception of attention to detail and housekeeping.

I recently moved and had to switch gym locations. This gym is clean, but really small with a ton of equipment crammed in one little space. Not a lot of room to workout which is pretty frustrating and going to take some getting use to, but overall not horrible. Needless to say I miss my other location and the people. :(
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Love Amy, she's the sweetest and is very good at her craft.  I stopped going because of their hours.  My hours that I work just doesn't go well with this salon but I would recommend them any day!  The estheticians at this salon are endearing, they remember everyone's names and what's going on in their lives.  Love Classic Nails.

DO NOT STAY HERE - if you want your belongings to be safe.

Lump sum of money stolen by patron or hotel associate and manager with nasty attitude refused to fully investigate.

Police were called and a police report filed.

The rooms were tiny. Beds hard and uncomfortable. The shower flood the floors - no bathtub.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: i really like this place, i order from them often and never had a problem even when they are busy, they make good steaks and hoagies, love their wings, and you can't beat their prices, oh and the pizza isn't bad either, been there in person only once but looks nice inside, has a sports bar feel to it

very good selection, by far the bigest liqour store i've been in,not hard to find what you need if you know what your looking for, i wanted to give this place a better review but the service was bad, most people that work there are smug and  snobby, just another place in the city that caters to the hipster/yuppie croud

Cute sushi restaurant within walking distance of my parents house.  We walked in and it was a little quiet but filled up more as we sat there longer. My parents had the Fuji and Volcano rolls. I went ordinary with a California roll and a veggie roll. Everything was delicious. Also, service by Mina was excellent, very meticulous.

I take back all the kind things I said!! Messed up my order, had the nerve to have an attitude, didn't apologize and definitely didn't offer a free fry!!! When the ex you give a second chance starts showing their true colors again! Throw the whole McDonalds away!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I am not really a Starbucks fan due to the prices of coffee. But I have to stay awake when I am at the hospital waiting for my father. My sister never goes to Starbucks and doesn't do sugar. The girl up front was not helpful and very short. The girl making the coffee was way friendly and made up for the rude girl.

Went last night with family and had the salmon special. Grilled salmon with a lemon butter sauce and capers, very very good. One of the owners stopped by our table and asked about our dinner and the waiter was very attentive. I love this place, cozy atmosphere and lots of friendly patrons for a Monday night.

The perfect corner dive. They were recently on Philly's top 10 dive bars, which is upsetting because I love this being our little neighborhood gem. The bartenders are always nice, and attentive. The atmosphere is tiny and dark, and they have .90 PBR always flowing! what more could you as for?!

Marias did an okay job with my hair. They make you feel very uncomfortable like theyre talking about you--thank god i speak spanish lol.  They use use homemade shampoo. And they don't listen to what you want. it was 40 instead of 30 because I have long hair. Whatev man.

I love all the Little Tokyo's, but this new one has two large karaoke rooms (like the big one at the S. Carollton location) that are perfect for birthday parties, private get togethers etc.. Our group of 20+ people kept the servers busy and the drinks and food were great and delivered to the right people when needed!

Went here because it was close to the hotel. It looked nice from the outside and was nice inside as well, however, the service was horrible, the menu was very confusing. The rolls were just OK. The sushi chef looked angry and acted as if I was bothering him.  Again did I say the service was horrible?

Cant speak as a hotel guest, only as a conference attendee. Their conference rooms, and accomodations for such are world class. Spacious rooms, catering- well above average, general aesthetics of the facility. Highly recommend. Handled our large convention with ease.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: It's not the best, but its also not the worst either.  They deliver cheaply and quickly, and they are also in a convenient area if you need to drop by and pick something up.  I've never gotten any good customer service vibes from their people, but I've gotten a decent pizza on the fly, which makes up for it I guess.

Among Tampa area Starbucks, this has shown to be one of the least accessible.  The entrance and exit are difficult to access.  There are about 5 parking spots available.  (The other 5 belong to the Game Stop next door.)  When the drive thru is full, you might as well not try parking for either one of those businesses.

The food is great, BUT THERE IS NO ENGLISH MENU and they ONLY TAKE CASH! Being a Mandarin-speaker just isn't enough, because you have to read the menu. Don't try asking the lady for the most popular dishes, cuz she'll cut you with her eyes. This hole-in-the-wall would receive a lower rating if not for the tasty food.

WOW! I called these people to get my cat groomed. She picked up, I asked if they groom cats, she said for clients. Maybe I may have switched vets, who knows. I said she is matted. "Oh we aren't going to do that, you are better off going to an actual groomer." Before I was able to say anything, she hung up the phone on me. RUDE!

Different day, different perspective.
Everyone greeted me, was friendly and made eye contact.
I appreciate friendliness.

Some days everyone is smiling and happy you've arrived, and some days they can't wait for the day to end.. I was lucky in that today was a wonderful day for everyone!!

nicely remodeled location.  unfortunately we were served lukewarm burgers earlier today. everything tasted like it's been sitting,  waiting for a customer for a few hours. 

the result is not particularly pretty.  

if you don't mind spending half of the evening on the toilet this might be a great option for you.

First time eating here with friends.  The stuffed French toast was absolutely delicious (my friend shared).  I got the Greek omelet and it was cooked to perfection.  The service was fast and friendly and you can't beat the price.  Good amount of parking.  Cute atmosphere.

holiday inn express good hotel in the middle of all the malls shops restaurants bars its a very very good location the staff was friendly and helpful from the front desk to the cleaning crew every 1 was nice the out door patio with sofa is really nice too wow holiday inn express good place to stay yelp on yelpers !!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Not sure the significance behind the name and logo of the restaurant.  Unless it was three guys putting their money together to form this business 
The food was great/ staff friendly/ huge menu from breakfast /lunch/dinner to dessert.   Open 24 hours will definitely be back next time in town

This is a pretty good sushi place in Skippack.  I tend to think many restaurants in Skippack are a bit overpriced.  For lunch this is a great place to go. Service was pretty good and the food presentation was good as well.  The sushi was decent. 

I may return if I'm in the Skippack area again.

I had the mini all meat pizza. Maybe because of the smaller size the sauce and cheese failed to bring out the "all fresh" taste experience. I definitely judge a pizza by the sauce. A slice from a larger pizza with vegetables may have resulted in a tastier experience that was not under-whelming. Service and atmosphere were good.

Is okay. The "fancy" bar in the neighborhood.  It's little pricey especially for what I've gotten. I've both gone there for cocktails and dinner.  I appreciate that they're going for being a classy place, especially in Manayunk,  but I'd expect more from it with that in mind.

Went back to check out Lolita's after I heard about the switch of the menu.   I enjoyed my main dish and dessert.  They were both pretty solid.  But the margarita and the guac didn't really stand out for me. The place is nice, definitely better for small groups, it's a little tight and can get very loud if its full.

This little bar is tucked in the back of the hotel, you walk through the restaurant and it's to the left. The drinks are delicious and the bartenders are knowledgeable and will tweak your drink according to what you like. Reasonably $$- but a little pricey according to Nola standards but so worth it! They also have happy hour

Love to gamble to drink at this bar. Marvelous call liqs to dance with my fresh squeezed orange or grapefruit juice. Pretty big glasses served in a sleekly dark schemed bar. Never been dissapointed, well maybe the gambling some of the time, but the drinks, never.

It's a Subway. That really says it all. It's so close to LSUHSC that I really appreciate it's existence. It's clean, there are sandwiches, the employees make your sandwich how you want it. Is there anything else necessary for a chain sandwich shop? 

It's small, but most people I know don't actually eat there.

Always delicious!

This is probably the best ice cream in Nola. I love that it is in an old mcKenzie's, I just wish that they had more room to accommodate the tons of people that want ice cream.

I usually get a banana split, but last night I got the bananas foster in a waffle cone. Even their waffle cone is exceptional!

Nice location. Right downtown. You can walk to broadway for good music and good food. The staff is so nice. Every time you walk in and out, they say hello and welcome you back. The rooms are average the beds are nice. They also have conf rooms if you need to book a meeting.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Old school everything! 

Cash only

Best meatball and gravy!

Super neighborhood vibe with locals stopping by for a quick drink

Did I mention the meatballs? 

Please do not update 

Please stay cash only

Please get the meatballs to complement any other great entree you order.

One of my favorite sushi places. The all-you-can-eat here is amazing. The Monster Roll is one of the best special rolls in sushi history. The last time I went I ate 72 pieces of sushi. We were the only ones in there and they played a musack version of "Unbreak My Heart" on repeat. Highly recommended.

Well its a subway so you know the deal. English wasnt to strong here which was a bit of a problem ordering. Sandwich making is not there strong suit here which seems odd at a subway and in pretty sure they dont like customers too much either. I probably should have made them remake but it is just a sandwich right?

Drove 24 miles round trip on a cheat night to get a single scoop in a waffle cone, currently my favorite treat.  Nope, they are out of waffle cones.  Seriously get it together people.  I should have followed the advise of all the other bad yelp reviews and not wasted my time :(.  Or I could have gone to the gym!!!

I have been driving by watching this place get ready to open.
Tonight I had a craving for Frozen FroYo and decided to stop by.  

It was OK.  
Toppings were not what I'm used to from other local FROYO places.  

There was an option to get regular yogurt too.  
The place was nice and clean.

Good ice cream, great prices, but very slow service and all of the food items absorbed the taste of the cleaning supplies they used. My napkins smelled like Fabuloso, and my cone and sprinkles had the distinct taste of it.  Cover your food before you clean!

Good basic McDonalds. No playscape but food quality and service are good. They employ persons with disabilities, so kudos to them for combating stigma and facilitating mental illness Recovery.  Can't extoll virtues as McDonalds franchises are ubiquitous and standardized.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Can't beat these guys and gals for high quality & efficient car wash.  Though lines form every time the sun comes out, they move cars through very quickly. Clean cars with no fuss are mass produced here.  Took my grandkids who loved the stuffed Sesame Street populace as well as Curious George.

Visited on a warm summer afternoon during Taco Takeover for a cold margarita. I had the Altos Blanco Margarita - refreshing and sweet just enough... The space is a beautiful open air patio with lots of fans all around. Good for cool vibes & refreshing drinks.

Visited Revolutionary Ice Cream on a hot Saturday afternoon with a large group. The shop was packed. I had the Drunken Brownies - chardonnay caramel ice cream with brownie bits. The brownie bits tasted more like chocolate chips & the ice cream was 3 star worthy.

Visited here on a late Friday night for some late night pizza. The pizza is simple delicious, I had a cheese slice and dressed it with parmesan cheese and  red pepper...simply delish! The crust is garlic flavored and flavorful. I highly recommend visiting here for late night snacking as they are open late.

Kin wha how may help youuuuuu. Still go here and still love it 

My faves are:
Crab rangoon
Wonton soup
Fried chicken wings
Pork fried rice
General tso chicken combination 
Subgum lo mein
***Eggplant & shrimp in garlic sauce w. Brown rice***
Beef ho fun

All of those are always delicious. Much wow.

Great pizza! Jules offers different approaches to pizza. i had a kale, mozzarella, and mandarin orange pizza! Delish! I like . how Jules offers seasonal pizzas. Their menu changes often. They are a bit pricey though. $20+ for one pizza!! I wish they were more affordable.

You would think this place had Frozen Custard given the name right?  Wrong.  It's ice cream.  It's good...akin to DQ, but not sure if it is amazing...but like sex, even bad ice cream is good.  I think the prices were slightly high like the other poster said too.

This place was good. It was clean, fresh, and trendy sushi in the heart of Washington square. The price did add up quickly though - but it is very filling. Splitting 3 rolls is perfect for two people. The rolls were creative, well-decorated, and very appealing. It's a great date place for sure!

This place is what you expect it to be. It's a quick chinese joint that you can get food at when you are in a rush and need to scarf down something. Not many people are seen eating here. It's definitely more of a take-out place. I wouldn't go here expecting fine dining, but rather a quick option for pretty standard chinese food.

We've visited many of their restaurants over the past few years. The one on Oracle that replaced Macayos is the most recent. It's right down the street from my house so it's my favorite. The food is always good. Drinks are tasty and the service is good. Table side salsa is a great touch. We keep coming back so we must like it!!

The place is nice inside and the server was pleasant however, the hot pastrami sandwich with melted cheese on a warm pretzel bun turned out to be cold pastrami and cheese on a cold pretzel roll. My friend ordered crab cakes and said they had a chemical taste. Sad that I wasted money on a meal here tbh.

I go to this Breaux mart almost exclusively for groceries. They have a wide range of hours, from 7am to 8 or 9pm and super friendly staff with short lines. The produce is priced similarly to Rouses and is always fresh. They have a small selection, but usually have cajun favorites. Huge beer selection. Quality quick grocery store.

Decided to try this place out with my cousin. I would highly recommend taking more people with you! This way you can try out more sushi options. I'm a sucker for sushi and a great deal. Unlimited!! The decor is not beautiful but I'm only there for the food and I don't need to be impressed with the seating.

Started off with the flatbread, which was amazing - highly recommend it. We therefore thought this was a good sign of what was to come in our entree. Wrong. Pasta was very disappointing. Bland, boring, and pretty pricey. 

All in all, service was great but food was mediocre at most. Probably wouldn't go back.

I have had China Garden for delivery twice but have never been to location. Solid Chinese and very quick service. They throw in all the sauce you need but I think you need to ask specifically for chopsticks. 

Love the sesame chicken and low mein. The way to order in!

My husband and I have needed to get our yearly vision checked and this spot was conveniently located. Now, we don't have any vision needs (glasses or contacts) but the doctors were very friendly, quick, and professional. Not to mention the desk manager who set our appointments is just delightful. And they take Superior vision :)
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Great tap house near the Trop with 40 rotating taps, and over 250 bottles, something for everyone. Very friendly owners and a very accommodating staff. Very good ambiance with a new outdoor seating area that makes it very dog friendly. Trivia on Tuesday nights is a winner, and constant special events.

We had a good stay. They have a very nice lobby. Hotel staff was nice.

The room was ok, nothing out of ordinary but very clean. 

My only disappointment was that one of the bars closed too early on a Saturday night, I think it was midnight and they stopped serving. Odd, we were in New Orleans, right?
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ate next door at Silly Goose and wanted to see why so many people were going here. Ice cream! 47-degrees outside but still room for Salty Caramel & Milkiest Chocolate in the World. Great. But if you want to try some different ice creams they have bankok peanut, goat chees & res cherries, etc all those people in line can't be wrong.

I have been here many times and it is usually hit or miss mostly miss.  Always feel rushed. Last time could barely feel the leg"massage"my nail gel was dull and barely lasted 10 days.  Even though it is convenient to my work I won't be back as I have found a better place.

Would remind you of a beach dive but right in Palm Harbor.  It is named appropriately as you feel as though you are hanging out in your friend's backyard.  Laid back atmosphere and friendly staff and regulars. Food is a notch above your typical pub grub and they are very accommodating to requests.  Great place to "hang out"!!

My favorite place to get Mexican Food. The food is five stars but the place is kind of in disrepair i.e.: torn up booth cushions, small amount of tables, out of the way bathrooms. That being said, its never stopped me from going and getting my usual "burritos supremos."

The hotel is super cute. I stayed here about a year ago while I was in Indy for a week. Parking is expensive, especially when you include tips. However they do have a shuttle service that took me to my office everyday. You can hear trains going through. It was clean and a decent price.(not including parking)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I loved Ginza more before I went to Japan and realized how fresh fish could be. There aren't any better deals in Nashville on sushi- the boat for 2 is tons of food - soup, salad, 3 rolls, 16 pieces nigiri and only around 30 bucks! The lunch specials are a great deal too.

I live close to Rizzio's and I've been here for some minor issues: taillight out, flat tire. These guys are terrific. Very straightforward, show you exactly what they're doing, and I don't think I've ever paid more than 10 bucks for something. 

For a minor tweak, if you're in the area, this is a great place.

The front office staff is so sweet, gorgeous scenic, green, and quiet area. This place is also the best value I found in the ridiculous Nashville market. I just moved in, but things are looking good. It's also very nice to not have a million flights of stairs like my old place!

Since we all know what to expect from a normal Dunkin' Donuts and Baskin Robbins I'll keep it simple.  Service is average, a couple of times I've gone after 5 pm and the donuts were stale or they've been out of ingredients.
