I'll visit every now and then when I have a sweet tooth or snack, but nothing out of the ordinary.

This restaurant is not trendy, but the food is great. If your looking for no frills, but great Mexican food, this is your place. The service great, the drink selection is normal, and the menu is quite large. I stress this is not a fancy place, but simply put, the food is awesome.

Very inviting place!   
Fun to visit because of the variety of flavors... 12 different yogurts.
An entire wall of candy toppings.... almost every thing you can think of.
Fruit bar was available with both fresh and frozen options. 
They had Mochi pieces as well as bubbles!!!

Ask for sample cups at the register when you walk in.

The trip down to Sansom is so worth it! The sushi and sashimi is top notch, and their three-roll special is quite affordable. The only downside to Vic Sushi is the space; the dining experience was very cramped, and the line quickly worked its way out the door.

The espresso here is ok. Nothing too special like La Colombe, but I appreciate that the location is so convenient. I'm not a pastry person, but I also have to add that their pastry case looked exquisite, despite being very limited (I remember only seeing croissants and a few donuts).

went to leave a review and saw I'd already started one a few months ago with 3 stars; averages out the two experiences

food was great even with us dropping the ball and  getting there 30 minutes after estimated time of completion. thanks for making the fries fresh! I was worried they'd be soggy but couldn't blame the restaurant.

I don't generally enjoy Chinese food, at least the type generally sold in North America, because I find it so greasy and it makes me sick. Although lingnan's food is still typical deep fried and greasy, I actually find a lot of it quite tasty, to the point I actually ordered Chinese food a second time in a couple months!

This place is always packed in the morning.  Literally the drive thru line is out to 60 and inside they are lined up to the entry door.  There is no coffee, bagel etc that is worth waiting in a line like that for.  They need to do a better job in staffing during their peak hours.

Came in for a mani, pedi & brows.  When I left I thought my nails looked nice.  But within 9 days the gel polish started to lift and peel.  Normally gel lasts at a minimum 2 weeks so I was a little irritated that it lifted so quickly.  

Had my brows done and they were terrible, uneven.

I would not go back.

We tried this place as something new. The food was interesting and it was good. I thought we waited a long time considering there was no one in there. Other than that, interesting take on quesadillas and wraps and mine was delicious!  I would definitely go back!

Great ambiance.  Good service for sure.  A group of 5 of us went for business lunch.  We had a pizza for an app and it was fantastic.  I had a caesar salad and the Salmon.  It was great.  The portions were good size and the lunch menu is very affordable.  Great place!

DON'T PARK IN THE PUBLIX LOT!  YOU WILL GET TOWED! 

I have absolutely nothing bad to say about this restaurant. The service was terrific and the manager is the best I've ran into in a long time 

Please don't be foolish and order the "bada bing" then please order the veal saltimbocca. Both are amazing.

The Quick: Oh wow the grenade! It will get you drunk and it taste delicious. The small size has the same amount of alcohol and liquid but does not come in a cool cup- you save a few dollars so up to you. I highly recommend making this part of your Bourbon Street experience.

Nice surprise to find Santa Fe Mexican Grill. I enjoyed my meal. Crispy chips and good salsa. Had a combo plate with a chalupa, taco and cheese enchilada. All yummy.  Plus the service was great. The price right. Negro Modelo  drafts for $3. Attractive interior. Clean and comfortable. Give it a try.

Some dishes are better than others. Some are just frozen fried chicken chunks with bottled sauce and others are completely homemade and really good. Oddly the Moo Shu lunch special is tiny considering it is just cabbage but it is one of the from scratch dishes and is wokked correctly and is great.

All the subs I've gotten from all Subways taste the same to me (as they should?), but I'm avoiding this one for life. They're so stingy with the ingredients! Lettuce and such should be packed on the sub, not sprinkled. The bread-to-innards ratio was a big no no for me :(

Newly renovated with nice outdoor seating. Great location and usually go here late at night for a quick bite when everything else is closed. The staff are efficient and always take my order correctly. This location is in the same plaza as wawa and rite aid.

It was stocked up, it was clean and the staff were efficient. While my goal is support local, sometimes Starbucks is what you need mid-road trip or when you have to push out a work email and need some quick wifi with a side of one of their cute snack platters. Solid choice!

Not a bad location. Better than the stinky one on Oddie. I mainly just use the after hours drop box for deposits. The times that I've been in to get change, the tellers have been nice. Parking is a bit of a hassle if you're driving anything bigger than a Geo Metro.

Bored out of my mind. Arrived early at the DMV. Tired of playing clash of clans and already wrote a couple of reviews on Yelp. What am I supposed to do? Get a 20 oz. mocha frappe from Joe's? Why not?  The ladies inside were super friendly and the frappe was tasty. See you next time!

We enjoyed this little place.  I got the fried green tomatoes breakfast platter.  The ham was delicious and the rest of the food was pretty good as well.  The friend green tomatoes were meh. My partner got the andouille sausage eggs benedict and he loved it.

It was okay.

Coming in late night for a quick bite, this place was merely adequate. The pizza was okay - not nearly enough sauce, crust tasted like it was frozen and thawed, the cheese was pretty good. If you're a little tipsy and need that late night snack, this place will suffice. IF you're sober, you can steer clear.

Everything is good here. I think the prices for the larger pizzas are bit too high for me but my favorite thing is the calzone!! So yummy! Everything has big portions so you're getting your money's worth. Has tv's to watch too. The breadsticks with the cheese on top is also a hit. The sauce

I stayed here last year and can't wait to go back. It was beautiful and yes, has great decor and artwork.  There is a gallery in the hotel as well. Everything was in walking distance and the price is reasonable.  Rooms are spacious and clean and they have a great gym.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Smallish inside and no wifi available. 

The drive thru is PAINSTAKINGLY slow. I've been through it a handful of times, and am writing this review as I sit in the line. It's been ten minutes and I've moved forward three car lengths. This seems unacceptable, especially at 4:30pm on a Wednesday.

Upscale, very nice place to stay, a lil expensive, but you get what you pay for. Valet parking is nice to use. Downtown and near everything, just a short walk away. Comfy beds, lots of pillows, good friendly service. All around nice place to stay when away from home.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Docked our boat and went inside for some cold alcohol. This is an old shack looking type place with great prices and friendly service. Next door is the Thai and American Food hut, as the beer shack only serves drinks, ha. Good place to hang out, and you can look over the water and sit inside or outside on the shared picnic tables.

horrible sushi....I have no idea how to describe it. Even cooked chicken/beef used the lowest quality meat you can ever find. not impressed. tempura shrimp is super duper small, and it's not even tempura fried! udons are too soft to chew. sushi rice is horrible. okay price.

Great location adjacent to the lake. When I went there, there was an event on the terrace, but the service didn't seem to suffer from it. Ordered a specialty burger with avocado. It was good enough but tasted a little dry. I think Its be willing to give it another try because of the great vistas at the location.

I really enjoyed this restaurant.  Came here with my fiance for a Valentines Day dinner and everything was amazing.  The appetizers were delicious and the entrees were even better.  Service was so accommodating and it really made the day and dinner special.

First off, free wi-fi is always nice!!

So other than that, the servers have always been really nice to me and iced tea is a great snack on a hot day - just don't get the tea that says it tastes like gunpowder, it really does taste like it!
For a snack, I'd say definitely get the pepper jack cheese croissant, toasted :)

Is it my imagination, or are the salads at Subway getting smaller while the price stays the same or goes up? I enjoyed my lunch salad here, and the folks behind the counter were very friendly & courteous, but hey guys, don't think that customers don't notice when the amount of food you get for your dollar shrinks.

Worst chicken soup I've ever had. Mushy egg noodles and sparse chicken in tinned chicken broth. Ugh. Yuck. However, the chicken was good. Wish it was fresher and a little less expensive for what you get, but I liked it. 

Don't get the soup. It is horrible. There's is much potential there for a delicious soup. Oh well.

This place is no hidden gem, its been here since the 60s.....you guys missed out when it was a REAL hidden gem.  Since the recent renovations it's very clean and beautiful, but the clientele here is just so lifeless and boring compared to the old crowd. RIP Le Roundup, welcome B Macs:/

I'm giving this place 2 stars because it was good and can be great if they make a few improvements. First off, get new staff.  The cashier literally said she was "just at work for a paycheck," so you can imagine how "friendly" the service was. Second, you cannot serve guacamole out of a squeeze bottle, that makes it so unappealing.

Ordered shrimp tempura burrito with spicy mayo. I was given shrimp and chicken instead of all shrimp. Although I thought it was very good, I'm not sure how I feel about this. Considering the cost, I did pay more to have shrimp. So therefore, I don't feel good about it. I give more than three stars, but less than four.

It's St Louis, not Chicago-so skip the deep dish.  The crust was more cornmeal than dough.  I wish we had tried a thin crust.  They have a great selection of local beer.  Some made just for their store.  Even though our pie was "eh", our service was great.

A little expensive, but they're fine. I've had strombolis and pizzas from here, always fine but not really memorable. Perhaps my mistake is not ordering their signature dishes and keeping it simple. They are a step up from their competitors across the street, who I won't mention by name here.

This place is absurdly overpriced, and the only positive thing about this location is the fact that there's a drive through. Four dollars for one scoop (one!! and a small one at that) in a cup? No thanks. The ice cream and frozen yogurt here aren't even that good. There's far superior ice cream shops literally all over the place.

Good little place to seek in for the lunch buffet. The service is great with the mother daughter wait staff. They always remember you and greeted with a smile. The prices are pretty low because of the buffet. If you like salad bars this place has one of the best in the area. I would return...

Although they say they deliver to the foothills and I definitely live  in Catalina Foothills#7, they would not deliver to my house. Seriously, I am 5 minutes away from this place. So I guess I'll never know how good or bad the pizza is because if I have to go out, it sure want be for their pizza. Thank goodness for Magpies

It's good and cheap....   this is the shrimp in garlic sauce and fried rice.  Their shrimp is always fresh tasting and perfect thickness of sauce.  You can switch out the egg roll for a diet soda to stay on track calories wise.  As you probably are aware....  ready in 10 minhut!  :)

This is my go to pizza spot, ALWAYS! Each slice is only $1.50. I mean, you really can't go wrong! My only complaint is the store itself. I feel like they could do much better with making it look more presentable. Other than that, I love this place and the customer service is good.

Food was not the best and service was very very slow. I ordered a bunch of sashimi and we also ordered a boat of sushi and sashimi. Much of my sashimi was partially frozen and sushi on the boat was not that great. Just a below average sushi place, not the best.

If I was drunk at 3am driving by with money in my pocket and nobody at the drive through, I would eat here again.  Seriously, the chicken in my taco was so dry it had the consistency of cardboard and the 'hot sauce' was basically water with cayenne, turmeric and garlic salt.  And why, oh why are the taco shells deep fried?

Good place for the money. Clean and comfortable rooms. 
Quick access to the freeway and not far from the convention center and Lucas Oil Stadium. Breakfast area very small so we ended up across the parking lot at the resturant there. 
A little confusing to navigate the hallways.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I want to love this store, really I do. The location is great and it has a convenient gas station but no. Just no.

Produce is always questionable at best & the layout is just AWFUL but the employees are great - that's the only reason I come back.

Seriously Kroger, please fix the staggered & scattered layout. PLEASE?!

I went there for a business meeting. The meal I ordered wasn't too complex but I am so impressed with what they did with it. Everything was delicious! The manager was also very welcoming and accommodating. The restaurant service was excellent all around. I will certainly return.

It's Mc Donalds in a Walmart. Not particularly clean or fast. Friendly though so I gave them an extra star.

Half the dining area was closed off when I stopped in so the only seats that were available were stools. I hate stools.

At least their chicken nuggets were fully cooked. Skimpy on the Sweet N' Sour sauce though.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Flat tasteless pizza if u don't expect much this place it may fit your bill?  
For some reason no matter how many ingredients u add the flavors don't pop?  My guess at 7.45 a pizza they had to cut down on quality and it shows.  Sorry to say much rather go to Grimalldi's, Pizzeria Bianco  or Piology

I sat at the bar by myself with only three other people seated at the entire bar. After 15 minutes I still had not received my drink order or had been checked on by any of the other staff. I let the manager know that I was waiting for 15 minutes without a drink and subsequently decided to go to another bar.

Get the Soft Shell Crab!

The special roll menu is abundant, it's a little dark inside though but I like the atmosphere. 

They take reservations, the place usually seems to be busy.

Probably my favorite sushi place in SB (and I have the sushi sensei badge, so I'm pretty trust worthy yeah?)

If you are on the West End and are craving sushi, this is the place to go. They have quick service, smiling staff and the food is great. The portions of sashimi are generous, the gyoza are the best I've ever had. Their rolls are mouthwatering. We had several including the Red Dragon Roll. They were all very good.

It was average sushi. I liked that the sushi wasn't just a bunch of rolled up rice. I don't know if it was just the day, but the salmon didn't taste right. But the rolls in general weren't that great. 

The service was attentive though, which I appreciated.

Great tasting and fresh fish. The Sushi & Sashimi for 1 is the perfect size for 1.  Skip the Sake Sampler (unless you really prefer cold sake) and pick ur favorite hot sake. As always, make sure to pick up a fresh- or salt-water Eel nigiri for the perfect after dinner treat.

Still loving this place and wanted to share some yummy food pics-  I tried the tamales dinner and hubby had the pastor tacos-- both excellent and huge servings as they come with rice and beans too!  Not pictured is the margarita that was on special- it packed a punch !

They just remodeled this place but they should have worked on the staff and food. Nearly half of the syrups in the soda machine were gone, the food wasn't made properly, and everything lacked taste. The fries just tasted like straight grease; not potato, not salt, just grease.

Aside from being the only DD I know that has converted floor space into a fire pit leather sofa lounge, there is nothing out of the ordinary in this shop.  The coffee is hot. The donuts sweet. The service so-so.  The lounge full of Russian 20 somethings. 
If any of these appeal to you, this is the place for you.
Me?  Not so much.

Amazing thin crust pizza and my friends and I love that it is BYO! I love their amazing toppings and that everything is deliciously freshly made! I love that they have GF crusts and their variety is fabulous. They are a tad high priced so I will probably only go if I have a Groupon.

On a recommendation, I had my mother take her car info Ralph's to get her muffler looked at. They were fast, polite, and had her in & out in less than an hour. Andre took care of the issue at a very fair price. We also appreciated that he showed us the issue prior to giving us the estimate.

#218

Been here lots of times and they have never got my drink wrong...except for today. It wasn't exactly what I ordered but pretty close and actually was very drinkable. I used to drink Starbucks almost everyday but the cost is now prohibitive. This is a good location no major issues.

#222

This is a gas station variety Dunkies. What that usually means is that they probably are out of your favorite donut. That's the way it is at these in another store locations but for the most part they are ok. This one is close and is usually well stocked but.....you know, out of this or that.

Stop  in here today around 3:00pm and was promptly seated. The food taste varies here. Some days it's great other days it's okay and today it was just okay. Now the atmosphere is always great so it makes up for the okay food on occasion. The drinks are excellent bottom line.

A Little Dragon restaurant is average. If you are on a quest searching for the best Chinese food around...you will leave disappointed...If you are hungry and craving Chinese food, you could do worse. Pleasant friendly owner, cheap food, average little place.

Great service and delicious food. I came in late on a Saturday by myself. Got seated right away and ordered a margarita on the rocks. Dinner bread was also tasty. I only ate once slice. (Saved room for dessert)

Ordered veal entree and coconut cream cake for dessert. Also a cup of coffee. 

I over ate but it was worth it.

Some of the best/freshest sushi in Tucson.  I always come here when I want good quality fish. The only downside is the ambiance.  It's a bare bones kind of place with just CNN playing on one tv in the entire area.  A little on the pricier side compared to other sushi places nearby.  Highly recommend for good nigiri/sashimi!

I went in today expecting a whole new Straub's.  I was a little disappointed to see that it was just the front section that had been  revamped.  Apparently they needed a larger section to sell liquor and beer.  They have also added a small outdoor eating area.  Maybe they are still working on the rest of the store.

At first I was pleased with how fast my service was. Like, super SHOCKED. Then when I opened my sandwich, it was evident that it had been sitting there for a while. the mayo turned clear, and everything was kind of soggy, and melted together.

This explains why my service was so fast. ugh.

I like the location of this dunkin donuts!


The service was fast. My hot chocolate was overbearingly SWEET. Idk why, but I get this hot chocolate all the time, and it has never been that sweet. Nothing that some added water didn't fix. My donuts weren't the freshest, but, again, nothing to worry about.

I've been bringing my baby here for 5 years now. I have no complaints. The pricing isn't bad, I remember comparing when I was first looking for a vet and this place won. I appreciate that they will bill you for services. The staff is always loving and welcoming to my Hazel, and we love and appreciate them for all that they do!

Came back to get my hair evened out - it's longer on the right. Got it cut by Anna yesterday and today, no one is here. As of 3:30. They're typically open until 5. No sign on the door to indicate that. Just one that says closed Labor Day. Not the day before. Disappointed.

This place can get really busy. I would recommend that you call Lynn and place your order. I went with a few eggrolls for my wife and I. Their prices are pretty good. I would consider coming back. It's great how close they are to my own home. Check them out!

My wife and I were looking to stuff our faces for lunch. This place is down the street from our home and we had been wanting to go for the longest time. The quality of the food can be better, but I appreciate the variety that they have and I appreciate the speedy and fast service.

The new building opened a couple weeks ago and it's nice. I'm a craft beer fan and they had a great selection with mix and match options. The employees were nice and helpful. They said they are going to get more beer in the near future. This will be my goto spot for craft beer.

Nice place, great location! All in all a clean, safe place to stay. Had to change rooms due to room 1 being musty! Yuck! Charlies Steakhouse is next door, so skip the lobby bar with overpriced drinks and stale wine and head over.Stayed for the breakfast buffet(carb overload) where service is friendly but the selection is weak.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: It was a cute place but in very hidden location with only an dark alley connecting it to the street. There is an ample selection of beers and a few games to play but it's better to go with a small crowd. I went on a Friday night and it was decently crowded with not much seating space.

Sushi is great - the food is always fresh. However, the service is terrible! The wait is always so long for your food. If you have plenty of time and a bottle of wine, sure, it's the place to be. Other than that, there's plenty of other sushi places around the area to go to.

The ice cream is good, but definitely not worth the price. I had the raspberry swirl and I did enjoy it but I can not get over how little you are given for how much you pay. I'm not from the area so this might me the way things are down here, but I probably wouldn't come back.

I'm glad that I ignored the reviews. The customer service was outstanding! I was made to feel welcomed and comfortable before I reached my room. The beds are comfortable and the room was spacious. The hotel is a little dated, but clean, comfortable, and the staff is friendly! I definitely will stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Pretty good food. What's awesome though, is they have this "deal" where for $25 you get an entire box of food. It's enough for about 5 people, or 3 meals for 2 people I would say. 

It's a bit far if you don't live close, but definitely a great deal, and one of the better New York style take out joints in the area.

Terrible, terrible, terrible attitude from the young lady who took and fulfilled our order at the drive thru window. She was incredibly rude and indifferent AND she got our order wrong, then was even more rude when we circled back to have her correct it. Will not be back to this location.

Service was top notch, and the hostess was very sweet to us.  For an expensive Italian restaurant I would say our main courses were just average but not necessarily worth the money.  I can confirm the bread was some kind of joke, tasted like day old super market bread.  Probably wont be back for a long time.

I don't get here often enough. Raconelli's has great NY style pizza. Generous toppings. You can buy whole pies or by the slice. Never disappointed in the 15 years I've been eating here. Tonight we got an 18 inch. Huge slices. Pizza was ready on time when I arrived to pick it up.

Freddies is a shoppers dream. A small store with a helpful staff and great products. They carry a good selection of groceries that includes local products like bread from Marconi and Fazios. The meat counter has a great selection and reasonable prices. This type of store heartens back to days gone be.

Stopped in and ordered a Bob's Deluxe pizza for carry out.  The pizza was ready in less than 20 minutes. I've never been to this location before as we normally go the one in Ballwin..Like that store the toppings are extremely generous.The crust was a bit thick for a St Louis style pizza but it was still OK.

Got to love the staff and ownership!  Thoughtful and dedicated. Came here to taste a variety. Treated fabulously and served beautifully. 

Nice setting. Comfortable!  Many options. Take advantage if you can. I appreciated the dedication to provide a consistent quality product. 

Baked goods...all local!

Always way too busy!  Always friendly!  Clean!  However today I found a table easily (one table was available) so I had peace and joy!  

All the rest it good. 

They do not like adding half and half when ordering, they prefer you add your own. Not pleased with that. Otherwise, there you have it. Another Starbucks!.

Loved this place. Short 5 min drive from Clearwater airport. Rooms spacious and cozy. Bed was not the most comfortable but wasn't the worst either. The breakfast was amazing. They had Turkey sausage which is a huge plus as i don't eat pork. We would def recommend this hotel and would stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Stopped her for dinner on a Monday. Nice small restaurant. Service was quick and efficient. They had some things on the menu I would like to try in the future. 

I had an eggplant parm that was good and a house salad that was excellent. 

 A little on the high side for a neighborhood restaurant, $23 for the salad and eggplant.

Nomnomnom definitely satisfied my sushi craving, its pricing was pretty standard but that lunch special though ! Pretty cheap for a lot of food :) the service was good the waiter was super nice! If you have a semi big party I would definitely recommend getting a private booth!

Good Mexican food
It was Cico de Mayo and the place was a fiesta of activity we had Jalapeño cucumber margaritas to drink. Had appetizers of guacamole and Queso Fundido tasty and fresh. I ordered a chicken stuffed chili relleno burrito, it was tasty spicy and a new taste. Will try some other items when I come back to Nashville

Would be 5 stars if it were just a bit more affordable! Delicious pizza and a great addition to the Rittenhouse area for a quick pickup, but one pie north of $20 is definitely pricier than other options in the area (Vetri for example). Still, really really good pizza!

Very generic Starbucks with a small parking lot.  The staff when I visited did not have the coffee roast I normally drink and wanted to charge me extra for a pour-over.  From my knowledge, pour-overs do not cost more than regular drip coffee.  I will not be returning to this location.

We went here on a weekend night. We did  not have to wait for a table. Our server was excellent   She did a great job. 
The restaurant  is noisy. It is tight on seating and can get a bit loud. 
The wine was good. The pizza was delicious. 
The dessert was frozen in the middle. I don't think it was made in house.

It's a nice lunch spot (they also serve dinner I just prefer it for a lunch location), small local place with some nice menu options. They have some outdoor tables which I enjoy! The service is often slow and slightly rude though. But still a nice option to get away from tourist crowds and have a bite!

Pretty good food, especially for the price. Cute atmosphere, clean, ample seating. 
The only thing I don't like about the place is that it's got two huge TVs on both sides of the dining room tuned into the news. Fox News too. Jeez, can't I just enjoy dinner without having to watch political jibber jabber?

Service on a Sunday night is awful!  Even though they aren't at all busy, and we just ordered salad, we had to ask the server for bread and we've waited at least half hour for our salad.  Not happy.  Like the food but there are plenty of other places to choose from so we won't be back.

Decent bar with a live band when I went. I enjoyed it but there are a lot of other bars on Bourbon that had more entertainment at the time. Hand Grenade was pretty good and a lot of bars would allow you to take it in with you while strolling down bourbon bar hopping. I would come back.

I find myself stopping in this location when I am in Kenner. It is down the street from the Esplanade Mall and in the strip mall area with Burger King and McAlister's Deli. I have had very good experiences in the drive thru and lobby. 

They are open six days a week. I recommend this branch location from any of your banking needs.

- Ordered the salmon dish for my entree. Nothing exciting, but no complaints.
- Very tiny. Feels homey.
- Some of the tables are stacked up in such a way that it's hard to get up without making many other people get up as well.
- Cash only. BYO.
- Pretty pricey. Plates are pretty large.
- Service is okay.

Hotel was in a shady neighborhood. Anthony, the GM is ENTIRELY unresponsive.  I have been calling them for months now with a simple question, but have not received a reply.  The same can be said for Vonisha (spelling?) the Housekeeping manager.  If customer service is a priority, please DO NOT give this hotel your business.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: When I moved to Ridley Park we tested a lot of places for good eats. China Wok is the best Chinese food around.  The order  is always right and the people couldn't be nicer. The food is great ever time.  Also very well priced. I say get food from here always.

Friendly service, usually quick, pretty basic dining area. Very much what you would expect from a Subway establishment. 

I noticed that they have a Keurig machine for coffee in the mornings so that is a bit disappointing even though it is a national chain.

What a cool place! I drove all the way here from the NE side to get a special liqueur I was searching for, and SoBro Spirits was pretty much the only place in town that carried it! My husband also enjoyed their huge selection of craft beers. I'd venture to say that if you can't find it elsewhere, they'll have it!

Love this place. The inside is nothing fancy but the food is why we go. I can't say enough good things about the ravioli in marinara sauce. My husband is addicted to the chicken parmagiana and fried mozzarella here. Also every time we've gone ,super busy or not, the service is always great.

The selection of unique donuts is a cool concept and something reno doesn't really have, but the donuts I had were just not too impressive. I would much rather have doughboys or rounds plus doughboys is cheaper. Another issue is the service here is actually really slow, on top of the long lines it's just not worth it for me.

So I'm altering my review.. After the first 3-4 times going here Kurt never remembered me (guess I'm not too memorable?) so I just kept getting 25% off for my "first cut". LOL. I felt like going to a place where the hairdresser would remember at least my face so I stopped going. Meh.

Me, too.  Deducted 1 star because they only accept cash.

How many years have I drive by this place and never stopped? TOO MANY
Should I had stopped here years ago? YES

One of my favorite ice cream maker is Working Cow.  If you like Working Cow, I think this is better.

This distributor carries a great selection of craft beer. It's my go-to distributor. They also have a small selection of big bottle beers in the back if you're just looking for something special. I attended an event here last summer and went home with a t-shirt and some other swag, not to mention the free burgers and beer i had.

Came into today with my boyfriend and ordered an iced cinnamon almond milk macchiato, caramel nonfat frappuccino & a venti blonde roast with a shot of espresso. They messed up all 3 drinks and our sandwiches came out burnt after waiting for 20 minutes after ordering.

A 15 minute wait for one smoothie I left. Should have learned my lesson when I went here before since it's en route to work and had a very long wait for breakfast. Decided it's not worth the trouble, thanks Burger King for encouraging me to prepare my own breakfast instead of consuming your products.

First time eating here. Good pizza, although I usually don't like provel or thin crust. The best part of the meal was the salad. Very fresh and generous portion. The mozzarella cheese sticks weren't very good, but I'll definitely be back for the salad and pizza. Friendly service too.

Another over-rated Mexican restaurant.  Portions are tiny.  $10 for two enchiladas and I'm still hungry.  Rice was so dry and crunchy that I'm not sure if it was uncooked (raw) or if it's just been sitting out for 9 days... I suspect the latter.  I won't be coming back.

This restaurant has a fantastic location. On a good day (like it is today) we love to sit outside on their back patio, have a drink and just relax and watch the river. The food is ok, nothing really special but consistently good. 

If it's busy, wait until a table on the patio is available.

People are friendly. The last four times we went through the drive thur, three of them we had issues. Either they forgot something or we had a special order, extra pickle, whatever. Get home and the order is messed up. Probably stay clear of the drive thur and go inside to make sure my order is correct, or just stop going period.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is a really cool bar.  They have a lot of great cocktails.  If I was younger, I think this would be a regular spot for me.  Now I will just come back at an earlier time.  One bonus is that it is across the street from one of my favorite places, Engine No. 9.  They do allow smoking, and there was a DJ in the back room.

I love NV Nails. It's quiet and the woman who runs the place is very sweet. It's a great place to get a manicure and/or pedicure and just relax. They do nice work and are reasonably priced. And they end every treatment with a brief chair massage - who wouldn't want that?!?

I'm not quite sure what the problem is here. Is it management? Is it employees? Is it both? Why is it that we are keeping people sitting in the drive thru for so long? I think they may need to hire more people? Horrible, horrible, horrible. The worst part is they don't care. Such is society now.

It was a slow customer service today.
And they forgot to add my tortillas like I requested. 
Order was ready as I arrived, +.
Waitress didn't smile or even looked as if she cared to assist me, - .
Place was decent as far as cleanliness.
Food was ..meh  (shrugs)
Jamaica was decent. ( a mexican beverage made from the hibiscus flower)

Good sushirrito in a great location in a food court near Suburban. Large portion and I like being able to choose my own toppings. Friendly service, but could be more well-staffed--she was working the cashier and preparing the food and working the phone and seemed frazzled.

My family and I needed a quick late night snack after being out most of the day in the city. Romeo Pizza was open and I was able to order 2 quick pies along with a carrot cake. The guys were cool, professional and fast. The pizza was very good and at a reasonable price!

Great hotel freidnly staff and if you sign up for something I believe it was SGD or something along those lines free WiFi for your stay.  The gym is a bit small with not a lot in it but the equipment it high end and you have some nice ammenadites.  I like it here and would absutely stay again
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Being an ex New Yorker I know what good pizza is, I would have to say Papa John's is pretty good pizza for not being New York or New York style.  it is an easy and fast substitute if you're looking for pizza although it is not the cheapest around some of their specialty pies are quite expensive, much more than their competitors.

I love Wendy's but this one is disgusting. I tried it three times thinking that first two times maybe it was a bad day for them... Fries are always soggy and old... Burgers old... The food has never been fresh but has all three times been cold and old... Never will visit again

OK so overall I had a good time and may or may not visit again.. the service is great and so is the atmosphere. The prices are great and the guacamole is the best... the tacos and quesadillas were average tasting... overall I give it a solid 4... I kinda wish I can give 3.5 but I rounded it off to 4...

My husband and I get my hair here. Brigitte and Marla do a great job. We have been going to Brigitte for a very long time. The shop is clean and my husband likes that they shave the neck. Price is more than hair cuttery but worth it, and there's just about always clients in here so you know its popular.

I stayed at this place right after it opened. There were no signs on the building and the road wasn't yet paved. I have to say that I loved every minute of my stay! The food was great and the complimentary happy hour was incredible! I got more than I bargained for and look forward to coming back!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Inside the airport: nice location with a menu filled with a little bit of everything. Pleasant staff and very good food. Feels upscale but doesn't command the prices of a really upscale place. I had the burger and fries with a Chardonnay and the staff was great.

Standard BK with a drive-thru.  I decided to grab a quick bite before my drive home from a conference.  Order was prepared properly (not a trivial thing these days).  The boy who served me was helpful in getting out of the lot the easiest way to head home.  Showing me the back road allowed me to avoide a dangerous lefthand turn.

Service was attentive and friendly.  The restaurant has a nice vibe to it, and presents well---stripped down to the basics in decor, clean and relatively intimate in size.  Food was well prepared and the menu full of unique choices.  Yelp steered us well in bringing us here.  Recommend.

Went here for lunch with my coworker. The lunch specials were great. Sushi was fresh and they had some interesting rolls that other restaurants don't seem to offer. Service could've been just a little faster as we were on our lunch hour. But overall very good, and I'd go back.

This is the best local Mexican restaurant! The chips and salsa are always great.  The specials are actually specials - actual discounts.  The Acapulco with chicken is my favorite with rice and a side of refried beans.  Easily enough to make another meal if you aren't completely starving!

I enjoy working out here. It's clean, affordable, and has just about all the equipment I can ask for. The only reason I don't give it five stars is because it doesn't have classes/group exercise. I would love that! However you can't beat $10 month. Also, they have free Wi-Fi, just ask for the password at the front desk.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Menu selection is pretty big. Food was tasty. Ordered peking duck, green beans, ma po tofu and braised pork. Only thing I didn't like was the ma po is supposed to be extremely hot. It was about as hot as a jalapeno pepper. 

Went around 7pm on Friday. Place was packed but service was good.

I drive out of my way to go to the Dunkin Donuts. The service is literally amazing. I can be in a huge line of cars and I'm on my way within minutes. My order is always right and the coffee is on point. The employees there are so sweet. I couldn't brag about this place enough.

The location & design is amazing, but the machines are older & there is no towel service.  You have to purchase towels or bring your own to shower or wipe sweat off your face. I would prefer consistency between locations when I get a better membership to know I will always be provided a towel.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The flavors here are pretty incredible. I had the bourbon salted pecan which was really tasty and the wildberry lavender which rocked my world. A little on the pricey side; I spent $10 on two small scoops and a bottled seltzer water, but worth trying just for some of the unique flavors on offer.

I ordered the fish tacos here which can best be described as so-so. They were messy served on a small flour tortilla shell with cole slaw which made the tacos messy. The fish as well was not crispy due to the wetness of the slaw. The only bright spot was our server who was spot on.

Mobile check-in was easy. The location is just off I40 at Donelson near BNA. The guy at the front desk was super friendly. They put me in a suite, but I did not care for it. I called down stairs
And the front desk moved me to a standard king room. Much more comfortable. About like a Hilton Garden Inn.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Best sushi I've had in Nashville.  Everything was very fresh. My boyfriend is from southern CA where the sushi is great and he even kept going on about how we need to return to Samauri.  The prices are very reasonable and they don't hold back on their cuts of fish. Everything was delicious and I'll definitely be returning.

It's ok. My meal was fine but just not wowed by their food. I loved the corn & crab bisque, artichoke Vincent was good but thought there would be more cream sauce, cannelloni was not great. I'd go back if someone wanted to eat there but not my favorite Italian food

A not bad restaurant in South Common, but worse than any other establishments around it.

There's over a dozen places in the area that are better than this place

What does this BP have going on for it?

1. Clean
2. Fast Service
3. Good service
4. Good deal on Tuesdays
5. Family friendly
6. Has VLTs

Over the past few years I have used this business and have continued to see better and better service. Although very small they are very efficient processing the customers. The turnaround time is very quick on most days. Apollo Beach is lucky to have a small local service available to all of us for our cleaning needs.,
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: A tad on the pricey side, but everything the waitress recommended was great! We had the hot pretzels, buffalo wings, French dip sandwich, and the Voyager burger. Wings were not very spicy, but cooked well. French dip, burger and onion rings were very good; everything cooked perfectly.

Food is solid for lunch. I have been a few times and everything I have gotten is pretty tasty. I really like their chicken paninis and their club sandwiches. Lunch menu is definitely affordable and worth it. Always feel like I am in a geriatric home when I eat there though. Tables are full of old people.

Although I enjoyed the taste of the sushi, last bite there was something very hard, rock solid. It was not a bone and I'm not sure what it is. The spider roll I got was mostly shell as well which was disappointing. I'm not sure that I will return due to the hard object in my sushi and one roll being mostly shell.

Pizza is very good. Order times are a nightmare. We order carry out and the estimated time is always more than an hour and is never even close to ready on time. Currently waiting for 2 large pizzas that are 20 minutes overdue, and counting. Don't plan on eating in, there's about 5 tables.

Bartender Will is excellent, attentive and helps you figure out the right drink for your day, mood, taste buds. Lol! I can be all over the place at times. Delicious & unique appetizers. Entrées are overpriced and haven't knocked my socks off but, Sarah the server  is a absolute delight! Cheers!

I had the skimpiest sandwich I've ever eaten in my life today. The sandwich maker was like a robot and could not have put any less ingredients on my sandwich. I won't purchase another $7 sandwich from this location. All I could taste was bread and lettuce. Very disappointing. Definitely not worth it.

I ordered the Chicken Adobo.  It was okay, the restaurant was pretty busy.  The food quality was more like a fast food Mexican.  The service was good!   I'm trying not to compare it to the Mexican in Dallas as we just moved here. I have my favorite Mexican restaurants in the Dallas-Fort Worth area!

I enjoy the atmosphere and ginger dressing salad but as far as service goes, my server walked away from me when I asked for salad dressing. I felt disrespected. I asked for something simple and it was made out to be the biggest hassle for him. He barely spoke to us and acted mad the whole time. Sushi was decent.

I love Winco, they mostly have everything & you'll be amazed with their low prices! I don't shop here much though because they're far to shop for groceries with. I love that their form of payment is debit /cash though I would love for them to go to credit card route as an option.

I must say i hate the little corner where the cafe is located! after passing the red elephant millions of times i decided to stop and I've been there 4 times now , I love the salmon risotto bowl...Nothing fancy plain good food quick, check in sit down and eat!

Very cheap Chinese food. It's exactly what you would expect greasy and not very good quality. Sometimes that's what I'm looking for in Chinese food though so this is the place.
Get the Singapore noodles. They have tons of stuff prop and seafood. Very tasty way to get rid if a hangover.

Great service and even better food! We just had my birthday there the other weekend and they were very accommodating with our large party of 20. Sushi is great and all made to order. Loved the 10th Street roll and they made us a special birthday banana roll. Thanks for the great birthday! I look forward to returning.

This is really a review of the rooftop bar more than the actual hotel itself.

Pros:
+ Separate entrance for the rooftop
+ There isn't actually a cover to go up
+ Great Drinks
+ Gorgeous view of the arch
+ Lots of space to lounge

Cons:
- Drinks are around $10 for one though
- Parking is a bit tough here
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Bad experience. Showed up to find out they had to cancel my reservation. No phone call, drove 4 hours. The receptionist was indifferent. She wouldn't even give me a number to call, I had to try and find on Google and go back in... I don't recommend staying here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Fantastic service, I love this place! I come here every once in a while to indulge in my sushi cravings. It's on the pricey side but the meal options are generous. The guys are so nice about explaining the sushi options, what's in them and how it's made. And I definitely appreciate the buy two get one free Wednesday option!

There's a coffee shop closer to my apartment that I frequent for convenience, but I've found that when I want a really nice cup of caffeine I walk here. That says something. Everyone is very friendly, especially the owner who is lovely.

It's more on the cozy side but there's some room to work in the front and back rooms.

The shuttle took 30 min to show up.  I am never booking wi th budget ever again for the rest of my life.  I was on the phone to cancel the reservation when the shuttle finally showed up.  I easily saw 20 buses from the other companies come and go.  The agent on the phone absolutely worthless as well.

This place is my favorite Sunday breakfast - brunch spot to head to. I usually get the French toast with a pint mimosa because it's only 6 bucks for that beverage! What a steal! The bartender Brenda is awesome and welcoming. Parking is a little touch, but on Sundays street parking is best.

Stopped in here on Friday night with friends for one drink.  This must be a real bar because there are no fruity girly drinks, which is all I drink because apparently I'm a princess according to one of my friends.I think the music was jazz? or there was a jazz flute...not really my thing but it was still fun.

If you are in chestnut hill and want sushi, this is the right place. The Kani kamikaze is the best roll on the menu. Also try the seafood soup, def the best in Pa. The broth is delicious and spicy. If I were them, I would charge double and put double the seafood in it. If they do that, nothing would come close.

Like everyone, we dropped in here to have a hand grenade. I must say the drink had a punch to it and had an enigmatic flavor. Given that you cannot have this drink anywhere else, it is surely worth a visit to try it out. In the evening there was a band playing Beatles tunes and I loved them.

Like any Dunkin Donuts they have good days and not so good days. The good far out number the not so good. I stop here often during my morning walk to get some coffee and enjoy a break in the AC. I also utilize the drive through a few times a month.  The few times my order was incorrect the happily and quickly corrected it.

Rude customer service.
Went through drive through to wait 5 mins with no respond when I said hello, they responded with I'm busy sir with an attitude. Could of said sorry one minute sir we are busy. One other person in drive through and only 4 people inside, not so busy my opinion. Thanks for the ride service Jaricelys A.

Bourbon street got to be a little too much for me, I just happened to find this place one night and really enjoyed the music here, drinks can be a little pricey here but being from NYC I'm used to it, this is a small chill place that draws you in with the live music that they feature, definitely a favorite go to spot in Nola

Great store. I love having it minutes from my house. They have so much. Groceries of course, but they also have a garden area, furniture, a sushi counter, Starbucks, electronics, books and more. Its so great when our store choices are limited in Sahuarita. Everyone is usually friendly and never too long of lines.

Good, fast, friendly service is all I ask for when renting a car. This location hit the mark. I am ever impressed with the quality of customer service Enterprise provides. In a daunting city to drive in, this company makes the check out and check in process a pure joy.

This place is a great service and awesome if you have priority pass. Food isn't super fancy but it's included so you want find me complaining! The soft pretzels are incredible and my personal favorite. Also really liked the chicken fingers and the buffalo chicken wrap!

It's Arby's and it's finally open!  They've only been open a few hours so couldn't miss my chance to be the first to review and put them on the map!  The 2 for $6 French dip and swiss met all tasty expectations!  Modern interior and a great location that needed more options and super easy to get to from I-10.

These were the nastiest wings I've ever tasted..They tasted like they were coated in salt. Ordered $20 worth (20 wings only got 17). I will usually eat everything or save but had to throw these out. The buffalo sauce was bland and garlic parm just too salty, small wings. Not a great experience and would not recommend.

Lunch for one in #BWE (Belleville West End). I read the reviews online and since they were mixed...I decided to try it for myself. My taste buds were delighted by the Hickory Grilled Salmon Club and the Soup of the day: Chicken Tortilla. I plan to try the late night menu soon. #stlmetrofoodie

A pathetic bartender and a poor selection of alcohol for breakfast. She moved slower than molasses and didn't even know what was in house. This bar is an embarrassment to our fair city! You have to buy the food on the other side and there is no drink menu although there is some variety of alcohol behind the counter.

My husband and I are huge fans of their other location, Gennaro's. Menu keeps it simple with a few salad, meatballs, antipasto, and pizza. Cash only and BYO. There is a cute outdoor mosaic courtyard for outdoor dinning. Pizza was very good, but we still love Gennaro's.

Yogorino is different and I love it. This store is much bigger than the one in rittenhouse. It also has gelato, which I am pretty sure is from Capogiro.
Decent amount of toppics. The sauces are delicious!
A bit expensive, but it's different and worth it.
Always pretty fast and friendly!

Good Service. BYO!  The free bread they give you is not the best, but the tomato pesto that comes with it is GREAT!!! Great pasta specials. Gnocchi is okay. Duck pasta dish is decent, but oily. I had a pasta special recently with shrimp, beans, tomatos, and etc, which was delicious. Clean flavors. Cute decor.

Ooka is always consistently delicious with good service. We dine here and get takeout often. They renovated the inside within the past year and the environment/atmosphere is really beautiful. Lunch and happy hour have the best deals. We love the specialty rolls.

I used to live by here and I still come here now that I've moved because they've always done a good job. The lady that works here is always friendly but efficient. She treats my clothes with more care than I do. They always come back cleaned well and I'll continue to come here to support her business.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
I am a huge fan of Gennaro's. It's got a thin crust, sweet and rich tomato sauce along w fresh mozzarella cheese. Also, the meatballs are excellent. Can't say enough about how much I love it here. Also, the decor is vintage and adorable. 

I have yet to be disappointed with Gennaro's

Nice enough property with a large, clean room and plenty of amenities. Only major issue was service during breakfast for both days I was there was terrible. The staff was friendly enough but I think they need to do some retraining on how to handle food service as there were too many mistakes made.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Room was clean and large and the décor was updated.

Fitness center was decent and had dumbbells and several machines.

Woken up at 5AM by their garbage service and when I mentioned this to the manager was told they 'have no control over when they come'.

Really? You pay them. You have complete control.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Best sushi in town!!! I tried this place with a friend and was so surprised by how friendly the staff was and the Sushi was amazing!! Couple weeks later, I insisted my mom and sister try it and they loved it too. They have been back a couple times since. I would definitely recommend the pink lady.

okay a 2 star review on a fast food chain via yelp = basically a 5 star on my fast food. its good (for fast food) hahahaha. been going here for years. i mean you go to a fast food restaurant you get fast food food. ya know? .59 cent tacos on sundays. just go

Tuesday night May 12 at 11:30 pm. 

Sat in the drive thru on one side while FOUR CARS orders were taken on the other side. 

I had to say "hello, anyone there" before my order was taken. 

Horrible drive thru procedure. 

0 apology or reasons given for the treatment. 

Horrible service.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Took in an extremely dirty truck... inside and out. I had a coupon for $5 off and let them have at it. Overall I feel they did a great job. Little pricey... though you pay for what you get in my opinion. Anthony was my detail guy and he did a fine job. Thanks, Christopher M.

Nice Lakeview hangout bar. Nice patio seating outdoors. The drinks were affordable. Great happy hour specials. The bar tenders are fast. Not a very  very diverse crowd so I sat outside with my friend to avoid the stares. I like that the music isn't so loud that you have to scream to have a good conversation.

This is a convenient location on busy Baltimore Ave.  Plenty of parking.

I come here to buy the hubs coffee and it's always made correctly and quickly.

My son sometimes pickups a warmed cookie which he loves.   

The staff is friendly.

We will definitely be back

[796]

I usually visit this McDonalds if I'm headed to 476. 

The drive thru moves pretty quick.     The in/out of this lot is awkward as I can only go one direction on the road.

The food is prepared as expected.   The staff is nice.

Plenty of inside room and clean bathrooms.

I'll be back.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Stopped in this busy Enterprise location to pickup a rental car for an out of town relative. 

The staff was really nice and car was ready when promised.  Since this location closes early they allowed us to drop off at the airport at the end of the day.

We will definitely be back if we need another rental.

Plenty of Parking since this location is very busy.

No inside kid playground (my sons complaint)

The inside is nice decorated in old school style (pics next time).

Drive thru is very quick and so far always accurate.  Sometimes the line is about to stretch into the street but they move quick enough that everyone fits in the lot.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: There are barely essentials here. No conditioner or lotion so if you shower that's a real bummer. Neighbor noise is a problem because the floors are incredibly thin. There is no carpet in the rooms so the foot noise on the room above me kept me from sleeping.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Got the new spicy fish sandwich and it was just completely caked in cayenne pepper. No good flavor, just extreme heat. I could only eat a quarter of the sandwich and I am someone who doesn't back away from spice. Would have been good with just a sprinkling.

A great place to stop for a meal, drink, wifi, and sports if that's your thing haha very nice people. However I can't eat garlic or onions which means some dishes are off limits for me even though they look so good. Plenary of parking & easy to get to and find.

Not the first time delivered order was wrong, but 3 different mistakes this time. Menu online says crabby fried comes with very own cheese sauce, it does not. Asked for sauce on side, it did not. Asked for Italian Wedding soup, got a substitute because they were out, without asking me.

I rarely stop at Wendy's but as a teen I worked there and sometimes like to remind myself of what my past work tasted like. I stopped through for a single combo with a chili cheese baked potato... but they forgot the potato. I was surprised, so I called the number on the receipt and no answer. Oh well better luck next time.

My dad had a horrible experience at their South Tampa location so he wanted to give this location a chance. He was looking for some frames and had been told they were not eligible for 25%...they were at this location and the lady who helped him gave great customer service. He left very pleased.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Have used this place plenty of times to hang out with good friends or for a date night. Veal Parmesan is my go to. Pasta portions don't disappoint here. The desserts were splendid as well whenever I have them. Great local staple of the area and I need to try their pizza!

We got in off the waitlist....so there is hope even if you plan late. The food was excellent as was the service. Definitely worth the price!  We have dined at several 2-3 Michelin star restaurants and found ourselves comparing catbird to them. Just book it - you won't regret it.

I was left wanting more from this restaurant after a Saturday afternoon lunch. Very good complementary chips and salsa! But the rice and vegetables could have been a little fresher on my chilaquiles and the sauce tasted a little Italian lol. Service was quick and  portions were fair.

Great ambiance if you sit at the tables. Food is amazing. Used a Groupon saved half off our meal. Will be back and will be looking out for other deals.  We ordered the chicken tempura, shrimp teriyaki box with sushi and potstickers and Beef Negamaki.  Everything was delicious and we were unable to finish it all.

Can I really review $6 pizza?  It's chain pizzeria done really okay. I like it sometimes. Not known for service, but the staff gets the job done. I had a 15 minute wait and felt lucky since several folks were waiting before me. Some confusion in the kitchen. 
It's $6 minimal frills pizza. Meets expectations.

Love, love, love the sushi & sake martini!  We were so busy enjoying the casual but on-point service, oysters, sushi, and conversation that we forgot too snap a few photos.  There will definitely be a next time! 
If not a fan of sushi there is a full menu of fresh and mindfully prepared options. But do have sushi. 
Outstanding!

This white castle is pretty decent, most times they are nice and accurate with orders.  I like the fact that they now have where you can use an app to place your order before you get there  and the waits usually aren't as long as other white castle locations

The owners are not good ppl... The wife is a mean woman.. She wished a friend would get Cancer and Die, because he was helping with a Cancer Benifit and parked in the wrong place.. Please keep yourself AWAY FROM THIS STORE... THEY DONT DESERVE OUR BUSINESS..

Delicious!  Service was friendly and attentive. The sushi was fresh and very good. We'd definitely be back. They have a very large selection of rolls it was difficult to narrow it down!  My only complaint is that when I've always ordered nigiri I've always gotten two pieces per order. This place only gives you one piece.

Soooo.  I only gave two stars because the staff was nice. Definitely not an italian eatery- my white ouzza selected- had zero garlic (advertised fresh garlic) and I ordered spinach. Which was frozen and I tried to oick off- but couldnt, so I had to make my own whole pizza and toss it. How hard is fresh spinach and garlic?

Very friendly, the two gentlemen at the counter were so helpful! (and I can be a pain!)  Chimichanga - off the chart!  I can never find the discs to make empanadas at home and they let me buy one.  My empanadas were amazzzzzing (sorry about the promise to bring you one in, they we couldn't stop until there was none left!)

The food is kinda pricey, but pretty good.  It's your typical greasy fast food place, but it still is worth a pick up if you are looking for a late night place in Tucson.  The service isn't too bad, but don't go inside in the late night hours.  Some shady people go in, but other than that the food is good.

Origami isn't the BEST sushi but it's also not the worst. Growing up in Tampa I've tried a million sushi restaurants and haven't found one that's really "wowed" me. Origami always runs really good specials and happy hours!! I go frequently and enjoy the relaxing atmosphere

Another outpost of Tropical Isle, home of the Hand Grenade and a few other drinks in quirky glasses. It's a dive and it loves being a dive. Live music on some nights, and the place is always open. Not as good as the bigger one, (better balconies at the bigger one), but still, if you crave a Hand Grenade, head here.

This is not good pizza,my son who loves pizza hated it and when I got a chicken Caesar salad there was barely any Caesar dressing when asked for extra and the chicken was raw!! And when ordering mild wings it's in barb bq sause?? Way to expensive for the little nothing portions

Last visit in May: Mom hated the veggie sandwich. I liked the cheesesteak, but it was burning hot. We had a friendly server, when Mom's water glass was chipped, the waitress gave her a new one. We both liked the Banana Xango for dessert. But I really loved the cinnamon butter sauce for the sweet potato fries.

Great neighborhood place!!! Just relocated form WI and it for sure has the neighborhood feel my wife and I were looking for. Great staff, Clint and Amy, are very friendly. Food is good and drink specials are reasonable, doesn't get much better!!! My wife had the burger and she loved it. Can;t wait to go back for a beer!

Beautiful bar! Such a classy establishment in the quarter maybe a block off of Bourbon St and you wouldn't know it! The bartenders are magicians making classic cocktails and smooth martinis. The crowd is always happy and excited listening to the awesome band. They are old timey Jazz but upbeat. Definitely need to check it out!!!

This place is pretty bad. I'm not sure if it used to be good or something, but those times have passed. Have ordered here 3 times, as I work close by. The food is just so, so bad. Barely cooked vegetables. Barely any flavor in the dishes. Everything has the same bland sauce. Customer service is also poor. Take your money elsewhere.

This place is wonderful. Great quality fish in the middle of elmwood mall. They have a good happy hour during the week with discount drinks and food. The real treat though is their bottomless mimosas for $8 on Sundays! You'll have good service in a cozy space and make sure to try the salmon nigiri.

Honestly. I wasn't that impressed. It was definitely a good time with the unlimited wine and the live accordion player but the food wasn't to die for. Also if you didn't drink a ton you definitely won't get your money's worth. Dessert left much to be desired.  I don't feel the need to rave about this place like everyone else does.

Not the best gym in NOLA. Classes are outdated and not a lot of people go to them. Customer service is not the best and the pole fitness lady that teaches there is a bit rude. Either way it has all the equipment, if you know what to do for a workout you will be fine.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I really love the food here, but the last few times I have come the service was awful. Super slow and server forgot multiple of my items. She didn't come check on us and I had many issues with not getting everything I ordered. I understand they are very busy, but it is frustrating to only get half my items.

It was ok. A bit pricey I thought, and as another reviewer noted, the product comes out too fast and you can end up with more than you wanted.  The no-fat froyo was a bit bland for my taste. I tried 4 different flavors Angel food Cake, Strawberry-banana, NY Cheese cake and French Vanilla.

This is my go to sushi place in northeast philadelphia. They always are consistent with their food and the prices are amazing. I've never been disappointed by the quality or taste. The inside is also really beautiful, so it's a hot spot to take people on dates.

You have got to be shitting me. One of the worst places I've ever eaten, airport or no. I got a Bloody Mary... disgusting, a total waste of freaking $11. Slimy, flavorless, gag-worthy. My husband got pancakes... I wouldn't be surprised if these came frozen and were heated up in a microwave. HORRIBLE. Don't waste your money.

The food was great the service was mediocre. The restaurant can use a remodel orange walls and dim lights.. Not the best ambiance. First time I go to a Chinese restaurant and not receive a side with the entree. The Mongolian beef was great, chicken fried rice was the best and the Orange chicken was flavorful.

Im not usually a Marsh shopper as I find their prices higher than my main store, Kroger. That being said I found an amazing deal on pizza's and 2 liters of soda. Two pizza's+ Two soda's for 10.50...even little Caesars can't beat that. You win my vote on this day Marsh.

Meant to include a review of this place last year and never got around to it. Well I have time. It'll be quick. Advertised free membership but charged $50 dollars for a FOB for after hours acess. Free does no equal **with exceptions**. Eat the cost and buy a CCTV camera or change your verbage
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I only had the cold brew here and so that's the only thing I can comment about. The whole thing tasted pretty light and could really pass for an iced coffee instead of a cold brew. Like a fellow yelper mentioned, definitely not the best cold brew. An okay cold brew, not better than Starbucks or Dunkin Donuts.

Nice little italian BYOB in Chestnut Hill. Very attentive service and food is very good. Eggplant appetizer is very good and the gnocchi is cooked perfectly, nice and pillowy. If they have the Branzino entree, make sure to get it. I'd say this is the best Italian restaurant in the area.

Well the location is fantastic and the overall facility is nice, I had two issues that may have just been our room- the shower was weak and the room struggled to get cold. I was there with some friends in other rooms, and none had this problem..may be an anomaly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: There is no comparison to Gaetano's pizza!  The white pizza with clam sauce is heavenly! All of the pies are delicious, having the best crust in the Philadelphia area! The crust is cripsy and delicious and the pies are always piping hot when you get them home. BEST PIZZA IN THE PHILADELPHIA AREA!

I had lunch here recently. The place was nice and clean. We got in quickly, but it wasn't very packed. They got our order correct and the food came out quickly and warm. The service was good. Overall I can't complain. It was good Mexican food at the decent price.

Definitely get the tortas - if it's in the name, I'm guessing they are famous for them. I got the pulled pork torta and it was delicious! Perfect blend of vegetables and meat and carbs :)

I want to come back again to try the guac bar - I heard you can mix and match your own toppings...including BACON!

Delightful stay in Tampa here at Fairfield Inn & Suites by Marriott

Clean rooms/WiFi 

Great customer care. From the breakfast station to the front desk staff to the people cleaning. Etc

WONDERFUL!! 

Definitely would stay here again while in Tampa. 

Love! So clean too

Also- coffee was very good. Perfect!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Some of their appetizers and entrees lack cohesion and execution, but I would gladly order only baskets and baskets of their grilled sourdough bread and vegetarian tapas.  During my next visit, I'm very much looking forward to their pizza menu.  And more sourdough.

Dunkin' Donuts is what it is. I like the bagels and donuts here more than Starbucks stuff but the coffee is not as good. This particular store is right across from the medical center and is pretty convenient for if you are stopping by the hospital or visiting the village at Vanderbilt.

I have been to Derfs a couple of times. Each time we come, it is very mediocre. The service is pretty slow and the food is average-nothing special. The workers are usually friendly and nice so that's a plus.  They do have a spacious patio that allows dogs for all dog lovers out there.

I took my dog here after reading the reviews and I can't say that the ladies at the desk were the friendliest but I definitely liked the Vet that looked at Sophie. He took quite a bit of time with her and made sure I had all my questions and concerns taken care of. I will definitely keep taking her back there.

THIS IS THE S L O W E S T STARBUCKS EVER!!!!!!! I've never experienced anything like this ever. And what makes it worse is that the employees didn't seem to be concerned as if this was the norm for good customer service. I will never go back...but on a positive note my macchiato was great lol :)

This location was very typical for subway. It was clean and the service was good. The staff were helpful when asked questions for directions to places in the city and recommending other places to visit and eat. It was super convenient as it was next door to our hotel when we needed a quick bite to eat.

Nina was the best! Clean place and painless. Very reasonable price. The only reason why I didn't give 5 stars was because one of the employees was going on a rant in their native language and it felt a little uncomfortable. Other than that very friendly service and a great job. I will definitely be going back.

Santa Cruz Market is my quick stop store of choice. It's a block away from my home and not jam packed with people. I find myself here once in awhile for random items I need for cooking. They have minimal brand options so you can't be really picky. But they get the job done and the staff is friendly.

What is not to love? Hot Doughnuts? If the light is on 9 times out of 10 they hand you one for free straight from the conveyor belt! The service is always fast and friendly and did I mention HOT Doughnuts? Stop by when the light is on and have a warm taste of goodness.

My company recently switched its preferred contract from HERTZ to National to save money. I see where the cost cutting went to. Only two cars available with little to no options, customer service is sub-par. My company saved money but I lost the value. I travel almost every week and if it were up to me....not National.

This is just a place that has chairs for individuals, who think they can cut hair for some money, to come in and care, on their own terms. Some of the barbers have a little talent but could master their work better if they drop their misconceptions and ego.

Surprisingly there are a lot of options for Sushi in the downtown and our experience here was good for the service but average for the food. Its a good place with decent prices but nothing unique or spectacular but then again its not trying to be that kind of place I don't think. Casual and laid back sushi is a good description

We get take-out or delivery from here when we are visiting my in-laws. Three words for you: Orange. Peel. Beef. You can thank me later. I am also a big fan of their hot and sour soup. This place is above average for take-out Chinese food, and the staff is friendly if you feel like staying.

The frozen yogurt here is super tasty, and I love the flavors. The last time I went, they had coffee flavor! They offer all of the toppings you need (fruit, granola, crushed candy bars, nuts, etc.). The place is clean and the owner is so nice. The outdoor seating area is awesome in the summer. I definitely recommend this place!

No one spoke English but it didn't matter. I used google translate and showed my phone to one of the employees! It's a fast-paced in and out store. The price of their produce is very competitive. I'll make this a regular stop on my way to Reading Terminal!

This is only a review for the restaurant. It was really, really bad. I was meeting someone at the restaurant because they had a long layover. We ordered nachos. The 'chili' on the nacho tasted like sloppy joes. They topped the pile of mess with cold whiz. I'll pass on this place forever.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I liked this little dive!  The outdoor area is very spacious and they have games set up.  There are plenty of large tables as well as benches along the wall.  They only had one bartender working on a very busy night.  She ran her butt off and we didn't have to wait long.  They have some decent beers on draft.  I'll be back!

I've been going to fresh market for years. It's a wonderful place to shop. The prices are a bit steep, but I love all the specialty meats and the wine selection. The service is always really good, staff friendly. The broasted chicken is one of the best I've ever tasted.

Probably the worst pizza I've had.  Dough is tasteless cardboard. Toppings are usually dry since pizzas are sitting out.  Not the cheapest pizza around. Overall pizza tasteless. Plus is that they are open late, but you probably shouldn't get it anyways. Hopefully they improve soon!

Burger is alright but wouldn't dub it best in Philly quite. The meat was juicy but not flavorful and the bun tasted a little stale. The short rib orecchiette  was too soupy and the odd tasting. On the plus side, this location can accommodate large parties and the service is on point.

Not Italian! 
If you like pasta with your garlic you will like this joint. Overcooked pasta, defiantly not what I would call traditional Italian cuisine. I recommend they hire Italians in the kitchen. BTW Presto Pasta has better food than Gianfranco's Trattoria

AWESOME pizza, with gluten free options - they even have daiya cheese! you can eat several slices without that sickening "itis" following soon after.

one star off for the chlorine bleach spray they use WAY too early on a Saturday night. not appetizing! 

love the place, so hope management will heed advice if they're reading!

Went on Labor day with the husband for afternoon HH & snacks. Asked bartender how they make their "house margarita" and if they make their own mixer, to which she replied "this aint Bartaco".  She also thanked God they were not playing "Marc Anthony". 

Food is okay.

I've been using Advanced Automotive for years now and am always happy with the work they do. Eric and his wife are very friendly and customer service is excellent. Quick turn around, fair prices along with being honest is why I keep going back. Check them out.

Amazing food and beer, the service is outstanding, they were so super accommodated with us since we brought our dog we went up to the terrace that was so cool and comfy. They give you beer samples to make sure you're happy with your choice. Great experience and we will be back again for sure :)

The service here is how I always remembered it to be and that's phenomenal. Affordable prices, honest ownership and top notch quality work. What more can you ask for in a business? You have a forever customer in me and may God continue to prosper your business. I love you guys for everything that you do.

Tried Matolis for the second time since I bought a home here 4 years ago. What a pleasant surprise the pizza was excellent. The crust sauce cheese and topping were cooked to perfection. I always like to patronize our local businesses. I would definitely order from there again!!!!!!!

While visiting carpenteria, we decided to eat at Tony's. The food was pretty good but the  service. I found a french fry in the middle of  my pasta. Also, a vegetarian in the group got meat sauce even though that wasn't what we ordered. Besides that it took a long for our food to come.

This review is only for their delivery service.  Food came almost an hour past their estimated delivery time which was really 2 hours after we ordered.  Food was warm, fries were limp and cold.  When I called to ask where the food was, all I got was, "It's on its way". No sorry for the delay, we apologise, etc.
