Can't really be too specific about my visits here as it's been a while.  I've been here twice and I remember the salad, soup, and sushi all being quite underwhelming the two times I've come.  I came for dinner once and lunch once, and service was me, and so was the food, and sushi is my favorite food.

How important should be that you get greeted when you walk in a restaurant? How important should be that the sushi chef smiles and acknowledges you ? This place was good...maybe even very good.   But we reserve judgement.  Are you paying attention management? Should we give you another try? Do you deserve more than 3 stars?

First time here last week and this place is the best within the Seminole/nearby beach area. There was a wide variety and the prices were great. The restaurant has a locals feel to it and was very busy for an early weeknight. We think we've found out new go to Sushi place. Service was fantastic and fast!

Everything was amazing. The lamb ribs were excellent and the dessert OMG! The bread pudding was to die for. The staff is seriously great and the bartender makes the best (strong and tasty) drinks! I highly recommend This restaurant for any occasions or just because!

First visit here, it was a Sunday. 

Food took 15 minutes even though restaurant was slow. As for cleanliness; C- . Food was lukewarm and bland (bland Mex? Apparently so). Trash was completely full, employees just hanging around watching me try and stuff my plate into the bin. Hmmmm...

The hotel is very beautiful but a bit expensive we prepaid for our room but did not know it would be a $100 hold charge on the card until you check out the hotel has everything at your convenience but it's a bit pricey so be prepared to do a little spending as well as no pool.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've always loved tea and finally started getting into loose leaf teas! The workers here always have great advice and recommendations! I love that they let you smell all the teas and have samples! It's a little pricey, but the quality of the tea is superb and totally worth it! I'm addicted!

After hearing my coworkers talk about this place I finally decided to try it. OMG, now I see why they talk about this place. The breakfast is amazing. The staff is so friendly and helpful. Surprisingly it's not that busy which is great for me. The food is very fresh. Eggs aren't from the freezer. And the price is just right.

The sushi here is very good and the price is great. I almost always do a lunch or dinner combo which includes soup, salad, and 2 rolls. The atmosphere is intimate, and the staff has always been friendly. When I've opted to sit at the sushi bar I've even gotten a free app!

Oscar never fails to impress and the variety of vegetarian rolls he can create is endless! Went in on a Saturday night around 8 pm and the place was still relatively busy. Lots of good options to try on the boats (if you eat fish) and if not, definitely ask Oscar to craft a veggie roll for you - you won't be disappointed :)

By far my favorite place to get a beautiful full set! They always look so amazing and perfect and the entire staff is so inviting and sweet, I love coming here. My only advice would be to definitely make an appointment because their books fill up fast and they're always busy, totally worth it though!

Are you in the mood for Mexican. I don't think you can do much better than a food trunk. El Tapatio is your classic food trunk; however there customer service is above the rest. We got the classic chicken quesadilla and it was amazing simply and utterly amazing. I don't think it gets better than that.

I took my friend Krystyna here for lunch on her birthday. Features some pretty solid Italian lunch combos. I had a half Parmesan Chicken Sammie and delightful little house salad. Quaint rustic atmosphere and looks like a good spot for happy hour too. It's just like a little Italian nook :) I'll be back!

I truly love  Armature Works but the prices are a little dodo putting if you ask me. The establishment is so eclectic and fun. But ten bucks for a one scoop waffle cone!? 
Surely this just can't be right. But I'll admit the flavors are on point and service is always great.

Rooms are fine, clean. Restaurant is horrible!! 

I had to eat three meals there because it was raining and I couldn't get out to nearby Reading Market.

The breakfast buffet is weak; I recommend ordering something fresh cooked from the menu and go into Chinatown for dinner or to Reading Market.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I prefer Fry's on Houghton & Rita Rd.  At this Safeway, you can't choose your own portions at the snack bar.  Sometimes a tiny box of chocolate pretzels is not enough, but two is too many.  Also, Fry's has Tortilla Land tortillas and better produce/fish/meat in my opinion.

Best lasagne ever! 

I've never dined in, but have taken food to go a few times. I absolutely love their lasagne and carbonara! 

This place is a hidden gem in the Jasper Gates area. It's been open for eons and it's obvious why. The food here is phenomenal!

This place tries really hard. It's authentic mexican....the plantains are GREAT and the mole is amazing. Why do you have to pay so much for chips and salsa? I will never know. But if you live close and want good mexican, this is your joint. And it's a shame it's always so empty, but hey! More room for you!

One of my absolute favorite places in this area.  Hibachi is so fun and SO delicious.  Their sushi is delicious and the decor is upscale/trendy.  I went here before I ever liked sushi and just did hibachi or you can just do the regular menu that includes sushi and other items!

We've been going to the west end location for a few years now. It has a beautiful atmosphere and nice clean washrooms. The service has always been good.

The food is good, but not the be all, end all, and it's pricey. I think that's why we don't go that often. There are other Japanese restaurants I like more.

It's very popular. It's good but don't ask them to change anything they won't. I get that they want it to be a certain way but really. I hope it was just the person at the counter not knowing what they can and can not do. The food is always good. Best salads .

I've been meaning to try this for a while . Got a salad and a pizza to go. Well organized curb side service. Everything was good. But it's a bit out of the way for me. Heard the Italian food was good. The menu looks interesting. Not just a pizza place. Probably best to eat there when things open up.

I have always loved Alex's.
I moved to West Chester years ago but I still make it s point to pick up two pies whenever I'm in the area. Great service! Always call you Mr. Only pizza. Closest to roman style. Thin crust. I always get double sausage lite sauce and a regular. It really is worth going out of your way. Trust me!!!!

Solid option among the limited Chinese restaurants in north Meridian. Took a gamble after the varying reviews on Yelp. Ordered 6 dishes or so for pick-up and it was ready in 20 minutes. All 6 dishes were great. Very friendly service as well. I'll definitely be going back.

Been coming here for almost 7 years and it's pretty cool for a dive bar. They used to have live music and the space was a lot bigger but rented out areas to other bars and restaurants. Tuesday's are the best days to come because it's 2$ for all Wells, Wines and Champs.

I only come because it's closer to my house. The customer service is horrible and they rarely have things that I need durning holidays. The only location without self check out and the lines are always close to Walmart status. Winn Dixie needs to revamp this entire store from top to bottom.

The sweetest staff and a very clean environment. Having this shop on campus has definitely brightened up my late nights of studying. The usual self serve frozen yogurt shop, but they always manage to have the best flavors! Try blueberry and cake batter blended. You won't regret it.

loud, cramped, and slow service.... but the nachos are pretty good and it's a great dish to share late-night. The chicken quesadilla is delish-stuffed full and tasty. A table of four shared nachos and a quesadilla and were satisfied. Two dishes is also about all you can  fit on their tiny tables.

Located in a strip mall, you wouldn't immediately think that it would have decent food, let alone raw fish. You'd be missing out if you passed it up though, as the sushi is both tasty and affordable. The last time we were there, the service was so-so, but it was a busy night. The food is worth it.

Decent. it was exactly what I expected, no more, no less. The breakfast was there, and it was edible-not fancy, but it will do, and the place itself is close enough to Nashville to do anything you want, and far enough away that you aren't paying out the butt for a hotel downtown. I would stay again if in the area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Very big store with more variety than other supermarkets. The beer garden is a nice addition. I try to go on weekday mornings when it is not crowded because otherwise it is mobbed and they do not open up enough cash registers. The deli kiosk is another great asset.

Odd location but at the same time convenient to my job.  It's in the lower level of the Marriott but wasn't easy to locate.  Service was good.  Unfortunately, because of logistics I'm left waiting outside with people walking by asking for money.  At least it wasn't raining...Oh how I already miss my RAV4!

Came at 10:30pm on a Monday night. Sat for 30 min in a drive through, got to the window at 11pm and they we're out of burgers. Laughable but annoying to waste a half hour when you're hangry. Ahhhh whoever is running this is horrible! 



Sincerely a hangry customer.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Pros: Decent car wash, convenient, good price, free vacuums to use after. 

Cons: Always a looong wait, very popular spot. Also noticed that after we went through the bird poop we had on our car was still mostly there. Could use better scrubbing! And we didn't have the basic wash either, we paid $9 for the super.

Honestly I've tried this place a few times, and I'd like to say I'm ordering wrong but every time I order I get something new and it's just ok. The rice has no flavor and it's not bad but I honestly think Publix sushi has more flavor. 

They do have a good lunch deal, pick 3 different rolls with a soup or salad for $12.

It has a nice atmosphere and is definitely a must for all first visiting Bourbon street in NOLA.  Home of the hand grenades, all must try even if it's just once.  The barmaid claimed it was stronger than a Long Island, not sure though because I had both that night.  Very friendly staff!

So here's the sandwich about subway at congress. The customer service was great. They were out of the bread we needed. She recommended the garlic bread which was good. They got 4 and not 5 stars because they didn't take pride in-store it was a mess. Food all over the floor and bathroom hadn't been serviced.

Today's trip included for sandwiches and we ended up here because the one in Apollo Beach is closed. Only one person working working today so that made things go a little slow.  I will say despite the wait our sandwiches came out great and all the ingredients were fresh.

If parking doesn't shy you away this location is quite quaint it has enough little table seating outside and inside to allow for a great business meeting or a coffee with a friend.  Staff is pretty friendly and they  haven't got my order wrong yet so got to give it four stars for that!

Tonight's visit was awful every time I ask for something they told me they didn't have it no taco salad no chicken strips, no chicken sandwiches, no bottled water.  I guess it was pretty funny because I could hear the girls working laughing in the background I left too when I left without spending a dollar.

Great little spot to have fun at...the bar was nice and had some pretty creative drinks. The bartender was also very helpful on what kind of drinks to order. The place was suppose to close at 12pm but stayed open late for us. They also had a live band who played awesome jazz music.

Well its not the Magazine st location for sure. I had the smoked salmon, shrimp rolls and calamari. The rolls were dry I ate some & the calamari tasted like they were really those knockoff pork rectum rings but maybe that's just what they serve at happy hour. Regardless it was poo along with the service. I'll pass on this location.

Huge spot with a great casual atmosphere. Sadly, drink prices are a bit high.  Music is nothing special.  Bartenders are super attentive and quick. It doesn't get too crowded in here because the space is so large. I'd come here first then walk to Dragon's Den to end your night.

Never disappointed when I come here. During the evenings it can get busy but if you're okay with sitting at the bar it's first come first serve. 
Servings are HUGE! Food is delicious! No complaints this place is excellent all around. It's also pretty cool you're able to see the cooks making the food while you're at the bar.

I only stop here for coffee after racquetball.   (Sometimes 1/2 a donut).

Good customer service every time. 

 Small sitting area, and odd parking lot.

I don't care for donuts, so I can't say anything good or bad about them.  

Again, excellent customer service.

I do like these sort of car washes....what I didn't realize until it was too late, is there isn't a need to scrounge for quarters, or get $5 in quarters from the change machine.  Swipe your card, $1.50 minimum, and time is billed accordingly.  Machine shuts off at $10.00.  Eliminates frenzied dash to dump more quarters in.

This is my new favorite go to place for breakfast. 

Hello bagels!!!

They have tons of choices to pick from and they're huge! I was able to eat half for breakfast and half for lunch. 

I love the black tea. Some places brew their tea too strong or too weak. This place brewed it perfectly.

Awesome place. The only complaint was the novice server who seemed like she was in a rush to get me and my companion out of there. But I'd sop it up to her just not being a people person.  I was having too good of a time to complain. Everything else was awesome..
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I just stopped at Costanza's while running early for a doctor's visit nearby and am so happy I found this place. 

My daughter ordered an ice cream stuffed cotton candy snowball for us to share. The service was super quick and the snowball was fantastic.

Tons of syrup, and it was really tasty.  The ice cream was delicious too.

I got delivery and decided to change from my normal delivery spot. The sushi was phenomenal, my only complaint was the tempura was cold, which was only because the poor delivery driver had to ride a bike in the cold! Looking forward to actually eating at the location.

Found this place on Yelp. We liked that it was close to our hotel and it was open late. 

We ordered two bowls of ramen, #73, with pork broth. I asked for no corn and no soybeans, but I had a TON of corn in my bowl. Not happy about that. Overall the broth and noodles were good.

Went in for their signature drink, the Resurrection.  The bartender was blah and so was the drink, which came out of a frozen drink machine and tasted like blue cough syrup.  You can sit in the infamous barber chair but then one of the wait staff makes you take a drink out of their cleavage, no thanks.  Not coming back.

Was a great place to eat and still is after new management! Food was decently priced and made with great presentation but best of all it tasted delicious! I had the Enchilada with Rojas sauce. Service was a little slow but that could be because there was only one server and he was running food too :)

The parking situation sucked, but other than that, no complaints. I loved the brick walls & large windows in the room. It was easy to make a reservation pretty last minute. Check in/our was easy breezy. It was also decently priced. I also liked how close it was to everything. I was pleased.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Excellent!!!   We went without a reservation and they found a table for us in their tiny, no frills restaurant.    They make up for it with amazing food!!!    The homemade dipping oil-so good! I had alfredo with shrimp and Sun dried tomatoes.  He had a veal dish.   Honestly you won't be disappointed!

seems that the menu has changed and the prices have gone up- attendance is definitely down- this used to be a packed place and now that there are so many other restaurants opening not so many people are going to chili's. Ate there twice in Dec.- the menu needs more healthy options- and more perks to go there-

I assume this is the one inside the Mallinckrodt Student Center, opposite to the campus bookstore. I eat there about once every week. I feel like everybody at WashU eats here. At rush hours 1130~1:30 it takes 10 min wait or more. Other than that it's just a regular ordinary subway...

This location is my absolute favorite Starbucks! I am a coffee fanatic and this one provide consistently good coffees, excellent, fast service with a smile! I prefer to go through the drive-thru because I am on the go, I think it's fab! I will be going again!

Located inside Market at the Fareway,Tokyo Sushi is by far the best sushi restaurant in Chestnut Hill. The sushi is delicious and very fresh. The customer service is absolutely remarkable - they really do make you feel like family. I love coming here; it's very easy to order ahead by phone or through their new website.

Ok I've been to many diners around the US and there are 2 types clean fancy one and dives.  Well 3 coins is a dive, its DIRTY run down just a messy place. But so are a million other place. So yes I have eaten here more than one time and i would go back. They know who they are.  it's cheap decent diner food.

Had a three meat calzone here that was pretty solid. I came back and got a meatball sub here though and it was probably the worst is ever had. The meatballs looked and tasted like they had been reheated several times. Definitely go for the calzone instead.

My credit union. Been with them since 1987. They've always treated me well. Several cat loans, savings and checking, plus they are set up at several local events and always hand out free swag. Got a nice tape measure with gadgets at last night's food truck event.

This is not the place to go to if you're looking for a quality job. The basic wash is probably as good as the ultra. See photos-  either vaccum is bad or they didn't pay attention. Dash and console was also not wiped. Prices are really low, so if you need a quick lower quality wash this is good.

Miso soup makes miso happy, and so does Yokohama. They have good service and good food. There's only one pet peeve I have... When I'm sitting at the bar and my server is talking to my back. I personally think one of the chefs behind the bar should take my order. That situation is awkward.

Decent Chinese restaurant not too far from where I work.  I've been here a time or two for lunch, and I do like their egg flour soup.  Another big plus is that they have really good home-made hot mustard.  Hot mustard makes almost everything taste better.  Also, the service there is always great!  So yeah, this place is A-OK.

Came here with my mom and my sister. The inside is really beautiful- the lamps and lights especially. Perfect for a date night! We got the party platter E and it was a lot for three people. Sushi is generally pretty good, really unique new rolls I have never tried yet. The sashimi is soft and fresh. Highly recommend.

This is a gem of a Chinese Carry-Out Restaurant!

I went here last night with my cousin and this is his favorite/local chinese place. The good was good, and the service was very friendly.

I had Sesame chicken (the dinner combo), and it was fresh. No complaints... and I've eaten my share of Chinese Food.

Nothing fancy, no frills kind of place. Cheap tacos, margaritas and beer. The brisket tacos are pretty good. Food comes out pretty fast. Two negatives: You have to request and pay for salsa and no baby diaper changing station in the bathroom. So like I said - keep it fast, in and out and you won't be disappointed.

Download perka app for loyalty  card. If you scan your QR code on your receipt it will keep track of your purchases. Typical yogurt place with great selection. Plenty of seating. I personally think they need more cereal toppings.....hint hint fruity pebbles . :)

Oh my god this place is amazing! The people are so incredibly kind and made us feel so welcome!! We loved it here and loved the atmosphere. They have cheap drinks as well as great company. We will definitely be coming can here when we visit New Orleans!! Loved it!!

Not the greatest but I guess I'll take it being in the middle of nowhere. 

First of rice is too crumbly, although seasoned better than average for America. Fish is cut too big for the portions of nigiri and in a rectangular manner which isn't great, also portly prepared and no wasabi under the fish.

Overrated? I think so. It's good but it is nothing to write home about. I got their oatmeal and a chai tea latte. Meh. Also most of the people there were quite rude. Not the staff, the customers. I feel bad for their poor staff having to deal with those people every day.

Stopped at Koi Saturday 3-8-14 and ordered chicken Tempura, Shrimp Roll, Avocado Roll, a Steak Roll (good), and Miso Soup all to go.  Wait was about 15 min, all packaged well and very tasty.  Took it home and had a nice meal with a pretty lady as well as seeing a good movie.

Don't go! Worst experience ever. Staff was not knowledgable. pick up date promised 2x and dont have yet. Spoke to Manager there, RUDE. Dr. Stopped to teach tech how to work on glasses 3x during my appt. Not cheaper even with my coupon than anywhere else. I would suggest to book your appt elsewhere.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I have to say i think i loved the atmosphere more than i liked the food.  Staff was nice but very slow.  I was very sad a disappointed with the tamales very mushy and no flavor.  Food was good and the presentation of the food was picture perfect and i might give it a try again later.

Nothing to experimental or avant garde. Bare essentials Italian in a fantastic location off Rittenhouse Square. Jam packed at 8PM on a cold Saturday. Conditions at the bar can be a bit tight and having a conversation can be challenging given the acoustics.

I had an ok experience here. To me it was just another nail salon. I've been in twice. Once to have some gel polish removed and the other to get a pedicure. 

The place wasn't anything to write home about. Service was just ok. Though both times as a walk in I was seen immediately and didn't have to wait.

Eat here. Don't ask any questions, just go! The fish is fresh, sweet potato fries are cooked to perfection and the crab bisque was amazing. The beer selection will please everyone. The service was friendly and efficient. Whether looking to hang at a the bar or enjoy the dining room, this place will make your stomach happy!

AMAZING sushi rolls, horrible service!

I had to ask to be seated after 15 minutes, ask for menus, ask for water, ask for refills, ask for the check, bring the check to the server so she would ring us up, and we even sat at the bar not a table. Lol

I'm so confused as to why it took 1hr for 3 rolls

I have only been here once. My girl had a slight cough (not kennel cough) and I wanted to make sure she was ok. The visit cost a little over $100 and I got some cough syrup and antibiotics. It was pretty simple. The people there were nice. I also like that it is connected petsmart.

Love our server Sara.  Love the wine selection.  One the few places I can get fresh pasta.  Tonight my pasta (Bolognese) was too aldente for me.  My husband's short rib was unacceptable.  NO short rib should ever need a knife and the ravioli was way under cooked.  Disappointed in our date night.

cool bar as i believe theres multiple locations. i got 2 shark attacks. love how they make it. $10. not too bad. love the decor. most people had the hand grenade. one time i was in there there was only like 4 people in the place. honestly id come back. the service wasnt too great butof corse when i tipped the guy said thanks lol

What!? A Starbucks across from CC's?  And they are open till 9pm when CC's closes at 5? Interesting choice to make! The interior is beautiful and it seems there is an entrance from outside and also the lobby of the main building.  Great views of Poydras from the window and it looks like there is lots of seating.

Safe, clean, easy access to I65. Lounge area in room doubles as lounge and pull out couch. Strange bathroom door design. The commode and shower are in a separate space. The door barely closes past the toilet so you have to step between the shower/ toilet to close the door.  Certainly no wasted space!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Just finish dinner here. Was seated promptly and received food in decent time. Ordered the Shrimp enchilada. It was ok, tolerable, but not the best I've had. My enchiladas shell were bland tasting and had a HUGE mound of uneeded Lettuce on top. The vibe is kinda blue collar -ish, not fancy, but decent.

I am not a beer snob but I like it at WOB. They let me sample all the draft beers so that I am happy with my decision. No food, but you can bring something in from neighboring restaurants. Music is loud, so it is hard to have a conversation. WOB is clean and they do like to support local charities.

I like to take the #TampaTrio here for lunch occasionally. We all get the buffet, though I only eat the salad. Wish it wasn't Iceberg lettuce. Kids love their pizza. We can eat lunch for under $30 for the 4 of us. I like the buffet because we don't have to wait, and who wants to wait when you have hungry Irish Triplets??

Great restaurant! I went here for happy hour recently. Beautiful restaurant and bar. Happy is allowed anywhere in the restaurant (4:30-7pm). They have some $5 sushi rolls and drink specials. All were great and the fish was very fresh. The regular menu looked great, i look forward to returning!

Like any coffee place, this should be judged based on the quality of the coffee. Though slightly priceir than starbucks the quality, taste of their fresh brewed coffee is simply delicious. One morning cup wakes up me and keeps me going all day. 

The delawares best rating says a lot about the coffee this place has.

I ordered the Farmer's Market pizza, and it looked amazing. Unfortunately it was drenched in the lemon oil that's listed as one of the ingredients, so much so that it was difficult to eat. Not sure I would come back after this experience, though in theory the place is amazing.

I went to O'sake twice within just 2 days this week! Must give them 4 stars out of 5 for the excellent service, super lovely and caring staff, fairly good rolls, lovely decor and warm vibe.
I'm a Sushi snob, so I must say even though I enjoy their food, their rolls ar very much Americanized.

Honestly, the sushi here was not very good quality. The salmon was definitely old and tasted pretty bad. When I quietly brought this to the attention of the owner they feigned surprise at first and then promptly took it off my bill. Can't say I would recommend this place to anyone interested in fresh sushi.

Barista crew is efficient and polite. If you come here during the day, expect tables to be taken up by McEwan students and business meetings. Not a lot of seating, but a nice space none-the-less. Large windows let in a lot of natural light, which makes this location welcoming.

Staff are awesome and are efficient at what they do best! I've never had a poor drink from this location. 

The cafe is usually pretty full, as is the outdoor seating. I see a lot of regulars here on a daily basis. The cafe is in good order, and the condiment bar is well kept considering how busy this location is.

Service is good. I had high expectations from the high reviews, but the food is really mediocre. We had the chirashi and the hamachi don. The fish wasn't the freshest. The miso soup and salad were unmemorable. The only plus about the place is that the service is pretty good.

The pizza is amazing. Amazing enough that that's the only thing we get when we go there. Service was nice, and it was cost effective as well being BYOB.  I would probably try their pasta dishes some time in the future, but looking at my fellow diners, the pasta dishes don't seem that impressive at all.

Typical Japanese restaurant opened by Chinese people. I went during lunch and will not be back. The food is very meh. The fish isn't the freshest, and the rice was under seasoned. I'm not too sure why this place has such high reviews for mediocre food, but then, I realized that there aren't many choices in the area.

A nice full bar located inside of the Kimpton Hotel. It is decently sized with plenty of seating and an area to play pool. They are fully stocked with all of the yummy basic liquors to make your cocktail of choice. The drinks are a little bit pricey, but the service is good and atmosphere is nice while staying at the hotel.

Ordered the veggie delight salad for $5.  I asked for more spinach in lieu of lettuce.  Nothing special, just a quick healthy reasonably priced lunch close to the airport.   I knew if I ordered a sandwich my wife would frown upon my poor decision on how I allocated my daily carb intake.

Incredibly cute place and I was not able to spend much time inside, but I was unimpressed with the coffee offerings themselves. Plus- none of the baked goods were vegan, so points are lost automatically. 

I could see myself working in the upstairs loft if I lived closer though.

Service great. Building and decor very mod and nice. Pizzas really good, especially the one with honey. Gnocchi a little over cooked. Some of the pasta dishes were overly salted. The portion of the pasta served is just right....you can easily get an app or side AND pasta and not have sooo much left over.

Went here tonight and had a very nice experience. Mark the sandwich artist made us a couple of very good subs and was very efficient. I wanted to tip him to learn that the owner decided not to allow this. I hope they are paying a reasonable rate. Mark deserves it!!

Their food is always fresh and hot.  It's good fast Chinese food.  They are so friendly and my kids love going there to talk to them. In the 3 years we have ordered from them they have only missed part of our order one time and immediately took care of it for us.

It's just an airport bar, so I rate it against other airport bars, which almost universally suck. This place was just adjacent to my gate, and it had live music and alcohol, both significant pluses in my book. We had a couple of appetizers that weren't bad but not something I would think about returning to.

Friendly, great food, huge portions, though you could wish for a cleaner environment - it's basically just not that kind of place. I always get the Pollo Asado, which seems to change a bit depending on what day you go. Sometimes there's sour cream in it, sometimes there isn't. I have no idea why. Too dry without it, though.

Didn't get a chance to order food but my Giant Patron Margarita was just ok. The service wasn't all that great but we were with a lot of people. I wouldn't advise coming here on weekends, it gets a little out of control, may give them another try on a weekday the next time I'm in town.

Loved the food! I was worried about the service, since I read lots of reviews that said it can be bad. I must say it was a perfect night! It was a full house and the server got our food our fast.  The dancing roll was one of my favorite roll.  Great deal, good food, and great company equal a great night. I can't wait to go back!

I was a little skeptical after reading some of the reviews. But after ordering I am very impressed! We didn't know it, but we walked in only  a few minutes to close, which I know is a big no no.  the guy was really nice to order and it didn't take long at all. Might make this a Thursday ritual!

Pretty average place. I had to wait quite a while for a car even though I reserved in advance for one. Guy I think I got a free upgrade because they were out of the car I had booked. Friendly people here though not he most efficient. Pretty good prices too.

They have a very limited craft beer selection, it's kind of disappointing. Their growler station is the only thing really going for this liquor store.

They also have very limited hard liquor options- and their prices are kind of high in my opinion. They have a lot of main stream beer.

Ugh! This DD sucks. They mess up a regular iced coffee...

Plus. I have a breakfast sandwich coupon in the drive thru. They not only didn't put the sandwich in the order but they kept my coupon.. We had to pull back around to get the sandwich. We order a ham breakfast sandwich and they gave us ham on a bagel... No egg or cheese.

Huge potions, lax dining experience, and quality sauce. The pizza here is eh, but their pasta dishes and just about everything else on the menu (salads too) are on-point. Try the chicken parm; you get two HUGE pieces of chicken that nearly fall off the plate they're so huge!

I've been coming here for a few years now, and I live  in St. Petersburg, the drive is worth it. Dr. G definitely goes above and beyond. This place is great. Doesn't really have a great selection, of frames, so I've just upgraded my lenses each time. So the exam itself is the most important part for me.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
I ordered an egg and pork roll on a long roll. 

The roll was soft and chewy, great.

The eggs were too dense and overpowered the sandwich. There was also a sweet margarine type flavor spread around the roll that I found out of place.

The portion was generous. And the service was prompt and courteous.

Finally stopped in after driving by for years. I have missing out. Easily the best liver and onions I've ever eaten. So much food for the money. Fried okra was terrific as well along with Linda our server. The whole staff was great. Will be back soon to try the other menu items.

During my year of school I've been here a half dozen times. Lunch special options are decent... Food isn't anything special and the wait/ service is really hit or miss. The only "plus side" is that the food is freshly prepared so that means you're guaranteed a bit of a wait.

One of the few barbershops in Greenwood that cut ethnic hair. Walk ins are welcome, we had no wait at all.  Both my sons received fades, but I would have like to see more drop down in my older sons fade. Overall, ok experience. I will keep Main Street Cutz in mind if my barber isn't available.

Say at drive through too long with no acknowledgement from inside. Drive up to window while the girl with the headset on was stacking cups and having a conversation with her workmates. Gave us a glance and subsequently ignored us.  Drove away. I will not return.

sushi is about fish not what sauce can i put on the fish or fruit to cover up the fact that the sushi is nashville fresh. was it good yes have i had better yes. if u want to know if a place is truely good get some sashimi or nigiri. and no big lunch specials either

Adequate. A good bargain to jump on when they publish their 2 for $16 deal coupon deal. The pizza is average for the area, well prepared and not overly Americanized/greasy like Ardmore pizza and Boston pizza but it lacks the quality of brick oven or board walk pizza.

Love love love this idea... Can sample all the flavors you like, self serve.... Some interesting concoctions to come up with.  Pricey for me as I am a big sweet tooth guy, and it is weighed so have to be careful as it can get over $5 for a small "bowl" of deliciousness!

I love the vibe and location of this place. They had a lot of ice pops to choose from. The staff was also very knowledgeable on all of the flavors. I got the Nutella pop and it was pretty tasty. The only thing I wish they had was a dairy free option. Other than that I would recommend to most people.

Found this place on the way to the airport, stopped in for quick take out. The service was fast and friendly, we ordered breakfast sandwiches to go. The sandwiches were made with   Two or three fresh eggs and The ham and bacon were good. 
No complaints, would stop in again.

Generally a great store with lots of choices and mostly good staff.   I did not care for the service I received at checkout.   I like the fact that you can get gas here to cash in your points and that those points you just earned do show up on your card right away.

Can't help but come back for the pork sandwich.  It is consistently good and today it was amazingly large.  We also tried the meatball sandwich since the are store made.  This was also quite good but a little skimpy on the meatballs as compared to the pork sandwich.

It great to have another Starbucks in Delaware County with a drive through.   Went through today and got a VERY hot barista made drink in a reasonable amount of time.  This Starbucks replaced the cute quiet one up the road nearer to Rte 320 that shared the lot with the pretzel company.

Service was friendly enough but was told by my beer drinking friends that I definitely overpaid here for the Sam Adams 1/2 case that I bought.   Service was fine, parking is easy, and the location is convenient.   Be more informed about the prices here, if you are counting your pennies.

I have stopped here a couple of times in the past two weeks for coffee and to use the rest room as this is just off the NJ Turnpike at Exit 2.  
 The rest room was not clean and the coffee is tepid.  There aren't too many other choices between this point and the Commodore Barry Bridge so prepare accordingly,

Typical Dunkin' fare and decent service at the drive through....however trying to get here from 130 Southbound requires you to pass it an turn around to come back.  Access to the drive through from the north side is also challenging.   If you have choices, pick another location, if not be prepared for the goofy setup

Postage-stamp sized store with saccharine counter people.   Coffee was hot and fresh like the servers attitude.   If you are not a regular here, be prepared for the condescension.  No Philadelphia Inquirer to be had here.  Just the Daily Times.   The guy behind me wanted 25 munchkins and there were only two varieties available.

This place was alright! The service was friendly and timely and there were no problems with the food. I came in between the lunch and dinner service so it was pretty quiet, but still comfortable. I had no problems, but nothing made this place that special.

Sushi Yakari is the place to go for sushi now in Tucson.  Sushi Cho is still good, everyone else is OK.   Sushi Yakari is not the late Sushi Ten.  The owners of Sushi Ten are now in Chandler and it is called Sushi Ken.  They are located on Chandler Blvd about 2 miles west of I-10.

Very nice atmosphere and attentive service. I wasn't impressed with the food, it was just standard Italian. I got mussels over linguini with red sauce. The mussels themselves were large and great, but the sauce was a little bland. The tiramisu was dry and more like cake.

When we lived in Nashville, we used to drive 30 minutes across town to get their orchid vanilla sandwich at least once a week:  creamy white orchid vanilla ice cream with a yummy black currant jam center sandwiched between two incredibly soft, cakey, Paris-style almond macaroons.  It is every bit as delicious as it looks.

Thanks to the nearby methodone clinic, it dragged this place down. I used to come here frequently, but had many problems with the staff related to pricing, food quality, etc. I work out across the street and shake my head in disgust at the guests out front. I can't, just can't....sorry...I prefer starbucks anyway.

Came here cause I was in the area and noticed they had straw-ber-itas for $20 for a case, they were 8oz cans and the 16 oz cans were 36.50...I didn't deal with the staff much except ringing out but they were okay, it looked like they had a good selection of beer, I don't live in the area, so I don't know if I would return.

Your average local pizzeria / restaurant in a strip mall. Love that it is BYOB. Love the live music on  Saturday nights. Can't beat the friendly staff, low prices, and convenience of dine-in, take out and delivery. Check the website for their specials, always something to look forward to!

Hungry at 2am (for whatever reason)? Order from here. Conveniently located in the same parking lot of the local college dive bar Firkin Tavern. 

Rutgers-style 'Fat' sandwiches, as well as other munchie type food. Healthier options are also available in the form of 'Fit' sandwiches.

Note: Food does not taste as good sober.

I've been back twice since my fiance introduced me to this place...I'm adding another star from my previous review. So far I haven't had a better Iced Decaf Americano from anywhere else...it took me 2 additonal trips to figure it out, but hey better late than never.

I've been coming to Manny's since 2007, and have never been let down.  Being from north Jersey, I don't particularly love their pizza, but everything else is amazing.  Their homemade soups, sandwiches and Italian dishes are excellent.  Their garlic dipping sauce, which is also on their "Palmyra Cheese Steak" is out of this world!

Picked up pizza from here last night and we've had it a couple times before. This is one pizza that my kids love....they don't enjoy most pizza (apparently I birthed aliens instead of children) but my son bit into this and said "This is delicious." We had a 18" with pepperoni an bacon and it was very yummy!

First time here,  Tracy did a great job on my pedicure.   The nail salon is clean.  They take your temperature as well as have you complete a questionnaire; I feel that they have taken great measures to protect their customers from COVID-19.  
I would definitely come here again.

So the teriyaki meat sticks were burned
The won ton soup had chewy pork in them
The steamed dumplings  looked like a kindergartner made them, they were thick and the pork was terrible. 
Never again. The sweet and sour chicken over cooked. 
Just bad all around

4.0. Although not the largest car wash, it gets the job done.  We've gone to several car washes and when you leave your wheels are still not clean, etc.  My babe is glad to have the unlimited car wash service.  Take home message:  You truly get what you paid for and then some.

Clean, nice looking cafe. The staff is very friendly. Ordered the chicken and waffles and all I have to say is what are people thinking!  Everybody loves this dish except me. I just can't develope a taste for ck&waff. Oh we'll, at least I gave it a shot. Next time it's gonna be the huevos rancheros.

Nicos is one of my mandatory stops when visiting Tucson. I highly recommend the carne asada burrito or the ground beef taco plate and for breakfast the sausage breakfast burrito. 

The service greatly varies between locations. On this day I cam during their lunch rush and my order took about  10 minutes.

This is a pretty good place to get the occasional haircut but the price is a little steep for me personally. $25 for a haircut just seems a little much I guess those are the prices now a days. The hair cut was great quality though. I also loved the conversation !

Great store with decent prices! I love stores like this! There always seems to be a better variety of healthy options compared to "typical" groceries. I don't really like the location of this store though. The parking lot always seems to be hard to get in and out of.

Not a bad place.... decent food and selection of beers on tap. Service has always been OK, too.

The place seems to turn into a meat market during the late evening hours on Fridays and Saturdays, though. Just something to keep in mind if you're looking for a quiet hangout.

Idk if its just this location, but the scoops of ice cream (baskin robbins) are always very small compared to what they used to be. They are Less than half the size they should be. Also some of the staff are less than desirable. I went there on a holiday and I'm pretty sure they were all high.

When you are far from your neighborhood and your looking for that lighthouse Dunkin Donuts is it. 

They are everywhere on the east coast. So it might not be your daily location but it does in a pinch with the same items are your daily spot. 

Last spot before you get to i76.

Service performed in 1 day without a reservation (as usual). I have used this service for 35 years with multiple vehicles and have had good results every time. HONEST and will always repair rather than replace if possible. Very inexpensive for the work they do, as long as you bring in donuts when you pick your vehicle up.

It's ok....The employees don't appear very happy. The place is beautiful and very clean. My pedicure was good....not great.  A little overpriced for the pedicure itself. The massage chair is awesome though. I could take this place, or leave it. No real lasting impression, but they did a decent job.

Horrible service and my steak quesadilla was so soaked with gravy the steak just kinda mushed up when you ate it we been waiting for over 30 minutes now while she is sitting at the bar talking with another worker in their phones! This is also my second time my quesadilla was horrible I will not be back

Eh. My friend had a groupon so we tried it out. It was just okay. There are so many much better and more reasonably priced sushi places in Indy. Two of our rolls came apart. It was kind of an odd atmosphere like a sushi joint/club. I wouldn't go back with out another groupon.

Best coffee shop in Fishers, hands down. Love their cold brew, their espresso, and everything. Wish they had some food options, but I get it. Where other places would have an extensive food menu, they have a hip clothing store. So if you know what you're in for, or if you're just looking for a great coffee drink, this is the place.

This place is just like every other House of Beer place I've been to in the area.  The beer is always good, and the staff is fun.  Good to sit by yourself or to bring a crowd.  The "outdoor seating" area leaves a little to be desired, but it works if you're not too picky.  Kat is a great bartender.

We ordered a thin crust supreme and it was delivered quickly.  We thought the crust was great and there were plenty of toppings.  This is my new favorite place when I want a great pizza. Its a little pricey if needed to feed a large crowd though.  The delivery was less than quoted, so that's a bonus.

Probably the worst sushi I've ever had worse than the sushi you get at a Chinese buffet my dragon roll tasted like a fried tuna fish sandwich, sent half of it to the trash and my miso soup was luke warm the service was good and the drinks strong gave it the 2 stars

Thanks for your excellent customer service Paris Jr.! Had to leave this spot a good review because the other reviews definitely do not do them justice. Quick and very polite service, didn't have my car available but upgraded me for the same price as what my original request was. Thanks so much!

My husband and I decided last minute to go out to eat at Bottos. It was very busy when we walked in and they were able to accommodate us which was a pleasant surprise. The atmosphere is nice and the severs and hostesses are very pleasant. Can't wait to come back

I am still looking for a good laundry to press my work shirts (tux) these people take almost 4 days cuz they send out maybe?  And the shirts are pressed over the buttons.i hate doing them myself but geez.also the arms were dbl creased on some of them..they will fix it for free but then i am leaving them and making an extra trip.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Tried the sushi rice bowl, which seemed a little more worth it than getting a tiny roll. The food was extremely fast, as it's a rainy day and less people were out and about eating lunch. The soy sauce mixture they give you to put on top was pretty good too.

Good vibe place, tasty appetizers and pretty cool location. The inside is a little run down, but I enjoyed the chicken parm and the fries. Quality sandwich with good amount of sauce and chicken and cheese, and the man who got me my order seemed really jolly and pleasant.

Not a great place for veggies or meat, but frozen food is alright. Check expiration date for anything you buy. Staff are quiet and not that efficient, so avoid busy days because lines will take 20+ minutes to get through. Hoping they read these reviews and understand they have room for improvement.

Not sure this qualifies as a piece of chocolate cake. There is about a 3/4 inch piece of cake at the bottom of a small slice, mostly made of chocolate cream or mousse potentially.  The Triple Chocolate Cake disappointed quite a bit, but can't say I knew what to expect, as I got delivery, so still had it for dessert.

We went to celebrate Cinco and was pleasantly surprised! 

Although busy, service was attentive and checked in regularly.  Good specials 

WHO KNEW they happen to have an amazing DJ??? Jeff Aspen played all, new and the best music we've heard in a long time.  Hands down could be enough of. Reason to go back!!!

The technicians were really nice but my gel mani is already chipping after 7 days. 
I just had a gel mani using the same product (OPI gel) at a different location in Conshy and jt lasted 3 weeks. 
It seems like is was applied too thick. I'm very disappointed.

Easy to get to, cheap and great food. What more do you want? 
Surprised that this place isn't busier. My husband works at the casino and occasionally they bring a food truck over. He is a great fan of their burritos and insisted we go try the actual restaurant. Glad we did. We've been going ever since.

I went to Lolita before the renovation works, when it was BYOB. Lolita 2.0 is amazing.
The new Lolita design is both warm and modern. The menu is right on point, with classics like the queso fundido which was awesome. Margaritas are very tasty, on the lighter side though.
Service was perfect.

The drinks are 10$ the cheapest but they are worth it. I couldn't decide what I wanted so I did bartender's choice, which was a great decision. He made me a Mexican trial by fire (I think that is what it is called). The only problem I have is that you cannot bring food from Reilly's downstairs.

I'm not that big of a fan. I had the chocolate and I don't know if it is because it is yogurt, but the chocolate tasted off. Like a little fruity/tangy. And the selection of toppings is limited, what place doesn't have peanut butter sauce!?!? Also, the service could be a little nice and not on her phone so much.

3 stars and NOT because of the ice cream, because of the slowness.  Its a bunch of young high school / college kids who have no desire to move fast or care people are waiting 10-15 minutes when their is NO line.  Ice cream is great, service needs work. Hire an adult to supervise please.

Good as advertised.  Came in here on a Saturday afternoon with my wife.  Cozy / Clean place.. had lunch, the fries are homemade an AMAZING and my wife loved her omelet and salad.  Everything was super fresh and not even THAT highly priced for the quality.  Nice bar, good wine list....good place, will return.

Went here for dinner tonight with my wife.  Its a decent place, inside is nice but borderline generic, but hey its a pub. Food was good no complaints at all.  Had onion rings for appetizer and the stuffed burger with seasoned fries. This place wont blow you away but its worth the money.  For two of us it was only $32.

If I had their food catered elsewhere it'd get 5 stars. But when you dine in and bat at flies only to look down and see dead flies on a sticky floor you can't help but wonder what the kitchen looks like. Not to mention the teenage daughter who seems bothered by your existence. 
Invest in some ambience and you'll do great :)

Went here two nights in a row because they had decent drink specials ($3 bloody mary's and margaritas on Sundays) and we were staying nearby. The room stank like vomit and excrement and the service was pretty bad. Go elsewhere unless you don't have a choice.

I was really surprised by this place. Is this the most amazeballs Chinese food that I have ever had? no. Is this incredibly delicious, fresh, and inexpensive take out with overly friendly service?  ABSOLUTELY.  Yes the building could use some updating, but so could my house.  The food doesn't disappoint and that's what matters.

One of my favorite restaurants to go to. Everything on the menu is delicious even the cocktails. I love the way they cook the pork belly. The atmosphere is pretty chill and welcoming. Rustic decor which was beautifully done. Fair price for the dishes and drinks for the South Tampa area.

this place has great food and lovely presentation. The sushi is fresh. The ambiance is a bit run down. My biggest complaint is the price. This place is very over priced. Plan to spend 30.00 a person without sushi.  (15.95 for teriyaki chicken, 3.00 soda, and an appetizer)

We were very disappointed in this new place to eat downtown. Very nice inside. But food was not good, service very slow. And at the end of our bad Lunch, for some reason they could not run our credit card, so had to pay cash.
Stay away from this place. Prices high and food not worth it. I feel they well be out of business  soon.

Outside of more grease than I like, the pizza is really tasty, the ingredients very fresh, and the environment clean and inviting. I am rarely in Conshohocken, but was pleased to stumble upon this place when I needed a very quick bite that my 7yo nephew would eat. He tore the pizza apart, so I guess that is a good sign.

Easy, tasty, inexpensive pizza!  What more can you ask for? Is there better pizza in Nashville, yes, of course, but their pizza is good!  It's balanced well and not chain-like.  Plus, it's right by Kroger so it's super convenient!  Their wings are pretty good too!

The service we received was lacking. Our waitress was nice but preoccupied with everything else besides us. Took her 10 mins to bring straws. However the pizza was delicious. Comparable to the brick oven pizzas Ive had in NYC. Will definitely return....but probably for carry out.

The people are very friendly and the food is cheap and comes in great portions. I'm giving it three stars because it's nothing extraordinary but i still enjoy it quite a bit! If you live in the area and are looking for something cheap and easy on your way home then i suggest Chow Express.

Surprisingly nice inside, and I felt waaaaay underdressed in jeans and a collared shirt. Everyone was in slacks. Mostly older people. Food was excellent. Price was higher than normal, but it's a small restaurant, and hey it's Eagle so everything is spendy. My buddy had the "opa" (?) fish and it looked amazing.

I'll give it a solid 3 for the people. I went there to play an open mic and thought *for sure* that it wasn't my crowd and that I'd get spit on or something.

Instead, they were very inviting and complimentary. The atmosphere is working class Sunday night drinkers.

This is the best sushi in the Tampa Bay Area. I have been here more times than I can count and have never had a bad experience. The sushi is fresh and everyone is so friendly. The wait times are outstanding I have never waited more than fifteen minutes for my sushi from time of order to table.

Stumbled into Jeni's one evening and what a pleasant surprise. I ordered the mini combination with 3 half scoops that really were enough for me and a great way to taste 3 different flavors. Now looking forward to returning to taste more of the creative flavors.

This is a pretty small location with only 4 or 5 tables. It's a popular spot for locals, so if you go around lunch time there will be a bit of a wait. They do a good job with making sandwiches and salads, though, even when they are pressed during the busiest of times.

I'm not a donut eater, but my daughter is sure enjoying her chocolate donut. Nice sunny little shop with a really friendly guy working the counter. They have a bacon maple donut that I'm surprised my daughter didn't want to try considering her love for bacon and donuts. We will be back.

Sandwiches and burgers are great and on par with a nice restaurant.  But, on a clear day there is few places better to go to for a nice quiet lunch!  The green fairways leading to the ocean and island views are why we live here and this place is a gem for a quick work lunch get away or just a treat for yourself.

I order food from here twice...They gave us plenty to eat and it looked very good...  The first time the food was ok but the last time the food was bland, tasteless and dry... I don't understand why there was such a difference between my first order and the second... 

I will say that the staff was very friendly...

Casual eatery with a pretty vast menu in Exton. Had lunch here on a wedding weekend a couple of weeks back. Service was excellent the food was very good. We sat outside and enjoyed the fountain nearby. Certainly a reliable place of you want to grab a bite when in the area.

Easily scheduled appointment. Quickly chose and had tires installed. Good selection. Ordered tires come quickly. Reasonable prices, be sure to review your bill though they like to add warrantee packs you may not want. Friendly, prompt, and professional. Overall very satisfied.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
It's been a while, perhaps even a year now since sushi Nami opened. We have become the "best customers" as per the owners, but there is a reason. 

Consistently well prepared, fresh and creative food. The service is good and if you are looking for a great Japanese meal (cooked or raw), stop in to check them out.

I ordered a chicken quesadilla because i had heard they were good from this small little taco stand in the Westbank.  The wait was a little bit long but the quesadilla itself was quite good.  I wouldn't go out of my way to visit this place but if you're in the area I would stop by.

This was my first time here.Great location. Nice ambiance.. Loved the outdoor dining. The entrees were a bit pricey. The tomato sauce was a tangy in my pasta dishes. Pizza was good needed more cheese. Server was very attentive. My drinks was always filled.Was very helpful in suggesting some dishes.

The slowest Starbucks i've ever been to.  Got trapped in the drive through line and it didn't move at all for 10 minute increments all up to the front.  Probably half an hour in that line for some latte that took 10 seconds to make.

Some days they are quick, most days they are slow as hell.  My advice is to just preorder.

i have eaten at their location on the boulevard and it was good but had odd hours, this locatuion however is more conventional hours, everything is good ( don't like sushi ) but the meals they prepare are to die for, prices are reasonible and service is quick, love it to death !

Walked in and I noticed that the shelves are kinda low in stock. Not sure if the stock have not arrived or the shelves haven't replenish with new stocks but the Vodka section was low in selection. 

The clerk was great and that was the most important. The good things is that you walk in and out of the place.

Yes. Yesssss. Yaaassssss.
Praise the holy Taco Jesus.
Yes! 
This might not have been the Best Tacos I've ever eaten my my life, having hailed from Santa Ana and all its beautiful taco trucks, but this was the best meal I've had since coming to UCSB.
1000/5 would recommend this place.

Rittenhouse market has some great produce and products.  if you're in a bind and need something quickly and your in the area it's a great place to shop.  I would never use it to get all my groceries because everything is extremely overpriced. Extremely friendly stare out always helpful.

I don't know why you make an appointment than have to wait. You make an appointment to avoid having to wait. This will be my last time going to Optical Outlet. A completely inefficient business that does not realize people's time is valuable.My mistake not sticking with LensCrafters.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: So, I stopped in on a Wednesday afternoon around 2:30 for a late lunch. The place was clean but the order boards seem totally out of wack. It was hard for me to find the different sandwiches listed. The guy behind the counter was pretty rude and unfriendly. I probably won't be going back but the food was fine.

oh my gosh! this place was a total blast! some of the clientel were questionable... The typical dbag, drunk, handsy type... but the music was awesome! total early 2000s music along with some recent pop. The drinks were good and decently cheap and the bartenders were nice and quick. Had a total blast dancing the night away!

If your only reason to go to a bar is beer, then this is the place to go.  If its food you're looking for, go down the st to Watkins eatery, or over to Passyunk for the many bars with food there...evidently this place is a throwback to the beer and shot bars of the 50s, albeit a better collection of beers...

Rizzios is a fine competent repair shop...have used him for years on inspections and he's fast and honest...needed to replace a windshield and his charge was not significantly higher then if I had gone directly to a glass replacement center...same on a rear light for my wife's car...great local business to support

We had a great visit when Chewy and Jugs hosted our friends' wedding. The hosts set everything up well, and the evening was well orchestrated. I'm not into the bar scene but I liked how classy they made the wedding. 

It seems like a good place for a drink and some grub.

I wish this location had a drive thru, but it is fine walking in. The employees are always nice. I wished my drink had a little more syrup in my iced coffee, but it was still good. I enjoyed my hash browns and turkey sausage, egg, and cheese sandwich on an English muffin.

They have an online ordering system which is great. The prices are okay, pretty standard. The food was good. Not amazing, but pretty solid! The delivery man gave us our food and also accidentally handed us someone else's order on top of it and we chased after him to hand it back.

The employees were okay, they were nice enough, but not overly friendly. They took a solid 15 minutes to prepare my meal (everyone else who ordered, both before AND after me) received their meals. Tables were okay, slightly dirty, doesn't look like anyone cleans the tables off in between customers. My chicken nuggets were hard.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: New Great Clips in town! Located in an up and coming area in Wesley Chapel! Right across the Tampa Outlets and next to some great restaurants! New facility filled with friendly and really professional hair stylist!!! Would recommend to anyone looking for a new look with superb service!

The only thing I like about this place lately is the food. Can't drink coffee and I used to love their Chai tea until they changed it to Orpha!!! It's awful!!!

The staff really needs to be on top of cleaning tables and emptying the trash cans. They're consistently overflowing. So sad. This used to be a beautiful location.

Great food and great service.  We've been coming to Cancun for years and it's always good.  The food is always fresh and tasty and the staff is always very attentive.  For me, fresh chips and salsa are critical to a good experience at a Mexican restaurant. The chips and salsa are always fresh and plentiful.

This place has a good variety and my grandson and wife love it for the wide variety of flavors they have.

Nice ambiance and plenty of seating both indoor and outdoor (when it's so hot that the yogurt melts before you can eat it).

I'd suggest this place to others and keep going back to get more.

Great spot to spend a couple days in the Tampa area. Lower rates than some local hotels, close to everything, bar is open late and they have warm cookies for free!

Rooms are a little out dated, but comfy and the staff has always been too notch. I would recommend a stay here if your looking for something in the area!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This was my first time coming here. It's just OKAY for me. I ordered a grilled chicken club wrap. It was pretty good. Service was good. The fusion of wraps, subs and Asian food is just a little weird for me. I don't see myself coming here often. It's not a bad restaurant, its just not my taste.

This is an awesome place if you like crew cuts and those type of hairstyles back from that era. When it comes to new hairstyles that are in with the current times they don't really know the terminology or how to cut those styles of hair. If you like crew cuts and if your over the age of 50 this you will really like this place.

The Hawaii Roll is sooo yummy!  It's tuna topped with snow crab and mango.
I always order a crunchy roll. They have the best in the city! 
Their snow crab salad was delicious. It's a generous portion. I love the avocado that comes with it on the side. 
The service was amazing. The food came out pretty quickly.

The inside of the donut shop was closed. So we decided to wait in the drive thru line. I was pleasantly surprised that the line moved incredibly fast. The service was A+. 
There are so many varieties of donuts to choose from. You can choose your own dozen to make. 
The glazed donuts are served super hot and yummy.

Their happy hour is great from 4-7pm, $5 margaritas and drinks. The lime frozen margaritas are strong so beware, the chips are ok but their complementary so what would you expect. The atmosphere is good, not to loud and plenty of space. Do yourself a favor, if going for happy hour get there early.

Maybe I came on a super busy day, but service was a little slow
But this place unique in a quiet part of time, decor is fun with a lot of TVs playing sports
Rolls are Suzanne, they have all you can eat, and miso soup is serve yourself, so you can make it however you want, also make sure to use yelp for free sake while you're here!

Lunchtime yes! Dinner time ok... we still love Scorched Earth - Miso Soup - Baked Green Mussels- Tempura Shrimp & Veggie Appetizer (size) During lunchtime parking might be packed but worth the wait for the space . Noise level is moderate- food is consistent & service is good.

Still 4 star worthy. I came inside tonight and got ice with the kids. Service was friendly- prompt & overall worthy of the 4 stars. I've came on other occasions too through the drive thru & admit on peak times there might be a delay. This location is very convenient to me & I definitely would come back!

Dine in is fast -friendly- accurate &  they bring the food to you!  This is a very busy McDonald's but nice. Dining is modern & clean (without  TV). Noise level is low to moderate & I rate it 3 stars because of over price / quality of food. If you're in the mood for McDonald's this location DOES serve breakfast ALL day.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The sign says 24 hours on Friday & Saturday but the manager is too lazy to serve food. He and his employees hang out inside but don't come to the window. Happens every weekend. They refuse to serve us. Terrible location and the GM should fire the night crew.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Dash Cleaners is a small dry cleaner located in the Publix shopping center. They offer same day service but I believe you have to drop off early in the morning to pick up same day. Otherwise, I normally get to pick up after 5pm the following day. Always consistent with quality and customer service!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: You know....I have been going to this Wendy's for two and a half years.     I some times buy the homeless people in the area a meal....and I have to commend the manager....she never charges me.    I go there to get dinner often, and I have never had a bad experience with them.   I love the food and it is HEALTHY and tasty.

It's not Garces. It's a nice place to get decent food but you'll walk out with a more-than-it's-worth bill. Tacos that cost $3 in South Philly at 3x the price for same quality.  Ceviche so drenched in citrus that the fish merely serves as a cracker. Interior is very nice, service very good.

Got in for a mani / pedi right away. Started soaking my old gel off my nails while getting my pedicure. Decided to get a regular manicure this time around. The salon was clean and staff professional. Was disappointed at the end when I was charged $5 extra for gel removal. But satisfied with my overall results.

ARE YOU KIDDING ME!!!!!! I've been sitting in their drive thru a total of 20 minutes. Why have I never learned my lesson about this DD.. I do not know. But after today I will never be back again. People have to go to work... don't have time to be sitting in a drive thru for 15/20 mins

Just came here after work at 8:50pm and all the lights were off and the employees inside cleaning.... I pulled up to the drive thru and no one answered. So the I went to the front to check the hours and it says they are still open. The employee saw me and completely ignored me. I will be corporate tomorrow

Yeah. This was my 2nd visit. My teen daughter loves this place. I just can't do it. While the all you can eat sushi sounds like a dream, it's just not great. My rolls were lukewarmish. The other menu items remind me Golden Corral meets college dorm. Service was super attentive and the pineapple coconut ice cream was really good.

What can i say other than horrible service, ill prepared entire staff and shocking how on a Saturday and Saints opening wknd with perfect weather them being open is an after thought. 
Would be good for the owner to maybe show up every now and then to see the ship sinking so pathetically. 
DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME GOING HERE!

I love how traditional the food is here. As a college student myself would think that the price is a little too high but I think it's worth the money. Menu doesn't have much fluff in terms of having different varieties of sushi. Totally recommend this place!

I don't normally frequent corporate places such as this.  However a cup of coffee was in need and this was the lesser evil. 

These guys are amazing.  Friendly. Funny. QUICK!  Wes, Patrick, Tyler, Mark, Sheena were all awesome!  Come visit.  I sure will next time I am over here.

This Winn Dixie isn't so bad. I treat it like a large convenience store...you don't want to grocery shop there, but it's ok to run in and get things you need.

I hate to say it, but Winn Dixie is just hood anyway. I don't know why anyone expects much more from them.

Really bad lunch time experience. Was served by Maggie, she lacked the customer service skills, I figured this restaurant would look for in its employees. We were neglected and it took our food forever to come out on a not so packed day. Food wasn't good enough to balance out the poor service

As Shelter has recently opened in downtown Reno, I did expect more specials and gimmicks. Nothing. The place is kinda hum-drum, but I'm optimistic that it will improve. I go there on Monday Nights to place cards against humanity. The place is big enough to hold our ever-evolving group.

I stop in to get a drink and nuggets. Why does McDonalds allow people to bring their dogs in? Nothing is worth seeing an animal relieve themselves where I'm trying to eat.  If the animal doesn't qualify as a service animal or an emotional support animal, then keep them out. Some folks are allergic.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The place was ok, tables could have been a little more clean. Staff was friendly but a little unorganized.  My coffee was extremely hot, I had to put a little ice in it to drink it. Hash browns were a little on the cold side and my sausage mcmuffin was nice and warm with cheese melted. Free WiFi is a plus.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The food was good but when we sat down at the empty bar around 7:45 pm to eat our meals, the bartender gave us our check. I've served before and know this is not the move to take. We changed our mind on ordering more drinks/food after feeling as though they wanted to rush us out.

Had some decent breakfast sandwiches here in the past, but the half frozen donuts I got today were simply unacceptable! I'm not mad that they get the donuts frozen, but at least give the customer a room temperate donut! Who wants to bite into an ice cold donut?!

Food was great and so was the service. Our server JJ was knowledgable and friendly. The hamachi sashimi app was delicious. We also had 5 rolls and every single was one was fantastic. Finished off with some mochi, which you can never go wrong with. I was impressed this location and will be back

I was really hoping Enzo's was going to be one of those surprise awesome CS places. The waitress service and CS presentation on a real plate kept my hopes high. Everything went down hill from my 1st bite. I liked the mushrooms, onions and being able to watch TV.

Nice little place with hard-working people. $13.25 after taxes for a 16-inch cheesesteak.I would rather a 12 inch roll with the meat pack in then the same amount of meat spread across a 16-inch roll.  My rider really like the Abruzzi.  The Pizza and specials looked good.  Good overall experience.

Five stars for Pinkberry, always! I like the original yogurt with fruit toppings. If you have ever tasted Vietnamese yogurt, the original kind of tastes like that! Yummy. Pinkberry is a bit pricy compared to other frozen yogurt places though; it's also not a "serve yourself" kind of froyo shop, they employees make it for you.

This is now my favorite place to buy my wine and spirits! I love the fact that they have tastings. I do wine they had more than 1 sweet wine on tap though. So I tasted and I liked it! I got 2! I went on a Saturday afternoon it was fully staffed and everyone was super nice.  The prices aren't bad either.

I signed up for the unlimited car wash. This was a great decision that I get reminded of every time I come here. It's only $50 per month and I believe the wash I use it for is$20. 

Staff is friendly, management seems to do a great job!

I highly recommend J's Car Wash!!

Music and atmosphere was awesome! Oysters were the size of a dime I kidddd u not, I saw a mother and baby roach not water bug the brown roach. Omg! The food was good I would go Bk but not sit at the to Roachy bar! Food is great might be roach batter right? Lol

The drive-thru was awesome this morning! Literally a dozen cars in front of me and I made it through in 3-4 mins.  The reason for 4 stars was my English muffin was a little too toasted around the edge but I always know I can get in and out on my way to work at this location. Great job!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: So good! I live in KOP but work in Phoenixville. King Chef Chinese is SO much better than any Chinese in KOP! Full of flavor, you get a ton of food and I get free wanton soup with my order every time. I will give it four stars because it can get a little pricey but the food itself is five star! So yummy!

I thought this place had zero atmosphere (but then again it is a carry-out joint) good pizza (it took them 20 minutes to whip up a small pepperoni and 'shroom pizza. It was greasy (but yummy). I thought $10.00 was a bit much for a small pizza but I guess the touristy nature of the area drives the prices.

1) carpet is sticky 2) didn't give us enough towels 3) phone doesn't work to call down to front desk 4) we asked them to clean our room five times, never happened 5) asked for sheets and blankets for the pull-out bed at least eight times, never happened. Don't waste your money here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Stopped in for a quick lunch. Got 2 sushi rolls and soup. It was definitely good!!! Just not mind blowing. The service was good. Ambiance/decor was above average but nothing special. I would come here again if I was in the area, but I wouldn't go out of my way to get here.

This is the best pizza place!!! Everything is good. They have a pizza called the bald eagle and it is buffalo chicken with American cheese and it is to die for. We get Grubhub from there and it is always delicious!!! Pasta dishes and sandwiches are excellent as well and big portions too. This place is awesome try it today!!!!

Good food and good lunch combos (about $10 each and includes rice, miso soup, and a few other sides).

Originally gave this place 5 stars based on the lunch combo price, but updated after getting their rolls.

If you're looking for rolls, I recommend Goleta Sushi House. Their rolls are about the same price but twice as big.

Ok I'm redoing my review simply because they're not honoring their yelp coupon. Why is it on here if it's not even valid. I've been coming here for a while and when I saw the coupon on yelp; like everyone else I wantes to take advantage of it. Get there to find out they won't honor it. Not cool

Had a great experience here.. I was driving from NJ to IU and my daughter and I stayed here overnight.  Nicest and easiest check in.  Great, clean, room with a view.   Did have to pay $30 for parking, but the location was great, we walked to dinner and all around the city parks, just beautiful and enjoyable.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: It's a great store. You'll get tempted by their lunch counter with its variety of hot meals, but know it's not good. Their salad area and deserts are awesome, however. Definitely check those out. They also sell a lot of organic/very nice prepared meals, some of them for also a decent price.

This is a wonderful haircut. Pat is a classic barber who does great, clean work. The price is fantastic as well- $16 plus tip is a real bargain for a reliable haircut. If he did straight razor for the neck and temples I'd give him 5* but that's a small detail.

Chinese take out is so similar from one place to another in this area. We go here because it is close to our house. The owners are alway very nice and really appreciate the fact you chose their restaurant over the many others. The food is  average Chinese.

Yum!! I'm in there at least once a week! Try the cookies and cream!

Lots of flavors (avoid the sugar free if you can) and tons of toppings. If you keep the serving size small and avoid the obvious toppings, it isn't horrible for you either.  Friendly folks too!
