It's just ok.. I haven't had the pizza everyone is raving about but pasta and sandwiches are ok. Not good, mind you.. ok. That's as good as I can offer for this ex-Pizza hut location which hasn't seen a paint brush or stitch of new carpeting since the early 90's.

Easy in, easy out and the cleaning was all done exactly as expected.  I've never asked for anything complicated though..

I love patronizing a small business. The owner doesn't say much but is always friendly and polite. I'm good with that.. who really wants in depth conversation with every service provider?? Give them a try!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: My fiancee is in love with this place - he loves their tacos and that it is super cheap. I'm not a huge fan of Mexican food, so for me it was just meh. That being said, though, the service was fantastic, and the food was super quick in arriving. Also, their guacamole was delicious and tasted very fresh.

In a downstairs grocery store - the ambiance is nothing to speak of, but they get your food out quickly. All of the dishes were quite good, but the standout was the baked salt wings. Great place to grab a bite to eat after work (lots of people seem to do this) or for takeout. Not really a dining experience, though.

The mall location tends to be pretty busy. Go sit at the bar and you can get pretty good service right away. They have a lot more options both food and drink wise then they use too. They are also very consistent on their output of food. It's not amazing food, but way better than other chains out there

Picky about my pizza. Also a purist when it comes to pizza. I want New York style, plain, with the right sauce and cheese combo and these guys do it right. Ok, it's a tiny place. No atmosphere. Maybe not even overly friendly but I don't go to a pizza joint to make friends. I just want to pick up a great pie. This is the place!

Oh. My. God. Yes!
Our favorite place for all you can eat sushi any day of the week!  Comes to about $25/per person.  It can definitely get busy on friday and Saturdays so expect a bit of a wait. So worth it!! 
Servers can be a bit inattentive and brash. Don't take it personal

The best! 

We've been going here for years and we're so happy to see them expanding their business and thriving. They now started doing hibachi, too! But I haven't made it over to just yet.
Their rolls and salads both usually very generous. And I thoroughly enjoy their hot tea

Personally I like this place way more than El Vez. I like that the atmosphere is a little cozier and its never really loud in there. Their menu is simple, but delicious. The desserts are out of this world! I recommend the tres leche. It literally melts in your mouth.

I don't get it. It's not good? I'm honestly surprised at the reviews. We ordered simply because it was nearby and convenient. The pizza tastes like cardboard. The crust had no real flavor to it at all. My friends and I were all completely unimpressed. I don't know what more to say than that. It's cash only - so remember that.

Simply fantastic!! Great assortment of homemade ice cream, reasonable prices, and the friendliest staff. I would recommend the Italian ice, trash can, or coconut almond and kahlua crunch side by side. We were on vacation and soooo glad to come across this gem. Please do yourself a favor and stop in if you're in the area!!

I went in with some friends for dinner but only got the apple pie. It was amazing! It has a crumble on top that is crunchy and sweet. I wish I could have gotten two slices but I think I paid like $5.00, after the a la mode lol. I don't know if we have one of these back home if so, I'll be there!!

It is a new location and it has the standard Starbucks' layout. I was just disappointed with the staff. The cash register,  a girl named Jessica with long dark hair,  was rude and had an attitude the whole time. They should be more careful with who they choose to hire for front of the house staff.

I am convinced that they caused the early death of my beloved dog. They misdiagnosed him for a very long time, and when they finally got it right, they were way too passive in their approach. They day he passed, I called them many times, and they insisted that we were doing all we could do for him. DO NOT GO HERE!

The staff upfront were friendly and respectful.  I, unfortunately, cannot say the same for the vet who met with me. His name was Rajesh Joshi. He had an extremely condescending tone. I was asking many questions regarding my dog's condition and he literally seemed annoyed that I was taking up his time. Horrrible  bedside manners!!

I'm not sure why this location has gotten such a bad rap. I just bought donuts and an iced latte from the drive thru, they moved people through very fast, were incredibly polite, my latte was well-made. My experience was fantastic so, if leadership has made a change, it's working!

Remodeled rooms are nice. The lobby and adjacent eating facilities need to be updated as it looks rundown and beat-up. The morning buffet area is not set-up very well and bottle necks at several places. Mainly because the serving area is in too tight of a space.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This gem ticks all the boxes for me, the dining room is intimate, romantic and has great lower lighting. The food is always excellent with many standards and interesting unusual options, love the champagne peach chicken and the service is always terrific!!!

We love Mexican food. Some things are very good, some are very "meh".  I am not sure what this place is missing, but we have no other Mexinan restaurants nearby, so we will still frequent the place. The food is always hot & fresh, the place is clean and the staff we encountered were all friendly.

Want to pay four times as much as any other store and be fleeced, well then head to Publix.  Thank goodness, ALDI, SPROUTS, WAL MART, TARGET, COSTCO and SAM'S club are all carrying organic products for much lower cost than Publix.  TRADER JOE's is also a good place to shop.

I came here one nigh to meet two friends for a drink. They ordered food, i did not, but I did have some of the cookies we got for desert. Those were great. We all got drinks that we enjoyed, and overall had a great time. Really nice atmosphere. I think it is probably overpriced, but overall it was a good experience.

We've had some decent meals at Cancun. We've also had a few misses. The Carnitas are usually pretty good. If you're craving Mexican, it's a pretty safe bet. You likely won't be transported to the tropical shores of its namesake, but it will probably scratch your itch.

Big, corporate and solid. The fact that it's attached to the arena is the big draw. In that it's worth going just to avoid the crowds. Other than that, it was nothing special. A clean bed and bath but not much more. 

Bottom line - Hampton inn is cleaner, but location, location, location!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Came in during my lunch break and ordered the General Tso's Chicken lunch combo. I chose to eat in and choice of presentation was quite nice. The chicken was tangy and crunchy and I really likes the pork bits in the rice. I was jonesing for some Chinese food, and so glad that Yelp led me here!

The only reason I'm giving three stars instead of four is because my order is consistently messed up here. I order beef and I get chicken. 

Their enchiladas with tomatillo sauce are clutch. The queso is tasty but don't order it for delivery. Overall decent place for delivery.

A cool dive bar in south Philly! Nice assortment of craft beer. The bartender didn't seem to know what a city wide was (a.k.a a shot and a beer special), but maybe they just didn't offer any . Oh well. 

I tried their signature $5 burgers here and they were very juicy and flavorful.

I live less than a mile from this Wendy's and their service is consistently bad. They're slow and it's rare that they get an order correct.  I like Wendy's, but I'm done with this one.  They've had nothing but incompetent employees in the ten years that I've been coming here.

I've been going here ever since I was a kid, and I'm proud to say this place still gives the best cuts ever!  Everyone there is super friendly and accomodating, especially Louis who has been cutting my hair ever since the first hair cut I had as a kid.  A bit on the pricey side, but well worth every penny.

This TD branch is one of the slowest branches I've ever had to deal with. Their drive thru is usually just 1 person covering multiple people. I usually wait about 5-10 mins for all my checks to get deposited, but the last time I went, it took 25+ minutes!!! UNACCEPTABLE.

Ordered take out.  Small order, only chicken with broccoli for my two girls who are picky eaters.  I asked for extra sauce.  I did not try it, but both my girls enjoyed it very much.  It seemed to be a bit too greasy for my liking! But will be ordering again since both of my princesses   liked it.  Came with steamed rice.

Love this Starbucks. Excellent customer service. Lawson is the manager and has such an awesome staff. I come here on a daily basis because of the atmosphere and awesome customer service I get. They have plenty of seating both inside and out. I come here to drink my coffee and relax. Love this place.

This place is a complete dump. Worst Dunkin donuts in the area. I cannot believe this place hasn't been shut down by the health department. There is trash everywhere on the floor, empty cigarette boxes on tables, no napkins in the dispensaries, and the trash cans are overflowing.  It's like walking into a third world country ...

Cozy and perfect for date nights. I ordered a small portion of the beef ragu and my boyfriend ordered the PB burger. Both are delicious, but the burger was unique and the strange combination was absolutely fantastic. The red curry cake with Jasmine icecream was exquisite.

I was not impressed with this place at all. The service was horrible and the food mediocre. My beer was never brought to me until I reminded the waitress.  We ordered an appetizer and it was overly fried with no flavor. The drinks and the food were overpriced.  We ended up leaving after the appetizer.

I was bar hopping in broad ripple last summer when I saw a lady outside selling pizza. It's my fave so I stopped for a slice of pepperoni. When I say it was the best slice I've had in years! Omg! That is not an understatement! Every time I go to BroadRipple I can't leave without a slice! YOU MUST TRY THIS!!!

We love to come here, sit in a box, and pig out on our fav sushi. Ever since my daughter tried sushi here she's loved it EVERYWHERE! They are just a little pricey, but the quality is great! We love the cheese wantons also! They're dinner plates aren't bad either. We've lived in the area 2 years and have been here 4 times.

We have had this pizza a couple of times and it is delicious! The flavor is awesome! There is plenty of cheese and toppings and the crust is just the right amount of soft and crispy. Only thing I don't like is the price, but you get what you pay for, right?

Ehhhh they do an ok job.......my gel polish chipped after 3 days which is upsetting when you pay more for your polish to last longer. From the look of everyone else's review it seems like we all had the same experience with the owner when asking for our money back or for the polish to be fixed. Customer not satisfied.

The only negative is that it took me two full hours to get a manicure and pedicure. I arrived as soon as they opened on a Saturday morning and they were slammed. However, they will massage your hands and feet for a much longer period than most salons. It was a positive experience overall.

Been a little hit or miss here lately depending on who's working. This used to be a consistently quick place to grab lunch during the noon rush. It's still a decent option, but some days are better than others. Other than that it's your run of the mill Subway - good sandwich options, great selection of toppings.

Eh I had take-out from here one time and it was pretty good.  Went in with the hubs and was not impressed.  The place definitely needs updating, and we were both underwhelmed with our entree choices.  The service was good, but it really wasn't that busy for a Friday night.

Clean rooms and friendly staff. Location is great if your on business for one of the many local large companies. Evening social is nicer than most Homewoods I've been attended. The rooms are clean but on the small side, and dated for this brand, but I would still recommend to anyone staying long term if traveling solo.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Tire time !!! Go see Jerome at Dobbs you will get the best price and service in the city !!! I went in for a specific tire brand but after a recomendation by Jerome I went with a different brand saving myself over $100 and still got the same quality tire I was looking for !!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Average pizza, was a bit over priced. Staff where ni've but the establishment was very dark and dingy. Mortys or Sams pizza blows this place out of the water. I my self am a total foodie but was not the happiness of my dining experience.  Sorry just not a 5 star time

It's "ok" but there are a few other sushi places in town that have better portion sizes for the price. It's a good location, decent ambiance...always has a fishy smell right when you walk in tho. Summer nights on the patio might be worth an appetizer and a drink.

This place isn't too far from where I live, and it's well worth the 15 minute drive to be able to wash my car and not have to find a bunch of quarters!  The car wash is always clean, and there's never been a wait when I've gone. It's just really convenient, and with a place like this nearby, there's no excuse not to wash your car.

Not sure why there are so many stars for this place but the pizza is middle of the road. We ordered thin crust and the crust tastes and look like premade crust. The sauce is complete average. It's possible they're deep dish is better but as far as I'm concerned they're pizza was bland. I'd rather get a pizza from Domenica's.

Good sushi with a Thai overtone, by which I mean the combination of ingredients is not traditionally Japanese.    The presentation was particularly dramatic for the combination plate we ordered.  The staff was nice, the servings generous, and the beer was good and cold.

Not the best place for breakfast but in a pinch it worked for me a few weeks ago when the place I planned to meet for an appointment was closed.  It's clean and the price is right for a meal. Polite staff, but they have the appeal of a midnight truck stop.

We went here with a buisness dinner of 6 people.  The service was a bit slow, but not horrible.  The salads and soups were the highlight of the meal, with the entrees being above average.  We were all impressed with the atmotsphere, the reasonable price and the good food.

Not terrible sushi but not the best either. We got 3 rolls, a salad, and miso soup it was $40. 

It looked great and wasn't terrible but you can definitely tell they don't clean their fryer or something bc we got a deep fried roll and a roll with shrimp tempura it was SO greasy! We couldn't even finish the deep fried Godzilla roll.

A very cozy yet spacious cafe right next to the train station! There are lots of seats including an upstairs seating area. They offer free wifi access as well. Their coffees, bagels, and teas are all delicious but on a bit of a pricier end. It's a great place to do some work or meet up with your friends!

My boyfriend and I went to Josephine for my birthday, and we had a good experience. Was the food and service good? Yes. Was it good enough for the price? I am not so sure. I did love the atmosphere of the restaurant and the location was great, but I'd personally rather spend half the price on a plate of food just as good.

It gets the job done for Happy Hour. Can't be upset with $4 Jack and Ginger-ale. Pretty decent size and there's a stage so I'm sure there's live bands here on some nights. 

Clearly the hangout spot for tons of healthcare professionals who've had a long day.

Great local Mexican. Decently quick service, cold beer, convenient location, ample parking and pretty elaborate menu. We tend to naturally flock to Chuys, but I'm sure we'll make it back to this place sometime--then again, nothing really to write home about.

Fabulous pizza in Edgehill.

Lunch special for $11 was a huge portion--medium sized salad and huge pizza. I had a margherita pizza, which was really flavorful. Great service... love the divey atmosphere. Parking can be tricky--either in the paid lot across from the shopping center or along a street nearby.

Great lunch spot!

Not sure about the food here.  Tried to call and place an order and was treated so rudely on the phone, I hung up.  There are a lot if choices out there... Don't need the attitude.

***  I've got past the fact that they aren't too nice on the phone.  Food is awesome.

I like the food here. I'm not a fan of the cigar smells from the neighboring business, but I always take my food to go. The staff is very nice and they seem to want you to not just enjoy your food, but enjoy your day. Downside: closed on Sundays. 

Even my husband the picky eater enjoys the sesame chicken.

We ordered to go from here and it was SO GOOD. We got cheese bread and BBQ chicken pizza and both loved it. It came in under the amount of time we were quoted and it was a good price for all the food we got. They did screw up by giving us garlic sauce inside of ranch, but that's okay bc the pizza was still awesome.

The all American fast food joint!!'
Today is breakfast time.  Bacon, egg and cheese biscuit with hash browns and orange juice.  Don't do this often but when I do, yum!!
I have never seen employees so happy to serve you!!! Makes for a great start to your day!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
C'mon, what can I say that you already don't know.

Running errands, was hungry, craved a fish sandwich... where else but here.  

Nothing special, nothing different, so so employess trying to earn a buck, except this particular McDonalds is AWAYS packed so be ready to wait a bit.  

Filet-O-Fish = Guilty Pleasure !
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Hit or miss every time. Please check your bags to make sure you got exactly what you ordered before pulling away from the drive-thru, they have a tendency of mixing up your order.

They have 2 drive-thru lanes which is great because it's quick. They definitely want to move fast and get you out of there asap.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Great service and reasonable pricing. I used a Groupon for our visit and it was accepted with no problem. I would say my favorite part of the meal was the desert. They have FRIED Icecream which is one of my absolute favorites. 

I would definitely visit here again

Service was friendly but this place needs some updating. For instance better pedicure chairs and dryers. I got a pedicure and simple manicure. I sat under the dryer for at least 25 minutes and both my fingernails and toes were smudged before I got home. I doubt I'll be back.

After dinner one night my friends and I were craving dessert. They all raved about this place so we went. Their is a decent ice cream selection and nicest staff ever but I didn't get the hype about the ice cream? Overpriced for the quality - don't need to go back but good for a try

If you're in a pinch this place will do. However I have another favorite sushi place and they're pretty hard to beat. Overall I wasn't as impressed with the food they served (rainbow roll, ninja roll) and will probably just keep going to my favorite place (also off McCarran) which has equivalent pricing.

This has got to be the worst McDonald's in the metro area. Waited more than 15 minutes for walk up order then when we got it, it was wrong!  Waited another 10 minutes for them to get it right. Had one girl working the counter AND helping the drive thru who was busting her ass. Everyone else seemed like they could care less!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I'm sorry to say it, but I didn't really like this place. The establishment itself is very small and I felt like my conversations could be heard by all. The menu selection was nothing impressive. I found hair in my food. The server was nice and the food came out quickly. I wouldn't go out of my way to come back here.

Simple.  No frills.  Great tasting.  Affordable.  All of this comes to mind when I think of Pizza Delicious.

The Garlic Knots (Ask for all the way) are downright illegal.  The pepperoni roll... Don't even ask for a bite.

Make your stomach happy and head to Pizza Delicious.

Great service, great food. It's on the pricier side, but it's good food! The older owner lady was very sweet and gave us free cookies. She was also pretty funny. The other waitresses were kind as well. Good experience and i'm sure ill be back since its the only decent sushi spot near ucsb

I love the doctor but it always takes forever to get through a checkup here.  They also push selling glasses a lot but since I wear contacts it doesn't make a lot of sense for me to buy glasses each year.  The doctor is very accommodating when I forget to renew my appointment in time to get new contacts (oops).
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Don't let the craptastic strip mall setting turn you off! Real foodies know that some of the best food can be found in those little mom and pop hole in the wall shops ... we ordered quesadillas, but the menu is extensive making it a challenge to decide. Great cheap eats for lunch. Can't wait to go back!

A great place to get a "burger," plenty of sodium, and 36 ounces of high fructose corn syrup.  Nothing says classy like wharfing down a 20-piece McNuggets while your wife gives birth or your sister gets an appendectomy.  

You can text ahead your order too, so they can screw it up before you even get there.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
A 24-hour drive-thru McD's, so if you hate yourself at 2am you can buy some burgers.

Last few times I've been in "my dark place" (my dark place is when I'm hungry and don't want to cook for myself), their credit card machine has been down.  So bring cash as well - also they took jalapeno mcdoubles off the menu, which is sad.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Only repro vet in the valley. Generally pretty good. Until you need to schedule a surgery on Saturday and they change your time a couple times. No apology no let's figure this out. Nothing. Had to cancel the trip to the zoo with my son. Unfortunate. Felt like their time was more valuable than mine.

Had a fantastic meal.  Kids loved it too.

The gnocchi is to die for.  Flat iron steak was good - the potatoes that came with it were amazing.  The ragu got wiped clean as did the spaghetti.  Desserts were good as well - so save room for the gelato and the espresso drink.

And it's a BYOB - definitely going back more often

My FAVORITE sushi place literally ever!!!!! 
My favorite special rolls are Speedy Way and the Snow one. Their crab Rangoon and clear soup is super good also! Plus the decor inside is really nice and the waitresses are super sweet. I literally love this restaurant so much.

I'm a Mexican food snob but thought this place was delicious! I got carne asada tacos with chips and salsa

Knocked 1 star off update: second time visiting, I placed a carry out order and was told 15 minutes, I came 30 minutes after to pick up and now have been waiting a total of 45 minutes and still haven't gotten my order

I must say my food was very good!! I had Fajita nachos ...yummy!! I also had two frozen margaritas!! Very very good and I had me a little buzz going! I would definitely eat there again. The waitress was very nice...she made sure we had everything we needed at all time! Great service!

Bartaco is my jam!!! Love that everything on the menu is light and fresh! Absolutely love their tacos!! Favorite one is baha fish and portobello! BUT our favorite is the corn - sometime we just go there for drinks and corn, lol! 

CON: seriously, can you provide toothpicks? (Needed from all the corn we eat!)

The donuts are great...obviously. But this place has the most inefficient staff ever. Buying a dozen donuts takes about as long as purchasing a new car, or closing on a house. And that can only partially be attributed to the idiots who wait until they are at the front of the 15 minute line to figure out what they want.

Not a fan of the new payment system.  I love sweet cece's because I can always get just the right amount for under $4.  However, now if I want the same amount it is $6.  I know it might not seem like a big difference but when you are used to something, paying by the ounce, it is silly to change a good thing.

Had a conference here and I'm giving five stars for the food they served for lunch alone. The place was amazing. The room was beautiful. Tons of coffee, tea and drinks posted throughout the entire day. Lunch was insanely delicious. Wait staff kept the room clean throughout the day. Great experience.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great experience for my first visit! Made reservations for 12 and was heated with our table ready outside. Great service. Great happy hour prices. Every single item we ordered was delicious.   The rice balls, the Mac n Cheese, the Scottish egg, the egg rolls, I could go on for a while. I'll def be back!

Dustin did a fantastic job cutting my hair. He was super nice and we had a good conversation. Sometimes it can be that awkward obligatory conversation with a new barber, but Dustin was super cool and easy to talk to. His cut was great and the price was right!

Super friendly staff. Though I wasn't able to get my car fixed there because of warranty issues, they did help me understand what was wrong with it - and they did it in a couple hours of what was probably the coldest day of the year. I'll definitely return.

Steve, where art thou?  When will Paci's reopen with the delicious pizza we love?  How long does it take to renovate perfection?  Please give us an update and let us know when you will be back in business. Nobody else's pizza compares...

MISSING PACI'S PIZZA!!!

A great concept and really nice addition to Hyde Park.  This place is sure to please and will hopefully become a lasting tradition to the South Tampa restaurant scene.  Love Bartaco!!  If they can slightly tighten up the food quality and keep prices reasonable, it will be a hit....

I ate here a few years ago with my best friend while I was planning my wedding. I had the stuffed shells which were delicious. The waitress was nice also. What disappointed me was that I ordered the cheese cake for dessert and the waitress came back saying they were out of it. It wasn't even that late yet.

Decent job. Been coming here for years. This is the closest one to my house. 
The register lady is Middle Aged and always in a bitter mood. Never smiles, never says "Come again", or "Thanks for coming".

Over all the carwash experience is okay. They never do a job well done on the rims. Vacuuming your car is a hit and miss.

We stopped in one night for take out after we went shopping.  We figured even though the plaza was beat maybe the pizza would be great.  Obviously people on yelp have never had good pizza I will say the sauce was tasty.  But the pizza... well it was below average.   The service was below average also.   I will not be going back.

A little pricier than usual coffee shops, but they do offer delicious roasts. I brought my out-of-town friend from Berlin once and he was impressed with the cappuccino he had. I usually come here to pick up a bag of beans. My favorite is Foundation! The decor has a nice, natural and minimalistic feel.

Overall I like this place. 

It's clean and mid-size, and there is space to sit. The workers were friendly and able to suggest some combos. 

The menu isn't huge, but the ice creams we tried (pineapple whip and charcoal ice cream) were both tasty. 

Gotta knock them on price though - $12 for two cones is pretty steep.

I have been to Las Palmas many times over there years.  Las Palmas is your run of the mill Mexican Restaurant which isn't necessarily a bad thing.  It's a great place to get a dos equis or margarita with some chili rellenos when I'm looking to get a moderately priced meal.

Eric and the crew are always thorough and honest.  They don't perform unnecessary work or try to squeeze extra money out of their customers. They are very trustworthy and I will never go to another mechanic in the Reno area again.
I have had a few unreliable cars and thank god for reliable auto shops like Advanced Automotive

Mediocre.... the fro yo's have that ice crystal like texture to them... UGH i hate it! like chocolate sorbet instead of yogurt. 
I have unfortunately been here plenty of times since it was walking distance to my apartment. Average selection of yogurts nothing unusual, toppings are the usual... the fruit is fresh and tastes great!

Went for lunch. 
High ceilings, large layout space. Service was a little slow, but friendly.
Menu has the typical bar food, with some pizzazz. 
The desserts looked pretty awesome.
I ordered the "I Dare You" hot wings. Very spicy & delish. 
My mind wasn't blown, but I definitely liked this place. I will go back for the wings.

I am not a fan of starbucks but this place is very decent. Why?
* private parking lot
* spacious, plenty of seats and even a study room
* the barista actually cared about spelling my name correctly. Say what?!? She still didnt get it right but I appreciated the effort

Went to dinner last night based on Yelp reviews. Wow!  They were right!  Good food, Great service (Thanks Karen!). I had grilled chicken sandwich with baked potato and it was perfectly cooked and tasted great. My wife had pasta and was very pleased. We definitely will be back on our next trip to Madeira Beach.

Love coming here for some fresh made tacos. The sauces are great, got to ask for the hot ones though. Tonsillectomy and Lava are nice, add some heat to your meal.
The nachos are almost enough to fill me up but always need to have a taco or two.
Writing this has made me want to go get tacos tonight.

They are nice people. But I felt like my manicure could've been better. I've been to other places and usually go to divy up north, but this was close to my work. The gel was $30 and in just 1 day my nail polish came off and broke my nail. The polish could've used another coat.

After all the rave reviews I was expecting something a little better. Nothing was spicy or really even flavorful just very, very heavy. The atmosphere is nothing to write home about. 3 stars because the service is excellent. Food unfortunately doesn't match it

A very solid 3 star supermarket. Not stellar, but pretty decent when it comes to asian markets.  There is a pretty wide selection of goods. No, it is not very well organized. Yes, it has that funky asian market smell. But all the goods and produce I purchased were fresh and the prices are fair.

I'm partial to BBQ chicken pizza and it did not disappoint here. I tried this one and the Margherita pizza and enjoyed them both. I also had the opportunity to talk to the manager while I was waiting to get my pizzas for takeaway and he was a kind man. Would go back!

Food is excellent, service is fantastic, but if you no longer eat carbs, this is not the place for you.  Wish restaurants would have a few items on their menu substituting zucchini for the pasta and sauces that are alcohol free.  I would give them 5 stars if they realized that people are more health conscious nowadays.

Worst fast food experience of my life. Rude. Delayed. Disorganized. Of the myriad of things that went wrong during my dine in visit to this location, the blatant rudeness and disregard for basic customer service was by far the most appalling. DO NOT EAT AT THIS LOCATION.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Was skeptical because of a few bad reviews but thankfully I had a good experience. The woman who did my pedicure also did my gel manicure which was nice. I wasn't jumping around from person to person. They got busy after I came in but still did a great job. Will be back again!!

Every year for the last three years when we come to Florida this is a must Go!  I absolutely love this place.  It is a bit pricy but soo worth it.  Dress up or casual the atmosphere is top notch.  I have not ever had a dish that I didn't like.  The restaurant is very clean and very inviting.

Perfect location, right by the neighborhood here. Always a good selection and the line is never too long because the cashiers are efficient. Also friendly. I prefer to come alone because if I bring hubby he spends so much time examining the vast selection of whiskeys and bourbons! Haha

Portions are huge.  Appetizers were frozen and not fresh.  Wings were good.  Sandwiches were good.  I will probably go back to watch a game or drink beer.  As for the food I would rather eat at Thunder Canyon or Fox and Hound.  They do have alot of TV's which makes it a good Sports bar!!

So all in all if you are looking for someplace to do your nails quick downtown this is about it and I think they know it hence they don't do much upkeep.  You aren't getting stellar service. My nails look pretty good and will do for what I need them for but would skip if you have time to go somewhere else.

Very cool hotel - an old train stationed that's been transformed into a hotel. It even has a train inside the hotel that's been converted to bedrooms. However, my biggest problem is that my room walls were paper thin. I could easily hear conversations going on in the adjacent room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Jennifer Barnes, the lobby Lead Bartender is amazing.. She makes any drinks, great hospitality and really makes you feel like you're​ home... In fact she went out of her way to get me some dessert from another restaurant on the other side of the hotel..I would come back as long as she's working.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Stopped here for a beer....Two draft beers (Rogue Dead Guy) cost $18.00??!! Served in dirty pint glasses as well! The bartender was nowhere to be found after serving the beer as well! Save yourself the money - head to the Irish Pol right up the street & get six good drafts for the price you're going to pay for two here!

They have a piano that anyone can play in the middle of the restaurant. I had the best mcdonalds experience of my life there where some guy was playing everything from 70's rock to Beethoven. Made my mcdonalds breakfast fantastic. So if you are in the mood to play or listen to some piano music, check this place out.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I went through the drive thru and ordered a combo meal of a large roast beef sandwich, a gyro, large onion rings and cheese sticks.  They asked if I wanted sauce I said yes. 
When I got home there were only 3 onion rings in my box I paid $1.00 !,# onion ring! And no arby sauce, wth.  I am not thrilled with the new Arbys.

I got the chicken dumplings and was impressed. The prices are all super reasonable and staff are friendly and willing to make adjustments to the food if you need them. 

You can eat there at a casual counter (you don't have to tip) or take it to go! Fast, easy, and great food. Chicken dumplings just $5.75 for 6 large dumplings.

The portion sizes are small (you can finish a taco in 3bites)   The flavor is hit or miss, but I've never gone wrong with the pork belly. You can also get it in a rice bowl that comes with a raw salad of red/yellow bell peppers and cilantro. 

The scenery is nice - very open with a "beach" feel to it.

Ordered this via Postmates and was letdown. I usually don't try sushi places out here in NOLA because, well, they suck. I ordered the spicy tuna roll and the spicy crunch roll. Both were tasteless and boring. The spicy tuna had absolutely no flavor and the crunchy roll was boring. 

One star for having Shumai here though!

Love Farmers Inn. Friendly service. Decently fast. Nice relaxed atmosphere. Haven't had a bad meal. I recommend the pretzel bite app. So yummy. Very accommodating. Big portions and delicious grub. Definitely try the house sauce with the fries. Yum! Super cool building and decent alcohol prices.

The donuts here are generally pretty good. Today they looked a bit old. I settled for an iced coffee which was delicious and skipped the donuts. They have a bit of a fly/insect problem. I will be back for some donuts on another day and hope that they are more fresh then.

Food wasn't bad. But could have been better. 
I had fajitas, stuffed pepper both were just okay. I love Mexican food
We were a group of 4 adults and 3 kids, no one liked the food as much. 
The ambiance is different and cute but food perhaps not so much. 
This place doesn't invite me again !!

My new favorite Mexican restaurant!  This is a wonderful family run restaurant.  I've been here three times and had amazing meals every time. Everyone I bring (wife,son and daughter) with me loves it too.  I recommend this place for authentic delicious Mexican.  I've ordered tacos, burrito, and the chilaquiles. All are excellent!

Some of the best thin crust pizza in Pinellas County. Cheese that actually stretches not like some of these big corporate places in which their cheese doesn't move. The crust- oh my gosh the crust is so good. I just feel like the sauce is missing something. Just needs a hint of sweetness.

Went here finally w/ E-Dawg and H used to live in Verdi so this has been long time coming.

Arrived prior to 2pm happy hour and waited with delicious hot homemade chips for the clock to strike 2.  Worth the wait for delicious esp the red sauce.

Finally not prego so the marg was delish

I don't know why this place had gotten so many bad reviews.  They are always super nice when I go in and clothes are  always done in a couple of days. They have a special five items for twenty dollars which isn't too bad.  We have been taking our stuff there for over a year now and never had any problems!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: It's no longs but pretty decent and they have Tiger Tail donuts! It is good to have another choice in the area besides Speedway, Krispy Kreme donuts. The girl behind the counter is always super nice too. It's a nice one stop for Saturday morning donuts and coffee.

this is the best barbershop in central Tucson close to the u of a The staff are really cool we went to barber school together so I kno most of the barbers and they are highly skilled barbers a lot of the U of a athletes go here to get their haircuts I recommend it

First time here. It was a Bit of a walk from B1 Boarding gate, but I needed to get my steps in.

One couple in front of me, and pretty efficient service.

Just grabbed a couple coffees and sausage McMuffin for the hubby.

I was surprised how hot the coffee was!

Glad I stopped for coffee.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place is small, but charming and their ingredients are super fresh. I had the shrimp tempura rolls which were delish! However I took off stars because, obviously, parking sucks also the spot is BYOB (huge hassle) and it's not even much cheaper considering that factor.

Went to Derek's a few weeks ago and was not impressed at all. Parking was terrible, but that to be expected -- after all it's Main Street, but the food itself just wasn't great. Everything was just a tad too salty and the drinks were pretty weak -- don't think I'll be returning.

I would have to say I was impressed by their chili. It has the little spice to it which I love. The restaurant itself was clean and our server was pretty nice. He gave us extra chips to eat with. The mixed drinks were made well and I enjoyed visiting here. Overall, pretty good experience.

I will say that they did fix it right but the estimated price vs actual price was a little off by $75 but they did knock off $23 so I can't complain to much. They attempted to make it right so I won't say my overall experience was bad.  

The wait was what took forever over 5 hours. That's a little long.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I was very happy when I walked in. It has a Tuscan feel and a very nice dining room. I took a seat at the bar. Reviewed their menu and decided on a Greek salad. It was delicious! The dressing was delicious. Generous portion. The bartender was kind, upbeat and happy to be busy.

I will be back.
Came in happy. Left happy.

Great touch less car wash for a fair price. They have 4 bays for hand washing if you're so inclined. Also a couple cool dog wash rooms. I've never used those, but they get busy on weekends, so must be good. There is almost always an attendant on duty during regular hours. They keep the place immaculate. LVE.

The oysters with the ponzu sauce, scallions, and drop of sriracha are my favorite. I would've gave them 4 stars just for the oysters alone. The superstar roll is pretty good, but the rest of the menu items I've had are just ok. The staff and service is good. I like the free edamame and soup they always give me

Sals Special wood fired pizza was good. They charge extra to have the pie cooked in the wood oven. The only negative was the charge of $3.00 for extra sauce, and the pizza wasn't saucy. So three stars and we will try one of the 50 other pizza joints in the Burg next time.

At night Budget was very slow, and understaffed. At times the customers were alone without Budget customer service, and several people waiting started talking to each other about how long the wait was. We got a vehicle that was in great shape, and better than expected. Turning the car back in during the day went fine.

Great food! We got the chef special which meant we had a seven course meal of whatever the chef wanted to feed us. It was cool. Some things we tried that were delicious and I never would have chosen from the menu. Also, this place has a real cool atmosphere. Great for a date or group outing.

Good, fresh sushi. The Mexican and spicy salmon rolls were our personal favorite as was the crab and cucumber salad. The miso soup was excellent as well. I didn't care for the tuna roll but my husband liked it. My younger daughter had chicken Katsu that was also quite good! Definitely worth a visit if you're a sushi lover!

Rolls were okay, my wife got the Hibachi and it was mediocre at best, paper menu and laminated menu showed different options. Waitress quoted $11.95, but every where else stated $10.95, service was not great for an all you can eat establishment @ 2:30pm... Should have gone to Ciccios next door!

This is my grandma's favorite place for sushi. The fish is fresh and great quality, actually the food all around is really good. The only issue I have is that it isn't really great for more than a party of 5 or 6 and the "all you can eat" is a little more expensive than other places.

This is my favorite location to go to. It's a little crowded at times and pretty much always has a steady flow of customers. So if you are wanting solitude to accomplish some work this might not be the best place. I don't mind the noise though and the staff is gracious and quick with their work.

Our first and best stop as far as bars in New Orleans. This place will always be on my to do list when I visit. Unfortunately, we got there when the Sunday night band was wrapping up their set but the 2 songs we heard were amazing. Drinks were great as was the atmosphere. Very cool, chill and classy bar.

STOP RIGHT HERE! Not kidding when I say best ice cream I've had in my life!! We've seen the line out the door many times and this time decided to give it a try.. we got 4 mini scoops and I actually had to close my eyes when trying each one! Soooo good. Friendly staff as well.

Too loud for my taste, and the food wasn't spicy enough for Mexican.  I like my Mexican to have more flavor.  
Families seem to love it here. Lots of birthday parties happening the Sunday I went.
All in all it was OK but I wouldn't drive to the other side of town to eat there.

It's ok but I wouldn't go out if my way to come here.  They don't make their own tortillas and they use Kraft Parmesan cheese on the refried beans. If you want authentic, everything made from scratch and fresh there's a taqueria that's 100% better and the best I've tried in Brandon on Lithia-pinecrest.

The pizza is good but not great ...could've been the toppings but not a fan! The salad and breadsticks were amazing! Next time I think I'll order some pasta as it looked amazing coming out of the kitchen !!! Great staff super friendly and great environment.

I've been to this place three times now. Every time we leave, we are satisfied. Prices are fair, portion sizes are wonderful, food is delicious, and the employees are friendly. 

I highly recommend this place to anyone, it is by far my favorite Japanese restaurant in Northeast Philadelphia.

One of my favorite sushi joints in New Orleans! I go every time I'm in town and my parents go at least once a week. 

They have a miso eggplant that is to die for! 

Portions are large and the fish is super fresh, you can't go wrong with anything on the menu!

Best McDonald's I have been to in the state of Louisiana.  I jave never had an issue here. They are quick, efficient and sometimes friendly but always courteous. Located on the outskirts of the Esplanade Mall with two drive thru lanes. Clean inside but usually the drive thru is busy
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I would not normally write a review for a car wash facility, but since there were 2 1* reviews, I thought I would help even the score - I had a totally normal touch less car wash experience here. There was no line, and the car wash did a decent job, no damages.

What a great idea! It really is a one stop shop for all things k-cup (there are cups for other types of machines as well).

Any flavor/roast blend you can think of is here, and the owner is super friendly and kind to boot!

Worth a trip next time you're on this side of town!

Mmmmm mmm! Love old spag factory. It's a great family restaurant. We had no trouble getting in with a 7 person table on a Sunday. 

Service was good, food was great - lots of options on the menu, the entrees all come with an appetizer, tea or coffee, and a very yummy ice cream.

Super Sunday night dinner with the family!

Growing up in South Philly I have had my fair share of Italian food both home made and at the restaurant. This place was not up to par for me nor for the other 3 ppl I was with. Service needs improvement and the wait for the food was a bit much. The dessert was ok. The creme bru le was soupy. I have never seen creme bru le soupy.

I have been to most of the WOB locations in the Tampa Bay area and this is my favorite.  The atmosphere is more relaxed and low key than the others.  Even when the place is busy it isn't overcrowded.  Also, the staff is fantastic and friendly.  The outdoor seating area is also good.

Old school donut shop with little frills. Walked in on a Sunday around 9 and got helped out right away. It was so hard choosing only 6 pretty donuts, but my husband and I somehow got it done - and then ate all of them. This place is everything everyone else says so don't wait any longer and head here for your next donut treat!

The club sandwich kept the rating from being a one star.   I have never come across a bowl of chili that I could not even eat.  The consistency was that of tomato paste.  Had very little flavor and even less beef.  It was as though they mixed beans, tomato paste, a little water and a dab of beef.  Not even edible

Large menu selections. Nice interior decor. Good food. Quality diner experience. 

For breakfast I like their cream chipped beef. Coffee is very good there too.

Lunch - the griota pita is great. It's a cheesesteak on a pita bread. 

Dinners are massive and cheap.

This was by far the worst Mexican food I've ever eaten. I'm pretty certain the salsa came out of a jar and it cost $2.25 for a small serving. The cheese dip with chorizo cost $8.75 for a very small serving; however, this was the best part of the meal. The employees were friendly, but unfortunately the meal left a lot to be desired.

New building is much nicer than the old building (working restrooms ext.), same good tex-mex  food, do not like their margaritas though. The cheese dip here is a winner! They did take a reservation for our large lunch party, which was nice.  Little bit of a language barrier with waiter.

Friendly and quick service at 10am yesterday. I ordered 3 1/2 dozen donuts and were thrilled to learn they are peanut-free. I ordered a dozen glazed, a dozen chocolate, a dozen sprinkled and a half dozen iced. I thought their prices were a little high, but got what I needed.

Smells smokey... this is a bar that hasn't changed any of the rules it seems. Smoking Indoors and eating food not my forte. I did try the wings which were ok. Beer selection was limited.  Service was slow. But seems to be a great locals spot.  Hanging there for sport tv watch, pool tables and just a place to drink.

The place is cute, but small and noisy. The coffee machines are loud if you sit in the front. I'm sure it's more quiet in the back. I had an iced latte. The drink was pretty good. The service was mediocre though--I felt like I was intruding the barista for asking a question about their drink menu.

Good music since I grew up in the 80's. Only take Amex, Discover, or cash. Thankfully they have an ATM. Small bar and the crowd is pretty young and obnoxious. I was groped a couple times before I made my way out of there. If that's your thing, you're in luck. 

Oh, and Flaming Dr. Pepper's are their specialty!

This place is great! The sushi chef was so fast I'd swear our rolls were premade if I didn't watch him make them myself. The restaurant is small but the decor and bar are nice. The fish was fresh and the variety was good. This is definitely near the top of my list of best sushi places.

I had a six-inch rotisserie-style chicken sub here. With a coupon, the price was $3.49 plus tax. I enjoyed it. This place has zero ambience, but it's a very affordable sandwich shop conveniently located next to the Fox Theatre, and service is friendly and fast.

I ate dinner here with a friend recently. It was my first time here. We had Kung Pao Shrimp, Garlic Chinese Vegetable and a Meat Egg Roll. The bill was $28.97 plus tax and tip. The shrimp dish was great; the vegetable dish was mostly just bok choy, pretty boring; the egg roll was OK.

This place has been here for years, and I used to eat here often. I hadn't been there in years, but I dropped in for lunch the other day. I had a fish roe hand roll and a bowl of rice with pork and cabbage in a spicy ginger sauce. The sauce was too hot for my taste, so I didn't care much for it.

I thought I needed a new battery, but unfortunately it turned out that I needed a new alternator. These people took care of it for me. I don't know if it would have cost more or less at any other place, but they did accept a competitor's coupon for 12% off. Grand total paid was $387.83. Now my car runs again.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: As you know it is now the oldest family owned restaurant in the US. Very friendly staff and great food. Meatballs are very tasty, pasta was "al dente" , and the environment was super easy going. I had a Linguini Meatball. Most pastas are cheap and good. $12-16 bucks for a huge plate. Check my other reviews for tips ;)

Just wow! All elements of great pizza working in harmony! Perfect crust, sauce and cheese. This place really goes above and beyond what I'd expect of a pizza place in the middle of suburbia. When you takeout, they sometimes give you a little bag of donuts with powdered sugar. So good!

This place is really hit or mess.

There are employees that are excellent and others that do not have any care for the customer whatsoever. 

Their donuts are awesome and their bagels (if the employees are not stingy with the cream cheese) are excellent as well.

I went here for a Sunday brunch. The place was relatively empty and yet we waited an hour for our food. I got the breakfast pizza with a fried egg on it. The pizza was super thin and flimsy and a liquid sauce on it that ran everywhere. The flavors were good but it was impossible to eat.

I had my first, and certainly not last, dining experience at San Antonio today. The restaurant is festively decorated and clean. The staff is friendly and attentive.
 
The food is wonderful and authentic with good variety. The prices are reasonable. They offer lunch specials.There's plenty of parking and adequate seating

I've been to so many yogurt shops, and this one is no different. Pretty cool late night get away. Reeses pieces and mixed yogurt are always good! Great setting during the day* if you have kids. 

Nothing spectacular, seating inside is limited but there's a table or two outside which works great!

Had the veal sliders, they were very good. After reading the reviews I think people maybe need to stay away from the pizza, don't be so bland, yes the word pizza is in their name. They chose a bad name. What I had was good. Sat outside, had nice weather. Was a good meal.

Easy, fast, cheap, and tastey meal. I am giving one star for each of these items for a four star rating. All of the times I have visited this location it was clean. Pizza is consistently good. Honestly Little Caesars is my favorite chain pizza place. Tastier and way cheaper than Pizza Hut and Dominos.

I came here for dinner once. The food was okay overall. They have a very extensive menu and cool decor. I had the Chicken Marsala. The chicken was tender, but the sauce was off and tasted closer to teriyaki than Marsala. The food was very affordable. I could imagine coming back to try something new.

Overall, a great deal if you have a bunch of folks to share food. Their portion sizes are great for sharing. I don't recommend their orange chicken, as it is super sweet. Also, their salt and pepper calamari has a great spice mixture but is waaay too thickly battered. Otherwise, they are cooked well.

I came here for a special occasion once. The beer selection and service were great. I however really didn't care for my food. I had the vegetarian special and found it to be pretty bland. I also had a cake that was quite dry. I'd give this place another chance some time but would need to consider carefully what I order.

Just your average yogurt place. Yogurtology and Yogurt Mountain offer better flavors and variety, but this place isn't bad. They also have coffee drinks which I've never tried so I believe that's another way for them to get customers. Haven't had a great experience of yogurt flavor/toppings yet, but they've been decent thus far.

Fresh fish and delicious! I had the star roll and Japan one sashimi roll....both were excellent :)
Hibachi was also pretty good!

Also, the overall atmosphere is relaxed and the staff is friendly. The lighting is just right for an evening out - there's a cool chandelier and bulbs hanging above. 

Definitely coming back.

This use to be one of my go to place when I lived in st Pete. Haven't been back in awhile but was in town the other night and it wasn't the same. The flavors fell short for me and there fruit choices were lacking. The staff was not very professional either. Probably won't be back.

One doesn't require much for a successful trip to the ATM. Just a fully functional touchscreen and a bottle of hand sanitizer, amirite? 

The screen works fine. It calls for chip technology so that takes some remembering. I keep the hand sanitizer in the car door so we're good.

F!!!!!  This Los Betos used to be decent but has gone way down hill.  Since they are open 24 hours, I thought getting a burrito at 5:10am would be easy.  Nope, they told me they were closed.  So much for being open 24 hours.  Avoid this place at all costs!

I enjoy this Arby's location.  There is nothing more entertaining than watching my co-worker Jared order four regular roast beef sandwiches in frustration to make two giant roast beef sandwiches to satisfy his hunger.  Location is good, service is typical for Arby's and food always tastes good.

I like this spot always quick and the servers are nice. I've never sat down inside and eaten as to I prefer to get carry out, but they are always courteous and prompt with my order. The inside is always full with people eating there buffet which all I hear is it is great. You can never go wrong with Super China Buffet

So understaffed and unprepared they asked me to leave the dining room and go to the drive thru. So I did that. And waited for 20+ minutes while they screwed up the order and were rude to me. It was 5:30 am.
I have pretty low standards for fast food joints but this place fails ANY test.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Came to try a new place for dinner. Happened to drive by so we tried it. Atmosphere was ok. Service was well below par. Appetizer was good. Slow to get drinks and bread. My entree was good but side was cold. My wife's dinner was cold. Service was down right terrible.

The only saving grace of this place is Jeremiah.  Plastic in  my first sandwich, wrong sandwich on the second run and extra pickles on the third.  Kitchen and management spend way too much time chatting while the cashier keeps fixing screw ups. Hope he finds a better job soon.

It's every single time I order here, they completely get my order wrong! But the thing is they repeat back what you want but makes the drink wrong! I ordered a caramel brûlée latte, it tastes like hot milk! No caramel flavor, no brûlée flavor no espresso etc.

So I think since everyone else's reviews maybe the store worked a little bit on. Customer service. I went through the drive-through today and everyone was super nice and thanked me for coming. I didn't wait a long time on my order and everything was hot... it was just a normal Wendy's.

The best thing about this place was the service, which was good. The margarita, while strong, was made with a pre-made mix that was awful. The enchilada sauce was not tasty. Even the guacamole was bad. I've never had bad guacamole before. Free chips and salsa were good. The Mexican rice was very good. But, I would not go back.

A hidden gem that has been in plain sight for a long time. The whole chicken with everything is a bargain, but the guacamole and chips are amazing too. The tacos are made fresh to order and you'll love whatever you eat. Get in here and try a smattering of what they have to offer, you won't regret it@

My bridesmaids and I were in here last week to have our nails done the day before my wedding. The people who work here are really nice, but despite spending over 40 minutes in the salon and drying for a sufficient amount of time, every single girl's toes were messed up by the end of the night. 

Their toe dryers simply DO NOT WORK.

Being from San Diego, i wouldn't say that this is my favorite place to go for Mexican. However, they have great happy hour deals on their delicious and massive margaritas. They've also been super accommodating when we've had large parties. This is definitely the go to party spot among me and my friends.

I've noticed some Dunkin Donuts have limited seating. This one in particular has a good amount of table and chairs. Also has a sofa area, as well as outdoor seating. Great option to enjoy some classic coffee and donuts and meeting up with friends and co-workers

First i saw this restaurant on the way home,i stopped 'n wanna try some sushi's cuz i am SUSHI mania anyway i bought special spicy tuna 'n spider roll.
And its make ma dinner...those sushi's were bigger than i expected specially in south philly.so i hava give 4 stars..

Tried a few new items and wanted to add to my review:

Szechuan dumplings are delicious! Always getting these going forward. Not super spicy just good flavor! 

Singapore noodles have a good curry taste but the pork tastes off-putting in my opinion.

Honey chicken is sweet and crunchy. Another favorite.

Way too slow!  The girl at the cashier was cheerful and friendly, but drinks were made way too slow!  This Starbucks is located on one of the biggest intersections in Clearwater. They should know to have enough staff to get drinks made for the general flow of customers that pass through here.

Overpriced Italian Restaurant. The quality of the food was definitely not worth the price. I had a pasta dish that was nothing special. Service was also very mediocre. Our server kept going MIA. If you like good Italian food, I do not recommend this place.

Best barbershop in montco, carrying on the old italian barber tradition, which means you might lose an ear if  a pretty woman walks by...but still the best montco has to offer . 

Go there around christmas they have cookies and other treats for the customers

Staff is great, and a $14.00 Haircut cant be beat

This is a pretty solid pizza. I only ever eat it when coworkers order pizza from here. I'm not sure if they are consistent though.  The last time I had a slice, I was so impressed.  I asked if it was somewhere new and they said it's Lovecchio's.   Maybe they tweaked something, but I'm looking forward to the next slice.

This is a pretty solid joint.  The food has always been at least above average, but nothing really stands out as being the best Chinese you can get.   Nothing disappoints, but it does miss that wow factor.  I've actually stopped coming here, because I go to their sit-down restaurant, Golden Bowl, a store or two down the road.

A nice little place and another good food option in the market. The owner/operators of Tokyo Sushi  are pleasant people and make decent sushi. The sushi is fresh and tastes good.  I usually get the spider roll and I am always happy with that choice.  There is usually a good variety of sushi in the case.

I love dunkin.  My husband and I will go to every Dunkin just to try it. We are fanatic's. This place has just opened and a lot of the employees don't know what they are doing. This place is super cute and the donuts were good it's just the coffee that was alright. They will get it.  I'm sure.

I love using National- the experience is always seamless.  I pick my car and off I go.  The returns are quick and easy.  This experience was no different, the staff is friendly, helpful and quick.  I don't rent anywhere else.  Thanks National, for a making my travel easier.

It's Friday so it's understandably busy in this drive-through. The first lane is for ATM; the next three for drive-up.

I'm typing this as I wait just to let them know what kind of transaction I'm doing. Looks like only two tellers for all these cars plus inside customers. They need to hire more people for Friday lunch rush.

I always want to check out Coyote Ugly's. This is the 3rd I've been to (Vegas and Milwaukee). This one was in the basement. It was so hot we couldn't stay. I was dripping sweat just from standing there. The atmosphere wasn't as much fun as I expected. Milwaukee's Coyote Ugly was worse, but this one was pretty bad.

Not good at all. Fish was fishy and I had to throw it away after one bite that I spit out. Noodle salad is flavorless. Wasted money. Maybe it was an off day I dunno cause lots of people like this place. It'll be while before I work up the courage to try it again.

Nearly impossible to pull in and there is always a wait.

I ordered through the mobile app today and I am still standing here waiting. People that just walked in got theirs way before me. It's been ten minutes.

I like their coffee better than Starbucks but this is just ridiculous.

First time coming to the new location on Calle Real & Turnpike! The drive thru girl was super friendly and great attitude. I asked for light ice for my drink, they kinda went heavy on the ice. But I'd definitely come back.
I am so glad we have a drive thru nearby!!

This place has some yummy rolls. I had the veggie roll and their tempura. It was pretty scrumptious. Their tap water is the worst I've ever tasted. But I'd recommend the food, they're located by the harbor so it's nice to relax and enjoy the beach after (or before).

I always come and order their lunch special. It is pretty filling and comes with miso soup, side of rice and then the lunch (with your choice of teiyaki chicken, tempura, little orange slice, rolls, udon noodles, etc. basically a lot of options.) The staff is always friendly and smiling.

I stopped by this Starbucks location during some errand-running yesterday. I ordered my coffee on the app. This location is pretty typical - drive thru, little sitting area outside, small inside seating area, etc. The parking area isn't huge, but I didn't have a hard time finding a spot.

I didn't realize that the stores at the mall don't open until noon on Sundays, so I got there before the stores opened. Luckily, Starbucks opens earlier, and I stopped by to get a coffee while I waited for the stores to open. Just a Starbucks, but it was big enough and had seating. What else do you need in a Starbucks?

I checked out Koto before a show at TPAC a few nights ago, and it was a decent sushi meal. Pretty traditional sushi menu and traditional interior for a Japanese restaurant. The food and menu wasn't exactly inspiring, but it was a pretty good meal! Not a bad place for a meal before a show! (Right down the street from TPAC!)

This is a pretty small place with a very limited selection of martinis.  On a Wednesday night we enjoyed a fun band - Friends with Benefits. The crowd was on the quieter side, so this felt like a pretty chill bar compared with the rest of the bars on Broadway.

The place has large water buckets with brushes that you can use to scrub the car before putting it through an automatic car wash.  There are 5 different options for the car wash - from $5 to $15.  And there are free vacuum stations for the inside.  One star off because the car comes out still wet from the car wash.

They have a great outdoor section and a nice heathy selection that is not all fried bar food. The soup/sandwich is always a good option or a fresh large salad. 
If you want to indulge a bit more get the nachos with everything. It's huge so you might need help.

We have been taking our dogs to Dale Mabry Animal Hospital for about 8 years and have been very happy with their service.  We have recommended it to friends and they have also been very pleased.  We have found the veterinarians to be friendly and experienced.  We will continue to take our three dogs to this office.

We arrived and were politely greeted by a young bartender/waiter.  We were curious ask the restaurant was empty but thought it was early - we went at 6. The menu is limited we both ordered pasta dishes. The food was decent - not bad not great. It was sort of creepy, gaudy, loud Italian music and no one there. We won't be back.

Very expensive since its self serve and the yogurt just pours out before you can pull the lever back up in time not to over serve yourself. You pay by weight. The plain, slightly tart yogurt is probably the best flavor. All the others are diabetes in a bowl.

The food is good and so are the prices. However, the Lo Mein and the white rice are very high sodium so it may make you very bloated. I eat Chinese food alot but this restaurant definitely uses more sodium than I am used to. 

I still recommend it cause the food is good and they are fast, but just eat a little at a time. :)

It was like a Hampton Inn was supposed to be. What else can you say? A place to sleep and eat breakfast. There was a bad smell right as you walk out of the elevator on floor 3. Probably had a leak in a room that ruined the carpet there. I'm sure they'll fix it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The decor should be a little more Japanese. For an example the music should be more Oriental style.
The employees are a little friendly but they need to stop talking with one another and serve the food.
The sushi is pretty good but its a warm. The sushi needs to be served cold and not at room temp.

I've never actually taken my furry friend to this animal hospital, but they have a 16 acre farm complete with cows, goats, sheep, an emu, an alpaca, pigs and much more that I'm probably forgetting. Great place to take the kids to check out all the cute animals for free! Insiders tip, all the animals really like Cheerios!

Review #156. Length: Short. They always clean our car pretty good. They have never stolen anything and have never had problems with cleaning. The entire property is dirty inside and out though. They stuff they sell inside is so jam packed that it feels like it's being shoved in your face.

Inexpensive sushi, you basically get what you pay for. Small restuarant with ok sushi. Wouldn't go in with high expectations but if you are in the area and restaurants are booked check them out. The server really wasn't welcoming which didn't help my experience there.

It's been a while since I've made a trip here. The service is always great, very friendly and helpful staff. I havent had the patience to wait on the deep dish pizza yet but it looks tempting everytime I see it. Worth a stop if your seeking great service and quality Italian food. Try the lasagna!

I mean... A girl has to review her local chicken nugget vendor. Living next to this McDonalds for well over two years. I've never had any issues, the people have always been nice, and nothing has ever been forgotten. Thank you 52nd and keystone for getting me over all my hangovers and saving my bad days with Diet Cokes.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Nice guys.   Got my car inspected in a little over an hour.  Didn't try to sell me anything I knew I didn't need.
I had to take a star off because the waiting area is not comfy and very cold!   I know...it's a garage...but a little heat would go a long way. 
I will be back!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Friendly staff and quick service. Clean and well stocked with coffee items and condiments for your coffee. We ordered coffee and two cinnamon twists. So disappointed in the twists. The pastries were hard and dry (except the glaze). Ugh...a coffee cafe should always have FRESH pastries!!

Well I can't give enough stars! Such amazing food at a great price. Great flavor and selection. One of the best enchiladas and Chili Relleno I've ever had. Plus not to mention they deliver. I repeat they deliver. If you're in the area give them a try. I did and don't regret it!

Horrible just horrible. Got a breakfast burrito. Guess they add sharp pieces of plastic nice. Hurt my tooth on it. No one is available to resolve this issue. Very unprofessional and rude about the whole situation. You'd think they would care seeing as we the customer pay their bills!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I'm extremely disappointed that I paid $500 for two night stay for a river view room with a balcony and I can assure you this is NOT a river view room. No view of the river. NONE. You should not advertise what you can not offer. No river view as indicated in room description. I'm EXTREMELY disappointed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Been going to Burger king for many years. And this is the nicest one I ever been to. Just wish there we're more like this. 

Great for kids. There is a playground on the inside and one outside. 

The food is always done. The inside is clean. All around great place to eat.

Dr. Khan and his team are fantastic. The ladies at the front are always friendly and remember me. Dr. Khan is incredible and goes the extra step to make sure you are comfortable and tries to get to know his patients, rather than the awkward in and out most places do!

5 stars all around.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The t ravs were home made and pretty good, arancini was nothing special and meat balls were plane like an unspiced meat loaf.  Cannelloni comes with a weird orange sauce and mushy meat and similar lack of seasoning.   The noodles were made too thick and kind of pasty tasting.  Nothing here we'd come back for again unfortunately.

Not sure why everyone seems to like this place?  We thought it was over priced for what you get.  Maybe it's because there is not much around this side of town.  Yes the inside was neat to look at, but the food not so much.  My mother and I will not be going back. Just didn't like the food or the price.

My boyfriend loves this place. Its his favorite ice cream place with so many wonderful flavors. The line is always long but it moves pretty fast. I like the almond brittle and the Bramberry prob my favs. Last nite we tried the cocoa curry coco and it was pretty good. Different but good. They had three new flavors for spring.

We ordered the Smokey Wings, which were undercooked. I ordered the Astoria Lamb burger well done which came out burnt. Told the waitress who apologized. My husband enjoyed his Turkey Rueben.

Overall it was a disappointment, considering we usually look forward to coming here.

Coffee is decent, people seem friendly, but not very efficient. Long line moves pretty slow. Not entirely the staff's fault - some patrons pay cash and take awhile, but a sandwich does take quite a bit. Just plan ahead of time so you don't miss your flight!

Is this the only DD in the Midwest NOT offering happy hour iced teas or coffees?  Either they didn't get the memo, or they aren't interested in business, and based on the emptiness of the parking lot, they may want to try something different - a national promotion maybe?

My room was fantastic, but SPG could improve their loyalty offerings.  Gold doesn't get you much these days, and I'm sacrificing my Diamond Hilton membership to stay.  Also, I'd recommend updating your app to include folios to avoid calling and requesting an extra copy. Last, SPG only offers prepay deals through its app????
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've been here a few times & have had varying experiences.  The sushi is delicious & they have an overwhelming amount of rolls to choose from.  The hibachi is wonderful & the portions are huge.  However, service is hit or miss, and that is a crucial part of the dining experience, in my opinion.

slowest mcdonalds on the planet sat in line for over 15 mins and never even got to the window to pay. horribly slow unapologetic service. then, while youre waiting you always have to contend with crackheads and heroin addicts soliciting change from you and everyone else in the drive thru line.  avoid like the plague.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: AWESOME!! My girlfriends and I just came here for some mexican, drinks and chatting and had a great time. The food was super tasty, the atmosphere was great, the prices are low and our server was THE BEST. I would go to any restaurant this kid served at. Great experience - go to this El Limon location if you have a chance!!

Great little frozen yogurt place.  Very clean and slightly futuristic.  Even with what I consider to be a lot of frozen yogurt and a generous portion of toppings, my total was barely $3!  I have been here once before and plan of coming back when I get a sweet craving again.

My guess is this is one of many touristy low quality traps that you fall into being new to a touristy city. The food was nothing special, bread and pizza came out cold. Staff is disinterested. Overall nothing terrible but so many better options in the city.

We have been to rodeo Burger a couple of times when it first opened and it was outstanding homemade fresh patties soft buns awesome toppings amazing honey dill dip for the french fries. 
however the last two times we've been back the patties of shrunk not as fresh tasting and not to as good of value for money

I am saddened to say that this place has slipped mightily.  The buffet used to be pretty good, but the pizza was pretty bad, the warm items were stale and the selection was sparse.  The baklava was still good, but that was about it.  Even the service has gotten slow.  Goodbye, old friend.

The food was delicious. I ordered the Caprese appetizer and it was one of the best I've had! I also ordered the small portion of the mixed salad and that was also delicious; I really liked the dressing. I had to give this place three stars because the service was very, very slow.

Decent food for hibachi but the atmosphere is a little shady and the other customers aren't the best company.  ALWAYS look in the clipper magazine for a buy 1 get 1 coupon, otherwise you are just overpaying. If you must have hibachi, not horrible, but otherwise I would skip them.

Contrary to the previous review, this is the worse bar I've ever been to.
It was my first time there, was invited for a friends birthday. Horrible DJ, smelly and dingy, very unfriendly regulars...(at least the people I had run ins with were unfriendly). Will never go again.

Its okay. The food is always piping hot and sometimes ready in as little as three minutes which makes me a little curious. The egg rolls are really good but dont have a lot of pork. The rice is more yellow than fried. The chicken is tasty but sometimes a little fatty.

I really wanted to give this spot a good review but this place is a business before a classic men's barber shop. I don't mind paying a high premium for a premium haircut but I just didn't feel like thats what I got here. To me it seems like you come here for the aesthetics more than anything. Like I said Its business first.

My favorite Chinese restaurant when I lived in Philadelphia. I always make sure to get a meal when I visit philly for work. All of the food is so tasty and inexpensive. The actually restaurant leaves something to be desired, but I'm sure that's how they keep the cost down. They prefer cash, but do accept cards

BYOB so no sake for us but luckily the sushi boat for 2 was amazing enough that we forgot all about it.  Their sushi rolls are great tasting and creative because who doesn't get bored of Philly rolls at some point.  I would definitely return to this restaurant when back in the neighborhood.

If you need decent fast food, Rally's is a good place to go. Open late so good for a quick drive through on your way home from work or a night out. The fries, in my humble opinion, are much better than McDonald's.  They run pretty good deals so this makes it budget friendly. Their shakes are pretty tasty too.
