Good location. Clean and bright interior. Very nice employees who allowed me to literally try 9 flavor a lol. A small is 2
Scoops and served with a waffle triangle . The bourbon flavor in the bourbon pecan is so potent. Loved it. Everything I tasted was good. Lemon was delicious

I went with a friend this week to get a gel manicure and our experience was quite pleasant! The man at the counter was a bit quick and determined to get us to pick a color and take a seat, but we didn't mind! It's not the fanciest place but everything seemed cleaned and orderly. The ladies who helped us were very sweet as well!

So convenient and the closest market to those of us who live near rittenhouse square. But it's way overpriced. Rather walk a few extra blocks and shop at trader joes or ride my bike to whole foods where the produce is much fresher and better tasting. Other than that, this is a great little market to get your milk,eggs,and bread.

Awesome place! Very nicely maintained. Have lived here for 5 years since they opened. Easy access to riverine and Philly and shopping in cherry hill without being on a major highway. Nice marina down in riverton. Bike ride in the summer along there are fun

Everyone was very nice and the atmosphere was great.  Exactly what you would expect from an authentic Mexican restaurant, but it was just ok for me.  The salsa was great and the chips were good, just nothing special.  A great place if you are looking for clean, cheap and Mexican.

Couldn't be more impressed by how this owner runs his business. I use cufflinks and collar stays and often leave them in, the owner goes through by hand and removes and reapplied each. Further, he delivers to my business and often goes out of his way to make small repairs on his own. Just amazed by this small business owner.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Very neat atmosphere, low key chill
Environment ! I've been for both brunch and dinner. They have a limited menu for both. For brunch I had an omelette and was the best omelette I've ever had. For dinner I had the chicken sandwich with apple slaw . It was good for what it was. The only thing I'd change is a larger menu..

I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but I tried to eat here today and they are gone! The place has been gutted inside and there is a for lease sign on the door. One of my favorite burger places since I was a kid is now one for the history books. Tis a sad day.

I love a quick take-out pie as much as the next lady, and I'm usually partial to Papa John's--love those banana peppers! But this location is just so lame. Our pies have been incorrect, often quite cold and don't seem to be fully cooked. Obviously not all franchise locations are equal and this one is just bad.

Absolutely loved this place! Great atmosphere, incredible staff, and amazing food. I had the burger and I ended up licking my fingers. Be sure to try the kale started its incredible. Don't expect and honey mustard sauce or hunts ketchup everything is made in house.

Unique and tasty ice cream flavors. 

This funky little ice cream shop offers a wide variety of interesting flavors. If you are feeling adventurous try lavender or chickory coffee. If you want to play it safe, try their delicious classic chocolate ice cream.

Wonderful and attentive staff with succinct service. Nashville doesn't have a lot of options for Italian food that isn't dated by their dishes. Moto is the innovator in this category. They executed the dishes, the ambiance and the service very well. Highly recommend.

The best compliment I can give this restaurant comes from years of travel dining. Having had dinners at Per Se, French Laundry and a list of Michelin started restaurants. I would still choose a Catbird menu and intimate dining experience hands down EVERY SINGLE TIME.

I was here for lunch and the drive-thru and line inside was so busy.  There was only one person taking orders for inside and it took 15 minutes.  The food at A&W is always good but when the service sucks, it's not worth the wait!  Not sure if they only have one person working at lunch all the time since it was my first time here.

The guy Jim is an arrogant jerk who debates how i want my hair done  Thus far he's berated his staff and Insulted my hometown, made anti- gay jokes and anti- semetic comments about not wanting to work with Jews. His staff looks like they are out of an 80s music video.  I won't be returning..

Sakana is one of my go-to sushi places. They have the best calamari in town and I like the variety of rolls they offer. I wish they had more rolls with Salmon in them, but the ones they have are top notch. The service is usually pretty good and their in house ice cream is really good. I will definitely be back.

After my last yelp posting, Retro quickly fixed the machines that weren't working. I feel that complaints at the gym or over the phone never got to management. Despite this, one Yelp posting resulted in swift action from management. Thanks for fixing them as promised!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Amazing sushi...fresh, flavorful, and deliciousness!  Why only 4 stars?? Too expensive! Some tuna sashimis were over $8-10...and most significant rolls were $13+! Too much, especially for the area and atmosphere. 

Tip: This place doesn't serve alcohol and is BYOB! So bring your own bubbles if you want alcohol...

While this place is truly unique and has awesome history, I find the drinks just ok.  Cool atmosphere, not too noisy to take a date here.  Bartenders are friendly.  They have happy hour.  You get to walk through Reilly's upstairs and take in that awesome food smell on your way downstairs.  All in all, not bad.

This is another welcome addition to the ever-growing Tap-houses in downtown St. Petersburg.  They could've scored better but during my visit my first draft beer was a little bit flat. They replaced it and I got a better draft.  The menu is limited, but I think they are still building it out  
The ambience and location is excellent

Very disappointed.  I order chimichanga and it was very bland as was the green chilies sauce.  My friend specified she was vegan and asked about the base of beans and rice.  Both chicken based.  She ordered nachos without meat and it came with the BEANS even after explaining vegan... no meat.

Just left, had carpets cleaned and the "best" car wash included. It took 1.5 hours to do those two things and it was a crappy job. Still bugs on the car, the carpets were not done all the way, like under the seats or moving the van seats at all. Waste of time and money.

Otra Vez is really good but not 5 stars. Their steak taco is probably the best in the city but their big entrees are a little off the mark, the beef rib is good but not great and other items are a bit pricy for what you get. Otra Vez does have great service though. I'll try it again sometime.

Everything you could possibly ask for in a restaurant! The waitresses were super nice, the food and drinks were delivered very quickly even for a Saturday night, and everything was delicious!! The bento box was a steal for $20 and I left full. My girlfriend and I definitely have our new spot!!!

This is my favorite anytime-Asian place on the south side! They have Chinese, Japanese, Thai, and sushi. Everything is very reasonably priced and they have sushi specials on Monday. They also have a different drink special every day. 

I really like the pad Thai, shrimp tempura roll, teriyaki chicken, and general tso's chicken!

Typical Starbucks, but the workers are so much nicer than I expected!  They were so easy to talk to and even cheered me on as I studied for my actuarial exam. By now, we all know what to expect at a Starbucks, but that was one thing that stuck out to me while I was there -- and I was there for quite a while!

I'm usually not a fan of El Maguey for my Mexican fix but it was the closest while we were in the area. I will say I was very pleased . Much better than the one by my house. The food was fresh and tasty. I heard the one by me has improved greatly do I may have to try them again.

Was in the mood for some Chinese and this place came highly rated here on Yelp. Nice little place. Staff was very friendly. The menu was standard American Chinese. Crab Rangoon were good, not the best I've had but still tasty. I went with the General Zoals with fried rice. Plenty of food and was good going down.

Nice & friendly staff but dangerously small and unorthodox parking lot. (Totally not their fault!)

Great location 1.5 miles away from my daily Rte 95 commute to and from Philadelphia. They uphold the Starbucks standards and I recommend this location if you're in the area.

Remarkably
nice neighborhood bar!  Had a really
good cheeseburger, washed down with a quality Irish Whiskey.  Small, quiet and neighborly.  A short walkfrom the Bourbon Street mayhem.  This cirner if New Irleans has three first rateburger establishments, but the vibe here is great.

Ginza is your run of the mill Japanese restaurant. Nothing too special is going on there. The sushi and habachi shrimp plate left me nourished but not satisfied.
Overall- just your average joe 

*** Giving them three because they were so nice and happy ***

This was an adorable diner-type establishment. There was plenty of parking in the rear, which was great. The staff was friendly! Menu was extensive, lots of choices! I got blueberry pancakes and sausage. Their sausage was awesome. Pancakes were good as well! Prices were fair! Overall a good experience!

This is a go to for sushi in the city.  Their lunch specials are superb and I love dinner as well. We have our usual orders for rolls but will switch up the special rolls because they all are great!
They don't use rice as fillers so the rolls are actually great quality.

Nice updates to the hotel.  Very small bathroom.  Had an exterior room and you can hear everything including the cars going by outside on the highway...kind of soothing when going to sleep until the morning when housekeeping rolls by with carts that sound like freight trains.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I didn't really like my sandwich I got here. I got the jalapeño cheese bread and it was tasteless and dry. I could tell it was old. Also I got tomatoes and cucumbers which were mush because they were overripe. Usually they're a lot better than this but today wasn't it. The staff is very friendly though.

This has quickly become a favorite of mine and my husband's! We used to make the trek down to Takamatsu, but after trying here we may just stick with it. It's a little pricier bit the service and quality is just incredible (: We've been here 3 or 4 times so far and will be making it a regular thing at this point!

Three Stars is being generous. My husband and I ordered hibachi and sushi. Sushi was OKAY, the slices were pretty thin. My hibachi came out COLD, drenched in sauce and my steak was WELLLL done (when I asked for medium rare). Don't waste your time here, go across the street to Sakura.

This is like chipotle for pizza. The ingredients are premium, and I'm pretty sure you can add unlimited toppings. Each pie is made to order down the assembly line and comes out on a wooden block. Everything is customizable. Taste and presentation were all on point and the pie is a steal at $7.99.

Not the place to go for late night munchies in the summer time.  When it's already hot and humid outside, they should probably have AC.  Coupled with a hot kitchen and you're in for a sweaty mess waiting for your food.  Pizza slices are pretty quick, but wings take a while.  Open late and dirt cheap, two positives = 2 stars.

Employees aren't the nicest but service is always quick and efficient. Went there during the lunch rush and was still able to be in and out within 20 minutes. 

The dining space is small but clean and pleasant. Limited parking in the area and that matches the available seating in the restaurant.

For some reasons my latte wasn't really strong (usually double shots take you right there), it's creamier than usual. Otherwise, the staff is very friendly as the rest of Nashville, and it's a cute little coffee shop in conjunction to the Thompson hotel. Wish I had ordered some pastries, they look yummy!

Don't waste your precious time or money. Service was super slow and food was way too expensive for portion. Also, our plate was served with a totally different green than was on the menu. They'll have to step it up if they want to compete with other Italian places nearby.

Had a business lunch with a fairly large party here yesterday and loved it. Very good Italian food, excellent service. It will be a 60-90 minute trip from home but, I plan to take my wife here soon. All of the dishes looked delicious and everyone enjoyed their selection.

Loved this place! I got the vanilla charcoal ice cream in a chocolate cone with Oreo dust and pocky. I liked how it came with 2 free toppings. The ice cream was delicious, not too sweet but very messy. The black ice cream stained my hands a little but easily washed off. I would go again and get rainbow sprinkles.

When I lived in Dtown, I'd come here often for a slice or two of cheese pizza.  It always tasted very fresh and delicious, but your typical greasy pizza.  The outdoor seating is nice in the warmer months too.  I tried a few entrees there too which were good. Great place for greasy pizza!

Ok so I believe I spent a total of an hour, hour and a half here, without an appointment. I'd say not too bad, but i'd expect it to be quicker if I had an appointment.  The staff and the optometrist are nice enough. No complaints there. Overall, was a good experience.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This is a great find in Shiloh!  The prices are very reasonable and the pancakes are fluffy.  My wife had the biscuits and gravy which were just ok.  The service was very good with many coffee refill offers.  I would definitely go back to try other things on the menu.  The only main drawback is it's cash only.

I had an early meeting in this neighborhood so I stopped at this new Maryland Heights Starbucks because I was early for the meeting. I got a Venti Jade Citrus Mint Hot Tea. The place was mobbed. The drive thru was mobbed. The mobile order pickups were mobbed. I got my tea and it was HOT!

So this is a brand new Blue Iguana just like the one on the rock road. I'll say the same for this one as I will for the other one. For $3 this is a super bargain. You get their basic car was and unlimited vacuuming. Who can beat that? Not the best car wash ever but more than adequate for the price!

The food was good, the service poor. It felt stuffy and a bit pushy. Our server forgot our wine, didn't check on our food after it was served, and we had to ask 3 times for bread. I specified it was a birthday at the time of reservation as well as told our server, who still failed to acknowledge.

This was last minute find as our AirBNB was awful.....the staff were super friendly and more than willing to do anything to help our stay to be amazing and they succeeded! Room was clean and beds were comfortable. We ate on the upper deck at night and it just felt so outta time and surreal.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Armature works is such a cool spot and this ice cream place was very creative and innovative! The ice cream was delicious and the presentation was perfect. Only reason this isn't getting a 5 star review is the flavor of the "red velvet" cone was actually no flavor.

Uhhhh.. okay so let me start that the place looks great and customer service was A+ but the sushi needs to have better quality fish.. I'll leave this as my initial review because I will give this restau another chance, looks like they have potential. Menu has a lot of offerings btw

I came here for lunch with a co worker one day and the service was friendly but very slow and it was not busy at the time. We ordered sushi and it was good but not worth the wait. If you are on a time limit I recommend calling in to place your order before hand. The decor is very nice it feels very high end. It was a bit pricey

Service has gone downhill. Waitresses are slow and rather rude. Have come three times each time missing a dressing or a drink or out of something major. 

**only for the cook** cooks are fabulous but can't make up for lack of help w bad owners and wait staff. They do great work w what they are given! 

Sushi is sub par.

Very rarely eat here because the service is iffy.. Tonight, it was fabulous! Very quiet and very few people in the restaurant. I guess that is why the waitress kept refilling our drinks. Jackie was a great cook and did a good job introducing the whole concept to the newbie at our table. I would go back, perhaps for lunch.

This car wash was awesome. I paid $10 and my car came out nice.  It is a do it yourself car wash so you will have to scrub our car with a brush and soapy water before you go into the car wash and then vacuum your car at the end. It a great place I will definitely be going back.

I ordered the red fish and it was very good. The atmosphere and the music was very cozy and friendly. The service wasn't very good seemed rushed and they weren't knowledgeable regarding the food that was served. Didn't care for the unfriendly service not sure if I will return I didn't get a very welcoming feel.

3.5 stars. The food is consistently good but prices are high for a sandwich you could make at home. I love the juice and crazy old goat. The patty melt was just ok. The staff is courtesy and upbeat.  I eat here once a while when I'm craving something cheesey, but would eat here more often if they dropped the prices a little.

Big selection and a monstrous size store. Pretty good job of rotating through product given it's size. Very pricy, but they carry considerably more than the average liquor store. Great tasting area and huge growler bar. Staff knowledge has marked improvement from when they first opened !

This was my first time here. The service was fine. We order a Ahi Tuna app. It was not very good, I guess I expected the tune to be top grade and it wasn't. My boyfriend and I order this app at different places. It happens to be our favorite. We both were disappointed.

Good proportions for the dinner servings.  Prices are average.  Chicken and broccoli is delicious.  Vegetable servings could be better (General Tso's had about 3 pieces of broccoli compared to 40 pieces of chicken).  Amicable service and fast cooking.  We will eat here again.

Monthly membership is really cheap!  Not strict about weight dropping like other gyms :)They always keep the place clean.

But 80% machines and 20% free weights. 1 squat rack, 2 smith machines, dumbells go up to 85lbs. Can't bring in my dip belt :(

Watch out for $25 cancelation fees and membership fees increase after 12 months
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Definitely my first stop if I need to pick up some alcohol for the house.   Clean and reasonably priced.  Loved how they sell "The Oyster" sauvignon blanc by Proud Pour.. Every bottle restores 100 oysters to local waters... and it's DELICIOUS! Definitely a hard bottle to find so I will be going back there soon to get more!

really really good!! the food here was yummy and the ambiance was nice. The only thing that id complain about was the fact that we weren't seated for a long time. The food was also a little bit pricey for what it was. I'd say that this place is a little bit more fusion than traditional.

Exactly what you expect. 

Very typical Mexican restaurant for Nashville. Food is good, but not memorable. The ground beef was very flavorless and the salsa tastes store bought. Menu variety and quality is very similar to a Cinco de Mayo or Las Palmas. 

I wouldn't be opposed to eating here again, but it's not a place I'll crave.

I was first introduced to UFO Pizza in its St Paul location. Close to my home town, it was one of the better choices for great pizza, and lasagna.
I was very delighted to discover after moving to St Albert 6 years ago, that a location for this restaurant was fairly close by:)

This review is for the shrimp fajitas. To my disappointment the shrimps and bell peppers lack of flavor although the veggies are fresh and perfectly cooked. The refried beans is very runny and not appetizing. The red Mexican rice is the ok. It comes with warm tortillas. I don't recommend this at all.

The review is for the dessert.

Tiramisu: a lot of lady fingers but I didn't taste the signature mascarpone and the liquor coffee flavor. It's okay.

Hazelnut cannoli is a better dessert option. The shell is very crunchy and definitely taste the Nutella in it. The chocolate or Nutella under it is awesome.

Random little pop shop in Broad Ripple. Popsicle flavors change daily! They are delicious! Some days, they have dry ice if you need to take them to-go and your home isn't so close by. A fun little stop just off the Monon Trail to get something cool to chill off with.

Love this place! Great attention to detail in regards to the decor and atmosphere. Very similar to Vegas! Fun themed meals and drinks and an inviting and colorful menu. Drink specials on Wednesday, including 5 mini martinis for $10! Amazing! Decently priced, good service in a fun yet relaxing environment. Wish I lived closer!

Good sushi although prices are a little high. My gf saw a cockroach climb up in front of her behind the glass where all the fish and shrimp is at. Pretty gross but overall it deserves a decent rating. 

This are my top favorite..they are all good !

1. Rickshaw sushi
2. Hiroba
3. Atlantis
4. Sushi pier
5. Jazmine
6. Wasabi

Service was quick, but not too friendly. Food was correct. My biggest complaint is that this place is not clean. Food on the floor that didn't get picked up, sticky floors, one guy took trash out but didn't bother cleaning up trash around the bin. Bathroom was ok.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: My family stayed here over the thanksgiving holiday.  My father in law said it was the cleanest hotel he had ever stayed.  Kirsten at the front desk was especially helpful sorting out two different reservations to be sure that we were able to pay for the room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Cool barbershop, relaxing atmosphere but must have an appointment. Unfortunately due to my tight schedule and inability to plan ahead for a head cut I don't get to use this place every time I need a haircut. However when I do use church street barber it's always been a pleasant experience.

This place absolutely should be avoided. Dinner for sweet sour chic and fried dumplings all got thrown away. On top of that delivery was over an hour and customers service was below substandard . It's funny because their menu says "Best in Tampa Bay" . Should be redone as "The Worst in Tampa Bay"

Surprised at the negative reviews. It's not a 5-star dining experience but perfect for lunch and a casual dinner. The fried pickle chips and buffalo shrimp are cooked perfectly. Lunch prices are competitive with the area and the decor is pleasing. The menu selection appeals to just about everyone. Definitely worth a visit

Wonderful local deli. If you're in the mood for a good, full sandwich (I'm a turkey sandwich ADDICT), this jawn can't be beat for taste, prices, or freshness. Wide selection of chips, drinks, etc. Always fantastic service from the lovely cashiers and others behind the counter. So happy to have this shop around the corner!!

My wife and I ate here a few weeks ago. The food is decent, but extremely over priced for Mexican food. I ordered one of the tortas and my wife ordered a burrito. Both were good, but not for the prices. I think Burritos and Beer in Noblesville has better tasting food at a fraction of the price.

Came here after a day of Disney. The air conditioned room and the dim mood lights strung across the ceiling were a welcome sight. I got the adult portion of the mac n' cheese and it was the perfect size of cheesy, creamy goodness. (Oh, and that bread is always amazing too)

Living nearby, I can see after one visit this will likely be my go-to pizza/Italian spot. Indoor seating is somewhat limited, so I recommend pickup or delivery if you've got a larger group. I recommend the dolce vita calzone -- delicious and HUGE. The small could easily feed two people. Order accordingly!

This Company and Jessica are awesome.  I had a car going into the auto body shop a friend of mine owns - and their prices and services beat out the big companies I shopped.
I would rather give my business to a locally owned car rental service and I'm glad I made that decision...

Why 1 Star?  How do you run out of Chocolate Ice Cream? Epic Fail!    Also selling a pound of Hawaii Coffee for 64.99 per pound! The guy that was taking my order had no clue what he was talking about. Tried making light of the situation but he was not having it.

Don't even bother going to the drive through, now days.

3 days ago, they were doing a "shift change", at 2 pm, so drive through customers were asked to come in.

Tonight.... 9 PM, they weren't able to take orders at the drive through, either.

I'm coming to the realization, they just can't keep staffed.

Flavors were spot on at this lovely ice cream shop. Small batch homemade flavors that cover the classics plus a couple creative concoctions. Everything we tasted was flavorful, not overpowered by the creaminess of the ice cream as they sometimes are at other places. I like that there's a little outside seating too.

This is my new all time favorite taco spot. Do not be deceived by the fact that's it's a small hole in the wall spot. Service is friendly. Everything is clean and the food is just amazing. I've tried almost all their tacos and burritos and haven't been disappointed yet. Try them you won't be disappointed!

It's not bad,  but not great either. The food was OK the 2 times I have been their, but it never left me craving to go back.

Give it a try if your looking for a new place to go, but in the end you'll probably go back to your usual source for mexican dining.

We had the tofu which was good, the California roll which was huge, the vegetable gyoza and salmon sashimi - not fancy presentation but it tasted good and the owner/server gentleman  was super nice and was quick with our food, clean up and the bill. They are offering 20% off for returning customers till August.

Went through the drive thru. ...for the first time EVER my order was exactly what I ordered.  But the presentation was horrible.  I looked like they just thru my food in the bag. Then they handed me my food, what ever happened to the double fold for freshness.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Good prices.... mostly friendly cashiers.... major downside in  the  late evening they stock... to do that the isles are jam packed with stock. If you are mobility challenged do not even think of trying to shop late. In the plus side, great bulk foods section.

This review is solely on customer service. We ordered drove to the window. We got to the window and paid then waited and waited and waited then she had this out or order not even looking at us not even thinking us luckily I had a hold of the bag before she let go of it just barely

Friendly service, good prices but that's where the good ends. My daughter ordered 2 orders of crazy bread and sauce the Crazy bread was over proofed and overbaked.... Not what we expected... Only we were too far away to go back and complain when we realized all of them were substandard.

Decor in this place is great. I actually feel like i am in Italy. Service was excellent. Food was very good also. Menu is very diverse and offers everything from pizza, meats, poultry, seafood plus usual Italian appetizers and deserts. Items on menu are a little pricey but food was very good.

Conveniently located in Broad Ripple nice grocery store. The selection of items is not nearly wide as in major chains but most of the things are there. As others mentioned, it is pricy, but the quality of products is also better. One thing I wish they sold would be gallon spring water.

I love the idea of a young guy getting his dream fulfilled, but this place isn't real good. The donuts are just a step above Safeway but ar a higher price. Doughboys is way better, they need to work on taste and value. You can't have a higher priced donut at a lower quality. Hopefully they will work on this.

After a little bit of waiting, our party of seven was seated. Food was great! Catfish fillets, coleslaw, and their tartar sauce were pretty good. Blackberry wine cake was really good. Service was very pleasant and atmosphere was good. Only negative was the smoking that's allowed.

I have used Starcrest several times.  They are very good.  The problem I have is they are also very expensive.  The price they charge is at least twice what I was paying in Chicago before moving here.  I have to find another cleaners but really like them.  If you can afford it I recommend them.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: This is a great barber shop where my son and I have been going since they openned. The owners care about their co-workers and customers and it shows in the quality of their work. Although i usually just walk in, the new reservation system is a nice option as lines can get long.

Excellent food, excellent service. When a 9 year old clears their plate faster than everyone else because the food was so good, you know the food is awesome. I got chicken rigatoni, gf got salmon rigatoni, both were awesome as well. I'll def be back again! Q

Huge selection, friendly staff, one problem. Why is this place not open early, or at all on Sundays?? This is the first beer store off of 95 when heading to the stadiums. Its insanity they dont wish to make a killing off all the people trying to tailgate on their way to the stadiums for football. Get with the program guys.

We came in at a little after 7 pm to order a couple of doughnuts and coffee. We were completely ignored. The employees saw us standing there. They never even acknowledged us. They flat out ignored us. Pretended we didn't exist. So... we walked out. No doughnuts for us, no money for them.

I moved to Willingboro a few days ago from Trenton, NJ, where there are chinese spots on every corner. For what it is, it is good. The food taste fresh, the "chicken" was moist and not overfried, the establishment was clean and in a safe area. Best of all, in relation to where i moved, it was withing a SHORT walking distance.

Average pizza at best. I literally think the guy that helped me at the counter was mentally disabled. My pizza was burned a little bit but it was okay. I suggest dining elsewhere if you're looking for good pizza. There are so many good joints nearby (Grimaldis, Rosatis). Not really worth your time.

Their sushi is some of the freshest I've ever had in Indy. I've ordered hibachi there as well and it's really good.  It's a small place so make sure to have a reservation if you have a large party.  Definitely try this place.  It's the best Japanese in town.

Highly recommend thi!

Don't even know what to say other than what the F#*K was that.....how dare you even call that food.... a toddler with a microwave and play dough could make more appetizing food than that...... just don't.... seriously grab a microwave sandwich form 7-11 you'll be a lot less disgusted which is terrifying

Ordered beef and broccoli and genera tso chicken with chicken fried rice and lo mein (extra 3 dollars)... it was decent but not crunchy how I'd prefer or spicy at all... crab Rangoon was great, and the sweet and sour sauce was trash lol but he staff was nice esp since i went an hour before closing.

Not a bad hotel overall.  The rooms are a tad out dated but they're clean. Staff is nice and helpful if you aren't from the area they are willing to help you out.  The restaurant selection in this part of town is slim picking but it's easy access to my work while I'm traveling.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Oh man first time walking in here they had almost everything you could imagine in bulk. Made the mistake of bringing my boy, he piled up on candy! And everything is just priced right. You can buy as much or as little as you need. Thumbs up to whoever created bulk barn

Good Breakfast, decent priced under $10 specials for a basic breakfast of eggs, toast, hashbrowns (meatless) or (with meat) with your choices of bacon, ham or sausage. Both under $10. Perfect portions of meals, not to much and not too little with quick delivery.

As grocery stores go, this is a pretty decent one. Although I do not understand the need for paying to use the carts in this city. Main reason of shopping at Safeway is to gain my airmiles and that it is close to my house. Other than that it is not that great place for food there are better.

Great pizza - it is my boys favorite but professionalism when you pick up your pizza is awful. My husband usually picks up our pizzas but when I did the one man was cursing and complaining the whole time I was there which made me very uncomfortable and not crazy about spending our money there... Hopefully this was a one time thing.

The pizzas here are phenomenal. Had a quick order of the margheritas and boy oh boy were they juicy! I'd support the wings but they could be better, feels like they have the potential for it. Love it and as I speak I ordered again and giving a massive tip cause I missed tipping last time

No Hot Water. Monday, December 1, 2014 from midnight to 4 am. 
2nd time staying at the Delta City Centre. Amazing front desk staff. Friendly house keeping staff. Hotel room itself, a bit run down, even with a great room view. I know I said stay again while on my first stay, but the hotel needs a major reno.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have never rented a car.  My daughter was the one renting but it seemed to me that the staff at this place were just flat-out surly.  It was as though renting a car from them was a major inconvenience to them.  Whatever.  The car was OK and the shuttles were pretty nice but nothing special.

I was skeptical about this location because of some of the reviews, but after I've visited I really like it.  I always see the staff doing daily cleanings on various machines.  All the machines have been in working order when I was there.  The staff is really personable and willing to answer questions
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: LOVED the octopus app. Will continue to dine here just for that. Seated right away. Looks like a house on the outside which adds to the comfortable atmosphere. Outside seating on the porch which is handicapped accessible. The volcano roll was amazing. You won't regret this gem of a sushi house.

First time here and I was really pleased. Menu apparently changes frequently but the stew and burgers we had were superb and reasonably priced. Ambience was very relaxed with an eclectic mix of people and the wait staff was incredibly helpful, attentive, and polite. Absolutely planning on coming back.

This is my first time on Nashville. This was the first place we went and it's literally behind our hotel. Cheap beer and hot dogs... What more could you ask for a bachelor party of 10? I suggest the Tiajuana Dog; spicy yet exciting. Everything else is pretty manageable. Definitely a good time.

Older motel style Inn. Bathroom was like walking into a cave. Bed was extremely uncomfortable (hard). 
They had Starbucks in the atrium but with the renovations going on there was pieces of white dust floating down from the air vents. Like it was snowing. 
On the upside, the restaurant was quite nice. Food and staff was great.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Typical Baskin-Robbins.  They always have good ice cream, shakes and sundays.  The service is good here too.  

The only downside is they way BR process coupons.  They charge the tax of what it would have been before the discount and then give the discount.

We always like Safeway.  The store is smaller then the larger Fry's in the neighborhood and it is easier to find what you want with out all the crowds.  We also prefer there flower and balloon selection.  The employees are great and always friendly.  We also like the US Bank on the inside.

Easy to get to when you get you luggage, but it is a bit of a challenge if  you have not been there before when  you return your car.  If you show up later at night there are very few options for vehicles.  If you are an Emerald Club member then getting your car is easy and if you use their app it is even easier at the checkout.

This place is a good place for Mexican if you are ever downtown. This is in our rotation for lunch establishments. The complimentary chips and salsa are homemade. I usually get one of the gringo tacos with yellow rice. The portions are plentiful and you will never leave hungry!

Took car their yesterday and got to admit that I wasn't very impressed. I paid $24 and they did not do a very good job at drying my vehicle. It had dried soap streaks running down the side. I should have conducted an inspection before I left. Didn't notice it until my next stop!

We always shop here just because it's convenient. The food quality is not the best and it is not under the best management. My wife who's in there 3 times a week asked a manager for boxes and they were so rude to her. I understand it's not their problem but show a little courtesy.

Excellent authentic Italian fare. You can really taste the difference between real homemade and the local chains. This is very similar to the neighbor restaurants that you might get in Queens. Real red sauce made with fresh tomatoes and handmade pasta make this place the best in Brandon.

It's alright. Our server kept calling us 'amigos' every 10 seconds which felt pretty forced and inauthentic, but she was nice enough, although slow. The beans had too much oil/lard in them, and the floor was pretty messy, and the rest of the food was just a little less that mediocre. Probably wouldn't go back.

Found this place thanks to Hidden Trenton.  The pizza is official! The pizza definitely has my stamp of approval. My officemates were impressed as well. I've had it twice in the last week! Only other thing I had on the menu was the buffalo wings, which were also solid.

Love that they're on Grubhub. Makes ordering a snap.

They had really great flavors, the fruit looked a little old. I love putting fruit on my fro-yo so this was a little disappointing. The place was very clean and I enjoyed my ice cream. I signed up for their rewards program, so I am looking forward to trying this place again!

I'm giving this place five stars because it definitely deserves more. The staff was so friendly when I arrived and I randomly got a complimentary upgrade for our room. There are so many great amenities and the price is something you can't beat for the value. Excited for the rest of our stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Went on Mother's Day before the dinner crowd.  The food was better than average, but it took longer than I thought it should to get.  When we were there the restaurant wasn't even half full.

I would be willing to go again to see if it was a "off" day for the service.

Very disappointed! Never used this car wash before but decided to try it since I was driving by and I knew it was a newer establishment. For spending $18 on the top wash and still coming out of the washer with the back side of my jeep dirty and mud still on the sides. I was upset! I'll drive to my regular car wash for now on!

Went to Lee's Friday night to get some Vodka.  It was 8:30 and it was pretty busy, lines down the isle waiting to check out.  You would think they would have more than just 2 cashiers working, maybe someone called in.  But if they want to keep getting out business they better step it up!!!

I went through about 6 of the appetizers with a friend and they were all great and creative. I was happy to find a restaurant serving something other than the usual steak, wings, etc. that every other place does and it was all tasty. The service was friendly and helpful. I hope this place takes off.

This dunkin donuts never has options. We ask for a boston cream, they just say "sorry we dont have those right now". Ok, we ask for a chocolate chocolate and ofcourse "sorry we dont have that right now either.... Um ok what do you have? - "glazed and strawberry". Wow why dont they just say that in the first place.

Nice hotel and the staff is very friendly. The one down side is that it is a bit noisy at night. You can hear people walking outside on the tile and if the bar has a band it can be a little loud. I would get a room at the far side if possible. The pillows are not so great so I brought my own this time. The rooms are nice and clean.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We had the four course menu with wine pairing, which was an excellent combination during the whole meal. The truffle infused bread and the veal cheeks with sweetbreads were the absolute highlights. Also, the raspberry beer was superb. But the bluefish was boring and gave me nothing special.

Ordered carry out last night.  Packaging and presentation left a lot to be desired.  Food portion appeared to be smaller than when eating in.  I was still hungry afterwards.  Maybe they haven't updated their menu on line as I was charged $2.00  more than stated. Hostess was not as personable as she could have been.

I highly recommend this hotel for any our out of town guests who want to enjoy easy access to the most beautiful beach in town, Butterfly Beach, and the famed Four Seasons Biltmore, as well as the chic shops and restaurants on Coast Village Rd. It is clean, very well-staffed and in a highly desirable walking location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: It was my first time here and was pretty good! The pizza wasn't too greasy and all the staff were so nice. And the prices are pretty reasonable. With tax I paid about $10 for a small pepperoni, which is totally big enough to be shared with two people. The free ice cream at check in is cool too!

So fun!  There's an air hockey machine, upstairs patio to people watch. Bunch of tourist types drinks if your feeling that and live music. The drinks aren't strong and they are pricey but if you have a couple drinks before coming in it's a good, really fun spot! Always have a great time here!

Definitely not my favorite Starbucks. They have messed up my order numerous times. It's especially annoying when you initially order in the drive thru then you have to go in and get your drink fixed. They weren't very apologetic for messing up the order either.

The service was a bit slow at first but improved once we ordered drinks. The food was excellent and there was a lot to choose from. It is very reasonably priced with large portions. Only major negative was the bathroom. The Bathrooms was disgusting! Which is never good at a Mexican restaurant.

Brown butter almond brittle ! Salted Caramel! Bramble berry crisp ! MIlkiest Chocolate in the world ! 
I feel like that's all I need to say ! All the flavors are amazing. These are my favorites and I absolutely love them ! My husband and I love ice creams and this place is definitely our  goto place for ice creams.

As a McDonald's you already expect a steaming pile of  on a tray served by most unemployable folks but this location really helps lower the bar. 

I dare anyone drive through for a bite at night and see the incredible talent that has been procured for this establishment.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: food is ok- really hit or miss- I ordered one of the specials which was suppose to come with spaghetti- They gave me like 2 noodles-it was ridiculous- so I complained to the waitress -she then comes out with a family style bowl of spaghetti -I mean for a $22.00 special the portion should of been bigger-

This is probably the best nail salon I've ever been to! I didn't have to wait or anything. The man did a fantastic job on both my toes and hands. I had never done the paraffin wax before and I absolutely loved it! My feet have never felt smoother. I will definitely be coming back every month.

We were here for lunch. We had a chicken katsu lunch box which was ok and 3 rolls from lunch special. The spicy salmon and eel avocado roll was GREAT. The Asashi roll was not good. It was a total of 24$. The service was GREAT.. the waitress was really attentive.

The ambiance, the food, the staff, everything was amazing ! It was great getaway for a night out with a friend to catch up on life. We enjoyed appetizers, a bottle of wine and delicious pasta! The tables were all socially distanced, the staff wore masks and were so attentive. I just loved this place and can't wait to go back!

All I can say is food and service is PHENOMENAL!!! Popped in for a casual date night. Got some specials in appetizers and entrees. Boom. Shawn/not if the dead was great and personable. Every recommendation was on point. Will come back again and again. Shout out to chef Jeff, formerly of le bec fin. I can eat this food forever.

We got 4 tempura rolls of different flavors and waited 45 minutes for our order.  I have never waited so long for my food at a restaurant where you are the only customer.  All tempura rolls tasted exactly the same, maybe it was for the amount of batter they had.

I always feel welcome here even though the new décor seems it dose not want you hanging out. Customers seem to treated on a personal family level. They are top Notch when they are on there game but sometimes it seems to get a bit frantic and confused. Most of the Baristas  personalities just bubble over

I got there at noon. the donuts they had there looked really good, but there were no "old fashioned maple" (my favorite). only one person working so a long wait. so I left. like I said the donuts looked really good so I may try again, but not on the weekend.

I use to like this place, but it appears this place has recently changed ownership. the food has gone downhill. the fried rice was ok, had more meat then usual. the sesame chicken sauce didn't taste good and the fried wonton had an odd flavor. I don't like it here anymore.

Insanely bad. Waited 45 mins for a table. Food came out slow and mediocre. Ordered dessert and bill came without dessert so we thought it was comped. Turns out the waitress forgot to put our order in. Never got dessert. Had to leave. Worst dining experience in a very long time. Would have rather stayed home and ordered pizza.

Go here if you dare lolll

Horrible service and out of stock by 10am. Why open a Dunkin in one of this fastest growing cities and never have donuts. They should put a sign up that says "NO DONUTS" so when you pull in, you don't end up waiting in a line for 20 min to be told "no donuts".

I got take out since I was staying in the hotel. It was ready very quickly. The host called me when it was ready so I could come pick it up. I had a cheese steak. It's no Genos, but it was good. The fries were fresh and seasoned well. All in all I was happy with my meal and would come back. Service was very friendly was well.

Really heavy traffic in the drive-thru! Otherwise, this place is pretty good. I like to go here the most when it isn't breakfast, lunch or dinner (which are the busiest times. 

There's a great atmosphere here. It's probably in my top 5 favorite Starbucks in Nashville.

Ate there tonight but was very disappointed by people working there. Service to the customers is obviously a low priority here. Personnel all looked like HS folks with no training on how to make customers welcome here! Food was okay but had to wait five minutes before anyone noticed i was standing there waiting to give my order.

Ordered a large cheese pizza for pickup from Slice on a Friday evening. It was ready in about 20 minutes. The crust was thin and very crispy, good if you're in the mood for that sort of thing. My dining partner loved it and it was a solid fresh pizza, but not the best I've ever had.

It's very overpriced , and the food is mediocre.. my husband ordered the lamb and had to send it back 3 times because it wasn't cooked correctly. I've had better meals.. it was my birthday so I had high hopes for this place ( since I've wanted to try it for a while) .. it's pretty overrated .

Best ice cream on earth. The end. How can something be so delicious? I don't understand it. The flavors are so unique and intensely accurate. Lavender honey, salted caramel, and petit four? Who is back there creating these amazing flavors? I can't handle it.

This Publix is set up nicely, is extremely elegant, and immaculately clean. There are so many employees here who are eager to help and answer questions. The one closer to my house seems to be the opposite as far as customer service. I may drive farther and come to this one  keep up the great work!

My favorite self wash car wash. It's pretty inexpensive also. Just bring your own towels. I typically don't have to wait that long. They also have a touch less drive through wash, which is great and won't end up scratching up your car.
As an added bonus you can get some cool pictures of your car there .

Their ice cream is good, but they are frequently out of toppings and stuff like that. It's annoying when you order a Hot Fudge Sunday, they make it and then at the end tell you they are out of Hot Fudge. The person looked at me like I was weird for not wanting the Hot Fudge Sunday if they did not have Hot Fudge.....

In my opinion the Hand Grenade (Tastes like a Melon and Vodka mix) is okay, a better tasting drink there is the Shark Attack! Which is a vodka sour, and comes with a shark toy!

Don't forget to use the free photobooth on the juke box!

Also you can go upstairs and look down at the busy Bourbon Street!

Solid spot but a bit to0 adventurous in flavors and textures. Perfect example is the foie with blueberries and chocolate which just didn't go.  Very fair price for the portion size. Good for Florida, would get lost in  a bigger market. I'd like to check back in a year or so once chef gets a bit more focus.

Just nachos!  Served on a small metal bake pan with a variety of toppings.  Frozen liquor drinks can be obtained at Norwals next door - they have a joint agreement.  If you just want an appetizer - don't want table service in Streets of St. Charles - this is the place.

I eat fish on Friday's during Lent and the McD fish sandwich is probably the best tasting fish sandwich out there. Even the bun seems fresher and tastier than what is used for other sandwiches here.

With a current 2 for $4 special, it's a really good deal.

Combined with a $1 large soda for a fast, fresh and satisfying meal.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Love this specific Subway, they are always friendly and happy! The store is very clean, and the owner is almost always there. 

I love adding all the fresh ingredients to my sandwich. I have never ever had any issue with my food from this place. 

I will definitely be going back!

If you hate the colour pink, this is not your place. There is a ton of pink vinyl booths. It's definitely something from the 80's. 

This is a great place for lunch. They have great specials. The food is always hot, fast and delicious! The prices are very reasonable. 

The staff is very friendly and accommodating.

This is the perfect store right outside of Phill if you need any kind of drink with sugar. Due to Phillys soda tax a two litter is almost $5.00! And for someone like me who entertains a-lot I will never ever pay for that tax! 

I do find that they do have decent deals and if you have a store card you can earn gas rewards.

Beautiful decor, great atmosphere, amazing food! My husband and I were thinking how it's NY prices but better quality than most we have had at this price point. He had udon noodles and I had a few rolls (Spicy Salmon is a must!) Flavors were great- not too strong but tasteful! :) We enjoyed our experience!

Just ate here for the first time on Valentine's Day.   Staff was awesome!  Bread was awesome! Food was awesome! Wife loved the chilled wine.  My Rib Eye steak was phenomena and my wifes stuffed chicken with alfredo just as good.  We had a great experience and will be comimg back again.  Very cozy atmosphere as well.  Great job!

It's clearly a really old facility. Broken ceiling tiles, water stains in the ceiling, 5 seats for the entire place. A woman who was sweeping gave me an attitude because I didn't pick up a dryer sheet that I didn't know fell. It got the job done but I'll probably try a different place next time.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Great sushi with affordable prices! We ordered Take-Out and were satisfied with the order. We ordered a variety of different types of sushi rolls which all tasted fresh and delicious. The sushi rolls were nicely presented on a tray which was a surprise to us. Overall, it's a nice restaurant to get a quick Take-Out meal.

Just got the Frenchmen Scallops and Lake Pontchartrain Roll, the roll was pretty good but the scallops... were very tiny as you can see a water bottle cap for comparison. And were inedible, tasted like straight salt! I love eating scallops. I feel really ripped off with the scallops, very disappointed.

Was disappointed.

Appetizers: 
Bruschetta was subpar; Bread was soggy.
Gnocchi was prepared perfectly. Unfortunately it was completely submerged in vat of a oil. 

Main:
Unidentifiable pasta dish that was also served in a pool of the same oil . 

Dessert:
Tiramisu was delightful. Thoroughly enjoyed it.

Hands down the best dishes I've had since I moved to Reno. Me and a girlfriend got the Moroccan meatballs and beef daube to share and both were impeccable. I personally liked the beef daube better, as did my friend. This place definitely just became a regular spot for me.

Inconsistent service. Sometimes quick but more times slow as in worst case 15-20 minutes. Mostly correct with orders but mess up at least 1 in 6 times in my experience. Customer service trends toward apathetic. I only go here when it is most convenient location-wise. Food and drink quality is on par with other stores in the chain.

There are only two reasons this is not a full five stars: Price & Portion sizes. The food is outstanding and the staff is very friendly. Their homemade bread is INCREDIBLE but I did find their desserts were 'okay'. Great place to stop by for some early dinner but I would never want to pay the full price.

Came here multiple times this past summer and it's been weirdly packed on saturday nights! I definitely enjoy the speakeasy vibe and not gonna lie, the $4 whiskey shot + coors special did my friend group dirty. The mixologists (bartenders) are always quirky and make the drinks like no other!

Veggie pizza devoid of sauce.
Garlic rolls devoid of garlic.
Pizza crust devoid of texture/flavor.
Wallet devoid of a fair amount of cash for this experience.
Walnut strawberry salad liked by wife - only save to the meal.
Pass.
Cappy's smokes it hands down.

Great ambiance, solid, hearty flavorful dishes, on point service at an equally reasonable price point.
A table in the alleyway between the restaurant and it's neighbor conjures amalfi coast cafe dreams. 
Our server Allison was delightful and cheery.
Two thumbs way up!

Courteous hosting, available parking across the street on University, and a nice ambiance set the stage for a very pleasant evening with great food.
Zuppa de Pesce was the real deal with chunks of fish along with the shellfish. Shrimp Papardelle
very nice. Bread - meh. Overall experience still great and planning to return!

Very nice employees but our food we got to go just wasn't very good.  The sushi was mushy and bland.  Every roll tasted the same and after two or three bites of each we lost our appetite and couldn't eat anymore.  We were hoping for better but just didn't happen.  Wish I could say positive bc the employees and restaurant were nice.

I stopped by here on the way to the mall and I'm so happy I did. I had an incredible dinner and was able to watch NFL playoffs in front of me. So my fiancé is happy with her shopping and I'm suffice with football. Excellent pizza,  very fresh, and very flavorful. I will definitely be back!

The shark attack drink is definitely one to get and don't the bartenders know that! The one who made our drink had zero facial expression and just went through the motions as he put it all together. He might have forgotten the alcohol because it really just tasted like a shirley temple.

Unfortunately the service wasn't the best, (unfriendly) the food was cold, the chicken was really cheap and the sauces were bland. I've never had terribly ski chicken where the teriyaki was tasteless.  No wasabi and small portions just made is a very I enjoyable experience. I really wasn't impressed.

This was a "one and done" for us. The sushi is not fresh, doesn't taste good at all. The place looks dark. The quality of the food is like a Chinese buffet like they've been sitting there for hours. We left with a nasty taste in our mouth. The service is okay.

Took my cat to the clinic few times and Dr. Mary is very caring and kind. She's soft spoken and very respectful in answering all my questions. The entire staff is nice too and they often take the time to get to know me and my pet. Prices are reasonable so this place is now my new go to.

They cleaned half my dashboard and totally skipped everything all around my radio area. Posted on their FB page with no response. I don't think they even monitor it. I won't be back. Total waste of $30. AND you're supposed to tIP. That's a thing of the past at the newer places should be here too. Thoroughly unimpressed.

came in for lunch they seemed very short staffed. we sent back our side of ranch because there was strings in it.  Our waitress was very nice but was serving the place by herself so it was hard for her to keep up.  my food wasn't bad but was way over priced for what we got all around.

A Subway is a Subway but what I like about this one is the lunch crew.  They have worked here for a very long time and hey get it right every time.  I have to say the dinner crew needs improvement.  They are teens but listen when people are speaking to you.  Other than that it is clean and the toppings are fresh.

Joe's Pizza is one of the most well rounded pizza, pasta, and sub shops around. They have wonderful salads as well. Whether it's a quick stop for lunch or a family dinner environment I highly recommend any of their locations. Multiple spots to choose from in the metro east area.

Delicious food and friendly staff. I like the fact that they have a lot of stuff other places don't usually carry, like uni. Their salmon and hamachi melt in your mouth. So good!
They are extra careful and even check temperatures here. Family' new favorite sushi place.

I stopped here to grab a quick bite before I came to work. And I was hoping to be in and out but that wasn't the case. Drive thru was not busy but it took forever for me to pay for my food and to receive my food. The food was decent but the customer service was just very slow.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Got to love a Chase with a drive-thru ATM and bank teller lane. I've never set foot inside this branch because I'm always able to do my banking from my car. 

One time, I found a $20 bill around the corner from this Chase, so I consider this a sign that this place is lucky.

I rather like that the person behind the counter is the one to dispense the frozen yogurt and add toppings. It seems more sanitary that way. If you are a person who likes a lot of toppings, though, then this lack of control might bother you. You could always just ask the person behind the counter for more toppings, I suppose.

Got there at 9:15 on a Saturday night. Employees inside, but the doors are locked. Tried the drive thru, honked, no response. Sign says open until 10pm. Girl completely ignored us. 
We frequent this location as our family dessert place. 
Never again. You just lost our business.

I think it's hard to mess up Froyo too much, the flavors are ok and they offer nice discounts for liking them on Facebook. But it's not the most professional spot. It's all a certain age group working to serve the same age group.  I get it, it's not great or terrible,  just average.

2nd time dining at Osteria Natalina.  Service was again excellent. I ordered the salmon special with pink lobster sauce and my favorite pear sacchitinis.   I tried my friends' other dishes -  lobster bisque,  caprese salad,  grilled shrimp and scallop,  and lasagna.   Everything was delicious,  this place never disappoints!

We have taken our animals here for a few years. Very friendly staff, reasonable prices, and clean. We had a couple of our dogs put to sleep, they were very understanding, polite and helpful. Gave us all the time we needed to visit with our babies. Check up on you. The do send out for cremation. I would recommend this place.

Absolutely amazing! Excellent service and quality  food! Can not wait to go back again!!!! The boar shanks were out of this world. We had a party of 12 and we all shared our pasta , meat and fish dishes...so delicious & a fun/professional wait staff. The restaurant was clean and had the perfect ambiance for an adult get together.

arrived at around 11p, after dinner with friends.  The hockey game was just ending and seating on the deck was ample. Service a little slow, but likely due to the fact our server was cashing out the folks that were there for the game.  This was our 2nd visit to the location and I see no reason not to go back again!

Good service but expensive compared to some of the other veterinarians in the area. Very good place and very cautious however they want to always have your pet in for a follow up (which I understand) however it is very pricey to take a pet to the vet to have their ears looked into for a moment and be done.

This Happy Dragon in Fishers is not as good as the one in Pendleton.  For one, it is much slower and the service was just OK.  The place was dirtier on the inside than most.

I didn't hate it...but for fast food Chinese there are better options if you look around.

First time hitting Greeks in Broad Ripple...have been to the one in Fishers many times and the quality here didn't disappoint.  The place was pretty quiet for 630pm on a Friday so my girls and I enjoyed pizza in relative solitude.

Will likely be at the one in Fishers more often but this is a good spot for pizza.

The last 2 times I've gotten coffee from this location it's been super bitter even with sweetener. Also watching them make my coffee they have not done it the way it is written on the ticket. Even though it is super convenient I will not patronize this location again.

This is a great place to start the night, meet a friend, or just chill . A bar with real bartenders I LOVE IT. I have had moscow mules, dark and stormy, gimmlet, give me somthing good, etc. I have liked them all. 

I think on thursday's and fridays they have a live bad maybe all weekend i am not sure.

I have never been disappointed with this store. The staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and its is very organized. They are not close to my house, but I make the trek if I am trying to make specialty drinks or having a party.  I have found the prices here are reasonable.  I can't wait until my next visit.

Great facility to host large crowds. 
My major complaint is that it is ALWAYS freezing.

Love the newly renovated carpets. And super glad they got rid of the scented air fresheners. 

The staff is friendly and always goes above and beyond. 

Food was good!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Tucked in a strip mall on Carothers so you have to keep an eye out! 

Super friendly staff. Not a ton of product. They were remodeling or something, the guy tried to explain.  Very dusty. Shelves and other item were scattered around. 

I will def go check it out again.

My company recently had an all day conference here. Don't judge a book by the cover. 

This place is cozy and inviting on the inside! 
Great lounge vibe.

Good coffee, and the sandwich bar was good.
THOSE CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES ARE FABULOUS.

The staff was helpful and friendly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is probably my favorite Chinese spot in the temple area. They're quick and delectable. The prices are also very reasonable especially for the taste. I really enjoy their dollar egg rolls and they have the best homemade sweet tea hands down! I just only wish they weren't so skimpy with their veggies

Tropical Isle gets the job done. They didn't lie - it is a VERY strong drink, it's just not the tastiest. The place is a pretty fun though, it's packed and has a live guitarist. There are a lot of pictures on the wall of famous celebs who have come! (I don't know if this is an added perk)

I sent them an email per their response and we will see if anyone responds to them waving the fee after misconstruing the like card being free when I never wanted it

Been 36 hours since I sent the email and no response back. Continuing to show poor customer service
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Lime card free 2wks and then downgrade to $10 month costs you $10 to downgrade. Staff can't seem to get their story straight about whether they accept credit cards or not. Had to sign up with bank account but had to pay downgrade fee with a credit card. Misinformed staff is not good customer service
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: A cool old school barbershop located in Fountain Square. When you walk in you feel as if you step back in time for a moment. One of the few places in Indianapolis that offers a hot lather shave also.  It's hard to find a barber who knows how to do crew cuts and military style cuts  but this place has nailed it!

F-.  Dingy and worn out.  The bathtub was dirty, had been re-caulked several times and the spigot was loose off the wall to the point of almost being inoperable.  The room was marginally clean, completely dated, and beat up; cracked walls, damaged trim, etc.  I'm truly surprised this place survives in Carmel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've lived down the street from the location of Santi's for my whole life and have seen many pizza places at this location come and go. I hope Santi's stays open, though. I fully enjoy their pizza. I love ricotta cheese on my pizza and they give you these really big dollops. Attached is a picture to show you the cheesy goodness

The hotel was clean and up to date however parking for a guest staying the weekend was over 70.00! The mattress was comfortable and after feeling well rested we figured we'd just grab breakfast downstairs.... Huge mistake. Way overpriced for the quality and we only seemed to be inconveniencing the service staff.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Highly overrated- I wanted the meat lovers pizza with extra meat and cooked well done. Ordered for delivery through Restaurant Connection. Got a small pizza undercooked with onions, which I hate.   Bought it on the Yelp rating, and this is one of the few times Yelp let me down. $68 for a small pizza with ingredients I don't like.

Really excellent personal pie venue.  You can select one of the specialty pies or make your own with whatever you want on it, all for 7.99 as of this posting.  I had one of the specialty white sauce pizzas, but added sausage and pepperoni.  Very tasty and I ended up taking some of the pie home.

We went for all you can eat ribs on Tuesday night.. Never again!! The ribs they serve were 80% fat and 20% meat. I lost my appetite for the day and ate my veggies only.. I don't know about their other dishes. But as far as their rib special, it was totally disgusting!!

Eh.. Not really impressed w anything so far. Got eggplant parm sandwich; had to Doctor that up. Got Sicilian and also had to Doctor that up w seasonings. Just kinda blah. The Sicilian was about 2 inches of dough too. And barely any sauce. Not a good ratio.

Finally got to try this place. And not really sure what the hype is about. The lady was nice and all but the sushi was warm. I have never experienced that and it was a little off putting. It also had an odor. Needless to say, we didn't finish. But the veg dumpling was ok.

Friendly staff. I never know what to order and feel pressured usually bc there's a line behind me of caffeine deprived, impatient people. But today was diff and the cashier helped me pick something to have. The toffee nut iced coffee and it was really good. Glad I listened.

Dinner and our server were both amazing!! I had never been there but read and heard great things about Eclipse so I was interested to try it out. I really liked the look of the place, fancy and formal, yet comfortable and friendly. Great food and great service. Thanks Eclipse Bistro!!!

Went here for after we got engaged. The hosting and staff were very accommodating of us and my requested date. They totally tweaked the menu for my wife who does not like seafood. It's pricey but the food was wonderful and since it was around 4 hours long, plenty entertaining.

It breaks my heart to rate this as 1 star. This used to be the best Chinese food place in the area. I've been a patron for over 10 years and it's sad to say there was a sharp decline in quality a few years back.  Not sure if it's due to new owners or what. Still haven't found a replacement Chinese restaurant.

Very good place , fresh fish , good variety if combinations good prices, the service is excellent I will go again


Buen lugar de sushi, el Pescado bien fresco, me gustó las combinaciones que tienen, el servicio es excelente , tiene take out , regresaré seguro

Came downstairs to grab some takeout to bring to my room...

Pros:
-The quesadilla was actually really good! The chicken was tender and not chewy. 
-Food came out quickly.

Cons:
-As with many hotel restaurants, it is a bit more expensive than other similar options.

Every once in a while I'll drop by this place, but it never changes. They have an absolute ton of daily specials, but their lists are confusing and the food isn't all that great. The servers never really seem all that happy to be there, and the place is stuffy and small with inadequately spaced seating.

There was a reggae band performing and the lead singer was really good so we went in. Not exactly sure what made it a "Superlounge". It was big and there were a lot of seats, but the place needs a bit of an update. The bathroom staff was rude and I was happy to leave to check out much better establishments along Frenchmen St.

LOVE this place. Probably best sushi place in philly! I always sit at the sushi bar, but if you want a table is definitely recommend a reservation since this place is always packed. Also, the rolls are affordable especially if you come in for lunch and get one of their specials. I WILL be coming back here.

With your meal you get salad/soup - main dish, unlimited bread and pop :) plus a yummy ice cream!! 
The only thing is that staff were super busy and stressed. They did not hide it at all, making guests feel it as well. Waitress was nice and helpful. Highly recommend!

My son and I come here once a week, every week. The service is great, and the quality of food is always fresh. 

Today, my Flatbread sandwich was overbaked and stuck to the paper; I couldn't eat it. However, the employee quickly remade my sandwich and gave me two complimentary cookies!

Well the food was okay nothing to write home about the service was poor. Our bill was $80 for 2 adults and honestly it was not worth it. I don't mind spending money especially on sushi but for the quality of rice and fish it was not worth $80. Not sure we will be back.

The atmosphere was pretty nice and the staff was friendly. We had 6 bbq wings and 6 buffalo - they were just breaded wings fried and the smothered in the sauce after they took them out of the fryer. Also got the black and blue burger - it was meh - if the prices were a little lower, it would have been ok.

Their double shots are inconsistent. The bar tender won't play current music. Pretty sure he is playing music he wants. Night light usually leaves around 11 or 12... also mix drinks can be sour and taste like syrup... just my experience with one bartender. He sucked.. he needs to be more happy at work.

As a preferred member I expect my reservations to be available when I land.  This has been the worst experience I have ever had with Avis. There is no staff at the counter and my reservation is not ready. In a competitive market and a larger airport, this is extremely disappointing.

Stopped by for lunch and ended up ordering the all you eat sushi and really enjoyed it! Lots of sushi for a great price, the only downside was that I wish they had more options for the all you can eat sushi but regardless, it was a good lunch spot and I'll definitely be back again.

Standard grocery store with some of the organic options. They have the milk we use at lower prices than Whole Foods but they're often very close to being expired. Basically not our go-to grocery store, but when we need something quick it works since it's so close to home.

I have only been here a few times.  The food was always great but they have very few options.  The outdoor seating area is nice.  One time I sat inside and luckily had my coat because I about froze.  The staff was friendly and the service was good.  All in all, my experience was good.  Just wish they had a few more options.

Great service and huge menu options.  Portions are generous.  Plenty of bread for dipping at the table.  There are a few tables outside too.  I had the Sicilian grilled tuna steak served over linguini.  Light chunky tomato sauce with capers and black olives.  I could only eat half. BYOB- gotta love that.
Definitely worth a trip.

I really wish you could give a place negative stars.  Not only does this place have horrible management, but they treat their employees absolutely horrendous.   For a place that is so new they really cut corners on materials.  You will constantly have issues in your apartment as well as break-ins.
Avoid this place like the plague.

Pro: food is mediocre, conveniently located near highway and shopping center
Cons: the cashier/server keeps her vinyl gloves on while operating the key pad on the cashiers machine and serving tacos shells/picking up the chips by her hands. No greetings at all

Their food tastes good, but might be missing a few ingredients to kick that japanese taste in.

I usually start of with a roll, and get their grill entrees. I love to see the cook preparing my food amd grill it

They use garlic, so be careful if you cannot stand the garlic, or causes you problems in the stomach.

Always welcomed by polite people which is very impressive given the current temperature is around 15F.

My car came out very clean and I was pleased. The car didn't come out 100% dry so I've got some white spots but honestly after how bad it looked prior to the wash I cannot complain.

This place looks very clean, which impressed me as I came in through the door. We have a pretty good variety between the two of us of dishes but we both had Carnitas for meat, and thought it was very tasty. I would say their food is much more than say, Taco Bell.

New review 02/21/2018. Since they were unable to help my Kami when she had a terrible rash on her tummy I have canceled my pet insurance at this location. I was never really very happy with the vets there as they seem to be asking me more questions and they were answering mine.

My kids like McDonald's and I used to, but they seem to not do quality checks anymore.  I went thru drive thru and asked for their deluxe chicken sand crispy.   This is what I got .... Ewe. Who would eat that?   By the time I gotta home it was too late for me  to drive all the way back.    People check ur food!!!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Nice that you don't answer the phone after ten attempts during business hours.  If your South Pasadena location would stop hiring felons then the quality would improve. Every time they screw up orders. Get involved with this location as they are causing you a ton of liability. Consistently shit service.

Huge car wash place and free vacuum that I never use. The machines here do as gold as others I've been to. I guess I'm spoiled by hand wash prior to going through the machine. I think it's a little pricy compared to others. But that possibly makes up for the free vacuum.

My husband's favorite fast food place. Mine not so much. Only thing I order here would be the jalapeño poppers or curly fries. I think their sandwiches are a little overpriced for the amount of meat they have. The service is fine. They get really backed up and busy during lunch time. Great location right off the highway.

It's just amazing to me how much of a circus this McDonald's is... I mean there is always an issue at this place.. the only saving grace is it has the sausage and gravy biscuits.  If you can, I would avoid this place all together... get it together McDonald's.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Really happy with the selection. I find the prices for the quality of what they are offering to be fair. I'm curious if the similar concept coming to East Nash is the same owners?  I hope so, my only complaint is location and it isn't their fault I'm an East Nashvillian!

This is now called Soft Taco.  first time I was ever there. will definitely be back!  Food was excellent.. I sat at the bar and had margharitas.. the bartender/waiter was fabulous and friendly.. Shame they don't have table service.. It was busy for a Monday night.

A hidden gem in a mostly empty strip plaza. The tuna don is out of this world good. A hefty portion of ahi tuna over rice, topped with masago, and dried seaweed, with cucumbers and Japanese mayonnaise on them. Authentic Japanese restaurant reasonably priced. I wish I would have tried this place sooner.

I love Anthony's coal fired pizza. It is thin crust style and is fresh and delicious. Try the mozzarella tomato sandwhich it is so good! The focaccia is like homemade pizza bread. 

Also they have eat in and take out services. Eatting in is actually very nice, they have a bar and all

I wish i loved this place since it is so close. I just dont. Not great/fresh sushi. Service has never been 5 star worthy. For the prices, i will go elsewhere. Manager isnt too helpful either....we LOVE sushi, but i will go to drunken fish or mizu before here....
