They put way too much ice in the bottle, refills were ONE dollar off and I didn't really feel a good kick until I got to the very end of the cup (but it was still good).  It tasted much sweeter than my previous visits.  I've been to New Orleans multiple times and I always grab a Hand Grenade!

Ever since they revamped the menu it's like a different place to eat.  The Arby's fries are better than cross-cut potatoes, they have a real Reuben, brisket sandwich, chicken cordon-bleu, and another IMPORTANT THING!!

Working bathrooms-- unlike the monstrosity of a chick-Fil-a across the street!!!?!?

As carry out Chinese goes this is very good. I got two carry out orders on the way home from work.  So I was the only order

We got the sweet $ sour chicken & sczhwaun chicken. Both were very good. 

Typical egg rools, but we're deep fried perfectly. 

Pork fried rice that accompanied the meals was typical, not great but not bad.

Have been here three times now.  Everything about the experience is 'so-so'.  Food is a bit overpriced for the quality/taste.  In general servers are pleasant, but everyone is a bit untrained or at best inconsistent.  I want to like it given the location, but just can't bring myself to spend more money here :(

Conveniently located in the Central Business District.  Good place to get work done and get a drink while you are at it.  Barista wanted to be sure she got my order in correctly and definitely out in the extra effort to make sure it was accurate. Overall a clean location with plenty of seating for a downtown location.

Fantastic little gem right on the river walk. The Aloft brand never disappoints, and these trendy modern rooms were more than adequate for a quick stay. Also a big shout out to the housekeeping and front desk staff who found something I left behind in the room and helped get it to me!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Stayed the night in Eagle and this was near the hotel and had a good rating.  It was yummy.  The atmosphere on the patio was very nice.  The signature drinks were well done.  It wasn't out of this world amazing but everything was well seasoned and had good taste.

Ginza is a very good Japanese restaurant that features excellent fresh sushi and a wonderful lunch buffet. Hibachi items are available for lunch or dinner, but there is no cooking at the table. The soups and other dishes are really excellent and the service is outstanding.

If anyone gets to Seminole Heights and wants good flavored ice cream (soft serve) Go to Bo's on Florida Ave just north of Sligh. I get the Cherry sundaes which they use plenty of maraschino cherries!! They also have go thick butterscotch malts!! Just try them and you will Love them!!

Touch free car wash that isn't worth a damn. Spots all over my car. No air dryer which is needed because your spot free water doesn't work! 

Better places around Tampa to get a wash....was in the area and thought I'd give it a them a try since they were a private owned wash. Never again!!!

Very spacious place to study. Customer service and parking sucks though. The barista with blue hair forgot my sandwich twice and went on lunch before even telling me that it was finished. Not the best Starbucks I've been to, but it's a great place to do homework.

Really good Mexican in downtown Haddonfield. Very authentic flavor. One of my favorite Mexican restaurants is a no-sign, hidden gem in the back of a Mexican grocery store, which is my standard for "authentic taste."  El Nopalito reminds me of that place. Very friendly service.

I've been coming here for years, always leaving happy. This recent experience was not what I expected. The sushi seemed of lower quality and was not rolled and presented like I'm accustomed to.  Service is always good. If this were my first visit, I would not be impressed. Hoping this was just a one off experience.

I ordered an iced coffee, but it had NO ice. There was coffee dropping off of the lid and onto my work clothes. This location really needs to get it together. I usually love Dunkin, but I will skip this location and go to the other one on Highwoods Preserve.

Just as good as ever---- took a group there and everyone pronounced their meals exellent. I'm not a red sauce person but the chicken Sorrento- mostly in wine sauce and cheese--- is one of my favorites. Only quibble, and I know they get this all the time: Why no credit cards? This is 2012, not 1905....

If they asked me one more time if I wanted any other food, before my kids' food was out, I would walk out. Sushi looked like it had been rolled by a four year old, food took forever, and the waiter never took drink order, just assuming we wanted water. Never coming back.

very unhealthy food...some of the stuff they sell looks like heart attack on a plate...so much oil...the food is floating in oil...i guess they do not care about the health of there customers....shady place...poor service...i will definately avoid this place...even 1 star is too much....

Ok resturant overall...down point is the long waiting time on weekends....food is Ok..the bento boxes, dragon eyes, and yakiniku are good....the service is usually ok, although last time we went there it was surprisingly sloppy and bad...food is better in the south side location, that is why i usually go there.....

went on sunday with the family....was busy so had to sit on the bar...as did not have reservation...the waiter was nice but the service was slow...however the food was good...the sashmi in traditional bento was really good...the chops in robata box was also nicely done...the temporas were a bit oily....will go again...

If you like crispy greasy pizza loaded with toppings this is your place. It was delicious. The place itself is pretty small, they only had two tables and maybe 5 chairs, so I'd recommend carry out or delivery. 
They have pizzas, salads and 20oz soft drinks.

The food ,the price and delivery service is great! We have ordered multiple items from this place and have not been disappointed. Do note their buffalo sauce is in fact HOT. If your more of a mild person ask for their sauce on the side and mix it with ranch or blue cheese to bring it down a notch.

This would have been a 4-star place because the pizza was very good indeed. They have a very good collection of beer too. However the only problem is that for lunch they do not sell pizza by the slice and hence you tend to overeat. Among their pizzas I'd recommend creating your own as it turns out cheaper.

I wish Papa Johns wasn't  so convenient.. The Pizza always arrives hot and fresh,  even in inclement weather. This is probably the best delivery pizza around. Still looking for the perfect pie in Tampa but until then its easy Papa Johns. My only complaint is that they charge for extra garlic sauces.. 2 is just never enough!!!

Agree with Leslie.  Pretty good. Love adding stuff to my pasta. It reminded me of how I make it at home. Leftover mushrooms, Green peppers, zucchini?  Just throw it in. Maybe a bit pricey but fast. Got it done. Lobster bisque was really ok   my 18 yr old will like it.

I live in carp and this is one of my all time favorite places, but I only like one thing on the menu. It's called the monte alban, and it's a creamy garlicky chicken zucchini dish over rice that is absolutely to die for! I get it with mushrooms and extra sauce. With the free chips and salsa it can feed 2.

Great service!  Went with my husband and got the boneless wings buffalo style-- very good. We both got burgers that were cooked perfectly and were very juicy. Fries were very good even though you had to pay $2 extra to get them instead of chips-- that was the only annoying thing. Otherwise it was a very good meal.

This place has a really cool vibe but personally, I wasn't impressed by their food. Service was OK, drinks were pretty good but food... mehh. I was thinking about giving it another try but there are lots of other places in Seminole Hights I'd rather go to.

Sushi was pretty good but service could be better. They will make sure you know that "you'll pay extra if you don't eat what you order" right before you even place an order and if you show up at 9 they will remind you that the restaurant closes at 10 like if you couldn't read.

Ordered for delivery, we ordered chicken and chorizo tacos with a side of queso cheese. The queso was very unique, it has almost like a broth base rather than a creamy base. The tacos came in two corn shells with the option of cilantro, onions, and three different salsas. Overall not bad just a good basic Mexican restaurant.

It wasn't a bad stay. The wifi in our room didn't work at all. They tried to accommodate us by moving us to another room and the wifi continued to not work. Rooms weren't horrible. The beds were SO uncomfortable, wasn't the best area. I think we overpaid for our stay. Definitely wasn't worth it
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: They weren't ready for the red eye rush on a summer Saturday morning (10 people in line) and had one person working the desk. The manager was at the second counter but apparently he had more important things to do. The poor woman working the desk was very friendly though.

We went to Giovanni's Kitchen on a Thursday night for dinner!! Everything about this place was AMAZING!! Appetizer, Salad, Entrées, Dessert and Service was top notch!! Our server, Adrian, was super friendly and knowledgeable. He gave awesome recommendations and was very attentive!! We will be back!! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!

Mediocre sushi. Appetizers are a joke - overpriced and portion sizes are ridiculously small (forget about sharing). Sunomono appetizer was barely a couple of spoonfuls. It's trendy allright - this place is for you if you just want to be seen and don't care about getting quality food for your money.

I've only ever gotten pizza and sides, but I think they are absolutely the best pizza in the area, hands down. I live in Ambler borough and delivery is always quick. I'm surprised by the negative reviews. I love their Greek pizza. The crust and sauce have great texture, flavor and proportion.

Yes! A clean, fresh, friendly subway. Bread is always baked just right, which is usually not the case at most locations. I ate a little too much Subway in my college days and got bored with it, but this location makes me want to eat there more for a "lighter" last-minute meal option. Friendly employees too!

I really love this little hidden gem. The coffee is fantastic. The staff is typically very friendly. It's a little small inside so I may not personally pick this as a place to go sit and work. There is only a few tables and they are very close together, however, it's a great place to grab a cup to go. A little on the pricey side.

First trip! Got the mojo pork, yellow rice, beans on the side...first thing that made me happy was they slapped a giant slab of crispy skin on top of the pulled pork. Fascinatingly good! Wife got a the marinated beef and enjoyed it. Empanadas left something to be desired. Overall, great little hole in the wall!

These guys are great! Friendly service with a fresh brew and good prices! 

Ken is my go-to and always does a great job for a haircut/beard-trim. Recently, while he was away, I went to Nick who gave me one of the best fades I've ever had. I'm definitely a long-time customer. These guys are awesome!

Great little Chinese Buffet in Seminole. Quiet and clean, and the variety is surprisingly good considering the size of the restaurant. Only giving 4 stars because the sushi was really bland, but then again, it was only a $6.50 lunch buffet;) We will definitely be back. The veggies were fresh and the meat was quite good!

Tried it for the first time. Had a groupon. Didn't think it was that special. I'm not a thick crust guy, but their crust is thin and kind of waxy. I might give it another try and check out of their specialty pizzas. The 2 ingredient versions were really lacking. Had better. Sorry Matteo's. I went in hoping it was going to be good.

The food was very good.  I went around 1400 on a Thursday afternoon and the place was pretty empty.  I guess in that area most of the places get busy for the lunch and after-work crowd.  My wife enjoyed the food and so did I.  I do like places with a short menu instead of trying to cater to every palate.

The only reason we went to Spirits was to check out the Bar Rescue results.   It was interesting, but we won't be back.   Service was slow - we had to track down a waitress to get our order.  The dueling pianos were a small step above Karaoke.  The barber/shot chair was like watching a train wreck - guilty entertainment.

Love the food here of course same as the other ones but the service is awful. They are usually so rude and condescending. We have given this place a few tries in case someone was having a bad day but the service is always the same. I would definitely skip this one and go to one of the other locations instead. Very disappointing.

on a few recent re visits MELT definitely has a vibe going.  The food was ok, somethings better than other things.  The waffles were good, the waffle fries were not, the salad was good but small.  They are creating a unique experience that is inviting and fun.

This is by far the best barber shop I've ever been to! You can make an appointment online with no wait. The prices are great and the shop is awesome! I recommend Kevin or Chago, both are great.... and yes they use a hot towel and a straight razor. I highly recommend these guys!

It's a huge grocery with low prices. 
They don't take credit cards which probably is a big factor in the prices 
The bakery has pretty good bread but I got a loaf that wasn't completely thawed 
I'm not sure if they do any on-site baking 
The employees seem to be extremely friendly and helpful.

Good place to get nails done. Even with a line, usually pretty quick to get through. 

I don't go to anyone else but Paul as he has the best quality work. One thing I don't like is that when they get busy, they start switching you up halfway through your service to different people to finish the job.

Walked in here because it was raining and I tell you what.. I love me a good dive bar, and beers are only $3, coming from Chicago where a dilly dilly/bud light in case you don't have cable.... is $6+ this is like making money. No food here but drinks are cold and shots are flowing

I've come here twice, kind of by accident, and been happy both times.  The first time I got tacos al pastor and the second time I got the quesadilla on corn tortilla (gluten free).  Both times the food was good and the prices were reasonable.  I would return.

Added May 2021: Last week I was in there and they had *five* kinds of mangoes, including a big green kind from Haiti that I had not seen before.  They were delicious!

Supremo is not new and shiny.  it has been here a long time and its age shows. But some of the reviews say it is dirty, and it is not.

Current member. Serves its purpose for the price. When machines break they're down for a long time. 
Hate that people hog the machines because they're too busy staring at their phones.
I would give them a 4-5 but their customer service has been extremely disappointing since new management took over. Also high turn over on staff.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Great prices, service and friendly staff. We love Goffs. The variety of beers is great and staff is knowledgeable and honest. My wife went to Goffs and the employee refused to let her carry a case of beer without his help. There aren't enough vendors like this anymore. Worth going out of your comfort zone for Goffs

Staff is very communicative. Deal with our requests in a timely manor. Comfortable living. Decent area of town. Outside security patrolling. Park setting. Pools are kept up pretty well and opened at the beginning of the warm season ahead of most other complexes. Thank you.

Did not wait long for a table even tho it was very busy. Service is lacking. Way too loud and tables are way too close together. Everyone on top of each other. Apps came out with food which wasn't ideal. Food was very good though. No complaints there. Average prices. Prob won't return for eat in but may for take out

I know everyone is a student, and the food is okay but waiting for a mushroom sandwich for 20 minutes, before it got busy, while watching 6 people that came in after you be served while seated, AND your order is to go does not go over well with me.  I'll bring my lunch, thanks.

Hard to say why but I have always liked McDonald's    I don't go often but usually once a month when I am in a hurry.  Usually just do a cheeseburger or double cheeseburger.   Prices are among the best out of fast food choices and like I said I tend to like the flavor.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I have been to this Starbucks on several occasions and have not had very good customer service. Maybe it is because I am going thru the drive thru? 

I always feels like I am annoying them or they are doing me some huge favor.  My drink was consistent with other Starbucks and service was done in a timely manner.

The loose tea can get expensive, 
but I love getting ready made teas, pretty wide selection, always something new and they let you mix to make your own concoction, always comes out perfect!
The staff are the nicest people around. They remember me when I come in and remember what I like :-)

Delicious authentic Mexican street tacos and more. Great selection of reasonably price tacos with 12 different meat fillings to choose from. A good selection of seafood dishes as well. Love the Tostada mixta, a mix of octopus and shrimp ceviche on top of a crispy Tostada shell. Looking forward to my next visit.

I came into here looking for specific Gucci glasses that I seen at LensCrafters; however, I did not see the brand. They also do not accept EyeMed, so I was kind of bummed about that. It was also pretty busy in there but it might be because people are trying to use their benefits before the end of the year.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: It doesn't matter when you go or how busy they are, the service is always slow and they always mess up order. Ordered 2 mcdoubles without pickles, and or course after waiting 15 minutes @ midnight both burgers had pickles. Will be calling to complain tmr!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We usually go here alot since its next to my husbands work but last time we were there we were sitting in the bar area next to the kitchen and kids were running around and being nosey. My husband and i also smelt vomit the whole time we were trying to eat.

People were nice - work was okay - nothing special!  I came for a relaxing time however the View was blaring out on the TV.  Who wants to listen to those Magpies yap on and on with their bias opinions on Covid 19 and vaccines.  Ruined it the whole experience for me - 80 dollars wasted !

The pizza was very good even though no where near the real thing!  But beware...don't order the Caesar salad it was over priced, wilted and without dressing. After calling to let them know their response was you need to ask for the dressing and they'll check the lettuce... unacceptable!

It's okay. Nice selection of beer, including microbrews and such.  But watch out for the dates on the packages.  They don't keep a fresh selection of beers.  Most were close to expiring within a couple of months.  It's a bit dark and bare floor.  The two employees were okay.

My husband and I frequent macaroni Grill locations and we love the spot just as much as all of the others. The food is typically pretty good. Every now and then something isn't quite right but the staff is always quick to fix any problems we have. I love their gluten-free menu.

Came here for a business lunch and was pleasantly surprised with the generous portion of the salmon salad. The salmon was slightly over cooked but it wasn't a deal breaker. The fresh bread with olive oil is a must try! Server was accommodating and polite. Will be back to give other entrées a go

I've been here several times and I have to say the first time was the only one that was enjoyable. The service has been so bad here. In fact, we had a waitress once who was so rude to my table that we asked for a new waitress. The food is decent, and the atmosphere is fun and convenient since it's right on the lake.

This is the worst Burger King in the area. I've given them 2nd, 3rd and 4th chances to get their act together. Never again. The staff is not trained properly, the drive through staff gets my order wrong EVERY SINGLE TIME. There is no excuse for this!! Never again.

The food is really good. I love a BYOB w no corkage fee. The problem is the sticky plastic table clothes, inability to talk to the people you came to the restaurant, and stiff waitresses.  The tables are so close together and the noise level is unbelievable. I ve been here three times before, but this will probably be the last.

Fresh fish expertly cut and formed into Nigiri and Rolls. Service was fast and courteous. Everything in my picture below was delicious and tender. Total after tax for the feast that you see was $55. I highly recommend this establishment for sushi in Tucson. Bathroom was clean and odorless.

This place is pretty good.  I probably wouldn't go as much as I do if Ashland City had more lunch options.  The food is always decent.   I have found hair in my food before which really grosses me out.  The service is always good and the girls are really sweet.

Great sushi, fast service, and BYO - love this place! Went there on a Friday night with a group of 6, and the hostess directed use to the nearest liquor store to pick up wine. The sushi is really good and the presentation is cute too, will definitely be back. Don't forget the spicy mayo :o)

Edomasa is definitely the most traditional sushi restaurant in Santa Barbara. That said, the sushi is just okay - fish doesn't seem as fresh as some other places in town. The bento boxes and other Japanese fare are very tasty with huge portions. Overall, I'm a fan of Edomasa, just not for the sushi.

The hotel was modern and clean.  The check in/out process was easy and the staff was courteous.   The location is in a nice area right off of I-65.  There are a few places to eat just down the street making it very easy to find a good meal.  I would stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Food is great every time I go. I am obsessed with the spring rolls and the ahi tuna. The goat cheese salad leaves a lot to be desired. You sure dont get much salad for what you pay for. 
If you do make it to Derek's, make sure you go while the sun is still up, because at night it turns into a shady hang out for the employees.

Good sandwich shop with great customer service. Be on the lookout for the groupons. They have them quite often.

I probably would come back even without the groupon  even tho Im not really a lunch meat type of person anymore.

Chicken breast wrap: 3/5 
Prime rib wrap: 3.5/5

Descent St Paul sandwich for a county Fried rice place. The best spots are still in the City of St Louis 3/5

Plain Fried rice 3/5 Descent stuff for nothing to write home about but it will get the job done.

Crab Rangoon:  3/5 not fried quite the way a love them but, they will do if I need some in a pinch and I am in the area.

Ok the test here has to be the Philly cheese steak.. Kinda goes without saying.

Unfortunately their Philly is boring and rather tasteless.  Would be ok if this was somewhere in the middle of nowhere, but not for Philadelphia.

Basically equivalent of steakum frozen meat splashed with water containing a few spices at the very end.

You'd think being a fast food restaurant you'd get your food fast right? Well not at this McDonalds. I was in the drive through for 30 minutes and they didn't even have my order correct. I told them to keep it. This is an embarrassment of a fast food restaurant. The employees are assholes and the management is awful.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Hope Lawyer is awesome! Super chill and fun to talk to and very good at what she does. I did a full mani/pedi today and i am very pleased w the results (please see pics). She was very thorough and definitely takes her time to make them look perfect. She overall provided excellent customer service and i will definitely be back.

I am downgrading this store because for whatever reason the management cannot figure how to keep it clean during busy times. The response "we just got slammed" is no excuse. I like most of the staff, and they work hard and are friendly, but the store HAS TO BE KEPT CLEAN.

The ice cream is alway yummy. Cash only so that can deter us at times   Many options of ice cream but some flavors can be sold out.  If you go in when there is a crowd, there seems to be no order in which staff wait on everyone. Other than that, it's a great sweet tooth fix any day :)

Great service and the food comes out amazingly fast. The selection for rolls is great and provides customers with a great variety of selection. 5 stars hands down for sushi in Nashville. The food itself is awesome and will satisfy that sushi roll craving one is always itching for.

Although I like the concept of all you can eat sushi, I wasn't too impressed with the quality of sushi. The sushi is not as fresh since it has been sitting out there for a long time. They also place a limit for the amount of sashimi you can order, which I believe you can only order 3 orders of sashimi (with 3 pieces each).

Best sushi in Center City.

Here's what's good / popular to order: 

1.Sansom Roll
2.Tuna dumplings 
3.Sunomono 
4.MangoTango Roll

About 10 seats inside I think ,but not so busy during the day so you might find a seat.Busier at night.Many people order to go due to no seats.

Sat at the drive through for 30 minutes for them to fight although say they were closed and an employee came out to fight me because I was upset they never answered me and according to the manager it was my fault. The need to fire all their employees they are terrible

It's not a true New York style pizza BUT it's a great pizza still. Will be back to try to Chicago style pizza. I am from Illinois right outside Chicago so I am hoping it do t disappoint. 

I would definitely come back and still order the New York style anyway.

My significant other works at Dominos, so no other pizza is allowed in our house. So when I am at work, I enjoy occassionally ordering Papa Johns. This location always is faster than estimated. The food is always yummy and the delivery persons are always friendly.

The pizza is really good here. It can be salty though. My biggest gripe is with the staff. They are horrendous. Not once have I been here and felt it was a friendly atmosphere. The staff gets flustered when it's busy, and they seem to take it out on the employees. It's just pizza.

Average. The sushi really wasn't that good. My friends order came out wrong twice. Her edamame had sugar on it instead of salt, and she ordered a salmon roll, but was given a shrimp roll. Service was slow. Sushi just wasn't that great. Shrimp roll barely had shrimp in it. And the spicy crab roll tasted funny.

It's a grocery store, usually has what I need. Not as nice looking/clean inside as some of the other Publix stores around but it's close to where I live so I come here often. The employees here do not appear to be as friendly as other locations. Not enough cart returns in the parking lot.

It was a pretty good price for an all you can eat buffet with pizza,  salad,  and breadsticks.   Wasn't very clean and the napkin dispenser had pizza sauce on it.   The pizza wasn't bad,  but wasn't that great.   I would say I was a little disappointed.  I would have to pass if asked to go there again.

John is absolutely the best mechanic anyone can ask for.  As a single gal, it can be hard to find a mechanic you can trust. You can trust John. He truly cares about your car (it's his patient!) and you!
I'm grateful that a friend referred me to him and that my search for someone to help me maintain my 2013 Honda Civic is over!

Not bad for airport fare.  Got to the airport with time to spare and stopped in for a snack.  My daughter got the mozzarella sticks which were ok.  My wife and I split the Nachos which were to my surprise really good!  Topped with beer cheese, chili, jalapenos etc.  Definitely glad we gave it a try!

Not bad.  This location seems to be very competent.  The employees were friendly and helpful.  There was of course a great selection of ice creams.  We had a big party who all had many different things and seemed to enjoy them all.  Not much in the way of choices in the area.  But this one is a great option.

Stayed here a few times because of the price. Never had a problem except for the smell I always get upon entering the room. Staff is friendly and has shuttles that go to the mall. Not the worst hotel I've been to, but I don't come here expecting a 4star hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Egg roll king delivers quality food at a FRACTION of what their competition would charge. 

Whwn you walk in you will notice the clean atmosphere. The walls are decorated with pictures of the food you'll be eating. I was very impressed with the staff as well. Helpful and fast. Cant wait to come back.

I've been coming here off and on since they first opened, the donuts are fine but the service needs work.  I stopped going here for 3 months because the staff was very unfriendly and rude.  I decided to start going back to give it another try, different staff same bad customer service.

MAC's is pretty straight forward. They offer different levels of washes ($4-$12 in range). Pull up, put car in neutral, pick your wash, pay, and when it comes out you get a soft cloth dry. It's not the most detailed wash, but hey it's convenient and it gets the job done.

Needed a quick car wash and ended up here on the recommendation from Audi Wynnewood (it's where they wash their cars). It wasn't the best car wash I ever received, but it got the job done. After the wash they are supposed to clean the interior and vacuum but they did less than stellar job.

I love this car wash. Easy to use screen allows you to customize your wash. They also offer "wash books". If you buy 5 washes you get a 6th one free. I also find it convenient that they offer free vacuum service after your wash (you do it). List for $6 i'm not complaining. 

Its a great location too, right off of 295 (exit 34).

After reading the reviews on Yelp, I decided to stop in and try a couple of slices. What I had was a very underwhelming experience. The two slices that I had where undercooked and under seasoned. I would say that the pizza is average to below average. I will not go back there.

Gotten take out here once and eaten in the restaurant for lunch once. The service was good and the price wasn't too bad, on the average, if not cheaper, side of a sushi place. The calamari was served in rings. The teriyaki sauce was light. The sushi and sashimi are very fresh. All very good.

Always good food and always fresh. It's a fun place, especially when eating outside is possible. Drinks can get pricey when ordering top shelf. This place is owned by the same person who owns Lily's which has been a staple in Doylestown for a while. I'm a fan of both!

We order delivery from Pronto occasionally and have always been happy with everything. The girls who answer the phone are always friendly and delivery is always pretty fast. My husband likes the wings and I LOVE the chicken piccata!! They give a nice portion and the side salad and bread are also very good.

This is my Disney World adult Indy version. I see myself frequenting as it brings so much joy. If you are a wine lover consider this place paradise. You can purchase Orin Swift Abstract for a mere $27 bucks. Unheard of! Lots of deals on my favorites. Yeppers I am a fan!

Food isn't as good as other white castles. Make sure you have lots of napkins because the grease will be dripping. They give out coupons but huff when you use them. Haven't had anything here that I actually liked. Check your bag because they probably didn't give you the sauces you asked for either.

Rented a car for 2 weeks. Filled up the gas tank 1 mile from the airport. THe fuel gage read FULL and the gas handled popped and wouldn't let more go in. When they emailed me my receipt they charged me $20 fuel service fee claiming the car left with 17.1galons but returned with 16.8 gallons. What a scam.

Really annoyed that they asked me to put on a tip to my credit card even before I was finished being rung up, I hadn't even picked out my colors yet! 

Then they spoke to me in only Spanish, I look Mexican, but I am Italian. 

I do like the seats, they are massage lounge chairs. 

Pedi mani gel is 70$! Expensive!!!

I have finally found my barber shop. 

Whitney Barber shop has the best product, the best price and the coolest location. I personally hate going downtown, but this place is worth it. Truly the best. I don't need to say anything else, all the other reviews nailed it.

I'm not sure how this is possible, but my car actually came out dirtier than it went in! I'm not sure if the water lines are dirty, or what the issue is, but I will have to take my car to get washed again this evening at a wash that I know will work. This was literally me throwing away $12.

Wow! Not a huge tamale fan but this place was absolutely incredible!!! I just moved to tucson and this was one of the places my friends who had lived here recommended. Everything was absolutely delicious and the dessert tamale was awesome too! I will be coming back about once a week!

We stopped in for a late bite and sat at the bar. Our bar tender moved quickly and provided good service. We had the goose sandwich and the Buffalo chicken sandwich. Very filling and full flavor with both. It was definitely better than average bar food. Plus I had a nicely balanced drink.

....mind blown....

It's not my first time eating here and it won't be my last! Every time I eat here, I leave with just a little more love for this place.

Best sushi in Indianapolis- Hands down! And it is priced well. $4-$5 for a regular role, $6 for my favorite specialty role. 

I suggest trying the Gabe Roll.

Great italian American fare. We live nearby so often get takeout. Their pizza and cheesesteaks are good, as are their italian dishes (marsala, lasagna, etc). However, I would strongly recommend the Pomodoro Signature pizza - it is phenomenal. See pictures attached

This is a great little byob in queen village. The pastas are so good and filling. Gnocchi was fluffy and had a delicious truffle sauce. Can be a little loud when it's filled with diners, but on a weeknight it's quiet and cozy. Staff has always been nice and attentive.

I love the snow bird roll, It's so simple but so fresh. Their deals are pretty good here for dinner. Their service is mediocre. The waitress that I always gets never really understands me but I get it if your first language isn't English. Overall good, not the best sushi ever.

Gem of a store I happened upon while searching for bottle shops within walking distance to my hotel. Great selection of local and national craft beers, and you can get a pour while you shop. I saw both children and dogs in the store, which is a plus in my book. Staff was friendly and helpful.

This place is wonderful. There sushi is do fresh and tasty. Everyone is so friendly and nice. The place looks beautiful.  Now that I tried out this place it's hard for me to go grocery shopping next door at giant without stopping over to get a roll. There sushi is addicting

The cutest Italian spot in this cute little corner! Me and my mom checked out the brunch menu and impressed with the choices. I had the Chicken Parmesan and it was so good! Flavors were fresh and delicious! The pasta was al dente and chicken was seasoned perf!  Only disappointing thing was that the service was super slow.

Let say big does not mean it's good.! Let's start out with the soup, yes it's complimentary but no seweed or tofu in it. They were very generous with the size of the Nigri/sashimi but the fish  were old and bad rice. Gotta run to sushi on Oracle to get my sushi fixed.

Still love their sushi but somehow I feels the quality of the food is different from sitting at the table vs at the bar. Lack of communication between staff and with the client. This is the place I would drive 45 min to have my dinner but after tonight its not going be awhile. I am very disappointed.

High rate on Yelp, but very disappointed. Even though their were under staff, but very friendly and helpful. Let's talk about food. Poor quality sushi, I'm taking about the freshest of the fish and the rice taste like soggy Chinese restaurant that we normally got with our entree. Tucson is not a place to eat sushi period.

I'm not a sushi fan, but my first time there today with my family was EXCELLENT! We had miso soup & sour n spicy soup. Seaweed salad, shrimp tempura, beef & chicken satay for appetizer. SUSHI; then green tea ice cream!! Yummy! Everything was good and staffs were nice. Will deff go back ;)

Delicious food, wonderful service, in a nice atmosphere. This was the second time I've eaten at Oak Oven, and both were great! My husband and I shared the Fumo pizza and the Frattura pasta. The small pastas are pretty small, so keep that in mind when ordering. Can't wait to go back!

I've been here a number of times now, and the food is consistently good and there is a wide variety to choose from. The service is pretty good. And the drinks are delicious! The Las Alahambres is like a Philly cheesesteak skillet. The fajitas, enchiladas, bean soup, tacos and tamales are delicious as well!

Excellent service.  Excellent Meal.  All is made to order and they do tell you that as soon as you sit down so just be prepared to wait but it is worth it! All local ingredients and the execution of the plates is flawless. BYOB which is nice.  Desserts are delicious .  Overall a great experience.

As far as laundromat a go, this one is pretty good. It was pretty clean and there weren't a lot of out of order machines. I don't have need to go to the laundromat a lot, but I've been to way worse. The owner showed up for a few minutes and was very friendly.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: If you come here anytime other than evenings and your food is correct and/or fully cooked you should feel blessed. I've been multiple times during the week in the mornings and afternoons and my food is rarely cooked correctly. Always have to send it back. Do not leave the drive thru until you check it!

I want to love it, I do. I mean how can you go wrong with fried chicken?  Unfortunately they've managed to take a favorite and make it just meh. 

Chicken lacked seasoning and breading but had abundance of grease. Fries were crispy. Green beans were undercooked. I would appreciate a cleaner place to eat as well.

I really like this salon. The stylist are very kind and personable even though there is a slight language barrier.  On my first visit I asked the owner trim off all my
Dead Ends and to please face me away from
The mirror. She was very kind and my HAIR LOOKED GREAT!

As someone that pays monthly it would be nice if they opened up all of the vacuums , if I hit up the car wash on the way home I typically can't vacuum my car out because they are all taken. Only reason they get my money is for convenience, but I'm sure the bad will soon out weigh the good

No frills, no fuss...just a great neighborhood bar with phenomenal beer, burgers, and snacks. Soundtrack provided by a deep catalog of vinyl records, service provided by a friendly crew of knowledgable staff.

Absolutely an asset to the neighborhood. I wish I lived closer so I could stop in more frequently. Highly recommended.

We ate here after reviewing all of the yelp reviews.   They were definitely accurate.  I had the big breakfast.  The whole meal was good, but you could can and sell that sausage gravy!   My wife had twigs and bark.   She said it was pretty good.   The staff was also well informed of the menu and very nice.

Always pricey but you know that when you walk in the doors. I'm a chef by trade and this is my go to place for meats, bread, and herbs/veggies. It's expensive but they have so many quality ingredients and I can always find inspiration to cook in the near/seafood section

This place is definitely not an authentic Japanese restaurant. Sushi is ok, on a smaller roll side, and a bit overpriced.  Not real sushi rice - can't taste vinegar in the rice. Staffs are attentive and accommodating. Asked for hot rice tea but don't have it. Shouldn't the rice tea be part of a Japanese restaurant?

I love this place. Eight bucks for an amazing custom pizza?! Free wine Wednesdays?! An array of pizza pastes, oils, toppings, and more?! Amazing. Meals can be customized without extra charge, and the suggested menu items are delicious as is as well. Staff are also quite friendly.

Does it get better than this in Indy? Can't say that it does. I knew the moment I stepped inside that this was a class above. Warm cloth hand towels, a gleaming sushi bar, they have it all. I stopped in for a quick meal. Hands down, the HK roll is my new fav. It's absolutely amazing.

Ordered a white veggie pizza and green bean Fries. The pizza had way too much spinach which made it watery and tasteless. The green been fries were over cooked - basically burnt. The delivery time was average - about 40-45 mins or so. I used to order their Sicilian pizza and LOVED it so I'll probably just stick to ordering that.

My wife stayed 3 nights, I stayed 1. 

First impressions: Nice, Modern, Clean.  The room was pretty spartan. Bathroom was nice and clean. 

Wife complained that the walls are super thin.  I didn't hear anything. She said she could hear her neighbor coughing.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Support local business! A co-worker introduced my team to this place, and now we visit at least once a week for fresh coffee and great service. Typically manned by the owner, this is the type of place where you want to become a regular. It's a great change from chain coffee shops that are also nearby.

Surprisingly good! This is a hidden gem in a boring mall plaza. If you open the door of the place, and see an Hispanic grocery store, walk further inside! The restaurant is located in the very back. Food is really good, the ambience is colorful enough to make your experience even better.

Best pizza in philly! Worth the wait every single time. Haven't found anything that comes close to how good this pizza is. I always bring friends from out of town here. Dan goes above and beyond to make sure you're satisfied with the pizza. I can't speak highly enough about this place.

My family goes here a lot and we always are so impressed and pleased with our experience. Great food, great staff, great environment. I usually get pasta, a bunch of appetizers like pizza and salads or a steak. You can't go wrong with whatever you chose to order because it is always done right and cooked to perfection.

This is a frequent lunch spot for me - at least 2-3x a month. The sushi has always been great quality and the happy hour prices are great. I also appreciate that the staff know and acknowledge me as a regular, going so far as to remembering my drink order! I'm so happy to have a good sushi place near work!

I love this location. Overs Midas has been good honest and fair to me. Nothing to complain about. This location has great staff and they are always willing to answer any question you might have about you vehicle. Oliver service has a buy 4 get one free. For me that's $130 savings :)
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Eh, for Hermitage it's okay. 
It's better than going downtown if you just want a quick fix and way better than going to Kroger.

For $13 you can get 3 rolls, a salad and a miso soup (subs are an additional $1) so its not the end of the world.

Sometimes the fish is spot on, others its super gooey and looks un appetizing.

Oh man. this place. Cannot compare to Koyo Japanese Steak. The first time we went to lunch the whole place was empty, ordered a bento box and the sushi was at least a few days to a week old. I know fish and this place cannot deliver good fish. the fried rice was okay. would not go again.

Been going here for a few years, ok in terms of cleanliness and service. They're open til 11 pm which is great. Only problems I've come across is that when the wash is done the clothes are still pretty soaked, doesn't ring out enough water. Also they seem to always have quite a few number of machines out of order.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: My two colleagues and I went there for lunch. The place wasn't very busy when we got in. I ordered the special, burger and fries. We waited 40 minutes for our lunch. By the time the food came, the fries were saggy and the burger not warm and soaking in bbq sauce. Not good.

Every time I'm in here, there are 4+ customers waiting and 1 employee. That employee is often on the phone. Occasionally I see another employee stare at me from behind the counter and then go back to sitting at the desk.

Enterprise, please staff this location better.

What a wonderful take out with such a great menu!! Everything from appetizers to dessert. Try the antipasto salad. It is amazing. A true explosion of flavor in your mouth. The tiramisu is the best ever. Service was fast, very friendly !! Love this take out when no cooking is in sight!!

Yum!!! I really enjoy the ice cream here. You can get ice cream or frozen yogurt with different toppings. The small cup size is
The perfect amount for me; not too much and just enough to satisfy. My husband got a strawberry banana smoothie that he throughly enjoyed. Great place to grab some good ice cream!

I don't know what happened here but just had the worst lunch in years. Fish in taco was half the size of tortilla, Guacamole tasted like a factory base with an avocado chipped in it. Salsas had no spice or flavor. Salad was super soggy. And the tortilla soup was a salt bomb. On top of the inept waiter. Never again.

The hotel is pretty new. Nice lobby, bar and cafe. The front desk dude was helpful and gave us a free upgrade. The room was clean, bed comfortable. 

If you're looking for a quiet stay ask for a room along the exterior of the hotel as rooms facing the pool can get noisy.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Great neighborhood dive bar. Incredibly unassuming: I drove by it four times before finding it, as it truly does not mean to draw attention to itself. Plenty of parking nearby, fun bartenders, plenty of bottled beer options, and bingo on Wednesday nights, apparently! 

Reasonable prices, and plenty of space for big groups!

Low rates. Good location for travelers and business guests.  Clean. Staff are nice. Kitchen open 24 hours for burgers and fries.  I've stayed at several Hyatt place locations across the country.  In my opinion they need to be upgraded to compete with newer courtyards.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Pizza was very good.  Its a tiny little shop, very little seating other than two high tops in the store and a couple of outside tables.  We ordered a large pie with pepperoni and we were very pleased with it.  Nice thin crust, lots of gooey cheese and pepperoni had a good flavor.

I've tried this place 2-3 times now and the food has consistently not been good. We tried two different chicken entrees and the chicken was overcooked and mediocre at best. The pork eggrolls were also not very good. Service was quick, but I'd assume wait a little longer for better quality food.

The food is usually well-prepared and fresh.  The prices are good. There are many options which are easily made vegan.  The atmosphere is cute.  The service however.....is usually lacking.  For much of the staff, this seems to be their first job so the idea of customer service may be new to them.

Super trendy place. I love the crowd, the vibe and the drinks. The food, however, i could only describe as "ok". I've never eaten anything there that stood out to me and the portions are extremely small. I love going there for drinks before w night out but it wouldn't be my first choice for dinner or any meal for that matter.

Went for dinner with my wife tonight and it was just okay. We have been to Jimmy's numerous times and generally really like the place. We had fried gyoza, seafood salad and 4 rolls. It was good but seemed to have been thrown together. I am sure we will go again. Maybe Wednesdays are just not a good night.

I stopped by for a French vanilla latte. The place was dirty and needed someone to do rounds cleaning. My drink was good for McDonald's standards. Also, first location I ever noticed a "no loitering" sign. It is a smaller sized McDonald's, but 30 minutes seem like such a short time to finish a meal.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I finally got a chance to try Blackfish. I live locally and everyone always raves about this place. It was delicious and I will definitely go back. I am not sure it was worth all of the hype, but the food was definitely fresh, unique and a great tastings across the board.

I am an regular sushi eater. This place is a spot you should check out if you are in the area. Fresh fish, great atmosphere, good service. They usually always have good specials. Make a reservation on Fridays and Saturdays for sure. They usually have an item or two on the menu that you wouldn't expect.

Can't comment on the food because I wanted to call in an order. Can't read the menu on mobile so can't see the full sushi selection to make a decision. Guess I'll have to try their food later when I have time to eat in and look at the menu better. I'm so hungry right now....

A unique menu and a very nice setting in a cool part of town. The specialties like the buffalo cauliflower and maple brunch donuts are worth the visit. I like the atmosphere although it sometimes borders on pretentious. The service is a little inconsistent or I would give them five stars.

I really wanted a great hot chicken place closer to my house but just got okay....chicken is tenders (huge tenders though)instead of a breast....spiciest is closer to medium at other places.. Mac and cheese is unique with bbq sauce and parmesan ranch mixed in but noodles tasted like the were frozen...not bad just okay overall

We have visited a few times and I am always pleasantly surprised. The quality of the fish exceeds my expectations and service is quick and courteous. I get the sashimi dinner and the 3 roll take out special for my guys. The sashimi dinner is one of their more expensive options but the quality is excellent and well worth the cost.

This place is one of the few sushi places I dine at since my love doesn't eat sushi.  The restaurant is clean but all the handwritten signs with items from the menu drive me crazy!  lol.  I'm an amateur sushi eater and usually order a tempura shrimp bento box and maybe a vegas roll.

Been going here for years since since it's about 4 minutes away from the house. They're food is very very good but the past few times I have gone here they're seem like they put less and less in and fill it up with either rice or vegetables.  I will be looking to get take out somewhere else from now on.

The restaurant has a fast-casual feel with rustic decor. We got the Roasted Veggie Pesto and the Margherita pizzas and both were excellent.  

I'm normally not a big soda drinker, but the selection of natural fountain drinks was delicious - loved the ginger zinger and the orange mango!

Great, fast service. I usually use the ATM that's attached to the building in the drive thru, but when it was down one night, they also have one in front of the building, so I was still able to make my deposit. Love the deposit by phone app, and the deposit through ATM with no envelope. 
love it!

The staff at this restaurant always  makes you feel welcome from the second you walk in the door till the moment you leave. They run different specials whether it's during lunch time or dinner. They offer something for each member of the family to enjoy. It has a friendly atmosphere and they remember you.

I love having a store I can walk to!  It is by no means anything like a Schnucks or Deirbergs, but we could never have a big grocery store in the middle of Soulard.  It's a great little neighborhood market with all the basics...meat counter, deli items, produce, beer and fresh/local bread, cookies, pies, etc.

Rule of thumb: don't go to sushi place on Monday.  Most places have not replenish their fish after previous weekend. 

Fish was okay, though they lacked toro. Sushi rice was a little bit dried (I guess it was made from the last portion of the batch).  Tamago was good.  

This is solid spot. I will come back, but not on Monday.

Truly a treat Everytime I visit Saint Petersburg. The desserts are amazingly creamy, and flavors change often.  Not only are you getting to treat yourself to cost efficient deliciousness, it's low in calories too, so added bonus. The staff has always been cheerful, so again your treating yourself to a pleasant experience overall

Best sushi EVER!  Yes, this is Mooresville, Indiana. It is not exactly the sushi capital of the world. However, the sushi here is the best I have EVER eaten. They serve nice, meaty pieces that are fresh and delicious. The service here can be a little hit and miss, but the food is fantastic!

The food is very good, but the dining experience is not. The place is super loud, super crowded, and our server was inattentive. All this after we were seated a full 30 minutes after our reservation time. The kitchen ran out of three of the menu items we attempted to order. Just an unprofessionally run restaurant.

My favorite diner in Tampa! They have really big portions and really good comfort food. They're open 24/7 so great place to come when you get hungry in the middle of the night. Three coins makes me feel like I'm in those old movies eating at a local diner. A must go if you haven't!!!

This place has become of my favorite casual restaurants at the mall and in this area. I enjoy their salads and their friendly service.

On a recent visit, I feel like the food has gone slightly downhill. Food tastes a bit bland and does not seem as fresh compared with past visits.

I got the Sushi and it was great! I am very picky about my sushi and this place was right on point! my fiancé got the salmon and fried rice, and he enjoyed it as well! The service was great, it could have been a little faster, but over all a great experience! we will be returning!

This is not a $35 dollar haircut. Didn't show what back looked like. Left it unstyled after cutting. Didn't shave the back of neck down to collar line. Didn't offer to trim brows. It's certainly no better than sports clips or comparable, but much more expensive. I have no idea where the great reviews are from.

If i could give them no stars I would. Everyone back there was moving slower than molases. People came in and were served and cut the lone cuz they were friends and the patrons were completely ignored. Ive never seen a kitchen so full of people move so slow.

I have been here opening night and came back tonight for another shot. Food service is still fairly slow but the food is good. About 8 tables outside so perfect on nice nights. Asked for a medium hamburger and it came out more than well done, but probably a mixup. 
Go for the quaint atmosphere but not necessarily the full package.

Good selection of sushi available, and descriptions are provided for each roll. All the staff were very nice and friendly. We purchased two appetizers that were delicious and several sushi rolls. A bit expensive for sushi but do-able. I would definitely return!

This location was spot on with their pick up time.  Their facility was a little hard to find since it is buried in a strip mall.  However they had plenty of parking for an easy in and out.  The staff was friendly and speedy.  Things were clean.  The pizza was hot and consistent as always with Papa John's.

I've had an alteration done here before and the guy did a good job. As for dry cleaning though, go somewhere else!!!! They do a crappy job (especially on uniforms) and it's over priced. I tried coming here because it was closer to my house but I will make the extra few miles drive now and go to my normal place.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Walking into the City Market from the Alabama Street side (past the YMCA) , this is the first booth on the right. Grill smells so good! Combos are about $8-10 and come with fries (get them with their seasoning) and a drink. Food is cooked to order so served piping hot. I'm a fan of the patty melt.  #yum #ReviewByRL

This is your typical Wendy's restaurant. It is in the middle of business parks and a few hotels a few miles a way from the airport. There not many food options around. I stayed at a hotel across the street and it was convenient to just walk here. The food was good and the service was also good.

This was good, every once in awhile I crave some good sushi and luckily Daiki Habachi and Sushi was conveniently in my neighborhood.

So I decided to order takeout. I ordered the Philly roll and the spicy tuna roll.

Both rolls were about 9.00. Service was fast and efficient. I will definitely return to try more rolls.

Excellent restaurant from Top Chef winner Kevin Sbraga.

Service was great and food was top notch:
- Foie gras soup (his famous dish)
- Grilled octopus
- Lamb rigitoni

There's a 4 course tasting menu for $50, which is a steal compared to some of the other top restaurants in the city.

Nice gastropub with a trendy inside and also outdoor patio.

Great drink list and nice selection of craft beers and whiskeys. Mac and cheese is addicting. NY Strip was actually very good. Deviled eggs stuffed with trout. Polenta fries. Brussel sprouts were addicting. Sandwiches looked good too.

This location is very clean, however, the coffee was not good. I typically visit Starbucks (other locations) at least once a day and I'm very familiar with the flavor of their Pike Place coffee. The coffee I purchased here was so weak I couldn't even drink it. It was just not good.

Be aware about this place . It's a ripoff! They put a price on auto trader to fish you and once you come they talk about the $3k disclaimer. They don't let you test drive unless you do an application it show money in your account . Terrible business people!!!

Had an amazing dinner. There was an hour wait as the restaurant is very small. They don't take reservations either. The service was on point and they appreciated that we waited for the table to try them out. I had the pasta dish with pink sauce, crab and lobster. It was delicious. I highly recommend. Good food and food service.

Chinese making sushi.  $5.99 for chicken Teriyaki with rice or noodles was not bad.
They do have the cheapest price for sushi here.  Haven't try it but it looked pretty descent.  If you're tired of McDonalds, or Chipotle, this place is a good alternative.
Free parking.  Food court.

Would be nice to get more than 5 pieces of Peperoni pizza.
Salad was 1/4 of Old lettuce.
Do Not buy a soda here....No Ice & they pour their sodas out of a bottle!
The soda was FLAT
I was charged for a Fountain soda!
Never going back!
Imo's has a standard!
NOT AT THIS STORE!!!!

The service was fantastic. Food was brought out on time with everyone at the table served together. Some spices seemed lacking, other than that my only complaint would be that for the price of the cioppino it should have had more than a handful of fish, two shrimp, 1 mussel, 3 or 4 clams and 3 large yummy scallops.

Awesome stay!!  As always the Hyatt brand did not dissapoint. Friendly staff and clean hotel.  Beds were so comfortable and pillows were awesome!!  The complimentary breakfast was really good and they had alot of choices!!  Seems to also be dog friendly.....
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great place for a family dinner or alone night w spouse. Wine is amazing, spaghetti and meatball dish is amazing along w their pizza.  Bathroom in a terrible location which is why I gave 3 stars.  You have to go down a flight of stairs, not good for elderly or handicapped ppl.

Went back again during the week (we usually give second chances to even the bad ones).  We were literally the only ones there, so service was much better.  
Sushi was fine, no different than the average serviceable, dime a dozen sushi place.  Not bad, but not memorable either.

The staffing and management (or mismanagement) of this restaurant is absolutely laughable. I'm not sure how this place hasn't been shut down for health violations or something yet. The absolute most incompetent staff at any restaurant I've ever witnessed. Avoid.

This restaurant is off the best and path a bit but worth a try.  Me and the wife stopped in here for the first time and were pleasantly surprised.  I had a perfectly cooked prime rib and she had a really large foot long chili dog that looked delisted.

Definitely going back.

I haven't stayed here yet although I've heard the rooms are beautiful! We went to the rooftop bar and it was beautiful. Very big bar with lots of open space, seating and beautiful views. The drinks are a bit expensive but the view and sunset makes up for it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This location is terrible. The donuts are always cold, they constantly run out of things and their cream machine is never "calibrated correctly". The last five times I've gotten an ice coffee with cream it comes out looking more like cream with coffee, yuck! I'd avoid this location at all costs.

This is a rather large Starbucks compared to some in the area but only had two people working in the morning so the line was awful! I don't normally come to this location since there's no drive through and had I known how busy it got I would have ordered online ahead of time which I def recommend! My drink was good tho :)

I've been here a few times for aquatic aerobics and spin class (I love spin class). The facility is very clean, friendly and helpful staff. I'm not a member yet but I am definitely joining. They have three day free pass, if you're interested in trying  them out.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Papa Vito's is an awesome spot. The bread sticks are yummy the pizza crust is perfect and the toppings are fresh  service here is good and even though it's in downtown Belleville and the place is a little out dated this is a nice dinner spot for the family! Hidden pizza gem in this area.

So I ended up here again, well it wasn't by choice... this time I had a better room, well at least on paper. Room was just over $300 on 17th floor. No view of the arch, access to a "club" that had snacks and soda. 
The best thing with the hole hotel was the concierge desk and especially Darius.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I am very happy with the haircut and hair color I received a couple weeks ago. Claudia, the owner gave me a free color service to introduce her new color line. She did a wonderful job, I would recommend her to anyone. She is friendly and professional, the salon is clean and all brand new!

This has been my favorite sushi restaurant I found in Nashville!  I went to 3 other places here before finding this one.  This place is BUSY but I was able to get a spot at the sushi bar and surprisingly enough it was super fast and the food was delicious.  This will be my go to when I'm in Nashville.

Great. Cheap. Fast... That's all you need to know, baby. This is the best kept secret amongst Mexican aficionados in the Madison area... Last time I had the shrimp tostadas, which were terrific. The sauces are great and pack a lotta heat... Better get a horchata to go!

kings of pizza has the best tasting pizza in philly hands down...even though the selection of toppings are limited you wont be disappointed trust me..if u on germantown ave and see a parking spot pull in right away take a some change out of the wheel for the meters and grab a slice

As a long time resident of Northern Liberties and a sushi fanatic, I must say Hikari is THE SPOT! 

When you walk in you are welcomed by the friendliest of staff and maybe if you're lucky you'll catch Mr.Sim, the owner and  mastermind behind Hikari. 

Crunchy spicy tuna and eel sushi are da bomb!
Chips pork dumplings ... YUM!

Decided to get the 2 scoop - mint chocolate chip and peanut butter swirl.  Unbelievable. Some of the best ice cream I've ever had.  And topped it with hot fudge.  If you're in the area stop by, this place is amazing.  They also have little games inside for kids / whoever to play with weather proof TVs.

best chinese food in the area, been eating from this place since i was little! will go out of my way to pick up from here now that i moved out of their delivery range! im picky with my fried rice and lo mein, they make it the best!! also great coupons offered on their menu

Went here for a birthday dinner.

Ordered the sashmi platter and three of their fancy rolls. sashmi was excellent. I will say to avoid their special rolls with the "house special sauce."  Tastes like a sweet relish.

Otherwise the atmosphere is great and trendy. Staff is friendly.

Their house made ketchup tastes like straight laundry detergent and I had to wait almost 2 hours to suffer it. P.S. they tried me on my 20% off coupon - they said 'it's posted on the bathroom wall that it's for the hours of 5-7pm'. Well yelp doesn't exactly specify shit that's on your bathroom wall, does it?

Based on the interaction the creepy owner has had with neighbors to his business and the people parking on the street, I'll take my business elsewhere. I've personally had to deal with this man. He is HORRIBLE. There are great cleaners that don't come with the "Why are you even here?" attitude.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Had these guys install 4 new tires on my car.  Once they were done, the tire light sensor was on and would not reset.  Not just one tire sensor was bad, but all four.  Cost for this little piece of plastic is $98/per tire. Place is a joke and the people who work here are total hammers. Would not come here ever again!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Excellent customer service, came on Christmas eve around 6:30, only 6 people. I ordered a Rainbow Roll to taste for freshness and it was. Also ordered Yum Yum Roll and Crunch Roll which didn't disappoint. 
Will come back to try other items like the baby octopus seaweed salad.

This is  a very good market. It has most of the stuff that you used to be able to get in China town, and it is slightly easier to park.  The parking lot sucks, but it is better than the one at T&T.  Meat prices tend to be pretty good, but quality of the meat seems to be hit and miss.

Been coming here for years and typically got great service, but this time fell WAY short. Had appointment for oil change, told me it would be an hour (FOR AN OILE CHANGE!) and it took an hour and 25 minutes. Don't plan to go back. Was real nice and friendly, but you can't over promise and under deliver.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Best carne asada I've had in a while! So fresh and full of flavor! The salsa bar was so clean and all the salsa was to die for! The grilled onions were still hot and perfectly grilled! My boyfriend got the Sonoran hot dogs and the bread was so soft and huge and fluffy! Not gonna lie I'll probably come back for dinner tonight haha

I believe my first post about Toscana was removed, not sure if i violated yelps terms. So here i go again with a much shorter post! Our waiter wanted nothing to do with us, and made it apparent! 
Terrible service! 
 I think the mixed reviews of this place tell a good story!

Busy place located right across from the Fox. Pricey and pretentious. Street tacos with a huge variety of weird toppings were not good! The meat was chewy and tough. 
House margarita was good and well made but served in a plastic disposable cup. That was a turn off! 
Fox patrons- it's not worth your time!

Is it me or are the workers just not interested in your car?
 Of the last five car washes I've had, two have been great and three have been just OK...
Today they we're so backed up that the workers didn't know which car should be next.
Overall a good enough wash but went over my car again at home....

Stopped in the other day for a dozen donuts filled. I got home and they were barely filled at all. I've been to many Dunkin Donuts around the area and a Boston cream is a Boston cream. This location donuts were definitely less filled than any other location. Don't waste your money.

I don't typically write reviews for fast food chains but I had a bad day and was looking for some comfort food. The staff is nice, the place is clean, and the food is decent when you are hungry. I always get the same thing when I come here, the turkey, bacon ranch with loaded potato bites.

This place is great! It's very small, cute and quaint. It reminds me of the coffee shops I would go to when in Long Island to run in, grab a newspaper, bagel and coffee. The only reason I gave it 4 stars and not 5 is because of the space. The service, items, and prices are exceptional!

Visited with my son last Friday.  We were immediately greeted and served.  The restaurant was very clean.  He had an Italian BMT and I ordered a rotisserie chicken spinach wrap with guacamole.  We also had drinks and a free cookie for my son.  Very convenient for U of A students and visitors.

Do not waste your time!! Over priced, inexperienced stylists. They said a partial baylage treatment would be $180 not even knowing how my hair would pull and still were going to do it anyways. They told me it would be $180 plus additional visits. Such a waste of time!!

love this place. recently ate there again with my family. the staff was very nice and our food was good. They did make a mistake- but they corrected it fast. the food came quick, it was fresh, tasted good and was filling. I will be back and its close to my house. It could be swept a little better but otherwise its a great place.

3 stars is about right.
Not the world's greatest supermarket, but it has lost everything you need and a soft ice cream bar is novel. It's great for a local market and convenient for my grandparents who live by to walk to.
More vegan options would be welcome!

Save time and order ahead. They have an amazing app! This place gets busy around 8 which is when everyone goes to work. Great place to eat and be served. The only feedback I have is that service is sometimes great and sometimes not so much. I will order ahead at least 10 minutes and they forget one of my items.

WOW,  prices have really went up since the last time I've been here!  $17 for a car wash, used to be $12.  I won't be coming back, especially since the last few times I was here they didn't do such a great job.  They used to be very good with good prices.  Now the quality is not as good and the prices went up $5.

I went inside on this visit and there was no line! whooo hoo!.
I was in and out in less than 5 minutes. 

There is a armed security guard that stands outside the bank and he is nice to smile and great everyone as they come and go.

ATMs available in both drive through and walk up.

Please get WIFI for waiting customers. When you do I will change 3 stars to 4. For about 9 months I have been going here. I like John's cutting; however, others may be hit or miss based on my experiences. So far I have found a better shop downtown and switched. Their business is booming and cutting is consistent, Red's is not.

As you can see someone contacted me from Planet Fitness and told me to ask the desk to make it cooler. I did that the other day and was told by the desk they are not allowed to change the temperature.  The temperature seems to be getting hotter and hotter. I would guesstimate the temp to have been about 75.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This place is overpriced and for no good reason. I've had several things "cleaned here but rarely do the spots come out. I had a down cover cleaned, but returned to me damp and moldy smelling by the time I took it out of its bag a few days later. Not returning.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Oh man, Highlander. I wish so badly I could review it more highly, but I can't. Used to be a regular here when I lived nearby, but service is consistently weak and food is average microwaveable bar food. Great place to watch a game and drink beer, but don't come too hungry.

Best tacos on the Westbank. My friend and I love coming here. My friend is from Mexico City and she says this is about as authentic as possible. My favorite are the chorizo tacos and their guacamole is amazing. If you are looking for great tacos give this place a try.

This place is hidden in a strip mall off of Bearss and N.Dale Mabry. It's pretty small and quiet. Has a sushi bar as well as booths and tables to eat. The sake is great annd the sushi is very good. The service was ok, the sushi speaks more for this place than the service.

Convenient branch.  A little difficult to get to depending on which direction you are coming from.  Also, be careful if you intend on leaving and going eastbound on Waters.  You'll have to make a U-turn on Waters or drive back towards Sweetbay and make two lefts.

This restaurant has a sign up front with a picture of a woman that dined and dashed. Honestly, with how long it takes just to get the check, I don't be her. Don't even get me started about how long it takes to get food. Given this place two chances, the food is decent but it just takes way too long.

This restaurant has a sign up front with a picture of a woman that dined and dashed. Honestly, with how long it takes just to get the check, I don't blame her. Don't even get me started about how long it takes to get food. Given this place two chances, the food is decent but it just takes way too long.

Rich and creamy!  TOO SWEET & TOO SALTY, however.  This is Mississippi ice cream.  I bought two pints two weeks ago & they're still in my freezer.  But I'm all alone on this review.  350 calories per serving would be ok if I loved it.  1,400 per pint.  I WISH IT WAS BETTER.

My mom likes this place. Awful customer service bad at setting appointments at correct time but hey I guess they know how to clean nails. My only thing is you have a business you know how long it takes to do nails just make your appointment at appropriate time.

Worst. Hotel. Ever. Would be OK if I had paid $35 for this room but paid $180 for broken sink, broken springs in mattresses, mysteriously wet bed sheets, right next to freeway, nails coming through popcorn ceiling, grumpy front desk woman, towels the size of a welcome mat and just as soft. Don't ever stay here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Hands down the worst pizza I've ever had. I can't speak for the other locations but if the formula is at all similar to the Inglewood location, I'm sure they fail too. The crust is cardboard, the cheese is gross and the sauce tastes cheap. The pizza is cheap but I would take little caesars or even a frozen store pizza over this.

We have had mixed experiences in this restaurant in the past, but we came expecting good sushi. We were very disappointed. Starting from the tea (tasteless as hot water), to the toro (fibrous), to the beef carpaccio (the opposite of tender and soft) we had a very unpleasant dinner experience. We are not going back any time soon.

Fricken love this place! Came here for my buddies 23rd birthday and spent Wednesday day drinking on the Patio. There are games and plenty of seating. The bartender was nice and even gave our birthday boy a birthday shot! It's down the road from our house so we'll be back.

Amazing. The size of the pizzas are perfect for sharing. Definitely go with 2 Pies and a salad.  We brought 4 pies over to our friends with a newborn and they couldn't have been happier. It's such a treat. Not the usual " pizza and salad" delivery order. Fresh ingredients and great atmosphere, BYOB is also a plus

Wasabi Sushi in Lakeview is truly a hidden gem of the neighborhood. I've tried a litany of menu items here from the basic rolls, to the special varieties, and even the dinner entrees. Along with the expedient service, Wasabi has never ceased to satisfy. 

Be sure to try the LSU and Yellow Dragon rolls, along with the Beef Teriyaki!

I still dont know how this place stays in business. The employees are all kids and talk to customers like crap. I've actually heard a manager yell at a cashier and told her to "get her ass out of there and go home." Never ever go there with your kids. Constant cursing rom the Levittown rats in there.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
very normal, sashimi is not good. the specialities are just normal. price is not worth it you will never find any japanese eating there I bet you.
food looks nice though but as taste point just normal needs to improve quality of where they grt the fish from.

Amazingggg sushi! Presentation is phenomenal! By far the best sushi around the Collegeville area. Great staff and the owner (Indiana) was so nice and pleasant! I would recommend this place to anyone around the area who is a sushi lover at heart! Will be back sooner than later.

Can I give 0 stars? Bad. They focus on drive thru to detriment of dine ins. 10 minute wait for qtr pounder with cheese meal? Please! Besides that, it is a ratchet place. No napkins or catsup on self serve. Must ask permission to use restroom. Give this one a miss.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
The food was very average but good still. The service was pretty good. It was very busy, but I don't feel like we had to wait very long to be seated or to get our food. 

The check was $30 for both of our entrees plus cheese dip. It was not too bad overall.

Food was ok. The sweet and sour chicken came so well done that it wasn't even edible. Way too over cocked. The beef lo Mein was good. Pork fried rice didn't have much flavor to it at all. Really upset about how over cooked the sweet and sour chicken was :/ couldn't find more than 2 pieces to eat.

The set up is a little strange especially the front of the restaurant and we had to ask to sit in the back...but i thought the food was good! Fish tacos were great and the margaritas were awesome! i did think that this place was way overpriced for the small portion size though
