The service here is great, and my favorite is their breakfast burritos. My kids beg for them. They are huge and filled with eggs, cheese, your choice of meat (we like the pork sausage) and potatoes, if you like (which I like!). Their green salsa is soooo good. We love their beans, too.

We've been to several of the Value Vet locations, depending on which one has appointments available.  It's obvious that they really care about the critters in their care.  I like the way that they don't automatically run up a lot a charges, but discuss various treatment options.

They keep adding new things to the menu, but until they take the roast beef n cheddar and the potato cakes off the menu, I'll probably never try any of the new stuff.  My wife is more adventurous and tried the new roast beef gyro.  She loved it.  She also had the salted caramel shake which was also very tasty.

Thank God this place shut down. What a shithole. My family got food poisoning here one night and corporate did nothing. My mom chipped her tooth on a piece of porcelain plate that was found in her salad and they still tried to charge us for the salad. Good riddance.

This is definitely the worst of all the planet fitness locations I've been to. Outdated equipment, staff that obviously doesn't care, poor layout. It's more like an oversized apartment workout room than an actual gym. Avoid if you can. There are better locations
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: One stop shop for all your fitness needs. Multiple types of exercise equipment, free weights, weight machines, personal training staff, tanning both,, massage stations, full bathrooms equipped with sauna. The only thing this place doesn't have that I've seen at other gyms is a smoothie bar. That would be nice.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
This location is no different than any other Starbucks as far as service. Not a lot to say that anyone doesn't already know. The staff is always friendly. 

A word of warning though:The parking lot is a damned nightmare!! Seriously, it's a train wreck. Otherwise always had a good experience.

Awesome wings, super great beer prices, pool tables, and a jukebox. The wings are not fried so be prepared to wait a bit for them. They are worth the wait. Order at the table but the bartender brought our food to us. The atmosphere is definitely bar as opposed to club etc. Overall a great place.

A place like this is why i stay away from bars in Mayfair. Over priced drinks, and its basically like a high school reunion. This is  where the Hoe-bert girls anf judge heads hang out, so if your into underaged girls and "beer muscle" boys this is the place for you.

I really like the servers here but jesus are they slow..it takes forever to get a drink here..The food is just okay..nothing to write home about. I'd recommend going early because I tend to go in late nights and that's when they are busy and can't seem to juggle all the customers.

Had Oyster appetizer and Crab appetizer.  Both outstanding.  Wife had Flounder with Lump crab and I had Fillet. Unbelievably delicious. Finished off meal with Baked Alaska with their homemade ice cream.  Unique and refreshing.  Craft cocktails were also excellent.  Great service and atmosphere at a reasonable price!

For a Chinese spot to order from, it's good. I've never had any problems with the food making me sick. The delivery is always fast and super friendly. I have no complaints! Again, this is your typical Chinese "fast food", this isn't a 5 star date-night restaurant.

This Dunkin' is the absolute worst.

There's only a 50% chance your order is right on any given day and you're normally treated to multiple employees screaming at you to get your order. 

They are also always having a tech issue. (Can't take credit, can't take the rewards app, etc) 

Skip it.

This was the first place in Florida I got to try. After being here for a year I've gone back multiple times and still had the same great experience! Delicious sushi for a reasonable price. Nothing too fancy, just a mellow hole in the wall spot for good sushi.

The customer service has gone downhill over the last few months.  I think there was a change in management.  The order accuracy is terrible and the majority of the staff DO NOT speak or understand English very well at all.  So disappointing.  I will drive to the next closest location if and when I eat at McDonalds again.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Love this place! So glad they opened this location. The tacos are amazing and really filling. You can't be the prices for the quality and quantity of food that you get. I used to make special trips to the other location and I am thrilled that I have one closer to home now.

Good food. Good service. Good prices. Family-owned diner with everything you could want for breakfast or lunch on the menu. Very casual environment. It seemed like there were lots of regulars there that knew the staff which is always a good sign. 

The pancakes were really good and the bacon was crispy.

The nachos here are really good  and so are the quesadillas but some of the quesadillas can be a bit one note in flavor, having more cheese than any of the other ingredients. The wraps have a little too much rice which makes them bland. The portions are huge, though, which is great.

This pizza is really the best pizza on Main Street!! The workers are very helpful and eager to sell the pizza! I had the bacon ranch pizza and it really was more than I expected; very very tasty!!! I was with people who had the buffalo chicken pizza and sausage pizza and they enjoyed it as well. Overall great pizza

Been going there for about two years now and it is so peaceful and relaxing. Friendly customer service and a food truck that is very good. 
The reason for the 3stars is they haven't upgraded the benches outside by the river. Getting splinters is not fun nor the snags on our clothes. Hope they get new benches! out there

Awesome location and EXCELLENT Food!!  Everyone there is so sweet and the restaurant is small and very beautiful. Great for take out.  Food comes out fresh and delicious. Highly recommended, worth the drive, the taste and the bucks.  Great job guys!! We'll be back! Bucks well spent here!

Have eaten here since opening day and for my money they have the best cheese steaks outside the city, and the Italian hoagies compete with anyone. The store is small for eating in but the staff are friendly and the quality is up there. Can't go wrong here.

This was pretty darn good as the reviews suggested. The coffee ice cream and the basil blueberry were tasty. I wasn't a fan of Zulu but my husband really enjoyed it. We were the only ones in there so I can't really say anything about the service as we were taken care of right away. It was yummy.

Decent sized tacos. Flavors are fine. I do not like their guacamole since it seems like it is from the box and not made from scratch. I love al pastor tacos but these tend to be super Greasy. If you are looking for a taco place that is more authentic I think this is one of the better places to order from!

Very unique flavors of ice cream. My 2-yr old daughter killed the Cotton Candy flavor.  She absolutely loved it! We rode the street car from our hotel on Canal Street.  Another highlight of her trip! She was so excited to ride a "trolley like Daniel Tiger".

I tried Munchy's a couple of times, because they are convenient.  Unfortunately every attempt was just a sub-par experience. 

Pasta: over-cooked, bad canned sauce
Hoagies: Eh.   But seriously, who doesn't offer mayonnaise as an option?
Chicken tenders: Dry, bland

Maybe their pizza is ok, but three strikes and you're out.

Love the concept, love the toppings, love the six flavor options. Frozen yogurt is delicious and really enjoyed picking my own mix of toppings. Buyer beware the cups are much too large!!! They fill very easily and you pay by the weight. My cup looked empty but it was plenty to fill me up!!

Service great. Margaritas not good at all. Very weak. The interior is beautiful, but unfortunately that doesn't make the food any better. Everything was very overpriced. Very sad that we waited so long for this place to open and we will never be returning.

Here for a Birthday party and the staff was helpful and got everything set up quickly. The place is clean and well kept and the food came out quickly and was great. It is hard to keep a place full of kids clean and organized but I think this location is doing a great job. It's an affordable place to have a children's party.

Always a fun stop for us. 

Service is friendly, there are both inside and outside seating options, and parking is very easy. 

Be careful on toppings as the weight adds up quick and you can easily have a $10+ Sunday before you know it.

They rotate a few flavors per month so there is always something exciting to try.

Their salsa was flavorless. To many green peppers in the fijitas compared to the onion and the chicken was dry.  Had to ask for more torrtias because the first ones where dried out. The kid who brought out the food didn't warn is how hot the plates where. My food was just pay. And by the way no Tolet seat in the men's room.

Was in town for work. I have visited this club in the past and had no issues so I stopped in again. 

Front staff is very friendly and welcoming. Got me checked in and on my way to do my workout in no time. 

Facility was very clean and well kept. machines were all working as intended. 

Will visit again with no problem.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Ok sushi for tucson. The menu is quite chaotic with handwritten menu items ALL over the walls. It could use a serious makeover. If you can get past this chaos, the sushi is pretty decent. Good sashimi, good rolls, good miso, good prices. Overall better than average sushi for tucson. The service is  always excellent.

The grocery store has really stepped it up lately. Lots of good sale prices and an inventory to match. The meat department is clean and I didn't see any meat that was past the best buy date.
It is close by so it is easier to get to than going to K rogers..yuck

The wine selection has grown over the yrs due to one guy who made sure they kept up with the bigger liquor stores in Nashville. Unfortunately he is no longer there and you can tell it.  There prices are higher than the larger liquor stores but if I am not driving into town I just stop there to save time and gas

Pros:
Very kind, friendly, attentive staff.
Newly refreshed and updated.
Nice atmosphere in all the common areas.
Plenty of parking albeit $10 + taxes a day 
Easy in and out.

Cons:
Shower floor corners were moldy.
Bath sink hecka low.
Very loud highway noise in the room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The best thing you can do for your pet is to take them here in any emergency!! I was very pleased with the staff's care and compassion, and was updated regularly by the doctor (usually twice a day). They truly care about their patients and have a team of wonderful doctors. Thank you Hope VS!

Friday 'all you can eat grouper' special is a good deal. They offer it fried, jerk, grilled and blackened. I tried jerked and blackened and both were tasty. The sides were just 'ok.' The service was all right. The weather was horrible when we were there but it looks like they have a nice outdoor area.

Usually excellent service and food. Tonight I must not have been dressed nice enough. Hadn't even finished my food when my waitress brought me my check and said "have a good evening" and left to go talk about her rescue dogs with a table next to me. No I didn't want dessert and an expresso. Very pissed off!!

I have never had Detroit style pizza and so it was a treat to try it.  Ingredients were fresh.  Flavor was great.  In general, the pizza was too heavy for me but I think that's a reflection of Detroit style pizza.  Will have to try the thin crust next time.

I love sushi.  I will not go back, not even for happy hour.    Not worth your time.  The snow crab was a disappointment.   Very little tuna or salmon in the rolls.  Huge pieces that should have been cut in half.    A roll meant avocado and lots of rice and a little tuna.    Service not good either.

This is a great clinic. I called concerned and we came right away and they took us back to a room immediately. The tech and front desk staff were very compassionate. The vet was conscious of the cost when recommending the treatment plan. I hope to not to have to come back, but I am glad to know they are available for our family.

Went with husband, son and daughter (in-law).  Our second time there.  Food was delicious, we all had different things and we were all pleased.  Comes with a salad and hot fresh rolls which they refilled.  Can't believe more people haven't found out about this place.  Would recommend this restaurant and their friendly staff.

This is by far the best Japanese habachi grill in the area. The consistency here is what really sets this place apart. We have been regulars here for years and remember why when ever we go to a different Japanese habachi grill. The food is awesome and the customer service is good as well.

It was a place to stay, but I'd not choose this place again.  Bed was reasonably comfortable, room was reasonably clean.  Shower was kind of nasty with a shower curtain that has been hung too low for too long.  Breakfast was in a small space and had waffles.  The end; of my stay, of my trip, and of my patronage of LaQuinta.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Why do I always get unsweetened tea every time I order sweet tea using the drive thru?? When I order inside, I never have that problem..... B.S. 
Although I will admit that this location does make the best Dave's single burger among all the nearby Wendy's locations. :-)

Service was slow and the food was just ok. It was kind if disappointing considering the location and decor. I ordered the panzanella salad with chicken added; it lacked flavor, believe it or not. I also ordered sweet potato fries which took forever to come out.

Consistently good. Nice beer selection and drink specials.  Love the french martini.  The salad dressing is delicious and we always get a side to dip our crust in.  The arugula pizza is amazing and my husband really enjoys the wings. Check it out.  You won't be disappointed.

Nice little Asian grocery store. Good selection of products, and decent prices. We especially like it because it's close to home, and we don't have to travel 45 minutes to get our Asian groceries. The owners are super- nice, too. Great people, great little store! Check it out, it's definitely worth your while to stop in.

we have been going here for years and are consistently happy with the food and value. I always look forward to the left overs the next day - serving sizes are generous. They always cook the calamari perfectly and the pasta as requested. Sauce is tasty and servers are warm and efficient.

They lost our order & it took over an hour to get chicken wings.  When we ask to talk to a manager there wasn't one....we were informed that they don't come in till really late.  This restaurant runs just like a ship without a captain.  It's disorganized & no one knows what they are doing.

Service here was terrible.  Barely got our water refilled, and the sushi took over 40 minutes to arrive (and we only got 3 rolls).

This location also did not have a brown rice option.

The only perk to this place is the convenience of it when doing shopping around the Elmwood area.

Of the Sake Cafes, this one ranks second.  This location did not have brown rice as an option for their sushi.  The also do not have the tuna cake appetizer that the uptown location does.  

One plus though is that the service seemed to be quicker than the other locations.

There is also plenty of parking in the parking lot.

Bathroom help with keeping sanitary and keeping stocked up. Also, what happened to that going out of your way-Starbucks  friendliness? Not so much here.  Outside of that, I love this Starbuck's setup and hope the one they're building in Trinity turns out this cool or better. The Cure was playing - pretty awesome tunes!!!

Ate here once an will not ever be returning again. I ordered a Carne asada burrito which was a decent size but had absolutely no flavor it was just so blah. The service was really great but the restaurant was empty so the food came out really fast just wish it tasted better.

Seriously the best pizza .... ever. My husband and I always look forward to picking up a pie from Bettina, and when Covid is over we look forward to having them cater our reception (eloped when our original wedding was cancelled). They are the nicest people - can't go wrong with any of their pizzas. To die for!!

This Wyndham needs some help. There are only 2 elevators in the building. They take forever, so don't be in a rush to get up to or come down from your room. I checked into my room and found some leftovers and cleaning supplies. This place has sub par reviews for a reason. Do not ignore the signs!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Not impressed this visit. Apparently they have a lunch special, which I was not offered. All 3 of my rolls fell apart and my Chardonnay was warm (&mgr knew it.) Won't be coming back. She could have comped the wine. Not happy about a crappy $27 lunch with lousy service.

I read the reviews here as our 9 year old son was craving Chinese food. This was the best General Tso's Chicken I've ever had. Both my sons loved the sweet and sour chicken, my wife her Lo Mein. Tasty egg rolls and fried wonton, everything was delicious and our service was first rate!

I wouldn't say this place is anything special or anything. Just your typical Papa Johns. If you're looking for a quick, relatively cheap place to grab a pizza, it's a good place for it. I have a feeling they have the business they have because of the business's close proximity to West Chester student housing.

I loooooooooove the birthday cake deluxe ice cream as ice cream or a shake.  Recently I tried the chocolate devine shake which was also delicious.  I'm anxious to try the apple pie a la mode next.  Very good ice cream.  I'm a fan.  I wish there was a closer location than alllllllll the way down Carrolton.

I've been here twice.  The pizza is huge!!  It's also really greasy like Italian Pie greasy where you have to get the paper towel and dab it because it's just so much grease. :(   They don't have sweet tea (but a nasty syrup sweetener).  Small place and is usually really crowded.  It's okay but I'm not dying to go back again.

Lots of draft beer options and had a good seasonal  selection- they even had my favorite pumpkin beer on tap (schfly pumpkin)  it's also a close Nissan Stadium, so that's a plus! Definitely recommend coming here before or after a titans game to hang out and enjoy a brew or two!

We are here for lunch and the food was no better the hospital food. My husband got the fish and it was thin and very dry. I got the a dinner That was bad as well! They were kind enough to take the price of my husbands meal off the ticket. For that I give the people a 4 star.

Good BP for take out or eat-in. It's big and spacious. I get the Boston royale and order the onions extra crispy. They do a good job of that. It's centrally located with lots of parking and a shopping Center in the same parking lot making it convenient for dinner and errands.

Large rooms, very nicely upgraded fixtures and comfortable bed, love having Keurig in the room though housekeeping seems to forget to replenish. Don't understand why the bar would be closed at 9:45 on a Thursday night. Otherwise a nice stay at a good price.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I absolutely love this place. The underground location, the divey feel, the quality tunes of the jukebox, the phenomenal beer selection, well at least for Nashville, what's there not to like? This place will always hold sentimental value to me. Got to love the Beer Sellar!

Cool for a Carmel rooftop bar. Super slow and not very pleasant service (if you don't want to deal with inebriated people...don't become a bartender) and I almost fell out of my chair when my martini came out to $20 before tax and tip. Overpriced even for Carmel.  I would put this at $$$.

Awesome spot for a larger group (can hold a party of 10-12). The service is quick, and the pizza is also very good. The pizza is similar style to grotto pizza (ie. the sauce in circles). There's usually quite a few topping options to choose from, and it's a BYO which is a plus. Always a good time at Slice!

I fell in love with this hotel. It was not perfect, but was so vintage and classic NOLA that the feel there is incredible, and a great site to see. The room was damp, as there was a big water leak on a wall, but we were so tired we were past the point of caring. Check in and out was effortless, prices were great.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: They were not able to get me in on Saturday so I made a Tuesday appointment. I got here five minutes early. After filling out paperwork, I was told I would be seen in 15 minutes. I've been sitting here for an hour. I wish they would have at the very least given me an accurate wait time- I am in a mall. Not impressed.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Great lunch spot! The rolls are fresh and delicious. The main thing I like about the rolls is they use the right amount of rice. I'm always taking excess rice off of my rolls but not here. The prices are great as well. Don't let the outside fool you. It's in a strip mall but the inside is a great atmosphere.

O I do love the O Bistro. The menu is eclectic and it's difficult to decide what to order since everything is so tantalizing. Staff is attentive and knowledgeable about the food. 

Highly recommend the short rib patty melt, lamb burger and my favorite the sirloin steak and Brie.

To say I loved this place was an understatement. My favorite part of this ice creamery is the ability to do taster scoops! 4 scoops for $5 was the perfect amount to try a few of their AMAZING ice creams (there is no way I could have chosen one!) Be prepared with cash in certain locations!

Given a 4 star rating not becauce of overall flavor but because of service, quantity of food and prices- it is average as far as Mexican food flavor, but it is good and atmosphere & other things I mentioned makes it a go to place for a lot of food at great price with great service--

Well, what can I say, it's sushi. Not super fresh, but for the price, it is worth it. They make the sushi look real nice, but it takes reaaaaaally long for it to come out and the service in general is adequate. And for those two reasons, I much prefer Osaki.

Pricey, but it's the closest to my house. But after today's pickup, where yet again they forgot to apply the coupons I showed them at drop off (you know, the ones I get 2-3 times a week in my email), I'm done. Forgetting once is acceptable, multiple times is just a scam.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Limited menu, but great selection of drinks! I had the Greek Salad recently and it was packed with veggies! More kalamata olives than I've ever seen in a salad before and the Greek dressing had good flavor.

Service was good and they kept my soda flowing, which was appreciated.

Had a wonderful pizza, I believe it was called The Soprano. You could taste all the different meats and cheeses, definitely fresh. It wasn't very busy so our service was fine; although our waitress took awhile to bring the things she promised, it wasn't too big of a deal. 

Overall, I'd recommend it.

I was unimpressed with this restaurant. Service was okay and when I finally got my beer the glass had a major crack in it. Took forever for the waitress to come back to let her know. When she did, she was very, very sorry. Food was not that great and again, slow in getting to us.

Great atmosphere and very comfy. However, the people working there seem to be a bit rude. The first couple of times I had gone were great. Price was great, people were great and I highly recommended it. Last couple of times were so so. I am definitely not as impressed and would not "highly" recommend the salon. It's just okay.

Service was OK
Food was good 
But NO miso soup and udon. Taste horrible!
Charged $4 for two cup of hot tea which was not reasonable I thought. 
We paid $30 each including tips (total 60)
Which was OK I think 
Considered the price in regular sushi restaurant 
It was cheaper since we had 6~7 rolls. (Normally cost 
8~12 per roll)

This is a cool little ice cream shop.  They had really interesting flavors like matcha.  My boyfriend tried it and didn't love it but he was glad he tried it.  I got coffee flavored ice cream and it was great!  The shop has plenty of seating and it's in a great location.  Only complaint is it felt a little a little expensive.

Ordered food, waited 30 minutes, asked if there was a problem, we were told by the waiter that our orders were not started and the pep would be another 30 min before it could be started.  The waiter asked us if we still wanted the meal.  We left for Bru Berger across the street.  Good decision

Recently we visited STH for a luncheon with a group of friends and I've always said I would review my previous review, and amend it if warranted, well they deserve an update.  They seem to have changed bakers and their grub, still bar food for the most part, has a much better offering. Try their hummus plate, it's delicious.

This place is HOME! The most comforting location to get your fitness on! The coaches are A-MAZING! They are so inspirational and motivating. Even on my crappy days I can count on this gym to lift me up! Get up and get out here! You won't regret it. It's addicting!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Awful. Just awful service. Never have cars ready even though I have a Gold Club reservation. Agents never acknowledge you when you walk in. Every employee seems put out by your very presence. In the world of customer service "what not to do" this place is a Saturday Night Live skit!

The server dropped menus on the table after we had to request to see them. Not very friendly.

Food was good, but you can probably do better. Sad to see the service so lousy.

It's cool you can eat on the street and people watch, but I fail to see what this restaurant does that others can't do better.

Victoria is an amazing hair stylist, who listened to my thoughts/ideas and was able to make what I had imagined work for my very straight think hair!! You also should try the hot tea they offer while you wait, it's super yummy. They truly pamper you at Sage Salon, I look forward to going every time!

I had an amazing experience. Quick and fast. The staff were amazing ! the doctor was very thorough and he put my contacts in to actually check the fit. Which I have never had done before . It was a cool experience.  The staff helped me pick The perfect pair of glasses for me I will always come back here.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Suchhhhh a cool, artsy, beautiful hotel. I came here for a quick staycation and would highly recommend anyone looking for a "I don't feel like I'm in Indianapolis" type of vibe. The rooms are spacious, modern, and luxurious. The service from the staff was top notch, and there are lots of great restaurants nearby.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The coffee is good but overall lacks consistency. Sometimes the drinks are too strong, and other times weak. Sometimes they are so busy shortcuts are made. Always friendly staff and the coffee has a good unique flavor, I just wish there would be more focus on getting the recipe's right.

Only went here once but I was impressed.  There was no line ahead of me and I was done in less than 20 minutes for a basic oil change!

On top of that they also vacuumed out the front seat, which was a huge plus!

It's in a convenient Central location and the price was fair.

If I'm in the area I wouldn't mind stopping by again
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Just had dinner here for the first time. It's so nice to find a small intimate restaurant in Media that cares about quality and friendly . Tori was a great server! So pleasant and helpful! The food was really good! You must try the monkey brains! Don't miss this out of the way find!

Very poor service. Had to cancel my order and get a refund as first barista did not alert second barista of my order. Waited 15 minutes! Second barista was very rude and had a disrespectful attitude. First barista Alec could not give me management info. I will find on my own and follow up. Avoid this Starbucks at all costs.

This place is kind of unorganized. There are mountains of beer everywhere and there doesn't appear to any rhyme or reason to where it is placed in the store.  There are also no prices really on items. If this placed was more organized then I'd go here more. I can't find what I need or how much anything is.

Frog legs!!  There were 6 of us coming for our 3rd return visit in 3 years, mainly because the food is good and my husband particularly likes the frog legs.  All 3 gentlemen ordered the frog legs and said they were outstanding.  Get jumping folks, and go get them!

I have had more than one experience now where this vet is constantly trying to upsell you on things you don't need. They DO NOT have the best interest of your pet, they have the best interest of themselves and making money. I would never recommend this vet to anyone.

Our first time here. Friday night, party of 5. Started with appetizers of meatballs and bruschetta. Both were amazing. Everyone was happy with their entrees including Filet Mignon Pasta, Hay Hay's Special and the Chicken Carbonara. Service was amazing as well!

Their doughnuts are good, the toppings don't make it past the day you purchase. The price is on point with a specialty doughnut place and the people working are somewhat friendly. Maybe after they have been open for a while and get through their growing pains I'll return.

Worst McDonald's ever! Super slow service, dirty restaurant, clueless employees, fries and nuggets always over cooked. We filed a corporate 7complaint a couple years ago about this restaurant and you would think they would get some better management in there but here we are years later and food and service still sucks.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Standard junk food. Sometimes the wait is ridiculous, but the employees always seem very nice. Their ice cream machine is always "broken" which is kind of funny, but mostly aggravating when my 3 year old decides that is the only thing she wants to eat for days at a time.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I visited this location back in May while visiting NOLA. A great spot for listening to live music. The food menu is also full of options. I tried the seafood quesadilla and it was delicious. The wait time was a lot longer than expected but the food was worth the wait.

I opened an account recently and the professionalism and knowledge of the staff really impressed me. They answered my questions quickly and with precision each time I called. No hemming and hawing or waiting "while I get someone who can answer your question".

This creamery has tons of ice cream flavor options and the staff knows how to get through a crowd quickly! 

I had a sample of the Lavender Honey and it was very sweet and summery. The Mexican Hot Chocolate has an excellent balance between rich chocolate, aromatic cinnamon and spicy chili pepper. Both are worth a taste!

I swing by the drive thru at this McDonald's when I'm in a rush to eat (either because I'm too busy to eat at home or I just forgot. Unfortunately the drive thru is usually very slow. I like the people who work here though! They just tend to get slammed in the middle of the day... Always!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I have lived in Nashville all my life and had never found an absolute favorite nail place until I found this gem through a friend!!!! I've been coming here for at least a year and recommend it to everyone. The staff is so friendly and do a great job every time. And they honestly have the best pedicures.

It has been over 7 years and I am not 100% sure it is the resteraunt I used to dine in. I love their chirashi bowls and soft shell crab. Every time I  travel to Tucson in 2007, I went there once or twice.  And always amazed sushi in Tucson is not bad at all, compared to sushi restaurant in DC and NYC.

They give your free miso soup but the sushi was not good at all. I could literally feel my stomach getting upset as I was eating it. It's super cheap, but you get what you pay for. I definitely would go somewhere else for sushi, unless you're trying to go on a cheap date, then by all means.

There are so many good Italian restaurants in the suburbs these days that I cannot justify driving out to CH for a return visit. 

The menu wasn't too summery and though some dishes were tasty they were not all on the same level.  Ossobuco was not impressive and the Gnocchi were large and a bit too dense.

Service was okay.

The margaritas were delicious, the food was OK. Nothing terrible, but nothing to write home about. The guacamole and the mole sauce were the highlights of the meal. Generous portions.

Caution: the menu has four soups that are starred as "vegetarian," but apparently three of them have chicken stock.

Excellent coffee, friendly employees, & free WiFi. Why go anywhere else? Oh, adorable retro (mid-century) furniture, air conditioning, & ice cream too.  My wife's iced chai latte was also perfect. A gem in the Marigny area just outside the quarter. Give them all your business.

Always sweet owners have done nicely in this location, great for a quick pick up or stop off by on your way back home.
Standard Italian fare made easy to order with components and meal deals/combinations that kids and adults both love. If I had this when I was a child in the 80s I would've been in heaven!

The wifi RARELY works and most of the machines (bike, treadmills, ellipticals, cybex's) are frequently in need of maintenance. For instance, right now all four bikes are having major pedal problems. 

But it's only $10/$20 a month, the staff are all very nice, and it's close to my house and work.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Hadn't been here in quite a while and was so glad that I returned. All of our food choices were excellent. Much better than I had remembered, and updated selections. Service was impeccable. The host, server and chef all checked to make sure that we were happy!

It's the best carry out  Chinese food place in the city. I wouldnt ever dine in. Your impression of this place will be remain good if you just get your food and go enjoy it somewhere else. I never carry cash so it's a little inconvenient to have to get cash before coming here. It's worth it though.

I love this place. I always get right in. I get a manicure and a spa pedicure for $33! You can't beat that. The spa pedicure involves a foot and leg mask, sugar scrub,cooling leg and foot gel, then a hot towel. It's heaven. I've become a faithful patron. I haven't found so much for so little anywhere else!

Matthew Roberts is a great salon! I started out with Azeza, and when she left, I switched to Ruth, who is awesome. I bring her a picture, and she makes my hair look exactly the way I want it to every time. She has cut it, given me fringe, colored a few different ways, and it always ends up exactly the way that I wanted it to!

My food just arrived after waiting 1.5 hours. It is a Friday night so I can be understanding, but our waitress did not even check in once to say "sorry" or provide an explanation. Their business appears to cater towards take out orders.  The food is okay. Not amazing, but certainly not terrible. EXTREMELY disappointed.

I used to hate this location, but something has changed in the past year. I don't know if it's the management or the employees, but it's gotten better! Food is fresher, employees are nicer, tables are actually CLEAN. Happy to see this place improving! Will come back.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Walked in here to buy a shirt - what a dump.   Tom Petty was in town and the place had 4 people in there.  

Shirts were not marked.  Asked the price And went to pay.  Price was double.   Left the shirt at the counter and walked out.   Agree- reminded me of a low rent district basement bar.   What a dump.

Small hole in the wall that delivers on taste. Was my first time here and I ordered the Sopes with chicken in a green tomato sauce. The portions are good, the ingredients were fresh, and overall a good experience. I can't wait to come back and try something else.

Gluten Free pizza is pretty decent. 

The toppings are pretty skimpy almost need to our double ham, double pineapple. 

There is only one size of GF pizza but compared to BPs, Pizza 73 & Panago this is very tasty, the crust might be thin but does have some chew.

I take back any negative thing I said in my 1st review. This place is AWESOME. After my 3rd visit I didn't even have to order anymore the owner is already writing my drink on a cup when he sees me walk up. They are always friendly and fast. I have never had an issue with my drink.

My boyfriend and I was really curious how this place was because we would always see it whenever we are the cherry hill mall. We tried it and it didn't disappoint, it's a bit pricey but the customer service and the quality of the food was great. You can see your food being cooked right in front of you, well sort off

I like this place only depends if the barbers that were more focused in the haircut quality than the discussion for the day. The weekend is where the great barbers are at. They are very understanding to their customers as far as I can see. Very community orientated area.

This place is out of this world good!!  The food is as good as the local places in Italy. It is the most authentic Italian food in Nashville. Delicious. My new favorite place. When you come, ask for Mary Beth. She may be the best server in Middle Tennessee!!!

If I can't get to my favorite spot, THIS place is a close contender. Usually very fresh but lately I have had an over cooked dry roll or two with shrimp. Shit happens though,  I'm not mad because I will typically order so many rolls to ensure I have enough options!

The hotel recently opened and the rooms are clean/updated. The hotel is easy to find and about 30-40 mins from MacDill AFB with traffic in the morning. My only complaint was the bed was a little too hard and I constantly woke up in the morning with back pain.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Fabulous service, reasonable prices, with great attention to details. The rolls were generous, the Mochi dessert was an exquisite treat -beautifully served with flavors of green tea, mango, sesame, strawberry and mango. The sashimi is could have been tastier...

Fabulous for take out 5 stars 
Inside I just don't find it pleasing... don't know if it is the layout I the tv. And or music playing and I like to see sushi chef at work and he is hidden away .. 
Juhn is best sushi chef and fabulous quality and beautiful but so tiny for the price. If I was rich would get take out all the time!

I went there last week because i saw so many yelp reviews and thought it might be good. But personally i think these hairdressers are not as good as what i have back in china. I have long hair, yet the hair cutting only took 10 minutes, which is very weird. Overall i think it's not worth all the reviews.

Our evening was a special birthday event and we were given a private room upstairs. The service was attentive and professional. He also picked up on our discussions and joined in the fun. He made an extra effort. I ordered the special before he had finished his description - ravioli, lobster, mussels, clams, cheese.....

These classes are just what I need to wake my muscles! I have been exercising regularly for several years but I felt like my body had reached a plateau. Not anymore! I can literally feel my body responding to the HIIT training by tightening up further. This works like nothing else I've tried!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Waited quite a while to be seated.  They were not that busy.  Super friendly server. 

I had scrambled eggs, bacon, potatoes, and toast.  Had to send my eggs back because they were overdone.  The ones that come back were excellent!  Loved the bacon. The toast and potatoes were good enough.  

Definitely recommend!

Love love love this place! Hands down the best Moscow Mule I've ever had (they hand crush the ice and make their own ginger syrup reduction - it's amazballs) and the old school band just made the experience perfect. It's my first time in Nola but this really is the best bar I've found.

Worst meal on the beach. 
Ruined our Valentines Day lunch.
Made us both sick.
The waitress even charged us for my coke
After the meal was returned. 
$3.99 for a coke! Should have been complimentary 
Due to the burnt and over cooked chicken and freezer 
Burnt tots!

Bonzai Sushi is so amazingly affordable and delicious. Their bento boxes are such a steal. I love their eel (unagi) nigiri sushi and their noodle salad! Their ordering system is pretty unique for a sushi restaurant where you order at the register and they bring the food to you after.

I'm surprised that during a busy time there is only one cashier. The person before me had an item return and it took such a long time. No one said anything to me while I waited and waited. I come here a lot and just expected to be welcomed and not ignored.

I recently started going to this branch as I'm the treasurer for a non-profit group. This is my first experience EVER with Wells and I have been consistently pleased with how well I'm treated. I do have one issue (I cannot seem to get them to mail me a monthly statement) which I'm hoping will soon get resolved.

Word to the wise... Stay away. Aside from the fact that it took 20 minutes to get two Whopper meals and a salad, the grilled chicken was burnt pretty bad. It was dried out like leather and tasted terrible. I know.... Why did I get salad at a burger joint... Because the boys wanted Whoppers... Next time I'll wait and eat later.

Seemed like a good choice until we got home.  Food Poisoning for over 24 hrs.  Called the owner to make them aware.  He thanked me but assured me that no one else was sick.  Seemed fairly indifferent.  If you wanna roll the dice be my guest.  Too many other good places to eat.

Breakfast today: Eggs, hash browns, WW toast...w/Sauage gravy.  Food quality was average.....has declined from my last visit two years ago. Parking very good.  Cleanliness average.  Waitress.....Shelly was superior. (I have eaten here for last twenty-five years)

2-14-18
Dinner for 1
Ambiance - Fair
Order Counter - POOR
Food - Hot & Sour soup....Fair tasting but low priced
Thai Shrimp House Special.....Heavy breaded and greasy....poor tasting, broccoli very good....very unhappy
Staff - VERY PLEASANT & POLITE 
Sorry, I will not return.

The best. Fresh high-quality sushi. Excellent nigiri and sushi rolls, but their urchin is the best I have ever had. Great selection of fresh specials. Great selection of beer & sake, many from Japan. Nice peaceful atmosphere. My favorite Japanese restaurant in Tucson for sure! Always great!

The food was great. The server didn't really understand our questions but he brought us our food timely. We had fajita nachos, regular fajitas, and tacos. Also we had the margaritas. My margaritas weren't great but they had tequila so that's fun lol. Overall we had a lovely time at Las Maracas.

My appointment was at 11a. I got there at 1040a. I didn't leave from a simple yearly eye appointment until about 1215p. The actual appointment took less than 15 mins. The office was freezing too. The lady that assisted me and the optometrist were friendly, even though my patience was wearing thin, so that was very good.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Okay! Let's get real. I got the combo, the food was really good. I loved it. It had very little chicken to almost no chicken. The combo has a pasta choice, salad, a toast that's only toasted on one side and a drink. I liked that place. The cream was my favorite part.

Amazing views of the river and Riverwalk.  Lobby is spacious and light but can be loud if there is a lot of action in the bar.  Pool is postage-stamp sized but has a cool view.  Easily walkable to several cute restaurants and other amenities.  I love the Bliss products.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went back in today to give it another shot and left very pleased with my cut and interaction. The quality of the fade was top-notch and I'm glad I went in again to give it another try. I highly recommend Maxwell's and will without a doubt be back every time.

No one in drive thru , they make me wait for 5 min than act like I'm bothering them when I order.Very rude ! Waited  another 5 min for 2 dozen donuts. Now they forgot my coffee but they didn't forget to charge me !!! If people don't like their job Stay Home !!

Been coming here since the place open and I swear it's gotten better and better every single time. We live pretty close by and we're super happy in this place opened up. Their weekend specials and brunch are pretty amazing. Some of the freshest fish in the city 100% hands-down

On an 85 degree day the air conditioning is not on. Staff are staring at me as I walk up to the door in a very unwelcoming manner. They don't greet me. They're abrupt and rude. Then I hear one making hacking noises from the kitchen. I'm so disgusted. Find a different DD.

I got a room here at a great rate on a last minute weekday trip to Newark. The best way to describe the facility is run down, both inside & out. The first thing I noticed when I walked in the room was the pungent moldy smell. The beds look fairly clean though & are spacious enough to fit 5 guests. I would not recommend this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I have used this location twice and they're really nice. They even offered me a ride back to my house, but I already had an Uber waiting.

I had only one issue with them before, I paid for a full-size sedan and they only had compact, and the employee didn't really spend the extra minute to look for cars in other locations.

Came to spend Valentine weekend with my wife and was greeted by a fist pumping concierge. They had great lounge music in the lobby. Felt like I was at a lounge in a major city. I really like the sheik appeal. Very trendy and modern. The entire layout is cosy and welcoming. A+++++ to the staff. FAST check in.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Extremely slow service. It took 45 minutes for someone to come and ask for our order. We eventually went to bar and ordered drinks. Two friends hated their veggie wrap and the chicken nachos were okay. Overall it did take 2 hours for lunch (should have only been an hour tops) 

Only good thing was $5 long Island pitchers.

The food is the only authentic Hispanic food around. Would very much visit again, however, I was not blown away. I feel as if dining in would change this perspective, but I only had take out. Tacos were good, but again, nothing to bring me back in a hurry.

I come here every morning to Order my breakfast. Depending on who Is staffed the drinks can be hit or miss. I think the caffeinated drinks are way too strong and needs to be mixed with decade coffee. I had to order skinny drinks because the the Originals had too much sugar, caffeine. And some of the food has too much sodium.

Dirty. Extremely rude and confrontational owner and lady staff. Hot dryers that don't vent (an old laundromat trick) that make you spend $5 to dry $2.25 of laundry. Melbas is right across the street. Clean, well lit, well run with courteous staff and with food and bathrooms. Never again "Quick" Wash and Dry
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I was disappointed because their ap ordering failed me! I ordered the pizzazila cheese steak and apparently the ap erased my order so I got cheese pizza instead. Don't get me wrong the pizza was amazing but everyone expected a specialty pie! Hopefully next time is a 5 star experience.

This place use to be good but has gone downhill. They had a coupon in a local advertisement for $33 for spa pedicure & manicure. When I bought the coupon to pay. They say there are different type of spa pedicures & it would cost $44 but it states this NO WHERE on the coupon. This was after the lady cut my finger. Never again.

This JW does not leave you wanting! Friendly staff with all the amenities and that Next Level treatment that you will only find at this chain! Every detail has been flawlessly checked and rechecked allowing you to have a experience second to none! Enjoy the Museums and Parks that border this Hotels great location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I had to cheat on my regular place, Glossy Nails, because I didn't have time to get there. I should have found the time! A pedi should be relaxing, but instead it felt rushed, and didn't even last 20 minutes! The massage, a joke! 2 minutes total, for both legs!! Never again! I'd rather have bad toes then pay for this!

There's something to be said for doing one thing extremely well.  In this case, it's coffee and only coffee.  It's not that their food is bad, its just that there isn't any.  That said, if you are truly a coffee aficionado, this place definitely merits a visit...but don't come here with an appetite.

Over the last year, it seemed their service has improved a lot. I used to wait 30-40min to get my food and always have something missing. But now the process is much faster and I can tell the place is more organized. Their amazing Calamari and food is what keeps me coming back. Everyone who goes here must get it!

I've only gone through the drive through here but have had excellent service every time. I always browse the deals to see if I can use any to save a little money! Out of the handful of times I've visited, I've only had to wait once, every other time the process is very quick!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: It's cheap-ish street food to help soak up your morning alcohol binge so that you may continue your alcohol binge throughout the night. It's certainly not the best pizza in New Orleans, not even in the Quarter, but it'll help keep you from blacking out after too may Hurricanes and Big Ass Beers.

This is hands-down the worst McDonald's I've ever been to in my life. The staff was terrible and unattentive, the lady sweeping and mopping the floor literally kept ramming her mop into my feet and the employees are just disgusting and look like they've never showered.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I've been to this one and the one on Magazine and have had great experiences each time. No issue with the service. The sandwiches are always great. I'm a big person on good tomato basil soup and there's did not disappoint. The waffle fries are delicious as well with a distinct taste.

This is the perfect example of when you hire ppl who could care less about their jobs so you'll get the service that comes with that. They don't care about going fast, getting yelled at, and who cares if you tell the manager? This is "just a McDonald's job". Avoid it and just drive further down for a better McDonald's.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We love Sushi Minato.  It's our go-to when we want good flavors, consistent quality and a friendly, relaxed atmosphere.  We take our kids in here constantly and the servers are always sweet to us and helpful with our kid-friendly requests. (Even if it means a bowl of marinated cucumbers!)  great fish and love the rolls!

Three different members of the staff assisted me and none of them were able to complete very simple tasks.  

My time was wasted and the staff for the most part was unpleasant.   And Sebastian in particular was very, very rude and unprofessional.

I'll be back after my next direct deposit to end my relationship with MidFlorida.

The restaurant is currently under construction so unfortunately this has tainted my first experience.  I called to order take out. Was told it would be ready in 30 minutes.  An hour and a half later,  we finally got our food. That said, it was delicious. Surprisingly, a simple spicy salmon roll wws my favorite thing.

Great Happy Hour. The $3 martinis are very good. They also have their entrees and pasta are half price during happy hour. I had the pizza today which was very good. However. The calamari needs more seasoning. It is a nice size portion but very bland. Otherwise I do recommend this place for dinner and happy hour

I really like their specials.
I had the Mahi Mahi and it was cooked just like I like it. My friend had the pulled pork and it was tasty. I did not care for the fried broccoli as an appetizer but my friend loves it. I would recommend this place for small groups and couples. They also have outdoor seating on roof.

Excellent food, impeccable service, and reasonably priced for an upscale restaurant. Very cute, small, romantic place great for a date. 

I will definitely eat here again! Just some advice, make a reservation far in advance for weekend dinners, the restaurant is small and gets very busy!

Quaint little sushi place.  Good service, OK raw fishies, and good atmosphere. Noodle or oohdong dishes were bad. Place is very quiet and strangely so were my kids. Maybe it was the ambiance. Looking forward to going back to eat outside when it gets warmer...

What a great Chinese restaurant with fresh home made food. The crispy orange chicken was divine. The fried rice was flavorful and moist. The employees weree friendly and went out of theiir way to make your experience enjjoyable. I highly recommend this Chinatown eatery.

Clean with an upscale feel. This place is one of the cleanest salons I've been to and they offer services at a fair price.

The pedicure is not rushed and includes lengthy leg and foot massages standard in the service.

My mom also loves this place - it's her go-to for "gel" nails since she gave it a try.

This is the best Chinese food on the east side. We have been going here for years and I was concerned that the food would change with new ownership, but it has remained the same, good, Chinese food we have always known. You definitely have to try the House beef!

We only ate a couple of small dishes at the bar, but they were amazing.  The wild mushroom and black truffle pizza is so good there should be another name for it other than pizza.  It's a gourmet masterpiece.  The cannellini beans are herby and yummy.  Eat here...you'll be glad you did.

No hot tub, tiny pool, fox news is blacked out on TV but all other news stations come in just fine.  Very musty smell as soon as you walk in and also down the hallways. The condition of the American Flag hanging out front is embarrassing and should really be replaced.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Worst costumer service I've ever experienced. Manager on duty was rude and unhelpful. Visiting from California. Valet is incompetent and front desk is useless. If you are passing through after hours, go to the next hotel. Obviously the late night staff here does not care about you or your needs.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Sadly, this once amazing downtown Mexican Gem has gone downhill.

The El Pasdor , has been tuff, quesadillas salty, with cheap cheese, Chorizo burrito, tasted disgusting over cooked, dry like sand. 

This was my favorite Mexican , I'm afraid , I'll have to find me a new place.

I'm from Mexico City, I've been living in New Orleans for 3 years and since I discovered this place I never go anywhere else to get Mexican food. Authentic and delicious! Servers are always super nice!

Do not mix this place up with El Paso Grill, it's not the same!

Love it here! I go to Jeanine each time (for a couple years now) and she is great! Whether I go in for some highlights and a new cut or just a trim, she always listens to what I'd like. I always leave looking and feeling beautiful. People always ask where I get my hair cut and I tell them they have to go here - it's great!

I regret the food and service are terrible because the atmosphere is great. Very small portions of mediocre Mexican at best. Slimy chimichanga was served in a pool of watery runoff from elsewhere on the plate and was not hot. Waitress never returned to fill glass or check in. So disappointing. I won't go back.

Bartender service sucked!!! Had to flag a bartender down just to be called out. The entire end of the bar hadn't been served. All they cared about was body shots & getting shots themselves. Music was broken and girls just kept talking on the mic.  Sucks because we were really looking forward to hanging there.

There are a few pizza joints within a few miles in this area and Kennett Pizza and Pasta definitely has the best pizza! We like to order the gourmet white and it's usually very good. I love cheese steaks and these are full of meat and cheese like a Philly style sandwich should be.

This Burger King was recently remodeled and is very nice on the inside.  The service is generally pretty quick and we are in and out in no time.  The food is typically comes out hot and fresh.  There had been a couple of occasions where we've had to return the food. Overall food BK.

The service is great, very attentive and friendly. The food taste, for breakfast, was slightly bland, but edible, which was why I gave this place 3 stars. The buffet definitely should get an omelette station or something to charge $16/person. The coffee was really good!

This place is awfully dirty, there are donuts on the floor and icing all spilling all over the place, the stations are all dirty and soiled. It seems like the dough recipe is not being properly followed because the donuts are small and dense. Simply unappetizing.

This place was disappointing, the calzone was so cold on the inside that the cheese didn't melt and the mushrooms were raw. The pizza was mediocre but then again it's not hand tossed, you can't expect a good crust from a machine pressed dough. The toppings were good but the lack of crust on the edges was very very sad.

I know with fast food the expectations tend to be lower, but this location seems to run a pretty tight ship. The drive through consistently runs pretty smoothly and the quality of the food is pretty good. A couple employees are stand-outs among an already pretty decent team all around.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The decor is fun and inviting. Staff was readily available and courteous. I had the carne asada and shrimp cocktail. Steak was a little dry but flavorful. Shrimp cocktail was large enough for 3 and was soupy, yet delicious. Oh, the mango margarita wasnt as strong as i'd prefer but it was ok. I will come back to try the mole soon.

The appearance outside is kind of deceiving but inside the food is really good! We stopped in one time to get dinner during the week and it wasn't crowded. On a Friday or Saturday night it is packed! There is a line for pick up and to be seated. Everything we has been pretty good so far.

We were happy to find a hibachi restaurant in the area! We didn't even know it was there because it was hidden in the corner. It was actually really good and we got seated right away. We got a lot of food and you get both rice and noodles with your hibachi selection. We will definitely be stopping back in.

We were wanting something quick and easy to take back to the hotel we were staying at nearishby. We went thru the drive thru and ordered. The staff there was INCREDIBLY RUDE but that seems to be a pretty standard theme in New Orleans. Food was blah, wouldnt eat there again.

Sushi was fabulous!! Their fried sushi was delicious. We did the AYCE menu, and it was worth it! Seems like a strict menu, but staff was kind and explained well! My favorite was the Tempura and the crispy spicy tuna. We did get two appetizers: didn't love the calamari, but edamame was tasty! Again kind, friendly staff!

Usually pop in to BP's for lunch in the lounge. The service is friendly, food fast and hot, and delish:) I can feel secure that when I go for lunch with a friend, that I will make it back in time for work. Yes, there have been off times where I thought WTH? But really, overall, I like it there -it's pretty reliable.

Not at all impressed with the service here. The waiter was much more interested in watching the football game than bringing food. I watched my meal sit in the pick up window for 5 minutes and he walked by it I less than 3 times. I finally got up and got it myself. He didn't even acknowledge that this had occurred.

Meh... I guess it's okay for Tucson, I certainly would avoid it if it was on the west coast, as there are far too many other options, but I've been here for lunch a few times and haven't been overly impressed, although I keep going back (have to mix it up, can't eat Eegee's every time).

Amazing pizza and location, right off the green belt! The service is quick and friendly. I love riding my bike to Lucky 13 on a lazy afternoon and grabbing an ice cold microbrew with some delicious pizza on the outdoor patio. Make sure to try the Lucky 13 Supreme with jalapeños, soooo good!

We just moved to the area and I am so glad we found this place! This will be my new go-to sushi spot. Our waiter was extremely friendly and prompt. And most importantly, the food was incredible! Overall, we have a wonderful experience and I would recommend this restaurant over and over again.

We were told to go here by a friend. They did not disappoint. The food was fresh, fast and delicious. Super huge portions too big for me. Wish they had half portions -- ended up throwing most of mine away and felt wasteful. But if you are a big eater go for it.

What I like about this place is that it is intimate and cozy. Staff was super friendly. We didn't stay too long but felt very welcome and eager to go back and try the food I heard about. 

The bartender was great and even gave us Halloween candy and when I mentioned that it was my friends birthday, he gave her a birthday shot

this past Monday at work my Mgr purchased a pretzel crust pizza and I had a slice which was very good later that day I had to go back and after was talking with the owner about it and I bought one for dinner took it home my wife had a slice or two and I finished it off I would buy it again

I went to Sparkle Car Wash last night at 5:52 pm.  As soon as I entered the parking lot I noticed the sign that read they were open until 6pm.  They, however, were not open.  I was very disappointed.  Closing early is poor customer service!  It's no wonder they haven't gotten too many positive reviews.

The best part about Win Dixie is the fuel perks I build when shopping here. I stick to buying the basics here and hit up trader joes for all my favorites. You can get some good deals at the beginning of the week on their 3 day specials but overall they are over priced as most all large food store chains are.

Liquid is a wonderful salon with such a great staff. I've been going to Ashley for years now and couldn't ask for a more talented hairstylist. Not to mention she's just an awesome person inside and out. Highly recommend Ashley and Liquid for any hair needs!!

Amazing sushi and great service. The prices are great and you get quality fish. The sushi isn't drenched in sauce and you don't need to add soy sauce. If you are looking for non Americanized sushi, this is one of the places to go. Sushi in its rawest form. 

Service here has always been amazing, and the food comes out fast.

Walk-in appointment after I couldn't get into my regular salon. Staff was friendly and attentive. They had a few suggestions that were helpful when I inquired about a certain style. They didn't rush the process as some salons do. Nails look great. Will return.

You ever go somewhere for your first time and the food is so good you get pissed you weren't going sooner! Had a slice of Margherita and Fresca today for lunch Yum! The sauce on the Margherita was very tasty. I loved the cheese and the crust was soft. The Fresca was like a white pizza. I enjoyed it also. Will definitely be back.

Baby sized tacos. $3-$3.50 per bite. Good food. Designed for those on a diet.

Taking quality over quantity too seriously. Contemporary layout, very clean, friendly staff.

Will not come back despite the delicious tacos aka bites. Value may be one of the worst I've experienced. Still hungry after 4 tacos.

Go to the one in Bellevue on Hwy 70 (only 5 minutes away). The staff are so much friendlier and eager to help, and their prepared food is so much fresher!! I've  learned this lesson for the last time tonight as I throw away half of the salad I got there...

They have the best Chinese food, it's a to go place only open during delivery hours, i always get the combination b, it's prepared fresh and comes with lots of food most of the time it's too much but who doesn't love left over Chinese! .. The prices are good as well.

This location is usually fast paced, accurate with my order, and always friendly. Even when there are long lines, the orders that are waiting are pulled off to reserved spots to keep the lines moving. I applaud the efforts of the team at this location and will continue to visit
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is your average local Chinese delivery place. They are fast, prices are fair, and its decent food. Although the other night when we ordered, they forgot a dish. We did not want to wait for the re delivery to eat so we let it go. It happens but I will probably order again.

This is the best sushi restaurant in the area. We had great service, delicious food and the ambiance is great. I have been here many times and I will continue to come back. Try the Truffle Eel Daikon roll if you like to try different things. It will blow your mind.

I used to love this place under the former owner. They took their time and did a meticulous job. This new owner works fast but my dip powder was full of cracks in less than a week. I wish I knew where the former owner (Sophie) and staff went. I'd follow them. Now I need to find a new salon... again.

We hosted our rehearsal dinner here a few days ago for over 30 people, and we couldn't have chosen a better spot. Incredibly affordable, the staff was friendly and accommodating, and my entire family has been raving about the food ever since. Thank you for making that day so special.

Very friendly people.  I got a gel manicure and it lasted a full month.  So I went back for another.  Funny thing about this place was they remembered my name!

Pedicures are good too.  They have fresh tools for each person.  The sinks are clean, but no plastic liner between customers.  (Something I prefer).  

A very good place!

Delicious! Never had sushi without rice and what a great option loved it and the presentation was original. Not just pieces of sushi on a plate. Ambiance was a little loud I couldn't hear my daughter talk very well but not that big of a deal unless your on a date

I would give this place a better review, but the service is usually not good. The pizza is a 6.9 on the portnoy scale, most people come for the Italian food. The Italian food is pretty good. It won't blow you away but it is solid. Chicken cacciatore , seafood fra Diablo. Good. Marsala is just ok.

This place will never get old for me!  I always love the older ice cream shops.  This shop is certainly a classic with a great selection of treats.  Try the thick and chunky brownie and house made ice cream sandwiches.  The staff is always pleasant and helpful.

One of my favorite sushi places in Tampa!  The sushi is always delicious and generously portioned.  The atmosphere is pleasantly decorated and comfortable.  The service is always attentive. They have a great sushi selection for happy hour including the Crazy Horse roll.  Worth trying!

Not a bad place to stay when you're in the area. Rooms are nice and clean, but a little dated. Very few "extras" in the room, just your basic stay. Free wifi. Free parking. Small pool. Free breakfast, however unappetizing options. Great location! Close to grocery stores, restaurants, several beaches, etc.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Great grocery store with a hot table of fresh goodies if you're feeling lazy and don't want to cook. On certain days you are able to get boiled crawfish by the pound. Tried it myself. Pretty darn tasty. 

This trip we wanted to do a rip on surf and turf. So we bought bok choy, scallops, and rib eye steaks. Came out awesome.

This is the worst McDonald's ever and I have no idea how this place stays in business...other than it's a McDonald's and someone is going to stop here. But the neighbor people know NOT to go here. Long wait for REALLY surly service and bad food.  Drive the distance to the Exton MickyDs for fresh food and happy people.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: There is just something about this place that I love. It isn't the fanciest place and it doesn't have the best Italian food I've ever had, but the food is always solid and the atmosphere is always inviting. Prices are reasonable and portions are huge. Definitely recommend you to try it, esp if you live in the area!

I love places for efficiencies, speed,  quality, or urgency, but maybe since it's late night last minute trip to this establishment.    There is a sense for everything speed, which is impressive, but not in taste.  

Maybe another day would be different, will see.

I went with a large group. The service was good considering the size of our group. It was also early in the evening, so the restaurant wasn't busy. The waitresses were good with keeping beverages refilled and asking if we needed anything else. The food was tasty. It was good, but not fantastic hence the 3 star rating.

The food is delicious... when the order is correct. I used to order the tomato pie from here since I can't eat dairy. The last two times I ordered, the tomato pie had cheese all over it. Once is a simple mistake, twice keeps me from ordering again. Very disappointed in a restaurant that initially wowed me.

This Starbucks is inside Target, I had gotten a wrong order from another store and was in Target, I mentioned it and Andrew working was incredibly polite and corrected it for me. Would absolutely return to this location. Not to mention it was delicious when I did get what I wanted!

Came by with some co workers for a quick lunch and had an OK time! Not too many tables but we got seated fairly quickly; definitely do not recommend big parties. I got the prime rib sandwich which was quite dry but I think for a quick bite this place is decent.

i really enjoy this place! i personally am a fan of their hot honey pizza here... so delicious. and the variety of their fountain sodas are amazing, all organic! 

my only tip is that during lunch time it gets pretty crazy so definitely be ready for it to be crowded

I ordered a grandma pizza last night and what I got was not that. It was a margherita circle pizza, the dough was not appetizing and very bland. not the Sicilian square pie I was hoping for. I was very disappointed and probably will not be ordering from here in the future

came by on a sunday for some sushi pick up and it was tasty! no complaints but honestly nothing really wow'd me. i'm also a sushi snob so that might be why

i'll definitely come back to give it another try since there's not that many good sushi places in the area besides Sagami.

Came here last night for some dessert and I loved it! I love the peanut butter in the ice cream but it comes out like strips? Kinda weird, I wish it was blended in more. I love the texture of the ice cream here. Very smooth and creamy with lots of flavor. I hope they come out with more funky flavors soon

ordered here from uber eats for my first time and was pleased!

i got the katsu w/ curry and the 3 roll specials. it took more than an hour to get to my place but everything was delicious!

the only critique i would have is that the katsu wasn't very crispy, definitely would want it to be crispier next time

Came here for a balayage based on great Yelp reviews and this is why I use Yelp! 

I walked in the salon and heard 2 Chainz bumping and knew right away that I was where I need to be. Joe was direct and recommended me some options and we got exactly what I needed. Appointments are mandatory but definitely worth it

This place was okay. Their "out of control" roll was really good but my hibachi steak was very disappointing. Lacked the sauce and flavor. The fried rice with it was very salty. I wouldn't come back but hey, that's just my opinion. I've had better Japanese food.

I've only been here once but was fairly impressed. My wife and I shared the double order of steak fajitas, good flavor and definitely  more than enough for two people. The service was alright, not bad, not great. I like the food here better than rosepepper, while the atmosphere at the latter is better. I like this place.

The manager at this place is completely unprofessional. He disrespected me because I needed to process a return from the SAME DAY, with the receipt and everything still boxed. No professionalism..... I felt attacked. I'll never go back or recommend this place to anyone

This car wash is a decent. Happy to see a new one in king of Prussia. I went twice, cleaned my car perfectly! I only gave four stars because nobody answers the phone when I call regarding the membership pricing. Place can be packed so be prepared to wait a while. Free vacuums and plenty of em!

This place is in its third act.

Act I: $20 cuts, five quality barbers, fresh vibe
Act II: $30 cuts, all new staff, loud and rude
Act III: ???

I hope Joe gets his act together and turns in around. He should realize that there are other shops down Haddon Ave that have copied the good parts of his game and left the bad parts behind.

You can tell a good Pizza Place by their plain cheese pizza and I really like their pies.  I order a pizza with green peppers and (although not listed on their menu) salami and it is just super-tasty.

Very pleasant people answering the phones and pretty quick delivery. This is my go-to pizza place to order from in Port Richmond.

Problems at this location with the soda. I work close and whenever I visit this location no ice and the wrong drink order. Even repeat what my drink order is and still get served wrong one. The one who does it works the second window. At park nah time 12:30-1:00. Older man with glasses.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
lowest prices of any grocery store in sb and has everything I need for all my mexican dishes and more. staff is always friendly and helpful. plus on the large parking lot and convenience. not one bad thing to say. stop complaining and write reviews on what business should be judged on. price, inventory and convenience. 

Cheyons.

Great job on my gel manicure!  It's still looking good after a week and a half and I work in health care and wash my hands a ton!  My pedi was good as far as the paint is concerned but wish the rough edges were smoothed out a little better around my heels!

Clean and consistent.  My kids each had a breakfast flatbread & a grilled chicken sub.  Both are good and much better than grabbing fried fast food for them.  The service itself was sssslllllooooowwwwwww....... and that is why I gave 4 not 5 stars. Otherwise, good.

Just had lunch there. It was fresh and tasted good.  We had Turkey club sandwich with a very yummy cranberry mayonnaise, and Roast beef club sandwich. Both were good. The service was attentive and pleasant. Now that we know they can pull off the basic American diner/deli food, We'll go back, and next time will try something Korean.

This place is average at best. I love mexican food, and this place is squarely in the middle. Their food is good, but a little greasy and "heavy". Atmosphere seems old and dark, and the booths look like they came from an old Denny's. 
Prices are the same as all the other places.

went here yesterday morning, the two gentlemen vacuumed my car great. After the car was ran through the car wash the two ladies only wiped down my windows and exterior. They did not wipe down my interior and I purchased the ultra wash. what a waste of 17 bucks, inside was still dirty.

Moles are authentic and delicious. Cozy environment. Water is filtered. Family owned and very friendly. Food is great! You can tell they put a lot of care into their food. Oaxacan food is not particularly spicy, but they can spice it up if you prefer. One of our favorite places in Carpinteria!

I really enjoyed my stay at this hotel right when you check into the hotel there are complimentary cookies . The front desk and the rest of the hotel staff was very courteous. The hotel is always kept clean. There is a bar and a lot of different seating available in the lobby. The hotel has an outside pool.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Broccoli & Shrimp with only a handful of shrimp. Don't waste your money. The flavor was bland to make matters worse. Even the shrimp fried rice & shrimp egg rolls lacked shrimp & flavor. Thought I'd give them another shot and it's the same story. Definitely won't be back.

Great sushi that can be very filling. They have a lot of different and creative options on their sushi menu.   I'm not very impressed with their food dishes though. Can definitely see myself returning because of the sushi and great location.   In my opinion, Peters sushi still is the best sushi place in town.

a good sandwich shop if you don't mind waiting a long, long time.  i only went once. been there.  done that.  thank goodness it was on an amazon local deal.  nice folks tho. the sweet fried (sweet potato) are different, very messy and sticky, but good...just get a roll of paper towels.  virtually no seating.  get it to go.

I literally go here everyday. I love it. The staff is always nice and they are great with regulars the coffee is so rich in flavor.
