It's cheaper than Starbucks and it has so much flavor you will realize how bland Starbucks flavors are. I've had lattes, lafreezes, espressos, bubble teas, and lunch here. All were exceptionally good.

I stayed here for a night while in town and the place is really clean and the staff is really friendly.  I left early in the morning for a flight, so I didn't try any of their food.  It is really close to the airport, which is nice, but you don't hear the flights or at least I didn't. I would definitely stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: There's only one speed here and it is S L O W. The menu prices are kind of dumb - the difference between a sandwich and combo varies between 1.59 and 2.09. But did I mention they are S L O W???  3 people 15 minutes.  And it's always like this. Sonic is close by and a better bet

LCAH is the best vet in town - hands down. The entire staff is so nice, professional, and always take great care of our 3 pets. 
None of the animals is ever upset going in for a treatment or coming back from one. 

I also want to highlight how cautious they have been throughout the pandemic and well adjusted their service is.

We are traveling from the Midwest and this Midas was able to identify a problem in sure was there for months! We were very unprepared for the set back. They were through and professional, they provided guidance with means to finance the repair.  From sitting in the office they are a busy location and i can see why!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Yum. I've been here twice. No complaints. Great service. Great food. Great ice cream. The rice to fish ratio is perfect. The appetizers are amazing. Every last one. The monkey ball is so tasty. My mouth is watering just thinking about it. The nigiri is sliced absolutely perfectly. This is easily my new favorite spot.

Every time I am in NOLA I stay at The Saint! I love the personal experience and their southern charm.  The staff truly goes out of their way to accommodate you. I stayed during the Essence Festival and encountered a few problems but they rectified it promptly. Customer service is their #1 priority! Thank you Saints!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This DD's brings back the excitement from childhood.  The doughnuts are beautifully displayed on the lit up shelves.  All of the favorites are present and fresh.  The staff,  no matter how early are so friendly and accommodating.  I adore this location and each of the employees.

Love Wendy's chili. Anytime I have a craving for chili I know I can always count on Wendy's!  Dipping by the chicken nuggets in the chili is also quite delicious . 

I've never had an issue with this Wendy's. Seems to be kept a little cleaner than other franchise locations but still not the cleanest. Staff is friendly.

Stopped in today, they were pretty busy, obviously.

I'm a HUGE fan of Starbucks, but the carmel Mocha, Venti was horrible: Burned milk, & not enough flavoring. I was super late or I would of gone in and returned it. Might have to rethink going back to this location again.

Katie is super sweet. However, don't advertise things you always run out of. Or better yet, MAKE MORE!!  I wish there was another donut place around here. There coffee used to be good. I've tried them all, butter pecan latte is the only good one. So I only go when they have that, but I think I'll be skipping them now too.

Katie is super sweet. However, don't advertise things you always run out of. Or better yet, MAKE MORE!!  I with there was another donut place around here. There coffee used to be good. I've tried them all, butter pecan latte is the only good one. So I only go when they have that, but I think I'll be skipping them now too.

I'm a big fan of Italian restaurants that aren't afraid to spice up their menu. They have all the traditional Italian favorites but also a variety of other choices. Pizza was great. Caesar salad was on point. Staff was extremely friendly and service was great.

Food is just okay. It would be better if the waiter would actually listen to the order. Also providing some condiments couldn't hurt. The breakfast I had was okay. They use cheese wiz in their omelettes which is just gross.  There are much better bars and food in the airport!

Out of the way little spot with generous portions and friendly staff. Dining area was very clean and the food service line was ok. Food was a little bland but it was tasty and not overly salty like a lot of Mexican food. Inexpensive was a plus and horchata also a plus!

I love the number of washers and dryer.  It is great to have WiFi access for free to watch a show while you launder.  I haven't tried their snacks, but their food counter looks a bit unkept.   Good value and great fast dryers.  Parking can be challenging if there are lots of customers.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: The employees are very nice.. but the inside of this place smells like POOP... could be from all the homeless people who like to lounge around there.. This mcdonalds never seems to have anything.. no parfaits no frapees.... no items with chicken ?? Poorly run and the drive thru takes forever
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

Overcharged. No work completed charged $170.00
.Unable to properly charge with warranty. I had the work completed at a dealership for $1400.00 less than they were going to charge me. The estimator seemed confused. All I wound up paying was my $100.00 deductible .My warranty supplied the new AC complete with labor and new freon.

text:
Took grandson & they goofed" up happy meal order very confusing . New & modern with great kids area. Very clean , but...... didn't have a clue about the order? 
Use the keyboard ordering & pre pay? Some staff helpful others " harried ? Sad to say on rainy day.

text: Went by Valencia Monday all closed up, busy street not far from movies. I've been to original stand on flowing wells & Wetmore , which moved in front on burnt adobe constructed 6os ? Bar in Nw corner a little north. Had the Yaqui taco several times very enjoyable.

Always dependable in n out burger before the Arizona baseball game at hi Corbett . I enjoy the " animal style" extra sauce & grilled onions off secret menu you can " google. Someone in our party ha protein style wrapped in lettuce no bun. Great fries & shakes too. No kids menu but the give them stickers not edible ?

The food was very underwhelming. I ordered veggie tempura and the batter was raw the sushi itself wasn't great I got a snake roll and the eel had tiny little bones that hurt to eat and made it impossible to finish. I also ordered a rainbow roll and it was okay. Save your money and eat somewhere else. Service was great though.

Have had lunch here 3 times this week as its right across from my work..  Get the chicken gumbo soup and the burger.... both are extremely good...  I've had the BBQ pulled pork which is very messy but good... The Caesar salad with grilled chicken is good also...  All in all a good experience and good food...

I am being very generous with these two stars. Not only did it take over an hour to deliver my food the delivery driver tried to get more money quoting a price higher than what I was called it over the phone the food is cold like its been sitting for ever & the people working are extremely rude

Well. They updated the inside and made it look nice, but it is a disaster. There is dirt everywhere. I had to wipe my table down before eating at it. I'm sitting here currently and there's mud on the floor. Trash cans overflowing. French fries everywhere. Please. Guys. Respect the remodel and clean the damn place up.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Very dirty restaurant one of the worst McDonald's I've ever been to! All the tables are disgusting and I am sure if the Edmonton health board walked in they would be fined . Sad thing is there is people to clean this type of shit up! Shame on you McDonald's
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Two people in line up and we waited for over 10 minutes to be served ? We decided after waiting that long to take our money and business else where . Use to be a great location but has gone down hill with poor customer service. I would rather go to the city and eat at another Wendy's after this experience .

Don't even know why I bother here anymore. Got here at 7:50 AM Wednesday morning for an "early bird special." Guy ended up taking two customers that he knew before me, then proceeded to tell me when I asked about special that I would get "5 bucks off at best." Nashvillians need to unite and get this place out of business!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
These guys are great!  Their service was prompt, fairly-priced, and pleasant. While the facility may not be the most fancy, their prices reflect the lower overhead.  

I will definitely return when needed. A strong reccommend for honest, competent & fair-priced service.

Have been here on a number of times
 I have to say this was not up to par. Took almost 30 minutes to get our salad. Then the garlic bread was as hard as a rock. When we told the waitress she was very snippy. When the food was brought out one of the dishes was cold. Have second thoughts about going back.

Excellent house special egg foo young and crab rangoon too! The house special lo mein is my favorite of any take out around this area. Prices are average with the competition in the area, and the food is good overall. The place always has people going in and out.

This review isn't based off just a one time drive thru experience but many... it is probably the slowest service I've ever come across from any Starbucks. Everytime I went, it wasn't busy at all, there were no long lines so I don't know why it takes 10 mins to get 1 order of coffee.

I loved the CONCEPT of Bottom Dollar, but this particular location was terrible. I had nothing but problems with the employees every time I visited. Corporate policy was never followed, and no one seemed to care.

Good riddance King of Prussia Bottom Dollar, and take your terrible employees with you!

This business has completely changed staff and ownership, and is now called classic car wash and classic oil change. I haven't got my car back yet but the staff has been wonderful and attentive. I recommend you check it is new business out they just opened   with new staff in November 2015

Bought there groupon and went in to try and get an oil change. The guy was very rude the whole time and I tried making an appointment. Only time the do oil changes is 7:30 in the morning! Funny how they are using groupon to gain more business and then they don't treat customers nice. Guess they just don't care about their business.

I just want to thank the trainer with tribal tattoos who reminded me mid-set that chalk is not allowed. I have a feeling that if you weren't with a younger female client you probably wouldn't have said anything. Maybe you should ask her if you looked cool.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: We were walking around downtown and stopped for lunch .. cute place ... we tried the deep dish corn meal crust.  We had an some kale starter that was ok .. very filling. I'm not a huge fan of thick crust pizza .. prefer thin but read the cornmeal crust was worth a try.

Donuts. Drive thru. No-brainer, right? Not here. I repeated my order 3 times, waited 20 minutes, and had to settle for some regular donuts because they were out of the specialty donuts that I wanted.

The donuts are great! They really need to get the business side together though.

This place is all the rage and it is easy to see why ! My hubby drove by there recently and just made up a reason why he "needed" donuts after just eaten a substantial meal. (Insert eye roll here ) 
These donuts are addictive and delicious and dangerous combination!

Having Burger King  was nostalgic for me. We used to go there once a week as kids- our small town Burger King gave a backstage "tour" to our elementary school and we had a loyalty to them. The tomato was not good and probably brought the whole whopper flavor down with it but for $2.99 it wasn't bad

Came in on Sunday morning and somehow timed it just right. They need more staff and there isn't a lot of seating for a group. The bathrooms are locked which is inconvenient and it isn't the cleanest place but it isn't awful either. We had a dozen donuts which were tasty and an iced hot chocolate which was surprisingly good

Came in on Sunday morning and somehow timed it just right. They need more staff and there isn't a lot of seating for a group. The bathrooms are locked which is inconvenient and it isn't the cleanest place but it isn't awful either. We had a dozen donuts which were tasty and an iced hot chocolate which was surprisingly good

I have the monthly top membership for unlimited premium washes. Today is Wednesday and the cones were up at 2pm so I couldn't use the wash. Does that mean I will get a discount on my monthly membership bill? I'm sure I won't. Happens again and I will withdraw my membership.

We were seated on a busy Saturday  night without  a reservation.   
Great table.  Attentive service.  
I find the food to be good  for quantity over quality.   There's just nothing that special about it. 
 I would recommend  the ravioli. 
Lobster... not so much.

We thought it was a fun bar.  Beers were really cheap.  Solo cup for the walk home.  Bartender gave us money to play the jukebox.   Friendly folks chatting and playing pool. Dogs allowed.  
There is no "lost and found". I dropped my keys and they were thrown in the trash. :(

By far the most amazing food! We took our family here for our daughters 30th birthday. We had 8 in our party. We all like to try each other's food. Each and every appetizer and entree was incredible! Frank and his family are so warm and welcoming. We had a wonderful night and will definitely be back again soon!

We had to get somewhere so we wanted to order our food when we ordered our drinks. The waitress did not want to take our food order and then left to get our drinks. I ordered shrimp taco's and it was literally shrimp and a tortilla...that's it... not much to talk about.

Mmm...the cinnamon buns.

Mmm...La Colombe coffee.

Cute neighborhood place that is perfect for a quick on the go breakfast or a lazy saturday breakfast when there is no food in the house.

Coffee is the best, and the NY Times is always out. Always a place to sit and cute dogs outside. Glad to live down the street!

Try the Osso Buco Bacco. It is deliciously rich and will melt in your mouth. I love love love it! The place is laid out nicely and the staff are friendly. Just stay away from any butterfish specials, just because that fish is not very good and has a history of digestive issues. Everything else is just awesome!

Ordered delivery - kai ramen, gyoza, miso, ginger salad, and volcano roll. I only finished the gyoza. Was sadly underwhelmed - flavors weren't amazing and the sushi seemed stale (is that even possible?). With so many other great choices in the city, probably won't order from here again.

Love this place! Sushi is always fresh and absolutely delicious.  It's a BYOB so you can bring some wine if you like wine with your sushi.  The staff is very friendly. I've tried various sushi places and none can compete with Kabuki. I would definitely recommend this place! I go here often

The decor has definitely seen better days, and carpet in restaurants typically skeeves me out, but the sushi is definitely worth coming back for. I did not have high hopes for Japanese food in Nashville, but Sonobana is as good as many of the places I tried in New York. Will definitely try again.

The pork Ramen and the two sushi rolls we got were just tasted okay - same as any other place. The fish chin appetizer( Kama) was quite good. Plenty  of fresh  meat and the right amount of seasoning, made it the only memorable dish of the night.  Service and the ambience were okay.  Overall it was not a bad experience.

They got delicious,  fresh taco here. The pricing was also good. But the eating environment was not so good.  It's basically a food truck in  the middle of fruit and vegetable market. It's smelly and as for the surrounding area, I won't feel safe to go by myself at night. It's okay to grab a quick bite or order the food to go .

The best sushi! Firecracker roll, Atlantic roll, Super Mexican roll, Caterpillar Eel roll all are to die for! Super fresh and made in the proper Japanese tradition with an American twist! However you can still find many traditional items! Service is almost always great. It can get busy, on a Friday or Saturday call ahead.

Everyone BUT Sherry was great. Got a bad vibe from her from the beginning. She talked down to me it felt. Let me know when she's fired I'll be back. Cassidy and Emma I believe (other young receptionist) were VERY nice. My dog loves everyone but HATED her....

Great pizza place! We were visiting St. Louis and asked a bartender at Ball Park Village for a recommendation on the best pizza place in the city, and this is where he sent us. The crust is cornmeal based, and it is delicious! We had a basic thin crust pepperoni pizza with basil - sooo good!

Suitable for my needs. Have arthritis through my body, just need to keep moving & try to build a little strength in the joints, nothing fancy. Good to see others here doing the same. 

Though, I too find it odd that it is supposed to be a judgement free zone & they have a lunk alarm and can kick people out for their attire.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Don't EVER go here, this place is the worst I have ever stayed in!
Nothing worked (TV, remote, heat).  Room was filthy.  Place is totally run-down.  Employees rude.  Worst experience.  You would be better off staying two doors down at the Motel 6 for just a couple of dollars more.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The pizza is good and the staff is super friendly. My only complaint is that it is quite pricey. I'm willing to pay for quality, but in today's economy I also look for value. However, they are strong supporters of our local schools and that has value as well. They are certainly the best pizza in Spanish Springs bar none!

Great happy hour specials. Perfect place to watch a game or have dinner with the family. The space is split into bar and restaraunt area. The fish and chips, buffalo chicken sandwich, and pazooki are always great. 
Best bar/restaurant choice on the NW side.

Easiest 5 stars I've given in a long time. The starter with the sunchoke purée reminded me why vegetables are even some times better than meat. But then we had the short ribs and pork loin. The drinks are excellent too. If you wanna take someone  special in New Orleans, this is the place to do it.

Pretty solid sushi place in New Orleans. Friendly service and quick delivery of rolls. Miso soup was good as well. Wasn't a big fan of the white tuna jalapeño roll, but the yellowtail and salmon nigiri were both good, and the shrimp tempura -tuna specialty roll I got was tasty also.

It an ok place to order if your looking for cheap food. This place is super cheap. The pizza is ok, their fries selection is pretty good. Sandwiches are decent. I rarely order from here unless I have a lot of mouths to feed and everyone is drunk enough that pretty much anything they eat will taste good.

Service was fine and it's nice that it's a BYO but I was super disappointed with the sushi here. It all tasted like it had seen better days- even the spicy tuna which generally can hide sub par fish with the spicy sauce. There are much better BYO sushi places in Philly, I would for sure skip this one.

I went to get something delicious and sweet to eat. We had an upside down banana split and a hot fudge brownie. Even if you just want a scoop of ice cream you will get an awesome dessert. They have sitting outside or a drive thru to pick up ice cream to go. If you want something different try their sherbet,  it's great.

After first bad experience, decided to try if something is different. Amazing experience. Went for lunch special and received good service starting from warm finger wipes till check. Miso soup was lesser salty and good portion of the meat in rolls. Now I would recommend them, specially for lunch..

Yum! We came here for the first time and was very satisfied. Their salsa and chips, and queso are great. Their beef soft tacos are awesome. I got the beef tostado and my husband got the fajita chimichanga and both were delicious. The service was vey good as well. We'll be back!

Kind of like Applebee's, maybe a little better. I had the chicken ranch wrap, which was pretty good. The server was great and very attentive, even though it was during lunch rush.  I would go here for a quick sit down work lunch, but not really great for date night.

This is the BEST McDonalds in Indianapolis, In area 
The managers are top notch 
The food 99. Of thine is correct and hot
The Employees are friendly and seem to enjoy working here 
Skip the other locations 

Hint  be careful driving out of the parking lot 
Washington Street drivers are unforgiving
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The staff at this place is terrific, the drinks generous, and the music awesome. The music is older American jazz, like 1920s and 30s ish amazing stuff, as well as classic rockin' New Orleans-style jazz. Very fun and comfortable place to spend an evening. You won't be sorry you stopped in!

A great place to get some frozen yogurt! Wide variety of unique flavors and toppings. Almost anyone should be able to find their favorite flavor combinations here. Yogurt selections rotate, which keeps things fresh. It's fun mixing flavors and thinking of new flavor pairings. Service is also very friendly and welcoming!

My family came here for dinner tonight & all 6 of us ordered different items.. none of us enjoyed it, so we left with 97% of the food still on the plates... the lady working was nice but the food was gross.. maybe they were having an off night but we won't be back.

We recently moved to cherry hill from Texas & I had been searching non stop for a vet that we could use & love. We came across garden state & we couldn't be happier the vets are amazing! The entire staff is so friendly. Dr.Koch is our go to! She is very knowledgeable & talks to you about pricing before any procedures are done.

Their ice cream is amazing! I've tried so many flavors and they are all delicious! We recently got pints of caramel cashew, espresso, vanilla chocolate chip, and chocolate raspberry. My favorites of those are the espresso and caramel cashew mixed together.  Highly recommend!

The sushi was fresh and delicious and their prices are great! I took off one star because our order was wrong-I ordered 6 rolls and they gave me double of one roll and another roll was missing. Other than that, we enjoyed the sushi and seaweed salad and will definitely order again!

Pretty cheap place and they do a decent job.  I believe it costs only $3 to dry-clean a shirt. They also run specials if you bring many clothes. And they do alterations. However, they wouldn't dye your clothes. 
They are always friendly with me and now remember me by name as I come in pretty often.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Ordered the family pack with Mark Pi's Chicken, Tofu with Vegetables, Spring Rolls and Egg Fried Rice as well as an additional side of Vegetable Lo Mein.

I was pleased with all the food except the Egg Fried Rice. It was simply brown rice with sparse amounts of egg. The Lo Mein was excellent- something I will order again and again.

Horrible horrible place! Do not come here for any car service. Dealing with Maria Najar sales person. Very rude, unprofessional and not sure how this lady has a job. 
I will make sure to tell everyone not to come here! 
From the second we walked In the door she was rude.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Ok, no pics needed. Food and service good, not great. We had a California and Mexican roll and the shrimp hibachi dinner and edamame (not any salt). Also, I had to go to the counter 3 times for refills of ice tea. Very inattentive service. Would not recommend. Sorry.

I love being a member at Torque! Everyone is so friendly, and all of the instructors are more than willing to help new members in class. I love all of the classes that are offered. The positivity that Torque offers is incredible! I always leave in a better mood, and feeling refreshed.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I have been a client with CK Designs for years! I love the fun atmosphere and fantastic stylists! I have loved every haircut, hair color, and hair style that I have gotten. I always look forward to my appointments! I love how I am treated while I am in the salon and LOVE how my hair looks when I leave!!

My first time at Nicey Treat, I biked from downtown and enjoyed a green tea treat. From there, my companions and I continued our ride up to Westfield and bike, and all I could think of after we turned around was how I wanted to go back to Nicey for a second popsicle! I would happily bike 40 miles to enjoy this deliciousness.

I wish I could give worse! I have a house full of teenagers and was told over half hour ago our pizza was out for delivery. Called back half hour later and was told there was no record of our order. So frustrated!!! Hope pizza plus can come thru in next 1/2!

A Full Plate Catered my sons wedding with 66 meals on 10-30-10.
Our guests raved about the food. No one but the Bride & Groom were vegetarian, and everybody loved it!  The food was great quality, set up was fast and on time. I would use them again without hesitation!

It's lunchtime on a Friday and they act like customers are inconveniencing them by wanting to eat.  The cook is wearing a tank top, nothing covering his hair arms.  Seems like training is needed.  Cashier on cell phone in front of store.  No lunchboxes ready ... During lunchtime.

Had a good first experience here, but not so great the next few times. I waited about 45 minutes for one of them, and I watched as the owner charged the guy before me $5 less than he charged me for a similar haircut. That was my last time. Not a bad barbershop, but I'll go elsewhere

After getting sushi that is obviously not fresh around Oct 2012, I would never go back unless they are under new management. If there are any brave Yelpers out there willing to go to this place after all the bad reviews, do let me know if they are safe to try again.

Only had a pepperoni slice but it was pretty good, and I'd order a whole pie in the future. The sauce was flavorful and seasoned well with just a slight bit of heat; there was a good amount of pepperoni and the amount of cheese was perfect. It was just not heated up enough. Restaurant looked warm and cozy and service was fine.

This is my new favorite Happy Hour spot. Great place to come after work and get happy hour cheap eats until 7 pm. I usually get a $5 margarita, $2 chips and salsa, $5 guacamole and $5 pork carnitas tacos and it's perfect. I have always had very good service. Will keep returning with my friends for happy hour.

Not the best sushi I have had. The interior of the spot is great, however it is extremely dark. My mother and I are new to the sushi game and not having explanations of certain rolls was a bummer. I wish the explanations were there. And what we did get was not that great. I've had way better experiences with sushi.

The new owners can't compare to the owners from a decade ago. I miss the old cenzos. Even though they aren't that bad now, it's not all too great, just par, at best. Out of all the pizza options, this place is best left to the middle and high schoolers looking to quench after school hunger.

Quick and friendly service. Walk-in ready and conversational and accommodating. They are ready for all sorts of nails- long, short, gel, or plain color. I got a French gel manicure on my very short nails and my mom had long ones and got the same thing. Both came out beautiful and I plan on coming back next time!

I have to start saying the food is really good, the environment and decoration is good, but I believe the place is very overpriced. The drinks are extremely expensive and the tacos are a bit expensive considering the size. Once again the food is really good.

Amazing amazing food!  Like an orgasm in my mouth!  However very very pricey!  Worth it to me but I know people who would not come here for that specific reason so just want to put it out there. I had the oysters, pork belly, and New York strip. Never thought I'd like beer humus but WOW!  I plan to come back tomorrow!

I'm loving this place! I tried it when it first opened and was not a fan. 
I've recently tried it again and love it! The drinks are good, the food is flavorful and the salsa is delish. 
I wonder if they have a newer chef as this place has improved in the last year and a half!!!!

Late night bar hopping, 
was ok, nice, friendly service, clean. Free popcorn! That always helps when drinking! 
There looked to be a dance floor area with juke box for music venue. 
Doesn't help some idiots wanted to start a fight with other idiots. Will try again some other time tho!

This is it. My favorite restaurant in the city I currently live in. 


Have not had a bad item I have tried, often get the clam linguine, have also heard great things on cipllopino. 


Desert is good, prices not cheap but worth it every time.


The wait is often 1-2 hours so make sure and join waitlist on Yelp 1st.

The food was good and the service was quick. The interior isn't impressive but it is clean. The burrito I had was smothered with cheese & sauces. The person I was with also enjoyed the food. They had a good diverse Mexican menu for everyone's tastes. Worth stopping by.

This place sometimes has amazing coffee but since the pandemic started, I don't know of another coffee or food place that has lowered the quality as much. It may be different staff pulling the shots or could be the lack of experience of going in but hopefully it returns to its old self at some point.

It's McDonald's, what else can you say? It has a playplace that is covered in yucky but what else can you expect. The have hand sanitizer and paper towel so I cleaned the table and that will have to do. A good place for the kids to burn off energy for basically free.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Asked the front desk where to go for real soul food. I was directed here. Its a little bar, there was a DJ. (it was the weekend) mixed crowd, some older, some young. Its really a bar with a small food kitchen. Menu was pretty basic, guy recommended I get the ribs, but I ordered fried chicken wings and greens it was pretty good.

Literally the worst. Why is there always a line. Why is there no sense of urgency with the tellers. Can never get out of here in less than 30 min. It takes me 5 min at Chase. I only come here to deposit rent check in my landlords account. It's painful every single month.

Very good hotel. It was nice and clean. The staff were wonderful. The service was really good. The rooms were perfect. The only thing the bothered me was, you can here the noise outside. There was something going on across the river and we could hear it when we went to bed. But overall it was awesome.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Middle of the road sushi and strange interior set up. I've eaten here a few times and I prefer take out rather than eat in. It's a family owned spot which is commendable in this day and age but having kids as your waiter isn't always the best option. Overall good qualities in the food here. They also deliver if your close enough.

I ended up at Ginger Beard Coffee for a second day in a row for some study time this morning. Another wonderful experience with the owners Derek and Josh making us feel right at home! I can already feel that this will be THE place to grab a cup of great coffee and chill.

We live across the street from Ritz, and have taken blankets, jerseys, and dress shirts to be dry cleaned over the past year. Their customer service is great, affordable, quick turn around, and open 6 days a week. Highly recommend Ritz for those in the neighborhood.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Went for hash browns. Asked for ketchup. Cashier tells me "ketchup is finished for today"....WHAAAT???? No ketchup packets???? Sketchy crew at night. Guess I'll bring my own ketchup from now on.  They only had about 7 muffins. No donuts. That's why I settled for hash browns. Oh well.

I guess it just doesn't matter which Wells Fargo you walk into you know you're gonna to get terrible, smarta** service. If you're a business owner and need to do business with Wells Fargo use another branch and if you must use this make sure you're not force to deal with Martin.

Unbelievably expensive!  Ordered 2 large pizzas with a total of 4 toppings and the total out the door was $50!!! Needless to say, it was not worth the money and if I could take it back I would. It was my husband who paid for it but still... a complete waste of money.

Stay was good.. Microwave was not mentioned while booking but was there.. Wifi was OK, not good really.. Room was clean, better than expected for that price.. Worst thing was shower nozzle.. It was almost like waterjet as if piercing thru body.. OMG.. horrible.. Not an adjustable one.. I would recommend to replace with adjustable..
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
A very slow Subway.
They always have one person doing everything, while the 2nd (older) person is always so busy performing intangibles that she has no time to assist with the sandwich making, cash register, receipts, etc.

I've opted for other places for lunch due to this inefficiency.

Chain outlet offering various frozen daiquiri's in a counter serve setting.Ordered small Mango and Mardi gras daiquiri  which costed $12  and they are pretty good.

Pros:
-------
Quick service
Rest rooms
Different size options
Tables to sit
In Bourbon street

I haven't tried our take out pizza yet but I can guarantee i will not return. I do not support any business establishment that has a minimum for using a credit card.  Our plain large pizza was $12.19 it's not like it was a $1.00.  A $15 minimum for charging is just plain bad business.

I haven't tried your  take out pizza yet but I can guarantee i will not return. I do not support any business establishment that has a minimum for using a credit card.  Our plain large pizza was $12.19 it's not like it was a $1.00.  A $15 minimum for charging is just plain bad business.

We love the pizza so decided to try eating in. After waiting 30 min get a table we asked for refills on our drinks and was told they don't to refills! We would have to get a pitcher of 3 different sodas or pay per glass. I guess we won't be eating in again. The decor inside is old and it smells  funky &  nasty. So disappointed.

When we got there around 6pm on Monday, there was almost no one in the restaurant. The food was so fast, and great services! We got "one night stand " and "cancer" rolls. Both were delicious and came with cool decorations on the plate (wish we could take it home ;(

If I remember correctly there are 4 self wash bays here. It was busy when I pulled in but scored a bay pretty quickly. They have a change machine so that's good. The equipment works so that's good. One star for the junior high worker tweens that loiter around more than work. It's bad for business.

Awesome. I went in just when it opens for dinner (5pm), just after an hour it's still not busy and my food came in pretty quick and hot! I was hesitant due to bad reviews but I was craving Japanese food and my food was great. Red snapper sashimi was too rubbery for me, so I liked their salmon sashimi better.

It seems as though they have changed their pizza dough. It's not horrible, but just not as light and crisp as it used to be. If it weren't for their fried eggplant pizza topping, I'm not sure I would be back. Please replace this new dense pizza dough recipe!

Stopped here for some drinks and some live music and we weren't dissipointed. The dueling pianos really made it awesome because the crowd got into it and the piano players were really good. There are a ton of places to drink on bourbon street but this place stands out because of its fun atmosphere.

Delicious Pizza!  The square Brooklyn is the best 5*****
service is fast and friendly
Price slightly higher than other local pizzerias 
Good place for large families or groups
Only reason for 4 stars is the weird entrances and lack of ambiance which are important choosing a restaurant to dine.

Seafood Burrito pretty tasty, kind of bland!  Very festive place.  Jeff ordered a Monterey Chimichanga looks yummy!  Service is good but not that busy.  Probably will not get the Seafood Burrito again,  it really needs veggies added to set off the flavor.  As stated before its a little bland

I teeter between 3 or 4 stars.  I think it's a nice restaurant and love that it's family owned and has a history.  Food was good.  Nothing I'd rave about, but definitely a place to go for some pretty good Italian food.  Service was a bit slow, but friendly. Noisy, but cozy.

You get what you pay for. If you buy an $8 pizza that's exactly what it will taste like. This can hit the spot when I just want a  quick pizza. No frills no wait. I don't expect McD's to taste like filet mignon so I don't expect an inexpensive pizza to rock my world either.

This place was delicious! We went on a nite-out-staycation on a Friday night. A little spendy, but great quality for the price! My wife had the beef and I had the pork shoulder; we had draft beers and wine=all good! Definitely worth a visit! Place could use a little more heat, but it was a cold Reno night!

This place has such a great atmosphere. We really enjoyed the staff and the decor. 

The food was delicious as well! The sushi was fresh and the rolls were done beautifully. We ordered the ninja sashimi roll and besides being huge, it was SO good!!

We didn't try the hibachi but maybe next time!

I've only been to this McDonalds' a few times, and have never had a problem.  The premises are clean outside and inside, the service is as good and accurate as fast food is these days, and the food is better than other locations in the Bay area.  Nice job, overall!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I love this small hometown custard place. I wait all year for Lemony Snicket (which is now the Lemon Submarine). They feature a new flavor each week during the summer so the best way to see what is coming up is to follow them on Twitter #Anniesfrozencustard or Facebook.

Stopped by to pick up lunch; great service, efficient, friendly & polite staff and the food was just right. Usually, I'm worried about the fries -please see my review of McD in Silver City, NM- but these were great! ;)

All in all, my visit was smooth, hassle- free and I got fed.

Thanks! :)
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I only had the pizza, it was good. I mean it's pizza, you'd have to be really horrible to be a pizza shop and mess up pizza. I didn't think it was any better or worse than others. I had half plain and half veggie and enjoyed them both. I would order from here again. The delivery was prompt and the driver was nice.

Creole creamery is an absolute delight! The price is unbeatable for the craft creamery ... $3 for a scoop is perfect! The cream cheese ice cream was my favorite - tangy and sweet. Grapefruit and Campari sorbet was refreshing! We highly recommend! It was so tasty we forgot to take pictures.

If you like Winn Dixie, there's probably not that many other grocery options around you...This store SUCKS. Seems to be a lot of people preferring other Winn Dixie's over the other, I have my doubts that they're much different. 
I've heard from family that live in Florida where Winn Dixie is based that they're terrible there too.

Had the yellow porch burger. Not bad but not good. Went on lunch and was late getting back to work because it took a while before a server came to the table. Food was out fast and was hot and fresh. Never had chips with a burger at a restaurant but the bright colored chips were great.

Huge lunch time crowd. Of course.huge playground for rug rats. There is a kiosk to order yourself without any assistance from staff. So that is the future of BK... less jobs for people starting out that need employment. High schoolers or whatnot . I love my cheeseburger though. Clean restaurant.

Might be the slowest starbucks I have ever been to.  I didn't use mobile ordering because I has a reward.  I ended up walking out without my order so I could make an appointment.  They fill the drive thru orders first and only had one barista working with a huge inside line.

The service was really great. Our server was really imformative, upbeat, and friendly ! The hibachi rice was seasoned well and tasted fresh . The sushi also tasted fresh as well with a variety of creative combinations . I ordered the rainbow roll which was not only tasty but presented neatly and beautifully .

Nothing special at all.  Rather disappointing as a matter of fact. Fajitas were over cooked. Served with a thin slice(?) of tomato, about 5 strands of lettuce and no cheese. Asked for cheese and lettuce and was charged extra for both.  Portions were small and the place isn't very inviting. We won't be rushing back anytime soon.

Why is this place decorated for Christmas in August?? Service was awkward at best and the food was fair. The tomato sauce tasted like canned tomatoes with no seasoning added at all. Best part was the small (very small) portion of roasted peppers and bread that they bring you with your meal. Glad we left before the singing started.

The staff is friendly but the service is quite slow as they appear to be understaffed. As for the sushi, it's an experience I'd rather not remember. The rolls are passable but small. However the nigiri is meh, particularly the yellowtail. Probably the worst I've had in a while.

Only 2 stars because of one reason. 
My husband just returned from a haircut by Susan, she did a great job however the male worker had a bad habit of using curse words. Sadly the cut and the price was great but due to the bad language he will not be returning. You've lost our entire family's business.

This is the place that I recommend to friends/family when they ask me for a nice Italian place in the city. The service is beyond professional, very European manner. The food is so delicious and the menu is clean, fresh and in season. Just writing this review makes me wanna eat there tonight!

Seriously.... YUCK!!!!  I was starving in the airport and ordered the mesquite chicken sub.  The chicken texture was so rubbery and chewy, I could not even finish the sandwich! So much for grabbing a quick bite to eat in the airport.  

Note to self (and others):  You're better off just getting a sandwich from Starbucks!

The wings and nachos are great but the kids burgers are just horrible.  This is the 2nd time that they taste horrible - Very disappointed. My kids didn't eat them at all.  So I tasted their burgers and it was really bad. Aside from being burned - they had an old meat taste.

Wow, overpriced and underwhelmed.  Almost $60.00 for two large pizzas and three salads, which contained plenty of iceberg lettuce.  One pizza was not even cooked enough, and was pretty skimpy on the toppings.  I"d rather have Pizzahut over this overpriced pie!

This place is great. I have the monthly car wash subscription and it is close to my house so I can go whenever I need to. The towels and vacuums are wonderful. The staff is very helpful.
I am so glad they opened in Eagle.  I used to drive to Pine and Eagle Rd. Not any more

I love this Tucson Tamale. There is a lot of space inside and outdoor seating. The food is always great and customer service is always friendly. Nice selection of tamales and beers (which are the perfect pairing). If you like the other location you'll love this one.

STOP don't even think about it! This is the closest fast food restaurant downtown indy and it's the worst run/managed/customer service place ever!. Their service is awful and if you're looking to grab a bite on the run you might spend less time at a nice sit down restaurant reviewed on my profile page.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place is desperately trying to be trendy farm to fork but slightly misses their mark. they indicate on the menu that they have gluten free entrees but the serving staff is absolutely clueless, bread was placed on my plate of gf food. it was ok but for the price I expected much more. I probably won't be back .

I love koizi, they never let me down. So many selections from hibachi to sushi and sashimi! The staff is always friendly and on top of things. I swear my waitress was a ninja because I never saw her refill my water and yet it was always full. The food is fresh and made to order. There isn't anything I can say bad about this place.

A bare-bones interior -- the most stripped-down McDonald's I've ever seen. No reason to go inside unless you have to sit down or use the bathroom. Their focus is the drive-through. Best to use that if you want a quick bite from a McD's. Food is routine McD's.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Was greeted immediately and offered a beverage by who I assume is one of the owners. Comfortable, modern, relaxed waiting area. Olivia cut my hair and did a fantastic job, and was fun and easy to talk to. Another hairdresser assisted me checking out and was super friendly and polite. All round good trip.

Under new management. Owners name is Mark and he's a major con artist. Took advantage of a friend that doesn't know much about cars. Just to give you an idea. One of the charges was $100 to clean the terminals on the battery and another was $150 for a tire. I looked up the price for that tire and Pep Boys had it listed as $70.

Cute new shop next to the discovery museum! Loved going in there and you can actually see them making the donuts. Tons of unique options and very good doughnut, they sell out fast on the weekends, a very popular options.! **good for coffee too! 

Both in and outdoor seating.

The atmosphere is great, with the gentle lighting providing a calm environment. The hibachi was delicious, especially the shrimp and NY steak options. The ingredients are fresh and well prepared. Awesome service and great chefs. Would definitely recommend this restaurant for everyone.

Literally the worst Carl's Jr... No, worst overall fast food location I've ever been to. It always takes roughly 15 minutes to get your food, no matter what you order. I've received moldy buns, wrong orders, and rude customer service. 

Major shame its the nearest Carl's by miles, so I'm not left with many options.

Pleasant, clean, and modern atmosphere. The veterinary professionals are confidence-inspiring and always willing to discuss potential outcomes and treatment courses in depth. The convenience aspect of an in-house boarding facility cannot be overstated. However, Crescent City is pricier than other nearby vets.

I come to this TD Bank due to its convenience to where I live but it drives me crazy that they are only open until 5 pm Monday-Wednesday. I really wish that they were open until at least 6 because I am never able to make it here in time after work. The upside is the workers are friendly.

This place is not the best of you want authentic Chinese but it is quick and delicious. This place is one of the only take out restaurants that will deliver to my house. The food is pretty inexpensive, but can be a little greasy usually I ask to make it with low oil and that does the trick!

The free use of the vacuums with purchase of a wash is nice but the past two times I went through there was still mud, dirt and bird poop on the car.

Its more of a car spray than a car wash.  I get that the cheapest service is $5, but its still advertised as a car wash.

I love this local BYOB spot for fresh food and community feel. Their salad with meatball is delicious. Ravioli are really good. Cannoli not to miss. There are few seats at the counter, TV and you could always chat with Frankie. It does get real busy and cramped up & loud so if you need more quiet dinner it's probably not the place.

Pretty good sushi overall, not the greatest but definitely not the worst. Service is hit or miss. Usually not too crowded either so easy to get sat quick. I enjoy the sassy roll and spicy crab roll. Will definitely keep coming back to try other rolls. Prices are a little high but not bad

All I can say about their food quality is that their target audience seems to be a lower middle class teenager.  It's somewhat creative, but they don't have much respect for the quality of ingredients.  I can't believe the place across the street got fewer stars from other reviewers.   Don't buy into the 50% off game.

I have had both good and bad experiences and it has depended heavily and entirely on our sushi chef. We have always stuck to sushi dishes there and run into a few kids who made incredible sushi, as well as a couple who made so / so dishes. We always prefer to sit at the bar.

Got the spicy beef special. It was good, with lots of fresh veggies, but there was barely any beef. I left hungry, even though it came with crab rangoon. At $7.50 for the plate, I was hoping for something more substantial and filling. Not bad, but not a good value, especially since Chinese takeout is usually so cheap.

I was referred by a friend when I bought my Camry back in 2013 after a $650 quote from the dealership in repairs....I went to Toy House and have never been happier...I didn't need half the stuff I was told and the guys really go the EXTRA mile. As long as I have my car they will always get my business.

I had stopped going to sushi house last summer (2017) because the restaurant had a revolting odor. I went again over the winter once or twice and no smell. But when I went this week and ate my sushi there was a hair on my plate. That being said I will not be going back again.

Large craft selection. Bartenders are really nice. A little pricey but craft beer is never cheap. Only bad thing is when you ask for your check, there is no option to tip so I suggest bringing cash. But i love this place, its my go to beer store, and the liquor store is nextdoor!

Last time I went to this Checkers I ordered wings with angry buffalo sauce and it messed me up. I like to eat spicy food and these wings were something I could handle. Its the day after I woke up burping, choking, & having fever symptoms. Its been over 2 weeks now and I am still sick but with only cold like symptoms.

This is hands down one of the best Sushi restaurants in Indy. I can't say enough good things about our experience at Asaka. The Sushi was great and worth the 15 minute wait to be seated. Prices are great. 
They also have a happy hour 5pm- 7pm. 
The staff were all wearing masks and they offered hand sanitizer. Highly recommend.

Decided on something "different" for a beer and bite with a Buddy a while back.
I must say...we made a good choice.
Clean.
Friendly.
Delicious.
Reasonably priced.
Hadn't thought about Mikado for years, but it is certainly back "on my radar" now.
I will certainly be back to this, or another location

When I am at Lowes...I must admit this is often where I wind up.
Consistant quality in my experience regardless of which location you find yourself neer.
Not the best burger bar. Not the worst. Thanks to their franchising efforts...there always seems to be one not too far away!
One order of fries will feed several diners!

Food taste good but is really overpriced. Black cod-$14 dollar for a super tiny piece, not worth it. The skewer doesn't have much salt on it although they say is sea salt. I would rather go Watari in downtown Edmonton, same price and you can at least order triple the amount you can have here and their food taste fabulous

Been here a few times and love it, the pizza I have tried has artichokes, ham and black olives with a thin crust, so tasty. I also tried the tiramisu and it was the best I have ever tasted, the coffee drinks are really good too, service is great! Definitely check this place out :)

I call it greasy Mexican. It's what most would call inauthentic Mexican. It reminds me of the style of Mexican that we had in the 80s. Remember ChiChi's? It's kinda like that. Yellow crunch corn taco shells, refried beans, iceberg lettuce...but it's great! And it's cheap and food flies out of the kitchen for a quick lunch.

This location doesn't seem to honor their posted hours of operation. Tonight they closed twenty minutes before tthe posted closing time. The two young teenage girls behind the counter wouldn't look up from their phones. Watched as other customers were similarly turned away prior to their 10:30p closing time on a Saturday night.

Thank God Chick-fil-A is right next-door these guys can't give him one way to save their Lives. I order two meals straight off the value menu and they messed them up. Seriously who does the hiring them it's ridiculous I will drive out of my way 15 minutes to not go to a Caspers owned McDonald's
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is the closest one to my house and although I wish they'd build one in the gentilly/NOLA East area, this is the best one to go to. It's in a very nice neighborhood and the environment is always chill and relaxing for study parties or getting a coffee on the go!

Really good pizza! Specially super late at night, what a surprise. They are fast (picking up at least) and the pizza is not expensive. The sauce and dough are really good. Place has both is you wish to eat there and they offer a few coupons with specials. Overall a good place for pizza.

Good sushi. Everything looks and taste good, the service is great and all a good price best sushi in town. They do a lunch special which runs until 3 $7.50 for two rolls and includes a soup and salad which is fantastic I would definitely recommend this place to all

Rally's you have got good food, but your service is 
TERRIBLE, with a capital T. And I'm afraid it is going 
to hurt you in the long run, if you don't change it. I'm 
not talking about any certain one , it has been every
one that I have been to lately. You need to make 
changes!!!

Best pizza ive had since being in the st louis area. I can finally say that i have found a pizza that I actually like!!!all fresh ingredients, great sauce AND they use mozzarella cheese!!!! I havent been to the restaurant but ordered one during an office lunchbeun and i want to eat it everyday. The wings are great as well.

The outside of the building kind of looks scary but once you go inside the decor is beautiful. As for the food...amazing!  I've tried several of their sushi rolls and they were all delicious. They also have excellent shu mai with a tasty soy sauce dip. Definitely a great place to fulfill a sushi/hibachi craving :)

Excellent food. Wonderful service. You may have to wait for patio seating but on a nice evening definately worth it! Beautiful patio and live music on the weekends.
Their food is more traditional mexican food then the others and their sauces are amazing...I highly recommend this restaurant.

Dunkin Donuts really needs to work on their processes. 12 people in line and one cashier. It's not the first time it's been like this, so I know it's not just because someone called off. They need to hire people who move quicker!!!!! This is the reason we don't come here more!!!!

It's average at best. None of the employees made eye contact or said more than absolutely necessary. Not rude but definitely not personable or friendly. Ordered 2 Cheesesteaks & 4 cookies. They were all average as well. I do enjoy Subway in general but will go to another location next time.

Always a great experience at Salon Bass! I've been getting my hair cut by Garrett for several months now, and I've recommended him to six of my friends (guys and girls), and they've all been very satisfied as well. Especially for a men's haircut, you can't get this quality for this price anywhere else in Center City.

Singh is a lovely person and made my late sandwich pick up wonderful so close to closing time! He actually really cared about the effort he put into the experience and he was honestly just so kind. I didn't feel rushed out or as if the late dinner grab was inconvenient. Will look for him next time.

My wonderful hubby and I tried sunny pizza tonight  and weren't really impressed.  The sauce was "different".  Not good but not bad.  The crust was blah and the wings just weren't good at all.  I really want to like this place but it's just missing something.

Took a gamble and tried amici's pizza last night. What a great pie!  Had a large pepperoni, sausage and mushroom. The dough was thin but not too crispy, there sauce was plentiful and flavorful and the cheese was amazing. I love it and will definitely be back for more.

This is the location in Canal Place. Line moved quickly and I ordered the peppermint hot cocoa. The cashier rang me up then a barista said, "we only have skinny mocha for hot chocolate." I'm not a regular visitor but how do you not have enough syrup to make the hot cocoa especially on a cold day?

Dave is a great barber.  He's always good conversation, especially if you like Harleys and guitars.  Great haircut for a good price.  He and his staff are also good with my two boys.  The sitting area is nicely appointed and there are things for the kids to do.

A slice of pizza is tiny, and it's pretty expensive if you want to leave feeling full. I wasn't a fan of the thin crust, and because of the rectangular pizza, I feel that there's less crust per slice, but the crust is my favorite part. Not bad, but not somewhere I'd visit again.

Good, fast food....their crispy fries are good and like the seasoning on them have tried turkey club,Philly, Italian grinder and hamburgers they are all good. Market has everything from milk to canned goods and hot coffee and cappuccino machine nice to go and get something quick instead of driving up houghton.

This is a great restaurant with consistent, quality service. It's nothing spectacular, but it's reliable. The steak is good and the pastas are great (especially the salmon pasta), and the wine menu has good variety. My only complaint is that the bread is truly terrible.

The food really is amazing, but the service could not be worse. Only go if you have absolutely nowhere to be and no expectations whatsoever as far as being waited on. If you are high as a kite, it seems you are in good company. Worth trying this place at least once though.

I've been there a couple times now and my experience is the same. Poor bartender service coupled with poorly showing the various football games. While the food is OK, all the times I've been there, I've had an issue with the order. I don't feel the management stresses attention to detail. Details matter

I have always loved Yummy House, and when I was moving away it was one of my last meals. I love the Mongolian Beef (extra spicy) and Yang Chow Fried Rice. I might find better Chinese food now that I live in California, but I've never had better anywhere on the East Coast.

Excellent service, great prices. Highly recommend it to anyone needing muffler service. They are very busy and will do the best to accommodate your busy schedule. Mike in the office was very kind, professional, courteous, and treated me with respect. Highly recommend this muffler shop to anyone seeking muffler work.

As much as I love Publix, this store always seems to disappoint.  Often times they are out of stock on many of the items I purchase regularly.

This location is one of the busiest in the county and there are always long lines at the check out. Definitely try another store if you are trying to get in and out quickly.

The parking is very limited and inconvenient, the strip mall is a little sketchy, but once you're in the place is a cute little restaurant. It was very clean our food and our waitress were very good. The price was not bad at all. We will definitely go back.

Worst Dunkin ever! It's always under staffed. Drinks are inconsistent. I prefer going through drive through because if you go in you see how dirty it truly is. The vitamin water is marked $1.99, but they ring up $2.19. I realized after I payed. I never check my receipt but I will now. Ill continue going to Wawa.

I go to La Viola pretty much once a month. I prefer the original location that is just the one room, it makes you feel like you are having dinner at your Italian grandmother's house. The staff is so friendly and the food tastes like its straight out of Italy. 

If you haven't gone there yet, I say go there. Tonight.

This place is awesome. It was my first time there tonight and Marty the owner made us feel at home. He was very personable and friendly and super nice. He let us try all of his flavors of ice cream and Italian ice. The Italian ice is amazing! It's so rich and a zing too! I'm so happy I stopped in and now it will be my new spot!

Waited over an hour for them to deliver my food that I ordered through Grubhub. Called to find out what was going on and was told the manager was on the phone and would call me back because they are the only one who could help me with an online order and the lady on the phone hung up. Tried to call back and my number was blocked.

No sides no napkins no drinks really management is a shit show .they are a crap fast food place don't care about thier management  
I don't want to order this place anymore 
Theirs food quality is bad everything is cold I'm sure everyone works for their paycheck 
It does not work that way
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Very good Italian restaurant on the north side.  Restaurant setting is of a street in Italy.  Bakery, wine, and tailor depicted store fronts line both sids of the tables with nostalgic items on display. Truly a great experience when dining.
Food is very good and beer is very cold.
Overall great dining experience last evening.

I used to go to the Coastline many years ago. It had a great crowd, friendly, classy and great music to dance to. Now, it's Cherry Hill's answer to a North Philly nightclub! Most of the music (especially Friday nights) is hip hop or rap. Just not a very nice place to go, completely lacks class.

Car wouldn't start. Called here, they don't have towing but referred me to a company. 
It was just a dead battery. They gave me a new one, changed the clamps, added coolant, and most importantly,  didn't try to gouge me. 
I think i found my NOLA mechanic. 
Thanks.

It's a cool neighborhood bar in a cool little  neighborhood. Bywater..
 Decent prices. 
Nice big bar, with lots of choices. 
Great place on a Saturday afternoon for a couple of "pops" (lol).
It was fun after brunch in the area. 
I'll go back next time I'm around there.

I had an excellent carne asada taco at Room Four tonight. It was presented very nicely and was dressed with avocado and cheese. I had the salsa rojo on the side - it was good but quite spicy. I would like to come back and try more items on their menu some time.

3 1/2 stars. Super friendly, decor is average. The food is pretty good. Still about 10 bucks a piece, but you get the salad with it. The house salad was really good. If you want cheaper but decent Italian food on this side of the river definitely give it a try.

Out standing fresh old school scoop ice cream and 
Yummy old school waffle cones. Great variety to choose from. 
Wonderful customer service. 

We bought two waffle cones with one scoop each it was only $5.32! The scoops where generous too. 
We will be going back!


Locally owned too!!

This has some of the best Mexican comfort food in town. Tortillas have to be the best in Tucson. Beans are soooooo good. Never can go wrong with anything here. I've been eating here for a long time. 
The only things I've noticed over time is that the crew that works in the evening isn't as on point as the day crew.

the service was horrible, but they said they had 2 people call off. I didn't like the menu at all - very limited - but they did give us free pitchers of margaritas and discount on our food because of the poor service, etc., but will never be going back there again. Maybe that is why they included the word LOCO in their name.

all colors of mold on the water fountains, chewed gum in the cup holders of the treadmills, teenage employees playing on their phones, roof comically leaks every time it rains, locker rooms have essentially no climate control. for a new gym (I joined weeks after it opened) it's going downhill fast.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Food was good and portions very generous. Staff was very accommodating and when there was an error with our order very gracious and made it right. A bit pricey but when you consider the pasta dishes contain enough food for two that doesn't make the price seem all that bad. I will go back next time I am in town.

Walked in and have a great experience!
They were able to take me right away, helped me pick out my color and I was in a chair within 5 mins!
I got a gel manicure which turned out fabulous and for only $20, who can beat that!
This place is right down the street from where I work so I'm sure I will frequent again

I love this place! Great environment to hang out. Especially being from a church in the same parking lot, I spend a lot of time here through out the week meeting people, and on days to get away and study. All beverages are rad, and friendly staff. The manager is truly welcoming as well.

I haven't been to A & W in year so I thought I would change it up a bit. 
The fries were hot, but soggy. The burger was good, also hot, but extremely over seasoned! I think I'll be chugging water for the next 24hrs based on the saltiness of that burger! Wowza!

We walked into our room and it wasn't serviced before we checked in.  We thought we had walked into someone else's room!

When we were given another room, it was filthy.  Please reference the photos.  I'm shocked by how bad this hotel is, considering how expensive it is too.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ordered delivery online.  It was convenient and timely, but all of the food was sub par.  Dried out bourbon chicken, bland general tsos, soggy coconut chicken and dried out beer sticks.  I guess it you want convenience over quality it's a go, but I'll get my Chinese fix somewhere else.

ordered and picked up dinner yesterday from here. delivery was an extra $1 and the joint was close by so i just walked to the place.

i took seafood gyoza and New York roll. the rolls were not bad.. i liked the sauces and the dressing on the rolls. i have had better sushi so 4 on 5 rating seems good enough.

Great coffee, can't go wrong with La Colombe, but the service and staff at this location were sadly not as great as the coffee. Hardly greeted as I came into the store, and basically had my coffee thrown at me. I will not be going back to this location any time soon.

Had dinner there with friends. Everyone ordered something different and everything was delicious.

I'm a sucker for Veal Piccata and this did not disappoint.

The service was punctual and polite with several checks to see that we were enjoying everything. Looking forward to our next visit.

Pretty disappointed with the service and food here. We did hibachi, so this review is not based on their sushi. It took our chef 1 hour to come to our table (only 2 chefs on a Saturday night). The hibachi show itself was nothing impressive, food was pretty average. I wouldn't recommend this place to a friend.

first stay at this hotel.... very clean... nice modern design, nice pool. very nice lounge, great work out gym. rooms are cozy, staff very friendly.  Bartender makes weak drinks. close to the highway so it can be a little noisy when trying to sleep.  AC units are noisy as well. overall... a decent place to stay for a couple nights
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Do. Not. Go.  Can I leave it at that?  Despite warnings on Yelp, I went for a haircut.  It did not turn out well.  They were not amenable to fixing it.  Add to that the A/C barely works and the music is the same playlist the CIA uses at blacksites to get confessions.

A great quick stop for a good yet cheap breakfast, the only problem is food temperature. Our coffee is not always hot, eggs don't always come our hot either. I almost think they premake certain things to get food out faster? Lunch is good. Service is good and friendly so lunch would get 4 stars

I had the pleasure of staying here recently. From the bellhop, lobby/ check-in receptionist, and bartender-everyone was warm and welcoming. I requested a corner room. Which allows for some extra space and spectacular views of the city. I can't wait to stay here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great customer service. I have had a car with them for the last month. The process for pick up and return has been seamless!  They worked closely with Gerber Collision, helped me collect my belongings to return to my vehicle.  They were pleasant and kind.  Would definitely use this branch in the future.

I have been going to Pete's for over 13 years been a while since I went. Pete is the best barbers and stylist in the city. He will help you pick your cut if your unsure and is very professional. Pete takes his time to give you the perfect cut and has been cutting for decades. Definitely give Pete's barbershop a try.

Know what you want before you call in your order. When you call in, the girl who takes your order is super efficient and you can be on and off the phone in under a minute.   The pizza is excellent and the speed of delivery is a bonus. Definitely feel comfortable giving them a 5 star.

I highly recommend Empire if you want to not get a haircut while the barbers come pick the 3 people that came after you. Poorly run business I sat there for 40 minutes and was passed by 3x. I guess I'm not cool enough for this place. Thanks for wasting my time. I will try to do better next time do someone will pick me!

This Starbucks is okay, but I'm only writing this review because the music is always blasting and hard to even have a conversation.  If you have to take a call, need to go outside.  I've found myself going out in freezing temperatures just so I can here my phone call.

Great rental car company at 30th St. station compared to the other vendors. Having rented from all of the other car companies at 30th St Station, I recommend National above the others. The staff are actually nice and friendly. At the other companies they simply stare at their cell phones and toss you keys.

This McDonald's is the worst slow slow did I mention just too slow. 10am breakfast I ordered the number 2 all I can see is the breakfast menu did they not ask me off of which menu breakfast or lunch you figure out the time. Or excuse me for not knowing they sell hamburger and french fries 24 hours now
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: My wife and I stopped here for lunch and found the food outstanding. I had the eggplant rollatini appetizer and my wife had an order of the chicken frances. Service was attentive and helpful, offering to modify any options on the dinner menu for lunch. All good was delicious and we look forward to coming back!

Hard to say bad things to starbucks (i mean all coffee should be same throughout all location) but they're just realllllly slow. VERY SLOW. Drive thru is always backed up and takes abt 20 min to get through even at slowest part of the day- i don't know why but they're really slow.

I've been coming here with my mom since I was a wee little girl. A wide variety of Asian fruits and veggies and of course tons of sauces and other random things that you may not be able to find at your local grocery store. Of course, with that said there's definitely a distinct aroma in the store but nothing that's gonna kill you.

The patio is great, but that was the high point of this restaurant. Service was uncoordinated with dishes arriving a few minutes apart as they forgot about one of our orders. Seems they are focused on being quick instead of a more thoughtful customer experience. Edamame was under-salted and the sushi was average.

Interesting take on Italian food, Chipotle style. Really great calamari and the piada sticks are an excellent side. The serving size of a pasta bowl is generous. I like to mix the diavolo and pomodoro sauces with chicken. You can customize your toppings to your liking.

I always had great service from this location. However, I have my list exam, the older guy with a mustache really gave me a messed up prescription.   During the entire examination, he seemed distracted and had a hard time concentrating. Because of this I have left the practice entirely.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
We go there because our grandkids like the play area. 
We always seem to get our food as ordered, it's hot, and don't wait too long. 
They aren't that busy and generally the tables and restrooms are clean.
What else can you expect from a fast food chain?  ;-)

Piadas here are so tasty. This isn't your kids Italian (unless they are a bit adventurous). The salmon is so good. I make a salad for a healthier option but everything is fresh and delicious. Their take on breadsticks is just so so but get the wrap or build a salad.

Although I prefer ice cream over Popsicles, this place has change my mind! They have vegan friendly options but I recommend the peanut butter or dark chocolate with sea salt bars. Make sure to get them dipped in chocolate too!  My only complaint is that there is not enough room to sit inside or outside.

Last time especially I'll be in this place. Customer service is absolutely horrible and they don't know what the hell they're doing. How can you go to a place to get something and they don't have it. Bad management for sure. Bye Dunkin the new place will open soon and you'll be under soon enough.

Stopped in here late Saturday afternoon after a Temple home game at the Linc.  Nothing special, but perhaps popular with the locals.  Service wasn't the greatest.  Bar tender was more interested in talking to people she knew and not very friendly.  Food was ok.

Atmosphere, Local hangout where everyone knows everybody! I've been here many times & only have sat at the bar.  Dinners come with a HUGE salad to share - that's yummy! Food is good.  But it's the timeless throwback atmosphere that keeps us coming back!!  Bartenders are superb! Drink menu isn't snoresville!

Called twice to see if they had my favorite bourbon.  Each time was told they had multiple bottles, which was confirmed by web site.  Told they would save me 2.  Drove 20 miles out of my way on a Sunday morning and two clerks each said they never carried the brand.  This is not first time this has happened.

Went for dinner on a Tuesday and restaurant was half full. Waited over 45 minutes for food to arrive and service was slow for drinks. Complimentary bread was portuguese buns that was warm. Food was big portions but was not hand made. No compensation for slow service. Will not return.

Came here and got the vanilla latte based on the stellar reviews. I enjoyed the latte although it didn't change my world like some of the other reviewers. It was tasty. We also got the cinnamon roll to split because it looked delicious AND the barista said it was on the food network. It was delicious. Just what you'd hope for!

Real happy with first time visit. Party of 12 didn't faze them in the slightest. Sal our waiter was outstanding. Food was delicious. Creme Brûlée tort for desert was amazing. We will certainly be back, probably just two of us next time. It's great to see Maurizzio succeeding with this new venture. BYOB makes it even better.

So filthy here. Kids pushing ahead of me and my child to get drinks. The outdoor play ground was full of bday parties taking all tables but body attending party to utilize the held tables. Big kids up in playground hurting the small ones. It was disgusting.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I have been to this restaurant numerous times and the food is always good and affordable. There is never a long wait, the servers is very attentive. The food come out in a timely manner. When you have a taste for sushi but want a quaint and quick place to get it come to the Sushi cafe.

Lame attemp at trying to be cool. Terrible music in between sets and way to long of a break between sets. There's a ctedit card minimum plus a service fee per transaction. In this day and age and in this location, it was the most ridiculous thing I saw on our entire trip.

I haven't eaten here in quite some time but I still taste the garlic knots. 

This place is great and the owner is a great guy as well. It's a nice little hole in the wall place to get some great food. My favorite pizza is a signature pie called "Whitey Ford" and it's just delicious! :) 

Give this place a try.

I ate there 3 times the food is ok if you like the Oliver Garden  and don't  know good Italian food. I remember why I don't  go there. They have a habit of seating you in the corner of the restaurant.  I did mention it was a birthday and of course nothing happened. Glad I don't go there often.

Great lunch with family. We ordered the chicken teriyaki and shrimp tempura. Everything was cooked perfectly. The portion servings were generous in a bento box and boy was it yummy. No one had a complaint. The service was friendly too. We left full and happy. Definitely looking forward to returning to this great little spot.

Old school Italian restaurant, smallish, busy, male- only wait staff. Mom LOVED the Eggplant Parmesan which came with pasta. Also ordered sides of broccoli rabe and escarole which were very good. Strange that the bread is just okay and not served warm. Red sauce good but really nothing special.

Awful food and awful atmosphere. Tasteless entrees with mushy rice. Mediocre sushi is a generous review. A big box of a restaurant with no character. The staff was efficient, attentive, and kind. But the food was a huge disappointment, couldn't even eat what I ordered.

I have had crooked mechanics before so I'm always skeptical about a new mechanic but I've taken my vehicles here several times now and they have been great each time. They even went so far as to walk me into the maintenance bay and show me exactly what was going on with my car.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
