Wonderful breakfast until afternoon and also great homestyle cooking any time of day or night!!  Lots of Italian dishes that are so good like personal pizzas and pasta --not to mention fabulous cheesesteaks!! Very friendly owners & waitresses & steady local
regulars...highly recommended!!

Please do not order from this place. Not only is it a crappy little place on Lancaster ave but in the last few months they do everything they can to make you order more food in order to use your card.. Also they no longer give you menus but when you ask for one they charge you for it. 
They are totally outta control.

Was excited to get a coffee this morning after dropping off my kid at daycare. Wanted a cascara latte but no luck. They were out of cascara syrup. Then I decided on the blossoming tea latte but no black tea base. They only had green. C'mon now Starbucks I am not impressed

eh this place is okay, not my favorite Dunkin' to go to but okay. The staff isn't really that nice, and they don't care about customers too much. They rush and mess up orders and some of them are rude. If you are in the Drive Through good luck they hardly care about those people as well.

Love this place.  Tried the other Sachiko and hated it.  Ramen is awesome, everything is pretty consistent with what I had in Japan.  They have real curry rice.  The hamachi was perfect.  Prompt service and the waitresses are funny.  Bottom line, my kids love it and they hate everything.  Thumbs up.

Lots of flavors and types (soft serve, hard ice cream, water ice) with abundant topping options. The ice cream was good and the price good. When we arrived, there was no like but after 5 minutes there was a line of 10 people.  There is definitely an after dinner rush.

Coffee is great but pricey. Parking can be tricky around the area. There is an upstairs with lots of tables (maybe too many?). The pastries are also delicious. Stop by if you are in the area!  Would have given five stars but due to the price, it's a solid 4 star coffee shop.

Always great coffee!  The pastries smelled delicious.  Many small kids came in, which suggested it was fairly kid friendly.  Seats were available even on a Sunday at 11.  Parking can be difficult, but if you are willing to find a spot and walk, shouldn't be too big of a problem.  Would go back for a sunday morning quiet read.

My favorite happy hour place! Definitely try the grapefruit martinis! The first time I went, i thought that the drinks wouldn't be as strong as usual because of the ridiculous low price (only $2 if you didn't know) but boy, was I mistaken! They're definitely worth the hype!

Delicious! I tried the guanabana for the first time and it reminded me of my childhood in Peru. The fact that they had such an exotic flavor, and one that hit so close to home so well, makes me wanna go back for more. When the place seemed to get very busy, the girl behind the counter remained very sweet and approachable.

Signed my son up for his birthday awhile back. He is special needs. We went in and at first they talked a good game. Dont be fooled very clicky. Alot were in the back room not out on the floor. I went in several times wondering if my son was telling the truth or just a misunderstanding. I told him not to bother going back.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: We came here after a long time between visits.  We had the spaghetti with meatballs, cheesy garlic bread(not on the menu) and a great Italian soup.  I was excited to hear they had the best Italian beer (Peroni) on tap.  Food and service were great and the beer was cold.  Wine selection by the glass was a bit weak.

Good tasty iced coffees and various donuts, my favourites were the Boston kreme donut and an iced caramel latte. The premises is small but has indoor abd outdoor seats abd a clean restroom. Don't through away the receipt as an online customer survey might earn you a free donut with your next purchase.

This is my first visit to this new taco store. They were semi busy at 1pm on a Monday. 
Service was nice, quick and friendly.
I had AL Pastor tacos, refried beans and a side of salsa.
The tacos and beans were good. The Al Pastor could be a bit more spicy for my taste but all in all it was decent.

We made our first visit today, and enjoyed beautifully made generous omelets. Served with home fries or grits & toast, they were wonderful. Our waiter was cordial, knowledgeable, and attentive. This owner/operated restaurant is newly renovated, bright and sparkling, throughout.

Not very happy...oil change expensive,even with $10 off coupon. At least customer service used to be good, as far as friendliness and concern of counter people. Didn't even get thank you.
Plus,could hear them negatively discussing other customers while sitting in waiting room
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Recently had rear brake pads and rotors done on my 2018 Ford Escape. Rob's Garage was reasonably priced ( hundreds less than the dealer quote) and did the work while I waited. I was in and out in 1.25 hours.  Great local, honest, auto repair shop and I highly recommend to anyone needing work done.

Ordered online sandwich with specific instructions as to mayo, lettuce, and tomato. None of the instructions were followed. Manager was responsive and didn't charge but annoying. 
This market is normally clean, stocked and friendly although consistently pricy.

Went through drive thru and the folks that work here need to learn common courtesy and manners. Saying THANK YOU for choosing McDonalds would be a start. Might also want to restrict cell phones and texting while working as appeared more important to check texts that concentrate on the customer
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This was the worse pizza ever... I went in because there was a sign outside for gluten free pizza .... it was not only way overpriced but it was burnt, very little cheese and sugar in the pizza sauce ... and to top it off  she was very rude and this was on a Tuesday evening very slow.

There's a champps close by so we go there often and I've never had a negative experience. The food is decent and they've got a good amount of beers on tap. The summer time is the best time to go they've got a huge patio with live music over looking the pond.

Friendly staff.
Clean room.
Comfy bed and pillows.
Nice shower head and shower pressure.
Nice breakfast buffet. Breakfast suggestion: More low-carb and fresh items; only ate eggs, sausage & fruit for this reason. Lots of starch/gluten used.
Internet was touchy at first but pulled through.
I would stay here again and recommend.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: First time.  My wife got the signature salad.  It was Ok maybe a bit heavy on the cherries.  I got the kitchen sink pizza.  I was very disappointed.  Crust was soggy in the center.  The mushroom, onion and sausage toppings were very light. I will probably not return.  Sad, this place is close to me so I wanted it to be good.

I love the variety cases that are put together!

This past fall, I snagged one full of pumpkin beer. It gave me the opportunity to try a bunch of different brews and come back for more. I'm just disappointed the variety cases were gone before I had a chance to snag a second.

Friendly staff, nice selection of beers. I will be back.

The atmosphere isn't great, but it's fine.  I've been to the Chinese market before, so i knew what to expect. I ordered wonton soup and general tsos chicken.  The soup was great, but the chicken was not so good.  The general tsos sauce was different with huge chunks of jalapeño and garlic, I didn't care for it.

I ate here a few months back. I really liked this place. It is small in size with limited options, but there is one really great ice cream flavor and why I gave it 5 stars. Its called Not So Vanilla. It is an alcohol infused vanilla ice cream and they put that in between two chocolate chip cookies! omg!

I have been a member for a few years now, this gym does the trick for what I need. The price is great and probably why I am still a member. The biggest downfall of the gym is it gets very busy and you have to wait or change your routine because the equipment is being used constantly.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Very good place to stay. If you are out of city, please make sure to take a daily pass to trolly car. That will help you to go around the town
Hotel has a very nice ambience. Music is good. I wish they added the parking with stay but its ok as its downtown and for the price you cant find a better place to stay. 

Will stay again
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Typical pizza joint. Good for a quick, cheap meal on the way to or from the beach.

Nothing to write home to mom about. Decent prices, but a typical thin slice of pies. The place was clean, nothing to brag on the staff. Just took the order and handed over pizza. No recommendations, nothing special.

Just an ok experience.

Inside and outside area seating! Diverse staff and fast service. I loved the location inside the park. The A/C inside is great and they have very clean restrooms. You can also order both inside and outside. My friend said their beignets were okay but the original location makes them better near the French Market.

Incredible food and service!  I went here upon the recommendation of a colleague, and it was spot on.  Get the lobster dynamite roll and ooka roll...both are large and satisfying!  The staff were incredibly fast.  I was on business so wanted to get in and out...was out in 30 mins!  Highly recommend this sushi joint!!

Nice sushi byob in Moorestown. The sushi was really fresh and they had a nice selection of sushi and an entire menu of other selections too. I really enjoyed everything and the servers were really nice and friendly. Everything was great! No complaints  at all.

This Starbucks often goes unnoticed because it is tucked away in a shopping center with a lot of businesses, but the store is really nice inside and the service is always top notch.  If you have an early morning game at Golden Eagle or an early tee time at Redhawk, this is your spot!

So far we have had the pizza, Stromboli, and wings. All were very good. I like my wings extra crispy and  sometimes they forget. But, that's minor. We have picked up from this location and utilized delivery. Both were great experiences. The food is always ready the quoted time. When we use delivery the food is always hot.

Best margarita pizza ever!!! I tried their watermelon soda, also sooo good! Only thing I didn't like was the lady who gave me attitude when I was trying to decide what kind of pizza to order. She was very rude and gave me a dirty look. That's why I give 4/5 stars. As of that the pizza was amazing!!!

We've been to this place a couple times. It's the best BYO sushi place we have found in the area. They have adequate parking in back which is a bonus for us since we typically go into West Chester Boro for dinner. I've only ever had sushi there, but it gets two thumbs up. Definitely get the fried ice cream for dessert!

Great social distancing and friendly staff. Not sure what everyone is being grumpy about ! Came in here early as a walk in was immediately helped and seated. I always bring my own polish and the gentleman helping me was kind, efficient and thorough. For $29 for a deluxe pedicure I'm more than happy with the results !

Not a huge fan. Got the Seafood Pan Fried Noodles and the Seafood Pineapple Fried Rice. There was hardly any seafood in either and hardly any pineapple in the fried rice. It was all just borderline bland. I'd probably only go back to try some of the Salt & Pepper dishes everyone else raves about.

Great place! I went here for the first time recently and will definitely be back. The staff was knowledgable, friendly, and I was seen within 10 minutes of arriving. They had researched my insurance options for me and made sure I understood what glasses offered me the biggest price savings. Great place!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The customer service was great! The donuts are made fresh. They are hot, tasty and gorgeous. The flavor selection is amazing- there are so many options! The only downfall was no iced coffee yet but she is working on that  very happy with this place. The decor is also very appealing

I am so happy I found this small asian market. I was craving ramune soda and I finally found some here. This is also a good place to buy other japanese goodies such as sake. This market is small but is worth visiting if you are looking for japanese or korean snacks.

This place is ok. One of its big advantages is that is open 24 hours. However, the food here is extremely greasy. The quesadillas are really good, however, they drip grease all over the place. Some things are not good at all such as their carne asada. It is really bland and flavorless.

Very unfriendly staff. Didn't treat us very well. The bartender lady rolled her eyes at me she was more worried about her crocheting then us. Drinks are cheaper tho. Just get the drinks to go and get out of there. Don't feel welcome. Was just a quick stop and got out. They only take cash.

Understaffed and extremely slow. Don't come here if you're in a rush.. This is the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. The lines are always long and slow to get through and the baristas show no sympathy when you do eventually get to the front. I only go here when I'm in no rush and extremely desperate for a coffee

They are so nice in there.  Payment terms are very clear.  Got my quilt back and it smelled and felt clean, but the stains were still there.  Not a big deal, but I expected it to look clean too.  I will still use them because they are close to my house, pretty affordable, and so super nice.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
We tried the new colorful ratatouille and it was wonderful! It visited of mushrooms, eggplant, garlic, olives and zucchini. 
The tiramisu was excellent as all ways.
My add the service was helpful and friendly.
Definitely would suggest the ratatouille and Macaroni Grille.

We love this little gem--it's always consistently good. Very casual and homey in the restaurant. We never feel rushed in the cozy space, and we love that it's a BYOB. 

We had CL cater our Christmas dinner this year and all of our guests were very happy. Highly recommend.

well over-priced. 15% gratuity for 5 people ( family with 3 kids ). paid $200. $30 gratuity. We still had to go to tim horton's for donut coz we were still hungry. Most of their sushi has the same spicy taste and prawn tempura was a size of a shrimp. terrible...i would never go back there.

Just walked a couple of blocks to try this out. Really yummy! I got the pancake ice-cream with the maple syrup drizzle, my mom got the chocolate peanut butter. We both really enjoyed our ice cream. A little pricey, but what I would expect from a small, local place. I'd go back.

A piece of Italy landed on Davis Islands. We were amazed at the fresh flavors and excellent wine selection on the menu. I have been back twice and have found the roasted chicken to be amazing! The paste fare is also fantastico! You will not be disappointed!

can't understand all the bad reviews except that people who are satisfied usually don't write about it. i have terrible feet due to botched surgery and yumi makes them look decent. regular manicures last a little more than a week so there's no problem for me. lots of colors to choose and i'm satisfied

don't understand why there are not more reviews for bruster's.  the ice-cream is really better than what's around. tanner's has long lines but their ice cream is average.  i think the best quality you can buy is nelson's but very few slores stock it. so give bruster's a try, they have a salted caramel that is delish...

first trip here for a mani/pedi and i am so happy i tried them. i used to go to another place on bustleton because of the guy who did a remarkable job on my problem feet but isn't there anymore. i tried to track him down but was unsuccessful but mnow have a favorite place and a favorite person, yuli, who was great!!! i'm happy.

Awesome food and delivery. I ordered veg chowmein and chicken chowmein platter. I got my ordered delivered in 40 mins at home. Food was just awesome. Eggs roles are just yummy! Also, their home made ice tea was just a treat. Quantity was good and tasty and hygienic food. 

A must try !!

Such a below average sushi restaurant, sadly. The service today was unfriendly & the girl seemed like she really couldn't be bothered to help me. My husbands sushi was also definitely gone off (dynamite/scallop) which we didn't realize until we were all the way back in Santa Barbara.

Fast service, lots of choices and nice people. The food was decent. I wasn't a fan of the beef, but the nacho cheese sauce and the combo plates were good. Reasonably priced, too. The lighting was really dark, and I'm not sure if it was intentional for ambiance or because they ran out of light bulbs.

I have been going to Oishi for about 4 years now and I LOVE it! Yes the service is slow at times, but the sushi is awesome. The prices are ideal and its not in the best area, but we have been going there and even though I have been to other places, I prefer Oishi over everyone!

Although I can't say it's absolutely amazing, it's consistent and that counts for a lot. Juliano runs the show and makes sure everyone is happy. On occasion they run out of a special but they we can usually find something we want and the house balsamic is worthy of drinking. If you want something local give it a try.

It's my go to Chinese take out place when I have a hankering for something different than what's offered on campus, and personally I really love their won ton soup, it's one of the best I've ever had. I'll definitely be frequenting here when I have my cravings!

I love Winn-Dixie and I use to love this location a lot. They have great deals and it's very convenient. However, today while checking out I seen a guy with his pet monkey. I've been told people bring  there dogs in as well. I do not wish to shop in a grocery store with pets! I find it disgusting.

Leah is a great nail tech.  She is the only person who gets my nails right.  Nothing fancy to look at, but lots of color selections and designs.  If you need to go in the evening or weekend I suggest an appointment.  They do take walk ins but it can be quite a wait.

Really good crab cake. I've found it hard to find crab cakes with the consistency that I like and this was perfect. The fried green tomatoes were a bit too thick but I'll forgive that and just not order those again lol. My boyfriend really likes their breakfast. Will go back

Stayed here overnight when I missed my flight. Bed is comfortable and hotel is located close to economy parking and has a shuttle service.

Suite was too large for my needs but great for multiple people or families. Did not care for the pleather couch. Hotel new looking & spacious.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Efficient and convenient service. Price was reasonable, car new and runs well, clean.

Young lady recommended that I go to Lido Beach in Sarasota. Took her advise and had a great time, just bring your own beach chairs and umbrella as there are no rental place on the beach for beach supplies.

A true dive bar for the locals. Everyone knows everyone. Very small space that serves just beer and is cash only. Has a jukebox, pool table, and ping pong table. Crowd here is mostly older 40 and up.  OK if you just want a beer but for the price and lack of entertainment I would much prefer just buy a six pack and drink at home.

I've ALWAYS loved this place (both locations)!! Came here last week and tried their new SUPER Las Vegas roll, baked scallop roll, and Tokyo Raman (which came with a California roll).... I was not disappointed!!! Tons of food, great flavors, and great service!

Vic used to be good but their time has came and went. I went there this evening and was served spoiled avocado in my tuna dumplings. Do not eat here they use low quality fish and don't care for their customers health. They don't even serve free water. Best casual sushi in Philadelphia is iSushi on broad and lombard st.

I work around here I had to get a wheel alignment done because I did a lot of work on my car tie rods and control arm. The price was ok for a wheel alignment. But for the pa state inspection they charge $90 which seemed pricey.I am use to paying only $60 for inspection.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I have purchased a 1998 volvo s 70 i have done a lot of repairs from the pcv oil trap and the mass airflow sensor. I have since driven it over 400 miles. The readiness monitors have still not set. I have done all emission repairs and this shop does not offer emission waivers horrible.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I go here for whopper Wednesday ok for the price  the self serve soda is too high tech and had problems when I was there could not use it had to get soda from counter on the back it's ok when it works and can chose from many drinks but when it is time to reset it or add refill just too long to reboot.

This place is a real gem - really high quality (and inventive) sushi (the riverside roll is a favorite), and great non-sushi options too (they use sushi grade salmon for their salmon teriyaki, and it's awesome). So happy to have an excellent neighborhood sushi apot!

Good bar food and friendly staff. The only negative is the bar atmosphere. The bar resembles a sports bar , however it's not a great place to catch a game. They added a dining room but the bar is usually full with tables eating dinner while the dining room is half empty.

We have been here several times. Saturday night usually and you will need a reservation. Super crowded. They have a Hibachi and regular restaurant. We usual get Sushi. Which is always delicious. It is expensive, so if you want a cheaper meal this is not the place.

We have been here a couple times. Once for Mothers Day and another for a 90th birthday party. They are very accommodating and service was good. The portions are huge and expect to have left overs. It is a BYOB which is always good and saves money. It is in a strip center. Food is good.

I have been here a few times to grab a quick lunch while running out to get some work errands done. What can you say about the food. It's fast food. In my opinion
One of the better burgers from the fast food places. It is always clean inside. Service at the counter is usually quick. No complaints.

We came for dinner on a Saturday night. We sat in the main bar are at a high top by the window. It was a cool dinner spot. Good for people watching. 
I had the NY Strip with blue cheese. It was cooked medium and it was goodMy wife had the Anglotti. She said was ok.
We will stop in for drinks next time.

We came for dinner on a Saturday night. We sat in the main bar are at a high top by the window. It was a cool dinner spot. Good for people watching. 
I had the NY Strip with blue cheese. It was cooked medium and it was good. My wife had the Anglotti. She said was ok.
We will stop in for drinks next time.

The store typically has a great selection of everything,and it's priced very reasonable, without having to sign up for a "Club Card". Also, every aisle has a quick view list which shows where the most commonly purchased items are. But what is most important, are the employees who are very willing to help the customer out.

I really appreciate someone getting my order while I'm waiting to pull up to window. It sure cut down on my wait time. I've got  hooked on the philly steak  cheese. And I really like their seasoned fries. I ordered onion ring last time, better than any I've tried in long time. Let's not forget the fat mo, love it.

Finally found a delivery place that both my husband and I agree on that isn't cheesesteaks!!  I got a Taco Salad with Skirt Steak and it was AWESOME!  However, my husband got a burrito that he didn't like at all (reason for the three stars).  We will try again, I will get the same thing and he will explore the menu further.

Some of the best ice cream I've had in a long time. You can tell their hot fudge is homemade-it doesn't have that chemical syrupy flavor that are in so many ice cream shops. And their ice cream was sooo creamy. Love that it is homemade and that they change their flavors seasonally.

I'm a huge fan of Little Nonna's. It was a bit of a wait because I didn't get a reservation, but there are a lot of other things to do in the area while waiting. 

We ordered the Spaghetti and Meatballs to share with a side of Garlic bread. I eat a lot but it was enough for both of us.

Cute BYOB, great for girls night out, or a date.  Loved the warm fresh baked bread, the homemade pasta, and the sense that I was eating in someone's living room with twinkling mood lighting. Enjoyed the buffalo mozzarella with artichoke hearts the gnocchi was nice, but the lobster shrimp ravioli is where it's at!

This place has a great selection of anything you need, it's also very spacious. The staff is kind and quick, and I like that. They are a bit on the pricey side if you are purchasing hard liquor (which is why I am giving 4 stars instead of 5). If you are buying beer, or hard soda, the price is normal.

Endless and they ain't lying. Food taser alright and it ain't anything special. It's endless so you can't expect that much. Lunch deal is the best value but no matter when you come make sure to plan ahead for a wait... it's pretty popular. 
You WILL be stuffed and it WILL be difficult to move.

Typical Comfort Inn nothing special.  No hot tub only a pool.  The front desk only had a smoking room for our friend even though a non smoking was reserved.  There is no shuttle bus and breakfast was mediocre.  The room will do, don't expect anything fancy....It was pretty clean though
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place is one of my favorites, cheap beer will be the end of me especially when paired with their delicious strombolis. It's a fairly big place and does tend to get a bit noisy when crowded but that is not usually the case. Staff is always friendly and attentive. We will certainty be going back soon.

I came here thinking this place would be an alternative to El Molinitos.  I was wrong.  The service was average.  The place looked a little run down.  The food was average at best, but didn't look at all appetizing.  I had the cheese enchiladas with beans and rice.

I eat a lot of Chinese food  ect. This place is buy far the best I have had yet. Egg rolls are quality made. And food is very very good. It's very hot when you get it. And they give you a lot. I will be back for more. It's a very simple place and they are nice.

Tried a couple different options and they were very good. Will go back to try a few more flavors, like the lemon. Went late on a Saturday morning so the selection was not as full as it would have been earlier in the morning.  Will try again earlier in the day to have the full flavor options.

Alyssa over at United Federal Credit Union is INCREDIBLE!  She is so passionate about helping people get their finances in order, bring down bank fees, and is just an overall gem.  For any friends that have recently purchased a car, I tell them to get over to Alyssa to get a better rate!

It's in one of the most expensive neighborhoods in Philly so, as expected, their prices are pretty high. Even things on "sale" aren't anything I'd call a deal. Definitely a place that survives on customers who can't or won't walk the extra blocks to Trader Joe's. It is clean, and the staff are friendly enough.

My friend and i ordered the caramel Machiatto. Mine was a tall and hers a grande. Both of ours had a pouring amount in caramel. They didn't do this last time. I taste alot less of caramel at downtown st.pete. Stay consistent! St. pete dt taste much better. Part street put like 3 table spoons caramel in there. Sugar kill.

Was here early a Sunday morning.  Was seated immediately.  Food came very fast and it was good.  I got the pancake special (3 cakes for $3).  Service was fine.  The normal prices seem high to me, but the specials are reasonable.  At peak times, wait can be long.

It was Christmas time and I wanted tamales.
Tucson tamales are really good with a generous filling.  I went with the chorizo & cheese and the green chile pork -- somewhat traditional.  What they're known for is some of their nontraditional tamales, such as the Thanksgiving or the vegetarian with curry.  So, experiment.

Quick service, friendly happy staff.  They really know how to make coffee and they clean the main part of the restaurant and bathrooms very well. 

They really need to clean the wires overhead and there is a big blast of dust on one of the windows near a vent.

Las Palmas is really, really good. I always get the taco salad and it is so big and filling. It's good for family dinners or going out with friends. They always bring your food out quickly (which is like kind of sus... like why'd it come out so fast lol). But no hate, love coming here for a good, quick Mexican meal.

The food is decent enough for a diner nothing special but most the the waitstaff is miserable.  The hostess is preoccupied, talking to staff and not acknowledging guests.  We've gone back to give it another try but always leave not wanting to go back due to unfriendly staff.

Nice enough building with a nice location. Room wasn't completely ready for us though at 9pm check in. Noise was a issue but if you want to be DT Nashville I don't think this can be avoided. Services and parking are going to be expensive as nothing is included in room cost. WiFi didn't seem to work even.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Mediocre at best... The pizza lacked any stuffing besides cheese, despite the fact that we ordered the supreme deep dish pizza. We also ordered a Greek salad, which instead came with balsamic dressing. Overpriced food, poor service, and above all, infuriating when a manager continuously makes up excuses.

Beers are very pricy. The veggie burger sucks, but the fries were really good. The draft list is varied enough but they don't show you what kind of beer each one is. We had to look it up on google every time. The lighting sucks and the chairs are uncomfortable.

Best gas station and auto mechanic anywhere! Owner is fair with prices, does great work and is honest!! Owner and all employees are really hard working friendly people. I have a brother who is a mechanic and still go here to have my cars fixed!! My whole family goes now, he's got a great reputation!!

Always a good idea to stop for a peach slushie and a dip come  This McDonald's is fancy with a fireplace and conveniently placed near the grocery store.  Line goes quick and employees are nice. But I really liked my peach slushie on a hot day. Good looking out McD's.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is a great place for a taste of Southern Mexico food. The dishes carry on the traditions of the South of Mexico. Your food will be complimented with fresh home made tortillas and Agua Fresca (home made drinks prepared daily). This place has an impressive collection of Tequilas, so shots all around!

First I only rating this on my take out order and I did not venture into the menu!! So once again they also did not include sauce for part of my order. The shrimp and veggie tempura had a nice coating but the shrimp need to be a little fresher. Also my rice dish had absolutely no seasoning!!

The faculty is clean and nice. Make sure you bring something to do if you are staying because there is only one TV and it's in the back of the store. This place is expensive. The most disappointing part were the dyers. They were AWFUL. It took me three hours to dry my comforter and other bedding.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Needed a late night fast dinner, so I ordered out some sushi and tempura from here. The atmosphere was a bit crammed and loud, but the service was fast. the sushi was definitely fresh. The tempura wasn't the tastiest but was quite good. Might not go here to eat in but would definitely take out.

This location always offers a friendly hello and welcome to jakes when you walk in. The items are prepared properly and brought out to your table. It may just be burgers and milkshakes but I love this place. It is way better than any other gourmet fast food burger joints. Stop going to fast food and start coming here.

Good pastor tacos.
Great complementary avocado salsa.
Salsa verse spicer than normal.
Red salsa pretty good.
Chewier tripe vs crispy tripe.
Lengua a little on the dry side according to my husband but I found it more palatable since I'm not a big fan of it anyway.
Will go back to try the corn bowl.

We went twice with a Groupon.  Free soup if you sit at the sushi bar.  Fresh sushi with good selection.  The crawfish did not taste fresh which is sad considering you are in Nola.  Big portion of fresh tuna and well constructed rolls.  Not as good Kyoto in Uptown but good value with a Groupon.

Came here for Cinco De Mayo. There weren't any available tables -duhh! (their busiest day of the year) Place was packed with drunks, DJ was spinning all night long and tons of drink specials! I'll def have to come back to experience the food because there wasn't much to choose from on this day.

First time here. My car was in need of a wash (inside & out). I got the full service and paid extra for them to clean my mats. When I got in my car, I noticed that the interior was still dirty! 
Now, I've gotta find another car wash, or I'll have to clean it myself. Such a waste of time & money!

OMG... this sushi spot is so cute and intimate! It's located in trendy Manayunk. Parking in that neighborhood is tough, but we lucked up. This was my 2nd time here, but first time for my date. I love that it's BYOB! The sushi was just ok. The entrees were a tad bit small, but filling enough. I'd def come back!

Marcia has been coloring my hair since August. She is personable, friendly, and provides a great service while making you feel like a rock star ! I change my color a lot and she always finds a way to save my hair from damage. I would highly recommend her you will not be sorry :)

Food: 4
Decor: 4
Ambiance: 4
Service: 3
Value: 4.5

This is a really cool little place, with a good but limited food menu, good and affordable drink menu, and a great atmosphere, just as long as you don't get stuck with the awkward wall seating when trying to eat your dinner.

Food is alright, good for the area but nothing to write home about. The staff is incredibly friendly and attentive. The best time to go is mid afternoon, there's no one there and the specials are pretty fair. Overall, a decent place to get some tacos but there is better food out there

We tried this for the first time tonight. We used to live in Nashville and the prices for what you get are a lot better by comparison to other Japanese restaurants there. We ordered a steak bento box and a few fried sushi rolls. They were great and the steak was soo tender that I kept stealing a bite for myself lol.

I could not be happier with my first visit to Salon Bass! Linda did a FANTASTIC job on both my highlights and cut (from long to right above the shoulder). Salon Bass is definitely going to be my new go-to salon! I strongly recommend it for anyone looking to make a switch.

This place was absolutely delicious! If you are in the mood for all you can eat sushi I would absolutely recommend this place. The servers were friendly and the service was quick! There were a variety of options, too. If you aren't big into sushi, they have non sushi items you can order as well. 

I will be returning soon!

Driving through and not from the area. I ordered a flat white but these people gave me a cup of milk with a splash of coffee in it. Didn't notice it till I was already on the highway miles away (I was giving my drink time to cool down). Terrible drive with no caffeine just hot milk. I hope the "barista" steps on a lego barefoot.

We enjoyed a yummy family dinner, in the middle of our week on the beach.  This is an old restaurant that has a lot of history - and the food was good.  I wouldn't suggest ordering the pizza, because there is lots of competition in the area for pizza, but the pasta we had was all quite yummy.

Always good service when we come here. Our car is old, and has had quite a few problems in the last 6 months. Every time we go to Meineke it is quick and efficient and we don't feel ripped off like we have with many other car places. Great service, will continue going here.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Never ordered anything except the pizza. Why would you order anything else from a famous pizza joint ? The pizza is sugar sauce and amazing. Mondays its damn near half priced. They are rude when you call and dont want your business so you know its gonna be good. And it is.

$5 for a small ice cream is a bit pricey, but most of the ingredients are organic and they don't use any artificial colors, stabilizers and other crap that other ice cream places such as Ben & Jerry's, for example, use. Tastes rich, like a real ice cream should.

Went here a few weeks ago.  The place is nice and the staff is friendly.  The food however was ok.  I had the chicken fajitas and sadly it was tasteless. There was no spices whatsoever on it.  The guacamole was just ok too.   We may try again in a month or so when they've been open longer.

Nick Boyd was absolutely amazing with the customer service he provided to my boyfriend and I this week. The location also serves as a uhaul location and he went above and beyond. There were some issues with our reservation and he made sure everything was squared away for our move. We were so appreciative of his assistance.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I hit up Stefano's II a few times a month with co-workers for lunch. They have one of the best slices in town with the best selection. Everything from there buffalo pizza, bbq pizza, burgers, and chicken tenders have been delicious. Good prices and quick service. 4 star's all around! Cheers.

Probably the best Chinese delivery place in the Manayunk/Rox area. We get the boneless spare rib combo with fried rice & a egg roll. Also ordered the pan fried dumplings, and a small white rice. Add a can of 7up all for $18. 

Food comes hot, fresh, and usually under 30 minutes. Cash only. Friendly Service! 
Cheers!

I was surprised at how good my food was, considering how bad the reviews are. My husband and I decided to try the general tso and myself the phad tai. He said his was good. Now mine was great. I would definitely order again. The thai shrimp rolls and their buffalo wings were really good too

So I'm sitting here eating while I'm posting his review. And it honestly pained me to give them such a low rating. But this place has gone to crap. It started out as 3 and now it's a 1. What has happens to this once favorite restaurant of mine that my whole family use to go to once a week? Good god someone fix it.

I see why this is location is so dead and their other location in Avon is Soo busy. It comes down to customer service. The worst of them is the bigger chick with the purple hair. She can't cut worth a crap, and rude as hell. If you're going to be a beautician you can't be standoffish and rude. This location will close eventually.

This Dunkin Dounuts SUCKS!!!!!!  The employees are horrible and the manager is even WORSE.   They do not give you hash browns when you order a combo meal.  They are slow and have never got my order right.  Dont spend your money here.  NEW MANAGEMENT is needed ASAP!

Disppointing. I was hoping for better.
Ordered salmon with string beans and roasted potatoes. The string beans were the best thing on the plate. I could tell the salmon was frozen when they cooked it. It just had that texture. Over priced for what I had gotten. Bathroom was absolutely gross. Im sorry but I will not return.

I have visited this place several times. They are cool if you need a quick sushi fix. The place was pretty empty when I arrived so I was served fairly quickly. They have a decent clear soup and rolls. I would recommend this place if you are in the area but I don't think it's worth a special trip.

I've been going to Ralph's for 45 years.  Delicious food. Good service.  I would have given it 5 stars but Ralph's DOES NOT HAVE EXTRA VIRGIN OLIVE OIL.  If you ask for olive oil, you get a bottle of CLEAR VEGETABLE OIL!!  For Pete's sake, GET SOME OLIVE OIL!! You're the oldest Italian restaurant in the USA!!!!

Loving my Pink and White Ombré nails from Ryan! I was definitely freaking out as the couple other places I tried since moving here in April almost brought me to tears! So glad I found this place! Make an appointment, as they are always busy! Super clean and cute inside. Great location for me as it is close to my residence.

Always an incredible experience. Check out their special Monday night dinners for a more affordable, yet equally amazing meal. Sitting up at the kitchen was a great experience as well. Service is always top notch like the food. No Jack Daniels but they do have Angel's Envy.

For the price this was one of the nicest hotels that I've visited.  I stayed on the 12th floor and had a great view of Lake Ponchartrain and the Causeway Bridge.  

The staff was very accommodating, but the room and view was really what made this hotel so great.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I would of liked to see more of a selection of yogurt but what they had was sufficient. They had plenty of toppings which was good. Their tables are in the shape of surf boards which is pretty cool. Is connected to a fast food mexican place in a gas station, mini-mart setting. Pretty good though! 4 Stars.

The people who work here are very helpful and friendly. If you call ahead and request something they put it on the counter for you so it is ready when you get there. They have a good selection of wines and a ok selection of craft beers. The only downside is the parking lot is small and crowded.

It's a lovely place to live except people like to pull the fire alarm in the building in the middle of the night causing everyone to evacuate about once every two months. Nobody is ever prosecuted, so it happens again and again and again.

Other than that, it's a quiet place to live.

Good hotel with a good price.  Beds, linens and pillows were just right.  Which means we slept through the entire night.  Clean, modern decor.  Bathrobes were comfortable made of soft cotton.  Loved the smell of the tee tree toiletries.
Lobby could have a more homey feel but the employees were excellent and accommodating.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place has a warm feeling when you walk inside.  The staff is super friendly and the interior feels  sort of like a lodge which I love. The menu is extensive and includes things like steaks, burgers, pizza, ect. I recommend one of the burgers but the ribs also looked great!

This is your typical texmex place. Good but not authentic Mexican. I have been here twice since its a convenient and while they do have some interesting menu items it is mainly your typical burritos, tacos, ect. The staff is very friendly though and I have never had any issues here.

The first time I came here I really disliked the food. I gave them the benefit of the doubt and assumed that it was just because I ordered the wrong things on the menu. I came back again and only ordered recommended specials. Either my luck is just horrible or the food here is actually bad.

A great experience whether you do it once or weekly. Henry talks a good story while giving you the best straight razor shave. I was compelled to review today as it was my first hair cut from Henry, he has learned a thing or two over the last thirty years of barbering, thats for sure. Thanks Henry!

This place is a solid sushi place, a little pricier than most sushi places but if you are going to the walnut street theater you can get a discount, that is actually how we decided to stop in here. Everything was very fresh and tasty but I did think it was a little too expensive.

Love this hotel, especially a suite and am delighted they are finally CHARGING FOR DOGS!  We quit using LQ after so many awful dog experiences but this stay was great.  We had a lovely quiet room, a great hot breakfast, and enjoyed the friendly employees.  We will be back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I wish I could give a negative star. I paid $15 for their highest wash and when I can out, the car wasn't rinsed and it was covered in soap. The rinse was all of 4 seconds and was horrible. I hate leaving negative reviews but this one is one I needed to do. The workers didn't care and just said that's how the wash goes.

We just had an amazing experience at Ray's. On the way to Washington our car had a minor accident and had to be checked for damage. Ray himself met us, and left a very good, professional impression. It took a short time and we are back on road. Thank You, Ray!

Thomas and his crew are very helpful and efficient when it comes to keeping my car it tip top condition. They always educate me on what my car needs. I rarely have to wait, even in this new "you-always-have-to-wait-in-a-social-distance-mask-wearing" world.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Whoa ok people r super nice but wth it was $34 bucks for taquitos, chicken n rice bowl, two carne asada tacos n a what was supposed to be a lg drink n rc lol...Mexican Coke is the Mexican soda or Fanta or horchata!!! I used to come here years ago. You really have to go south side for Mexican food geez

I went here for lunch, and ordered the fettuccini alfredo with chicken. I was starving too and got an appetizer, bruschetta. It wasn't the greatest. I'm not Italian and I don't even think this is italian food. Plus the waitress we had was really weird and spacey. Weird.

The service was very good and the food was just OK.  The only exceptional food was the pear salad.  I gave 3 stars because I ordered a Whole wheat pasta with pesto sauce.  There was so much sauce that you could not taste any other flavor.  This was the biggest disappointment in an otherwise good meal.

The atmosphere and service here made a great impression as soon as we walked in the door. Then it just got better. The oven bread was delicious. So flavorful! I came here with my family and everyone enjoyed their entrees. I highly recommend the Italia pizza. But the dessert was the best finale. The tiramisu was perfect.

Great place to start or end your night. Especially fun when the weather is great. Looking forward to see how it holds up when cooler weather arrives. Love when food trucks come. If you aren't a fan of the heavy glass cups, ask for a plastic one. Big space and as of now, still nice bathrooms.

Favourite sushi spot in south Edmonton, never disappoints! Quality sushi. One of my boyfriend and I's regular date night spots :)

Dragon eyes is a roll I'd definitely recommend for those a bit weary to try raw fish. You can't go wrong with the crispy coating and dragon sauce combination. Delicious!!

On my life. Best dinner ever!  My husband and I sat at the bar and shared a whole bunch of items (like..everything on the menu).  It was so fun being able to watch the chefs making magic happen from behind the bar.  Come with an adventurous appetite and be willing to try new things..you won't be disappointed.

Loved the Short Rib melt and excellent Eggplant fries. Bartender provided a well made Dry Gin Martini and a wonderful Russian River Pinot Noir. Considered deducting a star for the styrofoam to go container. May I suggest using the re-cycle product used next door?

Went through the drivethru beginning at about 10pm to get two happy meals...and didn't get through until almost 1030pm!!! Customers were becoming disgruntled and left the lines randomly. My son was hungry so I had to wait. 
It's a 24 hour drivethru but they seem understaffed to handle the demands on a Saturday night!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The food was on point along with the service but i felt like the menu was limited. The sushi chef was friendly made great suggestions over all was a good price and is a great place to return to! Also try the black jack or the upside down shrimp! Those were definitely my favorites!

Bomb! Try their Sonoran dogs, caramelos, tacos or burritos and you won't be disappointed! They have several locations now but the Southside is the original and the best! A must try when in Tucson! We love their fresh salsa bar that has pickled vegetables, several salsas, grilled chile's gueros, shredded cabbage and limes. Mmm.

HORRIBLE !!! Spent $30 on what was just plain garbage! The burgers looked burnt and were tasteless hockey pucks. Their spicy chicken sandwich had a very old-looking piece of lettuce and stale bread. The fries weren't even crispy and had black marks on most of them. Even the nuggets were tasteless! DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY HERE!

Excellent!

Old school barber action.
All of the stations are filled with competent professionals, I don't have to wait for any one of them, I can take whoever is available first and know I'll get a good clean cut including a beard trim.

I highly recommend them!

The pizza is okay,  some slices better than others, but the customer service lacks. I've come 4 times to give it a shot and try the different styles but I'm a big fan of spending my hard earned money where I feel it appreciated. The pizza is not that good that I'd return considering the service. Meh!!

I used to enjoy this place but over the last couple of years I've grown bored and less patient with slow service and average menu. The last visit featured cold fries a stale roll and a mediocre burger. I truly could've done better at Wendy's. 
All in all, Ron's Schoolhouse is a better experience and very nearby.

In 2014 Dr. Thomas performed an extremely delicate surgery on my 7 year old rabbit to remove a bladder stone. Two other vets declined to try it, but one recommended Dr. Thomas. With excellent care and follow up, he lived another 4 1/2 years. I credit the talent and care of Dr. Thomas and the Aardvark staff for saving his life.

This BK is ok, just ordered a crispy chicken sandwich & vanilla shake but they forgot to make the shake. Manager got on one of the employees for missing it & did not apologize but it was fine. Chicken sandwich was good & so was the vanilla shake. I would come back.

Not the friendliest & prices are higher then other places. Girl behind the counter kept tapping her longer fingernails while I was there, like she was bothered that I was there. No worries, I probably won't be back, there are other places that will smile when yu walk in, cause they know money is coming.

I guess I will write a good review for a change. We normally get pizzas delivered to our home from this location. The only down side is they say 30mins but it is always 45 or an hour, that does not bother me since I just started ordering it earlier. The pizza is always good & hot & they never mess our order up.

I typically go here for their all you can eat sushi special. The sushi itself is fantastic, no complaints. The serving staff sometimes are on the slow side, however some nights they have to manage the bar and the sushi bar. Overall great sushi, and the $25 all you can eat is a great deal.

Unreal customer service. I won't go into it too much as everyone that goes to this bank already knows, the rudest tellers ever!!! They have smiles on their faces when you walk up to them but that soon disappears into rude, condescending treatment of their customers. Pulling my $$$ and going somewhere else. Unreal...

Literally love this place! Wish we had one in DC! Reasonably priced sushi, super good quality, and chic interior space! The girls who work at the front are always super nice and friendly. When I'm in Philly for work I order pick up at least once a week. Gotta sit and eat here one time!

Currently sitting here. I'm in a party of four and we ordered separately in twos. 

We ordered spider roll, salmon sashimi, exotic sashimi roll, American Dream roll and the coco island roll. 

To put it in simple words, everything was mediocre. I won't be coming back. 

The food also took a while to come out.

This shop boasts "America 's Freshest ice cream" and they indicate that all hand scoop ice creams are made fresh in this shop.  The butter pecan really should have had toasted pecans.  It lacked a string buttery flavor.

Perhaps a different flavor choice would have been better.

Worse credit union. Is a pain to make payments online. They keep making mistakes on my account. Will not be using them for anything else ever. Will not recommend them either. I am sure that the slightly lower rate for a car loan is not worth the headaches you have to deal with. Awful, awful service!

I frequent this Starbucks for business and, out of the 3 in Doylestown, this one is the most 'work-friendly.' It's not too crowded and there's plenty of seats and outlets. Word of advise though: avoid like the plague on weekend nights due to teenie boppers getting dropped off for movie night.

The sushi was decent and the staff was very friendly. I come to Nashville often for work and I am glad to have found a cute and quiet spot. I am a fan of "no frills" type sushi (fish, cucumber, avocado) and had a simple roll but it was exactly what I wanted.

As usual, no problems at all with National.  Transportation to/from the terminals was pleasant (even humorous), the car (Avalon) only had 7K miles and was in great shape, exiting took all of 30 seconds, and return was fast and friendly as well.  Absolutely zero drama, which is the way car rentals should operate.

Friendly staff.  Only reason I'm giving them a 3 star is because of all the renovation.  Bed was a little stiff but all in all not a bad place to stay.  You are close to a lot of resteraunts and and of course you have Busch Gardens nearby too.  Would be my choice of places to stay after renovations are complete.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Very polite people, good service. 

I would have given a full five, however, the kids that work there together tend to cause too much delay and confusion when they mess around, using profanity and joking around with their coworkers, who like to stop in while they are off.

Food tasted great. Aside from this, service was lax, we did not receive the appetizer we ordered, and when we asked if they took axxess, they said they did, and you get a free appetizer with 2 entrees. If you like good portions and good service, maybe try somewhere else.

We could not leave the US without having a hot dog. The line was only three people, yet it took the two persons working here almost fifteen minutes to help us. 

We had a lucky dog, a quarter pound hot dog with ketchup, mustard, onions and pickles. Decent dog, but at 6+ usd per piece?

Wife and mother in law stayed there on 9/22/18 and 9/23/18. Vehicle was broken into along with 4 other cars, back window smashed out. Was told it happens a lot. Hotel says they are not responsible and did not care. Your car is not safe here, go somewhere else. High crime.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This is the Mexican place that you end up at when you've been out late drinking in Broadripple and nothing else is open. No one goes to La Bamba by choice. They end up a La Bamba, and they usually wake up and don't remember ever going. The food is greasy, better than Taco Bell but along the same lines. Fairly cheap.

It really ticks me off when I say thank you and someone doesn't reply with a you welcome. That is exactly what happens when I visit this location. Everything I come here the young man with all the tattoos never says thank you or you welcome to me. Terrible customer service. Makes my coffee experience so bitter!

This place has been a favorite of mine for years. They get busy on the weekends, plan in advance. They have a great sushi special, 3 rolls for $15, check for hours of availability. If you like sushi, check this place out. Oh, and they have  awesome ramen options too.

Their pizza was to greasy and cheese and toppings was running of the pizza but other than that the pizza their has a great flavor to it very delicious they people their I would say friendly and helpful but other than that it's a great place to dine in or order out .

Hit or miss . Always look in your bag before you get home or you will be surprised. They can be very rude and unprofessional. Whenever O pull up it looks like a club everyone is having way too much fun and not in a professional way. Their are some good workers but as they say one bad apple spoils the bunch.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I called to place an order and was told I couldn't order over phone. I said I'm less than 5 minutes away. She said it was store policy.
When I arrived at 840 pm, they had locked the doors. The sign clearly said closes at 9 pm. This is the second time I've tried to order and they closed early. They cleaning up as I knocked on door.

This place is nothing to write home about. The food came out EXTREMELY FAST, but when I first walked in the lady in the front sent me to the dinner room only for the hostess to send me right back... Ummmmmmm Miss ask me if it's take out or dine in, please don't just assume.  The food is just okay.

Family dinner for the restaurant week and it was very satisfied and delicious! It was such a nice deal for the great food: lamb sausage was fulfill and tasty, fresh salad had an amazing dressing! All main dishes were excellent! It's worth to try it! We will be back! Keep up with good dishes!

First time here.  Kani salad was ok, I did not enjoy the shrimp tempura or the negamaki.  The sushi was ok.  The service was very good.  Not the worst place in the world but not great either.  I give it three stars but I definitely prefer other places instead...

Came here for the first time and the food and service was on point! Luis gave a great example of what customer service should be - had a smile, impeccable manners and speedy service throughout lunch. He left a great impression on myself and my friends! Will come again. Thank you Luis :)

I LOVE PETRINIS! Their seafood pasta is to die for. That's my first pick on the menu and am slowly trying other dishes. I have yet to be disappointed, everything is straight fire. Pork chops, bruschetta risotto, garlic bread, seafood pasta... can't go wrong. Happy to have been introduced to this restaurant.

What a horrible disappointment. For the second time in as many weeks, there are no non dairy choices for those of us who are truly allergic to milk. How insensitive! So, if you're into dairy, knock yourself out. Otherwise, be prepared to go away unserved. Clearly, their loss.

If you like Italian food try this place - pretty darn good. I had the heaping plate of eggplant parmigiana and it was great. The dining room is interesting they have a huge big screen but don't worry it just plays a slideshow of nice images - I kind of liked it actually when normally I wouldn't.

Tennou Sushi is average as far as sushi goes.  The fish is not as fresh as others in the area. However does have later eating hours on weekends. Just opened a hibachi section, but have not had a chance to try.  They would be my third choice of eating sushi on the westbank.

I was very disappointed in the French onion soup and mozzarella "sticks". The fries were good and the chicken tenders looked good...my nephew ate the kids cheeseburger without complaints.  The service was slow, but friendly enough.  I'd maybe go back if in the area.

The pizza is delicious!  The sauce is sweet and just the right combination of sauce, cheese and crust.  This shop is about 35mins from me and I'll definitely be making more visits.  The only downside is the parking...no great, only street parking that I saw.  Also, the French fries weren't worth ordering again.

This CDM is okay, nowhere near as good as the dearly missed shop that used to reside here which we all knew and loved. The hours have been scaled back and they have done away with table service. I have had a few workers give me attitude about giving me freshly fried beignets. On the bright side you can now use credit cards.

Foodwise, this is the worst Wendy's! I would say about 1 of every 3 visits, I get old (brown) lettuce in the salad. Twice, I've gotten baked potatoes that were brown. The potato I had tonight was not only brown, but hard.

On the plus side, the staff are usually pretty nice.

Josh might be one of, if not the best bartenders in the area. He'll remember you, greet you, and make you feel welcome even if it's busy. Other staff members are also very nice. Best place for pool or darts without question.  I've moved away from the area but always recommend this place.

This hotel had attractive rooms, but the common areas were a little rough around the edges.
The rooms were very small and cramped, the elevator was dented chipped and smelled funny, the hallways looked worn and shabby.
The common areas were beautiful, newly redone, and the front desk staff was exceptional to be fair.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: been going there for over 6 years,,, never had any complaints and clothes always come out great if you go look online you can find coupons for a discount.  I like it because they are open later so I can go pick up my drycleaning on my way home.  Never had any issues with anyone in the front.  Great staff and great service
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Sitting in line for 20 minutes and still not moving, all for 2 hot fudge sundaes?! Huge line in front now and behind!  Then a tacky (ya I know it's McDonalds but THIS is tacky even for them) sign telling you to wait at the first window to pay and then no one is even there? Ha! A joke.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Intimate setting, friendly staff, good coffee and delicious treats

The front room is cozy with big windows on two sides that let in ample sunlight and great neighborhood watching.  Staff is great, amicable and pleasant.  It is my favorite local cafe and I spend hours here working and chatting with staff, friends and neighbors.

Love love love Tucson Tamale! The prices are reasonable and they carry a variety of flavors. The blue corn tamale is my favorite! I'd say the sweet spot is 2 tamales per person so be aware of that when you go.

They also have frozen tamales so you can take the goodness home with​ you.

Went here for a work lunch meeting. I made reservations for 10 before hand.  

Everything was 100% excellent down to the table, seating time, wait staff, drink refills, and amazing food. 

Absolutely will be returning with my family. 
Food was excellent!!!!!!!!

Great pizza and atmosphere!  The staff are gracious and provide excellent service.  The restaurant is located at the Citrus Park Mall, but only accessible from outside the mall.  There is an outside seating area which is great for enjoying the weather, food, and ambiance.

If you get the chance, jump at it.

This is up there with Stone Barns @ Blue Hill as my favorite dining experience. The food was elegantly put together, the matched wines were stellar, and the chef interaction throughout the night made for the perfect evening.

Will definitely be back (once I've saved enough)!

Stayed here for a night to get away in downtown Indy.    The hotel was great.   Really enjoyed the hotel.    Hotel was clean.   Rooms were fine.  Maybe could use a touch of updating.   Pool was nice.   Service was great.    Room service food was good.   No complaints.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Asked for the grilled Salmon.  They didn't have it.  Then I asked for the Gorgonzola salad.  They didn't have Gorgonzola.  Then I tried to use a coupon they gave me as I entered the store.  They didn't honor it.  

No wonder the place was empty.  Should be out of business soon.

Advice: Book in advance and use the kiosks. If you go to the desk get ready for a slew of offers, pushy customer service reps. The car selection was good, but the vehicle I selected because it was the model I wanted was seriously dirty like it was never washed from the previous renter.

Went here for an after dinner treat. They had a ton of flavors to choose from and I settled on the toasted coconut. It was good, but $3.50 for a small popsicle seems a little pricey. It's a neat little shop though and definitely worth it for a one in a while treat.

Really great pizza. Love Kim's chicken pie.   Manager who is there - young guy - is really nice and efficient. Service is always best when he is there. Because pizza is thin, doesn't hold the heat long - but worth putting in oven for few minutes if do take out. Like the whole wheat crust.

This is one of my favorite hole in the walls with killer hamburgers (my favorite is the firecracker burger).  If you're looking for an appetizer that's satisfies all tastebuds I recommend the Buffalo cauliflower.

Great place with lots of locals, cold beer, live music and a friendly outdoor Florida vibe.

I have been coming to them for over 10 years now. Family owned Mercedes shop. Everyone is very helpful here. Patrick is a awesome human being and a great mechanic. If your Mercedes needs any kind of work this is the place for it. I highly recommend them to everyone.

i made the mistake and came here during some country music fest. the hotel was not ready. fire alarm going off for hours one night. parking charge was outrageous. TV was not working. Elevators were broken. only bright star was housekeeping. room was clean.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: i mean room was clean. I got a 2 for 1 drink being a diamond member. It was fine. The area was a dump, but its New Orleans. 4-5 blocks away is Harrah's casino and Bourbon St is 10-12 blocks. Nice walk, but don't do it alone if your a female. take the expensive ric-shaw from the casino.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We love hotbox, I actually prefer it over all the other pizza place selections. We ordered the pie of the week which was ranch chicken and he cheesy bread which is my favorite breadstick. The service wasn't as pleasant as normal and the cheesy bread was a little hard but it won't stop us from going back.

First time at this new location and went through the drive thru. No one in front of me but it took almost 5 minutes before someone came to the window to take my money. Once she came she was super friendly but the wait was a little surprisingly. I got a java chip with an extra shot and it was amazing as always.

I've been bringing my pets here for years and appreciate Dr. Ricciardi for all that he's done for them.  Yearly checkups, shots, unfortunate accidents, sicknesses.... He's done it all and I've even boarded my pets overnight with him.  The prices are very reasonable.  I'm going to miss Dr. Ricciardi when he retires.

Excellent ice cream but the place is dirty. As my daughter and I were eating upstairs, I couldn't help but notice the dust bunnies attached to the ceiling tiles. Also the place needs to be painted. The walls are marked everywhere and the paint is chipped all over. Really good ice cream but come on guys, clean it up a little.

I love the ice cream here it is hands down the best ice cream around. It's pricey but you pay for quality. At least now you don't have to pay per mixin'. It's definitely a special treat though. 

The staff usually seem to hate their life and the quality of staff as declined over the years but the quality of the ice cream has not.

Servers at all the drive-ins they need training. I wanted an Iced Coffee with both vanilla & Carmel, there were several discussions, if this could be  done. It was made.  or an order could be slightly changed. Had the Battered fried Chicken dinner.  I Will order again.

Visited around 3pm.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Small, Japanese owned restaurant. The food is served in plastic containers, and the overall atmosphere is very cute! My friend and I had the Don (bowl with rice and toppings), and it was the perfect portion for me. It's a place that promotes simplicity and healthy eating- pretty much as Japanese as you can get.

Not my preferred Starbucks but it's a quick in and out thing. Location sucks personally, high traffic area, small parking lot. Sweet staff, quick and on top of things. Everything ordered is always made perfect. They always have my daughters cake pops in stock unlike the Irvington location.

I am so happy !!! This bar is amazing, it's clean and the bar staff is amazing, I was served by Tyler and Selina, they are so friendly and professional. I recently moved here and this will 100% be a bar that I'll come back to! 

Great service !!!! Sp impressed

I've never dined at sushi cafe, but I do love their weekly lunch special, 2 California rolls with nigiri (which I switch out with 2 tuna rolls for a small up-charge). The lunch special comes with miso soup which is really good! 

I recommend their lunch specials!

I'm updating my review. I love their sushi! Their lunch order (which I modify for an additional $2) is amazing. I get 2 tuna rolls and 4 pieces of nigiri with a clear soup, and it's an amazing deal and the freshest of the fresh. Their customer service is amazing and their prices are reasonable.

This is a great little spot. The sushi is fresh and the service is fast, for the most part. All you can eat, a la carte style- order as you go. Make sure to eat only as much as you can order or there will be an extra charge. I like to come to the spot after a heavy gym session to replenish carbs.

Great place to have a meal and a drink. Derek the owner is super nice and always very welcoming. The waitstaff is great and the bartender bobby always takes care of us with a nice stiff cocktail. The prices are on the higher side but comparable to other places on main st.

Agree with most of the other reviews. We came due to the hype to say we've been. Not coming back. Bathrooms were disgusting. Took forever to get drinks even though not busy and the main girl on the mic was wasted and slurring bad. Definitely strip club B team.

Food on the whole was kind of bland the chicken was dried out and almost tasteless the beans were very watery. The beef was tender and had him add just a little taste. The vegetables in the fajitas were not cooked thoroughly and were slightly crunchy which is not the way they're supposed to be served.

Sorry but no. Flies flying around, warm water, 2 orders not taken correctly (even when I repeated one of them to make sure it wasn't messed up), cold food (like- really cold), and it wasn't good. I REALLY wanted to like it. Try Tio's down the road, or go to Plaza Azteca.

Kind of torn. Food was good no complaints. But a weird delivery experience. I ordered on grub hub and food came quickly except man had a go at me for ordering online. Not sure if they just wanted me to call and not use grub hub or they dont want to deliver at all. Anyway, very odd as he was rather rude.

This location must have changed owners because the pizza is mediocre now. It doesn't look appealing anymore and the small things I wanted for my order wasn't done. I asked for light sauce and there's more sauce than cheese. Pet peeve. The chick did give me two extra garlics for free tho. Still meh.

Nostalgic Eye Care boasts a modern, fresh, clean and stylish office. It's very appealing when first entering. There's a small, but stylish selection of frames. Dr. Herring was very friendly when conducting my eye examination and informed me of presecription changes.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
I have always heard about In-N-Out Burger's greatness.  I finally got to try it when I was in town from Buffalo.  I was not disappointed!  Everything was so good!

I got the classic cheeseburger & fries order.  it was the best fast food burger that I've ever had.  I am so sad that we don't have one in Buffalo.

Just got my first cut from Mr. Carson Gauthreaux today, and it came with a free shot of whiskey!  Good conversation without the awkward, often forced feeling small talk I've often experienced.  Carson paid a lot of attention to detail.  Overall a great experience.  I will definitely be back.

What I like most about this place is its simplicity. $8 flat-rate cost for haircuts, cash-only, and first-come-first-serve policy. Unlike those quiet, boring atmospheres you usually find at those franchise hair salons, the ever-so-busy staff here are very friendly and sociable with their customers.

Great service and nice clean hotel ... Love it !!!! JUST ONE THING ... I JUST CHECK OUT YESTERDAY AND I FORGOT MY FAVORITE TIE :( .. I already call and they said that someone is in the room already , I hope I can get my tie back other than that I love this please !! Please help me to get my tie back !!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Absolutely love this place! Sure, it's your standard takeout Chinese place inside, but the food is consistently awesome, and it doesn't break the bank. I order out from here on a regular basis, and never regret it. The employees are friendly enough too. I completely recommend this place for all your Chinese take out needs!

I was here for dinner party of 6. Sushi was decent, service was better then some other all u can places. Only reason for 3 star is because it took so long for food to come out. Our appetizers came after the dinner and some sushi was missing from our orders. Overall good, I will visit again to see if I was there on a bad evening.

Homemade, very fresh Ravioli with Vodka sauce was perfect. Mussels with white wine sauce for an appetizer was really the size of an entree and they were huge. Good pick for a "just a passing by, lets try" kinda night. Didn't give 5 stars bc they forgot to bring out our white wine with the mussels.

The hotel is ok. Close to the airport. The breakfast here has been going downhill rapidly. What was once a decent breakfast has become smaller and smaller. Colder and colder. Poorer quality of food overall. I know it's changed names and owners. Whoever is in charge needs to pay closer attention
To details.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I live on the Island and have been here a half dozen times. Terrible service. They don't care about people. Just want to turn over the tables.  The people greeting you at the door are the worst. Food is pretty good. The people are not. Go somewhere else.  The pictures are of empty tables-but they won't say why.

I would give 4 stars but the food here is wildly inconsistent. Sometimes it is great and other times it is average. It is never bad so there's that! Building your own roll is really fun and I love the wide selection of boba options. The ramen is pretty terrible, Korean tacos are usually pretty good.

Love this Starbucks. I go thru the drive thru. Most of the time there is a long car line. The line does move quickly. I always order the Caramel Frappuccino. I am always happy with my order and with the service provided.  I will continue  to go to this Starbucks location.

I went to the drive thru.  I ordered chicken fries , medium fries with Buffalo sauce and medium drink. When the lady gave me my order, so looked inside. No Buffalo sauce. I mentioned that There is no Buffalo sauce.  Thank god I check. This is just unacceptable.  Very disappointing.

I work nearby to this place and we have ordered pizza from them for our meetings on multiple occasions. Hands down the best pizza I have ever eaten. If you live nearby, you have to try this place. I live 30 minutes away and I would go out of my way to eat their pizza!

I stumbled upon this gem one day and I'm glad I did! We ordered takeout and loved the Alfredo. I would definitely like to try other dishes at this restaurant. The interior appeared a bit small, but it wasn't too busy so that wouldn't be a big issue I don't think. The prices and portions are good too!

I don't get it. This place was EMPTY when I got here.  Nice people, but the burger wasn't very good.  That soft cheddar is weird, the burger lacked flavor, fries were of the frozen type.  I only visit St. Louis a couple times a year and I'm sure I could find a better burger.   

Cool place though.

Great options and you can get taste tes to make sure that you order what you like. They also have puppy vanilla cups for the dogs. Great to have a fun place that is dog friendly and clean. We have a great time stopping here on a hot summer day. We will be headed back for sure.

Got an oil change, state inspection/emissions and new windshield wipers. Great and friendly service. I would recommend. Only issue I had was the wait time. Said about 1.5 hours and was around 2.5 hours. Other than that, great job and I'll be back next year.

First time visiting but certainly will not be my last. Friendly staff with good prices. Two large 1 topping pies, order of fries, cheesesteak with FO's and a 2-liter came to $37. Pizza was about 8.2/10. Good Italian roll-meat had good flavor but could of been packed a little more. 

Overall it was a very promising first impression.

We came here for a team dinner last month and it was an absolutely amazing meal. Everyone at the table LOVED their meal. It's just unfortunate that they didn't have any vegetarian entrees at all. But, the server said the chef could make a vegetarian version of the pasta.

A 30 minute wait for a cold brew drink. I even ordered online!! I complained to the barista and he didn't apologize, just said, "Even the best have bad days." That's not an appropriate customer service response. There were 5-6 people working behind the counter, so it's not clear why things were moving so slowly.

Best dining experience ever.  The food not only tasted amazing, but it was creative and well presented. Service was exquisite.  My wife thoroughly enjoyed our meal.  Now this was probably the most expensive meal I have ever had; however, I would do it again in heartbeat.

I LOVEEE this place!! I've been going with my family for years. They have a great catering service - their meatballs & ceasar salad are awesome! I love eating-in too, it is a great atmosphere for a BYOB, always crowded, and endless pasta combinations for whatever mood you are in!
