My wife had a nail in her tire and I needed to quickly stop somewhere in order to have the tire plugged. 

The team at Monro had cars ahead of me  but they were very kind with squeezing me in. The work took less than an hour and was inexpensive. I would highly recommend Monro auto!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
We ordered food to go
It was ready promptly 
We got it home, it looked fine
My husband got the sushi I got the chicken teriyaki
My husband said the sushi was fine
The chicken teriyaki didn't have much flavor 
My son also tried the chicken and said it tasted funny
Crab wontons were good

Here is a brief but accurate review.  Chicken low mein was good, I'd give it 4 stars.  General tsos chicken was fair -  2 1\2, maybe 3 stars.  Boneless BBQ ribs - tasty sauce, ribs were overcooked - dry.  That's another 2 1\2 stars.  Egg rolls - blah!  2 stars.  Crab rangoons - BANGIN' 5 stars.

The quality of the ice cream is top notch. I got a single scoop of dark chocolate which was excellent. The fact that you can enjoy delicious ice cream while you play video games with your friends makes this place unbeatable. My favorite dessert shop on Main Street!

Horrible experiences and will never return.  Only reason I went there was because my brother was working there at the time and the manager wouldn't even let my own brother work on my car.  These people did a horrible brake job on my car.  Less than a year later the same brakes were cutting into the roaters.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Likes-
The live music. The drinks. The staff
Dislikes-
Crowd can be on the Douchebaggy side now and then.I try not to judge, and it might just be that I'm in my 40s and my paitience for young tomfoolery can sometimes be short. 
But overall......nice place to catch a fun band now and then.

I tried their creole cream cheese and it was just not that good. After two bites I went up to switch it because it was that bad to me and they said I had to pay for a new one. I ended up throwing it away... It's weird that they wouldn't want to make it right with an unhappy customer...

In light of the commercials that WF are running right now... today this particular branch provided excellent customer service to me and my family.
Mohammed provided superb customer service. He understood what we needed and executed the process in a timely manner.

Just went in for the first time. They have a wait list now which seems to address many of the earlier comments. Pat was very friendly and highly skilled. It was about an hour wait, but that was because it was full of customers, so I can't really fault them for being popular. Bargain for a haircut ($15) in a place with a cool vibe.

Pretty much a waste of money...ordered chicken and rice soup-it was 90% rice and the won ton strips were stale!!!!-couldn't even eat it! Then the crab Rangoon. I really love crab Rangoon and I've had it from many places but this was just bad. It tasted spoiled or something. Huge disappointment and waste of $30

Decent breakfast (I don't recommend their guacamole- it's the store bought lime green kind - they put it on top of the California omelette - FYI).   Women's restroom is often times in need of a cleaning, the toilet seat needs to replaced big crack on the side (looks unsanitary). Staff is always super nice.

This bank has the worse customer service ever! 45 minutes to deposit a check and we only had 2 cars in front of us!
The management officers in this place have no clue what they are doing. Hence, their workers are on their own and working slow and inefficiently. Changing to another bank, I can't stand them anymore!

I was a walk in and I had a new nail tech, she was not that great. She had to ask a lot of questions of the other nail techs. I do understand that new people need to be trained, but I am not the one for them to do their training on. So that is my reason for not caring so much for Galaxy Nail Bar.

Muggy restaurant, tables and bathrooms feel sticky and unclean, and the sushi just wasn't fresh. Even for the great value (I think it was 23.00 for all you can eat sushi and my husband ordered five rolls) we probably wouldn't return unless the food improves. :-(

Very fresh tuna today and their sushi is reasonably priced .. However my dragon roll had very very little unagi in it and no unagi sauce, and my rainbow roll was topped with mainly avocado rather than the assortment of fish rainbow rolls are supposed to have. I will still be going back but I will avoid those two rolls.

Another much deserving 5 star review. Fixed a pipe for me at 1/6 the cost of one mechanic's quote and 1/3 the cost of another mechanic's quote. And they did it on a Saturday in a couple hours. Amazing. Plus they are friendly and helpful even over the phone. Highly recommend for a low stress, zero hassle experience in car repairs.

Even after the overhaul, this place is still a dump.
Just now it's an overpriced dump with the worse bartenders, terrible staff and an owner/manager who has made it his lifelong goal to threaten me since i left him negative reviews. 
Overpriced beer, crappy food and a terrible terrible crowd.

Wow!  Maybe I should apply to be a server here.  
Thanks to the COVID all the decent workers are getting paid not to work.  Sure, friends enjoy this place for the drinks and food, BUT, maybe if it was self serve it'll be better.  Of course the server was fast in giving us the bill! LOL

Won't return due to unfriendly service and super stingy sandwich preparation. Definitely did not get our money's worth. Clearly, this location is not interested in customer service nor customer retention. There are so many better options for fresh subs and salads with better customer service in the Fishers area.

Very good coffee shop. Lots of seating, lots of light, and never super busy. The coffee is great, their food is very good and I like the price. Another great thing about this place is the staff. Very friendly, quick, solid service. I really like meeting friends for coffee there.

Check it out

The food is good--however--we ordered the Hibachi Lunch and the portions were so small you needed a microscope to see them!!

Make the portions bigger!!!!!

Had to go next door after lunch and get an ice cream sundae cause I was still hungry.

Portions are way too small!!!!

Optical department offers professional competent services.

I have bought several pairs of glasses from this place-no problems
at all-reasonable price.

No high pressure sales tactics as in other places where they tend
to try to upsell all services on the making of prescription eyewear.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
AVOID!

We ordered two sushi entrees----fish was OLD!

We tried to explain this to the person who worked there
we even asked her to sample some--she adamantly 
claimed it was the "freshest sushi".

Hardly!!!!!!!!!!!

Won't be back due to their attitude-old fish and lies.

Is this anyway to run a sushi business?

Glad to see this business doing so well. But you guys need to keep to your advertised schedule. 

Sign out front says open till 7pm... rode by at 6:35pm and you're closed while people are still vacuuming their vehicles. It's fine if you close at 6pm, just say so.

Located near Keystone at the Crossing. Popular location for conferences. Food served at event is some of the better food I've had through hotel catering. The decor could not use a little updating. Conveniently located to shopping and entertainment venues. If you're an independent movie fan very close to Keystone Arts Cinema.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Basic Chinese takeout place. Fried rice and lo mein lacked flavor. Sesame shrimp had runny sauce, needed to be thicker. Hawaiian chicken was lacking in veggies and chicken was tough. 

Looks to be family owned, young kids running around and helping. 

Not the best takeout option but if you are in a pinch it's not terrible.

So excited to be back at Pane E Vino.  We are getting take out as we just made it before 9pm closing on Sunday. 8 tables inside and it is cozy with fantastic food. We had the fettuccini in cream and spinach pasta with meat sauce.  We love their Italian dressing and the salads are good.

we will be back.

This is a great place to get sushi for lunch. Their lunch specials put it among the best bang for your buck sushi in the immediate area. The sushi isn't earth shattering but it's definitely good enough. They can get very busy at lunchtime so go early and call in your takeout orders!

The american heritage branch at 23rd and market has recently made the customers use the automatic machine. At 12.00 to 12.30. There are no tellers. Do not use tbis branch if you eant to pay a bill by check. I think thr customers should have a choice. Let me know what u think.

Just moved to the area and have been wanting ice cream the past few nights. Looked up some places and found "Bo's"! Went pretty late and pulled up to a line of about 6 cars. But they kept the line moving and we were out in no time! Kinda expensive for plain ice cream but they're open late and conveniently located, so it's worth it!

This place was an absolute mad house around noon. No customer access provided to rest rooms, dirty interior (such a shame since it's newer), a huge crowd waiting at the registers to both place and receive orders, and they gave me a chicken sandwich instead of the burger I ordered. I won't return to this location.

Not my type of food. The appetizer of meats and cheeses was fantastic. However they lost me when I ordered Alfredo and it was sweet like sugar, come to find out that is the norm by their chef. Disgusting. Didn't even eat half of it. Server was nice, drinks were good but the food is overrated.

I was really surprised with this business. I had ordered a special pizza and it turned out I didn't like it, and they gladly sent me another one and had the manager deliver it and ask me what was wrong with it so they can better themselves. I admire them for that.

Great place and donuts are amazing!!  Awesome variety so the kids always try something different.  Owner was super nice and even gave us a free donut when we left and came back because my little son ordered the wrong type and was sad.  Again, just a great place with service to match the quality of their product. Great!!!!!

This place has the best sushi around!! They also have selections which are not commonly found any where else. The staff is friendly and accommodating. Although the restaurant is small, they are VERY busy, so get there early or come with patience. Also, because they are busy, service might be slow, but well worth the wait.

I walked in at 10am without an appointment. Lee was there and happily said he could do a full set for me right then. He did such a beautiful job in a short amount of time. He is very friendly and made the experience wonderful. I will defiantly be going back for a fill and recommend him or anyone at Regal Nails to my friends.

They cleaned my car from the outside. I paid for inside and out... I had asked for every one of my belongings to be placed in the trunk. They threw away my adapter and only phone charger. 
Didn't clean the rear view mirror. They didn't wipe down the windows on the inside. 
Just one star fits.
They half-assed for what I paid for.

i've had the sushi and teriyaki chicken plates from here. very good sushi. the chicken comes with a decent amount of veggies which i love but others may not like. even if you don't still tons of chicken on plate. very good mizo soup and traditional salad as well.

The hotel is conveniently located, but today they gave me a room that smells so strongly of perfumed cleanser that I can actually taste it. When I called the front desk to see if all the rooms are like this, they transferred me to another extension that never picked up.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The manager called to address my review. I thought we were going to resolve the incorrect bill. But instead, I got a text photo of the check. I'm confused at this point. It was good they followed up, but they are still telling me we ordered food we didn't....

The pork tenderloin with caramelized onion risotto is TO. DIE. FOR. The shrimp carbonara was a little better than ok. The antipasto platter was also incredible and very sharable. I wasn't a huge fan of the tiramisu, but I think that was more about personal preference than anything. I'm fast becoming a regular.

Needed a quick lunch, so stopped in.  I had a mixed experience with customer service because the first person to take my order wasn't pleasant, and didn't make me feel welcome, however I needed to place a second order, and the second person was very welcoming.

Was hoping for better. Had the shrimp scampi and the shrimp was bland and over cooked. Ranch for the salad was watery. The bread and complimentary pasta salad were decent. Hubby had stuffed salmon which tasted better but still meh. Chocolate cake was dry. Needless to say I don't think we will be going back...

Very tasty, authentic Italian food for a reasonable price. Most entrees were between 15 to 20 dollars.  

We got the lasagna and manicotti and both were great. The stuffed mushrooms as an appetizer were underwhelming but that was the only bad part.  Authentic Italian feel and food and very good service! I'll be going back

Dive bar. Mostly filled with bikers when we walked in at 9pm friday.   Crowd thinned out a bit after about an hour and life was good.  

We grabbed a bite to eat it was a salad with cheese steak on top and it was delicious.  
Defiantly will go back for the good vibe and food.

We asked one of our waiters for suggestions in New Orleans. He said you need to start with a hand grenade in each hand. Um, one will be suffice. Trust me! They were good, don't get me wrong. But damn! Strong stuff that hits you hard.  They had a magnificent live band that plays a over the bar. Unique. We liked this place for sure.

You could spend a couple hours looking at everything in the store. They've got everything and everything is categorized. Prices are good and you'll find some unique things. I don't even drink alcoholic drinks often but you can easily find something to peak your interest.

It is so sad the food taste good but the service is horrible! Saturday night and we are the only people in the restaurant and we had to walk the check to the bar to pay.  Notice my tiny salsa bowl with chips.  Horrible service and I was very nice to the server.  Funny how you get a feeling from the mood when you walk in the door.

Great pizza. Great sandwiches. Great people. Every Friday night is Jim's night for pizza. It's the best in the area. Just a small place but mighty good food. Not much room to sit but take out so never a problem. Order early on Fridays they're always busy. Come hungry and leave with a few bucks left in your pocket.

Good food, love the garlic breadsticks and the pizza is good. Don't order there that often. One time, it took almost an hour after I ordered for them to come by. The food is ok and I get it once in a while. Coming in at lunch time is good cause you can get a slice and it's not bad at all.

I would give 5 but they always forget to give me "extra eel sauce" I ask for it on the side aaaaalllll the time.... But it's rarely delivered. Pay attention to the extra COMMENT BOX.... I love the sushi... Fast delivery... Pay attention! Paid 30$ today n all I ask for is EEL SAUCE ON THE SIDE....

This place has changed since Charlie sold it. I've been back 3 times and the sushi doesn't taste the same anymore. It's disappointing because the service used to be great, friendly, and now it just feels so cold inside and just unfriendly.... just some people working passing the time. 
It's sad but true... sushi isn't the same.

Used to come here for take-out all the time a few years back.

I went back today and everything has changed! The guys who used to work there don't anymore. The new guys who work there are nice, but the food sucks now. (Yes...even the garlic knots...). 

I probably will never come back again...

It's a liquor store, you know what you're going to get.  The product is what it is. Prices were average.  However, customer service lacked and  asking questions seemed to annoy the clerk.  I asked for grenadine, not only did they not have it, the clerk didn't even know what I was talking about.

One of my favorite spots in Tampa and it's open 24/7 I can go in at any time of day or night and get a huge breakfast for cheap I love the corn beef hash I've had the club sandwich and the spaghetti and always a great selection of pies and cakes it's a small spot but cranks our some good food

Sushi rice was off in regards to texture, it was almost slimy yet hard. Miso soup flavor was less than that of expected standard miso. Staff was friendly, which I honored the third star for. Doubt I will return as I didn't enjoy the food, I felt like I wasted my money.

So strange, but this place has the best vegetarian burrito! I come here at least once a week and grab one. My boyfriend likes to order a whole chicken and save whatever is leftover for his work lunches. Reasonably priced, friendly staff, and highly recommend the veggie burrito if your a vegetarian or just not in the mood for meat!

Wish I could review!
Sat here at a table 5 feet from the bar...
Watched everyone get their food

Never ever once got a waitress

Looked saw food
 BUT never once a waitress 

Got drinks from bar
No waitress

Update
Took two hours and my husband to track her down

El Patron left flyers under the hotel room door advertising FAST delivery.  We ordered a large pepperoni pizza and two Greek salads, and specifically asked for paper plates and napkins.

When the pizza FINALLY arrived 90 minutes, it was cold, the box was smashed, with no napkins, paper plates, or utensils to eat the salads!

A friend recommended Mrs. Duc.  I can't say enough good things about her.  The place is neat and clean.  She listens to you when you tell her that you are allergic to latex and have some medical issues.  If you don't like salons that use cheese graters on your feet, go and see Mrs. Duc.

I have trouble understanding why so many find this place so good. I went here and found the rolls to all be very Americanized with very little fish in them. I also order the salmon sashimi and if came out old looking and falling apart (maybe it was frozen multiple times?). I was not impressed.

I think the location of this place is better than the food, but still, I was not disappointed. It's basic Mexican fare and the ingredients are fresh. I would go here again just to sit out in the front and drink margaritas and eat chips and salsa on a warm summer evening.

It's a Starbucks in a really neat building! I love how Starbucks has re-claimed this space and made it usable again. The major downsides are that it's very busy and the drive through is incredibly slow. Major upside is that this building is a two-fer and you can get Chipotle next door.

I dislike Tower Grove Creamery's ice cream - I find it icy, bland, and unimaginative. I cannot argue with the location, however. It's an excellent spot to stop on a warm day for ice cream. I just wish it tasted better, or that the prices were more commensurate with the quality of the product.

Very authentic! The Sushi Rolls were top notch. Fish Katsu was delicious.  I felt like 
I was back in Tokyo. Complimentary plum ice cream is a nice touch. Get over your Americanized demand for fast service. The staff is as good as any place abroad. Learn to relax and enjoy the experience. Great Job!

Had a lovely meal here and great service from Paul (chef/owner) and the waitress. Interior needs a paint job, but it's obvious they aim to please and it was nice to see they have a good following of locals who see through the imperfections of the decor and support a long standing CH business owner.

PHENOMENAL! I am continuously amazed at the management and execution of this facility. Impeccably clean, friendly, social with the Starbucks on premises, tons of fresh food, expansive and open and I could just go in. As a previous manager, I can attest they are doing it right. Well done Fry's!!

We went here for lunch and have the turkey sandwich with cranberry and bean sprouts and a lovely curry soup. Although the sandwiches are a little pricey they are always filled full with a choice of many breads. The atmosphere is relaxed and casual and the staff is friendly.

I started a 6 week challenge here and have been pleased with the support from trainers on how to do moves as well as modifications. I've always felt welcomed as a newcomer and also have all the equipment you need to do your workout.  Nothing fancy but a great place to work out.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The coffee is very good. I like to come and get affogato for a delicious treat. It's bright and cheerful decor is nice, too. However! The service can be pretty surly. For example, we went at 8:30 and they were clearly irritated even though they're open until 9. I said hello and the barista said we close in about half an hour. Hm.

They have really done well to improve this location since it initially opened. The staff for the first 1-2 years was lacking customer service and kindness. In the last 6-8 months they have done a really great job at improving their timeliness and customer service, especially at the drive thru window!

So glad I finally got to try Charlie's sushi! Super fresh, delicious and reasonably priced. We got greeted and seated right away. Service was excellent and overall great experience. Got the veggie roll and the super crunchy roll that were both reallyyyy good!

I came in to buy tea as a new costumer and this lovely young man Jordan answered all my questions and sold me lots of stuff... I was so happy until this African lady started to talk bad to this young man In front of me and all the other costumers here! I'm very upset with this women's unprofessionalism:(

Walked in to buy a cashiers check and also wanted to open a bank account. But the tellers where so f. King rude they flat out told me to leave and get a cashiers check across the street. Wow seriously? Beyond nasty. I will never open an account for the way I was treated. Nasty Nasty...Evil Devil Bitches..

Went for dinner with my girlfriend.   Last time was good.   This time was awful.   I got chicken masala.   And it was still red, she got a burger.   Asked for it medium came out raw.  Told the server and she took the soup off.  But then added more cost into the drinks.   And never gave me the chicken back.

Dr. K is great and the whole staff at Mass Ave Animal Clinic gives our little puppy so much love! They also are so gracious​ in answering our many "1st-time​ puppy parents" questions. They always follow up and make sure our little guy is feeling good after something​ noteworthy​. Would highly recommend​!!

One of the worst McDonald's I have ever been to. We ordered all of our food then once we got to the window they told us they had no diet dr. Pepper after we had already ordered it. Then they tell us there drink machine wasn't working. We just drove off cause how do you eat and not have a drink along with it.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Nice hotel - location is perfect for walking to local spots downtown but there were several loud guests, dogs barking, and late night bands that played over the course of our stay. Not a dealbreaker but also not something that we enjoyed waking up to multiple times a night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: SS Cleaners did a great job on my coffee-stained white coat! It is free of stains and pressed very well. I dropped it off on Sunday and it was ready by Tuesday morning at 9 am, for $6.75. Their hours are very accommodating for someone with a long schedule. I will definitely be bringing future garments here!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Great hotel! Clean and affordable. Pet friendly. I read all the bad reviews and I'm actually shocked. The rooms are huge beds are comfy and water pressure is great! Only thig that sucks is theres never any parking and you have to pay $13 per day. Otherwise great hotel. Would most def come again and recommend.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I really like this location. The baristas are so nice and bubbly even when I'm half asleep and have no energy to talk lol. The line is sometimes wrapped around the building but it goes pretty fast, which I love. My drink is always made correctly and it's always a great experience. Thank you.

Sushi looked pretty darn fresh and tasted good too. The ramen is something I could make at home in 5 minutes, so don't waste your time on that. Not busy at all on week nights. Didn't have any wait or trouble getting a table. Places is huge and would work for larger groups.

Go to Chinese takeout place. Food is always good. Large portions, flavorful, cooked to order in minutes.  Not a sit down to dine place. They have tables, but its not that kind of place. This is a great local spot, not fancy in any way.  They could do better with cleaning. Appearance means everything in food industry.

I've tried Botto's numerous times hoping to like it. Unfortunately,  each time I have left unimpressed.  I kept saying the same thing every time I go and that is that the food is missing flavor. The sauce looks and tastes more like water rather than pasta sauce. I would only go back if there was no other Italian option in the area.

Finally decided to try this for lunch one day. Huge mistake! The beans were runny, the meat was super dry and tough and it tasted like it was cooked a week ago! The only saving grace was the chips and salsa. I dumped salsa on everything in order to stomach my lunch. Will not be returning.

I went to the drive through and it really took a very long time to get through it.  I had a burger, fries and mocha frappe.  It was typical McDonalds food.  The fries were crispy and the mocha frappe hit the spot in the heat of the day.  I wish they could speed up getting through the drive thru though.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: A nice deviation from the typical fast food burger joints. Flavorful burgers, eh fries(unless you kick em up with cheese sauce), and a castle shaped building. It's an experience ya gotta have. You can't beat the comforting gush of a couple tiny burgers to satisfy your cravings.

Lowering just a tad because the trash situation is ridiculous. To see trash bags pilled sky high was ridiculous and embarrassing when having friends over. Makes it look like u live in a dump. Overall my experience is a positive one but the trash situation needs to improve.

Lowering just a tad because the trash situation is ridiculous. To see trash bags pilled sky high was ridiculous and embarrassing when having friends over. Makes it look like u live in a dump. Overall my experience is a positive one but the trash situation needs to improve.

Had our Christmas Eve dinner tonight here. Three course meal. I had a the monk fish which was delicious and fresh. Most of my family had beef which was cooked and seasoned well. Wonderful staff and a great experience overall. Very pricey although! Definitely a place for special occasions only

Love the concept of quick pasta with optional added protein but tonight was a bit of a fail in that our pasta bowls (mine pesto; his carbonara) were lukewarm. Mine did not have the promised sun dried tomatoes, which it needed. Beverage choices are really good here. 
Overall experience was still good.

I go here because it is the only place in IND on private pass. $25 bucks of beer before a flight isn't bad. The private pass menu is limited set of apps, rather would avoid the heartburn before a long flight. Bar tenders are always friendly and courteous and aware of the private pass.

Store is bright and clean.
Used Pharmacy the other week. Didn't have enough to fill my prescription. Went back when they said it would be ready. Unfortunately it wasn't. But the pharmacist went out of his way and dropped it off at my house since he lived near by. Amazing service.

Chicken pasta carbonara is a very fresh dish. Setup like a fast casual restaurant (chipotle style) fairly fast and still tasty. Seems as though the menu is pretty limited. Make sure you grab a few peppermints because the garlic will wreak havoc on your breath.

The cleanest looking Burger King I've ever seen. I didn't get a peek at the kitchen but the customer dining area looked pretty spotless.

Except they gave me a small Whopper Jr. instead of the medium that I ordered. They must have known that I was breaking my New Years resolution already.

Every time I try a new sushi place, I either say they have the best sushi I've ever had or they don't. This place has righteously owned its spot on the "BEST SUSHI" list! I had the PoBoy and Unforgettable rolls. When I tell y'all.... THEY WERE SOOOO DAMN DELICIOUS!! Even the presentation of the rolls were dope!

I should have listened to the other guy who did a review since they reopened.  Not worth your money. Its nothing like the old pizza shack, the only thing they kept was the boxes. The sauce is completely different, as is the crust and cheese. Curiosity killed the cat but it only stole 18$ from me with this awful pie

I came here with a group of colleagues for lunch. The staff is friendly, service is fast, and the food is good. I had their Vegas roll and it was delicious! Very reasonably priced, and awesome options available for lunch. The only con for me was that they don't serve a fried California tempura roll,  but I'm a picky eater.

Dancing vampire and rolling fire were two of our favorites! Prices are reasonable. I would say the one downside of our experience was that we asked our server for vegetarian recommendations and he read us the menu ... literally pick up a menu and read it to us.

Not a sit down restaurant, but really good comfort food. Took a while to get our food, and it was on the pricey side, but it was worth it in the end! I got the duck, but all my friends raved about the veggie meatballs and spaghetti squash. I would go back for sure!

With a COVID 19 emergency going on in Tampa, why is my family the only guests wearing a mask? Since we arrived , not one person in the lobby or in the elevator has worn a mask! Even with noticed by the elevators!  When I called the front desk, I was told that the hotel doesn't have masks and they can't do anything about it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The food is okay.  The service was not friendly.  The people behind the sushi bar were pounding something loudly through half of our meal.  We asked them to stop, and they continued.  The seats are very hard.  We thought we had found a good place to go, but, because of the issues, we will not be returning.

Have no idea why they charge $25 for a haircut when they don't even shampoo! They serve you beer, which is a good and actually most salons do provide refreshments these days but the only reason people come here is to get a haircut. They neither do a good job and nor is the service worth the price.

I went here a couple of days ago for my friends birthday and the place was very nice! Unfortunately the menu selection was limited and their cocktails weren't that great. The service was okay. But when I go to a restaurant I go there to eat and I won't be coming back! However, the food was good. I just require a bigger menu haha.

Beef & broccoli - The meat was very tender & the flavor of the sauce is not overly seasoned... The Beef with snow pea & onions is also a similar tasting dish but I enjoy snow peas better.

Thai Tea is consistant & service is good.

This is my second time here, more updates to come.

A convenient location along So Virginia in the Winners Crossing in the Chevron. I'm always able to find something I like. A dozen flavors to choose from with plenty of toppings to boot. Today I had Kona coffee with a swirl of chocolate and vanilla custard.

Thai location always has a line. That's probably my main issue. Standard Wendy's fare and always solid in preparation. I have had a mix up in pick up but I have had that every fast food location. 

This location is surrounded by new developments so there may be more competition in the future.

This place was filthy. I ordered and went to the bathroom and it was filthy too. Trash was over flowing onto the floor in every trash can. The drink area was soaking wet from melted ice. Just gross. The ONLY reason I gave them 2 stars was because the cashier was nice. My cheeseburger is cold and hard. Waste of time.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Stopped in during a quiet time (daytime lol) for a quick beer. Cash only but they have an ATM right inside by the gaming stations. Friendly bartender and seemed to be a couple of locals stopping in too. Also, by the door there was a couple of crockpots of free food. That day, it was bean chili and rice!

This was our first time ever at Toscana 52 and it was a wonderful experience. The food here was delicious and filling and exceeded all expectations. Our server DAVE was so welcoming and made us laugh the whole time. Dave made our experience at Toscana one to remember. We will definitely be back!

I won't give them another dime!  I've been a regular customer for over 5 years.  The team doesn't seem to care about their customers....made a huge mess of my order and they just shrug their shoulders and turn away....I'm voting "NO!" with my wallet....I'll go somewhere else...adios!

Very good service but the place was empty. It was a weekend. If they advertised more then more customers would come. It is a clean store and cute photo opportunity inside. Looks like old fashioned ice cream store. Ice cream was very good. We bought a gallon to take home.

This Starbucks is really convenient for hospital employees and health sciences students. However, it's not open on the weekends and the employees have no sense of urgency. If you are in a rush, do not go to this Starbucks. It takes entirely too long to get your coffee.

If I could give less than one star I would. You pick up a car. It is scratched. No one to check it out. You switch cars after 1/2 hour and the next one is worse. And they mess up your paperwork. They make you late to leave. Then if you need to extend your information is lost. Do yourself a favor budget. Fire Cindy. Start over.

This is the BEST ice cream of anywhere I've ever been. Tampa's gem for sure. 

I recommend the peanut butter shakes, hot fudge sundaes, and my personal favorite: chocolate cone dipped in whatever (cherry is niiiiiiice.) 

Lots of bees and colorful characters, but a must-visit if you're in the area. MUST.

I have never eaten anything here that wasn't drop-your-pants-amazing. My absolute favorite is the crispy duck with cherry sauce and goat cheese mashed potatoes with fennel. The atmosphere is great too, although a bit loud. This is one of my favorite Ybor City dining spots.

Husbands chicken sandwich was not so good. 

My gnocchi bolognese: first time having gnocchi so not sure, but the sauce was fantastic.

When they ask you if you want bread, dont bother, it was super plain white bread. Like what you'd buy in the grocery store.

Love this sushi bar. The sushi is prepared fresh. The presentation is beautiful. The tables are fun and they even have private rooms. They have daily drink specials and 1/2 off specific sushi on Mondays. Their appetitizers and main courses are perfect too.

I don't know what's worse-- the service or the patrons. It's a shame because the beer list is good. We left because the bartender was too busy answering prank phone calls from patrons sitting at the bar to take our order. There's significantly better options in town for a good beer and good company.

A nice Mexican food place with plenty of options. The burritos and tortas are well packed with meat. Interior is nice and clean. Staff is friendly. Prices are about average. There's really nothing "wow" about this place, but it's located in a good area and they offer good food. I'll be coming back.

Good location within walking distance of most attractions downtown. Stayed in a guest king Room was nice and clean had a view of the arch. Powerpoints could be placed in easier areas for access and have two bed side tables would be better. Bathroom was nice and shower very big.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: They are becoming my go to cleaner, for every day items and bigger stuff too. I had my wedding dress steamed last year and my bridesmaid's dress for another wedding altered here. They were friendly and extremely quick with both specialty tasks. This was especially important I only had a week before the alterations were needed.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: The food is awesome here.  I love the cecina tacos, made with marinated beef- so flavorful and delicious!  Also, the chips are super tasty and come with 2 delicious salsas.  I'm a big fan of the green one- lots of tangy yumminess.  Great spot for authentic Mexican food!

I found this place because my normal drop by spot has not figured out how to adequately operate under covid restrictions. China King answered the phone quickly and my food was ready in minutes. The taste was pretty good. Not saturated in soy sauce or greasy. I just may have found my new takeout Chinese restaurant.

It's very convenient to know that I could get my favorite coffee drink in the middle of the mall while shopping. The barista here is always ready to listen to your order and every time I've been here they get my order correct. They also make your order fast so the wait is not long at all. Who doesn't love Starbucks!?

It's one of these places that you'd eat at instead on Macdonald , not great not too bad either, there delivery semi suck , but aw well , the greatest thing about this place is that there open really late , there thin crust pizza and broccoli chicken pasta are the bess thing

Not cheaper, faster or better.
My main complaint is the grinding as I was driving away, and one of the guys said that was normal for when you replaced the rotors and pads. Fortunately another guy knew that wasn't true, so he checked it out and fixed it.Price wa swhat you'd expect ajnywhere elose: 4 rotors and all pads, $800.

This place just opened and took over the space of an other pizza place.   The former pizza place was average at best and actually quite disappointing.  I thought pegasus pizza was tasty.   I love Detroit style thick crust so I may be partial to it but I'll be trying it again soon.  I only issue was I wanted more pizza.

This Starbucks is so slow. I used the mobile
App to save time and my drink was not ready. When I requested my drink from the Barista I was told she she was catching up on orders for people who were already in store getting refills. The only reason I gave 2 stars is for the large sitting area in the back.

ATM Never Works. Friendly staff though. They will work with you to get you a loan approval. Not a lot of technology though no mobile check deposit, Apple Pay, or Touch ID. But they make up with personalized service. You get the basics of banking, and very liberal with loan requirements

I love coming to the Starbucks. The staff is always so friendly, drinks are made quickly and never really a long line for mobile orders. With the pandemic and every thing going on in the world, the little things make a difference. "We Love You" written on a cup just brightened my day!

Pretty good, very pricey. Service was above average. The food was good but not worth the price. We shared a lot of food and that seems like the way to go. The sushi was good and we got multiple roles. The fried shrimp was awesome and my steak was very good as well.

Great new restaurant serving Mexican food.  Come try their food and experience a slightly different service..order, paid and pick up number then food is brought out to your table.  While waiting, which is not long, you can munch on chips and salsa.  Service is friendly and food is delicious.

I was skeptical about this place. The pictures to me didn't interest me much, so I asked a co worker and he said it was his every Friday meal
So I gave it a try -WORTH IT, it was delicious ! And the Thai Tea was extraordinary! This place will have a special weekday!

Color me impressed, this was my first time back since they reopened. The pizza was outstanding,  crust was perfect and cooked to perfection. The waitress was just okay. The inside looks really nice the fact they use paper plates takes away from the "dining experience". 

All in all 4 out of 5. Better service 5 out of 5.

My friends & I stopped by Landmark last night for an after dinner drink.  I won't be back.  The bar was virtually deserted at 9 pm on a Saturday night.  Though we were warmly greeted by a bartender, he didn't come back after the first round was served.  Not a fun atmosphere.  Basically a sports bar with no personality.

Maybe it was just the perfect night, but we loved it. The menu is small, but everything sounded delicious. We sat outside, tucked away behind some trees with no one else around. The wait staff was very nice and attentive and we felt no rush between courses. The food was on point!

I wanted to make masala chai tea at home. Went to this grocery and a nice lady there showed me what to buy and told me how to make it. Very helpful. This place is great , looks small from outside once you get in it's huge. A complete grocer with produce section everything is fresh and affordable. Run don't walk to this place

Super cute little local establishment!  The employees are really nice and the ice cream will definitely have you wanting to come back for more!  They offer samples on request and have 48 different handmade flavors to choose from.  Be sure to check this place out... you won't regret it!

The worst gym I've ever been to. I just cancelled my membership because of drew smith. Horrible manager. Rules change when he's there. When he's not there. Gym runs smooth! Huge turn over of the staff which shows how poor the management is. I'm heading up the road to planet  fitness.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The sushi was terrible. I am a huge sushi lover and found the sushi disgusting. They also wanted to charge me for ginger. Their price is $20 for lunch not $14.95. They also had only one serve for the entire Restraunt. Don't waste your money here. Go somewhere else have a proper descent quality sushi.

This is a unique donut shop in theory (unusual, fun toppings) but the toppings don't stay fresh overnight and taste bad if you try to save them. It's a novelty for sure and the kids love the options. This is the ultimate in junk food but when you're going off the wagon you might as well go big!

Big fan of the coffee.  The donuts themselves are average at best.  But the 2 stars here is for the service.  I've had a couple bad experiences this week.  To include absolutely messing up an easy order when it was not busy.  And on another occasion it took thirteen minutes to go through the drive thru (from order to window).

The sushi was bad. Bad, dirty aftertaste. Rice wasn't even seasoned at all, just bland, sticky, crap. Even the wasabi was poorly mixed and chalky. The atmosphere was depressing, dirty, and sticky. I don't leave many reviews but this was absolutely atrocious.

If I could give them less stars I would. They have horrible staff, very rude and not helpful. The actual doctor was extremely impatient and also rude. The girls at the front desk don't seem to have been trained. NEVER GOING BACK. 
Really great and affordable places in Bellevue.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Cons: handicap room with bed as hard as the floor, only one trash can in whole room, clock set wrong, indifferent staff( busy with paperwork when I checked out - no thank you to be heard), very small eating area (limited seating).  Pros.  Close to other nicer hotels, try the holiday inn express across the street.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This adorable courtyard hotel was the perfect setting for our 25th wedding anniversary trip. The property itself is quiet, secluded and private. The staff are flawlessly professional, thoughtful, discreet and unobtrusive. The rooms are sumptuous and classic. The views unforgettable. The biscuits and coffee are divine.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I can not believe I tried this place again.
Had no choice as total gridlock made it impossible to go anywhere else.

Same problems as before...

Terrible waitress service. Just didn't have a clue.

Food tasted all the same.

Horrible experience. Didn't get any better. Never again. I must be a gluten for punishment.

Papa Vito's has great pizza.  This isn't their first rodeo.  There is another and far superior location in Belleville- go to the downtown venue.  The West location has the same food but it's not the same.  This one has no character and it's cramped.  Go downtown, huge old building, bar and sometimes music.

This is one of my favorite lunch spots in the city. For a sit down restaurant, the service is quick and efficient. They offer really great lunch deals, such as soup or salad with 2-3 rolls for less than $15. The sushi is fresh and delicious. Great spot for a work day lunch with a group of coworkers or meeting up with friends.

Some of my favorite sushi in Center City! Situated right off of Rittenhouse Square, Zama always has a cool and bustling atmosphere, amazing sushi specials, and great wine. It's pretty easy to get a reservation, which is hard to say about most places. They also have a great lunch specials on the weekdays. Zama is one of my go-to's!

I was here a few days ago, I am a foodie and as such look for very unique dishes, but on this outing I was tired from Christmas shopping and to my surprise the level of service was to notch. The seafood manicotti was so flavorful along with fried calimari....this will become my go to spot a quick dinner, great job

This is a really nice place!! The food was really good. Started with a Mexican pizza flatbread! Delicious!! Then had fish tacos and a side of the cauliflower. The person I was with had steak enchiladas. They were good. Mine was better. 

The bartender made my margarita to perfection!! Desert of ok. Dinner was better!!

Food really good, but would like to see them add waiter service.  There are plenty of fast  food mexican places in Delco, but not enough nice Mexican restaurants, which this place could be based on the food quality.  Like that they liquor and beer as well...

I came here for lunch and the place is off a busy street but horrible parking.  Luckily it was a late lunch so I found a spot, otherwise I could see it being a nightmare.  The food was average, service was good.  There's nothing bad or great to say about this restaurant.  I will most likely not return.

Wow - this is a really good New Mexican takeout place that I must say is better the small local chain nearby I have grown to love. I had the Capechanos tacos  based on a friends recommendation and they were excellent - the pic says it all - I'll be back for more

Very professional! My AC was not working and I had an estimate done by another mechanic and he wanted to replace the whole system. Took my car to Dale's and they quoted far far less. Replaced the compressor and my AC is working wonderfully! Very fair priced and did an amazing job!

The place is real simple. No frills. They don't serve any alcohol beverage. 
The food portion is good. You get a lot for whay you pay. However, the service is slow &  sometimes your main course might come sooner than starters. 
But, best crispy calamari I ever had!

Every single time I've gone into this location the women working are snippy & rude. Tonight I just walked to the door at 6:32 pm & the door was locked & the woman behind the counter looked at me & waved me away. Google lists this location to close at 10pm and it's 6:32. Also their telephone number is not a working number ‍

Absolutely love this place!  Staff is friendly and attentive, and the food is the best I've had in Reno.  I can't recommend the Four Legged roll enough!  I've been to a number of different places and was happy to discover this little gem just down the street from my house.

I love this place. I had a terrible experience at the Sahm's Tavern downtown, so I wanted to make clear: I consistently get great food and at least good service here at Sahm's Place. We have a good time and feel like we get our money's worth. It's our go-to place.

No need to be clever or do anything than lay it out simple here: Best Pizza for many, many miles -only Lorenzo's on South street in Philly is better.  We struggle with ourselves 1) not to order it all the time and 2) not to split any XL pizza between 2 of us in one sitting.

Cool little dive bar that was recommended to us by some locals in the area. Bartenders were friendly and we were able to get three dollar kettle one drinks on a Saturday night. They allow dogs and smoking which made the play seem a little congested, but this is my type of dive bar. I would definitely go back.

Loved this hotel! We stayed here for a friend's wedding for 1 night in March. The hotel has a very resort-like modern feel. The temper-pedic bed and pillows were AMAZING and the lighting was fun and dimmed usefully. They had tablets in each room for room service, checkout, weather info, and more. I would definitely stay here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Delicious food.  Way better pizza than the previous owners.  We had the white lightening and a Cesar salad.  Both were very tasty.  Not much seating but the place is open and airy and has a nice patio.  Overall very nice and we will come back again.  Service was great!

I recently moved to Pelican Bay. It took me a while to move out of my moms house because I couldn't find anywhere I thought was safe enough. I like that there is a gate so not just anyone can come on to the property. Also, there is a lot of storage in the apartments. I highly recommend this 1st lake complex.

My daughter and I just opened and transferred all our accounts here. Their rates were better than other credit unions, and we like the perks. Very smooth transactions and nicely organized online banking. Bryan was very helpful, friendly, professional and knowledgeable! Highly recommend!

You need to update your hours. Not only does it claim you are open on yelp and on google maps but your hours are painted on your fucking door! Yet for some reason when I drove out to your place to get a haircut, there was no one inside at all! I tried to call and leave a voicemail but the mail box was full (How convenient)

Local neighborhood bar. Nothing to complain about.  Nothing to brag about. Good vibes, people & music, and cheap drinks!  A pool table and food (cash only) is available. The parking lot is small, but parking is available across the street. Be careful crossing the Whitehorse Pike!

The only place in the area we've found a good Baja fish taco! The staff are personable and very welcoming. Salsa is homemade and super fresh. ! Great tacos and burritos and margs! Bring your appetite 

I like to judge Mexican places by their flan- and this place is 100% recommended

The people at the front desk are outrageous! The hotel is dirty and the people are rude. There are stray dogs running about and I was told there is a pool but of course it's not in use.... Needless to say I will not be back ever again. Hope you don't make the same mistake I did.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I would give them 0 stars if I could.

I tried to pick up my rental car 20 minutes early, and they wanted to charge me an extra $91. ARE YOU KIDDING ME?! What kind of operation is this?!?! That's more than I'm paying for almost 3 days of my rental. Seriously shady business practices. DO NOT RENT FROM HERE.

Yum!!! I love the decor & the service. It is extremely clean & the staff are on point. (I will say the night staff are a lot more pleasant than the morning staff) Cajun shrimp Mac n cheese was huge! Super flavorful & delicious. There is a nice variety of foods which was great. I would definitely recommend to anyone in the area.

We tried the plan pizza and a custom one. There are many options to choose. You order on an iPad. There are New Hopkins fountain sodas as well as Snapple in bottles. The food was delicious with good proportions of toppings and crust. The people who work there were very friendly and helpful. Looking forward to returning soon.

Placed 3 orders to go of shrimp and tempura and instead just gave us vegetables and charged us full price called to tell them they messed up our order the head lady there said we don't have it on the menu but clearly it's posted everywhere but the head manager that's been there for years tell us that it's not.

A spikey experience.  Rooms and infrastructure are well kept and have a funky decor.  Good location.  Service is a bit indifferent, especially the lobby staff and bar.  With all the hotels in the area, I am not sure I would pick this one again, but not a terrible choice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Able to be seated despite no reservation on their very first night. Staff were very attentive. Food was very good. We tried the tomato and corn salad, Brussel sprouts and meatballs. Each had one drink and the bill quickly grew to 100 dollars for two. Very nice space but also very noisy. I think we'll go back.

The peach and tomato salad was excellent. The Caesar salad was good. The burger was overcooked. The spinach pizza was excellent. The olive oil cake was divine. Coffee was not hot. Somehow we spent 140 dollars . Kind of a lot for a burger and pizza, 2 apps and 4 drinks and one desert. The outside seating was very nice. Felt safe.

A-OK, good service, kinda cramped dinning area.
Generous with the chips and salsa.

The food was standard, maybe I'll go back and try other items, but I wasn't impressed.

Can I have some booze in my margarita? 
This is very good mango juice, but did I not show you my ID?

I love this place!! The tacos, the gazpacho, the plantains and the Mexican Street corn are out of this world!! I've heard the margaritas are really good too but haven't had them. I always get the Mexican Street corn off the Cobb so it's easier to eat! I also really like their rice bowls with sesame rib eye slices in there.

Pretty good food, lightnikng fast delievery.
Nice prices cant go wrong with lunch or combination platters
Dumplings are great, so are cheese wontons,and egg rolls

always get something extra spend $10 get an egg roll, Spend $20 get Wonton soup, and theres more just not sure usaullly dont break to $30 mark

Had our checkbook stolen and went to the bank to resolve and close account

They were unable to help so we sat on speakerphone with their onsite representative for 30 minutes in order to talk to one of their call center agents

How is that efficient and customer service oriented?

I just got the best hair cut I've ever gotten. I usually leave a heart salon feeling awkward and disappointed. Jasmine rocked it. I felt I could tell her what I wanted and even as we went what I did and didn't like. I got an appointment easily. Love it love it.

You cannot beat lunch for $9.95.  The portions are great because you get to try a lot of options for a great price.  It's also not TOO much food if you order within reason.  Our server was nice and professional and helpful for deciding what to order.  Go at the early side of lunch if you can help it - it's definitely busy!

Stopped in just before midnight to get some food, was very leery at the fact I may be in the drive thru line a long time, but actually it didn't take that long at all. In fact I ordered a couple Egg McMuffins, they told me it would be 2 minutes for fresh eggs I said no problem. This visit was actually very nice.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: If I could give The Eye Bar more then 5 stars I would! Stacy and Jared are so helpful. I've been wearing glasses for years and the ones they helped me pick are by far my favorite. Also to their credit my husband (who has never worn glasses) enjoyed the experience. We highly recommend the Eye Bar.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: It's just sort of your basic car wash. I can't say that  the automatic bay did a very good job of cleaning the back of my car. It also didn't really dry my car that way we should have. A little pricey, but it got the job (mostly done). I can't say that I'll go out of my way to come back.

Sushi tasted fresh & was delicious. Prices were very reasonable- $40 for 2 special rolls, 2 glasses of wine & a generous tip. The atmosphere was calming- lights were dim & there was a blue hue throughout. Service was a bit slow, but everything else about the experience definitely made up for that.

Very friendly on the phone. Not so much when I went in. There were 4 people working the day I was there and I just felt like they were indifferent. I was treated quickly and efficiently for my eye exam. Note to staff...everyone needs to smile and make the customer feel warm and welcome.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I think they're going out of business! This location just keeps running out of items. From louraine cheese to frozen earth burritos and certain almond milks there's never restocked items. Stopped coming here and now i make a longer trip to a much better one.

Never had an issue when I went there. Service was fast and workers were nice. Besides all the mutants that hang out there all day it's a decent place. The employees could pay attention better when taking orders. Ask for light ice? Make sure you tell them again. They will forget.

Fast and friendly service. Only had one issue but they fixed it right away. Wish Dunkin in general put more product in their donuts. Two bites and no filling. But thats a corporate issue. Just typing to kill space. I like turtles. One time i had a bagel and it was good. No seriously good.

Great place. Food choices were very interesting and I had a difficult time choosing. All four of us loved our food which was excellent. We especially loved the homemade pasta. The service was very good and the only downside was the noise level was a little excessive. We will return often.

Great take out & curbside service during COVID-19
Superior food packaging. Thank you for being open on Easter!  We ordered an Easter dinner with appetizers, Beef Wellington, Scalloped Potatoes, Salad, & Dessert.
Exquisite! Food was as tasty as our dine in experiences have been. Appreciate this locally owned gem!

This place used to be great.  Then the owner got greedy and stopped selling food to force people to buy from his other restaurant .75 miles down the street.

He also apparently got greedy with the alcohol distributors because he is not able to serve a large variety of liquor brands -- my guess is he pissed off a distributor.

Never been to this place and I thought I would check out the finger steaks. 
There were lots of them but not really finger steaks in my opinion. They were finger nuggets. The batter on the steaks was dry and burnt in some places. The meat was somewhat juicy even though the outside was crispy and not tender at all. 
I won't be back.

First time here. Was at a store near by and read bout this place on yelp. Wow! This place was amazing! The service was excellent and the food tasted great! I got steak tacos and steak nachos and they didn't skimp on the meat. I will definitely recommend this place AND eat here again!!

I would like to see more gel colors offered in their repertoire, but other than that; they are AWESOME!  Don, in particular, has this hilarious sense of humor.  I haven't used their services lately due to my economic situation, but once I get back on my feet; they can rest assured that I will be back.

I am happy to say the owners at La Vita have corrected the issues that I had previously mentioned.  The new associate manager Willie is on top of things and the quality is as good if not better than before. Nice to see that the owners care about the opinions of thier customers and took corrective action.

I had an absolutely wonderful experience at this location. Keeping in mind that it is still Little Caeser's pizza. It was cooked perfectly.  I stopped in on Friday 8/17 for the hot and ready now deal. The front workers were lovely and personable.  Quick, easy and house party hit. Thank you.

This is by far one of the worst MCD I have ever been too. Service ranges from bad to horrible. They can't figure out how to make a cheeseburger. Let's keep the mustard off of the top of the bun. Let's line up the buns and meat and cheese into orderly fashion. The one star is because apparently yelp insists I give at least one.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Glad to have found this location. The stylists here are independent contractors so they are all running their own business, this good service from everyone. 

There are ranges of experience and price levels for service, so depends on your comfort level

I see Kim every time, and she has always been great

A solid Meh. I can think of 4 or 5 other sushi places in Reno that, instead of leaving you disappointed, leave you over the top happy. Rolls fell apart, tempura shrimp was rock hard, every roll tasted the same, limited items you can order for lunch, mussels came out of the shell and were dry and hard etc.

Note that the hours open for the Ladue location are incorrect on Google search.  Call for correct times.  I say it was closed on Tuesday and Wednesday - only to call them and find out they were open.  Not sure whose mistake this is, but you should call for the correct info.  Service can be a bit spotty but the food is great.

Clean and nice, reasonable priced, friendly staffs. Closing time used to be wrong on Yelp but Yelp finally corrected it after a year. There's a coin exchange machine, detergent and softener and dryer sheet dispenser, mini bar, slot machines, folding service, drop off service.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Lately the gym as been super hot and smells bad. I had to gave up on working out 1/3 way through because I felt sick and irritated by the hot temperature and the bad smell of the gym. I really hope they gonna improve this cuz I loved this gym as u can see from my previous review on this gym.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Stopped here for the night to use some points. The staff was rude except for the team serving breakfast. The rooms were okay, need some maintenance.  The beds and pillows were very comfortable, but with people running the hallways at 4am it was hard to sleep since the walls are thin and you hear everything.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Enzo's is stepping up their game ‼ they are serving quality pizza as always. I'm a huge fan of their cheesesteak  very hard to find a good place within the bucks area with good ones  but their cheese steak is fantastic. their chkn parm dinner is so good I'd say it feeds 2 people... for the price it's rite

This place was great. A bit pricey in my opinion but I don't live in the city so it could be fine. The sushi was awesome and the service was on point and quick. Nice atmosphere for hanging out with friends. I had a quick dinner with my daughter before she headed back to the college campus. She loved it.

Absolutely fantastic dinner this evening at plum tomato. I had the parmesan garlic wings and the house special pizza. I would have uploaded pictures, but we dug in so quickly, there's wasn't a moment to take a quick picture. Service was fast and very polite. Overall wonderful.

Super cool vibe. We came casual off a long drive. Excellent service! The food was super yummy! Must try the brussel sprouts! They are so sweet and delish. We also got the gnocchi and scallops. We would definitely recommend this place to visitors and locals!

Have to say their management is on top of this. As I mentioned, Petrini's was our favorite pizza in SB until two in a row bad experiences. The manager contacted me almost immediately and wanted to correct the situation. So cheers to that! Makes us want to go back.

Went in on a Wednesday night and they had an awesome MC! The place had a huge diverse crowd, young/old, black/white and everyone was just plain enjoying themselves! It is a little dirty, but not too many bars on Bourbon are clean!! Best 'dance' bar we went to hands down, we'll definitely be back on our next trip to Nola!

This won't be popular, but I found the menu frumpy, too weird and pricey. The atmosphere is bohemian frat house with wooden school chairs to sit in. I like Seminole Heights and the gentrification happening there, but I would skip this over rated restaurant.

Been coming here for a while now, maybe a year or two. Service is always awesome, never disappoints! Would absolutely recommend!

Miles ahead of barber shops I used to go too. Not just the atmosphere but quality as well. Staff is always friendly and I have a good time just being there.

Good selection of asian grocery stuff and fair price. Joy is so pleasant to talk to and will help you find  what you want. Her vegetables are so fresh. A great plus is you can buy your lottery ticket here as well.
I love to come Saturdays to pick up Roast duck and sweet tofu here. Fresh and cheaper anywhere else.

Places always looks like it is always Christmas inside. But actually not so much at all inside. 
Nice selection of Italian food. Probably the best south of Newtown in Bucks county has to offer.  
A little on the pricy side especially if ordering drinks or wines.

The front desk staff were super friendly and helpful, the shuttle driver rocked--he was very efficient and concerned about getting everyone to the airport on time. I want to come back to Philly just to hang out at this hotel! The room was huge & super nice (very clean). Great job creating a whole experience Aloft!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Very good sushi. Yaki Udon Noodles with shrimp...about same as fastfood quality and way too salty...no subtle flavors. West Pine Roll was good. Bento Box with grilled shrimp was pretty average and too salty. Sticking with the fresh sushi, going forward.  BTW...the salads all had rotted lettuce. Ugh.

This place makes me want to eat popsicles morning, noon, and night. So many amazing flavors and unique combinations if you are feeling a little adventurous. 

I will say...steer clear from the corn popsicle. It's not as delightful as you may think. Other than that, get here and start your obsession.

Overall, a good place for a meal. This was my first time here and It was good, but didn't blow me away. The Chicken Parm was good, and the creme brulee desert was good as well, but nothing was out of this world/have to come back for. Very nice atmosphere, great look to the place!

Overall, a solid meal. Nothing was bad and I have no negatives, but here is room for improvement. The chicken parm was good, but I've had better; calamari also good, but not the best I've ever had. Price was on point for center city, but would have liked the food to be just a touch better.

Came here during restaurant week and was very impressed! The Caesar salad is delish! Mussels are great! Chicken parm was superb and tiramisu was amazing! Wish there was a bit more room between the tables, but other than that, love the atmosphere and the very attentive waitstaff. Will definitely be back!

THE BEST ice cream and water ice ever. A staple in Levittown for more than 60 years, if you want great treats, with an old-timey feel, Dairy Delite is the place to go. They have SO many options, and are always adding new things! Their water ice is also amazing. I never go to Rita's when I can have Dairly Delite instead!

Worst drive through in the city. Staff sometimes forgets there are two lanes and you end up sitting as the cars in the other lane move past you. Rude and never helpful. Always understaffed. Found a piece of plastic in my sandwich once and they treated me like I was trying to scam them.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I am stuffed! I bought off the "little" menu and it is more than enough. There is plenty of toppings to choose from and you can make a great loaded burger. It is a bit more than say McDonalds but worth it. The service was fast and friendly. I am not on this gourmet burger trend but if they are all like this I might be....

I went here a few days ago ignoring the warnings from my coworkers that this place had bad sushi. But I went and was disappointed. They have the saltiest rice and the sushi seems like processed fish. I feel like they just get some frozen fish and grind it up and make the sushi.

This place use to be good. But now they upped the prices on all their maki dishes. The only reason this place was good was the price. Otherwise the sushi isn't all that great. Although it is the best sushi in downtown st louis. Don't plan to go and spend less than 20 bucks after tip.

I come here a lot, probably more than I would like to admit. It's just really tasty and convenient.  I would recommend the double double with onions. 

I wish in n out would spread more, especially to Colorado. It's probably my favorite fast food burger place.

Half the time their equipment is broken or they clearly do not add enough food to the sandwich. The workers there are extremely rude! This is the 3rd time i have had some kind of problem there. I have tried talking to management and corporate with no one returning my calls or emails. I will not be going back until they change.

Great hotel.  Worst bartender in Nashville, and probably North America.  There was a line of patrons waiting for at least 10 minutes, while this lady casually meandered behind the bar pretending to have a pulse.  Surely a hotel in downtown Nashville can do better than that.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've been to this restaurant several times. Every time the food was exceptionally good. service was fast and the menu items are plentiful. you got a great value for unlimited hibachi and sushi. everything is unlimited for one low price and it's good! I highly recommend trying for lunch first. only $10!!!!

This is a home grown Mom & Pop shop.  However, they pick and choose who they want to give fair prices.  Quoted 80$ for the check engine computer, really? On a budget, just got a basic oil change.  They do implement their own credit system, awesome. How do you qualify as a non Hudsontrite, lol.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Not much to say here. Most PA Wine & Spirits I've been to are usually okay. For the most part, they have what I need when I shop here. Last Christmas I wanted to get my Father-In-Law a bottle of Glenlivet 25 Year Scotch. They didn't have any in stock, but they kindly ordered it for me.

Nothing like your local Starbucks , well my Starbucks is definitely better than yours lol, this place is in a good location for those of you that live in Zionsville like I do, this Starbucks is right next to the interstate and have some of the friendliest barista in the business

The food and the service is great here! They give you a lot of food for the money and the food came quickly. The owners of the restaurant are very nice! They sell donuts here and they are so good and the perfect ending to any meal. I would definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone who wants Chinese food!

It wasn't nothing to ride home about; I'm not in a hurry to go back there anytime soon. The food was ok. I got bacon cheddar fries & ask could they be well done & they weren't well done. The service was good & got it in the time they said it be here. I got there cheese steak & that was ok.

We came here to grab a quick bite to eat before going home at 10:30pm. No exaggeration, we waited about 30 minutes to get 2 burgers & large fry no salt!! Ended up leaving with NO FOOD! It was late had to get home! What the heck?!!? So much for "fast food!"
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I haven't been to Bernini yet for a full entree. I only sampled their Rollatinis that were offered during the Fiesta Festival in Ybor. Although they looked good, I wasn't a huge fan of them. I would not order them again, however, I will visit Bernini's to try the other items on the menu.

Have been taking all of my cars here for several years.  Very good value and great customer service, especially Tom.  They have never tried to sell me anything I did not need and when they do indicate that additional work is needed I never feel pressured to do it immediately.  Highly recommend.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Pretty much like a regular McDonald's, except cleaner compared to Philly standards. It's location is well suited in case you're out partying in the city (close to many clubs and bars), and can serve as a great midnight snack if you live in the Rittenhouse neighborhood.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Pretty disappointing. Flavor a neither interesting nor classic. Not fresh tasting, including the chicken. I guess the music was nice and the wait staff was efficient. I was with three others and we were 1 for 4 in terms of satisfied. 
I wouldn't recommend it, unfortunately.

Although a completely different feel to this downtown location, our evening was really just so/so. The place wasn't busy, but our server paid little attention to us. We had to clear our dishes aside to make room for dessert. Would I go back?  Probably not any time soon. Too many other restaurants to chose from.

Fry's is definitely the best grocery store down in the Green Valley / Sahuarita area. The lines are never too long, and they have pretty much everything you'd need. Their selection of vegan items is huge, which is probably what makes me like this store so much.

We have been there a few times and the food is average, the wait staff is  excellent. Last nights experience was  the food preparation was poor, meal arrived cold..  This is a good place for common Mexican food, but stay away from anything that has is uncommon and you will have a better experience.

The food was less than appetizing. We can normally eat a whole pizza and definitely finish it the next day. We just didn't like it.  It was full of people sitting in restaurant. The atmosphere seems cute, but the food made me sad. We won't go back even if someone pays for it. People were nice though

Great place!!!! Highly recommend it to anyone!!!! Saw the John Zarsky Quartet - The Tradestars there!!! They are fantastic if you get a chance to see them. 

Drinks are good too --- lol!!! Not your everyday Bourbon Street dive bar!!! Bartenders are great!!! 

Don't forget to tip your bar staff and the band!!!

Went here a few times while visiting the area.  Good comes out very fast after ordering and is good.  Hash browns are not greasy at all. Some servers not as friendly as the others but you get that almost everywhere you go.  Reasonably priced and good breakfast.

One of my favorite sushi places around Reno. They have baked rolls that are pretty unique and very tasty. I am pretty picky and there are plenty of options for someone like me or for someone with a huge taste pallet. The fish is always cold and fresh. Would be 5 stars if the service was a little bit better

Ok, I admit a good pizza and the delivery guy was fabulous... but $7 for a piece of key lime pie that taste like I licked the dresser just drenched in pledge... NO!!! Get Edwards entire pie @ Walmart for $6 and be much much happier!! And maybe go to Slyce... its worth the drive.

The restaurant is very modern and clean and the people are friendly, but the food is not all that. The sushi rolls are extremely large, not comfortable to eat. I have to say they do make it fresh for you, but a lot of the food is a little bland, nothing too special.

Very beautifully decorated. The mac n cheese was amazing, as well as the chicken wings. The pork chop is the priciest on the menu at $29 and it was very dry.  Happy hour drinks are very reasonable. Our waiter was very nice and knowledgable, but a little too pushy.

The Best Filet!! Awesome Lobster!! Fabulous Drinks!! Friendly Casual yet Classy Atmosphere.  Great for a girls night, date night, or a group.  This is definitely our special event place.  Have been for Filet Night, Lobster Night, and Prime Rib Night and All have been delicious!!

Very RUDE customer service through the thru window. Didn't acknowledge us, Didn't greet us, Didn't say your welcome the multiple times we said thank you. Got an attitude with us when asked for a napkin to dry of the drippy cup she handed us. Won't be going back anytime soon.

The service is not very good at this store. I stop here alot because it is on my way to work. I tried to use an debit card early in the morning and the guy yelled at me. Then messed up my order after I had to pay I'm cash. They mess up my order 50% of the time.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Family owned and operated.
Great quality sushi, but a bit overpriced for the amount they charge. Otherwise, nice clean establishment. Ambience is set for more of a quiet family or intimate couple dinner. 

Bring your own spirit,but worth the taste of fresh salmon.

The pizza was fine, but honestly I couldn't enjoy it after walking in to the place with it looking like this. Just ingredients all over the floor and counter tops, and no effort to try and be clean. Thankfully the lady who works there did wash her hands, but I question any pizza made in this kind of an environment.

First things first this place is walking distance from my house so it's an excuse to eat here. The yogurt comes in many flavors and oh so many toppings. My fave is Captain Crunch mmm. Join their club and after so many times you get a free cup. There's also a really cute outdoor area to sit and eat we love it

We ended up here after our hotel for a conference at Gaylord Opry was overbooked. We found the hotel to be quiet and clean. Chris at the desk was attentive and friendly. The waitress at breakfast was sunny and fun. There are multiple stores and restaurants nearby. You will need a car to get around.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces
