text: They tried to make so many varieties that some of them obviously failed. Some are very delicious, lake the classic glazed, but some are terrible for my taste - like one that seems just like fruit loops and nothing else. But I really like the place and presentation!

Courtney is awesome!!! I stayed right across the street, so it couldn't get anymore convenient than that. Little Bar is right in the heart of the French Quarter- 5 minutes from Bourbon Street. It's also about a 12-minute walk to the Superdome. Stop by and ask for Courtney-she's a true mixologist.

NEVER have been to a Starbucks with such a rude employee... Kelsey shouldn't be at a job where interaction with the public is part of the job description... someone should remind her that the customers are the reason salaries get paid (and the tip cup gets stuffed by customers too).

This place says they only work on Japanese cars. They also felt it was necessary to tell me that I would have to pay wether I passed my inspection or not  as if I failed my inspection, they thought I would just run out without paying? Super subtle passive aggressive disrespect (possibly racist), my favorite! ZERO STARS.

The 3.5 stars is for the barbacoa it self. Please stay away from the tortillas store bought they are disgusting if you want a real authentic Mexican food I don't think this is the place, I know those places to eat and run you want that go to El Guero Canelo. Don't take my word for a try it yourself.

what a shame. This is exactly what we need around Boise, a placxe to get some quick hot mex food any time day or night. Problem is I ordered a breakfast burrito advertised as having potato, eggs and pico degio. It was a burrito full of potatos and no other flavors.

Update: no longer Joel's! Not as good unfortunately...



This is a good solid pizza place. No frills just good food. Always consistent. We've eaten there a lot and always enjoy.
We spur of the moment ordered 7 pizzas from them and they accommodated very quickly!

This is my go to spot for authentic tacos.  I've tried other places especially for al pastor tacos and they always fall short.  This place you get nice tender meat with flavor.  Al pastor should never be bland or rubbery. I order tacos with aqua fresca, usually pineapple which is great.  Can sit there and enjoy a good meal and tv.

Food was cold I don't even understand how but yes it was cold and when I approached them about my food being cold they just shrugged it off like it wasn't a big deal I try to stay clear of fast food placed but since today payday I decided to treat myself definitely won't be coming back I wish I could give them 0 stars.

We really like Santi's pizza and their wings are really good. We get the hot wings and they have the perfect amount of heat. They have a wide variety of foods on their menu and the Santi salad is excellent- tons of marinated chicken. Their delivery is generally quite fast, too!

Great Hibachi! Fresh food and always perfectly cooked. Also, very chic interior; a nice night out. Their proteins are excellent, especially the scallops and ahi tuna. Also, the wasabi shumai is awesome for an app. The chefs are very nice and they have good house wine prices. Try a ginger gimlet; it is delish!

Looks nice from outside.  Long story short, urine on toilet seat upon check in, pubic hair in bed linens (I'm a nurse I know hair).  Dirty counters.   Definitely will not return.   Space is large but soiled dirty stained carpets too.  Not worth it, even if it were free.  
Gross
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Great hotel! Had the opportunity to stay at this Sheraton for a night while on business. It's located off of I95. It absolutely did not disappoint. There was nothing I didn't like about this place. Very modern. Great facilities and the room was quite spacious and accommodating. 

I'd stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: An update to my previous review. Pizza and sandwiches are good here but do NOT order seafood. My wife ordered scallops which I could smell before they got to the table and was very ill for 2 days after. A restaurant like this should only serve the freshest good but that wasn't the case

Solid lunch special. A bit overpriced for the quality for dinner. Love the presentation but I just dont feel the quality of some of the rolls match the presentation. There are times Ive been wowed here and other times its been meh- inconsistency in sushi places isnt my favorite. My advice is to stick with the lunch special.

Definately one of my favorite hamburger spots. I don't know how they make the fries but they are unique and super delicious. If ypu have a burger craving late at night they are open until 1am. The beef is fresh - never frozen. I recommend eating it sooner than later because it doesn't re-heat well.

We probably eat here twice a month rotating between the hibachi grill one time and sushi the next.  While it's not fabulous, out of this world food, it is consistently good food and the service is awesome.  We always feel like valued patrons when we eat at Hirosaki.

I moved to Newtown from NYC where I tried every gluten free pizza place, searching for something that tasted somewhat like real pizza.   Not one of them holds a candle to Jules Thin Crust!   Simply the best pizza out there.  I also always get amazing service!

Overall everything was great!...some of the best service I've ever received. I ordered the Nunzio (chicken entree) However the breading on my chicken was falling apart, everything was tasty and very well seasoned. I will be returning as this is not my first time eating here!..Love this place!

Hmmmmm mmmm mmm!!!! Want some good sushi then look no further. I've been goin here for years. My friends girlfriend used to work here and would bring home goodies for us often so that's how I learned about this restaurant. This place is an SB classic...enjoy!

Stayed 2 nights mid March. Quiet, pool area is nice, pillows are not fluffy so bring your own.
Bathrooms clean and modern.
We had patio room which came w/large couch and king bed.
Couch was really comfy.
You can hear drum beats at random times but not entire stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: First off, I love the eye Doctors. They are great. Where there service tanks is when you are looking at glasses. They do not have enough staff first of all. And if you are not buying something new they dont seem very happy to help you. I will only go there for eye exams and move buy buying to an online service.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This place USED to be a great spot. You could get good southern cooking for a great price. Now it is ridiculously overpriced and you get nothing. 2 tiny pieces of catfish and 2 sides for $11.00. Any run of the mill meat and three around Nashville beats this place. Avoid throwing your money away here.

Umai is a favorite and Chef Ray and his staff are terrific.  We're regulars, that due to dietary habits aren't as regular as we used to be.  Lots of terrific specialty rolls, plus EVERY day is very fresh fish day.  Reservations are a must, the space is small.

it was nice to have a more authentic menu than most restaurants offer. I tried the El Pastor Huarache, it was good but I thought it would have a little more flavor. Everyone else had a lunch special item and enjoyed their meal also. Mexican music, cold beer & service was good.

I had to give 3 stars because the front desk clerk was not the best and our vehicle was scratched after valeting. Besides that the rooms are a bit small but clean with clean sinks "clean sinks in hotels seems rare now of days". Restaurant was okay and valet attendants were really nice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We've been here 5 times, and I'm disappointed every time.  We get soft serve cones with sprinkles.  Great portions and toppings.  But the soft serve isn't terribly flavorful or special; very similar to the soft serve at McDonalds.  Maybe we should try the water ice or other flavors.

Cute little place in Washington Square. Love how they have a sake sampler option, honestly haven't seen that before on a menu. The food and service is pretty average. The sushi selection they have is pretty creative, like the M & M or sake bomb roll but honestly I prefer more normal rolls like the dragon or spider roll.

Simply amazing. I don't quite remember what I got as my last visit was nearly a year ago, but I do know this: it blew me away. Not even the fact that I was cold from the evening wind outside could dampen my enthusiasm for that little cup of heaven. I can't wait for my next trip here so I can make a beeline for Yogurtland!

I've been banking here for a number of years. Right now they're not busy at all, but I've been sitting in the drive thru to cash a check, and they recieved the check and my License, but still haven't even greeted me after 15 minutes of waiting. I get so frustrated at this place.

Friendly staff.  Rooms need some renovation and updating.  Our room was not very clean, had peeling paint, and dust on everything.  Location is fantastic - right off of Bourbon Street, within walking distance of a lot of attractions, and next to bus/streetcar stops.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Not a bad bar. Seems to be a somewhat young local bar attraction. Bar owner seems to party with the customers a lot. Food I had not tried here so I cannot rate it though I heard from my friend who brought me here it is good. Bartenders are cute. Larger bar area and more parking is this bar's only downfall.

Staff here are really nice and helpful, pretty clean place. They do have a nice amount of space and it doesn't feel overwhelming to be here. Happy to be a member at this gym. Anytime I have a question the trainer in gym or the staff try to help to the best of their abilities and I do appreciate that. Thanks guys.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I came in for my first time on a quiet Sunday, and the atmosphere was impeccable. Cozy chairs, friendly customers, delicious drinks. I spent a few hours reading and drinking my lattes near the front, wishing I could somehow live here the whole time. Higher Grounds is absolutely my new Third Place.

First thing to note is the service sucked. We waited forever for out seats, food, the check. It is super cramped they have way too many tables stuffed in a small space. The food itself was just OK nothing too spectacular. I probably would not go here again.

This place is the best.  A tiny dive off Industrial Highway, that serves up a great breakfast.  The staff is very friendly, the food gets to your table immediately, and it is carefully prepared, using fresh ingredients.  I travel to Philly periodically, and look forward to my stay out by the airport...just to go to Miller's.

The tacos are still great but that's about it. 
The burrito is huge but all beans and very little meat.  The carne asada has no flavor. Love the pastor though 
This used to be one of my favorite places, but they need to step it up. Too much great competition close to them now

Mediocre at best. The flavors are pretty bland here and the service wasn't great. Not terrible, but not worth the money to return. We ordered food because the buffet people rave about on Yelp is small and generic. The taste of the dishes is probably fine for people who haven't ever had really good Chinese food.

Wait staff is friendly and attentive but prices for frozen fish are a bit outrageous. You won't find much better but then again, that's not saying much. I find Mizu to be a bit of a gouge and believe the location to be the only reason worth a return visit.

The wings sauce is watered down. The wings are just friend and dumped in the box over the sauce without anyone making sure that the wings are actually covered with the sauce. So when you buy the wings you'll see a pool of sauce with the wings in it and the upper side of the wings is still without sauce.

I've been looking for a hand carwash just like this since I've moved down from Illinois. My Mustang isn't safe with the automatic washes. They always scrap the rims and sides, because it's so low.  This one was  perfect and close to home! I'm so excited to have found this one.

We found this place on Google when our regular spot was closed. I am so glad we did. The food was amazing as well as the service. The octopus and meatball appetizer awesome. We had the chicken parm and lobster ravioli ..so good. The tiramisu was the best. This was a good find and we will be back.

We went here with a group of 15 people and I wouldn't send my dog there to eat the scraps.  The soup was chicken broth with what seemed like string cheese in it.  The main dishes were horrible.  How they have the nerve to charge $75/head is out of control.  I'll never send anyone to this establishment.

Great menu. We made our reservations a month ago and we were out at a make shift table. My 6 foot 2 in father was on the end. The whole time people knocked into our table. I felt bad our waitress apologize. It was clear there was no managers there that night. Other then the food I would never go back.

I always get the chicken piccata with shrimp added. It is just amazing!  And out of all the times I've been here, which has been probably a good 50, the owner has been here all but once. That is what you call a good owner. This place is great and I will continue to come I love it.

Ken at Magic Nails is probably the best and fastest technician on the planet.He's been at it a long time,and it's evident.Got lots  of compliments on my nails.He definitely was worth waiting for,sent my friend to him,and her nails look great too. Thanks Ken!!

Two stars for an extensive draft beer selection. But twelve bucks for 6 wings that look like they were cooked last week? A 14 plain burger that suffers next to a whopper and is paired with maybe a dozen fries? Go in with no expectations and try not to be disappointed. Bottom line - the food is simply crap.

Tried the turtle, plain and cinnamon mini doughnuts. They were pretty good. Really fresh and melts in your mouth. I'd probably go again. 

My favorite were the cinnamon. The turtle was a lil too much for my liking. After eating 2 I was done. Forgot to take pics of the cinnamon and plain ones.

My family and I have been eating sushi here as long as I can remember. Vinh is the kindest, most generous person and provides delicious food. I thoroughly enjoy the banana roll in addition to the Goleta Sushi House salad. I also strongly recommend the salmon-skin salad. Thank you for a wonderful experience!

I had the chance to visit the burnside inn during covid so it wasn't crowded on a Sunday night. They had live entertainment on the piano which was nice. They have a lot of fun cocktails to choose from so I went with their house mule. It tasted great and I'll be sure to come back to try some others!

Dunkin' donuts one of my favorite donut chains. They always have fresh donuts in stock at a reasonable price at any hour of the day and to top it off - the coffee is delicious! With a variety of drinks similar to competitors like Starbucks, the perk is they are half the cost and taste just as great!

The worst experience I've ever had. A beautiful hotel in a great location.  All ruined by an incompetent and unprofessional staff. I have stayed at Marriott properties all over the world and have never had an experience like this... it's a shame because I had high expectations due to my other JW experiences..
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Despite not having some donuts, the lady gave us a free one for having to wait for one donut to be made! Worth the wait and since they are still trying to adjust to the demand, Jacks is still one of the best donuts around Indy. 

Service of friendly workers makes us come back for more, keep up the work Jacks

This is by far the worst subway I have ever been to.  Always out of bread, sandwiches are never right, pile on the veggies and smash it in a wrapper.  Been like this for years, and I'm guessing it will never change.  I've been to subway shops in North St. Louis that beats this place 5 times over.

Standing in line and the only person working the counter left to take her break. No one came to replace her. We literally wait for her break to be over. When she finally came back she laughed at us because it's still us. Yup, we haven't moved. Never again. I'll pay premium just to gtfo of this damn airport.

$13.80 for 2 terrible hamburgers. Burgers were cold and mushy. Fries were ice cold. That's why I should have taken the extra time to go to 
In N Out or Five guys or even Mcd. This restaurant was remodeled last year and looks great on the outside but their food is still SUB PAR

I am a tea fanatic, this place does not dissapoint! The varieties are endless and there are always hot and cold teas for you to taste. I love that they do punch cards. The location is cute and I never mind spending a few minutes of my day hanging out here. My personal favorite is the Apricot Black Tea, hot or iced, it's delicious!

3 stars due to one great experience and one bad one. Went here with family and had delicious pizza and a great time. Came back a few months later for a date night with the husband and when the waitress was serving us our pizza, she pushed her ungloved fingers into the air bubbles in the crust. Very weird, grossed us out.

Ugh, I hate when I have to come to this place. The food is really sub-par. They have some of the worst gyoza dumplings in town. All of their sushi is so.. mayo-ey and tastes not fresh at all. The prices aren't too bad.


Their chicken teriyaki is horrible.

The bed was EXTREMELY COMFORTABLE and SOFT!    Not much to offer for silver reward customers, and not much to sway a Hilton Diamond member, but as a Marriott Timeshare owner, I'm giving them a fair shake.  The young lady who checked me in was EXTREMELY HOSPITABLE, wish I remembered her.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have been here for both Sunday Brunch and for dinner. The prices are definitely on the higher side. The brunch was nice with a fair amount of options. Personal opinion, I enjoyed the dinner here much more. Their main cook (Chef Abu) is wonderful cook and extremely friendly.

The floor is filthy. Every table is littered with rubbish and needs to be wiped down! Several employees, including the manager on 3/4/20 at 12:15pm were on their cell phones. 
Kudos to Normand, an employee at the Burger King in White House for his due diligence.

The good: 
Food is ok not bad
They get it ready quick
Their beef on the stick is awesome

The bad:
Their food is just ok.  Not great not bad ok for a quick meal but nothing to write home about
Egg rolls not that good
Beef a little overcooked

A little below the other Chinese places in the area

Very cute place. They have a large variety of teas plus coconut milk and almond milk. Most coffee places only have soy milk as a substitute. My only complaint is that the tea is a bit over priced. I ordered a large tea and it was like $5! I could buy an entire package of tea bags for that price.

Worst customer service and cleanliness in a Starbucks even compared to busy ones in New York and San Francisco. No one acknowledges your existence, there is no friendly presence, and it seemed like there was no leader or manager in duty to give direction. A mess.

*This is really a 2.5 star review.* This used to be another good place to eat, but the quality has gone down. My last visit I was so disappointed. I had a steak quesadilla that was flavorless, runny guacamole, and a sad, sad frozen margarita. So not worth the pump and dump :(

My manicure was ok.  They don't massage or lotion and for the price that would be a given at any other salon.  The technician squeezed my fingers several times and made it uncomfortable to me.  I should have told her but she never made eye contact with me when I flinched. 
I won't go back.

You can't go wrong with original glazed. For best tasting doughnuts, visit in the morning. The parking lot and drive thru can sometimes be congested, but lines move fairly quickly. These are my favorite chain doughnuts! If they're not hot, I like to heat them up for 10-12 seconds in the microwave.

Giving it 4 stars because of the late night crew. I appreciate their no BS down to earth attitude. If you are new or a tourist to the area they will give you the low down about what's on and poppin. The pizza is ok. You won't notice too much of the taste when your drunk. When you not drunk the spot is cool for a quick snack.

The southside restaurant is even better than the W. 10th Street location. Don't let the all-you-can-eat aspect fool you. They roll top quality sushi and serve it with an artful presentation. And it truly is all you can eat. Getting your fill of sushi has never been cheaper.

Very relaxed place and quick service. Great cuts and service. I come here often, never have an appt and always get quick service. Love the barbershop talk. Make sure you are not sensitive as all subjects are on the table. Tv's all around with R rated movies or rap videos are normal. I think its pretty cool.

First time ordering here. 
Special Stromboli,was ready in a timely fashion, hot from the oven. 
Gentleman behind the counter  was very friendly. 
Very nice mix of ingredients and not over cookedd 
Based on this experience, will   Return to sample some other menu items. 
Unfortunately, the app was useless.

Very good green beans beef. Reasonable prices. The fried rice side dish wasn't the best. The general so chicken was really good. You can tell there spring rolls are hand made. The were delicious. The hot and sour soup was amazing. Definitely Recommend this joint if your in the central west end!!!!!!!

I've been here once before but this go around wasn't all that. We waited quite awhile for a chef to come cook for us and even though we said it multiple times the birthday girl still almost had her allergen placed on her plate . The staff, with exception of the chef, wasn't very pleasant.

Amy sure knows how to please! Amy and  her family go out of their way to make a wonderful meal! From seating to service till you have to go they will take great care of you and your guests!  
They even had their own show "The Family Business"
Very funny! 
My favorite dish is the dry spicy chicken! Omgeeee! soooo tasty

This was a lovely experience which I wasn't expecting at a drive thru automatic wash. The owner came over to help me when I dropped my card while trying to pay. He then walked around the car and asked if he could hand brush the worst areas. Of course I said yes! Will be returning here.

This place is dusty and overpriced. I've gone here twice and both times the employees are rude. There's a $10 minimum and if you dare ask if there is still one you will be rudely told "yep." The selection is poor and the prices are way too high. Just get a beer at Greeks next door!

No Thanks!!!! i went several times and each time didn't get the color i wanted and still paid 100.00 plus a tip,my daughter went for balayage and landed up just doing foils for a highlight,they did a terrible job,she went and had it redone at a different hair studio..They have a bad attitude.

I come there around 1pm but no employee at drive through , even speaker place, I asking the employees from the window, but she yell at me : " I don't understand, I can't hear you, come back for the speaker ". What's kind of professional service like that, it's made me really upset, I never come there again. Do NOT recommend
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
We ordered pick-up from here on a bad flu day..
Good soothing hot n sour soup that I was grateful for..
The crispy duck was dry though, and how you can manage to get duck dry, I can't possibly imagine!
All in all, a savior on a sick day, but I'll try other places when I want to have real good food.

They are constantly out of product. The staff is slow and don't seem to understand that running out of the same thing every day by 9 am means that you should make more of it. They can't complete simple tasks like putting mobile order labels on the correct order - then acting incensed when questioned about whose food is whose.

This is more a fast food restaurant where most people made to go order. There are few tables and chairs which you can dine in. Since the restaurant is so small you will feel crowded. Now for the food, it is low quality but relatively expensive. You can find better restaurant for the price you pay for.

They don't participate in the $5 footlong or $3 six inch of the month. I can only assume it's because of their hatred for American. If you're going to pay the regular prices, you're better off going down the street to a better sub shop - there are some in walking distance. 
Other than the prices, it's like every other subway.

Had not been here in many years and had dinner here on 2/22. Everything was top notch and the service from the bartender was excellent. We shared a Meditteranean Salad and Veal Parmigana and a dessert.  The sauce on the veal was sweet and delicious. Will definetly be back much sooner.!

I just came in to medium iced coffee but the person working was very rude because I news my phone to pay and they couldn't scan the barcode on my phone so then I ended up making me pay cash. I have never had a problem paying with my phone before this is such a bad customer experience.

Incredible pizza. Excellent service. BYOB. What else can you ask for?

I usually just get takeout. They make really good salads too (the gf usually gets anipasto). Service is very friendly and efficient. I've never had a bad meal from this place. My #1 go-to spot for pizza in Maple Shade

The food here is delicious, but the last two times we've been here the service is really subpar. Servers tend to disappear and aren't very friendly. It's not quite bad enough that I want to find a New Mexican place because the food is so good, but it's close.

Seafood soup and veggie enchiladas hit the spot! Cash only.. (I think bc the machine was/is broken??) We opted for the chile poblano sauce, which totally made the dish. The right balance of spicy and cooling, fresh veggies and nice dining atmosphere even though we took the goodies to go. Will return for eat in menu!

It's one of those "must do" things if you are on Bourbon St. $8/gernade. $7 for a refill.
They are SUPER sweet. Not a fan of that. As far as not having two? Eh. I had two and was nowhere near punch drunk... And no I'm not a raging alcoholic. 

I would not drink em ever again though. TOO DAMN SWEET!

The staff was friendly and prices are ok.  The food is average at best.  The rice and beans lack flavor.  The green salsa chilaquiles were oily tortilla slices with no visible signs and no flavor signs of green salsa.  If you're in the mood for good service with a below average food experience, check this place out

I stumbled upon this place while looking for a good ramen place in Tucson. The ramen and udon are both very delicious. The portion sizes were large and I often have to pack a to-go bag.  The Nabeyaki udon is super yummy. I'm not a fan of their sushi. This is often my go to place for comfort ramen!

Thought this place would be pretentious like some coffee shops like to be, but I was pleasantly surprised. The guy behind the counter was helpful and congenial to boot. If you live near by you're lucky, if not it's worth regular trips on the weekends. Coffee is amazing btw.

I'm writing this review on behalf of my children . Their school is nearby and they often stop in for a hot chocolate before or after school. They love it! My daughter thinks their hot chocolate is better than Starbucks. The staff are always friendly and welcoming. It's nice to have a neighborhood coffee shop that isn't pretentious.

Open during pandemic with great protection. Have napkins outside and they tell you use one to.open door, inside plastic barriers and distancing is great. My wonton soup was stacked and so yummy. The Singapore Mei Fun was good too. See and like my pictures.

Try this place out for the first time.....And for the last time. Order about 10 pm. on Saturday night. ordered a pizza and wings. Pizza was burn the cheese was burned and the wings over cooked. Ask for mild sauce got hot then hot sauce. I am very disappointed. Will not be ordering for here again.

Convenient to our place and does a decent basic car wash. Paid the extra to have the undercarriage done. 

Had a lot of water spots on the side from what didn't dry. I would like to see parking spaces that can be used to dry off any residual water under the handles or side mirrors.

i used to love this dunkin! then my lady moved. so the guy who works there now is just plain RUDE!!!!!! he repeats the order, then you pull up and its wrong....then he's shoving straws and the wrong drinks down you throat? no thanks, ill go to one of the other dunkins

Not sure why I continue to give this place chance after chance. Today November 27..I bought smores dip excited to get home & try it....only to see it expired NOVEMBER 9TH!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! this isn't the first time something like this has happened at this giant. Its ridiculous to say the very least.

We ordered a meat lovers double decker and large sausage and mushroom. The double decker was very good but the sausage mushroom we did not care for the crust. Agree with another yelper that it has a cracker taste. 

We would do the double again but not a single.

Came by to have lunch. We tried the conch roll and the shrimp avocado roll. The conch roll was a bit spicy but good, shrimp avocado was my fav. We also had the chicken box it was soup, rice California roll and chicken. It was good but will keep trying new places.

We came by to get rental to use while car was being repaired. They were quick to get us an upgrade as they did hot have one available at the time we arrived at no charge. We had the car about 2 1/2 weeks and dropped it at the repair shop where we picked up our car. We had no issue with them and the insurance company.

Don't know if it was the day or time but they were fixing the lights, made the place very tight to sit at and maneuver with 3 kids. But, the service was good, the sushi was ok. If you don't look this place up you will miss it. I probably wouldn't take kids next time.

Place is turning into a dump.   Parking lot is filthy and covered in carts - one attendant and 36 check yourself out isles.  Never a hand held basket at the front so you go to the check yourself out lanes and retrieve one for yourself.    Sad Bc use to be nice

Excellent tacos! My first visit was today, June 1 and I ordered 3 tacos. Steak, pork carnitas and chicken. I wanted to try a variety and went pretty mainstream. The food was made fresh to order and came up in about 5 minutes. Very hot, tasty and fresh. You will not be disappointed.

I hate this place! Way too expensive for an ok gym, the only thing they have going for them is that they're open  24/7. Canceling your membership takes two months and even if you're planning to cancel they will take money out for "club enhancement" fee so that's another thirty dollars waste
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The chicken in the risotto dish was the cheap, processed kind with the fake grill marks on it. For the price they need to use a real chicken breast. Other dishes were pretty good and the desserts are great. Service was slow too. Waiter disappeared for 25 minutes before taking order. Ingredient quality needs to go up.

My husband and I absolutely love this place. We go there often. Food is fantastic and hand made, can't beat the prices for the size of the meals that are served. The staff is always welcoming and takes the time to speak with us every visit beyond just taking our order. A real jem in a town full of pizza places.

Walked in and got a seat at the bar only for the rude bartender to tell me to have my id ready then wait 20 minutes for him to walk down the bar telling other patrons that he was the "mean guy". Finally we left after not even being offered a drink in a nearly empty bar. He is probably why it is empty.

Rude service, false advertising (reserves Ford Transit, got a Chevy Econovan), dirty vehicles. Got second vehicle with no apology, low tire pressure and garbage in it as well.  Also overpriced compared to competitors and not willing to accommodate in ANY way even though reservation was made over a month in advance

So first off this is McDonald's.... Well you know what you're getting when you go to McDonald's. So we don't go there often but when we do at this location they have these young kids working and they have the worst attitude possible. Like their facial expressions are even horrible.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Very basic pizza if you are in a rush and need something to eat quickly.   I like the walk up window idea that provides fast and friendly service during this time if covid..Otherwise there's too many other options than just settling for basic pizza.   The garlic knots were better than the pizza!  Very little meat on the Hawaiian!

Best Mexican food I'm tasted in A while.  Finally a restaurant that has Nice size portions.  I've been on the west coast of Canada for 6 yrs and this is the first time I've didn't finish my dish.  The staff was super friendly.  Most importantly the Margarita drinks are HUGE!

Customer service is lacking . The happy hour menu has too many rules associated with it.  Everyone at the table had to order drinks to have a happy hour discount even though we ordered the majority of our food off the house menu.  The fried food tasted like old oil.

We had a party of 5 and no one was disappointed with their meals.  Had to order 2 servings of guacamole because we ran out so fast and liked it so much.  Chips were hot and salsa was good.  All in all if I were in the area I would go back.  Staff was very friendly also.

Actually my first time back since COVID-19 and getting my new car. Will review after service. Need to give them a chance since Randy left.
It's sad like good business owners who are trying to make a living are having such rough time getting & retaining employees.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Eeeeeeeek :(  second day in a row l was there about 605 or later. Door on Swede Rd not open yet. Called yesterday while outside to see what time they open. They said 6:00AM. So I drove to the city restaurant it was open when I got there yesterday. Not this morning.

Well mom's birthday here today. She don't like to go out anywhere; however, she likes crab cake. We also use to go to Dawson's for many occasions as a family. 
I'm getting her a crab cake for dinner, carry out. The place is a good place to dine with family and friends.

4 stars for sushi 3 stars for other. I ordered a roll and a steamed dish. The steamed shrimp and veggies was underwhelming. Very few pieces of shrimp and rice was a little soggy. I did get an eel roll and it was good. Except I ordered it to go and they put cold sushi on top of hot dish. I'll stick with the tolls and try again.

You will not find better sushi than Ooka in the area.. or possibly anywhere else. Make a reservation if it's a Friday or weekend because this place fills up. Also, it's BYOB. The signature rolls are to die for. Must have: JAMES BOND ROLL. You won't regret it

Worst experience for service in my life.  Made an appointment for 8 am.  Besides the manager, nobody showed up for work.  Scheduled brake job for $69, oil change and tire rotation,  Got out of there at 11:10   !!!! Called their corporate offices.  Nobody there cared.  NEVER go here!!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Pollo Feliz is a good option for takeout, especially for a group meal. They offer good deals on bulk chicken, tortilla, rice, beans combinations. It is ideal for a last minute dinner option. Ask for extra salsa and carmelized onions to add some additional flavor to your tacos.

Ordered delivery to a nearby hotel and everything was great! The driver clearly read my extra instructions to call my cell phone and I would meet him in the lobby.  Even better, he called when he was a minute away to let me know! Food was fresh and exactly as ordered!

I used to love Snap Pizza until recently. Today I came and the staff seemed very annoyed to even "deal" with me. 

Please work on the staff Snap, because for "custom pizza" they seemed bothered by customization. Not one person welcomed me when I walked in or out.

I like this McDonald's, very clean, I got the mc pick 2, with the two quarter pounders, and got my girlfriend the 4 pack of chicken McNuggets with a side of sauce, my burgers were a special order with no ketchup or mustard and there was none!!!!! Awesome!! They have free napkins too!!!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: My favorite Mexican place in Glassboro nj. I'll miss it once I move. It's just delicious. I love the horchata, the burritos are huge, so are the quesadillas. Yeahhh they up charge  for guacamole but who doesn't? The service is fast, the take out is fast, everything here is just delicious. I always return. Thanks!!

First Sonoran dog was a success!  Awesome combination of flavors. I was worried at first that I wouldn't like it but the flavors pair together greatly. 
The carne Asada was also pretty tasty and we very much enjoyed our dinner. Can't wait to take out of town guests here to try a Sonoran dog

Imo's is a St. Louis staple. I find that people either love it or hate it. I am in the former. The provel cheese is what makes it great. This location is close and I have never had any issues. Definitely my favorite pizza. If only it were a bit cheaper...I'd be a regular.

We went to Chambers on a Saturday afternoon and found this place to be a notable stop when we are in the area. Their food was well made and the prices were very resonable for the area. 

The seats in the booth we had may need a slight updating as the stuffing has seen its day.

The hotel itself was spacious but could really use some room upgrades. The age is definitely showing. We were in a room near the elevator so could hear people coming and going throughout the night. Staff was friendly and it was in a great downtown location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: You know what this Wendy's is not so bad at all. I really like the employees here, and I feell for the most part they do an awesome job. But I have to say with this store is that while they are good with front counter stuff, they are not so great in drive Thur and I'm talking about at night.

After going to several Mexican restaurants in the Valley our kids keep asking to return to Fiesta Guadalajara. This place has also been recommended to us by several Mexican friends. The Carne Asada is one of my favorites. The service is always very friendly and prompt.

I've been going there for the past 10 years now, never disappointed!! Steven, one of the owner, is my go to person. He knows I have very high expectations about my haircut. Always takes his time and make sure everything is perfect! Highly recommend this place!!

My second favorite sushi spot, great portions, great prices, and cool special rolls! Love the scorched earth!!! Only thing it lacks is the cozy feel I'm used to in sushi restaurants.. very big place, and you tend to wait long sometimes.. but we'll worth it! Going to try a platter soon!

Probably the best ice cream I have had. It was very creamy and flavorful.
I see the comments stating it's expensive but I think for the amount I received for a double cone it was pretty reasonable- $4.50 plus tax. Also they have tons of flavors so you can't be disappointed.

I've come here for lunch during my break several times. It's clean, quick and the staff seems friendly. Trying to eat healthier for lunch this time of year is hard with limited time. I love the daily subs for a cheap lunch. All foot longs are $6 right now.

I've been here a few times and the service has been relatively fast. I will say the dining room is kept clean, with staff coming out on a regular basis. For fast food it's decent and fast. When I want something fast and convenient this is one of my regular spots.

Great workout great employees! Was here for work and dropped into a class they were extremely welcoming and explained the entire class to be prior as it was my first time participating in a Barry's class! Got a great sweat in and made sure to grab a delicious shake on my way out!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This gym is alright. The only reason I have a membership here is because the price and it is really close to home. A lot of the equipment for cardio is not in great shape, and if you go during their busy hours you will probably have to wait on everything you want to do
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I didn't have a problem here. They work with Geico regularly so there were not any issues with my rental after I was in an accident. I had to put the authorization originally on my car before Geico contacted them, but they transferred it all over to Geico without any issues. Pretty good experience for the first time

All I had was an irish cream breve, but it was a darn good one. The location is really hip and stylish, yo. The Village is basically U-Village in Seattle's U-District. This coffee shop offers high custom ability, a few pastry options. The menu is a tad overwhelming, but the staff was friendly in helping me pick out a drink.

First time there. Had the chimichanga and fish tacos... Both were really good. I would've liked more sauce on top of my chimichanga but if you like it dry you will love this entree. Got the shredded steak chimichanga... The steak was absolutely amazing! Fish tacos were light and delish..

Since moving to PA I have had a real issue with ordering Chinese.. This place is passable and quick.  Their crab rangoons are delish! 
I am always surprised that Chinese restaurants here do not serve chicken fingers though... The well prepared rice and chow mein made up for it though!

You feel so ... depressed when you walk inside. The workers sure feel that way and they make sure all of that 'energy' goes onto you! iyiyi I couldn't get out of there fast enough!

It's a chain so you know what to expect. I'll be back coz it's convenient ... maybe it was an off day.. maybe it's the norm. Who knows...

GREAT Asian Food Here! We were sat & immediately served w/a glass of water, Crispy Fried noodles & Hot tea! The combo meals are Delicious, well portioned & priced fairly! Inside the place is quiet and elegantly set. The staff is very attentive & friendly. I would highly recommend this place!

This place is your pretty standard Chinese food place. However, everything is made to order. I really enjoyed how the back was open and you are able to watch them cook your food in woks. They have fresh hot mustard, which I find does not exist in many other Chinese food places.

This hotel is consistently clean and well priced.  Easy location, ample parking, good Wi-Fi.  The lobby is quite nice, plenty of tables and places to plug in - thank you!

Breakfast is included or you can walk to the Bob Evans.  Starbucks is just across the way as well.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: this is the worst McDonalds ive ever been to the staff is lazy slow sloppy and put out garbage food. overcooked patties, soggy fries.  i watched an employee put his fingers in his mouth then tried making my order.  his manager saw him but did nothing until i called him on it. that's just one of many bad things ive seen there
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: can you say rude??  that's what the people are who work here.  Rude.  The La Freeze is okay but has gone downhill over the past year.  Always ask for an extra shot and most of the time don't get it. I ask and they say "yeah it's in there" but I can tell it's not. I'm scratching this coffee house off my list for sure

My friend was under 21, and they told her that as long as she was 18, she could go in, anyway. They never ID'd her. Then, like everyone else said, they forced shots down her throat and demanded money. She ended up getting her debit card stolen. This place needs to be shut down.

On my most recent trip to NOLA I came here for the first time and had a blast.  My husband and I drank and listened to a great 80's rock music band.  You can bring in outside drinks which is great! The shot girls are kinda annoying but once we told them no shots we weren't bothered.  We will go back for sure.

Update: last 2 times I ordered from here it was not good. Nothing like when I first started ordering here. The eggplant was just awful! Tasted like frozen food. Not at all fresh and tasty like it used to be.  No ricotta cheese in there. Half of it was hard and burnt. Threw it all out! Won't be returning here.

I've always enjoyed their tacos, quesadillas and rice. They're always very fast and the food is consistent. I think presentation could be improved and the overall look/cleanliness of the establishment. But it's good food when you're in the mood for Mexican.

I really like TD bank. They are welcoming, knowledgeable and will give you suggestions for banking needs that are suited to you. I was explained some interesting things about some accounts that I have. TD has always been really good for me, and my finances.

Tried it for the first time a couple days ago. Yeah, it's alright. The meat is fresh, the fries are plentiful. I just feel that it lacked something, and I can't quite put my finger on it. Not to say I won't come back, but I do think there are better places out there.

If you are looking for a clean hotel with a super friendly staff, then stay here.  I've stayed here twice this year.  No issues on either stay.  I like the location of this hotel.  It's close to the airport, shopping, restaurants, and Cigar City Brewing.  For the business traveler, the location is central.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Surprisingly great! 

The waiter was very clueless about the Menu. Why? There were only 2 other customers in the ENTIRE restaurant. Yikes? And they managed to serve me a meal I did not ask for. How?

Asked for soup, was given stir fry. It looked good so I didn't say anything... Glad I didn't cuz it was amazing!

This is soon to be our go to Asian restaurant.  The sushi is excellent and the only other thing we've had is the fried rice which is also excellent.  It's great for eat in or take out.  Each time we've been it's been relatively busy but not too busy to get good service.

First of all let me just say, this store has a great atmosphere of healthy looking people, however I ran into an issue with the cleanliness of the store, I don't recommend sitting down and eating, if you are on a lunch break or just looking to pickup food from somewhere healthy than this is your place.

This is the second time these folks have surpassed my expectations. I went in this morning with my broken glasses in a zip lock bag. They jumped in found frames my lenses fit, modified the lens  a bit and had glasses on my face within 15 minutes. The staff is great especially the young lady that waited on me. 

Thank you guys!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Wow!! Little Nona's was divine from the period kitsch decor, to the candlelit tables, to the welcoming staff. And the food? Absolutely prepared with love. The shortrib was fork tender, the meatballs gorgeous, the winter salad full of texture and flavor, and the list goes on and on. Nona, we'll be back to visit again real soon.

Edible, not good food by any means. They serve a lot of busses at this location and they are set to feed the masses. Cleanliness is not a priority here. It's a run down steak house that has seen its best day pass. Spare yourself the diarrhea risk and skip this joint.

Not the best service, but a massive improvement over Bull And Bear. The menu is quite small. They are learning and trying. I will definitely visiting again. My wife and daughter love it and have been multiple times already. I think they will continue to improve and refine their service and food. I look forward to it.

Yes! My search for where to get a quick, cheap trim is over. I've always been skeptical of going to Supercuts, but this one had so many great reviews I thought I'd give it a shot. The reviews are not wrong, people! Kalli did a great job and gave me exactly what I asked for.

This was my first time at Global quesadilla. The guy taking my order said he's favorite was the cancun. So I said let's try it and its was good. I like that you get three things to dip from sour cream, salsa and guacamole. I also got some four cheese queso and chips. It was also good. I'll be going back for sure.

My wife and I or originally from the northeast where Italian restaurants are a dime a dozen. Oak oven has a nice selection of food and wonderful service. The atmosphere is wonderful, and the interior is a little upscale for sitting along Jefferson Highway.

Oro Valley location. Good equipment great price. Chris on morning shift complains and stands around too much, night shift is great. The manager (Mike) tends to ignore all complaints no matter how minor. If you can, evening is a great time to go!! My rating is only a three star because of the manager
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: an average Americanized Chinese take out joint with a few seats that you can eat at.  I've gotten their lunch specials a few times and they are always consistently deliver what you come to expect from places like this.  a good place if you are looking for cheap, greasy spoon Chinese.

I must say that their pizza has definitely changed after the new remodeling/ovens.. it's more of a bubbly crust now vs their older soft doughy crust that I loved. However - Their cheesesteaks are great! I aim towards getting a sandwich instead of the pizza these days.

Literally the best pizza I have ever had. I crave it when I haven't had it in awhile... I consider it a treat when I am back home to get to have some Joey's pizza for dinner. I don't know what it is, but the sauce on the pizza is phenom. Love Spear and Joey.. always make my family and I feel welcome. Great guys, great food!

You got to try their enchiladas! Best I've ever had! Yum yum yum! I love their pork chops too! The staff is friendly and their atmosphere is casual and laid back. I enjoy going here for dinner any day I don't feel like dressing up much. Delicious, convenient, and definitely comfortable!

I heard it's pretty good and I also hear it's very expensive and turned out both are true. 
Food is good, got the lunch special spicy tuna don, but I would love raw tuna rather than cooked ones. One salad and one lunch special cost me almost $20 pre-tip. Didn't even order sushi or sashimi...

My favourite airport parking spot, price is the cheapest among other options based on my search. Their shuttle runs very frequent and they are only 0.5 miles away from the airport. I've only had one glitch for the past two years' experience with them where their phone was down. Every single staff was super nice to me.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Best pizza in Franklin!  Thin crust is like a cracker crust but is not crispy. They have great specials and the guys at the front desk are always super friendly. I tried almost every pizza place in Franklin since I moved here trying to find a good "go to" and Matteo's it it!

We loved our sushi chef - he was from China (as we discovered are 80% of sushi chefs) and was very friendly in nature and a true professional with his craft. The sushi came out quickly and was well made. We would like to come back and try the daily specials.

For a sushi place in a food court....this place is pretty decent. Each time I have been here there has only been one person. So the wait time varies a lot depending on the time of day.

I found the portions to be on the smaller side but the quality to be good.

Yesterday was my first time at this restaurant. Its a small place with limited parking. The staff were really sweet, they kept checking up on us. I got three rolls and they were great!  They have a 50% off menu and it's definitely worth the $$. I'll definitely be visiting this place more often!

I love eating here and have always had good experiences untill tonight. im taking a star off because after driving All the way across town to grab a quick bite here they had closed 20 min early. Its not great customer service if you're forcing your clientele to eat elsewhere during business hours.

Wish I could rate this place 10!! Wonderful little lady that always explains the massive menu to me. I go maybe once a week and I absolutely love the food and service. I try something different every time. Great authentic Vietnamese & Chinese options available!!

Went for the fish fry last week. Have enjoyed it in the past but this time was seriously lacking. Our female server seemed confused even though it was not very busy. Difficulty getting drinks. Our shrimp cocktail was served after the fish. The bill was wrong. Overall disappointing night.

Breakfast-sausage gravy and biscuits there was a waffle machine but no batter - hard boiled eggs- fruit apples and bananas- cereal and milk and pastries yogurt 
Deluxe Continental breakfast 
The room was clean - remodeling / painting in hallways- no surprises
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: You get what you pay for. It's 40$ a year and 10$ a month. There is plenty of equipment to choose and use. The equipment is getting older and all of the headphone jacks on them are going out. So don't plan on watching the overhead tvs, unless you want to fight the headphone jacks on all equipment.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Went here in the middle of the day so we were pretty much the only ones in the bar the entire time. BUT our bartender, Kendra, made it a blast for us. She was so kind and was super fun. it was a little dirty, but I wouldn't mind going back if Kendra is working.

Not a problem experience was good customer service was very good the only problem is this location for some reason has a very small selection of vehicles and they are cars you would not want to drive.  Very low end vehicles compared to other locations nothing you would want to drive. 

Otherwise everything else is good

An underwhelming experience. The house salad was dreadfully brown, the food was average and the 'music' was kitsch. 
This may have been good 40 years ago but is lacking even my Macaroni Grill standards. 3 people $150 before tips for a one & done experience.

Great cheesesteak.  Meat was chopped up nice the way I like it. Perfect amount of cheese.  Roll was the weak link if there was one.  On cheesesteak alone this was a 4.0 experience.   Butter cake for dessert takes this to a 4.5.  Friendly people. Would return to try some other things

Very nice restaurant at the airport Marriott. Service is a little slow but the sandwich I ordered was delicious. American beer - 6.00 draft, 7.00 bottle, Philly cheesesteak - 18.00 (overall a little pricey but if you are staying at the airport Marriott you don't have many options!

These guys roast their own small batches of coffee and the staff really cares and puts love into your beverage.  Throughout Covid they have found ways to stay open to be able to take care of customers.  Everybody that is a customer here, especially right now, is helping make sure this business stays open.

Car was clean and pleasant to drive, service was top-notch. All the employees that I worked with - either on the phone or in person- were helpful and friendly. Loved that I was able to extend my rental by two days (without any extra fees or exorbitant prices!) when my return trip got delayed. Very impressed. Will be back.

The food is good if you like tiny tacos. My wife thought the guacamole was too spicy. Most of the tacos were spicier than they needed to be as well. The Baja Fish taco was really good so I would just get a lot of those if you're coming here. Service and atmosphere was good though.

Do not go here, have been refusing to cancel my membership since March. And charging me each month. The manager just hangs up on me. They expected me to come in to cancel or go to the Post Office to cancel and get a certified check while the state was on lockdown and I have a newborn at home.
This place is a joke.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Some of the best sushi in town with reasonable pricing. Good crab Rangoon, gyoza, and teriyaki. Very reasonably priced martinis! My only complaint is it doesn't appear servers are assigned stations, so I get two different people coming out to get my drink or food order: service is friendly

WOAH! :D

Amazing food to be had here! Salmon risotto with asparagus was absolutely decadent and the service is great too! Only complaint is the lack of music... where's are the tunes?
All in all a great experience from start to finish... clean bathrooms too, amen! Can't wait to try the bada bing next time!

This place is a cute little hole in the wall sushi place with the KINDEST staff anywhere! The husband is the head sushi chef and his wife is the head waitress. They are both incredibly sweet. Their children used to be on staff as well but have moved on as they grew up. The fish is fresh and the sushi is authentic. Enjoy!

So good! We went in on a rainy Friday night and sat at the sushi bar. Cute, little hole in the wall place. Low key and no frills, which tbh is a nice change from most sushi places that put on airs. 
Great sushi! They're getting their liquor license still but it's also BYOB. Go check it out. Cute hidden Lil east Nash gem

I was really excited to try as this place seems really popular.  Finally tried it.  Meh.  Agree with previous review that server was not very knowledgeable.  The menu IS extensive although.  Decor is nice.  Pricing is high. Go across the street, much better sushi and service.  Or sushi Ai!

Food was fine but the employee's attitude was poor.  When we brought our food back to the counter because it was prepared wrong, the woman behind the counter smarted off to my husband.  The restaurant had a foul smell to it, too.  We'll probably pass this location by next time we're in the area.

I was expecting really great sushi and was unpleasantly surprised that it was just ok. I got 2 rolls (spicy tuna and Alaska I think) they were both equally ok. Not very full and the fish quality just seemed ok.  I will not return, there are plenty of other similarly prices places with better sushi.

I was invited to eat here on Nov 29th.. WOW the best Chicken Marsala... the way My Mom used to make it...There was so many mushrooms and it was super delish.. I found 4 nice italian resturants now who are my favorites.... You all, Da Sesto... Villa Gallace and Gratzzi..... you all got my vote.. fantastic place...

Food was delicious: chicken teriyaki 
And volcano roll was flavorful and didn't taste old or fishy. 
For mall food this is a step up. 

The employees are working hard and the manager is hopping back and forth between the hibachi grill and the register and also seeing if the sushi maker needs help too.

Ate here for breakfast during a recent 10 day trip and wasn't impressed.  The buffet items were acceptable at best.  Runny scrambled eggs, overcooked sausauge patties (to the point where it was inedible), flavorless pancakes...not the best experience with the service either.

This hotel would have gotten 3 stars except for staff attitude and lack of integrity. I have stayed at many HI and Expresses around the US and never have I been treated so poorly and with complete disregard to personal property. The hotel is not corporate owned so the front desk people aren't really concerned about your plight.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: As other people here say... Food Is fantastic!! One of the best Italian places in Tri-State! But the service? Not so much. 1 star penalty! Went to dinner here last week and from sit down took 4 hours for us to finish up. Don't these owners read reviews? I would do something about my service. I don't get it.

I had the bronzino special and it was so bland! Came with steamed broccoli (bland also. Husband had lobster ravioli which was delish. I was surprised at the lack of flavor.  I've been to so many amazing restaurants in the city it was startling I guess to stumble upon this one. In other news it was definitely healthy.

Pretty good spot. The price is kinda high but not really for sushi.  The rolls are different than what you would get at a non all you can eat sushi spot.    If you need an all you can eat sushi spot this one is amazing.  Good spot glad they are on southside.

Nothing bad can be said about the quality of the product! Rich, creamy, and they offer both classic flavors and some fun combos. They do shakes, malts and sundaes as well! A little pricey for ice cream, but it's so rice that you don't really need heaping portions to cure your craving.

Pizza was adequate, but the service wasn't particularly friendly and the ambience was 'blah.'  The biggest perk of this place is it being in DT Safety Harbor.  Hopefully they'll continue to improve or it'll be fated like most other lackluster businesses on this strip.

Variety and creativity of flavors can't be matched!  Friendly staff and easy online ordering during COVID.  A shame you can't do samples at the moment, but certainly understandable given the circumstances.  Would be 5 stars if the prices were a little lower!

A twenty minute wait turned out two hours of waiting no time.  The food was delivery at many different times, the first group finished, the second finished and the third group had to wait.  We ordered some guacamole after the first round was done and never received, but it was on the bill.  Very spicy tacos.

The staff in this Starbucks is very nice. They smile and are always polite. My coffee is always the way I like it. It does get quite crowed but the staff handles it well and gets me out quickly. I love having this Starbucks in my neighborhood. Hannah, Nikki and Justin are doing a great job.

The BEST fireworks for 4th of July were seen here tonight! I can't believe how close they were to us! Got our attention right away and we walked out of our hotel room to see a gorgeous display right over our heads.  What a treat! Gracious staff for this stay so far. Very accommodating to any of our requests.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Standard Subway fare. Restaurant was clean on the inside. Well staffed, no wait. A handful of tables available. Sandwich was quickly and well assembled by friendly staff. Ingredients tasted fresh. Good chip selection. Supplies were well stocked. If in the neighborhood, I would stop here again.

I always liked this place bc it's local and unique but the owners are consistently rude and stiff and don't at all welcome children in their shop even if well behaved and right next to parents. I won't ever go back bc I just can't stand the people who run the place. I certainly can find nice spices elsewhere.

The prices are a little high for a reason. They CAN! If you just want ice cream cheap, go get a .50 cent cone from Burger King. If you want to experience what Tampa Natives have since the 1950's, spend a little extra money and go to Bo's. It's worth the money!

first time back in awhile. 13.00 for 3 item 16" pie. not unreasonable. pie was very good. they do have a one item special for 10.99. but we liked the pizza. always the best in spring hill. was hard to navigate the road next to checkers at night. there is a back road much easier. but worth the effort. never disappoints.

Like the Dunkin Go 2s but it appears that when I visited the restaurant was understaffed - counter staff will try to keep you waiting using "I will be with you in a moment" as an excuse.  Something to keep in mind if you have to be somewhere on time such as work.

This Burger King needs to improve on their customer service - counter staff gets overly rude and aggressive with customers including one of the managers on duty.  Just wondering, is rudeness and aggressiveness to customers part of Burger King's customer service training?

Food is good but service is very disorganized.  Major mistakes on orders - check to see that your order is right before you leave the counter or drive thru window.  Are frequent order mistakes a way to run a McDonald's?  Again, check your order before you leave the counter.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: UPDATE:  Steer clear of this Burger King if you are pressed for time such as work.  I went in the drive thru for two breakfast sandwiches only to get a "I'll be with you in a moment" greeting which turns out to being ignored.  To make matters worse, I was behind someone who could not make up their mind what they wanted to order.

I asked for a couple of slices. They were old. It is a Friday night. It was as they were made two days a head of time. Service was either order  or get the hell out. Was there with wife and two kids I felt rushed and unappreciated. They were not even that busy. Overall a below average experience.

I ordered a 12 oz. mocha and it was undrinkable. I saw the barista make it with chocolate milk, but she must have added extra chocolate (syrup or powder?) because it was way, way too much. Even thicker and sweeter than Starbucks mochas, which are pretty instense.

Finally tried this place and won't be back. Food was not great and the horchata undrinkable - obscenely sweet with a weird (floral?) after taste. 

We had the carne asada taco which looked more like ground beef, and the Chile relleno plate which was a sloppy mess with flavorless chiles and soggy egg coating that slid off.

I went in to this location today for the first time. Usually hit the locations with drive thru options. Front register was kind and quick. Lady making the sandwich was nice as well.  Got a power breakfast sandwich, med hot black and one chocolate frosted donut.  I'd come back.

This place did a fair job. The girl took her time and  was very gentle. The service was fast, there was no wait. The pricing was fair. The only thing that could have gone better was that she did not clean the underside of my nails so I have chunks of acrylic underneath. :/

Took my boyfriend here to celebrate our one year anniversary and I couldn't have picked a better place! The sushi was great, but the wait for our sushi was a little long. However, it just so happens that they were very busy that say, so I'm sure they're faster on slower days. Definitely a good place to go!

This is my FAV sushi spot, the staff are so awesome everyone is so nice. The sushi well it speaks for its self i have modified the sushi a few times and it was never an issue and it always is exactly how i wanted it. The saki plum to mmm good. Its great if you are going solo are on a date or even a group of friends.

A nice and quiet spot to work on the laptop. The donut was fresh and the strawberry Coolatta hit the spot on this warm day. The location is out of the way. The only problem is the rush hour traffic on the Black Horse Pike (Route 168). You are at the mercy of the other drivers when entering and exiting the lot during peak hours.

Pleasantly surprised! Great experience all around. Friendly and fast bartenders, awesome pizza, yummy drinks, and of course the amazing location and view. Very close to the public beach parking, wide open beach view, and close to other bars and activities. Highly recommend!

I stay here all the time and everything seems to be great! Had plenty of hot water for my shower after a wonderful dip in the pool which I must say was wonderful. For the money this was an excellent value. Oh and you gotta try moms Mia's next door too, food was fantastic!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Service was impeccable! The lasagna, chicken parmigiana, and manicotti were good. We prefer a spicier sauce and theirs was a little on the sweet side. Personal preference. Only reason it's not 5 stars for us. Will be back for something without tomato sauce next time

Good car wash but currently been softer here for 25 minutes because they supposedly had to refill the soap and reboot the system. They said they are not used to this many cars. Well it's a sunny day just after a week worth of snow they should of been on top of it!!! Nice people who work here!!

So, gree up eating sushi because my parents are obsessed with it, I have never seen such thinner slice of sashimi. Is this a scam? I have gone to other places in Boise, of course some are like this there are places that give you the amount that you deserve. This fish is fresh but does it really worth the price?

Very favorably impressed.  Friendly and attentive staff.  Excellent chips and fresh salsa. Not crazy about their rice and beans and will order tacos ala carte next time.  The shredded beef and carnitas were tasty.  Restaurant was much cleaner and less worn out looking compared to other Mexican restaurant's I've tried in Boise.

The best pizza that I've tasted in South Philly. My favorite pizza from them is their Mediterranean White pizza. Every time I've had this pizza, it's tasted fantastic. Even my cat loves this it. She actually nipped my finger once  to get better taste of that delicious Mediterranean pizza.

Update: I called the police and talked to the property manager. There is an investigation happening. The officers assured me that this is not a common occurrence here. The property manager is handling things and I am waiting until my laptop is found or replaced.

We went to Little Nonna's at the suggestion of the concierge. The food was divine and the drinks were exceptional. The snot sphere is cozy and the wait staff was very attentive. It is a great place for a date with someone you want to build memories with. We truly enjoyed every bite!

Not a great experience at this place. It's pretty basic Americanized sushi. A lot of people like that, I don't. The fish wasn't very fresh, not good quality and not cut properly. If you get something with "crunchies" or lots of sauce, then you'd probably like it here.

This was an excellent experience. Food was well prepared . Restaurant was clean. My grand daughter ordered softly and was not what she actually wanted... the manager made it right at no extra charge. She was very nice as was the young man who prepared my salad.

Went for breakfast and the place was jammed pack.  Loved the hash browns but breakfast was over priced.  The service was top notched and very down to earth.  Will return for the Mexican dinner as this place transforms into a Mexican restaurant by night with reasonable prices.

3 stars for fresh ingredients but not enough of them. I could never find the bacon in my pizza and sausage was scarce.  They do not use herbs in this place and charged me fifty cents for the basil I asked to add to my pizza!!! My friend's lasagna was a very small portion.

Love this place! Quality is consistent prices are reasonable, either eat in or take out.

I always get the pasta Bella, a pasta dish with a Rosa sauce and some mixed in seafood. Totally homey! 

 Husband loves the eggplant harm and or pasta all for now (pasta with some pepperoni and ground beef mixed together with cheese on top).

I love this place!! It's a great place for a double date. I raved about this place so we took our close friends here for dinner and everything was so delicious we all left happy!! Once added to the wait list we got to the restaurant and checked in and had a table in 5 minutes. I will be back.

Had Sunday off and decided to get a good work out before my family wake up..  When I showed up at 630am, several people was waiting for the gym to be opened.  This gym suppose opens at 6 am on Sundays but no one was there.   


 Wasted my time,  I went home instead.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Total dive, but the best Carne Seca I have ever had including El Charro! Nothing fancy just good food. The large tortillas are  so thin and delicious and their beans are incredible! Only reason I give it 4 intead of 5 stars is because of the dive...not the food. Exceptional

The sushi here is made to order so everything is fresh. You can order as much as you want and as often as you want. The Sushi chefs here are amazing and the food taste just just as amazing. This is my goto place for sushi because its all you can eat for one price.

David did a great job. This was one of the best pedicure I have ever had. I got the deluxe pedi with hot stones and an incredible massage for $30. Then he did a cute design I asked for using gel polish. They were friendly and I agree with the other reviews. He took his time. I will be back. Again and again and again.

I stopped in yesterday to the Neighborhood Cafe for breakfast and it was excellent. I had the meat lovers omelette with a biscuit and gravy. The meal came out quick and was delicious. The service and family atmosphere is great and look forward to coming one day.

I usually love checkers but this one was horrible! Rude workers who look like they hate their job. My burger had such a soggy bun that it was like mush.. They said they were out of lettuce and the apple pie had no apple in it! Just stay away from this place!

My favorite for frozen yogurt! Creamy. Nice range of flavors, but I love the vanilla and chocolate swirl. Topped with kiwi and raspberries! This location just reopened, they had closed for the winter. Happy they are back, and hard to beat the price, 25 cents an ounce on Thursday.

Pretty picky pizza guy...  First timer! Drive by it all the time. Went with the thin crust... it was actually very good. 

Only thing that I did not like was the cheese combination used. Did not know to specify what I wanted. But not a big deal! 

Will try again!

Food is FRESH, UNIQUE, and constantly changing in exciting ways! 4 stars because sometimes for the amount of food you get, the price is high...BUT it's all sustainable, fresh, animal friendly, clean food. They have a nice outdoor upstairs patio to enjoy a cold one and fresh dish on a nice Florida day.

I always find whatever I'm looking for and get rang up by friendly cashiers, even during the after work rush and that one crazy time when the credit card machine was down.

Make sure you check the monthly coupons so you don't miss out on some great savings!

Pros:
Taste for most flavors have been solid. Nothing that has been terribly disappointing. Slightly cleaner than most other froyo places I think.
Good location, b/c it's obviously at the mall.

Cons:
Not as fresh as Pinkberry b/c the toppings are all out in the open.
Kinda pricy but I guess every other froyo place is as well.

This is a good spot if you wanna chill with friends and dance to good music. However , you are able to smoke inside (not sure why) so by time you get home your pores hate you and you wreak of cigarettes. Variety of people and music and the drink prices are great.

One thing I was very disappointed about was the fact that the delivery man demanded a tip. The order already takes a delivery charge plus I charged a dollar on my card. He came to my door I gave him another dollar and he demanded another dollar. That's not cool. But the food was good. Chicken cheesesteak hoagie

Pitiful establishment. I like to get an unglazed doughnut with powered sugar. I've gotten this before with no problem but today the worker wasn't having it. I explained that I've gotten it before but the lady said she didn't care if another worker did it for me.

Always saw this place from the road every time we came to Walmart, and finally decided to give them a try. I had a large burrito and my wife had a chicken chimichanga. Both were good and the side queso dip was even better. Service was very friendly and prompt. Would definitely come here again!

Cluttered and unclean atmosphere. It was open on Easter and my fill in looked nice but it took a very long time.  One employee was eating McDonalds while another employee's daughter played loud music and danced around.  Would have been nicer if it was cleaner and quicker.

Desperately in need of updates!
I stay at Holiday Inn Express' a lot and this hotel is near the bottom, because the beds aren't up to HI standards and the bathrooms are small.
However, the location is excellent and the staff is friendly and accommodating .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Mediocre. I mean it gets the job done, and it's not bad, but it's just not that good. I asked for it well done, and ever though it was cooked 'well done', it was still soggy. The cheese was a bit chewy, the sauce watery, and overall a bit flavorless. I've been searching for the best pizza in my area and my search continues.

Food is ok, nothing I would go out of my way for. I ordered chicken parm. pasta. The chicken was SO thin and over cooked. It was dry and hard, felt like I could cut my gums just from chewing it. Their burgers are all right. The salads are better than the rest of their food although they are not always as described.

Great additions on the Octoberfest menu, some German specialties worth a try. And some new mixed drinks. Always a pleasure to visit with a very professional staff. The Happy Hour may get crowded some days but I'm always able to find a seat or table. Great for crowd watching, as well.

WOW.....$9.18 for a 10" foot long sub, no extra meat, no extra cheese. Subway was fresh and clean inside and the food tasted all right. Just can't believe their prices have jumped that high in the years. Much better foods to get for lunch for that price, including sit down restaraunts.

The best dinning experience I think I've ever had. We ordered the chefs tasting and our friends ordered the entire menu. I enjoyed tasting rabbit and goat for the first time. The chefs are accessible for questions and conversation. Great wine selection. I can't wait to return!

Real New York pizza.  I tried a slice of pepperoni and supreme.  The pepperoni was excellent but not as large as I had expected. The supreme was a bit disappointing as the toppings appeared meager. I highly recommend the pepperoni. Decent amount of off street parking. Service was good.

Place very rough, rough interior paneled walls bright lights, not cozy , rough crowd mediocre food . Dirty floor especially in kitchen cashier area , old food on ground.. pretty gross. like old dive hole on the wall. Dirty and just not comfy. Won't return.

Their pizzas are the best pizzas that have ever entered my mouth.
