I would swim naked through a lake of malaria-infested waters full of piranhas and glass shards just for a chance to thank the goats that produce their goat cheese.  Their beverage selection is also a solid 10/10.  (I know you're reading this, Chuck).

Very nice atmosphere, good food and reasonably priced bottles of wine. I enjoyed the pasta specialty trio. My wife chose the prime rib. Perfect! They offered some amazing specials but I had my heart set on pasta  I was not disappointed  I'll be back. They have 2 locations this review is for Ridge road

I give this place 5 stars because we had amazing service with a very down to earth and funny waitress who acted like she had known us forever and on top of that our food was absolutely delicious. I got the blackened grouper tacos and my boyfriend got the lobster roll. I would go back if I got the chance.

Took care of my issue, but what a pain in the ass .... What kind of socialist hell causes them to have you "make a appointment" just to talk with someone about your account.
If I didn't have a free account with Chase I wouldn't have any account.
The absolute worst customer service I've ever experienced by any branch.

Brought my old sleeping bag in to hopefully get cleaned. I was worried as it's old Army surplus from WWII ... the fill/stuffing is actually "scrap wool" according to the label. The cleaners did a awesome job, no it's not perfect, but that's not what I was expecting.  All for $30, very cheap price as far as I'm concerned.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I've visited twice now with my newly adopted pup and couldn't be happier with the service. Staff are very welcoming and patient, answering my endless new dog mum questions without any issue. I'm more than happy with the level of care and attention my dog received.

Look y'all --- sometimes I'd rather have these fries than a steak at Ruth's Chris. Don't lie - you love them as much as I do. The key is moderation. The short haired lady day manager is always very nice. After dark it's another story. Short on cash? They always have some kinda $2 meal that's not on the menu...

Just recently had a gathering with friends and wanted to order quesadillas. We called in to place our order and were told they don't deliver to Kirkwood. They clearly advertise on their homepage "We Deliver Everywhere!" yet they won't deliver to Kirkwood? Hmm...

Ice cream is good, but overpriced. Cash only seems a bit out of the ordinary when it is easy for companies to accept online payments. They were also out of featured flavors - about five at the time of my visit. At nearly $5 for a scoop in a cup, won't be coming back.

The service was good but I'm not sure if it's this location or all dunkin locations, however the avocado toast was inedible. On my first bite I gagged! The "avocado" tasted like rotten, sour lime. It didn't even remotely taste like avocado. I was super disappointed.

A charming byo pizza spot! Their pizza crust is perfect and they have a great variety of topping options. Our go-to is the cavolfiore. Fresh salads and friendly staff round out the always lovely experience at Spuntino! Great for date night, dinner with a friend, and small groups.

I'm a beer-drinker and when I feel like splurging and mixing a 6-pack, there's a plethora of beer to choose from. I'm willing to plunk down a few extra bucks if it results in good quality beer and supporting local business. The staff is super chill and know their stuff. Plus the new setup for tastings is worth checking out.

They do a decent job on the washes, especially the detail work. However they always try to up sell you and the glass repair guys are VERY aggressive, shaming you if you turn down their service. It makes me very uncomfortable. Hint: emotionally traumatizing your customers is not a sustainable business model.

Really, really love this bar. The drinks were great, just enough alcohol and not too expensive. Staff was pretty fast in serving us. The live music was what made us go in and it was so good it kept us in for a great number of hours. I would definitely visit the 21st Amendment again if we ever get to visit NOLA gain.

They perform good work on my dry cleaned pants and laundered shirts but their pricing went up again. I'm not sure why the Mandeville location is $17.95 for dry cleaning 4 items but their Metairie location is a full $2 less at $15.95
I'm going to bring my items to Premier Cleaners in Mandeville instead.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Nice drive-thru car wash. I've had zero issues with equipment harming my car during my weekly visits since early 2019. There's DIY cleaners and rags for your interior plus extended scrub handles for your front end exterior. Pro tip: get their coupons/deals on the Local Flavor app or the Pelican Pointe app.

Went there last weekend. Service was attentive and food delicious. We ordered a teriyaki dinner and dinner is served with soup, salad, and white or brown rice. Had enough salmon teriyaki to take home for a lunch the next day. We'll be back for sure and will order a couple sushi rolls too next time.

I've never had a problem but I usually have it delivered or pick it up. Driver is always friendly an the pizza isn't my first choice but ti not bad not bad at all. I went in once at lunch time and I do agree the salad bar was a mess, but it was a little after lunch time.

These hot dogs are okay.  But I didn't get the hype.  I also don't eat bacon so my hot dog wasn't bacon wrapped.  Perhaps that is the key here.  You must get a bacon wrapped dog to enjoy it bc otherwise it's just a regular hotdog with random toppings that did nothing for me.

I was disappointed - my first sushi experience in Edmonton and it was lacklustre. I had it for pick up, the rice was mediocre, I ordered the chirashi bowl, the fish was okay, the salmon seemed fresh but everything else was a guess. They also force you to tip even though they're cold and unwelcoming. Wouldn't return.

This place does not offer military discounts. This place I realize is good for quick washes only, and then you can go home and finish up the job yourself. I wouldn't waste my time spending money on the premium washes and services. I've been here about 4 times and each time I have to go behind and touch up.

As chains go, Anthonys is pretty good.  Thin crust pizza is done very well.  Service was very good and going on Fri night at 6PM, we were lucky to score table for 6 in five minutes, but we did and thanks Anthonys.  Service was very good.  Only gripe, noise - very noisy.

Wow,went to BK last night,and actually went inside.This place is rockin good.The place was busy,but very clean,and the staff was wonderful.

It was Whopper Wednesday,so I bought four of those,gave two to the homeless,and of course left my usual tip of $20.00 with the cashier.

Wonderful,wonderful,wonderful!

Incredibly underwhelmed! Way way overpriced for poor service, lack of amenities, and very uncomfortable small beds. Definitely not up to the standards of a supposed 4 star hotel. Wish I woulda stayed at the Westin, or hell, the La Quinta for that matter...rooms are similar but at least you get free breakfast there
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: New place behind Applebee's.  Clean, nice. Lunch buffet 5.99 and a huge menu. Only problem I had was that the food on the buffet was not hot enough, but the store had just opened at 11:00. Other than that which could just be a new opening adjustment process, the food was great and reasonably priced.

This place is absolutely amazing! It's the hidden gem of broadripple. The meat that they used for my carne asada was really seasoned and you don't get that everywhere. Everything was great about the place but beware of you go into the wee hours of the morning.....drunk crowd but well worth it!

Great place to watch football- lots of tvs. Good deals on beer. Watched the super bowl here. I ordered the French dip -pretty plain but ok. My husband ordered the burger and liked it I had broccoli on the side and it was surprisingly good for s bar. $4 bloody Mary's on Sunday were delicious. Fun place!!!

Firstly, let me say that a whole lot of the Chinese in St. Louis is bad.  Having said that, HKE is the best I've had.  I'd give it 4 stars, but they never have your order ready on time, they only accept cash, and they always charge you a dollar extra and act like you're crazy when you point that out.

Very very happy with our experience!!   We got the monster roll which was delicious and then two hibachi dinners.  The service was attentive and fast and the food very good.  My husband said several times that he can't wait to return. Definitely recommend!

Nancy is awesome!! Her employees on the other hand need a talking to. I was here today 9/29. The  female employees on shift were cussing and talking. Just standing around not doing much. They kept messing up orders. The 2 tall guys were fixing everything and working.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Good gym for just getting in and out.  Cool staff.  Not too crowded most of the time.  Recommend going either late morning, afternoon, or early evening.  Around 5 pm it gets crowded and believe it or not, it's crowded late at night around 9pm.  No frills gym, get in and get out.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Service is great. Vegas roll was delicious! The spicy noodles did not meet my expectations because I'm looking for Korean Jjampong flavor.. it lacked a little Korean taste for sure.. 
overall I give it a good review review because good is good! And my noodles tasted better once the flavor settled.

Absolutely a refreshing experience! Not to mention how fantastic their entire staff is so accommodating &  their work is impeccable I wish I could go there every day! My gel pedicure, best ever and my nails are perfect!!!  The prices are great and makes it afordable for what ever service you need

Thank you everyone 
Vicki Vierra

The food is heavily outclassed by chipotle and isnt wonderfully seasoned either especially not the guacamole. Atmosphere is below par the only leg up they have is their okay cookies you could get a much better cookie at a bakery thats cheaper too. Why would i want a cookie with mexican food by the way???

Great food but severely over priced. I used to be a regular customer but I can't justify their prices anymore. Would stay a regular customer if they weren't so over priced. Bummer. Maybe if enough people stop eating there because of the extreme prices they will adjust them.

Nice fatty gross rude employees is White Castle. But i only go for the tiny burgers. The rest doesn't matter. Food is sooooo good! But don't eat too much. Could spend a lot of time on the toilet! Please bring back the ranch chicken rings!!! They gave me life!!

Used this location several times n each time I've just bout had to take out a bank loan!!!  Plus the "keep on coming back", check charge.  This was before Yelp, now I've found a perfect match for us reasonable prices for excellent care n health checks.  Good Vet's are worth there weight n gold.

Things have changed. This place use to be my favorite. So good and fast. Every time I go there it's a completely new staff and they seem to get younger and dumber every time. The food isn't even the same. It's so bland now. No worth the wait or the hassle of dealing with the young staff who are definitely not trained.

6 people sitting at the cash register and nobody is here taking orders. How long does it take to fill up a cup of coffee!!!!! If I was the owner I'd shut this location down until they can get good enough help to work here. This is an unmanageable disaster in here! Will never come back!

Inexpensive and really easy. Great buffalo chicken pizza. Salads are large and their balsamic dressing is terrific.  One good thing is that you see the entrees before you order them.  Stand in line service.  It's easy, fast and prices can't be beaten. Ample parking.

This restaurant has been around forever.  It is a bit dark on the inside.  The good is only fair.  We had many appetizers and most are bout the best. The drink menu is fine. Service was quite good. The atmosphere is friendly and welcoming. I would recommend it for that.  But not if you want a meal that tastes great.

Welp, today marked my last day ever eating at this Wendy's. Against my better judgement I figured I'd go through the drive thru on my lunch break (even though it's known to be slow as Christmas). I got a grilled chicken wrap and some fries and after eating 90% of the wrap I noticed a black curly hair at the bottom of it...

The beer, the music and the atmosphere is great but the smell of smoke gets to you after being there awhile. We had to leave. Once we got back to the hotel our clothes smelled like smoke, not good. Too bad they allow smoking, we would have stayed for another beer. Too bad.

Great ambiance, ok food, ok service. I have tried for many years to like Guadalajara Grill. But I must come on the wrong day every time. The food is never fantastic, just ok. The service is slow and I literally lose my appetite when silverware is dirty. The atmosphere is great, but I can't seem to get that wow feeling here.

A go to pizza favorite of our's. I love the crisp thin crust and the sauce and toppings are always fresh. 
Great atmosphere and very friendly waitstaff. 
There is sometimes a small wait for seating but that goes to show you that their food is highly desired. I often recommend this restaurant to pizza lovers like myself.

This is such a neat little place. So convenient for anyone. They have a deli for Lunch and  it's delicious. I got 2 chicken tenders (they are huge) and 2 sides with bread for 7.99. It was wonderful. So fresh and they offer dipping sauce. This is rare haha. It was great and I'll be back.

Different and unusual tastes, each more exciting than the one before.  Had to allow myself exceptions to any dietary restrictions for the evening (I do not pork), but when in Rome !  And they were as accommodating as possible.  A wonderful experience, 500%.

Fresh and delicious food, authenticity really comes through.  Great drinks, decent service.  I've eaten there about five times now and have yet to have a bad meal.  The enchiladas are amazing, soups and salads will make your taste buds sing.  And the desserts are very good (esp the crema de olla).

Four stars for the ladies that work there, because they remember me by name even though I only come in four or five times a year.  Four stars for their laundry and dry cleaning.  Two stars for their clothing repair.  I've started taking my repairs to an alterations person.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: GREAT NEW JAPANESE RESTAUTANT  The food was excellent-- wonderful Sushi and Hibachi dishes. The management and staff are extremely friendly, the service was very good. The surroundings are tasteful and extremely clean. I highly recommend this place. Plus, the prices are VERY reasonable. DONT MISS THIS GEM!!!

This is a great place to take your car for repairs! The 
prices are reasonable, the work is great and the place is spotless, which is something I look for because it shows the owner is organized and cares about his business and customers. Also they are great about getting the work done quickly. Thanks guys!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Like Chipotle for Pizza.  Interesting concept, but only 2 stars because it's overpriced for mediocre pizza.  Essentially you end up paying about $10 for the equivalent of 2 regular slices of pizza.  It's not bad, it's just ok and the price pushes the rating down for me.

If you don't mind waiting forever (even when it's just you in line inside), stop in and eat here. No matter who is working, it seems like it takes 30 minutes to get the whole meal. You either wait for the fries or the drink. I don't understand it. You would think with the remodel, they would be sharp and quick. Nope.

We go here once a month to wash our car.  I love that they have a shampoo machine for your car.  My seats were so stained from years of going on coffee runs for work and spilling all over.  After 3 or 4 trips of scrubbing, my seats look brand new and my car looks 5 years younger! I also love that they take credit cards!

Stay away from this place. Horrible food prep and contamination potential. Watched them place bread directly on the food prep table while cleaning the table with a dirty rag. Cleaned the surfaces above the food prep area sweeping crumbs and whatever directly into food being prepped. I couldn't eat my food.

Nehaya is an awesome stylist! Gives you exactly what you want and will tell you if the haircut you want will suit you. She's super friendly and amazing at what she does. Very passionate about hair! Place is clean, friendly staff, and uses quality products.

Good food and ok service.  Very slow. Apologetic and friendly but still slow.  Sat outside which was a bad decision.  Way to close to the street and the traffic was so loud we couldn't even have a conversation. And the smell of exhaust fumes was enchanting!  Won't do that again.  Do NOT get seated outside. It's awful.

Honestly...I just wanted an ice  coffee and what I got was unexplainable. I don't know what it is but it tasted like fake syrup with a tiny bit of coffee mix with orange juice. Terrible! The customer service was terrible as well.  Will never come back here ever again.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I was just getting home and thinking I would love a good hamburger. then I thought I love checkers hamburgers. I got sad because the checkers in Carrolwood has gotton so bad. the last time I was there I had to go back through  the drive thru to get my money back. How sad for Carrolwood when I used to love going there.

Food was alright however in the Italian market you could easily find much better. The wait was short but there were only two other tables filled. They only accepted cash which was annoying because the ATM didn't work and we had to go next door for money. Not a bad experience but not a perfect one

I have come here for at least 6 years and never have had a bad meal or dish.  The prime rib ravioli is amazing so is the fried calamari.  The servers are really helpful and nice.  Much better deal than many of the other Italian restaurants great food really reasonable prices.

i was having a "need pizza attack" so i jumped in the car and stopped by this store.  All the help were very helpful and friendly.  I wanted a thin crust pizza so i need to was just a few minutes for it to be made.  When the urge strikes again i'll certainly have Little Caesars on my list.

got a living social deal so decided to give this place a try... Overall food was not bad but was not spectacular... Our server Anthony was very friendly and did his best to provide fast service even though they were understaffed. I definitely will give this place another shot, seems to have great potential.

Love this place! The service is always good and the food is worth the price. 9.99 for the burrito Loco with rice or beans! The refried beans with cheese on them are one of my faves! The chips and queso is also a winner. I ordered their Bahama Mama today and it was heavenly. I would definitely recommend this place! Go!!

Absolutely amazing boutique hotel, the ambiance is beautiful. This place has modern nicely decorated furniture and full service bar in the lobby. The rooms are cozy and spacious but i stayed in a suite though. I will definitely stay here again and recommend others to try this place out.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I only had tried the pizza here. I would recommend the four cheese sausage pizza to cheese lover. I also like the plain cheese pizza with tomato base and mushroom tomato based pizza. The pizza is serve in large portion size with sensible price. The best pizza I have had in university city so far.

Worst McDonald's I've ever been to. The playground was dirty. We asked if they would wash a table for us, and they just have us a blank look, so we washed them ourselves. The playground itself was all greasy. Also, they didn't give us all of our order, and they didn't care.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: On a recent visit, the aforementioned waiter was gracious, kind, and went out of his way to see that my friends and I were well treated. Either he read this review or recognized me from the last visit. Either way,  the review, and the waiter, deserve an upgrade.

Delip, Victor, and the whole Big Brand Tire crew on Milpas continue to impress and far exceed all expectations for tire/car service... Much better than the anonymous car care provided by dealerships (steal-erships)... Great Service, Low Prices, AWESOME Value... Highly Recommended!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Delivery was very timely, but the 6 inch meatball sub was way overpriced for what I got, the Falafel balls were cold, which I have never seen before at other places, as well the Salad had the wrong Dressing.  Not pleased overall.  I should have stuck with piiza, which is also overpriced compared to other restaurants locally.

I have to say this has always been my favorite location. Good food and fast service. But after the breakfast I got friday, my feelings have changed. The quality just wasnt where it should of been. Hard busquits, greasy undercooked hashbrowns just not what I expected.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Fatty American Food and Pictures of Peach Long Island Iced Teas, Yes please!  During my research at IUPUI, I spent a few nights with at this Houlihans laughing it up with their awesome bar tenders, and order some huge platter of nachoes, and hot wings.  I liked it, I just wish parking was a little easier.

I've owned 8 pets over 4 decades now and my experiences at Dr. Kathy's have all been excellent.

The doctor and her staff are knowledgeable, efficient, thorough, and patient.

Their prices are also very reasonable.

I am very lucky to have such quality of vet care nearby.

Wow.... First time takeout the other night...had both a red and white...Both were excellent and immediately ranked in my top 5 ever... Crust was crispy but not too thin as to become a cracker...the sauce was very tasty and the white had just the right amount of oil and garlic... will be back very soon..

This place is so hip I thought I was in Portland, OR for a moment. I should've worn skinny jeans and brought my Macbook Air.

Intriguing food/alcohol menu. Small Plates (appetizers) were just okay. The burger was decent but not particularly amazing given the price. I liked their ketchup.

Horrible, I'm so disappointed how this place has changed. Our server Maddie. Was the worst server I have ever had anywhere. We've been going here for years. The last few times it has been disappointing due to the changes in food but we went back tonight and now we will never go back!

Ambiance. Service. FOOD. what more can you ask for? The margaritas are the best and the tacos are to die for! Oyster/falafel taco and grilled Mexican corn (I ask for it off the cob in a bowl - lime, cayenne and cotija) SO GOOD! Also doesn't hurt that the staff are very good looking!

Highly recommended!  My husband and I, along with another couple all ordered specials that were available that day, and WOW, talk about delicious!  We ordered some appetizers as well as a bottle of wine.  This place did not disappoint.  If I am in the area again, I would definitely go back!

Honestly the best cup of coffee I have ever had. Weird tucked away location in Nashville- but definitely worth the visit. I got the Colombian and was blown away. Im typically not one for bougie coffee options, but this has changed my mind about them significantly. Nice place to do homework.

The location is clutch. And i was honestly surprised by how good the food is. Hot dogs and/or sausage is the way to go and yeah girlfriend likes the chicken salad whick comes as an actual salad with fruit and crackers and stuff.  Plus the staff has always been friendly and quick.

Clean room.  Nice bed.  Good WiFi.  Tv was nice.  However the rooms are poorly sound proofed.  Had a room on the rear side of the building and heard every sound from traffic.  If it were quieter, it would have gotten four or five stars.  Woke up to an ambulance going down the pike.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I love the sushi here! The fish is very very fresh and you can tell. It is a very small place with limited seating but the service is good and quick. I like that it is also a BYOB. I do find that they rush you out a bit as the restaurant is very small but the fresh fish is worth the rush!

I've always liked going there for a quick and quiet place for sushi but I hadn't been able to go for over a year. I went last night and it was even better than I remembered! The sushi was fresh and better than good! The staff was attentive, friendly and accomodating! Great job!

I haven't tried too many dishes. ..but the ones I have were delicious.   I love that they do special requests.  I am a fan of calimari and they have a spicy fried fish dish and I get it with calimari.  Something different from the average American Chinese fare.

We drive by 3 sushi restaurants to go to Sakana! The fish is fresh and the service is friendly. I have never had to wait for my next roll without our chef asking " can I get you something next". This Sakana is a lot faster than the Sakana in Somerset! Good job!

Good solid local spot to get diner or a burger and you will get good service and solid food...don't expect a five star meal...but if you want a great beer...they have a wonderful selection and really nice food that is a step up from bar food...but you can have that too.  Love this place, its just comfortable.

This is the worst Mexican restaurant in Nashville. The food is gross! The service is terrible. I  will never ever return. When my issues were brought to the managers attention he was rude and offered to give me a refund instead of fixing the mistakes they made with my food. The worst overall experience I have ever had.

Taste? Great! I want more and all I ordered was the beef chow mein! Now for the bad ( and why it is not a higher rating). What kind of restaurant send the customer away with their take out and NO UTENSILS. As I sit here at my destination trying desperately to eat how chowmein with only my fingers my ire increases.

Do not go here!  This sushi place is a nightmare.    Sushi was awful and the owner doesn't know anything about Sushi.  Dont waste your money just go to fulins or wasabi if you are craving sushi in the providence area.  It is the worst run asian  food I have ever eaten.

I go to this branch quite often and love it! The tellers are wonderful! 
There is usually a line on Friday afternoons, but it goes pretty quickly. Other than that, there's not usually too much of a wait. 
They have complementary coffee, I've never had it, but it's there. 
Every experience I've had with this branch has been great!

Being kind. Had the buffet a couple of days before Christmas. Very limited and way overpriced. 12:30 and half of the items were missing. Pitiful example. Only went because we were in hurry and didn't want to wait at Irea's. Next time we will wait. 

The Unknown Diner says, 
Their buffet stinks.

First time here and it was really delicious. The service was friendly and knowledgeable too. I have food allergies and I'm vegan. She knew just the things I could have. I had soup and sushi wrapped in rice paper. They both were very tasty. I hope to be back. Thank you.

Was really hungry for guacamole and queso so asked the owner for a dish with both.  Chicken nachos it is.  Only thing is, I asked for carry out and two things happened.  No guacamole to be found, and was charged .30 cents for carry out.  Not cool since there was no signage for a surcharge.

Amazing Roasted Chicken with fresh mushrooms and squash. Excellent service. Great craft menu and cocktails as well. Management was always around and constantly checking in on our table. It was very nice not annoying. Will definitely be back to try more of what seems to be a rotating seasonal menu.

I've never had a vet who makes house calls -- this is definitely the best service Pennridge provides! It's so affordable, and it puts humans and animals alike at ease. Their tender, knowledgeable staff felt like part of the family as soon as they walked through the door.  These guys are just the best!!!

Went today for the first time. I love supporting local businesses and trying coffee from non chain places. The breakfast sandwich were excellent. Will come back. 

Was disappointed though that the guy taking the orders was very close to the cars and not wearing a mask. Very important during this pandemic.

I've used this enterprise location for a rental several times (the most recent being 8/20 to 8/29). Each time I've been greeted with a smile which might seem trivial but goes a long way with this girl) and professionalism. Every car I've rented has also been clean which is another win for me. I'd highly recommend this location.

Overall the experience was only okay the food was okay the service was okay. I would also like to touch on the point that it is against the rules for only one person at the table to order the all-you-can-eat if one person orders it everybody has to order it which is a ridiculous if you ask me

Excellent authentic Italian. Great service no liquor license so bring wine. Mozzarella wheel of fab as an app as well an the meatballs. But I'd recommend the meatballs for dinner. Chicken parm is great too.   Service is excellent. May want to make reservation

The wild grilled salmon over asparagus and risotto was bland. The risotto could have used a pinch of salt. The asparagus was too burnt for my taste.

The fresh bread was great.

The duck meatballs were mushy and the sauce was too salty,  otherwise,  I would give this place 3 stars.

This place is my go to place! The trainers kick my ass every time I go in and I wouldn't have it any other way. Instead of wandering around and trying to think of things to do it's structured for you! I call this place my second home! If you hate regular gyms then you will love it here!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: We came across this restaurant by accident, but were glad we did.  The food was kind of eclectic and different and a bit expensive, but all in all we were glad we went there.  The waitress was very nice and went out of her way to make us comfortable. Not sure if we would go back again, but it was a pleasant experience.

Still my favorite sushi place in the city but can struggle with consistency. Reasonable corkage, friendly and knowledgeable staff, and a fun, modern, yet somehow intimate-feeling ambiance make this place a winner aside from the food. Best fish selection you'll find outside of Manhattan, and a great saké list. A definite winner.

Great spot for a simple unassuming burger with a nice flavor. The onion rings were awesome- crunchy with a nice thick slice of onion inside; they taste homemade. The service was spot on- very nice, warm and friendly. Great prices too. No wonder the place is packed!

Good enough sushi.  Great seaweed salad, liked the addition of cucumber. But the age dashi tofu was eh, pieces were too big, the batter to heavy.  Also, I ate by myself so they put me at a small table right next to the coca cola fridge, even though it was after 9 pm and there were many other open tables.

Worst wend's i have ever been too. The staff are rude and completely unprofessional.  There manager is the worst.  I love Wendy's salads but frankly it's not worth going here to get it. I recommend everyone stay away from this place until the owner realizes that customer service is just as important and the name.

Decided to sit in Narwhals and order from here. Everything my friends ordered was delicious.  My favorite had to be the dessert nachos- the smores.  The cinnamon chips were delicious.  We also had the other dessert ones which were good as well. 

Pulled pork served on potato chips with sliced pickles - so good!!

I would recommend!

The portions are tiny and the food is very expensive. I can't say the food wasn't good but it definitely was not anywhere near as special as the restaurant staff believes it is.

The atmosphere is the real killer here. From the staff to the lingo to the decor etc this entire place is just outright hipster nonsense full stop!

This is a nice place to go and hang out with my buddies.  Generally I find the service good, but there has been a few times where I think I had to wait longer that I should.  The food is  like any other Boston Pizza place (it's not fancy, but good comfort food in my opinion).  I enjoy eating their Boston Royal pizza!

Great service! food is so-so. I had salmon and saba nigiri and a spider roll. Very nice people but for the price I wouldn't risk the food quality being the same as it was today. Again it's not bad. With me sushi is either wow, ok or no thanks. This was ok.

I am new to Delaware and wanted to find a good restaurant to celebrate a birthday. This place blew me away. From the waiter to the drinks, appetizer, meal and dessert it was hands down the best food and experience I have had from a restaurant! I would recommend this place to everyone.

Seasonally open and has more interesting ice cream flavors than a traditional chocolate strawberry vanilla place. A personal favorite is the tirimisu ice cream that has real bits of ladyfingers in the ice cream. I live so close,  I'll be popping in this summer

Not impressed.  Food was blah and service wasn't much better.  Also, I thought the food was waaay over-priced.  We were sat in the corner with a weird view of the kitchen and the fluorescent lights from the kitchen shined in my eyes.  Not a good experience.

There are so many choices at the mall, don't waste your time at Boston.

Hubby got the No. 7.  Roast pork, Peking duck and broccolini over white rice.  Everything was just ok.  Not ugh!, but not wow!, either.  Hubby says would have given a 4, but they microwaved it...I would have given it a 2, but I didn't order it...I ordered Scraple with home fries at the Amish breakfast place-see next review.

I enrolled at 12 th and market with city wide option and clearly this location is below my expectations. They don't even have shower towels  and most of the time they have no towels at all. The personnel at the reception is nice but cannot help amd say " it's not my fault". Embarrassing. Will probably not renew
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: We'd been walking along the harbor and pier and wanted to rest and have a cold beverage. Asked for iced tea- nope. They only have hot tea, but they have iced coffee. Really? You can't turn a hot tea into an iced tea? Barista just gave me a bored look. She was more concerned with chatting with her friend. Lame.

We tried Cucina Forte for the first time last week . What a terrific restaurant. The food was delicious! Our waiter Vinnie was very enthusiastic and extremely competent. He recommended the gnocchi, an excellent choice. The best in Philadelphia. I can't wait to eat there again.

My go-to sushi joint. Absolutely adore their nigiri and rainbow roll. Each roll comes with miso soup or soybeans to start you off while you wait. You get seated right when you walk through the door- even during happy hour/ lunch hour. Amazingly, your food comes out fast, and doesn't break the bank. Highly recommend!

Stayed here because our group didn't want to deal with the crowds at the casino down the road. Typical prices for Marriott. Room was beautiful and comfortable. Lots of space for three gals to do hair and makeup. Staff was friendly. And we were able to get tasty coffee to get us going the next morning.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Consistently disappointing. However, not a bad place to grab a beer and watch an eagles game.

The wing special during games is not actually a special... It's just a smaller portion for a little less money, and the wings still cost a dollar a piece. Don't be fooled!

Did a family pizza bundle and we were pretty disappointed. Pizza was chewy and no one was interested in second slices. Garlic knots with cheesy sauce was a nice option, and the salad was fine. Kind of a "meh" experience though the carry-out process was smooth and the servers were perfectly nice. Food just wasn't very good!

I'm so happy I found this place! Everyone is so friendly and their drinks are so good. I like the blue lady with white chocolate and oatmilk. I got that based on their recommendation-- so good! If you're in the midtown area, I definitely recommend this place.

Great Little breakfast and lunch spot. I really love their shrimp burger and I have a hard time ordering a thing else. However, everything I've tried has been fantastic. The place is always clean, and the service is good. Wish they were open for dinner too

My coworkers and I have gone here several times for lunch. We kept coming back because the sushi is so good and we love the lunch combo specials. The past few times the service has been worse and worse, especially from the hostesses. We decided after the last visit to look for somewhere else to get sushi nearby.

Yikes!  I've never had sushi that actually tasted rotten, until here.  And then the chefs insisted it was fresh?  I've never left sushi on my plate, but I was not willing to go back for a second bite.  
Interior booths are sweet. The young blond server was adorable with great service. Hope he finds a better restaurant!

Cute little India store with nice people. Fair amount to pick from . Call on certain days they may have rotis or samosas that are fresh that day . Prices are decent and fair. It's a small store so they might not have everything you are looking for but they have most.

Pretty good for the price . My husband enjoys their pizza . I'm not huge fan it doesn't taste like real pizza to me more like the fast food pizza like another dominos and Pizza Hut kind of pizza . I'm not huge fan of sauce either . But like o said their a good fast food pizza good for the price .

Was disappointed with the quality of the coffee served here, even though they are supposed roast their own beans. We actually had their coffee at another independent cafe in Philly and it was much better, so maybe the barista skill is lacking? Nice atmosphere and convenient location though.

Overcrowded with high school kids and a manager that hits that annoying lunk every 5 seconds, but I guess that's what you get for $10. The least the manager could do is to be in shape...what the hell...she is the manager of gym. What message does that send to patrons looking like a bowling ball with legs!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Fabulous European frames that you won't find in generic eye glass places like LensCrafters or Pearl vision.  A wee bit pricey --- but for a great look, excellent customer service --- aren't you worth it?
Staff is meticulous making sure frame suits your face & your lifestyle.  You deserve it!!!!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: BYOB - that's a positive; Fresh pasta - 'nother positive; unobtrusive, very good service - one more positive; tables too close - NEGATIVE (I didn't want to hear the fight about why somebody wouldn't go to dinner w/other somebody's parents). I'll go back definitely - - - - -  but maybe with earplugs

Very clean, affordable and kid friendly. Breakfast selection (which is included in price is great!) hotel is well located in walking distance to great restaurants. You do have to pay extra for valet parking (this is not an option) but it is a great hotel all and all.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Loved the stay here. Super clean, great location. No charge for parking, great size rooms and the balcony was super big with a great view! Staff was friendly and helpful Jeff and Shelley were great! My only complaint, the bistro was not open all day, it had weird hours of operation like 6am-10am then 5pm-10pm.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Poor skills but cheap. Worst hair cut experience ever. If you are used to Japanese and Korean style salon OR you are used to seeing a Japanese or Korean stylist, I would definitely tell you not to go there. He is a nice guy, but the salon is poorly equipped.

This is a brand new restaurant. I ordered a couple of rolls and they were not wrapped/constructed well- tasted good. I would say the service is quite efficient. They have lunch specials that are quite reasonable. The menu overall is diverse and very reasonably priced. Good luck.

One word. Claudia. The nastiest hostess in town. Here we are on Xmas Eve and she verbally spanked me no our party was down 1 person. Food was excellent the service was excellent but this woman set the tone for the evening . If this review were just for the food it would be five stars.

I was very excited to try this new Italian restaurant as there are limited options on the beach here for a good Italian food. This restaurant comes up short. The pizza is admittedly frozen and the food in general that I ordered was terrible. I would much rather be anywhere else but here at this price point.

I love this location!!!   Really convenient.   Melissa is my favorite.   She always fusses over my pugs when I bring them to the drive though.    She even draws puggy faces on the coffee lids sometimes.   All the employees are friendly and I can not recommend this Starbucks enough.

Employees were friendly and manager was attentive to customers getting the right order. Dining room needed attention especially the drink stand and the trash can  near the front of the restaurant. Fries were hot. Bun on the double cheeseburger was getting old.

Another expensive lunch at one of the vendors at Hunters Station. I had high hopes for the tomato soup but it was just plain; I would not order it again. It was served piping hot - no complaints there. There was nothing outstanding about the grilled cheese sandwich except for the cost!

Gave a tip and really shouldn't have . Nice server but asking for a cup of hot coffee and getting a cold cup because someone forgot to put on the warmer sucks. Normally our go to place but came after 1 pm so probably weren't expecting requests for hot cups. Shame!

Closest Dunkin to our vacation home so use it a lot. Today July 4th decaf coffees not hot as requested and they did not honor the AARP discount of a second donut free but gave 5% discount off bill, far less than the value of the donut. Not a very friendly staff even with the Manager Rachael there.

This is mediocre for a Mexican restaurant. I went with a group of coworkers and we had good service over lunch. However the food was less than impressive. There wasn't a lot of flavor which is one of the reasons that I want Mexican food! They did have queso so that helped but I just wasn't that impressed.

Starbucks is A-OK Starbucks the only thing I do not like about Starbucks they need to keep their counters clean and keep your floors and bathrooms clean it gets mad when you make the drink wrong and asked to remake it just my point of you other than that I love it

Every time I hear someone is going to New Orleans, I always recommend going to tropical isle and ordering a shark attack.... I never tell them anything more. Haha! But seriously I would choose the shark attack over the grenade. The grenade is pretty sweet but is refreshing. The shark attack is tasty and pretty hilarious

The pizza here is delicious. I'm a thin-crust kind of girl so I'm not usually a fan of deep-dish pizza but the pizza from CDDP is awesome. The price point leaves a little to be desired as does the storefront location but the food was great. Fresh made with tons of cheese.

Not every Macaroni Grille is the same. This location in Brandon must be one of the poorest performing. Went with the family,and the food was universally bland. This included the breaded Veal, the Fetucchini Alfredo. Even my favorite M. Grille dish- the Penne Rustica seemed off color.

Expensive. But who cares if the food is good!  Ordered a Chicken Francaise and Baked Ziti.  The Ziti was overlooked and hard. The Francaise was so lemony, it was like having lemon aioli sauce on the rocks!  Ok, the chianti was good, but not sure if the chef made that one.... So, disappointing to say the least.

As a virgin to hibachi, unfamiliar culinary experiences  can be daunting. Yet, Yokohama treated me with special care and gentleness. Fresh vegetables and tender meat made for a pleasantly surprising meal. I'm not much for theatrics, but the chef was amiable and generous, which eased my nerves. Never judge a book by its cover.

delivery guy was a total a hole..... starts yelling to come outside and get my delivery. but i told him that i couldn't cause i worked at a building and he starts again and saying come get your food now...... so i told him to keep the food and thanks for the great service......

I ordered an orange blossom roll, a shrimp tempura roll and a California roll. Everything was decent, but in the menu it states the orange blossom roll comes with eel sauce and massago, but it didn't. It also states the California comes with massago and it didn't. It was very disappointing to not get what I was expecting.

Our go to workplace Chinese lunch delivery and take out spot.  My fave is the Garlic sauce with vegetables and veggie fried rice, with no meat.  I find their meat to be rubbery so I only do vegetables here.  The wonton soup has a very dark meat inside also.  Lunch box deals come with in entree and soup or drink for about $6.

Had i not already paid for my food and the car behind me i would have drove off. Its 3am Thursday  july7 2016 I guess the poor girl is cooking by herself. Get her some help.   a car in front of me and about 5behind me have began to blow the horn. I chose to stop here Because of the 24hr drive thru and fast service.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I've been a long time customer but since the elderly boss lady no longer comes in things are starting to slide. Present owners have an opportunity to save this old Boise establishment, its up to them. I suggest moving to a another location and start fresh, clock is ticking Golden Star anybody home?

Not real sure what the buzz is all about here?  The pizza itself was super greasy but the sauce tasted good, very saucy.  I looked through all the raving reviews and figured I could not go wrong here.  Well, I feel like I went wrong.  Also, why in the hell do they not take a credit card or debit card?!?  its 2015, get with it!!!!!

Not a bad place for breakfast at all. I found the prices to be reasonable and the food was very good. I had their biscuits and gravy and ended up being pretty impressed. I also snagged a bite of my wife's chicken fried steak and thought that it was very tasty as well. Service was good too so no complaints there!

Nice place decor is interesting, the food was pretty average the alfredo sauce was the usual bechemel with cheese and became a little pasty before I was done. My wife had the stuffed manicotti and found it tasty but not remarkable. Service was good , overall not an unpleasant eperience.

The service is terrible here. We went for a friend's birthday and we had to ask for every single thing - menus, water, wine opened, silverware, plates, etc. It's a shame because the sushi is actually pretty good. Never going back here again. There are too many good BYOB sushi restaurants in this city to waste money on a bad one.

Had a great meal with family. The fresh mozzarella appetizer with avocado was phenomenal! I love how friendly the staff is. They are knowledgeable and go out of their way to make sure you enjoyed your meal. Prices are reasonable and BYOB is a major plus! This place is a hidden gem.

Terrible sushi. Stale fish (we actually fell sick after eating it). "Chef's special" had some peculiar combinations, with Mexican hot sauce and what-nots. It gets 2 stars only because of the friendly service we got. 

Or maybe I am just used to good sushi - coming from the coast - and should not expect stellar sushi in the desert.

Nothing more then a regular Arby's but clean and friendly

I found this place from a coupon wanted to try it and oh my lady ga ga the guys here are awesome, the service was great and the food was hot and delish so needless to say this is my place for now on

Clean, a/c, non smoking, lots of washer sizes. Not crowded. 
Only drawback for me is dryers run in 10 minute increments, so you have to babysit them constantly instead of going across the street to Llewellyn's pub for a cold brew. 
Otherwise... I'm a happy launderer!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Pretty good sushi!! LOVED the vampire bowl that is a must when you go. The tuna pizza was ehh. It's texture was a little off and it just wasn't amazing. The France roll is delicious as is the KK. Wait staff was extremely friendly so that's a huge plus! Overall pretty good sushi and would go back if we're in the area.

A small place, so the menu is limited in comparison to the larger establishments in town. The quality is excellent., you won't be disappointed. The wine steward knows his stuff.  You can get a table on a weekend. Hard to find though. Hidden in a hotel with no Iris signage.

C'est beau, c'est sobre, c'est branché.
Et forcément, un peu overpricé, mais ça n'est pas un frein.

L'ambiance est agréable : amicale et studieuse à la fois. Les mochas sont un peu trop sucrés à mon goût, mais le cookie m&ms peanut butter vient rattraper cette petite déception. Une tuerie !

I grew up in Ga and these were as popular as mcdonalds. 
I absolutely love them and I've passed that on to my children.
Sadly, there are only two locations in Tampa and neither are near me. 
I love the soggy bread, the mustard and pickles. Goodness in a tiny burger.
The staff was friendly for being a fast food joint..

Probably the worst sub I had here. The two ladies here are degrading the name of subway. They don't understand the offers which are written in English. I had a coupon which says any footlong sub for $5 but these uneducated ladies could not understand what it is and I have to pay the full price.

Oh my! I have an MSG allergy and I have a real hard time when I go out . Chef Nate outdid himself . I ordered MAHI MAHI grilled and green beans with squash as  the sides . The fish was grilled to perfection ! I literally teared up . Dining out can be a nightmare . This night was a dream come true . Ia true gem on Hernando Beach

Exquisite most indubitably! I especially loved the yellow tail. Best I've had. 

The presentation was good as was the service. Very intimate setting but not too overwhelming. I will definitely be returning many times. 

Highly recommend - Sushi Nara is the goto place to hit.

It is a gas station Subway so occasionally the menu is limited. 

When they get busy,  they struggle to get the orders correct. 

This morning, there were 3 customers yet, 8 of the 12 tables had crumbs on them.

The Subway a mile down the street is a better option.

How can you go wrong with endless hibachi and Chinese food?

The prices are fantastic for the quality and quantity.

The staff is generally engaged and friendly.

I only wish they could bring the second, third, fourth, fifth, etc servings a little faster so I could gluttonously stuff myself before realizing I am full.

The best Pizza in Narberth (that's a low bar). Rather then ripping on these guys for being a very middle of the road of Pizza place, It's fairer to praise them for running a clean and consistent Pizza joint. If you want to grab a slice with your kids this is a great option.

Food was pretty good but the service was terrible. Waiter was rude, impatient and pushy. Forget about getting a refill on your wine. Our waiter disappeared and it took a long time just to get the check and they couldnt even get that right. First impressions are everything and i will not be returning...

I can't help but write this. This pizza is terrible. I tried it 2x now. The 1st time being 2 years ago. And i think it is worse since then. It literally has no flavor. I had to add garlic powder and that didn't help so i poured the ranch and hot sauce on it.

I love this little place! The tenderloin steak bowls are more than enough for one person and it tastes good. Food always comes out hot and fresh, only downfall is that it can take a while and occasionally the owners kids run around and beat on the bathroom door while I'm in it. Lol overall worth it for the price!!!

Today was thē worst fu-king pizza. Shitty job! I'm going to give them a break and start going to Pizza factory The Pizza was poor quality. I don't know if it was that particular shift. But they just did a horrible job. Got that piece about 5:15 P Either they were high in there or just plain stupid.

Our first visit was Valentines Day and the place was packed and really loud. The server was very nice and attentive but the food was nothing special. I got rigatoni bolgenase and the wife had shrimp scampi and we both thought  it was OK but we thought it was a little over priced given the quality.

I love San Carlos! The food is worth the wait. I go at least once a week and I love their soups (cheese/potato)! Everything there is good and I would highly recommend this for breakfast, lunch, dinner or a snack!
They do have a reputation for being very slow which probably hurts their business.

My favorite pizza spot since moving to Marlton. I judge places on their plain pizza, and Angelo's is spot on. They have these special buffalo-ish fries that are fantastic. A little sweeter than buffalo sauce usually is (which I prefer), and with ranch dressing drizzled on too.

A little underwhelming. The tortilla was stale and the meat was nothing special. The service was nice,  the chips and salsa were fresh, and the cocktails were nice. I'd give it another shot some day. 

Things to know:
1. The parking can be a bit confusing if you're going in a group. I parked in the back and walked to the front.

Don't waste your time or money. The service was terrible. The server wasn't friendly. The guac had too much cilantro and we had to send it back. I've never sent guac back in my life. The burrito was average but terribly overpriced. Do yourself a favor, skip Chulas and make the drive down to Los Vallartas.

First time using this location, and I've got to give them five stars. On a miserable day (95 degrees and humid) they provided me a rental, where other locations were out of cars. The guy that helped me (forgot his name!) was awesome, quick and accurate, and extremely customer centric. Kudos!

I have tried several stylists and they do great work.  However, there is a level of professionalism lacking starting at the front desk.  Calling to make or change an appointment can be such a hassle. 

While waiting, several stylists spent time negatively complaining about a customer.  This is very unprofessional.

The sushi was average sushi and nothing spectacular.  However, it was fresh. The service was great. I am giving 2-stars, because the restaurant was dirty, and the restrooms were disgusting. They really should clean the place up if they want people to feel comfortable.

Again had a superlative dinner at Anthony's in Downingtown! I can't believe this place is actually in the boro! The food was great, and our server Katie did a wonderful job of looking after us last night. Such a sweetie she is! I also really enjoy the decor in there!.......very nice things to look at as your eyes wander around!

The menu has burgers and pasta which threw me off a bit. When I go to a mexican food restaurant I fully expect just that. If you are picky go to Applebee's. The service was friemdly and fast. The food is just ok and they need to work on the menu. As with most Mexican places they have extensive choices but not here.

This place is garbage. I'm a heavy tipper and respect the hell out of a good barber shop but these dudes straight up ignore walk ins.  Pretty poor experience sitting there for 30 mins without an acknowledgement.  Plenty of barber shops that will value your business

Yummy House isn't my favorite. Food was OK. Not many choices for vegetarians, and they charge extra to make a dish vegetarian. (Always a shame when you're charged extra to eat healthy.) Only plus was the nice staff. Restaurant seemed dirtier than most. Location is iffy. There were bullet holes in the front windows!

If you like a Los betos type of place, then this place is for you! Personally I love great mexican food, so I don't really like this place and don't recommend if you want to eat great mexican food when there's so much better.  This was alright and if I want to have a quick fix then I may go again since it's down the street

We ate here last Thursday and were pleased with our food and service. The muscles were excellent. The atmosphere was calm and encouraged conversation. The chef came out and introduced himself. This is a BYOB, which is great. The server was very attentive. Would recommend for authentic Italian.

Cool little place located in the Cherry Hill Mall food court.

Prices are reasonable considering the size of the servings.

I had the chicken teriyaki with mixed vegetables and fried rice. Good taste and low on oil/grease. The veggies could have used more variety; my portion was mostly lettuce with some sprinkles of broccoli.

Phenomenal. The chef is on point and a lot of fun! The atmosphere is very relaxed and casual. We tried the sausage with spicy marinara and the chicken pesto ravioli and to top it off for desert we had the chocolate raviolis! Every single ravioli is made with care here so don't miss the awesome new spot in Reno!

Sugos food is always great but the waiting area and no drinks while you wait is ridiculous. Three large high top tables in the front are wasted on the 'waiting area'. Why don't the hostesses serve drinks for folks waiting. Better yet - put in a bar. Patio is nice in summer and staff is always friendly.

I have to say, this location seems to have many issues with prompt service. The staff is always great, very courteous and professional. I just have to wonder about what's going on with management. I've noticed this for last couple of years, this one tends to be very slow.  In other words if you're in a hurry...
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Please do bring a lot of cash, if u planned to come.
I had veal rollatini... not roll up , very strange. I thought Italian's "rollatini" means meat got roll up. I saw small round flat meat. looks like scalloppine. ( The chef napping at dinning hour?).,, . 
but it tasted good though...

We called this place for pizza take out. This is the best pizza take out I had so far. when it arrived it is warm, and the dough taste good good!
however, it seems one dollar or two more expensive than other take out. But I like it a lot. so I do not mind. My HB like the other pizzaeria.

2 points: it is convenient. 
1 point: Their rolls are very fresh, could compete with the bakeries. 

The deli food are good. ( I usually call take out for the hoagies. My first time buying Deli there, 

The price is slight higher than Pathmark. ( Actually I think all Pathmark stores are pricier.)

Eh not a huge fan and honestly disappointed. The gel manicure peeled off a few fingers in a few days. I went back and got a few redone and then they only lasted about 5 days total. Upsetting for a gel manicure because usually mine last longer. Not too expensive but certainly not cheap.

This was my 2nd time here. The ice cream is good but the scoops are WAYYYYYYY too small for the money! I had Honey Soaked Chocolate Almond and Peanut Butter w/ Chocolate flakes on a sugar cone. The place is tiny for the traffic. I'll stick with Baskin Robbins and Legato Gelato in Edge Hill for that kind of money.

Maybe I went at a bad time, Was not impressed and everything was super greasy and the service was slow. I sat at the bar and did not like watching the food being cooked, it cheapened the experience as I watched the frozen items go into the microwave and grease.

Such good ice cream! They also had some hilarious signs.  I had llamalicious (cake batter with icing swirl), my nephew had strawberry, and my brother in law had one of the no sugar added flavors and all of them were delicious.  I also tasted the strawberry cheesecake and I'll be back for that.

Exactly what you expect!  Your choice of frozen yogurt and lots of toppings. If I could add half a star for the warm peanut butter topping, I would. The outdoor seating is nice. So is the location right off the rail trail. If frozen yogurt is calling, this will do the trick.

Very chill atmosphere and creative drinks. They do a lot of house infused drinks. The peanut infused Makers Mark is particularly delicious. The bartenders come up with their own takes on Prohibition Era cocktails. Ours made the Port of New Orleans, and it was fantastic.

Our first time here and it was fantastic. We do sushi all over and this is the best yet. Service was timely and the atmosphere, friendly and pleasant. So much to choose from and all we had was good. If I have to choose one, I'd recommend the Washington Ave roll; you can't go wrong. All in all, a great dining experience.

This was very good sushi but service lacks in every way. We ordered an appetizer which never arrived, our salad was decent but the ginger was overwhelmed by vinegar. Definitely not an A+ sushi on my list, do not recommend this restaurant at all!

People have to wait for sushi on an average night, for well over 45 minutes.

I'll make this short & sweet; maybe.
I love Krispy Kreme.... even way back when you could ONLY BUY THEM @ Fry's Food stores.   
They started popping up then as soon as they came, they left!  

I was completely thrilled when Krispy Kreme came back to town yeeeeeeeeears later!

Thank you, Thank you, Thank you

We were looking for a new place to eat and I had seen the sign for the Alaskan Cod hand dipped. SO we went and not good. Small pieces of fish and really really greasy. Fries were ok and my daughter got the tots which were ok too, but probably not going back.

Good neighbour store. However whenever there's a sale it's limited even though the ad says otherwise or there's a restructuring croon to a type of flavour. Also certain cashiers have been observed to give better service to their friends, family or of their ethnic background.

Sushi was okay. Wasps all around our table. Not a big deal unless you're allergic. Probably won't come back here. Only 2 tables filled in the restaurant but food still took a little while. My assumption is that there is likely better sushi somewhere in the area.

Food 3.5
Value 4
Service 4
Atmosphere 4
Went for Bloody Mary bar on Sunday 'cause my friend has a problem  - with vodka that is. Anyway, waitress hooked us up with a big ole drink for just five bucks; breakfast was good value as well. Oh and they have a couple of tvs if you like sports.

Yeah, good place for quality Panera-like Italian streetfood. Think Starbucks meets Chipotle, which is what it is : a little pricey, a little chichi, and very clean and pseudo industrial. Oh and the sandwich i had was good. Not the best value but a good place to hang.
Food 3
Value 2
Service na
Atmosphere 5

I rented a mid size SUV and they gave me a compact SUV. They assigned me a car verses advising mw of my options. The service waa fast and they staff was nice. I would suggest allowing the renters to pick from the fleet available because I didn't get the car I thought I reserved.

I made my reservation with hotwire and prepaid and I took the insurance with Hotwire called Alliance. When I went to pick up my car the reservations rep advised me that since my rental car was worth $40,000 I had to take their insurance which was $30 a day. I learned this was not accurate and mislead. I wont use them again.

They didn't have any seating available downstairs, so we sat upstairs at the little indoor bar area.  The seating was a bit awkward, but the food was fabulous!  We shared a couple appetizers and they were all great!  I'd love to come back to try one of their burgers!

This pizza is greasy, cheesy, and saucy... And it's perfect that way! This is a must go to pizza spot in Tampa, one of the top five for sure. The wait time has always been reasonable, and if you arrive early they always have a game on. 

I highly recommend the cheese pizza!

Papa John's is good pizza. I get that there are those of you out there that feel too pretentious to consider a chain 5 stars, but you are out of your mind if you dont think the papa is bomb. This location represents the brand extremely well and I cant say enough good things.

I used to love this place but in my last order I pulled out 3 hairs from my pizza. That's absolutely unacceptable. I can understand 1, but 3? I used to travel 4 miles to get the pizza here (I used to live nearby and moved and couldn't part with my favorite pizza shop), now I won't return.

When arriving, we were so hungry. It took them over 15min to get food ready, much longer than expected. We ordered Sushi and Sashimi combo and Teriyaki steak. The steak was too well cooked so hard to chew. The combo is generally ok. Compared to the other Japanese steakhouse, a little disappointed.

Bad experience there, waited 20 minutes before even being reconize I was there to order. Phone kept ringing, young staff with no sense of bussiness running. Left with my 2 sweet grandaughters after not getting order even taken, no line waiting sad always loved getting ice cream here :(.

This restaurant is so overrated. When it was in Warrington it was so much better. The last three times I was there
 I had subpar meals. Twice burnt sauce. Really?  I wrote to the owner and he never had the courtesy to respond. Two stars might be one too many

Was disappointed again with this place.  Neighbor booked it for 8 on New Year's Eve. Service and food was horrible. $12 for the worst coconut shrimp, there were 4. One in our party didn't eat his entree. The owner is a very nice guy, but three bad meals in a row.

After work I went to this location for a hot vanilla latte, instead I was given a cold vanilla latte. I wanted to change it but somehow there was nobody in the counter all of a sudden. I did not bother waiting as I needed to get home. Did not like the service and wouldn't be coming back anytime soon.

my husband and I go there often and the food is very good.  The servers as well as the owners are nice, friendly and very accommodating..  The soups are worth trying as well as their specials .... we loved the duck and lobster specials we had.

Arlene and Paul

I feel so lucky to have found Maria's!!  The service was great. They close at 6pm and welcomed me with open arms at 5:30pm. My wash and set was $25 and included a free deep conditioning. I haven't had a relaxer in months, but I walked out silky straight with lots of body at 6:20. Will definitely visit again!

Pizza dough has great taste that's were it stops but if you like bland sauce and a low grade of almost no tasting cheese this place is for you. Staff are very friendly, nice little place nice neighborhood. A little improvement on sauce and a better grade of cheese than this pizza would be excellent.

Been to this location several times and I leave every time thinking wow, these people hate their jobs and act like serving you is an inconvenience and annoying. Donuts and food is always good, but customer service is what brings customers back and what counts. It's a shame they don't realize that

They just opened last year and every time we pass by they are alway super super busy. The line is always at least 5 people. But they actually move pretty fast because they have enough people working so that's good. If you like Starbucks then make sure stopping by when you are shopping.

Sushi was good but portions are very small compared to other sushi places! My special roll was way smaller than special rolls from other sushi restaurant. In my opinion, overpriced for their portion sizes and I probably will try another sushi place next time

I'm not a fan of this location, not only is the service not great, I've actually witnessed with my own eyes, 3 times where someone has had a phone or tablet stolen from them while at this location. This obviously isn't Starbucks fault, but I try to avoid this location for safety reasons also.

I honestly do not get the obsession with DD. We stopped by to try their donuts and the selection was terrible and everything just looked....sad. Then I find out nothing is made fresh, it's all shipped in frozen? Gross. There are plenty of better places to get similar items.

I know none of us go to fast food places expecting anything other than what it is but this location....SUCKS!!! They don't cook their fries long enough at all and come to you literally half done. I'm glad I've started eating better and healthier and won't be going back...probably ever.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I like Marsh grocery store but I'm not in love with it. The prices tend to be on the higher side. I usually stop in for a quick lunch or dinner options.  Marsh has good options when it comes to food and wine selection. If you don't mind the cost, it is a convenient place to shop downtown.

Buffalo chicken sandwich, good. Cold beers good. Priced right for anything on the island. Great happy hour prices. Winner was by far the chicken fingers. I got the kid meal version for a six year old and there was four VERY large all white pieces, juicy inside and perfectly fried with a little panko in the  breading.

My go-to store for liquor. Since i have no vehicle now i use their delivery service. It is very good as they show up the next day and deliver for only around $7 .
They email me when they are on the way as well.
Liquor prices are as good or better than everywhere else and staff is friendly.

Regular McDonalds. We ordered 4 sandwiches, and one came out wrong. We asked for no meat on all... And one came out with a sausage patty. Had to go inside (we were in the drive thru), which was annoying.... But at least they were nice while taking the order, and while fixing it.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Boooo!! Their fantastically priced coffee deal of $1.11 has now jumped to $1.49. In much the same way Katie Ledeckie pushed the envelope of what is possible with numbers and water, Fresh Market have done the same with their own (flavoured) water. Where will it end?

Morning coffee has changed forever.

All things change I guess they don't carry scallions anymore for the wonton because some people don't like it and the crab Rangoon is buffet style nowsad I have to find new location for my two favorites.  I've been ordering from here for years because they've had the best food so I don't understand why they changed anything...

Had been passing this place for a longtime. We decided to stop in hubby got pecan sticky bun something and I got Brown Butter Almond Brittle. It was a little bucket of heaven. The best ice cream I have had in a while. The storefront was super clean with excellent covid guidelines. I felt totally safe.

They have a lot of beer on draft. However, most of it can be found around town at any decent bar. I've only been here a couple times but each time they've been super slow, not sure if this is the norm... 
Bartenders can be a little slow and too talkative to people they know as opposed to giving good service.

thank GOD for Lazy Bee!  I drop my laundry in the morning before work and !VOILÀ! washed, dried, and folded when I get out  All for the same price as me doing it myself. Like my mom (R.I.P.) always said "Work smarter not harder." Faithful laundry service patron here
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I order from Ted's regularly. Their salads are nice and fresh. I've had the burgers and pizza. Sometimes the pizza can be cooked more. I don't like the toppings (mushrooms) falling off my pizza when I pick up a slice. I haven't had any major complaints. Again the food is fresh and when it arrives it is hot.

The one guy must be on another. Planet, complaining that Military And Police pay more.  No way!  The flat rate is $8.00 regardless.  I am amused with. Other complaints, what do you expect for the $8.00 flat rate?  PS, I am both Military Police and civilian LEO.

Yeah, I went there today... and yesterday. They call it the "habit" for good reason. Burgers are charred perfectly and come with gooey delicious caramelized onions. Insider tip: get the swiss cheese 'steada the classic american, and don't forget the chocolate malt.

I like their practice of changing menu every week. 
Every dish we ordered last night was very good. Barley risotto was excellent, so was my pork chop. 
When we walked in around 7p, it was almost empty, but was completely jammed by 8, despite the thunderstorm.

I stop in here as it is close to my job.  I usually stop in after 1245p.  The drive thru moves quick and they are accurate.  They always tell me to have a nice day.  That is impressive and keeps me coming back.  The 4 for $4 is my go to meal, with a junior bacon cheeseburger.

I haven't been here to eat in awhile.  I went through the drive thru and placed my order.  They didn't confirm my order which I found odd.
I ordered a cheesy sack (10 cheeseburgers), sack of fries and an order of chicken rings.  
Nothing spectacular cheap food to get rid of the crave.

In the past month I've purchased 2 new tires, had front and back brakes replaced and an oil change.  Terrence and Maurice gave great customer service despite some challenging situations.  They searched for coupons to help me save on the repair cost.  I will definitely come back to have my car serviced.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Beware. This McDonalds is gross, when you walk thru the door. Smells like something is rotting inside. Most of the workers look like they are zombies and on oxy. The food is gross. Cold fries and a double quarter pounder that has been the warmer for days. Just plain disgusting.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The thing about Ooka is the food - really excellent sushi. The non-desrcript building that encloses this restaurant does not look appealing to the first-timer, but prepare to wait for 45-min to an hour on busy evenings - lots of people in this area love Ooka for the great food, the nice interior, and the friendly service.

I love this place.  I was at Tchoup Yard with a bunch of friends and we were there for about 5 hours.  The design of the place is very nice, a large bar that is covered and a very large patio with tables and chairs.  The best thing about the night was the staff, especially Sam, our server.  We will return just to see her.

Oh yes--eat yourself stupid Italian food hidden in Harahan. It's worth the drive. We got very lucky when they converted the Popeyes that used to occupy the space!  Calamari, frattura & especially the gulf fish are excellent!  Staff is every bit as good as the food, too.

A year ago I said the same thing about this location and what do you know..... I STILL STAND BY WHAT I SAID!!!! THIS LOCATION HIRES THE WORST EMPLOYEES AND THE MANAGERS ARE BEYOND RUDE. It starts from top to bottom, the employees will not give great customer service if the managers don't enforce it. Smh

This one has the fastest service than the others but this location does not have many of the holiday flavors such as Pralines and Cream Cheesecake. The crew members are friendly and very knowledgeable about their products. They go out of their way to let you sample whichever ice cream you would like to sample.

Cheap looking and always empty but the chicken and shrimp tacos are the best. Taste the love when you bite down into the first bite omg! I love it. Ask for the Neshia special when you arrive and they'll know exactly what you are asking for. The English speaking cashiers are great with explaining the foods to you

The best gym EVER!!! You're never alone. Motivated from day one with all the support you need and more. Tons of classes available at your fingertips. Plenty of friendly gym enthusiasts to meet a work out buddy. Extremely clean and never smells like an old gym sock. Love it here. Never going anywhere else.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Dr. Renee was referred to me by Homeward Bound, which I have used before. Renee was compassionate, personable and very sympathetic in our time of grief. I would not hesitate to contact her again for any type of vet care. Thank you, Renee, from the Reid family.

So far our experience has been awful my daughter made the reservation 2 months in advance and when they go to pick up the van they said that they needed a 200 dollar deposit by credit card only as there policies changed as of 2 weeks ago, they refuse to honor the policy from when the reservation was made and paid in full.

The costumer service may not be the best, but we have always been happy with our food and the location. 

Super easy stop with kids after a beach day. Also, super easy take out. 

Get the green sauce on the primo chicken burrito. You will not be disappointed.

The one owner is very nice but the other is not so nice and becomes very offended if you question anything. I could taste the frozen nature of the squid, very expensive for frozen food, had a tasty sauce to hid the rubbery squid. bread taste very much like  yeast. al in ll not to bad but I can't put up with bad customer service

I go to The Global Quesadilla Company for lunch quite often.  They have a wide variety of quesadillas, wraps and nachos.  I recommend the St. Louis style quesadilla.  It has sausage, provel cheese and marinara sauce so it's like eating a thin crust pizza.  The Caribbean is very good as well with Jerk Chicken.

I stumbled on this place as I was looking for someone where else to eat. The other place was too rowdy for me.

This place is elegant but yet casual. 

The food was good and the beer was beer lol

I would come here again but it isn't cheap but it isnt super expensive.

So as Japanese hibachi's go this 1 is on the low scale. The ambiance is dark so as to hide the dingy appearance of everything. The food is watery and lackluster. The only saving grace is 1 sushi roll called the Hard Rock Roll. It is covered in a mountain of cheeses and tastes like heaven! Every other food item tastes pretty bad.

This is probably the worst Chinese place I've ever been to in Reno. I've been to many others and I mean I understand it's Egg Roll King it's cheap. But this food had no flavor.
