And then to top it off the lady at the register was rude both on the phone and in person. Will never come here again ever!

It's quick and easy and the food is good too. There isn't a huge selection to choose from but it's there to catch people for lunch so it's a decent enough menu for that. Vegetarians are catered for. There are always a few people in the cue but I take that as a good sign.

Great food great drinks great atmosphere, just plain ol amazing! Happy hour 4pm-7 has a number of drinks (beer, wine, saki, sakitinis) at half price and a number of rolls for 5$ and 7$ ! Or happy hour dinner of two rolls, a soda, and 3 sakitinis was only 22$!

We have been here a few times before. Mainly for cocktails and appetizers. This last time I went for wife's Birthday my steak was under cooked and my vegetables were under cooked also. Not the best experience I would not suggest this place for other than drinks.

Love the decor. Food is tasty but need to spend the little extra money and get some quality tortillas. MARGARITA was on point and service was very good and attentive. I have tried the specials the last two times and they are pretty good. Just need a little up keep and this place will be a five star.

Bad service and horrible parking. Ordered for pickup and food had been sitting there waiting but wasn't told ready for pickup.  No parking spaces had to park two streets over to get my food.  The pizza was cold and bland. For $27 a pizza totally unacceptable.

3.5 stars. Fish is fresh and rolls are well prepared. Servers are friendly. I am a sushi purist so a menu with a large amount of over busy, heavily sauced rolls is kind of annoying. If you are confident in the quality of your fish why smother it in sauces??

Large space which is a little stuffy and rundown.  Food portions are large but bland. Service is prompt but stiff. Pricey for the quality of food. This is kind of a tourist trap and I have actually witnessed a greyhound bus drop off a very large group of senior citizens here for dinner...

This place is smack dab middle of the road Japanese cuisine. Not great, but not bad. The sushi was good, the hibachi was okay. I would not travel far to visit this place but in a pinch, a good meal. Finding a table won't be a problem. Only two grill tables were filled at 6:30 on the Saturday night we went.

Had an eye exam appointment today for both my son and I; a very pleasant experience, no long wait, friendly & accommodating staff, nice office space; overall very pleased with my experience there today, will definitely be returning to make some eyeglass selections and for future eye exams.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Someone was getting married so it was cute when they did a shout out! Good music, good vibes, good drinks. A few people were dancing in front of the stage area and it seemed like a good time. There's no charge to enter. Mostly for older tourists since it seems like the songs are from the 80's.

I so badly wanted to love this place!! I ordered delivery and it got here super quickly, but my half of my order was wrong. The sushi itself was fine, though the sweet potato roll was mostly just tempura and the actual size of the rolls were pretty small. I wouldn't mind waiting longer for the food if they got my order correct!!

The diced, grilled Hibachi Chicken was good but smothered in a thick gooey teriyaki sauce diminishing its appeal.  The noodles lacked the flavor & texture typically found in such side, & the Miso soup could have been mistaken for dish water.

The steamed white rice & Tsing Tao were good, & the service was excellent.

If you like real Chinese food. DON'T go here.
The owner is very fake.  The atmosphere is something to be desired. It's not very clean .  Tables are sticky.  
The food is sweet. It seems as though they put lots of sugar in food to make it too sweet which I dont like.

I used to love the $6.95 all you can eat. It was not buffet style. They would bring everything out fresh as you requested it. I am SAD to say that I just passed the location and they are closed!!!! No sign up anymore and paper blocking the windows. My guess Covid did them in!

Another too much of a good thing. These donuts are actually more  like cakes, in texture and size. I love the creativity of the toppings but for me they would be better on a real donut, size and texture. Of course the kids love them and they are fun to look at.

I think it's gone down hill a bit since my last visit. My tempura veggies didn't have tempura batter on them. It was breaded in panko this time. Less of them than I got previously too. Music is way too loud. Rock music doesn't seem to go with the theme of the restaurant.

Food is ok, but service is lacking. Also, promotions are very inconsistent. We read in paper they had $1.00 night. When we went it was discontinued. Same thing has happened for their happy hour and jazz nights. We like something, go back to do it again, and it is no longer offered.

Great gym. Great staff. Always clean and the staff is very accommodating.  They will always answer your questions and not give you the typical gym employee attitude, you know what I am talking about.  If you are looking for a gym on the Far Eastside the. This is your place.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Just ok.  This is an average restaurant.  The food is exactly all other run of the mill Chinese restaurants.  Not bad.  You know what you're getting.  I normally choose the fast wok but they are closed on Sunday and we wanted Chinese food.  You won't be wowed or disappointed.

I'm not sure how this gets more than one star from anyone?
It's not clean, not well organized "we don't have fried jalapeños for your sandwich". Running out of product?
And last but not least, it's gross!!! It has to be a "I grew up with it" excuse to return.

We enjoy fresh local sourced ingredients. R Bistro is very fresh and local sourced. The restaurant even has it's own herb and vegetable garden next door.  We enjoyed then tomato chic pea soup, signature applewood panini and the Wednesday special toffee cake. Everything was great. Service was fast and attentive. We highly recommend.

Worse customer service EVER. They provide no guidance whatsoever and barely talk at all until they are telling you the price. They never said where to shop for those that are covered by insurance. They make many assumptions and do not tell you the. Ost, nor do they disclose that each additional cost is pe4 lense. Never again!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: It's a inconvenience for the employees here to take an order. They refuse to take any order at the drive thru window and inside is closed. Why does Wendy's pay any of these people? Don't know. But I bet a performance review would show they need to clean house and bring in corporate management.

If I could rate beyond 5 stars I would! If you love beer this is the place for you. The owners are very knowledgeable and will spend time talking with you about beer. You can definitely tell they love what they do. Excellent fridge selection with a rotating tap in the store.

After reno bighorns game I walked by this place and said what the hell for 2.99 a slice and drink. The pizza has no flavor, it needs updated sauce or something. All the damn sodas were somewhat flat and not right. The prices seem ok, but hell it is pizza, it should have some flavor. cheap eating, but nothing to write home about.

There are sooo many pizzerias in Clearwater and being from NY I'm a big skeptic when it comes to pizza.  I was pleasantly surprised with the pizza at Monty's.  The pizza is hot, cheesy and saucy just the way I like it.  The cheesecake was also very good.  The waitress was very friendly and pleasant.

The hotel is nice but it could use a few extras. The fridge is way to small for anything. And there is no microwave. You need to put down towels before you shower. Otherwise the floor is soaked.  The rooms has only one lamp that doesn't light up much. Other than that it's a nice place. The staff are very friendly and helpful.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: had 2 Spanish guys putting a new floor in and they had a hard time giving them their order so I got on the phone and ordered for them and the women taking the order was so rude just like the one and only time I ordered from them this place and the food still sucks!!!! wish we had a better Chinese place in town to order from

" That's A Robbery"- Pizza is great but don't order WINE! TWO- times mark up; $24 for $12 bottles?' No wonder wine isn't on menu; I love some Robert Mondavi, but damn, double mark up? Won't be back for drinks. Pizza good Chicago pizza overated; I've had Chicago pizza up north while stationed there.

The staff in this place is very nice. But the food is so so and the speed (well it is none existent). The drive thru is more like a wait thru. 8 minutes for 2 cups of black coffee? I mean this is not Starbucks. I think I will rather drive to the one at Busch and 56.

Terrible!! Wrecked my truck 12 days ago, they didn't have a pick up truck available so they got me stuck in this SUV that I can't use for my line of work-have called them almost everyday to arrange a reservation for a truck and they keep giving me the run around !!! Go anywhere else if you can !!

I'm only giving two stars because the food was pretty good. The service was awful. No refills. One basket of chips. All our food came out separately. I was done eating before the others got their food. They had plenty of people working so I don't understand what the deal was.

It's very hard to communicate here especially when ordering take out on the phone. To take out portions are substantially smaller than the eat in portions. The food has always been good though. I recently got the steak and shrimp hibachi it was smaller than what I would expect a child to eat for $20 I will show some pictures.

I'm going to give this Winn Dixie 5 stars, but not for the reason you might expect. They earn their coveted five stars due to the fact they have an excellent beer selection. They are the only store in the area that has both Kirin and Sapporo. And for that reason alone, I tip my five star hat at you Winn Dixie.

Friendly staff but budget extra time because you aren't going to get in and out in a quick manner at all. The worst time to go here is when there is a conference at the convention center. At that point don't even bother. Again nice people but not quick service.

Drive-through was slammed and early-morning took about 15 minutes to get coffee. The coffee was delicious I tried the new Punkin and a salted caramel. Got to the drive-through to pay and the employee was very friendly made the experience worthwhile will come back again soon!

Fantastic burger. I can't eat cheese and so I had to get it without cheese, which at other places usually leaves the burger dry and sad. Not here though! Delicious even without cheese. I wished I would have asked for it to be rare, that would have made it even better. Small menu but great environment and staff.

Here for a conference, and its a beaitiful day but this property has NO outdoor seating, nothing outdoors because its entrapped on a tiny island in a bog / nature preserve.  Unless you're a Candian Goose looking for respite on your journey you can skip this hotel and stay a little further out.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: All I can say is Wow. I've driven past this place countless times and never noticed it. The food is good, and I can't remember ever going to breakfast and taking food home until today. Very friendly and attentive service, smiles abound. I'm looking forward to trying them for dinner.

Still love the food, but don't really like the seating at the new place.
Not a fan of the European seating, where you are seating on top of the people next to you, and they can hear you whole conversation.
Not really sure why they moved, place looks no bigger than the old restaurant. Guess we will have to get my food to go.

Stopped at this location 3 times last week since I was working right now the road. Seems to be new managers and some new staff and things seem to be turning around. Lines went very quickly. My food was right and the same price every day. Hopefully they keep going in the right direction. Will return.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: It is ok. We don't have much choicein our small town,  so it's about aa good as it gets. The bad part is they know it, so they typically don't care if you're happy or not. Food can be hit or miss. Service is mostly miss. Prices are high for the quality of food and service.

Ordered a beer in the lounge and was going to order food. The air conditioning was blasted at I'm sure was full strength. It's not summer yet people. All the customers were wearing jackets. Servers didn't care. Bye bye. Not coming back. Food would have been cold as soon as it hit the table.

People will say "what do you expect its McDonald's" but when you pay for a meal no matter what it is you should expect what you order. Cheeseburgers are often cold (Cheese is not even melted) if you order no onion it should be no onion. Fries should not be soggy.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: They installed new car wash equipment in the stalls so the time is cut in half so they can make more money. Unfortunately it did not even clean the windshield! Miss the old ones. The vacuums are of course another charge and are really powerless, save your money.

How difficult it is to throw some ketchup and ranch into a bag ?! I know it is fast food and I don't have high expectations but god damn man. We are buying chicken rings and fries who eats them w/o condiments ffs. No need to roll eyes and get annoyed cuz I asked for couple lousy condiment.

Fantastic through and through. The dishes are nicely presented with an artistic flair and every bite was delicious. Looking forward to our next visit. 
This place was packed and the service was still spot on. Nice! Highly recommend! 
 Our new favorite sushi joint.

Love this place. I always get a large yogorino with pistachio sauce n chopped hazelnut. Wish they would be a little more giving on the toppings though considering how expensive the cup of yogurt is. Would give more stars but sometimes the staff can be rude, very rude.

How can you go wrong at a place where you build you own sundae. They had 14 different flavors of yogurt, plenty of toppings and 4 different topping sauces. The staff was friendly and helpful. Don't forget to check in on Yelp once you get there to get your free waffle bowl.

How can you go wrong at a place where you build you own sundae. They had 14 different flavors of yogurt, plenty of toppings and 4 different topping sauces. The staff was friendly and helpful. Don't forget to check in on Yelp once you get there to get your free waffle bowl.

This is a typical Burger King with their excellent fast food with great prices. Beware the app does not show in-store specials. The app does not let you cancel an order at least I don't know how or couldn't find a way to. The people are very friendly kind and I'd recommend Store to anyone on the run looking for a good fast food.

This is a nice clean place. Good equipment as well. Very nice locker rooms. BUT don't get sucked into the personal training game you won't get out. And it's not worth the money. You have to work around their schedule, not yours. So go for the gym and the equipment and it's all good
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The Downingtown location is closed... you will have to go to the West Chester location which is only BYOB on certain nights... I don't blame JBL, they have a great location on Gay Street in West Chester, but I do prefer to bring my own wine as you can't find my selection anywhere.

Always a fantastic meal and experience.  We chose a wine pairing last night which was very well executed.  It remains one of the best dining experiences in Chester County and continues to evolve to stay ahead of others.  

It is the perfect mix of creativity, energy and execution and should be at the top of your dining experiences.

Hannah did an awesome job and helped my first experience at treo be a great one. I have curly hair and normally keep it short and went in for an even shorter cut. I love it, she did a good job styling it and gave me a relaxing wash. I will definitely be returning in the future.

Food was bad, meatballs more breadcrumbs then meat, overcooked pasta. Food took forever to come out, bread was tasteless. Lot of mistakes on our order. Wasn't looking for comped food but atleast offer. Desert was good, cappuccino was good. Had to try it once, don't regret going but won't go back

Been working out at Clareview World Health for almost 4 years and I must say that the floors are REALLY dirty...I take off my shoes to deadlift barefoot and by the end of it, my sock are black with dirt and dust. Pretty gross. They need to sweep more!! A clean gym is a happy gym!!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: We gave this a try for lunch today. I love sushi so was excited to try this place. It was just ok. The burritos were alot of rice and toppings and not enough tuna. My friend said the same thing about her shrimp in her burrito. The avocado salsa and jicama was very good as toppings. it was about $11 for my burrito.

Delightful experience today. Service was great. The sushi was fresh and tasty.  The prices are good 
I don't mind the handwritten signs all over the restaurant, I think it's kitschy. 
My only complaint, my son ordered ramen and we were all finished eating by the time it arrived.

Great service and impressive sushi selection & quality.  It was a quiet night and I was brought a free bowl of edamame since he thought it would go good with my Sapporo.  The ambiance could use a little spicing up -- if the lighting and so on were on par with the food and service, it would be a step in the right direction.

Had a great meal last week at the new Passariello's in Haddonfield. The new building is stunning and the selection almost overwhelming. The only reason I'm not giving 5 stars is the pricing. Not everyone that visits your establishment lives in affluent Haddonfield! Way too overpriced.

Truly a delight. Nice outdoor seating (went when it was a bit warmer though), cute area, friendly staff, delicious food. I'd recommend the octopus and the gnocchi, and the bread with their house oil blend is a nice accompaniment. The squid ink pasta was pretty good too, fairly loaded with crab.

Heather is the best - I kept trying to find a good stylist in my neighborhood (west philly) but quickly realized it's worth the trip to south philly for an amazing haircut. Heather listens to what you want and is constantly up on new trends and knows what looks good with your hair texture and face shape.

Oh CB, how I love thee. We have been coming here (both to dine in and carry out) for years. Can't beat the price and the food is great as far as cheap Chinese food goes. I always always get the general tso's chicken and crab rangoons. This is our go-to Chinese place when we are in the area!

Friendly service and simple decor. It's everything I'd need from a coffee shop. The coffee keeps me awake, but is mild enough to curb my sugar/cream habits. It's also a nice quiet spot to get work done or read. Overall, a fantastic addition to the neighborhood.

Stopped by this place after the Discovery Museum with my daughter.  

She ordered a Cap'n Crunch doughnut I believe. It was tasty.  

I ordered a jalapeño cream cheese croissant and it was delicious.  

Doughnuts were a good size. 

Would definitely recommend to any doughnut lover.

This McDonald's ice cream machine is always broken. I'm starting to think they are not telling the truth to me. I can count at least 6 times they told its broke in the last 6 months. Other McDonalds ice cream machines seem to be working all the time. It's time I quit coming here for a very long time.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Found this place close to our rental and we wanted some ice cream. Not disappointed. The staff was patient as we selected our flavors. My wife got the mini sample 4 flavors. The seating was as expected for a quick visit. The ice cream tasted great and hit the spot.
*Please note, it is CASH ONLY

nothing against the staff, or the smoothie but the ambiance was strictly poser. the scone was stale, the deli was not upscale enough...whole foods does this better. it worked after a long hike, but we mostly just enjoyed each other, rather than the place. i definitely expected more.

It's unbelievable that you can find food this good at a walk up former snow cone booth. They don't speak a lick of English, but who cares what you end up ordering because the food is amazing. I always overeat and fear death is coming-but it would be a fine death. 

Try everything. It's cheap and amazing.

My car has definitely needed a car wash like once a week this winter. I like to go to Mike's because obviously they are well known. However, my car hasn't came out THAT clean as it should for paying $15! Sometimes there are some missed parts, or there are tons of water stains.

My wife and I love staying at Hyatt Place hotels anywhere to go. This one specifically was super clean, and we checked in around 1am and the front desk associate was super nice and gave us 2 free water bottles. The breakfast was delicious and they kept bringing out warm food every 30 minutes.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Very pretty inside and also clean. The staff is always warm and welcoming. I always get a standard pedicure when I come here and they always do an effective job. There were a few spots she did not wipe away excess polish from, but it's not a big deal as that'll come off with a shower.

Knocking off two stars because the lunch AYCE - 15.95/pp is not being offered anymore. That was the only reason we came during lunch hour. Our waiter told me it was a temporary promotion. Well I think that's weird. Quality is still good and service as well. The green tea ice cream tastes nothing like green tea.

This is my first time here. I came based on the good reviews on Yelp and I am not disappointed. The stag is very friendly and the food is delicious. They have a large menu with lots of choices. I had the enchiladas and can't wait to come back and try something else.

Hey, Chipole Restaurant fans!! You're missing out!! Meals are larger, more variety and more authentic all for the same price!! Tried Tinga, new favorite and Chorizo, another new favorite. Service was nice, wait staff friendly and helpful on both visits. Sooo00oo going back~

We were in this area to test drive a few cars so stopped by as we are always down for tacos.

Boyfriend had the tacos carnitas and I tried the tacos dorados. Very tasty. 

The service was fast and friendly.

Authentic Mexican food. The menus were in English and spanish.

If we are in the area again we will stop back.

My family has been ordering take-out from here for years. We are always pleased with our food.  Always ready on time and always delicious...never a miss. This is one of the few places we will eat take-out Chinese from.  You can watch them cook behind the counter.

Great service but literally just pulled in with the hot sign on . Got my donuts and the donuts scared me cuz they were ice cold..... how does that happen.... my luck... welp the donuts are sitting on the floor board with the heat on blast , trying to cook them before I get back to work.

False advertisement. Sign out front says dine in open, really wanted Arby's... pulled in walked up to the door closed.... Considered going in drive through with my 14" box truck and taking out the signs. Since I can't eat Arby's now... it's cool tho. Plenty of other places that are open inside that I can have some lunch,

This place is not a sports bar at all.  I went to watch a college football game the afternoon of the saturday before Halloween--they were playing dance music and had no sound on the tv's.  We left after one over priced drink and went next door to Buffalo Wild Wings..

This spot sucks. I called and placed an order Friday for pizza and cancelled it 5 minutes later. They still charged my card and refused to speak to me about it. The lady even hung up the phone mid sentence.  Stay away from this place, there are plenty of other options with better food!

Good food. The fruit plate was great, lots of fresh ripe melon, strawberry, banana, and grapes. The egg spinach bacon sandwich was very nice (and it was with real cheese instead of American cheese!) and the people I was with seemed to like their food. Around $15 per person. Friendly service.

El Pastor tacos are the best I've ever had!!! Fish tacos are amazing, guacamole was amazing. The taco wheels are homemade and cooked fresh to order. The owners (didn't speak great English) were as nice of people you'll ever meet. I truly recommend you try this small hole in the wall, it will not disappoint

These guys are getting a little too comfortable assuming they're the only game in town.  Was run much better when the owner (not his kids) was there more often.  The guys who are running it are unfriendly, unhelpful and just arrogant.   I'll spend my money at Walkers or go to Flemington and hit Little Brothers any day.

Donuts are fine but the service here is very subpar.  The employees are slow and not well trained.  We ordered chocolate frosted long john donuts and they threw it into a bag which caused the chocolate to be smeared all over the place. They need to hire people with common sense.

Great service, great seating, and good coffee. What more could you ask of a Dunkin Donuts franchise? The store is mostly populated by La Salle students. There are also Barack Obama photos all over the wall! It's a good franchise and I would recommend it more than the Starbucks near La Salle.

This place is really fun. Great coffee, and a nice neighborhood addition. I am a chemist, and I really appreciate the science that Scott brings to his trade. I thought he was going to break out the bubbling dry ice, or a liquidN2 dewar for his next demonstration. He makes brewing a magic trick.

Amato's is my go to for a cheese steak when it comes to the Burlington area. The price point for the cheese steak and fries is decent and a few times when I've ordered it I was extremely satisfied. That being said it isn't always the same experience but If I were you, I'd probably get the cheese steak.

By the time we finished our membership here, we had really appreciated the help from Julia. She was always ready to help with any challenges we had. The facility is adequate and clean. The desk staff changed over a lot in the couple of years as did the trainers. I think it is a good place to workout for the price.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Prior meals were much better than this past one.  Barely cooked pasta and uninspired puttanesca sauce made for a barely average meal.  Sand in the clams also was very dissappointing.   Not sure if the chef changed as this was very different than prior meals.  Will try once more, if no better then would likely not go back.

I was excited to see that I can order my burger medium. You can also order veggie burgers, which my wife really enjoyed. The food was good, but slow service. There was only one server when we went. That would not be so bad, but she was slow with only two tables.

Came back after the management change and service is still as bad as ever. Ordered to go and waited an extra 10 minutes to pick up my single order only to be told that my order was forgotten and that I would have to wait. We given excuses and no apology. Probably never coming back.

First time at South Street barbers. 1302 was booked so they sent me to there 2nd location (which is a couple of doors down. Luis was my barbers and was very friendly and explained the cutting process to me...because I had no clue. I'm so happy I came here and will definitely be back!

Thanks Luis :)

Made a deposit with a cashiers check. After making deposit was informed the funds were being held with no reason given. Went by 5 days later and asked branch manager to call. No call. Received letter saying funds being held. What a load of BS. 

Bank somewhere else.

I wanted it to be better. Went for my bday after seeing fantastic reviews. The house special of spaghetti and meatballs were nothing special. Apps were pretty decent. Place was tiny and packed. Maybe we just ordered the wrong things...although everything ordered was a recommendation from out server...

Loved their tiger eye roll! It was crunchy and omg that sauce was a killer. Really good stuff. I never tried raw seafood in my life. So when I took a bite of the rainbow sushi fish, it was very simple and delicious .It was very fresh tasting and didn't have that nasty fishy odor. I'll be coming back! Service was excellent!

Great chain. I always sit at the bar and receive great service from all servers here. Worth the visit esp when there's a long line for dinner seating and a quick bite. Make sure and try the shrimp Portofino, any of the appetizers and the eggplant Parmesan and always have the Caesar salad

Small place near CVS. Pizza slices looked ok. Great lunch special so I ordered that. Two plain slices with a can soda $5.00. Once pizza was warmed up it was delicious! Didn't seem like they had a lot of options and the pizza was a little greasy which is what's leading me to give three stars but overall I'd come back

Dinner out with coworkers. We were in a large group which made service difficult but the waiter was patient and attentive. The mixto ceviche appetizer was great. The traditional margarita was too sweet. The chipotle margarita was smokey but too spicy. All round - main course meals were authentic but just ok.

Huge store, great meat section, very good bakery and produce. You're more likely to find a good deal on a large-but-not-monstrous quantity than you are to find a high-priced, obscure/imported foodie-type item here. The checkout is pretty fast. I go here when I'm in the area.

I moved to Saint Petersburg about 1.5 years ago and needed to find a new optometrist. I decided to try here based on positive online reviews, and I wasn't disappointed. The staff and optometrists are extremely friendly and knowledgeable. Today was my second annual eye exam, and I'll be a long time customer!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Dawsons is a great place to eat! The food is great, the staff is friendly and they have a pleasant atmosphere. We walk away pleasantly satisfied each and every time. Crab cakes are delicious and steaks are tasty! Even the simplest dish of fish and chips is superb!

I've been with Ducklo Eye Care for over 10 years.  The care you receive here is absolute excellence - these are truly pros in eye health. This is a place you come for more than just a prescription update.  You also feel cared for, and there's hardly ever a wait!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
OK so, I must admit, I have gone back to Educated Car Wash as I have not found a good replacement that is fast and reliable.

I would say they do a pretty good job most of the time.  Sometimes they are not thorough enough and miss spots.  Sometimes they do things like my review above.  Not the best, but where else to go?

My fiancé & I stopped in here & left very unimpressed. Our chips & chorizo queso ended up coming out at the same time as our food & wasn't very warm. I ordered 2 al pastor tacos & a steak taco which all came out cold like it had been sitting for a while & had very little flavor to it. We will go elsewhere next time.

Had to make an appointment here because my regular eye doc still isn't seeing patients because of Covid-19. I was so well taken care of by everyone. From the doctor to the ladies running the front, I felt respected and comfortable. I would absolutely recommend them to anyone.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Food was good but very poorly ran. Management is a disaster. I felt bad for the 1 server who was doing every job...she was running around seating people, bussing tables, taking orders, at the register, delivering food all by herself. Took over an hour and a half to get our meal and then waited a half hour to pay the bill.

Decent Wendy's location. The food was Wendy's food...so cheap fast food. Service was slower than average and this location is a bit run down. No serious issues though. The kids love the Wendy's toys this time around. I think it is neat how it is actually something that the kids get to build.

Super fast in and out express pizza! Got meal combo 1 which include a large pizza, 6 pcs wings, some bread sticks, and a 2 liter soda for only 15$  can't beat that price anywhere! Pizza was pretty good but the wing taste and feel like microwave wings. Will go back for the pizza!! The place does need a to be wipe down thou!

The food was good but service was quite slow.  We stopped in for lunch and expected to be under an hour.  Didn't happen.  We showed shortly after 11 (opening time) and the bar wasn't ready and the server hadn't even arrived yet.  The cook came out and started taking orders while trying to get the bar set.

I work right next door to this place and love it.  They have a good selection and there isn't anything bad here to eat, nothing special but still good to grab a quick bite to eat.  The delivery is really fast and they have fast and friendly service at a good price.

I have to say I like this location better than the Frenchmen Street location. I've been to the Frenchmen location during the weekdays and several times there was an odd smell lingering through the place. That makes it a little hard to enjoy your lunch.  The sushi is always fresh and I love the gyoza.  They are delicious.

Not a great place to stay. Internet poor the lady at the front desk very unhelpful   Not a good business spot for sure. They do not have the amenities I have come to expect from Westin such as a coffee shop with espresso. Walls and ceilings are popcorn. Ugh
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I like their Pizza and their Cheesesteak specials as well as their wings that are prepared to order not cooked and then recooked and dipped in sauce as if they were fresh. Fast delivery I would recommend salad too great for the size of them the price is very good.

Tonight was our first time ordering here and we were extremely disappointed.  The chicken and fried rice we ordered was dry and tasteless we could not even eat it.  Literally had to throw our our entire meal away.  We won't be ordering again.  I would recommend to spend your money elsewhere.

Another great experience! Food is creative and well prepared. The specials are outstanding. Service was excellent and, importantly, fun. Ask for Rodney. Felt like he was part of our group. Friendly, funny and down to earth. Precisely what more restaurants need. Well done!

Their elote is delicious and the most authentic I've had in a Mexican restaurant other than when I go to Mexico! Everything was fantastic, but if you like things with a little more taste/flavor with salsa, let the server know! Steak street tacos are the best thing other than the elote on the menu!! Go try this place out!

Needed to find a local room due to mudslides and evacuation zone and this hotel was an excellent host.
Personnel were efficient and friendly. Rooms were large and clean. Location was excellent to downtown. I would highly recommend this HIE as an excellent getaway for Carpinteria.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The table side Bada Bing takes the cake here!  You can have it with the prosciutto or with artichoke (if you're a vegetarian) incredibly gratifying to watch and eat , loaded with delicious Parmesan. Get this and a large salad for two and it'll make for a healthy yet amazing meal.

Sick to my stomach....

Went in to get groceries.... 

The bag of lettuce I got is WILTING.  Verge of rot...

Speaking of ROT....

Bought salami there too... Opened the package when I got home... MOLDED!!!!

I can't believe this store isn't checking dates on things and allowing this to happen.

Horrible.

Every once in awhile Wendy's is good. Hubby likes the double and I like the chicken sandwich. Fries are always undercooked but heat up great in the air fryer! We ate here this week and my chicken sandwich was the driest piece of leather ever! Just awful! Probably our last time ever.

This is a high-end Mexican restaurant. The bar drinks are overpriced. $5 for a Modelo? No way, José. However, the taste and quality of the food is outstanding. The complimentary ranch dressing with the chips and salsa is something different. Visit Casa Grande for special occasions only. The staff is friendly and pleasant.

Rented twice; one time they made special accommodations to find us a bigger vehicle and the second time the staff members were as courteous and helpful as the first time. I'm Executive but would expect the same hospitality to all customers from this location.

The burgers at this place are legit.  I have to drive 40 minutes to eat here, but me and my kids love it so it's worth the drive.  The chicken is hand breaded, the fries are great, and the milk shakes are good.   It doesn't look like much on the outside, but it's a great place to eat.

I have been going to Dr Linda Lueth at Cortaro Farms Pet Hosptial for 13 years or more. She took care of my Rhodesian ridgeback/ Dane for 11 years until she detected cancer and I began going to the oncologist. She has given my cat more life after detecting valley fever and diabetes. I will trust her always!

First time trying this place. Wanted to try a New Mexican restaurant and this place didn't disappoint. The tinga quesadilla was huge I was unaware of this and ordered two. The pastor tacos were really good. The sauces were pretty good I'm usually a green sauce type of girl but the red sauce was definitely my go to here!

My friends and I love the Friday Fish Fry here. All you can eat Fish and Chips for $6.50.  The drinks are stiff and reasonable too. Ambience = 1 notch above a Dive Bar. This place is on West Prince a block east of Flowing Wells on the south side of Prince. Say Hi to Sheila the bartender.

One of my favorite places for sushi. Restsraunt is cozy and comfortable. The service is fast and friendly. The sushi is fresh. The price is reasonable.  They're is a lot on the menu even if you don't like sushi. I have tied many different items and all were great.

The Doubletree was very nice! We had a first floor room that provided easy pool access and a great view of the bay. We even got to see some manatees in the early morning. Bummed that I didn't get any chocolate chip cookies as advertised and breakfast service was spotty. Overall great experience and would return.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: When we arrived the first room we were in had hair all over both beds and the room was okay but not what we were expecting, so we called the front desk and they gave us a new room which was beautiful. The bathroom was nice, there was a huge tv and a great view of the ocean on our back patio. I would definitely stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Don't forget your wallet, high price ice cream cones, you can buy one at Burger King for .50 and I swear there is hardly any difference. The place might be nostalgic but the prices are over the top for what you get and I don't find anything that tasty or great myself....

If you order the simple things like tacos, quesadillas, tostadas, burritos and chimichangas, this is very good authentic Mexican food.  Choose fillings from among lengua (our favorite), al pastor, etc.  We prefer these to the more elaborate plates, which tend to be more Tex-Mex style.

I used to spend a lot of money here. Worst experience today at this Starbucks at Hillsborough & Memorial in Tampa. They ground my coffee incorrectly, argued with me, and refused to correct it unless I bought something else. Blew my mind. They were incompetent, rude, condescending, disrespectful and greedy.

I have never experienced any business with this level of service. These are the nicest people and the dry cleaning is impeccable. I would highly recommend this establishment to anyone. I believe this place is worth driving to from another town, that is how strongly I feel about this business.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Warning: mask rules are not enforced here! Ive asked multiple times at the desk for them to enforce but ive never seen any action and there are always at least a few people who dont wear masks :( but they have some good equipment and usually isnt too busy, sometimes showers are kinda dirty and smelly too
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This place is inside a hotel that's hard to locate if you're searching on foot. The pieces of pork were amazing but the carrots were hard. I thought they would've been a little cooked. The place is dark inside but has an amazing rooftop patio experience/view.

Day 1 was great. Maybe cause I went super early.  

Unfortunately it's gone downhill. The last time I immediately noticed a bad odor. No other way to put it except it smelled like sh"t. Very strong odor. I held my breath and proceeded to go laundry. 

It's a shame because their machines are pretty good.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I stayed for 2 nights. While the room was fine the staff had the the personality of a mop. No greetings, smiles,  nothing. For the hospitality industry I was really surprised. The continental breakfast consisted of juice, coffee, hard boiled eggs, bagels and bread.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: If I could give this place a 0 star I would. Owner is not present the shop is constantly closed and the hours aren't correct ever. The wait time isn't worth it when it's all said and done. Barbers are in the service industry, which means you need to be open to provide a service.

We keep giving this place another try. There is a lack of ambiance which makes it seem cold in here. We have had good meals with bad service and vice versa. Seems every time there is a new good server they go onto greener pastures. Needs some work to get on our regular list of places to go.

I had the Peddler buzz with an order of ribs. Both of which were delicious. The drink was an Irish whiskey which was made to perfection and the ribs were fall apart, melt in your mouth good. The service was okay And the price. was about what I expected it to be.

First time ordering from this Papa John's and I am well pleased.  Ordered a large cheese with sausage and pepperoni.  Sauce was a little spicy...will ask to go light on the sauce next time.  But overall good pizza.  Delivery was nice and friendly.  Will order from them again.

Amazing coffee and Gooey Butter Cake!  I hade the margherita pizza and my sister had the grilled grouper sandwich. She loved her sandwich and ate it all.  The pizza was tasty.  The coffee was amazing, my sister thought so also and she is not a coffee drinker.  First time we had Gooey Butter Cake in St. Louis and it was delish!

If it was not for cheap pizza. I won't go here!! The people that have work here . Are like the trashiest of the trash.  They dont have a filter for the mouth. But I guess that's what you get for $5 pizza!! The emplacement has no respect for themselves or the customer to come in there.

The food probably isn't 4 star worthy but I've grown up with this place so it deserves a better rating for longevity and just staying the same all these years. I love the hard shell steak tacos and how they prepare them. Great salsa and great location. Thanks for all you guys do.

Went here after a late conference presentation. The good places were packed, and many of the lunch places were closed. It was pretty good pizza for not having a plan. if you are tired and don't want to go out, you could do worse.

The pizza isn't worth a trek, but it's fine if you're tired and nearby.

The mix of wonton soup and egg drop soup was very good as was the house special lo mein.  However, the sesame chicken was inedible--a very large portion (coated excessively with whatever the red glop is) was too tough to cut with a fork or chew. Dumped it out!

It's dinner time and there's only two people here and they have a drive thru and dine in. There's veggies everywhere, other veggie bins, on the floor, everywhere! Same with the bread trays, it's just very disorganized. Actually, I was wrong, there's a third employee, but she's sitting in the dining room playing on her phone.

We like this place. The food is good and they have a decent beer selection. We tend to sit in the bar and the service can be spotty. Two different occasions I have ordered clam chowder and received chicken velvet soup. I ate it because I didn't want to wait but come on.

The first time I tasted there pizza it sucks no taste and expensive one slice $ 4:20 cents they cut a 14 inch pizza in 6 slices they total cost of the pizza is about $ 2:50 cents they selling 6x4:20=$ 25:20 cents $ 22:70 profit Amin let them make a profit this is rediqules I will never eat at sparros pizza agin

By far the best chicken joint around!  This restaurant is small and not well kept, but the chicken is to die for!  They offer the same sides as most others, but they seem to taste better...especially the green beans.  I never eat in, always grab and go.  Definitely worth a try, but be careful! You may get hooked!

Good lord! This place deserves less than one star. I waited in line for 50 minutes because of two staff members that showed ZERO sense of urgency and ZERO understanding of what customer service is. I will never use this company again. At least not at this location

Stopped by on my way home to get  treat for my sore throat. Service was adequate-nothing special. Purchased a medium scoop of pear sorbet-tastes like soap, chocolate, coffee and birthday cake - no taste at all - gelato. Scoops were of average size so, imagine my surprise when the bill was $17.44. First and last visit.

This is my favorite nail spa in philly. The environment is so peaceful and the staff is so sweet. I go to Sylvia and she always does the best job. My nails look amazing every time and they can do pretty much anything you ask for. Also the nail color variation is great!!

Not just a bar! I have been here several times over the past year, each time the food has exceeded my expectations. Creative menu, excellent service and reasonable prices. Tonight we had steak frittes and halibut tacos. Both were excellent. A great option if you find yourself in downtown Doylestown.

We got hungry parading down Bourbon Street on Halloween night so we stopped here for a bite. I had some medium spicy wings that were surprisingly good.I also tried a bite of my friend's Caesar chicken wrap but it was very salty.Not a fan of the pianos . It was fun watching the people take shots on the barber chair!

Great location. Friendly staff. Very nice breakfast buffet including the usuals (scrambled eggs, bacon, fruit, cereal) and also local specialties like sausage gravy and biscuits. Lobby area very clean. Nice towels, which is typical of Hilton facilities. Only complaint is that my sink wasn't cleaned during my stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Jules is cute, clean, no frills, organic restaurant that serves gf pizza and desserts. The gf pizza crust is good, not great but they are a ton of options to choose from. The desserts from a local baker, are pretty yummy. I had a salad which was really delicious and I highly recommend trying while having a slice.

We had a blue cheese burger, French fries, beer and wine. At fourty bucks it was okay. I like the neighborhood feeling of the place but the burger wasn't as good as Le Bus but cost more, at 7:30 last Saturday they weren't busy. Chef if you read this please perk up your fall menu.

Used to be decent but today did a terrible job on exterior and didn't even do interior until I complained. Still did crappy job plus looking at car I saw the driver side back door had scratches on it which weren't there before. Tried to talk to the manager and he says your car was dirty and it isn't our fault. WTH. Won't be back

Loved the variety of topping you can pick. Went on a Sunday evening at it was so packed. Go when it isn't crazy.  The only bad thing about the pizza was they just threw the topping and was a very small amount too.  I will be trying this place again when it's not crazy.

This was our first time at the Hyde Park location. Pros: food is good, service was good, and everything came to the table pretty quick.

Cons: tacos are not very big and the price is a little steep for tacos. Parking can be difficult if you don't get there early.

Do it again? Probably not..

Last couple times I been here not so great. The 2.00 Taco are a joke order off the regular menu...  by the time you order rice and beans ... it's cheeper off the menu..no flavor in the chicken... I ordered a cup of cheese queso for 5.95 it was literally less than 2 ounces. Really need to find a Mexican restaurant in St Pete.

Love, love, love this place! The ice cream is SOOOO good! They have great customer service as well. This location is cash only, but there is a Chase Bank nearby in case one happens to stop by without cash. I couldn't decide between two flavors, so I was able to get 2 "1/2 scoops" for my single scoop purchase!

This is one of my favorite breakfast joints. The prices are reasonable, the grits are creamy and the bacon is crispy. I love the ambience it's a family run place with veteran staff members. The eggs are always hot and fresh made to your liking. I'm always pleased when dining at Ajs good food and better people.

How can a doughnut store not have doughnuts when I order them this place is poorly ran by kids that seem they are on the new gummy bears she totally forgot my order and I was only customer in line very upset never will return to this store and hopefully maybe a new Starbucks will pop up

I'm sorry but I was ok with the fries till I got home and they all were totally burnt and hard and cold and to find out my McDouble meat is more dry then then bun and burnt the cook must have fallen asleep this is ridiculous I will never go back to this mcdonalds wish I could get a hold of someone here who acct cared
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I personally love to shop at giant. This giant is my favorite one. They have all the products I need. As well as fresh meat, produce and deli. It is great that they have a beer garden, coffee bar, and gas station. They never have long lines. Employees are friendly. And most importantly it is clean.

The music wouldn't have been as bad if the "hype man" wasn't so crude. He sang over every song, ruining any chance of you being able to dance and enjoy yourself. Felt more like he was trying to make a low budget girls gone wild video than host a party. Too many bars on Bourbon to waste your time and money here. #BarRescue

I absolutely love this restaurant! The building is really nice inside, kind of fancy but not too fancy. It has a quaint romantic atmosphere. The food is absolutely delicious! From their warm crunchy bread to their tasty Fettuccine Bolognese, this Italian restaurant is a classic. Not too pricey, and definitely worth it!

The portion was good for the price, but I was moved by the flavor at all. The dumplings were so weird! Not sure what was in them or how they were cooked, but I didn't like them at all. I wished the specified in the menu their not traditional dumplings. Overall, I don't think I will be returning here.

Great food and service!  The waitress Sheri was great and always stopped by to check on us and make sure everything was ok.  The Veal Lasagna and Chicken Piccata were excellent. Very nice atmosphere and pricing was 1/2 off on entries that day :-) I would definitely recommend this restaurant.

Great restaurant with spectacular view of the sunset in the gulf. Dinner was excellent along with the 3 Amigos for entertainment. The only negative is outside eating has smoking which is a shame. Also, we were not able to park onsite. I had to drop off my wife in front and park 6 blocks away and walk back.

Allting var superbra! Trevlig personal, bra priser och jätte god mat. 
Tog pasta alfredo, den var krämig och helt perfekt portion.
Tog dock lång tid innan man fick ett bord fast restaurangen inte var full, oorganiserad personal.

Alfredo $11.69
Pizza med ost $12.39

I love this place. It's always a solid choice. Great drinks and nice variety of totally different awesome tacos. Everything I've had here so far has been pretty great. Not my #1 but a super solid choice because great food, good and fast service and totally fair prices.

We live around the corner and swing by here all the time when the weather is nice.  Great rotating flavors.  I had "banana flambé" tonight, which was a banana and caramel flavor.  They always have low fat and no sugar added options.  Assuming you don't drown your yogurt in chocolate, it's a good healthy treat.

I really love this salon. Almost every manicure and pedicure that I have received here is excellent. The downside is that I often have a hard time getting in because they do not accept appointments. The parking lot is also very tiny so I recommend parking across the street.

Not the worst donuts I've had in my travels, but far from the best.  Got the raspberry filled, icing filled, and maple glazed.  The staff seemed genuinely nice.  If you're in the Indianapolis area and are close by give it a try, but wouldn't go out of your way to get here.

Great food..cold corned beef sandwiches are awesome. Please bring back hot ham and cheese sandwiches, they were my husbands fav-nos only offered in the jr. Sz. Empoyees way too hot in the summer,although they still provide a smile and a thank you. Recommended- air conditioner. It's nice to see the Empoyees comfortable.

Food is fine. The owner made a random homophobic comment about the two guys ordering in front of me who were clearly just two dudes hanging out. Unprofessional. Not a good way to talk to your customers, especially when your business is new to the neighborhood...

Cozy, friendly, attentive service, and great quality food. It's not a huge place, and we went on a Saturday night so it was packed with fun-having, loud people. We don't always go for that kind of backdrop, but it worked perfectly here. Will definitely go back. Also - the gorgonzola gnocchi is crazy good.

Mexican rice bowl was disgusting! The chicken had a funky color, not sure if it was dark meat or what! Chips and salsa were ok, nothing great. I've had the taco salad with ground beef before and it was ok, nothing to write home about. I can't see myself going back.

You can't get better high- quality Italian food in Tucson.  Raised on Chicagoland's Italian, I've been on a mission for over a decade to find good Italian food with a white tablecloth, crusty bread, and excellent olive oil. Enter Vivace. I recommend anything and everything, but don't leave without trying the martini!

Good spot for sushi in old city. Definitely try one of their specialty rolls. Late crowd. We got there around 8:15 and no prob sitting at sushi bar. Was more crowded by 9:30 when we left but still room st the sushi bar. Plus just down the street from sweet Charlie's and what goes better with sushi than ice cream for dessert?

Their pizza, pasta, and salad are okay.  They access to the restrooms are not easy getting around; and not clean either.  They need to consider getting a sound equipment system so people outside can hear when their order is ready.  

Tony's is much much better.

This is one of my family's favorite places to eat.  We go here all the time, even though it's completely out of our way.  

The prices are great, the portions are generous and the food is consistently good.  

The lunch specials are a particularly good deal if you're in the area.  Unfortunately they don't deliver.

Great mom and pop restaurant. Came here based off of Groupon ... they serve a lot food for what you pay but Service it self was not very attentive and we were the only people in the building .. we waited about 20-25 min just for the check and never got our refills for our drinks

This is my second visit to this restaurant and I just say this time was much better. The pizza good , the Brushetta in point and the parm delicious. My only regret was the eggplant rotelli did not have the ricotta and crisp eggplant. It was soft.,despite this the atmosphere was enjoyable and I will return

Really enjoyed the food. Cook was accommodating with special request. Server was excellent. The only draw back for me was we waited 1/2 hr past our reservation time. I realize it's a small place, very busy, however the wait, when you're hungry was a turn off.

A great, comfortable spot to leisurely enjoy a book or magazine over a cup of coffee when you have time to relax.  Service in the morning is SLOW -- you can grow old and die waiting for a toasted bagel with cream cheese.  If you're in a huge rush, I wouldn't recommend ordering food here in the morning.

My husband and I ate breakfast here while in town for a conference. He got the Western Omelette Sandwich and I got the Bacon, Egg, and Cheese Croissant. Both were delicious! The eggs were very fluffy. We also got coffee which was great as well. We enjoyed the atmosphere and the staff was cheerful and friendly.

Pizza was good, but the $9.00 King of the Hill sandwich should be called King of the Nill! It was plain and bland. Chips and salsa were nasty. I don't know where the salsa came from but it tasted like super cheap store bought factory made Salsa.
I spent a lot of money for a very mediocre lunch.

Came here during mardi gras. Great food, service was okay. It was not crowded at all and they confused half of our order, but politely corrected it when we told them. Pulled pork sandwich and cole slaw were delicious!

We could watch parades from the window while we snacked on yummy food. Can't go wrong with that!

This is the worst Dunkin' Donuts I've ever been to. They are ALWAYS out of something! They do not carry a full line of products and most of the time the order you receive is wrong. I go out of my way to not come
To this Dunkin' anymore. And the store looks like it could use a good scrubbing!

Breakfast was good. Service stunk. Seen our server when we sat down and when she brought our food. We had no syrup or ketchup at our table. I had to walk around and take from other tables. We both ran out of our drinks halfway through breakfast and drank melted ice because We could not find the server to get a drink.

Went for the first time to mix things up and was glad I did. First off, when you walk in you notice how clean it is, especially compared to it's nearest competitor. The beer selection was excellent and the food I ordered was perfect. Buffalo chicken cheesesteak. Highly recommended. I'll be going again.

Ordered 6 rolls, 4 miso soups, 1 edamame, and 1 yakatori for 4 people for lunch. The sushi was fresh and tasty but we were all starving when the food was finished.  Pathetically tiny portion sizes for the $60 cost.  Would easily have been $120 to feed the 4 normal humans. Just not worth the cost.

Update to previous review. 
Had the cheesesteak, as I'd seen someone else get one that was loaded with meat and looked delicious. That was not the case when I ordered mine. My dog enjoyed the rest of it though! Also had some pizza. That was pretty good. So if you're in the mood for pizza, go for it. Anything else, run for it.

We gave the Pyramid Grill a shot tonight. We thought the food was really good and was decently priced.  The service was really good,  our waiter Justin took great care of us. This location has had many restaurants cycle through,  I hope these guys stick around.  We will come back,  good to support the local business!

I give this place three stars. I stopped in for lunch. It was very clean inside. Great atmosphere. Service was great. A lot of people seem to enjoy it. I ordered the steak enchiladas. The food was ok. Nothing special. As I said, a lot of people seemed to enjoy it.

Is the pizza better then the Domino's right around the corner?  I suppose it is.  But is it worth the price mark up that comes with real quality pizza?  I don't think so.  Kinda in a weird spot where its definitely better then low quality grease but also not so good to be charging 15-20 dollars a pie.

Good experience, first time to this place. Lots of seating indoor and outdoor , live music. We were looking for good coffee but they didn't have much specialty coffees. Ended up getting one margarita pizza and fries, tea, and dessert everything was tasty. Nice hang out spot and good bite. Will go back.

I don't get it.  This is the worst pizza I've had since moving to the burbs.  The crust is bland and tasteless with way too much cornmeal stuck to the bottom.  Traditional brick oven pizza crusts are supposed to be thin because of the high temperatures and quick cooking times.  This was a bready, Domino's like crust.  Terrible!

A friend recommended this place for tasty, unique soft serve and boy it did not disappoint!! I had the charcoal in a chocolate waffle cone with fruity pebbles for my topping. They offer free samples and two free toppings with your order. Definitely recommend and I will be back!!

Christy was our bartender. She was great!  Very attentive and made really good drinks. We found this place while with some friends. Cool neighborhood bad with a lot of regulars who were all very nice and outgoing. You won't be disappointed getting drinks here. It was a great time.

Not a fan of this Starbucks.   I would go as far as to say it is the worst in in Indy.    The staff is slow and unfriendly and the location always seems drab and dirty.   There are plenty of other locations just wish they would redo the staff and interior of this one because it is closest for me.

This place is so underrated! I love the food here. It's not top notch but you can't beat the price! Plus, they give you huge servings and not just little bit like other Italian places close by! The pizza is definitely better than other pizza places I've been to so far. Give this place a try!

Ok, well 
you have to take this place all in stride-good n affordable sushi-crapass service.  I have been to cafe mochi over two dozen times and maybe twice had decent service.  The one time we had excellent service we just gushed all over the waitress!  It's worth it if you can accept the shitty service.  I accept.

This animal hospital was great when it was Cherry Hill - but now that it is Red Bank it appears to be all about the money. They are very expensive. My daughter took her dog in for a small cyst, and they tried to over charge her because the specialist was on duty and she "saw a specialist". Time for a change!

This hotel was a true disappointment. Rooms were dirty, sheets not changed.
Some front desk members were rude and indignant, totally screwed up our bill, the housekeeping manager was doing check out.
The Bistro was extremely over priced. The only good thing was the location.
Would not recommend.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great gnocchi. My chicken forte was just ok. My wife's lamb chops came out COLD. With how difficult it is to park in this neighborhood, and without valet parking here,  and considering we were underwhelmed with the food,it's just not worth the trip from south jersey.

Wonderful experience. The freshness of the food was incredible, the fish was so fresh.
The stuff amazing and friendly. Also kitchen chef Chen is professional. He knows what he's s doing. Sushi chef Derek is the best! I love his Sea Urchin shooter. High recommend.

Didn't believe all the bad reviews but guess what...they're right. Took over 15 minutes to get two burgers and an order of fries. Kept asking what my order number was. Finally got order went home only to find out I had two raw burgers. Cross this place off
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: So happy to have this place in the neighborhood! Best. pizza. ever. We got the one with the ham and fontina cheese.  All ingredients were fresh and tasty.  It was easy to pick up a piece, meaning the crust was crispy enough to hold up the ingredients. This will be our new go-to place for pizza.

I don't know. Maybe my expectation was too high. Rolls were good but I was little disappointed with chef's choice on sashimi combo order. Also yellow tail sushi tasted fishy. I'm not sure if I'll go back. If I do, I'm going to try other things, not sushi. 
Oh and recommend to make reservation before you go.

It was recommended by a friend to check it out and it was good. 
 
Food was ok overall. I was bit disappointed by uni nigiri. It had after taste of bit bitterness. I had better. Rolls were ok. I enjoyed tempura vegetables and shrimp. They were really good. 

Parking was convenient. 

Service was ok. It's very busy place.

I read the Yelp reviews on Luxury Nails and decided it was worth a try. I had a polish change for shellac, and the manicurist did a great job. Usually I wait over an hour at my usual salon, I was pleasantly surprised that I was in and out of Luxury Nails in 20 minutes. I will definitely be returning to luxury nails.

Super nice and brand new hotel. Location is fantastic. the staff is lovely from the managers to the valet service. They are all happy to help. Walking distance to all of Clayton. Hotel has a bar downstairs and excellent work out room. Probably the best Hampton Inn I've ever been to.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Rich and creamy frozen custard. CASH ONLY!

Two base flavors, vanilla and chocolate, go from there with cones, sundaes, and cements. Cements are like blizzards, with candy or fruit mixed in. I got the raspberry cement which was delicious, could've used a few more raspberries. Cute place in a really nice neighborhood.

The facility needs help! The car return was easy enough, but getting picked up is a nightmare. There  should be a drive for customer drop off / pick up other than walking all the way across the lot to the highway. Pouring rain didn't help, as I was completely soaked before reaching the gate. This can be much better

My go to place for an affordable great meal. I take my family of four for dinner for around $30! You simply can't beat that for the quality of food! They have the best fajitas as well as some excellent drink specials! The service I have received has always been excellent

Our favorite quick lunch spot! A wide range of ingredients to customize your experience, which makes it difficult to go back to Chipotle or Qdoba (our old mainstays). 

The staff is somewhat hit or miss, but most of them are efficient and friendly! Some even remember your order if you come in enough (like we do...).

As bad as it gets. The food here is way below average. Probably because of the LOW QUALITY. I don't know. They just don't taste fresh and are bland in flavor. I have given this place many chances, but after that last visit, tennou is off my list. I regret all those time and money i spend on this restaurant.

These guys know good customer service! I was waiting in the waiting room with my family while my new tires were getting put on. I couldn't help but notice how kind and helpful everyone who worked there was, even with being consistently busy. I felt like we were taken care of and the guys were genuinely nice and efficient!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The employees walking around the store here are very helpful and I think they have a great selection of wine and liquor. My only gripe is that the cashiers seem to be disgruntled every time I've ever checked out. Kind of a bummer when the rest of the experience is good.

Ordinary.  And they have a sewage problem so if you are sitting near the rest rooms you may become overwhelmed by the smell and then the staff spraying Lysol.  Just plain third world and it was expensive for the quality.  At half the price It would have received 2 and a half stars (if there where half stars).

I'm a no-frills coffee person. I typically drink it black, preferably in a paper to-go cup. 
If you're looking for the opinion of a coffee expert, I cannot help you.

But I can say that this is the best coffee in Fishtown. Taste-wise, the flavors are just delicious. The hook brings you back...

Stopped here on the way home from Clearwater. Friendly service.  Solid Mexican food.

Carne asada was very tender.  The fresh guac is amazing.  Chipotle shrimp is very flavorful.

The refríed beans were not my favorite preparations. But is just my opinion. 

The chicken quesadilla was also very yummy.

4 stars over all.

Catfish for 2 of group came out not cooked . Waitress took it back to get properly cooked fish. 6 of us finished our dinner and fish never came out for the other 2. Might be awhile before I come back . Disappointed this trip...! Manager offered 1/2 off the 2 meals but this was after everyone in our group had finished their dinner.

They have excellent service. Lovely cashiers. Although, they do not dog ice cream. I took my dog in and they didn't even let her on with me. I took her through the drive thru and I asked for their best dog ice cream and they started being really rude. 0/10 IGN would not recommend no quick scoops.

I love sushi and have been looking for an inexpensive spot near my home.  I ordered the spicy tuna roll, California roll and assorted tempura.  It was alright.. Not the best but not horrible. I would order again but it is just fairly expensive for the quality so I will probably just order when I am really craving it.

We had no issues here. Check in was easy. The room was clean. We also got breakfast and it was decent for hotel food. The pool didn't have a hot tub which is what i look forward to but it is what it is. 

.... we did find this super creepy note in the pull out sofa bed
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Gotten food from this location several times through DoorDash. It's always good! I'm only knocking off one star as the last time my burger arrived lukewarm and it was clear they got one part of the order ready way before the rest of it. Otherwise, I recommend!

Grateful to have this available, especially during COVID... but be prepared to wait in the drive-thru line for at least 35 minutes. Also, don't be afraid to put extra milk! Countless times I end up just putting in my own milk to make it the caramel color I enjoy.

Very rude service. Been coming here for a few weeks and still no change. I can understand employees having a bad day, but a bad week (or bad weeks) is not okay. On the positive side, the location is convenient and has decent parking, but expect slow and rude service. The Subway further down Carrollton is a lot better!

I stopped by with my little dirty car, especially on the rear end & bird poop on the back passenger window! I picked the $8.00 wash and left with the front end cleaned, back end still dirty and bird poop still on the window! I don't know why I keep trying this place out! I won't be back!

My son took me here for lunch, his favorite place! I ordered the broccoli and beef lunch platter and it was very Good! Usually the beef and broccoli is over cooked, but they did a great job! The pot stickers were okay, I had better! I kept my leftovers for my dinner at work tonight! Yes I would go back!!

Our reservation was a bit last minute but was handled promptly. We were celebrating 3 birthdays and had a lovely dinner. The food is very good but the menu is a bit limited. Prices are reasonable. Our servers were pleasant. Our deserts were on the house for our birthdays which was a nice touch. We will be back.

Meh... got the Grand Champion wash, but I did not get a cloth to wipe my dashboard, or any air freshener for inside the car. I doubt that I actually got the full grand champion level wash, because the employees did not seem invested, and it's an automated car wash system.

So after writing my review a month ago, I got an email from the service manager asking me to call him for a follow-up.  (Funny, couldn't he just look up my records and call me himself..?)  Regardless, I called and left a message.  No call back.  Shockingly amazing service!

Great new addition to the neighborhood Publix shopping center. This is by far one of the nicest Wendy's with touch screen ordering tools and a very clean and modern inside. The drive trough is always very quick and responsive. Staff is always friendly. My daughter loves their frostys!

I love donuts. These donuts, while edible, are not my favorite. The donut holes are rather dry and so was the German Chocolate one I had. I would go back again, because I do love donuts and I like to support small business, but they are too overpriced to make it a regular visit.

I was visiting from Victorville this weekend and stopped by this place, good thing I did the food was real good  burger was good shake was good but the onion rings were perfect !! Next time I'm in this area I will for sure stop here. And the customer service was good also.

Had good service, was clean and friendly. food was good... Chicken a little over cooked, a little salty and some things were very good like soup and tempura while others were  just ok. Seemed a little expensive for amount of food. Beers were $5 each   Not sure if I will go back...  Nothing bad to say but nothing overly great...

Regretting this decision to eat here, old dingy location, needs update and a deep clean. 
Had the Grandpa burger 3 dry flimsy patties coated in seasoning salt to try to give them a flavour other then dry cardboard.
The root beer is the only thing decent in this dying chain.

20 minute wait for the shuttle (in the middle of a Saturday) then a 37 minute wait in line to check in for the car. Complete lack of urgency on behalf of the staff and indifferent to the long wait time. Car was clean and they had a good selection of vehicles.

First time and last time going to this car wash was very disappointed car was streaky vacuum was really bad did not clean interior dashboard for the $26 price tag I think this is way overpriced not happy at all I would not recommend anyone they're it could have been a bad day but this was an extremely bad first impression

Food was pretty good, but they refused to honor a Restaurant.com certificate which they are legally contracted to honor. 

"We do have an agreement with each restaurant, which requires them to honor all outstanding certificates even if they choose to cancel." Restaurant.com

Food is actually really good, you would probably think it's not, but the place has the worst customer service. Every time I went it just kept getting worse and worse. Never going there again. One of the servers who has a tattoo in her chest is rude ass f%#& and sucks at this job. Trust me!!!

Service is very standoffish and unwelcoming. Been here twice, first had vegetarian chimichanga and it was ok. Them had the mushroom quesadilla and it was horrible. Mushrooms were chewy and not even seasoned. Made me feel sick and could not finish it. I don't plan on returning.

I found this place on Yelp after moving to St . Louis last year. They do such a great job for a fair price, I've been coming here ever since. I've never bought anything more than the Basic wash, and my Prius looks brand new when these guys are finished.  It's worth a trip to Rock Hill!

Took my car to Dobb's for an oil change. A month ago. Still having issues with my car after engine blew up after they didn't tighten my oil filter properly. Their insurance is handling things and a dealer has taken over on repairs. Do not recommend this place and will never go back!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Definitely the best place to go in NOLA. I've basically had everyone cut my hair (Hannah, Sherie, Paula, Jeremy), and I've loved my hair every time. For me, it's worth the price. The staff is extremely attentive and they genuinely care about their clients. Got a lifer here!

Never again with this place. I rented a specific SUV and of course when it was time to rent it the Budget people couldn't find the SUV...so I got a crappier version to drive. The girl behind the desk couldn't keep her face out of her phone...and had such an attitude. 
You get what you pay for I guess

Let's start with the shelves .....the items are never pulled forward at the end of the night. Shouldn't this be someone's job? The cashier behind the customer service desk, I think his name is Tyler or Tom? Anyway....what a grump, no hi's, thank you's ....nothing. Very rude behind that counter, like we are bothering him to help us.

Delightful place to go for a solid meal, though not on my first tier of Italian places in the city.  Great outside patio for dining when the weather is nice.  Good meatballs, Sunday gravy, pastas are hit or miss with flavors for me and I prefer when there are more homemade pasta options.

Ordered from here last night.. took an hour to come which was expected because there were 5 of us ordering. I ordered kung pao chicken. I got all of 4 pieces of chicken but a shit load of vegetables... that was kind of disappointing. The sauce itself was really good

First time in over a year- salmon was still great- now there are TVs, and a major shift in the sushi prep.  No more  Japanese Sushi Chef.  I miss that Japanese stoicism and absolute command of the knives, the forehead bandana, the shouted greeting when you sit at the Sushi Bar.

Not quite sure where the great reviews are coming from. The sushi here was just really bad. I've had sushi from grocery stores that's better. The service was poor and I'd steer clear of the wine too. We will continue our search for good sushi in Nashville.

Fantastic local coffee shop. High quality  espresso bar and an eclectic food menu with breakfast served all day . Terrific place to escape and steal away a few moments of peace on a hectic day. The crowd is as diverse as the menu. Laid-back and welcoming atmosphere. A true gem.

This is the only Dunkin on my way to work and while they aren't the greatest they aren't the worst either. Depending on when I go I can either get the best service or the worst. Afternoons are usually when I have the most issues with my order. I just wish they'd move a little faster in the mornings
