Yep, it is that good!!!  No need to expand on the positive reviews, it is THAT GOOD.  For this who have given this place less than 5 stars for "parking" or the server not going through the menu, stop posting reviews, no one cares!!! Go if you like spectacular food!!!!!

Food and service was great...especially during the lunch crowd. Came here this past Friday with a coworker and we both ordered a bento box. Our waitress was very attentive, polite, and personable. Will definitely come back with coworkers again. Too bad I live a bit far from the restaurant, however it's close to work!

The entire meal was extremely rushed. We were asked multiple times by multiple waiters to have our plates removed when there was still food on them. I understand there are multiple reservations per night, but there should be more time allotted for each reservation. 

The food was excellent however if you don't mind being rushed.

The store itself is fine, but the drive thru is atrocious. I've never waited less than 10 minutes and I come here frequently. Today they have a sign saying "pull around to the window to order." I've been waiting 15 minutes already. Get it together, Starbucks.

The wonderful staff at the Hyatt went above and beyond when I stayed with them. I had a rough day upon arrival and they made it all better. They upgraded my room and sent me a bottle of Pinot Noir (which was very good!). Thank you Jennifer, Andrea and all the staff that made my stay pleasant.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Fucking gross ass McDonald's! 
How is it that you can order something so simple yet your order is trash?
I ordered a ranch crispy snack wrap and a double cheese burger. No way in hell should a snack wrap have old chicken in it. No way in hell should a burger be cold after you just received it. Definitely WON'T be back.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is the best car wash i have ever been too. It's very easy to use and very fast once your in the car wash. I didn't think it was going to get all the dirt off but it did! I recommend the wheel shine. The vacuums they have are very strong best of all they are free.

I had high expectations since everyone I talk to loves this place, but I was disappointed. My tacos were kind of bland. Maybe I ordered wrong, but the menu doesn't have that many options so I think I was getting what everyone else gets. It was an okay meal to me, but I won't go again.

This is my second review after doing clothes here a few times and I can say the staff has excellent hygiene and cleanliness especially in Pandemic. I was hesitant to go and I w seen they double up on the help at the machine for the elderly especially!! This is the cleanest place in be come across to do clothes and MASKS REQUIRED
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Great vibe here; chill and relaxing, with friendly and quick service.

The coffee is a tad on the pricey side and there weren't many food options (biscotti was all I saw), but otherwise it's a great place to grab a drink and have a conversation. 

The cortado I ordered was one of the best I've had in the US!

By no means the best or freshest sushi I have had in New Orleans. However, they have a great variety of rolls and pretty good kitchen dishes. But, there is really nothing they do that is special or makes them stick out.

 You can get in and out pretty fast. Not a bad place to stop if you're looking for a quick lunch.

Subway, what's the point in allowing users to do online ordering if your "sandwich artists" aren't competent enough to even to read the simple instructions? Seriously, the only thing they got right was 2 out of the 3 meats that were suppose to be included. Wrong veggies, wrong cheese, wrong sauce.

Also your website is pathetic.

I went to dinner last night here and the food was really good . Except we got the crab cake appetizer and there was barely any crab in them . So I don't recommend that . 
For my dinner I got the baked salmon and it was delicious . I will definitely be going back

Not quite sure why there's so many bad reviews but I thought this place was pretty good the two times I had it. I had it delivered once and the other time I ate in. The quality was pretty good and it wast tasty and cheap! I'm definitely coming back to this place.

The place is greasy. The people who serve you are greasy. The pizza is greasy.  It would be average if they finished cooking their pizza but they don't. My brother says to try the roast beef.

2.2/5 stars. Overpriced for what it is.  Best pizza in carpinteria.

Okay I came, I saw, I conquered. Sorry, I don't get what the big deal is. It wasn't bad, but it wasn't amazing either. Prices are fine and the place is put together. I might take my mom when she visits because she wants to see what the big deal is with the Sonoran hotdog.

Ongoing issues with our account. Fed-up, I made an appointment to close my accounts. I waited 30 minutes when I had a scheduled appointment. Very insincere about having to wait. Major lack in communication and customer service. I was happy to stop dealing with ongoing issues and move my money somewhere I feel appreciated.

Sushi  was absolutely amazing! This is prob my fave sushi place To go to. Doesn't look like much on the outside, but the food is delicious. The staff was very friendly and they were impressed with how much sushi my daughter and I put away! 

Very filling and will be coming back!

I loved Sushi 7 before the new owners came in, that all you can eat soup and salad bar set it aside from all the others, and now the rolls don't taste the same and it seems there is far too much rice over fish. I'm done here, time to find a new place. Take care Sushi 7, you were my favorite...no more

This subway must be under new ownership bc they barely want to add extra vegetables on your sandwich. The spinach on my salad was border line bad with a bitter taste. I called to speak to the manager and was told that he's not in the establishment. Worst experience

Never again! I needed to get my nails done for my engagement pictures last minute. I only needed a gel mani. I had gel on my nails already and he took the drill out to get them off. That is absolutely not the right way to take it off and can do a lot of damage to your nails. The gel didn't last long at all.

I would give it a 5 since I don't like Starbucks but over the past 2 y this place has really gotten run down.  This is a neighbourhood favourite but the blinds are missing in some windows and the armchairs are so bad some patrons were thinking about going on Kijiji and finding chairs for free and bringing them here.

Try learning to accept bills larger than 20's especially when I order for 6 people and the total is 40+ it's ridiculous for me to think you can't break a 50. What kind of irresponsible manager made that a rule? Fix it. This place sucks worse than any Arby's specifically for this rule.

The food was great we stopped in to cap off a Sunday Funday with friends and the prices were reasonable we had about 6 different rolls all were PERFECT and the baby squid was awesome and the dumplings were a 6 out of 10, they don't have a kid friendly menu

This place is pretty bad, the menus average, this kind of food didn't really work at nutts at the canal before. Nothing special, waste of a nice space. Had cheese steak and chicken sandwich, beef was gross on cheese steak and the gauc on the chicken was rancid.

My burrito came out nice and hot and loaded with meat and veggies. It tasted amazing. My husbands fajitas were tasty as well. Chips were perfect amount of salty, salsa was a little too oniony for my preference but still enjoyable. The peach margarita was perfect.

Been going here For many years and never been this disappointed as I was this Sunday 9-24-17! Was seated in the bar area and after waiting for more the 15 min for service, no one showed and we walked out. Can not recommend this place to anyone any more. Go to Duffers a few miles away and better service and food

This place has goooood food! The wings & crab rangoon are my fav! Food is always hot & fresh. They cook it fast but delivery... not so fast. [Only one delivery made]. Staff is really friendly! Good prices. I'm definitely going to start eating here more often!!

Update: delivery times have gotten better! Food is always hot & fresh!

Delicious food! We love the kitchen service and the carnitas! This is not a dinning establishment but it is your quick save if you're traveling and need a bite, headed to the beach or picking up dinner to go. They also sell asada, adovada and chicken to grill.

This restaurant is nice and updated.  You Can skip the counter and order and pay on a touch screen

I think all the employees here are disgruntled because they are automating them out of jobs because none of them gave a rats A about customer service.  

The manager was nice.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: It's 5PM and they have their order ahead turned off - really irritating. It can't be that busy. Besides, we get a estimated time to pick up and we still have to go through the drive through line anyways. This location also took forever to open the inside compared to other locations. What's going on here?

Sorry but if you're a McDonalds off the highway and people make a choice to get off the highway to eat there-  giggling that your shake machine is "down" doesn't cut it. This place has other bad reviews so I shouldn't be surprised. There are too many other options out there to not deliver on the BASICS.
Booooooo!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: What a fantastic deal. The food is pretty good. Not spectacular, but you just cannot beat the AYCE price. Not to mention, the restaurant is very nice looking on the inside--very modern and clean. Quantity definitely surpasses quality, as is the case with most AGCE restaurants.

This grocery store is what it is. Buyer beware, and yes the store is outdated and looks grungy. However, they carry a good amount of fresh fruit and produce, often the apple selection is good. The staff is mellow and nice and respectful. I shop here about once a month or so.

So helpful and kind. Both times I've went I had to go on weekends. This is one of the only places open Saturday and Sunday which is so convenient. They've been honest with me both times and it took about a day for heat shield issue and second time a check engine light issue. I will go there again.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Good pizza and other menu options in the Phoenixville area. My wife and I really like the cheesesteak Stromboli. The only reason I didn't give them 5 stars is that they are slightly more expensive when compared to some others in the area. Great food, great staff - always very friendly.

Normally a good Starbucks location. Was miffed when, after waiting in a long line, discovered they were out of my favorite, one and only item I order, Emperor's Cloud and Mist Tea. Not one barista offered to check if they had any more in the back. Poor order management and lazy workers. Wasn't any better at 16th & Walnut location.

I wanted a shirt with their logo on it but unfortunately they printed a quote on the back of them in a really cheesy font that doesn't match the logo.... Try the Cookie Monster flavor! This is my favorite place. Gone here for years now. Very old school, classic place to get a great treat in New Orleans that isn't commercial trash!

This Place is pretty good I like the chips and salsa because the salsa is spicy and the food is great but on my last visit the meat was kinda dry, I had to ask a waiter to get me another but it was a one time thing I think because it was really good but food takes awhile to arrive so take advantage of the chips and salsa!

The actual wash is pretty good, and the owners/operators are nice.  But I stopped using this a year or so ago when I found big gouges on the sidewall of my tires. These were deep and I had enough of them that the garage I get an inspection from told me to replace the tire.

Not crazy about this place. We seem to have mixed experiences here, with both the food and service. They do have a variety of moderately priced breakfast and lunch items. I can never figure out how there hours work though, because sometimes I drive by when they're supposed to be open, and they are completely closed.

Seated promptly and server quickly took our order. Onion rings were light and crispy but flavorless without sauce. Poppers were good. Menu is limited Sunday to underlined items. Wifes chix was very good.sauce was exellent. but the fries were only so so. Overall meal was ok. Would give it another try if we are in the area

We went to look at new cars at this location. I thought a salesman finally came out since we had been there awhile on an early Wednesday afternoon. 
I turned around and a homeless man was in my face with no mask.
We never did see a  salesman, so please stay away from this location.

Rockstar from start to finish.  Great atmosphere.  Awesome location...able to amp up for an adults night out or bring the kids and make a fun family meal w/ a great vibe.  Have I mentioned margarita carafes yet?  Just order the large meal and let the chefs/staff do the thinking for you.  Awesome.

Pretty expensive for what you get and the beef sliders arent very good at all. I can find better value and quality at other fast food chains.  The only thing worth buying here is the brownie or cheesecake on a stick, only a dollar and 200 calories for yum.

Local spot, usually good. This time my food had plastic in it. I got delivery so did not complain. Will eat here again since this is the first time there was an issue. Had bacon wrapped chicken. I am sure it is prepared in advance so do understand. It's just that it was in a sauce and I did not see it until I was 50% done.

I love Tomo because of their great lunch specials and the deal on the all you can eat sushi. My boyfriend and I used to go everyday for lunch. The only issue I have are with the servers. They seem to stare at you the whole time you eat, especially if not many people are in the restaurant.

We've been here a couple of times and have always been satisfied. 
The pizza is certainly thin as described but always tastes fresh. 
The staff that I've encountered are generally cold but efficient. 
I highly prefer the pizza down the street at Whole Foods but this place is fine once in a while.

Usually ok for fast food but NOT TODAY! My food was over cooked. I tried the new Prime Rib cheesesteak was more like an amount of meat which would go on a slider! Nothing was good today.. not the fish sandwiches, not the cheesesteak, not the fries. I feel like I wasted $22!

Very disappointing :( I have given this location many chances hoping that the next time will be better but the fries are always gross and never taste fresh! On a positive note, breakfast is always good! I get the honey chicken biscuit (amazing) with the potatoe wedges and ice coffee.

Probably not the best best Mexican I have eaten, but a nice place for dinner. I had the fish tacos which was good, but could have been great if they green sauce that went along with it was better. An average dish at best. Nothing wowed us.

Service was good, and staff friendly.

All Bright is the best around! The owner is so friendly, trustworthy, and helpful, not to mention she does great work! I've left anything from t-shirts with stains to black tie dresses with her and they're always returned in a timely fashion and look brand new. The prices are reasonable, too. I won't go anywhere else!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I've always had a good experience with this shop, oil changes, tires and even a set of ball joints, I call ahead and see how busy and then either wait or drop off the vehicle, always receive a call for any issues found with cost. I feel I've always been treated fair on product and cost.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Good for a girls night out and the happy hour was fun with a quirky rum punch. The dessert at the end was smoking and super fun for photos. It was getting pretty quite later in the night so we walked to the Absinthe bar nearby to keep the fun going. Good times!

10 Nov 2019***

My wife had a coffee, which she liked. I had a apple fritter which was as expected.

The young lady behind the counter spoke with clear diction and had good cadence.

The unisex bathroom was very clean.

P.S
They seam to run out of pumpkin spice donuts early each day.

Had a really good cheesesteak from here a few months ago, thought I could get one today, NOPE!!!
Dried out and very skimpy on the meat, not to mention the fried onions were still raw!!!! $9+ and now I have something I can't eat!!! So much for lunch!  REALLY REALLY DISAPPOINTED

Great experience
Finally a restaurant that doesn't cram your entrees down your throat before you get a drink, enjoy you bread and have an appetizer. 
The server (jessica) was amazing; she recommended great dishes and the food was fresh and cooked to perfection. 
Ps blue cheese martini! Need I say more

Friendly staff,  although some act like they hate their job.  Some parts of the store have bad smells.  When you first walk in there is an overwhelmingly smell. Outside the building smells bad.  Good flower and produce department.  Staff in deli are friendly!

What can isay. Basic place, frozen drinks with generoue booze. Simple idea they execute fantastically. Start the day witha 151 octane nurš  your buzx all day. Bougjt the convenient sealed plastic cup. Refills ate are cheap er. Great attitude adjustment to start the day. Reliably good product

Disgusting, uncleaned room. Bathroom door knob was broken so I was unable to get into it (no shower after a 14hr drive...). Hair in the sink. Seemed to be mold in two corners of the room and place looked like it hadn't been dusted or swept in a month. I guess this is what I get for cheaping out on a $50 room. Never again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Visit 10/17/20
Several employees wearing masks below nose, asked to repeat order when got to second window, had to wait.  Fries completely burned and unedible.  Was advised by corporate this is because they are not changing their oil frequently enough, gross!!  Will not be returning
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Mediocre at best, I will not be back.  I ordered the chicken parmesan and it was overly greasy and lacked flavor.  It was served with a very small side of pasta, the sauce also lacked flavor.  The interior is also in need of some updating, the booths are quite worn.  Service was also painfully slow.

Got a dip powder mani today.  Nail tech was not sanitary, dipped my fingers into full jar of product instead of painting on or pouring into individual bowl as recommended. 

Looks good, but worry about sanitation and getting infection or bacteria 

Asked tech and she said always do this way,  won't go back

One of the best dinner experiences we had in a long time. I took my wife to celebrate her birthday. The food was top notch. We did the 4 course meal. For the amount of food and especially the quality, you can't beat the price. I loved the ambiance and would definitely recommend for someone looking for a nice dinner downtown.

This location is a disaster, place is always crowded in the morning only because of nearby Merck company, you will wait at  least 15 minutes for coffee.  Stopped in today, what a mistake, incorrect coffee order that had a burnt taste.  The croissant sandwiches were dime-size and cold, save your money, try a different location.

Very cozy place for two or a big crowd. My baby shower was held here and the staff and food (family style dining) were wonderful. The food is  very good especially for the price. I always feel comfortable dining here, even though I am not a frequent customer.

Wife and I had one of our first dates here. Twenty years later it still excels. Bread bowl of corn and crab bisque is to die for. Wife always loves the seafood stuffed pork chop. The room is quite bland, yet somehow romantic with it's dim light and close confines.

A great experience. Easy rental online, great service at Logan in Boston. Would get more stars except the car they rented me, a Fiat AWD, was a piece of junk. I won't drive another Fiat for as long as I live. Horrible traction, little room in the car, not much get up and go.

Usually I would get sushi here and spend about $20. It was okay for the price and the portion was average. Today though, it tasted weird. Also, maybe it was because we got a sumo roll but it cost more than usual. I'm pretty sure that it's not about $20 for a sumo roll though.

My wife and I tried this place Saturday, the portions are huge and very good. Very casual and inexpensive with a very friendly staff. I would definitely recommend this place to others. Will be going back for sure, if the second trip is as good as the first, the 4 star will be a 5 star (Never give 5 after 1 visit),

Menu says Sweet Iced Tea and Iced Tea. So I ordered Iced Tea. Response "we don't have unsweetened tea. I responded that the menu says you have it. She responded "we don't have unsweetened tea...  seems the 2nd tea canister is filled with coffee...  and they do t have Senior prices!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: While the service was a five star provided by Jordan, the host, Justin was so rude. No smile, no customer service provided and very unfriendly. I come to find out after talking to a friend that he was actually the manager. Hard to believe. Didn't let him ruin our incredible meal though but just couldn't give 5 star.

I was not impressed with the pedicure I received.  The pedicure was not thorough at all and little time was spent on the bottom of my feet, which are still just as rough as when I walked in earlier today.  For a $25 basic pedicure I definitely would have expected a more thorough job.

It's not my favorite. My boyfriend and I came here after passing by several times and reading good reviews. The food isn't as great as it sounds. His pasta dish was too zesty and salty and my pasta didn't have enough flavor. I rather spend a few extra dollars at Bocellis.

This place is a hit and miss, I've received warm yummy glazed donuts as well as cold donuts, I hate that the donuts are cold especially since they have the freaking machine making the donuts. The employees are teens/young adults who are too busy in each other business with mild manners who are un organized.

I wouldn't waste my time to anyone trying to get a simple nail service.  Walked in and lady was on front table with another customer. No hello, no greeting, not even kiss my a**.   Really get annoyed when you go to a service oriented business and not even get acknowledged.

This location is ok if you go in on a weekday but on a weekend just like most car washes they are overloaded and service is lacking...Vacuums are non existent and wipe downs include this shiny slippery Armour all that is not made for cars with leather seats... not good. (under new management)

Same good Starbucks quality; however, the interior design (layout of tables and chairs) leaves much to be desired. It's hard to believe this was the best that could be done with a place built from scratch. I've been in Starbucks converted from gas stations that had a warmer feel inside.

This place has THE BEST SUSHI in town...no wonder it's always crowded!

TRY:
Deep fried tofu with broiled spicy scallop sauce - great appetizer for sharing
Pork katsu
ANY sushi or rolls - ALL of their ingredients are FRESH 
*Lunch specials 

SERVICE:
Good. 

AMBIANCE:
Date night. Girls night out.

Very divey bar, rowdy bikers there, live band on the weekend, very friendly waitstaff, too much smoke and smokers inside, made my clothes smell. Band was good, people were dancing and enjoying themselves. I did not feel the safest there because of the rowdy men.

I come here regularly and am never disappointed. The staff, though looking SUPER young (maybe they're high school students? or maybe I'm in denial about turning 30?), is extremely friendly and the coffee is always delicious. The store is always clean, including the restrooms.

Service was excellent - quick, efficient and attentive
Ambiance was fine. Dinner mid week for two of us.  
Stuffed shells with sausage and meatballs. Really good and a lot of it. 
Salad with bread  
Nothing not to like about the food, the service or the restaurant.

Small  hole in the wall with great food. The fish tacos were awesome everything went together great and especially with their hot sauce. Their bowl of guacamole is also something to try for that it comes with a bowl of different chips to choose from & great guacamole

Great pizza at a terrific value. Always tastes like fresh quality ingredients and the flavored crusts are a must.

If you don't check for coupons, this location has even helped is find the best deal even after we place the order. Hard to find that now adays.

Too bad this chain isn't bigger in the area.

We saw this restaurant on buzzfeed and has to try this place out. By far one of the best burgers I've had before. Service was fast and the menu board was easy to order from. They even have a small covered outdoor area. I will definitely be coming here again on my next trip to Cali!

Very slow, unfriendly workers with unimpressive barista skills. 

Plan to spend a good part of your morning in their drive thru and when you get to the window you will realize they can't queue drinks to save their lives. And good luck not getting your order messed up.

We don't eat pizza very often, but when we do, we ONLY order from here.  It's pricier than other places, but the pizza is the best I've ever had and if I eat pizza, I want it right.  They get it right and their delivery is wonderful.  Thanks Mountain Mikes.

Sudden and dramatic decline in food taste. Chinatown used to be my favorite Chinese restaurant, but the last 2 times I visited, the food was unbearable bad. The same friendly waitresses, but terrible untasteful food. I wonder if the cook or ownership changed in the past year.

Staff is really friendly but the service is so incredibly slow. The drive through line is painful. The starbucks in Wayne never has this issue. You buzz right through. Its so frustrating. It doesn't matter if there are 3 cars or 5 cars in front of you. It always takes forever.

I tried to get a rental car From here thru GEICO and the first girl was rude and hung up on me and I talked to another person and she gave me the runaround that I have to go to my insurance company. I can't believe the customer service here Received five stars.

I really had high hopes ...they fell well below my expectations.  The food was mediocre, the waitress was sadly unknowledgeable about the restaurant and food and the Margherita severely lacking in alcohol for the high price of the thing.  I'd drive to Tampa to have Mexican before I'd eat here again.

Great cleaners. Take good care of clothes and do repairs as discovered without asking. Prices are reasonable and accommodating for rush orders or special requests. if it isn't right, they aren't going to let it out of their shop without fixing it.
Highly recommend.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Everything about this place is perfectly adequate. Haircuts, staff, the free drink while you wait, the location, the price (~$23).

If you're looking for something special go elsewhere, if you want to walk somewhere in the Central West End that's not overly expensive and provides a decent service, then this place works.

Somewhat flavorless. It's like a synthetic pizza. Despite all the options and seemingly fresh ingredients, there just isn't that much flavor going on here. Also, the personal pizza concept is kind of antisocial. Part of the fin of pizza is the communal meal, family style aspect of a shared pie.

Michelle is  Not only did she not pay attention as she worked (buffed same spot she hurt)  Water was so high it almost overflowed She even did one handed shoulder  massage so she could answer a text Chair was broken Weak leg Just brushed on lotion Such a bummer experience!

Oh Yogurt Beach. You will not be able to pull away from my first love of U-swirl because of your lack of cool and awesome flavors. Like cake. And sugar free pecan praline. 
The only reason you got an extra start though was your pretty cool staff who was super nice to me even though I had a half off coupon.

This place is great! So many flavors and toppings and for how much you put on your yogurt it's pretty cheap and it's self serve. I never have a guilt trip going here because yogurt's so healthy. During hot weather this place is pretty crowded but it's a place u gotta try!

The hotel was nice but we ended up in an event room with a murphy bed due to them being sold out. This isn't terrible but the way you present something should be considered. Don't pretend that you're upgrading us to an amazing room when you're stuffing us in the last room you have available.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The tacos are really good but keep in mind they are small. It is very easy to get carried away. We got one of each tacos to share. Personal favorite: fried oyster which is weird because usually I wouldn't eat oysters but it is really good. Sangria was very average.

Nothing special. Good menu and some things are good, some are just ok. I'm not sure what other sushi options there are nearby but I wouldn't go out of my way to eat here.  The atmosphere is quaint and it seems pretty clean. The service was 3 out of 5 stars.  Oh, and keep in mind that its a byob.

Beautiful atmosphere since it was remodeled a few years ago.  Food and Service is hit or miss.  I think they are trying a little too hard, the dinners don't have to be as fancy or as expensive as they make them.  The lunch menu & Monday pizza night (buy 1, get 1) are our favorites.

Absolutely horrible 
Friday nite busy time no staff
2 servers who were overwhelmed 
And 1 cook on unbelievable 
Yes u Guessed waited 40 mins for the order to arrive 
Salads not Mexican but just what u can get in any diner. 
The steak was I thought piece of leather horse meat and not ribeye ugh ugh
Horrible place 
Never again

This is a horrible location. They have been charging me for new filters and not replacing the old ones. They also didn't replace a piece of my skid plate and half the bolts required to keep it in place. Mr. Lube on 137th is obviously not dedicated to their customers and fraudulent. Never go here..

The reason I came here was because I drop my car in the body shop next door. Service is way too slow!!! We wait an hour for our food to come out!!! Sushi is decent but others are terrible. Especially Beef teriyaki. Avoid this place unless you don't have a choice.

I live in Pass-A-Grille and this has been my go to pizza spot.  Not sure if the woman taking the phone orders just doesn't listen or what's going on but this is the second time she's completely screwed up my order.  Time to find a new spot which is a bummer b/c I really like their pizza!

Reserved a truck weeks in advance, they called Friday afternoon before a Saturday morning rental to say they would not have any truck for me. I was told to call the national phone number, no help there either. Save yourself a headache and use U-Haul on 12th & Washington.

Ambrosia! Our family favorite. any time friends or family are in town we always take them here. The new location is nice and within walking distance from our house. Love the Goat Cheese Appetizer, Caprese Salad, and Gambari Pasta - ask for it spicy. When in the Broad Ripple area, Ambrosia is a must!

Absolutely love the patio outside. I do wish there were additional speakers outside for music. They have a great selection of beer. Food is fantastic, would love to see a meatball sub on the menu. The waitresses and bartenders are FANTASTIC this summer. Very accommodating and friendly.

The area doesn't have the best pizza in general.  Pronto is actually among the better pizzas in town. Their wings are Cluck U wings. Breaded and frozen like wing dings.  Just not a good product for a real wing fan. Sandwiches are decent and service is usually good.

I always try the marinara sauce when I try an Italian restaurant for the first time because if a marinara sauce is great on its own, then anything added can only be better.  I tried Ralph's once and was not impressed.  This is not to say the food isn't good, just not good enough for me to return.

Just picked up a small cheese pizza for $9.50 
So basically nine fifty for two slices what a ripoff and disappointment of quality and value obviously they think they are pulling a fast one on the public you should do like me and stay far away from this place 
Good luck this not mannhatan

Won't go back. We have been a number of times but the last time the sashimi was tough and really grossed me out. I think it wasn't cut right. In fact, it kind of ruined me on sushi for a bit. Luckily I was able to get my sushi mojo back by finding a few other places in town to rekindle my passion for lovely, lovely raw fish.

Great Happy Hour, and delicious authentic Italian! My favorite is the Gnocchi with Gorganzola sauce.....TO DIE FOR, little pillows of light deliciousness!!! Awesome bartender, Evo was entertaining and served delicious Margaritas. Calamari is also delicious!!! Give it a try!

Good service but the food was very average. My mushroom sauce on the salmon tasted like cream of mushroom soup out of the can before you add the water. Thick and pasty. Risotto cake was fine. Salmon on the dry side. Only 2 white wines by the glass. Can't say I'll be back as there are so many better places in the city.

Dom is great, he's friendly, accommodating, and does good work at a really fair price. Going to the mechanic isn't ever fun, but all of my experiences at Dom's have been great. If you live in the neighborhood, I definitely recommend keeping your money in a great, family owned business like Dom's.

Place is okay.  They just did a restore.  The drive- in section is a mess! Two lines, don't know who is supposed go next.  An accident waiting to happen.  The turns into the the lanes are too narrow and curve.  What were they thinking when they arranged this drive thru? Service is good, and McDonald's food is always a good value.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Good hotel. Not bad for price. In need of upgrades, but very clean and housekeeping and other hotel staff provided great service. The only real complaint was that the room was in great need of a dehumidifier. Room seemed a little damp when A/C was in use.

The "check in cookie" was fabulous!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My go to place to meet with friends or eat out with family. You always know the food is going to be good. The grouper sandwich and cheeseburger are my favorite. The Florida gold is in my top 3 as well. Yummy fries, nachos, stuffed jalapeños and milkshakes. Never had a bad dish.

I thought it was a tad overpriced. The food was solid. Not amazing. I just did not looove it. Oh and were we suppose to tip? we order at the counter and pay before we eat?? It just didnt do it for me. I'd be back for a drink because that area is nice for downtown reno.

Best sushi I've ever had and at affordable prices. Their spicy tuna is delicious as well as their house salad and ginger dressing (AMAZING). Our personal favorites are the ninza and Dr. Larry (with seaweed paper instead of soy paper). Friendly owners and always packed on the weekends!

Overall, very pleasant experience!
We were visiting from out of town when I had a nail mishap.
Kudos to Tiffany, who fixed the mess, and did an excellent job with my gel pedicure and manicure. My nails look great!
Everyone in the salon was friendly, and the salon was super clean.

Horrible service at this location. Doesn't matter that you are Executive. You will wait. Not a one time issue its constant for those of us who travel there frequently. 

Expect to possibly stand on their shuttles which smell and are dirty!

They only care about taking your $$$

Can I give this place a zero?  Dirty, rude, scary, filthy, odd... Did I say dirty?  Where is the health department?  Don't try to use the bathrooms, they are Never open.  Stay far away.  Drive a little further in either direction for safe food in a clean establishment.

Absolutely incredible meal. The service, the timing of the dishes, the atmosphere, and the food / cocktails were all exceptional.

Dawn was the best waitress I've ever had in any restaurant -- she was incredible.

Without question the best food I've had so far in Philly!

OMG we are here tonight because chef Andrew from master chef jr was there and we had one if the best meals ever!  We split desserts so we could try two and both were excellent!!  We will deffinately go back to try other things from that restaurant even tho they won't be from Andrew!'

Do yourself a favor and "educate" yourself before you go here. $14 doesn't even get the inside of your windows cleaned. Terrible wash, terrible service and my car smelled like rotten eggs when I got inside. The exterior of my windshield was still dirty and the guy argued with me and told me it was the interior. I won't be back.

I liked it, however, for a certified Neapolitan pizza I am surprised I have had better.  The pasta is no nonsense and very fresh but I like a little more flavor.  It is slightly bland.  It is still a good place I just wouldn't go too far out of my way for it.

Was a nice place to take the grandies.  2 comes and a vanilla malt for yours truly. Then it went sideways. The chocolate sprinkles (jimmies. 4 us oldies) started walking. I thought I was seeing things, but no, ants. They made good, with a free cone, but, still ants.

Absolutely the worst waste of money you could spend. Food was bad, like inedible and the simple two entree order was wrong. Not only were they in capable of making the food correct and edible but we wasted 45 minutes waiting on something we threw away. Thank god for peanut butter and jelly.

I have been here a few times. The menu is the same as Crazy Cafe, and I suspect the restaurant are related. Much like Crazy Cafe, the food is delicious and the service is just as good. For the price, it can't be beat. I have tried a lot of the different rolls they offer, and I am seldom disappointed.

I went in for my first class last night. The workout was great, and the instructor Matt was awesome. However, the blonde girl working at the front desk (I don't know her name) was so rude and unwelcoming. You would think a gym would go out of their way to be polite to all of their patrons, especially first-timers.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I went for an early Saturday dinner - dinner was ok (a bit overpriced IMO) but desserts were totally not worth it.  I'm a chocoholic and left 2/3 of my chocolate mousse (that's rare for me!).  Our waiter was friendly and very attentive - refilling sodas before we asked, etc.  I'll give it another shot

Food was good not the best portion sizes how ever they did get my order order sausage they brought bacon was still good regardless worst part was listening to the waitresses complain about losing tips and not doing anything to earn them ruined the whole experience won't be back get it together linny

Delicious food, fun atmosphere. family friendly and great menu for the kids. Service was great. Chris recommended the BEST dessert I have ever had in my life. The kids love the churros with chocolate sauce. The grilled chicken with grits was superb. Love the chips and guacamole overall a great experience we will be back often!

Was hoping for more from this place since it's the closest option. I first tried the froyo. The selection is small and the pumpkin and mint chocolate were absolutely horrible, and the salted Carmel was watery. The ice cream was ok-nothing to write home about.

I stopped in while shopping at other stores in this strip. Luckily, it was dinner time on a weeknight so I was taken right away. The pedicure and manicure were both excellent and I thought the staff was very nice. It's a little out of my way but glad I stopped in and would come back.

The food is good, beer is good. The waitress is friendly ... the place isn't very lively. It looks sad  maybe better music  or drink specials or food specials. It's not over priced, the just place needs SOMETHING. I ordered the BBQ pulled pork sliders, they are tasty. The beer is local, it's pretty good (if you like beer).

Went for restaurant week. Cute restaurant. Great ambience. Good service. Salad was good, appetizers good.. Pasta super salty and full of garlic.  Needed to drink a ton of water. The waiter was nice and asked if we wanted it to be remade. But we didn't want to do that. Dessert was good. Get the apple crumble.

clean interior
fair prices
extremely delish veggie mei fun & big enough for 2 light eaters! steamed dumplings are good too. my 5 year olds love the fried rice and chicken here! Not greasy, or saturated w/ sauce or over salted - fresh tasting & seemingly healthy

Love their pizza. Not too thick, crispy and generous with their toppings. Great falafel! I haven't had a good falafel sandwich in awhile and the closest one is a bit too far for me. Luckily now, it's only a phone call away. I would definately recommend ordering from here.

If I can give them "0" stars, I would.   They ruined my brand new sweater by shrinking it.  They tried to "block" it out which is stretching it out but didn't work.  They stretched out all the wrong places.  The owner never returned my phone calls.  He never apologized or even offered to give my money back.  Stay away......
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
I brought my 4runner in for service on a blown cigarette lighter. I used it to charge my phone. Service said phone was drawing too much amp and unauthorized charger was being used. So warranty was not covered. What happened to bumper to bumper service? My vehicle only had 20000 miles and 1 yr old at time of event.
Bad service

It's pretty junky and run down. The sign advertises prices from long ago and the rates are not posted until you get to the register.  The employees seem to be hard workers.   Tips for vacuum employees is inside at the register.  Hand dry employees accept tips outside.

Great basic Classic Italian food in the middle of a neighborhood. I have yet to find something that I didn't like. The staff is knowledgeable and friendly. I would not go without a reservation. The place is small.  FYI don't try to find parking use the valet. It is well worth it

We went for Sunday brunch.  It rates a 3 because it was o.k. but nothing special.  The omelets were good.  The service was not.  The waitress did not come back until she gave us the check - with multiple coffee cups empty and waiting to be filled.  For the price, go somewhere else.

So here recently the staff has apparently decided to just close up shop whenever they feel like it regardless of posted business hours, sometimes 7:30, sometimes sooner.  Makes you wonder if the owner or franchisee knows that.   The place improved for awhile and now it appears to be headed down hill again

I ate at Sushi Garden in the Foothills mall this evening. Best thing about this place was the staff. Very Very Nice! But the food was just ok, the salmon melted in my mouth but there was no flavor. And no Super white tuna. Should have gotten the all you can eat for what I paid and I went during happy hour. Fie!

This is by far my favorite burger place.  I rank them far above In and Out and they do fries the right way.  The prices are good, the service fast, and the food delicious.  I get my food to go as it can be challenging to get a table (at any of the locations).

got the kung pao chicken lunch special, comes with choice of white or fried rice,and  a soup or soda. 
total $6.15 including tax
price 4/5
taste 5/5

definitely a nice takeout place with decent portion size, not too much rice and not too little entrée. will be back for more!

It wasn't busy during lunch and the table was unoccupied so my coworkers and I sat down. We were not helped. There was this old dirty rag smell in the air - definitely not appetizing. We left after 10 minutes of no service and decided on Shake Shack down the street.

Just moved to the neighborhood and decided to order some calzones. They were big and pretty good but paying was a hassle. It's 2020 and I have to use their atm? They charged me .99 and my back charged me $2.50. So I had to pay $3.49 just to pay for my food. Wtf. Probably go elsewhere next time just for the sake of convenience.

Just last night the order was wrong as per usual. The receipt said plain no cheese, the sticker on the wrapper said plain ham no cheese, yet the sandwich had two slices of cheese. I'm convinced at that level, it was deliberate, and it doesn't serve the employees or the public at this location.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Do not order online! I get there the guy completely ignored me for ten mins.  When the lady walked in she looked at me like she had no idea what an online order was.  She checked her phone and said oh wel start that now. The food was bland at best. Should have read the reviews before going there

Pizza was very good, nice thin but still sprightly puffy crust. Very fresh and yummy. I would give five stars except for it was very odd when we entered we sat for five minutes with no one there and we thought potentially we would never get served. But it was worth the wait.

Eaten here 3 times- It's good but not consistent - fish tacos good but light on fish. Rice inconsistent fluffiness each visit. Tamales good but again varied between diners one was in need of a knife the other "perfect "- so I can't do 4 stars. Very slow for 3 people, better service last visit.

This place has really changed and gone down hill. The Sicilian pizza used to be a great deal as well as delicious. But now their pizza is extremely salty and hardly edible. The cheese seems to coagulate on the pizza rather than melt. I don't know what they're doing but I miss what they used to be.

One year later. Used mobile app for curbside. All curbside spots parked in with no one waiting in the cars. They were inside dining. Had to re do and choose drive through.  20 min wait with no cars in the drive through line. Maybe I stay away on Christmas Eve from now on.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Why can't I sample myself?  And why does the staff have to be so rude about it?  Yes, pouring samples for a grown woman is lame and awkward.  This is, however, your rule so buck up and be kind about it!  If the yogurt was better than "OK" this rudeness might not bother me.

This is by far the best Mexican we've had in West Chester. The tortillas are soft and delicious. Had every taco and they were all moist wth great flavors. Chicken enchiladas with red sauce was hot but still had great taste. Also had carne asada fries and it did not disappoint. Authentic flavors here. Go!

I am so thankful I found Andy again. He is amaizong job. I did a full set of On my toe nail and my hands he did a full set on my hands. They both turned out so well. I love qt nails and ambiance and the massage chairs. Cleanest and professional nail shop in Reno. Please come and check it out.

This Italian restaurant is amazing! You can never go wrong with what you order. They have a very large selection to choose from my favorite is the vegetable lasagna! Also the staff is very nice and makes you feel like your at home! It's a must go to and will become your favorite! Plus to top it off it's BYOB!

Hotel staff seam nice, but the hotel is in bad need of an update. The bathroom in our room was very dirty and in need of a deep cleaning. Small pieces of hair around the toilet and on the door. Door and trim around the handles were dirty. Also, it seems the pool and hot tub filter doesn't work.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Terrible customer service. I waited at the front of the line for 6 minutes while 8 people stood in the bullpen - 2 of which were helping other customers. The other 6 didn't make eye contact or attempt to acknowledge me - so after 8 minutes of standing there- feeling unvalued- waiting to deposit a Big check - I left.

Food is quite consistent, generally pretty darn good. I love the decor, wait staff is always super polite. The only thing I wish they could do better is spots on the glasses and tidier, cleaner tables. Maybe that's gotten better since the pandemic, I haven't gone back, but it is a favorite spot for us.

So far I am not impressed.  They seem not to like women. Guys are greeted warmly. I was asked if I wanted to check tire pressure !!!  Getting an alignment, and did I want tire pressure??? Are you kidding?  
Do they think I'm  stupid or are they?  
They talk to men.  Not to me. I think you can do better.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
They are extremely clean and use new buffers and nail files every time, which is a huge plus. 

Went for the first time yesterday for a manicure. Needless to say, I came back today for a pedicure because I had such a good experience.

I will be coming back to have my gel done again in a couple weeks.

Terrible. The customer service is really bad, I was yelled at by 3 different guys for doing something wrong. Each of these guys was telling me to do something different and they had no signs. Car was decently clean afterwards, but still won't go back with all the other local options.

We called off-and-on for over an hour to place a pick-up order and no one ever answered. I guess they're doing so well that they don't need the business? We certainly won't bother calling again.

UPDATE: Family was so set on fish for dinner, they drove to the restaurant; only to find that it was closed. Oh, well...

Delivery driver forgot plates and napkins and we tipped nicely before discovering.  Pizza good but pepperoni not crisped or well cooked.  Wish pizza joints would figure out the method of making pepperoni crispy without burning pizza there is one that does - Pizza Hut for some reason.

Ordered for the first time from the Harleysville Hotel for the super bowl. We ordered 25 wings and a burger. Even though it was one of their busiest days of the year, the wings were very good and the staff were very friendly. Will order from Harleysville Hotel again soon

One of the best pizza's in the area. I have been to Franzone's more times then I can count. Donna is by far the best waitress there. She is always very friendly and eager to please the customers. I love the sweet sauce which is rare among all the pizza places in the Philly area.

I absolutely love Suis Generis. I have been three times and I have had three different, amazing dishes. The food is extremely fresh and I love the variety they offer on their menu. The portions are sizable as well, so I feel like the food is well worth the price. While Maurepas is great, I find myself craving Suis Generis...

I have to get donuts for a weekly function and I've bought here many times. The reason for this review is their staff is really trying hard, especially the kid named Marcus. Give the man a raise and a promotion, way to make your customers EXCITED about their box of donuts. Also sugar is bad for you.

We really enjoyed the Kopper Kitchen experience.  The waitress was very friendly and accommodating.  I had the penne and my companion had the turkey dinner.  Both were excellent.  I am not even a big vegetable eater, but the vegetable medley that came with the turkey dinner was especially tasty.

not my favorite for takeout. noodle dish was greasy. rolls were a little weird. at pickup owner commented she was happy we didn't need chopsticks so she could save money. we got none of the "extras" dine-in customers receive, but paid the same. probably wont try it again.

We just moved nearby and have taken several items here as it is close and convenient; however, we continue to use Old City Cleaners because they do the job right and are extremely friendly. Average turn around times and very reasonably priced considering the area. Wonderful to do business with.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Amazing food!!!! Had the BLT, well half of it, I'm a big guy and couldn't finish this thing , 
My wife had the pastrami and my youngest had the bacon cheeseburger, everything was great and surprisingly inexpensive . If you're in this area or out driving, get your butts here this place is awesome. Service was great as well

Great hair cut for my boys! I'm taking a star away for setting poor expectations on the wait time which ended up being nearly 2 hours when we were told 45 min... And it's very pricey for not even having your hair washed. Local owner, army veteran, who supports the local community by sponsoring sports teams is a plus!

I got the mustard chicken sandwich for lunch and it was delicious! We also got a short rib grilled cheese and my friend gave it a 6/10 because they thought the size to the cost wasn't worth it and the meat itself was cooked well, but a good portion of it was fatty. 
Overall, it was a good place.

The hotel was Great. The only reason I rated it 3 stars because it was my first visit. I truly believe rating something to high leaves no room for improvements. The room was beautiful and clean. Front was pleasant on my visit. I like the amenities: gym, pool and pool table. I would recommend.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: food is good, but not good enough to make up for the terrible service. Walked into an empty restaurant, no one greeted us, the two girls at the counter looked up at us but couldn't bother to stop playing on their phones to acknowledge us or say a word. Unbelievable. Won't be back.

Not sure what the big deal is with overpriced pasta. Nothing special here, but my mom wanted to go and apparently everyone in my family is a regular. Its out of my way anyway. I know its been there a long time (was good at the other location) and they get a lot of regulars so they don't need me anyway.

FINALLY! I found a place in Tucson that makes al pastor right! The staff was super friendly, clean restaurant, great salsas and very affordable! I will be back before the weeks over.
My only suggestion to them would be to put the pineapples on the side!(I had tacos by the way)

Don't live here. There are fire alarms multiple times a week- at night. There are homeless people sleeping in the stairwells. The parking gates are broken. The key fobs always have issues. The hallways smell of marijuana every day. They have frat parties provided by the Gossett staff every week.

Nice new hotel. Similar to others of the chain however this one is on the river and in a great location. They have a good bar that overlooks the water. The breakfast was a little bit lacking. And the swimming pool look pretty small. Parking is valet only and $20.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I'm giving this place 3 stars because I like some but I don't like all.. pizza is decent. Broccoli bites & the Cajun chicken Caesar salad is REALLY good! However, the wings.. I'm disappointed. The buffalo sauce tastes like BBQ sauce. The wing in general was decent, wish they were meatier but the sauce was not good.

Never ever go here !!!  The guy behind the desk acted as if I was interfering with his day by asking them to quote me a price for a cat. Very rude n sat on his duff and did nothing but yuk it up with a co-worker. There was just one Truck in the bay and no line. I won't recommend these good ole boys to dig a ditch.

Burgers tasted freezer burnt. Yuck. Dining area was dirty. Floor was so greasy my daughter was sliding on it. 2 stars only because the lady at the counter was courteous. Would never have come here except had an out of town guest that had not had a slider in probably 10 years and was feeling reminiscent.

Excellent food and service! Took my sis here for her birthday. She ordered various sushi. I eat a plant-based mostly vegan diet and there were so many wonderful options! All the food tasted fresh and so good! Service was excellent and well timed. Will be back for sure!

I had my first consultation today with Nafeesah and the vibe was very inviting.  There was tasteful music playing and nice scent flowing through the salon. Nafeesah was knowledgeable and her advice was sound.  I will definitely go back for at least a trim and rod set.

I've been coming to Sonobana for 15 years (when they used to be called Benkay). I usually order the Special Bento Box for lunch. For dinner, I like the grilled squid app, spicy veggie roll, Johnson roll, mistake roll...  also the tempura udon is yummy. I don't recall there's anything I've ordered that I didnt enjoy.

We've been ordering from Starkey for about 3 yrs (2-3 x's a month) & it's always good.  The pizzas are all delicious (white special is my favorite :), greek salad, garlic knots, calazones, ck parm & philly cheesesteak are awesome, too.  Not to mention the staff & delivery drivers are always nice & friendly.  Enjoy!

Great Mexican restaurant in Oaklyn. The new space is a huge improvement.  We had the special TexMex burrito. Delicious. The potatoes were awesome too. A few speed bumps as the new place just opened and it was packed. We had great service from George our server. 
Can't wait to try the bar next time.

Ulivo was a pleasant dining experience. Our server was extremely knowledgable about the menu and gave vibrant descriptions. Our menu for the evening consisted of watermelon salad, prosciutto and cured meats, pasta course was tonnarelli and pappardelle, main course black cod and Berkshire pork...all very nice.

This is one of the few pizza shops in Mayfair that actually has a nice dining room worth eating in. We got the vegetarian specialty pizza, which was so generous with the toppings! The crust was also homemade and nice and thin. Gino's also has a bar, and made a delicious cocktail.

It is ok. They have complimentary margaritas which  is huge plus. You can bring your own drink too. Compare to other branches though, I cannot say this branch is the best. Staffs are friendly but service is very slow. Food is ok. I like their desserts but not main meal.

had dinner at Concetta's last night with out of town relatives who wer estaying in the St. Charles area (we live about 20 miles away).  We all thought it was good.  The chicken dishes were the favorites.  Prices are very reasonable, The bill for my wife and I was $31 and that included a mixed drink ($4).  I would definitely go back

Started ordering via Grub Hub and really like their pizza and their salads ... very fresh.  Prices seem reasonable for the quality.   Customer service is excellent (they actually called to check our order).  We have ordered at least 5 times recently and have never been disappointed.

The drinks are always up to the Starbucks standard, but the wait is not. The drive thru is generally super slow... 12 minutes from order to drink is not acceptable at 3:30pm on a Wednesday. Overall, great product with slow service. I recommend going inside.

Excellent food. Calamari and Tomato Bisque were superb. Interior space was exceptioanal. Pleasent, well layed out, no sense of crowding. Well lit. We did not eat on patio but it looked like it was a perfect spot for a dinner out. Hard to stand out in a neighbor full of great restaurants but this one does. Well worth a visit.

Poor. Food was of poor quality, staff was not knowledgeable of menu, purchased bottle of Chard - just set it in the table with nothing to keep it cold. I had to find Mgr to even get water refilled.  No wonder these restaurants are closing, I certainly won't go back.

Terrible absolutely a waste of time time and money.  Car was not cleaned I had pull it over to their detail section and clean it myself.  When I spoke to the manager he shrugged his shoulders and did nothing to correct the issue.  Stay far away from this place not a quality place at all.

They dont have a number listed, was going to call and inform them of my issues, but I will leave a review. I bought a breakfast sandwich on a croissant. The croissant is hard af, my breakfast meat tastes and smells funny. I threw out my sandwich, a $4.50 waste.

Went to Angelina's tonight for the first time. Absolutely loved the place. The food was so delish, service was good. We had the salad, gnocchi and chicken with peppers and a light tomato sauce. The food was simple and good with enought to feel full but not overstuffed. Would definitely recommend and would go back again.

This place was good and way cheaper than I expected the lunch special was a huge value and the chips and salsa seem to be free and all the food was very good with huge portions I would like to try them for dinner sometime and maybe even the margarita special I saw overall seems to be a good deal

Surprisingly good breakfast and really friendly, nice staff.
Omelets were great.  Home fries were delicious.  Beans needed some added spice and the coffee took a while, but the overall experience was really a good one!

Brought the newspaper and chilled while having breakfast and coffee.

This is a truly authentic home cooking establishment.  Traditional Italian cooking by a mother and son team. Wonderful hosts.  Probably the best pizza I have ever had in the Philly area. Entree are generous, enough to enjoy the next day. Everything prepared fresh that day. Excellent reputation with the locals earned over 22 years.

My Mother-in-law stay there a couple of weeks ago, the staff was great, room was ok til we saw ants in the sink and around the baseboard of the wall..Told the maid but I do not think she told anybody..

We will have to rethink her next visit where she is going to stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Not terrible in a pinch however I ordered two Big Mac meals with shakes and some BBQ and sweet and sour sauce with Uber eats. I received a call with the infamous our shake machine is broken so we got charged extra for something we didn't even get. Lastly we got honey mustard instead of BBQ sauce which is just the icing on the cake.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Winn Dixie's prices are a bit better than Publix...but you pay for it with poor service.  Generally, I have found the staff has not been trained with emphasis on good, courteous service like places like Publix or Chik-Fil-A.  Waiting times and assistance is definitely longer.

Excellent service. Waitress was really sweet and nice. Sushi rolls were way too big. The individual pieces were at least four bites worth each. That's not sushi. No ginger or wasabi on my plate (had to go ask for it). No soy sauce dish, had to ask. Overall meh.

I love them from grubhub! The fajitas and tacos hit the spot, the chips and guacamole are almost always awesome - got 1 order once w greasy chips but everything else's was great. I typically don't get Mexican food in NJ as my spots are in S. Philly or the food trucks . Jalapeños delivers too.. Great service always!

This is a classic St Louis Italian strip center restaurant, nice relaxing atmosphere, not too noisy, great toasted ravioli, Provel cheese topped salad, and solid red sauces pastas. 
It's a great place to come in a group and enjoy an easy evening meal with Bud Light or Chianti.

Great service, amazing food. I'm very particular about my steak and they did exactly what I asked and didn't give me attitude about it. The sauces were amazing, we will definitely dine here again. I tried eating here once before but the parking lot/yard guy was extremely rude, we left. This time all was well.

3 strikes and they're out.  There are plenty of other local places that are inexpensive that will give you a good cut.  I've tried them as well as others I know, and it's not worth having them ruin your hair then you have  to grow your hair out just to have another stylist fix your cut.  
Skip, skip skip!

Kind of loud and looks like the place the flea market decided to go to breakfast at. I do not care for this place more because of the people and employees in it. The food is OK as far as breakfast food goes but its kind of a bottom of the barrel overflow place.

Good pizza but slow service and a little over priced. I had used an online special to order a couple pizzas a few times. I got the owner once and he told me he doesn't honor online specials. Its on HIS site! Whatever, we chose Bros in Clearwater instead and they are much more customer friendly.

Great menu. Even greater specials. Preparation was a bit off. (Go easy on the salt and on how long you cook the pasta, please.) Adorable spot, but was disappointed that "outside" is actually covered with a plexiglass roof and therefor stuffy rather than airy. Servers were pleasant and attentive. I look forward to going back.

This nail salon isnt perfect but they do a real good cheap at manis and pedis and waxing. It is clean, they are nice and have a good variety of colors. I go there all the time, and even the guy does designs. It is a short walk off of South Street. $10 manicures - you can't beat it.

Fries are soggy at this location consistently.  Sad.  I don't mind the wait in drive-thru if only my fries weren't hot and soggy.   Maybe leave them in the fryer a bit longer?   Or is the oil not hot enough? Else, no major complaints.  My food is usually correct, but the fries consistently disappoint us.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Pizza is usually very good although the bottom is sometimes covered with burnt flour.  Cheesesteaks are AWESOME- the best in western Delaware County.  Service is spotty, cashier is unfriendly, and my pet peeve is the staff smokes out back where everyone can see them- yuck.  But again, awesome cheesesteaks (and fries !)

I love The Habit. And this location is the original, and it's just a coincidence that the burgers and onions here taste way better than @ other locations! 

The only thing I don't really like about this place is that they don't have enough seating during peak hours.

So far one trip and its ok
but high priced on a plain pizza
sill have to go again and try some other menu items
but for now this is all I can give is a 2
because I did not experience the favorable service
nor the bragged about food ive heard around town 
about John's
I will update when I can on my next visit

this is the best stop for pizza in Williamstown nj
 right off of main street in a small shopping center
kind of small  but the best pizza and sandwiches 
friendly family owned and always a great experience when I pick up
we have used delivery and never disappointed
no regrets when my kids say Antonio's tonight

Everything was delicious, nice/cozy atmosphere, super friendly wait staff and all at a reasonable price point.  Go mid week for no waiting time.  Dipping sauces were flavorful, but the rice and veggies with the Hibachi was even better!  UPDATE: visited again and still up to snuff. Good food, good show.  Recommended.

This is the place for you if you like entitled suburban families with screaming and out of control kids. 

The pizza quality is very uneven. I've had great and terrible in the same month. We don't frequent anymore not just because of the lack of consistency in the food but because of the Chuck E Cheese atmosphere.

Pros: Very clean and helpful staff. 

Cons: The food selections are meh. Very homogenized. Limited choices in terms of fresh ingredients for ethnic and/or international foods. Could use more varieties of produce. 

Overall this is okay if you need some basics but I prefer Shoprite overall for diversity and variety.

If you want great sushi and LOTS of it, Sushi Kingdom is the place to be. This is probably my wife's and my favorite place to eat in the area. Sushi is a great spot for a dinner date for two or with a big group of friends. Reasonably priced, great service, it's a real gem! We'll be back again and again!

Service was kinda rushed, wasabi wasnt fresh, and the meat was before the veggies... i mean wtf lol. Fortune cookie was stale :( and the fried rice almost tasted like mexican rice...  Other than that it was just ok.. and by just ok, I mean more than likely... I won't be goin back

Good food!  I enjoyed my food at wraps and found the owners to go way beyond helpful.  They offered sample of their food and soups.  The food is pricey for a burrito shop, but it is fresh and the flavors are there. The workers/owners are so friendly, that you can't help but cheer for them and hope that they make it!

It seems that this ploy of making you wait 25 min. for a table is on-going and is ridiculous.  The place was empty, yet customers are made to wait.  The server was very slow, as well.  I was not about to start to gamble and have to interrupt my game to go to the restaurant.  Figure it out ,management.

During the construction, business is open. We went to try this place for the first time, and this remind me of Rosa's Mexican Restaurant from Texas. Very good, Carnitas are my favorite, marinated very well, juicy and flavor is amazing! The corn soup was also great!

Rude on the phone. Overpriced. Almost no beef in the meal. No delivery. I do appreciate that they have dinner combos as opposed to most places that only do it for lunch. The only thing worthwhile were the dumplings, which were pretty good. Probably won't be back though.

This is your run of the mill Mexican restaurant, but it's a great place to take kids without feeling self-conscious about the noise and mess they're making. 

If you're looking for fine dining, look elsewhere. Otherwise, a good option for cheap burritos and beer/margaritas.

Listen go somewhere else!  This is the worst, slowest most poorly managed McDonald's I've ever been to. The owner or management of this place just doesn't care and it shows.. just to get them to take your order is a huge effort to them.

Trust me go up to the next exit
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Great selection of loose leaf teas to purchase in bulk (really reasonable prices) or as a hot/cold brewed cup. I like simple ingredient teas with no added licorice root or other sweeteners, so I just have to check the ingredient lists. Staff has always been patient, friendly & informative! Cute cafe atmosphere too

Love Mel's...love it.  I think the chef does a very good job with making authentic Italian fare.  The veal is sublime and the seafood items are always fresh.  The wine selection is also nice.  Wait staff can be slightly indifferent, but not overly so.  I do think the decor could use some sprucing.

This is really, really good sushi! The rice is soft and the fish is fresh. The miso soup, which comes standard with every meal, is the best I've tried in Tucson. You also can't go wrong with a place that gives you free ice cream after your meal. Overall, Kazoku is delicious, fresh and the prices are reasonable.

Still slow, still rude, new app NEVER downloads inside restaurant making sure that you can't use coupons. 25 minutes for 2 breakfast sandwiches. Gotta love that FAST FOOD. Then order is wrong almost definitely every single time. Must stop this awful addiction
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Was looking for a laundromat with top load washers.  They had a lot of washers but they are old and don't work properly. 
The dryers work well but liked to eat my quarters without giving me credit. 
The folding tables are on the small side.
Not sure I'd go back.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: The noise was deafening. No place for a romantic getaway. Part of my meal was the side of stir fried vegetables. It was a ton of shredded carrots with a few broccoli florets and not real tasteful. I thought there would be a larger variety of vegetables with a little more flavor. Service was great.

I have visited several meineke locations and I can't say this about every location but this location I definitely can. AWESOME! So polite and accommodating. They were efficient, fair in prices and stayed in contact with me through it all. Thanks guys for giving me a new convenient auto shop!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I'm unsure of why there are low ratings here, but two people hardly qualify a proper judgment. This is the closest Mexican restaurant to my house and they have the best flautas you'll ever eat, the tastiest and biggest taco salad, and some wonderful lunch specials. Not the cheapest, but a delicious time.

We walked out and I will not be back. We left after about twenty minutes and no one ever came to take our order.  It's not as if this was the first night it opened either, they should have had their game together a little more than that by this point.  The place was also REALLY loud.  Hated it.

Went for lunch for the 1st time ever with a coworker.  Had the 3 course luncheon and OMG, it was amazing!  What took me so long to get here?

The Caesar salad had the best dressing.  For the entree, I ordered the Fettuccini Gorgonzola and it was amazing!  I could eat that every single day.

Placed an online sub order, came to pick it up it wasn't ready. I was immediately told they were out of white bread. I told the lady behind the counter to forget it. Deli employees are terrible. She didn't even bother to apologize or ask me if I wanted something else. I will never order from this store again.

This is a good place for a quick in and out lunch.  $12.95 for all you can eat lunch.  Only thing I found  disappointing was that most of their sushi selection available on the menu was all cooked items.  Not much to choose from if you are looking for the typical sushi rolls.  The hibachi item were great for my kids.

We were so delighted to find this great restaurant. Humorous artsy decor and cheap yet great house wine from Slovenia qualify this spot as bohemian.  The menu is yummy, the food excellently crafted, the service fabulous. We already made plans to go back this week for brunch.

Tried to buy some liquor the first day but was denied because I had no I'd. I'm 28 so I didnt expect to be carded. Came back the next day with Canadian drivers license and they said the couldn't accept when the told me previous that I need a drivers license. Bad customer service and completely rude. Ridiculous!!!

This place gives both Italian food and Italian people a bad name. They use frozen meatballs and huge chunks of garlic in their gravy. The prices are too expensive for the quality of the food. The woman who runs the place is a nasty hag too. This definitely is not my kind of place....overall experience ewwww!

Had a great burger there first time I went. Second time we arrived just after they opened, the burger was dry, overcooked, only warm, the fries were barely warm, the hot tea was tepid.  Guess they weren't really open for business. Very disappointed.  Won't be going back.  Music too loud for conversation.

This is the best Chinese we've found in the South County area! Very friendly staff, quick turnaround time, and most importantly, delicious food. Both the Sesame Chicken and the Chicken Chow Mein were excellent with a nice grilled flavor. We ordered carry-out and each combo meal was enough for another meal. Highly recommend.

Tried this new peruvian-style rotisserie chicken place, and was very impressed. Chicken was tender, fantastic flavor, great sauces, and an excellent value.  I only wish they weren't so skimpy on the sauces - the little cups weren't enough.  Will just have to order extra the next time.  Overall, highly recommend.

While I'm only judging their pizza, I must say that I've been disappointed on my last few trips. The pie was gloppy, salty, and super greasy. The slices just wouldn't hold up to the soggy crust. Staff has always been extremely friendly. It's convenient and very close, but I think I'd rather go elsewhere for pizza.

Cozy atmosphere with fabulous service and perfectly prepared meal. Roasted chicken and Brussels sprouts are my go to favorites. Whether for a quick and casual dinner at the bar or a more intimate dining experience, Matt and his crew will take outstanding care of you.

I appreciated the frequent shuttles from baggage claim to offsite location.  Driver was helpful with fitting in all baggage.  Emerald Island was "picked" over by the time I arrived, but I did find an acceptable car ready to go in a timely fashion.  On the road in short amount of time.

I frequently get my manicures and pedicures here and they do a great job. Rarely every any wait time, the technicians are very thorough and always include a nice massage with the pedicures. I've been meaning to write this review since the first time I went but they'll always get my business.

The lunch specials are great at this place.  The sushi is very good and the wait staff is very attentive.  I found myself making this a weekly lunch spot and could not be happier.  I have not ventured away from the sushi, but I assume the other food is of the same quality.

Ordered a new dish, lobster and shrimp rice. Unfortunately it was so spicy I couldn't eat it. There was tons of cilantro and pepper. After noting that they were not part of the menu description, the restaurant took it off my bill. Others in the party liked their food.

Lovely employees, excellent service, reasonable prices.  I would definitely recommend this salon and I have tried many in the West Chester area that do not get my thumb's up.  Thank you Christy for a great mani/pedi.  I am a new client and now I will be a regular.

So many flavors, by far one of the best new places I have been to in Indy. Our table of four had shrimp and grits, roasted mushrooms, broccolini, deviled eggs, fried chicken and biscuits, key lime pie, and bbq smoked spare ribs. All was just spectacular. Big fan.

Sam is opinionated and that's OK. Some might perceive that as rude, but it doesn't seem he is trying to be hurtful. He sees the world in black and white and doesn't put up with foolishness. The food is plentiful, tasty and cheap. You don't go to Sam's for the ambience, but you will no doubt meet some interesting people.

I love this location it's clean comfortable and everyone is so nice especially my personal banker Allison Davis. Go and see her you can't miss her she's absolutely beautiful authentic an exceptionally professional. Take my word for it you will not be disappointed

Today I met with Joanie and Joshua they are so very nice and professional. I have really enjoyed my visit. I hope the corporate office sees this post they're absolutely fabulous and be sure to give them a substantial raise. They are holding it down in the bakery and my order is beautiful
