Great food!!! Especially the fio gras. But portion a bit small. Came here  a few times. Keep up the good work and make the portion bigger. I am not a big eater but I am slightly hungry the last time I left. When it first open, it was small. Now it is REALLY small.

Their pizza is ok.  The diner across the street makes a better white pizza.  Fries are not very good by themselves.  Pricing is about average.  Almost $3 for a specialty slice and $3.50 for an order of cheese fries.  The girl who was working the dining room was very nice and attentive.

Horrible experience...a few months ago I made an APPOINTMENT for a GEL manicure. Long story short...they "dipped" my nails in some sort of powder without asking me...no soak, trimming of cuticles, nothing. It was expensive and incomplete...no manicure services! Although it's in my neighborhood and convenient, I will not be back.

Apparently getting an order correct is a complete impossibility. I ordered a 1/4 pounder with no cheese. Sticker on the box confirmed. Yet, some idiot put one in the box with cheese. Of course didn't see until I got home. Tried calling to complain but phone number on line is for fax. Grrrrrrrrrrr
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I have stayed at the Grove Hotel a few times now and have so far been impressed every time. It is very well run with clean rooms, updated furniture, and friendly and helpful staff. I've sampled several hotels in Boise and definitely choose to stay here when I can.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place feels really different compared to Bourbon St. Very laid back and no craziness. Drinks were all made really well. One of the best Mojitos I've had. All the ingredients they use are fresh. Really good place to have a drink , listen to music and chill.

Stopped in this McDonalds on Saturday morning early had had the worst service ever the woman at the cashier was very rude she didn't try to help me she walked away from me and turned your back on me luckily someone else in the back came up to help me will never go back again
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I'd definitely stay here again. Clean room, friendly staff, typical free breakfasts, no noise problems....all the makings of a hotel worthy of my business. While I was lazy and didn't check out the gym, my coworker described it as "better than most." I bet the outdoor area is really great in the spring too.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Can't say enough good things about this local eatery - split a roasted beet salad and had the mussels diablo appetizer as a main course - let me say the muscles were plump and cooked perfectly and the diablo marinara was excellent. My wife had the shrimp pomodoro - smooth sauce done very well. One of the best BYOB's you can find.

I haven't been in awhile and it could be hot or miss but tonight it was a definite hit!  I got an order of fried dumplings ( ok, not great) and an order of Kung pao chicken.  It was perfect!  Nice and hot, perfectly spiced and delicious!  I could easily crave this.  Keep it up China Spring!

this place is decent. they don't have the best selection of glasses and most of their employees are RUDE with a philly attitude, but otherwise they get the job done. i've been going to them for a while and don't plan on changing since they get the job done.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: It was great place. It is small so expect that going in. Great spot to order in from or go for lunch probably woudl stir clear for dinner. The sushi was great.  Being from LA originally I feel I am a good judge of sushi.  I would not recommend this place for more than 2 people to go to.

Good Mexican food pretty much what you expect big portions at reasonable prices specials on mixed drinks and beer staff is friendly nice atmosphere. I got the chicken fajitas big portion and enough for lunch the next day. In hindsight it was really enough for two people. Our tab with sodas and 2 entrees was less than 25.

DO NOT USE THE FRAGRANCE SPRAYER ! New car scent did not work on 12/5/15 ! Only has 1 fragrance sprayer on site you don't get the clean car feel unless it smells fresh  .  I will also be calling the number posted on site to advise them of this . Rest of car cleaning went fine .

I've eaten here twice now - first time I got chicken tenders. Took a while coming out of the kitchen (I know they make it to order though, so I can't complain about that), but they were incredibly salty. Almost uneatable.
Got an order of fries and a burger to go. Fries were decent, burger was bland. Nothing special.

Overpriced hipster schlock. Look, I'm sure their bread really is as great as people say, but paying $10 for a single, small slice of toast topped with avocado, cucumber, and kale is pure-on silliness. I felt embarrassed for the employee who handed it to me.

Today was our first time here (i've lived here for 26 years) and it was fantastic!! Definitely was not expecting it to be that great. The young duo that run it all are the sweetest, and the food is excellent. I am also a fan of it being a BYOB. Can't wait to go back!

Everyone there is so helpful and nice. Chris and Lisa (in the auto center) are the best. There was a wonderful mechanic, I think his name is Ryan, who has a lot of patience and is very sweet. The prices are great! I used to go to another place but this is my car's new home, now!

Great ice cream! But this location has very limited seating. When the four tables fill up, you're left with the benches that are right outside the bathroom stalls. They definitely need more seating. Also, wish they would bring back their punch cards. I had a full one and they wouldn't even honor it :/

Probably will not go back again- food was cold- fries were horrible, and the order was wrong.  AND make sure you count your change - drive in tried to pocket a dollar- bill was  12 and change- handed us back 6 and change for a 20- asked how much was that again - she quickly handed out a dollar without going into the drawer.

Been here a handful of times. Its just not worth it. I see they are expanding in other parts if town. Tacos are average at best and salsa are sub par with no real spicy taqueria salsa. If you are going here on the Nolensville side of town, drive north of Old Hickory and get a real taco.

This place is exactly what you might expect from Chinese food in a strip mall- I was hoping this would a hidden gem but this it was not. 

I got the general tsaos chicken, egg rolls and rice. It wasn't terrible but it wasn't great. The restaurant itself isn't exactly cozy so if you do eat here take it out.

I've been to ZAMA half a dozen times since they opened last year. I love the minimalist decor, true to Zen keeping. I've only had their sushi, sashimi and designer rolls and I've never been disappointed with the consistency of taste, freshness & creativity. I'll come back. But, Umai-Umai is still my favorite,  by far.

First, sushi was good.  If that was the only thing we had ordered we would have been pretty happy.

Sadly, we ordered steak from the hibachi and it was HORRIBLE.  I mean the worst.  The meat was tough, fatty, and was covered in what looked to be barbque sauce.

Save your money.  We certainly won't return.

Overall another good stay, but the variety at breakfast wasn't as good as last time.....only bread for toast, no English muffins, or bagels.  The eggs and biscuits and gravy were also on the cold side.  But still a great family hotel!!!  We will be back!!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Tried a large cheese from here, overall it was okay, it really didn't taste very fresh though, and the crust had a bit of a previously frozen flavor going on, not sure if that's true or not, but overall just wasn't great.

Overall, meh, probably better than the big chains, but not really worth going back to.

An alright hotel. The heating/cooling fan is very noisy, you'll need earplugs to sleep. On monday morning they run out of food by 9:20 am and cleaned the breakfast room by 9:40 am even though there were a couple of dozen people who tried to get smth to eat. The breakfast was supposed to be from 6 to 10.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Tried for the first time today.  Ordered for pick up. The inside of the restaurant was very clean.  The food was amazing and large portions.  The crab Rangoon is the best I've ever had.  Let's just say I won't be going to my regular Chinese restaurant.  This is my regular place now.

Ok two choices for bread lol The cookies looked like somoen stomped on them and only 3 of them in the case at dinner time.The tomatoes were so green could have made fried green tomatoes with them.I know it's a subway and not a poboy or sub shop but usually decent but this is pathetic.

Omg the cashiers here are like the walking dead  personality of a dog turd! I only came here because my 80 yr old neighbor wanted something from here..Someone needs to re train these cashiers here expecially Brandi good lawd girl take the money you spend on your fake hair and buy yourself a personality

Had lunch special. Reasonable price. Food taste ok and clean. Staffs are nice. It was pretty good experience. Since i live in clarksville and i only ate here onece when i was in springfield to go to court for my speeding ticket  idk if i will ever go back but its a good place

Nothing fancy but if you are looking for simple food, cold beer, friendly service and cheap prices, you have the right place!   The menu is so short it hangs on the wall.  Great cheese steaks and the best home made peppers I've ever had...served in rubbermaid containers!  A must if you are in the neighborhood!

Heather is awesome - clearly a very talented stylist/artist. She has offered great suggestions for hair color that will work better with my skin. The cut she gave instantly gave life to my hair. The shop itself is a bright space and the vibe is chill. I'm thrilled to have found Halo Hair.

Can get pretty busy in the mornings but that's typical for a donut place. Always eager to help you, they even make sure to have a good variety of donuts fresh in the evening. Nice local place I take my family to from time to time because I know the place is clean and consistent.

This is a good hotel for the price. I've paid for a motel 6 for about the same price and was dirty and had roaches. The room was very clean and although they did take awhile checking me in. The receptionist was not able to find my reservation, but overall experience was great!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This was my favorite restaurant until yesterday. I was so disappointed. The steak was rubbery, the food taste different, and they changed the hibachi noodles, they were spaghetti noodles. I was disappointed when they closed the hibachi room, but at least the food had tasted the same.

Our washer broke and we needed desperately to do some laundry. Found Modern Laundry on Yelp, so I gave it a try. Facility was clean, machines were well maintained. Parking was difficult. Prices were a little on the steep side. But, all and all, got the job done. Would go back if our washer goes down again.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Love this gym and love Renah as a trainer! She really pushes you to work your hardest and to become the best version of yourself. Not only does Renah care about the well being of her clients - she cares about community organizations as well and supports them regularly with fundraisers. This is a wonderful place!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Not the worst, not the best. On one hand it's nice that they have a security guard hanging around...on the other...they have to have a security guard hanging around? They also had some sign up, something like no purses or bags or something because of a recent increase in theft. Yikes! The cashier was nice, though.

Went here for an early dinner and was disappointed with the price to quantity ratio. Food was good but for three people the bill was close to $100 for small servings is ridiculous. Waitstaff was friendly and attentive until the restaurant starts to fill up and then we felt forgotten in all the chaos.

This self-serve froyo store just opened and is very similar to YoYumYum.  If I did a side-by-side taste test, I'm not sure if I could tell the difference between both of their plain tart flavors.  Of the flavors I tried today, my favorites were Plain Tart & Pineapple Tart.  The price is right tho, 30 cents/ounce!

Food was below mediocre. I had hope after the first visit, but the second visit was the killer. Food was cold and service was so bad it will keep me from going back. Food really was edible since there are very few choices in this area, but it has to be hot! If you know good chinese food, this place will not satisfy.

This was our favourite U-swirl location, but recently changed to Sweet Frog. I don't know if there was a shortage or what, but they had nothing but low fat and sugar free flavours available. Since I was in the mood for something more indulgent, we went for ice cream instead.

We gave this place another chance, and were happy to see the bums not in there anymore. Small things, it is really loud and smoky, but it's a bar. And they need another person behind the bar to help on busy nights. If you are near the door, it might take a long,time to be,served.

My emergency stop only. Milk, eggs and butter - once in a while, a bit of meat or salad. Most of the baked goods are stale due to low turnover, and I will never buy flour or waffle mix there again. A good store for the neighborhood elderly, but too pricey for the questionable quality.

This is a very nice and clean store, which I like. I just wish they would keep the front door open until 9 when there are two workers there. I also have noticed the scoops are not consistent between different servers. I thought I had accidentally ordered a kids sundae one evening as the scoops were so small.

Pizza is salty and the cheese tastes like garbage.  When we order pizza it is delivered soggy.  The people answering the phones are very rude and in a hurry to take the next call that I  not surprised that many orders are messed up.  No more pizza from them!

Pizza is salty and the cheese tastes like garbage.  When we order pizza it is deli v ered soggy.  The people answering the phones are very rude and in a hurry to take the next call that I  not surprised that many orders are messed up.  No more pizza from them!

The pizza is great here! I use to enjoy the wheat crusted slices but they only now sell them as whole pies.  I always seem to manage to get a spot to eat inside during the lunch rush although they also have outside seating.The cashiers are always friendly and helpful! I would recommend this place strongly.

I'm still confused by the negative reports, I can honestly say something must have gone terribly wrong.   I know of no one that has had a bad meal, at San Nicola.  A lot of my friends will come out from Phila. for the wait is rare. The proportions are perfect and the pasta cooked perfect.

I also wanted to add that their lunch menu as well as atmosphere for lunch is fantastic!  I always make a point to know the owner of a restaurant and know who they are - makes a big difference when they are a big part of the kitchen - this is also probably one of the cleanest restaurants I have been in -

Food was alright we came to grab lunch in Sunday and the employee didn't prepare fresh food at all they took down the pasta bar down early all they had for us to choose from was old ass pizza that looked like it was sitting there for 3 days . The guys forgot my pizza in the oven. And took 5 minutes to get marinrasause.

Very nice room. The air conditioner was a little loud but the bed was pretty comfy.  The park and fly aspect of the hotel is the best. The shuttle had us at the airport in mere minutes. Very courteous and helpful driver. The shuttle runs regularly and made our travel so easy and even enjoyable.  I will be staying here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great cheese steaks, I've been going here since they were down the block a bit at a smaller shop.   The thing that makes these cheese steaks the best ever.. even better then an actually philly cheese steak is the bread they use.  They also have a nice selection of beers in fridge section

Pretty clean but the shower and toilet had cigarette burns on them. That wasn't appealing at all. The stay was good other than a stranger knocking on the door at 4am looking for someone, that was weird. The bed was clean and the room was clean. It was pretty comfortable.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Delaware generally lacks good pizza, but Anthony's is a good bet if you're looking for something slightly different. The coal fired style definitely adds a little extra something to the pie and helps the crust taste better than the crappy stuff you get at most pizza joints around here.

Arriving skeptical of Southwestern stereotypes, I was pleasantly surprised by the roast beef habanero sandwich I ordered. The soda selection was superb, distinguishing this cafe from other museum cafeterias that offer nothing but fountain drinks, Snapple, and over-priced mineral water.

Exceeded my expectations for museum fare.

This place is amazing. My nails look incredible and we got there first thing in the morning so it only took like 30 minutes. I would request this place for all of my friends and all of my family. You should definitely go if you want a girls day out or some time for yourself.

I went here for a late night dinner.  Thank goodness we found this place (Santa Barbara eating closes down at 9:30/10).

The food was pretty good, and I enjoyed the flour-less cake.  The service was friendly.  If you are looking for a place to go late-night, I'd recommend Roy.

This place had decent breakfast, the omelettes are great. Good prices, however it's way too crowded, the service is not that good, only one bathroom and depending on the day there's a line to get in. I'm not sure what I'm missing but it's not that good were I'll stand outside to eat there.

Love the kolaches. If you want donuts, come early because  they sell out of some of the favorites fast. Small seating area and when it gets busy, there's not much room in there. Parking is difficult and lot fills up after 9am because of the beauty store next door.

Super good food for a fair price.  Big portions and great atmosphere there.  The bread was really good, but killed me as I am not used to eating Gluten anymore.  Maybe I'll just stick to one roll next time, lol.  Anyway, the oil and spices are yummy.  Entree's poppin, good vibes, good eats.  I recommend!

Have done a very good job of taking care of me and my money.  Started out with them for a car loan,  and their staff has bent over backwards to ensure my needs are met.  A friendly, helpful staff.  I will definitely continue to do, and recommend business with them in the future.

Always a solid choice.  I haven't eaten anything I didn't enjoy.  The pizzas are great, so are the sandwiches.  I almost always get the chicken piccata.  My only issue would be that they should give you more potatoes on the side, it's always too little.  Otherwise I enjoy and recommend.

Amazing selection, helpful staff and reasonable prices. If you want run of the mill beer, go to wegmans, if you are a true craft beer aficionado, come here! It's a six pack store, so sure prices are a little higher, but not a rip off, and they have tons of stuff you will never find at wegmans!

Excellent tomato pie! I've ordered take out here twice and it's always been great. My boyfriend got an entree which was delicious as well. Downside is they do not open until 5pm even on the weekends. It's a bummer because we've wanted to order lunch from here before.

Simply the finest sushi one can find, along with a beautiful property. Terrific servers as well, and the gents creating the sushi are fun, efficient and very much artists. Delicious food that also is served with care. Listen to the servers about choices like sake. There are many very good options.

Have been going to this McDonald's for years and the last THREE trips to the drive-thru, we've either been missing an item or our order has been completely wrong, and the customer service/friendliness has gone down significantly. Very disappointed.  Will just be going a few doors down to Chick-Fila.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The members appear to be 16 yr.old high school children! Very dirty ,most do not wipe equipment after usage.trash is overflowing.Broken equipment remains inoperable for 3-4 weeks.The tanning booths are a real waste of time,since the bulbs are old,in desprerate need of replacing,impossible to aquire a tan.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Very good, arguably the best until you get to Gallatin. I've been here many times now. Food is very good. Tastes great, and stays with you a while. Isn't the most authentic place and is kinda pricey, but service is pretty good. I'd recommend you give it a try. 

Food-5
Service-4
Other-4

Slowest Starbucks ever! Twice I just left after placing an online order about 15 minutes before arriving to pick it up. Another 20 minute wait I decided to leave. While telling the barista that I was leaving she was rude and said "well fine". No offer of refund or credit. This has happened twice. So I'm done with Starbucks.

The fish is so fresh (Duh! We are in Santa Barbara!) The uni just melts in your mouth, the oysters are plump and briny, the Japanese scallops are so delicate and sweet, and the yellowtail...should call it YUMMYtail! Soft shell crab is local, fresh and spot on. Very friendly and attentive staff. LOVE THIS PLACE!!

Always disappointing to drive up during business hours only to be greeted with "terminal closed" on both terminals and no staff anywhere.
Everything was clearly open with two vehicles parked next to the building (employees I assume).
Another business that doesn't care about customer service.

We have been coming to this place a while for their tea, coffee and smoothies.  Last week decided to go for lunch and it was well worth it.  The thai tofu peanut wrap is AMAZING!  My husband had the chicken curry sandwich, which he really enjoyed.  Still the same great friendly service.

We ate here when it was new and had a great experience.  Excellent service and delicious food. We recently went back , around 7:40 at night and with half the restaurant empty, they had no reservations until after 9. Don't know what they are doing turning away business. We will not be returning.

Bought a pepperoni pizza and got it home...this pizza must have set there for a while and they recycled it to me...This pizza was hard ass hell.  This was not a pizza this was an old over done cracker.  I will not be using this location again.  
If I could I would give them a zero.

Best meal I've had in a long time. Not your American-Italian cuisine... this is the real deal! Sea urchin roe over spaghetti has that extra salty briny yumminess. Gnocchi are out of this world- delightful pillows that melt in your mouth! Had a large group there so got to try a lot and everything was outstanding!

Went to Hikaru with my hubby on Tuesday night.Food was good , but service was HORRIBLE ! We were ignored and it wasn't even busy. The waitress didn't know the difference between food items , never got back to offer more drinks, never checked how was the food  and it took forever to get the bill.

High cost and fortunately we had 3,000+ on credit card approved when checking in otherwise they wouldn't have even helped us out. Price of course was at high end without discussion along way when charging accumulated. Expensive life lesson during a emotional time of seeking help.

The server was nice, but the service was slow.  We ate lunch there with our children (who often eat out and love to do so) - but by the end everyone was exasperated from waiting.  I was also surprised by the cost - we could have eaten more upscale for the price.

Poor haircut and conversation. I use to love going to this place but stopped several years ago since I moved out of town. I came back and decided to get a haircut at my favorite old place but wasn't pleased. The other chairs may be better but it was such a bad experience that I doubt if I will make the effort.

A friend ordered 4 different Sushi rolls, everything was perfect! Well presented and fresh. I don't "like" sushi and fell in love with the Tiger Roll! 
We will definitely be ordering more take out sushi and venturing out to try the other dishes on the menu!

Went there for happy hour, very good value and good deals. Bartender was very good and food was better than average. The feel of the place is just a little off, can't really describe it but it feels somewhat more like a diner than a bar/pub/restaurant. Will give it another try.

This place is great on many levels. They have a wonderful selection of wInes, spirits and beer. Their staff is very knowledgeable, friendly and very welcoming. The atmosphere is fun and inviting. They also have private tasting room behind a secret door. Hi highly recommend this place!

Went here for lunch. They have great lunch specials that are reasonably priced. Cozy, unassuming place with modern decor. The fish lanterns are cute. Service was attentive. Sushi was quite good and tasted very fresh. This is going to be my new go to place for sushi in Center City.

Stepped inside to meet some folks here and we all agreed to leave right away. Smoke filled with no ventilation. Yet, people are all hanging out and having a grand time breathing in heavy, I mean HEAVY 2nd hand smoke. I smelled like ash tray the rest of the night. Really gross and unhealthy!!

I ordered the meatloaf, and it was awful. The green beans had that extra green frozen dinner look and tasted just as bad. The meatloaf had no flavor, and the mashed potatoes had a weird tangy taste so I didn't finish the meal. The bartender who checked me out was really nice though.

I love this place. It takes me back to the glory days of buckehead GA. Best mexcian food in the area. If you are visiting you won't be dispapointed. If you are local why are you even looking it up you should already know.

Best margriatas. Great food. Greats service. Love this place.

Been here many times. 
Can order lunch for breakfast, ordered a tuna melt at 830 am. I thought it was good. Hubby did not agree 
He got the chopper burger. Did not like at all.  I took a taste and agreed. They need to season the meat 
Fun place to go to watch planes land and take off

This place is incredibly overpriced for what you get. Like 50% overpriced. I paid $25 for an inside outside car wash which was just okay. For that money I expected them to go the extra mile but they made no effort to do anything more than basic. I will not return.

Newly redone inside when daughter took over the family business. Antonia flys all over making sure everything is going well. Food is still Greekish, but lots more than that. Great when you want an inexpensive dinner with no fuss or a great Sunday Brunch without breaking the bank.

This is a great pizza place...far better than Pizza Hut or Papa Johns. The staff is friendly and they always make our pizza to perfection. They have been very accommodating. We like a variety of pizza so they have split one large pizza into 3 separate toppings on occasion for us!

Great car wash but you NEED to get the old man out from directing cars in. He's miserable and so animated with his hands that I hate when he's there. Man he's miserable. Even gives grumpy looks when you try to obey his horrible hand signals. Need a new guy!! Wow.

Hi! Love this Starbucks store! But could you please update your hours to reflect when you are actually open during COVID? Over the past 10 months, the store (drive-through) is closed 90% of the time I've stopped by, but the website and all of the map apps say it's open. Thank you!

The so called Manager Arturo was rude! Not sure how hard up you have to be as a business to hire such a jerk! I sent an email to the GM with no response. Great way to run  business. I am a business traveler and avid Hampton Inns fan. I will not be staying there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: They have very good food. I'm usually surprised how empty it is in there because I am always happy with my entree. The ribs are fantastic. The only downside is the service has been pretty average, but if you want a good meal at a fair price this is a good place to go to.

Underwhelming at best.  No atmosphere, no drink list, bartender acted as if we were bothering him after being directed from Tony's due to a back up on our reservation.
It felt as if we had been sent the principal's office.  It was so quiet you could hear a pin drop!

Went in this place with an appitite hoping it was as one friend suggested., they liked the food, I was a little shocked about the prices,for where it's at you would assume they would be less than  triple digits here
.. I can go to Haddon twp to Bruno's for less... The food was not as good just fair....

Stopped for lunch, polite staff who were attentive. Clean atmosphere. ordered the fried chicken sandwich on ciabatta, with aioli, bacon, cheese and apple slaw-very tasty and really good. Entree came with sweet potatoe fries that were cooked perfectly. I definitely recommend eating here.

Service was slow and unfriendly. all reviews were ranting about there brick oven pizza so we ordered a margherita pizza, pizza came out with no basil or fresh moz cheese. it tastes nothing like pizza oven pizza just a classic pizza shop pie, so disappointed and will never be back so don't bother

We met friends at the Knight House tonight for dinner and everything was perfect. Brad was our server and did a great job. We had the Chilean sea bass and scallops, each cooked perfectly. The bass just melted in your mouth and the scallops seared to a Carmel brown.  The best restaurant in Doylestown, by far.

Fabulous!  Don't let the exterior dissuade you from trying this superb little bistro.  When you enter, you will be pleasantly surprised.  I had the best gnocchi of my life. It just melted in my mouth. My companions were equally satisfied with their meals. I am looking forward to returning again very soon.

I have been coming here for 17 years. although not the fanciest place they do great nails. They are currently remodeling and have a separate section for men. Their prices are fair compared to other local places. Making an appointment is your best bet since it does tend to get crowded. Ask for Mia you won't be disappointed!

Perfectly acceptable for NOLA even at Sugar Bowl prices (when compared to other places). Small but clean and well appointed rooms. Staff was responsive even with a full house. Close to everything but not too close to the quarter. Just two blocks from Mother's!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The Hidden gem in Edgehill is definitely Bella Napoli.  The wood fired pizzas are always made fresh, and the chewy crust is delicious. The bruschetta is always so delicious, and I have tried to copy the recipe at home, but can never get it right. You really can't go wrong with any item on the menu there!

I have been coming here since they opened. Love the shoulder rubs and the hot stones. All the ladies do great work. I've been to a couple other places, but I always come back here. I would have given them 5 stars if not for the fact that they are a little distant

The food was amazing. Finally, I don't have to go over into Philly to get my mexican fix!! I hate places like over the boarder, and don pablos.  This place is more authentic I suppose... the portions are tiny and the prices are not so tiny.. but I'm willing to pay for good quality food!

Over priced little ceasars!  WAY too greasy and the crust sucks! I'm from NY and I can be a little too critical, but even my family agreed it was not good.  The service was great though and I love supporting local businesses, so honestly, I will probably go back.

Not quite as great as before the reopening. The service is similar. The food is a little lacking in portion. But this place is still better than the other place across the street owned by the other family member. We appreciate the large menu, the casual feel, the price and the portions. We will continue to dine here!

Horrible! We ordered delivery from here and I kid you not it was the worst food I've ever put in my mouth. It also took roughly two hours to be delivered because the girl that answered the phone was completely incompetent. The food arrived and was unrecognizable, cold, and just disgusting.

I go to all of the locations, because I am all over the city some days. This is a great location.  The employees are friendly, fast, and the order is never wrong. I only use the drive-up, but it is always fast. There are Starbuck's in the area that could learn a lot from them-some are really bad.

Went last night, Saturday, had Chrissy for server. She was outstanding.  We had a small child with us and brought crackers to her. It was as if she anticipated our needs before we did!  Sweet and professional.  She is a gem!  Oh yea, the pizza is best best around!!

I live right down the street from this one so I've ate here several times. Out of 6 different times I think they manage to get the order correct maybe once. If you're going to use the drive thru I suggest you check your bags to make sure they got it all before driving off.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: My sister is visiting from our home state Arizona. We ordered a gazillion tacos and beans w/cheese. It was so good. Not disappointing in the least. The green and red sauces are actually Spicy and so flavorful! My hopes is this place remains the secret it is but I gotta tell you it's very good.

Fantastic experience from start to finish. They have delicious cocktail mixers so they can make you a tasty cocktail provided you bring the booze. Additionally, the server walked us through the specials and made solid recommendations. My seared duck breast was the best duck I've ever had. Would highly recommend!

Had my hair cut here last week and i have to say it was the best experience i have had in a very long time. i did not have to wait was seated right away, very friendly staff, The barber took his time and gave me and awesome cut just like i asked for. I will recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a great cut.

My neighborhood Chinese carryout.  We are SO LUCKY to have this fine Chinese restaurant in our backyard.  They deliver,  they do carryout,  and there are a few tables at which you can dine in.  There's a daily special which is always delicious.
 I've been a happy customer for over 25 years. DAMN I'm getting old!

Really liked the salsa, little kick in it. Mula was good, quac was the runny type . Sope, just not good. Too thick, no beans, which is pretty standard, no lettuce. Just like onions, salsa and a smattering of cheese. Asada taco, not bad, generous with the meat and the flavor was ... not bad , just not a standout

Room set up was good but Ac didn't work. They had to send engineers to our room at 10:30 at night.  It was one of those "your unit is frozen up so we will have to turn the heat on to fix it." When the heat was pushing 80 in June we finally were able to turn Ac back on. Just an old place with wallpaper peeling.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I enjoyed my meal there. I though all of the food was fresh and it was a relaxing environment.. I would go back and recommend it. I think there are definitely probably some dishes that are better than others and service is a bit odd with them usually having multiple waiters to a table, but friendly nonetheless.

Didn't give it 5 stars because it's a bit pricey. I go here for lunch often. They have a great meat and 3 and the cashiers are always very nice. Great place to go pick up a few items but if you need to go pick up multiple items I suggest a bigger box store because prices are typically much higher.

My sister and I stopped here during our vacation trip.  I enjoyed the chicken with lemon and capers sauce. It came with two nice size chicken breast.  The sauce was delicious.  We also enjoyed the Italian chop salad. I would also recommend the house Chianti

My college friends and I love going here and we love that it's open 24/7. Breakfast, lunch, dinner, no matter what time of day. It's not "gourmet" but I'm pretty sure no one expects that from a diner. Good food, kind staff, cool atmosphere, and they have basically any kind of diner food you'd want. Highly recommend.

They don't enforce wearing a mask. Two people came in  without masks and were not challenged. 

I'm a type 1 diabetic. I will NEVER give any Turkey Hill my business again.  

If you think this virus is a hoax, this is your place. 

If you ask they may start offering window licking contests to facilitate heard immunity.

Love this place! We have grown up eating balduccis and it never disappoints!!!! I would eat this pizza everyday. #deepdishtodiefor everyone get the deep dish. Be prepared though it is real deep dish! Also order it prior to your visit because it take a bit. Bacon pizza there is my favorite and my sister gets the French dip.

Ever seen an aggressively bored looking zombie work at a froyo place? Here you will. Even some of her other coworkers were trying to revive this poor girl.  The froyo is delicious, amazing, my favorite place in town for it.... as long as you take the initiative to ask for samples and can be your own customers service.

This Starbucks is a public nuisance. It blocks traffic, today it almost caused an accident as it was blocking TWO lanes of traffic on west end in the rain. Cars were driving by and honking at the car in the middle lane and the employees did nothing about this. They should be more responsible, someone could get hurt.

First hair cut was good about a month ago.  Went back in today for another, different person, told her what I wanted.  Well ended up looking like I am in the armed forces, very, very short.  On top of that I part my hair one side, and she cut it to part to the other side.  Well at least it will grow back.  I will not be returning!

Great food and great price. Seating is horrible. Very small establishment.  Get here early if you have a big party. I enjoy the quality of the sushi at this establishment and would go as far as as saying it is the best in town. If they got a bigger space,  they would he awesome.

This was an amazing experience for our anniversary dinner.  The ambience is very French country, rustic.  I felt transported to a cozy, farmhouse somewhere in the Loire Valley!  The food was delicious, unique, fresh, and the presentation was beautiful! I really recommend this place for a special date night with your one and only!

This is a great place when you just want a sandwich or burger and a drink without breaking the bank. Good friendly service and good food and drinks. They have specials each night of the week. We've never waited for a table and we've been there 3 times, but we've never gone on the weekend.

I typically don't review restaurants at all. I will say the delivery service really sucks. Ordered food at a 7:45 and was finally delivered around 9:10. The food was ok, but terribly cold. This is probably a good sit down or takeout restaurant, but the delivery is terrible.

Decent casual hotel with decent continental breakfast.
Breakfast area and seating areas could have been maintained better and neater but one staffer thought it was more important to be checking his phone constantly rather than focused on guests and his job.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This place is pretty decent. The ambinace and service was fairly solid. The endless quantity also was pretty good.

The sushi is sort of hit or miss. They have a couple of good rolls, but a few were definitely sub par.

The wait can be ridiculous, so definitely get there early or expect a wait.

I'm undecided how to rate this because we didn't actually even get to eat. They close for lunch at 2. Got there at 1:25 for a slice of pizza (would have been out well before 2) and they refused to let us barley even in the door. For that reason, I will never be back.

Got brake work done. They fixed the issue so they did their job. Jimmy was friendly but not very accommodative. I had a coupon I wanted to add on after the estimate (which is a hefty amount) and he wasn't willing to add it. Had he let me add it I would have saved $100 and I probably would have come back in the future. Not anymore.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Morning rush is a hot mess. Not a single napkin in my bag or anywhere on counter. Dispenser empty. One cashier with a line building behind me. Manager was trying to help but made matter worse. Donuts were ok and coffee was decent. Don't stop here unless you use the drive thru. Drive thru gal is sharp.

Lived in the area for 3 years and never stopped in to lotus. My mistake! Great dinner and didn't feel overly full when leaving. We stayed a half hour late without realizing the time and our waitress didn't rush us. It was such a good dinner; can't wait to go back!

The worst hair cut of my life. Extremely nice staff though, but lets be realistic, we do not go to the salon to chat and be friendly. I am sorry, I don't want to be mean, but please learn from my experience. It's like going to super cuts and paying 4X the price.

Took the family for brick oven pizza. The DiParma and Peloti pizza was fantastic! We had truffle fries, fried calamari and brushetta as our appetizers. The truffles fries were the family favorite.  
Service was okay. The staff seemed inexperienced. 
Other than that, nice family atmosphere, BYOB and good food.

We ordered based on Yelp reviews.  We couldn't even finish the Lady Roll or the Rock n roll.  Gyoza was good with good sauce.  Philadelphia roll & spicy tuna roll standard but nothing special.  We will not go again.  Nashville's dining scene is becoming overpriced & underwhelming:(

Great carne asada tacos, the sauces really make them great, a creamy tomatillo, and a face melting hot sauce paired together made for excellent tacos! Daughter liked veggie quesadilla. Service superb. Chips fair, salsa,very solid cilantro mix with a bit of heat. Rice and beans Ok.

They won't do what you want. You pay 400 bucks and they will argue with you and say they don't like what you want you can only get what they want to do. Staff is catty kind if stuck up. Colour wasn't very nice was blotchy. One of those places you feel like when you leave there just talking badly about you.

Beer prices are consistently higher than Lueken in Clearwater. Same product but $1-$2 higher every time. I mentioned it to the guy at checkout but he just shrugged it off. No problem. I don't like the service, I don't like the prices, why would I come back here? I'm done with B-21.

Great food!!!  The service is always terribly slow. It doesn't matter what time of the day or week we come. It sadly keeps us from coming and when we do, we remember why we don't. It would be fine for a slow pace date but with kids it's hard to wait 15 mins for a box and the check.

This store is the closest to us and we enjoyed going there, they have a great selection of food items, but ALL the non-perishable items were largely expired and opened (NO SAFETY SEALS), and the dates on the items were dated to expire when both my son and daughters were born, 2005 & 2008. I believe we will go back, but not to soon.

Facility was clean and prices were reasonable, but the quality of my mani/pedi was not good. She didn't cut or file any of my nails and put the polish on sloppily and too thick. I could've done a better job myself. One of my toes seems to be infected now as well.

I've washed my clothes at laundromats all my life.  They differ in cleanliness, convenience and cost.   I like this one because of  the attendant, Donna.  She is friendly and helpful and always has a good story.  This place is very close to my home.  I never go on the weekend because of the crowds.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Really solid choice for good Mexican food. The menu is quite extensive for a strip shopping center restaurant. I had beef ribs and my other half had a chicken and grilled vegetable entree with a creamy
Sauce. Everything was well prepared with fresh guacamole, retried beans and Mexican rice. We certainly plan to dine there again.

Their hotel bar was great!  Lively, open, clean, stylish, and with a friendly, attentive bartender.  Great prices, too!  Draft microbrews were only about $4.  As a bonus, they didn't tow my car out front, when I was parked in the loading zone with my hazards on for over an hour.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The staff is friendly an courteous. However, they have a tendency to overly concentrate on the drive thru customers at the time and expense of the walk in customers. The key word here is fast food. Which is THE reason I go to Wendy's or other fast food joints.

Ok if lights are off. Scary in daytime. Old and dirty. Drinks only. Have always seemed to have met a weird group when in at night. One night an old drunk white guy was insistent that e was a black man and was bugging all the customers. Bartender did a pretty good job of managing the crazy but.....

Read reviews and comments on Facebook so thought I would give a couple of weeks to get things figured out. Evidently that still isn't enough time. 8am and they were out of doughnuts. Figured since I was up and out and wanting doughnuts I'd head to Longs. 2 stars for getting me to go to Longs!

I got the $40 interior add on to find my car still dirty inside (cup holders, door jams, hatch carpet, etc). I literally had to stand next to the guy, tell him what to clean, watch him and check each area. Magically he still thought I should tip him! No thanks!

Ordered the Greek salad and didn't receive grilled chicken called to let them know and the girl argued us saying we ordered the wrong thing even though in the description on the Slice app it says grilled chicken under Greek salad...prices are high anyway, never going back!!

Place isnt what it used to be! Ordered a calazone and my bf specifically said with ham. The girl told him itll be extra, he said ok. Did it have ham in it? No!! We werent charged but not the point! And what stinks is calling and complaining wont get you anywhere! Their prices are too high to be screwing up.

Well upon booking this hotel, there was no mention of the restaurant and club lounge being closed. The bar and restaurant has been temporarily relocated. 

I had some free beverage vouchers and decided to visit the make-shift bar. Free wine was excellent, service was a little pushy and the food was just okay.

coffee shops that are good (offer everything you want: wifi, good music, quirky perks and deals, a neighborhood feel) are hard to come by.  And then when they do exist - they so quickly become obnoxious (gimmicky, franchise-able, bougie).  This place is perfect and not obnoxious.  Really, it's perfect.

We stopped in a couple weeks ago. We entered, were told by a worker that someone would be with us in a minute. We waited for five minutes at the counter, then left. This location continues to get bad reviews. When will they become like the rest of the Castles and give great service?

All was well until our rental van got keyed (aka. vandalized).  A couple of light, but long scratches down the side cost us nearly $2,000.  If it costs that much, then Hertz is being duped by their repair company and passing the buck to their customers.  Was loyal, now...probably not so much.

My husband and I have been there twice, and both times food was simply delicious. I highly recommend the Dragon Rolls and the Green California rolls. The service is always attentive and nice. If you're looking for an authentic Japanese restaurant Hikaru is your place.

Have been coming to this Big Brand for over 10 years now including their old locations. Delip and Victor have always provided great service and the tire prices are inline or lower than TireRack. The guys in the garage work hard and take care when handling your car and wheels. Recommended!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This is the place you go when you are by Stearns Wharf, there are no other coffee shops in sight, and you need something to drink. The staff is friendly enough, it is close to the wharf, there is a place to sit, but the products are not very good. This place is more for convenience than quality.

Been back since and my experience has been ok. Even though subway usually skimps on lettuce and other toppings this location seems to be even more stingy. Other than that food is fine, service Is decent and the best thing is they're open later than most other subways.

First time there, outstanding plenty of parking and spacious interior. Waitress, Louisa, was great. Salsa and chips are tasty, ask for the hot salsa but it is very zesty! Large menu but all 3 of our dinners were delicious and so reasonably priced! Definitely be back again.

I live right nearby Kampai and have ordered carry out from them more than once. Every time, without fail, they manage to mess up my order. All I want to get the food that I paid for. For a place that charges what they do, this is - in my view - in excusable.

I went to this place and ordered Two float's showed the pic what I wanted just different flavors of Ice cream one for me and my little Sis..He gave me half of what was on the pic and wrong flavors .He Said its not picNo management or anything at this place to complain to.

Bad review for bad experience. I forgot to close a tab that had two beers charged to it and they ended up charging me $55... not sure how. I suggest not keeping a tab open. But to add, the beer selection was disappointing and there were wayy too many immature frat boys there.

I could seriously eat at your restaurant every single day! I love that you offer different options for different peoples needs! So happy that now that I am trying to lose weight that I don't have to stop eating at my favorite place! You seriously have the best hot dogs I have ever eaten in my life!

Service is the worst. The food was good but took way too long.  I had to let my entree get cold waiting on the to bring my companions entree.  And the server just made ridiculous excuses.  Then he disappeared for long periods.  The place at 8p was almost empty yet they couldn't bring out our entrees together.

Normally very good service and I have been impressed many times. The service is normally spot on but today the lady that took my order was very abrupt and short. Maybe I caught her on a bad day or maybe she was just in the weeds but it doesn't. Take too long to smile and be a bit more personable.

It's more like 3.5 stars for me. I've been to Josephine a few times over the years, always hoping it's better than the last time. The atmosphere and service are good but the food has some work to do in order to be as good as other similar-tier restaurants.

Very good sushi, great special rolls, amazing sauce. The restaurant is small but charming and has a SoCal beachy casual vibe, the service is usually great but when they get busy it becomes a little uncomfortable in there. Go early or go late for a good seat, try the yellowtail habanero press box!

Pulled in a few minutes past 5:00 pm asking them to put a patch on a tire that was leaking.  Was told they close at 6 and already had a scheduled appt coming in. They couldn't justify paying overtime for a $24 patch job. No problem -- drove north a few blocks to National Tire & Battery .. They were happy to help me.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We were very pleased with the accommodations. Room was very clean and yes the bathroom was tiny but it served it's purpose....LOL We will definitely still there again. We had an interior room next to the elevator and didn't hear a sound. No way I'd get an outside room but that's just for safety reasons no matter where we stay!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I wish I could give this place 10 stars...... If I could eat at Sakura everyday I think I would. And I don't think I'd get tired of it either. Arguably the best traditional, American sushi in the city. There's nothing novelty about the place; solid food, great service and decent prices.

Low end diner food, maybe not as good as Denny's, maybe about equal.  But I wouldn't eat there unless you just are too tired to drive elsewhere.  Food too salty and sugary and some things tasted canned.  Slow service, but friendly enough.   Atmosphere pleasant.  Reasonable prices, maybe a bit higher than the quality would indicate.

I've been using Seville Cleaners at the Oracle address for 3 years and have been very happy with their customer service and ability to produce a quality product on time and as promised.  I've experienced none of the negative issues voiced by the other Yelpers.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I love this place! My friends and I get takeout here quite often, and we have enjoyed everything we've ordered so far. It is just takeout, so it's obviously nothing fancy, but great for what it is. (The crab rangoon is superb) The service is fast and friendly, and the pricing is great! It's always a stop we look forward to.

First time here atmosphere is relaxing and calming. Tom is my nail tech today he has been doing nails for over 17 years he is very attentive and gentle I'm loving the way he is politely pushing my feet back in the water.. So far so good I will post a pic after the majic has been completed

Very bad service and i took one month for rent, so they charged different types of taxes and extra fees. Finally they charge for tolls but all the tolls i only paid I didn't use ezpass. Budget is the worst rental service and i took car from different place

Food is ok .  Impossible to call , they pick up the phone and hang up on you with out saying a word . I understand they may be under staff or too busy due to current pandemic but I believe this is rude. Please put a message or something but don't just hang up on people.

I went here for 1st time and all what I can said is that I was not disappointed. I got my refill done very quickly and clean I can tell that the technician was skilled ,she was fast and fix my nails better that other places in the area. Is a little bit more $$ then other but I'm satisfied.

update:  to other viewers...check out the "filtered" reviews... something  keeps certain businesses at the top and others at the bottom ( like this one).  in fact my review totally disappeared, that's the reason for my update.  kinda annoyed.  so i'm always sure to check out filtered reviews for every listing

Cuter than expected !
I like to review for single diners, since I am often alone on business. 
This place is perfect for one-ers. 

Little 6 seat bar, friendly people, decent food but I just had a pizza. My pizza experience is NYC. So that's where it lost a star. 
Next time I'll have pasta because it looked great!

Just left ray's after my rear wheel bearings where going bad and they did a fast and professional job.   Ray not only gave a 4% discount for using cash he had parts delivered from a further distance because they were cheaper for me.   I recommend anyone go there and you'll be pleased

I went for an oil change just to check them out.  The reviews on Nextdoor have been good. I believe they have been in the neighborhood for awhile.  I went down the street for breakfast and coffee.  He told me other things I need to get done,  (which I knew).  I've been looking for one place to service my Honda CRV. This may be it.

Great local spot on Johnson highway away from the filth of main st.... Both soft serve and hard ice cream they actually make here and they rotate the special flavors every week. Lotta strange kid type creations including unicorn? But seriously give it a try

Took a group there on a Monday night, the place was packed. The food and service were excellent. Our server was Clayton, if you have an opportunity to get him you will be lucky. I had the veal NOCI and it was the best veal I have ever had. We were a large group of 17 guests and They handled every detail perfectly.

I really wanted to like these donuts, but they're sickly sweet and dense. Aesthetically they're gorgeous and customer service was pretty good (not much interaction).  I'll probably give it another go in the future, since they just came out with vegan donuts.

Karen and Joe Perotta are what make this Imo's the best in the area. They always put the customer first and act like you're eating dinner in their kitchen. If u want a true Imo's pizza, this is the place to go. Just the right amount of sauce, cheese, and toppings.

Made an emergency stop with battery / alternator issue. Went above and beyond to get us a free replacement battery from a competitor. Spent time and effort to save us $. We were prepared to purchase the meineke battery. They cost themselves money out of decency. Exceeded all expectations. Very grateful.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: These guys are the real deal: extremely knowledgeable and helpful, and most importantly, they are totally honest. If you want an auto repair shop you can trust, look no further. They have helped me to avoid costly repairs that other shops "recommended" and that turned out not to be necessary. These guys are a Lafayette Hill gem.

Just had the brunch.  The pulled pork tacos with grits and blue corn tortillas was great.  Shared an order of the truffled Parmesan frites that are out of this world.  This is the fourth time I've visited and every time has been very good.  Once we had the chefs table, I highly recommend it.

Easily the worst meal I've had in Philadelphia. Don't get the Groupon. The food was comparable to senior center food. Salad with wilted lettuce. Chicken in "white sauce" was nothing more than cream of chicken dumped on some baked chicken. Bread was cold hoagie roles. Service lousy. Not sure how this place stays open.

The Ranch is exclusively a late night bar. I've never been there before 1am. Once the Regal Beagle closes down most of the customers transition to the Ranch. They offer free popcorn, which is nice, but the bar is kind of gross. The late night clientele is a bit sloppy with their free popcorn and it ends up carpeting the floor.

Very fresh and tasty sushi. Miso soup had a nice, strong flavor.  There is a large selection of appetizers,salads,fried rice and sushi to choose from for the all you can eat. Not sure I got my money's worth for the $20 but that's on me and won't be a problem for big eaters. Glad to see this place on the Southside.

Incredibly slow. Our food was ready but employees just standing around and didn't collect the money for about 5 minutes of standing around. Ordered regular fries but got the size of a child's meal. Hamburger had wrong toppings and was not warm. Not sure what is going on here. Needs new management or something. Not going back.

Plenty of other options for your appetite in the airport. Skip the cheesesteak here. They use cheese wiz and it tastes awful (plus a surcharge if you want onions and peppers, which I found humorous). Lots of TVs but no availability for ESPN or Fox. No power outlets either. At least the service was friendly

I alway go to McDonald's for fast food because they are generally cleaner than most other fast food places. Tonight I noticed the girl preparing my order wasn't wearing cloves not sure if that is required but I always remembered them wearing them in the past .
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
"Simply put...everything is DELIZIOSO!!"

This is my favorite Italian restaurant near my home. It's very difficult to find quality Italian food with decent portions at a fair price. Giovanni's gets five stars on all counts.

My personal favorite is the chicken parm.

Make it a destination if you, too, love Italian food.

I'm rating Salon Capri only 1 star because of the owners attitude. I wish I could do 0 stars. Every time I go there she is so rude about something and it is very unprofessional and not very smart of a small business owner . She does an okay job with hair. But I will not return or ever recommend this place.

Avoid this place!! They are nice enough on the surface, but completely took advantage of my spouse and charged us for unnecessary things. I called them to discuss and was promised a call back from management to rectify, but never received one. We will never return!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I must be the only person disappointed in this place. Sunday afternoon, place was busy and grubby, hardly any cakes, and to my horror the server made my pot of tea and took the leaves out before serving me, a huge no-no. Tea was too weak - drinker must always be able to choose strength. Would not return.

Worst Krispy Kreme ever, doors were locked at 10:20 PM went around the drive through to learn that they are out of doughnuts except for 12 doughnut holes left!!! A KK location is out of doughnuts what a joke. And the fact that he mentioned the 12 holes is beyond me. They definitely need better management at this location.

This place is over priced and disgusting. I hear its supposed to be a sister restaurant to Cafe Napoli on Kirkwood Highway, but I don't see how that can be possible, since that place is delicious. I'm not sure how you can mess up a chicken caesar salad and then charge $12 for it!

Great location, staff is awesome! King bed is quite comfy and bathroom is VERY spacious. I'm here for a conference at the Marriott on Canal St, and I can walk there in ~5-7 minutes, depending on the traffic lights...

You may want to join their (free) loyalty program to get the free Wifi...

I'll definitely return!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Surprised this place has such good reviews. Showed up early on a weekend morning. They were out of most ingredients and there was only one staff member working. The service was very slow. The restaurant was a little grubby - paint peeling off the walls, paintings askew. Would not come again.

I'm a little disappointed that when I got home, I noticed my order of SIX donuts was wrong. (Was really looking forward to that cinnamon bun doughnut). Then when I tried the glazed, the two I had were very stale (most likely from the day before?). I'm very disappointed that my simple order could be messed up.

I just wanted to order an ice cream cone and it took like 20 minutes when I was at the front of the line. Anyways after ordering the ice cream I paid cash and the guy touched my money and didn't even wear gloves when he was touching my cone. Wow! I'm so done with McDonalds
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Great Taste.... More like can't swallow. I ordered seasame shrimp and all I could taste is the uncooked batter. I even had doubt if the shrimp was cooked. Overly sweet but tastes like nothing at the same time..... vegetable noodles were greasy. Don't know how they are in business

Good pizza, small business, great service.  Not blowing fake sunshine service like a chain restaurant.  Grass roots italian.  Their sauce is thinner like ny pizza and slices are big, you can order halfs of pizza toppings but they migrate.  All in all good solid food.

I came here today because my normal barbershop was closed. I have had a great deal of difficulty finding a good barber since moving here from Rhode Island. However, I think that I have found my new barbershop. I received an exceptional haircut in a timely manner at a very reasonable price.

The equipment is new and works well, but some (not all) of the kids working there have a bad attitude.  It's pricy for an exterior only wash, but the do it yourself vacuums work very well. I also wish people would respect the clearly marked "Members Only " lane.

Haven't gone back since I found dirt and a big hair lol in my food. If looked like something at the bottom of the broom. I took it to he manager and asked for my money back. He basically threw only $5 at me. This was four years ago and I was new to the area and I have never gone back. Nog sure if they have new owners since 2010.

Our go to sushi restaurant.  We love the sushi platters to go.  I also make it here for lunch and usually get the shrimp hibachi.  Sooo good!  Everyone is friendly and have never had a problem with service.  They also have my all time favorite sushi roll, Pacific Fusion!

My car seriously looks like it came off the lot.  Not a crumb to be found and my car was pretty filthy. They even cleaned the door jams, vacuumed the trunk, and high pressure air blowed out crumbs in the consoles. Best car wash I've ever been to. Highly recommend it and I'll definitely be back often.

The staff is very friendly. They use hot towels for all pedicures even the basic pedicure. They also use tub liners to reduce a customer's chance of getting an infection. Utensils are sterilized and individually packaged. Kathy is great! I highly recommend this nail salon.

Called this place to ask what approximate wait times would be like if I headed over there and whoever answered was extremely dismissive and wouldn't give me any type of answer. Looking for a new barber in the area and they clearly aren't getting my business. Customer service skills need some work.

went for my first time last weekend and the pizza was great! they even have little boxes so you can take your food home to finish. they don't have regular soda though, it's organic and not that bad either. there is barely any parking though in the lot. i will definitely be back!

I took my parents to Sunday brunch at The Farmer's Daughter and we were all very pleased. They had a large selection and everything was delicious (except the oysters which were tiny and shriveled up).  The restaurant is beautiful and the staff were all very friendly.

Hands down, the best beer store in the city.  They were great when they were across the street, now they are unbelievable.  The selection is unrivaled by any other beer store in the city.  Seriously.  They have more beer per square foot than most 2 places combined.  The cold box is awesome as well.  A gem in the hood.

So bad so so bad. I wish everyone would boycott this place until management can train their idiot staff how to take a order say please & thank you, how to properly make a sandwich, putting the correct order in the bag, etc...  I can't believe the stupidity of the staff...
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Only stayed one night but the room
Was clean and comfy. Had a fridge. Right across the street from Harrahs casino and Mothers, which is an awesome hole in the wall breakfast or lunch spot.
This hotel is an asy walk to Bourbon & Royal street fun. I'd stay here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Came here with a groupon tuesday night and it was mildy busy. We were seated quickly and we were recommended a party boat for it was our first time trying sushi. Everything was amazing!! To finish our night we had green tea tempura fried ice cream. Will definitly be back again. Our waiter alex was the best!!!

I called to see if the gym is part of myhealthways network and instead they tried to sell me a membership. I'm still waiting for them to call me back regarding the myhealthways program. I re-explaned to the person about the program and they said they would check again. SWEAT fitness the ball is in your court.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Food was great. Service was excellent. They have homemade ice cream usually with several flavors (6+) this location only had 3 to pick from one of which being vanilla :/. But will definitely be back, had a very enjoyable time with the server and the chefs.

We walked in and the first thing I noticed was the smell. It smelled like dog poo.  We even checked our shoes. Ordered two bottled beers. Bar tender was fine, beers were cold, but we didn't stay or eat because of the smell. 

Next day when we walked by the same dog poo smell attacked us...  It must be the actual smell of the bar!

Food was good.  Waitress was attentive - probably too attentive.  She brought us the wrong check - of course, ours was higher!  Figures!  The main peeve was the opera singer - from his bad toupee to the volume, it was almost comical.  When he did "Sweet Caroline" in an operatic style, all we could do was laugh!

We walked into a nearly empty place well after the lunch rush. There were two hostesses attending to many serious duties. Sadly, none of these duties had anything to do with seating customers. We, a party of 2, were the only ones waiting. And waiting. And waiting. 

We gave up and went elsewhere.

I'm always skeptical of restaurants that offer coupons all the time. I was not overly impressed with the food at Mexico City grill. The service was painstakingly slow. I felt like they could have used higher quality ingredients. Overall not a horrible experience but I will probably take my business elsewhere.

Osaka is a small neighborhood Japanese restaurant in the heart of Chestnut Hill. The service is always young & inexperienced yet eager to please and attentive. The food itself is constantly good bursting with flavors of ginger, sweet garlic & soy. Overall this is a great place to go for a dependable yummy evening out.

I took my car there to get my turn signal fixed. I had to take it back 2 more times because they didn't fix it properly the first or second time. Additionally, when they put it back together they broke my cruise control and it no longer works.

The workmanship is shoddy and I will not go back.

I like this place. Good food and good service. Although they don't deliver, they never keep me waiting when I pick up --10 minutes is really 10 minutes. 
 
I think it might be on the high-end of Chinese food pricepoints (for the NE) but their Japanese food is quite reasonable.

The service is alright (some of the servers are very friendly). Unfortunately, the food is just not up to par. The pizza is just okay and the sandwiches are pretty bland. My experience hasn't been as bad as some of the other reviewers, but I'm not in a hurry to go back.

Always cold. They leave the doors open and have the air on,even when it is freezing outside.
Uncomfortable furniture. 
They used to have a working fireplace but its never on anymore. Bummer.
Drinks are not that good.
Just not...cozy. I want my coffee shop to be warm and welcoming, and it didn't feel that way at CBTL.

Amazing neighborhood restaurant and bar! We loved everything we had, great cocktail menu, awesome selection of food, and wonderful service. Live music & heat lamps were an extra bonus. Welcome to the neighborhood- so happy to have a great option in the area!

Overall, the food is excellent. The atmosphere both outside in the courtyard and inside is lovely. The servers though always seem as if they couldn't care less. I've been time and time again and can't ever remember a time where I've felt as if I wasn't an inconvenience. My most recent time may be my last time for a while...

I am getting ready to re-sign. Plenty of equipment and great hours. Downside-- I hate the guys that sit on the machines and talk/stare at the girls.  Come on cavemen...this isn't a bar.  Work out or get out of my way.  Also...not cleaning your sweat of the machine you just used is disgusting!!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
This place was horrible! They got my entire order wrong even when I made sure to repeat it twice! I ordered with my moms card and when they came to deliver they had to actually see her and her I'd even thoe I told them she was fast asleep 
So I had to wake her up for $13 worth of food 
that was unacceptable

One of my lunch meeting spots.  I work out of my home so I need a place to meet clients where we can talk, spend a lot of time and - my preference - that has great food.  Ichiban is one of the best.  Delicious sushi, I can almost always get a table without waiting (at lunch) and, pretty reasonable prices..........

This place was delicious! We randomly stopped here on Fat Tuesday because we were so hungry and needed to charge our phones. We got the salmon and avocado roll, the shrimp tempura roll and the tchopetula - which is what you see in pics. It's was so good we ate it too fast lol. My absolute and vodka was also strong as hell.

This is honestly the best Dunkin Donuts in the area. The people are courteous, actually understand your order AND get it right, and it is super fast. No worries about being late to work by going here - literally, you can be in and out in 5 minutes with a drink and breakfast!

Been here several times.  Brooklyn pizza is excellent.  Platters--chicken Parmesan and chicken sorrento were delicious and reasonably priced. Portions are very generous.  I am Italian and fussy and I would not hesitate to recommend this local establishment.

It was OK pizza for the price. There are better places in South Philly for sure. The salad had pretty mediocre ingredients--unripe tomatoes, iceburg, a little bit too vinegary dressing. 

Pizza was good but pricey for what it is. Awesome crust, good cheese, mediocre sauce. Not a bad place to try out to see if you like it.

Horrible service waited forever in the line they forgot about us & all we had was 2 scoops of icecream with sprinkles ignored us numerous times cars behind us got there icecream the cashiers are rude with no manners...horrible establishment, horrible service.

So let's start off the food is good for fast food. They had more then 6 people inside and 1 with no mask.No social distancing. No Mask! Sorry I will not be back. I can't  take a chance and obviously nobody cares that works at the China Wok. I'm losing a place I often go. They are losing a good customer. Sorry!

Check out photos of the mens room which requires you ask for a 2 foot log on a key! Pizza is soggy like a jock strap and takes an hour to get.

Their deck is empty for a reason on a nice warm day.

$20 for a pizza what sucks isn't worth your time. I suggest to wait for a seat at other outdoor resturants nearby.

The snobbiest donut place on the south-side.Hello you got nothing on Longs. Do not know if its the owners or what. But these are not the the Jacks donuts I have had at the original store. They are smaller and more expensive. You might have the name. But that is about it.

All i have to say is this is the best pizza in Philadelphia.  I have had pizza in NYC and Chicago - the two pizza capitals of USA and slice wins hands down. Love the crispy crusts and the cheese. Our favorite is the fresh topings especially the eggplant and tomato. I wishh they stayed open late.

Meh.. Everytime i come it's something... Just got a chicken biscuit.... No honey no flavor...just chicken and bread.... Paid for the food and they said they didn't have biscuit and if i wanted a muffin instead?.... If u didn't have it then why wait till i paid to tell me this.

Not a bad restaurant at all.  The food was good not the best Mexican but certainly not the worst either. It was pretty much what I expected, I wasnt blown away by my experience but wasnt dissapointed. Very friendly service and the prices are on the cheaper side and worth it. 
 
Food: 3.5/5
Service: 3.5/5
Ambiance: 2/5

Outstanding quality, delivered fresher than competing Mexican restaurants in South Philly. Tacos al pastor came hot, with the tortillas still pliable, not cold and hard like I've become accustomed to with delivery. The rest of the food was also great. Delivery driver was extremely respectful, so make sure to leave a tip!

A trashy bourbon street bar. Buy 3 bottled beers (including Heineken and the usual crappy American beers) upstairs and hang out on the balcony. You can easily hear the live music from across the street there. Echoing the others, the shot girls are creepy and very pushy; avoid them if possible.

I ate here for lunch on Thursday to check it out. It is cleaner and has a nicer atmosphere than when it was Taco Del Mar but the food was just as bad. I had the Carne Asada burrito and I don't know if the steak was old, overcooked, or just a very low quality cut but it was so tough and chewy I could barely get it down.

Overall, it was fun trying weirdo foods. The menu changes so it does't matter what we ordered...but the cheese plate & tartar was sooo good! Here's my opinion: there is no reason to go to the same restaurant twice so I can check this restaurant off my list and move on.

Hands down the best haircut I've gotten in my entire life. Cool looking place with a great atmosphere and a friendly staff. I got my hair done by Jennifer who was fucking awesome! I would definitely recommend Dapper to anyone, and I will definitely return.

Wow!  A very nice place with excellent service.  We had a very attentive, professional waiter.

I had the carbonara.  I was still thinking about it the next day!  This is definitely the kind of place where you should skip the old standards like Chicken Parm and order something fancier.

Stellar service and awesome bartenders! One would immediately suspect the rather beautiful bartenders to be obnoxiously conceited, but they are anything but. And the live music is top-notch. Even the bouncers are friendly. Definitely a must stop in Nashville.

The service was good. Food was gross. 
Lasagna was old and dry. Disgusting. 
Lobster ravioli was cold. 
Chicken balls we got were kinda gross.  Too much lemon flavor. 
The only thing good was the chocolate cake. 
I will never, ever return here. Way too many good restaurants in Nashville.

My reserved table was not ready and I had to wait an additional 20 minutes.  Outdoor seating would have been nice except that all of the outdoor heaters were out of propane.  The drinks I ordered were wrong.  The only saving grace, and reason this deserves 2 stars and not one is that the food was okay, not great, but okay.

Remodeling so no pool, disappointing. A very expensive room for 3/4's of a hotel. Near the interstate and loud. Room is nice otherwise. Staff says website indicates pool not functional. I did not notice this on website beyond checking amenities which indicated they had a pool.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: If there's one thing you can count on at this PJs it's consistency.
