Consistently burnt coffee, consistently apathetic staff, consistently broken machinery, and consistently questionable pastries. Convenient for students who are cramming for exams in Howie T and have limited time to find a caffeine source.

First time at this barber shop and I left satisfied. The wait was kinda long but it was worth it for the cut. Chino did a good job on my hair. He paid attention to detail and took his time. I usually go to Supercuts, but for 2 dollars more, Magnolia Barber shop is way worth it.

Probably one of the best place for sushi in philly. Chirashi never dissapoints, fish taste fresh. They got great selection of special rolls, and regulars rolls taste great as well. Last time I got their fancy roll with salmon and scallop roll. Beef gyoza is delicious.

Food is a hit or miss. I ordered mayonnaise walnut shrimp and it was deep fried in some dough which I had it another way without the dough. After 3 pieces I had to stop it wasn't good. I threw the rest of it out. To me the shrimp tasted "dirty." I have to find another spot to order in search in the Mayfair area.

Terrible experience. The manager showed up 8 minutes late and then told me and another customer to wait on the street. When we refused she told us the locations of two other branches where we should go. The other customer with me was with a walker! What a nasty attitude!!

Generally pretty good but today was off...
Ordered a Venti latte and received a grande chai tea. Ordered a venti pike one cream...hard to mess that one up right ?? WRONG, they forgot to add the cream ! 
Come on guys. I pay good money for a coffee. I expect you to get it right. !

I've never gotten an incorrect order from them. Fries can be soggy at times. But everything else is usually fine. And correct. Interior is updated and modern.

Update: Credit for fixing the persistent soggy fries problem. Past two months they've been consistently crisp and dry. Good job.

This is a great, no-nonsense dry cleaners.  I've tried a few in the area, and this is by far the friendliest and most reasonably priced one I've found so far.

They only charge $8 for hemming (women's) pants, and they always do a great job.  Plus, they have 20% off dry cleaning on Tuesdays and Wednesdays.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I have been a resident of this dump for 2 years and save your money and live in a cardboard box! It is much safer to live in a box. I see thugs from Philadelphia in the parking lot just waiting for who knows what!! Are you sure this is not Section 8 housing? There are some real scums that live there so beware!!!

I ordered the elephant burger with fries. The burger was tasteless and the fries were too greasy. Another reviewer said that it tasted like a frozen burger just warmed up...I think that's right. I eat here before but I won't be back again. I would expect a lot more for $10 when I order something for takeout.

Was skeptical at first, but was extremely impressed.
Soo fresh. spring salad came w fresh ground ginger dressing and even avocado slices. 
All sushi was amazing, crazy tuna special was phenom though.
Yaki Udon was also fantastic. one of the best Ive had. 
 Definitely will be back here.

The Korean pork belly tostadas are flavorful and tender. The hibiscus pomegranate margarita wasn't too sweet or too boozy, just right to sip. The coconut tres leches was rich and warm, perfect pairing with the scoop of fudgy chocolate mousse. My boyfriend had the braised short rib burrito- he finished all of it.

AWESOME happy hour prices!  Comes out cheaper than most all you can eat places, and you can still get the fancy, shmancy rolls (which you usually can't get on all you can eat deals).  Really good handrolls, rest of sushi is decent enough. And for the price, can't be beat!

Be aware this is a cash only store.  We always shop by using a credit card which affords us a level of fraud protection.  This store does not take credit cards at all.  Keeping this in mind I do not feel comfortable going here with a pocket full of cash.  Winco needs to join the current century and honor major credit cards.

I have been going to this restaurant for years, but the last few year the ownership changed hands..and so did the dishes. The soups used to be fabulous and now they use water as their stock.. They are so disappointing. The Peking duck was unrecognizable. Please address the tasteless food issues! I want my Chinatown back!

So. Expensive. Especially produce. But clean. Well staffed and always open until 10 so very convenient. And mike I guess he's like a manager? One day I forgot mu wallet and he gave my toddler some fruit and let me get my bread and return later to pay (which I did) just off of good faith.

Best sushi in Tucson! Portions are huge, service is terrific and the sushi chefs are very accommodating! The have great happy hour specials every day and the fish is fresh and yummy. And very important the place is always incredibly clean.

Hands down the best around!

This place is just horrible in every possible way.  Out to lunch and grumpy waitstaff every time I've been there.  I will spend my money elsewhere - anywhere I'm not made to feel like a burden for having the audacity to be a customer.  Too expensive and crap food. Yuk.

Anna was by far the best! She made a list of restaurants and other bars to visit. Not only did she make the best cocktails we have had but she literally explained exactly how they would taste! We were so happy by the time we left we spoke about her and the bar to everyone :)

My family ate here recently. The food was average but the service was horrible.
We asked to see the manager, a man named Miguel, and he was VERY RUDE to us and pretty much said that if we didn't like the long wait we were experiencing then we could eat somewhere else next time....WE WILL!

We went there on Dec 24th. Service was very good, and so was the sushi. It wasn't cheap, but it was worth it. We were happy to have found a place open on Xmas eve, and even happier that the food was so good. It wasn't the first time we went there, and we will go there again.

Went in for lunch. The pesto that comes with bread was excellent. Ordered the salmon with linguini which was a bit on the sweet side, but still decent. Also got the breaded prime pork tenderloin which was heavy. Both dishes were too oily, the pork would have been more enjoyable if they went lighter on it!

This is my go-to place in Upper Darby.  Comfort Mexican, very authentic.  The prices are reasonable and the food is always good.  It is not fancy but it always delicious and the the folks that run it are super sweet!   We go often and plan to continue to do so.

I give this place 3 stars because the food there was fairly good, but after my mom started getting red bumps and allergies while others where having stomachaches. If this had not happened then this place would be getting a five star. The price for all of my family was very unreasonably high.

I did not care for the food here. The taco salad comes with shredded chicken and shredded lettuce. I personally like chicken chunks and regular lettuce in my taco salad. Also the sopapillas here are thin and crunchy as opposed to the typical bread like sopapillas. Rice and refried beans are standard. Prices are reasonable

Dark and Dismal. 
Rednecks and old men.  
TV's are at least 25 years old. 
Have to pay to hear music. 
2 old women bartenders, neither can make a decent mixed drink. 
They haven't put a penny into up keep or updating the place for a long long time. 
What a waste of prime real-estate. 
Tisk Tisk for shame.

We used to go here ALL the time.  Very good sushi at one time.  Last time we ate there there the rice was too dense; the wasabi was not even close to fresh or hot; and the fish just did not taste right.  Especially the unagi.  Disapponinted to say the least.

Extremely inefficient and slow service. Took 10 minutes to get my latte this morning with only one person waiting in front of me. I'll only come here if I have time to kill. Then again if I have time to kill then I would go somewhere with better coffee and a more relaxing environment.

This place is terrible. It was the second time I went. The first time I figured okay maybe it was just me. I actually had to go take it and vacuum it after I left there it was so bad nothing was wiped down the windows were dirty they didn't vacuum the back it was horrible and for $30 for a cleaning and tires never again

This is the filthiest McDonald's I have ever been to. Floors are sticky. Serving areas are messy with spills, garbage, and dropped food.   

If you happen to get food poisoning after eating here, the bathrooms look like they were trucked in from Suburban Station. They're disgusting and none of the toilet stalls have doors.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I can't recommend this place because the barbers tend to be hit or miss here.   Whenever I go there, there's a line out the door for Jason and the others' chairs are empty.  I have never had the time to wait for Jason, but he seems to be the most popular.   The other 4 barbers have varying degrees of capability and friendliness.

This is a Red Mango imitation but, like most imitation flavors, it's not as good as the real thing. The flavors are weaker than those at Red Mango and they only offer one size of cup. iirc, the prices are the same, too, so, given that there is a Red Mango down the street, there is no need to visit Chill.

They dont precisely measure each scoop of tuna or seafood like they did me at the Bullard location. portions are generous, but I lowered their rating because their published hours of operation don't jive with the hours they're actually open.  I went there are sat. nite when they were supposed to be open and they were closed.

Wow!!!    Never have been to Boise before.   Went to go look at the college for my senior and stay at The Grove.   This is one of the best hotels I've ever stayed.  The best find!! For the money.   Had dinner in dining room the food and serve was fab.   Will always stay here when in Boise.   Great job guys!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Good service, but really mediocre food. Definitely not worth the high price. My penne broccoli rabe was half submerged in water. The meatball appetizer was pretty decent though.
We had to try the place out because we heard it was so good. We don't need to go back. Once is enough.

Lost a pair of pants I brought in to be hemmed. Owner was rude to me when I asked to be reimbursed for my pants after giving them 3 weeks to find them. Said that never happens there, and he highly doubted they lost them. Then where oh where are they??? Will not be back. (I did get reimbursed)
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I went here because I had a coupon...I've lived here for years and somehow never went to Scoops.  I will definitely be coming back, although I think it's a little pricey.  I do wish they had a few more places to sit down outside, we ended up sitting on a bench.

I have to say is a normal hotel ... not nice and not ugly but the breakfast is super great. Cost me about $80 so I say is decent price. I would have like that they extended the breakfast time to 10am. I only had 20min, I got there at 8:35 for breakfast and when it hit 8:50 the lady started to put everything away .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Attentive valet staff, clean room, modern look. Overall a great experience. The front desk was extremely friendly and knowledgable. No real complaints, but as a Starwood member and other experiences at Starwood resorts, just not worthy of 5 stars. I guess there just wasn't the "above and beyond" we're used to with Starwood.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: During the craziness with COVID-19, my son left his glasses at school. Sterling Exton was able to see him for an exam AND provide him with new glasses during the same visit. The staff was very helpful and I was impressed with the doctor during the visit. Our experience was positive and I am grateful they were open!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This is a real burger place (as opposed to a McDonald's burger). Very good food, but nothing that blew my mind. Pretty good selection for a decent price. You'll get a burger+fries+drink for around $7-8. The seating is alright, all outdoor though. For the price, and the quality I would definitely recommend. (Good shakes too)

New to Tucson. Went here because the diner is in the top 4 of the Best Breakfast in Tucson competition; thought we'd give it a try. Service: great. Cindy Lou introduced herself and really runs that place well. Food: prepackaged so while not bad, it's not the best you'll ever have. Price: what it should be for what it is.

Terrible terrible place to buy anything. I think the staff is tired of their job itself. Old food and donuts... doesn't taste good, they never get the order right, they never have orange juice they're always out. And the pace looks rubbed down. I only come here when it's urgent. :(

A real Jewell of Ardmore. Pizza begins with crust and this place has a complex, crispy wood oven base that makes the toppings shine. The veggie special pie is so rich and yummy. A step up from typical pizza places, but still with great prices. 

The owner is super friendly. Keep it real. Keep it local.
Keep it Ardmore.

Mediocre sushi, cramped space, and terrible wait staff. If you're in poverty and really need to eat sushi, this would be the place to go. There's a lot of hype around the place, but I was so disappointed that I signed up for Yelp to warn everybody that it does not have quality sushi

I pretty much came here because of the reviews and was not disappointed! I will def be coming to this place from now on. The staff was very friendly and knowledgeable and my appointment was thorough and painless. They were not pushy at all like some eye places that try to get you to buy the most expensive things.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: My friend and I were greeted by the nice Japanese workers and the Japanese style seats which made the whole experience more amazing! I would recommend the seafood tempura platter. Roll seemed small for the price. Even though everything was a bit pricey, they compensated with their customer service and the great food

Yeah, not the best, but certainly not the worst chinese I've ever had.  Their seafood fried rice is pretty good and they have great chicken wings. One more thing... how do you know  " the chef spits on the grill", b/c someone told you that?? um, ok...that's ridiculous.

Solid pleasant Mexican place. You get a lot of chow for the buck. Salsa looked and tasted like what I make so it was great. Objective I swear. Good value, typical mi casa ambience, and muy bueno service. If you are in the area, I'd stop in. You won't be disappointed.

The past couple of take out orders here have been horrendous. The fixed star review was when this was popi's.

Since the changeover, the food has truly gotten worse. Quality of chicken hasn't been as good, items from orders have been missing. Just not good. 

It's too bad. I truly miss popi's.

Amazing service! Katie was able to lift my dark brown hair into a beautiful blonde today AND gave me the best cut of my life. I have gone from salon to salon in Reno, trying to find a good stylist. I swear by Crush now. And every employee in there is friendly. I highly recommend them.

One of my favorite places. I have been a big fan for couple of years now. Piada is reasonably priced, given the choice of fresh ingridients they have. I love the Calamiri piada and most of the times settle for that. Go order the Calamrir Piada..you will love it!!

How can you trust the safety of a store when every single AM shift man working is wearing a chin mask???  These guys also prepare drinks incorrectly and are heavy-handed with milk added to drinks. An AM drink and a PM drink, or a drink from another Dunkin shouldn't be completely different.

Walk in to pickup a online order which was quick and easy. The ambiance is really inviting and attractive to dine-in. I had beef nachos and flan which was pretty standard in price and taste. Next time I will try the more authentic offerings to really judge the quality.

Waited in the drive through for over 15 minutes. No acknowledgement or apology for very long delay. Employee didn't confirm order or amount charging to my card. My burger was cold and disgusting. The fries tasted like they'd been deep fried five times. Never going back.

Food is better at Taco Bell and half the price. Had to request a menu.  Service was terrible, had to get up to get silverware ourselves. Beans were cold, taco shell from a package. Taco had ground beef and lettuce on it, that was all. I will never go back.

This place is disgusting. Really bad. The rooms are outdated and gross. Opened the hotel door, smelled the room and said, "heck no" (I actually used profanity). Staff is unhelpful and unfriendly. AVOID THIS DISGUSTING DUMP!!!!! We're leaving and going to another hotel. They will not give us a refund and we just got here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Went for a Sunday night drink/snack. The place has grown into something too big for south tampa. Too busy to deal with small time people.They're too busy to deal with patrons after 830. Love the place;used to be My favorite in hyde park but look for to seeing alternative options to patronize.

I called this restaurant to find out if I could place an order to my fathers house without me being there. I was able to order and pay for the order over the phone. The food arrived in time and my dad was so happy with his meal! I couldn't be happier with their service! Thank you so much!!! 
LIz

This was one of my favorite sushi spots before the new ownership.

Now it is just another generic sushi joint. 

The good news is now my wife wont make me drive from the other-side of sparks just to eat here.

Sorry to see you go Sushi Seven... I thought what we had was real :(

Ordered two slices one pepp one cheese both felt hot but the cheese wasn't even melted. My coke from the cooler was barely above room temp. The pizza would only be good if I were drunk and I was STARVING so that was frustrating! So hungry but hating my food lol

i've traveled all over the country, and of course have to get my froyo fix no matter what state I'm in! I have to say.... I have yet to walk thru the doors of a place that has better frozen yogurt, better toppings, better cleanliness, better customer service...than this! Love you guys!

First of all this is the best value for a great cup of coffee. Hands down! The one thing that I love is their description of the hints of flavors in the coffee is right on the money.  
The place is not jammed packed. It's simple and calm.  
Just wish they had a little more offers to nibble on.

I found the liquor selection to be good and the prices a little better than the other local stores. The premises are clean and well maintained. The service could be better, Megan was efficient with the checkout but not interested in helping me find a specific product. Overall a good experience.

I used Pride Cleaners every week for a couple of years. There owner never once spoke to me and he refuses heating or a / c to make the place comfortable for employees or customers. Elsa is great but the other employee that runs the register is rude. I have not returned since she said "I don't like you".
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Great location; very nice rooms and sweet staff. The only change I would suggest is the way breakfast is set up- move the toaster and waffle iron out of the main buffet line, it creates a huge traffic jam. If it was on a separate table, the line would flow much better.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We have used the carwash twice. Each time it was not overly busy (we always go in the evening). The wash does a good job. We like the compressed air gun to blow out the mirrors and seams before we hand dry. Some of the vacuums seem to be stronger than others. Overall it is a great carwash

Northern Liberties has been needing this place! The sushi is AMAZING, the chef is so friendly, and the special rolls are really unique. This is the best spot around. We've been getting take-out from Hikari every Sunday during quarantine and it's the best part of the week!

Disgusting service at best. 18.75 for a burger and fries? Fries were just dumped in the bag. Some woman who I assume was a manager that was off duty was barking orders wearing short shorts with tattoos on her legs ( believe me she didn't need to be wearing them ). So needless to say I won't be wasting my money again.

Disgusting service at best. 18.75 for a burger and fries? Fries were just dumped in the bag. Some woman who I assume was a manager that was off duty was barking orders wearing short shorts with tattoos on her legs ( believe me she didn't need to be wearing them ). So needless to say I won't be wasting my money again.

Ordered delivery. The gyro is good but nothing special. The fries that come with the meal are also good. However, the burgers are horrible. Large but limp, barely cooked through, and frankly I wondered if it was dig meat. More likely it was a frozen patty of some kind. 

Skip the burgers completely.

Great service! Very personable and honest! I took my work truck into Dales and I couldn't be happier! They were so personable and friendly, not to mention they found the leak in my radiator and gave me some recommendations, with no pressure sales. Great to see a honest professional auto shop! I will be returning!

Been going here about 3 times a year for over 25 years. The quality has really gone down over the past 5 years or so. The soda fountain hasn't been updated this decade. The soda is always too zeltzery. The McDonald's on 70 in Marlton is closed to my work and it's a lot better.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Just went to alvernon optical at the 4747 e sunrise location   Front help was very nice and
business like   However I found Dr Theresa Setlock to be brusque,cold and rude and was only interested in selling glasses.  I would give less than 1 star rating if possible.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Absolutely clean environment, fresh fish even on Sundays....everybody's so friendly, especially Jonathon and Rodrigo, love their specials, just ask them to make you some !  I'm Asian, and I know sashimi, however, you can't compare here to the Bay Area...so, not bad for Reno, good place for a fix!

The quality of food at Monicals has gone down significantly. We used to order from here regularly but the last several times have been unacceptable. See attached for pictures of kids lasagna and BBQ wings, which we didn't even eat after looking at them. The pizza was average at best.

Nice service. We tried the fried calamari and two types of pastas and everything was well prepared. There are two areas to the place (one more casual), allowing for more flexibility for the setting you're in the mood for. Definitely a good addition to the restaurant scene in this part of town.

Cool place to go browse beers and enjoy a pint or two.  They have about 30 beers on tap, and fill growlers.  They do not offer food (unless you think potato chips is a food group!), but you can bring in food from elsewhere.  Prices are steep, but hard to beat the variety and special offerings if you're really into beer.

Good food but slow service. You can be the only person in the drive-thru and they will still make you "pull up to the red gate" and wait 5-10 minutes.

If you go inside to order the service is worse. Waited 15+ minutes for a fish sandwich even though my girlfriend and I were the only people in line.

It was after lunch, around 1:30 when we stopped for a bite. Waited long for our order of crab bisque and a BLT and avocado sandwich. The bisque was hot but boy is it thick! No evidence of crab meat. The BLT was cold by the time it was served and so were the fries.  A couple who came after us were served their soups before us.

Great car wash for the price. Basic wash is $4.00 and it includes free vacuum use. If you go on Saturday or Sunday of course they are going to be extremely busy! My only issue is with the pay kiosk. The sun hits the screen & makes it real hard to see the payment options.

don't get food to go, unless their paninis are supposed to be soggy and why bother toasting?

I ordered the prosciutto one, and yes, I know it's cured, but I couldn't even eat it because it was sooooo salty, and of course soggy and limp.

not impressed at all

They allow people with domestic violence history to live here and get into fist fights. This changed over the past year. I guess they decided to loosen their requirements of who can live here and several of our new neighbors have been having domestic violence issues. I've had to call the cops four times over the past year.

Once or twice a month this is my favorite sushi spot! 
I love it here! 
Great fresh food, great staff and overall I just love it here! I always get sushi, my boyfriend will get hibachi.  Never can go wrong with any food choice! 
Friendly and warm atmosphere!

The staff is very friendly and helpful.  This location is small so seating can be an issue if they are super busy.  If you're tired of the traditional breakfasts and looking for something different and tasty, try the Ultimate Breakfast sandwich. Ciabatta. Spinach. Bacon. Egg. Tomato. Avocado.   You won't be disappointed!!

Hands down the BEST hotel I've ever been to, and I've traveled a lot. The front desk people are so nice and considerate, the bathrooms are spotless, the pool is awesome, the rooms are amazing, I could go on and on about how amazing this hotel has been. They were very understanding and I just love the breakfast and lounge area!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went here for breakfast with the hubby... Very yummy! I had the duck confit hash which was decadent! Hubby had the pancakes which he says were good but a tad dry. We also shared an order of the turkey dumplings which were unique and quite tasty. We will definitely come back!

Not terrible, just ok ("meh" in yelp terms). Food was decent, crab queso was the best part of the meal. The real issue was price, Mexican food should not cost over $100 (including 20% tip) in Ft. Washington for 2 people. Much better options in the area, you just need to look around. Building was nice and clean, service was fine.

Thanks Colin R. Now I understand. Sometimes it is great and sometimes it stinks. It is hard to believe the pizza is from the same place I used to love. After giving it a few additional tries it was time to move on. 

Sounds like the owner needs to coach his team on how to major those great pizzas!!!

Little pricy for the quality/quantity of food. Very small menu. SO LOUD. Do not recommend for date night. we went on a tues for our anniversary and couldn't even hear each other. 
Pretty good happy hour deals until 7pm. Food comes out whenever it's ready, not together. Service was only so so.

Watched the dirty shaggy Chef smoke a cigarette out next to the dumpster on the side of the building as my girlfriend and I walked up looking forward to a fine dining experience.

Food was really heavy and dense. Very flavorful but after a few bites was tired of it.

Theres much better elsewhere.

I cant recommend.

What an amazing, fun, cool, beautiful hotel. Best staff, great rooms, quiet, great location, amazing bar with a great band! People that complained in other reviews about not enough coffee cups, or lights are to dim need to stay at the best western! This is New Orleans, not Sunday school! STAY HERE!!!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I paid for the $12 wash and my car is still dirty, the tire shine sprayed on my rims and tires but didn't rub in so there was blue everywhere that I had to wipe off. I pulled up to the vaccuums the one didn't work and all and the top fell off of the tube. Don't waste your money.

Been a fan of Gratzzi for years . All the way back to the failed project next to parking garage . Always a wonderful dining experience . Food is top- notch ! Service is great . Love the wine selection .  Took my girlfriend who travels to Italy at least once a year & she likes Gratzzi. Very authenic .

The only reason it's not a five star bar to me is the lack of food availability. Add a grill in this place and they would not only make a fortune they would shut down local food businesses, I mean good quality Swamp Room type food. I'm tellin' ya..........

3 stars for the cleanliness, friendly staff, and piping hot food.. But the food itself just didn't do it for me. Rice was plain with nothing in it (seemed to be just rice with soy sauce) and the chicken seemed to be more bread batter than actual meat inside. Just didn't do it for me.

Really good pizza--I had a slice of BBQ chicken thin-crust and a slice of cheese Sicilian-style and they both were very tasty.  Rating 3 starts for their opening hours, or lack thereof.  We came by on a Sunday and they just...weren't open.  No hours posted on the door or available online.  It's frustrating not to know when to come.

I'm a lifer at McD's but this place is THE WORST. The employees all look and act like meth heads, most don't have teeth, and there are several who must not EVER take a bath. When the people working at the McD's SCARE you so bad you won't even eat McDonald's , there is something very seriously wrong. I will NEVER go back.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Easy check in. Nice shower. Aveda products! Beds were nice too. My booking was supposed to be a park and stay, but didn't show as such. The manager on duty was great in helping me out with correcting the issue. Although I haven't been back to retrieve my vehicle. Hopefully, that will still be the case.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Mediocre experience.  Good: Service, appears to be own and operated by a family.  Bad: the food was overpriced and poor in quality. I ordered chicken and it was one of the poorest quality pieces of chicken I've ever had. Additionally, the portion size was small.

I thought because of the reviews on yelp that it was going to be a great breakfast, it was barely ok. They don't know how to do Benedict's, the fresh fruit tasted like cheese impossible to eat. The coffee was good, and we didn't have to wait for a table. 
I would recommend it

Very disappointing!  Stale chips, slow service and watery taco salad. Yuck! The server was nice. I love the one in town but this one has some major adjustments needed. I will wait a couple of months and maybe give them another try.  I was so looking forward to them being here. Bummer.

Usually I really like this but recently had a bad experience. It really does matter who is taking the orders. They need a bit more mature person working there with a bit more experience. Even going in there she can not take an order correctly. But everybody loves a Barbie.

It's the ONLY option around here.  Hersey's ice cream isn't the best tasting ice cream with their meager tasting cones.  At least use Turkey Hill flavor ice cream.  If Rita's or Dairy Queen ever open around here, it'll give this place a run for their money.

It's a hit or miss type of place. Tonight was good but there are several times where our brick oven pizza is a bit burnt.  We ordered the capellini prigatono & margherita pizza.  The crab meat on the capellini was a bit fishy & dry but I was starving so I scarf my food down with gratitude! :-)

Dirty Store and nobody rotates stock so check dates before buying anything and no AC very hot in store and would it be to much to ask if some workers spoke English. bad customer service and just to buy a couple of items you will wait in check out line forever manager doesn't care.. you have been warned shop at your own risk

AN INFURIATING RIPOFF. 

Don't know how to fill order accurately or load food in bags. Twelve breakfast burritos smashed hamburgers. Hamburgers were wrong. They left bacon off one & other had 1 patty, not 2. 
Burgers were dry & tasteless. 
Ice cream was good.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I love coming here. Service is great and the atmosphere is nice. Food comes out hot and well paced. I've had the veal which was cooked perfectly. I've had several pasta dishes that were also great. Their sauce is always consistent. Always need reservations.

We ordered take-out on a Friday night after spending the day at Sesame Place.  My husband had sushi and I had the Yaki Udon.  My order came with Miso soup and a salad with a wonderful ginger dressing.  We also got an order of gyoza.  Everything was fabulous!  I would highly recommend the food here and would definitely come again.

30 dollars for a large and two small sandwiches are you kidding me?? You don't honor subway deals and coupons?? You're lucky I had places to be or I would have left the finished sandwiches on the counter..
What a rip off I'll never go to your store again..

I'm a grown adult and I just went to Dunkin Donuts for the first time in my life! I used the drive thru and got a cake donut and glazed donut. The black guy at the window was near impossible to understand and I kept asking him to repeat. He was nice though and didn't charge me for my tea!

Best wings you'll ever have, flavorful, smoked to perfection. Im not much of a drinker but I'll come for the wings. Unfortunately the last two batches I got have had feathers and not tiny ones big sopping in wing sauce feathers. Wondered how they missed them they were so big. Going to try one more time if i see feathers im done.

Don's Auto is above and beyond. They have fair prices, excellent work and good wait times. I have brought my car here for 5 years and they always do an excellent job. He never makes you buy things you don't need. I would highly recommend their service to everyone!

From what I remember this place serves Seattle's Best coffee, so it's nothing unique but it's good and convenient. Tiny space so I imagine it's cramped if/when it gets crowded, but if you're looking for a quick iced coffee on the way to/from the beach, its a decent place to stop.

This place is actually called Jack's, although I did in fact get my hair cut by Ernie.  Ernie is a nice older gentleman who's slightly hard of hearing.  That did not, however, keep him from giving me a fine haircut.

I just walked in - no appointment.  Haircut was $20 - which I thought was quite reasonable.

Poorly managed, person in charge was not willing to correct employee mistake so I returned my food and not treated well. Will not EVER return to this location and probably my last visit to a Subway. Food is mediocre at best anyway...so they lost a customer over $1.80 mistake which THEY made.

Why cant I ever get a correctly made order from this McDonald's? Even when there are no special requests. Always wrong or incomplete. Manager tries to apologize and offer explanations but I honestly feel quantity over quality here. I wish this wasn't my neighborhood Micky Ds..
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I had a party there, and it was horrible from start to finish. Our food was suppose to be ready when we got there, we had to wait about 45 minutes to get our food, and the had to wait 2 more times to get the rest of our food. The bar tender was very rude to us. They were very unorganized! Just not a good experience.

I went there on Thursday last week and it was the worst car washed I've ever had I would never go back I came out of there to vacuum my car and it was still so dirty on the front and the back . I should've of just went to the Metro car wash like I always do this has never happened to me in a car wash

The front desk people are very rude. Upon arrival we get no hello, thank you for coming. The lady at the front immediately said we have no rooms ready yet.  The hotel rooms smell really bad and does not look very clean. We also did not have towels in our room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I went on there on a monday evening to get take out. There was no other customers in the restaurant. I felt it too quiet, but the rolls I ordered were great. As soon as I was leaving a few cars pulled in for dinner. I'm not I've never had better sushi, but I don't think anything this good for the price can beat it

Wasn't really a fan. Something about the taste I just didn't care for. Also when I placed my order for delivery they checked my address and had no problems. 20 minutes later received a call from the delivery driver saying I was too far away??  He did end up delivering and was decent while he was here.

The food is fresh , delicious, and reasonable. It's not the usual mess of melted cheese and bland sauce. 
The service is excellent. Best Mexican food in the area. The flan is the best I have had outside of Mexico. Never really that crowded except for the occasional party. It should be packed every night.

Horrible sauce poured over everything! Straight-from-the-botte ITALIAN DRESSING was generously poured all over my spicy salmon roll. So awful! Plus the Uni was not fresh. Plus I got it delivered (fairly quickly) so there was no way to send it back. Please for your own good go somewhere else.

Pizza is pretty weak, and $3 a slice? 

Horrible service. Seems like an inconvenience to them for you to be in there.

DIRTY. Everything is dirty.

Dude working there was screaming a very inappropriate story to another man across the room which consisted of every other word being F**k.

I cant believe the flimsy old wood chairs haven't hurt someone yet. They make a killing there on ice-cream sales. Go buy some new benches for the customers! Also, its 2015. Cash only is not going to work for most customers. Your prices are high enough to take credit cards.

Wouldn't go back. Everything was uber-oily and it was freezing in there. The restaurant was virtually empty and I had my coat and scarf on by the time the food came. Not enough quality or ambiance for a return trip. Agree with the others that the service was uber slow.

Used to come here every Sunday before football - never had a problem until about two weeks ago. The Sunday Crew is awful - the coffee is disgusting, you are constantly overcharged, and they never know about their own specials. Back to Starbucks until they get things figured out.

It's certainly not bad, but it's also nothing to get excited about. The slices are of a decent size geometrically, but the overall value is ruined by how little sauce and cheese is put on each slice. Boise definitely doesn't strike me as a pizza town of any sort, so the fact that this place didn't wow me wasn't much of a shock.

It's a good place to go for my kids since it's so close, I do wish they took credit. Now and days who really carries cash? I do like the options for water ice or ice cream. I wouldn't say go out of your way for richmans, but it isn't to common to find an ice cream spot, so for kids it's more about the experience.

Why does people think this place is more than 1 star. Canned mushrooms. Not enough sauce on the pizza. Frozen Mutz. Front sign reads since 1979 or whatever date they said. Looks like that was the last time they did anything to the place. Clean your floors.

Sauce dry. They don't use enough sauce. Tried them 3 times - coming from Bklyn/ Staten Island I'm a skeptical NY I gave it 3 tries !!Place needs a major over haul. Dark and dingy. They have been there for years you would think they would up date the place.

Delicious all I can say about this Italian Restaurant. I give it 5 stars. Delicious Calamari as well as the linguine with red sauce. As for the bread we were given garlic knots,,,,,,,,who does that.  Wow Great time too. Tables spaced apart. Social distancing couldn't ask for a more enjoyable evening!!

First trip to this restaurant after hearing about it many times. The staff was very friendly. Great view. Spouse and I both had catfish filets and both of us came to the same conclusion-  not enough flavor in the fish ( salt and pepper?) and the hushpuppies were dry and flavorless as well. We were both disappointed.

My friend stayed here and her son got sick on the bed and floor in the night. She went to the front desk to ask for cleaning supplies and they told her not to worry and they would clean it. When she got home they charged her card and extra $300 for "damages" and cooperate wouldn't help her get her money back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great environment.  Good music.  Helpful, friendly bartenders.  The big drawback is the cocktail menu.  Way too heavily focused on drinks made with rye/bourbon/whiskey.  Where's the rum drinks?  Gin drinks?  Vodka?  The creativity of the cocktails needs to expand to these other spirits.

Went on Christmas Eve, our first time at Nonna's, and had a great experience.  The food was great, definitely recommend the bisque and Chicken Marsala.  The ambiance was great... we had a chance to dine in the "wine cellar."  We'll definitely make this a regular when dining in West Chester.

*went here for dinner Friday* they have a large selection of sushi and sashimi to choose from. They also have. Hibachi section. I really enjoyed the deluxe sushi platter and you get a lot for what you pay for. Service was excellent. I would definitely recommend coming here for date night

Oh yes they came through again tonight with solid pizza, minimal crust, and great taste. I can't say enough about these guys. Nearly 10 years I think in Edmonton, I know previously St Paul. But yeah the cheese was oplenty. I had 2 10 inch 1 toppers. One with olives and the other with beef. Toppings were fresh and the beef was real.

Prices are different than posted inside the salon. The menu board said $5-$10 for a gel polish change but I was charged $18 ($3 to remove polish). And I ended up with polish on my finger tips. Nice, friendly service, but don't trust the menu prices posted.

I really wish this place was better organized. It's always chaotic and it seems like they're short of people. You have to repeat info over and over and over again. The prices are super high but that's not the location's fault. Enterprise's website needs big time help too. Still I come here because it's close to my mother's house.

I went here b/c after doing the arthritis walk,i really wanted an ice coffee,i went in and asked for pistachio ice coffee,guy looked at me like I was speaking Spanish,so I pointed to the picture behind him,tasted like a reg ,but service was quick and swiped my card like a pro.would have given a two but i haven't had better .

Two recommendations- treasure from the sea albacore seared, garlic ginger pepper ponzu is my favorite - could have eaten just that x 5- so delicate and bursting with flavor. Fire cracker Roll spicy scallops, cucumber, topped with spicy tuna and spicy sesame oil !!
Stop by !!!

I have only ordered the pizza here but it's my new favorite New Orleans pizza joint! The pizza crust here is amazing (like all the other reviews say)... it's thin yet chewy. The meats that they use are top notch and they run weekly specials to keep things interesting.

This is an average Anytime Fitness. Nothing fancy. Parking is an issue and they recently removed two parking spaces which has made the issue worse.  Oh but police officers can park their vehicle in one of those two spots. Also, the water fountain has warm water!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: We accidentally ended up at their new location when we were trying to go to another restaurant.  The food was overpriced and the service was horribly slow from every end.  They also failed to mention salads arent included and charged us 14 dollars for two side salads....i recommend going to a drive thru rather then going here

We did this last night and it was fantastic!  From the pleasant person on the phone who recommended "Grandmom's Pizza" (yah, do this, you won't regret it!) to the specialty dishes we had as entrees, everything was fresh and really tasty.  We will definitely eat here (well, takeout) again.  Keep up the great work DiCarlo's!!!

Have been at STH 4 times, all positive experiences, friendly waitress and excellent waiter (Gio).Love the Naked BLT salad, atmosphere was fine, have been there when a lot of people dining and a handful, and liked it. Best sports bar in town too with all the flat screens.

Overall very good to excellent. Nice patio seating. Good nigiri selection with the Tako and salmon being excellent this night. My wife enjoyed the crab puffs and tiger roll. Blue Man roll was tasty with a nice hint of cilantro. Not the best I've ever had but a solid meal in a great location.

Food is ok for Subway food. Problem I have is they close early all the time, talking like 2.5 hours early.....  Attitudes of employees is pretty horrible as well. That may be due to the fact that they have way too few employees working during busy times.  Probably won't be going back to this subway.

Visited the bar after seeing the bar rescue. Had the resurrection and love the cup. Drink was ok. Had the fried pickles and shrimp beignets, food was awesome. Sat by the door because the rest of the bar felt cluttered and dark. 4 stars for the cup and food. Just wish the bar was more inviting.

Very cute and trendy frozen yogurt joint but expensive and have a very limited selection of flavor. When I went last time they only had the basic flavors and less than 9 flavors. Ok if u want just strawberry or vanilla yogurt but not if u want more unique flavors.

For me, this cozy, authentic Italian restaurant hits high marks in every area. Food is fantastic, service excellent, location is perfect and atmosphere is everything I look for in a family owned restaurant. I happily drive here from Tampa for a good dining experience at every chance possible.

Place is OK not to much going on in this place . I will take in consideration it was a weeknight.  Bartender was  some what friendly seemed to be more concerned with regulars and friends then us .She only spoke with us when we were complimenting her. This is a small town bar . Don't expect much.

Over priced. And ordered a 9 ounce glass of wine and was handed about a 3-4 ounce. Politely asked if he was sure it was a 9 ounce glass and argued with us. I work at a restaurant and can tell you 100% that it wasn't a 9 ounce glass of wine. Extremely over priced a
but the food was good.

Eat here frequently as we live nearby. Not the highest quality but for Mexican food has been consistently good. Service is good and as expected. Dont drink alcohol so i cant comment on their drinks but they have a full bar. Seldom busy and have an outdoor area.

Went for an early dinner during the week and it was pretty empty when we arrived but was quite full by the time we left. The service was good and the food was great. The rustic decor is very nice. My only complaint is those orange metal chairs are REALLY uncomfortable!

My go-to spot when I want a solid cup of joe. Not too many options, no flavoring, nothing fancy - just quality, locally roasted coffee (check out their other location on Master Street, too!).

Whenever there's seating, it's also the perfect spot to stop in and get some work done!

If you're looking for a classic Italian restaurant, here's the place. Excellent menu. The best pizza on the beach, and a place favored by Pass-a-Grille locals, as well as regulars from all over. 

There's a welcoming family feeling at Gennaro's, and you'll find fancier restaurants but none friendlier. We''ll be back soon.

Delicious sushi and dumplings!! The Tokyo Roll and the dinosaur roll are our favorites. Spring rolls are just meh.
*edit* my husband says that I don't like spring rolls so I cannot be an authority on whether or not they are meh. But he assures me I am an authority on many other things and I agree

Good customer service, average list of drinks, terrible decor. Worst atmosphere I've experienced at a bar downtown in a while. It's like surf town meets neon cowboy with questionably furnished decor, and a modge podge of pop art and shitty folk expressionism. Weird vibes, man.

Usually this place is pretty good,  but lunch this week was disappointing.  Arugula and prosciutto  on Flatbread were off, and chicken on Cobb  salad was spongey. We will try them again- maybe it was just a bad day. Waitress  was very nice, and soups were good.

I couldn't finish my enchiladas because they were absolutely drenched in enchilada sauce and cheese. The texture and taste of it was ruined by all the goop. Also could have done without the giant heap of lettuce on top--I had trouble finding my food underneath!

While the tellers who do standard transactions are competent and polite, if you need to see a banker or other customer service person at a desk, forget it. They never have time for you. If they are on the phone, they won't even glance up and give you a nod or the "one moment" gesture. I hate this place.

Terrible customer service and attitudes. Asked for a signature item on their menu (31 below) and the employee asked me what that was....then proceeded to tell me for the fifth day in a row that they don't have soft serve ice cream. Not very helpful or kind.

Incredibly disappointing service. The hostess was not polite and waitress seemed put out when I asked for a cranberry juice. My wife and I both had the "buffet" The made-to-order omelette was very good, but the rest of the "buffet" consist of; scrambled eggs, bacon, sausage, some fruit and milk and yogurt. And it's $16.

I just went for few drinks in the bar area during the happy hour and to check out this new location.  They have pretty good selection of beer and the price is very reasonable, $3 for any beer on the menu. The appetizers were awesome. We had calamari scillion and it was soo good. Have to check out the dinner menu soon.

I tuened in a silk shirt for dry cleaning. They shrunk it two sizes. When I told them about it thay said sorry, it must have been bad material and there's nothing they did wrong. Not only is that wrong, it's just plain bad business. I will never use them again and I highly recommend that others don't either.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I don't know why this place doesn't have higher ratings. From food to service, this place is pretty solid. Price is also reasonable with the portion size.  Specialty rolls is around $10-14, while simple smaller rolls are $5+.  Unfortunately I didn't eat any raw items this time but the bf said the raw sushi was fresh and delicious.

I'm not sure the name of the lady that did my gel pedi and mani with tip/dip. She was exceptional. In a world that pays no attention to detail, she was exact opposite. Wish I knew who she was, my fault for not finding out. Kudos ma'am, thank you! And thanks Apex.

We've eaten here on several occasions now both lunch and dinner. We've had delivery and take out as well. The portions are large so plan to share. The pizza is always very good and the servers attentive and friendly. My favorite is the lasagna which is always fresh and very tasty!

I really don't wanna do mean reviews because at the end of the day, people work here and that's real. This food here is completely lackluster. And in a city like Philadelphia, that is pretty unforgivable. Seems like there's no passion in the kitchen. Food is expensive. Poor understanding of how to use ingredients.

Love this place and Tina is outstanding!
I wasn't in love with my nails from the gentleman at a prior salon and gave this place a try.
We removed the acrylic nails and now have the powder dip on my natural nail. So much better for the nail bed and looks outstanding!

The people were rude and not welcoming. We waited twice as long as we were told. My technician rushed the entire service and was very forceful. Not gentle or relaxing. Overpriced as well. Can get cheaper and better pedicures across the street. Will not be back.

Food is excellent. The only downsides are the price and portion of food. This place has great chicken parm, spaghetti, and lasagna. However, for the price I'm paying id expect portion sizes to be bigger (or at least have the meal come with a side salad that's not a la carte). Will definitely be coming back.

Horrible customer service. Got clothes back damaged at the hands of Milto cleaners. The owner admitted their wrong doing. Then tried to blame the damage on being pre-existing. Never will do business with this company again. Guess this is what you get when you pay minimum wage.. go to Tuchmans...
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Very friendly service. It was a 9 min walk from where I was staying. Convenient and clean. Only paper bags though, so bring your own bags if you'll be buying heavier items (e.g., apples, milk). Wish they had a larger vegetable selection but it was decent for a neighborhood grocer.

Good, but all the hype is silly.

The food was good and the service was  good (although a little too heavy handed).  There's nothing much to complain about, it's just that the place does not live up to its over-the-top reputation. Which is not its fault.

Enjoy it, but don't go crazy over it.

I was very impressed with this hotel. It was closest to the attractions and less expensive than others I looked at. Staff was great, room was clean and comfortable. Hotel restaurant was great! Only negative was the very small bathroom.  I would recommend this hotel to anyone who wants to be on the edge of everything.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Very spacious and the food appetizers were good. The waited mentioned they had 1/2 off at the time and I liked the fact she suggested that instead of something more expensive. Also had happy hour about the same time. The "monkey brain" was delicious and very generous portions

I came on Yelp to see the reviews before eating here. The reviews were correct about the Honey Hibiscus tea and the shrimp and crabmeat pizza. The service was excellent. I also had the eggplant as an appetizer and it was so good that I would have just ate as my entree. I would definitely recommend going

I love this place!!! There aren't any other places in the area that are as good for the price. There were many places mentioned in other reviews but they all end up costing more and can't compare with not only the quality of the food but also the friendliness of the staff. They have the best specials and ginger dressing!!

Finally tried this little restaurant and wasn't disappointed. Reason didn't give 5 stars was a little pricey, had enchiladas with rice and beans. Little serving of rice and beans, enchilada very good, chicken little dry but not deal breaker, mole sauce delicious. Overall good, recommend.

Delivery and deliciousness!!! Where can you get wood-fired that delivers? Ordered a Margarita pizza and the 4 cheese with sweet onion. SOOOOO good! How have I never gotten pizza from here before?And as bonus the girl who took our order on the phone was the nicest person ever, quite refreshing!!!!

This cute little place has all the ice cream flavors you can think of, many toppings and lots of yummy sundaes to choose from. It was very busy at 8 pm on Sunday, but the line moved fairly quickly and the staff was friendly. Great find in the Uptown neighborhood!

Idiots can't get an order right..it is their job to receive an order..when you ask for ..no this and no that..make it..and they fail right there..haven't been back since..i also may add I took the matter up with the night manager and realized I was just venting to an anal canal..
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Like so many we too  anxiouslyy  awaited the opening of Limoncello Chester Springs. We have had  dinner there twice, and frankly will not return. The staff couldn't be nicer, and the orders were filled promptly. In the end it all comes down to the food, which is at best mediocre

Must have changed hands. Different personnel - prices way higher. Been there twice in the past month and a half, both times disappointed in the service, selection and prices. It's a shame - County Beverage has been around for decades but it's going downhill.

Hertz is just so predictably bad, I don't know why I still occasionally rent cars here. The last time (in Bloomington, IN), I had a ridiculous long wait, and incompetent staff, and messed up car assignment. Hertz @ the St Louis airport proved to be a sorry repeat. Ugh.

The best sushi restaurant in Goleta, and one of my favorites in the Santa Barbara area.  Seafood always fresh and high quality.  Other non sushi dishes yummy as well. 
But the best part is whenever we are here as a family they take special care of the kids.

A great place to get your car fixed. There are quality mechanics such as Brian and the owner Kaleel. They ensure that your car is fixed with good parts and provide good advice for the proper maintenance of your car. Their prices are 95% of the time cheaper than their counterparts. Check them out if you want your car fixed right.

I hate coming to this place now that they got rid of the self checkout lanes and replaced them with the four "express lanes/15 items or less." They only ever have one maybe two (if you're extremely lucky) of those four lanes open and half the time the line is filled with people who have more than 15 items.

Bought a Living Social" deal.
Thought I give it a try .But after talking to Cynthia over the phone I decide not to go there. She said she was going to charge me extra because I have longer  hair and  "LS" takes most of her money.
Really? ........No really,really?
No thanks!

Ordered the Abbondanza meal for 4-6 people for a Father's Day celebration.  Antipasto, Fried Calamari, Penne Alla Vodka, Eggplant parm, Chicken Cacciatore and breadsticks.  We picked it up.  The service at the restaurant was friendly and efficient.  The food was plentiful and delicious!  Highly recommend their catering service!!

This evening the gent who took my order was cheery and smiling ear to ear. He thoroughly answered the  questions  that I had about The Mix burrito. 

My order was filled promptly and was double bagged for my bike ride home. 

Once home my burrito was still fresh and warm. It tasted great!!

Just went through Wendy's needed a quick lunch before going back to work this is the worst place I have ever eaten  if I'm not mistaken they opened at 10:30 I went through at 11 o'clock thinking maybe everything will be fresh wrong the burger was cold the fries were cold it was just gross never again will I go there

I started getting my groceries here due to its convenient location. The Whole Foods out on 86th is a bit of a hike, but offers more selection. It's a pricey grocery store. I haven't purchased any of their fresh produce, but they carry a good selection of organic brands in their packaged and frozen section.

Used to be good and clean, bathrooms this time were a disgrace. Paper all over the floor and stale smell that had not seen disinfectant for a while. Staff were walking by full trash cans in restaurant. Guy making our burrito was not clean.?Will never attend this place again.

Had a great meal with my hubby Guy and girlfriend Verenice. Our cashier was Omar. He was absolutely fantastic. We will be back because of his Welcoming and Charming Personality. It made the difference between an okay experience and an Excellent Experience.

Excellent food. Big portions. Super Delicious. They have free parking right across at the Galleria parking garage with a validation of your ticket. They charge for the chips and salsa, not complimentary. Atmosphere is interesting. A cross between Pizza Parlor lighting and subtle romance. Great Mexican Food.

We loved coming here. Apparently they have closed. We came by tonight for dinner and everything is gone inside. We ate here last week and asked how things were and was told everything was great they were even introducing new items.  Don't know what happened:(

We LOVE the Custard Station. The owner is wonderful, her employees are always patient- which can be rough on a busy night with a lot of indecisive custard lovers!! Their chocolate custard is truly delightful- and I honest to god have dreams about their drumsticks-  both the salted and the Heath!!! Yum!! Local jewel.

More times than not, the cooler is broken or not stocked, so room temp beer it is. One time the bouncer insisted on photocopying my ID, at which point I should have just left. The selection for your frat house brews is fine, but otherwise it's worth a trip to someplace better.

This place is amazing. Some of it is a little pricey but it's so fresh. The Liz roll is amazing for vegetarians and my husband loves the blue crab hand roll. Once Jimmy gets to know you he doesn't forget what you like. It's always crowded, and for good reason.

My husband and I went here for lunch to take advantage of the endless hibachi and sushi. It was a weekend afternoon and not too busy. The staff was friendly and the service was quick but the food was just mediocre. For the price it wasn't terrible but it would be worth going to one of the better sushi restaurants in town.

The doughnuts are really good here, they're always gone cuz they're so good.get up early so you can get the doughnuts you want.sell out fast.tried the new up and coming rise n roll not impressed at all. We compared to jacks to them. Jacks was a lot better a a lot bigger and cheaper. With jacks early bird gets the worm.

Went here for my boyfriends mini birthday dinner. Ambience was great. This place has indoor and outdoor seatings for when the weather is nice. The host and waitress were very welcoming. The food was ok, pasta red sauce was bland could use some pizazz. Looking forward to a better meal in the future.

If I was rating this solely on my meal the stars would be higher. .. unfortunately my husband's order wasn't as good as mine.  I had veggie mu shu... he had General's. Twice.  Neither time was bad by any means.  The food is fresh.  The service is very friendly. Ambiance is good.  Small mom and pop shop.  I will eat here again!

Lovely place in downtown- definitely more upscale and pricey but delicious! Went with a group of 7 and it was a great experience. The food is very well prepared and flavorful, and definitely worth the price. The staff is extremely helpful and polite. Definitely would recommend for a nicer dinner or lunch

I have been getting take out from Enzo's for years. Really good food and monster portions. I can eat several meals from one order..I have been through most of the menu and it is good. I cannot comment on anything that has fish or seafood in it, but it looks great.

Large parking lot. The place is clean with lots of seating. Serve yourself soda, tea, coffee station, and salsa bar with other condiments. Some items are a little pricey for fast food, but they do have some $5 box meals that includes alot of food. The people are friendly. The food came out hot, and overall decent.

Came here twice with my sister and her son and granddaughter,  the place was clean and the people were friendly. Both times we went, had the chicken piccata with fettuccine alfredo combo. The salad was crisp and cold, the chicken and pasta were hot and tender, plus you get a drink from the soda machine 100+ choices??

First problem get rid of the picture of wings. Some look like they were eatin!!! We ordered mushroom/pepperoni pizza. We got plenty of mushroom and 4 pieces of pepperoni!! Large pizza plain was good. 3 orders of wings DRY!!! 3 orders of wings and 2 3oz cups of blue cheese.

Lacked ambiance and parking was a challenge.  However, I did like it was byob because there is a liquor store across the street.  The rolls were overpriced, however, they tasted fresh.  Yes the rolls were basic but they were good.  Not the best but better than seiko!

I gave up on this Dunkin. They screw up my order every time: no/wrong flavoring, insufficient cream, or the cream tasted spoiled. Twice the iced coffee made me sick. I was so excited for this Dunkin close to my home but will find another coffee shop that's actually competent.

A friend that was staying here invited me, I thought yeah, airport hotel yada-yada.  But staff treated me well.  I hung out at the hotel bar.  Prices were reasonable.  I ordered the loaded potato skins, THEY WERE EXCEPTIONAL.  Some of the best I've ever had.  Reward this staff with your business.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My experience at this byob was super good!  The entire experience from online reservations, exceptional customer service and wonderful food will be real hard to beat.  Frank is a super wonderful owner/host who exudes personable attention to each guest.  I will most definitely be back with family and friends. Awesome! Ciao!

Very good place to rent car. No problems what so ever. I have found every person who works here, both professional and very friendly, and always had a smile. Came to pick me up right on time for rental. Very busy place also. Thank y ou Enterprise. This is the company for my go to car rental.

Stayed while attending a conference.  Rooms were comfortable and quiet but a fire alarm went off at 3 am.  The main bar was a great socializing point and bar food was typical fare. A bit of a walk to Reading Terminal. Conference venue and food were good.  Recommended.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Overrated.  Have been here twice, once for plain pizza and once for stromboli.  Both times the pizza was nothing special and cold (even though they said it would be ready in 20-30 min and I showed up at 15).  Dough is pretty good, but not enough to make me go back again.

Stopped in approximately 7:15am to order a green tea. The cashier stated they were out of both varieties of green tea.

...What? How does that happen? Tea packets are the cheapest thing to stock and store. I drove down the street to the other Starbucks and ordered without any issue.

This place is falling apart which is a shame because it has so much potential. Our chef did absolutely none of the cool fire tricks that the kids love :/. Food was decent but our waitress was horrid. Bathroom toilets moved back and forth an inch and had water seeping out underneath. I'd stay away from here.

Make no mistake, this is HANDS DOWN the worst McDonald's you'll ever visit, if you decide not to heed the countless warnings above and below this one. Do yourself a favor and just go to the location at 2400 W Oregon Ave., it's literally 5 minutes away and 110% better.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: My daughter went here with a pub crawl on the weekend, bartender TOOK her $20 for 2 drinks and refused to give her change. When asked for the change the short brunette told her it was a tip and refused to give her any money back. Pushy bartender should be fired!!

Very good wings. Great TV set up with all NFL games on Sunday.  Cool game room right next door with all games on 
Downside. Very limited menu.  
Little too Pricey on appetizers 
$8.99 for regular size fries with gravy that tastes like bottle from Publix. ??

Good price, decent equipment.

 Nobody tells customers to rerack weights, or reracks the weights themselves at the end of the night. New people wouldnt know gym etiquette because the staff rarely practices it.

Machines are dirty, even for a gym.

They care more about selling personal training and getting new members.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The food is disguisting. I have never seen such a bunch of lazy managers like this store. All they do is sit on there phones all day. Try working for a change...everything is frozen and microwaved just about...employees come in stinking of weed. Never have had a decent meal there yet. Even Burger King is better than this place
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The nails turned out ok. The service was good. The issue here is that they really up-charge your manicure. What was supposed to be a $12mani ended up being a $24. I left feeling cheated. For almost that price you could get gel or something more then a basic manicure.

Staff is very good.  I ordered a small Tropical slushy drink for the walk on Bourbon in the middle of the day. Perfect!  I didn't dare go near those hand grenade drinks - I saw what it did to those people walking around with those green glasses in their hands.  LOL

Went to Collingswood Veterinary for 20+ years without a problem! Then, new doctor bought practice and treats customers with indignation and disgust. Many employees left when he took over. Staff turnover has been like a revolving door. I miss Dr. Self and Dr. Tara!!

I love this place. I usually get a bagel there once a week and it's the most inexpensive bagel I've ever come across ($1.35) and it's PERFECTLY toasted and buttered. Also comes with a napkin which is thoughtful-unlike Manhattan bagel- twice as expensive, always burnt and no napkin. The employees are super nice as well.

Blah.... vegetarians and vegans not the place for you. Oh and you can't trust the menu said our waiter after meals came out without promised items. Drinks are strong though... meat lovers this is your place. Crowded. Bathroom eek! Make reservations at your own risk. Great people watching.

Cheap and good.  Not good in a healthy way but good in a buttery, thick, shiny, sweet and salty way.  It's a very standard if not well-worn diner.  It's the kind of place where your heavily tattooed waiter, upon realizing he forgot your ketchup, will slap you on the shoulder and say, "Hang on bro, I gotcha.". And that's OK.

The ice cream is my favorite.  It rates a 5+. The service is not good at the Factory which is a shame.  When my husband questioned the server, she had a  bad attitude. It think these young people need training on providing good and polite customer service.

I am hard pressed to name a better pizza place in Phoenixville. Crust is on the thin side, fresh and chewy. Their specialty pizzas are fantastic and ingredients are always fresh. My favorite is the Eggplant Parm pizza. 

Paninis are always very good and my sons love the Fried Chicken sub. Great...now I'm hungry.

Awful!!  heard this was one of the best restaurants in St. Louis and naught!!  The cannelloni is fair and the Veal Chop with Eggplant tasted like bad pizza.  Their signature dish of linguine with Lobster and Shrimp had no flavor. Joe took care of us we ordered all the dishes he raved about and none were good.

We ordered two ice cream cones for kids and the woman who looked like a grassy bridge troll came to the window holding two mutilated ice cream cones and said "I'm bad at making ice cream cones" we smiled and said thank you but secretly wished she could master the art of ice cream twirling as it is her job.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: A rude young African American girl gave me tude bc I had to ask her to remake a child size ice cream cone. Her corny dude conworker laughed at me for making the request. I don't understand how they don't understand what a child size ice cream cone is compared to a huge adult sized one. Behavior was rude from both.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Wish all businesses still operated this way.  Great service, very honest, extremely quick and the price was much less than what I was quoted over the phone at other businesses.  I will return for all of my exhaust issues in the future and will recommend them to any friends or family needing this type of repair.

We went here for lunch. I ordered an enchalada and my husband ordered the 2 taco lunch special. The salad that came with his meal was not good, it tasted like it was out of the bag and they just threw some pre shredded cheese on it. My Enchilada meal was literally a plate of cheese. Not yummy. I won't be back

I'm a recent fan of this wonderful restaurant.  I had no idea it was there (and I've been living here for years).  I do recommend going on a week night if you'd like great service.  It gets too busy on weekends (because it's so good!!!). 

The service, food, atmosphere, and location are the best!  I go at least once/week now.

I gave a three-star rating as I actually did not have a chance to eat at this restaurant today but I did once in the past and it was OK. I purchased the $10 for $20 Yelp deal with all intentions of going there for lunch. When I arrived, the doors were locked with a For Rent sign on the door. Now I have to get my money back.

Went to UCSB for graduate school. This place has the best food EVER. We ate here weekly! What a diamond in the rough! Everything here melts in your mouth. Now that I've moved I wish they would put one where I live! I can still taste those chicken sandwiches!

I've tried this place a handful of times over the past few years and every time I leave a little disappointed. The food is ok, not the best Italian in the area. They have great toasted raviolis but other than that I don't see the hype. I'd rather go to another restaurant in the area

First time ordering from this place.   The last time.  Ordered  ribs and It had so  much red sauce it was  on edible.    Ribs had too much fat   Rice was ok but never again. Quality was not  good.  Take out is not what it use to be.
People seem to be giving us leftovers.

The food had no flavor & what they had for hot sauce was a joke.  On top of that the girl taking our order did not understand or speak English very well, we asked if the chicken in the burrito was grilled & she said yes but what we got was boiled overlooked shredded dry chicken.  I will take my business elsewhere.

This was our second visit to this establishment.  Good sashimi both times and nice atmosphere.  Both times there was only one waitress but they handled the service professionally.  Price was fair and quality good.  Most likely this is now our favorite Tucson sashimi source.

My wife and I have eaten here a few times, either sitting in the front for a quick slice or in the back for a full meal. Every time we've been here the food has been excellent. Pizza is very good as well as the Italian dinners. I've had the Gnoccis and the Spaghetti and meatballs, both excellent dishes. I will continue to return.

This place is amazing! Every time I went, they took their time and pampered you in the way you should. They really really take their time. Other places rush bc they are so busy and just do a crappy job on your nails.  Really recommend this place! And the spa pedicure is a must!!

This motel is vastly superior to the Holiday Inn next door.  The rooms were quite adequate and had a mini-fridge and a microwave.  The pool was fine and the hot tub was large.  Free hot breakfast was just OK.  No attached restaurant, but that was fine too.  

I'd stay here again in a minute.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Stayed here a second time.  Really enjoyed the hot tub and pool area this time.  Did I mention the warm chocolate chip cookies around dinner time.  I'd stay here anytime.

The only negative to report is that the hot breakfast is essentially identical every day.  Would it kill them to change it up a little bit?
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This is great new place! The salsa is excellent, and my whole meal was delicious. I am from West Texas so I have high standards with Mexican food. This place is above par for Florida. If you live in the St. Pete area and want to enjoy some good Mexican food, try Santa Fe Grill!

Way too overpriced. The service is ok- they've adjusted my glasses a few times on the spot.....but If you look around the web- you find all the same frames for much cheaper- and bring them in somewhere to get the prescription filled for cheaper as well. The eye exam is pretty pricey too. Look elsewhere unless money's not a concern.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
I just moved here. Called to ask if any one would be able to work with my hair needs. I only require a certain brand FRAMESI. I was told, without be listened to, No thank you. And they hung up on me.
I could not go to this salon after such blatant bad phone etiquette.
Sorry guys, you must already have enough clients.

Pretty good but they used an almost teriyaki type sauce on some of our rolls that was a bit too sweet and unexpected.  Love sitting outside and getting the fresh air here.  Also, loved their miso soup.  The volcano cake appetizer was not the best- there was too much salmon as compared to scallops on it.

LOVE the omega 3 roll.

It's a great, friendly, comfortable, consistent local neighborhood spot for breakfast or lunch or even dinner. Its simple but yummy. Really enjoyed salads, sandwiches, burgers here so far. We don't have any complaints at all.  The food and service and atmosphere is perfect for what it is- a yummy casual local neighborhood hang out.

I ordered the california roll and the sweet potato roll as a lunch special which are served until 3 pm. The lunch special included soup and salad. Both were delicious.  The sweet potato rolls were so good. I preferred them to the california roll. The server was polite. I had a nice dining experience.

For the 3rd time in a row, I paid for extra dipping sauces and Papa John's failed to give me the extra dipping sauces in my delivery.  I won't be ordering Papa John's ever again.  In addition to ripping me off by charging me for things I don't receive, the quality of food and service has gone downhill in recent years.

Okay place for a beer, but the food is just okay.  If you go, stick with typical bar food like wings.  My son ordered a burger that was so rare it was raw inside.  Then when he got it back, it was well done. We have been three times because we wanted to give it a fair shot, but will probably not go back for dinner.

Not the best pizza, but Matteo's gets four stars from me for being enlightened enough to sell gulten and dairy free pizzas. It is nice of you to go to the trouble for the occasional person who has allergies. Its rerfreshing to find a business that does things for good measure that aren't related to a buck.

This is my favorite Starbucks location in all of SJ and Philadelphia. Outdoor seating is a very enjoyable feature, and the interior is spacious and inviting. Have never experienced a bad barista here. There are two bathrooms with average cleanliness. Speed of drive through seems on par with other Starbucks.
