Walked in for lunch one afternoon. They only offer one basket of free chips to their customers per policy was told .  Food was just ok, service was ok. But there are so many other
Mexican restaurants around town that are ok but serve unlimited chips to their customers.

I highly recommend the spinach ricotta dolce pizza, it's outta this world!!! Pomodoro romano pizza is really good too. Don't expect too much aside from pizza at this place though. Tried ordering a salad last time I called and he practically laughed me off the phone!

Not a bad McD's, but not a great one, either. Food was as expected, staff was mixed with some not too interested in much of anything and a manager doing her best to take care of everyone. Crowd was a bit sketchy for 2 PM on a Saturday. At 2 AM I expect it, but for the middle of the afternoon it all felt a bit...off.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Below average friendliness, though not rude; absolutely snail-like speed of service. I've been to this location multiple times and it's always slow. I felt like a transaction, and not a very high-priority transaction at that. 

The food was what you'd expect.

Warm night.  Generous samples given.  I was in search of a stand-out ULTRA-flavor.
I prefer a frozen ice cream.
This was melty, almost liquid ice cream.
Very costly.  Excessively sweet. 
For me, no stand-out ULTRA-flavors.
More affordable and better tasting flavors are abundant elsewhere.

Update, sadly...the shelves are getting bare and it looks like this location might be closing. 
----
I've been shopping at Breaux Mart since I first got my drivers license and my mom would send me with a list and a blank check to the long gone location on Gen. Meyer.

ZERO STARS! Unless you want to get hit up with scam damage claim, DO NOT RENT FROM THIS LOCATION!!! Smiles and lies, lies, lies. That's what they are all about. They lied over the phone when I was arranging the rental, then they told a fabricated story to the corporate claim people and then they lied to me again.

I just recently had a private party at Stella Sera and everything was perfect.  The food was delicious, the presentation was wonderful, and the service was impeccable.  The owners did everything possible to ensure that everyone had an amazing experience.  I would highly recommend this restaurant.

Good affordable hotel in center of Bourbon St.  Balcony rooms are great if you plan to only sleep in daylight hours.  Noise from bourbon st goes until around 5am.  Most rooms share a balcony which is also strange to me.  4th floor is nice and quiet but you can't see the street bc of balconies  below.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place is one of the best lunch options in the area. It's better than a Chipotle and about as good as a Qdoba, better if you're the kind of person who likes supporting local business. I recommend the pork. They've also got really good chocolate chip cookies.

Went for the 1st time yesterday. Good service and great spot in Downtown Tampa. I had the 3 tacos combo and I was a little dissapointed. The food was blend and the tortilla chips to hard to chew ( I tought they were going to break my teeth).  First and last time.

We met a client here for dinner who was staying there on Business.  We were underwhelmed with the service we got in the lounge/bar area.  Service was hard to get and not very friendly at all.  The food was just OK.   Apparently, the rooms need to be remodeled here.
The food was just ok.    For a Marriott, this missed the mark.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Jake's Pub is like a hot ex: No matter how many times you have been burnt, you will always return due to the convince and familiarity. Probably been there 300+ times, but I will say after they banned Matt Johnson from entry, the place went down hill and the demise became more evident.

I really enjoyed my experience with big brand for my oil change. Even though it's a busy service station all the employees work together to get the customer in and out in a professional considerate manner. I trust them with my vehicle and I know they are doing a good job. Thanks for good service!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I've been coming to Barber ND for over a year because Nicole is the most consistent barber/stylist I've ever been to. I used to have a regular stylist and they were hit or miss, but Nicole gets it right every time. She takes her time and is a perfectionist who makes sure you love the way you look. Highly recommend!

Ok so we're snowed in and decided to order out and have this place a shot because of their name and honestly it isn't! Cheesesteak was dry,and French fries were soggy not crispy! Pizza was ok and they also messed up our order! Never again will we order from here!

i absolutely love this place the entire staff is SO PROFESSIONAL and they are all VERY WELL EXPERIENCED!!!!! i do not go anywhere else for nails, eyes, and my toes. tina and billy are awesome people and they make everyone feel like family when they walk in the door

Update...
Josh from Sears called today and apologized for his co-workers actions. I was very satisfied with his quick response and insurance to providing coaching to Mike. He was very accommodating and I will continue to use their services.  Thank you Josh.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Consistently get the wrong order in drive-thru.  Need to repeat order at the order station because servers are having three other conversations with other people so they can't hear accurately.  One pump of flavoring ordered does not mean three.  Pretty simple concept.

I have gotten several pedicures here in the past, and they did a really good job. But when they charged my mother the same price for a basic pedicure as they charged me for a basic pedicure with two designs, I couldn't return. I referred my mom to them and she was overcharged, that's unacceptable!

We ordered a margharita pizza. Very nasty. Thick doughy uncooked crust with a few slices of cheese with dark brown pieces of basil (it also smelled like stinky feet). Delivery guy was very sweet,so the star is for him. Pricing on their website was also not correct. The pizza was actually $15.50 not the $14.00 stated on the website.

Awesome awesome awesome!! We stopped here after the botanical garden and we are so glad we did! The ice cream was delicious. The sherbet was divine. The service was top notch. You can't ask for more then that from an ice cream parlor. Has that old time shop feel. The kids loved it and so did we!

Ice cream and milkshakes good, service poor.   Waited on by a young man, who either had friends/or coworkers visiting.  In between our orders he would get sidetracked talking to his friends.   Very unprofessional.  After reading reviews, this looks like a common complaint. Sizes of scoops were good, great variety of flavors.

I came here for the all you can eat sushi. It was definitely worth the 21.99. Really great selection with all the usual favorites plus a few unexpected items. Also plenty of fish-free items to choose from for those who shy away from raw fish. I loved the special rolls! I hope to go back again soon.

I love the pizzas here. The place is away from the touristic area, and you can tell the locals really enjoy this place, because it's always packed. If the weather is nice, the terrace is the place to eat. I've been here twice with my wife and both pizzas we ordered were excellent (pepperoni and arugula+prosciutto).

Similar to others comments...it's a DD and some times it's good and other times it's just okay. Orders right and at times it's wrong. I'll continue going here since it's around the corner and the coffee is priced right. Just keep the donuts fresh and in stock.

New Year's eve at a nice local Italian Restaurant. The good: Gwen, probably our best waitress in 2013. A great sense of humor and very attentive. My Chicken...really good, would order anytime. The fair: everything else. I'll try this restaurant again, but not too quickly.

Went there for the first time tonight place is very dated and small the customer base is mainly seniors,if you are a regular they are friendly with you and make you feel at home first timers are given the cold shoulder,entrees are average20.00 each with limited deserts.Much nicer and friendlier places for a lot less money.

Been twice, food was just ok. Way too expensive for what you get. Be careful what extras you ask for, sour cream is $2 for a small ramekin, guacamole was $3. That makes for some pretty expensive tacos. Much better options on 4th street in St Pete, and much better mexican food nearby for less money.

Good customer service. However, not impressed at all with the pedicure. The pedicure was short, no attention to my cuticles, and definitely didn't get the good scrub down that you would want with a pedicure. Not sure about their fills/manicures since I was so disappointed with the pedi I just cancelled my fill.

I don't drink anymore but I was buying some alcohol for a holiday party that my husband and I were throwing and just have to say, this place is beautiful inside, the people who work here are extremely nice and helpful, and they have a cute dog that hangs out at the shop! Always a bonus.

Great location.  1 Block from Ryman Auditorium and 2 from Broadway. Great bars right across street in Printers Alley.  My corner room was updated and very modern.  valet service and front desk were very helpful.  On the nicer side of the typical Courtyard property.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Interesting rolls and a good beer selection. Spicy tuna roll and salmon roll not the best, have had better almost everywhere I've been for sushi. Don't think I would go again, but they did have good ice cream. Maybe would try different dishes that aren't sushi if I ever went back. Going to stick to my holy grail in philly.

Ive been told 5 (yes five) different times that they are out of white bread.  And each time it was around 5pm.  And on 2 different occasions I was told there was no white bread because they needed to bake some.  
Staff has been either rude or apathetic.

Spend your money with someone else who might appreciate it.

Waited for 25 minutes and not a single person waited on us. No waters. No menus. Nothing. They weren't short staffed. There was a table of workers sitting down eating casually. Terrible service. Got the attention of two waiters and both looked in our direction and did nothing. WASTE OF TIME. WASTE OF LIFE.

The pizza was just ok at best.  We ordered the works.  The crust was pretty good.  Unfortunately,
there wasn't a lot of toppings on the pizza except for the over abundance of onions. Also, the sausage was missing.  May try them again for other items.  Hope it's better than the pizza.

This is not your run of the mill pizza place. Custom pizzas to your liking. As someone who is gluten free, I thought that my days of enjoying pizza were over. But Snap not only has a GF pizza crust, they have a cauliflower crust which is to die for! It's also family very friendly.

We came here for a few drinks. They have a few decent specials if you want to save a buck. Plenty of TV's. Great sports bar atmosphere. Plenty of different liquors and good selection of beers. Jared was a great bartender, I would recommend as a good bar between high end and dive, will be back.

Best nail salon in the area. My is so nice. The place is clean and the prices are good. The pedicure is great, worth the extra money for the deluxe. If you have any problems with their work just let My know, she is all about customer service and making sure you are happy.

Terrible service. They're condescending and downright rude, what a shame. I used to love this location, but since they hired new staff, it's quality ha significantly gone down. Will drive the extra miles to another location and might even give Starbucks less than a mile a way a shot.

Pricey, pricey, pricey!   Make no mistake about it, the food is really, REALLY good. We ate once on our own and then for a few sponsored events. But we can't justify spending so much on a regular basis. We seek out the bargains in this town, and there are plenty of them.

Explained to the hairdresser exactly what I wanted and she basically gave my long haired boy an 80's mullet. He is 3 and a half and sat still the entire time thanks to the entertainment.

Pretty much "weed-wacked" his hair. Hair grows, oh well, but I won't be coming back.

Suprisingly good experience. Good Midtown location. Staff was 5 stars. Breakfast was better than most complimentary breakfasts who just serve carbs. Nice fruit and protein selections. Room, fitness center and pool were nice. For value, safety, convenience and relaxation you can't beat it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I have eaten at Taqueria del Sol three times now and have no complaints.  Not fancy, but the food and drinks are good.  The Texas Margarita is great and so is the roasted chicken enchilada.  
If you are looking for a fairly inexpensive, no frills meal, it is a great little place.

Disappointed in the service. The food was good casual fare.  Went there Saturday night with the family. Waited 10 min until our server came over to take our drink order.  The place had a lot of servers walking around but none were ours and it was not crowded.  This extremely slow wait continued throughout the meal.

This Wendy's is right by my house.  I love wendys, but my last 3 visits the fries were cold and mushy and mt burger smashed, my nuggets no sauce.  This used to be my favorite Wendy's but unfortunately the disservice the last 3 weeks has caused me to not want to go here anymore and will drive further to another Wendy's

This place was simply awful it took 25 minutes to get a drink, at 2 in the afternoon on Friday.  The server s were being gawked at and talking to all of the regulars, and the place was filthy dirty. No food at a beach bar is i same to me.  The servers were not friendly at all only to the male customers.  I will never be back

The food here is normally good, with fresh out of the fryer fries being offered more often than not.  The dining room could be a bit cleaner, but that's a common complaint when it comes to cheap fast food establishments.  All in all, this McDonald's location is alright.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: A cheesy minimum spend is required to dine in, a fake "washroom broken" sign is up to keep the riffraff out of the johns, and the food is uninspiring.  I know that it has to be harder to run a restaurant around there, but even taking that into account, I am unlikely to return.

Cold, overcooked fries.  Warm, overcooked burger patties.  Sketchy loiterers.  Filthy dining room.  They should be ashamed.  When will McDonald's Canada corporate head office sort out these disastrous Edmonton-area locations?  Standards seem to be near non-existent at some of them.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I came back again, but the second time wasn't a charm.  A lady cut my hair on my return visit and symmetry doesn't appear to have been part of the deal.  It'll grow out, yes, but when you're paying $25 plus tip for a simple mop chop, you expect better.  I'll pass on this place from now on.

Food quality has become a problem again at this location.  Lately, staff members there seem incapable of properly cooking the fries for which McDonald's is famous.  They seem to be overcooking them to the point where they are unpleasant to eat.  Not recommended until they fix this problem.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
My haircut was noticeably uneven the day after when I was trimming up my sideburns.  Meh.  For $20 plus tax and tip, I expect better.  

Barber on Whyte offers pleasant staff and surroundings, but the cut is what counts at a barber shop.  This is a big ol' Whyte Ave pass for me from now on.

The restaurant has been here for a while but they continue to get better and better. Large outdoor seating area and spacious indoor area as well to accommodate social distancing. And then there is the food. Fantastic menu with lots of options for every palate. Highly recommend.

You can't beat this spotless new place for an airport stay. The shuttle drivers are awesome. Everything inside is new and attractive. The front desk was friendly and speedy. I hate for everyone to find out how nice this place is because the wonderful prices will go up! Oh well.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This was our first time here. I had a soup called Cocido. Wow, tastes like homemade. My wife had a chicken taco salad. Delicious! I will be back just for the Cocido, But we are gonna come back and try some other interesting sounding dishes as well. What a nice hidden gem this place is!

Baked bread appetizer was excellent. Farm house salad also very good. Pizza, meh. We will come back and try a pasta dish or sandwich. Would come back but not for the pizza. If you like the artisan style of pizza you will probably enjoy it, I prefer a traditional crust. Staff was nice and friendly.

Small and I recommend setting a reservation if you go between 7:00 - 8:00 most nights. The atmosphere is nice, the service and food is very good however I don't recommend bringing small children. Very happy with the price for the quality of the overall experience. BYOB so if you want a drink don't forget to bring it.

Rude rude rude.  The servers run their mouths over how irritating guests are. While I know they're venting, none of it was called for.  Also there is no out seating despite their patio. If you're looking for sushi, just find somewhere else or get it to go and don't bother with the service.

One of the best spots on Main Street. Although a little pricey, Derek's never disappoints. Perfect for date night. 

The wait staff is always friendly. There is a good variety of menu items, and they offer BYOB-- with the stipulation that you pay a $10 corkage fee on weekends. 

I highly recommend the salmon and asparagus risotto.

A very special lady works here. Her name is Lourdes and she noticed me struggling while trying to bring in all my laundry. Just having a right hip replacement surgery and needing a left hip replacement is limiting my abilities. She came outside and brought my laundry in and helped me. She is the best!!!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: These guys are exceedingly slow and brusque and rude! Do not recommend this location! The line isnt long but the wait times are horrendous.  It should not take 20 minutes to get a simple latte.  I ordered amd finished my shopping in Frys and when I came back, I *still* had to wait 5 minutes.

Awful service. Drive thru is always backed up and they ask you to hold everytime you pull up to speaker, no matter how many people are in line. Myorder was wrong once, and had to go inside to get refund and got MAJOR ghetto attitude from the cashier. I only goto this McDs now for the occasional coke. Terrible, SLOW service.

This is our neighborhood choice and we've eaten there several times and not had any problems. This last time we got a flatbread club and the bread fell apart because it was so dry. Made an awful sandwich. We'll try again but want people to watch out for the flatbread...

The pizza is ok, it's a typical pizza place menu. Satisfies your carb cravings at an affordable price. However, what is with this restaurant closing so early? I wanted to order dinner, so I looked up their hours, and found that they close at 8.45pm! That's a bit too early, even on weekends, especially being next to a movie theater.

The food is great, but they are extremely slow and disorganized. Call to place your order, wait at least 30 minutes before going to pick it up, and double check before you leave. Avoid the busy times, like Saturday nights, too. Judging the food and portions, though, China House ranks very high for me.

Sushi Land is our go to sushi place. The food is consistently good and the staff always nice. We wandered in when we first moved here and have been returning for seven years. The salad dressing is sesame based and a great reason to eat lettuce. It is a great neighborhood place.

Has many beer choices that are only available at bar that were served in unclean glass.

Wine pour was very small for the large price.

Restroom appears to have been cleaned last week my shoes stick for a moment with every step '' heavy pee smell all the way home''

I would go here again if I became a drunk with very low standards.

Silly girl. She came and emptied the tip jar probably because I was sitting about 6 feet away while waiting for my food. Lol I found that amusing because there was only a little bit of change in there. I noticed when she emptied the change into her hand. I'm Glad I didn't add my change to the jar.  And I was against the T wall too.

Chose this hotel through a conference website because it looked more interesting than some of the other options. I was enormously disappointed that the view from my room was of the hotel lobby. Note that some rooms lack views with any natural light. Hoping to escape the WI winter for a few days so my room was a big disappointment.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The owner is really unfriendly unless you are hispanic.It seems if you are caucasian she is rude.Wait that is if you are a woman.She fired a woman in her 70's that had worked here for almoat 10yrs.The place is cleanbut 6 buxks for a wash that's kind of high.Even rho it's really convient i will fo out my way just because of service.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Not one of my favorite Italian spots. I'm not sure if they had a different chef that night, but the food I ordered wasn't very good. Spaghetti was more watery than ever. But our service was pretty good, and she was very nice and didn't rush us to hurry up and order.

New to the area, been here twice so far and both times very good! Salsa has good flavor, so many places are almost a bowl of puréed tomatoes. My Dad was in town and got his favorite, shrimp cocktail...said was best he has ever had. Very friendly staff too. Will definitely be back!

The roast chicken is to die for! Food and service are both excellent. The restaurant is small and fills up fast, so reservations are best. However, if you have time, put your name on the list and have a drink next door at Sasha's while you wait for a table.

Extremely good po boys. 
(I was tempted to give this place a 5, but lets just say 4.5)

It's in a slightly shady location, and I don't know if I'd want to be hanging out outside the place at night, but that said some of the best  boys I've had in the city were at Soprano's.

I walked in this dump with my family. ..... the overwhelming sewage smell hit me like a back draft! We looked at the menu before we decided if we would stay. .... the prices are OUTRAGEOUS! We turned around and walked right out.  From the sounds of the other reviews the food isn't great so I'm happy I didn't waste my time or money!

I had dabbled in Crossfit type workouts for a while and decided to give Crossfit Forte a try.  Evan and Katelyn both are very good at teaching proper technique in order to insure a safe workout in a very positive environment.  I highly recommend Crossfit Forte regardless of your current fitness level.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Love giving business to local places that truly appreciate their customers! This little place is the epitome of hands-on owners treating their customers like family.  All 6 of us loved our meals, and with soup, salad and bread, we were full by the time our delicious meals arrived.  It's byob, which is always a plus.

I enjoyed most of the sides. I like the pepperoni roll which was different from anything else I've had before. Lots of pepperoni. I highly recommend. The garlic knots were very garlicky which I also enjoyed. Pizza was not bad.  We got it to go. I also had the Caesar salad which was large and tasty. I recommend.

The food may be ok, in fact, it might be great. My friend and I had to leave very quickly though. Once we sat down, we noticed a REALLY strong smell. It smelled like mildew inside. I think it's just because the restaurant is old. The ambience kind of killed it for us.

It just is not that good.

They charge too much for what you do get.

It is the sort of place that I go to once a year because I always have a bad experience.

Milkshakes & cheese fries are pretty good. Chicken fingers not bad. I would stay away from the salads.

Anthony was my barber and had no clue what he was doing.  I showed him exactly what I wanted, and he made me look terrible!  I had a really nice beard before this and now it looks JACKED.  Did I mention his hands shook and his fingers were in my eyes and mouth?  I would NOT ever come here again.

disgusting! a simple blt was the greasiest coldest thing i ever ate. my husband got a roast beef bacon n it was cold n bacon was almost non existent. Curly fries were like yesterdays. oh and the cashier needed training. he blamed his mistakes on the manager and manger let him talk disrespectful. awful awful...

Wow, very impressed. The best cappuccino I've ever had. This guy knows what he's doing! Great bold coffee flavor, perfectly balanced with the milk. 

Price is comparable to Starbucks but so much better and great to support a local business. 

Will be back to try the variety of teas and other coffees.

We agree with another post. Food is super hot but lacks flavor. The item we had that was ok were the  dumpling but they were only ok. Our chicken cashew had no flavor and shrimp egg foo young not so great either. Also, this place geared for take out not sit down.

My husband and I ate here today. The food is always good, but the lunch special is no longer special - no soup and egg roll. The price is higher and the portion is smaller on a smaller plate.  There is more rice though!  $9.50 for Kung Pao and $10.95 for Mongolian Beef. Come on PF Changs.

I eagerly anticipated the opening of this location..and they did not dissapoint! Always fresh, hot and giant portions. The seasoned fries are definitely a highlight, and the small size is big enough for 2 to share. Great customer service here too...just all around one of the best burger joints in town!

Our first time here and the food was....okay.  Mediocre at best.  I had the cheese ravilol.   It looked as if it was under the heat lamps for too long.  It was dried out.  The hostesses were at a table behind us cackling throughout our entire meal.  Service was slow for an empty lunch time service.

The inn features a great pool,laundry,vending machines and very eclectic furnishings in the rooms no two are alike. The rates are low and the staff is friendly also very close to Carpinteria itself. I've stayed here several times and will again on my next visit to this area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Flies all over and even though it wasn't crowded it took 10 minutes for someone to come to the register to help me and waited an additional  30+ minutes for my food and all I ordered was a sausage mcmuffin meal. And after all that I had to get out of my car and go back in because they forgot the hashbrown.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: awesome food, huge menu, pleasant atmosphere. love the pizza and pizza sauce, garlic bread, spaghetti, and burgers. honestly, everything tastes good. service is pretty solid though it can be a bit slow when its busy. however, everyone is nice and its a great mom and pop place. highly recommended.

Told the delivery man my order wasn't correct. I was missing two things. Called and asked them to send the delivery man back with the rest of my order and the guy on the phone was rude loud and he said he not coming back that way. So I'm out of food and money.

Little pricy but room was clean and very nice beautiful views out front and back. I personally had no problems with staff at all. All and all one of the nicer places around here definitely would stay again and recommend to anyone looking to stay here. Not to mention your right in downtown Dunedin!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Patriots won the Super Bowl, so I needed a man trim to make a statement about the big win! Heather dialed me in with the sick cuts, it's no barber shop with a beer or scotch and a tight fade but for $15 can't beat it! I tipped her twenty for hour she spent on this design.

Me and my girls stopped at Joe's Pizza around midnight on a Sat night and were not disappointed.  The Pizza is tasty with a great sauce and the service is great.  Eddie hooked up our pizza with expertise and a smile.  I seriously recommend trying this spot out.

I will not return to this location. I contacted the manager in regards to a poorly made pizza I received, he replied to my online inquiry but never followed through on taking care of things. I even sent a photo to prove that the appearance of the pizza was not acceptable, and I never heard back from him.

I've been taking our cars here for several years as soon as they're off warranty. Good quality work at a better price than the dealer.
Just before Christmas my oil pressure sensor sprung a leak. They got me in next day and had it fixed faster than what was expected.
Definitely a thumbs up from us.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
A burger joint that's got free peanuts while you wait?!
That was interesting & actually good as I love peanuts.
Burger was OK, not exceptional. Tons of fries.
Should actually rename themselves 5 guys fries & burgers.
Fries & peanuts good, Burgers, meh.
I'll return if I'm really craving a ton of fries because that's what you get.

Food was good, I would even say great, but it felt very overpriced. I am used to paying in the teens for special rolls but when I looked at the menu and saw that most special rolls were $17+ I was a tad surprised. Service was slow but our waitress was training a new employee.

Enjoyed the tamales and the staff was nice. Their green corn tamale was savory, with cheese in it. I'm partial to ones that are on the sweet side. Pinto beans, black beans, rice, and nachos all left something to be desired.  

This place has RC cola brand on the fountain, which is a rarity.

Great food, but don't be in a rush! The restaurant has only one working microwave, which only fits two tamales at a time -- and takes about ten minutes to heat the two. We waited a half hour for a take-out dinner of four tamales, with no one ahead of us in the restaurant. 
But the tamales are the best!

Excellent spot for breakfdast this morning while cheering the on my family that are walking in the Gasparilla Race. Our waiter was John and he is one of the best around.  Just the right amount of conversation and attention.  Food was fresh and served timely.  I'll be back!!!

I have no idea how this place stays in business. I mean yes it's Burger King so expectations are pretty low to begin with, but you will be unpleasantly surprised by this location. Dirty. Orders never rights  and my god the drive thru is agony. Just avoid this place, not that anyone should be eating this food anyway.

Stopped in to check out the WXYZ bar. The bar had a great look to it, but the bartender did not know how to make mixed drinks. That ruined us and we left...old fashioned is not shaken and caramel apple martinis are not made with apple juice. If you go here stick with beer or wine.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
It took me 20 years to finally try Country Club Car Wash and only 10 minutes to  realize it wasn't worth the wait. 

I felt embarassed driving away after dropping $24 for a half-assed car wash.  I'm used to hustle from places like this -- instead, I felt hustled.

The only place my girlfriends and I will go to grab a bite that we know we can trust for good sushi. So yummy, so reasonably priced, and so many different rolls to choose from! The fish is always fresh. I always get 3 rolls so that I'll have extra to take home for later. Highly recommend this spot!

I gone to this place since 1983.  It's not the same anymore. They used to have the best Caesar salad anywhere but now it's average. Paper napkins instead of cloth  menu scaled way back and pretty expensive. The wine glasses they use, no Italian would be caught dead using.

Maybe we arrived close to closing time, maybe it was an off night, or maybe the place just plain sucks. How does a mexican place run out of salsa? Ask Las Margaritas cause they said they were out. The rice was dry, the sauce over my enchilada was flavorless, the service was slow, and the price wasn't worth it. I'll never be back.

Live this place and here here whenever I am visiting my family. I live in New York City and travel to San Francisco once a month and this still ranks at the top of my list. Great, fresh sushi, great ambiance and very cheap. Oh, did I mention that it's BYOB?

Food was awesome!   Had the veal parm.   Other with us got the Lasagna and manicotti.  Very tasty!!! Desserts were great!   Only street parking but they do have valet.  Our waiter was a little dry.   Was really serious and in a hurry.  But he was good.   Make reservations it was packed inside.   I would definitely return!!!!

This was my fist time at Ralph's in many many years and I was reminded why I haven't been in so long. Food was ok- the veal was tough and the escargots stingy. Prices were steep-$150 for the 4 of us. The family liked the sauce and agreed it was worth the trip- once.

Three stars for the bartender that served us ,deysi(aka gorgeous) I believe her name was.  Amy on the other hand, must have been having a bad day.   She would give customers dirty looks when they would come up  for drink.   And was just horrible. She needs to find a new line of work or leave her problems at home.

Friendly staff. My order was made accurate and refresh. My cold food was cold and my hot food was hot.. The drive to line moved smoothly and quickly even during lunch time on a weekday.. I had no complaints with my recent trip to this Burger King location..

It's a pizza place and they cook for me and I paid for the service and pizza. Nothing really special, nothing really bad about it. Ok place because after they change things for the last several months, they don't really have good coupons. I order from Papa johns a lot less than before these days.

Don't order a Bloody Mary from this place, they charge you $12.00 for it and it taste like water, they won't give you your money back even when your glass is half full. What a shame for a 12 buck watered down drink you lost a customer who comes to your restaurant 7 to 10 times a year.  On the positive side the Fish Tacos are good.

Just held A meeting at this hotel with 47 of my key team members and it was terrific. Location connected to a mall is amazing and great restaurants within walking distance. The rooms are comfortable clean and super modern. The staff was friendly and the food was good.   Definitely recommend.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went in to pick up a pizza that was ordered online.. When i got there the pizza wasnt made and no one had any idea where it was or when it would be done.. About 10 girls standing around behind the counter talking about school, pretty much ignoring me..  Done with this place..

I really like this place.  They practically have everything!  It's def dated, but it is clean and the staff is friendly and helpful.  Great beer selection, and again just about everything if you need something in a pinch!  Plus, how can you not love their neon sign?!?

Great prices, nice friendly staff, and you're in and out quick!  Liquor or wine- The selection is good too! Don't expect to get high-falootin fancy stuff here, just the basic table brands. Parking is usually right out front on the street, but put a dime in the meter- Ridley loves to ticket people here!

I've always had great service from Bart and his crew. They complete repairs quickly, and with close attention to detail. Prices are well below dealer cost, but with much more personalized service. I no longer own a German car, but would certainly not hesitate to recommend Group One to a friend.

Amazing food and atmosphere!  I had the best meal I've ever had at a Japanese restaurant!  The Steak & Chicken combo was fantastic, as was the soup, salad and vegetables.  The spring roll appetizers was great, too.  My wife had the Kirkwood roll and love it along Chirashi... She said best sushi in STL!  Highly Recommend!

They bait and switched me when I tried to book a large party.

I had a reservation for 40 people at $20/head. After the owner agreed to hold the table for me, he continued to take reservations and once he had enough other reservations, he cancelled on me and claimed I hadn't actually booked the table.

Stay away.

For Mexican delivery this was fair.  The one milkshake was fine but the other (strawberry) was not edible.  It was not cold enough to be a milkshake and tasted weird.  Delivery was fast and portions were large.  So you get what you pay for since it is so cheap.

Come here about once a year for last ten years.  Never a bad meal, but never anything memorable.  I'm not a breakfast or brunch guy, which most of the reviewers seem to go here for. I can't get excited about an omelet. The things that keep me returning is that I live close by, and the french fried eggplant.

The presentation of your bland, mediocre sushi will be the best thing about your meal. It certainly won't be the management who insults you when you try to diplomatically try to explain why you sent back a totally disgusting roll. I'm going back to Yoshimatsu.

The absolute worse customer service. I reserved a car over the phone , the lady completely messed it up and ran my car. So when I arrived To pick up my car there only way to resolve was to either refund me which would take a week or charge me 100$ more. Complete waste of my time. And money never ever will I use this service

This sushi restaurant is very good. It's a small cozy place. The lady who was our waitress was really nice. We ordered the Fuji mountain roll, jalapeño crab roll, bagel roll, and the firecracker. We also ordered the tuna tartar and gyoza. Everything was real good, a must try!

The corner room with large picture windows is fantastic! We have a view of the arch and a view of the river on the 11th floor. 

The staff was very helpful checking in and out. We walked to Busch Stadium for a great Cardinals win over the Cubs and ate in the Village last night!

Totally enjoyed this hotel!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We love it here! The pizza and salads are great, and you can ask for modifications and extras. The whole staff is very nice and works hard to make things right. We have been here probably 7 times and have not had a bad experience, except maybe a slightly long/slow line on a Friday night,.

Rude and bad service. 
Left my drink on the table and never called out my name. Even when I stood in front of the girl she continued to ignore and failed to mention my drink was waiting. 
I hated spending a single cent at *$ but got a gift card to burn. 
Would not go back to this store.

I went to this Wendy's to get food for a birthday party They got the order wrong I had to go up to the window to give the order the lady at the drive thru never let me finish talking then she got mad I felt sorry for the birthday girl because it made her cry because some people didn't get what they wanted

The service was fine.  No one there was really helpful.  My food came out lukewarm and the people got mad at me when I told them I wanted something hot, not almost cold.  They got it right eventually.

Would not come back unless I wanted some ice cream or a baked potato.

Avian and exotic is a great facility, everyone is very professional.
is the only place in Indy that I trust with my bunny's care.
I boarded my bunny for two weeks and they were awesome. Brianna Worrell answered all my questions prior to board him.
Heather was very friendly every time I called to check on Nejo.

They take a lot of liberties in preparation of classic dishes. Piccata is a big variation from classic prep. The appetizers appear,and taste to be prepared frozen apps that are heated up.  The vodka sauce is reminiscent of watered down condensed tomato soup. Pretty pricey for low quality.

Totally friendly staff.  Room was clean and huge.  Everything very simple in a positive way.  I had five stars but the AC was sooooo loud.  And when people next door used tHe shower it was loud, too.  I guess the pipes.  Other than those two things they are five stars.  No other noises what so ever.  I'd still come back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Came in for an early dinner. They started us with a free appetizer that consisted of garlic nots and bruschetta.  I had the Lasagna with a salad. My wife order the small marguerite pizza. The lasagna was a plate full and tasty. The pizza was solid.  We will be back.

I don't know what is going on with the food places in northeast I love this place but the last time I got something deliver the delivery driver seem to be in a rush I gave him 20 and my bill was only $10.68 cents and I had to tell him can I have my change he just laugh and my food was not that great.

I find this place to be an over priced olive garden. I couldn't decide what to get so I went with the classic, chicken parmigiana. Since this is an Italian restaurant they should be exceptional at this dish. I stand corrected, chicken was rubbery, sauce had no taste. Not worth the price, go somewhere else.

There is nothing really stellar about this place except that it's the most affordable sushi around town. Customer service isn't great, but you get what you pay for. I'd recommend this place for people who are craving a quick sushi fix and aren't too particular.

this place is my most-visited grocery store, mainly cause there's not much else around. it's not glitzy, but they have all the essentials plus a good international foods selection.

it sometimes smells weird, and i caught of a glimpse of chicken feet and pig's feet in the meat case today.

but i'll keep going back.

San Sai is definitely something unique as far as downtown cuisine, but it's nothing really special. The sushi is just okay.They have a lot of other options like teriyaki and various salads that are also just okay. It's good for a quick lunch, but don't expect too much.

Went to Clearwater location they were rude and refused to seel me the product saying I had to go to largo store. Now I am at largo store and they say I have to bring my pet in to see the dr before they will (continue) to prescribe the prevention heart worm medication. DO NOT USE BANFIELD.

Good spot for take out Mexican. The tacos can be dry sometimes, nothing a little salsa verde can't fix. The rice and beans are good but a little expensive for a side. We have had some problems but nothing that would not keep me from calling on my lazy days. All together a decent spot for your middle of the road Mexican food.

We ordered a Lg Greek Salad to go when we got home we found an old wilted, slimmy rotten salad. This should NOT have been served, not fit for consumption. It appeared to be several days old, rotten & completely limp salad. I am becoming increasingly disappointed in food quality after being a devoted customer of years.

This is my FAVORITE sushi! Everything is so fresh and reasonably priced for the quality of fish.  My friends and I go here all the time, we've become regulars.  If you're in for trying something new I suggest getting the Volcano salad and the King Kong roll - it's a lot of food, and it's all delicious!!

Excellent food at a reasonable price.  I've had the cheesesteak which was not the best ever, but decent, and a calzone which was truly 5 stars.  Dinners and pizza look delicious!  Can't wait to return.  I took off one star because the location is very inadequate; not nearly enough parking (no lot).

i was on this side of town playing frisbee golf and decided to get some lunch.. stopped in here for a few beers and a sandwich.. it was pretty good i ordered the club and it was tasty and pretty big i made a mess all over, but i washed it down with some more beer and left satisfied..!

For a chain Italian restaurant, I absolutely love this place! They have a decent wine selection, and I feel like it is better quality compared to like Olive Garden for example. I would give it 4 stars but sometimes service is a little off and my food had reached the table cold more than once.

Good location, price is fine if all you need to do is sleep & take an Uber. NO ONE seems to be at the front desk for long periods of time. I waited over 15 minutes in an abandoned lobby to check in. The TV had no volume control & tried to call for an hour. No wake up calls decent breakfast, but you get what you pay for.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The house salad was good. You can pass on the egg rolls . The fried rice was tasty . The soba noodles didn't taste like soba noodles I've had , the were very thin like angel hair pasta . All the food is very very greasy . It's quite expensive too for noodles and rice

The food was delicious, the ambiance was nice and the customer was excellent. We both had a cocktail, both good . I got the carbonara, it was perfect. My friend got the braised ribs and risotto and it was amazing. 
The initial salad was very tasty . I will definitely go back

I ordered steak teriyaki Togo. I really enjoyed it. I think I'd really like it if I had it there. It came with a small salad and miso soup. I ordered pork egg rolls. First , I didn't need them and second, they weren't good . They weren't fried enough all I tasted was cabbage. I'd definitely order from here again.

My friends are I went to Sakana based on a friend's recommendation. This is the best sushi place i've been to hands down! The fish was so fresh. Everything was tasty and cook to perfection. I wish i didn't live 5 hours away but i'll definitively go back there everything i go to Santa Barbara.

Okay, so this place is SEVERELY understaffed. One waitress is obviously not enough. But the food is fantastic especially for the price! I recommend the Krab Special or Volcano Roll. They're open late, have a nice laid back atmosphere and like I said the food is on point. Would be 4 stars if only they had more staff!!

Ninja sushi is family restaurant concept good service hibachi are sometime over cook and some time are perfect cook ( came to get hibachi like 3 time now ) sushi was ok ( for sushi eater ) togo alway good timing if you want something fast before you go back to work. over all it is good place if you stop by smyrna.

Brought in and was advised a week turn around. Their windows decal says same day service on shirts. That is all I had.  I have used them many times.  I spend well over 2000 a year on dry cleaning here and possibly more. She did not care. They just lost my business. Did not try to accommodate.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Very disappointed. Pay for all you can eat and then are told that they will charge you to take home whatever you don't eat!  If you leave it on the plate to be thrown away, then there is no charge. Makes no sense to me. Definitely won't be going back there again. Stick with Kobi's. Food is better and the "show" is too.

Great little sushi place that's not overpriced and super busy;  3 sushi chefs that never stop!  Nothing fancy about Vic and fish is really fresh.  If you plan on dining in it's very, very small...only 1 table for 4 and 10 seats at the sushi bar.  Bring a BYO is a big plus.

We had the all meat pizza with garlic & parm on the crust. This was our fist time here, it was good not excellent but it was tasty. The sausage & ham were very good. We ordered the original breadsticks as an appetizer and it was delicious!! We'd return for another visit.

Not clean! The food had good flavor but this place needed some elbow grease put to it. Neither the taco or quesadilla come with rice or beans. Chips & salsa do not come complementary. You have to go outside around the back of the building to get to the restrooms! We are not a fan & will NOT be back...ever.

These guys are nice but they told my daughter she needed all kinds of things that when we checked into them, she really didn't need. I'd be careful of just taking what they say at face value. Luckily, we just said only do the oil change and we'll get back to you about the other stuff.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I've only tried the pizza, but I was very pleasantly surprised. It's definitely some of the best to be found in the Brandon/Valrico area.  The crust is thin, crispy and delish; the toppings are generous; and the large pizza is HUGE.  

I only wish they delivered!

I truly love this place and have been going for years but strongly suggest breakfast their breakfast are phenomenal my issue is if you get their cheeseburger the buns are always way too big for the meat  so you have too much bread but for breakfast you can't go wrong

Neighborhood Gem. Great Italian food in pleasant surroundings. Young chef provides great value and wonderful fare. Many home made pastas and specials. Byob. Professional service, they want you to enjoy the table for the evening, almost like Being in Europe. Our go to spot many times, never disappointed.

Highly recommended. Red Kitched or Ruth Cris both fine dining inside the hotel. The workout room is nice. My only gripe, there's NO SWIMMING POOL! There is lots of DRINKING going on and the area is very secure and relaxed. Late night food? go to CALICO's!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Super comfy beds (Starwood preferred guest property ). Noisy air conditioning but I sleep well so didn't bother me . Smallish rooms, but clean and well kept. Nice housekeeper wrote a personal note when tipped nightly.  Fun lobby with bar + outside bar and on the go easy breakfast choices.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
First visit. I've been to the location on N Florida Ave and been very happy. Brandon Blvd is small and in a little strip mall. The selection was lacking but the donuts I bought were good. Service was okay. I'll stick with the N Florida store.

PS: Could someone please open a KK in Hernando County or northern Pasco??

I ordered a cake for my 10 year old. No bakeries have video game themed cakes. I asked if they could put an image of a video game character that he likes. Sandra, the associate that assisted me, was patient, helpful and made the cake look really cool despite that she was so busy. We truly appreciate her effort and service.

Awesome little place.  Complimentary drink while you wait for your appointment (small beer selection, whiskey, and cokes).  Very comfortable, relaxing atmosphere unlike most places these days rocking the long rows of chairs and mirrors.  Very friendly people.  I got my hair cut by Paula, who did a very good job.

Called this place after seeing the reviews on google and yelp to get a sport exhaust fit for my car. The person I spoke to quoted $1450 as labor charges !!!! Rip off and ridiculous pricing. I mean for god sakes get real !! The porsche dealer quoted $900 lmao this place is a joke

Brought my dog back to get her stitches removed yesterday 8/7. Was told "all's well." Discovered tonight that they missed one of the two stitches. So I had to bring her back... again! So let me amend my prior thoughts about veterinary competence. Purple stitches on a shaved white leg. HOW HARD IS THIS?

We were one of the only group of people in there at the time, and yet service was terrible. The waiters were just standing around, near our table, not taking our orders, or refilling our wine glasses. The food was very good, would go again - but the service definitely needs work.

Great Chinese food, ordered through DoorDash. Prices are good, quantity is large, and quality is great! My driver, Minh, got here early, and the food was hot. I got a pork egg roll, hot and sour soup, and the beef lo mein. Egg roll and soup were great. Lo mein was not spicy at all,  bordering on bland. Would definitely go again.

We received the wrong donuts through the drive thru on multiple occasions. Only ordered 4 donuts. Strawberry doesn't sound like chocolate. Receipt is correct but order is wrong. 

The employees' lack of attention to detail is obvious. This is an easier job than most fast food places. No reason for these kinds of mistakes.

No update about the closing time change that I could find. Got there at 7:54, and they were closed. Drove out of my way as it's one of the few places to get citizen cider. Even said I know exactly what I need. Would've been in and out. 

Will never go back.

My kids think the wings here are the best around.  One complaint - their online menu is really old.  Several times I've been surprised by the cost of my order.  The prices are considerably higher now.  It would be nice if this business would be more honest and take the time to update the prices.

This is not the worst Dunkin Donuts I've been to, but it's also not the best.  The coffee is generally as acceptable for DD, and the breakfast sandwiches are as expected.  Several new members of the staff are friendly and I think this has improved this location.

Drinks were reasonable and strong. Nice staff. But only gave 3 stars because of the smoke. I had a gentleman who smoked a cigars right next to me. Another patron said he was going to smoke his weed before he performs which he did inside and constant cigarette smoke also. Also the band was awesome.

On the plus side this is a new and clean location.  On the negative side... Everything else is pretty bad.  Don't come here if you see anything more than three cars in the lot.  I waited 29 minutes for a standard number six.  The staff was running around but didn't seem to know who was doing what.

The indoor atrium pool makes the guest rooms smell like mold, the wifi sucks and times-out twice a day even though their system should know how long you are staying and keep it active, and they made probably what was a terrible terrible motel, look nice. This is a joke of a Marriott and this is where the Opry stars go to die.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: It is just now 10 p.m. and I am sitting outside of straub's and it is closed I've been here for the last 5 minutes and security told me that management said shut it down. My greatest concern is are the people inside ok and if you're scheduled to close at 10 o'clock when I close at 10 o'clock.

This place is really busy on Sunday mornings! I had read good reviews so I think I was expecting really good diner food, but I didn't taste anything special in the food or see anything interesting in the menu. Its decent food, and I guess its a better alternative to the national chains.

Restaurant is like 85 degrees, no A/C.. they keep the doors open.  Ordered a simple sandwich at the counter, and the girl asked me 2 times to confirm what I ordered.  Arrived home to find the wrong sandwich.  Had to return and reorder.  This is a complete inconvenience.

Found plastic wrapping on my lasagna, which leads me to believe something along the way was frozen.

They did offer a free meal next time I come in, but the lack of attention to detail, and the yelling from the cook in the kitchen makes me not trust them anymore.

Great atmosphere to say the least. But Wish they had Natural drinks. I ordered a Margarita, but the sour mix is not made from scratch.  For a place like this, I thought they make drinks from scratch.  In other words , is just like any regular down the hill bar.

Disappointing chicken tacos. They were surprisingly flavorless...and no, none of us had covid :( Nice portion but tasted like chicken from a can unfortunately. Horchata was pretty good though. Warning on the chips: I was shocked. $7 for a container of plain chips with no salsa or toppings.

A rip-off. 18 piece sashimi for $49.95 when three of those are shrimp so thinly cut you coils use them to roll a cigarette? Small chunks of tuna and salmon round out the mix? While the service was good the quality is lacking for the cost. Go somewhere else.

We went here for dinner Friday night.  I had the carbonara which was excellent.  The pasta tasted fresh and homemade.  Service was very good and professional.  My wife had a veal dish which she said was excellent.  The place was full but no waiting.  Seems like a lot of old time customers were there which is always a good sign.

I love that this nail salon has hours on a Sunday. The location of the salon is in a congested area so it helps to have some off hours to mitigate that. I got a pedicure and it was fantastic. The detail to every part of the pedicure were noticeable and appreciated. I haven't had a manicure here but I recommend the pedicures.

The woman who answered the phone and greeted me when I arrived was really nice. That said, we ordered the pupu platter which is basically an assortment of their appetizers, and honestly, it was probably the worst Chinese food I've ever had in my life. We ended up throwing most of it out. Very, very disappointing.

Had dinner At Down Under tonight, and my wife and I both had the Aussie Dip. The meat was as tender as it could be, the au jus was very good, the garlic mashed potatoes (huge portion) was excellent, and my wife even commented on the ice tea. Very busy, but service was great, and I highly recommend this restaurant.

Not sure about the $$, as our meal was more in the $$$ range, but worth it. The waiter did a sampling of their different pastas for us as an appetizer - I would have been fine with that and a salad. But he said they'd make Veal Saltimbocca for me, so I'm in...it was delicious. everyone really enjoyed their food.

Excellent homemade goodness - much better than I can make myself.  Love all of the veal dishes - they have the best veal in the area.  Good choice for catering as well.  Excellent value and my guests raved bout the food.  Catering can be done on/off premises.

Every so often, my son demands that I take him to Joe's for a donair.  It's that good.  Once we saw the owner chasing someone out of the store like Seinfeld's 'Soup Nazi', but she deserved it.  And he's always been great to us!  Delicious sauce, very nice fries ... it's as good as fast food gets!

The only hand car wash place around that area. Not as nice as it once was. Employees seem more interested in socializing with each other than interacting with customers. No one seems to care. Lobby is pretty gross. No management at all.

Will not be back anytime soon.

Worst subway I have ever been to. There's dust hanging from the ceiling decorations, just waiting to fall into your food. The woman who made my sub bunched all the toppings in the center of the sub, just terrible. She looked like she was on drugs. STAY AWAY FROM THIS LOCATION. VERY POOR QUALITY.

Fabulous!  Prompt, friendly staff that was personable, never pretentious.  Excellent food -- tried the sweet potato soup, pork belly, beets and cheese appetizers.  For entrees - the short ribs were our favorite.  BYOB too!  Highly recommended and definitely in my top 5 byo in Philadelphia.

Worst pizza I've ever had.  Soggy and unappetizing.  Threw away the leftovers.  

Service wasn't good either.  Guy never came back to fill water and although he was nice, I had to go find him to take the order.

This just can't be what they serve in Italy.  If so, they need cooking lessons.

I had a couple of friends in town visiting and they are pretty picky eaters but from what I've heard about the place, I had no problem bringing them there so we could try it out.  I loved the selection, not the typical bar and grill menu.  Great drink specials as well.  I will definitely visit this establishment again.

I go to Starbucks at least once a week. I go out of my way to avoid this location though because they are just so slow. 15 minutes from the moment I place my order in drive thru until I receive it is unacceptable. And the staff seem to revel in the fact that they are so incompetently slow. Awful.

AWFUL!!!  Ive been here before and it was good, however, this time the rice was mushy and had no flavor at all.  The rolls were small and I was hurried out of the place. It was terrible. I usually dont give one star but they put no effort in the food and the service was terrible.

This is my new favorite restaurant in the area.  The food is the real deal.  Chef is Italian and man his food is incredible!  Our whole family was blown away!  We feel like we've discovered a treasure.  Our waitress was very personable.  Good items on the menu and the restaurant itself is very clean!

This place went downhill
We have ordered from here several times from work and enjoyed it. Today 3 people threw their salads out Using different ingredients, out of many salad ingredients.
The shrimp for salad was hard and gross We will never order from here again  The place was empty

Being of Italian extraction and from New York, I judge an Italian restaurant initially by the quality of the bread and then the tomato sauce.  Both stink at this place.  Buy the bread at Publix, for goodness sake.  The sauce tastes like thick, sour tomato paste.  Dark dungeon atmosphere.  Wouldn't go back.

Suite
It was clean and nice - a missed door between bedroom and living room - but it wasn't a big issu. Swimming pool is a little bit small. 
Breakfast
as always in hotels (milk, cereals, eggs, some kind of meat, waffles, fruits: bananas & oranges, some pastry .etc)
Front desk
They were polite and helpful.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The pizza really lacked in authenticity. They used can mushrooms on the pizzas and a little heavy on the sauce for my taste. The staff was very friendly and the price wasn't bad. The cannolis were pretty good. In my opinion it would go along way to use  fresh mushrooms on the pizza, however two for one beer didn't hurt my feelings.

Supercool atmosphere - very friendly staff. 
That said, it really is all about the pizza... 
You can tell when a business owner is paying attention to what patrons want.  Chef level food made with excellent ingredients and delivered in good size portions.  
Please help me welcome this place to Oro Valley! :-)

i stayed here for five nights including new years eve and I had a great time. It's a Great place to stay, the staff were friendly. They have a social hour on select nights with FREE wines, beers and a nice hot meal. It's one of the best deals in town plus the location is perfect for tourists.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: First and last dinner at Ryan Christopher's. Arrived for our reservation and the waitress was not flexible with our "assigned table"...turns out the seating was ok. Appetizers were fairly good, entree(s) were fair at best. The snickers pie was delightful, the other cake again fair. Just not impressed enough to return or recommend.

Terribly understaffed on Christmas Eve. After clearing a table of glasses and other debris from previous customers we seated ourselves and waited.... 10 minutes later we still had not even been acknowledged so we left. Less than half the tables were occupied and most of the empty ones had not been cleared.

I came here for lunch with a Groupon deal. The service was very poor, with the waitress taking 15 minutes just to bring water, then disappearing before we could order. A quick sushi lunch took over an hour due to the delays in waitress service. The food was not anything special and overpriced for what you got.

Color selection is limited. Staff workers don't understand much English which makes it difficult to communicate what the costumer wants. But overall polish is clean and well done. I recommend calling ahead for an appointment or you'll just be waiting around all day.

Very fast and courteous. Extra most bestest is what I mainly order. I live nearby and I come here twice a week in the last two months. The price is good, the service is friendly and fast. Seems like it's employed by teenagers, haven't had a problem and I really like the prices. Overall good experience

I give this location 0000 stars! Just awful....Messed up our breakfast order and forgot to give us syrup with our 2 orders of pancakes! The breakfast crew  needs a retraining on how to work and service customers the right way! Come on mcdonald's you can do better than this!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Very, very happy to have discovered Felicia's. We have been very disappointed in N delco/Havertown pizza up until now, after moving into the area from Philly. Their pizza is legit. We tried both their house special w the spinach and a plain. Both were delicious. Amazing crust (my sign of a good 'zah). Thank you Felicia's!

I love coming to this sushi spot! I believe that Arigato has better quality sushi however not by much, and Ichibans price point is much much better. The counter sunk tables are an awesome touch, and the guys behind the sushi bar really enjoy talking to you if you'll let them.

The veterinary care was good however the front staff is incompetent. I was charged double through a clerical error. I understand mistakes happen but dealing with mistakes can define a business. I was made to jump through a lot of hoops with no apology. I would not recommend this practice.

Some of the best sushi I've ever had!  The 'Pink Lady' is a personal favorite and a must try!  Cool and chic atmosphere great for a lunch date or evening dinner with friends.  Can't wait to try the sushi boat, which I've seen and is big enough to fill the table with a variety of sushi!

Laredo has flavorful combinations of sauces and meats.  They are more than the same ole Mexican food.  Their salsa is on the spicy side. My husband is not a fan of Mexican food, and he liked Laredo.  They have real table cloths and tasteful decor.  I've only been there once so far and look forward to going again.

Excellent and cheap. Big fan of the al pastor burrito.  I dont know what "authentic" mexican food is, but this is my best guess.  Well, at least compared to the Cantina.  And theyre open til 1:30!  Just dont plan to eat there. They have tables, but Im pretty sure theyre just for show.

The resurrection was good. They brought back the turtle, so I thought it had to be good and tried it (sorry, Jon Taffer). I was mistaken. Not sure why they brought it back as it was disgusting. I was embarrassed to carry it around. I do wish there was a better "souvenir" cup. I did like the atmosphere and the dueling pianos.

Not only will they refuse to do any type of curbside pickup during this pandemic but when we acted to verify they weren't doing this - as nearly all restaurants are - we were rudely reminded that "no, just told you that we won't do that."

Just rude.  It's pizza. We will go to Sam's where the service is friendly.

I love going to Danny's downtown shop easy access from the central bus station . He also knows how to deal with my surgery scars so they're not showing.
Sometimes I wish He was also a dog groomer (haha) because my poodle is just plain naughty (Knotty) when I try to do him.

Oh my goodness!  Haven't been here before. I had the prime rib done to perfection with a baked potato with the trimmings.  The Tiramisu with vanilla ice cream was to die for.  Michael was our server and outdid himself. We wanted for nothing and left happy and full. I would recommend highly.  We will be back!

This place was really good! I was waking by it one Saturday and I think they had just done a soft opening. Last Friday, I figured I'd check it out, and even though it was around an hour to get my pizza, it was sooo good! Newest pizza spot in Old City, and everyone should stop by!

Ordered 2 pies extra crispy. Was disappointed when they arrived and the dough was soggy. Not very piping hot.  Did not want to wait another hour for a remake.  When I called was put on hold and then came the dial tone. Basically a pizza made from recycled pizza boxes. From Chicago where REAL PIZZA is made.

Dr. Birnbaum is absolutely excellent. My husband and I both went to her and were very satisfied with her valuation and explanations. The staff were extremely friendly and helpful. And because of the attentiveness of our optical assistant we got a great deal!!  We highly recommend, and we are very hard to please.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The name has changed to Fito's but the food and the staff are still the same. The BEST fast food Mexican place I have found on the east side. The carne is awesome. And the beans are perfect. The burritos are huge and the tortillas are so wonderful. Even the churros cant be beat!

This is the only 24 Hour Burrito Pl. I've ever gone to That closes. Tonight at 3 AM. They announced to me that they are closed for cleaning. Upon driving by no industrial cleaning truck was seen in the parking lot. No cleaning activity was seen happening at location. Suspicious. And disappointing.

The other review is a year old and NOTHING has changed. It is still the same hateful rude man and the same hateful rude actions. My friend has a hearing problem so she kept asking him to repeat himself and that enraged him that much more. No "thank you"!   He must own the franchise. Why would they keep him around?

RAW Big Macs, Refried fries. I watched the manager (skinny older woman with grey and white hair in a pony tail) scoop the fries out of the bin and put them back in the fry basket. There was blood from the burgers on my buns. I will never be returning to this Mc Donald's again.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Our room on the 10th  floor was amazing. Large bathroom shower and the bed was amazingly comfy. Excellent location in the city for hitting Broadway and the night life in the lobby bar was exceptional. Saturday DJ brunch was fun. Folks at the front desk were very helpful and house keeping was excellent.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: 4 stars only for pizza I ordered a lg supreme which was amazing so flavorful and toppings were a generous amount. THE BUFFALO WINGS SUCKED WAY OVER COOKED AND DRIED! will never get the wings again, wings are supposed to be a juicy lighter color not dark dark and dried from overcooking and too expensive.

Dunkin Donuts was my "go to"  for coffee when I was in the east coast.  I ordered my usual french vanilla  coffee and a dozen munchkins. The smell and taste reminded me of those good old days. After I finished my coffee and munchkins, I ordered a dozen donuts for the ride home.

Szechuan Beef and Happy Family were fine, didn't include the Chicken Fried Rice in the order.  Lo Mein tasted like it was bathed in peanut butter, fried dumplings were thick and tough, crab rangoons were made with artificial crab, orange chicken was an obvious reheat from leftovers. Doubt we'll ever go back

I always recommend renting from National. It's easy if you're an Emerald Club member. You go right to whichever car you want and go. It's that simple. If you reach Executive level, you can upgrade your car at no additional charge. Associates are always helpful. Go National!!

Great stay. Great room. This hotel is within walking distance of the French Quarter. It is very clean and the staff is very helpful and courteous. Parking fee was$36 plus tax plus tip so if you can find an alternative parking location I recommend it. I would definitely stay here again if we came back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Date night at A Mano was great!  Service was impeccable.  Loved the food and the ambience!  Goat cheese gnocchi, porkbelly, and antipasto was fab.  They cure their own duck prosciutto in house, need I say more!  Overall we were very impressed and enjoyed our visit!

Jae and his crew are knocking it out of the park.  I had this spicy squid salad that had this killer mix of spicy flavors and textures that I haven't experienced in the multitude of other sushi joints in the area, and I've been to plenty.  Price is right too.  Grab a bottle o sauvignon blanc and get over there.

I noticed they always have a job listing for Maintenance, it never used to be like that back before 2008 so I wonder what is going on with the staff, I know one staff member there I worked with back in 2005, this person was not very nice and hard to get along with. I know it is the reason why I can not get an interview.

The service here really needs work. I've been three times through the drive thru and before I even pull up they say "Welcome to Wendys, Whats up"...... really whats up? be a little more professional. 

Food is average wendys food, you cant really screw it up... unless you forget the cheese on my meal...which has happened

Very nice place. Came without reservation, ate at the bar. One very rare restaurant where you can eat an appetizer, an entree and a dessert without being too loaded. The cuisine is fine, well elaborated and in the same time simple. An actual good combination of taste and texture. Love it!

I usually rate beer first but we have only been there for lunch and haven't had beer so no rating there.  But, the sushi is really good here - especially the Chef's Specials.  The service is always excellent and prompt so I am a big fan.  Really do like this place.

Anthony's is one of our favorite restaurants. Great atmosphere, outstanding food, friendly + professional staff. The best non-Buffalo style wings anywhere in the DE area. Paired with a small salad (plenty for two) and a bottle of wine. I would take a picture but our plates are empty. Glad Anthony's is here. More than worth a trip!

An average Japanese restaurant, I would say nothing special. I liked their prices more than sushi, the presentation is so so, the rolls were a bit saggy and loose, the waitress wasn't  pleasant at all didn't smile once. I mean it's not the worst place, but it's not on list of my favorite restaurants either.

Wife and I went for lunch and they were only serving dinner.Service was 4 star in a small cute dining room...more nostalgic than anything.Antipast was average as were our entrees.

We have had much better Italian dishes in other restaurants in the city as we found this famous eatery to be a bit over rated. Oh well

This is the best local take-out Chinese in the area. They seem to change owners every 6 months to 1-year.  The latest people who took over seem to have the best food of all of them in the past 10 years. So if you want cheap American Chinese food this is the place.

This is the only Japanese restaurant in Hendersonville that I know of that has bento boxes on the menu. The sushi was good, and the prices were really reasonable. I'm  one who judges a place more on the food, but the decor is really terrible if that matters to you. The service was good.

My experience was nothing like what the other Yelpers indicated. Everyone was polite and friendly. Kara at the bar is very nice and works hard. Food was great. 

New restaurants struggle the first few weeks, so give them a break and try them! I'll be back!

Went for lunch: Waited a loooong time at the front door just to be seated...waited longer to order...and even longer to get our 2 small pizzas. The place wasn't even crowded so i don't know what the hold up was. Pizza was good, but prolly not worth that wait.

Business operates just fine, although the prescription that was generated by exam was off.  The glasses ordered with prescription were still a little blurry. I ended up going back to Costco and was able to get glasses that help me see clearly. Nothing wrong with the business, I just don't have much confidence in their results.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: To be fair, the hash browns are awesome! Really, and my breakfast sandwich was decent!  However, the Donut ... it was stale, and I got there at 7AM, so what gives.  I don't understand how at 7 AM, I am served a stale dried out Donut?  Nevermind ... I wont be back!

Great bar.  I've gone multiple times and the service has always been good.  One of the times there it took the servers some time to realize that we had not been served, but once they realized they were very apologetic and served us very well the rest of the night.  I really enjoy Wednesday night trivia.

Interesting Italian food with above-average quality for the area.  Wine list outstanding in breadth and selection.  Prices a bit on the high side for the area, but reasonable value for the money.  Server was a bit awkward and inexperienced, but was also friendly and trying hard to be helpful.  We will go back again.

We went there for the lobster tasting menu and it was among the best meals I've ever had! The sommelier is fantastic with his wine pairings and affable demeanor and the staff overall is professional and attentive. This restaurant is truly one of a kind outside of center city.

I don't review fast good places normally.  Today I ordered a medium #1 special.  No coke available, no chocolate frostie available.    Then, I get to the window, and get no fries with no order.  Ummmmm. is management lacking?  Maybe someone needs to lose their job?

Come here often, slots pay well have won about $15,000 and lost about 4000 over the last year.

Food is pretty great, the meteor pizza is pretty is delicious..

Waitresses are pretty good in the lounge. They look exhausted most of the time but still manage to work a lot and do a pretty good job.

Even you drink or eat, $15 to park. 
We go here all the time, except the day there is black woman who sings horrible...
Just out of tune. Very uncomfortable to listen and people are laughing saying Oh my god.
This bar has nice pool, jacuzzi, and access to beach. 
Wonderful place except that day the lady is there.

The owner is very friendly, the service...so, so. The portions are small. Not quite Authentic Mexican Cuisine. Good music tonight. A single guy singing western music. Would try again and order something else. Had the Maui Maui fish tacos and hardly any fish in the tacos.

I will definitely be going back! The ice cream was creamy and smooth. I had the king cake flavor which had pieces of yummy king cake mixed in. The service was great, nice atmosphere. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars was because it's cash only. Luckily I had cash. I guess it was my lucky day!
