I've eaten here three times. The first two I had cooked food. Tonight my friend and I ordered just sushi. I am very disappointed. Fish is dry, tough and tasteless. The rice wasn't cooked right. Also who wants to eat sushi with the skin of the fish still on it? Yuck!. I'm done, who wants my To-yo dollars?! lol

Save your money. Went down from our room at Circus Circus to get coffee and tasted disgusting. Tasted nasty just like the room coffee. The hotel needs to upgrade and get a Keurig like some other hotels I've stayed at (Marriott). Take your money and go to Starbucks at Silver Legacy.

Feel it is overpriced and the waiter was not very pleasant.  Too many Italian restaurants in the area to settle.  Bread was the best part of the meal which comes with olive oil.  They said they make the bread in house. So I guess  it's 2 1/2 stars in my book.

wish I could go 2 1/2 stars.  It was OK.  Went for dinner.  A little pricey for some items for what you got.  Service was good.  Parking can be an issue.  Restaurant/Bar was not busy.  Next time will some of the other restaurants along Main Street.  Manager did not seem very friendly or go out of his way to check on things.

really disappointed.   Lobster bisque was missing the lobster.  Not one morsel.   Prime Rib sandwich was more like sliced roast beef.   chicken sandwich was OK.  We would have ordered another round of drinks but did not see the waitress.  By the time she came we were past the point of wanting another round.   Hostess friendly.

While we didn't actually fo here to eat, this was one of several Italian places I searched the menu online for Linguine with red clam sauce. In a town and location known for oyster, shrimp and clams, I was disappointed in not seeing a red clam sauce on the menu.

Nice atmosphere and clean. Too many bringing chips, taking drink orders, and a 3rd taking entree order. Got requests a little mixed up. Entrees Were all well prepared. Chips are important to a Mexican restraint but theirs were a bit stale or we would have given 4 stars.

This is the best place to buy a bottle of wine in the area. The staff is consistently warm, interested and helpful. Without exception, recommendations are perfect for the meal or the occasion. Selection is always broad at all price points and we always have a great wine at the cost we wanted to pay.


Always a pleasure!

Not enough seating for normal folks wanting to sit and enjoy a coffee with a date. Is taken over by students using Starbucks for a study hall. Funny cause some of them don't have a purchase that I have noticed? 
Sorry but I pay good money for Starbucks coffee .

My husband and I rent from
National whenever it is an option. My recent trip to St. Louis for a family emergency was made easier by the Emerald Club. I enjoy having control over the choice of vehicle. It also allows you to try different makes and models of cars you may be interested in buying.

I've been taking my vehicles to Fountain St. for about 10 years.  That's because they are reliable, friendly, honest and fairly priced and isn't that all you can ask for from a repair shop?  Not really a whole lot else that needs to be said.  Talk to Brian over there and he'll get you set straight.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Selection is on par with the other "upgraded" FW & GS stores, but the lines are the worst and the customer service is non-existent. While I live within 10 blocks of this location, I choose to drive to South Philly if necessary, but go to NJ whenever possible.

This location is rough. Very slow and staff are more interested in socializing than serving customers. Went to pay and was told to wait while 2 employees finished gossiping. Orders are always wrong to the point of throwing away food. Drive the extra distance and go to fishhawk or 301.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is based off delivery order, so mind in person dining may be different. Food was ok, it was a standard sushi menu. A lot of different sushi but it was just ok. Rice did not hold to the roll, while flavored well it fell apart and you could not eat the roll properly. It was mediocre at best.

I wanted some chicken and waffles, and since it was a short walk from the hotel, we ended up here. The waffle leaves a bit to be desired, but the chicken was plentiful and good, along with the eggs. I'd suggest ordering a biscuit, as they are large and very good.

I was very surprised with how good the service and sushi is at this place. The happy hour special is awesome; half off Sushi rolls and certain pieces. It runs from 4:30 to 6:30 Tuesday thru Saturday. I will definitely be back again & again. If you do go try the bagel and eel.

Small quiet nice ambiance the shrimp tempura was good but it was a little heavy with all of the tempura vegetables. The egg noodle soup was fantastic it paired perfectly with the ginger dressing on the side salad. The tea was a little odd no color but smelled like coffee but it got the job done.

A very busy place when I was there. I ordered to go and only had half a block to walk to my hotel, but the pizza was cold that fast. Not a lot of flavor in it either. I didn't order other items, but might try next time I'm in town. I think they deserve another chance.

AC in the rooms barely works.  With the thermostat set to 60 and the fan on high, the temperature in the room still rose to uncomfortable levels throughout the day and took all night to almost catch up.  So if you like your room hit and humid you're in luck.  Otherwise you don't have any option but to sweat it out.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Has been there forever. Pizza is never reliably good. When it's good, it's delicious. When it's not so good, it's terrible. Usually greasy. Normally I don't blot my pizza with napkins but I always have to when I get spatolas. Good if your only dropping in for a slice and some garlic knots.

Some of the employees are really good, but others have no business in customer service. Maybe they are new, but then they should have a supervisor with them. The food is the problem. The breakfast sandwiches are super greasy and hard. Maybe lunch is better.

Fourth shirt ruined by these people (shame on us for going back).   They always claim it was somehow our fault (most recent hole that was there when we picked up a brand new shirt) - "must've been a bug eating it"    What????  We're done.  Lousy cleaners/lousy service.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I live near by and 99% of the time they do a good job.  I can remember a few times they get things wrong during the order and pick-up, but Im in a hurry and Im sure they are rushed because of prime time but over all I have been happy with what expected from a fastfood store.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I used to love this place but lately It went downhill! Just payed almost $30 for food and received a half of a cup of salad dressing for a huge bed of lettuce which was supposed to be a chicken Caesar salad and two cheese steaks that tasted like a pound of cheese and no meat!!

Awful. Place wasn't busy. Greeted by bartender who said "sit anywhere". We wanted a booth and sat amidst other patrons. The booth was still dirty from previous patrons (bill still there, dirty, napkin with chewing gum). Three waitresses walked around us but never acknowledged us. We waited 10 mins and left. Won't go back.

My GF used to live here,and we return every year for Mardi Gras, and was one of her favorite spots. 
Excellent service and food was great. After dinner we went to the bar for a night cap. Again great service. IMHO wine list needs updating and more Italian varietals.

Very nice local pizza and cheese steaks. Our favorite at an intersection with a dozen places. Great guys behind the counter. Just booths but worth trying.

The 'steaks are great. nicely toasted roll and large. Pizza is thin crust. and nicely flavored. Pretty cheap

The worst. Don't go. Period. Rude staff. Food is sad. Place looks disheveled. If I could give it zero I would. Hot latter ordered serves on ice. When I said order was hot it was remade and still cold. Staff bad mouth customers. No manager on site which may help explain the problem.

So nice that they offer soup or salad with the entrees, and both are delicious.  The eggplant parm was great, very light and flavorful.  The pasta with seafood was abundant with mussels, scallops, shrimp, calamari, and a big piece of white fish (grouper?).  Very tasty marinara sauce. Service was very attentive.  We enjoyed!

Can't seem to give them business ($$$)... a sign you should stay away!
Tried to make multiple successive appointments, but found it impossible to connect with a live representative. The phone line is automated; even the chat line is run by a bot (Amelia) that keeps asking the same question.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
I moved from San Diego to Tampa last year and was looking for a reliable mechanic to work on my 230.  I was referred to DP and I have to say that they are top notch! 

I've since sold my 230 and purchased a 2012 E350. I'll be sure to bring it to DP when I need service. Great service!

Was in for the Dog Show.  Outdated guest rooms, in several visiting friends.  Furniture trashy, drapes need replacing.  Doors loose fitting, heat source noisy!  Free breakfast a joke!  Catered dinner bland.  Dessert cakes good.  Grounds need lots of work, sprinkler system heads sticking up and people tripping and falling.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Food is ok, but don't go if you expect service or your order correct.   Mine was incorrect.  I told them that I was not eating it, but they left it on my check anyway.  Took it home to the dog.  Seems like they could get it right especially since it was repeated multiple times.

Totally in love with this thin-style pizza! My wife & I get in here regularly because the pizza is great & the salads, including the many fresh extras in them, are always super-fresh. We feel the quality, quantity, and friendly staff are a fantastic value for the price!

This is typical subway shop. Nothing special with their subs. Bread was dry and not very appealing. Had the veggie and was tasteless. Had a coupon so I thought I would give them a try as my sub shop recently closed. Again a typical subway with average food. Razor thin meat slices. Portion control to the nth degree.

I hate writing bad reviews, but don't waste your hard earned money here. Came here on vacation and wished I read the reviews before going!Mismanagement shows reflection of this place. Dirty tables, long wait, food just blah. Sad because we have always enjoyed this chain.

They forgot my chicken on my Cobb salad. I assumed I had read the menu wrong so I ate it without complaining, but checked the menu online and yep, they forgot. Strange. Service was fine. Pretty sure our server doesn't like her job much. I actually tried calling but they dont answer the phone.

Five stars for a great gluten-free crust!  Delicious and wonderful to be able to eat pizza when the whim arises, as good GF options can be scarce and way expensive.  Highly recommend for those with allergies!  Can't speak to the 'regular' pizza.  Will definitely be back.  Great service.

Firm 3 stars. Small somewhat cozy eatery. The seafood they serve w/sushi, sashimi etc, is fresh and delicious. Had to ask for more ginger and wasabi, because the server brought very little amount of both when the dish was served. The lady server wasn't necessarily friendly for whatever reason, so we had to reconsider the tipping.

Great pizza. Has always been the best in Broomall, but now they have some competition. They have ear-in. Salads, other food options than pizza. I never understood why they don't deliver. Authentic Italian. You can watch the guys flip the dough. A Broomall tradition!

We ordered the spaghetti and meatballs and ziti Francis. Both dishes were plentiful and very fresh and tasty. The waitress service was exceptional. The gravy was so good we bought a jar to go. The bar area was hopping while waiting for tables. Definitely worth the wait.

Great location, has all the basic amenities. Not at all covid conscious so you kind of take that on as your own responsibility which isn't ideal. 
If another gym is equal distance I'd recommend that, but it is nice having the basics in the Summerside community as there isn't much else.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Why would I go somewhere, where they are rude to me on the phone ...even before I get there? Awful customer service!! Wanted to get 3 hair cuts and the girl who answered the phone on 7/12/18 around 1:25 pm SNAPPED at me for asking a question!!! No thank you for giving them my money!!!

I  eat at Trattoria Vittoria regularly, the food is always excellent, the service impeccable, and Ivo at the bar is absolutely the best bartender in Santa Barbara. I am constantly surprised at the people that stand in line and wait for the restaurant across the street, when there are any seats available at Tratt Vitt.

This hotel smells like cigarette smoke everywhere--in the hallways, in our non-smoking room, etc. If you prefer not to smell second hand smoke, take a pass on this place. Yes, they are updating it. But it's primarily in the form of poorly slapped on wallpaper. We switched to the Best Western after the first night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We gave Rode's one more try.  The food was average, the service was slow.  We had fried shrimp platter, fried fish platter, and tortellini with chicken and artichokes.  Only the fried fish was above average and a good value.  Unfortunately, we will not go back.

I Stopped in Luca'a pizza today I haven't been there for years and I wasn't disappointed!  

I had their lunch special 2 slices of pizza with a fountain soda for $5 

Mamma Mia (sauce on top) excellent!

Place was fairly clean and the staff was friendly!  I'll definitely be back!

Food was very good. Service very good. The restaurant has  very out dated looking decor and not that clean. If you want to have Chinese for lunch call a head and order it for take out or use their delivery. Don't eat in the restaurant it will definitely put you off your meal.

Great place at a great price. Everyone is nice to you and great food for the money. The service is slow at lunch, but if you are willing to wait it is worth it. Don't judge this book by it's cover it is a great little place. I am sure it is fun when the night life comes out as well.

Honestly I booked this hotel because it was one of the cheapest on hotels.com but it was a great place to stay. Budget friendly but not a sketchy place to stay at all. The room was clean and modern, the bed was comfortable. Easy check in, even late at night. Felt safe and it's close to downtown.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I'm easily disappointed in Nashville nail salons. They often leave a lot to be desired. But Anthony gave me one of the best pedicures and gel manicures today, and did it in just an hour (including old gel removal). He'll definitely be my go to guy from now on.

Their food is alright but the people behind the counter are pretty rude. If you do choose to get food here, I recommend ordering it either on the phone or online. When I tried to order in the store I was ignored for 10 minutes while the guy behind the counter was doing a bunch of miscellaneous things so I eventually just left.

Ate on a Saturday with my wife.  Food was good but the service had poor attitudes all night.  Our pony tailed 55 year old waiter was a jerk all night.  Our tab for 2 was over $150 and it felt like a waste after the way we were treated.  Food was good and I can see why the reviews are mainly positive.

Teds will always hold a place in my heart. the pizza good, the conterlady is a sweet heart and the owners are rather nutty. it's not the best pizza your ever gonna have but it;s far from the worst. it's always quick and they have good chicken fingers and cheese grinders, they aren't open on sundays but thats dealible

I have eaten here about 6 times now. 3 of them for lunch and 3 of them for dinner. Every time I get it for dinner it tastes amazing and fresh. 5 star worthy. But every time have it for lunch everything is terrible. The dough is clearly frozen. Everything tastes frozen from the night before. Texture is awful

I would give this 4-1/2 stars.  authentic mexican food and fresh.  The 3 salsas were delicious, I preferred the green tomatillo for the spiciness.  El Doble Doble was delicious, the chicken filling moist and flavorful.  Very reasonable price for dinner for 2 adult 1 child ($24.60).  Would highly recommend, and will go back again.

Just moved to the area and had a wonderful experience here! Great variety of colors. I got a gel manicure and it was don't quickly and looks nice. I look forward to going back for one of their 4 specialty pedicures. Yoonie did my nails... And I will surely ask for her again!

Wonderful nail salon! I have been going to American Nails for 9 years and now travel 15 miles from my new house to continue using their services. Lucy is amazing with gel nails. All of the ladies are detail orientated and very compassionate and proud of the work they do. Lucy, Jen, Kim, Nancy, Tracy... Everyone is great!

Needed my tires topped off and tried to go to Big Brand. They were so busy that I couldn't even pull into the parking lot. Decided to go to Tire Pros and I'm glad I did. They were busy too, but I was in and out of there within 5 minutes. Very nice and quick service.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Amazingly tasty pizza.  I guess I was prejudiced against this restaurant by the fact that it is in a bowling alley.  We had no idea what we were getting into so we ate there.  Not too noisy as only a couple of lanes were in use.  Best to do a take-out which is what everyone else was doing.

Had lunch here and we ordered the broccoli beef and the sweet and sour. Both dishes were delicious. The fried rice wasn't my favorite, but the egg drop soup and the egg rolls were delicious and super hot. The building is a little shabby but the food is good.

We loved this place! The prices were generally under $10 for meals and under $5 for a roll of sushi. The vegetarian tofu burger was honestly the best I've had! 

To top it all off, the staff was super pleasant and attentive and the general atmosphere was very hip. I highly recommend this place.

Customer service sucks, I order a  to go order and sit at the bar.  No one offers a glass of water or even see if I wish to have at for a beverage.  When the waitress does come to bar she asks the other person next if she's ok and then Walks off.  This wasn't the first time.  Great food bad service

Had dinner last night. Pasta w/meat sauce and the Mrs had mussels app for dinner.  Happy w/mussels,  meat sauce nothing special  (lots of hamburger chunks) was expecting something a little more exciting,  more pizazz.  Nice bottle of wine on special. Will be back.

We have been ordering food from this location for a few years since moving into a nearby neighbourhood. They became our go-to place for pizza orders. Top quality, fresh and more than reasonable prices. Donair is also great, just a touch too spicy for us though. Highly recommended.

Never had the opportunity to taste the food. When we arrived for our 8:00 reservations, we were unapologetically told to wait 15+ minutes outside in the freezing cold weather (there was no space in the tiny vestibule) 
We ended up at Lacroix where the service and food is always excellent.

Pizza was generic, totally tasteless wings not even a little salt or pepper. Stuffed mushrooms sucked, cheese sticks soggy grease sticks and took 45 min to deliver 5 blocks away. I have been traveling the country for 30 years and this place is Sad..... should get a quarter of a star

I really was disappointed in this place.  Everyone said how good it was, but almost $40 for 3 grilled cheese sandwiches, 2 fries and 3 drinks?  No thank you.  Would have been worth it if the sandwiches were loaded.  They weren't.  Skimpy servings.  Very, very disappointed.

Not impressed, went here for dinner based on the awesome reviews, wont be going back. Coconut shrimp was decent but a little too "fried". Cranberry salmon was kind of bland, crab cakes were burnt, appetizer took forever to come out and we were served the wrong dessert, although the dessert was the best part!

I'm reluctantly going with 3 stars as the service was very good, and they have Carta Blanca beer, served ice-cold, a rarity in the Boise area.  But the food is just typical McMexican - nothing to distinguish it from 90% of the other Mexican restaurants in the area.

Food is so-so and will fill you up. The crowd that I saw when I was there Friday was pretty young.

Negatives: a credit card is required when reserving for large parties (7 or more) - the margarita mix is pretty rancid (too sour!) - I was told that the Mad Mex margaritas (slushy style) are better.

Pizza Mia makes New York style pizza. Prices are average for a pie, and the sauce isn't bad. I wouldn't go back anytime soon, only because I prefer other Norristown-area pizza places (Charlie's, Via Veneto) over Pizza Mia. It's decent pizza, so stop in and give them a try - who knows, you might like them more than me.

Today I came here with friends. Had two scoops of chocolate chip cookie dough ice cream. Talk about refreshing and smooth - I love ice cream!

There's a play area for kids (or you big kids out there), and you can buy flowers at a florist right in the farm. I believe there was a petting zoo too? Recommended for a bite.

If you're partying in the area or here after-hours, this McDonald's is one of your fine dining choices. Heck, even if you're shopping and have the urge to eat a McChicken, here you go.

It's cheap, and if all you want is Chicken McNuggets to slow the effects of booze on your bloodstream, there you go.

If only they had booze.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Calamari = excellent! Crisp, with a hint of lemon. Dipping sauce is substantial, too.

Spinach dip = gross! Do not order this appetizer...

Once again, our service was excellent. Both the bartenders and waitresses did a great job of remembering what drinks we were drinking and making sure our glasses were never empty.

Great location, friendly service, and they were out of Apple Juice. They didn't have apple juice which completes my favorite drink. They have great service though and always a joy to sit in and read a book or chat with some locals. I'll be adding my favorite drink to the tips. Let me know how you like it! @hyundoekim

The margarita was average but only $3 for happy hour!!  Being from SoCal, this restaurant does not compare to Mexican places out West, but the food can pass for Mexican-ish.  My chicken mole was okay and my friend's food was not memorable.  They can put "cheese sauce" on any of their entrees by request...

I finally did try the newly revamped Ho Sai Gai (previously a salty, MSG laden place of my youth). But I'm sure that it is much different now. Was talked into getting take out by a sensitive stomach friend who was paying, telling me "it's very good!" Meh. There is a reason that I stopped eating Chinese food 10 years ago.

This is one of my favorite coffee shops in Nashville - I love the soy lattes and the staff is uber friendly! I also dig that it's one of the only locally places to eat/drink in the gulch.

Parking can sometimes be difficult, but if you get there during the afternoon when there is no valet you can park right in front of the shop!

Good place for a couple of drinks...never ate here so can't comment about the food, but I wouldn't be opposed to trying food here. We just happen to go in for drinks later in the evening after we have already eaten. The drinks are $8 and $10 each so it's a little pricey, but it is Clayton.

Food is typical bar food I suppose. It was nothing special. Pizza was lacking flavor. Tater tots topped like nachos with sour cream, cheese, jalapeno and tomato was interesting but definitely not many healthy options available! Decent draft beer selection. Trivia machines and a jukebox is a good addition.

This tiny run down looking shack is so decrepit that I swore they were closed until I got closer and saw that they were still open. They only do soft serve ice cream but you can still get shakes and sundaes. I opted for a regular swirl on a cone, it was definitely high quality soft serve with a decent portion at a decent price.

Creamier than the fro-yo places we have here in NYC.. different, but definitely a good different. I never thought I'd enjoy syrups and nutty toppings, but Yogorino had me changing my mind.

Kinda wish they had a Yogorino here.... well, guess this gives me another reason to visit Philly again.. no better reason than for food!

We stayed here for Southern Decadence. The location was good for that. I liked it was across from the river. don't expect anything great. we had 4 rooms and they were all very different. it's old and looks that way. the AC worked and the people were friendly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I had the chicken fajitas here. They were mediocre at bet. In a city filled with delicious Mexican food places this would not be among my top choices. It may look like an appealing hole in the wall, but you'll be disappointed. At least the service was friendly and speedy!

Every time I'm in Tucson I dine her for dinner.  The roasted beet salad is my favorite starter.  The menu changes with the seasons and nothing I've ordered has been nothing less than perfect.  Most recently I had their fresh pasta with meat sauce.  They also know my face and know I come in from Houston.

Good for a quick wash, but a bit pricey for what you get. It's strictly a drive-thru car wash. Don't expect them to vacuum or wipe down the dashboard.

They have honored the only coupons I had, pre-paid 50% off coupon from SpinSaver @ $9 each, which I think is a fair deal for Kidd Glove.

Originally a tequila bar (they still have quite a selection) Blue Agave now has a fantastic selection of beers, ales, and my favorite ciders on tap and bottles. They have live music and pizza to snack on. The staff is knowledgeable and friendly. Fun place to chill out and enjoy a quality pint.

My spot on the Late, late. They are most faithful and not disappointing. On the hot, hazy weekends...? Don't expect to have fancy ass flavors of Ice Cream. They sold out of those flavors by 6. Still I go becasue i know what to order at what time. I think they are a bit expensive on the Ice Cream side.

I went again, because Myska had little 'bump' on her skin, and I was afraid it was a tumor. It happen again, that Dr. Schneider was there and gave her good, precise examination. It turned out, that a little bump was just follicle, little compound of fat. I was so relieved! Good treatment, I paid just $45 for check up.

I really liked this place. We spent about $20/person and were completely stuffed. I was quiet happy with the taste and freshness of the sushi. It was on par with sushi restaurants in the Bay Area and certainly much better than what Kokopelli's has become over the years.

amazing!!! I was in from Seattle for a wedding. My uncle loves this very particular tequila ( Don Roberto) that is hard to find...Jason, the owner found it for me, ordered it and is hand delivering it to my uncle in SB on Tuesday.

Jason has an awesome store and his customer service is outstanding. Thank you for all your help.

What's with the black beans, when everyone knows the correct bean is the pinto bean? And the even better refried beans.

Was not impressed with the nachos, the are bland.

Fajitas (chicken) were also bland.

The salsa surprisingly tasty and flavorful, but still not enough to save the food.

Solid coffee, no BS!

It's located near the carousel which is located near the foodcourt.

It's espresso-only, if you want the taste of drip coffee, get an Americano! (as I did)

Nice selection of sweets too.

Feels oddly out of place in the Citrus Park mall, in a good way.

Nice facility, but I wasn't comfortable with the vet.  Although her brochure emphasized her interest in the "parent" perspective, she completely dismissed everything I tried to tell her about my dog's history.  She was friendly in her handling of him, but we're going to try another spot.

Tried it for the first time today, and it was just meh.  Everything was really sweet, even when I ordered things that were supposed to be spicy.  I didn't see mussels on the menu, but maybe I overlooked them...or it's just a dinner item?  It was okay, but doesn't hold up to Sushi Pier (One, not Two) or Hiroba's.

Food is so basic for such an expensive price. Customer service isn't great, it's like they hate when you walk in and they have to do work. 

I'm staying for two more days and won't go back to this restaurant or the sports bar here. I'd rather pay more and leave the hotel.

I'm a big Starbucks fan, and have frequently become a regular at 4 different ones between South Philly, Center City and Old City.

This one isn't one of the best, but when I've gone there during a busy hour or even a slower time, they've always been pretty quick about taking orders and getting them made well and fast.

I thought this hotel was pretty good...cold air conditioned rooms...good maid services and a good restaurant downstairs to eat breakfast.
i didnt stay in my room much over the 2 and half days i was there but hey they fluffed my pillow

p.s.
thanks ralph for callin a cab for me...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Rooms are clean & upgrades are nice. The staff is friendly and pricing is just about right for the kind of service you would come to expect. 
They have a nice feature called the gallery kitchen of some sort, if you're looking for a quick bite and not having to leave the premises.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
What? 

How has this not been reviewed? 
Oh, that's right because who really treks out to the burbs to yelp?

I grew up with Angelo's and although, it always came second to Station's pizza. 

Next time, I go home - I shall re-visit for old times sake and to give a more detailed review with pix.

Wait for it. =)

If I lived closer by,I'd definitely be a regular here. The sushi was fresh & delicious. The rolls were a good size - generous without being so big you can't get them into your mouth. And they have a roll wrapped in cucumber instead of rice.... The Naruto Roll, I think. It was delicious!!  Everything was great!!

Oh my god they have barbecued squid have you tried barbecued squid this is a high-class little restaurant the sushi is so fresh that the octopus talk to me talk about a couple of cephalopods anyway I love hookah That's how Google spells Ooka when you talk into the phone
cowsandpigsmaketheearthwarm.com.

The products are always on point. But since this is the only Starbucks within miles, the lines are always long. Never any available tables. You will definitely want to pre-order your stuff if you need it fast. 

WE NEED MORE LOCATIONS,CORPORATE!  GIDDY UP!

A very safe bet for meats, spanish deli, and cafeteria type food. With the amount of people they serve the food is always fresh. This was bought by a Dominican so now they serve dominican breakfast (Mangu). 

The coffee here is on point like it should be in a latin establishment.

A quick breakfast stop on a Thursday morning around 10:30. Service was friendly enough, one employee was helpful and made little jokes with us, while the other girl just seemed grumpy at the world. Food and coffee was as expected, good as always. Cheer up a bit, ladies! But thanks for maintaining a clean shop!

Was in St Louis for 2 weeks on business and went here on a suggestion from a guy I met in a bar - boy, was I happy that I made that choice.  

This place was AWESOME.  The pie was the best that i had ever had - however, I know St Louis is not Chicago, but it sure tasted yummy.

Great craft selection on tap as well.

Friendly quiet restaurant located across from Target. We haven't tried the habachi, but ordered some lunch bento boxes. Presentation is very typical with your standard choices of teriyaki meats that is accommodated with soup and salad. Portions for the entree is on the smaller side, but decent pricing.

Great shop with skilled barbers. Prices are reasonable and they always do a great job. You can get a great fade as well as an amazing beard trim and shave. I would highly recommend this shop to anyone. Only thing is you need to have cash with you as they do not accept credit cards.

This is not the cleanest looking nor the newest gym, but it is the closest one to me that offers hip hop aerobics class! Though they were in the process of getting a new instructor....It does its purpose, it has all the workout necessities for me including indv. tvs on certain treadmills !
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Check in was easy. The hotel was well maintained and clean. The hotel staff was helpful. I would recommend asking for an external view room because the interior rooms sucked. My view was a wall which limited the natural light. I did not like this. There are ample restaurants near. The fitness area is nice as well.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Stopped in here for some chinese food based on the number of stars and reviews for this place. I walked in just before the dinner hour and the place was empty, only the employees were there. I ordered my food and was out the door quickly. It was good food though. The employees were very friendly too.

This is one of my favorite places to have sushi in Philadelphia. I discovered it during the summer of 2007 and have been addicted ever since. My boyfriend and I love the all-you-can-eat and BYOW aspects. 

The service is quick, sushi is fresh, and fried ice-cream is perfect.

Shortest drive-thru line, so I took a shot. 

Their spicy chicken sandwich isn't terrible, but it could use a little more toppings. Can a fella get some tomatoes or as least some sauces? The fries, were actually very good. Dare I say, almost better than Mickey D's? 

Don't come at me! BK got me in a moment of weakness.

Happy Hour Monday-Friday 4-7 p.m.


- Mondays: $2.50 shots, Well or Call

- Tuesdays: $1.50 Imported Beers

- Wednesdays: $3.00 Martinis, Cosmos, and Lemon Drops

- Thursdays: Half-price Infernos

- Fridays: $2.50 house wines


Receive complimentary shrimp cocktails and selected appetizers with purchase of cocktail.

This place is just amazing! Great ambiance, reasonably priced, cozy, romantic. It is great for dinner dates, or business meetings or juts plain going out and treating yourself for pure fun....bottom line, you will not go wrong here.

Do not pass on the opportunity to eat dinner here, you will love it.

Excellent!! Had the clam chowder, which was incredible! The flavors were all unique, not your usual clam chowder.  The shrimp carbonara was very well done with homemade pasta, spring peas and lamb bacon! The staff were attentive and having a great time together!

Great selection in a narrow, over-stuffed location on Campbell.  I found a few premium spirits that are no longer available in the Phoenix area, and they were at the old prices too.  Beer selection was quite notable and I appreciated the availability of single bottles.  I will probably stop here on every visit to Tucson.

Great place to order delivery from. Have never had any problems with our order and the pizza quality hits the spot every time. Their sauce has a good tang and not sweet and their cheese coats the pizzas well.  It's definitely my go-to for when you just want to have a lazy night at home and not worry about cooking.

Left a significant amount of grime on the front of my car and on the lower side panels. I'm having trouble finding a good car wash here. I'd give it one star if I lived somewhere else with better options (ex. Brown Bear in Bellevue, WA). But relatively speaking, it's an okay option for the area.

Great pub burger and great toasted ravioli for dinner while waiting for my flight. The ravioli was nice and toasted and sprinkled with Parmesan cheese and served with marinara. It was quite good. The burger and fries were very nicely prepared and fresh tasting.

Doughnuts were OK, definitely lots of local places doing them better.  Coffee was decent and their breakfast bagels are pretty tasty. Service was adequate, but nothing memorable. Overall a bit of a letdown after seeing commercials for DD for years but never having a location nearby.

Bad. I STILL remember how horrible the food was and how inept our waiter was.  Avoid this place, even if it is within walking distance of your hotel.  Unless of course you don't mind just going for cocktails.  (I visited on my Bday last Aug, 2013, just cleaning up my draft reviews, I reckon I had hoped to ad photos).

This is the resrurant inside the Hilton, It has really good food really however slow service. I ordered a bacon cheese burger it didn't have the bacon on it, but they  brought me out a lot of bacon to make up for it.  good price except for the little bit slow service, overall it was a great experience

Ummmm so yea... I waited WAY to long to drive up here. The food was great! Doing Keto and waitress was super helpful pointing out rolls without rice. Decent freshness for the fish-- only negative was wasabi was not spicy. Tasted like wasabi, but didn't have the burn. Guess I'll be trekking for sushi from now on. YUM.

Korean owned sushi joint with strip club neon lights, specializing in jive ass California rolls and other cooked stuff. The teppan tables are manned by white guys, which I find ironic, because in California all of the teppan tables are staffed by Mexicans.

We were staying at the Le Pavillon right next door and stopped into the VooDoo Two Lounge on our way back from the Quarter.  We enjoyed a great, low-key atmosphere and some great drink specials.  Not crazy crowded or loud.  And with the big projector tv, was a great place to watch NBA playoffs.  Great place.

Average quality and prices. I had the teriyaki beef bento with miso, rice, pork dumplings and a California roll. It was more than enough food. Taste was comparable to multiple other places. My wife had a couple of sushi rolls she really enjoyed. Overall...ok.

The entire staff at Briarcrest is truly caring and compassionate.  The doctors take the time with you and your pet. They clearly explain your options.  The best part is their follow up.  I would recommend Briarcrest to everyone whose pet is a family member.

You wouldn't think that at the Circus Circus they could have such GREAT sushi, but they do. 

The only reason I give 4 instead of 5 stars is becuase you have to WAIT forever to get seated...but that is what happens when a restaurants is understaffed and has great food!

Golden Crust is a little better than average. Whenever you order over the phone, they never have a person who seems to understand the most basic of words. It always takes 5 minutes to place a simple order. You're better off going to Fiesta Pizza up Germantown...but this place does have beer...and Four Loko.

This hotel is great for a one or 2 night stay.  The location is great, and it has everything you would need for a short stay.  The room is small, but extremely clean.  We were on a high floor so we didn't experience any of the noise issues other people complained about.  I would stay again :)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Pricey (this is Montecito) but excellent. The service here is top notch too. 

I was a little skeptical because I don't like when pizza is charred - I think pizza aficionados call it "leopard spotting" - but I asked for it without that and it was perfect. You can taste the care that was put into the pizza and I love that.

I can't believe I had to wait until my 60's to have a Double Double Animal Style.  I have been deprived all these years.  This is a proper burger cooked the proper way on a proper bun for a bargain price.  The fries...not so much and as such a star is taken away.  Sorry.

Potentially the worst car wash I have ever had. Not only was my car filthy after spending about $40, but they literally seemed to just breeze by everything during the walk through. Truly the worst car wash experience and a complete scam for the money. Will never be back. Pity, because it is a beautiful place.

Best sushi in Philadelphia! The quality of the fish here is amazing! But this place is not just a great sushi restaurant but it has all the accompaniments to make the meal fantastic, edamame with wasabi salt so de-lish! The eggplant with tofu and mushroom sides are amazing, order them!

Enterprise runs less shuttles than the other agencies at the airport. And they have less agents than the others as well. The experience from standing at the curb waiting for the shuttle to driving away in the rental car took 1.5 hours. Will choose another agency next time.

It's a pain in the butt to get back to the hotel.  There are several shopping dining options in the area.  Wild Ginger is a very tasty place to dine.
Rooms were clean.  Bathroom only had a shower, no tub.  Glad I shaved my legs before I went! Whole hotel was exactly as you would expect from HIE.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Basically what you would expect from a suburban Wendy's.  The restaurant was reasonably clean.  The place was quiet except for the piped in music.  I can't remember being in a fast food restaurant that was this dead at 8 pm.  Must be the community.  Food was OK

Breaux Mart  is a nice neighborhood grocery. Locally owned, not a national chain.  Whether it is the weekly shopping or just popping in for a quick purchase, there is seldom a long wait in line.  The store is clean.  The veggies are fresh. They always have a fair amount of help in store.

Enjoy breakfast here! They make fresh made tortillas and salsa that complement the dishes they offer on the menu. I've had the chorizo, egg and beans and this was my favorite.

I recommend stopping in and making repeat visits. Service is friendly and the environment is clean and open.

A Full Plate did the catering for a work event I planned.  They were great.  Responsive, reasonably priced, and the food was fantastic.  I will definitely use them again.  For larger events, they will also work with party rental companies, so you don't have deal with multiple vendors.  That's a great time saver.

Decent hotel. Very clean and friendly staff. Excellent location- walking distance to the French Quarter. If you stay, bring your earplugs. From the 14th floor i heard every horn honk on the street, every siren (and there were a  lot), every hallway chat, every door in my wing open and close - all night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This supermarket is super sketch but considering there aren't much asian supermarkets in the area, I guess it'll suffice. 

Everything in stock is super over priced but I guess they kind of have to to make end's meet and also since there aren't any competitors around.

I have not tried the main restaurant on 9th street, but I will say that the shrimp low mein I got from the reading terminal location was very good. I will have to try the restaurant soon. I gave this review 3 stars, because the service could have been better.

Cheap, fast Chinese food.  Stay with the duck, pork, and soy chicken.  The spare ribs have too little meat.  The soups, and bok choy, or Chinese broccoli are definitely a bargain.  If the quality of the meat was just a little higher this would be a real street food gem.  I do love the Reading Market--A Philly tradition!

this restaurant feels like a chain...or that it is the first incarnation of a concept that is meant to be one...the food wasn't really bad, pre se...it just lacked any sort of care or love or soul...the waitress was fine, but seemed wooden, corporate, detached...overall i was disappointed with the experience

Bourbon street is crazy. I can only imagine what it is on a slow day. Seems like it's party 24/7. If you are here you need to get a grenade, then drink it fast, than come back for another and I'm pretty sure you'll be feeling it by your 3rd one. These little suckers are potent.

I went in 40 minutes before closing time and was refused service. So frustrating! They didn't offer to make an appointment later.  Basically showed us the door. Great location, but bare minimum setup and atmosphere. In desperate need of a redesign for the space and an attitude adjustment for the front desk staff.

Love this place. You can tell how the food will be by the chips and salsa, awesome! This location has a burrito not on the menu called the Jose Burrito, it's made worth grilled chicken, beans, cilantro, peppers and a touch of jalepenos topped with a white cheese sauce. Delish!

Hotel is nice. Restaurant ok.

Food at the R&R Grill isn't great and the beer selection is poor for a hotel chain that touts itself as the "Beer Hotel" (four points hotels). Service was great. Ambiance was, well, loungish though they were playing Paula Abdul hits. Margaritas were great.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Decent selection.  Very Americanized but still tasty!  Cute venue.  Friendly servers.  

They have a happy hour which makes it way more worth the trip.  

Weird but really uncomfortable chairs with short backs - feels like you're sitting upright on a stool the entire dinner

The wait service is all I can really rave about.  My waitress was a very friendly.  

Who ever runs the cash register need a lesson on customer service.  It's my guess he's the owners son with some sort of attitude.

The food was abundant but just so so.

I'll find another place to meet my needs next time through.

Went to this bar, after THE Bar (the Florida Bar Exam) & it was a-ok for me. The bartender knew what all her patrons had just been through so she was working her tail off keeping glasses full.  I wouldn't try the spinach dip (too salty, too much parmesan) but given the circumstances it was an acceptable spot.

They do not honor wash packages that were bought when this place was Cardinals Car Wash.  Typical of businesses these days, one sells knowing they have services to honor and the other buys knowing they won't honor those services.  Would thought they would have updated it by this time as well but it still looks like a dump.

It's okay, not great...

Service was pretty good... but since the food was slightly less than mediocre, not so important to me. 

UPDATE: It is one of the only restaurant-restuarants in Suburban square that was open, so I went back another time... Salads are okay... nothing special though.

Bringing the speakeasy vibe to Tucson. There's a slight dilemma though: The cocktails are high end with price tags to match, yet the place as a whole has more of the bare bones starkness of a dive bar. Friday nights in January are neither too crowded to get a seat, nor busy enough to have a lively atmosphere.

This is pretty good.  I had just a cup of the peanut butter ice cream w/ no mix-ins or fancy stuff.  Yummy by itself!

For ice cream, it's definitely not too heavy and the guy working there was cool, not crabby or hating his life/job at all.  That was refreshing!

I stayed at the French Market Inn during our recent trip to New Orleans. 
It was during Mardi Gras and Fat Tuesday, so the hotel was packed, but they handled the crowds with ease. It's a perfect location in the french quarter. Check this place out if you're looking for a perfect hotel in NOLA!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Hand Grenades=YUMMY! They claim to be the strongest drink, not sure if they are, but they were tasty. I really should try them blended next time. Place was slow (at 3:30pm, haha) so service was very friendly. 

It was a very smooth and tasty drink, not sure what is in it, as "its a secret" but was enjoyable.

So far so good with the gym it's not bad for 21 dollars a month and I get to bring someone for free . Management class tonight so far I have not been ripped off. And I have been signed up with thisgym  for almost a year. And people are friendly and try to help me out when I need help. I only wish they had a pool
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Best sushi of my life.  My wife is a "sushi snob" and couldn't get enough of this place. This is not a less is more kind of place. At Sakana, more is more! Of course they do off very traditional dishes as well.  Great atmosphere and decent wait time.  Can't wait to come back!

Been here quite a few times, small but it is a BYOB and most of them are tiny - its more cozy...reminds me of places I've eaten in Italy.  Food and service are good, don't like when you substitute but there dishes are really good the way they are prepared.

We ordered takeout and they gave us the wrong order. Then, to get our money back, we had to bring the food back to them. What we got looked totally unappetizing, so I can't imagine our actual food would have been any better. Don't waste your time. Or money.

Loved that my tea was the perfect temperature for drinking. The description accurately depicted the flavor which you can really taste in perfectly brewed tea. It's disappointing when others serve coffee and tea at a scalding temperature that numbs your taste buds for the rest of the day.

Blah!
terrible service. The bartenders were unfriendly and acted inconvenienced by my order (jamesons on the rocks and a local beer).  She brought me a shot and all but rolled her eyes when I asked for ice. It was $12 for my drinks. The brass band was mediocre (in New Orleans???really). I won't be back.

Very good at their craft, no doubt. With that aside, these guys are elitists to no end. Because I wanted a standard cut, hold the hipster, they cut my hair how they wanted regardless. They should learn to play it safe with people who do not want something extreme.

I have to say I have always loved this Starbucks, but on Apple Maps it lists "pets allowed" which implies pets can be inside. Today I was asked to take my small dog on a leash outside. Doesn't really seem like pets are allowed. Just because you serve a puppuccino doesn't make you a pet friendly Starbucks. Very disappointing.

Truly enjoyed their pizza. I've been trying to find good pizza in Nashville and this was definitely it. I had a salami with spicy honey pizza that was phenomenal. It reminded me a bit of Roberta's Bee Sting pizza in Brooklyn. Great spot and I'll definitely be ordering takeout from here again soon.

What a diamond in the rough. Housed in the midst of an outdated strip mall, this comic book store-meets-modern barbershop is a real Jersey gem. Friendly staff, unbeatable prices, and haircuts that look like you paid way more than you did.

Do yourself a favor and get your next cut at Webb's. You won't regret it.

Homemade ice cream, a few around Nashville. We waited in line and ordered the coffee and peanut butter with chocolate on a sugar cone. Small portions for the price tag (prob should charge $1-1-50 less for single serving) but a great little treat! Curious about their other flavors! Will return for sure

Pizza was very doughy and toppings were non existent. Margherita didn't have the fresh mozzarella you'd expect but instead was just bits of tomato on top of a regular cheese pizza. Maybe we got the wrong pizza? On the bright side pizza was ready within 15 mins.

Food was good, but overpriced. $17 for a freaking veggie pizza? I understand it's a craft pizza, so I will pay a bit more, but the two bartenders were plain rude and short.  I understand that you were uber busy with St. Patrick's Parade debunks and the volleyball crowd, but you can relax and act interested in people.

Food is good considering it's a chinese takeout, great cause it was near the office but they've since moved and changed their name if anyone is looking for them. 

https://www.yelp.com/biz/golden-empress-garden-philadelphia
Golden Empress Garden
618 South Street
Philadelphia, PA 19147

Food tastes good, but not authentic. Service is prompt but not very good. The server was so busy that he had no time for small talk or smiles. And he never checked back after delivering the food.
Clean place, playing Mexican tunes. Overall experience was okay. 

I doubt i will be back.

The ambiance was cozy and our server was polite. The escarole soup was tasty, but didn't have much escarole. The lobster risotto needed some seasoning and was good but not great. My friend had the carbonara pasta and thought it was good. My biggest complaint are the dishes were small for the price.

Went here on a Sunday for a night in philly with Boo. Service was good and everyone was was very nice and attentive. They had good beers and sakes, and the fish was good. Had a few rolls, tofu, and sashimi, everything was good but nothing was spectacular. Definitely worth a try, and worth the price.

Best Dunkin' Donuts service you can possibly find! I'm in and out in the morning and that's the way a morning rush at a popular morning coffee and donut spot should be. Nevermind the food and the sometimes pricey combos the service at this particular Dunkin' sets it apart from the rest.

Worst hotel stay ever! Hotel gone downhill since our stay here four years ago. Big groups here very noisy and rude. No peace at the pool either. Awful experience and to add insult to injury they will charge you a $25 per day resort charge on top of the room charge!! We will not be back!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
It's a nice place with a great atmosphere, but nothing stands out. 3*

Customer service is excellent. The server is incredibly attentive. 4*

I only tried the sushi and it doesn't stand out. The taste is just so-so. I personally think that the sushi is a bit dry. 3*

After all the glowing review, I have to say I'm disappointed.

Food: my pizza is a little bit undercooked. So, 2* there. Though the taste is excellent. 

Customer Service: It is probably one of the worst around. I asked the owner (the pizza maker) several questions and he didn't want to answer. Not a very friendly guy. 0*

We were staying at The Best Western plus along Nugget Ave & this was an option for delivery. It took about 45+ minutes but it was still warm when it got to us. Flavor & price were on point. Just did smalls- would have wished for utensils & plates since it was a Grub-hub order but I tore off the top of one box & used it as a plate

Love the architecture at this Publix! It's def not as bad as the reviews say it is. It's clean, I find the staff mostly friendly-hey they deal with a lot of jerks all day! It's all about how YOU treat someone that counts!                          You can pick up essentials here, get money

It's difficult to write reviews for chains that are really consistent! But this In-N-Out is pretty much like every other In-N-Out. Animal style fries are delicious. Or if I don't feel like that I get a grilled cheese. :) Quick service for how busy it is and consistently good.

Pleasantly surprised to find this mom and pop chines restaurant near my apartment. Ordered the lunch special for $6.95 which includes (I ordered the shrimp Egg Fu Yung) your entree fried rice and a drink of your choice. I've already been here twice and have left full and satisfied. Will return definitely!

A few years ago, this place was sold to new owners, and now it's gone completely downhill.  The former owner strove for authentic Italian ingredients in the pizzas as well as sandwiches and was Italian herself.  The new owners know nothing about that stuff, except how to run a restaurant.  The authentic feel of this place is gone.

The place is too loud to get any work done. The environment feels a bit tense because there are too many employees talking and laughing just as loud as the customers. It doesn't have the sophisticated feeling as the other Starbucks I have gone to in Tucson.

As Holiday Inn Express Hotel's go, this one is top-notch.  Good service, GREAT room, good location (right across from Lucas Oil Stadium - I mean right across the street) and decent parking.  The rates are very reasonable and the breakfast was piping hot.

When travel takes me back to downtown Indianapolis, I'll be staying here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Had the $16 sushi/sashimi lunch set, which was a lot of food, and includes soup or salad.  The food was good, and included a "crazy" ornament on the plate that more aptly belongs in a fish tank.  Nothing to complain about, but also nothing terribly exciting.  Not a bad spot for lunch, and not crowded at all at 1pm.

The staff was so attentive and friendly.  The only down side was how extremely busy the front desks are as they have over 1000 rooms.  The room was clean and the bed comfy.  I wish the wifi was free with the cost of the rooms it was rather expensive so i did without.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Being considered one of the nicer hotels around should give the Loews some motivation to update their menu at this restaurant.  I've had so many meals here and while the food is good, its nothing special at all.  It's also quite pricey considering what it is.
Come on Loews pick up your game.
The brunch has potential..

I only walked in to take in the scene. 

The plate pricing is similar to Mimi's.  The vibe of the lounge is conservative and uptowny. The clientelle were middle-aged. The bar seemed slightly hipper.

I see it as a good place to meet up with your moneyed aunt when she comes to visit.

I love this place. A truly unique and lovely vibe. You almost forget your on Veterans. Our waiter was extremely attentive and on point. I started with a Caesar salad. Perfectly crispy and on point. For my meal, I had the lasagna and the gravy was awesome. Always a wonderful experience. Having my leftovers for lunch.

This is an authentic decent Mexican restaurant. I initially had little trouble speaking with the staff because I don't speak Spanish. However, they do have English speaking staffs who helped us ordering the food. The taste is really good, staffs are friendly and prices are normal. You should give a try.

Slightly hard to find, Fifth Quarter Lounge is sort of a random/awesome place to catch a band.  The bartender is AMAZEBALLS---seriously, just the sweetest ever.  They apparently usually cater to the heavy metal scene, though I saw a different genre the night I was there.  The beer is cheap, too!

Typical "Chinese buffet" reheated frozen food, with a fairly small selection for one of these kind of places. The food is put on the buffet with even less care (and, therefore, is even less appetizing) than usual.

Although, I was surprised and happy to discover the fried scallops were actually pretty darn tasty.

Love pizza places.  This one's not so good.  The room is long, spread out, and odd.  The crust is sweet- not a fan.  Other ingredients are just bland- lacking flavor.  Nothing special stands out about this place.  Perhaps I ordered the wrong thing?  Although, if "the wrong thing" at a pizza joint is pizza, there are issues.

It was good. The rolls were a little loose, so it made them a bit big.  It was decent and I would go back. It filled up at lunch time, so go early (11:30) if you can. It is a small place. My friend order the cabbage salad and it was HUG E.  It was topped pineapple and she loved it.

They had some good sales on their opening day we got some short ribs that were really marbled and tasted like Wagyu. They also have a lot of seafood especially octopus and baby octopus. their produce on the other hand does not seem the freshest. I would come back here for their meat sales.

Lousy drinks, bad service, not sure why it us still around.  Literally waited 15 min for a drink when there were 8 people at the bar ands mostly empty Restaurant.  I don't usually care about price, but $15 for a not very good martini?  This ain't Manhattan.  Food was moderately priced however.

Mac & Cheese should be pretty simple right?  And it is.  That's probably the downfall here.  I've sampled a few dishes now and nothing stands on its own as a meal.  The salad option helps but I don't see much hope in this concept given the product at this point.

Cake here for me and daughters vision exams and had a wonderful experience. 
The doctor was and very informative.
Nikee the store manager was so helpful and friendly.

I made her aware of my budget and she was totally understanding and she made sure I saved money.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
A hair cut is a hair cut, right?   No, one said ever! Especially, if your want a good hair cut with style and with barbers with tons of experience. 
$40 a hair cut not cheap but a really good hair cut.

https://instagram.com/hendersonvillebarbers?igshid=18354iamqeyuv

It was sooooooo GOOD!!! I went there with some friends and it turned out to be the best sushi in St. Louis that I have had. The Godzilla Roll was great and so was the Caterpillar roll. 

It was really busy when I went, so the service was a little slow, but the food was worth the wait. Good Good food. 

Check it out!!!

Delivery or pickup only.

3* all the way. Easy order and 100% accurate. Thanks for that. Packaged well too. We had sesame beef, northern vegetarian, and mushu chicken. It was all standard fare and taste.  

You can do better and you can do worse. It worked in a pinch.

Only eat here if you like croutons for bread. Both times I have eaten here the bread was super stale/crunchy (not toasted of course). Also, Subway has gotten pretty expensive, not that the franchise owner has much choice I'm sure. At least for the money, you'd think I could get soft, fresh bread. At least the staff is friendly.

Mediocre sushi, a bit expensive, but very nice decor and atmosphere. Their rice is a bit too sweet for my taste, and their rolls are pretty uninspired. I'd be willing to give it another shot though, seems like it has potential.

Can't complain about the service.

This place has some great sushi! We got several rolls but our favorite were the Sushime Special Roll and Paradaise [That's how it's spelled on the menu] Roll. We love that they have several rolls with fruit.

The service was a bit lacking but since the sushi was so good, I'll cut them some slack.

I forgot my Ralph's card and I couldn't get the phone number right in the keypad so the cashier scanned his Ralph's card from his keys which was very generous of him to do :)

Best grocery store in Goleta (seriously, IV Albertson's and Vons doesn't compare).

There's always an issue with them getting your order right at this location. They keep putting there young people on the drive thru who have attitude problems and I don't understand why. If YOU made a mistake in my order how are you getting an attitude with me?!

We ordered an iced caramel latte and chai latte.   They were both flavorful even though they are definitely over priced but then again that's pretty much most coffee shops.  The staff was friendly and the store was clean with plenty of space for social distancing.

My husband and I absolutely LOVED this place. We had a scrumptious meal here. This is a really hip and yummy place and I loved every bite. It had me thinking of moving to Indianapolis, it was that good! Felt and tasted just like any Napa or Sonoma fine dining restaurant, only that would have a x 2 bill.

The Arch was just right outside our hotel. A+ for that. Everybody was so nice and welcoming, it really made our stay here enjoyable. We had a good view from our window. They even took the time to print us a map and steer us to the original Ted Drewes Custard place. THANK YOU!! YOU ARE AWESOME.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Best restaurant in maple shade and then some. Service is excellent 80% of the time, and food is always good, delicious and hot. 

Coffee is fantastic and portions are enormous. The prices are excellent too. 

We go almost every Sunday after church, and every Sunday is great and yummy.

Love this place! It's an absolute must visit every time I come to New Orleans. I love the open air market and the live music. They had a musician when I visited. Best time to come is early morning to beat the crowd. It was a great experience to have a beignet in spite of COVID.

Expect to leave hungry. 

I understand their "thing" is "this is omakase in Nola" but for the love of god at least ask patrons if they want to re-visit anything instead of barreling through to dessert. Or stop calling it omakase, call it "chef tasting" or some shit. 

Ingredients were fantastic but for the cost, nah.

Simple, delicious and exactly what it should be. Don't like the side dishes because they are the typical rice and refried beans you expect. They can make it unique by creating real homemade dishes that would compliment their food. The tacos are authentic and seasoned very well. Cold beer and good chips and salsa are great.

Customer service really is terrible and they take a long time to give you your food the majority of the time- even if it's just one burrito!  I've never heard a welcome, thank you or please from anyone the employees.  Their fish tacos are amazing but I may not ever go back because of the service...

Great bar atmosphere.  But the food is a big meh.  The tuna appetizer was okay, but the steak bites were supposed to be filet, nope.  Don't know what kind of steak it was but definitely not filet.  I only eat filet so I know it well.  I like the bar over all, maybe the burgers will be better, I may try that next time.

Expect to wait 15 min. for a table of four. The floor space in the West end location is much narrow and smaller, the decor is very clean, bright and modern. Everything tasted just the same as the South Common location. Since the day it opened, I find the Dragon eye to be smaller and smaller in portion?

Coffee usually made well. No problems with the drinks. The line can get lengthy due to inattentive staff. Besides that, shop is clean, parking can be scarce due to it's location (tight strip with Verizon & Monroe Muffler) . It's a usual driveby for us on the way to Sam's Club. Worth the run in.

Nice location if you want to be away from the crowds of the French Quarter. A few good dinner options within a short walk. Staff and services are on par with most Aloft locations. 

Free wifi, plus valet parking is $39 a night. About the going rate at the hotels in the area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Edible, but barely. The good news is that I don't think any Pandas were killed for my order. Sadly, I don't think any garden was, either. The food is greasy, bland, and strangely metallic tasting. Not sure if this even rates as takeout Chinese. Maybe it's thow out Chinese? On a positive note, it is very cheap.

Ridiculous. Salads weren't fresh, the french onion soup was over-spiced and watery. Can't speak to the breakfast here, although I've read it's good..

Waitress was in an awful mood, was rude to our whole party. And what kind of "cafe" only offers basic coffee? 

Do yourself a favor and stop by somewhere else.

did the lunch special. good price for so much sushi. but I really didn't think the sushi was that great. maybe you get what you pay for. the rice was very soft too. the place is def small as other reviewers mentioned. I think I did Eel, spicy shrimp, and asparagus.

Nico's is perfect if you can't make it to spots like Maico, Anita's, or La Fresita. 
Standard burritos, nothing-special tortillas, big portions. 

Don't come here expecting a culinary experience, but if you have a hankering for Mexican fast food and nothing else is available, definitely make a stop at Nico's.

Steak dish with anchovy dish. Do it. Waiter suggestion and we LOVED IT. Started with the bread, the oil is phenomenal. Gin cocktails were delicious. Just really great experience overall. Came here with out of town guests for their last Nashville meal. It was delicious and great service.

Fresh sushi, not the best I've ever had. Like some other reviewer, my server was sweaty...something you'd expect during an August day at an outdoor cafe. Clearly they need to work on the AC during the summer months. This place was decent, not knock your socks off.

(2.50 stars)  Reliably good food and service at this very large highway eatery.  The menu combines several Chinese cuisines with a menu page or two of Chinese-American choices.  I've enjoyed what I've ordered here.

The layout of Golden City resembles a banquet hall; by no coincidence, many catered events are held here.

One fine little full scale grocery store located in the Soulard. This store has been at its current location for many years, under different owner's. It was originally a National Food Store.
    Overall the quality is great and they have anything you want a large chain would carry.

I love their Charburger with cheese and onion rings!! The patty is juicy and veggies are fresh. Their ranch dressing is also great! Although I know one meal at The Habit gives me almost 1000 calories, I can't stop going there!!

If they had more spots and inside sitting, I would give them 5 stars!

severe allergic reaction suffered here!!! DO NOT COME HERE IF YOU HAVE ALLERGIES.

i triple checked with the waitress about gluten allergies. she still said the spicy tuna was safe. i took one bite, and it was riddled with tempura flakes. now i'm suffering from an intense allergy attack. 

it's straight up negligence.

This gym is located on the 6th floor of the Conrad. It is well above average! 

It's stocked for your workout! 

Plenty of cardio equipment... Treadmills, elliptical, and bikes.
Full line of weight machines.
Free weights
Mats
TV's 
Cold water and cold towels/ regular towels too.

You get get a decent workout here!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've been to HR locations all around the country and this one was by far the worst. My onion rings came out cold twice. I think that the grease was old or something because everything that we ordered fried was overly crispy and burnt. Yuck, what a waste of a meal. I wish I would've had an authentic NOLA dinner.

Cool hole-in-the-wall vibe with good drink specials and a surprisingly large space. The front area is smoking-allowed, while the back is not--and they actually do a good job with fans so the smoke doesn't make its way to the back. There was a decent sized porch that seemed nice too.

Kim Cameron, Valencia, CA
This place is good, but not the best! My friend & I used to joke that the food would give us stomach "issues", if you know what I mean... :/ I always get cheese enchiladas because they are my favorite Mexican food, & Rose Cafe's are much better (the sauce especially). Sorry Super Cuca's!

Stayed here again for one night when visiting in the area, and things have stayed just about the same, which is good. Clean rooms, convenient location, pet friendly, free WiFi. 

We saved a few bucks and didn't opt for the room with refrigerator and microwave.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Average.  Just average.  Also I never had a cold brew before that was chalky and subsequently told that was normal.  I like my cold brews smooth like at other spots in town "handlebar / French press".  

Meh.  But the seating is nice and free parking- so choose what matters more for you.

This place is horrible.  Run don't walk away from this place. They are clueless. They ruined my wife's GF pasta.  Over cooked. Her chicken was rubbery. Service was mediocre. The place was empty on a Saturday nite.  That is all you need to know.  They won't last the year.

Car was fine. Returning it was more complicated than it needed to be. Three attendants in the booth. Only one assisting customers. Samilah should be trained that if she sees a customer walking to her from the line, she should not continuously say "nextnextnextnextnext." How unbelievably rude.

My car was completely filthy when I brought it in. It left looking great inside and out. For the price I think they do a really good job. I was in and out pretty quickly. And everyone that worked there was very nice. I would definitely get my car washed there again.

Not bad. Food is ok, a bit bland, but served hot and fast. Decent menu selection including Chili Colorado. Open 24 hours, good location. Fast service. 3 star food but an extra star for everything else, including price which was under $10 for a meal with good portion size.

It's alright. I think they could do a little better than just tossing your chicken and fries in a cardboard box that starts sweating through with grease after a minute. The chicken is solidly good, though, and I like the shakes. I also feel like the wait here is a little longer than it ought to be, considering the simple setup.

Another fun stay here.very nice pool area. Staff was friendly and efficient. Just steps from the beach, so you get the best of both worlds. Room was decent. Air conditioning was VERY loud. Seemed like bathroom could have been cleaned a little better. Walking distance to many bars, stores and restaurants.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
YUM!!!!  tons of toppings, lots of ice cream flavors, crazy long hours, and staff that is ALWAYS CLEANING.  i love me some clean ice cream joints!

this is a definite must go.  hopefully it will encourage a revitalization of the surrounding shops and westmont theatre across the street.

I've taken several items to this cleaners and they always do a great job. They have cleaned everything from elegant dresses to suit jackets to purses, and they are always done in a timely fashion. Even a jacket that what I thought was stained beyond repair, they managed to make look new again. Staff is friendly too!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I love this car wash, and the people that work here. It's always very clean and the vacuums have very good suction. If I could change one thing I would like it if they  sprayed off the problem areas of your car as you enter the car wash but other than that I'm very pleased and I come here often.

Update: I shared my disappointments with the manager; I subsequently received an apology and gift certificate to try them again. I'm not sure if it's worth the time to return, but I appreciated the last ditch effort to get us back in for another meal. Adding a star back.

This is what a 5 star restaurant is all about. Appetizer was a goat cheese caprini. Hubby had the rack of lamb with scalloped potatoes and I had the pistachio crusted trout with sauted fresh spinach. Both were excellent. I highly recommend this restaurant.

Not a big fan of 'bucks but one thing they do well is consistency and efficiency - except at this place. But  OMG the wait here is ungodly...........
You WILL WAIT at least 15-30 min for coffee. 

Just go into Kroger and buy the coffee - take it home and brew it yourself because you will get it quicker than this location.

The ambience leaves a bit to be desired, but the service was excellent and the staff friendly. We went on a Monday night which was nice because it's free margarita night! The food was good and tasty but mine was a bit on the dry side. The price was right so i would give it another shot and try something different.

Decent coffee, but always busy and with a limited selection of options for donuts/ muffins. Staff isn't terribly friendly, but at least they're not rude. Drive through has room for improvement- not much they can do given the set up of the shopping center as a whole, though. 

Not a terrible option in a pinch.

Went and tried the spaghetti and meatballs...awesome! great sauce and really great meatballs stuffed with cheese really made this, usually boring, dish something special.  not too expensive and a pretty decent wine list...going to make it the new regular italian spot

Tony's pizza is really to die for. Fresh dough, true wood fired brick oven, oh my goodness good ingredients.  When he makes it, his nutella pudding is amazing (call ahead day before and he'll whip you up a batch).

Highly recommend this hidden gem in Ardmore.  You won't regret it.

Ummmm.....okay in a pinch but not a place I'd go out of my way for.  

I'm a fan of soup. Both hot and sour and egg drop/wonton mix were okay. The beef in our  chow fun was tough and chewy. Chicken chow mein lacked the 'je ne sais quoi' and the orange beef should just be called "beef." It wasn't bad, but lacked orange flavor.

They once filmed an episode
Of Bar Rescue here. 
By the looks of the "crowd"
The end might be near. 

I guess Jon Taffer
Can't even save this place. 
Selling specialty cups
With a glowing skull face. 

Something should be done 
If Spirits on Bourbon 
Wants to start seeing 
Their customers returning.

We recently went back and got take out.  We shared a vegetable calzone and it was huge but quite plain tasting as I only really tasted the cheese.  The sauce they provided was ok but not enough.  The spaghetti was average also.  So if you want a lot of food for your $ they will deliver.

Wow, what can I say?  Publix strikes out wherever I go!  I found numerous products discounted and the price was actually reasonable.  Then I notice the product is expired!!!!   How can they get away with selling expired product?  This has happened at several different stores.  Next time I'm taking pictures!

We need to keep this sushi place a KEEPER in East Nashville! We had the edamame, tempura and crunchy shrimp, and mackerel nigiri. Everything tasted awesome...sushi was prepared in front of you. The place is perfect to have conversation and even meet other sushi lovers. Will be going to try their soup with ramen!!

Yikes. This location was terrible. I ordered the beef tacquitos, and the corn tortilla was still raw and falling apart inside. 

The location itself has the same decor of other Nico's locations, though it was a tad dirtier and smaller. The prices are on the lower side, but I definitely wouldn't recommend this place to anyone else.

I moved in down the street and am happy to have this be my local market. Lot of options, especially for "grab and go people" like myself. Friendly staff. Welcoming decor. Parking is easy.

I remember the old Robert's in this location. I liked it then too, but this is a thousand times better.

This place was very cool and creative. My friend and I had their famous shark attack drink. They literally will put a show on for this drink.
