The ring a bell, drop a cute gator in the drink and fill a shark with red liquid and dunk it in your drink. Definitely recommend stopping here at least once if your in the area.

This was not good. Nothing had much flavor. The veggie protein I tried was cold. The beans had that weird powdery texture and I also bit into a few really hard pieces of rice. The staff was friendly and the space is nice for a quick lunch, but man...that food needs some help.

After all the great reviews, I was excited to try this place. Unfortunately, our experience was not great. My soup was bland and the noodles were very firm. My husbands dish was incredibly greasy and bland as well. My green tea was watered down and they claimed to not have tapioca yet about 5 minutes later I saw them serving it.

I'm going to go with a 3 star on this one, I'm a little torn on it because the location, a Starbucks in the lobby and Shula's on site make this Westin a nice place to stay.

Questionable: Front desk service, on two different stays I could have had better service.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've been here a couple of times, I'm not sure if this should not be classified as a dive bar. I think they had the 'Beast' on tap. If you go here you are gonna leave smelling of smoke. I hate that but if you are looking for a place to have a beer with normal folk and not be bothered got it.

I've been doing my dry cleaning at Soulard laundry mat for over two years now. I've never had a complaint about them. They are budget friendly and timely. The ladies are always helpful when they take my laundry. I need to ask their names because I go there once a week and they always help me out :)
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Very impressive!

Celena is the associate who processed my order and she is AMAZING and very familiar with how to match glasses to faces and preferences and has a knack for helping you maximize your vision insurance plan if you have one. I have rarely seen this high of a level of customer service anywhere ever. Go here.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
The Hand Grenade is dubbed New Orlean's most powerful drink so of course I had to try it. It was also warm that day so having a nice cold drink walking around Bourbon St really hit the spot. 

Even though the drink is sweet and doesn't taste like strong alcohol, it's one of those drinks that creep on you later.

We were warned. . . but we went against the advice of locals and ate the pineapple. They were not kidding, those lil chunks of fruit are STRONG. Just another bit of a dive bar. Solid music, lots of space to wander both inside and out. Seems to be a Chicago bar judging by the sports paraphernalia.

It's not the best Chinese that I've had in NJ, but it's affordable and more a hit than a miss. Shrimp with broccoli is bueno. If you order Their general tso chicken ask for it extra crispy. I've never actually eaten inside the restaurant because its tiny with minimal seating, but take out and delivery are fast.

I've been here three time and my car just does not get clean. Today my car came out of the wash with several scratches that weren't there before! When I tried to talk to the guy he just ignored me and said that it was impossible for that to happen. I'll never be coming back to this place.

Nice hotel near Valley Forge national site and not far from Philadelphia. Room was clean and large with a sitting area and two beds. Nothing fancy but that's okay with me. Glad to have the mini fridge to use. Reasonably priced and friendly staff. No issues of concern.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
No local wines or beers

Solid place for all of the mainstream liquors and beers but they don't have any of the local wines. There's at least 8 local wineries that they could be stocking but not to have 1 is a shame.

Points for being very helpful but helpfulness can only take you so far if you don't actually have the merchandise.

I mobile order at this location pretty regularly and I usually ask for no foam because my $5 drink is often half full. Today when I picked up my order (in which I requested no foam) I open my drink to find it actually not even close to full.....just sucks when you're paying over $5 for a drink and it's not even a full cup.

Expensive, flavor-less, shiny looking sushi.  Small portions.  Will travel the extra distance next time for a better product.  Okura in Hockessin, DE isn't too far and has far superior sushi.

Nice atmosphere and great service, but wouldn't rush back here for sushi.

UPDATE : i get my hair done 2 doors down from this place . Yesterday as i got out of my car to  go to my  hair dresser. The owner of the nail salon came running out of the shop and damn near grab me . Following me to my hairdresser. I had to turn around and yell at her to leave me alone.

We tried cotton candy, salted caramel, red velvet cake and one other flavor. They were out of the one I wanted to try, not a terrible ordeal. Overall the ice cream was very good.

But the young man helping us was outside with his friends when we walked up and he appeared to be the only person working. Definitely unprofessional.

Cutest shop ever!!!  Love the flavor selection, def worth a trip!  3 scoops will set ya back $6.  We tried:
Reisling pear sorbet-my fav
Goat cheese and berry (?)-nice
Milkiest chocolate-waaaay to grainy for me
Salted caramel-pretty yummie
Brambleberry-my other fave
Peach cobbler-ish one-meh

Pretty good food, standard enchiladas with melted cheese and red sauce, beans and rice.  Chips and salsa.  Problem is it in a strip mall, kinda sketchy so you think you might get a deal, then you pay $11 and wonder what the deal is!  Needs to be priced better, or offer some lunch specials!  Friendly owner though.

I went to Gardunos last night. I had the chicken enchiladas with salsa verde. They were possibly the hottest Mexican food I have ever had but so tasty. My boyfriend had them with red salsa. The Margaritas were good. Wouldn't call it my favorite Mexican joint, but I am definitely going back.

Quick and easy!!! Friendly service and convenient location. I don't think my black mini van has had such a goos shine since I brought it home and this made it look new! So glad too after the love bugs wreaked their havoc. $18 was well worth it for the full treatment.

Quick and easy, just how I like my car renting experience. I've been traveling on business for the better part of this year. The Enterprise location has been my best experience by far. The safe if friendly and they even give me a complementary upgrade when I happen to have people traveling with me.  Great location.

unorganized. 
girl with short blonde hair and glasses was extremely rude when i asked about about the rest of my order after about 5 minutes of waiting. instead of being courteous, she responds with "i'm just making drinks"

hopefully someone sees this and teaches her about customer service

This place is not the same since its opened! Always late on their time estimate, forget to fix things you asked them to do it! It is not that good place to fix my cars at! Will never come back. Smyrna has many many good mechanics that willing to take my money!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
We had a great dinner here the other night.  Before the meal we got warm towels.  Free salad and soup before the main courses.  The wait staff was nice and pleasant.  The sushi was pretty decent and reasonably priced. I also tried the chicken teriyaki appetizer, but wasn't quite as impressed.

Would come back again.

I call crap on COVID as an excuse for days old donuts, coffee that is cold or so dam hot it's burnt.  If there is a true owner of this business and they live anywhere near it I implore you to go taste your own products. It's not worth the money you expect to get for it.  I fee Starbucks across the street will close you down soon.

Wendy's is still a Wendy's in terms of food but at least this location has their new renovated look which for a fast food joint isn't half bad.  They're not too far off 309 so that was also an easy on/off highway plus and our order was done right the first time.

In the world of grease, what more could you ask for?

The service was great. We sat down, ordered our drinks and appetizer within 5 minutes. Our food was out in a fast time. The burger was good and cooked to oder. I've not had a good bun soaking burger in quite sometime. The fries were of the frozen variety so that was the only downside.

Just had my hubby pick up our two personal pizzas.. margherita and broccoli rabe and onion .. 
our 1st time ordering here , and last 
The pizzas were burnt ( both of them) if we were so hungry I'd brought them back .. sorry we thought we would give this small restaurant a try during pandemic

Hands down, best grilled cheese sandwich EVAR! Not sure they still have it on the menu because I haven't been in ages, but used to get it every time I went, it is amazing. Grilled sourdough with yellow mustard, tomatoes, and grilled onion with American. Delish.

Cedar wood, salted caramel and brambleberry crisp to name a few. You can't visit Nashville without a trip to Jeni's! The weekend evenings are crowded, but other than that you can usually go through the line pretty quickly. Feel free to sample every ice cream on the line. It's worth it.

Being an all glass walled dining area located in city garden the view is great. The service is fast and very friendly. The food is pretty good but is overpriced compared to other options in the area. Good for a lunch meeting but to pricey to make a part of my regular lunch spots.

I like this Rouses because its easy for me to get around and they have most of what I am looking for.  I wish their produce was more robust and their bakery larger but thats about it.  I loved that they had a CSA over the summer and want to try that out next year if they do it again.

Haven't had McDonald's breakfast in forever! Food was ... Um... McDonald's-ish.

The girl taking my order was training which was slightly painful.

I will not be flexing my 'i can write a super awesome review' muscles here.

Just wanted to let people know their is nothing wildly right or wrong with this place.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I was scared to go to this McDonald's after all the bad reviews here, but had little choice 10:30 at night. I was pleasantly surprised. Went through the drive through and the employee promptly took my order. He was super polite. The food was exactly as expected. I wouldn't hesitate to go again.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Went to Cheese-ology today and my wife  got the bacon bacon, the kids got the 4 cheese, and i got the chicken cordon bleu. The cordon bleu was good but a weird after taste. The 4 cheese was good, and the bacon bacon was good, but they were all alittle flavorless. We will probably try it again the food wasnt bad just kinda boring.

Can't beat it for the price. Place is kind of drab inside, but the food makes up for that. Great selection of sushi and appitizers. The beef satay, gyoza, Kani salad are good. And remember, all you can eat. Staff is a bit drab too. They seem bored and annoyed when we went. Would get four stars if they just smiled!

I was so happy to see a familiar friend open sonearly for my flight home. The baristas that were working at 5am were so friendly and worked quickly to get each of us waiting in line taken care of quickly and getting us caffinated for our trips. I ordered a venti blonde cinammon dolce latte and it was delicious.

Very nice location near the monument. For walkers, it is always nice to have a reference point. 

Arrived very late and received a very warm greeting. Folks could not be more helpful. 

Rooms are large for a city location. Plenty of foodie/bar venue to enjoy around The Circle.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Dirty bathrooms, equipment broken for months, weights are rarely racked, not enough plates distributed throughout the gym, usually no spray or paper towels to sanitize equipment, bent bars, bars and other equipment are never cleaned or oiled, and rates just doubled. There's probably more I can add but you get the idea.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Delivery: Order was 45 minutes late and there was an item missing. Would have been somewhat manageable but the terrible customer service compounded the entire disaster. There are so many other sushi places in Philly; we will not be making the mistake of ordering from here ever again.

Usually I expect decent service but apparently Desiree woke up on the wrong side of the bed. I was glad that the other employee was much more pleasant. Too bad I had to deal with a lifeless Desiree who showed no signs of what customer service is or even plain old common courtesy.

Hit this location for lunch. Trusted my fellow helpers and was not disappointed. Best Mexican food I have had in the area. The enchiladas verde was outstanding. I lived in so cal for several years and no good, authentic  Mexican food when I eat it. El Changarro is the place to get it!

As a Santa Barbara local, I cannot believe that this was my first time at Goleta Sushi House! This is a quaint little spot on Hollister with decent prices. The sushi is absolutely amazingly fresh and the employees are so kind! I will most definitely be back soon! Thank you!

Hot, delicious, fresh donuts. Husband and I got a half dozen. 3 fresh glazed, 1 cream filled glazed, 1 psychedelic glazed, and 1 blueberry glazed cake doughnut. YUM! Coffee was not the best, but maybe it wasn't a fresh pot. The tasty doughnuts made up for it though!

I really love the location of this hotel. It's right in the heart of the city with plenty of restaurants and shopping. The staff was nice and the hotel was clean. We had a king room, which was a little small, but that didn't concern me too much because we only slept there. The rooms were decently priced as well.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We had a nice outside table by the railing so that we could see the boats on the river.  The red Sangaria was very tasty.  BF liked the margarita.  We didn't have food, so we can't comment on the quality.  We like the location though, so we will probably try the food someday.

My mom loves the sushi here and especially the Ama Ebi. This time was disappointing. I got to-go order on Wednesday night and took it home to share with family. 

Into my 2nd piece sushi and found a long strand of hair in my Ama Ebi nigiri!!! Not what I was expecting for the price I paid. No thanks!

It's a DD. Just like any other... Except this one runs out of donuts a lot, and messes up your order frequently. We've been in 5/6 times in the last year, and one or both problems have popped up on all but our first visit... I'm happy to have the new business out here, but they really need to work on a few things.

Spotted this place while driving by and decided to give it a try. We ordered shrimp fried rice with chicken wings. The chicken wings were really good but the rice was hard and lacked flavor. Maybe we got the bottom of the rice cooker because it was so late but that does not excuse it.  The two stars are only for the wings.

We didn't eat, but the vibe and decor were awesome.  They handled our group of 20 (unannounced) with ease.  Definitely a place I would frequent if I still lived in Philly.  Will try the food next time I am back, but it looked good based on what I saw going past me.

Got a free upgrade to a penthouse/loft, so that was pretty sweet! Didn't explore the location much, but it's only a 10-15 minute drive from downtown Nashville, which is a major plus. Free parking and hot breakfast (though it's pretty lackluster). Not too shabby.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is not out regular layover hotel, but its leaps and boy des above the Four Points PHL airport.  Access to fridge and microwaves, free breakfast, next to Philly Dinner, Denny's right next door, plus a friendly staff.  This place is great for a short stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This is a shitty Chinese place that has greasy ass food but I still eat it when I'm drunk. I think the Ethiopian place next-door is better. They're making food out of tofu product and God knows what else. That being said I love their spring rolls when I'm drunk. Also great for loosies and other smoking products.

The address is wrong on this site. It's on Little Rd in Trinity. 

We had take out wings from Alli Gators and they were just okay. I hope they are better when you actually go in the restaurant. They weren't bad...they just weren't great like everyone told me they would be. I'm hoping my next visit will change my mind.

Great service and a very nice happy hour. Pasta was average. I ordered the dill pasta special and it was made with dried dill (not fresh) so that was disappointing. The scallops I added were very tiny, but not over done so that was good. Overall, I'd come back and give it one more try.

The outside patio is beautiful. The ambiance is tranquil and relaxing. The food we tried wasn't very good. The Mediterraneo pasta had a very strange flavor and the pizza tasted like it was frozen then heated in the oven. The highlight was the butter for the bread. Doubt we will be back.

It was good, but not great. The hostess and waitress were awesome, and the atmosphere is cool.

I found most of their food to be fried and/or beige in color with few vegetables. I wouldn't refuse to go their again if a friend invited me, but I would never recommend this place.

Ordered pizza and fries for Sunday football and I can tell you, this was the biggest waste of $37. 
I asked for a cheesesteak pizza, well done, and only half of the pizza had steak and the other half was just cheese. 
My fries were no where near well done, they weren't even close to a golden brown.

This spot has become my favorite place in Tampa for Mexican food. The staff are always super friendly and the food is fantastic. I love that they are willing to make edits and have vegetarian/vegan options. Also, the horchata and jugo de jamaica are crazy good. Perfect place for a quiet and delicious dining experience.

Stopped in for some food before a Cardinals game.  Sat at the bar and had the Genoa Pizza, small version.  Very large for the price and great!  Service was great, the bartenders came alive as I created small talk which I was grateful for as I was on business on my own.  Would recommend.

Ordered take out. Very quick and cheap. Had the green chilie enchiladas and the steak tacos. Enchiladas were decent but tacos were lackluster. They gave a huge amount of guacamole but it needed salt. The orange hot sauce was very spicy and tangy- good stuff. The green one was also good.

Always great, fast, and polite during the day. 

The late night staff is rude, slow, and always "out of" random items. 

The person doing drive thru is literally yelling at people through the drive thru speaker. A drive thru that all of us have been sitting in for over 30 minutes now.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Ok I've eaten this place enough to say it's not good. Very bland and at most
Just mediocre. I've order different dishes to give the menu a full try, it's all just about the same. Nothing is amazingly tasty. Which I had high hopes because it's close to me but I prob won't order again unless I'm in a pinch.

Don't come here. No refrigerator and no microwave in the rooms AT ALL. TOLD THAT IS WAS AGAINST THE "LAW" to heat up food?? Really?? I'll never return here and I've never heard of a law where you can't heat up food in an hotel like wtf??? Craziest thing I've EVER HEARD IN MY LIFE!!!! Done.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Loved their wing zings and French fries!! Ordered from here several times! I ordered a tray of wings for my Christmas party and it was a huge hit! Everybody has been asking me for the recipe, unfortunate for me I didn't make them.... but fortunately I do know where to get them! Thanks Solly Pizza!!

Second visit was much improved. This visit tried the chicken piccata with side of pasta.  The night we revisited, they were out of IPA draught and out of scotch. How can they allow booze outage??  

Suggest sticking with and ordering only the basics. Handled our group well

On vacation in the area and our son needed a haircut. Yelp always comes through. Small shop in a  tiny L shaped strip mall. 2 barbers, chatty and skillful. Seems to have a loyal local following by the men coming and going who were familiar with the cutters. Gave a meticulous cut for 15 bucks. Go here.

I like the chimichanga & the sopapilla. 
Normally pretty fast for lunch, but tonight @ 8, I was here for about 10 min before being seated. Took another 20 to get waited on & never did get checked on. All that said, this was the exception. Normally, I get in & out in 30 min or less & they did have a couple of big groups.

Great food and quick service. Perfect for eating just before a tour. We did let have time for a sit down restaurant and could not find a quick, walk-up place. Then, we hit upon the Firehouse. There is ice cream and a deli on what seems to be the same property as the grill and bar. I highly recommend it.

We mostly get takeout here but have occasionally eaten there. Food is uniformly good - excellent Wor Won Ton soup, crispy duck, and walnut shrimp. House fried rice is also excellent. Takeout is always ready as promised and they are reasonable and friendly.

Wish they had 1/2 stars. Would be 2.5. The meat was delicious, the service was good, but the crunchy taco I got was drenched with oil from being fried. It's cheap, and close to where I live, better than Taco Bell for sure. I'll be back, but I won't be getting a crunchy taco!

This hotel sucks, sucks, sucks. My friend picked this place for us to stay while we were visiting our friends in STL. The staff are super friendly and very helpful. The room was YUCK. It was stains on the sheets and some of the towels. The bathroom floor was gross. I will never stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: MMMMmMmmmMMMMmmmmm!  I'm eating the Chipotle Shrimp Salad on this week's lunch special menu.  DELISH!  The spicy, smokey chipotle sauce on the shrimp is wonderful with the subtle, sweet homemade lime vinaigrette dressing.  I highly recommend this salad!  But order it soon... it's only on the menu this week!

Clean large spacious room with a King bed and a bathroom the size of most motel rooms. Check in was fast and easy, I did have a problem with the door lock which was promptly fixed. This is a nice property very close to downtown Philly, I would definitely stay there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I love this nail salon! It's clean and the women that own and work there are so lovely. They're kind and professional. The only downside is that it is extremely expensive. A gel manicure is $20 more compared to any other local nail salons. Other than that, Top Nails is the best nail salon around!

Wow order drink today.  It was wrong and I thought they are supposed to make it right per there policy they did but WOW why the attitude??? Not happy as I visit SB daily may need to ban this location from my visits. I bet this location may not be open too long !!!

I do like 24 hour fitness,I have been I member a very long time.
this location could use a makeover I do understand if its not in the 
Budget. Then a few upgrade would be find,I do realize its the only one in SB for visitors so I do appreciate  a place to workout at.
staff seems friendly so I will be back .
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I came in and the guy behind the bar was completely rude but this was honestly the 2nd unpleasant interaction with him. I ordered 2 containers of plain white rice, he looked at me crazy and charged me $2.95 per container that weren't even full. Customer service in St. Louis continues to suck!

Subway is just subway. Over rated multi billion dollar establishment that the name is so big no one cares about quality and taste. Sad but true. The zombies will continue feasting. I gave them 2 stars just for the fact they were smart enough to sell a shitty product and still make billions. Wish I was that smart lol.

Desperate for instant gratification I called Fusion China...........they were here in less than 30minutes and HUGE portions!  Food was alright.............the Schezuan wasn't quite spicey enough for me..........

Because they were fast and polite I'd try them again for a relaxing night at home reading.

From the moment I walked in I felt a little strange about the place, but the manager was extremely friendly.  I purchased a Groupon earlier and I had no trouble using it!  This is a place I will come to over and over again, plus the yogurt price is very affordable for any ages!  Come check it out for yourself!

Had a heck of a time finding this place even after having been here once before. After negotiating the trailer park I managed to stumble upon it. Well worth it as part of my Sunday riding ritual. Nice riverside view and pleasant atmosphere. Decent food and cold beer.  A-OK

Every Sunday riders from all over come to Peggy's Corral. Lots of bikes, a band, drink specials, vendors and all sorts of goings ons. I should love it. Sadly, I don't. I never seem to really get in the groove there. Something is missing, something I can't put my finger on. I want to like Peggy's, but...

If I could give it zero stars I would. Worst experience with take out yet. Waited for my order for an hour. A woman who was there with her family who had waited there 90 minutes finally walked up and left. El Limón Havertown needs a better system for taking and getting orders filled. This was ridiculous!!!

Fast friendly service for food to go. I love their buffalo chicken Stromboli and their steak fries are delicious. They are willing to custom make or alter their foods upon request.  The wife loves their breaded chicken sandwich. The portions are large and guaranteed to fill.

Hibachi rice is great! Take out is really slow on the weekends sometimes, but it's understandable as the establishment is small & seems very popular. It's located in the small town of imperial, and for small town sushi it's great. In comparison to some of the bigger city establishments Fuji's sushi doesn't measure up.

Been there once only but was very please by the friendly service and warmth of the waitress.
We were seated right away and ordered the shu mai (4 pieces) very good.
We both  had sushi, both very good. 

This place also does takeout which I could definitely enjoy in the future.

Most popular sushi restaurant in town, also one pf the favorite hang out place for me and mt friends.... Though the quality of the food varies from time to time...... one last time near the final I had stomachache.... But most of the times, it's fine..... So.....wish they could improve.....

When people think of all-you-can-sushi immediately think low quality.  Boy was I in for a pleasant surprise.  I've been to sushi bars in Japan so I know quality.  Everything I ate here was fresh and I'll definitely go back.  They also serve regular Japanese food which was a plus.

Best donuts in town! I had the chi and French toast donuts and loved them! I couldn't say anything bad. The selection is pretty massive. They were out of glazed but these are amazing and their americano was pretty good! Great place to get a donut and a cup of joe.

Pretty simple place to review. Restaurant mostly clean, Service is fast and friendly. This was an easy midday pitstop for a quick lunch. No complaints. Food  & service are consistent at this location. 

Picked up a sesame bagel with  egg and cheese. I wish they would bring back the lunch options like tuna and chicken salad.!

Not great but ok. Everything is just so... Generic. There is nothing special here besides consistency and the basics and maybe that's enough. Coming from Los Angeles and San Diego, how I wish there was a tacos El Gordon around Santa Barbara but for now, I guess this is the best we can get.

We got 4 Sliders, 4 Corn Dogs, 4 Chicken Sliders, 2 drinks, 2 orders of Tater Tots and some kind of donut for under $30.

Lots of fast food options in this area, but this is the only locally owned fast food establishment I've seen - so happy to be able to get huge meals, quickly, affordable and supporting local.

Not worth the hype. I was excited to check out this place since I heard people hyping it up but don't believe the hype. Their flavors are underwhelming and I was disappointed that when I came from jersey to Philly just for the honey dew flavor but sadly the machine was down. Cute for an Instagram picture but that's about it IMO.

love their soup - you can choose how spicy you want it to be. They have a great taco salad and service is phenominal. I go back at least once a month. Definitely give it a try if you are driving through Montecito and looking for something not as expensive as all the other restaurants around.

Very comfortable beds, hip minimalistic furniture.  Not much amenities like coffee.  Huge big 70 inch tv.
Easy front desk checkin.  Nice outdoor area with tables and chairs.

Very small 10 feet pool.
Decent stay close to all Atlantis casinos and all the good eats.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Staff here is extremely nice. Ambiance is great. Prices are reasonable to higher end (but keep in mind im cheap). Sushi itself is OK - good flavor but definitely not anywhere near the best sushi ive had. Again, i am from California so take this with a grain of salt.

I have been wanting to check this place out for the past year and I finally did. I'm so glad that I did and I will for sure be back. The guacamole and chipotle chicken quesadilla were delicious!  The guys were very sweet and even gave me a small sample before I ordered.

This place is always so slow and understaffed. From the meat counter to the Deli to checking out. No one is around to help with bagging or price checking. They need a floater to help with the front end so you can at least leave there if you need to grab something quickly.

Fine for basic hair-cutting needs. Certainly not a salon, but if you're just after a simple haircut it's fine. 

Prices are reasonable, and if you install their smartphone app you can make reservations before driving down to the store. Reduces wait time quite a bit, and you know in advance how busy the place is.

Had a great experience at Serafina today. Waitress was attentive and knowledgeable about the menu. Calamari was one of the best I've ever had. Salad selection wasn't that great, so I got the appetizer Carpaccio di Tonno...amazing and filling! Prices are pretty high for the portion but thats expected.

this place is new and hipster.  The line was to the front door, and the place was packed.  They could have used more counter help to ease the pain of the line.  I love the coffee in this place, and that is what I got.  I could see the drive through was also packed.  I will definitely be back here

This place is wickedly overpriced.  The rooms are the size of my closet... I've never felt claustrophobic in a hotel room before this.  Here because I was limited to employer approved hotels... and all the others were sold out.  Staff is friendly, but maybe because they're trying to compensate for everything else.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We like you tacos at the taco truck but I wish you offered cilantro without onions. We have requested that numerous times over the past two years but unfortunately you don't seem to be able to offer cilantro only. Unfortunately we had to take our business somewhere else because of this. Not everyone likes onions.

This is my personal favorite Chinese place in St. Louis. Fried rice with extra egg, potstickers and crab Rangoon are always hot and fresh. The St. Paul sandwich is good as well and a unique St. Louis tradition in way of westernized Chinese food. Seems to be family run and they sell Vess soda! ;)

I had my graduation party here with my family and it was a great meal. Food was delicious, but the service was so so. The woman who was working did not seem happy at all. I will definitely love to go back with a smaller group. It might be a more pleasant experience.

Squeak Squeak 

This place does a good job at getting the dirt off! There is no towel dry or detailers for the inside. But for a 5 minuet run my car through 5 buck wash it is great!!! They do have vacuums and trash bins but it is do it yourself!! There is a fee for the vacuums so bring your quarters!!!!

Never in my ENTIRE life have I seen a $12 watermelon! I love watermelon but there is no way I was letting my CEO buy us a watermelon  tonight. Publix didn't have an explanation to the price they just said "ok" and took it off the bill when we said it was too much.  #watermelonfail

We went there for lunch and had a salad garlic chips meatball sandwich.  The food was great and the service was good as well. I can't wait to try their pizza and wings.   I have gone to the incline resultant for years and they galena spot had not let me down.

Anxiously awaited for, Fujiyama has opened in Meridian. The sushi was spot on, only thing I wished is that they also used some sauces, especially creative ones. The freshness of the sushi was excellent and I saw some nice looking platters and a boat combo pass by. Five visits later, excellent!

Best pizza in the area!! We are from Philly and have a hard time finding good pizza around Clearwater. Bros Pizza is delicious, and the pies are huge!! I gave four stars because their delivery is terrible, always do pick up because you will wait an hour plus for pizza to be delivered.

My wife took me here for my birthday. We had great service and the waiter brought me a cool dessert.

Nice ambiance. We had seating in the front corner which was private enough for our special moments but no too secluded where you feel like your waiter may forget about you.

Order from the menu, don't get the buffet!! The beef chow fun with veggies from the pink menu is fantastic!!!!

I repeat. DO NO GET THE BUFFET! 

Otherwise the food is very very good, reasonably priced, and probably somewhat authentic based on how many Chinese people I see eating here.

After I saw the inside I opted for takeout. Most of the vinyl on the chairs was really cracked. The food is great and I think I found a new go-to restaurant on the way home from work. My picky 4yo told me it is the best food ever and I don't think I've ever heard her say that.

Service is amazing, the young men working the counter are always so nice. The food was the best Chinese we have had since moving to Indiana, General Tso's, and Orange Chicken is amazing. The crab ragoon is delicious, as are the fried wontons.  Quick service, and quality is great. We will be revisiting Ching Garden.

So this place is like taking a trip in a time machine....seriously so 1960's Chinese! The waiters are in white shirts and tuxedo bow ties, the menu is EXTENSIVE and it is soooooo delicious! The crab ragoon and fried wontons are to die for, the General Tso's chicken is delicious with all white meat! Go there its awesome!

Has got to have the worst produce of any grocery store I've been too. This place certainly doesn't take pride in the cleanliness of its most perishable product. 
When asked if they have any additional produce in the back I was informed that the guy was on break and couldn't be bothered. 

Poor excuse for a grocery store.

Had a flat tire emergency and stopped in.  They provided terrific customer service including helping me out with a ride.  They explained pricing options and allowed  me to choose without pressure. Excellent work and they excel at treating the customer well, above and beyond expectation. bravo!

It's been awful the past few months ask for a iced coffee with liquid sugar and I get regular sugar even though the sticker says liquid sugar or if I ask for extra cream I get a black iced coffee with a extra cram sticker hopefully they can get it together soon....until next time .

Loved eating here! Food and service were muy bueno. ( very good). This is a New Port Richey on highway 19. My co-worker got the tortilla soup and raved about it. For inexpensive Mexican food, we shall return. My tacos were great. Chips and salsa were right on par.

This truly is a hole in the wall. But my oh my. Great food awaits. We got pizza to go and it was fabulous. The servers asked many times if I needed something. When I visited, there was an older clientele going for a special. 
    I want to return and absorb the ambiance of the place. I'm betting there are more delights on the menu.

This is my daily go to coffee spot, the staff are friendly and fast. Every Starbucks is basically the same, this one is no worse than any other. Except the location is ideal for me and the many downtown office workers. 

The bathroom can only be opened by asking at the cash register, this is due to the central downtown location.

Really good happy hour deal. Close and convenient for Tulane students. Takes NOLA bucks! However the service is below par and they often act like the don't give a f***. Further I've heard rumors of food poisoning but I've yet to experience it and I eat there regularly. Fun for sake bombing with a group!

Ive been going to this place for over 10 years and its never disappoints. If they had twice as many tables it would still be full. Expect to wait and bring cash. A simple menu with enough choices to satisfy. The house wine is great and make sure to have dessert. Worth every penny. The parking is terrible tho.

I love how cute this place is. The atmosphere was so romantic and the service was wonderful. The food was just ok. I'm come from an old school Italian family, it just didn't live up to the hype all the reviews gave. Its not to say I wouldn't go back and try something else or just have apps & a cocktail. The environment is so nice.

This is my favorite sushi spot in Philly. I love the ambience; it is quiet and intimate. Great for a date night or a small group gathering! Servers are friendly and very attentive. I love their rolls. I have tried all of their different rolls on the menu so far. Delicious food hands down!

I used to come here in the morning and it was fine.  The last few times I came at night and the staff was joking around and not making the orders in the right order.  They need more training or different employees.  How can my mobile order of two items get split by 2 other orders

Came in with a coolant hose that had just blown and Nick helped us out right away. Knew it would be a quicker job so he had us helped immediately so we could get back on the road. Very affordable too. Even went out of their way to help us do a quick rig fix to our bumper at no charge. Thanks guys!

I've used this office twice now and have never had any problems.  Polite and courteous staff.  My only improvement I could suggest would be to extend Saturday hours.  Closing at 2pm? Very difficult to return the rental over the weekend with these types of hours.

So the food and the service was pretty good. I just felt it was overpriced, especially the wine. They use a good quality motzarella. I have to agree with Molly L., if I am given bread at an itialian retaurant I would like Olive Oil for dipping, not butter.

This place is awesome. I worked at a local car wash for 5 years and this one is definitely way better! The chemicals clean better, the wash is more up to date and doing the job yourself vs someone else doing a half job is seriously the best. This place is neat and clean. I love this!!

No ac no phone in my room smh you can hear everything and when I say everything I mean it . They literally had to put a whole fan in my room because of the non working ac . Everything is just so old fashion here . Really need a makeover . The one thing I did like is the bathroom it was very spacious
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place never let's me down.  I Come here every time I'm in town at least once a week.  I always order the NY strip steak. With a loaded bake potato,  and fresh garden salad. The staff is always friendly.  And they offer a great liquor selection.  The price isn't bad for the quality

This gym is pretty good.  It's always clean, the front staff has always been friendly, and so far it hasn't been overcrowded.  There are 2 things that I do not like though, it's way too hot and they do not have the closed captioning on the TV's for when you're doing cardio and listening to your music.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I ordered the Pink juice.  It was good, but not great.  It's hard to give a fair review based on one juice flavor.  However, when I walked in, the first thing that I noticed was that the store smelled awful.  They sell breakfast, gyros, fro yo and juice all in one location.

Don't go here, ever. Have tried the drive thru and walk in several times - in addition to everything always taking a very long time for fast food there is high probability the order will be screwed up / missing something and several staff members extremely rude.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
This place is in a shopping area, close to a Walmart and across the road from a Publix.

I don't drink coffee but came here for a hot chocolate on what was a cold morning by Clearwater standards. My hot chocolate was fine.

It is pretty much an average Starbucks, which means the prices are higher than they should be.

I gave this place a 1 the last time I posted a review, but the Manager contacted me to make it right. This time I got Annie and she is AMAZING!! She took her time to go the extra mile. She didn't rush and massaged my feet back to life. Give it a try, they have some great people in there. I will go back!

The staff was not very welcoming.

The fish nuggets were delicious and well fried but small portioned for price

the Margarita Shrimp: Large, turdfilled P&E shrimp,  sprinkled with Old Bay, and a cup of Cocktail Sauce. The menu reads so much more.

My beer was cool at best.

Not a spot for me.

Decent hotel. 

Clean rooms. 

We've stayed twice. I would stay again because the price is good ($119 for two queen) tasty breakfast and pool for kids. 

Fridge and microwave in room is great for little kids snacks. 

Basic, affordable, family friendly hotel. 

No complaints but I've stayed in much nicer hotels for the same price.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Just an average McDonalds...and we hit at a below-average time (big line and understaffed for the peculiar-time-to-get-a-big-influx-of-non-mealtime-traffic).

Still giving it a 3 star, because they were trying hard to keep up.

Coffee wasn't bad for afternoon McD's coffee, either.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Awesome hotel to stay at.
Located directly inside the Tampa airport so was incredibly convenient to fly out of with two small children the following morning.
Rooms were as clean as could be, staff was more than friendly, and room service came on time in the morning, hot and very good quality.
Would def reccomend staying here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Not my favorite sandwich place, but Subway is a reliable option for grabbing a quick lunch. This location seems a bit rundown, but is near some nice places. That said, if you're in downtown, you really should be eating somewhere better. Yes, I know this makes me a hypocrite.

I made an online reservation and was disappointed when there was confusion if I had a car. The car I got once it hey did figure it out was smaller than what I reserved. Thrifty is very inconsistent with their service lately and though I am typically loyal to thrifty I may be look to someone else in the future to rent from.

Food was great, I had shrimp and peppers, chilaquiles, and cilantro rice with a Cadillac margarita- shrimp was nice and spicy and the sides paired well. Wife had shredded beef enchiladas, cilantro rice, charro beans and Sangria. Staff was nice and waitress was there when we needed her. We will go back soon.

Really good pizza at a decent price. It's really worth a try. I highly recommend the sausage and caramelized onion. They hand make their sausage and it's really good. It's pick up only and last I went, they only accepted cash. Everyone was very friendly and even though it was takeout only it was really worth it.

I only stayed there for one night, but I was impressed.  For the price, you get a room with a contemporary feel and is very clean as well. Plus, they accept cash without any annoying deposit like some places (ahem...Clarion). For a quick one night stay, The Inn at Chester Springs can't be beat.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Really cool tucked away breakfast place in Tucson. I took my family there and the wait staff was so sweet, they even made my little girl a mini silver dollar pancake. Great local restaurant and very affordable prices. The food is also tasty it'll keep me coming back again and again.

I want there for my vday make up date. ( it fell on mardi gras this year). The server Cara was awesome! The food was good too! We did the lollypop pork chop for an app. I had chicken & my man had pasta. Good ombiance n nice reasonably priced food. A good night.

Very good pizza. I love the sauce. The only think that keeps me from giving a higher rating is the super-thick crust. 

The tomato sauce is fantastic and the style of pizza is great. They load the sauce on heavily on top of the cheese and it tastes great. All around good pizza.

The Yellow Porch has lots of mixed reviews and so I went there with curiosity and trepidation. The lunch was so good! The celery blue cheese soup is a can't miss. The lunch special salad was wonderfully composed. Our server was wonderful- he was efficient, friendly, and knowledgeable. I highly recommend The Yellow Porch.

Wouldn't book again for the price to value ratio. $30 for parking, room was just ok, had to pay a resort fee... Also the complex is huge, so you have to walk around with a map to find your room. I think there are better hotels in the area for a better price.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My little gem.  This place is off the charts.  The nicest folks you'll find and some of the highest quality sushi around.  My brother who's a conneisuer of sorts from San Francisco can't believe we have this quality in little old Nashville, TN.  You can waste your money at Peter's but I'll be living large in Lennox Village!

Terrible, wrong order three times in a row.  Even caught it on the third time they changed the order twice and still it was wrong.  I just want a bacon cheddar mcchicken with just bacon and cheddar. EVERY TIME I get chicken with lettuce and mayo.  Never again will I go here.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Their tamales aren't terrible but they aren't your typical tamales. I would say they fall into a category I'd call "Alternative or perhaps New Wave." If you are looking for traditional tamales this is not your restaurant. As I said they aren't terrible. Just know they weren't made by your Tia.

Less deluxe rolls than what I like to get at Kuma, but I had some not so great fish at Kuma and wanted to branch out. The quality of fish was great, the rolls fresh and tasty, and that tuna ball app (forgetting name now) was super tasty. And the sesame dressing for the salads is literally the BEST dressing I've ever tasted.

Slow service and mediocre quality sushi. It's not bad, but it is not great either. Tuna and salmon were just okay. I am not sure how the restaurant was able to mess up scallop, but they managed to serve something that wasn't tasty or recognizable as scallop at all.

This is a good ole barber shop. It was my first time there and aside from a little wait (but I was lucky cause it gets busy on sats), great haircut and great guys. Reasonable prices considering location in relation to overpriced places in Manayunk that give bad haircuts. Definitely got a good thing going there. Get it in early.

They cook these dogs in batches so if you have a flight to catch, put it order in and pay, then wait.  I waited for a lucky dog and nearly missed my flight because some inconsiderate person snakes me in line and ordered multiple dogs with all the toppings.  Minus 1 star for lack of line orderliness.

I can in around lunch time and while the waitress on duty was wearing a mask, the sushi chef and another kitchen staff member WERE NOT! Unacceptable. Additionally they allowed someone to walk off with a takeout order I placed. Luckily I received a refund from grub-hub and they quickly remade it. Hence the three stars.

Dr. Quinn was terrific with our cat Naj. Answered all of our questions about the lumps on his legs, got him the diagnostics he needed, and got our little guy back into fighting shape. All while dealing with the operational nightmare of the quarantine. Really glad to have them here in Goleta.

Sushi is better than the hibachi. Veggies were cold but meat was hot. The crab Rangoon was just ok. It's an interesting sweet and sour that they use. I came back because the last time I came, the sushi was good. The overall experience is just kinda meh. Not super over priced but nothing that is crazy amazing either.

I grew up by a Monical's Pizza and it is very possibly the first pizza I ever ate.  Thought the entire chain went out of business but a few tears ago WHAM I saw (and ate at) one in Champaign, Illinois.  Now there is one in Greenwood and I LOVE it!  Thin crispy crust, square-cut.  It's no Bobe's of Washington but I recommend!!

Drive-thru is fast. They have veggie options but beware of the rice, it has chicken broth in it. I am not sure about the beans yet if they are made with lard or not. Their churros are really good and I like that they're open 24 hours. I just need more info to see if they are able to cater to true vegetarians!

Reviewer # 3. 

This is a good car wash with machines that work well. You can get quarters here, but cleaning products and air freshers, vacuum, do it yourself car wash (the best kind) and a shampooer. It's very helpful to be able to shampoo your car when something gets spilled or an animal or child gets sick,

I am not really a fan of chain restaurants but this one did okay in drive through.   I got my sandwich hot and fast.  No complaints there.  Everything looked clean about the outside and the lady that took my order seemed okay for the morning shift.

I ordered a double croissiant, it was delicious and enjoyable.

My room did not have a sheet on the bottom mattress and I could see stains. I didn't have a car, they don't serve dinner, and there are not a lot of places to eat in walking distance. My room was also swarming with 10 lady bugs, but the front desk was nice enough to find me a new room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place is very clean, and the staff was friendly, however the quality of work was not good. I went in for a back fill, because my normal nail person was out of town. It took over 2 hours and my nails were left very thick and days later they were lifting.

Stopped by on a Wednesday night and had no issues finding a seat or receiving great service. The bartender made a fantastic Old Fashioned and Manhattan. After having been to four other bars around down, The Famous, thus far, has the highest quality mixed drinks.

Called Friday morning and was told car would be ready that afternoon, it wasn't done until the following Tuesday. One of the repairs I brought it in for wasn't done. They were super friendly and apologetic on the phone about my car not being ready, but this is unacceptable and I won't be returning.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: It's pretty worth the hype. I was super full from dinner and still couldn't stop myself from getting the vanilla. I LOVE THAT THEY HAVE POCKY to go with it. Rumor has it their flavors change. I'll have to go back to give a thorough review. I will say it was packed when I went with little seating.

Awesome lil spot! You can tell it's fresh from the moment you walk in! The service was perfect, I believe her name was Jenny?!.. presentation was on point and so adorable! The sushi rolls are good sized, delicious, and had so many choices!!! I will def make this a must stop!!

What an excellent evening - start to finish! We had a party of four and had a 45 minute wait on a Saturday night. The place was hopping. 

Once we were seated, we ordered two appetizers which were delicious. The specials for the evening were excellent. Although they were very very busy, the service was superb.

Was working locally for a couple of weeks and decided to stay here. Check in was efficient, greeted as a Platinum member, bonus points, and welcome gift. 

Rooms were clean, comfy, and smelled fresh. Staff was friendly. Basic courtyard seemed newer restaurants near by (driving)

Under $150 per night
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Where's Happy Harry?  I used to stop by often on my way to work, but the bottom line is that most of the employees are odd, borderline rude.  I've spoken to other locals and they agreed.  It's a small space, you just gotta have a nice employee there while you shop.

We just stayed one night here but were very pleased with our stay. The staff were pleasant, the room was clean and updated, minimal room noise even with a bunch of youth sports teams staying there. It was a reasonable cost for Nashville, much cheaper than downtown.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: There's probably about at least a 50% chance they'll get something wrong with your order. I will say though, they are pretty fast. I'll keep going just because I work down the street and often want something cheap and quick. The people seem nice, just maybe don't really care about their jobs.

Love this place!! So many delicious varieties of tea, nice atmosphere, and they even have a "breast feeding is supported" sticker on the window, which is fabulous because I like to meet friends with babies here to have tea, socialize and feed our children when needed.

Was one of the best drive throughs in the area, now it's the worst.  You can't use the McDonalds app to order and the drive through system has been down the last three times I've tried.  Today, the drive through was down and they directed people inside. I got inside and the registers weren't working either.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
The crew at the Milpas location is on top of every job and every customer every day. Kind, caring, patient and willing to take the time to help even though they are always busy. 
They get the job done in time and inform you if anything else needs work without being too pushy or upselling service.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Usually a long wait since it's the only location in the area. Service has always been polite and efficient but make sure they repeat your order back to you. I've received wrong orders a couple of times and unfortunately did not realize until I was down the street.

This is the large dunkaccino I got... maybe 4/3 cup full.. I swear I didn't drink it... and he didn't even know where to look for it on the machine to bill me, instead he billed me for hot chocolate... well I don't know the price anyways. I go there because it's close to home... I guess I will go to another one then lol

Customer service was poor when I went. No smiling faces or chipper attitudes like some of the competitors. The contents of the burrito seem to just moosh together into a lumpy casserole. Not terrible, but not returning anytime soon. Chipotle remains king of the hill for me.

This location and the Red Rock location are my favorites. Always clean and air conditioned. Sometimes a little crowded but it doesn't keep me from my workout. This location is bigger in the inside than it looks from the outside. It has the most cardio machines and a good assortment of weight training machines as well.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Cute little shop. The donuts are a little different here than I have seen. They seem much more dense and cake like and the frosting on the maple bars wasnt smooth but very thick and chunky. Honestly was hoping for more flavors than they had in the cases. Overall not bad and the donuts we got we liked. Will definitely return.

This is my kind of bar! Definitely not the craziness of some of the other Ybor bars. It's a bar you can go to without having to scream in each other's ears to have a conservation. The pool tables and couches give it a nice " chill" vibe and the variety of beer on tap is the icing on the cake.

I always enjoy coming by to get tacos from the local area. The one place that threw me off was the fact they only had horseradish cilantro and onion as veggie options to go on tacos. Still a very delicious meal and cheap if you are on the go and need something quick.

My friend and I had Evergreen last week and we were not at all impressed by the flavor or presentation of our selections. I had shrimp and broccoli (the shrimp tasted like cardboard) and my friend had peppersteak and onions (2 pieces of steak and an infinite amount of onions).  

Verdict: NOT AGAIN!!

One of my favorite New York style pizzas in Tampa. We also love their wings  I do have to say, we stopped ordering it through DoorDash and Uber because every time it would be cold....and maybe it's just me but the freshness isn't the same. We now order for pickup, and it's nice and hot every time.

My friend and I had about an hour to kill before our movie started nearby. The restaurant was extremely busy, but we were seated at the bar almost immediately and were tended to by one of the bar tenders. We put in an order of wings and asked for 2 Blue Moons. Wings came fast and beer was great! The wings had a good flavor too!

Wish I could give zero stars. Everyone in the place was clueless. Kept saying their "system is down," but were able to see everything on the computer just fine (it was an excuse to explain the severe slowness /incompetence). Nobody in the place had a clue about my reservation. Got frustrated and left.

I was really excited to try this restaurant since it has such great reviews and it will be really close to my new house. It has okay food but it took forever to get out. My fiancé was not very impressed with his sushi. Sushi Maru in Brandon is much better.

We had a very lovely time at Moto. Our waitress was an aspiring actress. She was not only beautiful, well-spoken, funny and kind but also attentive. So service, 100% perfect. The food was great as well. I had a vegetarian lasagna that was very good. The ambiance was hip and chill. The whole experience rocked. Thank you, Moto!

Came here for a pet grooming trade show. Very nice hotel, clean, comfortable with amazing staff. Nice pool area too. Thank you to the hotel for allowing dogs even though this is not a pet friendly hotel. My only issue is the buffet breakfast is very expensive. Good experience otherwise.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: In a city of great eats at any price range, skip this unless you're doing the liquid lunch thing or just want to pay a hell of a lot for very average, even below average food and ultra slow service even for the Big Easy...  Took three hours to get a salad!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I rarely order delivery, but when I do it's always Spring.  Their portions are extremely generous, and their garlic sauce rocks.  I recommend the spare ribs, roast pork, diet chicken and broccoli, and tofu and veggie soup.  The only thing I've ordered and haven't liked is the hot and sour soup- it's neither hot nor sour.

Signed up for the monthly family car washes and our cars have never looked better. It's also given us something to do as keeping the car cleaned inside and out has become somewhat of a challenge. I wish there was one in Hendersonville but it's not too far to drive to Gallatin.

I used to love this place when I lived in Arizona. We stopped by this place the weekend before Christmas. The selection was good and the prices were good as well. There is a lot to like in this store, especially the frozen section. There were better deals to be had than at Sam's Club on the same brands. Wish we had these back home.

The hotel's website says it was renovated in March 2016.  Maybe the lobby but the rooms are absolutely horrible.  The knob on our shower/bath is loose and isn't even held on correctly.  The beds are not comfortable at all.  There are no fridges or microwaves in the rooms.  I won't be coming here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Seems to cater to senior citizens who seem to think anything that they don't have to cook themselves is wonderful. I had a shrimp basket. The shrimp were very small, but OK. Mashed taters with gravy (the kind that's as yellow as a school bus and obviously from a can or mix). 

Not a fan. Plenty of other good places to go.

Very friend staff who took care of our dog many times. He is anxious and slightly territorial so we were worried how he would do. They were well prepared and he did great. Staff is friendly and the place is clean for a clinic. Overall: glad for the experience.

Food was good server was good but I WILL NOT be back , due to the simple fact the manager had me pay for something I didn't order !! He refused to take it off even if it meant his servers didn't get tipped . She was so sweet and I wanted to tip her but you will not charge me for something I didn't order .

Nice people work here. 
But the whole Macaroni Grill has lost what it used to be.

We tried date night here. Bad choice.

Meat dishes aren't so good. Tried to get angel hair and marina sauce on the side. That couldn't be done.

Loved you in your hey-day but not any more. Good-bye old friend.

Stayed there New Years Eve, 2012..the room was beautiful, however..there was no fan for white noise..not even in the bathroom.  The thermostat was broke and it was HOT.  With nothing to drown out outside noise, and the heat, we didn't sleep at all.  Also, the toilet was not clean...something brown and crusty on toilet.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Nice salon, friendly staff, they took us as walk-Ins pretty quickly but our pedicures were a bit weak. No scrubbing of our heels at all, basically no exfoliation at all. For just $20 know that you will only get the least amount of cuticle care and toe scrubbing and polish.

Excellent pizza... Pretty quick to get food out so might reconsider that appetizer. Almost arrived at the same time. "Personal" size is served but unless your really hungry, I found them shareable... especially if you brought beer to drink. So many choices... Nice to split and share!

One of the finest hotel suites I ever set foot in.  You have a living room and a bedroom.  There's a bar downstairs.  

Place is close proximity to the airport, next door to a few other nice hotels.  Very close to the ghetto so don't go too far north on Island.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Every morning I get a Venti Vanilla Latte and one out of  three times it doesn't have any Vanilla in it.  When they make it right I enjoy it and have a pleasant experience at this location.  But I'm done getting up early to spend $4.95 on an undrinkable beverage before work.

Here for the first time. took a chance and was pleasantly surprised of getting my pizza well down not burnt, just the way I like it.. I was a little disappointed that they would not deliver. (3.8 miles) Here visiting from up North and will come back again when visiting safety harbor..

Food was hot and fresh. Lobby was relatively clean. Trainee at register was nice and did her job. Only complaint is that the fries weren't salted. So I dipped them in ranch and they were just fine. Soda station wasn't overly clean but wasn't a mess. They did the job good enough.

Was in Indianapolis fir my birthday weekend with my daughter.  Decided to get a pedi while we were at the mall.  $27 for basic pedicure.  They did a great job and we're very friendly.   I did not think the place was dirty as other reviews stated.  Looked like most mall nail salons.

Bar taco.. eh, nothing special.. expensive hyped up taco spot that caters to the upper yuppie crowd.. we picked 3 small tacos for our order and ate them within lightning speed.. we were still hungry afterwards.. i wouldnt exactly call this a authentic taco spot and would not bother coming back as we were not exactly impressed

The slowest Dunkin' location I've ever been in and the employees are not friendly. They seemed to be busy with their own conversations while people were trying to pay. This staff definitely needs to be retrained to wait on people faster, we have flights to catch!

By far the best tacos in Indy.  The perfect meal?  Best deal around. $8 will get you a cowboy cookie, large drank, Paul Bunyon taco and a Pesco Bill burrito.  Roscoe's is far from where I work and live, but I will forever make the trip when I get a taco craving!

Clean rooms, the doors were a bit confusing and they seemed to be in the way a lot for me.  The beds were comfortable, but I could not adjust the heat in my room. It wouldn't turn down and I had to turn the air on to get some relief. The hotel is very close to cypress parking too!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Had to do it.  Only been to the White Castle in Vegas, and I was so Vegas'd I didn't remember​ the taste.  

If you've been to Krystals you've had a White Castle.

Took over a 1/2 hour for 3 sliders.  Not kidding, and it was like 11:15 so not lunch or breakfast rush.

Food was excellent and that was where it ends.  Hostess forgot to seat us and we waited at the bar 30 minutes and there were plenty of open tables.  Server was too busy for us and was around maybe four times on the two hours we were there.  Service very very slow.

I love this place. I love the outdoor seating in the warmer weather. I love being under the flight path for Stead Airport and watching the F5s do an overhead break. 
I love the molcajete, the Carnitas, the tacos, burritos all of it! 
I love the margaritas. 
I love the atmosphere. 
I love this place.

Look...
This is not a first date spot. This is not the sushi place to take someone if you want to impress them. This is not Raw or Obon. 

This is where you go to get the biggest and best cuts of nigiri and sashimi in town, throw on a 1/2 price roll or two and wash it down with a Kirin.

Enjoy it for what it is.

Another bar we ended up at each night. Their house band is awesome with their rock setlist. There are some bar stools around the 2 bars and along the back with several high top tables with stools. They offer drinks for $5 a shot up to 4 per drink. The girls' bathroom always had a long line though.

Just left Lykon Automotive and I couldn't be happier. It was my first time there and they made me feel comfortable and not like I was getting ripped off. Everyone was friendly and even took the time to speak to me and my husband not just take our money and push us out the door. Thanks for being awesome, I'll be back for sure!

I'm shocked that this place isn't a 5 star on here.  I drive WAY out of the way for the good food here.  The hibachi and sushi are both wonderful.  Advice - if you have a food allergy, check your stuff!  I have a severe avocado allergy and my take-out has had it twice now, but they are always very accommodating about it.

I got a togo menu in the mailbox last month ago and decided to give a try.
I ordered Special Boston Roll and Rainbow Roll I have to say very Delicious!!!!
Fish is very fresh and I like how they presentation is very nice and give a big roll when they say it special roll^^

One of the better Italian restaurants in the city. The one on St. Charles is far superior to the one in Metairie. I like their veal Saltenboca And other standard view of dishes or outstanding. I've never had a bad meal and in fact most meals are excellent and not overpriced.

The Gasparilla bar in terminal F is a great way to i toro dice visitors to the Tampa Bay Area but not a great way to send them off. No local beers to speak of at the bar and food selection is pretty minimal. 

The southwest terminal has better food and drink options with cigar city and ulele.

In our quest for delicious sushi bites, we were pleasantly surprised by what we found at Sakana. Perfectly prepared rolls and delightful combinations made for a most excellent lunch experience. The healthy ratio of meat to rice was refreshing. So fresh and so clean! We will definitely be back!

Very clean store to start off. Plus its of the beaten path, never crowded. You can get in and out. Employees are friendly. This is just a grocery store. Just basics. But it does meet my needs. I love this place. Told my best friend and she is hooked. Glad your here and hope you stay forever.

Love Mongolian but this location is the worst one I've been to. Their ingredients were low and had clearly been sitting out for some time. Their staff was pretty unfriendly and I ended up getting charged twice because the guy on the register didn't know how to work it. Food was fine but probably will not visit this location again.

This Starbucks will make you late for work!  I've spent as long as 20 min waiting in the drivethru.  I even tried going inside since there weren't too many people.  I walked right up and ordered and it still took 15 min.
Leave yourself plenty of time or find another Starbucks.

This Starbucks will make you late for work!  I've spent as long as 20 min waiting in the drivethru.  I even tried going inside since there weren't too many people.  I walked right up and ordered and it still took 15 min.
Leave yourself plenty of time or find another Starbucks.

Probably the best McDonalds in Santa Barbara. Generally very clean, the employees are the nicest, doesn't attract the weird crowds. In case any managers are reading this I would like to give props to Joshua, he was VERY polite, cracking jokes with us, apologized for a 5 minute wait time!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We went for happy hour.   Service started out pretty good.  Got our drinks and appetizers.   But went down hill from there.  The server forgot to place my order.   We sat for 20 minutes still no food.  Meanwhile people who sat down way after we did got there food and drinks. Server

Wowwww, this place is not good. Our table of 8 agreed on this. The pizza knots came out cold with a horrible taste. The pepperoni pizza was greasy. I didn't care for the red sauce. The pasta was okay. Long line to order. Table & a few plates were dirty. On a positive note our waitress was nice.

Not going to make it. This Pizza restaurant doesn't seem to be sustainable, put aside the 40+ minute wait for a pizza. The prices dont seem at the right price point. Servers/management need more experience.
Maybe they should call "Restaurant: Impossible" for a few pointers.

The ambience is nice and the service is good, but the food lacks flavor. My best friend and I ordered Chicken Tuscany and I could have easily made this dish myself. The price is too expensive for the presentation and taste of food.  I would not waste my time eating here unless you don't mind a lackluster dinner.

This spot overall was pretty good. I ate there late on a Friday night, it was a nice setting, the service was nice. The food selection was not too desirable in my opinion but the quality was good. It's one of those places I would try again hoping for a better experience next time.

Racism is alive & real here. Never staying at a Sheraton again!

Sheraton, thank your manager, Kevin Keys, for a loss of business. ..Lots of it!

In a time like this, especially, racism is NOT ACCEPTABLE! ..Especially, on a young lady's birthday. Sorely disappointed is an understatement.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
On two different occasions I have ordered from them and have had to wait more than an hour (a hour & a half actually) for delievery. Mind you I live 3 blocks away. When I called to complain.. They gonna tell me that they are very busy. They magically came to deliever in 10 min later. 

This place has gone down over the last year.

Nothing exceptional about this hotel. Lobby has been renovated with new floors and new furniture. The room is clean, but A/C blows right on my face when I am in bed. There is a restaurant part of the hotel, but other options are available close by. Friendly staff. A little pricey.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Bad day for national. NO CARS FOR EXECUTIVES' CLIENTS and has to wait outside in the heat for vehicles. Customer kept coming and no cars. What a poor service: look for other rental options in the future. Bus took more than 20minutes to show up so j decided to walk 10' to the place.

Very disappointing stay at this property. Location isn't great - rooms are a little dark, but the biggest challenge is apathetic service. Not sure if this is reflective of Hiltons generally but at this location management is extremely subpar/not up for the job. There are better options in SB. Find them!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
They charged my credit card more than my final bill.  When I called, the guy who I dealt with basically told me "It's not my problem" and had me chase down accounting to get a refund.  The hotel room was moldy too.

But the breakfast was pretty good - so two stars.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went to Tuna Bar last week for their sushi-making class and had so much fun! Chef Ken taught us how to filet a Hawaiian yellowtail, how to make sushi rice and how to make our own sushi rolls! Overall, it was a fun and interactive experience. I would absolutely do it again.

i too thought i was going to save money...NOT-i bought beef that we could not eat-the produce is ok-but the store brand bread etc is awful.staff is so unfriendly,and i agree with previous writter,maybe a little slow..but even slow people can be friendly-don't think i'll be back any time soon

I live in the neighborhood...So far I've loved every drink I've tried! My favorite has to be the Premium La Freeze Red Velvet Cake...the food is ok...it seems overpriced but the sandwiches I've had are fairly big...wish they had sides to go with the food other than those horrible chips.

Tacos are good for St louis. Service is terrible. I waited for about 5 minutes for a menu. Then about 10 before the waitress came back. Also i realized that the some of the servers actually finish preparing the food behind the counter. Not good! 

- Horchata is amazing! 
- tongue tacos are delicious

I have been to Farmer's Daughte rmany times.  It is a good place but has dropped of a bit over the last year.

Can't miss items:
- Cheese Boards
- Warm pretzels with Truffled butter - so good!

The bartenders are good but used to be much better.  Not as attentive as they used to be.

The wine list needs some new items on it.

Nice centrally located. Close to all bars and great if you do not need a car. We stayed for three nights. The only thing I didn't like is that the bedsheets were never cleaned. The bed was remade but same sheets left on it. That's the reason for the three stars. Everything else was fine.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great atmosphere, very modern and classy.  Our server, Mark, was friendly and attentive.  All the dishes we ordered were delicious; Surf & Turf Tempura, Bison Chili, Ribeye and Market Salad.  They also have a nice beer and wine selection.  We'll definitely be back!

A cute little neighborhood bar with friendly bartenders and frequent live music.  Drink prices are reasonable and the atmosphere is casual, but not quite divey.  Decent sized bar with table seating and a small stage.  Easy location right next to the Eldorado and walking distance to many other bars.  Will return.

Kudos for atmosphere, creativity and presentation.  Food was good but not enough of it.  My tofu entree ($14) consisted of at most 8 cubes of tofu and sautéed greens. No grain on plate.  Had to ask for bread.   Same for dining partner's dish.   Chef needs to rethink his vision.   This one isn't working.

The pizza here gets worse and worse every time I come back. The last 3 times it has been inedible. Undercooked dough, dripping grease, funky, salty tasting. We dined in last time. The pizza was served cold in a cardboard box. The grease literally soaked through the box.

I'm allergic to wheat and dairy so a pizza place is never high on my go-to list. This one, tho... had a wonderful house salad with a subtle vinaigrette, and they added pepperoni and prosciutto to make it a meal. The pasta looked delicious and got rave reviews and the pepperoni pizza may have saved a life.

I got stick by emission station, Dave signed a repair, I had ran out of gas after going though these long line to get your vehicle inspected, and Dave sent his son to get more gad for me. I'm a handicapped senior so I appreciate his blessing. Thanks Dave, Paul Johnson

I should have listened to the negative reviews I found on the web. This has to be the worst Mexican restaurant I have ever eaten at. In fact, I got the Mexican platter and tried a bit of everything and it was all awful. Taco Bell would have been a better alternative and more authentic.

We had a good 2 night stay here and wouldn't hesitate to recommend the hotel.  Being right on the Loop is definitely a plus.  Even though we had a car it was nice to be able to walk to so many shops and restaurants.  The staff is courteous and responsive to requests.  We didn't encounter any problems at all during our stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The atmosphere is the only thing going for this salon. I felt like I was a hinderance to them the entire time and it was the shortest, half ass manicure ever. My cuticles still look awful and the polish had peeled off two nails by the next day. Save your money, people.
