I've only gotten takeout from this place, but their sushi is on point! Super delicious! A ton of super innovative, fun rolls, and fresh lobster and crab! The atmosphere is lively and LOUD, but if that's your thing, this place is a great choice. Regardless, the food is delish and reasonably priced.

This place is pretty bad. The staff just don't care and is reckless. Countless time have they forgot my order or completely didn't have my stuff but still charge me. Every time my gf and I order from them something is messed up. This is today's order... burnt ass croissant and is falling apart

It's way off the beaten path, and you need to take the St. Charles line a few notches down to get there, but Creole Creamery is NOLA's best Ice Cream place. The peanut butter sundae was just heavenly. The Rose Ice Cream flavour is basically frozen Rose. I loved it.

I did not like the fact that for every single roll it seemed like there was cucumber in it. 
It was like ewww no more cucumber please!!! 
I ended up having to ask for no cucumber or just order nigiri.
Either way if you dont like cucumber on your sushi, then this place is not the place to go.

They are open during the hours they have posted.  The food is typical for McDonald's.  The service can be as little slow during peak times, but they are always very nice and helpful.  The bathrooms were clean and so we're the restaurant floors and tables.  I had a great experience here.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: What a joke of an advertisement that you can order cook to order- bull crap. Every freaking time - no matter what its always an old been sitting in the bin burger- you had one F-in job! Cook a fresh burger when someone ask for cook to order or take the option away all together.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Unruly teens being loud and disruptive.  No staff person controlled them.  Food was good. Even tho I am not a fan of Arby's    Host/ cashier Jaelin needs special recognition. We were not quite sure what we wanted and kept changing. But he kept up with us and got our orders right. Shout out to Jaelin.

Staff was very friendly. The building is so huge and wide open. Ever sound echoed just normal talking was magnified a gazillion times.  Hadn't been to an eye doctor in about six years so they had no previous glasses to go in  just my word.  Didn't need distance glasses. Only reading. Great. Will buy cheaters
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
I love this place.  I smile every time I walk in here.   

They open a bit late on weekdays (sorry 9-to-5ers), but there's nothing better on a relaxed morning than a bottomless coffee and a double stack waffle.  The service is always spot-on and friendly.   The waffles (get a waffle!) are damn good.

Took over 90 min for a 10 min oil change. They damaged a part on our car. And put the wrong oil in another car. And didn't put enough oil in another car, had to drain again and put full amount in again. Some cars were out quick but most took about 30 min because of an error by staff
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Tropical Isle is the producer of those green drinks every first timer and out of towner walk down Bourbon with: The Hand Grenade.  Drinking one may just be considered a rite of passage. No one knows what they put in it, but you won't remember it anyway.  Best of luck, Young Padawan.

Terrible. I've been here a few times due to the convenient location but this was my worst experience to date. There is a serious language barrier although somehow the manicurist knows how to try to upsell me on gel multiple ways. Please see this photo from one day later.

There is no replacement for Subway. But the people here are fin to deal with. So far I have only been told that they were out of lettuce once. Several times I have came in and have found no iced tea. I am here for the healthy options people. Make sure u got them. Overall it's a clean place.

Not a very good lineup of and not very knowledgeable about Indiana breweries or craft beer. They were pushing beer made in Ohio as local to Indy. They also had some very old beer on the shelves, such as an IPA over a year old, so check the dates of beer you buy. Seemed like they had a good liquor selection  tho

Chill and beautiful place for tacos and margaritas near South street. I've been going for the past couple of years and always get the blood orange margarita, tacos, and tortilla soup- it's a relief to never feel rushed and eat delicious food while people watching.

I have taken all of my animals here since moving to Indy. They always take great care of my babies, explain treatments,  and follow-up on care (sometimes better than my people docs). They have helped two of my babies at end of life and were very respectful and kind.

We had dinner for six and everyone's meal was good and the service was fast. I had the special talapia and shrimp with cheese sauce and it was both unique and tasty. The scene is more bar than restaurant so if you want more casual or intimate atmosphere then this is not the place.

This place is absolutely horribly run.  Place is packed, with people waiting at minimum an extra 20 minutes for their orders or for the counter staff to get off the phone. 

Chose any other Westshore pizza location before this one.  It will take less time to drive a few extra miles.

Whenever I'm in Chalmette and it's around noon, Bonzai is where I think about going. This place has always been consistent, quick, and friendly. They are fair with the serving of fish they give with their rolls.
Although Umi is just down the street, I feel as though my money is well spent here.

Decided on a whim to stop in here with my daughter. We split the vanilla cake batter donut and she got the medium iced coffee with French vanilla flavoring. Service was friendly and fast and the dining room is clean. The donut was filled with Vanilla buttercream, a bit sweet for my liking definitely a donut to share with someone.

Hello, my name is Nichole. I took over ownership of Robertsons and renamed it Giovanni's media barber shop. Please stop in to see the new services that have been added to the menu. We now offer straight razor shaves, hair color, head shaves, eye brow and back waxing, and also ear candling. Thanks and hope to see you soon!

Not sure how this place is still in business.  Great location, but its not worth it, walk or uber off campus.  I got a gel mani and the gel was peeling off that night.  I asked for my toes to be square shaped and I do not think they could be anymore round.  This place is also kind of dirty.

Outstanding selection, the premises are super clean, the feel is very modern. I was fairly surprised to find relatively low prices on many different items, despite being in the heart of Davidson County, let alone in a more upscale store. On top of that, the staff are super helpful and courteous. 10/10 would recommend!

Tests some soreness keeping it real quick to bouts of colorectal discomfort and urinary tract stingingly be there in the morning to imbibe my favorite venti caramel latte... Astra espresso LoL lol because I am not sure if I can stay woke up at this time of year! Happy Christmas and New Year

Pretty disappointed at the lack of food my daughter received for $7.50 (kids meal). 

The sandwich was smushed and the bread size was so small. Also the fruit cup was sour and nasty. 

My frustration is that it's bread and cheese and it shouldn't cost that much for so little.

This is our first and last time here unfortunately.

Absolutely horrendous. If I could give 0 stars, I would. 
1. Didn't receive the correct order. 
2. Didn't receive my drink. When I asked for it, the employee gave me an attitude, took 5 minutes to give it to me & gave it to me without ice & even more attitude. 
3. No napkins 
4. No straws 
5. No receipt

Won't be returning.

Well.. yeah... this place is good. Great flavors and topping... bottomings. My wife and I come here a couple times a month. It's very white inside... kinda modern I guess. But we like to come here and hang out a bit. Love the sorbet too... if you are looking for a more healthy option.

Service was fine and the Starbucks quality was the same, but those airport prices are crazy as usual. When you order a bagel, they give you a knife and a small pouch of cream cheese that's barely enough for one side of the bagel. It's also a $1 up charge when you inevitably ask for another one...

My first review of this place wasn't great. Our order had  things wrong, no chopsticks, and soy sauce was spilled all over the bag and boxes. Today, no chopsticks again and my avocado roll had really brown avocado in it. I want to like this place so bad but there's always something wrong with my order. Ugh!

Went to Yanako for dinner on a Friday night. We were seated promptly and the ambience was relaxed. Their sushi is amazing. Had the Yanako sampler, Yakitori, and a few rolls. We recommend the soft shell crab roll and the spicy salmon roll. Will be going back.

I didn't realize how much I liked their sushi until I had other sushi in town. It's not anything special by any means but it's cheaaaaappppp. Crazy wait most of the time and you can't make reservations. Don't except anything extremely fancy because it's not. But it's also not $20 for two rolls.

I love the deep dish/Chicago style pizza. It's got a lot of sauce which I loved but was too much for my bf. they are happy to make it half and half though :). Beware it can take awhile to get served if it is busy. The staff is nice and friendly. I definitely wish I could find this pizza at home.

Early Bird Specials even on Friday! The food here is wonderful, the prices are right, and the service is friendly and efficient. My wife and I keep coming back, especially during Lent for the deliciously Provel covered Cod Cardinale! Oh, and best house salad in St. Louis in my opinion

The location is odd.  It feels like you are walking into an office.  I ordered the shrimp burrito and ceviche.  The burrito was delicious, however the ceviche was hot.  I have never had hot ceviche before and I don't think I will order it again.  I love their salsa and chips.  I would definitely come back.

I love there California roll. I get it every time. Not a big fan on there deserts but the sushi is really good. I got there a ton and every time I've been it's been a great experience. Sometimes it can be a long wait depending on the hours I come in but usually there spot on. Definitely would recommend eating here if u enjoy sushi.

I'm so glad I went! I'm convinced he's genius. I love my cut. He gave me exactly what i wanted. And my color is exactly what I asked for. It's been a while since I've left a hair salon feeling like my stylist nailed it. And he did. To top it all off, he's a fabulous guy!! I thoroughly enjoyed his company!

Horrible experience.  I presume the  person who waited on us was the manager because he was dressed nicely.  He was very rude and seemed pissed off that he had to wait on us.  They were out of sweet and sour sauce and our chicken nuggets were cold.  Won't bother coming here again.

Waited over an hour for our order just to find out they didn't even start on our order yet. I get that you're getting a lot of delivery orders but don't be greedy and take our order, wasted our time. Wasn't the best customer service either. Thanks for our water, the only good part!  :)

Best ice cream shop ever, anywhere, done. I am a lover of good ice cream and they always have the fire. The service is amazing and they have a business model that works wonders. They make their own ice cream and all of the flavors are unique and amazing. Check them out and you won't be disappointed!

I just moved here from Brooklyn.  The New York style pizza is a fraud.

I grew up in Chicago.  The deep dish is a little better, but still plumbs the depths of mediocrity.

However, after having tasted New Orleans pizza in a few places, this joint is probably better than most in town.

For New York style, Pizza NOLA is much better.

Nice place off 4th street. The food portions were wildly generous and the chips and salsa flow all night. I got the taco salad with steak and it was enormous. Very well balanced full of veggies and a hearty portion of steak. The service was a little wonky at times but the atmosphere was lovely.

O'Bistro carries gluten free products, but even if you order it, sometimes it comes out tainted. Double check your food. 

It's a shame too, because when you have a food allergy, you would rather have a sub par meal than be contaminated with gluten. The food here is good, almost getting sick from my takeout.. Not cool.

Staying at the Marriott Courtyard near this location and decided to try a pizza delivery by them and I was not disappointed.  The pizza was hot, fresh and delicious.  I was told it would be delivered in 40 minutes, but was delivered in 30.  I highly recommend this business.

I have been here a number of times and have always had good experiences. For some reason, the service was really bad this time. They were not especially busy. Maybe the waiter was having a bad day or he is inexperienced.  The food was also not up to their usual standards.

Been here a few times with my kids. The ice cream is overpriced and the lines are usually long. As the only place at Armature Works that serves dessert, these guys are making a killing. Portion sizes of the exact two ice cream bowls were not the same, which caused controversy between my kiddos. Next time, we'll probably pass...

fun place , lots of cool stuff to look at in there.Solid chicago style pizza , they offer other dishes as well.  Im not the hugest  fan of chicago style pizza , but I would bet this is the best around Tampa bay.   To me this is a place you go to at least see once for yourself.

A New Orleans classic. Always has unique flavor options as well as classic options, such as Cookie Monster or red velvet.

I usually get one scoop in a cup with 2 different flavors. 

Prices: Very reasonable! Just remember: Cash only.
Family friendly. 
Very chill atmosphere.

This place is very warm and cozy with a laid back vibe. We went in there on a random Thursday night for one drink and had 3 or 4 of their Moscow mules. Definitely THE BEST mule I've ever had. They didn't have live music that night but the music they were playing kept us staying and wanting more.

The new lady who is the cashier in the mornings has totally turned this Dunkin' around! She is so pleasant when taking my order and always ensures everything is correct. I love that she is friendly and takes the time to provide great customer service first thing in the morning! Keep it up

I like staying at the Springhill Suites because they're a touch nice than other hotels. This one isn't as nice as others in this chain. Service and the people were very friendly and welcoming, just thought the hotel  could be nicer. The location is about off the freeway as well. I'd stay here again...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is our weekly craving... everything is so good and fresh, especially their dressings and sauces! Pizza is amazing , my favorite pizza is Ds delight, I also like the pinwheels. They also have a great lunch menu! The staff is friendly and I always enjoy going in there. You won't be disappointed !

Ordered Red Curry and an iced Thai tea. The curry had no flavor at all and there were about 3 pieces of bell pepper in the entire thing. It was all bamboo shoots. The Thai tea was all milk and had no flavor. Very disappointed because I've heard good things about this place.

I scream, you scream, we all scream for CHARCOAL ICE CREAM!!! Huge thanks to owner Chris who gave us 2 complimentary charcoal cups for our charcoal ice cream cake layer! This was the best sweet 16 cake ever, thank you!!!! Best HOT new trendy ice cream in Philly, GO!! ps our tongues are black :) ha ha

Uhhh.. I don't really understand the hype. They come in pretty containers you know the iconic ones but I mean the whole night I felt sick from drinking this. We also got the hellos shots which were fun to try. The prices are really cheap and that's a good part of this place but you can tell you be using cheap stuff.

Social distancing, and masks are required. 

Fresh doughnuts are definitely here. I came to get a hazelnut colada, and only drank some of it. I forgot my son was with me, and he drank the majority of it. 

We also had fresh blueberry doughnuts. One a piece. We will definitely be back soon.

Surprised with the 3 star rating. My taco was so good it was as if I just stepped foot in Mexico City. The bartender told me which meal to get. Unbelievable taste. Authentic ingredients. True Mexican food. Nashville has the worst Mexican. This is a true exception.

Caught up at the last minute and asked if they could change a tire out said no problem. Drop the car off 20 minutes later they told us to be back in an hour. We came back a few hours later because we had to work and they only charge us $21 to change out my flat tire. Thanks so much guys could work
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The smell was too overwhelming and the organization of the store made it very confusing to find certain items. It has a selection of items but I think Kimpo has a better assortment, and they're about the same size. I don't think I'd be returning to this store; I would recommend driving to Kimpo or Lee Lees.

My girlfriend and I met here for a three-hour lunch. It's a girl thing. Always excellent service, I ordered the field greens salad with goat cheese but added their grilled house smoked shrimp - killer. They have one of the best flavored iced teas in town too. I can't recall if it's peach or not, but it's something like that.

The Internet was down during my entire stay. Which meant I had to go to Starbucks at 7 in the morning to study for a test for grad school. Also the entire place reeked and it was obvious that they've done no maintenance to the hotel in years. Disappointed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Service was horrible.  Took forever to get refills.  Was not impressed with the service. 

Salsa was not chunky.  I like thick chunky salsa.  If you don't mind, then salsa was okay.  Had a decent flavor.  

The entree was good.  The steak had a great flavor.   

I won't be going back.

So we use to go to Angelo's and they were great haven't been there in a few months because of the holidays. We ordered tonight and realized prices went up and when we got the food it was different and not as great. I mean it was ok but it use to be better. I'm wondering if they have new owners.

Seriously, who raves about brussel sprouts? Apparently I do. This otherwise horrendously disgusting excuse for a vegetable is a total rockstar on the Meat N Potatoes menu. I don't know what they do to it, but it's completely epic- give the brussel sprouts a chance. Great fish tacos and filets as well. Yummy food!

We came here after seeing a movie and it was just what we needed!! Nice atmosphere with a great outdoor area! The service was excellent! We were lucky enough to be the first customers to try the ravioli, and it did not disappoint! The chef came to the table and presented our dish! Awesome experience will definitely be back!

Best Italian restaurant in the area hands down!
Everything from service to food is phenomenal. You feel right at home in this atmosphere.
Just remember to make your reservations ahead of time because it can get packed. Can not recommend this place enough!! Me and my husband have been going for years and not a thing has changed!

The donuts are little works of art...looks like you made donuts with your kids. Very heavy on icing but good tasting donut if you scape a bit of that sugary drizzle. Coffee is low on the list here but worth trying their donuts which run about $2 or more a piece

Has a nice feel to it but when you dig in not enough natural and Organics considering the demographics. So it's the kind of store I pick up a thing or two and still have to rely on Whole Foods and Trader Joe's. Pls pls carry more vegan and organic products.

Mediocre food for unreasonable prices. The pasta sauce is homemade I believe but there was way too much olive oil which drowned out the herbs and other flavors and pooled at the bottom of the meatballs. Margherita pizza had similar sauce so there was absolutely no flavor to it. Very disappointed after reading such great reviews.

Coming from So Cal, our expectations were low. The service here was extremely slow, but very friendly...they run on Tennessee time. The sushi was better than I had expected. 2 for 1 sake was an unexpected bonus. We had the nasty Nate..worth trying. Smelt roll is good if you're a fan of the quail egg.

Racket warning!!! Be Careful highway robbery . Undisclosed 30 dollar parking fee per night. First room we were given smelled like an ash tray. And another undisclosed 9Am construction to seal the deal. 3 strikes your out. Bad business. Hate  to give bad reviews but come on.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I normally go to Wasabi or Mikado when I want to eat some Japanese food. But sometimes I go to Kobe because of the affordability. I find their sushi is slightly better than Kyoto Japanese Restaurants in town but I like this place because it is family friendly. They also serve a wide range of Japanese foods. Worth a try.

Sushi was okay, very small sushi rolls with very little fish in each roll. Nothing really stood out here. Even the avocado on top of the rolls was cut super thin. Also found an eyelash in my roll. Ugh .... At least the server was very nice. I think there are many other competing sushi restaurants that are much worth it than here.

I love Foundation coffee! Today was my first visit to the Sparkman Warf Foundation location and it's honestly as nice as any location they have!!! The barista took a careful art to making my latte and it was a beautiful experience, I have now been to this location twice and my coffee is always amazing and the service is great!

Came for the first time to Uva with my family. We shared the calamari appetizer and then I had the angel hair pasta with shrimp. Then got a cannoli for dessert.  Everything was really good and the service was excellent! I also really enjoyed the colored fountains.

Seafood udon 4 stars
Chicken teriyaki 2 stars chicken was over cooked and dry
Dragon rolls 3 stars
California rolls 4 stars
Prawns tempura 5 stars
Decor 4 stars
Service 2 stars

Not that impressed with our experience.
I won't drive across the city to visit again.
Yelp let me down.

We were there lastnight for a birthday dinner and evening was delicious. The server was so attentive, we didn't have to ask for anything. I had the Vodka Rigatoni and it was so yummy. My girlfriend had the Eggplant Parmigiana and it was tasty not mushy at all. Really friendly staff and great food.

I've been coming here since I was very young - a family experience. The owner knows me and is always friendly, love that they have quality food at an affordable price. Check out the lunch specials, you get a ton of food. Not necessarily a fancy sushi bar, but it does well for what it offers.

This hotel has a great location on Canal Street. It is just across the street from the French Quarter. The Streetcar line is in front of the hotel. Most of the major Mardi Gras parades pass this hotel down the side street. Also Harrah's Casino is next door. We will stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Food good. Very small menu choices. Salad is small. You just get lettuce,  tomatoes, n carrots. Soda selection is small. They give you only 2 warm rolls n ice cold butter.
The music they play is Mexican. The staff is Mexican. The name is Italian.  You would think all Italian workers n music.

A bit over-priced for the quality. I wasn't a big fan of their crust being that flavorless and bready. The pizza waffle fries were pretty good, but I wish they had actual pepperonis on than these bland little ones that look like you got them from a Walmart pack.

One of the worst locations on the north side of Indy. Today there were TWO people working on drinks for over 13 people waiting....it took the cashier over 7 tries to put an iced coffee drink order in correctly. I get these are difficult times, but managers need to schedule enough employees to take care of customers.

Enjoyed a clean room.  The bed was comfortable.  Rates were great during the week.  If you want inexpensive no frills motel this is a great place.  They had a microwave in lobby where we heated food.  Highway accesible where we were able to go to Solvang (50 minutes away) and Santa Bárbara.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I have had the guys at Meineke spend a couple hours over the course of 4 different visits, and in each case never been charged as they have all been re-call issues. Finally went back and had some massive work done, and they gave me a great deal on labor, drove me home AND picked me up! Won't go anywhere else...
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Mediocre pasta for high prices. Their pasta was $24 (parpadelli) for barely any meat, lots of onions and lots of pasta. There is also lack of consistency, sometimes raviolis are dry, sometimes good. I think I've given this place enough chances for their food to taste better.

Ordered delivery for a bunch of rolls and tempura. The taste was good, nothing too bad. But the sizes of the sushi rolls were smaller than expected. 

The tempura was good but the sauce provided tasted bottled. However, no issues there. 

I would have probably given 4 stars if we got proper sized sushi rolls.

Saturday evening at 9:30pm we went in and a guy greeted us and said the kitchen is closed.  Hours on the door said 10pm, and they have a bright neon "open" light.  So if you want to try out this place go before the staff decides they are done for the evening.

Hot, fast delivery, and a great price for what you get! We ordered on a Sunday afternoon and it was great. They offered no contact delivery and easily found our apartment, not many delivery drivers take the time to and we have to meet them on the street so this was much appreciated!

Coffee? Check. Fresh donuts? Yes. Reasonable prices?  Yes. Great alternative to the Starbucks? Check. Sometimes there are even coupons. I didn't have any today but that didn't deter me. I'm not sure why I can't add own cream and sugar or why there isn't a non dairy creamer option? Just a thought

This is our go-to place when we want to go out. The service is prompt and friendly, the beer list long and varied. Good burgers and sandwiches for meat lovers and vegetarians alike. I especially enjoy the hippie gumbo and their breakfast offerings. The coffee cake is sooooo good. See you soon, Sahm's; thanks for being there for me.

Great if you want some authentic spin of the border mexican food. They also have some American twists on their menu such as the fries with meat which is essentially nachos but with French fries instead of chips. The workers are always so nice no matter what time you come and they always give you plenty of salsa.

Saw this on my drive home. Took my parents here. 
We ordered the pork tamale, veggie burrito, and pastor and chicken tacos. 

Everything was great. Owner was very friendly. Salsas were delicious. I just moved back from Austin, Texas. The food was almost as good as the tacos I got there. For Indy, this is a great shop.

In a nice way , the food court at the mall has better food . Although delivery was quick . The food was just awful ..... the worst part about it that it was overpriced but I gave it chance to see if the quality was worth it and I looks like I got the complete opposite .

Best thing to happen to Metairie! So happy to know they have an amazing coffee shop now that I can go to when on the east bank. You can't go wrong with French truck coffee it's delish and the staff is always awesome. Just to make it better it's inside Whole Foods! Winning!

This location needs a massive upgrade. Building and interior are dated. Rooms are tired and just feel dingy and worn. If you are staying one night as you pass through town - fine - but any longer I would say find something else. There are zero amenities near the hotel or even at the hotel. IHG can and should do better.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Every time I go to this McDonald's I'm highly disappointed. The wait time is always ridiculous. Especially in the morning. Most of the staff is rude or incompetent. 95% I receive an incorrect order. This store really needs to clean house and start all over!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I was stranded at Hilton Head Airport because the Buget employees decided to leave early at 3pm, even though I had an email and phone confirmation to pick my car up from Budget at 3:30pm. The National employee stepped up and helped me figure out how to get a car for a reasonable price.

The coffee is so delicious but if you aren't a coffee expert, make sure you do your research before you set foot here. They might be a little too pretentious for their own good, and I always try to give baristas the benefit of the doubt. The owner was fantastic though. Super helpful and friendly.

The employees are the best thing about this car wash. Since Champion took over the quality sucks!! It leaves soap on my cars after the rinse and the driers leave water on the car, I called several times to complain but they are to embarrass to return my call. Go somewhere Else Champion Car Wash Sucks!

Don't go to this Wendy's if you actually want fast food. Tried several time because it's close to work but no matter what time i go, even if there's no one else in line, it takes forever. Used up my whole 30min break trying to get a burger only to have to go back to work with no burger

Eh. Sushi wasn't great. I got the 3 roll special and the rolls I got were pretty bland. I also got the seaweed salad which I figured would be difficult to mess up but I was wrong. I took one bite and couldn't eat any more. I feel bad giving 1 star so I put 2 :/

We love Nicey Treat! Especially on a hot day! It's such a great dessert after lunch and a stroll through Broad Ripple. I love how many options they have! The grapefruit lavender popsicle is my favorite and the kids love getting theirs dipped in chocolate. I think the popsicles are a little pricey, but they really are so delicious!

UPDATE. This Wendy's has CHANGED their chili. It tastes different, and is mad spicy. It has black pepper visible all in it, and is just not good. Go to the Ridge Pike or Montgomeryville locations instead. I seriously can't even stomach this Wendy's chili anymore.

If this is Heaven I never want to leave! The staff, quality of service, convenient location, value, and the drinks all make im in class worthwhile! Got a pedicure done here and I have to admit I didn't want to leave that massage chair at all! When I come back to Nola, I will definitely make a stop here again! 5/5

First time, and definitely not last. If you find yourself in NOLA, check out this outdoor/indoor pub. Plenty of space to chill with a nice adult beverage. Dog friendly patio. Tasty food. Clean above all! Host your next celebration, or get together here as you catch a ball game on one of their multiple televisions. Cheers!

I mean how can a pink berry anything be bad but alas 'twas so! The gal taking my order was using blackened bananas and luckily the young kid there was like ' whoa girl go cut up a new banana ' still old and mushy nonetheless and the frozen yog was just ok nothing like back home pink berrys oh well

Service for a busy weekend evening was very good.

The recommendations were strong and the night was highlighted by the Vetri roll.  Eel isn't usually what I believe to be the strongest base for great sushi roll but combined with some truffled uni and it was delectable.

Chef Zama again did not disappoint!

Just hated it!!! I had a steak quesadilla and it really taste like burnt water. There was only lettuce, cheese, and sour cream on it. I had to be honest with the waitress when she asked, is everything ok?? I said no, and she literally laughed so I laughed back lmao.. I didn't even eat half of the quesadilla that I order.

The bridge has been burned. Don't lie about what's wrong with a car just so you can get a bigger commission out of it.. 
Also shoutout to that one mechanic who told us to buy our own parts for a hell of a lot cheaper and going to a mechanic. You're the real MVP
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
There is a dnd by my house and then there's this one by my work.
I alwayyyyyys bypass the one by my house for this one and the other one has a drive thru.

This one has always been kind and fast! Their drinks are consistently delicious and taste the same every time!

The staff was very helpful and fast. Our orders came out prompt and correct! 

My only improvement suggestion is the cleanliness of the bathrooms. They were absolutely filthy at 8:30 on the morning. I can only imaging they haven't been cleaned in days let alone keeping up their regular schedule.

The food, especially the sushi and sashimi, are a 4-5 stars. They get 3 stars because of the rude and nasty server. Come in for the food, but keep your expectations on service and friendliness as low as you possibly can. I'm ok with that. The food was fabulous...

Best place in the area for your sushi cravings. Sushi cafe offers a fresh and tasty variety. They offer many options at affordable prices. Be cautious that some names are not your typical offerings. For example, I ordered a Philly roll (salmon) and received Krab. Overall, recommend for lunch and dinner.

This place has very slow, rather unfriendly service, but the food is great - fresh and yummy, and we scored a large table for our group upstairs and that was great too. I had unagi with rice, and hot sake - both delicious. The sushi looked great too - I'd try a roll or two next time.

This hotel is located just a few minutes from the airport and a quick Uber ride downtown.  The rooms are nice but the walls are thin so be ready to wake up with your neighbors.  The bar staff are very friendly and the service is excellent.  The card swipes to exit the parking lot are slow to respond.  Overall, 4 out of 5.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I got a cut here on Wednesday. The guy that did my cut spoke very little English but he gave me exactly what I showed him in the photo. Also when they wash your hair they add a massage in and they wash it three times. Over all it was so relaxing and exactly what I wanted in terms of the look. It's $25 for long hair.

At first I was skeptical to try this place because I am a pretty picky when it comes to "Chinese food" but this place is AWESOME and the price is right too!  I love all their soups, and love the sesame chicken.  They will even let me special order it without all the breading.  A must try!

I am lucky enough to live on the same street as this shop and can drop my car off and walk home. When my brother locked his keys in his car he just walked up and asked and they gladly walked down the street and slim jimmed him back in at no charge.  More honest, professional mechanics cannot be found anywhere.

The soup was amazing, possibly the best I've ever had to the point I bought some to go. 
The fried food though was questionable and hurt my stomach which is why only three stars, couldn't finish it. 
The service was really great although I do agree with a slight language barrier.

Nice looking rooms that are clean with lovely staff.  However, the beds are ROCKS even those with the feather toppers for the beds.  So hard!  If that is what you like it is a 5 star if not it is 3.  I would have kept staying there if the beds were better.  Never again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: It is the worse Italian food I ever had. It looked and tasted horrible. Chef Boyardee out of can is better. The chicken parm lasagna and veal was like leather. Chicken Alfredo was a serving size for a little kid and was soupy. Way to  pricey for this garbage. Don't waste your money. Even their coffee was like mud.

Awesome pizza shop...these guys have the best cheesesteaks around.  Anytime I'm home from CA I HAVE to stop here and grab the buffalo chicken cheesesteak.  They also have great pizza and hoagies.  I wonder how I can get these guys to open a Joey's in California :).

Super good italian food. I wish the pizza wasn't so greasy, though, it makes the cheese slide off almost immediately and it's hard to handle. However the mozzarella sticks were very tasty with a good serving of fresh cheese! And i especially liked the dough/pizza crust. Will be back to try more.

Ordered a simple pork fried rice. The rice was bland. Not well fried. The meat was very sparse (approximately 6 pieces in entire order and fatty. The only other ingredient besides rice and "meat" are sprouts and egg. Overall a very lack luster flavor experience. The staff was friendly and prompt.

It's a liquor store. Went in. Got my bottles. Left. The workers are kind of in their own world and they don't really communicate with the customers until you are checking out. I noticed that some were familiar with some of their customers who must be regulars.

Whoever was working drive through this morning was extremely rude and sarcastic for absolutely no reason. Blonde older guy probably late 20s early 30s. Tried to call to complain but apparently they don't have a working phone number? If you don't know how to talk to people don't work in customer service??

Nice rooms but worst customer service I've ever experienced. The system lost my reservation, the front desk failed to remedy in reasonable time, and the Wi-fi password never worked. At least the shuttle guys were nice enough to pick up and drop off at odd hours.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I was hoping to grab a quick lunch here, but that didn't happen.  Service was really slow and the pizza wasn't that great either.  I tried the cauliflower pizza, after I was informed that it is one of their best sellers, but it was too greasy for my liking and didn't really taste like anything.

Tried this place for the first time with a best friend who had recommended it. Drinks were great and staff was friendly! So cool to try a secret bar in Tucson. Had fun trying the dice game to pick a shot to try too! Can't wait to go back to try more drinks there sometime!!

If you like Mexican food you will love this place.   Hands down one of the best Mexican restaurants in the area.  They have this location and also one in Swansea.  When looking for the place just look for the big palm trees outside.   Nice outside area that I plan on taking advantage of when the weather gets nicer.

We go here oom occasion with some friends who love this place.  The music is good, but it's  not my "style" (they play a lot of Motown). The place is always electric, friendly and packed.  I am sure we will be back, although i prefer the 79s-90s rock/pop music at the Famous Door down the street...

This restaurant underpays and overworks children... yikes. 
Have fun with those civil penalties! 

Glad to know those kids are getting compensated though. 

Hit funny, cool, or helpful if you're against this type of business operation and want to support those kids and people abused for their work and time.

Oh this place just bring soo many memories! What's wrong here? NOTHING! This place it's really good and everything is soo fresh! Orange juice freshly squeezed, french fries freshly cut, burgers are really good but the best part are the shakes you name it they have it!

We were there in the morning to get a baked good.  The bagel was not fresh and tasted old not soft and fresh.  This Kroger seemed smaller than the ones we are used to visiting.  Although, this is a good location to stop and gas up your car off the interstate.

This location is clean and modern, but not very well run.  The order kiosks have been broken when I tried to use them.  The service the other night was very slow - it took them over 10 minutes to get the fries with my order and then my burger was not warm.  I live local and eat here a couple of times a month, but I am about done.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We went back last night. The food was still exceptional and this time the service was flawless. Looks like they have everything figured out. The food came out on time and there were no long waits. We decided that we will try to make this a regular treat. So happy to have a Japanese fine dining option in the area!

Food is fine just the employees seem to have a attitude and lack experience slow business but waited like 10 minutes when there were like no more than 1  ahead of me and the person serving me typically threw my food at me but to make matters worse there seems to be drug addicts, but everything else is okay
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: A very modern Dunkin location. It looked like this location just opened as everything is soo well maintained. There are outlets scattered throughout the place which makes it an ideal location to get work done. The staff members are friendly and wished all of the locations were like this.

Not sure what people expect.. it's a BK there always some what fast and friendly and food is always about what I expect from a fast food place and the fact it's close to me work makes it even more convenient for me. I do wish they had a smaller value meal but I can live with it..

Coffee is amazing here! Just be warned they don't have wifi so it's not the best study spot imo, but they have plenty of seating and friendly baristas. 

My main cons are that they close super early, and that I 100% saw a mouse running along the wall. Be wary and have your feet up and keep your bags off the ground!

I have stayed at this hotel twice. Both stays were two nights. I like the hotel, and had the complimentary breakfast during each stay. The staff was pleasant and accommodating. The rooms are nice and clean. They also put different types of warm cookies in the lobby! I would stay here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I gave it a shot since I heard multiple people in town say good things. It was fine. Just donuts. Nothing really stood out about them. They pretty much tasted what you would think a fresh Dunkin' Donuts would taste like. Probably won't go back. I can find better in town.

The food, selections and service are outstanding!! Even their Raspberry Ice Tea is sooooooooooooo delicious!!! Check out their large menu. Enjoy their exceptional, soups, salads and best of all, their sushi  sashimi and tempura (including, vegetable, shrimp, chicken tempura )!!! Great indoor dining and take-out!!

Not sure what happened to Los Betos but it seems to get worse with each visit and this morning's trip will most likely be my last.  My breakfast burrito had an off, peculiar taste, so much so that I threw it away.  There's probably some things that are still good here, but I'm not willing to try and find them.

Had the hot turkey sandwich daily special on my last visit. The meat wasn't lunchmeat style, but chunks of turkey breast pulled off a roasted bird.  The coleslaw is homemade and tasty but the best part of any meal here is the pineapple cake...moist, amazing and delicious enough to make me come for a meal just for the dessert!

The taste is OK but not memorable. There was nothing wow about it. In fact, we took the Supreme pizza home, fresh right out of their over. 10 minutes later, I tried the pizza and it was soggy and cold. It's definitely not NY style to me. Save your money and go elsewhere, even Pizza Hut or Dominoes.

The exterior car wash is good, but the free vacuum service doesn't compare to its competitors. The suction picks up the bare minimum. I keep coming back bc it's the closest to home, but am realizing that it's not worth it bc the interior of my car doesn't really get cleaned.

The service is spectacular!
The menu is short but diverse!
Every dish is executed well. 
I get the ramen or the NY steak salad usually. 
The price is way cheap for what you get!
And yes you must be a Church member to enjoy this restaurant unless there is a special event.

This spot is conveniently located adjacent to the hospital and Perlman center, offering your standard Starbucks staples. Their cue is often short and if you're lucky, food may be disseminated minutes before closing time. The seating area is quaint, though not cozy like other neighboring Starbucks locations. Overall solid spot!

We walked down Bourbon Street and saw all of the people carrying these big bright yellow drinks and we just HAD to get one. Great marketing. They were really good, but definitely on the sweeter side. It's more of a touristy thing to do, but it was fun and good. I couldn't drink more than one because of the sweetness!

The pizza here is pretty solid! The portion size is nice. The deep dish corn meal pizza is amazing. The thin crust meat lovers pizza is full of meat. The stuffed peppers were not spicy and yummy. The service is good. The atmosphere is hipster and has a full service bar. The salad portions are large enough for 2 people to share.

Can't go wrong with Starbucks! I got a coldbrew with almond milk and a shot of vanilla in a reusable cup. I did have to add a bit of creamer and vanilla to it but it was still tasty! The condiment bar could've used a bit of attention as far as filling up empty or almost empty containers but we made do with what was there.

Service was terrible but the donuts were delicious. No donut name tags of what stuff was and when I had a question, the lady was so rude and made my feel like an idiot. Still mesmerised by how soft this swirl donut was. The chocolate part was so soft. I don't understand. I want it for forever and it'll now be in my dreams.

I have been a member for years and have nothing but wonderful things to say about them. Great service and a true spirit of innovation. When I mention new services that IMCU has implemented many of my friends respond with "I wish my bank did that."  I am glad my bank is IMCU.

We stopped here on the way to the airport and had lunch. Service was excellent, and the bread was fresh from a local bakery, sandwiches were good. Ample seating, tight parking lot, but right across the street from a Cafe Du Monde and next door to a coffeehouse.

This was a small shop inside an office building and hotel. A short walk from my hotel and I came in for a drink to tide me over for the commute. 

The barista was very quick and friendly. She apologized for a delay in helping me since a man wouldn't stop talking to her. 

My coffee was hot and tasty and I have no complaints! :)

This. Is. The. Place. Wow the band late last night was INSANE. We had the beat time people watching and listening to great music. 

The bartender (I think her name was Lindsey) worked her a** off. Man did she move keeping drinks flowing and orders moving. 

The bathrooms are super clean too, not what I was expecting!

I really like the French Truck Coffee local chain and this one is in a great spot and has some really friendly staff!  Fully stocked with a nice selection of munchies and a wide array of coffee  choices you can't go wrong. don't forget about iced tea - mmmmmmm.

I would never shop here, the reputation they had was never good. You could smell sour meat as you walk in the market. People who do shop there obviously don't value their stomachs. Maybe they like having food poisoning. It's a Cousins on Baltimore Ave, I'll never shop there for food. I'll buy napkins, and paper towels!!!

Definitely not the original. Beignets were doughy and not crispy on the outside, WAY too much sugar, I get it's supposed to have a lot but this was drowned double the amount at the original location. 

Cafe au lait here was burnt and not really even drinkable. One sip and I was done. I'll stick to the original.

Definitely NY style pizza. Tried several places in this area and Mark Anthony hit the spot. Their cheese pizza is Thin crusted and the sauce was on point! Their Sicilian was amazing true thick crust. The antipasto salad had so much meat in it. Their price is amazing too! Very nice owner.

Ordered takeout on Cinco de Mayo. We understood that it may take a little while to get our food, but our order still wasn't ready after more than two hours so we finally cancelled. What made it worse is that it's my oldest child's birthday today and it ruined our birthday dinner.

The restaurant lacks in aesthetic appeal from the outside but the inside is cute. The food is good, wouldn't go as far as saying amazing. The service is good, again wouldn't say amazing. The hibachi wasn't my favorite, would prefer to go and just order off the menu.

First time ordering from La Crema Caffe! The Calabrese panini was tasty as well as the cinnamon bun. I ordered over the thanksgiving weekend, and they gave me a free ginger cookie with a cute note :) I will definitely check them out in person once dine in is back!

Burger King in Ballwin is not that great. The cheeseburgers were ok. The frys were ok as well. The restaurant is clean. The staff is friendly.  The soda fountain is way to watered down. It doesn't taste like soda. More water than anything. Mgmt needs to reengage and re train the associates. I give this location 3 out Of 5.

Trying to be understandable with covid and staff shortages. But we honestly think they forgot about us. 

It took forever to get out drinks out and a table that sat down much later got their food before us 

Our waiter was friendly when she came to the table ...  food was great but not worth the wait

Have waited in the drive-through line for at least 10 minutes and still waiting while I write this review. Came for a quick iced coffee, but sadly am going to have to stick with the Starbucks we have all around this town. This is the second time I haven't had a great experience with the time of their service. /:

First time here today, walked in waited all of 5 minutes and Vicky took me right back for my gel manicure.  She was great!!  Took her time I didn't feel rushed she helped me find the perfect color.  This was the best manicure .   I will certainly be back. Thanks Vicky

TERRIBLE! Don't waste your money. It's a shit hole. Dirty rooms, disgusting pool and you can't breathe due to poor ventilation. We will NEVER book Wyndham again. If you stay on the first floor, your room will smell of the curry they're cooking up in the restaurant inside the hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This was the worst place I've ever eaten in Nashville. My meal and 1 glass of wine was $60. The lasagna was fine until I pulled a large hair out of it. The gnocchi was bland and the "grilled" chicken was a rubbery, boiled, unseasoned chicken breast. One word to describe Giovanni west- YUCK.

The sushi is the best one I've ever tried in Lutz. I ordered and my food was ready as soon as I walked in. They gave me some really amazing sauces, except for the soy, I don't like soy to much estrogen in that. Estrogen makes you more feminine, I'm a guy. Anyway I'll be back for more Mexican sushi!

This place is a disgrace.  Rude service and fraudulent business practices, in my humble opinion.  Repeat offenders of no deliveries with no notice, refusal of refunds, etc.  I filed a complaint with grubhub and am submitting this review here in hopes others avoid getting ripped off/treated poorly by this company.

I love the ceviche and chips and guacamole here. Be aware this is almost a tapas style restaurant- everything is small portions so you'll have to order several items to make a "dinner". Cool ambiance, great patio one of the only places in Hyde park village open pass 11pm.

I went there today attempting to pick up foods. During the COVID 19 pandemic, no one, not a single person who handles foods there was wearing a mask... I left. And I will not go back. The workers didn't seem to care, nor the managers or owners. Do I trust foods from there? Sorry, no.

I love the service here. Everyone here was so accommodating and sweet! If I didn't have less than 24 hours in Nashville, I seriously would've just stayed at the bar and chilled with the staff and have great conversations. They gave us great recommendations. Definitely need to come back and enjoy Nashville while staying here!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: It's ehhhhh....we won't go back. Which is a bummer because we really love hibachis. When you pull up it looks closed. The pond inside that they feature is dirty. And the windows need washing. The place setting was not good. BUT the waitress was nice and the guy at the grill was nice and talented, food is better than environment.

This gym is awesome!

Pros: lots of equipment, a nice turf area, great staff, very affordable, allllll the kettle bells

Cons: lifting floor gets a bit crowded because they have a lot of machines packed in, no towel service

Overall, a great gym that I would recommend to anyone!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This was good and very cute warm hippie atmosphere. The food was good. The server was AIGHT. But you know, we went on a sunday and it wasnt terrible wait time or anything. I enjoyed the food and the prices weren't cheap but I wouldn't really say it was expensive either. Food quantity was reasonable as well! Id come back!

The best part of this place is free chips and salsa and an amazing happy hour.  Two for one margaritas that will knock your socks off.  The food is ok, but def not fresh-mex, more like cover it all in cheese and after a few drinks its not so bad.  A fun place for a drink and a cheap dinner.

i got there a exactly 10 am....i thought it opened earlier. I was the only person in the place. Ordered the city waffle with six wings, and scrambled eggs with cheese...wings had a nice flavor (unlike that deep fried cardboard at HODAKS)....the waffle was okay , but they need to steal waffle houses recipe............

It's not accessible by walk from airport. Need to take car rental shuttle although they were very frequent. Have been to such shuttles on many airport but this is not so near by bus too. It took good 15 mins to ride in bus to reach. 

Not a very good experience here while renting car. Had to wait long enough.

I always leave Gauthreaux's with the exact cut I imagined.  I get lots of compliments from people and requests for my barber's information, it lets me know my hair is RIGHT!  Courtney cuts my hair and my son's hair and it's always a great experience.  Gauthreaux's is comfortable, clean and inviting.

The sushi was good. The service was poor. We ordered take out and we're told it would be ready in 15-20 minutes. We ended up sitting around for 45 minutes before our rolls were ready. We would have appreciated more honest communication about the time it would take to make our order.

Original Location!  Great outdoor 'drive-in' atmosphere!  Small but fun.  Food is great and service is even better!  Great shakes.  Onion rings are a MUST.  Always get the Santa Barbara Style burger when in Santa Barbara!!  Made to order. You will not be disappointed !

Great place to come to for a low key night with a group of friends! The outdoor patio has picnic tables and an outdoor bar. The janga on the table is definitely a plus. The indoor area has a dj on the weekends and the best thing is they don't charge a cover. Also the milk stout on tap is amazing.

I'm changing my review because I think the manager is really wonderful. I can tell that he is patient and works really hard. Unfortunately, it can be hard to find good employees sometimes. 
This is a good place if you just need a snack, a coffee, and a place to hang out and do work, send emails, etc.

I WILL NEVER ORDER HERE AGAIN. ordered a pizza at 1130pm. Email said 20-37 minutes. It is now 130am AND I DO NOT HAVE MY ITEMS I PAID FOR AND ORDERED. called the establishment and they were rude and hung up on me when asked about the status of my order. Will I ever get my pizza? Will I get my money back since I never got my items??

Horrible . When I first I moved in I loved it. Since new management it has went downhill. I cannot wait to leave this crap place they call luxury . I call and no one ever answers. I leave voicemails and never get call backs . I get excuses as to why they can't answer phone calls when there all sitting down doing absolutely nothing.

I am a big foodie. When it comes to pizza I may be a bit of a snob. East Ridge Pizza, Scotto's and Gaetano's all of Willingboro have the best pizza in order in all of Burlington County. I've had them all and still it's the list. Guinto's is now the 4th on the list. Taste, service and price. My go to now I'm in Lumberton.

If I was able to leave zero stars I would , customer service is complete shit , they have a bunch of stupid teenagers working there . They fuck up your order and the food is terrible . Never going there again and I highly recommend if you don't want food poisoning you go to a different McDonalds.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ last time I went to koizi was two years ago. Same stuff really. For lunch you get a pretty good deal for $11.99 a person. Fun fact, it used to be $9.99. the dancing crab roll is the best signature roll they got and the koizi roll falls under a close second. Third favorite is the rainbow roll.

This Local family owned restaurant is delicious. 
Amazing fried fish and chicken! 
I don't know how to eat cod cutups without hush puppies and spaghetti anymore.
While there fish and chicken is delicious my favorite meal is the bbq chicken sandwich!!!

Love the food and the drinks.

More grease and MSG than one should have to ever experience, even in a cheap Americanized version of a Chinese restaurant.  Second star is for the staff, who are at least polite and do a decent job of keeping this small restaurant (there are maybe 8 or 10 tables) clean.

Wow, this place was BUSY on Saturday morning. I know why too. They serve very good donuts with a smile. Fresh, yummy, and lots of choices. 
I wanted to try the kolaches because of other reviews and they look so good but we were there for coffee and donuts (no we are not the police) so I stuck to the basics.

Historic building with great aesthetic value. Rooms are clean and spacious. The gym is in a bank vault. Friendly bellhops and door folks. Staff was helpful and easy to work with. I have stayed twice and enjoyed both times. Great hotel with perfect location. Highly recommended!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The food I would say is mediocre.  The environment is comfortable and can be enjoyable to go to with a small group of friends. The only downside I experienced with this restaurant is that they are understaffed.  I'm not sure if it was just the owners running it, but some more servers might help them.

Simply put, this is the best sushi place in town.  The food is off the chart.  The fish is fresh and never disappoints at all.  This is a business I am more than happy to support.  They also finish your meals off with a plum sorbet that is delicious! Get a group, and check it out. This place is a hidden gem.

I had not heard of this restaurant prior to eating here. I am giving a 5 star rating solely based on how delicious the food was. The service was mediocre, but wow! The food really hit it out of the park! The service was good, but the food sold it for me. I can't say anything but positive remarks for this restaurant

Took a suit jacket and pants in to be cleaned for my husband. They only returned the jacket. Weeks later they finally found out they gave them to someone else who had returned them and they sat there for weeks not knowing who's they were until we kept calling repeatedly. Unreal!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I have been here twice. The service was very friendly and attentive both times, no complaints there. The first time I went the food was good, I really enjoyed the truffle fries. The second time however, the food was not good at all. Both my dish and my friend's dish (I had eggplant parm) lacked flavor.

I was just traveling through and stopped to workout plus take a shower. Front desk staff was really nice and checkin was a breeze. The place was clean and the equipment all worked. The showers and locker were really nice. No complaints if I was local I would join there
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Great sushi hot spot. Quality fish in every roll, and the Sashimi is excellently prepared in how it iss sliced and presented. The service at this establishment is super hospital and very friendly. We try to order from here at least 1 time every two weeks it has become that good.

This location is awful. It's as if they take random people off the street to work there. I've never seen the same people there. It's suppose to be hit and ready but even if you call ahead it still takes thirty minutes. I'd suggest paying a little more for better pizza

Don't get the shrimp! They don't devein them. Don't get the veggie spring rolls either because they have pork in them. After I advised the staff I was told "we checked the box, it's tofu."  Last I checked, tofu doesn't taste, smell or have the same texture as pork.

Compared to the other hotels in this area it's reasonably priced. Smaller breakfast then the other hotels but a great selection bagels, wraps, rolls,  fruit etc.there isnt anything to do within walking distance but the shuttle will take i back to the airport where u can get on the train. Highly recommended.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I came here as it was close to home. I was greeted when I walked in. As I was picking my color, I was told my chair was ready. The man who did my pedicure barely spoke to me. He did gestures, tapped my foot and looked at me until I figured out what he wanted me to do. The pedicure was rushed and the quality wasn't great.

Hands down, probably one of the best Bourbon bars in Tampa, in that area. They have a very extensive collection of Bourbons and Whiskey. I enjoyed trying local and other brands I had never heard of. The staff were great and they know their poisons. Will visit again.

I was in desperate need of a trim as this was my first time growing a beard. Set it up with Vernon and basically let him take the reigns on what to do. I could not be happier. I was surprised at the detail a beard could even be given. Definitely will be back. Thanks again.

I want to start off by saying that the saff here is amazing. Aaliyah helped me out at the front desk and kept checking on an issue that I had. When I went to the front desk again I had Jackson check again and he was in no way bothered.  These two made my entire experience and I'm so grateful to them both.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Finally a DD!
The place is quite small but there is a drive thru. I bought a dozen donuts for 8.99 not including tax.
I really like the glazed and blueberry donut. 
The donut itself is very moist and soft but also very sweet.
Can't wait to go back and try other flavors!

Ordered pizza for delivery and it came quick (via door dash). The pizza is super cheesy and hardly any sauce. Pizza is like sex in the sense that even when it's bad it's still good, but I didn't care for it. Still ate it of course but not what I'd pick in the future.

For AYCE sushi in Reno, it isn't one of the cheapest options, but it is tasty. Hard to find a roll without avocado though, so if that's not your thing, I wouldn't recommend it. When we went, there was only one waitress in the entire place and she was clearly stressed out, which made the experience a little tense.

I've been eating Wendys for 35 years and always enjoyed their Classic Chicken sandwich.  I always order it with everything.  I call it  "Fully Loaded" with ALL condiments and extras.  This place nailed it.  Perfect sandwich.  Staff was very nice and made sure they made it exactly the way I wanted.  Will return soon.

The customer service when the wrong pizza was delivered to my house was RIDICULOUS. I was on hold for 20 minutes to even speak with the manager who was less than helpful. At least I got my money refunded.

The only reason I'm even giving this two stars is because the food from here is typically good.

This restaurant was just ok. The food was good, they had gluten free pasta and the waitress was friendly. The prices were a little steep and portion sizes were small. The pasta dishes did not come with soup and/or salad which I would recommend they do. I will not be returning.

4 stars just because it's not the best quality in town. This place is great though I've loved coming here for a few years now. The house salad has the best ginger dressing around and the happy hour is my favorite time of the day to go in. The inside is very nice and the whole place flows pretty well. It's an Oldsmar gem.

No one loves coming to the bank, it is what it is. 

So if I have to come I want the service to be super fast. Chase does just about everything with the atm so the helps avoid a long line of customers waiting for a tell let. 

This location is fairly new and the tellers are ffast

the BEST place. My friends and I come here all the time!!! Well priced and the food is actually very good. Rico, one of the manager is amazing!!!! I only gave them four stars cause their lines get soooo long during rush hour and they only use one of their registers :(

Until now I used to go after work & have a beer to watch the sunset. Except when I went this week, I was surprised to see the ugliest chain length fence not only blocking the view of the sunset but making it feel like I'm in a bad neighborhood or something. Thanks Undertow. Good luck with that.

Love going there. Always so nice. They're busy most days but it's worth the wait. They could tell me an hour and they always move me in 30 minutes. They always do any design I show them and are so caring about my nails. Everything is clean and the place is really new looking.

The pool and beach area are the best around!!! The rooms are not really updated, but they are clean. We aren't really in our rooms anyway!! We come here every year and we love it!! The balcony rooms around the pool are awesome and the sunsets here can't be beat!! Can't wait until next year!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My boyfriend went in today to see the owner to fix a bad haircut he had elsewhere and he has been raving ever since. His hair looks amazing and super clean. He also got a great product that is made locally by the business. Exceptional service and haircut, highly recommend.

Friendly service...
Wow! 
The people working here are a super friendly bunch. Customer service is a 10!

Timely, quick service and super convenient.  Location is great...minutes from the airport!

I would definitely choose Alamo STL when I come back to town!

Sushi here is very good. The fish appears to be very fresh and the rolls are delicious. 
Price is reasonable. The service however could use improving...they need to hire more wait staff. I have not tried the pho here but have heard good things. I will definitely visit again to give this place another shot.

This place is clean, but the menu misrepresents the food. My wife had a SoBro burger with no beef. I had Nashville Hot Chicken biscuits and all it was was Tyson chicken tenders with cayenne peppers sprinkled on. My sweet potato fries were cold. Two tiny biscuits for $11.

My favorite sushi joint in bucks county outside of Oishi in Newtown. This place has it all and the quality is incredible. Highly recommend for hibachi and sushi lovers. Special shout out to the miso black cod. This is the most flavorful item on the menu and I can't get enough

The service here is very well. Truly an relaxing feeling to be away from home. I would like to highlight one particular individual name Ron, the bartender. Ron's service has been amazing and welcoming. Great recommendations on questions I asked.  If Aloft continues to have employees like Ron your company is in great hands.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Love love love this Starbucks! Hannah helped me today and she was great! She was super helpful and patient with our party. This is definitely one of the best starbucks I've been to. Very clean, efficient & professional. All Starbucks should be run like this one honestly, they really have their stuff together! 10/10 recommend!

So first impressions are always important and this one was ok, I had the Chinese chicken rice it was bland and Bourbon Chicken was just ok , so if your looking for fast food and cheap this is the place to go, as always I will give this place a 2nd try to see if it  was just a bad day. I gave it 3 based on price.

I think I'm done with this place. Location is so convenient. Not enough care given to preparing food. Not cooked well, cheese is never melted. Always sorry I went there after I go. Most Wendy's are becoming this way around here. Ruining their reputation. I did go to a Wendy's in KY that was amazing!!!!

What a cute little surprise on orchard! Service was amazing and the food was delicious!  Make sure to call ahead it's an hour wait most nights!  This is the closest to real Italian in Boise!  Wish we had a Little Italy  but for now we will plan to dine here.

The catfish here is good. It's a nice place to come that's usually quiet if you eat outside and want a decent meal in Ashland City. Prices can't be beat. 

I also appreciated that our server was honest about what was frozen and what was made in house. We ordered all her recommendations and were not disappointed.

Super cute place tucked away. Great Pimms Cup drink- Lisa was our bartender and she was super friendly and helpful. They serve these amazing chips with seasoning on them at the bar. seriously they are crack. Love this place! Only con is that it smells like smoke.

Super cute place tucked away. Great Pimms Cup drink- Lisa was our bartender and she was super friendly and helpful. They serve these amazing chips with seasoning on them at the bar. seriously they are crack. Love this place! Only con is that it smells like smoke.

There are several El Magueys in the STL area but this one is not my favorite. Space is small and service is a hit or miss. Food decent, though I like the overall taste at the Chesterfield location off of Olive better. Margaritas are large but pure sugar. Price point is always great!

Delicious little Mexican restaurant and their lemonade is to die for. But, even though their food is made from scratch it really lacks flavor and the chicken is super dry. If you catch one of the servers particularly the female one on the wrong day you won't get attentive service.

Its freezing in here at all times. Ever tried doing cardio with lungs full of ice? And what kind of gym doesn't even have a scale anywhere? I'm not even going to get into the obnoxious "lunk alarm" constantly going off. Its clean and the staff is friendly, but this place sucks.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Wonderful service! I called ahead letting the staff know that I was looking for a quiet place to take an exam at 10am. The hotel was more than accommodating and allowed me to have a very late checkout. Cleaning services completely respected my space and did not knock like I asked them to! Overall great experience!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: A great local establishment in the Brewerytown area. I went to Pete's to get my beard trimmed up. He got me in quick, and had me looking clean in no time. It was my first time in Pete's, but I'm a regular customer from here on out. Definitely check out Pete's if you need a barber in Philadelphia. You will not be disappointed here.

We went there on my my boyfriends birthday.  There was so much hype.  It didnt meet the hype.  For  huge pizza lovers we were highly disappointed.  Bland pizza.  Service was not so great.  Thankfully we had a coupon.  WWe will not be back ever and will not reccommend! Poor parking!

Very polite and a very good deal. Two pairs of glasses, including the eye exam, for $79. The doctor was really nice and welcoming. Very sweet woman! The front desk was a little jumbled, but nonetheless i was seen within 30 min. They have a good selection but i will wait to see what my new glasses will look like!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I am a huge fan of Crust-when then reopened on Main Street I was thrilled! This was my first time trying a calzone there, build your own with sausage, artichoke and roasted mushrooms. Unfortunately the artichoke was unnoticeable other than that it was pretty good-definitely doughy but I guess that's expected in a calzone!

I get it, it's a spin on ice cream. It's decent, it's not great. If people visit I'm not taking them. It's a particular favorite of my little sisters, it's no Angelo bercata (I don't think I'm spelling that right), but that's Apple and oranges. It's okay, we'll priced, decent, solid 4

Hotel Californian was an amazing experience.  Beautiful property. The rooftop pool is perfect. Also the food up there was yummy.  This place was recommended to me and really exceeded my expectations.  The beds were super comfortable and the rooms were pretty large.  Great views. Highly recommend staying here
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Wandered into this place for trivia night on a Monday. Love that they have wine on tap I enjoyed the rosé. Also so many great specialty cocktails on the list. I've had the satsuma old fashioned which I assumed is seasonal. And also the s'mores cocktail with the peanut butter bourbon. Oh so many good things can't wait to go back

Vegetarian alert! Best sushi I've ever had in my entire life. My boyfriend of 5 years said that this was hands down the best meal  he has had in our 5 years and let me just say... we've hit up some amazing places

Hands down without a doubt would come back every single time.

This place is ok but I wouldn't go back.  My girl is on a semi kosher diet so she is very limited on fish basically tuna, salmon and fake crab.. she wanted to switch the fish on the dish and they wouldn't allow because it's the rule..we were the only table in the restaurant so it's not like they were to busy to accommodate.

I ordered the barbecue burger and it was absolutely horrible. When they made the onion rings that go on the burger they left the skin of the onion on and so underneath the breading was the hard part of the onion skin. The burger was anemic and not hot nor juicy. Way too much barbecue sauce. Disappointing experience

Tried to plan my rehearsal dinner there. My bridemaid called, I called, my fiancé called. We each called this location and Ambler and were constantly told someone would call us back. I even got "can I call you right back?"... Not a word. Wrote a review on Facebook and got blocked! Guess they don't want business.

Incredible. Truly best sushi in town. Habanero Yellowtail and Salmon/Mango/Passion Fruit rolls are my favorites! Yes it's pricey, but you will be full, and you will leave with a smile on your face. Make the drive and plan for one of the best romantic dinners in town!

Everyone was super nice and helpful! Everything was delicious except for the ramen. The broth tasted kind of weird, almost old. The broth ruined the entire meal for me, I was kind of disappointed. However the sushi and service made up for where the ramen lacked! Will be returning in the future but never ordering ramen.

Only been in once (April 2016), but was impressed enough I wanted to log it here. Sat at the sushi bar and went the distance from miso,seaweed salad,sashimi,rolls and a first for me "soft shell crawfish sushi"...it was a great experience overall, looking forward to returning and having something to compare this experience to.

I'm sure we most likely hit tonight on an off night, because my wife and our dinner service didn't resemble other reviews. Two parking spaces in back, waitress messed up five separate items. Food was on par with other sushi spots. Nothing notable or exceptional. Ambience and cleanliness was average.

Never even heard of this place till i had to wash 3 levels of football jerseys. This is the way to go. They have jumbo washers....theyll take like 8 loads, thats mind blowing. Ill bet even Stormy Warren couldnt do that. They serve beer, have food, tvs...so awesome!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Neat little care wash, prices for auto clean are from $6-$9 an something I found pretty awesome, they have two dog or car I guess, washing stations. Bring about 10-15$ to wash your buddy and it has soap an all the works.... Only thing that'd make this better is a 4th auto washing bay.

Favorite local chinese!! We have tried all the area places and nothing compares. GREAT food. Never had a problem. I always require changes (I don't eat pork or onions, don't like celery in my cashew chicken) and they always accommodate. I find the staff friendly.

This is a great cheap place to get take out.  The combo plate is one of the cheapest in town and they pile it with food.

  Service is always very friendly and fast.  It's a small space with few tables and the ambiance is non existent but it's fine for a quick lunch. I don't think I'd take a date here.

Tried this place out because I'm trying different nail salons in my neighborhood.  While my nails look great , I feel as though it was too expensive for what I received. I got a pedi and dip mani it was 80$. For 80$ I wish there was some more added value to the experience.

The service was fantastic! My fish tacos were deliciously seasoned and the avocado upsell was on point. My friend had the omelette which was the smallest omelette either of us have ever seen, for the price it should be much bigger. Overall pretty good and great location.

Store is never open during early business hours like advertised. Ive tried to come here around 6am each day and it's still closed.  Their yelp info says open 24/7 which is completely untrue. Whoever runs this particular location needs some help or this store will lose alot of business. Sure lost mine.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants
