text: As it's a McDonald's fast food restaurant I know not to expect much here. BUT this specific location is probably one of the worst. I Ordered 2 oatmeals and received not only old dry oatmeal but no spoon to eat it. Also no napkins. The disgusting  slobs that work here really make this location a huge failure.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Nasty place. Food is dry and get your order wrong. I got it delivered and my total was 25 and I had 40 and he said he didn't have change and kept all my money.  Then when I complained they got an attitude. Very rude people and can't wait till they go out of business

Service was nice and food was okay. It didn't seem like there were any Japanese or even Asian people in the kitchen. (You can see into where they make food). Doesn't mean the food was bad but is something to point out. The decor and atmosphere was not my particular taste. I don't know if I would come again.

.This is the worst McDonald's on the planet they only accept cash all the time they give you no forewarning you're stuck in a line full of a dozen people when you're not prepared because you have a card they're completely unprofessional by not giving you a heads-up and it's the absolute worst customer service in Tampa.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: A quaint little cafe nestled in a residential area. The service was very friendly. Their handmade tomato jam 'pop-tart' was really good! Surprising, really. The shakshouka was also delicious. Minus one star because they were out of several ingredients so some of us weren't able to have our first choice.

Great location on Clearwater Beach. Breakfast is ok, nothing spectacular with limited gluten free options, though more than some. Rooms are clean the first day, but cleaning service is light at that. Its cheaper to walk up the street to get a beverage than here. Again great location, average hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This chase is BEYOND SLOW. THIS IS INSANE. I got in line at 1:00pm with three cars in front in the business line and I am now leaving at 2:00pm. The other lines have being going somewhat fast. So now I've wasted my whole entire lunch break and am late to go back to work:) Thank you Chase. I appreciate it. GET IT TOGETHER.

Decided to give this spot a try, ordered a chicken bacon ranch pizza. At best it was ok but it left something to be desired. Few things I wasn't happy about were they used bacon bits from a container, crust was 2 inches all the way around, and finally the lack of chicken. All in all it was ok. Wouldn't spend the money on it again

Yummy lunch..
I never order burgers out, but Gallagher's is the exception.  
Recommend the Candied Bacon Burger with Vermont White Chedder. Good and juicy.
The House Bloody Mary is also a Must!!!
They do have a Thursday Burger Special where all burgers are $4 off.
If you are ever in Waterloo Il stop by!!

Excellent customer service and amazing catering! The cake decorator was accommodating, great to work with, and made this beautiful cake! I also ordered sandwiches which are always a hit and come beautifully prepared. I highly recommend and will always go to McCaffrey's for future parties!

Oil Change- Done Expeditiously 
Maintenance of the guest area is/was extremely horrible. Empty cups laying around it looked as though the floor hadn't been mopped in months the coffee pot was stained with OLD coffee. The restroom was so disgusting to the point the smell of it was making me sick...
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Driver-Thru Attendant Had The Nastiest Attitude And Made My Drink WRONG. Went Inside To Get A Remake And As The Associate Was Assisting Me Other Co Workers Were Rude To Her Especially With Their Tone And Approach. The Drink Was Remade And Was Extremely Distasteful. I Won't Visit This Location Again.

Food definitely had a kick to it especially the guacamole. I'm not a big fan of spice, even the ahi tuna bowl I had was spicy so by the end of my meal my mouth was on fire. I'm used to having the option to add spice. Food was good, but don't plan to return my poor tastebuds can't take it. I'll stick with Ciccio Cali

Worst customer service. Do not go here. I needed a car because me be is at the dealership for repair and parts will take two or three days. These guys said they had no cars. I understand. He would not even look at other locations to help me out just nope sorry. I was the first not customer anywhere in sight. Pathetic.

Around $4 a scoop. Not bad. Very good ice cream though. It's hard to see it, but it's under the hotel. Parking might suck since they only have a private parking lot for the hotel guests. Friendly customer service. Awesome ice cream. Definitely will come back.

I like the convenient location, and the food is very good. Crispy, fresh pizza. I've had a couple strange experiences with the waitstaff, but ordinarily I sit at the bar. Both bartenders have been excellent. I would recommend Crust to others. I've never been less than satisfied with the food.

I love trying out new places. I've been wanting to check this place out for awhile. Finally gave it a shot. Was very satisfied. Super friendly staff. Owners were right in the mix. Loved chatting with him. Stephanie did a great job. Really impressed with the cut. Next time I hope to get in on a beard trim and line up.

Great selection and right next to where I live so that is great! However some of their employees are rude and angry and really annoying to deal with. If you are going to hire micro managing assholes then get me a self checkout so I don't have to deal with them

If you sneeze, you may miss this charming local dive bar. Do not get sidetracked and head over to the large sports bar in the same shopping center. The love is fierce, the drinks quick and strong, and the smoke not thick enough for your to carve am SOS message into.

A self car wash. Don't use the brush. Don't use the credit card machine either because like everyone else stated, the number is broke and doesn't work. 
1.50 for three minutes. Not bad - just shady that you can't get into contact with the owner if something happens

I enjoyed loaded. I appreciated my meal same with my friend. I was a little thrown off my the fact that they put actual potatoes chips instead of the traditional tortilla. I liked that they are connected to Narwhal so that was nice. I also liked that I came during happy hour

Fantastic ice cream and selection. Great flavors, and you can sample every one of them. Service could have been better, she seemed like I was annoying her to sample two ice creams before picking meanwhile I was the only customer there. Regardless, I would definitely return. Happy hour is a great deal on a hot FL day

Breakfast is fantastic. The hostess is very friendly and welcoming. Our lovely server is on top of everything, never needed to ask for anything. Sweet tea is fresh and delicious. Highly recommend. If anyone complains about this place, they are their own problems. It's Heaven here. God bless.

Very nice people, great service and great Sushi. Had the Hurricane Rolls. Excellent as always. Also the Sexy Girl Rolls. Place very comfortable.  Angela , who served me, pleasant and outstanding. Look forward to my next visit, which will be soon!  Can't go wrong. I really enjoy Mizu.

Wow! This is not your neighborhood Mexican restaurant- the food and service were excellent! The owner Pat is too sweet and kind- she waited on us and made sure we were happy and satisfied- I had the chorizo huevos and my husband had the chicken chimichanga- both excellent!

Located on the corner of Madison & Tampa St in downtown Tampa.  The sangria is excellent .  If you are really hungry I'd get the Nacional Chimichanga ... Named for the three sauces .  I ate that thing for dinner and the next day at lunch at home.  Lots of white meat chicken in it .  Tacos, quesadillas are good too as is dessert !

Words cant describe my love for Bartaco! The drinks are beyond great & very fresh, the guacamole & salsa are so good & the array of tacos are amazing! I enjoy tapas so i love the option of getting smaller, single tacos at bartaco rather than a whole meal of the same tacos at another restaurant. The corn is also a MUST!!

Can't miss the hand grenades while you are walking down burbon st. This melon favored vodka drink comes in a cute green container. Drink is quite delicious and even though it doesn't seem very potent, the alcohol does sneak up on you. The large is only $10 and is definitely worth getting.

With all the money you're saving by eliminating the only reason we used to come- (the all you can eat sushi)- buy your staff new shirts that don't advertise it! The world is full of businesses that are using Covid as an excuse to not give a crap anymore. If you bring back the special we'll be back- even if the price is higher.

I heard mixed reviews of this place. We decided to come here for drinks and apps. The drinks were a little on the pricey side and so were the apps. We order the I think bulgogi fries, not sure of the name, and they were just okay. Not really hot either. I wish they put a little bit more meat on the fries.

The enchilada combo plate was tasty and a great value at $7. You get 3 enchiladas in your choice of meat with 2 sides.  The sides were average beans and rice, but the enchiladas were fantastic. They need to provide metal forks because the plastic utensils can handle it.

This is a frequently visited place I go for lunch in downtown Lansdale.  I have always dined in but you can do take out.

The food is great!

On my Thursday December 19, 2019. I enjoyed the Burrito Buraccho and my wife had the El Pastor tacos. Another great meal!

The pizza is good, but the service sucks! First of all I was charged for the three topping, but only got one. Then they wanted to charge me for a tiny cup of ranch. I ordered wine and they gave me beer? I went up to order another glass of wine. They ignored me and answered phone instead. I will not go back there.

Beer selection here is off the walls, crazy ones that I haven't even heard before. The interior is modern and has a draft room in the back. 

BUT...12 bucks for a 4 pack of Allagash...pricey...

Overall, a very high mark up on everything...pass if u wanna save some money

Food is pretty mediocre here. Went for a friends bday party and ordered a shrimp/chicken type of thing and you can taste the shrimp must've been old or frozen...not fresh at all. 

Sweet spot for a date cause the decor is nice and they got an outside spot. 

Best part: byob.

Absolutely consistently the SLLOOWWEESSTT Starbucks I patronize. I don't understand why service is so slow here. I also don't understand why I continue to patronize this location other than convenience. After being stuck in drive thru for an unacceptable amount of time this morning, I will rethink this!

I want to give a shout out to Jordan at the front desk always making customers feel welcome with a smile. She responds to any concerns making sure equipment and area are always clean. Always making the customer feel special. I've been at this gym for 8 years.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Love this gym!!! Been here for a year. The staff and is friendly, great equipment, and while there are always people in here it is never too crowded at least when I go which is generally between 5am -7am / after 9pm or on weekends after 2pm. Highly recommend!!!!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: You can not go wrong with Richies Barber Shop. It's an old school shop with 3 chairs and plenty of friendly conversations if you are in the PortRichmond,Bridesburg,Fishtown area you can not go wrong with these gentlemen. They are not open on Sundays and Wednesday's .  If you need an appointment make the call @ 267-575-7858.

The actual gym is on the 2nd floor and accessible via stairs or elevator . The staff here is friendly and the gym is very clean. The equipment is still pretty new so it has more variety compared to the older ones. I just wish they stored private cubbies like some of the other gyms
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Terrible service.  Had to wait 20 minutes on a bus to arrive to the terminal.  The bus was standing room only w very little AC.  When we arrived at the car lot the selection was terrible.  I asked the attendant about other cats and he was rude and not helpful at all.

Beautiful spot right on the water. Rooms are clean, staff is extremely helpful and friendly, and there is free breakfast and parking. Within a walking distance (right across the street) from downtown Dunedin and shopping. Pet friendly! Floors are tile which is really nice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Worst customer service ever. Every single time I come they always sound like they don't want to be there and it's a problem that you came to their establishment for lunch. They've officially made life easier for me to give up fast food. If I could give no stars I would.

This Burger King has got to be the worst. The WORST customer service. The WORST in the world in order correctness. The WORST!! Stay away. McDonalds ,Wendy's and Taco Bell are all up the street. Just spend the extra 5 mins to go there instead. Thank me later.

Lebanon, Mt Juliet City Guides joins Mt Juliet Love and Music City Mingle in celebrating this business friendly global luxury Hotel. It is so refreshing as a business person on the move constantly to be in an environment so engaging and enriching.  You have earned our Big Daddy 5 Stars Review! Compliments of Chaplain Oscar Smith
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Best planet in the area! Quality machines (even got the ropes and monkey bars too) very spacious and staff is extremely friendly and always eager to help anyone. Such a positive vibe every time I come here. So happy they opened. Lots of people willing to train newcomers as well.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Typical chain pizza. Opted for the BBQ Meats on thin crust which has a sweet and tangy flavor and is actually pretty good. Would probably swap the Canadian bacon for chicken next time... just me. 

Anyhow...good place for a super late night eat as u can place an order up until 1:30am.

I was at this location at approximately 12pm on 6/27/20 and the kid working the drive through had his mask on like a chin strap. The lack of regard for customer health will have me NEVER visiting this location again. I threw my food out because who knows what was happening where I could not see.

I know it is fast food but to wait over 10 minutes for a sandwich and then have the staff find humor  when my wife asked about it just makes me sure if I have another option for fast food I will take it .

People work hard for their money and dollars
Matter so good bye to this location for sure
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
The food here is good and EVERY order has enough food that should last you a couple of days. Can't go wrong when you order any of their cheesesteaks or seafood platters from there.

Only reason it doesn't get 5 stars is because its only take out. But still great food there.

The absolute best Chinese food I've ever had! I will definitely be back! The only reason they did not receive 5 stars, is because the service is lacking. We had our drinks and food quickly, but no water refills, and they didn't ask how we liked everything. That could be worked on for sure.

This place is in sketchy area, trash in the parking lot, food with ants on the floor inside, the floors had a lot of dirt & mud everywhere. Not sure if it's the employee/owners day off from their duties but this place is definitely not clean. The place is cheap tho! That's good & the machines seem to work well
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Worlds most convenient bank my a**. Every time I go out of town (which is every week for business), they block my account.  It's a pain in the tush and they say they can't do anything about it. On hold for 22 minutes trying to unblock it last time. I'm fed up and switching banks!

No frills, no crazy looking statues except for a waving cat when you first walk in, but the food is pretty authentic and great tasting and reasonably priced. The Mongolian Beef and Shrimp Toast was spot on and seasoned perfectly. I will definitely be back to try different things on the menu.

stopped in for dinner at the recommendation of a nearby inn.

a bit uptight for the beach but maybe i don't really know santa barbara?

salad was good.

boar was very good.

service was good.

the mousse was really good.

and the hostess who does not miss any of her workouts was nice too.

I have been wanting to try Tinker as I know their coffee beans are distributed throughout Indy! I ordered the hazelnut latte, and it was great! Not too sweet, just perfect! I wish I got the baristas name, but she was so friendly and bubbly! Really friendly and great service! I didn't try a tart, but I need too!

An all day business meeting ended up with seven of us converging on Jarrettown for dinner. Appys of calamari, Cajun fried oysters and Caprese salad didn't disappoint. Our steak, pasta and veal dishes? All very good. Service? Top notch. The bill? Thankful it's not on my account. My first visit. Hope to return.

Over-hyped and over-priced in my opinion. Don't get me wrong. They have good mac and cheese in several creative variations (most of which I would never care to try) but you REALLY have to be a Mac-n-Cheese lover to appreciate paying $9 for a main meal consisting of a small skillet of mac-n-cheese.

Staff needs to work on the way the speak to the customers and how they treat them. Pretty rude. Then to top it off the drinks they make aren't up to normal Starbucks standards. I've given this Starbucks multiple chances.  I'm done. They need some serious training.

We typically get order carry out and get the family special of two pizza with a salad, breadsticks and a 2 liter soda. I enjoy the quick service and taste of the pizza. We don't eat pizza here often because it's a bit pricey but it's good. The dining room smells of smoke and it's small but I always pick up.

Great pizza! Great tasting beer on tap. The only downfall is wishing it was service styled cause waiting in line numerous times isn't fun. But overall really great vibe and great food. It was pretty busy so you know that's a good sign. Looking forward to coming here more this summer!

Good experience. Went thru the first time after a long road trip and a ton of bugs on my dash, and there were still a few dirty spots. Spoke to the woman working there and she let me run thru again. Vacuums they provided work decently. Got my interior clean. No spray bottles or towels like other car washes.

I am slowly working my way through all of the new establishments that are popping up in Seminole Heights. I love how we now have all these different places to go to eat. Food is so fresh and flavorful, and the staff was great when I went. Need to plan another trip to try out the rest of their menu

Stopped here in early AM needing something.  Ordered a Burrito and watched as the cook stopped mopping and proceeded to make my burrito.  Did not wash hands did not change or even remove their gloves; which were just holding a nasty mop handle.  Did not eat the damn thing but the dogs liked it.  

Nasty nasty nasty

bf-

Ben greeted me and immediately looked at my AC problem. He came back 5 minutes later to tell me my AC compressor was out wrote me an estimate for roughly $1k. I thought it was high so I had a second opinion.
 
Turns out it was the fan clutch and not the compressor. Saved over $400 elsewhere.

I always forget about Prada...but I saw a buy one get one Valentines Day offer. The young lady working had been working since 7:00 AM it was close to 9:30 when I arrived but she was upbeat and professional! The food is always good as it's almost like a subway where you get to pick your items. I hope I remember to visit more often!

Honestly, this was maybe the worst fried chicken I've had from a place that was supposed to get it right.  I compared to something off the buffet line at Golden Corral.  The service was good and the staff was friendly.  Dunno, maybe an off night but I wouldn't go back.

Plant City is a Mexican/agricultural hub of Central Florida, so expectations were high.  $2 tacos were well portioned,  flavorful and all the accompaniments (cilantro, onion, salsas...etc) were available buffet style.  I was assured the pastor was freshly shaven off a spit, but judging by the cut and cook of it, had doubts.

Keeping in mind that it's an airport restaurant, it's actually pretty good. I got the cheesesteak wrap and fries. Service was a little slow but I had really low expectations to begin with. I'd probably go to this place again in the future if I'm in the airport. But "airport good" and "non airport good" are very different.

Staff is usually friendly, but the service/inventory of usual Starbucks drinks and sides can be inconsistent. But if you want a simple drink and an awesome view and atmosphere, you can find that here. The interior is awesome and the big windows allows customers to enjoy the Riverfront views.

Take this one with a grain of salt because I am a tea person. Sump has some tea options but I just did not find them memorable. I thought menu items were a little overpriced.

That said, my S.O. who likes coffee LOVES Sump and says they are the second best coffee in STL. He'll write his own review.

Came here recently with a group of friends for dinner. It's BYO so make sure to bring your own bottles. We did family style and ended up sharing the bruschetta, salads, Margarita pizza,  lobster ravioli, and vodka rigatoni. Overall, everything was good but my favorite dish was definitely the lobster ravioli.

Affordable and delicious food! 

Not the best location, but I believe it is simply the neighborhood and not the business' fault.

I ordered by the phone, and the guy who took my order repeated everything back to me to ensure that he got the order right. I appreciate this because my order was so large!

I love Sun Sushi! One of the best places for sushi in Santa Barbara. We have done take out and dine in and each time it's phenomenal. Even with things being uncertain and ever changing with Covid their quality has stayed consistent and it's definitely one of our go to restaurants now.

The best! I exclusively only go here now! The prices are also the best I've seen in town. I see T, the owner, and she told me she trains all her nail techs personally to ensure they're all quality! Plus the spa is very pretty and aesthetically pleasing when you walk in. Great atmosphere and great service!

I never have coffee at Starbucks, it's too strong for me. I'll usually opt for a chai tea or a latte. My boyfriend is a Starbucks fan. This one was fairly standard for the chain. No better, no worse than any of the others. We had a drink to wake up and wait out rush hour before heading on our way.

While I truly enjoy the smiles and a friendly service at The Pennsylvania Avenue Wilmington Delaware Dunkin Donuts, the New people on staff are not giving quality coffee. Yesterday my coffee was watered down and cold. It was a sugar free French vanilla latte

Easy Parking, Great Customer Service and clean establishment.  I got 4 tacos at $2.00 a pop, the fish and shrimp tacos were bomb.com but the two Carne Asada tacos were lacking... the meal was under season and dry. Also the salsa is super hot so be wary  lol

Big fan! In my opinion, this place is one of the best sushi restaurants in NOLA. Everytime I go, the fish is always fresh and excellent. Service is always on point. Also, the portions are decent for the price. My go to things: Chirashi, Salmon Carpaccio, Spicy Tuna Tartare.. Don't sleep on this place. Check it out!

We were here last night for a Birthday Dinner. The food as always was great. All of us were impressed by the wear of masks from the hostess the the waitress. We were taken to a social distances room of restaurant. We had not out to eat in months and it was a loyally enjoyable safe experience for all

Is ok, I have a black Jeep and a monthly subscription to this car wash.  Only complaint I have is the water spots, they say you don't get them, but you do, lots of them.  Bring a towel or a soft cloth to hand dry your car afterwards, you're going to need it.

Been standing at the register for 5 min and still haven't been greeted or talked to while I listened to a bunch of girls laugh and joke around in the back. Brendan ran up and took my order and was very present and invited me back. He is the reason for my return.

the tacos were amazing, and I really wish I had gotten the horchata because I haven't stopped thinking about it since.

It's been a bit since I was there, but definitely looking to go back!

This place is small, and in a non-ideal area, but takeout is good!

The only downside of this place is that they are closed on taco Tuesdays, however the food is fantastic! Simple, easy, fresh and fast. #SEFF, thank me later guys. I love how this place is set-up, no matter how slammed they are you will be eating within 5 minutes.

Love coming here! The staff is great & open to suggestion. They will really take care of you if you tell them what you want. The VIP card they now offer is pretty cool to. Earn towards free services. 

I definitely recommend DT Nails. Their pricing for their services makes for a great overall value.

Worst meat department in America. 3 times I have tried the kabobs and each time they must be horse meat, You cook them medium rare and you can't chew them. Absolutely horrible. I want to like the store otherwise but don't like to have to drive to another store to buy steaks.

You did not get your monies worth if you went to the University of Arizona and did not go to Los Betos at least 10 times past 2am.  Is the food good quality, no.  However, Betos is a legend in Tucson and it tastes so great after a night of partying or celebrating a great basketball or football win!

This is the place to go if you want deep dish pizza. Be patient and you will be rewarded. They put so much cheese into the Chicago style pizzas, it's insane. They also have the strawberry salad, which is pretty tasty. This is a popular place, so keep in mind that you will have to wait.

Definitely one of my go-tos for Mexican food in Nashville. Great location, decent food (I recommend the LP special for entree and chorizo queso for appetizer), and potent margaritas! 

If you're looking for somewhere with good food and great happy hour to hang with friends, I for sure recommend Las Palmas.

Service not great. Had to keep asking for my pastries long after getting my coffee. Mocha super sweet (?). Coffee prep station very messy. Very long lines to drive up extending onto busy Bay St. Large dining area but over air conditioned so we ate outside.

A good burger and fries to have not matter where you are at. Spend just a little more time than fast food to get a better quality sandwich. The cost is of course more expensive which is the only down side but quality does cost more. Make sure to order a small or medium fry unless you are trying to feed a family.

I paid for a supper job but got a lousy one. When I complained
the lady said I could bring it back and pay $100.00 for detailing. What
a rip off. She could have ran the car threw again but obviously
customer service is not their strong suit. I am furious and will not return
there again.

Aside from a nice neighborhood, what's then point of having a hot tub when it's cold as heck after 40 minutes of warming up...also a little frustrated with the one working treadmill, a squeaky secondary treadmill, and a dysfunctional elliptical.  Aside from that, all is well.

I am so so happy with my fill. I've had acrylic nails for years. After moving from New Orleans, I couldn't find a place that I was happy enough with to become a regular BUT that all changed today. Max is great and did a wonderful job. I'll absolutely be back and highly recommend comfy nails.

I really love water ice and Diane's is great.  I especially love their banana, pineapple, and watermelon water ice.  The prices are a bit high, but compared to other water ice stands, Diane's is a better quality.  If you don't mind paying the extra cash, you will love it here.  Enjoy!

Ive been wanting to try this place out for years.  me and my fiance finally had an opportunity to try it. I was let down. I ordered the salmon which was dry, my fiancee ordered the pork chops, it was burnt and full of fat. The meals are definitley over priced for the quality.  I will give 1 star due to location and environment.

So fun total dive place. Cheap drinks-$11.50 for two bud light bottles and a vodka drink. Obviously lots of regulars-one or two should have been cut off at sent home at one in the afternoon lol. Bathroom ugh but bar area itself pretty cool. Cash only. Old school juke box.

It's one of mine and my better half's pizza places in Reno / Sparks. We just don't order often because it takes over an hour to get food delivered, at the restaurant or even for pick up. We still continue to go there because the food is delicious; it's just a bummer when it comes to the lack of efficiency.

We live very close to Cena and have overlooked it many times. Joke's on us! After having dinner there last night, we will not make that mistake again!! Our meal and service were top notch. I was thoroughly impressed! We ordered fried eggplant, shrimp risotto, and a pasta dish. It was all perfection! We will be back!

I've lived here for about 8 months and they're very nice. The kitchen is open, (not a galley, which I love) and updated. The only downside is a lack of an extra storage closet and the walls are a little thin. Other than that, staff is very helpful and maintenance issues are done quickly.

They always know our regular pizza order. If we deviate it from it, they are like why? What's up? Everyone remembers our names. I feel like we have been going here forever, like family. We keep coming back. Pizza is pretty awesome. You will get hooked. Give it a spin

Been coming to this location for about 3 years now. Never have I ever been charged extra on a free drink for my birthday. It's always been free no matter what I've gotten. This time they charged me extra for almond milk. Rather go to Starbucks where my "free" reward drink is actually free.

My 7lb Yorkie went into instant anaphylactic shock after being bit by so many red ants, dr Q took us instantly and got us the help we needed on no notice. He followed up with us every few hours, and was so good at explaining every step to us. I definitely recommend Paws and Claws after our great experience.

This place is the LAST place to go for a haircut.  Plus, the people that own this place are 100% racist and will treat you like trash if you aren't white.  I'd rather go to Great Clips than EVER go back to this place again.

Overpriced, rude and racist......no thank you.

Moto is such a great place to go for a date night. However, as much as they recommend the Brussel sprouts... DON'T GET THEM! They are not good. They still smell like Brussel sprouts but they're sweet. Very odd. Just avoid them. The filet and the prawns & risotto were fantastic!

Best food in the area by a landslide. Great staff, great food, great experience. Everything is amazing, every time. You can tell they truly care about what is on your plate and the entire experience. Always enjoy a night at Henry's. Do yourself a favor and go.

This family friendly establishment has my heart! Unique and delicious items on the menu. It will be a fun staple for the neighborhood. 

Although I would like to see an improvement in the hot dog flavor. I wasn't the biggest fan. However, I still give them 5 stars because the  restaurant team that works there is amazing.

I went there one time to have a tie dry cleaned and they did have it cleaned in just a few hours but when I got it back it was ripped in places and the fabric was torn. I just wanted a stain out of my tie and now I need to go buy a brand new tie because this cleaner destroyed mine. Thanks for nothing.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
I called today to place an order. The man on the phone was impossible to understand so I when I asked him to repeat what he asked me, he simply hung up on me. Abruzzi food does not have nearly good enough to deal with rude customer service. 

Not worth the customer's time if trying to order over the phone.

Went in today to dine with a friend and got terrible customer service from the manager and the food was disgusting everything was cold and under cooked. Very displeased and am never returning. Manager argued with me and repeatedly said well my customers are happy as if I wasn't a customer because I wasn't happy. Very displeased

The hotel itself 5 stars, sadly the surroundings of the homeless living across the river is not the view you want to look at sitting outside to enjoy an evening sunset. Otherwise, clean rooms, polite staff. We practically only here to sleep as we're visiting tahoe for the week
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I would like to give 5 stars but having two little ones in the pool, the staff came in right at 11pm and stood, not politely quite intimidating to say the least demanding ppl to get out. To tell a 10 year old the pool opens next day at 8am when finding out its 9am was not a fun situation. Will stay elsewhere
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My Mother went here to get a shampoo and hair cut her hair being short above shoulder and when it came time to pay the price givin was $45 .mind you no color. Just be aware that hair cuts start @$25 .so that means that they charged her $20 for a shampoo..really!! There is a reason. That their parking lot is always empty.....

I've had my hair cut several times by Arnise, and she does a very good job. Twice though, I've had others cut my hair and have not been pleased. The first time, I went back and the manager fixed it. The second time, I decided to go to another salon and have them do it over. I won't be going back to Great Clips.

the line was looonnnnggg and it moved -- really not that fast but we were waiting for ice cream so it was fine.  Had a few samples of strange combos of ice cream that just made you smile, giggle and want some more.  I had banana/honey and pistachio and honey.  Tasted the Queen City Cayenne -- that was crazy good.

I always come here for my lunch meat. Very nice staff and the lunch meats are very fresh.  You can call and order ahead and they will have it ready.  Whenever you walk in there it smells good. Makes you instantly feel hungry and want to order one of their sandwiches.

AMAZING. Low calorie ice cream that tastes SO good. It is thick and creamy. Not icy at all like halo top or some of that other low calorie ice cream. It's in a bit of a random spot location wise but worth going to! They have flavors of the week which are pretty good. I got hazelnut and snickers!

I really enjoyed this takeout. Everything arrived piping hot, the General Tso was particularly good. I think it could've used a little more spice, so next time I'll say, please add more heat". Everything arrived in 40 minutes. Prices are good, very plentiful in the portions, I made two meals out of it. Highly recommended.

Danielle is awesome. She's super flexible, got me in last minute and finished my hair up in record time. It turned out awesome! I hate going to salons and dealing with your typical salon drama. Moxie is the complete opposite. You're in and out with great hair!

Nice ambiance, they're always friendly when I come in. This particular time I was having an eczema outbreak, Victor was super nice about it. He shared his son has the similar issue and gave me tips to help heal my hands. My nails are perfectly shaped! I would definitely recommend!

Best shave ever! Enjoyed the absolutely best shave of my life courtesy of Nathan! 30' of relaxation and precise craftsmanship. Also enjoyed the bourbon on the house. The staff shared many local recommendations with me which was much appreciated and an added service. 5 star experience for sure.

Good basic chinese.  Great price.  I normally get vegetable dishes, they will modify upon request (sweeter or spicier or no egg).  Appears to be family owned.  They are what they say.  Good chinese at a good price.  Mainly a take out place.  A bit of a dive to eat in, but they do have chairs.
Reliable, a solid 4 star in my book.

This was amazingly convenient. Daniel picked me up from my house at 11:30 and I was home with the rental car by 11:45! I didn't even have to go into the shop, he had everything prepped on the iPad for me to review and emailed me a quick summary. Very friendly and through. A surprisingly pleasant experience. Thank you!

The Szechuan beef tastes like they cooked it in chemicals. The pepper steak had no taste at all. The teriyaki chicken had no flavor, like they put the unseasonal chicken on a grill and called it good. And the hot and sour soup was only hot and not sour. Overall 10/10 would not ever go to again. I've eaten army food that is better.

We wandered in needing COFFEEEEEE at 3:00pm on a Friday afternoon and could not help participate in a couple of the many amazing donuts!  They are so fresh and outstanding!  The Boston Cream and vanilla cake are phenomenal.  We sat awhile with sweet Tray the new Barista.  He was a refreshing delight!
We will be back!!!

Not crazy about this place - Ordered lunch a few times here since my job is walking distance from the place. I would order online, and I come in and it's never ready, there online system is terrible. Than, I ask for well done - and it's medium. I don't like the service. Will not be going back.

Five stars for the atmosphere, crowd, and music. One star for the "Midnight Potion." I don't know WTF was in that drink, but it was beyond foul and I couldn't finish it. Cheap drinks, though, at least by this Chicagoan's standards. I'd probably go back but next time I'll stick to beer.

It's Subway, most people have had Subway and this food here is not going to be the best you've ever eaten.  But this particular location is always clean, someone is hiring really nice kids to run it,  always friendly.  And I do like the convenience of the drive-up window

I have to be honest, not the worst ice cream I've ever had, but not the best, by a ways. It was just kind of mediocre. But if you have a specific flavor you like there, it's still decent ice cream. And how can you argue with ice cream, in the summer,  in Arizona.

I agree the prices are high. Actually I thought I was at Citizens Bank Park until I realized that the Phillies weren't playing. As for the custard, there is none. The cone I was served appeared to be frozen "Moo-Moo Milk" like the fast food joints serve as shakes. No wonder this is Custard's LAST STAND!

This is a pretty nice restaurant in the northern part of town. I've been twice and the food is good. The tempura could be better because it's not as light and airy as I've had. AYCE sushi  is good value and pretty good fish. Service is quick and attentive. Selections for the AYCE are pretty extensive.

The sushi here is good and the service is good. I caught them early for dinner service on a Friday and found out after I arrived it wasn't an AYCE sushi place after I arrived. The place showed up as AYCE sushi  on Google, but it wasn't. The parking lot is tiny. The place is pretty plain. Good experience and food overall.

I think this place may have been really good in the past. There was certainly a crowd of locals. The food left much to be desired unfortunately. Pasta overcooked, alfredo too creamy. Decent chicken parm. Homey and welcome atmosphere but i won't be going back for the food.

The food here was fairly mediocre, not bad but nothing extraordinary. I had the pork katsu, which was slightly pricier than other places in Philly and I couldn't really taste the difference. The service overall was fine but I left feeling still hungry and thought the food was just fairly average.

The coffee was made with little to no care at all. I
The attitude from the employees there is basic. You'll be lucky to get any eye contact whatsoever. The coffee was so hot that the cup it came in was becoming flimsy. It's just not a pleasant experience 
 And at the prices they charge...

Every time I try to come here after 2am they claim their system is "down". But they ask is we are door dash prior to taking to our order. I'm very frustrated with this location and don't think it should be called 24/7 if they can't provide that for their customers.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Nope. Just nope. Cost way too much for what you get. They're coffee is way too acidic, and far too pretentious. When I want a cup of coffee or an espresso I'd like to be able to state I'd like a small, medium or large. Venti pfft! Besides that, it gives me an upset tummy. So over s***bucks.

Pros - nice equipment and employees are also nice.

Cons - we were so unhappy with our personal trainer for our new member assessment that we walked out part way through the session.  She didn't listen to what we were trying to tell her so it was a really negative experience.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Trendy with Small Plates.  If you want a 10oz steak this may not be the place to go.  This was are 3rd time here.  We basically show up with an open mind and plan on trying new things.  We order a bunch of different items and see which we liked the best.  Every time there has been at least one plate that was really over the top.

Okay yes it's authentic it's okay I mean depends who you get as a waiter, almost need a translator 'but I will say it's tasty Chinese food it's not the greatest' one person $31 for two it's okay- house chow mein with beef sweet and sour pork - egg rolls-
Inside needs a facelift for sure'

Well it's definitely delicious try to go when it's not as busy but it is good the spaghetti and meatballs* I got was a little spicy I will say but it was good so just FYI, appetizer just tasty it's good food it's good Italian food reasonable yes desserts amazing made in house it's worth it you'll love it

I liked this place a lot. The pizzas are delicious and the vegetarian options are great. I had the kale pizza, which was actually amazing. The location is not the most developed area but it's always interesting to hit up the area Bywater area - kind of a recently become hipster area.

Their food is pretty good but I just placed a $60 order online and  they still charge a 3% "convenience fee" for using a debit card. I can understand if it's under a certain dollar amount but for an order that big, they should be able to absorb the transaction fee.

Food mediocre,  service non-existent. 

They were quick to seat us but then very, very slow with everything else.  The salsa is not bad, but the queso is watered down and the chips are too thick and not very fresh.  The portions are not small but not well balanced in the seasoning department,  mostly heat and salt.

Great for lunch. They have 2 roll lunch specials as low as 7.99. Have never ordered a bad roll. It's my favorite sushi place with even better prices. Service is pretty slow but I actually kind of like that I have time to drink. Their fruit (both the mango and strawberry) sake is 10/10 !!

I went during the daytime and had a pleasant experience. There was no wait time so the hand grenades were given to us immediately. Was an older crowd when I was there which was cool. Bartender also informed us to save our cups to get a dollar off our next round.

Stopped in while a visiting the local Saturday market in Heritage Park. They were closing but graciously took me in for the last one of the day. I'm traveling and needed a quick trim. No wait, I'm and out in 15 minutes. Nice to get a nice clean cut for only $14. Back home my haircut is $30. Thank you Eagle Barber Shop!

Just meh.  18.00 breakfast was majorly lacking.  Few options and what options they had were just meh.  I've had better breakfast at hotels with free continental breakfast.  Won't eat here again. Definitely with the trip across the bridge into CW for better breakfast.

They have a great deal for 3 rolls $11.75 and each roll has 8 pieces. Very small restaurant with two actual tables and then sushi bar seating. Very quick and efficient sushi chefs that are actually Asian (which is a plus). I shared the fried sweet potato, salmon, eel, and shrimp tempura rolls which were all simple and good.

I love this place!! So many places I. Town are not very clean or through, and this place is great! Plus they do a Parafin treatment  no extra charge!any places charge extra and they do it really badly. I've only been getting gels no acrylic, and my last lasted two weeks before it started looking chipped! Highly reccomend!

My friend had a groupon and so we decided to make a girls night out of it. We each got a roll and salad. I enjoyed my sushi as did she. I also ordered a martini but it was much too strong for my preference, others may have been happy. I definitely will be back to try more of their food.

This little gem is tucked back in a plaza, easy to miss but I'm here to tell you. You don't want to miss this place!! 
The queso birria tacos are absolutely incredible!!! Please do yourself a favor and stop and grab some!!! I mean look at how they packaged it, with some tlc. I'll be back monthly.

This Starbucks is my normal spot, and I love it. Warning- the drive thru line can get crazy long, so utilize the mobile order option on the app. The parking also is a mess, but the drinks are always right and the baristas are really friendly and efficient.

I've been looking for a new nail salon and this one is a block away from my office... so I made an appointment for after work to try it out...  I am in love!  Great customer service, awesome nails, good beverages and fun conversation!  I will be back again and again!  I'm a regular now!

The Vets especially Dr. Johnson is amazing! The office staff not so much. The prices are wonderful and they do a lot for the animal rescue groups that  is what has me driving 45mins to go there BUT don't expect great customer service. One front office person will tell you one thing and one will tell you another. Very frustrating!

This place is amazing! The car wash itself works wonderfully. And having all the towels to dry and the super powerful vacuums was amazing! They have a client for life. The staff at the entrance was also very friendly! I can't stop telling people about how awesome it was!

JH Cafe is just ok! I gave 3 stars because they Egg Drop soup was good. I ordered the General Tsao's chicken with shrimp fried rice. The sauce on chicken was soy saucey and runny so the chicken was soggy. I usually like a thicker sauce and a tab bit spicy! Typical shrimp fried rice, no seasoning.

Food is very good but the service need some tweaking. There was a large group that took all the wait staff away from the 4 tops. It took 20 minutes just for a beer and chips. Then finally got to order food is outstanding. The outside area is very nice especially this summer. I will be back. All they need now is liquor.

Beautiful hotel and great service.   The gentleman who checked me in was pretty nice and made sure I checked into a room with a city view, much appreciated. 

The hotel has 3 restaurants,  one for breakfast, a seafood/fine dining restaurant & a sports bar.

My room was very nice as well.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Purchasing a pair of glasses at modern eye was a fantastic experience. Great, no pressure service by a team (special thanks to John and Bill) of the most friendly and helpful people. They made the process painless and I left feeling good about the investment I had made. I cannot recommend the 13th street store enough.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Don't know why there are a bunch of bad ratings, this place is great! It does look kinda sketchy on the outside so I was skeptical but trusted my friends opinion on the sushi and she was right! It was to die for and one of the good places in Edmonton to get sushi.

Started going here for my monthly pedicure and it's amazing. The space is immaculate and they take covid protocols very seriously. I love going to  Ja-Hyde for a pedicure. She takes her time and gives an amazing massage! Plenty of parking and always very accommodating for appointment times.

Got a plain pizza it was aight I've had this pizza before and it was completely different then what I had tonight,I think I needed a few more minutes in the oven for my liking.last time I had it was by the slice and was reheated in the oven witch made the pizza better in my opinion

I kept passing this place today and finally made the stop. Plenty of choices for shakes. Thick creamy delicious milk shakes. I'm a bit of a purist and went with vanilla, and was gooood!  Felt like I was on the set of American Graffiti, I like the vibe and look of the place.

This by far is one of the worst bars in Indy.  The staff is disrespectful and violent.  I was with a group of women that was basically attacked by a male bartender.  If you are looking for good service, a good time, or being treated like a decent human choose another location.  You will be disappointed in this establishment.

Satisfying. Good food. pleasent service. House dressing/creamy Italian and clam chowder both awesome. Had eggplant parmesan. Bf had combo plate with manicotti and lasagna.  Pie n two beers too! Check was $48. Deal for the locale and portions. 
P.S.. free parking next to vons.

Best sushi on the West Bank. This wouldn't be a 5/5 in Tokyo or on the West Coast, but for this area, this is where you go. I tried tuna focused sashimi and maki and loved every one. I stayed away from anything with crab so I can't comment on those. Come check it out

Great food, loved their elotes! I ordered a skinny margarita and the drink was great too. Our server was super nice and she was fast, as well as attentive. With so many Mexican spots in Tampa, it's important to stand out and I think this place really did that.

By far the best Chinese take out at Temple! General Tso's chicken and dumplings are always the best and the best thing is its CHEAP and you get TONS of food. The other take out places have made me sick and wish I had just gone to China House. They are really nice also and actually speak ENGLISH!!!

I would have to say I was quite disappointed in the hotel room.  Little small and the mirror door to the shower was cracked mold in the shower the bench in our room was dirty.  I gave it a 3 because the staff were very friendly.  My husband needed milk for his pills 2 70 for a small box..
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Everything was great! Fishbowls a fair price, dance floor was great, and bouncers were friendly. ALL EXCEPT the manager who yelled me out of the bar due to me trying to stop my friend from getting scammed by one of their bartenders. Don't expect to feel welcome there.

A reason for each star: the food was fine (hamburgers with BBQ sauce), the service friendly, and best of all, before the teardown renovation, it was a charming piece of real history I walked to for lunch. The new owner destroyed part of our culture. I haven't set foot in the new place and don't plan to.

Really disappointed for the extra charge to "toast " my veggie burrito especially since I said no cheese or sour cream which are probably the two most expensive ingredients that I am saving them from putting on the burrito.....time to head to another place....bummer

Been to this spot twice in the last month. Both times the services was horribly slow. I actually had just came from the king of Prussia store which was twice as busy with the same amount of employees and got in and out in less than a fraction of the time it took this store to make one simple latte.

I have been taking my cars to H&H for over a year now. They do great work and are a pleasure to deal with.  Chris is always very pleasant and upfront with what needs to be done and you don't get the feeling they are doing unnecessary work.  I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for quality mechanic work.

Ive heard people talk about this place so indecided to take my kids there around 12pm. They had quite a bit of different donuts, drinks, etc... the Bacon Maple donut was big enough for two people! It tasted ok, tasted kinda blah with the Bacon cold and you could tell it was made this morning. I "might" go back but not sure.

Pizza and gooey cake looked delicious!  St. Louis style cuisine. Family owned business, staff and owners were very friendly. Although they got part of my order wrong, they readily fixed the issue.  I would recommend calling ahead as everything appears to be made to order fresh.

This is one of my FAVORITE Starbucks. I go here almost weekly to do my homework and study. I am always so productive. I really enjoy getting my lattes in a "for here" mug. It makes my whole experience feel more cozy and more like a small coffeeshop and not a typical Starbucks.

Hot plates topped with cold food? How's that work? Must be the heat lamps. If You want idle food hit up Panda Express. This place is the most overrated Mexican food in Tucson. The menu is average and the staff are unfriendly with customers. As a native from West Tucson I definitely don't recommend this place!

Stay away!  After $1,500 in bills and an unnecessary amputation and failure to do a simple culture my dog remained ill.  The excellent Veterinary Specialist Center did a simple culture to ID the nature of the infection and prescribe the appropriate medicine, which is all she ever needed.

This place is either a hit or miss! The garlic knots are awesome. The cheesecake is pretty decent and the pizza is either amazing or undercooked and run of the mill tasting. Delivery has always been on time for me. Overall not bad but I just wish they had consistent cooks!

If I could give this place NEGATIVE stars I would. This place is the worst nail salon I've ever been. I asked for a gel manicure and within 3 minutes he was done my "manicure". 2 bloody nails later...I asked for him to stop and pay. Also, the service is HORRIBLE!!!!!! Do not go go this place. Pictures to follow.

Got a double cheeseburger and a drink and it was good. Got my food quickly and everything was made correctly. They don't have $1 drinks here and it seems like their special menu is a little different so I'd keep that in mind when you visit. Overall, a decent McDonald's.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Good food. Usually pretty accurate when determining wait time for delivery. Cheesesteaks could have some more meat but good sized portions on entrees and pizza is very good. They used to give out coupons in their menu but seemed to get rid of them for some reason which is a little disappointing.

I'm very excited to have authentic Mexican in Lansdale.  Ordered the tacos al pastor and Gorditas.  The tacos were good.  Meat was flavorful. Would have liked some radishes for crunch.  Corn tortillas were thick and a little rubbery.  It would be great if they made their own.  Gorditas were great.  Freshly made and nice texture.

Stopped here for a quick lunch today, the food quality is what you would expect from a high school concession stand. I'm not necessarily upset, but I feel like a "restaurant" that focuses on hotdogs could give you a little higher quality food. Overall it's convenient and I'd stop again when pressed for time.

We had a terrific meal here. Service is fast and friendly. Food is delicious. The Sunday Supper is a huge potion with a great variety in meats (meatball was the best). We also really liked the lemonade drink on their alcohol menu. Cute and small location can be tough to find at first.

This place is legit..best beans in Boise.
Chili Reno's are fried...
Bang for your buck and damm good food!
Finely a Mexican place that taste better than Taco Bell
All the other want to be Mexican restaurants should eat here n eat what real food tastes likeExcept Campos mkt

Only came here to support a singer that performs here. Was my first time eating here, I got the linguine & clams. The clams were a weird green color and the sauce was very oily, it kind of grossed me out. I only took a few bites. the chocolate cake and cappuccino is very good, however

My husband and I went on a date here after having our little one. It was so delicious and such a good experience. I love how it feels like home and everyone is part of the family when you go for dinner. I have dreamt of the gnocchi since we were there! Don't skip it!

Love this place! Outstanding food and legitimately even better service. Family run with great pride and care,you'd have a hard time finding a bad meal. The bar staff are knowledgeable with modern cocktails and the food is delicious. Marilyn and Andrew rock!!!

Great prices, great people, very good food, excellent service. Not a fan of the decor, but overall great value for the price. Always get our food quickly so no need to rush through lunch. Everything cooked fresh to order. Very accommodating with special orders.

We started with the Chicken Biscuits as an appetizer and I ordered the Braised Short Rib 'Meatloaf' as an entrée, both of which were wonderful. The ambiance of the place perfectly suits what they have to offer. Very rustic, upscale southern fare. The Meridian-Kessler / SoBro area has been needing a place like this for far too long!

The BEST coffee shop in Fishers! Highly recommend the cold brew or the Black & Orange. All the baristas are friendly and knowledgeable, they play amazing music, and the setup is so cozy. It's really cool that Sure Shot is inside of Vardagen, which sells awesome local clothing. I love coming here to study or work!

I have gone to this nail salon for years the man was usually nice the woman always had an attitude.   Recently the man has gotten a attitude also, you can only take but so much.... I'm done.  Also the woman doesn't know how to give a pedicure if her life depended on it.

Won't take responsibility for a scratch to my rim after it jolted my wheel mid wash. Another customer had a similar experience recently causing a flat tire. Filed a BBB complaint two weeks ago and they haven't responded. I haven't been back since to use my unlimited plan because it's awful customer service.

I love the creativity of the doughnuts here. They also offer Vegan doughnuts on Tuesdays which is great for my husband. My only feedback is the staff hasn't been very friendly the couple of times I've been in and the coffee wasn't very good. I ended up buying Starbucks after my most recent visit.

Lobby looks totally nice and renovated, but does not reflect the rooms at all which reflect something from the late 90's. Bed is a giant marshmallow. Textured wallpaper. Toilet is a deep squat to the floor. Needs an update for sure. Sofa needs to be donated to a fraternity. This place is MEH. Front desk lady was nice though.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We could go across the street for pizza or travel down the street to Little Pizza Heaven. We come here.  Pizza is consistently good, good crust,  sauce,  flavor. Other meals have been good.  Beats the competition,  hands down. 

I don't know why the price is shown as $$$. It's a pizza place.  $-$$ tops.

So... this place changed owners, and the quality isn't the same. Hope they step up their game and make some positive changes. There is so much competition out there and they need to set themselves apart and above from the same old pizza/wings/cheesesteaks that you find everywhere. Food is now just OK. I miss the old owners.

Amazing dairy free ice creams, lots of vegan options, so good!!!!!!!!! This Jeni's is in a great location w lots of fun shops to check out. Staff is so friendly and kind, they made the already outstanding ice cream experience even better! Two thumbs WAY up!

We would love to try this place, but the music is always incredibly loud! How do you converse with anyone in your party without screaming? You can feel the music beat in ur chest while in your car at the stop light! Turn the music down a few notches and we may check it out.

The service here is terrible. Look at this full house but the employees have placed all of the chairs on the tables as if it were closed.

Last time we were here they were so rude - it seems like they're being intentionally slow as to dissuade new business.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Average hotel.  The air conditioning was loud in our room.  Water was tepid and water pressure might as well have been Non existent.  The elevators had issues and were a bit creepy.  The staff WAS friendly and very attentive when called upon. The only reason I'd give this hotel 3 stars is the staff.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Santa Barbara's best late night eatery for a reason! Roy is a very proud individual and should be. I've never once been here and he's not been here. The new artwork is amazing, done by Aaron Latham. great food every time. Love this place. Roy thank you so much for having us

Amazing food and amazing people! Every time I come here I am greeted with smiles and all around happy people! The food is always on point with amazing sauces and all around quality food! May I recommend the chicken piccata! 10 out of ten. This place knows what the people want!

The staff at the front desk was VERY rude. Peter in particular was not helpful at all and I was very disappointed in the way I was treated. I called to ask the availability of their rooms and he simply refused to help me. Will not look to stay here again any time soon.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Close to the airport and shuttle runs regularly. Front desk has a very kind staff at night. Restaurant and Bar open. Executive lounge up and running again. Gym is amazing and has all you will need away from home. Rooms are average but clean. Rainfall shower and the best bed ever.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My son was super disappointed that his apple slices contained only 2 slices of apple. "What's up with that?" He said. Then his sister shared hers. But seriously... who was in charge of apple packing?  You dropped the ball. Also, we didn't get ketchup. That's was a let down.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I've been coming here for years and love all of the dishes that I have tried. The sushi is great for the price and especially for the area as many will know that it is rather simple. As a pescatarian I find the seafood and vegetarian dishes to be excellent. My favorite dish is the jumbo shrimp pad Thai with curry!

Had the bacon burger and frosty, I also have the chocolate frosty when I eat at Wendy's 

The baconator burger was good, one big slice of lettuce, slices of onion, 2 slices of bacon, melted cheese with one single beef patties, on a toasted bun. 170st location across the street from Fionn MacCool and IHOP

I find Papa Murphy's to always be consistent and a take and bake is usually fresher than pizza delivery. Their ingredients are fresh and I like their thin crust option which is lower carbs than the regular crust. The $10 Tuesday special that they offer is a great deal!

Two words: SUPER SKURTLE.

Just shut your mouth right now. It's going to make you slap the person next to you as soon as you take a bite! Not to mention, who the heck doesn't like saying SKURTLE?? 

They have tons of variety and there's something for everyone there. Go check this place out!

Ehh! Doughnuts are like pizza! Someone's favorite is the next person's most disliked location. It is what it is. Service was awesome. Love the mural and shop. Not a favorite of my family for doughnuts. Glad they are staying busy and have a great following.

Ive only been inside once to me personally its way to small and gets way to packed. Buttt robs jamaican food in the back is the best! The mac and cheese is the best. Wings are perfectly seasoned. Plus rob is so nice! I would def recommend the food but call atleast a hr b4 u pick it up he is slow.

This place is very consistent with what I want and really nice. When I order hash browns they always care to give me ketchup even when I never ask. They are always quick to get my order and I get everything I asked for and a little more. Since this dunkin is the closest to me I always find it great that it's very convenient.

Really disappointed in the orange chicken. Used to be so good before new management/owner took over! This was our absolute favorite Chinese spot, we moved out of the area and had it today for the first time in a long time and unfortunately, we will not be going back. Shame!

The food is phenomenal. I've been to several sushi restaurants around Indy and nothing has better flavor than Sakura. Prices are comparable. The only downside is the speed of service. Other restaurants are much quicker at getting rolls out. The wait is definitely worth it.

We stopped at this KK on National Donut Day. I expected it to be complete madness. It was not. They got us through a long line fast. The iced coffee was pretty good. It was also cool that you can watch how they make the donuts while you wait in line. 

Insider tip: if the circle light is on you can get free donuts!

Decent hotel. Fire alarm randomly went off at 8am the first morning we were there, then housekeeping attempted to enter our room at 8am the next, only knocking softly before keying in. Breakfast selection was poor and not well-stocked. The hot tub was broken, but the pool was nicely heated.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Sooooo good! I've been to both locations. Leo's in Medford has more choices, but both have plenty of options. My favorite is the Roman Holiday and Mario Lanza! I hear he goes to Italy often for specific ingredients too! Best ice cream, water ice and gelato around! Hands down!

Best Mexican on the Northside of Indy. I love getting the elotes which are corn covered with butter and spices. The owners are really sweet people and you'll see them cooking, cleaning, and taking orders. This place also has a sauce bar where you can get all the sauces you want.

Ace made my first work trip a breeze. I was picked up from the airport and when my original car wasnt available they upgraded my car to an suv for free.  They definitely helped make a stressful arrival much easier! I will use them again next time im in town!

Stayed for a convention and was impressed! Hotels at airports are often shady or poor. This venue was great for the convention, the employees were nice and the rooms were comfortable. I will say that the room prices for what was included were a bit high. (Hence the four stars) Otherwise, it was a nice time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Awful!!! It is obvious drive-thru is the priority! Walked in one person ordering was it at the counter! I'm getting ONE drink ---- 13 minutes in I ask how many drinks in front of me?? 4!!!!??? Money back thanks and goodbye! Tons of employees --- crowded actually.  Ridiculous

The staff is great at this location....smiles &  friendly hellos. It is kept clean and there is ample parking. The tanning beds could be updated to newer models, but they are efficient. I do wish this location was bigger with more of the equipment (stair climber, pf360, etc) that other locations have.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I was craving Mexican and decided to give Nico's a try.  Got a takeout order of the Cheese Enchiladas with rice & beans.  Not bad for a little takeout shop in a strip mall.  Their rice was really good and the sauce of the cheese enchiladas was just about perfect.  Not to hot, but with just the right amount of zip to it.

My husband years ago would come here and he said it was delicious. He recently took me here and it was bad. The service isn't great, the salsa is watered down, chips were stale, sodas are flat, alcohol doesn't taste right in whatever you order, and the food isn't great either. Taste and feels like a glorified Taco Bell.

So far the best sushi we have tried in Nashville.  Sunshine rolll was the best that we had.  Very friendly service and we didn't have to wait to get a table.  Not really into rolls that are fried or with cream cheese, but there is a good selection to choose from.

Menu was a little dated.. service was on point but they brought everything at once when we ordered appetizers salad and my pasta course I felt a little rushed I also felt a little pricey for a BYOB but the food was on point and we did enjoy the dinner specials for the night

While I don't have much experience at all with sushi, the crispy roll and Bryn Mawr rolls at Sushiland are both delicious. It's reasonably priced and a great Main Line date spot. Sushiland is a favorite of Bryn Mawr College students, and that wouldn't be the case if it weren't pretty good and reasonably priced.

Edomasa has become my go-to place for sushi rolls. They have good prices and a varied menu. I usually get Tokyo, Marina, and Hip-Hop roll and is a good amount of food for two. My husband has also tried their beef ramen and it was super tasty. 

Friendly staff and a perfect option for a Friday night dinner!

Nice spot on the water, in the back of the hotel. 
Live music playing (started at 7pm), which added nicely to the ambiance. Familiar names on the wine list, which I appreciated. I ordered the crab stuffed salmon and a loaded baked potato/veggies. It was tasty, the veggies were a lil al dente for my taste. Debating dessert now...

I went in with several shirts, dresses, and pants for dry cleaning. They were prompt and helpful with respect to taking my order and returning my clothes on time,  but one of my pants came back very discolored and unfortunately is no longer usable. Otherwise a good experience...but I wouldn't risk going back, unfortunately.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
AMY'S BEST OF INDY PICK :)
The best filet mignon in the Indy metro area, along with the Portobello mushroom appetizer.  That's all I need for a great meal in a nice atmosphere.  Cocktails are also very nice.  Friendly and professional service.  Love this place!

Decent donuts but honestly not the best in town. We had a variety dozen and the donuts were good. The ones I had you could kinda taste the fat or grease honestly don't know. But considering donuts never go uneaten in my house and I threw away 4-5 donuts it says something.  I much prefer Doughboys or Donut Bistro

Went through the drive through and the woman was very nice and friendly. You don't really get that much anymore with drive thru fast food service and I can understand. But she was great. Food was good. Fresh and hot. Loved the oreo shake and husband and kids loved the blue slush. Quick service.

Yeah yeah, so they are another donut shop trying to copy Voodoo Doughnut with their hip pastry delights that border on the weird.

But you know what? IT'S GOOD.

Yes, it is a bit more pricey than regular boring donuts.

But you know what? IT'S GOOD.

Also: Open until 11pm for drunk donuts! 

That potato chip donut...

Excellent, quick and efficient service. Price is right and I really like my hair cut. Didn't talk a lot to explain what I want, but his talent is there. Walk in is welcome and 15 minutes later, I was done. Definitely I will be back. Parking is in the front of shop and is free.

Got the elite wash. $39. Very disappointing. Took car home abs vacuumed the many spots  they missed. Poorly cleaned cup holders and dash too.  They do a rush job that is not thorough. This is my second bad experience here. Wil not return. Just not worth the money.

Whenever I'm in town to visit my family I have to stop here and eat. The food is good and the service is slow but is good. We usually come here to eat the family meal and always get the bo bo platter. I was too hungry so forgot to take pictures of it but I did get pics of other food.

This Starbucks on big bend is honestly the worst one I have ever been to. The service is unbearably slow and I have never been to a Starbucks that basically made a hot sweet milk drink instead of a creme brûlée latte with two extra shots of espresso. Disgusting.

This hotel is awesome! Very upscale setting.  I love the view from our  room. My first visit and not my last. My acquaintance and I enjoyed the ambiance of our room. The king size bed was so freaking comfortable. The bath tub was super clean  and comfortable .  I look forward to my next visit if you know what I mean lol.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We had great service here this morning. The staff was energetic and friendly. They were happy to help us and even brightened our Friday morning. The food was fresh and our order was quick and correct. Way to go McDonald's!! Way to make our breakfast a positive and peppy experience.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
BEST homemade ice cream there is in NOLA. Forget carvel and cold stone or any chain creamery, they don't hold a candle. The flavors are unique and ingredients so good. I go every time I'm in NOLA. 

There is almost always a line but it moves pretty quickly. Also CASH ONLY!

This Starbucks is right where I work so I stop by frequently.

Service is consistently friendly and nice. 

Obviously it depends on the hour how busy it is thus how wiped off tables could be, how prepared ya gotta be upon being the next customer helped, etc.

Nothing to complain about. Have always been served well!

Had a wonderful stay for July 4th weekend. Amazing location and near pretty all the major Tampa attractions. Our room was clean and comfortable. The staff was quite pleasant as well. Looking forward to staying again on my next trip to Tampa. If you're in the area, I highly recommend!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Live in the building and my dog had a seizure and possible stroke. Quickly ran down and was told the earliest they could seem me was later in the afternoon by the desk clerk. Horrible. . She said I was better off taking him to an emergency hospital. December 3, 930am.

When you make the wrong drink admit it. A skinny cinnamon dulce is nothing like a macchiato. There is no drizzle and it's made with skim milk not whole. Thanks for wasting the time it took to stop and the money I prepaid with my app. Glad I can go back to my own neighborhood soon. Oh... and there was NO ONE in the store.

So I've be here twice and I love it. It's a little pricy but please know that you are getting quality food. The atmosphere is very nice. I ordered the beef bagogi and my wife gets the teriyaki beef combo with sushi. Let's just say it's a ton of food with some of the best miso soup we've ever had (minus the lack of tofu).

This place is great for fresh sushi that doesn't break the bank. We go here all the time and it is usually very busy which, I think, is a good thing when it comes to restaurants.

Definitely worth checking out.....just be sure to have patience when it comes to parking;)

Pretty as a prayer book, this place is magical! The dining room --in a church--had incredible acoustics and the piano player was excellent. The food was wonderful! The cocktails were perfect! I would like to live in a Groundhog Day-style time loop of my evening there. I can't wait to go back!

Piss poor customer service and an office that smells of cigarettes from the attached motel ALL THE TIME. 

I am an Enterprise Gold member and rent from the company a lot. This location needs to reconsider its staffing, proximity to the motel and just general customer service experience. 1 star.

If you really love this place then you haven't ever eaten at a real sushi restaurant.  The California roll I got (I was scared to order raw for delivery) is basically grocery store quality.  The chicken dumplings are ok but allllll I taste is ginger.  Expect what you might get at the mall if you go here.

If I could give them none I would. Paid for 40 nuggets for a coupon. Ended up with 20, and the wrong sauces. I'm not mad about the time I had to wait or that the young woman didn't know how to use the coupon. I just can't. This is part of why I don't eat here or most fast food places anymore. I'll make my own nuggets next time.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Since they raised the wages and the price of a carwash, the quality of the service and attention to detail has gone down the tubes....We have been taking our cars there 2 times a month for years but no more....Instead of honoring my request to clean the wheels I was told they look fine......WTF

Closed early due to low staffing.... ok fine, that's reasonable but I came back another day at 10pm no closed sign, no one answered the drive thru and I saw employees running around and hiding in the kitchen when I pulled around. Wtf is going on at the place
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Christel once again is providing exceptional service, and this time I'm spelling her name correctly. She is definitely a jewel, which is why I inadvertently misspelled her first name. She told me it's fine, but I know what it's like to have folks misspell a first name.

I have dealt with numerous vets over the years.  I have only ever had to use one that had a worse manner than this vet and their office.  I cancelled the appointment I had made, and will take my dog to the Ophthalmologists at Mizzou before I will make an appointment here again.

I would highly suggest not even wasting your time applying to these apartments. All of the employees told me different information about when the deposit would be made. I was ripped off before I could even move in! This is not good business and there are other apartments in the area that are much more worth the money than this one.

Chinese express has been around for quite some time and has always been reliable and affordable. Their whole orders are enough to feed groups of 2-4 and no matter the dish you'll always finish satisfied. 

My favorite things to order are their crab ran, sesame or orange chicken. Can't go wrong there! 

Check them out!
