Can you spare the Salsa???  Omg this was the 1st latino restaurant that I ran out of Salsa 2 times before I ran out of chips. Portions are small. We went during Happy Hour so the prices were reduced. Unfortunately so are the portions. Frozen Margarita in a 10 oz water glass, Seriously?

I visited this office on 2/1/16 as I had scratched my cornea and was in pain.
Dr. Andrew Pritchard examined my eye and treated me with such kindness.
He is a wonderful eye doctor. After a day of rest and eyedrops I was able to continue on my road trip with my daughter.
I highly recommend Dr. Andrew Pritchard.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I used to come here often, but it is out of the way for me now. I was nearby so I gave it a shot. The service is worse than it used to be, though not the worst I have ever had. Ultimately, all of the three stars that have come off are due to the price. Seriously, $28 for a wash? Complete rip-off. I won't be back again.

This hotel is perfectly located in the heart of downtown Boise allowing access to just about everything on foot. The staff is great and the rooms are new and clean. Parking couldn't be easier (you literally park on the floor you're staying in, and they have a ton of amenities.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Sushi very good. Very nice staff as well. The only negative is the decor.  The place is massive. They need to utilize the space better and redecorate. The wall color is not appealing. Cheap furnishings. It needs to be a little  intimate and modern, in my and my husband's opinion.

I wanted to have close friend and sister have a taste of the ice cream that I heard was very delicious.  Atmosphere was very welcoming and pleasant. I order the Cinnamon Toast Crunch . It was everything you could imagine. I would come back . FYI the prices are ($)

Love that Taki is conveniently down the street from my work so I can call ahead for lunch. Their spicy noodle from their Thai menu is delicious. The sushi is ok at most in my opinion. I just wish the sushi taste fresh until then I'll stick to my regular spicy noodles.

Nice staff but very average quality Mexican food. Their fish selection consisted of Tilapia. That should give you a good indication of the level of quality. However, I took my chances, ordered the (Tilapia) fish tacos, took one bite and sent it back. This place really more or less resembles a fast food Mexican joint.

Best pizza in NOLA area. (Probably better than actual NY pizza lol) I am a NY resident and have had my fair share of different styles of my pizza but this was hands down the best I've ever had. I'm not even a big pizza fan but I gobbled this up. And the garlic knots were so good and garlicky.

My wife and I dine gere on a regular basis, the food is always great, and so is the service, our drinks never get empty. The only reason I knocked it down to a 4 is all the parents that come in and let their babies scream without doing anything about it, you have to make parents control their kids.

A real hit or miss at this location, though the experiences I've had were mostly fair. Each subway menu is nearly identical, so this is on the staff. 1/3 I would let make my sandwich, so I sometimes walk in and back out. That 33% is getting 4 stars though. Thanks!

Nice hotel and whatever but can't check in because I'm not 21. I can't stand this. Very annoyed right now. There should be some waiver or something. So I've been sitting in the lobby almost two hours now waiting for my friend to drive up from Baltimore to check me in. Ridiculous
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Worst White Castle in America. I travel a lot. When I put my order in she cut me off halfway so I pulled up to the window to finish my order and she was all mad throwing stuff, Slamming the window and texting all her friends while taking other people's orders. she got mine  wrong... And the Line was super long so I just trashed it.

This is place is great! So clean, professional, and well-priced. I love coming here. There is one particular guy who did my nails about a month ago... I never learned his name. He took a long time and I was a bit antsy. But then I looked at my nails and WOAHHHHH!!! They looked amazing and lasted forever without a single chip.

Amazing new cash wash.  Hope they keep up the standard in the future.  Super clean my SUV in the drive through wash.  You vacuum your own car. Vacuum worker great, they also have air hose to blow out crevices. Plenty of clean microfiber towels to finish off the door jams.

Zasu was absolutely incredible From start to finish. The entries rotate often but the octopus starter is a crowd favorite and I couldn't wait to try it during my visit! It. Was. Incredible!!! The space is inside is also beautiful   so it makes for a great date night.

I have Eaten here Multiple Times since Discovering this Restaurant. Overall the Food is very Good and the Staff very Friendly.  I just wish They had Fountain Drinks. They Open at 10am which is Great! I really like Their Tacos ,Burritos and Fajitas . I am sure that Their many other Offerings are Good.

Chicago's pizza with a twist is something new to Reno and it definitely hold up its name -- With A Twist. Their butter chicken pizza melts in your mouth! I love their samosas and their wings. I'd recommend this place to everyone who is looking for something new and want to add spice in their life!

Yum Yum Yum - First Timer with St Louis Pizza and I am definetely a fan!
Well priced and delicious, I would love to have some more of this type of pizza.
Completely different style to NY, Chicago & the pizza we have here in Australia. I appreciate that they have developed their own style of pizza here & its definetely a winner!!

This place is near our home and they do excellent take out. Love to have a margarita while I wait. My husband enjoys the fajitas and I usually try something new each time. I've never gotten anything that wasn't good. Step up the atmosphere and they be a five.

In the past this place has been pretty decent, but this time around it seems like nothing was working very well. Particularly the dryers which just didn't seem to get hot at all. I'll still come here next time, but if it isn't better I won't give them another chance.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Ice cream was good, I got the mississippi maker and cookies and cream. The cookies and cream was delicious but the Mississippi maker had hard large chunks of cookie that were hard and not that flavorful. It is also pricey. But the service was great the lady there gave us HUGE scoops  and was very sweet.

If I could give it less than one star I would. Bad food, poor service and dear god was it overpriced. This place, with it's phony bologna vibe (really, a dj is necessary?), is clearly run by people who have never run a restaurant. Do yourself a favor and stick to maurepas across the street. B

Food was ok and service was incredibly slow. Only one server the majority of the time and she was doing her best. A gentleman appeared just prior to my departure and he had zero personality and moved slow as molasses while my server was running like crazy.

Not responsive to customers, unapologetic when out of requested items. Generally cavalier attitude toward customer service- spoke on the phone and in person and just got the impression the person behind the counter didn't care. Donuts are pricey- there should be some consideration for the customer.

Ok so maybe it's not always the same excellent food. First time everything was excellent. We went there last tues and was very disappointed. Two of the three orders were wrong and the food was bland at best. Cheese dip was good though.  Guess its hit or miss here.

It's not my favorite place to get my nails done but  it's a place I go if I need a quick mani or pedi. They're not too expensive ($20 for gel mani and $35 for gel pedi). They're always fast and they do the job well. I wouldn't say I feel "pampered" which is why I'm giving it a 3.

Generally had a pretty go experience here.  The car wash is cheap & they do a decent job.  There has been a few times where I went and I asked for an interior wipe down and they said they couldn't do it because they were understaffed - which was hard to believe because there was 4 of them drying my car & no other cars in sight.

I go here every & get their Special Fried Rice with extra broccoli.  Today, I decided to try something different.  I got the Light Crisp Shrimp  with broccoli.  I was told by the West End Wok's finest that this was their best selling shrimp dish & it was her favorite.  I was sold!   It was simply delicious

These guys have horrible customer service and are super slow. Don't know how to ring up a bill and do t know their liquor inventory.  They lost a sale because in being disrespectful and belligerent. Lady with Snow White hair.  Didn't even want to ask her name she already was fired up for some unknown reason and was very confused.

I come here often enough for the staff to know exactly the extent of my winoism. 

The selection is great, the prices are reasonable, the shop is beautiful and the staff is friendly and knowledgeable. My favorite place to pick up a bottle of wine on the way home.

Normally I get a crab salad and a snow crab roll, but ordered a Clearview roll to-go from their online menu. I was really disappointed bc it was fried. I don't like the fried rolls. I'm not sure why it doesn't say that on their menu. 
Used to be a big fan, but have found much better sushi restaurants in the area.

Honestly, I was not at all impressed with the girls behind the counter. They were unfriendly and came off pretty rude. Their hours are also really tough. There have been multiple occasions where we've said "let's get Lorenzo's" but they were already closed. Big bummer. However their pizza slices are massive and pretty dang good.

Pictures are deceiving. 

Pros
Great location to arch and dowtown area
Gift shop and restaurant available. 

Cons
Hotel rooms small, old, and musty smelling
I had a rotary phone.
No extra plugs or ports for phone charging.
Must request view of arch for a much upgraded expense of $50.00
Parking is expensive
Breakfast expensive
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The ice cream is for eclectic tastes.  Overly rich, and super sweet.  My kids could finish a single scoop.  So if you are a vanilla or chocolate type of person-probably not the place for you.  If you are a super taster and want 5 different flavors all at the same time - this place is heaven.

This place is the most amazing Mexican food that I have ever , ever, ever, did I say ever? EVER!!!

Their margaritas are SOOOOO GOOD and I get them frozen. 

I'm in love. 

I found out about this place through my friend, brought my husband with me tonight. 

He LOVED it.

This place is usually my favorite. I sent husband in after ordering and it said 20 minutes. It took an hour and the guy touched his nose and then our chicken so he told the person at the counter and they did nothing. Very upsetting experience. Also my husband was so upset he forgot to get the free soda for takeout.

Interestingly enough this handggrenade bar makes one of the best rum punch/hurricanes in the quarter and the 3 in 1 happy hour specials make this a good deal.  
We also enjOyed excellent service and conversation with Kristin the bar tender who gave us good info  on local establishments.
Fun times!

A long line for coffee, but I see why. They have a great variety of hot and cold beverages. We got a chocolate croissant, but was given a cream filled. They quickly made right though. They have a nice outdoor area where you can sit and people watch the beach. Good spot for coffee for sure!

Very good service - friendly and efficient. Sushi is average and not overly expensive for the area. I hated the blaring rap music, which was especially jarring in a sushi place. Nothing to go out of your way for. About equal quality to Drunken Fish, without the pretension and  price.

Came here on a Sunday for lunch and we sat outside under the tent. It was a gorgeous day. I had the Caesar salad with shrimp. The serving size was large which was great! The shrimp were a tad undercooked but the overall experience was very enjoyable. And right in the heart of Peddlers Village, a great location.

Trash days are Monday Wednesday and Friday. The first day I came I was not able to get into the drive-thru, I was determined to find another morning routine so I waited and found out their trash days. You want to come for their customer service and stay for their food!

They have an average review on here of 2 stars. I wouldn't give them more than 1. They are so understaffed. Long line to see someone about the most basic things. I've been here many times over the last 3 years and each time it's the same thing. I hate this branch.

Nice Italian restaurant. Crowded seating and it gets pretty load but worth it. Great wood fired pizza and a whole host of other excellent menu items. Situated in an old bank building with a very high ornate ceiling. It makes for an interesting setting especially being in YBor city.

This rental location seems to have the best selection and prices in the area. They were very accommodating and helpful. They went to extra mile to make our experience great, so I will go the extra distance when I'm in NOLA for get a vehicle here when needed! Thanks!

Excellent price for huge portions and great taste and quality. The menu is unique and caters to everyone's taste. One of the few places in Algiers that serves the 32 inch poboy at an excellent price. Calling ahead to order is recommended to avoid lengthy wait times during a rush.

I've been here many times, and it's honestly pretty good. Not the best sushi in the world, but not bad by any stretch of the imagination. The owner is really nice and remembers you after you've been there a few times. I like the lunch combo, and the sushi. Very Goleta, well priced, reasonable.

Nice facility...but even with an emergency the wait is long. I took my dog there for 6 years and the staff acts like they have never seen us before everytime we arrive! Their is no personal attention, no care, no compassion....go to West Vet, it blows this place out of the water!

Close to the water. It's a modern hotel. Clean and simple design.

Interior has nice simple design and decor. It's nicely and we kept. 

I could stay here, there's close by restaurants and shops as well as casual food dining right nearby. There's also a little restaurant attached to the hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great option along the boardwalk for a bite to eat! My mom, sister and I sat outside, but there was an option to sit inside as well. I got the shrimp skewer, my sister for the philly burger and my mom got salmon. All was delicious. The sides are homemade. Joy was our server and she was so sweet and welcoming. Would recommended!!

Absolutely overpriced. Their specialty rolls are not the size that you're thinking, but closer to a 6 piece basic tuna roll. Quality of the fish was fine but rice was too hard making the rolls difficult to eat and a little dry. Super disappointed and feel like I got GOT.

Sign in the lobby about their amenities being so popular they're now for sale had me excited. However the cramped rooms, insanely uncomfortable beds, lumpy couch pillows as bed pillows and no fitted sheets resulting in laying half on the plastic mattress cover dampened that excitement real quick!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We have ordered here a bunch a times and always enjoyed the pizza and Stromboli's! This time we ordered pizza steaks and a buffalo chicken wrap. The wrap and chicken were all delicious! The food was ready for pickup in 15 mins and service was friendly. Will definitely return!

This place upped themselves to a category 5.   They don't deserve to be a category 3.   We experienced. Dirty stained sheets.  They did fix this immediately. 
The people next door screamed like Neanderthals until 4:30 am.  Finally "security" interviewed.   
For the price they charged.  I expect better.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We did take out pizza from the Trattoria and it was packaged nicely for take out. Now the negative--the crust was so hard, so chewy and tough, so inedible that we ended up tossing it. I'd recommend eating in if it can be done Covid safely but take out for us was a bust.

The ice cream is delicious,  good service & friendly staff.  But, I can't comprehend with all that room, why no tables & chairs.  That would certainly entice me to come more often and would be a benefit to the business. Consider adding tables and chairs as there is more than enough room to section off upper back of lot.

I think this gym is quite good for an all purpose workout . Plenty of cardio equipment, machines and of course free weights. Certainly not a bodybuilding facility but then again, that's obvious. The Black Card is what I have so I train when I travel for work - can't beat it
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Since I moved down here finding a place to eat or a place to deliver was hard. So when I found this place I ordered numerous times, the last time my large cheese pie was greasy and.the French fries were cold . I will no longer be ordering from there anymore .

They are frauds!! Do not use them for anything. Thus includes banking and credit cards. They put an address in my credit report that I do not live at but refuse to remove it. I will be suing them. I have proof they did it. Recorded all their calls as well. Everyone if you have accounts with them change now!!!

This was such a pleasant surprise... The restaurant was clean, super friendly waitress and the food was very good... No wait, it was excellent, tasty and you can order everything on the menu!!!!

It's all you can eat but not from a buffet bar, naw... They are making it fresh as you order!! 

Definitely coming back!!!

My room was big with a gorgeous view but.... someone else's hair all over the bathroom! In the sink, in the tub, on the towels....gross!  Housekeeping came and fixed it but that should never happen in a "clean" room. Staff was nice and helpful. Location is great
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Safe, clean, spacious room & comfortable over night stay.  The security guard on duty very attentive.  The pool & outdoor patio very nice & inviting. Was given a goody bag upon checkin which was an unexpected friendly touch.  Very pleasant overnight stay. Would stay again when visiting Tampa.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The atmosphere is good. Service was slow. Never had an offer to refill my water. Gentleman at the counter of the kitchen wearing headphones and texting on phone in view of customers. Food was very good. Antonio was my server. He was friendly but like I said never even offered to refill my water. Place is clean and nice atmosphere.

Ordered through Uber around 1130pm on a Thursday night. Delivered pretty quickly and food was hot. Had a Big Buford, cheese fries and mozzarella sticks. Burger was ok but wasn't my fav of the fast food burgers. Cheese fries were tasty but the mozz sticks were really salty. Was an ok meal after some beers but not jumping to go back.

This Starbucks location is very poor, running out of cold brew coffee more then once when I've stopped. Couldn't understand the person trying to explain this to me. They seem to be very understand staff on a regular bases with a backed up line at 2 in the afternoons in the drive threw and inside.

The location of this hotel was great! Close walking distance to a lot of great locations. Our room was clean, but small, everything worked nicely. My only complaint is our room was an adjoining room and our neighbors were very noisy! We could hear word for word what they said and talked about.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Thanks for fixing the outlets at the farm table!   

Congratulations Bryan on your promotion!  

Your engagement with customers and attention to customer service will surely shine through making this one of the best *$'s in the city.

I look forward to the introduction of Nitro to your location!

Came here with a fairly large party for dinner this past week. The ambience was nice and the food was delicious, I recommend the open face turkey sandwich, the brisket and crab cakes :) the only thing that hindered our experience a little was that our server was very unpleasant and rude. Which all in all is a pretty easy fix.

Food is great.I didnt know that wearing gloves when you make a pizza there is optional. When I ask the cashier, why is one lady wearing gloves to prepare the pizza and one guy isnt. Her reply, we're clean, we wash our hands. Yes, but now I' m eating his DNA, thanx. She just stared at me, no thanx, I wont be going back.

This Buger King is great for grabbing something late at night, maybe after the casino since it's open 24 hours.

It's a great spot to grab a sandwich or combo that isn't over priced. Just please what ever you do don't order the special fries... they are ALWAYS out of them. The sandwiches are still ok...

The drive-thru line here, whether it is wrapped around the building or just a few cars deep, moves extremely slow.  I have never received fast service at this fast food establishment, but the order has always been accurate.  It'll do in a pinch....as long as you're not in a rush!

Disappointed in this location. The server was very unfriendly and not welcoming at all. We sat with empty drinks and no chips for an extended time and when our food arrived it was cold for our entire table.  When we mentioned it to the server she just shrugged.

Hands down, the filthiest place I've ever been in. We were there for coffee and the drink area was coated with spilled drink on the counters and discarded trash. After 10 minutes, a girl came out, presumably on her break, to fill her drink and just took a napkin and wiped it down. Nothing to clean or sanitize it.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I got the chicken fried rice. It was pretty descent but maybe because it wasn't spicy at all as requested. I also got the chicken and broccoli but they mixed the order up. I will definitely like to give this place another try because I belief they have potential. The pizza eggrolls were really good.

There is nothing more stressful than not finding a good place to maintain your car. Finally after many years I can say that I have found the best trustworthy place for my car. I am very satisfied with the excellent work they do at Big Brand Tire. I feel safe driving my car after excellent service. I highly recommend this company.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I ordered a couple of slices which were ok.  Sadly, the employee who got my soda was wearing his mask around his chin as he poured it & handed it to me.  A second employee went into the pizza oven to get his slice out also with his mask around his chin.  AVOID THIS PLACE,  NOT FOLLOWING SAFETY PROTOCOL.

Great local coffee shop in Channelside. Every time I go the service is always friendly and quick. They also offer specialty donuts that are always delicious! I've had their cafe con leche and some of their lattes. They also offer a loyalty program which is love! The coffee is always good, but in my opinion a tad overpriced.

BEST pizza in New Orleans. I love the Margherita pizza and the garlic knots. I did not give it 5 stars because the service can be a little "meh". You have to bus your own table and the cashiers don't really seem to care about the customer. But still gets 4 starts because its so delicious

Was a Waffle House. Food was pretty good took a little long to get it, but they were really busy, actually surprisingly busy but they are practically the only place around with a open dining room this late (11:00) we had chicken tenders and Tenderloin both  good.

If you're going to Reilly Pizza, definitely make a stop here.
All of their cocktails are really interesting and taste great!
The place is small but wasn't too busy on a week day night and there is also a beer garden directly upstairs with heater lamps for winter.

The service was mediocre at best. I had the sample appetizer platter and it was very bland. The chicken strips were decent, but the artichokes and the skins dishes were bland. Also, the rolls were not very warm and, honestly, they weren't very good. I do not plan to frequent here again.

The wait is over, Fairmont has a wonderful new restaurant. 
A Mano features Italian seasonal dishes prepared with just enough innovation to make them truly memorable. 
A lovely dining room and open kitchen that is welcoming on a cold winter evening. Large windows give the cosy space a sophisticated feel.

We got a car wash and they didn't even wipe the outside of the car down throughly. The rims looked milky as well as the chrome around the vender like they let water sit on it. We just bought our car a couple days ago and we had a scratch on the car already when we got back. Never coming back here!

Came on a Saturday night at 10. Parking was a little tough, but there was no line! They have a HUGE selection of ice cream, like every flavor you see on their website is being scooped in store. I had the dairy free Texas sheet cake and the dairy free roasted peanut butter and strawberry jam. So good!!!

Came on a Wednesday night at 7 with a party of 8. We made the reservation that day in the afternoon. We were seated right away and our waiter was very attentive. I got the Cobb salad which was pretty good and a huge portion size. Also ask for the bread for your table, it is amazing but forgot to take a pic.

Came here for the dinner and a movie deal. My husband ordered the "Jaws" roll and hasn't stopped talking about it. Mine was tasty too, just can't remember the catchy movie theme name. I would like to come back for the all you can eat sushi dinner. This place has good service, great sushi...wha'ts not to like?

Terrible Starbucks, mainly because the workers have no common sense. Instead of handing the drink to the person from the window they put it on the counter next to the register.. doesn't need to be that difficult or take that long... timed my drive through experience 26 minutes.... INSANE

Disappointed in the service 

I've been in this line for 21 minutes!!! I feel trapped as there are concrete barriers around their drive through. 

Only to arrive to the window and they're no longer serving chicken biscuits. 

I will not return to this location.

Great takeout spot for sushi takeout in the city! I was happy to find everything just how I ordered it when I got home. I ordered the Sushi and Sashimi Combo and it was very fresh and delicious. Convenient location and affordable pricing. I'll be ordering from here again!

I've ordered takeout from this place multiple times and they never disappoint! Ordered their Chirashi this time around and it was ready in less than 15 minutes. The Chirashi came with miso soup and salad and the portion size was great. It also came in nice packaging. Definitely going to be ordering from here again!

We have always had THE BEST pizza at the Theo's in Elmwood so we decided to try this one.  I was so disappointed.  We had the large meat pizza and garlic cheese bread.  Crust was not crispy it was very greasy and the bacon was burnt. So with the bacon being burnt it made the whole pizza taste burnt!    .  I LOVE the one in elmwood!

It is located in the Rita Ranch Market. Took my son there today and he loved it. He is picky .  We dont live in vail, my daughter had a game and my son has a game later in vail.  We were close to sports something cuts but thank God I read the reviews .  This place didnt have any reviews. Im glad we came here

Thank you for having a lovely, immersive, and community oriented business. The welcome upon entering was so warm. Even though selection is small it packs a great flavor and taste for any sweet tooth!! Brought the kids along and they loved it as well. The owner is personable and engaging!! My children really appreciated it.

This place has the freshest fish to make their sushi. The sushi is always on point. I've never had any disappointments here. The staff is very friendly and pleasant. They sometimes bring a little special chef creation which is always good. I love this place.

This is a good place to come after eating dinner or doing a little shopping. It is pet friendly so you can bring your dog in the patio. The sangria is my favorite! The beer selection is broad with occasional specials. Thursday nights are bingo nights. It is so much fun! I recommend coming here for a chill time.

Probably one of the cutest places I have been to in a long time. This small mom and pop place has everything that will be a successful restaurant in Newtown. Great food and service. All ingredients were fresh and delicious.
Ordered the siliciana and margarita pizza. Both were delicious. Lemon cake was delicious.

This was our first time eating at this establishment.  I would say Root and Bone is more of an experience.  The host was kind and complimentary.  Our server, Michael, had great recommendations and answered all questions.  The food was exquisite.... We harms the BLT for an appetizer.

Came in after a very long day for what I thought was going to be a good local joint. We waited over an HOUR  and never even got our one pizza. It's almost like they never made the pizza at all! They barely came over to check on us. I live right down the street and even the atmosphere was not inviting! Never again

George's is one of my go-to places to eat in Broad Ripple. The service is amazing and the owner is really friendly. The prices are also on point for the amount of food that you get! The nachos are also a great late night snack to share after a long night out!

I have had the worst experience with rodeway inn and to top if off they fraudulently charged hundreds of dollars to my account without my consent or authorization and thought i would not realize it just lowdown dirty NO GOOD i dont recommend this hotel..STAY AWAY
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Beautiful restaurant with good service.    Bread was brought to our table before we even had our napkins on our laps.    

My tuna was nicely done and a large portion.  The wasabi sauce was very spicy but delicious.    My eye were watering at almost every bite.

2.5


Large portions which allowed everyone to take home leftovers for another meal.   

The garlic bread was the best thing of the evening.   Buttery, garlic, crispy finger licking good. 

My veal was okay.   Too much wine in the sauce which was so over powering it's all I tasted.

I placed a to go order online and husband picked it up. Food came as expected. I ordered a calzone and my husband ordered the chicken and broccoli Alfredo. He said he loved his, I however thought my calzone was meh. It was soggy towards the middle. The outside was crispy and had some bite to it. The rest of it just fell apart.

Like the atmosphere and location a lot here. The food can be hit or miss though. The pizza is Naples style so is pretty good. The pasta is what is eh for me! Sometimes it's great and other times just ok. Wine list isn't anything great either. But you get what you can for Italian when in Nashville. There's not much!

Look, this is typical Tex-Mex food with far too much salt and MSG in everything.  Its not bad to have dinner after golf with a buddy but not to bring an out of town guest or even someone you really like..  You wont get sick for sure but not a place you plan ahead to go.

Stopped in a few times during a week stay in NO with my girlfriend. Environment was great. The drinks were creative and good.
We got there right when they opened one evening before the crowd showed up. Stopped in again another evening during a busier time. Good experience on both visits.

This place has great food but the place was was too loud with obnoxious clientele that management let get out of hand which was totally disappointing. Several people asked to move their seats due to the one table which was a shame.  This restaurant was a family favorite and we doubt we will ever go back.

Don't believe the ads. 2 day early deposit its false advertising. My deposit came in 3 hours early. That's about it. Phone operator seemed like I interrupted him from something more important.  Thought I'd help support local business. Maybe I'll support a different bank.

I wish I could give this place 0 stars. They are the absolute worst for picking up their phones and over one and a half hours for delivery when it says it was being delivered 20 mins ago. The place sucks! We are so tired of giving them more chances. On to the next papa johns that cares about their customers!

Mask Mandatory and social distancing enforced!!

Super friendly little coffee shop hidden behind traffic. Great customer service, everyone was friendly. I got my regular vanilla ice latte which tasted like I was drinking from a paper straw....but I wasn't!! Flavor was off but wasn't undrinkable.

I'm impressed! Wonderlust is my favorite and honestly the only one that I tried. its hard for me to try other teas when yerba mate, passionfruit and cherry blossom already took my heart. Maybe one day I'll have the guts to try something new. Give this place a shot, it's delicious and I always catch myself craving Transit Teas!!

This place is good, inside and out. I had a wonderful, wonderful hair dresser. She treats you like a piece of art. Her name is Rachel. And that's all ye need to know. 

Can't wait to go back...but she did such a good job on my hair, it still has shape three months later!

Zolos is back! 4 visits in 3 months and every time exceeds expectations. I know it's had some awkward years- 2020 is one of the good ones, and we all know 2020 has been awkward most places.
Calamari, artichokes, French onion, spaghetti and meatballs, veal piccata,chicken piccata, etc all solid!

I really liked this place.  The Udon noodles were fantastic and the sushi was fun and had some really good flavors.  My sister went crazy over the Hawaiian rolls with mango and I really enjoyed the different options on the menu too.  The fried ice cream was to die for!  Yum, yum. We will definitely be back again.

So many unique flavors to choose from that I've never seen before and I sampled many!  I loved their famous cheesecake ice cream with fresh strawberries!  And the sign about unattended children in the back was hilarious as well as their sample junky signs.

I'm not a big fan of the Aloft hotels.  However the staff at this hotel was very nice.  These hotels remind me of college dorms more than a nice hotel room.  They always seem a little louder then the average hotel room.  Part of that comes from the bar being right on the middle of everything.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Went on a Saturday afternoon before dinner, so place was not too crowded. Charming spot, with fresh cocktails. Nice place to get off of Bourbon Street. Had the Zephyr- delish! Piano player was great, playing some classic New Orleans songs! 

Sarah the bartender was delightful and knowledgeable of the spirits and brews.

Unfortunately, I have been here 3 times now and I have not been wowed once. There was a time when they had a really fun bartender who did tricks so this was fun to watch. The food is not very good. I am sad to write that because I know it has been around for a while and is a family restaurant but I am out of chances with them.

It was ok. Not the best Mexican restaurant but not the worst either. Enchilada Rojas tastes awful. The flavor doesn't really come together. Too much going on, there's prickly flavor and sweet then spicy and gross it's all over the place. One bite you like it, the next bite you don't and the next you kinda wanna throw up.

This is our neighborhood Chinese food place. We were sad to realize they do not deliver. If they do deliver we have not figured out how to do it.  The crab Rangoon's are good here, but the sesame chicken tastes more like orange chicken. Maybe there was a mixup in our order? The service is friendly and quick.

This place is great! Centrally located to the grocery store and liquor store yet very close to the airport.  4 stars only because of no shuttle to the beaches. Publix is across the street and Panera is right next door.  The hotel does offer shuttles to local businesses that are close by, and you have to arrange it in advance.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I am a fan!!
 From the managers  to the front line folks, they are amazing.
So friendly and helpful. 
They go a million miles a minute and find time to personalize the service. 
I can't  say enough nice things about them. 
I go there 4 or more times a month.

Staff is friendly, the ice cream is so worth the prices!!!
They have some flavors that are always there and then there is a revolving list
My current fav is the mandarin ginger beer!!
There is always Porkys it has bacon and bacon bits.... on my!!
Come on you know you need some ice cream
Smiles

As happy as I am to finally have a Starbucks drive thru after 3 days in a row of getting my drink made wrong I'll be going back to the Fry's Starbucks. Drinks are to expensive to have them wrong and the staff a little rude when you ask them to please get it right today. Too bad but it will save me money in the long run!

I wanted to love this place but I wound up just liking it.  Their food is good but the pie is raw because it's woodfired.  I think I'll have them pre-bake my dough if they can do that next time.  The salad was great but it needed a lot more dressing it was very dry.

Waited 15 minutes in the lobby for one sandwich. Got to my car and thank goodness I checked. It was wrong. I went back into the lobby and no one wanted to make eye contact. They remade it and while I waited. Yes waited again I asked for a small shake for my trouble. They said they can't do that.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is the salon to go to. Clean and calming. Tina is my girl and she's always doing such a good job on my acrylics - normal color, gel, or even ombré. She's awesome and super nice! All the technicians do a good job so I never worry if Tina isn't available.

I booked this hotel back in July. When we arrived on December 26 I paid paid cash for my room and they still charge my Credit Card. I paid cash for my room. They still charge my credit card 250.00 I wouldn't trust them. The staff was rude they don't seem to really care. I spoken to my bank I got my 250
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place is efficient and delivers high quality. They actually read the label, feel the materials and let you know the best cleaning method for the garment. I've been in the Southampton area for 20 years and have struggled to find a reputable and trustworthy place. Trust these people!!!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Man o man. I love the tortas here the burritos the tacos... they have delicious food and good workers, always ready to serve and nice to customers. I am from Cali and we definitely know Mexican food there, so yes this is one of the best places for the tortas and the burritos and tacos from Mexico.

It was raining last night and I was really hungry for a chicken cheese steak hoagie; to my disappointment, that sandwich was absolutely disgusting. The chicken was not chopped well and it had no flavor and the ketchup was watered down or cheap. I gave that $8.59 waste of money to my neighbor's dog... he liked it.

A wonderful hidden gem! I love how they are freshly made and made to order. I would like if there were tables and chairs to sit and have one or two doughnuts with a coffee and a friend, instead of it being take out only. Other than that MamaBuntz is a very nice woman and you can tell she loves her business.

The store was clean and service was very quick. I love that Starbucks has switched to paper straws now! It's great for our environment. 
As far as the drinks go, this was the absolute worst Caramel Frappe that I have ever had. It was watery, flavorless, the caramel was thin and the whipped cream was melted. Very disappointed.

This place is horrible. 
Against my better judgement I got a chicken cheese steak for lunch.  OMG!!! It was so salty.
I totally got food poisoning later on in the day.  And this coming from a man who has a cast iron stomach.  

I do not recommend this place.

If I could give it 0 stars I would. Just got delivery via DoorDash. The kids meals literally had 3 nuggets in a bag, no fries. We're now headed to get the kids more food elsewhere because they are starving. Soda was flat too on the adult meals. Tried calling but it rings and is not accepting messages...I wonder why...

Unfortunately this was the worst sushi I've ever had. Ordered 2 of the specialty rolls and 2 regular rolls. It took me a lot to write this review as I love to support small businesses and see them thrive but the food was so disappointing I felt it would be a disservice to others not to share our experience.

make sure you load up your parking meter with about $10 worth of change and cancel all your plans for the rest of the day. service is painfully slow which sucks because the very few times we did see our waiter, he was so friendly!! Just wish we could have saw more of him....and receive our drinks/food in a timely matter :(

We opted out of staying in downtown Nashville to save on costs, but we should have just stayed downtown bcuz this hotel is not cheap at all and is in the ghetto.

There is nothing around there to eat, you need to drive pretty far.  :-/ We were disappointed.  

The bathrooms smelled really bad the entire time, like strong wellwater.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The Starbucks app is great, gives great discounts and rewards. The menu is still WAY Overpriced! Great food and drinks but some of the coffees that they serve is alright. Overall it's a great place to study and, grab a cup of coffee on the go. I definitely recommend it.

I put $20 dollars on a card, dried two loads, then when I tried the card again it just said "error." This business owes me $16, but they have no phone number or email by which to contact them. This is easily the most unsatisfactory experience I've had with any business, as this is the first one that has outright robbed me.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Amazing experience. I have to admit I'm not all that into sushi but my friend was. I was NOT disappointed! He ate salmon sashimi and I had Eel and avocado! Also shrimp tempura roll. Everything was delicious and very easy on the eyes! Presentation was delightful. Friendly staff. Average prices. YUM!

Stopped in here for breakfast as I had errands in the area.  Coffee was weak.  The eggs and bacon were fine.  The potato pancakes seemed like they were preformed frozen product; I would not order those again.  The waitresses work hard but the place feels oppressive and tired.  I gave it one star to be kind.

Fast and friendly service.  My grandson said the chicken quesadilla was a 10.  I had the chicken fajitas. Nice sized portion, but the chicken was way over cooked.  The rice and beans were very good.  Margarita was a little watery.  All in all average.   Prices are a little high.

The band was great but the service was horrific. We stood at the bar with several other people for over 20 minutes while being completely ignored. The one male bartender just chatted with a friend and the woman didn't give us the time of day. Several of us gave up and left.

I really like this gym. Its new but they work hard to keep it clean. There are many choices in equipment and classes. Plus the place is 24 hours! 
I wish it had a place to swim but the sauna and infrared massage kind of compensate. And for the cost I feel it is well worth it.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Updated review: What a shame. This place has really gone downhill.  I no longer go here because the pizza is usually burnt and dried out to the point of not even wanting to waste the calories. America's Pie is the only decent place in West Chester for pizza.

Pleasantly surprised at the quality of food and ambiance. The staff was courteous and knowledgeable and the food was excellent . The kids loved the calamari and I enjoyed the grouper which was cooked perfectly. The potatoes au gratin was the best I ever had! Excellent wine selection too! I will be back

I've had several transactions with The Tire Pros -- buying tires and flat repair. They are always professional and friendly, do great work, sell good quality tires, and turn things around fast. I've been very impressed with these guys, another enthusiastic recommendation!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Hotel was nice, front desk a little slow. Rooms are nice. Tiki bar by the beach/pool was convenient but drinks were awful, everything is overly sweet and they are using cheap liquor (though bottles say differently). Fortunately, there are better places to stay in Clearwater and will visit the other options if/when we return.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went here the other day and asked for no tomato. My sandwich still had a tomato on it. No big deal. Just took the tomato off and ate it. Went back today and asked for the same thing. This time they left the tomato and took off the lettuce....beginning to question if the guy in the back can read.

Stopped by this location yet again! Delicious, fresh fruit, tons of toppings to choose from and the most delicious frozen yogurt ever! Staff is super friendly and helpful! Location is very clean. Sanitizer and gloves currently available. Outdoor seating also an excellent option!

Doughnuts are awesome and delicious. Dunkin are not that great, but are still doughnuts so I'll give a 3 star. Usually too dry and not worth the price. Coffee is also not great. Flavors are kinda weird too. Definitely not my first choice but i will still eat if available.

I wanted something quick, but I couldn't eat meat. I saw that they offered honey shrimp for addition $1.29. My total ended being $10 something. I thought it was a little pricey since, but it's whatever. I just didn't like the fact the coworker said, "well you wanted shrimp so you gotta pay extra".

The pizza was decent, but not spectacular. I had a slice of goat cheese/onion/bacon that was particularly good.  However, my girlfriend got a slice of sausage/pepper that was pretty horrible, way too spicy/oily with little flavor.  Hit or miss place.  Also, they don't have cups of ice, what's up with that!?'

I'd give it 5 stars but for some inconsistency with the pizzas.    The crusts can vary considerably in thickness from visit to visit.  We prefer thin.  And sometimes they are just too thick and bready.  If you don't care and like both equally, you'll give it 5.

My daughter and I went in and got a mani and pedi. It was good during. Atmosphere was good. we waited 20 minutes after our apt time, that was frustrating. 1 week later the "GEL" decoration was coming off my nails and one of my daughters gel polishes came off a finger.

Just save your time and money and pick another nail place. The nail tech was so aggressive and electric filed my nails paper thin. She took no time to make the shape look good and the paint job was sloppy. I don't write these reviews but this was needed. DO NOT GO HERE

Went here in an attempt to escape the rain. When we walked it I was taken back by the outdated decor, but our waitress was a young lady that did a great job! Also, our food did not take that long to come out and was good! My friend and I both enjoyed what we ordered.

Oh Sahm's place is amazing . We moved to the area last year and the previous homeowners left us a note with suggestions for places to eat . Sahm's was top of the list and they weren't wrong ! Good food, beer, and casual setting. Nice place to go hang out with friends and enjoy drinks and comfort food.

When you try to explain to them that you don't want to cancel your contract, you just don't want it to renew they don't listen and just cancel it anyways and you end up having to pay a cancellation fee. If you want desk people that will listen to what you're saying don't go here.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I placed a pick up order yet I get there and the order was never put into the system...they forgot the pancake extras, a biscuit (which my toddler didnt let me forget that part for quite some time after eating lol)
first experience there that I was actually let down about :/

Chinese Gourmet Express at WestShore Plaza in Tampa is a great place to stop for quick and delicious Chinese food when you are hungry and need something fast. The food here is fresh and flavorful. I have been happy with all of the orders that I have made from here.

The Westshore Grand, A Tribute Portfolio Hotel on Kennedy Boulevard in Tampa is a great hotel that has much to offer and is in the middle of everything. I really like the rooftop pool and the views from the rooms. The staff here is very friendly and accommodating to make sure that you have everything that you need for the best stay
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Got an iced latte instead of frozen for the first time and it was delicious!! I had been going to Starbucks for years and years but I travel to the north east frequently where dunking is dominant. It may be more carbs/calories than starbucks but in my taste way better.

Omg this place is straight up beautiful and brand new. Everything about it is perfect as you can expect. I don't like the fact that it's always all showers in new hotels but it has a very nice modern feel to it. Will definitely stay here again soon. The breakfast was amazing also.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place is honestly the best hidden gem of Brandon area. The pesto chicken pasta is to die for. Amazing deep dish pizza I just can't get over how delicious it is. We only do take out but as soon as you walk in you can smell the yummy Italian food. Their staff is very sweet and helpful.

I have used Miller for years for all of our many vehicles and they are always reliable, informative and thorough.  They always call a week or two after they work on my vehicle to check in and make sure everything is still going well...unheard of customer care in this day and age!

Thank you to all the staff at Miller!:-)
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Went here yesterday with 2 future co-workers.  It was pretty good.  I got the nachos.  They had a lot of flavor and were huge.  One friend got a burrito and one got  carne tacos.  Everyone enjoyed their meal.  I would go here again.  See attached photographs for more detail.  I could have used more  salsa for my chips and nachos.

I'm originally from Philly so I know steak sandwiches. Penn Station does a decent steak sandwich -- but a few select places in Indy do it better. Their sandwiches are tasty & prepared fast -- but just lacks something -- maybe it's the bread, maybe it's the way they cook it in an oven vs on a grill...

The monthly memberships are a great deal. Anytime I need a vacuum, or my wheels get dirty I run the car through here and they give you a dashboard rag, air freshener, and towel to dry everything down. It's quick and easy. Probably won't be using it as much in the winter but I go 2 times a week easy when it's nice out!

The sushi tasted good and fresh at the time of eating it. However, it caused both my husband and I to be constipated for almost more than 2 days. We were each nauseous and could barely eat anything for a while. I truly haven't been the same since and am scarred from eating sushi for a while

Arrived at 7 for dinner was told we could wait but we probably wouldn't get a seat because the people currently sitting at the tables (and no longer eating) were staying for the show(which started at 9). And no you can't make reservations unless you are a party of 10. Super.

As expected, we called right at five to order, and still had a 45 minute wait. 

Always worth it for the Bazils Special.  I showed up five early and it had just come out of the oven. 
They work hard in there. 

My only spot for pizza take out. 

CASH ONLY.

Always a great service.  Very friendly staff, quality washes at a reasonable price. They offer a basic and a "do it all" option and a pick your pieces option.  The vacuum area is worth coming to even with a wash.  It offers hoses on both sides of the car so your not dragging the dirty hose across your seats.

I was pleasantly surprised by this hotel. Very clean, reciently updated and who knew?!?  Some of the suites have a jacuzzi tub in the room. Great for a bit of relaxation away from the kiddos in a hot jacuzzi with a movie. Front desk was great with allowing for a last minute late check out. Would recomend for sure
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I have been eating sushi since I was 5 years old. I am from NYC and have experienced some of the best sushi. This places beats them all. I am hesitant to write the review because it will get busy and I won't be able to get in, but they deserve a stellar review. I love their fish - it's hard to go anywhere else.

I've had good previous experiences with them.  Apparently, they've changed their name and I guess under different owner.  Got a simple sweet and sour chicken = over cooked and tough.   Fried rice was good.  Maybe it's just this one time but it was very disappointing.

We loved this rooftop bar and restaurant.  We both got steaks.  I got the wago and my wife got the Australian 6 oz with truffle butter.  Hers was better but both were amazing.  The service was amazing and all of the extras we got where awesome.  We wait right at the edge, the view was great.  Highly recommend.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Hands down, the best burritos I have had in Indy!!!! I crave their burritos EVERYDAY! The chicken and steak burritos are to die for! Well seasoned, meat not over cooked, made to order, and great ingredients. If you haven't tried this place out, you are definitely missing out on some savory, delicious food!

As someone who takes pizza very seriously, I can't say enough positive things about Snap. The staff is always friendly, the ingredients are always fresh, and they make it easy to customize your meal to build the superior pizza of your dreams. 10/10 would Snap again.

This place is good for a quick, cheap lunch if you work in Center City. Staff is less than helpful, and they pick up your slice with their (unwashed) hands. I only go when I don't wanna shell out $8 at honeygrow or Chipotle. Heads up: they only have pizza and salad.

The Food at this McDonald's is good.  I always get my food nice and hot.  The only thing that makes this location bad is the fact that the service is horrible.  You place your order and sometimes have to wait 10 minutes just to get your food.  Even when there is no line.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Great little place on one of the main drags in Manayunk, definitely family friendly and relaxed. We got the sushi for two platter, which had a little kick due to tiny bits of wasabi hidden throughout (loved that). Bring a good bottle of white wine and enjoy!

Worst car wash ever!  I've given them chance after chance & they continue to disappoint. I spend another 20 minutes cleaning the inside once they're done. Then to top it off the waiting are reeks of cigarette smoke. I couldn't even sit in there the last time I went. I will NOT be going back there.

I usually go here for some late night, after work, cravings. I never go in during the last hour, and tonight was no different. But man y'all could have just told me you didn't have chili dogs ready. Otherwise, the Bug Buford, fries and drink were all great. I appreciate what you guys put out, but this is whack man

Not a good experience. The bartender/waitress was more interested in doing shots, with what I assume were regulars. After finally placing our order she insisted that we cash out so she could leave. Not very friendly. The food was okay, I had the BLT and my brother tried the shrimp tacos. Wouldn't recommend.

This place is really good.  We had garlic cheese bread for an appetizer.  The toasted ravioli is the best that I have had.  Baked spaghetti is to die for and the manicotti is really good as well.  The staff is friendly and it is a comfortable atmosphere.  We will definitely be back.

We tried this restaurant for dinner. It was nothing special, just cheesesteak and cheese fries. But the customer service was wonderful & friendly. They said about 30 minuted for delivery and that's how long it took. They called when they were at the house. They were quick and order was correct.

This is the best sushi around. I am not sure if they will ever open up for dine in, since they are doing a great take out business. They have a fantastic sushi happy hour! I can't say enough about the quality of their rolls. We go at least once a week and have never been disappointed!!!

No reminders of appointments. No check in phone calls . They claim most costs are included in plan , yet somehow every time I go I pay extra out of pocket.As long as you pay monthly they just take your money and forget about you . I will be transferring Hospitals

Always very slow service and order is  always wrong. Staff is rude even though they got the order wrong. Sat   at the drive thru for at least 10 minutes before pulling away. My coffee did not taste like usual so I asked them to remake it and they became rude.

Check out my double stack from Wendy's.  They are missing a stack.   Other wise the food was good lunch rush on a hot Friday afternoon but I'm missing a burger patty.   I will give them another chance.  I got two 4 for 4 deals which are still a great value!

I really want to like this hotel I really do but some key things are missing. 1.-No microwave 2.-no refrigerator. As someone who traveled from out of town with food it sucks that I can't hear it up or put it in the refrigerator. I hope they add both In the future. It would make this place so much better!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Love this place for photos and a GIRLS NIGHT OUT! The drinks were very pretty and tasty, but the food was quiteeeee small on the other hand, despite the hefty price. I recommend getting food before coming here! Follow me on IG: @piggieats_ for more reviews!

Probably one of my favorite places to have my delicates and coat dry cleaned at. Prices were very reasonable as a t-shirt would be around 5.50 and a long coat would be around 12.50. They were able to remove the stain on my satin dress which is why I also highly recommend this place.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I got kicked of here the other day, I fell asleep in the soup. My narcolepsy kicked in and my grandson wouldn't get me my medication. My hoveround also moved way too slow. The only reason this place gets three stars is because of the glory hole in the men's bathroom.

Decent coffee house. Main area is mostly clean. Today's wasn't as packed as it's usually is. Restroom needs some TLC. I usually get the La Freeze just just for the flavor. The music isn't loud which is a plus. The internet works fine at this location. Had a pleasant time today.

A simple Puccinos. I typically come here once a week. The wifi works majority of the time. Coffee is constant. Always ask for a primo for the extra kick. Deserts options always seems fresh. Clean restrooms at this location. Parking tends to get tight at times. The barista is nice.

Checking out as I type. Enjoyed our overnight late Valentines day stay. Breakfast buffet included in the price, heated indoor pool, and nice sized jacuzzi. I will say we were displeased with the fact that the banister to the jacuzzi was broken. It was mentioned to front desk, then removed. Would stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Normally I do not have a good experience here. Partially due to me because I come by within an hour of them closing . However today the woman running the drive though was very nice, she was friendly and looked me in the eye when we spoke. I would give 1/5 stars but that one kind interaction raises my rating to 3/5.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The holy grail of beer bars in South Philly. Both the burger and veggie burger are immaculate. Always got something rare and delicious on draft, but I usually go for Hill Farmstead, Tonewood, or Tired Hands. Dudes who work there are very chill and Cassie is the sweetest most interesting bartender to chat with, she's the best.

A pretty decent hotel. Location was less than ideal, not really able to walk anywhere that I planned to, but that is partly on me for not checking the area prior.

All in all good service and a very clean and spacious hotel. Definitely catered toward the extended stay crowd, so not as many amenities as a normal hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I am not ashamed! I come by the drive through JUST for a vanilla ice cream cone. I am convinced though that they have changed their formula because it is now more of a frozen yogurt consistent and color. Where as before it was more creamy and white vanilla. Maybe it's just me... but i need answers.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
If we lived in the area we would certainly become regulars at the Menagerie - the name in itself .! I just adore it. 
The Staff was friendly, the restaurant was clean , and the latte was delicious. Plus I got a heart foam floater. My favorite : ) Pop in and warm up with one of their cups !

Review only for Reading Terminal location*

We went there on a Monday around 3pm. No line, yay! Ordered & got food in about 5mins. They chop up the meat fresh to order. Always ask for extra sauce all over. It was good but Chinatown location is so much better! Based on getting it To-go for from both locations.

What an amazing experience.  It was my first time renting a car for my own use and Dwayne could not have been more amazing.  Prompt, friendly and efficient service.  Will be using this specific location moving forward.  Thank you for making it such an easy & painless transaction.

Ew. Inside was decent, but the outside area smelled like urine and there were multiple people walking around barefoot or sleeping in the chairs. I sat down without realizing that I was actually sitting in a chair that stank of  dried pee. Never going back there.

I got shrimp in lobster sauce, there were 3 shrimp in it. The shrimp were tasty but the sauce was basically water and corn syrup, gross! Also, the crab fried rice was burnt rice and the crab was disgusting and mushy slices of whatever fake "crab" they use.

Food was yummy, service was friendly.  My burger was one if the best I've had in awhile.  I could tell it was made by hand, not a machine.  It was tender and tasty.  Also, properly cooked.  We live in this area and are excited to have a new place for casual meals.

It is a small pub style restaurant located on a Lederach golf course.  Atmosphere is casual with pub style food and a few entree's.  Good for casual dining.  Food is good but not exceptional.  Conveniently located on route 113 in the Harleysville/Hatfield area.

Was in Kenner, LA looking for something outside the box and came across The Big Cheezy. Was greeted warmly and provided assistance trying to figure out what to order. I ordered the Crawfish Grilled Cheese and Tomato Pesto Soup. Both were great. I would definitely return to try other menu items too.

AWFUL! My husband went and got me a chai latte, walked to the hotel(across the street), took a dip and it was cold and coffee based.  Went back- waited over 30 minutes to get it made and again- made with coffee.   Went back and the guy tells me "that is how we were told to make it.  VERY DOUBTFUL! Chai is tea and coffee is not‍

Waited an hour for food. Service is terrible.   No chips, nothing.  Come here during the week the food  is good but it you can't handle the weekend. You need to hire more people or put less tables.  In the end the food comes and is missing the stuff I ordered.

Very nice local diner. Brenda was very attentive and friendly. Nice to find a place that's open 24hrs with reasonably priced food!. Ordered the gyro which also came with fries. Gyro was nothing too special but not bad either. Fries were actually more like steak fries which they gave you a large portion of.

Ive been coming here for a little over a year or so and I'll be honest this shop is great! They have always been honest and real with me. Never seem to rip me off. They'll tell me if something is worth fixing or not. They always accommodate me and my crazy schedule! Highly recommend this shop!

Why 3 stars? Because I LOVE Bern's dessert room and had really high hopes for this shop. The ice cream is FANTASTIC - very similar quality to the actual desert room, but the deserts themselves were underwhelming. Don't get me wrong, I will be back, but if you have time, do yourself a favor and go to the actual desert room.

Probably the best Crab Rangoon I've ever had from anywhere. Hands down. I wasn't a huge fan of the General Tso's Chicken--it almost tasted like a strange BBQ sauce. I'm also not a fan of the fact that they're cash only. I rarely if ever carry cash on me but they at least have an ATM inside if you're willing to pay the service fee.

Hands down best chinese food in the area!  The couple that run it are always pleasant and they are really quick in preparing your meal - especially when you dine in.

The wonton soup is easily the best ive had anywhere, and the beef teriyaki is delicious!

You pretty much cant go wrong with anything on the menu - its all amazing!

It is mediocre Japanese food. The price is high but not the quality. I have lived in Japan and tried many different Japanese restaurants in and outside Tucson. I probably will not come back here. There are much better options in town: Sushi on Oracle, hands down the best, on Oracle; Obon in Downtown; Ginza on the way side...

I needed to find a quality auto service for a Benz truck type SUV with mid-high miles.  I found a Great family owned business. Had an A1 oil change as well as new front brakes.  Both prices and quality beat dealership standards. Thanks...now I can balance luxury and affordability as well as longevity.

The recently opened middle eastern food  cafe at the back of the store is about as good as you will find. Everything is made fresh and the prices are very reasonable. Adam runs the kitchen and is the nicest guy... and takes great pride in what he does. Plus it's healthy for you :-)

Great service and charming staff but the custard is meh. I threw mine away and my kids and husband finished theirs but didn't think it was very good. It has an artificial creamy consistency - like extra creamy cool whip, not like extra creamy real dairy dessert. There is a lot of good custard out but this doesn't make the mark.

Do not bank here - without any notice, they charged two of my grandchildren $5 per month for a year because their custodial account went under $300 and they turned 18??????  No notice, no email,no letter.  Had these accounts since they were born!!!  
 
Called other banks, and they do not have that rule, only TD.
goodbye TD

I had a great experience today at Halo. I came in for long layers and to cut some inches off to freshen up my hair. Madison did a great job helping me add volume and movement! She, along with everyone at the salon, was extremely professional and kind. I will definitely be coming back!

The tiki bar/Chinese food restaurant reviews are spot on! I wish I would have snapped a pic of the waterfall in the entry way, sorry... It was totally what we were in the mood for! Got the pot stickers, broccoli beef and general chicken, SO GOOD! (No buffet?) We will be back, maybe for karaoke night ;-)

I wanted to stop by to get a cup of Cafe Du Monde before a Plantation tour but only had a few minutes so I opted for the closeby PJ's coffee. Service was good but coffee was average at best. I am very particular about my coffee, particularly the dark roast. This place didn't do it for me.

Really disappointing. The service was fast and friendly, but the food...ugh. Thankfully I had a coupon, but wow. I remember why it's been almost 20 years since I've eaten there now. I had the original chicken sandwich. It came with wilted, shredded lettuce in the center of the sandwich, and a blob of mayonnaise.

Ordered 1 taco 1 enchilada 1 tamale combination plate. I wasn't impressed. The tamale was awful, very bland, and very dry. The taco meat was bad too, as were the soggy taco shells. The enchilada was the same bland, dry meat as the taco except caked in half melted cheese. Sadly, I don't have a single positive about this meal.

Franzone's has good food. I had their pizza and their cheesesteaks. Both are very good. I noticed how the pizza has a different type of flavor for the sauce. That may be what sets them apart from others I have tried. I've been here a few times and will return.

I finally got around to trying the Chicago deep dish around my birthday and I think I'll just stick to my regular old New York style because I've come to find out that Chicago deep dish just has way too much sauce for my liking. But it was absolutely delicious though it's just not my style of pizza.

Stopped in because my wife's feet hurt. Had a couple of "solid" margaritas. The bartender (Donna?) was super personable with the folks at the bar, carrying on multiple conversations. We sat at one of the tables and watched the people stroll by on a Friday night. Older crowd, quiet bar.

How can you hand the cashier your phone with a coupon on it and they don't notice the price didn't change. Because the don't care but I'm afraid it's the area not just BK. THERE IS NO PRIDE IN WORK AROUND HERE. 

Asked for unsweetened tea and get tea out of a fountain machine. Sorry but that tea sucks.

Happy to have Lou's in Indy. The Windy City is our second home and due to the circumstances this year we decided to stay in Indiana. It's great to have the taste of Chicago in Indianapolis. We ordered online and asked for curbside pickup. The process is seamless and the food is solid.

A friend and I grabbed a quick lunch at Piada today. I ordered the Chicken BLT for my meal this afternoon. The staff was friendly and it only took a couple of minutes for our order to be ready. I wrap was big enough that I could barely finish it. Overall this place is great if you are looking for a quick bit to eat.

Walked in.. Didn't take too long for a sweet to come over. They were super nice and moderately attentive. I got the fish sandwich which was delicious and my partner got a meatball stromboli which she loved. Impressive joint for a plaza :) I'd recommend it for sure.

What can you say, this is Baskin-Robins. It's America, so forget about the price and indulge. We also bought a hand packed quart of bubblegum on the way out, can't get it anywhere else.  My Moosetracks rocked, also best chocolate and peanut butter of anywhere.  Also, I downloaded the App, lots of deals there.

Its 2019.
It's absolutely unacceptable that you cant go eat at this place for a party of 1. I attempted to order 4 chicken wings, fried rice, and homemade tea. Came up to 8.91, they require a $10 minimum to use a credit card. I order from here all the time but just happened to stop in for lunch. Never again.

Poor service, long wait for our order to arrive, food was below average. I paid $2 more for a wet burrito and was treated to lukewarm canned enchilada sauce and a few shreds of cheese. Our hostess was attentive, drinks and chips were refilled promptly however it didn't make up for the lousy food and the 45min wait.

Ambiance, great food, and warm, accommodating service. Moorestown has a winner! Everything about this place is on point. The passion and pride is evident with every single bite. It's BYOB, so grab a bottle of something nice and head over to Megu. (The musical selections offer a fun twist! From Motown to authentic Japanese).

I came here several times during freshmen year to try the California burrito and the carne asada fries. In all honesty being someone that has tried nearly a hundred different taco shops a was not much of a fan of eating at this place. The salsa was always a hassle to ask for and the food was over priced for the quality given.

The past 3 times I have been there the coffee has tasted terrible, not fresh. The staff doesn't say a word to you, just takes your payment and hands you your coffee while talking amongst themselves. It's unfortunate because I live so close to this location.

This location is the worst. Customers are always lined up 8 deep and the workers ignore the line. They are more concerned with drive through than in store. When they do wait on you they are rude. Evidently they need more help. Even though we were staying at the hotel next door we wouldnt return. Go anywhere else.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Caesar salad was good. Naked wings was pretty good too. But the pizza hmmmmm not so good. Tomato sauce was super runny to the point that it made the whole pizza wet n soggy. Service was good though . I'll come back for the naked wings n service but not the pizza

I believe the staff is stealing money. I was told cash only.  When asked why the cashier said because it was after 8pm. I've been eating McDonald's all my life and never heard of any rules like that. I was left with no choice but to leave bc I only had debit.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place has one of the best pizzas in the area. Their buffalo chicken pizza is phenomenal. You can choose from four different flavors of sauces. Delivery is usually about 45 minutes, but it comes hot everytime. I would highly recommend this place. It's starting to become the only place I go to for pizza anymore.

Paid $20 and got a plain vanilla car wash.  They didn't even wipe down the console.  It was pretty poor customer service and the English speaking manager, Stanley, basically defended the crappy job performed by his workers.  I will find a better place to go.  Not fun to feel fleeced.

Went there for a graduation dinner. Pam, our waitress, was lovely.  Brandon was helpful pulling off a dessert surprise. The meal was great: chicken parm, pizza, lasagna, penne with vodka sauce and meatballs.  Good salad too.  The tiramisu was still frozen ~ hopefully they will let it thaw a bit next time.  We'll definitely be back!

I used to go to this place all the time when I was craving a good Authentic Mexican meal. I haven't been there since covid hit, but finally made a return. They moved!!! They now have a bigger space and a slightly different menu. All in all great meal and will be back.

Great produce and fair enough prices. I like this place better than Fresh Grocer except for the cashiers. The cashiers are extremely rude. No greetings, smiles or small talk. One practically threw my groceries down the belt. This place would've great if they worked on their customer service skills.

The service is really not that great, nor is the food. 
The convenience of it being the most local sushi restaurant was the only thing that kept me coming. 
However, I've accepted the fact that if I wanted to be satisfied with my meal, I wouldn't necessarily go here.

Awesome GNO - Chef Luigi never disappoints!  From the infamous rice balls to the fork tender veal scallopini-  everything was delicious - homemade Italian bread - homemade sauces & desserts!   Ingredients do matter & they are skilled crafted into deliciousness by the chef.  Highly recommended & a true dining delight!

Pizza delivery tonight. Quick service, great pizza! We've ordered pizza here many times and it's consistently good and delivered in under half an hour. The staff is always polite and helpful. The large pizza is HUGE and they send a coupon for free garlic knots each time.

Nice coffee spot walking distance from my apartment. Can't really feel the vibe here but I had a salad and it was well put together I also had a Mint tea and asked for extra sweetener and the guy mad snarky lol I would def come back though just with my own sugar lol.

Steve did a great job diagnosing and fixing my '99 Jeep Grand Cherokee...and Jeep owner knows that you never know what's wrong with your Jeep and any given moment.  Steve came out, identified the problem, told me how much it would be to fix it, and then did it.  Honest in his pricing and service.  Thanks!

First time trying this place and they did excellent! Super impressed. I got the ultimate wash where the armor all the interiors and my car looks brand new. They didn't skip out on the cup holders or dash either! Vacuuming was great too especially since I have a furry dog. Only about 20-30 minute wait.

Pretty mediocre experience. Walls are thin, could hear my neighbors' kids before 7 AM. Housekeeping kept "forgetting" to come. Could not turn on the heat on a very frigid weekend in FL. The complementary breakfast was the only saving grace, good mix of options.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Half hour to wash my car, $18, and I STILL have to wipe down vast swaths of my dash board?!  Come on guys!   I'm not sure if it's lack of trying, or bad products and vacuums or what.  I pay someone to wash my car inside and out. Not mostly wash it so I have to finish it up later.  Makes sense why I only visit them once a year.

The renting process was smooth and the car was clean. When we dropped off the car and were waiting for the shuttle, the entire drop off area and waiting area was filled with trash from wrappers to plastic bottles and all the garbage cans in the drop off area were overflowing. No pride in keeping anything clean and nice looking.

Debbie always knows how to create the look I want. I show her a picture of the color/cut I want and she works her magic. I never expect to have the identical color/cut as the picture bc I'm aware everyone's hair is different. I've never left Salon D unhappy. Thank you, Debbie :)
