Deliciously decadent frozen yogurt. The service is always prompt and courteous. But, expect to pay what seems a bit more than what a frozen treat might be at another popular dessert shop.

Overall, I think Annie's is worth the extra cost. They have a selection of flavors and always serve with a smile.

We have been Jeni's fans since they opened their location in Brentwood. However, during the covid, we have done some pickup of various flavors and unfortunately they come extremely under-filled. For 12$ a pint, 1/4 of it was empty jar. Extremely disappointed. See attached picture.

Went through the drive through here got a glazed donut and a coffee for what I paid I was seriously disappointed!I felt i donut that got smashed in The Pa Turnpike it was that bad they need to up their game or I won't be back!Coffee B was pretty bad also I can do better job with my Keurig!

Great ambiance and customer service but the cost does not match the quality of service. I'm willing to pay extra for a fabulous hair style and timely appointment but unfortunately both me and my mother paid nearly $100 for a style cut (two different operators) and neither of us were satisfied with the end product.

I'm so bummed that the new employees don't really seem to care about their customers. The coffee tastes vary depending on who makes it. 

I need consistency so we moved on. 

Has great potential if they can deliver better customer service and consistent coffee recipes.

Good selection so far. They definitely have the room to expand more, and would hopefully add more taps. I am not familiar with New Orleans laws, but I know my local CBC does growler and crowler fills. Hopefully this location is allowed to do that so I can take home some more rare beers next time!

These "authentic" tacos are trash. They have no taste whatsoever! And they charge you to use your debit/credit card. The tacos are too expensive for lacking taste. And anyone who has given them 4 stars are probably suburban kids who have never tasted authentic tacos in LA. Absolutely trash.

Very pleasant coffee shop. Trendy vibes. Clean. Very friendly and attentive staff. I was quickly served. Lots of seating and I noticed it was dog friendly. I got a dirty chai latte and an apple fritter and it was $8. I was there only for a few minutes, but it was all around very pleasant experience.

Love the tom yum soup because it is full of yummy scallop and shrimp with a nice spice.
The sushi rolls are a little disappointing.  Today I ordered the yellowtail roll and they clearly skimped on the amount of fish.  Even at half price they were disappointing.

As far as the lunch combo goes, disappointing. Most other places include soup or salad and a small portion of vegi temperas or Cali rolls but here, nothing is included so we didn't go for it. We ended up ordering a combo dish. Quality of sashimi is good. I wasn't impressed with their choices.

Spur of the moment pull off the highway and stay for the night. Wow, new pool amazing outdoor setting and a very clean room. I stay at a lot of hotels they are going out of their way to make us feel safe! The best part is Melissa at the bar/ restaurant, she might be the most friendly person in Nashville!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Honestly, it was good. But for me it wasn't worth the price ($25 for 5 ravioli). This is mostly my fault since I am vegetarian and there were not many options... Fun and fancy for a special night, but I won't go back.

Although, whatever they brought with the focaccia at the beginning was everything.

My spot for tacos forsure ! I went with the tacos this time: chicken, fish, steak, pork, and beef. The quality of meat is good and all juicy. Extremely cheap !!!!!!!!! You will be full after your meal. They load the tacos with protein. Don't forget to ask for the green salsa for on top

We take both of our dogs here and have really liked the crew. We've used a couple of different vets in Nashville and KSAH has been significantly cheaper than the others and has been great quality of care for our pets. Being in Kingston Springs they've also been able to get our dogs in same or next day when we've called.

47 years in business?   Ha!  You bought a reputable practice from Dr Dalo who was amazing, what-two years ago.  You also fired most of the staff and hired I'll-equipped workers except a few.  You've only had your license since 2014.  So how can you say 47 years in business?  The negative Yelp reviews speak volumes.

Great experience.  I had Robyn and I'd have to say that she is a hair artist!  Don't go to her for a quick hair cut.  She takes her time and is perfect.  The exact hair cut needed for being in need for months.  Make sure you go on line and get an appointment but you can't go wrong and you'll not go to the chain places anymore.

Really sparse choices in the Emerald Aisle on this Monday morning.  Mostly minivans (ugh)..  The Hyundai I ended up with was fine, but as I was pulling out, I noticed a faint smoking odor.  It wasn't overpowering, but it lasted the full 3 days and was a constant irritation.

Went with a small group for dinner, would be good for big parties as well. Ambiance was great, busy but our server and staff was very attentive.
We shared a few appetizers, it was ok. But we all enjoyed our entrees, you can never go wrong with the pastas. By the end of the dinner

I live near this restaurant so we go quite often.  It isn't as good as it was a few years ago, very popular and quite expensive. 
Sometimes you have to wait for your ordered food for a long time. The place is too small to have any more wait staff. 
The variety is maybe too great and therefore, has lost it's special magic.

I should have checked Yelp before ordering from this Subway. I ordered and paid for my meal online and went to pick it up and they didn't have it, then said they had to call their boss. I had the receipt showing I paid for it. Anyway, they ultimately figured it out.

Employees were disrespectful to say the least. An employee Kayla, thew any sides back into the cubbies, had the worst attitude and preceded to yell for what else I wanted in my sandwich. Not only that, to top it off, they don't know how to cut or make the sandwiches.

During my visit this McDonald's was undergoing construction and the dine in option was closed. This resulted in long lines at the drive thru. Despite this, staff were friendly and positive. Turning left out of the location is a challenge because it's so close to the red light. Overall - no complaints.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Disappointed would be the word I would use to describe my experience. This is a glorified motel that is used for overflow of the Gaylord resort. The air in my room was awful, room had a funky smell, and  shower head was low (and I'm short). This place is not a location I'd voluntarily choose to return.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Alot of people where talking about the pizza so I decided to try it out to me it was just regular pizza nothing special about it at all but it wasn't bad I guess you could say it's a change from the traditional pizza that you would get at the bigger chains but a little more pricey

Been going here since i was like 14, so that's almost 20 years. i've tried other salons and i always come back to them. Vy, the daughter, is so kind and really knows her stuff. Tina is so gentle and creative, any design i want she executes, and she's a brow magician.

Have been here a few times and always get super hot and fresh food. The restaurant is new and clean and man do they have an operation going on in the kitchen. Impressive to watch what they have going on when picking up my food. Love the portions and prices! Always feel like there is so much for leftovers!

Ordered delivery and it arrived quicker than estimated arrival time. Packaging was great, had a seperate little container for the soy sauce which was a nice touch. The sushi roll (cracker roll) and tuna sashimi tasted fresh. Everything looked great. Will definitely be saving this as a place to re-order from in the future!

Love Surprises.  Ate dinner there with my family on a Saturday evening.  No Complaints at all.  Kids had burgers and hot wings, we had entrees of Scallops over Risotto. Everything was very good.  Great view 
The Lambertville Inn needed some competition and I think we found it.

Very good food. Kids love the variety. Always fresh tasting. Eat as much as you want. You can either sit at the hibachi table or not, it's up to you but you can still have hibachi either way. Kids love the egg rolls and yummy yummy roll. Lunch is a great deal, best time to try it out. Be prepared to wait, there's always a wait.

This place is always slow! I refuse to waste my gas in their ridiculous drive through line, but also the wait inside is just as long! The employees seem miserable and have such visible attitude towards each other. We got our food to go, which included no napkins and silverware was not included. How am I supposed to eat a salad?

Great coffee spot in center city . Their coffee roasts are amazing; smooth and flavorful. Their matcha latte is also great! A little pricey but basically on par with what you'd pay anywhere else in Philly. Also the spot is beautiful, I've only been here post covid but it looks like a great study spot .

Went to Gallagher's for lunch today. Ordered kentucky hot chicken sliders and special fries. Was very good! Not hot enough for me... But that's personal opinion. The fries were garlic parm... Delish. Our waitress was very good and inventive. Will def be going again!

This McDonald's was clean newly renovated and the staff was polite and helpful, I do not normally eat McDonald's I haven't since they had a dollar menu how many years ago? However I needed to get breakfast before work and it was on the way to work thank you guys I still won't be back LOL
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Went in for beer and chips, duh, but they do not price their beer? I had to ask the guy behind the counter every price which is totally inefficient. Its a shame, they have a large selection but I'm not interested in getting gouged at checkout for a lousy six-pack.

Cute coffee shop inside the Thompson Hotel. It's well decorated, but there's a not a ton of space. 

I got the Flat White and it was perfect to-go. They still go out of their way to do milk art with it. They have a great selection of both coffee and pastries. Wish I had time to sit down and try some!

If I could give this place a 0 I would. The clerks here are beyond rude and the security guard that was working today 8.18.19 was completely rude and awful. The store really needs to enforce some good manners! I have never been rushed or told to hurry up or told I was going to be locked in if I didn't hurry. Unbelievable!!

If I could give this place a 0 I would. The clerks here are beyond rude and the security guard that was working today 8.18.19 was completely rude and awful. The store really needs to enforce some good manners! I have never been rushed or told to hurry up or told I was going to be locked in if I didn't hurry. Unbelievable!!

This place is simply amazing. The prices are great, the waiters/waitresses are really polite, and the atmosphere is the icing on the cake. What's better is it always smells good whenever I go. Highly recommended whether you want to go on a date or just grab take out.

I came here for a quite bite to eat on the run. I had a shrimp poboy with fries to go. I have had a lot better poboys in the area. It was amazing but it wasnt bad either. I would say just average. The staff was extremely nice though. It has a good dive diner atmosphere, if that is what you are looking for.

A good hotel located just north of downtown Nashville, Tennessee. Customer service was good, convenient location with several restaurants in walking distance, the beds were comfortable and the hotel was clean. Isn't this everything we are looking for in a hotel?

I would definitely stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Great sushi at a great price. Honestly we got 6 rolls and it was 30ish bucks. The menu is huge and the customization for the rolls are awesome I think next time I will get my spicy tuna roll fired lol! Next time my sushi  craving hits I will be coming back here!

On a recent visit to Nashville with some friends, we stumbled into this place after getting a bit tired of the butts-to-nuts bar scene on Broadway. Beer Sellar is, in my opinion, the perfect dive. Tons of great beers on tap, very mellow, and cool staff. Highly recommended. We'll definitely be back next time we're in town.

I'm rating this in context to the other taco shops in Tucson. First off it is a tad bit more expensive than the others. A plus for the pozole offered over the weekends. Tastes a little more fresh than other shops. Long drive-thru waits are the worst. Once they iron out that kink, I'd consider this a go-to place for mexican food.

It is very nice inside. I got the stuff veal chop, that was ok. I can't complain. The bread and peppers they brought out to the table was a little week but it wasn't bad. Note and it has nothing to do with the restaurant and that's parking. Depending on the time. You might have to park a few blocks down.

The Ambiance, gives very much rom-com! The service was great! The coffee was delicious, I finished before I even got to the car... next time I'll get less ice. The New Orleans Ice coffee is delicious! I definitely will be back to this spot for Coffe, croissants, and chill!

Part two review. First part was about first visit to Bosco's and how the nice lady made a GF pizza for my friend. She did everything by the book. 

Took it home she had it for dinner. Two hours later she was sick. For two days. 

DO NOT order a GF pizza from Bosco's.

Why do I try??? Mobile order. They didn't even know who I was and I specifically asked if it was ready as I had to pick up my son. They said yes. Now I sit here pulled over while I wait for my food. I said I was ready for my pick up 11 minutes ago and still waiting.....

The service was quick and friendly. The catfish was flavorful and juicy and the restaurant is super chill. Would have loved to have sit upstairs. The muffin cornbread hit in a certain type of way. I feel like the sides are meh but the meat makes up for it.

I could not expect better service or dining. This place is out of control with the food, ambiance, and experience. We had the best time at this hidden gem. The owner was beyond hospitable and customized everything for us. They were on top of everything and seemed to genuinely enjoy being here. I will definitely be back!

No complaints. Nice restaurant. Previous review said something about the restrooms.  Must have gotten fixed.  I had lunch sushi combo C and water to drink (5pc sushi- California and crunchy shrimp rolls / drank water - $10.87 before the tip.  I'll go back.

Finally found a vet that is compassionate and cares about your pets well being. We took our 8 year old rescued dachshund to get teeth extractions and a cleaning and it didn't cost us an arm and a leg! Reasonable pricing but most importantly amazing vets. We need more vet clinics like this in the Reno- Sparks area!

Overall: Good
Appetizer: Crab Rangoon- amazing 
House salad/dressing- amazing
Miso soup- high quality 
Entree: beef yakisoba- amazing 
Bento box- teriyaki salmon- amazing, spring rolls- good

Service: mediocre (easily distracted)

Sushi: fair. 

Dessert: cream brûlée- tasty but cold

Go for hibachi, skip the sushi

Amazing food and impeccable service! Decor is so-so but, the food is so spectacular you won't be looking anywhere but at your plate! Reservations not accepted so, it was great to be able to wait next door and comfortably enjoy wine while awaiting your table.

These people are scam artists.  Read the reviews you will find that Krass and Patel are thieves. Tried to cancel with 48 hours notice because I was hospitalized and they basically laughed at me and said tough shit we have your money and are not getting it back.

text:
I don't understand the hype... this place is mediocre at best. I guess when in the desert you get what you get.... 

A lot of the menu is fried - and with cream cheese? 

Happy hour is not offered you need to ask.... 

They don't accept AMEX ? 

Was not happy with the food nor the decor and ambiance- needs work

I've been going to Philadelphia Vision Center for many many years since they open they're the most honest place around and very kind and very helpful priest and the staff that works there are the one of the best around thank you for taking care of me all these years Bruce you're awesome

text: My wife an step daughter and waned ice cream and this place seemed close. Was very surprised when we got there and it wasn't real ice cream, but we tried it anyway. We all thought the same, it was creamy and had taste. Just didn't fill the spot. I'm sure for ppl on keto or other diets would enjoy this

We went here for a birthday party and I was impressed by the Vegan and Vegetarian selection.  Try the Veggie Crunch and Vegan Long Roll. My pescetarian friends had an assortment and the spicy tuna looked fresh.  Not sure on taste.  Staff were great to our crowd.

I have been here twice, once for a cut and once for a cut and highlights.  Both times I was with Brie and both times I was extremely happy with her work.  Unfortunately she has left, but I believe everyone working in this salon is great and they have a great atmosphere there!  will definitely go back!

The best selection of chimichangas in town right here. Service is always quick and it's great for large or small groups. Food and drink prices are very reasonable for the quantity. There are also coupons and groupons as well. I will say, overall it is pretty standard Mexican fare.

I try to like you, I do! But I end up disappointed every time. I want to be your friend but you make it so hard. 

Three bad experiences with click-list and you don't ever have everything I need- how is that in such a huge store?? 

Publix treats me well and fulfills all my needs. There's no debating - Publix is my boo.

The tacos are real tasty, so for that they get two stars. But what kind of self-respecting Mexican uses that 7/11 yellow "cheese sauce" on the goddamn nachos??? No comprende! Isn't that illegal or something? I bet they wouldn't serve me that crap if I was in the Los Zetas cartel.

Food- Excellent. The flavours were spot on, and the portions were smaller for the price but that was sort of expected. I didn't dislike anything I got.

Service- Attentive

Atmosphere- Cute very dim lit restaurant in the city. We sat at the chefs bar and it was fun watching them prepare food. Its pretty romantic feelin

Finally got to try me some White Castle out. Been eating her sister Krystals for years. The fries suck big time. The burgers have a little bit more flavor then Krystal burgers to me though. Giving em three stars because I tried the impossible burger and it was raw. The inside was mushy and red.

Their Pizza is absolutely subpar. The sauce was just sickeningly sweet, and the crust was nothing special.

It's a shame, they took over Aquilone's, whose pizza was the best in town.  Now we have to go looking for a new pizza place. There aren't that many good ones in Levittown that really know how to do a great, chewy crust.

The dirty little secret in the south Jersey / philly area is that there aren't many Mexican restaurants!! Why? I'll never know. But this little mom and pop restaurant will soothe your cravings for Mexican food. The food is good and the servers are friendly.

Our server got our order wrong 3 times. 
Chef selection sushi was basic and not memorable. 
Unforgettable roll tasted like a big roll of rice, barely tasted the fish in it. 
Shrimp tempura was bland and dipping sauce tasted like dipping in water. Just used the soy sauce on the table.

Like most MCDS usually the food is okay. Unfortunately, this time the food wasn't good at this Mcds. The bread tasted old. The meat was cold. And the napkins was on the bottom of the bag making the napkins very greasy. Who wants to rub grease all over their hands and face ? Nobody, I hope? Well thats my experience today.

text:
By far the best tacos in town. I've tried the lamb, chorizo, rajas con queso, mushroom, al pastor. They were all good. Their tortillas are freshly made and delicious.

And the owner is super nice which always makes the food taste better!

This place is so much better than Lily's or Cuernavaca. Go give this place a try.

This has become the designated restaurant my friends and I will go to in Bryn Mawr. If it wasn't one of the more affordable BYOB places in the area I don't think we would frequent it as much. The food is meh. As a sushi lover, average would be a compliment for the selection and quality of the sushi.

This has to be the worst possible McDonald's in STL. Waited 15 minutes inside to get order taken and then another 10 minutes to get my order. Service was horrible along with the bad attitudes of the staff. The person that waited on us had the worst attitude I've seen. Was arguing with customers. Will never come to this one again.

text: This large building is architecturally beautiful, I guess the ATM is locked with a gate u til they open at 9am? I guess I can understand the need for extra security in downtown tucson, this is probably the main Wells Fargo in town where most staff trains...

Came to mosaics in Friday morning to get menudo con pan. The kid wants it but it takes overnight to make menudo so came to mosaics cafe to get a bowl for approximately $10. I'm glad they expanded the parking lot as it was right before the expansion, even today at 11 am the parking lot is almost full.

The bar staff was especially awesome.  Cyndy was personable, handled a busy Tuesday night very well, and made sure that we were all taken care of while were were there.

Check-in assistance and concierge lounge were also good.

Happy to stay here again.

(Frequent traveler from out of town).

text: Don't judge this place from the outside. The food is authentic, delicious, and cheap. Occasionally will drive out of the way 15 minutes just to get some tacos here. The staff is friendly and the service is quick. Haven't found a more authentic tasting place in Indy yet.

Nicki is awesome. Never have a bad time when she is bartending. Food is kick-ass, if you love burgers and wings this is the place to go. Super friendly staff, cool environment, can sit outside, and love that they have local breweries like evil genius on tap. Our go to spot, especially during football season.

This place is great and very reasonably priced I made a delicious pasta and my hubby had a pizza we shared and we still had left overs. Super yummy. And the kids shared a cheese pizza for 4.95 how can you beat that? All of us more then full for under 25 bucks yea buddy! We will return!!

This place is exquisite! I wish I was local this would be the only place I would come to get my nails done. Got my first gel matte mani and I absolutely love it. Ambience is on point and everyone is so friendly and attentive. Will be back next time I'm in town.

My first time renting a car very upset and will not rent from them ever.  Ordered rental from priceline.  I checked everywhere on the site to see if a credit card was necessary.  I used my debit card to pay and it went through. It never said anything about additional holds on my account.  When we got to the a

Pizza was great.  We ordered the 2 large cheese pies for $19.99 and they didn't disappoint.  This is not a go out of your way place to get pizza but is a good bet if you want some solid Jersey pizza.  The place is super old school but in a cool way.  Definitely adding this place into our pizza rotation.

Former member - go anywhere else, because they do not do business ethically. Their cancellation policy is not honest and they hit you with at least two extra months of billing. 12 months after I canceled, I've asked repeatedly to be removed from their email lists and they refuse.

text: Highly overrated!!!  The waiter was not attentive, not friendly, not anything. Food was cold, not too tasty.  We go out for dinner seven nights a week and there are a lot better places to eat for $100 than here.  Not a good experience at all. Don't see any reason to ever go back.

A block away from the Main Street but this place was a hidden gem. It's a small place but they serve authentic food at a reasonable price. I ordered two asada tacos and an asada tostada. The food was delicious and although I don't live in the area, if I ever find myself around there I would definitely return.

A block away from the Main Street but this place was a hidden gem. It's a small place but they serve authentic food at a reasonable price. I ordered two asada tacos and an asada tostada. The food was delicious and although I don't live in the area, if I ever find myself around there I would definitely return to Monterrey!

Absolutely love ginza and the people that work here. The shrimp tempura and crab rangoons are my favorite appetizers. Sweet and sour chicken is great and so is general tso's. Not a fan of the hibachi and yum yum sauce. I've only had one unpleasant experience here.

Looking for the after dinner dessert? Chill Bros!
Great Ice cream, great location, great flavors. Tons of different choices.
Personally, I am dairy free so for me the flavors were limited to only 2 options at the time I went. My boyfriend on the other hand was in heaven with the Popcorn Ice cream.

The haircut was fine. The overall rating was for the condition of the workplace and mostly the lack of Covid concern. 1 barber was wearing a mask. The others were not. People sitting in chairs not wearing them. People waiting not wearing them I didn't feel comfortable and won't go back.

I'd say they get my order right maybe 30% of the time. And 10% of the times they've gotten it wrong they've just given me someone else's order. Once or twice I can see, but if this has happened to me more than three times I can only imagine. Good news is though, when they do get it right it's a pleasant surprise!

I came here with 8 other girls for bachelorette weekend dinner. We all ordered a variety of dishes but I HIGHLY recommend the black spaghetti (it tastes the same as regular but the black pasta might mess with your head a little). The hot honey pizza was very interesting and intriguing! The Brussels sprouts were to die for!

Great location and price. The bed was like diving into heaven and the pillows
were so soft. I have never slept so good and only wish I had a bed like this at home
with the pillows. The hotel was clean modern and breakfast was good too. I would 
stay here again. The gym was perfect and clean.

text: Nothing exceptional, but a good place to stay if you want something that you can guarantee is clean and comfortable. The staff here is very friendly, personable, and helpful. They are very attentive and happy to help with any request or need that a guest may have. The staff truly makes the stay here nice!

text: Stopped by for a cut today, since I didn't have an appointment and they had only on chair in the salon I was told to wait outside. What will happen when the temperature is in the 30's will they have patio heaters? Patheyic way to run this place, I simply left.

Phoned in an order for this unit off Clayton Road in Richmond Heights today. Ordered sweet and sour shrimp withe the shrimp not to be fried, Was warned shrimp tastd bad that way but no worriess, got home to an order that was completely wrong. Avoid unless you want this type of treatment.

I honestly love this place. Take people there all the time. It's pretty authentic food, not overly "American". Fresh ingredients, not greasy, and tastes great and the wait staff is friendly. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars was the atmosphere is a little bland. Didn't have any "life", but it's still really good quick food.

I love this store! They always have well-stocked shelves and have a much larger variety than meets the eye for such a small store! The sandwiches they sell are reasonably priced and always delicious. I love stopping in on my way home to grab a few items. And the people who work there are always very kind and friendly.

Tried Chill today and absolutely loved it. Lots of flavors to try, great toppings, and good value compared to the other yogurt shops in the neighborhood. We liked it 100x better than Sweet Cece's. Strawberry Shortcake and Blueberry were our favorites!  Can't wait to go back soon.

They take your money over $60 every June for an anual fee plus pay $24 a month on top of that a $58 fee for canceling the membership not including tax . Just blew my mind how could you charge 3 months with of the membership just to opp out of it that's crazy never will I support PF again

text: I took my 2008 Dodge ram to ice cold air for an evaporator core replacement. Not only did they beat the competitors price by over $500 and offered a 2 year warranty but they also had my truck back to me within five hours. Pete and his crew did an exceptional job and I would highly recommend them.

Great authentic Mexican food!  We had tacos pastor , a guisado de res quesadilla and pollo asado nachos.  They are all prepared in front of you with fresh ingredients. You can choose all the toppings you want. Overall awesome experience!  Service, cleanliness and taste all 5 stars!

Moved back down here from upstate NY. Had been in search for that one person who could cut my hair just like back home. I was lucky enough to have Caitlyn as my stylist. Listened to every nit-picky request I had and made it ten times better. As long as I live in Philadelphia I'll be going here. Beer with the cut is also a plus!

For being part of the hotel this is an average coffee shop. Good coffee and fair prices, even given the location. They need to get an updated website with their food menu. The breakfast burritos were heavy on potato and lacking for meats. Would not get again and not worth the price for any food.

I go here for the salad bar and soup, it is usually very good. Over the last month the lettuce and veggies don't seem as fresh. They also WEIGH and charge you for dressing which is ridiculous. 

Over priced on groceries. 

Staff is unpleasant, they do not smile or greet you.

I always go to this shop for any maintenance on my car that I can't do myself. They're always straight up with me and they take the time to show me what exactly is wrong and if it needs to be fixed right away or not. I truly trust these hard-working mechanics with my car.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The quality of service at this Firestone has gone tremendously downhill. The last time I went for a oil change they forgot to put my engine cover on. text: The food here is awesome!!!!!! They have a new roll called big easy roll, which was deep fried but it was so good! We also got their po boy and Lsu roll. Our 2nd time here and we loved it. Family friendly restaurant, which was perfect for our little family! The food came out super fast. Glad to have this in the parish!

Might have been better if we hadn't ordered it through grubhub. By the time it arrived it was cold. The chicken strips were questionable. Shaped weird and had some sort of green tint to them. The bacon cheeseburger was so dry it was inedible and the fries were barely cooked, floppy and cold.

THANK YOU to all of the employees and manager at Krystal tonight. DoorDash was completely and utterly incompetent. While it was not Krystal's fault, they made it a million percent right-even though they were short staffed and had a very late rush right before closing.

They recently redid the entire place so we decided to stop in a few months back. Love this place--we go out of our way now to buy our liquor here. They have a great selection of allll the booze and some of the best prices in town. Also, they're open on SUNDAYS!

Room was clean, check-in was contactless, and smooth. 

No room cleaning during our stay and no answer when we rang the front desk or operator. Room was small, as others noted, and the mattress has a trough where most people must sleep. The AC unit was loud. I have stayed at better Fairfield Inns.

text: I went to Presto Pasta for the first time today. I was very pleased with the service, the delicious food, and cleanliness of the place! Alejandro took our oh so very complicated order, with so much patience and grace, and it was very appreciated! He made our first experience here a great one, we will definitely be back soon!

Off the beaten path, but worth finding! Old marina area and sits on water. Had the Grouper melt sandwich (grilled) w/fries and it was phenomenal! Had 3 craft drafts and 5 domestic swill - wish they had a few more local drafts on tap. Very laid-back, chill place. Seemed to be a lot of locals.

The food was excellent, although the tacos are a bit small. I had the pork bell, fried oyster and pulled pork tacos.   I was very pleased with my meal and the company.  Take note: if this is your first date, you will be yelling across the table.  It is a bit noisy here :-) will come back with me friends next time!

Very good tacos, my favorite are the shrimp tacos, very good quality ingredients. Nice location downtown. I also had the carne asada tacos that I wasn't a huge fan of. The chips and salsa is also very good! They have a taco Tuesday deal where the tacos are $2 each! Definitely worth it!

Went back since this was only nearby eatery
Indifference of staff and poor attitude still reigns just fewer four letter

The burger

text: Born and raised in Upper Darby, I grew up on Leandros Pizza on 69th Street which was awesome. So I recently moved to broomall and found a place just as great! I usually just go for a couple of plain slices and they are delishhh....Definately the only pizza in broomall worth eating...

I'm not the biggest Ice cream fan, but my girlfriend lives the kryptonite ice cream, and I really like the more chocolate-y flavors like extreme moose tracks. The staff is very friendly and they also sell brownies by the register. I will definitely be back.

Veal parm entrée was delicious, nice and crispy with just enough sauce and mozzarella with a side of spaghetti. Tasted octopus and broccoli rabe w/ sausage and white beans apps all top notch. Other entrees stuffed pork chop special seamed to be a hit as was pasta with osso bucco ragu.

Very good service but food not @all good. Miso soup was tasty, but the salad was nothing except iceberg lettuce w/a couple of strands of carrots and  a dressing that was tasteless. The potato salad also was quite bland, The bbq saba was overcooked and partially burned. A very disappointing meal & a waste of money!

I had lunch w/a friend there on Saturday & we both enjoyed our meals. Both meals included miso soup, salad, & a California roll. She had a yellowtail 'collar' & I had a tasty sautéed red snapper. We both were served rice, but I had a nice medley of vegetables & she didn't. Service was friendly & professional. Highly recommended!

Oh yes this has been the first 5 star I have given in this crap town. I am a single man, but if this pizza was single I would definitely be neck deep in it. That's not even acceptable for a man and pizza to date, it's just weird. But the pizza here is so gotdam good here it can maybe just maybe have its norm in society. I love you.

Haven't been there for awhile but staff looked all new. Has there been a change in ownership?
Waited over an hour for our rolls and it was not busy. They were ok but not as good as I remember, 
Used to be a favorite game place to go but now I'm hesitant to try again.

I will never depend on a pre called in order nor ever wish to buy there ever again. Every wensday i run a group meeting and requested 12 fricking glazed donuts 30 mins in advance to provide for our members .this is 2nd time they put me out to dry with no donuts .not mad but furiouse...stay away .

Just recently came to this location I got the triple cheeseburger for two dollars and a McChicken with cheese medium fry large Dr Pepper  and three cookies  that triple cheese was hitting  edit extra onion pickle to it and as long ways drive was stupid Long.

text: Coffee was ok, not bad, not the best. Breakfast sandwich and donut was very good! Not awesome when your husband waits in line to keep the three person limit and then gets kicked out when a customer comes back in to correct a precious order. These are not cities mandates and customer service should always be a consideration.

The Elmwood is totally unassuming from the outside. Inside the restaurant the staff is working hard for a first rate experience. We were a group of six and ordered just about everything. Flavors were given careful consideration and played well in the dishes. I'm looking forward to visiting again soon.

Food came piping hot. Delivered to Courtyard and in estimated time. Good prices. Decent food but beef tasted a little flavorless and could have used more meat (if it wasn't a little off... ). Hot and sour was neither but didn't taste bad just ok. Basically they just needed more seasoning on everything.

Ok pizza but not my favorite in the area. Tried it twice. Grandmas Sicilian, chicken bacon ranch and pan half meatball / half sausage. Good flavor but on both occasions that we ordered I felt the pizza was undercooked. Some people prefer a doughy crust, I'm a fan of crispier. Don't think we will be going back.

Very limited seating. Yellow ceiling tiles from age.  Potato salad was bland.  Burger was better then average. I love historic places, but it has seen better days.  There was one other table there yet service was a bit slow.  The big turn off for me is given tiny ketchup packages and a cheap unknown brand.

Well I have been there before and no complaints on the food my issue that I had tonight was we were seated and that is where our service ended. Waited 20 minutes and nobody even took a drink order. Plenty of people walked by but couldn't even get any eye contact. So we left.

Recently was trying to get brunch here. Even though there were tables available, they chose not to sit us and had us wait. They were also not able to communicate how long the wait was was or answered any of our question in a promptly manner. I thought the staff in general came across as rude and uninterested.

The place is clean, the service was awesome- some of the nicest baristas I've ever had, they were fast, the drinks were perfect and I was pleased. I feel like I'm betraying my normal baristas at the Frys location who are awesome-but these ladies need some recognition! Great job!

I went to Barry's Castle for a long time and was always happy. It is a great place filled with great people. Unhappily, I moved so far away that I could no longer go there . It was more than an hour to get there. I must say , that I miss going there and have not had a good haircut or color since I moved. You cannot go wrong at BC.

Just moved to the area, and was pleasantly surprised how good the sushi at Saku is! I ordered the Ocean roll, shrimp tempura roll, and unagi sashimi, and loved it! Hubby got sashimi and a roll, and he liked his food as well. Service was also great. I'm excited to have a good sushi spot so close to me!

It has a PlayPlace,  which is great just to give the kids time to blow off steam. 
The drive thru takes quite a while to get through, but it's not nearly as bad as the location on the west end of Plainfield. Avoid that one at all cost. 
For the most part my orders have been correct.

text: This was the most horrible service I have every had at DD the owners were rude and pushy and they were taking orders from other people in line behind us and not paying any attention to us. The male owner was screaming at us and we will never be going back there again

Screw this place. Online menu pricing is way off. When I questioned the price differences they said menu was not there's. They do not take credit but will happily charge you a fee to use your debit card. Food is not that good for the rudeness and hassle. I guess they are true to Chicago gangland rip off.

No no no... if I could give this a zero rating I would and let me tell you why. McDonald's is supposed to be a kid friendly place to bring your kids to have a quick bite and they promote that in their ads. However they hire staff who sit around and cuss loud enough for everyone in the restaurant to hear including my kids....
