text:
I don't normally enjoy going to the barber, but my first trip here was better than most places I've been to.

Starting out with a beer while I waited  is a nice touch.  The barbers were friendly and the conversation good. 

Overall great experience in a comfortable atmosphere.

If you are going for drinks and a California Roll u are safe otherwise don't go! I normally go to Arigato but got talked into going here. Not only was it same price as Arigato ( for certain rolls) the fish was not fresh and customer service wasn't the friendliest or quickest. Avoid!

Be very careful going over your check at Blue Parrot!  The waitresses seem to like writing whatever tip they want onto your bill, even if you only have a party of two. 

I am giving this restaurant two stars because, on a previous visit, the owner was cool.

Far and away, the best bar on the Wilmington riverfront.  Kelly was one of the coolest bartenders we ever met.  Honestly, the other guys were really salcking, but Kelly more than made up for it.  Highly recommend.  No pretentious nonsense, just good deals and good times.

Good solid neighborhood sushi spot. Not the best in the city, but a great place for a quick walk-to dinner. Very fresh tasting fish, BYOB, and reasonable prices. Friendly service, quick, they kept my water glass filled, and it was quiet and clean. Will definitely return.

They fucked my Subaru up! my inside smelled like a dirty towel plus mildew ! For a week! I had to get Lysol wipes and wipe my car when I got home and they did a horrible vacuum job. Had to buy a lot of air fresheners. do not go to that car wash they use dirty towels to wipe your car inside !

Warrington has been missing a hibachi/sushi restaurant and Mizu is exactly what the area needed! The service is excellent, the staff is so attentive and truly makes sure you are enjoying your meal. The added bonus is that the restaurant is BYOB! I have gone with family and friends for various occasions and we always love it.

So disappointed. I could walk to this place from my apartment and had high hopes it would fulfill my weekly taco needs. My food was so bland. And we stood and waited at the register for an eternity to pay because the sole waitress was MIA.  We waited so long my date actually walked back towards the kitchen to find someone.

The food here is good, but it's nothing special. The rolls aren't that filling so I always end up ordering more. Nonetheless, I like coming here because it's close to my school so it's convenient to walk here and order rolls with friends. The sushi and noodle plates are definitely not bad but I've had better.

I had lunch last week with friends and the service was soooo slow!! we were there for almost 2 hours which is crazy during lunch time......took forever to get the bill and then to process the bill!!!! It is really noisy as well!!
The food was decent but took way to long to order and finally be served!!

I spent 1.5 hours today for a basic wash.  They forgot about my car because people behind me had left before me.  When I walked to my car there were water spots all over it.  Some sort of wax is stuck on my windshield, and my car is more dirty than I arrived somehow.  This place clearly has more business than they can handle.

Stopped at Burger King Black wood-Clementon Rd at 445 PM Wed 12/2/2020. 1 car in front of me at drive thru...sat at speaker 3 1/2 minutes before my order was taken. Got home, around the corner, burgers were cold, fries lukewarm. 1st visit to a Burger King in 30+ years! May be ANOTHER 30 years before I visit again!!!!

Just ate at Cotoletta and was so impressed. Delicious meal, great atmosphere, and wonderful service. In addition to their regular menu, they had amazing specials. They do not have the built up huts but we were perfectly warm with the multiple heaters they have scattered around. Will go back again soon!

Amazing experience! All the employees are super professional, talented and delightful! I had my hair cut by Michele, and it was the best cut I've ever gotten! And I have been going to high end salons for years! I will never spend $30+ at a high end salon ever again knowing I can get an even BETTER cut here! Highly recommended!!

Durango falls at #2 of my favorite Overland Mexican restaurants. Not because they are bad by any means. Durango does have excellent salsa choices. You don't get just one flavor, you get mild, medium and hot salsa. If you are looking for a place to grab a quick bite to eat, great place to go.

Stopped for an afternoon coffee. Used the drive thru. The young man taking our order was nice and knowledgeable. I ordered an ice coffee with cream. It was very light, mostly cream which I didn't order extra cream. I tried one of the sugar free flavors-Carmel. It was good, but a little light!

I love Sbarro. Their stuffed pizza is truly one of my favorote things. Which is why it makes me so sad that this is the last location in the entire region and that since their employees refuse to wear a mask properly or at all, I won't be back. Make them do it right or fire them, and I'll be back.

Last time I was here will be my last visit to this establishment. After a few years since my review they still have not improved their customer service, or shall I said it even worse than before. Never again I will be back or any of my friends and relatives will come back.

Fun little Italian restaurant. Had the fettuccine Alfredo and shared it with my son. It was eaten quite quickly. Very delicious and creamy. My wife ordered the lasagna and she enjoyed it as well. Service was amazing and very attentive. I would definitely recommend if you are in treasure island and looking for delicious Italian.

Staff took care of us "close to closing time" so kudos for that but...
Why are all the lights off one hour before your posted closing time? 

Also it's such a turn off to hear the conversations taking place while the window is open. I get it's late night, just close the window so I don't gave to hear your banter.

Nothing special, but cheap AF. At Perfect Cut, I paid $20 for a shampoo, haircut, blow dry, and tip. This is unheard of -- I've spent between $30-60 for a TRIM at other salons in Philly.  

The haircut was meh, but I don't need anything fancy dancy. Also, bring cash.

We went on a Saturday afternoon and the bar was dead. The atmosphere is very blah but their drink specials were hard to pass up. $3 mimosas! The girl at the bar was friendly and outside seating was nice to people watch, but the bar inside was very dark and smelled like smoke.

Boston Hotel being a Holiday Inn Express with a half better furniture and decor. I've attached a couple of the photos that struck me as kind of odd that they would leave it like that. Not sure what the other rights are in this area but this was $99 a night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My friends and I ordered takeout from here and I got the Sun Roll. This roll was reallyyy good and flavorful! I love cream cheese and avos in my rolls, so this was the perfect roll for me. I definitely will check this place out again to try out other rolls!

I wish my stomach was as big as the menu. I wanted to try more. The ambience here is already nice. I love the how to sort out the food by cooked, semi cooked, and baked. Variety of ice cream. Service was on point. They play kpop which is amazing since I'm an avid kpop listener.

Update: I don't know what caused the turnaround, but the Koizi I loved is back!  When I was outvoted for a recent dinner with coworkers, I was pleasantly surprised to find the food and service were excellent! Thanks to who or whatever happened, I can't wait to go back!

Excellent and quick service. I needed new tires, they got me in the same day. Unfortunately my tires were special order, but they received them promptly and installed them quickly. Been over a year and have had zero issues with my new tires. I will go back.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Hair Cuttery...here's a idea..just like almost every service industry out there...reward your regular customers with a loyalty program. At the very least, your all about phone numbers...so when you see a repeat customer call...let them make an appointment!!!

We had the rudest waitress (the Italian woman) ever. I left her a $6 tip on a $38 check then took my kids to the car. My wife used the ladies room and was still inside. When she emerged, the waitress chastised her for not leaving 20%! Some nerve! We were loyal customers, but we're never coming back. Ciao!

So my son and I went here and the pool and restaurant are awesome. However we went to the bar and we had the pleasure of a bartender named heather she had the personality of a stick. She made you feel like you were bothering her and I think if she smiled it might of killed her. Hopefully it was just a bad night for her.

This location doesn't have a very good selection of anything, especially wine. They have the popular labels but if you're looking for anything special I doubt you're going to find it here. The employees are nice and helpful but for being a "fine wine and spirits" store I expected to see a better assortment of wine and liquor.

I've eaten here several times and love the place. Part because I live across the street but they make really great affordable sushi. It is byo if your into that as well. I love sitting at the sushit bar and ordering more sushi than one man should. 
In short good atmosphere good sushi good price! 

Also there is parking around back.

Really wanted to like the food based on some of the reviews but the quality of the pizza and disgusting Greek salad ("what do you want for this price?" quoting the owner when asked what was included in this salad) is enough to keep looking for an establishment that has acceptable food without a rude encounter -

A reasonable motel and budget friendly place to stay. There is a pool for guests to use if you dont want to go to the beach. The room included kitchenware, utensils, plates, bowls, a small stove range, and refrigerator. However, when we first arrived there were an American cockroach. Overall, its a reasonable place to stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Great food and great prices, but the service is terrible. Anytime that you order give yourself 45 minutes to an hour to actually pick your food up. More than half the time it still isn't ready in that time. Even the dine in service takes way too long. This restaurant needs to hire more servers.

Consistency. With large chains consistency is the key to success. With Starbucks you know you can walk into a store in Philadelphia and get the same, solid cup of coffee as a store in Ohio. This particular Starbucks is consistent. CONSISTENTLY DISAPPOINTING. Try the Barnes and Noble Starbucks coffee on broad instead.

Avoid this McDonald's at all costs. This is by far the slowest, most incompetent place you could possibly order food from. I love a few minutes away, and will drive the a further McDonald's for food (when we do get it).  It if you are looking for some Mcshitty service and food, then this is your spot.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Modern and fresh interior is what brought us in. Food is good but I got the special-sunny side raviolo with truffles. I love anything with truffles but $30 for a single ravioli? At least give me two! Good thing we got appetizers to help fill me up (shrimp rings and Mac and cheese are pretty good!)

Definitely a great spot to whip out your computer or papers to do a bit of work, as long as you don't walk in hungry. They have the usual pastry going on but that is it really.
Good size of coffee too. 
Side note, it is in a drugstore.. or maybe the drug store is in the coffee?

Great hotel and excellent service. The front desk was super nice and attentive! I honestly prefer this Marriott over the Courtyard one. It was just cleaner, larger, and overall had a nice atmosphere. Would definitely stay here the next time I am in Santa Barbara and would recommend this hotel over the courtyard.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Once we got our coffee that was supposed to have extra sugar in it and it had hardly any sugar in it I had to pull over and Set all over the car messing around with that great new land that they use now and after all that the coffee still didn't taste good thank you very much for another great visit to Dunkin' Donuts

There's an x-ray at all Dunkin' Donuts just make their own rules. Change the lid so you spilled coffee all over your car locked the doors unlocked the doors no bathrooms and now this one doesn't let you order anything on the inside at all because they're too busy with the Uber eats unbelievable horrible horrible service

They have really good food. Always have hot food. Nothing seems to be leftovers. The staff are friendly and are good about getting food out on the time that they tell you. Once in a blue moon I do get the beef and broccoli and does taste a little off, but Other than that, no complaints.

My husband is a beer connoisseur & is always looking for the cheapest and largest beer selection under one roof.  And he loves this place.  My kids like tagging along for the complementary animal crackers they get at the checkout & the car in the back of the store that they get to ride for free while daddy shops.

Arrived on a Friday Morning at 10am & they were sold out of almost all there breakfast sandwiches. Really, so off to another Starbucks - hopefully- another one has it, or it's off to plan b.

The staff was nice & place was packed. Looked like a good work space, just not sure they will have their normal products.

The Hotel staff is Amazing. The guy over the valet did above & beyond service. Now to the Front desk staff.. Wow is a i can say. Their personalities greet you with welcoming & comfort like home, then they get you laughing. Great place over all with comfy rooms.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Absolutely phenomenal Veterinarians and staff. They provide the upmost progressive medicine around, and the communication on how my kitty did just surgery was top notch. Thank you Dr. Nash, Dr. DeHaven, Dr. Artman, And everyone else who took such great care of our kitty

They mix their hot food with cold. I ordered sushi and chicken teriyaki. When I got home the sushi was worm and frankly disgusting. I put it in the refrigerator and it didn't help. The chicken teriyaki was good which helped me get over the sushi. I'd recommend sticking to hot food from here.

Love this place!! It's totally our go to sushi place, never disappoints!! 
Service is awesome, very friendly. They have rooms with rice paper doors for your dining experience or if your having a romantic evening. 
Definitely recommend giving this place a try, you won't regret it!!

Typical McDonald's, has a kiosk so you don't have to deal with the cashiers. Drive-through is pretty efficient. Inside is pretty clean however can officially have rowdy people. This is a normal McDonald's. Sometimes they don't have the special promotional items eg the Shamrock Shake. They occasionally run out of other items.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Visionworks has a great and varied selection of frames, sunglasses and contact lenses. 
We were helped by Nick, and he was so patient and helpful. Between my husband and I, we must have tried on dozens of pairs, and took pictures to send to our daughters for approval! Nick made sure we got the best price. We are happy customers.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I got the third pound thickburger combo the burger wasn't as pretty as it is on the ads but it was very good the fries are ice cold I couldn't eat them and had to throw them away I love Hardee's breakfast and I guess I should start sticking with breakfast only there

I've come here both as a guest and as an Uber delivery driver... the employees have been disrespectful every single time. Very short and have a idgaf attitude including the on duty night manager, who's been here the last three nights I've picked up orders from here.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The food is okay, but for the prices your better off going to the Villa, or El Molinito. Both places have much better food! Villa on Ina is awesome 5 stars all the way! It's a small restaurant and a mom and pop's place the food is the best up on the Northwest side of town.

The food here was definitely better than expexted.  Pu Pu platter had a good variety.  Not a fan of the bacon and shrimp dish...no direction.  Still, think it's very good takeout.  Would give another star if not for how rude the owner is and how she talks to customers.

Wow! Very impressed with Dustin the owner of Badasci Repair! I have him service my Fleet of trucks on the regular. Recently he hooked up all the electronics on my boat! Stereo, TV, LED lighting!! This guy is a master of all trades. Thanks for the great work Dustin! Cheers

Awesome service, great low prices and good quality!! Thank you,will be back!! And they have a huge lot of inventoried tires! I went in there for 1 tire blow out, and left with 3 like new tires. Very very fast considering its on a Friday right before a holiday weekend. Great job guys!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Shrimp PO boy was good, side salad,very good, Philly cheese steak good. The service was a bit rushed, but I'd rather have that than wait a long time for food. The chorizo dip was good, over all good, I hope this place makes it, perfect for families and a quick bite for reasonable prices

This place is not bad. They got my order wrong and over charged me, but offered to compensate. If I want to get some Arby's I wouldn't mind going here, but it has a little room for improvement. Being I worked at Arby's in my youth I know what a great one looks like and I think this place can become great.

Loud , noisy, yelling , screaming  ; I went on the weekend ; it sounded like a bar fight coming through my room's wall . Loud music playing all night outside in the parking log .The room was okay and was kept fairly clean . If you looking for some peace of mind ; don't come here on the weekend at least . Maybe weekday is better .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: An absolute fantastic surprise on the east side. Over the five times I have eaten here has quickly become my favorite sushi place in town. Great food, fair price and friendly staff. Unfortunately for me I moved to central Tucson and now have to make a drive to get there. Highly recommended.

I go to this McDonalds all the time. Although Ive never experienced bad customer service they are a horrible McDonalds. They ALWAYS forget something in your order or run out of food. If they weren't so close I would never go there again. I feel like they hire people who don't know what their doing. They need to be shut down.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I use to eat there once a week.  Stopped going there after terrible customer service, especially the rude hostess.  I walked out.  I even called the manager to tell him the bad experience and he blew it off like it was nothing and probably happens all the time.  There are too many good pizza places around here.  I will not be back.

The food is neither fresh or homemade...  One of the most average pizzas I've ever had. I expect a lot more out of Philly... Even at the airport. I guess I should have stuck with the cheesestake... I wanted pizza will need to wait until I get home to get some.

Beer was flat , service was terrible and we will never know how the burger was because I had to catch a flight before they managed to get it out. I don't mind overpriced at an airport, I expect that, but this was bad enough to almost be funny. Thanks for that lightning service and underwhelming personality .

. There was a bug in my kids orange juice- and it wasn't a fruit fly. Fruit flies would be more understandable, considering I'm a bar manager and deal with keeping fruit flies away. This looked like a tiny bee. 
Buffet bacon was old. Cooked food was actually Okay. Service was a bit slow. Overall mixed experience

I went in today to get some new tires but I was told I didn't need them yet and what I really needed were break pads. So they know what their doing, which is good. That however is not my issue with them. My issue with them is that no one in the whole place was wearing a face mask, which during Covid 19 is bad.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The food was good, not amazing but pretty good when looking for sushi when traveling. Went back the following day with a group and everyone said their food was great. The place is fairly small so it won't fit a large group but it's intimate setting is nice.

Good for what I usually get. (Grilled chicken breast on 6' whole wheat flatbread with tomatoes, black olives, onions, and baby spinach). Usually a little dirty/disheveled, and the workers aren't the friendliest. It's what you'd expect from a fast food restaurant.

Never order the spicy ramen. They essentially mixed cayenne pepper and water and threw some instant noodles with rubber textured pork. The California roll that came with it was dry and tasteless. 

Service was decent. The only thing that was good was the miso soup they offered when we sat down. Wouldn't recommend

3rd favorite Mexican joint in Nashville.
(I know,I know ...it's Tex Mex now shut up and read...)
Great food. Great service and chips & salsa forever!
Day in and day out this place rocks! Lunch or dinner it's always solid!
The GRILLED chicken taco will make you a better person.

Went here with the family and had an awesome time! Not only was our food awesome (I had the blackened Mahi) we sat outside which we love! Our daughter was allowed to hula hoop on the patio and the bartender/waitress along with all the people there loved it and encouraged her! We will be back for sure!

Terrible customer service and they'll make you wait forever with zero results. 

Whether you make an appointment or just walk in- the result is the same. 

If you complain, they seem not to care and basically tell you to go pound sand. 

Tip: find a different place.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: By far the best pizza in Carpinteria, the salads are delicious, the lasagna is delectable. Everything í have ever had there is spectacular. The people are great and the prices are much better than Rusty's. I don't understand why it has Rusty's as being cheaper on yelp, Thats just false.

Decent fish quality for a very good price.  There are a good variety of $10-$15 dollar entrées, or you can eat your heart out with the $20 Sushi & Sashimi combo.  If you love sushi but are on a budget, this place will do nicely.  Also, the mochi icecream for desert is fantastic.

I loved this place! Food was good at best but the service was amazing and the dessert the dessert  one word fantastic!!!

It's expensive so be prepared. Four of us went out every one had an appetizer entrée and a dessert no drinks and our bill Plus gratuity came to $523.00. Don't let the price Deter you it was worth it!!

So I love the commercials for Arby's. I drove by the Arby's and went to the drive-through because I wanted to order the special they have on the fish sandwiches. Now I'm in the drive-through remember this and I ordered the two fish sandwiches and they tell me they're out of fish. You've got to be kidding me right!

Could not be happier! I have always had the best experiences with Jack Furrier and their sister store's Desert Rat. Excellent communication, fair prices, friendly staff. Willing to do the odd ball work I request. I will be back for all my tire needs for sure.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I had the chicken parm, it was decent, but I was a little underwhelmed for the price. The place is ambitious (it wants very badly to be fine dining), but the food doesn't match up to the cost. 3 stars because while the food is edible, it is not worth the price.

Leo's has it all, great food, superb service, music, dancing and a great bar.  Very conveniently located on US 19 with lots of attached parking.  I highly recommend Leo's wings and all their appetizers.  They are pretty good at accommodating dietary needs.

Nice folks.  Just wanted an oil change.  They called with a detailed review of what the car needed in addition to oil change.  Decided to just do the oil change and the bill ended up being over $80 due to an inspection they like to do when changing oil.  That part of your car review is at cost to the customer without warning.

Good service and good pizza and garlic Knots. Love the location and the ambience of the place. Nice to see a neighborhood joint doing well. Keep it up and we will be back. Mark made an excellent rum runner and provided good service. We were immediately helped once we sat down at the bar.

The food is always a hit, but the customer service leaves a lot to be desired. Ordering online is not at painless as it should be and calling in an order is even worse. It's not unusual to wait 20-40 minutes to get in touch with someone to place an order. Beware.

We love Bill. So amazingly friendly. Truly service with a smile. They definitely definitely treat you like family. And HONEST!!!  Most people stay with these guys for years. They even give you a ride home when you drop off. Prices are pretty good but the service is where they shine.  Try them once and you won't go anywhere else.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Went back to Florida and stayed her again this time for two nights. Has a great room clean quiet. Staff just as friendly as last time. The free breakfast is the best at any hotel I have ever stayed at , eggs, sausage, pancakes etc.... It's right off 19 and easy to find.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This lame excuse for a sushi bar was empty which should have been my first clue. They are NOT service animal friendly at all and told me I could not have my dog in the sushi bar. I think I see an ADA fine headed their way!! What a shame. First gang of jerks I've come across since getting to the city of brotherly love!!

Very good and glad they are finally open for business. Fast, friendly service. Salsa and chips were good. Salsa is a little spicy, just like I like it. Fish tacos are good and rice and guacamole are delicious. Hubby had chicken chimichanga and he liked it too. Oh, the pico de gallo is yummy!! We'll be back, for sure!!

I have eaten here many times. I always order the egg rolls. awesome. szechuan beef is fantastic. service in house is great.  there are more traditional options and the usual "chinese food". my wife and I have been in and told the server to suprise us and they always do.

Well first time trying this place but might be the only time. The drive through pictures wow! look so delicious, but upon receiving food the tortilla on the quesadilla was burned. I has the chicken mula, it was decent just not happy with paying for burned food.

After my first visit it's hard to understand what all the fuss is about.  When I walked in at 115 there were only two other people in the place. I ended up grabbing a menu and seating myself.  The pizza was as bland as any I've had in quite a while. Certainly don't think I would go back

I've been coming here for about 10 years to get my eyebrows waxed, and they do a great job every time. It's nice to come in and have the same lady do  my eyebrows cause she knows exactly how to do them. I can't comment on the nail part cause I've never gotten them done here.

Pretty decent place, I really only come here to get the carnitas tacos and a horchata. The pork is cooked very well and has a nice crisp in it. This place also has really good and spicy salsa, it will def make your nose run haha. Drive thru is pretty slow so be prepared to wait.

My brother and I go here a lot to get our cars washed. Nothing fancy or spiracular. They prewash your car first which is nice then they send it thru the car wash. Usually gets most spots off my car. The vacuum machine work pretty good at this location, great suction. You can also purchase a monthly membership for unlimited wash's.

Literally would give zero stars if possible. I have been waiting in the drive thru line for 30 minutes.... 
Their coffee machine is broken? And they are only accepting cards. I will NEVER come back to this location. Employees are beyond rude . Do not waste your time .
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I love going to this coffee shop! It's a nice escape from reality. I can go here, order coffee, have honest conversations with the baristas about art and life while it's being made. Usually lines aren't long at all and if they are it goes very quick. There's upstairs seating as well as downstairs! So make sure to venture around!

Inside not open, so unrealistic to be able to grab your coffee and go. 20 cars in line at all times and you can't just run inside and order. What's the point of using the app to order before hand. Avoid this location if possible. Signed- a very tired exhausted mom that needs to be at work on time.

Delicious pizza but very over priced. I ordered two number 4's which is a single slice single topping, a side (2 breadsticks), and a drink and the total came to almost $20. My breadsticks were supposed to be pepperoni and I got to plain breadsticks. Check your order before you leave the drive up.

I get almost the same thing every time I go and they do a great job at this Starbucks and the employees are nice. The drive thru is a little wacky because of the bank that used to be next to it, and if you go during busy hours, you'll hold up traffic waiting to get in line since it connects to Edgewood.

If you live in Greenwood, I would say make the drive and go to Longs or Boydens. These donuts are bland and definitely not as good. There's tons of other donut places around (I haven't had a chance to try yet) but I would recommend trying them. I am giving 3 stars for the nice service I got from the lady! Very kind.

I had to wait 1 hr and on top of that, my quarter pounder bacon burger with extra bacon did not get ANY bacon and they forgot a sausage McGriddle and my fries were cold. The manager had an attitude and asked me twice what I ordered nor did I get my receipt because the kiosk was out of paper.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I always go to this location when I'm in the area this morning it wasn't busy yet it still took my order over 15 minutes and they were out of gravy for biscuits and gravy and the sweet tea was bad and my fiancé's iced caramel macchiato was warm with no ice. So disappointed never coming back.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: "Do you like it raw?" the menu asks me as I first gaze upon it. I ordered the McNabb roll after my favorite former Eagles footballer, and it was as delicious as Donovan was in his prime. This restaurant is great for groups, love the BYOB, and I definitely love it raw

It wasn't bad, but...I like more flavor and texture in rice. It would make it better if the size of nigiri rice and thickness of fish are more consistent. 
The service and the price was really good comparing to other sushi restaurants around here in Reno area.

Great selection of Indian ingredients and great prices. Nice produce and spice selection. Prepared food is also very good. Only complaint is they say they are an Indo-Asian grocery but they don't actually carry Asian ingredients. Knowing this going in, I'd give it a 5. Quality family run business.

Love, love, love this place! I've visited this both the Broad Ripple and Fountain Square locations multiple times! Fell in love w/Cookie Butter and Spicy Mexican Chocolate. Vegan options are also available and aren't bad at all! I actually tried the strawberry minI would def recommend to everyone!

Alison helped me get a loan to buy a new travel trailer. She was very polite ,professional, and knowledgeable .
She found me a loan rate better than the dealerships 3 lenders with no hassles. It didn't take long to get approved
, and they really do treat you like you are their best customer. I highly recommend using them!

I would love to tell you that I've discovered a gem or found a hidden treasure here but I cannot. It's just a donut shop. It's clean and they provide fast service. So on that front it's great but again, it's just a donut shop. So when you're looking for a dozen donuts to bring to the office this place will meet your needs.

I love the chicken croissant #1 breakfast sandwich from here. If I go its before work and its between 630-7am. They open at 630 and in the past they've been pretty quick but the last couple times it seems to have taken longer than usual and im the only car there. So I wouldn't recommend if you're in a rush.

Knowledgeable guys and easy going. Glad I went here, they saved me from having to buy a new transmission no thanks to the other big o location on Mae Anne avenue totally blowing a transmission flush. I will be returning to this location the next time I need work done.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This subway needs to switch being the 24/7 subway with the one on N. Hills Blvd. At least the one on N. Hills Blvd is stocked and the owner is very present and welcoming there. 4th time here tonight and this location fails to keep stock. Do the area a favor and stop being the 24/7 subway.

Drinks were good and the bartenders were knowledgeable. Ambiance was more relaxed than the crazy atmosphere of other spots. 

It was nice to spend a little bit of time here with friends, just hanging out and playing cards. It got a little crowded only because it was pouring down rain.

Not the ordinary 'mexican' hole in the wall restaurant.  This place is nice, the menu has many options and the food tastes really good!  
I had the shrimp tacos and my husband had the crunchy mahi tacos. Both were so delicious!  Crispy chips and fresh salsa.

These guys were very helpful with setting up a reservation for my rental car. They gave me several different options and we're very easy to use. They also went I've r the car and the agreement with me to make sure everything was good to go. Will definitely be back when I need a rental again.

Great pizza and prices! The sausage pie was to die for! So delicious. Service was kind and pleasant, but I could have used a refill on my drink a little more frequently. The booths were very small. I am overweight, however, I'm only 5'9" and my legs could barely fit under the table.

Had the carnitas, ground beef and sauteed steak tacos, which were all so bland, and the shredded steak quesadilla, which was just ok. Their rice and refried beans are pretty good, but that wasnt what i was interested in. All in all it was a waste of money for me, taco bell wouldve tasted better

Scrumptious classic Italian food. Meatballs, chicken parmigiana, chicken cacciatore and pasta. I went there for a set dinner to celebrate a birthday. We were seated on the second floor which was quieter so our loud group. There was so much food and a carafe of wine. And a perfectly sized cannoli for dessert.

Clean and renovated bathrooms. Bed was just okay.  Stayed  with points; glad I didn't really pay for it or I would have been disappointed. Room was oddly large -- with that much space they could have added a seocond armchair or a sofa. Parking options don't exist : you will pay $22 for valet.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: These guys are the real deal barber shop. Very talented, professional, and dedicated to quality. I made my appointment online which was straightforward. Showed up, got a good looking haircut in a reasonable amount of time, and was on my way. I highly recommend. Reminders for for new patrons: bring cash, and show up on time.

Very nice people, but poor knowledge of anything other than simple banking needs. Wasted a lot of time getting there, waited on them, and didn't have a resolution in the end. Had to drive over to the Brentwood location to get what I needed, wasted my morning. Hopefully this location gets some more finance courses ASAP.

We are in town for the Sugar Bowl and this hotel is awesome!  The staff took the time to tell us where things were around town and even referred us to a great restaurant around the corner.  The only complaint is the valet price, however when there is limited parking it us what it is!  Enjoy your stay, because we did!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Do not listen to that bad review! This place is amazing and we will keep dining in to get this fabulous food! The servers are excellent and like any Italian restaurant, it's noisy and yes crowded. Makes us feel right at home! Thanks Oak Oven for your wonderful food and special homemade pastas!

I liked the live entertainment and the waterfront patio. The food was a bit lacking here though. I had the buffalo chicken sandwich which suppose to be a house special and my blood pressure get like it was going through the roof. The hot sauce was incredibly salty. Service was ok but could have been better.

I was very disappointed to see Rouses continue to advertise for and use the services of Big Lees Towing. He's had some very shady dealings way before the video of him attempting to run over a drunk female. Why do you continue to expose your customers to this violent predator.

Rouses has emerged as one of the Premier remaining local grocers in the area. They've invested quite a bit into their stores. I've resolved my issue with the firearms in a way that works for both of us and I quite enjoy shopping there again. It's ALWAYS clean and stocked. I'm proud of the image Rouses casts on Louisiana!!!!!

I had the cheese ravioli with marinara sauce and it was quite good. There is so much to try but was curious how the "basics" were. There was good spice and it was tasty. The food is cooked to order, so there's a wait. But frankly, I liked that. The owner is very friendly, the atmosphere casual and we enjoyed ourselves.

You get to choose what meats you would like to have, tortillas are delicious, rice is delicious, beans are delicious everything is delicious!!! I recommend the avocado Chile sauce. This place is the cleanest local Mexican restaurant in this city! Plus the 7 dollar baby sized burrito fills you up all day.

If you are a local, you know what I'm talking about. This is one of the closest things to Kyoto restaurant. The owners son used to work at Kyoto on Prytania and has brought a lot of knowledge with him to origami. At times, staff may be slow but the sushi is nothing but fresh and fabulous.

Stay away from this dry cleaner.  They stained 3 of my dress shirts in the same place and I gave them multiple opportunities to fix it. To the dry cleaners credit, they fixed 2 out of 3, but enough is enough.  They also did a horrible job of pressing my shirts on my last pick up.  STAY AWAY!!!!!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I was a frequent patron of the restaurant until tonight. Had a dead roach on the seat in our booth. Was moved and comped with a $2.50 soda. It was explained that the exterminator was in a couple of days ago. I would have expected more of a comp than a soda.

Hadn't been to Arby's in years but I wanted to sandwich this one was OK Service was OK and I went inside so the wait didn't seem to be too bad....nothing spectacular.
I was disappointed that they don't make onion rings anymore because theirs were really good.

Always a pleasure to get a cool drink or some warm coffee related drink from Starbucks can't go wrong when they have what you're looking for lol...
I understand that all of the shortages are causing problems for their business as well as others so I can't complain.

this is probably the slowest McDonalds I have ever been to, and they are constantly out of anything I would ever want to purchase from this fast food chain. I have no idea how this place stays in business while always finding a different way to disappoint it's customers on a day to day basis
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I used to rent cars for a living, but when I went out to get my vehicle I was disappointed with the cleanliness. McDonald's wrappers, coke cans, and trash everywhere. Unknown substance on the hood. 

I spent 20 minutes cleaning the vehicle and filling it up prior to my trip. You guys can do better.

Came early on Thursday night and thank goodness. Reservations were full and onky a few tables for walk ins.
I had Osso Bucco and couldn't finish it. Cooked perfectly. Hubby had lasagna and took half home. Service was delightful. Atmosphere is great with view of greenway.
Nice patio that we hope to visit during warm weather.

This hotel just went through a major renovation and is very nicely done.
I find the staff to be professional and nice. 
I want to pay specific compliment to the van driving staff. They are extremely friendly and helpful regarding information about the area. They have made each of my business stays at this hotel nice and welcoming.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I went in to get my acrylic filled. I had some fungus under one of my nails and so we decided to remove them which was fine. The down part is they removed them by picking and using a face nail to slide in between my nails. One part that she could not get off the nail tech just filed down and painted over.

Wells has had a lot of bad press over the years.  As for my wife and I they have been great bankers.  We are warned when any kind of fraudulent actions happen to our account.  They have quickly and professionally corrected any issues we have ever had.
Service is fast and professional.

It's okay. Many of the flavors I've tried were over sweetened. Too much sugar in their recipes. Hard to appreciate the nuances of the cream and special flavors. Sugar bombs.

Great variety overall.  There's the inconvenience of cash only in a virtual money world-  And it's pricey for what you get.

Love love love this place! A+ for atmosphere and service! However the last two times I have been here, I have not been wowed by the food. It may be personal preference for me but the pasta needs more sauce. This was echoed by another table mate too. Also, was a bit long getting the food out.

The wait staff was excellent!

My experience was very poor and not what I expected from a highly rated brand such as Hyatt . My room was clean for the most part but there was a few missed areas, the breakfast was terrible, and a woman that I assumed was a maid barged into my room unexpectedly. I should have followed my gut and booked with Hilton.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Mikado Southside offer a fancy Japanese experience. When I say Fancy it is pretty expensive compared to before. Bento boxes for lunch is Min. $15.50. with no sushi. I ordered their A-1 (Sushi bento) for $16.50. Wish they gave some Miso soup with the bento. Overall, not bad but a bit expensive.

I've been here for 4 years and am always amazed at the service provided by the staff - no matter whether in the office or maintenance. The apartments are pristine, the complex is beautiful, and the people are GREAT! I highly recommend The Enclave for someone looking for a great place to live.

This is the worst Subway. I come here because it is on my way home. They only have one person working. Need at least two people if they are going to have a drive thru and for safety purposes. I feel sorry for the one employee. 
I will give one star only because the one employee did the best she could. Bring your patience!!

First time to the restaurant.  My daughter and I had such awesome experience.  Delicious foods.  Must have the Brussel Sprouts for the appetizer. Absolutely fantastic service.  Robert was our waiter.  He was so accommodating and so great to us.  Highly recommend to dine here.  Will come again whenever I am in town!

The wings ( extra hot ) and lobster bisque are really good. but the restaurant only survives because there is no competition around.   The service is horrible and the food mediocre and way over priced.  Bar prices are also over priced.  When more restaurants come into the area  Rhodes will struggle to compete.

I love in-N-out burger, but today I was dissatisfied, my burger was under cooked and red in several areas. There was a lot of people there but that doesn't mean you have to under cook burgers to get it out faster, other than that the fries were great and the service was not too bad

Overpriced and I frequently end up with digestive issues after eating here. My husband has an iron gut and has had issues, too. There are a lot of great Italian food options available in the area and this is not one of them. Menu is basic at best and it's poorly executed.

Absolutely loved this place! Classy, clean and a very friendly people. The decor was so nice, the host was so gracious. I was here from out of town and ended up getting one of the best manicure and pedicures I've had! Would definitely come back next time I'm in town! Very highly recommended.

Nice snack/restaurant stop to make while visiting the Pima Air and Space Museum. Order your food at the counter, get a number and take your receipt to cashier pay. The server brought the food to the table pretty fast. Food was hot and yummy. Eating area was clean. Nice little play area right outside.

This is a good fun pizza place. It has really cool decorations and memorabilia for gangsters and old school mafia people.  The atmosphere was excellent and cool to see. The pizza was also solid. We got the pepperoni and we all enjoyed it as well. I recommend trying it out

My "service engine soon" light came on after an oil change here.  Went to a different place and they found that either the dip stick was not fully seated or fill cap wasn't on correctly.  They quickly fixed the issue and the light turned off after about 10 minutes of driving.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Good local coffee roaster and warm interior.  But it's the heart of the Holiday season and they are blasting acid jazz.  ?????   I walked in being relatively relaxed and I'm leaving a bit jumpy.   Isn't a good coffee shop supposed to provide the opposite experience?   Oh well, off to 20 tap for a beer.

We ordered a hurricane and boy was it strong! The atmosphere is nice and cool.  This place is great for groups. There's a vintage cocktail list and a beer list.  It feels like you're in a mob hangout. There's pictures of all the famous mobsters on the walls. The bar connected to our hotel which was easy to access.

Just like all of the other reviewers, I was in line for a ridiculous amount of time. I actually put my car in park twice and ended to putting in a mobile order. From the time I put in my order (while waiting in the drive thru) to the time I actually got it was 11 minutes

These guys used to be good about 10 years ago, but more recently when I brought my Mustang in for an alignment after some suspension mods, the tech tried to coerce me into paying him to replace my lower control arm bushings.  Having built up a dozen or so Mustangs, I called BS and took my car elsewhere, never to return.

I love Starbucks. I am a barista at Starbucks but this location is ALWAYS slow and they ALWAYS mess up my tall vanilla latte in a Grande cup with whip cream. It's really not a complicated order and I'm saying that from working at the busiest Starbucks in the world.

Perfect location for a car wash off 135 and Smokey Row in the Kroger parking lot.  There's usually not a line, and the wash is comparable to Crew- not the cheaper car wash options.  It's easier to get in and out than many other options, so this is my car wash of choice.

My car looks a lot better... until you look closely.  Crumbs and the wrapper to my kids' breakfast bar were left behind.  My trunk was not done, and they didn't clean underneath my wipers.  Polite staff, quick in and out process, and not terribly expensive.  Definitely not a thorough job.

Excellent customer service, very affordable, and trustworthy!  Our business has two vehicles, and we exclusively use Fountain Street Auto for regular maintenance, repair, and inspections.  They work with us to find economical options rather than try to drive up the bill.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: One guy I believe name Adrian said I couldn't change my address over the phone and that I had to change it online or in the branch. Found out I could change my address thanks to the chase on Grant. They are not the most helpful people when it comes to taking care of your account wasn't pleased at all with them.

Read the reviews first. Place has horrible service. Took so long and made my GrubHub driver wait for almost an hour and then canceled the order when he got to the window because they lost it. Absolute garbage service line wrapped around the building. I don't know the quality of the food but I can only assume bad AVOID

Food is delicious. Service was great. Atmosphere was family oriented and inviting. We had a party of 3 on a Sunday morning around 10am and there were TONS of people in the restaurant eating and waiting outside but the wait was only 15 minutes. I recommend this place as I love diners!

This pizza place is delicious. Probably the best pizza around. The prices are decent, the environment is very old Italian (Chicago) the pizza is like a thin and crispy type. I love it. This is our go-to pizza restaurant, it's worth the drive ! You should really try this place. Family owned and run!

Went here for lunch. Good food,service was a little off I don't know if maybe they were short handed. Was never asked about drinks was basically given water and not any other choice. But the food was good. Could stand a good cleaning in the dining room I was kind of put off by the state of the walls.

A fantastic place to buy liquor if you have a penchant for smug assholes ringing you up. I usually go in there after some biking on the Monon and they look at me as if I've just escaped from an outhouse. Hey there, Fauntleroy, you're working a liquor store, tone down the high brow b.s.

Super friendly owners. Ordered the Kani salad which was different from others I have had. Definitely has a kick to it which I enjoyed, but was a bit too heavy on the mayo. Good size rolls, not too much rice. Had the tuna and Alaska rolls. Would go back and try other menu items. Interested to see what this little place grows into!

Spider roll made. Deep fried with the taste of old oil, sushi rice hard. When requested iced green tea was told all they had was hot,suggested they bring a glass of ice on the side. Miso soup cold and served 1/4 of bowl side of rice served in chipped dinnerware.

We traveled to 4 different places.  1 of which was another Vision Works,,this location is the absolute BEST ....aka TOP NOTCH when it comes to  Selection, Price points, knowledge of product and CUSTOMER SERVICE,  

Deaf. Friendly!  Respectful transactions on the sales floor!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Not worth the cost. Incredibly over priced. The food is mediocre, but it's not worth $25-30 a portion. Host had no clue what social distancing was. Packed us all into the bar and next to the only other couples that were sitting there. Server was great. Everything was lack luster. Won't be back.

I took my fur baby, Rayna here recently to say goodbye. She had been suffering from renal failure for a few months and I felt it time. The staff was wonderful, so caring and the crematorium they used did an amazing job leaving me with beautiful keepsakes of my little girl. I highly recommend them for vet care.

First time visit to the restaurant , while in Philadelphia yesterday attending the 9th Street  Italian Market Festival. The food was very good. We would go definitely have dinner again at this Italian establishment. Philadelphia has some of the best Italian restaurants without a doubt.

They are not nice. Don't tip them they never say thank you they have their own conversations. They barely look at you. Grab what you need and go. Sometimes i don't even think they listen to what u want and just plop it on the table. I REPEAT DONT TIP THEM.

Hands down the best sushi experience in Philadelphia Chef Hiroki is a wizard ! His craftsmanship, presentation and precision is unmatched. Each course is superbly superior to the next the marriage of flavors takes you on a journey to a universe of glee. Congratulations Hiroki you are a star !

Back to being a Starbucks gal. I was going to Dunkin' off Missouri & the evening service is terrible. The moral & energy here is consistent. My only thing is the amount of espresso they give in a single shot is extremely minute. Not even a full shot. But I'd rather come here where the service is great.

This ice cream shop has a very good quality product yet the workers are not organized you don't know where the line begins to order the place is messy, it's not clean there's no trash cans to put the trash outside the store the glass doors are dirty -If  this issues were addressed I'd give it a 4+

Service with a smile! 

I am always greeted with a smile and I always feel welcome!  Good music is always playing and the atmosphere is always fun!

The only drawback is I wish someone would say bye or thank you as I'm leaving.  I always tell them thank you!

Even during quarantine, this local eatery knows how to provide excellent service and delicious food. Ordering food from Mama Flora's was quick and easy, and the food was ready very soon. The staff was very courteous and our order was perfect. The food was delicious and the portions were substantial.

Really good! I recently needed lunch a few days and The Works pizza was pretty darn delicious! So good that we decided to give their cheesesteaks a try the next weekend. Equally delicious, although massive! Quick delivery, delicious food.. not much more you can ask for these days!

A beautiful space with lots of seating and modern decor. It is a great place to meet with friends and the coffee was quite good. Note that it is probably not the best place to work as they have no wifi (though xfinity wifi does work) and signs encouraging people to not stay very long.

Service was wonderful!! The server explained the items in the menu and they had a good selection of wines by the glass. 
I got a salad with grilled salmon. The size was really big and the salmon was warm! I couldn't finish the salmon and had no room for dessert.

Best Chinese food I've ever had, and Chinese is my favorite! Spicy beef, general Tsos chicken, and lo mein are our go-to's. I've also had their egg rolls, spring rolls, and chicken with garlic sauce which are all very good. My only complaint is they aren't open on Sunday, but that is minor.

Worst burger king ever, this is the perfect example of a bad restaurant. Menu screens always off, soda machine never full, employees talking with each other while I'm ordering the food. And she complains because I said it lauder. Definitely need a manager from a better area.

It was better than expected for the price. The AC actually worked, the door locked, and no major stains. The bed was decently comfy and they had a pool and free breakfast. Definitely nothing luxury and there were a bunch of things that could have been better maintained, but for the price and convenient location, I'd use it again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My husband and I were visiting Santa Barbara last weekend and found this restaurant on Yelp.  It is a quaint restaurant with some tables outside that were occupied.  Our server who I think is the owner was very friendly.  The service was fast and we enjoyed our sushi.  We'll definitely come back when we are in town.

Do not come here looking for first-class accommodations or top-tier service.  You will not find them.  What you will find is decent sushi at a good price and fairly efficient but not attentive service.  If you go with the right mindset, you will have a good meal

This restaurant is amazing in every aspect.  The staff, atmosphere, service, and most importantly, FOOD, are top of the line.  Our waiter recommended the Sausage, Honey, Calabrese Pizza... it was delicious!  Who would have thought, right?!  I would definitely go back here again the next time I visit Nashville.

I really enjoyed my first experience here and am looking forward to returning. Fish tacos totally exceeded my expectations and the scallop special with sweet potato was delicious. Mattie provided exceptional service. Enjoyed the margarita that I decided to have another for dessert.

This place is right off the beaten path. Seems to be a nice place to drink, dance and meet people.

We stopped in for a night cap and the people were still flooding in.

They have security at the entrance, for checking IDs and handling any issues that may arise in the later evening.

Joined a few friends here while we waited for a table for a restaurant nearby. I was only here for a few minutes. The ambience was somewhat casual with a room full of pop culture references. There was trivia going on Thursday nights. The main floor can get quite cramped. I definitely want to check it out during the weekends.

The place looks great,  but that is where the great ends.  Unimpressed.. plan and simple.  Would prefer to wait 20 min for bagel bites than spend a little longer than that for food that will make me regret eating.. leave me with that belly full but appetite not quenched feeling.

Probably best sushi places I've found in this area. Ordered the miso soup, spicy tuna roll and Santa Claus roll, all were delicious. Food didn't take too long, and Our waiter was on top of everything and checked in multiple times. Overall a great experience, would definitely recommend

This is by far the best pizza out of all the locals in town and surrounding. The staff are super friendly and I believe it to be priced well. We used to frequent another local place but felt the pizza was missing something so decided to give Joey's a try and haven't gone anywhere else since!

I special ordered 8 cases of Grolsch 15.2 flip tops and got for 7.99 a 4 pack 51 cents under Win Dixie as I am a home brewer and the flip top are great but the down side is they usually sell for about 2 dollars a bottle so basically I got the beer for free

This place is hipster, not tasty.

They do offer alcoholic ice cream flavors, but their "fun" selection of flavors doesn't make up for the lack of taste. The ice cream flavors were really off putting, makes me wonder how this place has great reviews... thanks obama

Good spot with a very laid back atmosphere. Very nice patio area to hang out as well as a pool table which from what I saw seems to be free anytime to play a game. Ryder is a very knowledgeable and attentive owner who shows pride in his establishment. I'll be back many more times for certain

It was a great place. Nice and clean. Waitress wasn't super friendly but not rude either. Food was great. You can tell it's cooked to order and from fresh ingredients not pulled from a freezer. Would eat here again and definitely recommend. We thoroughly enjoyed our experience. Compliments to the chef.

Managers stood buy as they were trying to sell their subscription to the car in front of me while the other lane had 6 cars go into the watch.  When I asked the manager about he pretty much said "too bad".   Stay away.  These guys could care less about you.

Great experience! And very fast. I was in and out of the wash area in like 2 min. It's a little pricier than others in the area, however I'd say it's worth it and they do offer an inexpensive monthly membership. Free vacuum is a great perk too. My car looks brand new!!

Food was amazing staff is either overworked or insanely slow, Heard 1 lady complaining that because the governor ordered it doesn't mean it's a law, It was clearly a staff members the other staff members were yelling at her, She was threatening to quit Over it hope she does Place has very good food Staff needs to help

Really bad service. I ordered prickly pear shrimp taco, but only got a shrimp taco-- the waitress was just not listening. Ordered another margarita, but took 30 mins for them to bring it to me. Don't think it's a place I would like to go to for another time or recommend to others...

The special lasagna with pulled pork was spicy and quite good and very filling.  The tri-tip was decent although a bit tough and overly smoked, but the horseradish potatoes were really good.  The prices are very reasonable for both wine and food and the service was fantastic.  Overall a very solid restaurant.

Surprising to give 4 stars for a museum restaurant, but it was good, better than what you'd expect. Prices were high like any other similar establishment. 
Great selection of option including healthy choices. You can get a greasy cheese burger, a salad, or a protein bar and fruit. Something for everyone.

I have been in this salon 5 times, I kept coming because they did a good job on my nails and the location is convenient, however I always have been disappointed with the customer service. They lost 2 clients today for the awful experience my friend and I received, never coming back

What can I say Tammy did such good work before now it's like she just cuts you, you tell her and she says "it's ok" as she taps the cut.., she over books and always says 5minutes..., unsanitary there has been two occasions when I go to her my toes get swollen. Not only that she has been sloppy with her work and does what she wants.

Very straight-forward take-out fare. I have only tried two dishes - a simple broccoli in garlic sauce, and a tofu with vegetables - and also hot and sour soup. I liked them all. Veggies were fresh, sauce had a nice tang. Recommendable and very well priced.

Great guy, the most polite and caring hairdresser I've had. While some Asian salons have told me I have too much hair to work with, Joe told me I had a lot of hair, and it was good *swoons* I loved how he cut my hair, and it turned out great to me. Not much more to say except i'll be going here from now on.

Brought my car here for an alignment, they said to just drop it off and pick it up tomorrow because it would take that long!  Couldn't believe it!  Then when I mentioned something my father-in-law fixed, who is a retired mechanic, they didn't know what it was!  No way am I coming here again!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I wish I would have found out about them sooner! I've been here twice and both times have been awesome. I had a fill in today since my daughter is due any day now and JOE was phenomenal! He was so friendly and personable. He did an amazing job...my nails look even better than the first time. I'll definitely be back!!

It's nice to have a break from dining hall food, but service can take upwards of 30 minutes. A verbal fight happened today behind the counter and delayed service by 10+ minutes.

The service isn't well optimized for busy times! Making each sandwich individually slows down the line and often leads to mistakes.

Vincent's is the #1 Italian restaurant in New Orleans! The complimentary fresh, hot bread and garlic butter is soo good that it's hard not to fill up on it before the entree arrives. The entree also comes with a salad and pasta side dish of fettuccine alfredo, which is a nice touch.
The portions are very generous :)

I want to say that this McDonalds is amazing! Its clean, the employees are not only friendly but our order is always right! I live in the Danville/Avon/Plainfield area and I wish you would train the McDonalds there! I have ordered thur the drive thur, inside and mobile app. Always s great experience.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: It's a cute little restaurant with very friendly staff. My boyfriend really enjoyed his vegetarian pizza. I ordered a veggie pizza without cheese and it was okay. Not many vegan or even vegetarian options at all. It's okay pizza, but it's more a place for meat eaters unfortunately.

This place is awesome! I live downtown so I walk here for dinner all of the time. The Al Pastor on the tacos or nachos is my absolute favorite. Great horchata as well. The service is a bit slow & lacks at times, but the great food and decent prices definitely make up for it.

Went in on a rainy Sunday evening. There was live mariachi and it was very busy! Service was fast, our waiter was shy but very nice. We noticed all the wait staff helps each other out. Random staff would walk by and pick up our used plates or offer refills. I am Mexican and was very pleased with the flavor and food.

Not the best pizza in town.  Not a long wait for a Friday evening.  Server was very polite and helpful.  Would have been a 4-4.5 if pizza had more flavor and less grease.  Glad I tried it since its local, but moving on to a few others based solely on taste.

They have some good selection of platters... I had the Happi Platter, which has Dynamite Roll, Beef Roll and California Roll along with edamame. The food quality was average (edamame was really undercooked). 

Overall, it's ok for a quick meal if you are not expecting much.

A very nice hotel!!
The rooms are spacious and clean. Nicely decorated without much frills or thrills.

It has a small lounge for breakfast, included with rooms. Room service for in room dinning is not available, but you can pickup your order from the downstairs. 

The staffs are excellent and supportive.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: They were so nice when I walked in and said they could complete the nail design that I requested. As customers came in and they got busy, service quickly faded. The owner became rude and impatient. Also, my nail design was not what I asked for, just do yourself a favor and go elsewhere.

Insanely convenient being connected to the airport. Check in was easy and fast. Very pleasant Collita checked me in. The exec lounge is closed so they gave me extra points. Nice upgraded room. The hotel bar & grill is open. It's been remodeled and the gym and pool are open (covid).
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Food was good, I got a burger without a bun. They got drink wrong, I ordered Diet Coke and they gave me Dr Pepper and I didn't realize until I was in car. Also- it was a foggy day/ their floor was so moist inside you almost fell and hurt yourself and I was wearing tennis shoes with good traction and not in hurry.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Originally, I came here to drop off a car so I thought I'd return since my first experience went so well.

Now I understand all the poor reviews. The gentleman who "assisted" me today made no effort to hide his apathy. He seemed bothered by me and my questions. Never again.

This pizza is really awesome!! 

I've ordered from them several times, each time there pizza has been phenomenal! 
These last few times, we ordered their Keto pizza crust and it was delicious. 
They are fast, friendly, and have never messed up our orders. I definitely recommend to everyone!!

Simply put, Leo's was good but not great.  Maybe it was just the plate I ordered but it was nothing special.  In a city that prides itself on its Mexican restaurants, Leo's was just fine...but not better or worse.  Plus side was a very friendly staff and cozy environment.  Not my first choice for Mexican food but would go again.

Completely ridiculous, One kind of bread.  The poor kid behind the counter had no idea how to make the sandwich my mom ordered.  She had to pick something else. He was the only one working, No help!  
Hardly any toppings, People walking out!  Is there a manager around anywhere??  What a joke!

The staff greeted me as soon as I cake in, there wasn't a wait. I got the Love Me Tender" Pedicure. The lady who did my pedicure did a good job with the massage, cutting cuticles and polish. However,  the callus removal could have been better. The price wasn't bad but the place I normally go to offers a lot more for $3 more.

Food was good and service was good but this is the smallest sushi restaurant I've ever been to in my life. The tables are too close to one another. I was kind of uncomfortable eating here. I've even lived in NYC and the tables were not so close to each other. I won't be back here for this reason. 
Sorry

Classic spot to go out and get a great meal in the city! Snug and cozy, you walk in and immediately get an overwhelming feeling of "home." 

BYOB, and still a place you can get dressed up and have a fancy meal.

You can't go wrong with any of their pasta dishes.

Servers are awesome, very professional and personable.

Out of a big chain they are pretty good carwash. Even if you get the $20 ultimate it's a good deal. They ah e recently installed new bug sprays before you get to the main wash. This place is always busy. I think my only complaint is they are starting to get too big for themselves and customer service has fallen.

Not impressed and probably won't be back.  Blandsville this should be renamed.  The funghi pasta is mushrooms over pasta with a water splashed over it.  It was the epitome of UNFLAVOR.  The chicken in the alfredo tasted like nothing as well.  The higight was the tiramisu, but I can find that just about anywhere.

Very popular local spot in Hyde park. This place is always busy and good for a quick bite. But typically is very busy, loud, and crowded. Service is always very average and food is overpriced for the portions. Things add up quickly for what you get at this casual spot that is hyped up far more than its worth.

For weeks I haven't been able to use the TD bank app because the website has not worked !! This is a horrible inconvenience because I do the majority of my banking online , and they (TD) don't seem interested in fixing the problem !! TD bank doesn't deserve not one star !!!

Price was average for my oxtail noodle soup $7. But it was so bland. I had to add flavors myself, and still couldn't find it justice. I saw other people eating dumplings, which looked really good. Maybe I just order the wrong thing :( Next time I will go back to try the dumplings, cuz the price is pretty cheap there.

I love the staff here. The products are great. Store is clean, neat and orderly. The prices are too high, though. That's really my only complaint about this place. I like it other than that. Would recommend.
My favorite thing about this store is their Huckleberrys side.  Love this section. They have the best products.

This hotel was the worst I have ever stayed at. I went to sleep normal and woke up full of bug bites. I went to complain with the front desk and they just shrugged it off like no big deal. First and last visit at La Quinta. Really bad quality controls. How hard is it to make sure rooms are safe to sleep in.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: They had a great takeout service available due to Covid. You can't dining but the food stays fresh enough until you get home. I had a variety of rolls and thoroughly enjoyed each of them. We plan to get takeout for New Year's Eve to celebrate the end of 2020..

Got an unexpected call from assistant vice President Wanda black who was unbelievable to me on the phone and truly valued me as a person and customer she is what brought me back super sweet pleasant and grateful sometimes things go sour she understands this and made it right GREAT credit union much luv to Nevada one

This pizza was really good. I felt like I was eating pizza from my old neighborhood in NY. I was looking for a pizzeria close to my job, so Yelp sent me here. I ended up passing by a couple of pizza shops before I got here. I'm glad that I didn't change my mind and grab any old slice.

I haven't lived in Tucson for well over 12 years (live in NYC) however, I come down quite frequently to visit with family. Despite not living here, I still come here for my eye exams! They have my records from when I was in the 7th grade! 

I come because it's easy, it's quick, and I like the doctor.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Angelo's is my first choice for food for a family night out OR catering. We order Chicken Bosciola for every home or work party and people ALWAYS ask where the food is from. Every meal is custom and every pizza is amazing. Consistently good food and it's family run, so it's warm and inviting.

Did not like my sub.  Got the BLT. Way too light on the vegetables.   Asked for extra on a couple items did not receive.  Also had the Italian  herb bread.  Was super thin and I'm not sure cooked all the way.  Just like millions of other folks, I've been a subway fan for decades.  So bummer

This is one of my top three Italian choices in Tampa! They just added zoodles as an option which is great for everyone that is watching their carbs! The happy hour is great and we love to sit in the outside alley way with the hanging lights for a great vibe

Wow, I am so happy we found this place! We got the $7.99 any burger Monday special and everything was great! The burgers were huge, well cooked and flavorful. We customized our order and they got everything correct. 
We can't wait to try more items on their menu!

Jimmy and his mechanic did great work  on my car's electrical system and they both showed me what had happened to the battery. They explained the situation very clearly and even waived the $50 fee for the battery and charging system test. I would definitely recommend AASTRO to anyone whose car needs major repairs.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Haven't eaten at a Hardee's in years but I was glad I stopped at this one. Had the mushroom and Swiss thick burger and small fry. Everything was fresh and hot but there wasn't anyone in the restaurant when I got there (7:30PM) and the dining room was not clean. Need attention to the tables a little more often

The fish is great!! Large portions and very fresh but the rice quality is very subpar. We do love the staff and they have become friends and we regularly frequent. Giving it four stars for everything minus the rice which is an easy fix because we turn it into sashimi :)

No, just No.

I'm sure this will be deleted with all the other negative posts that I know others have posted.  

But all I can say is if your pet needs help, there are more qualified and compassionate places.   

The experience was far beyond bad.   So sad.

We did take our cat to another hospital.  VSEC, Philadelphia.   They found that path Hope was sending us down was unnecessary - no surgery was needed.   Administered the proper treatment and my cat is now well.  We were correct in not trusting the advice from Hope.

The food was good quality and served hot. Tried just aabout everything on the menu other then the sushi over a few visits. Service at times can be really slow, especially when busy. They are not over staffed by any means so I suggest going at off times. All in all a great meal for a cook as you order all you can eat.

If your looking for that true Barber Shop experience then RJ's is the place to go. Not only a good place for a haircut but there is usually some interesting conversation going on. I've been going there now for several years and recommend RJ's as one of the best in Tampa Bay.

Had a few rolls and pieces of sashimi. The sashimi texture was a little too chewy and not melt in your mouth, and the rolls were ok but nothing that interesting. The hikari roll was my favorite but it really just tasted like a regular spicy tuna roll for twice the price.

Lucky's is always there when everything else is closed but that's about all its good for. If your looking for Chinese food Chili Szechuan is just 1 block and AMAZING. If your looking for dutches, backwoods, and loosies just go to 49th and Baltimore where their cheaper and fresher.

I would give zero stars if I could. Everytime I order it's messed up and missing items, you're on hold for over 20 minutes just to call and report the issue. The staff is rude and hangs up on you. The manager backs the rude behavior. Will not order from here again I don't need to be disrespected while just trying to feed my family.

Been here several times.  Normally, a nice bar.  But it's just that....a bar.  Recently went in, actually surprised it was open, none of the staff wearing masks, when asked why they weren't wearing any, they just scoffed.  Shouldn't it be closed because it is JUST A BAR?!!!?!

Edited review:

We talked to the owner and our situation is better understood. A very rude and hurtful technician lead to a terrible experience for my close friend, but this has been rectified and confusion is gone. My cat loves this vet but we are more cautious moving forward.

I stop here in a pinch. I usually get one of their salads on the go and for the price it's not bad. Sometimes I get the McChicken also. It's not slapped together like other locations. So if you're in a time constraint and need a quick lunch I wouldn't turn my nose up at the local Mickey Dees
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The donuts were o.k. The cleanness of the place was kinda gross and we got there at 9am. It was also annoying trying to tell the guy what donut we wanted when he himself didn't know what location they were at cause no labels. . I will stick to Doughboy donuts

Falling behind their competitors in both quality and value. It isn't even a good "quick option" anymore because of the bad food. McDonalds is now phasing our the dollar menu. Odd that people still going there in my opinion with all of the better choices available.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Best Service/Caramel-Iced-latte around! I have been to multiple Dunkin' Donuts in PA and this branch/location is the ONLY place that gets my coffee orders right, including Caramel-Iced-Latte; my favorite!!  Also; they truly know how to move a long drive-through line.  The employees are very polite and know their stuff

Worse BP ever! I ordered here twice in a week and I work nearby.  Both times I requested to make sure they have a fork in the delivery and both times they failed to provide that.  I called the restaurant and they did nothing about it.  I am definitely not ordering from here again because their customer service licks ass.
