Was in town for a baby shower and came here with my uncle and cousins. I love the BYOB tradition in Philly and this place does not disappoint. That night had a grouper special with crispy risotto that was wonderful. But the highlight was getting to hang out with 8 wonderful family members.

I got my slices to go.  I used to go there a lot when it was named something else. I got a veggie slice that had too much olive oil on it which made my toppings come off.  The other slice was ok.  Ok so 3.25 a slice I can get a small cheese 2 blocks down for 2 more dollars!

Super easy rental process. Everything is done electronically which is nice. Just make sure you take a photo of the gas gauge if you return after hours. This is the second time I got hit with a completely inaccurate filling fee. Also, my nonsmoking vehicle reeked of smoke.

They have a great HH 4 - 7 with flavored Stoli Martinis for $3.  I ordered the tortelloni carbonara and while I liked the sauce not a fan of the sausage. The bacon wrapped shrimp were very tasty. The Veal piccata was tough and the veggies a little too al dente. Will probably be back for happy hour but probably not for food.

Habe been here multiple times and everything I've ordered is always on point!!! Tonight we had the pleasure of being served by Italian Mike Casio. Stellar service and perfect recommendations for the table.  
If you have the chance you better not miss this gem.

We ordered a pick up order , it's made fresh so it took about 15-20min not bad but the food was cheap and the portions were huge we both enjoyed it I had got the chicken rice bowl and the beef rice bowl but the beef is just strips of steak cut up expected something different but still great !

Forget Manchu..... This place is winning if ur looking for some good fried rice and chicken wings!!!! Area isn't so pretty and it's a convenient store but don't let that shit fool u.... Quick food. On the go food. Don't feel like cooking and ur home alone food. Fat girl Fat boy moment food!!!! Idea gotten. Basically food is delish.

Today was our first visit as new patients. Great service, loved the selection of eye wear. Dr. Imler was thorough with both our teen boys. They said it was a great experience and the staff and doctor were friendly and kind. I highly recommend Progressive Eye wear.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Well, it's been a month since my last visit, and I thought I'd give Shogun another chance. There were fewer customers than last visit, but we still had to track someone down to order and then get our check.

The food is decent and worth the trip. If you go, just be sure to stay on top of things to keep the visit moving.

filthy restrooms, and the burger I ate made me sick as a dog. I have gone here once a week for the past  yrs because the food was good. I called and left a message and even emailed them to let them know. NO response.. A long time customer who will not be back

The Bloody Mary and pickled green beans are fantastic. Service is NOT enthusiastic. If you come here do NOT associate this with the hospitality or service you will receive in New Orleans. The hospitality in New Orleans is definitely top notch. Just not here. But your options are limited in this airport.

This was the second time in 3 recent trips that there was no hot fudge. How can you have a sundae without hot fudge? I'm not slamming them because the world is funny right now and perhaps there are supply issues BUT I honestly don't think that's the case. The server seemed nice and offered a genuine apology.

What an honest business!  Everyone was wonderful!  I thought I was facing an $800-$1000 repair and after Dan's Brake World looked at my car it only needed brake hoses totaling $140 including bleeding brake, fluid, and labor! What a load off my shoulders and what a great place to go!  I'll be back!

Love Marco Polo!! I always get the same thing every time I go--the penne vodka. The pasta is cooked perfectly and the sauce is so fresh and has so much flavor. There hasn't been a time when I went and was disappointed with the food. Whenever I'm in the mood for good italian food, this is the spot to go!

Nice location not far from Nashville downtown but far enough away not to be in the hussle and bustle of the city. Nice rooms very clean. Very nice people at checkin. The only complaint is the breakfast. The eggs were watery. Other than that it's the traditional continental breakfast.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: If you find a long queue next to a gas station in Conshy, you've reached Scoops. It's our local go-to place for ice cream sundaes. We love their chocolate soft serve and Graham Slam sundae...Lots of hand dipped options. Big portions, so make sure you have a big sweet tooth. Kind staff. Open for just Spring and Summer seasons.

Wonderful, family owned Italian spot. Pickup or eat in the modest dining. I've been eating here since I was in high school and have never been disappointed. When we host families over for a pizza night- this is our go to! Stop by and enjoy some great food and friendly service.

Good service and decent coffee for $2.75. This was a very busy place around noon. If you are looking for a place to study or get work done a lot of people clearly enjoyed doing it here. I found it to be a somewhat distracting environment that would hinder my productivity but I enjoyed chatting over a cup of coffee on the couch.

Ehh... went on a Friday night,cute place but that's about it. Asked the guy who waited on us for a menu, they don't have one... no food either (which I just read is in the near future) waiter/ drink delivery guy was not exactly pleasant. We had one so-so drink and walked to Frenchys. I'll give it another shot in the future.

Second time ive been there in the morning , been told i cant order a burger , told broiler was down , i can understand once but twice ? Its BURGER king & i cant order a burger ? I aint the too crazy on things but this makes me go crazy , lol -fatpeopleproblems?

Couldn't be more positive about this place, and it starts with the service: owner and staff greet people by name when they come in, service is EXCELLENT, restaurant is clean and organized, and the donuts are GREAT. Unique styles and flavors while maintaining great taste. HIGHLY recommend.

Look delicious... minus the fly. The other day I saw a fly pee on my curtain and watched it absorb into about an inch of a wet spot. That fly has been on that donut for going on 4mins and counting. Donuts look so good but I'm afraid I'm not brave enough like my friend who ordered two and enjoyed them.

I enjoyed their sushi rolls, but the miss soup was only luke warm. Nice ambiance and very friendly service. Three stars due to the sub-temperature soup, along with violations found during their recent health inspection. Not the worse, but when serving sushi PLEASE store the food at proper temperatures!

Over charged me for a meatball ., made me wait 30 minutes. Almost had to leave but they came through in the End . I think 9.00 is a bit much for a meatball sandwich that the menu said $7.50 . So three stars is the best I can do . I said the sign is showing $7.50 along with most the rest the subs , she acted like I had three eyes .

Best and creamiest ice cream in the city! My favorite place to go with my daughter. The black chai is soooo good! And yes it's black ice cream!   All sorts of fun seasonal flavors. When you walk in, you are taken in by the dreamy and delicious smell of the fresh waffle cones! The staff is sweet and accommodating.

Love this Starbucks .. I think the manager, I'm not sure is always pleasant and makes sure customers and staff are wearing masks .. and he even wipes the door handles constantly and it gets super busy in there in the morning, but service is always fast and pleasant

This bar was appropriate to visit so close to Halloween, because our experience here was horrifying. I don't want to waste anymore of my time on this place than I already spent there. I feel sorry for the bands that have to play to meager crowds of disgruntled patrons. Even Jon Taffer from Bar Rescue couldn't save this disaster.

I mentioned to the Cahier about all the bad reviews.  They charged extra for what.   It a small van ?? 
I tipped them well and noticed the vacuum was terrible and they didn't clean all the widows. Even w am nice
Personal tip.   So i guess the quality has dropped. 
Well it's a shame the are new hand car wash cheaper up on hwy 19.

This restaurant is great! The food Is awesome, especially the tacos, and the drinks are really good too. They also have other food options, such the chicken soup (which is amazing) and the chopped salad (the best thing ever). In recommend this restaurant for lunch and dinner.

I wish there was a 0 star rating , guy in the drive thru was so rude , I couldn't hear him thru the speaker , then I said hi! He replied I TOLD  YOU TO WAIT!  I just left I should share this location in my social media so people never go there I'm sure 500k followers will want to know about it!

This is your standard sushi restaurant, with a more romantic setting. The food was delicious, and the prices are slightly higher than what I'm accustomed to, but still reasonable. The waitstaff were polite & very much on top of things, as we did not wait long at all at any point throughout the evening.

Cold hash browns. This McDonald's ALWAYS has cold hash browns. And the service is by far the worst of all the McDonald's restaurants I've visited in my lifet. I've given this particular McDonald's several chances to redeem themselves and they've managed to fail every time. This place is a joke
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Overpriced but OK. Pizza dough is bland but crunchy. The cheese is melty.

The location of the beverage dispenser is bad, it creates a bottleneck. 

The free wifi never connected. 

I like the redesigned space, it is far more modern than the menu which is very old-timer. I am not coming back.

Multiple credit cards and mortgage and car loans and I'm done with chase for good.  They don't care about you at all and I recently sold my house and both realtors were discussing how bad chase is and how they have a lot of hidden fees that other banks and credit unions don't charge for .

Super cute and intimate when you're in the mood for Mexican. Indoor and outdoor seating available. On the night I came, I made reservations and still had to wait by the bar while a table was getting ready. Pretty upbeat. I had the shrimp enchilada and it was pretty good and filling.

Oh how I wish I could give a better review. The food was okay and the service great. However the woman who checked us out didn't acknowledge us, ask if we enjoyed the meal, or even thanked us. She was very rude and spent more time chatting with her coworker than to give us the proper attention. So... we won't be returning.

My steak quesadilla was amazing, my friend ordered the aguachiles and they were really spicy so be carefull. Food was authentic Mexican really tastefull, didn't put five stars because the servers were really slow bringing us drinks and even to check us out.

Sakura is known as the best sushi in Indy and I would definitely agree. Their rolls are authentic, fresh and bigger than most restaurants. It can get pretty busy on the weekends and the restaurant is quaint so I recommend making a reservation or takeout. The service was a bit slow for sushi but definitely worth it.

Red Bank Veterinary Hospital At Home service is the best vetinary care my cat Lucy ever has received.  Dr. Avery and Miss Laura are wonderful!  Very thorough, kind, gentle, caring, loving care in your home!  So stress free for my Lucy. Thank you Dr. Avery and Laura ! Highly recommend you to all !

What can I say about this place? 
This is the closest to authentic Mexican tacos! Tiny place with friendly staff and they have a bar where you can add salsa to your tacos.
Talking about salsa, it's a very important part of a taco and their salsas are the bomb!

This was the most disappointing pizza I've ordered. Crust and sauce were tasty, toppings very sparse. I ordered pepperoni and extra cheese, there were maybe 3 slices of pepperoni on half the pie. The chicken was was the same, maybe 3 pieces on half the pie. Don't waste your time or money.

Meh. Tasted like day old sushi. Hard rice. Slightly browning cucumber. Low-quality ingredients. It didn't even look good. 

If I were you, I'd save your money and pass. 

I'm still struggling to find a good sushi place in this area. I'd rank Sushi Land in Bryn Mawr way above this one (and I'm not even that crazy about Sushi Land).

I worked here a billion years ago, and I still come back for my favorites. It can get pretty greasy (cheat day!!!), and the staff is almost always teenagers, but they're friendly for the most part. Prices have gone up a lot but it's still a nice treat now and again.

My man booked us a trip to Nashville to celebrate VDay! Yeah, it was a week early, but we planned it that way! The hotel is near plenty places to eat and extra explore. The view from our room was awesome! We would definitely stay here again. FYI, the parking here is $32 nightly...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: 6/20/21 super good ice cream! Plenty of parking  and a decent selection of ice cream although they were sold out of a lot when we visited.  Be aware they ONLY TAKE. CASH!   The employees are friendly and the place is small.  It's worth a stop for some dessert.

So sad that they aren't open, but they did amazing. Last place I went before quarantine. 
So my friend and I went, they have several pedicure options...ranging from full relaxation to regular pedi. 
I got dip nails, which I was impressed with..they even gave me a massage while they did my nails.

Can't wait to see you guys again!

Thank you Mt. laurel animal hospital, you guys are amazing and caring.  I had to take my granddog in for an emergency and they couldn't be more helpful and caring.  At 4 in the morning, the receptionist Cherrie to the tech and vet, such nice people.    Excellent service and attention.  Thank you all.

Excellent food and service!  The Blackened Salmon Oscar was truly delicious... the red pepper cream sauce with crab went really well with the salmon, and the risotto was a nice touch.  The crab cake and pretzel stick appetizers were both tasty, and they have good sweet tea.

I booked a night recently through a third party booking site for $150, at the end of the day I ended up paying $250...This place is a scam and has terrible customer service. Will never be staying here or another Hilton location ever again and will actively advise people I know to do the same.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I found my place in Boise, Cool Vibes! Chuy LISTENED and understood I came from a Barber in Fort Lauderdale I had for 13 years and he knew exactly what I was concerned about. He told me what he was doing and why .  Plus they have a cool bar next door to grab a beer on them. Ironwood Social is the bar.

This is a must when visiting Bourbon St.! One drink is enough trust me. I tried the skinny hand grenade which still has a very good flavor. The horny gator was also very good. But my favorite was the shark attack. It taster like kool-aid. This place was seriously so much fun.

Always double check your menu on the screen before you pay.
There's communication issue. Strongly recommend use numbers after menu such as "salmon and tuna poke bowl, 2 of them" other than "2 salmon and tuna bowl." You might get twin Salmon roll and 2 Tuna poke bowls...

This has become one of our favorite beach bars. Drinks are reasonable, large food selection with some unique items for the beach (cheese curds, poutine, lots of burger options). Wish they had a few other flavors of Vodka, but we will definitely come back for the food!

I'm from maine and went down to st pete beach. My  rack and pinion went on the way down. decided  this was the place I was taking my car to. I called them on a Thursday and they got me in on a Monday. Awesome service and in a timely manner.  They also saved my vacation. I'm so glad that I went here.

One of my favorite authentic tacos in Nashville. It is a hole in the wall - food truck/restaurant. The tacos come in 2 fresh tortillas and the meat is very flavorful. My favorites are the Carne Asada and Al Pastor. Great green cream sauce as well to top off the tacos.

Every single time I visit this business on Canal St., the service is great.
The frozen yogurt is no different than any other Pinkberry - it's delicious, as usual.

I just have to say that I'd rather drive the extra 3 miles from mid-city to go to an establishment with impeccable service.

I sent back the kale salad, the dressing was not prepared correctly, and I was not charged. My Cesar salad was ok, but nothing great. The eggplant appetizer was fine, but would not order again. Pasta dishes were ok, but nothing that will bring me back. Service was very good and new location was nice.

Good food, but don't get delivery.  Takes way too long and the girl on the phone has no idea what's going on.  For one, she sounds like you're inconveniencing her by calling to ask where your food is after 2 hours.  Again, the food is good but they have to get their delivery and reception process up to par.  It just stinks...sorry.

They have a decent amount of equipment so you can get a workout in but where they are lacking is not having  barbell bench(s) or a simple bench to do dumbbell presses/any other seated work where you need back support. To compensate for this they have benches that fold up into some awkward seat.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Bad service and bad store..i order too much things ,and paid for money, but the store don't give me enough food , such as :no French fries,no large hot tea,no large  iced tea ,no 6 PC buttermilk crispy chicken tenders meal ,,I paid the money,but don't give me them,I am angry and unhappy!!I don't like the store !!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Don't use this place, it is just a bait and switch for their junk cars. All the crappy cars no one else want go here and they will reserve you a car you THINK you will get then try to push you in some junk.  Travis is the worst customer service agent. He does not care and should not be employed.

We go often enough since it's local. The new menu they have put together in the last month or so is significantly smaller, and portions are smaller. Some of the items are cheaper though so maybe that is why. Service was good last Sat night but we aren't rushing back anytime soon. We aren't fans of the new menu.

We came here recently when indoor dining opened. Had a 6:45 pm reservation & was seated promptly. Low lit lighting made for a nice ambiance. Socially distance seating. Masks enforced. Food was served quickly & hot although we thought a bit bland, drinks were okay. Service was pretty good. A bit pricey. We're glad we tried.

I ordered sashimi - salmon, tuna, and yellowtail.  All three types, bad fish.  Not spoiled, but definitely turning and slippery bordering on slimy.  I did not finish the fish, but I did pay the full tab and left without riling them.  Watch out for the fish!

I can't stand bad pizza but my kids do. So that's as far as I'm going with this review. The only thing it has going for it is location to the schools. Everything comes from a frozen bag. Can't say enough how aweful it is but 12 year olds love it. So there you go.

Lovely resort and a great location.  I was extremely disappointed that it took 3 rooms to finally get one where the air conditioning worked. I had an early check out and I was in the furthest building.  There was no bellman available to assist with a ride and I had to walk in the dark with my luggage.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Seems like a nice place. Cheesesteak was the smallest thing I have ever had! It would have been ok if it had been exceptional? It was not. Had better cheesesteaks in places that had no right selling them. Onion rings seemed like food service stuff? Not worth it. Spent $13 to be disappointed.

Place is great and convenient, not bad if you don't mind, very very low water pressure, no hot water, only warm, thermostats that are not connected, really firm bed, stale bagels, and not able to find a way to get to hotel if driving east on Gult to Bay,THEN THIS IS THE PLACE TO GO.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've never had any problems with chase bank until dealing with this branch.  All other branches go out of their way to help me, but this branch refused to fax my copies of my checks to my accountant.  I've had no issues with assistance with his exact request at any other branch.  Not happy with this branch or the manager.

I like how every sahms location is a bit different. This one boosts a menu with lots of variety. I had the special for Fat Tuesday, a vegetarian jambalaya. I was surprised to see my friends salads came with a piece of coffee cake! The buffalo cauliflower is delish. There's so much on the menu I need to try!

Horrible service. In fact the server forgot about me totally. Didn't even get a menu. Other people were getting menus. The server looked me in the eye twice. Finally had to mention was waiting for a menu. She said oh. I said goodbye. Try hiring more people instead of doing everything yourself

Great little spot on the beach serving authentic Italian food in a cute setting... all with excellent service. 

Our party of five ordered a range of food, from meatballs and bruschetta appetizers to lasagna and pizzas for dinner... and it was all wonderful. 

Cannot wait to come back and try more of the menu.

I have been to this location a few times..all I can say is when it is crowded u risk the chance of being cheated.. I ordered a Frapp.. large.. my mistake, I drove off should have gone back..was pressed for time.. ended up with nothing but chocolate syrup and ice!! .almost 6 dollars wasted!!! because they want to rush your drink!!

Not much "atmosphere", but the food is amazing. Delicious sushi and even better hibachi. I wouldn't go anywhere else for hibachi. You cannot order hibachi from a table in the dining room though. Reservations recommended for large parties who will take up a whole hibachi table.

DON'T RENT AT THE RETREAT! This is the most deceptive, undermining place I have ever dealt with. Management is sub par at best,false advertisement is rampant. Continually changing rules via random, inappropriate e-mails. This place is a total waste of your $$. Heed our advice and look elsewhere.

We tried their indoor dining last night, and it was disappointing. We had to wait a long time for a table with just 2 of us, and the workers were moving very slow. Our waiter was great, but the food was mediocre. So much that we didn't even take our leftovers home.

This place is usually ok with speed of service and taste of food but you have to watch them. A few times I went and they only gave me 1 piece of bacon on breakfast sandwich or no sugar in my drink. Although this isn't a big deal to some I like to get what I paid for.

The staff is very nice and very helpful. The hotel is beautiful and quaint. The rooms are kind of small, nothing fancy, but who comes to the French Quarter to spend their time in a hotel room?! The location is GREAT 3 blocks off Bourbon St. Close enough to walk and far enough to get a quiet night sleep.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Horrible experience. Had an issue with a check deposited incorrectly  due to the team member not listening. Had to call 3 separate times to resolve issue. Each time received completely different information. Take your business elsewhere to safe yourself time and stress.

The donuts are delicious, but stay away from the coffee. I ordered a latte and as I was drinking it, I felt something slimy and chunky in my mouth. I took the lid off, and there was a thin layer of something really gross around the rim of the cup. Curdled milk, or something? Not sure, but I will stick to coffee elsewhere now..

Who ever works the window needs to get another job. Not only was our food absolutely disgusting and inedible she was rude. The tomatoes are rotten on the salad. You can tell by the taste of the food and the color of the fries that they haven't changed out their grease for frying in a LONG time.

Sushi Cortaro has pretty good service and the waiters are attentive. There isn't a lot that stands out about this location otherwise and they have similar Japanese and sushi fare that you would find in any other Japanese restaurant. Quality is decent, but not outstanding.

After reading all the good reviews, I went on to place an order for 1 large pizza, 10 buffalo wings, and a large fry. 

Buffalo wings was trash (undercooked), but the pizza made up for it. 

Delivery driver was disrespectful. I ordered through Yelp and tipped in advance, so I couldn't take it back.

When in Goleta, Lily's tacos is a must stop! Absolutely the best tacos I've tried (even better than the ones in LA imo) so that says it all. Simply loaded with lots of flavor and generously served. My words can't speak enough for how much I love Lily's tacos, highly recommend!

Recently celebrated friends 50th birthday at this hotel.  Great location - just a 5 minute walk to downtown.  Hotel was beautiful.  Rooms were nice and clean.  Staff was always very friendly and welcoming.  Good food and drinks in bar.  Will definitely return!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This was my first time trying In-N-Out and I was excited to finally try it. The cheeseburger was really good, but I wasn't too impressed with the animal fries. I expected a fresher flavor. However, the service was extremely quick and the cashier was extremely polite and helpful.

Super tasty and kind staff. Was pleasantly surprised to see they had dairy-free ice cream made from coconut milk (only one flavor but it was divine)! Only criticism is that the line to order is on a different side than the cash register and crowds tend to get confused, making waits longer.

We've been here for the Baskin Robbins ice cream and they have a nice variety of ice cream flavors. The service is good. They did give us a spoon that had something on it (dried ice cream?) so we had to ask for a new one but otherwise, their food safety appeared to be fine.

I know they are closed right now, (seasonal) but the worst service since the new owners took over.  Workers licking their fingers while preparing orders and when complained to the owner, he said it is hard to find good help.  They have forever lost my business.

Moved to the Indy area from Florida not expecting to find a barbershop like 4:59. Top notch customer service , reasonably priced and Katelynn J  gave me the best cut I've ever had. She even took extra time to make sure I loved it. I'll be a life customer not just for the cut but also for the shampoo too!!!

I've been here twice with my friend now, and both times have been great! We're both Vietnamese so it's nice to speak to the owners in Viet as well. The sushi quality is not the greatest, but it is not bad whatsoever. The rolls can be slightly of larger size, but that's my only complaint. 

Go and support this business!!

Meh!  No better than grocery store sushi the night we were there. The wife and I ordered the Valentine's Day special, and it was slapped together  without care. The rolls fell apart and had way too much rice and not enough fish. 

I have had good experiences at Mikado in the past, but this wasn't one of them.

I'm here every week.  It's conveniently located around the block from my apartment.  It's run by a friendly gentleman.  They do open a bit late in the mornings and close around 5pm and each order takes about a week to clean. But, they do a good job, and also do alterations.  Pricing is reasonable.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: The best quality sushi in the central west end.  I won't name the other sushi restaurants in the area, but kampai is definitely a class above. Always fresh and consistent.  My go-to is a sashimi combo. It's chef's choice but I've never had a bad experience.  The rolls, entrees and appetizers are all good too.

Tyler is great! Prime location to zip in and out for a good workout.  Whether you are just starting to work out, or looking to switch up your current routine, this is the best place to get results! Every single workout is different, so the variety keeps me motivated.  Definitely worth a visit to kick start your fitness routine.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Really did enjoy the coffee from this shop. Unfortunately by the time that I got to my car (right after ordering) the paper straw had falling apart. I totally recommend this place however their drink cups should either be a sippy cup style or have a different type of biodegradable straw. Otherwise will totally be back for more!

If you want to get out of the Quarter, walk through a cute little park, eat Beignets while you listen to talented musicians, city park location is the place to go. To my surprise there is also a Park filled with many sculptures right by it as well. This place is perfect for a Sunday afternoon stroll

Great little spot along Main Street which serves up some seriously good ice cream. Features a wide selection of tastey-looking flavours, portioned generously to say the least ;) Loved the peanut butter fudge swirl - we will for sure make it our preferred place for any ice cream cravings!

We may have had too high of expectations for this restaurant, but left feeling a little underwhelmed. Our drinks and appetizers were good (get the nachos), but our mains were nothing special and the fish tacos were boring, actually. Treat this as a happy hour spot and not a speciality dinner night.

Some of the best sushi we've enjoyed so far in Philly. Shared the Rittenhouse three, one specialty roll and a few small bites to start, all of which were very imaginative and high quality. We were also drawn in by the desserts, something not typical for us but we really loved what we shared...We can't wait to go back!

Please update your hours in yelp and google. This is our second visit to here. The first time, you were closed for a holiday, and today you are opening much later today (Sunday). On google, you are supposed to open at 11:30. Also you can indicate your hours on the answering machine.

Shared 5 rolls with my wife. The Dynamite special roll was definitely our favorite with crab meat, sprouts and scallops on top. We also really liked the Everything Bagel roll. Service was a little slow but it was a nice feel where I could go there casually or for date night. Would go back.

Best Asian food in Fishers area. Fresh and so fast took 10 min to make the food fresh. So flavorful and white meat chicken was so tender. Top favorites: Crab Rangoon's were made in house also love the noodles. Mark Pi chicken tangy and garlicky yummy sauce covered in crispy white chicken chunks.

Great sushi and always a great staff! Monster roll is my favorite! Also really great hibachi! I usually do to-go but eating inside is alright. A little dark but nothing too crazy. Overall I'd say this location has the best sushi in the New Tampa area and it's not even close. Love it!

Horrible horrible horrible. The entree was very small that I finished less than 5 minutes!

We sat outside and there was a fruit fly in my sisters drink. We told the server and her response was "well you are sitting outside." She did not apologize at all or offer her a new drink. The service was horrible. Will not come again

I passed this place for years because of the location and outward appearance ...huge mistake. After a couple credible sources telling me to go, I had to try ...went back twice in 2 weeks. Great Sushi, not overly crowded and comparable prices. Great little tucked away place in Sunset Hills

This place seems poorly managed. When you get what you order, it is perfectly fine, but the wait for it can be a bit more than you bargain for. Might want to build in a little bit of extra time if you plan to stop by. 

The workers have been nice, but it seems like they aren't quite ready to handle things without more support.

The food here is always good, the service is quick and the place is clean. I like to order ahead in the app as you can easily customize the food. Since I don't eat meat it's nice to be able to click the option in the app and not have to get confused looks at the register when you ask. Ha. I'll keep going.

This spot was a great choice for a quick weekend trip! I really wish we could've taken advantage of all it has to offer but due to COViD we could not. Check in was a breeze and the aesthetic was awesome. I would definitely stay here again. Considering it is right on Canal St and 2 blocks from Bourbon St it is remarkably quiet
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Good place to drink cheap beer and listen to the locals talk about the good old days when it was legal to beat your wife. They have ample boat parking which is nice. Bartenders are very willing and NASCAR is always on the tube. If you do go please tip the help, cause shit man, their job sucks.

Had a nice late lunch. My entree was delicious!! Although the chick pea fries we had as an appetizer were so salty we could not enjoy. Our waitress was lovely, but from the moment we walked in we felt as if we were being rushed as they do have a time limit and limited seating. Would go back again though.

These donuts looked delicious at first but once I tried one then I realized how stale they were with no filling in the headlight donut! this place definitely needs to be updated on management to let such nasty food go out the window, My local dunkin I appreciate more since this visit

We went to the safety harbor and we decided to have a slice of pizza at Bravo NY Pizzeria. This was the first time we were trying Bravo NY Pizzeria. For the slice we ordered Veggie Pizza. We got the hot slice of pizza in minutes. The pizza was amazing and delicious. Next time will definitely try other items on the menu as well.

Idk why but this location is just terrible. The food is often inedible. Today I got a breakfast sandwich for myself, and bagel minis for my son which were both burnt to a crisp. Also, got some hash browns that tasted like they were fried in grease that has never been changed. I won't be coming back to this location.

The only people I trust with my hair. Shane is the best and makes sure that everyone on his team mirrors his skill set so that you are always in good hands. I grew up in Tampa and this is the only place I will go. They always provide high quality services and products. The inside is also super cute and artsy so you can't go wrong!

Called in a order for delivery of a large cheese pizza (well done) on a Wednesday night. Asked them to have the driver call, he didn't. The pizza arrived and was very hot and fresh. It was VERY well done and somehow still doughy. The pizza was extremely greasy and seemed like it had extra cheese. My friend and I did finish the pie.

Not the best bar on bourbon st. The specialty drinks are not that great either. We tried a shark attack and a hand grenade. The shark attack was cute, for novelty, but I couldn't even drink it. Was the gimmick of them making the drink worth the $10? Yeah, totally.

Asaka is best for its happy hour sushi from 5-7pm every night it's open. It's closed Monday and Tuesday, and it's only open from 5-9:30pm most nights- but it's worth the trek to castleton for the deal! It might be smart to make a reservation because the restaurant is very small, and we haven't gotten a table a few times.

I'll take Wendy's over the "Golden Arches". There's times they run out of the kids toys but always make up for it by offering a small frosty. They used to offer mixed berries as an option of the fruit but these days it's just apple slices. Their chicken wraps are delish but they always skimp on the lettuce and condiment.

Nice convenience store with hot food you can order. Pretty popular it seems and with small parking lot, you must be quick. Order through phone and pick up open until 9:30 or 10. Support your local business, I like this kind of store. Perfect for single guys.

Good sandwiches. Like but dont love their homemade chips. They refused to make me an order 20 minutes before closing time once. Quite odd. It was a one time issue and have had no complaints since. I cant recommend the BLT from personal experience, but thats what all my carnivorous friends enjoy most.

Glass Water bottle had black mold at bottom. We didn't notice til we had drank a glass. :-( 
Next glass bottle had a chip at top. Wth? Our order was wrong. Been customers  since it opened.
Not the first issue with service. 
Can the owner pls read this. My lunch and future visits were ruined after the moldy water bottle.

Incredibly rude staff, insulted my wife and kids while they were in the store. I have forwarded a long detail review to the corporate office and will not go into all the detail here. The owner of this establishment should reconsider who he/she has on their team!!!

Great spot for a quick haircut! It was definitely the shortest time wise of a haircut I've ever got - I asked for more layers, a couple inches off and thinning out my hair. However the lady that cut my hair was very good at her job and did a decent job for a 10 min cut! I would go back for a quick cut or trim!

extremely average ramen! kind of bland, and they didn't even give us an egg in our ramen, which is mentioned to be included with any bowl. server was very inattentive and kind of careless. atmosphere was super weird with random new orleans jazz that went on and off randomly. lol

Came here to get a fix for my favorite fountain soda and I had to pull into mobile ordering area to wait because they were changing out the soda bags on the system. Really?! So now I've been sitting here for 5 minutes after ordering, paying, and going through the full drive through line.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Open since 1978. Haven't been here since 1998!! We ordered a single layer pizza well done wraith pepperoni, fresh mushrooms, and sausage. A little more on the doughy side and light on the sauce but the toppings are fresh. Owner is very friendly and visited every table while we were here to greet everyone. Comfy family environment.

Love this salon and the staff!! Great prices and amazing quality. I always have a fun experience when I get my nails done here! I have gotten all my work friends to get their nails done here and they have the same feelings as I do. Definitely recommend Glitz!

I just got a meal from this Wendy's, which I go to often & my sandwich is ice cold. I'm incredibly pissed & they didn't even give me my receipt so I can't go back up there or take a survey to complain. Thanks a lot for ruining my dinner!! I really hope I dnt get sick from eating this undone meat...

Always good service and good food here. We have had many things here and never turned down the food.  Fantastic southern sweet tea might I add! So filling on food that you are able to have leftovers for the next day! Everyone will be asking you where your food came from!

Usually I'll get my coffee here and occasionally some donuts. But the last time I stopped by I was served some stale donuts. I don't understand why people can't get rid of the old food first. I've worked in food service and I don't get why nasty food is served. Please retrain!

This is one of my top five restaurants in the Philadelphia Suburbs.  The menu is creative and classic at the same time.  The menu is always seasonally influenced and changes often.  The tasting menus are always fun and a perfect amount of food.  Great place for a romantic date night.

The salad came out frozen - and the dressing was not tasty.   Had to ask for fresh And had salad remade 
Most of the dishes were just OK    But I left food that was not tasty at all 
No flavour in the Miso soup 
The staff were friendly & polite 
The sashimi pieces were large and presented nicely 
I won't go back

Owners are super nice! However, It's extremely expensive for the amount of ice cream you get(which is not a lot) The ice cream was not as good as expected-however the caramel was delicious. They ran out of many flavors early on a Saturday night. Also, it's very cramped inside-the layout is not great

Gotta change this. They took both the pizza and fries off the menu. No offense If you eat here ur a gibroni. They took the best stuff off the menu. Still a very calm atmosphere and inviting dining room on a winter night but in desperate need of a menu change.

I tried to get a rental from here. They gave me the run around. Oh, we don't see your reservation. We can't find the reservation. You will have to reserve a vehicle again. No thank you. Went to Enterprise and was in a car in less then 20 minutes. Don't waste your time.

Apparently the name has changed to 'greener cleaners' but must still be under same management. Staff rude and very unfriendly. They still only take cash or check and you must pay to drop off. Couldn't leave my stuff due to not having cash/check and won't be going back.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Super rude baristas. 

This Starbucks is the closest coffee shop to my office, so I occasionally pop in for a cold brew. I regret it every single time. I'd rather drive across town to French Truck or Cherry where I won't be greeted with an eye roll and a snotty attitude.

The food here is horrible. The sweet and sour chicken is really sweet pork. All the other food we ordered tasted nasty. Not worth any amount of money. DO NOT ORDER from here unless you like crap. 
 Not only was the food nasty BUT the order was messed up and didn't want to go back so we thru it away.

I'm a big fan of tacos, and these are definitely unique flavors! I like that you can order them individually and try lots of different options.They also have tasty handmade drinks and you can sit at the bar or table. They do have a happy hour. It's been open for awhile, but still gets busy in the evenings.

How could you give this place anything but 5 stars?  This has to be the best Imos in St. Louis.  They honestly taste better than any others I have eaten at!  I also agree with the other review on here... The owners truly make the restaurant what it is!  Thank you to them!!!

For $3.75, it's tough to beat this car wash. The brushes are smooth & don't attack you car. The blowers at the end do an excellent job drying the car. They appreciate your business & are very polite. Even Reno PD has all their cars washed here.
Rail City Car Wash is a good deal !!

Terrible experience. First, they sent us coupons so that's the only reason we ordered from here. They didn't accept the coupon. Then what we ordered was not in our pick up. The chicken was super soggy and seemed like it had been sitting out all day. We received the wrong rice as well. Will not be going back.

We ordered 2 Quesidillas for delivery this past Friday night. We live 10 minutes from the Global. After 45 minutes , I call and they say it's in route. 30 minutes later it arrives. Quesidillas were slightly warm. The flavored were ok. The sauces were weird!

Delivery is quick. I have ordered mandarin chicken from them twice now. Come to find out they don't know what "Mandarin" means. They only have sweet and sour sauce for their breaded chicken they call mandarin chicken. (Not deep fried). They are the only delivery for Chinese in the area. Wow, I miss quality take out.

Our new go to spot for sushi!  Other local places have gotten more expensive, smaller portions and sub par ingredients and flavor.  This was our first try and we were VERY pleased.   Fresh, huge selection, nice phone staff and really terrific sushi.  Great job!

Unsure as to why the reviews are so negative - Shake Shack isn't meant to be a gourmet burger joint, it's fast food! Definitely of a higher quality than most fast food burgers and fries & this location is consistent with others that I've visited. Very friendly staff & I think it's great that there's the option to order on a kiosk.

We've been here twice since opening- won't be going back. Very expensive for what you get! Didn't care for the burgers (and I'm a burger person). My husband didn't like the hot dogs. Fries weren't hot! Nothing was hot! Got the same experience both times. The best thing about it, is the peanuts!

Walked in to buy some groceries, found out multiple products on the shelves were expired, walked right out. Lady at the counter was mean mugging since we walked in the door and didn't say hello until I, the customer, greeted her. No hard feelings just sharing so they can improve their customer service, it's for their benefit

Great service cool cocktails and good food about service they are so friendly and welcome they have a lot cool cocktails about food we ordered shrimp salad and beef tounge quesadilla 
Shrimp salad was like wOW huge salad top of delicious shrimp and beans 
Beef tongue was delicious and tasty.

I am a lover of Italian food. I grew up in a huge Italian family and have been to Italy several times. This place was "ok" at best. Food was ok, the setting was ok and the service was ok. I honestly have no desire to go back. Not saying it was bad....but nothing to write home about.

New to the area and decided to try Victoria's Nails since it was 2 minutes from my new house. Was not disappointed! The ambiance and conversation were both very nice and my nails look amazing. Prices are the best in the area, so excited to have a salon close to home.

This pizza is fine I guess. It's not disgusting by any means, but it is pretty bland and forgettable. In addition the quality is really hit or miss during the busy times like Friday night. They have everything you would expect from a pizza joint apps and sides wise, but nothing to really set them apart

The best Chinese food ever! Jade the owners niece is sweet as pie. The food is freshly prepared so be patient. Once you eat here you will never eat at none of the others again. You won't believe that you ever ate at any of them! I promise. Must have the hot and sour soup.

Positano's is my go-to Italian place in the area. There's not much competition, but it also outranks the likes of OG & Carrabba's as well. I have been many times and always try something new, yet I have never been disappointed. Specials are always fantastic.

It's not very express, it is expensive for the sushi ratio you receive, meaning the rolls are unusually small. I don't know if that's how they were trained to make it or trying to save on cost to profit margins... I don't know. I just know for $75 of sushi looked like $40 - $50 worth from many other places.

I have been to several Crew washes and I have to say this is the first time where the attendant pulling me in, Zach, remained smiling and seemed like he really enjoyed his job. Don't get me wrong, the service is great 99% of the time but his personality and smile made you feel good about going! Good work Zach and Crew team!

It's just ok. I ordered a large with double pepperoni to go. Had a friend pick it up and bring home. When I opened the box I was seriously disappointed. For some reason, it was cut into squares and was not double pepperoni. After taking a few bites my friend and I both said "Definitely not worthy of $18 pizza."

Of the several sushi places I've been to in Philly, this one is solidly meh. It was fine, but not great. The fish seemed like it was watery, not very flavorful. I finished my food but wasn't particularly excited about doing so. The bathrooms were grody, there was water staining on the curtains upstairs.

I'm a basic bitch that loves Starbucks so I will leave nothing positive reviews! Service is pretty good for the center city location! It sucks that it's pretty crowded but that's not their fault! Bigger location would help but that wouldn't keep me from coming back and getting my ice cold latte!

So-so.  Ordered and shared a lunch special bento box ( tempura and teriyaki beef), supplemented by a side of edamame and miso soup.  Soup warm, not hot.  Beef very dry.  Perhaps we should have ordered sushi roll, but we thought the bento box was a "miss", despite good tempura.

I really can't tell you how really bad this place is. They are rude and unhelpful. They did not have a car ready it took 40 minutes to get one and it only had a 1/4 of a tank of gas. They said I needed to go fill it up as they don't have cars with full tanks.

Solid neighborhood bar. Best low-key place to grab some drinks and watch the game in Dogtown. Has a decent patio and a little game room in the back that's worth checking out. Sadly the burger place that cohabitated here left so there is no food available. Also hosted a disastrous trivia night the last time I was there.

How can you not love Jeni's?  We just happen to have stumbled upon this amazing ice cream shop and now it's our favorite.

The brown butter almond is my absolute favorite but all are very good.  

Jeni's is our go to dessert stop every time we are in Nashville.

This place always does the maple sugar snacking bacon all wrong, 3rd time this has happened to me at this location, they always forget the sugar, I know I sound like an fat mf, but I'm actually skinny. Just once in while I crave this and this location never does it right, y'all make sure your order is correct before leaving.

Great baconatpr burger sandwich and fries today... too long to wait after ordering although very friendly service. A little pricey compared to other fast food locations.... drink machine unique for sure. Very nice area for customers to eat in and very clean.

This is the worst McDonalds ever, the employees are rude & hateful. It takes longer than any fast restaurant. I was given my food & the employee never said a word when I asked for ketchup I got a sigh & an eye roll. I will drive 10 miles out of my way not to go back. If you can don't stop h
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

I was given my food & the employee never said a word when I asked for ketchup I got a sigh & an eye roll. I will drive 10 miles out of my way not to go back. If you can don't stop here.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I was really looking forward to this since it had 4 stars on Yelp.  But, unfortunately it fell short.  The waitress rushed us to put in our order.  The cocktails were not good. The food came out completely drowned in sauce and the chicken was rubbery.   This wouldn't be my first choice if you are looking for a top notch experience.

Cancun is a great spot for a meal or a drink with friends. They have wonderful outdoor seating. The day we went (it was a Friday), they had a 30oz margarita for $10 (can't get better than that). They serve complimentary chips and salsa and also we ordered queso, which was divine.

The waiter was prompt when we arrived. The food was super yummy, queso was on point. However, nice the food arrived, our waiter disappeared. We needed refills and then the check. We waited for 10 minutes, then finally went to pay without our check. They need to add more waitstaff at lunch.

Bottleworks has a bar inside. While it's just a temporary bar until their main bar is complete they are doing a great job with the drinks and music selection. Super laid back with couches and comfy chairs. Low key. Drinks are about $12 -$15 on average but for a low key, good music spot, I'll pay!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is our go to spot for sushi and it has been for a year now. The wait staff is so friendly and attentive. Their menu has things you won't find at other Japanese restaurants. Try the Saba shio or the chirashii bowl! Always fresh and at the perfect temperature when you get it. Ken always thanks you for coming. Great place.

You can get a boat of sushi for 14.95 which is pretty decent. We got the titanic boat, a baked scallop roll, and crab Rangoon. 30 bucks total which is an awesome price for sushi. The crab Rangoon were sooo small though. They serve you complimentary miso soup, which is always delicious.

Option to eat inside or outside under a tent.  There is also a bar under the tent.  We chose to eat inside.  It was on a weekday, therefore not crowded at all. We did not have to wait.  Restaurant was clean.  Service was good.  Nice variety of options on the menu. Food was overall good.  Pricing was reasonable.  I would recommend.

This was a great hotel stay.  The staff were very kind and the rooms were perfectly clean.  Additionally this hotel is very close to I-65 and several great restaurants.  It's only 15 minutes from downtown Franklin.  This hotel has been added to my places to stay in the future hotels.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I went during lunch so the menu seemed limited. Wasn't bad. Service was solid. Really nice lady was at the front welcoming everyone and even welcoming us back if we went to the bathroom out in the lobby. I guess there are pretty good steak options at dinner so kind of curious about those.

We eat here about once a week. Very reliable. In general very friendly, prompt service. Sometimes they seem a little short staffed and are not the greatest at communicating that. Food is yummy and large portions. Nacho himself is very friendly.  Definitely our favorite Mexican restaurant in Bellevue.

Fritz's offers a wide variety of desserts in a family friendly atmosphere. This is one of those establishments that could continue to add seating and still come up short. 

They start with the basic recipe and offer a wide variety of mix-ins - feel free to try each and every one of them. 

Turtles rock!

Great appetizers but bad sushi! The sushi was chopped up and not rolled properly. They need to learn how to make sushi before serving it. The seaweed was old and very chewy. Not only that, but both my girlfriend and I got an upset stomach after eating here. Old fish = no bueno. However, our server was very nice.

I don't go to Mcdonalds often.  This location shares a building with a bp gas station.  I think I've always used the drive thru. It has a dine in area, but I suspect most of their business is drive thru.  The food is McDonald's, it's consistent for the chain.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Here are the pros: they delivered in a HUGE downpour. They were right on time. Food wasn't fishy at all. Not ridiculously expensive

Cons: Not memorable. The gyoza was average. The rolls were decent, but nothing unique.

Overall, I don't think I'd try it again ... pretty average

Bo's is a must in Tampa. It has a retro feel and genuinely has not changed in the 20+ years I've been alive. The service is ok- not an exceptional experience, but in this case I think that's part of the charm. The ice cream is delicious, indulgent, and exactly what you'd expect.

I really didn't love the ice cream here! The customer service was good, so I definitely appreciate that. However the ice cream itself was very icy (had chunks of ice in it) and not at all smooth and creamy. They do have "odd" flavors which might be the major draw for some people, but the actual quality was lacking.

One of the disappointing eating experiences in a long time. Calamari was heavily breaded and rubbery when I got thru the breading. Also had chicken noodles. The noodles were mush. The sushi rolls were average. To be fair, I had them delivered from 3 blocks away so the noodles might have gone from over cooked to mush in transit.

Stopped in for breakfast before work. I got the impossible breakfast sandwich. It was nice and warm but the corners of the bun were hard as if it had been overheated. I didn't get a drink since I was headed to the office where coffee and tea were available. I'd like to see truly vegan options for sandwiches.

Crispy tacos were crispy on one side. All 4 of them. The burrito was COLD as I got it. Had to ask to reheated in which they ruined the it by just pan frying it on 2 sides. Overall one of the worst Mexican dining experiences I've ever had in this town and Im a local born and raised

Romano's has been my favorite go-to italian resto until last Sunday, they served me a dry and unappetizing sticky toffee pudding. It used to be this super moist layer of cake, but that day, it was not. I am deeply disappointed by that when i tasted it. I hope they can do something about that

I really like this place. The lighting, decor, food, drinks, service! Nom nom! 
I usually order 3 or 4 dishes to share plus an appetizer. I completely love a brunch cocktail they have with st germain and chartreuse. Order the brussel sprouts (i know it sounds lame but you'll be amazed) and the dumplings.

I have only been there once and I really liked the atmosphere. Quiet and relaxing. 
The service was really great, the girl who took care of me was very attentive to detail. 
They have many lotions and nail polishes. Really comfortable chairs and good service bundles. 
I'm not giving 5 stars because I think it was a bit overpriced.

This was the last place I ate in NJ before heading out west, so I've got a bit of a soft spot for it. That said, it really is a perfectly fine place for what it is: a restaurant in the mall. Have reasonable expectations for price/quality/portion and you won't be disappointed.

Blessed that O Sushi is our go-to neighborhood joint!  Everything's been quite good so far, but I've been stuck on the Spicy Korean Ramen special of late.  Delicious!  Wait staff is efficient and friendly, the food is classic Japanese, with some creative items, as well!

I have absolutely no idea what the heLl the hype is about this place.  Sadly I was thiinking I was finally going to get a bit of NY in New Orleans but hell no... wonder if the bohemians even used yeast because the dough wAs crunchy but horrible.   And thanks for the 7 pieces of sausage on my pie!  Never again!

Went here with a groupon last night.  Food was very good.  The salad brought me back to my childhood.  We didn't like the fact that a 22% gratuity was added directly on the bill, there were only two of us, not a table of ten.  We would have tipped generously but would have preferred making the decision ourselves.

Food is decent and fresh at this very busy restaurant at lunch during the week. Employees seem a bit overwhelmed and confused.  Wait for food is so so.  The outside apperance needs paint and sign and awnings replaced because this Wendy's looks like the Kmart of all Wendy's from its neglected appearance.

I am a huge fan of Starbucks! It's definitely helpful to have a cup of coffee or tea to start the morning off but the staff at this location are really rude. 

I've been very patient with them but its not great to deal with impolite people (especially staff workers) when you are looking for a pleasurable day.

This was one of our very best experiences with Hampton! Customer service was above and beyond. The rooms are large and comfy you do have the added expense of valet parking off campus, but the valets were great. If you want breakfast, unlike other Hampton's where it is in the lobby, this one serve on the fourth floor.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great southern Italian cuisine. Everything is fresh and made with love. The exterior is a no for me. It's not very inviting and they seem to just be ok with their local traffic. They could be doing a lot more business but I feel they would rather limit their patrons to Jefferson parish residents

Stopped in during a day trip to try it out.  I had 1/2 scoop of the coffee and 1/2 scoop of the sun popped corn (or something like that).  My partner had the Honey Vanilla Bean.  They were all good, but I don't think I would make a special trip to get any of them.

Some of the best wing dings I've ever had anywhere and I've had plenty. Wing dings and tacos are my favorite foods and this place does not disappoint. Fried well, not greasy or undercooked. I always order my sauce on the side so I can really taste the flavor of the chicken.

Checked in this morning. Front end staff was nice . When you come in it's super nice everything is clean . Then you get to the room. Room was nice , bathroom was dirty . The soap holders had black hair and yellow residue. The wall had black curly hair on the wall . Shower was never cleaned pretty damn nasty
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Food was excellent, slightly pricy but considering the location, that's a given. The portions were very substantial. Only complaint was that our waiter was not very attentive. Had to flag him down a couple of times as he stood around talking quite a bit with fellow coworkers.

Will never take my cat here ever again horrible experience with them .Was shocked when surgery was performed on my cat without my permission or the person who was helping ng with the bill .Very upset over the whole issue my cat is my family member. I only gave a 1 ,if there was a 0 button that's what they would of received.

This is one of the better spots in Manayunk but in my opinion, pretty average overall. It's also consistently packed which does take away from the experience- wait times, close tables, and so many college kids. The spicy margaritas are pretty great though, so I'm hoping the alcohol takeout window lives beyond the pandemic.

Nice place.  Went on a Thursday night.  They close at midnight.  They had a band playing.  Only issue was they seemed a little understaffed.  Took a little while to get a drink and we were the only people at the bar.  I would come back and try it out on a weekend.

Loved the food on this place.  Some unique offerings.  Nachos & salsa were freshly made and were great.  Wings were excellent as was the chicken wrap.  Service was slow.  Only one girl tending bar and serving us.  She was sweet but spread thin.  They desperately need signage .  Had to call to find it

Waited 35 minutes for the shuttle. No one answers when you call the local number and one guy working behind the counter did his best to move people thru. Just a horrible experience and Bonni "the greeter" seems to think. noone has any place to go. The speed of execution and the overall attitude at Alamo Is horrible.

I absolutely loved this Italian restaurant! I had the pistachio chicken with angel hair in garlic and oil sauce and it was the perfect combination with the Pinot Grigio wine. My boyfriend had the lasagna and said it was delicious. The staff was nice and overall our experience was great. Will definitely be dining here again.

I have never had a more thorough exam in my life. So very nice & completely professional. The doctor went the extra mile to make sure I was going to have the right prescription. She answered all my questions & explained everything. I heartily recommend this office. You should not even think about going anywhere else.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I called and told the lady my order she said it would be a 15 min wait so I showed up about 18 minutes later and they told me that it would be a 30 minute. This is what little Caesar's calls really for pick up pizza more like ready to wait pizza. I'm never coming back to this location

Great, homestyle diner in the seedy part of Tampa, the menu make up for the location featuring a wide variety of American-belovéd breakfast items influenced by the Hispanic culture of Tampa, the service here is great and the coffee is always hot, earning the five star review.

Exceptional service, elegant food in an exquisite setting. Like being transported to another world. Attention to detail is exceptional. The food is beautifully prepared and presented. The pairings are on point. The service is exceptional. Reservations are a must. Treat yourself to this decadence.

My wife and I and some friends ate here tonight, and the food was great and the service was fantastic, but having to sit next to this was a bit disconcerting.  We joked 'don't order the sushi.'. But seriously Wei Asian please take care of your fish if you're going to have them.

I only went here because the line for the drive-thru was relatively short.  Based on other reviews, looks like I got lucky.  

Great process for covid, and announcer was knowledgeable about how a deal wouldn't be applied to my order until after the checkout was completed.

Sushi was decent, but nothing extraordinary. I really wanted to like it since it's local, but the actual restaurant feels like it's mostly for delivery, because there were only two tables seated including us. I think this place would be better for delivery, not dine in.

The restaurant was rated ok for us we were a party of 3 its nothing that you want to order here that you can't have any place else we went around 3 o'clock in the afternoon there was more staff then there was customers.  Very lack the flavor. Not a fan don't think I'll be coming back.

Good AYCE Japanese restaurant. It has a good atmosphere, good selection of food, decent quality of sashimi and sushi. Some of the things that stood out the most were: sashimi (above average for AYCE), mussels (though they used to be unlimited), beef short ribs, and most of the other cooked food (zucchini, mushrooms, etc.)

Decent, no frills nail salon. I called to make an appointment with ease and received very thorough instructions on adherence to COVID-19 precautions. I got a gel manicure and normal pedicure. The gel manicure wasn't perfect but the service was good and the people very nice.

Just had after my first visit at Glitz and I will absolutely be back. It was the first time getting dip powder polish and it's gorgeous. My pedicure was relaxing and I liked the music playing. It was a nice place and I couldn't be more happy with my services today. Looking forward to my next visit.

The counter girls are so sweet. It's the annoying short haired manager who spends more time yelling at her employees in front of all the customers embarrassing them than putting together the food I waited fifteen minutes for when I was watching people who came after me, leave before me.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Disappointing dry-ass whole chicken for $28.00. Black beans tasted like tar. Cucumber salad soaked in red wine vinegar was soggy and tasteless rice. Tri tip tacos were flavorless. Hot salsa was good. Grocery store rotisserie chicken and a taco truck much better and you'll save $10.00. Ain't goin back ever!

Great meal at the refinery. The pork belly small plate was great and then I had the rabbit, was dying to try something different and it was great. My wife is gluten free and also can't have salt or butter, they were very accommodating. The service was impeccable and will definitely be back many times....

Service was quick. The portions were small. I received a piece of yellowtail shahimi which the entire backside of it was covered with skin. I sent it back and was not charged.

All in all it satisfied an immediate need for eating sushi but, I felt that I was leaving unsatisfied.
I will not be returning.

We went there for my birthday expecting la hacienda and the la hacienda menu and we're really disappointed not only in a small menu and the outrageous prices but we also were never served. No one even took our drink order. We waited for 30 min before we got up and left extremely disappointed.

I like the customer service at this Rouses the most.  The handicap carts are usually available here, charged and ready to use...a worker even brought one to my vehicle for me to use.  Now that's service!  That's the reason I shop here more, then it's not far from Sam's on Airline.

Great Sushi Restaurant! Excellent Prices for Dinner and Lunch Specials!

Great Service, Staff was very helpful, Sushi Chefs were great! Everything was delicious! Would Recommend to Sushi Lovers!

I would return to this sushi restaurant the next I am in the mood for Sushi.

Tried to park outside his restaurant in an available parking spot and the owner told me he was expecting a delivery. When I didn't immediately move he yelled at me to "go f*** myself" repeatedly and advanced towards me threateningly. Gonna go ahead and skip eating at this one.

Nice people to deal with but the prices are off the wall. Hundred dollar bottles selling for 500. 35-40 for 100. I was a bit shocked when the cashier told me $600 for two 750ml bottles. But judging by the  other bottles by the register I'm guessing many others walked out disappointed.

I previously posted a review in favor of this business but feel it's morally necessary to rescind it as they're choosing to be open and operate unsafely despite covid19 guidelines. They are preparing food and drinks without masks or other safety precautions. No coffee is worth potentially dying for. Skip this place.

We got two pizzas-- a Capri and a green olive and sausage-- for take out.  They were fresh and hot when we got there, and totally delish.  It reminded me of the slices we used to get in NYC, though the bottom crust could have been a little crispier, for my tastes.

Entrees can be hit or miss here.  I've had a couple of good sandwiches/burgers.  On my most recent visit, I ordered a salad with tuna.  It was just lettuce with a slab of not-that-tasty tuna on top, nothing mixed in or cut up.

It is pretty dark inside too.

bad: the line here can get super long, MAKE SURE they gave you ketchup if u asked for it as they tend to forget, the fries are soggy and not hot

good: overall food quality is decent, employee all wear their mask which is good, they make their food fast which is good, they always gave me napkins and utensils if needed

Monthly subscription available. If you are going to was your car at least 2 times a month I think it's worth it. 

Always clean towels. Strong vacuums and floor mat washers free with wash. 

I have tried others. No issues with this one and they have multiple locations.

Too many young teens with lack of social skills & customer service. Order is usually wrong i.e. ask for no pickles, always end up with them or no ice, always get ice. It's the lil things but when I pay for a service I expect it to be correct. But when the order is right it's good at least.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
So  I was persuaded to come back for lunch  It was  like a different restaurant It was really good I just loved my ginger tofu(  yep same dish as last time  It was very  good! as were the Miso Soup and the salad I ate every drop  service was also good
Glad I came back

Every time I bring my dog, everyone is very nice and helpful. My dog is "spicy" is what they call him, and they do such a great job with him regardless. They try every way possibly to make visits for him easy, although he gives them a hard time. Glad I came across this place!

If you like fresh, creative sushi you must check this place out, plus the happy hour deals cannot be beat.   Tried a few items on the happy hour menu + a couple rolls on the regular menu.   My favorite was the lollipop roll- the fish was so fresh. Can't wait to go back for more!

Great hibachi restaurant - especially for the price! Don't expect a fancy place, but it's not bad. Large portions and staff and food were super.
Early bird specials before 6 PM. My friend got the combo with lobster, chicken, and steak, and it was only $24.95. And it was like a whole lobster! Awesome deal.

Out of all sakana restaurants in Reno this one is by far my favorite. The service is always good even when busy. I found the owner to be very friendly and take pride in his business. Try the tuna tataki. Its so tasty with a smoky flavor. Service and Fish quality A++++.

Very big portions for a very low price. Not much that makes it stand out from other Chinese cuisine on campus. Limited seating inside so defiantly have a back up place in mind if you planned on dining in. 

4/5 because it's nothing too special and $.50 for using a card.

They're awesome! Sooo knowledgable!
I am blessed to have been steered towards these two brothers by my regular mechanic, who knew I needed extensive work done to my car they were unable to provide.
Especially can say, for women alone or seniors looking for HONEST
Gentlemen..
You've hit the bonanza!

Worst Starbucks ever. Problems with their order system supposedly. Caused all the girls that ordered after me and some other guy to get their drinks before us. Like we didn't exist the barrista kept calling out what the newest people waiting wanted. Finally we went up to the counter and made a point to demand our drinks

About six weeks ago I was at a subway in Sedona and I was so excited when I got a paper bag instead of a plastic bag. I thought the change might have been universal but alas today at this subway I was given a plastic bag.  
The food is great, but I care more about the environment than eating good food at Subway.

they do not answer their store phone and it's soooo annoying!!!!!! i called the store almost 20 times to speak with the manager and even waited until better hours to call and they still never answered!!! what kind of store in 2020 does not answer their phone !?

I like doughnuts, but these things are just way too sweet. They do have a big selection. The doughnuts are in the Voodoo-style (lots of toppings, like cereal, bacon, candy). If you're a fan of really sugary doughnuts, then it might be worth a shot -- personally I don't recommend it.

Extremely long slow line at the drive-thru. Took several minutes just to get an answer at the order area. Unfriendly and no customer service whatsoever. In addition when I asked about Whopper Wednesday I was rudely told they don't honor it at this location. Terrible place probably won't go back.

I can confirm the mice infestation that's been mentioned in several reviews. We are not dealing with mice! Never had this issue anywhere I've lived.

Putting mouse traps down is not the solution. My family will not pick up another dead mouse!
This has been going on for two weeks.

It was ok, but I am not really sure what all of the fuss is about.  Very nice service.  I was still hungry when I left and spent a lot on a meal that was not cooked in a real kitchen, which I guess is impressive?! ... Not really sure... But I probably won't be back.

Was there in the afternoon, one person handling both the register and drive thru.  She is doing her best and is very polite, I don't have to wait too long, but can't imagine if it is busy.  Anyway, the donuts not as fresh probably have been on the rack for a while.  If you want fresher donuts, this is not the place to go.

I'm originally from the East Coast New York area- so I'm a bit of a "pizza snob"...but for some reason Hungry Howie's has landed in my top favorite pizza places! My husband and I's go to order is the Howie Bread & half sausage half pepperoni pizza. The price for both is under $10. Great deal for some good pizza.

While in New Orleans this club was recommended by us to go and check out. When we got there it was more of a lounge scene than an actual club. Quite small and the vibe was off. The music was good but the atmosphere didn't match at all. The bartender was nice and their food was great. Next time I can just stay on bourbon street.

Love this little hidden gem! Great lunch specials and sushi creations. O.E.C. roll is awesome. Noodle bowls are amazing also. Little heavy on the garlic in the hibachi dishes but still delicious. Weekie is the best server and always remembers us when we come in.

I had to try this place out as it listed as one of the most renowned Mexican restaurant in Tucson.  A bit far from the beaten path for me.  Had a to go order for beef flautas, flan, and churros.  Flautas were a bit dry, but were tasty.  Desserts were really good

I thought checking in online meant I would be serviced when I got to this location. I checked in and a Gentleman came in after me. He was waited on and I am still waiting. I guess I don't understand the concept of the check-in. Needless to say I am about to go to a different location or perhaps a competitor. Not so happy Friday

Don't waste tour time or money going to this McDonald's. Their management all needs to be fired and all their employees are rude or high on most days. Never know when they will be closed or open. Never get your order correct. This place should be shut down.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We are locals and love trying out new places. My husband and I ate breakfast and were not thrilled with the cost of versus the quality. Overall, Expensive for mediocre food. Nice restaurant and ambiance but better Mexican places with much better food in Nola.

Certainly not saying this is the best hotel or the worst hotel I stayed at. Rooms are clean and comfy though. Been staying here for years only complaint I have are the bug infested rooms. Last visit roaches where crawling out of the tub drain and in our room through the ceilings. Housekeeper is also very rude.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Classic Chinese restaurant experience from start to finish. This restaurant has been in the area for a very long time. My fiance's family grew up visiting, and he took me there. Now it's a special spot for us as well. The food is affordable, filling, and tasty. We appreciate the tiki drinks.

My entire family takes their vehicles here and has for years. It's a family run business at heart and the customer service is always sincere and urgent. As soon as we call, they really do get you in as soon as they can. 

Oil changes are standard cost and I trust their opinions on my car. Great local business!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I've been to Hal's many times and never had a single complaint! The atmosphere is cozy, and the food is delicious. Love the $5 martinis on Thursday. Was recently there for Cinco de Mayo and had the BEST TACOS OF MY LIFE. No joke. Seasonal menu so always new items to pick from! Will be a customer for life!

This is a nice little date spot! The grilled cheese isn't anything special, however, I found the fries and milkshakes to be excellent. It's not in a super busy part of Nashville, so parking wasn't a hassle to find. Price was a little up there, but not a bad place to come eat at every once in a while.

This location's cream donuts do not have much cream in them at all. I also got some of the classic Krispy Kreme filled donuts. My son and I both agreed that they were not fresh. I was also given birthday cake batter filled donuts. That is not cream. That's just gross.
