First time traveling alone for work, everyone was so nice and friendly at the hotel, I stayed for 4 nights. I had absolutely no problems. The free breakfast was awesome with many choices, everything was hot and fresh. Rooms, linens, & towels we all nice and clean!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The food we had here was very very good.   One of the best calimari I've had.  The veal was amazing.  It's BYOB.  The atmosphere is fair.   Not a the place for a romantic dinner.  But if your looking for great Italian food at a fair price this is a great option.   Take out is a great option as well.

Two separate visits to Paganinis and the same result:  a terrible experience with poor service, bad food and the most insulting owner we have ever encountered.  This restaurant will likely disappoint you and you'll wish you had gone to one of the other much better and customer friendly restaurants in Doylestown.

This is one of those places that are just so good that the long line makes you wonder how bad do you really want that frozen treat. 

Luckily I braved the line and the heat, being rewarded with a cool and refreshing Mangonada. A little heavy on the chamoy, but for my taste it was perfect.

Stay away from this Rip off Big O, They were suppose to change my transmission fluid and rotate my wheels. I paid over $300 and found when I got home work was not done. I returned to the shop and they gave me a lame excuse. Manager should be put in jail for selling services not performed.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Look, if you want a burger that is consistently good, Five Guys is the call. The service is quick and easy, load up with your favorite toppings, and, yes, go ahead and get the Cajun fries. 

Five Guys is no frills, good food, and at a price point that can't be beat. Go ahead and grab a burger on the go.

So, my daughter and I stopped in for the lunch buffet, and as you can see in the picture it was rather sparse. To be fair I didn't include a picture of the "salad bar" with its wilted lettuce and mystery dressing. The pizza was ok but the laughs we had over the "buffet"were the best part.

I like the space, there's lots of outdoor seating and the bathrooms are inclusive. I wasn't in love though with the staff. They were so busy chatting with each other it felt like you were bothering them when ordering. The WiFi is good though and the space is great. Haven't tried the food, the coffee is good

Sushi Kingdom used to be "The Spot"

Back in the day, there were nowhere near as many AYCE Sushi locations as there are now.

If you are passing by and don't want to travel any further, then it is a decent spot to grab a decent meal.

Nothing is spectacular about this place, but it's decent.

This place used to be better when Dave was around. Manager lady and staff are letting it go down hill on him. Good food if you wait a while. Women stand around talk and check there phones. Turning back into shot and a beer bar. FYI please wear your mask waitress's. Customers shouldn't have to ask.

I don't usually write reviews, but I will this time. My first time at this salon was Sunday, they were awesome. My nails are beautiful, my manicurist was Jeannie, she was polite, and very friendly. The salon is clean and beautifully kept, I will be going back.

We finally have an authentic Japanese restaurant in the Brintnell/McConachie area!!! Fresh fish, great service and nice decor. The sushi chefs are very experienced and the servers are friendly. But wait..they have Ramen too... in chicken or pork broth. I cannot wait to go back.

Enterprise management really does not care for their customers the manager of this location was supposed to call me in reference to my complaint and they never did! It has been almost a month and still no one reached out. You have officially lost another customer but from the looks of it you really don't give a crap.

I went in for protein nails almost two weeks ago. After less than a week they started to crack and they look horrible. I'm very disappointed because I've been there for manicures and pedicures and they were great. Will not be getting protein nails done here again.

Quite the turnaround!  Congratulations.  The service was great from the moment we walked through the door to the moment we left.  Each item of food we ordered was a mouth watering surprise.  The wine selection is admirable and well priced.  The decor is pleasing and comfortable.  Another new favorite has been born.

The staff here need to find new occupations. They can not make sandwiches, simple as that. I often wonder if THEY would even eat the sandwiches they make. Just a sloppy embarrassing mess. There is another subway location just down the road on the corner of Loyola, not even a minute away, and much better than this location.

This hotel is very nice. The restaurant is fantastic, and the rooms are clean and nice. The beds are very comfortable and the shower has good pressure and is nice and hot. 
The reason that this hotel gets three stars is that it was hard to get a reservation, and the valet got mud all of the inside door of my porsche.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Two words ... flies & filth!! 
There are a mass amount of flies in there that leads one to believe that they  are breeding in that place and there are maggots thriving. The furniture is filthy and the flies are happily eating off the tables! They need an exterminator there and a cleaning crew!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: One of the best sushi places around! The sushi chef will make the most creative food art with the wasabi! The wait staff is always friendly! If you order more then three rolls they will put it in a beautiful boat! Looking forward to dinning in but extremely happy they are now open for take out!

They were super busy and I thought that the guy had called out that my car was ready, so I walked over and found one employee in my passenger seat cleaning a window and another employee sitting in my drivers seat like he's on a break just texting away on his phone. Really?!

Best Chinese in south county! Very fresh, always friendly. Always piping hot!! You have to try the crab Rangoon's!

This is the only place in south county worth going to for Chinese. It's not overly greasy which is very hard to find in a cheaper Chinese restaurant

This is by far the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. The coffee is always watery and weak. This store never has what's on the menu. The employees seem as though they are confused as to what to make when you order it. I wish I could of have a better experience here, because it's so close to where I live.

Always smells delicious when you walk in the door, have not had an entree from there but their drinks are amazing!! Pepinitos here are the best, (we even tried recreating them at home but wasn't the same!) their churros and deep fried ice cream are mouth watering as well!

Perfect location for everything 
Close to PUBLIX, Target, Trader Joe's and downtown
Clean, comfortable and reasonable 
Mr Long at desk is incredibly nice and accommodating
My husband was quest of the day 
This is now our go to hotel when we come to St Pete
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Incredible food and friendly people!! We went here for an anniversary dinner so when I made the reservation I noted it was a special dinner. They gave us the whole back room to ourselves for privacy. Being our first time there the waiter helped us pick out the very best food items. Do not pass up the coconut caramel pie!

I hate this place..b/c I  live in the area, and all you can hear is the annoying music that from there. This place should not be in an area where there are homes across the street. I have kids who cant sleep b/c of this freakin place. Go away and get of this neighborhood.

I come to the gym 4 days a week. Equipment is always available, and the people are nice. Sometimes they have bagels and cream cheese for the guests which is nice. The staff is friendly and attentive, and the facility is clean. They make it easy for me to stick to my fitness goals!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I went to Feline Cat Clinic and it was an amazing experience. If you're having trouble with Sabino Veterinarian Care seeing your cat, you might try Feline Cat Clinic, off Campbell. Dr. UpChurch is amazing with cats. She had no trouble at all with my boy. Got a full panel of bloodwork. No medication needed. 100% difference.

We have heard nice things about  O'Bistro and decided last minute to stop in for dinner. We were greeted at the door and felt a happy vibe right away. Shane was our waiter and he was delightful! The drinks were great and the meals were tasty. We were too full to try the desserts, but will def be back!

I stopped in for a glass of wine & a small bite. This was my first time eating smoked salmon & it was ok. The service was good as there was only 2 people at the bar & a bartender. The bar is extremely small though, allowing 4 seats which I'm grateful it wasn't full because we would have been on top of each other lol.

For the price? This place is so good! I ordered like 4 rolls and it was like a price of one special roll from other sushi places. I love coming here with my friends and bringing our own drink to drink. Waiters are really nice because they have to deal with our craziness and they open our bottles for us!

Yo abre una cuenta de negocio hice un depósito de 25,000 y me cancelaron mis cuentas por hacer un depósito a mi propia cuenta Y hablé a costo me Service y me dijeron que para aseguranza ellos no llamaron a mi amigo que me dio el cheque no hicieron nada pero me cancelaron mi cuenta mía por eso no le recomiendo Chase

Six months after discovering this spot and ordering from it for delivery nearly every week, all I can say is YES. Delicious pizza which always hits the spot with wood fired pizza dough and those perfect toppings. If you want to experience pizza with a nice wood fire smoky aura to it, Spuntino's is the way to go.

I have eaten here about 5 years ago and again just recently staff are very friendly and location is clean which is a positive. But the pizza was yuck years ago and again sorry guys . I gave 3 stars as my service was on point and my salad was fresh and wings were good

Don't even think of taking your car here. Used to take my 3 vehicles there for years with not to many issues (leaky oil filter, missed grease zerts)but the last time they were telling lies about condition of car. The BS reminded me of the horror stories you see on 20/20. The owner needs to lose his franchises and his arse.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Semi-what Worst McDonald's to go to. Every time I go their shake machine is down or they are out of something. I know you go through a lot of stuff but it's like dang not that quick and it won't matter what time of day if you want a shake or a smoothie it's always gonna be broke or down.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Normally I wouldn't bother reviewing a fast food place like this, but I waited so long for my breakfast - many people who ordered after me got their food before me, and this isn't the first time. Also, hash browns are never as crispy as they are at any other location.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Over all a decent place to eat, on the nights of dining under the stars (Wednesday) the service is extremely slow it took us 1 hour and 39 minutes to get our food!! But I have to say the main course was amazing the appetizers were mediocre. For sure will come back (on a less busy night!), loved the earthy vibe to the restaurant!

Those guys are so friendly, and although I fancy myself quite the coffee drinker (keurig on the night stand, 2 cups is a tease) that cold brew will have you standing up straight. First time Ive been to a coffee shop where they asked me about "caffeine sensitivity" before making a recommendation. Hell yes

Location was great. The restaurant and bar had terrific service and good food. The check in process....ugh. My fridge did not work, TV kept freezing and going out. Valet parking is expensive. I stay all over the US on business. This is the most expensive valet parking rate I have seen. Rooms are clean and bed is comfy.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Looking for an Italian restaurant in downtown? Bernini Restaurant is your best choice at Ybor. I always come back, you can enjoy the outdoor or their romantic dinner area, or just suit yourself at the bar. Try it! won't regret.

Dress code: casual
Parking maybe an issue since it is on Ybor.

Hard to see in this image but they've add a hanging plexiglass shield (to the left of the guy in gray) to separate you from the employee. Still have to hand your card over if paying without cash. 

Also you can ask for salsa (red or green) they closed the salsa self serve bar. Employees are wearing masks (typically).

Delish fresh very well made!!! The sushi chef we had was incredible fast and over all a nice person as well as the other sushi chefs . The only reason I didn't give a 5 star is that our waitress wasn't attentive. We had to look for her to get water or to take our plates. She seemed very confused with her job.

I am from El Paso so I was lured in as I was driving by. The chips were ok and the salsa was good, but the rest was awful. Taqueria were fried FLOUR tortillas and who know what was inside posing as meat. The Queso Fundido was not even passable. Service was fine and I hate to write a bad review but the food was terrible.

This is a very tiny restaurant.  We walked here from our hotel on vacation. The food was really good. My sister fell in love with the spaghetti sauce. It was really light in color and seemed like it was barely there. But, the taste was delicious. We both enjoyed our meal.

I actually really like this place. I used to eat their pizza from a north county location years ago. Finding one near my house was a pleasant surprise. We've eaten here about 5 times and it's always a good experience. I really love the pesto on a pizza. I've not had anything I wouldn't recommend.

I DO NOT TRUST this shop with my car. I recently brought my car in to this Midas branch to get an oil change before we drove it to Florida. They did not put my air filter back in my car! Nor did they put the air filter compartment back together. Luckily, the parts were just laying on top of my engine.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Food is ok... typical Mexican food.  Atmosphere is so freaking loud and obnoxious!  Loud, trashy, low class families,  trashy attention seeking loud trust fund hipsters dressed like homeless junkies drinking PBR... East Nashville at it's worst! SUCKS! Terrible experience!

My mom has been dying to try this place. It was pretty basic and the food was okay. If you are easily disgusted by people's bodily functions, do not sit around the open kitchen layout . You'll def witness workers coughing in their hands and touching your food immediately after. Disgusting.

Overall the car wash does a decent job it's nice they do supply drying towels and window cleaner. Though the brush that cleans your tires is very stiff and if you have painted rims it puts scratches in them I have contacted corporate twice now with no response.

We did not make a reservation, but were told they could seat us until the table was filled in 90 min, despite 4 tables being open most of our dinner. Our waitress was not attentive to us and did not tell us the specials. The first time we were here the food was beyond fantastic, but this time it was not nearly as good.

Seems like it has the potential to be a beautiful hotel. Location is great and the property was once nice. But it seems very run down. No housekeeping services or breakfast during Covid. Daily parking and resort fees. The total rate came out to over 250 a night for a room with no view or amenities. Not worth it
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Have been here twice. The first time they fit me I quickly and the place was very clean and quiet. Unfortunately my nails were cut/filed unevenly. I figured I'd give it a try since it was a super busy Saturday. No appointment and they fit me in right away! My manicurist did an excellent job.

This Starbucks location is nice but I have to say that the people that work there are incredibly rude. The girl that took my order had such a bad attitude. I don't feel like I want to go back to this location. They really need to get people that actually want to work there or at least have some manners and good customer service.

A brand new Mexican food restaurant. I've tried several different items so far and love everything. The tacos are incredible and only $1.49 each! This style of Mexican food reminds me of the food I'd get along the California coast after a long day at the beach. Savory and satisfying. A must try, I'm sure you won't be disappointed.

Truly a special experience.  I can't remember the last time I've enjoyed a meal quite like this one.  Totally unexpected but so very appreciated.  Once the city opens up I doubt we'll be able to reserve this restaurant under two months in advance.  Great host and amazing service.  Chef Mack is an artist.

Better than any sushi I know of in the area.   The sushi is reliably fresh and served in an inviting way.  They are often very crowded.  Most sushi places I know serve green tea as part of the meal and give spicy sauce on the side if asked at no charge.  Osaka does not and charges for both, so I would say they are a tad stingy.

All you can eat sushi, if you even want to eat it that is. The rice was dry, nearly crispy and the sushi was far too large to fit in one bite. The saving grace was the fried sugar dough but that comes as no surprise, it's fried sweetness how can you go wrong there?

Stopped on our first leg on a Detroit to San Diego trek and relied on prior yelp reviews to pick a restaurant near our hotel.  Pleasantly surprised to find great Mexican food and Margaritas in a family owned restaurant that is half fast food while true Mexican...and did I mention good Margaritas.

I've been using them for a year since we moved to NW Reno.  At first, 5 stars as I could drop off in the afternoon and dry cleaning done the next day around 5pm.  However something changed and I can't get Friday dry cleaning on Saturday anyone. When you fly for business, Monday return does not work.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: There is always the longest line at this Starbucks. Plan on being in the drive through for over 10 mins, and probably closer to 15 mins. The employees are extremely kind and personable, but the service is extraordinarily slow. Also, they seem to be randomly closed at times for no particular reason.

Just tried Senorita's after hearing such great things and so happy we did! Everything was so fresh and delicious! The tacos were authentic and the fajita was amazing. We shared the nachos to start and by far, my favorite nachos around! Will definitely be going back soon.

Not sure what's going on with the pizza since the place has been remodeled. 
But it's horrible.  Sauce was on top of the cheese. Barely any sauce.  Bottom of the pizza was black and tasted burnt. Sad to see my favorite pizza spot change the way the pizza has been made for years. Wasted my money.

The best deal is during lunch for their buffet. Pizza is decent quality compared to most all you can eat places and prices are reasonable. Ingredients are fresh and the service is friendly. I appreciate the Idaho based themes for pizza names. Some locations are better than others. I'm not sure why.

The crawfish was some of the best we have had so far this season. Just enough spice, with tons of flavor. The waitress/owner Jodi was very attentive. The onion rings and fired okra were crispy and matched well with the sauce served along side. This is a great local joint, with great daily specials!

Good food at fair prices.  Attractive presentation.  They are always busy.  They only have street parking so around dinner time it is really hard to find a place to park for dinner or even just to run in and pickup takeout.  Very unfortunate because I know I would definitely go here more often if it were not for that.

Just so so food. Not slow, but fried rice was not very hot seemed warmed up carrots were raw. Crab rangoons now very hot and brown again sort of undercooked. General tso's was tasty sesame was just general tso's with sesame seeds sprinkled on top. Overall just average

Top Cleaners does an excellent with dry cleaning as well as alterations. Service is prompt; my clothes are always ready when promised. The place is clean, they follow covid protocols, and the owners are very professional and pleasant. I highly recommend Top Cleaners.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: This is the spot to grab some of that good, homemade Italian sausage while checking out all the single 40 year old cougars out on prowl. Take a Prilosec before hand because acid reflux isn't your friend when your makin that bmw 5 series you can't afford shake in the parking lot.

The food here was small in portion and plain in taste. Some food was just straight soggy or lukewarm when it served. The breakfast buffet before 10am was average. I gave them one more chance on a to go order of chicken and waffles. It looks like they just put it in the microwave.

I had a really good experience with Dom and his team. They were very friendly and knowledgeable and I know they gave me a really good deal on my tires. It was my first time using Doms Auto Repair and I will definitely be back in the future. I highly recommend them!!!

*Sigh* I just want my coffee without attitude from the older lady. Everyone else is friendly and this location is really convenient as a Vandy student. I may have to try to figure out her schedule and avoid her. Otherwise, it'll be a trek to the 3005 West End location.

Super slow service on a Sunday brunch.. we waited more than 40 min for our food and we had to call our waiter several times to get more bread and drink refills . The restaurant didn't even look busy I don't know why it took for ever for us to get served verte disappointed :(

Its been a long time so bare with me, but my band played here in 2005.  Fairly decent crowd and I remember the staff being friendly.  Drinks were cold and we actually sold some merch.  win/win.  Always love to see clubs support local music or bands touring (in our case from Pennsylvania) and need to fill a date.

Very good! We've been here several times and it has been great every time. The pizza was great. If you get the pizza, get it wood fired because it is way better. I got the pasta e fagioli and it was great! All of the food was wonderful! I would recommend this place to anyone who wants some good pizza, soup or even some pasta.

Excellent sushi, great service. Nigiri was fresh and delicious. You must try the mochi (?) dessert. Green tea ice cream nuggets wrapped in some kind of rice paper coating with a very subtle chocolate sauce on the side. Small but just right size portion... phenomenally delicious.

came for lunch and honestly it's just solid sushi. expect to pay about $30/pp to be decently full. the marriott roll and i think fantasy (?) are quite good. nothing super special, but prices are solid, service is good, and the fish tasted fresh when I went.

Wonderful people here, from the front desk to the vets. They've taken care of my hounds from the normal (neutering) to the unusual (pup eating 3 lbs. of baby formula). Doctor's Graham and Ford are both kind and thorough, and I appreciate the professionalism of their office.

Really great place to get a professional haircut. It's kept extremely clean and has a friendly staff that's professional. The barbershop's staff is great with children and I have witness them display patience and compassion when giving kids their 1st haircut. I definitely recommend barbershop!

Pre-covid review

The best part about this place is the location! The lounge area was decent and we had a nice view. 

Otherwise, it's meh! Small rooms, not perfectly clean, and I was excited about the free snacks and coffee but then found out they're not stocked that often.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Favorite place for sushi in Arizona. Sushi is always amazingly fresh.  I love that they serve edamame and miso to every customer. My only complaint is the the sushi chefs are a little snooty.  You are in the customer service business - hello.  But wait staff bends over backwards to make you happy.

Nice place and a nice meal. We ordered a variety of things and here are our top three: mushroom bisque, corvina, gnocchi. The one dish that I would not rave about is the roasted brussel sprouts. To me, there was an odd sweetness that I wasn't a fan of. But everything else was superb! And make sure to save room for dessert!

This bank sucks!!! They gave me such a hard time and im a private bank wells fargo customer i should not have too go threw all of this to get a cashiers check.. and the indian lady is a bitch and the white lady!! This location is horrible!!! Spare your time!!!

Always packed and always have to wait for machines. It's a very nice facility but I dont think they were ready for the amount of people that signed up to the number of machines they have Available. Now I'm locked in to a two year membership and can't even work out do to the High volume of customers.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Literally half a cup of coffee ! I always get this order and it is a inch maybe an inch and a half less then the cup . This is absolutely ridiculous the line takes forever and not to mention you have to repeat yourself numerous times in order to get what you want. Never coming here again !!

I have had fantastic customer service during my stay. My housekeeper was super! The front desk staff were available and helpful. The rooms could be updated and lighting needs to addressed. The lighting was very dim. The coffeemaker was frustrating just because it is so small. All in all, pleasant experience.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Small, weird set up, but the coffee etc is on par. What was really gross was one of the staff eating and talking to the other staff who were making the drinks. He didn't seem to care that there was a line up of people watching him do this, but maybe they were too engrossed in their phone to notice. Anyway, yuck.

Once again a McDonald's drive-thru messed up my order. I asked for one item and was given a meal instead it contains things that I cannot have due to my diet. I think part of the problem lies in the defective equipment at the drive-thrus. And the second part of the problem is the wearing of stupid masks.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Went there around 3pm today and the service was fast but when I got my food is was barely lukewarm at best  I had to microwave it just to make it edible . This place goes through phases where one month it's really good then they go to shit and I blame them solely hiring work release workers

YUM!!! Oh man I love a good thin crust NY Style pizza and this did not disappoint! The pizzas are huuuge but very thin so we totally ate the whole thing. Half cheese and half sweet heat. The Sweet Heat is AWESOME! spicy and salty and sweet. Overall the pizza could use a touch more flavor or herbs, but a great slice!

How can an Italian restaurant call themselves an Italian restaurant with a vegetarian lasagna???? Offer a meat based lasagna as well. I'm baffled at this place, pizza was ehh, all portions were very small and bland. Pasta was reasonable, same with the service. I was expecting a lot more from this place.

Great service staff. I expected a little more in terms of quality of rooms. When compared to Le Méridien and The Alexander in town this property needs an update. Pillow bar was awesome!  Great location but not at top of the field when compared to other higher end Indy locations.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: All service open today. Company has it posted, "wear a mask when outside your car". It's posted but half of the patrons were outside vacuuming cleaning their cars without masks. All employees had masks on! Great wash, really only economical if you buy a membership and it's so worth it.

Stopped by for lunch and had a bit of a slow start with service. From there we got more attention and could enjoy a Caesar salad (it came with a hard boiled egg which was a tasty touch) and a delicious stuffed burger and perfectly cooked crinkle-cut fries.

I absolutely love this place! The staff is always friendly and accommodating. We had a family lunch here for a christening with 6 children, the restaurant doesn't have a "kids menu" but worked with us on the food for the kids with us. The food is awesome and very reasonable

Victoria was a great server and started the pace off well at this small gem of a place in Conshocken. The celebration was my mother-in-Laws 80th birthday.  I ordered the rigatoni and my wife and family had a variety of dishes that was delicious.  Old style Italian in a small intimate space.  The conoll was also fabulous.

I just don't get it. You wait too long, pay too much and then leave wondering if there's something your missing. As my husband wondered as we pondered the Brussels sprout leaves filled with broth (5). Where do you suppose the rest of the Brussels sprout is?? This is very 90s to me. Ouch

Awesome, finally a good hair salon in the Mainline!!!

She is super friendly, kind, and most important of all, a great hair stylist. She actually used to work in Korea (I love hair cuts in Korea) and she's moved here recently from Chicago and opened her hair salon.

Looking forward to being a regular here

Really friendly people and great food!! Only thing is that it's kind of expensive. That being said, the food is pretty authentic. 

Pro-tip: of all the times I've been there, it has only been not-busy one time. Call ahead and make a reservation so you don't have to wait!

Stopped for lunch after not having been there in quite awhile. Was not disappointed! Had a small deep dish pizza to split with my wife. SO GOOD! Have enough left over for lunch tomorrow. This place is a hidden gem. If you haven't already been here, and you enjoy Italian food, try it. I don't think you will be disappointed.

This Burger King doesn't deserve even 1 Star. It has to be one of the worst run fast food restaurants I have ever been in. Horrible service and unbelievably dirty. I have been here several times over the years and it has never changed. The doors should be barred shut.

Don't waste your time at this hotel!  Never felt so unsafe in a hotel in my life!  I thought so much more of Sheraton before and now i will NEVER stay at a Sheraton again.  The Hilton right near this place is much nicer and has more competent staff!!!!  

STAFF IS ZERO HELP IN ANY SITUATION!!!! 

Wish i could give it 0 stars...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Employees are very nice but the hours are horrible. What happened to planet fitness being a 24 hour gym? It's only 24 for four days. Also, other planet fitness still do pizza and bagels during covid but this one cheaped out on both. The owner seems to care more about profit than the customers
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: On July 1st went in to get doughnuts for sons birthday. Lady had to go in the back to make more. I saw her drop the stick used to hollow out the doughnuts on the floor. She picked it up then used it on doughnuts then placed in box and handed to someone in drive-through. I've contacted corporate

When I lived in LOL, we were spoiled. That store was top quality. Now, I don't enjoy Papa John's, although I keep giving it a shot. Tried the new cheese stuffed crust. No better than a DiGiorno. Meh at best. Asked the driver not to ring the doorbell, as the kids were asleep. She EXTRA banged on the door.

7.49 for a six-pack of hoegaarden and the muffalettas are decent.  But a lot of their products, like condiments, jarred and canned food, and even meats, are exceptionally close to their expiration dates.  Attempting to sell Bacon three days before it's expiration date seems like a pretty sleazy business practice to me.

Pro's:  good beer selection and a lot tv's

Con's: had chicken parm. Replace the word chicken with fried hockey puck. I think the delay in my food being brought out had to do with ensuring that any flavor had been removed from the chicken before serving. Fries reminiscent of Jersey turnpike Roy Rogers.

Wonderful Starbucks location. The staff is great and always friendly. I mostly go through the drive through and the employees are always sweet and funny. My favorite was when I asked if they made a different type of drink and the response was "heck ya, and it's super yummie" this response made my son and I giggle. Nice job!

The rooms were clean and well maintained.  The staff were friendly and helpful. I would give it 5 stars but there is something about the block it is on ...  made me uneasy just that one block.  Easy access to Canal St and Bourbon.  Reasonably priced being so close to the French Quarter.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Even though most reviews for this place are negative, we decided to go because we were in the mall and they were open late. SO GLAD WE DID! I had a pedicure my girlfriend had a refill and my 14 year old daughter got a new full set. We all we very very happy. Very nice technician's and very good work. We're definitely goin back.

Dropped in to have a slice and try it out, I had a plain cheese slice, I didn't like it at all.

Nu Yalk Pizza is WAY Better. Smiling with Hope Pizza is also good but not as good as Nu Yalk.  If you want a GOOD slice of pizza go to Nu Yalk Pizza in south Reno by Winco.

Good food but I was not pleased with the prices. Way overpriced for bite sized tacos. The salsa verde is good but the "chips" are simply out of the bag tostadas. The duck taco is really good but in the end I wont be going back, the value of the product compared to the price doesn't add up for me.

Great hotel! We really enjoyed our stay! Breakfast was amazing and the pictures of the facilities are accurate! Very beautiful rooms and lobby. The only downside is if you have late checkout they will still come to your room at regular check out time. We will be back!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We did take out.  Quality of the sushi was good.  Unfortunately they gave us another persons order so we had to go back after going all the way to our house.  They pretty much blamed us for the mistake and did not care that we had to go back to get our actual order.  It left us feeling really uncomfortable.

I stayed here a few times before and had no complains but last night we stayed here again and it was TERRIBLE BED SHEETS were dirty, bathroom was incredible dirty, staff has no clue what they are doing. It just seems like nobody wants to be there and dont care about their job. The kitchen staff is rude and unprofessional and dirty
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I really like this place more than anything for the ambiance. The food is not bad by any means, but I think I just have quite high standards. The presentation of the food is quite lovely, just not super flavorful. The service is pretty good too, never had any complaints. I would recommend for a nice evening :)

Good grub at a reasonable price. A great mix of offerings. In the Land of the Hoosier Pork Tenderloin "Sandwich", theirs is one of the better ones.
Good live music on Fri evnings. Group last night did great covers at a volume level that allowed patrons to still converse.

Clean ice cream shop with good customer service. My husband got the peanut butter ice cream and I got the goat cheese cherry. Both were excellent and we loved the waffle cones! 

Highly recommend the goat cheese cherry if you're seeking something tangy and tart. It's delicious!

From 4 stars to 2 .... Machines are old and wore, washing machine by the door have bad Rubber door grommets  which RIPs your clothes when  mention  to the mother of the owner she is super mean about it .......in addition parking lot dirty and not well lit at nite
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I came for a wedding Labor Day weekend and my biggest complain was the elevators. We stayed on the 12th floor and the elevators honestly took 3-4 minutes I timed it. There seemed to only be two working elevators and the were SLOW. I did take advantage of the small but useful gym. Breakfast was fine and staff was really nice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I must say I love  this location! The
Equipment thus far has shown me more results in 2 weeks the LA Fit has in 6 months! New equipment working untouched muscles! Great employees & the Pilates machine class is a must! Try this machine you'll see quick results‍‍‍‍‍‍
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: We didn't know what to expect given the typical automotive repair business. It appears they did everything correctly the FIRST TIME with no attempt at an upsale. I am pleased and will return to the Grant / Oracle facility in the future. Thank you for making me feel I got what I paid for.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: First time there. Everyone was very nice, polite and the service was excellent. We ate at the bar because we didn't have a reservation (recommended!). The food was delicious. Prosciutto appetizer was excellent. Muscles for dinner. Huge portion. The focaccia is Superb!

I don't understand this place. I swear it's like they TRY to get my order wrong every time. Coffee is either water or its burnt. I haven't been in months hoping things got better; I went this morning and got terrible coffee and the wrong sandwich. Ridiculous, the manager should be fired.

I love their food especially their crab Rangoon. Their staff is very nice. I have eaten there for about four years and have never had a bad meal. They have a good system for getting food to you during COVID. Their delivery is also a big help. I would rate it a 10/5 if I could.

We have tried so many ice cream spots since moving to New Orleans. This place is phenomenal. The ice cream was fresh, the flavors were unique and oh so tasty...my taste buds are singing me praises! The superb customer service was an added bonus. Our kids had a blast!

From my son: I get my hair cut here a lot because Oscar always treats me right that man takes clippers to my scalp like Michelangelo carving David for the first time. dude is straight surgical with the scissors - has me looking like a 7 when I am at most a 5.5. do yourself a favor and get your haircut here.

Very nice resort with clean and landscaped grounds. We had a ground level ocean view room that was very quiet and private. There was a park with a nice playground within walking distance and the beach was right across the street. We enjoyed our stay and will definitely return.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We got a waffle bowl with gooey butter cake ice cream and the honey vanilla bean ice cream. This was amazing and would definitely recommend it to everyone to try it!! We also got a scoop of the milkiest chocolate and another scoop of the salty caramel. The chocolate-ice cream flavor and the waffle  cone was delicious

Went on a Saturday night and the place was not crowded. The atmosphere was lovely and the service was exceptional! Very friendly and inviting. We had the Chicken Parm and Crab Stuffed Sole.  Both entrees were very tasty and fresh. Everything was well-seasoned and just yummy.  We will definitely return.

If you are looking for a bad haircut at a cheap price this is a good place to go. Brought my 4 yr old for his first real haircut. It looks good from afar but up close you can see how uneven it is. Not sure if all the hairdressers are the same so you could gamble.

What an amazing, loving vet and business.  We were new to StPB vet clinic, with our Abby.  Even though we only had a few short months left with her StPB vet clinic made us feel loved and supported with everything our girl needed.  We highly recommend them!

Hadn't been here in a couple of years and unfortunately remembered too late WHY I stopped coming to this restaurant. It wasn't too busy but waitstaff was slow. Slow to take order and slowER to serve. I had a ham & cheese melt on a croissant..croissant was tasty & ham was like shoe leather.  Needless to say, I won't be going back.

Always get take out. Food is good and consistent. Staff is friendly. General Tsao Chicken and Crispy Chicken are the two entrees my wife and I like. Potstickers are good as well. It's your run of the mill Chinese place but probably the best option in the Oakville area.

Sadly the management has moved their focus to the Market Street and Logan gyms leaving this to fend for itself.  It has been months of enduring spinning bikes in disrepair.  Bottom line.....follow the dollar.  The smaller gyms are no longer on their radar.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: After watching Thrive from a distance I finally took the plunge and signed on to work out with Alissa Higgins.  Besides being totally adorable she's an awesome trainer.  The constant variation in work out makes it challenging and fun.   If you're looking to turn up the volume on your work out routine it's money well spent.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: First time here. I thought it was going to be a greasy spoon. As it turns out the inside is much better then the outside appearance. Wait staff was very friendly , the food was very reasonably priced ( breakfast under $10)  I would definitely eat there again.

This is a Hidden secret. Hands down best Grilled Octopus in the Bay Area. Hands down best blackened mahi mahi wrap.  Never ever had anything even close to being off here. Should have posted sooner on this place. Daily seafood specials , definitely some of the best lemon chicken soup. Can't say enough about this place

I LOVED my experiences at Bench Animal Hospital and am so sad that I moved out of state and have to find a new vet. They are very communicative, transparent with pricing, and most importantly have been great with my pets (cat and dog). Nothing but wonderfully experienced every visit!

This place is awesome! I've been going here for my haircuts for several years and they have always done a consistently quality job. The staff is knowledgeable and friendly and ensure that you are satisfied with your haircut before you leave. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a haircut or shave.

The prices are very fair given the huge portions. We stopped in late and enjoyed fast service, though it was lacking in enthusiasm and friendliness. The ice cream was pretty good, though my butter pecan could have had a little more flavor. I'll likely be coming back for the old school atmosphere and homemade treats.

Great! I was a little surprised by the neon lights inside but the sushi was really good, the service was great, the prices were good. Definitely looking forward to going back many times. 
It's a lot more casual than Umai Umai, which is only a few blocks away. Engimono is great but I still say Umai Umai is the best sushi in the city

Excellent. Came for my adult son's birthday. I made a reservation, even though 6 00 on a weeknight. We probably didn't need a reservation,  but the place filled up while we were there. Great Italian food. Swordfish was excellent. Pasta and red sauce terrific! We had dessert in honor of the birthday, and that was phenomenal.

Jimmy is great, the sushi is great, and the aquariums are lovely.  This place is no where near my house but I stop by any time I'm anywhere in the vicinity, and always pick up a massive takeout order when en route to the home of my second family in Seminole.

In town on business for a night.  Easy check-in (thank you, Marriott Rewards!) and check-out process.  Room was clean and I like that they have a spacious desk in the room, was especially nice because I had to work from the room for a couple hours.  Very friendly staff and the hotel coffee was better than usual.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went to this McDonalds last night a little after 10pm, after also going to the McDonalds on 11111 Bellefontaine Road.  Neither one's shake machine was working.  I asked if there was a certain time that they shut the machine down.  The employee said "no, it wasn't cleaned when I got here earlier"...Really???
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I checked website to order it seems like its under new owners. Menu changed entirely for the specialty rolls and prices are so significantly higher:( oh no! We will miss the lunch specials and happy hour specials:( Will miss Origami for its great tasting food and affordable prices!

Looking for a new sushi spot now....

Ambiance is nice (a variety of drinks offered) and the staff are pleasant and welcoming but the final product is less than impressive. Dry skin around nails left untrimmed, cuticles barely touched, polish unevenly applied. I hope they fix these things as I'd like to see them prosper.

Listen, this place has GREAT NY Style Italian food, but I will NEVER return to this shop due to the owner and employees.  They couldn't be a ruder bunch of people.  When you leave NY you should also leave the attitude.  Either that or move back up.  I have no problem going somewhere that appreciates my business.

It's a nice date night place. The food is above average, the atmosphere is a little on the upscale side, and they have a nice drink menu. It's a polo or button-up kind of place. You don't need to put on your suit and tie, but I wouldn't feel comfortable in a tee shirt.

Don't let the name Gaylord fool you. This is the forgotten family member of the Gaylord hotels. Very outdated in every way. I found old chocolate milk in our fridge. Had the room cleaned  then returned that evening back to the room to find a fork by the bed which we never ate one meal here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Valeria's was SO much better. I have tried to give Fito's numerous chances, but the food just isn't good. Bland Mexican (Americanized Mexican) food? If Taco Bell is beating you in the Mexican food game you might need to fix some things. I would not recommend.

If they made their donuts on site I would probably be giving them at least a 3 star review. The coffee is good, but when I imagine a good donut I am not imagining opening up a hostess package and that seems to be the quality of the donuts I have gotten here. The donuts at Fry's and Safeway are better than the ones trucked into DD.

I went to Raffertys in 100 Oaks last night, got the BBQ chicken breast. It was pretty good, just not enough BBQ sauce on it so I ask for extra BBQ....   they charged me 30 cents. REALLY? I dont go to places that nickle and dime me so a 30 cent charge means you lose my business for good. (I'm just glad I didnt ask for Ketchup!!)

I have no idea how an establishment like this stays in business, I have been treated with an extremely rude and aggressive tone every time I have ordered here. I as a customer shouldn't be yelled at due to them being busy, I am in complete shock that this is somehow still open.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Would have given five stars, but quality seems to have gone down over the years. Presentation isn't as on point and staff seems slightly crabbier. There aren't a whole lot of sushi options in the area, and the happy hour weekday specials are definitely reasonable for the quality of food, so I would suggest!

I have been ordering from Tokyo Tasty for years now, and in the beginning it was genuinely good delicious food.  But these days, it's not been so good.  The food now is a little bland and doesn't have the flavor and care in cooking that it used to.  Also, delivery takes quite a while and food is cold by the time it arrives.

Been a member here for 3 years and just recently signed up for the Thrive Program. Felix is my trainer and he's awesome! The workouts always seem to kick my butt and I'm never bored. Location is great and the staff is really friendly. Definitely recommend.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: So I stopped in to see if this place holds up to in reputation. I took out 2 tacos, a burritos and Jamiaca. Tacos started off good and had some flavor, burrito wad o.k. until the burnt meat. Beans were tasty, tortilla was soft, the meat could have been better prepped. The traditional  hibiscus drink was worth the stop.

I'm only giving it two stars for the convenience that it's in Target. But other than that, just go to the other Starbucks further down Manhattan. The baristas here always have an attitude and never make my drinks right. My orders are usually simple and they still seems to mess it up.

While they reside in the former Accupolco Joes location, sadly not 1 menu item is from Joes. The food was basic at best and lacked seasoning. Joes was a destination restaurant so I can take this off my list now.
The former name goes away in a few months and will be El Toro going forward.

Today was a hit. My car was returned clean inside and out. It shines! The backseat and windows were  thoroughly cleaned, removing signs of my child's dirty hands and feet. They have it dialed and are super efficient, all while keeping it friendly, especially at the final stage of drying. It could be a bit friendlier upon arrival.

It's Good but not Great. It was worth the money. I had basic tuna, salmon, and white tuna rolls. The rolls were large and the taste was good. I've had better, but I would definitely go back if I was close and craving Sushi. It's worth a visit to try for yourself.

Very nice people here and good service. 
I've experienced Jacks donuts in the past, but 
Today I didn't enjoy. To be fair, there wasn't a large 
Selection, but the cake donuts weren't like cake donuts;
they were all sugar all the way through.  It was like the 
whole donut was made of icing.

I ordered food from Bistro through Grubhub. The food arrived very quickly, although one thing was missing. I called the restraint and they went above and beyond to fix the issue. The missing item was delivered by the bistro staff. The food was not only wonderful the staff is truly excellent. We will definitely go back!

I ordered a to go pizza a couple weeks ago over the phone , the lady who took my order made a mistake I realized once I was driving back home , the food ( pizza its average, overpriced and the service is slow , I took them  20 minutes to have my order ready and I called ahead ! I am never coming back .

Spent over $70 for a basic dinner for two and appetizer!   Way way over priced.  Especially the three dollar cans of soda used for our drinks.  Food was ok but not worth the price.  Nor is the cramped atmosphere.  Will not be recommending this restaurant to anyone.

This place is the happiest place to be at 7:00. Friendly upbeat staff that welcome me by name every day. The coffee of courses great.  The place is clean and organized. All COVID-19 precautions are in place. I love starting my day at this Starbucks. It's hard to be a grumpy morning person after you visit this place.

Can You Say..OVERCOOKED?!Also Didn't Get My Cheeseburger.This Location Is LAZY By The Looks Of It. They Don't Care About Quality. They Just Care About Making Sure The Food Isn't Undercooked And That It Gets Out That Window. I Get That It's "Fast Food"  But I Mean...It Should Still At Least Taste Good Right?!

Apparently they don't appreciate Priceline.com business.  Only once in a great while do I experience this but it has happened here.  Plenty of room at the hotel -checked in at 4:30 and the room they give me has frosted out windows 75% of the way up.  No view at all (well unless you stand on the cushion).  So disappointing.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I don't care what authentic Chinese food is. Everything here is awesome. Best General's Chicken in the World. In fact, I often daydream that it's raining General Tso's from Chef Chun. And I'm frolicking through a meadow catching pieces with a butterfly net. A tad pricey for the portions, but...Great place!

Fabulous dinner (short ribs) with amazing breadbasket by former owner of Cirque, among others. An awesome BYOB addition to Chestnut Hill dining at a reasonable price given the quality. Now we just need to get our waiter some diction lessons and this becomes 5 stars.

They have really great drink prices and margaritas. The food is average but still a great place to go and hang out and eat. They had problems for a little while but it seems that they have picked up on their food quality. But it is a very nice place to go eat at with the family

This is our weekly go to for great Mexican food when we're in the office.  The staff is so nice and gives very prompt service. The food is wonderful and at a great price. Although there are many food options in this area, Mazatlan's is our choice every week!

I love this bar. I was visiting on vacation and ended up returning often. The bar tender Morgan was fantastic. She gave great recommendations of things to do throughout the city. And she makes excellent, excellent margaritas. The locals are sweet and the aesthetic here is lovely.

Great pizza delivery in the neighborhood! Food is delicious and just what I'm looking for when craving some Italian food at home. Get the onion rings, they're awesome!! 

Delivery is not so good. Basically had a delivery guy bang on my door as hard as possible and throw the food at us because I didn't hear my phone ring.

We have always had our favorite restaurant here in FL. Our last visit they were closed for vacation, so a friend recommended Villa Gallace.  We love it here! The food and service was amazing!  Everything we had was perfect! We now have a new favorite Italian restaurant :)

Nice clean place. Have been here for lunch a few times and a happy hour. Its okay, but usually not my first choice. Lunch portions could certainly be a bit bigger and the chicken cutlet could have some more chicken to it.  A good fall back spot or place to go when in the area

The website says they deliver, but when I called the restaurant the pot-smoking-sounding-guy on the phone said they don't deliver.

How can you run a business where you WANT to SELL stuff to PEOPLE who will PAY YOU and refuse to do exactly that?

Bye bye, Golden Dragon.

The sushi was very good. 4 stars only because of service, not too friendly. Once we ate the first sushi roll my bf wanted to order another. But before we could do that the waitress dropped the bill off at our table and left not saying a word.. like I said, great sushi but lacking service.

I LOVE GLITZ, I have had both dip and gel there and they always do SUCH an Amazing job. Absolutely the only place i'll go in Reno! The inside is very clean and well decorated, flooded with beautiful natural light!The women who work there are so personable and make getting your nails done so fun!

Petrini's is for Santa Barbara nostalgia lovers.  There are many places to get better food, but if you grew up here, Petrini's holds a special place in your heart.  I'd recommend lunch...try the number due or the torpedo combo and if your waitress is a little sassy, just give it right back.

This is the best bar, will the most amazing staff. Nice people, cheap yet strong drinks. Homey vibe and great tasting food. New Orleans hole in the wall, right next to the famous gator tour. Stop by and get yourself some beer buckets before your swamp adventures.

Very clean and comfortable accommodations!  Easy walk to downtown Nashville.  We asked to check in early - our room wasn't quite ready but the desk clerk took our number and called when it was ready.  We also requested and received a late checkout (12:30 vs. 11:00).  Would definitely stay there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ehh, was expecting better. Staff was friendly & quick. Flavors of food just not that as strong as I would have liked it.  Salsa tasted like nothing & our chips were very stale. Raspberry tea didn't have much flavor. Ordered fajitas for 2, totally worth the price. It could feed 4 for sure, so much leftovers!

We came here to Dine in. We waited at the host station for at least 10 minutes without anyone asking us if we need to be seated. Several staff members walk past us without saying a word. This place was not even that busy. I would not recommend this place. I certainly will not be returning.

Staff was not masked. When asked if they could be because we had a 9 month pregnant mom in our group, only some of the staff agreed. It was a very awkward and contentious interaction before I spent hundreds on a small birthday party there. I would not recommend or return.

Well they must have gotten a lot of complaints because They brought in a new manager and she cleaned house. I must say service is MUCH better now lines move a little faster but hey there is labor shortage everywhere HELEN the new manager THANK you for cleaning house.

Decent. For student housing and the cost for space, this is a decent apartment. There are definitely some issues with management and their "promises" to residents though. But, the area isn't too noisy and if you have decent roommates there's not much to complain about otherwise

The staff are fantastic. I was the classic definition of tourist. I went to the lobby counter multiple times asking where a good place to visit/see would be. And each and every time they have me more than one options. Very great staff. Location is not in DT but very accessible to it!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Customer service is awful.  The owner/host really doesn't care. He wouldn't seat our party of 3 until everyone was there, even though his restaurant was half empty. When we were all there, he continued to make us wait while he putzed around in the back. The food is not worth this man's attitude.

Good pizza for a fair price, but a very rude staff member named Alexis. She was rude to me and to a couple of other customers in front and behind me. This is the second time I've encountered her with such poor customer service. Management needs to deal with this issue or I won't be patronizing this location any longer.

We've been back a few times and unfortunately I have to change my review. Chips are so stale every single time. Meat quality has dramatically decreased. They gave the most expensive drinks in town. Dinner for 2 with 1 drink each cost $58 and we left dissatisfied.

Just beware. You will return to this delightful little slice of a bright light of hope in Wilmington dining experience. A well trained staff and kitchen clicking like they can't get it wrong. Hopefully back there in the heat of the flame  egos collide. Thank gawd. Wonderful prepared dinner. Thank you.

We just moved to the area and were hoping to find a good coffee house. So happy that Lucky Goat is just a few block walk! The seasonal drinks are amazing and the service is so quick. During covid-19 they have implemented an online system but it's super easy and takes 30 seconds. We love this place!

THIS SUBWAY GIVES ALL SUBWAYS A BAD NAME
Why do people want to work in a food service business when they hate customers?  Seriously, they should try a profession that doesn't involve the public.  The owner/manager reminds me of the Soup Nazi on Seinfeld.  Stay away!  Try Jersey Mike's or Jimmy Johns.

The staff members and cooks are extremely accommodating, the desserts are divine, the setting is lovely, and the service is great. This is definitely a place you want to try out. Get the ribeye steak. It's one of the best steaks I have ever had and the creme brulee is equally delicious.

I really like garlic. But, evidently the cook spilled quite a bit of garlic into the batter for the Sunday fried chicken dinner. Way too much garlic for me. The rest of the Sunday fried chicken dinner was pretty ho hum. Drove all the way from St. Charles county MO for this alleged extra good fried chicken. What a disappointment,

Make sure you double check your order when they hand you your bag in the drive-through. Especially if it's the manager guy taking the order, he gets your order wrong. I ordered sausage egg and cheese on a sesame bagel I get home and it's on a croissant. I order avocado toast with bacon, I get home it has no bacon. Just annoying.

Best wash ever. I feel like my scalp can breath. I think it's a little pricy $40 then not including tip. I feel like $40 would have been worth it if they used a round brush but it wasn't. It was a paddle then flat iron. The end result was great. I would differently go back for just the wash! Amazing wash.

Very pricy for what you get and watch out for they use red pepper in everything but don't list it on the menu or tell you -  was seated a couple of feet away from organ player/singer (too close) for my liking of a intimate dinner setting -  waitress was very nice.

Aivi is a Goddess. She's incredibly personable and a prodigy hair dresser. She listens to what you want and exceeds any expectations you might have. Along with being the best hairdresser around, she's an insanely talented barber. She will makin you fly and makin you the pho.

First let me start of with this: I know sushi.The sushi served here is very bland. Most certainly not worth the price they ask for. I would not have eaten here if it wasn't for the groupon.

That said, the service and ambiance are great. They just need a new chef.  

Summary: TERRIBLE OVERPRICED SUSHI, great ambiance and service

i like the space! but i had a horrible experience  first time taking a class at your gym, the instructor (think her name was nefertitit? bald head middle age woman) was very rude,  I felt very uncomfortable and i will NOT be comming back for classes or recommend this place, if they are gonna hire UN-PROFFESSIONAL "teachers"
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Beautiful location. Friendly and responsive staff. 
But, mold on ceiling of bedroom and bathroom. 
Hotel was fully booked so they couldn't give me a new room. They lowered my rate for both nights. Can't see myself returning until a full remodel is completed. Unfortunate...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I am from NYC. And believe me this is as good as any place on the upper east side in NYC. Big fat egg rolls fried to perfection. Fried dumplings awesome. Delicious moo shoo pork!! And house special fried rice prepared to perfection. Do not listen to any other review. The only place better is Chinatown.

Mai did a beautiful job on my nails (full set with gel) and Linh did the best pedicure! They both took their time to make sure I had a great experience! Both were very enjoyable to talk to while working on my nails! Would definitely recommend American Nail Salon!

This place is great if you want to get an incorrect order and subpar fries and burgers. They didn't deliver any of the sauces, and to make matters worse the food was cold. Wanted to have a nice and easy meal for father's day, but instead now the family is annoyed. Thank you for ruining our holiday Checkers!

Everything about this place is awesome, except the smoke. I realize that is part of a bar, but sometimes it's overpowering. Their prices are fair, never cheap, but that keeps the riff raff down. It's a great place where you can chill or have a blast and no one else is really going to give a Sh**.

I have to say I was pretty disappointed when my food arrived. I ordered cheese enchiladas and a crunchy beef taco. I've had authentic Mexican food and this was not. This taco looks like I ordered it from Taco Bell. The beans, rice and enchiladas were ok. Mexican food is my favorite and this place just didn't do it for me.

Incredibly disappointed. I made an appointment days ahead of time and they told me it would take approximately an hour to service my vehicle. When I arrived at my appointment time they told me it would be a "few" hours because of the vehicles ahead of me. I guess making an appointment didn't matter.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I made the mistake of going to this store with a severely painful eye due to something lodged in the eye. The response i received from the manager was they could give me a appointment sometime the next day. They clearly would risk someone blinded before they would interrupt their precious schedule. MONEY OVER PEOPLE !!!!!!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The nail tech I had was very nice but the work was not as great as I thought. I came home to see my nail polish was extremely bubbly and not even. I had another nail tech who I assume may have been the owner put on my shoes before I left and she also saw my nails and said nothing.

My children loved the freshness.  We eat a lot of sushi and as pre teens and teens they were impressed. Everything was good I had the Hello Kitty Roll it's wrapped in soy paper cause I was avoiding carbs. They had the Magazine Roll, Calamari Crunchy Roll and the Sushi Entree all were good.

The manager is completely rude and care nothing about customer service. I can't believe that she was so unkind and rude this is where families go. Why would you have a manager like this. He name is Tenu or Penu. I couldn't quite understand her. I just would never have someone like this running a store.

The sushi is so good, but the main waitress is so mean.   Forget refills or bothering her.  She will literally walk away when you're speaking to her.  She's been there for years so I don't see her leaving anytime soon.  Sucks because i love going but can't take the attitude

The service has gotten better. One of the better starbucks in the area. I'd go to this one over the Target one down the road. But avoid the drive thru at all cost if there are any cars in line. One time I saw 2 cars in line at the drive thru and I thought ok this will be quick but nope took me about 10 mins to be out.

I don't know what changed here but the last couple times I've came in.. the wait time has been insaaaane.  And all I'm getting is a classic combo.  Nothing special.    Less than two people ahead of me.    I used to love this quick stop on the way home... but now i think I'll drive a bit further

Friendly fast service! But this location is horrific. Dangerous line blocking Broadway traffic.  People still making illegal left turns from Broadway east. This location should never have been put here and should vacate. Starbucks is great but move to better location with safer ingress and egress

Worst McDonald's ever. Long waits and inaccurate orders, especially weekday mornings! Worker looked straight at me and asked me what I ordered to drink, after just taking my coffee order, returned a few moments later and asked if I ordered an orange juice! Smh....avoid
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I usually love their frappe's; however, this location is not up to par with the others. When I ask for my whipped cream to be blended in, for $7 a cup, please make certain it's blended in. My experience here was less than satisfactory. I don't believe I'll be visiting them again.

I used to live close by and was a frequent visitor.  Like all Dunkin's, food preparation could be a little slow.  But the people there were almost always polite, and the store was clean.  I particularly enjoyed sitting outside (even when cold) after a stressful day, as it was relaxing to just drink coffee and watch traffic go by.

Changed my mind about them. Extremely overpriced and boarding requirements are outrageous!  OST more to board there than my entire 2 week vacation. 
Also all that answer the phone talk over you and only care about getting out how much everything is goin to cost. 
MONEY DRIVEN ‼
Goodbye won't be back.

Everyone at Berry Farms eyecare is so professional , knowledgeable, courteous and efficient.   I never have to wait. All my questions and concerns are answered. Dr. Crim is very patient and takes the time with you to make sure you are satisfied before you leave.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Went for a mystery theater dinner last night.  The service was pretty good for a large group but the food was on the same level as Fazoli's.  I had already been told by a family member who dined there recently that the food wasn't very good and this confirmed it.  For the price it was not worth it at all.  WOn't ever be going back.

We have been going here for over 15 years between Michigan road and rangeline.  Unfortunately today maybe our last they were trying to run the restaurant with 2 employees on Valentines day.  Never got our queso and food came out wrong after 25 min of waiting on it.   Very sorry to say La hacienda here we come.

This McDonalds sucks without relent.  Two basic rules of the franchise 1) deliver hot food and 2) have the food taste good.  These Ronald McDonalds didn't just give me food that was not hot, it was actually cold, like refrigerator cold.  Wtf.  Also their soda seems to be run through the toilet.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I was so happy to find a place where my omnivore friends and I can go and I can have vegan food that isn't just beans and rice, or a lettuce-only salad. The staff is friendly, the toppings are varied and delicious, and the pizza is outstanding - at a reasonable price. We will definitely be back!

Friendly, clean, affordable, quick and a great paint job! I'm pretty particular about how neat my polish is painted. I was very satisfied. I walked in and was able to get one service done right away. I will make sure to make an appointment next time. 5% discount when paying with cash for over $30 services.

OMG The driving line was so long I decided to go inside and now I know why there was such a long line outside because they are so friggin slow! I waited 10 minutes when I went inside there was only one person in front of me and then they screwed up my order twice! Don't go there go somewhere else

Not really impressed at all.  The rolls I have had have all been bland and underwhelming.  Not necessarily bad sushi, but just not good sushi.  I typically order the same rolls at other places so I have a good benchmark of what they should taste like.   I've tried it twice, both times at lunch and simply haven't been impressed.

I love having a friendly coffee shop so close to where I'm staying. But -- and it's a big one -- the coffee is lousy. It's all caramel middle tones and little of the bite and depth you get from a good espresso. Sorry, but this is the whole point of a good coffee shop. Good coffee!

Horrible!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
I will never come here ever again. The service wasn't bad the the food was made sloppy. My sisters cheeseburger had hard bread on top and it was ripped on the side so they had to remake it. After drinking 3/4 of my drink I noticed mold on the side of my cup.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Out of artichokes for the second time in a-row for our favorite pizza. Server recommended bacon ranch which was good, but still not my favorite. Probably won't go back, too many other choices. This used to be our favorite, but lost us due to lack of ingredients.

Pizza arrived fast and relatively warm. Lots of very tasty meat toppings and super nice, thin crust. But, the gooey cheese whiz flavor underlying the whole thing was not a pleasant experience. I understand this is a relatively popular local concoction, but it produces nothing like a traditional pizza flavor.

They have actually pretty good pizza but I really really really really hate places that advertise they're open until 930 and then close early because they're really don't give a crap so good place to get pizza don't pay any attention to when they close because they're liars

Go somewhere else to go to Pieology

Hands down consistently poor service. Today I sat in drive thru and was ignored in my lane while other customers in next lane were waited on. Went inside told the female manager  who gave me a blank look and didn't' say a word or apologize. Avoid this location as it is always poor service and the food is never hot.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Very bad, oily mei fun, no veg at all, grey chicken.  The oil was very stale tasting, I wouldnt have fed it to my dog. Oh and a fun little extra I noticed when picking up, an illegal (by visa MC standards a huge merchant violation) dollar upcharge which was not divulged for using a credit card. AVOID

Very upset. Bought a bottle of tequila and mixer from this location. They put them both in the same paper bag. The bottom on the bag broke as I was getting out of the car. The bottle broke with glass everywhere and cut the inside of my legs. Very upsetting. Should line w plastic or separate heavy bottles.

1st time at this location, Drive thru only at this time. There was quite a wait because the inside was closed, but it was worth it! The order taker was nice and when we got to the window he had a smile even though there was a long line behind us. We ordered a little bit of everything and it was great! I hope to return soon.

Long lines and not enough registers open.  They want you to use self checkout.  They usually have two self checkout lanes and rarely as many or more regular lanes open.  Poor use of manpower and you occasionally have to bag your own groceries because they can't figure out how to manage this location.

Awful. She did not do a good job at all and more pricier  then places that do an okay job. One of my nails was not fully polished, you can see a bit of the clear color on the nail. She did not even file the toe nails. The nails are not even, each nail is in a crooked line, just like I had cut them at home.

Bring the multi grain back.that's only good bagel in the store that you guys should bring it back and thank you so much for the consideration

Bring the multi grain back.that's only good bagel in the store that you guys should bring it back and thank you so much for the consideration

I would give this four stars but it is quite pricey for the food I recieved. The rolls I tried were good, and the tuna tataki is probably my second favorite in edmonton. The service was decent too, another complaint would be that the menu is quite limited.

I really enjoy the food and staff here. I am always greeted with an enthusiastic smile. The food is great. I have had numerous different items on the menu and lean towards the tacos. They make their own chorizo which is very good. They have a fully stocked bar so if you can't find a libation here, you can't find one anywhere.

While the food is good (rating 3-4); however, we rate the hostesses a 1-2. They are rude and act like you are bothering them. 

Brickside should retrain the staff (especially the older lady) and make the hostesses realise that the customer's are paying their salaries. It takes no energy to be polite.

So this is a beautiful and well organized hotel. The afternoon early dinner complimentary beverages and drinks and snacks are a big plus and very popular. Breakfast at Friday's are actually "world-famous" as they advertise it. Overall, good hotel and good location. Great staffs as well.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Pizza is A+. Crust is on the thinner side (not thin tough), but crispy and crunchy, has a sourdough vibe to it. Sauce has a little tang, and cheese is flavorful.

Really good NY style pizza - reminiscent of John's on Bleeker I think. 

This place is a great addition to the neighborhood. I'm psyched.

Horrible customer service - I keep giving them another chance, but it never improves. Waited 10+ minutes this morning for a small latte. And that was before the Monday morning rush. Ask if your drink is coming up? They'll purposely prep others before yours. A bit too much ego for my taste.

The staff was friendly, environment nice, but toppings were scarce for the additional price, $2 ea veggie $3 ea meat, and that's on top of the base price for the pizza or calzone. I don't mind paying for toppings but I'd like to have more than a sprinkle of them.

Would give 0 stars if I could. Trying to pay off car loan. Basically saying "take our money! Please!!" And they are making it impossible! Trying to milk every bit of interest out of us as they can. Poor customer service. Had we known then, we would have stayed away!!!

This place is a disaster! Understaffed and because of that they are completely disorganized and inefficient.  The two orders in front of my order were incorrect and then my daughters order was wrong as well. A lot of people like Dunkin Doughnuts but I will not go back any time soon.

Such a great hidden gem! We were forced into line dancing with friends across the street so my husband and I wanted to get a great dinner before a night of dancing. 

Sooo delicious and very nice workers. Can't wait to go back! This might be our new favorite "mom & pop" sushi joint. YUM!!!

Good food, fast and friendly.    Decent portions.   Good value for your money.

I love the "Four Seasons" under the 'Chef's Specialties.  It's  'a delicious combination of lobster meat, chicken breast, sliced beef and roast pork sautéed with fresh vegetables in special sauce'.

Ordering for second time. First ordered BBQ ribs, General Tso's chicken and Fried wontons. The food was hot, fresh and delicious. The wontons were double wrapped which is too much dough for me. It's been difficult to find real Chinese food nearby so will use Grub Hub for delivery.

The nail tech was nice and did an okay job. She did not completely remove all of my old color and I can still see some. The salon was dirty. Everything is dusty. The "arm rest" that everyone uses did not look clean and everything on the stations was gross. Take a little time and wipe everything down. I won't be back.

Definitely the worst McDonalds I have ever eaten at waited 30 minutes for my food the forgot the sauce and when I did get it it was wrong.
