I ordered 4 large cups of sweet tea and they ended up giving me 2 sweet teas and 2 things of coffee. Another time I went which was last month I saw a roach climbing on the seat never again
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This Subway is terrible in comparison to other Subways. Management and staff are VERY rude. Do not like to honor coupons. They barely put anything on the subs. Other locations put a lot of meat and stuff on the subs. This location it's bare bones. Worth the extra drive to go to Cedar Hill if you really want a Subway sandwich.

There is literally ONE good cashier. Her name is Kaley. My boyfriend and I have been going to this Publix for over a year and always end up complaining about how long it takes to check out (i mean long) until we were in Kaley's line. From that point on, we always find her register to check out at. 

Also, the deli IS AWFUL.

First time at Koizi today for lunch and I was so happy with the service and the quality of the food.  My wife and I wanted to try something new and I'm thankful we found this place.  Food was fresh, lots of choices and I even got dessert all for one price.  Definitely going again!!!

It's fine, but it can suck getting into the parking lot because the drive thru line can get backed up all the way to the entrance point on the road.  And getting out can suck too if what you want to do is turn left at the light on Ulmerton.  Just makes the place not worth it.

Terrible service. The building is run down and the pizza takes twice as long than what they quoted you, even though there are five employees and no customers. They will ignore you while you are standing and waiting for your order. Luckily these are franchised and there are better locations.

Do not rent here if you actually want things done. You can call maintenance everyday for a week and they still will do nothing. There is literally a board on my porch that is broken, my friend (and myself) tripped over it I literally injured myself, but yet they still have not fixed it! Surprise surprise. Very unreliable.

Mediocre food.  Sushi is not done neatly prepared. Instead, it looks like they roll it as quickly as possible.  Only vegan sushi choice is avocado. If you sit at a table where they cook in front of you, you're going to leave stinking of the oil and food. Atmosphere is just dark.

Joined recently--definitely great value for your money; Small specialized classes (for free) are offered Mon-Fri; Billy (trainer) keeps you motivated and makes the classes fun but challenging!! Where else can you use HydroMassager, tanning bed, total body enhancer at no additional cost!!!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: For $350 the rooms are lacking quite a bit! The room was SMALL and do you think we could have something other than paper cups??? There's a Starbucks in the lobby but some crappy coffee in the room. I would say you are paying for the location which was great but come on Marriott!! Step up the amenities!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Stop here periodically on way to work. Love the NY girl that works the window. Always friendly even at 6:30am. She works really hard but seems like the staffing is always on the short side. Great breakfast items and healthy options are really good. Iced coffee made with dark roast is really pretty good.

Guac, margaritas, and tacos are amazing, but not quite worth the bill you get at the end. I typically spend way too much money here and feel like I need to get something else to eat on my way home. I guess thats to be expected in Hyde park. I've never had an issue with service before.

Moved out of the area in the early '90s. Gaetano's was the only pizza we ate. Moved back recently and have ordered a couple times now. God Bless the old guy who ran it a couple decades ago. Today it's a different pizza, the sauce doesn't taste as fresh and the last 2 times, the crust was burnt!!! I'm REALLY disappointed.

Gotta be the WORST customer service in Tucson. I come here several times per week for my business account...tellers are absolutely MISERABLE to deal with. Very dry, not friendly, never thank me for my business and have terrible attitudes! Closing this business account and going elsewhere

The fried chicken and French toast was incredible. The homemade white toast that accompanied the eggs was also delicious. Service and food were both great. I highly recommend the fresh squeezed orange juice as well. Cannot wait to come back and try the dinner menu!

I ate here a couple of weeks ago after looking around NOLA for an easy pizza alternative. I enjoyed the pizza very much. I happened to time it while the selection appeared full and fresh. I was not disappointed. I will definitely return if I am in the area!

Quick delivery.   The pizza was a disappointment though.   Sauce was really good but not enough of it and the cheese and toppings kind of slid off.   The crust was thin and a bit floppy.   We got sausage and mushroom.   It could very well be one of those pizzas that is just much better in the store and not delivery.

Be prepared for super sweet sauce, I guess it is a Southern thing. Staff is very friendly and attentive, pizza falls short. Cheese should be browned a little, not jet white. Crust on deep dish was good, but veggies undercooked and that white cheese! Thin crust pizza was so soggy, the crust was inedible. Needs some crunch!

Jim rocks 
Chris rocks too
This is the best bar !

We are superfans because they have all of the best beer, and kickass tunes, and pretzels!!!

You must come and see for yourself! 

If you love good beers - not crap beer- you will be so happy with the selection

Great atmosphere 

Clean bathrooms

I'm giving this place three stars because it feels a bit ran down. The shower installations have rust, the bedside lamps tilt from the wall, the hallway smells like curry on level five. Other than that, it's just a general room you stay in, nothing too special. It's good for the price so you get what you pay for.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Tacos are great and not greasy like a usual Mexican restaurant item. Even their veggy option is great. They keep the costs down by giving you the meat and taco wrapped. You add everything else from the bar. It is fast and tailored and takes unnecessary expenses out.

Really nice, clean atmosphere. It's a gem in a bad neighborhood. Totally safe, friendly staff, and very affordable. Soap, softener and laundry bag dispenser available with easy to use change machine. 7-11 next door is nice for when you want a snack while waiting. Highly recommend!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Ordered again thru Grubhub for delivery. The steak I ordered was overcooked, and the baked potato that came with it that was supposed to be loaded, was not. It came with butter only. Delivery took well over an hour and basically everything was cold when it arrived.

Stopped in around 1:30pm for lunch. This place is really unimpressive. For one thing there seemed to be no air conditioning, so it was hot in the restaurant. The apps we ordered seemed to be just frozen items thrown into a deep fat fryer. Entre of Sukiyaki beef was nothing special either. For the price you can do better.

I had to put my cat to sleep and was struggling with the decision. Dr. Frank made me feel ok about our decision and was wonderful as I went through it. She was frankly amazing and even sent me a card after the fact. If you are facing this tough decision yourself, I recommend Dr. Frank.

I have been there twice with two different groups and we all thought the food was excellent, service was wonderful and the surroundings are very, very beautiful.  The chef is very accommodating and the food is reasonably priced.  Definitely going back for more.

I went last Saturday. Everyone was polite. Quickly moved through the process. However, the fries were lacking. I feel like maybe they spilled out or something and there wasn't time to refill the container. I was in a rush and never went back. And probably won't be back.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: My friends and i just recently discovered this little creative pizza haven... the pizza is delish (all the ingredients are FRESH).. the place is quaint and CLEAN.. and the staff is SUPER friendly! The prices are great.. great find.... and i've been back twice in 2 weeks!

when i was there couple years ago everything was great, but i when recently food was just ok and i thought it was bit pricey for quality they serve now. i don't know they raise the price or when food was good, i didn't care. server wasn't to good, seemed she was having bad day? i don't know i will recommend it now.

Quick and easy but you should probably give your car a quick soak and scrub because there's only so much the machines can do. Also make sure to take advantage of all the amenities when you exit the wash because you will not find convenience like that everywhere!

Abruzzi's has been my go-to place for so many years now. They are the only place that cares about quality food. . I own a business in the city, everybody knows if you don't return the incorrect food anybody can call and do a scam. Sounds like 2/7/20 post just needed some free fries. Best pizza in town!

Might be a great place but I left there after sitting at the bar 15 minutes and watch 2 waiters and the bartender (not behind the bar) talk about how busy it was going to be tonight.   I gave up- as did two others.  

I will check it out again tomorrow night.

This place has been a Chalfont/New Britain staple for an long as I can remember.  It's always good whether you eat in or take out. The staff is sometimes super short with you.. But I'm pretty sure that's because it gets so busy sometimes.  Great pizza, steaks, etc. good stuff!

Price hike and same dull food! $19.99 for Shrimp Fajitas now and the shrimp are so small and overcooked - not worth it!enchiladas have a strange red sauce and the cheese was not even melted for $12.99
Will not return. No idea how to place stays in business

Not very fresh raw fish for the price! They think their "all you can eat" is a good deal but it's all mediocre!
I ordered yellow tail nigiri that looked darker than yellow tail should be and smelled horrible! I get it's Covid times but should not serve old and raw seafood that is not fresh!

Coffee and tea are both pretty decent, but pretty pricey. This place is a 15 minute walk from my house, but I rarely go because it doesn't feel very inviting (to hang out, which during COVID times is fine). I've never had a bad experience, but nothing to write home about for the price.

This is my second time going to the store and both times my coffee taste like garbage and this time it was lukewarm. The first time I went I thought it might just be a bad day for them but they have not made a cuppa coffee right either times. I will never return to this Dunkin' Donuts!

The invisible man.
Table for 1...a full 5 minutes before staff brought water.
No menu.
Another 5 minutes...still nothing.
Some staff just hanging around...
Only about 1/3 of the tables in use...
Unacceptable.  $ and experience went elsewhere... Not a word when I walked out.

Extremely rude people!! They refused to make a simple order for no reason and then screamed on the phone when we complained. What happened to customer service? What happened to "have it your way" ?? I guess that's out the window. Very disappointing and strange!!

Great little place with very good Japanese food. 
I like getting the yakisoba with chicken and will have leftovers for days. The katsu is cooked well. Crispy and moist. The spicy tuna don was very yummy as well.

Very good food for very reasonable prices. Would highly recommend. A solid 4 star place.

The veterinarian services are amazing _ have nothing but positive things to say about them but the Pet Insurance is disgusting. We just lost our dog and you cannot get through on the phone and the email address is no longer operational. I'm resorting to a YELP review in hopes of getting the companies attention.,

Great experiences every time for pick up and delivery. Always hot and visually pleasing pizza. This past time we ordered delivery, they came early and gave us an extra pizza that they messed up! They really didn't have to do that, they could've eaten it, yet they brought it to us! I'm a forever customer after that.

This is hands down the best pizza place in New Orleans. The classic pepperoni is a staple and I've never been upset with any of the weekly specials. We had to wait a bit longer than usual due to COVID, but I understand that it is due to extra precautions in light of the pandemic.

We tried Jake's Pizza twice.  The first thing you notice is the grease on the bottom of the box.  My wife said "It was the worst pizza she had in her life".  I'm not sure, however, it should go on that list.  We will go back to       Papa John's next time.  We are done with Jake's pizza !

We had the worst server in history.  We waited 30 minutes to place drink order.  Waited another 15 with no drinks. Left the premises.  We had dinner reservations and were seated promptly but never got service.  Three other waitresses delivered drinks to people who arrived after us.   Very disappointed

I Made appointment over the phone, but the person whom took my info did not log it in. Got here 8:20 in the morning and my appointment was not log in their system. The guy at the front desk customer service was below average. I would Think before making appointment here or make this place your last choice.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The ice cream is cheap enough however there is hardly any ingredients in it. The Pralines & Cream was all cream and enough pralines for 1 bite. The cookie dough had 3 pieces in a medium size cup and the chocolate peanut butter had 2 bites of peanut butter. Also, the server had no mask or gloves. Not good

No customer service. Ok for eye test as they will schedule you you for that but don't waste time picking out glasses. After waiting 10-15 minutes for someone to become available multiple times they waited on the next person who walked through the door instead of customers that were waiting.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Amazing service. Beautiful decor. Second time staying here after a long journey. Close proximity to Canal Str, Harrahs Casino, Port Authority, Bourbon Str.  A bit expensive but well worth it. Ask the front desk for a city view, you will not be dissatisfied.
Who dat!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I had a very bad and heartbreaking experience but they listened to my concerns and are trying to make up for it so I will give them that.  A lot of hospitals would not.  Also specialty Dr's are very good but their ER needs an overaul to bring themselves up to par with the RBVH reputation. I hope they will do that.

When they first opened their food was amazing! I'm sad to say that it has definitely been on the decline since. They have forgotten things for our order numerous times when we order take out or delivery. Make sure to check your order before you leave there

Food was cold when arriving at table. Outdoor heating is completely inadequate. Food came out way before drinks. Drinks were so light on alcohol that I didn't order another round. Messed up my order. Super slow service. No parking. In general disappointing and Very unlikely i will be giving them my money again

I just brought my cat Oreo here for the second time today. My only regret is that I did not find them sooner! They are wonderful! Dr. Connelly took care of my cat Oreo, and for the second time, was absolutely wonderful! Very caring and knowledge. The front desk girls are also awesome. If you own a cat, this is the place to go!

A self-serve setting. The location appeared clean and offered a suitable amount of flavors. Various flavors tasted watery and a number of them were not available. Timely and attentive customer service. This venue's outdoor setting doesn't secure any calm and tranquil enjoyment.

Paid $$ for their top wash - entire front of SUV was still full of dirt and bugs, clear that their brushes had not touched it - had to wash myself when I got home. For the $$ should have been a MUCH better wash - other washes do way better for less $. On a plus they include di-it-yourself vacuums.

Very good food, but don't order any extras.  I ordered a Stromboli with fried onion and a side of extra sauce.   They charged 50 cents for the sauce and $3.50 for onions!  $3.50!   That is more than 20% of the cost of the entire entree, for a small pile of chopped onions.  Sorry but that is a ripoff.

Maybe there is a nicer lady there than the one that cut my daughter's hair yesterday. I'll keep it short and simple. Rude and way too expensive for the quality of service. She made me uncomfortable and her interaction with my daughter was awkward. Will not be going back.

OK FOR A LUNCH. NOT FOR DINNER.
Tacos are not filling. They have one tortilla with one piece of meat and a pinch of veggies and no sauce. 
it is very "street style" because you feel like you got something off the dollar menu. The food is not restaurant worthy. 
You need around 6 tacos to get full, 10 for a guy with a good appetite.

Usually very good, we go here regularly. Sesame chicken is great. We got some funky tasting lo mein recently but it happens I guess. I've been in this area for 14 years & have not found great Chinese food... We just bounce around from place to place but this is our usual spot

My wife and I were married here 6 years ago. The amazing food is still talked about today. My wife and I will be having a steak dinner there for our anniversary and we can't wait to enjoy the awesome food. Everything about this place is awesome and my family will enjoy it time and time again!!

Have tried getting in contact with owners several times. From my personal experience they don't give a shit about the customer. Ice cream is good just make sure u never have a concern or complaint because there is absolutely no one to address it or that will respond.

I'm not sure why this store has so many negative reviews!! My family orders via the mobile app and there's always a great offer, so no issues with ordering. Pizza is consistent with the brand, and the store manager (Leo) always has a smile on his face. I can't say I expect much more from a franchise but maybe that's just me.

The food is outstanding and the waitstaff is very friendly!  We eat here several times a month since it opened.  Four stars because the kitchen is VERY slow.  Last time we were in there, it took 2 hours from start to finish, no joke, but still was worth the wait :)

Long lines, locked doors, out of things a lot. Really not a great location. Sometimes after placing an online order, the doors are locked when I go to pick it up, forcing me into the long drive through line, which defeats the purpose of ordering through the app in the first place.

Muy mal servicio ,, estamos en cuarentena y supuestamente solo órdenes para llevar ,,PERO NO CONTESTAN EL TELÉFONO ASTA LAS 11:00 am en punto  si llamas alas 10 :59 no te van a contestar ahhh y luego vas arecojer la comida y vien mamones como si no quisieran trabajar ,,,Lastima del dueño que no está al pendiente

One of my favorite Italian restaurants: delicious food - reasonably priced, excellent service. My all time favorite is their spaghetti and fresh clams, their lasagna is excellent, as well. So much good food to choose. feel free to ask the staff for recommendations - they love the food too.

So sad about the recipe changes after the relaunch. Their tomato pie was my favorite for as long as I can remember. Was best in the city IMHO but now it's a completely different taste and texture wise. Gave it try twice but it's just not as good  and I don't like it so sadly won't be ordering anymore from here.

I recently had reason to use this WF branch in Haddonfield in order to get my name added on as Power of Attorney to my elderly mother's checking account. It was a long-ish process, but all through it WF personal banker Yolanda George was friendly and professional. Could not have asked for better treatment.

They offer park and fly for an extra fee. We parked for 5 days when we came back someone stole our catalytic converter off our car. When we spoke with a supervisor at hotel she said call the police but we don't have cameras outside.  Do not stay park here!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Love this gem, don't ever change! Been shopping here for years and they have the best selection of booze in town. Skip Total Wine and shop local, where you will get far better products and service!  Only thing I wish is that they would open up inside again. I know it's hard with tight spaces and covid, I just miss the browsing!

Raw oysters were bad!!  The Rittenhouse Roll (lobster) left us with indigestion.  Dragon Roll claims "crab" but is mock crab stick.  Prices are high relative to portion, even for Philadelphia.  Parking is impossible, so be prepared to pay.  Would not return or recommend.

If you want to wait 1 hour and 45 minutes for an average pizza this is the place to go. They don't even call you to replace an out of stock item and they just deliver a partial order.  Wise up Pats, there are numerous places in Downingtown and Exton that sell pizza and appreciate their customers business.

They say they're different from big banks - yes. Less reliable perhaps. We were supposed to get a notification if the amount fell below $100 and did not. This, we got our first ever overdraft - which they would not overturn. Not even as a courtesy. Avoid this bank.

Intimate. Authentic. Reasonably priced. Risotto was superb. Carbonara was elegant in its simplicity. Wild mushroom crepe special appetizer was creamy and rich. Bananas foster dessert on the famous pound cake from Stock's - cart me home and call 911 - out of this world.
Highly recommended.

Love this place! Quick, service that is friendly and attentive. Food is always fresh and delicious. The only reason I gave 4 stars instead of 5 was because I was pretty disappointed with their margaritas. They taste like they were poured out of a store bought bottle and were pricier than other restaurants.

Months later and they're still awkwardly asking for tips. Awful every time I stop through. Can't wait for another drive through coffee option asap. Perhaps put up a sign about the top policies and stop having your workers ask "do you want to leave a tip?" If I wanted to leave a tip, I would.

The coffee is so meh but it's the only drive through option. They are nice, but stop asking people if they want to leave a tip on their card. It is so awkward and rude and poor customer service. If I wanted to leave a tip, I would make it clear. I shouldn't feel like I'm forced to just because you straight up ask for one.

Breakfast burritos!  We were quite pleased to enjoy Sunday Brunch in the Bywater.  The homemade chocolate and golden raisin  pop-tarts were a great starter to share.  Shaken, not stirred iced coffee was welcomed on this warm day.  Great job Suis Generis, we always enjoy dining with you!

Much better than Crew and I would have given 4 stars but all 3 times I have gone there the attendant has motioned me forward to the track system and immediately turned it on before I had a chance to put the car in neutral and without giving me a heads up.  Not too good on the tires.

Sugar Donuts and glazed donut holes were my favorite. They were bread-y and light. Overall a solid start for a new shop! It was really cool being able to see the people frosting the donuts and the owner was working in the back! Nice to see where your donuts come from!

Went in for a beard trI'll m which they said they can do. Sat in there for 5 minutes and abruptly left after the stylist just brushed the combs and clippers and no sterilizing of any of kind with regard to cutting and trimming tools. Sorry ,not again will I go somewhere that does this. Very unsanitary and gross as well.

Absolutely disgusting! Ordered the Chicken Pad Thai and it smelled spoiled. Called to complain and got nowhere with the waitress on the phone. Never again. Several other resturants in the immediate area worth going to for Japanese food so don't waste your time or money.

At the 2nd window. Employee handed me the food, as I was saying "thank you"  he/she  slammed the window door without saying a word.  McDonalds need to train employees to be polite or at very minimum, not to be rude.  Don't think I'll be going back there for awhile.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
It's  great to have such a nice gym in Plant City!  Lots of equipment, facility is immaculate, friendly staff, and extremely reasonable.
I usually go between 1:00-3:00 p.m. and never have to wait to use any equipment.  It's open 24-7 to fit anyone's schedule.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I will say this is one of the BEST doughnut places I have seen in a while! They have quite a plethora of doughnuts and wild ideas! Its not meant for someone on a diet ill say that, but its great to check out their doughnuts and try them! You wont regret it!

Closed on Tuesday's!! 
Nicest people and great food!! Love their veggie dishes, like the vegetable fried rice, actually has tons of veggies. This is the only place that actually loads it up and it isn't like "oh look, there's a piece of broccoli."  I've used it as a base for a couple dishes for work events.

Literally deserves less than 1 star. Rude owner who couldn't even help me after I had a bad experience with take out. His response was "not my problem". The sushi is NOT GOOD!!!! It isn't fresh and I received the wrong sushi rolls. Do not go here if you don't want to waste your money.

The sushi here has its good and its bad days. Today was my first time returning and the staff was rude, they don't serve the salad anymore with the soup, and it took long to put our order in. The only reason I come is for the happy hour but other than that, I won't go there.

Tropical Isle is a great place for drinks and live music. The staff is amazing and the drinks are awesome. There are several varieties to choose from including the famous Handgrenade only available here at Tropical Isle and the affiliates. Almost anytime is great to stop in. It is touristy, hip, divey and enjoyable.

The food is great! And I the experience of this place. It's tucked back from the street so it feels like a secret spot. Sushi Circle is family owned and run by a husband and wife who are sweet and charming. You won't find that just anywhere! Very cute little dive with great food and a great vibe.

I stayed here due to work . Rooms are average . Breakfast is like eating plastic food. I can overlook all that the worst part was the rude front desk woman. I will not be staying here again. We bring a lot of staff and clients to St. Petersburg area but I will never recommend this place again .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Fantastic space but at least on a recent beautiful February Saturday afternoon, a bit of a surly non personality of a bartender. Not looking for a new friend but at least a welcoming that might keep us there for a second drink. Won't keep us away though, look forward to another visit.

Ordered about $300 worth of sushi from here and I kid you not when I say none of it was edible. The fish smelled bad, the rice was so thick and gross, just really bad sushi place overall. Santa Barbara doesn't have great sushi in general but this was rough.

Literally the best place in Jersey! We started coming here 5 years ago and it's our go to place for everything! Their pasta entrees are out of this world good, especially the spaghetti and clams. Oh and did I mention it's the best pizza in town? Don't forget to bring wine it's a BYOB! Best place ever!

First Yelp review. 2 things you can always count on here , fair priced goods and sour attitudes. I don't care for the meaningless banter, no need to be cheery and make a customer connection. Just a formal transaction,  no need for the attitude from left field, I don't make you work here

Just a fabulous meal. My fish tacos were the best halibut tacos I've had- the fish was beautifully prepared on home made tortillas.  The service too was friendly and attentive.  All in all,  a really great experience for a spur of the moment decision on the 4th of July.

This place is nasty smelly dirty. Please see these pictures. They have feces all over the toilet and the floor. Do not eat here. The freezers are not working. I can not believe that a business like this does not care about its customers and the businesses sanitation.

I can't say enough good things about this restaurant I've only tried food at the Blue Bell location and I have yet to be disappointed they are always so nice on the phone, repeat your order back to you for accuracy and always deliver what was promised! Not to mention the food is so yummy!!!

The creativity of the chef and pastry chef is phenomenal.  The appetizer "chef plate" is great.  The waiter, Dino was very educated with not only the menu, but also the history of the restaurant. 

The duck breast was moist and perfectly paired with pears and cranberry.   The grouper was like being back in Louisiana.

The gym is nice, fairly clean and you can't beat the price.  I also signed up with Thrive and do group training with Kerwin - he's great!  I have an injury, so he always tailors my workouts and is flexible with moving my times due to my changing schedule.  Love it!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
MeH, it was....ok. Very creative donuts but, some of the combinations were just, different. Donuts with Frito Lays? Fruit Rings? Cinnamon Toast Crunch??(this one was actually good)
To be fair, we did go to the shop at 9:30p, so I'm sure it was slim pickings.

Good price, but you get what you pay for! The original room we had was an open shower that did not drain properly so we had to be moved to another room. The other room was better but we left with bug bites that are likely from bed bugs. The manager also made creepy remarks to us. Will not stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: During this COVID chaos its WRONG for Redners to be to lazy to STOP a clearly unstable lady from shopping or even checking out Today at 3:15. When she refuses & argues to wear a mask. Clearly Redners sees them selves as an exception.. so if your not in the mood to wear a mask clearly Redners is all on board

Room was clean but the breakfast in the morning was not very good. There was lukewarm water for tea but no teabags, lukewarm coffee, pastries that were not the freshest. When told there was no coffee left, the server did nothing about it. The computer in the lobby was broken. Pool not opened, either.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Came here on a Friday night and had a couple of local ipa's. Large craft beer selection and great vibe. Had a local musician playing @ajr_music who killed it! Didn't order any food but like I said if you like craft beer and a cool crowd come check this place out!

Without a doubt the best mechanic in town! Eric and his team are honest, efficient and extremely fair with prices. My family will only take our cars to Gulfport Garage and refer him to everyone we know. They get the job done right to ensure you're safely on your way.

Be very wary of this facility and suggested services!  Had oil change here today. We were told we need new brakes. Took the car for a second opinion and we were told the brakes have at least 40-60K miles left on them. They also tried to tell us we needed other "add ons" !
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I've been going to this Winn-Dixie for 20 years. I won't go ever again. Fully 1/3 of the people in the store had no masks. Many employees either had none or were wearing it with nose out, no point to that. I used to trust this store, now I don't. 

They are not safe. I would strongly suggest you not patronize Winn-dixie.

Overpriced drinks...what's even worse is the overconfident bartender, matts inappropriate comments along with his unimpressive beer tosses really ruined my night. Keep working on your tricks Matt. Pretend you aren't working in a hotel bar with your crusty stache
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The clerks are rude and unprofessional, I've come in multiple times to just be ruded out and they seem happy when they're unable to assist you with something.  This branch really needs to reconsider the rude front desk women. I will go else where from now on. I've had enough

Nice beer selection but otherwise bad. The iPads over complicate the whole process and the tab closes way too fast. However, worst part was the large number of fruit flies. If I had noticed earlier I wouldn't have sat down. Definitely made me question the cleanliness. Didn't try the food as a result. Happy my beer was bottled.

So bomb!! Best tacos! The tacos are like street tacos with meat, onion, cilantro and lime. Their salsa is on point! Rice and beans are amazing as well! Taco tuesday specials and specials everyday of the week! Yum Yum Yum, a little more pricey than the hole in the walls, which i also love, but worth it!

LoVe this gym! Been going for 6 years and am so glad I started! Friendly employees that make you feel at home. Always clean! Lots of equipment choices without being overwhelming. Classes to choose from for any type of fitness level. Members there are nice and friendly as well, never feel judged or intimidated. Highly recommend!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The hostess greeted us warmly, but the waiter treated us so cold that he completely ruined the dinner. When we ask him questioned about the rolls, he answered with unmistakable contempt, very short and quick answer, no smile, aloof. We were shocked. We won't come back.

Great if you want to run on a treadmill, they have like 40. Other than that there is no where to workout because it's so packed and the gym-goers here are just rude. Teenagers acting fools & people hogging equipment for no reason. I won't be back to this PF.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Not one to leave yelp reviews but not being handicap accessible is not going to sit well with me. My beautiful friend had to go all the way down to Felix's, which i will mention is an amazing establishment with incredible pizza, instead of being able to just go to the bathroom here. Please change that.

Always excellent and personalized customer service. Been renting from this branch for more than 10 years, multiple times per month for business purposes mostly. Never a bad experience. Every person there from manager to the car wash guys goes the extra mile to please.

Worst Dunkin in town! We live by this location so we tried this place so many times ...Coffee tastes old and bitter. They hardly ever have a good selection of donuts. Once they ran out of creamer for every drink??? Very sad franchise, we now drive to the Dunkin further from our home since this one is so bad.

Incredible food and amazing service. Stopped in on our way to the Temple game. Get a reservations and show up on time. The place gets packed. They do accept all major credit cards, they haven't been "cash only" in 5 years. Escargot and tiramisu were the best!

Words can't express how upset I am with this business.  Long story short, they ruined a pair of designer jeans.  They refused to make the problem right by refunding me or even trying to repair what they did.  The woman at the counter was rude, argumentative, and has no business dealing with customers!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
We went here on the way home just because we were hungry and always were intrigued by the Tuscany building. We love Mediterranean and fish. 
They serve Mediterranean fish flown in that day, never frozen. Wonderful!
Now our favorite place for dinner!
Good wine list, also!  The best Italian in Tucson, and we have tried many!

Why, with all the great Italian restaurants available in Philly, would you come here?  

Very pedestrian food, no parking, no credit cards, and no ambiance. I understand the history, and perhaps even a little of the charm, but frankly, those factors don't compensate for tasteless, bland food.

Service was slow and server got both orders wrong which didn't really matter as the food was dry and boring.  On the upside the margarita was tasty and surprisingly strong (probably so you don't notice how bad the food is).  Also salsa lady was very good - sadly store-bought chips.

The young African American guy that works the window at the drive-thru tried to make fun of what I was wearing then called me a "f***king melon head" without me ever doing or saying anything. I was just tryna get some donuts. Giving this two stars b/c at least the donuts were good. Probably should fire that guy though

Great supermarket. I love good prices on produce in particular. However, some employees are not wearing masks and they are socializing with each other. This makes me feel unsafe and uncomfortable. Because of that, I am trying not to go there any more. Too bad. I am missing this great store.

UPDATE - 
After a bit of a rocky start, this place has really found it's groove.

It's nothing fancy, 100% order the steak fajitas and the margarita (spicy or regular). The food is fresh, well-cooked, and served good-sized portions. 

Definitely check it out!

We have been here many times. The spaghetti and meatballs is delicious. Chicken spiedini was always tasty and moist The atmosphere is very pleasant suitable for casual or entertaining friends.  It is nicely decorated. Wait staffs are always friendly and attentive without hovering.

The staff isnt the friendliest but the food is fresh and seasoned well. I am originally from North Jersey and up until we ate at panda Garden I had not found Chinese that is good as it is at home, Panda Garden is right up there with some of the best back home. Definitely returning.

Loved the sushi but... our server was very hostile towards our table. It was disappointing we never got refills on our water and we were never taken care of like we should have been. The waitress took care of all of her other tables and tended to them, but not to us. We tipped well and were polite. Wish we got the same in return.

I've been coming here for a few years and staff has changed. I felt a bit rushed and the person (male) who took care of me had poor attention. He was trying to multitask but doing a poor job of it. I had asked to have my current glasses adjusted and he never did it.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Stayed here for a conference as the Gaylord Resort / Convention Center was full. While the room was clean, it was pretty outdated despite the cost not being much less than conference rate at the resort. Overall disappointing for the price. Internet in room was also very poor.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Almost $4,000 later for them to tell me my dog "might have" colitis and giving me a prescription for special diet dog food. They were extremely cold, passed me from doctor to doctor when I was just trying to get clear answers on her prognosis. I will absolutely never use these people again.

Was not blown away for the price.  "Liked" all my dishes but only over the lobster app. The bucatini was good but definitely more spicy than billed. We ate at the chefs table and were gently rushed through the dinner. Too much money to feel like we were holding-up turning over the table.

Food was ok, but definitely not worth the wait. 1 hour and 10 minutes to get our food. Waitress seemed like she didn't care, no explanation, no offers of more bread, etc. She put her tip on the bill for table of 6 so no skin off her nose. Won't be going back.

We love coming to Rodes. Their brunch is amazing and the bottomless mimosas make the day. All of their food is great. When you go, you have to ask for Andy. He is their best server. He is so energetic and makes sure you have the best experience. Every time we go we make sure to ask for him!

Prompt and friendly service. Italian service and food you crave and look for! Bring your family, your date or just solo because you have an true appetite for good food. Every time I'm in Cherry Hill I make a point of planning it around a meal time so I can stop I'm here!

Passed by for the kids to check out the indoor play area. Seems fun. Haven't tried the food. Inside seems clean. Parking along all sides of the property. Modern updated interior and tables, some may have an outlet charging station. The exposed air vent along the play area is actually clean! Not covered with dust.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Pedicure was not very good at all. No foot message. No sugar scrub or lotion for legs. They use a grater on bottom of feet and no bags for the spa which could lead to a foot fungus if not cleaned properly.  Wasn't relaxing at all. They do a good job on acrylic nails depending on who u get.  Not recommended for pedicures at all.

This place is disgusting and not fit for families. There are people here who clearly do drugs during all hours and I had to switch rooms as there was so much blood stained on a mattress it seriously looked like a crime scene. I've never stayed somewhere so filthy. Do not bring kids here
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Double Knot is wonderful, so when I saw this spot I had to try. Sushi rolls are tiny and overpriced. Not freshly made. I ordered spicy tuna rolls and received dried out tuna with no spicy sauce. The spicy cucumbers leave much to be desired. Better off elsewhere!

Overall really good place, the noodle plates are tasty but wish there was more food. The crab rations are some of the best I've ever had. The sushi is decent but wish they had more specialty options. Also they are the only restaurant not open for dine in in the area unfortunately

The pizza is okay, I mean it is a chain so you can't expect much. One thing, if you order online don't include the tip if paying by credit card. Leave it blank. Our driver obviously saw that he was already guaranteed a tip so we only saw him after an hour had passed on a slow late Sunday evening.

Creative flavors, even beyond the usual "they have this topping, and that flavor", this place should be on tv for their exotic flavors and combinations. Not to mention, they're always changing and expanding the menu offerings.

I've never been disappointed with anything I've taste tested or ordered.

This hotel is terrible during a pandemic. In the lobby, there's usually many maskless people walking around despite the signs telling people to wear masks. This hotel feels extremely unsafe, and has a complete disregard for safety. There needs to be staff telling people to put their masks on, because COVID still exists.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Cancelled our order for no reason after 5ish hours of waiting (and no this does not mean 10 minutes that equal 5 hours - it was hours). Unprofessional and will never order from again. Plenty of other Asian places to order from in Philly. Now I am just hangry because I want food.

This is the slowest drive thru of any fast food restaurant that I have ever been to. The drive thru workers taking the orders are extremely rude. Just to get a drink will take on average 10 minutes and that is if there are no other cars in the drive thru line.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
You've got a habit, and they've got a burger grill.

Burger stacks up to In-n-Out, but I only go for it over that because location location location.

Pros: pepperoncinis, avocado, and a decent veggie burger
Cons: price point ain't as competitive as the In-n-Out. Fries and shakes ain't much to write home about.

The service is pretty good and they are fast with takeout at least but the food is pretty fake and made me sick I didn't even eat a third of my meal and still ended up sick to my stomach. It could have just been an off day   The prices are good though for the rolls which was all that I ate but the quality is still poor.

I would never take my car for work here again, they lied about repairs as I was getting 2nd opinion about my alignment, they also wanted to charge me 4 times as much as it normally should. The staff was also very rude so I would avoid this place all together.

This place was great from start to finish. Service was awesome, we had everything we needed and it wasn't overbearing. Food was fresh and delicious, there wasn't a single thing we didn't like! We may have over ordered, so we are looking forward to left overs for lunch tomorrow! We will definitely be back!

It could be better here. The bald bartender is a bit of a jerk. The wait for drinks is pretty ridiculous as well. The food is great though after you wait an hour for it. Oh and if you want a server make sure you go find one or they'll just walk past you for hours.

My old neighborhood standby is still up to its usual fine quality.  Nice B&B with flavorful entrees at a reasonable price.  Service is great.  Went there with a group of 6 on a weekday.  Not crowded, though this is usually not the case.  Excellent night out.

Visited the rooftop bar, Vantage. Friendly fast service and awesome views! Beautiful breezy spot to enjoy the beauty of Saint Pete and Tampa from the ninth story of this lovely hotel. Had the oysters and dessert. Thoroughly enjoyed everything and I was treated great.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Excellent hotel.  The King suite was nice and comfortable, with a flat screen TV in both the bedroom area and sitting area.  Good water pressure and shower head.

The included breakfast buffet was much better than most, with fresh eggs, oatmeal, fruit. and the ubiquitous waffle machine.  Coffee and tea were available all day.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The name says it all. This is the best pizza in the city, and some of the best pizza I've ever had in the world. Eating the pepperoni rolls is like hearinffthe voice of God, but with mozzarella. They have a rotating menu so check the website but whatever you order will be amazing.

Absolute garbage service. I watched 16+ cars passed me in the other lane because they don't know how to properly take orders. Literally sat in line for over 30 minutes while people who pulled up got their food and 10 and I couldn't move isles. They need to fix there organization because that was trash
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: From the friendly, attentive, knowledgable wait staff to the memorable meals, this is not a place to miss!  The filet was tender and perfect. The pasta dish was perfectly al dente.  The evening ended with the perfect tiramisu.  A completely enjoyable evening!

This location has better free weight equipment than the others but it gets too crowded. Sometimes I've had to turn around and leave because there's no room to use the free weights. People who just use the treadmill or work out at odd hours won't have a problem.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Are my favorite sub Italian bmt on Italian herb and cheese. Haven't had subway in over two years so it was like old times. Store looks clean.
Friendly and super fast. The cheese ended up in a pile in the sandwich: that's the reason I didn't give 5/5. I like it spread evenly.

Bad service, carne asada tacos were cold and flavorless. We have been here several times and I always want to try again because it is close to our house but it always disappoints. It just feels like no one in this restaurant cares about the customers or the quality of food.

ended up here, two days in a row after bad visits to the graham st, and natural bridge st, locations... must admit, the service was great, fast, and the counter lady was friendly, and conversational..  I hate it I didn't remember her name... she totally made up of the others lack of service...
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: A lot of people seem to be really into Bar Taco as it's consistently busy. It's good, but there is better Mexican in town and for less money. I will say that their guacamole is excellent, and they have a good mobile wait system in place so you can enjoy Hyde Park Village while you wait.

This credit​ union is in trouble. Their telephone customer service takes forever if you live out of town and can't go to a branch. I've been on​ hold waiting for 10 mins and then I got disconnected only to wait another 10-15 mins. Online is good but when you​ need to speak with a live person, they are rated a 0.

If I was dying, wouldn't order this. Rather have dominos with a 2 hour wait because I know they're gonna come. This food was mediocre, can't believe the hype given towards this place. Do not spend the time waiting on this place. Just have that hot n ready from little caesars ready.

I love the variety of pizza selections and is the best local pizza place in the area. The pizzas are bigger than expected but worth the higher prices. The staff is always friendly and accommodating, but sometimes you'll be on hold for a long time if calling in the order. Their pizza, pasta, and appetizers are all delicious!

Wonderful food and great service!  Eric was our server on two visits and he goes above and beyond to make it a great evening.  Every dish that came to our table was beautifully presented and tasted even better than it looked.  Loved that the wine list includes very reasonably priced options.

No service at this place...  Every time you go there in the drive thru no one ever acknowledges you...   This place has the worst drive through I have seen...   Do not go to drive thru, because you want get service... It seems that this place is constantly under staffed...   Horrible place

The staff was nice but VERY VERY slow. I went in at lunch time on Saturday. There were about 4 people in line in front of me (probably backed up because of the extremely slow service) and I waited in line for 35 minutes! This is excessive for a subway restaurant.

Wow. How do they think they will keep their customers with this overpriced, sucky food? Paid 9 dollars for my little daughter's buffet, and 18 dollars for my lunch buffet and a coffee. Next time we'll go to Monell's, pay the same price, but enjoy actually delicious food. I am definitely not coming back.

Dined there when it first opened and many times since then. Pricing has increased to the point where you're not getting what you're being charged for. House salad which was complimentary and very good is now $12! Most other items increased about $5 or more! Quality isn't what it used to be! Do not recommend and will not return!

I haven't tried too many things on the menu here, but what I do get is so good I get it over and over again! This is definitely my second-favourite sushi place in the city. I have eaten in several times in the past, and most recently done takeout several times. It's absolutely excellent, fresh and delicious!

First time here and their rating is spot on. Service was super friendly and very relax full. I had a cheesesteak and there was tons of meat and flavor. Huge portion and could barely finish. Next time I am in this area stopping by again for sure. A most try !!! Nice job !!

Had such high hopes but so disappointed.  Garlic/sauce/spinach ratio was just not right, the crust didn't hold up and was devoid of texture and "mushy ".  The 6 minute ride home and the cheese was already cold requiring microwave. Perhaps just not baked long enough?

This place was a gem before having to offer takeout only.  The staff and servers are pleasant and friendly.  Takeout is presented thoughtfully and in an appetizing manner and is as delicious as when it was (and well again be!) served in the seated dining room and sushi bar.  Prices are very fair for both food, beer and wine.

Terrible house keeping. There was no paper tissue or body wash in the room. Housekeeping knocked at our door non stop (until we opened it) very early in the morning to clean it. The hotel said they would issue a $50 discount to the bill for our troubles but they ended up actually adding $50 to the total (rather than subtracting).
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I ordered the California Burrito with chicken, and it was good, but my dish wasn't as warm as it should have been and my husband's steak fajitas were over cooked. The service was not good. Our waitress was nice and competent, but overwhelmed and we didn't see much of her.

Hit or big miss. Don't walk in and expect to get a good haircut if you don't have an appointment with one of the ladies. Worst haircut I've gotten in 60+ years of getting haircuts. I gave the guy a tip out of respect for the profession...but shouldn't have been charged for the haircut.

If you plan to do a mobile order, this place takes upwards of 20 minutes to get it to you. The app is never correct, and the mobile order situation is a disaster. There's no way to know an accurate time, to cancel your order, or find out where you are in the queue.

All i can say is wonderful. The owner or manager may appear curt but she is really interested that you have a wonderful experience.  The yummy sauce is available for purchase.  OMG it is mouth watering. The lunch special is really something.  Excellent. Go you will enjoy.

Their shake machine almost never works, other than that the place is pretty good I guess, can get pretty busy in the drive thru some days. If they could just fix their shake machine, it would be a really good McDonald's, but for some reason it will not stay working.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Soooo delicious! Restaurant was cozy with great music. Wonderful owners and very entertaining 3 year old daughter who joined us for dinner! We ordered Rocchetti Pasta with a pink sauce with shrimp; it was so good we ordered more. Loved the bread  as well. We will be back to try new things!!

Excellent Pizza But Filthy place. Cannot believe they have not been shut down yet.  They must have rats and bugs because it is absolutely filthy.  I was in twice in a week and saw the same pizza dough that must have fallen still under the oven.    THE PLACE IS GROSS

Use to be great but has been slipping. The pizza is so inconsistent.  Every guy makes it different and some are much better than others. Dont ever go for the monday pizza special. I think pizza is made in advance and just heated up. Twice now i got it and it was dry and disgusting.  Also workers are ignorant.

Go to Jason. Just do it. I showed him one photo and briefly explained what I wanted and he ran with it and did an absolutely amazing color and cut. The entire staff is attentive and kind and make you feel at home. Well priced compared to many places around Santa Barbara. Highly recommend this hidden gem!!!

Ok
Driving down the road to perdition (TX), decided to give their new breakfast menu a try
Definitely a cut above the usual fare at mickeyD, whopperville or Jack in the crack
3.81 for a single samwich vs 2 for 4 at mickeyD, but to me, it tastes better
I only wish their drive thru personnel didn't get lost in translation

Two Emerald Aisle experiences in 7 days at the Philadelphia airport.  Both times the checkout at the gate took over 15 minutes; and not at rush hour. Each time I pulled in behind a car being served so it was not due to a long line of cars. Really need to speed up the process.  Check in experience was fine however.

The food is good but you need to get your order to go. The owners kids stay in there and they are loud and all over the place which is very tiny. The kids sometimes bring food out to you and spill it on you as well and of course don't apologize. It's not a place where you can have conversation but again, the food is good.

We were really bummed when slack's hoagie shack, where we used to go to all the time for cheesesteaks, closed up. We couldn't find a comparable one nearby. We finally tried this place and were pleasantly surprised! Meat was good and not fatty, quality roll (so important). Only disappointed that we didn't find it sooner.

This place is filthy and service is slow and typically unfriendly. I am routinely asked to pull forward and wait on 2 am wraps. There was no one in the line behind me. I told them I was not willing to pull forward and wanted a refund. The manager was accommodating, but not friendly. I will never go back, you should not either.

What a great way to start a day than a good cup of coffee and a friendly staff that greets you by name.  Just when the emails start rolling in I just twist my cup around and enjoy the hand written "Have an Amazing Day!" Thanks for starting my day with a smile.

We LOVED this vet. Leaving was so hard but we moved to a new city. Our dog is anxious for life ha and the vet was so attentive to his needs and loving with him no matter how shy he was. They also always eased our minds and complimented how sweet he was despite being difficult for them. Would 10/10 recommend either location.

Food was delicious- great happy hour prices. Would have given 5 stars but the waitress in the bar area on a Friday evening after 9 was terrible - she never came back after we placed our order.  We had to ask the bus boy several times for more drinks, more food, napkins and our bill. The Ravioli were amazing!

We have eaten at Vitello's on a number of occasions and have pizza delivered probably once a month. All I can say is it depends on who is cooking. The owner cooks great and I have had great pizza. Tonight's pizza was delivered and was the worst ever, just awful.

This is THE WORST Arby's I have ever been to. Tonight was the second time I was over-charged and didn't get all the food I ordered. The employees could care LESS. They are so incredibly SLOW, and the food was cold and the fries containers were half full. TERRIBLE OVERALL

My husband and I love this place. Their sushi is always fresh and creative. I love their tempura. Everyone who works there is SO pleasant. It is so much fun to get a group together and do the hibachi tables. We go to Yokohama a couple of times a month, and we have not tired of it in the last couple of years.

Mom and I tried this place first time together for a mom daughter night out. We loved the food and staff and atmosphere. Outdoor seating is relaxing and they can accommodate gluten allergy needs with real meals, not just salad. Delicious scratch kitchen food. Wine and drink options including mock tails are fantastic!

The bank manager, Jovan Rodriquez, put us through a horrible experience. He typed in the wrong account number, refused to help us and I spent the entire afternoon on hold with Wells Fargo Bank higher-ups trying to clear it up. It was his mistake and took hours to clear up.

This is the WORST dealership on the planet. If you are considering buying a Chevy, and this is your only option for dealerships, then do not buy a Chevy.  They honestly spoil the Chevrolet name.  Horrible service, horrible communicators, horrible quality, absolutely the worst in every way.

I rented a car from Ace Rental in Clearwater.  They rented me a car that the rear tire that the steal belts were showing.  I didn't notice until I had a flat.  I am glad that we didn't have a crash due to the lack of inspections due to Ace.  Wish I could post the pics and video.  Do not rent from Ace rental car.

different.  Small portions .  Nothing outstanding. Good service.  Since the ordering system is a bit unusual, they do spend a bit of time explaining and checking to see if you need anything.  The servers are a strong point to this restaurant .  
I think there are much better options in Tampa for this type of food.

Fantastic tasting menu
My sister and I had the tasting menu. It was perfect. From the server, Peter, to the beautifully plated dishes, it was definitely 5 star. For those of you wanting to try a new restaurant or who like tasting menus, this is the place. We will definitely be back!

Our church group attended an annual event this year for the fourth time. We usually get valet parking. This year when we arrived, we were told that our event was not a valet event. Here we are in our Tux and Gowns and we had to park down the street and walk back up the hill to the entrance. 
I feel that horrible service for us.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Not too shabby cheap Italian food. The food satisfied my pasta cravings. I ordered a chicken Alfredo combo, the Alfredo wasn't bad, but the chicken was pretty awful. I'm about 100% sure it was frozen. Tasted like the ham that comes out of a ham and cheese hot pocket. I'll order it next time without the chicken.

Staff is friendly with a few exceptions but I noticed a lot of younger adults/teenagers work at this location so the coffee drinks served are obviously made lazy and with lack of training. I ask for specifications and they ask me questions like I don't know what I'm talking about and then don't do it anyway.

Definitely not the definition of fast food. I don't think once I haven't had to wait on my order. Literally, not one car in the drive thru and I have to wait almost every time. 
Usually can't complete my order accurately either. I visit this location for convenience but I think I'd rather wait in the long line at Taco Bell.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Don't be deterred by the negative reviews!  La Baia is a very charming and homey BYO.  The food is great and the prices are extremely reasonable.  I've always found the staff to be very accommodating and funny.  Definitely worth a try.  And don't miss the mozzarella la baia appetizer!

Pool is not as advertised. VERY small and indoor only. Brown scum on tiles. More than 2 at a time is crowded. Spa is cold and cloudy. Screen in room is ripped & window was open when we arrived, so bugs got in. Shower drain very slow and water temp so hot it'll scald your feet if you're not careful. Otherwise, clean. Breakfast ok.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Great new spot but you have to look for it.  They have like 9 different types of protein to choose from and the Mexican juices are so yummy!  Try the watermelon juice!!!! So good. They are new but have a refreshing approach to Mexican food.  Similar to chipotle style. Give these people your business and not the big chains!!

Hotel was nice and clean.  We were able to check-in early in the morning to be able to park our car to head over to the parks without concern for having to pay for parking.  Sam, The shuttle driver from the hotel to/from Busch Gardens was extremely courteous and friendly!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Love the staff..always happy and friendly!!!! Margaritas are awesome!!! And the backyard food is so much better than a lot of restaurants...my favorites the handmade burger cooked outdoor with a special aioli and the full loaded tator tots ..including chorizo..totally tummy

My husband and I wanted to eat subway for lunch. As he finished telling them what I wanted, he continued to say what he wanted as well and got ignored by all the staff. He ended up just getting my sandwich because he was so frustrated with their service. This happened Feb. 2nd at 11:40am. Never coming back here. How disappointing.

It had been years since we'd been to a  Dunkin Donuts and we were surprised  by how pricey the mediocre donuts were.  The people working at the counter made it seem like we were bothering them,  and they did not stop their side conversation to take our order.  We will not be back.

This store is awesome! Great staff! Managers are very nice and professional and know how customer service works. There had been a few bad apples working there but for the most part this store is great! The coffee has a way better taste than the competitor and the donuts are amazing! The rewards program is better than Starbucks too.

I typically really enjoy this location. I come here frequently. Today, the fajita taco salad I ordered had styrofoam in it. The workers and the managers made it seem like it was no big deal. This situation was a little off-putting. I'm not sure if I will return.

This, by far, is the best eye care office and doctor I've been to. The office is immaculate, the service and staff are always quick and courteous, and the doctor himself is the most thorough and kindest doctor I've experienced. I recommend everyone I know to go here!!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Was here for a birthday dinner. Fish was good quality (which should be a given at any top sushi place in the city) but not worthy of the price. Small portions. Even the Miso soup portion was embarrassingly small. Desert was another small portion of a basic cake roll. At this price point demand more.

Fat Salmon is my go-to for sushi. My fiancé and I love this place. I always order Shrimp Shumai for appetizer and the Shrimp Tempura roll. My fiancé is much more adventurous than I, so he orders their specialty rolls, which he raves about. I can't imagine there being a better sushi place in the city!

Went there yesterday and was greeted by a young lady with a horrible attitude. Really wanted to leave before I spent 25.00 on these doughnuts. I spoke to an older sweet lady and I suggested they do not let the young attitude deal with customers. These type of kids are the kids that expect 15$ an hour min wages. I will not be back.

I liked this new place and was looking forward to going back for breakfast but they changed their hours already in just the few short weeks they've been open.  It was open at like 8am last time I was there and now it's changed to 10am so I spent my money across the street at Fitos.

Happy Hour from 5-7 is the best sushi deal you'll find around. You have to call right around 4 to make your reservation (necessary). For two of us, we get six rolls and two miso soups for under $30. And it's good, substantial sushi. The Happy Hour menu is slightly limited but you can't beat the deal.

Based on Yelp scores we probably wouldn't have eaten here. But it was the only convenient place. It turned out to be quite good food, service and atmosphere. Just picked order up it was completely wrong. Simple order not sure how you could mess it up. Told it would be 20-25 minutes went to pick it up and it took an additional 25 minutes! Pretty bad considering out of three things ordered only one thing needed cooked!

Loved this place when I lived in an apartment across the street. Pretty unique only down side is if you are working traditional hours and don't plan your Saturday morning around going to the store then you probably won't make it to there location while they are open.

Outstanding meal. 4 different entrees, salads, soups, desserts, wine, beer ... all couldn't have been more tasty.  Good prices, great menu, very friendly, low keyed and the BEST in Boise! There is no comparison to the quality and taste of their food compared to Gino's.

Ive been there twice and loved it both times. I had a buffalo chicken cheese steak that was delicious (I would have liked some more hot sauce but that's an easy fix) the pizza was really good but just as good as the next place. One of the BEST mexican restaurants in Tucson. EXCELLENT food and service.

Catering is awesome, has never failed us!

This is by far my FAVORITE Starbucks location. The staff is amazing and is always ready to answer any questions I have about new items! They never fail to make me an excellent drink super quickly! Let's not forget how great Mike is! His energy and kind manor is the best part about this store, absolutely love it!

The flavors were outstanding. The chef was very accomodative. Some of us were vegetarians and he modified the dishes for us. Will definitely go back.

By far my favorite sushi place in surrounding Nashville area. We drive from Nippers Corner just to get the sushi. Great presentation and service. Freshest ingredients!!! Do know that they aren't open for lunch service (made that mistake a few times). Love love love this place :)

The owner Joe, and the waitress Irina were both very nice and friendly.  the place was clean, warm, cozy and had a nice atmosphere.

Ate there last night.  I had the scallops.  My food was lukewarm and bland.  Before the meal they served bread with olive oil.  It tasted like ordinary supermarket bread, and the olive oil was cold.

Dr. Denick is great and very thorough. However, the eye doctor's receptionist has us changing optometrists. She's very rude on the phone- she's snarky and laughs at questions. When we went in person she's even more snarky! We won't be returning because of the front of house service!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Absolutely horrible.  I waited in the drive thru for 30 min.  I had to ask twice for someone to take my order while the took the orders of the other drive thru.  Then AFTER I order, they tell me they don't have drinks, ANY drinks.  Seriously?!  I waited a half hour only to just leave and not get any food.  WILL. NOT. BE. BACK!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Are you kidding me where do I even start. First of all our waitress was terrific. Short girl with glasses and a nose piercing I forget her name but she was awesome. We had a large party as well. Talented staff. The food was remarkable. Very nice atmosphere inside. Nothing to complain about! Come support them!!! BYOB too.

I was visiting family and needed a car wash and this  was the only one I could find. I should have listened to the reviews. I will never go back. The car still had streaks of white all over one side. Plus I was missing my retractable car charger. They are not friendly and over-priced. Don't go here. Big disappointment!

Great food at a reasonable price! Excellent service..we'll be going back. We ate in the smaller dining room and found the noise level to be acceptable. I was surprised by a reviewer who chose Guiseppe's in Edgmont over San Nicola. We live 5 minutes from there and won't go 
near it for dinner..crowded and noisy.

Great place for a simple soft serve + dip if you like. I got the chocolate soft serve with a cherry dip and all I can say is it felt like childhood. The dip had a nice crunch to it and the soft serve was creamy and smooth. It made for a perfect treat on a hot Florida night.

I asked about checking the1976 Eldorado I just purchased.i was told the had a  27 point  was free. got there and was told I was to pay 80.00 an hour it took 3hours to rotate the tires and fix a aturn signal bulb they said I owed 300.00 dollars this place is a rip off never go there again andtell anybody  to stay  away  RIP OFF

Best barber in the city as far as I'm concerned. The price is hard to beat too, $16 for old school razor cut. Marco is a real professional that can give any stylish haircut. Hires quality assistant barbers too. You need to make appointment, sometimes a week in advance to get in.

I've been coming here for about a year now and love it. Traci is so talented and really takes the time to get to know you and give you an amazing haircut. The salon itself is really clean and there is a ton of parking which is a plus. Highly recommend Bella Capelli for anyone looking for a new salon!

Went last night with my son and husband we loved the bread, the food, dessert and coffee! It was all very good! We had a great server she was a little on the busy side but she was so personable it made up for having to wait! One of my new favorite places in Boise!!

i spent last week in the french quarter at a b and b on bourbon street. the washing well was perfect for my special laundry needs as a guest in the city, fast efficient and friendly, unique business owner operated . a great place to get insiders view to the local scene
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Went here for the first time. Had high hopes for the chicken! It was ok kind of dry potato salad had no flavor and I was told the Mac and cheese was very popular but also had zero taste. On the other hand I tried the birria tacos and those were amazing. I would go back just for those!

Truck couldn't get into gear at 430 pm. Phone BRAKEmax. David got me a tow and off my truck went. David called today at 930am truck was ready for pick up. Bushings went bad. Thank you David for Everything, it was painless . The guys at 2240 n Silverbell , thank you
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This place is the best Chinese in the area and it hasn't changed one bit in 25 years. Have been coming here for take out, dine in, New Years dinners for ever and the food is always amazing, the same waitresses are quick and friendly and the exact same decor. This place never fails and is always a good choice.

Good prices & customer service. I like supporting this local business which is also family owned and operated. 
The pre-made foods are wonderful and perfect to bring back to family in other states. They also have a good selection of speciality items like sugar-free and dairy-free products.

I took a date here for Valentine's Day
We started off with oysters which melted in the mouth.
Then we had a couple of very nice strip steaks.
The bar has a very friendly crowd, and an awful lot of
single women alone for valentine's day. 
Lovely place with a nice upstairs dining room.

Just got food from this Chinese take out. Food was awful. They say New York style, no way. Got beef and broccoli, didn't taste like beef and had a weird texture. Also the people working there had horrible attitudes. Will never go back! Didn't even want to give one star. Spent $46 and it's going in the trash!

I've seen customers in there chatting away with the owner while not wearing a mask.  The owner had a mask on that covered his mouth only.

I wish the priority was the safety of the food, rather than the owner's desire to talk to anyone who will listen so that he can explain how the world works.

First, double check your charges--tried to run a plus $4 charge on my charge slip.  Thought they did a great job until I took time to look the car over.  Even with the enthusiastic approach of one of the employees, several unwashed plsces.  Took over 45 minutes & still not clean.

This is our favorite Italian restaurant in the area. Always great service and you can count on the food being well prepared every time. A nice wine selection as well and the wait staff are usually very knowledgeable about the wines. Great place for quiet dinner by the river.

This is truly a neighborhood gem. Frank and the crew are always accommodating. The food is great and the specials are just that, special. They also accommodate special events. Just call. They do large parties with notice and funeral luncheons. Makes a mean steak when it's on the menu.  BYOB.

Never stayed here before but glad we did .  This was an awesome location close to everything without the nighttime noise.  The lobby and room were very modern and tastefully decorated.   The bed was so comfortable. The staff was among the most helpful I've encountered. Can't say enough good things
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My second meal there and it was equally as forgettable as the first time. Ever since Cazuela's closed (off of 36 in Avon) it's been a struggle to find decent Mexican fare. I am full, because of large portions. If I had my druthers I'd rather stay away from this place and eat at the Penn Station next door.

What a waste of $9, automatic was said it had a dryer (wasn't working), and even worse it did a lousy job washing the car. They must use hard/unconditioned water, it left a film on windows and didn't even get most of the dirt off the car. Can't comment on self-serve but save your money for an automatic.  This one is AWFUL!

This was another great Mexican spot. Their rice and refrozen beans where amazing. Had the taquitos lunch special. Great prices for lunch. Great service and mixed drinks are amazing. Would definitely go back for lunch. Great location with plenty of parking.

don't buy wipers from Lube city.
one broke off at the tab after 6 months, the other broke off this week.
I replaced the first one, but after the second one broke off I felt a replacement or a discount on a replacement was in order.
was told they don't warranty their parts.
this after getting service work done there for many years.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Ordered the La Nonna pizza and picked it up to take home. Hadn't had this particular pizza from Joeys. Very disappointed with it. The crust was like cardboard, flavorless, and extremely oily. Have had other meals here which were good. Wouldn't recommend this particular pizza.

It's good. Nothing to write home about but good. It's hard to find an exceptional takeout Chinese food around Mad Beach area. But this place is good. Had the house fried rice, raggon, bourbon chicken, shrimp and veggies. For a quick drive by for a Chinese food fix, it's good.

No doubt an above average selection for this area.  You'll be fine if you can navigate on your own.  Staff leaves much to be desired -- better floor staff in the past.   Perhaps it was the day and the time, but the shopping experience was not comfy (middle of week and mid day).

Recently ate hear - food was very yummy and great prices.  The only reason I am not giving 5 stars is the place needs a little updating as far as the decor, booths furniture etc...    BUT FAST SERVICE AND GOOD FOOD at a very good price.  Had pancakes and sausage and grits = YUM YUM!

I ended up back a week later with my other car. Not only was the staff absolutely fantastic, but I may have gotten the best wash I have gotten ever, here or elsewhere. It was like a mini detail, car was spotless. Using my axxess card, it was a great deal, couldn't be happier

The food was really good, my husband ordered chicken fried steak, and said  the taste was great. I got the Denver omelette  and I also ordered it with ham & cheese. They didn't charge me for the ham which I thought was pretty Awesome. I will be there again , and the staff were very helpful

Cheap drinks in the quarter is enough for some people. You don't have to be gothic or weird to get in, the people are very friendly.
