Goto the back bar the bartenderess is very liberal with the spirits according to legend, and definitely take a tour of upstairs where the freak show is a sight to see.

Terrible service and unfriendly- Dave. Kept leaving my hair cutting service and would come back after 5 or so minutes. Then gave him another chance and didn't honour my appointment time. I waited 45 minutes and then I said I was leaving. He Could have cared less. Hair work itself was terrible. Wouldn't recommend this place.

We had HoHo Chinese tonight. The food was really good. I like the Hot Braised Chicken and Crab Rangoon. The man and his wife were really nice! We dined in. The place just remodeled and so it was very clean. We will definitely be craving those Crab Rangoons tomorrow.

My friend who owns Star Auto Body had referred me to Frank, as that is who he only uses for his own vehicles and trusted him and his workmanship.

I found Frank, to be honest, upfront, takes pride in his work, and they are a local family-owned business like us. I will be returning with other vehicles and send friends there also.

Less than mediocre. Went through purchasing the top wash and areas of the car still white with salt residue. I'm not one to complain, actually lenient on reviews. I would skip the place unless last resort. Best car wash I've been to is diamond express in Springfield. Blows this place away, cheaper and has free vacuume.

The manager was very rude. We asked simple questions (when the pizza would be here, how long It would take, how much It is) and the manager on the phone was very antsy and ended up hanging up on us. We called back and she explained she was the manager and seemed very mad. Our order was big enough to ask questions

Great food, great service. Been getting takeout here on average about once a week for a year, and never had a single problem or complaint. Not sure why there are bad ratings on here other than maybe some cranky customers or fluke experience. Pizza is great, subs and pasta dishes are awesome too. Can't go wrong with Franco's.

This location is awful. They don't bake their own donuts? So anytime after 10am, the donuts are stale. And my iced vanilla latte, often more times than not, tastes watered down more than other locations'... However, the customer service is always outstanding. The staff is always friendly and those who are not, do not seem to last.

Delicious... you have to order the honey ginger tea which has slices of real ginger and just enough honey. It is heaven. Had the crunch roll and bird nest roll. 

Service was quick (though you wait for the rolls) and friendly. 

Prices were reasonable, especially for special rolls. 

Will definitely be back.

I dined in tonight and everything was excellent!The staff is very friendly and accommodating and the food was very good. The atmosphere was clean and we felt very comfortable with the seating and thought everyone was socially distant. We will be returning soon!

Nice spot to have breakfast. Food is delicious and plentiful to say the least. My new weekend breakfast spot. Try the corn beef hash. If you can finish their plates your really hungry or just greedy! Lol. They service was friendly and welcoming and food was served timely,  after your order is placed

The staff are pleasant. However, I had reserved a mid-size car but was instead given an SUV because they said they hadn't finished cleaning the mid-size cars.
They also made an error on the Invoice with an erroneous extra charge of over $100 which I had to call and have corrected.

I went to this nail salon because I had a gift card. I chose a basic gel manicure and left with bleeding cuticles. The gel polish lifted on at least 4 fingernails lifted and peeled off in less than 72 hours. It took longer for my wounds to heal than the manicure lasted! This is why I do my own nails....

Big problem is portion size. You just don't get your money worth.  The sushi rolls are small compared to other sushi restaurants.  We ordered sushi to go with salmon skin salad. Small amount of salmon but the worst part was they forgot the dressing. Was supposed to be ginger dressing but got nothing.

Awful food which took forever to get - well over 30 minutes. The Ribeye was paper thin, the mashed potatoes paste and covered with "plastic" nacho sauce. My husband had a beer that he couldn't drink because of the funky smell and taste - an obvious sign that the line had not been cleaned in some time. Never plan on going again.

The food is always good here and the young man at the register was very nice and polite. I do wonder why the phone rings incessantly and why the murals are of such depressing scenes? The pictures are of very unhappy people and unattractive streets in Italy. I know we go here for the food that is a good price and tasty.

I appreciate an honest auto repair shop. I took my car in to this Brake Max for an alignment after getting four new tires. They called me to tell me I did not need an alignment and could pick up my car. They were friendly, honest and have a nice customer desk and waiting area for future reference.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I liked it very much. food was tasty and waitress was very nice. very warm ambience. great spot to grab dinner. only draw back is it's kind of a boring atmosphere. they do not host live music or even have a jukebox. in fact I don't believe they even had a sports game on. other than that I give it a B+

$7 for a wash that is literally broken? Some soap came out of the nozzles to get my car kinda soapy, a long wait, and then the light flashes to drive away?! It didn't even rinse off my car. I'm going to attempt to contact the owners and then report to the BBB. It isn't functioning but still takes your money.

Absolutely worst customer service! Not timely with regards to appointment times or promised delivery of glasses. They cannot keep up with who is there and who needs help. Promise things they know they cannot deliver. The list goes on and on. Check out the complaints on Better Business from others as well.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: At this location you have to wait and ask for your mobile order. There's no specific employee that attends to the mobile orders so it takes forever. I would recommend that you have a specific employee to cater to mobile order pickups or allow customer to grab their own orders like other locations.

Too expensive for what you get. Minimum $400 a room (which of course includes a resort fee), $29 for a crappy buffet breakfast, and $21 for parking.  The rooms are nothing special - it's basically next to the ocean.  Skip the view and find something cheaper.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I highly highly recommend the dragon ball it's my absolute favorite and it's the chef special. It is so GOOD! this is my new favorite sushi place and so close to home. Will be coming back here again. Everyone here is so nice, not sure why some people had a bad experience but most certainly not! This is my new favorite place!

Excellent clinic for our two small dogs. The Vet and Vet tech were very helpful and helped our skittish dogs comfortable. They take a holistic approach and have great healthy alternatives for pet care but they are not pushy with recommended treatments. Will definitely return!

This place forgot multiple order items, gave us salad with lettuce that had already gone bad, and served multiple raw fish items that were warmer than room temperature. The fried items were over fried, making the food inside tasteless and giving it a horrible texture. I would not recommend this place to anyone.

I'm Asian and I know Asian food. This is a Chinese food restaurant pretending to be Japanese. The sushi had no flavor and was poorly constructed. My meal was garnished with a beat up old flower, I wondered if it may have been used on a dish of a previous patron.

I love the ice cream and the cute animals. My family from out of state always request to come here for an after dinner treat. I usually walk here to burn off the calories from eating my favorites. The coconut and tiramisu ice cream flavors are worth the two mile walk.

The front door should have a sign: 
WARNING: This place might suck! 

The place gets a four but the bartender gets a zero-no stars.    A bar is about the people so she makes it a skunk.  
May be the only time I have literally said "that bartender is awful". Not even trying.  
Lots of better places in Boise to enjoy with friends.

I saw that wendys came out with a "classic chicken" sandwich, thought I would give it a try.... TERRIBLE. No lettuce, or pickles as menu shows. Tasted stale and fries tasted old and were less than warm. It is no wonder this place looked like a ghost town compared to the McDonalds up the road

NEVER AGAIN

We took my parents here for a week day dinner and it was really nice. The food was cooked fresh after we ordered and everyone was happy with their food. I got blackened salmon over pasta and I loved the flavor of the fish. The bread was fresh and service was great. Very friendly staff.

We went here with a large group of people and the service was pretty decent and they accommodated us quickly. The sushi was good, but the ramen was amazing and we will be back! Also I was glad to see kids there too, we will be bringing ours when we come back as well.

Customer service is horrible! We reserved a passenger van for a summer vacation trip and week before they called and confirmed our SUV will be ready!! Then said it will be hard to get a van this late but if we did it would cost you more money than we quoted.

This is my favorite Planet Fitness location! I recently moved up this way and absolutely love this location! Very clean and never too crowded. The staff is also super nice and attentive. I plan to stay at this location permanently as the other locations I have belonged to were never as nice as this!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Good service however every time I asked about a rear differential fluid changed they either said my car didn't need it or they just never did it after setting an appointment for it. I've been here multiple times and their service has been pretty good I just don't know if I'd continue coming here.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The pizza and potato skins here are so good! Their crust is crispy...my favorite pizza in the city. They also bake fresh bread and desserts daily (the cheesecake is awesome).  Another bonus is the woman who manages the take out area. She is so friendly and personable... She's wonderful. I highly recommend STL Italian!

The worst possible McDonald's. If you go after 9pm you will wait at least 10 min in the drive through with 1 car in front of you. That's if they don't say they're closed during their normal hours or they will be only cash. Not sure how corporate still let's this one stay open
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Stayed in the hotel the establishment is located in. Nothing really special about the place. Food was "ok" but way over priced, $22.95 for a shrimp platter w/fries with only 9 shrimp! Oysters were good but clams were very gritty. Jessica was friendly enough.

The restaurant has begun it's steep decline. No options for vegetarians other than combining side dishes. They used to have a garden burger, but that's been dumped. The menu is stale and needs to be updated. They used to have specials to give some variety, but that's also gone. This used to be a 5 star for me and my family...

This review is for this specific location. Do NOT do delivery. I ordered pizza for lunch on a Wednesday...pizza arrive 1hr and 40min later...1 hour after the estimated delivery time and pizza was luke-warm. I love Imo's, was disappointed with this service:(

Making an appointment is imperative for the customer at this location, however, honoring the appointment should be just as important to the salon. My 6pm appointment did not begin until 6:52pm. That is unprofessional and unacceptable. If I was not traveling tomorrow, I would have left. Never again.

Ordered on Uber eats.  Order was bring prepared for an hour and a half.  Finally got me at 9:15.  No bread came with it and long ago they stopped including butter.  They charge extra if you ask for a little more bread and they give you a tiny little bit.   But no nothing tonight.  Should get refund.

Our favorite bar/lounge in New Orleans!  We loved the décor, the drinks were spot on (loved the Frenchy) and the music was great.  They even played the Godfather and other old movies on the TV.  In a four day visit, we went three times.  We tried other places but the 21st Amendment is the best.

Oh my goodness! I don't need to say a lot about it other than My nails look absolutely gorgeous, Le(Lee) Is the bomb. Super sweet, and... AND...... They offer mixed drinks. I seriously had a mimosa while getting my nails done. I am falling more in love with this town, every weekend.

As a regular at the New Jersey Restaurant, Yokahama, we stopped to have dinner at the new restaurant here in Phila . Start to finish everything was excellent. Ken has done a great job with ambiance and excellent fresh meals. Service was great also. Parking was a bit of a challenge though.  Good luck Ken.

Just do not go there!!!  I was a customer since about 2009.  They say they have a satisfaction guarantee policy.  It is not.  It is all about up selling to more expensive products than insurance covers.  Giant rip-off.  I will tell absolutely everyone I know to steer clear!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This last time I went I had the Brownie Royal. Delicious and filling. I think my favorite is their banana shakes. I would go there every July 4th as a kid and get it and watch the fireworks over St. Louis from my backyard. If you go just remember to bring cash. No debit, credit cards, or checks allowed.

better then most spots for the late night burrito, consistent and decent prices. customer service could use some work but that's expected, I'm sure they didn't fantasize working at a burrito stand when they were kids, most people tend to hate their life in tucson so thanks for not giving me gristle.

Horrible service, waitress is cleaning with dirty gloves takes them off bring our food and then gets right back to cleaning. Asked for more water takes off dirty gloves grab a water jug and served. Their kitchen situation is also not good although food is alright. Very stingy owners.

Have been an Uptown customer for 20+ years.  Never again.  I was running very late due to activities & traffic in New Orleans, called salon & they said as long as I was there within 30 minutes.  I arrived within the time frame, stylist Nikki was packing up & told me No.  To boot no other stylist offered to take my appt.

Pros: the hotel was affordable, well-appointed, and quiet.
Cons: our room wasn't all that clean. We found several pieces of garbage from the previous guests strewn around and the mattress was stained and torn. I'm pretty sure no one vacuumed before we got there.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went to this restaurant tonight with my family and the food was disgusting. Beyond gross I guess the first flag should have been when we walked in the door and almost all the tables were dirty,  but there was only a couple in there at one table. We will not go back there.. if I could give less than one star I would do it.....

I go specifically to this Starbucks whenever I can because the staff makes the coffee taste even better. I happen to go in on a Friday morning and we all had a big laugh because I was the fourth Mike in a row. They hustle the orders out and do it with a smile... I'll be back for my next cuppa coffee soon.
- Mike #4

Used to love this vet, went there for years. Unfortunately after taking multiple X-rays, they missed my dogs tumor. This tumor I found out after taking him to an ER for an unrelated issue, is cancerous. And has progressed significantly. At this point there is nothing that can be done.

I picked out a color for a regular manicure and the nail tech just didn't paint my nails and still charged me to full price. I didn't have time for them to redo the service once I realized I wasn't getting my nails painted. 

There are lots of nail places in STL and I will not be returning to pay full price for partial services.

Well first  I order a large meal they charge me for it but say there out of large cups. The soda they poured had soda spilled all out side of the cup they handed to me.  On top of that after I ate it I ended up getting food poising from this food causing me to get very sick .

Found my lunch rather "meh."  Had steak enchiladas and could swear there was chicken gravy on it. Not saying it WAS, but that's sure what it made me think of.

Service was good- quick and friendly. No gripes there. Maybe I just ordered a less-than dish today.

The folks there are very nice.  Why not five stars?  Sometimes, the rental process takes a bit long-both getting and returning the cars.  Also, their selection of cars is less than stellar.  But the attitude of the people there make up for that-thus 4 stars.

This gym is one of the cleanest I've been to, so kudos to that.  The equipment is great, and the classes are really awesome and challenging. I like to try a new class every week, but my fav is the spinning.  And it's always open- perfect for my hectic schedule!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
THEY DONT ADHERE TO APPOINTMENTS. I waited 23 minutes and then technician didn't say hello, apologize , nothing . TERRIBLE service - I was then told to have a seat as if he was ready and waited an additional 10 minutes lol .

Greedy nail technician taking advantage of consumers during this pandemic.

My review may be biased by the occasion we were celebrating . The food, simple pasta traditionals ,were ok. It is the atmosphere that was  so oppressive ; it seemed joyless and perfunctory. It was a Saturday night, the place should have been crowded; it wasn't. Something is going there. Maybe it's hiring family.

I usually get good food at Fortels but had issues this time. Pizza had little taste except for the pepperoni. The mushroom appetizers were inedible. All wet and mushy on the inside and no way it was made with fresh mushrooms. It was carryout so no server to complain or take back. Not if we will go back for awhile.

It's been a while since I've been here, but they use to have Pre-fix meals on Mondays for $35 (like Restaurant Week.)  The food was really good and a nice place to go with friends without breaking the bank.  The restaurant is a BYOB and has a comfortable casual atmosphere.  I would consider the food to be Californian French.

We recently switched to tire discounters and have so far enjoyed good service and fair pricing. We will continue to go back their with both our cars. We also enjoy the convenience of them being so close. Would be nice if they offered shuttle service with in a few miles. Overall very happy! thanks you!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Bad service and bland food. I must've gotten spoiled with other places that sell ramen and sushi around town because I was really, really disappointed with this place. The prices were average for the meal size but the meal didn't taste good at all. The ambiance was kind of cool though.

Went a little after 3 pm on a Thursday. Only a couple patrons, so no surprise the service was good. Had the New Style California Roll, Sex in the City Roll, Rainbow Roll, and the Spicy Salmon Roll. All were good. Nice atmosphere. Would definitely eat there again.

I canceled my reservation well in advance of my intended stay and IHG charged me the full reservation for canceling. IHG will never get my business again. Piracy was illegal in the past so it's mind-blowing that corporations have the right to rip off customers right and left in modern America.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Place is way over priced and pizza is horrible. Worst imitation deep dish and NY style ever. Only good thing about this place is the beer. My final straw with this place was sitting and waiting for 20 min for a waitress. Got up walked out. Will be leaving this place off my list of places to eat.

We visited this location on a rainy Wed morning in June. The service was a little slow but the employees were friendly. Very small store with only chairs for 10 guests, which is probably enough on a sunny day but not on a day when everyone is trying to stay dry.

I ordered a chicken Caesar salad to go. I get home and open it and it's hot lettuce (bc they sat it on top  of the pizza oven) and chicken. No onion, tomatoes, homemade croutons, or fresh shaved parm cheese as they specifically said on the menu.  Terrible.

Best Mexican restaurant I've found in this area! Will definitely be coming back! We ordered the steak tacos with Mexican rice and black beans and hibiscus lemonade and it was amazing! There was melted mozzarella cheese in the tacos and the steak was so tender and fresh! Very good quality and great value!

Every so often I come to McCaffrey's for their hot bar when I need a quick bite to eat. The food is average, but convenient. 

Most items seem over priced. Luckily for the owner it seems he has some pull in the area, because a wegman's or Whole Foods would put this place out of business.

Front desk with bad attitude. They were going to charge me for a camomile tea which is complementary in their other location which is in Georgia! For breakfast no cream cheese no butter ! So why did we have bread !! Eat it with what !? Overall not happy with the customer service ! But rooms are big and clean .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We stopped into Coyote Ugly during the day and Kendra was our bartender. She was a ton of fun and hosted a bunch of entertaining games for everyone at the bar. Very cheap beer! $2 PBR, Bud, and Bud Light. The night crowd is a little less enjoyable-- mainly only guys.

Extremely slow!!! 25 minutes in a drive-thru, come on! There is a reason why people want to stay in their cars, we need the time. Def need to improve here. Other than that, coffee was great as always and staff was friendly. Time management is an issue therefore 2 stars.

This is one of the best Italian take out places in Downingtown. Great customer service, fast delivery and the food is always amazing. We order pizza and wings all the time and it's always excellent and when we change it up and try their pasta dinners they are delicious as well. Great local business!

Really great place if you're looking to get Covid-19 and treated condescendingly by staff. I especially loved getting threatened by the employees after asking for some water with my order. Would highly recommend if you're looking for mediocre food, power-tripping workers and unsanitary kitchen conditions.

Dare I say this is the best restaurant on planet earth.  No number of Michelin stars can adequately encompass the experience.  For course number one, I'd recommend two monster margaritas.  Then escape out of the bathroom window before course number two arrives.

Trendy looking atmosphere, very well done. Room was clean with a unique layout. Free self parking is a big benefit. The roof top bar is very nice for drinks. The appetizer list for the bar could certainly have been better. Mostly all big offerings with very little to no finger food offerings.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: They don't keep their appointments. There's no point of making an appointment because they let who ever comes in go. They're very rude to their customers. They rush the person they're working on so they get the next walk in. The place was hot and very dirty. I definitely don't recommend.

Hands down the best BYOB Resturant you can go to in the area! Food is outstanding! When your reading the menu and deciding what to get, it gets a little crazy cause your mouth starts to water when your reading what's in everything. It's so good. And it's a little place that's hidden in medford but you will never forget it.

The food was good. Different from most Chinese restaurants I have been to however the chicken dish was mostly vegetables and very little chicken. Also the crab Rangoon had very little on the inside. For $6 ($1 each) I would not buy them again. It was good but over priced compared to other places I have been to.

I've been settling for a horrible nail place in milpas and finally decided to venture to a new place with little hope. This was the first place I tried and I'm not going anywhere else!! Ruby was amazing!! She took her time and made my nails look stunning!!

I love Dunkin' Donuts. I really do. But this place is completely incapable of getting my order right. I ask for a iced latte. No sugar. One pump mocha. What do I get? Tons of sugar and the drink is BLACK not with lack of milk but because it's thick with mocha syrup... I just wish they were more competent.

Pizza Guys, 3080 Vista Blvd Suite 110. I just found my new pizza place. I ordered a medium Hawaiian and medium all Meat. It so good I had to force my self not eat more. And I had a coupon giving me $17 off so I paid  $25, Excellent PIZZA. Definitely two thumbs up. I will be back.

The hotel is very nice with just about everything you need. There were three of us staying for five days so we got a two queen bed room. These were not queen size beds more like twin or full that was not comfortable for my wife and I to sleep in. The bed was also very old and lumpy. We were very exhausted after staying here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Not impressed. While the veterinarian was very nice, it is not a place to brag about. The whole appointment took 2 hours and I still left feeling uncertain. This place was cheap, but I felt that was the level of care I received. The staff (aside from the veterinarian) was extremely unprofessional and useless.

Stopped in for a coffee and burger.  Excellent manager on duty.  My coffee needed to brew and she kept me updated on when it would be ready.  I have been to many fast food chains and McDonald's usually never disappoints.  Would have been five stars but my McDouble's bun was a little over toasted!  Keep up the good work!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Dr Brand is very helpful and offered diagnosis that we had not heard from our previous vet. This was such a relief and I'm so glad I sought out another opinion. The staff is super friendly and professional and appointment times are available when you need them!

returned home today to find that there is 0 security working, half a dozen visits to the lobby without so much as a trade of a person working the front desk to keep the building safe and secure. 

good to see our well being and safety is worth saving a few dollars downgrading the security component of the building.

Beer selection is great as is the upstairs deck (if the weather allows outdoor dining).  Menu was unappealing.  My party ordered 4 items.  Only 1 was decent.  All 4 were overpriced.  I am thrilled that it exists, and wish them luck, but the food is no where near as good as they think it is.

Below average food.   Ordered Kung Pow chicken and it was unetable.  All salt and had a strong fish taste.   No spice what so ever.   Also ordered chicken low mien and pork fired rice.   They were average.   If you really need a Chinese fix you could try this place but I will not be back.

Worst 
Panhandlers coming up to your car at the drive tru ,
Place is dirty,!
Workers are slow, extremely SLOW 
when I place and paid for my order the wanted me to park up in the parking lot and sit in my car for God how long.
it's called fast food! in and out. Get with the program Mac Donald's.....
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Horrible!! I came at 11:30 am and tried to order a turkey egg sandwich. I was told that they wouldn't do it because it's not breakfast time. last time I check breakfast cut off time should be at 12. Went to another subway and they served me my breakfast sandwich. This shop needs to do better

Their service there is below unacceptable the drive-through workers are complete in the cells and have no respect they can't take a simple order they should not be working there at all absolutely disgraceful customer service horrible employees and they are very rude I will no longer go to list location again because they suck
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Sorry but I was so disappointed when I last dined here...it's not the awe-inspiring WOW it was in previous times. Never have I paid so much for so little. We had the pairings and the entire evening was underwhelming. Maybe it was an off night but it's now off my list.

Decently priced sushi -- woman at the front is super friendly and sweet. Staff were all friendly and food came out pretty quickly. Ambiance is nice and provides sort of an escape from the craziness/noise of the city. Was here during lunch and it's a little more quiet and easy to have conversation and not yell at each other.

After Very long wait time (even with a reservation) the server took approximately 30 min to come take our appetizer order. I believe we had the one and only wobbly unstable table at the restaurant (by the street). Our entrees were cold upon serving. With all of this being, the staff was friendly and apologetic.

Horrendously horrible. Does the owner ever stop in this place to see about his establishment?  Very long wait even when there's no line. Order confusion and very dirty store.  The entrance door was full of greasy fingerprints and looked like it hadn't been cleaned for months. Do not recommend.

I love the Marriott brand. However, I realize that sometimes not every location can be a winner. I've been here 30 minutes and I already regret booking this hotel. 
I could spend the next 30 minutes ranting about it but I've got better things to do with my time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Some of the best Mexican food I've had and I lived in LA. Great margaritas. Quest was great. Servers are friendly. Ivan was great. This place will be packed come season for travelers. Fajitas were fantastic. Burrito was off the charts but I'll ask for extra meat next time.

Ordered from here a few months ago, and liked the food, so I thought I'd try them again yesterday. I ordered BBQ spare ribs, with hot and sour soup, and pepper steak. The pepper steak was good, however, the fried rice accompanying the ribs was very dry and very bland, as was the soup. Very disappointing.

Been there a couple of times now. The food is really good and fresh(stopped for a take out burger late close to closing), and the people are very warm. I recommended it to my cousin and her husband, so they went for a sit down dinner and were impressed. I'll need to order a pizza before I'm completely sold.

I got charged for a night I didn't stay. I did call the front desk as well as booking.com that I couldn't  check in til later. I did also provide the hotel my name and confirmation number etc. But the hotel didn't even contact booking.com. I ended up having to pay that night I didn't stay for $250 up.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I'm not sure what has happened to this place.   We were regular customers here and enjoyed the food and atmosphere.  It has progressively gotten worse in the past several months.   I had a salad tonight that had ROTTEN eggs on it.  Seriously....I hope I don't get sick!!!!!!  I will never eat here again !!!

Decided on delivery with GrubHub when pizza finally arrived after an hour past time it was to arrive.   Pizza was ice cold, tough and hard to chew. They couldn't even cut it all way through.   Funny thing our dog spit it out and wouldn't even eat it.  Worst pizza ever had

My husband and I loved this restaurant, ice cold beers and great food, Monica was our server and she was absolutely great! She always made sure we had everything we needed, checked on us frequently, and went over and above! We will definitely return to this location and we will definitely ask for Monica!

Not sure what has happened to Moxie's!? We walked in and only 5 tables were seated. Took 20 minutes to get out drinks. Ordered after 30 minutes. Food was terrible. Cold fries, wilted salad, flavorless pasta and overdone fisher and chips. Used to be so good. Waitress was nice, but new.

Would have done five stars but the service is terrible here. The food is fantastic. Everything we ordered was good. Be prepared, the salsa is HOT. Good but hot. Ordered tostada, excellent; enchilada,  very good; chicken soup, excellent. Prices ok for a la carte but a little pricey for meals.

I ordered a volcano sushi roll to go and it was full of unmixed mayonnaise and it was not good. The service was horrible as well - and like I said this was a to go order so I can't imagine what it would be like if I ate in the restaurant. Huge disappointment

Had dinner tonight at the newly reopened VIA CIBO,  and I gotta tell you it was absolutely Delicious!! I had the Chicken Parmigiana with Alfredo pasta, as good as what I've had in Rome, SERIOUSLY!! Check it out you will not be disappointed. If I could give them 6 STARS I would!!!!!  May 3, 2018

We used to come to this location every Sunday morning for coffee and donuts. Donuts are fine, but the coffee is lukewarm at best, cold at worst, nearly every single time. Then they act like its a hassle to warm it up! I mean, seriously, how do you send out cold coffee when that is half your business?

48 dollars to wash my truck and clean the inside, sure it's Santa Barbara so you expect these prices... but expected a little more detail on both the inside and outside, two star average sounds about right for the price and value you get when you pickup your car.

Nicest hotel I have ever stayed in.  The only thing I could possibly say negative about this place is how far the rooms are from everything.  And the elevators are a real pain to get used to.  Staff was very friendly and helpful.  I would stay there again without hesitation.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I called this branch today.  Even though I have a checking account with Fifth Third they would not notarize sale documents for me since the mortgage is not with Fifth Third.  I will be closing my checking account and I will never have a loan, mortgage or any other business with them ever again!  Very poor customer service!

It's a McDonalds, if you want fine dining go somewhere else obviously. I don't know how I feel about these new table service changes. Getting your food isn't the problem, getting your food correctly hot and fresh is what's needs fixing. Fix your key issues BEFORE you try to make things fancy.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: No matter a pandemic or not, they take forever to process a food order. And then when you get to the window, the fries are either over salted or raw...or both. So next time you order from this location, and it's not all locations, stay put and check your order. It's bound to be wrong if you drive off.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Service was great, easy sitting but food was mediocre. The best comparison is olive garden with slightly higher prices. The best part of my dinner was the walnut cranberry salad with the lavender vinaigrette and now that's what I'm going to try to easily make at home.

This place is hard to judge, they have like one good cook.  Sometimes you can a amazing tomato pie, sometimes you get a regular pizza with no cheese...or like tonight sometimes you get a great regular pizza, or this oddly made hopefully bacon pizza

I can't spend any more money here

Top notch quality and flavor. For the price $58, this is way way better omakase than other ones , probably the best I had in Philadelphia. the chef knows what he is doing , so for someone enjoy omakase, you will not regret. This is not the place you will bring empty belly, this is the place to open and activate your taste bud !

Whatever you do don't get anything with roast beef.  Thick, tough, grisly, looked boiled.  Other things are probably great but I was disappointed both trips there with the open roast beef and French dip.  I will go back and try something else as the atmosphere and service was good.

Customer service is at an all time low. This is the closet Dunkin in Avon. If they arent being completely rude then they are rushing your order completely. From the "is that all" from start to end of your order but then the food comes out not complete as well. My family decided this was our last visit! 

Pathetic and rude!

grub.  what can i say. G. R.U.B.  delicious food, nice cozy atmosphere, this place has it all.  the one drawback is that you may have to wait a while because there are so few seats (like 6), but otherwise i think you'd be hard pressed to find a better spot.

grub.

Best mani pedi ever!  Extra attention to cleanliness and service.  First time there and was a walk in.  I was immediately greeted and had Alex perform my services.  He was so gentle and professional.  I did the SNS nail system and will definitely be back in 2-3 weeks!!!

Delicious food and a nice variety. I enjoyed sitting outside. Each of the 5 of us had different entrees so we could sample. I could have easily kept any one of the choices to myself - delicious. Our waitress was wonderful - nice sense of humor, prompt service and patient as we asked lots of questions.

I had to write this review before I pulled off. This is absolutely the worst Dunkin' Donuts I've been or seen in my life. The store is dirty, they have no donuts or anything and the 2 Indian guy behind the counter are rude as fuck. Spend your money elsewhere, don't not go here.

If you want. A sandwich with cheese and lettuce and skimpy ass meat that you can't taste and a sandwich that takes over 10 minutes to make let the meth head in the afternoon make your sandwich. Can't believe this woman even got hired. Subway you are losing your reputation hiring drug addicts. Never gonna come back to this location

This is one of Santa Barbara best locations for a complete hair saloon.  It comes highly recommended.  The folks are friendly and hair artists.  They will turn your hair into a master piece.  My hair has never looked better.  Jason is a true artist. MAKE SURE TO GIVE THEM A TRY, YOU WON'T BE DISAPPOINTED.

This is my local neighborhood bar and I love this place. The new manager is super welcoming and gets to know all of his regular bar goers and even the people who just stop in. I love that they added live music some nights which is great. Absolutely love this place.

I hate to say it...Sunset Grill underwhelms me every time I go.  This was my first visit in some time, perhaps a year.  The food is decent and good quality, but the flavor profile is generally bland as it was on this visit (salmon Caesar salad).  Offsetting that is very capable service, reasonable wine prices and good desserts.

Had good experiences with them in the past, but they are terrible now. I am shocked and appalled at the level of rudeness and u professionalism exhibited by their staff. In the event of an emergency with your pet, you'd hope to receive some kindness and compassion, so I recommend Animal Emergency Center on South Virginia instead.

It took 40 minutes plus for my simple enchiladas entree to arrive. I hardly focused on the food. I just wanted to eat and leave.  Not once did my server Andre apologize for the delay - perhaps this is normal for Zapata's? It was next to the hotel where I was staying but I should have got in the car and driven to someplace decent.

If you like waiting in a drive through line for 40+ minutes to get your daily coffee, this is the place you wanna go! I've found it actually much faster to drive to the Dunkin 5 miles away than the one right next to my house. I've tried going in the store to get my coffee with no better results.

Good, not great.
Some of the reviews and friends' recomendations led me to believe it was more of a restaurant than a dive bar.
Maybe three stars isn't fair, it is a decent dive bar, the burgers are good, not great, the fries are good, not great.
It is what it is, good dive bar with a small kitchen.

The hours (24-7) are the reward here. Having ones own key allows Anytime workouts.
Decent combo of machines and free weights. Has enough to get a swole on.
But....the showers are a DISASTER!!! Look at all the mold!!! UNHEALTHY!!!!
When was last time these were cleaned?

Please gripe to management about these pig-sty showers!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: my gf and i wanted food we walked 30 minutes and i called before we got there and they said they were open we get there and the guy says there not open how tf afe you hoing to say your open and when we get there your closed bullshit never going yhere agaun id give this a zero if it was possible
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Awful.    I just went in for Evan Williams egg Nog and he didn't have any said it's not due in yet.   BS.   It's been out for 2 months.  Plus he didn't know what Pinot noir was.  .Are you kidding me?. . Never go here. .Sum dumb F.  K serving that shouldn't be there.  If this is the best you have I'd hate to see your worst.

Never come here the food is frozen and way too expensive I came here with four members of my family and it cost 90 dollars. The chicken fell apart in my hands the second I picked it up I also had fries with a that but way too few. Fifteen dollars that I will never get back. I will never come here again no matter what.

I eat here with a group of co-workers about once a week, and have done so for about 7 years. The food is good, the service is fast and very courteous. 

Nothing fancy or special here, but it's good, reliable, and the team works hard to make you a repeat customer.

Ok for a touristy restaurant.  We ordered gator bites and fried shrimp.  The gator bites and sauce was amazing. The fried shrimp lacked flavor.  The best on the plate was the tomato cucumber Italian salad.    The waitress was good - Natalie.  We just really didn't think it was worth the cost.

I had a very good experience at Dobbs. The guys working the front desk were very nice and helpful. I bought four new tires from them. I cant say they had the lowest price but I wanted service that day. They ordered the tires from another store and had be going in about an hour. I'll be back for sure.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Had lunch at taste. It was ok for a quick bite. I had a cheesesteaks and probably by local standards was on the low end but I liked it. The other plates were good looking too. I don't think you can really go wrong here but you can do better a few blocks away for the price. But hey it's in a hotel.

This was my first visit to this salon.  The workers were very kind, professional and did a great job on my nails, pedicure & eyebrows.  This was by far the best pedicure I've had in a really long time.  Also their prices are much lower than the other salons I've visited in Bucks County, & trust me, I've been to many.

Suprised at how full and large the burritos were, plus the guac & nachos portions were huge (you don't get that much anymore). They were out of something we ordered online but the store called and were very friendly and accommodating. Delivery was super fast. Food was delicious and very fresh, highly recommend!

Haircut was decent, but I wasn't seated until 30 minutes after my scheduled appointment time. No one apologized for the wait. No one thanked me for my business.  I don't mind paying $30 for a haircut, but when I do pay it, I expect some respect and customer service in return.

Don't bother. The owner blatantly doesn't care to have new business. He shows it by his most unpolished, downright crappy attitude.  In addition, there is dog feces on the floor and it smells like a dirty kennel- kinda an indication of how things are run.  Literally. Locals go elsewhere!

Lack of employee there, 
Made  an appointment to get a safety deposit box there, drove all the way there, person/ Banker didn't come in, they did not even call to cancel my appointment, Manager was nice and apologetic, but that didn't explain why they didn't have another person to cover.

I was really excited that a sushi restaurant was coming in by my apartment complex, but when I tried QQ I was extremely disappointed. First off, the place wreaks. When I finally got my rolls, the fish in it was brown. In all honestly, this place doesn't seem safe to eat at. I suggest taking your sushi craving elsewhere.

Alex is a miracle worker! Best manicure in town. I'm used to gel nails only lasting for 2 weeks max but she does such an awesome meticulous job that they last over a month easily! I'll even tell her what color I'm picturing in my head and she will somehow make it appear in front of me!

Really pay over $70 for interior detail, get in and dash hasn't been touched, interior right? Wrong.  Was told that's extra $102 and change think I'm gonna spend a bit more wait a little longer, so I don't get bent over again.  For the price could of done it better myself

Today I was highly unsatisfied. I ordered two chocolate chip cookies and as I was biting into what I thought was a chocolate chip cookie, I sadly realized I had been bamboozled into eating an oatmeal raisin cookie. Oatmeal raisin cookies are against my religion. Please do better.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Got my nails done on Saturday and it's Thursday and half of them have already chipped or started peeling on the sides. They were bumpy and bubbly from day one. Not worth the cute atmosphere and free mimosa if you have to spend money to get them done again 5 days later.

Exceeded expectations!  Texas Margarita is the best ever!  All ingredients mixed fresh; not a premix.  The Molcajete is a combination of the best fajita ingredients but with a delicious red sauce that makes it way better.  Our server was delightful.  Everything about this place is outstanding!

I chose the Boise Family Eye Center because they had good reviews on Yelp.  Could not be more pleased with the professional treatment be Brent and his staff. A thorough examination found things for which I had not previously been tested.  Their pricing is very competitive the service is excellent
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I'm not sure why they started having a worker stand at the pay machine to "help" you select a wash and pay. Basically he's there to up-sell you a wash membership. Every time I go I have to be accosted and asked if I want to join their club! Why can't I just drive in and get the car washed??? It's annoying and bad customer service.

Service used to be the best . Five out of five hands down, I'd go here than any other McDonald's . The shake machine appears to be down and they can't get your order right , they rush you to order and then proceed to get it wrong . The shake machine is never down but it always appears to be suddenly.... Shitty service.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
NOT WORTH IT!!! Ice cream is under average and very expensive (small scoops)... !!! $3.25 for a very tiny single scoop and $7.25for a triple
Scoop which was more like a single ..... Was very disappointed ...GO TO RITE AID just a few steps across the street on the same side..!!!

We sometimes get delivery from here. The portions are a little small for the price and you have to learn what is good and what it not (not the wonton soup). but once you figure it out, it can be a decent place to add to the delivery rotation when you don't feel like cooking.

We chose Imo's tonight, but we were very disappointed. They say delivered will be in forty-five minutes, that's fine, but when the delivery comes the dishes were cold and they were wrong. We called again and they said we need wait another hour or forty minutes. I hope when they deliver again the pizza is hot enough

If you are in Reno and need a place to stay this place is very reasonable and very clean. There is a nice hot breakfast waiting for you when you get up in the morning. The lady who checked me in was very professional and very friendly at the same time. I will definitely stay here again when I am passing through.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: La Vecchia is my favorite restaurant in Reno. Authentic, delicious food for a reasonable price. The hospitality and service is exceptional, as is their gnocchi. It's the perfect spot for a date, celebration, or, if you're like me, just getting your monthly pasta fix. Muah!

I moved into the CWE this past summer. West End Wok is across the street.  Which is great, and dangerous.  Great and dangerous because the food and service are really good.  I've had the Kung Pao Chicken and the Hunan chicken.  I also like their pork egg rolls.

I was really disappointed today to walk in and find that the man who was cutting my teenager's hair was not wearing a mask.  The other barber was also not wearing a mask.  Thanks to the hostess who was.  We were planning to take all three of our boys there, and so were several of our other neighbors.  Time to find another place.

----Easy to get in and out, The menu is small and easy to order off.. The restaurant is always clean when I come in. The rest rooms are always stocked and clean. The staff is neat and tidy and they ALL are dressed the same not sloppy and unmade..I will be be back for sure!!..

Great authentic food. Portion was good. Price A+, relaxed atmosphere. I really know Hispanic food and this met every standard. BYOB, service was a little slow so I took 1 star away. But the food was worth the wait. Music was bachata I would of loved mariachi, but it was still enjoyable.

I found this unbelievable gold mine last summer. Was back in town and I went for lunch and dinner. The food was the best. I had lasagna and it was excellent my son and his buddy loved the chx parm. My friends loved the place. Had casata dessert freshly made by the chef from Sicily was like being in Italy. BYOB. Awesome.

Went to Sunday breakfast this AM for first time. It was REALLY good. Prices not to bad either. Had the 49ers breakfast. Sausage was really good and it was all cooked perfectly. No need to go all the way in town for a good breakfast if you live in the area!

Very awkward when I walked in here the other day to pick up my mobile order. No one noticed I walked in and there was an older woman behind the counter yelling rudely at an older male worker about someone in the drive thru. Don't think I'd like to go back in when she's working.

Sushi was good but not as good as the prices made it out to be. Customer service is hit or miss depending on the employee and how busy the restaurant is. Very small dining area which can feel very crowded at times. There are better places to get sushi in SB than here.

If I could give less stars I would. Price gouging because it's closer to Old Tucson, bad customer service and the mgr ugh doesn't need to be in charge at all.we ordered 2 combos and they only gave us 1 fry and argued that we should not have but 1 fry after paying almost double from another McDonald's location.  Ridiculous!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Slowest fast food on the planet. Currently 20 minutes in line and have moved one car length. Two cars pulled in behind me so I'm trapped. This wasn't how I expected to spend my Sunday. Apparently management is fine with this type of service based on other reviews stating the same thing.

Drive a little farther to another McDonald's if you want good food. I'll go here in a pinch, but staff is always rude (doesn't acknowledge you, let alone say "thank you") and usually the food/drink isn't good. I got an iced coffee here once and it was the most horrible crap I ever tasted.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I go to planet fitness in 5 states and this is the first one that won't change the channel to the football game. Why have TVs if your not going to change the channels to what a guest wants? Well back to the history channel.... it's so motivating to work out too.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The food could be much better if they would spare the salt! The rice tastes as if they dinner an entire Sally shaker in it. Even the tacos were far too salty. I've tried the place twice now, and found this to be true on both occasions. I want to taste the food, not the salt!

Was very excited to get my car washed here. Went today and got the full package only to end up disappointed. Car got cleaned and everything but i noticed that one of their machine scratched my tire rim. Was hoping to have it resolved but I was rushing to go to an appointment. Giving a review to let others have a fair warning.

Probably the most inconsistent Dunkin I've been too and it's a shame because the owner is cool....the workers just don't care...the one that drives the white BMW opens the store, everyday he's late and god forbid if it rains he'll be even more late. Hopefully the owner will see this and fix it

The band was amazing the bartenders sucked.  Getting service at the bar is next to none.  So sad because the music is amazing.  Why is the owner keeping these jerks behind the bar who don't wanna do their job?  If you wanna listen to the great band bring your own drinks!

After going back several times in the past couple of months, can only say that something good has happened to this place!!  FINALLY!  Service is much better and friendlier, food has been fresh and timely.  Only scored 3 stars, (originally only 1-star) but if things keep improving, will recommend.  Good improvements !  Keep it up!

My husband and I are not big fans of sushi so we tried the Chicken Fried Rice and the Chicken Teriyaki.  It was probably the best we ever had.  Everyone was very friendly. The atmosphere and service were great. Everything was cooked and seasoned perfectly. The neighborhood needed this.  We highly recommend it.

BEWARE! Worst hotel I've ever stayed in. I only stayed for a night but I would never go back. My room smelled like a basement, the thermostat did not work, the only thing that's really included in your stay is a bed, shower, tv, and the gym - literally, and I woke with allergy issues and a face rash the next morning.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I go after work around 6:30.. even if I'm the only one in line it takes forever to get my drink.  The employees are holding conversations with each other or a friend who came in to say hello and they can't seem to talk and make coffee at the same time.  Very frustrating.  N

I remember when royal pizza was good! They went the way of the new age! Just cheap and stingy. I hate generic pizza joints but I'm gonna recommend anyone like the hut or 73 over this place! Save your money. I Don't write reviews but they earned this one! Never again.

Fantastic tacos and cozy atmosphere. An absolute favorite. Friendly and knowledgeable staff which can sometimes be a little too attentive considering there is the option for a blue card to use as a call for service. Hot sauces are a plus and plenty of menu options. Wish there was a better happy hour special!

We hadn't been to Bella Aquila for quite some time, not really sure why, but I'm glad we returned. The seafood risotto and the pan seared halibut were excellent, the halibut perfectly cooked, flaky with a delicious glaze. The atmosphere was very welcoming, classy, but not overdone. The drinks and the service were spot on.

I had lunch from this place and now I have the stomach flu. The ingredients used are not fresh and the place inside is not clean. If your  going to eat from here please pay in cash because the lady behind the counter will charge you a fee even though you spent over 10 dollars.

The place is a quaint little spot on Wydown. We had a wonderful meal and great drinks well exceeded my expectations. We were also able to get in without reservations on last minute notice. Jordan, the bar tender" took great care of us and knows her craft.  (Golf clap here)

I spent approximately $550 for 2 frames and prescription lenses. That doesn't reflect a 30% discount that I received because I am a member of AARP. I found 2 of the staff, acting as if I was imposing on them when I asked questions or requested something. I wil NEVER go back there again.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Normally we love this place. Tonight we got a delivery and I had ordered  a shredded beef tostada and taco. I found 3 huge gobs of fat in the meat and it grossed me out so much that I threw it all out.  Normally,  it's very good. The beans, rice and chips were very good.

We have been to this place before and it is not the same.  We came for happy hour and the rolls were so small it was ridiculous.  This was expensive give the portion size.  The fish tasted ok but for even the happy hour prices, it was not worth it.  The only good thing was the server who was very nice.

Extraordinary service and systems.  Worked with the teams at Gerber, Geico & Enterprise car rental, all on campus.  It was a pleasure to watch a well oiled machine in process.  Polite & knowledgeable staff.  All of the staff at Enterprise were on top of their games - sharp group.

The sushi is the freshest and... cleanest (for lack of a better word) I've ever tasted. I'm worried that I won't enjoy sushi anywhere else now! Even the ginger and wasabi are different (better), and the miso soup. I could go on, but bottom line... I highly recommend.

I've had 2 other haircuts at the Supercuts Ontare location. All were good but today I got my best cut from Bradley. He listened to what I wanted and did an excellent job while giving me knowledge on hair structure and the type of shampoo and conditioner that would work best for my hair type. His 5 star ratings are well deserved!

No complaints about sushi. Fresh and nice presentation. The restaurant was to capacity at 8pm on Friday night and it got really loud in the restaurant. Also the waiter came to our table 3 times within 5 minutes of us sitting down to ask to take our orders. Attentive...yes. Did we feel rushed?  Also yes.

this place is gross.  the equipment is old and decrepit.  they don't even play music.  also, the lifting equipment is downstairs in a basement without windows so it feels stuffy and damp with the pool right there. the only good thing is that it is the only 24 hour gym in santa barbara.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
The hand grenades are definitely my favorite. Hubby and I both enjoyed them, they taste fantastic-super smooth with a great buzz! They definitely get you feeling right (2 was apparently too much for me) 
There just $10 compared to tiny shots at most places for the same price. Must try!!

Nice hotel. Area is definitely a lot safer than it used to be. Something funny happened though. I ordered the fruit cup with granola and the "granola" was a crushed up sugar cookie. Kinda weird... But STL has awesome breakfast places so if you have the time go out to somewhere else instead of eating in the lobby!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My husband and I just ate at Folk for the first time and we're blown away by our meals and service. We had Nicole as our server who was knowledgeable about the menu, attentive and all around pleasant. The pork chop and eggplant sando were delicious and atmosphere was wonderfully intimate. Thank you for such a memorable experience.

Always disappointed but this was their 3rd and last chance. The pizza was fine. The chicken Parmesan was DRY. And my Caesar salad had the date of November 18 on it and we ordered on December 1st. 
Maybe eating in would be better but I'm not willing to give that a shot at this point. 
It's too bad, there seems to be potential.

I hadn't ordered from Papa John's in years but thought I thought would give it a try. I found the quality and service to be worse than my experiences in the past. I had a simple order of two items with extra garlic sauces. They forgot the extra garlic sauces and the pizza was overcooked.

We went there couple times the food is amazing if you go in a right time like when they have a good chef there. we got to go order most of times but all those times they got somethings wrong, they always find something to mess up with your order, it is ridicules to waste time to go there and get wrong order.

Communication is key in a haircut, and in customer service.

I asked Laurie not to cut the sides of my daughters hair short. She assured me she wouldn't. And she did. 

When I told her (super kindly) that her hair was shorter on the sides, she defended herself instead of listening.

Getting a refund was an argument.

I went there and ask for shashimi on rice. They cashier did not understand what it meant. I had to explain. Then what a git was a bowl of rice with chopped raw salmon mixed with some stupid sauce. It tastes so terrible. Horrible food quality. Way too expensive. Stay away from this place.

Make sure you check the dates of products that you buy off-the-shelf products are often expired deli area needs to be cleaned up somebody back there is always coughing or touching all kind of other stuff before they touch your meat. Overpriced for the area.

The service at this place is always horrible nobody  is in a rush to do anything went there today and they were out of bread how is that possible when everything pretty much on your menu you need bread for owner needs to stop hiring lazy kids and hire people that actually want to work and service customers

Had a large to go order and am not very proficient with online ordering the manager advised me it was cheaper to get the lunch special online. He helped me order my lunch, save 15 dollars even though it was busy. Food was awesome and overall experience was great. The managers name was Christopher.

i signed in to order new contacts and after waiting for 30 minutes or so, i practically had to ask for help.  there were a couple of employees sitting on a laptop blithely unaware that there were customers waiting.  i will be going elsewhere for my next eye exam.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: My GF and I pass through Chester 2-3 times/yr. We discovered Abruzzi two years ago and  make it a point to order take-out from them at least once (and often a couple times) per visit. Their pizza never lets us down -- delicious sauce (not too sweet/not too salty), fresh cheese and veggies, and thin, crispy crust.

We wanted to go to the Palms but they were closed on Monday.  So across the street was Tony's Italian restaurant.  Their pizza was quite good and most of the others in the restaurant were locals that eat their often.  Prices as affordable -- $24 for a large meat pizza.  1/2 caraf of wine was $14, a bit pricey.

The staff is always courteous and friendly and on top of guests who need help. I've loved every flavor I've tried, and I appreciate that I can bring home a pint of my favorites if I want to. I appreciate how the staff adheres to current safety guidelines and do their best to keep us happy and safe at the same time.

Jesus Christ the food here is so awful I can smell the hot shit as soon has it comes off the grill from the gas station. Shakespeare says To be or not to be more like to pee or not to pee because it smells like piss all in that bitch. Every time I order food from here it is straight up trash
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I really liked this place.  We had a party of 6 during Restaurant Week and we were treated very well.  Offered both Restaurant Week menu and regular menu.  Allowed to sit and enjoy without being rushed.  Food was great for everyone in my party. Loved the calamari appetizer!  Attentive service.  Will be back!

I fell on this property by the elevator and was told just take the escalator next time. Staff is very rude besides the day manager who gave me 3 bio freeze packets for my injury on the property..  Wouldn't recommend this hotel unless your with a large group. Or want to be close to the stadium!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great local convient place to take your pets.  The staff is amazing - return calls quickly & very easy to schedule appointments especially in an emergency situation.  Prices are a lot better than other vets in the area & they spend more time with you & your pet.  Glad they moved into our neighborhood!

I always find something to complain about, but this place made it extremely hard to find something! No odor, squeaky clean, warm vibrant colors, high end touches, microwave, enclosed fridge.....I didn't want to leave! I paid $68 for double beds! If you have high expectations, this place gives 100%. Definitely will be back!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I've gone to Burger King for years. I work nights so when I get off in the morning I order a whopper and fries. And the LAZY employees at this particular Burger King doesn't make fries and makes you eat hash browns with there order. Don't eat at this Burger King. Employees are liars and lazy. McDonald's here I come!!

Yummy! Love the ice cream here. The cereal milk one is so delicious. Although the dry ice smoke show is very kitschy, they pour hot water on it so it melted the ice cream faster so I opt out of it. The ice cream is so tasty in my opinion doesn't need to be dazzled up.

Terrible service at this location. Alaina was having a bad day or something, but reading previous reviews it seems like it is an every day thing. They didn't get my order right the first time so I had to get out and go in for it to be fixed. No apologies... just rude service. Won't be back.

Highly recommended Sushi & hibachi spot.
Ive been going here since open. Everything is great. My favorite sushi roll is the Dancing Crab Roll. The hibachi experience is fun for everyone and the grill flavor is great. I personally also enjoy the yum yum sauce and the Mongolian beef a lot.
Everyone dont waste & dont eat too much.

Both times Ive been here I was upset with the results. Communication is lacking and overall the experience left a bad taste in my mouth. I went here because I live close. But in hindsight I wish I would have travelled to center city. Decor is awesome and I love the orchids but the stylists are lacking.

In a word....sucks 
Off airport, hard to find.
Not open until 7:30 they don't tell you that.  When you get there before 7:30 for an early flight what are you supposed to do?  Exactly 
Oh and they say they have EZPASS but don't
And an English lesson wouldn't hurt
Enterprise is in the terminal by the way
I'll be back...never

This is my favorite Italian spot! I get the spaghetti every time. Although the spaghetti may sound like a boring choice, at Mia Sorella they make it their own by adding an abundance of different types of seafood. This interesting take on spaghetti makes Mia Sorella that much more special! I can't wait to come back here!

Worst manicure ever. She used her thumbnail to push back my cuticles then didn't even bother to trim them. Left me with dry, ragged cuticles. Wanted a simple green accent nail with glitter and it looks like a 2 year old did it. There's plenty of other shops ....... don't go to Happy Nails as you won't be happy.

I should have known.... Came here out of convenience but I might as well have cut my hair on my own. Hair was cut accidentally too short - hair cutter "misunderstood" how short. He was so bad that I thought it be best to just leave the place with uneven hair than try to get him to try to get it fixed.

This place is awesome!!!! If you're into $hitty food and awful service. The seafood bisque looks like dog vomit and I'm sure the vomit could give this soup a run for its money tastewise. If you want to live of the edge and risk missing you flight and ruining your life, come here.

Wasted almost 2 hours over a month tracking down missing reward voucher from Chase Marriott Credit Card.  In the end, the explanation I received made sense, however, the attitude and flippant tone by "Freeman" from Chase and "Ron Moore" at Marriott was unnecessary and demeaning.

Awesome customer service, Alexander C was able to help me resolve an issue with my debit account and made the process as painless as possible. I would recommend this branch to anyone who's interested in banking with chase because the staff is always very helpful and attentive when you walk in. Thank you!

Professionalism and great customer service. I went there initially because it is close to my home and because they take my insurance. I am so happy we found them. Top notch optometrists and support staff. A great selection of glasses. Honest and fair business practice.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I have been trying to recoup $2100.00 that was taken from my account on behalf of this business and the services they charged for were NEVER RECEIVED!! I have called at least 1-2 times per week for 3 months with continuous run around and no resolution.  Be careful!!!!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: For being a little hole in the wall it was very good sushi! The rolls were delicious and the sake was even better! If they would just split the check and make service a little faster it would be a 5 star rating. The little old lady working there is kinda rude.

This place was terrible. Don't order scrambled eggs, they use powdered eggs. Terrible. Wait staff was friendly but food is garbage. I'd rather jack off a bobcat with a handful of cockleburs than eat there again. Oh and their "blueberry toast" taste like fruity pebbles with butter.

The crew here are always very efficient! The music is too loud so its difficult to make or take calls. It's frequently too cold. I've brought people here and we have had to leave because the music is so loud.  This review is after more than 2 dozen visits so it is not random.

This place is great! Only lost a star because I paid for drying when apparently it's free?? I had a baby so if there was a sign I didn't notice it. Bummed I spent about $10 on drying. Regardless I'll be going back today. It's clean, tons of washers and fun video games.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Mediocre at best. When I opened the menu it was covered in finger prints and old food.  Prices are a little too high for what is received. There was barely any crab in the crab cake sandwich. Shrimp appetizer was over cooked. Fish tacos tasted as sad as they looked.

Passing through the area and had to get a car wash to keep Florida's bugs from drying on the car. I wish we had this car wash back home in Jupiter. They did an excellent job on the exterior, carefully removing all of the bugs and cleaning the wheels for $11. Awesome.

Stopped by on Sunday afternoon, and the restaurant was closed. There was no sign on the door, and no answer at the telephone number. The interior looked like the business had moved out. Their website still shows business hours and take-out availability. Very poor communication with customers.

Quality of food and service continues to decline. I have been disappointed with my last few orders from Linda Jean's, but continued to go back due to the quality I received in the past. Well, after a few rude encounters with the staff combined with poor quality product I've had enough. Spend your money elsewhere.

Love love love nanci and her staff ! down to earth and wonderful people! Great atmosphere and oh yeah they do great work! Honestly if your looking for a new salon or new to the area, salon glam is a must try! I promise you wont regret it and definitely will end your search for a salon here!

Yep this place is a joke.Simplelest order ever and get it wrong.No apology nothing.The pitiful ass manager offered no apologies just an attitude like i was an incovience to her.Yeah fast food workers deserve 15 bucks an hour lmao.I will give you 15 bucks if you can get my 2 plain hamburgers right.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: They must replace the carpet as it makes this place smell dirty.  Also check your statement if using a credit or bank card as they didn't inform me that a mistake was made and voided until I called the next day.    Food was good, no roaches in site but service was slow.

New to this area and found Chow Express on Yelp. Lunch special (11 a - 3 p for $5.95) Curry Chicken was expertly prepared with generous portion.  Includes rice and soda. Restaurant is very clean and service is fast. I'm back now for dinner takeout at my new go-to for neighborhood Chinese!

I ordered bolognese pasta dish to be delivered through Uber....it was awful. AWFUL! I am pretty easy to please with pasta but it was basically a small bowl of noodles. Minimal meat...it was so dry. We ended up throwing it out and ordering elsewhere. Irritating I spent $26 for a dry, bland tray of noodles.

first off, the meatballs are dry, and dare i say, too big. and frankly when i order garlic bread i dont want to have be the one turning it into "garlic bread". the arancini balls are the best ive had. beautiful garden patio, just revisit the meatball recipe.

Mediocre food coupled by horrible service. Dined with my in-laws and 87 year old grandmother. I have never been to a restaurant that requested we leave to accommodate another reservation (less than a  2 hour meal!). We will never be back despite proximity to the main line.

Service took quite a while to even get plates and cutlery.  Our wine wasn't poured for us either while the other tables were. Im assuming this business is understaffed. Don't book if you're aiming for a dinner under two hours. Food was fine but again took a while.

The food was amazing service was excellent and our waiter was awesome. My wife asked waiter to bring her one of dished he showed up with half a portion of each 1st time a waiter has ever done that . Place is pricey but the south tampa crowd can handle . Heard a new owne4 is coming hone he keep the menu .

After a day at Leadbetter Beach, the salmon salad here was an unexpectedly delicious surprise! I ate at an outdoor table (thank you, Covid) and watched the seagulls and the sunset over a nice glass of red wine. It will be a "must do" on my next trip to Santa Barbara.

Waste of $ and time. This place charged my card twice and the machine never worked, never washing my car. I will dispute the charges and never go there again!

Update: 
I emailed this company through their website, and they sent me a credit to cover my losses.
Appreciated.

Today was my first appointment with Crystal! Not only is she a lovely person she gave me the hair color that I have been looking for for a long time! The color is just beautiful  and she was able to do highlights and a cut all at once! My new favorite salon!

Car's air conditioning didn't work. Staff wasn't super friendly.  Place smelled bad.  (The last one may have been the old man in front of me's fault).  I wasn't happy with the experience.  Slow service and limited drop off and pick up hours due to it being in a Sears.

Drove to drive thru, ordered senior coffee, charged 97 cents, at another McD on Olio costs 53 cents. Told by employee tgat was the price 4 years ago, did not recieve change or receipt, drove to next window given warm coffee no label on container, I presume that dollar bill disappeared. Will visit Olio in future.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Have to admit, I was leery about sushi from a restaurant named Jimmy's. Boy oh boy was I ever wrong!  Everything was wonderfully delicious from the sashimi to nigiri to rolls to the baked mussels-a must try! Sake was tasty because it wasn't heated to boiling and didn't burn off your taste buds!  Cant wait until next trip!

Very rude staff person just yelled at me for not saying how many donuts I was planning to order before I started listing the donuts I wanted. He scared my daughter. Seemed very irritated and was barking at us. We left. This isn't the first time someone has been rude here. We won't be returning.

The food is pretty good, the takeout is quick and the prices are reasonable. I would have given a better rating if the staff had made us feel feel a little more welcome.  We have been there a few times and have received awkward treatment from a few people on the staff. ( I don't really know how to explain otherwise).

The food is nothing special. I love the idea of a nice place to get drinks on the patio after a bike ride or a run, but the food is never that great. I can honestly probably make most of it at home and have it taste better. Service can be slow at times at well. This place has great potential.

Late night gem! At $3.50 a slice this place was a great snack spot. The only drawback was that the crust toward the center of the slice was was a little soggy, but overall the value for the money was definitely there. Tasty, great toppings and the staff was super friendly! Will definitely be back!!

As I sit here in room 1603, it is almost 1am
I ordered room service at 9:50 and was told 1 to 1.25 hour wait
2 calls later, I still dont have food and I am supposed to get up now in 6 hour for my daughters volleyball tournament in the morning...

other than that, the hotel is nice, just dont order food
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I come here often. Very good service, and the food is usually great! Lately, I guess I've had bad luck here- today we were served almost warmish fries. Our order of crispy onion rings were soggy. Instead of receiving a chicken club, I was given a regular sandwich. The bun on two of our burgers were on the stale side of life.

Food was good. Got the crab stuffed chicken breast which was very tasty. However, the servers definitely made us feel out of place being the only  Americans dressed casually there although I don't think the server realized it. Subconscious bias? I hope in the future to be treated as well as Caucasian guests.

The prices of the food were good. The food itself  tasted okay. I ordered the lasagne, and quite frankly, it tasted like something I could've made myself. It was nothing special that would make me want to come back at this restaurant. Staff members were a bit buggy and didn't seem to enjoy their jobs.
