I'm a real fan of this Starbucks because it's comfortable and cozy as I come here to do my school work alot.

However, there's a huge problem with this location taking in a lot of rowdy and homeless people who are there to lounge and charge their phones (they never buy anything).

Also, turn the music down a bit, will ya?

We have gone to Sakura several times and have enjoyed the food and the service each time. It has priced their dishes a bit below the norm, but we build up our order because of that and it costs us as much as most, but we really don't care, WE ALWAYS ENJOY OUR MEALS THERE,,, WE'LL BE BACK AGAIN SOON!!!

Let's be honest it's all about the fishbowls here. It really depends on who made the batch. Sometimes it's sugar water with a splash of alcohol, sometimes it knocks you flat on your behind. Either way it's just $10 with $7 refills. I think it's worth the gamble.

They gave me the wrong coffee drink, I had paid extra for a latte. And no napkins in the bag at the drive through? I can never understand this, as though I want to get food in my car?? 
It's a drive through yes you need napkins... Duh 
The two stars are for he well made sandwich .
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Good food good prices great portions but customer service is really lacking. Only got one refill on my soda the entire meal and it took the waitress 5 minuets to get it back to mr  this place could really turn it around if they had more than one server at a time or if the servers they hired were a bit faster

It was good until i saw the dude playing with his phone with his gloves on behind the counter.   I was at the sushi bar and saw him hide it...so he knows it's gross.  Sorry....but truthfully he also crossed his arms exposing his pits to the gloves...then worked some sushi over.  Sorry again.

I have been a member for 3 yrs and I love this gym. Staff are wonderful, very clean gym and bathrooms. The only problem was coming in at 9:30 tonight. You need to tell your members to not load up with perfume. This one girl on treadmill gave me an asthma attack. It's pretty bad when her perfume is still stinking in my hair!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: As far as basic auto repair goes, this is about as good as it gets. They are honest, efficient and the prices are reasonable. The only criticism I have is that they are somewhat limited in the repairs they can perform. If it's a complex fix, I usually have to take it elsewhere.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The food was authentic Italian and out of this world.  It is a small cozy restaurant, with a linen tablecloth's, a very comfortable atmosphere. Our waiter Brian was so kind, we felt like we were with family.  This was recommended by Jude RV Park where we are staying - we Will definitely be back

Saw a fantastic band on the rooftop last night. Gorgeous view and amazing service.  Keith was our server and he was top notch awesome. When his shift ended we were sad but Heather took over for him and she was an absolute doll and very attentive and courteous.  Thank you for a wonderful evening!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Dr. Lee was dismissive of valid questions. Instead of just answering, he made me feel like they were taboo and not to be asked. Seeing as how I brought my dog to a vet clinic, i don't think asking a dog health related question was out of line. Will not be back.

Unbelievably rude staff at this location. They've been incredibly rude on the few occasions I've been to this location. I know working at McDonald's probably isn't high on the life satisfaction meter, but that doesn't mean you need to be a complete cow to your customers. Management needs to get a handle on this.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I love coming here.  The sushi is great, fresh and on time.  But if you have reservations plan to wait.  It takes them forever to seat you and the wait staff is slow.  Also if you go early its a screaming baby fest.  Try the specials.  The Sushi Spring Roll is the best bang for your buck.

Lots of good staples here, to stock up for a multi-day stay in NOLA.  The fried chicken and red beans located in the deli in the back are surprisingly excellent!

Best of all:  When it's really f'ing hot & humid outside, walk in the A&P and go to the refrigerated section where you get a sweet sustained blast of cold air.

The food is alright here.  Their clam chowder is ok, it has a lot of chunky food in it, but the soup itself is watery.  The staff are all very nice and friendly.  

They were able to accommodate us nicely during graduation weekend; especially since we had not made reservations.

This place rocks! Very fast (2 Hr turn around time) and friendly. I travel a lot for work and depend on these little laundromats often. The price is right and it's conveniently located in the French Quarter. 
I told the nice woman working there I'd write this review....so if you read this and go there, tell her I sent ya. (wink)
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Came here on Saturday for brunch with friends. The stuffed Italian bread French toast is decadence on a plate: cream cheese, mouthwatering black currant syrup with almonds, whipped cream and fresh blueberries. Best French toast I've ever had. Everyone at my table looked at my food in envy.

Easy check-in, great price from priceline, super friendly staff. Clean and comfortable rooms. What more do you need from a hotel? I would give it 5 stars if it was more centrally located, but I'm sure the proximity to the airport is a plus for some people, just not for us.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We had AYCE sushi. The rolls were pretty good. The problem is you have to like cucumber since about 80% of the rolls have it. Some of them had lots of rice and just the littlest amount of filling. The service was good and the drinks were reasonably priced.

The building looks cool with the black paint. There is still some growing pains with the drive thru. I'm not really a fan of the new fries. There texture was inconsistent and had a slightly bitter flavor. I will try this restaurant again the the future and see if things improve.

I spent $27 and my car wasn't throughly cleaned. The back window was still dirty. The inside was not fully vacuumed- not even close. They didn't wipe the dashboard or clean the cup holders. Even wiping down the inside of the doors was an extra charge! Plus the $3 upcharge for my SUV. Go to Waterway.

on a random weekend trip out to philly, my friends and i used some travel points and got a couple of rooms at the sheraton for the night. i don't really have much to add to the reviews that have already been posted. i mean...it's a sheraton. seen one, seen 'em all.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
As seems to be true with every Publix I visit, I can't say enough nice things. They let me in the store early so I could buy some milk.

I am partial to the sub sandwiches, although they do take a few minutes to make if you don't show up at lunchtime (they slice your meat fresh).

Nice local place.  Not fancy, but is open late, at least for New Hope it is, weekday it was open til 10:30 p.m.  My husband and I both had a pasta dish and actually liked them, thought it was pretty good!  We both had soup and enjoyed ours as well.  The waitress was extremely friendly and helpful.
A good choice.

So GLAD we found this place!  Awkward strip mall location, but once we found our way, it was all good.  Our party of 5 was seated right away, cute decor and the staff was very friendly.  My kid had the chicken bento box, while the rest of us paid $22 each for all you can eat!!
It was very good, fresh, would go back!!

Great place to stay if you're in the Brentwood area. It is conveniently located close to everything you could need. They offer fast dry cleaning services. The place was nice and clean. It is a bit far from the entertainment of downtown Nashville, but that is not what I was there for on this trip. I recommend.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I filled out an online survey about our stay at Super 8 and someone actually read it and responded and said they were crediting my credit card for the full amount of our stay.  I was quite surprised at the offer plus their sincere thanks for the feedback.  Customer service is alive and well at Super 8.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Excellent! 

The food is delicious & cheap (not to mention filling!), the atmopshere is pleasant & welcoming, and the service goes above & beyond what's necessary.

A great way to spend a Friday night - get together with some friends, grab some booze (it's BYO), and nom on some Mexican food here.

We went here because it was close to the hotel and it had a prix fixe menu.  Everything was mediocre, nothing special.  I wish we would have went to Olive Garden instead... so much that we actually went to OG on our last night to get a proper Italian food fix.

Great service, great food.  I had the duck, which was fabulous.  My boyfriend had fish.  He rather enjoyed it.  We also enjoyed the bruchetta and chocolate cake.  Both were great.  

Unlike others, our service was perfect -- not too much, not too little -- overall, it gets 5 stars and a visit again soon.

I'm not a huge Yelper, but I have to say, I was impressed with my National experience.  In the past, we were burned by horrific service and long lines at Avis, Alamo, Budget, Dollar... We'd become Enterprise fans, but Enterprise isn't open overnight.  We opted for National and it was a great experience.  Highly recommend.

Our second trip here from out of town. Miguel was our chef at the  sushi bar. The "Don't Ask" roll was fabulous. The Ahi grilled was so so. The green mussels were a hit with the hunky husband. They even had banana sushi with chocolate and toasted coconut that was surprisingly good. $20 all you can eat can't be beat!

Very nice for lunch. Good for business or a date meetup Great decor and service. The menu has something for all. The bistro chicken is a simple yet tasty entree. Chicken is cooked perfectly and the potatoes delicious. The seats by at the bar is very comfortable as well.

Came here for all you can eat sushi, and it was worth it considering how much I ate. The sushi itself was alright though. I've had better, but what else do you really expect if you're getting all you can eat, right? It was pretty empty when I was there but it could also be because it was still early for dinner time.

Ate here last light. Pizza was good. We turned the maplewood into a deep dish. Being from Chicago, I was missing a tad of sweetness in the sauce & sausage.

The wait wasn't the 20 minutes we waited to sit... But getting our drinks did take 20 minutes, both rounds. The server was nice. But service was slow.

Come here if you're a fly.  Or a person who likes flies.  This Starbucks is conveniently located and usually seems to have tables open.  The employees are friendly and efficient.  But both times I went there to do work, I was grossed out by the flies buzzing around.  It's good to take out the garbage sometimes.  Just a thought.

Dope spot on the fringe of sanity; I used to wander in this hidden corner of Asia during my studies in Philly. They have basically everything to make any dish from Vietnam, Thailand, China, etc. They even had a roast duck guy in the corner, but you have to get there early.

Had the eggs benedict for brunch-the english muffin wasn't as puffy, and neither were the eggs...came with fruit salad. Friends had the chicken tacos-it was ok. Another friend had the omelet. Service was good, but food was just average.Cute atmosphere and ambiance.

Great food and great price.  Im vegetarian so I am glad they were accommodating and had options.

I used my checkin too for a free drink. The guy working Tuesday night was very helpful with the menu and helping me pick my meal

I got the pesto pasta, thanks for the suggestion!

My bf took me here for dessert after 'all you can eat shrimp' at Red Lobster right across the street! The outside has a hip retro feel with bright lights and lots of retro silver! Service was fast and the cashier was polite! I love Hot Glazed Donuts anytime!

I love this pizza because it's cheap and you can get a lot of it.  If you like the St. Louis cracker crust type of pizza, you will like this pizza.  They have a buy one get one free large pizza deal every day all the time.  Never buy two pizzas, and try the bacon pizza.

Stopped in for a quick afternoon caffeine pick me up. Ordered a blended ice mocha, and it was less than sweet. Ok i guess, but i didn't satisfy the sweet tooth my gf had at the time.

The space is around the counter is a little cramped and i had to bump into people just to get out of the place.

We did an early dinner here last weekend and the service and sushi was good.  The all you can eat, you call it feature was the best.  We were able to call out our favorite fish and how we want it made until our bellies were full.  I would return when I am back in Reno.  We enjoyed their Mountain Roll.

Good space (bright, airy), good workdesks and chairs, good mochi.

But contrary to previous reviews, the WiFi is NOT fast, it tops out at 8 Mbps which is usable but SLOW. (For comparison, 50 Mbps is minimum speed for typical road warriors who get on VPN and do Skype meetings, etc)

ABC is the go-to place on the Island for party stuff and has been such for the many years I've had a place here  Good wine selection, beers, and liquors.  

I really like the large Cigar Humidor.  Lots of brands, high to low with good prices and specials.  No need to go to the "Cigar Stores" as ABC has all that and more.

This place has gone downhill in the last few months.  It was dirty.  We judge the cleanliness of a restaurant by the cleanliness of the bathrooms.  The bathrooms were gross.  And, a person in my group ended up getting sick after we ate there.  We won't be going back.

ok, take your miso soup and leave. that is where this meal should've ended for me. miso soup wasn't spectacular in any way but at least it was comparable to other Japanese restaurants.

the sushi rice was overly cooked and mushy. this made it hard for me to eat any of the sushi.

They gave me a good rate on a car loan, but heaven help you if you have to call their customer service for anything. Prepare to WAIT. Also, changing you address with them is a ridiculous hassle. Who offers online banking, but won't let you update your address once you've logged into your account??

Couldn't believe the attitude given when my friend and I walked in for a haircut. Two "stylists" sitting in the chair with 1 hour and 5 minutes left till close and we ask to get cut and they say oooooooooooh we are gonna close soon so we can't take you today. Rude is all I can think of. I would never go here again.

Based off all the reviews, I thought this place was going to be my regular - not impressed in the slightest. My review is pretty much the same as Samantha Helen from April 2019 - almost identical experience with Henry.

I've never been back and started doing my own nails.

Longest wait for service ever. For the most part, this isn't Marilyn's fault -- there are too many customers here for one bartender to handle.

Thanks for turning on the tennis though!

If you watch how glasses are cleaned here -- admittedly, the same way they are at many bars -- you'll ask for a disposal plastic cup instead.

Really cool guys here at this shop. Just came in to have them take a gander at my brakes but they helped me get these gosh danged rusty license plate screws out that I had been working on for 5 days. Didn't charge me for it. 

Definitely coming back here the next time I need anything they do and I suggest you do so as well.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I really didn't like this place.  It's terribly overpriced -- the food was unsubtle and not particularly tasty, but pretty expensive.  Our server was similarly unimpressive.  Actually, he was pretty unpleasant.  Basically, I got robbed and wouldn't go back.

Great barber shop. Always friendly and does a great job. Consistent. Hard to find a great barber especially one that can do a good fade... Waiting room only no appointments.

When he gets busy and fills up he closes the door/sign early so make sure you call ahead if it's after 3.

Highly recommended!

So far so good. Came into Yeats while my car was being repaired. The female bartender was very nice & attentive. I sat outside b/c it was a beautiful day & she made many trips back & forth to refill my drinks check on my food etc. The prime rib sandwich was pretty good and my cosmos were delicious.

I love the front desk staff at the Packard but the elevators are a real problem. For the amount of rent we pay and the lack of accessible and safe stairways, there is no reason an elevator should be down on average once every other week and then take more than one day to fix. If they are that unreliable, replace them!

Ask for Kaleigh! She just relocated to this location, but I have followed her from each salon she has been at. She is a hair goddess and always brings my hair back to life. I usually just tell her to do whatever to my hair because she knows what's best and does an amazing job every single time!

Not to shabby! We were just looking for a place to crash after the ball game and this was perfect, just out of town that it wasn't crowded, breakfast was tasty too. The only downfall at all was our ac unit squeaked on and off all night, but everything else was great!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Well, aside from the shards of glass in my foot from people dropping bottles caused by to much crazy - this place was a FLIPPING blast! I haven't danced around like a fool, and had that much fun, in quite a long time!  And friends, it was long overdue. 

Hit this place up late night - What a good time!

Solid 3.0. For $6.99 + ~$2.00 for beverages is a pretty good deal for the food. 
The food was of good quality, though I think most of the cooked veggies were from cans. If you need a good meal at a great price, hit this place up. 
Not haute cuisine, not a night out kinda place. Just for a nutrient load.

Best pizza I've had in Center City.

I've had good pizza and mediocre pizza here, I think it's best when it's made fresh.  They also have something called a "gizmo" that's basically sauce and cheese on a toasted roll - a handheld pizza.  Pretty clever.

The staff here are really nice, too.

Pizza is not worth ordering again with so many other options around for pie...so I thought I'd give them another try with a cheesesteak  - not only was the service terribly slow, the steak was just mediocre.  I ordered at the counter, went shopping and came back and they hadn't made the sandwich yet...??

3.5 - Went with a table of four.  The outside/inside transformation is kind of fun.  We all got pasta.  The ravs are made on site w/ homemade pasta dough.  They were very good.  The red sauce could have wowed more, but all in all it was a good meal.  I'd go back.

Very clean and new hotel. The staff is very nice and the rooms are always tidy and smell terrific. I wanna know what air freshener they use so my house can smell like that!

I only have one problem, their beds are listed as queens and they feel smaller than twins.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've never actually had a mocha that I didnt want to finish. Let's just say that each sip I took, I had to re-evaluate if I should take another sip. I'm giving it the benefit of the doubt that maybe that girl just put too much whatever she put in it and made it super sweet.

Small but was very clean and had nice bathrooms that were accommodating for changing clothing/shoes. The wi-fi worked fine for me.  I was there around 7pm on a weekday so I can't say how crowded it gets during peak times but I wish I lived closer to this location as I think it's the nicest one I've been to so far.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Nice rooms, the king suite is interesting, there are 2 TVs in the separate rooms, but no door. It's contest trying to watch something other than what my guy wanted to. 

The breakfast was more than adequate. Comfortable rooms and the people were really friendly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I didn't consume any food here, only drinks. Our server was super nice. She was so considered about our needs. She's friendly and made the whole waiting time at the airport much tolerable. I will stop by here again when I'm at Boise Airport and have plenty o time to kill.

My local DD!  Great friendly staff even though they seem to always be busy. The parking lot is a little annoying with the one ways and always seems full on the day you want to rush in and out. Overall a good clean spot to grab a cup of coffee (maybe a meal) and run.

The first (and only time) I ordered food there, the flavorless pulled pork sliders and salad took almost 40 mins to come out and was not fresh. Service is always incredibly slow, but since it's the only bar in the terminal (that I'm aware of), I keep going back. Drink here (if you need to kill time), but don't eat here.

Yummy treats and a staff that encourages sampling. Ice cream made with various spirits such as Belgian ales and Bourbon...oh yeah goat cheese too.  I had an oatmeal creme cookie and it was decent especially considering it was over $5.  I will return and get an ice cream.

How lucky am I to have such an awesome restaurant in front of my office building.  Killer sandwiches, soup, salads, and even breakfast.

I suggest getting the Cable Car.  This sandwich will blow your mind AND your diet!  It's a good thing they've got some great salads to have the rest of the month.

Very fresh ingredients and a kind of artful preparation and presentation make the small plates food at Zing very enjoyable.  Mixed drinks specials and balanced wines are a nice accompaniment.  During the warmer months, the balcony is the perfect place to savor this food and drink.

We ordered take out here while traveling and all in all it was good. My better half had the sausage with broccoli rabe and a salad with shrimp. I had grilled vegetables and a salad with shrimp also. The real test would have been to try their pizza and pasta but we wanted something light.

This place is cheap, quick, tastes okay if you want that cheap-Chinese-vibe in your mouth, but I *think* gave me food poisoning. BUT it might not have. Everything tasted fairly okay until I emptied out my egg fu yung combination plate into the toilet from both ends a few hours later. So have fun.

This place is a fine place to stay if you understand that you are staying in an active train station and your room will shake a couple times a day from trains.  The pullman car rooms are adorable, but very small and narrow.  

The front desk and bell desk staff was beyond sweet and helpful.  Wonderful customer service.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My boyfriend and I were visiting New Orleans from San Diego --  We ended up eating really great sushi....  But best of all we drank some fabulous hot Sake and then the boys made us some speciality drinks ---- our waiter was cool as hell and we had a great time that afternoon --- thanks for the good times!

best pizza in new orleans.  the only reason i am giving it four stars is because the food is inconsistent.  i don't know if they have a large turnover of employees but sometimes the food is excellent and other times it's quite sad.  overall, if you want pizza in new orleans, i think this is your best bet.

They diagnosed the problem and fixed it same day, it wasn't the problem I thought it was and was a lot easier to fix than I thought. Very professional and friendly. I've had a recent bad experience with a different mechanic so this felt really good. Will be going back!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Tex-mex in PA! Delicious everything, we got enchiladas, soup, tacos, quesadillas, tamales, tostadas, and more tacos! Ingredients were fresh, service was fast, and location was easy to find & park. Seating inside & out, small dining room, call before heading over.

Great food and service!! Our host made recommendations and we ordered... all were wonderful! I highly recommend the Mussels Vidaloo and house french fries for apps and the Hangar steak was perfect! This place is hiding in a strip plaza but once you're inside, the ambiance is clean, hip and inviting!

Rooms a bit on the small side. Front desk staff seemed nice. They have a small pool nice for kids to expel some energy. Other than that not much to say other than our room was clean, had a small dorm size fridge and microwave. They provide free wifi and seemed ok.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My wife and I stopped along our route to rest. We thought the hotel was clean and there was a small pool great for little ones. Only one issue that I noticed. The young female attendant was busy texting on her personal phone to attend us at the front desk. Guess she wanted to chat more than do her job.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Go to ANY other location than this one. The *manager* working the drive-thru window just shorted me almost a dollar in change. 

They're always slow, they hold the food in warmers until it's long past edible, then serve it anyway. 

This franchisee should be forced to eat his own store's food for a month.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The Custard Shack is a great spot to bring the family to get ice cream! The staff is always pleasant and helpful my son loves it here. They have a menu of dessert choices that won't overwhelm you.  I agree with Rich D. the lines can get long, but it's worth the wait!

The decor and ambiance is lacking but the fresh inexpensive Japanese fare will have you coming back for more!  Last time I was there we had the most unpleasant, disorganized, and slow server ever!!  Here is to hoping I will never have her serve me again because everything else was delightful!!

Good flavors but everything is HEAVY

if you're looking for a big, heavy, hearty, saucy, cheesy, creamy meal than this is the place to go. The food comes out quickly and while the staff is a bit robotic in their scripted delivery it's all good. You'll be rolling out of this place by the end.

Avoid this place.

Cons:
- Takes 30 minutes to get your rental car once you get there
- Staff is courteous but doesn't really say hi or talk with you (they just kind of mind their own business)
- No apologies or anything for slow service
- Cars aren't cleaned before you get them.

We ordered rainbow, aloha, and mamas rolls. They rolls were decent and portions were good (8 rolls) per order. I didn't care for the aloha personally. It was convenient since we stayed at the hotel. I was surprised that they charged full price for kids if we wanted to do all you can eat at the bar.

You like burgers, right? You like toppings? Choices? Good fries? Not fast food fries, I'm talking about GOOD fries. 5 guys type of thing, I mean. You need Cheeburger Langhorne. Good service, friendly faces, good times. They do it like no one else. Good for everyone, even vegetarians. Delicious stuff, and lots of fun.

I went in with scraggly beat-up nails and came out with gorgeously shaped and dipped nails. 
This was my first time here and I had Elena and she really took the time to get my nails shaped correctly. 
Sometimes a dip manicure feels extra thick on the nails, but Elena made sure they were just right. 
I am so happy.

I hope that in future months The Refinery becomes my most frequented restaurant. Menu changes weekly on Thursdays. Old bungalow house with very cool feel to it. Owners are always helpful with descriptions and suggestions. The menu is mostly prepared from good from local brews and farms. I leave feeling full and morally aligned.

For the price this is a pretty decent gym. They don't have ALL the machines I'd like, like the stair stepper for example but it gets the job done. This gym consists of mostly men so if that bothers you, be aware. I enjoy coming here and it's close by with parking.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Great Mexican food at a great price.  There are two locations.  This one here on Grant, but the first one I went to is on Oracle.  They are both wonderful.  Any of the ala carte burrito's enchilada  style or any of the chimichangas enchilada style will make you happy you came here.

The service here was awful....truly. Our waiter didn't seem to care about taking care of us AT ALL.

I suppose if you want to watch sports, this would be a good place. The food was just okay. I really thought this was a waste of my money and time. The atmosphere was like any other chain sports bar.

There's an advertisement screen showing 2 new flavors jamoca fudge and cookie dough flavoring for ice coffee, I said I'll have one of those, "sorry we do not have those flavors" what kind of crazy is that? It's like going to KFC and asking for fried chicken and they don't have any

My parents have been a loyal customer since 1995 to present day. I've been a customer since 2006 to present day. They are very helpful and friendly. They only fix what the problems are. They'll do their best to help you save money. Prices for service is very reasonable. Just look it up.

This supermarket sells everything even liquor(a large selection to choose from too)!! We dont have that in Austin,TX. We have to walk next door to Twins. There is even a dining area with TV to heat up your food if needed with condiments and plasticware. The area is decored with Saints. I like it. Awesome!

I was completely underwhelmed with the pizza at Mad Tomato, the pizza that I ordered was mediocre. There are several other places in Saint Louis that serve authentic Neapolitan Pizza, and they all use wood burning ovens in contrast to Mad Tomato's gas fired oven...

It's not the best hotel you can stay in.  Items left in the room after check out seem to magically disappear because retrieval isn't happening. The restaurant there is awful so make sure you get out to experience good food. It definitely won't happen at Crabby Bill's.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place is absolutely fabulous. It's hidden and descrete. The service is amazing, and the food is to die for! I had the filet mignon with the garlic and butter sauce and steamed spinach...The best I've ever had, ever! This place should be a 7 star restauraunt. Will be back for sure.

This place was awful. Ordered for delivery. They answered the phone with a simple "hello" I had to ask if this was China Delight. 

The Szechuan beef had no taste at all. This dish should have been spicy but instead was BLAND! The absolute worst Chinese food I have ever had! Can't give zero stars but wish I could.

Become a regular and Sammy will treat you like royalty. Sammy loves what he does and loves his customers. He will ensure the customer service is high quality, food top-notch, and the experience memorable! Sit at the Sushi bar and you may have the chance to chat with Sammy.

Stayed here for a work conference. Beautiful hotel. I heard not so great reviews on the Il Terrezio restaurant on site, but the bar food was great! Had a positive spa experience as well. Would definitely stay here again...but only if it was work related; not hurrying to Tampa at my own freewill anytime soon.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Fun crowd, great specialty drinks, and friendly bartenders. You need a Resurrection drink to enhance your Bourbon St crawl. Treat you pals to a barber chair shot as well! Drinks are pricey but everything is pricey unless you  get away from the tourist traps. Good  times

Enjoyable restaurant/store in cute, historic-feeling little Lebanon, IL.  Things I liked:
-Easy drive from Scott Air Force Base
-Home made pies (worth the trip just for this)
-Witch festival going on the night we were there
-Vegetarian options
I recommend it!

This place is clean and conveniently located, inside the mall food court. They did seat us right away on a Saturday night when all the other places in the area had a 1 hour wait.

However, we did not know they have a limited Friday's menu that lacks the new gourmet mac 'n cheese that we were craving.

Amazing views. This hotel is easily accessible. The lobby restaurant is a nice surprise. Very swanky and upscale. Outdoor patio seating is heavenly. 

Room is spacious, clean, and very well maintained. Bathroom and shower is spotless. 

So far every employee I encountered had a pleasant greeting. Definitely a great experience.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I usually stop in Tucson whenever driving out west and back, its a good place to refuel the car and get some grub, but I always had to play the what-fast-food-place-to-eat-at game.  Now I can stop at In-n-Out AND get gas right next door at Chevron.  #WINNING!

My friends and I decided to hit up this place after wanting to do something light and not cajun/creole. We each got a few items. I was pretty happy with what I got. The rolls were tasty and the service was prompt and friendly. I'd definitely hit it up again next time I'm in NOLA.

This restaurant used to be the best sushi bar in Tucson.  But it recently changed ownership (end of Sep 2010).  Sadly, it does not live up to its name.  I do not recommend this place.  Restaurants like these give Tucson a bad reputation for being a cow town.

I have been going to sushi 7 since they opened in 2007, so I wanted to check it out when I found out it was under new ownership.  The quality of fish seems to have improved, and the new menu had plenty to offer.  I will definitely continue to be a return customer.

This is one of two Japanese owned Japanese restaurants in Boise area (the other one is Shige). I am Japanese from Japan living in Boise area so I know what the authentic Japanese foods are.

I like their sushi and also like the variety of combo menu they have.

The food is very good, a local favorite in the moderate price range.
There is an Italian restaurant across the street that also has good food, but is very loud, hard to have conversation.  But Trattoria Victoria is just right, good food, nice atmosphere without breaking the bank.

About 10% pricier than other places for single beers, although the selection is a bit better overall.  I got the impression that the bartenders would have preferred that I didn't come in (maybe they were taking a break, or just having a bad day, but not the friendliest place).

Nice, basic hotel as most Fairfield Inns are. Comfortable, large room. Most are suites in this hotel. Got a decent rate on marriott.com. 

Free breakfast option is always nice. In town for a couple of concerts my son was attending and turned out to be a convenient location. Pizza delivery available if you want/need it!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Friendly and unusual optometrist shop.
I lost one of the nose pieces on my glasses last night.  They fixed me right up; replaced both pieces, balanced and cleaned my specs.  Charge? Free!  They said they provide as a service, just consider them when I'm looking for new glasses.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: My recent review of this restaurant was less than perfect, that being said, the manager reached out and gave me the opportunity to revisit, which I plan to do !!!  I appreciate this gesture since I have "heard" how good the restaurant is , thank you Brian !!

I've been going here for over 20 years.  What I love most is that you get cheap gas and a decent wash at the same time.  Sometimes they miss a spot or two on the car wash but for the most part they are pretty good (and Im a clean freak).  The deal is even better with the SB Axxess card discount.

This place is no bueno. I came in to grab a snack and waited nearly 10 minutes even though I was the only one in the store. Meanwhile the employees stood around gossiping, not a good look. I don't expect much at a fast food joint, but I didn't even get that here.

This is the worst pizza place I've ever ordered from.  I should have gone with my hunch and ordered Papa John's.  At least you know what you're getting.  The pizza took over an hour and the delivery boy was annoying.  I do not recommend this place at all.  In fact - boycott it!

It's a tiny coffee shop a few hundred yards from the beach. The service was friendly considering it was 7:30 in the morning. My iced mocha could've been a little sweeter, though I guess that's each to his own. I like supporting independent coffee shops, which this one definitely is, but it has a lot of work to do.

This place is awful. They totally ripped my wife off. The claimed they diagnosed her vehicle, but then said they couldn't figure out what was going on. Still charged her. For doing nothing. And then tried to get her so spend an additional $800 for 'shocks etc'.

Avoid at all costs.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
No words needed. Simply the best!!

They've updated their menu to include more rolls. When splitting with another person I normally do the three roll special, and then we each did a specialty role. I tried the Sansom roll in the lover roll and they were both fantastic, as always!

Like a lot of other bars on Broadway the band is up front so you can hear them from the street. Bands play for tips. 

The drink prices are decent and the bartenders are serious; they keep bottle openers in their wrist bands.

The band was okay (they seemed to do original songs) but the talking between songs wasn't that great.

Your standard Hard Rock Cafe. It was a breath of fresh air to the overwhelming fried seafood everywhere else. We had a turkey burger with alfalfa spouts. It was pretty good. A little pricey, but you're paying for the rock-star ambiance. Great location. Service was poor, but that's not uncommon for HRC's.

Real authentic Mexican. I loved the salsa and tacos, great carnitas, and some interesting offerings, like pumpkin flower quesadillas. I also love that the owner's mom sends the mole direct from Puebla . I thought the interior was charming and the service very good. Can't wait to go back.

Really glad I decide to stop by and do my laundry here. Met the nice local working here she was so nice gave me the best spots to check out that made my trip to New Orleans so worth it. Thank's Kims Dirty Laundrymat for the clean clothes and great conversational and local spots to hit. I suggest this spot to all.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: This was my first time at Pinkberry and it was okay.  The people were extremely helpful and I enjoyed them but it wasn't worth the price, $11 for 2 small yogurts. The actual yogurt was good but I can get that anywhere. I may go back, but only if I have money burning a hole in my pocket.

I travel to Nashville every other month of so on business, and I always make sure to stop at Yellow Porch.  Everything I've had here has been delicious.  Particularly memerable was a daily special salmon salad.  The waitstaff is helpful and attentive and the food is fresh and delicious.  Love.

Ordered through DoorDash. Took an hour and a half. Not the drivers fault, the wait was excessively long & the driver kept us updated. Our food was cold, there was like 10 fries in a medium order, and they forgot the sauces for 20 piece nuggets. Don't accept DoorDash orders if you can't keep up with the demand.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: These guys are a little bit pricey, but very friendly.  They even hemmed my pants for free one time- and did a great job.  That was a nice surprise.  I like that they have a little drive-up area that you can pull your car in for quick drop offs or pick ups.  Saves the hassle of finding a spot.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: The sushi was way overpriced, but edible.  They didn't add Asian Pear to my roll, white instead of requested brown rice was included, the avocado was over ripe, and the white fish (my fav) was not in stock.  For $9.67/roll w/2 fish and no other add-ons, I would go to pretty much anywhere else.

Terrible shrimp with walnuts with a ton of condensed milk sugar sauce ruining everything.  Plus the menu items look nothing like what you order and the waitress even admits that the pictures don't match.  The only saving grace is that the crispy duck is super tender and pretty tasty.

Yoko's used to be my sushi spot a decade ago. I moved out of state and forgot about it. Today I came back and was transported back in time. The sushi was delicious and the atmosphere was delightful. The service was slow but the drink prices were low. I'll be back

See the 4th paragraph of my review of Marcello's in Bordentown, but insert the word "garlic" in place of each reference to "parmesan" in that paragraph.

Luckily, I don't find excessive garlic quite as offensive as excessive parmesan, hence the 1 additional star.

This practice was recommended to me by one of my neighbors and I have been going here for about a year and a half. The whole staff is so great and the doctors and vet techs are so thorough and patient. You can tell that they really enjoy and care about what they do. I would recommend them to anyone.

I can't think of a single thing I would've liked better from my experience from this place.  Every person I encountered was professionally dressed, courteous, and helpful.

Not everything about our trip to PA was smooth, but this was one of the best businesses we encountered in our week-long stay.

The frozen yogurt is like any other Yogurtland but the girl working there is really something! I waited 5 minutes just right in front of her and she didn't acknowledge me! She was in her bubble for 5 minutes! I should have recorded her! 
Millennials at work ! but try Santa Barbara Millennials they are one of kind!

My husband and I have used Matthews dry cleaning for years. We have used them for dry cleaning and for alterations. They are always very kind,considerate and accomadating when we needed things by the next day. I have never had any problems with any of the work they have done for us. I would refer them to anyone I know!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Food was acceptable but the prices were astronomical. I would have rather eaten in the French Quarter for the price. For what they charge, I would have expected it to be much better or unique. Truth is that is is average food at high end prices. I will never eat there again.

DON'T EVER go here if you're in a hurry.

Went there this morning on my way to work and waited 15 MINUTES for a sandwich this morning; people were ordering after me, and getting served right and left.

No explanation, and no apology.

I will NEVER bring my business here again.

We got in to town kind of late and went here on a good friend's recommendation (he's a SB native). It was nice that our hotel was right down the street. The place was packed but we found 2 seats at the bar. The drinks were stiff and the food was good, tasty Italian fare. Loved the local flavor too!

This is a very unexpected surprise within a recreation place, like City Museum. The sandwiches here was so delicious, you would think you stepped into a NY deli, not a facility's "food court". The ones to try are the Reuben and Roast Beef "Samwiches".

Although its no surprise that such a cool place has a hidden gem of a eatery.

Our first time in Boise Idaho.  Came here to buy hard liquor. Disappointed. . Guess Idaho has a state law that doesn't allow groceries market to sell liquor.  Picked up some pre-marinated ribs and chicken. Ribs was tasty. Chicken was a little salty.  Someone got season happy.

I know that I've said that I like dive bars, but this place is just too much. Every time I give this place another chance, it lets me down. The last straw was the two attempts to sing karaoke there on different nights and the DJ not showing up either time. Somewhat shady crowd sometimes, just stay away.

There food is just meh, and their service is not good. They cant take an order over the phone because their servers are to lazy and they don't take credit cards over the phone because they have an archaic ordering system, I would have to call it bad management.

Dammmmn Gina this place is sloooooow! They have one barista working that takes orders, makes the drinks & runs the register!!! Not their fault. They need a cashier! This is inside a busy ass hotel!!!! The quality of pj's is very so so....it's supposed to be convenient, at this location, it's neither of thosr things!

This great BYOB italian restaurant is tucked away in a small shopping center.  It has the typical italian restaurant decor and a nice, casual atmosphere.  The prices are reasonable and the food rocks!  My fiance loves the pizza and I love their shrimp scampi!

Ignorant lady working the counter charged me to much more than I should have been and prices are clearly posted and she argued the fact. Look at the photos of the so-called clean linen we received back covered in long black curly hair and small black genitalia hair everywhere
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: The food here is pretty good and the prices are great. There is a nice selection of vegetarian dishes. The baked goods are also delicious. They could have better teas and the coffee was over roasted. I plan to eat here frequently, but I'll probably just stick to bottled water.

A little pricy for what you got. The antipasti and soup courses left a little to be desired. The pasta course was the best course. The dinner was bland and came with an excessively salty salad. The dessert was great, and so were the cordials- but didn't make up for the overall experience. We won't be going back.

We live in Scottsdale az now and I booked reservations for a new years dinner with my girl at this restaurant we both love. The family has always been the highlight of the restaurant from the dishwasher to the hostess or host depending on days. 
The sea bass is awesome!

My friend Thomas told me he would take me to Gavi's for two years and then he finally did and it was good, but it was weird.  The people working there kind of stared at us but didn't really give us any extra attention.  It was kind of like we were in a zoo.  The sauce was tasty.

1 word. AMAZING! I had the best meal of my life tonight. We had crabmeat with Fava beans, amazing. Salad with pine nuts and goat cheese, amazing! Branzino, omg, amazing! Filet migon, amazing! And desserts, yes, you guessed it, AMAZING!!!!!!!!!!!! I love this place! Best kept secret in South Jersey.

La Quinta hotels can be really hit or miss. This one was middle of the road, but super helpful front desk staff and the hotel itself was on the newer side and really clean. The pool is good, too. You can't really go wrong here. If you're looking to choose a location between this one and St. Louis/Riverport, go with this, 100%.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: AYCE on a Tuesday night. Selection was limited. Rolls had a ton of rice and broke apart almost immediately. Orders took longer to make than other sushi experiences I've had. Definitely not the best sushi chefs, but the quality of the fish seemed fine. Overall, just average.

It's not a bank so there have been a few limitations but the staff is lovely and kind.  I have received great financial advice on a myriad of subjects.  And the ATMs feel safe and convenient.  In love with this organization and joined AFCU because I got nothing but positive reviews from my peers.

The chicken tacos are surprisingly delicious especially drenched in their salsa. Everything else I've ordered from here are just ok.  Takes a while, maybe 20 minutes, to get your food after ordering so I've learned to call ahead for pickup. It's worth a try for a taco plate.

Hit or miss service.  The older lady working drive thru is not very friendly at all.  Every time I see her the only words out of her mouth is what I owe, and that is it!  I then told her, "have a nice day" on my most recent trip.  No response from her.  

She needs to take that negative attitude home!!!

I have lived in Miami, FL and in Chicago, IL and have never paid $3 per shirt. When I finally got my shirts back they weren't pressed correctly and two shirts had stains on them that were not there before I dropped them off. Good luck but my experience was overpriced, and bad.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
I walked past this place and then checked the Yelp reviews. The comment almost made me not go here. But, I did. 

The red wine? Perfect. The service? Not bad at all. I ate at the bar and the bartender was great. Super friendly! 

Overall, food was decent, wine was good and people were friendly.

I'd absolutely go back.

Recently, we had the opportunity to dine at their new location, in Clayton.  We had the eight course tasting menu with wine parings.  

As I wrote in my earlier post, it's just not my type of restaurant.  I appreciate what they do but prefer other styles of dining.  Also, dining here is pricy!

Such a favorite, and within walking distance of my house. It seriously elevates the neighborhood; I wish more places like it would open up - I want Pennsport to be a restaurant destination! 

The staff has always been friendly, the chef has come out to the table to see how things are, the artwork on the walls is lovely.

Not super fast, and not super cozy, but great great food.  We like to order take out.
Meals are under $10, and I'd recommend anything but the chalupas (kind of disappointing) or the quesadillas (real basic cheese/meat - kind of too plain).  
Chimichangas, tacos, enchiladas - all great.

I thought by paying more for a hand scrub inside and practically would be worth it....its not. I had to go back and wipe the inside of the cleaner they used that streaked my windows and dash. I could have paid for a $3 wash and gotten a better job done on the outside. Its very over rated

I called a week ago and scheduled an appointment with Jess for today. When I called to confirm my appointment right before leaving work I was told that she went home for the day and did not take appointments and must have forgotten. That is completely unacceptable.

The food was just alright, but the price was comparable. If you are looking for a place to eat before you head back to your hotel after a day of sightseeing, they will take good care of you and fill you up. If you are looking for a great dining experience, I recommend going elsewhere.

Ate here twice one recent weekend. Lunch was ok. I had a grilled sandwich, nothing special since I can't remember what was on it. For brunch I had huevos rancheros. The menu said 'with crisp torillas', instead got salty nacho chips that were disgusting. Totally ruined what is normally my favorite brunch dish.

my boyfriend and I have only been in NO for 3 days and have eaten here twice! I don't eat fish, but the veggie sushi is awesome! my honey had the New York hibachi steak with fried rice, veggies, and miso soup which was delicious too. I urge you all to go try this place!

I visited this place while waiting for my flight.  The staff was friendly and I liked that the cashier took the time to let the root beer foam settle such that the cup could be filled to the brim.  I had the mushroom vegetable (no spinach) pan pizza and a small bowl of salad and both were quite good.

can't decide between chipotle or subway? go to pita pit! 

the ingredients seemed to be better, there was a wide enough variety of options on the menu, and it's a unique alternative to chipotle or subway.   

I was satisfied, the pita didn't break or spill out the goods, and the ingredients were pretty good quality

If you are looking for a very small selection in a buffet & want to spend too much money, then I recommend it, if not BEWARE! the selection for the price is AWFUL!! & the waitresses don't even smile or ask if you need something more to drink. this place sucks don't go here!!

I will admit that I usually only shop here when I am too lazy to go to Save On, but at the same time, I've never had any major issues. Their produce is always pretty nice! The only time I was disappointed was when I accidentally bought expired gravy mix, and really that was my fault for not checking the expiry date.

We went to Hana on the recommend of a Yelp review and could not have been happier. Food was great, including the presentation (see photo, post a few bites). The staff was great and welcoming, as well as, telling us about their delivery and weekly specials. It's close to home so we will be back...a lot!

Udon is my Japanese comfort food of choice.  It's how I rank a Japanese joint.  These guys do it pretty well! Personally though, I think they'd do better if they didn't strive to be a fancy modern restaurant, their space is better suited to be a hole in the wall gem.

Charming is really the key word for La Viola. The old location is very Intimate, i commonly find myself chatting with neighbors that I brush elbows with. If you don't find that fun, than you can go across the street for identical quality (not the best) food. Great wait staff!!

This place is just okay. Not the same as the Sakana in Las Vegas. The one in Vegas is way way better!!! Went here with the wife thinking it was the same as Vegas. The menu is not the same. I don't know if they are affiliated. Same name, so we thought they were.

Espresso was juicy, bright, bangin. Four Barrel coffee from San Francisco as the guest roaster, so tasty on the pour over! ANDINO ESPECIAL one of my favorite coffees, like sugar cane mane! And tasty eats, brioche bun, ham and cheese, won my heart. Thank you for being friendly, rad, inviting. Loved it

What hot summer night would be complete without a walk up to Scoops? Only a rainy night would keep my family away. Great little ice cream stand. Good selection of Ice Cream and Water Ice and my favorite frozen chocolate covered bananas.
Prices have gone up a bit but then again so has everything else in the neighborhood.

This is a great homebrew shop.  George and Nancy are very friendly and helpful.  If you're curious about brewing, just stop in for a chat.  They're like walking home brew encyclopedias.

For the regular brewers, you can buy a 50 lb grain bag, which keeps costs down (if you're an all-grain brewer)

Biggest complaint; cash only. Sooo customer unfriendly. Why push the $3 ATM fee on me to avoid $.20 of credit card fees? Other than that, service was friendly, the unusual flavors tasted like what they say they are, and the traditional flavors were pretty good too. I'd give at least another star if the took cards.

The owner is very welcoming and I bring my friends and family here every chance I get! Make sure you get a bowl of Alamos Dip!! I've never had a bad meal or experience here. If you call in they'll even time their prep to make sure you're picking up hot food and not cold stuff sitting under a heat lamp waiting on you.

This place is so forgettable. Always pretty bland and seems to be more expensive than it's worth. Used to have a solid steak sandwich but it's been changed. Probably one more thing to cheap out on from the owner. I can't say many good things about this spot, probably better to find somewhere else.

Every person in this establishment is a great hairdresser and very friendly with my kids.  Cheap haircuts and a fun experience for my kids?  Yes please.

The downside is that they are usually busy, so plan to wait... but there's stuff to do around there... so put your name down and you'll be first when you get back. :)

The pizza is amazing. The best we have had since we were in Naples, Italy. The menu is limited so don't expect pepperoni and sausage. This is true Italian flavor. The Calamari was very tasty as well. Nice wine and beer selection. Great service. Friendly staff.   We will be back.

My kids love this hotel!

I say different. The hot water was out in the entire hotel from at least 6:30 to 10:00p. I couldn't shower and missed our reservation to a pretty famous place. We received no makegood or apology.

My kids say 5 stars and I say 1 star, 3 star average
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Do like a little warm kick to your ice cream? Then the mole chocolate is for you. Deep chocolate ice cream with a warm peppery kick. Perfect ice cream for the winter.

Actually there's something for everyone. All the ice creams, popsicles, and other tasties are made by hand with fresh ingredients.

Treat yourself. You deserve it.

Came here with my family of 4. We got the pork chop special, the ravioli, the spaghetti and meatballs, and the caesar salad. The standout dish here is the pork chop. It was cooked and seasoned perfectly. The pork was juicy and moist.  The other dishes were average at best.

I went in for a routine eye exam. The staff was friendly and helpful. Brosof was also very nice and he explained everything he was doing and was very good at explaining what he found during the exam. They also had a good selection of glasses. Overall, good place to go!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Met an old friend there for dinner. We both lived in Japan previously.  He commented that it was a little slice of Tokyo.  They even had large bottles of Orion beer (brewed in Nago,Okinawa). The Otoro was a bit closer to Chu Toro, but I'm not complaining.  It's on my list of approved restaraunts.

McDonald's tastes the same everywhere and if you are forced to live near one that has crap food I feel for you. The best thing about this location, is that it is so fast! I have to rush just to keep up. Careful to check your order before you leave. Occasionally a salad dressing, spoon or sauce can be forgotten.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We went for dinner on 5/13/13.    We had the mushroom flat bread and heirloom tomato salad as a appetizers. For dinner we had the scallops, the salmon and mushroom fettuccine   The food was very good.  The service was less stellar to say the least.  I would only recommend The Saint James if you don't mind poor service.

After landing in RNO, I had mapped this location as my first stop before heading eastbound on I-80 to Winnemucca.  It's a friendly place.  This is one of those Starbucks that asks your name so they can call it out when your drink is up.  Never give your real name, always make one up like "Godzilla" or something.

Terrible rooms. Tub was still dirty. Under the tables had garbage and dust. Lobby leaked water from ceiling. Loud single pane windows,  sticky elevator floors. Restaurant is really not a restaurant.

Staff is friendly.  But that's all.

Rm 215. 5/27 to 6/3 Stay
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The pizza in here is really good.  It's unfortunate when you call to place a phone order it should not take nearly 3 hours to be delivered.  Not to mention, the food was cold and no utensils were included with our office delivery.  Will not order from this location again.

Well this is my second review here. Staff was super nice. Room was clean as always. I do have a complaint, who has a non-smoking room and a smoking room joined with one of those connecting doors, the smell goes right thru them!  The staff did understand and took care of us. Just a stupid move on whoever laid the rooms out.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We really enjoyed our stay in Boise at this hotel. The staffs were very friendly. The room was clean and spacious. Other than a great deal on price, two complimentary drinks, free breakfast, and free wifi were great additions to the excellence of this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Okay....... so perhaps you are busy right now.... but with three employees at the front counter area and in five minutes NO ONE minimally says "good morning" or "we will be right with you"?!?!  Really?  I expect much better service from Starbucks.  Really sad....

I rate this restaurant below "meh", but above barf...Should have known when the menu warned of food borne illness.  The waiter looked like he smoked mad weed which I usually give bonus points for, but he had really long hair on the back of his neck which knocked him down a few notches.

A great neighborhood bar with a super waitstaff and welcoming atmosphere. Spent a couple hours here in the afternoon playing trivia and enjoying vacation.

No food, so don't come hungry. There's enough other places around, though, so that's not an issue.

Make a point to drop by and say hi.

Note:  His & Hers is now closed.  There is a sign that says it will be opening as fish and chicken restaurant soon, but no dates provided. 

Obviously, the star rating system isn't really applicable here.  However, I can't post a review or otherwise share the closure information without one.

Great sushi but restaurant wasn't that busy yet we waited over an hour for 3 rolls. Seems they are focused on their delivery business. Eventually we got food and it was good. But they need to do better. They offered us nothing. No free drink, nothing for waiting at a table for an hour after ordering.

Hotel is nice and in a nice area. They have free internet and upgraded internet. However, the upgraded internet isn't worth its salt. It's slow and if you're attempting to stream videos or play games you will experience buffering or lag. Compared to other Courtyards, the internet is lacking. Hence the 4 stars instead of 5.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The car is spotless!!!!

We had a bit of a hiccup with the rims of my new car but the manager there took care of it within a few days so I am extremely appreciative of his attentiveness. 

I probably won't ever run my car through a conveyer belt ever again but if I could I would come back to this car wash

I love their pizza - in my opinion they have the best white pizza.  I have also used A & S for a few catered lunches at my workplace, and they were great.  The owner helped me figure out how much food I would need given the number of people. All the food was delicious and many people commented that they thought it was really good.

Go upstairs get 3 beers for $6.50 (bud, bud light, ultra) you can't mix and match so just drink 3 or agree on the beer.  They don't tell you it's 3 for 1 so you have to ask, that was a tip from another local bartender on Decatur street.  Nice balcony over looking Bourbon with some red bull tables.

The food was good. Homemade fries and the fish was good as well. 

Little overpriced for what you get but, it's probably due to the location (on the water). 

However, it was very! slow. We waited almost 45 mins to get our food once we ordered.  So that is what drove down another star.

look, I'm not in the business of trying to make others look bad. But, facts are facts. FACT: my expensive dress coat that was dry cleaned was dropped off with its belt. Picked up sans belt. Owner states things are shipped off site for stuff. Do what will with this info.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Fantastic location.  Right on state street.  Walk 200 feet and there's the beach.  Walk 5 feet in opposite direction: all of state street with its glorious shops and restaurants.

You pay for what you get.  Not the best hotel in the world.  But it fit my needs for the weekend.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have been eating here for over 10 years, so good! The service has barely ever dissappointed except last visit where they skimped me alot of chicken in my chicken parm, they tried to fix it but failed :( Other than the prices rising... definitely a place to check out, great great food!!!!!!!!!!

Just an update that after my terrible experience I DID write a private message to Hertz social media person, just as requested in his response to my review, and never heard back from him. This place is a joke. I have been back to NOLA since, and was quite happy to find that not every rental service here is as bad as Hertz.

Would be five stars, but they keep fucking up!
Every order TASTES great, but is either very late, made wrong, or insufficiently proportioned to an unacceptable degree.
The manager is a dick and doesn't care.  He specifically disregards yelp reviews, citing users' ignorance.

This is mostly about the "impossible whopper". Was really hoping this turned out to be anything like their marketing campaign. Mostly "impossible that it would get any drier." Or "impossible that it should taste any blander." Not a good option for meat eaters or vegetarian/vegans."

The staff were spot on. The food delicious. 1/2 price bottles on the Sunday night we were there. We had the steak for two and ordered medium rare. It arrived rare and the waiter noticed immediately, without us saying a thing. So 4 stars, kitchen under cooked the steak which can happen. Excellent date for my wife and me!

What can I say, The pizza was good, but the staff there are absolutely miserable.  Our waitress provided good service but had 0 personality.  She was obviously having a bad night.  The guy making the pizzas was slamming the dough on the prep table like he wanted to do that to someone's head.....

This location gets most of its points because of the building. It was completely rebuilt and is very nice. The problems are typically the loud staff, sometimes slow service, and fountain drinks that have less than optimal fizz. The food is usually consistent, so it's not a complete loss.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
It's ok.
The floor is very sticky, and the baked potato was extremely dry.

But Wendy's has baked potatoes and chili, which makes them superior to every other fast food place... And in this particular Wendy's, there is a fireplace wall and seating area that are actually pretty nice. So still 3 stars :)

Best service and best value out there, no other shop is better in my mind. They have fixed vehicles for us for years now, from our Z4 to our Honda Accord, no problem too complex, no issues too small, they do it all and they have some amazing vehicles they work on. 

THANK YOU IVM!!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Dirty and poorly managed.  With no line a long wait to order.   Part of our order was brought to our table 15 minutes later.  We sat after wiping our table and seats. When we were done eating the rest of our order was brought.  The drink counter needed stocked and to be cleaned.   Our experience left us disappointed

The couch was completely falling apart, trashy, and has not been cleaned. We opened it up for our kid to sleep, and it had food, garbage, dirt, and dust all over it. The bedding we had to go back to the front desk to get, and it was also trashy with a big hole.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This review is for Budget, which is with Avis. Not very helpful people. I returned the car, walked in, and the kid asked me if I had the Mileage. 
Me:  No, because I've never had to, you guys always come get it, and no one told me I had to. 
Him: Well, you need to go get it.

Staff is friendly. Helpful.  Rooms are not good. So old with a moldy smell. Really really moldy and wet smelling.   Sheets were clean and I didn't find bed bugs. But I wouldn't go back.  I'm sorry such nice people have to work there and deal with unhappy customers.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I can honestly say I love their pizza. I love the fresh texture of the pizza dough, they put a good amount of cheese and the sauce has a good flavor. I prefer them more than Kings pizza, I felt that Kings pizza was good but more pizza dough than toppings and the pizza sauce on Kings pizza has a very bland taste.

McD is one of my favorite places for fries and Big Mac. I love that service is fast and accurate; however, this place gets packed at night & weekends. This is on Broad St. near Temple University corridor so expect the college students to be hanging around and enjoying the free wifi.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place just rocks! Great food and service.we just tried the Ceviche Roll and let me say it's delicious! One of the best Sushi places in Reno. Make sure when you go into Circus Circus or Silver Legacy that you make plans to eat here. All you can eat option too!

While this isn't 4 Diamond dining, the food and service is great.  They have VERY good pasta, and incredible portions which will last you for a couple days.  The pizza is great, with the sauce very similar to my own family's recipe (Momom would approve)  I also like them because they deliver, and fairly quickly I might add.

Updated hotel. Rooms were clean and renovated. Close enough to the ballpark to walk and the subway. Conference rooms were clean and comfortable but a bit of a walk from the rooms - next building across the street but you go underground to get there. Staff was friendly and courteous.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This bar had a cool atmosphere, but don't go here for dancing. I went for the "Smiths Night Dance Party" and was so disappointed. The dance floor was packed...with people standing. Nobody was dancing. NOBODY. It was such a bummer; the music was great, but nobody seemed to notice.

Hands down the best Pizza in town!!! I've had the Rachies bake, eggplant and chicken parm subs and the meatballs. Awesome squash soup when they have it! Everything is fresh and flavorful!!!  If you are coming from to visit Tucson, your a snowbird, or you just a regular resident this the best place to go! You will be glad you did!

Amazing! I've had duck a few times and know it's a hard dish to get right but the duck leg at Maize was fantastic. The service was attentive, knowledgeable and friendly. I love being able to watch the chef as well. Maize is truly a unique experience in the heart of old town Perkasie.

Stayed March 2013

My husband & I stayed here for only 1 night. We had an early flight out of TPA & didn't want to have to leave Sarasota so early in the morning. This hotel is really close to the airport & easy to get to & from. It is close to International Mall for shopping & restaurants. It's clean, which is important to me.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Such a great place. We normally see Dr. Rockwood for our pets and she's fantastic - kind, empathetic, gentle, but also intelligent, and decisive. The same is true for Dr. Hyduke. The entire staff is great, from reception to the nurses. Couldn't ask for anything more. I really appreciate them.

Monte's Auto is the place to take your car in Germantown. They are honest and affordable. They also quoted me at one price and then found out my battery had a rebate in it and lowered the price for me. I was driven home and then picked up when the car was done. I couldn't have asked for a better shop in my neighborhood.

Nice and quiet inside. Old r&b playing in the dim interior. The bar tender was nice and drinks were good on a muggy afternoon. Glad they don't allow smoking inside anymore but this little hole in the wall gem was perfect for a quick rest to cool down and re-energize.

Literally been sitting here for an hour and they tell me there are three people ahead of me. I had an appointment. I'm furious with the service, not to mention there aren't any seats here to sit. The office is chaotic at best. It is cheap which is definitely a pro but this service is awful.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Awsome service and great selection of sushi for AYCE..We came on a sat night and suprisingly not a crowd..Its like we have our own sushi chef since its only two of us in in a very end corner. Overall sushi is good , maragrita is awsome and service is fast..

SliCE is my absolute favorite thin crusted pizza place!  All of their pizzas are fabulous!!  I can eat the Caramelized Onion & Goat Cheese pizza every day!  The Truffle Pizza is just as good.  Everyone who lives or visits center city should experience SliCE!

The frozen grocery store White Castle can not compare to the real deal. 

It is soooo good, and whenever I visit my relatives in the STL I have to have those lil sliders. One time I almost missed a flight back to Cali just to get me some White Castle...Yeah, it's that serious!

Prices are okay for the amount of food you get. The restaurant's decor is pretty cheesy, but the service was descent.  I generally just call in to-go orders.  BTW, it's in the back of a parking lot, I was doubting my GPS the first time I went there. Keep your head up and you'll find it!

You basically have to stand outside with all your dirty laundry trying to figure out how to get a card for this place but it's not to bad. Inside is not very big but enough room to get the job done there are no televisions or anything so much sure you bring a book or at least charge your phone before you start.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Laundry mat in the city, pretty much says it all. No parking, very small & very busy. However, that being said, get there early, get a spot, wear a mask because they require you too (bummer). Washers & dryers are pretty expensive, I did 2 loads and it was every bit of $20. Free laundry detergent and dryer sheets though!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: With the choice between this location and the one inside westshore mall, this is definitely the better choice.  Plenty of seating inside but only two tables outside.  The staff was great and very pleasant.  Coffee was perfect as was the food.  I enjoyed the comfy seating by the window to chill at.

Small Starbucks connected to embassy suits. Only a few homeless out front some seats but over all you can sit inside or out without difficulties.  Nothing special here.  They served my breakfast egg sandwich still frozen in the middle but there did offered to make me a new one.  It just needed 20 more seconds luckily.

Amazingly creative chefs and high quality fish make for a great combo here. There's lots of items that I've never seen before and most were tasty. The seared at your table Kobe slices was a cool trick. Melt in your mouth beef was easy to cook and delicious. Coming nigiri was excellent. It's a great spot with good service.

Crap location.  Comfy beds.  Check in staff was slow and not helpful. Don't waste your time thinking the concierge lounge will ever have coffee, food, or anything "ammenity-like.".  Have tried it twice and found nothing but bruised apples and disappointment.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place has amazing dishes and amazing drinks, much of which is locally and wildly sourced. It's a gem in the rough and one of the few places that can make something that goes beyond my own kitchen skill level. Thank you all for the work and passion you put into your craft.

We have stayed here twice and the location is convenient and our dogs can stay for free. Beds are comfy, rooms are clean and quiet, bliss toiletries, staff is friendly, bar has decent drinks, and there is a pool table. Aloft has been a consistent hotel for us and the free pup stay is worth giving these hotels a try alone.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Very nice and busy nail salon. We were able to get service right away as walk ins. They did a beautiful job on our gel and classic manicures. Daughter messed up one of her nails and they happily fixed it for her. Right next to Digital Worlds VR for mom's that want to get nails done while their teen get their virtual reality time.

I had the penne Milano it was outstanding. Plenty of prosciutto was in the meal and the brandy cream sauce was excellent. 

My wife had the spinach ravioli.  She loved it as well,  she thought the creamy cheese sauce was very good. 

Our waitress was very nice and very attentive. 

We will stop back again soon.

Very affordable and quick, but those are the only pros! Do not let them clean anything delicate and/or silk, and/or white! They will ruin!!!! All the money you save with their cheap prices will go to buying clothes to replace the ones they ruin so think before you let them dry clean your prized items!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: The people that work at this Fry's are so nice.  I feel like I know them.  They are quick to ask how your day was and how you are doing.  I get asked by staff frequently if there is anything I need help with.  This is the Cheers of supermarkets. You feel like everyone knows and remembers you.

I have had a handful of different Chinese places around the Manayunk area but this one is definitely the best. Quick delivery and great prices. The General Tso's chicken chunks are large and the pork fried rice is great and is not the weird yellow colored rice.

Good service and a quality hair cut. The shop offers a comfortable atmosphere of a traditional barbershop. Hot towel shaves are available if you have the time. Matt the barber is quiet but professional. He will remember who you are and how you like your hair cut after only one visit.

Very fair price for quality service.

The food was pretty good, for Boise. I was pleased to be eating somewhere that wasn't a chain. Service was fantastic, even though it was busy. One of the owners was walking through the place, shocking in on guests and making sure there experience was a positive one. Quaint and cozy atmosphere. I'd go there again for sure.

We went in with a large group for breakfast.  Service was friendly if a bit slow-we needed to request some items multiple times before we got them.  Everyone said their food was good, everyone was somewhat disappointed with the small-ish portions.  Overall it was a good experience.  Not stellar, but OK.

The place looked cleaned. I didn't order food, please place was empty not to many travelers on New Year's Eve so seat yourself. The drinks are very over price for spirits and I know I'm at the airport, but 13.00 for LIT in an 8oz glass is a bit much.  Lauren the bartender was great.
