Stopped for a late dinner and sat at the bar. Very good service and attentive . Specials read sounded spectacular as we had the traditional " St. Louis fried ravioli" which was great and shared a pasta special. When in STL my wife and I always try to make it to Cafe Napoli

A single phrase comes to mind when I think of this Los Betos location:  Ignorance is bliss.

My recommendation for this place is:  if you need to enjoy your meal, use the drive-thru and don't think too much about sanitation. If you do this, you'll be in good shape.

The sushi was ok. The prices were way too high for the quality. 1 adult and 1 toddler ate lunch for 40 dollars plus tip and we didn't order anything extravagant - hand roll, salmon sushi, maki rolls. I had a spider roll too and it had no flavor which was disappointing.

The wife loves this S. Philly dive, but it's typical S. Philly  Italian fare. Expect to wait. The mussles are good and ask for plenty of bread. You can't let that broth go to waste.

Plan to be scolded by a S. Philly mother if you don't finish your plate and don't want the rest wrapped. ;)

This restaurant tries to be too cool for its own good.  The food is not in the spirit of authentic Mexican or a bold interpretation of it, for that matter.  Do not expect a hearty meal here, but rather expect high prices, skimpy portions, and unimpressive flavors.

This is authentic Mexican and it's good. The reason for the 3 stars versus 4 is because the waitress spilled half my beer says "sorry" walks away and takes an order from another table!  Nothing to clean the spilled beer up with or an offer to replace the beer she spilled.  Terrible service!!!

This is definitely my go to place for sushi. The rice coating the sushi is just the right amount. My favorite roll is definitely house roll, and make sure to try the mackerel sashimi. It taste so fresh and yummy unlike the buffet version. The ultimate best thing about this place beside their food is their price!! 50% off sushi

Food is delicious. But had to go with three stars because of the service is super slow. They cater to their regulars and won't make eye contact with you hoping you don't ask for something...like water...never got it..asked 3 times...and the place wasn't even busy

I ordered here 3 times for different items over the past weekend - pizza, hoagie trays, cheesesteak - all were of great quality, on time, service was great over the phone, in person, and delivery.  They were a great help in getting me and my coworkers fed for this past weekend.

Delicius! Great atmosphere and service too. The waiter clearly explained the menu and answered our questions. The owner stopped by several times to check on us as well. We enjoyed every course - appetizer through the waiter's self proclaimed best cappuccino. I will definitely be going back.

Make the trek all the way out here because the pizza is that good and I'm not aware of any other pizza place with this quality of pizza.

The man making the pizza clearly enjoys it and cares about the product. Haven't had a bad one yet. Even taken a few home to reheat and it was still good.

I go here nearly every time I go to downtown Santa Barbara (mind you, that's not often) but every time has been very good. They have great pasta and great pizza. They are a little on the pricey side, but when I got to places like this, I expect pricey anyways.

This place is precisely what you expect from a plaza Chinese take out restaurant and it is consistently excellent. The food is made fast, the service is friendly, and the portions and prices are fantastic. If you're looking for Chinese take out in downtown, this is the place to go!

Expensive, unfriendly service, and mediocre food. The burger was bland and our waitress was one of the rudest people in the service industry that I have ever come across. For the price you pay, you would expect a whole lot more than this establishment dreams of giving you.

Oh wow. Went in for the first time today for lunch. Owners waited on our table. Very friendly. Beer is ice cold. The pizza is unlike anything I have had before it's like a casserole with a delicious crust. Really high quality ingredients they definitely take the time to do it right. I will be back

I love this place. It's our go to sushi when in Tampa. So many different choices on the menu. My husband and I only really eat the cooked stuff, which many times makes our choices limited. I like that I can go here and eat different rolls, not just the same old stuff. The hibachi meals are great too!

This place used to be fun when if first opened but not so much anymore. The bands they get are not good and the crowd disperses early. Its ok as a pregame spot but not a place you are going to be in all night. If you live on Countryside its a convenient location and the drinks are mixed ok.

I love Sushi...  love a good hole in the wall restaurant even more - combine the two with being right on the water, and this could be my favorite restaurant! Too bad the food is terrible - Ive had fresher sushi in Colorado!

Two stars for a mom and pop place still managing to hold a place in SB harbor.

Rotary lacks a bit on ambiance but the sushi is nice! The chefs prepare each role like they are trying to win a prize for its presentation. The fish is fresh and worth your time. The Treasure Valley needs more places where you can get quality sushi. Rotary is one that you should put in your rotation of sushi spots to try!

Staff is bad, continually! No matter what time I go, they always get something messed up! The last time I ordored a coffee and 2 muffins. 1 for me and 1 for my son. When I got home there was only 1 muffin in the bag, and I was charged for 2.
There coffee is good and it's close to home

This is probably the worst haircut I've ever had. The dude was more concerned about the game on tv. I only noticed how bad the haircut was when I got home..first off he cut off more than what I asked for and to top it off, the cut was so uneven. I'm gonna go somewhere else to get it straightened out...very very disappointed..

My wife and I drive past it numerous times. She decided to surprise me for my birthday and took me there. The menu was great, the service was great. I had a butter fried quail on top of dirty rice and green beans. Just simply amazing. The wife had the half of chicken and had enough for a second meal.

its a hole in the wall the map and address are correct unlike a yelp review if you notice the name of the road changes north of 116th out of towners the general tso chicken if you like with pork fried rice "the norm" i guess you have to ask for it mine came with white rice yuk

I've been going here since they usually do a much better job than the competition. However, it seems that they are short cutting cleaning our cars! I got the works cleaning package and to say that they did a poor job would be an understatement. Will try to find a better place or continue to do it myself. Not worth the expense.

Chicken carbonara!!! This was the best Italian food I have ever eaten. The service was great and the atmosphere was nice. The chicken carbonara and the chicken Marsala were both ordered and devoured. I was a bit casual so make sure to not wear shorts. It's a more upper-scale restaurant and it's fantastic.

Service was lacking and servers and hostesses were confused. Music was too loud to have conversation. They only offer three salad "dressings" - Caesar, balsamic, and fresh squeezed lemon. Um, what? But the $5 fishbowls are a draw and the crab Rangoon was very tasty. Needs more menu options...

We came.
We danced.
We ignored gross men hitting on us.
We ordered water.
We went to the next place.
Not much to say except we passed an enjoyable 20 minutes here listening to ratchet dance music and watching drunk guys pretending to be "the band" on stage.
Also, there's a fish tank! (Poor fish)

Absolutely painless, there is a hidden feature called "skip the kiosk" you can choose all options online and go directly to the lot grab your vehicle and go!!! Return was quick and easy and I even got credited back $19.00 (why I still don't know) very happy with my experience with Alamo!!!

This place claims to be a new renovated hotel. iT IS DEFINITELY NOT! Walls are super thin, you can hear everyone talkingin the rooms next to you very clear, rooms are dark, location is not great. Service is slow and people working here are even slower.... Then I remembered I'm in the south so I should have expected that.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My husband and I have eaten here a few times and were real fans of the style of pizza-- crispy, well done crust, chunky tomato sauce. But then a couple of weeks ago we both got *very* sick from the pizza. Curious to know if anyone else had this experience?

We stayed here when my son and I went to Florida for his Spring Break. Amazing views! Hotel was clean, great customer service, my son loved the heated pool, I loved the restaurant right downstairs with live music, delicious food, great drinks and fun stuff to do. Definitely going to stay here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My first visit here proved to be a very wise move. The other reviews were spot-on (pun intended.) took a few minutes to manually enter each garment I left into their system, but the conversation made the time pass quickly. Extraordinarily friendly employees made the experience delightful. I'll certainly be back!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Very good food, with great prices! The food makes you feel as if you are at a more upscale restaurant, but it's so casual that you almost have to do a double-take. I eat here at least once a week and alway get great service with great tasting food!! I suggest the Tribeca White with mushrooms...the black bean soup is very good too.

Well located for Tampa Convention Centre, and not far from a TECO Streetcar stop.

Generally in good decorative and maintenance order.

But too many minor service "niggles" (frequently with different staff members giving diametrically opposed advice!) to warrant a more favourable review ...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Had a great experience from start to finish. We were sat at our table quick and courteous, our siracha bacon appetizer was amazing. I had the fish special and my husband had the meat special, both were outstanding! Throw that on top of great Service and Botto's becomes an instant favorite.

The house band is awesome! Funk, jazz and even some R&B. Lead singer, saxophonist is a real showman!  You'll be lured in and before you know it you'll be out on the dance floor. They also have an accessible balcony for those looking to give away a few extra beads over Bourbon St.

Both Dr's Dose were very professional and knowledgeable. They took care of my baby girl, Felicity, who is my first female dog. They told exactly what to expect from the surgery and even called me to let me know when the surgery was complete, to let me know she was OK and just resting until the agreed 5pm pick up time.

Best thing was price at $45-50 per night.  It's fairly clean but super outdated.  Tiny bathrooms and old style TVs.  The offer a breakfast but it isn't much and it ends at 9am.
The employees seemed very friendly and no one from our team mentioned having any issues.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place is a great bar.  Especially if you want to get shot.  It is one of the only places in Chestnut Hill that really make you feel like you will probably get shot while you are there.  It's lousy, disgusting, depressing, and full of drug addicts.  A cesspool.

They make a great cup of coffee here as well as espresso and soy chai tea latte. Nice selection of teas and the staff is always friendly. Just wish they had some vegan pastry options but the bagels are good here as well. Upstairs offers a nice place to chill with your cup of joe!

I know they have some bad reviews but i had great service. I was running late because my meeting lasted longer than planned. I called them and they waited until I arrived,  two minutes after closing on a Friday night. They were friendly and quick (they wanted to get going as much as i did). The car was ready and ran great.

Meh, reviews looked good, but after trying my cheese enchilada, it was filled with fake cheese. Gross Kraft Velveeta stuff. Then I tried the white queso over a chili rellano. Taste like a dried up egg with again fake cheese inside. Salsa was decent and can't really mess up refried beans.

Room is musty.  Hallways are in poor condition- stained carpeting, worn walls.  The gym equipment is severely aged and in need of replacement- in fact, the whole room could use an update.  It's a great location and the staff is nice, but the rooms and hallways were a far cry from what I would expect from Westin.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The food was good but a little overpriced for what you got on your plate.  Service was slow but friendly. We chose this place based on reviews so I would say try it once and form your own opinion. I ordered a long island iced tea and was told that it was premixed. I should have skipped the drink.

Really delicious pizza! We got the shrimp and crabmeat pizza and ate the whole thing. They put a good amount of shrimp and crabmeat on there with artichoke hearts. Thin, crispy crust pizza too. Cool atmosphere and looks like they are adding a patio with TVs.

Sushi is okay. Nothing too write home about but about what I expected for Boise. The all you can eat special is good if you get exactly what you want and don't have left overs. I got nigiri because they don't offer sashimi and was charged for not eating the rice...lame. Will say the seaweed salad is great!

Service is solid.  Food is solid.  Ambiance is meh.  I bring the family here for easy, solid mexican food with no frills.  Sometimes they have a mariachi trio playing.  I'd go closer to 3.5...seriously, if you need decent mexican food, not expensive, safe for family and don't want to cross the river to get it...this is your place.

Very good sushi. Since this place is in Somerset it takes a bit of extra effort to get there, but it is worth the extra drive. Many of the things available on AYCE at Sakana are not available as options at other AYCE sushi places in town. Service is friendly and prompt.

While the drive-thru can be slow (generally the people placing orders), the staff is awesome! Very friendly & helpful & generally quick with an order. Seating indoors & out is limited, but still enough most of the time. Can get a bit noisy because of limited space, but not too bad.

My husband and I took our neice and nephew to this location to get some ice cream. The place is really nice and clean which is always great hence the 4 stars , the staff was really nice but wanted to rush our order which is kind of annoying! But overall we will come back

I second everything Marshall H. said in his review.  The owner (Skip) came to our table, introduced himself,  and made us feel right at home.  Our waiter was great.  He was attentive, helpful, and kind. I can't wait to go back.  The food was delicious, and plentiful!

Used to be a great store. Last few visits 1 person at deli with people waiting/empty shelfs during busy times.  Limit selection of chicken on a Tuesday afternoon with the Chicken self being almost empty.  On a Sunday morning  at 10:00. Employees tying to stock shelf's with a crowded store. Not sure what change.

We ate here once after a Whataburger fiasco in OKC. The people were very friendly and the curly fries were hot and fast. Just had basic R B sandwiches, nothing fancy dined in and used the sauces. Arbys seems to be the most consistent of the fast sandwiches in my experience.
I would come back if in St louis area again.

This was our first visit! The host was courteous, the waiter, Daniel, was spot on with information and continuous service, never missing a beat (thank you!). The food was ok...for the price, I feel it could have been more fresh tasting and better presented...we didnt leave hungry but we werent necessarily satisfied.

Walts used to be one of the best steak places around. Since the remodel the steaks just aren't the same, the steaks are still decent but no where near what it once was. My suggestion to anyone who is a long time lover of walts steaks is to stay away, you will be disappointed.

Cannot say enough about the food and service tonight at Luciano's. The food is obviously cooked with expertise and caring. I am so happy to have found this little gem on the Bench in Boise! New favorite place, I think we are going to become best friends :)

Derek's has awesome crab cakes with avacado-corn rellish and half price wine bottles on Sunday's.  They have small plates so you don't have to spend a lot and can get a couple small things.  

Some bad things: The chicken quesadilla is bland and some seats are too close to other tables.

Authentic Mexican food. Fresh corn tortillas made right in front of you and the aroma of flavors made my mouth water. This small, order at the counter restaurant has fast service with decent prices and friendly, helpful staff. My husband couldn't get enough of the el pastor tacos haha. We will definitely be back.

My experience from when I walked in the door was great. My friends and I wanted to sit outside but it was full so the manager Chris bought us appetizers at the bar and quickly got us to a table outside. He came over to check on my table numerous times as well. Great experience thanks to him.

Ambience: Modern, comtemp, brightly colored tables, small close setting
Parking: Street, walkable distance
Food: Tuna tartare: 3/5 (topped w. fried string potato, yes pls), Lobster wasabi salad (topped w. maraschino cherry, no thanks) Sushi: Firecracker Roll, Liberty Roll 4/5, Fried green tea ice cream 3/5

Such a comfortable and ambient space with a great rotating selection of hand poured coffees. The service is excellent, the baristas really make an effort to get to know their customers. They remember what type of coffee I like and make tasty recommendations when the menu changes. Also the hot cider is bommmb.

They charge for a refrigerator even if it's for medication. Not sure if that is legal. The internet is SLOW SLOW SLOW so don't expect to get much done work-wise. No jacuzzi and the pool is not enclosed and closed. Not really a 3 and 1/2 star hotel as advertised in my opinion. I feel like this place isn't a good value for the money.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Love Parkway Cleaners. Always satisfied with their service. Staff is friendly and attentive, you never have to wait long to get checked in. My clothes are always ready for pick up at the stated time. I have sent rugs and comforters there as well. Nice job!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I was 20 mins late for my appointment and yet I was greeted with a warm hello - how may I help you. Shade did my twist out (first time getting them) on my tapered cut and I absolutely love it. I've been going to NY to get my hair done. I found a new home! I highly recommend This professional salon.

I got dragged here again. Once again a terrible experience, the "Dancers" thought it would be a great idea to shake up beer and then spray it all over the crowd. Nothing I enjoy more then going home smelling like beer
The bartenders suck
Bouncers suck
Forget this place

I was excited to try this place, and the food was actually very tasty.  The service was absolutely terrible.  We waited 45 minutes - 1 hour for our food, and it all came out at different times.  I paid $16 for a bowl and was very dissapointed with the portions.  I could have eaten 3 bowls.

This place has run of the mill bar food.  The best thing I've had here has been the grouper sandwich.  The vegetables I had on the side were very salty.  They have a large bar and lots of TVs.  The service has been good, but I'd rather get better food somewhere else.

Not the best stay! Getting into Parking garage was a fiasco. Had to wait 10 minutes for someone to come lift gate. The bed was extremely hard. We were woken up at 6:00 am on sunday by an alarm going off in a vacant room. Took 20 minutes for hotel to get it turned off. Overall disappointing visit.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Came here at 5 on a Sunday and they turned me away, said they were closing even though the sign on their door (and their hours on Yelp) said they close at 5:30 on Sundays. Maybe management needs to hire more workers or pay their current workers more so they can stay open according to the hours they post.

Christmas Eve we called theFry's in Sahuarita and the machine specifically says that Christmas Eve they close at 9pm. At 6pm we made time to go and they were closed. There were many others who made the trip as well and were disappointed Christmas Eve to get their last needed Christmas Day food items.

Do not go here. I came on a Tuesday for lunch and was sat at 12:15, waited without acknowledgement for 10 minutes. Another table was sat after me and they got their drinks right away. It's now 12:30 and I still have not seen anyone. I got up and left. Most ridiculous service I've ever gotten.

Mid-tier RI, looks like the last reno was around 2010.

High-floor rooms are reasonably quiet, beds are comfortable, HVAC is ok. Clean, no frills property. Breakfast is a bit worse than most RI locations. Overall quality more like a Courtyard.

Short walk to restaurants and bars on Broadway.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ok. Here's the bottom line... Cheap food and cheap drinks near the French quarter. The staff is cool and the locals are cool. No need to go anywhere else. Save your money and get drinks here. The only sad part is no draft beer. Only bottled beer. But they're local beers and cheap. Do it already. Come here.

I really wish that there was a Dunkin Donuts in the Puyallup/Graham area! Sad that they got scared out of the Northwest and California when Krispy Kreame came to the area, love they're donuts! But they're advertising really annoys me saying "America runs on Dunkin when there not in the 4 states I mention!

The Yutacan shandy was a really tasty drink. The variety of 'high end' guacamole's is pretty intriguing. Didn't enjoy the house made salsa all that much as it is very watery. Shrimp and chorizo quesadillas were pretty average and the timing and delivery of food to the table limited the ability to eat a variety of options at once.

The ladies at the front aren't the most helpful but they are very efficient at calling to remind for appts. The vets are FANTASTIC, especially Dr. Martini. She diagnosed my cat with kidney disease and high blood pressure and consistently checks up on him via visits and calls. A bit pricey but I'd say the vets are worth it.

GO to this restaurant! You will not be disappointed. Salsa is fresh, all food is fresh and very tasty. Clean and friendly atmosphere. I was in New Orleans for work and live in Arizona. This Mexican restaurant is better than most restaurants even in AZ!!! 

Don't continue to wait, go eat here and enjoy!

This place is so slow, dirty, and unprofessional.   Manager and employees had no name tags on. Fries came out burnt. Every alarm in the back was going off. They fed an employee before the customers who played before him. They were out of quit a bit of things. Every time we have been here it's been a horrible choice.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: As soon as i walked in I was greeted by the friendly cashier. However the food was overpriced and everytime ive gone the food has little to no meat. As much as they charge they should have a decent amount of meat.  If you are in the mood for mexican you ate better off going to any other place.

Stayed here for a family event last summer. Gorgeous rooftop pool. Comfortable beds in a large room with a view. The restaurants were excellent. The only downside is the parking- if you do not want to valet (we are not crazy about it), it is quite a hike to the parking garage.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Unlucky experience I hope where the meals came out wrong. But hey this happens they just make you the correct thing and your all set. Not here. They said it will take a very long time and didn't offer anything to compensate. Bad management hurts everyone. Wanted so much to like. Unfortunate.

First time here. Ordered the ribs thinking they would be bite size but they came out full size ribs. 
The ribs were mostly bone and no meat. But everything else was good. 
The staff were a little rude and can tell they didn't want to be working. 
Overall experience was mediocre.

I came to this location at about 7:45 AM and they were SLAMMED!  Even though they were hustling, every single employee greeted me with a smile as I walked in the door.. I made my order and left in less than 5 minutes! Needless to say my Friday is off to a great start! Thank you Starbucks employees !!

Anytime I'm here I stop by to get m fill of sushi and other delights. The prices are good and the staff friendly. If you want the real deal, sit at the bar and ask "what's good today"? That way you get the freshest they have. That's what they do in Japan. Oh yeah try the "Mango salmon roll" it's great and well worth it.

Absolutely amazing tacos! The pastor and carnitas are great, as well as the tamales. Another great thing they offer is a variety of salsas to put on your meal varying from mild to very hot, all of which are very flavorful, though I found the hanañero sauce to be the best.  It's a great spot for a quick lunch!

Aggressive clerks convinced me to upgrade to next big size car and charged me upgrade fee for a full extra day when I returned the car 1.5 hours after the 24 hour period. Tons of hidden charges. Ended up paying double what they quoted me and they weren't willing to prorate over 24 hours

As a travel agent, I would recommend this hotel. For a sleep over and get going the next day kind of itinerary, this hotel does its job. 
My only gripe was that our room was not ready when we were looking to check in. The people cleaning the rooms were taking there time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Great creative options with big fish portions. The Chet's are very helpful and ask if there is any sushi you'd like that you don't see on the belt. They also have a large variety of rolls. Food came with complimentary miso soup which is great! I recommend asking to try a few eel pieces

You can't go to New Orleans without getting a daiquiri. There was about a handful of people inside and I walked right in and ordered a mango flavored daiquiri, it was about $$. Initially it didn't seem like there was much alcohol in it until I was almost near the bottom. Then it hit me.

Great place to take a date or just go and have some great Japanese food.  The staff was polite the place was clean and there's lots of parking. The food was definitely delicious that I wanted more. I'll be making another stop at this place, definitely south jersey' s best kept secret.

I've been to a lot of Sarku Japan's before. From my experience this particular Sarkus serving size is really small. I always get the teriyaki chicken with double meat. Usually I would be stuffed after, however, I wasn't even full after the meal at this Sarku. The plates and to go boxes are both smaller. This was not satisfying...

As a girl from the region.. I know good pizza. I'm in LOVE with Pegasus!
Oh did I mention I don't eat dairy or meat?! Guess who has OPTIONS FOR ME!! Couldn't be happier with my BYOB vegan pizzas I've gotten so far. The quality of their food shines in the flavor. Thankful to have them so close to home!

just FYI kids are not allowed. We came here Sunday  after brunch & me & my gf wanted to get a few drinks. My husband who was not drinking was holding our 6 month old baby who was not crying or making a sound. & they told us we had to leave. No kids are allowed. Just a mom wanting to have a few drinks

Usually does good work but I have yet to go in for a repair where they did not try to sell me something else. They said my brakes needed replacement two weeks after I had them rebuilt. Need more work done but scared to go into them. They'll probably tell me I need my engine rebuilt.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Great restaurant, generous portions for lunch and fantastic service at affordable prices. Our server who I assume might have also been the owner was so friendly and kind. The meatballs and marinara were delicious as well as the strombolis. This is the best food I've had in New Jersey.

I am very picky about my hair salons. Yet, I liked this place.  Service was stellar for a Dominican salon. The place was very family oriented and the service was quick.  My hair was bouncy and great.  However, they charged me $40 for a blow-out.  That's a little on the steep side for just a blow-out.

Meh. It's okay. Ate here once and it was decent, but I wasn't compelled to come back. With all the pizza places around here, I'm surprised they stay open. It's nothing special, really. I wish we would get some better restaurants in this shopping center. At least Natural Cafe and Los Agaves are a great start.

I was conflicted on what to order. I love thin crust but my curiosity for gluten free won out. How lucky for me that it was pretty thin as well. Very fresh veggies, hot and pretty fast delivery. Slightly pricey but I did get 5 toppings on my side. I will be doing this again!

lots of great reviews, my experience, though, was pretty lackluster. the staff was very friendly, but the barber cut my hair only using electric shears and not scissors even after I specifically asked him not to - and even crazier is that I didn't get a buzz cut. I'd recommend going elsewhere.

Awesome location.   But price is set like this is a hyatt grand and it is not. 
It is a very clean hotel but it is not high end. 
They have free breakfast which is nice but not what I want specifically from my hotel.  
But this is one of the best locations in town and the hotel is very new
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Your basic Americanized Chinese food, but always hot and tasty. The Crab Rangoon are fantastic and clearly house made. The potstickers are doughier than average, but I find them quite good. The sesame chicken is always a good choice. If you're looking for a cheap, fast, tasty lunch, I suggest the Orient.

I originally asked for a glass of Sauvignon Blanc, until the bartender informed me a 6 ounce glass would be $16. ARE YOU KIDDING ME? I know it's an airport, but geez. The food was decent - I had the buffalo chicken sandwich and was glad to see it was grilled instead of fried.

Terrible customer service. Laresha was annoyed and bothered to make me a sandwich. I was greeted unhappily and then rushed through my whole order. She tossed veggies on my sandwich and was sloppy. Her attitude was disrespectful and unkind. I will not ever return here based on the customer service alone. Pitiful!

I love Sergio's, their sauce is " How grandama used to make" wonderful balance of herbs and tomato, with a hint of sweet. Very friendly service in a casual diner like atmosphere. Prices are fair to portion size, come hungry or bring some home. Would recommend! I'm a regular there.

Excellent coffee house- the latte and the maria latte (honey cinnamon) were amazing.  I'm really bummed because I wanted to try the Gulchie (vanilla, caramel, edible glitter) but I didn't get a chance.  The vibe is perfectly modern but homey, and the service was great.  Really awesome local gem.

Sloooooowwwww service.  Five minutes for first beer.  Soggy mucus-like gelatinous sugary cucumber salad.  Cold miso soup at 7:45pm on a Friday night.  Second beer for third guest never even came out.  We got up and left.  Ten minutes later at Zen in Westchase.  Drinks immediately and rolls already in the works!!

You deserve every bit of this 3 star and then some. It's all in all a very mediocre experience. The rooms are mediocre, the staff is mediocre, the breakfast is mediocre. Don't go there during an event, because they're definitely going to run up the check on you.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I've been coming here for about six months now since moving closer to the city. The staff is absolutely wonderful and consistent, even when busy. Lee and Harry are my favorite for nail appointments and Kim gives a perfect pedicure (if you want any of them, be sure to make an appointment if it's a weekend or prime hour).

I'm not sure what the problem is..maybe because I was raised on Krispy Cream these donuts are always a let down. They seem stale to me and I'm not sure who is in charge of hiring at this store but I seem to get the same lady every time and her shirt always looks filthy.

I Love This Sushi Shop!!!! Get Your Sushi and Go or Have a Seat and enjoy.... Although I Tried sitting and eating but Ended up ordering 2 more rolls! The Sushi is SOOOOO good! I Recommend the Create Your Own Roll... Also I'm a new fan of the Soy wrap over the Seaweed wrap! Try it Out!

Check the dates!! These folks know how to put a case of beer on the shelf but struggle to understand good beer doesn't keep as long as the cheap stuff they spent the last decade selling. Also, the cashier needs to question whether her personality is appropriate for a front-of-house position.

What to say? It's the Pony. Perma east Tucson fixture. Erik and Gilbert can be found bartending Thursday thru Sunday, although I don't recommend going on Sunday if you're a lady, unless you want you bits groped...in which case you're not actually a lady. Almost anyone who goes has a great time.

Freezing cold rooms and hallways! ATM never worked and the front desk refuses to call cabs for guests. There is one guy who is in charge of cabs and if he's not there they make you call one yourself.

Rooms are clean and spacious. Great TV channel selection!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The atmosphere of this place was nice. It has lot of flat screen TV's which make it an ideal place to watch sports. I've eaten there a few times. I recommend the St. Louis Sandwich. It was very good. The service is mediocre. The have a large assortment of beers on tap to choose from.

DO NOT COME HERE. They will take advantage of you, basic things like putting new tires on the rear, they did not do and we had to ask. One of the service men driving out our call was super aggressive -- slammed on the acceleration and brakes as if he wanted to break our car!!! 

SCARY PLACE, BAD SERVICE, DO NOT USE.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Like many of the reviews here, good luck trying to cancel your account. I have tried MULTIPLE times to cancel my account with this place and each time, I'm told I'll receive a confirmation email or return call and never do. I'm still being charged and I'm not even in the state anymore! Absolutely ridiculous.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Great hotel.....didn't mind that the structure is dated.....large clean rooms.....great staff...great west side location....lobby check-in was under remodeling but temporary check in was fast and efficient....price range was moderate because I received a 40% off regular rate through travelocity....
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Dinner took over 2.5 hours. Two tables that came in after us received their food before we even got our starters. Meat was way over cooked, pasta and mashed potatoes were cold. Customer service was poor and two requests to speak to a manger were ignored. Will not visit again.

Decent place considering there isn't many other bars in the immediate area. Kind of an older crowd early in the night then younger people come out later. If you live in the area and don't want to trek out to South Tampa or Downtown then I'd suggest Linksters.

Worst customer service ever! I can't believe these ppl have jobs! Where are the owners and ppl who represent what this company use to stand for...... Class a cut above the rest! Now I might as well go to joeys to rent a car I'm sure I'd get great service there!!

CLEAN and exceeded my expectations.  If you sign up for their point system, you are immediately eligible for an upgrade.  My friend and I stayed here and asked for one room with 2 beds.  They ended up giving us 2 ROOMS connected by a door with our separate beds and bathrooms.  It was awesome.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Last night me and 3 friends visited the salon for the first time. When we arrived they had everything ready for us for our mani's & pedi's. We had such a nice time and the nail techs were so friendly! Prices were very reasonable and I will definitely go back! I highly recommend!

I am in Marriott gold reward card holder, so I always stay on Marriott properties. This property is OK, nothing special, the staff are friendly, it's a bit loud in the hall, but other than that it's OK. I try to stay away from the elevators because it's so noisy, but is twice as loud near this door where I am.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Awesome hotel. Huge swimming pool, friendly guests and staff, great location, can't beat the price. Would recommend to anyone trying to have a fun weekend getaway at a bargain without staying in a dump. Four stars and shout out to the drunken lady at the pool with her five minute comedy roast of her husband- made the trip!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Two stars because the food was hot.  This restaurants owner should be ashamed. The inside was just short of disgusting.  Sticky floors and spilled liquid around the trash bins.  Trash everywhere.  If I weren't starving, I would gone next door to Sonic or the chicken place.

The slowest McDonalds I've ever been too. At first, I thought they were super busy, but once I got to the window, I saw that they don't even attempt to move at a normal speed, to the point where you can drop down and do 10 push ups and they are still trying to find the cup for your coffee.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Ken's has great quality sushi and we enjoyed it. But it is in an older building that needs some renovation, and the parking lot was unlit and filled with people loitering. I live nearby and would go back during the daytime but I was frankly worried for my safety after dark.

The baristas are pretty nice, sometimes, but they have no concept of food safety. They're constantly touching their hair or bare bellies before making my drinks. Today I got a hot chocolate that was barely lukewarm. I ended up throwing it in the trash, and that's $4 I'll never get back. I won't be coming back here ever again.

A great place to get raspados and tostitos based tosti locos. The raspados are delicious and I sometimes stop here on my way home. There are many options for raspados in this area but for raspados solely, this is one of my favorites. I wish they would expand to more food options.

Not impressed with this place at all. Wasn't very busy when we visited the Happy Cow but our service was less than average. Found the place a little on the run down side. Nothing really special about what we ordered. Cows all over restaurant looked a bit dirty and kinda overwhelming.

The food portions are obnoxious (in a good way), the quality of the food is to be noted. I LOVE their miso soup, it's so good! Excellent selection of vegetarian and vegan rolls and the intimate environment when you dine in reminds me of many nights out in New York City. Definitely recommend checking them out!

This place is pretty good. I like the atmosphere. The man at the desk was not as friendly as I would have liked but the women who did my pedicure was nice. The parking is also limited. I would come back but I am going to visit a few more salons before coming back.

Nice facility, and a reasonable price! The equipment is all nice and functional, and I've never had anyone bother me during a workout. Tanning beds may be a little weak, but they're about the same that you can find in most gyms. The staff is friendly and remembers your name! No complaints here, I just need to go more often!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Celebrated National Margarita day here.  The service was extremely slow.  If you like long and I mean long lunches this is the place for you.  2 1/2 hours to eat a meal is a little long.  The Drinks took forever to come as well.  Probably will not visit this On the Border again.

My date and I came here and after careful consideration, decided on ordering the $39 platter. It came with 32 pieces of sushi and featured several delicious rolls! The kamikaze being my favorite! The sever was patient with us and did not rush us out if the restaurant since we had stayed a little after hours.

This was my absolute favorite Chinese take out place.. I didn't know they changed ownership, but the food you receive there now is just like any "New York style" Chinese food.. Very disappointed. The previous owner proudly boasted about having traditional Cantonese recipes... This is worlds away from what it was.

So much fun and yum! This spot combines cereal and ice cream to make a delicious treat. The venue is great with hanging swings and if you're not craving ice cream the are attached to a cookie dough spot. We were pleasantly surprised by how good the cotton candy, pop rocks and lucky charms combo was. Highly recommend.

All You Can Eat sushi!!  Went on a Sunday evening and it wasn't crowded.  Staff was attentive and sushi chef was able to make sushi quickly.  Sushi was fresh and delicious.  It was a little strange that it was hidden inside a Mexican restaurant, but we would are planning on returning.

I usually don't like Mexican food, but this place is awesome. I loved the farmers cheese taco the best! The veggie burrito or the Chipotle chicken was also amazing!! The potato taco / chili burrito were okay and we're basic or too much chili. But overall it tasted amazing for the majority! Just order the right thing :D

Excellent service, food was served in less than 15 minutes during lunch hour. I ordered a snow crab salad, it was served with asparagus and avocado slices, I also enjoyed the King Cake roll with coconut shrimp and toasted almonds, I wish the cream cheese wasn't as overpowering but otherwise great roll. Awesome experience.

Lions Choice is back in Illinois!  And my first visit today (at the old Tim Hortons location) was worthy!  Awesome, tender roast beef, wonderful fries, and a dipped cone. What could be better!?   Welcome back ... feel the ROAR!  Oh ... and it's got the coolest dining room AND IT SERVES BREAKFAST!!!

Has to be my favorite Mexican place on page! I love their green salsa and their chicken nachos! Their tortas are also very delightful!! Usually pretty fast service and  friendly!! Kind of a smaller place but so good they also have a Mexican grocery store right next door which is really neat!!

went with a large business group. We selected our meals earlier that day so they were prepared for us starting from our salad choices. Very fast & courteous service. The lasagna portions were HUGE..more than I could finish but very good. Not sure about the prices since we didn't see a regular menu.

Publix is the best supermarket around. Period. Shopping truly is a pleasure here- it's clean, huge, well-lit, everyone is always so helpful... They really go above and beyond to make your shopping experience a positive one. I hate that I'm living up north currently and have to settle for way inferior grocery stores.

This particular location has terrible service most the time. When they are probably staffed or have capable experienced employees, I would recommend. But that isn't very often. Mostly during mornings hours. Even though they are less busy than the Starbucks in the area, you will spend more time in the drive thru here.

Service with a smile! Knowledgable and pleasant staff who took the time to explain what services I needed. The wait time quoted was accurate and the price was fair for what I had done. The waiting room leaves a bit to be desired but hey it's a garage. Great bunch of guys work here and it's a pleasure to see them.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Futura Car Wash update: I filed a complaint with the Better Business Bureau and this place has yet to respond. The BBB even gave them a time extension. They have until tomorrow to respond.  It seems that once Futura has your (and my) money, that that's all they care about. 

I will continue to post updates.

We have been coming to this dry cleaners for over a year now. Great service and very nice people. The owner is very personable and polite. She even took time to remember our name. We come at least once a week and have never had a problem. We are very appreciative. Thank you!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Coworkers and I usually split a pizza and a cheese steak. Couldnt see the cheese in the sandwich but was mixed i  with the meat. Can't beat fresh bread toasted in the oven! Got the fra diavolo by mistake (devil hot), couldn't finish it but still good. Good service.

This place was slammed, an hour long wait to get our car. Their system were freezing and acting up. I'm sure the staff was screaming in their heads, "what in the fresh hell is this???? But guess it's not their fault. 
Jarred was kind, held it down, calm under pressure despite it all. That's why the 5 star review. Thanks Enterprise!

Went here for the first time and was extremely disappointed!! ALL the food on the buffet we tried was cold. Hardly warm at all. Was also very stale tasting. We will NEVER be going back. This place also gave me food poisoning because they do not properly care for their food.

We were greeted by a very friendly gentlemen named Lindsey. He helped us choose a good wine and beer and off we went. The chicken wings were good, the Florence pizza was great, and the Diablo sandwich was AMAZING! Marriage material. Very good deal and great location for non locals because it's on the streetcar route.

Came here for a seminar , great hotel , beach view , pool beach view and staff is extremely nice and caring.  The beds are comfortable and the rooms are beautiful . The room had patio doors overlooking pool and beach. Small kitchen area in the living room . Overall stunning !
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I would give this place a 3.5 stars. The service was great but food was okay. Nothing that I left with that was memorable. The bruschetta and eggplant parm were good. Their desserts were above average, especially the chocolate bread pudding was really good.

Amazing food and amazing service!!! Took pics of our meals but ate most of them before I could even post. Loved the portion sized. We had the beef ravioli and caprese appetizers. Both delicious. My pesto pasta was perfectly cooked and flavored. I'm in town for work for and I'm so glad I picked this spot for dinner!

I used to love this place. The pedicure went up in price and down in quality. Barely included massage, if you could call it that, in the pedicure. It was more of a rubbing of lotion on the legs. The nail trim wasn't even very good, leaving the nails too long when I asked for shorter. Polish is uneven. Won't be going back

we love joeys but i was very disappointed that the owner / manager wouldn't budge on his decision to charge us 60 dollars for a bottle of wine that's under 20 dollars at B-21.. I'm ready to pay double but triple ???? He obviously could care less when we knows if we stop eating there,
they have a hundred people behind us that will.

Just reopened a few days ago in their new location. The acoustics make it very loud in the restaurant. The pizza was pretty good but I don't think I would come for the pizza. I like another local place for that. I will be back to try some of their pasta dishes and I'll update my review then

Overall a good experience, the shop could use some sprucing up.  The business wasn't buy at all, and the prices are comparable to other shops which I wasn't expecting given the location.  I am pleased with the way my mani/pedi turned out and I plan on returning.

I had a lot of laundry built up because my washer broke and I had been too busy for a laundromat. They took my clothes no problem, were so sweet and when I went to go pick it all up it was so neatly done and wonderful I'm having a hard time living up to their standards now. And so inexpensive!!!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
They gave me the wrong order, but the one I got was really good and flavorful! I ordered peppered chicken and onions. I got chicken in a sauce with onions and green peppers. The egg roll was really good as well. Pretty good cheap Chinese food.
Will order again.

The food is good, I'll give them that. Everything else needs work. When I called to place an order the other day, I was told 20-25 minutes. I got there 25 minutes later and STILL had to wait another 25 minutes until it was ready. That experience has soured me on Happy's.

This hit the sweet spot! All of their flavors are super unique and a lot of love goes into it. It's a cute little shoppe - we loved trying some of the flavors before buying. I settled on the gooey butter cake flavor which was SPECTACULAR! Yummy chewy chunks in a beautiful vanilla base. Friendly staff, clean place. Don't miss it!

Friendly staff and very efficient!! It's always nice to be greeted by a genuine smile and warm welcome...and I truly felt that when I walked through the door. Very clean and very well maintained store. The baristas were quick on the feet to get the orders out, which is always an accomplishment.

This is a really nice clean hotel with.  Pulled in here on the last leg of a huge road trip.  The room was huge!  Very clean and the beds were really comfortable.  The complimentary breakfast in the morning was your usual fare but everything was fresh and clean.   Would totally stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Sea Hags was an easy spot for a late dinner at the beach. Luckily, there was no line...and no waiting.  But, that was probably because there isn't anything special about the place.  For being an empty restaurant, the service was lacking.  The drinks tasted like cheap Applebee's knockoffs.  The food wasn't much better.

The location is really cute, but for someone who likes good tasting coffee black, this isn't the place to go. However if you are the type to drown coffee in sugar and creamer to make it a milkshake, you will be very happy here. They did have a nice kombucha section, and it wasn't too carbonated which is a plus (for me at least).

Can't deny the view. But the food and drinks are Applebee's level. The pasta says house made... but it's definitely from the box. The shrimp tacos were definitely frozen shrimp and not de-thawed correctly so they were rubbery. Come for the location and order well drinks and fried food.

By far the worst pizza I have ever had. Not 1 redeeming quality including having to wait 45 minutes for it to be made. I am baffled as to how anybody else rated it higher. I don't know what sauce and cheese they use but it is most certainly not Italian. Never never again.

This place is great for lunch! They make sushi rolls fast - the volcano roll is amazing - shrimp tempura topped with spicy tuna!! Just an FYI though, they don't take AMEX which was annoying since I was traveling for work... Also, it is in the mall food court so perfect if people can't agree on what to eat!

The live band today was awesome! Enjoyed some adult beverages taking in the Bourbon St. NOLA atmosphere. Drinks are reasonable and there was no cover charge when we went on Sunday afternoon!   Check this place out if you are +21 during the day on the weekend if you don't care for the nightlife crowd, which can be a bit raunchy.

Every time I come to this location I get sugar at the bottom of my iced coffee. Who wants to take their first sip of iced coffee chock full of sugar?? Nobody!! I even asked them to saturate the sugar and they never do...I gave them three chances and they failed me...never going back there again.

Disappointing and food quality did not meet expectation. The shrimp tempura was poorly cooked.  Spicy tuna tasted not fresh.   Tempura sauce tasted too much vinegar.  Worst Japanese Food I have in Nashville.  There is a sign that you must leave a tip. If not, you will get charged for 15% tip unless you pay cash.

My poor review is for the policies at Scotia. You can't deposit cheques unless you are at your own branch.  They do not accept bank drafts as cash, which they are.

Also, with TD being open til 8, and open 7 days a week, why is this bank only open till 4 most days?

Nice place.  Good music.
Clean safe environment.
Had my brother-in-law's birthday celebration there.
 But the food: The crab dip was good but we ran out of chips asked for more and thay said it would be 2$ more who does that???Hot wing weren't done We return them thay didn't have anymore. The drinks were good.

The atmosphere was beautiful..
The drinks were Made well
Was not impressed by the food..
The hot wings were not good.. Complained about Them . Was told we could purchase more..
Order the crab dip. Wasn't enough chips Ask for more was told we could get more for two more dollars.
Ask to speak to the manager he never came over.

This might be the worse, no it is the worse dry cleaner ever.  Ridonkuously expensive. Never open and they don't care if you are there or not.  My guess is this is a front for something else or they are wealthy and do this for the write off. Cause it isn't to actually dry clean. They simply don't care.  DO NOT GO HERE.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Stopped by last night for a late bite before the movies. Best decision ever. Had the vegetable tarted flambé. To describe it in one word amazing. I haven't been in since before the remodel and it looks gorgeous. The food and decor make you forget you are in Wilmington.

HORRIBLE.  This place came highly recommended to me so I eagerly went. Marcos was on his cell phone the entire time while cutting my hair, and my haircut ended up crooked!! Do not go here.  When you're spending this much $$ on a haircut, you deserve to go somewhere where the person gives you 100% of their attention.

Cheap and really close to downtown by car--that's it. If that's all you need to be happy, then you're all set! Don't expect anything more or you will be sorely disappointed. A convenient place to lay down your head with money left over to blow around town.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Love love love this place. The two guys that work there are so kind and helpful. You can tell they really care about their customers. I'm very suspicious of the bad review on here as I've been there dozens of times and have never had anything but a great experience

I have had their pizzas in the past, but lately I have just been ordering their salads. I did enjoy a freshly made greek salad with a good portion of feta cheese, tomatoes, onions, and olives served on a fresh bed of lettuce!!

It tasted great and was made fresh to order!  I will return for another great salad anytime!

The most horrifying experience I have ever had in any medical situation human or animal. This is a corporate business with corporate mentality. I will make certain to communicate to every pet owner I know to seek other services from professionals. This establishment is no part of professional nor compassionate. Inhumane.

Good for a froyo fix. I've had better but I've also had worse. They had toasted coconut, which I love but they were lacking fresh fruit. They have free parking out back but make sure you get a ticket from the machine, we got a citation because we didn't have one on the dash.

All the coin machines were taped over; no way to get change. We drove all the way there for this specific style of car wash & discovered this major hang up. Drove down the road & gladly spent $13 for a drive through car wash with free vacuums. Tropical's loss.

Best breakfast sandwiches in the world! I know there are a million Starbucks in Indianapolis but I always go to this one just for one reason , Rowan. Rowan is the manager at this location . I had an issue and he immediately took care of it . Amazing customer service ! Also super fast drive thru!

Clean and comfort, there is kitchenware for some cooking. Big couch in the living room as an extra bed is very good. The only negative was breakfast never been enough for the guests and little improper manner of staffs. Overall, still good to stay over nights.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Nice new hotel. Great breakfast buffet offering that comes with room.  Staff is very nice and helpful.  Location is perfect to Broadway, Riverfront, dining, and Titan Stadium.  June 2015 there is a bit of construction to look at and hear but it was not distracting enough to be concerned.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I love this place, and every year I request a fudgy the whale cake for my birthday from this location. The owner is always extremely nice, and the experience is consistent with what you would expect from a Carvel. Nice, clean shop with good ice cream. Im sure I will be back soon.

Vo is the best nail spot in Tampa. Im not sure what they do differently here but my pedicures last at least 4 weeks without chipping, and im rough on my polish! At other places I would be lucky if I got 2 weeks out of my polish. Tan is the best for pink and white, he is fast and always does a great job. I highly recommend!

The noodles were way overcooked in the lo mein and there wasn't much flavor. The crab puffs were gross and while the potstickers had a good flavor, one of them was really burnt.  We just moved and our last neighborhood had an awesome chinese place, so maybe I'm just spoiled. On the plus side, it was very inexpensive.

Had a sick puppy. They got me in within the hour and it was one of the best priced vet visits I have ever paid for! The ladies were all so friendly and even called a few days later to check up on him, I recommend this place to anyone who needs to take their pet to the vet!!!

Great food, go there hungry, as the portions are a fair size. Private and cozy patio, the food was very flavorful, service was awesome! Price point, it was well priced, due to the portion sizes that you receive.I would recommend this restaurant to others and would return again myself... would like to try the lunch menu next time.

I would give this 0 stars if I could. Spring break week and they closed at 11:15 PM. Online it says they're open until 1 AM. Absolutely ridiculous service, just because they just wanted to go home earlier. I would recommend never going here. It's terrible.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
HOLY COW!  Now I see what everyone has been talking about.  My belly and butt wish we hadn't tried it as I can't wait to go back.  I got there at a good time - 12:30 on a Saturday and there weren't many folks there.

The place was SUPER clean...spotless!  The attendant was helpful and informative AND my dessert was DELISH!!!

Very disappointed with the service this morning around 7:30. They have at least 5 people working drive thru and 2 people serving everyone in side. The young lady making my coffee was extremely slow and did not seem like she wanted to be there. My coffee was bitter. I am not happy whatsoever.

The most bland, flavorless cardboard Chinese food I've ever had. I'm new to the Tampa Bay Area and decided to try Taste of China based off their star rating. Comparing this to "average" or "every other" Chinese delivery restaurant's food is an insult to ever other Chinese restaurant out there. Won't ever order again.

This place is just fantastic.  It's hip and casual and located in a great part of town.    It's a play on Mexican street food with familiar dishes turned trendy.  Every thing we tried was great, so I'd explore it all, but the crispy fish tacos can't be missed!  Oh, and they have mexican style street corn...mmmmm.

For a buffet place this place is good. It's typical "okay" buffet food. 
On a Friday night this place was almost packed. Some of the dishes were GREAT. I loved the chicken and mushroom, and lomein. Most was pretty fresh. 

It was just under 20 for two people. Decent buffet, would eat again

I love the down home vibes this dealership gives, the customer service was excellent. This is a smaller dealership so I made sure to book an appointment. Bob was my sales guy and he told me about how this Volvo is the 3rd oldest Volvo dealer in the US! Overall great experience and they always set you up with the right expectation!

A quaint, refurbished historic hotel in the downtown area close to a variety of dining and shopping options. As such, there's a daily parking fee of $16 for your stay should you wish to park on-site (and why would you not.) Rooms are on the small side, yet nicely furnished. You're definitely paying for location, location, location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
My boyfriend and I only have a limited number of days in NOLA, so I have been trying to stuff myself with all the beignets I can eat!

This location is less crowded than the original location, but the beignets taste just as fresh and delicious nonetheless. And the views and clean dining area are an added bonus!

The breakfast burritos are excellent, as is the hot salsa which they charge extra for. However, every time I've been I have terrible.service from a snotty young girl. I am a customer and should not be treated like I am inconveniencing the staff for supporting their business. 2 thumbs up on food, 2 thumbs down on service.

These are amazing tacos. Wow. We are traveling from Boston to Virginia and stopped here as we found it on yelp along the way. Big miss not to visit this place. Amazing. 
Great salsas and great speedy service. Well done. 

Wish we had something like this around us.

Had an amazing stay here, the room is very clean and quiet. The staff were helpful and friendly. They have a basketball court, indoor pool, laundry room and cardio room. There are a lot of attractions nearby, within driving distance of course. I look forward to staying here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've been here a few times now and have pretty much tried every stylist (except Joe!). I can honestly say that I love them all and have never left feeling disappointed or unhappy. I just left an appointment with Sydni and she did exactly what I wanted. I walked out feeling confident and beautiful. Will definitely keep coming back!

This is the worse Rally's location. If you have about 30 minutes to burn then you will have no problem. Everytime I go here I have to wait at least 20 minutes for food. You are better off going to the location near best buy, they are faster and friendlier.

Pricy tacos, but you won't have this type of tacos nowhere in town. The portobello, the cauliflower and all the tacos are fantastic. The guac and chips, the salsa and everything the offer in the menu is delicious. If you want to try something different then Bartaco is the place to go!

I've come to this place for over 10 years. The owner is very nice and always remembers friendly faces. I recommend the pizza above everything else. Nice, easy, cozy place to just relax and grab a bite. It's not far from the local schools so expect kids to be in the place.

I've always loved Italian food and I'm so glad IV's finally got one!

The pasta are all great, but what's REALLY sensational was the Sorriso Nutella. YUMMM. It's literally just nutella with dough, but it's good. I can get it all day every daaaay. The owners are a couple and they're super nice! Good place to eat.

The room was clean and the beds were very comfy. The front desk staff were polite at check in. I won't stay here again because although they have a freebie type hotel breakfast sat up it doesn't come with the room it's an additional $12.99 per person and coffee is $3.22 per cup
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I only stayed one night. It met all of our needs. The staff was friendly. Room was very clean, bathroom clean as well. We had a room right on the first floor and was able to park right out front. Great price. About 20 minutes away from Philadelphia and RIGHT off of the NJ TURNPIKE exit4.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My tire popped after hitting a curb. I saw the reviews and decided to give them a call. They were so nice on the phone and even nicer in person! Quick, painless, and honest folks. Hopefully I don't need them again too soon but I definitely would recommend them based on my short interaction!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Been going here since I was an awkward teen, but the water ice continues to hang with the cool crowd. Great service, great ice cream, event better water ice. Rita's who? Come to Joe's and try their Joe of the Jungle flavor! Slap some ice cream on top and you got yourself a perfect date.

Just your average subway. Good fast food. Don't even think about going to lunch from about 12 to1 pm Monday through Friday during the school year. It is one of the high school hotspots, and you will be waiting at least twenty minutes for a simple fast-food sub sandwich

Don't worry with the other reviews.  The inside is clean and the service is fantastic.  Food was delicious.  I tried the curry croquettes as an appetizer and they were pure perfection.  I had the lunch special of two rolls and seaweed salad.  Everything was fresh and tasty.

Mediocre Japanese food. Nabeyake Udon was served too hot to touch for about 10 minutes, by which time all ingredients were soggy and over-cooked. Broth was watery and not flavorful.
Service was OK but waiter didn't clear the empty sushi plate and did not offer an alternative when I complained about the udon. Would not recommend.

Service is friendly but the food is not that good. Baked lasagna is small and soupy. The baked rigatoni is absolutely disgusting. Bland as bland gets. You pay $12 for noodles, sauce, and cheese. The white sauce is pretty plain too. I don't think I will be back. The food is a rip off.

As far as fast food joints go this was not that bad. Though there was a pipe sticking out of the building when we went to the drive through which was a bit concerning. 

Also they didn't give us any onions, when we asked for extra onions! But the burger was alright, and the lady who gave us our food was nice.

The last 3 times I have gone there, my order has been incorrect and it seems to take forever to get a simple order. 
Today, I specifically ordered an iced coffee with Splenda and stated 2x NO sugar. 
Wouldn't you know--I have a lb of sugar accumulated on the bottom of my cup.

They are awesome! Great prices. Best fried rice in town. I am in love with the crab Rangoon at sushi cafe, I always get them when I go. The staff is so helpful and friendly, I haven't had a bad experience yet in over 20 visits. The sushi tastes fresh, and they don't mind if you have special requests on how to make your sushi.

Sad but true..this place certainly didn't pull through.  The service was crappy, and kept giving us the wrong rolls.  They ran out of high chairs.  They argued us when we said what we ordered.. They need to learn all about service and pleasing custumers. Won't be back here again!!

This is the DD that is in my town. It is one of the best I have been to. The employees are friendly, and when they get to know you sometimes you get a free donut or coffee! I would only give a DD a three, but this one get an extra star because I am biased towards it.

It's exactly my rating, okay. They give you a lot of food but it definitely is a fast food Italian type restaurant. The pasta is pretty bland but it is nice to have fast and filling Italian food rather than the fancy restaurants sometimes. That being said, you get what ya pay for.

The staff here has no clue what's going on, ever. I've Been here three times now and every time something has been wrong with my order. I get the same thing every time I go, but always pay a different price. I love Dunkin coffee but I will not be getting it from this location ever again.

This was my first time staying here and from seeing the interior, I like it. Nice interior, tv is great; my only issue was that the there are no late-check outs, and the guests had to leave around 11am whether they're staying for more nights or not. But great furniture.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I came her for my birthday brunch ....the server knew it was! Not only did my order not come out in time but the manager said to the waiter that it would take another 20-30 minutes! Then when I went to pay.....they didn't offer to take anything off the check! Not even 5$. AWFUL!

Filthy sauna/pool area. Moldy walls, stinking, standing water.  Men's showers are dirty and in disrepair.  Complaints to staff and management do nothing. State Street location much better. Goodby IAC, hello Axiom.
Read the "not recommended" reviews for the REAL low down on IAC.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Went for lunch with people from work. Italian Wedding soup was more broth then anything with minimal flavor. Had the Gnocchi Vodka and it was terrible. The gnocchi were so mushy and flavor less. Only good thing about the meal was the garlic bread! I will not be returning to this place.

Meh.. they only have one flavor of donut and super sweet toppings. Service was not great. Came in with my daughter one day said it was our first time. I had to pull teeth to get the woman behind the counter to tell me how it works. Over priced donuts and terrible service.. I don't think they will be there long..

I'm so unimpressed by this coffee bar. Both mine and my partner's drinks tasted like disgusting tap water. No joke. I didn't even take a third sip, it was terrible. I am a big fan of Ike's, but this location is not up to standard. I'll be sticking with my nice downtown location.

Ordered a pizza here for lunch on friday, close to 1PM.  My mother-in-law thought it was taking too long and told me to call them back. I tried to call but no one answers. I looked at the menu and it says they close from 1-2pm on friday. Over and hour, later we get our pizza. It was not even warm.

Cute small pizza spot.  Delicious crust, thin and crispy. We ordered 3 pizza salad combos, salads were fresh and delicious and the slices were hot and huge.  The sauce was a bit bland but otherwise all was good.  service was good but the waitress was very flustered. Worth stoping in if you are in Green Valley.

Great place to shop. Very friendly staff and usually well stocked. Much more peaceful shopping experience than Walmart. Lines are usually not long. Sometimes deli gets our call-ahead order wrong but they make it right. Love the coupon system. Gas stations are clean and easy to access, especially the new one.

This store has a huge variety of liquor and wine. There is a cooler with other beverages of choice to mix drinks. They sell lottery tickets too! The staff is always very friendly and accommodating. I've felt like a member of the family for many years! Give them a visit!

Love this place. Not expensive, friendly staff, quick service. True Mexican Food.  I would give it 5 stars but they can seem to work cashier. Once I showed them a 10% coupon from foursquares and they didn't put it in. The second time - they charged me twice for a burrito. Didn't notice it until I got my statement.

We have stayed at this hotel multiple times and never had an issue. This last time will be our last. The staff was completely new and very unfriendly. Our room was more expensive and it was close to impossible to check in even though we were in a hurry.  The AC didn't work in the room either. We won't be coming back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Absolutely delicious!  I had Swiss chocolate almond, husband enjoyed raspberry truffle, and my son had pumpkin.  We all loved our selections and can't wait to go back to sample other flavors. The only reason for four stars instead of five was due to being a cash only establishment (with fairly high prices), and lack of seating.

I've been here a couple times. It's always great!! I had the House Omelette the last time and it was fantastic. There was a little bit of a wait, but it was hopping on a Saturday afternoon. I try to come here whenever I'm in Tampa. I recommend it to anyone who wants great food at a sensible price, and really friendly staff!!!!

Garlic Cheese Bread is my go-to appetizer as it sets the mood for either a deep-dish or thin crust pizza. Go with former if you're looking for more filling meal and since I love meat the Mighty Meat really hit the spot with sausage, ham, pepperoni and bacon.

We LOVE Ooka! Service is friendly and well-timed. Drinks are great. Food is so delicious! Ambiance is cozy and modern. Moderately priced. We always dine in their "regular dining" area, but they have hibachi too. I haven't experienced that enough to comment though. At any rate, definitely go -- best sushi in the area by far!

Ordered basic cheese pizza delivered for first time, via GrubHub.  Delivery went just fine, but the pizza tasted very cheap, mushy pasty sauce, like grade school pizza, slimy fake-tasting greasy cheese, like re-heated Schnuck's frozen pizza.  I just really didn't like it.  =(

I just bought my car here for the first time. This shop is great. The communication was really good. They send you a really thorough questionnaire before you come in, which is very helpful. I wasn't expecting such honesty after having bad luck at a few other shops, and I really appreciated that, it's refreshing. Thank you!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
The Asian lady that owns the cleaners is really really rude. Do not take offense to it. It's just how she is. 

Unfortunately these yelp reviews mean nothing to her. She doesn't know or care. I'm looking for another cleaner where my business is appreciated it. They don't do good work and when I confronted her, she was rude.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Great beer selection and cozy atmosphere. Stopped in here for a pint while waiting for our table at Port Of Call around the corner. The locals were friendly and the house dogs were too. (Yes, there are actually dogs who just chill on the floor by the door). Always will make it a point to stop here anytime I'm in town.

Jackpot, Geisha, and Po-Boy rolls are amazing - to die for. Also, their Seafood Yaki Soba is different than usual japanese restaurants in that it had a hint of cayenne pepper that makes it delicious!
I moved out of New Orleans, but still visit Origami every time I Come to see my parents.

The bloody Mary looked NOTHING like the picture by another patron. Tasted great  but it definitely needs all those amazing olives pickers etc. Currently out of scallops and crab cakes. The snapper was tasty though! A little pricey for the portion. Service was great! Very friendly staff.

We went here on thanksgiving night, we are from Orlando. Overall it was a nice place very busy, which seems like they didn't expect that. We sat inside due to the cold. Our server Renee was great very honest! We both had the shrimp tacos and they were great!

Awful. Just awful. The worst part is, they don't care that they're awful. Received a quarter pounder that was stone cold. Asked for a replacement and the manager refused. Simply because I had already eaten some. Ridiculous. They've lost my money for life. I wish they would go bankrupt.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Great location....lousy service. Sometimes their credit card machine is down. Sometimes they run out of items. Frequently, including today...nobody answers at the drive thru at 11PM despite it advertised as open 24 hrs.  Thankfully, Wendy's is nearby...though a less convenient location.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Came to get a "slice" as the name of the establishment implies, however there were no non-meat options! I ended up having to order a whole pie.. I chose the Florentine, which is a white pizza with spinach and tomato. Super tasty and crunchy crust. Would definitely try coming again!

Second meal in a week. Last week had delivered. Tonight went inside and ordered. Food has gotten progressively worse. Hot and Sour soup was neither.  It was lukewarm, had consistency of gelatin and tasted awful. Egg rolls not cooked all the way. Triple Crown had no taste. Delivered food was cold and tasteless. I won't go back.

I know it's another McDonald's but a group of 6 of us stopped on a busy Sunday morning. Service was a little slow but considering how busy they were it was expected. Food was hot and the order was correct. Everyone who worked there was very polite and helpful. Great customer service!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Great prices, friendly service and a vast selection. Easy to get to and plenty of parking. Open later than most on Fridays and Saturdays. Even has good hours on Sunday. Definitely my go-to spot. Cups, pong balls, ice, limes, taps, anything you really need they have it.

Every time we come we get the wings & cheese fries which are great the only reason I gave it 3 stars is because the wait time is horrible always! In store is about 30-45 mins so I can't imagine delivery wait time! But still give them a try if your patience can deal with the wait time because the wings are pretty good!

From my initial phone call to the drop off and pick up, it was a truly exceptional experience. 
I needed same day service and they got it done with the most receptive and friendly service I've ever experienced at a dry cleaner, let alone most businesses!

Thank you!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Love this place. Perfect for all occasions. Staff is great and knowledgeable and its definitely upscale service. Large menu with plenty of options to choose from.
