While the few dishes I've tried from here were yummy (chicken parm and lobster mango salad) I go back mostly for the beautiful scenery both inside and out.

Good, casual dining pub. Lots of TVs showing various sports, friendly staff, live music and decent pub fare. 

The steamed clams were a little on the small side, and the sour cream that came with the nachos was oddly bland. Oh, and no beach view if that's what you were looking for. 

All in all, few complaints for a good pub meal.

Nothing like drunk zza on a Saturday night. There was a fairly long line out here on a brisk night, but it moved along quickly. I was anxious for some great pizza, but it only turned out to be OK.

As I am wont to do, I had the plain ol pepperoni slice. It wasn't worth the cost, but ya know, sometimes you just gotta eat.

Smells funny in there, they have icky looking carpet so I'm sure that's the culprit. Service is slow and the place just feels dated. Had breakfast which was okay but overpriced. Not many options. Probably won't go back because I could barely handle the smell while I was eating and my husband felt nauseous from it.

Sushi here is amazing! We ordered the salmon sashimi, crunchy spicy salmon roll, scallop roll and 2 specialty rolls. The food was brought out very quickly, water glasses always stayed full and the waitress was always easy to reach! 

Will be back again to try more rolls!

I had a great time getting my hair cut here. I wish it didnt cost extra for a blow-dry after the wash and cut but i loved Debra and it was a friendly environment. I checked in online before i got there to make sure id have a spot (this was also at 830 pm so it wasnt too busy). Ill be back!

This place is very good for pub food and domestic beers. Not much of a menu for craft beers lovers. Food is priced right below $10.00. Most is fried. Love the atmosphere. Great for Sunday Football!!! They serve breakfast on Sunday during NFL and you don't want to miss it.

This place was awful! Cold food, flavorless, and poor service. We got something traditonal that we knew we would like, Kung pow chicken and fried rice and both were far from delicious. We didn't even finish the food and opted to go eat elsewhere.

I would not recommend this place to anyone and I will never be returning.

I live right around the corner and I eat here quite often. The food is very good and everyone working  is very friendly. I would recommend the Hunan chicken! 

It smells a little like cigar smoke when you first go in but that is because of the cigar shop next door.

Our family loves Toucan Swirl!  The service is always amazing.  The owner is super friendly.  Yogurt is yummy!  Our only critique is that the flavors and flavor combinations could use improving.  We love this place though.  We live supporting a local business owner.  Visit Toucan Swirl!  You won't be disappointed!

I really like this nail salon. While they aren't open on Sundays any longer, the wait on Saturday usually isn't too bad. On the downside, I'm not sure they sterilize their instruments or the foot baths they way they should. My nails always look good when they're done so that's a plus. I would NOT recommend the waxing services.

For such an inventive restaurant, I'm disappointed in one of the most basic items.  I had the burger, which was delicious, but the Yukon gold fries that were on the side were in the saddest state ever!  Soggy, greasy and unflavorful.  I felt bad wasting my pile of fries - just couldn't eat them.

Visited this place as a recommendation by a friend and the first thing I noticed was the incredible decor they've got going on. Beautiful walls complemented by various items that add that extra wow factor. Great food, especially the spicy chicken! Overall really enjoyed this place!

I had two parties for my daughter here, took her for a haircut and got my niece's ears pierced. The shop is beautiful and clean. The staff is amazing!! Kind and patient and high quality work....just awesome. We will defintely keep coming back and would recommend this place to anyone for any service they offer.

I've been there twice. WiFi is nice. It's a little expensive compared to other places. There were two change machines and one of them was out of order, the other didn't accept any of my 10 separate bills so I had to go somewhere else as they don't accept credit cards.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: So close to my hotel I had to try. The salsa was homemade and great but the chips were not. I am just spoiled because I get fresh made chips at home but to me this is just lazy. Carnie was a but tough, but good flavor. I would keep an eye on the kitchen standards.

Visiting Philly and hungry so jumped on Yelp and Las Bugambilias popped up in our area.  Always in the mood for Mexican food, so why not try it.  Thank you Yelp!  

Good food and atmosphere.  It's quite small inside.  If weather is nice, I would suggest sitting outside.  Overall a very good experience.

Love this place.  I feel like the sushi chefs always go out of their way to chat and make people feel welcome.  They always have the best quality of food and the rolls aren't premade.

Last time there, we tried the dessert roll.  Fried banana, mango, sugar drizzle and big enough for 3 people to eat!

NEVER COMING HERE AGAIN. I walked in and heard a woman beating  her son in the back while he was screaming and crying. Absolutely disgusted. Many other local businesses to support around Glassboro, will never support child abuse like this God knows what happens at home.

I came in late for the sushi buffet and was NOT disappointed. The Titan roll is hands down the best but they have amazing options on the bar. I will for sure make this a regular spot. The sushi is on point but what really sealed the deal was the Keith sweat slow jams they were playing. I'm so glad I work so close!!!

Large Party, Weekend Night

Josephine is a great neighborhood restaurant with an interesting menu. Our service was great, and one of the highlights of our Nashville trip. 

We were a little over dressed as most places in Nashville are casual. This is a business casual scene.

like all yogurts. no special flavors. but I do love the rock chocolate, that was very delicious and I've never seen on other frozen yogurt shops.
went on a Tuesday afternoon and no one was there lol. the cashier was very nice, hope he gets more people sometime.

This place is the whole reason I want to live in a true big city. I could easily see myself grabbing needed supplies as I walk home from work to my downtown pad.  Unfortunately, I am only visiting. I was impressed with the selection, the hot section of food, and how nice the staff was.

Pretty good Mexican food here today. Had the ground beef tacos and their chips and salsa. It was all really good. The salsa especially had a really good limey flavor. I'd give it a 5 star, but any place that serves beans and rice as sides to a dish can't get a perfect rating. Beans and rice is prison food.

Best sushi in the area! LOVE going here! Very expensive but worth every penny! It's a very nice treat for myself! The Oshie, OMG, Volcanoe, and White Tiger are my TOP favorite! And soup and salad with it! I love it!!!! The employees are so kind and friendly and work hard to give good service during a busy night!

The prices aren't great and the staff seem uninterested in customers or helping make decisions. Been here maybe 10 times over the last 12 months and never had a good experience. I now travel 5 miles farther away to go to a store where I feel my custom is welcome. Would have been 1 star but felt bad, so upped it.

Terrible customer service. We stayed here for a wedding and were incredibly disappointed by hotel staff throughout the entire weekend. (The staff was even rude to the bride & groom.) Stay somewhere else! Many other great places in St. Louis that are more client-oriented.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Came here for my birthday last week. To be honest, I really don't see the hype with this place. I've definitely tasted better sushi. The only thing I really enjoyed was the ambiance. Our food took almost 40 minutes to show up to our table... And I wouldn't call 6 pieces of sushi dinner. Definitely not coming back.

The food was absolutely amazing. I came with two vegetarians who are very particular about their mexican food, but we were all blown away the depth of flavour in the sauces. I ordered the verde chicken enchilada and the tortilla soup and loved them both! They also had great margaritas.

Great Food! I've tried the Texas burrito and the Bacon burrito - both were excellent. The red salsa is some of the best I've ever tasted. Maybe the best. There is plenty of room to dine in or they also have a drive-thru. They also offer complimentary chips. I will definitely be back to try more of the menu.

The Paris Rd., Subway for whatever reason is much more polite and efficient than other subways. The staff is always greeting you with a friendly smile and loading up your sandwich and salad with plenty of vegetables. If you have the option to eat Subway in Chalmette, I recommend the Paris Road location.

The staff are wonderful and very caring. You can tell they have general concern for your pet when sick. My dog Kody has been going there for a little over a year now and each time they greet him like he's family. Dr. Snyder is amazing and I can't say enough positive things about Rhonda and the other support staff.

Good sushi and good prices!  I had the dancing vampire. It was good, a little spicy and a little crunchy but not too much of anything. Accommodating - they squeezed our large group in before the next one came and also made no fuss about splitting our checks which is just so appreciated.

Tried to eat here. Place was empty but was told it would be 15 minutes to be sat at the hibachi grill. Too many rules regarding group/table ordering. All have to order all you can eat. It's annoying. Ended up leaving because the menu was confusing and all the rules.

Pleasantly surprised that a sushi place...in Reno...in a casino...in Circus Circus was good.  Didn't do the all you can eat, but had several different rolls.  All were good, but the standout was the ceviche roll.  Very interesting and tasty too.  The only drawback...no sashimi.

This is my favorite Italian restaurant the area! And this area has too many great Italian options. I frequent this place as much as my waist line will allow. My favorite dish is by far the Lobster fettuccine. Bring your own wine and enjoy some great Italian food and great service!

Just ordered take out. The food was done quickly and the staff were nice. The pizza on display doesn't look great but I got 2 cheesesteaks and they're really tasty. I also got an order of fries for $5. See attached photo. I didn't like that I could have probably counted the fries in the basket.

oh I love the pizza.. some say it's was salty but I think it's goood...I love the crust and the dough how it's thin and that's crust is super good. YOU GOTTA TRY IT. and it's call hidden pizza for a reason cause it's in a corner across from Brew brother that you wouldn't think there nothing back there in a corner lol...

My favorite coffeehouse! Plenty of seating for groups or solo trips. I usually get an iced coffee and a ham and cheese scone, both are always delicious. Mostly, I love their mission! Read more on their website about what they're all about. They are amazing people!

This Checkers location has decent food. Its not the best but ive never had a bad meal. Beware, if you decide to sit out and eat there, you will be asked for money from local homeless people and people just getting out of jail. It happens to me everytime.  But I go there on late nights for ice cream and its really good.

The hotel is located on the bay and offers beautiful views. The rate was reasonable and the staff were very friendly. We enjoyed our stay and the restaurant had a great selection. Our meal was delicious and had a great presentation. When we come back this way the Bay Harbour will be our first choice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I admit, I was suspicious when I saw how many stars this little Mexican restaurant had. It's very unassuming from the outside, and even more so on the inside. But I was extremely surprised and very pleasantly surprised to have a delicious dinner at a very reasonable price.  I will be back!

Thought this was a decent enough place to stay for a night or two. No problems with the room, a complementary breakfast, and a quiet place to get some rest (or to get some last-minute work done). The staff was very friendly as well, which is always a plus.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The place doesn't have air conditioning and all the beer is rancid from being overly warm and they will not accept returns for rancid beer that is so to their poorly maintained facility. I wouldn't suggest buying anything from here if you don't like wasting money.

Horrible, ordered 2chicken parmigiana with linguini, well come to find out if you want sauce on the pasta " you need to tell us". Are they crazy? Who has ever seen boiled pasta with no sauce next to your entree?
This place has gone to hell in a hand basket ! I will never eat there again, no matter how Hungary or convienent!

I'd give them zero stars for zero service but that's not an option. Drove over there today with a filthy car with bugs stuck all over it. Special occasion in the morning, I wanted my car clean. Got there at 5:15pm knowing they close at 6pm on Fridays per their website. They were closed.

Food was not great. Photos on Yelp were deceiving. Ordered chicken parmigiana, chicken piccata, linguine w clams, sausage and broccoli rabe and mixed greens salad. Everything was bland, flavorless and dry. Maybe only thing that was good was the bread they threw in. Will not be ordering again. Wish they took some care w the order.

Nice little restaurant. I ordered the beef teriyaki lunch special and that was quite good. The steak strips were nice and thick and the added variety of salad, rolls, and soup was a nice addition. They over poured the dressing and teriyaki sauce but that's my only complaint. Service was from friendly.

I was there for lunch and the service was good although their were only six people dining.  The squash soup was excellent, bread was excellent, ambiance was excellent but where we get off course was the entree of fried drum was only average at best.  With 3000 choices in new Orleans it is best to look elsewhere.

Great place to stop and have a glass of wine after shopping.  Food all looked good but pasta and shrimp, chips, and soups looked the best.   We got a burger and it had great flavor.  Crab cake portions were Barbie doll portion size but good.  High end cliental.  Service was slow but they were busy.  TV s in bar.  I will go back.

Had my wedding brunch here. Biggest waste of money. Outrageous amount of money of for bagels and we had to ask for refills of water! We had to pretty much beg them to pack our food up at the end. Do not recommend anyone having their wedding brunch here. The woman who ran it was not that responsive either.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Great location, next to Airport and downtown Boise. Rooms are spacious and fairly clean. They have a fridge and microwave. The front desk is also nice and professional.

Free parking, indoor pool is open till 10pm which is nice.

Only minus one star - they have spotty WiFi coverage.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I love this place for cheap good mexican food. The margaritas are awesome if you are looking for something like that.   chips and salsa are always plentiful. fajitas quesadilla are awesome and was a lot to eat comes on two plates.

the place is small but the workers are always fast and nice.

My husband and I just grabbed a drink on their front patio. Staff was extremely nice and moved umbrellas around so we were in the shade. Our drinks were decent, but nothing incredibly impressive. It's exactly what you would expect at a joint on the boardwalk. Sugary but delicious, perfect for heat while on vacation.

I ordered sashimi deluxe for dinner. Overall, quality of sashimi was ok. However, there were two things that really bothered me: dried rice and weird taste of ginger. I am guessing that both rice and ginger were aged abit. Maybe I was just unlucky that day. But yeah not a pleasant experience.

Best full service car wash I've come across in the area. They spend the time on the interior that most places don't. Pull the floor mats out and scrub them, wipe everything down, spray and scrub the seats. I'm always impressed at how long they spend on my car. Great job for the price!

Been here a few times service is always slow even when they are not busy.  However, their food was always great so we kept coming.  The last time 2 times we were here it was awful first time thought it was just an off day for them but second time was even worse and we will not be coming back.

After waiting for an hour for 3 sushi rolls, we were told that it normally takes an hour for sushi. Ironically, the table next to us ordered 6 rolls right before us. Not only did they receive their rolls in a timely fashion, they were done eating before we received our order. Never returning. The service is terrible.

We tried Fat Salmon for lunch.  We ordered the lunch combo with salad, chicken katsu, California roll, rice and gyoza, the sushi lunch and an additional spider roll, order of Himachi and Unagi. It was fine - but nothing special.  The atmosphere was fairly nice.  Food was ok - nothing more.

One of the better Sushi spots in the Reno area. The service was prompt (mostly) and the food tasted good. There were a few times during our experience that we had to wait longer than usual for our food / bill, but overall it is a good place to eat some good sushi!

This is a great gym that is conveniently located in the Northtowne Plaza. The employees take pride in the appearance of the gym and it definitely shows. Most of the equipment is new and in good shape. They even offer a water purifier which I absolutely love. I am happy with my decision to join so far.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I take my daughter her after school to get sushi at least once a week. the service is great and they now know my daughter's order when we walk through the door. She always gets the avocado rolls and I get the beef teriyaki bowl with the California roll. The sushi is well made and taste great. The prices are very good. .

It's a great place to go to if you are craving sashimi, have a big appetite, and love sushi. However, if you want quality sushi, I wouldn't recommend coming here. The sushi rolls are mostly rice and the fish tastes super fishy. The service is not the best, but it's alright.

Great product and brand but extremely slow. I go to the one on Gandy and by my work on Westshore. The speed of the drive through depends on the employee. Some are good but most are super slow. Very frustrating and making me start to avoid going. Super super slow.

This place got good Yelp reviews and we didn't want the standard old ice cream place so we went here. The ice cream wasn't the creamy soft serve I was hoping for. It was more like ice milk, but I'm picky about my soft serve. My 9 year old was happy though.

Place is a little misleading when you walk in. It smells like dirty mop water and the staff is not very friendly at all. I was disappointed because I had heard such wonderful things about the place. The food however was amazing. Best pizza I have had in a while!

Authentic tacos! First time visiting here and I'm pretty sure I found my new favorite taco place. I had lengua tacos, which were phenomenal and tender. We also had the Vampiro and the Mula. All incredibly delicious! I can't wait to take my taco expert here to treat him to these tacos!

Great staff.  Reached to me as a Plus member to confirm my reservation and offered me a free evening with my rental. I arrived, had a smooth check in and had a small wait for my vehicle but it was worth it. 

I will definitely return and refer friends here.

I've been to jimmys pizzeria on several occasions the pizza was on point, those garlic knots with the marinera sauce are o so yummy, recently tried the pork Jamie sandwich delicious puts subways sandwiches which are nxt door to shame!!check them out for sure

I've never had a problem in here ever but today......y money was counted out on the counter. I'm not sure if it was bc I gave him a 100 dollar bill and he didn't want to mess up or he was just being rude! Put my money in my hand just like I put it in yours

Seems like they did a decent job.  I didn't realize they had an Axxess card discount and now I am sad because I spent 100 bucks on about 15 shirts to get laundered and two suits to get dry cleaned.  I thought dry-cleaning costs were fair but the cost of laundering shirts was pretty high.  Should have checked the prices first.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Went here for lunch and it is now my favorite sushi restaurant! The fish is fresh and the presentation is amazing. I ordered a Naruto Roll, which was refreshing, and a combo off the lunch menu. My dad and I sat at the sushi bar area and got the chance to talk to the chef, he was nice and the service was great!

If you enjoy feeling cheated, I recommend this place. If you enjoy overpaying for tires and tire repair, I recommend this place. If you enjoy slow, unpleasant service technicians, I highly recommend this place.  Bottom line, if you love Walmart quality/service at Nordstrom prices, it'll be love at first site at Tire Kingdom.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I really wanted to enjoy this restaurant, but the food was less than mediocre -- nothing labelled "spicy" was spicy, the quality of the meats was very poor and grisly, and the flavors were bland. I wouldn't recommend eating here unless there are no other options.

RUDE ASS STAFF HELL NO ‍ tried to tell the girls about the blonde who had a major attitude problem and she said ok...? and shut the window, HELL NO GIRL that is not how you handle a customers complaint! welcome to customer service, better start learning how to do it.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Some of the rudest staff i've ever met, terribly slow service ( like waiting in the drive through behind 2-3 cars max, and not moving for 15 minutes), and the food always seems to be cold. not quite sure why it's so hard to mess up some burgers/chicken nuggets and fries, but they always seem to
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: If you need a stylist you can always trust, Jessi is your girl. Now that I live in New York, it makes me very sad to not be able to see her. She will make you the best blonde you've ever had. Such a gem. Also the salon is decorated beautifully and just makes for an overall great experience!

Extremely disappointed every time I go to this Starbucks. Because of its prime location it always busy, but the drive thru is terrible. Monotone, unfriendly service and my coffee rarely is enjoyable. I have a simple request, yet depending on who's working... It's always different.

Jason's Toridasu is great! The sushi rolls are delicious and fresh, the miso is outstanding and Jason is a really nice guy truly concerned with pleasing his customers. I love that every meal comes with a water and a soup.  I cannot wait to try the salad with sashimi; it looked amazing. I'm definitely going back.

I found that the people were on the rude side. Hotel was fairly clean but they were renovating while we were there. Hotel was very noisy with the beach party club, and the parking was atrocious. This place is convenient to nothing except a dose of date rape. Don't think I'll stay here ever again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Pretty good sushi at really cheap prices. Normally I'd expect to pay at least $6 for a shrimp tempura roll but I paid $3. The shrimp tasted great and huge chunks of avocado.  I also had a spicy salmon roll which tasted great too. I'll definitely be making a trip back to try more rolls at this place.

Service was friendly, atmosphere was welcoming for a sports bar type environment.  Chicken fettuccini was okay, cavatelli with broccoli was okay. Bread was delicious. Ordered tiramisu and after waiting 15 minutes, it was served to our table. It looked amazing....but sadly was frozen all the way through. :(

This location closed and now the company refuses to contact me.  The third party company says they can't cancel my membership and now I'm stuck paying for a membership I will NEVER use.  Do NOT go to any of their gyms and sign up not when there are other places to join with no hassle of a contract.  The customer service sucks!!!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Only had appetizers and drinks but we were very pleased. We had a great waitress, Morgan. The mules were amazing. I would totally go back and try some of their entrees. Our appetizer of sushi was very good for a non-sushi restaurant! The bbq flatbread was also very good as well the sliders!

This was our first time going, we are new to this part of Tampa so we thought we would go try this place out. The employees were pleasant, and we got a ton of food for what we paid.  That being said the food was good but not great. Not bad but not our favourite. Not sure if I would go again.

Just moved into the Riverloft Apartment into a beautiful condo with high ceilings, an amazing city view and tons of space!  The staff at Riverloft have been beyond helpful with the moving process and helping me learn more about the area.  I look forward to enjoying my new home and meeting new people in the area!

The store was need and organized. There where no issues with the pace at all. Lack of what I was looking for was the only downside. I like this place, it's a nice and open space. I would come back here. While they did not have what I was looking for, they did have other items I had not seen before.

I have had acrylics for 8 years solid and go to the same lady. BUT I was in reno and decided to stop here and I am glad I did. I had black paint caked in my nails and they got it all out. It was so relaxing and the massage chairs are REALLY good unlike most other places. You won't be disappointed

I have been to this salon a few times. They have always provided great service. The shop is very clean and provides an atmosphere that is inviting. They have always done a great job on my nails.

I have gone to a lot of salons in the city and though this is not my standard spot it's on the top of my list.

My husband and I absolutely love Hubbard and Cravens coffee!  We have started to make it a weekend ritual to stop by and get either a coffee, latte or cappuccino.  They have a really great selection of coffee and there breakfast sandwiches are delicious.  We will definitely be going back!

Electric went out in house, wife's job sent her home for being dehydrated.  Marriott courtyard took our last minute reservation and gave us a kings size bed for a king and a queen with plenty of air. Marriott courtyard is now my favorite place to stay very courteous workers.Thanks my wife is better.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I just returned from San Diego, CA and this place is just as good as any of the Taquerias I visited out there. 

I've only tried the Tacos El Pastor and Carne Enchilada so far. Both are fantastic......

They also serve beef tongue and tripe for the more adventurous palates. 

This place is the real deal!!!

Love authentic Japanese food here, the sushi inert is really awesome and FRESH!
I also tried their asaka ramen, miso ramen and ton katsu, excellent!
You definitely need to make reservations if you come here for dinner at rush hours,the waiting lines are long more than you can expect.

McDonald's is always good but 90% of the time they're getting my order wrong. I mean really wrong. I go there really late a lot because I work nights and the kids who work that shift are always laughing through the drive-thru speaker and it's really unprofessional.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Tried to order a frappucino 20 minutes before they closed and was told that "frappucino machine is shut down for the night". They also had thrown out all pastries/snacks. There were 5+ people still in line at that moment. I ended up spending my money elsewhere.

I brought my clothes in for alterations and I was told to buy new clothes. So... you don't want my business?

Keep in mind that all of the positive reviews are from years ago when they were under different management. The current operators seem to be terrible.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Sherry is wonderful.. I have tried other nail salons over the past couple years, Lookin Good puts others to shame. Highly recommended. I usually get a manicure, today I had a spa manicure and I was very happy. If your looking for a great nail place, check them out..

Very good dinner - I had the Mole Pablano.  This is an upscale mexican / texmex restaurant that has good food.  I can find cheaper (but just as good or better) other places, but if you're looking for an evening out with friends as a nicer than average venue, then this is a good place.

Wow, YoShow is a great yogurt shop! It's unique and what a creative concept!! Love the outdoor movie nights. It's so refreshing to have different flavors, like all the Greek yogurt especially the Greek Java flavor! The Affogato is so great, I highly recommend it!. There's a ton of toppings and it's reasonably priced.

Nice change of pace from busy Bourbon Street. Clean, not too loud. I will regularly stop for the frozen Italian Coffee while in New Orleans. I was torn between that and the Tiramisu martini but the bartender, Joe, was helpful with his suggestion! Just like he said, think Wendy's frosty with alcohol! Yum

Very friendly and nice hotel. They have decent amenities and great view from the room. They have an eco friendly card that you can put on the bed but it does not stand out so I did not use it the first night. I wish it was more visible. Otherwise, I love this hotel!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I live in California now, home of some pretty great sushi.  I still make a beeline for Sakura when I am back in Indy.  Always Fresh fish, my favorite rolls at great prices. Where else can three people eat sushi until stuffed and happy for under $40?!?
I love you and miss you Sakura!

Really great service. We were stuck at the airport and ordered a large pizza. We enjoyed every ounce of it. Although the crust was Okay. We had a half supreme and half white. I wouldn't order the white Ever again from them but the supreme was great! Awesome service, Nice people. 

Made our delayed flight much more tolerable!

This is probably one of the best sushi places I've been to in America. After going to japan, my bf and I are sushi snobs.. this place is comparable to Japan. Very fresh sushi! The servers and chefs were very welcoming and so nice! Will definitely be back!  Thank you sun sushi!

The owner is super nice and we have liked what we have tried so far;  Garlic knots (asked for extra oil), dry and breaded wings,  pepperoni and plain pizza.  The pepperoni was a tad bit salty but the wings were great and the blue cheese bbq fries were awesome!  Will be going back!

Don't trust this place or its rating on google they messed up my brakes. Mechanics aren't that good they know basics. I paid them went in with my brakes in good condition just needed a little work came out with my car needing more repair because the mechanic messed up another part on my car. My car is pretty new as well.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Average mexican food experience for my husband and me. We tried chimichangas and both thought we've had better chimis at Chevy's.  Too bad since this seems to be their specialty.  Nothing terrible here, but we won't be back, still searching for the best in this category!

Fun to go to a tamale restaurant, even though it had the feeling of a fast food chain. Something we don't get back home, fresh homemade tamales!  Not sure I would order them shipped back to North Carolina, but it was a fun and different treat for us while we were visiting Tucson.

I went to Ice Cold Air to have my ac looked at. Its April and getting hot.
It was not working properly. Kevin the owner was great. He spent so much time( over an hour) looking for the issue and explaining to me each step. He is not a salesman, very honest, and reasonable beyond belief. I am a new customer and you should be also.

Veryyy good sushi!! This place has good cut fish, nice tight rolls, and good proportions! The EST roll was delicious! They will custom make whatever roll you want too! Fresh and yummy! Definitely a good spot for sushi and we are very picky about our sushi! Would recommend for sure!! Great service!

Their window out front says they open at 11. We went two different days at 11, and they were closed. Finally checked online to see what was going on only to find they actually open at 12. Seems like it would be an easy fix to avoid annoyed customers. Very frustrating and poor customer service.

Not sure what to think about this place. Nice rooms, really cool bars, worst customer service ever. Managers clearly haven't been through any sort of proper training. They spend more time arguing in defense of policy than accommodating normal requests and moving on.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: There is no way to get into this place to use the "free vacuums" it's like they want you to go through the $5 wash that doesn't even clean your car to use the vacuums. Traffic cones blocking to get to vacuums. Only way to get to just vacuums is to go in the do not enter.

Great place to get an eye exam! Love that they are open seven days a week so it's very convenient for those who work during the week and are also open very late. The doctor is also very good and they have a good selection on frames! Will defintatly keep going there!!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Hubby and I just had the new XLNY pizza. Only $9.00 for this delicious pizza. Large pepperoni and crumbled sausage on thin crust. Sauce was fantastic with added oregano. Probably the best we have ever purchased from this location and we have been going here for years!!

Food is four stars but the service is two. A solid 3 Stars. The outside looks permanently closed because the windows are covered and the sign is out dated. However, the inside is authentic. I would try other places in the future because I value service but the food does not disappoint.

Yesterday for Mother's Day we took 18 people and were seated in the front room. Ciconte's did a wonderful job in presenting a fun atmosphere,  great food, in a very timely manner.  I'd like to give a special shout out to the waitresses, waiters, and of course Tony for a Happy Mother's Day!

Horrible! Beef and brocculi was dry and chewy, the honey chicken soggy and the fried rice dry and tasteless! The crab Rangoon had little or no filling, let alone crab and were dry as well! Not sure what was worse the food or the fact that we wasted money on it!

To Whom It May Concern:
I was just wondering if you wouldn't mind answering a question. I bought a bag of cheese (for $7 and change), one scoop of ice cream in a cup, one scoop of Italian ice in a cup and two scoops of ice cream in a cone and it came to $26 and change. Is this normal pricing? Thank you.

Well, dunno of it was good or bad. Portion sizes were good. Food was decent, not amazing. It took forever to get served and one order was forgotten. Also it was overpriced. The writing on the walls was pretty tacky. So left with a full belly but not amazing overall.

So, quick lunch was needed. Figured I would taco del a try. Though the menu looked good I would have to say it didnt live up.... It was bland. Lots of options so something else might be good but the beef burrito was meh. The service however was amazing and having beer was a nice touch

Really neat place in North Wilmington. It's always refreshing to find a place where the staff and chefs truly care about what they're putting out of the kitchen. I personally enjoy how they have a different risotto each day  if you're around the way I highly suggest giving this place a try.

Cheers,

Haretfeld Country Club and Pub

I have often brought my (Elaine's) Brunch Bunch and (Elaine's)  Wingwoman's Happy Hour group here, always fabulous!!
Clientele great for socialization, affordable prices and good food!

Let them know Elaine recommended

Only reason not 5 stars...a little out of the way location wise

This is a great location. Modern equipment and look, high end locker room, and personal tv with each machine. When I was here this afternoon, here was less than 20 people which made it a very nice place to work out. I look forward to coming back to work out here again.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Horrible service from "Vicky" at the front desk! I have always preferred this hotel chain that one time I even lived in another one of their hotels for 6 months, but after this horrible experience with " Vicky" I will NEVER stay here or at another Holiday Inn Express. I've never met anyone as rude and bitter
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The coffee experience was a great one, this is why I'm going there in the first place. The customer service side was not the same. We usually come to a coffee shop to relax, the environment at the front till caused tension and frustration, one can only hope this changes as the rest of the experience was great

In town for a meeting and a quick visit with my son, an attorney in Clayton. I Fratellini was highly recommended by his associates. We were not disappointed. Lovely spot, great welcome and service, excellent food and wine. I will revisit with my wife on the next trip.

This place is one of the worst.   They literally make up their prices as they see fit. A guy who doesnt speak English greets you, you tell him what wash you want, and then he writes $20 on a yellow post it even though platinum says $16.99.  They charge an extra $1.50 for a larger suv, so we are at $18.50.  ????   Never coming back.

Since going to Diamond Nails, I have gotten my gel manicures consistently because they are that good. I typically schedule an appointment with Henry, and he is great. He is very attentive and precise. I have had a little chipping, but that's if the manicure is about 3 weeks old. You should try this place!

I love Jerry Bob's for breakfast! We had no wait this morning and our waitress, Kaylee, was attentive and friendly.  Our food was served quickly and was delicious.  The atmosphere is relaxing and the prices are very reasonable.  We'll definitely be back again.

I just had lunch at this BUSY Subway near St. Mary's Hospital and my sandwich came out looking rather sloppy - without me even having to complain or ask a team member came over and asked if she could remake it for me!!  Awesome, they were super nice!!  Great customer service!!!

Awesome gym.  Very affordable with great equipment.   They even have a movie theatre where I can get my cardio done while watching 21 jump street!   Staff is very friendly, and they have a great selection of protein bars and shakes.  Can't beat it for the cost.  I found my favorite gym.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: My dad likes this place and recommended that I get my tires replaced here (my rear tire must have had a leak, it kept loosing pressure). The staff were knowledgeable and explained all the options. They replaced the tires in the expected timeframe, for the expected cost--about as positive as car repairs can be. :)
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I absolutely love this place! Make an appointment they have so many regulars! I get my pink and white gel nails there. They are always on point. I feel so pretty with these nails and I get compliments even when they been done for 3 weeks. Sonny doesn't talk much but he is a perfectionist! I will not go anywhere else EVER!

After waiting nearly an hour (not busy) we ordered 3 rolls.  1st they were out of asparagus.  Then, came back later - out of salmon.  Then the rolls came...  Yay, we thought...  Nope-  brown avocado.  Glad we got the groupon...  Makes this less painful.  We won't be back...

They put down all of my information wrong, got to the place had to stand outside after the woman was extremely rude and refused to help me. Then pulled up all of my information on my east pass then they wouldn't let me rent it because my information didn't match what THEY put down.

We arrived  pretty early on Friday night (6 PM) and Jack Willie's already had a full house.  Live music was already playing with a great band (Katz). We were seated and served promptly and the food was terrific! It's a 'must visit' establishment in the Tampa Bay area.  Jon

I've been a customer of Waterworks for the past 5 years.  I'm always greeted with a friendly smile by Ann, the front desk cashier.  I look forward to getting my Audi washed because I know she'll take care of me.  The guys always do a thorough job and pay attention to detail.  If there is a problem they always fix it without issue.

Hate to kick a place while its down like the other guy... But Christ. There was hair in my pizza that took ten minute to over cook (I order two slices... They just needed two minute in the oven).
My boyfriends cheese steak was great, big too.
But I just nope. Nope nope. Awful

The food here was good, but the restaurant was filthy. There were peanut shells, fries, and wrappers all over the floor. The staff were also shouting inappropriate comments at  each other, and it made it uncomfortable to eat there. I'd go to Five Guys again, but not this location.

This is the second year in a row we came here before the father/daughter dance.  Last year nobody came to our table for 15 min so we left.  This year I called and made a reservation and there was no record of it when we arrived.  We had to wait 15 minutes and were late to the dance.

Came here to celebrate a friend's engagement. The food was amazing, the service was really good. Some of the desserts were really good too. Unfortunately my dessert, the dark chocolate cake wasn't one of them. The ice creams, which my friends ordered, were very good!

This place sucks. Apparently for you to get service in the place, you need to give them your info, and if they have availability, then they call you to come over and have your car fixed. Mind you, I booked an appointment online and the guy told that they haven't fixed that issue.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I have been to Oggi on Davis Islands on several occasions now. This is seriously authentic and unique Italian. Not only is the food amazing -- you feel like you're in an intimate, family setting. Such a friendly and sweet staff and owner. I can't wait to go back!

What's the big deal? Crowded, loud, mediocre food, disinterested waitstaff.  Only thing going for it is the people watching---the "beautiful people" seem to like the place.  But go someplace else if you want good food and service---there are plenty of alternatives very close by.

Don't be fooled by their "30 day written cancellation notice". What it really means, is 30 days if you cancel ON your payment date. If you cancel the next day, your 30 day notice is actually 59 days, because IAC will make you pay for the full next month's dues, if they come due during the 30 days.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The chicken Marsala was fabulous. I was disappointed with the Sinatra, especially for the price of the meal. Overall, I have had some really good meals there. Much better than the "chain" restaurants. I would take my family or friends there and would not think twice about doing so.

Worst service ever.     Two gentleman working.  No sense of urgency   Making orders of people who placed them after us.  We will never come back to this one as the we are still standing waiting and everyone after us has been served as well as the drive thru  RIDICULOUS!!!!!

This place was amazing when it first opened! Then they got staff from another Mexican restaurant and this place quickly went down the tubes! It is just like the other place now poor service and the salsa is so hot you cannot eat it hate that bc it was so great when it first opened

We love the Pizza!  Unfortunately service does not live up to the food.  Today we waited 1 hour from the time seated (1/2 hour wait).  Hair found on food.  No apology or excuse.  No offer of discount.  I don't know, is it me or are we just to lazy to speak up or share what is true?

Great food. We had enough to have a second meal the next day!  Our waitress was super attentive and very friendly.  I had the Pasta Fagioli soup and did not like it!  It was very bland. We did sit in the new addition and I agree the floor to ceiling mirrors are a little overboard.  Not sure what kind of ambience that adds.

Don't waste your time or money on their bland freezer food that's been reheated. Grouper wasn't fresh or tasty. Could have gotten a better freezer lasagna and they were out of cesear salad dressing. This place is good for college kids getting cheap drinks and pizza but that's it.

Love this place. Great personal sized pizzas, fabulous waitresses, excellent entrees. Great for the kids and the staff/owners are super kid friendly. Celebrated my birthday here and they were good about bringing our own cake. Prices are very fair and food is good!

So $22 for chicken Marsala with no pasta no side nothing???? "Best philly meatballs" $8 and taste microwaved and $8 soup that was nothing but kale and pasta no broth! I have never seen such an appalling service for take out. I would not recommend this at all. The sauce was not good in the Marsala and beyond bland.

To the girl in drive thru that I handed a twenty for an order that came up to be $15 something and tried to argue that I don't get any change...

Go back to elementary school. These employees need to be trained way better because half of them can't even get an order right.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: They were working in a catering order and my dinner mates sushi didn't arrive till I was almost done my yaki soba. The sushi was good and fresh. The yaki soba had well over cooked chicken and very little sauce. In addition the saki menu was limited and they were out of my selection, the only sparkling one.

Ok tucked away in Elkins House is this delicious jewel. The food is fresh and cooked to perfection . The service is friendly and genuine. It is nothing like eating awesome food and the chef walks by and smile. Well let's just say my food is so delicious I gave him a wink !

They were out of so many things. We had to change our order and then we had to change it once more when we drove up to the next window because they discovered they were out of that as well.....but at least the woman was nice about the situation and apologized. I wouldn't hesitate to return here since this was my first time.

This is another poor Mexican restaurant outside Los Angeles county.  I ordered carne asada, but the meat was as thin as the paper!  I guess I am so spoiled by the good Mexican restaurants in LA that I get surprises when I eat Mexican food outside LA.  At least this place had rice and beans.

I eat a lot of sushi, so I'm pretty particular about a few things. The miso soup tasted watered down, not enough green for me. The sushi was moist but not the best tasting, and the wasabi was mild, to say the least (I prefer spicy, obviously). Probably wouldn't visit a second time.

Get the bear claws. Don't think about it, just go get one. Happy, sad, celebrating, just go get a donut from this place. The best! The addiction is a slippery slope, so do ensure you have a support group of good friends around you to pull you away after eating too many. Enjoy!

Thanks for the whole chicken breast on a chicken club salad. Super inconvenient. Is it that hard to cut it up for someone? Also, they forgot the cheese and gave us one soggy strip of bacon on top. Asked for extra tomato and got 3 pitiful round ones. Done going there!

Bethany was such a delightful young lady. As always the staff is kind and very quick getting my many coffee orders together. The other day I requested that my coffee be stirred well after ordering,. Without hesitation, Bethany gave a me a huge smile and offered to do so with no worries. Thankyou Starbucks for hiring lovely people.

Fantastic service from the front desk.
GREAT food at the restaurant.  Complimentary use of the gym next door.
The room was fine, I would have given them five stars except the Wi-Fi is TERRIBLE !!!  Every 2 minutes you have to login again!!!   Super frustrating!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I usually love coming here, but I went yesterday for a full set of acrylics with dip polish, and Annie was so busy that she rushed through the whole thing. She didn't clean up my nails/cuticles at all and shaped my nails so fast that some of them are crooked.

O.....k...not getting the great restaurant review on the wall, but everyone's taste is different. We ordered tofu with rice, wasn't that good. Rice came out like it was leftovers on a paper plate...small portions. Very dull in house dining area. Would not go back.

Disappointing all around. But in particular as a "Titanium Elite" member. Asked for a standard late checkout, but was denied. Normally would not complain but felt that there was literally no effort made at all to try and accommodate any incremental status requests. If that's the case, what's the point and why stay loyal.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Diamond in the rough! This place doesn't have much ambiance but the all you can eat sushi is great! It is not a buffet it is made to order. You can get anything from sashimi, sushi, hand rolls, special tools, Japanese food, etc.  Try the kani salad it's really good. Service is friendly!

This is quite possibly one of the worse buffets I have ever eaten at. The food was cold and doused in sauce.the drink machine was the focus of the dining bar. Only 2 main food sections with about 8 pots. 

HORRIBLE!!!!!!!!!!

Spend your money at McDonalds and not at this place!

We have been going to Riviera for a few years for pizza. It was hard to find a pizza place when we moved to Abington, but we this is the place! We recently got cheesesteaks, and they did not disappoint! It was packed with meat and for a great price! I would recommend Riviera to anyone looking for a local Italian place.

I took my puppy to banfield for all of his shots and office visits. Recently had him neutered and everything went really well. Dr. Lore is the veterinarian who takes care of my dog and she is absolutely wonderful. Very informative and communicates very well.

This was such a dump staid for one night room smelled disgusting, ladies of the night working a majority of the rooms. I actually went next door to Walmart and bought a fitted sheet to sleep in. The only reason I highlighted 1 star was that it wont let u leave it blank.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Went and got breakfast burritos.....mine was wrong and I asked for beans and didn't get that either......also I ordered 3 rolled tacos......when I opened the package the guacamole was brown and looks like the rolled tacos were from the day before.....UNACCEPTABLE.....YOU CHARM ED ME MONEY FOR OLD FOOD?

Pretty small but a nice little sushi joint. Decor is pretty gimmicky in a Starr-ish kinda way but is nonetheless presentable. The specialty rolls had a good bit of variety and the few we tried didn't give us dysentery so we were happy.

Try the smoked squid in ponzu sauce salad, it's phenom.

I am not a "foodie." I just enjoy good and quality food and Niche definantly did not disappoint. The food was very good, it's a great place if you actually want to converse with your dinner partner and the service was very attentive and accommodating. Worth the try!!

Best sandwiches in town. If you were looking for a fancy meal do not go here. As a sign says, this is not Burger King you don't get your way. But, it is also one of the coolest place in town to have a drink and have a great conversation. The interior was designed in 1950 and not much has changed at all but I gotta love it.

I would give this place more stars, but try to go there today and they were closed. 6 o'clock in the morning I'm tired and hungry and want coffee and food and they're not even open. Very disappointed and really do feel like they should open at least at 6 AM like all of the other coffee places.

The staff at this Dunkin Donuts location are always polite, attentive, and work fast pace. It is the perfect stop for a quick bite to eat before work, or if your craving some breakfast foods later in the day. Their donuts are amazing, but personally I think the blueberry bagels are the best thing on the menu!

This is one amazing sushi restaurant! Sushi always comes in a timely manner. The staff is very friendly. Even after just going in a few times, they remember me and even remember where I told them I work.  If you want good food, good service, and a good atmosphere, go to Arigato Sayonara.

After waiting a full hour for our entrees we left.  Took the family to dinner at 7:30 and at 8:45 we were still not served our entrees. Even if the food was better than average (which it is not) an hour is ridiculous.  I keep hoping for a better option to open in the area.

The I went there to get my AC in my truck they told me my compressor was out I went to Walmart and bought Freon and put in it and it started work and they tried to charge me $760 the biggest rip-off there is do not go to Ice Cold Air on Park Boulevard I'm not saying they're all that way what they were

I've been twice because I wanted to give this place a second chance as I love all things I've cream. Both times I went I tried different flavors and all of them were freezer burned like they had sat in the freezer for a long time. Don't waste your money or your calories.

The food and menu are terrific. The owner has done a wonderful job turning this place into one of the best Italian restaurants in Bucks county. We love the patio seating and the dining room ambiance is elegant with a little pizzaz. This is also the place to go to see and be seen ... great people watching!!

We came here while we were walking around the city. It was a cute little place. I got an Iced latte and the espresso tasted like it was burnt. It was not very good. My partner got a caramel iced latte and they were pleased with their drink. So I guess it is a hit or miss.

Awesome food, great deal... Love this place! The all you can eat sushi has a lot of choices and is made to order. Great atmosphere, friendly staff and I really love the guava candies they give you on the way out. I've never tried the hibachi, but Im sure its just as good. This place is always reasonably busy - so you know its good!

Everything was fine but not particularly great.  Food was just ok and for the cost, I don't feel it was worth it.  Same with service.  Nashville was generally more warm and welcoming than other cities but service at Josephine was more aloof and dull.

I would return if friends insisted but I would not voluntarily dine here.

Food is excellent. Nice music. Good ambience... BUT the service is worst. We were 5 and the server brought only 4 plates.  Next, she doesn't bring paper napkins.  We have to ask twice. Next, she doesn't come to ask if we need anything. Next, she gives us feeling that we are obliged having been there.

Having a full functioning Starbucks inside of a hospital was a great idea. There long lines in the morning but it moves really quickly.  If you go to Starbucks, I would suggest getting the app because you can get points on your purchase and eventually get free coffee.  You can't redeem your free drinks at this location.

First visit to any Chinese restaurant can be a bit intimidating. This is a chain restaurant and it sort of reminds me of Panda Express. Ordered takeout on a Saturday night. Order was ready in 10 minutes. Nice staff. Good amount of tasty food for the price. Probably will be back!

I visited Mark Pi's during the summer of 2018. The first visit to any Chinese restaurant can be a bit intimidating. This is a chain restaurant and it sort of reminds me of Panda Express. Ordered takeout on a Saturday night. Order was ready in 10 minutes. Nice staff. Good amount of tasty food for the price. Probably will be back.

Came here for morning brunch on a Saturday; we were seated right away which was great. However the service was a little slow, we had to ask for sugar twice for our coffee. The food was okay. Happy we tried, but will not be back. Maybe lunch/dinner is better

Great hotel with a kitchen, smart tv, big sectional, king size bed and nice bathroom! Overall, it's really nice and I would recommend it for sure! As soon as you walk in the front lobby, you can tell what kind of hotel it is. It smells great, it's very modern and the staff is very friendly!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is one of my favorite Dunkin Donuts! I go there every morning on my way to work. Never a long wait and my coffee and coffee roll are always on the counter when I walk in. Always greeted with a smile. They really take the time to get to know their regulars.

My girlfriend and I went her for Valentine's Day and it was a wonderful experience. I ordered the duck breast and she order a steak. Both of us absolutely loved our meals. The meat and vegetables were so fresh. Also the staff here was great. I would absolutely recommend this place to anyone.

This Dunkin' Donuts is a hit or miss. My coffee wasn't stirred so all the sugar was at the bottom. And My passengers chai latte tasted like it had curdled milk in it and smelled horrible. I was on my way to I75 for a quick road trip, otherwise I would have went back and complained in person.  Other times my coffee was good.

Great ambiance, however, we received a $4.00 charge per drink for our manhattans which our waitress said was a "surcharge" because we did not order food. So they were $18.00 each. Cokes for our two kids were $5.00 each. Pretty lame if you ask me. Won't be going back.

Not a huge fan of the new in dining ordering but the food and drinks were AMAZING! Hands down, best tacos ever had! Also ordered the chips and three dips and friend plantains, highly recommend! Had the red sangria and it was one of the best, not too sweet!

Stopped here before my flight. The waitress was busy chatting and took a while to turn her attention to me. I was the only other person waiting to order at the bar. 

I ordered a beer and it was $10.95 and a mimosa was also the same price. 

They don't put their prices on their menus.

Amazing! Delivered in 20 minutes to my hotel room. Super fresh, tasty and creative rolls! I got a Geisha Kiss roll, White Ninja roll, and spicy tuna hand roll. They followed my special requests perfectly through the delivery order on the app. Very impressed!

Decent enough property, but slightly ''used up'' feel.

BUT:  Park 'n Ride to the airport is convenient and saves money.  You can leave your car on their property for up to two weeks at no charge...with a FREE RIDE tot he airport AND BACK.  

Signage is not good, you will probably drive by it a couple times....
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I went in for an SNS removal and a regular coat of polish yesterday afternoon. The lady doing my nails complained the entire time about how difficult the SNS is to remove, but the actual paint job was good... until today. Every single one of my nails is chipped the DAY AFTER I got them done. I will not be going back.

Excellent place for fro yo. I come here at least twice a month because it's the closest to my house now that BTO on Sunrise closed. The topping selection is great and I particularly enjoy their toasted almond flavor. 

As an added bonus, they give Yelp users an added discount just for mentioning the app. Yay!!!

The food here used to be pretty good for a neighborhood pizza shop, but lately it has gone downhill. I ordered a stromboli that had no flavor and looked like it was rushed and last week I ordered a slice of pizza that was greasy and seemed under cooked. I think the owners sons took over and it shows.

The hotel is average. It's clean & it's in a great location. Elevators are a little slow & the room was not ready at 4 pm when we got there. The customer service was great. This hotel is good for the price they offer a free happy hour & free breakfast. I would stay again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
We have patronized 4 times in the prior months
Then we go one Friday night
1.5 hour wait. Something about an ordinance about the number of tables allowed. Dismal experience
Prior to this is was a bustling, fun, homemade wine experience! Warm
Never went back
A shame

Pappys Liquor is a great cozy liquor store with lots of selection. There were several things that I hadn't seen at my local liquor store. The guy behind the counter was very helpful and pleasant, prices were reasonable. It was within walking distance of the hotel we stayed at, do that was a plus. Definitely will be back!

Staff was very attentive.  Liked the seating booths.  They improved the experience.  Appreciated the Healthy roll, all plant based.  And it was very tasty.  Didn't get a chance to try the tempura, because they were out.  Hope to the next time .  Food was very tasty.

Without question, this is the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to. I have now been standing for 20 minutes, awaiting two drinks that I have already paid for. Given the expected holiday demand, this location is extremely inefficient. FIND ANOTHER LOCATION!

I had the sourdough and it was awesome. Good flavor, cooked to order. Fries were crisp and golden brown. The fry sauce perfect with just the right amount of relish in it. Healthy portion of fries too. 

I've eaten at some of the other places with the same ownership and like this the best.

This is the worst gym I have ever gone to. They cannot even keep the showers running. They are not open 24/7 any longer and the 800 number for billing is really messed up, they cannot even find your account. Go to fitness connection as tons better and 1/3 the cost.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: We had two of their deep dish pizzas.  And some of their adult cheese sticks as an appetizer.  Was 1pm on a weekday.  So no crowd.  The appetizer was good but limited.  6 cheese sticks.  The pizza was good.  But the crust was more like baked cornbread that deep dish.  Was ok.  But a little expensive for the experience we got.

Pretty awful. Paid for the "better" automated car wash, didn't clean my car at all. I could have done a better job just throwing a bucket of water at my car. What a total waste of money! And when I went looking for someone to talk to about it there was no one to be found! Don't waste your money!

Great breakfast place if you want a platter.  Not much else in yardley is open early, and serves a full breakfast meal.  This place opens at 6, friendly service,  good food, eggs pancakes meat, etc.  All for 7.25 pretty reasonable.  Definitely as good as Denny's which is a trek away in langhorne, with more small town atmosphere.

5 stars 

These guys were fantastic 
A phone call with an appointment 30min later 
Greeted by name - well looked after - great experience with haircut and shave for $40 
Old school set up and values ... But don't let the decor fool you - these guys are sharp !!!

Top notch! Sushi was fresh, a lot of specialty rolls to choose from. Miso and salad come with meal, not extra which is a nice change. Great service!
Only one problem, she couldn't get my card to read, I'm not sure they have the new chip sanners so just a heads up!
We will definitely be back!

Probably the worst service I've ever received at a sushi place. There's no one to seat you at the door and I watched others come into the restaurant looking for a host. Why is there even a host stand? The food was pricey and tasted mediocre. Don't think I'll be back.

Old world family Italian atmosphere...  The wait staff was excellent.  There was no waiting for your food or drinks.  The gnocchi with meat sauce was a hit as was the gnocchi with marinara sauce and a side of meatballs.  We ended our meal with a bowl of spumoni large enough to share!  This reminds us of New York!  We will return!!!

Old world family Italian atmosphere...  The wait staff was excellent.  There was no waiting for your food or drinks.  The gnocchi with meat sauce was a hit as was the gnocchi with marinara sauce and a side of meatballs.  We ended our meal with a bowl of spumoni large enough to share!  This reminds us of New York!  We will return!!!

Molto bene. Food like Nonna would make. At least I'm guessing it is if I had had an Italian grandmother. Another "will be back and bringing friends and family" for my Philly list. Amazing portions compared to the price. Totally affordable. Friendly and fun staff.

I have never been disappointed. 
Greg Baker is to pork what I.M. Pei is to architecture. 
Had the clams as an app,  which were tasty. Pork shoulder was perfect. I can say, without hyperbole, that the Refinery is the greatest place to eat on Earth for the next 10000 years.....
GO NOW!

Excellent food and service. Miso soup was the best I have had in a long time. The fish seems expertly prepared and is of great quality. The ordering process for the all you can eat was a little bit confusing at first, but it is a great deal. We will be back!

Another great Yelp find. The tacos are delicious ... street style done WELL.
Margaritas are delish, not too sweet with the perfect amount of tequila 
We've also tried the enchiladas and the pozole, both were excellent choices!
Very authentic, which is always the goal!

Great meal. A little disappointed with Caesar salad that was brown. Considering pricing I would hope the kitchen would be more observant on how food goes out.  Our waitress Sarah was sorry for the salad and apologized which was nice but my concern was the kitchen not our waitress.

Every meal here has blown me away. I couldn't overstate my recommendation. Very fresh ingredients, unique combinations and excellent preparation. You can tell they care about what they serve. Just Awesome. 

Go. Don't hesitate. You'll love it. 

It does get very busy at peak times so plan ahead!

Really great hibachi and sushi! I have eaten here once and had the King Lobster roll, and the chicken and steak hibachi. The dinner came with miso soup and salad. The dressing was perfect and not too spicy. All the staff I crossed paths with were very polite. I had Carmen as my waitress and she was extremely attentive and caring!!

I absolutely do not like going to the dunkin donuts. I order a sweetened iced tea with lemon. They put regular sugar in my iced tea so it just sits at the bottom and doesn't taste sweet. They can't even fill my drink all the way to the top. I will never go back to this dunkin.

This is probably one of the most unorganized franchises I have ever seen. 35 min to make a single cheeseburger, lack of staffing, lack of stock on hand. The one extra star is for Ian? He went above and beyond the rest of the staff to offer good customer service with what was available. But this location needs major help.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I get takeout here about once a week - usually a hibachi meal. The portions and food quality are great and they are able to get the food served to you pretty quickly. Its not the cheapest food but worth the couple extra dollars you spend. I haven't personally tried the sushi but I hear great things from co-workers.

I like this place! I have enjoyed dining here several times and typically get a few specialty rolls.  I have friends who love it here and rave about the "monkey brains" - not actually monkey brains.  It isn't always on the menu I believe it's a special but if you ask they will make it for you.

Hands down the best eats in Tampa. From the friendly staff to the weekly changing menu. You also can't forget the Sunday brunch is simply amazing I'm so glad I've stumbled upon this awesome little place. The chef has some of the oddest pairings of ingredients but they go together so well.

Just came back from a poor experience.  Outside wash fine: interior vacuum cleaning almost nonexistent. Was concerned after watching cursory   vacuuming of vehicle ahead of mine.  I paid for "The Works", $20 fee, didn't even wipe my dash/ armrests. Very disappointed.

New to the area and trying to find our Chinese place.  
This might be the worst Chinese food I've ever had! The rice was yellow rice and very bland.  The chicken was over cooked and the sauce was clumpy. The fortune cookies were stale too.   We ended up throwing the food away and cooking a late dinner.

Alright, the salad bar and other lunch options are great for a somewhat healthy and inexpensive lunch, but you need more staff to check and weigh items. If you offer the service than make sure you can deliver the service needed. Most people only have a short time for lunch.

Silly me, after we were seated I asked for menus. Mamma Maria's doesn't roll like that. Glorious. Five courses or seven and entree 1, 2, or 3 are the choices. Like being at my mamas house, the food keeps coming and not a bite was disappointing. Wine is included as is coffee and a cocktail with dessert. Price was very reasonable.

These guys need to change their name to 20 hour fitness
Since they're no longer a 24 hour gym. I mean how many of your client base  based on the idea that they would be a 24 hour gym. Maybe a sixth reduction in cost might be in order as well Since you took away a sixth of the gym hours.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: My family and I stumbled across Jimmy's Fish House quite by accident. But the atmosphere was welcoming so we decided to give it a try. The food was wonderful and our server was appropriately attentive. Fresh caught grouper (lightly breaded) and a lovely cup of tea.

I had a great experience here. Very convenient. Clean for the most part. There was a faint urine smell in the bathroom. I must give a huge thank you to Camar for his help. Very accommodating, pleasant, and helpful. One of the best customer service experiences I've had. Thank you, Camar!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Heather is phenomenal. I had bad triangle-curly hair from a previous cut that needed to go. She gave me my first Devacurl cut and I am so pleased. If you have curly hair that needs some love, go check them out! Cut+wash+style with a glass of wine was $45. No push to buy products if you didn't want to.

First time coming in and not going through Drive thru. Got breakfast and drinks with my son. Hot chocolate for him (bitter) and ice varamel latte for me (always yummy). Breakfast is blah. Grits are instant and were under cooked when given to us. Sausage and eggs were okay. 
Staff is decently friendly but not eager to help.

Had the mandarin chicken today. It was super fresh but it was extremely chewy and awkward to eat. Couldn't figure out if the chicken was old, uncooked or just poor choice of meat. Flavor was good and service was nice but I'd go to panda express before I'd come back.

The SPINACH AND ARTICHOKE DIP is a must get. Easily the best I've had and in my expertise, I've had some fantastic artichoke dip in my day. Anyway, the sausage and peppers were amazing (the most reviewed dish on their yelp or something like that) and the turtle cheesecake was to die for. Will come back.

What IS the deal with this location?!? While the baristas are always nice & polite and my order is usually correct, I am flabbergasted EVERY TIME I come here by how long it takes to get through it. Inside or drive through, it amazes me every time. 

It's the only one on my way to work however, soooooo.....

My experience at The Farm and Fisherman Tavern was pretty good, great ambiance. This is one of those places you drive by all the time and always tell your self you're going to hit, but never end up going. Hopefully I'll be back soon for an updated review. Cheers.

I really wanted to love it but the reality is most of their staff turns over quickly and is not experienced. I paid the most I have ever paid for a cut and got one of the worst. The retail and atmosphere is fabulous but a bad expensive haircut is unacceptable.

Ice cream was good. Went in about an hour before closing. Had to navigate our way around the workers mopping and cleaning up for closing. Spoons for toppings were being put away while customers were still coming in. Location on Los Altos seems a bit more friendly with a more "family type feel.

Wow. The best ice cream spot in St Pete Beach. Better than Larry's. Yup I said it. Why? The taste. And we asked why is it so good??? The staff said it is freshly made by the AMISH here in FL. Yes worth the stop. Unique flavors. And so clean. Will keep coming back!!

We a very good experience with Alamo at Tampa. The only issue was the smell of smoke in the air system. We needed to get air freshener to deal with the odor. Car itself was fine and the service was fine as well. A sign to remind drivers that there is no smoking would help.

This is probably my favorite restaurant in Tucson. It's also the only place I will eat sushi at anymore. The place is clean the food is amazing and the price is very reasonable for what you get. My friend and I go here so often that they know what we get every time.

Ate here with family for lunch food was fair and over priced. Atmosphere was terrible. This place needs a makeover there is seating on top of other diners. Can't be comfortable in hard wobbly chairs. Nothing to look at as the decor is probably the worse I have seen. They need paint new chairs. Tables

This place is great. Good sushi and they have a decent all you can eat option. I don't typically get that because I don't eat enough to pay for an all you can eat sushi, but I know my brother loves it. This place is also BYOB, which all sushi places should be!

I would recommend this place.

Food tastes fine, but it never knocks my socks off.  My biggest complaint though is that the menu has stayed the same forever.  A "nice" restaurant should be one you can go to often and be impressed.  Even their specials dont deviate from the same pallet as everything else and come with the same boring side items.

As other reviewers mentioned, my reservation was not respected. I arrived 5 minutes early and was not seated until 15 minutes after my reservation time. The food was 5/5, but the restaurant seemed short staffed and a bit hectic. I only saw my server sporadically. I would rate the service 1 or 2 out of 5.

Food isn't terrible, menu is decent, the buffet is adequate.  "Meh" just about covers it.  It gives off the atmosphere of being an "old people" place meaning, while obviously not true, everything seems boiled.  Which is probably okay.  Considering that I AM an old people.

We only live a couple miles from here but didn't know it existed.  What a great place! Very quaint with wonderful food! My husband had veal and I had gnocchi, both were the best we've had in quite sometime. Prices very reasonable. We will definitely be back!

Not really impressed. Service was ok. The waitress was very sweet everything else was pretty sub par.I asked for medium cooked steak and got rubber instead. Chef was not very interactive nor skillful at his tricks. There are definetly better hibachi restraunts to try rather than this place.

If you're into volume and not taste this is your place.  The beans were bland, the tortilla chips greasy, the cheese bland, the salsa fresca was totally uninspiring.  
Like 1 reviewer said, "on the outside it just has it all...the smell, the locals, ..
I went for the food and got nothing except calories for my $.

This place is cute ykno, I came here just to catch a quite lunch. I got a normal bowl of wonton noodle soup and it was very hot and gave you lots of veggies. This place is very convenient and cozy so its just a little restaurant in Chinatown waiting for you when you have no where to eat.

This was one of my best stays ever at a hotel. The staff is super friendly and makes an effort to remember each guest for more personalized service. Dogs are allowed for a $135 damage deposit, and an additional $35 for the entire duration of the stay. Much better than places that charge $25/night!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We ordered two burgers, one with no onion, one with no tomatoes. We were in the drive-through so our order came up on their screen.

Brought the food back to the hotel room, and they had given us two old ass, cold burgers, both with tomatoes and onions. Like, what? We were the only two people at the joint, no excuse for that BS

We were in town visiting on vacation. The bacon wrapped shrimp and my husbands shrimp/chicken were both great! The best part was the mixed berry margarita that I got! Our waiter was really friendly. There didn't seem to be enough waiters and no one to bus the tables, but we enjoyed it!

I really like the interior, but I don't like how online it says open till 11 but then I get there to work on a paper and they tell me at 8:56pm they close in 4 minutes. They didn't have their hours posted anywhere in the store. I also don't like how they start putting their food away at 7:30pm.

Amazing! Lookout there is a new contender for sushi in Tucson. This place has the great classics but takes it a step further with some amazing creative rolls. Very impressed with staff and atmosphere.  Prices are great and the cucumber wrapped rolls are the best I've had in Tucson. A must visit.

This is probably some of the worst Chinese food I've had. I've eaten at many different chinese restaurants and everything I've had from this restaurant is below average.  You can get your food fast, but you can't get good food.  We need another Chinese restaurant in the area.

I go here a couple of times per year and the food is usually pretty good. I just left there after having the meatloaf special. I should have opted for a sandwich.
