The meatloaf special was not very good. The mashed potatoes had the consistency of gruel. Sorry,  but I did not enjoy my most recent experience.

Came here at the recommendation of the concierge at the Ritz.  I'd give it a solid B.  I tend to rate sushi joints by the quality of their unagi (eel) and it was good here, as was the rest of the sushi (especially the seaweed salad), but nothing outstanding.

I am a customer of that restaurant for 30 years. what is nice about food is consistency. You know that you get the dish with the same quality and taste. One more time:  Really good food quality and service. Always open! Highly recommended for lunches and dinners as well.

One of the best burgers and craft beers I have ever had!!!  The only downfall was that they were out of the entree I really wanted to eat (and there are only a few entrees to choose from).  It's good that it's a small menu, as you can tell they do a great job focusing on what they have.  Keep up the good work!!

I called Kid Glasses as a change from our optician we've used for years hoping for better selection for children. The man I spoke with on the phone was extremely rude so I cancelled right then and there. I'd rather have the same frames then be treated the way I was. I wouldn't waste my time even calling this bussiness
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Very friendly staff!!  Excellent wait time..none!  This particular location is large & very well spread out so if you are concerned about Covid distancing this is the place for you.  Very clean, mask required right now & everyone had them on.  

Highly recommend!!!!!

A small but nice place for one or couples. Very close to City Hall. Bubble tea is highly recommended. I also ordered salmon bento box with California rolls, shaomai and salad in it. Enough for me and price is reasonable. As I remember the coconut bubble tea cost me $3.5 and salmon bento box less than $10.

Everyone with a one star is right. They charge you a couple of hundred dollars "deposit" that they are supposed to refund 3-5 business days after you return the car. They never do. I have a dispute going on right now with American Express. This company is a scam! Read the yelp reviews!

The food quality here has always been kind of touch and go (at least for takeout), but tonight I had straight up rotten grapes in my Anthony's Signature Salad and it was just gross. The times we have called the service has been slow and unfriendly. Tonight's meal was just super disappointing.

The service was very nice.  Spinach salad was really good with avocado and blue cheese.  I should have heeded the steak house ambience.  The salmon might have been from a warming lamp at Denny's.  Dry and without enough residual good flavor to see it's way beyond the garnishment sauce.

Definitely the best Mexican joint in town! Top shelf margaritas are the highlight of this place. Pretty much had everything on the menu here, never have I been unsatisfied. Prices are reasonable food is extraordinary. But back to the margaritas, they are Godly!

Came here for breakfast and had a good experience. The play area was great and deserves 5 stars. Food was the same as any other McD's. Gave 4 stars because it could have easily been a bit tidier but as we were leaving I saw an employee doing some wipe downs so maybe this is unusual.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Great place! It's family owned and family run and they're the nicest people. I love the food, if you haven't tried the cabbage salad it comes with a secret-recipe dressing that's to die for and is a great starter to any meal. The prices are great as is the food and I'm always happy to return!

We have been coming here for many years.  Things have changed so much with the new owners. Food is good but the portions are now so much smaller. No consistency in portion size.   Way to overpriced for the newly skimpy portions. Unfortunately, We will go elsewhere after our latest order.

Tonight was our first time to go Holly Spa and Nails. I found the atmosphere pleasant and clean. The price for the pedicures was in line with every other place around here. I asked for a flower on my toe and was pleasantly surprised that they added several things bedsides a single flower.  Definitely will be going back

Just had one of the best manicure and pedicures I've had in a long time! I didn't get the woman's name and I wish I did because she deserves all the credit. She was very detailed and did an amazing job. 
I live in LA, I'm just visiting family here for a few days. I wish I could take her back with me! lol

Customer service from Assistant Manager is subpar!  His personal interaction skills need improving. I have encountered him many times and he never seems like he cares about the customer. Other employees have been pleasant but I will be doing my shopping elsewhere.

Great staff friendly clean rooms updated modern good points and bad points not so much parking and the rooms say no smoking but there is a stench of cigarettes smell so bring a candle if u pick this place or if u smoke it won't bother you. If only it didn't smell like smoke this place be a 5
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place was disgusting.. they don't even know how to make toast.. raw hasbrowns.. will never be back. Don't waste your money here.. The best one hands down is the one by the airport on valencia.. You might have to wait longer for your food but it's well worth the wait and the staff is awesome.

Me and my parents had a good stay here. But the toilet flushed bad, and the wifi did barely work. Otherwise, it was a good stay. Nice rooms (they are like small apartments) with kitchen, tv, fireplace etc. Remember to rent a car if you go here. Free breakfast buffet!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Don't expect anything fancy. Don't expect to get seated.
Expect good food for good price. There are better options out there but if you're not planning on spending a whole lot, this is the place. I suggest bento boxes, not sure about other meats but chicken and beef are pretty good.

We went to this restaurant out of convenience since we were staying at the hotel. I really enjoyed the salmon but my husband got the petite filet and baked potato (which was served warm) and he wasn't crazy about it. The bar selection was good but prices seemed elevated overall.

When I lived in Tampa, I used to go here at least twice a month.  They have an excellent Happy Hour $2 martinis.  Their menu offerings are also at a discount until 7pm.  

Tip:  It gets really crowded here; especially on the weekends so you either need to make reservations or get there early.

It was OK. Haven't been to this place in a while. I wouldn't recommend takeout. All I asked for was sashimi (5/6 pieces) and veg tempura. Sashimi was good, tempura had a nice batter. They said they'd be done in 30 mins, but it went well over, and lasted about an hour. The restaurant wasn't even that busy it was 5PM.

Not impressed. Menu stated my sundae was $3.89 plus $0.50 for each topping. I got two extra toppings and somehow it came out to just under $6. Also, there was a giant hole in the middle of my sundae. The entire middle of my cup was a gaping hole of missing ice cream. Wont be returning.

Had dinner there last night as the owners closed Wild Iris. Expected it to be similar but there was no comparison. No atmosphere and very noisy. Good was sub-par for this level restaurant and the service was very poor. Would not recommend this place at all.

Took my car here and I had a great experience. Art listened to my car issues and also diagnosed frame issues that other shops didn't bother to even look at. They are quick and reasonable. I brought my other car in as well for the air conditioning another great job and that fixed my door handle too.

As a frequent monthly user of Holiday Inn Express' for business my normal hotel was full.  The White House HIE is definitely not worth $176 a night.  Beds very uncomfortable.  Room had bad odor. Very loud hallway noise until at least 2am.  I will be so happy to be back at the Mount Juliet TN HIE next time
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The pizza was fantastic. We loved being able to pick unlimited toppings. Plus they have gluten free options and if its allergy based, they'll wipe the oven and change gloves. We will definitely come back. Happy Hour is 2 - 5 I think. $5 pizzas with unlimited toppings!!!

From the fabulous drink mixer menu to the amazing meal and wonderful service, our dinner could not have been better! The calamari appetizer was delicious (though a little bit tough). The strip steak was perfectly seasoned and cooked. HIGHLY recommend dinner here!

I actually really like this Hyatt. The room is nice, the view was decent, and overall the vibe of this hotel did not disappoint at all. It's not far from anything. Lyft and Uber can get you around easily for food and other places to visit while you're here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Incredible atmosphere and wonderful food.  Make sure to do a reservation, this place is worth it!  We sat outside on the patio and it was so comfortable.  They don't rush you and the food comes out quickly. The grilled gnocchi and the Sunday gravy are incredible- but be smart and share.

Stopped by here for an NFL kickoff party. It was well done and so festive with the football theme. Decorations, games and the huge flat screen, bleachers photo booth etc were great. Staff was very welcoming and the bon fire outside was lovely.  Location is great if your looking to visit Santa Barbara!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I had the sunomono salad. The octopus was still slightly frozen.  I also had the rainbow roll.  The server was pleasant and attentive but it was neither phenomenal or lackluster.  It's a bit of a run down look but the sushi seemed fresh and the green tea was hot.

Sushi was great, but bring a parka if you go! Went last night and they were having issues with the heat- two small space heaters for the entire restaurant didn't help at all. Guess they wanted to make sure no one stayed around too long.. quickly in and out.

Bad, very bad. Ordered double quarter pounder. Got a regular one. Also ordered 10 pc McNuggets. Costed over $10.  Both were not warm. Staff not motivated at all. Toilets dirty, tables dirty. Last one leaving turn lights off and lock the door please. Permanently.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Disappointing, rolls were poorly made (big chunks of fish on one end no fish in the other and not cut all the way through) also had several bones in our fish and found a dead worm in the edamame. However, our server Rocelle was really nice and pretty much saved the evening with complimentary a Saki.

I love this place. The staff is very friendly, and the service is pretty quick. I usually get a large coffee before I hit the gym. I order on the go through the dd app before I leave my house and by the time I get there  my coffee is sitting at the pick up window.

Super clean and friendly staff. Probably the most comfortable bed in a hotel I have ever slept in. Easy to find and simple check in-out process. They also have free parking for up to 14 days if you are going on a cruise. That's the reason we picked this place.  Super great value as well. Would definitely recommend staying here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Rented out their business room for my baby shower & was absolutely pleased with everything! I got to rent it out for a great price , and got to keep it all day ! 

Plus the staff were very professional and welcoming to all my guests, despite the fact that we got a bit loud during games . 
I would definitely recommend This hotel !
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Our first time here and it was awesome. Small place with friendly people. June was our waitress and even asked for our names for "next time". We ordered sushi and it was delicious. I have a soy allergy and they handled it no problems. BYO highly recommend it if you are in the Lansdale area looking for Sushi!

I used to love their clams and linguine and a red sauce. But apparently they decided to cut corners on this dish. Instead of a rich marinara sauce with tomato pieces I had something that resembles something closer to Campbell's tomato soup. It's a shame but I won't be going back

Had the steak sandwich and it was outstanding! Very cute little spot that feels very homey. Also a nice spot for convos and a few drinks. Would recommend this place to someone who likes a different flare on food. Did I mention how amazing the steak sandwich is??

Beautiful hotel, staff nice. There were a group of young ladies twerking in the hot tub with music while children were in there swimming mine included. And when we were ready for bed the room next to us made so much noise all night it was a little impossible to get my girls to bed at a reasonable time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: GREAT SUSHI!!! I never really had bad sushi, but this place is by far the best I've ever had. Their Hibachi is awesome too. The chef we had was very funny and entertaining. Very great food all around. I've been here 3 times already and will keep coming back.

Cute little shop at the corner that serves decent sushi at pretty reasonable prices. Had the butterfly maki which consists of salmon sashimi and avocado. There are also bento sets which come with a choice of tempura, chicken or beef served together with sashimi and miso soup. Overall, this place is great for a quick sushi fix.

Food was amazing. Had Crab Fondido (actually full of crab and cheese) and Vegetable Enchiladas. I liked the enchiladas because unlike most, it was filled with butternut squash, corn, and cauliflower...veggies you don't normally see in mexican veggie dishes.

Everything was very tasty and staff was super friendly.

Worthless staff. Brought a broken enterprise cargo van here as instructed by the location where we rented. Got here and was greeted rudely by someone who made their broken van my problem. No effort whatsoever to own the problem and solve it for the customer. Never again.

So I am giving Nino's a 3 star rating because the food was prepared to satisfaction however I was unimpressed with the pizza. I was never impressed before the new owners took over but now I am even more unlikely to get pizza from here again. The fries were nice and crisp. The ceasar salad was good.

Top 2 restaurants in downtown Saint Petersburg. I ate the Pork Ossobuco last week for dinner and my goodness, it was the best dish I've had all year hands down! Service is always fantastic, and the $10 corking fee gives Gratzzi something no other restaurant can compete with. Overall Gratzzi has it figured out. 10/10

Ordered a double bacon pizza and wings tonight- got a pizza with 5 small strips of bacon on it with wayyyyy too much cheese with wings without any dipping sauce as requested or the parm and red pepper requested and it was cold.... wishing I would have called Imo's in instead

I love Mexican food so I had to try it. I had the steak fajitas. The meat was very fatty and no taste. Guacamole had no flavor either. The beans were great!  Sangria was not homemade and was served warm. The service was mediocre. The price was excellent. Won't be back at any price.

After the holiday weekend everyone was booked! Unfortunately I took a screw to my tire and needed it fixed, and fast. I spoke to AB Ramos in the front and he managed to get me in and out within 90 minutes. (Had a couple people in front of me) He was very polite and professional. I would definitely recommend services done here.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I took my 10 year old son here for a haircut.   He was well overdue for a cut.  I explained to Frank what kind of cut we were looking for.   He did it perfectly.   My son rarely mentions his hair,  but commented at least 10 times today how much he loved it.   Thanks!   We will definitely be back.

The reason I'm posting this is because I was there today and when I was talking to Liz she said that I lost my mind because of my girlfriend so that is the reason I am posting I did like this place but to me this place is not a friendly place yeah we joke around but that was taking It too far.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
I like pizza but this is not my kind of pizza. It is tucked away in near the El Dorado Casino and is probably a cheap snack if you want something quick and easy. 

It is more like a New York style pizza where it kind of falls apart and is quite greasy. I don't like greasy because it tends to irritate my stomach.

I was at the restaurant for the Social Media Club panel discussion. This was my first visit and only took time for a drink and appetizer. They had a small selection of scotch with the standard fare. I tried the calamari which was very bland. So, while that was disappointing, the service was pleasant, but not attentive.

12/10 fuck this McDonald's. I waited in line for 20 minutes after working a rough night shift just for them to tell me at the screen that they weren't accepting card. If you're gonna do cash only at least be gracious enough to put a sign that says so. What a huge unnecessary waste of time.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I come once a week for 3 things. Top shelf Margaritas, chips and salsa, and Ceviche. In that regard, I love this place. The molcajete is my favorite main dish period. Gringos like myself typically get fajitas or quesadillas, but trust me, get the molcajete. Tacos are good too.

I went in to buy a new pair of frames today. I cannot believe how rude Dr. Lockland was! She made a smart comment about everything I asked about or said.  It's a wonder that this store is still open the way she treats customers.  Needless to say, I do not recommend this store and will never visit again.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Horrible service - avoid on weekends if at all possible. There are some great vegan options which sounded delicious, but we didn't get to find out because we had been waiting for two hours with no updates from our waitress and no refills. There are far better options in the city for vegan brunch.

This is the best veterinary veterinary hospital I've ever had. From the staff at the desk to the veterinary tech/nurse to the vet themselves. Totally professional, caring experts in animal care, affordable. I have five cats and am making them my veterinary care for all five

Ordered a steak and onion panzarotti, 1 plain and 1 mini garlic. They were all very good, I loved them. I deducted 1 star because the garlic tasted exactly like the plain cheese. I'm not sure if I was given both cheese by mistake or the garlic taste is just non existent. Either way I will be back for sure.

Rooms are small.
Workout room is terrible.  The worst I have ever seen.
Was in workout room with another hotel guest, very uncomfortable,  felt like we were on top of each other. 
No weight bench.  No water cooler.
Would not stay here, except every other hotel filled.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: So disheartened by this recent experience. I ordered delivery through Cuisine to Go, the Chicken Parmesan and crème brule pie. The chicken parm was so salty and soggy that I found it difficult to eat. the pie on the other hand was delicious! all in all it was just ok.

Recently had lunch here. I had a combo of a taco, enchilada and tamale with rice. It was very good, but not 5 star worthy great. A little pricey compared to the joint across the street. The salsa with the chips was top notch. Nice place with a cool atmosphere. You could certainly do worse in this area.

A large section of flavors and server was very friendly and patient while I tried to decide what I wanted. I tried their chocolate chocolate chip and vanilla toffee ice cream. Very expensive, ice cream was good, but not amazing. They also have yogurt. I liked the benches in front a lot. It was nice sitting there, eating ice cream.

Ordered a sausage and mushroom pie for delivery. 
Absolutely the worst pizza I ever had!!
I'm a pizza snob but I hoped the pizza would be at least adequate but was not. 
First and foremost the use can mushrooms. Wet, soggy canned mushrooms!
The pizza was very doughy and tomato sauce was terrible. 
Never again.

Attended a business meeting and came early so I could eat. I had the chicken marsala with whipped potatoes and spinach salad. The chicken was excellent, the potatoes were cold, and the spinach salad was good but hard to fork. Service was good but a little slow. I was in about five might been shift change.

I was provided a quote for work to be done and when I went to book it in, the quote increased by over double.  I told them I was going to think about it, and when I called back to cancel, they didn't seem to really care.  Went there once, not sure I'll go back.

Not a good car wash. They never vacuum the trunk even if you ask for it.  They always have an excuse.  Takes forever.  Friday I was there for 1 hour and 30 minutes.  Never even vacuum my trunk.  They do not take pride in their work. I do kit recommend this place.

Rundown. That is pretty much the overwhelming takeaway from this 12 story disappointment. Service is so so, but this place is pretty tapped out; water stained ceilings, minimal HVAC, outlets that don't work, etc..  You would be much better off at the Courtyard a few miles away.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Worst stuffs ever. The guy who made my order was unprofessional. He asked me to hurry up in ordering when I was taking to my kid asking her what she wanted on her sandwich. Then, he started asking the next customer about his order before finishing mine. I had to leave to other Subway where the stuffs respect their customers.

Staff is super helpful and very honest!  You cant find a car repair/tire shop that you can trust anymore.  They don't try and sell you stuff you don't need.  The store manager Juan Carlos is a great person to deal with and I would refer anyone to this location.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Priceline was 4.5 star hotel. No way 45.00 a night parking and tiny rooms. Door literally hit the bathroom. No tub. Terrible valet service! Called ahead to have car brought around 20 min before we went down. Had to wait 30-45 min to get the car. I will never stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Everything was fine untill we got to dessert. We ordered dougnuts and the inside was not even fully cooked ...the doughnuts were raw inside they didn't offer anything to compensate us or to speak to a manager about the concern. Highly suggest not going here!!!

Staff is just sitting at table on phones.  

Made my sandwich pulled it out of the microwave before it was fully heated (roasted chicken) and went back to sitting at the table.  Didn't wash hands.

Ice tea is empty.  The tables were dirty.  The chips not stocked.  Might want to get better management.

2/26/17 Noise has gotten louder, floors boards overhead have really taken a beating! The noise is annoying and nothing has been done about it from office. The apartments are poor quality and the paper thin carpet provides no insulation. Beware! Shop around before deciding on Camelot!

I really admire the people who work here they made my visit extremely comfortable even though my toddler was being a handful the only reason i didn't give a full 5 is because i feel the optometrists couldve been in a better mood definitely the only thing that made the visit unpleasant.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Fun bar. Drinks are strong and give a nasty hangover from all the sugar, but you can't come to New Orleans and not get a hand grenade. They taste good, the bar is fun and crazy and sticky. The crowd is rowdy. Exactly what we were looking for. I would definitely go back.

Iv'e come here for years and never disappointed . I order the same thing : chicken with broccoli and white rice , fried rice , and sometimes egg drop soup . My order is served up in 10 minutes or less . You can help yourself to as much condiments as you like .

To go order was correct, piping hot, quality was excellent. Very consistent, good quality every time we order. Today we had Chicken/Broccoli, Kung Pao Chicken, Pork Fried Rice with extra egg and several appetizers. They have handled any past minor problems quickly and professionally.

Usually its pretty nice at this location but recently 3 of their air conditioning units were broken. It had to of been 100 degrees in there on these hot days plus all the people working out. There was no reassurance that it would get fixed soon. I just felt like they should have found a way to keep everyone happy.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Never go here. Took my car here for a muffler. The guy Jim who helped me told me I needed more then a muffler and the total cost would be $1150. Went down the street they told me I did not need any of the other stuff just the muffler and it only cost me $240.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This is a great place to stay! Rooms recently renovated.  Staff are friendly and very helpful.  I come here to this area several times a year and have stayed here several times!   Always very happy with my stay!  Thank you!  Bob Evans is next door which makes getting meals quite easy for my grandson and me!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Customer service is horrible after 1pm. The morning crew  keeps the place going, After 1pm it's like a zombie crew comes in and has no clue how to run the place. Sitting at the speaker of the drive thru for 20mins without getting your order is unacceptable. Get it together Dunkin!

This place offers a really good burger! It's juicy, fresh and flavorful. The French fries are thin and served pulping hot. I have tried the original and the rosemary version. I couldn't really tell the difference in flavor. Thankfully the service is fairly quick since it is located in the Philadelphia airport food court.

I just needed to vacuum my car but they said I could only vacuum with an $8 car wash. I told him I'd pay for the vacuum but he refused. This happens right after I go to another car wash 4 min away where the vacuums WERENT EVEN WORKING. Can a girl just vacuum her car in this town...

Had the worst service this morning 6/15/19. If your morning crew is having a bad day, don't bring them in. A simple "have a good day" instead of basically tossing my items at me silently, would be nice. Customer service is always an issue at this location, inside and drive thru.

The customer service from the younger woman with brown hair in particular, was horrible. Headset on, trying to bring food to customers in the room, while also taking orders. She was rude to me as well as my father, and people like her can ruin an entire visit. Saturday, July 10 at 7:50am.

Working in the area & saw this place. Should have stuck with our plan to hit Taco Bell. Service was fine but the food is like cardboard. I love Mexican food because they're not afraid of flavor. Not the case here. It was awful. The cost was the same as any other Mexican restaurant. Very disappointed.

The worst service and drinks I've ever had! I would give this place zero stars. We ordered strawberry daiquiris which tasted like dish soap. The sea food was fresh but the waitress wouldn't give us the time of day to explain that the drinks were horrible and they still added the 18% gratuity to the bill.

This is a handy spot to grab a quick drink and sandwich or stop in for apps and a drink. Most apps are heavy, almost all are fried. Tots were an awesome deal and tasty, buffalo and coconut shrimp ok and the Ruben roll (fried) ok. But it's a grease stop fill er up place. Average rating for average place!

If I want to get pizza delivered from Royal I have to get it from the west end location. It's never as good as when I pick up and get it from the Hamptons location. Always inconsistent with their quality. Last night I ordered and barely any sauce on the pizza and undercooked. From now on I will just pick up from the Hamptons!

I haven't rented a car from Hertz in years, but recently needed to do so. It was easy to make the reservation, the customer service representative was friendly and knowledgeable, and the car was clean and ready to go. No hassle experience; pleasantly surprised!

My first time eating Kyoto today. Did Cali and Dynamite rolls for take-out. Both lacked flavour. Maybe I'm too used to Vancouver sushi, just moved here... I'll keep looking for my go to spot, Kyoto will only be on times of Sushi desperation. Great atmosphere inside though.

I really like this place. The food is authentic and fresh. Service is quick and attentive. I have only ever either dined in or picked up food so I can't speak for the delivery service. The flan here is the best I've ever had. Portions are big. This is my go-to Mexican joint.

I was in the area for a family wedding and got a stain on my dress before the wedding. I was panicked and luckily found Pro Cleaners through family's recommendations. They were extremely friendly and had great prices. Most importantly they got my dress super clean and on time for the wedding. I highly recommend!!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I had a great experience renting a car at the airport. D'Andrea, one of the managers, was extremely helpful. The car was in great condition, and the rental was as simple as it could get. The last time I rented from Alamo was in the late 80s so I didn't know what to expect. I was totally pleased and impressed. Thanks Alamo.

Superb!  We have recently moved to Ambler and have now been to this restaurant 3 times for dinner, two times for Tuesday small plates.  Without exception , the food, drinks and service are top notch.  We have sampled everything from vegetarian offerings to their homemade gelato.  You can't go wrong with this restaurant.

It seems most either love or really dislike this place. I can't say I really dislike this place, but I can tell you the pizza is weird. There's very little cheese. I'm sure that's by design, but it doesn't make sense to me. I will very likely go elsewhere for pizza but I may try a sub at some point. No rush though.

Dependably good hibachi. They have some unexpected dishes on their menu like Monkey Brains and Bibinbop. I've tasted or ordered everything on the menu multiple times. It is all good. 
Their sushi is also very good, don't let the half off sushi days fool you the rolls are awesome and the fish is high quality.

Decent sushi. After waiting awhile I almost wanted to switch over to Mexican food instead of sushi. Chef should had brought the food one at a time instead of all at the same time cause literally I waited 20 mins until I get my food. Service was okay waiter kept checking on us.

I love this store, very friendly staff!! They have a wide variety of things to buy from here!! The staff is very kind and they get to know you!! Gus the owner will stock things in his store if he doesn't have it on the shelf! He goes above and beyond to make his customers happy!

Very surprising with wonderful sushi! They have sushi other restaurants don't have. Different combinations that some would not normally think to put together but it works and is really delicious. The staff was very friendly and the restaurant is very clean. Will definitely go back.

Excellent food! 
This was my first experience here but not my last.  I had the sweet and sour chicken & a vegetable roll.  Wonderful crispy coating on both.  Not greasy or heavy like some other places. Fast, courteous service.  This is my new "go-to" Chinese restaurant.

My husband and i decided to try Rizzo's again because we live super close and we figured why not give it another shot. I was pleasantly surprised. I still think it's a bit overpriced but the food was good, our server was attentive and drinks were kept filled.

The pasta doesn't taste like anything but sour. The sauce tastes just like water. The quality of the food is not so good as its reputation. The waiter serves the neighbor table water. When we ask for water, he suggested there is a soda machine and let us to get it by ourselves.

Michael was very helpful and pleasant to deal with, he voluntarily shared with us good places to visit in the area, explained very well rental coverage benefits. Nice and professional young gentleman. Processing took less than 5 minutes, much quicker than most rental places.

Only person in the restaurant. 9 minutes for a cup of coffee. 
Watching the lady set up for breakfast handling muffins with her bare hands wiping them on her pants.
Flies all over the place and nobody seems to notice. Especially the ones landing on the muffins!
What the hell?
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I was sad to see Blue Belly go, but I am so pleased that Square Pie is its replacement! The crust is thick but airy, the sauce is delicious, and the sides are a perfect way to supplement a small pie for two. We enjoyed the meatballs and arancini. I only wish they were open on Sundays!

Worst pizza I've ever had. Cold, with burnt edges and horrible tasting sauce. Granted, we ordered on a Sunday at peak hours, and I t took 1 hr and 15 minutes for it to arrive. I understand they were probably slammed with orders, but that doesn't justify the low quality of their food.

Service is prompt and also there is professional staffing at the front desk. 
My husband and I enjoyed a clean room.
Also spent a night in a room on the 6th floor and enjoyed a Romantic view.


Complimentary breakfast at the lounge


I would recommend this place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Have you ever wanted to drink a pink starbursts? This is it. So amazingly sweet but not overwhelming. It is so smooth that you won't mind drinking one of three and regretting it when you realize you can't get off the bar stool. Hand granates are the real deal!!

Normally I hand wash but I desperately needed a wash and decided to stop here on my break.  Instantly regret this since I finished with the car not being very clean and clear coat scratches EVERYWHERE.  Now I will have to get my paint touched up from just one wash

Pretty sure we saw a drug deal while we were there, so there's that. Also, the server was really impatient with our order and didn't get my husbands order correct at all. Food was ok, nothing worth going back for. So bummed, was really hoping to have found a great neighborhood Mexican restaurant to come back to!

On a recent trip down to Florida, I had the opportunity to visit Retro Fitness. I was very impressed by the friendly, professional staff.  Everyone was respectful and courteous. Cleanliness is a plus, so I will definitely visit this club on my future travels. Keep up the great work!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
John is as honest as the day is long.  His work is top-notch, his rates are reasonable, and he gets the work done quickly.  He and his crew can work on almost any car.  I've never had a mechanic I'd recommend more highly -- and I've tried quite a few in Santa Barbara.  Give him your business -- you won't be sorry.

-Doug

Good Donuts, I'm only giving them 3 because I'm a huge chocolate lover, but not a cake donut fan. I feel most of the chocolate options come in cake form only. I do love the Apple pie donut, so if I'm more in the mood for not chocolate I know where I'm going, otherwise doughboys never disappoints.

My tire completely popped & these gentlemen took great care of me. I'm a young girl who knows nothing about cars and they were honest, friendly, and super quick! If you are new in town or looking for a reliable auto shop.... This is your spot! Extra thanks to Wesley Leon for the hospitality and great advice! I will return.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Nice people and quick service. The pizzas are tasty enough (better than Dominos for sure). One time they made a mistake on my order. When I called them, they put a note on my account for a free pizza the next time. This is a company that knows how to treat its customers.

Not ever going to try this place again.  They offer deals left and right and you can neer actually use one.  When I buy a deal, I actually go into the business and spend extra money and tip well.  They refused my deal weeks before expiration.  This place is a JOKE

Stopped in for a quick breakfast, apparently that is somewhat lost on this place! No one at the counter ever! They just look at you and ignore you! Finally used the kiosk, which I don't mind but why not hang a sign saying to do so instead of people looking around and waiting. Food was good and order was correct.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Creme brulee, I would give it a 4 out if 5. The ambiance is very clean and nice. The customer service was really good, i needed to place a special order and the host help accommodate me to make the Valentine's Day very special for my partner. No complaints on my end! I want to come back and try the pizza soon!

I had the carne asada and the al pastor. I was somewhat underwhelmed by the flavor and have tasted much better taco places. The positive was that there was a lot of meat in the taco and the hot sauce was spicy. Other than that the taco was not too memorable for me.

I went in for an oil change and was told I needed brakes and rotors, over $400.00. I am on a limited income and it's not in my budget. I took my car elsewhere and found out I only needed brake pads for $160.00 It was fast and a good price for an oil change but that's about all I'll let them do.

It was ok. But really just ok. Sat at the bar and was hoping to interact with the folks making the sushi. They did not even say hello. And the restaurant was almost empty. 


The rolls I got were nice. But not a lot of favor to them. I felt like I was eating rice with soy sauce. 

But the waitress was nice and very attentive.

The food is still good most of the time. However be cautious of the hours posted online. As I leave this review they are supposed to be open yet they are not.  This is the third time they were scheduled to be open but are not and there is no information as to why.

Menagerie oozes modern sophistication from the moment you walk in! Tucked into a cozy, quaint location, you feel as though you've stumbled on a hidden gem. The baristas behind the bar are welcoming and attentive, happy to chat as they whip up an excellent pour over. I'll definitely be back!

I love salmon and was VERY HAPPY with the salmon/veggie/lemon dish (forgot the name) my hubby didn't care much for his chicken pasta (old chicken/ felt like it was freezer burn at one point) not good! Lack of Service /on a slow day, felt awkward, nice place thou

I stop in to sushi ai often because its QUIcK, EASY and CONVENIENT when i shop in this area "market plc" its well done Generic Japanese....rolls are always consistently good with one exception the scallops roll-very fishy &over cooked. Over all Good, with fair pricing, and staff is professional.

We were in the neighborhood and decided to have some sushi, so I yelped this place and was very happy with my decision. The fish was so fresh, it just melted in your mouth. If you are ever in the neighborhood, stop by and give them a try. You will not be disappointed.

We were excited to try this place based on the reviews.
The good: the sushi we ordered was tasty and fresh.
The mediocre: the hibachi was ok nothing special.
The bad: Our service was poor. They were not friendly, didn't refill our drinks, and we had to wait forever after our meal for our check.

Ho-hum.

The doughnuts are fairly tasty. I'm not sure if the staff understands that there are 12 in a dozen. In a recent purchase of a dozen doughnut holes, I only got six. My previous purchase seemed light too, but I never thought to count them(they were for my kid) One of my doughnut holes was the size of a grape.

We stopped at their food truck parked over by Kohl's today. Ice cream and waffle cones were delicious. They didn't have any place to sit so we stayed in the truck. If you want good old fashioned hand dipped ice cream without fancy toppings it is a great option.

I travel over a half hour just to eat here! Been going here for years (even before the current owners) and I gotta say... It's great! My wife REFUSES to eat anywhere else as far as Chinese takeout goes... They actually use real rice... No cheap yellow rice here! Tried almost all the menu over the years... NEVER DISAPPOINTED!

Solid pizza, a bit heavy on the cheese but that's an easy fix. Good, non-greasy crust. Great service. The beer was limited, but cold and reasonably priced.  The patio is great and is well suited for a great winter season and watching games. We'll be back for sure.

Do not rent from this place! I left my wallet in the car accidentally and my necklace was stolen out of my wallet and nothing has been done about it. It was my mother's day gift from my kids who bought it with money they saved. Would give 0 stars but wasn't an option

Complete garbage! None of the food is actually grilled. Everything tastes like rubber due to being deep fried and nuked in the microwave. Even the ribs..yeah those ribs that are smothered in liquid smoke. Then baked for several hours followed by another nuking and served on a platter with a fresh out the microwave condiment.

Had a pre purchase inspection done here prior to buying a vehicle from a dealership. They were very fair in their pricing, and gave me a good idea of the vehicle's condition. They were also very timely with the service, and spent time with me to make sure I understood the vehicle I was planning on purchasing.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This place is awesome. My wife and I come here every week. Chef Vargas is a wonderful person and his staff is super friendly. The empanadas are the best I've ever tasted. Everyone raves about the chicken and waffles as well. Support local businesses and give this place a try.

Great meal. The appetizers were wonderful.  Complex flavors, perfect. The crab cake.. so good, hard to describe. So much great food, just too full for desert. My loss, for sure. The freshly baked cookies were the perfect end to a fantastic meal with service to match.

I dont normally eat Wendy's but since it was across the street i figured why not! My experience was absolutely perfect. Food was amazing, fresh, fast, and most importantly it was what i ordered! Thomas took my order and was the most pleasant fast food employee i have encountered in tucson! Good job Wendy's!

If you like to get ripped off, this is the place for you. Just spent $5 on two different stalls to try and wash my truck. Neither one had a working foam brush and one didn't even have running water. So basically just spent $10 just to wash my truck with water. Best part they have no contact info listed. F$&& this place.

1. Tasty, flavorful sushi
2. Chic ambience 
3. Great service, friendly staff

Gotta dock a star off because I ordered an extra sushi platter with my friend & that sushi roll was not the tastiest. Threw off the vibe of the other delicious rolls. Just a personal preference. Too bad I forgot the name of that roll :(

Went in after a friend referred me. Ended up with Nick Miller cutting my hair and fixing my beard. Easily one of the best experiences I've had, and I'll be back for sure. 

If you're in Indy looking for an awesome hair cut, definitely go in and ask for Nick. He's the short, really ginger guy. He'll do you right.

Dined last night with family and was disappointed in our food. The service was very good, friendly. The entree ( pasta with sweet sausage, rabe, beans was well over cooked. The pasta fell apart was soggy and very small portion. A very uneventful Caesar salad, small and dressing was too salty. 

Go here for pizza only.

Great Place to get a haircut . Fun atmosphere and they take thier time and do it right . The wait time can be extensive but this tells me people are happy with the service they provide as most people wait . This is the busiest Barber Shop I have ever seen . Great Job Guys !!!-

Cute little nice restaurant in a quaint little subdivision of Longleaf. The food was good and good size portions. The restaurant has a lot of seating for big party's and small ones. The service was good. Will go back again and recommend this restaurant to my friends.

This place is SSOOO hit or miss for us.  We live close which is why we go.  Sometimes its great and sometimes its just ok.  But, the owner Jimmy is kick ass, which is why we continue to dine there.  Its always busy so he must be doing something right.  I would recommend at least trying it for yourself.

Ordered sushi Togo. The service was good and they made everything correct and fast. But the sushi was bland, the sauces had no flavor, what was supposed to be "tuna" looked and tasted like it got ran over by a car. Our hot and cold rolls were luke warm, and for sushi that grosses me out. Don't think I'll be returning.

I got the buy one get one glasses.  When I picked them up and used them for a day or two, I realized the bifocal area was too short.  I took them back and they re easier due the bifocal area to enlarge it.  When I picked them up they were perfect.  I would definitely recommend them!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I really enjoy this place and their drinks but their bouncers really need to work on their bedside manner. I live in the neighborhood so I definitely appreciate their sensitivity to Ubers, etc., but they could definitely be less rude about it. Maybe don't hold patrons hostage and not let them leave without explaining why?

Don't pay for early check in they will still have you wait in lobby with bags for well over an hour. The front desk isn't very friendly. While this is a great place to stay plan on waiting, housekeeping can't keep up. Didn't plan on wasting vacation time in lobby waiting on housekeeping. Front desk could appear to like their jobs.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: For the price, this place is just not that good.  The toasted ravioli was average and the crab cakes were awful.  I felt like we were eating a pile of mush that did not stay together.  We ordered after 8pm to go, so we could eat at our room so that might of been the problem.

It was so busy b/c of restaurant week. It is understandable that service was lacking. However it takes little time to acknowledge the situation and customers to make them feel valued. Dinner took two hours. I would go again not during r/w. The food was really good.

For the price the food was just ok.  I was disappointed they had pre-made the risotto so I couldn't order it without onions (the first time I came had the risotto and the onions were little raw chunks so sent it back).  The waitress was good and view nice but won't be running back for the food.

By far, this is one of the worst car washes I've been to in Tucson. My windshield still has mud in it from the last rain storm. My car has water spots all over and it looks worse than it did going into the wash. I just wasted $15 and now need to go pay more somewhere else to clean it.

Meh...your typical high priced pizza joint...not best for kids with unrefined pallette, unless you want to pay $15 for a huge cheese pizza. We were passing through,  it was worth the stop, but not authentic St. Louis at all. Service was slow. Staff (mostly men) were more focused on looking 'metro' than service.

Great New York Style Pizza!  My experience with New York style pizza is extremely limited, as I've never been to the east coast, and have grown up strictly with St. Louis style pizza.  Reminds me of Sbarro, in style, not flavor.  Flavor is awesome! Love the sauce.  A greasy mess of deliciousness :)

Tyler and his team are the only people I trust to work on my vehicles. I had issues on my M6 dealership blew me off and couldn't fix it. Tyler and his team was able to fix the issue no problem. He kept me informed with pictures and text for the 2 days they had my car of everything that was going on.

Wow! That's terrible!  I've had my hair done by the owner Leslie for 27 years.  If I were you, I would have called.  I have referred several people to Premier and they are all very happy.  I would have called the owner Leslie. Sorry your hair event With Patrick turned out so bad.

This place had been a long time coming.  It's a nice high end take on a low end small town Mexican restaurant.  It has the authentic Mexican food, and inordinately strong margaritas of a rural Mexican restaurant with all the great service and ambience of any or their St Pete staple.  Really a blessing after a long day at work.

I will definitely come here again for an oil change! The staff was very friendly and you can't beat the price! I made an appointment ahead of time online, so they were very quick at completing the job. I'm happy with their service and would highly recommend coming here for an oil change.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Just wanted to update my review. Given their response I wanted to let viewers know that they do not treat everyone fairly. My coworker lived there and got out of her lease 7 months early with ZERO penalty. But they charge me for a cleaning fee for the counters that are next up on the list to be gutted.... tell me how that is "fair"

Stay away, dirty! 
There is so many health code violations at this restaurant. 
They don't wear gloves, they switch places from being cashiers dealing with dirty bills to cooks with no gloves. 
I tried to report that to the management and they ignored me. Stay away!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Everyone enjoyed their food and the hibachi experience, but a negative experience with the hostess soured the mood right at the beginning.  She was unfriendly and snippy.  Because of this, we opted to skip dessert and leave.  We do not plan to return to this restaurant due to this experience.

I had lunch here again! Same waitress, same great energy! This time I had the Reuben Sandwich. What a great sandwich...and Shut the F up...excellent fries...deep fried to perfection. I will definitely order that again.
My friend had the Texas Petal Burger. He loved it. He also ordered a piece of Carrot Cake...huge!

Absolutely fabulous stay! The rooms were beautiful and the service was impeccable. My husband and I travel quite a lot and we both agreed that this was one of the best hotels we've stayed at. We had dinner at Core restaurant and the food and service could not have been better. Lovely hotel and lovely people.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Wonderful and caring. I had to put my cat down. Dr. Thomas, the veterinary assistant and the receptionist were all outstanding. I loved the paw print which was made with my cats name on it. The cost was much lower than expected. I will gladly refer anyone to Strickland.

The atmosphere was really great! Perfect place to watch football, or any game! Our service was excellent as well, however the food really wasn't the best! It's a new establishment though so I expect it will improve with time! I'll definitely give it another try

Worse service, took 20 min to get nuggets. I'm not sure why they are hiring meth addicts or recovering crackheads. Obviously they are still abusing drugs, unsanitary stench gave away the hideous truth. Please fire the personal working on the morning of March 26
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Great place to come for tacos and I mean tacos.  They have a variety of different tacos with a salsa bar.  We tried chicken, carne asada, vegetable, and pork... all if which were tasty.  They didn't have any chips or sides to go with it.  I would recommend this place to grab an inexpensive bite to eat if you are craving tacos.

This company probably has the best customer service in the world. As soon as I posted the review they called me and talked us through what happened and sent us a check for the money. They also sent us a dip stick from Kia for my car. I've never seen this kind of service anywhere.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Waited 2 hours for an oil change that was scheduled with an appointment. The longest oil change ever...They tried to upsell me every step of the way. The last thing was my oil dipstick was "all of a sudden" missing. I told them no thank you, I don't want to buy anything more here. Save your time and your money, DON'T GO HERE.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I like Ken's sushi restaurant.good food n good people.my favorite sushi are Melinda, Nashville roll n bento box.the starter is all good.love them all.i don't care what other people say about inside and outside of the restaurant,I come to eat not to judge .

Just came from Villa Barone for (lun-dinner) and was completely satisfied! Two very noisey parties (if you don't mind it)  and a friendly staff, everything was fantasic! Pizza and Mussels dish with white sauce was melt in your mouth yummy. Staff did not rush you in-between dishes. Prices reasonable. BYOB. Kid friendly too

They are under new management and they are absolutely amazing. My nails are perfect. Always have trouble finding a good place to get my nails done and now I will always go here. I brought my niece she is 2 and they were so good with her she had so much fun.

Had delivery from here today....i was not impressed the black beans and rice lacked flavor ....the cuban was a big no like they use process cheese and not real swiss....and the potato ball had and aweful taste like old meat and stale potatoes....the whole meal was gross and i will not order again

Need to find a different car wash. This is what $18.99 got us. So disappointed. This is the second time in 4 visits this has happened. Maybe we need to take it to the drive thru car wash and clean the inside ourself. I really want to support our local business but.....

Living in Tucson, good sushi restaurants aren't easy to come by.  This place is great.  Already a fan of the original sushi on Cortaro, this place gives you the same feel, along with great sushi. The fish was fresh and plentiful in the rolls. Definitely the sushi place to go after a day in the mall.

Ew I placed an order over the phone and the guy answering was extremely rude and barking orders at me in an unprofessional manner. I'm a frequent customer and I've never experienced disrespect from an employee like that. Whoever is working the phone tonight needs a strict talking too.

Christina is silly. When I told her I just moved here from CO, she told me her husband was from there and asked if I was picky, because her husband is so picky. Ha!! I'm not, at all and I have since gone back to her a few times. In fact, I need a fill this week...

I was really worried that this place would be really good, because we live like 2 minutes away. It's okay, poo poo platter was pretty delicious, my beef with broccoli was not good, his bourbon chicken was okay. We will try other dishes again, just not all the time like I was worried.

BEEN GOING HERE FOR YEARS. I was never dissatisfied with the job they do, or their prices. Love their gel manicures and perfect pedicures. I have no need to even try another nail salon.  100% happy. Great people working there,  they work hard to please their customers. My gel manicures last forever...
MaryAnn P.

Love everything about this place. Great atmosphere, drinks, bartenders, management. Love that there's no smoking inside but the have a cute little area outside for smoking. Always have some kind of music going on. Perfect place for a girls night or a casual beer.

Has anyone ever watched thru the window when you're eating for food or even inside? They don't wear gloves and yet when they go to put your food in the bag they put their hand inside to open it. And 9 times out of 10 the fries spilled in the bottom of the bag. Just think about that for a second.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The Sashimi Deluxe was only outdone by the Peanut & Avocado Roll.  Delicious, fresh Tuna & Salmon with a great presentation.  The location is right next to the PA Convention Center.  It's outside appearance doesn't do it justice.  The inside is clean and relaxing with excellent service and talented chefs.

Yep 0 one of the worst BK ever ! Ordered the new taco what a waste of a buck taco had set to the point of soggy  ordered a chicken original without lettuce thinking it would be at least hot but guessed. wrong !! Going to Culvers  have had it with This BK tried to give them a zero rating but wouldn't let me post review

The staff is extremely rude at this hotel. It's an inconvenience to ask a question. It's dirty as well. Our bathroom was not thoroughly cleaned. And lastly the room is tiny we are in. Sink outside of toilet area in room. Would not recommend for a budget hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Amazing service, cozy location and great food. Stopped in around 6.30pm on a Thursday night. Our waitress was very attentive and accommodating. The food was flavourful and promptly delivered along with complimentary hot garlic squares. Overall we had a great evening and will definitely go back!

This place is TOP notch. The sushi is bomb, the service never disappoints, and for the price it's well worth it. I love their sweet potato roll, the speedyway, the mango roll- honestly, it's hard to choose. If you're on the fence about going here, just do it. You won't regret it!

Horrible. Manager Elmer 1st over charged me for my drinks and argued with me about it. Then they gave my chicken sandwiches to someone else in drive thru and then had sauce on my husbands bacon cheeseburger and we said no sauce. Bad service. Won't be back. And I will be calling the day manager about it.

Delicious since its original location in Berwyn. I love their salmon and asparagus pasta. The prices are very reasonable considering how high quality the food is. The ambiance now is old school Italian and appropriate for dress up or down. Decent drinks too!

Coffee is great, employees are friendly but service is ridiculously slow.  If they have 2 or more cars in drive through, don't stop.  I had 3 cars in front of me and was in line for 20 minutes....and that is not out of the ordinary.  They need more people working in the morning.  I HATE going there because of this.

This is a check-in nightmare  (Cardinals v Cubs game) but once you are checked in it's okay. We waited in a 20-minute line to check in only to be told that our room was not ready and go to the back of the line again which turned into a 1-hour line. Great location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: They open at 8am. I came in at 930. The toaster oven wasn't turn on i had to wait 15 min for that to get heated up. I wanted ranch in my sandwich didn't have any full. Just didn't seem like who opened or closed the store did a,good job at all. Not prepared at all.

Worst rental experience ever.  If you're looking to rent a car and you are arriving at Lambert St. Louis go literally anywhere else.  Hitch a ride, borrow a car, buy one then return it.  Walk if you have to.  The most inept vapid people you will deal with in any service industry.  A big fat 0/5 stars.  Don't waste your time.

Staff is always friendly however this place is always way to packed. Never been to a gym you can't workout because every machine is taken. If you are only there to run on the treadmill then you are in luck because none of the pre-teens are using those. WHERE ARE THEIR PARENTS!?!?
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This is right after my gel refill, I've tried to like this place but the edges of my nails are always cut narrow and left without polish. My cuticles are never cleaned up when when asked. I've been years ago and remembered why I stopped going. The staff is nice but every tech I've had does horribly on nails.

The food was alright, it wasn't bad, but it wasn't what I was expecting, the waitress didn't come off friendly, and the group didn't like her very much. We went on a Saturday and we're seated right away witch was nice, the overall  environment was nice and relaxed, I wouldn't go there again though

Love this ice cream spot. The drive thru and incredible service makes it extremely convenient. I usually get soft serve vanilla with rainbow sprinkles YUM! Their portions are HUGE!! My husband usually gets the thick and chunky and a small is like a large so be prepared :)

Horrible horrible horrible Horrible horrible horrible
