Wow this was really bad... slow, order was wrong, food was gross
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Ridiculous pricing for basic treatments/services. My girlfriend just took our dog there for a foot injury. The vet cleaned it, prescribed some antibiotics, and gave my dog a shot to the tube of $400. Do yourself a favor. Don't go here. Pick another vet ... um, anyplace other than here.

Today was my first visit at orchid nails. It was a great experience!  My nails look great and my feet are super smooth!  Also it is very clean here. I love that they sanitize ALL of their instruments individually in bags. I highly recommend this nail salon.

The manager, Phillip, is beyond rude and aggressive. This manager does have his guidelines to follow, which is appreciated taking his job seriously. However, when interacting with members, he comes off aggressive. He also used inappropriate language with me personally. I do not appreciate how he handles his members.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Don't even waste your time here. I ordered my pizza in advance for delivery because I couldn't drive atm. expected delivery time is 11:30 am and it's 12:45 right now. where the fuck is my pizza?!? I called them to see if i can have someone else picking it up and no answer. Just don't order here ever.

Went here last night for dinner for the first time. It was just ok. Nothing too great. Sushi was decent but the pad Thai tasted like ketchup. Crab cake was decent, it didn't have a whole bunch of fillers. Mainly crab meat which is a plus and size was good.

If I could go lower I would the above picture is of a bacon, egg, cheese grit platter. After a 2 hour wait they sent that slip minus the cheese grits. Also send home fries that look like mashed potatoes. They fell all the way off. They got to busy to handle and they don't care. Used to be a good spot not any more.

Nail Expert is,my favorite nail shop..Tracy and Paul are the owners, very nice people...Tracy always does mine and my daughter's nails..Tracy  is very talented, I always tell her to do whatever she likes because I trust her, she is very talented...and the sweetest..

In the past a very  nice, comfortable restaurant with good food and service.
Today, not so, the food good, but the service  doesn't recognize there is a line between attentive and intrusive. A shame, because surely it will discourage the traditional client.

The worst. This place is always hiring and it seems they can't obtain and/or retain any good help. Not once, out of maybe twelve total visits, has my order been correct. The simplest of requests proves too difficult for the staff here. Stay on the highway another three miles and hit the next mcd's.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: How can you go wrong with a BYOB with great food and great service?!? Its a very intimate atmosphere great for conversation over a nice glass of wine. I had the Bavette Steak which was to die for. It was super tender. Overall, great choice for a 1st date or just ladies (gents) night out.

This made me break my keto diet, I walked in with some friends and just couldn't help my self. I chose the waffle bowl with two scoops of their decedent chocolate I believe it's called (it's like fudge brownie in icecream form), with sprinkles (of course) and I never regretted it.

I love the Renaissance brand and I was excited to visit this one on my business trip to Reno.

Giving 2 stars because the wall unit in my room was terribly loud and kept me up all night. 

I'm not sure if the management is in the process of replacing the wall units, but I won't return unless this issue is resolved.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Authentic hidden gem! I just moved into town and whenever I miss my mom's guatemalan home cooked meals, this is the place to go! Great food, large bodega attached, and the food is always great. Lighting isn't the best in the seating area, but if your looking for a bite of some real spanish food, and not taco bell, this is it!

Liked the pork fried rice and the egg roll.  The general tsos chicken was acceptable. I've had better.  The hot and sour soup could have a little more hot.  Red pepper is available to raise the hot, but doesn't have the same flavor as the hot peppers. Also tried some pork lo menu and the noodles had an unique texture.

After being lied too by another rental agency I wandered over to Alamo for a rental and was pleasantly surprised with the service Tony provided and the timely manner in which he got me on my way. The whole staff was great, car was very clean and I am a Alamo customer from now on!

I love this place. I have literally never had a bad order. I don't remember the name but I shared the burrito wrapped in bacon with my husband, so good! Their tacos are really good too and so is the elote! Everything is freshly made to order and always hot and delicious

This hotel did not have a blanket for the fold out couch. How is that possible when the room is a suite?  We called for a blanket & after waiting 45 minutes, we canceled as the blanket was a no show.  The room was just ok, but not worth the price. The front desk people were average. 
Staying at a Marriott next time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The worse car wash ever. Today the line was too long to pay. The cashier was unbelievable slow and didn't care about the line. Everybody was unhappy and complaining. After almost 20 min to
Pay the car wash,I got the car really bad. They  dried up super bad the car and dirty inside. Don't wast your money and time there.

BEST hidden secret in Kennett. Amazing service, delicious food. We went there for a date night and it was 5:30pm- we had the place to us for another 30 min- don't mind us, we loved it! It was like a private dinner. Delish food! I also went for their Sunday Brunch and it was spectacular! Definitely one of my favorite spots!

This has been the closest Dunkin to me, since I can remember. However, they hardly ever get your order correct, and anytime you order they have no idea what you are saying because they are too busy talking to their coworkers. 

Just once, I would like a correct order.

Awesome sushi.  So yummy.  Many options.  I've been several times, but have never ordered off full menu.  Only sushi.  The service is inconsistent.  Sometimes you get soup, Edamame, orange slices, desert- sometimes you don't.  Staff can be somewhat rude and inattentive.

We were visiting the city of Brotherly Love and hit Yelp and found this hipster little Japanese restaurant. One of the great things is that they take reservations. The sushi was excellent, as was the fried tofu as an appetizer. All in all an excellent meal.

I went to Sakana on Monday and the service was unusually slow.  There weren't that many people in the restaurant, they were just short on chefs so the sushi took really long.  It was pretty good sushi but not good enough to go all the way back to Somersett.

Staff is all super nice and friendly. Hotel was clean and presentable. Not worth what you pay for unfortunately. Mini fridge was extremely small and didn't work well. No microwave in room, only suites have them which I found to be weird. Bed and pillows were comfortable.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I had to check this place out after everyone kept talking about it when it opened last week. In all honesty, it's not worth all the hype. Cute atmosphere but nothing too special about the ice cream. There's unlimited toppings but not much to choose from. Not worth the $7 compared to other ice cream spots around town

The St Louis Airport location in Terminal 1, next to A3, is easy to access, quite comfortable, with plenty of places to recharge your phone, while indulging in tasting wines or champagnes by the glass or flight. There are tempting food choices, including a number of vegetarian options. Spoil yourself!

The Refinery was hitting on all cylinders last night. An excellent meal matched only by the exceptional service. Fresh, local seafood prepared to mouth watering perfection. I was dining by myself and was paid attention to like I was part of a large party. A must for anyone in the Tampa area.

Great  customer  service.  I went I'm intending  to purchase  new glasses.  I explained  to  Katrina  how uncomfortable  my glasses  were.  She changed  out the  nose  pads  free  of charge.  They are  great  now. Thank you.  I would  recommend  you  to  all.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This is hands down the best pizza I have ever had in my life! We tried both the Hawaiian and the Old Country pizzas and the Cacciatori salad (which was also amazing!) And not only was the food fantastic but the service was impeccable. Friendly and helpful staff and great food. What more could you ever ask for?

This place is one of the best in town.  Honest, reliable mechanics.  I came in to have my brakes checked out because another shop wanted to charge me 250 dollars.  Chi laughed and did my brakes for 60 dollars and my car runs great!  Great local independent business!

My husband and I celebrated our two year anniversary here tonight - it was wonderful ! Natalie was our server and she went above and beyond. Everyone was super friendly and the artwork was amazing !! I like that this place is comfortable and not stuck up . It's the real deal!

Love how thy do the prices in that they don't charge by the weight! Staff is very friendly & you will want to tip them every time. They have a great selection that they change up & bring other great selections. Also they use a healthier version of regular sugar that won't break down so quickly & make your blood sugar spike!

Ordered a simple combo. Came not as ordered and when I let waiter know he said will it work?  He left check his order and returned to tell me he wrote it down correct and chef made it wrong. Asked again if it will work. No it won't. That's not what I ordered!  We were the only ones in the restaurant to cater too.

I was excited to see they offer a few vegan milks. Oat milk is my favorite. I got the latte. Met a friend and my sister here. They got Columbian coffee.  We came on a Saturday morning so it wasn't too busy. Plenty of seating space and a community table in the back. It is clean, cozy and the staff is extremely nice. We will be back!

Pros: Friendly service, clean, modern and affordable, lots of food options nearby, they seem to be taking Covid seriously which I appreciate. 

Cons: Internet speed was extremely slow, the lighting in the rooms was very harsh and way too industrially bright for a hotel room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place is awesome! I have been coming here for years now, and it is always great service, clean with no waiting lines. They have coffee and convenient place to wait and relax. You should know they also do oil changes and other minor mechanical services for all type of cars and trucks. Highly recommended.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Can't fault the coffee. Had an interesting cookie too which was very nice. Spent a couple hours here doing work & taking ph calls. A good place to work or study from as background music is not too loud and the tables are suited to work. Will remember this place fit next trip.

Dinner menu was reasonable for a bar menu and whilst I forgot what I ordered it was nice. Beer options are good but not extensive. Wines are nice too. Typical Sheraton pricing. Bar was very busy all week due to a large corporate group which created quite a lot of noise & buzz but pleasantly so.

Nice choice on the Broadway strip downtown. Not as unbearably crowded as some of the other more popular names. We saw an amazing female violinist climb on top of bar and give a stunning performance. They mixed up the live music between rock & country as well as some pop tunes. Drinks are good and cheap. Fun times!

They did not have two items in the menu we asked for. The one item we did ask for took a long time, but after paying and waiting they said they did not have any tea. Sweet or I sweet. Do not recommend. Taco Bell and Wendy's are next door of which I ordered right after and they had my order without issue.

I'm obsessed w/ nachos & I'm so glad I found this place! Quick service, extremely nice & helpful staff. We got the crab rangoon nachos app, then got the split decision nachos : Buffalo chicken & BBQ pulled pork (put the red onions on the side b/c my boyfriend is a diva). Definitely will be back!

The sushi wasn't bad at all, but the hibachi was awful. The rice was inedibly salty, as were the noodles. The chicken was overcooked, and the scallops were fishy with a very unappealing texture. The building itself needs an overhaul--it just feels very dated. They gave us plenty of food, but it just wasn't good.

This place used to be great. It still has great views of Tucson lights and the ambiance is very nice. Food continues to be expensive, but is only average at best now. Service was poor and they changed around the dinning room and I don't like it as much. Found out after we ate here that it was bought by Wyndham.

Linda was awesome, she's the sweetest waitress I've ever had. It's not my first time here but it's an awesome spot if you ever need a super late night meal for very little amounts of money. Liz was a great hostess who got us our drinks and it was an awesome night. Thank you Linda, you sweet angel!! Linda and Liz forever.

Everything that came out was so good. We got pork carnitas, carne asada, and grilled chicken - everything was amazing! We don't have any complaints. We tried the tres leches cause I heard it was delicious but it wasn't as amazing as I expected. Overall, everything was great

Took 6 mins for one bagel. Forgot the brown sugar packet for oatmeal once. Overall, it feels like they're understaffed or careless. One of the self-order touchscreens doesn't work. 

And on top of that, just found out McDonald's now doesn't have oatmeal anymore :|
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
These people are scam artists...agreed to one price and then charged for another.  

I got the run around - local referred my complaint to national office and the national office referred me back to local center. 

They "signed" a contract with the signature I used to agree to one time credit card charge.  DO NOT TRUST...
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The absolute worst.  I joined  because it was inexpensive and they had a couple of classes I liked.  After ONE class, they decided they were going to charge me an extra ten bucks per class....nevermind that when joining I was told that the classes were included.  In short, one crowded zumba classs cost me 99 bucks!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: A little too mediocre to be priced the same (or more expensive) than most.. Especially the beer... small space .. family owned and operated which is always nice.... no margaritas... a place to stop when you don't have the time to actually dine but want tacos and NOT Taco Bell..

What a fun night out! We tried so many unique dishes paired with excellent drinks. It got me out of my comfort zone when it comes to trying new things and did not disappoint. Definitely a place you should experience at least once. Be sure to plan ahead, save up ($$$) and make a reservation.

Just ate here for the second time. I thought that maybe the first time it was just an off day but it was awful again.  the staff acts as if they are doing you a favor by taking your order. Food is of poor quality with the exception of the salsa which was pretty good. Large place but the interior is very run down.

Good barely. Definitely not above average and a mile from being great. Best thing was the relatively spicy and tasty salsa. The service was friendly but infrequent in checking on me. The Vegetarian burrito was dry and basically a salad wrapped up in a lackluster tortilla. Big portion but no creativity or taste to write home about.

No coffee in the lobby ! Insanely noisy! Elephants upstairs sounded like they were running til early morning, Squeaky floor ! Barking dog next door, pillows were really lumpy. Lousy coffee in the room.  Day Receptionist was rude and not friendly ! Will not stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Checked in and as I traveler over  the past 30 years had the most engaging ,fun, and most awesome experience with James.
What am authentic likeable engaging personality.
He could teach classes.
Thanks James you are a rare personality in the service industry.  You will fo far!!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The sushi is great. The place is nice & clean. Service has always been great. They have the sushi boat which is great if you have a crowd and order enough for it. My husband and I do the take out a lot. It travels well (we live about 10-15 minutes away). Not cheap but well priced considering what most sushi places are.

Pork fried rice was good. Portion was good. But the general tso's chicken was too salty for me. I didn't have an egg roll, but my friend loved them. Also, I tasted the orange chicken, and it was flavorful and not overly salty. 

So, ok Chinese but I'm not raving.

Hotel service and rooms aren't to your typical Crown Plaza quality. Complained to front desk and felt like we were totally ignored. Housekeeping is not what you expect from a hotel charging what you pay here. There were some electrical issues as well. Hotel is old and not well maintained.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This was a really good sushi place. The fish was very fresh and all the rolls were good. The prices were very reasonable.  Why 4 stars? The special roll i ordered (the geisha) packed the special flavor i expected. The simple yellowtail roll was better and i thought it was the best.

After a long day of traveling (that isn't over yet) i needed a cup of coffee.  While the coffee is good the friendly staff was what really made my day.  The nice girl behind the counter greeted me with a smile and made me feel appreciated!  Thank you so much for a little ray of sunshine today!

Everyone at Cherry Hill Animal Hospital is outstanding.   They have gone out of their way many times when i have had emergencies with my golden retriever.  I recommend them highly to everyone I know owning a pet & to even strangers. If you want top notch care for your pets, this is the place to go.

I've been here twice. Fast service. Food is good. Sushi selection is okay for the all you can eat. Rice was undercooked for my hibachi dish. My favorite is the vegetable tempura. The white sauce for the hibachi is delicious! $17.95 for dinner's endless sushi & hibachi! $9.95 for lunch.

Polite staff, great taste and great value, still, over 15 years after I first tried it. I'm normally not a fan of Chinese food as it's so salty but not from here. Truly the best Chinese restaurant in town, great for a cold winters night, Chef Chun's is not to be missed.

It's really hard to eat IN the restaurant because it's so small. Don't bother going with a group bigger than four. 
That being said, I absolutely recommend Vic for a special take-out dinner. The sushi is always fresh. The special rolls are creative and delicious. The price is great for the quality. I love this place.

We've been ordering from here for a few years now, always speedy delivery. Food tastes awesome every time, good variety on the menu and the prices cannot be beat. Taste of China is my go to place to order in. Try the general Tso's chicken or mongolian beef-YUM!

This was a great stay hotel. Very old and very cool feel to it. I really loved our room, it had no windows but it was nice and quiet considering the hotel is right on the square. The staff was very friendly and gave us water during the water boil advisory due to a busted pipe in the city. I enjoyed staying here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Excellent dinner for our family gathering of 8 on 1/22. From appetizers through mains, all was excellent. Service polite and attentive. Love the bacon wrapped dates with Gorgonzola, waffle sliders and I could go on. Will definitely return even though 45 min drive.

I used to go here fairly often but have stopped after the last time I was there...  The main waitress is fairly rude.  The sushi used to be pretty good, but if you get the all-you-can-eat, expect to get a HUGE amount of rice in each roll... not impressive.

(Delivery order) Wasabi and ginger always come with sushi, not sure why they didn't come with my order? I got a California roll and a crazy horse. On another note, does the yakitori always come with just 2 sticks for $5something? And the chicken teriyaki (not pictured) was made poorly. Taste and amount served  not the usual

STAY AWAY!!!! Quoted $260 for vehicle to pass inspection.  When I got there to pick up I was told the charges were nearly $400 and the vehicle didn't pass inspection.  Never would have authorized work if I knew they wouldn't pass the vehicle and still not sure why it was $140 more than I was quoted.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Sheraton - stay away for a large party event. Turns out they only serve food for 1.5 hours in spite of a snow storm that delayed arrivals. $25/person and they took away the food and desserts. They made excuses and would not work with anyone. Do yourself a favor and stay away.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I am an out of town Business Traveler and I rely on Yelp for good recommendations. This one did not disappoint! All you can eat sushi for $19.99 on a Monday night sounded too good to be true. I tried and was not disappointed. Bright, clean place with fresh Sushi. Great buy and I will be back.

This is the best hotel we have ever stayed at. Gorgeous lobby, friendly staff, clean rooms, and comfortable beds. We got a room with a king size bed that also came with a pull out love seat. It was perfect for our 3 year old to sleep on. The free breakfast was great. Going to try to stay here every time we go to St. Louis.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The corporate office reached out to try to make the situation right. On the next order, the store did everything great like they had in previous visits. While the frustration wasn't completely alleviated, they acknowledged the mistake. I still think there is an opportunity to do better and hopefully they will in the future.

This is a convenient location closed to everything the mall, olive rd restaurants, downtown St. Louis plus more!  The room is clean and the breakfast is great.  Everything is within 15 mins.  I like the room with the separate area.  Will definitely go back on our next visit!! Highly recommended!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Stopped here after seeing this restaurant on yelp. Everything was amazing. Pizza was fresh and homemade. It was delicious. Also tried the nutella timasu. It was so good. Service was excellent. The owner guy was so nice and friendly. The atmosphere was cute and the experience was incredible.

I live in the condos next door..i check in once a year to see what's up here. Nothing changes but the calendar. Same people on the same barstools..place reeks of cigarette smoke..there is a small menu..am afrais to order off it. ..not a good place for me, it just may work for you

The few times I have dined in have been an entertaining experience, our waiter was hilarious and I love the very tiny and quaint atmosphere. The food is better than most basic Chinese restaurants I have been to. I really enjoy ordering delivery from here (great hangover food).

Horrible food. Got General Tso chicken and it was hard. Half of the pieces were not edible. Terrible customer service. I asked for a soda instead of an egg roll and was told that was not what I asked for when I called my order in so I could not switch them out. Don't recommend this place and never going back.

Once again I find myself judging New York style pizza while not in New York.  So if your in Reno give it a try. The texture is a little off but overall it will pass.  The only draw back is lack of sauce.  Ask for extra sauce and have them cook it a little more. It needs more of the slightly crunchy crust.

Super upset with their service. Called them SEVEN times to try to tell them that I have a DoorDash order and that if they couldn't do it just to cancel it. They cancelled it FOURTY MINUTES AFTER I ORDERED. I love this place but I'm not going to order from them again. That was absolutely horrible.

I go to Pinkberry whenever I find one in the city I am visiting since there is not one in Knoxville, TN. The staff was extremely friendly! They acknowledged my birthday and were very personable. The store was very clean and both the inside and outside sitting area were well manicured.

I took my friend here this morning because she wanted to get breakfast for herself. I don't know how people are eating here!!! The odor was disgusting! It smelt like something died and I was just purely disgusted. My friend ate her food and said it was good, so if you can get past the smell go for it. I wouldn't recommend though
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Had the beef cheeks--beautifully plated, tender, and tasted good but I wouldn't order again. I was jealous of my companion who ordered the scallops. 

Cocktail was fine.

Had the chocolate mousse and sour cream ice cream--must try!!!

Awesome service.

Staff was knowledgeable about gluten free.

I would eat here again.

This is the absolute worst Starbucks I have ever been to. The line is awful, the service is slow, and the employees are rude and inconsiderate. Many times in a row they've messed up my order and made me wait. I started ordering online and they still don't make it until I get there.

I'm very pleased with Burger King.   They make my burger flamed and make them right away and my way just like the tv said.   The French fries are good to.   This establishment is by my house.  The waiter has been there a long time and calls me by my name.   It's very friendly and I like to go and have my dinner.

I've been there three times straight and gotten a good cut every time.  Not the fanciest or trendiest place in town but never crowded easy parking and nice looking staff.  Also dig the retro sk8 art . But they could really use a DecoBudz to get the conversations rolling lol thanks guys !

They got my order all wrong! I don't eat cheese on fish.  But was quick to correct the error and to upgrade my fries to a extra large which is why I come to McDonald's anyway; and a coupon for my next fish sandwich free very friendly staff just made a mistake as humans we make mistakes it's how you handle it
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Sheets were clean in a decent sized room with two double beds. Carpet chunks were replaced with new carpet due to some weird red stains throughout the room, shower facet was coming apart and the water was either Scalding hot or cold. The cleaning crew was annoying loud in the am. Probably better hotels for the same price nearby.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place is amazing. I'm not surprised that it's been around for so long. The simple rolls are done as well as the specialty ones. The interior of the restaurant is small and informal, clearly their efforts go towards the food and not the decor- which is not a bad thing! It's my new go-to sushi place.

Convenient location but my order is always not made right. Espresso frappe looks just like milk blended with ice and looks so white. Chai latte that I ordered is not the same as other Starbucks. Taste like hot milk. They need to train their baristas coz their drinks are not pretty standard.

5 stars for the price and speed. 1 star for the quality. If you are a poor busy student who aren't picky about food then this is a place for you! I got a big portion of lo mein, fried crab cheese puff and hot sour soup all less than $15. But none of them tasted good lol... Im spoiled by Asian food growing up so this is a no....

Mediocre at best. My husband ordered the torta and it looked like a Subway sandwich, cheese not even melted! I had the chicken fajitas and seemed they were like frozen sliced bits that didn't come to the table sizzling. Service was nice but s l o w and the place wasn't busy. Not a memorable meal.... probably not going back.

Just stayed this past weekend and loved everything about it!! I see that alot of people had problems with all of the modern day technology, but it was quite simple actually. It is a little far to walk to anything but a very short 6 buck cab ride to Bourbon St. I would highly recommend!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The food here was good and was like home cooking. It was terribly overpriced though. The staff was friendly. The food had good flavor and seemed fresh.

 The atmosphere is not genial for business, dates, or a quick meal. I wouldn't recommend this restaurant for most occasions.

Mediocre food, the wait staff was far below average and just not a good experience. Much better Italian food at Gino's or Bella Aquila. Disappointed that their Fettuccine Alfredo is so bland. I've never had Alfredo sauce from a jar but I can't imagine it being worse than what they serve at daVinci's.

Not a good day for Gibson Cafe.  Out of most draft beers and out of several menu items (chili, coleslaw)....and poor service.  They were willing to sell w-a-y over cooked chicken, chicken tenders, and soggy nachos and some canned beers.  

The kid playing music and singing (Clay Shelburn) was the only plus....so he got my 40% tip.

Beautiful hotel, nicely appointed rooms. I was really impressed. Most staff was pleasant and always in sight to provide help. Why not 5 stars... well the bartenders (both lobby and roof top) are terrible. The worst we experienced while in Nashville for 3 nights / 4 days. I would just say inattentive and at one point rude.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My only reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is because the parking lot is way too small and crowded for how popular this location is! I came to get my Fall dose of PSL and just as usual... I was not disappointed  The indoor seating is gorgeous and spacious as well.

I've been down in NOLA for a couple of years now and have tried a lot of places and Osaka Kohai very ok. Service and casual and rather slow, they were all wearing saints attire. Fish was fairly fresh. Rolls were all creative and yet a little weird. Not the biggest fan but not opposed

Stopped in for lunch. Got the steak bento box. Fantastic... Steak is rib eye, very tender and flavorful. Comes with soup and salad which were also very good. Best ginger dressing I've had. Service was also great. Will definitely get this again. $10.95 was well worth it.

Sapori makes you feel like family. It's small, cozy and makes you feel at home away from home. My favorite dish I've ever had here was a special; Papperdelle noodles in lobster sauce featuring a lobster tail and crab meat. A must have for any seafood loving Italian! Sapori NEVER disappoints.

Great service and food. Not inexpensive but the brunch menu was very unique. Very nice, open atmosphere. Short rib hash, velvet french toast, soft shelled crab benny, and more! If you want a unique meal in a great setting and don't mind spending a bit more, I highly recommend the Little Lion.

This was my first visit to BCB because I am from out of state.  I had the Peasant Plate and I absolutely LOVED it!  Everything tasted so fresh!  The service was great without much wait time even though there were several people eating there that day. Easy on the pocket book too!  I will definitely be a repeat customer!  Yum!

Just don't do it.  There are better places to spend your money.  Just took my 13-year-old son here. Not only did the stylist do a horrific job with the cut but she also nicked my son's neck and blamed the razor.  Had I noticed this before I walked out the door, I would have refused to pay.

Love that I have this place as a quick neighborhood sushi joint just around the corner.  The sushi here is good.  Not great, but the best that I have found around norther liberties.  And I love that it is a BYOB.  Their lunch specials are a great deal as well.

We have been going to Regal for years. Love the family. Fabulous customer service. Owner is very dedicated to taking the greatest care of your clothing and household goods. Repairs are available. The best I've ever found for shirts!  Organic products are used.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Mother's Day brunch here was absolutely disgusting. Out of all of there many choices the only edible things were the hash browns and the donuts. The prime rib was well done and was like leather but with less flavor. The eggs were ice cold! Our glasses were filthy so we did not accept any water.

Horrible.....FPI MANAGEMENT bought the place jacked rents way up and implemented unfair rules....valet trash is forced on tenants and the "upgrades" are done very cheaply.....staff is truly rude. Used to be a nice place to live. Read other reviews it's really horrible here!

We like China Chen. It's not the best, but pretty good. We miss Ming Fang back in NJ. I would say China Chen has some growing pains. Delivery would be a great service. I would also say that they need a better cut of pork in the BBQ boneless spareribs. They're good, but mostly overcooked. They do make a very good egg fu young.

Can't believe I waited for 30 minutes for cold nasty food. Chicken nuggets tasted like cardboard. Forgot sauces milk for a toddler what a waste of time and money. Worst part is I contacted corporate they send me gift cards to use only in Florida and I live in Ohio will never step foot in another McDonald's
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Grouper (bunless for me) Sandwich was wonderful. My dad got the club sandwich and ate the whole thing and loved it!  We both thought the coleslaw was fresh and tasty.  This was last meal in St. Pete because he is moving.  He's been going here for over 25 years!  We love the staff and the food!   Great bar and restaurant!

A very nice Chinese restaurant on the West End.  Not a very big place, but they turn out very good quality food.  I was there for lunch and got the Orange Chicken lunch.  It came with soup, Spring roll, crab Rangoon, rice and a some broccoli. Very reasonably priced.  I really liked that their iced tea is Oolong.  Delicious!

The wash turned out very nice, but when I went to grab the five or six quarters I had in my coin tray for a tip, the quarters were missing. I spoke to the manager about it and he offered that maybe the vacuum sucked the change up, but the dimes were still there and it is in part of the car where you wouldn't vacuum. Disappointing.

I want to give the place more stars but I can't. Service is great, fast and friendly. Lo-main is good, egg rolls are good. Spring rolls too sweet. The fried rice is horrible. Unless they improve their recipe I will not order fried rice again. Great potential.. they just need to step up, read the reviews and take note.

New owners are very nice.  They're starting out so the menu is a little limited but they have the Italian staples - pizza and pasta. AND the pizza is amazing - totally fresh the sauce is wonderful.  Pasta is good too.  Definitely worth going and going back.

Great food, Great service! We were seated immediately and our server was wonderful. I had the fried green tomatoes, smoked wings and lion burger. Great! We went on a Saturday afternoon and my 8 year old daughter was comfortable and loved the window booth. Great atmosphere. We will be back.

Decent museum food and plenty of drinks and ice cream. This is much better than the old version of the grill as it is much more spacious and therefore relaxing. It's a good place to take a break from the walking and heat and recharge yourself for a great museum experience.

The food is far below average and their customer service is even worse. I have come here on several occasions only because it is closer to my apartment than any other restaurant. This is the second time I have had to wait in drive-through for 30+ minutes. I do not recommend this location to anybody.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Went in on a Sunday around 11am. Wife got a breakfast burrito with bacon, I wanted regular carne asada. I ended up with a carne asada breakfast burrito, so bit of a communication break down. I thought it didn't have a enough salt or flavoring. Wife said she liked hers. Green salsa is best.

Sushi done right! Always delicious and staff is very friendly and welcoming. Everything we have tried on the menu has been amazing including all the sushi, soups, ramen and udon noodles. Katsudon is awesome. Rice on bottom, topped with onions and egg and fried pork on top. Yum!

Today the atm was declined again over 1 1/2 on the phone with card security, card services and credit union member services each blaming the other department and still can't use the card. Expect to deal with the most incompetent employees in banking at the Credit Union of New Jersey.

Booked via Expedia for a great deal on 2 rooms. Great location. Very clean. Super helpful and friendly staff. Amazingly comfortable, adjustable beds. Climate was awesome. Didn't try the food.  

The only bummer was that the pool was closed. Huge disappointment for the kids. :/
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Came here Friday night on a date, food was good service was good I got the octopus, duck, lobster ravioli, and the ink pasta. They were all good but I wouldn't order them again except the lobster ravioli. For dessert I got the tiramisu, I thought it was ok, I wish the coffee taste was alittle stronger but over all 5 star

The worst green tea Frappucino ever made!!  It looked like I was scraping algae off the sides and bottom. It was chunky and just gross. Already down the interstate before I took my first sip of it, something tells me this is what they count on. Will never go to this location again!

The food was okay, but the service was absolute garbage.  It took over two hours to have dinner and the restaurant was not that busy.  The server was unapologetic and avoided us while everyone who got there after us ate dinner before we did.  Three stars for the food. Zero for service.  Will not be returning.

This place is Great! We went to a show nextdoor at the Pageant and it was really nice to walk right out to the concert. The rooms are nice and big and very modern. Was easy to check in and right upstairs. Parking was great also, big parking lot out back for the public and customers. Will definitely be back!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place is AWESOME. The Pizza and salads that we ordered were amazing.  Rating it a 4 because seating sucked.  We had to wait around for others to leave.  Small small seating area and we're only a family of four. I would definitely eat here again BUT it will be a "to-go" order.

Food was amazing. We ordered the 5 course tasting menu. One of the courses was striped bass. My husband had gone fishing that morning and we asked if they would add this fresh fish into one of our courses. Every course was 5 star. Flavored and cooked to perfection!!

Had a great dinner here.  We have a big group so we ordered almost every appetizer they had.

I would highly recomend crab fundido app.  I had the Korean BBQ tacos.  They were good, but they do not have too much to offer on the side, unless you specially order side dishes.

The guac and salsa were both good.

I was craving some good Italian food being that I haven't had it in forever. I decided on this place based on the reviews. Got the manicotti to go.. It tasted okay but the thing that was most disappointing was the portion size. I thought Italian food was suppose to be filling but this just left me feeling like I ate a snack.

Good sushi and a great staff. The atmosphere was fun and relaxed and the sushi was great.  The Caterpillar Roll looked like it was shrunken (bonsai sushi?) and was adequate.  the fish/shrimp quality was good with the amaebi and albacore being deliicious.  I will have to go back... they ran out of the local uni.

Sooooo yummy! Some of the best tijuana style tacos I've had in Reno. Definitely recommend the Al pastor vampiro. It was delicious. 

I ordered through Yelp and picked up through the drive thru. I was happy that the food was ready when the expected pickup time was.

So bad. They're always out of many flavors, they only accept cash, and they clearly torture their employees. Every single person must greet you when you walk in so basically you are bombarded with a bunch of bored teenagers shouting "HELLO!!!!" Prices are sky high. Hate this place.

Came in for a late lunch, chips and salsa were great if you like spicy salsa. The food was excellent, perfect portions and decent prices. My only complaint would be the margaritas, they tasted pretty good but for their sake I hope they just forgot  the alcohol, because they were incredibly weak.

Sushi is pretty good for Indianapolis.  The cooked food (tempura) is very good.  Cleanliness is a bit of an issue; there were used sugar packets in my water glass.  I've been here twice and the kitchen is a little slow.  The people next to me were waiting for their sushi for a long time.

The thing I really love about this Wendy's is that they hire special people for their entire staff you might wait a little longer you might have cold fries you might not get the right thing you ordered and they might not know what tartar sauce is but they're special so that's great

Be cautious my wife went in for an oil change and they said we needed over 1,000 dollar brake job.  I didn't believe them since car isn't that old and have no issues or warning signs. So I took car to my preferred shop Buellton Garage. I asked them to check brakes to see what they would say. THEY SAID BRAKES ARE JUST FINE!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: After not being back for many years I was hesitant to return. The staff was warm and the food was amazing! The veal Scaloppini and special risotto were delicious. I highly recommend giving Il Forno a second chance and returning! It's still a classic Italian spot in Edmonton!

This is the worst hotel I have ever stayed. The staff is very inconsiderate. The maid placed a doer hanger on my room and several other of my coworkers staying no service. This was all made up. No one in our group put anything to think our room shouldn't be made up.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Very nice hotel. We were there for Washington University graduation and they had shuttle service. Staff is very nice. Rooms are nice.....we had the Betty Grable Suite (funky). Room service prompt, coffee in the lobby, they are a very good choice if you have a kid at Wash U.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place just shouldn't be open right now. They have no menu other than gross hotdogs and literally like 5 drink selections. You have to stand on the sidewalk to order, and they don't even have outdoor seating. It's just sad. At least the dude working was nice though.

Loved the whole experience here! Very nice people, friendly and welcoming! Brought in my 9 year old niece for a girl day and they treated her as nice as they treated any other customer which is hard to find.  Our nails look amazing and the price was the cherry on top! Will defiantly be coming back!

We finally got a chance to try this relatively new restaurant in Haddonfield. The menus are huge for such a small place! Tried some favorites to test them out and they passed with flying colors. The service was friendly and helpful. This place will be a regular stop.

The Tea Place has thee best bubble tea around! I love their mango-bango fresh fruit bubble tea with sago/tapioca. They also have really good lunch specials and paninis. Everything I have had there has been very tasty. Plus it isn't often crazy busy, which is nice!

Staff was nice but food was just okay.
Had the fried noodles and vegetables with shrimp (lo men)
Shrimp was already cooked and a bit hard, did not taste fresh.
The sauce was just salty, not flavorful.
Be aware that if you order a hot one, it'll burn your mouth.

They're complete idiots here and rude as hell. I asked for hot sauce three times and each time was given mild. I asked for a medium drink and gave me a large. Yea it's the same price i don't give a damn I don't want the extra soda! But y'all want $15 an hour smh
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I've been a member for 5 or 6 years. The other reviews are true. This place is dirty, especially the locker rooms. They've been that way for a long time. I try not to go as it's a zoo at 5 p.m. I've joined Sports West. It's in a whole other league. I've been to other 24 hour clubs and this is the worst.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Very impressed with the honest service and professional attitude. Ricky, the owner, took the time to show me the diagnostics of my cars alignment and gave me a more than fair price for repair. Staff was welcoming and the office even has free WiFi and Netflix! Highly recommend.

Ordered 5 ice creams. 3 were incorrect. Was missing one. All 5 were simple and small. No additional toppings. Went to twisties treat in st pete this weekend. Thought it would be same. Will not be returning. Can't wait for the new location to open closer to home in Port Richey. US 19 and Embassy.

You know you're in the wrong place when you walk in for lunch and the sandwich person looks up from her magazine and says "...yeah?"

Seems like a third world country establishment. What I might expect at a subway in Columbia. 

Depressing. Dirty. Non-existent customer service.

i guess nobody knew there is one in godfrey, il.  it's only been there about 3 years.  it is a great store.  i like it better than aldi's.  they don't carry as much as aldi's but it's cheaper and it's kroger brand.  which is national brands but in a kroger lable.  i can't think of enough good things to say about rulers

Great team. Everything went smoothly. Scored a low-mileage rental, just right for Boise. Contrary to what some of these haters are throwing around, the whole team was efficient, warm and straightforward. Will be returning for any of my rental car needs in the area.

Nice view and Bar food with live music. This restaurant was ok, they were flexible with substitutions, the food was just ok, I had seafood linguini I'm not a fan of scallops so they substituted with shrimp, the tomato sauce tasted store bought. My wife had the grouper again it was ok. I won't hurry back.

Absolutely terrible, employees talking behind counter not taking orders, stood in line 15 minutes just to order because drive through was backed up. After I ordered I waited anther 15 minutes for burnt spicy nuggets... stay away from this terrible establishment

Very disappointed with the food 
I asked for a tomato and basil
Soup with a grill cheese sandwich and the soup was literately a jar of tomato and basil pour in a bowl and heat up for you 
The grill cheese sandwich very dry no taste was very plain 
My experience was very but very disappointed I spend $9.56 for this

Rooms are nice size but the A/C gave us fits all weekend. Bathroom is small and I'm pretty sure there was black mold in there. They are in the process of remodeling so maybe it'll be better soon.  The breakfast was nothing special. Television channels weren't that great.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Great Service. Tasty food and large selection of Mexican food and drinks.
I would recommend a better kitchen air extractor and filter. Upon return home you will need to put your clothes to the washer . But in my book, that is a minor detail. Everything else worth the effort. I go back without hesitation.

What a great dining experience!  The sushi here was not the best I have ever had, but it was definitely good and fresh.  The service was impeccable, very attentive and much better than I expected before going in.  There is a great variety of choices on the menu and the prices are relatively cheap, especially for the sushi.

Today I had breakfast with my husband and he had the filet mignon, asparagus and lobster eggs benedict, and I had the Jimmy's skillet with andouille sausage. Both were amazing and I totally would come here again!! Definitely 5 stars! The presentation was perfect and this wait staff was very friendly.

Yikes! Worst looking Westin I've ever stayed in. This franchise is normally nice. But this one is the dumpiest looking one I've ever seen. Old torn up carpets and really dated looking interior as well as exterior. They claim to be in a renovation period but I'm not sure when they plan to start.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: First time coming to this location . Cashier was unfriendly and had an attitude. I ordered a berry hibiscus with light ice and my drink came out quickly but it was definitely not light ice , it was heavy ice . 90% of the cup was ice even though it even said light ice on the cup.

Bad experience, this place tried to charge me 20 dollars and sign a paper to avoid blaming them if my expensive frame gets damaged. What was the 20 dollars for?. This is the only place who charges yhis ridiculous fee.. . Where do they ship the frames? So they can get broken ...
I left and went to another optical center.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Ugh. Mistake prone front desk was our gateway to a musty overpriced room where we wiped our feet off before we went to bed. I should have slept in my rental car. I will give it one extra star than my gut tells me because it is conveniently close to the airport and they had a morning breakfast (sort of).
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I rented from them atleast once or twice a month for a couple of years. The service is OK at best and the cars are mostly American. I would not have preferred to rent from here simply because the prices were higher than usual but the company I worked for had a corporate account so didn't have much of a choice.

Sorry... Did not meet my expectations. Ordered Fiesta nachos and they were a soggy mess. Ordered 3 hard tacos and they were just plain tasteless. Taco Bell is better. Was impressed with the service and the extensive menu. Maybe I should have ordered something else.

This place is terrible. I can never understand why the parking lot is always full. It is amazing how bad their waitstaff is and the hostesses are about as uninviting as it gets. The only redeeming thing about Bacco's is their pizza and a couple of the appetizers. The entrees I have had were just awful.

My favorite sushi spot that I have been coming to for years. I ordered takeout today and it was made quickly but with care. The presentation was even beautiful in to go containers! The servers are always prompt and kind. I have never been disappointed here and will keep frequenting this place!

Honestly this place sucks. The amount of beans and rice that came with the combo is pathetic. Like one spoon (not full) of beans and rice and the tripas are soggy. Yeah its 6$ for a combo plate but you're actually getting your 6$ worth if not less. Yes their nice employees but i went to eat not to talk. Im never coming here again.

Great service and great staff! I have been going to Simpkins for many years and they have always been terrific. The turn around time is great and the prices are very reasonable. Additionally, any time I ever needed a tailoring repair, they have turned that around quickly as well. I highly recommend Simpkins.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I've been going here for a few years and can't go anywhere else. The atmosphere is great, staff is friendly, and they always offer you a drink, water or wine :) on the weekends it's better to go at 4 or later or else you'll have a wait and no appointments on the weekends. Priced very similar to other nail salons.

I am so in love with this restaurant.  The food is so good!  I'd call it "refined" Mexican, though mu of the dishes are very rustic and home style. So different from the run-of-the-mill Mexican restaurants.   My favorite fish is the Chicken Mole.  The service has been exceptional every time.  I've never been disappointed.

I absolutely love staying at Hyatt Place when on the road and this property didn't disappoint. The entire staff was amazing and everything was top notch. The room was clean and comfortable. Breakfast was great. I always recommend Hyatt to friends if they're looking for a quality experience. Thanks Nashville!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Pure trash. Over charged me. She charge 2$ for a water cup. I complained And instead of refunding me my hard earned money, she reluctantly gave me a regular cup for fountain drinks... That I didn't want in the first place. I hate when people double down on their mistakes. I really hope she reads this and Repents for her sins

This was the worst food I've ever paid for. The pictures of the food mislead me to believe it was quality. The quality is lower than a public school cafeteria. This was a complete waste of $50. Don't waste your time here, you'll be happier at White Castle.

Pros:  pets are allowed, clean rooms, very nice staff.

Cons: LOUD AC unit  and Windows that allowed every single sound from the highway in!  It seemed to never stop!  I didn't sleep well because of the noise.  Rooms need an update but bed was comfy and clean.

Overall I would try to find a place farther from the highway next time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: First time at this place.  Staff was friendly. I ordered chicken wings and I thought it was pretty good!  My fam had chicken tenders. All seem to like it as well. I gave it a 3 star because I didn't taste any seasoning but otherwise it was not bad. It was crispy enough.  I'd go back again

Stopped in while wandering the downtown area shopping.  The patio was empty which is why we went here to sit down in the shade and grab a beer. 

Pros: decent beer selection, fast and friendly service

Cons: very out dated interior and furnishing wise.  Overall interior was lacking on the cleaning side.

We stopped by Alia's in hopes for good drinks and a nice work environment. We were disappointed with a sweet, flavor-lacking chai and internet that was incredibly slow (despite being the only ones there). I hope to stop by and review again, for this time, not great.

Three cars crashed into each other today, while going through the line. When one of the drivers asked one of the employees why no one came to help, his response was, "Did you read the sign? It says enter at your own risk."
Yea, nah. This isn't number cars.

An update to what I wrote on October 24th. 
Budget finally came to their senses and credited my credit card $104.15. More and more companies are going out of business because their customer service and customer relations SUCK! 
When I worked in retail, we followed the motto....
THE CUSTOMER IS ALWAYS RIGHT!!!

Great restaurant!  The bread and butter was a nice touch. We started off with gizzards, they were the best gizzards I have ever had., the breading was amazing. The ranch was great! I had the salmon, it was so flavorful, it flaked nicely and the glaze was just right! I also had a side of pasta either white sauce. We will be back!

kind of bad smelling, but most gyms are. for what the price a month is the place is pretty ok. im just going to workout, not lay on the floors and walls. thanksfully its not crazy busy and the machines are prettty up to par. not bad for however much i pay a month, plus some of the gyms in other cities totally make it worth it.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I like this place considering the distance it is from my house! I used to go to Goodland but not only is it farther but the barbers are always loud and obnoxious and they talk more than they cut hair. It is a bit pricier than them but the close distance makes up for it! Ask for Danny, cool guy

Great place that has a coastal California vibe. The tacos are great and the corn is to die for!!! Love the atmosphere and the indoor/outdoor options. I also like the a la carte style although it can get quite pricey. The center wrap-around bar is great too!

Really like this place - not your ordinary run in the mill Mexican food.  Be warned that this is only a Mexican restaurant at night. During the day, it's an eggs and bacon breakfast kind of place.  Great outdoor seating, delicious (cheap specials!) food.   
I'll be back....

I'm very picky when it comes to mexican food, but this is probably one of my favorite mexican restaurants in Philly. I love their wet avocado burritos. They are amazing. Never been to this place as I've always had the food delivered. The delivery service is very quick.

I go to George's for the chicken velvet soup because it's the only place in town that sells it. Food is good. Not great. But service is always awful. Slower than slow & everyone who works there seems like they would rather be anywhere else but there. Forgetful & aloof.

One of the worst services I had ever experienced in my life. I sat at the drive through for 15 minutes waiting to place an order another vehicle came they took care of that car and when I went inside to talk to a manager she was rude and refused to take my order. They are the worst I've ever come across through.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I always love this place. BUT - the hostess I had on Saturday night was incredibly rude. She suggested I was incorrect about my reservation, and refused to accommodate us even though I called in advance for my mother's birthday weeks ago. Everything else was great.

Great pizza and a great price! They messed up my order but fixed it ASAP! I was a little leery after all the bad reviews but I thought I would try it anyway. Glad I did! The appetizers were good I wouldn't bother with the stuffed mushrooms again but everything else was great.

Had nothing but good food and great service EVERY time we had dinner here. I always liked the way cooked their meat but last time I had the scallops and they were perfect. So, yes they do both meat & seafood very well and their French onion soup is delicious.

Used to be good place for classic, homemade Italian cuisine,  but prices have gone up and service has gone down. Won't be back. Found a much better BYOB Italian in Malvern( TONINO'S)with GREAT homemade pasta dishes and phenomenal short ribs. High end cuisine disguised as a pizza joint.

I usually stop on my break at work to grab a bite. Afternoon is always busy and I have noticed that it depends on the manager whether your food will be on time. I reccomend going inside because using the mobile ordering app for curbside does not make your food come out any faster.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: There is always a big line outside, and so I was willing to give it a shot. It turned out to be rather disappointing. They say "you haven't lived until you've tried the red Chile." Well, I've lived. And now I wonder to myself "is that all there is?" You want red chile? Go to Taqueria Juanitos.

Loved the crust and sauce, but looked like they used canned mushrooms on my "Bobs Deluxe" their best seller. Came to $25 for a small pizza (which could feed two very well), small Caesar salad and a drink. It was ok, don't think I would seek it out next time I'm in town tho.

I visited this animal hospital after my cat Beau was bitten by a Western Diamondback rattle snake. The staff was very professional and attentive to Beau. Their quick actions (including blood work and antivenom administration) likely saved his life. Thanks so much!

Horrible service, slow and you end up getting nothing that you ordered. Its hard to understand why when there's 8 people working there and they still manage to not get one thing right that the customer ordered. Go to the one in Stowe the service is exceptional.

Was in Tampa/St. Pete for work and the desk guy was pretty pushy for upgrades since I was here for work. Pretty annoying. Then told me there were no gas stations between St. Pete and the airport. Guess a ploy to get me to pre-purchase gas? I chose another company for the next week of my trip.

Usually really like budget but this morning had a issue. Pulled into check in and budget wrote the contract wrong. That means I have to go to the front desk and straighten it out. Now I have the risk of missing my flight or risk being overcharged all because someone at budget did not do their job

I had an excellent experience!  Astgik B cut my hair. I have naturally curly hair and it's hard to find a stylist who doesn't cut  it too short.  She actually went on to straighten it with a round brush and hair dryer and then re-cut it so it was even.   best haircut I've gotten in a long.  time thank you!

I have been here once, but won't come back. I ordered tempura and my friend got teriyaki undo. They are really normal, do not need to Indy to enjoy the meal. I am not sure whether we ordered wrong dishes. Based on my past experience, sakura offers me just ok Japanese dishes.

Would not recommend the pizza or wings here. The pizza dough smelled so artificial that I couldn't even  stand taking bites of it. I can't even note how the sauce and cheese tasted because the dough smell overpowered it. We got mild wings and they seriously felt and tasted like they were microwaved.

I will give this location a little more credit than the Riverview location because they have been slightly more helpful. HOWEVER, they are so rude on the phone and clearly don't care one bit about anything but getting your money. I wouldn't recommend either location.

Called for a reservation, guy picks up, He had to repeat himself 3 times because I could not hear him. He yelled at me.... I schooled him on customer service 411. Like a fool, I still booked a reservation. 

If I ever had to guess what shit tastes like, Milanos is it.

Great location. I stayed here recently for business travel and found this property to be priced well compared to some of the nearby hotels.  Short walk to Millers Ale House (always a good choice for food and drinks). The rooms are a little dated but adequate. Decent fitness center as well.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel
