text: Kylo Ren's Fury blew my mind!! It was dark chocolate, cinnamon, habanero ice cream with a raspberry ribbon and dark chocolate chips. The spicy flare on top of the rich chocolate ice cream just made it work. Although it may not be for everyone, it is the most creative flavor I have had in an ice cream.

The Parkway Hotel was very nice! The customer service was excellent; and, all employees were very welcoming.  Complimentary breakfast is good for grabbing something quick.  We were in town for a wedding, but it is close to all the hospitals. A very pleasant place to stay if you have to be there for medical reasons.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This is the thrid time I have made a review and some how they are
removed.  Im sure this isn't the owner removing it. So if people can
 remove reviews, is this (real People.Real Reviews) I think I will use
the A list for now. And get the real deal. Don't take my word for it look
up Red's. on A-list See who are the Pro's

What a great place to eat sushi.  My husband had a few rolls and I did the sashami plate and it was very fresh and wonderful tasting.  I think it is family owned and everyone was very friendly.  The prices are very reasonable.  Not a fancy place at all but a great place to eat.

I have eaten here about 5 times and every time the food has been delicious, fresh and overall fantastic! I can't say enough about it. The service is wonderful and quick. It is a hidden gem in Yardley and they have great lunches as well as dinners. Dining outside is also a nice feature.  It's worth your while to go!

Had an early dinner there last night. The quality of food is totally not worth the $. The food was below average and bland. I could cook a better Italian dinner and I'm not a very good cook. The service was slow but bearable.  My date seemed to like their dish which I tasted and it was ok but there are better places in the area.

I went in for a routine eye exam. Covered 100% by insurance. The Optometrist that examined me coded it as an Opthalmic Medical exam and so insurance would not cover it. When I asked them to code it as a Routine Eye Exam, they refused. I would definitely go elsewhere!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
They make some mouth-watering, savory, authentic Mexican tacos at this place. I had the al pastor tacos on corn tortillas with cilantro and onions and would definitely recommend them.

Owners and staff are very friendly and passionate about food and service.

Vin Hoa is the BEST Chinese restaurant I've ever eaten at.  I've been getting food from them for over 20 years and their food is consistently good.  They are the only Chinese restaurant I have ever been to that I can say that about.  I love, love, love their Crab Rangoon and everything else I have ever gotten from there!!!

Had dinner here to celebrate with my husband, the service was wonderful, but that was the best part of our visit.  The wine was overpriced, the steak for $36 was very salty and slightly tough.  And it ended with a styrofoam to go box that was so thin it fell apart in the car and we had to clean the food off of the floor.

I generally prefer traditional sushi rather than new-wave.This place has both plus a very tasty selection of sashimi. I had nigiri and sashimi, my friend had maki, and even some veg. selections for my wife. Nice people. It is a bit small so not good for large groups. Besides that, highly recommended.

Hardly top line. I get more services in a Courtyard -- no place to get snacks or soda, shuttle takes forever.  Not sure it warrants the Renaissance brand. More Fairfield to me.  No mention at check in of Concierge lounge tho I'm platinum. Saw it referenced here. Oh well.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: It's expensive but handmade so justified. They run out of flavors often so go in with an open mind because they're probably out of whatever you wanted. Then you'll end up with an obscure flavor but not too obscure because then its freezer burned. Good luck! Sometimes it's good!

Brian was amazing to deal with. I called on a Monday, he fit me in 1st thing on Wednesday morning. We went over the challenge with my Jeep Grand Cherokee after dropping off at 7:30am on Wednesday. Already had received a call with a diagnosis by 10:30am. TAKE your car here! Friendly team, clean and HONEST!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I've only ever gone to Nightengale at this clinic. He used to be thorough, never made me feel rushed with my pet, and cares deeply. As he's gotten older the attention he paid seemed to be less and less. I don't know about the other vets at this clinic. The updates on your animals through email is nice though!

I love this place!! The staff is great and so is the food. I don't go here often but when I do I get the orange chicken combination plate. I also like that the food isn't super greasy. Its very clean on the inside and you don't have to wait on your food all day long.

This place was rediculious charge for parking and wifi they don't clean the rooms unless asked, and the on site restaurant was aweful with regard to service sitting for half of an before anyone takes my order another half 
Hour before I get any food and never got my drink....  And... Single ply to I. The rooms...  Wtf.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is the best coffee (black coffee) in Nashville. The atmosphere is inviting. Tanner was very friendly and insightful on brewing methods and types of beans they have. It is a little more expensive than other coffee shops but for the quality it is well worth it!

Sitting here waiting 45 minutes for a pizza that was supposed to take 20 minutes. The place is empty and the owners are in the back arguing while their children run around the restaurant. Wow such a poorly run business.

And the pizza was not even all that good. Wish I could have written a better review.

Lines are ALWAYS long and terrible... At least a half hour an that's during business hours!!! Staff is friendly but they really need to step it up. There is always people standing around doing nothing while line is long. Least efficient business I have ever been to.

First time here. Brought in two stray kittens that I decided to keep and all the staff was very friendly and helpful from the get-go. All my questions were answered and they were very sweet to the kittens during the examinations and vaccinations. Will definitely be back!

I've never had a bad experience with the quality of food from Hana but service there is not my favorite. Whenever we've dined in (which could be simply because we've gone during dinner) the place is louder than loud and the food is very slow to come out. For take out its a fine and relatively cheap sushi option in uptown.

i hate every McDonald's in Santa Barbara Except this one ! This is the only one i will eat at Because there customer service is Really​ good . the cashier BLAKE is Super nice and does a really good job Super happy with this place  thanks for making every trip to McDonald's a good one
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is seriously some of the best ice cream and frozen yogurt I've ever had and I'm somewhat of an expert or at least connoisseur. So worth circling around for a parking spot. Got the trio of three flavors for $6. Lots of gluten free and dairy free options too.

The absolute worst customer service of any franchise I've ever been to in my life. The elderly Asian woman in there is absolutely miserable and deserves to be fired like every single day. I've never met someone so incompetent at their job but yet still has one.

Pizza sauce is very sweet, meatballs were dry, green peppers were chopped like they would be on a frozen pizza, and dough was undercooked, for pizza I would not return, however the waitress was very accommodating even though she was the only one working on a fairly busy night(8 tables) and she was working the bar!

Great fresh Mexican food. The grill is visible from all seats in the restaurant. My wife usually gets the rib eye taco and a black bean soup. I mostly order the California burrito and bring half of it home for lunch the next day. The food here is far better than the Mexican restaurant next door. It's a real gem.

I've been a customer for several years. They have great service most of the time. People tend to trust the Goodyear name. But I always feel that they up sell yo when to are there. The tires for my 2006 Titan cost about $250 each and really don't last that long. A good mechanic is hard to find and this place does a decent job
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Manager is cold and lifeless. Acts as if the customer is a nuisance and an inconvenience. The pizza is OK. We've been customers of this Snappy for years. This is the worst run ST yet. The pizza is not good enough to endure the staff. Sad, really. This place will never make it with the current people.

Love the atmosphere, like walking in to Italy and being welcomed by an Italian gentlemen (I'm assuming the owner).  I give this 2 stars because of the food! We ordered 2 appetizers Gnocchi and Pear Fiocchetti. Both were flavorless, we actually left after the appetizer.

BYOB! Need I say more?  Ok. I guess I will.  Sushi is great. Service is great.  We (hubby and I) went on a Friday night at 6:30pm and seemed to just beat the convention center rush. Get the Love Boat if you're a party of 2.  Presentation is beautiful and the food was really good.  Not overpriced by any means.

So good! Rarely do I find ice cream that is worth a review. I got the fudge sundae and red velvet ice cream. The brownie and red velvet cake were moist and delicious. The employees were talkative and patient while we ordered. I also loved all the original flavors they had available.

The quality of food is unmatched in Reno. This is our new favorite spot, we have tried nearly everything on the menu and it is all extraordinary. The wait staff are helpful and sweet! Additional seating just outside the restaurant or in the wine bar next door. I vote this place best of Reno'

Horrible experience when applying for a loan. Found out they pulled my credit when they shouldn't have. Then, they flat out lied about the reasons for denial on the adverse action notice. Unethical business practices. I will file an official complaint.  Avoid them!!!

Racist. 

Tiny place, we were clearly in line first. 

The owners decided because the Caucasian couple behind us brought alcohol, they deserved a seat at the bar before us

Perhaps a smart business decision to cater to this group but a despicable way to deal with people of your own kind

I'm done with this overrated place.

Worst Wendy's I have ever been to! The floor was so gross! It smelled like cigarettes. They took forever to enter in our order. The drink machine smelled bad andddd there was a hair stuck in it! The water was discolored, I threw it out immediately!  This place needs an overhaul! I would give a zero is I could!

Waited 11 mins for 10 piece nugget which came to me cold and mushy. Took them back to counter for new ones. Manager made it right and got me new ones, but what was gross was to see an employee eating fries from the serving station. She was sneaking them in her mouth as manager walked past.!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Worst rip off ever. Saint James is so egregious I created a yelp account just to warn innocent bystanders. Service is mediocre at best. Prices through the roof and my best description of my meal is dry dog food. However the fries are great, but is it too much to offer ketchup without having to  ask? Why can't I rate ZERO stars?

I really liked this place. The flavors are all unique and you can taste the quality natural ingredients. After sampling several I decided on the signature Orange Cycle and was not let down. Yummy waffle cones freshly made. 
Great service and very accommodating. 
Will definitely be back!

Tacos are small but godly, literally learned to love duck here. Not the biggest fan of their beef tacos; however, my partner loved some of them and we had just about everything on the menu and cannot give any other complaints. Staff are fun and I like their hands off way of ordering food.

It is now called Rock n Rebel. Menu & food has changed . Got a salad that was small and VERY over priced. "Crock" of chilli was VERY over priced! Tiny small cup for 5.99! Wraps now do not come with home made chips and Coleslaw any more. That was a selling point .  I used to recommend people there . Not anymore

NICEST, NICEST owner.  Yummy yogurt, some sweet flavors, some not so sweet.  There are so many choices always that you are sure to find one you like.  There is also outdoor seating, which is great in nice weather.  All around one of my kids' favorite places for a treat.

they took me as a walk-in, contact and glasses exam, done in under 40 minutes.  decent glasses selection and mine were ready the next day.  only criticisms would be the generally chaotic situation at the front desk and how run-down the exam room was.  but all in all a good experience.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Don't be fooled by the newness of the corporate park- this hotel is just a spiffed up older model.  Old amenities (wall mounted hair dryer/ tiny tub) and you can hear through the walls- even normal conversation level.  Also- NO restaurant!!  You have to walk 2 hotels down to the better Marriott property for that.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This is my new favorite sushi spot. Everything came out quickly!  The staff was very kind and made sure we were taken care of!

I would definitely recommend this to anyone in the Marlton area looking for a good place to grab sushi at very reasonable costs.

Try the Phoenix roll! It was my favorite! Everything was very fresh.

It was an amazing experience. Best experience I have ever had with a car rental company. I always leave at least an hour leeway time to pick up or drop off a car, but even though it was off airport, it only took about 15 minutes to get picked up dropped off, serviced at the counter and in the car. AMAZING !!!!

100% pleased. I really appreciate how manager was waiting for us arriving late and helping us with our luggage bags. The car was clean and didn't have a smell. It was nice to have a choice of cars. It was great the driver's seat had adjustable lumbar support - I'm 5'2" and sometimes the driver's seat is way too wide and deep.

Food was good. Service was good. I wish the food and service were great. The atmosphere is cozy and the chocolate martinis at the bar after dinner were yummy. I remember the food being a lot better tasting and more interesting in the past so we were disappointed.

I was hoping to order a Marco's pizza online because I heard so many good things about them. Somehow it wouldn't take my address so I couldn't order. Tried 5 times, kept entering my address and it wouldn't accept it. So much for the convenience of online ordering. Not in the mood anymore for pizza, so I'll try calling next time....

Today was the first time I have went to an actual Froyo. I must say that I had a excellent experience the flavors and prices where awesome and the have a military discounts. The best part was the customer service Majda and Zaharh were awesome very helpful and polite.

Dirty, dirty check out belt every time I go there!  I talk to the manager on one occasion told him it was one reason I don't go there. I was there today and again filthy belt.
Also people please check your slips! I returned many times because of errors. Today was the coupon for the watermelon did not come off last weeks order.

Worst Starbucks ever. I stood there for several minutes before I was even asked if I needed something. You can watch the employees and see they don't even talk between themselves.  The mood is very depressing. Take my advice and drive a few more miles to a Starbucks that cares about their customers.

I have always looked for a descent Chinese place that delivered, my normal spot at Front and Cheltenham doesn't deliver.... thanks to Yelp. I found this spot. it was just as good as my normal place. descent delivery time, actually faster then I thought. now I have two Chinese spots.

We have taken our animals to Pantano Animal Clinic for the last 15 years and love it. We now have 1 dog and 1 cat (Dr. Lent saved our last cat, who had been attacked by a bobcat. The cat lived several more years and died of old age). We wouldn't go anywhere else.

I live across the street so when I first moved in this was my go-to suhsi place. I went almost 10 times before I realized it was sub-par compared to other sushi restaurants nearby. A very hit-or-miss locale. Sometimes it's great, sometimes it's cruddy. Either way, not worth the price.

Waited too long for the meal. After finding the manager passing shots on the deck and complaining our waiter finally came back to check on us. Brought out part of meal.l, but not the crab legs. Many better places on the beach to visit. Won't come back again

Dr Bufkin is wonderful. She is kind, caring, and patient. She explains everything beforehand and then again as you need her to. She came to our home and helped us when our little old man dog was suffering, in the most gentle and compassionate way possible. She really helped us, and we couldn't be more grateful for her expertise.

Friendly staff and great service. The pizza options all sound amazing. I got he farmers market pizza it was delicious. I recommend it highly. The fountain drinks are unique as well. I had the blackberry lemonade it was refreshing. Recommend coming here for lunch or dinner.

Had a very good experience at this location recently. I went in for 4 new tires and the service was great. The staff was polite and friendly, the price (including sale) was better than expected, and my car was ready on time. No complaints, would come back for future service.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I have taken my French bulldog here since she was a pup. They always take great care of her. Are quick to call me back if I'm worried or have a question about something. Dr. Yuhas is experienced and kind. Always explains everything to my anxious self, takes the best care of my dog daughter

I have been coming to this place for a while and always left satisfied. Food always fresh , staff are very helpful and friendly. First time ordering delivery from them and it was so fast , they got to my door like around 30 mins . Highly recommended, try them out whenever u are in the area and craving sushi !!

They guys here do the best to help you get the car or truck you want. We rented a full size to take to Florida and they gave me a QX80 Infiniti perfect for the trip. They got of there way to try to get want you want.  Stephen Ryan is great!  I will always come back to them.

First visit and will be going back. I've never be a huge fan of donuts but this place might change my mind. But seriously some yummy donuts that hand made to order. 

The owner was also supper sweet. Verdict just go and try this place and if your not a donut lover this place might change you.

Excellent food and quick service. My first time here. Much better than traditional fast food places. I had the double bacon cheeseburger special and it was delicious. I will definitely be coming here again. Outdoor seating only so flies were a minor inconvenience hence 4 stars.

I stopped in because of all the whoop la, and I was mildly disappointed. I got two slices to go and maybe that's the problem. I loved the sauce, it's probably the best pizza sauce in NO, but it had no cheese on it. If I ordered a whole pie to go would I have got at least some cheese on it?

Rented from this location a few times. They never have my car ready, The cars look okay on the outside but are pretty on the inside stains torn carpet.  Not the best if you're picking up clients.  Plan to be there a while to get your car.  Looking for alternatives as I type.

I got two slices of pizza for a quick lunch, needless to say, after waiting for about 20-30mins, for co-workers wing order, I'll never go back after that, pizza was very dried out, like it was sitting for a while,& very thin, where the one slice had a hole in the middle. Russ G.

Won't be going here anymore cause they still have their lobby closed so you can't go in with your pet ! BULLSHIT ! Everywhere else is open but not this Vets office ! REALLY what the hell is the problem ? My dog can go in but I can't , somethings not right about that.

I had tremendous help today from bank manager Serena. She was quick, professional, and very thorough. And she had good management skills with the surrounding customers and bank staff. She was easy to understand, explained procedures well to me and was able to accomplish quite a lot in a little space of time. I am very grateful.

This is just my type of restaurant. The meat and three as it is called around home. The food was good and had a lot of options. The staff are some of the friendliest people I meet around there. I was there for lunch and really wanted to come for breakfast. Thanks

Honestly the most adorable ice cream parlor I've ever seen. Delicious ice cream and a lot of variety! There's even an arcade for the kids (and young at heart!). The banana peanut butter chip was ridiculous. Honestly just what I look for in ice cream. Great hidden gem, will definitely be back!

Everytime I order the Dragon Eye Roll it is less and less tasty.  This time I even took half home because I just couldn't eat anymore of it.  Also, seems to be the last place on earth that charges for a soda refill, without telling you.  So the $3.40 the restaurant made on my refill came out of the tip.

I just ordered delivery from here and was super underwhelmed. I got the tofu and veggies. I didn't get the rice that I was supposed to and the tofu wasn't cooked very well. So I basically ended up paying 25 bucks for a box of veggies in a salty sauce. Would probably be better in the restaurant but who knows.

There are not enough compliments or recommendations I can give to Marlin and Garage-1, of course there is a reason why he is in such demand. Could not be happier with the work he did on my Porsche and strongly recommend you consider Garage 1 for work you need on any car you own.

It was disappointing that even with a reservation our 15 passenger van was not ready. Our team of 11 year old boys, who had traveled all day, had to wait an hour for the van. I will be using a company with better customer service for our next traveling tournament.

Was looking forward to their brunch.  Waitress was super nice and efficient. However we ordered drinks and an app. After over 30 mins we still hadn't received our drinks and the appetizer came before hand. Waitress said the bar was backed up but when we closed out there was one person sitting at the bar. Hands down worst service.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Absolutely incredible! The service is top notch. Our waiters were on top of their game, knowledgeable and could answer our questions with perfect description. The food was incredible and prepared to absolute perfection. Do yourself a favor, make reservations and do not miss out on this St. Louis jewel.

Fantastic Sushi!

Packed on a Saturday night, definitely a good sign when you're walking into a new-to-you restaurant. Ingredients are high quality, service is spectacular, and getting able to watch sushi being made by skilled artists is always a treat. 

Will be back for sure!

I must've visited them on a bad day. The person who wiped my car post the wash was disinterested and left quite a few spots on the car. Also, the wash wasn't as great as I expected from the reviews. This was my first car wash in the area and I hope I find a better place.

Let me start by saying these guys are awesome. I had no appointment. I had an emergency. Scott, the manager got me in and got me two new tires very quickly. This is not your average "discount" tire place. They are knowledgeable, friendly, quick, and above all else, honest people. Thanks guys. You helped me a lot.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I made a reservation a week ago for mother's day. My family and I drove the long drive to Figaro's (we don't live nearby) and lo and behold, it was closed! I'm not sure why they were closed. I did make a reservation and their hours are from 5:30-9:30 on Sundays.

Coffee okay.,music inappropriate at times, not the cleanest place around 
Furniture looks trash picked. 
Big issue male worker owner generally  a big moody creep
.i try to interact as less as possible. 
With so much competition nearby pretty stupid. Lady always nice.

Good pizza,you get to customize it. I'm so happy the old gallery is back open,
Great job so far and still incomplete. 
In this retail Apocalypse this was a ballsy $200 million investment.
Only 4 stars since they were out of many common toppings early in the day. 
I would return and recommend.

Stopped in there a few weeks ago for a pizza.  The kid that answered the phone didn't know the menu, and then ignored me for five minutes after my arrival while he watched television and folded pizza boxes.

The pizza was good, nothing special, but I would go there again.

Taking my business elsewhere, needed my military uniform dry cleaned and 3 very small patches put on. Brought in on Wednesday needed by Friday at close. Lady said they were to busy for me. Some way to treat the military. Luckily I found a better place said no problem have it to me Friday at 1.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Where do I start with this location! They never get your order correct. All I order from there is a large sweet tea with NO ice. Those idiots always give me a bitter tasting tea with NO sugar and a cup full of ice. Don't get me started on that horrible layout of a drive thru.

Ordered the pint size of shrimp fried rice and I kid you not I counted a total of four small shrimp mixed in it! Rice was overly cooked and hard....chicken wings were the only good part of the meal. One tip to the owners would to be have your front counter people work on their customer service.

I was 18 and this was my first time ordering contacts. You took advantage of situation and my lack of knowledge in this area. Since then I have done research my own and found affordable options for contacts and also other local clinics that offer exams at a much lower cost.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Got takeout from this restaurant and was unfortunately under impressed. I was really hoping for higher quality food considering the price point is not cheap. However, the pasta was just okay. I had super high hopes for this restaurant and ended up a little disappointed.

This place is great, reasonably priced and great customer service. When I picked up my cleaning I brought in a pair of shorts to have a button put on.
She put it in while I waited and did not charge me. I tried to give a $5 tip, but she would not take it.

Try them out you won't be disappointed.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I only came to this place after reading other reviews...this is a good size chinese food rest, but almost missed it when driving by but very clean rite out from when u walked in, the owner seemed very friendly, and the food...lets just say i will defenetly come back when I visit Reno.

The Bashful Bandit is safer than Safeway grocery stores as well as safer than driving on Tucson's streets.
The Bashful Bandit has hosted many charity events and contributes much to Tucson's culture.
Good food on weekends and probably the safest place in Tucson for an unescorted woman.

0 Stars. 
Probably not a good idea to stay here if you are a person of color. 

Staff at the front desk was rude. The lady was talking nicely to the couple in front of me but not the case when I showed up. Read some other reviews and I can see the similarities in the way they treat people.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I've been to this location a couple times in the past. The sales pressure is obnoxious. I purchased contacts after getting worn down by the employee. When I called back the next day to cancel she barely spoke before hanging up on me. Last visit to that store. I drive by now and just shake my head.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The ice cream is good.  The place is a mess.  Trash is overflowing while employees just stand around behind the counter.  The men's restroom is currently out of order and the women's is dirty and messy.  If I owned this franchise, I would step up the experience by providing a clean place with employees that care.

Really bad. Poor customer  service. I mentioned that they did not do any callous  remover on my mother and the lady began at arguing instead of just  doing it.  won't be back ever.  

We now go to One Day Nails  6174 E Speedway. They are busy but fantastic. Detailed and very

Had to get reservations a month prior.
Was a nice restaurant and the service was good.
The food was ok. Appetizers and the Tiramisu was amazing.
The main dishes was ok. we tried some pasta dishes, sword fish and branzino.
I definitely have had better Italian in the city.

The place looks and smells great! However, the music was so lame, the food was meh, and they did not serve the allergenic sensitive food in separate plates like we asked, so we couldn't eat it due to the cross contamination. Very disappointed, after having been eyeballing the place for years now.

The only Krispy Kreme is town. The service is great, the girl named Celina is the best. Always smiling when me and my friend walk in. The donuts always hit the spot even when it's closing time. I highly recommend this place is you have a sweet tooth. It's not just the donuts but it's the service.

The female employees at this bank location have attitude & are extremely rude. This bank needs to train their employees on how to provide customer service or just hire nicer people. The people at 5/3 Bank on Donelson Pike are extremely nice & helpful. Do not go to the location on Old Hickory Blvd in Hermitage !

It's going on 2 hours and still no food. I placed a delivery order for a reason, so I don't have to go out but 2 hours is excessive and when I call to check on it, they told me maybe the driver got lost and then she proceeded to ask me YOU don't have a car? I'm about to lose it. I don't even want to try this food anymore.

Located very close to my house, I wanted to really like this food. Unfortunately, it's probably the worst Chinese food in the area. We've tried it 5 times now and each time it gets worse.  We are done. Advise to try Sichaun House, or Mandarin House or even Dragon House in Fishers.

Would have been three stars for the service but we were super disappointed by the food. There was literally yellow mustard on the octopus appetizer, and the other appetizers we got were bland. They should try some really good Italian in the area like non solo in Morrisville.

This was the worst experience. 
Ran out of work to bring my dog in for limping & crying from pain.
Arrived 20 min late & the very unpleasant office manger turned us away. 
Mindboggling!! Wow!
1 happy person tells 5 people, 1 unhappy person tells 10.
Another Vet is gracious enough to sneak her in today.

It was OK the food was bland didn't have any taste. I live right across the street from this place. I just wanted to try something different. I ordered the taco salad but it didn't have any taco shells in it. I probably want go back to this place. The staff was friendly just not helpful when ordering food.

This was a half a block from the Marriott where I was staying, it's a small neat place.  I opted for take out which I ordered online. I had a bento box which was well prepared and nicely presented in a takeout container.  The staff was very nice and attentive.   Great choice if you are staying near the convention center.

First off this place is super tiny- only 3 tables! We did get a table after waiting a little and  We Got the meatballs, garlic bread to start. Both very good, and then we got the pochetta and melanze pizza. Both delicious  but enjoyed the melanze more. Their pizza is really dense so expect to be full after two slices !

When I picked up my items only one of three looked like it had been cleaned. The other two items had hair, stains , and deep wrinkles. After items were redone, wrinkling was better, stains were mostly gone, and dry brushing on the spot too care of the rest except stain in picture below.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
As far as haircuts - fine......I had my preferences as who cut my hair, but generally had no issues besides... 
What completely put me off though and lost my business were the mannerisms and the obnoxious behavior of certain someone there. Moreover - the way he treated his female employees was a disgrace.

Get ready for them to take your credit card and debit card information and ring up random charges without your permission, when you aren't even there.  It's been two months since I visited them one time and four separate charges showed up on my accounts in one morning while I was at work.

The food was bad. This was the first salad that my son had to spit back out from any sushi place we've ever been to, and he loves that salad.  The chicken in the Bento box looked terrible and the noodles were overcooked. The food looked very unappealing. We left without finishing our meal.

My husband and I have lived in North County for 7 years and had not found pizza we really liked until we tried this place. It was far and above the best we've had in the area. Great sauce, just the right amount of cheese, and we love their Italian sausage! We're done looking! This is our new pizza joint!

Stayed here for one night while traveling to east coast. Showed up with no reservations and was quickly given a room.  Staff was prompt and courteous. Pull out couch was missing bedding and staff quickly got us some. Overall a good quick stay and would come back. Recommend trying this hotel if in the area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Ordered from here a few times. Delivery is slow and the food comes cold. Pizza is definitely different and would be good if they put some care into it. Do not order the "chicken salad", it is literally only canned chicken breast and mayo on basic white bread.

Weve been here before and it was great but not so much this time.. it was Good food... and the severs were nice.. but the service was slow... took 30 mins for my husband's rolls. And we didn't get our last roll so we just left.. bummer .. because that place is good...

Ever since the management change this place has gone downhill. No one seems to know what's going on and all my pre booked appointments have been lost. I only go to this place because of my amazing nail tech Laura (who I've been loyal to for 6+years). If she wasn't here i assure you i wouldn't spend my money here.

The food and service were great, however I am knocking it one star because they do not have a changing table for infants. It's something small, but Conshy is infested with young families. There should be at least one in one of the two gender neutral bathrooms.

I would give zero stars if that was possible.  Gnats in the wine, waitor was rude and slammed wine glasses on table and said "I am done with your table" after we complained about gnats.  Do not even think for a second this place is worth your time money and meals.  Buyer beware!

Honestly, I don't understand what the hype is about. I went because I won a gift card so I thought I'd give it a shot. The veggie dumplings were burnt, the avocado rolls were warm which freaked me out, and the rice containers weren't even filled all the way. The only thing that was good was the ginger dressing and the service.

Love this place but guy in the deli area wasnt wearing his mask over his mouth and nose so I decided not to add more and did instacart from another store. If you're going to wear the mask.. wear it. All that money to be covid complaint and you cant even wear a mask?!

kinda of a cool joint in South Reno. The night I stopped in there was a cool band playing some decent tunes. BUT the bartender ladies are slow as hell to acknowledge youre there and even slower at getting your drinks. Will give this place another shot though and see what happens.

Our friends recommended us this cafe, so we decided to have lunch there. The BBQ ribs were very good, but my Mongolian beef was way too salty. Fried rice was disappointing too. The hot tea they served us was hardly warm and very dark, in other words not freshly made.  It was our first and last time at this cafe.

Food is good and the atmosphere is cool but the music is WAY WAY too loud. To the point that the 3 of us couldn't even talk at our small table. I used to take everyone there when they came to visit from out of town but the loud, horrible music tonight ruined the experience and unfortunately I won't be back.

Meh. I had the short ribs which were too fatty to eat. Ordered a side of Brussels sprouts which never came out. Had to remind waiter to have removed from bill. Spinach salad was fine. Not a bad place, but since I squandered $170 for two, there are better options.

Excellent, excellent place to go! Everything I've tried there is amazing, especially the tortellini, and the prices are very reasonable. Brian, the owner, is very friendly, as are all the wait staff there. It's just a great place to relax and enjoy the food and companionship.

I go to collegeville cat clinic cause they care! Unlike an ER  i visited on sat june 29,19,I always get great treament from them,5 stars all day everyday.Stand up recomended place for my furkids!They are NOT a groomer its a vet,need grooming go to a groomer

Moved here from Boston, so obviously needed a new wine bar. This was the choice! And it is a good one! The food is spectacular, although I would like to have a few more options to choose from. The wine is lovely as well. And, if you like old movie theaters, there is one across the street. Great date night!

For something different at a pizza place the wings and salad are very good.  The bar service is just ok.  Too much making drinks for the tables to pay attention to people at the bar.  The bar is very big and a great place to watch the goings on.  Good crowd on a Thursday night.

It was just OK. I would not go out of my way to go there. I had the pizza and it was not great again just ok. My wife had the shrimp Alfredo and it was soupy too much sauce. We are staying at a campground in almost walking distance and I don't believe we will be back this trip. Just not a real favorite for me or my wife.

Com'on Wasabi, please don't combine cheap instant noodles with pre-mix broth and call it 'ramen'. It's not even close. It was a very disappointing dish. I hope you quickly improve otherwise word will spread amongst locals and you may not last long. Will only return if I see improved ratings

The doctor and staff at Pennsylvania Optometrics Vision Center are alway courteous and efficient. I have visited their office several times, once for an emergency and they got me in on a very crowded day. I have never had a negative experience there. I highly recommend them! Plus, Dr. Brosof has a great sense of humor.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: In town for business, went here for lunch.  3 stars on the food.  Had the tortellini with prosciutto and mushrooms.  Cream sauce was just right and not to heavy.  Need to add a little more prosciutto. Reminded me a lot of Patrizio's in Dallas.  Great patio, great location, and the service was on point.

Avoid this place:  the rooms need major carpet overhaul...
There are stains , spots, &  ripples throughout most of the rooms.

That being said= housekeeping repeatedly does NOT vacuum rugs after each guest.

This is the worst Sheraton I've ever been to.

The location is nice, but that is it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Nice Italian family restaurant in Jenkintown. We had good pizza with a nice thin crust. Decent garlic dinner rolls. One member of the family got a pasta dish with crab in a vodka sauce, which was also nicely prepared. Family also enjoyed the calamari appetizer. Good service with an attentive staff - friendly atmosphere.

After being in here for over 15 minutes without being acknowledgement from any of the 5 sales agent present. I have no choice but to give a review. I brought my business elsewhere. The colour of my skin shouldn't justify the service I receive. This isn't our neighbors down south.

The best restaurant in Tucson 100%

Marvelous!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Decent car wash.  However, my seat belt panel was broken during the duration of my car being in their possession. The manager stated that because he "was the one who vacuumed and sent it through the wash" they are "not responsible" because he "didn't see anything happen to it". I will never give them my business again.

I've definitely had better Chinese food. This was a more on the bland side. My boyfriend and I ordered general tsos and chicken and broccoli and weren't too crazy about it. The crispy noodle things were stale. The hot and sour soup was not hot and sour and was more on the sweet side. I won't be eating here again.

Not too bad if you're in a sushi mood and happen to be downtown. It is on the expensive side as far as sushi goes here...but the quality almost is worth it. That said, the downside is the often slow service. The servers are generally polite, and the food decent.
Not the best sushi I've had, but not the worst either.

I was born in Naples, and I can tell you this is about as close to authentic Italian cuisine as I've come across in Philadelphia. A little more salt in the sauces than we might use at home but that is to be expected in restaurants. Excellent food. Try their Napoli salad....fantastic!

Rather new to Boise. Looking for a thirsty Thursday adult beverage. A co-worker and I found this by happenstance. What a wonderful discovery. Warren was the barkeep and was absolutely wonderful. Comfortable, easy to  talk in this atmosphere. Going to make it a regular stopping point. Good selection, great prices and free popcorn.

Was excited to try this place out based off the reviews. The interior design was nice. However the portion sizes of the rolls were completely lacking. It's basically a half sized (maki) rolls for a full priced roll. The flavor was all there it tasted great  but overall it was disappointing.

My husband and I have eaten in the restaurant and also Uber Eat's it! SO good! We've had the Tortellini, meatballs, garlic bread (SO GOOD), and chicken fettuccini Alfredo. There's not a single bad thing to say, everything was so fresh. Not the typical pasta you get out at restaurants - it was incredible!

Modern and well maintained hotel and room. Very comfy bed. Friendly staff. Fair price. Will definitely stay again.

Breakfast quality was just okay and could stand some improving, which is why gave 4 instead of 5 stars. But in grand scheme of things not a big deal!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Mmm..I love Cafe Napoli.  The bar is great as well.  The staff is well educated, friendly, and go above and beyond to make their customers happy.   The night life at Napoli isn't bad either.  Who can go wrong with beautiful people and tasty drinks? I prefer a nice glass of wine from the huge wine selection.

This is my second time ordering the $11.50 lunch special, 3 different sushi rolls with miso soup.  I'll continue to order from Kabuki when I feel like having sushi.  I'm going to try to taste all of the different rolls as they give you 40 different options!  Amazing. The food is just awesome.

It was my first time ordering here and I don't regret my decision! I really liked the thin layer of rice and the flavor was perfect. Also the service was really good!! But I must give a 4 star is because there was a tiny piece of fish bone inside philly roll. Other than that, everything was perfect!

I love this place the people are nice the food is to die for and  it's so close to home. Last couple times I have gone there the eating area is not the cleanest. The tables and floors are always sticky but as long as you take the food to go you will be on cloud 9 after you finish eating

No frills gym with all the basic cardio machines, weight machines, free weights, and even a circuit training area. They also offer free fitness training with a staff member. If you are looking for a bare bones gyms this is a good affordable option. However, there are no extra such as a pool nor any Pilates, Zumba, yoga, etc.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Great Mexican food. Great prices. Huge portions. Extensive menu. Fresh, clean, attractive decor. We were amazed by this new Mexican restaurant. They've been open for two weeks today. All food made from scratch fresh twice a day. We were stuffed and ate less than half of our order! We have a new favorite Mexican restaurant.

This Wendy's has been around since the 80's and is desperately in need of being torn down and modernized. I eat here often and the food is good but the staff's service is usually horrible. If there was another Wendy's closer I'd never go back to this again.

Good pizza especially the crust. The pasta on the other hand was awful. The penne with vodka sauce tasted like Chef Boyardee and the lasagna was literally six layers of noodles with nothing in between swimming in watery marinera. No thanks. No excuses for this garbage.

used be a lot better. 
I always get General Tao's chicken. 
These days, I feel somewhat they are not doing as good as they used to. 
Getting too greasy and ingredients are not as fresh as before. 
Well, still it's so close to my place, that's why I order for delivery once in a while.

The mac was okay--I wouldn't rave over it--but it was decent. I agree with others that it's overpriced and a tad greasy. If you have children--this place is a MUST. Kids meals are $5 and that includes milk/juice. For the single folks--unless you're a college student--I suggest going elsewhere.

I rent every other weekend.
Service has always been courteous, even friendly, and punctual.
I will continue to rent here - as long as they pick me up from home - with my heavy suitcase.
Pity that the occasional sales never seem to apply here.
Ryan, and others, were professional.

My wife and I went there on our anniversary two years in a row. The menu was unchanged down to the stains on the cover. The decor is old and tired and the service so so. We won't be back. This place is in serious need of renovation of the building and an overhaul of the menu.

Won't be ordering again. My pizza was cold, doughy and a lot of flour. Sausage tasted like tiny meatballs instead. Cheese or crust wasn't good. Overall the entire pizza experience was disappointing. Also ordered carrot cake. Equally if not more disappointing. Dry inside and hard around edges and no flavor. Probably got an old one.

I'd 100% stay here again! Great area with close restaurants and shopping but not too far outside the city. Clean and comfortable rooms - I slept great of which I rarely do in hotel rooms. Friendly staff and very nice breakfast in the morning. Make your own waffles, eggs, turkey bacon, pastries, fruit, coffee.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We were always fans of Moxies on Sharlands..Today we went in for some favorites . Calamari came out as some kind of sticks instead of body parts fried. my burger was dry and had no tomato ,onion , or lettuce as it was before . i was told there is a new chef..my advice would be to try and rehire the old chef . won't be going back..

15 minz till closing i got turned away for to go soup people were pulling in and they were like oh well .. went once was great .. but ive been in the hospitality business half my life and if ur sign says 9 ur open till 9 bad move i will not be back and i will spread the word

I was uncertain if this uptown Italian could compare to Irene's. I am no longer in doubt. The veal was paneed as it should be and the vodka pasta does not suck. The broccoli casserole, which is only available on weekends is also a surprise treat. The service is also great. Tons of local charm is an extra as well.

Does the job for me - cheap, fast, not-quite-authentic takeout Chinese on my way home from classes and football. I can't really ask for much more than that.

Lunch specials are a great deal - I typically go for either the General Tso's chicken or the sesame chicken. My vegetarian wife loves the sesame tofu.

The store has moved to 490 N broad street-Suite 3.
The food is still nauseating and horrible!!!!! The chief got the COVID but still work in the kitchen!!!!! So horrible restaurant!
The Hong Kong owner is against gay, often sneered LGBT and black people in chinese!!!!!!!!!!!!

Terrible staff in the front, very careless and fatigued. The lady who helped me is very rude and seems like she could care less to be there, forget be helpful! Optometrist was pleasant and efficient. Front desk staff need a morale boost to do a better job!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
This place has really gone downhill on three occasions the chicken was dry and cold.They messed up my order in the drive through the employees
 are to busy with horse play and acting like kids on a play ground all while the manager sits in the dining ares eating with a friend... THIS PLACE SO SUCKS!!!

This place has the "Best Hurricanes" I have had on my trip!!! The bartender Corkey, she is  super friendly and the patrons are just as nice!!
They took our picture at the bar and  Kenny the manager  made me and my daughter a Rose from tissue paper.  They really know how to treat you at the Mona Lisa lounge!!!

Best mexican restaurant in town. Being Hispanic myself, i can get really picky with my Mexican food but this place hit the spot. Not only is the food great, but the service is pretty quick. Even on a busy day, from seating to paycheck it only takes about 30 minutes or less.

OMG I am here right now. We are done eating and are afraid to get up to pay. We are thirsty but not willing to go through the fear of acquiring a drink. So funny. But probably won't be back cause the sushi was fine but probably not worth the stress. Funny experience we stumbled upon.

We really enjoyed our meal here. They had nice variety on their menu. The food was fresh and well prepared. This restaurant is inside a Marriott, don't be turned off by that, it is very good and a refreshing change from the chain places in this area. My wife and I both had grouper each prepared differently. It was delicious.

Dear Owner,

The average McDonald's franchise makes over $1 million a year in profits.  I'm pretty sure you can use some of that to fix that eye sore of a wooden structure outside.  It has been peeling for years. Please help preserve the integrity of the Main line.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Bodybasics provides individual attention no matter your level of fitness or age. Their attention to detail in exercise form protects against injury. Being greeted by name with cheerfulness makes this such a welcoming place. Wonderful trainers, wonderful place!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Stuck in the back "patio" of a restaurant (Opa) this uninviting area had only six beers on tap. It was hard to hear over the hum of A/C condensers and tinny music blasting out of a $8 boom box.  Uncomfortable seats and wobbly tables. Hate to say it but we have had better ambiance in friends back yards. :/

Good for what it is. I did not expect more than what you'd get at the market but this was better. About a dozen choices that day on the all you can eat table. I'd go again and do it the same way since the menu descriptions are a bit vague and this way I could see what was going into my mouth.

It was our first time eating here. We had a nice view of the river. My Crema di Pest Degli Spinaci was very good my fiancee had the lamb it was kind of bland for his taste but our waitress was so nice that she gave us a free dessert to make up for it.  Nice atmosphere.

Their pizza is nothing special. They offer 4 different types of crust from NY style to deep dish. I wanted something in the middle so I ordered pepperoni & sausage on a Neopolitan crust. It was a thin crust but crispy.
The only ingredient on the pizza that had flavor was the ground sausage. I couldn't even taste the pepperoni.

Well I only write reviews if it's insanely great and the staff is awesome or if it's really poor. Fortunately the bartenders were awesome! The food just way below par. Zero flavor on the fish, seemed thawed although was told it was fresh. Broccoli and potato's terrible. Should have gotten a burger. Too bad. Great location

Food was excellent yesterday but when I asked for an extra shrimp for the 2nd order( was so good we ordered a second one so all could have one) the server said "no they don't do that". I explained I would pay extra to accomodate the extra shrimp. But she said no. Seriously? One shrimp extra? food great. Service not as impressive

The bad:  overcooked crab legs and terrible service.  Brought the complete wrong drink. 
The good:  beautiful view and live music.  
It's really a shame that one of the most beautiful views at the beach has substandard food and service.  So much potential here.

From start to finish, our experience was great! The butternut squash and olive oil dip with bread kicked things off followed by two good appetizers - just the right size. The pork special and veal dinner was fantastic -both so tender you could cut with a fork. Definite winner - we will be back for sure.

We've been going to Giovanni's for many years, and it's only gotten better now that they've doubled the size of their dining room. The biggest (really only) problem before was the wait at their peak times. There just wasn't enough space for everyone who wanted to be there. Give it a try, you'll like it!

Portobello pizza and four cheese.  Both edible. Portobello was not as good as four cheese. At $4.50 a slice with same medium pizza $12, if you like the pizza then you may want to get medium pizza instead. It is very overpriced for an okay pizza. Not worth coming back forth. Go to Bagel Shop next store instead.

Don't waste your time. The website is misleading.  Went with family for breakfast. The potatoes were dark brown with no seasoning, scrambled eggs were bland, biscuit was not tasty at all, husband/daughter both ordered pancakes and couldn't finish them. We were very disappointed and can't understand all the rave reviews.

I ordered shrimp lomen combo.  Shrimp was small and no flavor and still I had to hunt for them.. One thing I admit is that I got lots of noodle and rice.   I guess they hope we will be satisfied for the quantity..  Fried rice had minute pork.. Stay away from this place.

One of our favorites when we are in St Pete! Great food and amazing service. I have had many different dishes and would be hard to pick my favorite. They are all terrific. 

We usually take a large group and they are always gracious and accommodating. We will be back!

Approved by New Yorkers!!! My wife is from New York and according to her, New Yorkers have high standards for their pizza. Pretty much at least 98% of Philly's pizza joints have disappointed her. Angelos is her top 3 in Philly because of their quality and affordability.

There is no reason for businesses to be cash only anymore it's 2019 and for them to have a non working atm outside is just absurd. I get it's cheaper for them but it should be about pleasing customers and a lot of people don't carry cash anymore for obvious reasons. I'll take my business elsewhere.

My family & I have been loyal patrons of Cafe Riviera since the early 90s. It's one of my favorite restaurants. Menu is wonderful, prices are reasonable and service is always great. I always order the same dish and in the 20+ years we've been coming to Cafe Riviera, the recipe hasn't changed. Delicious every time!

Worst car wash ever. Just horrible. Scratched up my windshields, my paint, left chips, and didn't even clean off dirt. It ruined my genesis coupe and I love my genny. I'm fucking pissed. If you love your car don't bring it here they will fuck it up. 2nd time this happened, once a year ago and now again.

My only issue with this place is that they lie. When your order shrimp, they give you prawnS!!

But ok What??????? this place is GOOOOOOOOD!

I ordered the shrimp and spinach spaghetti and I got SO. MUCH. SHRIMP. 

It was so garlic-y and delicious and it was such a generous portion!!!! Go here!!

Can't agree with the glowing reviews...the sushi was nothing special to taste or to look at. (Also, recommend avoiding the Mexican roll, it comes with unappetizing blobs of mayo and Sirachi sauce atop each piece) Best part was complimentary red bean ice cream served as dessert.

The hotel is very old and in need of lots of maintenance and cleaning. Cockroaches, old food, smells like cigarette smoke, filthy rooms and many other issues. Do not stay hear. Tried to inform staff of the condition of our room multiple times and they were not concerned at all.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: A great place to go for glasses. The doctors are very knowledgeable and the wait time is short. I wish they had a larger selection and discounts and specials like some of the other places advertise, though. All the staff was friendly, I've read other reviews to the contrary, maybe they got rid of the unprofessionals.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Never received my order. Ordered through GrubHub and when the driver went to pick it up they told him they gave it to someone else. Instead of even offering to remake it, they just sent him on his way. Both GrubHub and I tried calling and they didn't even pick up. Very disappointing and will not be ordering from here again.

This is a warm and cozy place for getting nails done. Recently moved to the area and after having a terrible wait time and cold response for first timers at the nearby Hot Nails salon, this was my next stop. Was not disappointed at all. Decent prices. Will definitely return.

I mean come on who in their right mind wouldn't give niche a 5 star rating.. Although Niche's previous location on Sydney St produced a much classier atmosphere the ceilings were too low causing the restaurant to be incredibly loud.  The new Niche in Clayton maintains the high class food and upscale venue. 10/10 would eat again!

I came here after leaving Tire Kingdom.  Not only did thy fit me right in they also beat the estimate that Tire Kingdom gave me and my cost was reduced by 35% AND extra services which was not included in Tire Kingdoms estimate. I will definitely only use these guys in the future. Thank you so much Paul for your honest workmanship.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: They advertise that they are open until 9:00 on week nights. I drove 15 minutes to get Mediterranean Delight pizza and when I got there they said that they now close at 8:30 Tues-Thurs. Wish I had known before driving all that way on the coldest night of 2015.

Really fast delivery! I saw the reviews on this place and was excited to try it out for the first time and it's amazing! And the prices are really good. Highly recommend this place.
Ordered the Stromboli, side of celery and ranch, very delicious! Stromboli was cooked perfectly and side of celery was pretty big! Will order again.

Here in Westfield visiting my cousin.  Had the unpleasant experience of checking out with a huge sourpuss at the register.  The guy didn't even say thank you at the end of the transaction.  No smile.  No pleasantries.  

If you don't like dealing with the public, please look for a job that doesn't require that.

Had gel polish done on my fingers and a regular pedi 2 1/2 weeks ago now. 
Fingers look almost as good as the day I had them done (except for the regrowth) and toes have held up almost as well. 
Massage was wonderful and they spent the time to actually pamper me a bit unlike Hot Nails the last 2 times I had gone there.

Loved this pizza the first time, but the second time it was as if the didn't read my order. I asked for well done pizza and it was barely cooked through and super doughy. Arrived pretty cold too. Wings were very salty. I will order again in hopes this doesn't happen again.

It was much better when it first opened, food quality has gone down. I liked it when the rolls came in 4, instead of 8 because you could try different things without getting too full. The hibachi fried rice and noodles from the kitchen aren't that great at all. Sushi isn't as fresh either.

I couldn't get the cashiers name but there is an older lady who runs the drive that does not know how to multitask, very rude to customers, never gets our orders rights because she is distracted by the person paying at the window! She definitely needs fired!!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Ben's BBQ at the Best Western was quite a surprise. Recently opened,the quality was much better than average and I've been cooking and eating bbq for the past 35 years.

We went because we are staying at the hotel but if I was local I'd be here frequently.
Good beer selection too.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Great little place. Huge selection. One of only as few Liquor stores in the area that offer nearly a dozen beers on Tap, and have growlers. Discounted Growlers on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. The owner was very helpful and knowledgable. I recently started coming to this area and this is my new go to store.

Went to get a fill and was assigned to a man. Typically no big deal. He was aggressive and at one point even physically grabbed my hand when I tried to pull it back to tell him I did not want him to do something. I felt extremely uncomfortable and will NEVER return.

Paid over $100 a night-no fridge-no microwave-only Starbucks coffee in the morning (not a fan)-no free breakfast-TP roll holder broken-AC/heat fan extremely loud-when I complained I was told "It's working, isn't it?"-no hot tub-will not stay again--save your money!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Love the new renovation of the restaurant and atmosphere; however, the food portion is quite small and expensive. Huge price hike compared to before the renovation. Service was mediocre and was charged a prefixed 20% tip. This experience really tipped me off from coming back again.

Ordered delivery from them on a Thursday night. They said 30-45 minutes. Around an hour later called and they said they forgot the order and it would be 15 minutes. 25 minutes later we called to say forget it and they said it was out for delivery. So steer clear of delivery.

I'm tired of my children coming home telling us about what they overheard at this barber shop and we will not be returning... and it wasn't just profanity or sex words they hear in there. I'll give 2 stars because the barbers have been kind and did make an effort to learn their names.

Kabuki was good for it's price but it is not good enough for me to return. The chicken katsu box was not anything special; it was a little bland. The fried rice in it had kind of  a strange taste/smell to it. Vegetable roll was decent though. And the coffee bubble tea was strong and delicious!

Pane e Vino is located in a shopping center in Montecito. I love italian food and was really looking forward to a romantic dinner with my husband. Needless to say, the food was average. Was not impressed at all. The waiter was terrific and atmosphere was great but the food could have been much better.

so their tire prices are great, but often they are too booked to do a tire rotation, or if I'm having an issue with a leaky tire.   or I was told I might have to sit for several hours.  decent folks here though.  i'm happy that they've even had a few women as managers recently.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Since this place was open,  the neighborhood quickly embraces it. Our group of friends have been there together dozen of times, the service and food are very good and the space is comfortable, fun and inviting. They know what they're doing and don't overlook the details.

The fence is an eye sore. You have to get buzzed in and that is only if the bar tender is paying attention. It is ridiculous, hire a security guard instead of the fence. None of our friends go there anymore. Go to Chris' Beachside or Toasted Monkey instead!

I'm very frustrated with this company.  I was hit by a driver in a PhillyCarShare car, and a week later, I still (1) can't drive my broken car (2) haven't been told where to go for repairs and (3) don't have a rental car.  Very annoying business practices.  Haven't driven one, but never will now.

Ok so they contacted me  and offered me a one day free rental.  That said I will be going back in Nov and will try to get the same lady to wait on us.  Should be entertaining.  I have seen the same review from other so it will be interesting to see if the have done anything about it.  They get two star for replying to my review.

Today was not a good day at the Mosaic.  our food was wonderful, however the bathroom odor was offensive.  No matter how good the food, no one wants to smell a stinky restroom.  The restrooms need a good cleaning and the installation of some type of deodorizing system.

This gym is great for convenience- hours & location but jeez it is hot! It's colder outside than inside. I've made a few suggestions to staff and there hasn't been any improvements. They have power fans scattered about so I'd assume there's a problem with their AC.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Decided to give Soochow a second chance on Saturday to redeem themselves.....to no avail.  Ordered $42 worth of food and was SADLY disappointed AGAIN.  I called and ordered as soon as they opened and everything, except the white rice, tasted like food from the day before.  Lesson learned.....never again!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

OK color job (more what she wanted to do than what I wanted) Decent enough cut but she pulled my hair so hard combing it out that my scalp hurt for weeks after. And she very cold and not personable at all, if I wanted a bitch who didn't like me to cut my hair I'd visit my sister.

The car rates are fine but big time cheaters with rental insurance. I already took car insurance with Expedia and the agent was trying to sell more insurance. Day time robbery . And while returning car they said that I punctured the car tire while entering the enterprise , again a lie . The tires were perfect.

I love a good grilled cheese and tots. Unfortunately, the Grilled cheeserie fell short of what it had the  potential to be. I ordered the B&b grilled cheese. The flavors were good, but there was not very much cheese. The tator tots were cold which is disappointing. The best thing I had was a strawberry milkshake. It was delicious!

Not sure why other reviews are so low. The place is really clean and tidy, very nice staff and quick service. Delicious breakfast burritos, just like the east side location. I had the chorizo, potato and egg breakfast burrito, and was able to get salsa verde on request. Great prices! You can't ho wrong here

They do a nice job but they charge more if you use a credit card and if you pay in cash, bring extra because they change their prices upward very frequently. I'm trying a new less expensive place for now.  Nice atmosphere, parking is iffy, you may have to walk far.  Sometimes the wait is long,

Came here because it was walk-in only and I called two other places that were more appointment based and was told they had no openings all day! Leroy gave me exactly what I wanted he's a nice guy too! Real happy with the cut and a great price too. Thanks Leroy!

Excellent service! Excellent food!!! 
My husband had the burrito with chicken and it was super tasty. I had the street tacos and they were also superb!
They have happy hour on Saturday nights til 8 pm too for 1/2 price margaritas which was a bonus. 
But the best of all was the fried ice cream - outstanding!

Think twice before ordering barbecue from here.  Ribs were ice cold, beans seem to be straight out of the can, Mac and cheese was lukewarm with bits of tomato in it.  A novel approach but not really barbeque style.   Had to wait 10 minutes with several people behind the counter for this. Won't be back.

The service was quite impressive. My chicken Marsala was more a chicken in mushroom cream sauce than Marsala. It was very flavorful and a large portion. It was definitely freshly prepared. Maybe not 100% authentic but would return again for another meal. The pizza looked quite good.

I have been going into W Phila for my haircuts for six years.  I wanted to find someone
local.  Unfortunately, Moxie was more expensive.  Danielle took about five minutes to cut my hair and all the while she was involved in conversation with someone else.I got a really bad hair cut.  Won't go there again.

By far the best sushi on the Southside and around Indy. You can't beat the quality, service, and atmosphere. Have tried many other sushi restaurants, including the new sushi place on the Southside, but Ichiban still offers better service, taste, quality and atmosphere.

The drive-through line was a 10 minute wait between the time I paid and the time I got my food.  Then I discovered that they left the fries out of my order.  I could be a bit more forgiving of the slow service if they had gotten my order correct, but they did not.  Avoid this hub of poor service.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place beats the cold, dark, and crummy single washed and dryer at my apartment building. I had 3 weeks of laundry o had to do and it costs me less than 15.00. The staff was really nice and helpful as well. The machines are nice and the building is clean. I'll be back!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: My husband and I went to this restaurant with 2 other couples. I had read the reviews so I didn't expect much. All 3 couples loved their food, service was fabulous and every person who worked there smiled and said hello. Very friendly. We will definitely go back.

Like they say, if you can't beat them, (and there's no way you can !), then join them.  Recently goofed on something, was sure it was gonna cost me big, went here to get it fixed as cheaply as possible.  They came up with a solution that should have cost a little, and wound up not charging me anything.  You can't beat them !
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Horrible service! Horrible delivery! The order is not right, and they couldn't give 2 f***. When I called to complain it was obvious that they didn't care. Please don't waste ur hard earned money at this dump. Go somewhere where they will appreciate your business.

Wonton soup was disgusting. Sweet and sour chicken sucked. Mei fun wasn't good, barely any beef. Pork fried rice is gross. I don't know how this has any good reviews. Will not be ordering again. I'm sorry, I feel bad to leave a bad review but maybe if they get enough of them, their food will improve.

All dough no toppings!  The worst.  I have ordered from this Papa John's for years but something has changed. This is the worst I've ever had from this location. It was nothing but thick doughy crust and very little cheese, and a scattering of toppings. Yuck!!

Stopped in for a late lunch. Service was good. Food however was nothing special. I ordered the ceasar salad with grilled chicken. Chicken was good but the ceasar dressing was a dud. Tasteless and bland.  Typical ceasar dressings are rich and add a lot of taste to lettuce. Romano's ceasar was just not good. Won't be back.

It always blows my mind when I encounter people in service industries who are rude, cold or worse... indifferent. Everyone I encountered at this hotel, from the front desk, to the bar and bellman all seemed like they would choose to be anywhere else than here. 

Just some advice... hire happy people who want to work here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I needed a last minute cut & style and decided to try this salon. It's definitely more of a 2 star salon compared to others on Metairie Rd and was pricey for services provided.  I will return to my regular salon where I receive a true spa experience for less money.

I went in here to meet a client. The latte that I ordered was good along with the frozen drink that was ordered for my client. Cash only which can be annoying. Also I have to agree with a previous review about how uncomfortable the seating is. I had to sit in that aweful chair for an hour. Get some cushions people!

This is the closest one to my house by a few miles, but I usually skip it and drive to one located farther away because the quality is better.  I went tonight for convenience.  Fries are always cold and taste old.  Burger had been sitting awhile.  Ice cream machine is always broken.  I'll continue driving to the farther locations.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Lists itself as non smoking hotel so everyone goes right outside their rooms with their stank smoke of choice...then the next guest wonders why the non smoking room smells of smoke.  Getting pricy for one of the less desirable properties along the Turnpike / 295.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Not open during listed hours!!!

I love Starbucks even though they refuse to build stores within a 20 minute drive for me. So Saturday night I was out , looked up this store's hours on Starbucks website which stated 10pm and drove 10 minutes out of my way to arrive at 9:30. Store closed!!!

I ordered an iced almond milk latte and asked for my honey to be melted with the espresso. It's helps with the flavor & the honey  not sticking to the bottom of the cup. Although I didn't get to stay and enjoy the ambiance, it would've been a nice place to sit and enjoy a cup of coffee.

Not impressed. I ordered pho and thought it was disgusting. I had never had it before so I could just dislike that type of food. My fiancé and I both love sushi so he decided to order some rolls. He said that they were not that great. Not bad but not a place we would try again. At least not for pho or sushi.

Don't do it! Dine elsewhere! Several friends and I had lunch here. Service was competent and lunch specials were moderately priced. 

But all the tastes were wrong. Ginger dressing tasted like corn syrup. Vegetable roll tasted like frozen spinach. Salmon roll wasn't awful but portion was minuscule. 

Very disappointing.

Not that great..beds very small and uncomfortable..rooms clean but it's a budget hotel very limited amenities. I think it's a good cheap place for groups like sports teams since that seems to be the clientele in the summer..,best feature is the location..breakfast is basically just cold cereal or toast..coffee was decent though.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Great spot. 70-year old bar is dark even during the day. Cheap, cheap, cheap. All the Abita's and NOLAs on tap for $4 and $5. If you're a tool and want to buy two drinks with a credit card ... leave go to Bourbon where they'll get you for $8. It's cash only. We had also had a $5 Bloody Mary. More than solid.

The food was ok. I got the the Philly role and spicy hand roll. both were just ok-nothing special. I went on a Sunday and service was still slow when no one was in there! The place is alright regarding decor. Small and nothing special. I heard so many great things about this place and was soooo disappointed :(

We ate lunch inside.  The demeanor of the guy was like omg I must serve you.  Had to go get our drinks refilled.  Only 4 tables inside.  Good for take out only.  Crab rangoon only has cream cheese inside so blah.  Mongolian beef was very good and so was egg drop soup

Discovered this place going for ice cream next door. The menu is extensive and the staff is courteous. The food however is nothing special to me. The deep fried items tasted old bland and over cooked. I might go back to try the pizza and subs but as it stands now I'm not impressed by my visit

Below average. The rice they use on the rolls were too thick and too moist. Over  battered on all the tempura related item. Few of our items did not come and few were brought out twice. 1 star for the ice cream. Saturday and the restaurant had few customers, should have seen it as a sign to not go in.

Good ice cream but very disappointed that I was given a broken styrofoam cup at the bottom and they tried to cover it up by not giving me a new cup and adding another cup! At the end I ended up eating some of the styrofoam and sharing it with my kids. They were not very apologetic when I mentioned it.

My go to spot when I need just a good ole plain pizza. Crust is nice a crispy with the perfect sauce to cheese ratio. Quick service even throughout covid. Would definitely recommend for their pizza, haven't explored much else on their menu but definitely plan to!

Pizza and garlic knots are very good, but as much as the family running the place is nice, they really need to work on their other menu offerings. Had the lasagne and hubby the spaghetti and meatballs with a salad. They were bland and it was the thinnest, most lackluster lasagna I've ever had.

The house salad was colorful and good.  The spinach and goat cheese salad was good but spinach needed to be cleaned more.  It felt gritty.  The crust is thin.  Pepperoni pizza was well covered with pepperoni. The Naple pizza was ok.  The staff was friendly.

Loveeeee the murfreesboro one right by campus! This one has messed more up in the 5 or so visits. I've been served frozen hash browns, never even went in a toaster... always the wrong coffee. I'm new here so hopefully they are too and service will improve with time.

Spotted B7 driving by and stopped for dinner, never having been before.  Happened on a great happy hour bar menu: surf and turf tempura roll, mahi mahi tacos, brie filled potstickers.  All was prepared and presented with creativity and tasted great.  Definitely a cut above.
