I ate here twice during Manayunk Restaurant Week and was disappointed. While the menu includes some unique options, the reality is that it sounds better than it tastes. The lobster ravioli actually was very good, but the chocolate pretzel tart was so hard I almost cracked my tooth!

Food was very good. Service was alright a little on the slow side. Although the food came out  very fast and was very hot. Male host was very friendly and very nice. On the other hand the female hostess was rude and not very friendly. Would probably go back again

I don't recommend going here unless you're really hard up. I went at 3:45 am and the service still sucked. took twelve minutes to get two sandwiches and the food is overpriced. overall i'm not impressed but there wasn't many options to eat that early in the morning

Hotel staff is slow and rude. Arrived to check in at 3:00pm and was told room would be ready in 30 minutes and then when I asked 2nd time was told 45 minutes.  Still not in my room as I write this. My suggestion is spend a little extra $ and stay somewhere decent. Unless slow lazy and bad attitudes.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The roast pork with provolone and greens is the best I've ever had, and the pizza is pretty good, too.  I ordered a sandwich tray for a large party from here and was very pleased with what we got.  I highly recommend Pappone's - and this in an area where there's a pizza and hoagie shop on every corner.

I've eaten at a lot of taquerias..from the restaurants..to the little trailers/taco stands, and hole in the walls..from cali to texas..even in mexico. This joint was average. It's good, but it didn't have all the little side stuff like radishes, jalapeños, and carrots. I give it 3 stars.

This gym is great. It is plenty big enough and has everything you will need to get in a good workout. It is also usually never crowded no matter what time you go in. I'm 26 years old and have been working out all my life so this gym helps me maintain my fitness.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This place is insanely over priced. Rude staff. Skip this and go literally anywhere else. There are some good stores in franklin, like Red Dog. Green Hills has Buds, which is also good. They have EHT Bourbon listed for $120 and it's MSRP is close to $40. Greedy.

We go to this place because it's part of Yelp's 5% cash back.  The food is okay not great, but they have a nice bar area.  The dining area is big so it seats a lot of people therefore we usually never have a wait.  It's good for a last minute decision on a weekend.

We love sho wok but some reason we always want Chinese on the Tuesday the day they are closed, and we always forget, since they don't have voicemail set up with their hours or website we tend to forget. But other then that sho wok is in our top Chinese place to carry out!

We came in from San Antonio, Texas and loved this place! The photo is of the charcoal vanilla and vegan mango swirl! It was so so good! I had found them in Instagram first and knew I had to stop by! The soft serve is creamy and the staff was very friendly and helpful!

Had to come back for the charcuterie board, an old friend, and an espresso martini. Today, we tried the cheesecake. It was so luscious, rich and sweet dessert. Highly recommend. Will be back soon to try other menu items. Thanks Hannah for the great service!

Its just a donut, coffee and bagel place. How can you fail? Well, by not having any product and blaming it on the truck. We went, since it fairly close to Sunken Gardens, but they had no donuts. It was 11 am...not 9 pm! What they did have, 6 donuts to start with? What a sad place. Back East they would have been ashamed.

Stopped here with my kids, the frozen is good here . The flavors are good and there are plenty to choose from. Plenty of toppings to choose from. The only thing I thought was weird was the girl behind the counter kept disappearing into the back. But overall it was a good place

It's really good value for money, the chicken would be improved if they generated a light boil to tenderize the chicken. Currently, the chicken is tough and not that tasty but the beans and condiments make them yummy.

Plus the workers are polite-courteous and some times funny and helpful.

Just ate their tonight and the food was delicious ! Flavored perfectly and very fresh ! Our server was nice , attentive , and helpful .. Def get the all crab crab cakes app and the bloody beet salad .. The short ribs melted in your mouth! Loved the huge beer selection and def don't forget about dessert !

They bring me DIRTY cup with lipstick on the edge. Our plate was dirty too! But they serve sushi and rolls. And there were no excuses followed. I strongly do not recommend this place - they have DIRTY DISH!
It could be dangerous for you health! CONTAGIOUS AND INFECTIONS

It is sad that the McDonald's at the location upper state street closes their ice cream machine, when the lobby closes at 1130pm. I had gone in around 930ish and they already closed it down. It is sad to se that especially if you are a regular to tha specific McDonald's. Hope they can change that.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Change your hours on Google! We walked in at 9:15 and felt very unwelcomed!  Employees only gave us the option for take out! If your kitchen closes at 9:30 then please update your hours  because on-line it states this restaurant closes at 10pm! Not a pleasant experience!

I was thrilled when I came across this barbershop when I moved to Philly. My definite go-to. Roman is friendly and gives a fantastic haircut at an affordable price. It's a clean setting and conveniently located in Market East. Couldn't recommend this place more highly!

An unbelievably terrible hotel. We experienced the following during our stay:

1. Stained linens
2. Discolored, gross carpets
3. No hypoallergenic bedding was available
4. No hot water
5. Given a different, worse room than we booked online.

It is clear that Philadelphia 201 should NOT be hosting guests at this point.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Spilled a drink in my car and asked them
to just clean that up and charge me whatever. Ended up being $95. I then waited an hour before I had to go and they hadn't even gotten to my car yet to be cleaned. Never coming back. Would recommend only going if you have a lot of time to kill.

Plain, hot, black, 12oz cups of coffee that cost $7.50 need to 1: be hot, not slightly above room temperature and 2: taste better than dunkin donuts. Absurdly over priced and underwhelming. If you like paying too much for crappy coffe, go to Starbucks and pay too much for theirs and save yourself some money!

I took my 2012 Ram to Rob's back in February because both my headlights went out. Not only did they get my truck in extremely fast, they fixed a bad connector on my wiring harness and got me back on the road. Very decent prices and super friendly and honest. I'll be back.

I went to Oishi today for lunch. They have some creative rolls. Most were very good with only few being average. Service was great.  Prices are about what I'd expect to pay for sushi. Sansui in Rock Hill is still my favorite but I'd recommend Oishi if you're in the area.

The food is very good, however the service has much to be desired. The staff is very rude. They are not welcoming and are very unfriendly. They have a very bad attitude and it makes going in very unpleasant. It's a shame because this place is in a great location and has such potential

I've been going here for years when I come home to visit the parents. I had read the recent reviews of new ownership. I asked about it they claim that's not true well I can tell you NO WAY NO HOW should a hoagie or cheesesteak come
On a hard sesame roll. I hated it! Wrong on every level. I won't be back.

Got into Philly late in the evening and the hotel I was at, gave me a menu to this spot. This place had awesome food and true East Coast Chicken Fried rice!  They delivered the food to my hotel room and I went to bed happy with an awesome quick meal. Excellent food and fast delivery!

Absolutely love this veterinary hospital! Dr. Austin is attentive, knowledgeable and so personable! I was going to Baring Veterinary but got fed up with the high prices and poor follow through. Now I pay a monthly fee and it includes dental! Thanks Banfield!

This was ok... Not the best sushi I have ever had but def. not the worst. The pizza roll was the best thing we had but still wasn't amazing or particularly note worthy. Prices were ok cheaper than Sakana but Sakana is just so much better. Good miso soup though.

Quick check out and in, even though they were very busy.  Didn't have compact so was  upgraded to mid size at no extra cost. okay for one day, but if it was longer, would have preferred smaller car.  Also didn't like that there was a charge for extra driver, even though Alamo insIde.

We ate here 5 years ago and really enjoyed it so we came back. However, this time, they missed the mark. Maybe it was just an off night or their quality has declined. If you stick with the traditional Italian dishes, you'll be fine....don't stray ie. Mussels...lastly, the service was slow and they added in their own gratuity.

Cucina Forte is one of my favorite Italian BYOB's in Philadelphia.  Everything on the menu is delicious.  Especially the gnocchi and the veal special.  Mike is an excellent waiter and the service is always excellent and personal.  I would highly recommend for small and large groups.  This has become one of my regular spots.

This place was gross. Looks like it hasn't been cleaned in months. Window sills covered in dust. No table was clean huge rips on some of the seats. Then my son had to go to the restroom where the soap is actually turning green and the floor was cleaner than the sink. This is what the front looks like I can't imagine the back.

I used to love this place. $50 for many courses and wine and liquor. Now it is $55, the decor outdated and dirty, the food seems cheaper and not as good, and the restaurant was empty. I was so disappointed. I saw it on groupon after not being there in years and I won't be going back.

Best sushi in Indy.  I wouldn't give it 5 stars only because it lacks in presentation and the restaurant could use an overhaul.  

I have not had fresher fish or a better selection in Indianapolis.  If you're going for diverse, fresh fish (not rolls per se), then this is by far the best.  Ocean World is a close second.

One of my favorite sushi places in the area. Four stars because my rice was a bit dry the past few times I've gone. Other than that, sushi is half priced every day so it's a good opportunity to try new rolls you typically wouldn't. Spicy girl roll is amazing.

Best Auto Place I've Ever Been (Teslas go here)

Came in here with a brand new Tesla Model 3 that I unfortunately got a bolt stuck in the tire. They fixed it immediately, and for FREE! I couldn't believe it. The best service I've ever had and it was free. Definitely coming back here to get tires.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Hmm. Service was kinda meh, which is okay- but the sushi just tasted like it had been sitting around for a while. Just not super great. I would recommend going to another place if you have a sushi craving- there are far better restaurants one can go to! Hope they get a refreshed passion for food :)

Since Los Mariachis was featured on "Dirty Dining", we have only been eating Mexican at upscale restaurants. While this place is not upscale by any means (not that it even needed to be!); the food was hot, fresh, and delicious, the service was friendly and quick, and the beer was inexpensive and cold. We will definitely be back!

Food was excellent but the service was not great!  We came to celebrate my child's birthday and it took forever to get our orders and then took forever again to get our foods.   We sat down at 6:22 pm and didn't get our foods until 7:18 pm.  Slow service. Excellent food.

Amazing place, went here with couple of my friends and diddnt expect to be so good. When you are there just say nothing else but "duo chao yu". Wait and see what they will bring you. The best food ever!! Very friendly staff and the place get busy so hurry! Try one of the most finest southeast china cuisine!!

Good food, fast and nice servers (even though busy). First time here with my wife. She had steak fajitas and loved them, I had steak enchiladas with mole -- excellent. Didn't have room for dessert but will try the tres leches next time (there will definitely be a next time).

Edible, but not good. Salsa is super tomato-y (canned flavor) and spicy (not from fresh jalapeños). Chips had no salt and old tasting. Queso was good. Fajitas had no flavor. Refried beans had no flavor.  Our server was polite but exceptionally slow at bringing everything requested. We will not be back.

This particular location is great because it's right on my way to work but they are so so slow, and the staff isn't very friendly. Except for the older lady with grey hair. She's really nice, I think she's the manager. I always end up waiting at least 10-15 in the drive thru and at least 10 mins when going inside...

It tasted like leftover sushi never again 

The crunchy in my crunchy roll was stake and over powered the crab 

 I don't even know what was going on with my po boy roll 

The only thing that was decent was the steak in my hibachi rice... Oh and the cashier but um never again I had better sushi than this.

I stopped here while waiting on car repairs, and decided to order light.  Well I had the quesadilla whatever, which was a variety of chicken, steak,taco and shrimp. To my surprise it was delicious.  I wish I had planned on spending more time. I will return soon! p.s.  the shrimp was the bomb!

This is the most popular meal on the voyagers menu. It is the taco salad. It was sent to me with the crust of the shell it was stale dry I had to tear it apart it was not crunchy showed it to the manager so he brought me a new shell instead of replacing the mail....o rating Zero radio

I booked this days inn due to it was a Wyndham for my sister funeral. Never again. It is dirty, patched walls, bathrooms that is nasty, and floors that so dirty that I wore socks and shoes to bed!! My daughter wore a hoodie to bed. Thought it would be a little more modern and cleaner. Tv is good!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Be warned.  DO NOT SHOW UP EARLY.  They literally have people waiting in the lobby to check in.  Not one room ready before 3:00 p.m.  I am sitting here and bet magically rooms will appear at 3:00 p.m.  This places doors would shut if they were in Las Vegas.  Just bad way to start your guests off.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Stay away from the auto wash. I just paid $8.00 for a "Super Wash" that consisted of something liquid being sprayed on my car (soap?), then a rinse, than a spot free rinse. The whole process took about 90 seconds. Car looks just like it did when I got there. Total rip-off.

I just went to the restaurant to get my favorite little snack, brussel sprouts. They always had crispy brussels on the menu, and the serving would feed 4 people for $5.00. I just paid $6.30 and got the tiniest to go package  have ever seen. They have changed their menu which in my opinion has gone downhill.

Lovely little yoga studio.  Quaint, clean and accomplishes the goal.  My references: I have been to several studios in this area and throughout the nation.  This was a pleasant experience as I was looking for a relaxed atmosphere with with a cool temperature.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I have stayed here so much. I am so sad to say that we had to switch rooms three times because the beds were so nasty. There was food on the wall and hair in the bed. We were not there for an hour and they would not even give us a full refund. We left and stayed at the Omni Royal there were super helpful and nice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Dr. Grinsell has been caring for all our pets for a very long time.  He's compassionate, kind, gentle, and has a sense of humor.  He will do his best for your pet and will be there when you choose to go no further.  Dr. Sara is great with pets too.  I would recommend Truckee Meadows Vet to anyone.  They're good people.

Saw Dr. Lyons with Oncology. Everything she said and recommended only made my little boy sicker. Now he is no longer with us and she was completely wrong about his condition right up until the end. If your dog is diagnosed with cancer, don't make the same mistake I did.

This place is genuinely the worst. Been a member for 10 + years and I dread having to call customer service. They put holds on my account for no reason (one time it was because I bought Starbucks?) and I'm always wanting to pull my hair out because of them. Switching to chase soon

david  went above and beyond to ensure i not only ordered tires that fit my car, but i loved them as well. i have never received such care and compassion from big brand before. needless to say i will be going back to see david and the milpas team for all my tire needs. thank you guys!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I love Dragonfly! The coaches are awesome-they really care about you and helping you get stronger. The members are the best! Supportive, encouraging and fun. I look forward to working out and continuing to get stronger everyday! I also love that the owner and coaches give back to the community and support other local businesses.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Menu is much more impressive than the location. Prices are average, fish is fresh and staff at the sushi bar friendly. Great variety of sake. Tamago (Japanese omelette) has a great distinctive taste, but even after bribing the chef, recipe remains a secret.

The room was clean, the bed comfortable, breakfast okay (few choices--more like a continental breakfast). The room had the sink by the entry door and the toilet and bathtub/shower in another room--I prefer the sink, tub and toilet all in one room so if I get up before others I hopefully won't wake them.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Food was good, the atmosphere can be improved. Probably should commit to take out or drive through and get rid of the eat in tables. Eating in was a little awkward. Children of the staff running around making a lot of disruptions. Probably not going to be my go to spot.

This gym is very clean. Staff is always walking around cleaning up. The music is at a nice volume and good selection for workouts. They do need to update their equipment though. It is old and they have much better equipment at the other youfits.                                 



M
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This is a decent cheap place to stay. We got in around 10 pm to kids running through the halls but not the hotels fault. The room was nice and comfy and the bed was better than a lot of hotels we have stayed at. This place will not blow you away but for the price you cannot beat it. We booked on Priceline
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Normally everything is great... White pizza with spinach and ricotta a disaster!  There was so much ricotta and spinach it was disgusting... Pizza going in trash... Couldn't even scrape of topping to make it edible.... Less would be more in this case.  Awful awful white pizza

Signed up for the monthly CarWash package, went today for the 1st time. Super Nice location, the car wash and amenities were well worth it ! Some issues with the entrance and exits. All new construction over there, it should be nice once it's all built out. ‍

Stayed here during early July for 4 nights during 2018. 
Check in was quick, the staff were friendly and the location is perfect. The rooms are nice and clean too. I would say an improvement would be making breakfast a part of your stay, otherwise I can't complain. Thanks for the great stay!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Absolutely the best pizzeria i've been to. They make great food, reasonably priced and always have friendly help there. I have seen ALOT of pizza shops come and go over the years in Washington Township and this one has stayed in its place. They got it together there.

Friendly staff. Foods Ok. Have mot eaten here in a long time. Maybe a few years?

Don't drop anything on the dining carpet. 
Carpets are filthy in the dining area. Corporate needs to stop being so cheap and get routine carpet cleaning at least once a week. Terrible looking.

This has got to be the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to. There was a group of three girls in front of me who ordered iced teas already made in the blender and it's took them 20 minutes to get there order. It took me 25 minutes to get my tall Caramell Machiatto. Ridiculous.  I won't be returning to this place again.

Just reopened and not impressed, 
Apps. drink service ok.   Some how lost dinner ticket  and waited till several later tables ate & left.

Server told us lost ticket food being made. OK shit happens. 10 seconds later boiled food not sautéed dinner arrived,
Got the check won't be back .  Not a fan of tavern either .

You walk up to the counter place your order like a fast food place. We waited 25 minutes for order. Everything was passed tough burnt tasty. And over price for the portion of food received. We do not recommend this restaurants 127th  -123st. St albert location wise fast and tasty food service

Carmichael's Cannilloni is my favorite dish! So much flavor, so much goodness! Great atmosphere coupled with great service! The menu options are awesome and very reasonably priced! Jordan is our regular server and she is the best (friendly, quick wit, knowledgeable)! Jim's Happy Hour here I come!!!

My wife and I, our first time eating at this establishment on 12/26/18. The server Stephanie was so anxious and nervous it made us uncomfortable. The food was good. The establishment was clean and organized. The pricing was reasonable. I'm going to stick to what I love the most, Jimmy's Pizzeria and Caffe Torino.

This place is awesome! The pizza is very authentic Italian. Don't expect or ask for Americanized toppings like pepperoni though. They have excellent meat toppings, sausage, prosciutto, etc. Salads fine as well. The restaurant is a bit hidden in the Edgehill Plaza.

New owners took over. Food is awful. 

Chinese restaurant staples like fried rice and sweet and sour sauce were barely edible. Last time there for me.

It's too bad as this was good food, good prices and great quantity with the old owners. Now it's just nasty.

Oh and the prices went up

I think in any endeavor to mass produce a meal there is a certain amount of give and take with quality. Guadalajara Grill does a lot of givin'. The meal I had was solidly good (Bacon wrapped Shrimp), the service was great, Mariachis were in tune and in the groove, and the margaritas were delicious. This place is worth a visit.

I haven't had a Krispy Kreme in awhile and was really craving some. These were a half day to day old.  I though their whole miso was fresh donuts. The donuts were stale, not that usual fluffy texture I've had in the past. The glaze was old and sweating. I remember these donuts melting in my mouth. Not these things!

This is a great place! The manager Bart is always there and keeps the gym very clean and the machines/equipment in good shape. This location is much better than the Thompson rd location. The 24/7 option is very convenient and the bathrooms with showers is really nice as well. Thank you Bart!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I love this frozen yogurt!! You don't have to add candy for it to taste fabulous. I usually get original and add strawberries or raspberries. Simple but yummy! I love that they do this for you and that every customer before you has not had their hands in it! Also, low calorie, can't beat that!

I'm staying right now at the Comfort Inn Alton we have stayed here quite often. We have non smoking room but you can still smell smoke here in the hallway of second floor...I ask the clerk for a tub and got a shower nice but I like to soak after a long trip...not a real big deal
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
THE Worst apartment complex in Brandon 
Renters beware, 
Maintenance is worthless, always putting jobs off and blaming each other for not fixing things 
Roaches are everywhere it doesn't matter how clean your place is you're going to have roaches 
Office personnel are so unprofessional 
This place doesn't even deserve a single star

Beer selection was pretty good, and the food was good pub food as well. The patio seating wasn't bad on a nice day, and the big open spaces inside made it a good place for groups.  Unfortunately, the business seems to have gone down with the crumbled wall, and they've been closed for months.

Inconsistent price/value relationship.  Prices are very high and food is only slightly above average.  A bottle of cheap American beer at $6 and the house wine was $8.  Way too expensive for what you actually get.

Food was above average.  However, would still recommend going elsewhere.

this is the worst ever, cold food, coffee sucks, servers are rude and barely speak english. The owner charges above the advertized price.  service is slow, had to turn off my car cause it was overheating, Do not go there, i thought mcdonalds had standards for there franchises. apparently not.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place needs either a new management or a new owner.   I just witnessed young worker act like a pre-adolescent with a senior with a  hearing device because he wanted a specific donut from the display and she just did not have the patience.  Folks like  her should never have jobs dealing with the customers.

I have been very disappointed the last handful of times stopping at this location. They seem to close whenever they feel like. The last time i was able to stop in after work they had no equipment on site to get an eye exam.  I will be looking for a new optometrist.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Stopped in for the first time on Cinco de Mayo. Service was slow but the food was well worth the wait!! The tortilla soup was the best I have ever eaten. Margaritas, line, was very good, strawberry not so much. Rice was cooked to perfection. No dry or soggy rice here!

had a terrible experience at Payless so came to advantage. there was a long que but that can't be helped sometimes. when we arrived at the counter the lady was super helpful and friendly. didn't feel pressured it to getting there insurance  we got seen and out in 15 mins. car was a little dirty but pretty nice

I tried this place while in town for Labor Day weekend & it was PHENOMENAL!!! The crab nachos were amazing. The Buffalo chicken nachos were awesome as well.... Just a tad bit too spicy. The service was great too, the ladies were very nice and courteous. I will definitely be back soon.

I have applied for 2 loans with Kathy Depung over the years and have been very happy with her service. She is on top of her game. The process went very smoothly because of her work. I have already recommended 2 people to get in touch with her regarding loans!

Terrible service, order is 9 times out of 10 wrong order and I have to come back almost every time. Workers very talkative and inattentive to the customers. Pleasant attitudes but always on phones, gossiping etc. Coffee doesn't always taste fresh. Will not be returning.

If you know anything about Mexcana food you will never go to this NASTY Place . I ordered three soft tacos OMG that was awful I feel sorry for all white people who eat there I know no way in hell Mexican eat there STAY AWAY from this place I think Clearwater city inspectors should give it a visit soon

Went to DN Nails this afternoon to fix a full set of nails that I had done at Studio 3. The nail tech did such an amazing job cleaning up someone else's mess. I would highly recommend this nail salon. He went above and beyond to make my nails look beautiful and natural!

I am a deaf customer and usually I have great experiences with nail salons since I type out what I want and show them picture the boss was rude and unprofessional she snatched my phone out of my hand and got frustrated with me! Don't go here, this was my first time and is surely my last!

I just had some food delivered from Vallarta's. This was the first and last time that I'll order from there. I had a steak quesadilla and it was horrible. The steak had no flavor and it was suppose to have cheese but I didn't see or taste any. I'm super disappointed and expected more since the one on Dale Mabry is so good.

Sushi Ten is one of the best sushi places in Tucson besides Sushi Garden and Azian. You can't go wrong with Fresh and affordable sushi. I've been a regular since 2013 and their customer service is fantastic! I'll be coming back until I get stationed somewhere else!

Meh. I don't know what I was hoping for but this place left me wanting more. The "king" size sandwich made me wonder if I got the wrong order. It was not what I expected.  Oh well. Had to try it based on the reviews. Not super excited and probably won't go back.

usually for special event cakes I go to Taylor's but after being disappointed with the last one they did for me I decided to go to marsh instead. Laura in the bakery did a birthday cake for my daughter and it was amazing! it was exactly what I asked for. I will start going to marsh for all my cakes now just to have her do them!

I LIKE THIS PLACE!!!  They offer something other than the usual burger & fries!!!  It is always very clean and the food is always very good.  Also they frequently run specials on line with Groupon type advertisers.  Usually the deal is $5 for $10 worth of food ~ that's a great deal.  Oh!,  their soup is very good too!!!!!

One track mind thinks their way of hair cutting is the best way, rude af, honestly american hair salon is better. Did not like, because they don't listen to what you want, not really welcoming feeling, gossips to much and not personal to customers. Does not deserve one star deserved, never coming back!

Just had my Car into Autohaus for the first time. Great experience. Thrilled to have found a great independent Mercedes shop. Brian is thorough, detailed, very personable, and explains everything. And it's his shop and he does the work. Prices great as well. Easy access off the 101, too.

Delivery was surprisingly quick and the food tasted great.  I requested special instructions for 3 meals and they got it right.  I ordered the General Tso Chicken, Shrimp Lo Mein and a Fried Wing Platter- all of which tasted fresh and piping hot upon delivery.  Would definitely recommend.

Very satisfied with my food.    I had the chicken avocado wrap with ranch dressing.   Best ranch I've had in a while.    Hubby had a burger.   It was a nice size and cooked they way he requested.   Overall a very nice lunch experience.   Will definitely come back.   Atmosphere is nice and cozy.

Absolutely the worst "pedicure" I've ever had, I can't even call it a pedicure. Went on Sunday, the place was empty. It was obvious she did not want to give me a pedicure. She did nothing to my feet! No foot massage whatsoever. I wish I had not tipped her at all but I can't do that. Horrible. Will never go there again.

This place is a little slice of heaven.  Hands down the best tomato pie/pizza in Philadelphia.  Great thin crust, easy on the cheese, and nice tangy sauce.   All of the toppings are high quality too.  Modeled after the king of all tomato pies - DeLorenzo's in Trenton.

Friendly Staff, consistent quality and great pricing. Sadly this is the last one around. Been a regular for years now and hope the last one still in Kenner will remain. Cant stand Taco Bell and will have to stick to homemade if they ever go away. Bout once every two weeks gets my fix. Thanks for sticking around.

Rooms were clean, staff was helpful, but a/c units need upgrading.  Rooms were were hot and stuffy.  Staff attempted to reconcile issue but I was honestly too tired to move room to room to correct the issue.  Irons need cleaning too should anyone need to use them.  Decent location in proximity of airport and any necessities.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: A old fashioned style Hibachi with various types Sake. Waiter/waitress very polite and the over all experience leaves you wanting more. Prices were perfect and the bathrooms were up to date and clean. Sushi rolls were very fresh!! Along with the Hibachi. Over all expect a four course meal and family fun environment!!

One of the best views in clearwater, and this is the main reason why after the awful service we received the first time, we still came back once more. Environment was flawless, however the food was mediocre, and the service was again terrible. Would not recommend unless your dining standards are set very low.

Hangout ramen is my go to place for ramen and sushi! I have been 3 times and every time they impress me! The ramen is always so flavorful and has a good spice to it! The sushi is rolled well and is always presented beautifully. Such a great menu they have there!

Tried whole pizza for first time there.  Not that good, as it was dry and overbaked.  Not that many folks there, several pickup orders .. no excuse .. Someone should provide quality control before sending food out .. forgettaboutit ...   Better pizza at Amicci's

It's not that they do a bad job- though they used the wrong color even though I told them numerous times which color I wanted. What makes the place the worst is that they are SO unbelievably rude. I'm sorry I bothered you with my business and money. I advise anyone to stay far away from this place.

I got an oil change here.  Polite employees, quick service, and even easier when you schedule an appointment. 

The price isn't bad either when you consider all the little extra services that come with a standard oil change.

They also give you a free shirt when you check in on yelp.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This could have been a nice experience. Unfortunately our server made it a rushed and impersonal dinner. Fish tacos were delish but my plate was whisked away and when protesting it was too late with other dishes dumped atop. Who does this?  I guess my money wasn't good enough. 'Get me out' fast!?!

I've lived in Mexico City and Texas and this is the only spot around where the tortas are on par.
These delightful sandwiches are amazing.

The Torta Milanesa de Res is a 5 star experience.

*edited from 4 stars because I just ordered one again the other night and it was SO GOOD! These tortas keep getting better and better.

This McDonald's is nasty, dirty, out of ice, lids, screwed up my order as well as my kids order. Have old toys for happy meals when they advertise the new ones. Fries are cold. Worst of all is how rude the staff is, no respect. Don't waste your time of money.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We were in TN visiting some family and were in the mood for sushi and decided on Arigato's. It was an excellent decision. Everyone was very pleased with their order and the service was outstanding. We will definately be coming back next time we visit. Great job!

Pretty much every time that I go here at night they tell me they can't take orders because their equipment is down. I get that Double Quarter Pounder with cheese craving and until I satisfy it I keep thinking about it. So I end up going back every night after the bar, hoping that this night it will be working and IT NEVER IS.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This vet is amazing.  We had an old dog at needed special care.  The staff and Dr. Pelton showed extraordinary compassion, expertise, and professionalism for our pet and for our family, through a very difficult time.   We have had a number of great vets, but this organization is stands apart.

Ordered a shrimp po-boy and seafood gumbo. This is a small family run establishment and the staff was extremely friendly. 

The shrimp were decent, but not spectacular. Although I ordered seafood gumbo I received chicken and sausage gumbo. Even though it was not what I ordered it was still very good.

I'm conflicted about this place...
The food, for the price, is just ok. I've never loved anything I've ordered here. It's just always "fine"
I've started just going there for drinks before or after dinner. The service has always been great though. So there's that.

Went there on a Monday night, the food was good. The service was very slow; I do not know if it was because it is always like that or if it was Monday and they were not expecting many people that night(it was fairly crowded). All the sushi was fresh and very good and the people were friendly.

Still one of my favorite places to eat at when I visit Tampa. Good food, cheap prices and they cleaned up the place a whole bunch. New ceiling tiles, fresh paint etc. Wonderfull family style dishes. Clay pot items are very tasty and different from usual chinese food fair I find elswhere. Keep up the good work guys.

The food is ok, kind of plain. The prices are a little to expensive for what you get. $.40 for a small salsa cup and $1.25 for a can of soda turns me off. I could under maybe a round number like a dollar for a soda but that extra 25 cents irritates me. 
But the people who work there are always nice and pleasant

This is the worst customer service of my entire life. There was a FOUR HOUR wait for a car with a TWO THOUSAND dollar security deposit for all Floridians. This company must be just bilking customers as they circle the drain of insolvency trying to get one more executive payday before closing their doors. STAY FAR FAR AWAY.

Service did not make us feel welcomed at all, and we just sat at the bar and had a beer.  I wanted to go find another restaurant without having a beer, but my girlfriend didn't feel comfortable just leaving after going upstairs to the bar.  Nice decor, but needs better staff.

I have been to this store  three times  this  week  and they have been out of  various normal donuts   ( jelly, lemon, dunkin)  Is this  a donut establishment .. when I finally  got a old fashioned donut  this am it was stale as can be.. needless to say I shall be  moving on  from  this  place!!

This place is yummy and one of the 1st Asian places to eat with good service and prices. I love the BBQ pork slices on the appetizers and they deliver! It's a good place if your craving some good chinese food of course does not match up to PF Changs but it's good for the price

It is a bit of a dive, but the Surf n' Turf burrito was really tasty and gigantic, the Tres Leches dessert was very tasty, and the staff was really friendly and proud of the restaurant. The salsa was the only thing that was average, and thus the 4 stars. I will definitely go back.

Room service breakfast menu portions are small and in room coffee maker was not adequate. Staff was absolutely wonderful. Room is modern and very cosy. We got the standard room and were very happy. Valet parking is a bit costly BUT it included in&out which the self parking did not include.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I love Today's Nails so much. I have been going for at least 3 years now. Every two weeks for both gel manis and pedicures. They are so clean and do a meticulous job! My nails could be more perfect. Great selection of colors too. If you need a nail salon, definitely go here!!!

Great gym. Great hours. Staff/Trainers are always available and willing to help, as I have had some billing questions. Place is always clean and operational. They have recently added some new equipment as well. Only reason they get 4 stars instead of 5 is size.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This place is my go-to whenever I'm craving sushi at home. I can't comment on anything other than the vegetable rolls, but they have been fresh and tasty, not to mention well rolled. Deliveries are fast. It may not be the fanciest sushi I've had but it's reliably good and inexpensive.

All I have been renting cars from this site for 4 years.  Plan on being there awhile as there is usually one person to help you with your car reservation.  This past week I had to wait for one hour to get my car do you amount of people One person is assisting.   To the management-Please use atleast 2 people to manage your facility

Can I give negative stars?

Yuck.... ordered veggie pizza and got something that literally tasted like shit. The pizza sauce was not cooked. All they did was boil all vegetables and put that along with crushed tomatoes on a crust and called it pizza. What we saw was something that was swimming in tomato liquid. Yuck.

The service here is great.  However, the house salad has wilted lettuce and a very sour balsamic vinegarette dressing.  I asked for blue cheese dressing and it tasted very strange.  The flatbread was cooked well on the top but very soggy and not cooked on the bottom.  My stomach hurts after eating there.  Very disappointing lunch.

Horrible experience, courtesy (or lack of) from what appeared to be the owner. He will go out of his way to ruin your time, even if you aren't in his establishment anymore and you're on the beach. Definitely not ever returning or recommending this place to anyone.

It seems the employees there are not very responsive. Had a few bad experiences: called and nobody picks up the phone, voice messages left behind are not returned. 
Did not receive a call when glasses/contacts were ready for pickup - I had to call after not hearing for a week just to find out they had been ready days earlier.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: For what this place is, which s a hole in the wall, its pretty good.  I've always had take out which is normally very quick and but still always seems fresh.  They've got a great lunch special and everything else is pretty cheap too.  But you do have to pay for fortune cookies.

loved the atmosphere here, the service was great right when we walked in. We ordered the calamari as an appetizer-- delicious. I ordered the homemade rigatoni carbonara, and was extremely pleased. Large lunch size portion, which I never complain about-- leftovers for dinner!

We order Golf shrimp..marinara sauce looks and taste that is from a can..It was cold too..We complaint but they didnt care much..The other plate was descent but not for $20 dollar tag.
I think you be safe if you order just.pizza..Dont expect much fron.other.convination dishes.

Of all the gyms I've been too this one is top 5. I wish it had a basketball court or a pool but nonetheless the staff is amazing and he sauna is always open. I've also never had a problem with waiting on equipment to be free, except on holidays where times are limited.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Two words: food poisoning.  Within 5 minutes of eating their house salad with ginger dressing.  I should've known when they seem to not clean their wooden chopsticks very well, and I had to ask to have my plate changed due to food pieces still left on the dish.  I couldn't even eat the sushi.

I will not come back.

Went there for the first time recently. Did not know what to expect but ended up having a blast! Very friendly atmosphere including the bartender who was very sweet. Highly recommend for a nice place to drink and chat with some friends. Will probably be checking out again soon.

I really enjoy coming here to get sushi when I am on a budget. The staff has usually always been pretty friendly and the decorations all around are pretty nice as well. I think the phrase "you get what you pay for" is accurate, because the sushi is average but pretty good for the price you are paying.

Not consistent.

Yesterday my drink wasn't melted and I actually had whipped cream protruding from the top of my lid LIKE ALWAYS. Today this is what I received. This is my favorite SB because they don't mess up my order like the other ones. So disappointing.

Man, this place does not disappoint. Enjoyed our time at this location. Excellent service, great sushi & food came out on time. I'm glad that they have one a little closer to home. Can't go wrong with AYCE. The staff and manager are super nice & the place looks really good.

Four stars bc I haven't tried more than the pizza, which was very good. Cheese pizza was better than average, but the Brooklyn Pie is great. The garlic knots are delicious.  Menu is a little pricy, but you can tell they use quality ingredients and the staff is very friendly.

This is one of the McDonalds that I like because there is two drive through lanes (most people know that their are some people that sit there for 10 mins we all know that the menu has not changed any of its food selection in years so why do they sit there for 10 mins or longer staring at the menu get your food and move on)
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I judge a Mexican restaurant by their guacamole. Order the chunky guacamole for some of the best in town! I had the nachos with shrimp, crab, and fish. Sounds a little weird but it was delicious! Sure, you can get the usual American-Mexican restaurant menu items here, but try the other stuff.  You won't be dissapointed.

The staff was awesome. I had such a wonderful time. I have celiac disease and the executive chef went above and beyond to make sure I had something to eat at breakfast!!  If I owned this hotel I would do everything in my power to never let the Staff leave.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great music but what kind of bar advertises bourbon but can't make an Old Fashioned? It's literally just bourbon, bitters, sugar and water or simple syrup. Very simple. Wasn't a matter of not having time to make it because the bar was empty when I ordered it.

I always go to Andrea.  She is super friendly, offered a free consultation prior to me booking the actual appointment, and always has me leaving looking fabulous.  The entire staff is friendly, and the brands they use and carry are amazing.  It is a little pricey, but you get good service and results for what you pay.

I will be honest with you the only reason I stayed with this hospital is because of Dr. Massos. I was not to keen with the other vets and some other staff members. The place is clean and nice. On 2 of my visits I could not get Dr.Massos,and she is the only one I feel most comfortable with. I am thinking of searching for another vet

Slow service, drinks have very little alcohol, luke warm food.  They charge you $4.75 for a side salad the size of your fist with wilted lettuce. Lobster Mac and cheese was less that mediocre at best- not cheesy, lobster was just on top and it was very dry.

This is hands down the best Italian restaurant in the city, and one of my favorite restaurants period. The ambience is fantastic - both inside and in the outdoor garden area. The menu has a fantastic variety of different dishes but the Sunday Gravy is incredible.

DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY. Place is terrible. I ordered one simple thing. When picking up my food the lady behind the counter had an attitude. Get back to work. My order is completely wrong so I call back and get more Attitude from the same lady. Do not waste ur time

What a great new place! The sushi is delicious with beautiful presentation, and brown rice is available for an extra 50 cents. The prices are pretty average for New Orleans sushi places. I'll definitely be back, though I'm sure it'll be full of Tulane girls in no time.

Out of all the places in west county, this has become our favorite sushi restaurant. We really like sushi, so I wouldn't say it's perfect... But we may be more picky than most. There's a few things I would change but overall the flavor is great. It can fall apart and the masago is extremely small... But we still really enjoy it.

Worst service ever! Slow, stuck in the drive through for 25 minutes this place made me late to work every time I've tried picking up lunch for work. It's ridiculous how a fast food restaurant takes 20-30 minutes to serve a meal.
Management/owner needs to improve this bs!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Straubs is great and they finally are carrying some kombucha.  They now have St. Louis's first locally brewed kombucha, Companion Kombucha, or COM KOM for short.  It's great and doesn't have that funk that the national brands have. They have Ginger, Lavender and Elderberry. Delicious.

Due to their process, I found several holes in a pair of my slacks. When I pointed this out they replied that it was due to moths; curious, none of my other items which I keep in the same closet are moth eaten.  They would not even offer a refund.

I will not use this place again, plenty of other options very near by.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Have ordered Steffens Pizza before, but no specials. This time order dbl hamburger. Pizza came with dbl bacon. WHAT!  Called the restaurant & spoke with mgr. "Oh yea, I remember that one. Probably just put dbl bacon on instead." Double WHAT. Ok, no trying to make it right?  Nope. They do have great salads.

This place used to be better.
Its still good when you are seeking to eat as much sushi as you can but they definately can lower the pricing for the all you can eat. 
Its a little ways from where I reside, but if i am craving to eat a wholesome of sushi, this is my spot.

I had an extremely horrible experience at this location. The customer service was terrible in the bakery. The manager of the bakery seemed miserable as well. Very disappointed with this location. I'm going to stick to the blue bell one. I felt as though I should warn otherss.

More than just pizza. The new remodelled restaurant has more Italian dishes. This Saturday we tried some of their breakfast meals. Great with an Italian flare. We also tasted some of their pizza slices offered by customers sitting next to us. GREAT too. I should have taken pictures of the meals.

A Fav spot for BYOB in Blue Bell! The service is superb. Mediterranean menu has specials added daily. Food is delicious... My favorite is the shrimp scampi over angel hair. To die for! I've had special times with special friends here many times. Must try!!! Reservations not accepted so go early on Wednesday Friday nights.

They only had one chef on so we waited a very long time for our main course. Chef was delightful and entertaining. Fried rice was delicious! Portion size on the larger size. The two big frowns I have is even though it wasn't busy it took forever. They also charged us for refills on our soda's. Never heard of such a thing!

Excellent experience. From the desk staff to the techs and veterinary surgeon, everyone is kind, friendly and caring. They are also extremely professional and knowledgeable. They made a knee surgery and recovery as smoothly as possible. When there, I know our sweetheart is in great hands.

Waited a long long time. When we were finally waited on he was very nice. One guy running the bar, waiting tables and delivering the food. Way understaffed.  The food was good. But I would not go here again. Felt too bad for the poor guy running his butt off.  Need to hire some people

I've been a customer for several years. This evening, I picked up a medium pizza and wings and when I walked in I noticed that none of the employees (4) were wearing masks.  No masks in sight.   
Also, the A/C was not on and I noticed food sitting out in the heat.  Needless to say, I was disappointed in Little Anthony's.

It is unfortunate that this restaurant served a soft shell crab sandwich--a "special"-- with a hard shell crab in May ($15). The chic avo panini ($12) and chef cup soup ($6) were all right. The atmosphere was good as was the noise level. Tablecloths were a plus at lunch.

This place was great for lunch. Came back for brunch and probably won't be back for that meal. The service was good. Chef Vargas nowhere to be seen at brunch - and he invited us! They were out of staple breakfast foods and I can make better at home. Sorry Chef Vargas - brunch was a bummer. Lunch is the mainstay.

Black card membership makes it easy to bring a workout partner.  I am a previous gym nut and I do prefer this model due to price and 24/7 access.  Wish the free weights had more and I guess a platform is too much to ask -- the lunk alarm would be on constantly.  (truly can't complain as of the price).
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: A bit pricey but very good. The atmosphere is really pleasant and there was a lot of privacy. We had the ravioli and prawns and left feeling more than satisfied. For desert we had creme brûlée which had an over cooked taste to the tip, it was the only bad part of the meal.

The best sushi spot in all of PA.. a true hidden gem...I hesitated to give a great review because of selfish reasons but can I tell you that no matter what you order you will not be disappointed! Take out or eat-in the food is always beautifully represented..I LOVE THIS PLACE oh the prices are great to...

I stayed here for two nights...and it was a HUGE disappointment.  The units haven't been remolded in years.  My room wasn't very clean...and the staff weren't very friendly!  I think they need to step it up to Marriott standards!  Too many other great Marriott properties in King of Prussia/Valley Forge!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I have been looking for a place that has good chicken and I found it!!! The grilled whole chicken is AMAZING here. I had it with tortillas, beans and rice and couldn't have been happier with my choice! This is that hole in the wall that you will miss out on if you're not paying attention.

Good place. Would eat here again. Here are my ratings out of 5:

Value: 5, good food, good service, great price
Service: 4
Chips: 2, warm but stale
Salsa: 3, nothing fancy
Fish Tacos: 2, bland
Pork Tacos: 4
Beef Tacos: 4
Taquitos: 4
Red sauce: 3, more heat than flavor
Guacamole: 3, quite average

Very thoughtful wine and dinner menus. awesome and very knowledgeable staff. i recommend this place to all of my friends- initially as a special occasion spot, but my experiences have been so consistently impressive that i would eat here any opportunity i had.

Very mediocre for the price. Peeling wallpaper, etc. No extra stars for convenient location near the airport, since we were on a road trip. Breakfast was average; watery tasting eggs, pork sausage patties, good selection of yogurts, no wheat bread or wheat English muffin choices. If you don't care for waffles, good luck.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: 1 * is too many for the level of service received at this location . Stopped to grab a few muffins and asked which flavored muffins were available and proceeded to be screamed at by the inconsiderate clerk behind the counter. We all have bad days but when you're in the customer service business get your act together

With new owners, food is not the same.  Egg rolls were bland. We ordered chicken lo mein , beef aNd broccoli and Princess chicken.
All very mediocre.  Probably won't go back.  But nice people working there.  Fried rice looked like steamed rice with a few peas.

Not good. Ordered sesame chicken made with white meat. My chicken was so breaded that at first I couldn't tell if there was actually meat in it. Taste was lackluster at best. Got cold quickly. Also, ordered a small and my thumb was bigger than the carton of white rice they gave me. Don't waste your time on this place

I usually don't go anywhere under 4 stars let Alone even under 4.5 for that matter. We were in the area and gave it a shot. I loved it. Patio was great. I'm sad they don't have a basic salmon avocado roll on the menu, but other than that sushi and apps were tasty

This place as at greatest decent... my food came out quick but was extremely greasy and not in big portions, an the price may seem cheap but you don't get much for your money. The rum punch was not bad but my bad food out ruled the drink. My bill was 150$ plus tip and only 4 people went!!

Customer service needs improvement - when they loose something they should apologize.  I took a coat in the spring and didn't notice the hood was missing until I needed on a very snowy day.  They did find the hood but no apology!  I was shocked at the attitude of  this inconvenience.  I will not return.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I could have gotten better sushi at the super market, the rice was so mushy and nasty. i got my daughter chicken nuggets and they where grey on the inside and the fries for her where undercooked. never again will i order from the place in my life absolutely disgusting.

Had holiday lunch there with about 20.  Food, Drinks and Service was ok, nothing special.  Ambiance kitchsy, but nothing too interesting.  Maybe I'm just not cool enough to appreciate.  The bill left me feeling like I had been roofied and molested.  I will never return.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: If you want good food and excellent service come to this McDonalds. You can tell that the staff here actually cares and tries to get orders out as quickly as possible even when they are slammed. I would recommend trying their new burger the smokehouse burger.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The burgers are good not great. The fries are the best part of this burger joint. You pay around 9-15$ for a burger and fries so you expect a great burger. Don't get me wrong the burgers are not bad just over priced. On the plus side you get a massive amount of fries which makes up for the price, for the most part.

I got a flat tire the night before and showed up first thing in the morning. Even though they were already busy before 7:30am Ricky helped me right away! I was able to be in and out in less than 30 minutes. These guys are awesome and provide the best service they can and it shows! Thank you guys!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Avoid this McDonalds if you can.  They have a very bad attitude and often screw up orders.  They not only don't care, they actively dislike their customers.  I can't understand why they are allowed to carry on the McDonalds name given their consistent failure in every regard.  I fart in their general direction
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Needed glasses and the convenience of a one hour place appealed to me.  I had gracious and no pressure customer care. The glasses we done in 45 minutes and were the right price.   The staff were really friendly and I'd recommend this to you if you want glasses at a good Price and quickly.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The staff was soooo rude and took for ever to get one thing out they where even making tik toks in the back of i could give this place negative stars i would and also, when ever i come up here there icee machine is always broke so burger king better get on this because you lost my business (also no apple pay)

Great place to get Sushi in Nashville, and the "Nashville Roll" is definitely worth trying. It's right by the riverfront at the Intersection of Broadway and 2nd, making it a good place for any visitors (like myself) who are touring the bar/club scene.

Service was fine, nothing exceptional, but no complaints at all.

The food was good...not great but good.  However, the noise level was so annoying that it took away from the entire dining experience.  Noise does not equal convivialty, it just makes conversation impossible.  Part of a good dinng experience is the atmosphere and Sapori's misses the mark.

I'm new to sushi and, as a rule, I have an experienced guide. But this time I did not have this. It was awesome. Attentively prepared Before you are attentive and fresh ingredients. The staff were friendly and knowledgeable and happy to help newcomers, which is best to enjoy. I highly recommend it.

Most of the positive reviews are from a few years ago when the sushi here used to taste delicious. But in the present time, the sushi tastes average and mediocre. Other menu items, including the yakisoba and the udon, all taste plain and absent of the usual Japanese flavor. Combined with the high prices, O'Sake is a place to avoid.

I love love love this place!  I have been going here since they opened (i think 7 or 8 years ago) and I won't go any where else! They are friendly, clean, and they all do such a good job!  You will not b disappointed if u go here! In my opinion this is the best place in Missouri to get your nails, toes, and eyebrows done!

The live band in the rooftop bar (4th floor) is too LOUD for us in the 3rd floor rooms. As I sit here writing this review, the ceiling is thumping each time the drummer hits a beat. This will go on until 9 pm.  It's awful.  

Other than that .... everything else is fine so far.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I forgot to order the hand-tossed (code in St. Louis for "normal") and was unfortunately served the "St. Louis Style" which I personally do not like. My mistake, but least the salad and service was good. If I was in Belleville again I would give it a shot but  with the normal style. I might have a more favorable impression then.

We started with the recommended smoked dry rubbed wings, they were wonderful.
I had the ribs and Mac n cheese, and my husband had the curdler burger. I'd recommend both, they were delicious.  The homemade chips were a little to over seasoned for my liking. 
We will return.

Everything was absolutely wonderful, the best shumai I've ever had. Great food, service, atmosphere, great everything. The restaurant itself looks gorgeous. Everyone loved their food, and I honestly expected it to be much more expensive. Definitely coming back here!!

Food is decent but service is horrible.  We were left with no utensils, we asked for napkins four times and eventually had to take them off of another empty table.  Our server never checked to see if our food was okay and it took a very long time.  I am going back to Shogun, much better.

Not authentic, but this is Nashville.

The Vegetable Tempura was just deep fried vegetables.
The salad and miso soup were good.
The Udon was so-so, but the tofu tasted like it had expired.

I did not try the sushi or the Thai dishes, hopefully they
are good.   

The waitress was friendly, and service was good.

As soon as I walked into the lobby it smelled like a locker room. The wasn't much better and felt a little dirty. The drapes were torn and you could see spills on the desk. 
The bed felt comfortable enough, however. 
Next time I'll keep driving and look for something else.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: A fine place. Perfectly clean and quiet. Only complaint is they have a crappy Continental breakfast and charge you $17 for it. I opted out of that and went to Panera across the street. It's ok the charge for breakfast but if you're gonna charge $17 you should probably at least make it real.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Not sure what the other reviewers experienced but they're a very friendly and down-to-Earth staff, which is the same I'd heard when they were recommended to me. Answered all of our questions and made us feel really welcome. Seems to operate more like a small family of experts than a cold facility.

I don't know what these two other women are talking about.  I went to see about my driver door not closing due to frozen ice inside the door I was charged $58.00 to have it thawed out. If I would have known better I would have used hot water to thaw the door out myself. Ladies beware.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I go here for lunch several times a month.  The sushi is always great and crafted well.  I usually stick to spicy tuna, spicy salmon, and Philly rolls, but the special/fancy rolls are great too.  The miso soup and ginger salad with the lunch specials are great too.  Best miso soup I've had.  The service is always great too.

If you feel like waiting 20 minutes for a burger then this is the bk for you!  Literally 20 minutes. Every. Single. Time. Come on bk, get some more staff or something! There's no excuse for such consistently slow service. Maybe go get training from another bk.

I tried Panda House based on the reviews.  It was a bit of a let down.  I tried the House special Chow Mein and the General's Chicken.  The chow Mein was pretty greasy and the General's Chicken was bland and was mostly breading. Sorry to say, I won't be going there again.

Dont even want to give you one star...Worst food I have ever ordered. I had one bite of my general tsos and one bite of crab rangoon and spit it out . . Everything tasted off except the rice. Would like a full refund !!!!! Do not ever expect my business again. Nasty Food!!!!!!!

What an amazing little gem in Harahan!! We heard about this place and finally decided to try it!! We were not disappointed! The atmosphere was great, the food was phenomenal and so fresh, and the service was kind and so friendly! We will definitely be back!!

I agree.  This place isn't that great. Shrimp popcorn comes with little baby shrimp or something. Who knows where those little bits were. The po boy tasted funky. I guess I had a minimum level of expectation when I was going there and this place just did not met it. Sorry to say.

My dog got spayed here yesterday. So far, she is healing fine. But she came home wreaking like piss and animal poop... leading me to believe they either put her in a really dirty cage all day or she soiled her cage and they left her in it/ did not clean her off.

Wayyy overpriced for it being so unimpressive. The sushi pieces are very expensive but the quality of the fish and preparation don't match up to that price. It doesn't hit any mark. There is better sushi. There is cheaper sushi. And there are other places with more thrills. I'm not sure where this one fits in

This Alamo rental is the only one I go with at the Philadelphia airport. It gets you exactly what you expect, and that is why I love it. Easy booking with no hidden fees and no confusing language. The cars are in great condition and with great value. Check out/in is ALWAYS incredibly friendly and speedy.

We were visiting Nashville for the weekend and ended with this bar both nights.  Great bands, great service, clean bathrooms, not overcrowded.  Great place to dance and enjoy music without being slammed into by tons of people.  Will visit again if in Nashville.

First time I have ever had White Castle. It's decent, I had some fries that were not as great as some other places. The sliders were solid, I had the standard slider with Cheese. I will note that in comparison to Krystal, these are a bit less greasy I guess? The most impacting thing was the heavy cheesy taste, which I liked!

This was my first time coming here and was very pleased the staff and customers are friendly Paul took his time with me and answered all my question. I had an acrylic overlay and gel polish done. No cuts even nails the shape I wanted look and feel like my natural nails. See you all in a few weeks

Absolutely the worst McDonald's in the St. Louis area.... staff was rude, unprofessional, and many other terrible words... took almost 30 min just to get through the line at 6:30 pm.... HORRIBLE!!! Will never go back to this one.. shut it down or get new management.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Fun flavors, good variety, friendly staff. Ice cream is yummy; nothing to write in your diary about, but tasty enough. Prices are a little steep (we're in Seminole Heights - not the Lower East Side!), but not so high that they are off-putting. Overall a cute place to take your family for out-of-the-box flavors.

Must have went on an off day. The food was very bland and tasted very grassy., not what I expected. The plus was the server was awesome that's why I gave 3 stars. She provided great customer service. Might try it again, because of other reviews. Like I said, it might have been an off day.

Love this place and the people that run it! Amazing gel manicure that is very thorough EVERY time! Awesome add ons like chrome or hologram finish. I come pretty regularly and love the welcoming atmosphere and movies they play. Pedicures are also very thorough and last longer for me than most!

We ordered a 40 count nugget. A 20 count nugget. And a 10 count. 70 nuggets in total. Only got 40 nuggets. Went through the drive through and was asked to wait in a pick up spot. Waited for over 30 mins. The food was good and they did make sure to provide a shit ton of sauces like we had asked.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place isnt what it used to be. Im only writing one review and its a shame it had to be about japonais. The new menu sucks. Will not be going to japonais for a very long time. It was the best sushi joint in edmonton but now its probably amongst the worst.

This Mc Donald's has no pride or management.  Every time you go there the employees are horsing around and on their phones. The Mc nuggets tonight were not only old but very old. Just keep going to the McDonald's at wal mart. Haven't been there but next time I want
McDonald's that's where I'm going they can't be any worse.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Love, love, LOVE this place!  Small plate Tuesdays are an amazing deal and offer delicious food.  Weekend dinners are fantastic and there is a good mix of new dishes and old favorites.  Desserts are particularly amazing (try the Chocolate Pate or the handmade donuts).  Service is always excellent.

The last time I was here was about 15 years ago. I finally got the chance to return this week and it was just as I remembered. The food was great and the staff were very friendly and attentive.  I Just think it's so comfy inside. I will be returning more often.

Terrible location. Ordered from here twice and both times order was messed up. First time our pizza looked thrown together and missing half the cheese. Second time, forgot half the order. Was promised a refund for the item and was never actually given a refund. Dishonest and likely poor management. Won't EVER go here again.

There was a roach walking on my booth and it was not a palmetto bug. It was small one like you find up north and usually its not the only one . I didn't make a scene but had bus boy get it. What's happens when place is closed and lights are off, do they all come out so ill never go there again

This location does not follow the time frame. The store supposed to close at 10:00pm and I was there at 9:54pm. It was already closed and the worker didn't even care about. If you are not closing the time written on the door, why do you even write it??? So disappointed with this location!

Really pleased with the room. We were going to Mt Lemmon & Sabino Canyon & the hotel was close enough. Looked at a few closer, but they weren't as nice. We had. A couple of questions about the bill & internet. The manager answered them and we felt he was very polite,helpful and professional.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: On the positive side the room is nicely decorated and the staff here is very friendly. In the minus side has kept up all night by a Huge fan in the hallway that I am guessing was trying out a guestroom two doors down. And minor inconvenience, that Iron didn't work.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Cute coffee shop, not the best place to get work done, but great for chatting/hanging out with friends. Love that they are dog friendly, and that the staff are generally easygoing. 
Their espresso is a bit too watery/weak for my taste, but i am a diehard espresso fanatic.

It's a really good, inexpensive Cuban sandwich.  It's not overstuffed, but it isn't skimpy either. For 5 bucks it's tough to beat. Service is friendly and quick. The store has a couple of small tables, but it's pretty tight in there. I'd take my food to go

We had a wonderful stay at The Moonrise. The staff were polished, helpful and friendly. The room and hotel was sparkling clean. The hotel is gorgeous with a fun theme. There's plenty of entertainment at the Delmar Loop and nearby. I would unhesitatingly stay here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The very best Italian food in Philadelphia. The freshest Bronzino and veal with tagliatelle and eggplant parmigiana and top off dinner with their apple torte. Great wine selection and Franco is a welcoming host with his wife as chef. We eat there at least once a week before concerts, theater or just for the evening  


Lynn and Joe

The very best Italian food in Philadelphia. The freshest Bronzino and veal with tagliatelle and eggplant parmigiana and top off dinner with their apple torte. Great wine selection and Franco is a welcoming host with his wife as chef. We eat there at least once a week before concerts, theater or just for the evening  


Lynn and Joe

It's a very nice place but there's no staff, so there will be a wait. My pedicure was great but my nails are amateur hour. I don't think they are good at artificial nails and nails that aren't square. Unless you are going for a pedicure I wouldn't recommend it.

Thank you Tony for moving your location to a bigger, fresher,cleaner restaurant. Your pizza Is the best and your service is very good. It's nice to come into your place as you remember each and every one of my family members, especially my kids. That makes them feel important and welcomed.

Found a couple of shell pieces in my lobster ravioli. It was also too spicy. The bread that was brought to the table was hard as a rock. I thought that bread was hard until I bit down on a croutons in my Caesar salad.This is the third time I have tried this place over a one year period,I will not go back!

This place is really THOROUGH. I regularly get waxing and pedicures here and they really take their time and do a very thorough job. I hate it when I leave a salon feeling like I could have just done the service myself and I never feel that way after leaving here. The only thing is the waxing area could be a little cleaner.

Beautiful hotel, rooms are huge and the bed was very comfortable. The free hot breakfast is great for being free, lots is different options. Well worth your money. The only annoyance was the bar next door. They were extremely loud way into the night, but that's nothing the hotel can control. I would definitely go back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My fiancee and I are sushi lovers and have dined in some of the best sushi restaurants all over the country.  We enjoyed Miyako prior to Tenno's opening and while I think Tenno got off to a shaky start, they've improved both services and quality and we are now weekly lunch regulars.

This and Napoli 2 have always been delightful.  The appetizers, salads and entrees are great as well as the service.  My only reason for rating it as four instead of five was the bread pudding.  It was over favored with a cayenne Carmel topping that was not good.

One of the best sushi restaurants in Santa Barbara - quite possibly my new favorite! The guys behind the bar were great, and the sushi was amazingly delicious - obviously fresh, high-quality fish skillfully and artfully prepared.  Wonderful service, wonderful sushi.  I will definitely be back soon and often!

Nice atmosphere. Decent service. Large but Pricey wine list. $20 for spaghetti and meatballs. It was ok not special. Meatballs were good but small. Need to put some more pasta on the plate too. Good thing we ordered an appetizer. Better value and Italian nearby.

I wasn't expecting much to be honest, but this place blew me away! I got the basil pesto pasta (all pastas made with home made sauce) and it was incredible. Incredibly fresh and flavorful! My boyfriend loved the pizza too. The service was good and the people were nice! Really tasty food and huge portions- a true bang for your buck

Food was pretty good.  Sushi was fresh for the most part.  Seaweed salad was borderline.  Service was good.  Came just after 330 was charged dinner prices.  When I asked waitress what time lunch ended she said 4. Then she changed mind to 3pm. Curious which it is.

Service is terrible.  At 8 a.m. on a Thursday they had only half of the racks filled with donuts.  No chocolate pretzels, no caramel yeast, no chocolate yeast, etc.  This is the second time I have been in and they did not have what I came in to get.  I ran over to Long's and they had what I wanted ready to go.

If you enjoy the smell of urine you're in luck. One step above camping in a tent out back. Cool to see a cockroach- I love wildlife. Blood stain on curtains. 2 stars because I have no bed bugs will update it to 1 Star if I find any symptoms of them in the next few days
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The hotel itself is fine, certainly a step up from the local Hampton Inns, Hiltons, etc. What is exceptional is the food. I had the scallops and sautéed spinach for dinner, and it was as good as I had years ago in southern France. Also had breakfast and that was great. It seems they have some excellent chefs!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Absolutely love this restaurant.  Consistently good food, great atmosphere, and good lunch menus.  Their mushroom pastas are always tasty and they have a great wine selection.  I've been there for group outings, business lunches, and dates, and I've always had fabulous service and great food.

Very disappointing. Service very slow, had to ask for refills. Was served the wrong order, then only half of my actual order but charged for it all. Friends had mixed reviews, one said they would give it four out of five, one said two out of five. Food was just ok.

We went into Thario's because friends had mentioned it.  We were happy to find out about it.  The food was wonderful, fresh and delicious, out of the ordinary.  The chef is from Europe and she treated us with a chocolate dessert she was trying out.  We enjoyed the experience and we're going back!
