I went to get our lunch. I ordered the Steakhouse Burger. It has to be absolutely the worse sandwich ever. There was no condiments or vegetables on it. I truly won't buy another nor visit that location anytime soon. I'm very displeased with the entire experience.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I wish you could pay for the 360 without having to go inside. Especially for us with a dog in training. It makes no sense other than for the cashier to try and sell you something you don't want. I'm not happy with this policy in the least. I can get a 180 at Crews Car Wash without this

Most outstanding element of this restaurant:  1 tea bag = $2.75.  If you need a 2nd tea bag, it will also cost another $2.75!  Total $5.50 for tea.  Outrageous.
     Because they are open for breakfast, you can go in for lunch earlier than 11:30 a.m.
    There are menu options that are not standard fare and fun to try.

Yikes!!!  This place is so old dingy and dilapidated. Everything is peeling falling apart and/or rusted. Microwave didn't work. Toilet and tub gross. If you're in a pinch and need a place for 1 night at the most go for it otherwise don't even stop. :  the staff was nice the outside was clean.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I've had many problems with TD bank in the past. For example, twice they deposited my money in someone else's account. TWICE! Thankfully I keep my deposit slips. Finally I broke up with them. Today I had to go there to cash a check. $10. Seriously? Why am I paying them for cashing a check? 
TD Bank, you suck!!!

Do not stay here if you are a business traveler!! I don't think I've ever had a worse experience. Within hours, I had something stolen from laundry room, multiple calls for noise complaints!! There were Birthday parties, baseball teams, and plenty of party goers!! 

I was scheduled to be here one month. It won't be one week!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I loved the atmosphere here the wait staff was awesome and the food was great. Now I went when they where serving a preset menu with wine pairing and it was killer. I thought the portions where small but it added up in the end. The butter cake is the best desert I've ever had and I'm greedy!!

Great chicken! We ordered the 8 piece family meal that comes with 2 large sides. The chicken was really good, if you love El Pollo Loco you will love it. We chose the rice and beans. Beans are good (boiled not refried). The rice is ok, not quite Spanish rice. 
I finally found my Chicken fix!

This place is fantastic! The decor and atmosphere are beautiful! I loved every single thing I had here, except for the hog jowl (likely due to the fact that I just didn't enjoy jowl in general as opposed to the execution being poor).  
Service was great, out server was so nice and knowledgeable. I can't wait to go back.

Terrible customer service!  One employee covering both Budget and Avis counter and the lines was 8 deep.  Not what you want to experience after a long flight.  I guess that's why they were the cheapest, no workers, lesson learned to pay more for quality service.

On 1/6/2022 I was supposed to be checking out.. the young lady at the front desk (brown wavy hair Caucasian) was VERY RUDE!! And didn't seem interested in helping me at ALL!! She should be fired no second thoughts.. not what I expected from "southern hospitality
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The car wash location damages my car and saids it's not their fault. The cars part was solid but the their not responsible. Go here if you want your car damage , sorry you got kids as managers and they don't know to operate a business so stop going to crew

Very good meals!  Excellent octopus appetizer!! The staff was very attentive! We loved Ira! Great personality! Excellent with dealing with guests! We'll definitely be going back. One of the better byob restaurants in the area! Fresh food and fresh ingredients! Definitely recommend!

The staff was SO polite and nice !!! They had such a great attitude and our food came out so fast ! Probably the best service I've had since my visit in Nashville. If your looking for Mexican this is the place to go ! Plus , only $40 for us four girls and four whole meals. Our waiter was so polite. I will return !!!

Tina is by far my favorite tech.  I've been going for almost 3 yrs and have had almost every tech.  Today was not my day though- new tech?.  Pedi is ok; didn't want polish, etc just a mani with buff.  Granted I have rough cuticles, but they're only slightly better than when I went in.  Not buffed either.  I'll be back for Tina!

Really having issues with their online support. Misspelled my name and took a week to fix to set up account. Now online car payment was not made since a signature page was not received although rep said I was set. No notifications of issue until I emailed. Not happy with what I thought would be a good experience.

Love this barbershop. It has a friendly staff, the barbers know what they are doing, the atmosphere is great. I will definitely recommend this place I'll give  it 10 stars if yelp allowed me to. 
FYI- on a Saturday morning they are crowded so remember to make an appointment.

My friends & I will never return. The manager was rude & we didn't receive the deal that they offered us. There aren't enough bartenders or waitresses for the over crowded place. You wait forever before someone serves you. Not to mention, the manager/balding jerk is rude!

We used to love Italian Delite, but over the last year we have noticed a serious drop off in quality. It has us in search of a new go-to pizza place
*update: Italian delite has since reached out to us and delivered an apology and refund. Good business and customer service deserves to be recognized. Thank you for making it right!

This place is AWFUL. I took a dress to be cleaned and when I went to pick it up, it had an additional ink stain that I know was not originally there. The woman repeatedly said she did not put it there and refused to even attempt to remedy the damage. POOR business management.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Had the fried green tomato and smoked wing small plate. Both tasted good and fresh. Ordered short rib, catfish, and fried chicken. All were good. Waitress was friendly but inattentive. Didn't stop back often enough, out of water with no refills. Dirty dishes still on table when we left.

This place is awful. The touchless car wash does not clean your car at all. Not worth the price of the wash at all. I went to use the vacuums the other day and used my card and was charged $10 just to use a vacuum for 4 minutes. I absolutely hate this place, it's robbery.

The owners of this place are rude and argumentative when you try to let them know you are having issues with the machines. The wife is rude all the time and yells at the two boys she has working there. The husband is a jerk too. The place it's self is not bad. They need to work on their customer skills.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I went with my girl friend on a Saturday night I used an coupon I purchased from groupon. It's a nice cozy restaurant,good service but the food isn't that good, it seem under seasoned and over cooked. Actually later that night I ended up throwing up which seem to my dinner.

Sergio is the man, third chair on the right - I went in for a flattop repair and shave and he excelled at both - I highly recommend this shop.  If you are looking for a tight flattop, level on top he is the man to see.  Very friendly shop with great customer service, I will be back next time I am in town.

Fernando has been cutting my hair for 3 years. Whether he uses clippers or scissors he does consistently excellent work - as judged by my fussy wife! He is always cheerful and prices are reasonable - plus he works amazingly fast. I highly recommend him and this old-school barber shop.

The food is always good, the people there are so nice.  I am happy to give them my business because they're always polite and the place is clean.  They genuinely appreciate our business.  Their sandwiches and cheesesteaks are excellent, and so are their pasta dishes.

The chicken katsu was a thin crunchy chicken tender. And I was expecting katsu sauce, the normal sauce for chicken katsu, and they gave teriyaki sauce. I also got blueberry green tea for $3.50 and although it was pretty tasty, it was 60% ice. Also no public restroom. 

Overall very very overpriced for the quality of food.

The food here is the typical chinese delivery food, but the deals are fabulous!  In their menu, they have a section for "family specials" where you get a ton of food for little dough.  You can feed each person for about $5 per person!  Who can ask for more?!

WAS the best in Tampa Bay. They kept saying they were going to reopen??
BUT didn't....... where did Skip go & now where to get that kind of pizza
..... I need my Paci's !!! Tried Christinos, Krappys, Grimaldis, Wood Fired Pizza, can anyone recommend a great pizza joint I haven't been too??

Pizza Snobs

Our first visit to JAX and probably not our last.  Funky little restaurant with a small but appealing menu.  Arrived in time for Happy Hour half-price appetizers and wine, which added to our dining experience.  Sampled a bit of everything at our table and all good.  Friendly and prompt service.

Recommended!

Hidden Gem!  Just opened.  No liquor license but other than that a home run!  I had the Diamond Roll and Rainbow Naruto roll as well as sake, maguro, hotegi, tako and kani.  Very fresh and presentation was nice.   Staff was very friendly and attentive.  Will definitely be back!

CLOSED. This restaurant closed in June 2013.

This restaurant had been around since the 1960's and remained family owned the entire time. The food was good, the decor dated, and the service acceptable.
Serving their core constituents of retirees and snowbirds, they were a well loved fixture on the beach.

I posted incorrectly.. i wrote and posted to broad axe.. my mistake. Food is ok.. but Phils tavern... i dont feel like rewriting.. lol. Read bradaxess' review.. its for Phils tavern. Thank u phils tavern...underrated and best on the butler strip.. HANDS DOWN..

They overbooked the hotel by 20 rooms. I was there for a conference and they had to relocate me for one night. This was a HUGE inconvenience. They didn't even call to tell me and the only way I knew was because I was calling to see if I could have an early check in. I will not be staying at this hotel in the future.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Good gym, but still needs a little work. The remodeling has been a definite bonus! Generally this is a great spot. On week nights though it gets very crowded and hard to find machines. A bonus is there are tons of little workout areas, where you can sneak away to have some space for your workout.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Carry out. Completed order at 12:20pm. Was told 30 minute wait. Nobody else came in or picked up an order while I waited.  Got food 47 minutes later. Sushi was ok but the long wait likely means I won't return. Too bad - it looks lime the type of restaurant I would likely enjoy when they reopen their dining room post COVID-19.

Food was absolutely great, not too much not too little. Just a little annoyed at mosquitos biting us, as well as the condensation of the A.C. kept dripping on me, but ehh things happen. Other than that service was quick, food was great and my husband and I are definitely going to visit again during our stay.

Terrible nails!  For a long time I just dealt with their nails because the shop is crazy convenient.  The nails were too thick, looked terrible, and popped off.  They rush even when the shop's empty.  

I now drive 20 miles to a much better shop that takes their time and delivers a much better product.

If you like Sushi and Sashimi, this is a good place for you, as long as you don't mind the bad service. Order slowly and see how you feel about how much you can eat, because they will charge you for the left overs. Food is great, but the service is below average. So, come when you are good mood and hungry.

First off I love places like this since I do use many of the products they sell. That being said I went in and found a few new items I was interest in and purchased them online instead since almost everything in there was 60-75 % markup. Wouldn't buy anything I here but still a great store for window shopping.

Sorry. New to the area and stopped in for a slice. I was very disappointed. The slice had no character. The dough was tasteless as was the sauce. And the cost was higher than normal. In that type of business you only get one chance to make a good impression. I'm sorry, but you didn't.

Had a group of 16 last night. The upstairs was empty and we had three people working our tables. It took 45 minutes to get a drink and then the service continued to be very slow.  We asked to speed up three time but the service never recovered.  The food was very good when it finally arrived

BEST SUSHI I HAVE EVER HAD. I am not a picky person, but I would say this is by far the best sushi. They keep the restaurant VERY clean and the service is the best I've ever come by. I would recommend this place to anyone who loves sushi. I also have eaten here like 4 times in a month. It's just that good people.

Food is good but the customer service isn't that great We just placed an order for pick up and got home and saw it wasn't exactly what we ordered. We called to let them know that we ordered something different and they didnr want to be at fault for their mistakes.

It was "ok", the fries are AWSOME and the reason for the stars.  I had a Reuben, not really flavorful.  It was a special...would have had more seasoning or more 1000 island dressing.  The burger per my sister was ok (blue burger).  Again, the fries are AWSOME.

Excellent nail salon in Brandon! Really good prices and high quality work. They are super friendly and speak English perfectly so you can get exactly what you ask for. They also have a stamp card system that never expires, so you can get money off if you're a regular customer for a while :)

They are considerate, helpful staff,
clean neat and fair. Very good results for the 30 yrs I have utilized there services difficult and normal 
projects are excellent. Fair and honest pricing. I travel 25 min and have many options but Earls is the best around.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: What a pleasant surprise. Great price for excellent portions and taste. We had the Hibachi steak and veggie bowl and couldn't eat half. Brought leftover home to enjoy it two more times. Going tonight for sushi. The staff are great and service was quick. Our favorite!!

Great rolls but would advice staying away from the sashimi quality was not very good, was not sure if the salmon was real, tuna was also not so good they must do a bait and switch because looking through the sushi bar glass the fish looked great but what I received was completely different.

I grew up going to Bo's. It hasn't changed and that is what I love about it. My favorite I've cream is the dipped cones. Strawberry to be exact and that's saying something because I don't like any strawberry but the fruit. The staff is AMAZING. Price is Fabulous. Thank you Bo's for the memories and great cream!!!

Good Mexican food and salsa made at your table the way you like it. We had a birthday party there that night and everyone enjoyed there food. The sea bass and shrimp dishes received a lot of praise.  Service was good and the happy hour drinks were a good value,

Had a Groupon, did not realize they close early.... Seems like they close mid day  and then reopen. Wait staff checked with kitchen, they would still serve us, so that was really nice. Food good, don't know about atmosphere since we were only ones there. Was fine, not sure I will return (based on distance).

The Hotel is in a very safe part of the city.

There is an Applebees downstairs in the lobby.

Several decent bars are within walking distance.  

Parking is not free, it's in a ramp near the hotel. 

The hotel is slightly overpriced, the room will not blow you away.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I was excited for my first post-COVID-19 closure cut, and Melanie did not disappoint. I easily scheduled a time and was able to get in and out quickly with a high quality cut. Not only was the service top notch, but the conversation was great too!  Thanks, Melanie!

We have eaten here for years,,,pizza sauce is too sweet for our taste but we like their white pizza.  Also love the spring mix salad which is loaded with goodies and if you top with grilled chicken it's a great meal.  Wings are one of the best in the area.

Love this place!  Have been looking for an in and out wash since we moved here.  Family owned and great service for the price!  I think people don't realize a full detail is $150+ you can't expect every piece of dog hair out for $30.  Exactly what I wanted.  Will definitely be back!

Thoroughly enjoyed our first visit to Ristorante Filipino. The atmosphere is warm, cozy, friendly, and very Italian, just like family! The service was excellent! I thoroughly enjoyed the Shrimp Gamberi and one of the best house Italian salads ever! I will definitely frequent this restaurant.

Great new location! The food was delicious and the fish fresh as usual.  Had the Super Dragon, Jason, Crazy Dancer and Treasure Valley rolls along with Mix Poki, and miso & edamame.  Everything was flavorful, beautiful, and Yummy! Our server was super friendly and helpful. So happy to have this closer site, cant wait to come back.

There restroom provides the perfect ambience to take one's own life. That's the nicest thing that could possibly be said on behalf of this ShitHole Inferno. I know D&D and I like it most of the time but I would rather capture a pigeon and eat it than go to this awful place.

wife and I went on vacation and we picked this hotel because they are pet friendly and we were happy with everything about this hotel and would give it five stares but the bathroom was small and they need to invest some funds into there upkeep of there bathrooms.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Cavetelli Bada Bing was amazing.  So tasty and cheesy and fun to watch make table side.  But more than I could eat.  I'd suggest sharing it with someone.  Also, Monday night 1/2 price wine bottles is a great deal.  Had a wonderful evening and meal.  Will definitely go back.

We took our volleyball team here and the service was top notch. The owner and his staff treated us great. They made of us felt welcomed the entire time even though we were a large group. The food was great also. The pizzas were homemade, which you could definitely tell in the taste. I highly recommend this restaurant.

Love this restaurant. The food are always fresh and so good. My daughter loves the huge cheese pizza and I love the grandma's pizza and the crispino. The pasta are great also. Always have huge portion for the pasta. The staff and the owners are really friendly. The place is family oriented.

Outstanding work by these guys, got me in and out in a timely fashion. Explained what options I had for my tires and alignment, eventually got me signed up for a 3 yr alignment program and got road hazard protection on my tires. I'll continue to bring my car here.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Ice cream is good but lines are generally very long. They only take cash and some employees are quite rude. The manager seems nice and apologetic but doesn't make up for rude employees. You serve ice cream to kids and you make people wait an average of 10-15 minutes for it, at least be nice.

So delicious! Everyone at our table absolutely loved their meals. Our waitress was wonderful, I wish I remembered her name. She was both helpful and incredibly kind. We finished our meal with complimentary espresso and the pineapple dessert which was just as amazing as our entrees. My new favorite place on the island!

Ladies, don't hesitate to make an appointment here. I started coming here to just get tough ups for my short hair and Nikki won my heart. Today we did an extreme color change and I'm beyond thrilled with the results. Great atmosphere and great owners and staff.

Got to the pick up window and discovered 2 of the 4 employees were not wearing masks in the kitchen. Really?  Also the window was so dirty with grime and fingerprints, I lost my appetite.  Asked for my money back and went down the street to Sammy's which is ALWAYS a good experience.

Disappointed in this Westin property

The good: Nice view. Easy parking in and out. Decent fitness center. 

The bad:  unclean. black and orange mold growing in the tub/shower.  

As for service, left my room at 800am, returned 4pm, housekeeping still hadn't been to the room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Thank you for your comment.
However instead of trying to say I didn't stay there (still have the receipt) you should take the comments to heart.
Bar was mentioned in quotes - 
Flat screen TV = still an old TV
I travel all over the world and do not leave comments out of spite or unnecessarily - I leave them to share my experience
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Not recommended due to terrible service. Ordered for delivery, they showed up and didn't give us the right order after it took over an hour to get there. Called back and they didn't get it right after the second attempt. Called to talk to a manager multiple times, they never called me back. Terrible customer service and follow up.

Great, friendly service from the time I called to schedule an appointment until the time I left. Very happy with the oil change I had done & also love the fact that the tire rotation as well as other routine services are included unlike many other competitors who'll charge extra. Will definitely be returning to this location!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Why people rave about this place escapes me.  It is indicative of a not great palate.  the cured meats are more like Oscar Myers than real Italian salami or prosciutto.  Just big and cheesy and overly sauced American noodle type meal.  Edible enough but it really is an exercise in mediocrity

After a year of allowing my friend to color my hair, I decided it was time to take it to a professional.  I let Joe do whatever he wanted and he did not disappoint.  He gave me a fabulous, natural looking ombre that I have gotten a number of complements on. Joe was so personable and made me feel very comfortable.

Can't believe I attended the Gulf Coast Sons of Italy meeting and dinner tonight at Leo's.  Now I'm not Italian but Lasagne isn't flat and looking run over by a car
Food and Service not worth my $30 ave check.  Come in for the all you can eat pasta Monday's for $3.99 and see no one there

Nice old hotel. Always clean and neet. Fantastic staff.  Very professional and oh so polite.  BUT the lame ass breakfast food needs a major change.  Served the same items every day. Would stay here again in a heart beat. But I will walk across the street to Panera Bread for breakfast next time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I've taken both my Ford and Dodge to this location. 
They've been honest and reasonably priced. 
Great work fixing suspension and brake system problems. 
I had an instrument cluster problem they couldn't fix 
 -but they recommended a place that got the job done (also fair and reasonable).
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Beware! I made a mistake with their online booking system and got confused about the day I had booked. I have been a customer with them for a while but theywould not reschedule the appointment and charged me $40! I would be careful about giving them my credit card in advance, they will use it.

VIOLATES TAX LAWS. I bought a sandwich. They charged, along with the regular sales tax, a tourism tax. According to the city's site, "This tax is a business license tax, not a sales tax." So, not only do they have meager sandwiches, they violate the law and you pay.

Had my 50th birthday celebration at Rick's last night and had an absolutely amazing time. Food was delicious as usual. Wait staff were great - very attentive, friendly, and provided a lot of good recommendations for appetizers and main courses. Thanks everyone for making this a truely memorable evening.

Get a 16 inch matzo cracker, pour tomato paste on top with Lucerne mozzarella cheese.and put it in the oven and in 15 minutes u have a bazil's pizza. I heard the place used to be good but sucks now. I gave one star bc it actually had enough ingredients to fill u up but....my God!

The room seems nice but the WiFi is very suspect. I have not been able to get my Ipad to connect. The correct network shows up on the list of available networks and then drops off before I can even launch my browser. The guy at the front desk is very helpful but he can only tell me what he has been told.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Horrible service! I do not recommend at all!! Sat for 10 minutes before we were greeted! Food took a long time! Chips taste stale! My nachos were chips were soggy & didn't even have any cheese on them! I'm a waitress myself so I usually give people slack but not here & wasn't checked on once or asked for refills!

Security man Mike is fantastic, but the other staff are not very helpful. Good hours for us working folks! Just wish Chase, my west coast bank, had more of a presence in Philly, and it wasn't such a pain to change from TD to another local bank...though I am thinking about it.

A decent clean place to spend a couple of nights here for work but I would never pay full price!

The water didn't work properly in my first room, the tub had water in it and the rod were quite old. Even saw se mould in the bathroom.

I splurged on this hotel for the sauna and it was pretty disgusting. Dirty, old and messy.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Toro and blue fin tuna were their special of the day, and it was specially tiny!

They charged full price and gave food actually worse than all you can eat sushi place.

This is a pretender. Similar price like high end sushi places but no class here......

Save your money!

This is my go-to Italian restaurant. Every now and then we try others but keep coming back here because they are the best. Favorite dish is their "Pasta Tarantella", chicken peas, mushrooms in a delicious pink cream sauce. Huge portions. Also the staff is great and the owner greets everyone. Highly recommend!

Excellent place. Very attentive staff and great food. Had the cod fish special which was perfectly cooked and delicious with bacon and mashed potatoes. All desserts are home made and the tiramisu was outstanding. Don't miss this place for some outstanding Italian food. It's a BYOB.

Fred P

I ordered yesterday because I got a  new advertiser in my door. I order a double turkey burger and mushroom cheese steak. My bill was much more than stated on the advertiser . when I questioned 
the difference the man on the phone kept saying taxes and delivery. I added the taxes and delivery price he quoted yet, it did not add up

Great place for dinner with your college student. Just be careful not to over order. (Our hunger was bigger than our stomachs, but the leftovers went over well back on dorm.) There's a great selection and the rolls are huge! Highly recommend if you like sushi.

First time trying this place after passing by for 20 years and I can't believe it took me this long to find this hidden gem. It is the quintessential Pizzeria/Italian Restaurant with good food and a mom and pop feel so I highly recommend giving it a try when that's what you're in the mood for.

They are very slow at this location no matter what time of day or night that you come. They also don't use gloves to prepare the food. The manager had to ask the crew and they took the gloves back off within 5 min. My wait time was over 20 min so I got to see alot today.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Service is solid, establishment is clean, but the food leaves much to be desired. It all tastes store-bought and inauthentic. You're better off heading to guero canelo or somewhere nearby for a Mexican food experience. Prices are also on the high end for the lack of overall flavor.

This is what my car looks like after their 30 dollar ultimate wash. They just got finished "cleaning" it. Also they put synthetic in my car instead of regular during the oil change so now it's going to cost me more wherever I take it. On top of all of this they are rude.

If vaccinated and want a choice  of wearing mask - don't shop here - spend your money where u can chose to wear a mask if it is moorland to you 
Thousands are not anti mask - but are for personal choice 
No more of my money spent at Payless liquors
And I know I am not the only one as others walked away

The only resort like feature of this hotel was how sandy the bottom of my feet felt after walking around barefoot inside the "cleaned" room. Didn't make it to the beach but it sure felt like it with how disgusting the room was. Too bad it's a pretty spot right near the beach but the rooms were so gross and run down
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Every time I visit this location I end up waiting anywhere from 10-15 minutes to get my coffee in the drive through. Given the fact that this is the only Starbucks near CWE that has a drive through I continue to visit it. The employees are nice but the service moves at snails pace.

I stopped in to get my 30 day supply of food and water and other supply's . The place was clean inside and outside of Fry's and the staff were friendly . Every one should get there 30 day supply of food and water. Because of the supply chain and the debt ceiling and the Goverment shut down on 12/03/2021.

My dogs are very diverse and have special needs. I appreciate that North Hills takes that into consideration when dealing with my dogs and their many issues.  However, as many times as I've been there, the front office never remembers my name or my dogs  I understand staff changes but some of them I see every time I come in

Great fun upscale Mexican menu!! Had a wonderful dinner tonight! Service was amazing - great waitress and manger. Drinks and the Food was delicious especially the guacamole!! Celebrated a special birthday- surprise with a candle and cake / appreciate the great service all around!!

Whenever we're in the mood for tacos, we go to either this place or El Tapatio on Nolensville Rd and order the tacos al pastor. It's a tossup between them for which is better, but they're both hands down the best tacos in Nashville. Can't believe how lucky we are to have this place in Hermitage.

I love this place. The service is always friendly and the food.... very good. Soochow is a casual dining restaurant, with excellent pricing.  I have been there frequently (especially for their lunch specials) and have always been greeted courteously. I definitely recommend giving Soochow a try.

Good live music on Sunday night, wait was an hour for sunset but bar area was lively and fun. Sunset shots were good (and free). Food was average. Atmosphere and drinks were what made it best. Hostess, bartenders, and waitress were hospitable and very nice.

I was happy with this place, as the eye exam was free and the doctor was both efficient and thorough. The service staff was helpful, and did not attempt to sell me on extra products that were not needed. The pricing for the two pairs of glasses I received was about what I expected to pay as well.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Great Bloody Mary! They go down very easy Calamari appetizer is not worth it. I asked the server if it was fresh, not the pre-frozen in a bag already breaded. She said yes it is. No, IT IS NOT fresh. Was six rings and three tentacles pre-breaded, pre-frozen, awful and chewy. Waste of $9!

Came here tonight because I was craving goat cheese and Pizza. Got make your own so I could get extra goat cheese, ordered extra goat cheese, got home and had a piece and turns out the guy put extra ricotta and not goat cheese! I am so upset. 

If they look too much alike, don't put them next to one another or add a label!

Not a big fan of this hotel. The building and rooms don't look as good as the pictures on their website, the room layout is strange (the TV is hard to watch from the bed), sometimes the maid does not show up, my card key randomly stopped working, and the lines to talk with anyone at the front desk are consistenly a very long wait.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: There web cite says they open at 7:30, they don't it's 8:00. So I left and returned at 8:05 waited 10 minutes then took my business elsewhere. This place must be under new management I've never had any issues with serving my vehicles here. But this is the third time and like in baseball I'm out.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I, like most of the community, couldn't wait for this place to open. Unfortunatley, due to the lack of professionalism and overall attitude of the entire staff, I find myself driving a bit further down to Rivergate for booze. It's a shame, this place has great potential. They just need to hire people who aren't rude.

Just drove by there last night and the place is closed!  Building was totally empty. What a surprise - had no idea. Their Chaddsford location closed recently as well. Very disappointed because it was one of our favorite local hangouts. Does anyone know what happened?

Went two days this week, once inside, once through the drive through. Both times, equally slow. I'm trying to get my gold star before the new ridiculous policy takes place-this location is on my way to work but it looks like I need to search for a new one. I don't have 15 extra mins to waste in a line or a drive through.

Price's are reasonable. Store is clean. Employees are very friendly. Meats and fruits are fresh. They don't have much in the medicine isle but there's a Walmart up the street. There's a gas station out front.  Pretty good place the do your grocery shopping.

Besides waiting 12 minutes to be greeted and our drinks orders were finally taken...Overall everything after was great from the appetizer to the dessert.  Haven't had such amazing authentic Mexican food since serranos..We'll be back, just hope the servers are more alert towards tables getting seated in their section.

Been here for at least 1-1/2 hours. Ordered 45mins ago. wanted over 20 mins to even have a sever come by that is only after I asked if anyone could take our order. Granted they are packed but still no excuse for the excessive times. Been waiting 15 mins at least to get another drink.

This place can be hit and miss. They do have a loyalty card, but do not have specials nor honor coupons like the Tucson locations. They apparently can get away with it in Green Valley.  Unless you absolutely need a wash, next trip into the big city have your car cleaned there.

Aggressive and unprofessional shot girls. Did NOT take no for an answer, would follow, CHASE, harass and FORCE shots down your throat even when told NO repeatedly. Also over charges you even though clearly shown what the cost is.
Physically aggressive bouncer that I witnessed throwing a patron to the ground. 
Shady and unsafe.

Rated fairly highly, I thought we'd stop in here for a beer and a snack. It is really grungy, which made me question the cleanliness of the food and cups. That's never a way to enjoy a meal. It wasn't bad, but for what you pay there, they really can afford to clean the place up a bit. Please.

Big and beautiful, and only a short walk to Bourbon Street. This high rise provides spectacular views of the French Quarter and the river and includes a nice restaurant and bar. Front desk staff were friendly and nice, and you're getting what you're paying for.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Remember when top sirloin at publix sold for one week at $3.99 per pound I purchased several from different location they were NOT too sirloin at all I don't even think they were STEAK worst meat ever. Chewy no mater how you cook it. I will NEVER buy meat from them.

Meh.

Not terribly impressed with this hotel, though they seem to work pretty hard at it.

Staff is good, service is good location is pretty good, though it's on the "not happening" side of downtown.  Good for running on the river, bad for restaurants and bars.

Overall, the hotel is just very very dated.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The customer service stinks. We ordered a crispino pizza for pick up. When we got home, it was not what we ordered. I called to get it sorted out and the person on the phone argued with me that I ordered the wrong thing and refused to make it right. Will not be going back.

We had a private luncheon in the back room. The staff was good about refilling the trays and making sure everyone's drinks were full. The whole atmosphere was very cozy and homey. Get the chicken parm and baked ziti; skip the vegetable medley (a little too well done for my taste). Good brunch/lunch choice in the area.

Got lucky and got a table on a Friday night and got treated to one of the best Italian meals I've ever had. I got the "Sunday gravy" which was fantastic. The meatballs and the braised meat were some of the best I've had. My gf got the gnocchi which was heaven in every bite.

So happy we happened to go here.

i've been a GS patron about twenty years now. always good food, good service, and their refusal to update the decor since the late 60's makes this place my favorite. its not every place that has chinese mural paintings against faux wood walls. the general's chicken is possibly the best in boise.

If  you are moving to Tampa on a tight budget and need a place to crash until you find something more permanent, I highly recommend staying here a few days. Nothing to write home about but I found it very comfortable and convenient for looking at apartments in South Tampa.  And they have free wifi and inexpensive weekly rates.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This hotel serves its purpose and does nothing wrong.  Plenty of parking.  Clean rooms, clean pool.  There were places to eat on site.  

It was a cheaper option than staying right next to the airport and they offered shuttles to places nearby.  

If casinos are your thing there was a couple very close.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Best local bar in St. Pete!! Love this place! We are visiting from CA. This place was highly recommend. My boyfriend and I sprint two days here. Had the pleasure of meeting the owner Marty. She was great! They also own Smileys Shake a local eatery. Just welcoming and good!!!

I usually don't review chain places but DAMN! 

Ordered an Iced coffee ended up with a cup of brownish water. My first sip was full of coffee grinds. Really? SB coffee never comes full of coffee grinds. This cup was watered down and just bad. 

By far the crappiest starbucks experience I have ever had.

Really enjoyed my stay. Everyone was courteous and I felt very comfortable. It had a great combinations of high class without the stuffiness. 

Clean rooms and comfortable beds. Great view. Loved the pool. The sports bar Champions has an excellent setup for watching games.

Jacuzzi is pretty small.

I would stay again.

Thanks!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I like the place, but the smoke isn't a turn-on.  The bartenders do make a mean drink.  However, the crowd can be a bit snooty at times.  Great place to hang out and play music on TouchTunes, not so great for conversation.  +1 for pinball and games in the back.

I wasn't that impressed with the bar. I went on a Friday. The locals were mainly there and I was a little bored. Also, I didn't really like the straight laced crowd that much. I was hoping on more of a medieval artistic theme but it is more like a typical sports bar.  There are better bars in the area.

This place is so frustrating. They don't know what they are doing. I had to call five times to get my rental extension. They claimed it was the not the rental agreement number first time i called...but next time it was fine. They seem very incompetent-either that or that get some kind of kick out of being annoying.

Yummy, yummy, fresh-not-canned Mexican food right off the highway.  Prices are a little high (although in keeping with the Santa Barbara area), and the temporary construction in the shopping center detracted from an otherwise excellent lunch.  Wait a few weeks, then get yourself down here.

Extra star because you are 30 feet away from Bahama Breeze.
Always nice that you do not have to drive.

if you are staying here because it is close to the airport.................be aware that the closest gas station is 10 minute drive away (in the event that you have a rental).
Free wireless.
Decent work out room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Easy to find! It gets the job done. A spot to stay for the night and a place to shower. The beds are heavenly. Not bad.. Suuuuper comfortable you feel like you're floating. Although it'd be nice to have a mini fridge. Free wifi is awesome too. Speedy network.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Supremo is a fine supermarket- but why do they always only have two cashiers working? Just cheapness I guess. Same reason you have to push your groceries on the belt and the credit card machine takes two minutes for each transaction. Sigh. It wouldn't take much to improve things.

I'm impressed. The room is nice. The linens are nice. The beds are comfy. The manager is on top of everything! 

The breakfast is on point. Scrambled eggs, potatoes O'Brien, bacon, doughnuts, pastries, bagels, regular and cinnamon waffles, big and small waffle griddles, yougurt, and 2 kinds of cereal.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Great water ice. Plenty of flavors. Big bonus for those of you who get the late night cravings because they're open late - 10:30pm. I went at night so I didn't get a feel for the surrounding nature, which is probably a big draw for families with little ones.

Service was fine, atmosphere is fun, food needs some work.  The temperature of food served needs to be improved, cold tacos are not appetizing.  The salsa is tasty.  I think appetizers and drinks is the way to go.  I am not a fan of food that is served below temperature.

The food here is not only great tasting, it's creative. I've had meals at many michelin star restaurants and Niche is on par with all of them. I was impressed.

Don't think about it, just go for the 8-course tasting menu and you will be in for a treat.

Menu changes often. Be sure to make a reservation.

All my rolls were doused with yuzi dressing. Never had a rainbow roll or nigiri with such dressing. This made the rice soggy and falling before reaching the soy sauce/wasabi. The rolls itself were not symmetrical and around .5 inches in cut.  The usual size for a roll is 1 inch per piece. Unagi nigiri was small.

This place was amazing. They took me last minute on the day of a Saints game which is crazy. The place is huge and has a great atmosphere. I was there to get my seriously janky hair fixed before a big party and Rachel worked wonders! 
I would recommend the place and Rachel to all of my friends!

It's a hotel...it's fine.  It's kinda not fabulous or comfortable. The room is just kinda plain.  There's no real good comfy lounge and it's in need of an update or refresh.  Or maybe I'm just used to more of a  business travel hotel which this is not it...I think I'll pass next time I swing by.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I didn't get to have the continental breakfast but it was offered. They do have a free happy hour which is nice but I didn't get to enjoy that either

The room was huge. Living room with attached double bed room. It was really spacious! I only stayed here one night but I would definitely stay again in future
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: There I was walking in and thinking that i will get my pistachio yogurt with sliced almonds banana mochi and granola and then I got to the toppings counter.....BAM THERE WAS NO SLICED ALMONDS!!!!!! it was a little upsetting but everything else was great. :) great music too!!

So I decided to come here spontaneously and I was interested in the combo deals. Well...the pizza is nothing amazing. You do get what you pay for and the price is great considering what you get. The location is also decent, being very close to the nearby casinos.

I try to avoid this location as much as possible.  I love Starbucks  and will frequent many locations but this one is sooooo horribly slow.  Not sure what's going on with their management here.  Unfortunately it's one of the closest to me so at times I'm stuck going to it.  Don't go there unless you want to spend 20+ minutes.

I dont know what the hype is about. This place was terrible. I waited 45 Minutes for my California burrito that I watched them microwave and then put on a plate warming table before bringing to me. Their food was bland and they didnt even give you chips and salsa. Definatly wont be going back. El YUCKOooo experience.

One of the few places in town to get gluten-free pasta. You just have to ask for it. And they cook it quite well. However, make sure that if you have celiac disease you ask if there is gluten in any of the sauces you order also. Many restaurants will add flour to sauces to help hold them together.

I arrived on time and they didn't have my car ready.  I made the reservations four weeks ago.  Not enough time?  Dan was not really a help at all.  No apologies and the car they did finally get for me had dings all over it and water spots on the mirrors and windows.  I am not impressed.  Try Avis.

Service was ok
Food was ok

I was dissapointed. I ordered a pasta dish and the pasta was undercooked not al dente. So I paid $25 for undercooked crunchy pasta. hmmm maybe I should have said something, but I don't ever trust sending food back to the cook.

Oh well. I don't think I would ever go back.

Cheese-ology is delightful.  I enjoy the genius of a restaurant devoted entirely to mac and cheese.  Mom and I came here and shared a mac and cheese and a salad.  Plenty of food.  The service here is fast and friendly.  I would definitely come back next time I'm in a mac and cheese mood.

Let's face it, it's McDonald's - Who doesn't love the greasy goodness of those crisp, salty fries? This visit, I tried the Shamrock Shake. What is this green monster? It's not quite minty, it was a bit fruity, it wasn't great but it wasn't terrible. So my curiosity is still peaked.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: tip: this location is very hard to find if your not from around here; going with the directions from yelp it leads you to the middle of the st and this location is atop a hill over the street and they dont have signs so your not gonna see it from the road. but overall its a baskin robbins ice cream is ice cream

Its better than the Extend Stay America!

+1 Parking is relatively easy
+1 Free breakfast
+1 Suite Shop (better  food)
+1 Good sized rooms
+1 Nice front desk

-1 Beds are somewhat comfy (not really)
-1 Thin walls and doors are extremely loud when they shut
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Been here twice for lunch - exactly what you see is what you get, great Italian-American food. Portions are generous but not monstrous, waitstaff are interactive and helpful, they've got great wine, and they have sauce and meatballs for sale! A little pricey - but the location in the heart of the Italian Market justifies that.

The service and bread were the best things about our experience at Vivace. The meals (seafood stuffed shrimp and penne with sausage) were OK, but not great.  The wine is moderately priced (at least compared to Chicago) and the coffee was good. I expected more from "one of Tucson's best."

5 stars for being inexpensive.  3 for just being too dingy.  Carts are falling apart and maybe 1 of 6 dryers (and or washers) not working.  I would have been satisfied if it just could've been cleaner.  I would have found some other place if I wasn't pressed for time.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
After skiing at Squaw Valley during the day, we saw this place by our hotel and stopped in.  Overall, we were impressed - good sushi, good prices, and nice vibe.

Two of us had the spicy tuna roll and one cucumber roll.

Their beer selection is limited to a few Japanese beers though.

In the land of Dunkin Donuts, It was nice to actually find a Starbucks, unfortunately the whole "our air condition barely works" BS, is not helping the fact a large pile of sweat beads is starting to drip down the crack of my ass, as I sat their on my lap top, trying to pretend my life is meaningful.

I went there yesterday for the first time to have a nice Mexican lunch. I give it two stars because it did not present itself as it should have by overcharging for the margaritas, not having normal Street fair matching street fair prices, and difficult ordering system.

Update: tried general tsos combo platter and disappointed that it wasn't spicy and tasted just like sesame chicken. Also disappointed in the beef and broccoli and lo mein, both very blan and I'm not sure texture wise it's beef. For that I'm going to lower my rating.

After moving all weekend making dinner was not an option, I was wanting to check out the area and came across this restaurant. I ordered the sesame chicken, crab Rangoon, and fried dumplings. Overall impressed, especially with the sesame chicken. Will order more things again another time.

I did stay for business purpose and I was very please with the room and the friendly staff. The room I took was huge and very clean. They also offer Starbucks brewed coffee, it doesn't get it better then that. The location is great with all the surrounding stores and top restaurants. I will stay there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: In St. Louis for an evening and the Westin was a solid call.  Nice rooms, comfortable beds, ridiculous double-head steam shower.  Breakfast downstairs was enjoyable.  Across the street is the Cardinals' new stadium, and Metrolink is 30-seconds from the front door.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Great place for lunch. Right around 11 you can get in and out easily. Good selection,  but they are a franchise so not everything online is on the menu. I have also used the phone ahead takeout service. My food was waiting upon arrival. Great for those short lunch breaks. Thanks!

I went there while visiting Indy, not knowing about the food style. I was surprised when I found that I could only order appetizers from the menu. I get that it's their style.... but it would have been nice to have some other options.

The beer (Bells Two Hearted Ale) was good, and the service was just okay.

No matter where we went on Bourbon Street, we kept coming back to one of their 3 locations.  The friendliest staff, minus Chris the homophobic jackass at one :P

The single acoustic players & the bands at all of them were so awesome, friendly & funny.  

When is the hand grenade gonna replace the hurricane? :)

This place rocks! I ate here this weekend and went crazy....gotta read the directions though or you will be paying $1 a roll that you waste. Would have given it 5 stars but the employees kids were running around playing kick ball....great food, great value.

Very small menu with maybe 2/3 of it with some sort of sea food. Sea food, in a landlocked state. Really? Loved the salad, but that was pretty much it. Small parking lot as well and the place is not big either. If you go, don't forget to make a reservation.

I heard it's a great spot if you're a local, but if you're not they're just so mean here.  I was so excited to visit here but was treated with curt and unfriendly treatment.  There are so many bars in New Orleans where they're happy to have you and welcome you.  This is not one of them.

Your paying for location. It's not a bad place, but to pricey for what it offers. The beds were only full sized, not queen, in our room. The place has been updated some, but still shows it's age. Also, breakfast wasn't all that great and all the tv stations were snowy. That said, it is in a great location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Ordered a Greek salad and it was made with iceberg lettuce. Wtf?? And it came out after we had finished our pizza already. Ordered an appetizer too which came out after we finished the salad! Pizza was good though but not worth being forgotten about even though we were the only table in there!

I've been here a few times - I must say if you order the right thing it's very good.  The inside is also very nice and they have a little patio.

Last time I was there I definitely ordered something I wasn't expecting...but oh well.

It's a nice place overall.

super easy pick up and return, car was clean and i had absolutely no problems at all. the guy who rented me the car and inspected it with me was friendly. the shuttle to get to the airport was right on time and i waited less than 10 min for it to come....i have no complaints at all...easy rental, transaction, payment, and return..

My husband and I loooove the hard to find/Belgian/unique/imported/beer-snobish beers. We was able to find many at this lil store tucked away in a strip mall in Clearwater. 

Don't most of life's hidden treasures like this usually reside in a strip mall, though?

This place is the best. Best getaway from Bourbon. Best proximity to great food (Dis&Dem), great prices, great bartenders, great atmosphere, great events and great outdoor seating. But don't bring your asshole friends because nobody here has time for that.

Well, this is weird! I took a picture of my friend eating Fro-Yo (visit 2 of 2) and looking annoyed.  Artist David Fullarton found it randomly on Flickr and did an excellent reworking of it in an illustration of his.  Fro-yo + art.  I can die now.

http://www.flickr.com/photos/fullarton/3857079388/

Lots of flies everywhere, very unsanitery and annoying.  No longer offers milk or even half and half by self serve station.  Baristas doesn't accurately measure what goes in and often times give you a latte where most of the cup is foam.  Music is sometimes too loud. 

Good things: plenty of power outlets and chairs. Open 24 hrs.

For what they charge and my room curtains didn't close all the way, my sink makes noises, there was no coffee mate with the coffee machine tray, slow and unprofessional valet staff and they only had 2 elevators working. The ups is the location, the pool and their rooms/bathrooms big.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I was not happy with the place. It could be better for the price I had to pay this weekend. The bathroom door was terrible. No handles just sliding door. The room is tiny. The wi-fi was going in and out. I have to say I had better Holiday Inn than this one.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: If I could give this place less than 1 star I would.  Guy at counter is rude beyond belief. I honestly was so appalled at his attitude I literally drove away and headed to the next place I hit where they are so nice and fast !! If he isn't the owner the owner should fire this guy.  So glad I left and didn't give him my money.

Don't go to Diva on Sunday, extremely short staffed, fastest pedicure I've ever had.  I waited 35 minutes, no sign-in sheet,  they were calling people that just walked in to sit down.   I was not going to let that happen
I have had good service in the past when the owner is present, she runs a tight ship.

The pizza is really good. And I like the atmosphere. When the weather is nice, the front room has big garage-style windows that open up to give it a bit of a patio feel. The only downside is that they can be a bit slow at times. But if you aren't in a big hurry, I put the pizza second to Mellow Mushroom in Nashville.

3.5 stars. This is my neighborhood Starbucks. I typically grab my coffee to go. It's always busy and staff are always friendly.  I've never had an order messed up at this location, so service is consistent. They have nice big tables, which makes it easy to have a laptop and spread out.

Nice affordable hotel. Bottom floor rooms  a little less desirable due to a slight damp smell. Beds very comfortable. Could use either more pillows or a better pillow offering. Will stay here again next visit due to the fair price and location close to affordable eats.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Not only is the pizza amazing but the service is excellent as well. The manager visits our table and chats with us each time and even remembers us. Even though its in a mall it still feels like our neighborhood pizza joint. The Caesar salad is phenomenal too!

I dont think I will ever come back here. The staff didnt know what they were taking about, what kind of sushimi I could have with my order, or much less anything I wanted to know about the entrees. The California Roll was decent but not that great. Overall it was a little expensive for quality that was sub par.

My wife and I love this place. The staff are always friendly, courteous, and know about the items on the menu and if asked about a certain dish, they won't steer you wrong. We don't like to cook at home, so we eat out almost every night. We always make a point to come here at least twice a week.

After a major hiccup on our trip, that left us without a room, the front desk assisted us with the booking company to ensure our night's stay. Sharon was more than accommodating and helped us a great deal. Our stay was great, room was awesome, and staffed was outstanding. Thank you Embassy Suites
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Don't normally review hotels on Yelp but this Courtyard was kind of a mess. Room was clean, but phone didn't work and TV was right in middle of desk/ workspace. Didn't really work design wise. Convenient that it was near airport. Ok experience. Stayed at much better Marriot's
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We were surprised at the lack of organic produce. They had a few other items we needed but overall we had hoped for a lot more. And they don't have beer - so we had to go to another store. Which was a bit of a hassle since we were without a car. Probably wouldn't be to locals or those with their own wheels.

I had the chicken parm for dinner.  The waitress didn't wow about it so I took my chances ... and it was mediocre at best.  I pointed it out to the maitr d' who offered a dessert, the choc mousse cake, whichc was excellent.  So it's hit or miss (how does a Philly Italian restaurant NOT have great chicken parm?)

Great service people were very friendly. Pizza was very very dray though we did end up getting one with no sauce on it, still it was way to dry.  Brownies looked so good so I went for it....mistake had to be a few days old as it crumbled apart when I bit into it.  I would not go back.

Food was typical McDonald's. My problem is an employee (I think the manager) has her kids with her, running rampant, and unattended in the play area. They were eating in the playground, doing cartwheels, throwing themselves against the glass, and set off the door alarm...
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Ordered on uber eats, stir fried udon noodles and some pieces of eel and salmon roe sushi. The sushi was fine, the noodles lacked flavor and overly salty. I ended up throwing most of it out unfortunately. I historically had great experiences here, I'm hoping it was a once off.

Ordered Eggs Benedict.   It came out timely.   There was no crowd.   Eggs were hard no yolk to make it a real Benedict experience.   Was going to try for dinner, but if they can't get breakfast right, I'm not ready to trust for dinner.  Maybe the eggs stayed under a heat lamp too long, I'm not sure where the problem occurred.

Not fancy, not the best service (waited a bit more than a half hour for the check), but the food was decent. The place was busy, so we had a good feeling about the food. Not worth going out of your way for, but a decent choice if you are looking for sushi in the area.

Pinnacle Bank issued a rubberized "Cashier's Check" to me and it bounced sky high. I'm out $6,000. Reported it to this "bank" and have heard nothing. It must be hand-in-glove with the perpetrator.

Beware of any financial instrument you receive from this place.

Excellent hot Turkey sandwich on a day Winter refuses to leave alone. The meat itself was superbly cooked, the bread ... well, the bread can be summed in one word: yummo.

No, I don't care it's not a real word.

Try WilliB's then walk next door to Flying M for a pretty good latte.

Very good.  I had butternut squash ravioli which was very good.  Calamari delicious as well as friends meals.
The service was great.  The gentleman answered our questions and was patient when taking our orders.
The restaurant was clean and had a great atmosphere.

This place is not the best! The burritos are average, had no favor! Just a boring burrito. During the lunch hour they have no guacamole?? They gave me some runny green salsa instead. If you want a good place try senor frogs on linden. Way better and it's a nice sit down restaurant with better quality in Carpinteria.

Had the tomato mozzarella flatbread from the Bistro and it hit the spot! Wasn't made with fresh mozzarella but definitely would have it again! The Hotel is newly remodeled and located in a very short walking distance to two bar/restaurants. Would stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Sucks, sucks, sucks.....oh, did I say that it sucks??  So bad.  Staff sucked.  Food sucked.  wine sucked.  Made the rest of my night suck as well.  Note to self...listen to Yelp reviews, don't have your friend choose the restaurant, and never go to an Italian restaurant in a place known for spicy creole food.  My mistake.

Fair food without the fair prices, gobbs of people. I had the big hungry burger combo. I devoured it. It was just what I wanted. I also go a chocolate malt. It reminds me of the slower paced life that America has forever forgotten. It was nice to sit outside. The atmosphere is just right! I'll be back!

I got gel/shellac nails and I hate leaving bad reviews... but honestly the woman who did my nails didn't do a good job. She left paint all over my cuticles and it didn't look neat. The nail techs were nice, but I left feeling pretty disappointed in how my nails looked. I won't be going back,  unfortunately.

Everyone is really nice here and the service was quick. I can't escape the feeling here (and at any jiffy lube for that matter) that they are always selling something? Someone addresses you with a hundred things your car needs. Like thank you for informing me OH MY GOD HOW AM I SUDDENLY SPENDING $200?!?!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The product tastes pretty good. However, the portions are too small and/or overpriced by about 25%. Our table was not entirely clean, the bread roll was almost flavorless and the guy who took our order was clearly not happy to be at work. I've been and won't return. Too many other good choices.

Too smokey for me inside, but I really LOVE sitting outside when the weather is nice. Best chilli in town -- they have a regular and vegetarian option -- both are delicious. 

It's also a great location for people watching, as it is located on a busy Mass Ave corner.

This little hole in the wall was absolutly fantastic. A lot of food for the price. Too much food almost. The cheeseburger was very tasty. The pork tenderloin sandwich was awesome. Onion rings, potato salad, and deviled eggs were all delicious as well. Will definatly be back.

I love Starbucks in general, but the staff here really could use a little more training. Every time I order my drink it's different and every time a client orders it for me it comes out different as well. Also always very busy. Maybe a few more staff members or some free espresso for the staff. ;-)

Rooms untidy, holes in bathroom door.  Take my advice, stay at the Westin next door  and come back to the waterpark.  For the extra $50 for the room, you get a much cleaner experience.  The only reason this got a second star was due to the nice attitude of the employees.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Atrocious service. Not to mention one of the bankers used my girlfriends personal information to try to add her on instagram and then tried sending her personal emails. There never seems to be a manager on site. No one ever calls you back. Single worst banking experience ever.

Hand grenades!! You have to get one from here ! They taste amazing, a nice sour sip everytime. You can get them on ice or blended. Either way is tasty. You get a cute plastic grenade on top for some pizzzazzzzz. Be careful, these sneak up on you...don't be fooled by the sweet sour taste. You might just end up passed out.

Both times I've tried to go it's been at least an hour wait. They won't answer the phone when I try to call ahead. Can't comment on their skill cause I've never waited the hours to get in. Beyond Nails right across Pyramid costs a little more, but they get you right in and do a great job!

The resort just opened on December 18, 2009. We vacationed there from December 27- Jan 2. While the location is remote and very beautiful, the service is not up to par with other Ritz-Carltons. I would wait at least six months and let them work out the kinks before making a reservation.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I love Charlie's. They have been taking care of my fiancee's and friend's cars years. They are honest people, who do great work. They won't try to sell you more than you need and get the work done quickly. I can say that I have no doubts when I take my car to Charlie's and she always comes back purring like a kitten.

Just an awful delivery experience. Forty-five minutes later than the 45-60 minute delivery window promised and by the time it arrived, it was cold and the order was wrong anyway. It's fine for eat in or pickup, maybe, but don't order delivery if you're hungry or it's later than 7:00.

Virginia, who was working the drive through today, is probably the best employee that they could ever ask for on the customer service end. Unbelievably sweet. On top of that, she knew the name of the person in front of me and knew what they would be ordering before they ordered it. She just had it ready. Never let go of her.

If you need a $20 haircut in Philly, you should try it out here. I walked in and the hairdresser served me right away. She was friendly and talkative. I got a decent haircut that was somewhat inexpensive, so I'd recommend this place to anyone that has a tight budget.

When in the other day after I had unsuccessfully tried to get in with Ricco's for a few days. Didn't have to wait and the guys were really friendly. Got a nice fade from Chuck, he definitely put some work into it. Standard Port Richmond price and a benevolent atmosphere. I'll be going back.

I love my new gym - the employees are always very courteous and helpful. The gym itself is very clean, and has all the essentials. I go at the hours I would imagine would be the busiest, but it is never too crowded. Also a great value - truly a fantastic gym!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Not the greatest sushi joint in town. I prefer this place over Sushi Garden.

They have happy hour from 11-7 most days and then 11-5 on fri and sat. 

They have good quality fish and their rolls aren't huge like the all u can eat places. definitely worth checking out if you're out on the east side!

Great location. I really loved how large the room was. The bathroom was a wee tiny--but overall it served a purpose.

I will say that if you are a light sleeper and there is a crying baby next to you, don't expect to sleep much. The walls are rather thin. It was rather shocking to be able to hear crying through the walls.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The hotel is beautiful and the staff was very friendly. However, they didn't do the best job of getting our room ready. One of the lights above our bed was missing. Old coffee was in the coffee maker. Both of the cabinet doors in the bathroom fell off when we opened them. Great location. Decent price.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Great prices. Customer service in pick up was very slow with a long line and check out process. The car was good and turning it back in was easy. Plus the shuttle took me straight to the airport. 24 hour shuttle service is convenient. I'll continue to use whatever place gives me the best prices.

Pretty decent Mexican food, especially for the area (in which Taco Bell counts as Mexican)which was a nice surprise.  They've also got enormous, highly potent margaritas.  Beware if you're driving!  Oh wait - you've got to drive everywhere in this town!  Beware!

I'm vegan and they have a treehugger pizza that I added pineapple to with no cheese of course and it was AMAZING!!  The service was also top notch...a pleasant rarity these days.  In a world where pizza places are a dime a dozen, this place stands out!  Highly recommend.  Also, they have quite a few TVs if you want to watch a game.

Great local Japanese take-out or dine-in (BYOB).  Their sushi is fresh-rolled and delicious.  Every item I've ordered has been excellent!  The dining area is small and not intimate. They do have a sushi bar, although I've never dined in.  The staff are friendly and service is fast.

One of my favorite sushi spots in Philadelphia. This is the place you go if you want something crazy and lots of variety. Also vegetarian friendly for all my vegetarians out there. 

So many options so little time. My go to favorites are Rolling Fire, Volcano, Sleeping Volcano, Kimchi Ya. 

Also can't go wrong with some miso soup!

Marinara sauce was weird and didn't taste very good. The lady that helped us was abrupt and we could only understand 1 out of every 29 words she said (yes 29). And the crackers were pre staled.  I would give this place one star. But the garlic bread was delicious, so I'll put two stars.

Nicest waiter and bartender; gave us lots of tips and told stories about Hurricane Katrina. The food was very tasty; I had Lasagna and my friend Chicken Alfredo Pasta. Big plates and the bread was tasty too. So relaxing with lighter music than what is out on the street.

Service at this location is always bad and always have some kind of issue with my food. Today was old soggy French fry. Employee was bothered that I asked for fresh fries  sorry I interrupted your conversation, but maybe you should socialize outside of work. This location needs training and over all food quality improvement.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Great neighborhood food!

Nunzio provided good Italian food at reasonable prices. 

We had the calamari, Asian pear salad, mussels, salmon, veal, and ravioli. All tasty and not super heavy.

The service was great. 

Great touch for the chef to come out and say hello.

I'd come back here again.

Great place to stay! Convenient location with great shuttle service. AGM Keith M. is AWESOME!! He went out of his way to make our stay extra special. All hotel staff are great from the management to the shuttle drivers to the cleaning staff. Stay here --you won't regret it!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
outdoor patio was deifnitely great.
The place has amazing food. 
Tried the shrimp scampi and it was succulent. I definitely recommend it. Everyone in our party loved the food.
Service can be improved, but give me goood food and I'll forgive your lack of service.
Their wine list was also good. Go here.

I have the misfortune of living in the townhouses next to this eyesore. I will soon be buying fencing for my back wall because random trash is pitched into my yard by their guests. As for artistic flair, does graffiti count? I look forward to the day they knock this place to the ground.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Really friendly and helpful staff. That is most certainly the highlight of this place. My room was an okay size, but the carpet down the hallway leading to it had some obvious stains. The restaurant offerings are okay, but nothing to write home about. Good cocktails.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Very nice....

I have stayed at this Marriott a few times and it has always been a positive experience. 

The place itself is very pleasing to the eye; from the moment you walk into the lobby to the time you get into your comfortable room. 

The staff is very helpful and willing to assist you in anything you might need.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Well I booked an appointment with a person who did not exist here. So that was a little awkward when I asked everyone there who that person was...I can't even remember the name, maybe Viago or something. I ended up going somewhere else because of it. Wasn't thrilled about driving across town to get a a haircut.

The hotel and convention center is beautiful through and through. The restaurant options are sufficient, and the catering was impeccable. The rooms were quiet although I anticipated otherwise, and the staff is very friendly.

I'd stay here again, be it business or pleasure.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Customer service is great and they really take care of you! I've used them for a number of different services for my Volvo S40 and never seem to have an issue. The service is friendly, quick, and everyone takes the time to explain both what has been done and what needs to be done in the future.

Pretty sure they just pressed my sweater and bagged it up instead of actually cleaning it. 

There was a bit of food dropped near a button that had formed a thin crust. It is something that's easily removed. The crust was still there after the $7 "cleaning."
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: If you like soup this is the yogurt place for you! The flavor selection is decent but the temp is almost always too warm. Like dripping milk instead of yogurt. More than 50% of the toppings were empty on our last visit and per usual the place is staffed by teenagers who are busy talking to their friends.

Constance was my bartender last Friday and she was FABULOUS she noticed that I liked the bigger straws and not the small stirrers and put it in my next drink. She was so attentive and quick.  I don't venture to Uptown often but she is going to make me start!

Although Yelpers have reported it closed, it is not.
My friend and her husband raved about their delicious dim sum lunch Just this afternoon.
Update: my bad. My friend was at the location on Dale Mabry. Waters burned down as reported in prior comments.~sorry.

Love this planet fitness! We've visited so many across California, and even around northern Indy. We love the open space, atmosphere, lighting, cleanliness, and customer service. You won't regret joining this gym or making the trek from another town to visit!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Taco Tuesday features $1 tacos. Drinks are also 2 for 1. While the sangria was a bit too sweet for my taste, the tacos are good and taste great with the nontraditional sauces on the table. Easily the best deal around if you're in Grand Center on a Tuesday.

Definitely one of the nicest courtyards I've ever stayed in - and I stay in marriotts 80-90 times a year. The actual courtyard is pretty amazing with two fire pits, pool and hot tub.

The rooms are standard but very clean. Every employee I've met had been super nice and helpful!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We stopped in here for a burger and a beer.  I always order my burgers medium rare, this was served medium well.  The hostess was not friendly and our waiter seemed overwhelmed.  Earlier in the day we stopped for an app at Buttonwood Grill and that was much better than this place.

I wish I was able to comment on the food, but I can't. We were ignored at the hostess station for over 10 minutes. Then when someone arrived, they told us it would be at least a 25 minute wait. The restaurant was half empty! We walked out and took our business elsewhere.

We ordered two types of Mac and cheese and both were lack luster. The noodles were low quality and while the cheese was generous it was not worth finishing. Really disappointed. The people who love this place just have never had anything exceptional, but it is cool that it is in the loop.

Vet and staff take extra time to explain pricing and services.  Vet was able to do blood work and schedule surgery within one day.  She even called before surgery to be sure that I was comfortable with the procedure. No pressure and very compassionate.  One of my best vet experiences.

Our stay was fine until they added a $250.00 room charge and claimed I told them by phone this was ok.
Umm no. I received a phone call REMINDING me that smoking was not allowed in the room or in balcony despite all the signs. I thought this was courtesy call not a SET UP.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces
