text: I have to say the only thing I enjoyed was the drinks . The food was cold and underwhelming. The service was slow and the decor isn't inviting . We will not be back to the little Lion with all the great restaurants in Philadelphia . I suggest you step it up .

I just went here for the first time and had a nice dinner at a reasonable price, the filet with bacon and the Tapit IPA.  My friends enjoyed their meals too.  I was worried by the mixed reviews on this site, especially of the service, but ours was just fine.

Just tried the new Goleta Petrini's, ordered 3 large pizzas.  The crust, which is always served thin, seems like a dry wafer more than a real pizza crust - 0 for 4 in the opinions of my family.   Cheese so-so, toppings decent.  Sorry to give a local business a weak review, maybe some will like this kind of crust.

Hole in the wall, but boy let me tell you I would crawl into that hole any day.  Staff was the best and very accommodating. Everything was spot on. Chicken adobo was excellent, guacamole was chunky and smooth and the salsa with the free chips had the right taste. Will go back again and again and so should you. Great job!

Very mediocre experience.  They sat us 15 minutes past our reservation with no apology and the server had to be flagged down every time we needed him.  Food is fine, even good.  Service is slow and the hostesses are very rude.  Won't be back unless maybe a glass of wine and food in the bar.

I ordered a "value meal" with a $1 off coupon.  It included a foot-long sub, chips, and soda.  The total was $8.10 ($9.10 w/o coupon).  That price would have been ok if the sub was excellent.  But it wasn't even close.  I would have been better off going to a neighborhood sub shop or Wawa.  Not worth it.

At the bistro 2100 right now was seated at a table that was clearly not cleaned had to wait 7 min before my server came by to even take my order/check on me I pointed out the mess on table and have been here another 10 min with it not being cleaned and still no food. I would expect better service especially at a table for 1.

Very poor and service!  We were never offered drink refills or did the server ever come back to see if our food was prepared probably.  We had a difficult time just getting someone's attention to bring us the check.  The pizza was okay.  The pasta was greatly overpriced!  Linguini with just garlic and olive oil $19!!

It's decent -- nothing noteworthy positive or negative.  It's a HIE.

Parking is a little wonky, from a side street.  There's a Wings & More and gas station next door.

It's not somewhere I'd vacation, but to night over for business, it's what I expect.   Although, if you're an IHG Platinum, don't expect a room upgrade :/
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is the best and freshest sushi place I've eaten in Nola. I have been to several. I do get the raw fish rolls.l, usually not cooked or with tempura. The quality is very consistent and very fresh. I keep coming back even after trying the newest sushi bars in town.

You know you're at Ed's when you see the big old white dog behind the counter. Friendly staff that will help you with your selection.  This month they have wine tasting classes - I can't wait for the champagne one! Usually they have a good selection of sales.

Hands down, best pizza in Tampa!!!! Ingredients are fresh and made to order. I had the prosciutto and arugula pizza and it came out piping hot, which is the first thing I look for. Great customer service as well!!! If you are looking for fresh handmade pizza, Platts is the place for you.

Nice family run place. Pizza is New York style, great for the price. Antipasto salads are full of meats, cheese, veggies, and are a great value as the small can feed 2-3 people. Sandwiches are decent. Pasta meals are just ok, nothing great. Best bet is the pizza, which has a special on Mondays.

This is an awful business in our neighborhood. Not sure who owns this particular store but they must not care.  Rude,slow and unfriendly sums it up.  Drive thru is even worse.  Too bad the burger king across the street is hardly better. My advice is if you don't know anyone who "works" here prepare yourself for a lousy experience
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is our go-to local Italian restaurant near our place.  We've visited 4-5 times, and always get great food great atmosphere and great services. We love the fact that the restaurant seems family-owned and takes great pride in their food quality and services.

We were there on the 4th of July for lunch and there were 6 adults and 4 kids in our group.Our waitress was useless from the very beginning. I thought the waitress was dreaming.My uncle asked how much money is for a 3 year old and a 2 year old she said 13 bucks!that was the worst place I had been to.

Gets only 4 on first visit took waitress 25 minutes before anyone came to table to ask for anything.  It was a Wednesday night and not real busy.  They must have been caught off guard by few more people showing up. Food was great when we finally got it and drinks were good also. Will go back again.

I don't like having my panzorotti microwaved. That should give y'all a clue. The pizza is an "eh" on the rating scale. Are there any good pizzerias in Burlington County? I have found only one, out of all the pizza places around, only one I would go back to.  This is NOT it.

Been using them on a regular basis for past 4 months for shirt laundering and dry cleaning without a problem. No broken or loose buttons.  Actually I have been pleasantly surprised that my white shirts are more white and less dingy than previous place!  Always friendly and accommodating.  Reasonably priced.  Dog friendly
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Great pizza. Fast order. Came out of the oven exactly on time. 
I was up from Texas to help my Dad with some home repair. Had a medium spinach tomato and Feta. This is what we call a margarita in Houston. It was excellent. Fresh ingredients supple soft but nicely cooked dough. These guys did it right. Good choice.

Had friends down from Phoenix and they stayed here, we decided to get a room as well. The front desk staff was very warm and friendly. The room we received was nicely updated and modern. Clean crisp linens and a very comfortable bed. Although we didn't get down to the pool the grounds and pool area looked really lovely.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This hotel is great! We stay here frequently and love it.  Clean, nice pool, and nice rooms. When we stay here we are actually in the area for Santa Barbara but we prefer to stay down here in carp even if the holiday inn on state st has availability. This hotel is great!only a 10 minute Dr to Santa Barbara.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Been meaning to dine here after a recommendation from a colleague. Found it lively, comfortable, very satisfactory. Salads and squash soup were both pleasing first courses. All of us ordered pasta dishes. Food came quickly, service was attentive  We all enjoyed ourselves, and I'd be inclined to go back.

Eat here quite a bit. I gave this establishment 4 stars, which is well deserved. I find the restaurant to be a little "dirty/old", so that's why I knocked them down a star. They have a friendly staff, speedy cookers, and delicious margaritas. I recommend the, chorizo & egg with rice & beans.

Stayed here for a work conference over a weekend. Not a five star hotel, but for the price it was pretty good. Lobby is nice, and concierge floor was well furnished. Rooms were clean and staff efficient and friendly. Breakfast buffet is $16 which seemed pricey, although food was good quality. Great to stay if you're at the airport.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ordered the Cobb salad for lunch minus the blue cheese... It was mediocre at best. Hardly any salad and loaded with so much bacon it was impossible to taste the other ingredients. This was a to go order otherwise I would have complained to them...will not order this ever again...

Honestly was having such a crazed horrible moment and the dudes here were incredible! So nice, so fast and friendly! When every other tire shop in Philadelphia turned us down or wouldn't even pick up the phone the gentleman at Tire Techs really went above and beyond. Seriously life savers, cannot thank them enough.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Ok so I'm hold right now for like 10 minutes it's 7:27 so the manager knows who was a hostess at that time. I can hear what's happening on the other line and the girls is not really busy. She's laughing etc... Why am I on hold I don't know. Food is great though. Get more professional people to work for you

Classic Renaissance. Nice remodel, rooms are great, and it has become our go to spot for business travel. Our rate always includes wireless and breakfast, I don't like the $10 a day parking/$12 valet.

Love the restaurant, because they have reasonably priced, great dinners, but they do have leisurely service.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Absolutely gorgeous garden seating under the stars, and scrumptious Italian food. Had the cavatelli, spaghetti marinara, gnocchi, shrimp linguini as main dishes for our party. Dessert included cheesecake in a cute mason jar, tiramisu (with a kick of rum), and cookies with chocolate. Definitely not your run of the mill Italian fare!

probably the worst McDonald's ever.  It's dirty, there are an insane amount of flies (everywhere, including my orange juice!), the staff is unprofessional and it took 21 minutes to get my food right.  I've ordered, eaten and paid at a sit down restaurant in less time.   Skip this McDonald's, there's one on South Broad.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I went here today to get coffee for my family and I will never be going back! They were extremely rude, didn't get my order correct and when I asked which one was the decaf coffee they again answered rudely and came to find out it was decaf!

You are better off going to one of the other coffee places in town

When I first walked in I asked for a free day pass.  Most gyms will give you a free day pass.  They said the day rate was $20 plus tax to try the gym. They had no free weight squat machine, only smith machines.  Also no machines to work your calves.  I would have bought a membership if they had more free weight equipment.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Free wifi. Nice seating. Pretty decent baristas. The two black girls had MAJOR attitude but I love my Starbucks so I'll be back. It's definitely wayyyyyy more expensive than my Starbucks at home. I can get a venti iced chai tea latte for 4.23 at home. I got a grande here for 5.81. Crazy!!!

The service was great and the ice cream was excellent! The only thing keeping me from giving five stars is that I'm a "chocoholic" and they didn't have a chocolate flavor on the menu. The Brown Butter Almond Brittle and the Ndali Estate Vanilla Bean were great!

Service is absolutely TERRIBLE.  Its a shame because they have an awesome selection of beer.  The food was decent but was surprisingly served on paper plates with plastic forks, knives, etc. Bad idea, Jet Rock, bad idea.

Only go here if you have a long layover and can handle bad service.

Doesn't follow the legal water distribution laws for customers. Just tried to obtain water after buying an alcoholic drink and was told the cost was $4.50. When I asked for the manager and wanted to hear specifics he walked away from me and didn't provide an explanation.

best sushi place in st. louis!!!!! i am overly obsessed with their volcano roll (soy paper-no fish eggs). i also love their butterfly roll and hawaiian roll!!!!! 

also can't forget about their bagel roll. honestly if you haven't been here do yourself a favor and treat yo self!

Well, I just had the seaweed salad and the sushi.  It was ok.  The salad was a little drowned, and the sushi just seemed a little dry--like it wasn't that fresh or something.  This place has mostly great reviews.  Maybe just I didn't order the right thing.

Food was delicious. Menu has changed so some of the items shown on Yelp menu are no longer available. When placing order for pickup the employee didn't know the new menu real good so that was frustrating. Would definitely eat here again when we come back for vacation.

We called ahead for a dinner reservation for 5 people at 6 PM.  When we arrived, it was a busy night and we had to wait 15-20 minutes although many tables were unoccupied.  The problem was there were not enough servers working the floor.  The food took a long time to prepare, but was very good.  We would go back again.

Terrible drive thru! Have gone by 2 times in the last week and they have tried to overcharge me, give me drinks that were not my order, and did not have my drink near started by the time I was to the window (plus I had been waiting for 15 minutes already in line)..

Horrific service!!   Been here for 30 min.  Staff has zero smiles on their faces.  They could care less that we are all standing here waiting.    Fast break get priority then rental people get priority then those of us waiting to rent the sub par cars.  NEVER AGAIN!!!!!  Lesson learned.

IBD is a must if you are South of Nashville! We all ordered 12 donuts and PSLs - they were the perfect morning treat! We highly recommend the glazed!   The staff make you feel like an old friend when you're here and you will feel like the heart of life is good! Don't miss out on this adorable shop! It's a pleasure!

Great food! The steak was fantastic and perfectly medium rare. Topped with shrimp, mushrooms and a steak reduction to die for. The potatoes and veggie spot on. Desert, don't even get me started (best bourbon pecan pie ever). 

The service was also spot on and it is Southern Decadence weekend.

Great room. Nice hotel. Very swanky. Great view of downtown. Very friendly staff. Only downside is 20 bucks on top of room just to park in an unguarded and halfway plowed parking lot. Parking should be free for guests in my opinion. 

If parking was free this would be 5 stars.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: A quaint restaurant in a beautiful city! All the items we ordered were great, but the veal/prosciutto/ sage butter ravioli & beets and tomato salad were the top two! Our server was very nice and there weren't any issues with waiting times, noise, etc! Looking forward to trying some of the main dishes!

Crazy shuttle ride like Mr. Toad's  cracked out wild ride. We literally thought we were going to die on the way from the airport to the rental car facility. It was like riding on a world horse and getting bucked off before you nearly go through the windshield.

I stopped here while on vacation for drinks and apps with a friend. The burrata cheese with Brussels sprouts had great flavor and the Jersey Sunrise was a refreshing drink. The atmosphere was hip but relaxed, and the service was great. I liked that the menu had everything from tapas to shareables to large meals.

I went  here to buy some donuts and my favorite type of bagel, onion. I have been to this location three different times to get one and all of the times they said no or we don't make those, when recently i got told they are per the manager's request, to what they make. Just not what it use to be sad.

Best Chinese food in this area! Closest place that is on the level of deliciousness of Kum Fong is in Chinatown in Philly... Recommend the Singapore Rice Noodles, or the Homestyle Chicken. Wonton Soup and Egg Roll are a must and the Crab Rangoons are an excellent starter.

I love this place! Took my boyfriend here for his first time, he loves it too now. Super clean place, the gentlemen working today was very friendly, and very fresh ingredients. I didn't know this company is locally-owned! And they help with donations. They deserve all the stars!

If you're looking for great Italian food, look no more. Best spaghetti and meat balls I've ever had at a restaurant. The rigatoni, veal, and gnocchi also very delicious.  Their deserts were pretty good. I recommend the lemon cheesecake. Will definitely be back next time I'm in Philly.

Delivery is crazy fast. The food is good, it doesn't taste overly salty as many Chinese take restaurants do. I have introduced this spot to many of my coworkers and like me, they have this number saved in their phone now. I highly recommend the shrimp fried rice with extra shrimp and egg.

I come here all the time. And it's normally always good service and no problems.  But I went here today with my husband. And he ordered me a 4x4 plain with ketchup bc I'm allergic to cheese. And when we got home there was so much cheese on my burger. I was not able to eat my food.

My husband and I went here last night. And the kid at the window was so rude to my husband. Kept laughing at my husband and when we asked for sauce, he said that it's 30 cents for sauce. I've never had to pay for sauce from McDonald's in my life. So weird. I won't be coming back to this McDonald's!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Terrible customer service, workers who argue with each other making the process of getting in and out take much longer than it should and management that doesn't care. I will drive out of my way to go to another carwash and to avoid ever using this business again!

To fight the humid/hot NOLA weather - we decided to make a pit stop at Pinkberry.  A ventured out from the normal yogurts and got the "honey comb" soft serve instead. The first bite taste abit weird but it eventually grows on you. Overall, the store was clean, staff was friendly and soft serve tasted great!

Not my most favorite place, specifically because it's just too many people for me. Hard to move and even enjoy the outside area and games, which I really would've liked to.

Difficult to get a drink at the bar and the bartender was actually rude to me. 

Unfortunately not a great experience and I may not return

We waited to be sat and granted service was great and the waiters were so nice, but I ordered
Risotto and it looked looked like white rice and I'm pretty sure it was that. I was so disappointed that I didn't get real risotto. I'm still going to go back, but wish they served what they advertised

I'm astound with this beautiful imitation fireplace and flat screen TV. It makes fast food dining more enjoyable. What a great concept!  The chili was good and is my daughter's favorite. Not bad for a fast food restaurant. Getting better,  thank you Wendy's!

Food is absolutely incredible. The fresh pineapple and pork belly tacos are always my go to. It's hard to beat the atmosphere of Hyde park. The only reason I give it 4 instead of 5 is due to the service being somewhat slow at times. Other than that I definitely recommend.

Terrible customer service!!
Irresponsible and rude staff 
None of the hotel's features matter when the hotel screws up your reservation 2 days before your trip from across the country
Oh and everything is non-refundable, once you hit that button say goodbye to $ 2000
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I don't know what changed over the past 4 weeks but I've been ordering from to go orders for the past year and somehow almost every morning we come in they no longer have cold brew left and our drink isn't ready when we stop by to pick it up. Please change something. We place our order 10-15min in advance.

I'm so in love with this place. For so many reasons. Support local!! I prefer the green versus black tea options.. not sure why, I think the water may be too hot on the black tea for some reason? Regardless, just personal preference. Music is always awesome and friendly girls who work there.

Not very good sushi. Came in wanting to give this place a try but the service was very slow and the sushi was extremely bland. Couldn't taste anything but the sauce. Had to stop eating because it wasn't worth stuffing myself on the almost tasteless sushi. After the meal I can say that I would not go back.

We ordered take out /delivery, it took close to an hour. The order was wrong. I ordered soup instead of egg with lunch combo. No hot mustard or sweet and sour sauce as requested with order. Its all most as though they didn't look at the order that was place online. Never again!

There aren't many choices for quick breakfast places in this area. So I come here. They frequently let me down. Donuts are stale. Or they done have what you want. So much that they need to just start by telling you what they DO have. Make sure you get your receipt as they also seem to forgot to prepare things you've ordered.

This hotel reminds me of a nicer Motel 6. The rooms have paper thin walls. You can hear your neighbors clearly. Also, I wasn't to fond of the sliding bathroom frosted door that had no lock. I found an empty chip bag behind the TV which worries me. If they miss something that can easily be found what about the rest of the room.....
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I order from them regularly and so far not disappointed in my selections. Have tried several menu items but stick to what you know and like best. Don't try to be too adventurous with this one. Food is fast and they are friendly when you walk in or call. Best advise is to go with the combos if you are not sure.

Ramen extra spicy tonkutsu broth was pretty good, but it comes with a hard boiled (not soft boiled) half egg and the cut of pork is so that it falls apart easily--but not because of tenderness. Also the pork belly yakitori is dry, cold, not tender, no fat (I mean we order pork belly for a reason...)

Came here just for an overnight stay. So here is my list of pros and cons:

Pros
*nice size room
*very large fitness center with a ton of cardio equipment and weights
*nice size pool
*nice lobby area

Cons
*missing toiletries on arrival
*front desk lost my reservation
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Came here for a couple of afternoon beers while listening to some local Jazz.  You really can't go wrong with free Jazz while boozing it up.  Drinks were nice and cheap and the music was just the cherry on top.  

Will come back when in New Orleans.  Enjoy!

My sis Shirley had us meet here for lunch. It was farther than I expected but worth it!! Our meal was delicious. Sushi rice was some of the best I've ever had. The fish was fresh and overall I loved it, even the cute atmosphere! Next time I'm in town I WILL be back.

We will give them another chance but out of 8 of us that ate there no one left satisfied. My fettuccine was not cooked and the sauce was awful. I hoped that they would have also changed it up a little more than the last 4 restaurants that were in that space

Vetture's is THE best in town!!  Not only is the food authentic and amazing, the owners and staff are so wonderful! I wish I could give more 5 stars! You really must go!!  Let them make you one of their specialty pizzas or sandwiches, you will not be disappointed!

One of the most stuck up places I've been too. Not very friendly. Sushi is different and offers unique flavors. So, it was great to try different types of unusual sushi. However, considering this is an upscale restaurant, I wasn't particularly a fan of it.

Decent bacon wrapped jalapenos. Good decor. I liked the large couch to sit on and eat as well as the games to play on the patio with a fireplace (over sized jenga, over sized connect 4 & corn hole). Also no smoking until after 10 on the patio was a nice touch.

It is a great location for any conventions. Love walking downstairs to Starbucks. My biggest problem is probably the room / hallway carpets so gross. I think somebody much have tracked gum throughout our room and hallway. If you walk in our room it is sticky......
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Terrible experience. The staff there was friendly however the car wash I received was terrible!!! They didn't get all of the dirt off of my exterior.. and the interior they BARELY touched.. there was still dirt and dust on the center console and the floor mats it was barely any better. Not worth $12.. and that's pretty bad!

SCAM This company tried to swindle and SCAM my elderly parents. They not only took money out of their checking accounts BUT they continued to charge them MONTHLY. I have reported them to the Better Business Bureau and this company also uses different phone numbers and alternate addresses. WATCH OUT for these WICKED THIEVES !

Amazing service! I love the casso Fundido with chorizo and sangrias! The servers work hard and every answer is "ABSOLUTELY!" Great little relaxing atmosphere can sometimes get a bit rowdy loud when oyster shots kick in at larger grouped tables but loud happy is a lovely sound. Been dining here 3 years and thrilled to support local!

Do NOT stop at this Dunkin. Today was the final straw, sat at the drive thru for twenty minutes just to say that I had a mobile order. No one answered so we drove around to the front. No one was there and the drive thru window was wide open. Tried calling like 10 minutes without any answer.

They have a very solid beer selection here touting several microbrews and specialty cocktails, a big plus for this "middle of nowhere" bar and restaurant.  Many of the visitors to Nockamixon State Park should find this appealing if they stop in for a cocktail.

Amazing coffee and roaster! My wife and I visited here and I got a cap and she got a mocha. They tasted great! We also got a croissant cinnamon roll and it tasted amazing!

A must-go if your in the city!! 

The staff was super nice!!

Also pick up a bag of beans while you are there! You will not be sorry!!

Honestly, the place is a good 'dive' for regulars to go to and be with friends. I honestly thought the place was dirty and a bit raunchy. It smelled of bugs.

They do have TVs ALL over the place on different channels for news, sports, TV shows. 

They have a good selection of liquor and have the basics. Not bad over-all.

Pepperoni pizza is SO DELICIOUS!! Highly recommend that over the many other things we tried on the menu that were just ok & expensive. We also found the owner off putting. Why have a pizza counter people can sit at if you act annoyed with questions about making pizza (and  don't engage with the customers?) Strange.

This hotel may have been nice when it was originally built, but despite some granite countertops in the suites, it needs major attention. Fixtures are very dated, and carpets and walls need replacing. There seems to be a lack of care. I wouldn't stay here again and would recommend friends look elsewhere.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I arrived at a nearby hotel after their restaurant closed for the evening. They pointed me towards Roy's. Very rarely am I overwhelmed, but Roy's exceed all expectations. Friendly and attentive staff and the best filet I've eaten in a very long time. Thank you.

The hotel pleasantly surprised us upon arrival.  Though it didn't seem as welcoming from the outside the hotel was very nice.  All the amenities were in good condition and so were the rooms.

Overall, if you are looking for a good overnight or weekend stay somewhere for a descent price, look no further.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Very accommodating and nice customer service. Everything was as good as could be expected considering I only need a car because mine had broken down and been towed from downtown St. Pete, so my mood wasn't good.
Called to make sure everything was okay and we were happy. Have us a ride back to the dealership afterwards.

Love this place!!! A friend took me before I even moved to Nashville & it's now my go to place since moving not too far away. The food is delicious, the drinks are great (a few places nearby have syrup filled margs), the service is always fantastic, & the patio is perfect. Thanks for being so awesome Los Tres Amigos! :)

Last night in Nashville!!!! Enjoyed an incredible dining experience at The Catbird. What a treat!!! It was a 15 course meal that was more than just dinner.... It was an experience!!! The atmosphere, the creativity, the good food, good friends, and the chef interaction just made the whole 3 hour dining incredible!!

They did such a good job, thank you! We randomly just popped in here for a hair cut at the last minute and I think it's our new go-to. I don't remember his name but I think it started with an "A" :) I only paid $12 before tip for his cut which was more than reasonable

Worst customer service, ever. I get a rude cashier every time I do a carry out order. Currently, "Blondie" is the rudest cashier there. I don't know her name (she doesn't wear a name tag), but it seems as though her failed attempt of being a trophy wife has put her in an incessantly bitter mood.

The special line for the unlimited pass is always having mechanical problems. The whole point of that line is so that it can get the customers in and out. Absolutely pointless when it doesn't work. Why am I waiting 5 to 10 minutes to get my car washed? Looking forward to the grand opening of the new one in Speedway.

I used to frequent El Azteca for luch regularly but not anymore. Something here has changed since late 2009 or early 2010 and the red sauce is simply bland marinara, even the dip for the torilla chips
has less flavor. The last two times the red sauce doesn't have a spice to it so it doesn't qualify as Mexican to me anymore.

Went thru 2 times car still dirty, a whole 1 minute and 21 seconds is how long u get going thru the wash! A total rip off! They had us like sardines bumper to bumper! They give u a quick spray on driver's side and u start rolling in the wash! This is a total RIP off!!!!! And they are making tons of money on people no thanks!

Tried Rocco's for the first time last night with a Rocco regular - had the Buffalo Chicken Stromboli and it was everything I wanted it to be. Their deck oven turns the crust a perfect dark gold. The crust is delicious and has a killer crust. Also had a good chicken steak & cheesesteak. Stromboli though was A+, give it a run.

Front Desk assured us of no construction noise, that's all we heard all day. Called down to front desk and the noise never stopped. Elevator noise also, so request a room far away from them.  Better yet if you want a place to get some sleep and rest. Go elsewhere.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Employee named Jamie is absolutely rude and racist. She verbally attached an unsuspecting girl without cause and should be reprimanded accordingly. Absolutely disgusting that a girl is ruining the reputation of a great local establishment due to her own close minded, uneducated views.

Very pleased with a pair of pants that we got hemmed!! My wife bought an expensive pair of jeans and was afraid that they would get ruined, we were skeptical since we haven't  used a cleaners since moving to Tennessee. Her pants looked great she was very pleased!! They are a little pricey but other than that no complaints!!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: So I happen to love chicken livers. Villa Di Roma has Chicken liver Romano on their menu - it is wonderful. Add a dish of broccoli rabe(perfectly cooked) to help soak up the butter - garlic - amazing sauce.  An inexpensive bottle of Ruffino Chianti made for the perfect meal!. Service was super friendly and excellent!

Absolutely my favourite sushi place on this side of the Rockies. I fell in love with the bagel roll and am actually placing an order for it as I type. The pink geisha cocktail is a must have. I actually moved to this area mainly because it was close to this great restaurant (and the park).

In town for a conference and at the recommendation of a friend came here for dinner. Food is fresh. Service was attentive and knowledgeable.  Atmosphere is laid back. They didn't have any avocados for my salad but other than that I didn't have any complaints.

Went in for a quick lunch and had a wonderful time. We only had about 40 min. We didn't realize it was restaurant week and took advantage of their $20 preset menu. The mushroom and cheese balls were AMAZING. Overall, for a small tiny spot, it was delicious!

The service was so wonderful. Everyone at the counter is pleasant and happy to assist you. I had my reservation set and the car was already in the parking spot waiting for me to pick it. The employees offered me directions and ask if I needed any help getting to my vehicle. Such great service.

Rudest staff I've ever encountered.  I wouldn't give this place another dime.  Liquor stores are a dime a dozen.  If I were you, I'd spend my money elsewhere.  If you do decide to stop in here, I definitely wouldn't do around 5:00 on a Saturday.  (Especially on January 16, 2016 ... hint, hint)

Love this place. It's our go to sushi joint. Sometimes we come weekly other times biweekly. 
Not a huge diversity of food and roll options. But what they do they do well and portions are above average. Consistency is key here. Same great tasting food every time.

Vivace was my favorite restaurant in the past. It seems like it's become ordinary and uneventful. The food quality was very mediocre at best. I've did give it a few tries with thoughts that it was an off night..

I think Danny needs to walk back into the kitchen he's an amazing chef...

The food is ok. The prices have gone up quite a bit over the years and the portions have gotten much smaller. The lady owner is very rude. I have taken it a few times. But now I am over it and will not eat there again. I tell everyone I know to avoid this place.

Waited up front for 15 mins to do massage/body enhancement/ hydromasssge . The guy who was supposed to be up front was hanging out in the back. I only got to do body enhancment and didnt want to wait another who knows how long for him
To come back up front. I got annoyed and left
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Fabulous for sushi but pathetic drinks and you could get better Mexican food in a toilet in Tijuana.  Going here to eat anything but sushi may be the biggest mistake you make in a lifetime. Yes, I know this is a harsh review but it's totally accurate.  Wish there was a choice for ZERO stars.

Nice little spot.  More like a hole in the wall... dj was more old school.  Played good music.  Drinks are good. Nice and strong. They sell food in the back.  More of a local city goer spot.  If you want a tourist location this isn't it.  Try it of you want something different. This place is heels friendly.

I never sat down and ate but I got to go a few times.  I always try something new hoping it would taste better than the last thing I've gotten but that's never the case. The food is eh it's not great but it isn't the worst only thing that is worth going there is the fried ice cream

Placed a $31 order in the subway app for this store. When I got to the store it was closed. Asked the guy inside what to do for a refund he said to call customer service. Guess what? There's no customer service for the app and they don't respond on Twitter.  Avoid this store and the app like the plague.

At first I thought it was gonna be shady because there is a trailor park beside it and a old run down fireworks store. But it in a good locate close to lots not too far to down town. Room was clean nice and if you need any amenities you just had to ask the front desk.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Fantastic property. The perfect place for a remote retreat! Great hiking trails, delicious food options. It's nice that you don't really need to leave the resort if you don't want to. They have everything you could possibly need. Customer service was top notch!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I'm from Chicago and was here on business so I am used to really good sushi. This place was alright. They had a ton of options and everything was presented very clearly but it was just ok. It was pretty empty even though there was a HUGE convention in town. I'd try some other places before going back.

The Gospel Coalition Women's Conference rolled into town, and this shop opened on the weekend just for the ladies in dire need of Jesus and a cup of coffee. Cute little shop to stop by for your morning coffee with Kari Jobe jammin' out on the stereo. Awesome! Great coffee, and amazing spirits. Thanks for the caffeine boost!

Joann was my tech for my fill. She is very quiet but such a great employee. She made sure I was satisfied with my nails. She was very concentrated and although she was quite she has great customer service skills. I def will be back when I'm in town again !!! Thanks Joann

Great local feel esp vs State St. Good service- everyone is really nice.  My fiancée and I were just disappointed that when we got there they ran out of both uni and anago and red snapper. That being said, fish slices are extremely generous compared to anything I have ever seen. Definitely worth a stop. Prices are very reasonable.

Friday night is not the night to dine here if you are looking for a quiet intimate setting. This was by far the noisiest restaurant I've ever eaten at. The food was so so. The service was fair. I was very surprised to be charged $10 for a bottle of Pelogrino mineral water.

I mean one giant slice of NY pepperoni pie and a pint of beer for $5.25....killing it!! Yes you have to drive through a little ghetto but come on y'all this is New Orleans...get used to it lol. Great place! And the girl who took my order is named Taj also!! A RARE meeting! Ha!

This place is amazing, and the ever changing, and inventive flavour creations mean that no two visits will be the same.

The only way this place could get any better, is they offer some stick-less versions of their deliciousness, if for no other reason than samples.

If there was a zero star rating I would give it --the absolute worse bar in all of New Orleans-- the bar is known for one thing its barber chair shot- but the girl doing it the night we came said it was too cold and made me and my entire group feel like we wasted our money-- if drinks were free i'd never set foot in there again

Everything was perfect from the customer service to the flavors in the pizza. Such unique options as well! They have FLAMING pizza where the whole pie is set on fire. The owner is genuinely passionate about making pizza! I highly recommend giving this place a shot. It's the newest pizza place around

It's a great local chain. Food is good and they have a great selection. Be cautious placing phone orders as they seem to get it wrong 50% of the time. Not sure if it's the system they use as my order has been read back to me fine, but what I get in the bag is different.

Ordered at 1 am, delivery was so fast, deliver guy and person I talked to on the phone were both very nice. I ordered a buffalo and cheese lovers pizza and they were amazing! Never knew about this place until last night, but I will definitely order from them again!

The coolest thing is a beer vending machine,  sadly it doesn't work.  The beds are a little hard and the airplanes a little noise especially at 6 in the morning but it is at the end of an airport so what  did I expect.  The staff has been very friendly and helpful.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This hotel is in a great location but it is very old and the rooms are very plain. I would not recommend this hotel for a long stay. 

Pros:
Great location 
Polite staff
Large suite area

Cons:
Rooms need to be renovated
Beds are old 
Very dusty
Carpet old
** Overpriced. $490 room rate in August. $560 after taxes and fees.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: From a well traveled hotel junkie due to work , I have to say this is the most awesomeist hotel I've ever stayed at.I've hit all the notable brands up and this place takes the cake.Breakfast is 5 stars. Gym is 5 stars.Rooms are 5 stars. Customer service is 5 stars.Rooms are 5 stars !!! Just stay here .... You'll thank me later :)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Not bad...but not good. If you're looking for delicious pizza, this prob isn't your place. If you need something quick, this is a decent options. Wings had more sauce in the takeout container than on the actual wings. Pizza was pizza...not overly flavorful but I ate it.

I live in NY and the restaurants around Chinatown are usually pretty crappy.

This spot deserves better than 3.5 stars for being in Nashville. You just need to know what to order.

Ginger and scallion lobster
Sautéed snow pea leaves
Crispy tofu 

Are all pretty good

What a wonderful surprise in the edge of the Warehouse District near the French Quarter! No on-trend design details were overlooked in the recent renovation. Really clean room- nice hotel and bar staff- super comfortable bed- delicious food and drinks in the bar/restaurant!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great service... Our hostess was the best part of the visit. An extra star for the quality of fish and seafood here but the food was very poor in Flavors n texture!  All I could taste was rice from sushi to hand rolls which masked the beautiful seafood. And it wasn't cheap by any means.

Really no hot coffee available at 8:30pm !!! What a joke! I thought this is a coffee place. Was told only iced coffee available, what? Working nights looking forward to coffee only to see this joke of a place! Usually I like to give good reviews, hard to do if they don't sell any product.

It's inside a convenient store (like at a lot of other train stations) so may have more limited options but otherwise I've never had a problem here- didn't find the quality to be any different than a standard Dunkin. They are fast which is most important when you are trying to catch that train!

Surprisingly enjoyed my meal there the other night. I was told that it was a "pricey" place to eat; however, my friend and I felt the prices were on par with other local restaurants. My serving size was perfect and services was very attentive. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone.

I'm so glad I decided to start bringing my cat Tuna here.  Every single vet and vet tech has been nothing but kind, professional, and extremely knowledgeable. Special thanks to Dr. Zemanian and Dr. Howell. I truly believe that Art City Vets cares about your pet!

This is my first experience here. The pizza is incredible. The crust is nice and fluffy and the pizza has the perfect amount of grease. For $3 I would have liked the pizza by the slice to be a little bigger but the flavoring was next level. The flop factor was there.

Awesome service, awesome people. I brought my pants in for a one day cleaning and they did it no problem and also fixed the cuffs at the bottom that were coming undone. Also thoughtful about the crease/pleate in the middle. Very good service. I will be back!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: If I could give this place zero stars I would. I would never order to go from this place again. Made that mistake 1 too many times. Which is so sad because all the other El Magueys are so amazing. This place could be dead and their servers would still be moving slower then ever.

Donuts are great. I think reviewers need to cut the staff some slack. I don't think things beyond their control should be blamed on staff. The staff, mainly young and stressed out high school or college students, don't deserve all the rudeness and attitude you feed them. Many of the, are trying their best. Just saying...

Great food and service!  I'm used to Manhattan reataurants, so I have a pretty high bar, and this place exceeds all expectations!  Stopped in for a random lunch while on the road and the cuisine could not have been more to my liking... And the prices were fantastic.  Please please open one in NYC!!!

Probably my favorite pizza joint. Just as good as mellow mushroom or red elephant. The deep dish style pizza is to die for and the strawberry walnut salad is the best ive ever had anywhere. If your in plant city its a place you must stop by and have lunch at.

Food was great! Buuuuut the entertainment was ehhhh. I give it to anyone who performs live but the singers were very out of tune and sounded like they they had a rough night before. We ended up leaving as soon as possible. 
Overall the food was great. The service was great as well.

The hotel is really nice but a little bit to big for me. The staff was really nice. The food was just OKAY. Nothing to write home about even though they raised the buffet prices for the convacation all week. I might go visit again since the staff was really nice. You might try it when there is nothing going on downtown.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The service was great and all fo the staff is very friendly. 
Food was also on point. We had the beef shin 4lb for 4 people and it was a lot of food. We also got the octopus (it was just okay) beef chips (really good) and charred broccoli for side (highly recommend it)
Beat drink was prob the best drink there.

I  was actually very pleased with how fast the service was! I got my frames with the rx same day. They said it could take up to an hr only took less then 20 minutes ! Can't beat it ! The promotions are what they say no false advertisement or hidden fees getting my new prescription was smooth and very comfortable
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Reuben pizza little topping and what makes me very angry, if you tip the waiter on a credit card,  the whole house splits the tip. So the waiter gets little of it. That's ludicrous. Never to return. $32 for a medium pizza,  small salad,  2 drinks and mini cheesesticks.

Best bar food in st louis... Buffalo sauce has a ton of flavor, pork belly tacos are addicting... Full bar, lots of tvs, really good casual ambiance... Sometimes service can be really slow.. On busy nights they need more staff but once you can actually order both food and drinks come out quick...they have really good deals too

This place has the best New York style pizza. Also the philly cheese steaks are great. The chicken wings are good but seem expensive for what you get. I ordered delivery on a Thursday night and it came quickly. This is a place that I'm going to keep ordering from.

Such an amazing and unique Italian dining experience. I'm generally not a huge fan of Italian restaurants, but this one was truly outstanding.

I had the lobster Mac & Cheese and the other person in my party had the spaghetti & meatballs. Both dishes were incredible and the service was excellent.

Would come back here!

What's not to like here.... Other than rude staff, longest wait times of any fast food restaurant I've ever been in, and their refusal to get even the simplest orders right? I ordered a black iced coffee today and what I got was iced milk that was slightly discolored by a teaspoon of coffee.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This was a very professional, clean and fun Hitel to stay at for 4 days. They have a great breakfast buffet and free happy hour. All he staff smiled and greater you. It also had a nice friendly, southern like vibe in the lobby. I am staying here next time in the area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I remember this being a better place to eat initially. Now I recommend the all you can eat chicken strips and not a lot else. The service is ok and it's an affordable place to eat. We tried the shrimp-do not recommend, it was over breaded and the cocktail sauce tasted off.

Stayed here recently... 

Cons:
Loud neighbors during weekdays and thin walls
ROACHES ... and this was on a high floor
Annoying shoe shine guy who pesters you every minute
Mediocre food and high priced bar 

Pros:
Nice front desk staff
Easy access to nearby areas
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Waiting in line for 30+ min, no kiosks active, I'm a gold member and they have staff not working at the gold reception desk but aren't inviting people to be helped (and refused to help me because I didn't book it with my gold #,) all the while late for an interview. Good times ;) never again.

The pizza is delicious especially when it's fresh, but when I bit into my Kennett Square slice, I found myself chewing on a strange piece of plastic. I had my boyfriend contact the store in which they compensated us. We will still support, but I need them to be more mindful and careful while preparing the food.

Nice hotel and property. A bit dated but not bad.  Very good staff and service.  It got low scores for the parking. $28 per night for hotel guests is robbery and there are no alternatives in the area.  That's the price of a rental car!  $13 a day for wifi in the room, ridiculous.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I regularly order their veggie burrito or quesadilla when I get a craving for good quick mexican food, and while both have hit the spot (in terms of flavor and portion size), my only complaint is what constitutes "veggies". I've learned my lesson though and now ask what their veggies are for the day or simply, "no celery!"

Most economical place to have a decent beer in IV. Once you have two jars its easy to give in and buy a slice of slightly overpriced pizza. Great place to hang out with friends and watch sports although it is often difficult to find seating once dinner hits on weekends.

I came in for 1 new tire.  I have now been sitting here for an hour and 15 minutes and they still haven't even taken my car back yet.   Another girl checked in her car for an oil change at the same time I did and her car isn't ready yet.. that means it's taken her just as long to get an oil change.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
We showed up in New Castle looking for a place to eat and since my daughter and I enjoy pizza, we made a pizza tour stop.  We ordered 2 pizza's, one all cheese and the other hamburger aka meatball, pepperoni and tomato. 

The sauce was okay but the pizza itself was just so so. The ranch dressing on the other hand was really good.

Walked in around three in the afternoon on a Saturday. The waitress was extremely friendly and the restaurant was very clean. The miso soup and salad was very tasty, and the sushi was promptly served shortly after. The presentation was enjoyable, the food delicious, and the bill cheap.

Very familiar with the restaurant, but Sadie made the difference tonight with her exceptional service. She stopped what she was doing to take care of me despite being busy with her own tables. Most other people would have ignored me being where I was sitting was not her area.  Papa Vitos, u need more employees like her

Nick is a great banker... Showed me more options of beneficial bank products in one day than my previous bank showed me in years... also got me refinanced at a unbelievably low 1.99% and got me approved for a credit card with the lowest rate in my wallet... Only complaint I have is that I didn't leave US Bank sooner lol..

I love the food but the hostess is very rude. She assumed because I spoke English that I didn't speak Spanish. Was very rude and hostile hung the phone up on me not once but twice, on two different occasions. I will never order form them ever again. I pray they fix this issue.

I'll keep it short as it is consistent with others.  Elevators are slooowwwww.  Breakfast is a cluster, although if you are like me and just want coffee and oatmeal it is fine.  Rooms are big and comfortable. The staff is friendly and is a good central location and a Phlash stop is right outside the door.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I love hanas sushi with a passion. They seriously have the best sushi in new orleans hands down but the customer service is horrible.  You start your meal off with a delicious noodle salad float to some amazing sushi and in between have to deal with a waitress who acts like your in her way. Fix please for 5 stars.

Looks nice but not great equipment. Too crowded during prime hours. Dumbbells only go to 90lbs. Has staffing issues. Waited over 30 min to get registered. $100+ for a membership. $25 for a day pass. But to end on a positive note- beautiful clean gym and good location.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I am always coming back to this place. Amazingly delicious and unique pizza joint. Spices and ingredients always taste so fresh and the pizza is always cooked to perfection. Employees are always friendly and I love contributing to local businesses.  Give it a try you won't regret it.

I'm normally on time for all my eye appointments but I recently moved so I had a hard time getting here. But despite the fact of me being 15 minutes late the staff still took extra care of me and helped me with choosing my contacts as well as some really cool Gucci frames!
I Love Eye Encounters!  P.S. I'll be on time next time lol
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I wish I could review the food, but we left after a 20 minute wait to even be offered a drink, and the woman working helping several people that picked up orders, as well as answering two calls as she was taking our order and cutting us off to answer the call. So rude :(

I had a wonderful dinner of chicken with goat cheese and prosciutto.
It was served with veggies, they were done perfectly. Hubby had the veal special and it too was the best,. If you are ever in St Pete and are looking for a great Italian food place, look no farther! We will be back!!!!!

My husband and I were starving after a long search at McKay Books. This place is right around the corner and the chips and salsa were calling our name. It did not disappoint! The waiter was very nice and attentive, and the food was exactly what we were wanting!

Never have I had an issue with this Starbucks the only reason they are getting 3 stars and not 5 is because I ordered on the app so it would be "quicker" I could have came in and ordered normally and gotten my food quicker, there are so many mobile orders sitting here as I type and mine is still not done very upset about this.

The food here is good. But I can't give a great review to any restaurant that is packaging their food in styrofoam and plastic.  

We had been to a Nico's elsewhere and the burritos were wrapped in foil and paper.  Here we got plastic and styrofoam.  Meanwhile, the ocean is flooded with plastic, just like the earth.

Nope.

Clean, comfortable, great location. No issues with our room and the concierge was helpful in recommending area restaurants. Breakfast buffet offered various options and the attendant was quite helpful. We would definitely return when passing thru Nashville again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Please please please check your order. They will do everything to make sure to miss your order. I've order food here just to go home and have half my order missing. I expect to have competence people handling my food. I expected too much. Please hired people with somewhat training. I shoulda when to Chick fila.

Unacceptable. Pictures show after the second attempt at the gel manicure. Polish was all over my skin and she said she messed it up and would do it over. I didn't even notice my toes until I got home but there was polish all over my toes. The lady was nice enough but this is totally unacceptable especially after a second try!!!

Free breakfast. Big suite room. Nothing special about the hotel itself. Parking is confusing (1st arrival - then you get the hang of it) and expensive.

The location is great for vacationers. Its in the heart of downtown Philadelphia. Few walking blocks away from the Love sign, city hall, Chinatown, etc.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Clothes got stuck and delayed my day. Then I sat down to a confused roach crawling in circles on the floor and washers. Now, I will be itchy all day. Who's to blame? I'm just irritated now. Nothing personal to the nice guy on duty who helped with my refund.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I love the food and atmosphere here a lot! My only complaint (which isn't really the restaurants fault) is the parking can be a little tough. It's in a strip mall with a lot of stores, and small narrow spaces to park. But seriously other than that - Food is great and totally worth it!

This restaurant is a little crowded. Not much in the way of atmosphere. The food was mediocre. Our waiter was arrogant and disinterested. He talked me out of ordering what I wanted and I ended up with bland pasta. Appetizer antipasto platter was good. Cheesecake was crumbly and lacked flavor. Would not go back.

Beautiful, but small, interior room, no windows.  I was fine with that, as I wanted total peace and quiet.  Cold AC, comfortable bed.  Really great location, especially for the price.  Will stay again for sure.  Has been completely remodeled.  3 blocks from Bourbon St.  Beautiful courtyard and retains all the charm.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The portions are great and everything I've had so far has tasted great. Sadly every time I order for delivery, I always get some guy named "Manoli" who is rude, gets annoyed when I ask questions which is inevitable you can barely understand him. Won't order delivery anymore.

A smoky dive bar just a few blocks off Broadway, down near the river. A bit of a seedy neighborhood but we had no problem walking there. Pool, Foosball, Darts, Golden Tee, and great tunes flowing out of the sound system. Good beer cheap with friendly bartenders.

Small but nice.   Perfect for readjusting after the long flight.   One night, no more.   Good for singles and couples but not kids. The rooms are too small and the bathroom is teeny, tiny.  Not enough outlets for the modern world.   More lamps with chargers are desperately needed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I've never been to a subway that gives so little meat on their sandwiches. There were 4 bit sized pieces of chicken on my sandwich. Also, I asked for salt and pepper and the lady put whole peppercorns on the sandwich instead of grinding the peppercorns. Worst subway experience ever.

I guess if you are 21 and only want to get wasted ass drunk and pass out in the street. Then ok. Hand granades are disgusting. Seriously gross. I tried it because I fell into the trap. Just don't. They are awful. I prefer tasty drinks and craft beer not sugar water with ever clear. Lol.

Brought my Yukon in for a clanking noise which I thought was the brakes. After a quick drive they found it was my U-joint. They also found I needed a new belt. They had the car fixed and ready within just a few hours including an oil change I threw in. Thanks for the quick accurate service. 4 1/2 stars.

This place is the worst! Took two hours to get the food, when it finally came the order was wrong and the food was cold. To make it even worse! When I went to the sub shop it was FILLED WITH ROACHES. Please save yourself the headache and stomach problems and avoid this TERRIBLE place.

These people are amazing we lived here for a year and never had any problems! The maintence crew is the best I have ever seen every problem we had was addressed and fixed either the day of or the next day. The ladies in the office are great as well. If I hadn't bought a house I would still be living here!

Dude upstairs threatened to kick my buddy out cause he didn't tip fast enough. He kicked him out. I said that was a dick move he was waiting for change. He kicked me out to. He threatened to push me down stairs and I only have one leg. Crappiest bar on river street.

Keep hoping this place will hold up to the reviews but I don't think I will be going back anytime soon.  Chicken dishes really tasted more like rubber than food. Sauces were overloaded and in general pretty gross.

Best bet is to stick with fried rice or something without meat.

Cable was out my entire weekend and the bottom floor had sheer window drapes. I don't lotion or get dressed in a bathroom so it was what it was. I figured if people complained about my body walking around naked they should have supplied their bottom floor patrons with curtains that close not just ones for show.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Nice Place. Comfortable, clean, very close to the fun part of town. Economical. Breakfast served and with eggs and meat (protein is good). Wifi connected easily and fast. Good design with a nice common balcony we could eat our breakfast on. Really did all the things right for a basic hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This hotel was priced right compared to others. But the rooms were small and simple. The worst noises occurred starting early in the morning. Cars, trash trucks,  voices, babies, water running, vacuuming. It was the worst experience I would never stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My burrito literally fell apart after one bite. The tortilla was partially stale like the bag had been left open over night. Carne Asada had no flavor and the cheese wasn't melted at all. I'm continuing my search for the good Mexican food in Reno cause this ain't it...

Not many flavor choices and in my opinion weird flavors so I didn't get any.  My boyfriend got the Toasted Coconut and I tried it.  It was very sweet.  The best part was the waffle cone piece they stick in the ice cream.  There's too many good ice cream shops out there.  Save yourself....

Ice cream always great! The young blonde who worked 4/8/19 @7:20pm was very rude, no customer service skills. We go here a lot and usually the girls are very nice. If you don't like the public you shouldn't work it in. Go work in a warehouse. The brunette was very nice and helpful. Ice cream was great though.

I go to this Dunkin' sometimes two times per day. No matter if it's morning or night my coffee is always what I order!, which may seem weird but if you traveled just down delsea to the one in glassboro you'll know what I'm talking about. The staff here is always friendly and they know their regular customer's orders by heart.

The dude at the front desk was a pro. I travel a lot and nothing grinds my gears more than an incompetent person, taking 25 minutes to check me in. He had my keys ready to go, everything was done and signed in 6 minutes tops. The hotel is a dumbed down Hampton. But that's all best western pluses. Safe travels.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The room smelt of old cigarette smoke even though it's all non smoking. The water out of the shower barely makes it out of the shower head. You can hear everything that is going on above you, next to you and outside.

The only positive I can see is that it was somewhat cheap. I will not be staying here again
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Absolutely terrible. Employees stood around and watched an a line of people waiting for their order to be taken grow. No sense of urgency. Stood in line for 15 minutes, then when it was brought up that we waited they argued with us about it. One said she "didn't want to go to jail today" and walked off. Nasty bathrooms.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: :( Had better pizza from Publix. Chicken was still cold inside. No wonder it took them 10 mins to make it from scratch. Also got a Greek salad and was gross. Like something out of a premise Walmart salad isle. No wonder they were empty on a Saturday night in this area.

Umi!! Where do I begin! This little gem is located Somerdale NJ & has the absolute best sushi in Jersey. The sushi is always fresh and the staff are always helpful! The plum wine is also great! You won't be disappointed

Favs- The Latino roll and spicy tuna roll. Amazing!

Crazy. It's the place for 3 for 1 beers! Even imported! I like that during their happy hour, it's been a tradition for many years. They book in great rock bands too, someone is always having a jam on stage. Great hangout, some dancing. Terrific for people watching and a good spot to meet up at to begin your evening out.

Just had dinner. Two basic meals and an appetizer, no drinks or dessert - with tip $70.  I ordered Piccata. Got parm.  Didn't ask her to take it back ... since we waited a while for what we got.  Nice no hurry sit down meal.  Quantities are huge so it's really 4 meals!

Fruity flavors?? I asked for regular dark roasted.  Sorry, don't have that.  Regular drip takes 3-4 minutes.  Plus a double shot of espresso. It was cold and weak? 12 oz cup for $6.00 ?  Not happy with this experience. That was 1st and last time for this place. Sorry Sump, didn't have time to elaborate in person.

I am just about to give up on this place. They have good donuts, but they don't make enough of them I've gone in there about eight times and twice they have what I want. You don't make enough old-fashioned Maple donuts I'll probably try one more time then I'm going to give up forever.

I went here last night with my husband. The service was quick even though they were busy. We made it in time for happy hour which is a great value! I ordered the salmon sashimi, the first order was alright, but the second order was great! This place is worth a try.

This is our go to place when we know we want a great meal. Never had a bad experience at Rbeach. Asked to see the kitchen and the owner didn't hesitate to give us a tour. You know your going to get great food when the owner is proud to give you a tour of the kitchen.

Wish I had read the other reviews before going here.  The waitress and hostess were very unfriendly.  The food was lackluster.  The ginger dressing was very odd... it tasted like tomato and tobasco sauce.  It was our anniversary dinner and I regret spending it at this place.

I love working out here the trainer is amazing and pushes you to be the best!!!!.

With that being said the front desk people stand around and talk non stop. The tanning beds are NEVER CLEANED. This is the nastiest place I have EVER SEEN when it comes to keeping the bathrooms and tanning areas clean!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: We love fletcher's. It is consistently good every time we go. Favorites include cod basket, chicken tenders, steak special and house salad dressing to name a few! We ordered carry ours a lot during the quarantine, glad to be able to eat in person socially distanced

Great customer service! The lady at the bar was more than helpful and patient. We had a few drinks prior to coming in and she was more than accommodating to our shenanigans. She introduced new drinks, food, and desert options to us and was fantastic at it.

My girlfriend and I order out often. Tonight the girl working takeout (didn't get her name) was a total gem. I forgot to mention on the phone that my girlfriend can't have cheese on her veggie wrap. We had to come back and she took care of us without question, even though it was my fault. Food was great! She deserves a raise!

I have good & bad news.  The GOOD news is that the food was absolutely delicious.  The BAD news is that our overall experience was only 3 stars.  We arrived at a non-busy time (2:00pm) for a late lunch, we were seated quickly but it took FOR-E-VER (45 min) for our food to arrive and it wasn't even a difficult order.

I got my blazer "dry cleaned" and it came back with stains on the inner lining, and it clearly wasn't cleaned because the pits still reek. DO NOT GO TO THIS CLEANING SERVICE. Charged me $15 to make my blazer worse. Going to get it cleaned again somewhere else.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: The woman is so nice, I've had her hem women's double layered silky dressy pants, repair some tears, she did a fabulous job, the pants were perfect, the mending was perfect, she does it quickly at a very reasonable price. She's my go to for alterations and mending.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Veterans Day such an American day and Dunkin' Donuts claim to be American. One donut for the first time ever. I went to Krispy Kreme I got welcome salute and a coffee with two donuts. Why people go to the stinky Dunkin let's boycott the un American business for ever

The 1st experience we had with Club Car wash, Resulted in us losing our back windshield wiper.   It is currently been 2 months And we still do not have it replaced.  We have reached out multiple times to try and get this resolved.   I am completely unsatisfied with their customer service and their management!

We had a nice evening at the Landing. Due to Covid the menu is online and must be viewed on your phone. The menu currently was a little limited when it came to entrees. The service was fine, a little slow. The food was just ok, not amazing. The restroom was not too clean and I had to inform a server that there were no paper towels.

Food is great. So good I'm willing to travel about 20 mins to get to it. Forgive me for not remembering the dish but the lamb tacos that is dipped in the soup with cult and onion is incredible. So so so damn good and filling. Hopefully they can expand but in the meantime I'll travel for it

So, I went to this McDonald's to have a good time, but unfortunately my hopes were not met. I ordered a happy meal (because it was a good day) but my good day ended there. My happy meal did not come with a toy. I'm very offended. I wanted my toy. Felix I deserve my toy. If you are reading this. I'll get you.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I'm so happy this place opened next to my place. The interior is very modern and chic. As for the food, the octopus taco and guacamole was delicious. The drink cocktails made by joe was also good. The service is great and I'll be back often since it's next to my place.

If you are looking for a hotel with personality, check this place out. It is the old Federal Courthouse that has been refurbed but still has the uniqueness of a courthouse. Great location in the city, 3 minute drive to Ybor City (shuttle will take you there). The licati
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: They completely ruined my $250 prom dress to the point where i could not even wear it and i got it back the day before prom! The alterations that were supposed to be made, were completely messed up and completely wasted over $200 on something i couldn't even wear!!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Food is great for the price, short staffed but its a buffet you're not going there to be served. The owner is the cook for dinner buffet, so food is slightly better than lunch.  They trade off between pork roast & ribs on any given night both are excellent

Needed a little covid sushi pickup in our lives and the reviews pointed us here. So glad it did, everything was super fresh and delicious. We ordered from the Yelp app and everything was ready on time and reasonably priced. If you're craving sushi you won't be disappointed. If we are ever in the area again we will totally be back.

I've been to most of the sushi places in town and this is by far my favorite. The staff are wonderful and welcoming, the food is fresh and delicious and always comes very quickly. I used to go every couple weeks. I wish I still lived across the street from it.

Nice people, but it takes entirely too long to get out of this place with a car. Also a problem for cashless tolls, as Enterprise does not provide an EZPass. NY 9A requires EZPass or they mail a bill. Enterprise then charged me for the toll plus a $10 admin fee.

This coffee house is a treasure chest! The coffee is great but the atmosphere is even better! There is so much to look at! It's quaint but cozy. The people who work here are friendly and their bathrooms are so creatively decorated, that may not mean much to some people, but it's definitely an attraction and worth the stop.

this checkers had very slow service, and the employees were rude. The buns were dry and the popcorn chicken was basically all breading, with little to no chicken in them. I would only give one star if it weren't for the fries. Checkers fries are the best fries, even at this mediocre location.

We had a wonderful meal Lobster ravioli was delicious and the wedge salad was enough to share. Ambience is very nice. I would have given 5 stars if it wasn't for the bread they serve it was a white bread cake yuck!!! I wanted so much to have a nice crusty bread with my salad and entree.

The staff was not at all helpful when i went in to find frames for my 7 yr old. There was 3 employees sitting behind the desk and never got up to help me just pointed to the way and said go pick a frame and there was no one else in the store. I will not use this location again!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I love this place!! It's a great deal with decently good food. The only thing that isn't great is the ginger salad- it's basically just lettuce with a creamy sauce that doesn't taste anything like ginger and one slice of cucumber. The green tea ice cream, however, is so delicious as well as the soups.

Simply because the line is always long! Every time, no matter what time. The line is too long. You may not even have to step out of mine beside it's just too much. The staff is ok, but not as friendly as your neighborhood Starbucks. I get it, non-stop hand crafted drinks!

I came into this Starbucks and I wanted a simple latte and they took over 10-15 minutes to do it and they weren't even that busy, I am usually patient but this was ridiculous. The staff were alright but they got distracted easily and also tended to the drive thru like the lobby orders weren't existent.

Staying here for work, the bartender was very nice. She mad a great drink, I ordered the wings... don't, just don't. The wings were overcooked, and the bones kept breaking in the chicken. Almost no meat on them even though they looked huge. Mostly breading. Didn't try anything else.

We ordered 4 full sheet on Friday night for 24 people, ordered a plain cheese for the kids, meat monster, meatball, and spinach and goat cheese all of them were delicious I always go by yelp reviews normally I would wait until they have over 150 reviews but I check out the menu and said let's try it glad we did.

This your neighborhood tavern-ish place. You go to relax or hangout with friends or just because place. Good selection of beers, friendly staff and good food. Husband and friend love their Miami style wings. Any kind of fries from their menu is oh so yum! 
This was our first and definitely going in soon.

Pleasantly surprised...it's a take out place but has authentic Chinese which is actually pretty good...except maybe a little too salty (for my taste) but will definitely come again (and ask to go easy on the salt).  Glad to see another place in New Tampa with good authentic Chinese !

I stop here each year when I come for the US Nationals drag race. It is amazing to watch them serve so many people in such a short time. EXCELLENT service, fast & friendly. They act as if they already know you. Food is great for a great price! I make sure I stop for breakfast to start each race day.

Very disappointed since my last visit. Maybe changed owners?? No General Tso chicken. Food didn't seem very warm. Won't be returning anytime soon! Also kids pay same as adults that's ridiculous. Only reason I didn't give it  to star is because the honey chicken was really good.

Ordered large drink. Only $1. I go to McDonalds often first time here. It's the best one I've been to. Though I had to clean off the table myself because my table was dirty. Deserves the review I gave it. BEST PLACE EVER. I recommend you try this place it's amazing.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place is awesome. My husband and I tried it for the first time yesterday and it's my new favorite place. Everything we ordered was amazing. My only criticism is that they opened this restaurant too far from our house! If you haven't eaten here yet and are wondering if you should...you definitely should!

Was really surprised with how good this place was for a hotel venue.  The French toast is a must have with its almond encrusted outside.  The bacon was also high quality, the decor is very beautiful.  Huge reason to choose this hotel as a place to stay when you can have a nice meal as well.

Great experience. Delicious menu and friendly, genuine service. I enjoyed my drink at the bar before being seated -- especially the clever names of the cocktails... Sharable items make for a collaborative approach to dining. I appreciated the thoughtful spacing of our courses from the waitstaff. Will certainly return.

Good place for brunch in the historical center of philly. The place is really nice and huge! I had the omelette and it was really good. My husband had the eggs but it wasn't so good, and they didn't bring him the toast so he had to ask for them, and when they brought them it was just bread not toasted.

The St. Louis coffee scene is trending upwards with Sump Coffee leading the way. Delicious coffee are the staple of the shop but it takes a backseat to the atmosphere they have created. If you don't leave the shop with the desire to get their logo tattooed on your body something is wrong with you. Great place, recommend it to all.

Only been open a few days and they're already CRUSHING IT. Came with a gluten free friend and even though they didn't have their gluten free flower yet, they still had options that she said she LOVED. Personally, as a gluten tolerant eater myself, I plan to come back SOON.

Don't use this cleaner. They lost my husbands nice works shirts shirts and claimed they never had them. They found the suites they claimed they didn't have at first but never found the shirts. The lady was very rude saying they had nothing for us. They got a new system and lost track of items. Would not do anything about it.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services
