text: Yikes! I'm hoping this was just the bare bones covid 19 problem. We were given the wrong room. Charged for all the amenities of a suite and not given a suite. No soap to even wash our hands in the bathroom. Dude. This hotel has so much potential but sucked.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Trying this place for the first time.  We did not call in and were able to order right there. When we got home we noticed the food was a lunch portion which was perfect.  After tasting this food,  I am very satisfied with the flavors.  Not bland at all like other Chinese places we've been to. I intend to go back.  New fav spot.

The service was mediocre... it took about 45 min to get our food. Our drinks were only refilled once, once we got to the bottom of them. We didn't arrive during peak hours but by the time we left it was 6:30ish and the patio was packed. zero social distancing. I was pretty underwhelmed.

This family owned restaurant would've received 5 stars. But however, I will never come back here again during restaurant week. It's unorganized with all the commotion going on around. Service was amazing, food tasty, then the icing on the cake it's BYOB!! 

P.S. CASH ONLY!!!!

"24/7" appears to be up for interpretation at this location. After 11 you could wait forever at the drive thru--why? Because literally no one is inside. Doors open, lights on, zero employees inside. This has happened to me maybe 3/3 times over the last few years and to multiple friends. Honestly, it's so bizarre.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I take my car here for anything I need looked at. They do great work and are reliable with timing. I've interacted most with Anthony and Geoff and they're just genuinely good people who care about the experience of their customers. I always enjoy talking with them and appreciate the quality work they consistently do on my car.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Very polite servers, the place is really, really clean and they have a lot of yummy looking options outside of a delicious scoop. 
Love that the ice cream is smooth and fresh - no ice crystals (a pet peeve.)
It is a welcome addition to the neighborhood for a quick treat that doesn't require absolution after.

Friendliness of the staff was amazing however not very helpful and thorough. The hotel itself is in need of repair work. Elevator was slow and noisy. Room was in need of repainting. Mold and bubbles in paint and creases in bathroom. Hardware in shower loose and falling apart. Hospitality and housekeeping hard to coordinate.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Wonderfully strong and flavorful coffee. We happened upon this location after visiting the Liberty Bell as it's right across the street, located on the first floor of an office building. A cortado and a latte were ordered and they were quickly and perfectly delivered. Very friendly and efficient staff.

The staff routinely shuts out the lights and closes the shop 30-60 minutes (and sometimes longer) before the posted closing times.  I've tried a half dozen times on different days of the week to eat at this Subway, but I've finally given up and taken my business elsewhere.

It's like the workers didn't know how to build a sandwich. They all just starred at us and when you ask for the toppings they act like they don't know what to do then only put a few. They cooked my sandwiches in these brown bags and they came out a mess and not toasted- just warm. The steak was still cold!

This place is like farting when you have the flu. Maybe your stomach is going to feel better, but it might cost you a pair of socks and underwear when you strip those shit riddled pants off. Foods horrible place is dirty delivery is horrible and may God have mercy on the souls of all who eat this shit stew.

Know someone in the building and have visited bunch of times. Not sure whats going on with the building but i was looking to rent here and just seems like each time ive visited its gotten worse and worse (urine smell , the vomit issues, ) and now I hear they have no security which alarms me, def,. looking elsewhere to rent

Poor costumer service n the phone - they don't tell you about the $5 delivery fee until after making your order - then delivery took an hour - and a tip was expected - don't believe the prices on their flyer - if you're st a hotel in the area put the flyer where their food needs to be - in the trash - the worst $23 I ever spent!

Do not purchase any personal training through this company! They change trainers so frequently that it'll make your head spin! The only positive about this company are the fitness classes and the instructors! Please heed my warning! Do not get sucked into their crap!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: These guys are GREAT!! Everyone I talked to was so nice and helpful! They took the time it takes to go that extra mile! I have always taken my car to the dealership for my synthetic oil change and their normal price was almost $20 cheaper. This Midas will be my new go to... thank you Ron!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Great open atmosphere and friendly, helpful staff.  Would have never found this place without being referred here and glad I was.  
Had the blackened oyster poboy with the grilled veggies.  Veggies were amazing.  Poboy was very good.  Definitely recommend the crawfish queso too!

Came here two more times with my family while staying in New Orleans over the course of a month, every visit was as good as the first.  Says a lot about a business when you get the same stellar food and treatment from staff on a busy Sunday or a low-key Wednesday evening.  I'll see you next time Pizza D

Wow this club is AWESOME!! They just had a change in ownership and you can tell that the new owners take pride in their business. In just a month since the ownership change, They already brought in new equipment! Its also nice to see that the new manager takes pride in the clubs as well and goes around and cleans!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: All the negative stars a McDonald's can get! They should close this location for so many reasons, customer service is the absolute worst! They are supposed to be open at 6am but on multiple occasions they are not , 6:15, 6:30 go up to drive thru and closed. Ugh just take it out of Wilmington already ..
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: If you pay for a full price car wash you expect to get a full price service. Had only one kid pre-washing the cars as we went in. Only got the driver side washed before they sent us through with dirt and mud still on passenger side. Does wonders for the paint job

Definitely needs an update. Only one bath towel in the bathroom. Would you let your kid or anyone else for that matter sleep on this fold out couch? No coffee to make in the morning except decaf. Blood splatters on ceiling in living room.  Drugbags must have stayed Furniture has stains. Stains on the curtain. Disgusting..
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: A place that makes so-called Jamaica using flavored mix should not call themselves a Mexican restaurant. If you're not going to boil the Jamaica leaves don't call it that on your ad, call it punch... because the sugar in this punches the crap out of your blood sugar!

It's hard to find real Italian food in the suburbs. This place is real deal! The food is always great, staff is great, and atmosphere is very nice. I've had a bunch of different' items here, all have been excellent. Definitely fresh ingredients used. Always satisfied after a meal here.  This is my favorite restaurant in the area!

They always go the extra mile, every time I rent.  Leon and the staff r awesome and always take care of my rental needs.  Thanks Enterprise Kirkwood Hwy, I'll always use u.  Let's face it they get busy, I don't mind cause on the backside, they make up for it by always being professional

One of the worst dining experiences possible. They truly do not deserve to be in business. Very long wait times for everything and the older woman who seemed to be in charge was incredibly rude and disrespectful. They treat you like you are inconveniencing them with your presence.

Great food, great prices and great service. This is a favorite of ours. Every meal we have here is wonderful, comes with a salad and lots of bread! We have dined outside during covid and the service was still phenomenol, take out is always prepared on time and still hot. Highly recommend!

I have to say I absolutely love the new look at the rosebud, formally Mambu. The wine is exquisite, service exceptional, calamari amazing, and the entrees me and my fiancé ordered were the best in town. We will be back and if your looking for a great atmosphere with great food I suggest you stop in.

Outside is sketchy to say the least - weeds growing long, signs taped to the door and windows, and lights not working. The interior smelled of musty old furniture and grease. The tables and booths were old and dirty. The sushi was so-so. I won't return, even if I were to eat only fried food.

Amazing pedicure- but I would not recommend going here for nails. I spent four hours there and even though I'm very happy with my toes, my nails are uneven across the bridge and poorly shaped.  I had her fix it a few times, but after four hours I really had other things to do.

The service here is not as good as I hoped. For starters, their servers are really stuck up and act as if you're annoying them for wanting to eat here. I asked for chili sauce but didn't get it until I was done. My girlfriend got her food 10 minutes after I finished. The sushi was pretty good, they just need better servers.

If you like paying $15 to wash just the exterior of your car..this is the place for you! 
This was my first time washing my own car but i would never have figured it would take that long. The hose which washes the car had very little pressure and it took foreverrr

Not a very nice hotel. Crazy out dated. Hallways are disgusting. Our room was clean except for the bathroom. Still hair from the last guests in the tub. Yep, that kind of hair. Bed was ok. People at the front desk are nice. It was cheap... trying to dig up some positives here.....  not recommended.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Pretty good for a drive thru burger place, I had the spicy fries and the fried pickles and my other had the gyro.  Very inexpensive and served very hot!  The fries were really good.  Wasn't a fan of the pickles.  Lots of breading and not much pickle.  Husband liked the gyro and for the money it was a good lunch.  I would go again.

Beautiful and perfect spot for a conference. We had an issue with our fridge and air conditioner when we first arrived. I called guest relations and they sent someone up right away to fix it! The trolley stops right in front of the hotel, so it is easy to get to the quarter.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Another local restaurant with good eats who can't be bothered to update their menu but sure as hell can bother to raise their prices. Chicken was $15, now it's $20. Gotta get those tourist dollars baby! Or the old people who spent $500k on their Marigny house, they love a good $20 chicken leg.

I love this place but the drinks are OK. They have a great selection of loose leaf teas which is awesome! The lattes are sometimes fantastic, but other times they have no foam and are lukewarm, really depends whether they are in a rush. I don't know much about coffee but it doesn't seem right. The atmosphere is great.

I seriously went through the drive through at 10:27 and ordered a quarter pounder combo and was told no, lunch was not served until 10:30. I'm pretty sure those 3 minutes wasn't going to make that much of a difference my friends. Did you look at your watch drive thru lady?
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I frequent this restaurant weekly. It is  An absolute hidden treasure in the Upper Village of Montecito. Romantic patio dining. Sophisticated menu. Great place for lunch too.. Sand Dabs are a must! 
If you can get them to make the White Truffle Risotto, you will not be disappointed.

We had a lovely stay here for our anniversary. The staff was very friendly. The suit was clean. Would have liked some window coverings for privacy on the living area doors. A great place to stay close to all that the French Quarter and New Orleans had to offer.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Just moved into the area from DC l.  Needed a beard trim and cut to report to my new job.  With no appointment Fresh Cutz had me done in less than a 1/2 hour and was a tight cut.  Great prices, conversation and music.  Definitely check this place out!!!!!!

Never will return. Came here once and thought it was a little higher in price than normal. Came back this morning Bc I had a gc. Got a pedi with a white tip... well the nail polish pealed RIGHT OFF my 2 toes. Go to ASIA nails in tarpon. GREAT PRICE and your paint will actually last!

Sushi took way too long to come out, I only ordered two rolls and my second roll took almost a full hour to get to my table and I was the only one in the restaurant. Appetizers were good and they came out quickly. The hand roll I ordered was soggy and falling apart with way too much rice. Not a great first impression.

Wonderful food, fresh wasabi.  I had the salmon and California rolls...both excellent.  Yukari is a delightful host and catered to my gluten free requirements.  Amazingly, they even have a kid's menu.  I feel very welcome and relaxed here and would highly recommend sushi Yukari.

I've been at this hotel for years. Today I arrive at the airport and wait for a shuttle. After waiting quite some time. Nada. 
I call and ask if they have a shuttle,... Response "Yes, but you need to call to have us drive to the airport". Whaaaat?
Hotels by the airport typically run every 30 min. Right? Not this one anymore.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Great experience at the French Market Inn! Awesome location. Friendly staff. They even have a cat that roams the hotel! Bed was comfortable. Pool was a little dirty but we swam around 9 pm so that's expected. The room was not as clean as Id have liked. Found a random sock under the side table.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The outside of the building definitely reflects its name! We ordered off of the all you can eat menu, which is a great value. The sushi rolls we ordered were very good. I would  have to say though, that the wait staff could have been more attentive. But overall, the sushi was good enough that I would come back.

not good for large groups.  very hot in the breakfast area.  rooms are very small.  i'm very short but the shower head was installed for some one who is very tall.  they did not have any toiletries.  ice machine was not working.  sheets were not changed during my 3 day stay.  bed was very hard.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Excellent food at this little place.  All is fresh and cooked to order.  I had the Sizzling Fajitas and they were delicious.  They came out so hot and sizzling, I had to let them cook a little before eating. Not your regular chain restaurant here.  Delish....

Wow Is pretty much all I can say. The place was a mess, like they just finished a rush. But was slow when we got there. Every single table was dirty, the floors were disgusting and the food was burnt. Have given this White Castle more than one chance. Will not be back.

Had a reservation but they did not have a vehicle available when we arrived.  Basically had the attitude that it was our problem and did nothing to correct the situation so we went to Enterprise where we found a rental at a great price and excellent customer service . No wonder hertz is going bankrupt !

They always do such a great job with my pedicures! They are a little more pricey than I'm used to, but worth it. They also have partitions all throughout to protect you, employees, and other customers. When possible, they leave the door open to make sure fresh air is circulating through the shop. All are required to wear masks.

Every time I've been here, the food is delicious and service is great. I've been a handful of times and have been to many other sushi restaurants as well. A little expensive at times, but the hot green tea is delicious, sushi always comes out quickly, and they have a lot of Mochi ice cream flavors :) A favorite!

Absolutely terrible! We've ordered delivery once they got it wrong then gave us issues to remake or refund money. Gave them another chance as a pick up order. No complaints. Decided to give them another chance at delivery and we received almost the exact same issue.

Terrible McDonald's. It would be nice to a) have my food made in a way that it's not falling apart from being thrown in my bag, b) have a straw in the bag or at least given to me, and that's probably because c) the people working the window don't even acknowledge your presence or say hello or anything. Terrible.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I have been here three times now.  Good food, service was just ok twice.  Our drinks sat empty on two occasions.  Two visits on weekend nights we had to shout over extremely loud music.  In such a small place why aren't musicians dailing the volume back a bit?

I trust Pat's for my auto service. They're professional ,friendly and efficient, whenever my car or truck needs service. When My engine stopped running on the way to work, one phone call and it was picked up and ready to go in a day. I will continue to use and recommend Pat's as my favorite auto service shop! Thanks guys!!!

Pizza was pretty good, but the fried mushrooms were not. The breading was separating from the mushroom and  also kind of thin and mushy. The ranch that came with it was yummy though. The toasted ravioli was pretty good though. Not the best, but not the worst either.

It used to be Benkay. It was changed hands many years ago. The quality dropped quite a bit after the change, long time ago. 

Today we decided to try it again. We think it's pretty good now. Maybe they changed owner again? The uni was very fresh - the true tester of a good sushi bar.

I had a mani/pedi and brow wax today.  I was happy with the service.  No wait, clean facility, and nice quiet atmosphere.  I don't get anything fancy done; so I cannot speak to how they do with gel manicures, designs, or full-ins.  Based on my experience, good value for the price.

Over priced for what they are offering..$135/person+$60 (Sake pairing)+Tax...have food at your house cz when you get back you might need another dinner ..vibes are good and the best thing was, their heated restroom seat  now you can imagine how much I liked their food

did a walk in haircut since I found it on yelp and I was nearby. the man was very detailed and did a good job. reasonable price for a city haircut and included shampoo and 'massage'. the massage is really just 15 seconds of scalp massage during the shampoo process.

Got the 20$ package. The tire shine was only used on one side of the car. So one side had nice shiny wheels while the other looked old and bland. Not how I want my car to look when I use it with customers everyday. I emailed them a couple days ago and are waiting on a response. This was at the First Capital location.

I ordered a medium caramel ice coffee with cream, no sugar, and then extra caramel. When I received it, it had barely any cream in it and I also got charged for the extra caramel but there was probably only 1-2 pumps total. It was horrible and I ended up throwing it away after a couple sips. The workers were nice though.

What a find!  We were looking for a place that delivered and are glad we chose this one.  The rolls were cheap and delicious.  I recommend the Snow White Roll, the Pink Lady was good too.  We've tried the other sushi places in the UD area and they are over priced, give small portions, or don't deliver.  We'll definitely come back.

Not sure what to do here. Clean hotel. Good service. The standard one would expect...nothing special. But the hero was that bed! Sooooo comfortable and the sheets were amazing. Wonderful sleeping experience. Easily 5 stars for the bed. But the $350+ summer rate for a damn Holiday Inn can suck it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We got two grilled grouper sandwiches with fries to go. We were staying next door at Edge Hotel. The sandwich consisted of a tiny piece of fish and soggy fries. Edge Hotel highly recommended them I guess because it's sister hotel. Certainly not for quality of food!

The lunch specials are great! $11.50 for 3 rolls that comes with miso soup and salad that you can't beat! We had to wait a little bit for takeout but it was well worth it. My favorite rolls are the Philadelphia roll and the shrimp tempura. Contactless curbside

They are not on the airport grounds and rely on a shuttle which is never there to pick you up.  The customer service is terrible and the car condition has been bad 2 times for me personally.  My suggestion is use an on site car rental and save yourself the grief and aggravation.

Do not stay here if you need to get some sleep. Horrible. Complained to front desk 5 times about how loud a party was next door. At 1:30 in morning I walked downstairs to make them listen to audio recording of the party from our room. It sill continued. You can hear everything between rooms.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Being right on bourbon it's hard to stay in one place for very long. So didn't experience too much here, that said this was still a cool hang out spot. Drinks were not crazy overpriced and very New Orleansy (colorful and sugary). Oh and one thing: you better try the chair fireball shot!

I just had Bravo for my first time. Slices of pizza were very good. Towards closing they still had special slices on the counter. I tried the BBQ chicken (excellent), plain (very good), buffalo (good, and very spicy), sausage (good).

The owners were very friendly, I'll definitely make this my local pizza spot.

Went through the drive thru at 9:40pm. "Drive Thru Open" sign on their window was on. Checked yelp, "open until midnight". Hours on the drive up window says open until midnight. Employee says they're closed. In conclusion.. they are NOT open until midnight. Change your hours and turn off your damn light!

Friendly and quick service at the drive-thru, but disappointed with the food. Took Mom to get breakfast after bloodwork and she had a hard time eating the croissant. As for hash browns, there were only 5 (picture shows 4, mom already ate one before I saw the bag).

This will go down as the worst Chinese takeout I have ever experienced. Egg Foo Young gravy didn't even taste like a regular Chinese EFY gravy. Egg rolls were so soft I can't believe they ever hit the fryer. Here visiting so really look forward to getting home to real Chinese.

Stopped in to watch the sunset tonight, to grab a quick bite and a few cocktails with good friends in town. Our waitress was Trish, and she was very pleasant and accommodating. Food and drinks were good, but the service and atmosphere is what made our evening. 
Thank you Trish!

Went there for the first time today and it's now one of my favorite spots for tacos. I got the enchilada combo with rice and beans plus 5 tacos on the side. Everything tasted great and service was fast. Works were kind and recommended me on what to get. Definitely will be returning for more.

Food is great. Service not so good. They are social distancing either they make you wait. To save space and chef time To sit with strangers and your literally shoulder to shoulder at a dinner table with random people. I asked why we had to share a table with strangers when we already had 4 people

Even though the selection was great and what I got was amazing, the price had me in "sticker shock ". I simply wanted a place where I could get an amazing sundae; what I got was raked over the coals for something not that wasn't quite what I was looking for. Bring your bank book.

The winner of the Best Meatballs in Philly is no lie. Great Meatball Sandwich, very good thin crusted Pizza, friendly environment, and a quick take out. If you're looking for a nice Italian restaurant or take out, this is your place to eat in Collegeville.

I've never had a bad experience for haircuts until I came here. The barber seemed as if he wasn't paying attention and just sang songs. He didn't have a clue how to cut my hair. His taper was the worst I've ever gotten. Shortly after my haircut I went to another barber to fix my hair. Just saying You have been warned.

The place is a mess. Equipment all over. No one bothers to pick up after themselves and management let's it continue. Mats are from when they opened over two years ago. I never see them wipe anything down. You use to see employees picking up and wiping things down. Not any more since the new owners took over.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: There were four of us so we had a good selection! Teriyaki was good but ramen was excellent! My husband and daughter had the spicy seafood and spicy kimchi ramen. They both loved it and were sweating it a bit by the time they were done. The Funky roll was really good as well! Definitely give it a try!

I have been going to Caroline at Dandelion Salon for close to 3 years. I've lived in Washington, DC and Atlanta and she is the best stylist and colorist I've ever had! She knows exactly what to do with my mostly curly/partly wavy and getting-grayer-by-the-minute hair!

Not a bad place to stay but make sure to bring your walking shoes. It's at the extreme edge of the French Quarter and anything decent is at least 2-3 blocks minimum. The accommodations were very good. I like the open lobby.  Room was a decent size, and hotel staff is very friendly and extremely knowledgable of the area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I love this place!  Trainwreck Tuesday!  If you don't know you better ask somebody!  My favorite local place to grab a burger and brewski.  Tonight I had the Hawaiian Chicken Sandwich and it was delicious!  I just recently moved to the neighborhood and always make a stop a couple of times a month.

We are on our way back home, we were hungry, we wanted breakfast, and we didn't want fast food chains. So we drove into town looking for local flavor and taste. We got it! The omelette was great, potatoes yummy and the thick bread toast capped it. The rest of the party had waffles and 2x2! Great food!

Walked up to the doos for a walk in appointment but did not go in. Customers were seated VERY close and there is no partition between clients and technicians. There were about 15 people within in the small salon. No way social distancing is possible. It's a whole no for me.

This is a great restaurant. The bread is incredible. Dip it with some oil and parmiginan cheese and that's worth ur trip already. The pasta was great as well, very creamy and tasty. Nice location in clay terrace with an outdoor quiet spot to have a nice dinner.

I took my car here for an oil change and it was done very quickly! Everyone was courteous from start to finish and I received a call to remind me that it was time to get a new oil change which I really appreciate. They also let me know that they noticed a few leaks and refilled the fluids that were low.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Cons: The only available parking is paid open parking that is not secure or valet for $40. Check in is listed as 4pm, but they weren't ready until 5:30pm.
Pros: The location is awesome. It is right on the edge of the French Quarter. The staff is incredibly friendly. The room was clean.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I can't say enough about this wonderful management! Such kind people, who actually care about the people who live here. The office staff is sweet, friendly and professional!! Not to mention fast. Clean and well maintained grounds, pet friendly and great, upgraded apartments. I love it and recommend it to anyone!!

This restaurant was good, and the service was as well. It was worth the trip - just doesn't come close to our favorite Mexican restaurant back home.  Cheese dip was lukewarm and it doesn't come with chopped up peppers in it. Fajita chicken quesadilla was good. No complaints - it's just average Mexican food.

Our first visit in New Hope July 14 during Covid. Everyone was taking the correct precautions and our bartender Amanda was  wonderful! She made us feel very welcome and had excellent recommendations for not only food but what to do as first-timers in new hope! The place was right on the water and had such yummy calamari.

This restaurant deserves more stars. Service and food all are wonderful. If you are craving for some authentic sushi, you can ask for some with eel or raw seafood. Don't ask for fried rolls. 
They have a little store inside the restaurant, not really a market.

Checked Loaded Nachos out today in The Streets of St Charles.  They were helpful and answered all my questions, and gave the options available.  They provide take out, indoor and outdoor seating -- all socially distanced.  The food was great, will be back for more.  The Buffalo sauce on the Buffalo chicken was spot on!

Would be unfair to compare them to Chinatown restaurants in New York or Boston, but I'm just happy they're here in Nashville. 

Their beef noodle soup does satisfy that occasional hankering for Taiwanese comfort food. (The xiao long bao however doesn't really do it)

Dine-in experience is pretty good and food is always great. Just tried to call for take-out and I was put on hold for 5 minutes before I hung up the phone. I tried to call back and it rang about 20 times before somebody answered... and put me on hold again!

This was a great experience! Adorable old world chic feel with great food and service! The meatballs and garlic bread were a great app for the family. I would definitely recommend arriving for an early dinner we were able to have our choice of seating but it got very busy by the time we had finished.

I was on vacation in philadelphia so this is ZHE PLACE for a real Philly cheese steak . The stars was not for the food. I gave them  to the cashier, good customer service. Food was nasty nothing to compare with the real Philly cheese steak. Cheese look like cream cheese it was horrible

I really enjoy Friday evening dinner here. Love the Wakame, Mango Salad as an appetizer.  They have a great happy hour for Sushi, Sashimi, and drinks!  Draw back is not open for lunch during the week and no happy hour for Saturday and Sunday.  The decor is a modern, chic feel. I've always had really good service here.

This is as good as BYOT gets. I was a little worried going outside of center/olde city but I'm glad I did. Excellent service, tasty margaritas, and fresh food. They also accomodate large parties. I had 10 and a table behind me had 20! We had a blast, drank and ate until we were stuffed, and the bill was $20pp. You can't beat that.

This is the worst sushi I have ever had. I went to the origami on hillsborough and it was so much better than this place. The eel sauce was horrible and the sushi was basic and nothing great about it. The only good thing was the salmon nigiri was good and it was a large amount.

I am spending a few days at this Starbucks this week because of the free wifi.... great staff and super friendly... I am originally from Orange County, Ca and I have to say, I was not used to nice, and friendly staff at Starbucks. A big 2 thumbs up for all the staff here.

I don't understand what the more negative reviews were talking about. I'm currently in the restaurant posting this review because of how GOOD the food was. Flavorful, big portions, NOT expensive. (My plate was $11) the service was great, and our server was very friendly with my 3 year old daughter. I'll be back.

Love, love, love every single person who works here.  They are so friendly and helpful and empathetic. We have had three of our dogs here.  Dr. Kidd remembers each dog we have had and loves each one of them. She saved one of our dogs lives via emergency surgery. We are big fans of the ladies at Pocopson!

Great location, the assistant manager Sam will make sure your taken care of. First time I met him he was scrubbing a car perfectly clean in the TN august heat. Cars have always been good in my book. You'll be happy, and they'll take you home if your within 5 miles

I'm a Marriott Reward Member, and have never posted a Yelp review before. But my stay here was bad enough to merit my first post. Customer service was poor, there was no TV remote in my room, and the bar/restaurant was understaffed. Plus, no internet. Definitely don't eat there, but also don't stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I'm from the Bay area and our Bible study group decided to go to Santa Barbara for the weekend.  Our group went here to have dinner for the very first time.  We were surprised how delicious and fresh their food were.  The service was also good.  We will for sure go back when we are in the area.

The service is absolutely abysmal and well below what we have come to expect from a Susan Spicer restaurant. Extraordinarily disappointed. There was a long Line waiting for a table and despite at least six empty tables, folks were being ignored.  A truly abysmal performance for a restaurant owned by a legendary chef.

I frequent the Olive location every couple weeks. Love the strangers and the variety they provide. Always greeted with a smile and quick service. Like any donut shop that tries new flavors there are hits and there are misses but for the most part they are good flavor combinations.

Food was amazing.  Sat outside overlooking Filter Square.  Server was very attentive and helped us out with the menu. 

Pros: 
Come for the Cutlets and the Cutlet special with longhots and eggplant. 
Amazing location. Finally something is open on the square. 

Cons:
Somewhat limited menu.  Pretty pricey.

Creative menu, fabulous service, and absolutely delicious sushi. We are BIG fans of sushi and are super impressed with this place. 
The citrus role is super unique and we couldn't get enough. It was a wonderful experience and we can't wait to be back. 
Learned that tables are hard to get between 6:30 - 8 p.m., so get there early!

Tara the bartender was AMAZING! I was traveling alone on business and she was so friendly and efficient! T.C at concierge was wonderful as well, incredibly helpful for all of my crazy questions. I gave the place a 4 because the room wasn't very clean when I arrived. There were crushed up chips on the couch..
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I was pretty high on this place until I went to the bathroom and saw that there was pee in the toilet. Cause the toilet didn't flush properly because the handle is broken, and the soap dispenser also didn't work. So how do store employees wash their hands you have to wonder? Eww

My stylist is Jenny K and she is amazing! She is great with blondes and is very personable. The salon is very relaxing and attentive with the changing times caused by COVID.  I am so happy to have found Jenny, I trust her immensely and am happy with my hair every time!

Guys have been super helpful with scheduling and review deals for my truck. Always try and let you know what's wrong with your vehicle by actually being truthful and not looking for another buck. Usually pretty good on timing and letting you know how long it will take. Staff is friendly.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I would DEFINITELY recommend the Nail Bar while in Nashville. They have a large selection of scented lotions for you to chose from. The salon was very clean and the services were top notch. I would recommend the mud masques and taking advantage of the complimentary wine.

We checked in went to the pool and there are roaches everywhere. I went to the manager he wanted to see them. He said oh they come in from the outside pool area. Hello no they don't the hotel is disgusting. I would never stay there. We left and checked in to the Hilton huge difference
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Came in because I was starving and needed something quick.  I got the 6" rotisserie chicken.  The bread was fresh and the vegetables were great!  They even have Swiss cheese.  I would say they are trying hard here to sell a quality sandwich.  I know that's what I got!

I have to admit the pizza is good. However, the people are rude. I called for a pickup order - rude on the phone and worse when I got there. The young man with the large sideburns is the rudest  one. I hesitate going there even though the pizza is good. Too bad the service doesn't equal the product.

Make sure to get a quote in advance.  I'm pretty sure I received the special "tourist" rate that is roughly double the $20 price for shave/cuts referenced by other reviewers.

All in all, decent cut, but in my opinion was not worth the $50 (incl tip) I forked over.

Awful service!  The Asian lady at the register doesn't speak or understand English very well so she keeps getting orders wrong and she is so busy talking that she doesn't hear you anyway.  Getting rid of her would improve things but they have along way to go.  East coast Diukins could teach them a thing or two about customer srvice

I have used this location before the remodel, the burgers were great,  but the fries were burned and brown, when I talked to management They said that is how the new fryers cook them, won't be buying fries again, doesn't look like the golden brown pics all over the the walls.

Best barber shop in Smyrna, no doubt about it. All of the barbers are super nice and they all know what they're doing in there. I have really thin hair so I always have a hard time getting the right fade I want. Ever since I've been coming here it's been perfect. Never had any complaints on my cuts.

The gentleman who responded here has been diligent in his responses to my posts. He has emailed me personally and offered his apologies- there may not be free wifi but you do get a caring and attentive staff, which means a lot in the hotel business, I think.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The detail work here is excellent and even a normal car wash you really get what you pay for but fully expect to be here 30 minutes with nobody around and sometimes more than an hour. People drying and wiping things down take FOREVER! 
Overall really good job, good value...maybe the slowest car wash in America

Michael and Laura are the best! They are the only ones I trust with my color and cuts. They're both easy to talk too and always do an AMAZING job on my hair. Everything is top notch from the customer service to the facilities to the haircut. My hair looks and feels great, I couldn't be happier.

The pizza was good and enough was left over to take to the hotel. Atmosphere was average and drinks overpriced. Used a Groupon and the establishment appeared to have a hard time understanding how it worked. Hearing the employees speak overtly about sexual issues was unusual.

The frozen rosé drinks are super good! Not too sweet, and a great way to cool down in the Tennessee heat. Our server, Sean, was kind and welcoming. We appreciated the hospitality and warm welcome! Great patio for sunny days, and a walk up bar for quick service. Love this local spot.

Went to Bob Evans with a couple of friends. One of my friends got his silverware and it was covered in suasage gravy, yet it was wrapped in the napkin. Needless to say I was pretty disgusted as was everyone at the table. I like the food here but that really made me not want to eat.

I've been a customer of momma Mia now for two and a half years. I just love their Pizza and wings. I had a super bowl party where I had a huge order with pizza, salads, and wings and garlic knots. Everything was delivered hot, fresh and yummy!! Staff is always friendly and helpful! Highly recommended!

I have been going to this ice cream place for years now and it's absolutely one of my favorite spots to get soft serve. Pricing is decent for the amount of ice cream you receive. They also make their own root beer for those who did not know! & Their staff is friendly most of the time. Overall, this place is a must for summertime.

Just ok. Had a few rolls. The Fusuon roll was lousy. Salmon inside were crappy cuts and very chewy. Ew. Service is off too. Maybe it's not really a sushi focus but if you're gonna have sushi on the menu, please make it good quality. Will come back to try the Chinese dishes but won't be havin sushi again here.

The hotel is under construction for a major and needed renovation. So if you are looking for a restful stay go to another hotel.  The front desk will offer a renovated room but will neglect to tell you to expect construction noise throughout the day even on a Saturday. Management is shamefully negligent as well as absent.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I love this place!! The brunch was sooo yummy. I got the biscuits and gravy with a side of bacon, and my partner got the waffle benedict and we both loved it. PLUS the mimosas were the best I've had. The champagne was excellent and they were always chilled. Definitely recommend!

Phenomenal. In the past four months I've rented a car here twice. Both time it's taken me over a half hour to check my vehicle in. Four people waiting in the office and one person behind the counter that clearly does not know how to type.  Come on Avis, get your act together - this is the big time now.

I went in for acrylic & pedicure, the pedicure was great but the woman who did my acrylic was rushed (see pinky). They are currently coming off after just having them for a week 1/2, normally mine last up to a month. 
Also, my nails are uneven. The thumb on my life hand literally has a dip.

Worst experience ever. Used to love going here and drinking margaritas on the patio until the last time when a waitress that wasn't even ours picks a fight with us at the cash register bc our food wasn't right and then flips us off out the window when we got to our car.

I just recently found this place and had no idea it was just down the street from me but I'm so happy I did!!! Very kind and hardworking staff who make phenomenal food! I ordered the orange chicken and fried dumplings. Everything was made perfectly and quickly. I'll definitely be back soon!

It was a Sunday afternoon. Not busy at all at the time. I waited 30 minutes for my mcchicken sandwich meal. The fries had been sitting there and were cold. The buns were stale. The service was stale. The facility is unkept and dirty. I won't be going here ever again.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Really nice place with very good coffee drinks and pastries. The only thing is it's too quiet inside and could use a little more decor, but it's new so it gets a pass. Also, hoping they put a table outside someday because sometimes the whether is really nice outside.

I really love their lattes here and the price is very decent.

An old, lackluster Sheraton is still better than a lot of mid-range hotels out there, but this was still a disappointment. 
Our room was smoky, and so we were moved to a room with cracked lampshades.  It didn't inspire excitement for the Sheraton brand.The whole hotel needs to be updated. I bet it was great in the 90s.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Mark Pi's is my favorite Chinese restaurant. My family has been going here for many years and it's the only Chinese we eat. It's always delicious and reasonably priced! Quick service no matter if you order to go or eat in. Can't go wrong with anything on the menu in my opinion.

This is by far the best gym experience I've ever had. The staff is so friendly, Chase and Nicole were so helpful my first time there. The bathrooms have been spotless every time I've been in, and it's always a good mix of people in the gym, a very comfortable setting, not threatening at all.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Worst checkers I have ever been to, should be shut down the way it's ran. The three times I've been here the order has been wrong, something wasn't working or the drive they speaker wasn't working. Staff looks poorly dressed as well. Please shut this place down.

Food was just ok.  Quite expensive.  Burger patty tasted overcooked.  Got a vanilla and a peanut butter shake.  Both were just average.  McDs are better.  Fries were a bit salty in my opinion.  Got a crispy chicken sandwich...also nothing to write home about.  It reminds me of a Carl's Junior but with a more limited menu.

Outdated, needs a serious makeover. Electric outlet didn't work in bathroom, coffee maker brewed only 1/2 a cup. Had to restart several times to get a full cup. Worst of all, fitness center was 76 degrees with the ac cranked all the way up. It was cooler in the hallways.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Best pedi in Reno in my book!  Affordable, full service, exfoliating scrubs, massage, hot stones & paraffin all in brand new massage chairs & newly remodeled salon!  
Very friendly service which routinely accommodates walk-in appointments.  Highly recommend!!

First time here, had a great experience with Liam! He did a great job on my french gel manicure. The price was right too! Salon was clean, very nice inside. I called same day and made an appointment for after work and was taken on time. Will definitely be back again very soon!

First time on Frenchman Street, and we had the pleasure of enjoying Ed Wills.  He and his band were fantastic!  The bar service was ok, I stuck with bottled beer the whole evening.  If your looking to hear great music and have a cold beer, good spot to go to.

Just like any ole Mexican restaurant. There is isn't anything different that would make it stand out from any other Mexican restaurant. The staff are very nice and tentative. Eating during lunch time can have slow service, but other than that it is good. I placed an online order and it was ready In ten minutes which was nice.

Such a great spot to get your sushi fix! I got the salmon flight (not what it's really called but forgot the real name) and agedashi tofu. I wish the tofu had a bit more flavor but it was still yummy. Also, they have super quick service which is a huge plus!

It's one of the few places open right now that has a salad. I ordered the shrimp Caesar salad, it had exactly 6 medium shrimp. It came with too much Caesar dressing on it. The server (Brit) was super nice and brought out more lettuce. 
Recommendation ask for dressing on the side.

I ordered several rolls to take out.  All were fresh and delicious. The menu was huge.  They have something for everyone even those who are new to sushi or who don't like raw fish.  I especially liked the volcano roll and the shrimp tempura roll would definitely go back.

Have picked up take out for lunch twice now. The prices are reasonable and the sushi  does not disappoint. Once I can dine in I hope to add the 5th star! The lunch specials include so much food! The classic Mexican roll  and the eel cucumber roll were delicious! The seaweed salad was nice and fresh too!

This is my first time here!  Not bad at all.  The set up is a bit odd, but compared to the way shine car wash does it in Arlington TX, not bad at all.  While watching them work they seem to pay attention to detail, and so a great job!  Cashier needs a personality and they could use benches outside to sit as well.

Balducci's is a well established Italian restaurant with very authentic food and wonderful wait staff.  They go out of their way to serve you a great meal and make you feel like one of the family. Stopped by one evening as they were about to close and they even recommended another restaurant which was equally as good!

This location screws up my order more times than they get it correct. Today I ordered a Carmel iced with cream, it's so bitter and there is barely any cream. & a toasted everything bagel with cream cheese. My bagel is not toasted. Souderton location is the best!

Polite people and one of the most interesting hotel I've ever been. The one star off is because they need to do some changing inside the hotel. It's so old fashion and seem super old & not really managed... But overall, it'll be a nice place to stay over the weekend
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Got an eye exam and contacts today at the eye bar, and the service was great. Lauren got me in fast and was super friendly. I didn't have to sit around and wait like I gave at other places, the dr was very personable and quick as well. Got a really good price on my contacts and have no complaints! Thanks!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Thoroughly enjoyed our first visit. I had chicken Pasquale and husband had chicken Piccata- both were excellent. Nice small salad included and delicious homemade bread. Added homemade tiramisu which was different but delicious. Mark was an excellent server!! Lovely experience.

The po boy was delicious and so was their pulled pork.  I love the ambiance here and it's cool to visit this place from bar rescue! Their cup with the light up skull is also cool, I took one of those home. The staff if awesome to! I'll definitely 'lbw returning here when I'm back in Nola!

May 29-June 1, 2017

This hotel is definitely no frills but clean and served our purposes well.  20 minute walk to downtown.  Cab ride back was approximately $10.00.  Not an area I would want to walk around in after dark but felt safe during the day.  Staff, especially at check in was very nice.  I would stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This McDonalds says it is open 24/7 but we are here at 11:53pm on a Saturday night and they won't serve breakfast because they said they are about to close at midnight! Someone needs to change the hours on Yelp to reflect the correct hours for sure. The employees said the Yelp hours have been wrong for 2 years now!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
We love Mexican food & love that they make the salsa in front of you. so yummy!! our only dislike is that every time we come the chips at stale. it's been multiple times, different days & times. kind
of disappointing especially since they talk about their chips being fresh.

Marriott, you need to pull this flag. A Renaissance? More like a bad Motel 6. The lobby had a face lift but that's it. Old rundown rooms in poor repair. Broken vent, cracked toilet and a frig and microwave that look like they fell off and was dragged behind a truck.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The service was not that great. Seemed as if proper training for customer service was lacked. Heard some back talking when a server was asked to do a simple task. Server complained. Was not a good look. And was rather slow as far as refills and keeping up.

$15.99 per day for wifi. $9.99 for wifi worst than your phone on 3G. But why should they care. Their location is right across from convention center. They feel they can add all the extra fees they want. And serve bad food. It's not a hotel, it's Brilliant ways to screw over your customers travel. Got it.!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Not service driven. 
Not clean
Pick up driver at airport didn't stop the first time. Just drove we had to call. My hubby arrived separately and this happened to both of us. 
Breakfast tables were sticky. All the ones we tried. We asked for a wipe off and they were still sticky. 
So skip it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Service was terrible, lady who took our order was more concerned with her cellphone than our order. We live 80 miles away from this Burger King and got about half way home to realize they didn't even put my burger in our bag, so I paid 15 dollars for French fries and a drink! If I could give 0 stars I would! Awful service!

Worst McDonald's I've ever been to, half my order was wrong, service was poor, only one register was open at lunch time, I was in a rush so it was only until I made it back to my workplace that I realized they never gave me napkins nor a straw for my iced coffee, fries were old and the patty was overcooked
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Was it bad? No. Would I seek it out again? No. The service was subpar in that we waited several minutes just for someone to acknowledge that we were at the "wait to be seated" sign. The waitress was eh. The beers didn't come until after the app...annoying. BUT, the food was decent and the portions were ridiculous. Atmosphere...C+.

This is an amazing place with an amazing atmosphere. I'm greeted as soon as I walk in the door and shown to a table either inside or outside underneath a tent. The waitress is very attentive and we never have to wait for service. The food is amazing as well!

Rooms are great, spacious and modern. Staff friendly, great location BUT.....they are attached to sister hotel springhill suites and the signage and getting around is terrible. I'm pretty good navigating around and the facility is hard to figure out. Hope it gets better.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Discovered 2 nails in the right rear tire of my wife's suv mid afternoon and called over to tire kingdom to see if they could squeeze me in with the modified hours thanks to Covid19. They had me bring it in at 3:30 and had it done and out the door by 3:50. Great service, great price!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Pathetic....  Maybe I had a bad night.  I should have known when I walked in and no one acknowledged me but kept talking to each other.

Happy hour menu... confusing to say the least...they agree.

Pedestrian sushi.  In a rush? I'd still go somewhere else.

Customer service is usually pretty good, however Starbucks says they care about their employees but then start them off at $9.25/hour when the company has the ability to pay a living wage. PAY YOUR WORKS MORE. ESPECIALLY DURING A PANDEMIC. YOU ARE NOT ESSENTIAL.

I stayed here with a group of 14 people for a combined bachelor/ette party. The rooms were nice, and hotel staff was very accommodating. 

The front desk gave very good food/drink suggestions around the city. They also went above and beyond in finding us cabs, and making sure our stay was enjoyable.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went to Rusty's for their all you can eat Alaskan Snow Crab as they advertise on Saturday.  After we were finally seated and stated to eat we found out it was snow crab.  Very disappointed.  Snow crab and king crab are two different things yet we still paid a king crab price.

Quite simply: badass coffee.

They source, roast, and serve to a much higher standard than others, creating a product that is as quality as it is special. Hands down the best coffee experience you can have in Nashville, and likely many places in the US.
If you love coffee, you won't be disappointed.

Just had dinner at Bella Aquila and was disappointed.  We sat in the bar and a counter/bar area behind was thick with dust.  Flowers were wilting in vases and decor very out dated. Then our meals came and the steak was cold and not sure was a NewYork cut.  Will not go back

I was in this area for work training, and was craving good Chinese food. Well I definitely found it. This place was awesome! The staff were super friendly. I had beef and broccoli and spring rolls. I forgot to take a picture but I ate it all! Lol awesome place. Would definitely go back if I'm in the area.

I've been here a few times and the food had always been good. It's a pity that they have been hit with the Alberta Health infractions. Unfortunately, I don't think this is the first time this has happened, and probably won't be the last. 


I sincerely hope that they can clean their act up and keep it clean.

These people took our money in advance, then refused to rent to me or refund the money because my bank isn't on their list.

Alamo stranded my children and I in the airport at 10 PM, after promising a vehicle weeks in advance AND taking my money.

I literally hate you, Alamo.

Weird place, which is a shame, as it's in a great location. Doesn't seem to know whether it's a dive bar, or a down-at-heel cafeteria. The drunks at the bar think the former, the disappointed diners the latter. SB has enough restaurants - if this place went full-Dive bar (with a slight refurb), it'd be a

This place was absolutely amazing. Staff is wonderful and attentive. I had a chicken, steak, and shrimp fajita and it was probably the best one I've had in my life. My girlfriend got the chicken quesadilla and could only eat half of it it was so big! Definitely a must stop for dinner and is sure to be one of our favorite spots.

Very good sushi and all u can eat!! Sushi is fresh made and taste really good! And service is pretty fast! Only one thing that is very loud in the restaurant, it's like u r sitting at the bar! But the foods are pretty good, so definitely will go back again!

Too bad there is no option for 0 stars. Terrible service, worst DD you can possibly go to. Dirty floors, rude and inappropriate employees think they are so smart, please just relax you sit there and sell donuts.  Had to leave the store without buying anything because of their attitude. Will never set a foot in here. Terrible

Came here from CA and needed a good Italian Sangiovese. Couldn't find anywhere close that had a proper selection. Ralph was incredibly helpful and knowledgable and knew the Italian homeland very well and helped me select a wine very quickly. Thank you so much!

Well.... if this is the wine store in Lawrence Park then I have to let you know the employees are a rare breed. You MUSR line your bottles up and make sure the employee does not have to "reach" for your bottle!!! I go there every week and yet to get a greeting of any sort. So discouraging.

This spot has great sushi, they don't communicate the prices on the menu, but they're about average with a typical sushi restaurant. We enjoyed their outdoor patio area and enjoyed the rolls we got. The staff was kind and doing their best considering how busy they were! I would absolutely recommend getting some rolls here.

Sign says open 24 hours, yelp says open 24 hours, people "working" inside. Order screens turned off. Called the store and asked if the drive through was open and she said no. I asked why the sign said 24 hours and she said it was just on the weekend. It's 1am on a Sunday night. Just wanted a dang cheeseburger.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Wasn't good experience! There lowest carwash is $4 and it don't really clean much ! Mobil carwash down the road is $3 and way better quality than this carwash and don't have long wait like this carwash ! Moreover you get 10cent per gallon of gas when you purchase carwash there in Mobil!

This is normally my go to car wash and it normally dose a great job at washing my car and the vacuum are always good this last few times the washing has not been as good as it use too be specially if you pick the wheel shine one side my car comes out perfect the other side dose not. I hope they can resolve this soon

Two servers failed to show up for work the afternoon were there so service was slow and the servers who did come to work were running hard. As Teppanyaki goes it was about average that is all teppanyaki is very good. I'd go back. There was more food than usual; I didn't finish all of my Filet Mignon. That's really unusual.

I love always coming here for my weekend coffee drinks. The owners are wonderful people, and the local roasts from Exo are always something to look forward to. They also have some awesome baked goods, as well as some loyalty cups. Definitely a good place to stop at especially if you're about to head into Bookman's next door.

I thought the pork egg rolls were just average, and the hot mustard wasn't so hot. The free bag of crispy noodles were stale but the bag we purchased was fresh. I was not super impressed with the house fried rice, it could have had more flavor. The Hunan Chicken and Chicken with string beans were spicy good.

I usually come here with family or on special occasions. I usually order their chimichangas (the dos order) I love the large servings of beans and rice. 

Sometimes the dishes aren't as clean as I like. But the food quality is good. 

Nice decor inside too. Like traditional Mexican restaurants.

Really weird photo. Is that a staple on a finger covered in sauce? There are a lot of great pizzas in this area. This is not one of them. It's not bad. The service was friendly and the store looked clean. The ingredients tasted good. It's just more crust than I like.

The inside of this market it dirty and the owners just glare and grunt at you. Fun fact, if they don't like the way you park in their parking lot, they stick giant parking violation stickers on your window that you can't peel off. Stay away! 711 is just up the street on Oddie!

Um, this place is nice and updated.  Friendly check-in. Room clean, and then I see the shower.  WHY,WHY,WHY. This is about 10 min handyman job and $2 worth of caulk to make look nice! WHAT ARE MANAGENENT THINKING? This is like a cockroach on a perfectly cooked filet mignon.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We only give this motel 2 stars because of the family facilities. However, for $102.00 the room is not worth it! No, refrigerator or microwave and the bed definitely needs replacing. Carpet needed a good cleaning too. We've slept in Super 8's nicer that this for half the price. For this money go to PeachTree.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I ordered at the drive through and the service was good & I asked to use the rest room. She warmly said yes that's fine. When I entered I was startled by a rude male employee walking towards me yelling that they're dinning area was closed. I felt like I committed a crime & not that I supported the establishment.

I don't know what you guys did to the Big Mac sauce but it tasted horrible. Never buying a Big Mac again. Why can't you guys fix the ice cream machine. It never works ever. The line is also very long and I only have 30 minutes for my lunch so I'll be taking my business over to Carl's Jr. next time
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: La Viola is a cute restaurant with good service, good for a big group (which is rare in Philly). The food was just okay, pretty middle-of-the-road quality Italian food. Nothing terrible but a little pricey for what you got. The food came quickly though, the waiters were kind and accommodating.

I ordered my glasses on 12/12/16. Still waiting for them and the amount of excuses and finger pointing on who's fault it is, is quite astonishing. What do they do for me? Nothing! They say they cannot do anything to compensate me for my time and headaches waiting for my glasses.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This place is a treasure! The Mussels red and clams white sauce were outstanding. I got a veal dish and my wife got the dolce vita pasta dish both were out of this world. I usually get skeptical with ordering veal out ,but this place does it right! I can't wait to try some other recommendations.

Visiting this place was on the top 5 things to do in New Orleans during our visit. Yes due in part because of Bar Rescue. I was so disappointed. I ordered The Resurrection and it tasted watered-down there was no flavor. I felt so sad. Especially after paying $15.

Our first meal here was fabulous. Our second was fine, but the servings were way too large and not as flavorful as our first visit. Our last visit  in September I ordered the chicken piccata and it was so bland and the chicken rubbery I couldn't eat it.  Next time we go I will stick with their pasta dishes.

This is the best Mexican food in the north valley's! The atmosphere is always fun. Sometimes they have live music and in the summer they have a beautiful patio. It's by far the prettiest place in lemon valley. Then the food... Excellent. All of it. I can't even count how many times I've been here.

The hotel has a strong canvas smell like you're sleeping in a military tent or old sleeping bag. The staff seems nice the key wouldn't let me into the concierge floor and I had a repeatedly go back down to the front desk and have them reprogram my card key.   Room service which now comes in a bag.    Bathtub drain was very slow.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Fantastic Japanese restaurant. Authentic.  The sushi is fantastic and they usually carry the more rare items such as Toro and Uni. The price for the quality of sushi you receive is of great value.  This will be a normal staple for me when I'm in this area.

Order $90.00 worth of pizza and they won't even comp a drink while I wait for the pizzas to be done that were ordered and they should have already been ready. I was the only one there, maybe a little customer service would go a lot further and get people in the door.

I would comment on the food, but never got it. After 35 minutes of waiting for a $15 salad, it never came. I was at the bar and had a water that was never refilled. I wanted to order something else, but decided that I there was no reason to give my money to such a poorly run establishment. I will not go back.

It has good pressure but the foaming brush was horrible it barely put out any soap I did better with the high pressure soap wand and using the brush separate very difficult to do I had to re wash my car twice because with the foaming brush not working it was really bad

Fairly good Subway, they make good sandwiches at this location and staff is friendly. 
My only complaint is that they blast the music so loud you have to yell your order and repeat what you say several times because they can't hear you. 
I've come in different times in the day and the music is always loud.

I work near this place and frequent it often on my lunch break. The sushi is delicious. The atmosphere is nice and calm during the day. Never visited there at night but I would assume it be the same. Great place to get together with friends. I definitely would recommend.

Waited at the bar to order drinks for 5 mins or so. Bartender took my order. Served 4 other people at the bar. Got 1 drink. Served 2 more people then got the other drink. Then walked away and started cashing out a group that walked up to the bar. I gave up and went back to my friend. She dropped the drinks off 5 mins later.

My brother and dad started coming here in the early 2000's and I have been bringing my son here since he's been 9mo. old, he's 5 now. Humphrey is an incredible, humble person with a great personality. He has such loyal customers and has made great friendships. Great customer service and awesome haircuts at affordable prices!

What an amazing restaurant!!!!! The reviews said it was very good and the menu looked promising. We didn't expect to be wow'ed by everything we were served. All of the food was cooked perfectly and their use of seasonings is excellent. Can't wait to eat here again!

I think I found my new favorite barbershop. The girl there did a great job and was able to get the four of us in the waiting room all finished in under 40 min! She was extremely nice and receptive to what we wanted. I found out she is the founder's  granddaughter.

I've been here twice this week and the sushi was very good. Service was excellent. I ordered the Chefs Special which was a King Dragon roll and it was phenomenal!  The roll was huge and packed with Lobster, spicy snow crab and asparagus dressed with some colorful roe and tasty sauces. I did not leave hungry.

This is a small dive with no ambiance. The actual sushi looks nothing like the professional photos posted on yelp. The crab lover roll is for those who love fake crab which is nobody. Lastly, there was one employee who was the sushi chef, hostess, waiter, and cook. This left service much to be desired.

There are bed bugs in this hotel! Not only that, but the sheets were not changed.
Spoke to hotel management about this. They were very very rude.
Not only did they refuse to provide treatment for the bites we received, but also made bitter remarks. The management staff should be laid off. They bring shame to the IHG brand.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: So excited to move into the Girard. The website sold me right off the bat showing how the building has so much greenery and the super cute dance video was a nice touch. Working with the Greystar team on picking out my apartment home just sealed the deal. If you are looking for luxury in Phily, this is the spot.

First time visit this morning for breakfast. Great value and food was terrific.  Asked for well done potatoes with onions and they  were crispy and delicious.  Scrapple was very tasty and cooked perfectly,  nice and crispy, not the mush you get from many other restaurants. Friendly service .will defintely go back

After reading these reviews and seeing exactly HOW many times this company will be sued... I'm staying FAR FAR FAR away from them.. I'll make sure my friends and family do the same... Nice story about them on a few Facebook pages today... They'll be out of here soon.... We won't miss them at all ;)

The worst in area. Inside constant beeping. Employees standing around, disinterested, taking breaks in plain view. Order accuracy poor. Drive up is like roulette. I don't speak getto and can't understand the order taker. Rarely is my order correct. After so long you think I'd learn.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: They suck, they will take you for every penny they can. Very unprofessional, the loan department is not knowledgable and does not follow up. Even with a loan approval you have to beg them to actually do their job. Ugh, disgusted by this local business and in this case the big box banks are better.

Terrible! The sign says $10 car wash for all types of washes. However it's a lie! It charged me $20 and it charged me TWICE! When I called the phone number above associated with the owners it just rings, no machine and no one picks up the phone. 
This car wash is an absolute scam!

BED BUGS!!!!!! And they don't care!
Alarm clock was broken. TV remote was for a different TV.  The fridge froze everything!
Very bad!  NOT DISINFECTED! Want Covid? Stay here, you'll get it!  Don't stay here unless you want to be eaten alive by bedbugs!!!!!!!!!

text:
Not a good value for your money.  Lady wanted to look up my reservation before she would open the door and let me in out of the cold??!!   WELCOME to 1975....no microwaves in the rooms!!  WTF?  Also the phone doesn't work!
There are better hotels to spend your money on.
