text: Veggies didn't seem like they were washed well/ broccoli tasted dirty, over cooked /not crunchy.  Shrimp was small whereas other similar chinese take outs put jumbo shrimp for less $. Sauce had NO flavor. White Rice wasn't even good. Price was higher than most for lunch special.

This Enterprise Rent-A-Car location does an excellent job with customer service, employee courtesy and competence!  :)  From pick-up to check-out to check-in to drop-off, we had no complaints.  All employees were helpful and friendly!  :]  Keep up the good work, Enterprise Employees!  :D

Disgusting. 

What else can you expect from Brookhaven though? Not only is the service bad, but the cashiers are very rude and unprofessional . Everything tastes like it was microwaved on high for 30 seconds, and is mushy and disgusting . Think twice before coming here!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is my new fav car rental spot. Used the app and prepaid and put in info so we could skip the line and was able to get our car and leave the lot in like 5-10mins most. Not asked multiple times about upgrading to different options or cars so that was really nice too. Will definitely be using them again for future!

A shout out to Retro Fitness and Victoria!  I love the gym and enjoy the early morning spin classes!  Victoria is also a fantastic trainer.  My daughter trains with her.  She motivates and encourages her to success.  

Thank you Retro Fitness and Victoria!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The food was excellent. The service not so much. On a laid back Sunday night out waitress was nice but did not come around often enough or bring our check quick enough to earn anything close to a 20% gratuity. Correct change was not given to a few members of our party. Other than that the atmosphere and cuisine was excellent.

This hotel is amazing and has a lot of architecture. I loved staying here . The only thing that was not so great was being by the elevator and hearing our above neighbors getting up every morning . Other than that the staff was very friendly and had many helpful tips on where to eat and go in the French quarter .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
It's always good! Gotta get the Magic sauce on them fries  
It was SUPER busy with minimal seating and room for waiting. But it's a fast food joint so not unexpected. Outdoor seating with umbrella tables available. Not super clean. Hence the 3 stars. 

But the I good is good and the staff was friendly!

It's always good! Gotta get the Magic sauce on them fries  
It was SUPER busy with minimal seating and room for waiting. But it's a fast food joint so not unexpected. Outdoor seating with umbrella tables available. Not super clean. Reason for the 3 star rating.
But the food is good and the staff was friendly.

Horrible service! Came off of highway after dog had vomited in car - no businesses except for crew - needed to use bathroom to clean up - refused to let me use the bathroom even though I explained situation- extremely rude! No hospitality! Will never go here or recommend!

Hair in salad! Called to speak to manager and the lady who answered the phone was very rude. I kindly stated my piece and she mentioned she will make another salad for me and to return the salad with the hair in it.  reselling this contaminated salad? I think I need to call and report this place.

This is our second trip back we have 4 little girls and they love this hotel.The restaurant Jimmy's is such a friendly place to eat great views the bird George is an extra the staff goes out of their way to make you feel great.Molly was so wonderful with the kids.Great service all around.Can't wait to come back.Thanks,Lisa

Stopped in for breakfast - who can mess up scrambled eggs and home fries?  This place can...I haven't had a breakfast this awful since I was on a submarine in the middle of the Atlantic eating powdered eggs.

Gross, awful, get something else...or go somewhere else if you can.

We went to spirits first when we hit bourbon streets because we saw it on Bar Rescue. We loved the skulls (we still have the cups). It was perfect to go to for our first place. It got us buzzed and in a good mood! We loved the jalapeño blue drink. Highly recommend. We went back for refills.

My friend and I normally enjoyed this place as its quality and selection had been good.

He got the jamanji roll the other day and had some wicked bad food poisoning. It's sad cause we normally have a good experience here. 

I hope they see this post and make sure their fish is fresh next time!

This is a good spot in Lakeview. The bartenders are very friendly and professional. Afternoons tends to be a local crowd but later the young people show up and it has energy. Friday's are great because they have crawfish! Don't really have a complaint. Just a really good neighborhood spot.

This is a place to pass on I paid 10.00 for a Long Island Tea smh and it was the worst drink ever and it was in a really small cup . It was supposed to be a watermelon flavor type but it tastes just like cough syrup. A waste of money and time.  DON'T ORDER LONG ISLAND TEA HERE

This is the worst wendy's in Middle Tennessee. No matter when you go, you have to wait forever in the drive through line or inside to get service. This place has been this way for years and nothing has been done. The owners need to get off their asses and do their jobs. They are ruining the wendy's name.

The guys inside are friendly and the store is clean and well-stocked.

I appreciate that they don't try to make you wear a mask.  They understand the mask mandate is not a law, and contradicts the Nuremberg Code and CA Civil Code 51. Further, why wear something that doesn't work??

Thank you Mesa Liquor for helping restore sanity!

They  were closed  on a Monday,  . Bad idea  hello do you  want to make  $ . As a customer  I'd never  recommend  a place  that isn't  open when you need it,  or want to  during the  week.  That's uncalled for . I get the point  as if it was a holiday  but its not.  It's a work week  . Would not support or suggest  going  here .

Terrible service. Always leave something out of order. Employees are rude. NEVER leave the drive thru without checking your order at least twice. They left three items out of our order tonight and put pickles on when ticket asked for no pickles. Food is almost always cold too.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Checked in, no line. Fitness room so I can workout with towels available. Room clean, linens fresh. Continental breakfast. Quiet hallways. Snack available for purchase. Bar inside hotel. Close to restaurants and gas stations. Friendly staff. Appearance clean
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I picked up breakfast while waiting for flight. Food was hot. I asked for orange juice instead of coffee and charge a $1.29 up charge  for a small. I asked why didn't I receive a med for that price. Requested a refund and went to chic-fa-la. I hate a franchise tries to overcharge you and see no issue with it.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Just skip it.  Newly renovated but room smelled like smoke, internet was better on my cell, pool was empty in June, window basically came out when we tried to air out the room,   i tired to cancel reservation but they charged the whole stay and would not refund.  Workout equipment also broken.  Go figure.....  really?
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
We love foodie restaurants and heard a lot about this menu. Neither of us were sold. The food wasn't superb and the effort to be "different" seemed to be too much. Not a spot if you're looking for romantic or intimate either. 

We prefer Edison over here and have gone back to Edison several times.

Leo's is one of Tucson's hidden gems. If you are looking for an affordable meal, incredible service, and delicious food all in one, Leo's is the place. The best bang for your buck with the experience of a place that would charge a lot more. Can't recommend it enough!

Great pizza! the service was a little slow although there weren't that many people in the place.
I haven't tried anything else, but on Monday's they have a special $10 for a pizza and salad, both are enough for 2 people and you will still have pizza to take home.

Kabuki is older, small, and pretty convenient for it's King of Prussia location, but lets face it, it's not top notch - it's fairly fresh but not amazingly tasty.  The menu could be updated and for the price they are charging it should be much higher quality sushi.

The rooms weren't very clean ie cracker crumbs on floor dead bugs and dust bunnies under beds bed skirt had something on it and caulk around soap dish was mold stained and room keys wouldn't work properly I will not be staying here again unless it is remodeled
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: It's fine from a Starbucks point-of-view, but I won't go back. Their parking lot is the worst. Since there are plenty of people other Starbucks I can go to, I'll save myself the headache of getting stuck in the long line due to one-way traffic patterns and too little space for cars to maneuver around the store.

Atmosphere including the blue Jean clad hostess set a bad first impression. Very disheartening. However the service was good and the food was great. Thus the dilema--bad atmosphere but good food, really good. Prices are a bit pricey too. I think I will return if I have a good coupon to receive a discount.

Watch out for their price scam - they'll quote a lower price per day for a vehicle than you had already reserved, but then tack on many new fees that actually make it far more expensive.  And they do it with a nice smile and a friendly demeanor to make you think they've got your best interests at heart.  They don't.

Probably the slowest service I've ever had at a subway! At one point the two people working had 7 sandwiches stacked up on the counter. It took so long to get through the line that my toasted sandwich was cold by the time I sat down at the dirty table to eat it!

This place really is amazing! Especially if you want to clean up your car very cheaply before going out. I always go there for a three dollar carwash on my way home to St. Charles County or before going to St. Louis city for the night life. It is a perfect location.

small location, and i was skeptical going into it from previous reviews. But i had a great all around experience. This was my first time ever even renting a car. I never spent more than 10 min there and the lady who helped me was super friendly and got me out on the road to work in no time.

There's nothing bad about this place whatsoever. The staff works very very hard and is very efficient. They know their beer and have specials all the time. The food is exceptional I had the devil eggs  the cod soup--Excellent. Anyone living in Cherry Hill and not visiting the farm is depriving them selves.

Ok so I would like to Atleast start off bad and end on a good note. Bad news is that I found a chunk of plastic in my soup and literally almost lost my tooth bc of it... looks like a broken spatula or something. Hurt like hell but I'm pretty understanding... the food is good but really bad first impression

Excellent service. Fantastic ice cream. Seriously impressed.

There's also a nice covered area outside that has three full sized tables, two baby tables, and two benches.

Very affordable prices. Best salted caramel pretzel I've ever had. Would highly recommend.

They stop serving breakfast at 12, coffee cups are incredibly small and waiter was too busy running everything. My boyfriend ordered the fish and chips which was 3 measly fish fillet things (8.50) and I ordered the veggie melt (8.50) which was...creative. All and all too expensive for the quality.

I have been to several restaurants in the area, the food here was by far the worst. The food was so bad my wife and I took 1 bite and just asked for the check. We went to a pizza place after. I wouldnt recommend it, but maybe I came in on the day the cook was off or something.

Vincent's was an awesome and wonderful experience! The food was delicious a little salty but nothing some cheese and pepper couldn't fix! The wine was delicious and everything about the atmosphere felt like a true Italian experience. This place is located in a cute location and has great service !

Trillium was amazing and made my birthday night extremely special! Tammy was the perfect waitress and treated my girlfriend and I amazing. The food was incredible and the service was awesome! I would highly suggest coming here again as we are planning on it very soon!

Thanks again Tammy and Trillium family !

stayed there in April while it was under serious rehab.  the first night I didn't have hot water.  the phone didn't work, and the wall outlets did not function.  Parking was a mess because of the construction.  Hopefully by the time you stay there, the renovation will be complete.  Until then, I recommend taking a pass on this one.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: OMG!!! Are you freaking kidding me??? $40 for crappy ass hot dog and  2 large Caramelos and one small caramelo??? I've had better at any south side truck for half of what you are charging!!! Canelo you should be ashamed. Never ever again !!!!!! Oh  yeah and our CaRamelos  where burnt as well!!

I have been to Fortels in Fairview Heights, IL 3 times. I went the second time because  I really was impressed with it the first time. I couldn't wait to get back down to eat there again. After the third visit I don't see going back. Don't know what happened this time, but was not impressed anymore.
