Amazing customer service. Great energy. Couldn't ask for more. The gel is so shiny and the prices kind of blew my mind  also;;; VERY FAST. I'm so use to having 2 hours taken out of my day for going to the salon, but not at prose! Thanks ladies keep up the great work!

We have been regulars of both Joey's since they opened the location at Golden Acres.  We have never had a bad meal at either location.  We also love the chicken parm, and chicken marsala. I love how you feel like family when your there. Such a warm environment! The greek salad is amazing.

Since my first 2 star review I visited again.  This time I ordered the pizza and was really happy with it.  So I definitely recommend the pizza and NOT the calzones.  The big drawback of this eatery is its small size which keeps the noise level pretty high.

Great place to have sushi. The service is good and the staff friendly. The atmosphere is fun and homey at the same time. They play fun music. The rolls are tasty, I think the raw are better than the cooked. Man on fire and Sushi 7 rolls are really good as well as the hand grenades.

If you like watered down ice coffee or burnt hot coffee and not getting exactly what you order food wise you'll love this Dunkin. The other one down the street Id rate at 3stars it's bigger and cleaner yet both places make Krispy Kreme's coffee taste great

Such a fun place to visit. It is very loud so if you are prone to headach and/or over stimulation steer clear. Other than that, it is a great place to go for dancing and drinks where you are actually engaged with the bar tenders and dancers. Drinks are affordable, and good. Not watered down or anything! Would definitely go again!

if i could give them no stars i would
chushang spicy in philly is literally the worst. i waited for take out for over an hour... to ask in another 20 minutes for a refund... that i didnt recieve until i asked 5 times. terrible customer service. i never got my food.

Food was tasty and made fresh. Ordered Oven baked Samosas, chicken wings, Shahi paneer pasta and Tandoori paneer pizza. Place is very clean, it has full bar with great beer! Also attached is games adjacent to dining area.. a fun place to go with friends and family.

The bad news first. Menu says for a medium stromboli is $12.99.. it was $17 when I got there but I was too tired to deal with it. On the positive side, very possibly the best stromboli I have ever had.. if the price was reflective on the menu I would certainly continue but I am thinking I am getting ripped off

I love Koizi, it was my main go to buffet when I was living in Florida. The dancing Krab and chicken hibachi were my favorite! The price is great ($10 for lunch) for the food and the quality is amazing! Don't leave any rolls uneatened, or else you'll be charged! That's right, don't waste food!

I've been here a couple times before and the Sashimi was very good. We live 3 blocks away so my wife and I came today for lunch. We were seated and after 20 minutes passed without even being served water was all I could take. It appears they have one lady taking care of the entire restaurant and take out orders. It's such a shame.

Got to celebrate my 21st birthday there and the staff did not disappoint at all !! The food was amazing ! Any of the Martinis were to die for ! I definitely recommend starting off with bruschetta and also ordering the calamari literally anything form their menu does not disappoint!

This place has the slowest drive-thru, ever! They're always out of items, and they never get my order right. Also, it's incredibly unprofessional when I can hear the conversation through the speaker. Also, when I opened up my bagel, I found a hair. Disgusting! New management is what this establishment needs.

I was visiting Nashville from Australia and was recommended to book The Catbird Seat. I'm so glad I did. It was a wonderful experience . The food and paired drinks were amazing! The service was second to none, with the chefs and wait staff all being very warm, friendly and cheeky! A great dining experience.

Called today cause they put a menu in my screen ripping it..manager told me yeah he got calls last week with same complaint and that he wont fix the screen. Its more imporant to ruin ppls property than to have their guys do the right thing and stick it in the door handle

We've rather enjoyed the food there every single time that we've been there. The atmosphere isn't fancy but what we're looking for is just good food. So we're happy that we found it just by driving down the road. No one told us about it, it's just close to where we live. I would recommend it.

For 10 years I have visited this location.  Over the past 2-3 years it has gone downhill.  Last night in the drive through with only 1 car ahead of me (who got 1 sack of food), it took 20 YES 20 minutes to get my food.  The response when I complained, "well our bun toaster is broken"... I will NOT go back to this location.

Excellent and attentive service. - The three times we visited this restaurant during our two visits to Tucson.  Their salsa is made fresh at table side has been outstanding. Food is tasty and then done to order.  Comfortable, warm and inviting atmosphere.  Have not Been disappointed other than too busy at the bar one time.

Don't stay here!!! They tell you about how great the rooms are but they suck!!! The view is crappy, small windows and rooms. Front desk sells lies!! They tell you the restaurant and bar is open but then when you try to get drinks you can't!!! Don't waste your money here!!! This place sucks!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I ordered chicken tacos from this location from the drive thru. I only live 5 minutes away. I got home started eating my chicken was dried out. I took it back and showed the manager the chicken she denied it and said I was wrong and that  she just made the chicken.  I haven't been back since

A lot of people I know swear by Dunkin's coffee so I decided to try it out. I went with a latte, which was definitely the worst one I've ever had. I also noticed they just pushed a 'latte' button on a machine in the back to make it. I wouldn't expect even mediocre coffeeshop-level drinks from here. First and last Dunkin experience.

I don't go there for anything else than chicken . Always good don't like bean so I order whole with extra rice some times I get the order wrong but it may be the lack of English but that still doesn't matter after you take a bite of the chicken. Be back today for sure at some point

The ice cream is poorly labeled and melting. The sign on the door and online it says the store is open. Once inside i waited 15 minutes never seeing an employee. The bathrooms are disgusting even though there is a sign inside the bathrooms claiming they are cleaned every 60 minutes or less.

Desk Clerk was nice, professional and courteous. Room was nice for the rate we paid. Only thing I didn't like was the people hanging out by the entrances and one guest had the hotel window open hanging his head out staring at whoever was coming. If it wasnt for that the stay wouldve been perfect.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Food was excellent! Got the kung poa chicken and they accommodated my requested for extra spicy. The gentleman who took my order was so pleasant and the meal was very fresh. Great quality. Lunch combo with egg roll and soup was $6.50. Forget fast food lunches come by here!

The service is great, and the sashimi is fresh. I've only given them three stars as I didn't find the maki rolls to be flavorful. The double double really did lack flavor -- you couldn't taste the beef or any other component of the dish. That said, the udon and the sashimi were great, flavorful, and fresh.

Don't keep change in your compartment because they will take it and every time I go there and get full service, I can never see through my windows and I there are still fingerprints on the Windows or Armoral, because I get my dash and doors done. But it took them stealing my toll money in order for me to stop going there.

this is Friday 1:20 pm. there was only 3 person working . one was in window and was and front desk and one was in back desk. there was not big line still they were talking themselves. and they dont care about customer . what a same we dont wanna business with is kind of bank. this is last done

Customer service is key. Pat doesn't get it. There are many other barbers in town that will make you feel welcome.  A simple hi...how are you? Maybe even a smile. It goes a long way. I haven't been to your shop in over a year and I'm still pissed off about your customer service.

The best italian meal I've had in the states.  Started with bisque and carpaccio, pasta for a main course and limoncello cake for dessert.  Food is of impecable quality and aervice was warm amd delightfully attentive.  Could not praise this place enough for our experience.

Loved their beer selection! Hospitality was amazing!Server Laurie and hostess Jerry were so fun! Loved Brussel sprouts, serving portions were very good!  Prices on the fish Friday nite specials were very good! The band and dance floor were a surprise good time. I can't wait to come back to the area and go here again!

Took car here today bc tire pressure light came on in car and stayed on after I filled tires with air. They took me without an appointment, filled tires to proper level, checked tires for nails, and drove it around to make sure light went off in car. Professional, quick, and courteous.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This location is friendly and fast. I have called for help ordering though Postmates and they were very helpful. They are busy so do tend to run out of some types of dounuts so they are not always my first choice as far as DD locations but thier drive through is fast.

This gym is close my house, but I would rather drive the extra few miles to Kenner. This one is always over packed. They want do anything about people just sitting and talking on the phone or taking selfie's on the equipment. The staff is never smiling, and when you ask for help it's not offered. This is my last time at this one.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Great hotel in a great location. Clean, comfortable beds, and quiet rooms. Microwave and fridge are very convenient. Close to many restaurants and shopping. Just minutes away from Franklin. Close to a lot of historical sites. Parking seems very safe. Good workout room and clean outdoor pool. Price reasonable.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Never had a bad experience from here. My family and I have been ordering from here since they opened forever ago. By far the tastiest and cleanest Chinese takeout in the area. Discounts for paying in cash. I love the egg foo young, and my fiance adores the chow mein. Also my favorite wonton soup and egg rolls.

Excellent, authentic-style Italian cuisine. Our waitress Arina was the best. So sweet and accommodating. We had a really great experience here from start to finish. Food was fresh and delicious! Will return next time we visit Philly! PS. order the broccoli rabe!

We went in for lunch and were greeted politely and seated. The waiter was nice but didn't ask if we wanted something to drink or mention what they offered. They are BYOB by the way. Lol. The food was good, no complaints there. Service was fast but we were the only ones there. Overall it was good. Just remember your bottle of wine!

Cozy atmosphere for a great little hometown bar. The wood stove really makes it a great place to linger over a beer or glass of wine. Juke box still has the classic country and R&B tunes to reminisce over. This is fantastic bar to relax and unwind. Thank you Mitchell's!

Like the idea of creating your own sushi roll but it is pretty expensive. I have had sushi that is better for the same price. However, I really like their ramen. I have never had ramen cooked for me in a restaurant. I would go back but it will not necessarily be my first pock

Amazing authentic mexican food! Guacamole made right in front of you, to your liking! All entries were delicious! Margaritas came in large glasses. Overall, everything was delicious and the staff was very friendly! A few options were able to be made gluten free with corn tortillas!

Upon my return to GV this winter I took my truck to be washed.  The entire passenger inside was untouched by either a vacuum or a wipe down.  Never have I been so disappointed in service.  Always in the past my vehicles have been returned to me in perfect shape.  I'll be going to the self service car wash for now.

It is so great to get sushi right when you sit down. I really enjoy not having to wait. The chefs are friendly and so willing to please. I got the Crazy Roll once and it was incredible. The included lights and dry ice. Anytime I want to wow someone, I take them there for that dish.

This place was amazing.  The food was the best Mexican food that I have had in St. Louis. All three salsas were delicious, along with the guacamole. We also tried two different types of torta (chicken and steak) as well as two different tacos (beef and steak). Would highly recommend this place if you are craving Mexican food.

Not much to add. We have been here numerous times (mostly pre COVID when they had an amazing happy hour on their burritos). Pre COVID....well, there is no more happy hour, prices are still decent, but food is just OK. BUT i love love love the rumchata martini....now, that! I would come visit them again and again.

Staff is great. Very friendly and accommodating. Peach bellini and cheese pizza were good and good portions. Red pepper flakes available upon request and bread was provided complimentary. Fountain view from outside is nice where it's a bit more of a casual environment, inside looks to be more fancy.

The tuna sashimi they gave me in my take out order was inedible.  Such a waste of money. Well fool me once. I will not be back!  You can't serve rotten fish to people!

Additionally the server that took my order was way too sick to be at work.  Really unappetizing and not appropriate when working in a restaurant.

We checked into this Best Western after leaving the terrible Royal Crescent hotel. The staff here are the main attraction. I wish I would've gotten their names to give them personal recognition. The room was modern, comfortable, and clean. The breakfast is a big plus too. The location is great.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Not bad but just boring. Not much of a selection on bagels, the breakfast sandwich was very average. Workers were generally rude and uninterested. Vietnamese coffee tastes more like just regular coffee

I do have to point out that there's not much wrong with it. It just doesn't stand out in St.Louis

Came back a second time just to be fair, service was a little better. I think they need more waitstaff so they are not so overwhelmed. The clams casino appetizer is so delicious I highly recommend it! We also had some kind of octopus appetizer, sliced this and served cold. It was fantastic... Overall food was great, service ... Eh

I love the ambiance at Vivace. The food is absolutely delicious and several of the menu items taste exactly like an Italian grandmother made them for you! Drinks are on point. Definitely a spot to have a nice dinner or date when you're craving legitimate Italian from a local restaurant!

Yes, sucked in due to the bar rescue episode. It was cool in here though they definitely held their own. Drinks were good, but the dueling piano operation was pretty awesome. Really enjoyed it, they played just about any genre of music and the woman pianist was awesome.

Finished this grande iced matcha latte with almond milk in .7 seconds! What a ripoff! Fast service but I've been FOOLED. I would recommend asking for NO ICE or ONE (1) ICE! The few drops I was able to drink were delicious but that was $5 thrown right down the toilet!

Just the best, most delicious, wonderful pizza! My family has been getting San Remo pizza for almost 20 years, it's just so good, plenty of toppings, amazing crust, and sauce. The antipasti is fabulous, the lasagna perfect. We are fans, and feel so lucky to get true New York pizza in Florida!

This use to be one of my favorite car washes but it really doesn't clean my car like it use to. I always have to do so much extra wiping after,  I might as well go to Mister Car wash for the same amount of money. And the bug remover price has gone up from $3 to $6 guess inflation happens during lovebug season ‍

Kelsey is THE BEST. I was super apprehensive to cut my hair but Kelsey made me feel so comfortable by cutting some inches but keeping the length. Seriously best haircut and blow-dry ever. Not to mention she's so cool and awesome to talk to.

Thank you SO much!

Had the crab cake appetizer, the crab crusted snapper entrée, and the bread pudding desert.  My wife had the mixed grill and the creme brule. All were as good or better than anything we've had before. The preparation and flavors of each dish were spectacular. One of the best in-hotel restaurants we've ever been to.

If you wanna get turnt up!! There drinks are strong and the hand grenade u can get frozen or on the rocks it has a secret recipe so can't really ask what's in it but it's worth it a few of these and walk down bourbon street will Have u lit! Wish I could post videos cause that's all I have

This is my favorite sushi restaurant in Metairie! I usually choose a few rolls to share with whomever I'm with. It's very good quality in my opinion and very quick service. I like the Metairie, Mid City and Uptown rolls. Next time I'm going to try the ramen when it gets cooler outside.

Good selection of whiskies, although it seems a bit bourbon-centric. Plenty of excellent scotches, blended and single malts and a very good variety of Irish whiskies. Lots of empty spots on shelves, though. With little cards saying the product is on order.

Service was very slow even though it was not very busy. Cheese dip was very thin and lacked much taste. Tacos were also very flavorless. We had the chicken, beef and pork and all needed salt and salsa to help them out.   Probably will give them another shot but it will be awhile.

This gym is consistently late in opening, staff failed to show up today to open the gym. There is currently a lot of gym members here that are very angry and upset that they have taken time out of the morning to come to the gym, and it is NOT open in time.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The cashier had a bad attitude yesterday she gave me the look of disgust and hatred and basically threw my money at me. The look one her face was kind of scary. The bad unfriendly attitude was not appreciated at all. I call it Phillytude. I also did not get my beverage.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: There are no hours posted of operation on the front entrance of this planet fitness. This place is poorly managed. They open and close without warning or properly posting hours of operation. You could make plans and they will ruin your morning because you have plans to work out and they will not be open.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Our family first time here and I must say everything we had was great! We ordered the supreme deep dish, pepperoni deep dish, chicken Alfredo, spaghetti and meatballs, and the seafood platter. Spectacular service, they definitely make you feel like home! Definitely recommend and would return for more.

So Krispy Kreme makes donuts here.  Their neon sign advertises hot, warm donuts.

So after my son had his medical appointment i treated to some Krispy Kreme.

He was munching on the donuts before I was out of the drive-thru and was very disappointed to find out  his donuts were  cold..

What an amazing place with great service! For an AYCE the quality of the food is pretty good! Didn't find a dish that I didn't like and the waitresses are so quick in delivering the food!

If you're craving just average sushi and want to eat a lot then this is your place to go!

My husband has been bugging me to try Malone's. I finally relented and glad I did. We happen to go on Monday, they run "buy one cheeseburger and half price" and decided to try. We both had the house cheeseburger, it was cooked perfectly, was juicy and tender. Service was excellent.

Between the hours of 5 PM and 5 AM there was no hot water. The entire room smelled awful of marijuana and the TV was fuzzy. Overall the staff was great but the hotel itself needs some TLC. This was not worth $100+ more like $45. Overnight parking was also insane at $42 a night.

Night of attendance 1/12/18 - 1/13/18
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have been a customer for 7+ years and have always been pleased with the service I have received. I have not experienced any issues with alterations, cleaning, etc. I felt the need to include a review since the scales were severely tipped to the negative.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: The 2 stars is because I think they think they are doing the best they can and they were cordial at the front desk though I did get differing information from different front desk people. I digress. So the other 2 star reason is because facility could really use an upgrade.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Tasty food, a bit overpriced for such a casual place with order at the counter and plastic soy sauce containers. 
There are some deals there and for football season there is a tv. $13 bento bowl and huge. The salads were delicious. Get in and get out or too go kinda place.

Lately I've been trying to purchase a vehicle, I have money in my account and on path has been declining everything, I can't even do transfers. What makes it even worse is that I've been trying to get in touch with them over a month. I'm really super pissed off. And wouldn't recommend them to anyone.

My family always gets delivery from here as it is one of the only good places nearby. The portions are really generous and the food is tasty. The pizzas are delicious. They made good suggestions and I really enjoyed the taste and presentation of the pizza. They deliver really quickly even when we order near closing time!

Small, family run business that is just great. There's really not much to say but go there and try what you want! Macaroni balls are great, Chicken Alfredo is great, and the people working there are just the best. Hardworking people doing the best they can, and the best is good!

The food was really good but the service wasn't. They made us sit on the 3rd floor and we found out later that the 2nd floor had other options that they didn't even tell us about. The 3rd floor is also more expensive so ask for a specific floor if you're coming.

Stayed here when I came down for a weekend with my husband. The place is well kept, clean and modern looking. We had a set of French doors leading to the veranda on our floor which was nice. I liked the fact it was in walking distance of all the bars and activity in the French quarter. I would recommend this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I appreciate the art, fun and creativity. However the donuts themselves aren't terrific. We had three different flavors and when you get through the clever topping, the donut itself is just meh. Won't necessarily stop me from going back, just not my favorite.

I'm biased, mind you, because my husband works the inside, and my brother was their driver for a while, but I still have to say this is the BEST place to get a case in SP, best import and craft selection around, and my hubby is helpful to EVERYONE, not just me...

Unassuming place with parking and entrance in the back. The food was tasty but inconsistent with the amount of fish/veggie per bite. Def will be back again, very reasonable prices and Friendly service. My date had the sweet potato roll and it was awesome; get it, you won't be disappointed. Also the water was filtered ;)

3 day stay. Location is central to where we needed to go. 3rd floor was quiet. Beds were ok, pillows were good. Washroom and rest of the room felt clean. The carpets need some cleaning tho. Cable was loud and clear. The fridge and coffee was a nice touch. I would recommend.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Coffee tasted delicious. The customer service was like no other business I've ever been to. The girl taking our order laughed when she started taking our order in a very rude way and then she acted like we were dumb for asking questions. I will not be returning to this location because I felt very unwanted and judged

Got the Sunday Gravy really authentic ..split it if yr not starving only thing not too stoked about was broccoli rob too salty  but short ribs meatball  sausage and gravy great! Go sit in the "backyard" awesome atomspere! Wine by the glass expensive and not a big fan of Italian wines but over all will suggest to anyone to try it!

Can't say enough good things about Don and James and the gang.  Great service.  Incredibly polite and respectful. Honest, competent and fast.  I get good prices and good service and they go out of their way to work you in if they can.

Very highly recommended.

Went there for my husband's birthday last November. My seafood pasta wasn't very good... however, our server noticed that and took it off of our bill. We had a couple of young kids with us and they didn't seem to be set up for kids. 2 stars maybe a bit rough, but bad seafood is bad seafood.

Sonobana is our FAVORITE sushi bar in town! They have my favorite rolls and my husband's favorite teriyaki sauce. Our toddler loves eating their tamagoyaki and masago, and I've never been disappointed with any meal we've had. It's helpful having the grocery store next door to pick up any Japanese foods I need for home as well!

They forgot to make my drink and took forever making it and didn't put extra stuff that I wanted ! Go to the Starbucks on magazine street it's way better and faster . Also I went @8:30 at night at this Starbucks so who ever has that shift was the ones who messed up on my order .

After hearing lots of great reviews, I decided to try it out first hand.  Waked in and thought it must be a different place in time. No masks required. Went and read a sign saying they don't enforce wearing a mask for health reasons.  Even the employees.  I'm a healthcare worker, don't need coffee this bad.

I went here based on the good reviews. 20 dollars for a wash, cut, and blow dry. When I showed May the picture, she cut it perfectly. The whole trip took less than 45 minutes for my long hair. Everyone was very nice to me! And they did massage my head as my hair was washed. It's a great little salon in Chinatown for a great price!

This review is for McDonalds at Broadway and Camino Seco although I wonder if this applies to all McDonald's. $3.39 for a small shake? Seriously? A small shake is 10 ounces and 1/4 of it was whipped topping. It was tasty but should be "Oh Wow!" for that price. I'm not buying a shake from McDonalds anymore. Ever.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I randomly drove by this food truck and gave it a try and it was absolutely amazing. I had gotten a Steak Quesadilla and a Chicken Taco and the flavor in their food was truly one of the best that I can say that I have ever tasted. These people earned my loyalty to them. I am definitely coming back.

Small portion sizes, I had to order more food to satisfy my hunger, and expensive for what you get. Not impressed. I ordered an "entree-sized" chopped salad with chicken added and it was the size of a side salad with minimal toppings, and barely any shredded chicken.

They have the BEST ice cream and water ice!
Good portions and friendly atmosphere! 
We have never been disappointed 
Open all year round
I love the fat free ice cream 
They also have a large selection of sugar free water ice!!
The employees are terrific!
Also a place to si and eat on side of parking lot

Ordered a meatball sub and their special Tuesday night spaghetti with meat sauce.  Hubby liked the sub, my spaghetti was a bit crunchy. They bake the sauce and cheese to melt on the pasta but it does get crunchy around the edges. They could use more meat in the sauce but over all not a bad meal for the price.

Stopped by after seeing tons of people walking around with these fries.  They look amazing, but the taste is average.  The flavor combos seem to be on point, but may be better if they used crinkle cut or waffle fries.  My husband said he liked the Southern Parm fries best.  Staff was friendly and quick to serve.

Drinks are great but the bartender has terrible customer service. Doesn't greet you and then wants to argue with you when she screws up your order, not once bit twice! Money or respect has no race but each time I visit she makes it out as if it does! Only between 3 and 7pm the chic that serves customer service SUX!!!!!

We have regularly ordered takeout and delivery from here over the last 6 years.  Delivery has almost always come in good time.  Food is consistent.  Wings are good. Stromboli is good value. Antipasto is good.  Really glad they kept up with delivery during COVID.  This is our goto delivery pizza place in Yardley/Morrisville.

ordered new glasses, called to find out of it.  Was told they arrived this morning. I was told open to 6 pm today. I drive 25 minutes to pick them up and they were closed.   How could they have arrived this am if closed and the call center needs to get their crap together location times. I am cancelling my order now
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I went in for a flat tire repair and ended up leaving with a new tire altogether as they said it couldn't be repaired. I've had issues before with Dobbs saying something needed to be replaced when it didn't... but it's not like I could drive it somewhere else for another opinion. Not a mask in sight, either, which was concerning.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I went here on a date, and loved it. Yes, the mozzarella sticks were from the freezer...which our waiter informed us when we ordered them. The entrees were amazing, though! I had the best chicken parm ever, and my date had a steak that was perfectly done, and and mashed potatoes with a delicious gravy!  We will definitely be back!

Went to Clearwater office no problem with the optometrist or the front desk staff but if you don't buy their glasses and all the add ons they will get rude and nasty. And god forbid you ask for a refund they will take 4-5 weeks. But they can take money out of your card in 5 seconds.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This place has the best pizza in Philadelphia. The sauce is delicious, the crust is always crispy on the outside and chewy on the inside. They're not stingy with the cheese or any of the other toppings, either. I order from them through GrubHub, and have never had an issue. Great food and great prices.

Wanted to print data sheets in the Business Center...printer don't work. Staff had to print at their work station.  That was nice and I thank them. "Sense the computers were replaced they have not worked well."  

This is a little inconvenience for the guest and staff.  Maybe management needs to know??
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Terrible. Took a cashier 5 separate tries and help from her manager to understand a simple substitution on a McMuffin. Another time I was at drive thru and no one else was in line, yet I had to lay on my horn for anyone to acknowledge me at the speaker. Morons...
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We use to live in the area and always ate here. They have updated the interior and it's very pretty. You know the Billy Joel song where he sings about the bottle of red, bottle of white at our Italian restaurant? Well, THIS is that place. It's a BYOB that is very cozy with delicious food. There is a great staff too. Don't miss it!

It's never welcoming or inviting each time i come. The people that work here look upset and not happy. It's alway awkward and not a Pleasant experience. It makes me want to refinance my car and go to a new bank. Really it doesn't even deserve that one star i gave.

My 89 year old stepfather loves this pizza. I found it rather salty, but it was tasty. We had it delivered and they didn't ring the bell or call, as instructed, so it was a bit cold. I've had better and I've had worse pizza and service, so I'll give it a solid 3.

Ordered food ahead of time to be picked up an hour later. Got here to pick up food and even received a text that food was ready but it was actually never even started. The lady at the front didn't seem to care much and just said sorry but we are just getting it started. This was my first time here and will probably be my last.

Great place. I got the shredded beef with white rice black beans and some other topping. The beef was very tender and juicy with a great seasoning. I also got chips and guacamole. The guacamole was pretty standard but the chips where thick and crispy which is the best. I definitely would come back again!

I'm from NYC , so I'm a harsh critic on food, bc I've had the best. This place never disappoints. I'm obsessed with their chicken curry. I haven't tried their sushi. The entrees are all so delish, fresh and delivered hot. We order sometimes once a week or every other week. Always good. Consistency is important. Thanks Ginza

I really liked this place. It is a nice change that they have some baked goods to include in your cup. It was not super busy, and the service was good. The selection of flavors could use some more tart ones,  but overall I enjoyed it and may come by again.

My experience is only take out, and the chopped antipasti salad is out of this world. 
I lost count at 11 ingredients.  The dressing was obviously fresh made, and delicious. $16 listed for 3. Two of us barely finished it for an entire, filling, healthy, romantic lunch. Perfect just before a little afternoon delight...

The new scanners stink!!!  Constant problems with them.  Very frustrating.  If the shopper shops there, then scans their own order and checks out, get user friendly scanners and give those of us that shop and do the job of checking out a discount.  Also do a better job of keeping the shelves stocked.

Been there four times.  Food has always been very good and cool atmosphere. Mostly good service.  Love the Gringo tacos!  Fresh + yummy.  Parking in city is a pain but free on weekend and much easier.  Safe as its feet away from Tampa PD HQ.   One of my favs.

This place is usually great but yesterday since they only had one guy to deliver for the whole restaurant at 12:00 pm my pizza arrived 2 hours after I ordered it it was cold and not good at all spent 30 dollars on lunch and it wasn't good at all, thanks but I'll order from places where they have a better customer service.

Solid workout equipment and spacious. Decent parking and never too busy to worry about exercise and time. I like this place but my wife finds it a little rude when it comes to staff. They could be a little more informed and professional. All in all I like this place and will be back.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
This place has some of the best sushi I've had since I was in Japan a few years ago. Jorge was our server and was probably the most polite server I've ever had. He bent over backwards to provide terrific service and you could tell he takes pride in his work. Give that man a raise. 

I will definitely be back.

Use to love this place and visited every time I was in St. Pete. Tried to stop by today, but apparently you can't park in their parking lot unless you are a member of some parking club? Sign actually says to Uber or walk there?!?!  Sadly went somewhere else.

Came in for a pedi and was seated right away! Was offered glass of wine or champagne, unfortunately I had to drive so I kindly declined! Recognized a worker from SB nail bar in Santa Barbara which I was pleased with his work before! I did white nail polish to match my hands! Over all pleased! Welcome new owners!!

BUY LOCAL. Small portion, unsatisfactory.

The price was good after i used the very easy to use mobile app however, the servers gave me footlongs that barely had any meat. Subway please. I love subway and my heart is broken after this flagrant. 

Will not return until my review is answered, catch me at a local shop until then.

Why is this bar still open during the COVID-19 pandemic when there is a statewide order for bars to remain closed. There are always creepy men sitting outside in the new patio area on Pardall staring at girls and catcalling. This place shows the worst side of Isla Vista.

horrible service ! most definitely DISAPPOINTED IN CUSTOMER SERVICE  NOT ENOUGH WORKES AND BAD COMMUNICATION SKILLS !! AND my sprite was flate & my fries didn't have enough salt on them .. only got da salt on the bottom of the box ?? how i'm each that mcdonald ? do better ! not only for me , but for every regular/future customers !
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Great place to stay. Beds and water pressure were good. Staff was friendly. Bar staff was really good. I would recommend to stay here. Only down side was a lot of homeless on the streets around the hotel. They have no problem asking for money. One guy got aggressive when told "no" by one of the guys with our group.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went in promptly at 9am (opening time) and was helped immediately. $20 for gel polish, no manicure. Very good price. Tam did an excellent job. I did need to shape some of my nails afterward, but not a big deal. The polish is slightly thicker in some areas, but again, minor deal. All in all a job well done.

I just got over food poisoning, and I needed something other than chicken noodle soup. 
Over the phone, the gentleman made sure I knew where they were located, and was polite. 

I just got fried rice and egg drop Soup, but it hit the spot. 
I dog sit in this area and don't live out here. This will be my main go to for Chinese

Long lines at check in. Poor room conditions. I will not stay again.
First room smelled like smoke. They did move us but the rooms u guess overall r not in the best condition. Reception is at a weird spot and even with the preferred line, the wait was so long! Was hard to keep my little one wait for that long.
Was disappointed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We are new to this area unfortunately we will not be using them again we were quoted 21.00 for a children's suit we left it. We then came back and picked it up and they charged us 4.00 more because a children's shirt did not fit in the machine so they had to wash it by hand.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: You have to get a wedding cake concrete or a wedding cake Sundae. It is sooooooo good. The cake is so moist with that delicious amaretto flavor and creamy icing. I love to get the sundae with a slice of wedding cake and three cherries. You will not be dissolved and it is a great value.

I don't understand why you get charged here for asking to replace bacon in a breakfast burrito with beans. Beans cost less than bacon. It costs a dollar for them to leave out bacon and reach for the beans? That makes no sense even tho it's not an inconvenience for them. Overcharge for things for no reason

Went through the drive through at 6:55am and was asked if I wanted to try a baked good I said no thanks then didn't hear anything for little bit so after saying hello a few times he gets on the thing and says we don't open for another 5min so I said ok and waited there then was asked to leave the drive through
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: First of all, the employees I encountered were friendly. The actual car wash was terrible. My car looked no different when it came out than when I brought it in. I purchased "The Works" for 18.00. Some other reviewers said the same thing so maybe just a terrible design for machine. Possibly the worst automatic wash I've used.

the hostess was very rude. we complained about our second drinks  being weak.  rather than just have new drinks made for us (8:00 drinks) she chose to argue that the drinks were the same.  mussels were disappointment.  brought out a saucer with a dozen small mussels.  wont go back,

This place was worth the wait in July, the rolls tasted great and lots of rolls to choose from, they serve Miso Soup & Salad before the food is brought to the table, their Hot Sake was great as well, we'll definitely be back to enjoy the food and great service!

Fist time walking by this cute hidden gem. Stopped in with my daughter and placed a to-go order, then I looked more into the men and decided to order more. The food was amazing, authentic, seasoned and the staff was friendly. I will be back very soon, so happy to finally find an authentic Mexican restaurant in my neighborhood!

What can I say about McDonald's showed up to McDonalds there's trash all in the yard told the manager about it she went she looked outside and then it still sits there as I'm leaving that's a half hour later and it's still there come on that's pretty sad...... came back an hour later and it still there
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Walked past this place while passing through Indianapolis and needed a cut so thought I'd give it a try. Must say was very pleased with the result and the general vibe of the shop. Very welcoming and the woman (sorry, forgot her name), who cut my hair did a great job. Thanks guys.

The service is very good here, and the food is good. They make a great Mandarin style lemon chicken which is probably the best thing on the menu. The ribs are also delicious. I'd give this 5 stars but since Shoprite moved in the parking can get a little hairy. Otherwise nice little place with good food.

Positives are good food and good beer.  Pizzas were uniformly excellent...though I prefer the pizza at Olio.   Salads and apps were meh.

Negatives are lackluster service, at bit of "Montecito Attitude" and a good looking, but not quite right ambiance.

Olio remains the best choice for the area.

Group of 10 on a Wednesday. Was disappointed we couldn't get the time slot we wanted but it worked out. Food was amazing.  Seafood stew was excellent. Deviled Eggs were a must have appetizer along with the calamari.   Everyone at the table enjoyed the meals.  Glenn our waiter was attentive and prompt.  Highly recommend.

I can't thank this place enough. I had surgery prior to the lockdown and couldn't handle anymore fast food. Thank goodness for Sakana and staff staying open. Not only did they feed me for a week but I lost a few pounds in the process. Support your local eateries. Thanks Sakana

Worst Chinese I've had in awhile. The fried rice tasted like it was prepared in an ash tray with way too much soy sauce. The crab rangoon were only fried wonton wrappers there was ZERO filling. The sweet and sour chicken was soggy and the sauce was jellified. Will not go back or suggest it.

I came and I was not greeted. They have a new thing where you can order yourself so I did that. Got my food fairly quickly everything was right. I went to go sit and my sandwiches were cold. The worst part of everything was the smell. It was absolutely horrible and smelled like something died in there. I won't be coming back.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
The once large portions seem to be a thing of the past, my most recent experience was disappointing. The dry pot was very small and contained about 5 measly pieces of each protein choice. What was once a shareable meal is now a personal sized pot.

We left hungry and had to go down the street and eat again.

Barely cold draft beer. Slow service (approx 7:00pm on a Thur). Hate the iPad ordering, app should be much more user friendly; or, how about go back to real people that take your order and deliver you food/beverages. Overpriced, but, so is everything else at PHL.

They have the best all you can eat sushi deal ever! Especially for lunch! The sushi isn't as good as it used to be but it's still my favorite place to eat sushi at. The wait can be long sometimes and they don't take reservations in advance which makes it difficult sometimes. I've never had a issue with them. Love this place!

Didn't expect it but, Ebisu Sushi Shack was certainly spectacular. Friendly atmosphere, great service and delicious menu items. Ebisu Sushi Shack has a great Award Winning Veggie Special Roll, give it a try I think you would love it, I certainly love it. Staff had amazing service, very helpful and accommodating. So good.

we came on Easter a very nice place, i came here a lot when I was younger, the yogurt wasn't as good as i remember but still good. because of covid, they aren't allowed to give a lot of one certain  thing. it sucks because i used to put a ton of stuff on it but now i can't. would totally go if your near.

This is a bit "off the beaten path" but is a great versatile Italian spot! Service is amazing, staff is attentive and knowledgeable. Food is fresh and delicious. Can be a place for a quick yummy dinner, or longer dinner for a date or celebratory occasion. Full bar and very nice wine selection to top it off.

Stopped in on a business trip to Tucson. Reviews looked decent. However, shocked at the below average quality.  Even the most basic rolls reminded me of grocery store sushi. What was I thinking getting Sushi in Tucson, Arizona  anyway?  Do yourself a favor and skip this place.

We've been visiting Boise for about a month and so far we have named this our favorite burger place! It's very rare that everyone in a family will agree on a place to eat, but we've yet to disagree the few times we've been here. The dbl bacon burger, fries, and fry sauce is so good.

The sandwich maker was being very skimpy on the vegetables, and I even had to ask for more spinach.  So it was a small sandwich, but my main concern is that it looks like only bologna for the meat.  I didn't ask for cheese, but as you can see, there's no variety in the meat.  So it was so-so.

Besides locking eyes with the decor of Typhoon Tom's wanted poster throughout the meal, this place was delicious, efficient, and the bathroom was wildly surprisingly upscale. Plus it's always nice to be able to order an alcoholic drink at 10am without judgment.

This place is a great place to eat in Apollo Beach. There's very few nice places to eat in Apollo Beach and this place is a nice change with good food and service. Nick I was awesome and the clams casino is the best.. The pizza is very close to the real deal. Just got back from Italy last week and the pizza is very very similar..

We recently ate here for the first time after hearing rave reviews.  The tacos were absolutely delicious and the burritos were good. I liked the corn, but the rest of the family did not. It was a little pricey for almost $5/ear, so probably won't order that again. The queso was lacking in flavor, but overall, the food is good.

Wow!   I love this place.  I have to say, after my visit to this establishment I can safely say this is my new favorite pizza. I was drawn here by the whole "secret pizza" of Las Vegas (sub par), only to find this gem in Reno!   This is a must visit after a night on the town.

So I am forgiving. And the owner was actually nice about what happened last time (previous review). He replaced my meal on a different day but I started frequenting another place. Tonight I decided to go with Rossanos again-- only for them to be completely unresponsive and disregard my order AGAIN. UNREAL.

I love this place. Because of their Surgeons team effort, my Ruby can now SEE and now long is in pain. She had cataract surgery and also bladder stone removal. It also smells fresh and clean in there too surprisingly. The front desk is super busy but they're workign as fast as they can. 24 Hours is very helpful.

If I could give this place a ZERO I WOULD. I work right next door and order the same exact thing every day by the same girl and somehow it's made incorrectly every time.  Today, the girl didn't know how to even order my drink, got the manager... and STILL WASN'T MADE RIGHT.  DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME AND MONEY ON THIS LOCATION.

This resort is older and the rooms show; however, being right on the beach for a much lower cost than others made this a great option.  The ability for the kids to walk out our back porch and be immediately on the sand was perfect.  The staff were all extremely nice, top notch.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Aptly named -classic barber shop.  The owner is the real deal -old school and raised in Santa Barbara.  Honest, great service, full service barber shop.  $19 for men's regular cut.  Walked in and instantly seated in the barbers chair Saturday afternoon.  I will be back again and again.

I ordered and paid for wine they claimed was in stock I was notified the order had arrived for pickup drove 12 miles to find out they only had 4 of the 7 bottles I had paid for. Clerk was completely rude when I asked where the rest was.  Still waiting for the credit to hit my account.  Horrible place!

Great room, large and spacious with big beds. Everything was clean and very nice, we were able to check in and out quickly. Just beware of the breakfast buffet,  it was $ 50 for two people and I'm almost certain they used powdered eggs for the scramble eggs.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Place smells like stale beer.  They have a hard time with credit cards or selling half cases.  Half of the cases I find here are way out of date.   Found a year old Pilsner Urquell and a year and a half old skunked mixed case. Prices are high for any specialty beer.

Went in looking for some bourbon. While not much allocated stuff in stock but that's to be expected in FL. John was super helpful in recommending both some store picks and some limited stock items. Prices were on par with the big box places. Items on sale were priced to move. I will be back.

1st time coming here and the sushi was good but not quite what I expected when I asked for a crunchy california roll they covered the entire roll with breading,  anyway it's not what I was expecting service was ehh, and layout makes it feel a bit akward which seemed like an afterthought.

I think this place is overrated... they don't even put chips on the table like real Mexican restaurants.., ( Cheap Ass's) food expensive for what it is .. Save your money and go to El Vez in Philadelphia we'll worth the money. I forgot the bartenders need to learn how to make Margaritas.

Well years Ago this place wasn't so bad,but walking in it smelled like urine!the place needs  some remodeling,carpets, walls,bathrooms everything!,the food isn't so bad they have hot crab,lots of options.Bit the atmosphere Makes it hard to enjoy your meal!

Fairly clean hotel but there was no hot water in the shower. The front desk didn't answer the 4 times I called down to let them know. I got through to the manager's number, but no one came up to check on it. I called about an hour later and they still didn't send anyone up. I was told the manger would be told about it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: COVID-19 compliant. Food hot and fresh but it's out of the way by the time I got the food back home it was cold. Google GPS made it seem like the place was a skip in a hop. But driving through all the traffic lights to avoid paying tolls. They don't have a lot locations in Tampa, that was the closet one from hotel.

Had my oil changed there twice, but also have driven through there many times and no one is available to give any service.  Very confusing because you don't know if there's anyone available, on a weekday!  The car wash is definitely not effective, the last time I washed my car there I went straight to another wash shop.  Avoid.

We went on a Sunday evening, so it wasn't too busy but not empty either. Host and server were friendly. We ordered the spaghetti with meatballs and a pizza. Both came out in about 10 minutes...WAY too fast to be fresh. My dish (Spaghetti) was extremely dry and I could tell that it had been under some sort of heat lamp to keep warm.

For those of us that need a sushi fix every couple of weeks, this is the spot.  Only better sushi I have had was in LA.  Your greeted as you come in and the good service never let's down.  Check their saki list. If you never tried high end saki, you are in for a treat.  Fresh fish, good saki, life is good.

Just ordered 2 medium pizzas, one veggie deep dish and one keto sausage. Good but not the best I have had ( that description sounds eerily similar to how I would describe my ex!) Haha! Anyways, I would be willing to give it another try ( the pizza never my ex) and I am very curious about some of their appetizers and salads as well!

This place had a lot of choices and even new ones I've never had. Kudos to the Mickey Mouse and Donald Duck nigiris. They were really good and delicious. But the reason for the 3 stars is the fact that the service was not as fast and the chef kept asking me what I want next when I still have food in my mouth.

This place is decent, but not so friendly. Had one dress shirt and a blazer dry cleaned here, they did the job and I got to choose when to pick it up within 3 days so wasnt so bad will come here again only because it's at the corner of where here I live. Parking is awkward there so be careful, is next to a wawa.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Well we waited for 50mins for our food. They were busy so a wait was cool, but 50mins? Not cool. Once we got the food it was very good and delicious. The bartender was courteous and friendly and liked the environment. Because of the excessive long wait I won't be back

I went to dunkin donuts everyday to use their wifi they falsely accused me for not buying their beverages and food the people in there were rude as hell stereotypes of people because I am African American I see homeless people in there most of the time , so I got kicked out just for taking to a homeless person

Loved this diner. Tastiest roast beef sandwich I've had in Florida. Dinner came with Cole slaw, French fries & onion rings all very good. They also make a great milkshake. You name the flavor & they make it. Good portions and prices were good. I will be back.

Phenomenal Italian food.  As good as you would get in the North End of Boston if not better.  Make a reservation to make sure you get a seat.  

If there are four or more consider getting the Bada Bing as an appetizer.

You never know who you will see when you are at this wonderful little spot.

This how I get my mornings started as sippin is believing with a hazelnut ice coffee and grilled cheese. This is by far my favorite 2 items to order no other location can hook me up then store # 351519. The service is superb and staff is amazing no matter when I visit.

Bunch of young girls with horrible, nonchalant customer service. I ordered a caramel iced coffee which they put EXTRA sugar in and I didn't even ask for sugar, cold, UNCOOKED hash browns that we had to go around and get because they forgot and no napkins in the bag.

Great service, very nice people! I have been going there for over 15 years with same owners...

They have always listen to what I need and I detail my cars every 3 months.

The regular car wash is good value, as well as works, and Ultimate and if they ever do a poor job the will re do for free to questions asked!

UPDATE: 
 I called and talked to the manager, he was very concerned and was shocked with my experience. He sent me a gift card for a free mani or pedi, I was pleased with the pedi, the nail technician knew what she was doing, and completed the pedi very well and in a timely fashion without making me feel rushed.

Not impressed at all. Ordered from a (very rude waitress) a taco and shrimp with garlic. The shrimp came out over cooked and tasted very odd. I ate one bite and won't touch it again. The taco was okay, I asked for some sour cream but never got any. Would not return here.

Didn't like it here. Couldn't understand the doctor and they kept trying to up-sell us.

The woman at the front was nice, and so was the tech. 

However, after repeated calls dealing with the office manager, I still can't get a letter from them so I can submit to get the micro chip info updated. 

Won't be going back.

Showed up 2 and a half hours before their listed closing time and they had already locked the doors for the evening. We had driven 35 minutes to meet friends there and were not pleased that they wouldn't let us in, when it was clearly listed online that they should still be open. Will not be returning.

Super casual, a little on the divey side, but hey, if the price is right and the food is awesome, who cares!  Sushi doesn't get any better than this for this price (happy hour).  I admit I am reluctant to write a review because I don't want everyone going there!

Delicious burgers, ice cold beer and I like that I can get a side salad instead of fries. Nicest staff--my husband left his phone and sunglasses on the bar and they found us outside about to drive off and gave them to him. Another reason we love this little place!

Vickie and Eddie very professional and know their business.  Barber shops everywhere hurry through a haircut, I don't like this.  I like the fact Eddie takes his time, pays attention to detail and in general I enjoy conversing with him, and Vickie toooooooo !

They bill your insurance for everything incorrectly and hold up your benefits so you cant use your vision benefits anywhere else. Terrible selection that feels cheap. Just go to Pearle Vision in Seminole mall across the street. Much better service and will help fix your insurance. Especially if you have VSP vision insurance.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I am grateful to Boulevard Animal Hospital for its kind, caring staff, but most of all for Dawn Urioste, DVM.  Dr. Dawn embodies everything one looks for in a veterinarian.  She approaches her patients with skill, diligence, and most importantly, with love.  I can think of no better vet in the Philadelphia area.

We found the bed a bit stiff for our liking. The TV really didn't work so well as we could only actually see a couple channels, the rest we could only hear. The elevator door was a bit noisy and scary? Breakfast costs were not completely explained to me, they need to be a little more clear.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Thank you fie the amazing customer service from Debbie!! Found out two bags were missing from Instacart order. Live in downtown St Pete and was going to drive to get them. Instead Debbie went out of her way to bring groceries. Thank you so much for going above and beyond!!!

Consistently screws up my door dash orders- forgets sauce for nuggets and swaps apple pies for strawberry ones. There's no accountability or way to correct it. I have had zero problems with other restaurants when using door dash. I won't be ordering from this location again.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: ZERO STARS!!!! There is black mold in the soda fountain drink spouts. It is so much build up, that it look like it has never been cleaned. I know this, because I have been a health inspector in another state. This is disgusting! Thanks for reminding me how nasty it is to eat out!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Great location . Pet friendly. Staff not so much. 

I asked for dog bowl at check in and was met with scowls and told they didn't have them. Odd because I stay in aloft properties frequently and have gotten dog bowls every time.

Parking is ridiculous and they know they have their guests over the barrel
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Want to work out in a freezer? This location is for you. For the past 5 weeks the temp in the morning has been 59 degrees. That's in the gym....not outside. Why have the A/C running when it's 35 degrees outside? Very uncomfortable environment. 
On a positive note, Reilly at the front desk is fantastic- always friendly!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Took my Tacoma in to have front end inspected after experiencing problem. Mechanic inspected and found no problems. Didn't charge me!  Super professional. They just gained the future business of a family with five cars. Support this local auto mechanic!  I will!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Love Arby's but y'all gotta clean the food counter. There is a window so customers can see the sandwiches being made and it was nasty. Roast beef laying directly on the nasty counter. Come on!  Brand new and already nasty. Brought my child and they wouldn't even eat after seeing.

OK So, our family of critters ( dogs and cats) have been going to Jefferson Animal Hospital for over 50 years. Yes, 50 years. We love this place. Gentle, caring, professional. They really treat everyone like family.

Don't let the "outside" fool you. You can't always judge a book by its cover. Try em, you'll like em.

Says the drive thru closes at 2am multiple times coming here no later than 1:45am to no service and when I'd get there before 1:45 there would be an obvious attitude from the man taking orders and there was no meat for any "big burgers" whatever that means

I ordered a pizza on seamless and the time estimate was an hour or a little bit more. An hour later they called me to tell me they wouldn't be able to get to me tonight. Why they couldn't tell me an hour earlier is beyond me because now everything else is closed.

Food consistently good but they give you less wontons and smaller portions when you eat in and charge the same as when you take out. You would think that they save money on containers so it makes no sense why. When you add the cost of a tip, it's not feasible to dine in.

Someone removed my first review that I posted about my experience with Enterprise. Second review: They said I brought the car back with damage. There wasn't any damage to the car when I returned it to them. If there was damage the attendants did it at Enterprise after the car was returned!

Charged me 3X the advertised price for an oil change, and 2X the going rate for a new battery. Tried to push other repairs on me that sounded suspect. Great job, Autofix, you got a few extra bucks out of me in exchange for my never going back again and recommending to everyone to stay away from your ripoff shop.

really crappy food.ordered eggs over light with sausage and toast.one egg was hardly cooked the other was hard as a rock.sausage was hard and toast was burned.used to eat there all the time.ladies room was really dirty.employees just stand around talking.they forgot our silverware and straws.

My first visit.  The food was good but the service really let this place down.  Not the servers fault, she was busy. Really had to chase a staff member down to get water, a drink and the check.  It's not inexpensive and the setting is really great,  but the service level has to match.

Great food. Horrible horrible horrible service. Staff is friendly but not efficient. Been twice in last 2 weeks. Had to wait 10/15 minutes extra for pep sticks. Can these not be made up ahead of time?! Placed order online and waited 15 later minutes when I arrived for pickup. Won't be back.

This Italian restaurant takes me back to Brooklyn, New York. The Sicilian pizza is phenomenal, their garlic knots are probably the best I've ever tasted, and their Jamaican Beef Patties are mouthwatering. I live about 45 minutes away but trust when I say that I will definitely be returning!

Staff is very disorganized. They ignore there customers and continue on with there own personal conversations. I know there a busy location but they take forever to get you your drink. Might need to reevaluate there staff because they don't seem very proficient.

This is by far the best frozen yogurt shop I have been to. The owners couldn't have been more welcoming. The yogurt was great quality and their topping selections were very good. No corners were cut! Prices were below typical yogurt shops. I highly recommend.

They were accommodating and able to serve me their fish and chips even though it was not on the Sunday's Menu.  The fish is of good quality which is hard to find in Tucson!  The coleslaw was drab and too much celery seed in the vinaigrette it was bathed in!  Service was average. I found the bar prices on the high side.

I live in Dallas and I've never been to Woodlands (or Florida), but Dr. Kitz used to practice in Dallas and I remember her very well because I've had lots of pets and lots of vets and Dr. Kitz is the ONLY smart one I have ever had thus far, and it's been several years since she left here.

Sitting at the bar in lobby right now with wife and sister in law, waitress brought us two menus for three people then never came back. What's the point of even having a waitress if she can't do that simple task? Don't waste your time drinking or eating here. Go down the street first.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great food. Never had a bad experience. The fajitas are amazing. The margaritas are very good and service is good. Chimichangas are good as. Go early they always have nice crowd. The frozen strawberry margarita is a must as for tanjin spiced rim instead of salt.

Yelp says this place opens at 9AM on a Saturday. I showed up at 9:30, and... it was closed. Now, I'd blame Yelp for this, but the sign in the window on the door clearly says that the place actually opens at 8 on Saturdays, yet it still was not open. I won't be wasting any more time trying to figure out when they're actually open.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Terrible. Hostess seated us and we waited waited waited and no server. We were only having breakfast buffet. I asked hostess if we fixed our own drinks and she apologized and brought us drinks. NEVER had a server come by for refills. Saw several but moved like zombies. Needs new management or be shut down.

They don't abide by their store hours. It's very frustrating when going by a schedule and to see that they're not open when they say they're supposed to be. Don't say you open at 10 am when in fact you open at 11. They say me waiting outside as well and didn't open the door. I'd rather drive an extra 10 min to go to another subway.

We found this delicious restaurant. The meats are well flavored, the service is fast and I love the condiment and salsa bar. On my last visit, I tried the shrimp burrito and I think I found a new favorite food. I highly recommend eating at this restaurant if you are in the area.

I've been with this gym for sometime I loved how it would be open 24 hours but now unfortunately they close at 9 and that's exactly when I'm off work I'm still paying $40 a month waiting for them to reopen their hours I'd appreciate it if they can find some exceptions for the people that want to work out later in the night
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Cannot say enough good things about this place. The food is amazing. Hands down my favorite Italian in the area to go to regularly. I've not had a bad dish, and I've been going for years. My go-to's are: chopped antipasto, Italian wedding soup, baked ziti, gnocchi Sorrento, and the garlic rolls that come standard!

The Mexican rolls were amazing! The only thing is the dynamite roll tasted weird and something seemed expired! But they switched it out for me at no cost! Everything else was delicious! They gave me no problem when I explained the dynamite roll tasted weird! Would totally go again , the Mexican rolls were something special!

Very, very poor experience here, two times too many. Both times my drink was wrong, and not to mention their manager Justin comes off as un professional, frazzled, and rude. I will not be back to this CB&TL. There is a Starbucks across the street where my money is much better spent.

Sushi was great! Good selection for their all you can eat menu. However, when we checked-in on Yelp for the 15% off your entire check and showed the ticket to the waitress, she told us that we couldn't use it for sushi. Seems a little ridiculous to offer 15% off then not accept it.

Walked in the door and the shift manager was yelling at seemed like everyone. Had to wait a long time to get helped at the counter and then the food was barely warm. Upside the restaurant was clean. That's why it got 2 stars. Go somewhere else is my advice.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Average but better quality than China King up the street.
I could tell they pre made my fried rice by how not moist it was. The chicken was freshly made. The crab rangoons were not they were probably sitting above the dryer they weren't hot but they weren't completely cold they were kept sort of warm.

Love this place, JUST GOT MY FILL IN, AMAZING!!!! They do pedicures and eyebrows beautifully too, stop on in, you'll love it here too, plus there is never a wait.. I buy gift certificates here,all the time, it's me and my daughters favorite and only nail place. Id give it 100 stars if I could. ‍

The service and food was better than I expected especially with the reviews.  My server was very helpful and knowledgeable about the menu.  I chose the tilapia which came with soup, salad, and a side dish.  It was worth the short drive from my house and I plan to go back again.

Pretty kool atmosphere and layout but will be better in the summer to take advantage of the outside deck. Serious call out is that they can't make a chocolate martini? "We don't carry the ingredients" Seriously, no contemporary bar today cannot make a chocolate martini. Basic.

This place is amazing!! Michael Corbett the assistant manager was extremely helpful and kind to my boyfriend and I. I would highly recommend this place for any of your car needs. We got a new tire there for a reasonable price and quick service. I will be coming back!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We had dinner last night with friends. Each person ordered something different. We were pleased with everything. We decided that we would be back very soon. Our server was great. I have had lunch there with friends and everyone was happy with the food and service. Carol

The pizza is decent but overpriced. Don't bother veering off the pizza area of the menu as the portions are incredibly small for what you pay.  With a number of options a short distance away in downtown Kirkwood, do yourself a favor and go to one of them before Fortel's.

Need a Wendy's in this area ! Can't remember the last time I was pulled up and parked for food there and the service is better. However on the bright side though, Chrishelle is the only smiling employee in the drive thru. She's upbeat and tries hard to be pleasant with the customer. So kudos to her. She should be a manager.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I would give it a zero if I could. Waited 20 mins for the server to take out order. She didn't even tell us the specials. 20 mins no food. The people next to us that just waked and ordered got there order in under 10 mins.  We waited another 10 mins nothing.

If it wasn't for the staff, I would have given the hotel one star. The hotel is in desperate need of a good cleaning and a total makeover. The stairs have dirt and dust all over them. The rugs in the rooms have hills and valleys all over them. I highly recommend looking for a different hotel for your stay in Philly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Mark, Josh and Glen are the very best! They have turned my 77'Int'l Scout into a dream machine with care and always fair. When they feel I need extra help, they gladly give the best connections/ recommendations. They take care of my sons Jeep, always responsive, always best quality. Truly a 5 star recommendation!!

We are just visiting some friends in town and wanted Chinese delivery. Loved the option of ordering online but it took almost an hour for our food to arrive. The cheese wontons were absolutely AMAZING but we were a little disappointed with everything else...shrimp tasted old and just nothing too great about the rest of the food.

"Beautiful hotel", but dirty carpet (need to be replaced new one). 

Checked in 2:45 pm, but room is not ready waiting housekeeping for 45 minutes. The front desk lady's customer service skill is like the one in Motel *number*.

Good bye to this beautiful one.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Went last night with friends for the first time. Everything was wonderful. They even made my friend and I something not even on the menu. The prices were good for all the food we had.


We will go back again soon, even with the difficult on street parking .

OK. A theme restaurant. We ate in the car in the restaurant. It's a chuckle and a burger. Service was good. Food was good. Burger and fries passable. It's just a fun place that doesn't take itself too seriously. $1.00 PBR's. So for $4.00 the place starts to transform. $6.00 and it's miss the plane and dance on the hood of the car.

My daughter and I needed a pedicure after painting fences and laying pavers. It was early morning Andy & Cindy opened early for us. They bought the nail salon and remodeled. The chairs are brand new and WONDERFUL also have a hand massage built in. It's COVID clean and atmosphere is calming.

I dislike rental car companies in general, but chose Alamo because it has a Skip the Counter service that allows you to proceed directly to the rental car kiosk and pick up your car.  It takes about 5 minutes and is wonderful.  Our car wasn't the best, so I would say don't get a Kia Niro.  That was not a great car.

I normally frequent this nail salon but today it wasn't a great experience. There were only 3ish nail techs and I'm sure one is not really a tech but a fill-in. Customer Service was subpar and every time a request was made it was like I was irritating them. I ended up taking my services to another nail tech in the area.

Hello Tim F., Based on your response to my wife's review it doesn't surprise me that you made the decision to keep your gym open, which needlessly put the health of your staff and members at risk.  Your response and interaction with clients is the reason we will be canceling our three memberships.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I knew something was wrong when I placed the order they said ready in 5 minutes. Lo Mein was mushy and shrimp were soggy. The shrimp toast tasty odd, like old pork so we had to throw out. 
Lastly we were sick all through the night. Need I say more. 
Be cautious with this place.

Do not go to Fletchers. They are running a scam. They are advertising 2 free tires, if you buy two, but this is baloney. You DO NOT get 2 free tires if you buy two. I don't how they can get away with this, because it's a total sham. I would not recommend this business to anyone, unless you want to get taken.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This place is DISGUSTING. That's not a missed cleaning! That's build-up. No coffee maker in the room either. Front desk lady was rude. Do NOT stay here. Terrible customer service as well when the BBB tried to contact them on my behalf. They ignored the BBB. Stay elsewhere!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: First time eating here so maybe it was a fluke, but the Gringa quesadillas were so greasy we couldn't finish them.  Oil poured all over the plate.  It tasted ok, maybe a bit more salt than I'm used to.  Seemed fairly clean and the people were nice enough.  But I don't think I'll go back.

Why are they so expensive? My wife had a eyeglass allowance of $260.00 for eyeglasses and after everything was done a balance of another $260.00 was due. Needless to say we did not buy. 
Remember: Their all on commission and upselling is what they do!


Ok thanks customer service.  Need an address.
