text: I had a car reserved here for my trip to Tampa the area. I ubered there from the airport. My flight arrival to Tampa was a little delayed and I arrived to the Enterprise location at exactly 3:00 which was also their closing time. The doors were locked and no one in sight. WILL NEVER USE THIS LOCATION AGAIN!!

If you're a party of two plan on having company, cause they are gonna seat you side by side (I do mean side by side) to the other parties of two. 

The tip is 20% mandatory on menu..... So don't question it, cause they will pull out the menu and show you the fine print. 

Don't eat Italian in New Orleans !!!!!

The food was horrible, the service was so completely rude. I have never been treated the way I was in this restaurant! Waiters that WORK at the restaurant got my phone number and started texting me vulgar disgusting photos. Overall extremely disappointing and dissatisfied. DO BETTER!!!

Oh and I forgot to mention in the previous review....the hair dryer was also sticky and dirty in our room. One of the light bulbs in the bathroom was also out. What a place. This place really shouldn't be in business. I truly see this place as a "rent by the hour" type of hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This location is consistent. Consistently rude, slow, and not up to standards. The food is ok, though. I have visited on numerous occasions because it it on the way home, and I keep thinking it will get better. I'll update this review if something changes, but for now it is some of the worst service I have ever received.

The food is good , if u have hours to wait for it !  They are Always understaffed like they aren't expecting customers I guess ‼ Anything u need , u have to ask for because the waiters are too busy to ask u what u want . I've been here several times and it's the worst of All the Sahms around ‼

After two years waiting for this place to open my husband and I were really excited to see it had finally opened. We pull in, parking lot is full, open sign is lit up... But they are currently closed for "improvements". I give up with this place. I was really looking forward to it as I've been to the Orlando location.

Niche is the type of place that makes someone new to St. Louis think, "you know, I could make it work here."  Everything we had was wonderful.  The decor is perfectly modern.  The lighting and atmosphere are perfect - perfect for a romantic meal or a fun group dinner.

Meh. Tried three times during the weekend they were  doing gingerbread cheesecake donuts they never had them  once and blamed the other crew. They have coupons that say ANY dozen donuts for $7 then say ANY doesn't mean ANY.....Not impressed by their glazed donuts they're just sugar bombs

The toll house pie is fantastic!  The food is very good- I recommend the short rib grilled cheese sandwich. The service was great.  They were dealing with a large private party and a full restaurant and didn't drop a beat.  Did I mention the incredible toll house pie with ice cream and a fudgy chocolate sauce?

Terrible experience.  Verified pricing before leaving cleaning; yet bill at pick-up was significantly higher---and the workmanship was awful.  Left the items for a redo but 2nd cleaning was no better--as if they had not been re-cleaned; however the bill was less.  Would never take clothes there again.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Such a great little tucked away BYOB that I'm so thankful to stumble upon. They're grilled calamari was enough for me to go back again the next week. Everything from the appetizers to dessert was delicious. Don't know how this place isn't constantly crowded but works out well for me!

Awful service! Arrived 20 minutes before closing, the employee didn't try to take my order but instead called me boss stating he was waiting on a manager and was closed. This is terrible service! The company should be open for stated hours plus employee was very rude!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I do not have high expectations from Chinese food in Nashville.  With absolutely no disrespect meant to the town which I visit frequently and like very much, there just not a large enough selection for me to expect excellence.  

I ate at Chinatown tonight, and found it very enjoyable.  My

Disappointed with the amount of meat that is in their meals.  Food is tasty, but needs more protein.  The meat in hot and spicy beef and chicken chop suey is chopped so fine you can't taste it. It is mostly vegetables.  Don't cut corner your one of the few in Dunedin that is good.

I'm always used to getting the five dollar car wash. today I decided to do the $15 car wash and it scratched up my whole entire tires all four of them. The guy in front of me had to do an insurance claim because of his one tire. Loved this location till now

Not only were my tortillas cold when I came to pick them up from my order , I asked the cashier if they were fresh and she said no, they ate yesterday's tortillas! I can't believe they would not give me freshly made. Also, I've been here twice, and both times, my food is cold! Ugh.. not good food or service!

Service was great and the bruschetta was delicious the bread was dry but luckily it was complimentary.. my husband had the lasagna and it definitely tasted homemade he was very satisfied... I had the penne ala vodka and it was the best I had in the Tampa are.... we will definitely be back

Nice staff, great location if going to the Fox to see a show. Used to be great food, very tasty. I think with the new management the quality of the food has gone way down. Everything was very bland for the price.  Have to find a new place to go now before seeing a show.

We were one of two couples there and the food took much too long for an empty restaurant. Not only was my steak mostly fat but my fiancé within an hour of eating there was vomiting up his crab cake. I will never go there again nor will I recommend it to anyone. I would give zero stars if I could.

Ate at this place last week on Sunday at 4:30pm, looks like drive though only open?Very good food they had some hiccups on my order they gave me the wrong order for my green burrito and my chipotle beef taco came with this Ganic gristle in it, but even with the mess up I'm still going back, to re try.

Horrible service and the food wasn't good. We ate the Trio Sampler appetizer platter and gumbo. I was sick all night with stomach cramps and diarrhea. The manager informed me that food poisoning wouldn't come on so quickly, which is totally wrong and displayed terrible customer service. I do not recommend this place!

Bar was not very full on a Thursday night when we got there.  The resurrection drink was pretty good,  and after one I was feeling pretty good,  now for the reason for the three stars.  The piano players has no personality,  and could not play today's music.  I mean when you go to howl at the moon there is a good mix of music.

The service was poor.  The waitress keeps on asking how things are going. All we wanted to do was eat in peace and quiet.  The waitress had an IQ of a negative number.

The chicken platter took so long to come out of the kitchen. I just don't understand why a simple dish takes so long. 

We will not go back.

Great experience. I made an appointment walk right in. Got a much needed pedicure. Brittany is such a great person to talk with. Very energetic and funny. She takes time to perfect her work! Love it. And love my toes! They are so pretty and cheap!! Definitely going back soon!

Low quality sushi place. I've had better Publix sushi than this. 

1. Low quality rice. Too hard and not soft enough. 

2. Fish tasted old. Texture wasn't smooth and clean cut. 

3. Took 20min to her 3 rolls of sushi. 

4. One waiter handling 6+ customers at once.

This hotel is very nice looking outside but very very dated inside. The beds are awful the shower heads have lime build up and have hardly any water pressure. The keys seem to constantly lose the programming. The mini fridge was missing the freezer door. And the lighting is very dated.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We decided to eat some Mexican food before flying out of Tampa. It isn't in a great part of town but don't let that stop you from eating here. Service and food very good. I had the steak chimichanga and my wife had enchiladas. I would recommend this place.

Dr. Flanagan is a good doctor, but support staff (except the lady who fits the glasses - she is great) is terrible. Dr. Flanagan needs to understand that her support staff is failing her. I called over 12 times to get a copy of my prescription... I still do not have it, tomorrow will be call #13.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I am on my second cup of coffee and my server has stopped by twice to say "I will be right back " and still has not taken my order. Trisha is taking care of 6 tables?  Busy dropping off extra napkins and arranging silverware on empty tables. Horrible service.

First time trying today, take out. Really authentic flavors and generous portions. 3 of us had burritos, one had the huevos/chorizo torta and I had tacos al pastor. Everything delicious. Everything on spicy side so be warned. Great counter service. Will be back for dine in (cute and very clean inside)

Small service center with very qualified technicians.  And they are very honest.   Pleasant people to deal with.   They serviced my Smart car for about 1/3 the price of what the Smart center wanted.  Good people. I have referred family and friends to them.

Came here because I was told this place was the best in town. This place has all you can eat. It seems that every roll I ordered was more rice then fish. Even the nigiri tasted old. They do have great service but the service alone does not make up for the food. I gave this place a try but they all can't be winners.

This company is the worst.  They seem to only find ways to charge you fees.   Getting a personal loan from them was the worst mistake I have ever made financially.  If you want my advice do your banking at a real bank and not this sad exscuse of a company pretending to be a bank.

The coffee was good. My only complaint would be the seating. If you are going with more than one other person or planning on doing work with someone else with laptops, the tables are not big enough. There is one larger table but the chairs for that are uncomfortable.

If ya'll ever down in New Orleans, check out this place for some great entertainment.  This place always seems to have a great crowd and usually an awesome band playing some cajun and Zydeco music.    We strolled in this place to check it out and ended up staying for quite a long time.  Good clean fun.

Your represent the voice of America.  Good for you.  My son says you have the best chicken tenders in town and I can always go for a good ole Bud bud.  God bless you and God bless America.  (run some promotions right now... good time to do that... no jingles just 1/2 off appetizers would be a good one)

Great little dive, with amazing food!  I'm a huge supporter of local business, and this is one of my favorites.  Fun atmosphere-laid back, no frills, and live music on the weekends.  When we have visitors in from out of town, we always bring them here, and they always want to come back.

Everything is a great presentation.  We did not think this little place that you would think like a small deli would be this good.  Very good deserts all made in house.

I have eaten here 4 days this week as I am here for work.  Normally I would go to another restaurant after 2 days but they also have a daily special.

One time deal.   This is not authentic, it's Americanized Mexican food.  Enchiladas had chopped chicken, and melted mont. Jack and cheddar cheese on top, no queso fresco, no cotija.  Chips were stale and salsa was a mix of canned tomato sauce doctored up with tomatoes and onions.  Very disappointing.

Relatively new Chinese restaurant in my neighborhood...got a flyer on my door so decided to try their takeout service. I ordered online, which was quick and easy...reasonable 5.00 delivery charge. 

The food arrived in about 45 minutes...it was piping hot, well packaged and VERY tasty...I definitely will be using them again!

My family member has been living   here  almost two years they are raising their  rent again. They never  fix anything you  need  fixed they just  don't care. They  want you to pay almost 500 a month for a small studio the prices now are to high. The new management are something else  very rude not helpful or nice in any way

Will always choose dunkin over Starbucks! The drive-thru is always fast and efficient, they've never messed up my order and the donuts always taste fresh no matter what time you get them. The coffee they have is always fresh as well and the inside is clean and inviting.

Great food and service.  Waiter was fantastic and explained the food.  We got street tacos- pork, steak and chicken.  All great but our personal favorites were the steak and chicken.  We had the chicken sandwich as well and that was good.  Salsa was super yummy and very fresh!

Cullen, I think his name was, was incredibly nice. He provided a friendly and grate service. He engaged in conversation with our large group and was a cool guy overall.

The restaurant is in a pretty cool location. It is just before the Eldorado sign to the right. 5 stars!!

EVERYTHING about this place is soooo yummy! The staff is kind & accommodating. The food is outrageously good! If you aren't blown away, tell them & they will fix it. I don't care what you have .... it's YUMMY! Everyone is so willing to make your time awesome! If you have a bad time... it's your fault!

The BEST salon ever!! Friendly people. Talented hair cutters and stylists. They have this lovely cucumber/lemon water available! This salon has new ownership and is completely freshened and looking good. I would highly recommend this beautiful salon in Summerland.

They sent me a postcard that looks like a recall for my car
it claims my factory warranty has expired.
My car is 20 months old with 3000 miles on it.
I have a hyundai with the usual 10 year warranty.
They are just phishing with snail mail.
Please ignore these  crooks

The room is spacious and the bathroom was clean, BUT the key to the room never works and you have to constantly have someone come up to open the door...had to go to the restroom and wait for someone to open the door and no one ever came. Stay somewhere where you can at least get into your room!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We stay in Hyatt Places whenever possible, and this one did not disappoint.  Although we were only there one night (and we skipped breakfast), the room was clean and quiet, the bed was comfortable, free wi-fi.  Front desk staff was very friendly.  Good location, as well.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The shop is incredibly cute! They have a wide range of donut choices. We got the fruity pebbles, pink sprinkle, classic glazed, & donut holes. They were all good, especially the crumb donut holes. The only negative thing was the service, the people were not friendly at all.

Waiting in the long drive-through to try the McRib they're touting. Haven't been to McDonald's in a while. This is the sandwich I received. Is there quality at McDonald's anymore? Maybe it's just this location seems to have poor ratings should've checked.

I put a picture of how they advertise it, and how I received it
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Trash a** food. One of the worst pizzas I have had in Philadelphia. Was under cooked and doughy. Marinara was ok and cheese was ok. Definitely not waste my money hear again. More that likely the reason this pizza sucked a** was I ordered at 10 pm and they close at 11 pm. Still , no excuse to make a poop pie.

We've ordered several times and food is usually good. Today they got the order wrong, forgot to include several items. There would not refund money for items that were missing and there was no manager available to remedy the situation. Food was also subpar  today.

This new location is a plus, nice and cozy. Me and my wife couldn't decide where to eat at 10 pm so we finally stopped by little Tokyo. We got squid steak, rock and roll and vocalno roll and wow, it was a lot. Ann was a great server and very nice.

Cons: menu was so big, as a size a table, and the karaoke room was a lil loud

A decent stay was unfortunately ruined by how disgustingly dirty the pool was.  It was a health and safety hazard.  I do hope my children don't get sick.  The water was cloudy, with hair balls floating on top.  Very, very gross.  The hotel in general was dirty as well, but the pool was shocking.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The food was great, but the service we received was horrible.  We ordered a salad with our pizza and waters.  It took twenty minutes to get our salad and our server never brought our drinks.  When we asked for our drinks our server acted like it was an issue and was slamming the cups and ice behind the bar.

I walked in and ordered two pepperoni slices to go and a can of Pepsi.
Total was only $4.75. I remember when the previous owner was there. The place is 100% cleaner. The pizza was great and quickly heated up. I'm pretty happy there is a good close shop nearby home

The customer service leaves a lot to be desired. Questions were answered with an impatient "yeah" instead of patient yes ma'am, even though we were the only ones in the store. We were not thanked for our order and soon as she finished ringing us up she disappeared in the back.

I needed a haircut and it was time to find a new stylist. After reading reviews on yelp, I decided to try the Bobby Pin Lounge. I made the trek downtown which I hate doing because of the whole parking hassle.. TOTALLY WORTH IT. Great cut under $50, and fun experience! I go back today to have color done.

We had a good time, place was clean, drinks were quick, got the skull thing and barber drink, whip cream with my root beer was a nice treat to cool down on, music playing on the piano dint really match the mood of the place, need to play more exciting stuff, good time tho

Don't order a flat bread pizza from this location unless you want it totally charred on  the bottom and according to the staff member we returned the pizza to was our fault for ordering a flat bread pizza in the first place. Sorry we thought it was on the menu.

I was walking the whole avenue looking for a coffee, but everything was closed! 
I saw this place in the google maps, so I decided to give it a try and it was a really good surprised!
They close at 8pm, what is great since the others close at 2 or 6pm!
The cappuccino was good, and the mini donuts REALLY good!

Renter Stay Away !
They try to keep your security deposit and counter service took 1 hour. They have little help and try to sell you all options hard. You need to show them your insurance declaration page or they will not rent you a car. There fleet is in poor shape to top it off.
Pay more and go elsewhere

I'm very upset and disappointed. I just got my brand new 2020 car in February and came for the first time to wash my car, when I came out of the wash, I noticed one of my beautiful rims got all scratched up. I'm sooo upset and will not be returning. If you care about your car, don't come here and get a hand wash.

Not a great experience.We were checked into the wrong room , not what we reserved for.Then a double charge on on the CC , because they said me and the other person has the same last name,then when we got back from dinner,we were told to be quiet because people were trying to sleep.We were not even loud.It was crazy.

text: I'm waiting on there delivery guy to come back with my money I will leave him another tip along with the one I have already given knowing he did not cook it. I took a bit of each food sample of my order and am feeling sick from it. The food was so bad that it made me download this app

The lady who cut my hair had no idea for what she was doing. Didn't blow dry my hair, even used wax on a wet hair. I had to walk around the city with a disgusting hair.
Recommended for people who doesn't care about their hairstyle, just wants a descent place.

Wait until the hoopla has died down before heading to DD.  Place is packed and the staff isn't prepared to get slammed like this.  I think it'll be fine once the excitement of a new restaurant opening in Rita/Vail dies down.  Currently we have been waiting for over 20 minutes to get our order.  They ran out of munchkins too.

Beware. Witnessed an incident between a customer and the owner. Owner was extremely rude and cursed at the woman who was trying to discuss a problem. Never seen anything like it and will never go back.  The owner bragged he was rich and did not need her business....well, he won't get mine either.

text: This is a good breakfast at a very reasonable price. Generous portions and home cooked flavor! My only complaint is that the service was a bit slow for our first visit. Slow to take our order and to bring our check. Hopefully better next time as we do plan to return!

Alexis was great! I would love to take her back to Tennessee to be my FOM. Her superb customer service skills should be highlighted. That's a skill that isn't teachable. Either you have it or not. She has it. Not sure of her work ethic but thus far she has went above and beyond for me!!! Thank you!!!!!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My husband, two young children and I stopped here for one night to break up a long drive. Couldn't have asked for a better place to stay! The room was spacious, the bed was so comfortable, and everything was very clean! The staff was fantastic - such nice customer service. I'd definitely recommend staying here!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The pizza was real good. The appetizer was also good.  But the service was poor. We waited more than an hour for two pizzas and were at the restaurant for almost two hours because it took so long to get us a box and the check. We went 40 minutes without seeing our waitress. We never received a drink refill. Just poor.

Didn't see much of the staff, hotel looked decent but don't walk on the carpet without slippers very dirty, although the rest is tile that was also dirty, hotel seems to be in need of updating , was the worst LaQuinta I've stayed in quite some time, must be the franchiser
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I would give this place 6 stars if i could!!! Amazing service and delicious pizza, i find myself going out of my way just to stop by this place and get a pie to bring home. If you're looking to try something other than pizza look to the mortadella rotolo, it is incredible !

I am a big fan of Ninja sushi I've been coming here since they've opened! Their service and food used to be outstanding but for sure has gone down hill within the past year, takeout time varies but can take up to an hour..I still come here all the time though. They're pretty cheap and the atmosphere is nice.

Absolutely disgusting behavior by the wait staff and whoever the guy with the beard is. If you are a person of color, they will immediately profile you and will ignore your orders. Spend your money where you are respected. Not somewhere where you are treated like you don't belong there.

Angelo's gives good prices for a good pie. The pizza here is what you'd expect from a hole-in-the-wall, small-town pizza place with STL style. I can't say it's the best I've had or the worst I've had, it's right there in the middle. I'm not a fan but I'm not adverse to it either.

This pizza was pretty good. It doesn't really taste like Provel to me. It is very, very similar to a grilled cheese sandwich but  in pizza form. I can see how people would absolutely love it, it's just not my personal cup of tea. Crust was the perfect amount of crisp and softness.

Rude!!!  When I walked in, the employee looked at me and walked into the kitchen for a while.  When she returned she said we only have wheat bread and are out of all other bread and continued to list all items they were out of and never looked at me.  When she was ready to wait on me, all I got was a stare.  I walked out.

RUDE EMPLOYEES! There are some very sweet employees but most of them are rude. To the nice employees who make it enjoyable to come to McDonald's thank you. But to the rude employees that work there go find a different job to where you don't have to deal with people because your people skills are not great.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: So when you say you are open at 6:00, am that doesn't mean you should be walking across the parking lot to open up at 6:15 am! So, I am officially done with this place! Some of us have to be on time to work, especially those of us that are health care workers.

This is my favorite spot for pasta in the area. The owners and staff are very nice and helpful when ordering. I love how they offer a create your own pasta which allows you to get exactly what you want. They give you the best bread which is so delicious and fresh. I would highly recommend this place!

Dinner was awful, went for Father's Day. reservations were at 6:30, dinner wasn't served until 8!!! Have been there for brunch before and it was good!! Never again for dinner. The bus boy was alot friendlier and more service oriented than our waitress. Stay away for dinner!!! And expensive and not worth it!!!

Horrible customer service. I was looking for a new mechanic. After a great oil change experience I thought this place was it. Wrong. These guys treated me like I was trying to trick them into a free inspection, and then proceeded to tell me I could go somewhere else if I didn't  like it. So I will.

I decided to try this company for the first time at this location and honestly, I really hope it's not that bad at every location. I went through the drive thru and it took forever just to get a coffee. The coffee was crunchy from just pure sugar, absolutely disgusting. Starbucks for me, I guess.

Decent espresso, limited baked goods, and one badass space. Super comfortable spot to read, huge windows, back patio. Probably the prettiest coffee shop I've ever been to. 

If you're a party of four or less and need a spot to sit and chat over respectable coffee, this is definitely a great spot to check out.

Bands are decent but I got screwed on my vodka soda it was $11 (seriously). I didn't tip the band as I was pissed at the bartender.  Make sure you ask how much before you order  - I assume the bartender is either adding her own or the bands tip into that $11

Finally decided to step into this barber shop.  Patty really does a great job of making you feel at home and comfortable.  I like how she kept the old school feel and look to the place.  Really a great place and I am incredibly happy I finally walked in. A+

Ordered from here and hour ago the order came to my hotel and went back to the Chinese restaurant with my food
He didn't come to my door or knock or anything I tell the front desk to call up to my room then the lady that answering is mad at me ‍ I haven't tried the food yet but confused and rude  I wanted to eat not eat aggravation

I was excited to go in here after seeing it on Bar Rescue a couple years ago.  It's nothing special at all.  The bartenders were very uninterested in their job and the atmosphere was very boring.  It was also pretty dirty inside.  They still have the chair and drink from the show but everything else seems to have gone downhill.

This hotel is under construction and the website does not indicate this information. There's constant drilling from 8 am until 3 pm. This staff's service needs major customer service skills improvement including the staff working the Applebee's located inside of the hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Holy no. This place is very well situated and so I wanted to like it since it's close, has better hours than other spots, and cheaper pricing compared to other area barbers. But there is clearly a reason for the smaller price- uneven haircuts, and generally unprofesssional. You'd be well advised to keep looking

Went in today to encourage my mom to join. The equipment was dirty. Around the peddles etc, could use a good scrub. Also there was a massage bed AND a massage lounge both not working. Honestly it just looks like no one cares. The employees all stand at the counter, arms folded talking to each other.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: We have eaten there many times over the years. The food continues to be first rate and the portions are generous, Our waitress this time was great, and she had a very busy station. They are getting up there on price but the value is still there. Nothing fancy, just good food.

The sales clerk was questioned on why she wasn't wearing a face covering (mask) to protect customers safety. I was told that it was her personal preference that she chose not to wear one. So if she has no respect for my safety,  then from now on, I will take my business somewhere else.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: They prey on the elderly, convinced my 77 year old mother that her warranty was expiring and signed her up for a $200/mo warranty. When we informed them of our financial POA, they refused to cancel the contract until our attorney got involved.  They essentially stole $400 from our mother.

I truly enjoyed this hotel and what a deal.  It was clean and convenient to everything.  My room was larger than my first apartment.  All staff were polite and helpful.  It can be noisy because you are right on the French Quarter so I say bring some of those squishy foam earplugs and enjoy the heavenly bed for $120/night
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: After going for many years when the owner is not around customer service is horrible.  3 employees that work there were very rude talking in their language we knew they were talking about us. After 15 years it was so bad we will never return it was that bad.

While the food was ok, the service was awful! Had to stop someone multiple times to ask for refills, and then had to ask for the check. After waiting 20 minutes, we walked to the cash registers and finally were able to get the bill and pay. Will not be going back.

I really like Holly - she does a good job and gives me honest feedback about my hair ideas  without being pushy or rude, which I personally appreciate. She also does a good job of balancing being professional and being fun to talk to. I've never had a bad experience here, it's the first salon in NOLA that I've really "stuck" to.

Very good, albiet pricey local (and mostly) organic food. Nice ambience although for some reason I couldn't help but feel a little awkward just being there. I don't know why and maybe I'll put my finger on it but that's why it is getting a 4. Everything else was great and you (hopefully) might not feel the same way.

Excellent pizza! Highest praise from a very picky eater that said it was the best pizza ever! There was a problem with a salad and it was quickly corrected. Very good service considering she was doing everything else to run restaurant except cooking. We will return.

Great Pizza & great meatballs.... so we got both!  A sausage & Fennel (my favorite) as well as a Margherita.  One in our part is GF and enjoyed his pie too! Highly recommend the place, our food was great as was our waitress (who also bar tends) July.  Thanks for a great night!

The staff here are the best. So friendly and helpful. Calling us by our names and doing all they can to make our stay comfortable. It would be nice if the sitting area furniture was a little more comfortable and a reading lamp in the sitting area as well. Kitchen is sufficient, we can easily cook our dinner.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Pete's Pizza is an institution in Philadelphia (for sure), while the original on 52nd & Haverford Ave. still maintains its rep, Pete's Pizza II pales in comparison. The food lacks a certain love the original carries and the customer service could use some improvement, other than that its the hood and alls good.

I was disappointed with my food, especially after seeing so many positive reviews. Tacos were plain, nothing on them except meat and tortillas. I got chicken and beef. Both meats consisted of tiny little pieces, overlooked and not great. The service was good but based on the food I won't be coming back.

The food is good but a bit pricey.  What i did not like was the lack of English speaking staff members there who are willing to help you.  Granted it was my fault for leaving my sweater there but it shows you how honest some of the workers are when i call back to see if they still had my sweater.

I was stoked to come here, but man...the sushi was lame and the chefs werent very friendly (the night we came). It was also super overpriced. We were so excited to eat here from all the reviews and pics - maybe we came on a bad night? Either way, pretty disappointing.

Little crazy in here. Everyone is everywhere. The burger quesadilla is horrible. The cheese sauce was cold. The burger was like warm, and there is no flavor. Tasted like a watery tortilla. Best part of my meal was my fries and mellow yellow. Such a bummer today, normally I love burger king.

Horrible hotel do not stay here. Took forever to get our room. Almost 3 hours after check in. Rooms are dirty (they only clean the surfaces) not the entire room. Had rat poop under the bed. Bed had stains on it along with the wall. For the price I expected a lot more.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've eaten here a few times and enjoyed it every time.  I love the pizza.  The chicken wings are great.  Much better than ones swimming in spicy red sauce! My only complaint is that it's LOUD in there when it's busy; you have to yell to be heard over the din!

Absolutely hands down the worst McDonald's in the city.  Can't track orders, don't know their own menu, and ridiculously slow.  If you want what you actually ordered in less than 30 minutes go somewhere else.  You can actually make it yourself correctly at home faster.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: A great beer distributor that caters to all tastes with a selection ranging from local craft beers to imports and the crappy stuff (if you're into that). The staff is friendly and helpful and if they don't have what you want they'll try their hardest to get it for you from the distributor.

Very professional! They had reps wearing suits that did the car inspection as I was there instead of leaving me to do it by myself like all other rental car companies. 

I left my phone in the car on Sat and Carla F. mailed it to me from TN to CA by Tue. 

Great job! 

Sean Allen

GUYS!!! You've got to support your counter better. It's not fair to people who come into the store in the name of saving the environment rather than sitting in the drive thru. Or what about people who come into the store  because they don't FIT in the drive thru and are responsible and park instead of blocking traffic?!

The hotel is absolutely beautiful. There are some strange smells in the hallways and common areas, though. 

One person the made our stay was Trevor from room service. We were enjoying a day by the pool and he went above and beyond with service and hospitality! Trevor was the reason our trip was so great!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Best sushi I've ever had. Amazing fish. They give so much fish with nigiri, more than I've ever seen. They always give delicious miso soup. The seaweed salad is scrumptious and so is their seafood udon noodle soup. They have half priced rolls every day and every sushi roll tastes amazing. Friendly staff and great service.

I've gone to nearly every nail place surrounding the Downingtown and Thorndale area and 2KB is the best of all of them! Friendly workers, who always laugh with me when I tell them I bit my polish off. Dip it color looks great and is so affordable!! You will love it here, give them your money!

My food was delivered leaking chicken and soup and I called and all I heard was a bunch of people yelling back and forth and doing nothing about it. DO NOT ORDER from here it is disgusting unclean and they do not take care of their customers.  They refused to give me money back and unfortunately I paid with cash.

Food was "decent" but not spectacular. However, despite the restaurant being at roughly 1/4 capacity, both food & service were VERY SLOW!  Also, the table we were at was too close to the kitchen so we had the "wonderful" odor of their sanitizing solution from the moment we sat down.

Hands down the best sushi in town. They have a great lunch special and a lot of options on that menu to choose from. The staff is very friendly. They are always very consistent with the presentation of their food. 10/10 recommend to anyone looking for a sushi place in Tucson.

I was so happy that I decided to try out this taco stop! Though it's awkwardly placed, this place provides you with some of the most authentic Mexican food you will find in New Orleans/Gretna! I hadn't found a place that reminded me of the authentic Mexican food in Houston but THIS TAQUERIA IS IT! You won't be disappointed.

It's basically diner food, quite good and well priced. 
The menu is extensive. Breakfast is served all day. 
It was very busy. As a result, service was fairly good,
but not great. I heard good things about it and was
not disappointed. Will try the Sunday brunch buffet
next.

It's a shame this is one of the only Dunkin Donuts in Carrollwood because this location is HORRIBLE!!! They are always short staffed, the people are miserable, they NEVER have any ingredients needed to make a drink. Why promote certain things but are always out?

DO NOT TAKE YOUR PETS HERE. Worst place ever. Took my dog here because she had an ear infection. They tried telling me she needed a bunch of tests to rule things out and charged me $990. Now they moved to Cuthbert Blvd in Haddon Township under a new name. Don't be fooled!!! The absolute worst place ever!!!

This place has good review but most of their sushi is all cooked sushi, not much raw rolls. We got all you can eat and sat outside.. bad idea. Service sucks outside. They won't refill your water. We didn't get soy sauce or ginger until half way through getting our first order. Nothing seemed fresh. Won't be back!

Very good stuff here!!! Quite a lot of things to chose from. The wait is something long but worth it! The location is very convenient for me so I go there often. The only thing that kept me from giving a five star is that the waiter/waitress sometimes shows an attitude...
But overall, this is a great place!

On short notice on a Saturday, they were able to get my sons car in, diagnosed and fixed the problem with front hub assembly bearings. Car rides smooth and quiet now. He drives this car to and from college so they understood the necessity of getting the work completed.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I only had my oil changed but was disappointed because I did not receive a check list of the fluid levels that were filled.  I complained about my brakes squeaking but they had no solution or recommendation.  I was told that they squeak when the car is cold.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: My first ever yelp review goes to this place. So well deserved of its consistently fabulous reviews. Great people(and puppy), great atmosphere. Garrett did my balayage/cut and he is soooo exceptionally talented with an amazing personality to match. Go here. You won't regret!!

I had a 12 o'clock appointment. At 12:40, I had not been seen. I asked how soon I would be able to have my eye exam. I was eventually told five minutes and that the exam would only take five minutes. No luck, so I left. I also felt uneasy about the amount of time I would have been allotted.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
I am new to town and my car failed the emissions test to get registered.  I went to Sooter's because of the good reviews on here.  They were great!  They explained just what was going on and fixed it quickly.  I passed emissions yesterday!

I will keep going back!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Room was decent, toilet had ? brown material (left over poop)  in it and beer served on tap was out of season (Sam Octoberfest as winter has been out for a month now ) then blue moon was flat. In short Don't drink the draft beer here at the bar. Front desk staff was nice
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Food was outstanding and the employees are so respectful. Pizza and Burgers are absolutely incredible and I could not recommend them any more to anyone in the area. They have an amazing selection of food in the deli and in general provide an amazing experience.

We love their veggie/vegan options. Our favorite is the royal California with soy paper and no crab. Delicious! All you can eat has great appetizer options as well. We love the waitlist option on Yelp and use it frequently so we don't have to wait outside the restaurant for our table. Service is always great.

Great service and delicious appetizers. Went with a party of 5- food came quickly, which was really important as we brought a baby with us and babies only last so long in public places. Outdoor seating an byob two big positives!!! Will certainly go back again; excited to try their take out.

Wow. This is a beautifully designed restaurant with equally delicious tacos. The guacamole wasn't great and the salsas were a little too spicy without much flavor. Ambience was great and I can't wait to visit the Orlando location. The prices are very reasonable and the craft margaritas are fresh and light.

Crap service for a ok car. Also being next to a toll road beware of the crappy toll fees they forget to mention and buried in the contract. Use the one toll and pay for the toll and $5 a day, for the entire rental, whether you use tolls anymore or not. Thieves with crappy services and maybe average cars, Great Combination.

FILTHY! Lost my 5 year old daughter's Bunny cake for her Easter Party. Rude, slow and lazy employees.  Apathetic and no apology that the cake was lost. Has 21 Flavors not 31. Advertises flavor of the month but doesn't actually carry the flavor.  Very slow moving employees. Cake decorator sick.  This shop should be closed.

We booked this hotel due to proximity to the ballpark. We were initially impressed with the room & bathroom (very large) but the bedroom itself had not been cleaned nor vacuumed well at all. Also, not able to adjust the room temp (by design of the hotel) so the room was very stuffy and somewhat warm.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Love it here!!  Food is so fresh and delicious.  They also have a great beer and wine selection.  Only drawback is that it is a little pricey, but I appreciate the local ingredients so I don't mind paying.  I haven't tried a happy hour yet but I am looking forward to it!

Love Dolce. Normally do delivery, went for pick up today and no one there was wearing a MASK (even customer)?Please please wear a mask (even customers)  so we can safely support small businesses.   

I should have said something but I was shocked and ended up throwing it all in the trash.

Although they have some good sushi rolls the atmosphere is awful. The people that work here are very rude, and aren't helpful at all. I don't find it that clean here. But at least try the shrimp tempura roll if your going to go. I would say do a to go order, but you'll wind up being on hold for 15 minutes on the phone.

Went to La Viola for restaurant week.  Its a small restaurant with a good ambiance, and is quiet so it was easy to have a conversation through the entire table.  The food was great and portions were of a good size.  For restaurant week, I definitely left full!  A great value.

If you love soft and doughy tomato pie don't get the Philly Pizza because you won't enjoy it. Every slice was a constant reminder I was eating Pizza without cheese.  A good tomato pie doesn't cause those feelings. 

However I will return and order the Angelo Pizza! I also like the pepper that is provided  on the side.

Mike and Amanda and Tony have been helpful and quite intelligent, knowledgeable, professional, courteous, and fast in diagnosing and repairing my Honda Civic. I believe that their prices are fair, and I continue to be a satisfied and appreciative customer.

I accepted the upsale to a premium class car and zero deductible insurance, but will not do so again.  These options turned out to be very expensive.  The check-out and check-in were efficient and the clerks were courteous.  The car was not as clean as it should have been for the money I paid.

I've been ordering from Yelp while staying at a local hotel. The delivery is quick & friendly. The food is really good and portions are exceptional for the price. I've eaten from Giovanni's at least five times over the past two weeks and it's been very good every time. Would highly recommend eating here!

Our new nail spot. Went here for my wife's bday took her and our 6 year older son. Great service, they sang that oh bday to her and made me feel nice and comfortable too. I normal get maybe 1 or two pedicures a year and have been back every month since August because this place is awesome.

Dry cleaning is generally quick and of good quality. I blew out the seam on a back pocket of some dress pants. For $14 they haphazardly ran a sewing machine up and down the area. I have a sewing machine and could have done the same. I took the pants to the professionals for a professional job but that's not what I got.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: wth is this, i usually live arby's, i came through tonight and ordered a chicken sandwich.. didn't receive that i vogt two chicken tenders instead of a patty??? and i also tried ordering a jamoca shake but the guy at the window said it was down and had already cleaned for the night very disappointed tonight :(

This place was recommended by our hotel we were staying at. On the outside it looks outdated and I never would have stopped if it wasn't recommended. The inside is 50's style. The burgers and shakes were actually really good and for the price, I was happy with the decision to eat there. The waitress was also very nice.

Pricing is reasonable and the care is exceptional. I'm always informed prior to payment. I love the fact that this hospital will involve you, the pet owner, in the medical care process. Saves money and provide the best care according to you and your pets needs.

I had a nail in my tire and these men got me in no time. They were so kind and caring. Especially the service manager Brian! He helped talk it through and made sure I knew what was happening. His care for others did not go unnoticed! I would come back for any of my tire needs!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Wow! I am new to this area. This office is five minutes away. My cat is under the weather, btw...thanks for evening asking why I was calling, and I was told they aren't taking new patients because of COVID. I understand this is a difficult time but JUST WOW.

If I could give Vic Sushi 100000 stars I would, their sushi is the best in town and one of the most reasonably priced. Even though the place is tiny the food is outstanding and the service is extremely quick. I would highly recommend this place for any sushi lover :)

I visited the Mt Laurel location. Everyone was friendly and helpful from arriving in the front door to the end.   Hope was helpful with my frame selection and making sure I had the frame I needed.  I thank everyone for the service I received especially Shaun.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: All burger kings are slow as hell how can you call this fast food. I mean 20 min wait for food is unexceptable. The staff is rude and slow and the girl working the front counter went from sweeping the floor to bagging food and did not wash her hands...ewwww

At a fast food restaurant all you asks for is your food to be fast. I was asked to pull to the front of bk to wait 10 min for an impossible burger and some chicken fries. Why sway why? Because they are slow on the cell phone and talking to each other that's why...

Idk why I keep giving this place a chance 15 min for some chicken fries and impossible whopper is unacceptable. This is suppose to be a fast food restaurant. And who runs out of dr pepper I mean come on it's one of the 4 top drinks to order. Burger king should be disappointed in the customer service there staff continues to offer.

First time coming to this place. Sat at the bar, quick service. Chips and salsa were given to us. I had the lunch steak fajitas, which came with 4 tortillas, and a hot plate of rice, refried beans, lettuce, guac, and pico de gallo. I also got two ground beef tacos. All for $15. Food was awesome, will definitely come here again

New customer. Call they don't answer. They don't call you back. Called to see if they were open  they finally answered.  "open to training only". Could not even use the sauna. will have to drive to Wesley chapel or other gym.  So far not impressed.  Will write later on rest of service.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: THE BEST PLACE EVER! My nails lasted 3 weeks, every other place I've been to my gel manicure chips after 2 days! Great prices as well! The wait time is a little long for walk-ins (probably because they are amazing) so I would recommend making an appointment!

This place is great! I was a little skeptical because of all the bad reviews on Midas' oil changes in general, but the service I received was great. The men working were very nice. The only reason I gave it 4 and not 5 stars is because I made an appointment at 10, but my car was not seen until about 11:15 and I was in a rush.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: So far this is the best Japanese food I have in the city, so far. So very very good. I had the seasonal mushroom soup, followed by the Chirashi. The rice was seasoned very well the fish was good. The only peace of fish I thought could have been a lot better cut was the tuna. I worked as a sushi cook for a while. This is good.

Bought a medium drink n b4 I even got my straw in it. It dropped n spilled everywhere n instead of them just replacing it! She charged me for another one!!!! This is not customer service or the store I would recommend ever!!!!! And this not the first time that the customer service has Sucked!

This was our first time here, and it was amazing! The food tasted excellent, and was priced more than fair. The service was great too. I had the gluten free pizza, and it was so good.  The crust was very tasty, and not greasy like other places. Looking forward to coming back again soon!

This Dunkin has incompetent and rude workers. My coffee is never good. It tastes old and watery and they try to hide with flavor with a ridiculous amount of cream and/or sugar. They have no intention to make our visit quick and easy. I won't be returning to this Dunkin' donuts.

We had dinner here on Sunday the18th.I thought my dinner was very good, my partner was not crazy about his. I had a Caesar  salad which was fine, but the risotto Frutti De Mare was excellent.
We sat outside with not much traffic. In all I thought it was fine.

Richard from Chicago

An unfortunate discredit to the PJ's brand. Machines are almost always broken, ingredients are out of stock, or food items have been on the shelf for a week. Fortunately, the one around the corner runs like a top. Save yourself a trip and go there instead.

Be aware that Belmont Animal Hospital says a canine annual exam will cost $50. However, the heartworm  and fecal tests (which are a part of a standard annual exam) cost an additional $77, meaning the actual cost is $127 - more than double what they tell you!

The food was good I'm not from here but it was ok the service was shit the lady was very slow she doesn't even give us and forks or knifes I had to get up and get it if your looking for a 5 star restaurant it's not what you looking for and not very sanitized not the best restaurant I been too.

Great Mani/ Pedi. hot stone/lotion massage on legs and it was cheaper than my normal spot! Jimmy is the best, he will take care of you. went above and beyond expectations. He let me in when they were closing, took his time and stay an hour after it closed.

It's really pretty. The rooms are like apartments. I stayed for one night and went on a walk in the morning, and when I got back, they were cleaning my room before I checked out. So I couldn't get back in. I didn't have any stuff in there, but...that felt weird. Sat in the lobby for a while and waited.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My first time using this facility and will likely be my last. As others have mentioned, signage says there is an attendant on duty, but there was none and other customers told me they have never seen an attendant. All equipment is old and about a third of the machines were either inoperable or limited to one cycle.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Avion was the 3rd place I checked out. The minute I walked in I was greeted by Ana with a big smile. She was very informative and listened to what I was looking for. All the paperwork was done with no problem as well. The apartment was really nice and the entire complex was clean. I give them 5 starts all day

Came for an early dinner. We both shared the supreme pizza. It arrived hot. Very good flavor. I also had a cup of their sausage soup. It came very hot. Mildly spicy, but very good. Our server was OK. We had to ask her twice to refill our drinks and for the check.

I usually have to wait about 30 minutes past my appointment time.  The front desk staff aren't terribly friendly.  I spent $200 last month getting "laser treatments" for my dog that did nothing.  The care is typically pretty good but those are the things I don't care for at Gray Fox

Usually I come here and the sushi isn't too bad...I went here tonight and tried the hibachi which looked nothing like hibachi and came in a soup, the grilled octopus didn't look grilled at all and just all together was incredibly dissatisfied.  If you want some basic sushi, it's a nice place to go...just dont order anything else.

I've only visited this place once, but they did a great job. I visited on a Saturday, and it was PACKED. Well worth the wait. Can't beat a glass of wine and a pedi. Prices were also reasonable (I've paid more for much worse/less service at other places). I'll definitely visit again.

Again waiting in line for over 15 mins to make a deposit while the inside has no one in it...FOR NO REASON! Why do you have to text to walk in the bank? There's one person sitting at the desk. WHAT A JOKE! 
Wells Fargo and Republic are so much better with timing!

After hours we checked in via a window which should have been the first sign. The hotel is quite run down and the only updated elements are the sink and tv. The carpet was not very clean and the room had a slightly unpleasant order. The ac was pretty loud. We were only able to stay one night and it was one too many, unfortunately
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: First time taking my car here after bad experience with pep boys across the street. Scottie and the other man at the desk were friendly. Took another car there the next day. Treated us well didn't try and oversell or use pressure for additional work. Will go back regularly
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The service as soon as you walk in to the moment you leave is impeccable. The lamb rack special in a peppercorn sauce was cooked well (pink) with lots of flavor. The wine list is short but well considered and the bread is to die for. The pasta arrabbiata was al dente and full of flavor. A great choice

I went today and I'm soooooo disgusted the girl at the window was playing with her tongue ring while ringing me up! Clearly I said nvm and didn't take my order but I am beyond disgusted! She was literally rubbing her tongue and playing with the ring in her mouth

They just opened last week and we've already been here twice. Amazing customer service, fantastic ice cream. They have a lot of unique flavors that you can't get anywhere else. We actually came back just to get another scoop of their lavender honey, which is absolutely phenomenal.

Super helpful and very nice staff, great vet, and they got me in right away without an appointment.  I just moved to Santa Barbara on February 2, 2014 and they got me in this morning with no hassles.  Super great spot and my cat and dog will be going here for the rest of their lives!

Absolutely fantastic service. They told me an hour and it was closer to 30 mins. I had a slow leak in my tire and they fixed the valve and sent me on my way no charge. I would highly recommend to anyone with tire issues!  Thank you to Delip and the rest of the Big Brand Tire staff.

text: Had high expectations that came way short. Upon arrival for our 8:30 resv on a sat night, we stood at the desk for 10-15 minutes before even seeing a person. Our serve, Bruce, seeming to be rushing us from the beginning.  It was odd. The whole experience was MEH

I stayed at this hotel in August. It's functional and clean. It was very busy when I was there, the area for the breakfast was too small and the staff unable to keep the food out quick enough. Nice rooms, I had an upgrade to a bigger room on the top floor. I would return to stay here again. Not spectacular but nothing wrong either.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I hate to give bad reviews but man, my experience was awful. I came in for a manicure and I ended up picking a deluxe gel manicure. The whole experience took way too long--like almost two hours! And my nails look awful. The nail tech was slow and the massage wasn't anything special. Way overpriced. I won't be back.

The pedicure was okay! But my nails she was going so fast she cut me like 3 different fingers ! Then she put on the wrong colour so I asked her to fix it and she got really angry and was being rude it was very unprofessional, the quality of the nails for the price I paid was awful I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone !

I had an amazing experience here! I was very indecisive with what type of frames I should get and the person helping me was very patient and really accommodating. They gave me an amazing deal for what I wanted. Definitely recommend this place if you're looking to get some glasses.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The BEST Italian Restaurant in Philly! The food is delicioussssss! Beside the food the service is also great and very friendly! I highly recommend it for big parties, family dinners or just a to go place with your friends. The prices are pretty cheap for the food and service they provide! I never get disappointed of that place!

It is always a pleasure to shop at Giant. I am very impressed with all of the friendly workers. In particular, I would like to highlight Giant cashier JOSHUA. This employee is a great asset to the store. He is always, friendly, patient and willing to help. 
Congrats on having hired Joshua!

Cute little BYO nestled in Rittenhouse. We were traveling through on our way back to New York and we stopped here via a friends recommendation. Candace was our server and she was super lovely. Very knowledgable of the menu and everything she recommended was hella tasty. We will definitely swing by again in our travels.

I ate inside the restaurant and the service was bad, just one person doing all the work for all the medas and the delivery, I ordered sushi and they were the smallest rolls I have ever eaten in my life.  disposable plates and glasses, the price of the food is not in line with what you receive.

I've eaten here since the early 90's. Food has always been fantastic. Won't ever go back again though. I saw two mice running around the dining room during my last visit. We told the woman there and she just shrugged it off saying that they came from next door.

Stayed here in June 2017.  Woke up to a roach next to me on my bed.  The director of operations, Adi Altman called to apologize 3 months later and said they cannot compensate because the roach is a "common garden beetle". So after I complained more, he offered 2k SPG points which is more insult to injury.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Service was good.  Guy who seated us was kind of unfriendly. Food ok. We were given tomato juice that was clearly bad. About half of the table enjoyed their food the other half Not so much. We have been there before and it was better. Maybe they were having an off day.

Ate at the sports bar. Slow service was slow even though not busy, average burger and stale desserts. Disappointing to say the least. Tried the outdoor area, same thing. Slow service, average food, but at least waterside. Prior visits were much more pleasant.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I use to go to this place since 93 when i was in school, i just went back with family, i'm not sure if they changes chef or change products but the teriyaki chicken was not the same, i will continue to go because sushi is great but i will need to talk to staff and let them know i miss the old flavor.

This place is running a whore house , you can pay the receptionist at the front desk 53.00 cash no credit card needed or Id required for a room , she pockets the money and you have a room for the hour , also the manager is on this deal also just ask for Rodger

text: Unbelievable! My mother inn law lost her glasses in a fire.  She has dementia and couldn't come into the office.  Carol went out of her way to find her prescription in archives and replaced her glasses free of charge.!!! Thanks to shana (?) Carol and chester county opticians!!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Awful meal. Edamame was clearly microwaved and didn't even have salt. Salmon tasted frozen..and bad.  Waste of money. Overpriced. Also terrible customer service. Had to speak with owner and he was rude. Would have been more satisfied with a bowl of cereal.

Excellent food! Great knowledge of ingredients. Excellent presentation and quick service. I ate at lunch. The fatty tuna nigiri was so tasty. I also had the mango roll, very fresh and sweet. I had the Spanish roll, it was good just very surprising, had lots of citrus flavor right at the beginning. Overall very pleased.

I like to shop here, I like all the products they provide, the only complane is about the lack of professional service. The cashier talks on the phone with her headphones on while checking out customers. This is really holds me back from going there more often.

Gave this place another try after a disapointing experience a while back. Food was okay. Service was adequate, however, this time we were asked to change tables after our meal because another customer had requested the booth we were in.  We were at our booth less than 75minutes total. I won't be returning.

Jason squeezed me into his schedule while I was visiting from out of town. He was great and did exactly what I wanted. I left feeling great and looking good too. Days later, I still love my cut. To top it off, he's such a nice guy - a real pleasure to spend an hour of my vacation with.

Extremely slow service. I thought leaving for work extremely early would leave me time to get breakfast considering this location is always slow, still wasn't even able to get my breakfast after standing in line for 15 minutes and the line not even moving 2 feet!  I will be driving out of my way every morning to get my breakfast.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
This was an enjoyable experience with my puppy JACOB.  Clean, and We love the palpable joy when you see each member of the team handing your child    Friendly and fast service, appointments do not wait too much 
Recommend to anyone looking for excellent care and great people

The chicken cutlets were seriously the best I've ever had (and that's saying something). You really can't go wrong with any of the dishes, but you HAVE to try The Stack! Chicken cutlets, eggplant, sausage stuffed long hots and cheese combine to form one of the most delicious Italian dishes I've ever eaten. Can't wait to go back!

DONT DO MY MISTAKE if you want italian food in santa barbara MAKE SURE its not this restaurant ..i dont know why this place called italian food restaurant ..it has nothing to do with italy at all..services there are bad ,the food is NASTY and prices is high..

I didn't complain until checkout that the room was musty and didn't feel well cleaned since we arrived very late in the evening.  I did inform the front desk at checkout. The lady at the desk offered to have a manager contact me since I was in a hurry.  Never heard back so I won't be going back.  Not worth it.

text: Paid $12.49 for a large and small milkshake - got basically 2 glasses of milk.  Not sure they are aware that milkshakes contain ice cream.  Could have poured the whole thing thru a strainer.  This is second time I've gotten a "deluxe milk" from them. Won't be going back - one in downtain Franklin knows how to make milkshakes

I rushed to Starbucks because it said they close at 10pm and I get there right at 9:30pm and they tell me their closed. I tell the barrista I thought you guys closed at 10pm and she said on Thursday's we close at 9:30pm they need to fix their hourly schedule I'm highly unsatisfied and disappointed.

Great service. Small place so stare of regulars when you walk in can be intimidating ... Push through!  Had the cheesesteak hoagie (after reading other reviews) and it was great!  Not something I would EVER order but totally delicious.  

Limited menu (sandwiches) but rotating specials, very clean and again, great service.

This restaurant I have tried to keep in my list.  Overtime  have seen the terrible decline in food quality and such.  I DO NOT ever recommend this restaurant.  DONT TRY THEM.   Also, it's been a consistent problem with delivery they often say the driver didn't show up.  I call Bullshit.  This is the last time I try.

Terrible place, no security.  My friend her purse got stole from this place.   People just looking for fight for no reason. two of my friends were got jump for no reason.  Manager doesn't do any thing to protect the customers.  Better carry weapons if you go there to protect yourself.  Highly not recommend to go by yourself.

Slow service, very slow! Food was mediocre. Music was TOO loud. Had passed by this restaurant many times and convinced my husband that it will be fun to try a new place to eat for us. Unfortunately, our experience left us wishing we had continued down the road. Will not be back.

Worst Dunkin I have ever been to. Constantly understaffed causing wait times of 30+ minutes on weekdays. Just left there with nothing because not only was their credit card machine down, but their drink machine was also not working. Such a joke. Don't waste your time!

Great place.  Visit at night to enjoy the water view, outdoor music and dancing.  Buffalo chicken dip was great.  Burger was soso, would get seafood next time.  Stuffed shrimp were good.  Had breakfast next morning and it was awesome.  Best breakfast in trip

Whatever they did to the kitchen and its staff over the last few years I've been away has dramatically improved the food.  The blackened scallops and grouper are outstanding.  Appetizers are very good as well, with a large portion of calamari.  Recommend for the fish without a doubt.

Slowest McDonalds in the state. Every single time, no matter what time of day. McDonalds needs to take this franchise store back and give it to someone who cares about their brand. Management is seriously lacking at this location. I now drive by it to go to other McDonalds in the area.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We had a Hawaiian. The pizzas are ok, the secret to a good pizza is always the crust. The dough they use isn't the greatest, it tastes really cheap. Like a frozen pizza crust. Which is fine for a frozen pizza, but not for a pizza joint pizza. Spend a little more money UFO and get a better quality dough, your customers will love it.

For what I spent ($29) I would have thought they'd do a better job vacuuming the inside but overall decent value for a hand wash, wax,  dry. Service was quick but not overly friendly or helpful. Not rude or anything just kind of meh. But hey, my car is clean.

Service is absolutely terrible at old Clinton hills location. This was our 2nd time here and the slow service was not worth the mediocre food. For the price, we could have had a better meal at tavern on main or papa vitto's. The original fletchers on the west end is much better.

If you LOVE sushi this is the place for you. The  waiters were very kind. Food was good, would come again. I quote my dad " best sushi bar in Boise".  They have made this restaurant beautiful.  Hope you come to this restaurant. They also have green tea ice cream and fried ice cream.

Me and my man went there yesterday for lunch had a coupon I had the roast beef it was really really good he had the Ruben nothing to brag about but it was good establishment nice and clean finally took a minute to get our food but it was really good and I haven't been to Arby's in like seven years

Horrible service- my husband was ignored by the employee standing at the register/ another employee finally came over to take his order. Waited over 5 minutes for an iced coffee/ no additions. I took a drink once we had started in our way - horrible - it looked like coffee/---tastes like spit -not sure what it is - tossed it
 .

We went on a Wednesday night, 18:45. Restaurant was about half full which resulted in a timely service. The 5-course tasting menu was great and left us longing for more. Definitely a place to come back and discover the rest of their menu! One of the better restaurants we have been to so far since moving here 8 months ago.

This place used to be middle-of-the-road, but over the last year, food quality, service and interior decor has had a major overhaul. Right now this is the best sushi place in Santa Barbara.   Very kid-friendly.  Great value for money.   I like the chirashi bowl.

Never ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever again!!!! It is my belief they altered a custom outfit. Nuridin the owner didn't even apologize. Is that how you do business? Wow. Never ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever again
