text: Have been a consistent customer for a year.  Then they raised prices.  Now an udon soup costs $15.  I just spent $16 on soup (15+tax) bc I felt like an ass just walking out when I heard the charge.  Tokyo Bleu and Sumo in Cinnaminson have food of the same quality (perhaps better) with fair prices.  Bye forever, Yokohama.

I cannot say enough good things about this place. The service is awesome .... they let you try as many flavors as you want   ..... and best of all the flavors they have are mind blowing. 

We even bought her recipe book and made 3 of the recipes in the first week.

I would and have been recommending this place to everyone!

Went because the burgers looked great and hand good burger reviews.  I think the burger would have been awesome but it was served on at least a day old bun.  I think everyone can tell old buns by the way they crumble.  Anyways, looks like a fun place to have a beer, but the food could be better.

I like thin sliced sausage on a New York style pizza. Unfortunately, Cornerstone missed it taste-wise. The meat was scarce and over all, it was just A-o.k. Suggestion: add more toppings and work on the flavor. Looking at the other ratings, maybe I was there on a bad day.

Last two weeks ago when it says put go to leave the car wash somehow it pushed me towards the right and scratched up my rim and two days ago getting out of there again couldn't go I heard a tick sound going to vacuum up my car leaving the parking lot I realize I'm getting a flat tire sign and it cracked it

So sorry. Made the order by phone for delivery to my location down the road less than a mile and on the second street from them. After waiting 50 minutes I called only to find my pizza dinner was still In the store. Upon speaking to manager on duty I cancelled the order at the 1 hour mark, that's not delivery!

Here for a company conference.  Service is excellent!  Rooms are clean and modern.  The fitness center rocks.  And after a late return from a hockey game, Tameka went out of her way to get several of us ice cream after we were unable to find anything open.  So unexpected and above and beyond!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great selection of flavors and my first two trips were great as far as service goes.  The third, however, was so disappointing it knocked it down a full two stars.  It was pretty busy, but that doesn't warrant an eye roll and sigh at a GroupOn punch card!  I even spent money on top of the total GroupOn price.  Rude, rude, rude!

Disappointing food and service. Waited over an hour for our food to arrive and the place was not busy at all. Also, the food waffle and waffle sandwich that we order were both bland and uninspired. It is nice to have a waffle place in St. Louis, but the quality and service were lackluster.

Months later, and when I walk by I notice that the outside patio is still dirty, large cobwebs in the eaves, same food/menu...still won't spend a penny here.  It doesn't look like management cares much about their online reputation.  We need more competition in the neighbored hood to push them to make some much needed improvements.

Majority of employees have 0 customer service skill. Not friendly. No eye contact. No pep. I understand fast food can be tedious but at least try to have a good work ethic and value your position. 2 stars because my frappe was good unlike the staff at this location.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: My boyfriend and I went for dinner here for the first time and we had a pretty good experience. Our waiter was nice and efficient. I got the shrimp alfredo, but for just under $19 I thought I'd get more than 5 little shrimps. It's very cute and has a homey feel. I'd probably go back.

Pretty good food and generous servings. My wife and I had dinner there and the box was excellent. We had to take some home which was enough lunch for both of us the next day. The service is adequate, but could be a bit better (otherwise 5-stars). Prices are no cheap, but are reasonable.

Check in was very easy and professionally handled. Seen within 5 to 10 minutes of appointment time. Dr. Michelle Seemed to be very knowledgeable and thorough. Her assistant was very kind. I would recommend Thrive to anyone looking for a Veterinarian Hospital.

Best place in town. They do a great job and there products are the best. The beardsmith sells a soap called the shampoo bar which has helped my sons eczema greatly!! We've tried 100s of different products for his skin and this is by far the best his skin has ever looked! Highly recommended for skin issues!!!

It has been a year that I moved out here to Runnemede. Luigi's is the first pizza joint I tried and I am still afraid to try any other place haha!! Staff is super friendly every time I call to place an order. Super accommodating! You need to try Luigi's Pizza and Family Restaurant of Runnemede

While shopping at the mall, hunger set in. Why not pizza?
The pizza was good, not great. Anthony's is a better bet in my book.
Service is where they lost credibility with me.
Lackluster, and slow!
I would have had another beer or two if they were more engaged.
Next trip to the mall, it will be Chic Fil A.

This is definitely my favorite pizza place! The people that worked here are so kind, friendly and funny! The pizza is so good I'm definitely coming back here again! The proportions were really nice and the pizza tasted amazing! I would go if you get the chance and are hungry, but make sure to bring your appetite.

Service was terrible
Food was good.  I guess maybe the key is ordering all you can eat.  Every table around us, had continued rolls coming to their table.  We ordered 3 rolls 3 appetizers.   Got appetizers and one roll immediately,  but took 30-40 minutes to get other two.

I love this Starbucks location and staff! They are always happy to take my order and have genuine smiles for customers. No matter how I want my drink they listen and have great suggestions when I want to try something new. The store is clean with a nice atmosphere inside to sit and enjoy.

Love this place. The pizza, the pasta, the salads, the desserts, the wines. We've yet to have a meal here that we didn't think was absolutely delicious. I haven't tried the whole menu yet (despite going back regularly) because I tend to get hold of a new favorite and can't let go, but I'm bound to try everything out eventually lol.

So disappointed, went back to Annie's and had a horrible experience.  They were very busy on Saturday and the technician did my manicure in less than 5 minutes.
When I got home and looked at the dried nails, they looked horrible.  A three year
old could have done a better job.

For a classic Italian Restaurant, this place was very good.  Apps, entrees, and desserts were all delicious.  Chicken Picatta was perfection, meat dishes were cooked very well, although the lamb was a bit on the tough side.  Service was very good and attentive without being obtrusive. Highly recommended.

We went for lunch today, and waited half an hour for two sandwiches, with only three tables filled. We left after half hour, told the chef/owner the wait was ridiculous, he just shrugged and turned away.  While the food is good, the service has become less than professional.

Beat sushi in town and the prices are very reasonable 
The hibachi is also very delicious. 
I recommend the bagel roll for cream cheese and salmon lovers. Mexican roll is awesome as well. Volcano roll is good but I don't have a great taste for scallops. And tempura crunch is amazing.

Great store!  Two employees and the pharmacist went out of their way to help me.  One of the cashiers and a manager (William, I believe) didn't stop until they found one item, and the pharmacist left her pharmacy to help me find another.  Very kind and courteous people.

The experience and help from the staff is always professional the past two times I've visited. But wait  3rd visit was different when I was given Dr.K. She was rude and never contacted back although she said she would. I don't recommend this place even if it's the last animal hospital during a pandemic

This place is an absolute gem. Friendly staff, amazing, healthy sandwiches, and surprisingly well-stocked shelves to browse through while they are making your sandwich. Sandwiches and grocery are actually very competitively priced. I love this place, it has made a regular out of me.

The customer service at this location is very good! Cars are ready and clean when you get there. I've rented cars from numerous companies and Enterprise (especially this location) goes out of its way to take care of the customer and I appreciate that.  Brandon (who has now moved to another location) and Kirsten do a great job.

Great eye care. Both Optometrist and assistant must have asked me 10 times if I had any questions during the exam and discussion. New office is beautiful and everyone there was incredibly helpful and friendly. There are many choices for eye care out there, I doubt you'll find a better experience anywhere else.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This place is no longer open to the public as a hotel. It's been a dorm for IUPUI students since fall 2013. Chancellors restaurant onside is open to the public and is pretty good. Only eat here if you are on campus and can't walk to much better places downtown

text: Wow, went to ricks for their $5 (2 slices and a coke)! What a joke. They gave me 2 slices (petite slices) and charge me more because I wasn't dinning in. Now I remember why I've only twice. I was really bummed out about this place. We went there for the first time and I got food poisoning. My boyfriend and I ate the same exact thing except I ordered one extra thing. Yellowtail. 
It was all delicious and if that didn't happen, we would have definitely been back.

Mike is a great, honest guy.  I've been going to Mike for three years and have never had to bring a car back because it wasn't fixed right the first time.  Mike will always keep you informed on what is going on with your car and give you options if there are any options.  Highly recommended.

What a lovely place to sit and have a meal. Brunch is tasty. Sweet potato fries and the sangria are my two favorite menu items. The desserts are to die for! Ross with his cute apron is a wonderful waiter who works hard to get your order out in a timely fashion and is friendly. Eddie is the best expo I've ever seen.

I would avoid this place. They quote you one thing when you check in your clothes and price changes when you pick it up. Spent $16.50 to clean a jacket I bought at Costco for $20.00. It would have been cheaper to dry clean a 2 piece suit. No thanks there are better places.

I get pink and white  acrylic, lee is really good at them BUT always talks me out of getting polish or a design done. I have given them 3 tries and all 3 times I walk out not getting what I wanted.

This place is a must place to go and get a burrito or taco , the flavor just hit your mouth differently, I would 100% recommend this amazing place. There staff is nice, clean , and always there if you need help finding out what's good. 

Keep up the good work fitos!

This place is the worst place. Consistently the worst. Wish it didn't suck. But it does. Two scoops of mint chocolate chip in a waffle cone? No. Sorry all out. Of BOTH. "Would you like me to ready you the flavors we DO have left?" (Something tells me there are not 30 flavors on the list). No thanks.

Such a cute market/ spot to grab lunch. Food was delicious and they have a fantastic selection of meats and cheeses. I was able to walk next door and get a wine recommendation to pair with the meat and cheeses I purchased. Faire & Girard are so convenient with helpful staff.

If I could give this outfit a negative star rating I would. False advertisement. They advertise unlimited mileage through Priceline when they have a rule that if you live within 65 miles of the desk, it isn't unlimited. Ridiculous. Save yourself time and go with the experienced, better known companies.

Update to my experience......I finally put on the jumper in which I had the zipper replaced and the zipper isn't even attached at the bottom.  So I paid 55% more than the quoted price for a zipper that wasn't even sewn in properly.  
Wow, didn't think I could be more disappointed.

text: You come to get banking help. They move at snail pace before they finally acknowledge your presence. After they finally greet you, you're told to wait and have a seat..... 40 minutes wait.  Just to get a simple request and an answer. Any who, friendly service. Just seem understaffed.

We have always loved everything we have gotten from Villa Nuovo from pizza to salads to their amazing dinners. Tonight we had the margherita pizza and WOW! Fresh delicious tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella and fresh basil! Simple ingredients executed perfectly!

Smells horrible throughout the gym. The basement is gross and grimy. I've discussed the smell  and cleanliness issue with staff but no improvement. Worst 24 Hour Fitness I've been to. I only continue  to go to this gym because of the convenient location for me.

I swear to god how hard is it to get a combo meal without a coffee. Every DD I visit feels like it's employed by the same group of idiots who can never get your order right and don't know their ass from their face.

I give two stars because at least my breakfast sandwich didn't have a steaming pile of dog shit on it.

Bought beer 2x here over the past month and both times the beers were expired.  Pointed this out to the individual working the 3rd time I came in and was promptly told not to worry about the date.  Would you buy expired groceries for full price? I think not...

I gave it 1 star because there is no 0.
Pizza took almost 2 hours and 2 phone callsto arrive.
When it finally showed up it was ice cold.
We got #15 for 4 people. Only 2 of is ate the wings and we both got sick.
Wish i read reviews before ordering. Beware when the flyer states no refunds.

This is the best veterinary office I've ever been to! I've been a dog owner my entire adult life, from a pit bull to a sigh tzu, and they are amazing! The pricing is extremely reasonable. The staff is always friendly and very knowledgeable. Thank you for the excellent service!

Yogurt naturally has been my favorite yogurt spot for years! The thing that I love most about them is that it's not just soft serve froyo, but also the traditional scoop kind that mimics traditional ice cream. If you're looking for a sweet treat look no further!

Our stay was during renovations, but our room was nice and renovated (windowless, but nice). The staff was nice and courteous. There's a courtyard which was very pleasant and cute cat named Patrick who roams the courtyard. And the location is great for everything in the French Quarter!

text: They engage in conversation when there are long lines.  Not too friendly to older people.  House coffee is sometimes O.K., and sometimes stale tasting.  They don't refill the chocolate and cinnamon cannisters and I've often had to ask for milk.  They don't check to see if it's empty.

Waited 10minutes just to have my order taken in the drive through then took another 10 minutes to take my order because the man on the microphone seemed to be talking to another person at the window and couldn't multitask. 3 cars behind me ended up flooring it leaving before we eventually gave up and left ourselves. Awful

I went here one time and I will never go back. The man who cut my hair did a terrible job. It was uneven had a random long strand in the back and he didn't know how to layer hair at all. I was extremely disappointed and ended up immediately going to a salon to fix it.

It was the first time we saw table side Salsa making.  It was delicious!  And the frozen drinks were great.  I loved the decor with the colorful paintings of Mexico on the walls.  There was even a live Mariachi trio.  (Not too loud or obtrusive.)  The food was plentiful and good.  Very friendly and attentive staff.

Called for a take out order this past Thursday evening.   Guy answered the phone and told me "we're too backed up, call back tomorrow ".  Wtf!  Never had that happen in my life.  Food is good here in the past, but service as of late has gotten really bad.  Get more courteous help Kazu, your customer service is suffering.

Have always enjoyed the food here but the high turnover leads me to believe that they may not treat their employees that well. It's always better to see a familiar face over a new server everytime we come here. But food is consistent even if the turnover is a bit of a turn off. My favorite are the mussels and buy one get one pizza.

beware...beware..beware...peapod and giant are a total scam..

you will not get what you order.

it will indicate in stock when you place the order, and then it will not be delivered. 

i waited 10 days and recieved less than half of what i ordered.

do not shop at giant..

do not shop at giant..

The best gym in the world from the Body Enhancement, massage chairs to staff, when I'm feeling low I can always find a little sweetness at Planet Fitness (you know tootsie rolls are there no pun intended, I mean everyone is so up beat and happy to be there from the staff to the members, they're just fantastic).
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Careful!   We called and were told a minimal wait...got there in 15 minutes and was told next open table was in 2:30 hours!!! Referred us to their sister restaurant next door which was stuffy and $$$.  We were told this by the same woman we spoke to on the phone!

Used to be one of my favorite restaurants. Unfortunately, the service and quality, at this location, have went down. Not sure what has changed.
Seem very short staffed lately, but it is more than just that.
Really hope they figure it out and get it back together. Because for years they were wonderful!!

Manager sucks and so does service. Charged me for a small latte instead of an iced coffee which was 3$ difference, manager wasn't helpful in the situation and talked to her back to me the entire time. So upset that I just left the coffee and breakfast there. 5$ waste at this location.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The environment is quiet and clean, and our waitress My was very friendly. She offered us food suggestions since it was our first time, and refilled our drinks in a timely manner. Food was reasonably priced and tasted great (we ordered some sushi rolls and the chicken udon noodles), would definitely come back again!

The food is generally ok but nothing to write home about. However the beer selection is not good. The main beers are the Big Lug brand which is not a very tasty brand. Beyond that, the options are very limited.  This used to be one of my favorite places until they changed the beer selections to feature primarily their own brands.

Loved the waffle smell. Even though the waiting line was long,  it was worth it.  In fact, I was excited that the line was long,  anticipating the ice cream must be great.  And it was so delish. Loved the waffle chip with whiskey and pecan. Will come back with my kids.

I don't get why people like this pizza. I've been there four times and the pizza is average at best. Yes, they have lots of choices for unusual toppings but the product cannot compare to the crisp fresh oven baked pizza at Tacconelli's. different leagues!i

Toscana is the worst. Too expensive. You wait forever, then they seat you by the bar. The loud bar. You can't even hear the person across the table from you. Service is always crappy, the waiters/waitresses are always snappy. Not fun. Not authentic. I want it to be better but it never is.

They serve wonderful cafe conleche and freshly made Cuban sandwiches!! They also have excellent customer service and a super cute cashier that is there almost every time I go in. There is a small area to eat your food and socialize too. Bonus points if you speak Spanish.

They have ok food but omg their customer service and having "no manager" ha ha sucks. They were wrong and didn't fix what they messed up. I plan on getting my 34 dollars back. They must have talked about me because their poor driver ran away and I couldn't even give him a tip.

Best nail salon I've been to, I drive over 30m to go here. I've only ever had Annie do my nails, as I always get dip powder with tips. She's very polite and always does a great job, and will check in to make sure you like them. Always have a great experience, only thing is sometimes the wait is long.

Poor, rushed service. Our server didn't check on us. The food was meh. Menu wasn't anything exciting that I hadn't seen before. The deviled eggs were good but really how can you mess that up? And the server took away plates while I was in mid bite...really? Don't waste your money here.

I had requested a mid-size sedan through Costco, but when I arrived at 8:30 pm I was told to choose between the large SUV or the smaller one. Huh?! I ended up with a Jeep that didn't handle well for a 60+ smaller woman. Also, something sounded off with the tires and my son agreed. Back it goes tomorrow.

Went in at 9:50 to get some late night donuts because they said they were open until 10:00. Manager said they were closed and refused to serve me. My opinion is that you honor the time you say you will close even if it's an inconvenience for you but I guess they don't see it that way.

Very disappointing. We waited a long time to see what was going into the building. The high ceilings and open concept did nothing to baffle all the sounds in the building, we could hardly carry on a conversation.  The food was bland and tasteless. The salsa tasted spoiled.  We love Mexican cuisine but sad to say we won't be back

We absolutely love this meat market. It has that great hometown feel and really good quality meats. The staff and owner are genuinely nice and offer amazing customer service. You're definitely missing out if you haven't tried their specialty bratwurst. Yum!!!

I agree West Michigan Veterinary is an excellent place for decent pet care. I had one incident that caused me to pick my days to make a trip to the clinic. They have two veterinarians on staff. I give Dr. Johnson high marks, but the other vet not so much. Also, the front desk person is not very friendly. You have been warned.

worse than canadian tire

all i did was get a simple oil change and now my twin turbo 1jz supra is misfiring the head gasket had lose fuckin bolts and they listed the wrong engine for my car

if i wasnt flushing my heater core they coulda blew my damn engine and 90$+ for oil isnt a deal.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I got the pink postcard from "National Vehicle Protection Services" urging "Immediate Response Requested" warning that my factory warrantee expires, and I should call with my car's VIN number and exact miles. Interesting, since I have not owned a car in over ten years!

Beware!

Great place. Great atmosphere. Great people. Great prices. Can't ask for much more than that. Ordered a catfish sandwich with fries, and it was delicious. If I'm ever in the area again, I'll be back. Has a great view of a beautiful river. We sat at a table right by the water.

My favorite sushi place in town. Charming little hole-in-the-wall joint with great cozy Japanese atmosphere. Rolls are well proved and there are always specials, and in my opinion the best vegetable roll in town. Great place for lunch, I highly recommend it.

My husband and I were walking down state Street and decided to have dinner at Aldo's, not sure if I was really hungry but it was pretty good. We had the Alfredo fettuccine with stake, I think I needed more alfredo sauce but I finished it all people there were nice.

Food came out very fast, staff was super friendly and the food was amazing. The arancini was incredible if you aren't a huge mushroom person I would still get it. I hate mushrooms and I couldn't taste them at all. Also the meatballs and parents were fantastic.

Really wish no stars were allowed.  "Supervisor" gave incorrect information and then unable to correct herself.  Wearing a boot so unable to leave her office so customers have to go to her.  Epitome of laziness and ignorance.  Avoid this branch if this woman is in charge!

They have new owners recently.

I had my front pads,drivers side rotor & caliper replaced in 1 1/2 hours on Valentines day(10am). The price was a good value at $220.

They were nice and efficient and I recommend bringing your car/truck to Rainbow Muffler in Largo.

Our experience at this Enterprise has been the best rental car experience we've had! No hassle, quick service and super friendly and helpful! Not only do they pick you up to get your car they will take you home after you drop it! HIGHLY recommend this location!!

these ppl are so ruid and have no clue how to clean clothes. she ruined my lab coat then after i asked them to fix it they spread stains all over the coat and then very ruidly told me my clothes were not welcome back!!!! worst service i received in my life
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
This restaurant is by far the closest you could get to japan here in Edmonton. 
They have a bar where you could see your food being prepared, it would've been better if the chef will just pass the food to you, but instead the food is still served by the servers.

Tortilla soup was very watery with barely any chicken.  The enchiladas were decent in flavor but not necessarily for how expense the place is. The place was clean and the ambiance was good.  I have been here a few times and I gotta tell you that for the value, there are much better Mexican restaurants in the area.

Everything is super fresh and yummy. Its my new favorite stop! The bowl is by far my favorite , I change what I put in it every time so it never gets boring;) the guacamole is made fresh and is amazing and I love all their salsas. A lot of healthier options too .

My husband and I stayed here in October 2013. We had a 2 story Villa and loved it! Everyone was so friendly the Villa had everything we could have wished for (except a washing machine & dryer). Short walk to the beach, CVS & restaurants.Well maintained with covered parking lot. Would recommend it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
always forgets something how you going to give me drinks, fries, napkins and zesty sauce... where is my whopper??

Just make sure you look in the bag before you go home, I ended up eating a ham sandwich with zesty sauce, fries and a diet soda. 


wow at least they remembered the diet...

Food was AWESOME, our server was fantastic However the owner was a complete jerk and very rude. We were there for a birthday celebration with a large party. Reservations had been made and were confirmed. The owner apparently did not communicate with his staff.

I've been coming here since they opened, but not anymore. Everytime we come the food tastes different/comes with different things. When I order carry out the kitchen forgets stuff ex. Sauce on enchiladas and the food is cold. Even when the owner is boxing the food up as I'm standing there.

Clean, when most airport hotels aren't. Beds were OK, needs updating of cheap finishes, and it was quiet. Restaurant is barely passable, more like bar food. Just sandwiches, pizza, and apps. Really, for a stayover due to a cancelled flight, I'm only looking for a clean and quiet room, a hot shower, and a shuttle. They did OK.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Fat salmon is amazing!! Their shrimp tempura is definitely my favorite. My friend always get California roll with extra spicy sauce. The ambiance is very chill. It's extremely small in there. The servers seem pretty nice overall. Totally recommend you trying this place out!

The Breakfast is good. I have gone there 3 x's but everytime I go I am reminded that service is very slow & when you have a toddler that doesn't work. If it was just me and my husband I would come back but with a child and the slow service it's not worth it to me.

It's the best sushi in town, as far as quality. But you'll wait over an hour and a half for your food -- every time. And if you order online, don't expect it to be ever be ready on time either. Plan to pick it up 45 minutes later than the time they tell you.

This is my local Dunkin' Donuts. I never usually do not go to this one because they make terrible coffee! The black lady with messed up teeth shorted me a dollar! On national donut day. This Dunkin' has 1 star. This Dunkin' Donuts needs a new staff immediately. I will not be returning to this Dunkin' Donuts!!!!!SMH

The coco keys water park was a huge let down. The heat broke and it was colder inside the water park than it was outside. The room was filthy and wasn't worth $225 a night. We won't be returning. We then had a problem and the manager refused to speak to us which was very rude.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The best! My wife and I have been coming here for more than five years and it has always been a great experience. On this past service, John and Michele have gone above and beyond to make sure everything was running well and I was happy. Couldn't ask for more, beats the dealerships every time.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I paid for the Platinum package. The most expensive one which includes interior vacuum and cleaning all the interior surfaces. These photos were taken about 5 minutes after they finished. The whole interior was left pretty messy. Debris that just needed the vacuum to touch it was still there everywhere.

1st time I've been to this McDonald's and they messed up my order. They forgot to put 2 sausage egg mcmuffins in my bag. Now I'm too far to go back and their phone don't even work!!! Smh... I think it'll be a while before I go back. I should've checked the bag before I pulled off. So y'all got me this time.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The new remodel is awesome. The only thing I am still disappointed in is the bantering between the workers, it seems there is always an issue with someone. They also have not kept up with cleaning or mopping since redo, but overall it looks great and the food is typical McDonald's food.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I intended to use the drive through. But they had it blocked off. I almost left but decided too get out car. The cashier Anthony was great. He was very much on point and he spoke when I arrived, and spoke just before I left. 

The inside was very clean as well. No complaints

Just ordered a large pie for lunch. It got here in 15 min. It was cut in 6 instead of 8. But I'm most disappointed that this pie was definitely cooked last night. It's not even possible to get a pie cooked and delivered in 15min. It did taste really good though even though it was cold. So there is that.

The service here was phenomenal.  Although the hotel itself was a little above average, the service made the stay worth it.  The staff was friendly and helpful throughout the entire stay. The location of the hotel was great as well because it is right off the highway and easily accessible.  I highly recommend this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place lures pet owners in with their $1 first visit deal, and then preys on their fears in order to talk them into having a bunch of expensive and unnecessary tests conducted.  I am so glad I didn't fall for it and went for a second opinion...Learn from my mistake and DO NOT take your pet here!!

I'm so disappointed and unhappy with my nails. The lady who did them was supper nice so I didn't want to tell her I didn't like them but wish I did. I tried calling to see if I could get my money back or at least get them fixed but no one answered the phone. Needless to say I won't be going back

Beautiful restaurant but wasn't thrilled by the food or prices. Everything was very small portions and with very few options it made ordering a little difficult. Especially for a group that doesn't necessarily like the same things. The items we got were tasty but expect to pay $$$$ to feel full.

Good made fresh food. Friendly service. Spicy square Tomato pie is great and so is the gigantic wedge salad. Open later then most places for dinner. Specialty pizzas are good. Especially the cheesesteak hoagie and     broccoli, spinach, & tomato pie. They have got the best wings too ! Them wings are huge, biggest I've had anywhere.

What a complete shit show. Dealer sent me over here because that's who they contract with for the rental cars. Great concept except that I've been sitting here at enterprise for an hour because they have no cars and actually had to go to someplace else to pickup cars to be able to rent to people.

Went to try this place out. It was clean and modern with lots of baseball decor. The sushi rolls we got was crunchy roll, spider, dragon, and tiger roll. The tempura veggie and shrimp were good, fresh light batter and fresh veggies. I would come again next time. Got really full here

Had a great catered meal by Anthony's last night. Everyone was extremely happy and while we ordered for fewer persons than were attending we still had leftovers for the generous portions. 
Delivery was on time and we will be having them cater more in the future.

My husband and I tried to go to this restaurant for dinner. We were turned away by the host who said they had a completely fully restaurant and couldn't seat us. It was at most 2/3 full - counted at least 10 empty tables. Maybe he doesn't understand what completely full means.

I am so glad I found this place. Amazing food great service. I cant recommend this place enough the fries are great, the fish sandwich was out of this world. My wife had the cauliflower flatbread which was cooked perfectly. Also the tavern pretzel is addicting be warned. Cannot wait to go back.

Nobody in the restaurant and because there was no one working the hostess counter we set ourselves at the bar. After about 10 minutes we had to go get our own menu. We finally tracked down the server who was not ours but said, "I guess I could take your order." We left.

Was looking for a new nail salon since the past few times I have gone to my regular salon they have done a HORRIBLE job. I found Lookin' Good just by an Internet search. Kathy did my gel mani and pedi and they look AMAZING!!! Everyone was so nice and it was incredibly clean!!! Can't wait to go back!!!

Restaurant has a large sign complaining that people don't like working there because of the owner's politics. Making radical political statements to your employees and customers might not be the best business policy. And the food and service aren't particularly good.

Horrible management and incredibly unhelpful staff. Continued to charge my credit card after I had filled out all the paperwork to cancel my account, AND they lost that paperwork. On top of this incident, no one was sympathetic or had the nerve to apologize for the mistake. Would not recommend this gym/company to anyone.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Delicious food! Great prices on Sunday! Love the jenga game and cornhole! Big, nice TVs throughout the place. My only complaint is that it's really dark in there. I like to see my food while eating but that's ok. The restaurant is based on a cabin experience, so it's expected to be dark. Definitely looking forward to going back!

I got delivery.I excepted to receive a crispy brick oven pie. However, I was disappointed because the pizza arrived soggy and the pepperoni wasn't fully heated through.  The restaurant is only 1 mile away from my place so it couldn't have been the box trapping moisture.

Great Food it can be a little over priced but the service and the quality of the food make you forget the cost it is worth it.  The staff are so friendly our waiter was helping serve one of his other tables and one of the other staff came over and refilled our drinks and gave us some more bread they go out of there way to be nice.

I've been living at Waterfront for about 7 months now and Destiny makes living there soo much easier. Whenever I need anything she is there to help me out, any questions I have she is there to answer, and she is just amazing. So if your coming to look at an apartment make sure you talk to her!!!! She got you!

Just wanted to add, after talking with another parent who's child had food poisoning here this week that my child got sick within 10 minutes of finishing his pasta dinner. The server we had had to help me rush him to the restaurant bathroom where he immediately got sick.

Unfortunately the only thing I can share is that my poor teenager had food poisoning after we ate here. Whether it was from the food or bad kitchen practices I can't be sure but I felt I needed to warn others.

I would like to add that our server was very sweet and attentive during the entire experience and super helpful.

Went with the suggestions of other yelp visitors and ordered the ceviche verde, chop salad and carnitas tacos. Amazing. Already planning my next visit. The Michelada cocktail was very interesting; it's a cross between a Bloody Mary and a beer. Sounds weird but worth trying.

TD bank is probably the worst bank around. Their fees alone are enough make me cringe whenever I check my account. I finally switched when mint.com told me I paid over$200 last year in fees. The hours are convenient but not the cost. Please look into every bank in your area before giving then your business.

3 stars for nice employees who are sincere, but -1 star for slow service. I've been to this McDonald's 3 times this year and each time it takes more than 7 minutes (up to 15 minutes!) to get a quarter pounder- no special requests. It's supposed to be 'fast food'.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
They charge 7.5% sales tax then round up to next penny. The tax rate is 7%.  When I told the manager she didn't care. This franchise isn't being honest with its customers.

Donuts are normal,  sandwiches are frequently under cooked.

Hope you have a better experience.

Best pizza in the Pike Creek area.  Good pasta dishes. Make sure you ask for the homemade pasta! 

I recommend their ortolana and the gnocchi. 

Nice place for the entire family.  Our 4 year old loves sitting near the fish tank and we love the cheap carafe of wine  :)

Super friendly staff.

Another Great Meal At Jax Kitchen.  Our waiter Justin was attentive and had great recommendations!  The Crab deviled eggs are so yummy.  We had the short ribs which were nice and tender and the mashed potatoes were the best I have ever had.    We have never had a bad meal here and will be back again and again!

This place used to be awesome, always was quick, kind, and correct. Recently things have started to change. I've come here probably 5 times the past month to get the drink I always get, the nitro cold brew, and they've been out of it every time. I'm no longer wasting my time at this location.

This is my go to spot in the Eastlake area for sushi. The owner is usually the behind the sushi bat making rolls. They have a huge variety of fresh rolls that are good for any veteran or newbie sushi eater. I eat here at least once a month and often drive an hour to eat here unless Im in the area for business.

I went to see Dr. Haberman today for a exam and fitting.  It was a great experience. She makes sure your comfortable. The staff is down to earth just like her.  She's very knowledgeable. I never been to any doctor that  made me actually want  go home and write a review. Great doctor, great vibe, great prices. I'll be back!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Great tasting donuts! The different types of donuts they have were amazing! Dino sprinkles! Fruity pebble sprinkles, bacon donuts! Prices were great and the staff were all so sweet and patient with us while our toddlers picked out their donuts they wanted!

Everyone here is great! They have awesome deals and get me set up for every trip I take. The driver service is also awesome as i can return a car in the morning and be driven to work. They honored my AAA discount at 5% and were answered any and all questions I had!

A+ team!

nasty guy making our food was not wearing a mask. is he at least six feet away from the food? no!!! this dude was making sandwiches during a pandemic breathing into the food and all of the ingredients! unacceptable!!! this location need a reality check! you are making peopoe
sick!!!!!

This is the real thing run by a family who greet with warmth. It's inexpensive with large portions. I had the chicken Gutierrez which is chicken cutlets with smoked spices and rice and beans. There were four chicken cutlets! I took half the plate home for lunch tomorrow.

Be careful when using your credit card when going through the drive thru. I handed my card to the girl and she disappeared with my card for about a minute. A week later on that same card all these mysterious charges appeared. I called and talked to the male manager but that was a total waste of time.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Slow, slow and slower. Burgers are OK if you can get one. Not worth the ridiculous long wait. The place closed once. Shocker. Reopened and still slow and medioce. Service is garbage. Food is mediocre. Same place from the first time they closed. At this rate they will close again.

By far, Mediterraneo has the BEST PIZZA in the Malvern, Frazer, West Chester & Exton area.       The owner is a New Yorker and knows how make a good NY style thin crust pizza.     I can guarantee you that if you try 1 pizza from this place you will not go anywhere else.    It's a slice of NY right here on Route 30!

Delip and the entire crew are wonderful human beings. Thank you so much for making my disaster ok again. My Sunday was looking wrecked and you saved our vacation. Thank you so much Big Brand Tire and Delip for everything you did for me. 5 stars!!!!! I will tell all my friends to have their tire work done here.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: These guys are a great dry cleaning business. I've never had an issue with my clothes in three years and they always have quick turnaround times. The staff is incredibly friendly and easy to work with. They accept debit and credit cards which is very convenient. A great option for dry cleaning
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Been there for a mani/ pedi twice. Had different people do it but unsatisfactory both times. They apply thick coats of paint that bleed out into the skin. The skin around it starts peeling too after 2-3 days. One of my friend goes there regularly, and she seems to like it.
I guess am too picky, but been to better places before.

Food is average, however the customer service is lacking.  They seem to enjoy being short and snippy  with customers who have questions. They need to keep in mind (just as I certainly will the next time) that customers are not petty annoyances, they are what keep them in business and are free to make other choices.

We stayed for almost two weeks. Charming old-fashioned villa-like place with all kinds of in-house amenities - mini golf, restaurant / bar, pool / jacuzzi. The neighborhood is quiet but has everything - shopping and restaurants - and the beach is two blocks away. We would definitely stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Hands Down the best sushi place around!  Chef Eddie and other sushi chefs make the experience even more spectacular. My favorites are the Younger Sister Roll, Seven Seas Roll, Maguru Su Miso, the Oysters, Uni, Live Scallop, Eel Avocado Roll, Escolar...You can't go wrong with anything on their menu.

Customer service is horrible waiting in line for 15 mins. You pull up to order your food and don't hear from anyone for 5-10 mins. At least let people know please take a look at your order and I'll be with you shortly instead of having people guess what's going on when they have to be at work soon

I've been taking my car here for years. Always found them to be honest - as they never suggested or pressured me into any unnecessary work. I do like that they inspect my car and tell me what maintenance should be considered soon. Tony M. got me in right away last minute on a Saturday, which was a huge help.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I was unimpressed with both the service and the sushi... I got a roll that cost $16 and found it to have the shrimp on either end... and then imitation crab meat (like for a California roll) in the middle pieces... i found this to be insulting. the house salad was great though...

They charge an extra $3 just because your truck has some mud on it. Never going here again. All I wanted was a cheap $4 wash which any other place would have gave me. Ended up having to pay $7 AND having to sit and wait for much longer than other places.

If you just want a quick automatic car wash, go elsewhere.

Worst service ever. Our server was absent at best. Empty water glasses, no bread, no server. When she did attend to us, she was abrupt, practically shoving a basket of bread or glass of wine. We got nothing unless we asked for it - nothing was offered. Food was ok but not good enough to put up with such poor service - ever again.

One of the best meals I've had in a long time. Excellent gnocchi, only complaint was that there wasn't enough sauce. The service was attentive, but maybe a little overbearing. Since this place is an old-school Italian eatery the service fits. A great place to take parents or friends visiting Philly.

Food is usually good. Pizza is hit or miss. Tonight as well as my last visit multiple staff members were wearing their mask below their nose, some not at all. I heard when they shut down earlier this month it was due to a Covid 19 outbreak among the employees.

I waited an HOUR on top of having placed a phone order for this it came like this....? I asked them to refund me and I asked for a manager and they said nobody could talk to me. If I could give this place no stars I would. Don't waste your time or money here

I am so disappointed in the service I was given today. Not only was I overcharged, but the nail tech cut me 3 times!! Blood and pain and acted like it wasn't a big deal- definitely wouldn't recommend, went to relax and get pampered. I didn't get to do either !

This was probably the worst experience. The salmon was dry the first time and the second time it had no flavor. Service was poor, but I suspect, she was new to this. I'll give her that. We work hard for our money and definitely wish we would have gone to Tokyo express and spent a fraction of the cost

I went to this Salon and it was wonderful!  My stylist was Lacey!.  She was a sweet girl and really knows what she is doing.  She did EXACTLY what I had envisioned and more!!!  I have not felt this good about my hair in ages!!  I highly recommend this salon and Lacey.  I will definitely be going back!  Thank you so much, Lacey!!

They have a fun game where you can win a free car wash, and I've won several times!! Love coming here! My favorite Hville carwash! I love this place including the people the prices the equipment and that my car is always super clean and damage-free when I leave!

Last night was our fifth visit to Sushi Moto.  The service was terrible and the roles were mostly rice.  Our $52 dinner was tasteless.  In the past each role was a flavor explosion.  Not sure why the restaurant has changed, but we are NOT going back to Sushi Moto.

Absolutely amazing!!  Food was wonderful and presented beautifully.  The drink pairing is a must. Can't say enough about this place. The chefs and Sommelier are personable friendly.  They took the time to interact with every single group. This wasn't just a dinner it was an experience.

First go, naw it wasn't crack
Still gotta respect the cheezy mac
They tryin hard to be an innovator
But fancy parts weak like AC Slater
Ceasar and bisque, kinda alright
That bbq pork ain't got no fight
Keep it simple, I'll return to sample
Next time, light me like a candle
Word to your mother

We moved to the Boise area from Seattle and this is the best sushi restaurant we have ever been to.  We had the fried oysters, salad with ginger dressing, udon/tempura, and the spicy tuna sushi roll (18 huge pieces)...service and atmosphere was great and the food was perfectly delicious.

I tried this place because it was one of few delivery options for my area. I didn't have high expectations, BUT I was pleasantly surprised. Me and my family loved it!!! They forgot my drink which was a minor bummer. The food is pretty good and reasonably priced.

I would trust the one 5 star review this has, because she works there. This location is horrible, horrible staff. Extremely rude, long waits. I honestly wouldn't care waiting 20 minutes for food if the staff was at least nice and pleasant and acknowledged that I just waited 29 minutes. But they don't care about you or there job

Went here with a friend & was greeted by the sweetest family! We went during off hours, but the sushi did not disappoint. Our rolls were loaded with fresh fish. 

The staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming. Wish I didn't live so far away. We'd be here a lot.

stopped by 6 pm on a Friday.  Staff was attentive.  the pizza did not look that great if you wanted to go with slices.  we had a couple of prepared items that took quite a while to arrive.  too much sauce splashed on but the food was cooked OK and was hot when it arrived.

Stayed here for one night at a decent price of $85.00. Location is about a 15 minute walk to downtown happening area. The hotel itself is a bit outdated and needs a thorough deep cleaning. Parking is very easy and checkin checkout was easy enough. Not a bad stay at all.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I eat at a lot of Subway's. I've paid with the Subway app at most of them. This one the clerks wouldn't listen and forced me to use Apple Pay. I wanted to use my PayPal balance which has to go through the Subway App. They were very rude when I tried to explain what it was and they insisted Apple Pay was the same thing.

I have been a customer here for more than 5 years and every time I go there my order is always messed up!
There is as well people under the age of 20 working there and they do not care about the customers and is messing our orders, but the only thing they care is their 13$ an hour. Next time I'm going to a different McDonald's.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
One person working @ 0730 in the morning?? The long line was not progressing so I had to walk out. 
It looks like a nice, clean shop with plenty clean tables, easy parking, and pleasant decor. But, customer service needs to be more prompt for morning rush.

Complementary breakfast was very good they have like a buffet type of thing going on its by far the best descent hotel I've stayed at for a very reasonable price the pool and bar are nice as well not located very well it looks sketchy but very descent hotel I would definitely stay again
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Absolutely filthy and disgusting. It's mind blowing how ill maintained this market is. A simple renovation would improve hygiene and attract shoppers. They have a surprisingly decent selection of international food but that definitely does not make up for the horrible condition of the place.

Don't know why I'm bothering to write this. Not only can't the employees count they don't know which patty for what burger. These are the same workers that believe they should be paid 15.00 a hour. This is not a job to retire on, it's a stepping stone to better.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Wow.  Food tastes good and that's the end of the restaurant's positives.  The service is slow like molasses.  The drive thru always seems backed up.  

It's not hard.  I've seen "The Founder".  Just do your job with speed and get your customers in and out.  It shouldn't take 20min to get me an egg McMuffin meal.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Nothing beats the quaint yet upscale atmosphere of in person dining, but the quality of food thrives during times of delivery only without fail. DELICIOUS flavors. Alfredo is impeccable, not too saucy yet so cheesy. Red sauces and the eggplant dishes are amazing. By far my favorite small family style Italian restaurant.

Food is ok. It helps that you can add whatever you would like to the pizza. Gluten free is a plus. If you order online, do not show up when the pizza "should" be done. I showed up right when they told me to and they hadn't started the pizzas yet. They aren't slammed or anything, just hadn't started yet.

My car was dirty... covered with salt and dirt. The Tiger Express Carwash was awesome. The workers (3 of them) pretreated it and worked hard doing it. I put a tip in the container and they all smiled and thanked meso I knew they were appreciative unlike many these days.   My car looks great and I will return!

I ordered blintzes as there one of the specialties. 
I was expecting crepes filled with cheese and sauce with strawberries. 
The pastry was too thick for my taste. 
Hubbies breakfast was not to his liking either. 
I've had sandwiches there and they were great. 
Disappointed no staff were wearing masks.

Yelp has not updated the hours for this location. I've submitted an edit to this, but for now here are the CORRECT hours I found for this location. Overall, good service from this location!


Monday 4:30AM-10PM
Tuesday 4:30AM-10PM
Wednesday  4:30AM-10PM
Thursday 4:30AM-10PM
Friday 4:30AM-10PM
Saturday 5AM-10PM
Sunday    5AM-10PM

The food and service is great. I always get a salad, eel sushi and the hibachi rice. The prices are very reasonable too. 

The booth seating is private and tucked away from the hibachi grills, great for a date night.

And I just love the waitress. She is awesome!!

They are usually pretty busy and do a good job of trying to get people in and out quickly. Sometimes it's tough because they have a small lot, but the reps are all very friendly and very helpful. I've never had any issues with this Enterprise and use it any time I rent a car.

I brought my car in for a tire rotation.  Check in was quick--the guy met me at my car as I pulled up!  The man that helped me was friendly and helpful and made sure that my car was taken car in a timely fashion and finished quickly to save me from sitting in traffic on my way home!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This is really closer to 2.5 stars. Especially for a Sheraton this was below average. Shower water pressure was atrocious a/c was broken for a day and a half, the breakfast was just ok. The staff was very nice and willing to go the exes mile do that makes this worthy of 3 stars but for the price I've had better hotel stays.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We stayed one night prior to flying home the next morning. The lobby and dining areas were clean and reasonably appointed. The dinner and breakfast were excellent. The room was small but had what you needed for the night before a flight. We will stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Food was great. Service was not bad.
But in the end they charged gratuity 18% on the bill even though it was just me and my friend. And they didn't tell us anything about the gratuity. If we didn't see the bill carefully then we might had payed more tip then we needed too.

We went for brunch on a Sunday 
Morning. They easily accommodated our table of 12. We did have a reservation and were seated quickly. The server was very nice, accommodating and quick. The food was fresh, prepared well and served hot. We all had standard breakfast items nothing jazzy. 
We would definitely return.

Fast and friendly service for a Saturday morning!  Thanks for the great fade!  I was expecting a long wait and was pleasantly surprised to walk right in and sit in a chair!  Location was clean and close to Fish Hawk and the price was right!  Keep up the great work gents!!

The employees were very cordial in the drive thru...however, they messed up our order.  Ordered two six piece chicken nuggets...one had 4.  Instead of honey mustard...they give us pure honey.  No ketchup as requested.  The only thing I did catch was the drink order they messed up.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I trust Don and his techs with all my cars, that is if you can get an appointment. Everyone knows how good they are, and the place is always busy. I recommend going here. I travel 25 minutes from West Philly, and fight the Washington Ave. traffic to go here.

Didn't appreciate being forced to buy water by very loudly being told by the lady..."are you sure? The water here is VERY bad!!!" You cant filter water for your patrons? And after that, never check on us again? Portions were very smal with meatball panini has 3 small ones cut in half. It was basically a marinara panini.

Pretty soso, I thought, sushi was not at all fresh on a Tuesday night. Maybe I got unlucky, but I also wasn't crazy about the steady diet of rap music that accompanied the 2 TV screens. Not a real peaceful vibe, frankly. Friendly service, but I had no desire to tarry.

I came here by recommendation.  I was greeted and told them what I wanted.  I was quickly seated and attended to.  The work was good and efficient.  The price, I thought, was about average for Nashville.  I left satisfied with the service I had received.  I would certainly recommend Apex to a friend.

This place is ok but the bartender was very  rude,and the band was your everyday Burbon st band, nothing special.what I dislike the most about this place was the dirty bathrooms,I should report them to the health department...I'll go there again only if I'm drunk out of my mind.

It is a good restaurant. The location is great and if you go there during summer you should sit outside. The waiters are not helpful though. We asked for fries for at least three times and the waitress brought it in the third time. However the food is really good. I suggest you should try their wings they are really good.

I came here to get some change for nephews and they told me that they only had $50 in $5s in the entire bank.  This is why I belong to a credit union!  The only reason I even have an account at this bank is because I use their 3% cash back rewards visa card.  Seriously?!!  A bank with NO change.  Sounds like a lie to me!

Our clothes have always come back looking great. 

There is usually parking in front, for very quick drop-offs & pickups. 

Jim, who usually handles the interactions with customers, is a gem. This place gets 5 stars, but with Jim there it should be bumped up to 10 stars!

Amazing customer service, really.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
The hotel staff were friendly and breakfast buffet was nice. 
The bathroom was spotless but in the living room there was a lot of black mold in the air vent that made me feel dirty the whole stay. 
The hot tub was fantastic but pool water had a green tint to it, and visible algae on some underwater surfaces.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Lilly's tacos used to be very good for the price of the tacos my family and I used to go there all the time on Friday but after a while The food started going downhill the meat was very dry and no flavor so you had to use a lot of the condiments to make it taste good.

I called last minute hoping for an appointment and they were able to fit me in! I went from platinum blonde back to my natural dark brown hair and they did a beautiful job (Giovanni did a great match back to my natural color)! It was a very clean salon and all the staff was very friendly.

The most horrifying experience. It took two hours for them to serve our food on a Monday night where bartenders forgot to submit our order. No apologies were given and we were barely asked if we needed a drink ugh. Don't waste ur $ here on bad service, rude staff and semi food.

This is my favorite restaurant in my area the smoked wings are one of a kind and all on the menu is a treat. The smoked brisket Sandwich and mozzarella sticks are amazing. This is a must go to if you are in the area. Service is amazing and food is fantastic.

2 stays in a row they checked me into a dirty room.  2 out of 3 mornings they forgot my wake up call.  Daylight savings?  Fix the clocks since I don't carry a screwdriver to do it myself.  Not sure what other hotels are around but I don't recommend this 1 star hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Went for a birthday dinner.  Horrible acoustics  Food was tasteless.   Service was  so poor.   Asked for a cake to be brought out at the end for a birthday surprise when I sat down and waitress was all confused and delivered a tastless cookie  no one knew she was coming thus no singing.   Very disappointing!

I've never been disappointed when we go here. Everything is fresh and made to order and homemade. They pride themselves on quality ingredients and every time we go, we feel like family. Tonight we had the House Vegetarian pizza with spinach, broccoli, tomatoes and ricotta cheese. FABULOUS!!!!

I rented a car in Tampa and it smelled like the strong "new car" fresheners.  When we finally located where both of the freshers had been hidden and took them out, we found out why they were there.  They had been put into cover up the cigarette smoke smell from the last renter.

Was visiting New Jersey and stumbled across this unassuming restaurant in a strip mall of all places. We ordered fettuccine carbonara and chicken parm. It was fantastic. Both soup and salad and garlic bread is included with ea meal as well. Next time I will skip the salad. Prices are reasonable too. We will be back.

Another stellar experience at A1 Japanese Steak House earlier tonight.  The wife got the filet mignon and chicken combo and I stuck to my California roll and Avocado roll.  We complimented our food with plum wine and hot sake!  Drink and food delivery were timely and the staff was on point.  Always a great stop for us!

One of our favorite stops in Mooresville for some delicious sushi and Bento boxes!  The family business has a super friendly staff and the sake is delicious.  The staff remembers us and knows exactly what we want to drink.  That is one of the many reasons that sets them apart from your usual stops.  Good times and good food!

Fantastic!!!!! Owners are extremely nice!!!!
Food is so so good. Last time we went they had house made hot sauce, the Serrano was phenomenal! Food is authentic and delicious! Pipian Verde was incredible. Arroz con Pollo was also super good, we added chorizo. Haven't tried anything bad!

The sushi is really good.  But as I write this I've been waiting 45 minutes for my two sushi rolls.  I've eaten here a few times.  Except for after the lunch rush, it always seems to take a long time.  Like I said, the food is good but I don't know if it's worth the wait.

If I could leave no stars I would . Awfulllll service . We ordered on doordash and called them and we were told that they don't do doordash. The call was interrupted and my friend called and the lady hi g up in her face while she was talking. The food was cold. There was no napkins or forks like we didn't order all of this rice.

I have been to several Mavis Discount Tire Centers. I found the service I received at the Oldsmar location to be the best. The Manager Felix was very knowledgeable and helpful. Even though this location is farther for me to drive to, I will make this my destination when I need maintenance on my vehicle. Cheryl
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Room is nice. Front desk girl was SO KIND AND PROFESSIONAL actually everyone at the front desk was AWESOME! The hotel only have three floors so you have the option to take the stairs. Very clean hotel! No complaints I stayed here two nights very comfortable and clean
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Excellent homemade Italian with a great presentation. Custom drinks are great, try stormy Monday. Service is excellent. Does take out and local delivery. Highly recommended. 

Homemade pasta and motz was excellent.

Extremely reasonable prices 

Great discovery

We stop by for lunch.  We had nachos and a burger. The nachos were good but the burger left alot to be desired.  I can't comment on drinks since we decided to go alcohol free, but i was not very impressed.  
If your going to check it out best go in the evenings after 8:00 when they have live entertainment.

We booked an entire wedding weekend and extremely pleased with the hotel as well as the staff .  Kelsey and Meghan were tremendous, both assisting with wedding details making our stay there perfect.  A first class operation.  The view in each room was spectacular. Thank you Tampa Marriott.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place was once my favorite. You couldn't expect too much in this area. They didn't have a much variety of sashimi/nigiri, but the food were in a good quality most of the time. One good thing was that they had sashimi, though indeed the size was way too small.

They outdo themselves every time I visit. Last time I was there I got a tremendous haircut. I had my appointment with Kyle Addison, his attention to details was really amazing and you could see it in the outcome. Really satisfied with my haircut

"This is one of the best haircuts you've ever had" ~
Girlfriend :)

Thanks Sir.

this place was great a few years back. whoever is running it is running it into the ground. everyone has an IQ below 80.

12 minutes to cash a postal money order.....................

Ill just open an acct with Republic Bank and close this one down. Been going here for 35 yrs.

@MarcosPizza 6102GunnHwy
Tampa& @UberEats drvr tried to scam us. Got message from @UberEats app.Drvr saying @MarcosPizza there's a remaining balance of $11. Called @MarcosPizza mgr claimed doesn't know how to work delvey machine & Call @UberEats. Won't delvr w/o more $
Canceled order.
Glad I saved screen shots.

Food was good; well above average.  Service was slow, seemingly in the kitchen as our waitress was attentive.  Noisy.  Difficult to have a conversation.  There was confusion about whether they a BYOB.  Long story, but no one there quite understands what their liquor situation is.  We did figure it out.

A cute Inn right in the middle of the Quarter. I enjoyed my stay here very much. The staff were super friendly and helpfull. 
The room was pretty spacious and I even got a balcony. The style is old, colours are a bit boring but that might just be my taste. I felt pretty clean and price was good
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Based on other reviews, apparently I'm 
not the only guest with a frustrating experience over missing personal items. Generally nice property, but minus one star for charging premium prices in a very not premium neighborhood. Minus another star for GM not returning an email.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Not quite sure that they clean the salon thoroughly. Another problem is they care about what they want to watch on TV more than what their customers would like. Customer service is not a priority for management. The good: I had a tech, Amy, who was great. She was a little slow but cared about my nails being perfect.

Hogies were good but overpriced. Lots of flies trying to get our food and drinks which definitely makes enjoying a meal tough.  Service was pretty quick but then again we were the only people in there for lunch. To finish out the outing the bathroom was disgusting and didn't have any toilet paper.

Food is terrible almost every time I stop here. Hash browns come out either like hockey pucks of not cooked at all and covered in grease. They never take the time to put their sandwiches together and always come out falling apart. The only plus is the coffee.

Jenna did a great job styling my hair. I have long and easy to tangle hair but Jenna was gentle and so I had a nice relaxing time as she combed and styled it - just what I needed. I also really like that the salon uses and sells the whole line of Kerastase products.

Was excited to try this place but none of the employees had masks on, incredibly rude. Another customer praised them for not abiding by local rules as I was incredibly uncomfortable by the lack of respect for their customers health and safety. Very disappointed and I will not be returning.

My husband and I ate at Emery Wood last night.  First things first - our waitress was FANTASTIC!   She was helpful and friendly and just knew her way around this restaurant.  

The only thing that was disappointing and why we won't be rushing back to Emery Wood Fired:   the TEENY TINY food portions.

Best rental experience I have received in a long time. I rent frequently for work and even though this is a personal rental the we're very professional especially with dealing with the insurance company. Would definitely come back here when I need a rental again.

I called this Dunkin and asked what time they were open till and they told me 9 o'clock. I showed up 10 minutes before closing and they did not take my order after telling me that I could come till 9 o'clock. Very upset with my experience and will never go to this Dunkin again.

Quick service and wonderful staff. The parts needed for my Mercedes SUV were ordered and delivered the next morning for my appointment, and I was in and out the door in an hour as quoted. All the guys in the office and the guys working on the cars are so friendly --  personable and knowledgeable. Thanks guys!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I moved here from South Florida a couple years ago and was looking for a car wash. I somehow stumbled on Camel Car Wash and wow I am impressed. One of the best drive thru car washes I've been to all around the US and am an avid road tripper. Thank you Camel and looking forward to referring many clients.

The worst place ever to eat and unprofessional people you'll ever encounter!! The bald headed mother-f*cker with glasses was rude and did not take my order and handed me my food with out a bag!! Do not recommend this Burger King to anyone!! Especially the service was subpar!!! Bad service overall!!!

went there a second time. Had the jamison style wings. they were great. also had a flatbread pizza. My husband had the spinich salad he said it was ok. Just be warned there mixed drinks a pricey. If you want a cheaper mixed drink go to the candlewyck or pineville.

We like this restaurant very much that we ate twice on our stay. You can have different rolls for a small price and you get to taste really good flavors. I liked the Tchoupitoulas roll very much. They even kept the restaurant open past 10 pm so we could finish our dinner!

Waitress was good and worked hard. The place is understaffed. It took 30 minutes for a visit from someone so we could order a drink. 2 hours to get the food. I think the workers are fine, but the management is skimping on payroll. Don't go there to eat until he place is properly staffed.

I am so pissed at this place that I am actually creating an account on yelp just for this review.

I ordered everything and 1h30 after did not get my food.
Not only that, as I called them and they said "we don't have your ticket".
So pretty much waited 1h30m for nothing.
Terrible service. Never again.

I will not be returning to this location. The drive-thru employees are in dire need of some customer service training. As someone in the industry, there are times when you want to say something rude..but you JUST don't!! Sorry you were having a bad day, but your customers are not the ones to take it out on!

The cashier was extremely rude and and refused to help us when our corporate cards chip didn't work. She said she didn't know what to do and refused to help. I was after I told her we would go somewhere else, she stepped up to help. How rude. I won't return to this Starbucks again.

Nasty overpriced pizza. Nearly $5 for a slice of pizza. Sauce was very sweet and watery. Don't be fooled by the cars in the parking lot. They belong to employees. No one needs or should want this. Tear it down and put a gas station or something ppl will use. Waste of time and money. YUCK. You should be ashamed of what you sell

Stopped by early right before opening and needed to get a oil change before work. I didn't have a appt nor a lot of time to wait so Victor took me in and completed the job in less than 45 min.... Great service and I highly recommend big brand ...Thx for everything
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Nice clean and friendly place. Salsa not very tasty. I had the El Rey chicken burrito. Burrito had very small amount of chicken. My burrito should have been called a onion and pepper burrito. Its a shame the food is not very good because the employees are great

Not the best sushi in the area.  I was out and about in King Of Prussia area and I was craving sushi.  I have been here last like 10 years ago.  They were accepting diners so my daughter and I went.  As soon as we parked and got out of the car, we noticed a horrible fishy stench.  This alone will make me not come back again.

Good service. personable waitress and the waitstaff was savvy in making sure we wanted for nothing. We had drinks, appetizer and salad. Food was fresh and drinks were cold. Only recommendation would be to make the calamari more of a signature dish with a little more flavor.

Food is great...service not so much. Great margs! But the serving staff is hit or miss. The guy behind the bar sucks and when he forgets to put in your order he gets an attitude. So seriously good is great but go in understanding service blows! I love around the corner so we've tried 3 times now and same every time!

This Italian restaurant is awesome!  The food is authentic and tasty. The price can seem a little high, but the portions are huge!  They definitely do not skimp!  The staff is always friendly. We do take out and dine in, either option is great. The dining area is clean, and pre-Covid, always packed. Love this place!

This location is rude rude rude. Be prepared for impatient tones directed at you as soon as you walk in the door. I've rented from this budget as a fast break member 6 times and it never falls short of aggravating when dealing with these representatives. They completely lack customer service skills. One word GHETTO

Ok, so I was one of those tourists that got lured in to the patio seating, perfect for people watching on State street...but I am a "foodie" so I was disappointed. 

Service - SLOW!!! I swear we waited over 15 minutes before anyone even brought us water. 
Food - Mediocre
Price - too high for mediocre.

This gorgeous hotel is located on a hill in the suburbs of Nashville.  The view is spectacular.  The hotel suites are large, clean, modern and well appointed .  Staff is very friendly and helpful.  Ample parking is available.  Several shops and restaurants within short driving distance.  Fantastic option for a romantic getaway.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
So let me hear this correctly... The mechanic breaks something while doing a simple installation of a tire and I'm supposed to foot the bill for your error? According to this Dobbs location. Do yourself a favor folks and go to real pros. Not Dobbs. The only professionalism here is taking your money for subpar service. 

natin
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Goleta Sushi House is my favorite sushi place in the area.  The woman who runs it makes it special by treating us like family. She even made us her special creation on our last visit which included tempura avocado!  The sushi is really good; we haven't tried much else.

Eh it was just ok. I got California rolls and they fell apart when I picked them up. They barely had any filling and The avocado was brown. The roll selection was small. They got my order wrong and then blamed it on the chefs. I guess I'm spoiled living in the bay area...I would not go back here.

I was a little skeptical because of the location at first, but once we were inside the delicious aromas gave me confidence. The menu is a little cryptic but we ended up with the carnitas plate and pork flautas, both were worth ordering again. Portions were good, quality was solid, and the check was small. De-lish!!

Me and my friends love this place for it's food, wine and has a full bar.  The ambiance is very comfortable and cozy.  The bar is great to sit at and have dinner as well.  Ivo is one of the bartenders who will make sure you are taken care of from pouring your wine to ordering and serving your amazing meal.  Fantastico!

Must be new ownership since the rating does not reflect the good quality. The gravlax (cured salmon) is fantastic.  Something my wife and I can't get anywhere else. 

Friendly staff and the place is clean. Lots of choices for sushi and rolls.

We make a trip from LA twice a year and will be stopping here every time.

It's quaint, well staffed, and attractively priced given the location.  Really, it's got a lot going for it.

That said, it's still small and fairly high priced on an absolute scale.  Think of a Manhattan hotel.  Now relocate it to Monecito.  That's what to expect.  Similar quality plumbing, too.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is one of the nicer Holiday Inn chain hotels that I've been at recently. The staff is friendly and accommodated every need. The building seems to be new and in very good condition. Easy access to the mall, many eating establishments (I recommend Chili's) and a huge shopping center.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Nice ambiance but the food was average and bad value.  Clam chowder was okay.  The cheese bread was some mozzarella melted over a french baguette that totally lacked flavor. Pork chop was very tender, but the flavor  wasn't infused well.  The veal saltimbocca was tender and well cooked, but the flavor was average.
