The Hotel is a bit outdated. The rooms were decent. The Front Desk staff was great. The Bar and Restaurant staff were not so good. Very short, no smiles and we always felt like we were a bother to them. I was here for a convention. We will see if I come back here next year.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The food was good but the portions are small considering the price. I ordered the Chilean sea bass; it came with a small piece of fish and four asparagus. It was delicious but if I am paying close to thirty dollars for a meal I should leave feeling full. The restaurant was clean and the staff was friendly.

Great patio!  I used to love this area when I lived in St. Louis so I was excited to get back there last week.  I had a pasta dish I can't remember the name of and it was awesome.  I practically licked the bowl clean with the bread.  Can't wait to be back in St. Louis and dine here again.

Came here for mussels and some appetizers but the service was extremely slow and not to mention forgetful. The mussels weren't as good as they were before but I guess you can attribute that to different chefs working or something. Still waiting for the check to be delivered as I write this.

I was soo impressed with this place!!! The atmosphere & food were amazing! The staff was outstand, not pretentious, & very professional. Get the deviled eggs W/ brown sugar bacon. We wernt sure at first but my friend & I LUV'ed THEM!! I cant wait to go back!!

I would not pay full price for this Omni.  Half of their rooms face this weird dirty shaft that had spider webs and other grossness on the windows.  They made a mistake with our booking and it took a while to resolve.  On the plus side, the service is pretty good and you can use the pool at the Omni Royal.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: You'll be pleasantly surprised by the quality of food at this strip mall Mexican.  Portions are generous, drinks are good, food is interesting and well seasoned.   We had a fine time, and thought value for dollar was high.  We generally agree with most other positive reviewers.

One of the best selections of beer on Bourbon Street, but at a price. I was excited when I saw a place that had an IPA on tap, but not excited when she charged me $11 for a 20 oz cup of it. Alas, I had one brew and was off. Friendly bartender, plain bar, good beer, bad prices.

Mexicano style tacos were lacking, and I found a chicken bone in my burrito, which was also relatively blah in flavor. If you want to pay by card your order must be $10 or more, which is why I got 3 tacos and a burrito.  Probably won't come back here, Guatelinda and La Parada both have better tacos, in my opinion.

Definitely worth your time. The servings are big; did the movie rolls and went with Anger Management, the Man on Fire is really good too. No need for the all you can eat, since one roll is big enough to fill you up unless you have been starving yourself all day.

If it wasn't for the nice waiter, I'd have given it a one. First off the food was expensive of course. Second, the food was not that good. I had a veggie omelet, so bland and tasteless, it was just a hint better than cafeteria food. 

The coffee was ok. I will never eat there again.

Hotel is great - the staff however is another story. I simply called to confirm my reservation the woman called ADDY was unbelievably rude and could not even confirm a simple reservation, I then spoke to her manager and he was great. If you don't like people ADDY please don't work in customer service bye thanks.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Nice modern lobby. No room service.  Comfortable bed. Minimal toiletries..had 2 face bars no body soap and no body lotion. For this rate you expect at least lotion. Staff was businesslike..not rude just not overly friendly.  Room was clean with large desk area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The Service was interesting. The guy who took my order was rude ... And Made me feel like i should not give them my credit card over the phone... 

The philly cheese stake I ordered was bomb but my pizza was delivered like so tried to call to complain but they did not answer the phone

Located in the heart of downtown Indy, the Westin is a nice hotel option. Clean rooms, nice amenities and a friendly staff make this a good selection for those not looking to break the bank. Walking distance from Lucas Oil Stadium and Bankers Life Fieldhouse as well as the Red Garter and Chick-fil-a.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We made reservations and went last evening for the first time.  The food was good, when we finally got it, but the service was not acceptable.  They did not have adequate wait staff.  The tables beside our party of four sat down, ate, and left before we received our main course.  We will not be going back there.

I've only been here for happy hours... but they have a really nice happy hour. Legitimately good wines by the glass, featured cocktails, and really great small plates. 

They're also good for larger groups (and by that, I mean 4 or 5 people) and have outdoor seating on Broad Street. 

Definitely recommend.

Pretty good, but too pricey for my taste. I guess I am too used to buying amazing Mexican food at taco trucks in LA. 

The other negative was that it took FOREVER to get my food to go. About 20 mins, and there was no one else in line. Guy in the back was sleeping or something. 

Great salsa bar.

Amazing food. Went here for lunch with a friend. We asked them to make items that were not on the menu and they did! The food was great and authentic. We ordered the malai kofta which were not on the menu but the cook made it from scratch. Tasted great. Friendly workers. Prices a little too high.

Nice staff and room. Actually, the room was better than expected. Nice modern renovations, down to the heavy, sliding doors for the bathroom and bedroom. Plenty of space in the King Suite. The single elevator to the ground floor, however, proved to be a choke point. Would definitely stay here again and recommend it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The menu needs a little more of a selection my hamburger was alright I've made better hamburgers myself does't compare to any of the little Hamburger joints I'm accustomed to out in Southern California were I came from the finger Steaks were a little dry would i go back no unless a new owner improved the quality of food.

I stayed here for one night. Very cheap.

I noticed random hairs on my bed sheets and mattress, also even in the pillows I saw a small stain. I believe it was clean, they must have not used a lot of clorox. The area is very isolated. At night it made me not feel safe. Other than that I didn't have any problems. I slept peacefully.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
We got here pretty late and left pretty early the next day so we didn't see much. It looked like they had some fun amenities we missed out on though - pool, hot tub. 

The room was clean and the employees were nice. The girl refilling the food during breakfast was a bit rude but everyone else was really nice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Got in late last night and this morning we found a old Budweiser bottle- not ours! on the floor yuk!!! We requested to have our room cleaned while we were out wine tasting and our rooms were not cleaned! Trash cans are full and the Budweiser bottle is still here! Do not stay here!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Recommended to me by a friend/local. A good little Italian restaurant in a fun area. Menu was small, no white sauces btw. Service was good and attentive. Not sure if I would go back if visiting again but it's a solid choice. Must have reservations for parties larger than 2, in my opinion. Food was very good.

Bill's Auto Repair was a huge life saver. We were in town on a family emergency when some one thought it would be cool to smash out our car window to steal absolutely nothing. We called Bill's and they were very helpful to try in squeeze us in. Within 2 hours we had our windy replaced. Can't recommend this place enough!

Well, I went back in yesterday, but this time it was slightly disappointing. The bread was too hard... still got great taste, but just a bit too hard. 

I still like this place. I recommend the dish Chicken Scarpariello. It's spicy & flavorful in the very right way. It will takes your taste bud into a new level.

Love this place!  Being a Franklin girl I am more than willing to truck my happy a-- up to get this ice cream!  With all kinds of crazy flavors to tickle your taste buds it is so worth the calories!  The salted caramel is my favorite, but they are all delish!

Would have gave another star but my soup was borderline warm at best. Really disappointing. On a positive note, the Hawaiian Roll was excellent.

Staff was friendly and wait on a Friday night was above average. Sat at the bar and was sat immediately. Overall, nice atmosphere but lacking attention on quality of product served.

2.5 hours for an oil change! I had an appointment scheduled! When I asked to speak with manager, he was gone for the day. Absurd, first and last time I come here. If I wouldn't of asked it would of been longer. Ridiculous, this was at Cerritos location x( you thought jiffy lube was bad! This place suggests extreme car repairs.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Stopped by for an oil change on Saturday around 3:30. He told me he was out of the gasket for my car. He gave me a coupon for the inconvenience. But was thoughtful about it and was willing to get it for himself. Rescheduled for the following week. So different from the one off bell and 67th!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Crap service, decent salads. My friends ordered crab dip which was dropped on the floor and left there. When we pointed it out to the server, she muttered "Accidents happen!" smiled weaklyvand left. Guess what? It was left there for the rest of the meal and we weren't even compensated!!!

Read the reviews on Yelp when deciding to go here. It took a really long time for us to get served and even to get any waiter attention at all. The taste was nothing to write home about - normal, maybe even somewhat bland, Italian fare.

Disappointed, but maybe it was a bad day? Would try again if I'm in the neighborhood.

When you get service, it's great place with a friendly staff, but ... and this may be the mid-west pace thing, but if you come at a time that's peaking for the area (Saturdays for instance), get ready for a waaaaaaiiiiiiiittttttttttttttttttt (translation:  a long wait).

I really don't have much to say, your typical uneducated employees. Maybe one person is ASE certified, then again, how hard is it to change oil or rotate a tire. Sales department is simply b.s, but then again all parts counters are a hassle.


Still hate this place
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We went to this place while visiting family in Boise. It was featured in Diners, Drive-ins and Dives. The food was good, but the ambience is entertaining. The Mac and Cheese was just o.k., but our sandwiches were tops. Try the sweet potato fries. They were closed really early on Sunday, so check their schedule before going.

This was a great hotel to stay at. Centrally located and near all the important spots, this hotel provided a nice bed and friendly service. 

The remote to order a movie was not working and the room was a little cramped, but, hey, that's not why you're in NOLA anyways.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I needed a nice haircut within a window and they delivered. I was seated right away, asked what I wanted, and within 30 minutes I was out of here looking sharp. 

The only thing that was hard was finding it, as it is underground and I spent 5 minutes on the surface looking for it, lol.

My room was very clean and modern looking.  The renovations seem to be worth every penny.  All hotel staff members were extremely friendly.  I would definitely stay here again.

A few cons: be prepared to spend $40 on parking, huge hotel-put on your walking shoes to get from the lobby to your room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This place was local to the company I was visiting.  Room was clean.  Staff was professional.

Free internet in the rooms.  Cable.  Etc.  All the normal business hotel amenitities.  The only complaint is that there weren't a lot of restaurants in the area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The hotel itself gets 2 stars....they get an extra star for location.

Room was not ready at check in so I had to wait in the lobby.  The room is kind of small and the only window is indoor facing which makes for a loud room.  Several items in the room didn't work and I had to exchange the luggage stand for a new one.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We got the chicken with wine sauce and the sauce taste like crap. It literally taste like they put tap water in when making it. It had a weird after taste that's for sure. Chicken was a little rubbery. The chicken noodle soup was good and of course the bread but cuz the main entree was horrible we won't be coming back.

This Chinese restaurant is the best carry out I have eaten at in St. Pete.  The place is clean and has enough tables if you would like to eat in.  The food is made fresh and is hot,tasty, and the portions are large.  The prices are also great.  I love their tofu and mixed vegies.

We heard so many great things and were really looking forward to the pizza. We ordered online and it took about a little over an hour to get it. It seemed a bit over cooked. The cheese was harder and dry. 
That said, they had wonderful costumer service and their pick up set up is very efficient.

Pretty decent. Nothing too special. Owner creeps me out a bit, but other than that.. definitely worth going to.
Bring your friends, not a date.

Pros:
Cheap
You pay for what you get

Cons:
Pretty damn ghetto outside
Next to some sketchy Mexican restaurant/bakery?
Parking lot is shady
The interior is an eyesore

Stayed here for a party with eight people.  We all had different rooms and they were all nice.  It's kinda loud if your room faces magazine street but I guess you can get ear plugs.  The staff was super friendly the front desk manager heather was so polite and accommodating.  I would defly stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I have been to probably 50 or more Motel 6's and this is one of the cleanest and nicest ones. Great price too, $40 a night. Has a pool and indoor hallways. A/C blasted cold during the hot summer outside :) Friendly staff and a good range of little green-belts for my dog to do his business!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We were in town visiting my daughter for family weekend and she was craving sushi.  We found Fujiyama on yelp and It was not a disappointment. For what it's worth, we live in the San Francisco Bay Area and the food here was on par with many of the restaurants in our area.  I highly recommend this restaurant.

Friendly helpful staff. All of the ladies are so pleasant! Dr. Itabiyi is the best....very kind, courteous and he explains everything he is doing. I don't know where the negative reviews are coming from. Must be old reviews from when the staff was different.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: i wouldve given it 4 stars if it wasnt for the blonde bartender, who would come up to us, then walk away just as we were about to speak.  she ended up attending other people who came in after us.  i dont know, maybe it was because she could tell we were from out of town... anyway, cool live music and yazoo is an awesome beer

Tried both the NY and Chicago pizzas. They were both really tasteless and boring. We wont be returning here.
When you call to order the daily special for take-out make sure that you ask for the lower price on the phone or they will charge you the regular price. Nice.

The pizza was okay, although in my opinion the sauce was a bit too sweet and the pizza itself was too greasy. However, my main issue with the restaurant was the price. I get that it being located in IV means that they could charge more, but $34 for a pizza and pint of beer is absolutely ridiculous.

Wonderful family run restaurant, pastas and steaks done to order, nice wine list, dessert choices are limited but wonderful. We will find a reason to return. A true deep family owned Trattoria with all working in the business. Love for your work really comes thru.

I just moved to the area this week and was looking a bit rough as my family informed me!  So my uncle  came in for the cut and I came in for the DE-grizzly Adams !   I met with Laura, and welcomed me to her station.   On top of being a wonderful new face that I was introduced to, I found a great and talented barber.

Went at lunch time.

High priced for lunch. Extremely slow service. Try someplace else for Italian food in New Orleans.

Excellent tasty food but small servings (like Paris, France)

Medallions (egg plant with sea food filling) great.

Blackened red fish, tasty.

Won't go back..

Picked the perfect night to be at Tutto Bene. Adam took great care of us. The cocktails had were a wonderful mix including the Ritz Old Fashion. Dinner was fabulous. Service was top notch. Dinner music was light and entertaining. Can't wait to come back. Thanks for a perfect date night.

Beware of the rooms in this place. Our experience was not good. The only advantage of this location is close proximity to the city of Nashville. 

The linens for our room smell bad on the first night. Then we found bugs in the room on two different occasions. Look for other options in this area if you want stay in this area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I finally found a stylist I love. Keri is great. Friendly, patient with my complete indecisiveness, and on top of it, an amazing colorist and can cut it too. I've been slowly trying to drift toward being a blonde, and she's done a great job easing toward it. I'm happy I finally found a stylist in New Orleans. :)

We were very pleased with the service and breakfast offered each morning of our stay recently. The reason we can only give this two stars is that the hotels HVAC system is has a fan that stays on continually. Hearing the blower all night took a lot away from what was otherwise ok. Would not stay again unless this were corrected.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
They have iPads in the waiting area along with free chargers (USB and AC) where you can order an overpriced drink and it magically appears in under 10 minutes. Perfect!

I guess they need a better way to figure out which iPad placed the order because I needed to let the waitress know the drink was mine when she came by.

Staying at the hotel for the month, have not had a bad dish there yet! For dinner this place never has more then half the tables filled, which is shocking! The food is great, the service is good, and the ambiance is beautiful! So happy that I am staying at a place that has reliable food which is always important!

This entire crew that works here is the rudest I've ever seen... And incompetent Sunday morning at 11am and they're out of donuts! Out of donuts? Serious? 7 employees and they're running around like crazy... someone needs to train these people...  I see why their stores Yelp is so low. Rude and incompetent

Came here for a quick lunch, had an amazing server Jenny, she was fun! Welcoming and Informative about the menu and very quick with the orders. Decor is circa 1970s which adds to the charm although not the most up to date place the food is amazing, freshly cooked and loads of it.

Great water front seating. I wish they had better chairs (plastic chairs) but the atmosphere and wait staff were friendly and helpful.  Regular American fare but the pulled pork sandwich was better than average. great place to view the river and the bridge.

After a terrible experience over at Fariview... we drove across town because we' found this on google. It is in a nice part of town. VERY helpful staff- (THANK YOU TIFFANY!)- rooms are clean, probably the nicest we've been on so far this trip. I wish we'd just booked it to begin with. Its a great bargain over here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Clean, large rooms, cheap rates, and tons of tv channels. Definitely better than expected. Only downside was that the adjoining room door is paper thin and could hear everything! They were unfortunately super loud and woke my husband and I up super early with a loud phone call. Could also hear the ironing board being set up, etc.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is what you call a "bar". Not that loud, obnoxious stuff over on Bourbon. This place has the neighborhood feel to it along with the look. Don't mind the dogs on the floor when you first walk in, they're regulars. I haven't eaten here but I have had a few tasty brews from their tap. Great place to stop by if you're in the area.

I will never go here ever again.  The lady who seems so nice there just told me what I wanted to hear with no regard to my questions.  She said repeatedly she will get back to me and never did.  I finally went into the office myself and found out she sent my car down the road to another place.  Poor customer service.

I was here for my birthday week and never thought there was a resort that would exceed my expectations and this place is amazing! Staff is friendly/professional/fun/smiling and the pastry chef is amazing.  I loved the water slide and pool, and the beautiful scenery.....just say YES.  Thanks again all...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: You must check out their comprehensive selection of craft beer and spirits!! Everything was well organized. Definitely had that "kid in a candy store" feeling. They still haven't gotten their official sign, so keep your eyes peeled, as you could roll right passed it.

On the plus side, Staff is friendly & respectful. The building is modern, rooms are great, beds are super comfortable.

On the minus: no hot tub! The complex is huge & spread out. Therefore shops & amenities seem sparse and kind of expensive. No free wi-fi :(

Great  hotel, better suited to sports fans and conventions.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I was pleasantly surprised with this White Castle. The service was very friendly and super fast. The food was typical White Castle, I did try their ghost pepper slider and it is spicy. It is not like the typical spicy fast food offerings. You have been warned.
I took my food to go; however, the dining room was clean and updated.

This is a nice Main Street type diner, with friendly waitresses, standard food, a good place to land when you are road weary and don't want to support the corporate chains. Had blueberry pancakes, scrambled eggs with spicy sausage and coffee. Good, solid if you are nearby.

I ordered the Cajun dog with everything and the bread was bigger than the dog and she doused it with so much of the condiments I immediately regretted ordering the works.  The dog itself was tasty though and whenever I am in terminal C I will probably stop by and order a plain Cajun dog.

They got the job done. It's not the fanciest or cleanest place but I got a manicure that I needed. One of my cuticles was cut in the process and the edges aren't as clean as I like them to be. $35 for gel manicure is ridiculous, everywhere else in Manayunk is ~25. Not going back here

This is the best Sushi/ Hibachi that we've had since moving to NJ in May. We found it on our way home from Philadelphia. It's about an hour from where we live, but we will definitely be making the drive to come back for date night. 

They have an all you can eat option which is amazing if you plan on eating multiple rolls.

This is by far our favorite Subway. Have been going there since they opened. The staff is always friendly. Food always fresh. Even when the line is out the door they are able to get your order done quickly. Order is always correct. We eat here about 3 times a week.

i have been to a few dunkin' donuts in new york and this one by far is the cleanest and fast. Seems family owned which is not a bad thing i liked it here oh and i also got some dunkin' donuts mug since i am from the west coast and they do not have any over there so it was nice to be able to get a souvenir  from the franchise

As much as I love Coffee Bean as a whole, this location is hit and miss for quality of the drinks.  Only a handful of baristas actually make the drinks I order properly, namely iced chai lattes.  70% of the time they come out as a watery attempt.

There is always space to sit however which is a plus and the free wifi is convenient.

All around fantastic. Owned by the most wonderful couple. First time I went in I learned it was owned by my old 2nd grade teacher who not only remembered me, but somehow got even nicer!  It's blasphemous to say this in STL, but it's much better than Ted Drewes and I said that before I knew who owned it!

Super great burgers, hoagies and cheesesteaks and they have falafel which is awesome. The pizza used to be bad, but they changed it and it's very good now! Maybe that's why they got such bad ratings. Also, in the past their staff was pretty often not courteous.

I got my hair done by Joe. My hair was really long but I got a haircut for only $18. I was so surprised how cheap it was when he did such a good job and put so much time and effort doing my hair. He was so friendly and did amazing job!!I will come back here again for sure!!!!!:)

No restaurant no breakfast two star pool.
Leaky sink makeup pillow dirty elevator and floors. 
Comfy bed! No ice, five choices of snacks. Five choices of drinks in a vending machine. Random full trash bag from a trash can on the middle of the third floor someone forgot
I wouldn't stay here again that's for sure
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: It was ok food. Expensive for the quality and kind of food. The Bar was the spot to be and the drinks are excellent but the food agghhh it was ok. I don't like to write negative comments but I was expecting better quality. Again I guess for the area was ok.

Here for a conference right before 2013 Super Bowl. Room was dirty, toilet ran continuously, and the pool was closed "for the season" despite the claim in the brochure that it was open year round. I wouldn't stay here again. But the bed was very comfortable!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I love Roy, the fresh food from the Farmers' Market, the service, the ambiance, the music, the art shows... and I always meet someone fun and interesting. When I have visitors from out of town, Roy is my first choice to bring them to. It feels truly Santa Barbaran.

I honestly felt this was the worse Mexican food I ever had. My meat was so chewy, it was steamed and not grilled...onions and peppers so big and barely cooked. I didn't even like the homemade chips. I just moved to the area and REALLY wanted to like this place. Very disappointed.

I'll give one star for price and one for location. The room was clean, but the bathroom was disgusting. They did come and replace the toilet seat,  but the damage was done by that time. Never in my life would I have expected a newly renovated hotel to have a rusted sink and old disgusting brown toilet seat.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Service is nearly always slow here and on the last three visits order has been either incorrect or they have given me too much money back. Seriously mismanaged personnel at this location, and most of the time they are out of basic product... love the coffee but that's about it!

Worst Starbucks experience.  They served FROZEN food and would't serve food that was in the display case because they would "save" it for friends coming later.  They ran out of drinks multiple times.  Further, there was chaos with too many people standing around in the back talking and not working.  Management should be aware.

I thought Criniti was just OK. The menu was basic Italian fare that reminded me of Italian restaurants from the 70s. Our waitress was great, the atmosphere was nice, but the food was average. No one at the table was overly impressed, but no one hated their dish either.

This place has the tastiest tacos! There are several meat choices, different salsas, and fresh cilantro and onions for garnish. I've only taken food to-go, so I can't comment about the sit-down area. The line can be out the door but they are so quick! Food is made fresh all day long. Tacos are $1.90 + tax (as of 8/18).

Horrible! Don't go here. The bathroom door was broken so anyone who closed the door all the way was locked in. I had to force the door open to get my friend out. The floor was soaking wet the entire time near the sink. The patio door didn't even lock. This is a terrible hotel. Find a new place!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: It is open late and they will give you pizza in exchange for money. The pizza itself is three-star, good but not great, the wings would be a four-star rated separately. They are in a garlicky smoky jalapeno sauce, very spicy and delicious.  Overall an average college adjacent late night pizza place.

Tried to eat here last night, restaurant almost completely empty owner refused rudely refused to seat us because they were too busy and only had 1 chef working. Really?? There were maybe 20 people seated in the entire restaurant if you can't handle another table of 3 then maybe you shouldn't be open at all.

Lovely, welcoming staff, but thoroughly dissatisfied with haircut. Uneven on top and a failed fade back and sides. Overpriced at $40. If it's the shampoo and hot towel shave that's bumping the price up, this should be communicated better. Likely won't be back.

Cool place! Make an appointment or you'll be sent away before your ass hits one of many empty vintage chairs lining the back walls.
Make an appointment?! In a barber shop?
One star for a cool space... Not that I'd know... I drove from Memphis to be dismissed within 5 seconds of walking in...

I take offense to being a repeat paying customer on a consistent weekly basis only to be asked to leave at the stroke of 10pm. Maybe the male and female employees working on 3/16/21 should seek employment that suits their less than stellar attitudes. The yogurt quality is always good though. I'll give them that much.

We have eaten here 3 times and were never disappointed. Nachos are a favorite as well as the tarragon ranch salad dressing... YUM! Entrees are fabulous and the prices are low for the quality of food. Homemade deserts were the perfect ending to our meals. Happy to have a great restaurant in Harleysville with a great beer selection.

Great family owned place! Was a busy night but owners made sure to get us set up with wine at the bar while we waited. Fast service and amazing food!! The "ciao Bella" pasta was so tasty and fresh. Highly recommend this place if you want true home style Italian food!!

This place is awesome... if you love karaoke, local flavor and a view of the river this is your place. Only serves beer/wine, bring cash... and don't dress fancy. The parking lot is VERY small and it gets very crowded. But if you want a good time where you can relax, enjoy and watch the entertainment, this place is for you.

Save your money. The rolls are overpriced, the food is not good or worth it, and the service is ridiculously slow.  We went during our hour lunch break and didn't even get to eat. We had to ask for it to go. Won't be going back. There are much better sushi spots in town.

I had a good lunch today.  I was looking for veggie and was able to eat a tasty blackean burger and some soup.  Service was OK. The soup was tasty but not very infinitive.  Cauliflower, Carrots and vegetable broth.

When fall comes this is a great outdoor seating with a cool view just outside of the main downtown area.

The vacuums at this place do not work this place is a rip off, this business is a rip off and should be closed down by the city of Nashville. Tried to speak to the workers with your kids they are very rude and just walk off from you and tell you they don't care

So unfortunately the espresso bar was closed. The only thing they had left was regular coffee. They promised me the next time I come to the espresso machine I'll be ready. Service was great. And I will have to definitely come back next time for a real espresso drink.

Do you like surprise orders? Do you like waiting 20 minutes for "fast" food? Are you an otherwise unemployable crack head who needs a job to steal food from? If you said yes to any of these questions, you'll LOVE this McDonald's. It's run by morons and open late! Enjoy whatever they can muster up to feed you!!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Called in order and was told 10 to 15 minutes.  Got to the restaurant 25 minutes after my call and food was not ready so already disappointed. No point in calling. 

However portion was huge just like others mentioned! You get a whole baking pan of food! The amount justifies for the amount you get BUT the taste was lacking.

Service was good and appreciated the low-key live music atmosphere (vs the louder, bar music down the street). Food was good but not great. Took the servers recommendation on Chicken Marsala, and while there was plenty of food, it was by far the sweetest Marsala sauce I've ever had - too sweet for my preferences.

Great service every time I go in. Absolutely the worst driveway entrance and exit anywhere. Constantly blocked due to poor planning with the drive through. You literally take a chance of getting into an accident if you are pulling in to park. It is a law suit waiting to happen. They need to fix it now before someone gets hurt.

We stayed at the French Market Inn this past week. First impression is that the staff is absolutely wonderful & helpful. Our room was ready an hour before check in which was great because we had a tour at 4pm. The hotel was clean & beautiful. We booked a petite room that overlooked the courtyard. I would definitely stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I had a wonderful experience at Moody eyes. The staff was knowledge about eye care and helped me pick out the perfect pair of glasses for my face. My eye glass prescription is very high and this is the first time in my life I have a pair of glasses that don't look like coke bottles. They are very affordable and have great hours!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The all-you-can-eat mussels over pasta on tuesdays is a great deal. Adriana's sauce is great. They also have some decent salads. I havent tried much else since I always get the mussel dish.  Overall this place has pretty solid food and the perk of being a byo.

I've been to this location multiple times and have had nothing but positive experiences.  The stylists here have a lot of regular clientele which is always a good sign.  The stylist I see is Kelley who is always attentive and smiling.  I once saw getting a haircut as a chore and dreaded it but now I actually look forward to it.

Cashiers have issues paying attention. They will ask you what they want and after you say what you'd like, you'll need to repeat your self 3 times. The donuts need work. They are sloppy and never ever have enough filling. I just paid $20 for donuts that have dry centers. Taking my business elsewhere.

This place reminds me of a good tacqueria in CA, but with a larger menu selection. The portions are just enough and the salsa bar is very good. The food was good. The only draw back is I was in the mood for a margarita and they don't serve alcholol. Only reason for not giving it 5 stars.

Ronnie is awesome! We are visiting Nashville from Worcester and wanted to get a more local vibe on our last night here..the beers are cheap and cold..great music playing and great company. I would definitely recommend stopping here on your tour of Nashville!!

Great outdoor dining options.  We enjoyed the lounge atmosphere with our toddler.  The crab burger is good but could be more seasoned.  Good jalapeño Mac n cheese.  Hubby liked his crab Benedict but the potatoes were cold and stale.  Okay coffee. Excellent service, very attentive.

Ordered extra spicy General Tao chicken and sesame chicken. Exact same thing!!! The extra spicy wasn't spicy AT ALL!! The rice sides were wrong and sushi was awful. Not to mention it took over 2 hours to get delivered from grub hub and it was awful, wrong and late.

This will be straight to the point! They might not have the best fried rice in St. Louis, but the simple fact that they deliver makes up for a lot of it. Sometimes if you want delivery you have few options, pizza or pizza, or oh yeah pizza. Check the out if you're in the mood for something different!

Great customer service.

Prompt service and vehicle in great condition.

The only drawback is that this location is not in the airport itself. Instead, you take a shuttle and are taken to the reservation office.

Shuttle drivers were very friendly as well. I would rent from this place again.

I have gone to this place probably about 4 times. Every single time, each associate is super friendly and knowledgeable. Everyone working is always pleasant and helpful, without trying to get me to buy a lot of services and goods, plus they're speedy and do a great job!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I might be partial because I live so close by but this is my absolute favorite local restaurant. They have a great local and regional beer selection along with rotating seasonal drinks. I've had a couple of different dishes but I always end up coming back to the Colonel burger which, in my opinion, is the best burger in the area.

Worst place EVER! Waited in line for over an hour IN THE RAIN!! Only to be told when we got to the door that they were not letting anyone else in. The door guy was the rudest person I've ever come in contact with and the manager wasn't much better! DO NOT GIVE THEM YOUR BUSINESS!!!! Terrible customer service!

Menu is well rounded with just enough changes based on season to keep things fresh. Gluten free pasta portion is perfect!

Skip's Alfredo is the best I've ever had, and mixed with his tomato based sauce it makes the best blush in Nashville. 

Awesome people, awesome food.

This is my go to place for Liquor.  The beer and wine prices cannot be beat so I usually buy in bulk so I dont have to keep going back and forth.  The staff was pretty knowledgeable about their product and friendly as well.   Sometimes in life, its not who you know but where you buy your liquor.

Ordered shrimp lo mein with no vegetables, had an overwhelming amount of vegetables that that was all you could taste. 

Changed my review to a one star because it gets worse and worse every time i order. Doesn't even taste like normal chinese food anymore.

Slowest Wendy's I've ever been to. I try back once a month or so to see if a new employees have been better trained. Nope...consistently slow drive through. Not even at peak times. Based on other reviews I've read I think this place needs a visit from corporate.

Always an amazing place to go for ice cream. Jenis has a cool vibe. Great service. Needless to say amazing icecream. They make their own cones in shop so the place smells amazing while the cones taste delicious! Their service is wonderful even with lines out the door. I definitely will go back !

Our group should have checked the reviews before sitting down.   We thought we have an hour and could do a proper sit down meal.  Well, 50 minutes later and we are still waiting for food to show up.  I am cool if you tell patrons ahead of time the normal food turnaround time but not this place.   

Yes, avoid at all cost.

This place is one of my fave places to go! Personally I am obsessed with their carne asada sope the mass is shaped and fried right there fresh when you order with Frid cheese loaded and then all the toppings. Tortillas are made fresh to order as well and the food is amazing. Great staff friendly and simple menu but lots of choices!

Juliana is a flipping goddess!! My hair was a snarl of bleach and bad dye and she saved me in time for my friends wedding. She took out some bad knots I was afraid I'd have to cut, gave me a style, fantastic dye and a blow out that survived Florida summer. Love the barber shop vibe, I don't do salons. Will be back!

Food is terrible... Burnt but the worse thing is the female manager who only gives a lot of attitude! No apology and demanding a receipt! She could have saved a customer by caring... does she really think I'm just going around trying to cheat restaurant out of a $2.00 sandwich?
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: You can't beat the price and meat portions of the tacos at Lilly's. Very fast service, tacos were ready ten minutes after I called in an order for pick up. The server was very thorough to make sure I had any sauces or condiments I needed for my to go order.

It was 6pm on the dot. Drive through ATM was closed. Like of 4 people for the inside ATM(because they haven't added their new ATMs and won't be adding them for another year and a half). Banker comes out to tell the customer to wait as the machine says "could not read" and doesn't bother to help any of the clients in line. Makes my

Bring a book.   Preferably a long read.... like 500 pages.   The waitress was extremely nice, however, was not supported since she had 13 tables.   The "infamous" Caesar  salad is a 3 at best.  I'd prefer a ready salad from Publix.    If you have time for a 4 hour dinner, this is YOUR spot! Cheers.

Got my eyebrows and lip waxed here and they did an excellent job at an affordable price. $17 flat for both waxings, and my eyebrows were shaped very nicely! Finally, no swelling and irritation afterwards. 

I will be back soon to try out a manicure/pedicure!

Extremely poor service. They gave me the car and the mat was still dirty so I sent it back to get vacuumed properly. I then drove off and noticed my cup holders hadn't even been vacuumed or cleaned whatsoever and there were a bunch of spots still left on the body of the car! 
Awful.

Your basic, small pizza parlor.  My wife ordered a pizza with pesto and artichoke heart on one half and Hawaiian on the other.  We carried the order out.  It was okay--the crust was a bit thick for me--I've tasted better.  I would try other items on the menu if we visit again.  We're just passing through.

The atmosphere takes you to the orient.don't let the taco bell and mc donalds stop you... it's not just a chain experience. The rolls were so yummy...we had 7 different ones.the service was attentive...my tea was never more than 1/2 gone. Can't wait to go back

Had a chicken pizza last night and it was great! Great deals,service, and desserts including my favorite, churros! This place knows what good pizza is! Also the service was great saying I'm one of those difficult customers that never know what I want! They were patient and welcoming. Would recommend.

I don't come here for my weekly grocery shopping, but I do stop by every now and then for specific items. They have awesome prepared foods that are great for lunch or dinner. Although I am a big fan of Fresh Market I only give it three stars because it can be a bit pricey.

Fresh, delicious sushi! SERIOUSLY, some of the freshest sushi I've ever had. We had the hibachi, as well- and it was amazing. The great part, we thought, was the fact that the sauce was so light. Very healthy option and scrumptious! Incredibly friendly staff. Fantastic prices! We will continue to come here regularly from now on.

I had dinner there Saturday evening and I was not very impressed.  The service was slow and the chicken burrito and chicken tostada I ordered had absolutely no spice to it all, even the hot sauce on the table was weak.

The only positive about this place was the chips and salsa.

Very good.  The bread was excellent. Chicken Parmesan was awesome as was the cannelloni.  Only 4 stars due to two things, the salad that comes with the meal had way too much dressing that ruined it. Also where we were seated was where people were waiting to be seated so it became congested and annoying.

If you're looking for the bar you saw on Bar Rescue, don't waste your time. The fancy blinking cups are gone, the stupid turtle drink is back, and the resurrection was nothing to write home about. If you are just looking for another no-frills stop on a Bourbon St bar crawl, that's about all it's good for.

The quality is decent but the nigiri is a very thin slice of fish and a huge proportion of rice.  I understand that the profit margin for all you can eat isn't huge but I think it would better to charge a little more and serve a bit less rice would be better in the long run. Just my two cents.

Love these guys!  Very honest, very good at what they do.  My family has taken our cars there for years.  I can always trust that their assessment is necessary, and they always call before they start a repair, so you are never surprised when you pick up your vehicle.  I would not take my car anywhere else.  Team Warren!

This hotel was clean and well maintained, but showing it's age.

The room was comfortable and clean. The bathroom was nicely sized with a good shower.

There is no fitness center, although there is an outdoor pool.

The WiFi was good.

The highway noise was very intrusive, making it difficult to sleep.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
It's nice place , but not clean as you expect it , there is dust on lamps and other areas , bar cooler its not clean 
They didn't clean the room till 3ish ! 

For the price they charging people I deserve more ,,,
We had breakfast and service and food was okay not excellent
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Very bad experience!
Hostess tried to sit us at a dirty table, had to ask her to clean it before we could sit down, deep dish pizza was cold and under cooked. A green leaf was floating in iced tea, waitress disappeared numerous times. Red pepper shaker top was dirty and had a hair sitting on it. 

Will not be going back.

We don't understand the rave reviews. The sushi & tom yum were mediocre. The fried oysters were small and tasteless. All together, we tried about 8 items. Everything was pretty much tasteless except for the house salad (delicious) & miso soup.  We wouldn't go again.

Puttanesca with Gluten free pasta: the sauce was very salty., it had chunky olives, tomatoes and pickled peppers along with capers.  Pasta was over cooked- mushy.
Chicken parmigiana was heavily breaded and pasta was again over cooked.  I will not be back here.  Terrible food!

Amazing laundromat!  Very friendly staff. Reasonably priced.  Yes some machines are out of order, but stuff breaks so people need to understand thats why there is a variety of washer/dryers. I will definitely be coming back. A bonus is that they will do your laundry for you for a charge!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Kind of a dive bar but the band that was playing was amazing... 80's rock!  A bit smokey and a cheap bathroom hostess peddling for cash in the ladies room....soap and towels in exchange for money... come on! Fun time dancing...would definitely go back. Right on bourbon street.

This place has gone downhill. Actually served a ribeye instead of filet. I feel a little insulting that they think people can't tell. The place was dirty and unclean cooking practices touching raw meat then serving you rice. This goes in my never again list.

i love dunkin and for the most part have good experience. however the staff is not knowledgeable of the products. asked for a medium coolata got a small and wanted french vanilla and i don't know what flavor i got but not what i wanted. please educate your employees!

when you taste the food it is good however when you go into the restaurant and look around is it appalling. they never wear gloves. they grab food from the cooler without them and eat right from there. the girls are siting ontop of the freezer with no shoes one. where is the state at?!

A terrible experience from start to finish. It took 20 minutes to get a drink when the bar was 15% full, the restaurant area was less than half full and when I went to order food, was told it would be 45 minutes minimum....for soup! Bartender wasn't friendly at all.

The gym is to Planet Fitness standards. Decent equipment, machines, and free weights.

However, I had to listen 3x to their voice recording to get their email address to initiate my cancellation, almost like they didn't really want you to have it...

tampafowler.fl@planetfitness.com
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Ordered take out. I'm giving 3 stars because it wasn't what I expected for the price. The toasted raviolis didn't come with enough sauce so definitely order extra and the picture of the cheese cake came with strawberries sauce and it didn't have any on it when it came

For a Hotel restaurant it's not bad. I had the Prime Rib with asparagus and potato wedges aside a carrot cake with fresh whipped cream and vanilla bean ice cream.  Steak was a little tuff but the cake was to die for. Ask for Elijah he understand the need for desert if you care to indulge.

Terrible experience. I have never been treated the way I was there. Me and my fiance are unfamiliar with the area and wanted to get alterations done. By the end of our experience lady was completely rude and disrespectful. We will never go near this place again.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Comfortable, clean, pleasant. Nice breakfast. Coffee, tea, and hot chocolate available in lobby. Cookies every night. Laundry only costs $2 to wash a load. A good enough place to sleep every night. Water heater broke on our last Morning, but other than that, no problems.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Draft Latte... wait, what?! This draft latte was something I've never seen before, but I saw someone order it and immediately had to try it. First of all the weight of the latte was crazy. So light and refreshing. The rest of the drinks and coffees all looked great as well. Go La Colombe!

Eye exam was through and no waiting to be called back! That never happens! Was impressed! I picked my frames ,the ones on sale and they were done in 68 minutes wow! My friend an I went together and hers were done in 30 minutes! Again ,Wow! Can't beat the price or speedy time! I can see clearly now!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Chase is always so reliable it's such a relief! The staff is great at this location but Moe is the best. He was so patient and helpful solving many of my issues within minutes. Stress free banking is essential and they nailed it! Get this branch new computers, they deserve it!!!

Beautiful store with a great selection.  However, 50% of glasses are "behind the bar," where no customers are permitted and 20% are on lockdown....the ONE expert staffer will hopefully be able to choose your perfect style if you are the only customer in the store...maybe.  Planning on going? Extreme patience needed.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The food is absolutely delicious.  Not much has changed in the years that I've eaten here except for their prices. I would recommend this place especially their flautas. I don't know how they do it but it's a flaky flauta shell instead of a crunchy one. Three stars cause it's a bit overpriced.

Great ramen but service was slow at lunch today.  About 30 minutes to get our two bowls of soup.  My friend likes the chicken udon and I enjoyed the miso  ramen. I've ordered takeout before and my order was ready in 10 min so not sure what the deal was today.

The worst experience ever! The crab is imitation crab and they don't disclosed it on the menu, they charged for a hand roll same as the roll, basically a rip off. And it's not even that good. They told me that customers already know that is imitation crab and nobody cares, never coming back!!! Horrible

Midas is a very good business. As a woman I always do my research when it comes to my car. So many places try to take advantage of women but I just happen to be the rare woman who love learning to fix them. Each time the price they quoted has been very close to what I expected after my research. Very honest business.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We not only waited 10+ minutes for our food, we were asked what we ordered after we paid and received only 1 fry even though we ordered 2 combos. In addition, our chicken tenders had a half of a cut up chicken patty substituted for a tender. We did receive a complimentary apple pie upon asking but it also sucked.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The eye Dr was good,the 2 hour 15 minute wait was brutal,with no apologies.They couldn't find a pair of glasses for me within my 300$ insurance allowed.The choices of frames seemed outdated.So I left with just my perscription.I wouldn't recommend this place,it was an uncomfortable experience for me.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This is the absolute worst Burger King ever no matter what time you go what day there will be a long wait . Pulled up on a Thursday night at 8:30 and "their system was down and they was closed" absolute terrible experience every time i don't think I'll ever come back to this location if i could give negative stars i would

We had the opportunity to host a rehearsal dinner for twenty. Everything was ready when we arrived as we dined on the patio. The food was excellent and the guests commented that it was the best Italian they have eaten. As you can tell from the comments, we highly recommend Giannfranco's for your party or a romantic evening for two.

Not a huge fan. I have been several times and always it is just...meh. I have had better. This last time, we mentioned to the server one person's roll was really bad and they acted like they could care less. I will likely not go back. There are better sushi places.

Are you kidding!  Went here with another couple after hearing so many good things. Wow!  Food is so so.  Had to ask the server for coffee and about the desert menu.  Was so noisy we couldn't hear each other across the table.  We will not be rushing back here any time soon.

This is by far my favorite all you can eat sushi place.  The food always comes to the table fresh and the presentation is a bonus! This place is also the only one where servers take the time to point out which sushi is which. Combined with the excellent service, you won't be disappointed!! And definitely try the Godzilla roll!!

Car wash is whatever. Nothing special. Workers are rude and one even cat called a lady while waiting for her car to be ready, pretty awkward. 

Pricing is standard, $20 for a med range car wash. I really only came because my car was disgusting and needed someone other than myself to wash it.

Pretty disappointed.

It was a beautiful day to sit outside by the lake. Our waitress was very friendly. However we waited 55 minutes after ordering for the food to arrive. Our waitress did not explain the delay until we asked her about it. I don't think I will go back because huge wait

The man who helped myself and my 3 friends out was so helpful and sweet. He made sure we knew about the speeding in Delaware and then before we pulled out of our parking spot he ran out to the car to give us some reusable cups for our trip. I'd recommend this place to anyone a million times over!!

Stopped her for the night..it was very clean, bed was very big and comfortable. some of the lights didnt work but it wasnt a big deal. We slept thru breakfast :( we were so tired from driving the ladys at the front desk made check in and check out very easy and quick and they were veryyyyy nice!! Thanks ladys.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The room & location are fine but if  you need Internet forget it. They offer enhanced for about $10 a day but good luck getting it to work. You get an hour of the slow speed for free but it's really  slow. Basically if u need Internet you may want to choose a different hotel otherwise it's not bad.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Very nice and friendly staff.  Offer water bottle when I went looking for water.  Though they do have water at their cafe for free.  

Ice machine every floor and and soda machine too!!! 

Non-smoking. Spacious. Neat and clean room.  Very comfy compare to other hotel such as western.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Booked here on Expedia.  Place is falling apart.  My ac woke me up every time it came on and this is the first time I've stayed at a hotel in the United States of America that doesn't have hot water.

I have a good sense of humor so I made it laughably bad but it was pretty terrible.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Quick and friendly service. Unfortunately good is very average.  Goat cheese pizza on the bland side as was the kids Margherita. Penne Arrabiatta was so- so as well. Fried Calamari app was fine but not memorable. Fine for a quick basic meal. Skip if you are looking for something memorable.

Horrible... I eat a lot of Chinese food and was in the area and decided to give this place a second shot. (First time was not very good) . My orange chicken was soft on the outside, flavorless, and the inside of the chicken did not look appealing at all. Twice is enough for me, would not recommend.

Great place! The staff knows you by name and is super friendly. It's much less crowded than the gyms in L.A., I been going here since I moved in 2014. 
I live 3/4 of a mile from the Planet Fitness off of Sunray - but I drive 20 minutes north because I'm a creature of habit.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This is one of our go to pizza delivery. Pizza is fresh and hot when we get it. Definitely recommend the Brazil's special pizza! You can't go wrong! Only complaint is that it can sometimes take a long time and they only accept cash or check. Need to get up with the times.

Came for dinner with my wife and daughter, hostess gave us an attitude from the get go. It was raining and they were moderately busy but not packed. Mrs Courteous told us we could sit on the patio. In a rain storm... when we asked about why we couldn't have a dry table she shrugged her shoulders. Won't be back.

Such a great spot! I was on a business trip so my colleague and I went here for dinner one night and my goodness I'm glad we did! The spaghetti and meatballs were out of this world with huge portions! Definitely would be a go to place if I'm ever back in town!

Passing thru Santa Barbara we stopped here all randomly and tried it.It was super awesome and great it's as close to home made tacos you can get aside from your mom and abuela.The only negative would be street parking is restricted or severely limited by the local PD.

We ordered delivery; sesame chicken, wonton soup, spring rolls and tofu lettuce wraps.  It was all mediocre.  The spring roll was a tiny egg roll, the sesame chicken was basically just chicken skins with very small pieces and little meat.  Tofu was ok but not great.  Won't order here again.

If you are looking to get a great haircut awith a great barber, look no further. I have been going to Nicole now for a few months and I am never disappointed additionally my wife loved the way I look.

One of the best parts of going to Nicole is having the option of a hot lather neck shave. 

I highly recommend Barber ND!!!

I just want to say this gym makes you feel welcome.they have free trainers on board to help with weights.it has a big parking lot full of parking.amazing massage chairs tan beds...its always people there working out in a very positive safe environment. I like it.Planet Fitness Gym ,Mantua NJ  Monique Henry
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Long lines are always expected here, and it's a bit pricey, but the flavors are unique and absolutely delicious. Wildberry Lavender and lemon custard were my favorite, and they always have rotating seasonal flavors. They are also open late, which means the perfect after dinner treat.

The hotel was about half full, with a lot of rooms. It was a non-smoking hotel, but there was a twinge of smoke smell in my room. Continental breakfast was there, but no fresh fruit and we had to make our own coffee. Wi-fi quality was actually pretty good!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: After being in Nashville a couple weeks, I was looking for a dive bar that's not a honky tonk on Broadway.  This place is a perfect after work watering hole if you happen to be staying downtown and don't want to deal with the crowded tourist spots.  You can always find a pool table, and the grub ain't bad either.

My husband and I vacationed in Clearwater a couple of months ago. We had a hankering for ice cream one night and ventured down to this little shop.

The ice cream was okay, I had the cookies and cream and he had a blue vanilla flavor. The cost was reasonable and the staff was friendly!

Went to Limoncello several times, always had a good lunch. The last time we went, we were seated right away, buy then ignored for over 15 minutes while others were served around us. Wait staff just stood around, so we just got up and left, the hostess saw us and said nothing. Won't be going back anymore.

We had a great time at this hotel for a bachelor party. Marissa in the front desk told us all the hidden bars to check out and great food choices in the funk zone. If she didn't navigate us there then we wouldn't have been able to find this spot.
The lark had good drinks and sand bar had good tacos
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Thought I could tell they were dealing with the understaffed-strains of the pandemic, our waitress was wonderful and food was great. I wasn't the biggest fan of the Lemon Drop roll (too big of a bite and not enough texture) but that's a personal preference.

One thing they are good at is forgetting to read the ticket on request. Second time they charge me for xtra lettuce and I don't get it and asked for no cheese and they give me cheese. 
I understand they were busy but ppl will wait for good food not shitty food
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Very nice place, staff is very friendly and provide great service. The food is good and the sushi is fresh. The first time I ate here I did not like a piece of fish in my combo, the sushi chef gave me a complimentary piece of salmon within seconds and then a piece of tuna a few minutes later.  I will be going back.

I ordered via Doordash the mushrooms panini and Honey BBQ wings. Thankfully the wings were decent so it wasn't a complete waste of money but I will never order to go again. The mushroom panini was so soggy, I could not eat the bottom piece of bread because it was soaked. The fries were also stale

Food and drinks were great but service was really slow due to the new QR code system they have. Waiting for drinks for 15 minutes. Then our food shows up at someone else table. It really complicated the process. The manager came by and gave us some free tacos for next time. So that meant a lot.

He said: Chow pretty good.  I think she says it all...

She said: The food here was good, but the staff was excellent.  We left an item behind here on our way further south. The staff held it for us for several days until we passed back though. I give the food a 4-star rating, but upped it to 5 because they were so helpful!

I have been going to Magic Nails for the past 5 years since moving here. I absolutly love them. Mai is an amazing waxer and she gets my eyebrows just right every time. I also love to get my pedicures there. I get the gel and they last for forever! Highly recommend this place!

My favorite neighborhood sushi spot! This is perfect for takeout, as well as eating in. All of the staff members are fabulous and so sweet. The sashimi is always fresh and so good. My favorite roll is the naked tuna roll and the rainbow roll. The rock shrimp tempura salad is another favorite.

Wow. Ok. I've wandered around the French quarter various times within the past um few years. I've wandered into this place on occasion, as you do. I would just like to say, what the what?  The zydeco bands here are really, really, really really good. Did you get that? They are just crazy good ok? You really have to stop by.

ABSOLUTELY TERRIBLE SERVICE! I waited 45 minutes for them to bring the car back to the Enterprise. I was repeatedly told that the car was almost ready, only to find out that the car had never even left the previous location. There is a serious lack of communication, I would NOT recommend.

The hotel is ok. Rooms are very small. You pay for wifi but it doesn't work. The valet service is horrible since the cars are probably parked in The next state over and they charge you 35.00 a night! Hotel seems expensive for what you get. Over 1600 for 3 nights at 2 rooms.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This location is slow. Over an hour and a half for oil change and rotation. That was with an appointment and while I waited there for it to be finished. 

Have had great experiences with the high ridge location, but plan on leaving your car for the day for anything you want done at this one.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I come here often. The service is great. It's a small sushi bar husband and wife run the place. I can't comment on the raw sushi because I don't eat raw fish but the crystal roll is very good. It's a California roll with baked scallop sauce on top. So good and prices are reasonable.

My non-smoking room smelled like smoke. The carpet was gross, one elevator and ice machine were out of order, the a/c didn't work well, old bedding, and gross carpet. The guy at the front desk was really nice and helpful, which was the only thing this place had going for it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The quality of the service was subpar. We went in for a casual afternoon lunch. The staff was not particularly welcoming, and the entire experience just felt as if our presence was slightly inconvenient. 

The pizzas themselves were reasonably priced but fell short on the execution. Will be giving them another try. Updates to come.

If you're a fan of chorizo, you have to try the chorizo tacos here. They are PHENOMENAL!

Both the guacamole and the street corn were good too. 

I felt the chicken taco was a little underwhelming, but it doesn't matter because I will be ordering chorizo every time I come here in there future. 

Did I mention I love the chorizo?

This place is not a "posh" or upscale place, but they are nice and do a good job.  David or Anthony are the two best in my opinion- they take their time,t alk to you, and are extremely nice.  Their prices are a little cheaper than some of the other places and I think even do a better job.

We are used to ordering our coffees with all sorts of special things done to them. Iced, but dry with only 1/4 scoop of certain flavors, etc etc and these people bent over backwards to make it just like at the coffee bean at home. Nicest people and helpful!!!

Been here twice now, both times have been a major let down. Lots of spots and no where near clean enough for a $12 wash. The free vacuums are nice, they would be better if they worked well. Won't be returning, if I have to wash my car after the car wash then it's a total waste of money.

Another good stay in the SB area! Modern, clean, spacious...all of the above. Not to mention they have a lovely rooftop bar/restaurant with live music on certain nights and lovely views. Free self parking, large lobby and they have cookies. This place is an absolute ten...I will stay here again next time I'm in town.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Coriell EyeCare is one of the best eye care and exam companies I have ever been to. Making appointments is a breeze, everyone is so nice and helpful. I have such a hard time picking out frames for my small face and have scored 100% with the help of the staff. And such cute frames! Recommending to all to give them a try.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Never had a bad stay here st the Oxford. Rooms are always impeccable, breakfast crew are efficient and friendly. Front desk staff very cordial. Pool and hot tub clean and welcoming. My favorite thing is the lounge and fantastic bartenders there. They make the stay the best way to wrap up the evening.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Terrible experience and cannot day I am surprised.  The lack of respect, cleanliness, and overall attitude of the staff was disturbing.  Drove a few extra minutes and avoid this location.  There are plenty of great starbucks around happy to serve their customers with the respect they deserve.

Shane from new orleans was the best server I have had in a  while. With 3 adults 2 kids and a dog he made us all feel like family. The food was delicious. Which is hard to find for a dairy gluten free girl like me. Definitely worth the price for service and yummy food.

This is a great place that I notice is empty most of time - I can't imagine why. This place  served some pretty good Pasta when I dropped by. The pizza and the bread were fresh and pretty delicious. At around ten bucks for all of the above, I'd say this place is great value for money. I strongly recommend it.

For all-you-can-eat the price is totally worth it and especially worth it if you love sashimi, which can get hella expensive at other places if you're ordering it a la carte.

Their sashimi cuts are pretty thick as well, so you'll get your money's worth. 

The service was very fast and we'll definitely be coming back again :)

I had a great experience here. It was clean, the bed was comfortable, the shower was hot, the gym was up to date, and the front desk staff were friendly and helpful. The breakfast was just ok, but it was a classic free hotel breakfast, so I can't take a star away for that.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
For an airport spot it hit the void. I gave it 5 because it has perfect view, charging station at every seat and the server came around often to check on me. 
It's an airport. Look for something to fill your void and know it's NOT gonna be cheap! $15 for a double cranberry vodka. But worth it for my travel!

Desmond at the front desk and Chastity at Batch Bar get 5+ stars but my room gets 2. I initially was next to the fitness center and the slamming door was awful so I switched rooms. My current room has a Porto-potty like smell to it. Otherwise this hotel is nice but I probably wouldn't stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Great spot inside City Museum. Kids split a Bacon Cheese Pizza and the wife and I split a turkey bacon club. I loved the Chipotle Mayo!
A little pricey but expected since it's inside the museum. Wasn't expecting such quality food based on the location.  Pleasant surprise!

Food is great service is slow but waiter (Jack)  is awesome they even comped a $26 plate because is was slow... So do not expect fast service but friendly.. Not really the servers fault just management's.  Go sit wait and relax and enjoy.  Oh yeah try the crembole... Spoooooooon on!

Food was awful. Chef does not know how to cook Branzino. Basically just smothered everything in butter no crisp whatsoever. The portobello appetizer was tasty but extremely small. Place was overbooked and people were hovering around the tables the entire time we ate. We will not be going back!

Poor service.  The waitress brought two of five meals out wrong.Those that were correct were all brought at different times and the sides on the plate were cold. She also forgot one of our drink orders. All of this on a not so busy night. On a good note the tomales once I got the correct ones were good.

Have a room here for the weekend.. asked when i checked in if i could use a tall chair... the answer was yes!  Chair never arrives so i call again and the seemingly tired front desk person said no,  we don't load chairs out!! So much for even trying to help.....
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I had never been here but needed a haircut and the reviews were good so I took a chance. Chris did a great job and was even able to do a beard trim which I had not scheduled.  Love the haircut, the beard trim and the overall service and conversation.  I will be back

We stayed here for a weekend getaway and we found the Conrad to be very clean and inviting.  The staff was very friendly and helpful with anything that we asked of them.  The location was perfect and right in the heart of the city.   We would highly recommend the Conrad to anyone!  Two thumbs up in our book.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Wish I could leave less than 1 star...when you wait over 30 minutes for 2 meals to go, its uncalled for! Its called fast food....its barely food and its not fast. It felt like they had to kill the cow in order to make the meal! And its not like there was a long line or anything. Ridiculous, even fine dining is faster service.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Not the best Hilton property for sure. They are in the middle of a remodel, but they still need to keep the rooms clean. I checked into a dirty room, not like someone slept in it, but like contractors worked in it and cleaned up a little. It may be better after the remodel. Treadmill was broke too!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Lunch deals are killer! We got all this food for around $6 each. So much food! Everything is delicious too. You can substitute the drink for an egg roll, egg drop soup, and there are other options. A+. Highly recommend this place, especially for lunch. Lunch deals also take place on Saturdays, score!

Great location, and lots of parking. The rooms and the hotel grounds were very nice. The service when checking in was great. However the staff doesn't greet their guests at all. I walked pass the front desk 3 times today and the same older gentleman just stare at me, no words just looks. Guess I'm just use to friendlier staff.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Took the wife here for her birthday dinner.  Great food, we were in the patio in the back which was really pretty. The servers are fast and made some great recomendations. I had a lobster and seafood linguine and she had a seafood risotto.  Nice wine listing, not too long.  Would love to come back next time we are in the area.

I ordered a pizza and they told me one hour. An hour and 20 minutes later (and a phone call) my pizza finally came.. And it tasted terrible. On top of the awful taste, it was mostly crust. Bad crust. Never again. Not even sure why I gave it the second star.

It's on Bourbon St maybe we should have got drunk first.  Food was low quality for the amount we paid.  Wife and I each had a glass of house red, lasagne and our 3 kids had spaghetti side orders.  We spent over $100.  Lasagne was dry and not very tasty.  It's New Orleans.   You can do better than this joint.

Decent sushi - I'm not sure why it has such high reviews  I was looking forward to coming here and was disappointed in general. The prices a great but I just wasn't in love with my roll- it don't think it was worth the walk over but I would be willing to give it a second try- maybe I just didn't order the right thing!

Donuts are good but customer service is horrible. Cashier name on my receipt is someone named Sauny. She was very nonchalant, rude, and made it clear that she did not want to be there. Didn't say hello or anything and rolled her eyes when giving me my cash back. I don't visit often but I've had much better service in the past.

Got a car wash today, and they did such a poor job vacuuming and cleaning the interior, I'd rate ZERO out of 5 stars if I could! I specifically paid for the interior to be cleaned and it was a TOTAL waste of money!!!! Manager did not offer to correct and was barely apologetic. DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY!!!!!!!!

Waited 30 minutes beyond the promised time after arriving :/ Also the quality and taste of the pizza was poor. We had a few slices and then didn't even eat the rest, it just wasn't good. This is my first Yelp review if that gives you an idea, I just think there are some other options out there, save your time and money

very good local Italian place. portion sizes are a little bigger than necessary but everything is tasty. house garlic bread is delicious and fresh. lasagna was very good. the menu is kinda simple but it's' all well executed. the atmosphere is pretty good for being a repurposed building.

The food here is great and one of the best Chinese restaurants in town! Only downside here is that some of the waiters are sort of rude, you have to ask for everything twice, and the lack of parking spaces. If you come decide to come here on a lunch or dinner during the weekend, prepare to wait to be seated.

Car never gets dry.  I have the monthly car wash for the best wash.  I literally have to hand dry my car every time.  I'm talking the front, back, sides, the entire SUV is still wet.  Totally unacceptable for an $18 carwash.  Also, the back window is always covered in soap.
