Can't believe I never discovered this place before since I've lived in the area over 30 years!!! This place is heaven! I had the hibachi chicken - I had it delivered. Allow at least an hour for delivery - but the wait is well worth it! The food is AMAZING!!

Been here twice. Sushi were prepared quickly and taste above average without fancy decoration. It is quite understandable since this restaurant is very much like an all you can eat type. But it does ruin your appetite by a little when they squeeze 6 nigiri into one small tiny plate. I would pay a visit next time.

The only reason the star is there is cuz i have to raete them. But the servaice was bad i couldnt not look at the menu without the lady being like what are you having. Everything was gross and looked old. Even they eggrolls were bad. We will never be back. Just not good sushi at all scarred me to eat it didnt look fresh for sure.

Nice place and had a great time on St Patrick's day but why are the tenders so oblivious to customer needs , like you are invisible or something.... been there before on a regular weekend and same thing... could sell a lot more alcohol ... others folks have had same issue

Bartender yelled homophobic slurs at me as he threw me out of the establishment. Not sure why but it was incredibly uncomfortable. 
Not sure what I did to be kicked out? All he did was yell at me and say awful things. I wouldn't feel comfortable coming back here. I am pretty sure he had been drinking and decided to pick a fight ‍

Do yourself a big favor and spend the extra money to stay in a REAL hotel. This is not a real hotel. Waited in line for 20 minutes and got put in the smelliest room ever. Tried to cancel reservation but they still charged us. But that was still better than sleeping in that room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: They have great staff very friendly and nice. Pretty nice spot typical little Mexican restaurant, but the food isn't all that great there customers are mostly white people. If your looking for some real Mexican great tasting food try somewhere else this won't cut it if you're Mexican lol.

I had a comfortable visit to this property. The staff was very friendly and accommodating. The property is very clean and updated. The room was spacious and comfortable. The location is in a nice location in Goleta which close proximity to UCSB and Santa Barbara within a ten minute drive. I would definitely recommend this location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I keep trying to give this Dunkin' the benefit and trying again. But every time I come the line takes forever with only a few cars and the order I am given is incorrect. I hope that they are able to figure something out soon to make it a better experience.

One of my favorite restaurants in Manayunk.  Service is always good and the sushi is fantastic.  Highly recommend the Seven Seas and Kimono rolls.  The spring rolls are also very tasty.  It is also BYOB which is a plus as there are not many on Main Street.

Slowest drive-thru ever. Takes an average of 20 minutes between ordering and getting food, no matter how many people are in line, even if you just order one or two items. And there are always people standing around outside near the window where you get your food. Not very fast, food.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Wow. Such a horrible experience here. Due to an overbooked flight, I took a different flight the following morning and was given a voucher here for the night.  I have never been treated by such a mean, rude, and disrespectful front desk agent than the woman who checked me in.  I would never choose to stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The patio is nice. Haven't tried anything from the bar. My husband works near here so eats here occasionally. Says he's only gotten 2 sandwiches and that Jimmy Johns is better. We tried a pizza today. About a notch above cafeteria food. I don't see anything special about the food, but it seems like a cool place to chill.

Meh. Beautiful lobby and good service, good size fitness center with a pool. But overpriced for the quality of the actual room - the room was a bit old, with a motel-style A/C unit against the wall and no mini-fridge. Cheap and creaky mattress and we didn't sleep great. Probably wouldn't stay there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Guacamole and fish tacos were good...and that was about it.  The cornbread was terrible, undercooked and salty, the lamb and beef were tasteless and the lamb had a quarter size piece of cartilage in it.  The el jefe margarita wasn't anything to write home about either

Staff is friendly, cookies await you in the evening at the front desk, clean spacious rooms, and conveniently located next to a chili's in case you get hungry for something either than room service. Pool is clean, well maintained, and very nice place to stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I don't recommend this Starbucks unless it's your only option. They frequently mess up my order even tho I don't get anything complicated. This time I was tired of it so I just took it and threw it out when I left. It doesn't help that the parking is really small.

It felt like I was in an out and really appreciated the guy at the front desk taking his time to explain everything to me. 
For the 1st I got in my car after having it serviced and neither my AC or radio had been messed with.
I am definitely going to continue going to Goodyear as long as everything stays
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Friendly staff, decent beer selection, varied food menu with low prices, super casual atmosphere clearly liked by locals. Great outdoor open setting, one with the neighborhood, plenty of TVs to catch the game, background music does not blare in your ears, so can carry on a conversation without issue. Give it a try, cheers!

Went there for lunch with three compadres. Had a salad with some chicken thrown in. Not your everyday salad and not your ordinary chicken. One friend had a panini and the other some pasta with chicken. Both commented the best they have had. This place would have stayed in business in NYC. Enjoy.

Bottom line awesome service with a smile and employees are always looking for the best deal for you every time. Been there about 3 times in the last month and will be going back in the next 2 weeks because of the service. Hope this helps you decide on renting a car.

The eel sauce is watered down.  I ordered the Sumo roll with cucumber in place of creamed cheese.  Got crab spread instead of crab stick inside, and salmon spread instead of salmon on top.  So, watered-down elements.  Monday-Tuesday "special" - saki for $3 instead of $5.  (Normally $3.50 at other restaurants) not a big deal.

Went to the restaurant with a few girlfriends in the afternoon. Restaurant was not overly busy at all. We were given our sushi which was very good, but then were given the bill very quickly. Mind you, we did not motion or mention needing it . Would have been nice to order dessert, but felt embarrassingly rushed by our waitress.

Horrible service. Waited in line while I heard them screaming in Hindi because the microphone was on and the line was a mile long. I told the person at the drive through that he mic was on the whole time and the line was a mile long and she said thank you. Of course after I get to the window, they get my order wrong.

Update to my review (thought I had updated this before!). The valet service refused to pay anything for the windshield broken while in their care. They kept saying our insurance would pay for it. Uh, not here in Texas! We were out over $225!  We will NOT be returning to this hotel!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Pros: Ordered takeout, the pizza was cheesy, just enough sauce, which had a nice flavor and it looked great. Customer service, excellent. Con: The only thing I'd say is I'd rather eat in the restaurant because after a very short ride home, it was cold. Of course, I ate it anyway. :)

My barber recently changed to this facility to where I can set up appointments which makes thinks a lot easier for my schedule. Ask for Marcus if you ever stop, he does a great job and you'll definitely come back after he cuts your hair especially cuz he'll actually take the time to make sure it's a good job!

I don't live especially close to this establishment so it would be very unlikely I would bring takeout home from here, but I stopped and grabbed a few pizza's.  Turns out the pizza was better than any in my area and travelled exceptionally well.  We will be back to try some dinners soon after reading reviews.

The food gods were with us last night.   Had plans to have dinner at Audrey Claire but wait was hours.  Walked to a few others spots...all the same.  Took a. Nance and called pumpkin..and we got in.   Amazing experience.  First time there.   Really small and well done space.   Service and food were amazing.  Highly recommend it!

This place sucks... has potential though.  Maybe hire someone who doesn't spend more time popping his collar and looking like some douchebag from 'The Jersey Shore' rather making good pizza.   Just a bit of advice... pizzas should not have to be crammed and destroyed to fit in a pizza box.

The entry shows what I wish the rest of the hotel was, grand and appeared recently remodeled. However, the room on 24 was not impressive, the bathroom had only been lightly cleaned before I arrived, and there was not a refrigerator in the room as you would find in a normal Sheraton, Marriott, or other mid range hotel room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Probably the best location among the city to stay. Staff was amazing, room was awesome, and the free beer before the game was ice cold. I was very overwhelmed by how great this hotel was. I will definitely be back this fall to catch a Colts game. Indy you rock!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I previously rated this restaurant a 2 star because of the service.    The owner and management team reached out to me to discuss the issues.   They showed a lot of integrity in making the situation right, they went above and beyond.    The service now matches the quality of their food.....5 Star

I won't even give this place one star! However I had to select one. My 17 year old daughter went into this "envy nails" salon tonight 01/02/2017 for an $18.00 FILL and got butchered and nails full of unfiled glue then charged $30.00! Don't spend your money here. Wish I could post the pictures I took. No happy ending here!

I have been to the restaurant a few times. I had the Branzino and the paella and both were excellent. They tend to get busy due to takeout orders at dinner time but once we were seated, service was fast. Here is a picture of the delicious paella with saffron rice. Recommend both dishes !

My family attempted to have lunch here. It was packed, but luckily there were 2 free tables. One wasn't bussed yet, the other had only two chairs. We waited patiently on someone to help us get seated for 20 minutes, but all available employees seemed to be ignoring us. We eventually left without being waited on.

Great place! Our last stop for the night. If you're looking for a variety of beers, this is where you want to be. 
From the large tv's to the appetizers, not to mention the amazing beers! Did I say beers?? I'll cheers to that! Go and enjoy yourself, you won't regret it. Even our bartender was sweet.

This place is great! I went here for hibachi and it was terrific. It was a Monday evening so the place was kind of empty. The service was great and made helpful recommendations. The food was delicious, perfectly cooked, and very fresh. They also gave us about a bottle of free sake, which is always a plus in my book.

Appreciations to yelp for recommending Spuntino Wood Fired Pizza. It's comfy, clean and attractive. The menu is really wonderful, a lot of fantastic choices, I had to go with Caponata, and it was excellent. And also, the service was terrific and the staff was super friendly. I can not wait to return to Spuntino Wood Fired Pizza.

The pizza was good and the medium Italian was delicious! We were happy to have stopped by here! It looks old and run down but definitely worth a stop! The employees/management were extremely friendly and nice! Definitely will stop by again if I'm in the area!!

If you don't like STL style pizza, go elsewhere (but you're missing out!). Great place to order delivery. Hot food, friendly employees, quick service. Pizza is delicious, sandwiches, apps and salads as well. Pastas are mediocre. My #1 go to for delivery in St. Charles.

Fish tacos were awesome! But he didn't follow through on my request for corn tacos instead of flour. Menu was big and not super easy to go through. Also once we didn't order alcohol our server wasn't super attentive. Good flavors though and we would definitely go back.

This place has good food.  Only reason for no 5th star is that the place is super loud and we could barely hear the waitress 

Don't expect tex mex style Mexican cuisine.  This is more like Indian food meets good Mexican food.  Guac was great, tacos good.  We tried the tamale and it was exceptional!

I've been to this place multiple times in the past. Service has always been great. Each and every time the food as been absolutely amazing! The menu is seasonal but they do have some items on the menu that are there year round. Due to the pandemic I haven't had the chance to go back but I hope to come back soon!

Excellent service and flexible. Had to change pick up times because meetings were changed and they worked with me no problem. Russel was the guy who helped us with car and made it as painless as possible. Friendly and helpful give him a raise! Also, This location is helpful if you're stuck at the Best western down the street.

My colleagues and I dined here for lunch....once.  Each item that we ordered was adequate, at best.  The jerk seasoning on the chicken tasted musty.  The soba noodles were not cooked properly.  The only enjoyable experience was the outdoor dining on a beautiful day.  I can't say that we return again.

Be aware of the elevators and how they work. You have to type your number in before getting inside.  You can also take the trolley outside the hotel for $2 and it takes you down to the bars and fun area.  Also the fridge isn't really a fridge. I put all my food inside and woke up to it being chilled and it ruined all my food.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Good, strong margaritas. Not great. Waitress brought the wrong one. I ordered a mango. She brought lime. Didn't matter. Couldn't taste mango at all. Taco Tuesday and happy hour. Ordered queso and chips. Queso was thin and flavorless. You have to pay for chips and salsa? Tacos were good. Not great. Overall disappointed

Amazing! The AYCE is spendy but worth it! Maybe I've been sheltered from good sushi, but this was the BEST sushi I have ever had! every roll we got (and as a group of 4, we got a lot) were so good! None were bad though some were particularly great! I can't stress enough how delicious everything was!

We have rented from the Largo office quite a bit lately and we could not be happier with the service we receive at this location. They are always upbeat and on the mark to assure our satisfaction. I will continue to rent from the Largo office. I also tell all of friends and clients

Went in thinking it was only gonna be $28 like advertised for a full acrylic set but the lady did them And failed to mention before hand that it was going to be 35 because the shape and size ups the price. Never heard of a nail salon doing such a thing before, never going back.

Wonderful salon! The staff and my stylist Marie are professional and take great pride and care in keeping their clients' hair healthy and beautiful. This is the best salon I've visited in Missouri and the 3 other states I've l lived in. You should definitely try it out.

Terrible Experience. I was on a business trip and used our company portal to find this hotel. I've since petitioned to get it pulled from our list. The hotel itself is shabby. Rooms are old. WiFi doesn't reach all of their rooms. And worst of all I found not one, but two cockroaches in my room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: So over priced in here, I could get way more bang for my buck if I went and got Frys sushi! The staff was ok, but when the sushi was brought out it was room temperature! I don't know about you guys but it's usually served cold for what I eat... hope I don't get food poisoning.

Ordered a chili relleno and got a canned watered down one. It wasn't a whole roasted one with lots of cheese. In fact there was no cheese inside. I thought they were enchiladas. Very disappointed and I won't be back. The location in Nampa Idaho was the real deal, best Chili Relleno! This place not even close.

The pizza was...ok-ish. Fine, it was bad. The crust had zero flavor. Nothing special about the toppings either. The salad was topped with what looked like sandwich meat that was cut up and not that well cut up either. The drinks were good though, the huckleberry vodka was tasty. I'd go again to drink but skip the food.

Love this small family operated place for take out and we've eaten here for over 10 years. You have to know what to order. We get the szechwan chicken with fresh veggies cooked just right with no chemicals such as msg. For less than $20 my wife and i have get more than enough food.I don't recommend the deep fried dishes.

A friend recommended we try Mizu over some other local more popular spots for my birthday dinner. We were beyond impressed and had an amazing meal! Sushi was very fresh and well prepared. The hibachi was so good and something I can't wait to get when we are back! Highly recommend

This hotel was absolutely the best place to get a great nights sleep and wake up to fabulous grounds with the best customer service! There is a boutique hotel in Carmel that should sent its staff to this Marriott to shadow the employees to mirror the Marriott staff! Bravo Marriott!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Owner screamed in my face because I noticed they had broken the buttons on my coat. He became violently aggressive. Terrifying place, waste of money, and now I have to repair my coat after I only needed it to be cleaned. Stains remain all over it and it's in worse shape than before.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I've always gone there for the location relative to my job. I will no longer support their franchise. They charge .38 cents for one butter, I asked the owner if this was a corporate thing and he said no,I do it to make money. Sorry you just lost a loyal customer .

It's a bar first and foremost. Food is definitely not their forte. Great beer selection...that's really about it. I had a chicken sandwich which was dry and overcooked. My wife's soup tasted a few days old and the fish tacos were fishy. First and last time, but good for drinks and live music.

I should of read the reviews before agreeing. But please don't let yourself get lied too. Don't do the fuel option unless you understand that they are charging you for full tank no matter what. My cars were at half and the first counter lady said I get charged for fuel difference.

Twenty minutes to get a burger.  They are Sold out of everything. They also don't sell mozzarella sticks anymore, but it's on the menu. The Burger King down the road sells mozzarella sticks. This place needs some new management and pay people more if they can't get anybody to come in.

This hotel is absolutely disgusting, the room smelt like urine, toilet doesn't flush, the furniture is gross along with the beds. Absolutely not worth the price of over $200 a night. We felt so dirty inside. There was mold in shower, they charged you to eat breakfast for the price it was disgusting. I do not recommend
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This restaurant is amazing!! We moved here 3 years ago and I've been looking for a good Italian place and finally found it. The food was amazing, the service was excellent. Even my kids said it's the best they've ever had. Cannot wait to come back and try more stuff from their menu!!

I LOVE Guadalajara and all of its locations! The food is excellent, but the environment itself is very inviting! My husband and I love coming here for date nights and trying out new margaritas. I would recommend this restaurant along with all their locations to anyone visiting or even locals who are looking for a new place to try.

Sigh...it can't be that hard to make coffee right? Probably the worst Dunkin' Donuts I've been too. Coffee is always diluted, either too much sugar or not enough sugar, limited donut selections, and not so pleasant employees.  If this was a mom and pop donut shop it wouldn't survive.

This place has zero customer service. The employees are extremely rude and the owner allows them to continue their behavior. They talk back to the owner all while the employee at the register hands me the receipt and says "take this." Will definitely not return again.

Love this place, we traveled with a soccer team and they were able to accommodate our needs to large takeout orders of Spaghetti and marinara and chicken pesto sauce . The staff was friendly and had our order ready on time the three times we went there over 3 days!

As a heavy traveler, I've had all kinds of airport food. This place was surprisingly good. I got the Grizzled Salmon with onion rings and Caesar salad and was pleasantly surprised by all three. Definitely worth eating here if you have 30 minutes.
5 stars for airport food.

Online says it closes at 6, sign on door says it closes at 6. I get there at 530 and they have the door locked and the guy doesn't open the door but just motions that they are closed. Wasted my time driving here. 

I can understand if I try to roll in 10 min before they close but half an hour?

Worst place I have ever been for an eye exam. Rude and full of themselves staff. This place is extremely overpriced. The receptionist is an extremely rude lady. If you want to be humiliated and want to be abused go there. Otherwise avoid. Ain't coming back ever again.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Unfortunately this Starbucks gives Starbucks a very bad name. Super slow, mobile orders never ready, employees that don't seem to care about their jobs or the customer. Almost every time it's a frustrating experience. They need some training and new leadership

It is a sad when ordering a medium black coffee is bothersome. The young lady working the window seem bothered or having a bad day when she handle me a large black and I wanted a medium. Reason being, a DD member gets a med for a $1. She took the the large back dumped in a med cup and looked real happy .

Beef stomach...to die for.  And I mean that literally, because this place has some questionable looking folks hanging around it.

Best authentic tacos I've ever had. $1.50 apiece. But order 6 at a time because good food takes time, even at a charming dive like this.

Found this new little gem in Downtown Dunedin this afternoon! It's down near Strachan's on Main St! Amazing craft donuts! The donut artisans there know their stuff, too! Bacon on a donut!?! Get in my belly!!! They pair nicely with a stout or porter, too - just sayin.

Elevators on a convention weekend are a disaster. Trying to find the stairs.. At least conventioneers are comical and they brought a lovely quartet.       Worst bartender ever in lobby bar. He was rude and slow! Not even busy. I was a woman alone so maybe that was why.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Food was good but the service is ridiculous. They were nice but they wouldn't let us eat in peace. They literally took my moms plate out from under her while she was finishing up her sushi! They need to slow down and let people eat without making them swallow their food while!

I toured Camden a week ago and even though I did not pick this community. The community is very clean and quiet.  During my tour of the community my leasing consultant Alyssa Ford spearheaded my tour. Her professionalism and knowledge of the community were spot on. Ms. Ford thank you so much for sharing your community with me.

Had the bistro chicken and my wife had a salad with chicken. They brine their chicken and it is extremely salty and it has a processed chicken texture. Had the artichoke app and many of the leaves were burnt. The inside of the artichoke was  fine. The waitress was very nice. Food was very mediocre.

The hotel was nice, and the employees very helpful and friendly. The room was cozy, although a little creepy. The problem was that housekeeping was banging on my door before nine in the morning, waking us up! I couldn't fall back asleep, and most likely will not be returning.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We went to this place to try their famous 'Eviction Notice'. It didn't work but we did have a nice night. This place is probably the best Italian place I've tried in STL (including those places on The Hill). Authentic Italian. Good prices. I took one star off because the service was extremely slow.

Authentic "street style" Mexican tacos.  Several varieties. The carnitas are really good.  Chicken tacos can be dry.  They grill their onions so watch out if you like them raw. Nice helping of cilantro. Sauces are good as well.  Better for take-out as it has the taco shop feel to it.  I was pleased.

I just ordered two letter A burritos and didn't get what I ordered. 
It was a burrito with mostly egg, less than a third of beans and a pinch of cheese in one and the second has less beans and no cheese in it. 
Usually I have no issues here so I'm disappointed.

Yummy!! We ordered the chocolate one, Patience grasshopper, it was so cute and so tasty! I love the idea to put a serum shot on the side cause I personally do not like to finish all the shot at the top and nothing left at the bottom part!! This idea is perfect to even out the shot:) and plus it looks fantastic

Came to quick lane for an oil change. Matt took great care of me and my vehicle. They didn't have the preferred oil filter, and even tho the distributor took a while to deliver the part they were able to service my car quickly and efficiently. Will be back
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Love love love this tiny familly owned restaurant. It's the little place no one would think twice about when passing. Step behind the blacked out glass and give this place a try. It won't be the best sushi you have ever tasted but ya know what? It's pretty damn good! Especially for Nashville!

For a large chain this is an abomination.  Understaffed front desk. The staff that was there were very pleasant. Limited parking. Had to park at another location. No free internet for rewards members/business travelers?  Really. That's a joke in this day and age.  My business will be going elsewhere after this trip.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Typing this while I eat my room temp soup that I waited 2 hrs for. Normally happy with them but it took 6 calls to see where my food was and then driver lied saying he just picked up food...it is cold. Called in and told she would call driver..never heard back. $40 not well spent.

We tried to stay at this hotel but were told that pets are not allowed.  All of the other Best Western Hotels we've ever stayed at accept small dogs so we were surprised.  I believe that Best Westerns are individually franchised  - we were very disappointed we couldn't stay here, the location is very close to Santa Barbara.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We check in on Friday and hit the street of NOLA. So when we came back the room wasn't still cool. So  the nice people downstairs quickly found us another room and that room was much better.  This hotel is under renovation but is still very nice rooms and the staff is very awesome. I will stay again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Rooms get 4 stars. Beautiful renovated rooms, only issue was the room felt wet with the AC running. Very humid. Reason for 3 stars is customer service. While the person who check me in was very polite and helpful. The one who check me out and was there in the morning was very rude.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This business damaged the wires to my electronic system, cracked the dashboard with an improper re-installation, refused to fix the damage HE did; and then lied about it. This is the LAST place to bring your car if it need AC repair. Ben is incompetent and dishonest !

This is an amazing hotel for families!!! I mean a pool in the lobby, Multipurpose room with Volley Ball net (open all the time), an Arcade, and I'm not kidding when I say a TON more. It's great. Complaint: the only thing is it just looks low quality. But that's the thing, it LOOKS like it is, but it is far from it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I stayed here because I was flying out the next day. I was a little apprehensive of the restaurant because of the reviews on here but was pleasantly surprised. My Caesar salad was fantastic and the Tuscan Chicken Pasta was delicious!! I highly recommend eating at the Landing Restaurant while staying at the DoubleTree

With a big family and broken washer and busy schedule I brought these folks almost 50 lbs of laundry for wash and fold. Service was friendly and helpful; laundry was fresh and neatly folded; all done in about 4 hours for less than $2 a pound. Would recommend and visit again.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Was recommended to try this place by a friend and glad I did!!! Got one Chi Chicken bowl... fresh, yummy, gear ingredients and the sesame dressing was great! Also had miso and some rolls, crab Rangoon and Gyoza .... everything was awesome. Can't wait to go back.

Spruced up Diner Food!

Cold bread that the waiter toasted for me when I complained it was hard.  The salmon didn't taste fresh.  The chicken parm tasted like a frozen piece of breaded chicken.  Where's Chef Ramsey?

Advice - for the price, you can find better.

I went there a couple of days ago and the guy who cut my hair (not the more senior man who seemed to be the one who owns the place) managed to fail in a buzz cut. It literally took him less than 5 minutes to cut my hair, and he missed several places. I keep finding small patches of long hair sticking out...

This morning I got up and came here to get coffee and a bagel ..got to say they staff was very unprofessional very rude I guess bvb if your not a local they give 0 fucks about you. Rude as hell .I know its early but dam be more inviting but other than the rude service the bagel was good coffee sucks I should of went to Starbucks.

Olivia is great! She is so kind and thoughtful as she was cutting my hair. I was looking for a low key but comfortable place to go on a Friday night and it was perfect! Even after second guessing my decisions, Olivia was so reassuring and did should she could to make me feel beautiful. And with free parking, it's even better

Very good tortas so glad they open this 
Muy ricos tacos también
The other taqueria I used to go closed downtown 
Noblesville so I was very disappointed 
But I'm glad this place is here to stay 
I hope they put night lights out on their sign to get more 
Customers

Nice place, no introduction from server. Here's a Chalk board of "Specials"! Mix of business & professional clientele. Food was cooked as requested but no discernible taste difference from French Onion Soup/ Cheeseburger. Average Wine and experience at most. Not offered dessert . Seated next to crying baby ,not my preference...

I am extremely pleased with the care and service of Luckey Eyecare. Everyone in the office is very pleasant and knowledgeable, this was the most thorough eye exam I ever had. I would recommend going here even though they can be a bit costly even with insurance coverage.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Food was better than average. Pork stuffed purse in etoufee was very interesting and excellent. catfish was some of the best. presentations were nicely done. a bit noisy as its close to college campus so lots of groups celebrating events. will post photos later.

The employees are rude and don't care. The cashiers stand there and speak to their co-workers and act like it's a total imposition to do their jobs. They refuse to help with bagging. They would rather stand there looking at you like you're holding up the line than lift one finger to help with anything.

I had a five star experience at Firestone today! I came in for a tire pressure check, and I have to say Ms Jasmine is a gem! She was welcoming, helpful, and very informative. Her help gave me confidence in servicing my car at Firestone. Thank you Jasmine!!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The toppings for banana splits were disappointing. We ordered 3 banana splits and basically got 3 scoops of ice cream with a banana. The sauces and pecans were minimal, which was a huge shame at the almost $19 total. Hoping that it was just a bad experience and things are better if we try it again.

If you don't mind roaches in the bathroom, you might enjoy this rather dirty hotel.  Towels were paper thin.  I was comped a night because housekeeping was so bad.  They left the dead roaches in the bathtub and, the next day, they cleaned the bathtub after I complained but never made our beds.  I would never stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Amazing, fresh, authentic food with even better service. Our group got a burrito, adobo pork tacos, beef nachos, a fajita salad, and the mariachi plate and we were all very pleased with our choices!! We'd love to come back more often but sadly, we're only in the area for a few days.

Mica far exceeded our expectations. I suggest you allow the kitchen to guide your experience. They planned 5 thoughtful courses, and each was exceptional. Worth the trip, whether it's just up the avenue or out of town. 

Well done. We will be back within the month.

These guys are great! My family and I ordered about $200 in pizza, wings, and cheese bread and they were so fast! We had separate orders that one person called in and they had everthing set up perfect and had us in and out super fast. Plus everything was correct and delicious! We will be going back for sure!

The food is great, but the place needs a dusting. I pick up quite a bit of Door Dashes from here so I tend to look around and people watch while I wait. One thing I noticed is that the place needs a deep cleaning. There is lots of dust on the shelves in the front.

I was pretty disappointed in the quality of the sashimi here. The waitress did not even know the specials of the day which turned out horrible anyway. I would not recommend this place for someone looking for a fresh and authentic Japanese experience. I'll never be coming back. Worst birthday dinner.

This place is awesome!!! Fantastic place for the kids. Bring cash for the games. Pizza isn't so bad either. There is a merry go round, games, some arcade games. Lots of seating on one side and games on the other. Family fun for everyone! Can't wait to take my kids here again

This place is so hit or miss. Sometime the pizza is really good, but sometimes it's like cardboard. Sometimes they totally skimp on the cheese, and sometimes the sauce is super bitter and tart. We keep trying, and for the price, they need to start getting it right at least most of the time.

The music was on point but that's because my party paid for it!  The daiquiris were tasty and adequate.  Good atmosphere but a crabby bartender is why I'm not giving Fat Tuesday's four stars.  When you're serving pre-made frozen drinks, the struggle ain't real.

I LOVE how they make my hair look in one hour or less. My hair looks like it was permed or has a real good pressing, but its just a brush and hand held hairdryer. I really like the fact that they're not pricy I'd take my last 25 there Mon - Wed just to look like a million dollars any day.

ソノラ砂漠に カエル採りに行く為に泊まったホテルです。 リッツにしては 非常に低価格ですが、流石に良いサービスで 砂漠の乾燥の気候なので 各所にFreeのペットボトルが置いてあり。従業員も気配りしてくれる。レンジャーも常駐しており 野生の動物に対応。ワイルドアニマル ラピュタイルの観測部屋も有り、夜は 広大な庭で インディアンの歌声ショーだったりと プールに入りながら砂漠の真ん中で至福を感じれます！流石にプールの水は イマイチなのは 言うまでも無い（笑） 砂漠の真ん中ですからね。  また 行きたいホテルです。
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We have been going to Guadalajara for years .. we were so excited when they opened the one in the North side of town. But sorry to say that it falls short from the original one. The portions are not as big and light side of the alcohol in the Margaritas.... we will start making the drive back over the the other one!

I went to the optical on Saturday afternoon. Everything was so efficient, they have a great customer service and the dr. is very professional. I definitely recommend this place for your eye exam. The price was really good for me, they have a lot of options in there so you can make it with your budget.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Good experiences have much to do with good people. The people at Leo's have been warm, inviting, and extremely helpful. I would recommend Leo's Pet Care to anyone who has a beloved furry friend. Thank you Dr. Gilliam, for caring about our pet, being thorough in your assessments, and offering thoughtful solutions for his needs.

We got just your typical carne asada tacos so this food truck can prove itself. The tortillas were dry, the meat was even more dull than the tortilla and all the vegetables were pretty standard. Nothing stood out for us but their terrible price. We won't be coming here as well as recommend this to anyone.

The steady increase in cost is noticeable on how much you can get done with how many coins.  In addition now it takes forever to clear the soap line out to start rinsing and get rid of the suds.  All the while it is eating up more coins to get rinse water.
Going to try someplace else.

The best way to describe the food is boring. Is it bad? No, not really. Was I thinking "boy this chicken parm is great!" while I was thinking it? No. For the price, find somewhere else. There are lots of local Italian and pizza places with far better food. Unless you like food that is simply bland, don't waste your time.

Usually LOVE salads from here. Last week ordered baby spinach salad, delicious and all topping laid out in nice rows on top of the greens. This time, NO EGG and everything thrown in haphazardly into a huge mess. Disappointed in the extreme of quality from last time compared to this time. Employees should probably be evaluated.

Hotel is under renovations and loud. Had to move rooms. Beds are not comfortable and 4 of the 6 elevators went down and the staff response was "how do you think it effects us?"

Location is good, looks nice from the outside. It's ok on the inside but not worth the price.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Me and my fiance stayed here for one night. Such a great experience!  Clean room. Continental breakfast was delicious (its located in the tgifriday in the hotel). So it was not microwaved horrible food for once. But if ur in the area I definitely recommend this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place was fine for a two night stop over. The staff was super nice and accommodating! Plenty of towels, free coffee and water provided in room. The hotel itself is old and run down. The bathrooms are extremely small! It's in need of a huge makeover!! The beach is lovely. Also, the pool is ridiculously small!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place is great! They have just about every beer imaginable. The staff there can help select beer based on your preference. There is also a bar set up with 20 plus different drafts. Additionally, they usually have a brewery giving out free samples! You can't go wrong with this place!

This place is pretty bad. Had the duck rice and it came out like reheated old food.

We also ordered the small steamed buns, they seem to just be store bought ones - also did not have the appropriate vinegar dip. 

Probably better food from Panda Express....

Stayed for one night and would go back. The front desk was very helpful and courteous. The rooms are spacious and clean, and it was very quiet. 
I would recommend doing the valet it's convenient and actually cheaper than many of the self parking close by.
The free breakfast is not bad.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place was absolutely amazing. We had been up for over 24 hours traveling and they let us check in early. The beds were soft and amazing. The breakfast they offer is good with lots of choices. The customer service has been friendly and so helpful. I wish our entire trip was staying here!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Just here overnight for a professional meeting. The hotel is scrupulously clean, the food very good, and the service friendly and prompt. I was particularly surprised by how quiet the room was given the hotel's location adjacent to the airport - no plane noise at all. Perfect stay for the business traveler.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is our favorite Pizza Place in the area.  Taste of pizza, selections of beer and service are all top notch.  Atmosphere is also pure quality!!  Our server was the best ( shame on me for not remembering her name)  but will for sure get it the next time we go.

Called at 5:30, took them forever to answer the phone. Once I ordered, I went to pick up and waited nearly 20 mins for the order to come out. A kid answered the phone and replied multiple times with "yup" this will prob only be ordering here if I'm out of all choices

Yesterday I reached about the Courtyard in Lake Nina near Orlando. Doesn't carryover here. Tired hotel with not so clean rooms, noisy AC units and water that runs black when first turned on. Advertised airport shuttle not running at 6:30 pm. Just in general not up to the standards I expect.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The server Hiraldo was very friendly and attentive so it just to be clear I didn't have any service problems. The sushi really just wasn't that fresh, it reminded me of sushi I used to get back in TX from the grocery store. There are other places in town that do sushi much better

I dont work here.  It is a great place.  Very nice people. They care about their clients.  They want to please.  The food was excellent.  Freshest lettuce i have ever had anywhere-I had a sashimi type salad.  The salmon roe sushi was phenomenal. Fresh fresh fresh.  Can't wait until they have sea urchin.   This is a must try.

Went here on 2/18/15 at 8:45 pm. The doors were locked lights were on and a lady was sweeping the floor. I knocked she gave me a look and continued sweeping the floor... Nothing more frustrating than when a business closes 15 minutes before its suppose to. Should have done what i always do and ordered Jimmy John.

This is such a great place!  Wish I could get there more often, but when I do, I have to take home the Ginger Peach Mango Green Tea - OMG the fragrance. . . . and then the taste!!  It is good for iced tea as well as hot.  I buy refills for the tin container purchased last year and there is a discount!

I do enjoy stating at Hilton Garden Inns.  This one seemed a little older than most.  You could tell from paint job in the bathroom.  Front desk was friendly, maids that greeted me in the hall were all very friendly.  Our kids enjoyed the pool, I relaxed in the hot tub, and there was even an outdoor relaxing/tanning area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is my favorite Restaurant for Tacos Y Mas! If you haven't stopped by you're missing out! The staff is super friendly! I had an amazing experience here and I'll be back! Tacos are 6 for $10 you can't beat that in Santa Barbara! And Sunday's they have breakfast meals on the menu from Pancakes to Burritos!

Hit or miss here. Delicious salads each time.  Wine way overpriced for the selection offered. Staff friendly though fairly inattentive. Veal dishes are disasters. My husband has tried twice and vows never to return. My risotto was bland and apparently made of tainted food.  Was sick all night.  Not a good thing

Chalmette,  Louisiana post C-VIRUS. Great courteous young staff with plenty of energy and smiles, next time I roll through i will review their wings. As for the Philly berger, it was exactly that but with a small twist or additions and overall not too bad.  Tots were soft and cooked just right.

Extremely slow service. It took us more than an hour to get our food. And the server basically put zero effort into service possibly because he knew there was already 20% gratuity built in for a party of 5 or larger. Food was mediocre at best. I ordered fried chicken tacos and the chicken was extremely dry.

My friend and I came here for a simple chips and guacamole. When we got to the window we were told our order of JUST chips and guac was going to be $11. That's insane for that!! When we opened our order we found a bunch of chips with guac spread on top of them. Not what we wanted and wayyy too pricey. Will not be coming back.

I've stayed in different much less expensive hotel that includes much more... example parking is $30 here at the Westin but there's a lot across the street & closer to our room that is only $5. Breakfast and laundry aren't included however it's a "service" with fee
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This is such a great ice cream place!! My boyfriend and I go here every week since they have opened. He loves to play retro video games and I love ice-cream!, we couldn't have picked a better place to end all our weekly date nights.  We love the chocolate covered strawberry  and vanilla cherry flavors.

Took me three phone calls and an hour of waiting to get the airport shuttle to come. When he did come, he barely slowed down to give me a chance to hail him down.  Had to call back again. Tried to save a few dollars on the Marriott website - wasn't worth it. I won't be back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My first time travel in town! The server is so nice! We tried four samples. And finally got raspberry sorbet, black currant frozen yogurt  and sweet cream ice cream! I highly recommend the raspberry and black currant. The waffle cone tastes good also. And it is not crowded on Monday afternoon.

My man serving up the ready to make omelets this morning was a breath of fresh air!! He absolutely knew what he was doing and any fast order breakfast chef should envy/admire him! Yum yum yum!! Thanks man!! You are good at what you do!! We appreciate that!!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The server worked her behind off while the male server did barely anything. We had lots of people seated after us but received their food before us. It took an hour to bring us out lunch and we had a baby. The food was mediocre at best. I will never go back again. It's just been going down hill more and more.

So glad we discovered this place... shortly after we moved here, never been to another.
Clark is so fun to deal with & really knows what he's doing. He says "I love messy people", lol, cuz that's his bread & butter!
Clothes always look better after he's done, you can trust him, he really tries hard.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: they tell you, you can cancel at any time, but dint tell you there is a buy out fee. they up sell you to a higher plan. paid $24 monthly. to cancel cost another $58. BUT had i had the $10 monthly fee, there would be no cancelation fee. WTF! the more you pay the more you get screwed! so if you join, only pay the $10 price.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This is your average Dunkin' Donuts.  But they refuse to give me tap water every time I'm here. Even when I'm ordering coffee and food. I'll never understand places that refuse to give you the world's most abundant natural resource and instead force you to pay for bottled water.

If you want a straight shooting honest mechanic go to Reese's automotive.  My cars alternator failed and Chris was able to replace it immediately at a very very reasonable cost.  I showed up unannounced and he had it completed in 90 minutes.  Not bad for a Marine

Amazing ambiance with gReat service.  The beef skewers and orecchiette were my favorite by far, but the ceviche, lamb cruda, and sweet potato baba ghanoush were also very good. They have a pretty extensive drink menu with something for everyone. We will definitely be back!

If could give a zero I would .... menu says fast delivery... an hour and fifty minutes later I got a cold stomboli and an anti pasta with lettuce and a few pieces of cold cuts on it .... horrible..... just horrific... to boot the driver said they wouldn't order from them either.... go figure

They did an alright job but I don't know if it was because it was a hand wash or because they just missed a spot bit there were a few spots on my car that didn't get washed along with my sunroof. The mats were cleaned pretty good though even though I don't think it should have been an extra $16.

I would give Dr. Kathy a thousand stars if I could. She took great care of my dog in an emergency situation. Both she and her staff were caring and helpful! I will be coming to Dr. Kathy for all of my veterinary needs in the future. Thank you, thank you, thank you!

I moved to Langhorne 3 years ago from Philly and was always going to Pepsi's or Brothers's Pizza...NOT ANYMORE!  Not because they aren't really great pizza places but because a friend recommended I try Enzos...I'm hooked.  I pride myself on knowing how really, really excellent Pizza should taste and Enzos is beyond the best!

Service was quick and friendly.  Spaghetti was tasty. Salad was alright but the dressing made up for the iceberg lettuce.  I enjoyed the slightly spicy sausage and the beef meatball was amazing.  We got a ton of food in the family 4 pack,  enough for two meals. We'll definitely go back again sometime.

Pretty Expensive.. I got three tacos for $10. They  were good but nothing special. Also for a Friday night there were over seven people staffed but somehow it took awhile for us to be served at the bar. Maybe the place is new but the servers could learn to be more attentive.

I travel a lot and with the Snap that i have been going to in Tucson AZ, I have found that the gym is very clean. The gentlemen that work here are awesome.. Very nice and easy going. There is never a wait for machines. Over all the it is the best gyms i have gone to and will remain to continue.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Giving it a three stars because I really do love this place, but if you ever want something special ordered, example a noodle dish with no onion, you will ALWAYS GET ONION. I know it isnt a big deal, but If someone asks for none on it, you should listen, the person ordering could potentially have a food allergy to it.

Went for Sunday brunch and was really impressed! The coffee is really good and my omelet was perfect. The bacon looked stunning and tasted fantastic. I can't wait to go back. 

The server was really great as well, everyone working there seemed happy and friendly.

This one is okay. The washers and dryers are a liytle old school. The ac doesn't work that well, so on a hot day, its a little uncomfortable. They do have 4 big washers, which was nice, but no big dryers. It says they have staff on site, but I never once saw any staff.
