text: This is my rain, shine, super storm, blizzard best liquor retailer in the area. They seem to open the doors no matter the weather and I definitely appreciate that!! Great wine selection, even better prices! The staff is friendly and knowledgable. I'm so happy they are on the way home!

Such a wonderful and refreshing nights stay at this hotel! Wonderful staff and awesome strip of stores within walking distance. Pool was a little small and no complimentary breakfast but that's ok! The room itself makes up for those little things. I highly recommend this hotel and I will definitely be coming back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Actually the sushi was great and the shumai was excellent. The bathroom door is DIRTY. The staff was very friendly. Habachi better if you are at a habachi table. But expensive for what it was. I wouldn't go back unless they adjusted prices and did upgrades.

Hotel was very nice; staff polite, professional, and abundant; and the room comfortable, quiet, and clean. Continental breakfast was amazing-- omelettes cooked to order while you wait! We were very happy with everything here, and it was a good value to boot. Would stay again in a heartbeat.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Service was very unacceptable! 20 minutes of waiting and no water or orders taken. Where they do that at? To begin with the food is a C... but the service can possibly make up for that but in this case it made it worse. It's a Saturday night and you're busy, understandably but staff accordingly.

I attempted to go to this location on 7-20-16 for a full set at 6:30ish but had to make an appointment for today at 11 am.  They were prompt but that is where the satisfaction ends.  My nails are too thick, too long and the French manicure is uneven.  I will not be back.

Great experience with the exception that when I held my hand out it shook as I normally don't have my hands like that and my nail tech commented on it and that I was not asked if I want my nails cut down.......otherwise the salon was clean, I was seen quickly and the polish selection was nice.

Recently ordered 1 pizza for delivery at 8:30pm.  We were told 1/2hr delivery.  After calling twice, actually being treated rudely the first call, it arrived at 10pm.  They did not charge us but that was only after we told them the second call we were not paying for the it but would tip the driver.

Fast, fresh and easy. Really enjoyed the meatball while they had it over the summer. Now enjoying the Italian sausage pasta bowl. They always add extra toppings if you ask. The pepperoni breadstick is good and spicy. The food is always consistently good quality.

We came here during Covid for our anniversary and we're so glad we found this spot. It's amazing! My boyfriend said it's the best sushi he's ever had. Not to mention, the service was amazing! We will definitely be back! (I highly recommend the bulgogi tacos 10/10!)

Clean if old. Service was very good. It's a fair bit better than a "holiday inn" but hasn't been upgraded yet to the latest Renaissance standards.  It's close to the airport but kind of in the middle of nowhere and surrounded by water so you need to travel by shuttle or cab to do anything.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Yummm!!! As a dairy free person, it's so exciting to have multiple choices of housemade ice cream. I had a super delicious cold brew and coconut cream ice cream that really hit the spot. I really enjoyed sitting and chatting with my friend in the cute space as well.

My wife and I have been to Italian Touch four times in the last two months. It is a well kept secret. Mike and Sharon are the owners and take care of all your needs. Mike is the Chef and Sharon will take care of you like you were in her home. The food is excellent. Great place.

Toscana's decor and architecture is beautiful rustic Italian - but the food is on par with an Olive Garden type restaurant. However, they do have a quite impressive wine list.

The wait staff wasn't knowledgeable about their menu and our waitress was kind-of stand -offish.

We won't be returning to Toscana anytime soon.

Great food. Great service. The people are always nice and accommodating. The highlight is the fried rice. Instead of the typical carrots, peas and little pieces of pork, they use bean sprouts, eggs, and green onions(I think). I'm not a huge fan of carrots and peas so it's a nice change of pace.

I have nothing but good things to say about this Gym.
Clean,with plenty of classes to choose from,lots of new equipment and the staff is friendly and helpful and yes there were many delays with the opening day and yes we did had to wait, but in my opinion is was worth it.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This is one of my favorite Mexican Restaurants. I love the cozy feel and there is never a wait. The make amazing blended margaritas, you can even get a pitcher to share. We have never had a bad experience. They also have Horchata which I've learned not ever Mexican offers.

Giving it three stars because the Stromboli is the only thing good...the pizza used to be good but somehow it changed in the past few months...you have to rip the crust off now...the wings stay over cooked
..good blue cheese tho.....fries are too dry
...the cheese on the pizza is still good....Stromboli is the only thing good

I was on a business trip and mistakenly went this place thinking this is the Italian Village. We later found out this is Italian Market. This place is such a horrible place that should be shut down. It is so bad that I need to remind myself to yelp about it. I wish I could rate it NEGATIVE 10 stars.

I can't review the food since I never have even tried it.  I attempted to tonight.  Ordered food two and a half hours ago and it still isn't here.  I called a bunch of times over the past hour and a half to find out where the food was and no one is answering.  Pretty positive I will never try their food.

The old blonde women with the terrible make up is the absolute worst person ever. She criticized me when she gave me the wrong order although I repeated it twice when ordering. She has no respect for people and her attitude make me never want to come back to this place again.

The best barbershop in Carmel hands down.  Said has been at a few locations over the last 4 years.  His clients have followed him all over town.  Now has his own place.  Easy to book appointments.  The haircut speaks for itself...you won't be disappointed.

As far as cheap sushi goes this is not the place to go. The service is awful. Bus boys do nothing but joke and stand around, one waiter for the whole dining room. 6 sushi chefs in the back but still takes 45mins for my 4 rolls of sushi, c'mon. Go across the street to Kyoto for the same food with quick, efficient service.

Quite reasonable for shirts and slacks, they've gotten some coffee stains out of my shirts. I was in a pinch with a work trip surprise and they kindly took my order for same day service. I'm noticing a few bad reviews but I've got nothing but positive things to say.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: The room and motel was a lot better than we expected. EXCEPT maid service is HORRIBLE. We asked the maid to change our sheets bc we spilt something on it and when we got back to the room it looked like the room was cleaned however, the sheets were simply turned upside down to hide the stain. Yuck!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This location has terrible customer service. Apparently, you're not allowed to make more than one deposit at a time. When I tried to make a deposit earlier, I was told that I have to use the night deposit box...there was no one in line behind me, so I don't see what the big deal was. Maybe it's Chase policy?

If ehh was a flavor of pizza. It's okay nothing to crave over or go back to. I will say it was very greasy, I got the Meat Lovers Pizza which had less meat than anything. It wasn't even photo worthy. It just happened to be the only pizza place open late because of covid.

Large planet fitness with solid equipment. Seems to always be clean. With that said, the two main reasons i come to PF is because they are reasonably prices and are 24/7, or so i thought. This club is now 24/5 and closed after 7pm on Saturdays. I will be looking to switch to a different gym. Bye bye pf.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The place looks nice for nothing. Came in for a brow wax and pedicure. The girl dug at my toes the entire time. The quality of the nail polishes is awful. Brows weren't terrible but then again it was $7. As soon as I went to dry, everyone on the floor disappeared. Typical Asian salon experience

New hotel, the rooms are typical Aloft layout.
Comfortable& clean , close to the airport ( 7 min walk)
Bar with food in hotel ( limited) they also have a pantry with snacks. Plenty of restaurants on Uber Eats deliver  here. Front desk employees were pleasant and accommodating.. Rachael at the front desk has coffee in the morning
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE!! The absolute worst i understand that due to the weather my delivery could be delayed but they said they called my phone and they didn't. I've been waiting over two hours for my food and still haven't received it. Getting a refund and they will not receive my services again.

We had a pizza and zuchini at Bazils last night. It was just okay. I would say if it is convenient and no other pizza place is an option then it is fine. We tried it because we are new in town and prefer the local restaurant to the chain. However, we will not be going there again. It is not as good as we know it can be.

First time trying here heard some good things, food has limited flavor, tried the three combo all three items tasted the same.   A little sweet flavor, nothing significant.   We only saw our server three times to take our order deliver our food and bring our check
Probably will not be here again.

Asked for a table that would be the same size as the rest of them.  3 adults at a table that couldn't take all the plates.  We had a party of 11.  Our reservation was at 6:30.  I asked for a table matching and was told there was a larger party coming in at 8 and they couldn't take from that setting.

The only grocery store I could find in central Nashville that had more than just alcohol and chocolate. You could get most basic food items there but it's verrrrry overpriced. I bought like some pasta, sauce, one chicken breast and some cheese it came to $26. Next time I'll go to the Walmart

I have gotten the worst customer service from Hertz PHL twice already. The most recent is still pending, they are accusing me a misplacing the rental car key. They are attempting to charge me $250 and cleaning fee for a dirty car rental. Avoid Hertz car rental at the Philadelphia Airport.

Ok- here it is.

Shrimp w/lobster sauce and the smallest egg roll I have ever seen in my life- quite tasty.

Being that it was very good and at a decent price- the smaller portion size is quickly over looked. 

As I write this- I am full. Guess we will see in a couple hours-

I usually don't write reviews but the food is ridiculous. Chefs are definitely not Japanese.  Teriyaki chicken was horrible. The chicken is fried, not grilled and covered in soy sauce not Teriyaki sauce. The California roll is just a crab roll. Very disappointing

Employee was rude when attempting to order. Kept cutting me off to finish. Then at windows he didn't say one word to me.  Donuts were soft but almost like they missing sugar in the making.  Not up to the company standards. Poor experience won't be going back there.

We took a chance on Louie's last night. We were very pleased with the food and the service. The Italian sausage was as good as I've eaten anywhere, even in Italy. The wine list was limited, but we were able to pick a decent wine to compliment our dinner choices.

Katsu Don was good, quality and portions have improved from years past. My biggest gripe is I asked for a cup of water and they said NO FREE WATER you can buy our bottle water. A place that skimps on offering complimentary ice water to customers makes me question where else are they skimping.

My husband and I love the West Side one. We have tried the greenwood location twice since they opened. We have been disappointed both times. The quality of the fish they use is poor, the fried rolls it almost tasted as if the oil was stale. I rarely right reviews but felt obligated to write this.

This place use to be amazing when Selena was actually running it. Now it's way over priced, the staff is rude and unnecessarily rough. I'll never go back. Plus the man who did my nails completely trashed my cuticles. It was one of the worst experience I've ever encountered at a nail salon. Complete waste of money.

The delivery took way to long almost 2 hours till I got my food. My food wasn't even hot or my hot chocolate. If this the service Ima get from this place they don't got to worry bout me coming back. The crazy part is I don't live that far it's only a 7 minute ride.

I ordered a plain double cheeseburger along with nuggets and Honey mustard sauce and a sprite.  It was lunch time and I asked the friendly staff if I had a plain cheeseburger, cannot eat tomato products.  The Tangy BBQ was not edible.  So I had plain chicken nuggets and water.  Staff was very friendly but please check the orders.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place is an East Nashville gem, their brambleberry crisp and dark chocolate ice cream are truly outstanding. Add in a funky interior and knowledgable staff and you have a winner. My only downsides to this place is the lack of outside seating and a small parking lot.

Mid tier ice cream indistinguishable from Kilwins or mint and fox.  Didn't like loud music next door and sparse seating.  Kid friendly flavors such as unicorn, Cookie Monster and Superman were nice  although Kilwins has Superman too.  Mint and fox has cotton candy which is like unicorn.

Old school barber shop. Jay always does a great job with my hair, and although I'm not one that has any special needs it is clear that Jay is an experienced professional. I've recommended this place to a handful of friends over time and they're all current customers of Jay's.

I reckon this is the greatest restaurant on earth. Come here all the time and am never disappointed! Always a great meal, big portions, and the staff makes you feel like part of the family! And the live music is always a treat, and they're super nice guys.

It was my first time here with my family and I was pretty disappointed with the service to my super chewy steak. Our waiter or waitress (too many people "helping" us) kept forgetting about our biscuits. Overall save your money there's plenty of other nice restaurants to eat at in the area.

Went through drive through and the amount of cigarette smell was over whelming. Of course my window was down so now the smell is in my car. Also thought the price to dry clean my sun dress $12.50 was high. Dress looks good though. I really don't like having to pay to smell cigarette smoke.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Very disappointed. The service was god awful, took an hour to be seated and another hour to get our food. When it finally came, it was mediocre at best. The wait staff was incredibly rude and the whole place is disorganized. Do yourself a favor and avoid this place at all costs.

The lady who washed my hair was very rough with my scalp and did not give the massage that everyone mentioned. She was very brusque and kinda rushed through everything even tho there was no one else there. Overall the haircut was ok, but the friendliness of the staff was just not there.

First time there although the place is close to my house. The place has a nice ambiance inside and a courteous staff. The rolls were ok, nothing amazing. The miso soup tasted a bit like water with powder inside. Had much better. All in all an ok experience.

I love this place. Jared the bartender is awesome, oh - should have led with the fact that they have an "evening social" open bar... it is great!

I checked in with Zach past midnight and he was still cool! 

Room is great. I was traveling alone, and felt supper safe.

There's a restaurant, too. Burger was great.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This salon has been in the Keystone shopping center for years. Hung, Ken, Mi....... all do great work. I appreciate that they tolerate my sense of humor and joke back with me. There are also days when I am tired and don't want to talk. They respect that too.

This room was totally worth the money. It was quiet, everybody was very nice. The bed was comfortable. It's also really close to a couple of highways. There's no breakfast but there's coffee in the lobby. And, with the money you're saving you can go get breakfast.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Probably the worst caprese sandwich I've ever had. It was served on crunchy focaccia bread that tasted like cardboard. It was my own fault for ordering it. Starbucks caprese sandwich is actually better than this. Use ciabatta for this sandwich and it would be ok.

The worst!! I've been to the Gulf Blvd., St. Pete Beach location, maybe six times in two years that I have lived  here on the island and it's disgraceful!  Service is slow whether you go drive-thru or go inside!  
This time, 15 minutes in line and left with shit I didn't even order! 
Y'all suck! -1star
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Service was ok but the food wasn't. My husband ordered $14 tacos that had hardly any meat on them, my tacos came out wrong (they did fix it right away) and we ordered apple juice for our daughter and the cup came half filled. Not worth the cost that's for sure.

Unfortunately the hotel is under major renovation and I was informed I won't have any water tonight either. The check in process was not smooth and at 1am when your bag did not make it from LA and you just want to go to bed, a little more customer service would have been appreciated.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Love the place and staff.
It is a dog friendly bar which I love but beware people with viscous dogs are also welcome. 
One costumers dog went for me and the dog owner never apologized and the staff thought nothing of it.
If you plan on bringing young children beware.

Love this place! Sump is by far one of my favorite coffee shops in St. Louis. I like that they are open later than most, in case you need to study longer or get a coffee to go before a shift. Great selection of coffee, and the atmosphere is perfect for their business.

My goooodnesssssss this place is incredible. I drive an hour just to come to this place and have jenni's most unique ice cream. I would recommend this place to any ice cream fanatic like myself. You must try the " brown butter almond brittle". You will NOT regret a lick !!

Okay place for a nights stay before an early AM flight out of STL.  Check in process seamless and room sufficient to meet the needs.  Key system outdated and can be finicky to get in building and room.  Park and Fly options available, but didn't start early enough for us.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
We got a mondo size pepperoni and sausage pizza and a medium order of medium wings ordered from Postmates. It wasnt bad but it wasnt amazing either. It was just average. 
I'm not sure if anyone else has noticed this, but it literally tastes the EXACT same as pizza plus... even the ranch tastes the same.

Very good food. They may have one of the best pizzas ever... Their Philly steak pizza.  Service is bad, the waiters are slow and forget stuff and hostess doesn't seat you even though there's tables available and you have reservations. Keep the cook and the bartender and fire everybody else.

Visiting Philadelphia on a saturday, there weren't many restaurants to go to last-minute without a reservation. We were able to get one here. The positives: the waitstaff is really nice and service was great. Food was good but not great. Get the desserts for sure- cheesecake, tiramisu and chocolate cake were all very yummy.

Amazing!  I am not one to eat anything other than fried rice and lo mein so I can only comment on what I ordered. 

I had the pork fried rice and beef, chicken and shrimp lo mein. Both were very good. The lo mein sauce was excellent. 

The only thing that was missing in the fried rice was a little egg. Otherwise a solid 4.

Food was very flavorful.  My husband and I  had the sopes and tortas.  We ordered 3 each.  2 each would have been plenty.  Very excited to see flavorful Mexican in the burbs and not tamed down for the masses.  Definitely will become part of our rotation. 

Ambiance.....it's in a store strip, nothing spectacular at all.

1st thing they rented me a Ford Focus that had an expired inspection. I received 2 tickets in 1 day & had to bring them to Cherry Hill. They told me they would take care of it. I got a bill last week saying that they were going to charge me for the tickets. I have made numerous phone calls & it's still not resolved!

We stayed here one night, and we slept really well! From the outside it looks really bad, and we wondered what we had gotten ourselves into! However, rooms were clean and comfortable, wifi connection fantastic and the owner was really nice! Many parking spots, would stay again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Really, really good food. Really, really bad service. 

The back patio was lovely, but our server seemed to forget we were there. Ridiculously long wait for everything. Even had to go get the check. Maybe someone called in sick, but, luckily, the food didn't suffer.

I went to MPG on 22nd st for a oil change on my 2011 Silverado they took a guys truck in first that came after me said he called ahead well I called ahead as well then I get the bill it's 81.00 for a dexos oil change last time I had it done there it was 68.00 I was pissed I'll never go back there again!!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We've stopped by there twice in one week. Both times we had amazing service from two different servers. The food was also delicious. The homemade guacamole was seasoned well and so fresh. The steak in our entrees was also very flavorful. We definitely will be going back.

Will not be taking my vehicle here again. Purchased the $29.99 package. Witnessed employee drinking soda in another customers vehicle while vacuuming the mats. My car was left with water stains, my rims were not cleaned at all, and inside of windshield was not wiped down. Front of vehicle was not cleaned properly either.

No cashier behind register at this grill attached to Pima air museum.
Tram without air condition was late without announcement. It's a museum so there's no need to be on time.
Fountain soda $3.25 coffee $3/each almost as cheap as my Starbucks coffee at hotel.

Don't judge this place by its looks and short staffed dining. Who ever make it, the food is beyond great.  There are thousands of menus you can choose and the lady (i assume she owns this restaurant) gives people plenty of explanation on the menu and helpful recommendations.  I always bring my guests here when they visit us.

Best Pizza in Town hands down. Come once a week with my family. If it was me alone will be here 3 to 4 times a wk, however had triple bypass surgery in '12  and need to control my cravings. Love the entire staff, they go beyond their job description and responsabilities.

Fking ladies managers we order by mobile phone and when I pick up my order she said some one already pick up your order she didn't check order numbers and then said it is your fault, I have to make another one free order. So arrogant people.when I get my order is 20mins to wait.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Yo petes dirty A SSHIT  they failed their inspection because the workers had bed bugs on their clothes  mouse droppings on the damn slicer too  who's running this place? This deserves to be shut down. I ordered pizza there once and the pizza was the nastiest thing I've ever had.

The worst pizza I ever tried! After pizza was ready in the oven the dough sticked completely to the pan! We had to scoop pizza out from the pan. It was a big mess on our plates! So disappointing! Besides the taste of the dough was awful! Waaay too sour! Also it wasn't fresh made but already pre packed! Never again to this location!

We really enjoy the quality of this neighborhood gem. There's always something interesting and new to try and the vibe has always been fantastic. The drinks are strong and they definitely know their way to keep customers coming back. The staff has always been outstanding with a smile and attentive service. Check it out!

Been here almost 3yrs and have found it to be a pleasant experience. Jennifer, the manager of this property makes it a pleasant experience and always ready to assist in any way she can. Our family would recommend this place. Only drawback is lack of parking and a pool or I would've given it the 5th star.

Excellent food, and sevice! The salsa is to die for!! We are here visiting on a girls trip and have been here twice once for dinner and once for breakfast both times were wonderful! Happy hour 5$ margaritas were amazing as well. We will make this place a frequent stop every time we visit!!

I received a wrong order last week and called and spoke to the manager who was so apologetic and promised to make it right next time. Well  he sure did and he went above and beyond!! Wish I had caught his name as he was so kind and nice and deserves a shout out. Thank you thank you!! Will continue to go back!

If I could give a zero I would. We just bought a bacon egg and cheese bagel. It was so disgusting my son spit it out because he said it tasted bad. It looked like it was thrown together with no care in the world. Cheese tasted like it was rotten we had to throw it out. I will never be visiting this McDonalds again.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: worst restaurant ever! They will kick you out if you spent a little more time after eating, with extremly rude language and behavior, i have never see such service in my life! this is definitely the worst restaurant i have ever been. DONT GO THERE OR YOU WILL GET ABUSED LIKE ME!I GOT KICK OUT OF THE RESTAURANT!

My Fiance and i are totally DONE with this place. The Staff are all amazing. We can no longer accept how the Owner treats the customers and MOSTLY how he treats his staff. We found another Spa not far away which makes you feel welcomed and honestly does a,much better job about the same price.

All you can eat is the way to go. 
Nigiri samples were pretty good and unlimited -- can't beat that! 
Inception roll was my favorite. 
Anger management was also pretty good. 
If you are looking for a good sushi place for a good this is the place to go. But I'm pretty sure, there are better sushi elsewhere!

Well first they don't have any ranch for their salads and then when we were going to get some crab Rangoon they were out of that and they don't even do substitutions for you to get double rice and no veggies. Our waitress also has very broken English and can hardly understand what we're asking for.

I never had a good experience with the employees in this DD branch. They don't even pay attention to what you are saying and don't bother to ask when you stand there when something gone wrong with your order. Horrible customer service. Never again to this DD

I actually enjoy the sushi from here. I only order two, sexiest man roll and Jamaican roll. The Jamaican toll is seared salmon with fish eggs and some cilantro with a tart sauce. Sexiest man roll is salmon and sweet eel. I'm pretty happy with the place from those two rolls alone.

While it's fresh in my mind, let me note that the food I received tonight was cold and had to be sent back.  The creme brule' was runny cream which the waiter dismissed with "sorry".  The wait was excessive and any comparison to a good restaurant anywhere else is ludicrous.  Sorry St. Pete.....you need to up your game.

This is my second visit to koizi. The first time I went for dinner and it was fantastic. This time I went for lunch and it was even better. I tried the crab sticks they were like candy so good then I hat the shrimp Yocasopi it was heavenly. I Can't wait to go back.

This spot was very refreshing to come across when walking through the hot streets of St. Pete. The rolled icecream was cool to watch come together. I ordered the strawberry cheesecake one with banana toppings and it was amazing. Pretty cute for pictures too!

Terrible Chinese delivery takeout restaurant. Only ordered food from here because our regular Chinese takeout restaurant was closed. The person who took our order got everything wrong. What was delivered, was not what we ordered! Will never order food from this establishment ever again. China King is much more superb!

After moving to St. Pete I was on the hunt for a new salon and I am so grateful I found Balayage Blonde. Excellent service, extremely knowledgeable stylists that not only listen to what you are looking for but are also willing to invest in the health and quality of your hair! I would recommend BB to anyone looking for a salon home.

I am so so so happy this place opened up! Not only is it a blessing to burlington (that lacks a quality restaurant scene) but the sushi here is absolutely phenomenal. The restaurant is beautiful on the inside and my order is always ready when i come to pick it up!

Siara at the office is rude. There are roaches and bugs everywhere, people smoke weed even at the office center.  This place is a real mess. On top, they talk bad about tenants, or you hear them talking bad about tenants infront of other tenants. Very filthy and unprofessional environment.

Spoke on the phone with a gentleman to get a weekly rate. Horrible customer service. Spoke quickly and wouldn't listen to my needs and cut me off multiple times. I stopped him and stated that it is my first time renting a car. Unprofessional. Unhelpful. Went to different location.

RUN AWAY!!!!!!!!! We got a room that smelled like dog pee!! We asked to switch and got something just as horrible and horrifying!!!! We're so sick walking out! I wish Yelp allowed videos so we could show live footage of how awful this place is. I still have the scent of dirt, dog and smoke in my throat!!! RUN AWAY!!!!!!!!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Losing a star because they decided they don't deliver to my house anymore..after getting delivery many times. Went to pick it up at the time suggested and had to wait ten minutes even though there were only two people in the restaurant. Frustrated because I really like their food but their service is lacking.

So we walked in at exactly 9:30 pm and was greeted with "Hi, the kitchen closes in 30 mins so, order fast!" Don't know who trained these greeters but they failed. I gave two stars because at the very least she said it with a smile and not an attitude. Anyway, go to the one on Prince Rd. Service is far superior.

Great people, great food, and always leaving happy. Austin, their sushi chef, is extremely personable and goes out of his way to make sure everything is correct with your order. And their lunch buffet is the best!

Need a place to try, go for a business lunch or dinner, I highly suggest Tenno.

A hidden gem. Obviously since the last chain grocery store left this are the plaza has struggled. It may look to be the same for sushi house from the outside. But that is simply not true. The great service, wonderful staff, and amazing sushi keeps the locals coming in. I eat here often and so do most people I know in the area.

I thought the sashimi and roll I had were bomb.com. Excellent food. I would've liked to not have to ask for eating instruments, but that's an easy thing to overlook. I didn't get any pictures, but I'll be going back! I did think some of their rolls were overpriced, but there was enough to choose from that was reasonably priced.

Idk why this location is so unprofessional. The restaurant itself is absolutely filthy.... trash cans over flowing. Drink station is disgusting. And people are waiting HOURS for there food.... staff is literally just standing around laughing at people getting upset.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Came here for a group dinner with my partner and 6 new pals. I thoroughly enjoyed our meal and the restaurant. Would definitely return.  

Pros:
- BYOB
- Speedy, pleasant and attentive service
- Pappardelle dish was quite yummy 
- Cozy and compact environment

This is s great choice for cardboard pizza that took 2 hours to deliver and was ice cold. When I called to complain, I was told NO REFUNDS. I asked if it's policy to deliver cold pizza and take 2 hours. I don't recommend the place for anyone that is hungry.

No Wi Fi at this location.  They say they don't know the code to it.  It is probably fine if you don't need Wi Fi, I was there to try and eat and get work done.

I suggest they post that they don't do Wi Fi at this location, as this is expected at a place like this.

Bought extreme package and headlights cleaned was told 45min to an hour. Did not meet time as promised cause we had another appointment right after. Was given voucher for same services though still inconvenienced since we had to come back. Staff was friendly and indoor/outdoor waiting areas were clean.

Dr Veronica was rude and unprofessional. Seems to me she doesn't care for her job. Very unprofessional. I will never return and I will advice everyone to find another vet. Dr Mayo came highly recommended. Unfortunately we did not come in contact with her. Do yourself a favor and find another vet.

Not the best gym I've been to but it gets the job done.. The staff do not welcome you upon checking in. Equipment is outdated. It's super small so they have all the equipment  so close you can barely maneuver around. Better than most fitness facilities in the area though
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: There is an extremely rude older man who works there. He gets irritated easily especially with my young children. I've dealt with him twice. First time, I brushed it off and figured that he was just having a bad day. However the second time, he snapped at us, I left and will never be back.

My Husband and I were staying at the Kimpton Hotel Monaco near by and they had no decaf available so I set out to find a coffee shop and stumbled into this place. It's a great place. The staff was very friendly and brewed me fresh decaf and it was terrific. They offer some breakfast items too. What a great find..!

Paris is the most amazing front desk agent.  I was stranded in New Orleans to see Beyonce and Paris went way beyond customer service to make sure I was taken care of.  Although I could not stay at the Hyatt, I will only stay there in the future because of her attention to details and care.  Great job!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Don't believe everything you read on here about bad food. I've eaten here over 10x's and this place is legit! The food is excellent and the service has always been good. The best chori pollo I've had! I have no idea what some of the others on here are talking about. Take a chance because it's worth it!

Absolutely the best Chinese food in Spring Hill. I've tried almost every Chinese restaurant on the west sode, and the have all fell short to China 1. It's an oxymoron to say New York style Chinese food, but that's the only other place that has consistent Chinese Take Out.   China 1 is the closest it gets for me.

The guy is really sweet and accommodating. I wanted to get my undercut shaved on my lunch break and he fit me in. The atmosphere is really relaxing and he did an awesome job. I never once felt odd being a chick in a barbershop which I can't say for a lot of places.

This was the worst Chinese food I  have ever had. The hot and sour  soup was not edible and had to throw most of the pepper beef away cause it left a nasty taste in my mouth. The WORST PLACE EVER. Would not recommend it at all so I  basically threw $11.00 in the trash.

The best cold brew I've had, and service is always super friendly! My only wish is that the hours were more likened to those of a coffee shop. I know it being housed in a retail store probably dictates the hours, but I'd love to be able to pop in on my way to work.

We just moved here from Portland.  Needed a new set and loved this place. People were helpful kind and fun to talk with. Had pedi's, my daughter had a wonderful mani and go exactly what I wanted. Will post a picture of the eork. Henry did my nails with using files not all done by machines he used his hands. Great job.

Great service, almond with excellent recommendations.   I love the friendly and knowledgeable staff.  Selection is fantastic for both wine and liquor.  Nice to be able to find some high end options without having to drive to Nashville.  We appreciate you, Cheers!

Is there any negative star???? We've waited for almost 2 hrs....Worst service!!!! waited for almost 2 hrs for just 2 items, fried rice and beef with brocolli. No apologies. One server, one guy  making the sushi, i guess 1 or 2 cook. Won't be coming back anymore.

Have to give credit where credit is due. Been to this McDonalds twice this week and both times I got through the drive through in under 8 min. Still not the friendliest service (which is why I am only giving 4 stars) but at least it actually qualifies as fast food now.

text:
My sushi was served hot...I think that's enough said.

I ordered the dynamite roll and it just wasn't good. I understand this is americanized sushi but the scallops were overcooked and it was covered in a heavy layer of spicy mayo. For $15, it's really not worth it. Spend your money elsewhere.

Absolutely ridiculous. No available bathroom.  You're too lazy to clean it. I even had my own wipe to clean things. As a medical professional going to help people In their homes- I need a bathroom. text: I came based on yelp ratings. They actually do serve alcohol and have video poker machines. They also have two tv's, video games for kids, plenty of seating and enough folding tables so long as it isn't packed. Best part is dryers will start working with just one quarter.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Reasonably priced for 12 machines out of order. This place is old and dingy. Floors needs swept up and mopped. TV works good. Dryers are quarter by quarter no minimum to start which is a plus. Make sure attendant is present before you put money in machines and you should be fine. 
1.50 front loaders 
1.75 top loaders
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Wine list is ok and the starters were great. The penne and sausage was a bit bland as well as the polenta. The crab stuffed chicken was spot on, we could taste the crab as well as the chicken. Service was excellent and our server was very knowledgeable about the menu. Might try to add a Carmenere to the wine list.

The sushi is very fresh and well made.  The waitress that waited on us was very friendly and kind.  The decor is also very nicely done. My only complaint would be for lunch the roll selection is limited. This is not uncommon, but is not stated anywhere that I saw online. We will be back to try the special rolls for dinner.

If you ever need to rent a vehicle,  Enterprise is the way to go!   I worked with Lauren and Paul at the Tarpon Springs location and they are truly outstanding individuals.  I feel they went above and beyond the normal customer service one receives.  I highly recommend Enterprise and the Tarpon location.

Typical Starbucks. 
This one seem to be having trouble processing orders. I had to wait almost 10 minutes for my drink and several other people had ordered after me had received theirs. I think they were training people, so I will give them a pass on this delay.

The atmosphere is great. We were celebrating a birthday- they do offer a free dessert which was nice. The Torta Goat cheese appetizer was the highlight of the meal, so delicious. I got fettuccini alfredo with chicken, unimpressed, the sauce was weak and not very flavorful. The spinach ravioli was excellent.

This is a must everytime we visit Carpinteria. The staff is authentic not only in the amazing, creative menu but the staff feels like family. They have season foods and crestive dishes.  Just like going to Nonna's house for Sunday dinner. I highly recommend!

Good Sonoran dogs. Was a bit pricey (for hot dogs, Sonoran or not); however, (and unfortunately) now you're paying for the brand rather than the product. If you're a tourist, then it's well worth the money and time. As one might say, 'they're a Tucson institution.'

this is my all time favorite sushi place. The prices are reasonable and I love the special rolls so much. The all you can eat is a great deal. It's a beautiful place as well, the atmosphere is cozy and welcoming and the staff is very friendly and attentive. I don't get sushi anywhere else.

-yummy chips and sauces as a complimentary starter (we get refried beans also to mix in)
-food was tasty 
-It wasn't very crowded but it took a very long time for our tacos to come out but for the inconvenience we got a free order of tacos to go!      
-Will definitely go back

Genuinely the worst service I've ever experienced. Took 90 minutes to bring out our starters, 20 more minutes to bring out our entrees. Food is really good, I can't lie. But the waiters were horrendous & they did not seem to care at all about their customers.

I was very unhappy with the cut I recently got at Treo.
I had a picture of the style I wanted,what I left with was 
No where near what I had asked for.I ended up going to great clips after crying for an hour,got exactly what I wanted for fifteen dollars. Just goes to show you don't always get what you pay for!

The customer service was horrid! I was asked to come back in two hours and still had to wait.  It was myself and three children. They took walk ins at the same time, and we had to sit with our feet in barely any water and wait. The woman in charge was extremely rude. Will not return, and DO NOT recommend.

My wife scheduled an appointment to patch a slow leak. When she arrived, she was told it would take one hour. One hour later, nothing had been done. She told the advisor she couldn't wait any longer, and he simply said "okay" and handed her the keys. Stay away if you are a fan of good customer service...
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Go here now. Seriously, see if they are open and go now. Don't bother going to any other place in MJ and no need to drive into town any more.This place is that good! Miso,yummy. White tuna, delicious!The salmon,perfect- order with ponzu. Save room for mochi! Why are you still reading? Go now!!!

$55 for dinner with unlimited wine is AMAZING! the service was very attentive & they had the table ready for our reservation.
we were a bit disappointed in ordering the meat & seafood samplers-I think we would have been better off ordering one of the more specialized entrees. but, yum, yum all around!

Finally a pizza place I can enjoy! I was starting to wonder if New Jersey had any good pizza and here was one in my new backyard!
I definitely would be ordering again to see what else they can do. Thanks for making this Cali girl believe Jersey can do pizza!!

this place was absolutely TERRIBLE. called just to confirm my order went through to them through Eat24 and they told me they WOULD NOT deliver my order to me. Proceed to tell them I already paid and ordered through Eat24 and they told me I had to order again, pay again, and it would take an hour to get here.

Only get delivery if you enjoy waiting two hours for food, and enjoy cold fries/sandwiches and melted shakes. i've never had a worst experience with delivery in my life and this place is only 1.8 miles away from my house. theres no reason why my food was cold.

i'd give zero stars if I could.

Very disappointed with udon. I saw nabeyaki udon on menu and ordered cause I love fish cake. Yet all I got was chewy chicken and burnt egg on noodles. Hopefully sushi is better than soup. I couldn't even eat half of it. Very untraditional. I've had better at mall food court for half the price

Your average Chinese food, we've been there 2x this past month while vacationing and ok for late night only option. Not horrible but not anything to write home about. Egg rolls were, meh... beef and mushroom were, meh... happy family was, meh.... might be really good if your drunk !! LoL

Have visited this new location 3 times. Always a nice experience - great food, the sashimi and sushi are fresh with the perfect amount of rice on the sushi. The ambiance is cozier and more intimate than the Milwaukee location and the service is quick! Great moderately priced sushi house for Meridian!!

Made my wife puke 3 times.  Waited almost an hour for food but the folks who came in after us got their sushi.  No quail egg shooters, barely any nigiri at all.  Super weird spicy tuna and spicy salmon nigiri.  The guy server was extremely rude to us.  Twice.

I think this location does a great job, much better than Royersford with speed, card reloading is never an issue and I know how hard Starbucks employees work. My little cousin got treated awful at the Blue Bell location. Kudos to you guys! :) And to the guy who always remembers my name! Very nice people.

I LOVE THIS PLACE! I used to go to Carinos but now I will definitely be coming here for now on. The staff are nice, professional and courteous. The food is amazing! Beware though: it's easy to over eat the bread before the real meal begins! Definitely worth the 5 stars!

You guys suck. So slow and eveything is broken in the room refuse to pick up the front desk phone, the rooms are super spacious which is nice but service is so bad cant believe this. I stay at the Westin a lot and this was so disappointing. Literally horrible service. The front desk suckkkkkkkkkk hire better staff!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Horrible service, Tamara,  the cashier was very rude, unwelcomed, the order wasn't right, food was overcooked.We came to Tampa from Orlando for fishing and were excited to stop here since the location was very close to our spot. Never again will do such a mistake. BAD, BAD, BAD!!!!!

BEST PLACE IN TOWN!!! everything we ordered was AMAZING! street corn, shrimp tacos, baja tacos, and churros were incredible!!! Drinks were insanely good, I recommend the margaritas and paloma :D employees were SO friendly and welcoming from the start, our waiter was Kevin, he's AMAZING!!!! 5 STARS!! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

First and last visit today. :( Neither of us (my friend and I) enjoyed the spicy tuna roll or spicy shrimp roll. My friend didn't even bother with the leftovers. I tried, but I couldn't make it back to my office with my takeout box b/c of the overwhelming fishy smell. Too embarrassed to put in my work frig. Can I vote no stars?!

Stayed here a couple years ago for a birthday weekend for my husband. The room was clean with nice finishes and the hotel was beautiful. Great location, within walking distance to a lot of great sites/tourist attractions. Nothing particularly memorable about the hotel itself, except that it was expensive. Nice stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Have given this place a chance multiple times and it's not my style. The general tso chicken is always tough and hard to chew. The sweet and sour pork was also very tough. Rice seemed slightly undercooked or just old. I've had 4 day old reheated chinese food that tasted better than this did fresh.

Honestly, I was very happy to have this Starbucks in the area since I live in Seffner but it's inconvenient that one day they'll be open and the next day they're closed completely. Make sure you call before you go! Also when they are open they're always out of something.

Pizza is always good here! We have been getting the chicken mediterranean pizza for years.  Tonight we got a garden salad that had half black spoiled lettuce.  Not healthy.  I called up and they said we could drive back in and get a salad.  Sorry to hear that is all they could offer.  I hope this was a outlier event.

Best burger I got the guacamole bacon burger my girlfriend got the chicken parm sandwich and my daughter got the lil pizza all,tried the wings and fried pickles that hit the spot before our meals. Our Server Kenny was helpful with the menu. Love this place for sure will be back.

This ice cream was the best ice cream I've had in all my 33 years. Oh my goodness!!! The flavor !!! I'm mad that I only bought one! We were in Tampa on business and I had the craving for some ice cream. This shop was the first shop that came up. I'm SO GLAD THAT IT DID!! Will definitely stop by again the next time we are in Tampa.

I happened upon this place on a walk and was so pleasantly surprised. Staff is friendly prices are really good. Way more food than I could handle but good tho g I like left overs. My dish was delicious. It's rare that I even like Italian good that much unless really well done. Simple and clean. Well done

All my business goes to kal tire just not this location. The workers just stand around. I was there today just to get my tires retorqued and been waiting for 30min. I look in the shop and all workers are standing around and don't want to help. I don't recommend this location.

text: Funny how you wait a 15 mins for a chocolate dipped cone. How do you even hand a customer this sorry excuses of cone?! PATHETIC!! I mean I get its mostly kids  working here but damn.... extremely dissatisfied. Either the ice cream machine is down or they serve you turds such as this.

text: Honestly the worst Winn-Dixie I've ever been to. They let pan handlers stand out side all day long and harass you for money, the staff doesn't know where anything is or half the shit they sell, also the most unfriendly staff I've ever been around. This place absolutely sucks.

Great friendly service & would recommend this Dunkin better than others while visiting PA
Coffee piping Hot Fresh, clean well maintained. 
Quick and friendly courteous service@drive thru! 
Thank God No Toxic Styrofoam cups! 
Awesome a Senior discount 10% a plus!

Stopped in on vacation, sweet old building and sweet old guys. Honestly this was the most gentle haircut I ever had lol. Plus I wasn't aware they only took cash. Jack let me run to the next building to grab an ATM! I'd go back, I enjoyed the conversation and my fresh cut.

Service was not good the last two times we ate here. The last time, my husbands order was completely wrong. He ordered a carne asada burrito and received a shrimp burrito. No discount or anything for mix up. 
Drinks are made well but service is slow to get them.

Very good wood fired pizza. I had a craving and this place hit the spot. Crust was outstanding and the sauce was perfect so with the quality cheese and toppings it made for a great pie. I didn't get dessert but heard someone say the gelato was incredible on the way out.

Best ice cream ever!   Homemade flavors you'll never find anywhere else.  The waffle cones are different than any I've ever had DELICIOUS!!!   Service is awesome.  They will let you taste as much as you want until you find your perfect flavor.   I take every visitor I have there!!!!

Really great food, great portions and a nice relaxed family style atmosphere. Super busy in the mornings, obviously. So make sure you get there a little early before the hangry sets in cause you're gonna have an average 10-15 min wait, mostly on the weekends though.

Was looking for a place to watch some sports while getting away from the beach crowds.  Immediately found ourselves in the company of a group of friendly locals who made us feel right at home.  Decent selection of beers, great live music.  Food was OK, typical bar food.

We were in Nashville on business and found this place on yelp.  I STILL crave the ice cream concoction they made me.  Whipped cream, fudge, some sort of batter type ice cream and some crunchy things.  Oregon has some yummy places but nothing like Jeni's.  Really need another business trip!!!

I called 30 minutes before they closed, thinking I may have missed the delivery cutoff. But, I was wrong. They gladly took my Beef and Broccoli with pork fried rice order (which is good for the price.) On top of them making a special order of noodles for me. I definitely will continue to order from here.

Something's wrong tonight. I just had the absolute worst Curry Chicken dinner I've ever had. Not only was it not spicy at all, but, it was boring. It had no taste, not salty, absolutely nothing. This is a rare occurrence for them, I guess when I'm in the mood for spicy, I'll order elsewhere.

Food is awesome! But whoever the girl bartender is at 9pm on a Saturday night... She sucks!  Zero personality. Never talked to one person at the bar except to take their drink order.  I tried talking to her myself and got a 3 word answer. To bad, I liked this place. Glad I got food to go.

The people who work here are very nice, so it pains me to write this review, but charging $23 for a small, mediocre tasting plate of eggplant parmagiana  is wrong.  The pizza crust was also terrible.  This restaurant needs to either lower their prices or improve the quality of their food.

Hor
Ren 
Dous


Waitress took forever, their sashimi was somehow dry and they brought an entire plate of food to us an hour after we had ordered one extra roll. Only good thing was the muscles, and those come out a box frozen on the shell. Weak sushi 7, weak.

DO NOT go here if you are expecting air conditioning- the section in which the two big grills are does NOT have air.  We sweated more than anything last night.

Our waitress was the BEST, the Chef was great- he entertained the 7 year-olds in a super way. Food was good and plenty BUT unenjoyable as NO AIR CONDITIONING!!!!!!!

Delicious!! Was hesitant upon hearing an hour wait. But, the hostess insisted it was worth the wait. She offered to text us when a table was ready. It smelled fantastic and we were ready to try it out. I had the shrimp scampi which was phenomenal! It was my husbands birthday, he had veal Parmesan. Highly recommended!!

Urban Cantina is an excellent lunch restaurant with prompt service and delicious Mexican food. The atmosphere is warm and inviting and food items are quickly prepared with large serving sizes.  Not the best Mexican restaurant in Tampa however would definitely recommend and will be sure to go back.

This place is fantastic and consistent.  I have eaten here four times and each time it has been fantastic.  The Carne Asada is flavorful and marinated to perfection.  This place is never busy and has great food.  If you like Mexican my bet is that you will love this place.

do not order from this location!! why are the lights off inside when the store is open? why does their pizza taste poorly compared to other locations? why is the general manager horrible when filing a complaint? don't bother calling the company to complain because they don't care either.  after 10+years as a customer....i am done!

Overcharged for in cabin filters with a "lifetime" warranty and a $20 fee I was not told about to allow this warranty. $200 for an oil change and two filters. This excessive and will not come back again. Staff was polite which is why 2 stars instead of one.

text: Cannot say enough about this gym.  Our family loves the size , amenities, trainers , classes, fellow gym attendees and owner.  Going to the gym is no longer a chore, but a part of our routine in balancing our busy lifestyle.  Thank you for all you do Insook, Steve and Patrick!!

text: I was able to make an appointment an hour before hand which was great but since it was busy they didn't grt started till an hour after my appointment. I wasnt upset though I understand they were busy. The lady did a wonderful job on my nails. Im very happy with them and have gotten many compliments on them!

I would leave 0 stars if I could. My sister purchased food from them today, and after almost finishing it all she came across a bed-bug looking type insect inside at the bottom of her bowl. I am completely disgusted and I would recommend to anyone reading: DO NOT EAT FROM HERE! I will be posting a picture in the picture section.

Terrible donuts!  Dunkin' Donuts should be ashamed for serving such disgusting donuts.  They charge an arm and a leg for garbage when really they should pay me to take them. They are outright awful.  My dog didn't even want them.  Will not be back.  I'd rather drive 20 min to Murfreesboro for quality donuts at a lower price

I have visited this restaurant multiple times, I give it 5 stars because the food is great, and it's byob, the staff is very knowledge about the menu, since my date does not eat gluten. Very helpful. The spicy tuna sandwich is absolutely amazing! However that don't have it over the holidays. Definitely my go to sushi place.

This was a fun place to pop into and enjoy dinner. We are from out of town and enjoyed the local feel. The food was decent; the fries were awesome. I also had the Greek salad and it was very good. The service and price were both reasonable, and the atmosphere was super laid back.

Food is decent. I ordered mixed taco (3 pieces) with soft corn shell. The shrimp, chicken, and carnitas were cooked just about right. They were quite tender. The corn tortillas was a bit to "cornice" and not soft enough. Chips were a bit too thick and not fresh enough. It's a decent place for lunch.

At the risk of sounding like a major snob, here I go.
Yuck. There is nothing about this hotel that warrants a star; there is not enough customer service to make up for the hotels aesthetics shortcoming. Marriott founding fathers are probably rolling on their grave.

text:
Office is clean, staff is friendly.  Prices are reasonable, especially compared so some of the other vet offices I have been to in Nashville.  

Really want this vet to succeed.  I think it would help if they had an actual website, better branding, some advertising.

Been coming here since I was in diapers....or maybe since I learned how to feed myself, not quite sure, its been years. The OG place for taco's. Don't really have to say much because this place speaks for itself.

Bomb a** food, good prices.

The seating is limited btw.

Worst service I've ever experienced. We have been here for 4 of our 5 days and have not seen housekeeping at all. We've requested service 6 different times after having towels delivered at 9:30 on day 2. I've mmmm currently an hour into the wait for the housekeeping manager to come up...

text:
I have been going here for years but won't go anymore. In the last two months I know of several people who have gotten food poisoning from the seared or hibachi steak. 

Too bad because the food and service is good. Something is happening there they need to address around food handling standards.

Noble Roman's has great pizza at a very good price especially compared to the other pizza delivery places around town. Very good customer service as well. Also is open on Christmas Eve just so you know. Noble Romans is a family friendly place and is a sit in restaurant along with carry-out and delivery.

I didn't have an issue with the customer service but more so the quality of service. I took several dresses in to be cleaned. I showed the lady the area of concern. After I got the dress back, it was still dirty. 

I'm new to dry cleaning but I thought it would actually be cleaned. I'll stick to spot treating my clothes at home.

text: I love bk and i especially love this one when i dine in but going through the drive thru is ridiculous at this BK! Every single time i come up to the window they never have the right order up and when i ask for something "special"like cutting a sandwhich in half or certain sauce they can NEVER get it right!

Great customer service and kind employee's! My car engine abruptly failed and Mike squeezed me into a busy schedule to replace my engine. Not only was the help convenient, the replacement was also made in 3 weeks which was quicker than the original estimated time. Will definitely go to this shop again for any future needs!

Don't go here! They outsource dry cleaning. They don't do it themselves. Every time I pick up my stuff they always tell me the, "guy didn't come yet to drop off." Why would I trust someone that doesn't clean my clothes. Avoid this place! Go somewhere else!

text: I don't usually leave reviews but this place was so delicious I had to! I highly recommend the quesadillas, the tortillas are so good and fresh it leaves you full but not too heavy feeling like you over ate or it was too greasy. Great and fast service too! Fully enjoyed will be going back ASAP

The waitress was friendly enough but did not clearly explain the options for gluten free pizza choice. $15 for a 9' thin crust pizza is ridiculous! The manager did give us a discount. However, it was the worst tasting pizza I've ever had. Will not go back.

The rating is low due to the time we had to wait for dinner.  The kitchen must have lost our dinner order because we had to wait over 50 minutes after we got our great goat cheese salad. Our waiter kept checking but to no avail. The manager did not seem to understand our frustration.

Beautiful building and interior. Kind and helpful staff. Wonderful and relaxing atmosphere. Our food and drinks were 100% delicious. Well-prepared and amazing flavors. We went on a Friday. There was a packed house, so I would recommend calling ahead of time and making reservations.

Cannot wait to go back!

This is the worst McDonald's I have ever been to first of all you have to wait 5 to 10 minutes for someone to take your order and then when you get up to the register they are usually on their phone or too busy talking or doing homework to help you. Please hire some people that actually give a damn about customer service!

text: Affordable basic wash but the brushes ripped the back wiper arm right off my car. Do not take a station wagon through this car wash. Friendly wash attendants but management does not return messages left on their machine and their contact form online does not let you submit an inquiry.

Hailee the "lead" shift supervisor is rude, unfriendly, and generally an unpleasant person. No customer service skills AT ALL. Is it really that hard to be friendly when cashing someone out? Not even the slightest acknowledgment in response to my thank you.

Coming from an area that has has a donut shop on every major block to Greenwood I was supremely happy to find a real donut shop. The filled donuts are extremely fresh and do not have the artificial taste that many filled donuts have. I would recommend the blueberry glazed as well as the blueberry filled.

Bologna on the buy one get one free. They charge me over $600. dollars for two pair of glasses. I was floored as my last pair had cost me $350. Never ever go here. What  arip off. I dont know why I didnt walk out. FREE  PAIR? No they just charge double on the first pair.

text: This has to be the best Chinese restaurant in the USA. The food is fresh and amazing. I feel that they make the food with love. You can tell that they love working there.  I love the chicken broccoli, general tso and egg rolls. The service staff is very friendly. They are so nice. A great fast food Chinese place.

I don't know if maybe I went at an "off" time, but I was disappointed.  My group was the first to arrive for the lunch hour, but service was sluggish and  not very friendly.  The food was okay (didn't try the sushi), but it wasn't anything special and didn't make up for the less than stellar service.

Arrived at 8 PM on a Saturday night and asked for all you can eat sushi. Even though the restaurant is open until 10 PM, they cut off all you can eat sushi orders at 8:30. So they tried to charge me $27 per person for 20 minutes worth of all you can eat sushi.

This place is horrible. The food was horrible, the order was horrible and wrong! The people were rude. The only reason they even have a star on top is because their delivery was fast. But everything else was horrible. Never will I ever order from here again. HORRIBLE!!!!!

Please is very good.
Food came out maybe too quick, did not give us time to dismiss the Salad or the soup, need a slight time delay. 
Food was very good, looking forward to trying the sushi next time.
My only wish is that the owner would try to save some of money and NOT use so much MSG, the food is great without it.

The worst McDonald's I've ever been to. We placed a mobile order and had the receipt. They said they didn't have it, wouldn't even look at the receipt or check our order number/code. text: For the price, this place is awesome. Their prices are totally fair and their food is good. The three roll special is an awesome deal, and the rolls are in 8 pieces so you get a LOT of sushi. The spicy yellowtail apple roll is not to be missed. I trust them to deliver good food quickly and they've never let me down!

Normally Lolita is great, one of my favorites, and this was our 4th or 5th time here.  But tonight, it was just ok.  My food came out a good 5 minutes before my husband's, so it was cold by the time his came.  I hate to rate it this low, but the food was just ok this time too.  Not sure we'll be back...

Wow. We walked in and grabbed a seat on a whim tonight. Could not have been more pleasantly surprised. Had the mixed chips and salsa to start. The verde was amazing. Wife had the chilaquethes (sp?), and I had the special tacos (pork al pastor). Both were excellent. We left stuffed and so glad we walked in.

Food has always been good. But service is slow. I do not recommend this place on a weekend unless your ok waiting an hour plus to get your food. And the entire time you wait no one check on you or asks if you want a refill on drinks.  I won't be back on a weekend.

Old-school Delco place that's all about the pizza.Generous toppings and doughy crust makes two slices enough for a hearty meal. Order two hours ahead on weekends and bring a passenger who can hop out to pick up the pies (since it's tough to find parking if the spaces put front are full).

Worse experience I ever had in my life .my order was messed up.the employee made me wait and mumbled I could barely hear him.but  he got louder when he was threatening me and insulting me. He made fun of my clothes. And swore at me and threatened me. The manager didn't do anything about it either.

The general manager is so rude! I called and put in a complaint about this hotel and and the lack of service. His response was awful. He's unprofessional, arrogant, lack of respect for his hotel guests, and does not take negative feedback well. Do NOT stay here!!! Do not waste your money.

This place is not it. I've been cussed at by the workers. To say that they're not friendly is a bit of an understatement. Service was bad. Small selection of donuts. No Boston cream, no regular glazed, no chocolate glazed, etc. Donuts were stale. They gave me the wrong donut, I touched it, and when I gave it back they put it back on the shelf with the other donuts not in the garbage where it should've gone.

I had lunch here with my daughter while in town.
The food and service were very good.
It has a nice comfortable dining and bar area with a large deck out back. You have a nice view of the river inside or out.
The menu was very unique with many unusual combinations.
I hope to go back again soon !

Worst Dunkin I've ever been to. I've given this place a few chances. Order is never right, staff is unfriendly, very disorganized, and there's always some issue. They are usually "out" of something very basic. This morning they say they only accept cash after I waited on line for 10 minutes. Horrible.

Pretty big place.  Pretty clean.  I was honestly surprised to see tanning beds.  I thought they were no longer recommended for a healthy lifestyle.  The cardio equipment is in good shape, but the Nautilus weight machines are in dire need of new pads.  Many are cracked and dig into your skin.  This should be addressed.

text: Tourist trap. Food is not very good. Service is not very good--bad, in fact. I had an awful experience just trying to get someone to pay attention to me once they "dropped off" the food. I found this salon through Groupon and was introduced to Ashley, I am so thrilled! She is the only one I trust with my hair now. The salon is taking all the necessary precautions with COVID so I feel safe every time I go in. 
Make an appointment with Ashley, you wont regret it.

we were dissapointed at spending $90.00 for two, for good/not great italian food in a $30 atmosphere. There are hundreds of restaurants with million dollar interiors and great food. Why eat here? We would never go back . Go to Ralphs,  a block away and and save money.

Updated: Good place but not consistent in quality. For some reason their single slices that you get in shop are amazing but when you order a full pie it's like ordering from a new place every time. If their full pies tasted like their single slice house pies my review would stay at 5 stars.

In Philadelphia on business and this place was recommended. Whole experience was wonderful. Reservations are a must if you want any chance here. Service was excellent, food was even better. Returned the next evening by myself and everything was excellent again. Sunday Sauce is spectacular.

This place is amazing !!! Amazing customer service, great communication and so easy to order. Food was ready within 10 min and oh man it was heaven. Soft handmade tortilla, and the Al Pastor Tacos were on point  The Carne asada was good too but the Al Pastor stole the show, will be returning.

The guacamole serving size here is ridiculously small all while having being over a dollar. One dollar and twenty six cents, to give a perspective on how small the serving is look at the picture these idiots who own Sabor post under their gallery on yelp, comical. Food is mediocre, and often tasteless.

Lacking basic accommodations like pillows and ice. Also we requested a roll-away bed and were not provided with one. text: The dh and I got a pizza from here for take out.  We are usually sicilian pizza fans, but this was delish.  Good chewy crust, extra cheese that actually was and lots of sausage (round little balls, bigger then crumbles) lots of pepperoni.  Have to figure out how to get back here frequently.  Excellent pizza!

Great Salon! Awesome space with convenient parking right in Doylestown. Gaby the owner cut and colored my hair exactly how I wanted it. Very friendly staff.  and reasonably priced services, which is always a plus. I noticed they also do nails there as well!

Great place, and the only Chinese I'll eat in the CWE. I live a block away and am relieved that there is finally a decent Chinese place. I rec the spicy chicken - good white meat chicken in a spicy (Thai?) basil sauce. The prices are unbeatable, too!

Give it a try!

Now dealing with horrible leasing staff - dismissive and inconsiderate. We have a reputation of being the worst building to live in.  You can't even sit in the hot tub without some idiot putting their cigars out and leaving them around it.  I feel sorry for the people who bought in the building!

I love this place to get my gel nails done! I do have to say they rush through so if your looking for a more long relaxing treatment this isn't the place for you . Although I must say they are very rude on the phone . I called to make an appt and the owner hung up on me .

Customer Service:  This particular location has some of the unfriendliest, disinterested and unhelpful staff I've ever encountered.  

Location:  City Avenue is always busy so it's usually a hassle trying to get out of the plaza onto the street.

Stayed here ~ 2 years ago when it was still a Sheraton, and wow, has it deteriorated quickly. Surprised Starwood puts their name on this. It is badly in need of renovation. If you have a group, there is a back bar area to use.

After finding all the major car rental companies were out of cars, we called this company and not only did they have cars available, prices were reasonable and they offered to pick us up so we didn't have to uber.  Overall very friendly and professional company.  Highly recommend.

Great area! The food and the way you order is pretty cool with the whole sushi style ordering. I ordered the steak and shrimp tacos and I'd have to say they were pretty good. Also had some of their special mixed drinks, needless to say it was an overall good experience and will be going back.

This place is a great laundry mat with a very kind owner, but not a dry cleaner. I took few suits for dry cleaning. She sends them out for cleaning. text: Sushi overall was decent but was definitely not worth the price. We came in to have AYCE  on a Friday night, our waiter was good always checking up on us even though he was busy. Honestly though 2 AYCE was almost $60!!!!!! I'd come back but maybe only 2 times a year.

I wish I could rate this place better but they are too expense with poorly controlled food quality.  We had a party of six and half of our dinner were served luke warm at best. Each item is priced over $26 so you would think they prepared them with care. Apparently not.

Used to be a great restaurant. The owner is a lovely person, but the service now is absolutely horrible. The waiters used to make the clients feel special. They all either quit or were fired. The new ones make the experience not worth withstanding. Very sad.

Long wait, no problem.  Lack of "customer service," again no problem.  When a place doesn't take reservations and is walk-in only - it is disappointing to show up at 4:00 in the afternoon to see the Closed sign up when the hours are clearly until 7:00. The guys and the cuts are great though - it's worth it.

Wish I had checked Yelp before choosing to grab a table at Jet Rock while waiting for a flight.
Staff was pleasant but I ordered a cider and received a beer, the salad arrived dripping wet with water and it took forever to pay.

Travel is frustrating enough

Never heard of charging for chips and salsa in a Mexican restaurant. Margariras were ok at best
 The food was good and the waiter was attentive but new andnot knowledgeable.  Would I come back again? Probably not because there are so many excellent Mexican restaurants.

I used to go in at lunch and the girl behind the counter looked like she was on something.other workers are nice except when they correct your pronunciation of gyro to another one which also isn't correct. Be careful when they sweet talk you then charge you way more than it should be. Happens every time!

I love this store and especially getting to know Miss Sharon the cashier over the years.  She makes shopping there fun.  I live downtown Nashville and am so glad this store is there for workers and residents!!  Now if they would just sell coconut cupcakes :)

1st time on bourbon walked into spirits on bourbon and were completely ignored we stood there for a few minutes and finally walked out and went across the street to tropical isle. When we tried to go thru the drive thru the lady said it was broken.So then we went inside and we ask for 2 Oreo Hot Chocolate and they guy says the hot chocolate machine is also broken. You would think since it's cold outside that the hot chocolate machine would work or they would fix it.NOPE.

We really enjoyed this place. We had the St Louis box with pizza, ravioli, cheese balls, and cinnamon dessert. Everything was delicious. Definitely recommend this after a long day at the zoo. It was still overpowering. I won't be going back.

text: One of two really best sushi places you can eat at.  Love coming here great food great people!! I sit at the counter and ask my sushi chef to just make  me an assorted plate of nigiri and it is always awesome I believe his name is Chris. I try to sneak here or my other favorite sushi restaurant at least once or every other week.

One of the BEST restaurants in Indy!!!  Incredible delicious food and fantastic customer service!  Robert is an amazing manager, Frankie is one of the best servers we have ever had and Ashley makes amazing desserts!  How great for Indy that this restaurant opened.

We really enjoyed all our food and there is a nice vibe BUT the acoustics are horrible which made it hard for our table to have a conversation.  They don't have a lot of alcohol choices as I think they use all local small batch brands which was fine.   Go check it out, it's worth it.

I'm not the type of person to ever leave a review of a place, but I just couldn't help leaving one today. This was a terrible experience for me. I got my correct order, but it wasn't at all the drink I asked for. It was made completely wrong and wasted my time and money.

Went there today to get some food to go from the deli/meat counter. There was an older lady working. She was mocking me and was extremely rude when I asked a question. My go to spot when I'm feeling a Stromboli, pasta dish, or slice of pizza. Garlic rolls are my favorite part and are always delicious. Family owned and operated and always pleasant with good service. Don't let the other reviews keep you away and give it a try!

Budget car rental change policies are terrible. My flight was cancelled and changed by the air line. I would be arriving at my destination one day later. I tried adjusting my rental and remove one day of rental and they charged me 86$. It cost me more money to have less days of rental.

Service was slow. Ordered sushi which was 95% rice and virtually no fish or other ingredients. Showed the waitress and she blew it off stating that's how it should be. "Their" mac and cheese is Kraft and the sauces for the Shrimp and Scallops tastes like its from a bottle from Walmart. Definitely will not return.

Delightful dinner last night. Enjoy the ambiance, service terrific, owner VERY charming. Pasta and sea food the winner but the ribeye and the roasted chicken were excellent too. Wine reasonable, deserts delicious and the comfort factor, relaxed and friendly make this our favorite SB dining spot.

This restaurant recently completed a remodel and their facility looks nice.  The service is consistently awful though!  I don't expect much from fast-food employees but this place takes that to a whole new low.  Avoid it!  Subway and Dairy Queen are located nearby, they are nothing exceptional but much better than this McDonalds.
