text: OMG! Why would anyone ever go anywhere else for pizza? I swear it is the best pizza I have ever eaten! We ordered (to go) an antipasto  and the 1/2 & 1/2 pizza. We will never go anywhere else for pizza  again! It was pure heaven in a pie! The salad was fresh, crisp and plentiful. Thank you Vetture's! ....and now they deliver!

Great place for your loved ones.  Very caring ladies that know how you make your pet comfortable.  My dog came in all scared shaking and then the girls took him did something with him to make him feel comfortable like home. I was amazed. 
Great doctor and great front desk. 
Super clean and smells good. 
And the prices are good

We just moved to the area, decided we wanted Mexican food.  Checked yelp for reviews and wound up giving this place a try.   Wait staff was super friendly and asked lots of questions about our preferences on spice level to make sure we'd be happy with our choices.  Chicken enchilada was so delicious.  Definitely will be returning.

When I had my 2004 Volvo S60 I brought my car here every time! I always received good honest work and appreciated being treated fairly. If you are a Volvo owner, this is the place to bring your car for regular service or bigger jobs. These guys will take care of you and your ride 100%

This is the BEST place for breakfast! The staff is wonderful but the FOOD IS ABSOLUTELY THE BEST!!!...u will not be disappointed or hungry when u Leave here! This place was packed and our food was still out very fast and very tasty...I recommend this place to everyone!

Worst subWay can't even get an  order correct. Never ordering online again. This place is amazing! My son's glasses broke, I was worried! He has a very confusing sense of arrogance to him. I have been shopping there before you were born son, back off with your attitude!

Went 3 times . Each time at drive thru the man said the cash register doesn't work. I went to Arby's next door and see the drive thru magically working. Hmmm made me wonder for while until I realized each time was same person not choosing to serve me because of my white skin color. Racism certainly exists

This place never disappoints. It's my favorite Mexican place in the area. I usually get a quesadilla or nachos, and I'm never left hungry or unsatisfied. It's not the largest place, so it does get a bit cramped when it's crowded, but anytime I have a hankering for some spicy, cheesy goodness, I head on over.

Surprised by how good the food tasted. Hot, flavorful and generous. We enjoyed our meal and would recommend it for anytime you want casual Mexican meals at reasonable prices done well. Staff was friendly and a helpful for newbies from Florida. Next time we are in Tucson we'll be back.

Plain HORRIBLE. This pizza was burnt, hard, and had absolutely no taste! I ordered a pepperoni and sausage pizza and it was the worst pizza I've ever had. I also ordered buffalo chicken wings and they were uncooked and super nasty. They tasted like they were refrigerated and then heated up by how plain they were. Disappointed!

Have loved the gym until our family upgraded to the black level. The staff struggles with turning in the correct tanning bed. You're already to tan and then the tanning bed isn't programmed correctly. Staff needs to be paying attention to tanning details. This isn't a one time issue.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: A HUGE THANK YOU TO TRIOS FROM THE NURSES AT JEANES HOSPITAL ON 2C!!!! We appreciate you so much for donating food to our floor. We are beyond grateful for your generosity. Trios is one of our favorite restaurants and always will be. You guys have such a huge heart and are so kind. We love you!!!!

Food was good enough, margaritas were just mix.  Service was terrible. Sat us down at the table promptly and then forgot us - had to ask for water - drinks never came until after the food and we asked again. -guacamole was no better than store bought. We are new to town and won't be back- fairly expensive for what we ordered

GROSS. This might be the most disgusting hotel I ever stayed at. The room decor was outdated and it was a mess. Also we found bed bugs in our room and we left!! They offered to switch rooms but there was no way I could stay there! They offered a refund for the room and I left!! Disgusting hotel never stay there.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is the closest McDonald's to me so its location is really convenient. The food was great and all and I absolutely love the fries, sundaes, and fruit parfait. But one day, I ordered a salad and I found hair in it! Now I won't be eating anything else there unless it's the fries, sundaes, or the fruit parfaits!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I wanted to take the time to say that I had great customer service from this team. Katie the manager was amazing as well as the young man I picked up my car from! Could not have had better customer service skills-friendly , fast and efficient !! Thanks for making it quick and easy - will definitely be back!

Honestly going to this place its a waste of time they never open at 5am like it states on the site/hours on the door. I stop by this week twice at 5:30 and I see people in there walking around and I saw one employee just staring at us from the drive they window with their headset on and not taking orders which is ridiculous

So my sister made a reservation for 7pm and we arrived here promptly on time. Would you believe that it's 7:37pm and we haven't been seated yet? It's not about how good the food is at this point, I just had 40 minutes of my life taken from me I'll never get back. It's 7:38 as I'm done writing this review.

So disappointed :( Didn't live up to the hype. The $7 "garlic bread" was a small, lame, toasted loaf with garlic butter on the side. Dominos is better than that! The $17 personal pizza was like a dry flatbread and nothing special. Priced like gourmet, tastes like frozen.

Not really sure what happened to this place. Menu pretty much unchanged in a over year, out of the dinner special before 8, 30 min wait for drinks, steak served basically raw "because the chef didn't want to cook it medium" as per the server (but left on the bill). Last time for me.

Tremendously slow service. 5-6 people behind the counter all more focused on tasks than customers. Served the wrong size drink, did not call any names when they put drinks up. Might work if they were proper size and you were checking. Dismissive attitude when mentioned to them.

Cocktails were amazing wish I could say the same for the tacos.  Overpriced and the dessert was below par as well.  Chicken taco - chicken was fatty and that's all that was on the "taco".   Chips and salsa was kind of a joke.    Very far from Mexican food.

Food was average.  Had coupon and showed waitress prior.  After dropping $60, told they couldnt use the coupon.  Coupon was 100% valid based on print and waitress agreed.  Manager/Owner declined to accept and provide valid reasoning.  My last visit without a doubt, that is called bad business

A nice clean, quiet, non-smoking hotel with a large comfortable bed with a comforter. Far from the casinos tucked away in an office park. Perfect for a short overnight stay on the road between Colorado and San Francisco for those who have no desire to drink, smoke, or gamble or be around those who do.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Long line and no self-service kiosks. Friendly service though. Just gotta get with the times. Typical Philadelphia.

Update: I was charged an exorbitant fee for gas refill after returning the car, even though I confirmed a lower price with the agent upon getting the keys. Had to email them about ten times to get a refund.

First trip here with family. I was thrown off by the one man band playing and singing the oldies, that weren't Italian.. But hey, I'm Polish so who really cares.
Food taste was mediocre.. LARGE PORTIONS! Waitress was good and gave prompt service.
We will be back but it won't be the first pick.

I went through the self checkout. I bought a half gallon of tea from the deli, paid with a 20. Didn't get my cash change, only the coins. They refused to give me my change. Told me someone else must have taken it.  This store stole 17 dollars from me. I love the food in the deli, but I will never ever shop here again.

Stopped in for a bite to eat after work, was going to place a to go but the bartender was super friendly and persuaded me to order in. I ended up drinking frozen margaritas until close! Tacos were great, al pastor and tinga were my favorite! Definitely recommend! Suzie was great!

This Wendy's is good during the day only when Mrs. Lisa is working. She's great and customer service is awesome. At night they are so rude and act like they hate their job. They rush your food to you and rush you when ordering. Only worth it during the day.

Great beer list, good wine list. Bartenders are great, and the vinyl selection they play (with the exception of Steely Dan and some of the noisier Sonic youth stuff) is great. Burger is great -think the best burger you've ever had at a backyard BBQ. What I love the most is that it's super casual, but not divey in the least.

Ordered cashew chicken for take out. Was terribly disappointed. Chicken was far and few between (really....no more than a few bites) and the entire box was filled with cheap filler veggies (i.e., celery). Friendly/funny owner but subpar food. Will not be going back.

Horrible customer service! Waiting for a bar tender for over 5 minutes while he was screwing around with his buddies at the end of the bar. Obviously intoxicated. This is not the first time this has happened here. If they hired some quality bar tenders and not their friends, this would be a much better bar.

Terrible quality, no flavor, poor service. I should have read more reviews. My margarita had no alcohol in it and my burrito and beans were plain and bland. No silverware until I begged and no hot sauce available. Salsa was mild and flavorless and slow service. This was an unfortunate dinner experience.

Soooo happy we decided to stop here. The tacos were some of the best I've ever had and everyone was so friendly and helpful. Incredible homemade tortillas, we ate through almost the entire menu and every single one was incredible. This is the place you want to eat, I promise.

Josh and the rest of the staff are all very helpful and do a great job at running the community. The area is safe, place is well kept, and everyone is friendly. It's been nothing but great times here at Covington since moving in earlier this year. Definitely recommend looking into living here!

Terrible! Don't waste your time and money! They charged me $45 for a pink and white FILL IN. It's been less than a week and they are cracked, breaking...not shaped well at all. They were also rude and NOT speaking English. I'm sick and tired of spending money at these places for POOR service.

I'm DONE!

As always these guys are the best in Tucson. Took my truck for brake work and they did an outstanding job and stand by their work. Only place I will go for service in my vehicles. Highly recommend. Make an appointment because so many people trust them they get booked fast but it's well worth it.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Great place for Sunday Brunch!  Great waitstaff squeezing fresh oranges for mimosas or the Bloody Mary Bar. Yummy hot mini donuts with dipping sauce, cheese grits and fresh squeezed orange is a great way to start my day. Lots of brunch and lunch options available.

This place is the best! I wish I was here longer so I could go back! 
The menu looks pricey but IT INCLUDES SOUP OR SALAD. The pasta fagioli was the best I ever had! The entrees were delicious. The portions are generous. Our waiter clearly loves his job, has been there 14 years  and was fantastic! Come back to NYC! Pleassse.

Food is decent. Quick service. Just went there today. New rule: credit card purchase must be greater than $10. Had no cash walked out. ... what is this the 80's. I can use my Iphone to board a flight.  I know it cost money to have merchant account but in a world where many consumers don't carry cash this a bad business decision.

It was not busy at all and we waited 25 min (after ordering) to get one roll and two orders of nigiri. Very crowded at the bar. The hostess and waitstaff were very nice, but the chefs took forever, taking my husband's orders but skipping me every time. Also, the rice was sweet and mushy... Pretty Americanized and off-putting.

This is the best place to hang at BNA.  There is always live music and it's close to Southwest connections.  I always get the salmon and and glass of wine..it's almost an airport ritual.  The bar is great and I always end up in a fun conversation over sports at the bar.

Great service and great haircut. New to Florida and been here a handful of times with my little guy. These guys and gal are professional, talented and make you feel welcome. They're patient, kind, take their time, and make sure the kids are comfortable. We will not go anywhere else. You all rock!

Thank you McDonalds! I was having trouble finding a local McDonalds to help me with hot boxed coffee, I was able to get in touch with Donna from Christian foods who took care of my boxed coffee needs! McDonalds was super friendly and had everything ready to go for me.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I have been coming from the start...last year coming a few times a week for hoagies and sandwiches. I just got a large italian hoagie today for lunch and what a surprise!! It actually looked like a hoagie that you buy for a fundraiser.. very little meat & cheese at all...very disappointing!!

Picked up an order to go, not impressed at all, wished it was better. Even the salsas offered really had no flavor, and even the extra hot was not spicy, they do so much better. They used to be good. Won't return. It would be a good stop if you like bland mexican food.

this place is nestled in a strip mall in Pass A Grille. we were looking for a good pizza place and found it on Yelp. it's not fancy but the staff is very friendly. we got personal pizzas. the crust was crispy and light. it wasn't my favorite place but it was good and reasonably priced

I was shocked and creeped out to find that Holiday thriftway was boarded up bricks. ???.WTH, It's Gross!!. This construction site should be done or almost by now instead of looking like some big igloo or ugly dome. I haven't been up there since I put out this post.

I love this gym! Allan, the owner, is an absolute treasure. He truly cares about the quality of service, cleanliness, equipment diversity and fitness for all. This is THE BEST GYM I shave ever had the opportunity to use. He offers so much value for a small price.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I like that I can leave my clothes early before going to work and pick them up on my way back on the same day. Clothes are always ready.
Most of the time there are people line up to leave their clothes (good sign!) but the line move quickly. I am very happy with their services... and prices!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
I went with my husband. We ordered the nonna's pasta with the meatballs and a fish. The fish was salty but tasted good! The pasta was overcooked and didn't taste good. We had the burrata and it wasn't a good quality burrata either. The bread was too salty too.
Service was good and the place is cozy and well decorated!

Brush soap didnt work, high pressure soap didn't work. I have a $10 charge on my card???? It's says $2.50 on the sign. I called the number several times for a refund and just rings. I had to then drive down the road to Mission Bell car wash and pay them for the actual car wash. I would like a refund of my $10 please!

I got there and placed an order, but it turns out got a huge order of 17 pizzas just before I got there! They noticed I was waiting and handed me a cup for a drink, made conversation and let me keep my coupon! I had the watsonville apple, it deserves the fanfare. Great service, great pizza.

This is my favorite pizza in Brandon. Equal to Anthony's Coal Fired pizza. Pricier than the chains but worth every penny. The antipasto salad is just ok. That's the only thing I've ever had here that I didn't love. Just liked it. But the pizza is New York style perfection.

Love this place. This is our favorite stop for dinner after a long day at the beach. Good service. Bar and grill atmosphere. Excellent food. I love the buffalo chicken burger and we always get the pretzels and cheese appetizer. Their spicy Bloody Mary can't be beat anywhere. Can't say enough good about this place!

Very poor customer service, don't give napkins don't ask if you want sauce food was poorly prepared more cheese on wrapper than the actually food I paid for it to be on will drive the extra 10 miles to next Arby's before returning back to this drive threw only facility

Beware of scam at this store!!! The price was changed twice without any explanations during my purchase for a pair of glass. Really ridiculous part was they ran my credit card and fraudulently charged an extra 20 dollars before I noticed it later. So sad to see a dirty store in Tucson and waste my time! Will never shop here again
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
While on vacation we celebrated our 38th wedding anniversary, at our table of 6 friends food was anywhere between good to average. Food presentation was great.  
Service could of been a bit more attentive to our table, I was a little disappointed, maybe this is a regulars place but you need to be attentive to everyone.

Vegetarian lasagna arrived frozen throughout the center.  On second attempt it was still cool in the middle.
The other dish ordered was pumpkin ravioli. The ravioli were more like cardboard than pasta.
Service was good and staff friendly. Bread tasty and warm.

Hands down to the best Optometrics! Prices can be steep, but it's well worth the money-kind front desk lady, great doctor, and highly professional frame/lens salesmen! Small but nice selection of frames, and attention-to-detail services!

Highly recommended!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Nice looking restaurant! Elegant, good service.
However the menu is very misleading. The grilled beef hearts did not taste like anything and were like rubbers! 
Two dishes (onion tart and duck) were buried under too much "frisée" (not at all stated in the description).
The duck is a salad with all grain mustard (not in description)

Have always enjoyed fabulous service and fine food. It is excellent Italian food at reasonable prices. If that is the combination you are looking for it works. The space does not have quite the same ambience of past locations, but it is central to the city and there are some nice areas of the restaurant. Staff is solid.

There was a persistent smell of urine in the bathroom, which I thought I could chalk up to a less-than-clean toilet, until I realized that there was an actual large dried puddle of urine on the bathroom floor. Aside from that, the stay was fairly standard for a pet - friendly hotel: fine.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: They mess up your order a lot, giving you someone else's food and charge you for stuff you didn't order. This morning, they put egg shell in my sausage McMuffin with egg.....gross. Don't ever go there. Anything, anywhere would be better than this disgusting establishment.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We should have left the moment we saw how dirty the place was. My cup was filthy but my server did not understand English enough to understand I needed a new cup!The food was terrible and the place had a strange feel to it. I would not recommend this to anyone!

Stayed here 4 nights. Near airport, shopping mall and 10 minutes to downtown Nashville. A shuttle bus departs from Hotel No need to drive which would make parking difficult. Many restaurants and museums. Clean room and breakfast enough start the day. Quiet room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: A pleasant surprise.  The fried chicken tenderloin appetizer was tasty. Three of us got fried shrimp buckets and it was very good at a very reasonable price.  My son got a hamburger and it was also very good.  We had Kelly as a server and she was great.  We plan to go back.

I love this place! I used to go to the first location up near Elsmere as a kid all the time and when I saw this new location I knew it had to be the same people! Tacos are always fresh, cashiers are always very nice. A great soda selection and their sauces are so tasty. Definitely will be back.

I order pizza here frequently. I usually do take out because the restaurant doesn't hold a lot of people and it is always busy!  The pizza crust is awesome, pepperoni and jalapeño is my favorite pizza, and also really like the hot wings.  Glad this little gem is here!

I spend a lot of time traveling for work and we have stayed here quite often over the past 6+ years. They have been remodeled in the past year. The rooms are nice, staff is friendly. If you've ever stayed at a holiday Inn express then you've had the breakfast. Overall a good hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Pizza was ok, not great. I got the superbionic. I was excited about the artichokes. There was probably 1 quarter of an artichoke heart on the entire LARGE pizza. That was really disappointing. The only other complaint was there is a sort of bitter after taste. And the fact that the pizza was $21. Not really impressed.

Great tacos of all varieties and fast friendly service.  The only set back is that they are closed on Tuesdays .......I guess business gets lop sided when they get the      taco-Tuesday" trend  , other than that I would give them five stars as far as tacos go

Had a panini .. prosciutto was a few days past its prime and the panini comes with nothing other than cheese unless you select from a sparse list. Service was crappy and the furniture is totally unsuitable for kids. Also, despite being so pretentious, they served the panini with lays chips .. blah .. no options.

Great coffee and a cool atmosphere. It's a great place to sit and read, work, or enjoy the day on the patio. Bonus points for being there on a day when Rudy's flower truck is there. I had the nitro cold brew which was silky smooth and bold. My husband had the pour over which was delicious as well. Great neighborhood joint.

This was our first time in a haircut saloon since we came back to USA and Ruby treated my daughter beautifully.  She came home with a beautiful haircut and the price was just right.
I will definitely go back... it's going to be my turn next time.
Thanks Ruby for your help

A week ago we found out our pup was going to need major surgery. We had several quotes and needless to say I was shocked of the fees. I did research and found Animal House. They are very kind and very knowledgeable. I so appreciate everything they did for our fur baby. Please know that they are well worth the wait.

Pizza is rarely this good. The variety of toppings are extensive and surprising. Eggplant!  But it was *delicious*. Neat art, friendly staff, cool decorations. But all of that is nothing without great food, which this place has. A little cramped but it's a chill atmosphere.

the hotel is historic, thus really old and smells a bit moldy.
pro's: location,location location (downtown st. louis)
con's: no parking but private garage is just at d back of d hotel. don't dare to park overnight  or in wee hours at the street. d day we came there we saw 3 adjacent cars windows r being broken into.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Not appetizing. Worse service. The place is too small for the server not to be able to service you properly and timely. The whole restaurant needs a total renovation. The place is so old and dirty especially the booths. There is no feel of japan here! Disgusting!

I LOVE Marriott- big FAN. Family even owns multiple timeshares. But this hotel needs more staff at pool. Bar line is 45 minutes to get a drink. And only 1 person taking orders by lounge chairs. Come on Marriott- get with it! I know u can! Cause love y'all!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: CONSUMER BEWARE! They broke my van door and wouldn't take responsibility for it. They were nice enough to pull at it, and put wd40 on it to get it to work and when it didn't they said "sorry it didn't happen here" Now I'm stuck with a right door that doesn't work!

Lil disappointed with this place food wise. The house salads were served to us with browning lettuce, a piece of tomatoe and 1 piece of cucumber each. The pasta was ok, but nothing exceptional. I guess I just wanted/expected better. 


Service was excellent however and parking was easy enough.

Drinks are always inconsistent, I never know what I am going to get with what I order.  I usually order the same drink when I go, but every time it tastes drastically different.  Half the time it is terrible.  I have stopped going because of the inconsistency.

Very disappointed. I ordered the Teriyaki beef and rice. Very stringy beef, and the rice was dreeenched in sauce. It was edible, but won't be coming her again.

I also tried some sushi. I've never before had sushi with DRY seaweed on it. And I mean dryyy.

Made Edo Japan look like a 4 star restaurant.

I usually go w a member as a guest. The staff is friendly and the gym is clean. I wish there was a greater variety of equipment and maybe a larger area for mat work. No group classes. They do have really cool circuit training areas for full body and abs. Good cardio selection. Good deal for the price!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: All you can eat sushi for $22 per person.  Includes appetizers and special rolls including Spider Roll and dessert!  Sushi was just OK.  Tempura was terrible!  Not really tempura.  Chicken teriyaki was good.  miso soup was good. Good if you want to eat a lot of sushi, but otherwise, I'd pass.  Very friendly staff.

I lived in the neighborhood for a few years and this was my goto pizza place. Their pizza is great, cheesesteaks are great, my brother loves their chicken nuggets with honey mustard sauce. I still sometimes make the drive up to Mayfair just to bring home 2 sausage pizzas.

I have eaten at Dawsons a few time's Ribs are the best and the food is always good.
the service can be hit or miss. The place is clean , I like the idea of the big booths and it gives you privacy. They have a small bar but it is cute and the drinks are good.
I would recommend this place and the price is right

I love Baskin Robbins ice cream and have been a fan since I was a little kid.  The ice cream here was as good as ever... but the shop was filthy...and with only one person working, it took forever to be served.  The service was understandable in these times, but being filthy is inexcusable.

Wednesday night doesn't work at Bacco. Have met friends here and had great service multiple times. Tonight waited for 1.5 hours for dinner. Had to box our dinners because we had to leave. Manager made excuses. Wait staff was still excellent. Tipped my waiter.

Amazing vegan food! Came for restaurant week and each course was creative and had bold flavors. I am a tough critic with vegan food, since I feel a lot of people give credit simply for a restaurant having a vegan option. The food was on point, service was solid, and drinks were fantastic. Highly recommend.

This sushi restaurant is amazing! My boyfriend and his family come here often and we always receive great service and amazing food! Our most recent server's name was Ashley and she was extremely kind and attentive to us during our visit. Definitely check out this restaurant for all of your sushi needs!

The food at this restaurant is very good in my opinion.  The pizza is crispy and delicious.  They also have many gluten free options.  The only issue I have with this place is their delivery.  They constantly forget items or send you the orders wrong. They then can take quite awhile to correct the issues.

Used to be my go to sushi but the new owners do NOT provide a tasty bite.  I recently got some plain rolls, just tuna, AAC, spicy yellowtail- everything wrapped in seaweed paper YUCK YUCK YUCK.  This place used to have a yummy middle and a very thin layer of rice.   I won't get that nasty sushi again.

This place has horrible service. Nowhere on the website does it specify that you need reservations, yet when my boyfriend and I came here for dinner they refused to seat us because we didn't have reservations and they were "understaffed". Bullshit. No high end restaurant is understaffed on a Friday night. Go somewhere else!

Some of the worst coffee I've ever had. I got a large coffee at the Nashville airport and ended up not even drinking it and instead had the free instant stuff from my hotel. It tasted so weak and as if they'd run too much water over the same beans over and over.

Fast food coffee is better than this and half the price.

Got a cut recently from this place. I asked for a fade around the side and blended up top. I got neither of that. The barber (not the main dude) seemed to be in a rush and was pretty rough with the cut. He seemed more interested in getting it done as quickly as possible.

Terrible service and moderately portioned food. I have never had a waitress hand me back the bill and for me to figure out how it is split. I will not be coming back again. She never had a smile on her face. I would have talked to the manager if I wasn't being a tourist. May happiness shine down on you.

All staff were wonderful and very helpful.  But But wait read this.   However, don't prepay for car, I turned it in a day early and Corp. Hertz would not refund for the day. That is highway robbery!  I'll never prepay again.  Not sure after 20 years that I'll use Hertz again.

Our chicken parm sandwich was good- but service was an issue.... apparently our ticket never went to the 'back'.... after 20 minutes they figured that out, after 40 I checked back and it was sitting in the window . Issues happen- but when you know they do staff should have been on top of it.

Combo platters come with pork fried rice + egg roll + soup (egg drop or wonton) + your entree. I've only been here twice, once for kung pao and once for Gen. Tso. Kung Pao was amazing, Tso was ehhhhh. Seems like they are better at non-breaded dishes. 

Value is great though, combos run about $10.

I booked an appointment at 130 for my car for an oil change and was told hour to hour an a half and my car not touched as I returned an hour and 15 min later to be told my car was not worked on at all and that my appointment was only to get me into line for an oil change this has been by far the worst Midas I have ever been to
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Everyone needs to stop giving these Chinese rest. good reviews. People order based on your comments.  This place was one of the worst meals I have gotten from a Chinese restaurant.  My chicken and broccoli was pasty like cornstarch and water.  So bad I couldn't even eat it.  How do you mess up such a common dish.

Please do not go here. I came here for an oil change and assumed that i actually got one when it turns out they charged me for nothing and messed up my motor. Check your oil after if you do come here otherwise, please do not waste your time, go somewhere else.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Simply delicious! We ate here two days in a row and everything was fresh and tasty. I had penne with vegetable marinara  and added shrimp and my husband ordered the sampler with lasagna, fetticini Alfredo and chicken piccata... He loved his meal too! Btw, the employees are super friendly too.

I've only been in Tampa only a year and wondered  in this cozy little authentic restaurant, This place is amazing the bartenders are sexy ass hell, the food is great drinks are so good that mango tequila is amazinnggg ... my time there was awesome thank you

I keep going back to this place over and over again.  The drinks are solid and I've always had a good meal.  Sometimes it's a little crowded, loud, an crazy, but if you go at off times, it's nice and quiet.  The service is good, just a solid restaurant overall.

We have been taking our cats and dogs here for years. We have always found the vets and staff to be very kind and compassionate. Vets will always discuss options for treatment and cost with you, they have never charged us for something without doing so. Would highly recommend.

I stopped by one of my favorite places to eat when I am in Santa Barbara. I ordered my food to go and the girl taking my call confirmed the order before hanging up. When I opened my food I was sad to find that the order that I had ordered wasn't I was I received.

Came late on a weekend night. I was expecting a good meal and drinks due to what Ive seen through pics and people. When I get there, and see the menu it was so mediocre. 
The plantains were not cooked right. Waiter was nice though. 
Overall, nothing worth coming back for

I've eaten here dozens of times and the service is just god awful. They never, and I mean NEVER, give me my sauces, I always have to ask for them. And only once have they ever given me my drink, I always have to go back and ask for that too. And there are rarely any napkins.

The location definitely needs work

Good customer service and nice people working there but beware that if you go to any Midas for one repair, they'll tell you that half a dozen other repairs are necessary too.  Even for something "basic" like an oil change or fluids check.  I don't take my vehicle to any Midas anymore
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I'm not really a fast food person but I really wanted to try the new vegetarian burger, so I pulled over and order from the drive through the customer service was good I got my order really quick. The big issue is I found a Hair in my food which was so bad and I had to throw the food away.

Home spun Italian done very well. From the moment you walk in, the smells grab you. The plates are straight forward and the execution is very consistent. The red sauce is like mom made.  The gnocchi is ricotta and very light. The porchetta is some is the best (especially with the broccoli rabbe and sharp cheese.)

This location is, without question,  the worst ever.  Lots of apathy and attitude,  closing the doors early, cold lifeless fries and sub par burgers.  This place should be closed down and plowed under.  Maybe something reasonable will take its place.   Like a Five Guys....a REAL hamburger place.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Absolutely amazing! I have one very anxious dog and one that loves anyone that will pet her and both adore every staff member here! The staff is very nice and never over charge/make you pay for anything that your pets don't absolutely need. I will never go to another pet clinic and recommend this place time and time again!

This hotel was AMAZING!! Parking is my absolute only complaint. I stayed overnight and actually wish I would've stayed longer. The bed was amazing and the room was clean. The bathroom was okay, but that tub was EVERYTHING. I haven't stayed at "bad" Westin yet and this one was GREAT!! I will definitely stay here again in the future.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Do NOT rent from Enterprise at MSY. The service is so slow and terrible, once you get to the garage. You have to wait for someone to escort you to the car - additional 30-45 min of waiting! They need to get a new system, this is ridiculous!! They have had people here for over an hour waiting, about 30 people standing around.

I'd give 3.5 stars really but lunch is so cheap you cannot go wrong! Like $10 for endless shrimp and steak. I go there often too. Whenever I'm craving shrimp I def go here cus its endless. Oh and I prefer to sit at the hibachi table. The fresh rice makes a difference.

Most definitely worst service I've ever received, considering the fact that I received service from the owner himself, I expected way more. Not only haircut wise, but the way we were treated was just not the type of interaction you would expect in this kind of business where you work with people. Never will I come here again.

I cannot believe this. I am utterly appalled by the service. All of the bartenders are absolutely sloshed and getting drunker by the minute. If I had known my service would be this bad, I would have just gone to Taco Bell and asked for a Big Mac with a side of applesauce.

Went to Ambrosia for dinner and was very impressed. Staff is very attentive and kind. The burrata appetizer was delicious to start. The crispy gnocchi and tortelloni were also both amazing and had a lovely presentation. Finished it off with the creme brûlée. Highly recommend this BYO spot and  will definitely be back.

ate here on Sat night - food is good here but the service was terrible.  15 minutes to get acknowledged and then at the end it took just as long to get a check. Waiter forgot he has already given us the bill.  Kinda weird and a darn shame because the place could be great.

We ran into an issue when we arrived to pick up our reservation, however, Rebecca and the staff at this location exceeded our expectations in taking care of us. Rebecca not only made sure we got our rental but in fact made sure we got the minivan with the DVD player. Great experience on our end! Would definitely rent here again.

Update: Another rep contacted me and apologized, seemed very authentic about trying to solve the problem. Therefore one star has been added for customer service. Can't judge a whole shop based on a single employee, however the way I was treated was unbelievably inappropriate and that can't be changed.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We were in town for a 12 day work trip and didn't have time to do our own laundry. We dropped it off around noon on Saturday and they had it back to our hotel before we were even back ourselves from a night out. Great service and amazing staff. Thank you so much.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Got our miso soup halfway through our meal, I got a bone in the first bite of my salmon, the actual worst California roll I've ever had (seriously what kinda of sushi place messes up a California roll?), none of our meals came at the same time, no one out of the 8 people I went with enjoyed their food at all
Won't go back

This is a typical chain, family-style restaurant, like TGI Fridays. They have the normal assortment of burgers, chicken dishes, fish, etc. Nothing special. Food is average, ambience is average. It's good if you don't want to cook and want to bring the family to a restaurant with good variety on the menu.

Always have such a great experience! Everyone there is very professional and go out of their way to make sure you have a good experience. Sarah always does an amazing job on my hair and always recommend her. I've had a couple of ladies do my nails and they have all been great.

Placed large order over phone for pick up last night with a very nice and helpful young lady. They have the best Spanish rice but all of their food is great. Their combo meals are so large we always have dinner for next night too. Would recommend Nicos to everyone!

As always, we had a great meal.  John has added a keyboardist whose music blends well with the atomsphere.  Look for the great specials.  Frisday was "Beware the Ides of March" with special bargain prices, not only on the regular meenu BUT on his specials.  Our favorite resturant in Lansdale!

I placed an order online on July 4th. The app said they were open and charged us. The food never came b/c they were closed. When I tried to get reimbursed they said I needed to do it by the next day and wouldn't refund our money. They kept money for food they never delivered. The $30 they kept will loose our business forever.

After a day on the beach, found this gem on Yelp and we were NOT disappointed! The salsa and warm chips to start...made even better by the fresh guacamole which was incredible! The flautas were perfectly crispy and even the picky teenager was thrilled with her tacos. Don't forget to top it off with the churros--so yum!

Standard Chinese food delivery. However, the driver was extremely rude. He criticized me for making him go to far, even though the order was placed through grubhub and accepted by the restaurant. Overall the food wasn't good enough to justify putting up with rude service.

I have bought my glasses from Singer Specs for many years and have never had a bad experience.  It is usually crowded when I go in but never wait that long.  The people there have been nothing but helpful.  Maybe when people don't have good experiences, it is them and not the business.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This bank sucks, it's 1130 on Friday 15 people standing in line and 1 teller. while several employees sit around talking their asses off  while standing in plain view  of the customers . They don't stay open on Saturday past 1130 when the door say 1 pm and horrible customer service

We really like Subways and this one would be rated higher but every time we have been in there the employee is a cold jerk.   He could care less about customers and it shows.   Don't know his name but he's been there a long time. If we didn't like Subway so much, we wouldn't go back.

Juni has been my barber for about 8-9 years. He is absolutely the best barber I've been too and I will continue to go. The atmosphere is very laid back and he listens to what you want then gets it done. There is a reason why he is so booked and doesn't take walk ins very often.

I was really looking forward to our meal, reading the reviews. In the end we were both disappointed by the dishes. The short ribs were tough and way too fatty. The tuna takaki was surprisingly tasteless. The TNT roll was over sauced, it was hard to taste anything else. I did enjoy the pressed salmon. Yum.  Service was 5 stars.

If you're searching for a diamond in the rough, this is the spot.  A wide array of selections, family-owned, and large portions.  I can't compare the flavors to any other Mexican restaurant because it's so unique.  The servers are very pleasant and the food was absolutely delicious.  Do yourself a favor and try this place.

Very friendly. I stopped at 8:30pm for a take out while I was in the area and this place was busy for rating of 3 stars on Yelp. I got Szechuan style and it was not spicy but rather a little sweet. I think I should've specified I wanted it to be hot. The stir fry veggies were all fresh,  I liked that. Great lunch specials too!

Were speaking Italian in the kitchen, but wasn't that great.

Owner wasn't too stoked when we asked about the 2 for 1 deal during Eat Cheap Week, but he still gave it to us which was cool.

$4 for a bottle of Modelo though was a huge bummer. Would've given it 3 stars if the beers were $2.50

I might never go back to Sabrina's for brunch again.

The pizza rolls are to die for. The lettuce-wrap kale tacos were shockingly good. I felt like maybe they were eager for us to finish up so our table was free, but that's just part of brunch these days, I guess right?

We ate their family of three on a Tuesday night. They had four pizzas that were hard and old plus pasta was just spaghetti that look like it had been sitting there all day staff was extremely friendly but food was lacking!!
Would not eat there again in new Palestine

Had high expectations and was a bit disappointed by the food. Average food. The grilled fish was ok but not too flavorful. My seafood risotto was tasty enough but not memorable. We didn't try dessert. There are many other Italian restaurants a few blocks down.

I go here often and everytime I order online something is always messed up, I put in big bold letter that I'm allergic to shellfish and they still put krab on top of my mt fuji, I ask for yum yum sauce and they forget seven times, this has been ridiculous.. I thought y'all were better than this...

This restaurant was recommended by our Airbnb. It's a little Italian restaurant that was busy, but they were able to fit us in at the Chef's Counter. The food was amazing, fresh and full of flavor. We had fun watching the kitchen activity. I would highly recommend.

The lady who served us was so welcoming and kind. My daughters both commented several times saying wow the lady is so nice. Amazing customer service. The food was good but nothing exceptional as I've had much better sushi in NYC but the service was outstanding and deserves 5 stars.

NAILED IT!!!! We got a square pepperoni Sicilian and a chicken bacon ranch.  The chicken bacon ranch was great but the Sicilian was out of this world.   Me and my wife both agreeing on food is tough and we both thought it was amazing.  Best pizza we have had in a long time.    Highly recommend the Sicilian.  Thank you!

Went here at 1030pm. they dont close until 2am. got put on hold at the drive thru mic, had to try a few times to get them back. got a #2, stale bun, cold burger. fries were soggy and cold. You guys are giving Wendys a bad name geez man. If you are open for 3 more hours, how bout keep the place running.

Went for a dinner tonight with three friends.  Staff and Chef were very rude. We thought it was BYOB, honest mistake.  The worker said " should have looked it up" in a very rude tone.   We wouldn't mind paying for wine, but could not accept the treatment.    Do not recommend!

DO NOT GO TO THE DELI
The lady literally put chicken fat on my sandwich because they ran out of turkey. Did not put down a sheet while making sandwich and counter was disgusting. Lettuce she used was brown and limp. Definitely not like the Safeway back home. Will not return

Very clean and well kept, but useless machines and uncomfortable incline/flat benches. I'm not overly picky about my gyms, but golds had almost zero useful upper body machines and their dumbbell grips are meh. Also lack of squat racks and benches. Didn't ask for pricing, just moved onto the next gym.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Love this place! Their chips and salsa among the best I have ver had. The prices are great and the staff are really friendly. I prefer this location to the one in Cool Springs. I've never tried the original location in downtown Franklin, but I hear very good things!

Restaurant and ambiance are nice and the service okay, but the food is not as good as we had hoped. The Pollo Quattro Formaggio was bland and the chicken over cooked. The Gnocchi Sorrentina was tough in texture and the sauce was just okay. Unfortunately, we will not return.

My car got egged on the windshield, and went though 3 times and it still was stuck. employees Joe, Skylor and Manager Will all helped try and get it off with many products and a razor. They really went above and  beyond to help  get this off my windshield and  wouldn't  give up! Great location and an awesome staff

My hubby and I were in the mood for Japanese food and decided to try this place. The sushi was excellent! I had the yellowtail and my husband had the California roll which he really enjoyed. He also ordered a noodle bowl that was ok. I wasn't crazy about it.
The restaurant was very clean and the service was amazing.

Good food   Italian and specialty items included
Drinks are on point too not cheap either 
But good cocktails and red wine 
And I'm comparing this review  to other  cities
 not just local competitors 
Price is average on food but good service and a nice place

Nice, clean, friendly environment. Just moved here from Oregon and trying to find a new place after 3 years of one I loved has been a challenge. But Diamond Nails has solved that problem for me and I will definitely be going back. They're creative and listen to what you want. I HIGHLY recommend!!

The elderly gentleman who took our order was extremely rude, loud and obnoxious.  Talks to customer like they are idiots.  One of the worst encounters I've ever had in my life.  Food is mediocre at best and the dining room tables were all dirty.  Chili was room temp and disgusting.  I will never go back!

This is a nice setup and a fun place to drink and hangout. The food is nothing to write home about and our server did a good enough job despite being pulled away by pool side drinks on a Monday afternoon. Also there was a leaf blower operating for a good 20 min of our stay for lunch.

Unfortunately, I went against my gut and decided to get my car wash here. I purchased the the car wash just below the ultimate car wash option. After parking at the mall, I noticed that the car looked as if the front end wasn't washed and the inside widows weren't cleaned.

Man what an oxymoron Fresh market having a special on spoiled crab cakes two for twelve dollars one bite into the garbage. I'll never set foot in that store again. The prepared foods are completely under seasoned and over priced. Spent $20 there should have just thrown the twenty directly into the trash can disgusting

Only thing good about it location.   Asked attendant if tvs good be changed to cbs to watch game during run, and was told didn't know how or if they got that channel.  

If you want to workout circa 1995 this gym is for you.  They haven't updated equipment since then either.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Worst dry cleaning place. Brought in a comforter to get a few stains/dirty spots out and got it back worse than it was before. The entire comforter was tinted yellow and the previous stains were now set and not one had looked to get even a little better. It would have been better to do it ourselves in the washer.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Some of the best Mexican food I've had in a long time. Way better than a lot of chain restaurants. I went to try the food for the first time today with the idea that I would bring friends back for the BYOT(equila) if the food was good. I guarantee we will be there for Margaritas in the near future.

Great location and decent frozen yogurt. However, their policy of not allowing you to make your own yogurt sample is different than the yogurt shop down the street.  So, we usually chose the other yogurt shop. Also, the staff could be friendlier and more welcoming.

Paid $20 For A Shrimp And Oyster Po Boy With Onion Rings And It Was Horrible! I Only Had Two Shrimp And Three Oysters In It And Most Of It Was Bread! Waste Of My Money And I Def Wont Be Back. Wait 20 Minutes And Wasted 20 Bucks For A Po Boy That Wasnt Overstuffed Like They Advertised!

Somewhat flavorless Sicilian style pizza...disappointing as I had heard very good things. The crust tasted like it had been frozen, and the sauce had no other flavor than pure bland tomato paste. My hopes were high that the Chocolate Cake ordered for dessert would save the meal, alas, not to be...also flavorless.

My boyfriends general gso's chicken has now been overcooked three separate times which has been disappointing. However, my sushi and chicken fried rice is always great. This is still our go to spot for fast and cheap Asian cuisine. I just think he will order something else from now on.

The front desk person was just rude ! I would not waste my money here. Even had the front desk guy v all me a liar.  We had friends stay in our room while we went shopping ( they stayed 1 night in the next room) he said it was a fire hazard to have more then 4 ppl. At the time there was 5 ppl.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: STAY AWAY!!!! I bought the coupon on groupon. Like most things on groupon, it was no deal at all. I ended up spending close to $250 on a pair of glasses I didn't want, but was the only thing in my price range. It's been 3 1/2 weeks and still no glasses!!! I found Lou incredibly arrogant
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Larry, Terry, Ed & the entire team here area fantastic.  Not only have they taken great care of our cars that are 8 & 10 years old, they always manage to squeeze us in for an appointment no matter how late we call.  They go above and beyond and keep our cars tip top!  We're so lucky to have found this Meineke!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: As always, the food was delicious, and timely served.  One warning, don't laugh too loud, or the wait staff will ask you to keep it down!! I've never been to a restaurant where they ask you to "keep it down", when your table is laughing.  For a BYO, one of the better Sushi restaurants, from a food quality standpoint.

We loved it.   We have been there twice and both times it was excellent.   Both times we went just before the normal dinner hours and were seated right away.   The service was excellent and the food GREAT.       It is a great addition to the restaurant scene and Fairmount.

Their Uber Eats is always spot on!! Always correctly made and hits the spot, most reliable Uber Eats restaurant in my area. Have been there a few times for their happy hour and always have incredibly fast service. Last time in particular my server Brittany was so helpful with my friends questions and very attentive.

Started with the agnaloti, delicately flavored and slightly citrusy, the pasta was perfectly cooked. Moving on to the trumpet mushrooms- although meaty and packed with a strong earthy flavor, the portions were too small. The steak was excellent, medium, with crisp potatoes - light and airy on the inside.

I've been there 2 separate times -once at 9:30pm and another at 10:15pm - and NOBODY was ever at the drive thru! Hours are until 11pm as far as I can find. One time I waited 5 minutes, said "hello?" a few times and nothing. Not sure what's up but definitely crappy service...if you're busy just let the customers know.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Typical Reno trying to copy Portland and be 'hip and cool' but falling short. Doughnuts are meh, I can see how if people haven't been to the real deal are impressed but the places they're imitating do it a hundred times better. 


I'll probably go back again because I'm a local, old school Reno degenerate  ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

You really don't want to take your pet here! 

The cold hearted all woman
staff quoted me $40 for office visit over the phone, but after theirso-called "exam" I was charged $114 "for tests" even though no tests
were performed..  The examing vet was snotty, cold and very, very brief..

Denise was a warm, personable leasing agent. Despite the suddenly bad weather, she was accommodating and flexible. She braved the elements to take us around the community and show us the complex. Patient, funny, kind and understanding. Because of the weather it was difficult to compare to other complexes, but Denise was GREAT

Excellent menu, entrees, salads, desserts and service. Blush & Marinara sauces are great.  Pizza from the wood fired oven is The Best texture and flavor. Clam Bake Special in the summer is outstanding! Take out, delivery and dine in. A dining experience you will enjoy.

I had heard good things about Econo Auto Center so i decided to check it out after we were not happy with the dealer anymore. Rudy was able to find a belt that was broken and needed fixing, something i was worried about and the dealer couldn't find. 

They are really honest and give a fair price, I highly recommend them!

So disappointing! They put so much emphasis on the fact that they cook their pizzas in a coal fired oven...it would have been better if they put more thought into what goes on the pizza. The thimble of sauce on the pizza was incredibly bland. Will never go here again.

The owner, Zach, shows that he cares very much about customers and his restaurant. The Greek & spinach salads are simple & delicious. The pizza is up there with the best I've ever had, with light crust & fresh ingredients. Fantastic experience, highly recommend!

Philadelphia vision center always provides great service with a smile.  I was out of town and needed my prescription faxed for an emergency fix. Bruce and co. took care of the issue pronto. You can trust PVC will ensure your glasses are correct and to your satisfaction.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The service was horrible, the food took forever to come to our table, the food wasn't anything to write home about, they tried to tack on a 40% tip because there was 8 of us after the horrible service and only came around to refill our drinks once. I'll never go there again!

Honest, quick service. Had oil change, engine flush,  4 wheel alignment for $120 bucks! I will definitely be back. Hopefully this Sears doesn't close. As a newcomer to Tucson, I think I've found my place to have my car serviced. They also back their alignments for 6 months, can't find that anywhere else!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Gotta say this little place impressed us! We will definitely come back here. I got fajitas (best I have had yet) my kids got the nachos and my husband got enchiladas. Everything was perfect and service was great too! Oh yeah and the churros where delicious 5 STARS Thank you

This place was very okay. Staff was noticeably friendly and polite. Walked in, ordered and waited just 10 mins for my takeout. My order was correct. Food was okay, nothing overly impressive. Good place if you're looking for cheap, fast, basic Chinese takeout.

We were not impressed. The appetizers we had were very underwhelming...the mussels on a soggy toast and the bread(which was served cold). The drinks were very small. We ordered the pizzas and they were okay. You're better off going to a real pizza joint! Stay away! Overpriced and Underwhelming

Both my husband and myself rented cars at enterprise recently. I was pleased with the
customer service i received at this location. The employee that helped me was very pleasant and efficient. My husband would like the gas tank to be full when renting a car. That is the only thing that annoyed him.

How can a restaurant selling sushi not have wasabi, napkins or plum wine. They sell special rolls that aren't even grocery store level quality and charge 15.00 each. I also noticed the place is dirty. That's a bad sign for food safety too. Bad idea we came here.

This DD is terrible. The employees are racist and and they got my order order, wanted a cinnamon bagel with cream cheese and 2 bacon egg and cheese . Bitch gave me one bacon egg and cheese and a cinnamon bagel with bacon egg and cheese inside. ??? And they didn't even give a receipt. Lol wtf are they fucking serious.

I ordered tequila shots and without asking me gave me Patron and charged $9 per shot and was also charged for two extra drinks I hadn't ordered and when trying to get the issue resolved, they threatened to call the police! I will never visit this establishment again.

Food is good and worth the $. FYI- if u get takeout and they tell u 20 minutes it's closer to an hour. Also, always check your takeout order because they always forget an item. When u dine in expect chaos because the restaurant is too small and the staff overwhelmes the space.

sooooo, after talking to my insurance company, because advantage was accusing me and my husband of stealing their rent a car, hanging up on us and treating us horrible, we called Tampa PD AND Thank God they helped our situation, I would never use advantage again.

Great food and beautiful place but be very careful getting to and from your car or walking around here when it's dark. My husband and I walked a half block to our car after dinner, saw a woman get assaulted, and when my husband tried to help, the attackers pointed a gun at him.  Not exactly what we had in mind for date night.

They did everything they should have plus more.  The service was both freindly and informative.  I love teh fact that Bill didn't ask me the same quetions i answered when i first stopped by (i was shopping around for teh best price and serice).  The extra was that they provided recommendations.  Great job
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Arsenio, the branch manager has no business being in the position. Today I had the worst experience at Enterprise. Arsenio has no customer service skills and it is very disappointing that Enterprise has some like him representing them. Arsenio never took the time to listen to my concerns and try to resolve my issue.

Cold store-bought bread, boxed pasta, canned mushrooms, skunky shrimp.  My boyfriend had the yellowfin tuna which was cooked until solid gray and chewy.  I typically refrain from writing bad reviews, but we spent over $100 and completely wasted one of three dinners while visiting Philly.

We ate here after a movie (Summit theater right next door)....the food was delicious! The service was fantastic, she was so helpful with showing my husband how to eat with chopsticks....first time for him in a sushi bar! We both lived it! We live in Sparks, but it was worth the drive!

Small and empty...their were only 4 other tables being used the whole time we were there. Good luck in picking out the food because there is no labels to let you know what it was. The sweet nd sour chicken was good. Everything else looked like it was sitting out to long.

Ask for Laurel. I had some time during a recent trip to the area and looked for a safe and good place to fix my broken nails. The service was prompt and professional. The only thing keeping this from being five stars was the lack of OPI colors. I will bring my own Polish next time as the manicure was spot on!

Close proximity to French Quarters and shops on Canal Street.  Not too crazy busy. Hosts are kind and helpful.  Only issue we had was that it was very noisy facing St Charles Street and the water running throughout hotel  pipes are loud.  Otherwise great hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We waited almost two hours for cold delivery pizza. When I called after an hour and a half to get an update on my order, the woman who answered the phone was extremely rude and hung up on me.  My family and I drove in from Dallas looking forward to trying some local spots. What a disappointment.

First the good - the hotel staff were great!  I had sweet conversations with several staffers.
The Bad: The rooms are pretty pricey for the size you get. The bathroom and bedroom was very small.
Also, whenever the people in the room above me took a shower, water would leak down the walls of the bathroom I was in.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My wife and I got some food to go here and the Brussels are amazing! However do not order a pizza to go from here. You pay $13-$18 dollars for them to throw the pizza in a tiny container and make it all stick together. Love this place as a bar but will not be going back for the food. Overall very disappointed in our experience.

Do not use this company if you want to keep your clothes. I took in 9 nine dress shirts and picked up 9 dress shirts. The only problem being that one of my shirts had been replaced with permanently stained shirt. They do not have a system that records the general description of the  clothing you bring in. Very unorganized.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: This is by far my favorite place to go for groceries!! It is open 24 hours,very clean, and the staff is very nice!! I come here every Saturday morning! Only slight issue I have is the lines can sometimes get too long, not enough cashiers. A small infraction for a place so great!!!

I wouldn't even give this place one star! It is AWFUL! There are cockroaches, mice, and rat traps outside the apartment. The property manager never answers you so if you need something, you won't get it. It's old and was FILTHY when I moved in. It's pretty gross so do yourself a favor and DO NOT move in here!!

I really like this place. It's always kinda quite when I go in. It's kinda hidden but what a great find. I stumbled upon it one afternoon and went out for a beer and sushi with a friend. Nice environment. Server was pleasant and the food was GREAT!! I will definately go back!!

Stopped by on a whim while waiting for an appointment and had a coffee flavored oreo ice cream. It was amazing!  The sales lady was super friendly and professional, which on a busy Saturday can be a rare thing. Would definitely make this a more regular habit because of the good customer service.

Great spot to catch live band. In this particular night, a local favorite: Sarah Green and the Sound Machine.  It couldn't be better. Live, soulful, dancing and drinking. Looks exactly like what it is: a Lounge/Live Bar. Local
Drinks were strong. Margaritas were delicious. Good spot to spot in, catch and band and fly.

Great ambiance with a family feel. Went there and was surprised they don't sell wine, but told us where we could get some nearby. The food was flavorful and fresh. After dinner we were given some lemoncello which was fantastic. I will definitely plan to eat there when I visit again.

Received two mocha frappes that tasted like something was bad in them today. Called to complain but was hung up on. Rude customer service today. Some of the workers are nice here I have to comment. But the food is not consistent and some people in the office were rude.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: So I've always passed by Dunkin Donuts but never stopped. I'm glad I did. Their Strawberry Mango is pretty good. Donuts are great. Service is a bit slow. Some staffing issues as I overheard them while sitting at the window as the lady rolled her eyes in every direction. Other than that good is great.

I have lived in River House for almost 4 months now, and this place is super nice. The staff is wonderful and the rooms are surprisingly spacious given their square footage. The amenities are great and all the residents have been very pleasant. I have and will continue to recommend others to live here.

I recommend this restaurant for sushi lovers and those who love good food with an Asian flare-we went with a group of 9-5 ordered sushi-all loved it-the other 4 people ordered teriyaki combo, teriyaki chicken, steak and chicken tempura......they all loved their entrées too.  Sushi was great-excellent presentation and very fresh!

The joe morales tacos are pretty good. Usually have to ask for extra sour cream. The chips and salsa was pretty good. You get beans and rice with this dish. The service is pretty fast. You get ground beef, lettuce and a white cheese. I mixed the salsa into the shell. Meat was a little dry. Drinks are served in a big cup.

Location can be sketchy at night. Parking is tough even if you valet. The rooms are oversized which is nice. Hotel is nice. Staff is very friendly. Carpet in our room was torn as if an animal had chewed it?Seemed a little rough. Food and drinks in the evening is nice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Tubby Robot is now my favorite ice cream store. My recommendation is honey lavender combined with Mexican chocolate. The spicy kick of Mexican chocolate would be mellowed by the rich honey flavor of Lavendar. The two scoops in a cup would be almost too big to be shared with 2 people. Great deal and wonderful favors.

This is my go to spot for a sweet treat. I convince myself it's on the healthier side, but really there's nothing healthy that can taste this great. The Oreotella is SO.GOOD. Pro tip- mix it with a scoop of peppermint or coconut. Friendly owners and staff who always have a treat for the pups in the car.

Horrible Horrible Customer Service!!!!
Tried to overcharge 
Being mean and rude when I nicely asked for refund, sales person Said with big irritation "Here is your refund, but never ever come back here"
What??????
When i asked for a manager he suddenly Disappeared!!!!!

We came for dinner 6/6/18 and waited an hour to get a drink and then another 20 minutes for dinner which was horrible. Shreds of chicken smothered in onions, tasteless. Waitress never made eye contact, acted like we were not there. Very, very disappointed.

Cool old hotel, enjoyed the ambience and location.  But, bathroom was very small, water temp and pressure fluctuated and our room was noisy. If you are picky, you might not enjoy it. But if you are tired of the standard hotel experience, you should try it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My husband went to pick up an order and had to wait longer than expected. When it was finally ready, he went to pay for the pizza and saw it was the wrong size. The cashier threw in another pizza (large deluxe) free of charge for the inconvenience. Nice guys, THANK YOU! You know how to treat your customers!

This location isn't busy AT ALL whenever we go, and they ALWAYS forget something we order!! And when you pull up the the window to pay, they're just laughing and carrying on. Arby's (over all) has decent food for the price, but this location isn't worth the hassle! Save your money and your time!

Friendly employees but ill-managed store. Happy hour is usually pretty busy but there were only 3 employees. There was only one guy making all the drinks. Even worse, the poor guy had to deal with rude customers who couldn't even wait 10 minutes for their frappucinos. Needs more employees.

I would not recommend this place.  I was there today and two of the loads I washed did not spin to withdraw the water.  When the wash was done, there was still a ton of water on the clothes!  I guess they get more money for drying because of this.  I will not go back here again,
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Not bad, but definitely NOT good.  If you're hungry and this is the closest option, it works, but if you're willing to drive a little extra, its worth the drive...Cali burrito was 8.16 after tax...with no chips??? and limited salsa.  Step your game up zarape, Rudy's will continue to get me business everytime

What a wonderful find.  In south jersey visiting and found this place on Yelp and tried it. So glad we did. The food, drinks and service were spectacular. We are north jersey restaurant snobs and this was a find. If you are ever in the area this is a must.

Ordered 2 Deep dish Chicago pizzas a week in advance. Called the morning of the pickup date and confirmed. Pizzas were NOT even started at the pickup tiime. They delivered them to our house over an hour after we needed them. Very little toppings and very sloppy.

Looks like they just opened and I have to say I'm glad they're here. The place looks great the folks are very friendly. Good selection so far I've had two different pizzas. The red ultimate and white invernale . Both outstanding! I really enjoy the thin crust squares. Looking forward to working my way through the menu.

Service was terrible.  Food was worse.   Honestly I can't believe this place is still open.   We drove out of our way to come to the original.     
Confusion with the staff.  Order was incomplete and once they brought us the extra tacos we ordered they said they weren't going to charge us for the taco.   
Taco Bell is better

Meh,  I expected alot more from this place the gauc was good everything else was so so. The menu is very limited I also didnt like the fact they said we couldnt sit where we were but a few seconds later someone sits there and it's ok. $15 bucks for nachos arent that good nope wont fo back here

They have a great selection of glasses that you can't find elsewhere.  However, the service was lax.  Roamed around the store for 10 minutes without anyone asking to help me.  Once, I finally asked for help, the woman was actually good and attentive.  But, for $600 glasses, I would expect better service.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Over priced, small portions, and food is not fresh. If you compare this place to other similar restaurants it fails one numerous levels. I have never seen a filet come out and look like it was ripped away from a hungry dog before it was cooked for a guest. 

Just not worth the money. Won't be back.

Gross. Will not go back here. Taco salad with burnt tortilla chips on a bed of shredded sub lettuce. Burnt mozzarella sticks and to top it off wings it's BBQ sauce just dumped on them.  Come on man.  We were the only people in there. How can you mess this stuff up.

I had a 1:00 appointment and my pedicure didn't start till 1:40. My nails still haven't dried eleven hours later. They still are sticky to the touch and have bubbles in the polish. Not the best experience. Try somewhere else. Walmart's even better than this place.

Masks are required inside the building.  Out doors the manager said he didn't need a mask because he wasn't around people.  The workers outside didn't have masks on.  They can't wipe down the interior of the car " because of the virus".  Exterior wash is very good.

We have eaten twice at Zasu. We tried different dishes each time and they were all delicious and perfectly crafted. Some favs were the octopus appetizer, hearts of palm salad, the grouper entree and the perogies.  The vibe is also really nice and friendly. Looking forward to returning again!

Try to avoid this place. The labels on the ice cream flavors were all wrong. You had to ask what flavor each bin of ice cream was. They also were out of many things including waffle cones, mangonadas, and spoons. How can you be an ice cream place and not have spoons.

I went into Waterside Grille and sat outside with my girlfriend and had a nice glass of wine and apps. It was so peaceful and our server Justin was more than hospitable. We will definitely be back to stay here and would definitely love for Justin to serve us again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Bobby Pin Hair Gallery is such an awesome and unique salon!  Daniel is supremely talented and creative; a true artist behind the chair.  His haircuts are always the bomb.  I have also referred a few girlfriends to Jessi for color.  Her balayage is amazingly beautiful and grows out so elegantly.  Highly recommend this hidden gem.

Excellent service and a fabulous selection of eyewear.  I have been a customer for over ten years and have consistently been impressed by the staff and by the selection.  Dr T Adlington is friendly and thorough.  Dillon is super talented and always helps me find just the right look.  The entire staff is professional and friendly.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Cole's Kitchen opened only a couple of weeks ago, but I have been there 4 times.  The restaurant has a whole new vibe from Curt's last restaurant, but you will find reasonable prices and fabulous food.  You must try the mushroom mozzarella puff.  It is listed under sides, but I prefer it as an appetizer!

This place employs the most unfriendly, unhelpful, and rudest staff.  They only care about one thing and that's taking your money, even when you have already paid.  They just take and take.  Avoid this place!  Customer retention is clearly not a value on this planet.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: After the delivery and the review they immediately called us and offered us a free meal for compensation. Thank you so much for everything. They always help and always want to help their customers. The food has always been amazing and the staff has always been kind.

Fastest starbucks I've ever been to and I have definitely been to more Starbucks than I care to admit.  Seven of us rolling through the drive thru, everyone ordered and they not only got everyone's order correct, it was all ready when we got to the window!!  We were super impressed!!  Enjoy!!

Nice server, good pulled chicken & pork, but the nachos were without any cheese whatsoever -- no exaggeration. (& only a couple of literal drips of sour cream, couple slices of black olives). When we think of nachos, we crave cheese, we'll, it's not there at all! We were sad. Would say the servings were a little light for price.

My roommate and I have picked up from here probably 6 times and have only been in Nashville for under a month. We always get the nabeyaki udon that's always hot, plenty of veggies, and absolutely delicious. Sometimes the wait can be a little long, so order sooner rather than later but it's definitely worth it.

German Auto in Boulder did great work on my car while we were living in CO. After learning the hard way, I only trust German mechanics with my VW, and they did not disappoint. They performed an oil change and installed new struts. Got me in on relatively short notice and we're super friendly, as well! Highly recommend.

The food is always spot-on, but I feel like the servers have been kinda unwelcoming the last couple times I've been here! I don't really care because I'm mostly in it for the food anyway, and I understand it's really hard times for the service industry, and every other industry, right now.

From the man at the bar wearing a bud light t-shirt to the light bulbs out to the obnoxiously loud groups that have wondered in here after work, the atmosphere is definitely lacking.  The food was alright, but over priced given that we equated it to a metropolitan Denny's.  We wouldn't recommend it.

terrible！I can't imagine a restaurant can be like this. I ordered food with less salt and it came out just taste like a can of salt. And the service is rude. They refuse to commit they did wrong and rude at me. It is clear to see salt on the beef slice. Will never go there again.!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Bartenders are dicks, security bunch of dicks, patrons bunch of dicks. This place used to rock my socks wtf happened? You guys are fucking up thanks for ruining a great bar, keep up the good work. 1up was great before you guys decided to give it to the hipsters.

Well, can't find an owner to get my money back! $5.00 and the only thing that worked in Bay 1 was the foaming brush. The water simply poured from the connection on the ceiling whenever you tried to wash or rinse. It's NEVER been a good wash, taking money or spewing dirty water, but this was pathetic. NEVER AGAIN!

Slow service. Bad diarrhea after eating. Tasty food. Although the experience is horrible, at least the food has decent taste. Big portions, medium quality, poor service. Wouldn't mind going back, but that means I'd have to hit the toilet again. Choices need to be made
