Cute little place that we enjoyed. But, as someone with celiacs, it's awful when a waiter tells you that there isn't a single thing on the menu you can eat. It's so easy for an Italian restaurant to offer gluten free pasta. Or at least be prepared to discuss meat options.

drive thru often gets orders wrong even though they appear correct on the price display.  last week they totally forgot one item and this week I paid for an upgrade I did not get,  always double check items (open the wrapper and check) as well as sampling the beverage,
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This store seems to be open and closed at random even though it posts store service until 10:00 PM and 24 hour drive thru.  Would appear attracting and retaining quality help is an issue.  If they skimp on hiring; what other corners are they cutting?  Good coffee when you can get it.

Worst customer service ever. Ordered certain nachos because the description did not say the had cheese on them and the others did. The nachos came out with cheese and they tried arguing with us about what we ordered. Did not come back by at all until the end when they brought us the check.

Horrible experience. I just spent $18 on an order of iced oat milk (after being told that a hot one would cost $3 extra to "build"), the wrong flavor cake pop, a pretty good kiwi tea and a caramel crunch frap without crunch because they were out of it. Worst Starbucks experience ever.

Worst place in town.  Order on the app, show up at 930.  Closed.  They just shut down at any random hours.  When they are "open", expect 5o wait a min of 30 minutes if there's 2 or more cars in the drive through.  Oh yeah, they shut down walk in for over a year.  Update your hours people.  Stop wasting everybody's time.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I've had my hair cut by all three of the guys at Sulimay's at this point, all do a great job.  I've never had to wait too long, but when there is a wait, their waiting area is very comfortable and homey.  I haven't gone anywhere else for a haircut since I started going here.

I'd never have ordered an artichoke and truffle oil slice but the owner comped me! It worked. I'm your newest customer. Located half way between where I work and live, Slice could quickly become my downfall.

An aside: Owner is easy on the eyes making this place even more difficult to resist.

Disappointed. Very bland food. The service was good, but food wasn't. Order steak tacos, takes a lot to make a steak taste like nothing, and shrimp taco taste like it was rubber. Wish it was better, from out of town and was hoping it was good. 
Truly disappointed

Today was my first visit at Gloss Nail Studio, and it won't be my last! Christian did a perfect job on my nails! She was so nice and friendly  The shop is beautifully decorated and very clean. I'm so happy I found this nail studio. If you're looking for a great place to have your nails done,look no further, this is the place!

Just went there and no one was there to offer service at the drive thru. Mind you they close in 40 minutes and several cars were waiting for service. We left and went to Wendy's right across from them seeing that they care about closing at the appropriate time they are scheduled to close.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Just went to the drive thru... took them 3 minutes to acknowledge us, then waited another 5 minutes for them to come to the window. There was nobody in sight, so we drove off. Don't really know who's running this place, but they need to get a handle on it. Sadly I can't give it less than 1 star.

We had burgers & fries for lunch today at the Lake House. If you are looking for a great burger & fries it's 
above average. If ambience is not
important, this is a must try. The
customer service was excellent. 
We will be back to try other things
on the menu. Yay! I'm a fan.

4.5 stars
Extra care is taking in Their flavors. Not your ordinary salsa, beans, or rice. I had the Caesar salad with shrimp, the salad was with Romain and it was very fresh. Definitely recommend. The food is much better than perhaps your first impression of the exterior.  The wait staff was great!

Ordered two pies- one medium and one small.  Pizza was "ok."  Dressing at salad bar was limited and watery.  Not worth the money- $65 for two pizzas (lacked  flavor), 3 salad bars, and three sodas.  

I spend the same amount at Grimaldi's and their food has flavor and is worth the money.

Franchisee Filed chapter 7 not good considering that means selling off assets versus repayment plan. 
For those of us that have paid for a service not rendered is never a good thing. Unfortunately the nearest anytime fitness isn't rather far 

Planet fitness perhaps
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Every time I order from this place my order is wrong and today it was wrong and Burnt. I will not be going back. My bagel was burnt and had the wrong cream cheese my hash browns were like hockey pucks. I spent a good amount of money just to be served food I couldnt eat.

We got a balcony room so I knew there would be noise to deal with. Unfortunately we were also put in a room right next to the gym. I was rudely awoken before 8 am when the headboard started vibrating due to the machines next door. Do not stay on the second floor if you can help it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Used to love ordering from here... now this place gets our order correctly 1 time out of 3 if we are lucky.  Food and general product quality is not the same.. ordered a pepperoni stromboli that came with ham instead.  Highly disappointed for the last time.

Hotel staff incompetent. Had an emergency needed to change the reservation to Monday from Saturday they wouldn't accommodate without forfeiture of money. Four Seasons always makes an accommodation. I will never consider this chain again. If you're looking for a five star hotel this is definitely a no go.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I stayed here passing through with my family and have to say it was not bad. It needs a bit of an upgrade and a little work, but for the value. The rooms are small but adequate and clean and the breakfast was very good. The staff was very helpful and it is directly off the highway and close to Route 95.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I stayed at the Fairfield on business for the last two weeks. It is a nice clean and safe hotel. Only real complaint is the lack of a workout room. They have a deal with a near by gym but i don't want to get in a car if i'm in the mood to work out in the morning.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Very nice, updated Courtyard. I was only here overnight before my flight in the morning but the room was clean, and perfect. Check in was quick. Location is right off I-70 so there was a little interstate noise in the room but not so much i couldn't sleep. Price was right at only $89 for the night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Service was really good, and thought the atmosphere was nice.

But the all you can eat sushi sucked, minus the vegas rolls. It tasted like sushi you get in a box at a grocery store. It may just be because it was lunch but I have had better sushi at Sunflower market.

Clean rooms and professional staff; that's pretty much all I need. This is a standard offering for Doubletree and it suited our needs perfectly.
- Free wifi when checked-in
- Warm cookies upon arrival
- Lots of free parking
- Vending machines on all floors
- Roll-away cots available (but not in 2 queen bed rooms)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The mozzarella cheese on our salmon appetizer was overcooked and over powered the fish. The gnocchi I ordered were so overcooked that they were mushy. The puttanesca my friend ordered was good but could have used some more flavor. For the price we could have spent our money better elsewhere in the city I am sure.

I went to several bars on a recent trip to NOLA, but The Abbey was my favorite of them all. A dingy dive bar with cheap drinks and a great jukebox, it's the coolest spot in the French Quarter. My biggest regret is that I only went there once, but I'll definitely be back.

Oh, and it's open 24 hours. I miss New Orleans.

I have spent a total of four nights here.  The hotel is not perfect, but the renovations are not done yet either. The beds are very comfortable. My rooms all had large flat screen TVs. The baths are huge and clean.  Everything I saw was freshly painted.  My only complaint would be for the weekend rate.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My band's van broke down and we were stranded in Boise. BUT RUDYs SAVED US!!! the owner bill went out of his way to stay late and help us and not only that WAS COMPLETELY HONEST AND AFFORDABLE. what a rare treat in a horrible situation. Go to RUDYs the cowabunga babes promise a good deal.

A good place to watch the game(s): Flat screen TVS at every possible viewing angle, baskets of peanuts everywhere, fun sports bar vibe.

But the food is pretty dissapointing -- the mac & cheese and chili both tasted very school cafeteria-esque -- and, frankly, the service sucked.

This is one of the nicest hotels I have had the pleasure of staying at. From the cookies at the front desk, the the immaculate, nicely appointed suites, I had a wonderful night here. The pool and hot tub added to the niceness. I will only stay here from now on, when traveling to the area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I thought this place was pretty neat.  They have special events from time to time, so that would definitely be worth checking out.

Each floor boasts a different theme...I think my favorite was the first floor, which has a sporty theme but, more importantly, a pretty neat seating area overlooking the river.

not that bad, average but expensive. I had a pedicure and gel mani and the total was $57. my nails are smooth and even. they accept credit cards and are located in the mall which is conveniently (for me) connected to the Embassy Suites. last walk in accepted at 8:30.

Another good job by Alamo in the renting me a car department.  I got an apparent free upgrade to a mid size and had the car for six days for only $215. (thanks Hotwire)  The people are friendly and helpful and the car was really nice and brand new.  Leather interior?  Yes please.

Our old neighborhood bar back 10 years ago , college, post college. I know the crowd got younger and I got older  but still a great place to drink.  The best was rolling in right after after  snowboarding and the bartenders were all our friends who hooked us up.  
Mind erasers and a beer.... code word... 2 and 2

Check your orders on drive thru! This place shorted me on munchkins. C'mon, really? 

They also only seem to sell 2 or 3 varieties of munchkins at a time on Dunkin menu. Also don't go here on game days as their ice coffee tastes diluted. I'd rather pay the full price and get good coffee than throwing away bad $1 coffee after a sip.

Being on bourbon street we were worried that it would not be good. There were not that many people in here and so that further added to the worry. We were very wrong. The food was excellent. My wife had the redfish and I had the strip and both were phenomenal.  I highly recommend.

Totally not worth the trek. This was such a "blah" experience. I came here for business, and I felt bad for families that were staying here for fun. I would agree with other reviews that said the service was good - it was. I just like my hotels more updated and less outdated.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great spot to hang out and study or work, have some coffee and use the free WiFi. Usually pretty quiet but you do get the occasional rush of Westmont College students which turns the place into a strange noisy religious experience...I usually hit the road at that point or post up at the patio tables.

I love Maggie Moo's mainly for udderly cream or cheesecake alone or combined with some sort of chocolate ice cream.  I've never tried any mix-ins but I enjoy the ice cream all by itself.  It's sweet and very creamy and I really enjoy it's gooey, pull-on-your-spoon consistency.

I wore my sombrarro and was seated near the entrance.  Great location, great patio, dog friendly decent mexican food.  Order the large quacamole it is fresh and delicious.  Also, good chips and salsa.  As of now, no alcohol license, currently BYOT (bring your own tequilla).

I'd give it negative but there isn't the option. Nothing worked but rinse: no bug off, no tire cleaner, no high pressure soap, no foam brush, no triple conditioner, no coat protectant, the turbo dry didn't even work. No number to call, nothing. Complete rip off. 
DO NOT USE
DO NOT USE
DO NOT USE
DO NOT USE!

The best part about this place was how makes you appreciate the food you're used to having.  It wasn't terrible.  But it wasn't worth the price of admission.  Service was okay.  I'm surprised that this has such a high rating.

Now for the triad...
Decent food?
Eh.
Good price?
No.
Return visit?
Hell No.

Being a member of the Gold Plus program I always expect it to be a simple, straight forward process without an wait or confusion but I always experience a wait & confusion every time which is frustrating as that is the entire reason you choose to become an Gold Plus member.  Need better customer service all around.

They destroyed a brand new silk blouse. That was the first time i have used they're services. They kept the blouse for over 6 weeks and did not give me any answers. Manager/Owner will not return calls, poor customer service. Complete nightmare! 
I will NEVER go back again, i value my clothes way too much!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: The Rincon Grill at 49ers is undergoing a transformation under the leadership of Chef Rick. It is now a wonderful choice for informal yet delicious dining on Tucson's east side. Check their specials for real bargains. Ribs are outstanding.  Friday fish fry is now the best in town.

This is a great restaurant. We enjoyed a great meal while having a business meeting. We were not hurried at all. (We where there for 2 1/2 hours) I ordered the Linguine. (during lunch plain was only $7). The food was great and the portions were large. (I took 1/2 of it home) The service was fantastic!

I will go back again!

Not impressed. The check in reps hate to be bothered and are always on the phones. The room is nothing special - even by Courtyard standards. I'm a Marriott Gold rewards member and have stayed at the various Marriott branded hotels, and this one ranks on the bottom third. I wouldn't stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I had heard that the service had suffered over the years and when our friends invited us I was apprehensive.  But apparently the manager Donal is improving the service level. He was personally very attentive, making sure that our off menu drink orders were created correctly. 
The food was good but didn't knock my socks off.

Had some wonton soup and mongolian beef delivered via grubhub. Wonton soup was decent, especially with the crispy wonton flakes. I specified spicy for the beef on my order but the only flavor I could taste was cornstarch and a faint taste of beef. Maybe they got it backward?

I would give this place a negative star if I could.   I needed a spoon (to take my medication) and stopped in to ask for one.  The guy wanted .25cents for a freakin plastic spoon.  Unbelievable!!!  We're in a bad economy but this is taking nickel and diming to the next level !!!!OMG!!!

My husband and I came on a Sunday AM. We walked up to the cashier and we couldn't tell if she wanted to leave or wanted us to leave. It was a perfect example of what not do do when working in the customer service industry. The vanilla latte's were just okay.

No need for us to come back.

So we headed this way to partake in some karaoke.  Amazingly everyone knew how to sing.  The prices on drinks were a little high for such a dive.  Overall, it is an okay stop to make, but you wouldn't want to spend a lot of time there.  Good people watching though.

Beer starved living in Alabama. Stopped by to check out the selection (found on Find Craft Beer app) on a road trip. Great selection and awesome customer service (awesome lady that recommended Decadent Imperial I.P.A. from Ska Brewing - you are right, one of the top five IPA's I have had). Keep up the great work....

Great place to hang..amazing beer selection and their live entertainment was fantastic..you would never know you were in a mall. A little too loud while the band was on to have any conversation, but they had several flat-screen TV's to keep your mind occupied.  I would definitely go back.

Jeni is fun work for and her staff has the smiles on their faces to prove it.  I was so impressed with their attitude and willingness to help that the ice cream could have not even been good (which it is delicious) and I wouldn't have noticed.  Creative flavors and smiling staff makes this place a "must" in Nashville!

My friend and I were here for the weekend. Right out of the gate Champ helped us when it came to getting out begs to our room and was super nice. We stayed here last year but Champ made things a little easier and a lot better. Due to the fact he was easy to talk, great personally and out going.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I love when Mary does my manicure and pedicures.  My family and I have followed her for years and trust her with our precious feet.  She does the best job and gives the greatest massages during your pedicure.  She is so friendly and we consider her like family because we have grown to know her and her family over the years.

Run! Scream, if you can.  

Worst car rental experience ever.  Damaged lousy stinking (literally) jalopy.  Hertz has been decaying for years and this location sinks to new lows.  Expect long waits, filth, mechanical problems and endless automated voice prompts--profound unhelpfulness. 

Laissez les bad temps rouler!

Ahhh... I guess I should have started here to find out the hours. I mean, why would I expect a coffee place to be open before 9am? 

Who drinks coffee before 9am? 

I now see your hours are conveniently 9-4, which is when most other humans are at work. 

Makes sense.

My absolute favorite Italian Restaurant in St Louis and I know Italian having grown up in Chicago and living in St Louis for 5 years . You must try the Chicken Spedini, you won't soon forget it. The staff is helpful and friendly. Although I no longer live in St Louis I always find my way back to enjoy a great meal.

This is the most delightful grocery store in the area to shop.  The employees are friendly and MOST helpful, the aisles are wide, the store is very clean and bright - there is nothing bad to say about this store!  I shop here all the time.  The prices are the lowest in the area.

~Cindy!  :)
..

OK so not the best view in the world , nor do they just offer a coffee pot, however they do offer roll away beds in case u have company. their beds are stiff. the water pressure for the shower sucked , oh and I saw a coocarocha. there's not adequate outlets either.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I pass through the Philly airport on a too regular basis, every time I stop here I think "It will be better than last time", guess what its not.  It is a good place for a quick slice between flights, I recommend that you get the Stromboli, better than the pizza usually.

I stayed here on business.  The rooms are small and the shower is very low flow.  Very European style, low beds, little furniture.  Generally comfortable but small.  Very urban chic feel, not my style but great for a younger crowd.  Non-traditional, be prepared if you are expecting a high end traditional hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: First visit to this location was two weeks ago. Had an eye exam and was fitted for glasses. Was told they'd be ready the next week. Two weeks in, I'm still waiting. Every time I call to check, I'm greeted by a rude receptionist who can't wait to hang the phone up on me. Will not be using them again.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Decided to use my time in Nashville to get my hair trimmed and highlighted and was lucky to get a same-day appointment. Claudia was great - helped me balance out some too-blonde highlights and the salon is really open and airy inside. Easy walk from The Gulch or the convention center. Wish I could become a regular!

I didn't eat here so my review is not on the food.  I tried to use their website to order but the menu doesn't show prices for pizza, and pop-up ad pages loaded as soon as I clicked on their website.  They only appear to have one size (18") pizza and that doesn't work for me.

This review is for the Starbucks on the Southwest terminal at Lambert Airport. It always seems like an inconvenience for them to wait on you, horrible service. Last time I was there they only offered tall drinks because they were out of lids. AVOID THIS PLACE! I give it a 2 only because the coffee is still great!

Food was alright.. But the staff was awesome!! Very friendly and very efficient. No delay in service whatsoever. Lindsey was/is awesome. The food is what it is for this hour if the night (2am), but if the Green Room has nothing else going for it; The people that make this restaurant work are legit!

What a find in a corner of a strip mall. The food was all amazing. Home made pasta stuffed with Gorgonzola and pear for an app was amazing. Followed up by a perfectly tender veal osso buco over pasta with zucchini. The tiramisu was so light. The staff was very nice albeit slow. You won't find better Italian food for the price.

The room smells musty when you enter. The hotel is clean but definitely dated. The parking is not adequate for the size of the hotel & the lot is taken up by patrons of near by restaurants. Overall pleasant stay. Opportunity to improve front desk & room service customer & phone skills
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Friendly, laid backneighborhood full bar with pool, darts, smoking patio, juke box.  

Crowd varies between old regulars and college drop ins.  Dive+ atmosphere.

Cheap drinks, good medium-high liquor selection. 

Tell Buzz that I sent you and get any drink for the regular price.

We moved to Wilmington about 1.5 years ago and this is a simple staple. It's a great inexpensive dinner/date night on a Friday night, or a Tuesday night pizza joint. Portions are great and the food is not exceptional italian but enough to keep us coming back!

I stopped in early to pick up a cheesesteak to take across the country for a cheesesteak deprived hungry man. I was disappointed in how it looked. Like it was on a diet. Not a good impression considering I rave about how great cheesesteaks are. Ill stick with the pizza there for sure though. Thats still good

Although my experience with the Philly Airport was not that pleasant the car rental system with Alamo was really good. It was a fast Check in. I also like the shuttle service to the location. However the driver was going a little too fast for my taste. But all in all it was a raealy good. They even offered bottled water.

best Mexican I've had in the city. the burrito was great and the quesadilla my friend ordered looked more like a burrito panini. even the pico de gallo was so fresh that it seemed like it was made to order.

it's cash only and their in house ATM is out of order so make sure you have cash on you.

If I could give this place no stars, I would. This was the nastiest hotel ever! Bedbugs and hair in the beds, moldy carpets, and spiders and cobwebs everywhere. And that was just the first room! We were able to move to a second room and the air didn't work. So the hotel offered us a box fan!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
If you like to party like its 1999 this is your place. Rooms are the same orange brown they were my last visit early 2000‼
I rarely review but we are all disappointed with Laquinta rooms @Marriott prices. 
PS
Gold Elite 
Over 50 nites Marriott this year. 
And a uppity front desk. 
Never again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ended our night here for dessert and a nightcap, the staff was accommodating for us being walk ins and were seated in the lounge. The atmosphere and view is outstanding. The pear dessert was delicious, but would skip the $19 for an espresso martini next time.

This is a great spot with great food. If you can get a chair at the bar they are very comfy and the bar service is great. Actually the service is great throughout the place. Family owned and we have met some of them. This place does have some style and class so don't show up in cutoffs.

Out of all the sushi places in Santa Barbara, Sushi Go-Go is a No-No! The salmon tasted like tuna, the tuna was brown, and the ginger and wasabi were both dry. The dragon roles were good, everything else however, was not satisfying. I would recommend Kai over this place in SB any day.

I would give them a five for customer service during eye exam and purchasing glasses, and a zero for customer service during replacement.  I have a 12-year old who is really hard on glasses.  I will be looking for a new place that has a better replacement policy.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I've flown out of this airport every three weeks for five years, and nearly every time I've tried it, this quick-serve is out of several key ingredients (proteins, vegetables, buns/wraps). Whomever is in charge of ordering for this station needs to significantly recheck their math.

I love Wendy's but this has to be the slowest location in Indy. It routinely takes 15+ minutes to order and get your food in the drive through. It doesn't matter what time of day you go. The experience is still the same. Have left the drive through multiple times because of how slow it is.

Let the good times and the best flavors roll! If you haven't tried rolled ice cream let this be the best introduction to your pallet! If you love rolled ice cream and haven't been, what are you waiting for?! The atmosphere is family oriented, great staff, clean and the prices, Magnifique!

They gave no warning of starting to charge again during a pandemic in which most people are not going to a gym.  Then say you either have to come in or send a certified letter to cancel.  That is outrageous.  I would never join a planet fitness again and am putting permanent stop payments and reporting them to the BBB
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Went in because of the great reviews on Yelp. Waitress saw us seat ourselves at a table...22 mins later still nothing.  No water, no chips, NOTHING. I went to the counter to ask if we order there and i was rudely told "no at the table" and shrugged off. We left....

I've been going to Swamp Pike Pub for a few years now and have become a bit of a regular.  They have a great vibe there.  Wings are AMAZING.  Beer is nice and cold, with a pretty respectable selection!   Bartenders are nice as well is quick, even when it is packed!

Happy hours and specials are great as well.

super efficient - wash+cut+style took only 30-40 minutes. at the same time no sacrifice in quality -- i wanted my hair to be kept around the same length and just thinned out with the same layering as it had before. sandy did exactly as i asked and it looks great

Worst customer service I have experienced in Tucson. When ordering, I was told "I did not need more cheese" on my pizza. The staff and management have no concept of how to treat customers with common curtesy. Pieology on speedway has much better pizza and CUSTOMER SERVICE.

Ask for Dr. Frank, she works Thursday and Friday. She is the absolute best vet we have encountered. Thorough, friendly, sweet, truly cares, and is extremely knowledgeable! We have the utmost trust and faith in her abilities and love that we have found her.

It's not bad for a base line hotel, Sheraton Four Points next door is not bad, but the worst restaurant below, 'The White Spot'. Never had a bad night at a Hampton Inn and very clean. The other review was just a one off bad experience. Maybe it's because I'm Gold with Hilton but this does the job for work and that is was counts.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Do not trust these guys!!!  They told me that my tie rod ends were bad on my truck and wanted $309 for the repair.  I had my company mechanic look at it and determine that there was nothing wrong with them and it was an upper control arm bushing instead.  They were going to replace it and then tell me that I needed more repairs.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Disappointing. Having lived in Japan and Hawaii and dining  at some great sushi spots, sushi should be a delicious meal as well as an awesome dining experience. Fish not fresh tasting. Atmosphere-  meh. Tasted and felt like a C grade fast food spot. Won't be back.

Lots of hype, and while the pizza wasn't bad, it did not match up to neither the hype nor its name. Unfortunately the customer service really broke the whole experience. This was actually our second attempt, and both times, Sailor Moon the Cashier seemed bothered by our order for a pepperoni pizza. Would not recommend to a friend.

I've been to this shop twice- once for an emergency with my muffler, that they were able to take care of immediately and the second time for an oil change which was done very fast.  Will return before winter for new front tires.  Fast and efficient service!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I am a fan of HSHB.  Sure, you can get get the materials cheaper from NB or elsewhere...but George and Nancy have a much more personal touch.  They're usually willing to give you some tips if you ask.  
Be sure to give some rubs to Jake and Elroy while you're looking around.  The cats are really the one's who run the place anyways.

This Hampton is okay. Like other Hamptons it was clean, well priced, and the free breakfast is pretty good.

I didn't like that the TV was quite outdated and the gym was kind of small. Overall though it's not terrible, just a couple things could have made it a five star experience.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Over all great experience.  I travel all over the eastern US and stay at plenty of Holiday Inn Express.  This one was pretty clean and the staff was very nice and helpful.  Both days I over slept and miss breakfast but it's all good.  Just goes to show there beds are comfy
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I would give them 3.5 stars. Great location in the middle of Philly so can walk to lots of attractions. Few minute walk to the Liberty Bell. The interior was fairly nice and standard...not luxurious and not awful. Beds were comfy. Didn't get to use any of the amenities to speak of those. Parking was kind of expensive.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I ordered carry out but my service was very good. Very Good NY Pizza! I also ordered a small Chicago Style pizza as I never had it. To my surprise when I got home the small Chicago pizza was not cut (a little irritating to me) but not a huge deal. It will not keep me from going back when I am in town visiting.

For a Hilton, this hotel misses the mark.  The rooms have double beds, the mattresses and pillows are terrible, the "included" continental breakfast was a joke, and we had no maid service while we were there.  We had to take care of our own trash, etc...Very disappointing for the price we paid.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Great sushi. Cheap happy hour prices. The miso soup is the best in Tucson. The amount of meat is less than others but for the price it's a good value. The service is always friendly and fast. It's usually pretty busy so that should tell you something. Only had nigiri and rolls. Never tried their other foods.

I came in tonight because another bartender told me to check it out. I'm a bartender too but me and my friend were ignored for 10 minutes. I wish I had the presence of mind to have taken video but I watched the bartender take a shot. I guess he was too drunk to notice us?

whilst the outside set-up of the hotel was interesting, our loft room left us feeling uncomfortable with climbing stairs to go to bed. they could have notified us previously but we made do. pretty good location as well.
also there were a few lights that never came on with the flick of the switch, especially in the enclosed shower.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Day in and day out i see this girl behind the counter with piss poor  food handling practices with no hat and a shirt without sleeves not even in proper working uniform slicing meat and puts he shirt on and the pos system. Her gages are in and she has short bleach blond hair im saddened that this place will kill someone oneday

Tried this place after reading the great reviews, but I was very unhappy with the quality. Our pizza was completely burned. I have no idea why they would have put it in the box the way that it looked. They did replace it, but it was sloppy. I would honestly not recommend this place.

So my good friends and I went here for some late night ice cream. Two of them have bad Tourette's syndrome. And one was drunk. One of them in the back screamed because you know (they can't help it) and they denied us service and told us we were "unacceptable". Disrespectful staff.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Needed two buttons replaced. Neither where done. 

Asked for light starch or everything. My khakis could stand themselves up. 

The sleeves of my satin shirt were wrinkled near the cuff on each sleeve. 

The staff was courteous, but they half-assed my items.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Hilton Garden Inn Nashville/Smyrna needs an update, pronto! 

Clean rooms, comfy bed, hot water, but it has the feel of early eighties. 

This Hilton wasn't terrible but it won't be my first or second choice when traveling from Florida to Chicago and returning home to Florida.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is a small, quiet restaurant and the type I hope will overrun the national chains in town. They clearly have a chef, not a cook in the kitchen. And the staff is excellent as well. They have a changing menu, though I'm not sure how often, but the selections are thoughtful making the experience enjoyable.

Our third stay and we always have enjoyed it. All the front desk is helpful and friendly. We love the shuttle Drivers they all go out of their way to help make getting around easy. They are all super nice and I think we have used them all. The rooms are clean and it is a good place to stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place is disgusting. The walkways and walls are crusted over with dirt. The room was gross. We stayed there because we just moved to town and didn't want to dig the mattresses out of our truck late at night. The woman at check in was miserable. Definitely wouldn't ever want anyone I know to stay here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Booked my aunt a week here for her birthday. Called hotel to make payment arrangements and mentioned it was my aunt's birthday.

When she arrived, she was greeted with a cake from a local bakery.

She also told me that she felt comfortable and safe at the hotel, and that the staff was friendly.  Thank you Courtyard by Marriott!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Came for an eye exam for contacts and glasses, and it was all done very quickly and professionally. The customer service for choosing glasses is fabulous, and there is a wide selection. They even adjusted my glasses for free (after I had purchased a pair).
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Took awhile to get a seat, but we did not put in a reservation and had an odd sized party. There were plenty of tables available, but they set one up for our group as quickly as possible. The waiter (Dago) was very knowledgeable and the food was incredible. Friends were in from France and California; everyone was pleased!

Ok first.  This DD is located inside the gas station. Very minimal seating, so it's not going to be like the regular DD's most people frequent. I will say the service was good for being a super small DD with a drive thru window. It is faster to just get out of the car and walk inside to order.

I was very excited, based on the reviews. A little disappointed when I actually received a very soft, dry, undercooked Sicilian pizza. They were very sparse with the sauce and the toppings. Service was good and prompt, but unfortunately the pizza didn't live up to the reviews. I would not order again or recommend to family.

Disappointed. Waited about 40 mins for my coffee and still left without it because the wait was ridiculous. About 15 people waiting inside for their coffee and every order that was being called out was mobile orders. What's the point of having an inside for people to enjoy their coffee right then and there then?

I like this bar. If you don't like your drink even a little bit the bartender Kevin will NOT rest until you are completely happy.
For food- I usually get the buffalo chicken wrap.
I would probably come to the bar more often if they didn't allow smoking but I understand that's part of the appeal for some.

Love of my life, jeni's
I still miss the matcha marshmallow and osmanthus something something flavor (from spring 2017 I believe)... But the seasonal flavors are delicious every time, so I can't complain. 
Seriously, this place is a blessing. 
And you get free ice cream your birthday 
Ugh
Love u jeni's

Going to Columbo's after class during paramedic school was a regular affair.  The perfect place to unwind after a stressful day.  The place is laid-back, has great drink specials, and the staff knows how to have a good-time and can take a joke.  The Buffalo Chicken chunks, or whatever they're called, are awesome.

I was on vacation last week and walked in SB barbers last minute.  They got we in pretty quick and I got a cut from Pako.  I had my wife and two daughters and they offered Us waters and gave my daughter a lollypop.  Pako was very detailed and gave me one of the best haircuts I received in a while.  Would recommend to anyone.

The service was very nice, though my friend and I were charged double what the board said for the price of our nails. Our nails were not worth the price and we were confused how it had suddenly been raised for us / was not changed on the board. We will definitely not be returning.

MISERABLE!  I went there to watch a basketball game and the service & food were BULL$HIT --and the waitresses are little brats. They get away with this crap b/c they have college kids for customers that put up with it or don't know any better. Terrible place.

What can I say but viva Italiano!

This is the first tine my wife and have eaten here; but most certainly not the last!

The food was authentic, hot and delicious. 

Make sure you get the chance to eat here before the rest of the community finds out about it.

Service was slow, they brought me the wrong dish, but the food was pretty good and portions huge!

I would say this fare is typical to American-Italian food that you could find at most places, but for the price and portions it's not a bad dining experience. Just be prepared to wait a while for your food.

We found the accommodations plus location to be perfect for what we were looking for. The gym had a nice view, perfect for a morning workout. The hotel had nice amenities and it was far enough away from the chaos but close enough to walk. There's a market near by. Overall great experience
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The Abbey is a great dive bar in the French Quarter, set off the Main Street. It's cash only. The drinks are strong and cheap. There's an old school juke box. Bathrooms are a little ugh. Service is okay, about what you'd expect at a dive. Seems to be a hang out spot for the local day-drinkers.

The landing has a great view and I can only imagine that their deck is fantastic during the day. However, for a nighttime meal, I'd advise that you skip the view and try other options. Their menu is bland and the food is not served very nicely. For food, check out other options!

Loved this place, stopped in on the way home from Wesley Chapel. Had ginger salad, it's got a little spicy pepper kick to it, very tasty! We had a California roll, which was fresh and tummy!! Shrimp tempura and veggies had the perfect amount of batted. Tempura had broccoli, sweet potatoes, onions, zucchini!

Empire Barbershop is hands down the best barbershop in Tampa.  Ali has been my barber for a decade.  He keeps me looking fresh by having the ability to change up my look while maintaining a professional image. They are great with haircuts for kids too!  I give Ali and Empire my highest recommendation!

I have rented from many branches for a very long time but mainly from the Cherry Hill location on Haddonfield Rd. It has always been a top notch branch until about a year ago when new management came. The service now is horrible! The local Manager Cliff is obnoxious and does not value loyal customers.

So first time staying at this hotel in the french quarter, very nice lobby and staff was real helpful, checkin  is at 3pm they let me check in a 1pm so happy, room were clean, comfortable and spacious 
The price for a holiday weekend was not to bad, I recommend everybody to stay here it was a blast fun time
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The food and the experience was great! Spicy yellowtail roll was amazing and so was the chicken hibachi. One of the women taking care of our table was a little rude, but still giving it 5 stars because it was so delicious and everyone else provided excellent service. I will definitely be back!

Food was good. I come from Italy, so I'm just really picky. My American boyfriend gives it a 3.8
Great vibes and atmosphere. The arugula salad was so good and one of the best salads I've had. Lots of vegan options too. The restaurant has a view of The Row.

This place has been a nightmare. We arrived at 2:30pm and have not gotten a room yet. Been waiting 4 and a half hours and the staff hasn't addressed us at all on what is happening. This was planned months in advance and now our trip is cut much shorter. oi
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: There are much better places to go. This place is divey and dirty. The wine glasses are dirty. The bathrooms have never been cleaned. It's really a sad place. The service was good but my god wash the glasses you are serving. And try a spritz of Lysol every now and again. Dirty glasses, dirty bar, gross music.

I had a lady practicality put her face in my groin while I was eating lunch to clean the frames of the walls. She just couldn't wait to clean the spot I was practically sitting in. Things get done here, I like the determination. 4 stars. Minus 1 star for the practical hug. Even cleans the booth as I'm sitting here.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I love this place so much!  The food is so good and the pricing is just right.  My favorite taco is is definitely the lobster taco.  It has this delicious brown butter sauce and it's amazing.  Unfortunately it's a "secret taco" and I haven't seen it back on the menu since last summer

Another update. Just when I think it is impossible for this place to get any better it does.  The service is the best in St. Louis (and St. Louis has some excellent service); the food delights your mouth; the ambiance is elegant and intimate.

If you haven't gone to I Fratellini, you have no idea what you have been missing.

Could not have asked for a better experience. I called at 8:15 this morning, dropped off my items by 8:45 and they were ready before noon. And to top it off, Chris didn't even charge me! Will definitely be recommending to family and friends and will be returning myself.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Terrible. Not even food. If ingredients make the recipe there is no care here. Horrible quality rice with no flavor of sushi rice. Poor quality seafood poorly prepared. Cardboard texture. 
Save yourself do not go. Every aspect was worse than poor. 
Got Covid-19 protocol tho

I must say, I really enjoyed my stay at the hotel.  Nice room, great AC and extremely pleasant check in and check out. I can usually find things to be picky about but in this case it was all good.  I recommend this hotel, it's close enough to bourbon st (sp) to enjoy but far enough not to be a disturbance.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Amazing mom and pop shop in old town greenwood! It's always been a favorite between my friends and I. I took my family there for my birthday this year and none of them had tried it before but they were all very impressed! They are well known for their steaks and fettuccine! Great service and delicious food!

It's been such a horrible experience. I can't believe I've been a member for avoer 2 years. Everytime I use it I have an issue with either the card readers at the station or the card. And support is not very helpful. They can't be, they are across the Atlantic. Sigh I'll learn my lesson and stick to Lyft.

Don't come here unless you are ready for an authentic Mexican experience! There are several options to choose, for those who want something original, or something traditional. The Caldo de Res is amazing. Please be warned: The (habanero) salsas are PICANTE and SABOROSO. (They'll "bite" you with fantastic flavors!)

I just got back from this coffee/tea/bake shop. I'm hoping I came in on a terrible baked goods day because my croissant was so BAD, Inedible. It flaked into 3 million pieces, which is disappointing for a new, cute, and friendly staffed place. My latte was delicious and well poured. But that croissant.... burnt, yuck, gross, sad.

Today the staff is not focused on the customers. Stood at counter 4 minutes before anyone acknowledged me. 4 of them looking at me but kept horsing around. No greeting, no appreciation or concern for my satisfaction. Lots of laughing and playing amongst the employees. Poorly managed franchise.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: With the caveat that this review is based only on the lunch buffet, I'll begin. The food is tasty and there is an adequate variety. The variety of sushi is somewhat limited, but is properly prepared.   The staff is pleasant. The ambiance is somewhat drab. Overall, though, it's a pleasant experience.

It might take a little time  but the pizza is 5 star awesome. Best I've had in years   Show up a little late for pickup  it's well worth it. If u have to wait  it's warm and cozy like and old time mom and pop pizzeria. Excellent pizza  and toasted ravs.  The roast beef sandwichs looked great coming out of there oven.

They are the best!!! I just got my car washed after quite a bit and it was still not totally clean after the first round and Storm had me come through again to make sure it was looking perfect!! Great service and quick and easy!! Highly highly recommend if you live in Bellevue!!! I won't go anywhere else!

Ib started here on my honeymoon.  I gotta say that the staff is about the nicest that over ever come across in forever.
Now the motel was not the best looking and had seen better days Though, it did look like it was renovated. But the view was amazing.  I would recommend this place
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: What a great restaurant!  the sea bass with almond crust and orange-papaya salsa was excellent, and cost $17.  The chicken marsala was likewise delish, and $15 (the online menu on Yelp says $25.  Nice people, entertaining artwork on the walls.  ( Didn't stay for the live music.). Definitely a keeper.

Friendly staff. Cute pink benches inside. My hard ice cream was great, especially the peanut butter chocolate. My boyfriend made his own froyo and topped it himself. He liked his too and they have many topping options. The worker gave us small cups of water too which was nice. Would go back if we lived around here.

Love this gym!  I go to the Arnold location!  I had previously made a comment about a broken stall, and it was fixed IMMEDIATELY! Awesome staff, great classes (I'm SO glad to see that Zumba is back 3 nights a week!)
I've finally been cleared from my doctor to come back - I have serious hip issues - and I can't wait!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This restaurant is in the basement of a grocery store, hence why locals call it "The Basement." Stopped by here for lunch. Super casual place and food came out pretty quickly. Ordered the singapore noodles and beef ho fun. A bit oily but still solid asian food. Portions are big enough to share and the prices are great! Cash only.

Love eating here! Always fresh, fast, and pretty good service. Sometimes they burn the pizza a little but not usually. Only thing that troubles me is that the employees don't wear hair nets. I've always worked in food and I don't really like that it seems quite easy for hair to get in your food.

Absolutely the worst pizza I have ever had. It was burnt and way over cooked. On top of the hard burnt dough was a pool of sauce with toppings almost floating in it. How someone would let this go into a pizza box is beyond comprehension. Would not recommend.

I love going here. The nail technician takes her time in taking care of you. In my experience, there have not been any pressure sales for add-on services which a plus for me because I just don't like that type of sales tactic. Everyone is friendly and does a great job.

Disappointed - came because we really liked Fodder and Shine - owners made a bad decision.  Should have kept Fodder and Shine.  I ordered the fried chicken which I used to love.  Way over cooked even though chicken was moist.  The greens were excellent though

The food was actually pretty darn good and I would've given a 4/5 star review, but due the poor service and lack of professionalism I had to lower it to 2/5 stars. Unfortunately, I will unlikely come back due to my first experience here, but overall the food was good.

Delicious ice cream, the guava pastelito falvor on point. We're from Miami so we know guava ice cream in little Havana and this place is actually better. Not overly sweet. Perfect balance of sweet, creamy, and textures with the pastry puff and guava. We will def be going back! Also friendly service and nice simple ambiance.

This place is great. Good food, nice service, and cute atmosphere. I had eggs florentine and they were very tasty. The potatoes were served with peppers and onions which I liked, but I think they should tell customers, as this makes for a different breakfast potato experience. I will be returning!

I've frequented De La Paz many times over the years. I feel like I've been an apologist for those in White House that have told me they didn't like it or had a bad experience. But, recently the service has become poor although the staff is essentially the same. If in White House, try Agave's in the Walmart shopping center.

I have gone here a few times, however they are very disorganized and very rude. I called in made an appointment and then when I got there they told me I am not in the system. I responded I come here all the time and that if I didn't get a hair cut then I would go else where. They told me that's fine and they don't need my business.

This place has some very unique donuts with great themes. The staff is friendly and helpful. If I had a criticism it would be that the cereal they put on the frosted donuts gets stale very fast and sometimes the frosting is a bit thick.  That wont stop me from eating them though.

Absolutely hands down the best hotel in the area. The friendly and helpful staff are wonderful. Jessica the front desk manager took very good care of me during my stay. Room 335 has the best view and was larger than my first apartment. Lol. I'll be coming back each business trip.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: awesome meal with great friends on Friday!  Luca our server was excellent not a drop of food was left on anyone's plate and we had a party of 6.  Loved the large round table we had in the front window!!  My husband had the wild boar and loved it!  Can't wait to go back

1st time here and was very impressed! Food is EXCELLENT! I had the Chicken Fettuccine and it's the best around! Service was excellent as well, Melissa was my server and did an excellent job with recommending a great dish. I will definitely be putting this little gem on my favorites list!!

We love to eat at this place. Best sushi in Boise!! Our favorite roles are lion king and anger management. The restaurant has a very useful waitlist process which makes getting in on a super busy night super easy. Defiantly get the all you can eat sushi you won't regret it.

I've been coming here for years. I love all of the original workers, but lately they've added some new people that may just not be as experienced as the people that have been working here for a while. The quality of my pedicures has definitely been going down in the past year or so.

I'd give this place a 2.5 stars. Not that great. They have St. Louis style pizza that's really thin. I'm from California, so this was new to me and I tried it. Ended up tasting okay, but since the crust was so thin, I was essentially eating cheese and toppings. I did delivery at another IMOS and it costed a lot per pizza as well.

Ashley, at the front desk, made our visit so lovely! She gladly accommodated my husband and baby, as we arrived from the airport at midnight. She gave us the most beautiful room, with an amazing view of the city. Made us feel so special. And sent a baby bed up to our room, so our baby could sleep safely. Amazing service and visit!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great pizza but only call if you want to pick your order up. Delivery is easily 2.5 hour wait and usually arrives cold. Plus they never and I mean never comp you or even give you a discount if this happens. Pretty sad business motto. But it's Sahuarita and there is nothing around.

Twice we have been here and the rep named Priscilla always wants to make us spend more money than we need to.  She gives inaccurate information everytime. Do not come here if you have the option to go to another sears.  Or don't let this girl help you out.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: It's very small and cute. Brought my husband here for a massage. It's also a hair salon so there's music playing and girls talking/gossiping. So, I didn't get that "relaxing" feel that I was expecting. The masseuse was very nice and inviting. I wouldn't come here again for a massage though.

Off a recommendation from my dads nurse (Allison) at Banner University Medical Center, we came here and enjoyed every bite. It felt like it was a dinner and show because we truly enjoy the watching the woman who was making homemade tortillas. 

The atmosphere was amazing along with awesome service!

Lovely hotel and staff. We stayed here for two nights checking in on the night of the merger of Marriott and Starwood. The service here was phenomenal. Everyone we interacted with was wonderful. They even gave us a suite upgrade and late checkout. This is definitely my hotel of choice when I'm in the Tampa/St. Pete area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: A great pizzeria right down the street from the hotel where we were staying. We ordered the Kirkwood on a thin crust (also known as the St Louis style crust). The crust was robust and crispy with a sweet red sauce. Our server Pagie was great! Definitely recommend

Amazing service and ice cream. The matcha is bold without being overpowering, and the taro is perfectly sweetened. The woman who greeted me was super friendly, and even assured me that if I didn't like the first samples I tried, I could try plenty more. 10/10 will be back!

I highly recommend these guys! They do a great job of explaining the why behind what they did and they do the little things for customers that build trust.  This goes a long way in an industry where customers feel they may get ripped off or sold things they don't need.  Excellent service!

Otra Vez is a new gem in NOLA where I especially feel at home! Lindsay, the bartender is very welcoming and attentive. The cocktails are fabulous (try the Coyote Wishes!) and the food is delicious with tons of vegetarian and vegan friendly options. Will be back again and again!

Ok, I have really just one question: how do you go to the lengths to create an otherwise great pastrami sandwich, but you don't even try to pretend to toast the bread?
I did enjoy the DJ wearing the Naruto shirt and the mural of Urkel and the Kool-Aid Man.

Amazing room. Comfortable bed, wonderful staff, gorgeous furnishings. Loved it. Quiet and peaceful. Delicious breakfast with made to order eggs. Yum. Wish we could have stayed someplace like this during our whole road trip. I would go out of my way to go back to Boise just to stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I usually love ordering from here, but I'd never expect this to happen to me. Found what seems like a mosquito in my yaki udon. Really hope place cleans up and this was just a fluke. I know Shogun is really popular, but things like these can't be pushed aside.

Was looking for a place to eat and found this little place I order a Torta sandwich with bake chicken on it .It was delicious I mean really good. fresh advocado baked chicken many things was on it tomatoes etc very big but excellent .inexpensive devilious. Ha

Probably the best ice cream I've ever had.  The citrus frozen yogurts (lemon blueberry and bergamot) are *amazing*, as is the dark chocolate.  Definitely, definitely worth the wait, which you'll need to plan out your order anyway (if you're anything like me).

Avoid!! Save your money!
I asked for a tall coffee frappicino; I received something pale vanilla shade, warm and not tasting anything at all like a Starbucks coffee frap. 
When i reported to them I got attitude back.. I just left it on the counter and reported to the email on my receipt.

This spot decent, especially if your looking for sushi in a hurry. The spider roll and the Barrington roll stand out for me. The other items on the menu include hibachi style combos that aren't bad. Pretty decent neighborhood sushi place, if that's a thing.

I have worked with Ale since she worked for the Hermosa Beach branch. Many years of great work. If I ever had any issues she helped me with all my finances. Very kind, caring, helpful, and explains everything to me. She is the best customer service. If anyone needs a good finance doctor she's the one.

The good news is that I only saw 7 of the thousands of roaches that I'm sure are in the walls of this hotel. I appreciate that they decorated it to look like a thrift store. I also like how the friendly staff came into my room without knocking. Tampa Stadium, you're a star! One star to be exact!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The best bar in downtown Nashville! A great diversion from the commercialized and obnoxious bars on 2nd Ave. Ambience is chill and they have fantastic beers on tap! Make sure you try any of the Yazoo beers. Definitely going to make this place my Nashville hangout for years to come!

We had ordered from here before in years past. While our food wasn't quite on par with our previous meal. It was very good. We had the ham and cheese sandwich, the Romas special sandwich and the combination pizza. They were fast, courteous and our food was hot. We will definitely order from here again for nights inside resting.

Not authentic sushi. You get what you pay for. 3 roll special for $10.95. I've tried this place twice in the hopes it would be better a second time.  Ex - Spicy tuna rolls have shredded tuna not freshly cut pieces and sushi is made by Chinese not Japanese. 
2/5 atmosphere
2/5 service
2/5 quality of food 
4/5 price

I have to admit, I went on a whim and I had Sabarro from the mall the day before (which totally hit the spot) but I'm so grossed out by super soft crusts on Pizzas. I had a personal size so maybe that was the problem. Anyway, I won't be back. It's bad if I like the crappy mall pizza better...

Stuck here in a freezing ice storm and the staff has been very accommodating. Nice facilities, very convenient location (right next to a good mall with Nordstrom,Cheesecake Factory, regal theater), adequate breakfast, and good price. I will definitely stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Vegetarian warning: they ironically cook their tofu entrees in chicken broth, and you can taste every bite. Only complaint.  

Other than that, great service, great food, and they even cooked my pick-up order while closed. If a disgruntled vegetarian can give this place three stars, what's wrong with everyone else's reviews?

Worst lunch break I've taken in a very long time,I ordered the turkey burger no tomato no onion add cheese tell me how can you mess that up not once but three times fries were cold way too much ketchup if you are in a hurry and need a burger i recommend you pass on this place it has gone down hill.....

This is what our table has looked like for over an hour. Took for ever to finally take our order....then took 10x longer to get the order. If you have an entire day for lunch and some extra cash you might enjoy. Finally got the food and it was cold. Look at the grease!!!! Screw this place

This hotel is infested with bedbugs! First room had actual adult and nymph bedbugs and second room had major evidence of bedbugs at some point. 

It is also slacking in the housekeeping department. There was a pile of trash behind the night stands as well as an open condom and wrapper under the bedskirt.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Worst place I've ever been to. Shower does not work properly. The whole point of hotel is to shower and sleep and when half of that is not working you expect to be moved or compensated for your troubles or given a free room for one more night. Nothing was done! Rude front end staff. Will never recommend this shit hole to anyone!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Perfect Cuts offers great service and prices to accommodate a budget, without sacrificing a high style ethic. 
The receptionist is pleasant and helpful. (She even offered me the use of her iPad to find the haircut I wanted)
May is exceptionally talented and so nice.

Just checked in. I had asked for a king bed and they said there were none available. They asked me if that is okay! I shared what choice did I have. Then they told me to checkin tomorrow to change rooms but they should contact me asap when it is ready. Also the WiFi didn't work and they had to open a ticket!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The girl at the counter is very unfriendly. Both days I was there she never smiled or treated customers in a friendly way. The guys were almost as bad but don't interact with customers as much as she does. She gets a 1 star. The quiche was amazing, 5 stars for sure. I balanced it out with a 3 star review.

During covid they have drive thru open only and their speaker is WORTHLESS. So don't be surprised if your orders turn out wrong. I asked for homemade flour tortillas and got corn. They didn't have the best customer service once at the window too. 
Hard to find a good place to eat in Reno without breaking the bank I must say lol

Worked for me!

We were looking for a quick meal after a day of traveling. We got to our hotel and weren't looking for anything extravagant. This worked! Reasonably priced and friendly service. Free chips and salsa and food showed up quickly - everything we were looking for.

Would recommend for a traveler!

Rented vehicles here over the years when I go back to Philly to visit family. Prices are comparable to other chains. Located close to airport terminals and they have a courtesy shuttle  bus that continuously makes loops. Service was always fine nothing to complain about.

Flexible with great customer service and reasonable price.  Counter agent called Tampa Airport location to see if he could get me a better quote.  Location closes at noon on Saturdays but staff stayed late to assist us.  Finally, the same agent offered to synch our phone with the vehicles Bluetooth.  All good!

Matt is so nice and willing to help. I took my old truck in to figure out an issue with the charging system and other minor issues and he was quick to give me an estimate and even gave me tips to save money on parts. I'm very happy and will definitely be back.

Stopped in for lunch.  We ordered the large meat lovers for four adults and one kid.  More than enough and the pizza was very good. The dude who helped us was very polite and professional.  It wasn't terribly busy, which was a concern at first, but carryout proved to be busy.  We'll definitely be back.  :)

I know this hotel has changed names recently. You would hope the  management would step up the customer service. I called the front desk for 20 minutes with no answer the next time I was put on hold and no one ever picked up again. This will be the last time I stay at this hotel hotel
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Horrible service. Went through drive through and the guy said only grub hub and door dash sorry. Went into lobby to see I could order inside. The manager on duty was weird. Then proceeded to call me baby. Like overall horrible service then made me very uncomfortable.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Suzanne's small diner atmosphere feels warm and welcoming. Suzanne is a gracious host, and her homemade cooking is authentic and delicious. I stopped here for breakfast after landing at PHL with some time to spare. Her breakfast potatoes are incredible, as is the breakfast sausage. Definitely come to this place and try both.

I was in the area for a show and my lights did not work- I stopped by and was greeted by the nicest lady! They took care of me and my car right away- great customer service, super nice and very reasonably priced- I will definitely go back there when I am back in the area and need a shop!

Awesome main dishes and great customer service! Only a couple things took it down from a 5. We had a really flat beer and the bread for the table was very tough! But the entree really out did themselves!  Highly recommend if you are looking for really great Flavorful Italian!

If Tony Bennett came to New Orleans he would love this place. Romantic quaint environment with the added bonus of great food and wine. I can't wait to go back. Make the effort to locate the Filippo because it's not easy to find but the reward of great food is worth the adventure.

Authentic, delicious Mexican food. Ordered the Tostadas (chicken and carnitas) as well as Enchiladas Verde (chicken) which came with refried beans and rice. Everything was well seasoned and prepared. I did try to call ahead to place my order but both times went to voicemail. Reasonably priced for the portions they give you.

Absolutely with NO EXAGGERATION one of the best sushi places I've ever been with a super friendly server who did nothing but making sure I'm happy and satisfied... this place is not fancy as you might expect but the sushi and the greeting you get is like deluxe!! I am visiting PA but definitely be back when I'm in the area again!

Went here one Sunday evening with my wife. Great atmosphere, service & food. I was a bit disappointed and perhaps mislead when I saw the huge bar in the center of the room, but later found there was no beer on tap, only bottle and can. Other than that, great place!

Ordered via the Yelp App/Grubhub deliver on a Tuesday night. Easy enough. Only real issue with the meal was no wasabi. Whether this was a mistake or their practice, not sure. So I'll let that slide. Sushi was pretty standard. Can't complain, can't rave. Average.

Highly recommend this hotel. We were able to get a room at the last minute despite it being CMA Fan Fest week in Nashville. Staff was super friendly and helpful. Our room was more than I expected. King size bed plus a cozy sitting area. The bar in the lobby is a nice touch.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Pros: convenient shops and restaurants nearby
Cons: restaurant and shop at the hotel were closed, room was very small, my view was of a brick wall, very expensive (I paid $350 for the night), no room service, bathroom is small and there's no counter space. It's very difficult for two people to get ready.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I recently visited Dunkin donuts the establishment did not have the full variety of don't as they usually do.  They did not have the ingredients for all their sandwiches. Seriously and I was told that have more donuts in an hour, obviously not on there game for the day.

Tony and the staff are absolutely incredible. Robert is my usual server and he gets everything just right! I've been going so long with only wonderful meals by friendly people!
Cannelloni and Rose of Italy are amazing. I love the Salmon and yes it's an Italian Restaurant... but it's the best in the city.

Food was below average. My biggest gripe is thats its completely filthy in the restaurant and the bathroom is something out of a horror movie. Id rather use an outhouse before I ever step foot back in this establishment. How they pass inspections is beyond me. I can only imagine how bad the kitchen is

It was an amazing experience until the check out day. As we were checking out the front office person(I wish I got her name but she was about 5'4 and African American) she was very rude and short because we asked to change the billing card on file.  Nice hotel but they can definitely work on their commutation skills
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My husband and I ate here tonight for the 1st time. Food was delicious, atmosphere quaint and quiet and the server Eddie was amazing. Special thank you to Eddie and the owner for a much needed pick me up. When Gabe is ready it'll be his first restaurant he goes to! Thank you again.

Great customer service by all but especially the owners Marco and David! Not only did I literally spend half of what I paid at Costco several years ago for all four tires, I qualified for 90 days same as cash. They will have my business again and I'll be sure to spread the word.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The sushi was very mediocre and the service was bad and I felt like I was being rushed. The atmosphere was really quiet. The sticky rice for the sushi wasn't sticky. Still paid full price. The buffet wasn't full of food so I couldn't even go up for more sushi. They were clearing things up and putting the food away.

I was really excited to check out TImothy's but unfortunately, the food was awful. We sent back our pizza, it was so greasy and doughy there was no flavor but grease. The appetizers were small and pricey. We won't be going back, save your money and give it to a better restaurant on the riverfront!

In town for a night or two for my birthday Jared was a great bar tender friendly, funny and a great mixologist. He even recommended a place for great eats and (more) beer, Brasserie St James. The atmosphere here is fun and up to date yet cozy, music themed yet not too loud.

Never ever stay here, place is non friendly, totally non customer friendly. Owner claimed that unless you are staying here you can not visit friends by the pool (we where here for a birthday party). We wouldn't pay the $20 to park so we had to leave and so did everyone else. They are all about the money at this place. No thanks
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Absolutely the best tacos I've had .... I mean hands down ......I don't think I've had better.   Was passing through to the airport and stopped here for lunch,   Had the head meet and tongue tacos and both were delicious ...

A must try for anyone that enjoys tacos

Very authentic and delicious!! The best garlic knots and bread I've ever had. Perfect crisp while  soft and doughy. Stuffed mushroom were amazing and the spaghetti and meatballs were lovely. We finished with the lemon cake which reminds us of the lemon cake we had in Italy. Definitely must visit, we will be back very soon!

I got the small orange chicken which was super hot even when I got it home and the small felt like a large because I had a good amount of left overs. Plus it was delicious. So was the shrimp egg roll. And you can order online. And it's cheap. What more could you want? Nothing

Ryan and Shelita were incredibly accommodating and helpful! Nicest courtyard Marriott I've stayed at to date. Updated, clean, moderate price, comfy beds... Only complaint is the thin walls... But hey, we in #nawlins- you ain't spending time in the hotel ANYWAY!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've been staying in a nearby hotel and had walked past it several times before finally stopping in. The girl behind the counter was so friendly and patient, making sure everyone was given the time to taste the flavors they were considering.  Great price for the quality too.

We had a 7:30 reservation and 45 minutes later, our table is still not ready. The 10% off that the manager offered is not exactly cutting it for my first time here. We were told the reservation before ours came late, so it pushed everyone behind. How is that our fault?  I can tell you that I will NOT be coming back.

Is it standard company practice to require customers to beg for a packet of Arby's sauce?  I asked, multiple times, and still received none.  Not one packet in my bag.  Considering the luke warm, dry curly fries that accompanied my meal, the sauce is a bare minimum requirement to make them palatable.

Dined in once and had a great experience. Their meatballs are amazing and my boyfriend loved their pizza. Ordered take out today, got bruschetta. It was delicious and I loved that they put it on the side so the bread wasn't soggy when it got here. Awesome place. Highly recommend!

Wow.  4 people in line ahead of me.  Waited 10 minutes before realizing they skipped my drink.  After I reminded them no acknowledgement.  They did apologize when they delivered the drink, but the drink was terrible.  Tasted like pure milk with a bit of coffee instead of espresso.  Worst latte ever.  Wasted my money and time.

Great food - terrible to go service. Can not get an order right. Last 3 times they averaged 50% accuracy. Ill eat their great food but ill never order to go again. Management does not fix the problem, they argue. In house service is ok and the food is great.

Great little restaurant, with plans to expand.  I'm hooked on the Red Fish special item.  They change up the dish frequently which always keeps me ordering it.  Friendly wait staff and the owner is typically onsite asking how the experience was, which is great to see.

Great sushi prices during happy hour. Although, if you get all you can eat and order the nigiri, they will give you more rice than if you were to order from the regular menu. I guess it is their way to prevent you from eating too much. And you cannot leave any uneaten rive with AYCE.

This place is fine, but you get 30-40% less food than you expect for the price. Always leaves you hungry and grumbling about the price.

Go to Sushi Niwa or Sushi Ya instead. They'll make you happy for a better price + they're local businesses, not chains.

Horrible. The only place I used my credit card in Nashville was at this hotel. Well a month later I have the fraud department calling me about money missing from my account in Nashville. Someone who works here stole my credit card number and took out $1500 ! Shady people!! Ugh
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Have stayed at this hotel over 100 nights over past 3 years as the Iberville and now the Marriott , Great spot, Outstanding location  but since it reopened as a Marriott the service SUCKS! Don't get me wrong front desk is Great, car hops Great but food service now high priced Sucks
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Food was good but service was horrible. Taylor was the worst server I have ever had. She didn't listen to our order and it literally took us 3 hours to get dinner and drinks. Other servers around us seemed to be much more attentive than her but she really tainted the whole experience.

New owners at what was my favorite restaurant. Stopped in today for lunch and first bite of my steak I bit into a staple. The kind that holds paper together! Luckily I didn't swallow it or break a tooth.  Extremely disappointed and will never return. If you eat here check your food carefully before putting it in your mouth!

Nice place with reasonable price. As usual, it's an Americanized Japanese restaurant with heavy Cheese in sushi rolls :( but sashimi is quite good, with diversified choices. The service is nice, but the first order we had was completely lost...anyway it's considerable if you are hungry with sushi, especially the buffet menu.
