The hotel was very clean. However nothing worked. The phone didn't work the TV didn't work the faucet was broken. It's also not very close to downtown Nashville. Stains on the carpet in our bedroom. The best thing about this hotel was the bed it was extremely comfortable.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Tossing it up to an overall bad night for the kitchen.  

My Salmon Entree was served rare. My husband's Lamb was served well-done, dry and too chewy to be edible. The staff was kind but the chef's skills in running his kitchen are obviously inadequate. 

Never returning.

The atmosphere is loud, crowded, and fast paced you have to jump in and quickly yell your order lol but the grenade was very bomb lol get it Bomb (grenade) okay but yes I would definitely go back to Tropical Isle the next time I'm in New Orleans I was gone off of one drink.

I never complain, but Zama was a complete waste of time and money. The food was bland and texturally off -- I couldn't even finish my Dragon roll, despite still being hungry and its $15 price tag. Also we waited 45 minutes to get our very minimal order. Ridiculous.

A business lunch.  Very nice.  Great Waite staff.  Prompt service for drinks and bread.  Salads, soups, and appetizer.  I had the halibut entree.  Delicious.  We asked about the history and were told about the ghost sightings here.  After the lunch, the waitress gave a tour of the basement and the upstairs.

Met my expectations for a Hyatt place.  Same wherever you go with Hyatt place which is why it is nice.  One issue I had was there were ants in my room.  About 6 of them that I quickly sprayed with my hairspray.  I was going to change rooms but I was too tired.  I like this place bc of the hot breakfast. Full hot breakfast.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Place is nice, but poor people live here obviously. Amazon delivered packages to my front door a day I was not home. I got back the next day, they were stolen. Don't ever receive mail to your door, always the office so the broke ass people here don't take your hard earned stuffed.

The owner and staff made our evening really fun. We had a good time talking about many different traditional recipes.  I really enjoyed my Carne Asada and pork tacos.  They have the perfect combination of meat,  cilantro and diced fresh onion served inside tastey corn tortillas.  I'll be back to try fried ice cream and horchata!

Great restaurant!!!! Just recently moved to the area,so many italian restaurants to choose from but I'm glad I did! Awesome pizza, just plain cheese,yummy , blackened chicken with fetuccine pasta on a olive oil garluc sauce omg sooo good,the portion was great!! Great service! Im totally coming back! :)

Literally the worst customer experience.  Seriously, go out of business already.  Took my money, then denied my rental due to a friggen credit report?!  What the actual F? Your bullshit business practices will be shouted from the rooftops, have fun in bankruptcy.

Tried to make my Mother get a diagnosis for her brakes being out when they were working fine. Straight up lied to her face saying three of her tail lights did not work properly. 

Notes: You could get more sales by being honest and caring with your customers. 

Enjoy the low review for the crappy services provided.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
very clean inside
staff was incredibly nice
the lighting is very very dark
the lunch specials are great deals
i thought the rolls were better than the individual sushi pieces i got.
each order of sushi comes with two pieces, so its much more difficult to pick and choose as you can easily order too much food.

Amazing.  The food is always consistently great.  Our go to pizza place and everyone who has had it has nothing but great things to say about it! Owners are also super friendly.  Visited during the pandemic and really appreciate how serious they are taking the social distancing efforts.

Let me start by saying I don't like sushi....but this place made me change my view of sushi! This place is simply incredible. Everything is good! The tataki is extremely good and the dynamite will explode in your mouth...but don't take my word on it, try it for yourself!

Just left the Corner Bistro after a lovely lunch. Spouse started with the daily soup and I tried the black bean soup.  Both excellent. Spouse enjoyed the ham panini and I liked my risotto of the day, although a little bland. Well chosen wine list and nice vibe.

My husband and I went here to celebrate my sister in laws birthday. We all decided to get burgers and beers and wow... those burgers are no lie! Huge and delicious! Watched some Monday night football and enjoyed the bartenders company. I would absolutely go back again.

The food here was amazing and so was the staff. We got to try the tuna dumplings, gyoza, chicken teriyaki and sashimi. The sushi was delicious and fresh. The hibachi tasted great, and so was the performance! I also loved the interior of the restaurant and how clean it was kept. Definitely a gem that everyone should try!

Very inviting atmosphere.  The owner is very helpful and entertaining.  It's not like most laundromats where everyone seems miserable.  Also the dryers get hot fast. If you live in the quarter or if you're staying in the quarter this is the spot to check out.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: We eat here A LOT. It is one of our go-to places. The food is fantastic and the bread sticks are incredible. The Italian dressing is great but we prefer the creamy Italian.  Very friendly staff that remember you :). Seriously one of the best casual dining places we have ever experienced and I'm over 50.

The service is great! A unique twist on tapas for South Tampa. 

Can't miss items:
- Mexican Corn
- Watermelon Jalapeño Margarita (not too spicy)
- Duck Taco(s)

Make sure to get there early on a Friday or Saturday with wait times over an hour sometimes. It's worth the wait!

The ambience was nice.  Has a bit of a romantic feel.  The menu had some exciting options, but none of them lived up to expectations.  In the end, it was a fairly expensive meal with very average tasting food in a fun atmosphere. We have enjoyed many better meals in the area.  Service was very good, which made it enjoyable.

I've learned to never order avocado at a restaurant that doesn't serve Mexican food. I should have followed my instinct and not ordered the avocado BLT. It was terrible. Avocado was served about a month before it was ready. Others in the restaurant had the same issue.

I was in the area for one day before heading to Santa Barbara and called this salon. They are open from 9a-7pm. I got a mani pedi and thought the staff did an excellent job. They were super nice. I had an American French manicure, which took quite a bit of time. I will definitely return when I am back in the area.

Went there this evening 11/12/14.  All of the staff were warm and welcoming.  We had the Korean salad, lamb and vegetable curry and coconut almond pie for dessert.  Everything was perfectly done.  Have to put in a good word for our great waiter, Ben.  Thanks for a wonderful evening!

I read the reviews of this DD and was hesitant on stopping by here but my experience was fantastic! Enough for me to write a review and I never take the time to write reviews. The drive thru staff was incredibly kind and respectful. My coffee was perfect and the donuts were fresh. Definitely one of the best DD I've been thru.

I was in Nashville for work so I ventured out for dinner and saw a Jeni's across the street. I've never seen a Jeni's in Texas so decided to stop for a sweet treat! The ice cream there is amazing. They also have no -dairy options if you are lactose intolerant or don't eat dairy! The staff is friendly and customer service was great.

Got brought here for my birthday (here right now) and not only were the margaritas awesome , but the bartender bought us a shot. When we got dinner it was delicious , service magnificent and did I mention how good the margaritas are? We'll be back for sure! Oh yeah,  the bathrooms are so cute!

Tasty, quality  ice cream, we love the product. However, last Friday night had 2 servers that acted as if they had much more pressing things to do than serve ice cream.  I 'll have a hard time bringing my fam back there due to lack of customer service. Never make a customer feel like you're doing them a favor.

I went there for a gel fill and Amy was my nail tech. It took about 40 minutes and she charged me $55. I couldn't believe it. All I had done was a fill and mood polish. I have NEVER paid $55 For a fill. Don't go there. It's a rip off!! I was totally robbed!

I went there for highlights and my stylist did NOT get the color right. I left in tears because the color was awful!! Not only was the color awful but they are over priced for   something you don't love. I paid $200 for hair that made me cringe!! Never will I go back!

This is legit the slowest budget rental I've ever been to. The line was 8 deep with 1 person on shift for Avis and budget. Some guy walked out form the back and left the poor woman by herself. She called and called for help. Finally help arrived and it was the same person that left 10 mins earlier.

Came in first thing and just felt rushed as more people showed up. Kept trying to sell me on services I did not want. Pedicure was fine but my manicure was very poorly done. Lumpy and uneven, probably because she was distracted the whole time answering the phone and making calls. Unfortunately not impressed at all.

First time using this facility. I used the free coupon that Nissan 422 gave me. If it wasn't free, I wouldn't get my car washed here. It's overpriced and the guy who worked there is not so friendly. $10 for a basic wash?! Cash only? Car came out clean though.

Class-A barbershop and open on Sunday's to boot. They've decorated the space to give it an old style gentleman's feel and they've done a fair job. Regardless, it seems the barbers make an effort to get to know you and to understand your needs. 

I'm a fan. Definitely on my keeper list.

Went in for our anniversary dinner and enjoyed every dish that came out. Not your typical omakase and that's what made it stand out for us. Sometimes we get torn between if we wanted sushi or NOLA cuisine. This restaurant gives you both! Love the atmosphere of the restaurant.  We definitely will be going back.

I've waited almost 20 minutes for one cup of French Vanilla Coffee and when i finely said something about it the manager said everybody is called in order. I've watched several people get coffee that was in line behind me. I do give props to the cashier she spoke up and said she forgot.

Very nice bar! Everyone was very friendly! I went especially for the famous Seafood Potato and it was delicious! Seems like a nice lil whole in the wall if you're in your 30's and up....kool place to hang out and have a few drinks and listen to some good ol music.

With this particular location I'm not a big fan.  JThey are always running out of paper towels at some of the sanitation station, and it's not as clean as the other PF's I've been too.  The staff is very friendly, however, I'll be switching to another location.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This market has it all. Fresh is where it is at. If you looking to prepare a easy meal there are tons of items to choose from.  Vegetarian and plenty of meats from the deli and even roast chicken. Beer and wine along with a variety of ice cold non-alcoholic beverages to choose from.

I've been here a couple times now with my sorority, group of about 30. Service is fast and friendly. Workers are so chill. Food is perfect texture and temp. Their garlic bread is so flavorful and perfect soft/crunch. My go-to is their chicken broccoli alfredo pasta,,, so yummy. One of my fav Italian restaurant to dine in at.

This shop makes, hands down, the best cheese steak in Delaware.  Also, we love the Italian subs and fries, well done as ordered.  The folks working there are incredibly nice, and the service is great - they get you in and out for take out.  My only complaint is that this shop is cash only.

I had my hair cut twice there and they did a great job. Twice was done by the female hairdresser. I am too shy to post pictures here but let me just say this, after the haircut, my coworkers told me "your haircut looks great and is it expensive? It looks very stylish ". They definitely know how to make Asian guy hair look great!

Fantastic food. Wine by the glass not too good, you get half a glass. Better off with a bottle or half. Family style meal for 2 or 4 is a 7 course meal! Well worth the money. The staff are very attentive. You need reservations to ensure a table. Plan on 2 hours at least.

I don't normally leave bad reviews, but longest wait in a drive thru for only 2 cars in front of us. The reason why I'm even leaving a review is the customer service was just flat. The lady taking care of us should have a least smiles or something. We didn't get an apology or anything.

Usually like the service they provide. Last visit was dismayed to find that my wife's tuna sandwich had red sauce where the knife from a previous customers meatball sandwich. I couldn't believe that they would not even try to clean their utensils between sandwiches.

The slowest Dunkin' Donuts I've ever been to. If you're in a rush or on your way to work don't come here.  Thankfully I give myself enough time, because if I didn't I would be late every day. So far I have been waiting 20 minutes for my order of 2 sandwiches and 2 coffees. Also, they are always out of something.

In town from KC for the Women's March and found this place. Excellent. From the time you walk in the door the host Max signals you have certainly picked the right place. I had the strip steak. Wow. We sat at the bar where service was attentive and comfortable. These people make it more than just great food!

The food was good but the atmosphere of the restaurant wasn't great. I would only recommend for takeout. Dining in was not a great experience. They need a serious remodel and the buffet barely looked subpar. The entire time we were there they didn't change one dish on the buffet so I really don't recommend that.

If you are looking for "Fast Food", this is not where you want to go. We went through the Drive Thru and from the point of taking our order to handing us our food it was 20 minutes. On top of that, we checked to make sure we had the correct order and our fries were ice cold.

Overall great dining experience. Creative dishes using only the finest ingredients. If you are looking for something different but tasty give it a try. Good service and lovely ambiance led to a great dinner. Be prepared to make a reservation as this place can get busy. Well worth the $

Literally took me like 5 tries to get my car in the right position. But the cleaning was amazing and my car is shining like I just bought it from the dealership. This was a wonderful first experience as this was literally my first time using a car wash. I will be coming back guarantee.

Was so happy to be rid of B of A. But now, I just noticed the credit union charged me an $18 overdraft fee. Apparently because they are holding a credit for a check I deposited yesterday (Sat) in their ATM. Bank of America gave me 100% credit on ATM check deposits immediately, so that's disappointing, and just lost ya a star. Boo!

Ate here for lunch today. Waitress was attentive and pleasant. Music was too loud. I ordered the hibachi shrimp. It was quit good. I felt that for what I received on a lunch menu was a little pricey. $16 for lunch (drank water and includes tip) is too high. Other than that, not bad.

This service has been fantastic.  I would stay here over and over again. Great customer service.  I would recommend this place to anyone. I had a problem with bathroom  they fixed it n was so nice about it. Great service. 
Thank you letting me stay in your suites.  The trouble .maker.. lol
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is the worst hotel I've ever been to. I had to go to 12 different floors to find a working ice machine. The bed had a poop mark on the bed, there was a bee in the bathroom. The pillows don't have pillowcases. The TV looks like it's from 2005. The elevator sucks. It's an awful hotel don't stay here!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Nice place. But........

We came with our kids to see a game. The music was so loud after we got home around 10:00. Went on until closing time.... it was very very loud. Hard to sleep. Would not recommend unless you are going to go out parting as well and be home with the rest of the nightlife...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Fantastic food and a great space. The service was solid considering it was their opening weekend.  The pastas we tried were great, especially the gnocchi. Great short rib and awesome branzino.    Thrilled to have a great Italian byob in the neighborhood and will be back again asap.

Or the best service, but not the worst.  They have limited vehicles and the service is slow.  They were accommodating, but you have to push for it.  It's not apart of their standard protocol.  The shuttle service is lacking as well, take the Avis shuttle and walk to the budget area (100ft).

For being a pet friendly hotel they have no area for pets. The lady at the desk told us we could take our dog to the park that was a few miles away to use the restroom. Would not recommend this place for people with dogs. Rooms were clean and nice but they should have an area for pets.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Pretty good sushi at this place. I came here with a group and they were very accommodating and allowed us to customize our meals. I got a great cucumber avocado roll that was delicious. Very well priced and a great selection too. I would definitely recommend it for a casual dinner out.

The doctor of optometry was great!  My daughter has been to several other ODs and this doc blew them all away with an excellent exam.  It may take a while, but the quality and service are worth it.  The glasses however are very expensive, best to take the script elsewhere.  That being said, they were ready in one day - ONE DAY!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This place always goes above and beyond with making their food. I can tell the take pride in what they serve you. I've eaten here for takeout numerous times for my employees and they never have disappointed. I will always recommend this business to anyone wanting authentic Mexican food. Amazing flavor and so fresh. I love it.

My husband and I have dined here about 4 times.  Each visit has been top notch.  Everything tastes fresh and the service is very good.  The rolls usually have a unique and yummy twist.  Out of the many sushi choices in Reno, this is one of our most favorite.

We came here after seeing the reviews and the decent ratings however that is where it ended. Service was in attentive. Pizza was lackluster. You're not that far from Reilly's down the road which is overall significantly better.  Won't be a returning customer.

Of all the little Mexican places I've tried in South Philly this place is by far my favorite! I always get the chicken tacos and an order of guacamole and both are consistently excellent. I've never been disappointed. They are fast and reasonably priced and deliver (usually) too!

Best food in town!!! The porkette sandwich and cheesesteaks are out of this world!! And for dinner my favorite is the Sunday gravy!! Everything is so fresh and delicious! They certainly don't skimp on portion size either.  And when you go don't forget to order the butter cake!!!

Found this spot by mistake as I was wondering around the area. They have tacos  in various types of meet they are small so you might have to double your order. My favorite was the Pastor (pork) they have good flavor. The carne asada (flank steak) was ok need a little more seasoning.

This is the beat Italian in town! On a date, with family, friends, or even if you just want a great place to eat for the evening, this place is the best place. A small place, but very friendly service and even more amazing food! I went with a few of my family and I ordered the baked lasagna. Perfectly cheesy and so delicious!

Staff was great. The food was good. They do have a really small menu though. I was a little disappointed with selection. I would like to have seen more steaks and vegetable selections. Its a sports pub food type selection. But it was quiet and warm and food was good. The inside of the restaurants is really pretty.

Great vanilla late! Within walking distance to all of that the Gulch in Nashville has to offer. Baristas were very friendly. The furniture was cozy and even had built in outlets. The fresh flowers made for a nice environment. I could see how this place could get crowded very easily, as it is connected to a hotel.

Absolutely terrible. I ordered through Uber eats, and when it was delivered it was missing several items. I called and the two workers were fighting with each other about whose fault it was ... the the manager told me to come get my food and hung up on me. I will never order from here or come here again.

Wow!  A great server was icing on the cake! Thank you Samantha for suggesting the Sherry Vinegarette salad dressing -  that was definitely a treat!  And the Spaghetti Pomodoro with meat sauce was excellent - maybe the best i've ever had!  

Need a good wine choice?  Get a bottle of 14 Hands Cabernet Sauvignon.  Nice!

If we're going to pay $5 for custard, I wish they wouldn't leave the middle hallow. I'm still in love with the water ice and custard, but this has happened about three times. I'm not sure if this is how it's supposed to be done, but it hasn't been like this before.

Love the station tap house! Been here a few times now. Food overall is very good. Standard bar food with burgers and very good apps. The beer selection is very good as well (around 40 on tap). Large bar offers plenty of seating. Outdoor patio is great as well. Definitely will keep coming back.

I recommend the grenade on the rock (so did the bartender!)

I tried both versions but the frozen grenade was a lot sweeter for some reason and it was a lot more pleasant to drink it on the rock.

I normally don't like overly sweet drinks, but I enjoyed it a lot.

Very rude staff! I felt like I was at the TSA security check point again (FYI if you didn't already know TSA staff are just about the rudest people ) I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND this car rental place. They nickel and dime you to death and still treat you like crap.
There are plenty of other places to choose from.

Seriously, this wood oven pizza is the best in the entire Tucson area. Every time we come here, we have great service, great food and their wood fired bread is great. Great happy hour. Good for kids, they even have mini pizzas for them! We are from San Francisco and we're so happy to find this place!

Not impress with resturant i order a Burrito and 2 tacos burrito was 98 rice and beans  no meat what so ever tacos came late service its low wont come here aguin  taco bell its much better guess this people in Tampa DOES NOT KNOW much about Real Mexican food

Food was decent but nothing to write home about. We got a pitcher of house margs that was disappointing, tasted like Jose Cuervo marg mix just dumped into a nice pitcher. Table to server ratio seemed a bit much and made it difficult for our server to be attentive to our table.

Extremely thankful for this place.  Very really reasonably priced, the barbers are all excellent, and Matt hooks me up with an awesome cut every time.  Tried a bunch of other shops in the Philly area before trying Upper Cuts, and nothing else comes close.  You guys are amazing!

My daughter found this place and they are the BEST ever. Honest! Today they quoted $418 on a repair and then charged only $367 saying they over bid it!!!!! Was quoted $600 for the same repair by another shop. Same thing with other repairs, they are honest and do a great job!!!! I want everyone to know how wonderful this shop is!!!!

Foods mediocre, relatively cheap.  Got the sweet and sour pork combination during the evening while the buffet was closed. Service is ridiculously slow, maybe it's too much to ask for a refill for my drink or non overdone food. 

Atmosphere is ok, restaurant is basically dead at 8:30 pm on a Wednesday.

The service was good, but all six of us with different dishes, fajitas, tacos al carbon, flautas, tortilla soup, enchiladas, and taco salad, would rate the food as blah.  If you are looking for Mexican food with any kick (we love SoCal and Tex Mex) this is not your place.

Zero stars.  Seven people working, only one is a cashier and 17 people in line.  And yet there are still 6 people waiting in their food. Who trained these people? And now it's Credit or Debit only.  Does the King know they're allergic to cash here!?  After waiting 18 minutes in line they had no Chicken Fry Rings.

Amazing food! Crusts and olive oil is shipped from Italy. Everything we tried (meatballs, pizza, olive oil) was full of savory flavor. Pizza crust has the perfect crunch on bottom and soft on top combo. The wine selection is great. We enjoyed a bottle of Italian red that did not disappoint. Highly recommend this place!

We've never been able to find a seat in the past, finally landed a table on a Saturday night!  Raving reviews prior, but today the place was nearly vacant.  Waiter did a great job, wine was good, but the entree could use some improvement.  Keep striving for excellence, you've got the demographics to support top notch!

Traveling through from out of state. Sat in line for over 20 minutes. Everyone is leaving the line because it's taking so long. No one answered me at the speaker, so I had to pull forward to the window. All for a coffee so I can get back to Ohio! Worst experience trying to get a coffee ever. Wasted so much time here, incredible.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I have ordered from UFO many times.  They have courteous delivery drivers and their donairs and pizzas are awesome. My picky five year old loves their donairs and wants to order from here all the time. Their sauce is awesome. I always get the tzatziki but their sweet sauce is really good too.

Very cool atmosphere. Very creative menu. Maybe a bit too creative on the night my husband and I went. I had an interesting beet salad he had carrot soup. That we had the he enjoyed the local beer we had the broccoli risottoand the broccoli was undercooked.

I ordered online. Went to drive through but no one would respond. Several cars were in the drive through line and everyone eventually just had to leave and drive away. Wasted 20 minutes of my time after our late basketball game. Now I need my money refunded for my mobile order. Terrible business!

Although the drive-thru line routinely spills into main thoroughfare during peak hours (6-10 am), going inside saved me tons of time. Took less than 5 minutes to order and receive my drink.

Fully staffed with friendly folks! Very clean and cozy atmosphere inside.

It's been 5 years now three break ins  personally way too many in general to keep track of god forbid asking for something u will will ether get somebody that tells you they understand how u feel or treat u like you stupid and act passive aggressive 9-1-21

Do not stop here. Waited over 20 minutes in the drive through- 20 freaking minutes for chicken nuggets and fries for my 2.5 year old son. When we finally got up to window, everyone is just standing around and sat another 3 minutes at the window. Everyone looks like they don't want to be there- Do not stop here!

I was just spending a day in Clearwater with friends and had to checkout the place according to all the reviews! We had a blast! We took couple different items from the menu so we can cry them all, and we loved it!! Margaritas were amazing and made with fresh fruit!!! All the staff was friendly and it was good atmosphere!

Kristen and her crew are extremely informative on what I need for my vehicles. Just purchased an Audi but for years brought my Chevy here for its check ups and repairs, etc. I can always count on the Midas crew on Chelten Ave! I highly recommend heading down there for services and such, you will not be disappointed! :)
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Very disappointing. For the higher cost of rooms here, the value is simply not. We reserved a suite which was a dumpy small room. Room was cold and drafty an, overlooked Church street where traffic was noisy. It's simply not worth staying here. Dumpy and old. Avoid this place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Besides location there is no reason to stay at this hotel.  The rooms and hallways are cramped and it's clear there was a recent sub-par renovation.  The staff is courteous and the restaurant\bar is great, but that's not enough reason to stay at the Le Meridian.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We were staying in Reno for a few days and wanted tacos for dinner. Came to this taqueria and loved it! All the menu items are so good! We had a party of 15 and got everything in the menu! If you order asada tacos they come with hand made tortilla! My favorite items were vampiro de asada and al pastor tacos!

Not fast food but not slow either,  order at the counter they make it and bring it out. Very friendly staff. They have a couple italian beers and a small selection of wines. I had pizza, best in sherwood park. The meatballs in my wife's pasta pomodoro, amazing. Definitely  coming back again.

I must say that thus was a good stay when it started. The manager the second day after approaching her with an issue was very rude n tried to claim that we had too be charged more for smoking. I have a 5 6 9 and 14 yr old so who was somking. I do not amoke nor does my wife. All this because the room was not cleanes
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My family and I visit this restaurant on a weekly basis - we LOVE it!  The food is fantastic and always super quick service.  Sure, there's been a couple nights that it was slower than usual, but never where it's been a real problem.  Definitely recommend it!

The food is as consistently good as the server's!  Our family is glad to support a local neighborhood spot.  My favorites include the carnitas, the steak fajita burrito and the Chile relleno paired with a large cold beer!  Sit in the bar area and Raphael and Juan will take care of you.  Family friendly!!

Fish was raw in the middle. Sent back came back and was still undercooked. 
Had to ask for a refill of tea then server refilled it. Never came back to refill my drink again or was never offered a refill sat for about 30 minutes after eating. Very poor service.

I have two complaints.  One is the unreliable complimentary internet!  Of course, If you are unhappy with this they have a premium wi fi you can purchase....  Complimentary meals were served on cold plates.  Food, especially breakfast, is mostly cold by the time you find a table.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The food was great, the service was questionable.  The waitress forgot O ordered soup not salad.  I got salad but it was a quick fix.  She exchanged it but when she carries the bowl of soup, her thumb wad in it!  Other than that, the pork kastu don was great. Get the tempura appetizer!

This was amazing! I went with two friends and we ordered one of each, pizza, pasta, and salad. We all loved everything we ordered, but each had our individual favorites.  I have been craving that pasta again ever since I finished my very generous leftovers.  Favorite pasta in Tucson so far!

Very nice dinner and reasonably priced for the value. The piano man was a nice touch.  I would recommend three improvements to really pack the place.  A brighter sign outside, a wall fireplace and warm bread.  The bread was good but would be better if warmed up a little..  We will definitely come back.

Got the special today. The whole under carriage of my vehicle was still dirty. Bringing it to the attention of the worker and he used a dirty rag and didn't even get it clean. Asked them to remove my tire cover and they didnt and now it's scratched. Not worth my time.

Excellent coffee and a good atmosphere. We got the Kyoto and a Cappuccino. The owner was kind enough to explain how the kyoto coffee was made. Its brewed in something that looks like its out of a 1920s mad scientist laboratory. If you have a passion for coffee definitely stop by and get it.

Generally, we had a good stay. I'm only giving 3 stars because although I can appreciate the age of the hotel, the remodel leaves something to desire. No carpet in the room left very cold floors and if you're over 6 feet tall, showering will be a challenge.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Terribly long line with one guy working the regular line. Way less shuttles than all the other rental places. Landed at 3:30, just got to the front of the line at 5:15. Go anywhere else.  Then got a car with a gouged tire that was clearly low.  Then they were rude when we asked for a new car.

Pizza is made the same place he washes his underwear. He has a horrible temper, and if you disagree with him in any way he calls it slander and threatens to take you to court. He doesn't make his pizza's properly (no gluten free choices either). Also, he has irregular hours. He also has a record and owes many people $$

My partner and I came in on Valentine's night - we completely forgot it was a "holiday" and they were completely booked with a prefixe menu. We found seats at the bar and chose a few items from the a la carte menu that were quite good. The margaritas weren't too sweet and strong enough for us. Great atmosphere, friendly staff.

Inside this little hole-in-the-wall location is an awesome staff, fantastic chefs, and great food. Top it all of with really good prices. 

The outside looks pretty non-descript. Totally hiding a fantastic place.  The quality easily rivals Wild Ginger and Peter's Sushi, for half the price.

Visiting the Corner Bistro for dinner where the staff is very warm and kind, yet the food was a stocking expectation. I was just down for the weekend and wanted to get a feel of Delaware and I got it at the Corner Bistro. I'll stop back by for lunch next time...thanks a bunch.

Awful pedicure from a woman who did not speak any English and could not understand anything. She cut my toe in two places, was supper slow, and changed the price on me at the end. I didn't even bother getting polish- going somewhere else to have a proper pedicure when my toes heals.  Don't waste your time at this nail salon.

Can't leave zero stars but this place is awful. I waited more than 20 minutes for a McNuggets happy meal and a quarter pounder with cheese. Plus the people that work here are just unhappy. Get another job if you don't like what you do but don't take it out on the customers that are keeping you employed. #mcdonaldssucks.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I AM BEYOND PISSED WITH THIS SUBWAY. I was trying to do a carry out order. The phone rang for 3 minutes before they answered. Then after answering, they had me on hold for 12 minutes. An employee asked if I was still waiting. I said I'd like to make a carry out order. Then she hung up.

I mean Subway is already pretty much a first job for most of their employees, but really avoid coming here on a weekend. These employees literally had no idea how to address customers and had no sense of organization. At least they seemed busy by running back and forth and throwing things everywhere.

We came here with a soccer team and they arranged a select menu and had everything ready. The food came out fast and the service was excellent. The quality of food was great. We did call ahead same day and they were able to accommodate 32 of us. I strongly recommend it!!

My first visit to Louie's and I have no complaints. It was a Tuesday so Lasagne was the day's special and it was delicious. There was a salad before and enough lasagne to take home a lunch portion for the next day. Our server, Brooke, was attentive and helpful. I look forward to dining there again.

Pizza with pepperoni was excellent,  big & loaded with pepperoni. Have been on limited diet in rehab/nursing home for a year. Rehab is next door to Angelo's, a friend called & charged the pie for me. Price okay. Will hopefully shame another friend into getting me another pie.

My god. Ordered a Large Pizza last night and I'm still feeling the ramifications of just a few slices. I definitely got food poisoning Ive been having the works I don't have to tell you. Essentially I would never eat there again the food does not settle well.

Based on the other blood spatter pictures of rooms in this hotel my assessment is that it's an obvious place for needle users to hang out in. The front desk is not customer friendly. The escalator and front revolving door are broken. You'd be an idiot to not realize this is a junkie hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Basic manicure $20 which is more than average...usually around $15. However she did a nice job and I got a glass of wine so no complaints. I do love the cool vibe of the nail bar. Great place for a group of girlfriends. Still have $61 on a gift card so I'll be back!

This place is everything a local business should be. The staff is warm, friendly, and knowledgeable; the prices are fair; the selection is excellent. The owner is a local who has been a community member for years and years. I have never gotten a bad recommendation for a bottle of wine or whiskey here.

I had a great experience with Kylie as well. She has an awesome attitude and is super talented. My hair was in terrible condition when I walked in and when I left my hair was so soft and shiny. My fiance couldn't stop touching it. It finally looked and felt healthy.  I will always recommend her to my friends and family.

My ONE and ONLY stop for drive-thru daiquiris!! Has specials during the week and even has Long Islands that WILL knock you on your ass (Thursday's is the day for those, 32oz for $5.25 and 44oz for $7.25). So if you're in the Metairie area make sure this is your MUST stop for The Original New Orleans Daiquiri!!

The rooms and hotel were nice. Service in the restaurants was poor. I ordered a steak medium rare that came well, when I asked to have it right I was given a steak that was rare,pure grizzle veggies uncooked and didn't arrive until everyone else had finished so had it boxed and didn't find out how bad it was until after I paid.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Said always gives clutch haircuts!! I've been coming to him for four years and he never disappoints! If you're even thinking about going anywhere else - DON'T! If you take the $10 special at Great Clips, you'll regret it! And if you're a barber looking for a place to set up shop, get in touch with Said. Great guy, great cuts!!

The ice cream flavors were fairly unique (or else uniquely named). The staff was nice. I think i sampled most flavors before settling on salted peanut butter with chocolate chips in a waffle cone. I tasted great and the waffle cone was fresh! I enjoyed every bite!

Don't stay here! There are stains on the sheets, the floor, the furniture. There are roaches and there isn't really a breakfast at all. There are bananas and old muffins. It is dirty and things are broken. Seriously. The Econo Lodge next door looks way better, if that tells you how bad this place is.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: i have had many issues since the original owners left. but today was the worst. i sat at the speaker for 4 ues 4 minutes and the girl was still not ready to take my order. i left without ordering. there were 2 vehicles im front of me so it wasnt as tho they were busy.

Great atmosphere got seated relatively quickly for it being a Friday night without a reservation. The service wasn't great though. Waited about and hour and fifteen minutes for our food but it was delicious. Great food with great atmosphere. Definitely going again.

Wife had to cancel her membership because of work issues.  Been trying since july.  She submits to cancel and calls to confirm they received her email.  She was informed that it would be cancelled.  Then later they claim they never received anything.  They are a ripoff. 
About to start civil proceedings.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This is the worst experience ever.  Watching and listening to deak agents argue over a work schedule using profanity.  Being told that my wife "should" have my same last name.  The nondiscreet credit check at the counter.  The most unprofessional place ever!!! Terrible way to start a weekend visit to  Philadelphia.

Great selection of ice cream, if that's all you're wanting to get. Customer service could be better. They even stopped letting people in before their closing time. Milkshakes are TRASH. We ordered the chocolate shake and it tasted watered down. Would not return.

I have travelled to Tucson a few times over the past two years. This gym is conveniently located and easily accessible. The staff is super friendly and the gym itself is the cleanest I have ever been to. I highly recommend it if you are living or staying nearby.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Love this sweet shop. They do regular tastings and I always buy here for wedding gift baskets and special occasion gifts. They are great at recommendations in your budget range and help you explore new finds. Love the Centellino Wine Aerator the best and the chocolate-covered red wine bottle!! Yumm.

Love this place! I've been here a few times, and I am always impressed with how fresh the food is. The all you can eat option is a great deal of you are feeling pretty hungry! I would definitely recommend Sushi Club to anyone in the mood for some fresh sushi.

Never ever would stay there again!!!!
I would rate it as a 0 star motel
Staff is rude 
Rooms smell so bed 
Building is old 
I wouldn't recommend you guys to go there
Better pay extra $20 and find nice hotel by the beach 
This one doesn't worth staying there even a night
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Seriously. Over an hour and a half for delivery for 2 subs and cheese bread. Now I remember why I stopped ordering from them. It still isn't here, but I'm sure it will be cold.
***Update***
2 hours waiting now. I called 45 minutes ago and was told they were on the way. We live 5 miles away. Called and was put on hold forever.

I'm wary of putting my car through machine washes like these and will always prefer a hand wash BUT this shop is different. You drive onto a conveyor belt, hit N and once you're done & park to vacuum, there's always been someone to offer to help you finish giving your car a clean. A1 customer service and a good wash. Will be back.

Super disappointed today. I haven't been in a few months and decided to try Hai Street again. Their menu has changed and the quality has definitely diminished. I got the salmon citrus bowl and the salmon looks and tastes like it was prepared before Christmas. Yuck. Won't try again

I ordered takeout from Vic's last night. I thought the sushi was good; however, I think that the edamame I ordered had already gone bad! It was very dried out and parts of it were brown. I would order from this place again...but I will probably stay away from the edamame and other salads.

I went to this McDonald's 5 times over the summer at lunch time and each time the food was the best I've ever had from a McDonald's. Very fresh and the time from ordering to getting the bag was maybe a minute at the most. I don't know what the lunchtime management at this location is doing but keep it up!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We were so excited about this new location opening. We've been there several times and every single time the order is messed up. They can't seem to get coffee right to save their lives. I am a huge fan of Dunkin Donuts but this location will never receive my business again.

Smells like stale smoke. They gave us 1 pillow. There were 2 of us and I'm 8 months pregnant. There was no shower curtain. There were no instruments for cooking. There was 1 face towel. Umm... The fridge was cold and there were no bugs which was great. Meanwhile, not a place we would ever come to again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Excellent customer service. Will definitely be back. Tatyana is so sweet. Didnt catch the managers name but she is very engaged and you can tell she genuinely cares for the guests staying here and the experience they have. My first review but very deserved.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I just got my car done by these folks and am very pleased. I watched the technician do the work and he was very thorough. They did a detail with wax ans was 30% cheaper than a competitor to whom I did not take my car due to bad reviews. When folks do a good job I like to say so!!
Thanks!

I went in and ask for a gel color change, was told $20. OK, got the job done and the lady said sorry she was wrong it's $25. I said, you can't change the price after the fact. 
And the person that did my toes said no $20 okay. This is the second time they did that to me. Won't be going back.

first time stopping by, they were okay had tacos de asada these tacos are actually the "carne asada" cut up into pieces. not much flavor very simple taco. i expected more flavor and juicy meat but pretty dry. the only BEST part was they had grilled onions and jalapeños super spicy loved that.

I recently moved to the area. My boyfriend and I decided to stop by and grab a bite to eat, everything was great. I got a veggie wrap and he got a cheesesteak. The food was fresh, and hit the spot. And the service was fast. I'll definitely be back. Btw their french fries are awesome.

Arrived 10:00am . Ordered breakfast meals. Paid at window. Please pull up. Making you a fresh pot of coffee. Waited 10-15 minutes, got out of the car and went in. Sorry sir, waiting on the eggs. 5 minutes later she comes out with 2 bags, no coffee. What a joke.

Very nondescript food. We were quite disappointed with both the food and the service. The shredded chicken in the taco and enchilada was tough and tasteless. The chips were not fresh or crispy. We would not ever go here again. A waste of money and calories.

The employees at this starbucks are awful. Simple requests made drinks worse. All i ask was for to shake the drink.. one dude said he did when clearly the green tea sat on the bottom of the cup. And the girl dumped out the drink out of anger, and remade a drink that was no bueno.

Stay away from ALL U CAN EAT.   Sushi was ok, few rolls that absolutely had no taste. Also careful about hidden charges. " wasteful food". I ordered a roll that tasted disgusting. Because I didn't eat 3 pieces we were charged. Not happy with this place. However... our waitress was super sweet.

I'm debating whether or not two stars are a  generous review. The young lady working the shop was very cold and obviously didn't want to be working. I ordered a soy latte with a shot of peppermint, instead I received something that taste like a wet dog with NO hint of peppermint bath wash.

I don't usually post reviews but I've been going to FBG for years and I've never had bad food! Tonight it's like 90 degrees outside but I got soup to go and it's delicious as always! Also got just a dinner salad with grilled chicken and it's amazing too!  Love the servers and the service! Always a fun time with good food and drink!

Worth going when it's crowded, but unfortunately the food does sit around for a bit if there's no crowd. The sushi is good, but is actually kind of pricey! I would recommend going during happy hour or on weekend nights only. I live a block away, so I really want to like this place!

Refuse to help at all. They hang up on you (On the rare occasion they answer). Snide and Rude, like you are such an inconvenience. Save yourself the trouble and money, go somewhere else. It is just stress and headache. If you are looking for a peaceful place to live. This is not it.

Do not do mobile orders at this restaurant. They confirm that you've gotten your order even without bringing it to you. This has happened to me twice, the first time I actually got my order so I gave them the benefit of the doubt the second time around. Waste of time and money if I even end up getting a refund.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Well, I had high hopes for them but was left lacking. The pizza we ordered tasted like a glorified cheese bread. The staff wasn't very personable and i felt like I was just stared at, no smiles or "welcome in". I'll give them another shot but I hope it's a lot better.

I just moved in and paid first months rent on the 24th of December, then we get noticed on the 18th of January that we missed rent on the first of January? Okay for one that's bullshit, the new management is shitty and wrong for this because I paid for a whole month already .

Beware of this McDonald's. An employee from here is taking pictures of credit cards and using the cards. When you go through drive thru watch the person taking your money. They will steal from you. Be vigilant. We work hard for our money, and managers here at this McDonalds don't care.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Absolutely lovely and delicious. We had a large group enjoy a perfect evening (and celebration) at Rosa Bianca, with great service and great food (so many items on the menu made it difficult to choose but at the end everything was so good we tried everything). I will be back soon :) and many other times.

Great eye care! Very professional and friendly!! Recently had to get my reading glasses repaired and absolutely no problem, and it was under warranty. They even gave me a loaner pair with the original lenses while they processed a new replacement pair.  Great location for our family!  Would highly recommend VsionOne!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
This salon is clean which is appreciated.  
But it was not a good pedicure.  The women didn't even remove all the nail polish!  Made it seem like she was doing me a favor, no as a paying customer.  They are cheap M-W so they have that going for them.  But I wouldn't recommend if you want a job well done.

They sat our group over an hour after our reservation. Then told us if we order apps it would prolong our entrees, so basically recommended against it. The food is always great. But the service was really weird this night. No apologies, not stopping by from a manager.

Theme worst food I've ever ordered from DoorDash. My 2 kids and I each took a bite of our meals and threw the rest out. Placed hot food onto of sushi, so the sushi was warm. It smelled of bad fish. I had the chicken teriyaki, and it was oddly cooked to where it had an odd texture. Barely any sauce. Even my steamed rice tasted off.

I personally have always had a great experience here. The staff is always friendly and always gets my food and coffee out in a fast and friendly manner. Mike always greets me with a smile on his face. This is the only Dunkin I go to in the Indianapolis area from now on.

First of all, have a sweater or jacket if you plan on eating there...its freezing inside.  After we placed our order, we asked for a glass of water to drink.  They could not, would not give us water!  We don't drink soda. Out the door we went!  Note -  the place was empty!

I have been living at sawmill almost 2 yrs 
And I feel overall satisfied .  The landscape 
Sets a nice tucked away setting  .  Close drive to airport and malls etc . For the most part 
Quiet living with no negative distractions. 
Staff is very friendly and attentive to any needs that may arise. I would recommend to anyone.

I ordered a large coffee cream only. It came with cream and sugar so I took it back to counter. Guy at the counter went back where I could not see came back in 30 seconds and said sorry and handed coffee to me. It also had sugar in it. Guess he thought he could save a coffee but HE INSTEAD LOST A CUSTOMER. Good going Dude.

For a Sunday evening dinner, the place was alright.  For a Mexican restaurant the menu is very limited, as is the drink selection..  Had the chicken taco and it was good, but I think you can get a lot more for 10 bucks around here *nyc* so maybe I'm just spoiled in that sense.

I was kindly greeted upon entering the office and helped immediately; the agent was friendly and very just overall awesome.  This was the best experience I have had while renting a vehicle.  I would definitely recommend Alamo to anyone looking for a no nonsense process, great rates and amazing service.

Location was great if you are visiting the historic district. The decor is tired. The rugs in the room smell dirty like they should have been cleaned many moons ago. The front desk, wait staff and housekeeping all could be more on the ball. Rates are high. Parking rates exorbitant. Nothing to recommend it but the location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Just stopped in for the fries....the burgers are nothing special.  But the fries are pretty fantastic. And really pretty cheap.  

The place was pretty busy, despite that, I was in and out fairly quickly.  Overall the place was clean and the staff as friendly as required..

This place is absolutely disgusting and I wouldn't stay here again to save my life the rooms & common areas are dirty af. Everything is old as ever, the white sheer curtains are so old & dirty they literally look grey and the amount of dust is unreal. It's just nasty period
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Disgusting.save your money. I got the butter cream which other places is my favorite. Kids got chocolate and they hated it. This place must be bad for my kids not to like it. First time my kids have ever said that about ice cream. Hip cute place but ice cream is worst I've ever had.

Dated property, however the staff was very friendly and helpful. The pool was nice but not very big for the size of the hotel. Florida sunshine feels good no matter where you are I suppose.  There is a restaurant and bar on site, we will try that a bit later!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I wish I could give 0 stars. Rude and in caring, seem to look right through you as you stand in front of them waiting to place/ receive your order. As a member of the culinary/hospitality industry, please just try a little bit harder. 
It may be just another fast food Corporation  but kindness and compassion go along way.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
My cesar salad came as a house salad with a cup of Cesar dressing.
One of our guys ordered a soup that never came. by the time our waiter made it back to inform him everyone had finished eating. 
Overall food was good service was not. Coulda just been our particular server.

Sushi Japan closed for several months and now it's Sushi Ai. Still has the same $19.99 all you can eat sushi. Same good food. Same hit or miss service. They only have 1 bay instead of 2 now. Nothing appears to be different than before except they are in a smaller space. This is still where I will go for decent sushi.

Update 9/15/20- they literally handed me a happy meal box for my daughter without the actual meal in it. There were apple slices and a toy. No chicken nuggets or fries. My toddler didn't let this go and the "managers" "apology" over the phone wasn't sincere. 
HATE that this is my closest McDonald's
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The optometrists were nice but they were REALLY rude about the fact that I did not buy my glasses from them.  They brought it up OVER and OVER.  (8 times in a 15 minute period.) I understand that they get a great deal of their income from their glasses sale but the guilt trip was not necessary!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
I undertake about Covid and all. But who sits in a drive there for 30'minutes . It about made me
Late to where I needed to go. This is ridiculous this is slowest ass fast food place I ever ever been too. Don't go here unless you have all day and all night waiting for your order.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place is extremely disorganized. We were consistently missing clothes upon pick up only to be told she did not have anything else. I finally went in there with a list and watched as she went through all the clothes and found my stuff, which was under a different name. What a nightmare. I do not recommend.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I've had good experiences renting from this location, which I do several times a year. I didn't give the fifth star only because there have been a couple of occasions when the car I wound up with was not as nice as the one I requested in my online reservation. The staff is polite, and picking up the car usually goes quickly.

This place is super awesome ...i came to town for in a 26 ftr. Bobtail and the made room for me an gave me the balcony room so i could check on the truck during my stay. Phew ! Outta breath with that run on sentence. Super service an the manager is world class. I highly recommend this hotel. This place is perfect in every way.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Unfortunately we could not stay at this hotel because you can only stay there with a credit card. I don't own one and have no desire to get one. Was more than willing to pay with actual money from my bank account. Some places allow you to put a refundable deposit, which is what I ended up doing at another hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We had a great experience here! Food was amazing and the service was very good. When we're back in Boise we will definitely come back here. Excellent selection of interesting sushi and the price was reasonable for the quality of the food and choices of selections!

SUUUUUUUPER slow service. Ordered at the drive-thru speaker fairly quickly, but then waited at the window for almost 10 minutes before anyone acknowledged us, and when we finally got our drinks half of them weren't made correctly and tasted wrong. So disappointed.

Usually come in about once a month to get the Lobster Corn Chowder. I decided I wanted buttered noodles with my Lobster Corn Chowder and the buttered noodles were 13$. I feel like this is an outrageous price for just buttered noodles. Maybe that's just me.

If they don't mess up your order through take 20 minutes or their system will be down, honestly skip all the fast food restaurants and just go to sonic. Out of all the fast food restaurants in the area they were the only one that gets your order consistently right and out in a timely matter

On the way to another restaurant just happened to walk by Bowl and checked out the menu and so glad we went here. The food was awesome.   Had the Moroccan meatballs on couscous and the flavors were    outstanding.  If they have the brownie with fresh mint ice creme do yourself a favor and. Order it!   Great food and staff.

First time I have eaten at the restaurant. Absolutely terrible service. Arrived around 8pm and ordered the special thinking it would not take long to prepare. Took an hour to cook and deliver to the bar. Waitress never came to check on me or apologize for the delay. Would not recommend this place at all.

Got a hand grenade because everyone else was doing it (peer pressure). If you like sweet mixed drinks that's sneak up on you and get you drunk, this is it. First one is $10, refills are $9. The atmosphere seems like more of a get your drink and go but they do have a live band that plays if you do stay.

One of the best shops .. nice staff 
They always provide me with tips that helps me keep my car in a good condition.. if there's something need to be fixed or added they always write it down on a receipt which is very helpful , i always change my oil there and always will . 
Thanks guys for such service, keep it up
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This place was recommended by a friend we also looked them up on Yelp. Did not disappoint! Tried the Asada and Pork tacos,  both great! Neither were greasy which was a definit plus! Huge servings of meat accompanied by radishes, Lemon and grilled onions,  YUM!

This is my first stay here and it was very nice. A hidden treasure, if you will. Very clean, very welcoming staff, nice accommodations, the food incredible!!!! The views breathtaking. A must see! Would highly recommend for business or a great get-a-way. So much to do right here in the area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went there for the deal of 3 shirt for 6 dollars I asked the cashier about the price but they would not tell me they would charge extra for suit jackets when I came to pick them up they gouged me on the price and there was a faint stain left on my white jacket that wasn't there before.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Okay food, but they forgot to add fortune cookies. Meal just feel incomplete without it.  I'm guessing they were mad because I ordered at the last Minute but we wanted Chinese and they were the only ones open.  Oh well. Next time I'll ask to please add fortune cookies.

cute Mexican market in a neighborhood close to the Funk Zone. they sell about 20 flavors of ice cream and a ton of ice cream desserts, as well as lots of meats and fruits and vegetables. the hot tamales smelled great but were not very flavorful and they were relatively dry.

This place gives huge portions and the prices are very reasonable. The only thing is that the "hot" food arrived cold. It was obviously the food sat under the heat lamp for some time. I'd say this is an average 3 star restaurant but knocked off a star for getting served cold food.

This restaurant has two convenient locations in Tucson, Silverbell and Cortaro, and Stone and River.  I have been many times to both locations for lunch and think the half-price sushi roll lunch special is a great deal.  The taste is always fresh and I have never been disappointed.

I've been a customer for several years and LOVE the consistently delicious baked ziti wirh meat sauce sealed by mozzarella cheese.
I'll agree that the customer service is not good. Once they forgot my phone order when I drove there. The items are mostly reasonably priced.

This No Frills is fantastic! It's always nice and clean and orderly and it's a great place to get the majority of your groceries. They don't have the best bakery in the world, but I can definitely find most of the items on my grocery list each time I visit. The prices are great as well. I always come here to do my grocery shopping.

Went with a group of about a dozen guys for a monthly beer outing. OK selection of beers but we could not order any food. Two people prepping food in the kitchen but no cashier therefore no food available. We finally moved to institution ale with a much larger beer selection and good food served promptly.

I highly recommend this vet!  She is the best.  She loves what she does and treats each pet as I believe she would her own.  For a to your door service it was affordable and got us an appointment quickly!  My dog was not anxious at all with climbing in her on the move exam room. 
Highly recommend!!!

This place was a last minute booking on our travels. It was clean and pretty cool. It's the first union station in the United States. They have old train cars you can sleep in as well. Justify machines with a variety of coffee to choose from. It's downtown Indianapolis so well within walking distance of restaurants and
Bars.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Seriously your making coffee, follow what corporate has spelled out for you as far as what goes into each drink. Cutting corners and reselling us expired coffee is no way to retain customers. I pass 4 DD's on my way to work, I will not be stopping at yours, CUSTOMER SERVICE is a big deal is it difficult to be NICE?

This review only applies to vegetarians and the vegetarian items at the restaurant. I had the burrito, wife had the taco salad. Both were fine, but we don't like eggplant and zucchini in Mexican food. The menu didn't mention the eggplant otherwise I would have asked for it to be removed along with the zucchini.

I eat here maybe once a week. The pasta is my favorite but, I enjoy the pizza and cheese steaks as well. It's fairly priced and I have never had any issues with my food. I recommended to my mom and she said they have the best marinara sauce! It's the neighborhood pizza shop you would expect it to be.

Typical Marriott airport property. Pretty much know what you are getting. Decor is somewhat outdated but acceptable. Pillows are way too small and tall. Loyal to Marriott or I would have searched elsewhere. Service at Champions Bar in lobby was great. Nachos were average.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Wow! Saw their sign and decided to give them a try. Great staff, atmosphere, and better yet....sushi rolls! I chose the Summer roll and Excellent roll...they were both terrific! I will definitely be back to check out more rolls, and to give their Hibachi a try.

The Westin is clean, comfortable, and the staff is friendly. Nestor and Jenn at the front desk were very helpful and simplified our visit. It is conveniently located very close to the convention center and stadium. Jackson's, the restaurant down stairs, is good and one of the few restaurants within walking distance.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Bill and staff were fast, courteous, informative and very helpful. Pleasant experience, would highly recommend. Had an oil change done however asked if they would check out 3-4 other items needing work, and they did so and gave me quotes and honest advice. Thanks! You Rock.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I wish I could give 0 star!!!!! I made a reservation for 85$ online but at the end it turned to be 250$ ! Don't pay attention to the deals! They are all lie! The representative was so rude! Although I canceled my reservation, my account was charged and it took 72 hours to be reimbursed! Terrible service!

I brought my car here for a Platinum Car Wash and it was less than basic. There was still soap still on the car and had spots all over it (I have a white car so it's very noticeable). Also I still had dirt spots on the car so they weren't efficient at all with the hand wash. The car wasn't vacuumed completely. Will never come back.

No precautions taken around Covid-19. No one wears masks (Barbers or customers), no hand washing between customers. This is a great example of why the infection rate in Indiana is on the rise. Had to throw them a bone with 2 stars for the decent haircut. Not worth dying for, however.

Outstanding service, great location right on the beach, pet friendly, nice setting and landscaping.  You can't beat this place!  I needed it for a short stay and didn't want to lose a beach day (sooooo sunny with shells everywhere on this sugar white sand beach) and everyone was so accommodating!  Highly recommend it!!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Went in for lunch with my boyfriend. Food was good, but service was awful. Tables seated after us got their orders way before us. Plus, we had to wait ten minutes for the check to arrive, and another 30 for our check to be taken away. I don't see us coming back :\

My all-time favorite coffee place! Whenever I'm in Indy I make it a point to get coffee here. I even buy some beans to take home. It's a small and quaint shop, but the service is friendly and the coffee is great. If you consider yourself a coffee snob you will really like the coffee here.

This is my favorite place to drink. The Sunday shuffleboard league is really where this taproom shines. Its also a great place to watch a game. Selection is great, bartenders attentive and insightful, and the people are colorful. Three cheeers and more beers!

I love the Touche Bar. Special their "lemon drop" Martinis. Excellent.
Also I it is good spot during Mardi Gras. Cause it is not overload with people and you still have fun in there. It is also a great spot to watch people walking by, while sitting a the bar.

Owner thought it was appropriate to scream at and threaten me at 9 pm when he was driving down a one way street the incorrect way. Also, we used to occasionally come here- on top of the clearly rude and disrespectful owner, this is horrible pizza that clearly sits out for a very long time.

My husband and I went to try the new Healthy burger.  We ordered to go.  Drove to a park to eat and my sandwich was a horrible mess and had a long hair in it.  It was disgusting. 
This is my first visit to a Hardee's in 15 years because of poor quality and my last.

We expected great things here. The food was good, not great. We went for brunch, so maybe dinner is better. We had a sandwich and fries which tasted like any other sandwich. We also had a breakfast biscuit meal that was stood but left you wanting more in terms of flavor. Limited menu options.

This place is awesome! The owner makes sure the mood stays relaxed and friendly and the staff is always friendly and helpful. The wings were really tasty, it is very dog friendly! The walls are lined with pics of people who served in all branches and they welcome more pics for their walls. Love this place!

This place was great! I thought it was a little over priced at first, but the portions were pretty big! I got the chicken parmesean which was absolutely amazing! But the fried calamari as an appetizer was not good at all. That was the only app I tried so maybe the others are better. Overall, a good experience!

My favorite chinese food ever, I pretty much ordered it once a week a long while.  I moved away from Berwyn two years ago, and after living in Vancouver and Seattle I still miss Wing Wah.  I think I've ordered pretty much everything on the menu over the years and it's all good.  Really nice people making great food.

Great Gym! Ive been working out here for almost a year now. Nice equipment and very well maintained. Best 24hr gym in the area. My only complaint is it needs another squat rack. Other than that it has everything you need. The owner and his staff are really cool. If you live in Lakeview, this is the gym to join...
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Ok this was onsite got to rental desk where only 1 person working 3 people ahead of us took over an hour to get the car again dirty and full of scratches and dings. Was told we needed to get the toll transponder because all tolls aren't maned! NOT true. Don't recommend

One of my favorite date spots! Love the ambience and the prices are right for the quality/presentation. The colorful displays are great for those with ADD while waiting for the sushi to arrive lol (which usually isn't a long wait). You might see me here on Friday nights!

Been going here for years and it just keeps getting worse!
Did drive through tonight , ordered baconater, for what 9.00$ and got home only to find they used children's hamburger patties. We Also got chicken strips which had random nuggets as well as rock hard chicken strips. The fries were even nasty! Will not be back ever again

Only complaint is the NEVER even try to fill the fry no matter what you order. Pay 4.00 for a large fry and they fill it, 1/3 full. This location makes its habit and when it's the best thing they have to Even offer, it's more than irritating to constantly get less and less French fries. Especially IF they are fresh when you get um.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Love the salsa. Just the right amount of heat. Margaritas on the rocks were very good however the mix used for the frozen ones was not good at all. Food was very good but service leaves something to be desired. Hope it gets better because something needs to survive this location.

I ordered a fish sandwich with cheese and slivered onions only because I loathe tartar sauce. This was part of a carryout order placed inside the restaurant on 6/30/2018 @ 8:19 p.m. Got home, opened up the sandwich, and it had tartar sauce and onions on it, no cheese. I was so incredibly disappointed and disgusted.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Fantastic drinks! They are not cheap and they also are not made like skimpy drinks - so you get what you paid for. Only giving 4 stars because the food was average and 2 of the people in my party got their food 15 minutes after everyone else got their food. I will definitely come back for the drinks though!

This is a nice Fitness Center and highly recommend, but beware of the Billing Service they use, 'ABC Financial Service' They also do the billing services for anytime fitness and they do not allow you to cancel over the phone, you have to give them 30 day written notice to cancel your membership.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Unimpressive meal experience. Waitress was nice but food was so-so. Sushi chef kept conversation with friends at the counter but never said hello or goodbye to us. Sushi and sashimi dinner was unremarkable. Yakitori and kushiyaki tasted the same, too sweet.

Avoid this hotel until it is renovated. Appears nice when you arrive, but the mechanicals do not work - Keys to rooms, elevators, heat. Maintenance tech tells me they are about to do a complete renovation. On the positive side, the staff and manager are very kind.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I ordered a double quarter pounder with cheese and a large frappe and was charged $9.84 on my debit card. I drove away and opened my burger and it was a single quarter pounder in a double quarter pounder box. Then I noticed I didn't get a receipt.  What's going on McDonald's?  I was definitely overcharged!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: They do good work. We made an appointment at 7pm for a gel manicure and a full set. An hour and a half later my daughter still wasn't finished with her full set. I had to cancel dinner plans because this was taking so long. We will NEVER be back!!! I was told 10 mins so many times over the last 45 mins I'm livid!

What I remember:

Singing bartender with attitude (Billy Joel was his fave)

Drinks in glasses the size of my head (who doesn't like that??)

A karaoke stage for those moments when Journey's "Don't Stop Believing" just HAS to be sung.  In public. Badly. (Not by me, but I'm just saying ...)

And fun times were had by all.

The food is good.  I wouldn't go in very hungry unless you're prepared to spend a lot of money.
I've had a few of their very small taco bites and definitely have two favorites; the fried grouper, and the street corn.
Nice atmosphere for lunch but can get loud when its crowded.

I'm new to the area and was recommended this place by a friend since their machinery is more high-end than most wash's. I somehow managed to lock myself out of my car while I was there and the entire staff was hands-on ready to help. Great people great wash will be back soon!!

I live in KOP but I could only find one sushi restaurant! Kabuki! I must say their sushi is really really good!! A little pricey (sushi is expensive enough) but really good! My favorite is the salmon teriyaki with fried rice!! My mouth is watering thinking about it. Definitely a must try if you are in the area.

Comfortable, good food and service.  Never disappointed.  Only thing I'd suggest is timing delivery of food differently.  Wait until customer is finished with salad or appetizer to bring the entree.  Other than this all is always great. A four star here says "good" but I would call my rating "very good".

If I could give ZERO stars I would.
TERRIBLE service and treated like second class citizens because my daughter and I have a dairy allergy. The manager than had no idea how to deal with the complaint and the terrible meal took AGES. Please please do not waste your money here.

Food is very good , but I walked in there with my family on a Saturday for lunch hardly 6 tables and took over an hour and a half to get our food. Very poor service. Waiter never check on us or gave an update. I can't imagine when is busy not recommend this place.

We have come here several times and have enjoyed our time here. This time, the drinks came after a lengthy wait and were watered down from sitting on the counter. 
The cushions were extremely soiled and stained with food. 
Don't think we will return. Many more restaurants

There were 2 people infront of me waiting to see customer service, yet i had to wait over an hour to see someone... just so she could take 5 minutes to make me a new debit card. There was no reason for this to take so long.. and this caused me to get a parking ticket...

Hacienda is our GO TO for Mexican when in Clearwater.  We've been at least a dozen times & always excellent.  Great queso & chips, & the fillet tacos are fantastic.  They also have solid vegetarian options for my daughter & fantastic margaritas.  Julio does a great job.  You won't be disappointed.

Staff is friendly. The flooring almost always has clumps of dirt scattered around. No cardio machines (treadmills, stairclimber, bikes, elliptical) have a cool down button, which shows they opted for cheap equipment when stocking this location. Tanning beds badly need new bulbs or more frequent bulb changes.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers
