text: Best sushi in the area! Hands down! However they have the worst wait staff in any restaurant I've ever been to. Most of the time I just do take out. I've been going there since the place open and they had a daughter as a waitress, who was a sweetheart and she's since gone.

Stopped by today for a sausage egg and cheese mcmuffin this evening. Friendly and quick service. It tasted good and the price is average for a breakfast sandwich. But i did get a stomach ache within a few hours..I'm assuming it was the sandwich I had from here.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Used to be good.  Now it's all about in and out.  20 minutes for a pedicure.  Had a fill in and a shellac today.  They wouldn't take the coupon I had from their ad and they did a lousy job.  Am going to find a new place.  One that takes a little more time.

Best crab ragoon's ever had, they had tons of crab in them with minimal cream cheese. The sushi was delicious and well made. Only reason not 5 stars was the chicken and rice, it came with freezer vegetable mix which tasted bad. We did complain about it and got a sincere apology from the owner and a free saki.

Bernini has authentic Italian food and a great atmosphere. We go here frequently on week nights and on weekends as they have a great happy hour. It offers $2 Finlandia martinis as well half off entrees. The crispy duck is great but I normally can't bring myself not to enjoy the linguini con vongole.

Lady who checked us out loosely wore her mask, her mouth and nose completely visible.  She was talking  on cell while holding my drink cup.  Felt if she had Covid19, it was certainly in my drink (which I discarded).  Other employees respected Covid protocols.  Won't be going back.

Sad that Radisson New Orleans airport can't simply change my reservation to be two queen beds. We are two grown ass man going to see a football game. My buddy is recovering from cancer and we need a little help. But because we made 3rd party res, they can't trade king bed for two queens.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Horrible!!!!!  Ruined my shirt and did an awful job on ironing it.  Raised issue with the owner.  Said..."this is the best we can do, if you don't like it, go somewhere else".  Imagine this being said with attitude!  I pointed out an issue that was fixable, but instead I get told off.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Sad to see this place close, before Nick my Dad Owned it Frank O'Neill, Then NIck, i will deeply miss this wonderful place to eat, Living in LA CA i miss my snapper soup, Nick all the best you and your family Thanks for being part of the Family. William O'Neill

This place sucks.  Stay the hell away from here!  Building looks like it is falling apart.  Rotten eggs (literally) served for the most pathetic breakfast I've ever seen at a Hampton  inn. Someone should do us all a favor and burn this place to the ground.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Breakfast crew is usually great. The only complaint I have about this location is their coke always taste disgusting. Something is wrong with it. I thought maybe it was just temporary and tried again after a couple of months. Nope it's just bad all the time.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I came to eyemart for new frames. The place I was at before was wanting almost $800 for frames.   The staff Eyemart helped right away, and were honest about how I looked in the frames. I left with frames AND sunglasses for about $100.  

I will definitely return when I need frames again!!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: We really enjoy sitting on the patio looking down the valley toward Tucson.  However, employees rolled seven - yes, seven - carts with dishes, etc. right behind us the whole length of the patio.  The noise ruined the beautiful view and perfect evening to eat outside.  Food was very average.

Based on the menu and overall Yelp rating, I was looking forward to my visit. Unfortunately, the food was extremely disappointing. I won't be back and not a recommendation for others.  We went later in the evening so maybe the chef(s) were more focused on leaving for the night, definitely not the quality of the food.

i recently left my nail salon because it was starting to get extremely busy. because of my work schedule i can only get my nails and feet done certain days. nonetheless, it's an essential for me.


this place is super peaceful and low key. they are also very kind and give you a complimentary massage. will be returning.

I went in tonight to get one of my favorite drinks to have after a long day.   I asked for a London Fog.  Easy drink.   Earl Grey tea, vanilla, foamed milk.   What I got wasn't even a good cup of tea.  I don't know what the hell it was other than a waste of money.   Will never go back there again.

Worse McDonald's ever! They NEVER have anything in stock. Always running out of drinks or condiments. Customer service SUCKS big time!  While waiting to pay, their in side playing around ignoring the fact that there's someone waiting for them to take care of them.  Just horrible! They need new management
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I have only been here once with my husband. The service was really good, everyone was very polite. I just was not a fan of the sushi. The tempura roll must have been fried in the same oil as everything in the restaurant because our our roll was super fishy tasting.

Amazing pizza.  Been going here for twenty plus years and hasn't changed a bit.  My family loves the white pizza with broccoli, i always go for the three cheese.  I can't think of any way to make it better, sauce is tangy, cheese is kind of sharp, and crust is a little bit crunchy on the outside and a whole pie can feed a family.

This is the best play for glasses. They know what they doing. They fit my youngest child amazing.(no one else has been able too. So so amazing. Oh and my husband has glaucoma and has many issue with glasses but they had him cover to so not only for little kids but all kids.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I always go here for a quick bite to eat. It's one of the few sushi places that is not ridiculously expensive but still remains a quality option. The service is always quick and the food is consistently good. It's the perfect place for a nice relaxed dinner that won't empty your pockets!

As a frequent business traveler and Marriott platinum member I hardly ever review Marriott hotels since there is an expected level of comfort and conformity... especially at their higher end brand, Renaissance. The philly airport location missed this all together.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Nice, clean, comfortable!
Near the airport. Great for quick stay, new paint, new carpet, I was pleasantly surprised. Breakfast at six am. But if you need a makeup mirror you will be out of luck, wether it's for shaving or applying makeup bring your own. The front desk people were very pleasant.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Very poor customer experience. The girl behind the counter told me that the pizza was warm and the slice did not need warming. Sat down and took a bite and it was very cold. I then asked the girl to heat my pizza and she put the slice I had eaten off of Into the oven. Very unsanitary. Sad to see.

Dirtiest fast food restaurant I've ever seen - Almost bailed halfway towards reaching the counter. Wish I did.

Service was quick and my order was correct, but the bun on my chicken sandwich was rock hard (tossed it). Also, there was mustard covering the wrapper on my cheeseburger (which was ordered to be 'ketchup only').
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Hands down a great place to grab dinner or a drink. Ok, we grab carry out a lot too. Onion rings are homemade - and are killer! Great salads and wraps - everything is great. We've never had anything that wasn't yummy - definitely can't go wrong eating here.

Gave this place another chance.  Worst meal I ever had bar none. Food was bland over cooked horrible. The owner came around bragging how good it was, obviously he never tasted his own food. Stay away from this place I can't wait to turn in my full review at work.

We started with the calamari very over cooked and chewy. Then I had the lasagna Primavera and that was also over cooked tasteless. 
My wife had the Chicken "AL MATTONE" she said it reminded her of the stuff they served at her fathers retirement home. Our dogs 
seemed to enjoy it though.

Beautiful venue. New Orleans friends recommended this place and it did not dissapoint.  Selection is limited but everyone enjoyed their meal. Food is not cajun but it is diverse. We had the gnocchi and the chicken and these are flavors we had never had. We sat in the garden and enjoyed the view of the stained glass windows.

Besides for it being over priced for the wash and fold service, the customer service is terrible. I was basically accused of stealing because they typed in my credit card wrong and were not apologetic at all once they realized their mistake. I would definitely recommend going elsewhere.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
The Salon is nice and new, but the quality is lacking.  I felt like they were trying to up sell.  My nails need to be re- done after 3 days, and for the price the quality should be better.

I wish I would have read the "filtered reviews" before going to this salon, Yelp seems to filter negative reviews of this salon.

Donuts are often stale, expensive, had a long black hair in my donut, often overcharged.  Great location, untrained staff. Get a receipt!!!  Asked for a receipt today, said 12.96.  Actually debuted out of my account was 23 dollars and some change. With a few minor changes, this could be 4-5 stars.

I've never been here before, and I wasn't too impressed. The service was okay - we got our food fast - but drink refills had to be asked for. The taste of my food and the complimentary bread was a bit bland. My husband's chicken Parmesan was good, though. I think I'd only go here again if I got another gift card.

The ppl there r nice with a smile with an attitude and would be glad to take ur money... they r bad of not callin the consumer on there part or lettin them know what's the status is..!! I had too call every time and it shouldn't be like that with a business that has been for years...
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: My husband found a sharp piece of wire in his pancakes. They comped his meal but not mine. No visit from the manager. Bad customer service. This was soooo dangerous, I can't believe they just brushed it off like nothing happened.  I wouldn't go there again.

This is shop is a true gem.  Ilene is amazing and really knows her fermented grapes.  She has curated boxes of wine for both of my parents for birthday gifts, and is always spot on, impressing my siblings and my parentals! Stop by or email for advice or a curated selection just for you!

We have been here a few times and have enjoyed each visit. They are always willing to accommodate our kids with terrific meals. Sitting at the bar and being able to watch your steak or fish get grilled up on a real wood burning fire is a nice touch. We will be back! BYOB with the state store next door is convenient!

Sakura was a very big disappointment. The service was bad and the food was below average with poor quality. The soup was very salty, steak was over cooked (even though I asked for it medium) . The plating was sloppy especially with the sauces. Extremely slow service. Disappointing !

This was the worst company I dealt with for a car. They refused to cancel my reservation and tried to say I no showed and trying to keep my money. The girl at the desk insured me that it will cancel out and to call the 800 number to receive a refund. The whole company is unorganized and act like it's nothing they can do.

Came in for dinner later on a Sunday evening. After having our plates taken out from under us without asking, and after our waitress asking us to settle up, we were clear we were no longer welcome. 

This was all before 9:30 on a Sunday night. We won't be back.

I'm updating my previous review. After speaking with Mr. Kauffman, I got an apology and a free bottle of cleaning spray. I will give them another chance when it's time to get another pair of glasses. I understand things happen and this business owned up to it.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
A bar with an awesome, hip vibe and looks, but with slow, inattentive service. 

The bar is in a renovated old church rectory and courtyard. Lovely decor and lighting. The drinks were good. 

The service staff often appeared frazzled and confused. Especially slow service. But maybe I went on a bad night.

Small Italian restaurant with a nice set up people are nice and friendly food is tasty but the wait is too long for the food
Three tables with eight people total and it took 25 minutes to get a Philly cheesesteak and the order was not even complete
I waited too long for just good food

We were avoiding the crowd and hopped into this bar.  This is a great little dive bar....cheap drinks, snacks, and fast service.   In a busy town this is a commodity!  And, if you are a craft beer fan,  they have 52 beers on tap!  Yes!  Stop by if you are in the area for a chill atmosphere with good beer; )

We got take out and ate right outside. The pretzel pastrami sandwich is cold......... very cold. Very disappointing. Busy Sunday but this is their shot to keep folks  coming. Fries...... cold. Very disappointing lunch. two stars are for peddlers village atmosphere and take out beera.

Pappone's has been a great surprise. We were craving a Sicilian pizza which ended up being incredible- the only issue if I had to be picky would be that it was a tiny bit dry. We both said more sauce would have made it perfect! So consider asking for a side of sauce :)

Great cozy restaurant with great ambiance.  Food was above par, as was service.  This is our second time in the last week that we have eaten there and it was wonderful.  This will be our place to go and relax and have a great meal.  We were stunned that it was not overcrowded, as it is a hidden gem.

The pizza is always good, even when they toss it back in the oven to warm it up. It always satisfies me. They have a nice selection of drinks also. The chicken alfredo pizza is some of my coworkers favorite but I'm not bold enough to try it! Definitely stop in and grab you a slice!

The general Tao chicken was very bland and not spicy at all. The beef fried rice was typical, nothing to write home about, a little chewy. It's a good go to if your first option isn't available. I think they use MSG though so be sure to ask about that when you order. I forgot.

Looks so sketchy from the outside but the tacos were SO good. We got al pastor and carne asada. It tastes like someone's Grandma from Mexico is cooking in the back. Definitely check it out of you want some good tacos. They have a small amount of seating inside, and offer carryout as well.

I've never been charged for hot water. I order a coffee and a hot water. I've always been charged $1.09 after taxes. Today My total wat $2.18. Juan (the manager) charged me for 2 coffees and tried to tell me that they always charge for water. McDonald's employees and employers are stealing from us now.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: If I could give this a zero I would- made a reservation for an SUV and when we arrived they did not have anything to rent us except one low grade Hyundai that a smelly dude just dropped off saying it needed an oil change that they we give us for a measly 10 dollars less. Absolutely terrible.

This cleaner is terribly overpriced. I brought in a pair of jeans to have a button sewn back on the pocket. I had the original button I just needed them to fix it. When I picked them up a week later the bill was $63.00. For a button, I was in shock. They be ashamed they are ripping people off. I will never go back here.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Just went to this Mcdonald's to get a burger. I asked for lettuce and tomato on my burger & this is the amount of lettuce I received & there was no tomato.  Highly disappointed in the food due to the fact that it was not busy at all & they mess up the orders or forget to give you part of the meal more often then not.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Good service. But over priced. I've been going to then since it was signature tire and auto. Now that I've found placed like sterns auto repair and value automotive services, I'm moving away from the big names to go get myself a deal at small stores while helping them get business.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Never go here for breakfast. Order a simple breakfast and they could even serve it correctly. Went through drive through cause I have class so I order and they made me wait 20 minute for 3 McGriddles and hash brown and they were missing a hashbrown and a McGriddle. Went back and wasted 30 minutes of my life and I was late to class!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Avoid this place if you can! I ate here and then went to use the restroom and had an employee come in there when I was in there and didn't even wash his hands before leaving. He then went right behind the counter, put on some gloves and starting making some burgers! Disgusting! Will never come here again!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE.  Their ramp damaged my splash guard,  and they didn't even give a f*** . They said they are not liable for any damage happens in the car wash.  They are fraud. Their wax material put white spots on my black stripes, and they did not even admit it. STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE.

Delicious! Me and a group of friends tried this place out and were thoroughly impressed. I personally got the ramen and it was great. It was not salty nor was it too heavy. I have gotten ramen from multiple places in town and this place is by far my favourite.

Simple menu, great food. Can expect a bit of wait at peak hours. Worth it though. Ribs were tender and had cooked in taste, not fake taste with excess bottled sauce. Tasted original and just enough sauce. Chicken tenders were more than you could eat. Great taste.

absolutely love this place!!  the flavors are good quality. service is allways fast and friendly. i've also developed an addiction to the strawberry cheesecake with condensed milk its amazing!!!  and wedding cake with ice cream flavor and condensed milk.. oh my word the bomb!!!!!

Room smells like an ashtray. Hotel is very dirty Asked to check out and was charged an extra day.  Air conditioner didn't work. When we pulled up to room there were ppl hanging out in cars (parking lot)....smoking.... that you can tell did not belong there. Had a very uncomfortable feeling.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We walked here on a Saturday low key afternoon to sit outside and enjoy a beer but were told we arent allowed in because our 4 month old isnt 21. So we had to sit near the bathroom, not a table, to wait for rain to stop so that we could leave. This place is not accommodating or kid friendly.

We were a little weary of this place because of the bad reviews, but ended up going here anyway and were very impressed! We went after lunch time and it wasn't crowded at all. I got a lunch General Tao's, and while it wasn't that much chicken or spicy enough, it was tasty.

My daughter and I both had our hair cut at VN Salon this afternoon. They did such a nice job on both of our cuts. Our hair lays perfectly in place. You should see their mad scissor skills, definitely more precise than most hair stylists! The prices are great as well. We will definitely be back.

Went here early in the morning before heading out for the day and got 4 bagel sandwiches and a few coffees and hot chocolates and no joke it took 40 minutes.  Best part was there was nobody in there at the time.  Apparently they only have one oven and there was only one person working behind the counter.  No thanks.

I worked with Carrie to find glasses and she was fantastic. She searched the store and new inventory to help me find a pair and was so friendly. She also made sure that I got the best price for both glasses and contacts through my VSP insurance. All around great experience and service!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Service gets an A+, but it was not a busy night.  Food gets a C-. For a party of 8, most was well prepared, but a couple of the salmon dishes were not cooked completely.  the crab stuffing was so spicy it masked the other flavors in the dish.  And they charged a 23% tip on food & tax.

I stayed here for 2 nights. The first night, I realized that there weren't any blankets on the bed. I asked the front desk for a blanket, and they said they were out. The heater is right above the head of the bed, so if you turn it on, it blows hot air in your face! What hotel doesn't have blankets!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We came here for our last day vacation lunch. Server was nice but not attentive. Bartender was slow. Food was okay. We can check this off of place not to come back to next year. It was raining so they didn't have to wait on outside tables. I can't imagine the staff being able to handle a busy day!!

The staff and re-vamped menu lends itself to a pleasurable dining experience. I've been to Leddy's multiple times and have tried a variety of items-all very good. It's menu is reasonably priced. Simply put, take the time to formalize your own opinion as you should!

I've enjoyed this place for years.  Friendly staff and lots to options to choose from. Always a good time when we go.  Make what you know or venture out and try something new.  The choose is yours.  If you don't like the food here - we'll... it is you!  You made it!

I have been going to Diamond nails since the the new owners took over. Tom and Vivian go over and above to accommodate you, even offering a beverage while you are waiting to get a mani or pedi. The entire staff is very nice. I have Annie or Vivian do my nails and they both do great jobs. I highly recommend Diamond nails!

Shuttle from airport took forever while other rental company shuttles like Budget, Thrifty. Compact rental had stained seats and smelled of cigarettes even though no-smoking stickers posted on console. I come to St. Louis regularly and have rented better vehicles from the other rental companies.

I am very disappointed that this animal hospital would not help us. We were in the parking lot with a baby Nigerian dwarf goat bleeding from a head wound and they would not help us. Said they didn't take large animals. This baby was about the size of a cocker spaniel.

The People above me in room 328 were very loud and had no concept if being considerate of others because you could hear them stumping all the time in their room and slamming things. Maybe he has anger issues, but lack of consideration. I wouldn't stay here again unless I was on the top floor.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great sushi in an unsuspecting place.  Not only was the rotary, conveyor belt sushi yummy, but the special rolls were unique.  Relaxed atmosphere with great sushi.  I think Rotary Sushi is the best sushi in the valley.  Can't wait to go back.  I would love to try lunch here.

Y'all this place is the real deal. Tucked in the back of the bar, so grab a drink and walk on back. Get the Mac n cheese no matter what. Food is so so good, everyone is super friendly, and if you don't have a lot of time it's a great grab and go spot. So excited to go back soon!

We love this place.  Always clean and a really courteous and caring staff.  Our 
minature schnauzer is always taken care of promptly.  Also, we feel they have reasonable prices compared to other independant veternarians that we've visited before with other pets.  Would recommend this place highly.

The food , the art, the atmosphere. All excellent. An eclectic mix of high end cuisine and and a chill vibe. Roy has created a casual New York/LA scene that feels like home.  It's impossible to chose a menu favorite but don't miss the bread, house salad or tomato soup. This guy is no amateur. You will not be disappointed.

I was so thankful I found Ice Cold Air to change my oil and do some maintenance on my transmission. I was very nervous because I am a female and I'm not from the area, but they have proved to me twice that they are reasonable and trustworthy. Their pricing was also about $30 less than Aamco quoted me.

Just going through the carwash is fine. I use them all the time for the exterior. Especially since they provide a daily 10% military. The interior cleaning service needs more attention to detail. I shouldn't have to re-clean my windows and wipe down my dash after I pay money for someone else to do it.

This was probably the worst Italian Restaurant that I have ever been to.  We had the rack of lamb , with mashed potatoes and asparagus.  It was BLAND.  The best thing was the oil in the olives that we used to dip the bread in and the Stella beer.  Oh yeah, the service was good.

Very good pizza and Caesar salad.  Cheese cake was okay.  Place is very cute and full.  We sat at the bar and Brandon, the bar keep, took our order. He was super pleasant and attentive- even as we ordered no drinks!  Great charming place- we shared a pizza and salad plenty to eat!

Love their Dinner Special, served from 6-8pm. Includes either Cali or spicy tuna roll, salad, chicken teriyaki over white rice, miso soup and shrimp & veggies.... Probably I didn't need to also order a flower roll, but I def had leftovers!!! (To-go orders do not include the mochi ice cream)

You no longer have a waiter. Everyone must sit on their phone the entire night figuring out the app and ordering all drinks and food through your phone. Everything we ordered was sent over twice so we had to talk to the manager about 5 times about removing the extra off our bill. Awful experience.

Shit service, people were not friendly. Paid a lot more than any other nail place to be in there for only twenty minutes. They didn't even cover my whole nail with polish. Never coming back. Think it was because I am a black woman but can't be sure. Heard them talking in their native language and it just sounded racist.

Local spot with great pizza...I had the slice and salad special for lunch.  Great thin crust pizza and crispy fresh salad.  The restrooms are in an adjacent shop, but not an issue for me as I didn't require one.  Super service and prices, I would frequent often if I lived in the area.

Free soap, bleach and dryer sheets, plus very friendly staff.  Reasonable machine rates: we paid $2.75 for a wash and .25/3 min on the dryers, which took about 25 min to get dry on a medium load.  Much more reasonable than hotel or the awful drop-off place down the street that wanted $44 for what we did ourselves at Suds for $10!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
The best Italian food in the area 
Very good service 
Make a reservation, especially Fridays to Sundays. 
Don't miss the homemade gnocchi and calamari  Fra diablo. Large servings and great wine choices. 

Loved Zane our frequent waiter and confidant. 
Enjoy!

I was given a room that had an overbearing odor of mildew. And there was a old cup of coffee on the nightstand. That left a strong first impression. I am just not used to this kind of dirtiness from Marriott. 

I asked for a different room and they were quick to accommodate. And the hotel bar and food was pretty good.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Figured I'd give it a try. Had to wait for our pickup order and the food was cold. Carne asada was bland, dry, and tough- not at all how it should be prepared. Burrito was barely warm. I've had amazing food in rural Latin America and you're much better saving the money and making it yourself.

Best all around dining experience we've had in a long time. Cocktails, ambience, food, service. Faves included the root veggie tartare, fried zucchini with brisket, fried chicken on biscuit appetizers and shaved Brussels sprout salad. Don't sleep on this one Indy, in my top 5.

This place was really good. While I was traveling in Philly, my check engine light came on. They were able to get me in right away without an appointment in order to check the light and tell me what was wrong with the car and if it was safe to drive back home. text: The cashier overcharged me and then gave me some serious attitude when I called him on it.  He didn't want to void the transaction but said he would credit my account. When I picked up my order it was apparent that my clothes had not been cleaned at all.  I will not be back.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: We actually came in for an event that bud light was doing but it's a really cute bar! The drinks were free when we were there so I don't have comment son prices but they had a decent size bathroom even if it was a little dark  they have a cool wall & a small stage so it was really fun & we'll be back

This is my favorite Chinese food place I've ever had outside of New York City! All the food I have gotten from there is so good especially the sesame chicken and general tso! 10/10 recommend I have told all of my friends about this place and every single one of them also becomes obsessed with it!

This is as good as Mexican food gets here in Tennessee! My wife and I are from Southern California/Arizona and we know good Mexican food. Come try this new reastaurant, you won't be disappointed.  The staff is knowledgeable and helpful,  take their recommendations!

No wifi for 3 days in 2018 and no effort to fix it.  When I went to front desk to ask about it all, I got was, "it's been down for 3 days, and we can't fix it."   And the award for the most unfriendly front desk staff goes to.....Great job, Aloft. (Insert eye roll here)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We had a GREAT meal last night at the Metropolitan grill. I had a shrimp, fish, chicken & pasta dish which was amazing. My wife had a quasidea which was also very good. We Are going back for Thanksgiving dinner today. Traveling thru to CA. Stopped in Tucson for 3 days. Keith N. (Wisconsin)

This place is so delicious! Stopped here on our way through town and couldn't have been happier with it. Drinks were tasty and the food was amazing - roasted chicken was lemony and delicious. Fish tacos were great, as was the cassoulet. Wish this restaurant was closer to home for us! Oh and they played great music too!

Sadly, the owner was away in Italy when I visited fir the first time. I ordered a veal dish which tasted delicious.  My issue is the cleanliness of the kitchen. After about 8 hours or so I had severe stomach issues. Having a medical background,  the symptoms were e-coli or listeria infection.

I placed an order on Eat 24. The menu says it is served with rice, but the item came with french fries instead. I called to explain to the restaurant owner, and he hung up on me and refused to help.

Eat 24 called him, but he refused to give a refund or remake the order. This is not a restaurant you can trust. I would avoid.

Things used to be nice here.  Got new management in August.  Complex lawn and parking lots inundated with piles of leaves and nothing is being done about it.  Also, they have had 3 months to get online payment system up and running, and they still have not done it.

I had a problem of loose connections with catalytic converter, exhaust pipe and resonator and was referred by my friend Mario . They gave me an estimate and within a short period of time had me up and running much quieter and safer. I recommend them highly!

This review is simple.  The best pizza in Philadelphia.  Keep in mind that the crust is very thin and crunchy - this doesn't appeal to everyone - and the pie is relatively high on the sauce to cheese ratio.  But any pizzeria that survives even though it doesn't deliver has to be good.

Overpriced food with mediocre service. I ordered the Bronzino. It was filet , extremely small, and had not for the fresh black pepper, the fish would have been absent of any flavor.  The potatoes and broccoli were hard and undercooked. Lastly, waiter took forever to return our bill.  Should have gone elsewhere for the money. Avoid.

The Queen Village Sweat Gym is not a good option for child care.  The woman who watches the children is disinterested and unengaged.  She'll either turn on youtube on her iPhone or pop in a movie.  It is a huge room full of toys.  It is completely unnecessary to turn on TV.  Don't waste your money there.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The appetizers were excellent, oysters were fantastic and Mushroom soup to die for!! Rack of Lamb was ok. Small and fatty. It cost $35 but because we shared it they charged $39. Seemed strange since we had two appetizers that cost $22. This so annoyed me I would never come again.

This is the hidden gem of nightlife down in Redington Beach, where there is really minimal nightlight to begin with. The live music has always been great, the drinks are super cheap, and there is always fast service from the bar tenders. I can't complain one bit. ‍

I waited 50 minutes to leave with a dirty car. This has been my go to car wash for many years, and unfortunately today will be my last day supporting this local business. The last three times I have attempted this car wash I have been extremely disappointed and it's time to stop wasting my money.

Unbelievable food coupled with a cozy ambience is always a winning situation. But when you have your waiter custom make your appetizer, entree, and dessert every time you go -and the food is spectacular -there is nothing better. Best place for dinner in a 50 mile radius without contest. (Try the pear and Gorgonzola dish)

The produce there is pretty pricey but not much of s good quality compared to other grocery stores around the area. The salad I once had tasted a bit soured and old. The male manager there was rude and snappy to me one time. The place is pretty tidy, however. But I don't recommend this Giant at all!

These guys close whenever they feel like it. I used to enjoy hitting them Friday nights on the way down the shore, & there was always a line of cars in the drive thru at 10:30, 11pm. Went to stop there tonight, 9:45, pitch dark.
Wawa across the street is packed!
What a joke.

This family restaurant is pretty good, the food was pretty good. The staff are very friendly, the only thing I wasn't to excited about was the chips and salsa. The chips tasted as if they were stale. But everything else was decent. Definitely planning to come back to give them another try

The managers are terrible here they fired me without any notice I did nothing wrong the managers Spanish lady with long pony tail very disrespectful she has no management skill  I told the general manager that she did not have any management skills and he fired me instead of her for telling him

This is not a dive bar. The staff is overtly rude, the bar tender literally told my friends that they wouldn't be able to afford their drinks if they ordered doubles.  Apparently we weren't their kind of guests. No stars for this sad bar in a city full of options.

The good: interesting small plates, tasty cocktails and quick food service, the best dish I tasted was the drunken scallops.  The bad: the bbq sauce overpowered the duck confit sliders, and the hoisin sauce overpowered the moo shu bacon. The cocktails we ordered took about 25 to 30 minutes to arrive. I'd try it again.

I'll start off by saying this was the worst fuckin food Ive ever had......$38.for garbage .....it we t down the garbage disposal......spare ribs were burnt.....pork fried rice was fuckin yellow.....wonton mushy and slimmie.....a total disgrace......DONT EVEN TRY IT ONCE.....THE WORST

I wish I could give zero stars. Worst Banfield I have ever been to and this place is the reason I'm canceling all of my plans with this business . I don't wish to really elaborate because I'm just over it at this point . All I have to say is I should listened to the bad reviews on this establishment .

Vomiting and diarrhea from 4am Sunday til 7pm thanks to Vinny's Marco Polo pizza.  Will never order from Vinny's again. Whole day lost to being sick. Thanks Vinny! 

Nice customer service response from Vinny's. I didn't toss your shitty pizza around. Your delivery person did.

Here on business and hotel recommended this place.  It was horrible,  I ordered soup and flatbread.  The beef soup was so greasy, I felt like I had vasoline on my lips.  The flatbread was just wierd.  The server was nice and removed some items from my check.  Luckily I had chocolate back at the hotel!

Quick Business trip one night stay. Good layout of the room but I was petrified to take a shower. It was not clean at all. The shower head needed to be replaced at least deep cleaned and the tub floor was grimy as well. This was a good lesson  for me to never stay at Holiday Inn Express even for just one night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Made an appointment for this place to get some simple work done, arrived at the time my appointment should have been and waited over 20 minutes while they took walk ins. 
Receptionist was also very rude. 
Why accept appointments if it's to not take them?
Would not recommend to anyone.

Got a scone and lattes to go. Scone was clearly a day old and was overpriced. Latte was tasty but the tiny Dixie cup it was served in was barely over half full and it cost $6. I made more coffee when I got home. Ambience is nice but this is not a good place for baked goods or coffee

I stayed at this new hotel for my first trip to Idaho.  Location is great, right next to the Villages of Meridian. Front desk staff was very friendly, and the bed was VERY comfortable.  Also, love the full size fridge in the room.  Extra bonus: had a great view of the mountains from my room! Will definitely stay here again
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Watch out other car washes? Robert F was lying about the price quote given to him. He claims  hes a writer and moved here from Los Angeles. How about  telling the truth about the vulgar and abusive language you used on the employees? If you're a writer you should have been more professional at handling the situation.

I just went there a few days ago. Got a full set and pedicure. The lady didn't finish my toes. She left the big ones  undone so the  nail tech can put the acrylic on them. & she just refused to paint my pinky toe. Not even 4 days later a nail popped off. Worst nail salon possible. They should be out of business

We've been here before and enjoyed it immensely. Old style with really friendly staff. Very genuine. Had salad, pizza and corn chowder. I know... ministroni right? But we KNOW that's excellent! Try something different! It was excellent. We'll be back again!

STAY AWAY FROM THIS JOINT. We booked a room, paid for in advance over $200 and when we got there they said they had overbooked and that we did not have a room. Spent the night at the airport.  took over a month to get money back with no over of compensation or appologies  Manager could care less
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ordered their delicious spicy XO seafood fried rice & mongolian beef, besides the cilantro in the rice  (it's the texture & taste ) the food was delicious & generous in proportions. I would definitely come back here for more Chinese cravings & would recommend. Definitely worth the trip to Tampa ...

I ordered at 1:00pm called back at 2:15 they never put my order through.  Cancel that delivery. And the pork products aren't real either. I would not recommend it to my least favorite person . If I could give zero stars I would. No ones mom would leave them hungry so change the name.

Josh Nichols is a magician. He's experienced, knowledgeable, current on trends, and consistently provides cuts that maximize the potential of your hair.  His graciousness will appeal to midwestern sensibilities and he's a brilliant stylist. You will not go to anyone else ever again.

Biaggi's is fast becoming one of our favorite Carmel restaurants.  The quality of the food is consistently superior and in proper portions.  Moreover, the level and speed of service even during peak times is outstanding.  Staff are friendly and very accommodating.

If you use your credit or debit card, be sure to check your bank statement. I bought a #1 and a small frosty. Should have been $9. They charged $20.43 to my debit card. I spoke to the manager and she said the drawer zeroed out so obviously someone took the difference out of the drawer. As if the food isn't dangerous enough.

I did my nails on Monday and they damaged my nails so bad. I grew my nails out and went in for a filling and gel color. My nails lifted completely and paid $51 and when I went back few days later they wanted to charge me $35 to fix and save my nails. Worse customer care and disrespectful to customers

Car reeked of smoke! Notified the agent at the time of pick-up who apologized but did nothing to rectify the situation. After dropping off the car I had to immediately drop my coat off at the dry cleaner to rid it of the smell. Apologies are nice but only go so far.

The assortment of pastries is good and the pricing is fair. The service is excellent, very efficient. However the coffee is weak in flavor. While I like to be a fan the weak coffee gives me a pause. I've tried both the coffee and espresso - each lacked depth of flavor. And I find Starbucks too bitter and burnt.

I would just like to let others know the excellent service that I received today at this location. Ernie was more then helpful!!! I had a coupon that I intended on using but,  was informed of a better option from Ernie. Please check this location out when in need of any auto services. You won't be disappointed.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The food here is delicious. I ordered a veggie bowl and they had a variety of fresh mixed vegetables for me to choose from. I absolutely loved how everything tasted. The customer service here was also excellent. The staff was extremely helpful and friendly. If you have never been, I would definitely recommend this restaurant.

Went there because of the 3 positive reviews and won't ever be back. Fish was greasy and Frye's we're almost done. Tried to over charge us $10 until I questioned the carhop. So be aware of the pricing if you go, so so disappointed, loved the original Hungry Onion.

Good food.  A touch pricey.  The Ceviche starter is the best around.  Also, reasonable kids menu.  Ours had their food almost immediately after ordering, which allowed the grown ups to relax for a bit.  The entrees are good; portions are sized well.  Margaritas were also good.

Everything about this place is nasty!  Eight out of ten plates they have for pizza had bits of food left on them.  The employees were very rude.  The table was dirty and the chairs were sticky. The patio was disgusting, with food smeared all over the ground.  The pizza was rubbery.  How does this place stay in business?

I always have problems at this car wash. I just put in $3 and there's barely any pull from the vacuum cleaner. There's no one in the office there's no phone number anywhere and when I look it up on the Internet the phone number is disconnected thanks for boning me Ballast Point. This will be my last trip here

Love the bar but the food from "Cleaver & Co." and "Karibu" was absolutely terrible. In a city like New Orleans, famous for its food, no bar should allow themselves to offer such a terrible food experience for its customers. Will come back to the bar but will not eat anything there.

Will never stay here again! Our room was not cleaned, restaurant was terribly overpriced and no complimentary coffee in the lobby in the morning. 
They also charge $10 for parking.  Least amount of amenities at a Marriott owned hotel we ever came across. Do not recommend this hotel to anyone.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Says he is open on Mondays... its now 1/2 hour past opening time....  i like to give small time places my business but cant wait all day... either change your sign , get up earlier or leave sign saying you wont be opening when you claim to be... reluctantly going to Supercuts .. i would call first

This place is a gem. Definitely the best pizza in Delco. CASH ONLY. A little pricey, but well worth it. Order ahead, bout half hour, so you won't be waiting. It reminds me of Pica's pizza (sauce on top) not square pie, but round. Fresh ingredients makes all the difference. Enjoy.

Don't be fooled by these pictures, this hotel has not been updated since 90's. Had to change rooms 3x, final room, sink was clogged, blackout curtains hanging, toilet seat was broke . We came for our 14th anniversary and I'm sorry that I picked this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This hotel has the most offensive and rude staff of any hotel I've stayed.  The front desk lady was very kind to an older client in line with me, but very unkind to me.  It could have been racial bias.  I will avoid Extended Stay America hotels in the future.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: they were extremely busy and the window employee was extremely polite- but my chicken fries were all ROCK hard and lukewarm- and my whoppers bottom bun was absolutely stale and hard as well. All inedible. Didn't have time to get back in line and wasted 9 dollars. Completely unacceptable- retrain your cooks please.

If I could give this hotel zero stars I would! Absolutely the worst customer service and dirtiest hotel I've ever stayed at! DO NOT STAY HERE!!! There was dead skin in the bed and hair all along the bathroom floor and outside of the trash can. Absolutely disgusting and completely unacceptable! Corporate will be receiving a letter!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: went to Vic sushi bar when visiting Philadelphia for the first time. Good sushi, reasonable price, but service was awful. A waitress never smiled and no water served. I had to ask to get one. really? she didn't say anything, leaving a cup of water beside me; better service is required seriously.

Feels like family! They are VERY affordable and genuinely care for the animals. I like that the doctors are straight forward and give the best options of treatment up to me without any pressure. We recently had to put our 14 year old Golden Retriever down and it went very peacefully. We have been coming here for 5 years.

I walked in after a hard day at work for food and the person we ordered to was asian. And i could not understand what he was saying he was probaly speaking chinese. I pulled out my phone and went on my translator app and he was cursing at me. He said get your white nerd ass out of here. I will always remeber this experience.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Coming from someone that loves Mexican food this place is 5 stars, easy. Fajitas, tacos, Enchiladas, quesadillas are amazing and all are priced so fairly. Ive been to almost too many Mexican places and this is the real deal, been to Mexico multiple times and this place is on par.

Try the bread pudding french toast!  it is very sweet and rich and so yummy.The portion size is good and prices there are very good. I have not had the chance to try the other dishes yet but they have a good variety to choose from and all the prices seem reasonable. plus they are open 24hrs!

Good sushi and a full menu for non sushi lovers. My husband especially like the Korean style spicy chicken which he said really reminded him of Korea. Along with dinner we were served edamame, soup, salad and delicious plum ice cream all included. Ultimately, we ended up with a ton of tasty food for a very reasonable price.

We stayed here for three days. I usually like Holiday Inns but not this one.  The water was cold in all of our rooms, it didn't matter what time we showered. Our room smelled once we signed in but I was just happy to get a room early. The staff were very helpful and nice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This place is delicious.  The service is good, the food is wonderful.  
Reading from Lisa's post, to say it is 'a step up from the Village Inn or the IHOP' is simply coming from someone that does not have good judgement. 
We went for dinner, and the blackened grouper sandwich was wonderful.  Will be back!

We ate at Bistro 7 last weekend, for the first time in several years and were pleased with our meals.  We each had a salad (quite a large size) and a shrimp pizza.  The pizza was excellent quality with a thin crust and perfectly fired. We were impressed, and, based on this experience, will return for another meal at Bistro 7.

Worse food ever, $25.00 in the trash after  two bites. If there was any redeeming value it was hot when we got it home.
Never again, the reviews I read recommended this place.
Not sure where those people are use to eating.
Not even the fortune cookies, they were stale

This place is amazing. The staff is so kind and fun and friendly, the toppings are fresh and tasty, and you get to eat your delicious pizza on a beautiful wooden tray! I ordered the farmers market pizza and added extra sauce, olives, corn, and sweet potatoes. It was spectacular. 

$8 for your favorite pizza. Do it. So good.

Lived here two months and absolutely love it. The staff is incredibly responsive and helpful, and my apartment is huge. There's some noise from the hallways and street if you're on an external apartment, but nothing out of the ordinary for any apartment building. Very happy here!

Wine pours were light. Guacamole was delicious. Tamale with mole was very tasty but it was 3 inches long served solo - no extra rice or beans. Steak tacos were marketed incorrectly as they were in fact more like brisket with 50% fat. 

Over priced for what was delivered.

We chose Fratelli's for its proximity to the Kimmel Center.  Our waitress was very accommodating by helping us stay on schedule to make the show.  She was just the right blend of helpful, but not overly intrusive.  The food was good.  We would definitely go back again.

Nina was a really good person but she didn't know what she was doing, she got the price wrong twice. Not sure how you do that when it's a scale. Oh well you should give Nina a raise cause I decided to change my review from a 2 star to a 5 star. This place slaps.

I really only need one word to describe this location for budget Rent-A-Car. The word would is: horrible! middle the day only and only one agent working.  no help. 50 people waiting. The manager, I assume there must be one. Should be fired and replaced.  The sooner the better.

Have to say that the service here has greatly improved. In fact, both the food and service is awesome. I highly recommend this establishment for all occasions, whether having lunch with fellow coworkers or taking the family out for a nice dinner. Keep up the great hospitality and awesome food!

The worst haircut I've ever had. I know sometimes it takes a week maybe two for it's kind of fall into place after a new haircut but it's week three and it keeps getting worse there's no style there's no body there's no shape. I asked for lots of funky little layers I have a very traditional flat nothing haircut

We went in the evening. 2 guys running drive thru.  The orderer acted like we interrupted him. He was rude and unfriendly.  The window guy was worse. Both just jerks. Never returning. 
Oh! What did we get? Drinks. Just drinks. I guess that was too much for them to handle.

Food tastes great but be warned - if you're gluten free, they don't carry gluten free soy sauce and have no designations or guidance on their menu to help you.  First time I've ever been to a sushi place that didn't carry GF soy sauce. Would rate this higher if they were food allergen friendly.

I recently purchased a used car and took it in to 1st Rate for an inspection.  They were very quick, friendly and professional, plus went above and beyond in helping out with a few extra questions, including an additional test drive to adjust aftermarket tires.  I'll be coming back here regularly as needed.

The service was great and the food was even better.  Easily the most unique sushi experience I have ever had.  We went all out and ordered one of each of the appetizers and chef special rolls.  Each one was better than the last and each one was especially unique in flavor.  I cannot wait to go back!

All the food was extremely bland, it's like they don't use any salt at all. I ordered fajitas, side of rice and beans - none of it had much seasoning. They also forgot our tortillas, so we had to run to the grocery store since we ordered takeout and they were about 15 minutes away. Would not order from here again.

It can get really busy so usually go for takeout and call in if I get a craving at dinner. Twice I have dinned in when it was slower. Service was good and the miso soup was a nice touch. I tried many of the rolls and other dishes all good but I think the best thing on the menu was the mexican maki YUM!!!

I decided to switch from Fall Creek Vision Center to Target because my visit was going to be substantially less expensive. I had no wait at all. The appointment was quick and the staff members were very friendly and helpful.  Dr Spalding could have been more congenial. She was hurried and apathetic.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This place is run down and not safe. The carpets are bunched up In Hallways. Wallpaper ripped on walls. Entry walls are filthy. Stains in the tub, sink plug was broken. You should take this off your offers.  It's never been fancy and we just needed a quick nights rest to go to the airport in the morning.  I expected so much more.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We usually go to Asian spice, but weren't open on new year's so got take out from here. I can say, food was hot and affordable. But. I order kung po beef because it's a spicy dish, but was not spicy at all. Sweet and sour chicken was very chewy. Crab puffs have alot of pepper in them. Fried rice is only soy sauce and rice.

if you like unhappy employees..surly attitude, only 1 taste allowed per person...3 per our group of 3....and music not really family friendly...b@tch etc.....this is the place for you. the ice cream was good (though one was overly soft).  maybe just an off night for the staff but other good choices within walking distance.

The service was truly excellent but the food itself was almost inedible. 

Anything tempura'd or fried was completely overdone, the yakitori was rubbery and the presentation for the sushi and the other dishes for that matter were very unappetizing 

The 2 stars are purely for the service

Jeni's has a pleasant atmosphere and friendly service.  We tried 4 flavors, all very unusual and surprisingly delicious.  Chocomole (chocoloate, cinnamon, cayenne, and corn chips) and the key lime were my favorites. It is expensive for the amount of ice cream you get and outdoor seating is limited, but it's worth a visit.

The food was not great at all it was the worst hamburgers I ever had and the and the onion rings was horrible my wife had her roast beef sandwich and a roast beef was older than I am and I'm 75 just not a great place to eat there was a guy sitting at the bar he went out and throat up the food was so bad.

The worst place. It's run by kids with NO sense of urgency. No customer service. It's so slow. Out of ingredients with no signs telling u that. The ice block had to be cleaned first and there was black stuff coming up as they scrapped it. So gross. Be prepared to wait an hour with only 2 customers in the store.

I rented a car for over a month and never received my $200 deposit back....As of today I still do not have my money,I've been going back and forth with management and my bank...still nothing...Enterprise immediately takes weekly payments out for your rental but getting your deposit back is another story!!!!

Unfortunately disappointing. Service was poor but lots of employees standing around moving sooooo slowly. Careful not to break your neck on that greasy dirty floor throughout the dining area. Add some bland pretty tasteless food and that sums up this place.

Food took over an hour and 15 minutes, it was cold. The wings were like bones. No celery, no blue cheese. And they didn't wrap the fries or mozzarella sticks. I used to order from them years ago and it was always so good. I'm not sure what happened but that was so disappointing.

I lost 42 pounds while working out in this gym and this location. The staff are super friendly and laid back. Everyone in the gym is respectful. It's clean. I never feel uncomfortable and egos are checked at the door. Very happy this gym is conveniently located in my Broadripple, Meridian Kessler, SoBro, Midtown community.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Alfredo, no flavor at all, just cream. The manager did not say anything other than the kitchen was closed (at 8:30 on a Saturday Night). The server was very slow  getting to the table the place was not busy.  I see why.  Place looks nice and the olive oil was good it's too bad food and serve is so poor.

This place is fantastic.  Our server Nathan was very polite bad professional  through out our meal. I had a meatball panini which was fantastic and my wife had the seafood Alfredo which she said was also fantastic. I will definitely be back and taking friends!

Hello,
I paid $70 for just my nails to be done not including tip. No tips just dip polish... 
I am usually not a complainer but he did not do what I asked and put all these gems on my ring fingers while murdering all my cuticles. 
I had high hopes for this place! And the people were so nice! But I sadly will not be going back.

Found something foreign in my chicken Caesar wrap. They said it was overcooked chicken but I'm not so sure
.kind of turned my stomach off
..service was so so maybe cause we had a small  child ...had to remind her after apps were served that I had asked for a glass of water

Food was really good, but our waitress Amanda could benefit from some customer service skills. She was rude. We took my elderly disabled dad out for dinner and as he's asking her a question about a dinner,she pulls the menu from his hands. He hadn't ordered yet! Drinks were more empty than full. It was a disappointment.

I have been attending this location now for some time and since the pandemic this Team/Crew have stepped up to the demand by keeping the doors open during and safe for all to visit, since this World Wide Health Concerns the COVID. This location is Clean and the Staff are Friendly.
Managers resolve issues promptly without hassle.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I ordered the spicy salmon and New Mexican roll they lacked the spicy taste that I was craving. My order was to go and it was messy because the two rolls were put together in one big plate. When I have ordered sushi to go it has been packed properly to keep a good presentation.

I stayed in August, 2021.  I noticed how dirty the floor was when doing some pushups.  Lots of small debris and dust - felt like it hadn't been washed in a very long time (weeks?).  This does not encourage piece of mind during the pandemic!

The desk clerk was friendly & efficient.  The location is good - ez freeway access.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Kenny and the guys consistently provide a great customer service experience. Friendly personal service. Upfront about costs.  Respectful of your time. Clean sunny waiting area. From maintenance to major repairs, they've earned my trust to efficiently get the job done right.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Clean rooms. Very friendly staff. Nice wide hallways.   Check in was easy and fast.  Our room had a view of a horse paddock which was kinda cool.

Breakfast was nice. I like the fact that you can grab some fruit and beverages before you check out, a few snacks for the road.

I would stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I really love the atmosphere of this bar and it is a really fun idea. However, the people that they hire are extraordinarily inconsiderate and impolite. I have had numerous altercations with the bar tenders. I feel like they think they are my customer when in fact I am theirs!

Do NOT waste your time at this place. I placed an order and went to pay through the app with a scanner. Store has no scanner and wanted me to pay with cash or a card. Really?  If that's the way they do business they don't need mine or yours so don't bother!

Ital motors is a great shop to have almost anything fixed with your car.  Fred and his staff and extremely professional and will not find problems you don't really have.  I have been taking my cars there for years, and have never had an issue.  Support small local business!

Ordered online and got there and only my drink was ready. I asked if my other item was coming and the lady had the worst attitude about it when I just asked very nicely if it was coming. Will be returning but hopefully I have a better experience next time.

I came here on a Friday wanted to get my car wash ,vacuum and wipe down .Big mistake ! Not only did my tire cap was missing afterwards ,also my statue on my dash completely broken .They seem to not care about quality they want quantity more than keeping their customers happy .You are better off doing it yourself !

Stained carpets, smells badly, sheets dirty, pubes on toilet and in shower, hallways haven't been vacuumed since Bush was in office.   Staff at front desk was nice and responsive but that doesn't make up for this disastrous experience.  I should have just slept in my car.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: usually they're pretty good, the food is never insanely bad and out of the mcdonalds in the area, it's usually pretty above average. on my way home one night i was getting food for me and all of my friends, i ordered 40 nuggets and legitimately got 4 packs of sauce for 40 nuggets. the audacity
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Came here the first time for my birthday dinner with family. Food was so fresh and delectable. Had an arugula salad as an appetizer, then the main entree was blackened grouper. Simply divine. Thanks for a wonderful evening. I especially enjoyed the locals strolling in and everyone enjoying their meals. Will definitely be back.

We've gone there twice, and found the sushi to be quite fresh and affordable, and the Asian-American owner was very nice to us, as well as the other staff. But I am afraid to write a positive review, because this is the kind of hole-in-the-wall place you'd rather keep secret. Dang it I need to limit my yelping to achieve that!

Been here twice now and I will never go anywhere else! My nails look like real nails not those thick misshaped "nails". I've had two different nail techs and they both have me a quality product. No cuticle Knicks or sanding to deep into your nail bed. If you want great nails WITH a great price, you have to check them out!!

Advertising suites in reality they are not. Rooms are simple, a bed and a bathroom, one chair no dresser, so tv is mounted,that's it, oh and a bedside table with lamp. Also no maid service, all for more than 350$ per night! Disappointed for the holiday left early.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I feel really bad writing this because the staff was nice. But this place just has the worst sushi I've ever had. I'm the least picky eater. But I could not eat anything from here. The sushi was strictly imitation crab and Mayo. The Mayo was so pungent. I'm gagging.

This place is kind of a joke i placed an order for their food through uber eats and i order the shrimp Pad Thai and THIS is what i get (refer to the picture)... So unless you want to have to use a microscope to find the shimp you ordered and pais 3$ extra for dont get the shrimp pad Thai

Wonderful food!! But a little overpriced.  We took our 16 year old for dinner.  Our bill was $200 without tip.... For PASTA.  Yes the other food was good but not as good as my Italian mothers!!  I will stick with the other restaurants in so philly that are a real deal for the$$$$.

The food is absolutely delicious as well as the drinks! They also have nice, spacious booths and cool stuff to look at on the walls. However, when I went there, the service was really slow, even with no one else there at 4pm. And the place seemed a little too dark and musty, which took away from the atmosphere.

2nd choice as breakfast spot had hour wait. Food was not good. Flatbread was just some fixings sprinkled on cracker bread. Wasn't even grilled. Grilled sandwich was barely grilled. Scenic views of river. Bees buzzed around all meal. A pity such a scenic spot has such a poor Chef

This is a great store: friendly, clean, excellent products. I went recently, remembering their beautiful produce, and was asked at checkout if I wanted to receive promotional emails. I agreed. Today I picked up some great quality deals from their meat department. This is definitely a keeper for me.

Great place to stay. Close to everything. We had a huge 1 bedroom apartment overlooking courtyard. It has old time charm with 100+ year old building and stairs. Nicely updated. The key situation is odd, but European travelers are used to it. They should check IDs when handing out keys. Highly recommend
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Be sure to double check your take out order. Mine wasn't right the last 3 times. Sorry to say. Good food. Good value. Young staff doesn't care and doesn't pay attention. The owner or manager needs to fix it or customers will figure out there are other options.

This was by far my worst experience ever at a car place the manager was rude the front desk woman was rude and I still had to go back to another just for breaks in order for them to actually fix my car right. don't go to the Reno store take your time go to the one in Sparks, Rufino the manager over there is absolutely amazing
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I live in NASHVILLE.   I travel to Tampa twice a year just to eat at Spartico's place!  This is my favorite Italian restaurant in the country and I particularly enjoy Spartico and his warm reception and attention to detail.  Make sure you order the tortellacci!!!

I can't get a haircut here in Oregon but I was in Oro Valley last week and Aimee was working at CDO.  I have seen her once before and she gave me one of the best haircuts ever.  And this haircut is just as good.  She is quick, pleasant and listens to what you ask for.  It was worth the trip to Tucson just for the haircut

They had a great selection and very knowledgeable staff. They were friendly and quickly helped me find exactly what I was looking for. The Isles Argan laid out really well in the labels are very helpful. Whether you're an amateur or sommelier you will enjoy this spot.

Just straight up dope! We actually drove to Chicago from Muncie, IN just for some Lou Malnati's. It starts at the crust and works it's way up. I find myself craving Lous classic and have had many conversations contemplating the best of the top 3 Chicago pizzerias and lous is my top pick. Go there, eat good pizza, enjoy!

Food was ok. A fancy menu but executed with poor skill. I really wanted to like this place the ambiance is great and the outdoor dining is a plus. However, being that we dined outside our server may have forgotten about us. One of us had to go inside to ask for bread. Not a good outing

The service was friendly but slow.  The food was mediocre and overpriced.  It was hard to believe that they can survive in this area with the level of food.  We had eggplant parmagiana and one of the veal dishes.  Both of them were mediocre or below.  We won't be back.

it was a wed so it was slow. 2 non craft beers came to 7.00. the bartender seemed really disinterested even after I asked her a question or two regarding the beers. 

nice outside seating. no food but Tony's next door is good. 

there is a run club on wed night (I think weekly). seemed like a good crowd but otherwise it was dead.

Service is very slow, food is good, bill is full of additional charges, like service charge and they try to include a 18% tip so at the end with tax at 8.5% you should end paying around 30% extra in your dinning out, so be careful with that, always check your ticket before paying.

Bought a Don Carlos #2 Cigar today. Drove straight home and put it in my well seasoned humidor. Just poured a single malt scotch which I also purchased at the same store and the $14.00 Cigar was falling apart. If you are going to sell high end cigars somebody needs to pay attention to them. Very disappointing.

The food is great but the service and management of the place is horrible. I mean HORRIBLE. We waited almost an hour to get our drinks and  1 1/2 hour for our food. It's very disappointing to drive over 20 miles to find a food restaurant with such a HORRIBLE management group.

Awful restaurant, do not stop and waste your money. Dirty restaurant, dirty bathrooms. Got our order incorrect, forgetting fries and forgetting a drink and gave us an extra burger. Food was awful. Cold fries, soggy toppings on the burger. Complete waste of money.

This is the vibe you were looking for! Relaxed and inviting! We came in on our last day in New Orleans looking for someplace to hang out before heading to the airport. The space is just lovely. The service and beverages are fantastic too. I envy all of the locals who can visit this gem everyday.

The guy at the registry is a bastard xenophobe that will make fun of you in a very disrespectful manner if you happen to have an accent. Even though you're giving him money. If you still want to go there, please don't miss the opportunity to put him in his place.

AMAZING HOTEL! This property went through a renovation and you can tell! Beautiful rooms, great event space. Came here with a group and they have treated us perfectly. The breakfast staff stayed on top of things, even when 100+ of us came down within an hour period to eat. Thank you for such a great stay:)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This Dunkin Donuts has a captive audience and therefore the customers don't have many options inside the airport terminal.
Service with no smile, and lots of attitude.
Employees act like they are being forced to work.
Horrible service.
The last time I come here.

Bruhh...... do yourself a favor and go. The outside doesn't look like all that but inside is clean and the ambiance is nice. Went on a Sunday a 3pm so it was slow. We got tamales for an appetizer and ended up getting 5 more to go  we are most certainly going back because the food was bangin

Got a good deal on priceline and I was still let down.   Room was older, the fan in the bathroom never worked, the elevators were slow and the card to get up to the room was cumbersome. The bar closed at random hours and did not have the drinks we wanted.  For a hotel to cost this much, NO WAY!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Two stars for good location and cleanliness. Our room not being available until almost 5pm, having to pay for WiFi and having a maid knock loudly and then barge into our room at 8:45am this morning makes this place NOT worth the price we paid. Won't be back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I asked for a large coffee.  I got a large coffee.  I didn't ask for a smile, small-talk, offer to donate to the Ronald McDonald House, or anything else.  I didn't get anything else.  This was expected behavior, and for that, I am grateful.

And the coffee beats anything in 30th Street Station.

Very dirty restaurant.  I should have followed my intuition upon arriving.  Very dirty entry way and interior walls were dirty.  I had the most unimpressive chirashi ever.  Just rice on a plate with the fish on top and a few lettuce pieces.  Nothing else to accentuate it like you'd normally see.  Sub-par.  Avoid.

My boyfriend and I both ordered double cheese burgers and fries. The lady confirmed our order in a weird not very comprehendible language, so we have her the benefit. The girl handing the food out was super rude and you could tell she hated her job. In the plane we realized we got a cheese burger and one fry. Thanks BK

I don't know why I chose to come here, I should've known better. I almost feel like Taco Bell's food is better. I know, that's going far. They're Spanish rice and has to be pre-made and come in cans. Also, Rosarita refried bean are way better. I'm giving them two stars because they have good salsa.

Best damn restaurant in Tampa. Easily accommodated our last minute late night large group. Kept the drinks and food flowing,  and provided brisk friendly service. And the food? Stupidly good. Put it in your mouth. Go here immediately and do yourself a favor. This place is amazing.

Old school, South Phila Italian...

Waitresses are not real friendly, but the service is good.  Love the food!  Never had a bad meal. They have the best red sauce with their steamed clams!  Also love their Chicken Neapolitan (very rich!).

Parking may be a pain, but it is worth the trouble.

I wish I would have read the reviews before renting from here. Waited in line for 40 minutes because only one person was working and the kiosks weren't working. Then still had to wait because the car I reserved wasn't ready. Don't waste your time renting from here. Spend the extra money and go elsewhere.

Nice room at a great off-season rate.  This is a slightly odd property located away from the beach and kind of mid block.  Since most of the other hotels in the area are beach front or closer to the beach you could be disappointed if you didn't do your research.  

Staff was very nice and the overall experience good.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
They make their own tortillas. Their drinks are fantastic. The food is excellent, perfectly cooked with a delicious combination of flavors and textures.

I like this place a lot. One of my favorite meals since moving here from LA a year ago. Will definitely be back.

The food is not edible! Ordered the chicken tenders, nachos and a sandwich. Everything was so dry and over cooked. Probably some of the worst food I have ever had. The service took 30 min for the food to come out. Do yourself a favor and eat somewhere else...anywhere else!

girls (or boys) --

if you need a good present for a boyfriend, stat, THIS is the place to go.  hot towel shaves (plus booze), quality flasks, watches, shaving gear, cuff links, etc etc etc...  anything a classy boy (or a boy with a classy significant other) could ever dream of!

Its ok, it did the job while we were waiting for our Ghost walking tour.
A slice of pizza to hold us over, Slices were good size, the pizza itself was so-so, the atmosphere was gross, and dirty. the guy helping us didnt seem happy to be there, but i wouldnt either if I had to work there, especially in the night shift

Found this restaurant using Yelp. It's a casual, small place with seating inside and outside. You order your food, sit down and they bring it to you. I ordered grilled chicken enchiladas with rice and beans. I liked the food. I'm not much of a bean eater but overall it was good. It's an eatery I would frequent.

Not a bad little airport bar.  Nice atmosphere, a little expensive, but who looks at beer prices at the airport anyway?

Nice selection of craft beers.

Food was so-so, I had the Italian Sausage sandwich.  

I would suggest drinking but perhaps not eating here.

We stay at this Marriott several times a year while in Nashville.  The staff is very helpful and knowledgeable about the area.  The rooms are always clean and comfortable.  The bar area is perfect for socializing and we love the weekend breakfast buffet - especially the great prices if you're a Marriott Rewards member.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Decent for Tucson, but I wasn't that impressed.  They did not have any of the "fancy stuff" as the chef put it.  I guess Uni, Ikura, and Ama-Ebi are considered a fancy compared to the rolls which seem to be their specialty.   Unfortunately, they were not carrying uni that night.  The rest of the nigiri was of average freshness.

Pro: One of the best "pure" Sushi in Indianapolis. The cook is actually Japanese, not Korean or Chinese. Their appetizers are great too. The staff are friendly. I recommend going there on weekdays 5-7pm for their half price nigiri. Great deal!

Cons: A little bit pricy, but all good Japanese foods in Indy are too.

Shuttle to airport great. Car was nice with satellite radio. But the staff didn't look at the car when I returned it and should have. They also emailed a receipt with the wrong dates. And now I have to contact them to make sure I'm not overcharged. Sloppy accounting and inattentive staff. Would not use again.

Very nice hotel with large rooms and a super friendly staff!  I was staying over due to an early connection at TPA and was a little bummed that the hotel didn't have shuttle service until well after my flight departure time.  Other than that, it was a very nice stay and the room was fantastic!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Not a fan of this place. Went here twice and had to buy a drink just to use the bathroom. My girlfriend bought a white russian and I bought a shot. The bartender put my shot in my girlfriend's drink without me knowing. Poor service, dirty upkeep and barely had anyone in there both times.
