For kids glasses they have a ton of colors and patterns and sunglasses. Quick service and bonus if your prescription changes within 90 days (I think that's right) they will update your lenses free. With my kid that is exactly what happened and we were so glad they do that!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This was kind of rough. It's 8:45am and I waited 30 minutes for scrambled eggs and bacon... The food is actually pretty good, healthy portions, but for an airport cafe they really need to be faster in the kitchen. It's a good thing I had an hour before boarding!

This was exactly the hot dog I expected it to be and that made it a perfect dog. 

The cashier was efficient and friendly. It may have helped that I drop a dollar in the tip jar as I approached to place my order.  Either way, I love hot dogs and this one was just like one you would get at a fair.  #Awesome

The Great: The mouth-watering Noble Burger, the illustrious bartenders, Christian and Theo, and the mixed drinks.

The Good:  Decor, Atmosphere, and craft beer selection.

The Bad: The downstairs bar can get a bit jammed up on busier days, Center City Sips, etc.

Plusses:

Economical for where it's located. (My $85 single was $100 by the time Reno dipped its beak.)
The people running it are very friendly.
It has that old-school vibe and a sign to match.
Free parking.
Free WiFi.

Minuses:

Rooms are nothin' fancy.
Right on a pretty noisy street.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: If you want premium priced diner food with diner ambience, mediocre food and poor service, Phil's Tavern is your place. Needless to say my family and I will not return nor can I recommend it friends knowing we passed numerous other restaurants in the area.

Worst Motel 6 I've ever stayed in.
1. bathroom door doesn't lock
2. a little rust in bath tub
3. wireless internet never works
4. kinda annoying staff lady
I don't really expect very much from Motel 6, but this one was significantly lamer than all the other ones.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I frequent this Starbucks location. Generally quick & friendly service (even from the revolving door of baristas) as I always order through the mobile app before I arrive. Docking one star because the women's bathroom perpetually smells like the pachyderm exhibit at a zoo. Yuck.

This place was a huge disappointment. Wait staff was less than pleasant and made themselves scarce whenever possible. Food was a joke. Over-done pasta and thin, tasteless sauce. I'd rather waste my $ at the Olive Garden. At least there you'll get decent service with your awful meal.

I tried to pick up a rental car that was already paid for and they tried to charge me again and then ran my credit report and told me I couldn't use a debit card. Very unprofessional, pretty much fraudulent behavior. The manager is nasty and rude and all they do is talk in circles.  Walk down the hall to Avis!

This was our 2nd visit to this place. Stopped in on a Friday night. I had the chicken enchilada this time, my wife had the burrito and our daughter had the steak soft taco. All were happy with the meals. Clean place. Friendly staff. The queso was better this time than our previous visit.

This is the most amazing Italian restaurant in the area! We travel two hours for their delish lasagna and the pizza is amazing!!! Super friendly owner and always so accommodating! This place is a for sure try! Ask for Mario! He is definitely the hostess with the mostest.

For a DoubleTree this wasn't up to par, but it's in a great location. A few blocks from the French Quarter action, close to conventions and directly next to the casino if that's your thing. 

It had a nice outdoor pool patio that's great for lounging with spotty wifi. But I'm not here for the room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Hahaha this place is hilarious! The front desk guy looks like Mr Miyagi!! And he gave a me a deal for the night $70 i think because it was 1am. The room itself. Wasn't so great the bed was like a graham cracker and the pillows super stuff as well but last min room totally fine I'd do it again just for that guy.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Ooka was a complete surprise from what I saw on the outside.  Interior design of the place was totally hip.  Felt like you were in a big city eating out.

Food was very good.  The sweat potato tempura roll is amazingly good! New York roll and Western roll are both worthy of getting.

This place was not easy to find and they wouldn't check us in until exactly 3:00pm. The room was clean. Bathroom is nice. No toothbrush or toothpaste in site though. My mattress was uncomfortable and visibly sank tremendously in the middle. Restaurant closes at 10pm.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Tempura shrimp not tempura. Not a good value for the amount of food. Bloody Mary not good. I had a sweet tea and they mixed it up with regular tea on my refill.  Normally that's no big deal, but we were literally the only customers at the time.  Bad customer service
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I reserved a full size car and after a 30 minute wait I was provided with a mid-size rental.   When I returned the car there was only one staff member on the lot to receive scores of returning rental cars.  Staff was professional but as a customer i felt that I was an afterthought due to poor staffing & poor selection of vehicles.

I have not visited this business either, but similarly to the reviewer below, this address was used to fraudulently purchase items on my credit card through BH Photo. This salon's address and the name Mikey Tang were listed as the shipping address for a $1900 Macbook Pro. Not good. :(

Went here late at night for drinks after the wine bar across the street was full. Great decision. Good selection of alcohol and the bartender did a good job with the mixed drinks. This includes a spicy Dark and Stormy that was far superior than what I would usually expect. Loved the outdoor patio as well.

Late night arrival into St Louis and hungry on a Sunday night. Waitress indicated kitchen closed but happy to prepare a salad for me. Good club salad not outstanding and a really cold beer. Lots of wide screen TV's to watch games. Sport bar atmosphere. Cordial staff and made to feel customer important!

Great atmosphere. Had a caesar salad and the veal. Cheese overload and the balsamic veal dish was too sweet so not really impressed by the food. The menu was great looking and I love the presentation. Would recommend this place anyway because the environment is fantastic.

I was not impressed with the place. The ambiance is not for me. It is very trendy and a tad too dark for me. (But the blue lighting does look great). The prices were a bit high for my taste, that the quality of food did not make up for.  This is a place to try but is not for me.

We were in town around Thanksgiving, so got a good deal. The hotel itself is great - grand architecture, very friendly staff, nice luxurious rooms, awesome beds, and clean. The Starbucks within the hotel didn't hurt at all! 

Only nits: no free WiFi? Not even LANs?
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Average Italian food at above average prices. The service was slow and the wine recommendation terrible. The serving size was huge, a signature if quantity over quality restaurants. My salad was awful with very bitter greens, but the gnocchi was quite good.

Choose your nights wisely. A great, well appointed bar with leather couches and a pool table first half of the week, and any evening for an early cocktail. Steer clear on Fridays and Saturdays, unless you are hotel middle management looking to score a sorority sister.

Not sure what all the hype is about with this place. Wait staff takes forever, from greeting you, to taking the sushi order then when the food does arrive the sushi leaves much to be desired. 

I love sushi and this is the worst I've had in Tucson so far. 

Our waitress was friendly. that's the most I can say for this place.

Tobi totally rocked my customized pixie cut! She spent a lot of time and care on making this cut exactly what I wanted and made sure it would lay perfectly. She was friendly, creative, and easy to work with. She listened to all my crazy ideas and executed the cutest thing. Thank you for the care!

Great, friendly service and delicious homemade pasta. However, I would avoid any dish that includes fish as it does not taste fresh. I ordered the sea bass and needed a whole lemon to help me get past the fishy smell; fresh fish does not have a pungent smell. I do highly recommend the homemade tagliatelle.

The walls in this hotel are so ridiculously paper thin I can hear my neighbor breathing. The location is pretty good and it has nice history being an old train station but there are so many better hotels located in downtown Indianapolis than this hotel. Especially if you are looking for a good nights sleep.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I like the style of the restaurant, but it doesn't have a lot if space inside. They wanted us to sit outside but it was a cold.  I had the tonkutsu ramen which was respectable; The teriyaki chicken was nothing special. Everything was pretty much 3 starish.

I like the style of the restaurant, but it doesn't have a lot of space inside. They wanted us to sit outside but it was a cold.  I had the tonkutsu ramen which was respectable; The teriyaki chicken was nothing special. Everything was pretty much 3 starish.

My cousin and I went here for pedicures. Friendly and accommodating but poor selection of colors. 50 shades of red infact.  Cleanliness was subpar and nails smudged after 5 minutes. Manicure bubbled. Plus mani pedi was 47.50 and just around the corner it was only $40. Won't be going back.

The food was much better the last time I was here. The food was disappointing this time. The broccoli rabe was awful and the positano barely had any seafood. The seafood it did had was not very good. The service was good, which makes it disappointing that the food was not.

Some of the best food in the US; what a find.   It's not a surprise that the restaurant is run by a SF ex pat.  The food was fresh, inventive, and easy on the pallet.   I was only in town for three nights and ate there twice.  If I ever return to St. Luis I will make my way back to Niche.

I've been here a couple of times and I can honestly say that this place has the best lengua tacos I've ever had. If you're ever in the Santa Barbara area, this is a place you have to try for some amazing tacos. Also, the prices are reasonable; $2 per taco.

The food was great!  The Owner, Ms. Lee, is lovely!  The Teppan tables were as good as any in Hawaii and the atmosphere was perfect!  We had a great time and I will go there many more times before I leave Middle Tennessee!  Love, Love the fried spaghetti noodles at the bar.  Clever idea for munchies!

I love chowing down at goleta sushi house.

I've been coming here for years and it's always been a favorite of mine. The owner is the sweetest lady and always greets us like family. 

I love the salmon sashimi here the most. It's a pretty good deal. Nice thick slices that are nice and tender. Delicious!

Stayed for my friend b-day celebration in Philly, the parking is 30$ a night so since we only stayed one night on a Saturday we parked on the street since its free on Sunday.  The hotel is very nice, clean kind of "upscale."  It's pricey so consider that when booking but it is definitely in the heart of Philly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: While this Starbucks has no drive thru, Emma really made my morning. I super appreciate staff who enjoy customer service and are good at it. Thank you, Emma for doing your job while being happy and attentive to customers. You rock! The people really make the place.

The food was awesome which would have made it five stars, but the waitress Lindsay (with an "a") had such a horrible pretentious sour attitude that it almost made all my food sour.
I know what bacon tastes like. So don't tell me it doesn't taste like bacon it just has the snap of bacon.

The lobby was officially open for business during COVID-19. The branch was very organized and clean. The banker was efficient and sweet. It was a pleasant outing to be able to get out of the house and take care of our banking needs. The manager, Jeff, was warm and welcoming.

The live music here was AMAZING! My friend and I loved the band. However, the bartenders are awful. I stood waiting to order a drink for a good 10 min staring at the lady behind the bar as she stuffed her face with food, checked her phone, then ask what we wanted. She also didn't wash her hands after eating then serving us. Yikes!

I recently stayed there for 4 days...and I will DEFINITELY be staying there again. The location is perfect! The staff was perfect!! The room was like a cute little apt. Really enjoyed my stay and the bed was so comfy!!  If you're looking for a cozy/safe place to stay in the French quarter. This is the place!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This is the second time I've gone in. Ive had Roman both times and he does a phenomenal job. He gets you in, gets you out, but does a damn good job. He takes great care of you. I live in West Philly and it is worth my time to go across town to get my hair cut. $25 for a great haircut is well worth it.

Good place for business travelers.  It's real quiet inside with nice beds.  Provide quick free shuttle service around the area. Beds are quality and really comfortable.  They just need a better misc shop inside with better offerings.  Agree with the photos and reviews posted.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Management is very attentive and know everyone by name! The club is always clean and never too crowded. The equipment is all brand new, and I love being able to track my progress on the Preva Systems. 

Great club! I haven't been to another Anytime Fitness location (yet), but this one is going to be hard to beat!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Worst apartment complex ever. The front office staff has no idea what they are doing. The place has emptied out over the last couple months and we are counting down the days to get out of here. Staff cannot answer questions, and they are not friendly. zero customer service skills. Save yourself the headache.

Great location with a handful of cars in a parking lot is a sign. Used to be a good place with solid service and dishes. Figured I'd stop in for a bite while visiting the area. Tonight demonstrated that greatness is behind them. Food was bland or simply unpleasant.

First visit and well pleased. Erica provided excellent service guiding to make choices that ensures we will return. Started with potatoes poutine which was amazing. Had the amazing meatloaf, areaps and grilled pork chops as entrees and we all shared taste. Ending meal with a red curry pound cake which was amazing!

Came in with my friend to check out what changes were made after Bar Rescue. Everything seemed to be basically the same, only Modelo on tap, my friend ordered a whiskey ginger but they didn't have ginger ale? Overall felt pretty unwelcome and we left after getting 1 drink.

Excellent staff but the facilities are very outdated.  I requested a room change because the tile in my bathroom was broken and rather gross.  Also, the exercise facility is terrible - a small room with a handful of treadmills and some free weights.  I've stayed at much nicer marriott's in the past.  But, again, excellent staff.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Service, ambience were top notch.  We had antipasto, seared beef tenderloin, veal Marsala.  The seared beef was probably one of the most perfect plates I can remember tasting- and I'm a beef snob.  The polenta texture and taste was nothing short of amazing.  The veal Marsala was average.

The only didn't get the 5th star because of price ($14 for burger with no fries). I got a turkey burger, my wife got pulled port and we cleared our plates happily. They were very good. A little tight space in the bar section with luggage, but otherwise a nice place to hang for layover and hungry stomach.

First time to the Milano Inn and had a wonderful experience. The service was wonderful, the food was top notch and we were treated like family.  I found the prices very reasonable and the portions to be plentiful. I will definitely return to this wonderful restaurant.

I am going g to give them the COVID "can't find help" pass. But my 3 stars is generous summary of service and food

It must be better given the historical ratings and frequent appearances on "Best of" lists. So I will assume soggy crust, poor service are out of the norm.

After waiting an hour and a half past my appointment time I had multiple staff members agree that 1.5 hours was a standard wait time for a Wednesday morning. Unfortunately, I won't be able to support this establishment any longer. My time is worth more than how it was treated here.

The hotel itself was average, but booking a room for the event I was attending was a nightmare. Also, parts of the hotel were under construction and it was noisy. Finally, we were awakened bright and early by a protest out our window on the street that included a loud speaker blaring a screaming baby. Ugh!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ate there once a few months ago and it took 1 hour for our food to come out. The food was a B.  A couple days ago we decided to try them out again. Their website says the close at 10, but when we went in they said they closed at 7 that day because they didn't have a lot of customers. Girl behind counter was kind of rude about it.

I was sat by the hostess and given menus. About ten minutes later was given water. We then sat for another 30 minutes before anyone spoke to us and we went inside to order food to-go. Somewhat apologetic, they did nothing for the inconvenience. Food was overpriced and not very delicious. Will not be returning.

Whenever we are in Philadelphia, we always make sure to go to Fat Salmon. We love the blue and white ambience, always complemented with cool music. Each dish is a work of art as the many photos here illustrate. The service is cheerful, knowledgeable and quick

The food was good minus the large red hair in my food. 

They gave me new food but after the meal the dish was still on my bill and when we asked the waitress said "well they made you a new one." Super super snooty and rude.

The manager took it off but it was just unprofessional.

This place is only good if you're drunk, high or hung over. The burgers are definitely unique, I'll give them that. Very bland. Service was terrible as well. All of us got are food late, including one of us which they completely forgot about. Would not reccomend.

Unique little spot with a welcoming ambiance and cozy aesthetic. Staff were somewhat hospitable which was the only downside (-1 Star) but their food; the taste, freshness, and presentation compensate for this minor caveat. Service of staff needs improvement. My fair rating for this unique spot will be a solid 4 Star.

Fish quality is ok, and rolls are not super generous with meat quantity.

Some of the special rolls have some creative cutting techniques, like slicing a cucumber so that it can be wrapped around sushi.

Sauces can be a bit on the salty side, and some combinations are too heavy.

We got a half-dozen of different flavors and every single one was well done and delicious. I highly recommend the pumpkin cake donut with white icing. That was my personal favorite. Roughly $7 and change for half a dozen donuts. Definitely will go back to splurge on the weekends.

I wish I took a photo before driving through but this location needs new plastics over the drive through menu. Less than half of it is legible from the car because of the scratch and yellow tinted surface. Probably best to look at their menu online before getting there or expect to be asking a lot of questions about what they have.

DO NOT CONSIDER MOVING HERE! My lease is up this month and it cant come soon enough! Jennifer in the accounting office has horrible customer service and does not know how to talk to residents! All they care about is how much more money they can get from u! NEVER MOVE HERE YOU WILL BE DISAPPOINTED!!

Mimi nails is my absolutely favorite nail salon in the area. It offers an extremely clean, pleasant environment at great prices. I always walk away so happy with my nails and the whole experience. 

I trust them so much I even got my nails done for my wedding here.

My order was messed up. I asked for extra ketchup on my sandwich and got none. They totally left out a sandwich and to top it off, there was a dead bug under the lid of my drink. I will never go back here again and advise all locals to follow suit. The pen is mightier than the sword, I will be writing corporate.

Very good deals and specials but the produce is old and wilted. Lettuce leaves are decaying, potatoes are sprouting, avocados are mush. Anything else is ok to purchase (just check the expiration date) but there are better markets out there. It's cool they deliver if you spend at least $60 though.

Nothing, including the unlimited booze, will distract you from what's unfortunately subpar Italian food. Or maybe not exactly Italian food since the scrambled eggs in chicken broth served as soup doesn't really seem authentic. 

Pros: sweet waiter, yummy creamy limoncello, free wine

Expensive and sub-par
Carne asada is dry and lack flavor.  $2 per taco for street tacos is higher than any street tacos I've had before and the place doesn't even have classics like al pastor. If you're used to SoCal taco trucks, you'll be disappointed. Better to get some meat from the carneceria yourself and cook at home.

Zinc Cafe a great local business with phenomenal food and service. Every time my husband and I have eaten here (for brunch and lunch), the food is amazing: flavorful, plentiful, and fairly priced. On top of that, you really feel at home and taken care of in this restaurant.

Seems like a very nice laundry with very nice staff. But contrary to an earlier review is NOT a dry cleaner.  I'm leaving the 5* rating because I have no reason to downgrade them.  I just wanted to correct the record so that someone else doesn't go there seeking a dry cleaner.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Step below a chain restaurant Italian food. Recently visited for lunch. The same person hosting was serving, busing tables etc = poor service lead times. Food was average fare. Marinara sauce is bland to say the least. I would not return again given it is pricey for the quality.

We live in the area and always like to take friends here. I have even had folks from way on the south side tell me they drive out here for meals. Friendly prompt service with a smile. Weekends and dinner rush can get crazy. Live music on the weekends just adds to the atmosphere. Oh yeah food is Fantastic aswell.

Horrible food. I had a Gourmet Burger, the description sounded great, the actually burger no lies had to have been a frozen patty and bun they got from Walmart. They heated it up pulled it apart added some stuff to the middle and served it for $16.50. My microwave could have made a burger equally as terrible for $2.

Good Italian good and open outdoor al-fresco dining; a great choice if weather is good during these COVID-altered days.  Not sure, if they have heaters for cold weather. We stopped by for lunch and enjoyed a good selection of pastas and salads. They are good with social distancing and masking.

Great location and great sushi! A perfect lunch sitting by the marina looking out at the beautiful sail boats. Nicely priced rolls in a premium location. If we lived in the harbor, we'd be there daily! Wish they had sake.  Parking was FREE too, that's not always easy to find on the waterfront.

I don't know why people have been so hard on dimaggios in their yelp reviews. The food was actually pretty good especially in comparison to the surrounding restaurants in the area. Dimaggios was clean, and the staff was friendly and accommodating. If you're in the area, I'd say check this place out.

Ordered cheesesteak pizza and didn't realize there were stuffed and regular. Needless to say got the wrong pizza. Staff was less than sympathetic, almost rude. We moved on, paid for both. Also ordered calzone and soup. Calzone was cold in the center and soup flavorless.

Had breakfast there this morning and asked for a egg and chorizo breakfast burrito. There was no egg, onion cheese or clintro. I ask the clerk where the eggs were and she said the cook put in two eggs .. there was no eggs in this breakfast burrito.. will never go there again...

Spent around 30 minutes in the drive thru. Had a mildly complicated order and was missing a sandwich. The sweet teas were really warm and without any ice. Fish sandwich wasn't hot, not even warm. We were starving so we took it all without complaint. The girls taking the order and distributing food were very polite and patient.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We waited in the drive-thru line for over 30 minutes because no one was at the speaker to take our order or anyone else's. Our order was not ready at the window, and was actually not even taken down at all. They rang us up at the window and missed part of our order. Took us over 40 minutes total.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Teriyaki steak quality was very disappointing to say the least. I feel like they chose the lowest grade of steak possible to serve. Considering the price, I was expecting a much better quality cut. The vegetables were completely flavorless. The fried rice was also very plain.

Well, the service is incredibly slow, they never refilled our water glasses ( and they served unfiltered tap  water) and the food came out cold. 

Despite all that, the food tasted halfway decent. They just need more employees and faster service and for the love of God, get a water filter.

Melanie did a fantastic job! I was traveling to Reno for work and needed a cut before returning to California. Went at noon on a Wednesday and only had to wait about 5 mins. Was in and out in less than 30 mins. Hair cut looks great!! Will definitely return on my next trip to the area.

Can't say enough great things! From Libby (General Manager) to the ever helpful staff and everything in between. The room, vibe and location is perfect and there's so many added pluses to discover as you explore. All the restaurants have great happy hours and great wine selection. Wish we could give Hotel California six stars!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This hotel was reasonably priced, clean, and very close to the stadium and convention center. It was convenient to dining and shopping downtown as well. Great amenities, pool & gym. Also, the staff was incredible and went above & beyond to make our stay enjoyable! Would highly recommend this hotel! Thank you!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Pluses: big rooms, friendly staff. Negatives: NOT kid friendly. Very noisey hallways, ice machine empty, horrible music blasting from "a restaurant across the lake". No free wifi or fridge in the room. Considering it's $$$ to stay this really surprised me.  Meh. I'll stick with Holiday Inn.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Avoid!! Out of town business person, used them twice and both times my clothes were not ready when promised. The second time they were lost for a week, I was told the owner's daughter left them in her car (?). As others have stated, turning into and out of this parking lot can be difficult.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Oh my lord DO NOT RENT HERE. First of all, it's way way way off site. The shuttle ride builds an extra 20 minutes into your trip, and Sixt is notorious for long check ins and check outs. If you got this because of Hotwire - like I did - then I feel bad for the both of us.

Decent.  TGIFridays is attached to the hotel, and this is where the continental breakfast happens (sort of strange).  The views of the parkway were nice.  They played muzak really loud in the hall all night, and I couldn't sleep because of the muzak and light coming from under the door.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We came through here at 4 am when everything else is closed, and the employee seemed a little less than enthusiastic.. but who is at 4am?! We ordered two quarter pounders and some fries and they were all fresh and hot and made correctly. I was nervous when I read other reviews but I'm pretty dang satisfied.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Punk night manager accused me of being a drunk even though I live in st Louis. Called 4 times asking for a Corporate number and hung up on me. Last time said he would call pontoon PD. Lol . 15$ hour Really this is the piece Demanding this .  I will be calling till you no longer get work there bud. Worst customer service ever .
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is hands down my new favorite frozen treat place! I was sooo lucky that my Bumble date took me here!! (It went well by the way). I got the strawberry basil ice pop: 12/10!!! I'm glad I swiped right and found this gem (him and the cute frozen treat place).

I had probably one of the worst dining experiences I've ever had.. we have tried to come to this establishment multiple time but every time the service gets worse and worse! This will be the last time me an my family ever visit tacos Jalisco.. food is decent service is worse an no one cares..

We are visiting from south Florida and this was our first stop. We had an amazing dinner, and even more amazing service. Everyone there was so accommodating and kind. 
We had the monkey brain app, gyoza, bulgolgi udon and a bunch of rolls. Everything was delicious! This place is a true gem.

This is no joke my favorite taco place. They're consistently delicious and a great value for the price. Come support this local business and have the best tacos of your life (okay like....really good tacos). The only downside is they're closed on Tuesdays and I somehow always crave tacos on Tuesdays for some reason

Never again will I go to a place that waits on 2 other folks in-between my time of placing a order. Don't care what the situation is you can wait on them when I'm done making my order.   Sad thing is the manager saw it and didn't do a dang thing about it. 

Next time I know to never come back and waist my time!

Great small restaurant at the entrance of terminal 1. The size to the plates is on the smaller side , I got a salad and added a protein (salmon) to it and was still left hungry. Got the charcuterie plate and it was good but quite small as well. Great news, you can put wine in a glass and take it along w you :)

We live in SF bay area and eat plenty of good sushi.  This is right up there at the top!!!  Amazing!  Loving it!  Hand rolls, mussels, baby octopus, and rolls are amazing!  Skip the casino food! Thank you!  Great anniversary sushi.  Do the all you can eat!!!  All-you-can-eat appetizers included.

My family has frequented this place since I was a kid. Food hasn't changed. Sometimes service can be slow. Seafood soup on the weekends is a must. Red snapper is flakey off the bone. Beans are super creamy and hearty. Good is consistently great, service is just slow at times.

Ordered $25 worth of food and the cashier wanted to get an attitude because we asked for 2 extra sweet and sour sauces. For 30 nuggets we got 3 sauces.  All the employees had a terrible attitudes and gave us mean looks after they forgot our fries. 

Probably one of the worst McDonald's I've been to
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: All i can say is black mold was all over the ceiling near AC vent and in bathroom. Room smelt musty and the staff was not friendly. Bed bugs all over and the pictures look pretty but its not. Construction is going on they did tell us that but it just was disgusting. First visit and definitely my last.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ignore the old reviews with low ratings.  This gym is awesome and under new management.  Todd is super friendly and helpful.  I'm here visiting for work and the gym is a larger set up and is clean.  Great equipment and a great layout.  Location and parking is easy.  Definitely one of the nicest anytime fitness' I have been in.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: First thing when we got here they gave us the wrong room and we walked right in on strangers getting dressed. Second air doesn't work but thankfully it's not very hot. Third tub is clogged and won't drain. Fourth room is ground in filthy there's an inch of dirt on the tables.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Don't stay here!! These guys are complete screw ups!! I booked a room with this hotel online for a double queen only to find they just had single Kings. Then to make up for things they out me into their "sister" hotel next door, Americas best value. This hotel has its own set of nightmares. Stay away, I'm telling you.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: They can't be slower anymore.....I feel it's not because the food is hard to prepare but staff are not hurry... Their moved very slow even 10 people are waiting in front them... If you see 4 people in front of you, trust me, just leave. Otherwise, half hour waiting.

Literally every time I go to this McDonald's drive through they forget something, and always forget the condiments. The condiments are important people! By now I should know better and check before I leave.  It's worth while to drive to the Bryn Mawr McDonald's instead.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Not sure where these good reviews are coming from.. the service was odd, our salad had the whole bottle of Caesar dressing dumped on the lettuce, the pasta was undercooked, chicken undercooked, the sauce tastes like chef boyardee..sorry I wanted to like this place but this was very underwhelming

got acrylic fill. The guy never spoke a word to me. I asked him to shorten my nails and he did.  
he worked extremely fast. He skipped a couple smoothing and shaping steps. 
poor nail polish selection. What they had was thick and grumpy. Did not dry pretty. My nails felt rough after they dried. 
salon was busy. will not go back.

In town on business and found this place via Yelp! The staff was very friendly and the sushi was fresh and very good! I had the Spicy Tuna Roll and a Red Dragon Roll. The Red Dragon has a hint on horseradish which I normally don't like, but this wasn't overdone. I will definitely come back next time I am in town!

Awful caesar chicken wrap... What a waste of $7.50. The chicken was chewy and scarce,  with a price tag of 7.50 they should stuff the wrap with chicken, but no they don't!  And the caesar dressing tasted more like honey mustard than caesar... Learn to cook you amateurs!

Open the doors to a lovley, Japanese resturant. It's a nice quiet atmosphere where you can have a nice conversation and not have to scream across the table. Enviroment is relaxing and the hot towels are just the start. Servers were so sweet and nice. Food was delicious and modestly priced. A good place for a date.

The only highlight of the night was the server. She was pleasant and helpful. Every dish was over salted. The spices were over powering. The drink I ordered which was supposed to be a fizzy drink was flat. The portions are small and in general dishes are over priced. Does not work up to the hype. Desserts are ok.

Papa Vito has to be one of the best pizza joints I've been to. The pizza sauce is amazing, I had a chicken pizza with onions bell pepper and banana peppers. The chicken was seasoned. My boyfriend had the wings and he was super impressed. Live music on Friday night very nice. We definitely enjoyed ourselves

They have good ice cream and choices, that only reason I gave them 3 stars is because every time I go the they increase their prices which I don't like. Kid cups went from $3 to $3.50 now it's $4 or $4.50. Y'all will lose regular customers doing that. It's not fair to us.

I came to this Italian restaurant because of the reviews and gotta say it didn't disappoint! The food was super tasty and fresh, service was good. It's a small restaurant to be prepared to have a to wait before getting a table. Prices are a little bit expensive but food was tasty.!

Elevators are broken a lot. Parking lot gates sometimes don't work. Security Doors are often broken and left open. Rent is highly increased with lease renewals. Smokers have nowhere to go so they smoke on the step entrance to the building and throw the butts on the ground. Children play in the parking lot which is so unsafe.

Went here to get a manicure and they did an awful job.... posted the picture of manicure, if I owned a nail salon I shouldn't wouldn't let anyone leave with their nails looking like mine did. They made you feel rushed and there was nothing to make me want to come back

Stopped into this Pearle Vision one day during a short visit in St. Louis, after my wife discovered she left her contact lenses at home -- a thousand miles away. The staff here was very helpful, and pleasant as they walked us through the steps that resulted in getting contacts. We are so very thankful!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I brought my Ford Edge in for service on new brake booster, Very reasonably priced. My car was clean and they added windshield washer fluid,  How nice was that?!  Recommended service and repairs on my car for future. All my families vehicles will be coming to Tip Top Toys for service.

Had to be one of the best service all around service quality that I have been to. Enterprise lot of the time, hit or miss with service. But this one was exceptional. Kelly and the new guy was courteous and professional! Went through trouble to get things done. I would love to give them more business!

This is the best Mexican restaurant we have found! Everything here is delicious and we love it every time. It is best to take out because the dining room service is not particularly prompt, but that never stops us from coming in or ordering to go. Delicious!

We get consistently good food from Penn! We love the white pizza with broccoli and ricotta and the cheesesteaks, including the buffalo chicken cheesesteak  are filled nicely and tasty. They deliver and have been quick with how fast they get it to us! We will continue ordering from Penn

The fish is very fresh and the presentation is awesome.  Good date restaurant, especially if you want to experiment with options you have never seen or tried before.  Try the octopus.  However, it's expensive and I had a special roll that was soaked in generic chili sauce that not only ruined it, but was totally unnecessary.

Got their spicy tuna and eel rolls. I like the tuna a little spicier but that's personal preference, eel was balanced savory/sweet

Great value for the service and price. Interior design comfy and spacious. Overall cleanliness is handled well and staff is friendly, great for simple and direct service

Distrito was so disappointing. We sat at the bar and all the food was brought to us at one time. I'm talking , tortilla soup which was room temp, guacamole and Chips, the Chopped Salad, the worst shrimp Ceviche I have ever eaten, tacos steak and fish just fair. Really all at once for 2 people! Get it together!

Hotel looks a lot nicer in the photos.  The beds and sheets/comforter were rather stiff.  I would choose another location in future based on that alone. Overnight parking could be had right across the street for $20, which was convenient. Parking seemed hard to come by in the city.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Extremely poor service, instead of "Hi welcome to Burger King how may I help you?" We are treated with the very unfriendly "What you want?" Also, my order was thrown into the bag and as the worker turned to walk away I was greeted with his underwear hanging out over the top of his uniform pants. Very classy St. Louis.

Yooooo this mickey d's screwed up our order four times IN ONE TRIP and there was an obvious lack of communication between management and the team when we were told three different things by three different people. Honestly though the chicken is bomb as hell though so 2 stars.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I can't say enough great things about the Nail bar! I have been coming here for so many years, and there is no where else I would want to go! The facility is always clean and has a very relaxing atmosphere. The staff is always extremely friendly and they do a great job!

Horrible experience. One person at desk. Super long line. So we used the video kiosk and they misspelled my husbands name on contract. The video clerk said it would be fine. The woman at gate was ridiculously rude to us. We were forced to return the car and wait 30 minutes to fix this problem.

Fantastic customer service!  Everyone I have met since check in last night has been friendly and helpful. I can't get past the great bed and AWFUL pillows. Such a simple thing but bags full of cotton balls are not conducive to a good night of sleep. Bring your own pillow and you can expect a great experience.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Decided to try this place out. The food is amazing, but the service was truly horrible. Food took so long get out as people who came after us got their food AND checks before we have even received our food. We were a table of 2. The food however was truly amazing. Parmesan rosemary garlic fries were fantastic.

Watched 5 of every other rental bus drive by before I was picked up from the airport. Bus was packed. As we drove past the rest of the stops without stopping I saw many waving, laughing, and flailing for attention. Clearly a bad day for hertz pickup at the Philly airport.

I finish my work at 9 pm everyday so 24Hour is one of the good choice fitness for me. The things I like is they have a lot of machine here. And the things i really don't like is they don't have their own parking ! I have to find parking and sometimes it's very far.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Great experience with Dr. Murphy.  He explains everything and is using the latest technology.  He takes the time to get your prescription right. The often staff are organized and friendly as well.  My wife, in-laws, and mom use this office and all of us have had good experiences every time.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Most of the food was OK. My dad got a daily special, the branzino fra diablo. You could smell it from the kitchen. When the manager came to see what the issue was, he said nobody else had any complaints without any apology. We will certainly not be coming back with this customer service.

Neat little place with an interesting atmosphere and music I dug. The portions were huge so be to share and/or slip into a food coma with their eclectic takes on an American comfort food staple. They also had some surprising sweets options to compliment the macs

UPDATE,
I have been contacted by Visionworks Steve Sutton, Territory Director and he has been doing everything possible to make things right. The charge for the new frames has been refunded and I am going in this weekend to have the problem with my sunglasses corrected.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The hotel is nice. However, the restaurant food is just ok at best. I told the waitress that I wanted the Ruben sandwich with NO CHEESE. I get to the room to eat it and....it's loaded with cheese. The sandwich was soggy, the rice side dish was almost cold, and it took a LONG time to get served. Bottom line....eat somewhere else!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The place is clean & staff is friendly. We got to our room & it smelt awful. Now, with that being said, I work for a rental car company & understand that no matter how much you clean something, sometimes smell is out of your control no matter how much you try to fix it. Completely understanding!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This Wyndham garden is literally disgusting! I was staying in room 261 and I seen a mouse come out from under the bed. My heart literally jumped out my chest! I never would've imagined something like this smh. Had a late flight and didn't wanna pay full price just for a few hours but I definitely regret it. I should have!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Will NOT be back! Wanted a simple gentlemen's cut for my son and he's now early bald with no hair on top which is what I wanted. Don't remember her name but was clearly not interested. His hair is butchered and I'm still so annoyed the next day. He hates it I hate it literally worst $13 i have ever spent in my life.

Ordered delivery a second time and once again it arrived quickly. This time had sesame beef and egg drop soup with crab puffs. Puffs were once again good and the soup was pretty standard. The sesame beef was not good. Very soggie and bland. Not even a hint of spiciness. Very disappointing.

Good location, just over a mile from downtown. A Lyft ride after a baseball game only cost $6. A lot of good food near the hotel. Front desk workers were always friendly.

The hotel was not the cleanest and was a little worn down. For the price I would stay at the hotel again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Last minute charges up the wazoo
I was overcharged for a few line items and the most I could get back was 50%.
Very slow.
Rely heavily on automation to streamline rental process and keep people cycling thru. 
Staff count seems to be just enough to keep it running barring any unexpected problems

This place should not be in business. The food is not good and I am not that picky.  I got the Shrimp RIsotto (I love everything that comes in it) and it was awful.  The shrimp was over cooked.  My fiance and I both felt like hell after dinner and even the next day.  Save yourself the time and money and just find somewhere else.

The location is convenient and thats literally the only reason I come here. The management is NASTY to customers and employees. The front end people are RUDE and nasty and are inconvenienced by taking your order. "Whatchu want" is not how you ask for someomes order. "Whatcho name is" is not how you ask someone for their name.

I must say how amazing Hillary is! She just knows what is right for you and does such an excellent job. She is a very experienced stylist with the most awesome personality. I would definitely recommend Hillary for any color/cut styles! Thank you Hillary and thank you Crush! Loved it. Nina

As a guy getting a hair cut, you always want someone that can listen to you and understand what you want. It was weird that we had the same name but Neil did a hella of a job cutting my hair.  No pressure, great customer service.  All around a great experience.

By far the best Mexican restaurant we have been to since moving to PA in November from NY.  Our server, Karla Z. was amazing.   The house Margarita very tasty...not sour in the least because if too much mix.  Thanks for a great time, great food and great service!

Nothing special for the price
Location is a bit challenging.. watch for it or you'll for sure miss the entrance 
Smaller bathroom 
Breakfast was nice with waffles and pancakes each morning and the 430pm cookies are great
20 mins from downtown Nashville but an easy drive in..
Burger Republic is awesome .. burgers and shakes!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Eating at the Sushi bar. Turns out they recommend reservations due to the limited tables. it's You get a nice view of the gentlemen "suishing" behind the bar. And that's a good thing by the way; enjoy the show! 
Food is amazing presentation is second to none.

I love this place! The nail tech's are so trendy and don't let anyone take them for granted. They slay brows to the Gods too. Love it! 

Update: The only person I'll ever go to is Michelle. Tried someone else today and not only was she digging in my nails,  but she had the wax too damn hot! It was so hot that I stopped the service!

Delicious food.  Extremely pleasant interior. You will like it even if you have high standards.  Classy and cozy.  Employees professional and accommodating. Chef personally came out to offer to make my favorite dish from a restaurant in New York.  Went above and beyond.  Highly recommend.

I would give it no star if ican .help very rude  and the guy in the drive thru  is telling me  wtf cause he shorted  me a dollar  in the change.
