text: This restaurant has some of the best sushi I have ever had. The Bonzai roll was my favorite, I had to order a second one. I also ordered the dynamite roll and the green jade roll. Everything was fantastic. The restaurant itself is also so nice! I cannot wait to go back.

First time here and was surprised. The place is so,hidden and right next to a junkie gas station but is really cute inside and has amazing food. The chips and salsa was addicting! I got the enchilada meal with ground beef and is was plate licking good. Really fair prices. Will definitely come back.

We reserved the room on January 3rd on our way home to Des Moines. Very pleasantly surprised, king bed room, extremely clean and well appointed and very very comfortable for less than $100 including breakfast. Pleasant personnel  and extremely well lighted parking lot . We will plan to check out La Quinta future
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My wife and I sat down at a table for 5 min and were never acknowledged.  Then another couple literally sat down at the table next to us and got service before us.  My wife and I got up and walked out while the same server watched us without saying a word.

I switched my account from another horrible bank (citizens) for the same bullshit that TD is pulling now. Ask for a quarter for parking so you can get a problem they caused fixed, they look at you like you have 3 heads. Just as shitty as every other bank out there.

Trash from previous occupants still in the room. Molding falling off furniture.  Couldn't get tv remote to work, front desk lady had to come up to our room twice to get it to work. Tv reception was poor, very pixilated.  Dirty towels laying in the hallway.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: So, this was our second time here.  We should have learned from the first visit where  we got horrible service.  We are literally sitting in the middle of the room.  The waitress takes our drink order, one beer and water....then nothing.  Everybody who came in later is eating.  Food is ok, but services is way substandard.

Make the right decision, go to Dante's. It's pretty much the best and only option. 


Yelp is making me write a longer review, so I'm going to list a few adjectives Dante's is synonymous with: Delicious. Wonderful. Mouth watering. Tasty. Cheesy. Perfect. Orgasmic.

Awesome place to come if you have a 3 hour layover. Wait staff was prompt making sure my beer was full. Awesome draft selection. Pricey food but overall good place. Good music 80% of the time too

If I end up in the Philly airport again, I'll definitely go back here!

I'm glad we picked this place! The service was great, they were so friendly there! The sushi tasted amazing and fresh! I had the rainbow roll and my friend had spicy tuna. Best we ever had! Drinks were delicious and the atmosphere was great, too! It was even full and we got seated right away!

Tasty iced chai, breakfast scramble and burrito were good.  More cheese than I like so it was heavy. The chili salsa is good -- there's serious heat so be careful with that. 

It's right across from the pier so definitely tourist trap area with associated tourist trap pricing.

Very disappointed with our service.  Both of the staff members were rude.  Our account was billed for services we did not have.  When we tried to discuss with them, they told us call their corporate office and just moved on to the next customers.   They were very unconcerned with our situation.  I will never use them again. Beware!

Beware. Take your id at no matter your age. My friend is in her sixties and they didn't allow her in. Ridiculous...for a pop up with their own rules not worth it!  Manager said well I had to turn back a 85 year old woman cause she didn't have an id !
Wow!! That's is absurd!
So I would say bah humbug not a very a jolly holly place!

Pizza here is some of the best I've ever had. Great crust, seasoning and ratio of cheese to sauce. This is the new location. Seems like they are still working on the interior and the staff isn't extremely outgoing with offering their suggestions. That will not keep me from going back though at all! Highly recommend.

Allyson is amazing at cutting men's hair.  I walked in off the street and she could immediately see me, and she did a great job. Now she's my regular hairdresser.  The other workers are very nice and sweet and the atmosphere is very nice.  This is definitely a place, and a hairdresser, that I'll continue to use.

I ordered the salmon sashimi bowl it was good but the salmon was extremely thick. The chicken fried rice was flavorless and they charged us for something we didn't order. Overall some of their food was good but 10 extra for something we didn't order?? Really?

The ONLY Pizza joint in the entire metro NOLA area to serve authentic Chicago style deep dish pizza. This is a very small nondescript suburban pizza joint that you never heard of and tries a bit hard with pictures of Italians like Capone and cheesy piped in music of Dean Martin, but just ignore all that and enjoy the food.

This restaurant manager or whatever he his this dude that looks like a midget talk to my mother in a really un respectful way, this place and management  has no ethics and a really bad costumer service  because if I were there I wouldn't  bit the shi* out of him.

Carton Mexican Cream Ale is hands down the best beer I've had. It's like a lighter Guinness almost. Very creamy vanilla coffee vibes and it's 12%. In a lightweight and this had me warm and rosy in no time. Fun place to sit and have a drink or just shop around for different beers to try.

We were on our way home from NY, and decided to stop by Philly to grab lunch. We stumbled upon this restaurant since we found parking. It's AWESOME. We ordered risotto and crispy brussels sprouts. Both were delicious! We asked for plain arugula with risotto and it was the perfect pair.

I like their pizza.. once in a while.  The thing with Milanese is that one time they will have great pizza, and the second time you order it will be completely opposite and bad.  They aren't the best at keeping their pizzas consistant, especially the Boardwalk Style Pizza and the Special White Pizza.  Their wings are okay..

Just moved into the area and have been looking for a new nail salon. This place was absolutely amazing!! The service was great, very professional, clean, and I was in and out. I got a gel refill and gel pedicure and I'm absolutely in love! I will most definitely be back

The location is about the only good thing about this place. The sushi is fresh enough but the rolls look like they have been made by a 5yr old. They taste fine as the ingredients are fresh but just terribly made. Fine if you're a tourist but for locals avoid it if you can.

Staff was awesome, but the rooms were very small and somewhat outdated for a Hilton affiliated property. Combine the dingy room with the $38 parking fee and the $10 breakfast bar charge for Hilton Diamond members will more than likely result in me staying at another hotel when I return to New Orleans.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Stylist wouldn't listen to what I wanted. "your file says only 1/4" off so that's all I'll do."  Poorest haircut I've had at a Great Clips.  Healthy black lady with short, multi-colored hair did the work and never quit talking about her kids.  Should have insisted she do the work correctly but I just wanted to get out of there.

If a snail or a child ran a business, this would be it. They should change the name to Starbucks the Experience, because it feels like a Disney ride. Ridiculously understaffed or just terrible group of workers. Rather go to the one in Medford, faster and cleaner too.

NOT EVEN CLOSE TO AUTHENTIC TACOS! Taco bell is more authentic.. I'm sorry but to me an Authentic mexican restaurant knows what a soft corn tortilla with carna asada onions and cilantro is! Here all they have is American cheese, iceberg lettuce, tomato, soggy, flavorless tacos.. Yuck premixed weak margaritas..

Ordinarily I have had good pizza from here. However this time the pizza was done earlier than the app said it would be. I never got notified that it was done. The pizza was hard and cold and so was the garlic sauce. Very disappointed in the pizza that we had.

I have gone to Landmark already and been very disappointed. I went back again tonight to give them another chance. I was disappointed the second I walked in the door. No one greeted us as we walked in. We then sat a table for 15 minutes without ever being approached. We will not come back to this establishment ever again

I travel 30+ times a year and this is the worst service I have ever gotten from a rental car place. Currently have been waiting for the shuttle for more than 30 minutes while literally every other rental car place has gone by 4-5 times. 

This is on a Saturday at peak times. Stay away from this at all costs.

Went in thinking it would be like a typical barbershop. Quick in and out without much of a second thought at their work. Man I was wrong. These dudes take big pride in their work and craft. Great service and atmosphere and all around cool guys. Book with Steve next time you go

What a great night at this neighborhood gem! Everything we ate was delcious. The pasta special with the veal Bolognese was amazing also the appetizer with the arthichokes was great. My husband enjoyed the lobster ravioli. Our waiter and owner was fabulous Ernesto was on par. Everything was awesome! Can't wait to go back

I was here at about 3:00PM on Dec. 17, 2016. I was the first person waiting in the line at that time. One of the tellers started saying something in my direction. I thought she was talking to me so I walked up to her counter. But she gave me a look: "I am not talking to you". GREAT customer service!! Will never visit again.

What a wonderful little restaurant. Service was great and food was awesome.  It's not Vero in Miami but for local Italian it's the best thing going in Brandon. Ordered calamari, which was excellent. Also got the gnocchi and amaretto cake delicious.   Will come back for sure.

The breakfast we ate was good (but seriously it's pretty hard to mess up bacon, sausage, and French toast sticks)...

The service (waitress primarily) was horrid! We're from up north and she had an attitude the whole time.. She would visit tables around us and ask them if they needed anything then intentionally skip over ours....

I have been a big fan of Italian pie for many years but was very disappointed with my recent trip to the Metairie road location. I love your spinach subs but felt like not enough of the main ingredient was added to my sandwich. Wasn't enough on it to even cover the bread! Tasted great but not enough to enjoy.

I was in town for a few weeks and found this local pub. The food is great! I suggest the "trash can" burger and the hand cut tenderloin. Drink specials every night for beer and liquor drinkers. Monday 39 cent wings and Wednesday 3 tacos for $1 that's right 3 for $1. Nothing fancy here just good blue collar people unwinding.

Great stay!
Top quality hotel!
Minutes walk to Canal St.

Went there 2 years ago on Madigra. Location is Superp.
The Parade passed along right in front of the hotel. 
Checking in could be challenging during the Madigra. I waited about 45 mins to get a room that I booked 4 months in advance!

Room is clean and King!! Satisfied!!

Simply amazing.  I have not found a place that tops their chicken parm.   There is quite a variety of food which I have tried and have yet to disappoint.  The ambiance is relaxing and our waiter/waitress was quite attentive.  My favorite restaurant in town.

Awful!!!! It's a motel with new paint. Advertised complimentary breakfast online but that is false. Front desk staff nor security was unavailable to handle out of control party and actually excused the incident. Rooms are poor quality. Would NOT recommend this motel!!!!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Not sure what was better; the food or the service. Our waiter was very well informed about the food, the restaurant and even the neighborhood. I don't think I've ever had service this good before. 
The chicken was amazing. It was boneless and crispy on the edges. Very delicious. 
We are definitely coming back.

They're skimpy on anything under $13. I got the Pollo Caprese and the side salad was literally the size of my fist if not smaller. Also the chicken was over tenderized(basically flat af). It's my first time here and the service was ok. If you want bigger portions and a friendlier atmosphere Olive Garden is the way to go.

It was casino food. I got an appetizer for my meal... free ed ravioli. They weren't the best. The sauce has a pink tinge. It's ok. We prefer sweet sauce. My husband got the veal and gnocchi. He liked it. It was convenient cause it was late. Probably wouldn't choose this place again. The casear salad was good.

I love it here. The staff is great and always available the and anemeties are beautiful and the community is awesome. The maintenance is always available throughout the day. Neighbors are friendly and the main office is very cozy and clean. The staff is very professional

This dump gave my room away.  I called from Vegas and told them my flight was delayed and I wouldn't get into New Orleans till past three a.m.  Loser that answered the phone says no problem.  Wrong.  They gave my room away and cancelled my entire reservation.  Thanks morons.  Don't risk this garbage hole.  Do not stay here!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Enterprise had Melissa in customer service reach out with an apology July 5th and a promise the regional management team, that oversees the Florrisant location, would be contacting me to address the unsatisfactory level of service. So far that has not happened. Guess my time and money is not important to them.‍

We made a reservation online for an SUV in advance and when we got to Dollar about an hour ago, they told us they had no cars available. Their lot was completely empty except for one minivan- luckily we were able to take that instead because who knows how long we would've had to wait around there for the car we actually reserved.

Great sushi and amazing prices. We drive over 40 minutes to come here and we are regulars. Make a reservation if you are going on Friday or Saturday. It's BYOB. The wait time for the food can be a little long but the most expensive roll might be $7 so you can wait! Wait staff is good and prompt.

Just as good as I remembered! Icame here for the first time two years ago, and the food was so good I had to make sure I ate here again before I left town. The best part about Pi for me is that they will let you do a half n half of you can't decide or just want the best of both worlds.

I came in based on YELP! Reviews.  Very fresh, very tasty.  Wonderful atmosphere.  Very attentive staff.  This is a strip-mall gem.  As good as it gets. Do not expect large portions at a discount price.  Expect quality, service, and exceptional ambiance and you will not be disappointed!

This place is really good! I was exhausted after a long work shift and decided to order for pickup. It was ready quickly and the staff were very kind (I technically arrived after they closed, but I didn't know that they were closing soon when I ordered). Very good food! Reasonable prices as well. I will be back!

Their front staff is terrible.  Belittling, arrogant slackers.  The doctors are great, but they will be losing my business due to their receptionist and office manager.  Hard to schedule appts., do not call back when contact are ready, they  do not follow through with customer requests.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: One shuttle every 15 minutes if you are lucky. Other rental companies had shuttles by 3 or 4 times before one Hertz came by. Then the buses are overcrowded (and they can't pick up remaining spots) and it takes longer to get out. Pick any other carrier in Philly.

The guy who makes the delivery is very arrogant, never greets, never thanks, and he still sits in the car when I'm picking up my food,  he does the delivery, so he should get out of the car and come to the door and ring the bell.  and last time he told us that if we didn't give him more tip, he would ignore our order.  it's cheeky.

Awesome service here if I could give it 10 stars I would. Came in for a coolant leak, turns out I need a radiator. "Nas" called me gave me a very reasonable price for the job in total. Would total recommend. Came in to pay and was greeted by "tin" very professional I must say, had every answer to my questions.

Nice decor & atmosphere.  My daughter got the caramel apple latte and enjoyed it.  They only had one brewed coffee that was a medium roast.  I wasn't a fan.  I wish they would have had another option plus the cream formed these weird pieces in the coffee.  It didn't taste bad but kinda weirded me out.

The worst. Distracted workers on their phone and more busy gossiping. Super long wait time and very dirty sitting and standing area. The worst McDonald's location my family and friends have ever stepped foot on. Meat in the hamburgers gave almost everyone stomach problems.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I dont understand why in the world they would have pool waitresses in long sleeve and long black pants, come on, this screams they dont care about their staff or guests, cause they are hot and miserable. They should have shorts and tank tops this is Florida!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: LOVE IT! Location is awesome. Everyone has been helpful and wonderful. Renovations are done. New landscaping. Interior quality wasn't as good as I'm used to BUT the staff is friendly - so far so good. Pet friendly :) everything is clean. Mostly families and professionals.

The staff was great. The owner (I think) even stopped to say hello. I got a supreme New York style pizza. It was disappointing. The veggies weren't cooked all the way, practically raw. This was our second time here. I'd hoped to find a favorite neighborhood joint. Needs work....and better wine.

The best thing I have to say about this restaurant is that the staff was very nice. The fish was fresh but the rolls were mediocre, the miso soup was sweet, the ice tea was terrible and the chopsticks were cheap so every bite tastes like wood. Santa Barbra has many Sushi restaurants to chose from I won't go here again.

This place is just not good in any way.  $15 for a salad with frozen lettuce and a puddle of water in the bottom.  Manhattan served in the wrong glass.  Hostess totally unprofessional.  Atmosphere nothing to write home about.  Located in a half empty retail complex.

Walking distance from walking to French Quarter and Canal street shoppings. Valet parking is $44/day, no self-parking. Staffs are courteous and helpful. Room looks clean, but my daughter noticed  a some bug bites on her arm after 3rd night stay that got pretty swollen. They looks like bed bug bites.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I was served a beer in a bottle. After 2 or 3 drinks from it I realized something was all over the bottle. I can't be sure but it looked like someone vomited in the cooler and it coated the bottle. The bartender was less than cordial when I tried talking with her. I will NEVER go there again. Absolutely disgusting.

Decided to give this location a try since its closer to my workplace. That was a mistake as there is never amy towels actually here and clean, machines are all basically touching each other and the water doesnt get hot not even on the hottest setting. Highly dont recommend going to kingsway location.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: We have been taking our two cars here for three years. Jimmy always gives us good advice and great service. He is very knowledgeable about his craft and explains things well. Monica is great, and everyone is really friendly. We are very happy with Aastro, and our vehicles are too!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: After waiting at least 20 minutes for someone to help him, one of the employees working here told my husband, "I don't think this is a plan that we work with, and I don't have time to look it up." We will gladly take our business elsewhere after that kind of customer service.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The burrito was so full of flavor and my friend got the Hawaiian quesadilla and loved it.  The atmosphere was fun. The only thing that could use improvement was the salsa and chips.  Can not wait to try the desserts they looked amazing but I was so full, will get next visit

The front desk staff was attentive and welcoming. The computer was acting up and making check in difficult but T. Kept her cool and S. Stepped up to help. I sincerely appreciate how the two of them helped make my stay frictionless. The room was fresh , the design of the hotel was utilitarian but efficient. 5/7 would stay again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I love this supermarket. Staff is super friendly and helpful. I find prices are lower than Sweetbay and Winn Dixie......especially when they have buy one get one free on items.  My favorite spot for when I get the urge for a good sub. Oh and the fried chicken and chicken tenders are great too. Much better than KFC.

Super disappointed. There wasn't a good selection of donuts and the staff was super rude to me. My chocolate chip muffin was dry and hard almost like it had been sitting there all day. This Dunkin' used to always be a stop for me on my way to Nashville, so I figured I'd stop and get something. Not anymore.

This McDonald's is such a joke. You wait in line forever just to be met with a snarky employee who says all condiments are extra charge. Am I supposed to eat my fries dry?? I mean I should at least get one right? When I said it was no problem they rolled their eyes lol.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
The management listens and results problems almost immediately but you have to bring it to their attention or they can't help you and they're so nice there
Very personable
I have lived here about 18 years and the current management they put in place is the best ever had there

EVERYTHING THAT GLITTERS AIN'T GOLD. Do NOT live here. There are apartments next door, across the street, and down the road. Just do yourself a favor and don't.

Management changes multiple times during your lease year, and each one is just as bad as before. Take your money to a company and community that will appreciate you.

I was there the other day, should have made a reservation, but didn't. It took more than 70 minutes to get seated and it too another 40 minutes to get food. Food was good, so that's something to look for. Make sure you have a reservation and your experience will be a lot better than mine.

Staff and clinic was nice, Dr. Ortiz was able to assist us with looking at our kitten. She wasn't able to diagnose her but she was very helpful with getting us food and doing x-rays for us and even followed up after appointments to check up on her! Very thoughtful.

Wow! So happy with my experience here. The food was excellent, shrimp not rubbery, daises so delish. Some of the best bolognese I've ever had. Bread so soft and crisp altogether. Our services was excellent. We did come a little later around 8:30 on a Saturday night.

I came in here and I ordered and their service was really bad :(. I hade to get up multiple of time. I ordered a hot chocolate and they returned my money back because they "did not" have any really? Their coffee smelled like it was burnt and did not drink it
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Also known as the Roach Motel! No towels, No extra blankets or blankets! Room had bugs all over the floor and even on the bed. Front desk said no other rooms were available but we passed by two complete empty rooms! I would never recommend this place to anyone!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Dr Christensen is very good and a wonderful Dr.  The support staff is entirely another matter.  The worst customer service I have experienced in a while.   Lazy and not willing to do the work.  I don't think we will be back because it is just too frustrating.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I love these veterinarians and their assistants. They try so hard to be gentle with Gidget. And give her excellent care. She is a cockapoo, runt of the liter and sometimes she eats things she shouldn't eat. Poor thing. It's her mama's fault for not knowing better. Thank you Dr Gleaves and all your team.

The first plane to a restaurant here feeling very fresh sushi and other restaurants are not the same taste, and sushi dish is also very beautiful place which I have not seen before again. Services and the environment are good, I feel very comfortable coming to dinner!

I placed my order from the drive up, went to pay and had to pull up to wait for my order. after waiting 15 minutes my order had not showed up yet. so I backed up to the window and told them I was still waiting. when they handed me my order the 10 Krystal's were cold.  How does that happen. Plus only 2 employees working.

The customer service was terrible. Our waiter introduced him self as special.  We waited about 15 minutes before we walked out.   He said he was in it for dollars bit good customer service = dollars.  Our "special waiter" didn't make any $$$$ because we went to chili's... thank you chili's for good customer service.

I've been dining here since 2000.
It's actually still the best sushi around. I've tried numerous places in Florida and New York City.
This is the most consistent and CLEANEST food being handled and served.
The owners and staff have become "family" and are extremely gracious and warm.
Do miss out.

This was our first time at this hotel and the experience was pretty great. Aside from the AC leaking and making the room smell musty (which they fixed, but it was our last day). We loved the pool, and the staff was extremely friendly and personable. Will definitely consider this hotel again on our next trip.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I will not come back to Bravo's...$6,00 + for a slice of pepperoni pizza and a drink. Nothing to it.  It was ok.  I have gotten a whole pizza in the past. Their specialty pizzas are good, but again way over priced. Take out. If you want a slice of pizza, go to Costcos. $1.50 around the corner..

We came in town from Austin and found this place via Yelp
Decided to try it and glad we did.  Food, service were great
Spinach artichoke soup was best we've ever had. Chicken Marsala, trout meniere, veal were excellent
Chef came out to say hello and we really enjoyed the experience.   We will be back
This was a real find.

The ambiance of this buffet/restaurant says a lot about the food. Even produces questions about how the food is handled in the back of the house. I had the buffet. I should've taken my fellow yelp'ers review and ordered the food. The food from the buffet was mediocre and a little dry.

Haven't eaten there in years because the Pub went downhill and food was overwhelmingly disappointing.
We decided to try it again and were pleasantly surprised. Interior was renovated and clean. The food was actually quite good. Pleasantly surprised. Will definitely eat there again and would now recommend.

This was my first all you can eat sushi experience...I have to say, I left a bit disappointed. I was excited for a Friday night out with my favorite man and my newfound favorite food. The restaurant was dingy and outdated.  The service downright sucked....not a good location for a date night :/

The reason it received 3 stars from me was the veal was good not great but good when sauces come out cold and inform the waiter and nothing is done sad. We too were stuck at hollywood casino and if not for comps this meal is far worthy of a 100$. I had much better at the original charlie gittos in the 1980's.

Delivery took 2 hours, and quality marginally acceptable but does not worth the price. We ordered a large, which should better named as medium or regular. So too expensive for 40 bucks (including delivery and tip)! And there was raw tomato put on top after cooking, strange!

Okay....
Location: so parking lot is very ghetto .. however this is a hidden gem!

What to get and food quality : Let's start by saying the beef and broccoli is outstanding but the beef with mushroom is even better!
I advise calling ahead 15 mins before arrival !

Bottom line : Food is the best around Trenton/Hamilton area

Took over an hour to get food. Extremely noisy but the waitress did turn down the music for my sensitive daughter. She was amazing. The food was just ok. They also made everything to order. We just weren't overly impressed. For the prices of the food you should expect omg food and that aspect just wasn't there.

Although the food was good the customer service sucks, even though you had a long day doesn't mean you can talk to your customers anyway you want first rule of businesses customers first I will not be coming back to this establishment!!! Takes the term ratchet to a whole Nother level

Service was adequate but be careful in cafe.  While I was at the breakfast buffet my jacket which was on the back of the chair was stolen!  I was told that my coffee had spilled (I didn't have coffee) and that's why there was commotion at my table.  (Inside job?).  M. Parker
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Finally a restaurant ran by the owners from top to bottom.  Always making us feel at home.  The food is second to none.  They just care so much about wanting you to enjoy every single thing they make.  I would come here 7 days a week and get something new every time if I could.  Bellezza!

This restaurant was just OK. My margarita had little to no flavor and my food was also lacking in flavor. The server failed to refill waters or pay much attention to the table. Overall just a decent Mexican restaurant. Definitely not my first choice place in Tucson for authentic quality Mexican cuisine.

I work late hours and was excited to find a place that actually stays open until posted hours. It is a very large pub and has several tv's. Will it be around forever? Who knows. Bit it is a friendly atmosphere where most people know each others names.  It's a new weekly stop.

The food was just OK. Did not have much flavor.  The only Italian restaurant that I know of that did not have olive oil on the table.  When they brought the bread out,  it came with a little bowl of some light green stuff to dip your bread in,  it had no flavor either.  Would not recommend this place.

The food was OK, the Waitress was wonderful. But that kitchen was a great distraction to the ambiance of what could have a good experience.  There was many plates dropped and/or loudly broken on purpose. I say that because of the consistent YELLING coming from the kitchen staff mainly cooks!

I went to China 1 In Clearwater near my house till there location was damaged by hurricane Irma. I thought this China 1 would be as good. I was extremely disappointed. The spring rolls were very bland the roast pork with mixed veg. Was not good at all flavorless. Will never go back.

Not happy at all I got my cat neutered today & when I got home he got out of his carrier and the wound open & he's been bleeding from the incision since 4:00 and I took him back & all u guys I did was clean are serious . You couldn't at least fix it ? Glue it ? Don't take your animals to this location .

These rooms are like mini studio apartments equipped with microwave, mini fridge, 2 tv's, and a couch that turns into a bed. The rooms are pretty clean and neat. No shuttle was available for us to pick us up at the airport but it's all good because the hotel took care of the taxi for us.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: If I could give no stars I would the driver never called to deliver my food sat outside and assumed I should know the woman answering the phone has terrible customer service and proceeded to have an attitude as you can see by the reviews this restaurant has many issues DO NOT ORDER FROM THEM

Es un pequeño restaurant , yo no busco lujos busco un buen sabor de comida mexicana , restaurantes mexicanos lujosos su comida es pésima , taqueria Durango tiene los mejores tacos de St. Louis  le pondría 5 estrellas pero la verdad el servicio es pésimo sus meseras son muy lentas y algunas veces groceras

Flight got delayed so we thought we thought we would order food. Took 35 minutes for food to arrive. It's an airport cafe where expediency should be expected. Had to get our food to go and just made our flight. 
Avoid this place unless you have a long delay.

I couldnt go lower than one star. The veggie pizza was horrible!!! It was  cold, loaded with old vegetables and the cheese had weird taste as well. 
My bf ordered it after not eating all day and even his hunger couldnt mask the taste of icky tasting cheese.

DO NOT TAKE A LOST ANIMAL HERE TO BE SCANNED FOR A MICROCHIP!!! We found a lost dog and I took it here then they told me he didn't have a microchip. So the poor dog wasn't home for 2 days. Animal control came out to scan him and found one right away then called his owners.

My boyfriend and I come here at least once a week and get the crazy roll + whatever he's in the mood for and it's SO. GOOD. seriously never gets old! Staff are prompt and sweet and it's always a good atmosphere. Best sushi I've ever had, we drive 40 mins for it every time!

I ordered Chiles rellenos and they are tasteless, it seems like they defrosted them and tossed to the microwave besides that they were so bad I can't even finished eating, no to mention I had to paid $17.00 dollars for an awful Plate. I am so disappoint of this place....
Don't  waste your time don't come here

Don't waste your time. This is a really old hotel. The room#406 the toilet did not work the water would not fill up. Reported it and they never came. Food on the office chair, stains on the office table. Rust on the microwave. The bathroom walls were horrible. The shower was never cleaned. I will post photos as well.

text: Ok so I understand this is cheap hotel, fine..  Now, I believe there's a huge difference between being cheap and being plain nasty. text:
Will never use this company again. Cost to dry clean two simple maxi dresses was 61.00??!!!! Insane cost. Women behind the counter not at all interested in addressing my concern at the cost. 

You've lost my business and the business of the country workers/ family I've shared this experience with.

text: This little place is fantastic! My husband practically licked the bowl, which for him is a rarity--he usually never finishes anything!  The Duck Confit is absolutely amazing, and I've NEVER tasted Polenta that good before or since. I can't rave about this place enough.

By far the worst and shadiest car rental company.  They first would not give me a refund or credit when the world was shut down.  This company should be ashamed of the way the do business.  I will never us this company again.  Please sixt do the right thing

The staff is truly amazing. They are friendly, helpful, and have a wonderful sense of humor. My appointment was on time and the optometrist was very thorough and explained all my issues. The only reason I'm giving four stars is the selection of frames is not the best. I wish they would stock more frames with a little more pizzazz.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This particular McDonald's is ALWAYS out of everything even though they are clearly opened 24/7. I feel like they purposely do not sell certain things like "frappes,shakes,etc." because they won't have to clean the machine again. Uber orders are always an extreme wait. This place sucks!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Workers on their phones constantly might explain the consistently slow lines and the 24/7 suspiciously broken ice cream/slushie machines! The staff needs a culture overhaul or they need to all be replaced. Or perhaps it is poor management, but something is not right here in comparison to other McDonald's.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This particular location sucks! Their food is never hot when it is, the buns, english muffins, and the tortillas are hard as a rock. Unfortunately, when we take our food back we get more of the same crappy food... definitely hate that this is the only location between home and work. We would love it if they'd step up their game...
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: New make over is the worst and not inviting at all & the service is well below par. Three times now I have gone in and my drinks were all wrong or luke warm & that's not counting times that I had to wait for a new batch of brew to be made because they ran out of coffee completely. Seems to be more drive through oriented now.

We had a kid named Erik as the server, HORRIBLE!! He broke every restaurant standard, McDonald employees would not dare! On his phone in dining room. Smoking outside with tables inside, and complaining about his tips! Go to blaze or bazbeau if you want pizza.

I tried a new place while in town for the eclipse. I had the lunch special shrimp lo mein. The noodles were spaghetti. The shrimp is just frozen and warmed up, not fresh. The mushrooms were from a can and there was no flavor, no stirfry nothing to make it tasty. I do not recommend this place.

Staff was nice .   ThAt is all

I absolutely do NOT recommend going to this business and if you do, do NOT go to Tate. You will be highly disappointed, leaving having to spend more money on fixing his whole mess. Please, save you time & emotions, don't go here. Also if I could give 0 stars, I would.

The bad: Old. Outdated. Shower curtain smells like mold. WIFI only works in certain parts of the hotel. Not the full breakfast offered at other HIE's. Small TV's with analog channels. 
The good: they moved me to a room with a better WIFI signal. Walking distance to many restaurants and bars downtown. Underground free parking.

text: I stayed at this la Quinta for three days. Right away I noticed that the carpet all over the hotel was stained and that the hotel was old and needed to be renovated. The pillows and bed were hard. Air conditioner was working perfectly. The price was nice for what you get.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Very poor quality meat, especially ground beef. My daughter purchased ground chuck that was grey on the inside and tasted terrible. The owner, Mr Karsch, refused to replace or refund the purchase. Very bad attitude and poor customer service. Telling everyone I know to beware.

Brought the car in today with a minor alignment issue after they did the previous alignment a couple months ago. Thorough work to investigate the issue, plus a front tire flip & remount at my request. Got it back into spec at no charge.

Great service today, guys (and all the other times, too.) Thanks.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The owners of this place are extremely rude. I've been using their service for 4 years. Minor issues in the past. When I told them my shirt got burned, all I want is to aware and be careful next time. But their reply is"it must be done somewhere else", "it's not our problem." Don't care and no apologies. Will never go back.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I took my grandchildren to Sweetfrog today and was excited to see them open during the pandemic. It's was so nice to be able to get our yogurt, and everything so clean and the worker was so friendly . And so many flavors to choose from. We will definitely be back!

So there really is only one person working here who is always on his game and gives phenomenal customer service. He's been there for years, so this excludes him. They mostly cater to mobile orders, and can't multitask. And if you don't get there before Felix orders his 8 shots of expresso, you'll be waiting for 25 minutes.

Friends recommended this restaurant and we were not disappointed. Everything was delicious from the complimentary miso to the plum ice cream, also complimentary. Rolls are fresh, delicately made and cheap! And the house sake was fabulous. Give this one a try. I guarantee you will go back!!

I bragged  about how good there hamburger are to our out of town guests. We decided to go. Everyone ordered the bacon hamburgers medium rare. What we were served were charcoal hockey pucks they were absolutely pathetic the service was atrocious. I will not go back. Don't waste your time.

I brought my car in because I had a low pressure light going off even after filling my tires twice with air. They didn't find any leaks after checking and spraying. The mechanic went so far as to show me my tires and put extra air in so I felt safe for an upcoming road trip- and no more tire light. Great service! :)
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Younger girl who took my order was completely rude and i just wanted to walk out of there but I was hungry. I'm from Oregon so i said I'd never been there and she was extremely rude and rushing me when u asked about California rolls and the quantity they came in. guess customer service doesn't matter here

I know it's fairly new at this location but I've been here twice on Saturday mornings and the service is AWFUL!!! The owners may want to think about hiring a few adults because all these kids working here have no clue and all they do is text and check their phones instead of working on a busy morning!!

This is my favorite club in Frenchmen New orleans,  they definitely have the best band ever Hyperphlyy OMG THIS BAND IS AMAZING. We were in so many bars and nothing like it, my sister and I loved it! The Hurricanes are so good too. Really nice bar tender, but again we love the Musis AWESOME SINGERS.

Way over priced & greedy.  On 3/23/17 I made a reservation for 7/25/17 - 4 months ahead.  The cost of one night at this motel is $210.40.  Renaissance used my money for 4 months then refused to let me check in at 3 pm.  Their website also boasts a hot tub which had been removed so no only are they greedy but also liars
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
ZERO STARS!!!
First of all they don't have a hand sanitizer and the way the staff hand you the utensils is not very professional. The yogurt is disgusting. I expected too much with this place but It turned out so disappointing!!!! I wasted my $9 for nothing!!!! I wouldn't recommend this!!!

Worst $60 I've ever spent. And yes I said $60. My cuticles were left ragged and bleeding. My dip nails weren't smooth-- you could see scratches and lines across them. The dip didn't even cover my whole nail so they already look like I got them done a week ago. Will not be returning.

This is by far the worst Marriott property I've ever stayed at. Their beds are mushy and overused, and when I checked in I found a used condom wrapper in the nightstand and it was clear that the room and not been cleaned.  Is this a Marriott or a hooker hotel?
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Very disappointed I CLEARLY asked for a McDouble with NO mustard NO pickles and ADD mayonnaise!!! And this is CLEARLY not what I got !! Arghh, if I wouldn't have waited so late to eat my meal, I definitely would have taken it back, geez !!! Place doesn't even deserve 1 star !
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: In my opinion, the best Mexican food in town. Plenty of parking available in the attached garage. The portions are enormous. I've had the chimichanga twice and it's just massive. I also love that they have a salsa bar to go along with your complimentary tortilla chips.

Thank you for having vegan options on the menu! I was excited to be able to get an app/salad, soup and main plus dessert. Not because I needed it but because I could. All delish! My non vegan lunch date completely enjoyed his selections as well. We may become regulars.

Please please please do not get your eyebrows done here ! I did not realize before I had left the store that they had actually torn off some of my skin while waxing my eyebrows! I have never had this happen to me before and now even on the next day I look horrible!

Fast, friendly service in a great location. They are not offering seating inside at the moment due to COVID but there are plenty of places to eat outside or a great area to stroll and eat.
The ice cream is delicious! Unique flavors and very creamy. The in house made waffle cones and bowls are amazing!

This was a nice surprise! The food was great and the owner we met was very friendly! The restaurant was opened by brothers in Feb 2020 right before COVID hit and I'd love to see them do well. The menu is based on typical dishes found in the owners' home town.

Went to this place Wednesday had to return back Friday and Monday for them to re paint my nails due to it peeling off, I've been getting gel all my life never have I ever had to return twice to get a nail re painted, they blamed me please don't go here!! I use to love them smh

My regret about Ice&Cream is that I cannot have it daily. This place serves up some of the very best ice cream in town. Super smooth with rich bold flavors. The staff is consistently awesome. They're fast, efficient and organized. They are really patient with the customers.

gosh this pizza is good. i can't have enough of it. i am a die-hard fan of toppings on pizza and think that a cheese pizza is kind of a waste of realty space, but pizza delicious's cheese pizza is amaze-balls. there's a slight oniony taste to it that's superb and for a few dollars more, definitely get the garlic knots.

Dirty. Abysmal service- I sat at the bar for 10 min watching two staff members chitchat right in front of me without acknowledging me- got up and left without anyone taking my order. Back bar area stinks of rancid dish rags- seems the aroma wafts from the kitchen. Buyer beware.

The place needs an overhaul; to bring it up to date.  But the bed was comfortable. It was quiet. The breakfast would have been good, if I hadn't been gluten intolerant.  Bread everywhere,  nothing else. So we left to eat breakfast somewhere else. Overall...a 3.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Literally the worst McDonald's I've ever been to. After the manager or whoever was working told us the fries tasted terrible, we then waited over 10 minutes for our cold food. 10/10 would skip next time...  also super awesome how all the trash cans were overflowing and covered in sticky trays.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Soooo slooooow! We waited 20 minutes to even get a menu - which we had to ask someone for in the end. Wait staff never around and the place was half empty. Took so long to get food as well- leaving us minutes to run to catch our flight which when we sat down we had almost an hour to go before boarding.

Krazy Korner was really fun at first but then the server upstairs ruined it for everyone, constantly rolling his eyes while waiting for us to order and acting extremely annoyed by even having to be at his place of employment. I will not be coming back here and would not recommend.

They should change their name to "Ghetto at Largo". Run away from this place if you're thinking about moving here.  I'm a current resident and have been here for almost  years.  At one time it was a nice oasis but the current management is running it into the ground.  Best to pay a bit more and live in St. Pete.

A lot more than I had expected! Top notch guest services willing to help you at every turn.  They have loaner bikes for everyone in the family, free local rides to attractions near hotel.  Just park your car and relax.  I will definitely be staying here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great selection of fresh and prepared foods, meat fish and veg, bakery etc., but they don't manage the checkout lines nearly as well as the local Publix or even Trader Joe's so you are trying to stay in line while social distancing. Seafood is usually exceptionally good.

Ordered take-out while in the area on business recently. The General Tso's chicken was the best I've had anywhere in quite a while; big chunks of real chicken, flavorful sauce. Cold sesame noodles and egg drop soup were great as well. Will definitely go back next time in area.

Great little sushi place. The manager made us feel very welcomed and offered us some complimentary miso soup while we waited. Our order was made very quickly and was delicious. I've had sushi up and down California and this place definitely rates high in my book. Would recommend. Will try again when back in the area.

This place has amazing sushi! Since being here, just have never found a great sushi place. I do think Sushi Circle is that spot for us. Fresh, delicious sushi, attentive staff, and small venue make it perfect for a quick date night or just a "I don't feel like cooking" night. Would highly recommend to others!

I went to the Rocket Express Car wash to get my car cleaned as I had not for months I had a Pleasant suprise the staff was friendly to work with and the cleaning was well my car was perfectly washed and with the free vacuum It helped to get under the seats overall a great experience would recommend

Traveling for an extended time and needed some laundry done. Found this spot and they were terrific.  Friendly service, local business, and my clothes might leave me for a place where they get their proper respect and folding.  Wish I lived here so I could use them more!!Dinah was a joy!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: NO ELEVATOR!!!!!!! There is no elevator and they only tell you if you ask..... after they run your credit card. If your room is on the second floor, I hope you enjoy carrying suitcases up the stairs. Otherwise, the rooms are fine and there's a free shuttle to Boise airport. Sign up for a shuttle time slot at the desk.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Okay, if you want ritzy, stay at the Hilton.  The place is old.  The price is very reasonable. You can easily walk to downtown. Excellent water pressure for a great shower.  Beds are comfortable.  Wifi has a strong signal. Generous hot breakfast. Staff is friendly and helpful. For the most part, pretty quiet.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This was the first time I've been to China Kitchen. I had the honey chicken with pork fried rice and vegetable lo mein. The chicken was extremely sweet and crunchy...eh. The rice was very good but the noodles were a tad bitter but I can say they weren't too dry (I hate when I get dry lo mein.)

Nice atmosphere inside and on the covered patio. Tasty food presented nicely. We had miso soup, Ocean Salad, Ahi Poke salad, salmon nigiri and a few more rolls. All were very nice although the restaurant uses imitation crab. Service was efficient but neither warm or welcoming.

Been here for almost a year now and hate it! Have issues with holding packages, paint is peeling off bathtub and have had a leak in the piping of my toilet connected to my wall since June and now I have two giant holes in my wall from them doing the piping while I have two cats still living in this apartment.

Paganini is a paga-no-no!

Pretentious, pedestrian pasta priced for the location not the palate. 

No wonder the other Italian place down the road had a waiting list while this place was wide open! So I guess, that's *good* if you're in a hurry. 

Oh well. Once was enough. 
Our waitress was very nice.

Coffee is fine, location is fantastic, service is slow.  They have one register and don't seem to make an effort to keep the line moving at all.  When the line wraps around the door and goes outside, I would expect more urgency to ensure that customers aren't kept waiting for longer then that have to be.

They took 2 hours to deliver and I called to ask them if there was something wrong and ask why it was taking so long to deliver. The person who answered the phone was rude and unprofessional. Then the pizza sucked. I'll be telling everyone in Nashville to stay away from this place. So many others that are better...

Very disappointed  several times I've gone in early evening and they were completely out of donuts. Still had plenty of coffee! Every time I get there cream filled donuts there's no filling in them just a little dab in the edge of the donut. I grew up on Dunk in Donuts I now how good they should be an this place ain't doing it!!!

Do not bother to stop here. I spent a lot of money for a suite for several days. This place is a joke. The security guard is a young smart month kid. Because of this horrible experience I will never stay at Residence Inn ever! For the money I spent I got NOTHING!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This is the worst Enterprise location I ever rented from. The young man waiting on us was courteous but... operationally, this location needs help. Car are dirty and they never have the type car you reserve. I don't understand how this location glides under the radar of the mothership!!! Enterprise...fix this location!!!

Just had meal at Cena. Great CONTEMPORY Italian   Recommend the rack of lamb done to a turn. Veal marsala thick but unbelievably tender and tasty. Do not miss the tiramisu. The best! Ask for Stephanie   She will bend your ear but give you great and enthusiastic service. The parking is a problem  take the trolley and walk 2 blocks

Food was great. The employees went above and beyond the call of duty to fulfill my order and make the experience exceptional. The dining area is spotless and has a wonderful atmosphere. My order was delivered with flawless execution and incredible precision.

The worst building I have ever lived in. I had my truck vandalized, packages stolen, service orders not completed, and you can hear your neighbors. Look at the mail room and ask the local police department how many vandalizim reports they have for the property before you make your decision.

They have the worst customer service ever. Rude! And don't count on the transportation to and from the airport unless you have have hours to waste waiting for them. Rooms are so so nothing special and not all that clean. Next time I will certainly go some place else.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Horrible experience. Treated employees and customers terribly. The "Pizza Guy" was yelling at the cashier and belittling her in front of everyone. Absolutely disgusted with this place. Please learn how to treat employees. If not please don't act like an idiot in front of customers.

I used to love Two Girls Pizza. The last three times I have had burnt pizza and burnt meatballs and spaghetti that was delivered upside down so sauce was in the bag. It's sad because the only other good pizza place is out Sahuarita Rd. I guess it's worth driving out Sahuarita Rd.

Great haircuts but flawed system. Say I go in and check off no preference (first available) wait 20 minutes and two kids come in check off a barber. That barber becomes free he skips over the no preference guy and goes to the check mark. Could be waiting a long time for no reason.

Best Chinese food I've found in Fishers. Delivery times are long if you're going that route, but pickup times are fair. Really not sure how valid some of the complaints are that I've read from other reviewers. I've eaten here many many times and have NEVER had even the slightest issue.

Figured I would try a new pizza place in Reno. Never been to Mountain Mikes. We arrived just as they opened. The trash can was full, tables were dirty, and the whole place seemed dirty. It took several minutes for someone to take our order. However the pizza was good and was out to us fast.

We sat down at 8:57. It is now 10:14 and we still haven't received our food. This is the most unprofessional restaurant I have ever stepped foot in. I honestly have no idea how they are still in business. I have cancelled my order and on way out the door. Still. Hungry.

The young Asian kid running this place is probably one of the rudest people I've ran into in a long time cheap and angry maybe it's making eight dollars an hour that's pissing them off I don't know but whatever it is do yourself a favor and don't come here

I went there for the first time. The tech took a brush from her colleague who had used it on her customer - without sanitizing it and then used it on another customer. I paid extra for the extra sugar scrub, and the scrub was only 10 seconds. No kiddin'!!!

Will not be back.

I have lived here for 6 years with no problems. The maintenance staff has always been very attentive to any repairs I needed. The gym is huge and  equipment is always in good working condition. Plenty of parking. It is a bit pricy but well worth the extra money. Great place to live!!!

The people at this McDonalds are always so nice! Today they made my son a happy boy when they searched through their Happy Meal toys to find all the ones they currently have! We go there often when we are visiting and have never had anyone be anything but very polite!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I would definitely go to this place again. I needed an oil change and they did it quickly. They came out and told me some other options of things I might have done to my Tahoe but we're not pushy in any way shape or form. A very reasonable price to and coffee and TV in the waiting room.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I had a great experience as a first time customer. I came with a party of six on a Saturday and had a 30 min wait time. We were treated with complimentary champagne which was a plus. I would recommend a person to be assigned to greet customers when they enter so that they can know who to address any questions to.

Decided to try this place out today, and I was really impressed. Went through the drive thru and service was quick and friendly. I got the fish taco combo, and it was all delicious. Very good food especially for a quick drive thru. Will definitely go back soon!

This is by far the worst TD Bank I have gone to. The manager is rude and they make you wait for a very long time. The way they make their consumers feel is not ok. Seriously thinking about switching banks. If I could give this branch a negative star I would.

This branch is always short staffed. Multiple times I've come in and there is only one teller and a long line of customers. Meanwhile other staff members are just walking around the bank trying to convince customers to use the ATM instead of actually helping anyone.

Best pizza in Carpinteria/Santa Barbara. Freshest ingredients, great flavor and taste. Everything we have had is excellent from the caprese salad also with the freshest tomatoes to pesto penne which oozes of creamery butter. Dine either outside or inside. The owners, a husband and wife are very friendly, down to earth.

Was excited to try this new spot on Prytania but was disappointed to discover the lack of freshness apparent throughout all my dishes. 

The fish seemed old, the veggies were pre packaged and bland, and the snow crab content was high. 

Will probably not go back.

It's right next to the laundromat which is why we go. The food is good! However, the tap doesn't taste cleaned and the fact that you can taste it means it hasn't been cleaned in a long time. That is the only complaint I have, unfortunately it's a biggie though. It makes me question how not clean everything is behind the bar.

Wow, a real hidden jewel.  Don't let the location fool you. Worth looking for, easy once you know where it is.  Beans fresh ground daily, great pastries and lovely owners. Nice cozy place to sit with friends or stop by for s cup to go. Stop in and hear Anna and David's story of the birth of Yellow Brick Road.

When I called them they told me it was going to $48 for long nails. Then my nails end up coming out to be $130. I have never paid over $80 for my nails. My nails aren't even worth $130. I get long nails all the time and have gotten more complex designs. what I got isn't worth what I paid. Also, I was they would be more gentle

Just a heads up, if you get a membership at this gym they won't let you cancel unless you bring in a handwritten letter. They might also charge you for an extra month because you "didn't cancel correctly". Shady business 10/10 wouldn't reccomend to a friend
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Seems kind of nice, haven't even gotten to my room before having regret for staying here, the parking situation here is terrible, no in/out parking anywhere...moving cross country and not fond of leaving al my belongings in my car on the street in STL or in the hands of a valet
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Disappointed.  Smallest 3 egg omelette I've ever seen topped with cold salsa.  Huevo Ranchero OK not Pico like I know--lettuce as one of the ingredients?  Coconut pie hohum.  Jennifer did a good job serving.  May try it again and get the French toast she recommended.

I got the fish sandwich and it had no tater sauce and the cheese was not even there. When getting the ice cream it was a perfect swirl. Plus It was good. I worst part was  I waited for 30 mins. But the workers were so nice. I also got free fries because of the time wait. So I recommend there ice cream.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The barista named Alondra was making whipped cream. The whipped cream in my drink was truly a piece of artwork. Great consistency, great appearance, great quality. 17/10 would recommend! Never knew whipped cream would create such a great experience for me!

This was a hidden gem! I'm not from the area and I was visiting friends. They have such great tasting sushi and it's very big too! We ordered one rock n roll and two shrimp tempura rolls (shown in photo) and even though we only finished two rolls it was pretty filling for two people.

Possibly one of the worst experiences I've ever had a nail salon. They did not give me the color I asked for and my dipped nails were uneven and oddly shaped. After I asked them if there was something else I could do they just gave me attitude and did not offer to fix them. Way to expensive for the quality.

The food is really good here. The atmosphere is energetic, so if you want a quiet relaxing night, it might not be for you. But if you look forward to a hip happy hour then go for it! Maybe not the best place for a date because of the volume. Also the area near the bar is really tight and compact. But we'll be back!

My husband a friend and myself had an amazing dinner outdoors at this place. Service was great and I was amazed by the delicious food.my husband who is a crab cake snob throughly enjoyed himself and our friend delighted at the harvest salad .Added to my list of favs
. The best part was how may old friends happened in for a party.

Ok food, definitely not great. Service was good. Don't get the saltimbocca, has no flavor, pasta was over cooked, too much sauce which tasted just bland. Food presentation was very poor, not appealing at all. This is definitely not fine dining. Would not go there again.

Good food but I have never been so rushed to leave. For the price, we should not have to ask for more menus and tell the wait staff repeatedly that we are waiting on an order. 
We were not even done eating and our plates were being grabbed. 
Very disappointed in this visit and i been there many times before.

I crave their carbonara all the time. I love it for its delicious flavor but a bonus is that the corn based pasta doesn't sit in your stomach like some pastas do. The Italian take on bacon and eggs also delicious! Nice atmosphere and staff too. Love this addition to the Channelside area!

WORST SERVICE. Do not come here unless you are absolutely desperate. Worst service ever it almost ruined my day, the cashier had the worst attitude and did not want to serve us, while taking our order it's as if she was FORCED. I would give no stars if I  could.

I would not recommend using this location for your pet. I had an appointment that I had booked 3 weeks in advance that was overseen by management. They would do nothing to rectify the issue and now I need to scramble to find a new location to bring my pet in for her shots. Absolutely horrible service

This is the worst place we ever stayed for 100 plus dollars per night. We asked for a 2 non smoking rooms. Both are smelling smoke and. The reservation says 2 queen beds but they not queen size may be a full size. 
We spoke to the manager he has no answer.

text:
I love this place for a meal on the hill.   You go here for good basic food not the atmosphere.   
I love the shrimp Brazies light on the breading.  My husband loves the pepper steak.  Jim is our favorite waiter.    If your don't like garlic ask for light or no garlic.   Reasonably priced.

Food was great. Service was great. This will be my 4th time back since they have opened. My suggestions would be frito and or calamari for the appetizer. The main course I get the same every time which is tortillini Matteo's. Haven't had a pasta dish similar before and hits the spot every time.

This place is amazing!!!!!!!!! The decor is awesome first of all!!! It has a complimentary wine bar and you can bring your own wine too!! Probably the best foot and leg massage ever. Normally I feel like the tech rushes with the massage but not here!!!! I will be back for sure!!!!

Food quality was ok but if you want real barbecue do not eat here. I ordered the pulled pork and it was the exact flavor of what you would find in the bottom of a toco. If it came on a shell with all the fixings then I would have known what to expect and they would have gotten 4 stars.

El lugar es super acogedor, nos pareció un poco costoso  el precio por noche, el desayuno estuvo excelente, no mucha variedad pero la comida si estaba fresca, las personas del front desk no muy corteses, y los chicos del valet parking super amables! Lo único que me sorprendió es lo COSTOSO que es el hotel
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: over $22 for a large sub, large drink, and large fries for my lunch. the $6 large fries is almost always mostly small pieces and burnt pieces.  if they are going to charge this much for fries they need to prepare and cook them to perfection like 5 guys does. i dont know how they get away with charging this much for crappy fries.

"Very convenient. First car was not Gold Club Member quality. Went into office and person at counter took good care of us. Car was perfect value for the money. My only complaint with Hertz and most all rental car agencies is that the windows in the cars are never cleaned on the inside. Driving at night is very difficult."

I was very pleasantly surprised by my experience here. We came in as a group of 11 and the team managed to find a way to seat us all together. We probably tried half the menu. Everything but two dishes got rave reviews around the table - particularly the Bronzizzle and Tuna Usuzukiri. Surprisingly good low key sushi spot.

Please Don't Smoke When Delivering People Food!
Wow, my sister ordered a pizza from this spot and the Delivery driver was smoking a cigarette when he pulled up to her house.
Come on guys.....we don't care if you smoke but must you smoke around the food?! SMH really hard.

This place suck the people that work there suck, your order is never done right you ask for coffee and you get hot tea you asked for a bagel with extra cream cheese and you barely get any cream cheese  the people that work there  have an attitude they have people in there selling drugs

It feels good to know you have a local restaurant that serves authentic Mexican food with PRIDE!! Service is on point ever time. Soul n home food has me coming back. The food served is just like the great pictures on the menu. Thank you Jalisco's for providing me a home cooked meal and SOME!!

I went in for a routine oil change and was informed my brake pads needed replacing.  I was quoted an hour wait.  I accepted the service, and waited patiently for my hour.  Excuse after excuse after excuse, I ended up waiting 3 hours.  They are trained to lie to you for your money.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Joseph had a huge storehouse in the middle of "the city." Thanks for the rich dispensing at the perfect time. I had a peaceful visit on Halloween. I'm happy and I hope all people flock to this place. Hospitality is a service. Everything was perfectly arranged. See you in the future. Thanks again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Great place. I've popped in here a few times and have always been impressed with the food. The sushi is high quality and prepared well. Every time I've been, it hasn't been super busy, but don't let that fool you. The food is excellent. And there's a steady stream of take out orders that proves it's a local favorite.

The staff was friendly enough but that's where the "good" ends.  First the long term parking lot is full of holes and weeds and barely lit. The hallway carpets are DISGUSTING to say the least. People yelling or being loud in the hallways and the smell of marijuana in the hallways was really bad.    Will never be coming back
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: One of the few McDonald's locations that really can't get it right. The Medford McDonald's is fast and always gets your order right....Marlton McDonald's not so much. Especially if you are coming late night, expect your order to be wrong and your food to be luke warm AT BEST. Management needs to take another look...
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Definitely a great place to eat sushi.  We got the Sansom and Lover Roll and they were extremely delicious.  He decorated our dish beautifully.  I took off one star because it's a REALLY TINY sushi bar, it can probably seat only 10 people, but it doesn't stop me from going there.  =o)

Great service, very reasonably priced, and excellent food. Sushi was fresh and the portions of fish were generous. 

This place just opened so there are only a handful of reviews but I bet that will not be the case for long.

Stop what you're doing and go eat there now!

This is my go to AYCE Sushi place. They have a very nice atmosphere and there is a good variety of sushi and appetizers. The service is very friendly and they are pretty attentive when you need a refill on your water and tea. I would reformism this spot to anyone who is looking for an AYCE place and fast service.

We visited the restaurant on a saturday evening.  I asked for a quiet table. We got everything and more.  We had 11 with us and the restaurant was SUPER taking care
of our needs.  The food was SUPER and the staff is SUPER also.  Everyone was thrilled with dinner and we all will be going back real soon.

Picked up car after supervisor said done. Looked in befor leaving from driver side looked good.  After getting in from passenger side later found crumbs in passenger side. Side pocket had debris as well.  Warning...inspect your car thoroughly before driving off do not trust supervisors word.

We have FINALLY found an Italian restaurant that is on par with the restaurants up North!  This was as good (If not better) than the restaurant we recently ate at in Little Italy, NYC, and that's really saying something.  Atmosphere a 10, service a 10 and food off the charts!

This was the worst customer experience i have ever had at this arby's. The shift manager ws combative rude and disrespectful. When taking our order. This is the first time coming to this store at night. I do not recommend going at night. Done ask questions about the menu they will be annoyed by you.

Car was still dirty after going through the wash. Back of my Honda Pilot was as dirty as it was when I drove in. Just now, it was wet so I used my own towels to clean the entire back. Also wiped down the side windows and the towel came up dirty there too.  The wheel wash did nothing. Not coming back here.

Never go here.  Damaged my car.  I waited for police to show up, for insurance purposes.  Found out from the very polite officer the place is uninsured and I'd have to go to small claims court.  The Car Spa had my car on camera getting hit by the employee and still let me know too bad take us to court if you got the time.

I have visited Salon West a few times and each time it has been great.
From the greeting you receive upon arriving, a consult with your stylist where they listen to your request.
My stylist Denise is so professionally and she makes me feel special.  The Salon offers every service we ladies need.

This is the absolute direst gym I have ever been too.  It is obvious they have never dusted in there, the machines are old, and the front desk staff do not acknowledge you when you walk through the door.  The location and hours are convenient but not worth the money.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Worth the 5 minute drive off Beach drive! The service, Spencer, was 6 STARS. Which made the meal taste even better. Our three dishes were perfection. I wish I had more selections of wines by the glass. Thank you Chef and Spencer for a fantastic evening. 5 stars

Goleta Sushi House is one of our favorite places to go in Goleta! We are not from around here but we make frequent visits to see our daughter at college and always come to this great sushi spot! The mango salad is fantastic! I highly recommend this place to any sushi fan.

Craved some iced coffee after all the walking in the pier, but was very disappointed. I asked for almond milk but my drink was made with regular milk. I also asked for 2 extra shots but got 3 instead. Coffee was weak and watery. Lavender flavor was missing. Overall, not the best i've had.

this place was wack. You sit down look at menu then go up and order. I got chicken fries and they felt so greasy and squishy and not good. The environment was no good, I felt that they were almost mad at me. Only one cup size.... I wanted a small. Only good thing was honey mustard

Found this on Yelp and I gotta say I went here 2 nights in a row!!! Ordered the same exact thing both nights.  Carne Asada for $10 and jumbo margarita on rocks.  Excellent food and atmosphere.  Had garage doors open and it was great.  Nice new looks and they have a nice thing here.

Great place to go when I'm feeling for sushi.  Very creative selections, some are very spicy, all very fresh and delicious.  I don't really care for the dark atmosphere with blue lights but seems to be typical like other sushi places.  The many creative and fresh options makes me come back.

Still awful Customer Service.   Waited at front counter for 5 minutes while someone sorted sauce and the manager was standing at the food chute just waiting for food.  Finally walked out and went to Wendys.  Food is good, but service is the worst ever for a McDonalds.  No focus on Customer Service.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Hardly any sauce on the pizza and none in the Stromboli, which was filled with raw vegetables and almost completely devoid of the meat it promised. When I asked for sauce they gave me a 2 oz cup, which was enough for about two bites. On the upside, though, this place is great if you love having diarrhea!!!

We eat at all the best reviewed sushi Joints wherever we travel - including Hawaii.  And this one remains our favorite for the past few years now.  The Spanish roll and Baja roll are hands down our very favorite.  We always get those two and then something new.

We read the reviews online and decided to book for the night we were staying in town. A bit away from the downtown area, we found the hotel pleasant, clean and comfortable. The front desk staff were very helpful, the rooms had everything we could want. Breakfast was good with may options. No complaints here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Very nice room + bathroom, but the water from the sink smelled like sulfur and the WiFi was very hard to connect to. The staff was really nice and helpful though! The WiFi wasn't great and took a long time to get connected but otherwise, besides the sulfur water, there are no complaints!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: They are so very good at taking your money. And then so very, very terrible at getting you the glasses that you've already paid for. This place needs a consultant to help them think through their timeframe/staffing pattern. Or, like, helpful employees. Whatever floats their boat.

text: Super friendly staff, but my donuts were undercooked. The cinnamon roll was raw dough in the middle, saturated with oil on the outermost layer. I think the oil was not hot enough. I hope it was just an off day because this a a cute place with a great selection.

This legitimately could pass as the worst McDonalds in the entire country. Pretty sure the staff are just high everyday when they come in to work. Hands down the dirtiest and slowest establishment I've ever been in and that's saying it nicely. I'd rather starve.
