text: Decoration is very nice, good service that's about it this place is good for, sashimi tastes horrible and very thin slice. Two order of sushi rolls is about 1 order of sushi roll else where and very blend taste. Definitely won't be back here again. Wonder how they got so high rating , people must never had good sushi before.

Food is phenomenal!! Sometimes takes a while but worth it! Servers aren't that great unless your seating at the bar with miles. He's the freaking best! Love the happy hour option and just wish that the servers were  more knowledge about their wine and menu:

Do not use! Deceptive as per other reviews is 100% accurate.  They quickly prompt and tell you hit yes, yes, for the additional insurance, paid 80 a day for a ford focus.  I called multiple times and unable to get anyone on the phone.  Refused to help me, they are deceptive and horrible service.

Yeah played like 2 country songs....then the bartender proceeds to tell us you gotta buy 40 dollars worth of drinks or more at the bar or we aren't getting served and she was a cunt about too. Go somewhere else...anywhere esle. Do us a favour Fire your bartender and dj

Love the food and service at Villa Gallace. They were very busy but our waiter took care of us. The food was great! We loved the calamari and fresh bread. Our entrees were great! Seafood pasta and I had the lemon chicken. Would order both again. We will definitely be back.

Scam Artist. Avoid using this place. They are super unorganized and unprofessional. I got the wrong prescription and they refused to remake my glasses after paying $349 I still don't have proper glasses and they want me to pay out of pocket for a new exam.

text: My pedicure, by the owner. When I arrived home and saw the bubbles in my polish, I called her and sent pictures. She tried to blame this horrible pedicure on me. She was using old- bad polish. Very rude and unprofessional, I had to get another pedicure. Very nasty lady.

Right in the heart of the French Quarter, a block from Bourbon Street. A large, quaint suite (and mine was the small one), clean and with everything you could need. The people are welcoming and knowledgeable. I will definitely return and recommend this beautiful small hotel completely.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Great service, excellent food with large portions.  Why won't I ever return?   The restaurant added $20 to my bill after I had signed the receipt.  Most of us do not leave a $27 tip on a $28 meal.  Too many other eating options to support a restaurant that takes advantage of their customers.

Very over priced system. For their ultimate wash they really should think about a better wipe down of the inside. It would literally take two extra minutes but as a customer I know that I would leave feeling better about the price. Attention to detail is so important to retain and attract customers. I will not be back.

Best of the best. After having a horrible experience at the Merced Best Western we had a fabulous stay at the Best Western Plus in Goleta, Ca. All the employees were professional and friendly. The room was beautiful. The bed was wonderful. The property was fresh and clean.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Food is Fantastic. Very authentic. Huge portions and the taste is unmatched.  

However, the waitress gets just 1 STAR because she was awful.  NEVER came back to ask if we wanted drink refills, NEVER came back to clear table and NEVER even came back to give us the check.  SHE SHOULD CHOOSE ANOTHER PROFESSION

I just went to best nails! They suck! I got a pedicure and the lady cut my nails to short then she broke my big toe nail like chipped it! After all that she went to massage my legs and didn't use lotion and only did it for about 3 mins. It was horrible! Do not ever go here ! They rush everything! It's horrible!!

The scoop of ice cream I had was good, but it wasn't special enough to cost over $5.  I stopped in on a beautiful, warm Friday afternoon and the place was deserted - I almost walked away because I thought it was closed.  It also looked like it could use some cleaning.  As I stated, the ice cream was good, but not that good.

When Fox News started playing there last fall I thought it was unnecessarily divisive and literally unappetizing. I had heard they had switched but that turned out to not true. I walked back out. Why interject politics into lunch? In liberal broad ripple? Ugh.

The workers (mostly blacks) are so disrespectful here. Bad service and customer care. I asked how much the medium fries were and she said "I don't know" we're white and a black lady comes and asks after we ordered and she said "they're 1.19" I think they are racist.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Slow kitchen! Blah fettuccine! Come on pasta dishes do not take that long to put together. Poor wait staff is embarrassed by the delays. Food served to people dining together 10 minutes apart is not acceptable or polite. The manager instead of being apologetic was defensive bordering on rude.

The sushi is great, but service is horrible! The manager & I had a full blown argument in front of the entire place regarding a charge that was incorrectly placed on my order. She refused to remove the charge for an item I did not order and told me that if I did not like it then I could leave. Never going back.

Food overall is ok. Wait is too long. Service was terrible, which makes the whole restaurant look bad. We had Jonathan. He was distracted, lazy, and rude! He didn't ask us to have separate checks for a party of 8. Ask for another waiter! Only come if you have 2 hrs to spare.

The last two times I went to shop at Patel's market the doors wouldn't open.  When I drove up I saw people coming out with bags of groceries.  When I tried to get in the glass doors wouldn't open.  I could see people inside working and I waved, but they didn't pay attention.  Shame, I used to like shopping there.

Best nail salon in my opinion, and I've been to several in town and out of town. I aways get what I ask for here, whether it be by Tammy herself or her lovely daughter. Could be pricey, but this is the ONLY place that has my nails lasting 4+ weeks when I don't have time to come in sooner. They never disappoint.

My family came down to visit a week after I moved down here and we looked for a good Italian restaurant and found this gem! The staff was fantastic and so was the food! I asked them to put a different sauce that wasn't listed on the menu on my food, and they did it without a problem! We will definitely be back soon!

Nice guy seriously. But my haircut was crooked..... I had to go home and fix it myself which kinda defeats the purpose. Also the back/sides were way longer than I wanted even after a few revisions. I just gave up paid him, went home and shaves the sides a bit.

Just had my wedding here and everything was perfect. The staff was amazing!!!! I could not have imagined my special day any better. Huge huge thank you to everyone involved and making our stay so remarkable. All my family flew in from ca and enjoyed their stay as well. Thank you so much !!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Horrible!! Drive thru is ridiculously slow! Waited 17 minutes after placing order until I got it. Then when I got home, the whoppers were wrong. They had no lettuce,tomatoes or pickles on them. Disgusting! It'll be a long time before I ever go to Burger King again.

I called China Wok because I wanted to order some food. The Chinese lady was very rude.  The food was overpriced and was very bland. I asked for some extra soy sauce and the Chinese lady gave me 1 extra little soy sauce packets. UNBELIEVABLE. I won't go back

NO COVID-19 HELP.  I have been with gno for 2 years, never missed a payment(they charge 15.00 to make a payment online)  Now I have lost my job due to the virus, and their offer is they will charge me 40.00 to skip one month.  No other help available during these hard times.  Thanks GNO.  Thought you guys were better than that.

I went to Dereks tonight, the server was very nice. I was happy she offered us a customer card to fill out for discounts, at the end of our dinner we left and my husband phone was left at the restaurant. Within minutes we were notified via a phone call. Thanks so much, we will be back! The food was excellent!

Hotel has great Customer Service. Lobby is amazing and they have a Starbucks. Valet parking is great. And if you wish to park on your own the garage is right across the street.
Only bad thing about this Hotel is that they still have the old TVs that if you put it on Tag Sale for Free no one would take it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
ON THE GO ORDERING!!!!!! HAHA SHOULD BE ON THE SLOW FOR THIS LOCATION.  
As with every other review, terrible service, attitude, and basically everything else.  I have never seen the owner here, I guess if it was my place I would stay away too.  Dunkin on Market St is worth the drive, its one of the best I've been to.

I will never ever step foot in this establishment again. The customer service is horrible. I will not recommend this place to anyone.

Brief explanation of my experience: I witness the host/cashier rudely yelling at a customer to leave. After coming in respectfully and speaking in a respectful manner.

It was OK!  I was disappointed that they did not honor the YELP coupon.  They tried to convince me that it was for another salon with a similar name but different location. The coupon actually comes up after choosing this Name/Location!!!  I probably won't go back for this reason!!!

Lovely location, mediocre food and inattentive service. Over priced for what you receive at the bar and the restaurant. The bar had 8 people and it took 10 minutes to get the bar tenders attention to place a drink order. We asked our waitress twice for water and never received it. Will not recommend or return.

The pizza is definitely the best in the area. Not a big fan of the sandwiches and wings. Better options in the area for wings and cheesesteaks, but not pizza. As this place is a take out only place, maybe that is why the wings and warm sandwiches are not very good.

But if you want good pizza, this is your place!!!!

I was disappointed in this pizza. We ordered a large extra cheese and a large pepperoni with extra sauce. Nothing exciting. It is also overpriced in my opinion, even though this was a "Special Deal." ( $30 for 2 14 inch thin crusts. ) I won't be returning.

Unique sushi/foodie experience!
Each piece of sushi is a work of art.  The fish was absolutely delicious. I don't think I've had sushi this good in Philadelphia. Definitely a unique experience and not for someone focused on quantity.  Also - BYO (which helps compensate for the higher price tag)!

An amazing experience and both my glasses and sunglasses look amazing! My vision is perfect and I will definitely be a repeat customer.
Their attention to detail is reassuring, as well as their assistance with helping you choose an appropriate frame with regards to the shape of  your face.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Horrible liquor store. Inconsistent experience. I have been there about 5 times and that was 5 times too many.  Staff and owner are not in sync with inventory. Owner likes to play games with customers to create increased volume but it winds up causing unnecessary wait times and disappointed customers.

Completely messed up my hair! Super unprofessional location and no one seems to take their job seriously there and it shows! They were more worried about what movie is on the TV rather than the customer. Messed up my hair really bad! Do NOT go to this place if you want a good haircut.

Terrible service.... Waitress never checked in... Took a half hour to get salads out and over an hour for the food...  Don't waste your hard earned money or valuable time here.  Might very well be the worst restaurant I've ever eaten at in Delaware.  Was here the evening of 12/30... Wasn't even crazy busy just really poorly run...

I would not trust the positive reviews of this restaurant. This place is dark and dirty with uninspiring food. We were here in early December with a group of business people for dinner and we had a fair experience at best.

There are many better places to eat in this area in this price range.

This was some of the worst Chinese food I've ever had.  All the food was edible but that's about it.  Took us 15 mins to order then 45 mins to call us and tell us  they couldn't find our house.  I will not be ordering from here ever again.  I created this account just so other people would know of my experience.

The cashier had an attitude and got my order wrong. The drinks i got weren't made right. The mocha frappuccino tasted like pure milk and sugar somehow and my strawbery acai tasted like the water that was used to wash strawberries. I love starbucks but this is not good

Sue is the best at operating a rental car business with service for the customer. She went above and beyond to be helpful. She operates her business with a personal touch that is very different from the usual rental car experience. I highly recommend this location to rent your vehicle. Thank you Sue!

I had sushi delivered to my hotel from Vic.  I am very picky about my sushi and had one of the best meals ever!  I had the Holiday, Birthday and Tiger rolls and also the Tuna Dumplings which were to die for! I could not believe how quickly it was delivered.  I will definitely be ordering from Vic if I am in downtown Philly again.

The  restaurant wasn't busy, the kitchen was very slow. The food was marginal, at best. My husband's pork chops were dangerously under cooked, but they were very apologetic and made new ones for him. However, the whole dinner took 2 1/2 hours, without dessert, and wasn't worth the investment of time. I won't be going back.

I like the gym as a whole but when one of their trainers gets another job management makes them leave immediately instead of letting them give notice.  This is an inconvenience to members that wish to partake in classes.  If you let the trainers work after they give notice it would give you time to fill the position.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Stopped in for lunch at 11:15 am on a Monday prior to my flight. I ordered a drink and a cheesesteak at 11:21. My lunch arrived at 11:44, a 23 minute wait. The sandwich was average as the roll was not fresh. The bar tenders were nice. I got a 2nd drink after the meal. Bill was $37 plus tip.

$13 bucks for a great clean, cheaper than Crew, equally friendly and professional service and high powered free vacuuming at the end. Better value and a great experience! I'll be a repeat customer and they can accommodate larger vehicles like my NISSAN NV 3500 passenger!

Honestly disgusting. I found mold in my bathroom since 2019 and they still haven't done anything about it. Mind you this was before the COVID-19 breakout. Thank god im moving out and the office lady LITERALLY DOES NOTHING  ALL DAY LONG AND HAS A NASTY ATTITUDE. If I could rate these apartments 0 stars I would .

The best!

For years and years we have loved the products and specialty of Danny Scordato. He creates an amazing atmosphere and delicious food. 
Veal piccata, Caesar salad, bread with yummy basil oil tiramisu.  
For a special evening, business lunch or family event he has the space and the view. ENJOY

As a pizza lover, I was very disappointed in this place. Pizza ok but the service was bad, and there was a snooty blond working that should be selling pizza.

Cute little place, but they may not be able to sell enough pizzas for that high rent district, especially with the new competition coming to town.

We moved from southern Cali so we missed all the authentic and variety of foods available there resorting to cooking at home mostly here. Recommended by husband's coworker, we found Yamato's tonkatsu ramen to be very very close to our favorite ramen spot back in Orange County. Definitely a great find and we keep going back for it

Nice people but have servers without masks.  They don't care about my family members who are elderly and frail.  I'm going to Panera across the street instead. Maybe slightly better if you order through drive though but the people without masks are all over the place.

This place is usually great. The people here are fantastic and the food is always good - especially compared to the DD near Pilgrim Gardens.  My big complaint is that workers don't all wear masks.  So if you order just get the pickup so they don't breathe on you too long.

I really love this place - the customer service is great. But I have to stop going because half the people don't wear masks - they wear it halfway. I'll be going to the other coffee shop in the stop mall. But don't go to the Dunkin' Donuts near pilgrim gardens - I got food poisoning there once.

Be careful with American Heritage. When you get a loan they make you open a savings account. When you finish the payments on the loan, they charge you monthly for the savings account. You don't remember that you have one. Oh and closing the account is a hassle. You cannot do this over the phone. It is a scam.

Aweful, pizza was very tough, no flavor. Garlic knots looked like rolled up pretzel dough, tasted like raw dough. I was told this place was good but maybe new ownership or pizza makers. So far little Italy in st pete and Eddie and sams in Tampa are the best New York style

Normally, I love Fridays. This location though is awful!  Smaller portions than I'm used to, food was only warm, service was really slow despite only a few tables being occupied...   Maybe its because its a mall location? I'm not sure but will not be going to this particular Fridays again.

Loved this place. Only had drinks and a piece of fabulous key lime pie, which looked and tasted homemade. Which we had been hungry, from what we saw going to other tables the food looked great. 
Would recommend stopping here for a little local restaurant and bar.

Uugh. Next time order the cardboard flavor and pay less. Regardless of what you order you get the same taste

The dough is terrible. Like rough cardboard and little cheese. Go somewhere else and get better pizza. Don't know how people think this place is good

Was referred to johnny cools barbershop by a friend months ago to replace my drive to the northeast for a good cut. Not only is it alot closer, i prefer the shop itself and go to johnny who gives me the cut i want every time i take his seat. No downside to this shop. Family friendly and average pricing.

Moved here from the Southwest US and have been on the hunt for a few good spots to get Mexican food. I was very happy with my dinner at San Antonio! Homemade chips topped with beans, and delicious chile relleno for dinner. Guacamole also solid. We will be back!

It is hard to know they have restaurant there.. They need  a few signs and large menus in front.

The food was fantastic and very reasonable cost. The staff was friendly the service was outstanding. It felt like we were in Italy.

They do take out and delivery in addition  to a large  pleasant dining space.

I went to pick up my suit & other items on Saturday at 3:10.They were closed.Eventhough,their posted hrs say they're open on Sat til 3:30 as well as their posted hrs on internet.Which I checked before I left my house in New Orleans.Very inconvenient & inconsiderate.Too many other cleaners to choose from.

text: These guys are great. Most honest repair shop I have ever encountered. Brian and his team will get to know you buy name and tell you everything up front. I moved out of the area and I will drive 30 miles still to do repair work since I haven not found another place like them

text: I see a lot of negative reviews but I've never had a problem at this place. The atmosphere is great. I love the decorations. The servers are very nice. They can sometimes be slow to get refills, but not a big deal. The food is phenomenal. I highly recommend the cheese dip. This is definitely a quality Mexican restaurant!

text: We come here specifically for the dog washing facility. I took the red eye here bc I have a meeting early this morning.  Now I will be late.  Will wait another 10 min then will have to take a long taxi ride.  Great work Hertz.

Don't count on your car being ready when you expect it to be or for them to have what you requested. Also don't count on a grace period for returns.  Was made to wait 20 minutes, which isn't much unless you have somewhere to be, like most people at an airport.

Maybe because I'm Italian... or maybe because it was so hyped up... not sure ... but the food was okay not fantastic. I feel really bad saying that... I guess if you didn't know Realm or GREAT Italian Food ... you'd love this place. 
Honestly, was good... not great ! Wonderful , inviting staff.. good cocktails.

The good part is they speak English you can understand.  The young girl I got left lines that ate really noticeable. They didn't have they're glitter gel nail colors available so I just went with pink and it's not bad but seeing the lines from the drill puts it in a bad light.
