just sat in drive thru for 5 minutes and no one would take my order. Several; cars were behind me but since this happened for the second time this month I left and drove to a White Castle. I then drove home and looked up their phone number to talk to a manager but number disconnected. What is the problem at this location,

I wish I would have seen the other reviews before we came here. DISGUSTING!  Every single table was dirty. There were flies buzzing around the dining area and the table we attempted to sit at had a dead fly in the booth seat. We asked the woman at the counter to bag our food and we split. This place should be shut down.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Quick seating and friendly wait staff. Wonderful atmosphere for families as well. The food is unmatched by any other Italian restaurant in the area. The pizza is always fresh and the chicken parmigiana sandwich is the best meal I've ever had for under $10.

Great facility but make sure not to leave anything in your bedroom unattended. My laptop was stolen from my room while I was visiting in the city. The worst was that the attitude of the Wyndham staff, which not only did not help me to file the police report but also never even apologize for the issue.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Always the slowest Starbucks. If you're in a hurry I would say go to the next closest Starbucks and it'll still be faster than waiting in this locations line. I've seen other locations with long lines often but they move pretty quickly not sure why this one struggles.

Ordered from there tonight for dinner.  Got the garlic knots and meatball sub.  The knots were completely inedible.   Hard as a rock and couldn't even pull apart to try and eat.  Sub was soggy and disgusting.   Just moved to the area and completely disappointed.  Threw it all away.

Little cute salon... I went there last week for haircut with my haircut deal coupon from living social ... The cut was v fast as the way I wanted it to be . The only thing I did not liked was the product they used. .. Got a head ache after the cut !! 5 star if they change it..

They'll over charge when they think you're drunk after being a repeat customer 

Watch out for the Confidence scam

The bar tender asked the score of the game when he gave the bill so no telling how many times he pulled this scam when people are drinking heavy.

Not a wide selection of doughnuts in the mornings on Saturday, the lady seemed to be pretty in a rush to get us out of there and on the the next but. Let's talk about the doughnuts they are soft yes good doughnuts but there where no doughnuts holes so I can't speak for those the original can't compare with kk but over pretty good

There's one barber I go to at Duke who cuts hair well. Unfortunately he wasn't available so I went to someone else there who completely butchered my hair. I was very clear as to what I wanted and the barber either was completely incompetent or just disregarded my request. Avoid this place.

I had to bring in my ailing older dog and I would have not chosen a better place for him to be put to sleep.  Dr. Brady and the techs were sympathetic and also let us have time with him while sedated (he was in a lot of pain and would not sit still) to say goodbye.  

The best people I've met in a long time.

The beds were very comfortable but was about it. Room 149 had mold in the walls, a hair ball from a previous guest and a cricket in the shower. If it wasn't because we checked in at 2 am and were exhausted, we would have left. The gentleman in the front was very nice though.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My husband wanted to order Papa Johns but as usual I wanted to try something different from what we can get at home. Skip this place!! Ordered a supreme & it had no sauce & no flavor. The garlic cheese bread was a loaf of garlic bread with some cheese. I wouldn't recommend this place.

Service was great, I ordered the carnitas plate (roasted pork). it was ok, but it would have tasted better if it would've been made that day. I could tell that it was reheated maybe nuked, other than that the portions were big and the rice and beans were good.

Stylish but a cardboard box. Could hear EVERYTHING in the room next to me. Was awoken every day of my stay by the sound of my neighbor flushing their toilet, showering, etc. Cleaning crew was very loud in hallways, letting doors slam repeatedly. Comfy bed, stylish decor, but impossible to sleep soundly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Staff is pretty rude. They move very slow and they are always missing basics so I end up going to the Flourtown store which is better stocked and has friendlier more knowledgeable staff. If they the Flourtown store has in stock and this store doesn't, isn't that most likely a managerial problem?

reallly cheap price!!!!!
There are diverse sauces.
You choose the main toppings such as beef, chicken and so on. 
They give you the tortilla with the main topping.
And you can put chopped onions, coriander, and many sauces. 
And if you don't like coriander, you can put only chopped onion not mixed with coriander.

If I could put 0 stars I would. I had food poisoning here (100% sure it was this place) and was sick for almost a week. One of the worst I have ever had. I warned my co-workers about this place and one of them didn't listen and is now in the hospital with severe food poisoning. BEWARE! You have been warned.

Not only was their service crappy when I got there, but when we asked for one more thing they never brought it up and when I left something special (which I know is my fault) I called and they were rude and never called back. I'm in the customer service business....I'd just wish for more. Thanks but no thank you again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The tacos are next level. I tried so many and the fried fish is hands down THE BEST! All of the ingredients are fresh. Service was great but you do need a smart phone to do everything (menu, paying and ordering) I absolutely love the ceviche! I could eat it everyday.

I would not recommend nationwide vision. Most employees are not helpful and don't seem to know what to do. In addition, my glasses were broken when I received them. This was not a good experience. You are better off finding another company to do business with.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I ordered a dinner salad today and found a big dead fly in it. They were very rude and had to beg them to give me a refund. The mean pizza maker even wanted to rip me off with the refund and give me less money back. Never eating here again. Very dirty place. God knows if there are bugs in the other food.

First The positive.  The service was really good. Attentive and always had refills. The wings were ok but a little over cooked. The pizza was  burnt and hard. There was no flavor and just a smidge of sauce. We went here because the Joes in Troy is amazing, best wings and pizza ever! was very disappointed in the food here:(

Very clean place and everybody was very nice! However this place is overrated. Their asada tacos were so dry and over cooked. If you want more flavorful tacos stick to lengua or chicken fajita. Definitely won't go there again. Maybe add rice and beans to your menu, even quesadillas would be nice. Nothing wrong with having choices.

Expected a little better based on a 3 star hotel.  Fine if you're a single person looking for a place to sleep for a night or two.  I wouldn't recommend it for families though.  Some of the clientele on the "city" facing side was pretty sketchy.  Room was dated and in need of a remodel. Location is nice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Went with a party of 7 around lunch time and found that the service was all great and the food lived up to the reviews from friends that had brought us there! Will definitely be going back for lunch again! 
FYI - restaurant is small so I recommend calling ahead if your party is bigger than 4!

I had a great time this week. Great breakfast. Clean room. Refrigerator. Microwave. Plenty of hot water. Plenty of pillows. Plenty of towels. Nice tv. Free wifi. My only complaint is the soap, definitely bring your own. Eat at Lindy's next door. Or idaho pizza company will deliver. It's awesome.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Drove 7 hours to the hotel, was greeted by the receptionist by stating, "You're late." Room was clean. Fridge actually froze and destroyed all our food. Microwave didn't work. Housekeeping came twice because they had us listed as checking out on Friday when we booked until Sunday. Basically, it was not my most favorite experience.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Hampton Inn was clean. Most staff was friendly. Plenty of parking. The walls are paper thin with big heavy doors that slam loud. It is right off the interstate so lots of noise from traffic. The breakfast is sad and not for anyone who is eating low carb or low calorie or gluten free.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: If you work a night job and normally sleep in past 8am you're screwed if you live in this place. They schedule landscaping crews from 8-10am and will have multiple people with the loudest possible leaf blowers and lawn mowers ear f****g you bright and early to ensure you never get proper sleep.

Reserved an economy car but after waiting in line 45 minutes, was told only minivans were available.  Waited an additional 45 minutes to get a smaller car.  Disappointing since it took the entire morning.  Next time I will choose the second cheapest option - saving a few dollars was not worth the hassle.

Nice place on the inside, complete incompetence from the staff.  First, it's easier to get into a penitentiary than this place.  They treat patrons like inmates, and the attitude leaves something to be desired.  NEVER going back to this place.  Do yourself a favor and walk 100 yards south to Yards.

Normally I get great service. However, today was a little different. I sat at the drive-through window seven minutes with no response. Drove past the drive-through window and the employee working was sitting chatting on her cell phone. Poor customer service so I left

Terrible. The guacamole tasted rancid and bad, chips were thick and tasteless. Charged me for a guacamole app and then lied to me about charging me for it. This place is shady! Told them the guac was bad and they didn't bring out a new one and still charged us for it!

Terrible Krispy Kreme location. Got here at 10:20pm (when they close at 11) and they had basically no donuts left. Then I ordered some weird lemon donut and a drink. I got to the window and they had messed up the order and did not know what I had ordered. Very incompetent.

Just ok. A bit dated but staff was friendly.  Lots of airline crews stay here. Not much to do in the immediate area so you'd definitely need a car. There are 2 restaurants nearby ~ local and decent food for a meal but I wouldn't go back. Hotel is a $15 Uber from the airport ~ 8 miles.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Their homemade lasagna pasta is tasty.  The spaghetti is adequate, nothing I would rave over.  The veal was well seasoned, however, it could have been a bit more tender.   Overall the food was good.  I wouldn't mind coming again but I'm not sure that it would be on the top list of places to eat.

Love this restaurant!    The food is terrific and the service is excellent.  Everyone has a can-do attitude and does everything to accommodate a busy crowd. Frankie is ever present and greets all with a"how you doing"  that is earnest and sincere.  Don't forget the specials.  They are the best.

Not that impressed honestly. The atmosphere is great and all but the food comes in VERY small portions, and it's only mediocre in flavor. The price of the food definitely doesn't fit the quality. The servers seemed as if they belonged to a frat house instead of a fine dining restaurant.

The absolute worst McDonald's in Nashville. I will not be returning, I'd rather drive 7 minutes to the out of the way McDonald's than ever return to this one which is sad bc this one is right on my way. I've seen people wait for 15 minutes before giving up, during peak morning hours! Ridiculous!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Excellent food, moderate portions and prices, excellent service. I recommend the grilled octopus. It was some of the most tender and well-prepared octopus I've had. Dining room is small and tables are tightly packed. So, it's noisy and gets cold every time the entrance door is opened.

If you have ever eaten great Chinese food, you should never eat what they call food at this place. The items we ordered ranged from barely edible to terrible. It was a total waste of time and money.
As my son used to say "Yechhhhh!" when having something very unpleasant in his mouth - like foul tasting medicine.

I've been too ALOT of barbers and I can tell you that Jason is the real deal. No one has ever even come close to doing fades as well as him. The atmosphere is awesome and the conversations never fall short. Can't recommend HOB enough, you gotta experience it!!

Excellent food. Broody poorly-trained waiter on the second floor reached over my face with a dirty plate in his hand from another table. I asked for coffee at the end of the meal and he said, "I'd have to make it."  So we skipped the coffee. He got an 18% undeserved tip.

Called and ordered for pick up.  Was told 10 minutes and given an order number.   Went to pick up pizza and was told they didn't make it and I would have to wait for them to make from scratch.  No apologies, no discounts, no respect guess this will be the last time I go here.  Tell your friends to go elsewhere!

I went in to get a gel polish manicure on my natural nails. Within 3 days, my nails are already pulling up and peeling off. Highly disappointed. I was worried that this would happen as it only took the technician less than 15 minutes as she rushed through. Will not be returning.

Ownership has changed hands and Benny the previous owner and key to the food quality has left and gone back to La Stalla in Newtown.  Guess I will not be back here.  What a shame as this was one of my favorite restaurants outside of Italy.  Benny - see you at La Stalla if I ever visit again.

I couldn't be happier with Salon West and all the safety protocols they are following due to Covid. 
It was a relaxing experience because I felt so safe. And my stylist Nicole is such a talented woman! She took the time needed to talk about the plan for my hair after being gone since May. Excellent haircut.

Never again!  We tried this place twice for routine oil changes.  They always found things that "really should be done" on our "012 cars.  They claimed we needed a new tire and let the air out! They had the paperwork all written up when we picked up the car! LOL  I do not trust them, period.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: They close super early every night, like at least 30 minutes. If your sign says you're open until 10 pm, then that's when you should be open until. I've worked in restaurants and I get wanting to go home, but that is poor customer service and unprofessional. When they're open, they're ok.

Quite literally the worst 24 hour fitness i have ever been in. The weight room feels like its in a cellar. Weights strewn everywhere. Crackling music on broken speakers. Just a depressing place that works against your fitness needs because you dread being there.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Very cute location, and coffee was excellent! I'm a big customer service lover since I work in the industry as well and this place could honestly do a little better. I had never been here before yet I felt rushed to order and had to ask and then answer my own questions as the barista taking our order seemed disinterested.

There's a very good reason this place has great ratings!  It is that good and we have had sushi many places from New York to Philly to Boston among others.   The Majestic Roll and Angry Dragon were both huge and amazingly fresh.


Try this place we will be back next week!!

I just had the greatest experience renting a car with Avis in Boise, ID. Jonathan at the counter was patient answering our questions and enthusiastic to offer great customer service. Gail was equally as happy to help up find and checkout our car. Thank you so much for a great experience!

Stayed here last week for The concert all for the hall, this place was great!! Room was very nice, eat breakfast in restaurant down stairs, very good, and friendly service!! I will be going back to Nashville again ! I will come here again also loved it thanks so much for the great stay !!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We had NYE reservations and everything about our experience was fantastic. Our server was amazing, and everyone involved with service made sure we were happy & taken care of. Food and drinks were great (especially the Brussel Sprouts!) and I definitely recommend this spot for a romantic/special occasion meal.

Shrimp in the torta was rubbery and fishy. It comes preseasoned and cooked then frozen in a plastic bag they leave on the counter. Pork mollete was like jam on cheese toast. Coconut Horchata was delicious, though. Guacamole was also fresh and chunky, so maybe just go here for a drink and chips.

Very clean and quite!! The lobby of the hotel is amazing!!! Staff was very friendly. Room had 2 tvs kitchen sink, microwave, mini fridge, computer desk, couch had a pullout bed with extra sheets/pillows in the closet. I will stay here again if I'm ever in Tampa again. Felt like home.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Service was terrible, they are very rude, I was asking questions about my order and the lady hung up on me and did not answer the phone when I called back 5 times.  I order from here before and the food was disappointing but I figured I try it again, I would not recommend this place to anyone.

This little burger joint isn't too bad. Burgers are decent and fires are somewhat soggy but I think thats due to the fact that they are chopped up in the restaurant from regular potatoes so they absorb a bit more oil than usual. Still good though. Never busy so that's why I keep coming back from time to time.

These trifling owners will not even keep fresh water in their water dispenser all day. Only melted ice is available for 18 hours. As a policy they only fill the water in the morning. I've never stayed at a respectable hotel that doesn't offer water in a dispenser. Do better Indianapolis! You are an embarrassment.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Very friendly staff.  Clean and nicely furnished. Comfortable bed and pillows (choices of soft or firm pillows on bed).  Room had a strange smell though and seemed humid.  Also very difficult to find behind a Home Depot.  Maps app requires illegal u-turns to arrive.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Beer menu okay, menu is so tattered and dirty that I wouldn't order food. Staff was grumpy. 

They did have a live acoustic guitar singer that was really good and raised it up from one to two stars. Keep the live music and print some new menus, ask the staff to cheer up!

Doesn't even deserve 1 star. Waited AN HOUR for my food!! Waited between the payment and pickup sign and the person AT THE PAYMENT WINDOW  GOT THEIR FOOD AND LEFT. Trashy and dirty place and trashy and dirty service. I know this is McDonalds but cmon now I didn't know it could get WORSE!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Not to be that guy , but this place is absolutely ass. Straight up every time I come here they take FOREVER and manage to fuck up orders every time. The service is horrible and when I went this morning they were all out of their iced drinks. How does that happen ?? 1/10.

I got a chocolate shake today. Well it was all syrup. When I say syrup it was so dark you couldn't see the writing on the cup. Didn't really pay attention when I grabbed it and my food. Couldn't believe they would actually think someone would drink it. Well I threw it away.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This was my first time using Rocket Express to wash my 2016 Tacoma (July 2018). This resulted in several scratches on the passenger quarter panel that they refuse to fix. I had purchased the monthly pass, but I requested a refund as I will never trust Rocket Express to wash my truck again.

All I can say is "mediocre food and bad service". The so-called managers make excuses for the bad service and are unapologetic. I tried contacting the owners about my recent experience, but every time I called they were conveniently unavailable. At least for your health, steer clear of this place!!!!

The only place near me that has a Hawaiian burger. It was delicious. We also got a crispy chicken sandwich and my mother loved it. The vanilla and peanut butter shakes we got were pretty good, noting really special. The garlic Parmesan fries were also delicious. Would definitely recommend trying this place

Another rental here and another really good experience. Best rental car place at PHL bar none. Only negative is they stopped giving water and soft pretzels - bummer! But compared to the other choices at this airport, this is the gold standard. They actually seen to care about customer service.

Great location, parking lot well maintained.  Easy check in.  Room was great.  A couple of minor maintenance items were brought to management attention at Check out.  Breakfast needs a lot of work, not even a waffle maker, which it a standard in most hotels now.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The food is good, but the service is a bit slow. It took a while for anyone to notice I was there, even though I made eye contact with multiple servers. They also only have plastic silverware- which is not sustainable nor very good at cutting through bone in fried chicken.

Great customer service!  Uptown cafe always has great food, but I wanted to give them a nice shout out for the great customer service, something that is all too scare these days.  My order got a little mixed up on the way to a holiday party.  They didn't miss a beat.  They made it right and got me to the party on time.

We visited a few yrs back and had a great time. This was a great location and the hotel had decent rooms, it's 5-8 min walk to the French Quarter and in a very central downtown location. We managed to secure free street parking during the time we were there and didn't have to use any garages.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
ROAD TRIP
Summer 2016

1 night

LIKES:
Clean room
Spacious for 1 adult, 1 toddler
Comfortable bed
Fluffy pillows 
Fridge & microwave 

DISLIKES:
Sketchy 
Building smells old, looks old, doesn't feel clean
Room key sucked
No elevators
Small pillows
Dirty looking men hanging around outside
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: New Hotel, great facilities, new beds and clean facilities.  I paid $159/ weeknight and was impressed at my choice on Marriot.comc and enjoyed my stay.  Two things hold this back from an easy 5 star review; 47 min wait at the airport for their shuttle pick up and after I booked I found rooms for $20 less on Kayak
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I thought the purpose of a car wash...was to wash your car? Their automatic car wash does not understand this concept as my car came out just as dirty as when it went in. I threw eight bucks down the drain, literally! Not coming back, and for your sake I wish you wouldn't either.

I sat for 20 minutes before anyone noticed me. Wait staff repeatedly walk by me without making eye contact.  My order was wrong when arrived, I probably should've kept the mac and cheese they brought because the coleslaw was not delicious.  The ribs were meh. The frys and beans were good.

Yes, it is a tourist trap. Yes, the Hand Grenade is served in a gimmicky plastic go cup. But no trip to Bourbon Street is complete without a stop and a quick trip to the balcony. When I lived in NoLa (and when I go back) I always stop by for a grendade, some nostalgia, and to show my friends.

This is a solid Italian restaurant executing traditional fare with freshness taste and quality. I really enjoyed the eggplant appetizer. Beef carpaccio w/ truffle oil was out of this world.  Veal chop with fresh tomato rissoto was outstanding.  The acids from the tomato cuts the richness of rissoto. Over great dining experience.

We like the food here and it's close to Carpinteria State Campground.  Its located in a shopping center with Albertson's, hardware store, laundry mat, pet store, UPS and more.  Great location for us RV'ers. 
The Chili Verde Combination plate is good and the Chili Relanos are very good as well.  Really nice customer service.

This place sucked. The check in took forever and once we finally got keys it was for the wrong room. That dude was pissed when we woke him up at 1am trying to get into his room. The breakfast was kinda pricey for what you get too. I'm surprised Sheraton put their name on this property.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Can't complain for the price...  great old warehouse building about 2 or 3 blocks from Canal.  There is a lot within walking distance, but is just far enough to be quiet.  The rooms are a bit traditional, but the internet connection is solid and the staff has been friendly.  For $73/night this is a solid 4 stars!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: They are delicious, reasonably priced and they deliver! I have had the burritos, green enchiladas & chips & salsa and all were excellent. My boyfriend had the mushroom burrito, and carnitas burrito and a chicken quesadilla on different occasions and loved them all. Highly recommended!!!

Meh. This place isn't anything to write home about. The massage wasn't anything special - very gentle. The paint job was fine, but now I'm noticing quite a bit of over spill that wasn't cleaned up! 
I'm not overly impressed, but it's better than nothing if you're in a pinch.

I LOVE this barbershop! I've been getting my cuts by Melissa for about a year now and she does an awesome job each and every single time. Her attention to detail is at another level. 

Everyone else in the shop is also friendly and knowledgeable in the art of barbering. 

I highly recommend this place!!

Edomasa is a great place for sushi in SB. The atmosphere of the restaurant is like any other sushi joint, simple and vibrant. The sushi and rolls here are excellent. Everything has that 'fresh' taste to it and the prices are decent. This place is a must try if you are in the area.

Recommendation: Santa Barbara Roll

I wouldn't go back here again. The food was ok, but we waited for a long time for our food. And when I did get my food, chile relleno and a chicken taco, it was cold. 

They didn't get our orders right and their price wasn't so good. I would skip this place.

Hotel itself is average. Horrible if you like a room with a view. I first had a room with no windows, and then asked for another room. They gave me a lovely room with a view of an alley, a dumpster, and tons of rats. Seriously, saw rats right outside my window every single time I looked out. Ghetto, but fairly close to bourbon st.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I'm not sure if we cam on a bad day, but the service was sub-par. And there was a surprise charge of $48 added to our bill. Not good! I have been to Derek's several times over the years and now I'm not sure if I'll EVER be coming back.  Saving grace: Half price wine bottle special on Sundays.

Very good pizza only gripe would be that I wish it was fresh. They warm the pre made slices when you walk in the door but don't be fooled this doesn't take from the love that goes in to this pizza. Came with my family, friendly staff subway style order line and prices make complete sense

Staff is very accommodating and made our stay comfortable. We utilized the shuttle to get downtown for dinner and bar hopping at night, and getting a cab back was easy. The rooms are typical for a courtyard, but it was worthwhile for us to save some $ by staying here rather than a hotel closer to the bars on broadway.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Bed bug Ridden hotel! Stay away and please do go look at the pictures. My roommate and I both had bug bites on arms and legs. The hotel staff acted like I was a liar and did nothing to help the situation at all. 

My boss found an old dirty sock in his room. 

Stay at the Drury they offer free breakfast!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place is great if: 1.) you like waiting to be seated; 2.) you like greasy food. Pork sliders? Grease bomb! Lamb ribs? Grease bomb! Even the scallops were greasy.  I think next time - if there is a next time - I'll do 50 push ups and maybe a 10k before eating.

The neighborhood isn't ideal but the place had all I needed.  I could park my car for free.  The gates make you feel secure.  It's a 15 dollar cab ride to/from Bourbon street.  You can even hop on a bus and then take a streetcar to bourbon if you've got some time to kill.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Amazing service, food, and atmosphere. Highly recommend!!! Old school atmosphere, incredible wine selection. Unreal Italian restaurant!! Best in the state hands down!! Deserts are scary good and being a big eater, I would know!!! Pizzas are fanfuckingtastic, pardon my....screw that best ever!!!! GO HERE NOW....CALL AHEAD!!!!

My wife and I stopped in here to celebrate our first anniversary.  The food was excellent (pork osso buco and shrimp orrechiette) and our server Melonie was great!  She surprised us with a chocolate cake on a decorated plate.  Would definitely recommend eating here.

We were in town on vacation. This is a great little grocery store. We loved combing the shelves for interesting items. It is well stocked with necessities, too. We came in close to 9pm. The line was long at checkout, but they worked very diligently to get everyone through. They didn't turn anyone away.

Their prices have gone up and the portions have gotten smaller. Also, they charged us for a missing order and they said they would give us "store credit" vs refunding for missing item. There's nothing real special about this place to up-charge. Spend your money elsewhere.

Looks nice in the lobby, rooms have nice amenities, but not clean! I found blueberries, a PILL, (most concerning for moms like me) stains and paint splatters on the floor. Loved that they had a balcony, but it's covered in cobwebs and spiders. Beds are hard. Not impressed, especially considering the cost!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I just ran through with a $4 basic wash cause birds  all over my Jeep.  I think the rain will do a better job.  The car wash didn't even get the snow and dirt off the front bumper.  I wasn't expecting it to be sparkling clean but i would think even $4 should do a little better than this.

Cheapest supermarket so far in sb. Feels like home in l.a. Small & cheap. Bought the beef fajitas meat and it wasn't good though. Lacked flavor. Bought a chicken burrito and to my surprise, was pretty good! Super hot and also cheap. Quick fix for my hunger.

We stayed here for one night.  The rooms were fine, the beds were comfy, and everything was clean, but man were those shampoo and conditioner bottles tiny!  Like doll-house tiny.

They charged us $20 including tax for self-parking in the garage, which was a little annoying.

Overall, it suited our needs on our trip.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Honest small independent shop.  I was driving from Chicago to Atlanta and had issues with the clutch on my car.  I had my car towed there.  He was able to quickly diagnose the problem.  Turns out it was $17 hose.  I bought the part at O'Reilly's and he installed it.  I was back on the road for less than $100.

Fairly new building so it's still clean on the inside. Unfortunately, this is a rare situation for Arby's in my experience. 

The service is friendly enough and the food is standard Arby's, which means a meatiest and no damn veggies....just the way I like it.

One of the best food spots in Tucson. Too bad I only learned about it after both my brothers graduated from U of A. I'd recommend it for lunch or dinner. Service was excellent and the inside is very nice, with large walls opening for some al fresco dining. 

I got the spinach soufflé and it rocked. Highly recommend it.

I washed my car here and afterwards used the clear coat protective stuff, and my car, no joke, looked worse than it did before I washed it. The clear protective coat stuff dried as a tan/yellowish residue all over my car, and I had to scrub it off of every square inch. The rinse and foam brush work fine...

The coffee spot for East Windsor. The place is usually bustling which means the coffee will always be fresh. But the clerks are quick and attentive. The hoagies are a good value and made to order.its a great place to get a reasonably priced quick food that isn't a hamburger and fries that's been sitting under a heat lamp

Food was excellent! Service was great--truly authentic food. This place is adorable--low key and casual. Oh, and CHEAP! Everyone at the table loved their meal.

If you're looking for affordable, casual mexican food this is your spot! It's also a BYOB. SCORE 1 for Bella Vista

Wow I am a little mad that I even had to give one star. I was there over the weekend and the service was horrendous. I don't even know where to start. The bartending was just possibly the worst that i have ever seen and I will not ever return overpriced and just bad. sorry don't know how else to explain it i am speechless

My Toyota broke down on a Saturday afternoon during a road trip to Tucson and Mark diagnosed it over the phone and stayed open to repair it. Everything was top notch from the service to the faculty and the repair. I highly recommend this company for your vehicle.

DO NOT STAY HERE. If I could give ZERO stars I would. Horrible customer service. The front office staff is the worst ever. They need training in customer service. They are rude and incompetent.  Stay at the new Residence Inn or at the Best Western down the street.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Atmosphere was nice.  Up scale look and feel. But wear what you want. 
Decent menu but pricy.
The black bean and chorizo soup is awesome.  The toasted ravioli....... Not so much.  In fact.  Not at all. 


If there are people in the hotel lobby or bar it's pretty loud.

After using thrifty for over a decade, this was my worst experience. I upgraded from a mid-size to a full-size, but the cars were the same size (Chrysler 200 to Altima). I decided to just switch back, and the guy in the garage was kind of rude. Not what I'm used to from Thrifty.

Went the other day and got a pepperoni pizza and Caesar salad. I enjoyed the salad but the pizza was literally the greasiest pizza I've ever eaten. I instantly felt gross after one slice. 

I'm never going to get a pepperoni here again. I'm shocked that they send that out without blinking an eye.

Yelp listed hours that they were open till 1 AM. Upon arrival, the door hours read open till midnight. We arrived at 11:15, the security guard told us that they had already closed the kitchen and last call for drinks had already been made. So essentially they don't honor the hours posted at all.

I went through the wash twice and the front half of my car still had bugs stuck to it. If you're looking for a quick clean, then you might benefit here. Someone that actually wants their car cleaned and not still have bugs and debris stuck to it, steer clear and drive right in by. I will not be using this auto wash again.

I walked in without knowing it was a fine dining restaurant. The price was very high. The seat was very uncomfortable. The chair was so low. I felt like I was a little kid sitting at the adult table. Food was alright. I ordered the crab cakes. Nothing special. I would rather go to the bar next door instead. Will not return

Absolutely one of the finest places in the city. Even though it seems to annoy Aidan I typically arrive a half hour or so ealry for my appointment just so i can sit there and drink a scotch and read his fine selections of magazines all in the astonishing  environment that they've created.

I was lucky that there was no line and I got through quickly but the lady told me that Arizona law was a $1200 ticket if I didn't have proof of insurance. What a lie! We have my own insurance and I printed up my card so no big deal, but you're really going to lie like that? I can't stand liars.

Nice and clean hotel but the parking is outrageous and the charge for the room because of the events in town are ridiculous. I would have rather stayed somewhere else but it was the only room left downtown. Also we were forced to park valet because the garage was full and I felt obligated to tip the drivers. Kind of sucks!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I am at Maison bourbon right across the street. The music at krasy kroner is so crazy loud that I am unable on enjoy the music of my choice.
I think establishments of this sort which do not understand the concept of "live and let live" should not be encouraged in Bourbon street.

Great hotel and super staff! I left my cell phone in my room and Tajuana Turner in housekeeping found it and turned it in. My phone was sent back to my office in California via FedEx and was on my desk upon returning to work the following day. Cannot thank the staff enough; this is fantastic and truly over the top customer service!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I had high expectations for this place but for the price, it could be a lot better. The wait for the drinks was long, 15 minutes for a pour over, crazy. The breakfast food they offered could be better of they heated up property.  The atmosphere was nice and the baristas were courteous.

I'm from California so I know it's hard to compare things, but, the vegetarian burrito (guacamole burrito) was just that. The pick de Gallo was thickly sliced and unappealing to the senses. Unfortunately, I will not be going back despite the fair prices. It's a no from me.

Hotel location is great, but the rooms and bathrooms are very small.  The noise from the neighbors opening and closing their balcony doors is beyond bad.   Also, one can hear the people in the hallway as if they are in your room.   The staff is friendly,  but it doesn't make up for the old hotel and bush beer crowd.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Stayed here as they offered a nice suite sized room with free cruise and parking for a good price. This is a well appointed hotel with very friendly and accommodating staff. The only down side is that off site breakfast options are limited and their hotel restaurant, while offering a nice buffet is a bit on the pricey side.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Beautiful hotel. Trendy. Has that Northwestern feel, like the Ace Hotel brand. Perfectly appointed, spotless, charming, stylish. The only reason I'm not giving it five stars is because the housekeeping lady nearly banged down our door. She knocked like it was a SWAT raid. Not cool.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
My favorite place in town...er was. 
Came back to Tucson after being in Seattle for three years and was saddened to hear chef Yun was gone.   

Does anyone know where his new restaurant is??? Sake''s and a roll is on me if someone is willing to throw me a bone here.  :)

Closing early on a Friday is one thing. Laughing in my face when I show up 10 before you close and you lock the door is another. I'll make the drive to royal liquor from now on. You lost a 4x a week customer for laughing in my face. What were you thinking? Terrible employee should be fired

Very VERY inexpensive! The food was very good. Especially the eggs with cheese. Our waitress was very patient & friendly. I would def bring my family here again when I'm in town. 

The outside is suspect though. It's like a truckers stop. But it def surprised me.

Cheeesus Christ! Now I love cheese just as much as the next gal but can we maybe try to add more sauce and less cheese to the pizza. The pizza was 80% cheese and  5% sauce. The menu said crispy the only thing I got got was a soggy mess. I ate it because I was hungry but I won't be going back

This place needs an overhaul . The room had stains on the floors, walls and tub. The air conditioner barely worked and just needed a good general cleaning . There are a lot of restaurants in the area as well as other hotels . Maybe I just stayed on a bad day but I would try to stay somewhere else next time I'm in the area .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place is great probably the nicest people you'll ever meet! Brinda and Charlisa are great people they've helped me out so much. They've gone way above and beyond just giving me a a place to stay by showing me some really great hospitality on top of  giving me great recommendations for food bars and ect
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I would never recommend this place to anyone. Went today and had a scheduled appointment at 1:00 and did not start getting my nails done until 2:00, not to mention the woman doing my nails did not have any idea of what she was doing for my dip polish. I will be taking my money elsewhere!!!

The workers are nice but my boyfriend and I ordered two chicken burritos and they are the most bland burritos we've ever eaten. There is no taste. I wish we had the time to go back and return them, but we're in a hurry on a road trip. Pretty disappointed to be stuck in a car with boring food.

This was the best Mexican I have had in FOREVER. Carne Asada was spot on. Pork carnitas thumbs up. Even the chicken tacos were out if this world. The enchiladas mistos were so unique and delicious. Add on the street corn- you will not regret it! Enjoy. We love 2 hrs away and I would come back next week for dinner!!!!!

Great service, good pizza. But, the worst fettuccini I've ever had. Bland as hell, no flavor, no bacon....I mean I tried to give them the benefit of the doubt but that was the blandest Italian cuisine I've ever had. Great service . If not for great service would have gave 1 star.

We were in town with a group of
50 teenagers and needed a local lunch. We ordered 15 pizzas, some deep dish, some thin crust, more than enough! And so delicious!!! The pizzeria went out and bought nice plates for us to use since we were at a hotel. They were awesome!

I had a pretty bad morning in traffic getting to the airport. The Alamo Agent was amazing and empathetic to my distress. He got me checked in quickly and was kind enough to show my tank as full, when it was down some. I was very appreciative. Car was clean, smelled clean inside, and ran perfectly!

I stayed at this hotel while I was in New Orleans for a work conference a few weeks ago and it was great!  It's within walking distance of everything there is to see in New Orleans and the staff are very friendly.  They have a pretty good breakfast also.  I highly recommend.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The food and drinks are good, but the service is way too slow for an airport. I ordered my meal and drink as soon as the server visited my table   It took about half an hour for the salmon salad to arrive. Waitress is nowhere to be seen 20 mins after requesting my check.

This place racially profiled me as soon as I walked in . I sat down for two minutes to get my things out because I was about to start studying . An employee walks over and tells me that If I'm not going to buy anything I need to leave . Don't even think about coming here and spending money .

Went there for takeout. Got the "this burger", ordered it rare/medium rare and it came well done. The flavors all meshed together and didn't really add anything to the burger. Also got the Mac and cheese, while it self tasted fine, the crunchy toppings were burnt. 
On the upside, the staff was wonderful and attentive!

After standing in what looked to be a line to order for 10 min. We were kindly redirected to order w/ the barista. An "Order Here" sign or welcome "hello what can I get for you" may have been helpful. Average over all. Lots of seating room. Ambience average.

Pretty pathetic. Didn't even get to try the pizza. 2 hours later and still no pizza. I ordered a small cheese. Finally had to cancel the order but they wouldn't answer their phone. Pizza never showed up and just waiting to get a refund but have yet to accomplish it. Will never try again. Pathetic excuse of a restaurant

The front desk attendant was friendly and the cleaning staff was persistent, but the manager at check-in was not as friendly as he could have been. While the proximity of the hotel to popular tourist spots is close, the area around the Clarion is not somewhere you want to be past midnight.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I always get my eyebrows waxed here. They do a good job and it's very reasonably priced. They do things rather quickly and brusquely though, so if you're looking for something more relaxing, this may not be the place. Overall, I have never had a bad experience with them.

Slices are actually pretty small and they charge extra for vegan cheese on the vegan pizza. Not great, definitely not worth the price. Atmosphere is nice, wait time isn't outrageous, but you can find much better pizza in town. I recommend trying somewhere else unless you're in the neighborhood.

Worst Subway store, they served ur sandwich so cheap, sparing everything from the main meat to veggies, except for one guy who prepare ur sandwich like the one u see in TV ads, all others serve cheap, go somewhere, don't come here. You'll be disappointed for sure.

Outdated. Requested a double room - received a double alright...with two full size beds instead of the usual two queens as in most hotels. Also pretty sure they pipe the hot water in from Central Mexico as that's about how long it seemed to take the water  to heat up. But the staff was nice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Wish I could give this 0 stars. The costumer service from the manager was absolutely horrible. Dealt with a lady Aneesh I believe is her name and yelled at my mom after she payed for her meal on the app but was refused her order! Absolutely ridiculous. The place is kept completely untidy, I saw at least 3 cockroaches inside.

We did not like the food here at all. The sushi was not very fresh and the food was horrible. Service wasn't great either. The only good thing was that it fit the 8 of us well and it wasn't busy.  We won't be back. Mt. Fuji is the best Japanese place on the north side.

Happy and extended one night. This is a 2 star hotel (by traditional ratings) but I give it a 4 for that category. Clean, which is #1 requirement. Nice front staff and appears to be family run.  Breakfast was really minimal and below expectations. Coffee, bagels, some cereal.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The food definitely has a distinct flavor to it. It certainly isn't authentic Chinese unless by authentic you mean American Chinese food. The pricing is good and the portions should fill you up if you don't have a large appetite. The delivery person was always accurate in their delivery to the right location and was polite.

Absolutely the worst experience I've ever had. Sharon is the worst customer service rep I have ever come across. She has a disgusting attitude and even worse she's very condescending. Never again wil I ever rent from Dollar/Thrifty from the airport location again. Not surprised at the low rating.

Worst service at a Starbucks I've ever had. If you can't remember to make a drink for your customers then you have failed at customer service. You have one job... oh and they were out of the one drink I ordered... how can you be "out of a product" especially when I see the customer in front of me get two of the same! Ha!

The service was really good. We waited not even 15 minutes for our food.  Our server was excellent.  We had a problem with our coupon but the manager fixed it for us and was super polite. The food was good, the ribs were amazing. We defiantly will go back again!

I've had authentic Chicago deep dish one time in my life and I've craved it so much since. Pizza Amore has been the first time I've been able to have it since, and let me tell you -- it hit the spot! This pizza was amazing, and the customer service is awesome! I'd recommend this place to anyone and everyone.

A very warm welcome by the staff and owners.

Great workout, this gym really pushes for max effort!

Very friendly and serious atmosphere the really made me want to push myself.

I was a drop in and you can get two workouts for free if you buy a shirt! good deal
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Very gorgeous place with the layout and rustic feel, but rude staff.. I asked if they carried a certain type of liquor, they just responded with no. Telling me "we have this instead" or something helpful would've been nice, but I was on my own. So I searched, found what I needed and they were very.. snooty acting. Not a fan.

Better than North Beach, better than Little Italy!   When you walk in you'll think you're there to get a slice from a typical pizzeria, but venture back to the tables and try the eggplant rollatini and you will be magically transported to one of the best Italian restaurants between San Francisco and New York.

A roommate of mine took my spot in the apartment and I notified the ownership.  They left the place a mess and I got billed for $1,700.  I am trying to work with them but the company won't even send me pictures of the damages.  I was nothing but a solid tenant for them.

You know a place is authentic when you walk in and see lots of Mexican people eating happily. The restaurant is located at the rear of a small Mexican grocery store. The food was fresh and prepared quickly. I enjoyed my burrito. Salsas were good. Good random find out in the burbs (Bensalem)! I would come back.

Dinner was fairly average and for a Italian Restaraunt the wine list was not up to par, but still worth visiting due to a very friendly helpful staff. The Fruit De Mare dish had an over abundance of Mussels, which happens to be my least favorite shell fish, but the balance of the dish was good.

Here we go again. Closed in the middle of the night when you state you are a 24/7 business. It has been 10+ times you've done this to me and I demand some free food the next time I come. I will be contacting corporate and will be calling you in the morning. I've had ENOUGH.

Nice Clean Hotel .. Room was very modern .. Only flaw was they places me next to a room rull of children that played in the hallway until about 1am , despite me calling the front desk to correct the problem twice .. Oh the parents were there but they weren't bothered by it .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Nice Clean Hotel .. Room was very modern .. Only flaw was they places me next to a room rull of children that played in the hallway until about 1am , despite me calling the front desk to correct the problem twice .. Oh the parents were there but they weren't bothered by it .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Booked two rooms for this hotel for my family and prepaid it.  They wanted $100 per room (more than the cost of the room) as an "incidental deposit" before they could check in.  So what is the point of prepaying for the room?  I think this stinks.  I won't book them again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This Starbucks takes forever to serve people and get them through the drive thru. 10-15 minutes is the amount of time I'm usually sitting there. Needless to say I no longer frequent this location like I used to. It's faster and easier to order on the mobile app and just go to the closest store and walk in and walk right back out.

Horrible experience! How hard is it to make a cup of coffee without being harassed? Tried to charge me extra for my coffee when I specifically said I didn't want anything special in it. She said she was not going to charge me but tried to be sneaky and charge me. Horrible service would not recommend to give them business.

I only got Boba. I had the red bean, which was still grainy and not well dissolved. My boyfriend got a milk tea that was just off. The boba was also a little crunchy inside. However, their food choices (Korean Tacos!) seemed interesting, and they gladly remade my boyfriends drink. At least they have good customer service!

For being an in-airport, overpriced bar "restaurant" they did pretty well.  The staff was very friendly and the food was better than going the fast-food route.  Sitting space was a bit crammed but if you're stuck in BNA on delay then it's one of few decent places to hang out.

Just returned to this property after almost a year and besides the gym being awesome, the property seemed dirty (including the rooms) and I'm still surprised how poor the in-hotel dining options are.  Additionally, I think it's crazy that they get away with $35 Valet pricing.  I live in SF and that;s what we normally pay for valet.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Surprisingly nice room. Spacious. Inside like a hotel. Felt safe. Would have give 5 stars but had poor customer service. Guys at front desk were rude, impatient,unfriendly and hard to understand. Need new employees at this motel 6. Other than that. Price and place were good.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Always clean and the staff are always out and about making sure that everything is stocked and tidy during staffed hours. Kind of a small place, but there's everything that you may need to fulfill your workout. Additionally, the key fob access is very convenient especially considering the gym is 24/7.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The room we got was a little smelly, they didn't clean it very well after previous people who looks like had pets with them in the room. We called the receptionist and they never did anything to accommodate us, we tried to find a different place they wouldn't refund us or change our room. Was such a disappointing experience.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We wanted to stop by a local ice cream shop with friends after some fun under the sun and kayaking in Weeki Wachee river. I like the variety of new flavors but disappointed to have some icy chunks in my cone. Otherwise, this is a great place to cool off for a bit before heading out to do something else.

The buffalo chicken salad was tasty, but the kitchen closes way too early and the bartender I had was in a terrible mood and rude to guests. 

If they could bring their level of service to the quality of the food and drink selection, it would be a much more pleasant experience.

I had Gigi's in St Pete Beach and loved it. Service was good, but Treasure Island one was not good. $100 for family of 5 and we barely ate it. Sausage was hard, not like the fresh sausage we had at the other location. Sauce had a canned tomato taste. Disappointing since we loved the other location.

Wow- maybe I wouldn't be so bitter if I wasn't paying $509 for this Gen 1 Old as dirt Courtyard Marriott where being a Silver Elite- whatever that means- means no free water, no free anything. This is so crazy I'm sorry I waited so late to check in. SPG has been a disaster since merging with Marriott- need to switch to Hilton.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The bartenders are huge bitches who don't even know how to make a decent drink!!  Someone dropped their beer, covering the floor with broken glass.  The bartender handed the customer a rag to clean it up...  Talk about horrible service!  Go anywhere EXCEPT Columbo's on a Friday or Saturday night.

Visiting from SOCAL, cranky people here, except for the amigo in the kitchen, he gave free chips, first time ever my kids had a Bean and Cheese burrito with no fry beans???? When I pay I ask what kind of meat they have and this have tells me "it's right there, ready" wey y mal empleado...

Manager was rude as HELL! I wanted to leave but it's a holiday so I stayed thinking no where else would be open. The young man who did my pedicure was sweet but absolutely the worst massage I've ever gotten at a nail place. Start to finish it was a poor experience. First time coming and I'm not coming back

Racist comment by possible manager wearing grey shirt. Not funny and completely inappropriate. No apologies from her nor the staff who witnessed it. Refused comment card and refused to give her name when asked. You should ALL be ashamed! Disgusting behavior.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: HORRIBLE service.  Will not be using again. Charged us over 700.00 in fees PLUS gas, when we had a full tank at drop off. When we called to complain they basically said it was the intendant's word vs ours.  We usually use them for every vacation but will NOT be using them again.

We stopped there on the way back from dinner. They have a decent amount of options. I got a scoup of blackberry and my wife got bacio. I am not an ice cream person  but I have a decent amount of experience, and in my opinion the ice cream was average. Not great..but not terrible.

National is really easy and reliable, especially if you are an Emerald Club member. The cars are new and clean and prices are competitive. I like being able to choose my rental car when I arrive and when I return it is fast (since I am usually running late!)

The young woman who washed my hair did a fab job. my hair cut.. well now I have to get another better hairdresser.  They really dont know how to cut curly hair. I have a head full of fizzles (probably used the scissors to razor cut bad mistake for curls) . My advice give this salon on sixth a miss.

Fantastic!  Great food, great prices!  Giant portions!   If you are looking for a trendy chain location this is not the place, but.... if you are looking for quality authentic Mexican food this is where it's at!  Bright atmosphere and pleasant experience, this place is sure to satisfy your hunger :)

My family and I have stayed at this location several times and every time was amazing the service is phenomenal .Jayda has really made or stay a great time. She blew me away with her warming personality and kind heart . I look forward to staying here and seeing their beautiful faces !
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I have been going the Artist Haus for about five years. H get cut and color. I always get what I want and the staff really takes the care and time to listen to what you want and even help advise in color and cut suggestions. The atmosphere is fun and light. Highly recommend!

My mom just made me aware that a bit ago this place charged her twice and did not refund her. She was told she had to go print out proof that she was charged twice and come back. She ended up just calling her credit card company and they took it off for her.

Extremely overpriced, had acrylics putt on. Anywhere else I've ever went made them look natural, and real. When I was finished I left looked st my nails, and almost cried they looked so fake, and bad. The girl that was doing my nails was very polite, but the rest of the staff was staring at me like I didn't belong.

I went in to get a gel manicure, and the appointment was fine. Their prices are reasonable, have friendly staff, and they shaped my nails exactly how I wished. The only problem was the days that followed; my gel nails chipped after two days!!! The color has faded weirdly, and it is no longer shiney.

I've had nothing but positive experiences at this location. The staff here has always been so kind and pleasant. And the food is just what I order (sometimes I'm picky about no cheese or wanting extra mustard)! Once someone even gave me extra nuggets because I was so excited ordering them.

$12 automatic carwash left water spots on my right window (and probably other places) and some soap on my left rear view mirror. Did not fully remove bird poop from windshield or dirt from rear of vehicle. Used wash - rinse sequence rather than a rinse - wash - rinse that would get dirt off before washing.

This is a really cheap but awesome Italian place. It's fast but the food is so authentic and services great. Would recommend the really big pizza that's the size of the sample on the wall. The pasta are awesome with meatball toppings. The gelato is definitely a plus, mango flavor was my favorite.

Very disappointed...ordered from the slice app to the location .2 miles from our address...the pizza was good but 2 hours for 2 pizzas when were that close is absolutely ridiculous. Called to have them refund our money and they declined to refund ANYTHING. AWFUL CUSTOMER SERVICE!!!

You would think a little place in a strip mall would have mediocre sushi, but this place revels a top spot I've visited in NYC. The atmosphere is cozy and comfortable. The service was perfect. All of our sushi was amazing. We will without a doubt seek this place out again.

Germantown inn was amazing!! The building is charming and modern and also very cozy! The bed was comfortable and the bathroom was very updated with all the needed amenities--toiletries better than typical hotel amenities. The owner was also very helpful and welcoming and offered a delicious breakfast!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Big mistake coming here. I do not recommend this Avid rental car location. I have been here for over an hour. I would tell you the whole story, but I'll save you the misery. The people are nice, but the organization is all over the place. It's also pretty dirty.

This place was not only delicious but the service was stellar. Our waiter took time out of his day to tell us everything cool going on around town and made our experience so fun and enjoyable. Would recommend this place to anyone! Hot shot was really cool, told me he owned the place and could hook me up anytime!

Bit of a let down. Website said open til 9pm -Drove a bit to get there and walked in at 7:45 pm and was told the milkshakes were already put away for the night...!  The employee seemed a bit put out.  Last time I checked, the only ingredients in a milkshake were milk and ice cream.... bummer.

I rarely write reviews, but the customer service I received from Katherine today at the drive thru was the best I've received in a very long time. It took a little longer than usual to make a drink I had ordered, but she was so kind and friendly I didn't mind the wait.

I'm so disappointed that Ralph's has this digital coupon app...I'm exhausted that everything has to be downloaded to my phone in order to get a discount! What about the elderly that do not understand it? So they aren't entitled? I will never shop there again!

If you believe salads should be fresh and light then the bliefiot and kobucha salad at Nobel American is not the way to go.  The salad was blasted in goat cheese  dressing, it was difficult to discern the taste of the wild mushrooms.  The antelope leg was a saving grace though the arctic char was as dry as the Sahara.

I order from walts itleast once a week at work and everything on their menu I have had so far has been amazing. LOVE their steak fries the most. Fast delivery. Only bad thing I have to say are the people answering the phones have been rude every single time we make a call, and different people call also and say the same thing.

So I got a quote from Dave, he quoted me 4 hours at basically $110 per hour...   I asked him how he figured 4 hours do to the fact that if I had the proper tools it would take me about 35 minutes per side...  Brought my vehicle to another place, and they charged me 1/2 and are done already.   4 hours.   Pfff okay Dave.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Other than the very LOUD ghetto ratchetness of the wait staff, the food is great. Staff acts as if they're at home instead of work. Cursing loudly and being very inappropriate with one another with no respect for patrons. If you're down with that kind of behavior you'll feel right a home.

Food was very good but service was less than adequate. I guess not enough  staff working. Great homemade chips with special dip. Good steak sandwich. Problem was getting silverware and refills on drinks. Been here many times worth going to but just a hiccup this time.

In & Out, YUMM!!! The burgers here are so ridiculously amazing! The ingredients are fresh, the restaurant is nice and clean, and the location of this place is awesome.  Animal style burgers are made on point here.  Every time I get a chance to go to In&Out, I make every effort possible!

I had a free oil change after several years and a change of ownership. Sean, the new owner, honored the stamp card and was honest about his desire to get my return business.

I have returned only a few weeks later to get my wife's car done. They do a great job, and are fast and friendly.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I'm from San Diego and I have never seen a more dirtier gym! Machines were filthy,
mirrors were so smeared, and the layout of this gym is confusing. Although I got my workouts in, if I lived here, I would not attend this gym regularly. Where is your cleaning crew?
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: If your looking reeeeeally good Authentic Mexican food, this is the place to come. I'm live in Oxnard and trust me this place is worth the drive. This is my mine and my wife's second time here, and this place is so good and the workers are very friendly. A must place to come to.

Having a terrible experience with Thrifty located in Tampa intl airport right now.
Rental ran for 3 days, returned the car on 4/1 , they still haven't closed the contract and are still charging my cc on a daily basis !
I have phoned, left 5 messages, spoke with 4 individuals all to no avail !!
Frustrating to say the least

I was visiting my in laws for a funeral and needed a place to get a haircut.  I found this location to be very professional and very reasonable in price. Starting at $15 for cut. They did a wonderful job cutting my hair,  including neck and side burn shave finishing with a trim of my eyebrows.  overall was an excellent experience

Great service and great food. Probably the only restaurant in Isla Vista with this kind of service. I have tried every single dishes and I have never had something to complained about. They also have a really good Wine list, and everything is sold for a fair price! I recommend it

I'm pregnant and was craving donuts really bad one night  so I looked up a Dunkin that was open and this specific location said open till 11pm. I drive 15 min to get there and it's closed. Please please just change your hours if you're not gonna be open. Even when I got there it said you were open.

(1) order took 15 minutes longer than promised. 
(2) pizza was supposed to be mozzarella and provel.
      - 2nd time this has happened
(3) asked for ranch
(4) where's the Italian dressing?


Not coming back. Drive the extra 10 minutes to a better franchise location.

Sarra has been doing my hair for many many years! She listens to what you want, and then she gets it done, while making sure to keep the integrity of your hair! I get compliments on the color of my hair all the time, and every time, I tell them my girl is a magician! Spend some time in Sarra's Chair! You will not be disappointed!!

I know it is subway but the sandwich was made to perfection. I had an Italian BMT and my daughter had a chicken bacon ranch sandwich. Both were delicious. I'm going back to this location which is better than some of the other locations I've been to. Staff was friendly.

Very nice new updated decor in an older building. The staff was very nice and the place was well kept.  The walls were very thin so we heard people in the hallways very easily.  The bathrooms were small, but that is to be expected from an older hotel.  Close walk to the excitement downtown.  Overall fit our needs at a good price.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Supercuts and all the stylists at at this location have enough business these days that they have no issue turning people away. Walked into an empty store at around 1pm. One person working and one person having their hair cut. Was told that although the shop was basically empty that they would not be able to serve me today.

I really wanted to like this place, but the food was just mediocre. Every roll had way too much crab, and the miso soup was spicy. The menus were really dirty and sticky, and the place just felt a little run down. The service was just ok as well. Sorry to be a downer, just my personal opinion.

I ordered the tiramisu this evening and was very disappointed when it was made with cream cheese?! It left a very sour/tangy taste. Never had I had tiramisu with cream cheese. I see that their desserts are made by another vendor but I wished they selected a classic version instead. Otherwise my pizza and wings were decent.

I've been bringing my shirts / suits to this place for more than a year - always impeccable, timely, and reasonably priced. Awesome customer service - I'm often tight on schedule as I travel a lot, but I've always got my stuff back on time (and the owner even follows up with me on my cell on a regular basis!)
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I wish this place didn't have the best nail technicians because their customer service is awful. I'm constantly told it will be a 45-min to a hour wait and it is actually a 2-3 hour wait. And the front desk people are so rude. Been going here for 3 years and I'm strongly considering stopping all together

I ran in here during the riot today and they kept me safe and have been offering complimentary cocktails. I'm not even a guest here. Honestly they wouldn't even let me leave for my safety. The bartender Dominique has been fantastic and made me laugh when I was a bit shooken up. Thanks for the hospitality!!!

text: Not a good stay. Terrible hotel. Stay some where else! Elevator was broken, had to use the service elevator. Restaurant and bar were both closed. Fitness center and pool were under construction. Room was almost 85 degrees when we got there. Staff was friendly and it was a good location.
