text:
Great brand new hotel located in one of Philly's best neighborhoods! Hotel staff were wonderful and very attentive. My room was clean (NO bedbugs!) and decently sized with plenty of counter/storage space. The hotel was doing a great job following COVID-19 safety guidelines. 

I'll definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Art City Vets has been taking care of our little dog for 3 years now, and we could not feel better about the care she receives.  They are so responsive to all of our questions and concerns, and you can tell that every doctor and employee truly cares about the animals they serve.

Wayyyy too expensive for the food offered here... Tastes like a bunch of frozen ingredients slapped together and the service is cold... Staff treats you like a burden... I prefer NYPD, nicer staff and more authentic tasting food... I'm from Queens NY so I've had the real thing...

We visited the Burger King at 247 Main Street, Hendersonville, TN on 12/22/2016, and my grand-daughter found a hair in her burger.  They said they would make her another burger.  We declined.  Needless to say, we did not finish our meals.  Would definitely NOT recommend this Burger King.

It's a hidden gem tucked between the restaurant bar and restaurant. No signs except for a white arrow on the ground pointing downstairs to the bar. 

It's a long dark bar and the two drinks we had were delicious during our bar hop adventure. So glad we found this place!

Absolutely the best rental car experience!
The agent (young man) accommodated us when we returned a car from another location with mechanical issues, he gave us an upgrade due to the inconvenience and provided the best customer service ever. I recommend this location highly!

My experience with National Car Rental was the best I have ever had. Service was swift and professional. As an Emerald member, things were certainly expedited and the vehicle I chose was the vehicle I wanted. Thank you National for another awesome experience.

Here visiting from Atlanta and there are no public bathrooms. This manager claims it's because of COVID but the employees encountering customers all day are walking in and out 711 across the street says they don't have restrooms at all which has to be illegal and a lie
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Terrific little gem! Bread plate was amazing and featured a terrific selection of fresh local flavors. Burrata cheese place was delicious. Also had the margarita pizza, Caesar salad and mussels. Dessert was buttermilk peach pound cake. Yum! All delicious. Love that it's a BYOB! Can't wait to come back.

Really enjoyed my experience here they are a little harsh with the heat but if you have 4C hair like Minds you'll be able to continue to come here at least every six months. They are a cash-only establishment which is cool with me as long as you know ahead of time.

Service was horrible, food was so-so, the calamari tasted as if it was fresh from Publix freezer, had to ask for lemon. Roasted duck was good but the sweet potatoes were too sugary and blended in with the asparagus-we hardly ate any of it. Tries to be pretentious but completely low-level. Better to eat elsewhere.

Stopped by here on our way through the Public Market. Delicious! We got one scoop of the guava cheesecake and one scoop of coffee flavor - would highly recommend either one. Each came with a piece of waffle cone. A bit pricey for 1 scoop of ice cream coming out to $5+ per scoop, but they're big scoops!

So it's okay for people to be cackling and yelling in the hallway for at least 20 minutes, but I play my music at a reasonable level and it's a huge deal? Seems like prejudicial bullshit tbh. Fuck this hotel. Don't stay here if you expect to be treated equally. It's cheap af for a reason.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I have been there before but today t he service was horrible, one waiter. He never came over to see if we needed refills. They had no potato chips so they gave us fries. Skimpy portion. There were several items on the menu that they didn't have. Bathroom also was filthy. Not sure if I will be going back there after today

You always need to examine every inch of the car taken or else they will hit you with minor damage when you return. Check your cars thoroughly before taken out or the garage. Other than that,vibe service and employees are very attentive and always looking to help you if needed.

Excellent customer service! I use this cleaners weekly, and I'm very happy. They take the upmost care with my garments they treat me like a king. I'm very happy. Definitely will recommend this cleaner to my friends. I have been using this cleaner for 5 years
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
We were disappointed in Rotary Sushi yesterday for dinner because the moving belt had very few selections to offer to the 8 customers seated but what we did have was pretty good.  Could order from a menu but chose not to.  Nothing special based on orher belt sudhi Restaurants we have tried. 
Would probably not go back again.

I have gotten bad Cesar salads on two separate occasions from this place. The first was filled with bad lettuce and the second also had bad lettuce and was covered in mayo - Not Cesar dressing. I love nothing more than to waste my lunch break picking up food that I cannot eat.

We moved nearby 3 years ago and like the pizza and especially the penne pasta in vodka sauce with chicken and broccoli. One serving is big enough for my husband and I.  I would give 4 stars but when we get delivery rather than pick up something is usually missing.

I love this place my friend introduced me to it and I have never had any issues. The waitresses are so awesome and the sushi is the best. My favorite of course is the spicy tuna hand roll. I have never had a bad experience and believe me we go in there a lot ;) thanks Sushi ten for the great experience every time.

I love Dunkin but the service at this location is hit or miss. I have had some days (usually weekends) when it moves quickly but other days when I'll wait 10 minutes and not even order yet. All of the behind the counter opening tasks should be done before they open, leaving their main focus on serving customers during open hours.

Slow. Terrible customer service. Definitely dont follow health standards unless putting your hands on a cup and scooping ice with the cup is ok. Run out of atuff often. Dont waste your time going here! Ive given many chances and Im now done. I will drive 10 minites out of my way to the one on Sheldon.

These guys are very Cordial. They except your request for art or design without any problems. They have swatches of colors. The nail tech that did mine was very meticulous and concerned with the end product, very nice place to go. Not a bad place to go and it's affordable.

Consistently good food, friendly staff. My only complaint is that when you call in an order and they say 20 minutes it should be 20 mins until your food is ready. If it is going to be 40 minutes let me know. Twice now in the span of two months I have shown up 5 minutes later than told and had to wait for an additional 45 minutes.

It was time for a new clutch for my 17 year old Miata. The throw out bearing was making noises as well. On the phone, Danny sounded a lot more confident in the job than a local transmission shop did. I realize manual transmissions are becoming a rarity. Just drove the car to work and it is great!  Thanks guys.

They treated us horribly. We were the only brown and black faces in the place. The waitress never refilled my water. Yet refilled the waters of all the surrounded tables with white faces. Clearly for them having a brown faces equates to giving us bad service. I will NEVER come back.

It was very good. We had a Caesar salad, fried raviolis, shrimp appetizer, and a club sandwich, all which were very good. The food was tasty and well prepared (I'm picky) but it was a little slow, but not too bad. I would recommend. I also didn't stay at the hotel but the location is good and it's close to the ballpark and arch.

Great veterinary care here.  We just lost our beloved 13 year old Boston Terrier, and the care she received, the compassion, the help....  all of this was professionally handled.  The quality of her last year with us was made much better because of excellent vet care.

Fake!! Do not go here!! They rip you off completely. I went to get a gel nail polish change. They charged me $20 and when I came home and washed my hands with soap and water the nail polish started peeling off!! That is not how gel nail polish works!! do not go here.

Made reservations for 8PM on a Saturday night walked in and seated right away with no problem. After a 1/2 hour nobody came to our table and it wasn't that busy at all, so we got up and left. Really you have to wait a 1/2 hour for someone to say hey what would like.

I'm so disappointed by the unprofessional behavior. I had an appointment scheduled and when I arrived they had a sign saying they were closed due to a power outage. They didn't call or even post to their social media about it. They completely wasted my tone. Horrible business. Definitely avoid!

The past few times I've been into this mcdonalds I've had the same crew member on front counter and he always seems frazzled or overwhelmed and hardly gets the order right  and he'll just walk away.... I've just been very underwhelmed and this past time I just walked out and went to a different one (this was at 1pm)
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: First time here and its my last. Employee was nice but the ice cream not so great. I had the vanilla cookie dough yo yo and man. That ice cream was super melted like a shake. The store employees are always helpful. I like that they always have multiple check out lanes for quick service. There are always employees walking around to ensure you are finding everything you are looking for. Their new clothing and furniture area is a plus because they have a variety of items to choose from.

So I go to planet fitness and I'm waiting on a tanning bed, I was the next in line, clearing signed in right after this girl. text: First visit here for me.. From the start the ladies at the counter were genuinely friendly. Food came out fast and delicious. Inside and out tables. It is in a strip mall. She even checks up on the tables offering more chips or Togo boxes. All thumbs up!:) mandatory post surf !!

On a layover I had the Urban Chestnut Wingnut and a seasonal coffee stout. There were OK, but not as good as I would expect for craft brews. I didn't get food because it seemed a little spendy for what you get. I'll probably go back if I fly through Lambert-St Louis Airport.

Perfect! Super clean, super nice hotel. The shuttle even picked us up from the car rental drop-off site the evening we arrived and took us to the airport super early the next morning. Both shuttle drivers were very nice. Every staff person we encountered was happy to do their jobs. I would definitely stay here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Great car selection - love the "aisle" where I can select my own. All of the options were new models, the Chevy Malibu I selected had all the luxury features, it was great to be able to use the usb port to charge my iphone AND listen to my own music.

Pickup and return was easy and professional, will definitely be back

A few years ago, my mother and I visited the old Dunkin Donuts Location in Collegeville. We had used the restroom and the next tine we visited the location, they said we could not use the restroom because we "took too long". How do you define taking too long in a restroom?

When you make a detour from Jackson MS  on our way to Mobile AL just to eat here- you know it has to be superb. Tony greeted me at the door and said Welcome Back Bunny and sat me at the where Mother and daughter team Darlana and Chloe chat with while waiting for the BEST ITALIAN in NO!

Best pizza in New Orleans. ALWAYS GOOD! 
Every now and then they have Chicken Marsala with homemade gnocchi that is pan seared and served with wonderful green beans. I wish this dish was a permanent menu item. Every time I think of this dish my mouth waters. Treat yourself soon.

The wife and I wanted to find true Mexican food and I have to say that we have truly found that. We make it there at least once a week at and the staff is very helpful, we like to try new things on the menu and everything that has been suggested has been awesome

I took my F-150 in this morning. I did the $14 wash
There are many spots on the truck that were never touched. It still is dirty. Plus now has spots so bad I have to rub the Crome out to get the spots off. Do not go here it is not a good car wash. 
Also I called a few time and there is no answer.

The service here is great. I've been there 2 times and the workers are very nice. Unfortunately I would not recommend the gel manicures. I saw previous posts about this but decided to test it out myself. My nails came out botchy and frankly I'm disappointed. The other services have been great though.

Carried out the 7" Chicago style deep dish pepperoni pizza. It was one of the best choices of my life. From the first bite you could tell the quality of ingredients that went into making this pizza. I've never written a review before but after eating this pizza I had to write one. Highly recommend this restaurant.

Lobby & room are cool.  We got a King bed room . Chair is not comfortable. Bed is okay. Pillow out of cover. Bed fitted sheet was reversed. Bathroom sink is loud at night. Different experience with other four stars hotel. Location is good. Near liberty Bell. About 15mins walk to shopping center, Chinatown & terminal reading
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have an appointment there Wednesday afternoon and it was wonderful. The doctor was very nice and actually talked to me about my eyes. When I was having a difficult choice picking out glasses the lady helped me out. They are all so nice there and make you feel welcomed. If you live in the area I would get your eye care here.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Terrible service from the overall company. They make it very difficult to cancel membership. You have to do it from the gym or online and process took me 2 weeks including 3 hours on the phone. categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I was in the area from 2 hrs away. Decided to stop by before I got back on the road. With more than 2 hours remaining they said they had no time for me. All I asked for was a pedi and eyebrow. Also it is expected that the ship smell like chemicals but this was way too strong.

When you go to Dunkin Donuts, one would expect Donuts ... not the case here. We ordered coffee and a dozen donuts. We were told there were no donuts. As we pulled off, we saw the racks full of donuts and muffins ... hmmmm STAY AWAY!!!!!! Wish I could give this location negative stars.

The bathroom was disgusting! If an establishment will allow their bathroom to present in this way who knows what lurks behind closed doors?!? When we alerted the staff to the issue, they said, " oh it should be out of order", but there was no sign. Very disappointing!

I called inquiring about a price estimate and had the pleasure of talking to Bobby. He helped me and I was glad to come in and have my vehicle looked at.  Him and the rest of the crew took amazing care of both myself and my vehicle. Will definitely be coming back for my future tire services.

text: Went there for dinner and I must say I was highly disappointed. Our waiter who was also the bartender was not attentive in taking our drink orders, dinner order, or refilling our drinks. I would've given a better review if at every appointment I didn't have to wait 30 + minutes after my appointment time. It seems they are always behind , and I suggest they schedule according to what they can handle in a timely matter. Dr Green is great though

Scum. The lady working the counter told us our car that we reserved was a midsize (which we paid for...) then tried to give us this tiny little car. Had to argue with the manager show them our reservation then go back and forth fighting between the counter upstairs and downstairs. Scum bags

We were given a reco for this diner from the local hotel we were staying, and we are so glad we visited. The staff was friendly and welcoming, the food was simple and tasty. It was impressive to see young people with a work ethic too! If we are in the area again, we will definitely visit!

Food was great as usual. Was just disappointed as I ordered 3 meals and queso for takeout and only received one small bag of chips and a small sauce cup of salsa to share with 3. The queso I paid $3.99 came in a small sauce cup, I felt like it would have been more if we dined in. Enjoyed the food anyway.

After misdiagnosing my truck I finally got the right part for them to install only for them to install it in correctly. When I took the truck back for them to reinstall the part correctly they charged me an additional fee for their mistake. Would not recommend them to anyone if you want the work done correctly

This is my go to sushi spot but lately it's horrible!!! I placed an order and told it'll be done it 20 mins but when I got there 25 mins later and my order wasn't done. They didn't have the sushi and didn't bother to call me back that they didn't until I got there. NEVER AGAIN

The service wasn't the best. They ran out of ice. The coke was flat. No chips were served as a complimentary. Bathroom was dirty (like really dirty). But the food??? Delicious! Carnitas burrito was generous on the meat. Recommend order to go. Don't stay and eat

I do not recommend this location to consumers.  I ordered and payed for extra sauce and extra cheese. What I got was light sauce and light/missing cheese.  They delivered a pizza to me that had bare/bald patches.  I will not order food from this location again as Papa John's quality has gone way down hill.

Amazing! Seriously such a good atmosphere and the food and drinks match.  One of the best happy hours in New Orleans and the sliders are insane.  Im not even a pimento cheese girl but damn I ordered two.  Highly recommend! Good for a date or a group, good for lunch or dinner, all around fan.

I checked out of this hotel on 9/6. They charged my card an additional deposit of $153 on 9/8. This place is beyond horrible. They do not answer phone at the front desk and the man opened my room door without knocking because they have master key!  Place needs to be shut down

text:
Great hotel! We booked this last minute and was able to grab a nice room on the very first floor. Front desk people were very nice and accommodating to us and our 9 month old.

Very spacious, nice and comfortable king sized bed including a nice folded out couch.

I would definitely book a there again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Everyone was super friendly but extremely helpful.  Food was upscale but not overly fancy and servings were quite generous. Prices were reasonable for the quality of everything.  All around great evening.  

Don't forget to byob.  But if you do there is a state store near by!  Experience....

Multi billion dollar company and they don't have fitted sheets on the bed but use a flat she tucked under. Many higher end hotels do this  same thing. Why!! This doesn't stay tucked in never!! 
Friendly staff though. Never ate in restyle used any other service, just a sleeping day room.

text: Pleasant waitstaff. Charming ambience. The service was extremely slow and the portions were stingy except for the pasta dishes. Bread was replenished frequently to make up for the lack of food. Cauliflower was the only vegetable served. Pleasantly disappointing.

This is the worst mcDonalds I've ever been too. Slowest service. Employees do not care at all about their job, how they do it or the customers. It appears unclean and unkempt. All we ordered is Diet Coke and we got regular Coke. And that took 20 minutes. Really, pass on this one.

text:
Per others' experiences, it was the only place open that would deliver, but rather than the 45 minutes they said it would take, after multiple calls my food showed up 2 hours later. I sent the guy away. Horrendous customer service. They didn't apologize, just said they "got slammed." 
Stay away.

My hair is always on point after getting it done.  The stylist/owner takes her time and makes sure that your hair gets the care that it needs.  There is definitely a language barrier but but despite that she knows what she's doing!!!   She'll smile while keeping your hair styled!

Best place to get nails done in tucson. Friendly staff and a great atmosphere. Awesome deals daily and come here often enough they greet you by name. Best place to get shelack (if I spelled that right) free water when you walk in the door. Peter is great at doing his job!

I know that the hospitality industry has been hurt badly by COVID, but I would expect those who still support the business to be treated, if not well, at least fairly. Check iout the "breakfast bag" I was  given this morning, as the alternative to the unavailable regular breakfast.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: You will not be able to find parking lot at nights or weekends. Gate always broke. We want to turn the keys in early but they said we can't-have to wait til on that day. Real silly. We had to wait for two weeks to turn keys in.  Don't expect the full security deposit back as they will charge you for final pest control, etc.

Went for an eyebrow wax. Wax was too hot and burned my eye lid. Next few days my eyelid were red and tender. I stopped by and told the woman in charge what had happened. She offered to put cream on it! No offer of refund. I will never go back there and want others to be cautious of the temperature of the wax.

WARNING WARNING....This is not a barbetshop...i got a haircut their and it brought tears to my eyes. Another hairstylelist tried to fix it but to no avail. Very disrespectful people working here..i think they be drunk as they sit around and guve out berr to their customers...DO NOT GO TO THIS PLACE..WSRNING

I LOVE this place! I always get the very best glasses and the very best help at Modern Eyes Optical! Very stylish glasses and people who really care. They really work with you to make sure you are satisfied (and even help you pick the right frames for your face!) What else would someone want from a business?
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I've been to this location three times out of sheer convenience.Shame on me.This is the worst Dunkin' Donuts in the area.Avoid this one like the pandemic.Horrible service at this location.Can never get your order correct.The supervision is young and clueless.

Went through the drive through,  they forgot part of the order.  So I unloaded three kids and took them in to get it.  Manager at the front did so much as say hello or sorry we messed up.  Nothing.  Every garbage is overflowing,  there was not a single napkin in the place, nothing restocked and no clean tables.  Disgusting.

Worst Chinese food I have EVER had! Ordered seafood dish and it was mostly broccoli. So I paid 13.00 for imitation crab and broccoli.   My daughter had chicken and broccoli and it was so small m that a 2 year old couldn't get full from it.  I will never order from here again

I have been going to APEX for almost 2 years and have had most all of the manicurists service me at one time or another.  I think My is my favorite, but I really like them all. They are very clean and do a very good job at a reasonable price.  I am happy to recommend them.

Just discovered this little gem of a place.  The decor is a little on the dated side, but the food was excellent.  Probably the freshest fish I have ever had at a sushi bar.  The staff was helpful and friendly.  The prices were reasonable.  I will definitely return.

My husband and I have been living in Cinnaminson for 5 years and couldn't find a pizza spot that had good pizza AND wings (not those frozen wing zings.. yuck!) I stumbled upon Nick's pizza and I'm glad we tried them! The Brooklyn pizza was delicious and I really like their wings. Good job, Nicks!

The food was a 4 star but the service was a weak 2 star. Every server was rude and acted like they were inconvenienced to wait on our table. Close to 30 minutes to take our food order and then 1.5 hours to receive our entree. No steak is that good. Sometimes trendy is a definite no go.

Great little location that functions also as a Baskin Robbins. I do wish they played something a bit more kid friendly on the TV. All the tables were dirty too and they were so busy no one was tending to the dining room. The employees were very nice and smiley. The ice cream of course was delicious.

Fortune Cookie is AMAZING! I haven't been disappointed yet. Delicious and authentic Chinese cuisine for a great price? Yes, please! Dining in is clean and casual and delivery is fast and prompt. I suggest the Shrimp Lo Mein and Orange Chicken! Don't forget the Fried Wontons and Hot and Sour Soup! Scrumptious!

I got the riesling poached pear sorbet and the wildberry lavender and together they made the PERFECT pair! The pear sorbet is packed with flavor and tastes just like a fresh juicy pear and the wildberry lavender was so aromatic and creamy! Would highly recommend to anyone.

When I made reservations, I asked for a smoking room! She said Ok! Only 1 room in the whole motel is smoking!

The TV is new flat screen but the picture is 1980's tube quality! 

The room is spacious and the AC works! For the price, it should be a better quality! I only stay at Motel 6 ever! I usually get a better experience!

text: This place sucks, they need to have respect for there customers when they have there kids in there  hands and stop trying to fight them with there kids in there arms. They took an hour and eleven minutes to arrive on a 45 minute estimate. They refuse to deliver at my girlfriend's ever again because I wrote the time it took for our meal. I hope they revise the way they handle their orders and grow some brains for running a business.

Idk why this place is up and running. Worst employees ever, young man on headset ranting about life ain't fair and cursing a storm. I get it not in the best spot of the city, make a change. Add some decent people to the staff man, I'm sure there's others dying for their jobs.

Beautiful Hotel, amazing bed! We had two rooms both had issues with the shower. I couldn't get mine to work at all. The other room had issues with the temperature control you either had super hot or freezing cold water.

text:
As an Avis preferred member this is the worst location. Pick up is horrible, drop off is only one person working and the staff simply doesn't care. 
Shuttle service to airport is slow and after asking still no shuttle after 20 minutes. 

Stay away from this location and spend your money somewhere else.

Amazing!!  From the wine to the chips and salsa to the brisket tacos and must try elotes loco!  Everything about this is fresh mex and a foodie dream:). I live in south Florida and would literally fly to fort Washington for another meal here.  Absolutely fabulous!!!

What a wonderful find. Cauliflower Crust for pizza and it was delicious!! Salad was also very fresh and tasty.  Staff was wonderful - Tyler was very friendly and went out of his way to make sure we had everything we needed. Wish I could go again before heading north!!

Excellent acrylic nails done by Kim herself. She was open to looking at photos I had of nails I liked a recreated a set almost perfectly ! Her technique is excellent, prices are good, the atmosphere in the building is fun, and the experience was excellent. Would recommend for anyone who loves gorgeous nails.

Ordered salads for delivery.  Chef salad came with NO meat on it.  Iceberg lettuce was all core and not green leafy.  Definitely not as described on the menu. Greek salad was made with iceberg lettuce also all core and not green leafy. Breadsticks were good.

we were traveling from Panama City beach fla to Ohio and saw great reviews on this place. We stopped here to eat and it was fantastic the employees were great with my two boys joking around with them, the food was amazing! The prices were great and I highly recommend it even if your just passing through its a must stop.

The Best Cadillac margarita in town!
Good Service with a friendly staff. 
The steak chimichanga is awesome and there is always enough left over for lunch the next day. The chips are hot & tasty.
I am a local. Mariachis has been my favorite  Mexican restaurant for years.

Was disappointing experience.
Customer service was horrible,
Food was half cooked(Breakfast)was like the pick up off the floor.
Dining area smelled like sour,unclean water,dirty mop.
All Trash cans were full.
When we ordered they were out of most breakfast options.
Unfortunately Burger King is no longer the King

Went to the drive through at 11:45pm. I sat at the drive through screen for 5 minutes only to be told I needed to drove up to the second window to order. When I got there they took my order, the receipt would not print. Then I hear the employees using the n work over and over. Food was fine but terrible customer service.

text: Horrible! My son wanted to try the Travis Scott Burger. They gave him an uncooked Burger I didn't notice until I looked to see what was so special about this burger! I instantly got disgusted! The supervisor didn't wanna give me a refund! The drive thru Worked laughed like it was funny! Absolutely unacceptable
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Had the half rack of ribs with Mac and cheese, fries and onion rings.  Not much flavor in the ribs where there was no sauce. Not bad just not special. I suggest asking for extra sauce.  But value was good. Service was attentive.  I'd try something else next time I'm there to see if it will be better.

I've been going here since high school (not to age me, but almost 10 years) and it's the best place I've found. They offer great service, the lowest prices and do the job of a perfectionist! I love going here and seeing all of their smiling faces. I moved now but will still travel here to get my nails done.

Leave it be said, my personal recommendation is to avoid this place, I posted a truthful review about their practices and they had a lawyer contact me lol.  This place is a joke and the owner is very rude and the most unprofessional business owner I have ever met.  But go ahead, take your vehicle there and form your own opinion lol

Recently moved to Boise from Seattle.  My wife is asian and was in search of some chinese food.  I have to say this is the worst Chinese food, I have ever had.  Its not authentic which normally does not bother me the food is just gross.  

I will never eat here again.

Well waited for more than 15 min at sidewalk for shuttle. Very cold Day!!   Avis here clearly doesn't give a care about service. Consider going elsewhere.  This is the second time shoddy service at Avis in St Louis.   Certainly not what I expect from a premium service. And yes we do pay a premium at Avis.

Definitely one of the worst Dunkin experiences I've had. I never write these reviews like ever, but I've tried time and time again to go back here and hope for better service, but they're always unfriendly and quality of food and coffee is either always wrong or just not great.

This place everything on my shopping list for cooking Korean and Japanese food. It even had a specific Vietnamese fish sauce I had been searching for for ages.
They have a small but always fresh produce section. Owners are very nice and speak Korean and English.

Overall, love this place and no complaints!

Food was good, but service sucked. It took us 2 hours to get our main entree, even with a reservation; people who came in way after us that were served and done before we got our meal. We won't be back. They took no accountability for their crummy service.

Very good pizza spot in Montecito. Wood fired pizza with yummy cheese and my favorite little pepperonis that pop up when they are baked. The pizza is charred and could be considered burnt by some but it's just the way I like it. It's delicious and definitely a place I make sure to visit when I'm in town

III Illianos is my favorite pizza place hands down. My family has been coming here for over 20 years (no exaggeration) and couldn't love it more. The sauce is flavorful, the crust is fluffy but not too thick, and it's always consistent. The owners make us feel like family, and make some damn good pizza.

Very mediocre sushi. I guess I'm spoiled living in northern California. It's too bad I was taking my friend who hadn't eaten much sushi. It was pretty bland and not much of an introduction to sushi for them! The fish had a strange soft texture that seemed as if it was not very fresh.

This is the cleanest gym I've ever been to they are continually cleaning the entire day. I guarantee it's cleaner than what the state classifies as an "essential" business. And since when is not taking care of yourself (exercising) essential. Keep up the good fight GG you're more appreciated then you'll ever know!!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I understand that they are understaffed and the reasons.
We had lunch there last weekend Three of the four lunches were good. My lunch was inedible I ordered grilled Italian sausages with sautéed spinach and polenta. Only the spinach was edible No one came to see if we were happy with our meals.

This hotel was fabulous! The room was modern and stylish! Comfy beds! Nice view! Courteous and Fast service!  All was great except parking was expensive and when I arrived they didn't have any more guest parking, resulting in a difficult drive all around the area to try and find somewhere to park for the night.

text: Horrible service. Ordered on the app and came to find my order missing. No apologies whatsoever. In fact, the barista acted like it was my fault that my order wasn't there. Not sure what's up with your attitude. But if you were going to treat people this way, then maybe you don't belong here in the first place.

One word: RUDE. I pull up after letting them know I did an app order and before I even get the chance to reach for the drink, it's shoved in my face. Then I thought he was going to just chuck the straw into the car through the window. Is this really how Dunkin trains their employees?

Pizza is very good. Unfortunately the only salads they offer are huge (way too much even for two people) and all contain meat. It would be nice if they offered a smaller salad instead of one that's only appropriate for a large group. It would also be nice to see some healthier and vegetarian options available.

Great authentic Mexican food!! Just moved to the area and never been disappointed. Staff is always so friendly. Highly recommend the super alpastor burrito, along with their street tacos. And can't forget about the amazing flan for dessert. This is my new favorite piece to eat.

These guys CANNOT fade to save their lives. You'll physically be able to see the steps on the side of your head from the different length attachments used. They also do no trim work around the ear or back of the neck. Awful work!!! Luckily I have clippers and was able to make myself presentable until I could get to another barber.

Asked for a particular drink, when made it was done wrong. Watched the whole process. Asked the supposed barista if the drink was made a certain way, they totally lied ro my face. Called them on it, and received total attitude. Unfortunately,  this isn't the first time. Worst Starbucks I've been too.

Worst Mexican food ever!  Yelp failed me.  The fajita meat was boiled with no flavor.  The rice was bland, even the beans were bland.  Having grown up in South Texas may mean I have higher standards for Mexican food.  Even Chipotle is more authentic than this place.

Pretty clean and staff were super friendly and nice. Super FAR from ANYTHING to do though. That sucked. Free wifi in the lobby though and continental breakfast in the morning. Over all, it served it's purpose. Aside from Applebee's in the parking lot (which closes at only midnight!!) there is NOWHERE to get a drink or food nearby.

text: Food was good but wait staff was rude. Had to sit inside due to weather, switched out high stools for bar chairs with backs, and after an hour and a half manager came over, took the chairs from us and said they were needed for the bar. We are in our late 60s and 70s, and there was no one waiting for the chairs. Will not be back.

They always mess up my order on drive thru. text: Great hotel at a great price but go out for breakfast. Clean bright hotel with clean comfortable rooms. Friendly helpful staff. text: This is the "go to" place if you want to buy from people that really know their stuff. I've been there several times and have always come away with a great value. Owners are long time locals that really enjoy leading you to the right wine for your occasion. Got a great smooth tequila I've never had before. All good stuff!!

We rented a full size Dodge Charger @ Tampa airport for 8 days for $405.  Seems really high to me.  The car was clean and we got in and out fairly quick.  It was convenient since it was inside the airport.  Lady at the counter tried really hard to 'up-sell' you into someone more expensive....

New Orleans is not what it used to be. The city is trying to drive out the blacks with policy. This hotel purposely gives horrible rooms to black patrons. Also whenever there is a black event in town, the police profile blacks profusely and subject them to searches with dogs.

text: I lived at Concord Village Apartments for 6+ years, and in that time I was treated very well. The staff was courteous, I had great neighbors, and any maintenance requests (the few I had) were handled promptly and thoroughly. I would highly recommend Concord Village Apartments!

ATM NEVER works for cash deposits. I have to use the atm bc I bank with CDC credit union in Atlanta and I'm allowed atm services as a courtesy. However it never works! The ladies inside have said for months a repair ticket has been requested and it's always the same answer "should be fixed in a wk" but it's NEVER fixed

overall enjoyed brunch here! the eggs and bacon were great! the potatoes were good, just way too over seasoned. made it impossible to finish them. the mimosas were great and quite large! the atmosphere is great also! i would definitely try the donuts if i come back!

Love this place, I originally went to their state street location but they closed years ago. I stop every time I'm passing through!
Their wine bread is my favorite ( it's like a wine pound cake) but everything they have is really yummy!!  Definitely don't miss this very simple but amazing gourmet deli and bakery!!

Best nail place to go to. Love this place always feel welcomed. I normally stick to the same person who does my nails.  I never got Andy to do mines because he's always booked up. Luckily he was available on my bday. He did a awesome job!!! Love this place thanks Andy.

This place was pretty good service was kind of slow even though it wasent very crowded food was pretty decent i kind of liked it though   i had chicken quesadillas which were kind of spicey but was very good then i had a angus burger with cheese which was ok overall experience was pretty good.

My wife and I ate here while passing through on our way to Cali. Everyone has always told us to try In and Out when we get to the West Coast. Moving from Florida, we never heard of it. To say the least, all that hype can let you down if the food doesn't live up to it. Fries were good, burgers were nothing special.

Really good place! Great service and delicious sushi. One of my favorite sushi places in Tucson!!! It's very good, and if you are ever in town like me, definitely check it out. It was really busy when I went, but it was still very good service and very fast. Love this place! One of my go-tos.

Bartender was angry I asked for a menu when I sat down. She also lectured my boyfriend about his credit card for like 2 full minutes. Then went back to loudly gossiping to the only other person there. Beer selection was good. However there was lipstick on my glass. This was at 1:36 pm Wednesday the 8th.

Terribly Slow. 30 minutes for a coffee it's unacceptable. They treat you poorly and the drinks are watery down . Drive 5 extra minutes and go to the new one in highway 50 . 
Don't waist your time here.   By the way. Not one nor twice. Every single time it's the same . I'm done !

This is a nasty place to live.!
trust me, bed bugs,roaches,brocken car windows 
cabinets falling apart,a/c sucks, we expend 3 days without air conditioning and they just don't care
all they care about is money

The sushi is good (didn't like the sushi in the cucumber wrap) but the service is pretty bad. Our waitress dropped off our salads (the peanut dressing is the best!) and she didn't bring the right salad dressing. She didn't come back around for another 30 minutes. So disappointing.

Interesting story so bad enough they force you to wear a mask but then some of the servers tell you get out of the way that you're in the way and they're very rude about it the waiter was being nice enough to clear my spot for me and one of the other way he's told me to move and get out of the way they've lost my business for life

By far the worse McDonald's I've ever went to in my life!!! I really didn't know there could be that bad of a mcds in my life!! I usually don't take time to write reviews but wow I was astonished on how bad they were! Will never ever go back to that location EVER!!!!!

text: This place is a joke of a nail salon my nails came out terrible and they wanted to charge me 55 for this? I'm sorry but do not go here they are a rip off and only one girl knew slightly what she was doing. I've never had nails this bad and I didn't even get acrylic that's my nail that she shaved off unevenly.

Is tuna in the tekkamaki roll minced? It is at Jimmy's sushi. To their defense they claim that no one's ever complained but trust me when I say the texture when eating minced tuna roll is not appealing. For the most un-authentic Japanese cuisine, try Jimmy's sushi. Gross.

ICE CREAM PLACE THAT WAS OPEN LATE AND WASNT CROWDED!! the workers were super nice and let us get 1/2 scoops of 2 flavors, even though it's not really an option. the ice cream was pricey but SOOOOO creamy and yummy!! definitely recommend mixing flavors to get the best deal!!

Ordered a big mac. lets just say that was not a pickle in it. i am so concerned because i ate a part of the thing. service is great but maybe they would make a better big mac next time. P.S my child LOVED the chicken mcnuggets with the minion toy and it driving a car over a soapbox.

text: They are requiring masks which I think is great. It's nice to know two years of membership $$ is going somewhere with common sense. Also during the height of quarantine they paused my monthly bill without me even asking. Thanks planet fitness! I will keep supporting.

text: It's difficult to say nice things about a hotel that charges $10 for M&Ms repackaged in a tin in the room, and has 2 nights with cold water only in the shower.
