text: Amazing! So excited that there is a place to eat now. The cauliflower rolls are to die for! Never had something that I wouldn't order again. I usually order a specialty pizza, house salad, and either garlic knots or cauliflower rolls for our family of 4. We eat until stuffed and still have extra pizza for left overs.

Great food and great service - best Sushi we've had in a while!  We were on vacation and had a sushi craving and were not disappointed.  We had salmon, sunshine roll, tempura roll and Cali roll.  Portions were large and food was fresh - Vinh the owner was very nice!

We were greeted with a smile by a friendly employee who offered us free samples. The store was clean and looked well-maintained. Unfortunately, the price of ice cream is absolutely ridiculous. We payed almost $15 for two ice cream cones. Despite living across the street, I doubt we will be back simply due to this reason.

Doesn't deserve even one star. On line waiting for 45 mins. Got to counter. I have a prepaid rental. Half the transaction completed and then my name has been added to a *waiting* list.  Now it has been an hour and I am waiting for the car. Company is totally messed up.

Picked up our Enterprise Rent a Car at the Tampa Airport (TPA), and got the hard sell tactic to buy the added insurance.  They won't take no for an answer .... hate it.     Then I brought the car back to St. Petersburg Airport (PIE) and felt like I got a rectal cavity search to check in the car.   Won't be doing this again.

Who ever runs the shop at night is a bitch, drove passed it and saw someone inside and I know they saw me. So I pull up to the drive thru and they won't respond or anything. I stay for about 7 mins when I finally decided to take off. Check the store online and it's say it's 24hrs they even have a sign outside.... bunch of assholes

Haven't been here in over a year and thought we would give it another try. Very disappointed. Food was bland and overpriced. $17.99 for tilapia dinner which was 3 small tilapia fillets that were overcooked and very bland. Service was rushed and unimpressive. My husband did not enjoy his dinner either.

I enjoy P.C. when I am in FL. However, the last two occasions I went there, none of the staff wear a mask. With our current climate, that is definitely concerning. For someone, with a weakened immune system, this poses a challenge. I have been unable to go and purchase ice cream in over 2 weeks due to this.

This place is awful.  I used to go here when I lived there several years ago and they were great. They charged way to much and cut my nails all the way down. Then an hour after I left they started pealing and breaking. Do not go here. If there were minus stars I would choose that!

We have been to plenty of places nearby, but we wanted to try a place we've never been to. The reviews looked great, but both my fiancée and I got sick from the food.
I wonder if it was just us or if it's the place itself, either way, we will not be returning here.

I like that it's pet friendly but that doesn't mean the place shouldn't be clean. Walking around my socks were full of crumbs and nasty stuff just due to the lack of vacuuming. The shower on the other hand is so gross (see pics). I am in a pet friendly room so the wall is chewed up, doesn't necessarily bother me but not impressed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This place has the best Latin type food in the area... the food is delicious and reasonable... I had them cater two big events for me with over 100 guests and the food was delicious and their count quantity was very generous... both times guests took left overs home!  I would for sure recommend them to anyone.

Jeannette Gallardo

These guys are great.  Called last minute was able to rent a car then I also got an extension.  When I returned the car they gave me a ride home.  Everyone was friendly, courteous and businesslike they made you feel like family.  The whole crew here is happy to provide a service.  Will definitely recommend them to anyone.

This is one of my most favorite places to eat. It is consistently awesome every time we go. We always get the Chicago deep dish pizza, and it rivals any Chicago pizza anywhere. The ingredients are fresh, crust is crisp yet chewy, and the sauce has the perfect amount of tanginess. You can't go wrong here!!

I only ever go to this location because I don't want to get out of the car to get Duncan from the gas station near by. Long wait almost every time, mediocre customer service and my drink tastes off 75% off the time. This place is right across the street but I may start going to wawa instead and placing my order online.

My friend and I got a vanilla latte and an iced almond milk latte and it was outstanding. The cinnamon roll and monkey bread was really good too! The service was very quick and the workers were very nice and welcoming. The atmosphere is great and it's a great place for pictures. I will definitely be coming back.

I love this shop in Montecito! Jason and Brian are great. They offer a wonderful selection of wines, including many organic choices. I was looking for Angeleno California Amaro, which they didn't have at the time, and they ordered a case for me! Always super helpful and friendly, this is a local gem.

Please check on the renovation progress before staying here.  Drilling before 9 in the morning and construction in front of my door preventing me getting back in my room at 4 pm, lead to my asking for a move to the other Courtyard in New Orleans.  Would not stay here again until the renovation is finished.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: One of the worst McDonalds.  Food is typically fine (although they sometimes burn it), but service and cleanliness are terrible.  On several occasions, I have had to wait over 15 minutes to get my food.  Floors and tables are frequently dirty.  Employees and management give the impression of not caring.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Bait and switch. On the phone, Dollar quotes $3.99 per day for a PA EZ Pass for toll roads, but once you show up at the Philly airport they charge $15.99 per day! Plus you still get billed full price for every toll road you use! Many toll roads now won't let you on the road w/o an EX Pass. Rip off at this car rental.

I had dinner last Saturday night. Atmosphere great. Servers polite.
Had the tuna special. Thank goodness the portion was small because around 4am Sunday morning I awoke to terrible food poisoning .
Looking back the tuna didn't look fresh.
Unfortunate, because I can never go back.

The espresso was fabulous, WiFi was fast, and staff was sweet ! Outlets were present which was great because my computer was almost dead, the atmosphere was nice and it provided a wonderful space for me to get some work done! Would come back again and honestly probably will. Thank you. Amen.

This place is hit or miss I use to get rain x and wax but that area of wash does not appear to be lighting up or working it only drips so I no longer purchase this option . I was a member but after speaking to asst. Manger and wax not being fixed I decided to end my membership . I will try somewhere else .

Beautiful property that's extremely well kept. It has tons of amenities that make you not want to ever leave home, especially in a time where most of us are having to work from home. The front office is always welcoming and quick to address any issues that may occur. You can tell they really care about their residents!

Nothing really special. Table was not particularly clean, pizza was ok, but toppings would slide off the crust, so there was a bunch of toppings left in the middle of the tray as we removed slices.  Outdoor seating, but just 6 parking spaces to be shared with another restaurant.

Been going to Westlake Animal Hospital for over 5 years. Bella and Xena love their two vets Dr. HASSEL and Dr.DUNN. They are very compassionate, professional and caring. Bella gets her teeth cleaned every year. Both gets their shots, medications and anything else. The staff has the same attitude and especially during the pandemic.

Delicious,mouth watering perfect little sushi's. The chef is so sweet, staff so kind, server very generous :)) I don't live anywhere near here but I'd drive 30 mins for Yummy sushi and kind service. I love love love love love this place and it's worth the drive ´･･`

Gotta love a brand spanking new hotel that's located next door to one of the best steakhouses I ever had. On top of the great restaurants within walking distance, the high ceilings and freshness of this awesome Hampton makes me as happy as a kid in a ball pit.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I really like this gym. It's incredibly clean place to workout. It never has more than a couple people in there. The owner, Allan, really cares about his members and goes above and beyond to help them in anyway he can! A nice change from the typical overcrowded gym.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This place is fantastic! Cheery staff, helpful & pleasant drivers, great shuttle. I was nervous reading reviews *after* booking, especially during BNI & CMA week. We are very pleased thus far. Apparently the hotel has been updated recently. Will stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Always love going here for get togethers!! i've been going here since i was a child and the servers have watched me grow up! The food is excellent and comes out perfect every time, i've never had to send any food back before. I will always recommend this mexican place to anyone that is in town and lookin for something good!

Great clinic!! Tremendous emergency service on Sunday am by Dr Swisher when our mini pig broke into rodent bait trap/ingested poison-- she even helped lift out the heavy piggy from our car-- we take our 2 minipigs to the clinic for routine care and give them highest recommendations!

I never comment about restaurants but I feel I would be doing a disservice to future clientele if I did not mention that this was the worst Italian food I have ever had.  So much so my husband and I now have a pact that if the appetizers are bad then we should just pay and leave.

Very good decor. Nice collection of tequilas. My food was just slightly above average. The Seafood Enchiladas that I ordered mostly had vegetables with some seafood sprinkled in between. Should've been the other way around. The server could've been a little friendlier, seemed to be in a hurry.

This gym is a joke. I am new in town and was looking to purchase a membership.... As I went in because I saw the 7 day trial on the website to try it out... I was being pushed towards purchasing a week member ship or a full on membership. Didn't honor the 7 day free trial as advertised.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Ordered a vegetarian burrito with double beans instead of rice. The burrito is supposed to include zuchinni, lettuce, tomato, pasilla and bell pepper and cheese. I received only a single serving of beans, no pasilla or bell peppers, and carrots. Plus, the vegetables were not cooked adequately. Very disappointed.

Getting worse as time goes by. Stopped in tonight, yogurt was fine but the toppings were very stale. My wife and I both had Oreos, and they tasted like cleaner. I would be very surprised if this place is open another few months. Don't waste your time going here.

Very unpleasant experience renting car.  All kinds of extras were added and agent was pushy.  I tried to cancel some extras afterwards and was unable to do so.  Probably would not use Thrifty again.  AAA agreement was for $363. including taxes; we ended up paying $544.  I will complain to my credit card company and the AAA too.

This restaurant was a hidden gem!!! The food was outstanding ..plentiful and the best Mexican I've ever had ! The chicken fajita was excellent and enough for two meals! The taco bowl was fried to perfection and filled up to the top! The guacamole was outstanding with light airy chips! Hidden away in a little strip of stores... YUM

It's really disappointing that for how good this place is, the service is so lacking. Waiting to be waited on, waiting to get orders in, getting a partial order. Our waitress was more than polite but just missing. I do love the food though. I would definitely do takeout again, or dinner when I'm not in a hurry.

The Duke's haircut was the worst I ever got. I was chopped and total opposite what the direction was we went over. To top it off, it is extremely dirty, as I was waiting next to an outdoor blue recyclable trash can, that they had inside the cutting area filled with trash. I'm giving them one star because I couldn't give a 0.

Bad attitude on the drive thru staff. Wanted us to come in for whatever reason, just came from the hospital and I could not walk. I don't feel like if I have to explain why I can't walk in to the store. And my sandwich looked very thin and they forgot my cookies. No lettuce on my sammich

Let me start by saying the lady runing the front counter was kinda pushy, quick to get us rung in and walks away   :/ . The place in quite dirty, could have sworn I seen a cockroache! Ew! The vairaty of food is really suffering, but after looking around for a few minutes I lost my apoitight anyways! Never comeing here again!

We bought unbelievably stale donuts here today. How can one make a decision to keep and sell old donuts? Isn't that what you they do, or did they drop the quality along with donuts in their name? Do yourself a favor by going to Wawa or Giant up the road. Their donuts are made fresh daily and are much better quality.

Total gem here in the City of Trees. Very friendly service. The tamales and enchiladas were super bueno. The lady friend and I used to live in San Diego and Santa Barbara, so we pretentiously consider ourselves Mexican food experts. And this place is great.

Be prepared to be on hold for 15 minutes, not respond to emails, and for them to be extremely late for appointments. My appointment was over 2 hours late. I used to like Value Vet 3 years ago, but these past 2 years have been horrible communication and no response.

Valentine's Day dinner ruined with tough Rib Eye steak at $14 per pound and grainy store brand sour cream.  I am a "loyal customer" from Colorado where I shop at King Soopers, also a Kroger store.  Quality here is less than adequate.  Will continue to shop for meat at Costco.

The people were nice but after the vehicle  was supposed  to be cleaned  and I left the office  I noticed very long hairs attached  to my jacket.  I immediately  had to return  the vehicle  and have them clean it as I was already running  late and could not  wait for a new vehicle.

I am returning to this place tomorrow to get the BEES KNEES- vanilla and lavendar! 

I had the watermelon sorbet today. Healthy and high quality ingredients, everything is made and processed there, and prices are reasonable. 

First time visiting Tucson but when I come back I'll stop by this place again.

Booked three rooms at this Doubletree by Hilton. Stayed for almost a week. Everybody was so nice and helpful. Mindy, reservations specialist, was especially accommodating. The rooms were clean the breakfast was wonderful I would absolutely stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Choosing an apartment can sometimes be as difficult as it is important but the difficulty ends here. Great staff from maintenance to management that really makes the building. Overall, this building beats the competition come see this place and you won't need to tour anywhere else!

Worst rental car experience in 16 years! Customer service is awful. It's impossible to call the actual location. Sat at shuttle pickup for 45min and could not even call someone to see if it was running. Even corporate phone number would not and could not transfer me to an employee at actual branch. Never again! Do not do it!!!!

Let me start by saying this. I would give this 0 stars if I could. I ordered an hour and a half in advance for pickup and I sat outside for another 45 minutes waiting on my order. No offer of reimbursement or anything. I understand locations can get busy but good customer service goes a long way.

Just reserved a car on an hour's notice and had no issues getting the car quickly once I arrived. The person helping me was friendly and there was no line. It's a small airport and therefore small rental outpost, so I'd imagine that my experience isn't unusual.

I wish that I would have looked for these reviews before renting a car through Hertz.  The shuttle was non existent  for 25 minutes and then when it came, it didn't stop.  I saw several other car shuttle companies pass by at least 2 and sometimes 3 times before they'd returned.

How is Villa di Roma not 5 stars? Every time someone visits me I make them go to Villa di Roma when they say they want Italian for dinner. Never disappoints. Simple, relatively casual, no frills just plain good Italian. Perfect every time. Will keep coming back!

Pure incompetence. There's a reason McDonald's is failing. It's establishments like this. No focus on customer. No focus on "fast" part of food. No focus on quality. Shut it down until management can get their act together. Never again will I visit this location.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: My cat received great care from all of the veterinarians I've seen at this practice. They have walk-in urgent care hours in the evenings, which is very convenient. Vet techs are also wonderful, as are the front desk staff. The office itself is beautiful and clean. Surprisingly not difficult to find street parking.

Solid combo plates.  They give you a good amount of food for your money.  For $12.50, I got a fish taco, a chicken burrito, a beef flauta, and beans & rice.  It was all really good, too.  The fish taco especially.  As for the service, it was just fine.  It was quick, and our server was polite.  All in all, it was a fine experience.

Really appreciate that they spend a full hour for a pedi - no shortcuts and they are very thorough and meticulous. My last gel mani lasted almost a month and a regular polish lasted almost two full weeks with no chips! Plan on spending the afternoon if you are getting mani/pedi. You are not rushed out. Great service!

I LOVE my stylist, Ruth! She is innovative, friendly, and really talented. The people here are professional and pleasant. I am very demanding when it comes to my hair and I have never been disappointed. They are pricey, but well worth every penny. I highly recommend this salon!

This is the WORST Starbucks store I have ever been in and the first time I've ever had to cancel my order and ask to be refunded due to the excessive wait. The cashier didn't even apologize when I finally had to ask for a refund. Rude and inefficient employees and something is seriously wrong with the order fulfillment process.

The food was incredible. The Cobia collar was one of the most amazing things I've ever eaten. The service was excellent. 

Our temperatures were taken when we came in and the seating looked to be at less than 50% capacity which made me comfortable dining indoors during the pandemic

If i could give a 0 rating i would. The absolute worst DD I've ever been too. Never gets your order right & your items are either burnt to shit or barely cooked. Doesn't sell donuts on Saturdays.. um, what? Just drive a little further and go to Yum Yum or Starbucks. This place is trash.

They advertise Taco's for $1.25 on Tuesdays...went for my birthday my son and myself ordered 4 tacos.  When I got the bill they charged me $3.25 for each taco.  I asked the waiter and he said 'oh the $1.25 tacos only applies to ground beef tacos.'  Really???  You may need to clarify that when you advertise just sayin

This vet is the worst Vet in the world. She won't get her hands dirty. Won't do anal sacs in front of you.
She wants to examine or vaccinate in back room- without you! All you hear are yelps of pain. 
Dog comes back shaking and hating the vet.
She is the worst excuse for a Vetenarian.

I wish I could give this no stars. Management was absolutely horrible and dishonest. Slightly homophobic towards me and my friends. I will never be going to this place or any other location. Shame on y'all for your horrible management amongst other horrible issues.

My son is diabetic and can't carry his insulin with him? Omg, what a disgrace! I have to carry my epipen with me every where in case of a emergency. I guess that's not allowed either huh?  Terrible, policy and life threatening to those of us who must carry life saving products.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Unfortunately I've eaten here several times due to the fact that I was stuck at this hotel, a very tired Marriott property. The food is nothing to get excited about but I guess better than nothing. I was here last night and they had no draft beer at all. If you can avoid this hotel/restaurant altogether I suggest you do.

Money grabbers!! Charged me $130 for a cleaning fee because car was 'Excessively dirty' after a weeks vacation in the mountains, visiting State Parks off the beaten path, with six people. Yet they could not describe to me what excessive meant.  Ludicrous!!

As a transplant to the area, I decided to try this salon based on the Yelp reviews. I was pleasantly surprised. I was served immediately and the outcome was very good. Very satisfied. Prices are much higher than I was used to paying in Florida. Nevertheless I was happy with the final result.

First time at The Artist Haus and it was amazing! I followed my stylist Eric from another salon here! The salon itself is amazing, super cute, and Eric is the absolute best! Highly recommend Eric and The Artist Haus to anyone looking for a great hair experience!

The manger Kristin is a rude & should not be a manger or work at the window , i asked her to stir my coffee and she literally refused to do it and walked away from the window yelling "it's stirred it's stirred" even her employees were shocked by the way she acted . Super unprofessional

We liked it when it was El Rincon Bohemio, but we LOVE it even more now! The next generation of this culinary family has taken the reins and infused some fabulous new flavors into the food and the ambiance. Definitely a reason to come to Old Town and stay for the party!

Tracy did an amazing job on my pink and white gel set for my engagement photos as well as waxing my eyebrows. She was super personable and pleasant the entire time I was there and they are taking great precautions to keep themselves and clients safe during COVID. Would definitely recommend, and will be returning in the future!

Great, warm, friendly, and professional staff. First time patient, felt like I've been going there for years. Any and every question I had, they answered. All in all, a great experience and I believe I have found my new regular eyecare provider. 
Keep up the great job!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: food is okay but it's not all about the food. the service sucks... and has sucked 6/7 times I've been there. I still give it a chance bc the food is okay but my friend ordered Thai chili chicken tenders and the sauce was too wet, and it tasted like a soggy rubber chicken tenders... I didn't see one smile

Food options are terrible. Appetizers is terrible. Do not come here if you are looking for lasagna or any normal food. Menú is really weird. Not even a traditional plate you can count on. I was forced to try their fancy named plated. Taste terrible. I will never return. Very overpriced also.
Don't recommend

Absolutely love coming here! This pizza is amazing and has just the right amount of sauce, cheese, and meat. Not Your Average Joe's reminds me so much of being back in New York that I can't keep from stopping by at least once a week to get some pizza pie! If you're looking for great pie, you've definitely got to stop in!

Long time Yelp user, first time review. Took my wife here for our 26th wedding anniversary after catching the sun set at the beach. We split a pizza and eggplant parmesan, both were excellent. Leah, our server, was great as well. 

We are definitely adding VCibo to our casual night out restaurant rotation!

Went in to view Dr Lowells office and to meet him. Very disappointed with his staff and lack of customer service. After leaving I wrote Dr Lowell and email and received a response the following day. I will post both emails for you to read. 
I didn't not reply back.

I am an emerald club member and I love the fact that they have a wide range of cars in Emerald Isle in every location.  If I am on a Golf Trip or on vacation with the family National car rental is my answer.  I just love landing at any airport knowing that there will be no hassle or wait when it's time to pick up my car.

Literally the best in the city , 
Shrimp eggrolls are bomb  The Crab Rangoon is homemade. House lo mein noodles is my favorite I get mine with no pork of course. Shrimp egg foo yong is chef's kiss  gravy is to die for. Oh the shrimp fried rice is good too. Definitely a 10 out of 10.

This place is amazing! The decor isn't fancy. But the food is excellent and the server are knowledgeable. If your looking for a local byob with good Mexican try this place out. Here are my recommendations:
Tacos: chicken and steak
Fajitas: steak and chicken mixed

Terrible management! Overpriced rooms for small spaces! Terrible roach problems and there are rats in the vent! But the worst about my stay there was the deception by management! They will lie to get you to rent there and as soon as you do, problems ensue. I will not recommend this place and hopes new management takes over

1 other couple was inside and 2 vehicles were in the drive through. For some reason it still took 15 minutes to get my food and it 'magically' was ready when I went to the counter and they asked if they could take my order. I said 'no, I'm just waiting on my food.'

The employees don't really care about the food they prepare. You have to repeat what you want a gajillion times. What this place desperately needs is some quality control and employee training. Ive never had a worse experience than today. This particular subway has declined steadily in the past year.

Food is good. Service is really bad. They forgot part of my order and when I called they said they would deliver it in 10 mins. And never got it. When I called back for the manager/owner he said he didn't care and was very rude. Too bad Dave is no longer the owner he had great service and food.

This place is so yummy! I was visiting from Los Angeles and I happened to be close to the area so I decided to stumble inside of here. I got me two scoops of sweet cream(I'm plain jane) and I couldn't have been happier. Their ice cream is hands down delish!

Check-in staff was far from friendly, wifi won't work, shower head broken in my room, hot water doesn't work, and hair on the underside of the blankets. For as cheap as it is, it's fine. But I'd much rather pay slightly more and be able to access the Internet and shower in hot water.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I'm sorry Burger King but your food is just ew jalapeño bites pretty good but when I got the chicken sandwich it was super dry there fry's SUCKED but the chicken sandwich was kind of good  besides it being dry and there ch king was amazing Burger King your a fine restaurant just work on your fry's

Great service! On one particular night there were some really crappy (rude/inconsiderate) customers in front of me and the girl working was patient and professional with them. She offered free cookies and great service as an apology. My favorite subway to go to!

We have been here several times and it has always been clean with friendly staff, good variety and plenty of empty seats. I hope they can stay in business. Prices are based on the color plate that rolls by. They are happy to make extra of something on request or order from the menu.

I never leave bad reviews but this place is the worst, half the time they don't even take your order in the headset. Extremely rude. Wrong order. Used up my whole lunch break to receive the wrong order once again. No manners what so ever. Act like they got better things to do every time I go so why y'all even working there?
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I walk inside you restaurant to pick up an order and the little brunette woman shakes her head and asks "why the (****) are people coming inside". I just walked out. I get that you're short staffed but the staff you have don't have to be assholes.  I'd give this place 0 stars if I could.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: It was fine because we were starving but it's greasy. Love the thin crispy crust but I could hardly taste the pepperonis. The cheese is almost like something I'd get on a philly sandwich, sort of odd on a pizza.  House salad has way too much cheese on it!  The garlic bread is good. And the service is great!

I don't usually write reviews but I feel compelled to write this one. The Budget site doesn't allow for feedback. My most recent experience was awful. The man at the desk was extremely rude and dismissive.  The woman at the lot was just as rude. Shame on you Budget. I have used you several times.. No more

I was afraid to use it, since the bads reviews it had, but I used my credit car on the touchless wash car, and selected the lower service. It cleaned all the dust, salt and dirt due to the winter and my travel to Las Vegas. I think it was OK for the price I paid.

We have been here several times and have tried many of the items on the menu.  Each time we have been so pleased with the service, friendliness and very importantly the, quality and taste of the food we ordered!  Everything is fresh and spectacular.  A secret, if you have the chance, ask the family to sing for you...... amazing!!!

My favorite Mexican restaurant in Mt Juliet.  Modern feel, fantastic specialty cocktails rivaling anything  we would get downtown at a fraction of the cost. Memos frijole dip is outstanding. Prompt and friendly service with fast and delicious food. 
Can't wait to come back with the rest of the family.

August 5, 2014  I agree with former review writer no parking and the outdoor area needed cleaning.  Although busy, I had a glass of red, moderately priced, and the pizza was ready as promised on time.  Stay away from the antipasto..old stringy cold cuts over lettuce.
Pizza was good!!!!!!!!!!

I have all my medicine with me in my and it's checked I had my prescription of vivance and didn't realize it was in my there. They took it then stole 3/4ths of my prescription and refused to give it back, his name was Tom, at this point am an unsure who to contact. But I do not recommend going there

Saw all the great reviews and comments, and thought I would give it a try.
We have had alot of pizza in this area since moving here in May. I do have to say that this is the best pizza we have had so far in the area. Liked it so much am ordering takeout again for tonight. True New York style with great flavor.

The food was amazing!!  From the expertly prepared charcuterie board to our main dishes (short rib bolognese - OMG was this good, and the pork chop which was also excellent  - it was all fresh and delicious!  It is a little loud but overall a nice atmosphere.

Sushi was decent for the price, but the waitress had her headphones in the whole time and an attitude. Definitely not clean and there were fish eggs in my vegetarian roll, you would think when ordering a vegetarian roll that there wouldn't be a any residue of fish in there. Weird place.

Not way impressed at all. Rooms were dirty. Sheets were dirty, the walls were disgusting, elevators were gross. Asked front desk for extra towels and they never brought any. Multiple bugs were found that freaked out my daughter and we had to squish. Would not stay at this hotel again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Chicken quesadillas is too tasty to resist. Probably one of the best Mexican restaurants I have been to. Enchiladas are juicy and lightly crisp, enjoyed every bite of it. Overall it's a must visit place for people who loves to taste different kinds and best of food.

The price was fair, they're on time, convenient, our cats were happy and treated well, the doc provided flea and food recommendations, answered all our questions thoroughly and respectfully.  I recommend them.  My only minor nit is that we needed to bring our cats outside to the street.  I'd prefer house calls!

Very rude. The employees all seem like it was a huge inconvenience for anyone to come in and order anything. It was very clean. The new employee that was training was nice and made sure everything was made the way we wanted it but the other employees were rude.

I went to this bar on Saturday night for a friend's bday and ordered two bucket of Michelob ultra (5 beers each bucket) not thinking much. My bill was $80!!!! They charge $40 for each bucket of 5 domestic beers! This is crazy! 

The food did look good though.

Ive gone to Pep Boys all over the country, and am currently in Clearwater, Florida. I came in for oil change and tire rotation, and got great service as usual.  i even ended up buying 2 needed tires from them. Always great work for a great price. And the staff is super friendly and warm. Thanks, Terry and Richard
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: My fiancé attempted to get his tires changed here but because he and the owners son were fighting they made him go get his tires changed elsewhere. totally disrespectful in my opinion. i DO NOT recommend this place. such an inconvenience and so immature. they also charge super high prices for work you could go get done elsewhere.

The staff upon check in was great,  very helpful and accommodating. The dinner delicious the breakfast omlet was cold and hard. Only two entrances at front but the majority of the parking spaces are in the back of the hotel on a hill. No fun dragging luggage uphill!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We stayed one night with my husband on business.  Room was exquisite, clean, sensational view!  All staff was very helpful and friendly!  We loved the pool, enjoyed massages at the spa. Good location!  Went to the restaurant at the top and took in all the views! Will definitely choose to go there again if in the area!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Words cannot express how patient this staff was with my chihuahua who ended up having a ruptured anal gland ( I'm not the easiest dog mom to deal with) very personable, clean & competent clinic. The vet made sure to answer all of my questions and I did not feel rushed at all. The vet tech & receptionist were also very knowledgeable

The staff is rude. The waitress argued with me when I sent back the food because it wasn't what I ordered. The food was worse than the service. I had the boneless buffalo bites. They're processed/formed chicken nuggets in sauce, for $9. Save your time and money and get some trail mix from the newsstand.

Since this location opened, I have picked up coffee and a sandwich on the way to work here many times. It's been consistently good, with friendly service the vast majority of the time. My experiences have been exclusively with the drive-thru, so I can't speak to the in-store experience.

Sopressata goat cheese pizza was awesome. Pork chop special had the most amazing sauce and grilled veggies. Chef/owner were willing to make off the menu Fettuccine Alfredo and it had a delicious garlic sauce too. They went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and make sure we had drinks and bellies full.

This place is not worth the money. Not even close! The A/C doesn't cool the room and we were told that they are to small for the room and all the rooms are like that. Then our room was no where close to being cleaned. It was super dusty, gum on the floor, and ac filter had caked on dust.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
DO NOT stay here.  Why?
1. Manager is rude and ignorant
2. Room never cleaned in 7 days; had to steal towels off the maid cart
3. Very seedy part of Canal St. just outside the door-I suggest you cross Canal St, first then proceed to the French Quarter
4. Overpriced for the room
5. Coffee in the lobby totally sucked.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I had nearly $5000 stolen from me in this branch and no one did anything. Yelp won't let me post this as a review until it's long enough, but I think everyone should know. They're quite aware of a common scam ran in their bank and have absolutely no safeguards against it and do nothing to help you.

I give this Holiday Inn location 2 stars due to the fact that we left an expensive toothbrush in one of their rooms, called later that day and the following day, very rarely getting ahold of the housekeeping manager nor receiving a return phone call from her, and nothing. DIshonest staff.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Very authentic food - 4 Stars(would have been 5 if it were warmer.) Vegetable tacos were excellent. Tinga tostado very good. Watery, sweet margarita mix on the house -byot. Loud street if you dine outdoors. Screaming kids if you eat inside. Not a date night spot but awesome authentic Mexican food.

Not a fan at all. Very americanized Italian food. Lasagna was small overpriced and didn't taste very good. The corners were burnt and crunchy. The only reason I gave it a 2 star is because of the focaccia bread. Sorisso has earned his place next to another equally great chef, monsieur Boyardee.

The location is Good  and the Restaurant itself was nice, me and my friend both got a blended margaritas and it was very watery. The food was decent but the service was not great, we only took about 30 mins eating but was there maybe over an hour just waiting on our drinks, food and checks.

Rental car company doesn't have a shuttle that shows up at the pick up location.  After waiting 40 minutes and asking multiple people I finally called the company only to find out they are at another location and use a different shuttle service that doesn't even have the advantage name on it.  

Total waste of time.

I was treated very nicely by the staff especially by Isabel. Isabel is hands down very good and is very good at what she does! The receptionist and techs are really approachable and nice. The doctor is okay and is just doing his job. Other than that pretty good place for going the first time.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: My husband and I had pizza delivered to our hotel the night before we were married a few years back. We raved about how fantastic it was.... but could not remember the name of the pizza place! This is it! I'm in NOLA now... and getting some to bring home!!

Don't ask for hot donuts. Don't expect them all the time. Just drive by the lobby window and if the RED LIGHT is on that mean the donuts are hot. Also be nice to the employees. The only people that are rude would be the old ladies in the front.  And Apple Pay only works inside. Also lobby close early and drive thru is 24 hours.

We just found this new pizza restraunt in the Reddinton Beach area. We did order two pizzas and two salads. The salads were excellent, the pizza were also great. We did carry out. It was a good decision to go there. I recomend this place. We are from Detroit and good pizza is to find.

2nd time I am staying here and last.  Service is terrible.  Across from the convention center a million people who don't travel normally and not staffed to support, 10 minutes to check in Platinum Elite. Premium $$ to stay here, save your money and stay at the Hilton.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I agree with the reviews.  RUN , do not rent from them. They have some serious  deceptive practices. You tell them you don't want a service they charge you anyway.  I will never rent a car there again and will make sure all my friends are aware of the problems.

I have been coming to Modern Eye for the past 6 years.  Selection of glass frames is remarkable.  Lots of fun and funky designs available.  Staff is knowledgeable, attentive, friendly and helpful with suggestions.  Kate, Dale and Tom are truly exceptional.  This is the place to go in the Philadelphia area for glasses.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: It's the cheapest car wash around! You get what you pay for... the premium is worth it.  The manager is not pleasant, polite or accommodating. He is the kind of manager that makes local residents talk about what an awful business their car wash is to deal with.

My brakes needed an emergency repair as I was only just passing through St. Louis. I called Miller brothers in the morning and they were able to fit me in later on that day! We were on the road by the next morning and now safely driving because of their great work!

This place is horrible. Management is what you can expect. If you put a bottle on the floor, and it falls over and breaks, they will charge you for it, and berate you for doing so. Try calling the manager and ask for him to do the needful, and he will tell you to go fudge yourselves. Go to Canals, go anywhere but these jerks

Do NOT get a Dr Pepper here. I have been here a dozen times and every time I come it tastes so bad I gag as soon as I take a sip. Whatever it is, it isn't Dr Pepper. Aside from that the food is ok.....if you can keep it down after drinking this liquid garbage.

Visiting a friend in Nashville and this was our last stop of the night. I quickly learned that this place is the unofficial epicenter of bacherlorette parties. That combined with the relatively cheap booze made for quite a fun night.  

Definitely am going to come back here again soon!

Used to be a loyal regular but apparently the owner decided to get rid of euro tart so I guess I'll have to jump over to Aspen Leaf instead. I think what irritates me is that he apparently isn't listening to his people on the front lines,  you know, the people that talk to the customers.

Ate here tonight and paid with my credit card at 9:41.  At 10:20pm 20 minutes after the restaurant closes, my credit card company called to ask if I had charged $690 at Saks.  Didn't use card anywhere else today so he waitress must have taken my credit information when she ran my card.    DO NOT EAT HERE.  Criminals!!!!

The food was mediocre but the service is very good. While I would not recommend this restaurant, it is definitely better than some of the other food nearby. The service however was very nice and the atmosphere was fine as well. While this restaurant is not spectacular, the service nearly makes up for it.

Daughter went in to get hair done. Stylist was rude, didnt speak to her at all completely ignored her. Giving her the feeling she wasn't wanted there. I myself have experienced same thing from them. This location seems to find the rudest hair dressers. Won't ever go back!!!

Tonight I picked up a pizza and I felt the box and it was lukewarm. I asked if it was sitting there and the owner said no. It was cold when we arrived home and so we warmed it in the oven and ate tough pizza. Never again will I go there. I did call and ask if I could get my money back and he said yes but I decided not to bother.

Arlington is the perfect place to rent from if you're attending surrounding colleges. It's a short commute, and the apartments are able to accommodate roommates very well. Management is good as well. Only thing that's an occasional problem is parking, but it's rare.

My wife and I absolutely love Frankie Fellini's! If we're ever thinking of taking another couple out to a BYOB, this is our first and best choice! We only know them from dining there but love them so much we sent them a Christmas card this year because they made you feel so welcome.

Been here for 40 minutes now with 2 people in line in front of me. Not the ideal way to start a vacation. There is no sense of urgency and only 1 person working with 20 paid customers standing in line behind. Very unprofessional and will not be reserved again

It is a beautiful 60+ degree day in Boise and we (a party of 5) noticed the tables outside and wanted to stop and get lunch.  Due to the pandemic we choose not to sit inside restaurants.  When we went to request a high chair we were told that we could not be served outside. We were very disappointed.

This is a great spot for Chinese food! The food is at a good price with great portions! The staff there are always friendly! Most times delivery is on time, but once in a while they get busy. A good thing! The foods are made fresh everyday and you can taste it! Would definitely recommend coming here!

The food was very average I always get a super burrito and every where I go the asada is crappy quality meat,this places meat was all dry and hard very disappointed,the only place I absolutely love is aldertos on clear acre,you can tell the steak is good quality and authentic

Today I unfortunately needed to have my car towed (on a sunday night ) and called roadside assistance and ended up having this company tow my car. They got there quick and gave us an ETA over the phone. The guy was very professional and patient even though my car was parked in probably the most inconvenient way for him to tow it.

I love this building. I have lived here for many years.  The staff works very hard to keep the residents happy - from the property manager to the maintenance people to those people at the front desk. The apartments are a great size, high ceilings, large windows.  And the building is close to 95, 76 and Ben Franklin Bridge.

If you ever had good sushi (not supermarket) then you will be thoroughly devastated. We should have left when we walked in and we were hit with a bad odor. The second clue was that there were hardly any patrons. Save yourself some misery if you really like good sushi. If you like supermarket sushi it might be bearable.

It would have been nice if they had told us we needed to get our order to-go BEFORE we ordered our food. It would have made a huge difference in our order. Next time someone comes in near closing, orders beer and combo plates, that usually means they do not want to eat in the car...

I would rate this location zero stars if it were an option.  The associates here are always rude and never helpful.  I usually avoid this location but took a chance today.  I should have known better.  Needless to say, I'm shopping online for what I went in there for.  If you can avoid this location, do so.

We went for happy hour and let me tell you it is well worth it.  From 4:30 till 7:00 they have $3.00 Martinis and they use Finland vodka, they have wide verity of flavors.  I had the grapefruit one and is was perfect.  We also indulged on the food.  We had the pork OssoBuco and the salmon they were very delicious.

This place needs serious attention. Rooms run down. Single elevator was beyond slow. Internet was described as "old Internet" measured in kilobits, not megabits. Doors to building were never locked (unsafe). Shining positive was the staff who were very nice. Would not stay here again...

After moving here a year ago and having a hard time finding a place and someone,I was lucky and found this place and Jackie. I found it by searching top place to get hair service in Carmel. I had cut, color and highlights.   If you make an appointment you will be so happy and have no regrets.

When asked "what's your best donut?" I was promptly given a piece of their most well known to try. Amazing service! Point taken off simply because of the sheer size and girth of these donuts. When i went only one person was there so you get you haircut almost when you come in and if you are a parent feel free to bring your kid they have arcade games there and good people too 
$15 for on hair cut better than $25 haircut next to the jimboys down the street

This is a great location for us. The prices are reasonable and the service is good. The atmosphere could be a little happier overall, but we've always had pleasant enough service.

The place is nice. The service sucks, The service sub par. rather go to a spa or some other place in nashville where you will get a real spa service. I paid $80 for a pedi and basic mani. Glad to have finally found a good quick Mexican food spot in town taqueria style.  Great menu and great prices.  Burrito i got was big and very tasty. Hot sauce was actually hot too!  I love it    Everything was as advertised. Looking forward to going back soon.

DO NOT GO HERE ON A HOLIDAY.  The food was precooked and dried out.  You will get a good meal during the week.  Sure didn't help that the manager put friends at a table before several parties who were there first.  BUT like I said before, you will get a good meal during the week.

Delicious food and polite, efficient service. I had a quesadilla and it was made very hefty with plenty of meat. The cheese dip was great and the guacamole had a really good flavor. I would definitely go back. Also I'm sort of a salsa freak and I LOVED the salsa here.

I ordered a pizza last night from Imos and the driver got lost and the pizza was delivered cold. I received a credit for another pizza. I called to collect on the credit tonight and the Manager Chris insisted I pay a delivery fee. I refused. Is that any way to do biz?

This restaurant was the most disgusting place. It was not clean. The meat was a horrible texture and looked like organs. The woman working was standing on the counter while we were ordering. No one was wearing gloves while preparing the food. Had to leave halfway through my meal due to disgust. Never go here. Disgusting and dirty.

Beautiful dining room. Exceptional old school chinese ambiance. Food however bland and overpriced. Its not that the food was bad, just nothing any other cheap cafe style place offers for half the price. Had much better on Edmonton for less money. Room though is an experience.

We were waited on right away. There is a plethora of flavors and mix-ins!! So much better than cold stone. I'd say it's slightly overpriced but honestly nothing I wasn't expecting especially for good quality. And home made waffle cones? Yes please! Delicious. Definitely will be returning.

THE BEST sushi restaurant ever. My husband was a little bit apprehensive about trying sushi, but this is now a place that he craves! Yes, service can be a bit slow, but it is more than worth it. Our favorites: The Nashville roll, the crazy roll, and the yum yum roll! Try it out, you will NOT regret it!

-5 star

Today we tried Senoritas Mexican Taqueria. We had heard about it around town and finally  had to try it. When me and my family were done we realized we had eaten the best Mexican food we had ever tried. Their tamales were cooked to perfection and there meat was extraordinarily good. You have to try this place!!!!!!

Extremely poor customer service. The Employees can't even speak English. Not saying that they don't do decent work just make sure to check your receipt before you leave.

Staff in he evening is generally very rude. Messes up orders, and usually chatting it up while you're waiting at the drive through with your food sitting right there. I refuse to go back to this one. Do yourself a favor and go to the one at midway. They're always friendly and great to deal with. Food tastes better too.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We were traveling through Nashville and decided to get take-out as we were exhausted from driving and sightseeing. China King came up on our search and we were happy to  find it. Food was good (chicken and broccoli, sweet and sour pork, and shrimp fried rice) with the exception of the veggie spring rolls (small, bland).

As of today I have become a huge fan of this place. Pizza was very tasty and done exactly how I was hoping it would be since it was my first time here.i ordered a small pepperoni and sausage pizza. And yes I will be back again real soon. I recommend anyone who's passes by to try this place out and see for yourself.

Second time eating here. Don't remember what I ordered the first time . 
This time I chose the Hot Chicken. I've eaten a lot of really good, true, hot chicken. 
This was unfortunately not one of them. 
Three pieces-leg, back, thigh - really?
Hardly any meat. 
You've been warned.

Oh my god i ordered a medium carmel swirl latte like and it tasted really good tbh but i legit only got 5 sips...the cup was full of ice till the bottom ridge at the top of the cup. SCAMMERS!!!! anyways literally ask for light ice if you ever go lol. But i wont be going there any time soon, ill stick to Starbucks!

To begin with we had a very simple order but somehow they just couldn't understand it there for it took 10 min just to place our order. The cashier was very cold, and looked like she was miserable there. The staff was not friendly nor not helpful at all. The food was average. Definitely going to chick- fil-a next time;)
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Our first time there was Thursday evening...a great place and awesome food. Fresh and tasty ! It was worth the 25 minute wait. It is small and most nights I am told there is a wait. They also have carry out and it is a BYOB establishment. My boyfriend and I became instant fans. It small but quaint. We will be back !

This restaurant was very good! My family and I decided to stop here for lunch while on vacation (good choice). I've had lots of Ramen, but this is the best I've had. The service was excellent and everything was clean (bathrooms included)!
The ingredients that was used for our meal was very fresh! I highly recommend this restaurant!

Yeah.....Internet didn't work.  No hot water.  They said the hot water was fine.    Nope.  Luke warm water on the full hot setting after 10 minutes.  

It is under renovation.  Fine.  I knew that.  But no hot water and no internet.  Thank God for wireless hot spots.

I will let the water run for 30 minutes to see if it improves.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place is horrible. The server didn't say anything when I placed my order, just looked at me, like I was bothering them. I checked my food when I got home, the burger was smashed, there was something on the pickles, and the fries were cold. I didn't bother to eat it. Do not waste your money.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The food was great.  We started with the firecracker shrimp and then had the Korean salmon and the char-grilled meatloaf.  Everything was really good. The service was friendly and prompt.  We also had some really yummy cocktails.  Will definitely be going back to enjoy more of their great food.

The only complaint is I wish they had pool. But staff is nice and the rooms are nice as well. I stayed here for a Beachbody Summit and love how it's connected to JW Marriott and that's connected to the convention center and that's connected to Lucas Oil Stadium
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went in for an eyebrow wax and waited 45 minutes. They called back 3 other people that came AFTER I did that were getting manicures and pedicures which take longer than a simple eyebrow wax. Ended up leaving after waiting 45 minutes. Absolutely ridiculous!

The pizza was good but the sauce could of been better and the garlic knots tasted a bit like plastic. Will not be eating there again. You have to clean up after your self and I feel that they we're rude and when ordering felt very rushed. If your in the area and looking for a quick bite of pizza it's average. But nothing special.

I have gone to Dr. Quinn who is professional, knowledgable and very thorough with both my dogs. I have an elder Samoyed and a younger Maltipoo. She has cared for everything from teeth to a bad back and post surgical eye care. I cant speak more highly of her!

The ladies in this restaurant in the afternoons are RUDE and UNPROFESSIONAL!! I will NEVER spend my money with this place ever again. I tried to bypass the rudeness but the lady was soooooo unprofessional. The girl was on her phone at the register and being all loud cursing on the phone. I give this place TWO thumbs down.

This place is absolutely incredible! It's definitely the best ice cream I've ever had. There's a huge selection of unique and mouth-watering flavors designed by Jeni herself to choose from, and the prices are absolutely reasonable for the quality. I couldn't be happier to have it in the area!

I will never go or waste my money at this place again.This car wash put 4 dented gouges in my  car that i have had only for 4 months.I talked to one of the employees.And said they are not responsible for what happen.I even went in and filled a report.They oh well .Are you kidding ????

Had an issue with not liking the coffee I ordered and they handled it by giving me one I liked to substitute. This is how service should be at almost anywhere and its hard to find in chains these days. Compliments to this dunkin for thinking of there customers.

I like Oggis! I believe they recently switched chefs and sometimes certain dishes don't taste the same. I love their salads and they have great pasta and great bread. One thing I wish they'd change is adding cocktails to their menu. Some martinis would be lovely with dinner!

In a word: overpriced. $250 for a Thursday night stay and the only hotel staff I saw were two teenagers. Also they don't tell you the place is basically locked so I had to stand outside the hotel for about 15 minutes til I called the hotel (twice) to tell them to let me in. The place was nice but definitely not worth the price.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I used to shop here routinely.  Lately my favorite products have disappeared and been replaced with the store brands.  It has become so pervasive that it is now hard to find anything but store brand products.  Frequently the produce does not appear very fresh.   Time to shop somewhere else.

An old restaurant that I had not been too in a long time & I would never go back. Planned on ordering lobster in ginger & scallion sauce, a usually delicious,  easy dish. The waitress recommended the sea bass. I followed her recommendation. Both fish & sauce were terrible & it was not ginger & scallion.

So good!!! Favorite restaurant. I definitely save like $60+ dollars with what I eat verses going somewhere else. 

Come before 6 on Friday/weekends or you will wait a long time. It's popular! 

Just as good or better quality sushi as the best other sushi places in town for a way better price

Big disappointment. Early flight out of pcola unusually long TSA. Arrived here  starving and have dietary restrictions. Egg white omelet wow just what I need ............... sorry no egg whites. So you have eggs just no whites!!! Doesn't chickens lay eggs with both?? Go figure

This place is AWFUL. I went today and my nails look terrible. It literally took 2 hours for a fill in because the owner kept saying she was hung over and tired. The fill in was not even done good. Polish already chipping and looks awful where it's not. Don't waste your time or money at this place.

My husband stopped by and picked up lunch today.  We live down the street in Speedway and not only was the food cold the order was incorrect. French fries tasted like they had been cooked in a fish fryer. This was at 1230pm during the lunch time and it tasted like the food had been sitting under a heat lamp for quiet a while.

Avance's GM is very rude and did not handle my simple request well at all. She was incompetent and condescending. Incompetent and not helpful staff members behaving inappropriately do not suit the needs of the restaurant field in such a great city like Philadelphia. This place will probably not make it...

The fees they add on to your bill are ridiculous!  Budget adds on a 10.4% "Concession Recovery Fee" to your entire bill and a "CUST FAC CHARGE" of $2.50 per day, etc, etc. These are not taxes but fees they've come up with.  Also, I've never taken a toll road in Florida yet I got charged an $18 electronic toll road fee.

We sat in the drive through for close to 45 minutes tonight and watched at the cashier turned almost 30 cars away. Than when I asked for ketchup and sweet and sour sauce that I requested with my 50 nugget he gave me 3 of each even though I paid for extras. He should be fired for turning away all those people.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Not happy sold me things I didn't approve or sign for. Put insurance on that I didn't need but claimed I approved it.  Would not handle any business on the phone wanted me to return to airport rental to correct.   Deceitful would not  recommend.  They get a 1 because the vehicle was decent.

The food was okay...a little cold. BUT... the waitress chased us out the restaurant to ask for a better top. actually ran at us and said "this is my tip." we said yes. she harassed us for more. the whole time she waited on us she stared at us and it was a bit uncomfortable. Anyways 4/10 because the food was still pretty good

Went on looking for New Year's champagne.  We were assisted very capably when the selection we wanted was not on the shelf. The manager went back into the store room and found the remaining case and brought it out for us.  We also saved $30, which was an added bonus

This place is awesome!   The calamari was the best I've had in recent memory and their signature pasta dish, the Bucatini Taleggio e Speck, was amazing.  Great service at the bar - always our favorite place to sit.   We liked it so much we came back the very next night and ordered the same pasta dish.

The second star is because the hot chocolate with a shot of espresso was very good. The rest of the order was a train wreck. I ordered a glazed blueberry donut and got a plain one. The hash browns were burnt AND cold?!?! How does that happen?!?! Come on guys!

Are you kidding me? Show up at the return at 530, and dIdnt get a shuttle until 610. Cars from this joint always, always, always reek of smoke and brakes aren't great. How much is your time worth? Because renting from this spot will add a solid hour to your travel time, and that's on a good day. Avoid like the plague!

Coffee was on point. Avoid the hummus/pita/veggies bowl. They put the hummus on the bottom of the bowl, and the pita was completely soggy. The peppers tasted rubbery/not cripsy, like they weren't fresh. Not expecting much from a to-go bowl, but none of this was edible. I hope they change packaging or something!

Very dishonest advertising!!!
I prepaid $169 for my rental car for 4 days, which showed all taxes and fees. When I went to pick it up they said I still owed $429 in addition to the money I already paid. I cancelled it at the airport. They are giving me the runaround to get my money back. Do not use them!!

They either need to change their attitude or management completely. I can never step a foot in here without getting complete negative attitude from their manager. The workers are great - they're friendly and really helpful, but my god, something must have happened to their manager because he is just always a sour puss.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I got off a red eye flight, and proceeded to the full size line. While I was deciding what I wanted, an employee came by and said "you're a big guy and you look tired. Go take one of the SUV's over there" I was pointed to several GMC Acadia's. Great vehicle for a week long round Florida rental.

I was pleasantly surprised by this little strip mall place. Although the atmosphere wasn't anything spectacular, the sushi rolls were excellent! I have eaten at more prestigious sushi restaurants, but this sushi chef is very talented. The texture of his rolls were so delicious and he knows how to plate!

Garrett was incredibly helpful. Nice and friendly and informative. Even though they couldn't work on my car, because apparently it had been worked on badly befire I bought it.  I appreciate it all the information and helpfullness that he showed. Thank you for the help.

Place is trash. A bunch of inaccurate information online regarding pricing. Once you arrive they charge you way more and god forbid the gas idle is slightly below full they'll charge twice as much as the rental itself. They straight robbed me. 0 stars. SMD!

Had a great visit looking for a three bedroom for my mother.  Jacob was so friendly, but very knowledgeable of the area for her to shop in and walk to.  I saw many workers in the parking lot and lobby, they very friendly and seemed to care what was going on, in the apartments.  The model was very large and smelled delicious!

First time here. Fantastic pedicure however I asked them to match that color with gel on my nails and they try to paint them to different colors. Told me they did not have matching colors and then charged me for the manicure even though they did not paint my nails. Very disappointed and will not be returning

The owners are absolutely close mined and rude. I will never recommend this estsblishment. Bathrooms are gross, the actual establishment is over all hot and cramped. I love the staff, as most of the people that actually keep the place running are great people, but they lack when it comes to leadership. Good luck!

I will never order from here again. When you call and ask what kind of cheese they have for their fries and they say cheese whiz then you ask them, "is it real cheese whiz?"and when you get it it's like grade F that you got in high school and then the driver forgets half your order.

When you call a pizza place and specifically ask if the cheese they use for for their fries is cheese whiz and they say yes and then you get it and it's like grade F  that you got in high school. I will never order from here again....Spend the extra money and get real cheese whiz and stop lying

Avoid the top load machines. They are so 'water efficient' that some folds in the clothes do not get wet and even when you use just a bit of soap it is not fully rinsed out. The staff is friendly- until you have a problem.  More expensive than other options but the place is clean.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Got the lucky dog with cheese mustard and onion.
It wasn't anything special. Filled a spot while waiting for the plane. I had heard that they were pretty good, but was left feeling meh. Gave 3 stars for the staff, girls were pleasant enough, just need to smile more.

I visited this place for the first time today, the barber was very friendly and quick.  I haven't changed my hairstyle for a couple years but I showed him a picture of something I was looking for and he made it happen exactly how I envisioned.  Very pleased, definitely will be going back!

Worst hotel.  Advertises kitchen but no dishes no utensils no soap.  No tissues, two cheap towels.  Very thin walls.  Child bouncing and running on laminate floors above us all night and first thing in am.  Very over priced.  Cheep cheep furniture, even toilet seat falling off. Better off at the days inn with a microwave.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Cancelled my membership on the spot. Worst gym I've ever been in. Hands down.

I moved from LA expecting more quality in Santa Barbara, as it has a much smaller population and the city is awesome. Was sorely disappointed. I was a member for a few years before deciding to quit.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Do not stay here if you do not want to hear animals making noise all night long. The rooms smelt like cat and dog urine, all the animal smells really bugged my allergies even though I didn't stay in a pet friendly room. Despite that the customer service at the front desk was phenomenal.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I just wanted to take the time to thank the staff at Montebello at Summit Ridge. We lived in our apartment here for a year and a half and loved it. The grounds were maintained well and the staff was always so helpful and friendly. It was quiet and peaceful. This place is awesome, so thank you again! ~ Carrie Kidder

This place is incredible! I have ordered trays from Zinc a few times now for work. Everything was delicious and beautifully prepared!  Everyone talked about the food for days!  A must go to!
The area is fortunate to have this cafe! Robin generously supports and donates to the local community and schools. She is absolutely amazing!

Wife brought two pints of soup home.  One wonton and one hot and sour.  Both tasted like plain water and oil.  Disgusting.  Both had not chicken flavor and it is really bad when they can't produce a decent wonton soup.  Hot and sour is a little different but this had no wood ear mushroom nor shredded pork.  P. U.!

Wish I stayed here longer... Totally did not expect a a huge junior suite with separate living room set up. Bath products included toothpaste! Within a walking distance to a huge mall with plenty of options for lunch. Taxi to downtown Tampa is only $12. Helpful customer service.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Can't rave enough about Raphael, George and their tacos. Rumor has it they may have to close due to lack of business. So, you should keep them in business by going there and eating their AMAZING street tacos. Best around. Would be a real shame to see this place close.

great place.  pretty much only sit down restaurant for late night.  decent size.  simple design.  maybe im partial because i spent a whole lot of time here while in school but honestly i don't care.  give it a try

recommendations:  sb roll.  scallops, asparagus, fake crab, rice rolled in tofu paper

Friendly staff, but problem rooms and horrifying coffee. 
WHY do these redesigned hotels insist on installing sliding bathroom doors that don't actually close, and with a glass door? C'mon. Really?
Also: nice continental breakfast had the most awful coffee I have ever had in a hotel. That bad.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
As local as it gets. Great neighborhood spot with an outstanding selection of liquors and wines with a decent beer stock as well. 
They also are great for parties, as they deliver for larger orders.

Half a block from Langenstein's makes it easy to walk here before or after grabbing groceries.

We stayed here for New Years weekend. Price was reasonable for a last minute (2 days before new years) booking. They offer free wifi and complemantary breakfast.  The room was clean and i have no complaints. Hotel is close to Atlantis and 7-10 minutes away from the Reno strip. I would recommend it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Awesome pizza.  The best meal I've had since getting here, at a quarter of the cost.  Skip all those tourist traps on the beach and eat here.

We had a couple of Cesar salads and a large pizza.  Salads were very good and fresh, the pizza is New York style thin and well made.

The best wings I've ever had at airport. Compared to traditional airport concourse fare, this sports bar in Terminal A is pretty darn good. The bartender was polite, quick, and friendly. Layovers are a drag, but at this place, I didn't even mind it. Although I'm not a golf fan...with all those pluses, who cares?

One of the nicest staff at any hotel I've stayed at.  The place was spotless, everyday you could see staff making sure the property was in tip top shape.  Nice pool and just a short walk to the beautiful beach of Treasure Island.  Plenty of free parking and the morning breakfast some perfect .. even the coffee was Great
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: They came to my work and gave me a menu with a coupon, so I decided to give them a try. My family loves chinese food, but not this chinese food. We got  5 different dishes and not one of them was any good. I was so dissappointed,  another $30.00 down the drain.

A friend decided to take me and a couple of my buddies to this restaurant because it was one of the few restaurants that is opened late in the area. I'm not sure what to think of this place, it's small but not too small. The service here is not bad either. Food I would say is passable.

Absolutely disgusting.  The room was dirty and smelled terrible.  The carpet was stained and black from use.  The vent had dust that hadn't been cleaned in a long time.  Noise from the highway.  And parking is none existent. Not worth the money.  Zero star
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Understaffed, below par food (and that's grading on the airport food curve), and weirdly understocked. The bartender kept having to apologize for lacking basic ingredients for popular entrees. The options aren't great in Terminal F, even now that it's been overhauled, but surely there are better ones than this.

I've been to Lissa Ellison a couple times now since I moved to St. Louis and have left happy every time. On my second visit I asked for a skin fade and she got right to work and pulled me together right away.  Easy to schedule and takes her cuts seriously.

Stopped here in my trip home when hungry driving home on the 101. Food is bland, kitchen is dirty. Bathrooms have trash all over, cupboards kicked in and broken. I wished I had gone to Mc D's rather than here, at least I would know what I would be getting.

I was expecting a lot more honestly. They have free wifi which is nice. The drinks were pretty good, but it does bother me my friend couldn't get into the bar as he lost his wallet. I understand this may be policy to card everyone, but he doesn't look underage. Ah well.

The donuts we ordered for our wedding last week from Holey Schmidt put our reception to a whole new level.  The whole process of working with them was just lovely.  The donuts were delicious and Galen was so fantastic to work with.  We will be making Holey Schmidt Donuts constant stop anytime we are in Reno.

You should know it's expensive before you go there, but if that's what you're after, this place has excellent and creative neo-California gourmet food, a retro-modern hole in the wall ambience in a rare location.  It has a fun little glass bar to sit at too.

This is a full service (not a small satellite) Starbucks in the Hyatt. Good for a light breakfast if the more expensive hotel restaurant does not appeal to you. 

As for the quality of food and service, it is exactly what you would expect from a Starbucks, consistent.

They get two stars! Pizza looks amazing.... I haven't bitten into a slice just yet. I've been waiting over an hour for plates, forks ect... I'm staying in a very nice hotel after a long day and I called Gina's two minutes later to say.. You forgot the utensils I ordered a salad. What poor customer service!

We'd heard high expectations about this place and maybe that's why our dining experience seemed to fall a bit short. We ordered the cheese plate appetizer which was pretty plain. We then had to wait quite a bit before our entrees came out which were also average. Overall not a bad dining experience but it was nothing memorable.

Charging $2 for extra sauce on a pizza you didn't get cheese on seems a bit chintzy to me. Luckily, the PV downtown does not. Will not be going back to the West end store.

Best of all... I should have checked the pizza while I was there. They didn't even put extra sauce on the pizza. 

Good riddance.

Even though the recipe here is close to traditional Italian pizza, it is too salty and greasy with imitation cheese. Only people from St. Louis who in my opinion have a special relationship with oily food would appreciate this so called pizza. They do offer an endless salad which is great.

My favorite place in Tucson. I'm told there's better sushi to be had in town, but I like Sushi on Oracle too well to take other recommendations when it's sushi time. I live in Dallas but visit Tucson fairly often, and I hope to never have to leave without having eaten here.

Rooms being refurbished now, we were in a room yet to be done and it needed it but was still nice. The grounds were nice and the staff friendly five stars if they had enough parking.
The restaurant inside is a Starbucks in the morning and a bar/sandwich shop later in the day.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The Dunkin Donuts on 4th Street ineptly hawks a product that so addicts its customers that they are unable to queue, order and proceed through the line in any sort of efficient manner before consuming it, further corrupting the process and requiring greater and greater amounts of the product. Diabolically brilliant.

Wondeful company to order from. Very helpful from start to finish. I needed a specific alcohol sent to the East Coast and was glad to find them. Their shipping rates are very reasonable and their associate walked me through the order ing process beautifully and patiently. Would definitely buy from again.

I went here with my wife our firdt night in NOLA. My wife had the french onion soup and the filet and I had tomato bisque and the veal cheeks. Both of our meals were excellent if not unique to NO. My wifes filet was a tad over cooked but other than that the meal was good. Excellent service and a very nice dining room.

Got the slice of pizza, salad and drink combo. Caesar salad was pretty good decent size just a little too much parmesan. Pizza looked at tasted like a frozen pizza. Pizza was so crispy that when attempting to fold it just cracked in half. Whole meal was 6 bucks so yea you get what you pay for.

Stayed at the Inn for our 10 year anniversary.  Krazy Kats did not disappoint.  The ability to order half portions enabled us to have room for soup and an appetizer and a few bites of dessert. The filet mignon melted in my mouth and the crab bisque was to die for.

I have eaten here 3 times and was satisfied each visit.  The plates are authentic and beans and rice are the best I have had at a restaurant.

Pros: Handmade tortillas, beans, rice, agua frescas, mango chamoy margarita.

Cons: Nothing so far.

Each time I have gone service has been spot on.

What a let down. It might be easiest to say the only good part was the service. The waitresses were very attentive. Other than that it was a bust. Hard to find parking, sushi was warm, steak was not. Most of the rolls are filled with asparagus or tempura flakes, or topped with "Japanese mayo." No thanks.

Very nice ambiance match with an excellent service.
