Love all the food they serve but we shouldn't ordered 2 Edemame as my husband ordered All You Can Eat-Sushi & we got additional charge for something thats already included in AYCE-Sushi! But, we'll visit again every time we fly back to Reno! Yummy2!

We had a big work in Santa Barbara so we needed a place that our employees can sleep at night and can take a shower after working all day. I found this place for them, as it was convenient to the job site. 
You can't expect to pay cheap price and to get 5 stars, but it was certainly O.K for our needs.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Our family of 4 girls have been customers of Lonnie's for 8 years and have always had a wonderful experience.  The expert staff is friendly, timely, and have never been a disappointment to us.  We would recommend Lonnie's to anyone wanting a superb manicure or pedicure!

Just got my hair cut at Brick & Mortar last night, and would happily recommend it to anybody. Brandon is a good dude who does a great cut at a reasonable price. He accepts walk-ins, but more importantly he stays open until 7pm so you can get in for a cut after work without having to rush out the door.

The family took a rode trip from Maryland to visit Villa di Roma's. The food was wonderful. The meatballs are huge and oh so tasty. I loved the sauce and I didn't have heartburn after, which surprised me. The service was nice and welcoming. I can't wait to go back.

M.Morris

This place seemed promising based on other reviews, but I was pretty disappointed. The food was mediocre and the service was poor. I heard that they will be closing, so maybe the experienced staff left already. The lobster pot a few blocks up the street is a much better spot in my opinion.

I'll go with many other reviews... The sushi is okay.   Not great... not bad... but okay. Atmosphere is awesome.   I was in at 4:00 PM so it was dead as there were no dinner people there yet but I can see how it would be a fun place to eat with a group of friends.  

Staff were right on it... attentive and polite.

Very disappointed in my meal yesterday. The server was great but the Crab Louie salad, which I have had in the past, was missing the crab!  $15.50 for some lettuce, egg and a few tomatoes. Sprinkled on it was a little bit of the cheap nasty crab shreddings that come in a can. Disgusting. 

Did they change ownership?

Lotsa food for reasonable prices. Very, very helpful and friendly staff. Family owned and operated for years. Authentic Mexican fare. Guacamole is fantastic. Salsa is fresh and spicy. The son took over for his mom and trys very hard to keep going in her tradition. You won't be sorry you visited.

We were skeptical to even stop here at first because of previous low star review but there was nothing wrong with this Dunkin Donuts. Clean restrooms, coffee tasted good, super conveniently close to I-95 exit in and out plus staff was nice and friendly. What else to ask for? All good, keep up the good work.

Rude staff, slow service. 

I walked in for a coffee at 8am to an empty store and was not greeted, even after standing at the counter for several minutes. 

I don't think much more needs to be said. I've  never been disappointed by an experience in a Dunkin before.

First time customer and couldn't be more satisfied. The service was outstanding and the food arrived at our table in a timely manner. The atmosphere was awesome, though if you are looking for somewhere to watch sports this isn't the place. The three televisions could only play one channel.

I eat at Non Solo several times a week, and am never disappointed.  There are always new specials to try, each better than the previous.  Skate, eel, tripe, Oxtail, veal osobucco, and, if you want it, a great Italian hoagie.  Try the smoked salmon and rigatoni. Tons of fine wines to choose from.

Poor service.  Horrible service I wrote this review about 2 years ago because I don't like to talk bad about anybody, but now that I'm in the never come back again list here we go. Their cheese Pizza is tasty but their customer service is horrible, it almost feels like dealing with the Mob. 
Enough said.

Originally rented from another enterprise location  - but the team at 388 Nashville (Macy & Torian) took great care of us. The other enterprise location (close to the airport) ran out of cars for my family of 6.  Macy and Torian were patient with me and helped save our family vacation!  Kind, friendly & patient.  GZ

My favorite sushi restaurant. I usually get the deluxe lunch special, which includes a nice variety of sashimi as well as tuna rolls, all presented in a unique ship. The Tampa grouper (cooked) is also one of my favorites. I have to eat at Tokai once a week, and I crave their sushi multiple times a week.

Just so y'all know, out of the 50 1-star reviews this place has, there's always a line inside and outside the restaurant  it's fast, convenient and cheap food so if you expect at least 3-star service at a place with a dollar menu, you need to get real people. It's a MCDONALDS.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Chicken enchilada really good, fish tacos kind of soggy but super yummy sauted veggies on it . Nice service... let us eat at their outdoor patio and still  serve us beer outside in plastic glass so we could be next to our dog.  Next door to Don Roge tacos which came highly recommended but did not serve beer.

I found this place on Yelp and unfortunately was not quite as happy.  The place was nice and the service was good.  My son and I enjoy Mexican food, and neither of us walked away feeling that it was that great.  Were in town visiting colleges, will not go back.  The Shrimp tacos were very bland.

This is my first yelp review I have written. My experience here was so poor that I felt the only way to quell my disposition was to post my frustrations. The staff was okay but understaffed. I was late to work and had to wait seemingly an hour to even be helped.

Wow!  
The portions are very big, and the food is hot and fresh.  
I've been there 3 times now, and every time the food has been good.  
My favorite item is the the dry fried green beans -- enough for 2 people easily!  
The staff, although kind of abrupt-ish, was helpful.

3 stars because it was ok. I've stayed in a lot of HIE's and this one was not terrible, but not great either. The room had a mild level of undesirable odor. The paint was peeling in the shower. It was clean and the price was ok. We got a rate of $77 plus tax. I think that was "discounted"...just ask for it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My family and I are trying this spot for the first time. Only ordering 4 items, the total was $75.00. I am not sure if the prices were raised or not. There wasn't a menu to look at and I will given the benefit of the doubt, the food smells really good, but I can't pay that much for food.

It's been more than a year since I've been there, but the horrible experience is still burned in my mind.  I can't believe this restaurant has such a high rating.  I was there with a group of colleagues, and one of the entrees had a roach in it...needless to say, I lost my appetite and will not go back.

Incredible spot! We sat at the pizza counter and had a few dishes and drinks to share. Everything was delicious and the staff was happy to be there. Great eats (especially anything that involves bread!) and a superb drink selection. 

Do not miss the tiramisu!!!

Awesome place!! we just happened to be walking by and decided to stop in! I'm so glad we did.. The bartender was very nice and helpful when we asked him tourist questions and everyone in the bar was a regular. Super friendly great drinks! Very cool decor and courtyard with a pool!

I stayed there two nights in July and enjoyed the stay. I was on a business trip from June to August and hated where I previously stayed(Mount Juliet Quality Inn). This place had a friendly staff and the rooms were CLEAN!!! Wish I had stayed there from the get go! Props to the staff on a wonderful stay!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: So so delicious. Wish we were able to pick up our pizzas when they were fresh out of the oven but ya know... great ol' Covid times! We had ordered the Margarita pizza along with their bread with house made butter and their olive oil cake!!!!! Omg everything was tooooo delicious!!!!!

The front desk staff is friendly. The rooms are nicer than expected for the price. They are modern looking and well equipped. Our room was missing a coffee maker for some reason. The biggest negative for us is that we had to pay a higher rate for a nonsmovking room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Place is a complete joke!! Scam. Don't trust these people. Tried talking to the supervisor and the customer service rep didn't let me. Arguing on the phone for 20 mins and nothing. Complete scam. Does anyone know where I can get in contact with their supervisor or anyone higher up please let me know.

Worst experience I booked a night and somehow the date got changed, I called no later than 15 minutes later to change it and they said there was nothing they could do. No refund, no changing dates just a big fat waste of money. I definitely would recommend this place to anyone!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Best Chicken Pastor taco ever, carne Asada was so tender and flavorful. Would also highly suggest Pastor bowl. Got my tacos flour instead of corn. Also ask for cream cilantro sauce it went great with all tacos especially the Rock shrimp and Fish tacos. Great service and beautiful atmosphere.

Very good yogurt place. Toppings are good. Could use just a few more flavors. Average prices. A cup of yogurt may cost $4-6, depending on how many toppings you want. Good place to go for a simple tasty treat. The inside is very clean, always. Small space, but fun to visit. I think you will like it. :)

Great pizza! Great place to enjoy with family!! Can't wait to come again! I give this place 5 stars!!! I love all the delishios flavors and seasonings of the pizza the crust is soooooo crispy and just perficly delishios thank u for sharing this awesome experience with us

I ate here for my birthday. I have to say that the service and the atmosphere deserves 5 stars. I am giving it 3 stars because the food is just not what I expected. It is not your typical taco restaurant, they are craft tacos, which some people may love. Just not for me.

So because a guest has a complaint regarding the despicable conditions at your establishment, you feel unsafe and call the police. This is happening too often and such a disappointment. Cut rate service and discriminatory practices that deserve less than one star.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The tamales were pretty good. There was a little more masa than I normally like. I definitely had a problem with the service. I ordered two tamales, no sides. All they had to do was heat them. I waited 20 minutes and had to go up and ask about my order. 5 minutes later the woman brought them out. Not impressed

Randy went above and beyond. Not only was he extremely positive and up beat, he went out of his way to get our car ready for its wash. After the wash he cleaned our floor mats himself while we vacuumed. Very impressed with Randy and will definitely be back!

Food was pretty good, and staff is very friendly, but there are couple things wrong: 
1. If you are gonna charge an extra $7 on top of the $7 base price Caesar salad, you would expect more than 3 shrimp. 
2. Calamari could have used a little more spice
3. Although it was a large delivery, it was a little botched.

Its just not good. Sauce taste like its right out of a can. Sausage is sparse and has no flavor.  Everything is barely edible. I dont yelp, hardly ever. I felt so compelled to review because I'm hoping they will pick up some garlic salt, basil and oregano and go to town with it.

Worst Starbucks ever!! Do yourself a favor by not going there. They took an hour to make one frappe and served so many who came after us. We were driving back from philly and wanted a cup of coffee only. I would not recommend this place to people who are in hurry. I would not even give one star to this place.

Stayed there about 5 years ago and I want too go back
The staff makes you feel very welcome through its a very expensive hotel almost like family. 
The beds feel great a nice looking rooms. If you are a Nhl fan is right across for the hockey arena and I think most of the Nhl teams stay there.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We came on a Monday around 10:30 and the drive through was really busy but the man on the other side was collected and polite as could be. Our service was fast and Pete(?) (older bald gentleman) was very polite and smiling. It's nice to have good complimentary service like that!

This is place is terrible. The rooms were not ready on time. The employee on duty did not not register any guest upon arrival. Instead she chose to yell across the lobby as the rooms were ready. Once the room was ready it had a stinky stench. Luckily we were here for a wedding for one night and will never stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Worst customer service ever the manager said shes gonna call the booking.com for us because she cant find my name in the system even though we had a confirmation number already. She let us wait for more than an hour, i will let my relatives and friends not to go to this hotel they bettet talk to this manager lady.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: we were first timers and are so glad we went!  great food, awesome prices, and a warm ,cozy atmosphere made our party a lot of fun! tommy and mark were great!!  I would recommend chiarellas to any one who asks for the real deal Italian restaurant.   we will be frequent fliers.

Based on the other reviews, we were quite surprised. The lasagna was very ordinary: noodles layered atop each other with no sauce, meat was not flavored at all, just hamburger, just very unremarkable. The marinara had a burned taste. The service was very professional and very good.

This place is terrible . Awful service and rude people . Wouldn't even give me some damn ice . And it's free . So ignorant . And my friend is over here choking no one even cared to give her any water . Like I'm disgusted and I would not come here at all . And someone should report this place for their attitudes here tooo like smh

What a gem of a restaurant!  My husband and I went there today for the first time. It did not disappoint! The food was absolutely amazing! Authentic Italian food at its best! The service was equally impressive.  Cannot wait to go back and bring friends and family! 
Molto bene! Delizioso! Grazie, Mannino's!

We got the platinum package and still dirt, dust and hair throughout the car. Nothing is more disappointing then spending close to $30 for a car wash  and getting into a dirty car. Unfortunately I will no longer be recommending this car wash nor will I go here anymore.  On a positive note the staff was friendly.

THE most dapper experience! Hard wood floors, leather couches and a cold drink offered at the door. Straight out of the '20's. Not to mention the fine cut I received. Very knowledgeable and professional. Taper with a warm foam razor finish. Definitely worth the price. Would recommend to anyone and I normally do.

My boyfriend & I stayed here for one night. We were in town for a wedding. We absolutely loved it! The hotel is beautiful. Plenty of parking. Easy to get to the rooms. Our room was a little small but that's nothing. The bed was so comfortable! & we enjoyed the out door pool. Def will be back!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great bar if you're looking for something outside of the basic Bourbon scene. The DJ was great on Sunday night and they also had hookah but should put "while supplies last" because they ran out. The food looked delicious but I was looking for the nachos but they weren't serving any this night so will try upon my next visit.

This is the best auto wash place in town. Tyler showed great customer service and Griffin was exceptional to work with. He did a fantastic job with my Camaro. He hand washed it with great care and went above and beyond.  I'll come back again and again. Thumbs up!!!

Not the best Chinese food I've ever had. The potstickers were pretty great. The fried rice was ok, and the orange chicken was missing something? I'm really not sure what. Some spicyness, maybe? It was just very one note. It also wasn't that nice crunchy batter, which was disappointing.

Me and my husband went yesterday for pedicures.  We were greeted as soon as we walked and the shop is super clean.  The problem we had neither of them used the tool to remove the tool to remove the rough skin on the bottom of the feet. They need to spend more attention to detail instead of talking.

Went for Lunch today. I was excited they had a black bean quinoa burger!! It was pretty delicious! Service was a little slow and didn't seem like there were too many people there. That's the only bad thing about it, it is tough going there for a 1 hour lunch break!

They quoted me $3,000 for a lot of work that didn't need to be done, were rude when I said I would get a second opinion, and then tried scare tactics to talk me out of it, telling me my wheels would fall off if I drove it off the lot. And all this after an impossibly brief inspection. I got a second opinion and you should too.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I've been going to this place for 9 years and today I had the first bad experience. The lady on the phone messed up the order terribly then when called wouldn't fix or comp the food just said sorry. Definitely the last time I'll go here. Grill 19 for the win

Being from Stl, I do love stl style pizza.  With that said, there is something about New York style that I love.  Racanelli's never seems to disappoint when we order it.  Feraros has always been up there for me (Jersey style), but if I have to choose, the 18 inch pie from Racenalli's hits the spot.

Location is extremely convenient, price is right, selection is good. Lots of international foods which reflect the character of the neighborhood. The place smells fine, and security is usually just a guy who hangs out near the entrance -- more than at most grocery stores I've been to, but nothing too crazy.

We tried breakfast for the second time after the new owners took over.  You can no longer get home made biscuits.  The biscuits are very small and baked from pre formed frozen dough.  Very disappointed in the biscuits. The milk gravy is still good.  Pancakes were also good.

I've been here multiple times and always had a great experience. This morning, I come in for a full set. It was over priced, took two hours when I was the only one in the salon, and they look terrible. The paint is all over my nails. I am very disappointed.

The hotel was very beautiful and in a good location, the valet were the nicest part of the staff,super accommodating. However, the rest of the staff had a "not my job" mentality. The spoke very disrespectfully and gave attitude every chance they had. Didn't really know what was going on. Will definitely not be returning.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Group of ten went in for drinks and appetizers.  Ashley was our waitress and did a superb job.  We all ordered diffetent items and everything was well prepared, tasted great and was served promptly.  Our fourth or fifth visit and we have always had grea t service and good fiid.

We showed up with 8 adults and 3 kids, ordered pizza and salads, 3XL pizza 1 medium and at no point did the gentleman working the counter say that was probably too much pizza for the # of people. Guess it should have been a sign when we were the only ones there, made the quota for the day on our order he did!!

I can leave a one word review...AMAZING!  But i will say more. Our waiter Sel was attentive, knowledgable, and engaging. The food was beyond amazing. The wine selection fantastic, even the house wines are superb. Portions are large so you know you can enjoy it again the next day. This place wont disappoint!

The front desk staff person was friendly, but gave me misinformation  about the restaurant hours.  The bar staff person (Kristy) wasn't attentive and needs to take a course in customer service.  Something weird about the gym HVAC, smells like gasoline in the room.

Lousy...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The negative reviews on here are interesting. $90 a night is such an insanely good value yet they expect perfection. I was in town for a funeral last minute so I only needed to stay for one night. The room is big, clean, quiet. Everything I needed! Complimentary breakfast too. I'd recommend definitely!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The food is great here, but the servers are horrible and very rude, I would not come back here again. They need better staff and managers to run this sushi club, but bottom line is this very unpleasant service I ever had to be honest, with there was a 0 rating and I would give them that Forsure.

Brandon greeted us at the door and was soooo nice. It was our first time in. He let us know how everything went here and it was smooth sailing from there. But then we were graced by grace... she is absolutely an angel. She should be a manager. Hands down the best experience in Tampa.

I ordered qassadea with shrimp on their homemade tortillas. It was delicious, finger licking good. Maria is very pleasant the cook a little serious but what cooks are not. I could tell the food is fresh and he cooks with pride. I'm going back soon for their mole negro next time ;)

These guys guarantee you the exact car you sign up for and they are in perfect condition with blizztak tires (great traction in winter conditions) and ski racks. Their service is great and checking in and out takes minutes rather than sitting in line at the terminal. Highly recommend.

If you want to order here, DO NOT order from grub hub. Took me over 2 hours to get my meal and when I had called (for the second time to check on it) they told me there was no record of my order and they had never made it. All of that trouble for some mediocre food. Never again

The waitresses were really nice but the food was not great at all. I got blueberry pancakes and bacon. The bacon was so overdone that if I were to have thrown it on the floor it would have shattered like glass. The pancakes were also waaay overdone and not edible.

Such a wonderful staff  So caring and understanding. My grandfather cat is not the easiest to deal with. But they did such a Awesome job, never seen Pearl( the cat) so clam. Thank you Thrive for being wonderful, afodable...and so kind. You are the only place I will take my grandfather cat.

Paid $15 for the "second highest" car wash, it didn't even get the bird poop of my side and back window. I feel like the "scrubbing cloth" didn't even really touch my car and your car goes so fast through the wash that you honestly feel like it's not even doing anything expect getting it wet.

Lovely weekend away. We we're expecting mandatory valet that was the only negative. The balcony view and layout of the suite was great. The front desk was very attentive and having Netflix was an absolute plus.  
Very modern , west elm furnishings. Should we revisit Clearwater this hotel would be our choice
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Love love love the breakfast fast service great food .. Closest thing I had to a good old fashion southern breakfast.. Wasn't expecting it to be so good but by the time I had to loosen my belt I was wishing they had another one closer to my home. Next time I'm in bordentown I will be in

Dr. Ross is great! He really knows what he's doing and your exam will be prompt and as quick and painless as possible. The frame selection is good and the staff is very friendly. I've been going here for many years now, and have no problem recommending them.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I go to this subway about once a week since I work near by. Always the same familiar and friendly faces behind the counter. They're super speedy and the quality is always good. Good selection of chips and the soda machine is clean. With covid all the employees wear masks which makes me feel safe.

Hotel is great. Quiet on level 2. Large 2 room near the elevator had no sound issues. Only issue i has was with the bar which charged $10 for a draft beer. Also, it was more than $20 for a beer and a shot of Jameson. More than airport prices. Go across the road and get decent costs.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Stayed here for business.  My updated room had a very musty smell.  Humidity in the room was bad, no matter how low I had the temperature on the a/c. 

Gave this place 3 stars because I loved the salmon dinner at the restaurant onsite!!!  Also, the bar has a nice wine list.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Cars are pretty good.  Watch out for Victor.  If you need assistance or help with anything, don't go to him.  He stands in the lot looking like he'll help, but he's rude and not a people person.  Debating going back to national after dealing with him.  And yes I rent national cars frequently.  Over 315 rental days last year.

Nice place, but lunch was disappointing. My husband ordered a draft beer that smelled like vinegar and tasted flat. The California Wrap had bland chicken and literally one drop of guacamole. The French fries were cold. The croissant on the other sandwich was hard and the tomatoes were white and tasteless. Service was good.

The family and I dined here tonight. Nice little restaurant - certainly not a 5 star environment. 

But the food was GREAT!!

We had a large Sicilian square pizza that was very nice. Also recommend the garlic knots with marinara sauce for an appetizer.

If you are okay with small and quaint - you will love the food here!!

This was a major disappointment. This place was hyped up by some acquaintances. I had chips and salsa to start good not great. Then I had chicken tacos and shrimp tacos NOT GOOD at all. Chicken was bland shrimp had some kick bang bang sauce style but NOT GOOD

This place is awful. I booked a reservation to pick up a car and was emailed a confirmation email with the type of car i was to be receiving. I get here and they say "oh we don't have a car for you". horrible communication, staff is not helpful nor do they care. DO NOT COME HERE.

We ate in the restaurant (vs takeout) and had an excellent dinner experience!  We ordered the Baltimore, Cracker and rainbow rolls - one of a kind recipes and delicious!  We had excellent service and loved the atmosphere. We will definitely be going back and highly recommend!

Sucks.. coming from Massachusetts to get Sicilian and Stromboli since we don't have that in Massachusetts. The sauce was not good what so ever, it tasted like plant based sauce hoagies are good there but nothing else. Stromboli was too thin, too much dough. Hopefully it'll improve but not it.

Took my kids here for Sunday Brunch, food was not fresh. Some trays were empty. Pancakes were like hockey pucks, sticky buns were dried out. Very disappointing first time trying the buffet, would recommend people drive a few more minutes up the road and go to Hennings instead.

I d rather give them no star for rating!!! I brought 7pieces to there and two garments are completely damaged! they were like"If you done not pay the entire price ($160), I won't let you take them" people there are sooo RUDE!!!! They don't have the basic knowledge about fabric!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Great place in Chestnut Hill for sushi. My friend and I both got the Honeymoon roll which was delicious. The restaurant is a pretty small space, would not recommend for large groups. Perfect for a girls night with your BFF or date night. Make a reservation ahead of time!

The tamales are amazing here and there are lots of flavor options. We love the blue corn! 
The set up is very family friendly. We have two young kids and we felt very welcome and comfortable. 
The salsa bar is excellent. They need to sell cans of their Sherry salsa. 
The bathrooms have been very clean each time we have gone.

This is our second time there and we love it. The first, time we didn't really spend much time there but this time around we went to the pool and spent time in our room relaxing. The only thing I didn't like was the bugs in the pool and all around it. Granted we were by the Water but it wasn't relaxing.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We are regulars here at Ooka. Whether it's Hibachi or Sushi, Ooka knocks it out of the park! Hibachi is always delicious. My favorite is the Filet and Chicken. Sushi is always fresh and delicious. Try the Ooka Shrimp Dragon Roll and CB West Roll. Sashimi is also incredible. Make sure to visit Ooka!

The husband and I took a walk down the Riverside and stopped over at the restaurant. We had the salmon and grouper. It was delish! I'm very impressed- it actually has a really good flavor. We also had prawns 2 ways. Not very impressed by it-It was very typical.

One of my favorite sushi places I go to. I go here at least once a month. Its BYOB!! Their deals are amazing and you dont have to spent more than $20 for two people with the 2 for $20 deal. You can get soup, an appetizer and two dishes (or 6 rolls). Highly recommend this place

I am a platinum member staying at many Starwood hotels, I thought it was dogs allowed universal for Starwood.  Not at this sheraton four points.  They even have a 150 fine posted for having a dog.   Disappointing that sheraton four points doesn't follow all other Starwood hotels.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We were passing by Reno and decided to grab a bite. I was craving tacos we found Lupita's Mexican Restaurant. The service is great, the food is delicious and their prices are really good. To bad I live in AZ otherwise I would make this my go to spot. It's a restaurant bar but again the food is delishhh

Went Sunday morning, was not busy. Had a simple order at the speaker. Got to the window and had to give them my order again. Had to pull over, which was not a big deal, to wait for my food and drinks. Food was brought out but no drinks. Had to again repeat half of my order. Never once was the employee apologetic for the service.

Not such a special spot. The portions are ridiculously tiny! Really?  The "taco" is two bites!  The salad, bean salad...served in a tiny bowl like for a kids meal!    I've been twice, wont waste my money I was still hungry when I left!   Serve decent sized meals and maybe I'll be ale to enjoy a couple of cocktails to wash it down.

We ordered General Tso chicken. There was enough food there for the two of us. Their fried rice was really good but the chicken wasn't as crispy as I like it to be. The crab wontons were disappointing. The dough was too thin and there was too much sweetness on the inside.

It's so close to the house, we try and go thinking it will be better but it never is. The service is always slow, we always have to ask for water. My girlfriend loves their margaritas though. 

I think the real reason I don't care for this place is their chips, they always taste old.

Absolute favorite restaurant in Nashville. From the wine list to the dessert. Everything was fantastic! Highly recco the Chicken for Two, and the corn bread. The corn bread is to die for and melts in your mouth. The chicken was cooked to perfection, and the potatoes were yummy and crispy.

Went in and got a "mini" pizza , 9 inch pizza supposedly. Definitely was not 9 inches . Also got two drinks . We spent a total of $17.00 . They don't bring the food to you, nor do your refills. The pizza was just bleh. Wasn't very good and VERY GREASY. Next time I'll be taking my business to dominos .

4 stars for the food. No stars for the fact that we made a reservation, and the restaurant was almost empty, yet we were seated right near the kitchen where several servers bumped into my companion repeatedly. If you make a reservation here, make sure to specify not to be sat by the kitchen. Otherwise service was ok.

Well the name speaks to their service level and attention to detail. You get what you pay for and sometimes it works out and other times it's a hassle. Had issues regarding a misquote of price so really read the agreement and confirm changes are correct. Likely they will have issues so look twice, I didn't and I lost out.

I love this barber shop!!!
John and Moe are amazing!! I would drive from Jacksonville just to get my haircut. Only wish they were closer to me in NY!! But when I do come to NPR I love getting a fresh cut by them!!!!!

Highly highly highly recommend!!!!!

Good with kids too!

This restaurant refuses to seat singles.  Instead they insist you sit in the bar--which is incredibly noisy.  And after two experiences here-- sitting each time in the bar, I am very unimpressed with both the food And the service.  The food is overpriced and the service is impersonal.  Nice location though!  44everdpbroman

Of the few hotels in the Carpinteria area my family and I agree this  is our favorite one due to the comfortable beds, breakfast included and the very nice pool and spa. 

My only complaint was it was very expensive to stay there during the summer. 

However I do recommend this hotel as the best one in the Carpinteria area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Although our one bedroom king no smoking room was nice...our inlaws weren't very lucky. They had an ant infestation in their room along with mold. Also the stairwell is like 120 degrees with only one vending machine working. Front desk lady was ok but front lobby reeks of smoke. This place was 110% better as La Quinta
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I went here in October while visiting Santa Barbara. The food was so good we decided to go here for a second time instead of getting dinner in town or on the pier.
The place is open late, the food is good and not too pricey, and the waitresses were great both times we went.
I highly recommend Edomasa.

This was our first time trying this place out and we were very disappointed. Our pizza was overcooked and the crust had hard pieces that my son could barely bite. We also waited 40 minutes to get a pie to come out like this. The garlic knots were pretty good. Just not my pizza!

This hotel is one of the worst I've every stayed.   The lobby smells like smoke.   The water was turned off tonight.  Dirty and hasn't been renovated in years.  I wouldn't stay here again.  The corridors are long and haven't been renovated.  Amazing that people stay here at will.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Came here after a day of meetings and it did not disappoint. Went for the short rib based on some reviews and it was delicious.  It came with a knife, but I didn't even need to look at it! The neat was tender and paired perfectly with the greens. Topped off with an expresso creme brulee that was the perfect touch.

I can't believe this place only has 9 reviews so here I am. I have loved these flavors and staff for as long as I can remember. It's consistent. For the past 25ish years they always have the great water ice and consistent service :) my favorite flavor is honeydew.

This is consistently the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to. Drive through and inside are both painfully slow. And I have tried at all different times - weekdays, weekends, afternoons and evenings. I am always sorry when I decide to stop and grab something. Terrible service

One Star is as low as I can award. 
The absolute WORST MCDONALDS EVER!!!!
The management is absent and doesn't seem to care. The staff is poorly trained and can't be bothered to fix what was a minor issue but has now turned into a digital vendetta. 
Go ANYWHERE other than this place or you will regret it. I promise.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We had an awesome stay at the Q & C. In a town where the tourist vibe dominates this hotel is a most excellent alternative with both a cool boutique feel and a location that allows you to quickly jump to either the more local warehouse & garden districts or cross over Canal St to Bourbon. Definitely recommend this joint
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The one and only time I have been to this dunkin they forgot to charge a meal in which  a very rude older gentleman with a mustache called me up to the counter and yelled at the cashier. To top off the experience following the fiasco he made the wrong meal for me. I think if I return it will be strictly for coffee!

We went there based on the ratings as we were traveling through St. Louis. The place was mediocre at best.  Service was slow, they were clearly understaffed. The tables were sticky and felt dirty. The pizza was fine, the cesar salad was very average. An unmemorable experience.

The lattes are amazing! We tried the chocolate chip cookie and maple and we're very impressed. Service was a little slow because they were packed, but our waitress, Nina, was very attentive and polite. We tried the farmers cheese snack and loved it! Plenty for 2-4 people to share.

Use to go here all the time but the last 2 times i was disappointing  last time they forgot my calamari and it was over cooked and chewy this time they got the order right but the calamari was uneadible this is the u.s 19 location will have to try the little red location

I have been coming here for 10 years. But the last 2 years they changed all the new staff they do terrible job. I will stop going there. I was there 3 weeks ago not only I wasn't satisfied with the lady but she also charged me $3 extra for buffering. Is it that part of the pedicure since I didn't want polish????????

The idea of a more "green" hotel experience is a good one. Aloft's approach is minimalistic. The layout of the room, however, is s bit odd, a long pleather bench ( suitcase holder?) stationed under a mounted television. The beds were less comfortable than most hotel chains and the sheets were a bit scratchy.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Great haircut, great shave, great environment. 

If you're looking for the classic gentleman's barbershop, look no further. From the vintage chairs to the detail on the ceiling, these guys knocked it out of the park.

I got a straight razor shave and a haircut by Troy. This guy knows what he's doing.

Service was good, staff is nice, however the pizza was underwhelming. We got a slice of cheese pizza that was way overdone with part of the crust missing. The rest of the slices we ordered were also over baked. The whole pizza was nicely baked. It will not be a place that I will likely return to.

This is odds on the best restaurant in Delaware. Had a cheese plate, caprese sals, and two small plates (rack of lamb and bay scallops). Everything was fantastic. 
And the pour from the bar on my Woodford was GENEROUS... 
service was top notch. 
Go eat here.

I've only seen one show there and the staff was helpful. Not a large venue but not a small venue and the sound was was really good.  Unfortunately because of the smoking allowed inside I can't go back because of health issues.  It's a shame because a lot of good bands play there that I would like to see.

This hotel is very cute and clean. The location is not far from John's pass and the beach is right out back. There is also a pool and a huge hot tub. The day I stayed at Schooner Hotel, I was able to check in early which was a lifesaver. Jimmy at the front desk was so nice and helpful. I would definitely stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Very rude service. Dani our cashier was quite deaf and probably should think about getting some kind of personality. Not to mention, the barista I was kindly informing that their vanilla shaker was empty snapped at me for telling her so. Makes sense that she is better off not wearing a name tag.

This place was highly recommended by friends, so I tried it once and it was ok. I went back again to have my hair cut short for the first time in ages. My hairdressers next appointment came in, so they made me leave with my hair still wet, after a dramatic chop. It was October and cold out.

We went here to celebrate my 30th birthday on Saturday.  The food was excellent and Jerome was the best waiter!  He was extremely attentive and knowledgeable and really made the experience wonderful.  We are planning our next trip to New Orleans and we will definitely stop by and see him!

When it comes to technology, they are way behind. Most of the people are nice except for one teller who everytime I go there will just day "Hi" and give my receipt after without any pleasantry. Not a friendly lady at all. Always with a long face. CM are her initials. I bank there because it's close to my workplace.

Anthony and Elizabeth (Liz) made the experience a hassle. They had poor customer service skills and the entire branch was unprofessional. Save yourself the trouble and choose another Enterprise location or car rental company. I have filed a complaint against this location due to their bad business ethics.

Roma used to be great and well ran, seems like there is new owners now and it has gone down. Wait times are insane you order and pickup it's never ready when it says it's going to be. Food is still great but when each time it's the same story we've now will stop going here.

I'm not huge on the 4 Points brand of Starwood but for this one I make an exception. One of the nicest no wait the nicest 4 Points I've ever stayed in. New, very nice. Great room, great service plus they give both the points and a full breakfast and a damn fine breakfast it is . Highly recommended.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Why is zero not an option?
Food was cold, they messed up or forgot half of our order, half of the drinks were out on the machine, and the customer service was awful. Even if I got this food free, I wouldn't want it.
Save yourself the trouble and go anywhere else but here.

It's really hit or miss here. Sometimes you get an awesome haircut that is just perfect. Other times you get a cut that you could've done better yourself. But if you're only paying less than $15 for a haircut with no appointment, sometimes you just have to roll the dice. Besides, it always grows back.

Very overpriced and will try to scam you. Charged us for a bogus cup of ice we didn't buy and acted confused when we called him out on it. Said it was the customer before us. But he rang it up on our receipt. They probably do that to drive up their sales, hoping people won't notice.

Their burgers are simple, but amazing. No need for a million toppings and a fancy bun... Fountain Porter's nailed the classic backyard BBQ burger with lettuce, tomato, and cheese on a classic bun. (You know, the ones that come in an 8 pack?)  And for just $5 you can't go wrong. Great beer selection too.

I had dinner here last night. There were 3 of us and we ordered their minestrone soup and several entres. The minestrone was especially tasty and we highly recommend it. I had a vegetable pasta dish with artichoke and tomatoes which was also good. I recommend this place.

Pros: Great location and amazing outdoor ambience! Would love to eat here again because of this. 

Cons: Too costly for such a small slice. They charge for water. I asked for side of pizza sauce and they gave me frozen sauce in a small container. Wtf. Why would I eat frozen pizza sauce. I guess they are not big on customer service.

Bar taco is a cool New Mexican style restaurant. It had great service and good food when I went with my friend. Overall the restaurant was pretty good there were only two things the cramped table space and they forgot my friend's salad all in all it was good I am looking forward to go again

Probably the worst place to go for Quality products and service from what Iv seen all this place is worried about is money more than their employees I've seen many people being forced to go get shopping carts in the rain by their managers with it lightning here also I will never go to a place that doesn't respect their employees

So I am a regular customer here. Sat at sushi bar alone. Was completely ignored for 20 minutes when I arrived then after the first order was again completely ignored for another 20 minutes. IM NOT HAPPY! IVE SPENT SO MUCH MONEY THERE AND EVEN HAVE A SWEATSHIRT, which I happened to be wearing and was still ignored! Food was good.

Avis Philly airport saved me in a super pinch. Having had flights cancel and reroute I was forced to rent a car to drive home. Avis was cheaper, they were fast, helpful and really calmed my nerves in a tough situation. Thank you to Elda who was great and sped me on my way.

Nice trendy place for brunch. Great service with good presentation. Omelette was excellent with smoked Gouda. Interesting however that they charged for the onions and peppers in the omelette and for one slice of sourdough toast. What a surprise when we got our check.... We left feeling like we were taken advantage of!i

Not enthused about my stay here. The lighting is fluorescent and cold, the carpet is dingy, and there is rust in the bathroom. Also, why is the sink outside of the bathroom??? Would not recommend this as a place to stay - go to the Airport Marriott if you need a place close to the Airport in Nashville!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I had to wait for about 15 mins after my scheduled appointment, just because the Doc was with other customer. The Doc was friendly and had a good check Up!
Kep in mind that you might need checkUp once an year or once two years. Although I had a check Up within 7 months!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I have frequented this place every Friday for years, but the owner has always been a little rude.  Today, he messed up my order and refused to fix it.  That was the third time this year that our orders were messed up.  The food is ok but the prices and service are terrible.  My coworkers and I will not go there for lunch anymore.

Im a student that i attending NAA and the thing that got me to like this place is Miss Sondra her personality is what i like bout this place she is willing help in anyway possible that she can...and shes the person you want to have a as a friend because she tries to go and beyond to help people.

I tried this place a few times just to be sure with different technicians. It was awful each time. The last time I went the older technician put so many coats of polish on my nails and pulled me out of the heat too soon that the gel peeled off later that night. I'd go somewhere else unless you're extremely desperate.

This publix is by far the worst. Product selection is sub par by others and all garden selection is always close to expiring. Even the services such as getting chicken tenders  or whatnot seem to be not properly stocked or they stop making it sooner than other stores.

Confusing.  Flyers located all over the hotel about meal special.  Go to restaurant and no service staff to be found.  Go to hotel desk and they say they'll get someone they may be busy. With what I have no idea but no one was being waited on.  Just weird.

Placed a mobile order on 2/25/2020 around 12 to pick up a footlong. Received a 6 in. that looked tossed around and mashed. Only two employees managing the drive-thru & dine in. Line out the door. Didn't receive a paper receipt in bag. I will be going back for the other half of my sandwich.

I got a sandwich and the lettuce on it was rotting and the service was absolutely horrible. I walked it with me and my co workers and we got some nasty stares from the managers and staff, we are landscapers and obviously we are gonna be dirty but still we were treated unfair and i wouldn't recommend this place EVER..
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Ideal location at affordable price. Parking, breakfast and happy hour, but best feature is the staff and proprietors. Rooms small, but very comfortable. Furnishings in the shabby-chic style. Walk to the Dali and waterfront. Planned just one night, but stayed 2.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Decided to try the Farmer's Daughter restaurant out after hearing it's a really good place to eat. The service was excellent but the food to me didn't match the price. Nothing that was really special and didn't leave me wanting more.  Doubtful if I'd go back!

Had lunch there today with family the food was good but the service was poor the waitress could not remember the orders it was a mess.  I've never been a waitress but what's wrong with writing it down if you can't remember six orders.  I was DONE!  Everyone was about finish eating when I got my food.

We had a terrific breakfast. The new owner has a real talent, he makes a lot of homemade items such as noodles, scraple (which is a type of sausage) and strawberry jam. The service was great and the coffee was hot.
Give it another try if you were here with the other owner. I'm coming back for lunch. 
Now called Hilary 's Roadhouse.

I had not read the reviews prior to checking in or I probably would not have stayed. I did not experience any of the negative situations expressed by other reviewers. The hotel is older but clean. Staff was friendly and location was great.  I would stay here again.
I suggest that management should respond to negative reviews.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The ambiance was odd, the restaurant was almost empty and they still scrambled to seat us. The food was very good, but as we were getting ready to leave we saw a white mouse. White! Aren't pet mice white? It was a very horrible way to end the meal and we were more than happy to flee.

Pretty disappointed. Went to dinner with friends. Eggplant was kind of bland compared to last time. We really loved the cheese cake previously but they've changed it, not a fan. Also looked at my receipt today,had 1 Caesar salad, noticed they charged me for 2 salads. Waiter was a bit short attitude wise. We probably won't go back.

Never been to a Wendy's that was out of everything that I tried to order off the menu, fucking disgusted makes no sense for a fast food chain to be out of so much stuff or the entire staff on shift today (11/21/18 @ 4pm) was just too lazy to do a simple job.

Mr. Ali went above and beyond in handling my recent car rental! He was helpful in setting me up in a car that was above my expectations. He knew I had a specific need for my long weekend rental and made sure I had just the right car. I will be returning there and highly recommend this location,

I was looking for a nearby place to take my girlfriend for Valentine's Day and we ended up at Kai. It was quiet when we were there despite it being a Saturday night, which was great! The vibe of the place is real laid back and made dinner extra nice. The food was amazing and well priced for the portions you got!

Sushi is good and cheap when going to happy hour. Me and my family like our sushi with lemon,, every time we ask them for lemon they literally bring out about two slices for 5 people. Now I found out that their charge for lemon which i find completely ridiculous and cheap on their part. who charges for lemons?

Jack at the front desk is amazing. They were very helpful getting acclimated to the area. The hotel is centrally located. The only thing was woken up by the housekeeper who knocked at 8 am twice to clean the room. I work late as I have International calls. It is a nice hotel with friendly staff in a good location .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Literally the worst hotel experience I've ever had; my room wasn't cleaned for four days and the staff are utterly incompetent. Worst still, my attempts to complain were blocked by a 'pass the book' culture. Do not diminish your trip to New Orleans by staying here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Booked through Expedia.  One person at the counter who could get exactly nothing done. They had a daytime talk show playing at 120 decibels right next to the line. This place does not have their act together. I had to rebook and take a shuttle back to the airport.

We are two families with kids on vacation which makes it difficult for all to agree what and where to eat.  I can say, with a more than satisfied belly, everyone was content!!!  The food was above and beyond!!! Fresh, tasty and delicious!!!!  Wonderful experience in the Big Easy!!

Very happy with my first visit for a regular mani and pedi.  The place was clean, cheerful and nicely decorated.  The staff was attentive and friendly. I felt the quality was very good and the price was quite reasonable  @ $40 + tip.   I definitely plan to go back there.

Kid at the end of the counter doesn't know what customer service is.  Hint:  When a customer asks a question about the menu, don't point to the menu.  Classic reason why people who work at McDonald's do not deserve $15.00 an hour.  This place could benefit from the hamburger vending machines.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Do not let this place scare you off... location is sketchy...   and the vibe is still out of a truck but the FOOD is amazing!!! Do it - it's cheap and sooooo good.   People come and visit me and I take them here..  they always think I'm a little off from all the desert heat UNTIL the first bite...

Great stay! If your like me and the first thing you check is the beds/bedding, the beds were clean and the bed frame is metal which was good. Breakfast was great and checkout was noon, which if you are a night owl like me then that extra hour helps. Great customer service. Hot tub was a plus!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Hotel staff are professional, friendly and very helpful.  Rooms are priced well given the perfect location to all the sites to see for a family or for business meetings in the city.  Rooms are larger than typical embassy suites hotels.  Agree with other comments, the omelet chef is great to watch and he makes a perfect omelet.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This is mediocre food, at best. The quality is average, but the food is flavorless. It's reasonably priced for an airport ($9 for one wrap,) but you can just as easily go to Starbucks for a higher quality wrap. I will not be purchasing food from here again.

Very good food and service. Very loud and annoying proprietor bragging about his food such that I could not hear my guest. Very very loud and annoying atmosphere.  Food good and service okay.  The proprietor should stop bragging, let his food speak for itself, and not SHOUT in my ear while I wait for our appetizer to show up LATE.

This was our first time to a Pi and we were happy we stopped!  Our waiter, Sam, was very slow.  Took forever to come to our table and wasn't very attentive.  Pizza was great and came quick.  We had a thin crust.  The thick looked really good too!  We will definitely return!

A nice place to go when your looking for a late night meal. Sushi is pretty good but one complaint is that every time we go we notice the sushi rolls are very loosely rolled which makes it messy and difficult to eat. Service and atmosphere are both good, to me the perk is sushi at 12 am!

Was in town and excited about their two vegan options. They had vegan Oreo coffee and a coconut option. I couldn't decide so I got them both. The Oreo coffee was very strong!!! Not bad at first, but after a few spoonfuls it got to be too much, same thing with the coconut. I would recommend one scoop.

Happy Days are here again. Is this really Jersey? This retro style diner was absolutely awesome. We were going to go to Amy's, but the long line there scared us away. Here it was less crowded and food is just as good. get omelettes. For $6 - 7 dollars the portions were huge. By far the best deal here.

Nice place, had the garlic rolls, salad and pizza. The service was ok the place wasn't really that busy. Had the house dressing which had way to much oil in it. The garlic rolls are just that garlic. The best part of the meal was the pizza, great taste fresh ingredients cooked just right.

The food and salsa is bland. Literally no service. With only one other couple in the restaurant it's not like they were too busy. Many times we waited and waited until I had to get up multiple times to ask for anything. With so many better options available in Carp we will not be back

Parking and access is a little rough so they lost a star for location.    This is a store with a very nice whisky selection, extremely helpful staff and a warm atmosphere.    Their website is helpful if you want to search ahead of your visit - but a quick call and they are happy to confirm if something is in stock or not.

Always check your take out order. The employees that they have working there evidently don't speak the English language and can never get your order right. It makes no sense on why you have to repeat your order to them when they're going to get it wrong anyway.

We were seating at the bar and there were two bar tenders helping us, a guy and a young woman both were great, super nice and friendly, and fast. We had a great time there, drinks were goods and food tasty to our liking. I would recommend this place to a friend.

This place has horrible customer service. They charged extra to wash a small SUV and don't notify you before they hand you their ticket. When we approached the owner, he was very rude and said I shouldn't come back. I have never been treated like this in my life.

The food was dry and missing all of the flavor. I'd have to say that I caught them on a bad day because I've never gotten food this bad from them before. I have no pictures because after the first bite, I tossed it in the trash. I've been to a good McDonald's before and this wasn't it.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This location is so shady.  Online, it will tell you they close at 930, but the last two times i've called to place an order, once at 722 and once at 830, they answered and said "Italian Pie we're actually closed."  Hmmm sittin' here in the shadows cuz they throwin' all that shade...

This place was OK but not really that great in the flavor department. I always judge on the California rolls because they are the easiest to make and if you mess that up well........ anyways i wouldn't go here again, but who's to stop you from going and having your own experience. Sorry Bonzai but I'm just not a fan.

Just visited Yapple for the first time. Will never return. The guy working was SO rude & disrespectful (tall skinny guy with a bun) . Not only did he completely ruin our experience but come to find that all of the toppings were stale & so hard you couldn't even eat them.

The shrimp and crab cake appetizer is amazing!! We had the grilled chicken and the manicotti entrees. The manicotti was great, as expected, but the chicken really surprised us. It's delicious! Highly recommend. The tiramisu is also lovely. Everyone on the staff was welcoming, courteous, and helpful. Dining here was a delight!

Have enjoyed some Christmas shows there. Only went on Tues. & Sat. for Pulse take-over nights. Pretty rowdy crowd with drag shows. Smoke outside on porch. Bars are not fancy, feels like a dive bar in a nicer venue. The inside is really big and takes a lot to fill.

They an okay job on the outside of my car, but when it comes to the inside -- where I specifically asked for a wipe down and a vacuum -- I still have so much dog hair and nothing in my car was touched. I would take pictures but I have already cleaned it myself.

Horrible. Sunny is rude as shit. It's ridiculous. She always has an attitude like someone shit in her coffee. She charges people what she feels , how the fuck is a refill 55$ ?? It's unfortunate because her daughter is gem and I hate to talk about someone's mom but she's a bitch flat out. Customer service isn't her expertise.

This hotel was okay. The room was clean and everything was in working order. It's kind of dated though. There have been attempts to make improvements, but they fall short due to shotty work (I.e., poor tile job in bathrooms). It was an acceptable place to lay our heads during a long road trip, but probably wouldn't stay again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We are regulars enjoying lunch at OOKA; husband always has the roll special, I usually have one of the Bento box choices. Always delicious! Includes the yummy salad and miso soup. The meal can easily be completed in an hour to fit working schedules but there is no hurry if you wish to linger.

STAY AWAY. If compassion and care is what you are looking for, this isn't the place. The entire staff is disingenuous and clearly doesn't care about the well being of the animals they get paid to take care of. If your furry companion is in need, this is the last place you should resort to.

I am a Midwest native who grew up on Pantera's and Imo's Pizza, I must say this pizza was fabulous. Pi is like a pizza boutique...freshest ingredients I've had in a while.

We came here for my best friend's 35th b'day and she loved it. The Chocolate Chip Cookie with ice cream was to die for as well.

I have heard about Dunkin Donuts being the best anywhere.  I wasn't impressed.  They did not have much flavor, were a rather dry, and nothing special.   I thought at least their cronut would be good - but that was dry too ... and way to expensive for what it was.

Amazing credit union! Great service. Staff are all sincere and work with a smiling face. Breanna M. was a huge help when opening a new account and provided all necessary information and answered all of our questions with ease. I would definitely recommend you go and see her if you're interested in starting an account.

I am beyond disappointed with the service I received from this establishment. Not only was my food cold, but the hamburgers were less than half the size of regular McDonald's hamburger. They were like joke hamburgers or something. Is that what you think I am McDonald's??? A joke?????
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: If I could give zero stars I would. This place was terrible. Awful customer service, very dirty, people were packed in like sardines and not following COVID guidelines. Waited an hour for a table even though I had a reservation and left because I still wasn't being seated. I will not be returning

Just not the same.  This place used to be so charming, but not any more.  Prices are very high, food portions are small and not really that tasty.  Ambience is none existent; with bright lights and a noisy refrigerator.  Save yourself the time and money and go somewhere else

Amazing service and an incredible atmosphere! Zach was a fantastic server, very knowledgeable and a pleasure to talk to. If I could give more than 5 stars, I absolutely would. I am beyond satisfied with my experience and look forward to coming back many more times in the future

As most everyone has said, they are part of the kayak search engine that sends you through Priceline for a super cheap rental, but not really. $2,000 credit card deposit was requested for the trip, and after reading the reviews on here, luckily I did not go through with it. What a scam.

We have tried to go there several times. The ONLY time we were actually able to eat there was for lunch. Last call is at 8:45pm on Friday nights! What is that??? Bartenders are rude... service is terrible! Not a place to go to have a drink and watch a game...

Very surprised by the poor quality of the pizza. There was a Pizzeria Vecchia that was replaced with this place which was considerably better. The pizza itself was bland, salty, and greasy. The wings tasted old and over cooked.  The staff was friendly and was the reason I gave a few stars.

This hotel is truly beautiful and a top notch Hilton hotel in Franklin, TN.   We live locally but had to stay due to some work going on at our house.  The staff from the bar to the front desk were very engaging and welcoming.  Our king bedded room was very clean with beautiful view of the hills of Tennessee.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Cheesesteak Stromboli was fantastic as usual. We also had a very good calzone and wings.Our pizza was slightly off though, I think it was just a little soggy from the steam coming out of the oven and being put in the box for delivery.  Delivery was pretty quick as well.

This place has the best pizza I ever had. The ingredients are simple, but it is executed very well. It is almost enigmatic, because it seems like a generic pizza place but the quality of their food is outstanding.  I can't speak to why other people disliked it; everyone else I know who tries it loves their pizza.

This place isn't bad. Not too many choices at terminal c, so if you need a quick bite I recommend it. I got the Santa Fe wrap and liked it well enough. Service is great; staff is friendly. It's a little pricey, but I guess it's what you expect at an airport.

Stumbled upon this cute cafe while in town for a soccer tournament. So glad our boys wanted MickyDs, otherwise, we would have missed out on this farm to table cafe.  The cafe is a warm and inviting, the waitstaff is friendly and the food, delicious! I had the lump crab cake with hazelnut grits and and onion pesto.

Delicious deep dish pizza with fresh ingredients and great flavors! I got the small deep dish with half "South Side Classico" and "East Loop". So yummy!! Also loved the selection of beverages, which included local breweries on tap. 

Will absolutely be back next time I'm back in STL!

Swung through for a cash wash... thought it was pricey for $30.... then I got a crappy was and it took and had to wait an hour... I told them and they wiped a couple spots with a towel vs running it back through... Note: my car wasn't that dirty to start with...

WWAAYY over priced meals. A simple lunch order of a taco, enchilada and rice and beans was $14 dollars! Again, this was a lunch time price! The portion was VERY small as well. This use to be a decent place to eat but they've shrunk the portions and doubled the pricing.. I won't be back..

I love my apartment and the staff at River Point. I have lived here a year and I am happy to say I will be renewing my lease to stay another year. Everyone here is very friendly, work gets done quickly and they have added some really nice features to the community. I highly recommend River Point if you a need great place to live!

My husband and I have been going here for 5 years. Wonderful family run Italian restaurant with excellent food! Very authentic dishes. Love the decor and friendly atmosphere. A little on the noisy side when busy but that is also part of their charm. Reminds you of a good Italian family dining room!

The food and the service here were excellent !! My boyfriend and I arent from Reno but our server Mark gave us amazing recommendations for places to check out. The calamari 10/10 !! Also I got the sea bass and WOW, cooked perfectly, the rice and the sauce with it were phenomenal. Will be back again !

My server was absolutely amazing his name was Jody... he completely looked out for my party of 16 and rocked it! 
I had a great time good food and I would recommend anyone to come here and enjoy yourself. 
Water melon mimosas were great as well. 
Jody truly made our time here amazing and I will forever ask for him.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This was a great hotel and very affordable!  The rooms were spacious and very clean. I LOVED that they had dishes and silverware - made me feel like I was at home. The staff was very friendly and professional!  I definitely plan to stay here whenever I'm home visiting my family! It was also a great location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Pulled in showed security camera signs, parked across from the lobby entrance.  The rooms were clean but dated.  Staff friendly and helpful, but during the night my gas tank was drained by thieves .  Woke up to an almost empty tank.  It's park at your own risk and they stand by it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Service here was horrible!! I had to get a waitress to take our order, not only did she take it wrong she brought us wrong drinks. Waitresses were just hanging around the cash register not paying attention to costumers.  Food was cold. Just an overall bad experience

I just got the worst haircut that I have had after 74 years on this planet.  I was in the barber chair all of four or  five minutes. When I commented on the short time for a haircut. I was told "all of my haircuts take about that long".  Apparently this barber had never been to a real barber.

We ate here last evening with some friends and we absolutely loved it! Food was great, drinks were too. But most of all, we had great service!! Would love to shout out to Heather, our fantastic bartender/waitress! She was so sweet, funny, and skilled at her job. What an asset to the Social she is!

I have been trying to pay my Loan online and can't.  I have been trying to call someone to make a payment but can't get anyone on the phone. There a credit union and use that as a excuse to give horrible service.  Who would want to put there money in such a backwards bank.

One of the best burgers I've ever had.  I don't know how they do it. But the burger was perfectly charred on the outside and still medium/medium rare on the inside. It's not anything fancy. But if you're looking for an amazing burger this is the place to go.

The lady at the counter asked me if I could afford to extend my rental. I think because I was black she felt I didn't have money.  
She then charged me 4 times the amount on a 44 dollar rental. When you ask for a manager they ignore you . Very obnoxious. Ghetto establishment

very good pizza and great  food in general...ive never ordered anything that wasnt really good...since i order out a lot,i can say they are consistant too...the only bummer is theyre closed on sundays.....i fashion myself as a pizza connoissuer and always pick bellisimos over the other local pizza places.......

This bank is terrible. Opened an account, deposited money, in person, then they shut down my account the next day due to "not being able to verify my identity" and sent me a paper check. All of this without a phone call or email from them letting me know there's a problem. F*ck Bank of America

The owner is rude and lost two pants that belong to a set of suits.  He said he was too busy to listen to me and walked away.  If I could give less than one star I would.  Don't take anything here you will be treated like crap and your clothes will be lost!!! This place is a scam.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Keeping it simple-- great design for a donut shop, creative creations, and loved the shirts. 


Ridiculously slow barista, tables and floor need cleaned, and donuts were good but not great.   


I'll come back in a few months hopefully the kinks are worked out

Started going to these guys about a year ago.  Danny does my toes and Kathy my fingers.  Both are extremely professional and I always leave there happy.  They have yet to disappoint and I would tell anyone to take their business there.  The salon is also beautiful and extremely clean.

We have never been disappointed at Moro. The truffle fries are out of this world, and every starter and entree is excellent. 

The wine selection is a little lacking right now, but apparently they are going through a "transition."

Overall, I completely recommend Moro for any occasion.

I have been to uncle's several times, I have always made an appointment and I always have to wait about 20 minutes to finally get seated in a chair. It doesn't help that every time I go in it seems like there is a whole different staff. Save yourself the time and go to Roosters in Cool Springs.

The place is super unprofessional, i got a room with 2 beds on one of the beds the sheets had blood on them the other bed yellow stains. The bathroom dose not flush. The freezer over frozen. This place gets this one star only because A.C was cold. Never again
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Fun and friendly. Would be better with a few TVs but the pizza was great. Sweet sauce, flavorful cheese and the hamburger was amazingly seasoned. Crust would have been superb with a bit of oil and pepper. Got have dip for those pizza bones. Would recommend.

Decided to try this place since It was really close to my hotel.  It's Just a little local Midwest bar with some great bar food.  Service was good and drink were strong.  Had the steak sandwich (medium cook) with onions and lettuce. Good seasoning on the steak and a good medium cook.  I would definitely get it again.

The lady who works there is so nice. I couldn't have done it without her encouragement and assistance--I'm intimidated by automatic car washes.  So either my car goes dirty or someone has to help me. Often my car just goes dirty. Now that I know how to use this one I will use it every time.  Many thanks to the helpful attendant!

Awful service!! Do not go there!! This place routinely said they were changing the oil and servicing my wife's car and never did any of it. We found out later when we had a major engine issue. This place doesn't run a business at all, not sure what they do other then take your money.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Lunch and dinner options - amazing, they offer both vegetarian and non veg items. 

Cashiers - cheerful, engage friendly conversations and considerate of others when there is a line. 

Price - not as cheap as publix but less pricier than whole foods. Worth it in my book.

One word. ROACHES. I'm typing this as I'm leaving the hotel right now. A roach crawled from under our tv stand and to the corner of our room. Which was the cherry on top of the crumbling ceiling above the bath tub as well as hair in there. If I could give less than a star I would.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The location is close to many of the biotech and tech companies in the area. The room is updated and always smells good. 

However, I have been charged for extra nights in the past, due to careless mistakes from the check in staff.

In addition the restaurant is not very good at all and doesn't deliver to the room. Pick up only.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: BUG FOUND!!! disgusting!!! zero stars! never will i ever go here again! I order a shrimp and steak hibachi and found a gross bug in my rice. I was half way through my  rice when i round this. The manager tried to justify it by saying it was from vegetables. No matter where it came from this is UNACCEPTABLE!

I don't typically leave reviews. The pizza was pretty good. We went with the thin crust but the tension behind the bar was uncomfortable. The female bartender was extremely condescending to the male and seemed very unhappy working at this establishment which made it uncomfortable for all around.

It's over priced mediocre Mexican food. They nickel and dime you for everything. You want lettuce and tomatoes on your taco, that's .50 cents per taco. $4.00 for 2 1/2 ounces of pico de gallo. 3 pork tacos with a side of chips and pico ,19 dollars and change. There are better options locally.

The food was fine but this is probably the dirtiest Burger King I have ever been to.  There were sticky soda spills in the kids play area and throughout the seating area.  The high chairs had old dried catsup stains all over.  Hopefully they start to make cleaning more of a priority.

Came there many times for the last 3 months. Good food and nice service. You could bring your own wines.. even it is offering liquor beverages now. My favorite is OMG Sashimi roles but  other ones are excellent too. Four stars because there is an extra charge for a spicy jalapenos. Sure I will be back.

I had fra shrimp diavlo that was good but I got two orders of chicken tenders which were 11$  each and they were not good my dog wouldn't even eat them
also a Cuban panini which was mediocre at best paid 63$ which I don't mind if the food is good I've eaten here before with good results hope they improve

This place used to be great when it first opened. Now it's just over priced for under sized portions. The portion size is literally a joke. $2.50 for a kids cone that's literally a spoonful? Drive the extra mile to Do Me A Flavor. Scoops is skimpy and the service is terrible. Not to mention their hands are on the bare cones.

We were greeted as soon as we walked in.  There was a distinct smell-like a nursing home smell.  Waitress took our order, food came in timely manner.  My husband ordered breakfast.  He ordered bacon was given sausage.  The food was just so so,nothing outstanding.

My husband and I were there yesterday. I ordered open face turkey and my husband ordered the cheeseburger well done. Mine came out iced cold and his burger was raw in the inside! The manager came over, not impressed with her at all, so we paid for our drinks and left! Never again!!!!!

Excellent band and atmosphere. Bar tender ( guy with red t-shirt Christmas Eve) has been rude and complete jerk to several customers. He should not be working in any industry and he should be fired. This place deserves a five star if they pick a better bar tender!!

I admit my expectations might've been too high. Not the first time I have gone to a place that claims food awards then doesn't deliver. Burrata and beef tartare were let downs, risotto was okay. Actually came for the burger because they won best burger contest in Nashville. No burger on the menu. Makes sense.
