Paid for the $16 wash. My truck was not clean at all when I got out to inspect. And my truck was not dirty to begin with. Only reason I tried this place is because my normal car wash was closed. I will never be bringing any of my vehicles back. Not a happy customer.

Well, we came here 2 weeks ago and was very satisfied. Our room was very clean (Zoila was the housekeeper) and I felt safe here from the Covid ( I know it can be anywhere) BUT today this room is not clean and mold in the bathroom. If there is mold them they have NOT done a deep cleaning.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Greeted quickly with a friendly attitude, offered water on a hot day, waiting area and chair were comfortable.

Michelle Snyder was very personable.  Being first time customer, Michelle took a few minutes to get to know me and how I wanted my hair to look.

Initially my stay was nice, however after the third night I discovered bed bugs! Photo included, but to anyone reserving in the future be aware and make sure you check your bed. Only after I called down once and finally walked down to the front desk, did my sheets get changed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
We spent the weekend at the Inn and ate dinner twice at Krazy Kats. The service was exceptional with Audrey and her team (Max, Catie,  Erica, and others) making sure of a perfect meal. The food options are diverse and we were very happy with our selections.   The staff alone will have us returning again soon. Thanks so much. 
Luke

I just went here with my friends and her little sister and some of her friends. It was some of the worst service I ever received. When asked what we wanted he was rude and glared at us like it was annoying. He kept rolling his eyes and continued to glare. Definitely won't going back to this location. NEVER GO WHEN HES HERE.

Atmosphere- FAB. Came for a girls casual dinner. Place is soo cute.  
Food- YES YES YES. Had to try the calimari- yum. And then had three pizzas. All delicious. The nutella cake is AMAZING and we split a salted chocolate chip cookie. Desserts homemade. Will be back!

I was so looking forward to going to this restaurant. It is very clean and quaint but unfortunately the tomato sauce was terrible. If an Italian restaurant doesn't have good sauce none of their dishes are going to be that good. I will never go back to this restaurant for that reason

Another bad experience at this location. Not sure why I keep going in. Stood at register for 5 minutes. No acknowledgement.  No "we'll be right with you."  

Went out of my way to stop today. Now I'm running late w/o coffee b/c I finally just had to leave.

They've updated hotel rooms which are nice, but went to concierge lounge at 915 and there was nothing out. They def didn't want anyone in there. Terrible service from the guy in there.  Very disappointing. There are usually ladies in there that are incredibly nice and sweet.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We really liked this hotel.  The staff was super friendly. Especially a guy named Norm.  Every hotel needs a Norm.  The pool was nice and rooms were clean.  I wish the location was downtown as it is about a 25 min drive.  But it was very close to the airport.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Staff was very nice but first hotel room was very dated and had horrible mildew smell and candy wrappers on the floor.  Switched Room.... odor less severe but still there.  The linens have been updated but rest of room had not been.  Dirty Grout... Rusted light fixtures.  Again though/ stsff was very kind
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The room smelled musty and like cigarette smoke. I woke up the next day with bed bug bites all over my upper body. You couldn't pay me to stay there again. I've had great experiences at other Red Roof Inn locations, but this was definitely one of the worst hotels I've stayed in.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Steven at the front desk should not be in customer service. I spoke to him twice, very nice, trying to get an early check in as I was coming from out of state and he was rude and immature and extremely unprofessional. The second time I called he hung up on me. I will never be staying with aloft again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have to give credit to a customer service manager at this location, Michael, who went above and beyond to help me. I misplaced my car keys, and he spent A LOT of time and effort to assist me in locating them. He was incredibly kind and helpful in a stressful situation, and I could not be more appreciative of his efforts.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great food and great service!  Raina our server was fantastic!  My Ahi Tuna was cook to perfection and my wife's Ahi Tuna tacos were equally delicious. The only problem I had was no beer menu. Great selection of beer just had to go to bar to choose. No biggie though.

Crazy price increase that happened in the last few weeks.  Paid over $16 for my daughter and I to get yogurt.  Went to a different place a few days later and got the same exact yogurt and toppings - paid $7.

Ridiculous!  How are you going to compete with such absurd prices.

love love love the sushi here! They also have a great steak and shrimp hibachi! The pricing is amazing, especially on a college budget! its easy to get a large meal or just a quick (15 minute take out times) snack! of course the staff could be a bit friendlier, but i respect the restaurant as a whole still!

We've now given a few attempts to this place and it's a disappointment each time we visit. Food is ok, and service is slow. I ordered the chicken house salad which is supposed to be a house favorite. I guess brown boxer suits it's name because most of my lettuce and vegetables were brown too.

Just One word, The Best  Bottle shop in state of  PA ! Thousands of Craft brews with 30 draft lines to drink a beer and fill the growlers. I will be back again & again & again ! Reasonable prices compare to other bottle shops and friendly staff. They also get every limited run products available to PA. Great job guys !

What a great place this is.    This is one of the larger Hyatt Places I have stayed.   The service has been exceptional.   The larger family room and dining area has been a real plus.  They just ran a fedex package up to my room.   The location is right in the heart of all of the sites.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Horrible.   No notice from them that they in fact have no cars available.   Totally unprofessional business.  Booked rental requesting delivery. After an hour wait decided to Uber and pick up.   No car.  If you don't get your car from airport don't go hertz local ever.   Uber.

Food is mediocre at best and a biohazard at the worst. Last time I took a trip to this restaurant my food came out cold and the employee who helped me with my payment began to curse me out saying a number of things I won't repeat here. I cannot reccomend enough to skip this location and to beg for scraps somewhere else.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The employees were kind and helpful. I felt they were trustworthy and went beyond the normal experience I have with mechanics! Definitely will be returning for car maintenance and repairs! Hard to find an experience like I had at a mechanics! Thank you John for your help!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This is our first time in Santa Barbara and decided to stay a night so we found this amazing hotel! My family was so happy with there service and how great the hotel looks! And another great thing is that they have really good breakfast! Kids and I love this place and I will definitely come back again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Sushi brothers is a fraud
Is generic and  generic at best.
Located so close to the sea and such a limited selection
Of fish the as you would find anywhere 
If you want rolls sure this might be your place 
If you want sushi or sashimi I would pass
Two thumbs down

The order was messed up. When we asked to fix it, the cashier rolled his eyes. We ordered a bundle box and received 6 piece chicken nuggets instead of 10. We also ordered a salad, and we had to ask 3 times to receive it. Overall, the cashier was just rude and the orders were just messed up. Don't recommend.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place is FANTASTIC! Booked a Lamborghini for my husband's 30th birthday. Car was flawless, Jonathan treated us like old friends, and we had a phenomenal day on the road. Definitely think this will be his annual bday present going forward (I set the bar too high for myself lol)

Just got breakfast.....big mistake. The lady was friendly but the food is awful. Tried the chicken sandwhich, first the croissant was burnt and there was no bacon. The chicken was barely cooked and had a nasty black spot on it. Tots were soggy. Ill hold onto the chicken incase I need to gross someone out later.

Do NOT waste your time or hard-earned dollars on this "Pizzeria"!! They serve very bland pasta, uninspiring pizza, and have a very boring menu.
There are so many other restaurants in Nashville that would be better. Actually, ANY other restaurant would be better! Another Nashville FLOP! 
I give them a year....

When you ask for fresh cookies and get told no! Then they make your food sloppy as fuck. When did customer service decline, what happen to having it my way? 
Oh yeah I remember when you start paying incompetent people $11.00 a hr and your crew consists of a bunch of crack hoes that always look strug out.

Great barber shop. They take the time and care to make sure you walk out feeling a million $$$. I just walked in off the street and straight into a chair. Best $25 I've spent in a long time. And don't be shy to ask for some local NOLA secrets, they give great recommendations. Thanks again for an incredible experience.

If I could put zero stars I would. This place is  VERY unsafe and sketchy. I read other reviews online about this place before I booked. When I got here it was the complete opposite and very disappointing. And there are drug deals that are happening right outside and cops drive by about every 10 minutes because of how unsafe it is.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We lived at Stewards Crossing for 7 months in between selling a house & waiting for the completion of a new build. Office staff at Stewards Crossing are friendly, helpful & knowledgeable. Maintenance people very responsive. Grounds kept clean. Variety of ages live there. We had a good experience-- we recommend Stewards Crossing.

Have always been treated great at Dobbs...they get me in and out in a timely fashion.  The things they recommended were things i knew that i was overdue on...and gave me a great price and the work was done perfectly...what a breath of fresh air..save yourself the trouble and just go straight to dobbs so its done right.   J
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The wings at the hotel used to be really good; not any more. We went there yesterday, and I have to say that they were the worst wings that I have ever had. They were tiny and not very meaty. The side sauces were no better than the wings. If you are going out for wings, go somewhere else!

Not sure why this place is even in business. The credit card reader never works. Even if you do get the wash to work, usually only one dryer works. It is in a convenient location, but rarely everything works. The management does not respond to calls or left messages.

First and last time here! I order 3 tacos and a menudo, everything was horrible! The tacos were plain no flavor at all and the menudo was sour! I wouldn't recommend this place even if they paid me to do so! I don't know how some people have it some 5 stars reviews! ‍‍‍

Horrible service!!! The man running the cash register was extremely rude. They were out of garlic bread and refused to make more. It was still early at 6pm. Lasagna was average. This place is over priced for mediocre food and poor service offered. Plenty of other options on the terminal, do yourself a favor and pass on this place.

Had no idea this place fried their wings and seafood in the same grease. Had a really bad allergic reaction called in the manager Kelli, was extremely rude to me on the phone, and pretty much accused me of lying. Needless to say my bank was able to stop the transaction!  Won't be back. The costumer service from the GM is TRASH!

I won't be back..... After 30 years it was ok food but it's the illegal drug use you can see there that is a great highlight. Staff, managers and owners are aware and don't care! Worst dinner ever! I am only sorry I even had to give 1 star they don't deserve it.

The carpet and wall were so wet the baseboard was separating fr9m the wall.  I moved it and saw a bug.  We changed rooms, and it smelled better, no wet floors.  The pool was closed and the lawn was badly in need of mowing.  One brick pool pillar was misaligned.  Breakfast was fine.  I would opt for another hotel in the area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Decent room at a decent price in a decent location, but I have one major complaint. They told us upon check in that they had upgraded our room. Great, right? Until the next morning when they told us we had to pay for the upgrade. What? You have to tell people this kind of thing up front. Not cool at all.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place is a joke !  the movie hyped it and if that is what your looking for you will be disappointed.  The bar tender ( she ) was real pushy and thought she was something special...... Ahhhh  NO stop down the road on 2nd at Big Shotz, that's a good time.

The waitresses here are slow and unfriendly.  They never come back to the table to see if you need anything.  If you pay in cash and want change back to figure out the tip...they never come back to the table then either.  I suggest the SHOGUN across the street.

Not awesome. Would not stay there again. Mediocre rooms, ran into hookers in the elevator, rowdy neighbors and had the pleasure of a 4am fire alarm and had to evacuate. Also- it is located about 25' from the freeway so you get to listen to that all night....all this while paying MORE than other local hotels. NOT RECOMMENDED.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The only reason why I'm giving this place a 4/5 star is because the donuts are expensive $2/e w a cup of milk $2.50 16oz cup of milk and I'm frugal. However if price is no problem this is the place to be at with over 20 different donut flavors. The interior of this place looks very clean and unique as well. Come check it out.

I've been coming here for years and ,The sushi is always great! Especially the customer service! YOKO ( our server) she always goes above and beyond with her customer service! My friends and family are always delighted to see YOKO. She's always so friendly and professional!!

The food and service was not actually that great! If you are visiting Tucson like me, do not fall for the star ratings or the nice reviews! I guess in a small city like Tucson, due to lack of great high quality restaurants, Jax Kitchen is considered nice!!!! Who knows ... To me it was below average ...

If you are interested in mediocre sushi and  mediocre service this is your place. The food came out at 5 different times for 5 different plates. This included other tables being served in between. The food was not as ordered. Overall mediocre experience at best.

Ever since McDonald's has introduced the mobile order feature, it has been a nightmare because either the employees don't know how to redeem a mobile order, or they will tell you to reorder your items because they cannot find your order. It's better just not using this feature - at least for this location.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We had issues when picking up and dropping off our rental car even when making a reservation ahead of time. We were late for our flight because they were trying to overcharge us. Their workers are do not know what they are doing and need to be given better training.

Great Bank, great customer service reps. HOWEVER, they hold your money hostage. I deposited a check and they held it for 6 business days. When I went to my other bank and deposited a much larger one , it was available in 3 business days. Even if you have a emergency and its your money, they will not release it!

I've been coming here for years and this was one of the better meals I have experienced. Yes, the bread may have been a tad over done, but you could recognize and actually taste the rest of the ingredients. Pleasantly surprised. I'll be back..... but that's only because I really don't have a choice.

I  am coming to this hair salon from 12 years. Totally luv this place and their services. Michelle is best in evening everything from magic perm to highlights hair, wavy hair got everything done from here. Every time loved my look. 
Luv u Mitchell for making my hair look lovely always

Carlton has been my barber for about 9 years. He is a master barber and can style your cut any way you like. Attention to detail is what counts. You get that from him. I am very particular about my hair and travel to his shop from my home in Carson City because I know the kind of job he does. Going to his shop is money well spent.

Way overpriced. Only the management ever seems chipper. I've seen a few people quit. I still went there cause I live close but today I got a coffee and they charged me cause I asked for Light Ice... yeah I'm done. I'd literally rather go to Starbucks across the street for morning coffee at this point. 

There goes the neighborhood!

I wish I had zero stars and sashimi was very bad had a couple of pieces of the tuna but the looks of the mackerel well overpowering the smell like a dumpster.dragon roll was edible but the other roll was cut in way to big a pieces to even eat.do yourself a favor look else where

Ate here with my family after apple picking. We had the buffalo pizza, and it was sooo good! I took the left overs home and my mother tried some (who normally doesn't do chicken on pizza) she ate all the left overs :)
I wish I didn't live an hour away, will definitely be back though!

Of you are alone for lunch not the place to go. No personal pizza, pizzas are $18 plus depending if you add ingredients without drinks, fairly expensive for single lunch running into mid $20s. Ended up having very small salad and cup of soup $10. Won't return.

Service was great and staff were all very nice. Food was delicious. But the size of the tacos for the price was terrible. These were mini tacos that were more expensive than a standard size taco. We purchased 6 tacos, a soda, and a single beer, and paid way more than we should have. And we were still hungry when we left.

Attractive atmosphere, decent  food (nothing special) but prices are out of line.  $60 for two lunches, 2 iced teas, one small soup and tip - ridiculous!
Chicken fajitas portion was very modest and arrived with 3 tiny tortillas.  
It will be a while before I return to Teresa's.

This place over charges and makes up prices. My son paid $3.29 for a bottle of water. None of the phone numbers listed work. And this particular subway does not meet the standard of Subway corporate structure. This store blatantly steals from its customers and then hides. Go anywhere else.

Great stay in downtown Nashville! Really close to all the main attractions in and if not it's a short Uber ride away. The hotel staff was very helpful with everything we needed. Especially the front desk man, Keith. He was probably the nicest man I've ever met and was very helpful with my million questions!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Came here for a free value meal after the Bucs won. Won't be coming back - slow service, poor service, and rude kids working the counter. Asked for sauce, greeted by a blank stare and an open mouth "huh?" Rinse, repeat, and eventually (and bewilderingly!) given ten packets of barbecue sauce - one for each nugget, I guess.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Horrible customer service - I live 2.04 miles from the restaurant and they wont deliver even though the website clearly states $1.00 for up to 3 miles.  When I told the lady the website confirms they deliver up to 3 miles and I am under that she rudely said she would deliver but it would be even longer (1 hour) - NO THANKS!!!!

Staff is super friendly. The drive thru line moves so slow. SO SLOW. There's days where you will sit in line over 30 mins, that's if you can even get in line because a lot of times the line is on the street.  So if You're in a rush to get to work or anywhere, definitely go inside, That is If you can even find parking.

Very concerned for child safety! They have children run in the parking lot in front of cars,in front of the strip mall,there are blind corners and the children don't pay attention to cars. If they ran along the fence for the gym to winghouse it wouldn't be as dangerous.kids in traffic never a good idea.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Omg never again. The beds bugs the smell when you walk in. The loud noises from the streets and thin walls. DONT GET A BALCONY ROOM. The doors don't lock and it's connected to people next to you they can walk right in your room. Staff was friendly except Kevin. First and last experience with thy place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I've enjoyed every one of my stays with this hotel.  The rooms are kept clean & I love that every room has a balcony with a nice view.  The free morning breakfast is nicer than most- offering Made to order eggs/omelets.  

The elevators are a little slow, but all together I always stay here when in Philadelphia.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Been going here for years, always very good. However, last few visits, food was not good. Fajitas, my go-to dish was bland, dry, and tasteless. Friend said his steak fajitas were not seasoned at all and were very bland. Disappointed because we go there often as a family and teenagers go with friends at least once a week.

They can be difficult to work with as far as accounts go. If you want more than one checking/savings account they have a ton of criteria you have to meet that other banks don't require. So I would say they're not really into helping you budget your money and stay financially responsible.

BEWARE: Don't rent from Avis at this location!  We got a car that smelled like smoke, had barely functioning lift gate, etc.  When my husband complained, he was told they (corporate) would look into only to be billed for $1200 !! for damage we didn't do.  We'll be pursuing this, but what a load of garbage from this company.

From Chicago but read good reviews about this restaurant. Took my family there for dinner while visiting Tucson. The reviews were very accurate. All of the food ordered was great and reasonably priced. Our server was also very friendly and helpful. We will definitely return next time we are in town.

My best friend and I were excited by the other reviews we read, but were pretty disappointed. Neither her pedicure or my gel- mani were what I would call inexpensive. The prices were average at best. My gel mani started chipping and cracking within a few days.  Was not pleased with the product or price.

The only place in town on a Sunday night without an hour and a half wait. I was able to get a seat right away, but it definitely wasn't worth it. Our food was awful. Clam strips were overcooked with old oil. Tuna tacos were undercooked. Coleslaw was wilted and definitely out of a can.

Awesome place to go eat with the family! Great pies!! I highly recommend coming here when your in town. The service was excellent and the prices are decent as well. The restaurant is very clean and I caught a glimpse of the kitchen. It looked very clean! Just go!!!

If you want to be ripped off go to Pops Cones. They really give you NOTHING! It terrible Ice cream too. My sister, who is gluten free, asked for mint chocolate chip but received cookies and cream. Wanted to support a local business during their opening week but  I WILL NOT come back.

This is my new delivery favorite for pizza. The young man on the phone made it easy to have confidence in my pie being pert near perfect and it was. I ordered the Xtra large, five topping; meatballs, green peppers, mushrooms,xtra schmeez. The crust was thin and homemade. The even added garlic butter to the crust. Yummas.

The sushi house was the beat sushi my wife and I have ever had. We have eaten at multiple different sushi locations in the Philadelphia area and New Jersey and Sushi House just blew every other place out of the water. We can't recommend this place enough and already are planning our next order.

This Dunkin has made me a Dunkin coffee convert. This week I have had Dunkin coffee at multiple other locations and this location is the best. The coffee is strong, but not bitter and very smooth. Not only that, but the woman at the drive thru is always so nice and chipper.

Slowest "service"'I've ever seen. 1 car in the drive through and my order. My food sat in the window for 5 plus minutes. When I asked a worker if she could grab it, she told me it wasn't her job. Oh and the cook laughed and said "I burnt those." I won't be back

Food quality solid but EXTREMELY slow service.  Took forever just to get someone to take forever and then it took forever and a day for the food to arrive.  Maybe they were short staffed on a Sunday but I was unpleasantly surprised that an airport dining establishment could be this slow.

Who knew SP was the place for Mexican eats! Stopped in on a Friday night on a whim and was lucky to snag a table for one. Very friendly and efficient service. The al pastor tacos were delicious. Can't wait to come back with hubby in tow so we can try multiple dishes. Reservations recommended on the weekend.

Don't go to Tucson often, but, when I do, Teresas Mosaic is an absolute must-do. Stopped in yesterday with my wife and kids, after spending the day out and about, and enjoyed a delicious meal along with excellent service, provided by our server Reanna. Looking forward to our next visit. Order the mole!!!

Love Piada, but this location disappoints.  Spicy Tuscan Salad was okay with crispy chicken.  Calamari was terrific, while the Cannoli Chips were slightly stale with hardly any powdered sugar.  The kid at the cash register had human interaction skills on par with a gorilla.

I've been going to this location for a few  years now but I'm finally at the point where I will inconvenience myself and go to another location. The ATM is always broken as well as the "penny arcade". It's this location that I have constant instances of broken equipment or simply out of money.

New owners really cheap out on both mix-ins and amount of ice cream, if I'm paying that much for ice cream I'd at least expect my money's worth. Honestly just hit up any other marble slab. I usually go to this location cause it's convenient but I'll go out of my way to avoid it now.

I love this place. I'm a regular on Saturday or Sunday mornings and the staff is always friendly, fast, and good at what they do. The coffee is good (pricey for a half lb - but good) and the pastries don't disappoint. It's an added bonus that dogs are welcome on the first floor so I can bring my pup with me whenever I go.

I used to be a big fan. I would've given 5 stars. Lately, I was disappointed 3 times. The main issue is their rice. It's too mushy and vinegary as though the owner isn't checking the rice every day. I wonder who is making it... I know they can be better. I want them to make a big come back!

worst eye care professionals (if you want to call them that) i have ever seen!!!! made appointment came in 5 days later then they tell me that my insurance was an issue..... i am retired navy with tricare/humana insurance ..... have never had a problem with military insurance. don't go there!!!!!!!!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The food was ... passable but the service was terrible. It's a seat yourself restaurant. So we did. Unfortunately, it took forever to get the table cleaned off. It took forever to get menus. It took forever to get drinks. It took forever to get food. You get the picture. Only dine there if you have a delay and have plenty of time.

I placed an order for pick up during the pandemic  attempting support local. My order in total was 71$ and 3 of the rolls were missing. I would greatly appreciate the manager contacting me to make this right. This was me and my boyfriends date night and decided to splurge only to find 3 rolls missing

I worked for them about 4 years ago and it was fun. I'm now a police officer and decided to stop on the way home. They use to give a discount to first responders and military...not sure when or why they stopped. I asked the girl at the window and she didn't know either. Disappointed to say the least.

If you're ever at their east side location, be sure to pick up some of the Chicken Dumpling Paste. It puts the ASS in Casserole. If you find yourself unable to finish it, get a to go box and bring it home. After a couple hours you will have plenty of spackle to fill any old nail holes in your garage.

I travel all over the US, and I like going 
to a real Barber..I checked out Nashville
Barbers and this was nearest me.
I called (they take credits cards).
Just walked in..very clean..I needed 
a beard trim, good job. Will make it the place for me anytime in Nashville.

Nice look, respectable service, food was underwhelming. Steak was grey looking like it had been cooked the day before and steamed or microwaved before serving. Certainly not what I expect from a $30.00 plate. Having said that the veg was good, wife's noodle bowl was average and kids' grilled cheese were excellent.

Our party of eight had a nightmarish experience at Moro. The restaurant was empty, but our meals still took forever. Then we had to send most of the meals back because the food was inedible. Then the manager and waitress were rude to us. And if that was not enough, our car was broken into and robbed. My advice: stay away.

Wonderful place to stay...!!!
Atmosphere, staff, bar, food, drinks, check-in/out, valet, and was great. We're looking forward to staying there again..!!  The contemporary style was energy inspiring and a great location..!
A sexy vibe, staff friendly, guests sharp
and youthful... room was clean and well appointed..!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces
