text: I'm in town for a one day meeting and wandered here from my hotel.  It's a cute casual place offering a yummy menu.  From fried green tomatoes to pork chops and so on.   I don't order burgers but I had  a lion burger which was the best combo of sweet and   savory at the same time. YUM!

If you love being able to hear and smell everything from the apartments around you, struggling to park in front of your building, having your AC break more often than it should DURING the coldest and hottest months, or having a damp dryer from the person below you, this is the place for you!

This Planet Fitness is getting dirty ... I have seen the staff clean, but its only surface with not much effort.  And I would say 80% of the members are not wearing masks which is very concerning to me.  It will be just a matter of time until this gym shuts down, so unfortunate.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Their food is ok. The delivery service is awful. I have ordered from this restaurant  through yelp24 multiple times and the last three times the order took over 1 hour and 15 minutes to arrive just 1 mile away. The only compensation offered for the inconvenience was a "free" soda. Not acceptable!!

Gogo Sushi is my Gogo to at lunch.  Nothing satisfies quite like the Stop Drop Roll.  I always add the edamame.  Sometimes I have to add a Miso soup for good measure.  Yum!  Always fresh and fast.  The staff are always so friendly and helpful!  They have a customer for life!  :-)

I was so excited to eat my first bagel mini of 2021, but quickly became disappointed when I opened the bag and saw mold all over it. This is a serious  health issue and very concerning, especially during this troubling time of COVID-19. Please fix this. Sincerely, A Disappointed Dunkin' Customer

Wanna go deaf? The annoying, overly LOUD "background music" is so in your face that you can't remember what you're shopping for. Truly a stupid tactic, and that matches well with the awareness and intelligence levels of the store employees. Every time I'm in the Exton Ulta I get pissed off.

Only comparatively, it's busier, but not nearly as good as China Garden, across from Home Depot.  1/3 the filling in Crab ragoons.  Less than 1/3 the meat in Hunan Beef.   Both were very bland.  A red pepper on the menu suggests spicy.  Nope!  Hunan is very gentle at both places.  As gentle as teriyaki, with less flavor.

Showed up at 10:40 pm (closes at 11) and they already locked the door. I asked the employee collecting carts why so so soon and was told they decided to close early for no reason. This grocery store always finds a way to let you down. Never a good experience here. Go somewhere else.

Will never go back. Customer service is awful. Took 1 month to get contacts I ordered. In regards to an issue I had with previous purchase no help at all finally Johnson n Johnson took care of the issue.
Will be looking for new vision care. I'm done with Optical Outlet!!!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The baristas are friendly here but they get my order wrong every other time. They always seem to go up a size and when I asked about it the manager said its only a small price difference. Nice scheme they have going on. Make sure you ask for a receipt. That's the only time they get it right.

the girl taking mg order was an absolute menace, was rude for what??? first of all, why put a pic of dr pepper on the sign and then in the worst way possible say you dont have any. be more respectful, like girl you literally work at mcdonalds... super long wait and was so rude at the order thing & the window.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Good food, HORRIBLE SERVICE! The manager was one of the rudest person I had to deal with. Yelled over the counter, where she had guest! As I walk out the door a server a woman with short/no hair says "get out of here!" As I walk out. I will never return here and will not recommend to anyone!

This was my first time going to a beardsmith. They were referred by a friend and I am blown away. The important thing is quality of service which is amazing. Add in friendly staff, quality products, fantastic atmosphere and it all adds up to = I found a new favorite place

This is far from italian restaurant. Chicken marsala was made with canned mushrooms, gravy-like non-tasty sauce and served with pasta covered in tomato sauce. Had a few bites and left the rest in a plate. Uncomfortable booths, unpleasant staff. Dissapointed about this little place.

Best pizzeria in town! Fast seating, great service, great atmosphere. The wonderful assortment of healthy pizza is great, and some great meat pies also (my favorite). The price is normal for Carmel too. A great selection of beers rounds out the experience, definitely the place for pizza on the north side of Indy!

I wish I could give this place 0 stars, the food is cold and old the service is the worst I was talking to a manager and she walked away from me when I was trying explain myself like I was a child she should be fired. You should not treat customer the way she treated me.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Hotel is old and it seemed as they didn't put on the AC. It was hot and humid throughout the main areas. Also, room was discussing. I had multiple bites from some insects after I stayed there. Also, Tv didn't work. Called in and they did not correct the issue.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This location repeatedly makes people wait 15+ minutes in the drive-thru line until people start leaving; typically people need to multitask at a drive-thru, not handle one order at a time. If I were a manager or owner of this location, I'd be appalled at the number of sales that are lost due to poor service.

Tomato pie was a huge hit after my 
son's baseball game.   I agree with others that it is a little pricey, although for time and effort it saves me, trying to make many boys happy ... the tomato pie worked and was healthier than chips.     It's easy to add your own toppings at home if the boys want different toppings.

Nothing special. Measley little chicken's only saving grace was seasoning but even that was only decent. Entire entree was dry, especially the noodles, almost devoid of sauce. Margherita pizza was not good. Additionally, please note there is a difference beteen crispy and burned. Not worth the money.

Omg!! A most! Owner Jim... amazing.  Sweetest man ever! The staff is just as amazing,  Kelli the manager keeps out all together,  Lindsey is always fun.  The food is  outstanding and the beer is cold,  seasonal and a perfect end to your day.  Please visit Jefferson's and give your outlook on your experience

Food is fine, but my goodness 
Giovanni, clean your damn restaurant.  On this fine day, the kitchen was a utter disaster and didn't look to have been cleaned in a week.  The patio was an mess, and frankly the place just looked under staffed for a sunny (and busy) Saturday afternoon with a World Cup crowd.  Get it together Giovanni!

Support our small businesses, but DO NOT SUPPORT THIS ONE. The owners are rude and their behavior is completely unacceptable. They clearly don't care about their customers or their business. Spend your $10 somewhere that shows compassion for children with disabilities and their families!

ordered from here for 1st time since quarantine for our anniversary 43 yrs  food done in timely manner delivery dropped food had to throw most of it away was told from friends and family call and complain but don't eat any food they will probably not be good just upset that this is the normal no more honor in the restaurants

This was the most disgusting gym I have ever been in. The shower had black and pink mold, some of the toilets were backed up, and the other physically was not hooked up to flush. The staff was friendly enough, but that doesn't make up for the dirt and grime.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I really think they changed owners, food has been awful for several months now. Deliveries are usually wrong and food hasn't tasted the same. The Lo Mein was sooo greasy and the General Tao chicken had bones in it. We use to order from them all the time.. never again

The customer service /fraud department is not for the customer and they blamed me for a charge that was not mine. I had.Been  a loyal customer over 10 years . I will never open up a Bank of America. Credit card and think I know at  age of 50 what I charged. They suck

Staff is nice, but can not fix a cheese pizza with half cheese and half supreme.   Does not have thousand island dressing for salad.   They can not fix what I want so why would I pay them for something I don't want.  They are trying to dictate what they think I like and no ajustments at all.

The food was really good, but red onions in Fettuccini Alfredo?  Mozzarella Fritta= Mozzarella Sticks.  Large glass areas need to be cleaned better.  The service was a bit slow but it will get better with time.  Overall, we will eat there again and I definately recommend checking it out.

The look of the salon is lovely. The job that they do is around a 7. The front of the house lady and I believe manager is HORRIBLE! She is so rude and snotty. I went with my sister and we could not believe how unpleasant she was! I may not ever return because of her. Yuck!

Completely in love with this restaurant.  I enjoyed the shrimp linguini and an amazing drink called "Brotherly Love" 

My waiter, Drew, was absolutely fantastic!  He is a master at customer service! 

Highly recommend this restaurant to anyone flying in or out of Philadelphia

If you want some cold but not too cold goodness, then this is a place you can go to while walking downtown. There were many options of ice cream and toppings to choose from. When I was there this location had excellent customer service. The ice cream here is outstanding! Hope you enjoy this as much as I did!

I would recommend this clinic to anyone. They have taken such amazing care of our pup the couple of times she's had to go in. Dr. Harris is wonderful. She takes the time to talk to us and explain her findings thoroughly and thoughtfully. I know our girl is in incredible hands when I have had to bring her in.

I'm laughing as I write this review because my boyfriend a native St Louis resident talked this place up for months and months, about how delicious it was, explaining why the cheese was so special, and WOW what a big let down. Sure it's better than Pizza Hut but that's not saying much.

The best golden enchiladas, salsa, fajita nachos, literally everything here is amazing and the best I have ever had! My boyfriend always gets the arroz con pollo and he loves it. Great service, quality food, consistent servers and your food comes out fast and hot! My favorite Mexican Restaurant in Indy/Greenwood!

Adequate is the best word to describe this restaurant. The service is good. Food is average. If you don't want to leave the hotel to get food it is fine. The pricing is a little high for sub-par food, but it's in line with what you would see at other similar hotels. Lets just say I wouldn't go out of my way to eat here.

This was my first time coming to this nail shop. I was overall happy with everything. I got a pedicure and the gentleman took his time and was not distracted by the other employees or his cell phone. It is a clean place but they seem to stay busy so I would suggest making an appointment if you can. I will be coming back!

This is a run of the mill mexican restaurant.  Nothing special. The service is slow. The prices are high for the quality of the food. I am somewhat tainted as I was a fan of Lucero's. This place just doesn't measure up. It isn't terrible, but it isn't anything to write home about either.

It's fine, though the elevator situation is lamentable and the lack of an affordable self-parking option is an annoyance (increasingly common in downtown hotels). The TGI Friday's is convenient, but grimy and greasy. Sadly in need of a thorough renovation. "Breakfast included" is nothing to celebrate in this joint.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Under renovations but none of the staff members know what they're doing and they're moving in reverse. As someone who spends majority of their weeks in hotels, I expect better from Hilton and am highly disappointed. Rooms are small and dirty, staff is unfriendly and unknowledgeable, missing items in my room upon check in.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I'm a little bummed. I paid $50 to have an interior detail of my car done after my road trip- lots of dog hair. They didn't even vacuum my back seat or floor. Dog hair everywhere. $50? I could have dropped $2.00 in quarters in the self serve one down the road. Not worth the cost at all.

Worst service today Sat at drive thru waiting for several minutes to arrive at window and yet wait even longer than at box... Order in correct no receipt in bag and no onions on my Whopper! I asked girl at window who is always there if they are having problems today and she says yep and we will be all day!

Super unprofessional workers. I referred someone to this location, and she had a terrible experience. I called immediately to find out what was wrong and after talking to some guy named James I completely understand why her experience was bad. Miserable with life type of individual and bad atmosphere.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Good service and delicious pizza! My husband and I stopped in for lunch and split a medium pie with mushrooms, meatballs, and garlic and we shared a large soda. The pizza was great! It was made fresh for us and didn't take very long. I would eat here again if back on the area.

I have no idea why this subway has such a bad rap! I went in this evening with my kids very skeptical but the man who was working was very friendly and engaging with every customer who came in! Great food and great customer service. We will definitely be back!

The service is slow, the food is cold and the eating area is filthy. I heard a customer complain to the manager and she replied " Oh well". I went to this location 3 years ago and had a similar experience. I complained to BK corporate and nothing changed. I will NEVER eat at this BK again.

Excellent food, service and location. There are a handful of good Italian restaurants in the city.  Ambrosia is the only one in Meridian/Kessler or Broad Ripple that is great. PS if your idea of great Italian is giant portions in a chain restaurant, Ambrosia probably isn't for you.

Just got my oil changed here this morning. Dom got me in within 2 hours despite not having an appointment, picked up my car from my house, and displayed throughout a great attitude and personality. Having dealt withi some less personable mechanics in the past, I appreciated this and will definitely go back for any future work.

I ordered food at 7:15 and it was scheduled to be delivered by 8:45. I had to call at 9:00 to see what the status of the delivery was. I was told they hadn't started the order yet and was given the option to cancel. If it was that far beyond the delivery window, they should have called and provided information much earlier.

Coastal Mobile Veterinary is fantastic. Dr. McKenna is a skilled, compassionate, and attentive veterinarian, and I can't say enough about having a vet come right to your home. Dr. McKenna has really helped my diabetic cat Maggie, and I'm very thankful for her diligent care. Thank you!

Current resident and Overall Terrible management and place to live. Broken elevators for months now. Pool is not maintained. No cleaning company cleaning the hallways inside the apartment facilities. Barely no parking in community at night. Sea glass building is the worst. Stay away

Very small but nicely appointed Italian/Greek restaurant.  I was craving Italian so based on the other reviews decided to try it and I am so glad I did!  Very nice and clean inside, great service, and the food was very good.  Even my husband, who isn't crazy about Italian, enjoyed his meal.  We'll go back for sure.

My boyfriend picked me up a pub sub for lunch today. Sadly, the bread was SO STALE it wasn't even edible. It completely fell apart in flakes. This bread has to be  days old or sat out all night for it to be this gross. I can't believe an employee would serve that. I am extremely disappointed. What a waste of money.

Stayed here last night to break up a 15 hour drive.  We came in around 11 pm. Every staff we came in contact with was very pleasant! The room was very clean. Free wifi was great. Breakfast was amazing! Would def recommend staying here over other places in the area!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My husband and I stayed at this Hilton and we were very impressed with everything. It was extremely clean and modern. The manager was very helpful. We are thinking of booking a block of rooms here for our daughters wedding. I would highly recommend this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Small but very cozy
The moment you enter staff is nice
Complimentary steam edamame( i love that), hearty miso soup, and oshibori for your fingers.
Really impressed, fair price
Some people might not like it, but i love the fact it's a small restaurant you really get cared for. I will be coming back again.

I come here at least once a week and they seem to always get something wrong, either the coffee or donut, i rarely say anything bc it's minor things like chocolate donut instead of strawberry, or the wrong size coffee, but it's still annoying and it's every. single. time. the food is good tho and it's not that long of a wait

So I wake up this morning really really wanting a good sandwich to eat before my tournament so I went to Starbucks and little did I know I was going to get an egg sandwich with a frozen egg on it. I would've turned around to go get a refund but I had already thrown up from the frozen egg have to coach the tournament now

The pool was not heated, the rooms are very outdated with not enough parking near our room so had to lug everything from the back parking lot. , Little in the way of towels or toilet paper. When we opened the door the room reeked of mold and urine!! Paid almost 350 for two days in season. DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Great sushi! I had walked past this place multiple times, the outside doesn't look like much but the inside very nice. Cute atmosphere, was a little loud for a date night but it still was fun! Ordered the calamari for app which was awesome. All of the sushi rolls we ordered were great! Will definitely be going back!

We enjoyed our stay they are close to restaurants shopping. Everything was very clean and welcoming. The indoor pool was very nice. The breakfast was good. A great first cup of coffee and welcoming dining room.
We will stay here again if we are in Greenwood again
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: So, today I was walking around the river walk in Reno and found Antonio's.  Ordered the chilie relleno/ chicken enchilada combo. When it arrived, I dug in after a couple of bites, I suddenly said to myself... this is really good!  Some of the best Mexican food I have had in a long time.  Reasonable prices and excellent food!

Ordered with a coupon the other day. 
Order goes fine pull up to the drive thru and the guy asks for my coupon. I had him my phone with the electronic coupon on it. He goes "yeah I don't have a working scanner so I can't scan that so full price" 
The paper coupons have a barcode as well ‍ what was the difference?
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: No wait to order, but the food took a little longer than average for a McDonald's. I asked for my cheeseburgers plain with cheese,  but they came with pickles, onions, mustard, and ketchup. Seating was pleasant for myself and my baby daddy. Overall and okay experience for a McDonald's.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Typical Marriott, but substandard in attitude of the staff and the cleanliness of the property.  

Stepped into the bathroom and couldn't believe that they can't clean the floor of the shower better than they did.  Really amazing that the charge over $200 per night for this.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Best dry cleaners ever! My husband is extremely particular about his shirts-so we had tried 3 other places before finding this one. The people who own it couldn't be nicer, and the prices are very reasonable. You can tell they take a lot of pride in what they do. You'll be happy you tried pro cleaners.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I was looking for a new pizza place near me and stumbled upon brick house. I was skeptical because it said it was inside of a bowling alley but I seen reviews and said let's give it a try. Well all I can say is I am farrrr from disappointed. Best pizza I've had in years and the service was fast and excellent. My new favorite place.

Simple car wash and a respectable vacuum... you can't get it here. This car wash will try to upswell you on everything without even looking in or around your car 

I'd rather do it myself cause I can certainly provide my own bay attitude and service without the hassle

Check in was efficient. Physically not so great. A bit rundown. I ordered a burger from room service which arrived promptly however the meat was weird and square. 

Oh almost forgot - directly above the shower head on the ceiling was a 12x12 vent of some sort that was wide open and not able to close. Kind of creepy.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Really enjoyed my haircut here. Nice atmosphere and the owner/stylist (Robbie?) of the shop is very friendly and I haven't been disappointed. Fair price and an enjoyable experience. Def recommend it for a guy's haircut around 30 bucks. I usually call for an appt but I think they take walk ins as well.

We would definitely come back to the Clarion in Brandon, FL because the room was very clean and nice and we had free WiFi !    Hazel at the Front desk was so accommodating and friendly.  She made us feel right at home.  I also spoke to Luis and he was very helpful and made sure all was okay with us.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The staff was great and there were good happy hour deals but the food was meh and the wait for the food was unreasonable. The burger I received had 2 small dry patties, almost identical to the patties served on a normal macdonalds big mac. Disappointed with the meal over all

Love the atmosphere, drinks & food.  A great addition to downtown NPR.  I have been in multiple times and have never been disappointed!  Great place to relax with friends and enjoy a great meal!  If you are going with friends for a cocktail make it a social!  Fun place.

I come here every time hoping that the service would be better and I am always disappointed. The only thing that brings me back here is the good food. There is never an apology for the slow service or even a comp, very frustrating when you come with small children. Excellent food, but extremely slow service and kitchen.

The quality if this hotel is terrible.  The towels are so hard when I dried off I thought my skin was peeling off.  Also, the constant knocking on the door from the cleaning staff is borderline  harassment. If you plan on sleeping in, forget it.  I will not stay there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Hotel front desk staff were friendly and the breakfast was better than most by far. The room however was not to standard for cleanliness that we have seen on the many times we've used the Hyatt brand. I would not go back to the Tucson airport Hyatt unless someone could assure us it's standards have been raised.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Eclipse Car Wash has all of the amenities provided to keep the car cleaned and polished at a reasonable price. The drive thru wash tunnel thoroughly cleans my car in a matter of minutes. Really appreciate that clean microfiber towels are offered to dry off the windows, door jams, and wheels.

Every single time I come to Eclipse Bistro, I have a fantastic meal.  But, they really hit one out of the park last week when I went there for lunch and had the burger with bacon marmalde.  Yes!  Bacon Marmalade!!!  This was incredible...it could be put on dirt and it would taste good!  
Kudos and five big stars!

We have ordered pizza for delivery from this location for ten years.... now they say we are out of their delivery area........ I'm less than 5 miles away

We will not be using this pizzeria any longer.
Frankly I found it insulting.... it's an attempt to force us to use Ciconte's Gibbstown which is sub-par at best.

Really gross food. Tastes like it was made two days ago and with bland teriyaki chicken. Taste like the froze it and reheated it and poured some teriyaki sauce on it. If you are looking for great authentic asian food do not go to this place. Also payed $100 for us to all to not like it.

Horrible. I got the top of the line package and the gal doing the car, daughter of the front desk wan, told me point blank that my car had too much trash and - next time - they wouldn't clean it out. 
No coffee and the place is always empty and dirty. 
Guess what there will never be a next time.

The slowest McDonald's I have ever been to in my life. We waited 20 minutes in the drive thru. Unbelievable. Not only that but they were rude. I overheard am employee saying he'd like to punch out another customer. It even took the kid several minutes to return my change.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I have been using Park Avenue Cleaners for over a year now.  Their service is exceptional and the price is outstanding.  James the owner has trained a customer service orientated staff.  They bend over backwards to make your experience superb.  I highly recommend them.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I have ordered from B-21 for years.  Historically, their customer service and reliability were top shelf.  Three of my last four orders shipped later than B-21 committed at the time the order was placed.  Something has happened to their ability to ship orders on time.

Other reviews must be from employees. Tired, not clean - dirty towel in bathroom when we arrived. Fridge so frozen door would not close. First room offered reeked of smoke. Staff friendly, but Wyndham should be embarrassed to have this as one of their hotels.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Terrible service. Greeted by snooty young girl. Took full hour for server to take our order (we asked for a few minutes and then she forgot about us). No excuse as the restaurant was just over half full. Decent food but can certainly find better in this food city.

The pear Gorgonzola salad was excellent!  Five star salad in my opinion. We got a pasta sampler- fettuccine Alfredo, lasagne and chicken piccata. The three dishes were ok, nothing special. The piccata was the best of the three. The fettuccine was rather bland.  Prices were reasonable and service was good.

This gym needs an upgrade or a new location. It's dark and dingy looking and super small. came while visiting family members and since I have a black card membership thought I'd check it out. I couldn't even finish my workout. It needs a major upgrade. Don't get me wrong the staff was amazing and helpful. Super welcoming!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Great craft beer and pizza. Much better food and a more reasonable price than I would expect to get at the airport. I would definitely recommend it if you have time before your flight. It's also a good place to catch a variety of NFL games during the season if you are unlucky enough to need to fly on a Sunday during football season

Dr Turner is a wretch. She yells at her staff, belittles them in front of the other staff and clients when they make a mistake. If you have an issue with your staff, that certainly is not the way to handle it. I can only imagine how that girl feels from that mental abuse.

Good food is only part of the equation. When the cashier is miserable it sets a certain tone. When the cashier is literally rolling her eyes at a customer and slamming everything onto the counter, it doesn't matter how good the food is. Won't be back and this used to be one of my favorite places.

Terrible customer service, staff does not care about complaints, have messed up my drive through orders multiple times, called to let them know and the person who answered the phone only said, "ok, ok, ok." In my opinion you would have 100% better service and food from the Burger King across the street.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Horrible customer service every time my family or I go here. On 1-4-17, went in for some coffee cashier gave attitude when I simply advised I moved forward because no one had taken my order on the drive through. Cashier rolled eyes on me and walked off to get order. Very disrespectful. Due to this,  I will try to avoid this place.

I love the atmosphere of Pi Pizzeria. I think the name of the pizza I ordered was gringo 3.0... It was delicious, I wasn't expecting to like it as much as I did (Hot af thoo). They have a nice selection of beers and my girlfriend really liked their margarita. I appreciate that Pi has prices of their alcohol.

Ok, it's close to Christmas and the place was busy but the food was awful. The turkey sandwich was billed as having gravy and stuffing. Could not find the gravy and there was less than a teaspoon of stuffing. And everything was cold. I had sent back the soup and didn't want to bother with the sandwich. I will not go back.

The bartender, Andrew was great. Very friendly and accommodating! Joel Morales is the GM and he was filling in tonight-personable, friendly and made sure our visit was pleasant. As always, the food and margaritas were amazing! We recommend this place to everyone.

Second time here first time would be 4 star this time would be a zero. Pizza dough tasted like they added salt twice to it. Sub par service tonight. I'm not from New York but I've had great pizza on a couple different continents. Next time I'm in Nashville I'll look elsewhere for my pizza fix.

Please watch out with the Tucson Airport Budget.  An added charge of $250. to vacuum the front passenger and driver floor was charged. The floor had routine shoe usage. Budget told me that car was in good condition when returned. 
Will try to settle with Visa. 
very sleezy

The wife and I visited this place today for lunch, wasn't disappointed with the huge amount of rolls, all at 50% off.  We tried 6 rolls and they were excellent.  Wasn't too happy with the time to prepare the rolls, when we walked in we were the only people being seated.  The other patrons were on their way out.  We will be back!

Visited from Florida and stayed for a night. Customer service is great and the rooms are clean. Valet is overpriced, $42... really? I would just recommend parking at the Drexel University public parking garage literally a block over for about $15 overnight.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Food not bad for hotel type food. Wasn't really impressed with the Tuscan chicken with Risotto. Chicken Cesar salad was good but the chicken nachos were awesome. Wait staff greeted us and sat us promptly. Atmosphere is nice with lots of windows giving it an open feeling.

Good car wash, worth the money... Only complaint is that the hours are till 4:45 and today I was there at 4:05 and they were closed. Not the first time there were closed well before the posted hours... I go out of my way to go there, so it's a big inconvenience....

Delicious! I am a big fan of street style tacos and Bartaco knocks them out of the park! Highly recommend the Pork Belly taco, and the Street Corn Fritters! Not only it's the food exceptional so is the service our Server Johnna was honest and attentive as well as the Manager Will! We will defiantly be visiting again!

It really is a wonderful place to stay. Yes a little road weary however it was comfortable, quiet and very very convenient to everything we wanted without being on top of the noise of Bourbon Street. The staff was extremely helpful and is family owned and operated.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: It was ok. We had it delivered and that was fast; which was the best part. One of our orders was wrong, but that didn't really matter because it pretty much tasted the same. Sauces were flavorful but the chicken was weird in texture and taste. The fried rice I couldn't eat. However, the crab rangoon was good.

BAD SERVICE. Visiting from California and we rarely have DD nearby AND THIS IS WHAT I GET. You better be hurrying with your order 'cause this guy in the register will keep on hounding you: "Thats it!?"---after each order my wife keeps adding, they have to be patient. Grrrrr...

Thought I'd get ahead of the crowd this morning...by 5:25 am....not! Waited  half hour in drive thru... I wanted to get the original krispy kreme donuts...so I
It's my turn...she tells me..."we're out of the the original" wow ! The place just opened!
I got a half a dozen mix for my son...but pricey... Not coming back....

The food was terrible! Couldn't even eat the fries. They tasted dirty. It was horrible. Don't know if it was the fries giving it a bad start but even the burger was bad. I couldn't even eat but a few bites. About 5 minutes later my stomach was upset and I thought I was going to throw up. DIRTY FOOD!!!

We got a nail in our tire, and the low pressure light came on just as we were passing this Pep Boys. They had the best service, and the mechanic even stayed longer than his shift (on Labor Day) to patch our tire...for FREE! He and the manager were very nice and helpful. Highly recommended!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I was completely disappointed in all of the food that we received in our order. Both the chicken and the beef were slimy and flavorless in the teriyaki entrées. The crab Rangoon had a very odd, strongly sweet flavor that we also did not care for. Literally, threw that money in the trash!

Terrible experience with this property.  Including but not limited to- treats guests poorly, practices improper billing, has ants and is unclean. Altogether rude and unprofessional staff and would never stay here again, seriously considering never staying at any Wyndham property.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I will never go back to this subway. All of the vegetables were dry, brown, and must have been sitting out for ever. The store had a strong cigarette smell coming from the back. The staff was completely unfriendly and I eventually just told them I no longer wanted a sandwich. I would not recommend this location.

In town and took in the Lights exhibit at Cheekwood.  Were able to get a seat on the patio for dinner.  Great service, very friendly staff.  Flatbread was fantastic.  We tried 3 of the entree salads, all great, homemade dressing on each was excellent.   Highly recommend for food, ambiance and service

Tell me why I keep going here ‍I've been extremely disappointed at their service several times in a row. I served my husband and I wine the entire night.... why do we have a waiter! Whome I saw but twice all night.I'm extremely disappointed. Never again! D-U-N

have been frequenting this place for years even when they were at the other end of the strip by Winn D - my go to for fast Chinese/American cuisine - General T's chicken, Special Fried rice and their take on Buffalo Wings are my usual order for my fam and if overdoing it...the steamed dumplings - consistent and delicious

Complete lack of professionalism and quite frankly, I don't feel that anyone inside this office has any care for animals at all. 
I had to wait over a week for my dogs antibiotics and only received them because of constant follow up on my part.
DO NOT GO HERE.

Extremely clean hotel, hotel staff is beyond nice and will accommodate any and all needs. My wife and I were on our honeymoon and the hotel upgraded us to a suite and gave us $150 towards room service and surprised us with a complimentary bottle of champagne. No doubt I will stay here again when I return to Nashville
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Tacos are awesome! Burrito awesome. Been waiting to find a restaurant like this in the area for a while. Cant wait to dig into the menu on my next visit. Actually, eating the rest of my order from last night.... wish I had more of it. Love how there hot sauces have a nice stank on it. Really adds great flavor to your meals.

Great barbershop. Larry is fast and precise. He used a straight edge razor on my neck and sides.  Nice touch. I was very happy with my haircut.  $13 bucks is hard to beat.  Don't worry if people are ahead of you.  Worth the wait.  This will definitely be my spot as long as I"m in the neighborhood.

Awesome! Best pizza in Santa Barbara and all of their other dishes that we tried were delicious. Apparently the owner used to make pizza at a famous Brooklyn pizzeria. He must be the Yoda of gluten because the bread and focaccia they also make in house beats every bakery in town. Go check it out!

Clean and decorated nicely. Feels like a luxury salon but prices are fair. Tam did a wonderful job on my deluxe pedicure. They've only been open 5 months and it seems people don't know about it yet, because I walked right in on a Saturday afternoon and they took care of me right away. I'll definitely be back (with friends)!

STAY AWAY ALL WHO READ 

coffee - terrible, not how you want it, watered down and  flavorless 

Service- terrible, i was given the wrong order and they gave me the wrong things TWICE. Woman rolled her eyes 

Management- no one was wearing gloves, all were half - masked.

Have been here 2 times now and both times the service was poor. The first time I placed an order for carry out I waited an hour, went there and they hadn't even put the order in. This time I waited an hour and a half. They told me 45 minutes, I waited an hour and another 30 minutes in the restaurant. Great food but slow service.

Just an FYI, despite the sign in the front window, NO ONE on staff (except for the housekeepers,) wears masks in this hotel. When I asked about it, pointing out the sign in the window. The woman at the front desk said it was "encouraged" but not required. She apparently was not taking that encouragement.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Did a good job, but totally ignored my request twice. Asked for a scissor trim around the sides and back, then went a buzzed the whole thing. Asked for a 1/4 - 1/2 inch scissor trim on top, went and cut an inch and a half off. Got a military cut when i asked for a trim. Disappointing for $42.

Showed up for dinner with party of four and restaurant looked empty. Asked for a table and said we couldn't have one unless we had a reservation. Hostess didn't apologize or provide option to wait for a table, she didn't seem to be concerned about our desires at all. Won't come back or recommend as the don't seem to want business

The server Yvann was terrible and the chicken was undercooked / pink inside. The drinks were overpriced and watered down.  Only the guy bussing tables took care of us. He and the fried oysters were the highlights of the night. This was truly an unenjoyable dining experience. We won't be back.

DO NOT STAY HERE!! But if you're the type of person who likes blood stain on your bed sheet, dirty pillow case; overall disgusting and nasty then you just walk into heaven! Enjoy!!!! Do not trust review on Orbitz!! If we would have known how dirty this place was , we wouldn't have booked. What the HECK!!! (( I ALMOST THREW UP ))
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Worst service I've ever had. An hour in and the waiter never even took our order. Manager was too embarrassed to even come over and say anything.  I'd give it zero stars if I could. Next time, at least have the decency to stop by the patrons table to have a discussion why the service was so horrible. Grossly unprofessional.

We went to several Lucky Perks in the area while visiting from out of town. We had great experiences everytime. Our last visit to this location we dealt with Ellen. She was horrible to us; unfriendly and rude. It was honestly unbelievable. Ellen was terrible to us, for no reason. Will not be back because of the way she treated us.

Had a great experience with Phil a month ago.  I brought my '87 4runner in for a full inspection.  He billed me very fairly and didn't nickel/dime me for minor adjustments throughout his inspection.  
I plan to keep Phil on speed dial as long as I own these Toyota's, and live in town! 
Give him a call!

If you want a store with litter strewn about the entrance, an outdoor ashtray full of week-old cigarette butts, unhelpful and unfriendly staff, and a general unclean feel, the this is the place for you. You may especially like the dust collecting on some bottled and canned goods.

They told us a hour and it came a hour and 45, food was cold and when I asked for them to send me a fresh pizza they said wait to talk to the owner. I called back 20 times and they never picked up the phone. Was suppose to come with a 2 liter and I got 2 standard soft drinks. This was disgusting all the way around.

This is a hidden gem in the city. The food is spicy and authentic with a suburban charm that is welcoming and clean. Specious dinning environment makes you feel comfortable and the perfect lighting allows you to see the beautiful yet simple presentation. Take a moment out of your evening or day to enjoy this fine restaurant!

Best barber shop on the Main Line.  Great team and fantastic owner.  Went in for a birthday trim today and Mr. John wouldn't let me pay!  Turns out we share the same birthday!  Such a kind, generous and completely unexpected gesture.  I'm a customer for life!!  Thanks John (and Happy Birthday)!

Don't order from this location.  They will take your order, then 1 hour fifteen minutes later not deliver it and when you call say they are backed up and can't deliver it to your house.  Order anywhere but here.  We spoke to Mgr Naomi who talked to owner Debbie and they said sorry-it's our problem they can't deliver the pizzas.

The sushi and sashima is of the highest quality.  The raw fish was so fresh it must have been caught the day before.  I really enjoyed the white tuna, yellowtail, and red snapper.  Also, they get very creative with rolls.  Tried rolls I've never heard of and they were delicious

After 2 1/2 years of going to this place.  I am done.  I believe the entire customer service experience has been compromised by 1 very rude and unprofessional receptionist.  I will be asking for a copy of my dogs medical files and we will not be going back.

Food is okay.  Basic Chinese takeout.  The biggest problem is that the food is never ready.  Go when ever you want to get you food after you place the order because no matter what they tell you you will be waiting for 10 minutes.  I guess this could be a positive because food is still hot by the time you get home.

The donuts at Holey Schmidt Donuts are so delicious and so fresh!  My only complaint is that they have vegan donuts but only on Tuesdays.  I am so happy that they include us vegans in their menu but wish that they would have them on a weekend day when we typically go downtown.  That would be perfect!

What a great find - a remarkable selection of wine - something for everyone from "weeknight" wines to collectibles . Brian is so knowledgeable and genuinely helpful. And he doesn't make you feel inferior like some high end wine shops do. Love this place - I can never walk out with less than 4 bottles.

No thank you . Nice ambiance, nice outdoor seating. Good salsa and awesome chips but below average food especially if advertised for a family run place . Food lacked flavor. I wouldn't return for the food . 
If I returned it might be for a few drinks with salsa and chips .

We are visiting from out of state went in there to see if he could fix my glasses the temple was loose... Besides being small and crowded people behind the counter didn't look like they cared about their job I walked out before I could even get help I figured I'd go to a bigger business .
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I went in for a car wash on a week day because I had about an hour and a half before my next business appointment.  I splurged on the Express Interior package ($39).  That was a mistake.  Not only did the guy do a marginal job but it took well over an hour to complete the work.

This place really does make me happy.  When you walk in it is not the cleanest or prettiest sight, but if you want a good workout, it succeeds in providing just that.  Even though it is not the most well run place, the staff and ready-to-use equipment is more than enough to make it worth checking out.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I don't understand how a pizza covered in olives can be bland, but mine was. The sauce lacked both salt and flavor. I suspect that the mushrooms were canned and crust was pre-made. I actually threw most of it away.  I would have given it a single star, but service and delivery were super quick.

What a place - looks good from the outside - but wait until the music starts - Franklin Manor is out of control!  I have North facing unit 15 floors up and it's unbelievable the amount of noise you have to try and live with!  Can't wait to get out - Beware!!!  The staff are great but they don't have to NOT sleep here!

This was the worst hotel I've been to in a long time. Got bitten by bedbugs. So gross. I caught one on my arm before I went to bed and still fell asleep hoping it was a loner. Unfortunately they woke me up in the middle of the night with more bites. Disgusting. And painful.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: What a great find in an otherwise touristy zone. I was switching trains on my way to NYC and needed to find some place to kill time before my next train. The space was super chill and amazing. The coffee was great. The people were super friendly for a hipster coffee spot. I rally love this spot.

In town for the weekend looking for a nice meal with my mom. Came for a 5:30 reservation and the place was already bustling. Had a lovely meal with the most excellent ceviche we have ever had for an appetizer. Prices are very reasonable and the menu is fresh and well thought out. Would definitely recommend!

Excellent services as usual from the folks at Enterprise. The transaction was fast and there was no hard-sell to buy add-ons (insurance, GPS etc.). They ended up upgrading us to a better care for no cost. All in all, a great place to rent from. Outstanding customer service.

I've been here twice now, and both times the food and service were great. It's nice to be able to call and get on the waitlist beforehand, we had no wait when we arrived. The meatballs were a bit too spicy for our little one, but they brought out a new dish for her very quickly when we let them know. I will definitely go back.

Fun and tastefully-tacky themed restaurant that uses good quality ingredients in an entertaining menu.  They do serve beer and the mac-n-cheese with chili makes for a good appetizer to share (also comes with sweet potato fries).  This place makes for nice diversion from the usual sit-down places.

Amazing find in Wilmington! Grandma's gravy dish is amazingly delicious. Staff is friendly, space is small but super accommodating. Definitely a must try here! 

The place to go if you want traditional Italian! If you're in town for business, this is delicious and best meal I've had all week!

What was delivered tonight pizza wise had less ingredients on it than a frozen pizza on discount for $1.99 for the appetizer and the pizza or soggy and extremely cold. Barely any saucer cheese hardly any capers I can't believe this place gets the high ratings it does an eatery and yelp.

Worst McDonalds I've eaten at. Requested a signature sandwich, which was advertised, and told "we don't sell that no more". Purchased the 20 piece mcnugget and was even asked what sauce I'd like... Didn't receive any sauce and am several nuggets short. Do not eat here!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: If theres a Zero Stars, I would give this place a -zero!!!  Totally screw my breakfast orders. Ordered 4 #2(sausage egg mcmuffin) instead I got 2 ham egg and 1 eggwhite delight. Ordered small 4 OJ with it and got charge for 4 large OJ. FYI....check your orders b4 you leave.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I don't think I have ever had such an unprofessional experience. Tanya, I believe was her name, asked if I was there on business. Asked who I worked for...then began to tell me about how horrible my company is and maybe I should work for a different company. From then on she just had a horrible attitude with me during check in.

Worked out perfectly for our late arrival into NOLA. Plopped our bags in a room, went to the bar to wind down. Our bartender, Nick, was exceptional. He kept up with all his patrons, as well as taking time to write down some restaurant recommendations, which we took him up on. All were out of this world!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I rented from Enterprise on my trip to Philadelphia and they were great. They gave me a car with one of those push button starters that just wouldn't start for me. Yes, I know push button is supposed to be easier. They understood and put me in a car with a key ignition. There was no extra charge and it was a class above.

We ate here on a sunday night.  The food was as ok.  The only problem was it took over 1 hr to get our food.  When we checked in with the person at the counter she said their cook had called in and they had no one to cook.  This ruined our night very unprofessional.

Absolutely delicious!!! My family and I went here the night before the Philadelphia marathon to have sushi for dinner and it exceeded our expectations. My wife and I eat sushi once a week and we are very selective. The fish was very fresh and I would recommend this place to friends and family without hesitation.

Good location but arrived in afternoon and had to wait a half hour since my room want ready, outlet port in the room wouldn't work to charge my phone, and they overcharge for parking. Rude to aloof staff not willing to make you feel welcome when it was their problem with check in. sounds like this is a recurring problem
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I love Twisted Hair Salon. I have been going to see Roxy for a few years now. She gives the best haircuts! She is super sweet and talented. Everyone at the salon is always very nice and accommodating. I have super thick hair and Roxy always transforms my poofy mess into sleek and beautiful hair.

This perfect dive bar New Jersey state in the edge of no we're ... This place is straight out of the twilight zone beautiful bar tender all the local bots and girls ....its a nice cool afternoon the sun does not warm you ... You will be need Ing some tequila shots for that. Perfect place if ur ever in this conor of the world

Something about this place just gave me the creeps. Maybe it was the beat up looking store front and the empty parking lot...or the unapproachable and "out of it" or "bored" employees...? 

Not sure what to make of it exactly, but walked in, checked the place out, and then walked straight back out. Take that how you will.

I stayed at a neighboring propoerty but came to the Sheraton Suites to make some copies of a business document.  I was very stressed and flustered but in the hands of Nadia Vaca at the front desk, I calmed down immediately and got all the help I needed with the copies.  She is an absolute gem!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place is dirty and mismanaged. They definitely are not taking things seriously since the manager openly mocks disinfecting protocol. Also, Nick, the manager, seems to always be spouting off saying racist things. Very uncomfortable to be around, especially if you're a woman and not racist.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Pros: stylish, modern, very clean, conveniently located on campus, great stuff 
Cons: no AC - the only way to get some air in the room is to leave blinds and windows opened, but then you are on display for the entire campus; breakfast - bread, bread, some more bread, and a little bit of fruit
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: A very family friendly hotel that has been recently remodeled. Stayed in a train car room and my 10 and 7 year old boys loved it.  Staff was all very friendly. Only complaint would be the Pullman Lounge and Restaurant service wasn't very friendly and definitely wasn't speedy. We would definitely stay here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I went on Veterans Day for an oil change and they were very friendly, professional, and prepared. They had an amazing spread for all veterans including burgers, hot dogs, chips, soda, and a raffle. It was really amazing seeing them take such good care if our veterans.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Been searching for a great sushi place in Nashville and this is it! Rolls are wonderful! Don't be deceived by the outside appearance. True beauty is found within! The rolls are beautiful and the flavors are phenomenal! The eating area is small and raw or I would have rated it higher

Sushi rice was way too hard. Salmon was fresh but way too thin. The fruit was not fresh at all!!! The service was horrible, waitresses just kept talking all the time, like they didn't even care about customers. Don't worth this price. Don't waste your money here.

Asked for a whopper and a frosty. Never received them, got something called a "Big Mac" instead and a McFlurry. I photosynthesis the people who go here on a regular basis. Asked to speak to the manger who wasn't even Ronald McDonald. 0/10 would not recommend
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Crap customer service!  I went in there to get a replacement card and they weren't having it...I had my 2 forms of ID.  The banker went to the tellers and were looking st me like I was crazy!!!  Made me feel super uncomfortable!  I'll never step foot in that bank!  I'm letting the manager know tomorrow how wonderful they are not!

Great little home town bar. Great mix of people every night. Karaoke is always fun to listen to and the drink pricing is phenomenal. The bartenders are always in an upbeat mood and the owners are always around and pleasant to speak with. If you've never been I highly suggest checking it out !

WORST SERVICE EVER!!! Wait times were extremely too long and that wasn't told to me prior to placing my order. Establishment looked to possibly be understaffed. Cashier was very dry and unwelcoming and never apologized for the long wait time. I will never be returning.

Do not stay here they have the worst service at the front desk! We were there for a company convention and were treated very poorly! We ordered extra blankets and they took longer than an hour to get to our room! They're rude and don't make you feel welcome at all! Parking sucks as well. Place needs brand new staff.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
There are only two reasons to go here: 

The first, you're curious. Don't be. Curiosity killed the cat...

The second: you have a burning desire to enjoy a drink with the stench of urine permeating your nostrils. If that's cool with you then this is the place.

If you're after T&A Nashville has better to offer than this.

We went there with 6 friends, a total of 8 people. I will start off by saying the waitress was very nice. The food was at best not even luke warm and average Italian. They would not separate the checks. They wanted the entire meal on one credit card. We will not be back. The two stars are for the waitress!

Normally the hilton family is great. But this non smoking room had been smoked up, and was cold, the window was broken and would not shut, although it did help clear the air.   Staff was great, they would have given us a different room but Eagle fans sold out the city.  Free breakfast was also great.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: i had never heard of rally's previous to last night. i got the chicken bite box. the chicken bites were to die for, but the seasoned fries were not at all what they were hyped up to be. also, drive thru service was hateful. but the chicken was good so it's a win.

Had an appointment at 130pm.. they told me they will be with me shortly. Well an hour later they took my car back, as it's up on the lift thingy the 2 mechanics start arguing and screaming at eachother. Now another 30 mins I'm sitting here waiting for my oil change to be finished. Safe to say I will never be returning
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Well , I was hoping for very good food , given the reviews.
When you can get roasted potatoes to have any favor at all and lemon chicken to taste like watered down lemon sauce , less then par .
The Italian at Cheesecake Factory has more flavor .
Nice people , great server ... not returning .

We found this place on yelp. This is the best fresh sushi we have found so far. I fish and owned a restaurant and the food here is good. We have been to other sushi places where you can smell the fish before it gets to the table, rotten shrimp ect. Staff is super friendly as well. We had a nice time.

Booked this hotel thinking it would have local flavor, but a couple weeks later received a call that it is now a Meridien.  Totally unimpressed when $280 per night doesn't include free internet, and it's $39 per night to park a rental car.  Hotel lobby free internet only lasts 30 minutes.  New meaning brought to "The Big Easy".
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Mr Ricky came to pick us up from our hotel and gave us the what's what of the city! Southern Hospitality at its finest! Mr Lloyd welcomed us at the counter  and added to the experience. The best overall experience I ever had while renting a car. If you're ever in town and need to rent a car, come here!

Great place for families! We have come here a few times when I visited my sister who lives in Brownsburg. They have an extensive drink menu and has options for everyone. Everyone was very happy with their meals and the food was delicious! Our server was very attentive and thorough. We will definitely keep coming back!

Room are really nice. Clean and great customer service. The shower was nice. They have all the channels on television. We were able to watch the Allstar game in the room. My son loved the waffle maker in the morning. I would definitely recommend Hampton inn to others.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Worst Starbucks Ever! The average wait in the drive through is 10 minutes, and then your lucky if they get your drink right! Going into the store is just as bad, you wait forever while the staff just stand around and chit chat. The only reason I keep coming is because it's the only Starbucks that is close to my house :-(

After a lengthy discussion on the telephone regarding what was wrong with my truck (fuel lines) i was assured that they could fix it. two days and $50 later - i get a phone call telling me otherwise....friendly enough service, but i'll never take a vehicle to them again.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires
