The service at this location is great. The person taking our order was very nice and friendly. This location is way better than the one inside Walmart. This subway has been the best subway I've been to and their subs are delicious. I would definitely recommend going there!

After travelling in the car all day, we decided to get takeout from Oggi.  It was absolutely delicious and much  more than I expected.  The chicken parmesan was wonderful and I could not finish all the spaghetti that accompanied it.  You can not miss this little gem if you are wanting great Italian!

Excellent food and service! The cipino special was incredible - a veritable seafood ambrosia! I don't know how they created so many different flavor profiles in one dish. Eddie, the server, was excellent, attentive, and knowledgeable.
Another all-around great experience. A gem hidden in Brandon!!

Will NEVER bring my son to get a haircut here again. Not only didn't he follow the initial directions correctly, left hair all over his face, and crooked lines. Recommendation ... don't hire novice barbers (The guy with the long beard) to practice on your clients. Horrible experience

Sold our room to someone for a more expensive price and took the liberty of booking us at a hotel over a mile away from where we wanted to be. Had no idea they did this until I tried to check in. Complete disappointment due to lack of communication. Will never recommend to anyone traveling to New Orleans.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I love this comfortable hotel. The staff is always so friendly and go out of their way on every occasion. The originality of the building with the  open, fresh decor reminds me of cool, quaint boutique NYC hotels. Historic and personal. When we visit our family in town... this is our spot.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Nice place, nice people, trash food. They brag about their imported Italian flour but nothing could save their soggy crust. The pizza oven bricks probably have more flavor than the pizza. People giving good reviews for this place have never had good pizza. Is this really your best pizza Tennessee?

We went to Bistro 7 because we were given a gift card. Previously we had never thought about going. We were pleasantly surprised.  The decor and overall ambiance was very nice. We had nice meal, the service was good and the menu fairly varied and you can't beat an Anchor Steam draft for $4.

First time trying Rick's tonight.  Best NY Style pizza I've had anywhere in this area!  I grew up 40 mins from NYC and this pizza reminds me of home.  We got ours with pepperoni, ricotta, and extra sauce and it was perfect.  Definitely give this place a try!  Ignore the negative reviews... the pizza is fantastic!

Food is solid at this location, but the timing of carry out orders is not communicated well. We told an order of 3 rolls and an appetizer would be 30 minutes. At 50 minutes there was still no food. The hostesses weren't accommodating or apologetic regarding the delay. There was no explanation nor remedy offered.

We reserved a car online but when I called to arrange pick up I was told they were sold out. Their national database needs to be on the same system as their local data. They really left me in a bad spot. If they didn't do pick up and drop off I'm not sure I'd use them as much as I do.

Whats the obsession with ciabata bread? I like ciabata but there's many things on this menu that should not have it. French onion soup and bruschetta are 2 of them and we had both. Unbelievable somebody would put that on a menu and serve it to paying customers for the price they give out. If it ain't broke don't fix it.

Made an appointment, in advance, for a pedicure and manicure. Disappointing experience all around. Nail tech was rude, service was rushed and incomplete, and the business of the salon ("can you work Saturday" "can you take your next appointment", etc.) was distracting.

These people are a scam they charged me 200 to clean abit of hair of the back seat hair was nowhere else it would take anyone 5 mins and two dollars to clean it and they do a general clean of there vehicles before they re rent them! I could pay someone 200 and have whole car details #scamartist

Probably the worst so called Chinese food in all of Florida never mind st. Pete...couldn't be further from New York style chinese food ....you can get better microwaveable egg rolls at wal mart that are a year past the sell by date...do yourself a favor and take a hard pass on chinese kitchen

Just orderd from Pete's Pizza for the first time. Useing  yelp/Eat24. The total time it took. For me to receive my pizza was 1 hour. From placing the order on the website. To my front door. The pizza was good . Not to sauces,still hot.. Although I did'nt receive my whole order. Due to stock issues. The service was  average...

This is one of mine and my families fav place to eat. 
I recently went in to the shop for pick up, and noticed they are doing some remodeling. Looks GREAT!
Also noticed some new employees. Wow! Service was great, very kind and polite to me and my kids.
The food was delicious as always! 
Thank you Matteo's!!!!

Stayed here one night because our other hotel did not availability.  Hotel has a nice rustic feel to it.  Rooms are nice.  Biggest issue was the water.  The shower has no option between off and nearly unbearable heat.  The tap water in the bathroom does not produce cold water.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Food was phenomenal! Visiting from NJ where we can get great sushi! Outside and inside looks sketchy but the food was great. 

Ppl have said service isn't good. Wait staff impersonal. I'm from NJ so I'm not a judge on Midwest wait staff. They were a little slow for my liking but I'd go back for sure the next time I'm in town.

My son and I came in today as a walk-in and were impressed. Everyone was professional and the shop was clean and well-equipped. Very laid-back fun atmosphere and boy can they handle a fade. Did a comb-over for my son and a skin fade for me. Took their time and paid attention to every detail. Ryan was off the chain highly recommend!

Paraffin hot stones, massage -- it's all here. Young's is a super-friendly, very clean, and relaxing salon. The manis and pedis are great and the technicians work to shape your nails exactly the way you want.  I love coming here and I've had really interesting conversations with other customers, too.

BEST SUSHI EVER!  My husband and I are picky about food and have tried sushi all across the country.  This is literally the best sushi around. We come here almost every week. Sushi tastes very fresh and price is awesome especially the all you can eat option!

I went to get the screen on my IPhone repaired and was amazed at the short time (30 mins) to repair my screen! While waiting I received a polish change and it was also very convenient and quick. I knocked two things off of my to do list in 30 minutes! I will be returning....

The food here was actually really good. Food was cooked and prepared perfectly. The design of the place was amazing and relaxing for a good lunch break. I have tried alot of sushi restaurants, but this is by far one of the best I've ever had and it became one of my favorite sushi places in philly. I would definitely come back.

Best wings I've had in this area- crispy and tasty! Pizza was nice and thin, right amount of sauce and cheese- crust was perfect!  Tiramisu didn't disappoint - this will be our go to restaurant!!! Great job! I've worked in a lot of restaurants and I'm impressed for a small establishment!

Wow! This place has a solid selection... and if you are looking for some mid to low shelf bourbons they have them at a reasonable (+$5-10 over MSRP). They have a really solid top shelf selection too, but the prices are ludicrous. Grab a Stagg Jr for $200? Or a Weller CYPB for a cool $500? For me I had to pass.

Buyer Beware!!!!!  The operator of this carwash cannot be trusted to honor valid claims about the automatic carwash malfunctions.  He directs all calls to an answering machine promising to return call ASAP.  However, he never responds.  Using this carwash is very risky.

!!!!!Bed bugs!!!!!! Checked in, checked right back out.  Also had a roach in the bathroom.  I've stayed at some seedy motels in really bad areas that weren't this nasty.  His is actually the first hotel I've ever had to check out of.   I should've listened to the other reviews!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
If you want a quiet night's rest, don't stay here. The walls are paper thin. I have a 2-bedroom suite on the top floor and could hear the baby crying all night as well the extra vocal caretaker entertaining the baby. 
The room is nice, but after working all day, I need a quiet atmosphere to rest. Ridiculous!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Location and price are good, the mattress was comfortable, and the staff was very friendly, but the La Quinta website does not point out that the site is under going extensive renovation meaning the lobby is stripped bare and the pool is closed. On the plus side, right now the place is mostly empty, so it's quiet!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Worst Dunkin' in Stl. Placed a mobile order and the main door was locked. Some days it's locked and others it's not. Was forced to wait in a 20 minute drive thru line to pick up my mobile order. It was an iced coffee. I truly don't know how they're still operating.

Walked over here, was 5min late for the appointment to get a simple men's haircut.  They told me I had to reschedule and come back another day because they close at exactly 6p.  It was 5:20p, not 5:55p.  There was nobody in the place.  Go somewhere else, these people are unreasonable.  I won't be back.

My daughter needed new sunglasses in a hurry for a trip.  Pablo was so incredibly patient and helpful.  He helped her try find the perfect fit for her needs.  He went so far as to call around to all of the other locations to find us the glasses that we could pick up right away.  We will definitely be returning.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: We came for a weekend and while the hotel is quite beautiful the noise level from the other rooms and lobby were loud, wait staff in the hotel restaurant rude. The valets seemed to be the only staff actually courteous and respectful often appearing to be the only ones with customer service training
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Was disappointed with this Hyatt, especially in this upscale area. Hotel is run down. The rooms have a nice design but after looking at several rooms in the hotel, was disappointed that I had paid more for rooms with rusty hinges, rust on bathroom bars, peeling paint, some dust. Staff was friendly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Let me tell you, sister, the pizza was really good, BUT service was extremely slow. There were only 3 other tables and the server was running around like it was crazy busy. After we had already finished the pizza, they FINALLY brought the spaghetti and garlic bread. Tbh, would recommend if you order delivery.

Terrible customer service. I drove over 30 minutes to this gym, just to be turned away at the door. In order to have a day pass you must be 18 years or older and it is $15, contrary to the "free pass" advertisement on the website. The workers were also very rude.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Don't fall for the low rates.  We rented through Costco and car was $289.  Then after all the taxes and fees the total was $450!! That being said car was very comfortable and staff was helpful.  I would shop around as all of the rental companies are next to each other at this airport.

Maria at the front desk is extraordinarily rude. I am not someone who complains, however, there was leftovers in my room from a previous guest. She informed me there was nothing she could do about the uncleanliness. I am disgusted and disappointed. I will never return to this hotel even tho I come to Philadelphia often.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Fair fare at best. Good service but food was not up to the previous ratings. The pork chop had excessive fat but was not tender. The salmon was bland but edible. The dipping bread was like Walmart  loaf bread. The unusual blue cheese and celery soup was good.

We around 1am after driving all day. The hotel staff was not very friendly. When we got into our room it smelled like cigarette smoke and old lady perfume. There were strange stains and holes in the furniture. 

On the upside, the sheets and the bathroom seemed clean.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
What I recommend: Walk in, order a large drip coffee and a muffin, pay, take your order, and then get the heck out unless you like extremely tight spaces. 

Best black coffee in town for sure and the muffins are great too... If they ever relocate to a new, larger space it would be the perfect coffee shop.

For the most part, a Subway is a Subway without many differences. However, this Subway stood out mostly because of the super friendly service we received! The food was fresh, quickly prepared and the restaurant was clean. This Subway is worth a stop for the usual reasons but their service gets 5 stars!

Really fun and delicious. The girl was making her waffle cones when we came in. I tried the chocolate habanero flavor which was amazing. But I wimped out and ended up getting the "deep fried deliciousness". Choose what you want fried then add your choice of ice cream and toppings!  Wow!  I chose peaches and cheesecake. YUM!

Cool place to hang out on a Saturday afternoon if you have about 2 hours to kill waiting for your car to be washed.

Update: at least my car is still dirty making it very recognizable ... I guess they wanted to not throw me off by leading me to a clean car!

Awful service, used the app for a mobile order and multiple times they asked if I was a DoorDash. Drive through took over 30 minutes to get through with less than 8 cars in front of me, never go to this one. Better off going to Burger King, or wawa down the street
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Prices are above retail.  Rayban glasses are actually higher then buying from Rayban...or other stores.  As high as 35$ mark ups.  Having said that....Staff was very very nice and enjoyed working with my sales associate.  Friendly, attentive, and kind....  Just higher prices.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Amazing customer service!  My elderly mother and I evacuated from Florida and had to return the car to a different airport than pickup.  The front counter waived the charges and provided us with a driver so that my mother did not have to try to get in the shuttle.  I will DEFINITELY use Hertz again!

This place is a DUMP. AVOID AT ALL COSTS. It's old, the elevator, halls and rooms smell stale and foul. A deep cleaning couldn't begin to address it. The rooms are dirty and broken down. We checked out 28 minutes after we checked in; the time it took to secure a reservation elsewhere.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Update to my previous review.  When we returned to B&V recently, the same waiter who was so gracious about the previous incident approached me to report that he had passed on my concerns to management.  I'll wait to see if they better adhere to posted hours, but for now I'm satisfied.  The food was good as usual.

15 minute drive thru wait. Only 2 cars ahead of me at 4:30pm. Hoped food would be fresh and hot. Cashier said they were short but there were at least three young ladies standing around having a conversation. Four vehicles were behind me. Poor customer service.

Made a reservation during the week for Saturday lunch, expecting to get a seat overlooking the city except we didn't. Service was not good. Ordered a burger and was probably the worst burger I have ever eaten in my life. Very disappointed as I was looking forward to come here with my family.

As the service has expanded, customer service has suffered. My recent visit ended with the male tech grunting at me as he handed back my credit card. Apparently he was late to lunch because he rushed to his car and cut me off in my vehicle to apparently go to McDonalds across the street.

I have been going to Ralph's Muffler & Brakes on Washington for a number of years with various vehicles and I have always had great service at reasonable prices. They will even install owner provided parts (no warranty) which is another plus. I can wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone needing great service at a reasonable price.

My family just ordered the schnitzel dinner with baba ghanoush, whipped feta yogurt and cucumber sides. We chose to carry out and it was such a treat! The chicken was tender and flavorful with a delicious crispy coating. Sides were a perfect compliment. All three of us loved the meal. We highly recommend this dish.

Love this dinner. Nice stylish decor. Have been several times with the family for breakfast and lunch. Love the Orange Stuffed French Toast for breakfast and the Philly Cheese Steak for lunch. They also have great coffee!  Owners very nice and alway chat with the kids to make them feel welcome.  

This dinner is a little gem!

Late arriving .  Stayed in hotel and went to bar for a bite . Ordered charcuterie board , which was advertised as having Genoa salami , prosciutto, Brie cheese and craft bread .  
I was unapologetically served lunchmeat and pita bread: Oscar Meyer-ish pressed ham and salami .  
Sent it back . Come on Chef ! Really ?
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This was a pleasant surprise! Nice decor, very friendly staff. Had a chicken salsa verde tamale. Absolutely excellent!! Seldom ever find tamales on the menu and these were made there and really good. Also had a fish taco and a marinated pork taco. They were also very good. Looking forward to trying the mole.

Ordered some Chicken with FRIED RICE, these people offered my Pork fried rice and I told them I want fried rice.CHEAP customer service gave me 4 wings and WHITE RICE which was disgusting. Bad customer service and the HOMEMADE ICED TEA TASTED HORRIBLE. Wouldn't recommend

The rooms were atrocious. The moment we walked in, there was a musty smell that stayed no matter how much we tried to air out the room. There was dust in every corner and even inside the towels. The sink also had yellow stains that washed out when we turned on the sink, meaning the cleaning staff didn't even do that.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I went to this place because I wanted to try a new coffee shop rather than Starbucks. We had a hard time deciding what we wanted, but the ladies working there were so polite and nice. The prices were cheap and the coffeeshop is cozy and nice. Highly recommend this place.

They are the most honest, fair and personable auto mechanics I've ever taken my car to. I will recommend them all the time from now on. I finally learned a lesson that I've been told about for years about the service dept. at my current car dealer, but I never believed until my last time my car needed work.

Music in this restaurant is so loud you can't hear friends talking. This is especially true now that we all need to social distance. Manager Anna has been repeatedly been asked by different parties to turn down the volume, but has done nothing. PLEASE TURN THE MUSIC DOWN!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Had a very good interaction with Jeremiah on my recent trip to St. Louis. He took care of me and took the time to ask just enough about my trip to make sure I had the car I needed - no pressure to upsell, just a considerate attempt to make my experience even better. Much appreciated. Keep up the thoughtful work!

The worst service scheduled an appointment 8 pm and they didn't start on me until 8:30pm which they closed at 9pm I pay $85 for bubbly gel un shaped nails ( suppose to be coffin nails !?! ) and for them to rush me out the salon my toes wasn't dry ( oh they got ruined ) . First time there and it will be my last time there .

I am not the least bit upset that this business is shut down!! Anyone who seeks to profit off of a business named in such a blasphemous way should never have been invented in the first place!! Jesus Christ is not to be mocked!! If I could give 0 stars, I would!!

Had a tire blown out and called ahead. Was told they had tires in my size. Got there and found out they had "one set" in my size. Also, walked in to a customer yelling at the manager "give me my f*ing keys back" it didn't get much better from there. Paid $500 for 2 tires
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: First of all Paid $70 for a facial that was done very haphazardly and she just rushing it in to finish in 30 mins.the customer service is terrible and definitely not worth going next time.Maybe only good to get your eyebrows done and even that was taken too thin after telling the attendant that I wanted only extras to be taken.

Love the pizza, but the customer service? Not too good 2 hours before closing. As a previous manager in the food service, the attitude the employees give before closing should not be tolerated. It has upset me enough to choose not to order there despite the good pizza. Customer service is a make or break for any restaurant.

Came in for a routine car wash. I used the touchless automatic car wash and my car came out dirtier then coming in black splotches were all over my car. I don't know if it was the dryer or rinse was the issue but it's frustrating to get the "Premium" wash and still feel as if I need another wash to get the car clean

Hands down the worst. Just dropped my credit card with them after they refused to intervene in what was clearly a double charge. Four times on the phone with their dispute department, one lie after another. DO NOT TRUST THIS BANK. STAY CLEAR. YOU'RE BETTER OFF WITHOUT A CREDIT CARD.

I like Ambrosia's food but their service has been terrible lately. Tonight we show up at 5pm to eat. Literally no one in the restaurant yet they turn us away because "we are all booked tonight". This is the second time this has happened. They literally couldn't care less about service. And we are (or were) regulars at Ambrosia.

Terrible; place has really gone downhill, dirty, paints peeling from side of building, looks like a dirty mechanic's shop. Ordered a CHICKEN cheese steak and got a regular cheese steak; DON'T GET THE ONION RINGS, they are just all dough... I hope I don't get sick.... very bad....

What a wonderful meal! At our table we tried the Orecchiette with Spicy Pork Sausage (FABULOUS), the Roasted Garlic Spaghetti with Florida Clams (also very good), and Pan Seared Gulf Fish (also very good).  Would absolutely do this again.  Atmosphere was great, drinks were great!

Tomo's is a great local neighborhood sushi restaurant.  The owner and staff are always friendly and accommodating. I don't remember ever being disappointed with the food or the service. The sushi is always fresh and delicious. I would not hesitate to recommend their sushi to anyone.

Ordered Sushi sashimi dinner and a couple of other rolls. All good. Service was fast. Soup and salad are so so. If you want to use Yelp 10% off discount, talk to a senior waitress. Building looks old from outside and booth bench should be updated. Young waitresses don't look friendly.

The quality of the sushi was below average, tasted pretty fishy. I also ordered the miso soup and that tasted like feet. I could only eat about 5 pieces of sushi before I got completely sick of the taste and had to throw it away. The quality and taste of the food is a true reflection of its prices.

Yeah,it's your typical dive bar.  you can smoke(a plus...I'm a smoker),play pool and they have a pretty good selection of beer on tap(well,when I was there anyway!). I love a good dive bar and this isn't the worst one i have been to! the people were friendly and service was great. I would definitely go back again!

The order women who runs the salon is by far one of the rudest and unfriendly people I  have come across in a while I can't imagine how her employees feel. I have never written a review. I downloaded Yelp for this purpose. I could not let this experience go without expressing this.

The one who work here are RUDE and slow! 
They pick and choose which day they aren't making food. Refuse to cancel an order, instead mark it as picked up. Was told to reorder drinks WITHOUT a refund from the first. 

It also shouldn't take 30+ minutes to pick up a mobile order.

The best....we visit each time we are back in TN and love the Gordonsville TN store! Great selection, awesome service and very accommodating. Sammy is tops! If you need it, he will find it! His recommendations were always great! Wish they were closer to us!

I've given this location 5 tries and am now done.  I use Blue Chip, expecting my rental to be ready when I arrive. Two times, it didn't work, making me wait in line. Another time, I was placed in the incorrect car class. Another, I was is a car that didn't start.  So, certainly not a quick rental experience.

Very cute atmosphere, albeit very small and extremely warm.   Delicious salad but very disappointed with short rib pappardelle.   Tomato sauce completely ruined the dish.  Pork chop was very moist and flavorful, but again disappointed with the sauce.   So many other restaurants to try, no need to come back again.

Family originated in Italy That's why it's SO SO Great!! Amazing brother too. The place is a replica of what you would find in the heart of Sicilia!  Oh yes you won't be disappointed I can tell you that for sure. Clean Hospitality galore and phenomenal Italian food. What more can you ask for!!!

This place is fun, cool and delicious. We were warmly greeted upon arrival. The tacos, shrimp, grilled chicken  and steak were delicious. The guacamole was fresh and creamy. I highly recommend this place if you are craving fresh delicious tacos in a fun atmosphere.

Worse experience 
I got there and sat down and was told to sit in a chair, next thing I know the man was yelling and screaming and then he told me to move over there and he was gonna work on my bio so busy tell him I want to do that a young lady came and help me. She was nice she did OK but I will never go back there

I completely disagree with the bad reviews.  For me, Pearle Vision in Exton is amazing.  Dr. Lim, Gail, Micki and the rest of the staff have always gone above and beyond.  
In regards to the person upset about not getting their PD, valid complaint and I agree, except this isn't unique to this store or Pearle Vision.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Do not go to this car wash! If you order a higher premium wash, you will likely not get the premium version. They rush your car through, very minimal soap, bad use of dry mops, bad tire shine, and so many other things wrong! AVOID THIS CAR WASH. Go to another one to assure you will not get ripped off.

Very very busy dunkin, renovated and new looking, it was very busy on Saturday morning but Vanessa and Theresa were very patient and helpful to the customers. They had about 20 drinks to make every 3 minutes but were managing very well and were patient with everyone (even large orders like us)

Spring roll was very good; vegetables were OK (a little heavy on the green peppers).  I had chicken with cashew nuts; the nuts were soggy and the chicken was bland with a slightly rubbery texture (as if it had been cooked too fast).  My order came quickly but I would have happily waited the few extra minutes for more tender chicken

I love Chinese food. The egg rolls were the worst I have ever had. The seafood special was horrible!! The fake crab was like a dough. The piece they called a lobster was so tough you couldn't eat it. The beef and garlic sauce was ok.  Very little flavor. Will not be back.

Love love love this place. Ordered carnitas and a bean and cheese burrito. Both were amazing! We met Antonio and his wife. Incredibly pleasant people. We were so impressed we came back later for snacks and cocktails. He even shared his chiliquiles recipe with us. If you are doing the Reno Wine Walk, start here!

Creative specialty rolls. Sashimi and sushi are also available. I always get the green salad and seaweed salad and beef negimaki.  I really like their fried oysters too but it's only available on the weekends. Pretty efficient for the number of people in the place.

I think this is the worst hotel I have been to. It's smells like smoke, the floors are sticky, the beds have stains on them!  I only came here because of the pool and when I checked in they said the pool was open. I went to my room and changed then when  I went to the pool it was closed. I'm am very disappointed in this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Angel was very helpful in replacing my car (had been smoked in) that I initially received at a different location. There were no questions regarding my use of the vehicle, if it was even full of gas, or questioning anything at all. I was offered a wonderful replacement that I got to choose myself. Fast service as well.

This is my least favorite Starbucks to visit.  The only person that is professional is the worker named Kareema.   Everyone else is very rude.  They talk to you in a very exasperated tone.   They act as if you are bothering them by wanting to put in your order.

The food is awesome!!!  I especially enjoy the salads and the little loaf of bread they serve with your meal.  I live in Las Vegas and go to Boise monthly for work.  I never miss a chance to eat at Luciano's.  It's an important part of my Boise visit. 
Here's a bit of advice - go early to avoid the crowd!

Place is cozy, staff is incredibly friendly! I'd come here for lunch weekly to grub on some amazing food & get some work done. Highly recommend checking it out! I've also heard the take out is very well put together, meticulous, they put their heart into every dish!

I absolutely loved the staff! They were all wonderful. They made me and my family feel at home. They all took very good care of our needs and gave us personal one-on-one attention. This is our new "eye care home". Thank you all at Clear Vision Express on Thornydale.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Poor customer service. I had a do not disturb sign on my door left room and room service still cleaned room and stole money out of room. Spoke to customer service manger and GM Dan Tobias, they were very dismissive and did not address my issue. Pretty much said that it was nothing they could do their words against mine.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I've lived at here for almost 3 years and i absolutely love the building and location! The office staff is extremely helpful, outgoing, and the events are superb. I also appreciate maintenance team and how knowledgeable and prompt they are. Great place to be!

Had "the godfather" pizza. Delivery was quick friendly and fast. The pizza was great, one of the best I've had in a long time. Crust was perfectly done, the flavor was awesome. You could really taste the garlic infused oil and provolone.  Next time I'm down this way I will definitely be going back here again!

Nous étions sur la terrasse pour le brunch servi toute la journée. Service remarquable. Le serveur (Ian) a pris le temps de nous expliquer les spécialités locales sur le menu et les petits détails comme la confiture maison. Les plats étaient très bons et le cappuccino bien réussi.

I never expected to write a review for this place but I went to the drive through and there were no cars there either. Ordered a 10 pice nugget and it took them so long. Plus when I got home and opened them to eat it, the nuggets were uncooked. I'm literally never going back there again.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: New management has let this place go. We ordered tonight and our bravo fries were pathetic. The cannolis were like wet noodle tasted like nail polish remover. We literally gagged on them! This place used to be great. Not sure what happened with the previous owners, but I'm sad it happened. Won't be returning.
